sn: महोदरं महापार्श्व विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसम्। शीघ्रं वदत सैन्यानि निर्यातेति ममाज्ञया॥
en: Mahodara, Mahāpārsva, Virāpāksa "Do you speedily speak to the soldiers that they should sally out for battle at my command.

sn: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसास्ते भयार्दिताः। चोदयामासुरव्यग्रान्राक्षसांस्तानृपाज्ञया ॥
en: Hearing his speech-those Raksasa, possessed by fear, asked by the command of the king, the Rākşasa soldiers to be ready.

sn: ते तु सर्वे तथेत्युक्त्वा राक्षसा भीमदर्शनाः। कृतस्वस्त्ययनाः सर्वे ते रणाभिमुखा ययुः॥
en: Thereat all those grim-visaged Rākṣasas saying 'so be it' and performing benedictory ceremonies proceeded to the battle-field.

sn: प्रतिपूज्य यथान्यायं रावणं ते महारथाः। तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे भर्तुर्विजयकाङ्गिणः॥
en: Those mighty car-warrior, worshipping Rāvana, and desiring the victory of their lord, stood before them with folded hands.

sn: ततोवाच प्रहस्यैतान्रावणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। महोदरमहापार्टी विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसम्॥
en: Thereupon Ravana, beside himself with anger, laughing, addressed those Raksasas, Mahodara, Mahāpārsva, and Virūpākşa, saying.

sn: अद्य बाणैर्धनुर्मुक्तैर्युगान्तादित्यसंनिभैः। राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव नेष्यामि यमसादनम्॥
en: Today shall I despatch both Rāma and Lakşmaņa to the abode of Death with arrows resembling the sun at the time of dissolution, discharged off my bow.

sn: खरस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य प्रहस्तेन्द्रजितोस्तथा। करिष्यामि प्रतीकारमद्य शत्रुवधादहम्॥
en: And slaying the enemies I shall repair the loss of Khara, Kumbhakarna, Prahasta and Indrajit.

sn: नैवान्तरिक्षं न दिशो न च द्यौर्नापि सागराः। प्रकाशत्वं गमिष्यन्ति मद्वाणजलदावृताः॥
en: The atmosphere, the quarters the sky and the deep being enveloped with the cloud of arrows shall become invisible.

sn: अद्य वानरमुख्यानां तानि यूथानि भागशः। धनुषा शरजालेन वधिष्यामि पतत्रिणा॥
en: I shall slay today all the heroic monkeys with my winged arrows.

sn: अद्य वानरसैन्यानि रथेन पवनौजसा। धनुःसमुद्रादुद्भूतैर्मथिष्यामि शरोमिभिः ॥
en: Ascending my car gifted with the velocity of the wind shall I churn today the monkey host with arrow-like waves coming from the oceanlike bow.

sn: व्याकोशपद्मवक्राणि पद्मकेसरवर्चसाम्। अद्य यूथतटाकानि गजवत्प्रमथाम्यहम्॥
en: I shall like an elephant distress today the monkey-like pools having their countenances for the blown lotuses, and the lustre of their bodies for the filaments.

sn: सशरैरद्य वदनैः संख्ये वानरयूथपाः। मण्डयिष्यन्ति वसुधां सनालैरिव पङ्कजैः॥
en: To-day in the encounter, the leaders of the monkey hosts, with their heads transfixed with arrows, shall cover the earth, like to Ictuses with their stalks.

sn: अद्य यूथप्रचण्डानां हरीणां दुमयोधिनाम्। मुक्तेनैकेषुणा युद्धे भेत्स्यामि च शतं शतम्॥
en: I shall today with a single arrow, cleave hundreds of heroic monkeys fighting with trees in their hands.

sn: हतो भ्राता च येषां वै येषां च तनयो हतः। वधेनाद्य रिपोस्तेषां करोम्यश्रुप्रमार्जनम्॥
en: I shall wipe today the tears of those whose brother or son has been slain by destroying their goe.

sn: अद्य महद्वाणनिर्भिन्नः प्रस्तीर्णैर्गतचेतनैः। करोमि वानरैयुद्धे यत्नावेक्ष्यतलां महीम्॥
en: In the encounter today I shall, with the monkeys deprived of their breath and clept with my arrows, so cover the earth that it may not be seen by any.

sn: अद्य काकाश्च गृध्राश्च ये च मांसाशिनोऽपरे। सर्वांस्तांस्तर्पयिष्यामि शत्रुमांसैः शराहतैः॥
en: I shall satisfy today with the flesh of the enemies slain by my shafts, the crows, vultures and others who live upon flesh.

sn: कल्प्यतां मे रथः शीघ्रं क्षिप्रमानीयतां धनुः। अनुप्रयान्तु मां युद्धे येऽत्र शिष्टा निशाचराः॥
en: Get ready soon my car and bring my bow. And let the remaining night-rangers follow me in battle.

sn: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा महापार्योऽब्रवीद्वचः। बलाध्यक्षान्स्थितांस्तत्र बलं संत्वर्यतामिति॥
en: Hearing his words Mahāpārsva addressed the leaders of the army who were near him, saying, "Get your soldiers ready."

sn: बलाध्यक्षास्तु संयुक्ता राक्षसांस्तानगृहे गृहे। चोदयन्तः परिययुर्लङ्कां लघुपराक्रमाः॥
en: The commanders too quickly went round all the houses in Lankā and asked the Rākşasas to be ready soun.

sn: ततो मुहूर्तानिष्पेतू राक्षसा भीमदर्शनाः। नदन्तो भीमवदना नानाप्रहरणैर्भुजैः॥ असिभिः पट्टिशैः शूलैर्गदाभिर्मुसलैर्हलैः। शक्तिभिस्तीक्ष्णधाराभिर्महद्भिः कूटमुद्गरैः॥ यष्टिभिर्विविधैश्च निशितैश्च परश्वधैः। भिन्दिपालैः शतघ्नीभिरन्यैश्चापि वरायुधैः॥
en: Thereupon began to issue out in a moment terrible-looking Raksasas, emitting roars, having dreadful faces and with various weapons in their hands-daggers, Pattisas, maces, clubs, furrows, sharpened Śaktis, traps, various rods, sharpened Cakra, Parasvadhas, Bhindipālas, Sataghnis and various other excellent weapons.

sn: अथानयन्बलाध्यक्षाश्चत्वारो रावणाज्ञया। रथानां नियुतं साग्रं नागानां नियुतत्रयम्॥ अश्वानां षष्टिकोट्यस्तु खरोष्ट्राणां तथैव च। पदातयस्त्वसंख्याता जग्मुस्ते राजशासनात्।।२८
en: Thereupon at the command of Råvaņa the commanders brought one Niyuta (a hundred thousand) cars, three Niyuta elephants, sixty million horses, asses and camels and numberless infantry.

sn: बलाध्यक्षाश्च संस्थाप्य राज्ञः सेनां पुरस्थिताम्। एतस्मिनन्तरे सूतः स्थापयामास तं रथम्॥ दिव्यास्त्रवरसंपन्नं नानालंकारभूषितम्। नानायुधसमाकीर्णं किङ्किणीजालसंयुतम्॥ नानारत्नपरिक्षिप्तं रत्नस्तम्भैर्विराजितम्। जाम्बूनदमयैश्चैव सहस्रकलशैर्वृतम् ॥
en: They arranged the soldiers before the king and in the interval the charioteer brought the carfilled with excellent celestial weapons-richly adorned, containing many an armour, girt with a network of tinkling ornaments crested with various jewels. Having jewelled pillars and a thousand golden jars.

sn: तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसाः सर्वे विस्मयं परमं गताः। तं दृष्ट्वा सहसोत्थाय रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः॥ कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्। द्रुतं सूतसमायुक्तं युक्ताष्टतुरगं रथम्।। आरुरोह तदा भीमं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा ॥
en: Beholding the car the Rākşasas were greatly astonished. And Ravana, the lord of Raksasas, rising up all on a sudden, ascended that car, brilliant like the flaming fire and the aggregate rays of a million sun, quick-coursing, having a charioteer, drawn by eight horses, huge and shining in its native lustre.

sn: ततः प्रयातः सहसा राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः। रावणः सत्त्वगाम्भीर्याद्दारयन्निव मेदिनीम्॥
en: Thereupon proceeded Råvana, encircled by many a Raksasa as if rending the earth with the excess of his prowess. arose was

sn: ततश्चासीन्महानादस्तूर्याणां च ततस्ततः। मृदङ्गैः पटहैः शङ्खः कहलैः सह रक्षसाम्॥
en: There a huge sound of bugles accompanied with that of Mrdangas, drums, conchs, and kalapas.

sn: आगतो रक्षसां राजा छत्रचामरसंयुतः। सीतापहारी दुर्वृत्तो ब्रह्मघ्नो देवकण्टकः।। योद्धं रघुवरेणेति शुश्रुवे कलहध्वनिः॥
en: The lord of the Rākṣasa-wicked, the slayer of the Brahmins-the thorn of the celestials, and who has brought away Sītā by stealth, has come with his umbrellas and chowries to fight with the foremost of Raghus-this cry heard everywhere.

sn: तेन नादेन महता पृथिवी समकम्पत। तं शब्दं सहसा श्रुत्वा वानरा दुद्रुवुर्भयात्॥
en: With his tremendous roar the earth shook. And hearing all on a sudden that sound, the monkeys fled away in fear.

sn: रावणस्तु महाबाहुः सचिवैः परिवारितः। आजगाम महातेजा जयाय विजयं प्रति॥
en: The highly effulgent Råvaņa, having huge arms and surrounded by his ministers, came there being certain of gaining victory.

sn: रावणेनाभ्यनुज्ञातौ महापार्श्वमहोदरौ। विरूपाक्षश्च दुर्धर्षो रथानारुरुहुस्तदा॥
en: Being commanded by Ravana, Mahāparrsha, Mahodara and the irrepressible Virupaksa ascended the car.

sn: ते तु हृष्टाभिनर्दन्तो भिन्दन्त इव मेदिनीम्। नादं घोरं विमुञ्चन्तो निर्ययुर्जयकाङ्गिणः॥
en: They, desirous of winning victory, issued out emitting dreadful roars in delight and as if rending the earth therewith.

sn: ततो युद्धाय तेजस्वी रक्षोगणबलैर्वृतः। निर्ययावुद्यतधनुः कालान्तकयमोपमः॥
en: Thereupon the highly effulgent (Ravana) resembling Death, with uplifted bow, sallied out for battle along with the army of Rākşasa.

sn: ततः प्रजविताश्वेन रथेन स महारथः। द्वारेण निर्ययौ तेन यत्र तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।॥
en: That mighty car-warrior, went out in his chariot drawn by quick coursing steeds by that gate which led to where Rāma and Lakşmaņa were.

sn: ततो नष्टप्रभः सूर्यो दिशश्च तिमिरावृताः। द्विजाश्च नेदुर्घोराश्च संचचाल च मेदिनी॥
en: Thereat the sun lost its brilliance the quarters were enshrouded with darkness; the birds sent forth dreadful cried and the earth shook.

sn: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवश्चस्खलुश्च तुरंगमाः। ध्वजाग्रे न्यपतद्गृध्रो विनेदुश्चाशिवाः शिवाः॥
en: The celestial poured down bloody rains-the course of the horses was slackened-the vultures sat on the banners and jackals emitted inauspicious cries.

sn: नयनं चास्फुरद्वामं वामो बाहुरकम्पत। विवर्णवदनश्चासीत्किचिदभ्रश्यत स्वनः॥
en: His left eye and the left arm began to shakehis countenance became pale and his voice grew harsher.

sn: ततो निष्पपतो युद्धे दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः। रणे निधनशंसीनि रूपाण्येतानि जज्ञिरे।४।।
en: The Ten-necked Rākşasa thus going out for battle there appeared many bad omens indicating his destruction.

sn: अन्तरिक्षात्पपातोल्का निर्घातसमनि:स्वना। विनेदुरशिवा गृध्रा वायसैरभिमिश्रिताः॥
en: From the sky fell a fire-brand accompanied with the sound of thunder; vultures and crows emitted inauspicious cries.

sn: एतानचिन्तयन्घोरानुत्पातान्समवस्थितान्। निर्ययौ रावणो मोहाद्वधार्थ कालचोदितः।०८।।
en: Disregarding these dreadful omens which appeared then, Ravana, incited by death, foolishly went out to slay his (enemies).

sn: तेषां तु रथघोषेण राक्षसानां महात्मनाम्। वानराणामपि चमूर्युद्धायैवाभ्यवर्तत।।
en: By the wheel-sound of the chariots of the great Raksasas the host of monkeys calling each other, excited with anger and willing to gain victory, addressed themselves for fight.

sn: अन्योन्याह्वयानानां कृद्धानां जयमिच्छताम्॥ ततः कृतो दशग्रीवः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः। वानराणामनीकेषु चकर कदनं महत्॥
en: Thereupon the Ten-necked one, enraged, with his arrows feathered in gold, made a dreadful slaughter of the army of monkeys.

sn: निकृत्तशिरसः केचिद्रावणेन वलीमुखाः। केचिद्विच्छत्रहृदयाः केचिच्छ्रोत्रविवर्जिताः॥
en: And some of those heroic monkeys were bebeaded by Ravana-some had their hearts rent and others were shorn of their ears.

sn: निरुच्छासा हताः केचित्केचित्पार्श्वेषु दारिताः। केचिद्विभिन्नशिरसः केचिच्चक्षुर्विनाकृताः॥
en: Some had their breath choked, some were killed and others had their sides broken. Some had their hands cut off and others had their eyes put out.

sn: दशाननः क्रोधविवृत्तनेत्रो यतो यतोऽभ्येति रथेन संख्ये। ततस्ततस्तस्य शरप्रवेगं सोढुं न शेकुर्हरियूथपास्ते॥
en: Wherever in the encounter, the Ten-headed Räksasa, whirling his eyes in ire, went in his car the monkey leaders could not stand the vehemence of his arrows.

sn: तथा तैः कृत्तगात्रैस्तु दशग्रीवेण मार्गणैः। बभूव वसुधा तत्र प्रकीर्णा हरिभिस्तदा॥
en: There the earth was covered with monkeys whose bodies were rent with the arrows of the Ten-necked (Ravana).

sn: रावणस्याप्रसह्यं तं शरसंपातमेकतः। न शेकुः सहितुं दीप्तं पतङ्गा ज्वलनं यथा॥
en: As the flies cannot stand before the flaming fire so they could not bear the vehemence of Ravana's shafts.

sn: तेऽदिता निशितैर्बाणैः क्रोशन्तो विप्रदुद्रुवुः। पावकार्चिः समाविष्टा दह्यमाना यथा गजाः॥
en: Being thus assailed with pointed arrows they fled away crying, like to elephants being burnt by fire.

sn: प्लवंगानामनीकानि महाभ्राणीव मारुतः। संययौ समरे तस्मिन्विधमन्रावणः शरैः॥
en: Rävaņa with his arrows pursued in conflict destroying the army of monkey as wind dissipate the large clouds.

sn: कदनं तरसा कृत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो वनौकसाम्। आससाद ततो युद्धे त्वरितं राघवं रणे॥
en: Thus slaughtering the monkeys the lords of Räkşasas speedily reached in the encounter where Raghava was.

sn: सुग्रीवस्तान्कपीन्दृष्ट्वा भग्नान्विद्रादितारणे। गुल्मे सुषेणं निक्षिप्य चक्रे युद्धे द्रुतं मनः॥
en: Beholding the monkeys assailed and afraid Sugrīva placing Sușeņa in charge of a gulma*addressed himself for the battle. *The division of an army; a body of troops consisting of nine platoons or nine elephants, nine chariots; twenty-seven horses and forty five foot.

sn: आत्मनः सदृशं वीरं स तं निक्षिप्य वानरम्। सुग्रीवोऽभिमुखं शत्रु प्रतस्थे पादपायुधः॥
en: Placing that heroic monkey, his equal in prowess, in that command Sugrīva sallied out with a tree in his hand to meet the enemy.

sn: पार्श्वतः पृष्ठतश्चास्य सर्वे वानरयूथपाः। अनुजग्मुर्महाशैलान्विविधांश्च वनस्पतीन् ॥
en: And followed him on all sides the leaders of the monkeys with huge crags and various trees.

sn: ननद युधि सुग्रीवः स्वरेण महता महान्। पोथयन्विविधांश्चान्यान्ममन्थोत्तमराक्षसान्।।।। ममर्द च महाकायो राक्षसान्वानरेश्वरः। युगान्तसमये वायुः प्रवृद्धानगमानिव ॥
en: The heroic Sugrīva emitted terrible roars in the conflict and assailed the heroic Rakşasas and many others. The huge-bodied monkey-chief crushed the Rakşasas like to the wind uprooting the trees at the time of dissolution.

sn: राक्षसानामनीकेषु शैलवर्ष ववर्ष ह। अश्मवर्ष यथा मेघः पक्षिसङ्केषु कानने॥
en: He began to make a downpour of crags at the Rakşasas host like to the cloud pouring down hailstorms at the bird in the forest.

sn: कपिराजविमुक्तैस्तैः शैलवस्तु राक्षसाः। विकर्णशिरस: पेतुर्विकीर्णा इव पर्वताः॥
en: Being beheaded by the crags discharged by that monkeys chief the Rākşasas fell down like to mountains cleft.

sn: अथ संक्षीयमाणेषु राक्षसेषु समन्ततः। सुग्रीवेण प्रभग्नेषु नदत्सु च पतत्सु च ॥ विरूपाक्षः स्वकं नाम धन्वी विश्राव्य राक्षसः। रथादाप्लुत्य दुर्धर्षो गजस्कन्धमुपारुहत् ॥
en: The Rākṣasas being thus attacked and shattered by Sugriva and roaring and falling down on all sides, an irrepressible Raksasa, skilled in archery, in archery, by name by name Virūpākṣa, pronouncing his own name, got down from the car and mounted an elephant.

sn: स तं द्विपमथारुह्य विरूपाक्षो महाबलः। ननद भीमनिर्हादं वानरानभ्यधावत॥
en: And mounted on the elephant that highly powerful Virūpākṣa sent forth leonine roars and dashed against the monkeys.

sn: सुग्रीवे स शरान्घोरान्विससर्ज चमूमुखे। स्थापयामास चोद्विग्नानराक्षसान्संप्रहर्षयन्॥
en: Exciting the joy of the Răkşasas and removing their anxiety he discharged dreadful shafts at Sugrīva and his army.

sn: सोऽतिविद्धः शितैर्बाणैः कपीन्द्रस्तेन रक्षसा। चुक्रोश च महाक्रोधो वधे चास्य मनो दधे ॥
en: Being assailed by the pointed arrows of the Räksasa that lord of monkeys roared in anger and made up his mind to destroy him.

sn: ततः पादपमुद्धृत्य शूरः संप्रधनो हरिः। अभिपत्य जघानास्य प्रमुखे तं महागजम्॥
en: Thereupon uprooting a tree the heroic monkeys, skilled in warfare leaped and struck that huge elephant down in his presence.

sn: स तु प्रहाराभिहतः सुग्रीवेण महागजः। अपासर्पद्धनुर्मानं निषसाद ननाद च॥
en: Being assailed greatly by Sugrīva that huge elephant proceeded a little within the range of the bow and roared and died.

sn: गजातु मथितात्तूर्णमपक्रम्य स वीर्यवान्। राक्षसोऽभिमुखः शत्रु प्रत्युद्गम्य ततः कपिम्॥ आर्षभं चर्म खङ्गं च प्रगृह्य लघुविक्रमः। भर्त्सयत्रिव सुग्रीवमाससाद व्यवस्थितम्॥
en: Being greatly enraged on the destruction of the elephant the highly powerful Rākşasa dashed forward to face the enemy. That one of quick monuments took up his dagger and armour and viling, approached Sugriva.

sn: स हि तस्यापि संगृह्य प्रगृह्य विपुलां शिलाम्। विरूपाक्षस्य चिक्षेप सुग्रीवो जलदोपमाम्॥
en: Beholding his movement Sugrīva took up a huge crag resembling cloud and hurled it against Virüpākşa.

sn: स तां शिलामापतन्ती दृष्ट्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवः। अपक्रम्य सुविक्रान्तः खङ्गेन प्राहरत्तदा॥
en: That highly powerful leading Rākṣasa, finding the crag about to fall, turned a little away and struck the monkey with his dagger.

sn: तेन खङ्गप्रहारेण रक्षसा बलिना हतः। मुहूर्तमभवद्भूमौ विसंज्ञ इव वानरः॥
en: Being assailed with dagger by that powerful Räkşasa the monkey remained senseless for sometime on the ground.

sn: सहसा स तदोत्पत्य राक्षसस्य महहावे। मुष्टिं संवर्त्य वेगेन पातयामास वक्षसि ॥
en: Rising up all on a sudden he, clenching his fist, struck that Rakşsas in the mighty encounter on his braeast and got him down.

sn: मुष्टिप्रहाराभिहतो विरूपाक्षो निशाचरः। तेन खङ्गेन संक्रुद्धः सुग्रीवस्य चमूमुखे ॥ कवचं पातयामास पद्भ्यामभिहतोऽपतत्।
en: Being struck with the fist the night-ranger Virūpākṣa greatly enraged cut down with his dagger Sugriva's armour and tumbled him down with his feet.

sn: स समुत्थाय पतितः कपिस्तस्य व्यसर्जयत्॥ तलप्रहारमशनेः समानं भीमनि:स्वनम्।
en: The monkey rising up again was about to deal him a blow, hard as a thunder-bolt, with a dreadful sound.

sn: तलप्रहारं तद्रक्षः सुग्रीवेण समुद्यतम्॥ नैपुण्यान्मोचयित्वैनं मुष्टिनोरसि ताडयत्।
en: And receding a little, he baffled its aim and returned one on Sugriva's breast.

sn: ततस्तु संक्रुद्धतरः सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः॥ मोक्षितं चात्मनो दृष्ट्वा प्रहारं तेन रक्षसा। स ददर्शान्तरं तस्य विरूपाक्षस्य वानरः॥
en: Finding his aim baffled and himself struck in return by the Rākşasa, Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys, was excited with anger. And the monkey-chief was now on the look-out for an opportunity to strike Virüpākşa.

sn: ततोऽन्यं पातयत्क्रोधाच्छङ्खदेशे महातलम् । महेन्द्राशनिकल्पेन तलेनाभिहतः क्षितौ ॥ पपात रुधिरक्लिन्नः शोणितं हि समुगिरन्। स्रोतोभ्यस्तु विरूपाक्षो जलं प्रस्रवणादिव॥
en: Immediately in anger he struck him down with a blow on his forehead. And being thus assailed with the fist resembling the thunder-bolt of Mahendra, he fell down on the earth bathed in a pool of blood.

sn: विवृत्तनयनं क्रोधात्सफेनं रुधिराप्लुतम्। ददृशुस्ते विरूपाक्षं विरूपाक्षतरं कृतम्॥ स्फुरन्तं परिवर्तन्तं पार्श्वेन रुधिरोक्षितम्। करुणं च विनर्दन्तं ददृशुः कपयो रिपुम्॥
en: Blood gushed out of the person of Virūpākșa like to water issuing out of a fountain. And the monkeys beheld their enemy (Virūpākṣa) with his eyes disfigured in anger, bathed in a foam of blood, his whole body discoloured, trembling, rolling and crying piteously.

sn: तथा तु तौ संयति संप्रयुक्तौ तरस्विनौ वानरराक्षसानाम्। बलार्णवौ सस्वनतुश्च भीमौ महार्णवौ द्वाविव भिन्नसेतू॥
en: There upon those too armies of the monkeys and Räkşasas, being ready to engage in the encounter, began to roar like to two mighty oceans having their banks broken.

sn: विनाशितं प्रेक्ष्य विरूपनेत्रं महाबलं तं हरिपार्थिवेन। मुद्वृत्तगङ्गाप्रतिमं बभूव॥
en: Observing that highly powerful Räkşasa, of discoloured eyes, slain by the king of monkeys, the monkeys and Rakşasa forces engaged in fight and looked like the rising Ganges.

sn: हन्यमाने बले तूर्णमन्योन्यं ते महामृधे। सरसीव महाधर्मे सूपक्षीणे बभूवतुः॥
en: Like to a pond in the summer both the armies became gradually reduce.

sn: स्वबलस्य तु घातेन विरूपाक्षवधेन च। बभूव द्विगुणं क्रुद्धो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः॥
en: Beholding his own army and Virupaksa slain Ravana, the lord of Raksasas, was doubly excited with ire.

sn: प्रक्षीणं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा बध्यमानं बलीमुखैः। बभूवास्य व्यथा युद्धे दृष्ट्वा दैवविपर्ययम्॥
en: Observing his army reduced and slain by the heroic (monkeys) he perceived ill omens in the fight and was accordingly pained at heart,

sn: उवाच च समीपस्थं महोदरमनन्तरम्। अस्मिन्काले महाबाहो जयाशा त्वयि मे स्थिता।।४
en: He addressed Mahodara who was near him saying, you of great arms, all my hopes of success are now centred in you.

sn: जहि शत्रुचमूं वीर दर्शयाध पराक्रमम्। भर्तृपिण्डस्य कालोऽयं निर्देष्टुं साधु युध्यताम्॥
en: Do you slay the enemy's force, O hero, and display your prowess. Now has come the time of returning the favours of your master. Do you fight bravely.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो महोदरः। प्रविवेशारिसेनां स पतङ्ग इव पावकम्।६॥
en: Being thus accosted that Räkşasa chief Mahodara saying "so be it” entered the enemy's army like to a fly entering into a flame.

sn: ततः स कदनं चक्रे वानराणां महाबलः। भर्तृवाक्येन तेजस्वी स्वेन वीर्येण चोदितः॥
en: Excited by his master's command and empowered by his won prowess that (Rākşasa) gifted with great strength began to assail the monkeys.

sn: वानराश्च महासत्त्वाः प्रगृह्य विपुलाः शिलाः। प्रविश्यारिबलं भीमं जघ्नुस्ते सर्वराक्षसान्।८॥
en: The highly powerful monkeys too taking up huge crags dashed against the dreadful army of the enemies and crushed all the Rakşasas.

sn: महोदरः सुसंक्रुद्धः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः। चिच्छेद पाणिपादोरु वानराणां महाहवे।९।।
en: And Mahodara, greatly angered, severed in that mighty encounter, with his arrows feathered in gold, the hands, feet and thighs of the monkeys.

sn: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे राक्षसानां महामृधे। दिशो दश दुताः केचित्केचित्सुग्रीवमाश्रिताः॥
en: Then the monkeys in fear of the Rākşasas, fled away to different quarters and some sought shelter of Sugriva.

sn: प्रभग्नं समरे दृष्ट्वा वानराणां महाबलम्। अभिदुद्राव सुग्रीवो महोदरमनन्तरम्॥
en: And beholding his powerful monkeys force thus assailed in the conflict, Sugrīva dashed for ward and fronted Mahodara.

sn: प्रगृह्या विपुलां घोरां महीधरसमं शिलाम्। चिक्षेप च महातेजास्तद्वधाय हरीश्वरः॥
en: And taking up a huge and dreadful crag resembling a mountain, the monkeys-king hurled it with great vehemence to slay him.

sn: तामापतन्तीं सहसा शिलां दृष्ट्वा महोदरः। असंभ्रान्तस्ततो बाणैर्निर्बिभेद ततः शिलाम्॥
en: Thereupon finding that crag about to fall, Mahodara fearlessly severed it with his arrows.

sn: रक्षसा तेन बाणौधैनिकृत्ता सा सहस्रधा। निपपात तदा भूमौ गृध्रचक्रमिवाकुलम्॥
en: And being sundered into a thousand pieces by the arrow of that Rākşasa, it fell down on the earth like to a band of vultures.

sn: तां तु भिन्नां शिलां दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवः क्रोधमुर्छितः। सालमुत्पाट्य चिक्षेप तं स चिच्छेद नैकधा॥ शरैश्च विददारैनं शूरः परबलार्दनः। स ददर्श ततः क्रुद्धः परिषं पतितं भुवि॥
en: Beholding that crag thus severed, Sugrīva was beside himself with ire; and uplifting a Sála tree hurled it; and the heroic Räkşasa the slayer of enemy's force, severed it into several pieces with his arrows. Thereupon excited with wrath he saw a parigha on the ground.

sn: आविध्य तु स तं दीप्तं परिघं तस्य दर्शयन्। परिघेणोग्रवेगेन जघानास्य हयोचमान्॥ तस्माद्धतहयाद्वीरः सोऽवप्लुत्य महारथात्। गदां जग्राह संकृद्धो राक्षसोऽथ महोदरः॥
en: And hurling that flaming Parigha and displaying his (light-handedness) he stuck his excellent horse there with. And having his horse slain, that hero the Rakşasa Mahodara, ascended his car, and in great anger took up his club.

sn: गदापरिघहस्तौ तौ युधि वीरौ समीयतुः। नर्दन्तौ गोवृषप्रख्यौ घनाविव सविद्युतौ॥
en: Those two heroes, with club and parigha in their hands, engaged in battle, roaring like two bulls or clouds accompanied with lightning.

sn: ततः क्रुद्धो गदां तस्य चिक्षेप रजनीचरः। ज्वलन्ती भास्कराभासां सुग्रीवाय महोदरः॥
en: Thereupon the night-ranger Mahodara, inflamed with ire, hurled at Sugrīva, the club flaming like the Sun.

sn: गदां तां सुमहाघोरामापतन्तीं महाबलः। सुग्रीवो रोषताम्राक्षः समुद्यम्य महाहवे॥ आजघान गदां तस्य परिषेण हरीश्वरः। पपात तरसा भिन्नः परिघस्तस्य भूतले॥
en: Beholding that dreadful club about to fall the highly powerful Sugrīva-the lord of monkeys, uplifting his parigha struck it there with. And parigha, being sundered, fell quickly down on the earth.

sn: ततो जग्राह तेजस्वी सुग्रीवो वसुधातलात्। आयसं मुसलं घोरं सर्वतो हेमभूषितम्॥
en: Thereupon the effulgent Sugrīva picked up from the ground musala made of iron and ornamented with gold.

sn: स तमुद्यम्य चिक्षेप सोऽप्यस्य प्राक्षिपगदाम्। भिन्नावन्योन्यमासाद्य पेततुस्तौ महीतले॥
en: Taking that musala up he hurled it at the Räkşasa and who again hurled a club; and both of them being severed fell down on the earth.

sn: ततो भिन्नाहरणौ मुष्टिभ्यां तौ समीयतुः। तेजोबलसमाविष्टौ दीप्ताविव हुताशनौ ॥
en: Having their weapons baffled thus, those two heroes, gifted with great prowess and effulgence and resembling the burning fire, were ready to interchange blows.

sn: जघ्नतुस्तौ तदान्योन्यं नदन्तौ च पुनः पुनः। तलैश्चान्योन्यमासाद्य पेततुश्च महीतले॥
en: They emitting roars again and again, stuck each other down on the earth with their clenched fists.

sn: उत्पेततुस्तदा तूर्णं जघ्नतुश्च परस्परम्। भुजैश्चिक्षिपतुर्वीरावन्योन्यमपराजितौ॥
en: Then rising up speedily they again assailed each other. Thus those two heroes unsubdued, struck each other with their arms.

sn: जग्मतुस्तौ श्रमं वीरौ बाहुयुद्धे परंतपौ। जहार च तदा खङ्गमदूरपरिवर्तिनम्॥
en: Thereupon both of them, highly proficient in fighting with arms, were greatly exhausted. Thereupon they took up daggers.

sn: ततो रोषपरीताङ्गौ नदन्तावभ्यधावताम्। उद्यतासी रणे हृष्टौ युद्धे शस्त्रविशारदौ॥
en: Then uplifting them (those two heroes) with their persons trembling in ire, proficient in fighting and skilled in the use of weapons dashed on roaring.

sn: दक्षिणं मण्डलं चोभौ सूतूर्णं संपरीयतुः। अन्योन्यमभिसंक्रुद्धौ जये प्रणिहितावुभौ॥
en: The both of them enraged with each other and anxious to score success, moving in circle on each other's right side, addressed themselves for action.

sn: स तु शूरो महावेगो वीर्यश्लाघी महोदरः। महावर्मणि तं खङ्ग पातयामास दुर्मतिः॥
en: Thereupon the vicious-minded, heroic Mahodara, gifted with great vehemence and proud of his own heroism flung his dagger at (the monkey's) armour.

sn: लग्नमुत्कर्षतः खङ्ग खङ्गेन कपिकुञ्जरः। जहार स शिरस्त्राणं कुण्डलोपगतं शिरः॥
en: And as he was about to extricate his dagger from the armour, that foremost of monkeys severed with his dagger that Rākşasa's head with helmet and kundalas.

sn: निकृत्तशिरसस्तस्य पतितस्य महीतले। तलं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दृष्ट्वा तत्र न दृश्यते ॥
en: Beholding the Rākşasa chief fall down on the earth with his head off, his forces fled away from the field.

sn: हत्वा तं वानरैः सार्धं ननाद मुदितो हरिः। चुक्रोध च दशग्रीवो बभौ हृष्टश्च राघवः॥
en: Slaying him that monkey-chief, delighted, began to roar along with other monkeys. There upon the Ten-necked one became highly enraged and Rāghava greatly delighted.

sn: विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे राक्षसा दीनचेतसः। विद्रवन्ति ततः सर्वे भयवित्रस्तचेतसः॥
en: All the Räksasas with their hearts broken and countenances rendered poorly and stricken with fear fled away to different quarters.

sn: महोदरं तं विनिपात्य भूमौ महागिरेः कीर्ममिवैकदेशम्। सूर्यात्मजस्तत्र रराज लक्ष्म्या सूर्यः स्वतेजोभिरिवाप्रधृष्यः॥
en: Slaying and striking down on earth Mahodara like to a portion of a mighty hill severed that son of the Sun appeared resplendent in his own effulgence and became irrepressible like to the Sun.

sn: अथ विजयमवाप्य वानरेन्द्रः समरमुखे सुरसिद्धयक्षसङ्घः। हर्षसमाकुलितैर्निरीक्षमाणः॥
en: And winning victory in the action that lord of monkeys was espied by the celestials Siddhas and Yaksas along with all creatures on earth, having their eyes flushed with joy.

sn: महोदरे तु निहते महापार्यो महाबलः। सुग्रीवेण समीक्ष्याथ क्रोधात्संरक्तलोचनः॥
en: Mahodara being thus slain by Sugrīva, the highly powerful Mahāpäráva, having his eyes reddened with ire, looked towards him.

sn: अङ्गदस्य चमू भीमा क्षोभयामास मार्गणैः। स वानराणां मुख्यानामुत्तमाङ्गानि राक्षसः॥ पातयामास कायेभ्यः फलं वृन्तादिवानिलः।
en: The Rākşasa, with his weapons assailed the dreadful army of Angada as well as the leading monkeys. The Rākşasa severed the heads from the bodies of the monkeys like to the wind throwing away the fruits from trees. were

sn: केषांचिदिषुभिर्बाहूंश्चिच्छेदाथ स राक्षसः॥ वानराणां सुसंरब्धः पार्श्व केषांचिदाक्षिपत्।
en: He cut off, with his arrows, the arms of some and some were deprived of their sides.

sn: तेऽदिता बाणवर्षेण महापार्श्वेन वानराः॥ विषादविमुखाः सर्वे बभूवुर्गतचेतसः।
en: The monkeys thus assailed by Mahāpārsva with a shower of shafts. All the monkeys were thus stricken with grief and rendered senseless.

sn: निशम्य बलमुद्विग्नमङ्गदो राक्षसार्दितम्॥ वेगं चक्रे महावेगः समुद्र इव पर्वसु। आयसं परिघं गृह्य सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभम्॥ समरे वानरश्रेष्ठो महापाचे न्यपातयत्। तेन प्रहारेण महापाझे विचेतनः। ससूतस्यन्दनात्तस्माद्विसंजश्चापतद्भुवि।७।।
en: Hearing of the anxiety of his own army thus assailed by the Raksasa, angada, gifted with great vehemence, taking his parigha made of iron and resembling the rays of the sun, dashed on like the rising deep during the lunar half of a month. And that foremost of monkeys encountered Mahāpārsva, who thus struck by the monkeys became insensible with his charioteer and fell down on the earth.

sn: तस्यक्षराजस्तेजस्वी नीलाञ्जनचयोपमः। निष्पत्य सुमहावीर्यः स्वयूथान्मेघसंनिभात्॥ प्रगृह्य गिरिशृङ्गाभां क्रुद्धः स विपुलां शिलाम्। अश्वाञ्जघान तरसा बभञ्ज स्यन्दनं च तम्॥
en: Thereupon leaped on the battle-field the ! highly powerful and effulgent lord of bears, having the hue of red collyrium, with his army resembling the cloud. And excited with ire, he, taking up a huge crag resembling the summit of a mountain, speedily struck down his horses and broke down his car.

sn: मुहूर्ताल्लब्धसंज्ञस्तु महापार्यो महाबलः। अङ्गदं बहुभिर्बाणैर्भूयस्तं प्रत्यविध्यत॥ जाम्बवन्तं त्रिभिर्बाणैराजघान स्तनान्तरे। ऋक्षराजं गवाक्षं च जघान बहुभिः शरैः॥ गवाक्षं जाम्बवन्तं च स दृष्ट्वा शरपीडितौ। जग्राह परिघं घोरमङ्गदः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः॥
en: And regaining his senses in a moment the highly powerful Mahāpārsva, again assailed Angada with many arrows. He struck Jambavan, the lord of bears, on his breast with three-arrows and assailed Gavākṣa with many shafts. And beholding Jämbavān and Gavākṣa overwhelmed with arrows, Angada, beside himself with ire, took up a dreadful parigha.

sn: तस्याङ्गदः सरोषाक्षो राक्षसस्य तमायसम्। दूरस्थितस्य परिघं रविरश्मिसमप्रभम्॥ द्वाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां संगृह्या भ्रामयित्वा च वेगवत्। महापार्थाय चिक्षेप वधार्थं वालिनः सुतः॥
en: Holding with two hands that parigha made of iron and bright like the rays of the sun, Angada, the son of Vāli, with his eyes reddened in wrath, hurled it at Mahāpārsva who was stationed at a distance, to slay him.

sn: स तु क्षिप्तो बलवता परिघस्तस्य रक्षसः। धनुश्च सशरं हस्ताच्छिरस्त्राणं च पातयत्॥
en: Being hurled by the highly powerful (Angada) the parigha, struck down from his hands the bow with arrows and the helmet of the Rākşasa.

sn: तं समासाद्य वेगेन वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। तलेनाभ्यहनत्क्रुद्धः कर्णमूले सकुण्डले॥
en: Approaching him vehemently, Vali's son, gifted with great prowess, in anger struck him, with clenched fist, on his ears having excellent kundalas.

sn: स तु क्रुद्धो महावेगो महापार्यो महाद्युतिः। करेणैकेन जग्राह सुमहान्तं परश्वधम्॥ तं तैलधौतं विमलं शैलसारमयं दृढम्। राक्षसः परमनुद्धो वालिपुत्रे न्यपातयत्॥ तेन वामांसफलके भृशं प्रत्यवपातितम्। अङ्गदो मोक्षयामास सरोषः सपरश्वधम्॥
en: Thereupon Mahāpārsva gifted with great vehemence and effulgence, highly angered, took up in his hands a huge paraśvadha, sharpened with oil, bright and hard as iron and discharged it at Vali's son, and struck him therewith on his left shoulder. And Angada baffled that parasvadha.

sn: स वीरो वज्रसंकाशमङ्गदो मुष्टिमात्मनः। संवर्तयत्सुसंक्रुद्धः पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमः॥ राक्षसस्य स्तनाभ्याशे मर्मज्ञो हृदयं प्रति। इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्श स मुष्टिं विन्यपातयत्॥ तेन तस्य निपातेन राक्षसस्य महामृधे। पफाल हृदयं चास्य स पपात हतो भुवि ॥ तस्मिन्विनिहते भूमौ तत्सैन्यं संप्रचुक्षुभे। अभवच्च महान्क्रोधः समरे रावणस्य तु॥ वानराणां प्रहृष्टानां सिंहनादः सुपुष्कलः।
en: Thereupon that hero, powerful like his own father, clenching his fist, hard as thunderbolt and resembling even Indra's asani, dealt it, in great anger, upon the Raksasa's breast. And being struck with that fist the Rākşasa' breast was shattered and he fell down on earth. He falling down on earth slain, his soldiers were greatly sorry and Răvaņa attained to an excess of ire in the conflict.

sn: स्फोटयन्निव शब्देन लङ्कां साट्टालगोपुराम्॥ सहेन्द्रेणेव देवानां नादः समभवन्महान्॥
en: The noise set up by the delighted monkeys like to a dreadful leonine roar, as if rending the city of Lankā abounding in edifices and gates, resembled the great roar of the celestials along with Indra.

sn: अथेन्द्रशत्रुस्त्रिदशालयानां वनौकसां चैव महाप्रणादम्। श्रुत्वा सरोषं युधि राक्षसेन्द्रः पुनश्च युद्धाभिमुखोऽवतस्थे ॥
en: Hearing the noise of the celestials and monkeys, the lord of Räkşasas, the enemy of the gods, in great anger, again proceeded towards the battle field.

sn: महोदरमहापाचौं हतौ दृष्ट्वा स रावणः। तस्मिंश्च निहते वीरे विरूपाक्षे महाबले॥ आविवेश महान्क्रोधो रावणं तु महामृधे। सूतं संचोदयामास वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह।२।।
en: Beholding Mahodara, Mahāpäráva and the highly powerful Virūpåksa slain in the encounter Rāvaņa attained to an excess of ire. And ordering his charioteer to hurry on he gave went to the following words.

sn: निहतानाममात्यानां रुद्धस्य नगरस्य च। दुःखमेवापनेष्यामि हत्वा तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: All my courtiers have been slain and my city is shut up-I shall remove my grief consequent on all these by slaying Răma and Lakşmaņa.

sn: रामवृक्षं रणे हन्मि सीतापुष्पफलप्रदम्। प्रशाका यस्य सुग्रीवो जाम्बवान्कुमुदो नलः॥ द्विविदश्चैव मैन्दश्च अङ्गदो गन्धमादनः। हनूमांश्च सुषेणश्च सर्वे च हरियूथपाः ॥
en: I shall destroy Rāma-like tree in the conflict whose flower is Sītā and whose branches are Sugrīva, Jāmbavān, Kumuda, Nala, Divida, Mainda, Angada Gandhamadana, Hanuman and all other leading monkeys.

sn: स दिशो दश घोषेण रथस्यातिरथो महान्। नादयन्प्रययौ तूर्णं राघवं चाभ्यधावत ॥
en: And resounding the ten quarters with the sound of his chariot wheels that mighty carwarrior proceeded quickly towards Rāghava.

sn: पूरिता तेन शब्देन सनदीगिरिकानना। संचचाल मही सर्वा त्रस्तसिंहमृगद्विजा ॥
en: With that sound all quarters were filled, and the earth, will rivers, mountains and forests shook and all the lions, deer and birds were terrified.

sn: तामसं सुमहाघोरं चकारास्त्रं सुदारुणम्। निर्ददाह कपीन्सवस्तेि प्रपेतुः समन्ततः॥ उत्पपात रजो भूमौ तैर्भग्नैः संप्रधावितैः। नहि तत्सहितुं शेकुर्ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं स्वयम्॥
en: He created a dreadful darkness with the discharge of his sharp weapons and burnt down the monkeys who fled away to different directions. Dust was raised on the ground by those monkeys assailed and flying to various directions. They were unable to withstand the power of the weapon made by Brahmå himself.

sn: तान्यनीकान्यनेकानि रावणस्य शरोत्तमैः। दृष्ट्वा भग्नानि शतशो राघवः पर्यवस्थितः॥
en: Beholding his own army, assailed and cut into hundred pieces by the excellent weapons of Rāvana Råghava dashed forward. a

sn: ततो राक्षसशार्दूलो विद्राव्य हरिवाहिनीम्। स ददर्श ततो रामं तिष्ठन्तमपराजितम्॥ लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा विष्णुना वासवं यथा। आलिखन्तमिवाकाशमवष्टभ्य महद्धनुः॥ पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षं दीर्घबाहुमरिंदमम्।
en: Assailing the monkey-host, that foremost of Rākşasas espied Rāma, unconquered at distance with his brother Lakşmaņa like to Basava with Vişņu, holding a huge bow like one painted on the sky, having expansive eyes like lotus-petals, long arms, and always subduing the enemies.

sn: ततो रामो महातेजाः सौमित्रिसहितो बली॥ वानरांश्च रणे भग्नानापतन्तं च रावणम्। समीक्ष्य राघवो हृष्टो मध्ये जग्राह कार्मुकम्॥
en: Beholding the monkeys slain in the encounter and Rāvaņa approach, the heroic and highly powerful Rāma, with Sumitra's son in his company, delightedly set arrows on his bow.

sn: विस्फारयितुमारेभे ततः स धनुरुत्तमम्। महावेगं महानादं निर्भिन्दन्निव मेदिनीम्॥
en: As if rending the whole earth with that dreadful sound he began to draw the string of his excellent bow.

sn: रावणस्य च बाणौधै रामविस्फारितेन च। शब्देन राक्षसास्तेन पेतुश्च शतशस्तदा॥
en: With the sound of Ravan's arrows and the twang of Rāma's bow hundreds of Rākşasas fell down on earth..

sn: तयोः शरपथं प्राप्य रावणो राजपुत्रयोः। स बभौ च यथा राहुः समीपे शशिसूर्ययोः॥
en: Coming within the range of the arrows of those two Princes, Rāvaņa appeared like Rahu in presence of the sun and the moon.

sn: तमिच्छन्प्रथमं योद्धं लक्ष्मणो निशितैः शरैः। मुमोच धनुरायम्य शरानग्निशिखोपमान्॥
en: And desiring to fight with him first Lakşmana setting sharp arrows on his bow, discharged shafts at him resembling the flame of fire.

sn: तान्मुक्तमात्रानाकाशे लक्ष्मणेन धनुष्मता। बाणान्बाणैर्महातेजा रावणः प्रत्यवारयत्॥
en: The highly powerful Ravana too with his arrows stopped the course of those shafts in the sky as soon as they were discharged by Laksmana, skilled in archery.

sn: एकमेकेन बाणेन त्रिभिस्त्रीन्दशभिर्दश। लक्ष्मणस्य प्रचिच्छेद दर्शयन्पाणिलाघवम्॥
en: And displaying his light-handedness, he with one arrow, severed Laksmana's one, with three his three and with ten his ten.

sn: अभ्यतिक्रम्य सौमित्रिं रावणः समितिंजयः। आससाद रणे रामं स्थितं शैलमिवापरम्॥
en: Surpassing thus the son of Sumitrā Rāvana, ever victorious in battle, confronted Rāma in the encounter, standing like another hill.

sn: स राघवं समासाद्य क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। व्यसृजच्छरवर्षाणि रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः॥
en: Approaching Rāghava, Rāvana the lord of Rakşasas, with his eyes reddened in ire, began to make a shower of arrows.

sn: शरधारास्ततो रामो रावणस्य धनुश्च्युताः। दृष्ट्वैवापतिताः शीघ्रं भल्लाञ्जग्राह सत्वरम्॥
en: Thereupon beholding the arrows shot off Ravana's bow fall on all sides, Rāma speedily took up a Bhalla.* *An arrow with a crescent shaped head.

sn: ताञ्छरौघांस्ततो भल्लैस्तीक्ष्णैश्चिच्छेद राघवः। दीप्यमानान्महाघोराञ्छरानाशीविषोपमान्॥
en: Rāghava sundered with his sharp Bhalla his dreadful flaming and resembling poisonous serpents.

sn: राघवो रावणं तूर्णं रावणो राघवं तथा। अन्योन्यं विविधैस्तीक्ष्णैः शरवर्ववर्षतुः॥
en: With various sharpened arrows Rāghava assailed Rävaņa, and he again assailed Rāma in return.

sn: चेरतुश्च चिरं चित्रं मण्डलं सव्यदक्षिणम्। बाणवेगात्समुत्क्षिप्तावन्योन्यमपराजितौ॥ तयोर्भूतानि वित्रेसुर्युगपत्संप्रयुध्यतोः। रौद्रयोः सायकमुचोर्यमान्तकनिकाशयोः॥
en: And forming a circle, they passed each other by the right side. Uprooting the earth with the vehemence of their arrows, irrepressible by each other, fighting equally discharging arrows, they arrows looked dreadful like Death himself-and created terror in all creatures.

sn: सततं विविधैर्बाणैर्बभूव गगनं तदा। घनैरिवातपापाये विद्युन्मालासमाकुलैः॥
en: The sky was filled with their various weapons like to clouds in the rainy season accompanied with lightning.

sn: गवाक्षितमिवाकाशं बभूव शरवृष्टिभिः। महावेगैः सुतीक्ष्णागृध्रपत्रैः सुवाजितैः॥
en: The welkin appeared full of windows with that shower of arrows, shot with great vehemence and winged like vultures.

sn: शरान्धकारमाकाशं चक्रतुः प्रथमं तदा। गतेऽस्तं तपने चापि महामेधाविवोत्थितौ ॥
en: The earth was stricken with darkness caused by these arrows like to clouds appearing after sunset.

sn: तयोरभून्महायुद्धमन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणोः। अनासाद्यमचिन्त्यं च वृत्रवासवयोरिव॥
en: There took place a dreadful conflict between them desiring to slay each other, having their prowess unknown and fighting like Vitra and Vasava.

sn: उभौ हि परमेष्वासावुभौ युद्धविशारदौ। उभावस्त्रविदां मुख्यावुभौ युद्धे विचेरतुः॥
en: Both of them were proficient in archery, skilled in the art of conflict and foremost of those conversant with the use of weapons.

sn: उभौ हि येन व्रजस्तेन तेन शरोर्मयः। ऊर्मयो वायुना विद्धा जग्मुः सागरयोरिव ॥
en: They began to veer round the battle-field. And wherever they went, there appeared arrows like to waves of the deep roused by the winds.

sn: ततः संसक्तहस्तस्तु रावणो लोकरावणः। नाराचमालां रामस्य ललाटे प्रत्यमुश्चत॥
en: Then that destroyer of creatures-Ravana, with his hand engaged in discharging shafts, shot at Rāma's forehead a network of arrows.

sn: रौद्रचापप्रयुक्तां तां नीलोत्पलदलप्रभाम्। शिरसाधारयद्रामो न व्यथामभ्यपद्यत ॥
en: Thereat Rāma on his head bore that shower of shafts shot from his terrific bow, having the lustre of the petals of blue lotuses; nor did he experience any pain.

sn: अथ मन्त्रानपि जपनरौद्रमस्त्रमुदीरयन्। शरान्भूयः समादाय रामः क्रोधसमन्वितः॥ मुमोच च महातेजाश्चापमायम्य वीर्यवान्। ताशराराक्षसेन्द्राय चिक्षेपाच्छिन्नसायकः॥
en: Then reciting a formula, the exceedingly energetic Rāma endowed with prowess, wrought up with wrath, engaged in incessantly shooting his shafts, taking his Rudra weapon and again seizing his arrows, discharged them at that lord of Raksasas.

sn: ते महामेघसंकाशे कवचे पातिताः शराः। अवध्ये राक्षसेन्द्रस्य न व्यथां जनयंस्तदा॥
en: Alighting at the impenetrable mail of the Rākşasa-chief, resembling a mass of mighty clouds, those arrows did not then occasion him any pain.

sn: पुनरेवाथ तं रामो रथस्थं राक्षसाधिपम्। ललाटे परमास्त्रेण सर्वास्त्रकुशलोऽभिनत्॥
en: Again Rāma skilled in all weapons, from a powerful weapon discharged arrows at the sovereign of the Raksasas mounted on his car.

sn: ते भित्त्वा बाणरूपाणि पञ्चशीर्षा इवोरगाः। श्वसन्तो विविशुर्भूमिं रावणप्रतिकूलिताः॥
en: And piercing Ravana, those like to fivehooded serpents, resisted by him, entered the earth, hissing.

sn: निहत्य राघवस्यास्त्रं रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः। आसुरं सुमहाघोरमन्यदत्रं चकार सः॥ सिंहव्याघ्रमुखांश्चापि कङ्ककोकमुखानपि। गृध्रश्येनमुखांश्चापि शृगालवदनांस्तथा॥ ईहामृगमुखांश्चापि व्यादितास्यान्भयावहान्। पञ्चास्याल्लेलिहानांश्च ससर्ज निशिताशरान्।॥ शरान्खरमुखांश्चान्यान्वराहमुखसंश्रितान्। श्वानकुक्कुटवक्रांश्च मकराशीविषाननान्॥ एतांश्चान्यांश्च मायाभिः ससर्ज निशिताञ्छरान्। रामं प्रति महातेजाः क्रुद्धः सर्प इव श्वसन्॥
en: Having baffled Rāghava's weapon, Rāvana, transported with passion, took up a dreadful Asura weapon; and discharged sharpened shafts having the faces of lions and tigers and the faces of kankas and kokas,' and the faces of vultures and hawks, and the faces of jackals, and the faces of wolves, with gaping mouths, and terrific of aspect:; five-mouthed and red-hued. And that highly powerful one, enraged, sighing like a snake, by his power of illusion shot at Rāma other keen arrows having the faces of mules and the faces of bears, and the faces of dogs and cocks, and the faces of Makaras? And venomous serpents these as well as others. 1. Koka-a ruddy goose. It may also mean a lizard, a chameleon, a wolf. 2. A marine monster, generally confounded with the alligator and the shark: but really a fabulous animal.

sn: आसुरेण समाविष्टः सोऽस्त्रेण रघुपुङ्गवः। ससर्जास्त्रं महोत्साहं पावकं पावकोपमः।४६।। अग्निदीप्तमुखान्बाणांस्तत्र सूर्यमुखानपि। चन्द्रार्धचन्द्रवक्रांश्च धूमकेतुमुखानपि।। ग्रहनक्षत्रवर्णाश्च महोल्कामुखसंस्थितान्॥ विद्युज्जिह्वोपमांश्चापि ससर्ज विविधाञ्छरान्।
en: Covered with that Asura weapon that foremost of the Raghus, himself resembling fire, discharged an exceedingly vigorous weapon informed with fire; and shot various shafts having faces filled with live flames, and faces like to suns, and hued like to planets and stars, and furnished with faces resembling mighty meteors or resembling tongues of lightning.

sn: ते रावणशरा घोरा राघवास्त्रसमाहताः।४८।। विलयं जग्मुराकाशे जघ्नुश्चैव सहस्रशः।
en: Those terrific shafts of Răvana, resisted by Rāghava's weapon, were annihilated in the sky, and destroyed (monkeys) by thousands.

sn: तदत्रं निहतं दृष्ट्वा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा॥ हृष्टा नेदुस्ततः सर्वे कपयः कामरूपिणः। सुग्रीवाभिमुखा वीराः संपरिक्षिप्य राघवम्॥
en: Seeing that weapon (of Rāvaņa) destroyed by Rāma of untiring deeds, all those heroes, the monkeys, headed by Sugrīva, capable of wearing forms at will shouted, surrounding Rāghava.

sn: ततस्तदत्रं विनिहत्य राघवः प्रसह्य तद्रावणबाहुनिःसृतम्। मुदान्वितो दाशरथिर्महात्मा विनेदुरुच्चैर्मुदिताः कपीश्वराः ॥
en: The high-souled son of Dasartha-Rāghavahaving by his might destroyed that weapon discharged by Råvana's arms, was delighted; and the monkey-chiefs, filled with glee, began to emit shouts.

sn: तस्मिन्प्रतिहतेऽस्त्रे तु रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। क्रोधं च द्विगुणं चक्रे क्रोधाच्चास्त्रमनन्तरम्॥ मयेन विहितं रौद्रमन्यदस्त्रं महाद्युतिः। उत्स्रष्टुं रावणो भीमं राघवाय प्रचक्रमे॥
en: On that weapon of his hvaing been baffled, Rāvaņa lord of the Rākṣasas-was fired with double fury, and the highly effuigent Rāvaņa from wrath set about discharging at Rāghava a dreadful Rudra weapon, which had been। conferred on him by Maya.

sn: ततः शूलानि निश्चेरुर्गदाश्च मुसलानि च। कार्मुकाद्दीप्यमानानि वज्रसाराणि सर्वशः॥ मुद्गराः कूटपाशाश्च दीप्ताश्चाशनयस्तथा। निष्पेतुर्विविधास्तीक्ष्णा वाता इव युगक्षये॥
en: And from his bow began to issue forth in large numbers darts and maces and clubs, flaming and having the might of thunder; and various kinds of sharp clubs and diggers and nooses and flaming thunderbolts began to i descend like to the winds at the universal tumbling.

sn: तदत्रं राघवः श्रीमानुत्तमास्त्रविदां वरः। जघान परमात्रेण गान्धर्वेण महाद्युतिः॥
en: Thereupon the graceful and exceedingly effulgent Rāghava-foremost of those accomplished in noble arms-resisted that weapon with a powerful Gandharva weapon.

sn: तस्मिन्प्रतिहतेऽस्त्रे तु राघवेण महात्मना। रावणः क्रोधताम्राक्षः सौरमस्त्रमुदरीयत्॥
en: On that weapon being baffled by the highsouled Raghava, Rävaņa, with his eyes rendered coppery with passion took up a Solar weapon.

sn: ततश्चक्राणि निष्पेतु स्वराणि महान्ति च। कार्मुकाद्भीमवेगस्य दशग्रीवस्य धीमतः।७।।
en: Thereupon from the bow of the wondrous vehement and intelligent Ten-necked one rushed out discuses flaming and mighty.

sn: तैरासीद्गगनं दीप्तं संपतद्भिः समन्ततः। पतद्भिश्च दिशो दीप्तैश्चन्द्रसूर्ग्रहैरिव।।।।
en: The firmament all round blazed up with those impendent (arms) as blaze up the cardinal quarters on the Sun and the Moon and the planets dropping down.

sn: तानि चिच्छेद बाणौधैश्चक्राणि तु स राघवः। आयुधानि च चित्राणि रावणस्य चमूमुखे।।।।
en: Thereat Rāghava in the van of that army by means of vollies of shafts cut off Rāvana's wonderful weapons and discuses.

sn: तदत्रं तु हतं दृष्ट्वा रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। विव्याध दशभिर्बाणै रामं सर्वेषु मर्मसु॥
en: Seeing that weapon destroyed, Ravana-lord of Rakşasas-with ten arrows pierced Rāma all through his vitals.

sn: स विद्धो दशभिर्बाणैर्महाकार्मुकनिःसृतैः। रावणेन महातेजा न प्राकम्पत राघवः॥
en: And pierced by Rāyaṇa with those ten shafts discharged from his mighty bow the exceedingly powerful Rāghava did not so much shake.

sn: ततो विव्याध गात्रेषु सर्वेषु समितिंजयः। राघवस्तु सुसंकुद्धो रावणं बहुभिः शरैः॥
en: Then Rāghava-victor fight-waxing wondrous wroth, with countless shafts pierced Ravaņa all over his person.

sn: एतस्मिनन्तरे क्रुद्धो राघवस्यानुजो बली। लक्ष्मण: सायकान्सप्त जग्राह परवीरहा॥
en: In the meanwhile Raghava's younger brother, the mighty Lakşmaņa-destroyer of foes-growing enraged, took up seven arrows.

sn: तैः सायकैर्महावेगै रावणस्य महाद्युतिः। ध्वजं मनुष्यशीर्ष तु तस्य चिच्छेद नैकधा॥
en: With those highly impetuous arrows that exceedingly effulgent one severed the humanheaded standard of Råvaņa.

sn: सारथेश्चापि बाणेन शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम्। जहार लक्ष्मणः श्रीमानैर्ऋतस्य महाबलः॥
en: The mighty and graceful Lakşmaņa with a shafts cut off the head of the Nairta's charioteer, illumined with ear-rings.

sn: तस्य बाणैश्च चिच्छेद धनुर्गजकरोपमम्। लक्ष्मणो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पञ्चभिनिशितैस्तदा॥
en: Then with five sharpened arrows Lakşmaņa severed the bow the bow of the Räkşasa-chief, resembling the trunk of an elephant.

sn: नीलमेघनिभांश्चास्य सदश्वान्पर्वतोपमान्। जघानाप्लुत्य गदया रावणस्य विभीषणः॥
en: Vibhīşaņa, bounding up, with his mace despatched Ravana's excellent steeds, resembling hills or dark-blue clouds.

sn: हताश्वात्तु तदा वेगादवप्लुत्य महारथात्। कोपमाहारयत्तीवं भ्रातरं प्रति रावणः॥
en: Thereat leaping down from his mighty car, whose horses had been slain, Råvana was fired with high wrath against his brother.

sn: ततः शक्तिं महाशक्तिः प्रदीप्तामशनीमिव। विभीषणाय चिक्षेप राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: The powerful lord of Raksasas endowed with immense strength, hurled at Vibhīşaņa a dart resembling the flaming thunder-bolt.

sn: अप्राप्तामेव तां बाणैत्रिभिश्चिच्छेद लक्ष्मणः। अथोदतिष्ठत्संनादो वानराणां महारणे॥
en: Ere the dart had reached its destination, Laks mana severed it with three shafts; and thereat in that mighty conflict there arose a mighty uproar from the monkeys.

sn: संपपात त्रिधा छिन्ना शक्तिः काञ्चनमालिनी। सविस्फुलिङ्गा ज्वलिता महोल्केव दिवश्च्युता॥
en: The dart dight with networks of gold fell down in three fragments, as dropped a mighty meteor from the firmament, flaming and shooting out scintillations.

sn: ततः संभाविततरां कालेनापि दुरासदाम्। जग्राह विपुलां शक्ति दीप्यमानां स्वतेजसा।२२।।
en: Then (Ravana) took up a huge dart, glowing in its own energy, celebrated as being irresistible, and incapable of being borne by the Destroyer himself.

sn: सा वेगिता बलवता रावणेन दुरात्मना। जज्वाल सुमहातेजा दीप्ताशनिसमप्रभा॥
en: On being whirled by the impious and strong Rāvana, the dart possessed of exceeding energy, flamed up

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरो लक्ष्मणस्तं विभीषणम्। प्राणसंशयमापनं तूर्णमभ्यवपद्यत॥ तं विमोक्षयितुं वीरश्चापमायम्य लक्ष्मणः। रावणं शक्तिहस्तं वै शरवषैरवाकिरत्॥ कीर्यमाणः शरौघेण विसृष्टेन महात्मना। स प्रहर्तुं मनश्चक्रे विमुखीकृतविक्रमः॥
en: In the mean while the heroic Lakşmaņa swiftly come to the side of Vibhīsaņa, * whose life was placed in peril. And in order to save him that hero-Lakşmaņa drawing his bow, covered the dart, handed Rāvana with showers of shafts. On being covered with arrows shot by that high souled one, Rāvaņa with his prowess baffled, make up his mind to let (his brother) go. *The commentator explains; Himself coming before the dart Lakşmaņa saved Vibhîşaņa.

sn: मोक्षितं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणेन स रावणः। लक्ष्मणाभिमुखस्तिष्ठनिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing his brother delivered by Lakşmana, Ravana, facing Laksmana spoke these words.

sn: मोक्षितस्ते बलश्लाघिन्यस्मादेवं विभीषणः। विमुच्य राक्षसं शक्तिस्त्वयीयं विनिपात्यते॥
en: O you proud of your prowess! as Vibhīşana has this wise been delivered by you, passing by the Raksasa, this dart, discharged from my bludgeon of an arms, will depart depriving you of your life.

sn: एषा ते हृदयं भित्त्वा शक्तिर्लोहितलक्षणा। मद्बाहुपरिघोत्सृष्टा प्राणानादाय यास्यति॥ इत्येवमुक्त्वा तां शक्तिमष्टघण्टां महास्वनाम्। मयेन मायाविहिताममोघां शत्रुघातिनीम्॥ लक्ष्मणाय समुद्दिश्य ज्वलन्तीमिव तेजसा। रावणः परमवद्धश्चिक्षपे च ननाद च॥ सा क्षिप्ता भीमवेगेन वज्राशनिसमस्वना। शक्तिरभ्यपतद्वेगाल्लक्ष्मणं रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Having said this, Rāvana waxing furiously enraged, discharged at Laksmana that dart forged by Maya with his power of illusion, furnished with eight bells, having might sounds,t Incapable of being resisted, competent to finish foes: and flaming in energy-and shouted simultaneously. And hurled with terrific force the dart sending sounds resembling that of Vajra of the thunder-bolt, vehemently alighted at Lakş maņa in that encounter.

sn: तामनुव्याहरच्छक्तिमापतन्ती स राघवः। स्वस्त्यस्तु लक्ष्मणायेति मोघा भव हतोद्यमा॥
en: Thereat as the dart descended, Raghava addressed it, saying-peace be to Laksmana! Be you frustrated; and let your energy go out of you. *i.e. as Rāmānuja remarks, addressed the deity presiding over it.

sn: रावणेन रणे शक्तिः कुद्धेनाशीविषोपमा। मुक्ता शूरस्य भीतस्य लक्ष्मणस्य ममज्ज सा।।३४ न्यपतत्सा महावेगा लक्ष्मणस्य महोरसि। जिह्वेवोरगराजस्य दीप्यमाना महाद्युतिः॥ ततो रावणवेगेन सुदूरमवगाढया। शक्त्या विभिन्नहृदयः पपात भुवि लक्ष्मणः॥
en: But the dart discharged in the encounter by the enraged Rāvana, resembling a venomous serpent, dived into the dauntless and heroic Laks maņa; and (the dart) exceedingly splendid and blazing, possessed of dreadful impetuosity and resembling the tongue of the king of serpents, smote Lakşmaņa in his mighty chest. And with his breast riven by the dart driving deep through the force of Rāvana, Lakşmaņa fell down to the earth.

sn: तदवस्थं समीपस्थो लक्ष्मणं प्रेक्ष्य राघवः। भ्रातृस्नेहान्महातेजा विषण्णहृदयोऽभवत्॥
en: Rāghava, standing by seeing Lakşmaņa in that plight, had his heart overspread with sorrow.

sn: स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः। बभूव संरब्धतरो युगान्त इव पावकः॥
en: But reflecting only for a while, he with his eyes surcharged with tears was filled with greater martial ardour, and resembled the fire risen at the universal dissolution. Then thinking.

sn: न विषादस्य कालोऽयमिति संचिन्त्य राघवः। चक्रे सुतुमुलं युद्ध रावणस्य वधे धृतः।। सर्वयत्नेन महता लक्ष्मणं परिवीक्ष्य च॥
en: This is not the time to indulge in grief he, gazing at Lakşmaņa, entered into a terrific encounter resolved upon slaying Rāvaņa, laying under contribution his dearest energies.

sn: स ददर्श ततो रामः शक्त्या भिन्नं महाहवे। लक्ष्मणं रुधिरादिग्धं सपन्नगमिवाचलम्॥
en: Rāma saw Lakşmaņa with his chest riven by the dart in the mighty conflict lying drenched in blood, and resembling a hill with serpents present in it.

sn: तामपि प्रहितां शक्तिं रावणेन बलीयसा। यत्नतस्ते हरिश्रेष्ठा न शेकुरवमर्दितुम्॥
en: In spite of all their efforts, the foremost monkeys failed to extract the dart which had been hurled by the powerful Rāvaņa.

sn: अदिताश्चैव बाणौषैस्ते प्रवेकेण रक्षसाम्। सौमित्रेः सा विनिर्भिद्य प्रविष्टा धरणीतलम्॥
en: And further, they were (all the white) sore assailed with showers of shafts by the foremost Rākṣasa of them all. The dart having pierced Sumitra's son, had entered the earth.

sn: तां कराभ्यां परामृश्य रामः शक्तिं भयावहाम्। बभञ्ज समरे क्रुद्धो बलवान्विचकर्ष च॥
en: In the encounter the mighty Rāma grasping the dreadful dart with his hands, extracted the same the wrathfully snapped it* *The commentator has a characteristic note. This dart, having pierced the foe, used always to return to Ravana. But Rama, whose was the Lord himself, having spoken to it as he did, it could not this time go back; and Rāma snapped it, which none else could do.

sn: तस्य निष्कर्षतः शक्तिं रावणेन बलीयसा। शराः सर्वेषु गात्रेषु पातिता मर्मभेदिनः॥
en: As he (Rāma) was engaged in pulling the dart out, the mighty Ravana kept pouring marrowpiercing shafts all over his person.

sn: अचिन्तयित्व तान्बाणान्समाश्लिष्य च लक्ष्मणम्। अब्रवीच्च हनूमन्तं सुग्रीवं च महाकपिम्॥
en: Thinking nothing of those arrows. Rāma embracing Lakşmaņa, spoke to Hanuman and the mighty monkey, Sugriva.

sn: लक्ष्मणं परिवार्यैवं तिष्ठध्वं वानरोत्तमाः। पराक्रमस्य कालोऽयं संप्राप्तो मे चिरेप्सितः॥
en: You foremost of monkeys do you stay here surrounding Lakṣmaṇa. The opportunity for putting forth my prowess which I had sought, is present.

sn: पापात्मायं दशग्रीवो वध्यतां पापनिश्चयः। काशितं चातकस्येव धर्मान्ते मेघदर्शनम्॥
en: I shall slay this wicked minded Ten-necked one, who is resolved to pursue the course of unrighteousness. Even as on the expire of summer the Cătaka is eager for the sight of clouds, I had long been eager to obtain a sight of (Ravana).

sn: अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते न चिरात्सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि वः। अरावणमरामं वा जगद्रक्ष्यथ वानराः॥
en: You monkeys, this I swear to you-this very hour not long after you will see this world without Rāvaņa or Rāma.

sn: राज्यनाशं वने वासं दण्डके परिधावनम्। वैदेह्याश्च परामर्शो रक्षोभिश्च समागमम्॥ प्राप्तं दुःखं महाघोरं क्लेशश्च निरयोपमः। अद्य सर्वमहं त्यक्ष्ये निहत्वा रावणं रणे।५०॥
en: To-day having slain Rāvaņa in battle, I shall renounce all sorrow arising from the loss of my kingdom, from my sojourn in the woods, from my wandering in Daņdaka, from the ravishment of Vaidehi, from encounter with the Raksasa, all the terrible evils that I have suffered and all the troubles resembling hell.

sn: यदर्थं वानरं सैन्यं समानीतमिदं मया। सुग्रीवश्च कृतो राज्ये निहत्वा वालिनं रणे।। यदर्थं सागरः क्रान्तः सेतुर्बद्धश्च सागरे॥ सोऽयमद्य रणे पापा आपश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतः। चक्षुर्विषयमागत्य नायं जीवितमर्हति॥
en: He for whom I have brought over the monkey-forces, made Sugriva king, slaying Vali in battle, for whom I have crossed the ocean and constructed a bridge over the deep-the same has been come at by me in conflict, and the same has come within the range of my vision.

sn: दृष्टिं दृष्टिविषस्येव सर्पस्य मम रावणः। यथा वा वैनतेयस्य दृष्टिं प्राप्तो भुजंगमः॥
en: Having come within my ken, Răvaņa will not live, even as one coming within ken of a serpent of poisonous sight, does not live; or even as a serpent does not live, coming within ken of Vinatās son. *Garuda.

sn: सुखं पश्यथ दुर्धर्षा युद्धं वानरपुङ्गवाः। आसीनाः पर्वताग्रेषु ममेदं रावणस्य च ॥
en: Do you, you irrepressible ones, you foremost of monkeys, seated at the brow of the mountain, behold the battle between me and Rāvaņa.

sn: अद्य पश्यन्तु रामस्य रामत्वं मम संयुगे। त्रयो लोकाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धगन्धर्वचारणाः॥
en: Today let the three worlds with the Gandharvas, and the Siddhas, and the Caranas, see that for which Rāma is Rāma.

sn: अद्य कर्म करिष्यामि यल्लोकाः सचराचराः। सदेवाः कथयिष्यन्ति यावद्भूमिर्धरिष्यति॥
en: Today I shall do a deed of which the worlds with the mobile and the immobile and the gods, shall speak as long as the Earth sustain (creatures.)

sn: समागम्य सदा लोके यथायुद्धं प्रवर्तितम्। एवमुक्त्वा शितैर्बाणैस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणैः। आजघान रणे रामो दशग्रीवं समाहितः।५७।।
en: Having delivered himself thus, Rama, concentrating his attention, began to charge the Ten-necked one in encounter with whetted arrows decked with burnished gold.

sn: तथा प्रविद्धैनाराचैर्मुसलैश्चापि रावणः। अभ्यवर्षत्तदा रामं धाराभिरिव तोयदः॥
en: In the same way Rāvana showered on Rama great Nárācas and clubs, even as clouds pour down showers.

sn: रामरावणमुक्तानामन्योन्यमभिनिघ्नताम्। वराणां च शराणां च बभूव तुमुलः स्वनः।॥
en: There arose a tremendous uproar of mighty arrows discharged by Rama and Ravana, smiting one another.

sn: विच्छिन्नाश्च विकीर्णाश्च रामरावणयोः शराः। अन्तरिक्षात्प्रदीप्ताग्रा निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥
en: The shafts shot by Rama and Rāvana, severed and scattered, with flaming heads dropped to the Earth.

sn: तयोर्ध्यातलनिर्घोषो रामरावणयोर्महान्। त्रासनः सर्वभूतानां बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः॥
en: The mighty twangs of the bow strings of both, terrifying all creatures, were wonderful to behold.* *Adbhutadarśana-wonderful to behold, wonderful to witness is the sense.

sn: महात्मनां दीप्तधनुष्मतार्दितः। भयात्प्रदुद्राव समेत्य रावणो यथानिलेनाभिहतो बलाहकः।२।।
en: Then even as clouds disperse on being trampled by the Winds, Ravana, covered with showers of arrowy networks by that high souled one and reduced to sore straits by that one (Rāma) of a glowing bow, fled away in fear.

sn: शक्त्या निपातितं दृष्ट्वा रावणेन बलीयसा। लक्ष्मणं समरे शूरं शोणितौधपरिप्लुतम् ॥ स दत्त्वा तुमुलं युद्ध रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। विसृजन्नेव बाणौघान्सुषेणमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing the heroic Lakşmaņa brought down by the dart discharged by the powerful Rāvana and lying drenched in blood, he (Rama) after having fought furiously with the wicked-minded Ravana-and having showered vollies of shafts, addressed Susena, saying.

sn: एष रावणवीर्येण लक्ष्मणः पतितो भुवि। सर्पवच्चेष्टते वीरो मम शोकमुदीरयन्॥
en: This heroic Lakşmaņa brought down to the earth by the prowess of Rāvana, Leith like a serpent, enhancing my sorrow.

sn: शोणितामिमं वीरं प्राणैः प्रियतरं मम। पश्यतो मम का शक्तिर्योद्धं पर्याकुलात्मनः॥
en: Seeing this hero dearer to me that life, what power have I, with my soul overwhelmed with dole, to fight?

sn: अयं स समरश्लाघी भ्राता मे शुभलक्षणः। यदि पञ्चत्वमापन्नः प्राणैर्मे किं सुखेन वा॥
en: If this brother of mine graced with auspicious marks, delighting in battle, breathe his last, what shall life avail me or happiness?

sn: लज्जतीव हि मे वीर्यं भ्रश्यतीव कराद्धनुः। सायका व्यवसीदन्ति दृष्टिर्बाष्पवशं गता॥
en: My prowess is ashamed; my bow fall off from my hand; my arrows droop; my sight is dimmed with tears; my limbs weaken as do those of men in a dream; thought racks me; and I even desire death.

sn: अवसीदन्ति गात्राणि स्वप्नयाने नृणामिव। चिन्ता में वर्तते तीव्रा मुमूर्षापि च जायते।७।। भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा रावणेन दुरात्मना। विष्टनन्तं तु दुःखार्तं मर्मण्यभिहतं भृशम्॥ परं विषादमापन्नो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः।
en: Seeming his brother wounded by the wickedminded Rāvana, crying in preternatural accents and sore stricken in his vitals, (Rāma) overcome by a mighty sorrow, lamented with his senses wildered.

sn: भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणं रणपांसुषु॥ विजयोऽपि हि मे शूर न प्रियायोपकल्पते। अचक्षुर्विषयश्चन्द्रः कां प्रीतिं जनयिष्यति॥
en: Seeing my brother, Laksmana, wounded, and laying over the dust of the field, even victory, O hero, does not seem to me sweet. If the Moon is hid from the sight, whom does he then delight?

sn: किं मे युद्धेन किं प्राणैयुद्धकार्यं न विद्यते। यत्रायं निहतः शेते रणमूर्धनि लक्ष्मणः॥
en: What have I to do with battle? What have I to do with life? I have no more to do anything with fighting, seeing that this Laksmana wounded, Leith in the field of battle.

sn: यथैव मां वनं यान्तमनुयाति महाद्युतिः। अहमप्यनुयास्यामि तथैवैनं यमक्षयम्॥
en: As this highly effulgent one had followed me into the forest, so will I in the same way follow him to the abode of Yama.

sn: इष्टबन्धुजनो नित्यं मां स नित्यमनुव्रतः। इमामवस्थां गमितो राक्षसैः कूटयोधिभिः॥
en: Ever seeking my welfare and ever devoted to me, he has been reduced to this pass by Rākṣasas fighting in crooked ways.

sn: देशे देशे कलत्राणि देशे देशे च बान्धवाः। तं तु देशं न पश्यामि यत्र भ्राता सहोदरः॥
en: In land after land one meets with wives, in land after land one meets with friends, but country find I none where a uterine brother may be met with.

sn: किं नु राज्येन दुर्धर्ष लक्ष्मणेन विना मम। कथं वक्ष्याम्यहं त्वम्बां सुमित्रां पुत्रवत्सलाम्॥
en: What, О irrepressible one, shall I do with the kingdom without my Lakşmaņa? And what shall I say to mother Sumitra, fond of her son?

sn: उपालम्भं न शक्ष्यामि सोढुं दत्तं सुमित्रया। किं नु वक्ष्यामि कौसल्यां मातरं किं नु कैकयीम्।।१६।
en: I shall never be able to bear the reproach Sumitrā shall cast upon me. And what shall I say to Kausalyā and what to mother Kaikei?

sn: भरतं किं नु वक्ष्यामि शत्रुघ्नं च महाबलम्। सह तेन वनं यातो विना तेनागतः कथम्॥
en: What shall I say to Bharata, and what to the exceedingly powerful Satrughna? You had gone to the woods with him. Why then did you come (back) without him?

sn: इहैव मरणं श्रेयो न तु बन्धुविगर्हणम्। किं मया दुष्कृतं कर्म कृतमन्यत्र जन्मनि॥ येन मे धार्मिको भ्राता निहतश्चाग्रतः स्थितः।
en: It is better (for me) to renounce my life here, instead of bearing the censure of friends. What a sin had I committed in another birth, seeing that my virtuous brother, staying before me, has been slain?

sn: हा भ्रातर्मनुजश्रेष्ठ शूराणां प्रवर प्रभो॥ एकाकी किं नु मां त्यक्वा परलोकाय गच्छसि।
en: Ah, my brother! You best of me! O master, who were the foremost of heroes! Why, forsaking me, did you repair to the other regions.

sn: विलपन्तं च मां भ्रातः किमर्ष नावभाषसे॥ उत्तिष्ठ पश्य किं शेषे दीनं मां पश्य चक्षुषा।
en: Wherefore brother, did you not speak to me, who am lamenting? Get up See! Why did you lie down? Look on me with your eyes.

sn: शोकार्तस्य प्रमत्तस्य पर्वतेषु वनेषु च॥ विषण्णस्य महाबाहो समाश्वासयिता मम।
en: O mighty-armed one, in the woods and mountains you did ever use to cheer me, tried by grief and pining in despondency, with my mind overwhelmed (with woe).

sn: राममेवं ब्रुवाणं तु शोकव्याकुलितेन्द्रियम्॥ आश्वासयनुवाचेदं सुषेणः परमं वचः।
en: As Rāma was speaking thus with his senses overwhelmed with emotion, Sușeņa, soothing him, spoke these pregnant words.

sn: त्यजेमां नरशार्दूल बुद्धिं वैक्लव्यकारिणीम्॥ शोकसंजननीं चिन्तां तुल्यां बाणैश्चमूमुखे।
en: O foremost of men, cast off this train of thought tending to overwhelm your understanding, this anxiety giving birth to grief, and resembling the shafts of foes in the van of the embattled forces.

sn: नैव पञ्चत्वमापन्नो लक्ष्मणो लक्ष्मिवर्धनः॥ नह्यस्य विकृतं वक्रं न च श्यामत्वमागतम्। सुप्रभं च प्रसन्नं च मुखमस्य निरीक्ष्यताम्॥
en: Lakşmaņa enhancer of auspiciousness is not dead. His face is not distorted or blackened. Do you look at his countenance, which is beautifully bright and cheerful.

sn: पद्मपत्रतलौ हस्तौ सुप्रसन्ने च लोचने। नेदृशं दृश्यते रूपं गतासूनां विशां पते॥
en: His hands have palms resembling lotus-petals, and his eyes are pleasant. O king, one dead does not look thus.

sn: विषादं मा कृथा वीर सप्राणोऽयमरिंदम। आख्याति तु प्रसुप्तस्य स्रस्तगात्रस्य भूतले॥ सोच्छ्वासं हृदयं वीर कम्पमानं मुहुर्मुहुः।
en: (Therefore,) O hero, do not grieve. O subduer of enemies this one is instinct with life. As he is lying down on the ground, stretched at length, his respiration.

sn: एवमुक्त्वा महाप्राज्ञः सुषेणो राघवं वचः॥ समीपस्थमुवाचेदं हनूमन्तं महाकपिम्।
en: Having spoken thus to Răghava, the highly wise Suşeņa thus addressed the mighty monkeys, Hanumān, saying.

sn: सौम्य शीघ्रमितो गत्वा पर्वतं हि महोदयम्॥ पूर्व तु कथितो योऽसौ वीर जाम्बवता तव। दक्षिणे शिखरे जातां महौषधिमिहानयः॥ विशल्यकरणी नाम्ना सावर्ण्यकरणी तथा। संजीवकरणी वीर संधानी च महौषधीम्॥ संजीवनार्थं वीरस्य लक्ष्मणस्य त्वमानय।
en: O placid one hieing hence to the mountain, Mahodaya, which, O hero had formerly been mentioned to you by Jāmbavan bring hither the mighty drug sprung at it right summitVisalyakarani by name, and Savarnyakarani.* and Sañjīvakaraņi O hero, and the potent medicine-Sandhāni. Do you bring (these) in order that the hero-Laksmana-May be revived. *Lit.-that which restores the former complexion.

sn: इत्येवमुक्तो हनुमान्गत्वा चौषधिपर्वतम्।। चिन्तामभ्यमच्छीमानजानंस्ता महौषधीः॥
en: Having been thus in strutted, Hanuman, repairing to the medicinal mountain, was wrought up with anxiety not knowing the drugs.

sn: तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना मारुतेरमितौजसः। इदमेव गमिष्यामि गृहीत्वा शिखरं गिरेः॥
en: Then the thought sprang up in the mind of the Wind-god's offspring of immeasurabie prowess, I shall go, even taking this (entire) summit of the mountain.

sn: अस्मिंस्तु शिखरे जातामोषधीं तां सुखावहाम्। प्रतर्केणावगच्छामि सुषेणो ह्येवमब्रवीत्॥
en: In this very summit must that delightful drug have sprung. This I inter, inasmuch as Susena had forsooth said so.

sn: अगृह्य यदि गच्छामि विशल्यकरणीमहम्। कालात्ययेन दोषः स्याद्वैक्लव्यं च महद्भवेत्।।३५
en: If I fail to take Visalyakaraṇī, I shall come by disgrace, and if I spend much time (in thought), that would be fraught with evil.)* *Explains the commentator: 'If I take any other medicine by mistake, I shall make a fool of myself; if I spend much time in though, Laksmana may die.

sn: इति संचिन्त्य हनुमान्गत्वा क्षिप्रं महाबलः। आसाद्य पर्वतश्रेष्ठं त्रिः प्रकम्प्य गिरेस्तटम्॥ फुल्लनानातरुगणं समुत्पाट्य महाबलः। गृहीत्वा हरिशार्दूलो हस्ताभ्यां समतोलयत्॥
en: Having reflected thus the exceedingly powerful Hanumăn, foremost of monkeysswiftly drawing up to that best of mountains and giving three shakes to the mountain filled with various flowering trees-raised it up with his hands.

sn: स नीलमिव जीमूतं तोयपूर्ण नभस्तलात्। उत्पपात गृहीत्वा तु हनूमाशिखरं गिरेः॥
en: And taking that summit of the mountain resembling dark-blue clouds charged with rain, Hanumān from the earth bounded up in the sky.

sn: समागम्य महावेगः संन्यस्य शिखरं गिरेः। विश्रम्य किंचिद्धनुमान्सुषेणमिदमब्रवीत् ॥
en: Arriving (at his quarters) that wondrous vehement one putting down the mountain-peak, and reposing for a while, spoke to Susena.

sn: औषधी वगच्छामि ता अहं हरिपुङ्गव। तदिदं शिखरं कृत्स्नं गिरेस्तस्याहृतं मया॥
en: I did not find the drug, O best of monkeys; and therefore have I brought this entire summit of the mountain.

sn: एवं कथयमानं तु प्रशस्य पवनात्मजम्। सुषेणो वानरश्रेष्ठो जग्राहोत्पाट्य चौषधीः।॥
en: When the Wind-god's offspring had spoken thus, that foremost of monkeys-Susena-praising him uprooted the herb and secured it.

sn: विस्मितास्तु बभूवुस्ते सर्वे वानरपुङ्गवाः। दृष्ट्वा तु हनुमत्कर्म सुरैरपि सुदुष्करम्।॥
en: Seeing Hanuman's feat incapable of being done by even the celestials, the choice of the monkeys were amazed.

sn: ततः संक्षोदयित्वा तामोषधीं वानरोत्तमः। लक्ष्मणस्य ददौ नस्तः सुषेणः सुमहाद्युतिः॥
en: Then crushing the healing herb, that best of monkeys-the exceedingly effulgent Sușeņa, made Laksmana smell the same.

sn: सशल्यः स समाघ्राय लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। विशल्यो विरुनः शीघ्रमुदतिष्ठन्महीतलात्॥
en: Thereupon the wounded Lakşmana, slayer of hostile heroes-smelling it, curd of his wound and ailments, speedily rose up from the ground.

sn: तमुत्थितं तु हरयो भूतलात्प्रेक्ष्य लक्ष्मणम्। साधुसाध्विति सुप्रीता लक्ष्मणं प्रत्यपूजयन्॥
en: Seeing Lakşmaņa rise up from the earth, the monkeys, exceedingly rejoiced, honouring Laks mana, exclaimed, “Excellent! Excellent!"

sn: एोहीत्यब्रवीद्रामो लक्ष्मणं परवीरहा। सस्वजे गाढमालिङ्गय बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः॥
en: “Come!” said that slayer of hostile heroesRāma and with his eyes filled with tears, he deeply embraced Lakşmaņa.

sn: अब्रवीच्च परिष्वज्य सौमित्रिं राघवस्तदा। दिष्ट्या त्वां वीर पश्यामि मरणात्पुनरागतम्।।४७
en: Having embraced Sumitra's son, Raghava then addressed him saying, “By good fortune it is that, O hero, I see you returned from (the mansion of ) Death.

sn: न हि मे जीवितेनार्थः सीतया च जयेन वा। को हि मे जीवितेनार्थस्त्वयि पञ्चत्वमागते॥
en: Verily my life, or Sită, or Victory is worthless (without you). And you being dead what is my life worth?

sn: इत्येवं ब्रुवतस्तस्य राघवस्य महात्मनः। खिनः शिथिलया वाचा लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: When the high-souled Raghava had spoken thus, Lakşmaņa, aggrieved on account of the words (of Rāghava) expressive of infirmity of purpose, said.

sn: तां प्रतिज्ञा प्रतिज्ञाय पुरा सत्यपराक्रम। लघुः कश्चिदिवासत्त्वो नैवं त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: Having bound yourself by that vow, it does not, O you having truth for prowess, behove you to speak like one fickle and feeble.

sn: नहि प्रतिज्ञां कुर्वन्ति वितथा सत्यवादिनः। लक्षणं हि महत्त्वस्य प्रतिज्ञापरिपालनम्॥ नैराश्यमुपगन्तुं च नालं ते मत्कृतेऽनघ। वधेन रावणस्याद्य प्रतिज्ञामनुपालय॥
en: Those speaking the truth, never falsify their promise: the mark of a great one is even observance of vow. O sinless one, do not suffer yourself to be overcome by despair on my account. Do you today by slaying Rāvaņa, make your promise good.

sn: न जीवन्यास्यते शत्रुस्तव बाणवशं गतः। नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रस्य सिंहस्येव महागजः॥
en: Your foe coming within the sway of your shafts will not hence, living, even like a mighty elephant coming before a sharp-toothed roaring lion.

sn: अहं तु वधमिच्छामि शीघ्रमस्य दुरात्मनः। यावदस्तं न यात्येष कृतकर्मा दिवाकरः॥
en: I wish the speedy destruction of this impious one, ere the maker of day, having performed his work, has ascended the Setting-hill.

sn: यदि वधमिच्छसि रावणस्य संख्ये यदि च कृतां हि तवेच्छसि प्रतिज्ञाम्। यदि तव राजसुताभिलाष आर्य कुरु च वचो मम शीघ्रमद्य वीर॥
en: If you wish to slay Råvaņa in battle, if your desire to recover the princess, then, O noble one, O hero, today speedily set about what I say.

sn: अहं तु वधमिच्छामि शीघ्रमस्य दुरात्मनः। यावदस्तं न यात्येष कृतकर्मा दिवाकरः॥
en: I wish the speedy destruction of this impious one, ere the maker of day, having performed his work, has ascended the Setting-hill.

sn: यदि वधमिच्छसि रावणस्य संख्ये यदि च कृतां हि तवेच्छसि प्रतिज्ञाम्। यदि तव राजसुताभिलाष आर्य कुरु च वचो मम शीघ्रमद्य वीर॥
en: If you wish to slay Råvaņa in battle, if your desire to recover the princess, then, O noble one, O hero, today speedily set about what I say.

sn: लक्ष्मणेन तु तद्वाक्यमुक्तं श्रुत्वा स राघवः। संदधे परवीरघ्नो धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्॥ रावणाय शरान्घोरान्विससर्ज चमूमुखे। अथान्यं रथमास्थाय रावणो राक्षसाधिपः॥ अभ्यधावत काकुत्स्थं स्वर्भानुरिव भास्करम्।
en: Hearing the words uttered by Lakşmaņa, that slayer of hostile heroes-Raghava-endued with prowess, taking his bow, set shafts on it, and in the brunt of battle began to discharge dreadful arrows at Ravana. And mounted on another car, Rāvana-lord of Rakşasas-rushed against Käkutstha, even as Svarbhānu rush against the Sun.

sn: दशग्रीवो रथस्थस्तु रामं वज्रोपमैः शरैः।। आजघान महाशैलं धाराभिरिव तोयदः॥
en: Even as a mass of clouds poured down torrents on a mighty mountain, the Ten-necked one, mounted on his car, smote Rāma with shafts resembling thunder-bolts.

sn: दीप्तपावकसंकाशैः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः। अभ्यवर्षद्रणे रामो दशग्रीवं समाहितः॥
en: In the encounter Rāma, concentrating his thoughts, showered on the Ten-necked one arrows embellished with gold and looking like living fire.

sn: भूमौ स्थितस्य रामस्य रथस्थस्य च रक्षसः। न समं युद्धमित्याहुर्देवगन्धर्वकिंनराः॥
en: And celestials and Gandharvas and Kinnaras declared that there had been no other battle like to the encounter of Rāma stationed on the ground and the Rākṣasa mounted on his car.

sn: ततो देववरः श्रीमाञ्श्रुत्वा तेषां वचोऽमृतम्। आहूय मातलिं शक्रो वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then the foremost of celestials-ſakra-hearing their ambrosial speech, summoning Mätali, said.

sn: रथेन मम भूमिष्ठं शीघ्रं याहि रघूत्तमम्। आहूय भूतलं यातः कुरु देवहितं महत्॥
en: Taking my car, hie to the best of the Raghus. And reaching the earth do you welcoming (him) bring about great good to the gods.

sn: इत्युक्तो देवराजेन मातलिदेवसारथिः। प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं ततो वचनमब्रवीत्।८।। शीघ्रं यास्यामि देवेन्द्र सारथ्यं च करोम्यहम्।
en: Thus accosted by the sovereign of the celestials, Matali-celestial charioteer bending down his head, addressed that celestial saying. Speedily shall I go o lord of the celestials; and I shall also do the office of a charioteer (to Raghava).

sn: ततो हयैश्च संयोज्य हरितैः स्यन्दनोत्तमम्।। ततः काञ्चनचित्राङ्गः किङ्किणीशतभूषितः॥ तरुणादित्यसंकाशो वैदूर्यमयकूबरः। सदश्वैः काञ्चनापीडैर्युक्तः श्वेतप्रकीर्णकैः॥ हरिभिः सूर्यसंकाशैर्हेमजालविभूषितैः। रुक्मवेणुध्वजः श्रीमान्देवराजरथो वरः॥ देवराजेन संदिष्टो रथमारुह्य मातलिः। अभ्यवर्तत काकुत्स्थमवतीर्य त्रिविष्टपात्॥
en: Then yoking with steeds that best of cars, curiously wrought with gold; adorned with hundreds of small bells; resembling the Sun new risen; having its pole studded with lapises: yoked with excellent horses caparisoned in gold; furnished with white chowris, drawn by steeds resembling the Sun; decked with golden networks, and provided with a golden standardthe graceful car of the sovereign of the celestialsMātalī commanded by the king of the immortals, ascending the car went out of the celestial regions and came to Käkutstha.

sn: अब्रवीच्च तदा रामं सप्रतोदो रथे स्थितः। प्राञ्जलिर्मातलिक्यिं सहस्राक्षस्य सारथिः॥
en: With his hand holding the reins, the charioteer car, of the thousand-eyed (Deity) with joined hands addressed Rāma: saying.

sn: सहस्राक्षेण काकुत्स्थ रथोऽयं विजयाय ते। दत्तस्तव महासत्त्व श्रीमशत्रुनिबर्हण॥ इदमैन्द्रं महच्चापं कवचं चाग्निसंनिभम्। शराश्चादित्यसंकाशाः शक्तिश्च विमला शिवा ॥
en: O Kākutstha, in order that you may obtain the victory, the thousand-eyed (god) has sent you his car. O exceedingly powerful one! O graceful (hero)! O you that slays your foes! this is the redoubtable bow of Indra, and this is the mail resembling fire, and these are the arrows looking like the very Sun; and this is the dart shining and fraught with fair fortune.

sn: आरुह्येमं रथं वीर राक्षसं जहि रावणम्। मया सारथिना देव महेन्द्र इव दानवान्॥
en: Ascend you this O hero Slay the RākşasaRāvaņa, with me as your charioteer, even as the lord of the celestials slay Dānavas.

sn: इत्युक्तः संपरिक्रम्य रथं तमभिवाद्य च। आरुरोह तदा रामो लोकॉल्लक्ष्म्या विराजयन्॥
en: Thus addressed, Rāma, going round the car and saluting it, ascended the same, illumining the worlds with his splendour.

sn: तद्वभौ चाद्भुतं युद्धं द्वैरथं रोमहर्षणम्। रामस्य च महाबाहो रावणस्य च रक्षसः॥
en: The encounter that took place between the two cars with the mighty-armed Rāma (on one side) and the Rākşasa-Rāvana (on the other) was wonderful to behold.

sn: स गान्धर्वेण गान्धर्वं दैवं दैवेन राघवः। अस्त्रं राक्षसराजस्य जघान परमास्त्रवित्॥
en: Rāghava highly proficient in weapons with a Gândharva weapon resisted the Gandharva weapons of the Rākşasa king and with a celestial weapon, his celestial weapon.

sn: अस्त्रं तु परमं घोरं राक्षसं राक्षसाधिपः। ससर्ज परमक्रुद्धः पुनरेव निशाचरः॥
en: Then that lord of Raksasas-the night-rangerfired with high rage, again discharged an exceedingly dreadful Rākṣasa, weapon.

sn: ते रावणधनुर्मुक्ताः शराः काञ्चनभूषणाः। अभ्यवर्तन्त काकुत्स्थं सर्पा भूत्वा महाविषाः॥
en: The gold-decked shafts shot from Ravana's bow, becoming furiously venomous serpents covered Kakutstha.

sn: ते दीप्तवदना दीप्तं वमन्तो ज्वलनं मुखैः। राममेवाभ्यवर्तन्त व्यादितास्या भयानकाः॥
en: And vomiting living flames they of terrific aspect, having flaming faces, showered over Rāma with gaping mouths.

sn: तैर्वासुकिसमस्पर्शेर्दीप्तभोगैर्महाविषैः। दिशश्च संतताः सर्वा विदिशश्च समावृताः॥
en: Those flaming venomous serpents having the feel of Vāsuki himself, covered all sides and enveloped all quarters.

sn: तान्दृष्ट्वा पत्रगानरामः समापतत आहवे। अखं गारुत्मतं घोरं प्रादुश्चक्रे भयावहम्॥
en: Seeing those serpents descending in the encounter, Rāma employed a dreadful Garuda weapon.

sn: ते राघवधनुर्मुक्ता रुक्मपुङ्खाः शिखिप्रभाः। सुपर्णाः काञ्चना भूत्वा विचेरुः सर्पशत्रवः॥
en: Discharged from Rāghava's bow, those arrows plated with gold at the feathered parts and furnished with the splendour of peacocks, becoming golden birds-began to range (the field of battle) as the enemies of the serpents.

sn: ते तान्सर्वाशराजघ्नुः सर्परूपान्महाजवान्। सुपर्णरूपा रामस्य विशिखा: कामरूपिणः॥
en: The shafts of Rāma capable of wearing forms at will, turned into birds, destroyed all the exceedingly swift coursing arrows having the forms of serpents.

sn: अस्त्रे प्रतिहते क्रुद्धो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। अभ्यवर्षत्तदा रामं घोराभिः शरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: On his weapon having been baffle, Ravanalord of Rākşasas waxing wroth poured tremendous showers of shafts on Räma.

sn: ततः शरसहस्रेण राममक्लिष्टकारिणम्। अर्दयित्वा शरौघेण मातलिं प्रत्यविध्यत॥
en: Smiting Rama of untiring deeds with thousands of shafts, (Ravana) pierced Matali with vollies of arrows.

sn: चिच्छेद केतुमुद्दिश्य शरेणैकेन रावणः। पातयित्वा रथोपस्थे रथात्केतुं च काञ्चनम्॥ ऐन्द्रानपि जघानाश्वाञ्शरजालेन रावणः।
en: And with an arrow, Rāvana severed the standard; and having brought down the golden standard on the floor of the car, Rāvaņa wounded even Indra's steeds with a net-work of arrows. were

sn: विषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वचारणा दानवैः सह॥ राममार्तं तदा दृष्ट्वा सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। व्यथिता वानरेन्द्राश्च बभूवुः सविभीषणाः॥
en: Seeing Rāma hard pressed, celestials and Gandharvas and Carañas along with Dänavas, and Sidhas, and the supreme saints were overcome with sadness; and the foremost monkeys together with Vibhīşaņa aggrieved.

sn: रामचन्द्रमसं दृष्ट्वा ग्रस्तं रावणराहुणा। प्राजापत्यं च नक्षत्रं रोहिणीं शशिनः प्रियाम्॥ समाक्रम्य बुधस्तस्थौ प्रजानामहितावहः।
en: Seeing a moon of Rāmacandra in the grasp of a Rāhu of Rāvana that bringer of evil to creatures-Buddha-stood, assailing the Prājāpatya star-Rohini-beloved of the Moon.

sn: सधूमपरिवृत्तोर्मिः प्रज्वलनिव सागरः॥ उत्पपात तदा क्रुद्धः स्पृशनिव दिवाकरम्।
en: The enraged Ocean, heaving with smoking surges and flaming as it were swelled up seeming to the touch the Sun.

sn: शस्त्रवर्णः सुपरुषो मन्दरश्मिदिवाकरः॥ अदृश्यत कबन्धाङ्कः संसक्तो धूमकेतुना।
en: The Sun was blackened and assumed a stern aspect, with his rays dimmed. And he was seen with a head-less trunk on his lap and he was in conjunction with a comet.

sn: कोसलानां च नक्षत्रं व्यक्तमिन्द्राग्निदैवतम्॥ आहत्याङ्गारकस्तस्थौ विशाखमपि चाम्बरे।
en: That star of the Kośalas, relating to the deities-Indra and Agni-Angaraka-stood in the sky, attacking Visakha.

sn: दशास्यो विंशतिभुजः प्रगृहीतशरासनः॥ अदृश्यत दशग्रीवो मैनाक इव पर्वतः।
en: The Ten-necked one having ten faces and twenty arms, equipped with his bow, looked like the mountain-Mainaka.

sn: निरस्यमानो रामस्तु दशग्रीवेण रक्षसा॥ नाशक्नोदभिसंधातुं सायकारणमूर्धनि ।
en: Rāma reduced to sore straits by the Tennecked Rākṣasa, could not discharge his arrows in the conflict.

sn: स कृत्वा भ्रुकुटि क्रुद्धः किंचित्संरक्तलोचनः॥ जगाम सुमहाक्रोधं निर्दहनिव राक्षसान्।
en: Then the enraged Rāma with his eyes slightly red flew into a tremendous passion as if burning up the Rākşasas.

sn: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य वदनं दृष्ट्वा रामस्य धीमतः।। सर्वभूतानि वित्रेसुः प्राकम्पत च मेदिनी॥
en: Seeing the face of the enraged Rāma endued with under standing all the creatures were overwhelmed with fear and the Earth herself shook.

sn: सिंहशार्दूलवाञ्छैलः संचचाल चलद्रुमः। बभूवः चापि क्षुभितः समुद्रः सरितां पतिः॥
en: And mountains abounding with lions and tigers began to tremble, and trees to shiver. And even the deep-lord of streams-was wrought up wondrously.

sn: खराश्च खरनिर्घोषा गगने परुषा घनाः। औत्पातिकाश्च नर्दन्तः समन्तात्परिचक्रमुः॥
en: And rough and terrific clouds in the sky sent forth fierce roars. And stormy clouds rumbling went about the heavens.

sn: रामं दृष्ट्वा सुसंक्रुद्धमुत्पाताश्चैव दारुणान्। वित्रेसुः सर्वभूतानि रावणस्याभवद्भयम्।॥
en: Seeing Rāma wrought up with a mighty passion, and the fearful disastrous omens, all creatures were possessed by fright and Rāvana was stuck with dismay.

sn: विमानस्थास्तदा देवा गन्धर्वाश्च महोरगाः। ऋषिदानवदैत्याश्च गरुत्मन्तश्च खेचराः॥ ददृशुस्ते तदा युद्धं लोकसंवर्तसंस्थितम्। नानाप्रहरणै मैः शूरयोः संप्रयुध्यतोः॥
en: Then stationed in the sky celestials and Gandharvas and mighty serpents and saints and Dānavas and Daityas and those related to Garuda-fowls-beheld that conflict like to the universal tumbling as the two heroes faught on with various dire arms.

sn: ऊचुः सुरासुराः सर्वे तदा विग्रहमागताः। प्रेक्षमाणा महायुद्धं वाक्यं भक्त्या प्रहृष्टवत्॥
en: As they looked on the mighty encounter, the celestials and the Asuras, who had come to the conflict, from feeling of regard,* Cheerfully spoke (these words). *i.e. each party out of regard for the warrior to whom it wished well.

sn: दशग्रीवं जयेत्याहुरसुराः समवस्थिताः। देवा राममथोचुस्ते त्वं जयेति पुनः पुनः॥
en: The Asuras staying there said to the Tennecked one, Be victorious and the celestials again and again said to Rāma, 'Be victorious'!
