sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रोधाद्राघवस्य च रावणः। प्रहर्तुकामो दुष्टात्मा स्पृशन्प्रहरणं महत्॥ वज्रसारं महानादं सर्वशनिबर्हणम्। शैलशृङ्गनिभैः कूटैश्चित्तदृष्टिभयावहम्॥ सधूममिव तीक्ष्णाग्रं युगान्ताग्निचयोपमम्। अतिरौद्रमनासाद्यं कालेनापि दुरासदम्॥ त्रासनं सर्वभूतानां दारणं भेदनं तथा। प्रदीप्त इव रोषेण शूलं जग्राह रावणः॥
en: In the meantime, the impious Rāvaņa, desirous of slaying Rāghava, from wrath took up a mighty weapon, fraught with the essence of the thunder bolt; sending terrible sounds; capable of destroying all foes-furnished with forks resembling mountain-peaks; tending to strike terror to mind and sight; sharp-pointed resembling the smoking fire rise at the hour of universal dissolution; exceedingly terrible; irresistible (in battle); unbearable even by the Destroyer-the terror of all creatures-terrific; and competent to rive (all things). Flaming up with wrath, Ravana took this dart.

sn: तच्छूलं परमद्धो जग्राह युधि वीर्यवान्। अनीकैः समरे शूरै राक्षसैः परिवारितः॥ समुद्यम्य महाकायो ननाद युधि भैरवम्। संरक्तनयनो रोषात्स्वसैन्यमभिहर्षयन्॥ पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च दिशश्च प्रदिशस्तथा। प्राकम्पयत्तदा शब्दो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दारुणः॥
en: And fired with furious wrath, that powerful one took the dart in the encounter, surrounded in that contest by many heroic Rākşasas. And uplifting (the dart), the huge-bodied Ravana, with his eyes reddened in passion, emitted mighty roars. And the shouts ofd the Rākşasa sovereign made the earth and the sky and the cardinal quarters and all sides tremble.

sn: अतिकायस्य नादेन तेन तस्य दुरात्मनः। सर्वभूतानि वित्रेसुः सागरश्च प्रचुक्षुभे॥
en: And at the roars of that wicked-minded and huge-bodied one, all creatures were struck with terror, and the sea was vexed.* *The still-vexed Bermoothes.'-Tempest.

sn: स गृहीत्वा महावीर्यः शूलं तद्रावणो महत्। विनद्य सुमहानादं रामं परुषमब्रवीत्॥
en: The exceedingly energetic Rävaņa, taking that mighty dart, and sending up furious shouts, addressed Rāma in a harsh speech, saying.

sn: शूलोऽयं वज्रसारस्ते राम रोषान्मयोद्यतः। तव भ्रातृसहायस्य सम्यक्प्राणान्हरिष्यति॥
en: O Rāma, I in wrath uplift this dart having the strength of the levin. This will utterly deprive of life you who are assisted by your brother.

sn: रक्षसामद्य शूराणां निहतानां चमूमुखे। त्वां निहत्य रणश्लाघी करोमि तरसा समम्॥
en: O you, that delight in battle, today swiftly slaying you, I shall make you even with those heroic Rākşasa slain in the van of the forces.

sn: तिष्ठेदानी निहन्मि त्वामेष शूलेन राघव। एवमुक्त्वा च चिक्षेप तच्छूलं राक्षसाधिपः॥
en: Stay now, O Raghava, you shall I slay with this dart. Saying this, the lord of the Rākşasas hurled the dart.

sn: तद्रावणकरान्मुक्तं विद्युन्मालासमावृतम्। अष्टघण्टं महानादं वियद्गतमशोभत। ५९॥
en: And discharged from Ravana's hand, (the dart), surrounded with garlands of lighting furnished with eight bells, sending mighty roars, rising to the sky, looked exceedingly splendid.

sn: तच्छूलं राघवो दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तं घोरदर्शनम्। ससर्ज विशिखारामश्चापमायम्य वीर्यवान् ॥
en: Seeing the dart, flaming and of terrific aspect, Raghu's son-Rāma-endowed with prowess, drawing his bow, discharged arrows.

sn: आपतन्तं शरौघेण वारयामास राघव। उत्पतन्तं युगान्ताग्नि जलौघैरिव वासवः॥
en: And with vollies of shafts Räghava resisted the descending (dart), even as Vāsava extinguish the fire of doomsday with his showers.

sn: निर्ददाह स तान्बाणान्रामकार्मुकनिःसृतान्। रावणस्य महाशूल: पतङ्गानिव पावकः॥
en: Then even as a flame consume insects, the mighty dart of Rāvana burnt up those shafts shot from the bow of Råma.

sn: तान्दृष्ट्वा भस्मसाद्भूताशूलसंस्पर्शचूर्णितान्। सायकानन्तरिक्षस्थानराघवः क्रोधमूर्छितः॥
en: Seeing those shafts reduced to ashes and crushed on coming in contact with the dart, as they were coursing in the sky, Rāghava was transported with passion.

sn: स तां मातलिना नीतां शक्तिं वासवसंमताम्। जग्राह परमक्रुद्धो राघवो रघुनन्दनः॥
en: Then waxing wondrous wroth, Raghu's sonRāghava-took up a javelin, liked by Vāsava himself, brought by Matali.

sn: सा तोलिता बलवता शक्तिघण्टाकृतस्वना। नभः प्रज्वालयामास युगान्तोल्केव सप्रभा॥
en: On being wielded by that strong one, the javelin, resonant with bells, made the welkin blaze up, like a burning meteor on the occasion of universal rack.

sn: सा क्षिप्ता राक्षसेन्द्रस्य तस्मिञ्छूले पपात ह। भिन्नः शक्त्या महाशूलो निपपात गतद्युतिः॥
en: And when hurled, it alighted on that same dart of the Raksasa chief. And thereat, with its splendour lost, the mighty dart, riven, dropped (to the earth.)

sn: निर्बिभेद ततो बाणैर्हयानस्य महाजवान्। रामः क्षिप्तैर्महावेगैर्बाणवद्भिरजिह्मगैः॥
en: Then Rama, shooting straight-speeding arrows, pierced his (Ravana's) exceedingly fleet steeds.

sn: निर्बिभेदोरसि तदा रावणं निशितैः शरैः। राघवः परमायचो ललाटे पत्रिभिस्त्रिभिः॥
en: Then he pierced Rāvana in the chest with whetted arrows. And the energetic Rāghava hit (Rāvaņa) in the temples with three feathered shafts.

sn: स शरैभिन्नसर्वाङ्गो गात्रप्रमुतशोणितः। राक्षसेन्द्रसमूहस्थः फुल्लाशोक इवाबभौ॥
en: Thereat with all his limbs pierced (with arrows), and his body laved in blood, the lord of Räkşasas furnished with many limbs, looked like a flowering Asoka.

sn: स रामबाणैरतिविद्धगात्रो निशाचरेन्द्रः क्षतजाईगात्रः। जगाम खेदं च समाजमध्ये क्रोधं च चक्रे सुभृशं तदानीम्॥
en: With his person pierced with the shafts of Rāma, the lord of night-rangers having his body drenched with blood, was stricken with sadness in the midst of his forces, and was also overwhelmed with terrific wrath.

sn: स तु तेन तदा क्रोधात्काकुत्स्थेनादितो भृशम्। रावणः समरश्लाघी महाक्रोधमुपागमत्॥
en: On being greatly harassed by Käkutstha in anger, Ravana, delighting in battle, came under the sway of a towering passion.

sn: स दीप्तनयनोऽमर्षाच्चापमुद्यम्य वीर्यवान्। अभ्यर्दयत्सुसंकृद्धो राघवं परमाहवे॥
en: And with his eyes aglow, that powerful one from wrath and fury assailed Raghava in mighty encounter.

sn: बाणाधारासहस्रैस्तु सतोयद इवाम्बरात्। राघवं रावणो बाणैस्तटाकामिव पूरयन्॥
en: And even as clouds pour down from the sky on a pool, Råvaņa showered thousands of arrows of Rāghava.

sn: पूरितः शरजालेन धनुर्मुक्तेन संयुगे। महागिरिरिवाकम्प्यः काकुत्स्थो न प्रकम्पते॥
en: And covered with vollies of shafts discharged from (Ravana's) bow in the conflict, Kākutstha like to a mighty mountain did not shake.

sn: स शरैः शरजालानि वारयन्समरे स्थितः। गभस्तीनिव सूर्यस्य प्रतिजग्राह वीर्यवान्॥
en: That one endowed with prowess stood in the field, resisting those networks of arrows, and took up shafts resembling the rays of the Sun.

sn: ततः शरसहस्राणि क्षिप्रहस्तो निशाचरः। निजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो राघवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Then the fleet-handed night-ranger, fired with rage, discharged a thousand arrows at the chest of the high souled Raghava.

sn: स शोणितसमादिग्धः समरे लक्ष्मणाग्रजः। दृष्टः फुल्ल इवारण्ये सुमहान्किशुकदुमः॥
en: Thereat in that encounter Lakşmaņa's elder brother, with his body bathed in blood, appeared like a mighty Kinśuka tree in a forest.

sn: शराभिघातसंरब्धः सोऽभिजग्राह सायकान्। काकुत्स्थः सुमहातेजा युगान्तादित्यवर्चसः।।।।
en: With his ire aroused by the blows he received the exceedingly energetic Kākutstha took up arrows resembling the sur risen at the time of the universal dissolution.

sn: ततोऽन्योन्यं सुसंरब्धौ तावुभौ रामरावणौ। शरान्धकारे समरे नोपलक्षयतां तदा।९।।
en: In the darkness spread by the arrows (discharged), Rama and Ravana both fired with wrath could not be discovered of each other.

sn: ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टो रामो दशरथात्मजः। उवाच रावणं वीरः प्रहस्य परुषं वचः॥
en: Then that hero-Dasaratha's son, Rāma, Overcome with wrath, addressed Ravana, laughing, in a harsh speech, saying.

sn: मम भार्या जनस्थानादज्ञानाद्राक्षसाधम। हृता ते विवशा यस्मात्तस्मात्त्वं नासि वीर्यवान्॥
en: You vile of Räkşasas, in consequence of having through lack of sense carried off my wife from Janasthana and brought her under your subjection, you have been deprived of your prowess.

sn: मया विरहितां दीनां वर्तमानां महावने। वैदहीं प्रसभं हृत्वा शूरोऽहमिति मन्यसे॥
en: Having forcibly carried away Vaidehi staying in that mighty forest, forlorn and without me, you think, 'I am hero.'

sn: स्त्रीषु शूर विनाथासु परदाराभिमर्शनम्। कृत्वा कापुरुषं कर्म शूरोऽहमिति मन्यसे॥
en: Outraging the helpless wives of others, doing this craven deed, you thinkest, 'I am a hero.'

sn: भिन्नमर्याद निर्लज्ज चारित्रेष्वनवस्थित। दर्पान्मृत्युमुपादाय शूरोऽहमिति मन्यसे॥
en: O you having your dignity destroyed! O shameless Wight! O you of volatile character, having through your violence brought destruction on yourself, you think, 'I am a hero.'

sn: शूरेण धनदभ्रात्रा बलैः समुदितेन च। श्लाघनीयं महत्कर्म यशस्यं च कृतं त्वया॥
en: A great and famous act has been performed by you, a hero, and the brother of the Bestower of riches, surrounded with your forces!

sn: उत्सेकेनाभिपन्नस्य गर्हितस्याहितस्य च। कर्मणः प्राप्नुहीदानीं तस्याद्य सुमहत्फलम्॥
en: Today receive the mighty fruit of that infamous act done through pride, productive of evil.* *Remarks Rāmānuja, 'here and in the next world.'

sn: शूरोऽहमिति चात्मानमवगच्छसि दुर्मते। नैव लज्जास्ति ते सीतां चौरवद्ध्यपकर्षतः॥
en: O wicked-minded one, you think of yourself, 'I am a hero; but you that have taken way Sītā like a thief, have no feeling of shame.

sn: यदि मत्संनिधौ सीता धर्षिता स्यात्त्वया बलात्। भ्रातरं तु खरं पश्येस्तदा मत्सायकैर्हतः॥
en: Had you forcibly outraged Sità in my very presence, you, slain by my Shafts, would have seen your brother-Khara.

sn: दिष्टयासि मम मन्दात्मंश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतः। अद्य त्वां सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नयामि यमसादनम्॥
en: By luck, O you of an evil soul, you have come within the range of my vision. Today by means of sharp shafts shall I bring you to death's door.

sn: अद्य ते मच्छरैश्छिन्नं शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम्। क्रव्यादा व्यपकर्षन्तु विकीर्णं रणपांसुषु॥
en: Today beasts of pray will drag your head having burning ear-rings, severed by my shafts and covered with the dust of the battle-field.

sn: निपत्योरसि गृध्रास्ते क्षितौ क्षिप्तस्य रावण। पिबन्तु रुधिरं तर्षाद्वाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम्॥
en: O Ravana, vultures will alight on your breast, as you will lie low on the ground; and, athirst, they will drink the blood gushing out from your wounds.

sn: अद्य मदाणभिन्नस्य गतासोः पतितस्य ते। कर्षन्त्वन्त्राणि पतगा गरुत्मन्त इवोरगान्॥
en: To-day fowls of the air will keep pulling at you pierced with my shafts, and lying lifeless, as birds do serpents.

sn: इत्येवं स वदन्वीरो रामः शत्रुनिबर्हणः। सेन्द्रं समीपस्थं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ॥
en: Having spoken thus, that slayer of foes-Rāmashowered arrows on the lord of Rākşasas, staying before.

sn: बभूव द्विगुणं वीर्य बलं हर्षश्च संयुगे। रामस्यास्त्रबलं चैव शत्रोनिधनकांक्षिणः॥
en: The prowess and strength and spirits and force of arms of Rāma burning for the destruction of his foe, were doubled.

sn: प्रादुर्बभूवुरस्त्राणि सर्वाणि विदितात्मनः। प्रहर्षाच्च महातेजाः शीघ्रहस्ततरोऽभवत्॥
en: All the Weapons* presented themselves before that one cognisant of self; and the fleethandedness of that exceedingly powerful one increased immensely from exhilaration of spirits. *i.e. the presiding deities of them.

sn: शुभान्येतानि चिह्नानि विज्ञायात्मगतानि सः। भूय एवार्दयद्रामो रावणं राक्षसान्तकृत्॥
en: Seeing all these auspicious omens coming of themselves, Rama, finisher of Raksasas, set about smiting his foe more energetically than ever.

sn: हरीणां चाश्मनिकरैः शरवर्षैश्च राघवात्। हन्यमानो दशग्रीवो विघूर्णहृदयोऽभवत्॥
en: Assailed with stones by the monkeys and showers of shafts by Rāghava, the Ten-necked one felt his heart undergoing a revolution.* *Vighurnahrdayah : had his heart paralysed, according to the commentator. I prefer the sense given as more graphic.

sn: यदा च शस्त्रं नारेभे न चकर्ष शरासनम्। नास्य प्रत्यकरोद्वीयं विक्लवेनान्तरात्मना ॥ क्षिप्ताश्चाशु शरास्तेन शस्त्राणि विविधानि च। मरणार्थाय वर्तन्ते मृत्युकालोऽभ्यवर्तत ॥ सूतस्तु रथनेतास्य तदवस्थं निरीक्ष्य तम्। शनैर्युद्धादसंभ्रान्तो रथं तस्यापवाहयत्॥
en: When through the stupefaction of his innerself, he could not discharge any weapon, or draw his bow, or put forth his prowess, (Rāma) did not persist in smiting him. And the shafts and various arms discharged by him betokened his death; and his last moments were present. And his charioteer, driving his car, perceiving this, calmly took the car away from the field of fight.

sn: निवार्य भीमं जलदस्वनं तदा। जगाम भीत्या समरान्महीपतिं निरस्तवीर्य पतितं समीक्ष्य ॥
en: Then, seeing the king shorn of prowess, and dropt, his charioteer, struck with fear, swiftly turned away his dreadful car having the clatter of clouds, and went away from the field of battle.

sn: स तु मोहात्सुसंक्रुद्धं कृतान्तबलचोदितः। क्रोधसंरक्तनयनो रावणः सूतमब्रवीत्॥
en: After gradually regaining his senses, Rāvana, urged on by the force of the Finisher, getting into a furious passion, with his eyes reddened in wrath, addressed the charioteer, saying.

sn: हीनवीर्यमिवाशक्तं पौरुषेण विवर्जितम्। भीरं लघुमिवासत्त्वं विहीनमिव तेजसा॥ विमुक्तमिव मायाबिरलैरिव बहिष्कृतम्। मामवज्ञाय दुर्बुद्धे स्वया बुद्ध्या विचेष्टसे॥
en: perverse sense, disregarding me as devoid of prowess, and incompetent, and bereft of vigour-as cowardly, light, nerveless and shorn of energy, and as divorced by the power of illusion and debarred by arms, you act on your own understanding.

sn: किमर्थं मामवज्ञाय मच्छन्दमनवेक्ष्य च। त्वया शत्रुसमक्षं मे रथोऽयमपवाहितः॥
en: Wherefore disregarding me, and not minding O you of my purpose, have you taken away my car from before the presence of the enemy?

sn: त्वयाद्य हि ममानार्य चिरकालमुपार्जितम्। यशो वीर्यं च तेजश्च प्रत्ययश्च विनाशितः॥
en: O abject one! by you have my long earned renown and energy and prowess and credit been brought to naught.

sn: शत्रोः प्रख्यातवीर्यस्य रञ्जनीयस्य विक्रमैः। पश्यतो युद्धलुब्धोऽहं कृतः कापुरुषस्त्वया।६।।
en: In the very sight of an enemy of renowned prowess, and one capable of being gratified with valorous deeds, have you made me, burning for battle, look as if I were a coward.

sn: यत्त्वं कथमिदं मोहान्न चेद्वहसि दुर्मते। सत्योऽयं प्रतितों मे परेण त्वमुपस्कृतः॥
en: As, O wicked minded one, you did not even through heedlessness, take the car to the field of batile, I infer for certain that you have been bribed by the foe.

sn: नहि तद्विद्यते कर्म सुहृदो हितकामिणः। रिपूणां सदृशं त्वेतद्यत्त्वयैतदनुष्ठितम्॥
en: The act that you have done, does not appear as that of a friend seeking our welfare; but today you have acted like an enemy.

sn: निवर्तय रथं शीघ्रं यावत्रापैति मे रिपुः। यदि वाध्युषितोऽसि त्वं स्मर्यते यदि मे गुणः॥
en: If you have been maintained by me, if you remember my merit, do you swiftly turn the car before my enemy has departed.

sn: एवं परुषमुक्तस्तु हितबुद्धिरबुद्धिना। अब्रवीद्रावणं सूतो हितं सानुनयं वचः॥
en: Thus admonished by him of slender sense, the charioteer possessed of intelligence, humbly spoke to Råvaņa words fraught with good.

sn: न भीतोऽस्मि न मूढोऽस्मि नोपजप्तोऽस्मि शत्रुभिः न प्रमत्तो न निःस्नेहो विस्मृता न च सत्क्रिया॥
en: I am not afraid, nor stupefied, nor have I been bribed by the foe, nor am I negligent. And I have not forgotten your affection or your good offices.

sn: मया तु हितकामेन यशश्च परिरक्षता। स्नेहप्रसन्नमनसा हितमित्यप्रियं कृतम्॥
en: And studious of your welfare, I have saved your fame; and with a mind overflowing with affection I have done (to you) this unpalatable good.

sn: नास्मिनर्थे महाराज त्वं मां प्रियहिते रतम्। कश्चिल्लघुरिवानार्यो दोषतो गन्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: O mighty monarch, for this, you should not, like a frivolous and base one, criminate me that am ever engaged in what is good and dear to you.

sn: श्रूयतां प्रति दास्यामि यन्निमित्तं मया रथः। नदीवेग इवाम्भोभिः संयुगे विनिवर्तितः॥
en: Listen! I shall render you reason why I turned away from the field the car, rushing like a river when the sea is swelled up* *On the ascension of the Moon.

sn: श्रमं तवावगच्छामि महता रणकर्मणा। नहि ते वीर्यसौमुख्यं प्रकर्ष नोपधारये॥
en: I knew that you had been fatigued in consequence of your mighty exertions in the fight. And I could not perceive that your prowess then stood superior (to that of the foe).* *Two negatives in this verse amounting to an affirmative. This is the only instance of double negatives in Valmiki.

sn: रथोद्वहनखिन्नाश्च भग्ना मे रथवाजिनः। दीना धर्मपरिश्रान्ता गावो वर्षहता इव ॥
en: The steeds of my car were worn out by-carrying it; and they were battered, and helpless and perspired like kine in a shower.

sn: निमित्तानि च भूयिष्ठं यानि प्रादुर्भवन्ति नः। तेषु तेष्वभिपनेषु लक्षयाम्यप्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: And bad omens fast sprang up before us. And on these occurring, I perceived that things would go against us.

sn: देशकालौ च विज्ञेयौ लक्षणानीङ्गितानि च। दैन्यं हर्षश्च खेदश्च रथिनश्च महाबल॥
en: O you endowed with exceeding might, a charioteer should be conversant with season and place, with omens, and the expressions of emotions; as also with depression of spirits, exhilaration, and grief.

sn: स्थलनिम्नानि भूमेश्च समानि विषमाणि च। युद्धकालश्च विज्ञेयः परस्यान्तरदर्शनम् ॥
en: And he should have a knowledge of low, lever and uneven grounds, and the time for conflict, and he should be able to perceive the shortcomings of the enemy.

sn: उपयानापयाने च स्थानं प्रत्यपसर्पणम्। सर्वमेतद्रथस्थेन ज्ञेयं रथकुटुम्बिना॥
en: And a charioteer mounted on a car, should know when to draw near an enemy, when to turn away from him when to stay; and when to turn round from before the foe-all these (he should know).

sn: तव विश्रामहेतोस्तु तथैषां रथवाजिनाम्। रौद्रं वर्जयता खेदं क्षमं कृतमिदं मया॥
en: What I, for bringing respite to you as well as the horses of the car, have done by way of removing the terrific exhaustion, is proper.

sn: स्वेच्छया न मया वीर रथोऽयमपवाहितः। भर्तुः स्नेहपरीतेन मयेदं यत्कृतं प्रभो॥
en: I did not, O hero, turn away the car of my own sheer will. What I have done, O lord, had been dictated by my affection for you.

sn: आज्ञापय यथातत्त्वं वक्ष्यस्यरिनिषूदन। तत्करिष्याम्यहं वीर गतानृण्येन चेतसा ॥
en: Command me. What you say, O destroyer of foes. I will do every way, O hero with my whole soul.

sn: संतुष्टस्तेन वाक्येन रावणस्तस्य सारथेः। प्रशस्यैनं बहुविधं युद्धलुब्धोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Thereat, well pleased with the speech of the charioteer, Ravana, eager for encounter, after praising him in various ways said.

sn: रथं शीघ्रमिमं सूत राघवाभिमुखं नय। नाहत्वा समरे शत्रूनिवर्तिष्यति रावणः॥
en: O charioteer, do you swiftly take the car towards Rāghava. Without slaying his foe in fight, Ravana turn not away (from the field).

sn: एवमुक्त्वा रथस्थस्य रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः। ददौ तस्य शुभं ह्येकं हस्ताभरणमुत्तमम्।। श्रुत्वा रावणवाक्यानि सारथिः सन्यवर्तत।२६।।
en: Speaking thus Råvaņa-lord of Rākşasas-gave the charioteer on the car an excellent ornament for the hand. Hearing Ravana's words, the charioteer drove the car.

sn: ततो द्रुतं रावणवाक्यचोदितः प्रचोदयामास हयान्स सारथिः। स राक्षसेन्द्रस्य ततो महारथः क्षणेन रामस्य रणाग्रतोऽभवत्॥
en: And urged on by the speech of Rāvana, the charioteer drove on the steeds, and in a moment the mighty chariot of the Rākşasa-chief appeared before Rāma in the field of battle.

sn: ततो युद्धपरिश्रान्तं समरे चिन्तया स्थितम्। रावणं चाग्रतो दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय समुपस्थितम्॥ दैवतैश्च समागम्य द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो रणम्। उपगम्याब्रवीद्राममगस्त्यो भगवांस्तदा॥
en: Then the revered Agastya. who desirous of witnessing the fight, had along with the deities come there-seeing Rävaņa spent with the toil of conflict, staying in the field plunged in thought, and stationed before Rāma for engaging in encounter-addressed Rama, drawing near to him, saying.

sn: राम राम महाबाहो शृणु गुह्यं सनातनम्। येन सर्वानरीन्वत्स समरे विजयिष्यसे॥ आदित्यहृदयं पुण्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम्। जयावहं जपं नित्यमक्षयं परमं शिवम्॥ सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्। चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनमायुर्वर्धनमुत्तमम्॥
en: Rāma, Rāma, O mighty-armed one, hearken to the eternal secret, whereby my child, you will conquer all foes in fight-Adityahțdya,* sacred, capable of destroying all foes bringing victory the recitation, enduring and in destructible, and supremely good; fraught with all welfare removing every sin, chasing away anxiety and grief, bringing length of days; and excellent. *Lit.-The heart of the Sun-the designation of a Vedic Hymn.

sn: रश्मिमन्तं समुद्यन्तं देवासुरनमस्कृतम्। पूजयस्व विवस्वन्तं भास्करं भुवनेश्वरम्॥ सर्वदेवात्मको ह्येष तेजस्वी रश्मिभावनः। एष देवासुरगणाँल्लोकान्पाति गभस्तिभिः॥
en: Do you worship Vivasvata's offspring-the Sun-lord of the world, furnished with rays, who make people engage in work, and who is bowed down to by deities and Asuras. This effulgent one, producing rays is instinct with the spirits of all the deities; and he with his rays rule all creatures and the hosts of celestials and Asuras.

sn: एष ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च शिवः स्कन्दः प्रजापतिः। महेन्द्रो धनदः कालो यमः सोमो ह्यपांपतिः॥ पितरो वसवः साध्या अश्विनौ मरुतो मनुः। वायुर्वह्निः प्रजाः प्राण ऋतुकर्मा प्रभाकरः।।।।।
en: This Sun is Brahmā and Vişņu and Śiva and Skanda (a) and Prajāpati, (b) and Mahendra and Dhanada (c) and the Destroyer-Yama and Soma (d) and the lord of waters: and the Pitris (e) and the Vasus, and the Sādhyas (f) and the two Aśvinis (g) and the Maruts and Manu, (h) and the Wind-god and the God of fie and the creatures and the creator of life and the seasons. (a) The celestial generallissimo. The commentator gives a spiritual interpretation. 'He that by mean of his rays openent up the five organs of perception. (b) The lord of all creatures, by virtue of his bringing forth all beings through his energy. (c) Dispenser of riches, a name of Kubera. (d) Furnished with splendour, a name of the Moon. According to some endowed with energy. (e) Lit. the ancestral manes. Here the generator of everything. (1) An order of semi-divine beings. Here, "he who is adored by the spiritual." (g) In virtue of his omnipresence and his being the healer of all ailments. (h) All-knowing and being the primeval sovereign.

sn: आदित्यः सविता सूर्यः खगः पूषा गभस्तिमान्। सुवर्णसदृशो भानुर्हिरण्यरेता दिवाकरः॥ हरिदश्वः सहस्रार्चिः सप्तसप्तिमरीचिमान्। तिमिरोन्मथनः शंभुस्त्वष्टा मार्तण्डकोंऽशुमान्॥ हिरण्यगर्भः शिशिरस्तपनोऽहस्करो रविः। अग्निगर्भो दितेः पुत्रः शङ्खः शिशिरनाशनः॥ व्योमनाथस्तमोभेदी ऋग्यजुःसामपारगः। घनुवृष्टिरपां मित्रो विन्ध्यवीथीप्लवंगमः॥ आतपी मण्डली मृत्युः पिङ्गलः सर्वतापनः। कविविश्वो महातेजा रक्तः सर्वभवोद्भवः॥ नक्षत्रग्रहताराणामधिपो विश्वभावनः। तेजसामपि तेजस्वी द्वादशात्मनमोऽस्तु ते॥
en: He is Aditya (i) Savită (j) Sürya (k) Khaga (l) Pușă (m) Gabhastimān, (a) the Golden-looking and Bhānu (b) Hiranyarertā (c) Divākara. (d) And he is Haridaśva (e) Sahasrārci (1) Saptasapti (g) Maricimăn. (h) and he subdue darkness, and he is Sambhu (i) and Tvașță () Marandaka (k) Ansumān. (1) he Hiranyagarbha, (m) Sisira, (n) Tapana, (o) and Ahaskara (p) Ravi (q) Agnigarbha, (r) Aditi's son,(s) and Sankha, (T) Śisiranāšana, (u) Vyomanātha (v) Tamobhedi (w) the one proficient in Řk, Yajuş and Sāma; and Ghanavịşti, (x) and the friend of the Apas, (a) and he that swiftly course in the Vindhya way. And he is Ātapī (b) and Mandali (c) and Mſtyu. (d) And he is Pingala, (e) and the destroyer of everything, and the Omniscient, and he having the universe for his form, (f) and the exceedingly energetic one, and the beloved of ail and that one, lording it over all kinds of actions. And he is the lord (g) of stars and planets and constellation, and the origin of everything and the one powerful pre-eminently of powerful things, (h) and the one having twelve forms. (i) I bow to you (having these forms and functions). (i) He from whom all derive sustenance. 6) The producer of heart and the spiritual faculties by heat, and corn, etc. by showers. (k) Coursing alone, according to the commentator. It may also means 'He that sets people to work.' (1) Coursing the highest heavens' or says the commentator 'the heavens of the heart." (m) 'The maintainer.' (a) Gabhastimān-'Ray-furnished, or having the allpermeating Spirit of Auspiciousness.' (b) Bhānu-'having brightness' (c) 'Hiranyaretā' instinct with the cosmic energy. (d) Divākara 'maker of day. (e) Haridaśva 'pervading all sides,' or 'having black steeds.' (f) Sahasrārci-thousand-rayed. The commentator explains spiritually, He whose cognition points in infinite directions.' (8) 'He from whom proceed the seven organs of sense of people. Or 'he was has seven steeds. (h) 'Having rays.' (i) 'He from whom proceed the several sorts of happiness.' ) 'He who removes the misfortunes of his votaries.' (k) 'He that infuses life into the lifeless moudane egg.' (1) Having rays. (m) The cause of the creation, preservation and destruction of the Universe. (n) 'Good-natured.' (0) Tapa-means 'wealth.' Tapana-the possessor of all riches. (p) Ahas-day and Kara-maker. (9) Rauti teach-Ravi he that teach. (r) Lit. fire-wombed. He that carries the fire of doom within himself. (s) Aditi-without destruction'-means 'Brahma knowledge.' (t) Supreme happiness. (u) The remover of intellectual stupor or evilmindedness. (v) Lord of the welkin. (w) Dispeller of darkness.) (x) He from whom flow the fruit of acts; or he from whom come downpours. The latter epithet is justified on grounds of Physical Geography, rain being ultimately dependant on solar heat. (a) Apas may mean either the good,' or 'water.' Vindhya may mean either the way known as Brahmacāri or the orbit of the Sun. (b) He that is intent on creating the cosmos. (c) Ray-crowned or adorned with gems. (d) The bringer of death. (e) The motive force of the blood-tube called Pingala (1) Or the ornament of the Universe. (g) i.e. the controller of them, remarks Rāmānuja (h) Such as, observes the commentator, as fire) (i) i.e. the controller of them remarks Rāmānuja.)

sn: नमः पूर्वाय गिरये पश्चिमायाद्रये नमः। ज्योतिर्गणानां पतये दिनाधिपतये नमः॥
en: Salutation to the Eastern mount and the mount of the West. Salutation to the lord of the stellar bodies and salutation also to the lord of day.

sn: जयाय जयभद्राय हर्यश्वाय नमो नमः। नमो नमः सहस्रांशो आदित्याय नमो नमः॥
en: Salutation and salutation to him that bring victory, and the joy that spring up from victory; and to him of yellow steeds. Salutation, salutation, O thousand-rayed one! Salutation and salutation to Aditya.

sn: नम उग्राय वीराय सारङ्गाय नमो नमः। नमः पद्मप्रबोधाय प्रचण्डाय नमोऽस्तु ते॥
en: Salutation to him that keep his senses under subjection; Salutation and salutation to the Hero, (i) and to Saranga (k) and to him that awaken the Lotus (1) (i) Him that lead the senses, and that is endowed with the prowess of slaying Tripura etc. (k) Him that deserve the pranava, the holies formula in all Hindu Scripture. (1) That awaken the external lotus as will as the lotus of the heart.

sn: ब्रह्मेशानाच्युतेशाय सूरायादित्यवर्चसे। भास्वते सर्वभक्षाय रौद्राय वपुषे नमः॥ तमोघ्नाय हिमघ्नाय शत्रुघ्नायामितात्मने। कृतघ्नघ्नाय देवाय ज्योतिषां पतये नमः॥
en: And (salutation) to you O fierce one. Salutation to the Lord himself of Brahmā, Iśána (m) and Achchyuta, (n) and to Sura (o) and to him that constitutes the knowledge of Aditya, and to him that unfold me and not, me and to the devourer of all, and to the form of the destroyer of the darkness of ignorance. Salutation to the destroyer of darkness, and to the destroyer of enemies, and to him of immeasurable Squl, and to the destroyer of the ingrate, and to the deity, and to the lord of all stellar bodies. (m) Siva (n) Visnu. (0) The Sun.

sn: तप्तचामीकराभाय हरये विश्वकर्मणे। नमस्तमोभिनिघ्नाय रुचये लोकसाक्षिणे॥
en: And salutation to him that boast of the splendour of burning gold, to the destroyer of all mental obscurity, and to the maker of the universe. Salutation to the remover of darkness; to see illuminator of the Soul; to the allbeholding none of all the words.

sn: नाशयत्येष वै भूतं तमेव सृजति प्रभुः। पायत्येष तपत्येष वर्षत्येष नभस्तिभिः॥
en: The lord creat everything an verily destroyet it. And with his rays he suck up, and destroy and create (everything)

sn: एष सुप्तेषु जागर्ति भूतेषु परिनिष्ठितः। एष चैवाग्निहोत्रं च फलं चैवाग्निहोत्रिणाम्॥
en: When all are asleep, this one wake, he is resident in the hearts of all creatures. This one is both Agnihotra as well as the fruit reaped by the sacrifices thereof.

sn: देवाश्च क्रतवश्चैव क्रतूनां फलमेव च। यानि कृत्यानि लोकेषु सर्वेषु परमप्रभुः॥
en: He constitutes the gods and the sacrifices and the fruit also thereof, and he is the lord of all acts that are performed by creatures

sn: एनमापत्सु कृच्छेषु कान्तारेषु भयेषु च। कीर्तयन्पुरुषः कश्चित्रावसीदति राघव ॥
en: If a person recites this (hymn), he O Raghava, does not come by misfortune, when he is in peril of his life, or is ill, or in a lonely place, or in fear.

sn: पूजयस्वैनमेकाग्रो देवदेवं जगत्पतिम्। एतत्रिगुणितं जप्त्वा युद्धेषु विजयिष्यति॥
en: Do you with concentration, worship this god of gods, this lord of the universe. By reciting (this hymn) instinct with the three virtues, you will obtain victory in battle.

sn: अस्मिन्क्षणे महाबाहो रावणं त्वं जहिष्यसि। एवमुक्त्वा ततोऽगस्त्यो जगाम स यथागतम्।।२७
en: This very instant O mighty-armed one, you will conquer Ravana. Having said this, Agastya went whither from he had come.

sn: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महातेजा नष्टशोकोऽभवत्तदा। धारयामास सुप्रीतो राघवः प्रयतात्मवान् ॥ आदित्यं प्रेक्ष्य जप्त्वेदं परं हर्षमवाप्तवान्। त्रिराजम्य शुचिर्भूत्वा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्॥ रावणं प्रेक्ष्य हृष्टात्मा जयार्थं समुपागमत्। सर्वयत्नेन महता वृतस्तस्य वधेऽभवत्॥
en: Hearing this that exceedingly energetic one had his grief gone. then, well pleased, Raghava, exerting himself, contemplated (the hymn). And reciting this he beholding the Sun, attained excess of Joy. And sipping water again and again, and becoming purified, that powerful one, taking up his bow, and viewing Rāvana, advanced with a delighted heart, to obtain victory. And he became intent on his death with his dearest energies.

sn: अथ रविरवदन्निरीक्ष्य राम मुदितमनाः परमं प्रहृष्यमाणः। निशिचरपतिसंक्षयं विदित्वा सुरगणमध्यगतो वचस्त्वरेति॥
en: Then exceedingly delighted, and filled with rejoicing, the Sun, in the midst of the celestial hosts knowing that the destruction of the Sovereign of the night-rangers was at hand, spoke to Rāma “Bestir yourself.

sn: सारथिः स रथं हृष्टः परसैन्यप्रधर्षणम्। गन्धर्वनगराकारं समुच्छ्रितपताकिनाम्॥ युक्तं परमसंपत्नैर्वाजिभिहेममालिभिः। युद्धोपकरणैः पूर्णं पताकाध्वजमालिनम्॥ असन्तमिव चाकाशं नादयन्तं वसुंधराम्। प्रणाशं परसैन्यानां स्वसैन्यस्य प्रहर्षणम्॥
en: Then the charioteer fully drove with speed Rāvaņa's car, capable of bringing down the hosts of foes, resembling in form a city of the Gandharvas having elevated streamers, yoked with surpassingly superb steeds, engarlanded in gold: stocked with war-like implements; furnished with ensigns and standards; appearing to devour the welkin; making the earth herself resound; destructive to hostile host; and filling its own party with delight.

sn: रावणस्य रथं क्षिप्रं चोदयामास सारथिः। तमापतन्तं सहसा स्वनवन्तं महाध्वजम्॥ रथं राक्षसराजस्य नरराजो ददर्श ह। कृष्णवाजिसमायुक्तं युक्तं रौद्रेण वर्चसा॥ दीप्यमानमिवाकाशे विमानं सूर्यवर्चसम्। तडित्पताकागहनं दर्शितेन्द्रायुधप्रभम्॥ शरधारा विमुञ्चन्तं धाराधरमिवाम्बुदम्।
en: And as it speedily descended, the monarch of men beheld that Raksasa-king's resounding car, having huge standards, yoked with black chargers, and endowed with fierce splendour; as if flaming in the firmament; having the resplendance of the Sun himself; with thronging lightning pennons; displaying the glow of Indra's weapon* showering arms; and resembling rain-charged clouds. *The rain-blow.

sn: स दृष्ट्वा मेघसंकाशमापतन्तं रथं रिपोः॥ गिरेर्वज्राभिमृष्टस्य दीर्यतः सदृशस्वनम्। विस्फारयन्वै वेगेन बालचन्द्रानतं धनुः॥ उवाच मातलिं रामः सहस्राक्षस्य सारथिम्।
en: Seeing the enemy's car resembling a mass of clouds having a chatter resembling the sounds sent by a cleaving mountain riven by the thunder, Rāma, vehemently drawing his bow curved like the infant moon, addressed Mătalicharioteer to the thousand-eyed (deity) saying. *Indra.

sn: मातले पश्य संरब्धमापतन्तं रथं रिपोः॥ यथापसव्यं पतता वेगेन महता पुनः। समरे हन्तुमात्मानं तथानेन कृता मतिः॥
en: O Mătalī, behold the enraged chariot of my foe as it course on. From the furious speed with which he is again wheeling at my right, it appear that he has set his heart of slaying me in encouter.

sn: तदप्रमादमातिष्ठ प्रत्युद्गच्छ रथं रिपोः। विध्वंसयितुमिच्छामि वायुर्मेघमिवोत्थितम्॥
en: Do you therefore heedfully drive the car right against the vehicle of my foe. I wish to destroy this one even as the wind scatter clouds that have appeared.

sn: अविक्लवमसंभ्रान्तमव्यग्रहृदयेक्षणम्। रश्मिसंचारनियतं प्रचोदय रथं दुतम्॥
en: Do you with all your wits about you, without trepidation, and holding your heart as will as your eye in calmness, swiftly drive the chariot ruled by the reins.

sn: कामं न त्वं समाधेयं पुरंदररथोचितः। युयुत्सुरहमेकाग्रः स्मारये त्वां न शिक्षये॥
en: Worthy of Purandara's car, you ought not to be taught by me. Desirous of encounter and my whole soul bent on fight, I simply remind younot teach you.

sn: परितुष्टः स रामस्य तेन वाक्येन मातलिः। प्रचोदयामास रथं सुरसारथिरुत्तमः॥ अपसव्यं ततः कुर्वन्रावणस्य महारथम्। चक्रसंभूतरजसा रावणं व्यवधूनयत्॥
en: Pleased with these words of Rāma, the excellent celestial charioteer-Mātalī-drove the car. Then leaving Ravana's mighty car on the right, he enveloped Rāvana with the dust raised by the wheels.

sn: ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवस्ताम्रविस्फारितेक्षणः। रथप्रतिमुखं रामं सायकैरवधूनयत्॥
en: Thereat the Ten-necked one, enraged, with his eyes coppery and dilated (in passion), covered with arrows Rāma staying in front of his car.

sn: धर्षणामर्षितो रामो धैर्य रोषेण लम्भयन्। जग्राह सुमहावेगमैन्द्रं युधि शरासनम्॥ शरांश्च सुमहावेगान्सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभान्। तदुपोढं महद्युद्धमन्योन्यवधकाङ्गिणोः।। परस्पराभिमुखयोर्दृप्तयोरिव सिंहयोः॥
en: Enraged at the smiting. Rāma, with his ire aroused, but summoning up patience, took up in the encounter the bow of Indra endowed with exceeding vehemence; well as highly impetuous shafts having the resplendence of the solar rays. And then there began a furious encounter between those (two) eager for slaying each other confronting each other like to flaming lions.

sn: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। समीयुद्वैरथं द्रष्टुं रावणक्षयकाङ्क्षिणः॥
en: Then desirous of destruction of Rāvana, celestials with Gandharvas, and Siddhas and supersaints assembled to go to behold the encounter taking place between the two cars.

sn: समुत्पेतुरथोत्पाता दारुणा रोमहर्षणाः। रावणस्य विनाशाय राघवस्योदयाय च॥
en: For the destruction of Råvana and the success of Rāghava, there occurred round about the cars terrible bodements capable of making people's down stand on end. as

sn: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवो रावणस्य रथोपरि। वाता मण्डलिनस्तीवा व्यपसव्यं प्रचक्रमुः॥
en: The god poured down showers of blood on the car of Rāvana; and a violent tornado eddied on his right.

sn: महद्गृध्रकुलं चास्य भ्रममाणं नभःस्थले। येन येन रथा याति तेन तेन प्रधावति॥
en: And a mighty swarm of vultures, wheeling in the heavens, pursued the car wherever it moved.

sn: संध्यया चावृता लङ्का जपापुष्पनिकाशया। दृश्यते संप्रदीप्तेव दिवसेऽपि वसुंधरा ॥
en: And Lankā was enveloped with evening resembling the red Japā flowers and even in day appeared ablaze.

sn: सनिर्घाता महोल्काश्च संप्रपेतुर्महास्वना। विषादयंस्ते रक्षांसि रावणस्य तदा हिताः॥
en: Lightnings and firebrands accompanied by a terrible sound began to fall down on all sides. And beholding these omens inauspicious to Rāvana all the Rākşasas were greatly sorry.

sn: रावणश्च यतस्तत्र प्रचचाल वसुंधरा। रक्षसां च प्रहरतां गृहीता इव बाहवः॥
en: And wherever Rāvana moved the earth shook an the hands of all the Rākşasas fighting were as if paralysed.

sn: ताम्राः पीताः सिताः श्वेताः पतिताः सूर्यरश्मयः। दृष्यन्ते रावणस्याग्रे पर्वतस्येव धातवः॥
en: The copper coloured, the yellow, the red, and the white rays of the sun falling before Rāvaņa appeared like melted metals of a mountain.

sn: गृधैरनुगताश्चास्य वमन्तो ज्वलनं मुखैः। प्रणेदुर्मुखमीक्षन्त्यः संरब्धमशिवं शिवाः॥
en: The jackals followed by vultures, vomiting forth fire and casting their looks at him, began to emit inauspicious cries.

sn: प्रतिकूलं ववौ वायू रणे पांसून्समुत्किरन्। तस्य राक्षसराजस्य कुर्वन्दृष्टिविलोपनम् ॥
en: And in that battle-field the unfavourable wind began to blow raising dust and obstruction the vision of the king of Rākşasas.

sn: निपेतुरिन्द्राशनयः सैन्ये चास्य समन्ततः। दुर्विषह्यस्वरा घोरं विना जलधरोदयम्॥
en: On the Raksasa host on all sides dreadful lightnings were showered without the sound of the clouds.

sn: दिशश्च प्रदिशः सर्वा बभूवुस्तिमिरावृताः। पांसुवर्षेण महता दुर्दर्श च नभोऽभवत्॥
en: All the quarters were enshrouded with darkness and the welkin became invisible being covered with darkness.

sn: कुर्वत्यः कलहं घोरं सारिकास्तद्रथं प्रति। निपेतुः शतशस्तत्र दारुणा दारुणारुताः॥
en: Setting up a dreadful quarrel hundreds of terrible Särikās* began to fall down on his chariot. *A kind of bird (Turdus Salica, Buch).

sn: जघनेभ्यः स्फुलिङ्गाश्च नेत्रेभ्योऽश्रूणि संततम्। मुमुचुस्तस्य तुरगास्तुल्यमग्निं च वारि च॥
en: The horses emitted forth sparks of fire from their hips and tears from their eyes.

sn: एवंप्रकारा बहवः समुत्पाता भयावहाः। रावणस्य विनाशाय दारुणा संप्रजज्ञिरे॥
en: These and various other dreadful omens arose there announcing the destruction of Rāvaņa.

sn: रामस्यापि निमित्तानि सौम्यानि च शिवानि च। बभूवुर्जयशंसीनि प्रादुर्भूतानि सर्वशः॥
en: There appeared on all sides many an auspicious and good sign intimating the approach of Rāma's victory.

sn: निमित्तानीह सौम्यानि राघवस्य जयाय वै। दृष्ट्वा परमसंहृष्टो हतं मेने च रावणम्॥
en: And beholding all those auspicious marks announcing Rama's success, Laksmana was greatly delighted and considered Rävaņa as slain.

sn: ततो निरीक्ष्यात्मगतानि राघवो रणे निमित्तानि निमित्तकोविदः। जगाम हर्ष च परां च निवृत्ति चकार युद्धे ह्यधिकं च विक्रमम्॥
en: Thereupon beholding all those auspicious signs, Raghava, well qualified to decipher them attained an excess of delight an became anxious to display a greater prowess.

sn: ततः प्रवृत्तं सुक्रूरं रामरावणयोस्तदा। सुमहद्वैरथं युद्धं सर्वलोकभयावहम्॥
en: Thereupon there ensued a mighty and dreadful encounter of two cars between Rāma and Ravana, creating terror to all people.

sn: ततो राक्षससैन्यं च हरीणां च महद्बलम्। प्रगृहीतप्रहरणं निश्चेष्टं समवर्तत॥
en: The army of Räkşasas and the mighty host of the monkeys although they had weapons in their hands, became stupefied (for the time being).

sn: संप्रयुद्धौ तु तौ दृष्ट्वा बलवन्नरराक्षसौ। व्याक्षिप्तहृदयाः सर्वे परं विस्मयमागताः॥
en: And beholding them (Răma and Rāvana) fight, all the Rākşasas and monkeys, having their minds agitated, were greatly surprised.

sn: नानाप्रहरणैर्व्यग्रैर्भुजैर्विस्मितबुद्धयः। तस्थुः प्रेक्ष्य च सर्वं ते नाभिजग्मुः परस्परम्॥
en: With various weapons and hands uplifted for fight, they, greatly wondered, stood there beholding them and did not address themselves to fight with each other.

sn: रक्षसां रावणं चापि वानराणां च राघवम्। पश्यतां विस्मिताक्षाणां सैन्यं चित्रमिवाबभौ॥
en: The Rakşasas beholding Rāvana, and the monkeys beholding Rāma with wonder-stricken eyes, the whole army appeared like a picture.

sn: तौ तु तत्र निमित्तानि दृष्ट्वा राघवरावणौ। कृतबुद्धी स्थिरामर्षों युयुधाते ह्यभीतवत्॥
en: And expieing all omens Rāghava and Rāvaņa began to fight undaunted, firm, resolute and unagitated by anger.

sn: जेतव्यमिति काकुत्स्थो मर्तव्यमिति रावणः। धृतौ स्ववीर्यसर्वस्वं युद्धेऽदर्शयतां तदा॥
en: And determining that Käkutstha would win victory and Răvana would died, they began to display their own prowess.

sn: ततः क्रोधाद्दशग्रीवः शरान्संधाय वीर्यवान्। मुमोच ध्वजमुद्दिश्य राघवस्य रथे स्थितम्।८।।
en: Thereupon the highly powerful Rāvana, setting his arrows in anger, discharged then at the pennon stationed on Rāghava's car.

sn: ते शरास्तमनासाद्य पुरंदररथध्वजम्। रथशक्तिं परामृश्य निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥
en: Those arrows reaching the flag staff of the Purandara chariot and perceiving its might fell down on the earth.

sn: ततो रामोऽपि संक्रुद्धश्चापमाकृष्य वीर्यवान्। कृतप्रतिकृतं कर्तुं मनसा संप्रचक्रमे॥ रावणध्वजमुद्दिश्य मुमोच निशितं शरम्। महासर्पमिवासा ज्वलन्तं स्वेन तेजसा॥
en: Thereupon the highly powerful Rama, wroth, stretching his bow, made up his mind to return the blow, And aiming at Rāvana's flag staff he discharged a sharpened shaft flaming unbearably by its own lustre like a huge serpent....

sn: रामश्चिक्षेप तेजस्वी केतुमुद्दिश्य सायकम्। जगाम स महीं भित्त्वा दशग्रीवध्वजं शरः॥
en: The effulgent Rāma discharged a shaft aiming at (Ravana's) banner which, piercing the Tennecked demon's flag fell, down on the earth.

sn: स निकृत्तोऽपतद्भूमौ रावणस्यन्दनध्वजः। ध्वजस्योन्मथनं दृष्ट्वा रावणः स महाबलः॥ संप्रदीप्तोऽभवत्क्रोधादमर्षात्प्रदहन्निव। स रोषवशमापन्नः शरवर्ष ववर्ष ह॥
en: Beholding his flag staff thus broken down the highly powerful Răvaņa became ablaze as if burning down the everything with his unbearable ire. And being possessed by wrath he began to make a downpour of shafts.

sn: रामस्य तुरगान्दीप्तैः शरैर्विव्याध रावणः। ते दिव्या हरयस्तत्र नास्खलनापि बभ्रमुः॥ बभूवुः स्वस्थहृदयाः पद्मनालैरिवाहताः।
en: Ravana then, with flaming arrows, pierced Rāma's steeds. The celestial horses were not bewildered thereby nor their course was slackened. And they remained thoroughly unagitated as if they were stricken with lotus stalks.

sn: तेषामसंभ्रमं दृष्ट्वा वाजिनां रावणस्तदा॥ भूय एव सुसंक्रुद्धः शरवर्षं मुमोच ह। गदाश्च परिघांश्चैव चक्राणि मुसलानि च ॥ गिरिशृङ्गाणि वृक्षांश्च तथा शूलपलवधान्। मायाविहितमेतत्तु शस्त्रवर्षमपातयत्।। सहस्रशस्तदा बाणानश्रान्तहृदयोद्यमः॥
en: Beholding the steeds thus unmoved Rāvana was again exercise with wrath and began to discharged afresh his various weapons-gadás parighas, chakras and musalas, mountain tops trees, darts and parashus and thousands of other shafts by virtue of his illusive powers. And unmoved was his energy.

sn: तुमुलं त्रासजननं भीमं भीमप्रतिस्वनम्। तद्वर्षमभवद्युद्धे नैकशस्त्रमयं महत्॥
en: That downpour of various weapons became huge and terrible in the conflict creating terror and making a dreadful noise.

sn: विमुच्य राघवरथं समन्ताद्वानरे बले। सायकैरन्तरिक्षं च चकार सुनिरन्तरम्॥ मुमोच च दशग्रीवो निःसङ्गेनान्तरात्मना।
en: Thereupon leaving aside Rāghava's car he began to assail the monkey-host and enveloped the sky with a continual discharge of arrows. The Ten-necked demon let loose many a weapon even at the risk of his own life.

sn: व्यायच्छमानं तं दृष्ट्वा तत्परं रावणं रणे॥ प्रहसन्निव काकुत्स्थः संदधे निशिताञ्छरान्। स मुमोच ततो बाणाञ्छतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Beholding Rāvana in the encounter thus actively engaged in the discharged of arrows, Kakuthstha, smiling set up pointed shafts, and discharged them by hundreds and thousands.

sn: तान्दृष्ट्वा रावणश्चक्रे स्वशरैः खं निरन्तरम्। ताभ्यां नियुक्तेन तदा शरवर्षेण भास्वता ॥ शरबद्धमिवाभाति द्वितीयं भास्वदम्बरम्।
en: Beholding them Rāvaņa again filled the welkin with arrows-and thus with shafts discharged by them both another flaming sky was crated.

sn: नानिमित्तोऽभवद्वाणो नानिर्भेत्ता न निष्फलः॥ अन्योन्यमभिसंहत्य निपेतुर्धरणीतले। तथा विसृजतोर्बाणान्रामरावणयोर्मधे॥
en: None (of the arrows) missed the aim, none of them failed to pierce another and none of them was fruitless. And the arrows discharged by Rāma and Rāvana striking each other fell down on the earth.

sn: प्रायुद्ध्येतामविच्छिन्नमस्यन्तौ सव्यदक्षिणम्। चक्रतुश्च शरै।रैर्निरुच्छ्वासमिवाम्बरम्॥
en: They standing on their right and left began to make a continued downpour of Arrows and enveloped the sky entirely.

sn: रावणस्य हयान्रामो हयान्रामस्य रावणः। जघ्नतुस्तौ तदान्योन्यं कृतानुकृतकारिणौ॥
en: They opposing each other, Rāvana slew Rāma's steeds and Rāma in his turn slew Rāvana's.

sn: एवं तु तौ सुसंक्रुद्धौ चक्रतुयुद्धमुत्तमम्। मुहूर्तमभवद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम्॥ तौ तथा युध्यमानौ तु समरे रामरावणौ। ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि विस्मितेनान्तरात्मना॥ अर्दयन्तौ तु समरे तयोस्तौ स्यन्दनोत्तमौ। परस्परमभिक्रुद्धौ परस्परमभिद्रुतौ ॥ परस्परवधे युक्तौ घोररूपौ बभूवतुः। मण्डलानि च वीथीश्च गतप्रत्यागतानि च॥ दर्शयन्तौ बहुविधां सूतौ सारथ्यजां गतिम्। अर्दयन्रावणं रामो राघवं चापि रावणः॥ गतिवेगं समापन्नौ प्रतिवेगनिवर्तने। क्षिपतोः शरजलानि तयोस्तौ स्यन्दनोत्तमौ॥ चेरतुः संयुगमहीं सासारौ जलदाविव।
en: They thus enraged fought with each other and for sometime there ensued an terrible encounter capable of making ones down stand on end. The highly powerful Rāvana and Rāma *fighting with each other in the conflict by means of sharpened arrows, the lord of Rākṣasas beholding his flag staff broken down became enraged with the foremost Raghus. Rāma and Rāvaņa thus opposing each other in battle all the animals beheld them, stricken with astonishment. And those two great heroes, highly angered, began to dash towards and assail each other; and being determined to slay each other they looked greatly dreadful. And their charioteers drove the cars on, displaying their skill by moving in circles, in rows and diverse other ways. and those two excellent heroes, discharging their shafts and influenced by illusions, assailed each other proceeding and receding, Rāma attacking Rāvana and Ravana withstanding him. And these two cars coursed the earth for sometime like clouds accompanied by showers. *The epithet in the text is Laksmana's elder brother.

sn: दर्शयित्वा तदा तौ तु गतिं बहुविधां रणे॥ परस्परस्याभिमुखौ पुनरेव च तस्थतुः। धुरं धुरेण रथयोर्वकं वक्रेण वाजिनाम्॥ पताकाश्च पताकाभिः समीयुः स्थितयोस्तदा।
en: Displaying many a movement in the conflict they again stood facing each other, the forepart of one car touching that of the other and the heads of the steeds touching each other; and then pennons stationed on one touched those of the other.

sn: रावणस्य ततो रामो धनुर्मुक्तैः शितैः शरैः॥ चतुर्भिश्चतुरो दीप्तान्हयान्प्रत्यपसर्पयत्।
en: Rāma with four sharpened arrows shot off his bow, removed the flaming horses of Rāvana to some distance.

sn: स क्रोधवशमापन्नो हयानामपसर्पणे॥ मुमोच निशितान्बाणाराघवाय दशाननः।
en: And finding his steeds thus removed he was exercised with wrath. And the Ten-necked one discharged sharpened arrows at Raghava.

sn: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता दशग्रीवेण राघवः॥ जगाम न विकारं च न चापि व्यथितोऽभवत्। चिक्षेप च पुनर्बाणान्वज्रसारसमस्वनान्॥ सारथिं वज्रहस्तस्य समादिश्य दशाननः।
en: And he was pierced by those arrows coming from the powerful Ten-necked demon. He was neither overwhelmed nor pained therewith and he again discharged arrows resembling the thunder-bolts.

sn: मातलेस्तु महावेगाः शरीरे पतिताः शराः॥ न सूक्ष्ममपि संमोहं व्यथां वा प्रददुर्युधि।
en: The Ten-necked demon again discharged arrows at the charioteer, which fell with great vehemence on the person of Mātalī. Mātali was not the least pained or overwhelmed in that encounter.

sn: तया धर्षणया कुद्धो मातलेन तथात्मनः॥ चकार शरजालेन राघवो विमुखं रिपुम्।
en: Beholding his charioteer thus assailed Rāma was excited with wrath and overwhelmed his foe with a net of arrows.

sn: विंशतिं त्रिंशतिं षष्टिं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ मुमोच राघवो वीरः सायकान्स्यन्दने रिपोः।
en: The heroic Rāghava showered on his enemy's chariot shafts by twentys, thirtys, sixtys, hundreds and thousands.

sn: रावणोऽपि ततः क्रुद्धो रथस्थो राक्षसेश्वरः।॥ गदामुसलवर्षेण रामं प्रत्यर्दयद्रणे।
en: The lord of Raksasas, Ravana, who was stationed on the car wroth, attacked Rāma in the conflict with maces and Musalas.

sn: तत्प्रयुक्तं पुनयुद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम्॥ गदानां मुसलानां च परिघाणां च निःस्वनैः। शराणां पुरवातैश्च क्षुभिताः सप्त सागराः॥
en: There again ensued a terrible conflict capable of making one's down stand on end. And the seven oceans were overwhelmed with the sound of maces, Musalas, Paraighas and gold feathered arrows.

sn: क्षुब्धानां सागराणां च पातालतलवासिनः। व्यथिता दानवाः सर्वे पन्नगाश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: Those inhabiting the regions under the agitated oceans, all the Dănvas and thousands of Pannagas were greatly pained.

sn: चकम्पे मेदिनी कृतस्ना सशैलवनकानना। भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चासीन ववौ चापि मारुतः॥
en: Greatly shook the earth with her mountains, forests and gardens. The Sun was shorn of its resplendence and the wind blew very rough.

sn: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। चिन्तामापेदिरे सर्वे सकिंनरमहोरगाः॥
en: Thereupon the celestials with Gandharvas, Siddhas, great saints, Kinnaras and serpents, were all worked up with anxiety.

sn: स्वस्ति गोब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु लोकास्तिष्ठन्तु शाश्वतः। जयतां राघवः संख्ये रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम्॥ एवं जपन्तोऽपश्यंस्ते देवाः सर्षिगणास्तदा। रामरावणयोर्युद्धं सुघोरं रोमहर्षणम् ॥
en: Beholding the dreadful encounter between Rāma and Rāvaņa capable of making people's down stand on end, the celestials with ascetics began to pray, May good betide the Brahmins and cows, may people live in peace and may Rāghava defeat Rāvana, the lord of Räkşasas, in the conflict.

sn: गन्धर्वाप्सरसां सङ्घा दृष्ट्वा युद्धमनूपमम्। सागरं चाम्बरप्रख्यमम्बरं सागरोपमम्॥ रामरावणयोर्युद्धं रामरावणयोरिव। एवं ब्रुवन्तो ददृशुस्तद्युद्धं रामरावणम्॥
en: The crowd of Gandharvas and Apsaras beholding that wonderful battle between Rāma and Rāvana, said. The ocean resemble the sky and the sky resemble the ocean-forsooth this encounter between Rama and Rāvana befits them only.

sn: ततः क्रोधान्महाबाहू रघूणां कीर्तिवर्धनः। संधाय धनुषा रामः शरमाशीविषोपमम्॥ रावणस्य शिरोऽच्छिदन्दच्छीमज्ज्वलितकुण्डलम्। तच्छिरः पतितं भूमौ दृष्टं लोकैस्त्रिभिस्तदा॥
en: Thereupon Råma of long arms, the enhancer of the glory of Raghu's race, enraged, set his arrow, resembling a serpent, on his bow, and cut asunder Rāvana's head wearing shinning Kundalas. And that head in the presence of the inhabitants of the three regions fell down on the earth.

sn: तस्यैव सदृशं चान्यद्रावणस्योत्थितं शिरः। तत्क्षिप्रं क्षिप्रहस्तेन रामेण क्षिप्रकारिणा ॥ द्वितीयं रावणशिरश्छिन्नं संयति सायकैः।
en: Instantly there arose another head resembling the former; and it was speedily cut off by the light-handed Rāma.

sn: छिन्नमात्रं च तच्छीषं पुनरेव प्रदृश्यते॥ तदप्यशनिसंकाशैश्छिन्नं रामस्य सायकैः।
en: As soon as the second head was chopped off in the encounter by means of shafts another appeared again. And that was again severed by Rāma's shafts resembling thunder-bolts.

sn: एवमेव शतं छिन्नं शिरसां तुल्यवर्चसाम्॥ न चैव रावणस्यान्तो दृश्यते जीवितक्षये।
en: Thus were severed hundred heads all equal in brilliance. But the end of Ravana's life was not seen by him.

sn: ततः सर्वास्त्रविद्वीरः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः॥ मार्गणैर्बहुभिर्युक्तश्चिन्तयामास राघवः।
en: Thereupon the heroic Rāghava conversant with the use of all weapons, the enhancer of Kausalya's joy, began to reason within himself in various ways.

sn: मारीचो निहतो यैस्तु खरो यैस्तु सदूषणः॥ क्रौञ्चावटे विराधस्तु कबन्धो दण्डकावने। यैः साला गिरयो भग्ना वाली च क्षुभितोऽम्बुधिः।६०। त इमे सायकाः सर्वे युद्धे प्रात्ययिका मम। किं तु तत्कारणं येन रावणे मन्दतेजसः॥
en: Verily these are the arrows by which Mārīca was killed and Khara with Dūşaņa was slainVirādaha was destroyed in the forest of Krauñcathe headless demon in the forest of DandakaSālas and mountains were broken the ocean was agitated-and Vāli was killed; I do not perceive the reason, why they were becoming fruitless when discharged at Răvaņa.

sn: इति चिन्तापरश्चासीदप्रमत्तश्च संयुगे। ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि राघवो रावणोरसि ॥
en: Thinking thus Rāghava made himself ready in the conflict and began to shower arrows on Rāvana's breast.

sn: रावणोऽपि ततः क्रुद्धो रथस्थो राक्षसेश्वरः। गदामुसलवर्षेण रामं प्रत्यर्दयद्रणे॥
en: Thereupon Rāvana too, the lord of Rākṣasas seated in car and highly enraged, assailed Răma in the conflict with a downpour of maces and Musalas.

sn: तत्प्रवृत्तं महाद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम। अन्तरिक्षे च भूमौ च पुनश्च गिरिमूर्धनि ॥ देवदानवयक्षाणां पिशाचोरगरक्षसाम्। पश्यतां तन्महाद्धं सर्वरात्रमवर्तत॥
en: That dreadful and huge conflict, capable of making hairs stand on end, continued for seven nights before the eyes of the celestials, Dānavas, Yaksas, Piśācas, Uragas and serpents stationed in the sky, on the earth or on the mountain-tops.

sn: नैव रात्रिं न दिवसं न मुहूर्तं न च क्षणम्। रामरावणयोर्युद्ध विराममुपगच्छति॥
en: Neither for the night nor for the day, nor for a moment did the fight between Rāma and Rāvaņa cease.

sn: जयमनवेक्ष्य रणे स राघवस्य। सुरवररथसारथिर्महात्मा रणरतराममुवाच वाक्यमाशु॥
en: And beholding the conflict between Dasaratha's son and the lord of Raksasas, and Ragahava's victory, the high-souled charioteer of the lord of the celestials spade speedily to Rāma engaged in the conflict.

sn: अथ संस्मारयामास मातली राघवं तदा। अजानन्निव किं वीर त्वमेनमनुवर्तसे॥
en: Thereupon Mätali reminding him, spoke to Rāghava, Why did you, o hero, as if not knowing, fear him?

sn: विसृजास्मै वधाय त्वमा पैतामहं प्रभो। विनाशकालः कथितो यः सुरैः सोऽद्य वर्तते॥
en: Do you, O lord, discharge at him the weapon obtained from the great Patriarch. The time for (his) destruction, as described by the celestials, has arrived.

sn: ततः संस्मारितो रामस्तेन वाक्येन मातलेः। जग्राह स शरं दीप्तं निःश्वसन्तमिवोरगम्॥
en: Being reminded by those words of Mätali, Rāma took up the flaming shaft breathing as if like a serpent.

sn: यं तस्मै प्रथमं प्रादादगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः। ब्रह्मदत्तं महद्वाणममोघं युधि वीर्यवान्॥
en: The great Rși Agastya first conferred this upon him. This is a huge and dreadful shaft given by Brahma and highly useful in battle.

sn: ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं पूर्वमिन्द्रार्थममितौजसा। दत्तं सुरपतेः पूर्व त्रिलोकजयकाक्षिणः॥
en: It was made by Brahmä of undecaying prowess for Indra and conferred by him upon the lord of celestials desirous of acquiring victory.

sn: यस्य वाजेषु पवनः फले पावकभास्करौ। शरीरमाकाशमयं गौरवे मेरुमन्दरौ॥
en: In its wings there is wind, in its head there is fire and the Sun, in its body there is the sky and in its weight there are the Chill) Meru and Mandara.

sn: जाज्वल्यमानं वपुषा सुपुङ्ख हेमभूषितम्। तेजसा सर्वभूतानां कृतं भास्करवर्चसम्।७।। सधूममिव कालाग्नि दीप्तमाशीविषोपमम्। नरनागाश्ववृन्दानां भेदनं क्षिप्रकारिणम्॥
en: It is resplendent by its own lustre, well feathered and adorned with gold-made of the essence of all objects and bright as the rays of the Sun. It is like the fire of dissolution enveloped in smoke-like the flaming serpent, capable of piercing men, serpents and horses and was swift-coursing.

sn: द्वाराणां परिघाणां च गिरीणां चापि भेदनम्। नानारुधिरदिग्धाङ्ग मेदोदिग्धं सुदारुणम्॥ वज्रसारं महानादं नानासमितिदारणम्। सर्वचित्रासनं भीमं श्वसन्तमिव पन्नगम्॥ कङ्कगृध्रबकानां च गोमायुगणरक्षसाम्। नित्यभक्षप्रदं युद्धे यमरूपं भयावहम्॥
en: (It-can) rend the gateways, Parighas and hillis soaked in blood dipped in marrow, and extremely dreadful. It is hard as the lightningproducing a dreadful sound, assailing various (divisions of the) army creating terror to all, dreadful and (as if) breathing like a serpent. It is terrible as the Death in the conflict and provides food always for the herons, vultures cranes jackals and the Rākşasas.

sn: नन्दनं वानरेन्द्राणां रक्षसामवसादनम्। वाजितं विविधैर्वाजैश्चारुचित्रैर्गरुत्मतः॥
en: It is the enhancer of the monkey-leaders, joy and the repressor of the Rakşasas and is feathered like to a bird with many a picturesque wing.

sn: तमुत्तमेषु लोकानामिक्ष्वाकुभयनाशनम्। द्विषतां कीर्तिहरणं प्रहर्षकरमात्मनः॥ अभिमन्त्र्य ततो रामस्तं महेषु महाबलः। वेदप्रोक्तेन विधिना संदधे कार्मुके बली॥
en: The highly powerful Rāma, consecrating in accordance with the mantras laid down in the Vedas, that huge shaft-the foremost of all in the world, removing the fear of the Ikşvaku race, destroying the fame of the enemies and conduction to the joy of its own party, set it on his bow.

sn: तस्मिन्संधीयमाने तु राघवेण शरोत्तमे। सर्वभूतानि संत्रेसुश्चचाल च वसुंधरा ॥
en: That excellent arrow being mounted on his bow by Rāghava all the animals were stricker. with fear and the earth shook.

sn: स रावणाय संकृद्धो भृशमायम्य कार्मुकम्। चिक्षेप परमायत्तः शरं मर्मविदारणम्॥
en: And (Rāma) highly enraged, and greatly wary, suppressing (his breath) discharged that shaft at Ravana-piercing to the vitals.

sn: स वज्र इव दुर्धर्षो वज्रिबाहुविसर्जितः। कृतान्त इव चावार्यो न्यपतद्रावणोरसि॥
en: (That Brahma weapon) irrepressible as the thunder, dreadful as the Death and discharged by Rama, fell down on Ravana's breast.

sn: स विसृष्टो महावेगः शरीरान्तकरः परः। बिभेद हृदयं तस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः॥
en: That shaft, capable of bringing about death and gifted with velocity, when discharged, cleft the breast of the vicious-souled Rāvana.

sn: रुधिराक्तः स वेगेन शरीरान्तकरः शरः। रावणस्य हरन्प्राणान्विवेश धरणीतलम्॥
en: That body-ending arrow bathed in blood stealing away the life of Råvana entered the earth.

sn: स शरो रावणं हत्वा रुधिरार्द्रकृतच्छविः। कृतकर्मा निभृतवत्स तूणीं पुनराविशत्॥
en: That shaft, slaying Răvaņa soaked in blood and successful, again entered the quiver* humbly. *In some texts there is "na punaravisat" i.e. did not enter the quiver.

sn: तस्य हस्ताद्धतस्याशु कार्मुकं चापि सायकम्। निपपात सह प्राणैर्धश्यमानश्च जीवितात्॥
en: And from his hand who was deprived of his life fell down instantly on earth his shafts and bow. v

sn: गतासुीभवेगस्तु नैर्ऋतेन्द्रो महाद्युतिः। पपा स्यन्दनाद्भूमौ वृत्रो वज्रहतो यथा॥
en: And fell down on the earth from the chariot, the highly effulgent Rāvaņa, gifted with dreadful velocity and shom of his life.

sn: तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ हतशेषा निशाचराः। हतनाथा भयत्रस्ताः सर्वतः संप्रदुद्रुवुः॥
en: Beholding him thus fallen down, the remaining night-rangers, deprived of their lord and stricken with terror fled away to various quarters.

sn: सर्वतश्चाभिपेतुस्तान्वानरान्दुमयोधिनः। दशग्रीववधं दृष्ट्वा वानरा जितकाशिनः॥
en: Beholding the destruction of the Ten-necked (demon) and the victory of Raghava, the monkeys fighting with trees, pursued them on all sides.

sn: अर्दिता वानरैभ्रष्टा लङ्कामभ्यपतन्भयात्। हताश्रयत्वात्करुणैर्वाष्पप्रस्रवणैर्मुखैः॥
en: Being assailed by the monkeys and having their countenances full of tears in consequence of their lord being slain they fled away to Lankā in fear.

sn: ततो विनेदुः संहृष्टा वानरा जितकाशिनः। वदन्तो राघवजयं रावणस्य त तद्वधम्॥
en: Thereupon the monkeys being greatly delighted roared out the victory of Rāma.

sn: अथान्तरिक्षे व्यनदत्सौम्यस्त्रिदशदुन्दुभिः। दिव्यगन्धवहस्तत्र मारुतः सुसुखो ववौ॥
en: The celestial bugle was sounded in the sky and there blew the excellent air carrying the celestial fragrance.

sn: निपपातान्तरिक्षाच्च पुष्पवृष्टिस्तदा भुवि। किरन्ती राघवरथं दुरावापा मनोहरा ॥
en: Flowers were showered upon Rama's car which was covered therewith.

sn: राघवस्तवसंयुक्ता गगने च विशुश्रुवे। साधुसाध्विति वागग्र्या देवतानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: The celestials in the sky began to chaunt the glory of Rāma and praise him.

sn: आविवेश महान्हर्षों देवानां चारणैः सह। रावणे निहते रौद्रे सर्वलोकभयंकरे॥
en: And Ravana, the dread of all people, being slain, the celestials with the Cäraņas were greatly delighted.

sn: ततः सकामं सुग्रीवमङ्गदं च विभीषणम्। चकार राघवः प्रीतो हत्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवम्॥
en: And slaying that foremost of the Rākşasas Rāma satisfied the desire of Sugriva, Angada and Vibhisana.

sn: ततः प्रजग्मुः प्रशमं मरुद्गणा दिशः प्रसेदुर्विमलं नभोऽभवत्। मही चकम्पे न च मारुतो ववौ स्थिरप्रभश्चाप्यभवद्दिवाकरः॥
en: Thereupon the celestials attained their peace, the quarters were delighted, the atmosphere was clear, calm air began to prevail all over the earth, and the Sun appeared in its full rays.

sn: ततस्तु सुग्रीवविभीषणाङ्गदाः सुहृद्विशिष्टाः सहलक्ष्मणास्तदा। समेत्य हृष्टा विजयेन राघवं रणेऽभिरामं विधिनाभ्यपूजयन्॥
en: Thereupon Sugrīva Vibhișana and Lakşmaņa, welcomed Rāma, of unmitigated prowess singing his glory.

sn: स तु निहतरिपुः स्थिरप्रतिज्ञः स्वजनबलाभिवृतो रणे बभूव। स्त्रिदशगणैरभिसंवृतो महेन्द्रः॥
en: There appeared beautiful at the battle-field Rāma of firm promise, slaying his enemy and encircled by his army and friends like to the lord of the celestials surrounded by the gods.

sn: भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा शयानं निर्जितं रणे। शोकवेगपरीतात्मा विललाप विभीषणः॥
en: Beholding his brother defeated, slain and lying down on the battle-field, Vibhisana overpowered with the weight of his grief, began to lament.

sn: वीरविक्रान्त विख्यात प्रवीण नयकोविद। महार्हशयनोपेत किं शेषे निहतो भुवि ॥ निक्षिप्य दी? निश्चेष्टौ भुजावङ्गदभूषितौ। मुकुटेनापवृत्तेन भास्कराकारवर्चसा ॥
en: O hero, well-known for your prowess, wise and conversant with polity, you were used to excellent beds, why did you lie down on the earth spreading (on the earth) your long and actionless arms always adorned with Angadas and being shorn of your helmet having the resplendence of the Sun.

sn: तदिदं वीर संप्राप्तं यन्मया पूर्वमीरितम्। काममोहपरीतस्य यत्तन्न रुचितं तव॥
en: O hero you have come by what I had anticipated and what did not please you who were possessed by delusions.

sn: यन्न दात्प्रहस्तो वा नेन्द्रजिन्नापरे जनाः। न कुम्भकर्णोऽतिरथो नातिकायो नरान्तकः। न स्वयं बहु मन्येथास्तस्योदर्कोऽयमागतः॥
en: Prahasta, Indrajit Kumbhakarma, Atikāya, Atiratha, Narāntaka, yourself and others-none of you paid heed, out of haughtiness, to what I had said which has now been brought about.

sn: गतः सेतुः सुनीतानां गतो धर्मस्य विग्रहः। गतः सत्त्वस्य संक्षेपः सुहस्तानां गतिर्गता॥ आदित्यः पतितो भूमौ मग्नस्तमसि चन्द्रमाः। चित्रभानुः प्रशान्ताचिर्व्यवसायो निरुद्यमः।। अस्मिन्निपतिते वीरे भूमौ शस्त्रभृतां वरे॥
en: Oh! the bridge of the pious has been broken, the figure of the virtue has been spoiled, the refuge of the strong and powerful has disappeared and you have attained to the state of the heroes! The sun has fallen down on the earth, the moon has been shorn of its lustre, the fire has been extinguished and virtue has desisted from its action, this hero, the foremost of those using weapons, falling down on the earth.

sn: किं शेषमिहलोकस्य गतसत्त्वस्य संप्रति। रणे राक्षसशार्दूले प्रसुप्त इव पांसुषु।।।।।
en: O you the foremost of the Rakşasas lying down in the dust on the battle field like one asleep whom else have these remaining (Raksasas) deprived of their power and energy, got?

sn: स्तपोबलः शौर्यनिबद्धमूलः। रणे महानराक्षसराजवृक्षः संमर्दितो राघवमारुतेन।९।।
en: The huge tree of the lord of Räkşasas having patience for its leaves velocity for its flowers the power of asceticism and heroism for its firm roots, has been uprooted by the Rāghava wind.

sn: तेजोविषाणः कुलवंशवंशः कोपप्रसादापरगावहस्तः। इक्ष्वाकुसिंहावगृहीतदेहः सुप्तः क्षिप्तौ रावणगन्धहस्ती॥
en: Mad-elephant-like Ravana, having prowess for its tusk, family rank for its back bone, anger for its legs, and delighedness for its trunk, has been laid low on the ground by the lion of the Iksvāku race.

sn: निःश्वासधूमः स्वबलप्रतापः। निर्वापितो रामपयोधरेण॥
en: The powerful Räksasa-fire having prowess and energy for its rays, angry breath for its smoke, own strength for it power of burning, has been extinguished in battle by Rāma like cloud.

sn: सिंहङ्क्षलाङ्गेलककुद्विषाणः पराभिजिद्गन्धनगन्धवाहः। रक्षोवृषश्चापलकर्णचक्षुः क्षितीश्वरव्याघ्रहतोऽवसन्नः॥
en: The Räkşasas bull ever defeating others and powerful as the wind having Rākşasas for its tail hump an a horns, and fickleness for its ears and eyes, has been slain today by Rāma-tiger.

sn: वदन्तं हेतुमद्वाक्यं परिदृष्टार्थनिश्चयम्। रामः शोकसमाविष्टमित्युवाच विभीषणम्॥
en: Hearing these words pregnant with sound reasonings from Vibhīşaņa and beholding him overwhelmed with grief Rāma said.

sn: नायं विनष्टो निचेष्टः समरे चण्डविक्रमः। अत्युनतमहोत्साहः पतितोऽयमशङ्कितः॥
en: (This lord of Rākşasas) of dreadful prowess has not been slain in battle disabled. he is gifted with great prowess and energy and devoid of the fear of death.' * i.e. he has accidentally met with death.

sn: नैवं विनष्टाः शोच्यन्ते क्षत्रधर्मव्यवस्थिताः। वृद्धिमाशंसमाना ये निपतन्ति रणाजिरे॥
en: The heroes abiding by the virtues of the kş arriyas, who fall at the battle field for enhancing their glory, when dead, should not be mourned for.

sn: येन सेन्द्रास्त्रयो लोकास्त्रासिता युधि धीमता। अस्मिन्कालसमायुक्ते न कालः परिशोचितुम्॥
en: This is not the time to mourn for him although possessed by death, by whom gifted with intellect Indra with the three worlds was terrified in conflict.

sn: नैकान्तविजयो युद्धे भूतपूर्वः कदाचन। परैर्वा हन्यते वीरः परान्वा हन्ति संयुगे॥
en: Besides success in battle is not perpetual; either one slays his enemy or meets with his destruction at his hands in the conflict.

sn: इयं हि पूर्वैः संदिष्टा गतिः क्षत्रियसंमता। क्षत्रियो निहतः संख्ये न शोच्य इति निश्चयः॥
en: This procedure of the Ksatryas was laid down by the ancient preceptors that a kşatrya, when slain in battle should not be mourned for.

sn: तदेवं निश्चयं दृष्ट्वा तत्त्वमास्थाय विज्वरः। यदिहानन्तरं कार्य कल्प्यं तदनुचिन्तय॥
en: Beholding this to be certain and attaining calmness, do you be freed from your sorrow an think what should be done now.

sn: तमुक्तवाक्यं विक्रान्तं राजपुत्रं विभीषणः। उवाच शोकसंतप्तो भ्रातुर्हितमनन्तरम्॥
en: Thereupon Vibhișaņa stricken with grief addressed the powerful son of the king speaking thus with words ter ting to his brother's wellbeing.

sn: योऽयं विमर्देष्वविभग्नपूर्वः सुरैः समस्तैरपि वासवेन। भवन्तमासाद्य रणे विभग्नो वेलामिवासाद्य यथा समुद्रः॥
en: You have, like ine ocean breaking down its banks, broken him down, who had not been are this even defeated by Basava and the celestials.

sn: अनेन दत्तानि वनीपकेषु भुक्ताश्च भोगा निभृताश्च भृत्याः। धनानि मित्रेषु समर्पितानि वैराण्यमित्रेषु निपातितानि॥
en: By him were conferred many a gift on those who wanted them, were enjoyed many a luxury, were maintained many a servant distributed wealth to friends and slain the enemies.

sn: एषोऽहिताग्निश्च महातपाश्च वेदान्तगः कर्मसु चाग्र्यशूरः। एतस्य यत्प्रेतगतस्य कृत्यं तत्कर्तुमिच्छामि तव प्रसादात्॥
en: He propitiated fire, performed great austerities, was conversant with the Vedas and the great performer of sacrifices. I desire to perform, by your instructions, his becoming obsequies.

sn: स तस्य वाक्यैः करुणैर्महात्मा संबोधितः आज्ञापयामास नरेन्द्रसूनुः स्वर्गीयमाधानमदीनसत्त्वः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Vibhīşaņa with piteous accents, the high-souled son of the lord of men. gifted with great energy, ordered him to perform his obsequies and said.

sn: मरणान्तानि वैराणि निवृतं नः प्रयोजनम्। क्रियतामस्य संस्कारो ममाप्येष यथा तव ॥
en: With death our enmity has terminated and our object has been accomplished: he is as dear to me as to you: perform (therefore) his funeral rites.

sn: रावणं निहतं दृष्ट्वा राघवेण महात्मना। अन्तःपुराद्विनिष्पेतू राक्षस्यः शोककर्शिताः॥
en: Beholding Rävaņa Slain by the high-souled Rāghava Räksasaees, stricken with grief, issued out of the inner appartments.

sn: वार्यमाणाः सुबहुशो वेष्टन्त्यो रणपांसुषु। विमुक्तकेश्यः शोकार्त गावो वत्सहता यथा॥
en: Stricken with grief and with dishevelled hairs they rolled in the dust albeit prevented again and again like to cows separated from their calves,

sn: उत्तरेण विनिष्क्रम्य द्वारेण सह राक्षसैः। प्रविश्यायोधनं घोरं विचिन्वन्त्यो हतं पतिम्॥
en: And coming out by the northern gate along with the Rakssas entering the dreadful arena of battle and searching their slain lord the shedemons cried piteously.

sn: आर्यपुत्रेति वादिन्यो हा नाथेति च सर्वशः। परिपेतुः कबन्धातां महीं शोणितकर्दमाम्॥
en: O lord, O husband, O our all" and moved along the battle field soaked in blood and filled with headless corpses.

sn: ता बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्ष्यो भर्तृशोकपराजिताः। करिण्य इव नर्दन्त्यः केरेण्वो हतयूथपाः॥
en: With eyes full of tears and overwhelmed with the grief of their husband they began to move about like she-elephants without the lord of their herd.

sn: ददृशुस्ता महाकायं महावीर्य महाद्युतिम्। रावणं निहतं भूमौ नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम्॥
en: Thereupon they beheld there on the earth the huge-bodied and the highly powerful and effulgent Rävaņa slain like red collyrium.

sn: ताः पतिं सहसा दृष्ट्वा शयानं रणपांसुषु। निपेतुस्तस्य गात्रेषु छिना वनलता इव ॥
en: Beholding their lord lying down on the battlefield they all fell on his body like creepers tom assunder.

sn: बहुमानात्परिष्वज्य काचिदेनं रुरोद ह। चरणौ काचिदालम्ब्य काचित्कण्ठेऽवलम्ब्य च॥
en: Some wept embracing him respectfullysome holding his feet and some placing themselves around his neck.

sn: उत्क्षिप्य च भुजौ काचिद्भूमौ सुपरिवर्तते। हतस्य वदनं दृष्ट्वा काचिन्मोहमुपागमत्॥
en: And some taking up his hand rolled on the ground and some were beside themselves (with grief) beholding the slain (Ravana's) countenance.

sn: काचिदङ्के शिरः कृत्वा रुरोद मुखमीक्षती। स्नापयन्ती मुखं बाष्पैस्तुषारैरिव पङ्कजम्॥
en: And some placing her head on his lap, and beholding his face, wept, bathing it with tears like a lotus enveloped with snow.

sn: एवमार्ताः पतिं दृष्ट्वा रावणं निहतं भुवि। चुक्रुशुर्बहुधा शोकाद्भूयस्ताः पर्यदेवयन्॥
en: Seeing their husband Rāvaņa thus slain on the earth, they stricken with grief bewailing again and again in sorrow, wept profusely.

sn: येन वित्रासितः शक्रो येन वित्रासितो यमः। येन वैश्रवणो राजा पुष्पकेण वियोजितः॥ गन्धर्वाणामृषीणां च सुराणां च महात्मनाम्। भयं येन रणे दत्तं सोऽयं शेते रणे हतः॥ असुरेभ्यः सुरेभ्यो वा पन्नगेभ्योऽपि वा तथा। भयं यो न विजानाति तस्येदं मानुषाद्भयम्॥
en: He by whom the king Vaisrabana was deprived of his flower car, who terrified the high-souled Gandharvas, ascetics and the celestials in battle field, who did not know of any fear from the Asuras, celestials, and the Pannagas, has now been overpowered by a man.

sn: अवध्यो देवतानां यस्तथा दानवरक्षसाम्। हतः सोऽयं रणे शेते मानुषेण पदातिना॥
en: He whom the celestials, the Dānvas and the Rākşasa could not slay, has been slain in conflict by a man walking on foot.

sn: यो न शक्यः सुरैर्हन्तुं न यक्षैर्नासुरैस्तथा। सोऽयं कश्चिदिवासत्त्वो मृत्यु मन लम्भितः॥
en: He, who was incapable of being killed by the celestials, Yaksas and Asuras, has met with death like one devoid of prowess at the hands of a mortal.

sn: एवं वदन्त्यो रुरुदुस्तस्य ता दुःखिताः स्त्रियः। भूय एव च दुःखार्ता विलेपुश्च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Speaking in this wise, the she-demons, over powered with sorrow wept and bewailed again and again (saying).

sn: अशृण्वता तु सुहृदां सततं हितवादिनाम्। मरणायाहृता सीता राक्षसाश्च निपातिताः।। एताः सममिदानीं ते वयमात्मा च पातितः॥
en: Not hearing (the counsels) of your friends, always pointing out your welfare, you did bring Sītā, for your destruction as well as that of the Raksasas.

sn: ब्रुवाणोऽपि हितं वाक्यमिष्टो भ्राता विभीषणः। दृष्टं परुषितो मोहात्त्वयात्मवधकाङ्गिणा॥
en: Although your brother Vibhīşana addressed you with words pregnant with your welfare-you, for your own destruction, out of your misgivings, did excite his anger and have (now) seen (the result thereof).

sn: यदि निर्यातिता ते स्यात्सीता रामाय मैथिली। न नः स्याद्व्यसनं घोरमिदं मूलहरं महत्॥
en: Have you returned Sītā the daughter of the king of Mithilā to Råma, this mighty and dreadful disaster, destroying the very root, would not have befallen us.

sn: वृत्तकामो भवेद्याता रामो मित्रकुलं भवेत्। वयं चाविधवाः सर्वाः सकामा न च शत्रवः॥
en: Rāma's desire would have been encompassed his friends would have been successful (through Vibhīşaņa) we would not been widowed and out enemies would not have got their desires fulfilled.

sn: त्वया पुनर्नृशंसेन सीतां संरुन्धता बलात्। राक्षसा बयमात्मा च त्रयं तुल्यं निपातितम्॥
en: By there, Sītā was kept by force in captivity in a ruthless manner, and the Rākşasas, ourselves and yourself-all three equally have been slain.

sn: न कामकारः कामं वा तव राक्षसपुङ्गव। दैवं चेष्टयते सर्वं हतं दैवेन हन्यते॥
en: O foremost of the Rākşasas, forsooth this is not your own folly-it is Accident that unite all things and it is accident again that bring about destrucion.

sn: वानराणां विनाशोऽयं राक्षसानां च ते रणे। तव चैव महाबाहो दैवयोगादुपागतः॥
en: O you of huge arms-the destruction of the monkeys and the Rākşasas as well as that of yourself has been brought about by Accident.

sn: नैवार्थेन च कामेन विक्रमेण न चाज्ञया। शक्या दैवगतिर्लोके निवर्तयितुमुद्यता॥
en: When the course of accident is about to bring about result-wealth, desire, prowess or command-nothing is capable of with standing it.

sn: विलेपुरेवं दीनास्ता राक्षसाधिपयोषितः। कुरर्य इव दुःखार्ता बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणाः॥
en: Thus wept piteously the wives of the lord of Rakşasas like to so many she-elephants-rendered poorly, stricken with grief and with tears in their eyes.

sn: तासां विलपमानानां तदा राक्षसयोषिताम्। ज्येष्ठपत्नी प्रिया दीना भर्तारं समुदैक्षत॥ दशग्रीवं हतं दृष्ट्वा रामेणाचिन्त्यकर्मणा। पतिं मण्डोदरी तत्र कृपणा पर्यदेवयत्॥
en: The foremost of the wives of the Rākşasas (king) bewailing piteously cast her looks poorly towards her husband. And beholding her Tennecked husband slain by Rāma of Inconceivable actions Mandodarī bewailed there piteously.

sn: ननु नाम महाबाहो तव वैश्रवणानुज। क्रुद्धस्य प्रमुखे स्थातुं त्रस्यत्यपि पुरंदरः॥
en: O you of huge arms! O younger brother of Baishravana! Even Purandara feared to stand before you when enraged.

sn: ऋषयश्च महान्तोऽपि गन्धर्वाश्च यशस्विनः। ननु नाम तवोद्वेगाच्चारणाश्च दिशो गताः॥
en: The great Rşis-the far-famed Gandharvas and the charanas, fled away to different quarters in your fear.

sn: स त्वं मानुषमात्रेण रामेण युधि निर्जितः। न व्यपत्रपसे राजन्किमिदं राक्षसेश्वर ॥
en: Then (how) have you been overpowered in battle by Rāma who is a mere man? Why is it that you are not ashamed of it, О king, O lord of the Raksasas?

sn: कथं त्रैलोक्यमाक्रम्य श्रिया वीर्येण चान्वितम्। अविषह्यं जघान त्वां मानुषो वनगोचरः॥
en: Conquering the three worlds with your prowess you did attain your glory; and it is unbearable, that a man, ranging in the forest, has slain you.

sn: मानुषाणामविषये चरतः कामरूपिणः। विनाशस्तव रामेण संयुगे नोपपद्यते॥
en: You who are capable of assuming shapes at will have been slain in conflict by Rāma, in the city of Lankā unapproachable by men.

sn: न चैतत्कर्म रामस्य श्रद्दधामि चमूमुखे। सर्वतः समुपेतस्य तव तेनाभिभर्षणम्॥
en: I do not believe that your destruction, who had always been crowned with success, before the forces, is work of Rāma.

sn: अथवा रामरूपेण कृतान्तः स्वयमागतः। मायां तव विनाशाय विधायाप्रतितर्किताम्॥
en: (Methinks) Death (himself) came there in the shape of Rāma and spread illusions unconsciously for your destruction, O you of great strength.

sn: अथवा वासवेन त्वं धर्षितोऽसि महाबल। वासवस्य तु का शक्तिस्त्वां द्रष्टुमपि संयुगे॥ महाबलं महावीर्यं देवशत्रु महौजसम्।
en: Or you have been slain by Väsava (no) what power has he got to face you in the conflict gifted with great strength, prowess and energy and an enemy of the celestials as you are?

sn: व्यक्तमेष महायोगी परमात्मा सनातनः॥ अनादिमध्यनिधनो महतः परमो महान्। तमसः परमो धाता शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः॥ श्रीवत्सवक्षा नित्यश्रीरजय्यः शाश्वतो ध्रुवः। मानुषं रूपमास्थाय विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः॥ सर्वैः परिवृत्तो देवैर्वानरत्वमुपागतः। सर्वलोकेश्वरः श्रीमॅल्लोकानां हितकाम्यया।॥ स राक्षसपरीवारं देवशत्रु भयावहम्।
en: It is evident that the great ascetic Vişnu having truth for his prowess-the soul of all beings ever existing, without beginning, middle or end, greater than the great, the Preserver of the Nature, holding conch discus and club having Śrīvatsa* on his breast, always beautiful, incapable of being conquered, without destruction, devoid of end, and the lord of all men, assuming this shape of a man and encircled by the celestials, assuming monkey shapes, has for the behoof of mankind, slain (you) the dreadful enemy of the gods with all (your) family and Rākşasas. *A particular mark usually said to be a curl of hair on the breast of Vişnu. The emblem of the tenth jina or the mark above ascribed to Vişņu or Kṛṣṇa.

sn: इन्द्रियाणि पुरा जित्वा जितं त्रिभुवनं त्वया॥ स्मरद्भिरिव तद्वैरमिन्द्रियैरेव निर्जितः।
en: Subduing all your passions, you did conquer the three worlds-remembering their grudge they have now over powered you.

sn: यदैव हि जनस्थाने राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः॥ खरस्तु निहतो भ्राता तदा रामो न मानुषः।
en: Rāma is not a man since he slew at Janasthāna your brother Khara encircied by many a Rāks asas.

sn: यदैव नगरी लङ्का दुष्प्रवेशां सुरैरपि।॥ प्रविष्टो हनुमान्वीर्यात्तदैव व्यथिता वयम्।
en: We were sore-distressed when Hanuman, by his own prowess, entered the city of Lanka incapable of being approached even by the celestials.

sn: क्रियतामविरोधश्च राघवेणेति यन्मया॥ उच्यमानं न गृह्णासि तस्येयं व्युष्टिरागता।
en: I prevented you from creating enmity with Rāghava but you did not pay heed to my words and this is the result (thereof).

sn: अकस्माच्चाभिकामोऽसि सीतां राक्षसपुङ्गव॥ ऐश्वर्यस्य विनाशाय देहस्य स्वजनस्य च। अरुन्धत्या विशिष्टां तां रोहिण्याश्चापि दुर्मते।२०॥ सीतां धर्षयता मान्यां त्वया ह्यसदृशं कृतम्। वसुधाया हि वसुधां श्रियाः श्रीं भर्तृवत्सलाम्॥
en: O foremost of Rākşasas-0 you of a vicious understanding, for the destruction of your wealth yourself and your relatives, you did suddenly cherish amour for Sitā, greater than-Yeven) Arundhati and Rohiņi. Forsooth you did perpetrated an unbecoming deed by distressing the adorable Sitā ever devoted to her lord, an earth* even to Earth herself and a Śrī (Śrt is the goddess of wealth and good fortune-but Sitā is more fortunate than fortune herself-) even to Śrī herself. *The Earth is an emblem of patience but Sítā is more patient than the earth.

sn: सीतां सर्वानवद्याङ्गीमरण्ये विजने शुभाम्। आनयित्वा तु तां दीनां छद्मनात्मस्वदूषणम्॥ अप्राप्य तं चैव कामं मैथिलीसंगमे कृतम्। पतिव्रतायास्तपसा नूनं दग्धोऽसि मे प्रभो॥
en: Having brought in a false guise from the solitary forest the sorrowful and chaste Sītā, having a blameless person, you did bring on the destruction of your family. You did fail to encompass your desire for the company of Sītā. But now, forsooth, O my lord you have been burnt down by her devotion who is devoted to her husband. *i.e. that you were not burnt down there and then shows her greatness of mind.

sn: तदैव यन्न दग्धस्त्वं धर्षयंस्तनुमध्यमाम्। देवा बिभ्यति ते सर्वे सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः।।२४
en: You were not burnt down when you did captivate that middle-statured (damsel) whom fear all the celestial headed by Indra and Agni. (The god of Fire).

sn: अवश्यमेव लभते फलं पापस्य कर्मणः। भर्तः पर्यागते काले कर्ता नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: O husband, (proper) time appearing the perpetrator gets the result of his vicious deeds: there is not the least doubt in this.

sn: शुभकृच्छुभमाप्नोति पापकृत्पापमश्नुते। विभीषणः सुखं प्राप्तस्त्वं प्राप्तः पापमीदृशम्।।२६
en: The performer of the good receives good (result)-the perpetrator of the vicious (deeds) meets with bad (result). Vibhisana has attained to happiness and you have met with this your end.

sn: सन्त्यन्याः प्रमदास्तुभ्यं रूणेणाभ्यधिकास्ततः। अनङ्गवशमापन्नस्त्वं तु मोहान बुद्ध्यसे॥
en: There are damsels in your sergalio far more beautiful than she but you possessed by cupid could not perceive this.

sn: न कुलेन न रूपेण न दाक्षिण्येन मैथिली। मयाधिका वा तुल्या वा तत्तु मोहान बुद्ध्यसे॥
en: Maithili is not my equal nor superior either in birth, beauty or accomplishments, but you did not perceive this by your misgivings.

sn: सर्वदा सर्वभूतानां नास्ति मृत्युरलक्षणः। तव तद्वदयं मृत्युमैथिलीकृतलक्षणः॥
en: Death does not always visit all men without any cause-and Maithili is the cause of the death.

sn: सीतानिमित्तजो मृत्युस्त्वया दूरादुपाहृतः। मैथिली सह रामेण विशोका विहरिष्यति॥ अल्पपुण्या त्वहं घोरे पतिता शोकसागरे।
en: And death, in consequence of Maithili, has taken you far away. And she, shorn of all sorrow, shall enjoy in the company of Rāma, and I, of limited piety, am now sunk in the ocean of grief.

sn: कैलासे मन्दरे मेरौ तथा चैत्ररथे वने॥ देवोद्यानेषु सर्वेषु विहृत्य सहिता त्वया। विमानेनानुरूपेण या याम्यतुलया श्रिया॥ पश्यन्ती विविधान्देशांस्तांस्तांश्चित्रनगम्बरा। भ्रंशिता कामभोगेभ्यः सास्मि वीर वधात्तव ॥
en: Roaming at large with you in a car unequalled in beauty on the hill Kailāsa Mandara, Meru, in the garden of Caitraratha and all other celestial gardens, beholding many a country, wearing variegated clothes and garlands, I have been deprived of all pleasures and enjoyments, O hero, by your death.

sn: सैवान्येवास्मि संवृत्ता धिराज्ञां चञ्चलां श्रियम्। हा राजन्सुकुमारं ते सुभ्र सुत्वक्समुन्नसम्॥ कान्तिश्रीद्युतिभिस्तुल्यमिन्दुपद्मदिवाकरैः। किरीटकूटोज्ज्वलितं ताम्रास्यं दीप्तकुण्डलम् ।।३५ मदव्याकुललोलाक्षं भूत्वा यत्पानभूमिषु। विविधस्रग्धरं चारु वल्गुस्मितकथं शुभम्॥ तदेवाद्य तवैवं हि वक्रं न भ्राजते प्रभो। रामसायकनिर्भिन्नं रक्तं रुधिरविस्रवैः॥ विशीर्णमेदोमस्तिष्कं रूक्षं स्यन्दनरेणुभिः।
en: I am a widow now O fie on fickle fortune! O king, in lustre of countenance you are like the Syn, in grace like the Moon in beauty like the lotus; you are graceful, O you having excellent brows; you have got excellent skin, high nose and your countenance is graced with a brilliant crown and Kundalas. Oh how beautiful you did look with various garlands when your eye whirled with intoxication on the drinking ground and how beautiful were your smiles, O lord.
