Your countenance does not shine now-being severed with Rāma's shafts, bathed in a pool of blood, having your back-bone and brain deranged and covered with the dust raised by the wheels of the chariots.

sn: हा पश्चिमा मे संप्राप्ता दशा वैधव्यदायिनी॥ या मयासीन संबुद्धा कदाचिदपि मन्दया।
en: Alas! by my ill-luck I have attained to that after state making me a widow which I did never think of.

sn: पिता दानवराजो मे भर्ता मे राक्षसेश्वरः॥ पुत्रो मे शक्रनिर्जेता इत्यहं गर्विता भृशम्। दृप्तारिमथनाः क्रूराः प्रख्यातबलपौरुषाः॥ अकुतश्चिद्भया नाथा ममेत्यासीन्मतिर्बुवा।
en: My father is the king of Dănvas, my husband the lord of Rākşasas, and my son the subduer of Śakra. I was greatly proud of this and always confident that my protectors were undaunted dreadful, repressors of the enemies and famous for their strength and manliness.

sn: तेषामेवंप्रभावाणां युष्माकं राक्षसर्षभाः॥ कथं भयमसंबुद्धं मानुषादिदमागतम्।
en: O you foremost of the Rākşasas, how could this fear from man overwhelm you all who were so powerful.

sn: स्निग्धेन्द्रनीलनीलं तु प्रांशुशैलोपमं महत्॥ केयूराङ्गदवैदूर्यमुक्ताहारस्रगुज्ज्वलम्। कान्तं विहारेष्वधिकं दीप्तं संग्रामभूमिषु॥ भात्याभरणभाभिर्यद्विद्युद्भिरिव तोयदः। तदेवाद्य शरीरं ते तीक्ष्णै कचरैश्चितम्॥ पुनर्दुर्लभसंस्पर्श परिष्वक्तुं न शक्यते।
en: (This your body) is cool green like Indranila, high like a huge mountain, and adorned with Keyūra, Angada, jewels and garlands of flowers. It was graceful in places of enjoyments and incapable of being looked at in the field of battle. It was brilliant, being decked with ornaments like to clouds accompanied by lightnings.

sn: श्वाविधः शललैर्युक्तं लग्नैर्बाणैर्निरन्तरम् ॥ स्वर्पितैर्मर्मसु भृशं संछिन्नस्नायुबन्धनम्। क्षितौ निपतितं राजश्यामं वै रुधिरच्छवि॥ वज्रप्रहारमभितो विकीर्ण इव पर्वतः।
en: This your person has been pierced with shafts today; (and knowing) that it is not easy of attainment for me I am incapable of embracing (it) covered with shafts piercing through the very vitals. O king (this your body) green-hued (but now) blood-red is now lying on the ground like to a mountain shattered with thunder-bolts.

sn: हा स्वप्नः सत्यमेवेदं त्वं रामेण कथं हतः॥ त्वं मृत्योरपि मृत्युः स्याः कथं मृत्युवशं गतः।
en: That you wouldst be slain by Rāma was like a dream, but it has proved true! You were like death to Death himself, why have you been possessed by him then?

sn: त्रैलोक्यवसुभोक्तारं त्रैलोक्योद्वेगदं महत्॥ जेतारं लोकपालानां क्षेप्तारं शंकरस्य च। दृप्तानां विग्रहीतारमाविष्कृतपराक्रमम्॥ लोकक्षोभयितारं च साधुभूतविदारणम्। ओजसा दृप्तवाक्यानां वक्तारं रिपुसंनिधौ॥ स्वयूथभृत्यगोप्तारं हन्तारं भीमकर्मणाम्। हन्तारं दानवेन्द्राणां यक्षाणां च सहस्रशः॥ निवातकवचानां तु निग्रहीतारमाहवे। नैकयज्ञविलोप्तारं त्रातारं स्वजनस्य च॥ धर्मव्यवस्थाभेत्तारं मायास्रष्टारमाहवे। देवासुरनृकन्यानामाहर्तारं ततस्ततः॥ शत्रुस्त्रीशोकदातारं नेतारं स्वजनस्य च। लङ्काद्वीपस्य गोप्तारं कर्तारं भीमकर्मणाम्॥ अस्माकं कामभोगानां दातारं रथिनां वरम्। एवंप्रभावं भर्तारं दृष्ट्वा रामेण पातितम्॥ स्थिरास्मि या देहमिमं धारयामि हतप्रिया।
en: You were the enjoyer of the three worlds wealth and dread to them; you were the conqueror of the deities presiding over various quarters; you did shake Saikara (himself) you were the subdure of the proud and your prowess was well-known you did repress the people and slay many a pious man-you did, by your prowess, use to give vent to haughty words before the enemies; you were the maintainer of your kinsmen and servants and the slayer of many perpetrating dreadful deeds; you were the destroyer of thousands of celestials, Dänavas and Yakşas; you were the subbuer of Niváta Kavachas in the encounter, your did hinder the perfrrmance oí many sacrifices and were the protector of your relatives; you were the obstructer of pious observance creator of illusions in conflict and you did bring away from hither and thither the daughters of the celestials, demons and men; you did aggrieve the wives of your enemies; you were the leader of your own men the protector of the island of Lanka and the performer of many a dreadful deed; you did confer upon us the enjoyment of many a pleasure-and were the foremost of car-warriors Beholding such a husband slain by Rāma, I am, deprived of my dear lord still maintaining my being; (forsooth) my heart is very hard.

sn: शयनेषु महार्हेषु शयित्वा राक्षसेश्वर॥ इह कस्मात्प्रसुप्तोऽसि धरण्यां रेणुगुण्ठितः।
en: O lord of Raksasas, used are to many a valuable bed, why are you sleeping on earth covered with dust?

sn: यदा मे तनयः शस्तो लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिधुधि॥ तदा त्वभिहता तीव्रमद्य त्वस्मि निपातिता।
en: When my son Indrajit was slain by Lakşmaņa in conflict I was greatly pained-but today I am slain.

sn: साहं बन्धुजनैींना हीना नाथेन च त्वया॥ विहीना कामभोगैश्च शोचिष्ये शाश्वतीः समाः।
en: Deprived of my friends and relatives, separated from you O my lord, deprived from the enjoyment of many pleasures I shall lament for you perpetually.

sn: प्रपन्नो दीर्घमध्वानं राजन्नद्य सुदुर्गमम्॥ नय मामपि दुःखाता न वर्तिष्ये त्वया विना।
en: You have, O king. reached the way long and hard to be treaded-do you take me. who am stricken with grief and who shall not be able to live without you.

sn: कस्मात्त्वं मां विहायेह कृपणां गन्तुमिच्छसि॥ दीनां विलपती मन्दां किं च मां नाभिभाषसे।
en: Why did you wish to go leaving me behind who have been rendered poorly? Why did you not welcome me, unfortunate and poor, who am bewailing?

sn: दृष्ट्वा न खल्वभिक्रुद्धो मामिहामवगुण्ठिताम्॥ निर्गतां नगरद्वारात्पद्भ्यामेवागतां प्रभो। पश्येष्टदार दारांस्ते भ्रष्टलज्जावगुण्ठनान्॥ बहिनिष्पतितान्सर्वान्कथं दृष्ट्वा न कुप्यसि। अयं क्रीडासहायस्तेऽनाथो लालप्यते जनः॥
en: Why are you not angry, O lord beholding me, having put off my veil, walk out on foot by the city-gate. O beloved of your wives do you behold your wives-who have thrown off their veils. Why are you not angry seeing them all come out (of the city)? I was your companion in sports, O my lord; I long for having you; why are you not consoling and welcoming me?

sn: न चैनमाश्वासयसि किं वा न बहुमन्यसे। यास्त्वया विधवा राजन्कृता नैका कुलस्त्रियः।।६४ पतिव्रता धर्मरता गुरुशुश्रूषणे रताः। ताभिः शोकाभितप्ताभिः शप्तः परवशं गतः॥ त्वया विप्रकृताभिश्च तदा शप्तस्तदागतम्।
en: O king, being imprecated by those damsels, not one devoted to their husbands, pious and ever engaged in attending upon their superiors, who had been widowed by you, you have been overpowered by your enemy. The curse, proceeding from them who had been ill-treated by you has born fruit.

sn: प्रवादः सत्यमेवायं त्वां प्रति प्रायशो नृप॥ पतिव्रतानां नाकस्मात्पतन्त्यश्रूणि भूतले।
en: O kin, the saying, that the tears of chaste damsels do not uselessly fall on the ground, has been verified (here) forsooth.

sn: कथं च नाम ते राजन्लोकानाक्रम्य तेजसा॥ नारीचौर्यमिदं क्षुद्रं कृतं शौटीर्यमानिना।
en: O king, conquering the worlds with your prowess, how could you, always honoured by the king, cherish the vile desire of stealing away women?

sn: अपनीयाश्रमाद्रामं यन्मृगच्छद्मना त्वया।६८॥ 'आनीता रामपत्नी सा अपनीय च लक्ष्मणम्।
en: Taking away Răma and Lakşmaņa from the hermitage by an illusionary dear you did steal away Rāma's spouse.

sn: कातयं च न ते युद्धे कदाचित्संस्मराम्यहम्॥ तत्तु भाग्यविपर्यासानूनं ते पक्वलक्षणम्।
en: I remember to have never heard you lament in battle. Forsooth, it is our misfortune and the sign of impending death (that you did of this) conversant as you are with the past present and future.

sn: अतीतानागतार्थज्ञो वर्तमानविचक्षणः।७०॥ मैथिलीमाहृतां दृष्ट्वा ध्यात्वा निःश्वस्य चायतम्। सत्यवाक्स महाबाहो देवरो मे यदब्रवीत्॥ अयं राक्षसमुख्यानां विनाशः प्रत्युपस्थितः।
en: Beholding the daughter of the king of Mithila brought (in the city of Lanka) what, your younger brother Vibhīşaņa, thinking and sighing, said has now proved true, O you of long-arms.

sn: कामक्रोधसमुत्थेन व्यसनेन प्रसङ्गिना।७२।। निवृत्तस्त्वत्कृते नार्थः सोऽयं मूलहरो महान्। त्वया कृतमिदं सर्वमनाथं राक्षस कुलम्॥
en: This destruction of the leading Rākṣasas has proceeded from the disaster arising from your anger and lust. For your (vicious) deeds all our good fortune is lost-(and from them) has proceeded the great disaster exterminating the race. And by you all the Raksasa families have been deprived of their lords.

sn: नहि त्वं शोचितव्यो मे प्रख्यातबलपौरुषः। स्त्रीस्वभावात्तु मे बुद्धिः कारुण्ये परिवर्तते ॥
en: You well-known for your strength and manliness, are not worthy of being grieved by me. On account of my effeminate nature my understanding is possessed by sorrow.

sn: सुकृतं दुष्कृतं च त्वं गृहीत्वा स्वां गतिं गतः। आत्मानमनुशोचामि त्वद्विनाशेन दुःखिताम्॥
en: Carrying your pious and iniquitous deeds you have attained to your own state-I am only lamenting for me who have been sorry for your destruction.

sn: सुहृदां हितकामानां न श्रुतं वचनं त्वया । भ्रातृणां चैव कात्स्न्येन हितमुक्तं दशानन।।७६
en: O Ten-necked one, you did not hear the words of your friends and brothers, who spoke those well meaning words out of affection.

sn: हेत्वर्थयुक्तं विधिवच्छ्रेयस्करमदारुणम्। विभीषणेनाभिहितं न कृतं हेतुमत्त्वया॥
en: You did not obey the words uttered by Vibhisana, duly and mildly, pregnant with meaning and reasoning and tending to your welfare.

sn: मारीचकुम्भकर्णाभ्यां वाक्यं मम पितुस्तथा। न कृतं वीर्यमत्तेन तस्येदं फलमीदृशम्॥
en: Maddened with your own prowess you did not hear the word of Mārīca, Kumbhakarņa as well as those of my father-and this is the result thereof.

sn: नीलजीमूतसंकाश पीताम्बर शुभाङ्गद। स्वगात्राणि विनिक्षिप्य किं शेषे रुधिरावृतः॥ प्रसुप्त इव शोकात किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे।
en: O you resembling the red clouds O you wearing yellow cloth and excellent Angada, stretching your person on the ground why are you in the long run bathed in blood? Why did you not like one asleep welcome me who am stricken with grief?

sn: महावीर्यस्य दक्षस्य संयुगेष्वपलायिनः॥ यातुधानस्य दौहि: किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे।
en: I am the grand-daughter of the highly powerful Rākşasa Sumālī who never flies away from the field of battle; why did you not welcome me.

sn: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ किं शेषे नवे परिभवे कृते।८१॥ अद्य वै निर्भया लङ्का प्रविष्टाः सूर्यरश्मयः। येन सूदयसे शत्रून्समरे सूर्यवर्चसा ॥ वज्र वज्रधरस्येव सोऽयं ते सततार्चितः। रणे बहुप्रहरणो हेमजालपरिष्कृतः॥ परिघो व्यवकीर्णस्ते बाणैश्छिन्नः सहस्रधा।
en: Rise up! rise up! why did you lie down (on this occasion of) new discomfiture? Today have the rays of the Sun entered fearlessly the city of Lanka. The parigha, by which, brilliant as the rays of the Sun, you did distress the enemies in conflict which was always adored by you like the thunder of the wielder of thunder-bolt, which slew many in battle, and which was adorned with golden nets now Leith shattered into thousand pieces by arrows.

sn: प्रियामिवोपसंगृह्य किं शेषे रणमेदिनीम्॥ अप्रियामिव कस्माच्च मां नेच्छस्यभिभाषितुम् । धिगस्तु हृदयं यस्या ममेदं न सहस्रधा।८५॥ त्वयि पञ्चत्वमापन्ने फलते शोकपीडितम्।
en: Why did you lie on the battle-field embracing her like your beloved spouse? Why did you not wish tr welcome me like one not beloved to you? Ok fie on this heart of mine which is not sundered into thousand (pieces) albeit distressed with the grief of your death!

sn: इत्येवं विलपन्ती सा बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा॥ स्नेहोपस्कन्नहृदया तदा मोहमुपागमत्। कश्मलाभिहता सन्ना बभौ सा रावणोरसि ॥ संध्यानुरक्ते जलदे दीप्ता विद्युदिवोज्ज्वला।
en: Bewailing thus, she with profuse tears in her eyes and with her heart overflowing with affection became senseless. And being beside herself she flung herself on Ravana's breast, like to the bright lighting appearing on red evening clouds.

sn: तथागतां समुत्थाप्य सपल्यस्ता भृशातुराः॥ पर्यवस्थापयामास् रुदत्यो रुदतीं भृशम्।
en: Thereupon the other wives of Rāvaņa greatly distressed and weeping and rasing her up who was greatly weeping, began to console her saying.

sn: किं ते न विदिता देवि लोकानां स्थितिरध्रुवा॥ दशाविभागपर्याये राज्ञां वै चञ्चलाः श्रियः।
en: You not know, O worshipful dame, that the life of beings is very uncertain, and with adverse circumstance even the royal fortune become fickle?

sn: इत्येवमुच्यमाना सा सशब्दं प्ररुरोद ह॥ स्नपयन्ती तदास्त्रेण स्तनौ वक्रं सुनिर्मलम्।
en: Being thus accosted she again wept aloud bathing with tears her breast and beautiful countenance.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामो विभीषणमुवाच ह॥ संस्कारः क्रियतां भ्रातुः स्त्रीगणः परिसान्त्व्यताम्।
en: In the meantime Rama said to Vibhrsana, “Do you perform the funeral ceremonies of your brother and console his wives."

sn: तमुवाच ततो धीमान्विभीषण इदं वचः॥ विमृश्य बुद्ध्या प्रश्रितं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम्।
en: Where to the intelligent Vibhīşaņa replied with the following words-pointing out wealth and Piety, and judging by his understanding what is proper.

sn: त्यक्तधर्मव्रतं क्रूरं नृशंसमनृतं तथा।१३।। नाहमर्हामि संस्कर्तुं परदाराभिमर्शनम्।
en: "I do not think it proper to perform his cremation ceremony who had renounced all pious deeds was wicked cruel, liar and who had ravished others' wives.

sn: भ्रातृरूपो हि मे शत्रुरेष सर्वाहिते रतः॥ रावणो नाहते पूजां पूज्योऽपिगुरुगौरवात्।
en: He is my enemy in the shape of a brother ever engaged in doing injury to others and Rāvana is not worthy of my adoration albeit he is adorable by virtue of his being my elder brother.

sn: नृशंस इति मां राम वक्ष्यन्ति मनुजा भुवि॥ श्रुत्वा तस्यागुणान्सर्वे वक्ष्यन्ति सुकृतं पुनः।
en: O Rāma, perhaps people of this earth will call me cruel but they will again recognise my act as good when they will hear of his vicious deeds.

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा परमप्रीतो रामो धर्मभृतां वरः॥ विभीषणमुवाचेदं वाक्यज्ञं वाक्यकोविदः।
en: Hearing those words, Rāma, the foremost of the pious and conversant with the skill of speech greatly delighted, spoke to Vibhisana (equally) skilled in speech.

sn: तवापि मे प्रियं कार्यं त्वत्प्रभावान्मया जितम्।१७।। अवश्यं तु क्षमं वाच्यो मया त्वं राक्षसेश्वर।
en: It behove me to encompass your welfare since by your help I have gained the victory. I lord of Räkșasas, forsooth, you should hear my wellmeaning words.

sn: अधर्मानृतसंयुक्तः कामं त्वेष निशाचरः॥ तेजस्वी बलवाञ्छूरः संग्रामेषु च नित्यशः।
en: Although this night-ranger perpetrated many vicious and impious deeds still he was ever powerful, heroic and strong in warfare.

sn: शतक्रतुमुखैर्देवैः श्रूयते न पराजितः।१९।। महात्मा बलसंपन्नो रावणो लोकरावणः।
en: I have heard that this high-souled Ravana, gifted with strength and a dread to all people was not defeated (even) by the celestials headed by the performer of hundred sacrifices.

sn: मरणान्तानि वैराणि निर्वृत्तं नः प्रयोजनम्।।१००। क्रियतामस्य संस्कारो ममाप्येष तथा तव।
en: Enmity extend up to death-so it has ended; there is no necessity (of carrying it on). Do you (therefore) perform his cremation ceremony-he is to you as he is to me.

sn: त्वत्सकाशान्महाबाहो संस्कारं विधिपूर्वकम्॥ क्षिप्रमर्हति धर्मेण त्वं यशोभाग्भविष्यसि।
en: O you of long-arms it behove the to perform speedily with due rites and religious ceremonies his funeral ceremony-you shall be the object of praise (to people).

sn: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा त्वरमाणो विभीषणः॥ संस्कारयितुमारेभे भ्रातरं रावणं हतम्।
en: Hearing the words of Rāghava, Vibhīşaņa hastened on and began to make arrangements for the cremation of his slain brother Råvana.

sn: स प्रविश्य पुरीं लङ्कां राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः॥ रावणस्याग्निहोत्रं तु निर्यापयति सत्वरम्। शकटान्दारुरूपाणि अग्नीन्वै याजकांस्तथा॥ तथा चन्दनकाष्ठानि काष्ठानि विविधानि च। अगरूणि सुगन्धीनि गन्धाश्च सुरभीस्तथा॥ मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानि निर्यापयति राक्षसः।
en: Then entering the city of Lanka, Vibhisana, the lord of Raksasas, speedily got out Ravana's Agnihotra,' carts, brass utensils fire (and brought) Yājakas? sandal-wood, other woods expenses, Agura other fragrant substances, precious stones, pearls and corals. 1. A pot for preserving sacred fire. 2. The Brahmins who perform obsequies.

sn: आजगाम मुहूर्तेन राक्षसैः परिवारितः॥ ततो माल्यवता साधु क्रियामेव चकार सः।
en: Thereupon arriving immediately accompanied by Rākșasas and Mālyavān he engaged in the performance of cremation ceremony.

sn: सौवर्णी शिविकां दिव्यामारोप्य क्षौमवाससम्॥ रावणं राक्षसाधीशमश्रुवर्णमुखा द्विजाः। तूर्यघोषैश्च विविधैस्तुवद्भिश्चाभिनन्दितम्॥
en: Thereupon the twice-born ones, with tears in their eyes, covered the Rākşasa-king Rāvana's body, with a silken cloth and placed it on a golden celestial litter. With the sound of various bugles they began to chaunt his praise.

sn: पताकाभिश्च चित्राभिः सुमनोभिश्च चित्रिताम्। उत्क्षिप्य शिबिकां तां तु विभीषणपुरोगमाः॥
en: And taking up this litter adorned with various charming paintings and flags and carrying fire woods, all the Räksasas headed by Vibhīşaņa proceeded towards the south.* *Cremation-place.

sn: दक्षिणाभिमुखाः सर्वे गृह्य काष्ठानि भेजिरे। अग्नयो दीप्यमानास्ते तदाध्वर्युसमीरिताः॥
en: The Brahmins, versed in Yajur Veda and with burning fire in their hands, proceeded and were followed by the attendants.

sn: शरणाभिगताः सर्वे पुरस्तात्तस्य ते ययुः। अन्तः पुराणि सर्वाणि रुदमानानि सत्वरम्॥
en: The damsels of the seraglio followed speedily leaping (being ever unused to walking).

sn: पृष्ठतोऽनुययुस्तानि प्लवमानानि सर्वतः। रावणं प्रयते देशे स्थाप्य ते भृशदुःखिताः॥ चितां चन्दनकाष्ठैश्च पद्मकोशीरचन्दनैः। ब्राहया संवर्तयामासू राङ्कवास्तरणावृताम् ॥
en: And placing Rāvana on the cremation ground, they, greatly stricken with grief, prepared the funeral pyre according to due rites with sandalwoods, Padmakas, Uśiras? and sandal and spread an antelope skin thereon. They (then) performed the excellent obsequies of the manes of the lord of Rākşasas. 1. A sort of drug commonly called Padmakas. 2. The root of fragrant grass.

sn: प्रचक्रू राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पितृमेधमनुत्तमम्। वेदिं च दक्षिणा प्राची यथास्थानं च पावकम्॥ पृषदाज्येन संपूर्ण स्रुवं स्कन्धे प्रचिक्षिपुः। पादयोः शकटं प्रापुरूर्वोचोलू खलं तदा॥
en: And raising an altar at the south-east corner they placed fire at the proper place. They then poured curd and clarified butter upon Rāvana's) shoulders. And placing Sakata on his legs, Ulukhala* on his things, and the brass utensils, Arunis and Musals in their proper places, they celebrated (the obsequies of his manes). *A wooden mortar used for cleaning rice.

sn: दारुपात्राणि सर्वाणि अरणिं चोत्तरारणिम्। दत्त्वा तु मुसलं चान्यं यथास्थानं विचक्रमुः॥ शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना महर्षिविहितेन च। तत्र मेध्यं पशुं हत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य राक्षसाः॥ परिस्तरणिकां राज्ञो घृताक्तां समवेशयन्। गन्धैर्माल्यैरलंकृत्य रावणं दीनमानसाः॥ विभीषणसहायास्ते वस्त्रैश्च विविधैरपि। लाजैरवकिरन्ति स्म बाष्पपूर्णमुखास्तथा॥
en: Thereupon slaying beasts according to the rites laid down in Sastras and pointed out by the great saints, the Rākşasas (made a coverlet dipped in their marrow and clarified butter) And placed it on the face of the lord of Räkşasas. And decking Rāvana with fragrant garlands and various clothes, the friends, of Vibhisana, with depressed heart and tears in their eyes, showered dried paddy (on his person).

sn: स ददौ पावकं तस्य विधियुक्तं विभीषणः। स्नात्वा चैवाईवस्त्रेण तिलान्दर्भविमिश्रितान्॥ उदकेन च संमिक्षान्प्रदाय विधिपूर्वकम्। ताः स्त्रियोऽनुनयामास सान्त्वयित्वा पुनः पुनः॥
en: Vibhīşaņa according to due rites put fire to his (funeral pyre). Bathing and with wetted cloth, offering duly linseed and sacrificial grass mixed with water and consoling (Ravana's) wives again and again, he entreated them to go back.

sn: गम्यतामिति ताः सर्वा विविशुनगरं ततः। प्रविष्टासु पुरीं स्त्रीषु राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः।। रामपार्श्वमुपागम्य समतिष्ठद्विनीतवत्॥
en: They then entered the city. And those damsels having entered the city, Vibhisana, the lord of Rākşasas, approaching Rāma, stood by his side gently.

sn: रामोऽपि सह सैन्येन ससुग्रीवः सलक्ष्मणः। हर्ष लेभे रिपुं हत्वा वृत्रं वज्रधरो यथा॥
en: Rāma too, along with his army, Sugrīva and Lakşmana, was greatly delighted after slaying (the demon) Vitra.

sn: ततो विमुक्त्वा सशरं शरासनं महेन्द्रदत्तं कवचं स तन्महत्। विमुच्य रोषं रिपुनिग्रहात्ततो रामः स सौम्यत्वमुपागतोऽरिहा॥
en: Thereupon leaving aside his bow with arrows, and the huge armour conferred by Mahendra and renouncing ire after the destruction of his enemy Räma assumed gentlemen.

sn: ते रावणवधं दृष्ट्वा देवगन्धर्वदानवाः। जग्मुः स्वैः स्वैर्विमानैस्तै कथयन्तः शुभाः कथाः॥
en: Beholding the destruction of Rāvaņa the celestials, Gandharvas and Dänavas ascending their respective cars went away chanting this excellent theme.

sn: रावणस्य वधं घोरं राघवस्य पराक्रमम्। सुयुद्धं वानराणां च सुग्रीवस्य च मन्त्रितम्॥ अनुरागं च वीर्यं च मारुतेर्लक्ष्मणस्य च। पतिव्रतात्वं सीताया हनूमति पराक्रमम्॥ कथयन्तो महाभागा जग्मुर्हष्टा यथागतम्।
en: Talking of Rāvana's dreadful destruction, Raghava's prowess, the excellent warfare of the monkeys, the counsels of Sugrīva, the devotion and prowess of the Wind-God's son and Lakşmaņa and Sītā's devotion to her husband, those high souled ones, delighted, repaired to their respective quarters.

sn: राघवस्तु रथं दिव्यमिन्द्रदत्तं शिखिप्रभम्॥ अनुज्ञाप्य महाबाहुर्मातलिं प्रत्यपूजयत्।
en: Rāghava, having long arms, permitting the charioteer Mātali to take back the celestial car bright as the sky sent by Indra, honoured him greatly.

sn: राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातो मातलिः शक्रसारथिः॥ दिव्यं तं रथमास्थाय दिवमेवोत्पपात ह।
en: And being commanded by Rāghava Mātali, the charioteer of Sakra taking the celestial car, rose up in the welkin.

sn: तस्मिंस्तु दिवमारूढे सरथे रथिनां वरः॥ राघवः परमप्रीतः सुग्रीवं परिषस्वजे।
en: That charioteer rising up into the celestial region, Rāghava, the foremost of car-warriors, greatly delighted, embraced Sugrīva.

sn: परिष्वज्य च सुग्रीवं लक्ष्मणेनाभिवादितः॥ पूज्यमानो हरिगणैराजगाम बलालयम्।
en: Embracing Sugrīva, bowed to by Lakşmaņa and worshipped by the monkey he repaired to the camp of his soldiers.

sn: अथोवाच स काकुत्स्थः समीपपरिवर्तिनम्॥ सौमित्रिं मित्रसंपन्नं लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम्। विभीषणमिमं सौम्य लङ्कायामभिषेचय॥ अनुरक्तं च भक्तं च तथा पूर्वोपकारिणम्।
en: Thereupon Kakuthsha spoke to Lakşmaņa-the son of Sumitrā gifted with auspicious marks who was near him, "O gentle one, take this Vibhīşaņa to the city of Lankä ever devoted and attached to us, and who had done us good.

sn: एष मे परमः कामो यदिम रावणानुजम्॥ लङ्कायां सौम्य पश्येयमभिषिक्तं विभीषणम्।
en: This is my great desire that I may behold Vibhīşaņa the younger brother of Rāvana installed on the throne of Lankā.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु सौमित्री राघवेण महात्मना॥ तथेत्युक्त्वा सुसंहृष्टः सौवर्णं घटमाददे। तं घटं वानरेन्द्राणां हस्ते दत्त्वा मनोजवान्॥ व्यादिदेश महासत्त्वः समुद्रसलिलं तदा।
en: Being thus addressed by the high-souled Raghava, the son of Sumitra, saying, “So be it" and greatly delighted, brought a golden jar. And placing that jar at the hands of the lord of monkeys, that one, gifted with great energy, ordered them to bring water from the Ocean.

sn: अतिशीघ्रं ततो गत्वा वानरास्ते मनोजवाः॥ आगतास्तु जलं गृह्य समुद्राद्वानरोत्तमाः।
en: And repairing speedily those excellent monkeys came back with water from the ocean.

sn: ततस्त्वेकं घटं गृह्य संस्थाप्य परमासने॥ घटेन तेन सौमित्रिरभ्यषिञ्चद्विभीषणम्। लङ्कायां रक्षसां मध्ये राजानं रामशासनात्॥ विधिना मन्त्रदृष्टेन सुहृद्गणसमावृतः। अभ्यषिञ्चस्तदा सर्वे राक्षसा वानरास्तथा॥
en: Taking that jar and placing him on an excellent seat Saumitri with that water sprinkled Vibhīşaņa as king of Lankā in the presence of all the Raksasas, at Rama' command. And (Laks maņa) encircled by friends sprinkling him according to rites laid down in the Vedas, all the Rākşasas, devoted to him, his counsellors and the monkeys attaining incomparable delight, sang the glory of Rāma.

sn: प्रहर्षमतुलं गत्वा तुष्टुवू राममेव हि। तस्यामात्या जहृषिरे भक्ता ये चास्य राक्षसाः॥ दृष्ट्वाभिषिक्तं लङ्कायां राक्षसेन्द्रं विभीषणम्। राघवः परमां प्रीतिं जगाम सहलक्ष्मणः॥
en: Beholding Vibhīşaņa the lord of Rākşasas installed in the city of Lankä, Räghava along with Lakşmaņa attained to an excess of delight.

sn: सान्त्वयित्वा प्रकृतयस्ततो राममुपागमत्। दध्यक्षतान्मोदकांश्च लाजाः सुमनसस्तथा॥
en: And consoling his subjects he went to Rāma. And the monkey citizens, delighted, brought him curd, fried grain, sweetmeats, fried paddy and flowers.

sn: आजहुरथ संहृष्टाः पौरास्तस्मै निशाचराः। स तान्गृहीत्वा दुर्धर्षो राधवाय न्येवदयत्॥
en: Taking all those things indicating auspiciousness, he, irrepressible and gifted with energy, conferred them upon Råghava and Lakşmaņa.

sn: माङ्गल्यं मङ्गलं सर्वं लक्ष्मणाय च वीर्यवान्। कृतकाय समृद्धार्थ दृष्ट्वा रामो विभीषणम्।। प्रतिजग्राह तत्सर्वं तस्यैव प्रतिकाम्यया॥
en: Beholding Vibhīşaņa crowned with prosperity and success, Rāma accepted them all for his satisfaction.

sn: ततः शैलोपमं वीरं प्राञ्जलिं प्रणतं स्थितम्। उवाचेदं वचो रामो हनूमन्तं प्लवङ्गमम्॥
en: Thereupon Rāma spoke to the heroic monkey Hanumān, resembling a mountain and standing before him humbly with folded hands saying.

sn: अनुज्ञाप्य महाराजमिमं सौम्य विभीषणम्। प्रविश्य नगरी लङ्कां कौशलं ब्रूहि मैथिलीम्॥
en: O gentle on obtaining permission from the king Bibhshana, do you enter the city of Lankā and enquire after Maithili's welfare.

sn: वेदेह्यां मां च कुशलं सुग्रीवं च सलक्ष्मणम्। आचक्ष्व वदतां श्रेष्ठ रावणं च हतं रणे॥ प्रियमेतदिहाख्याहि वैदेह्यास्त्वं हरीश्वर। प्रतिगृह्य तु संदेशमुपावर्तितुमर्हसि ॥
en: Do you, O foremost of monkeys, inform Vaidehr of the destruction of Rāvana in conflict after communicating to her mine health as well as that of Lakşmaņa and Sugrīva. O lord of monkeys, it behove you to return with the tidings of Vaidehi after informing her of this pleasant news.

sn: इति प्रतिसमादिष्टो हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां पूज्यमानो निशाचरैः॥
en: Being thus commanded, Hanumān, the son of Maruta, worshipped of the night-rangers, entered the city of Lanka.

sn: प्रविश्य च पुरीं लङ्कामनुज्ञाप्य विभीषणम्। ततस्तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातो हनूमान्वृक्षवाटिकाम्॥
en: Entering the city with Vibhișana'a permission, Hanumān, again permitted, entered the vşkşa Vatika.* *A garden in the city of Lankā.

sn: संप्रविश्य यथान्यायं सीताया विदितो हरिः। ददर्श मृजया हीनां सातङ्कां रोहिणीमिव॥ वृक्षमूले निरानन्दा राक्षसीभिः परीवृताम्। निभृतः प्रणतः प्रह्वः सोऽभिगम्याभिवाद्य च॥
en: Entering there duly, the monkey, who was already known to Sītā, espied her, having her person not cleaned, like Rohiņi oppressed by Rāhu, sitting at the foot of a tree, devoid of joy and encircled by she-demons. And approaching her and bowing to her, he stood there humbly and unmoved.

sn: दृष्ट्वा समागतं देवी हनूमन्तं महाबलम्। तूष्णीमास्त तदा दृष्ट्वा स्मृत्वा हृष्टाभवत्तदा ॥
en: Beholding the highly powerful Hanuman arrived there the worshipful dame stood silent for sometime and then recognising him became greatly delighted.

sn: सौम्यं तस्या मुखं दृष्ट्वा हनूमान्प्लवगोत्तमः। रामस्य वचनं सर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: And beholding her gentle countenance, Hanumān, the best of monkeys, began to relate to her what Räma had said.

sn: वैदेहि कुशली रामः सुग्रीवः सहलक्ष्मणः। कुशलं त्वाह सिद्धार्थो हतशत्रु मित्रजित्॥
en: O Vaidehī, it is all well with Rāma Sugrīva and Lakşmaņa. He has enquire after your welfare.

sn: विभीषणसहायेन रामेण हरिभिः सह । निहतो रावणो देवी लक्ष्मणेन च वीर्यवान्॥
en: He has accomplished his end subdving his enemies and his enemy is slain. O worshipful dame, the powerful Răvaņa has been slain by Rāma, helped by Vibhīşaņa and accompanied by the monkeys and Lakşmaņa.

sn: प्रियमाख्यामि ते देवि भूयश्च त्वां सभाजये। तव प्रभावाद्धर्मज्ञे महानरामेण संयुगे॥ लब्धोऽयं विजयः सीते स्वस्था भव गतज्वरा। रावणश्च हतः शत्रुर्लङ्का चैव वशीकृता॥
en: I do relate to you this pleasant news, O worshipped dame; I do again delight you; it is by your grace, O you conversant with piety, O Sītā, victory has been gained, Do you be consoled and relieved of your anxiety. The enemy Rāvana has been slain and the city of Larikā has been brought under submission.

sn: मया ह्यलब्धनिद्रेण धृतेन तव निर्जये। प्रतिज्ञैषा विनिस्तीर्णा बद्ध्वा सेतुं महोदधौ॥
en: (Rāma said), "For discomfiting your enemy a bridge was constructed over the sea by me who was determined and who didnot sleep (for days) and thus my promise has been fulfilled.

sn: संभ्रमश्च न कर्तव्यो वर्तन्त्या रावणालये। विभीषणविधेयं हि लकैचर्यमिदं कृतम्॥ तदाश्वसिहि विस्रब्धं स्वगृहे परिवर्तसे। अयं चाभ्येति संहृष्टस्त्वदर्शनसमुत्सुकः॥
en: Do you not be afraid for living in Rāvana's abode for I have placed at Vibhīşana's hands the sovereignty of Lanka. Do you be consoled thinking as if that you are living in your own house. To behold you, Vibhisana, delighted, shall soon proceed.

sn: एवमुक्ता तु सा देवी सीता शशिनिभानना। प्रहर्षेणावरुद्धा सा व्याहतुं न शशाक ह॥
en: Being thus accosted the worshipful Sītā, having a moon-like countenance, and her voice choked in delight, could not utter any thing.

sn: ततोऽब्रवीद्धरिवरः सीतामप्रतिजल्पतीम्। किं त्वं चिन्तयसे देवि किं च मां नाभिभाषसे॥
en: Beholding Sītā incapable of replying the foremost of monkeys said, “What are you thinking of O worshipful dame? Why are you not welcoming me?"

sn: एवमुक्ता हेनुमता सीता धर्मपथे स्थिता। अब्रवीत्परमप्रीता बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा ॥
en: Being thus addressed by Hanuman Sītā, ever treading the paths of monkey, greatly delighted, replied with words suppressed by tears.

sn: प्रियमेतदुपश्रुत्य भर्तुर्विजयसंश्रितम्। प्रहर्षवशमापन्ना निर्वाक्यास्मि क्षणान्तरम्॥
en: Hearing this pleasant new concerning the victory of my husband-and being brought under the control of joy I am speechless for sometime.

sn: नहि पश्यामि सदृशं चिन्तयन्ती प्लवंगम। आख्यानकस्य भवतो दातुं प्रत्यभिनन्दनम्॥
en: O monkey I do not perceive any such thing which I can confer upon you in return, for this pleasant news.

sn: न च पश्यामि सदृशं पृथिव्यां तव किंचन। सदृशं यत्प्रियाख्याने तव दत्त्वा भवेत्सुखम्॥
en: I do see any such thing on this earth which can match your pleasant tidings and bestowing which upon you I may be happy.

sn: हिरण्यं वा सुवर्णं वा रत्नांनि विविधानि च। राज्यं वा त्रिषु लोकेषु एतन्नार्हसि भाषितम्॥
en: Silver, gold, or diverse jewels or the kingdom of the three worlds-nothing is a becoming return for your speech.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या प्रत्युवाच प्लवंगमः। प्रगृहीताञ्जलिहर्षात्सीतायाः प्रमुखे स्थितः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Vaidehi the monkeys replied-folding his hands with delight and stationed before Sītā.

sn: भर्तुः प्रियहिते युक्ते भर्तुर्विजयकाङ्क्षिणि। स्निग्धमेवंविधं वाक्यं त्वमेवार्हस्यनिन्दिते॥ तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मैथिली जनकात्मजा। ततः शुभतरं वाक्यमुवाच पवनात्मजम्॥
en: O blameless damsel forsooth this excellent speech become you, who is ever engaged in the welfare of your husband and ever desirous of his victory. I do consider, O worshipful dame, these words of your, far greater than the wealth, jewels or even the sovereignty over the celestials. Forsooth I have gained the kingdom of the celestials and other things since I have beheld Rāma, slay his enemy. victorious and peaceful. Hearing those words of (Hanuman) Maithili the daughter of king Janaka spoke to the Wind-god's son far more excellent words.

sn: अतिलक्षणसंपन्नं माधुर्यगुणभूषणम्। बुद्ध्या ह्यष्टाङ्गया युक्तं त्वमेवार्हसि भाषितुम्॥ श्लाघनीयोऽनिलस्य त्वं सुतः परमधार्मिकः। बलं शौर्य श्रुतं सत्त्वं विक्रमो दाक्ष्यमुत्तमम्॥ तेजः क्षमा धृतिः स्थैर्य विनीतत्वं न संशयः। एते चान्ये च बहवो गुणास्त्वय्येव शोभनाः॥ अथोवाच पुनः सीतामसंभ्रान्तो विनीतवत्। प्रगृहीताञ्जलिर्हर्षात्सीतायाः प्रमुखे स्थितः॥
en: You are capable of speaking words, chaste, pleasant and significant of eight sorts of knowledge. You see the praiseworthy son of the Wind-god and greatly virtuous; strength, mindedness, energy, forgiveness, patience, endurance, humility and many other excellent qualities crown you. Thereupon not being elated the least he again humbly folding his hands with delight and stationed before Sītā, said.

sn: इमास्तु खलु राक्षस्यो यदि त्वमनुमन्यसे। हन्तुमिच्छामि ताः सर्वा याभिस्त्वं तर्जिता पुरा॥ क्लिश्यन्ती पतिदेवां त्वामशोकविनकां गताम्। घोररूपसमाचाराः क्रूराः क्रूरतरेक्षणाः॥ इह श्रुता मया देवि राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः। असकृत्परुषैर्वाक्यैर्वदन्त्यो रावणाज्ञया॥
en: If did you permit me I may say all these shedemons who had tortured you before, distressed you in the forest of Asoka, stricken with grief of your lord, and who are cruel, have grim eyes and who perpetrate always dreadful deeds. worshipful dame, I have heard that these grimvisaged she demons distressed you greatly with harsh words at the command of Rāvaņa.

sn: विकृता विकृताकाराः क्रूराः क्रूरकचेक्षणाः। इच्छामि विविधैर्घातैर्हन्तुमेताः सुदारुणाः॥
en: I desire to slay all these dreadful crooked, ugly she-demons having fearful eyes, meting out to them various punishment.

sn: राक्षस्यो दारुणकथा वरमेतत्प्रयच्छ मे। मुष्टिभिः पाणिघातैश्च विशालैश्चैव बाहुभिः॥ जङ्घाजानुप्रहारैश्च दन्तानां चैव पीडनैः। भक्षणैः कर्णनासानां केशानां लुञ्चनैस्तथा॥ निपात्य हन्तुमिच्छामि तव विप्रियकारिणीः। एवं प्रहारैर्बहुभिः संप्रहार्य यशस्विनी॥ घातये तीव्ररूपाभिर्याभिस्त्वं तर्जिता पुरा।
en: I wish to slay all these she-demons, who had used harsh words and had always offended you, stricking them with fists, fingers, arms, dreadful knee-joints, teeth, chopping off their ears and noses, and pulling them by their hairs; do you confer upon me this permission. O far famed lady, I shall slay them by these various means, by whom dreadful as they are, you had been distressed before.

sn: इत्युक्ता सा हनुमता कृपणा दीनवत्सला॥ हनूमन्तमुवाचेदं चिन्तयित्वा विमृश्य च।
en: Being thus addressed by Hanumăn, she, ever kind to the poor, thinking and meditating, said to him.

sn: राजसंश्रयवश्यानां कुर्वतीनां पराज्ञया॥ विधेयानां च दासीनां कः कुप्येद्वानरोत्तम। भाग्यवैषम्यदोषेण पुरस्ताद्दुष्कृतेन च ॥ मयैतत्प्राप्यते सर्व स्वकृतं ह्युपभुज्यते मैवं वद महाबाहो दैवी ह्येषा परा गतिः॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, why are you angry with these she-slaves, who subject as they are to the command of their lord, have done this in accordance with another's order. I or my adverse fortune and vicious deeds perpetrated in another birth I have been subject to such a plight and been suffering the consequence thereof. Do yon not speak thus, O you of huge arms. Such is the course of Fortune. Forsooth by my ill-luck I have met with (this misfortune).

sn: प्राप्तव्यं तु दशायोगान्मयैतदिति निश्चितम्। दासीनां रावणस्याहं मर्षयामीह दुर्बला॥
en: I forgive, out of pity, all these she-servants of Rāvaņa; they used to torture me at the command of that Raksasa.

sn: आज्ञप्ता राक्षसेनेह राक्षस्यस्तर्जयन्ति माम्। हते तस्मिन्न कुर्वन्ति तर्जनं मारुतात्मज॥
en: And he being slain they shall not repress me any longer, O son of the Wind-god.

sn: अयं व्याघ्रसमीपे तु पुराणो धर्मसंहितः। ऋक्षेण गीतः श्लोकोऽस्ति तं निबोध प्लवंगम॥
en: Do you, O monkey, hear of a śloka, related in a Purana and pregnant with religious import, which was uttered by a boar to a tiger.

sn: न परः पापमादत्ते परेषां पापकर्मणाम्। समयो रक्षितव्यस्तु सन्तश्चारित्रभूषणाः।॥ पापानां वा शुभानां वा वधार्हाणामथापि वा। कार्य कारुण्यमार्येण न कश्चिन्त्रापराध्यति॥ लोकहिंसाविहाराणां क्रूराणां पापकर्मणाम्। कुर्वतामपि पापानि नैव कार्यमशोभनम् ॥
en: No one teke upon himself the iniquity of a perpetrator of vicious deeds. So it behove the pious crowned with an excellent character to observe the rules (of piety). “So it is proper to show compassion even upon these who perpetrate crimes and are worthy of being slain. Who is there who does not commit a crime? It is not proper to act cruelly even by them who take delight in killing men, although they commit various iniquitous deeds.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान्सीतया वाक्यकोविदः। प्रत्युवाच ततः सीतां रामपत्नीमनिन्दिताम्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Sītā, Hanumān, skilled in speech, spoke to the blameless Rama's spouse, saying.

sn: युक्ता रामस्य भवती धर्मपत्नी गुणान्विता। प्रतिसंदिश मां देवि गमिष्ये यत्र राघवः॥
en: You are the worthy spouse of Răma, religiously wedded and crowned with many qualities. Permit me, O worshipful dame, to proceed where Rāghava is.

sn: एवमुक्ता हनुमता वैदेही जनकात्मजा। साब्रवीद्रष्टुमिच्छामि भर्तारं भक्तवत्सलम्॥
en: Being thus accosted by Hanumān, Vaidehi, the daughter of king Janaka, said, “I wish to see my lord, ever fond of those who are devoted to him."

sn: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। हर्षयन्मैथिली वाक्यमुवाचेदं महामतिः॥
en: Hearing these words, the high-minded Hanumăn, the son of Maruta, pleasing Maithili said.

sn: पूर्णचन्द्रमुखं रामं द्रक्ष्यस्यद्य सलक्ष्मणम्। स्थितमित्रं हतामित्रं शचीवेन्द्रं सुरेश्वरम्॥
en: You shall behold Rama, having a countenance like the full moon, with Laksmana, surrounded by his friends and having his enemies slain as ſaci behold Indra the king of the celestials.

sn: तामेवमुक्त्वा भ्राजन्ती सीतां साक्षादिव श्रियम्। आजगाम महातेजा हनूमान्यत्र राघवः॥
en: Addressing these words to Sītă appearing like Sree herself the highly effulgent Hanuman returned where Rāghava was.

sn: सपदि हरिवरस्ततो हनूमान् प्रतिवचनं जनकेश्वरात्मजायाः। कथितमकथयद्यकथाक्रमेण त्रिदशवरप्रतिमाय राघवाय॥
en: Thereupon Hanumān, the foremost of monkeys, related duly all what did the daughter of king Janaka say to Räghava resembling the lord of the celestials.

sn: तमुवाच महाप्राज्ञः सोऽभिवाद्य प्लवंगमः। रामं कमलपत्राक्षं वरं सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥
en: Thereupon bowing to Rāma, the foremost of bowmen, having eyes, resembling lotus-petals, the highly wise monkey said.

sn: यन्निमित्तोऽयमारम्भः कर्मणां यः फलोदयः। तां देवीं शोकसंतप्तां द्रष्टुमर्हसि मैथिलीम्॥
en: It behove you now to see Maithili, stricken with grief for whom you did initiate all these works and the fruit whereof has now been attained.

sn: सा हि शोकसमाविष्टा बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा। मैथिली विजयं श्रुत्वा द्रष्टुं त्वामभिकाचति ॥
en: Hearing of your victory Maithilī, possessed by grief and having eyes full of tears, expressed her desire to see you.

sn: पूर्वकात्प्रत्ययाच्चाहमुक्तो विश्वस्तया तया। द्रष्टमिच्छामि भर्तारमिति पर्याकुलेक्षणा॥
en: I was told by her, confident of her previous trust, with profuse tears in her eyes, “I wish to see my husband."

sn: एवमुक्तो हनुमता रामो धर्मभृतां वरः। आगच्छत्सहसा ध्यानमीषद्वाष्पपरिप्लुतः।।।।। स दीर्घमभिनिःश्वस्य जगतीमवलोकयन्। उवाच मेघसंकाशं विभीषणमुपस्थितम्॥
en: Being addressed by Hanuman Rāma the foremost of the pious being bathed in tears, engaged instantly in meditation. Thereupon sighing hard and casting his looks upon the ground he spoke to Vibhīşaņa resembling clouds, who was near him.

sn: दिव्याङ्गरागां वैदेहीं दिव्याभरणभूषिताम्। इह सीतां शिरः स्नातामुपस्थापय मा चिरम्॥
en: Do you speedily bring Sītā here-the daughter of the king of Mithila-bathed, sprinkled with celestial pasted and adorned with celestial ornaments.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण त्वरमाणो विभीषणः। प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं सीतां स्त्रीभिः स्वाभिरचोदयत्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, Vibhişaņa hastened on and entering the inner apartment sent information to Sītă through the female attendants.

sn: ततः सीतां महाभागां दृष्ट्वोवाच विभीषणः। मूर्ध्नि बद्धाञ्जलिः श्रीमान्विनीतो राक्षसेश्वरः।।।।
en: Beholding the great Sītā, the graceful lord of Rākşasas-Vibhīşaņa humbly and placing his joined palms on his crown, said.

sn: दिव्याङ्गरागा वैदेहि दिव्याभरणभूषिता। यानमारोह भद्रं ते भर्ता त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति॥
en: O Vaidehi, may good betide you; sprinkled with celestial paste and adorned with celestials ornaments do you ascend this car: your husband wish to see you.

sn: एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम्। अस्नात्वा द्रष्टुमिच्छामि भर्तारं राक्षसेश्वर॥
en: Being thus addressed Vaidehi replied to Vibhisana, “O lord of Raksasas, without bathing even I wish to see my husband."

sn: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः। यथाह रामो भर्ता ते तत्तथा कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: Hearing those words VibhIşaņa replied, "It behove you to do what your lord Rama has said." on a

sn: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मैथिली पतिदेवता। भर्तृभक्त्या वृता साध्वी तथेति प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Whereto the chaste maithilee, regarding her husband as God and filled with devotion to her husband, replied saying "so be it."

sn: ततः सीतां शिरःस्नातां संयुक्तां प्रतिकर्मणा। महाभिरणोपेतां महार्हाम्बरधारिणीम्॥ आरोग्य शिबिकां सीतां राक्षसैर्वहनोचितैः। राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्गुप्तामाजहार विभीषणः॥
en: Thereupon placing Sta, bathed, performing the due rites wearing valuable clothes and adorned with valuable ornaments, palanquin, carried by many a capable Rākşasa, brought her (to Rama).

sn: सोऽभिगम्य महात्मानं ज्ञात्वापि ध्यानमास्थितम्। प्रणतश्च प्रहृष्टश्च प्राप्तां सीतां न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Thereupon approaching the high-souled Rama, who, bearing informed of (Vibhisana's approach) was engaged in meditation, Vibhīşaņa bowing down and delighted communicated to him the arrival of Sită.

sn: तामागतामुपश्रुत्य रक्षोगृहचिरोषिताम्। रोषं हर्ष च दैन्यं च राघवः प्राप शत्रुहा॥
en: Hearing of her arrival who had lived long in the abode of the Raksasas Rāghava, the slayer of enemies attained (simultaneously) to anger, delight and depression.

sn: ततो यानगतां सीतां सविमर्श विचारयन्। विभीषणमिदं वाक्यमहष्टो राघवोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Considering Sīta who was in the palanquin, over whelmed with grief, Raghava delighted addressed Vibhīşaņa with the following words.

sn: राक्षसाधिपते सौम्य नित्यं मद्विजये रत। वैदेही संनिकर्ष मे क्षिप्रं समभिगच्छतु॥
en: O lord of Rakşasas, O gentle (king) O you ever engaged in encompassing my success, do you speedily bring Vaidehī nearer to me.

sn: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्य विभीषणः। तूर्णमुत्सारणं तत्र कारयामास धर्मवित्॥
en: Hearing these words of Raghava, Vibhīşaña, conversant with piety speedily cleared (the people out of that place).

sn: कञ्चकोष्णीषिणस्तत्र वेत्रझर्झरपाणयः। उत्सारयन्तस्तान्योधासमन्तात्परिचक्रमुः॥
en: Attendants with armours and head-dresses on and with cane and drums in their hands began to move about driving away the crowed thereform.

sn: ऋक्षाणां वानराणां च राक्षसानां च सर्वशः। वृन्दान्युत्सार्यमाणानि दूरमुत्तस्थुरन्ततः॥
en: The crowds of bears, monkeys and Rākṣasas being driven on all sides began to fly at a distance.

sn: तेषामुत्सार्यमाणानां निःस्वनः सुमहानभूत्। वायुनोभूयमानस्य सागरस्येव निःस्वनः॥
en: They being thus driven there arose a huge noise resembling that of the ocean when agitated by the wind.

sn: उत्सार्यमाणान्दृष्ट्वाऽथ जगत्यां जातसंभ्रमान्। दाक्षिण्यात्तदमर्षाच्च वारयामास राघवः॥
en: Beholding the monkeys driven on all sides and troubled Rāghava out of anger and compassion prevented him.

sn: संरम्भाच्चाब्रवीद्रामश्चक्षुषा प्रदहनिव। विभीषणं महाप्राज्ञं सोपालम्भमिदं वचः॥
en: Thereupon as if burning (ever thing) with his angry eyes Rāma addressed the highly intelligent Vibhīşaņa with the following angry words.

sn: किमर्थं मामनादृत्य क्लिश्यतेऽयं त्वया जनः। निवर्तयैनमुद्वेगं जनोऽयं स्वजनो मम॥
en: Why did you insult' me by destroying all these? Do you remove their anxiety-they are all my own men.

sn: न गृहाणि न वस्त्राणि न प्राकारस्तिरस्क्रिया। नेदृशा राजसत्कारा वृत्तमावरणं स्त्रियाः॥
en: Neither the houses, clothes, walls nor reception like these are the veils of women.

sn: व्यसनेषु न कृच्छ्रेषु न युद्धेषु स्वयंवरे। न क्रतौ नो विवाहे वा दर्शनं दूष्यते स्त्रियाः॥
en: There is no sin consequent uponi seeing women in danger, difficulty, war, Svayamvara* sacrifice and marriage. *It is a form of marriage in which the bride selects a bridegroom foe herself.

sn: सैषा विपद्गता चैव कृच्छ्रेण च समन्विता। दर्शने नास्ति दोषोऽस्या मत्समीपे विशेषतः॥ ।
en: She is now in great danger and difficultythere is no sin in seeing her specially in my presence.

sn: विसृज्य शिबिकां तस्मात्पद्व्यामेवापसर्पतु। समीपे मम वैदेहीं पश्यन्त्वेते वनौकसः॥
en: Therefore leaving behind the palanquin let her come here on foot and let the monkeys behold Vaidehī in my presence.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण सविमर्शो विभीषणः। रामस्योपानयत्सीतां संनिकर्ष विनीतवत्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, Vibhīşaņa, being sorry, humbly brought Sītă near him.

sn: ततो लक्ष्मणसुग्रीवौ हनूमांश्च प्लवंगमः। निशम्य वाक्यं रामस्य बभुवुर्व्यथिता भृशम्॥
en: There upon hearing Rāma's accents Lakşmaņa, Sugrīva and the monkey Hanuman were greatly sorry.

sn: लज्जया त्ववलीयन्ती स्वेषु गात्रेषु मैथिली। विभीषणेनानुगता भर्तारं साभ्यवर्तत॥
en: As if hiding herself in her own person in shame Maithili, following Vibhisana, approached her husband.

sn: विस्मयाच्च प्रहर्षाच्च स्नेहाच्च पतिदेवता। उदैक्षत मुखं भर्तुः सौम्यं सौम्यतरानना॥
en: She, having a gentle countenance and always regarding her husband as her god, fixed her looks upon her lord's face out of surprise, joy and love.

sn: अथ समपनुदन्मन:क्लमं सा सुचिरामदृष्टमुदीक्ष्य वै प्रियस्य। वदनमुदितपूर्णचन्द्रकान्तं विमलशशाङ्कनिभानना तदासीत्॥
en: Beholding the gentle countenance of her dearest lord, resembling the full moon the removed her mental distress. Thereupon she appeared (beautiful) having the countenance of the clear moon.

sn: तां तु पार्श्वे स्थितां प्रह्वां रामः संमेक्ष्य मैथिलीम्। हृदयान्तर्गतं भावं व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Beholding Maithili standing humbly by him, Räma began to give vent to his pent-up feelings.

sn: एषासि निर्जिता भद्रे शत्रु जित्वा रणाजिरे। पौरुषात् यदनुष्ठेयं मयैतदुपपादितम्॥
en: O gentle one, destroying all the enemies in the arena of battle I have subdued your enemy-I have done all that can be accomplished by manliness.

sn: गतोऽस्म्यन्तममर्षस्य धर्षणा संप्रमार्जिता। अवमानश्च शत्रुश्च युगपत्रिहतौ मया॥
en: I have reached the other end of my anger, rubbed off (the insult) for my spouse being taken away by the enemy and have killed simultaneously my disgrace and enemy.

sn: अद्य मे पौरुषं दृष्टमद्य मे सफलः श्रमः। अद्य तीर्णप्रतिज्ञोऽहं प्रभवाम्यद्य चात्मनः॥
en: My manliness has been displayed today, my laboúr has been crowned with success and today I have fulfilled my promise by my own prowess.

sn: या त्वं विरहिता नीता चलचित्तेन रक्षसा। दैवसंपादितो दोषो मानुषेण मया जितः॥
en: That accidental misfortune, under the influence where of you were carried away by the fickle-minded Räksasa in my absence, has been subdued today by me, a man.

sn: संप्राप्तमवमानं यस्तेजसा न प्रमार्जति। कस्तस्य पौरुषेणार्थो महताप्यल्पचेतसः॥
en: What is the use of his manliness, who when insulted, cannot remove it? Even if he be a great man he may be called mean.

sn: लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्य लङ्कायाश्चापि मर्दनम्। सफलं तस्य च श्लाघ्यमद्य कर्म हनूमतः॥
en: The praise-worthy works of Hanumān-the crossing of the deep and the devastation of Lankā, have been crowned with success today.

sn: युद्धे विक्रमतश्चैव हितं मन्त्रयतस्तया। सुग्रीवस्य ससैन्यस्य सफलोऽद्य परिश्रमः॥
en: The labour of Sugrīva with his army, who displayed valour in the encounter and gave me good counsels, has borne fruit today.

sn: विभीषणस्य च तथा सफलोऽद्य परिश्रमः। विगुणं भ्रातरं त्यक्त्वा यो मां स्वयमुपस्थितः।।।।
en: Today also the labour of Vibhişaņa has borne fruit-who renouncing his brother, devoid of all good Qualities, came to my side.

sn: इत्येवं वदतः श्रुत्वा सीता रामस्य तद्वचः। मृगीवोत्फुल्लनयना बभूवाश्रुपरिप्लुता ॥
en: Hearing those words of Rāma, Sītā began to look wistfully like a hind, with eyes full of tears.

sn: पश्यतस्तां तु रामस्य समीपे हृदयप्रियाम्। जनवादभयाद्राज्ञो बभूव हृदयं द्विधा ॥
en: Beholding his beloved spouse near him and afraid of popular ignominy his heart was broken into two.

sn: सीतामुत्पलपत्राक्षी नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजाम्। अवदद्वै वरारोहां मध्ये वानररक्षसाम्॥
en: Thereupon he spoke to the exquisitely beautiful Sītā, in the midst of the monkeys and Räkşasas, having eyes resembling lotus petals and black and curling hairs, saying.

sn: यत्कर्तव्यं मनुष्येण धर्षणां प्रतिमार्जता। तत्कृतं रावणं हत्वा मयेदं मानकाङ्क्षिणा॥ निर्जिता जीवलोकस्य तपसा भावितात्मना। अगस्त्येन दुराधर्षा मुनिना दक्षिणेव दिक् ॥
en: As the southern quarter, incapable of being got at by the people, was conquered by the selfcontrolled great ascetic Agasty, so for you slaying Ravana, I (always) anxious to have honour, have removed my insult-as is the duty of a man.

sn: विदितश्चास्तु भद्रं ते योऽयं रणपरिश्रमः। सुतीर्णः सुहृदां वीर्यान्न त्वदर्थं मया कृतः॥
en: May good betide you-do you know that all my labour in the battle-field, backed by the prowess of my friends, is for you.

sn: रक्षता तु मया वृत्तमपवादं च सर्वतः। प्रख्यातस्यात्मवंशस्य न्यङ्गं च परिमार्जता॥
en: To uphold the dignity of my well-known family, to remove the ignominy consequent upon your being stolen away as well as to wipe off my own insult I have encompassed this.

sn: प्राप्तचारित्रसंदेहा मम प्रतिमुखे स्थिता। दीपो नेत्रातुरस्येव प्रतिकूलासि मे दृढा ॥
en: I have suspected your character; you, (Therefore) standing before me, are distressing me like to a lamp before one who is subject to an eye-desease.

sn: तद्गच्छ त्वानुजानेऽद्य यथेष्टं जनकात्मजे। एता दश दिशो भद्रे कार्यमस्ति न मे त्वया॥
en: Do you therefore proceed, O daughter of king Janaka, wherever you like to one of these ten quarters. I permit you, O gentle one. I have nothing to do with you.

sn: कः पुमांस्तु कुले जातः स्त्रियं परगृहोषिताम्। तेजस्वी पुनरादद्यात्सुहृल्लोभेन चेतसा ॥
en: What powerful man, born in a high family, take back his wife considering her as friend out of lust, who has lived long in another's house?

sn: रावणाङ्कपरिक्लिष्टां दृष्टां दुष्टेन चक्षुषा। कथं त्वां पुनरादद्यां कुलं व्यपदिशन्महत्॥
en: You were taken by Rāvana on his lap, beheld by him with sinful eyes; how can I, taking you back, bring disgrace upon my great family?

sn: यदर्थ निर्जिता मे त्वं सोऽयमासादितो मया। नास्ति मे त्वय्यभिष्वङ्गो यथेष्टं गम्यतामिति ॥
en: The object, with which I have gained you back, has been accomplished. I have got no attachment for you-do you go wherever you wish, O gentle one.

sn: तदद्य व्याहृतं भद्रे मयैतत्कृतबुद्धिना। लक्ष्मणे वाथ भरते कुरु बुद्धिं यथासुखम्॥ शत्रुघ्ने वाथ सुग्रीवे राक्षसे वा विभीषणे। निवेशय मनः सीते यथा वा सुखमात्मना॥
en: I speak these to you impelled by my sense of duty. If you wish you may live with Laksmana, Bharatga or Satrughna or with Sugrīva or Räkş asa Vibhisana. Do you settle, O Sita, where you may find your own pleasure.

sn: नहि त्वां रावणो दृष्ट्वा दिव्यरूपां मनोरमाम्। मर्षयत्यचिरं सीते स्वगृहे पर्यवस्थिताम्॥
en: O Sita, (I do not think) Ravana has overlooked you, who lived in his house, beholding you so graceful and beautiful.

sn: ततः प्रियाहश्रवणा तदप्रियं प्रियादुपश्रुत्य चिरस्य मानिनी। मुमोच बाष्पं रुदती तदा भृशं गजेन्द्रहस्ताभिहतेव वल्लरी॥
en: Thereupon hearing those unpleasant words from her beloved (husband) Sītā, always sensitive and who had never heard such unpleasant words, trembling like a creeper torn by the trunk of an elephant, began to weep shedding tears profusely.

sn: एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही परुषं रोमहर्षणम्। राघवेण सरोषेण श्रुत्वा प्रव्यथिताभवत्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāghava, enraged, with those harsh words Sīta was greatly pained.

sn: सा तदाश्रुतपूर्वं हि जने महति मैथिली। श्रुत्वा भर्तुर्वचो घोरं लज्जयावनताभवत्॥
en: Hearing those words of her lord, unheard of, before the great assembly Maithili was greatly humiliated with shame.

sn: प्रविशन्तीव गात्राणि स्वानि सा जनकात्मजा। वाक्शरैस्तैः सशल्येव भृशमश्रूण्यवर्तयत्॥
en: As if entering to her own person (with shame) and greatly pained with these arrow like words the daughter of king Janaka began to shed tears.

sn: ततो बाष्पपरिक्लिनं प्रमार्जन्ती स्वमाननम्। शनैर्गद्गदया वाचा भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon wiping the tears off her countenance, she with sorrowful words, addressed her husband.

sn: किं मामसदृशं वाक्यमीदृशं श्रोत्रदारुणम्। रुक्षं श्रावयसे वीर प्राकृतः प्राकृतामिव ॥
en: Why did you, O hero, like a common man addressing an ordinary woman, make me hear these, harsh and unbecoming words painful to ears?

sn: न तथास्मि महाबाहो यथा मामवगच्छसि। प्रत्ययं गच्छ मे स्वेन चारित्रेणैव ते शपे॥
en: O you of long arms, I am not what you have taken me to be. Do you believe me-I do swear by my own character.

sn: पृथक्स्त्रीणां प्रचारेण जाति त्वं परिशङ्कसे। परित्यजैनां शङ्कां तु यदि तेऽहं परीक्षिता॥
en: Seeing the ordinary women you are distrusting the whole sex. Do you renounce this suspicion since you have tried me.

sn: यदहं गात्रसंस्पर्श गतास्मि विवशा प्रभो। कामकारो न मे तत्र दैवं तत्रापराध्यति॥
en: O lord, though my person was touched by another-but it was not in my power; nor was it an wilful act (of mine); accident is to blame in this.

sn: मदधीनं तु यत्तन्मे हृदयं त्वयि वर्तते। पराधीनेषु गात्रेषु किं करिष्याम्यनीश्वरी॥
en: My heart is under my control and that is in you;-and what could I do of my body which was subject to another and of which I was not the mistress.

sn: सह संवृद्धभावेन संसर्गेण च मानद। यदि तेऽहं न विज्ञाता हता तेनास्मि शाश्वतम्॥
en: O you the conferrer of honour-our affection towards one another was increased by our living continually for a long time; even then if you have not been able to understand me I am ruined for ever.

sn: प्रेषितस्ते महावीरो हनुमानवलोककः। लङ्कास्थाहं त्वया राजन्कि तदा न विसर्जिता॥
en: O king, when the great hero Hanumān was despatched by you of Lankā to see me why did you not renounce me then?

sn: प्रत्यक्षं वानरस्यास्य तद्वाक्यसमनन्तरम्। त्वया संत्यक्तया वीर त्यक्तं स्याज्जीवितं मया॥
en: Had you deputed the monkey with that message I would have renounced my life there and then, O hero.

sn: न वृथा ते श्रमोऽयं स्यात्संशये न्यस्य जीवितम्। सुहृज्जनपरिक्लेशो न चायं विफलस्तव॥
en: You would not have been required to undergo this toil at the risk of your own life and giving unnecessary trouble to your friends.

sn: त्वया तु नृपशार्दूल रोषमेवानुवर्तता। लघुनेव मनुष्येण स्त्रीत्वमेव पुरस्कृतम्॥
en: O foremost of kings, being subject to ire-you did not perceive anything but womanhood in me, like an ordinary man.

sn: अपदेशो मे जनकानोत्पत्तिर्वसुधातलात्। मम वृत्तं च वृत्तज्ञ बहु तेन पुरस्कृतम्॥
en: Although I am known to have a father but in fact I am born of the earth. You did not sufficiently honour my character, O you conversant with character. are

sn: न प्रमाणीकृतः पाणिर्बाल्ये मम निपीडितः। मम भक्तिश्च शीलं च सर्वं ते पृष्ठतः कृतम्॥
en: Your marriage with me in boyhood shall be disproved and you not sufficiently considering all my devotion and good conduct to you.

sn: इति ब्रुवन्ती रुदती बाष्पगद्गदभाषिणी। उवाच लक्ष्मणं सीता दीनं ध्यानपरायणम्॥
en: Saying thus with accents choked in tears and weeping Sītā spoke to Lakşmaņa, poorly and engaged in meditation.

sn: चितां मे कुरु सौमित्रे व्यसनस्यास्य भेषजम्। मिथ्यापवादोपहता नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे॥
en: Make a funeral pyre for me, O Saumitri, that is the only remedy for this disaster. Being thus branded with an unfounded stigma I do not like to keep my life.

sn: अप्रीतेन गुणैर्भा त्यक्ताया जनसंसदि। या क्षमा मे गतिर्गन्तुं प्रवेक्ष्ये हव्यवाहनम्॥
en: To adopt the proper course for me who had been renounced before this assembly by my disaffected husband I shall enter this.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। अमर्षवशमापन्नो राघवं समुदैक्षत॥
en: Being thus addressed by Vaidehī, Lakşmaņa, the slayer of enemies, being possessed by anger, looked towards Rāghava.

sn: स विज्ञाय मनश्छन्दं रामस्याकारसूचितम्। चितां चकार सौमित्रिमते रामस्य वीर्यवान्॥
en: And understanding Rāmas intention by gestures and at his command the powerful Saumitri prepared a funeral pyre.

sn: नहि रामं तदा कश्चित्कालान्तकयमोपमम्। अनुनेतुमथो वक्तुं द्रष्टुं वाप्यशकत्सुहृत्॥
en: None dared there request, speak with or even look at Rāma like to Death, at the time of dissolution.

sn: अधोमुखं स्थितं रामं ततः कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम्। उपावर्तत वैदेही दीप्यमानं हुताशनम्॥
en: Thereupon circumambulating Rāma, standing with his head down, Vaidehi approached the burning fire.

sn: ददृशुस्तां त्रयो लोका देवगन्धर्वदानवाः। शप्तां पतन्ती निरये त्रिदिवाद्देवतामिव ॥
en: The three worlds-the celestials, Gandharvas and Dänavas saw her fallen like to a celestial from the heaven when imprecated.

sn: तस्यामग्नि विशन्त्यां तु हाहेति विपुलः स्वनः। रक्षसां वानराणां च संबभूवाद्भुतोपमः॥
en: She having entered the fire, lamentations, unheard of before, rose from all sides from the Rākşasas and monkeys.

sn: प्रणम्य दैवतेभ्यश्च ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च मैथिली। बद्धांजलिपुटा चेदमुवाचाग्निसमीपतः॥
en: Bowing to the celestials and Brāhmaṇas, Maithilī, with folded hands, spoke before the fire.

sn: यथा मे हृदयं नित्यं नापसर्पति राघवात्। तथा लोकस्य साक्षी मां सर्वतः पातु पावकः॥
en: As my heart has never gone away from Rāghava, may you protect me, O fire, the witness of the people.

sn: यथा मां शुद्धचारित्रां दुष्टां जानाति राघवः। तथा लोकस्य साक्षी मां सर्वतः पातु पावकः॥
en: As Rāghava consider me vile, who have got a pure character, may fire, the witness of the people, protect me on all sides.

sn: एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेही परिक्रम्य हुताशनम्। विवेश ज्वलनं दीप्तं निःशङ्केनान्तरात्मना॥
en: Saying this and going round the fire, Vaidehi, with undaunted heart, entered the flaming fire.

sn: जनश्च सुमहांस्तत्र बालवृद्धसमाकुलः। ददर्श मैथिली दीप्तां प्रविशन्तीं हुताशनम्॥
en: The great assembly there, young and old, overwhelmed with grief, saw Maithili enter the flaming fire.

sn: सा तप्तनवहेमाभा तप्तकांचनभूषणा। पपात ज्वलनं दीप्तं सर्वलोकस्य संनिधौ॥ ददृशुस्तां विशालाक्षीं पतन्ती हव्यवाहनम्। सीतां सर्वाणि रूपाणि रुकमवेदिनिभां तदा॥
en: And (Sītā) resembling the burning gold entered the flaming fire in the presence of all people. All beheld Sita, having expansive eyes, enter fire like to a golden altar.

sn: ददृशुस्तां महाभागां प्रविशन्तीं हुताशनम्। ऋषयो देवगन्धर्वा यज्ञे पूर्णाहुतीमिव ॥
en: The ascetics, celestials and Gandharvas saw that great damsel enter fire like to a full oblation in the sacrifice.

sn: प्रचुक्रुशुः स्त्रियः सर्वास्तां दृष्ट्वा हव्यवाहने। पतन्तीं संस्कृतां मन्त्रैर्वसोर्धारामिवाध्वरे॥
en: Beholding her fallen into the fire like to Vasudhārā, sanctified by Mantras in a sacrifice, all the females began to weep.

sn: ततो हि दुर्मना रामः श्रुत्वैव वदतां गिरः। दध्यौ मुहूर्त धर्मात्मा बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः॥
en: Hearing the lamentations (of the Rākşasas and monkeys) the virtuous-souled Rāma, with a poor heart and having his eyes full of tears, engaged in meditation for some time.

sn: ततो वैश्रवणो राजा यमश्च पितृभिः सह। सहस्राक्षश्च देवेशो वरुणश्च जलेश्वरः॥ षडर्धनयनः श्रीमान्महादेवो वृषध्वजः। कर्ता सर्वस्य लोकस्य ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः॥ एते सर्वे समागम्य विमानैः सूर्यसंनिभैः। आगम्य नगरी लङ्कामभिजग्मुश्च राघवम्॥
en: Thereupon the king Vaiśravaņa, Yama with his progenitors, the thousand-eyed lord of the celestials, Varuna, the lord of water, the threeeyed graceful Mahădeva-the rider of bull, Brahmă the creator of the world and the foremost of those conversant with the knowledge of Brahmā-all these arriving at the city of Lankă in their cars bright as the rays of the sun, approached Rāghava.

sn: ततः सहस्ताभरणान्प्रगृह्य विपुलान्भुजान्। अब्रुवंत्रिदशश्रेष्ठा राघवं प्राञ्जलिं स्थितम्॥
en: Thereupon raising up their huge hands, decked with various ornaments and folding them, those foremost of the celestials said to Raghava.

sn: कर्ता सर्वस्य लोकस्य श्रेष्ठो ज्ञानविदां विभुः। उपेक्षसे कथं सीतां पतन्ती हव्यवाहने।। कथं देवगणश्रेष्ठमात्मानं नावबुद्ध्यसे॥
en: O lord, you are the preserver of all the worlds and the foremost of the wise, why did you neglect Sītā entering into fire? Why did you not understand yourself the foremost of the celestials?

sn: ऋतधामा वसुः पूर्वं वसूनां च प्रजापतिः। त्रयाणामपि लोकानामादिकर्ता स्वयंप्रभुः॥
en: You were before the Patriarch of all Vasus, by the name of Rtadhāmā. And you are yourself, O lord, the creator of the three worlds. *A kind of demi-god of whom eight are enumerated.

sn: रुद्राणामष्टमो रुद्रः साध्यानामपि पञ्चमः। अश्विनौ चापि कौँ ते सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ दृशौ॥
en: You are the eighth of the Rudras and the fifth of the Sādhyas;-the Asvinis are your two ears and the sun and the moon are your eyes. 1. A demi-god-an inferior manifestation of Śiva: they are eleven in number. 2. An inferior deity or demi-god, one of a class of twelve.

sn: अन्ते चादौ च मध्ये च दृश्यसे च परंतप। उपेक्षसे च वैदेहीं मानुषः प्राकृतो यथा॥
en: O slayer of enemies, you appear at the beginning and the end of the creation. Why did you neglect Vaidehī like an ordinary man?

sn: इत्युक्तो लोकपालैस्तैः स्वामी लोकस्य राघवः। अब्रवीद् विदशश्रेष्ठानरामो धर्मभृतां वरः॥
en: Being thus addressed by the deities presiding over quarters, Rāghava, the lord of people and the foremost of the pious, spoke to those leading celestials, saying.

sn: आत्मानं मानुषं मन्ये रामं दशरथात्मजम्। सोऽहं यश्च यतश्चाहं भगवांस्तद् ब्रवीतु मे॥
en: I know myself to be man-Rama, the son of Dasaratha. Let the great Patriarch tell me, who I am and whence I have come.

sn: इति: ब्रुवाणां काकुत्स्थं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः। अब्रवीच्छृणु मे वाक्यं सत्यं सत्यपराक्रम॥ भवान्नारायणो देवः श्रीमांश्चक्रायुधः प्रभुः। एकशृङ्गो वराहस्त्वं भूतभव्यसपत्नजित्॥ अक्षरं ब्रह्म सत्यं च मध्ये चान्ते च राघव। लोकानां त्वं परो धर्मो विष्वक्सेनश्चतुर्भुजः॥ शार्ङ्गधन्वा हृषीकेशः पुरुषः पुरुषोत्तमः। अजितः खङ्गधृग्विष्णुः कृष्णश्चैव बृहद्बलः॥ सेनानीामणीः सर्वं त्वं बुद्धिस्त्वं क्षमा दमः। प्रभवश्चाप्ययश्च त्वमुपेन्द्रो मधुसूदनः॥ इन्द्रकर्मा महेन्द्रस्त्वं पद्मनाभो रणान्तकृत्। शरण्यं शरणं च त्वामाहुर्दिव्या महर्षयः॥
en: Thereupon Brahmā, the foremost of those conversant with the knowledge of Brahmā, spoke to Kākutstha, who had spoken thus, saying, "Do you hear my true words, O you having truth for your prowess. O lord, you are the great and effulgent, Nārāyaṇa holding discus and mace; you are the boar having one tusk; you have conquered the past, present and future; you are undecaying and without end, O Rāghava; you are the great virtue of the pious-you are the propounder of all laws and are four-armed; you are the holder of bow of time-the subduer of senses-the excellent Puruşa (person), unconquerable by sins; you are Vişņu holding dagger, Krşna and of incomparable strength; you are the army, the minister-the universe-the understanding, forgiveness and control of passions; you are the creation and destruction; Upendra and the slayer of (demon) Madhu; you are the creator of Indra; you are Mahendra; you have a lotus-like navel and you are the slayer of enemies. The celestials and the great saints style you as the refuge of those who seek for shelter.

sn: सहस्रशृङ्गो वेदात्मा शतशीर्षो महर्षभः। त्वं त्रयाणां हि लोकानामादिकर्ता स्वयंप्रभुः॥
en: You are the foremost of Vedas with its thousand branches and hundred regulations. You are yourself the creator of the three worlds, O lord.

sn: सिद्धानामपि साध्यानामाश्रयश्चासि पूर्वजः। त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वमोंकारः परात्परः॥
en: You are the refuge of the Siddhas' and Sadhyas, you Purvaja, ja, the sacrifice, Vasatkara, Om and Paratpara.

sn: प्रभवं निधनं चापि नो विदुः को भवानिति। दृश्यसे सर्वभूतेषु गोषु च ब्राह्मणेषु च॥ दिक्षु सर्वासु गगने पर्वतेषु नदीषु च। सहस्रचरणः श्रीमाञ्शतशीर्षः सहस्रदृक् ॥
en: No one is conversant with your birth and destruction-you are manifest in all creaturescows and Brahmins-an all quarters, in the sky, in the mountain, and in the river. You are gifted with thousand legs, thousand heads and thousand eyes.

sn: त्वं धारयसि भूतानि पृथिवीं सर्वपर्वतान्। अन्ते पृथिव्याः सलिले दृश्यसे त्वं महोरगः॥
en: You did uphold all creatures, the earth and all the mountains. You appear like the great serpent in the water underneath the earth.

sn: त्रील्लोकान्धारयन्राम देवगन्धर्वदानवान्। अहं ते हृदयं राम जिह्वा देवी सरस्वती॥ देवा रोमाणि गात्रेषु ब्रह्मणा निर्मिताः प्रभो। निमेषस्ते स्मृता रात्रिरुन्मेषो दिवसस्तथा॥
en: O Rāma, you did uphold three creations-the celestials, the Gandharvas and the Dănvas. O Rāma I am your heart, the worshipful Sarasvati (Goddess of learning) is your tongue and all other celestials, O lord, created by Brahmă are your down. The closing of your eye is the night and the opening is the day.

sn: संस्कारास्त्वभवन्वेदा नैतदस्ति त्वया विना। जगत्सर्व शरीरं ते स्थैर्य ते वसुधातलम्॥ अग्निः कोपः प्रसादस्ते सोमः श्रीवत्सलक्षणः। त्वया लोकास्त्रयः क्रान्ताः पुरा स्वैविक्रमैत्रिभिः॥ महेन्द्रश्च कृतो राजा बलिं बद्ध्वा सुदारुणम्। सीता लक्ष्मीर्भवान्विष्णुर्देवः कृष्णः प्रजापतिः॥
en: The Vedas are significant of your desire and the control thereof-none has got independent existence but you. The whole universe is your body, the earth is your patience, the fire is your anger-the sun and the moon are your delight; you have got Śrīvatsa (a peculiar curl of hair); you did before tread the three worlds with your three foot steps; you did get the dreadful Vālī bound and make Mahendra king: Sītā is Lakşmi and you are Krşņa and Vişnu the Preserver of people.

sn: वधार्थ रावणस्येह प्रविष्टो मानुषीं तनुम्। तदिदं नस्त्वया कार्यं कृतं धर्मभृतां वर ॥
en: For Rāvana's destruction you have assumed the human shape. You have accomplished that work of ours, O you the foremost of the pious.

sn: निहतो रावणो राम प्रहृष्टो दिवमाक्रम। अमोघं देव वीर्य ते न ते मोघाः पराक्रमाः॥
en: O Rāma, Răvaşa has been slain. Do you go up to heaven delighted. Sure is your godly energy and never goes for nothing your prowess.

sn: अमोघं दर्शनं राम अमोघस्तव संस्तवः। अमोघास्ते भविष्यन्ति भक्तिमन्तो नरा भुवि॥
en: O Rāma, never is fruitless your view and the chanting of your glory. And always successful shall be these persons on earth who shall be devoted to you.

sn: ये त्वां देवं ध्रुवं भक्ताः पुराणं पुरुषोत्तमम्। प्राप्नुवन्ति तथा कामानिह लोके परत्र च॥
en: Those who shall be devoted to you at one with Purana and the excellent Purasha, shall attain all their desires both in this worlds and the next. 1. A class of writings considered seared by the Hindus. 2. Great or supreme spirit-Purusa meaning that which abides or is quiescent in body.

sn: इममाएं स्तवं दिव्यमितिहासं पुरातनम्। ये नराः कीर्तयिष्यन्ति नास्ति तेषां पराभवः॥
en: Those persons shall never be unsuccessful both in this world and the next who shall chant this theme-excellent, instinct with the knowledge of Brahmă and describing the old history.

sn: एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं पितामहसमीरितम्। अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीमुत्पपात विभावसुः॥
en: Hearing those excellent words uttered by the great Patriarch rose up Vibhāvasu (The deity of Fire) with Vaidehi on his lap shaking the funeral pyre.

sn: विधूयाथ चितां तां तु वैदेही हव्यवाहनः। उत्तस्थौ मूर्तिमानाशु गृहीत्वा जनकात्मजाम्॥
en: With the daughter of the king Janaka, the receiver (Fire) of sacrificial offering, being incarnate, rose up.

sn: तरुणादित्यसंकाशां तप्तकांचनभूषणाम्। रक्ताम्बरधरां बालां नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजाम्॥ अक्लिष्टमाल्याभरणां तथारूपामनिन्दिताम्। ददौ रामाय वैदेहीमङ्के कृत्वा विभावसुः॥
en: And carrying on his lap Vaidehī, wearing a red cloth, resembling the newly risen sun, adorned with ornaments of burning gold-having black curling hairs and decked with fresh garments, Vibhāvasu gave her to Rāma.

sn: अब्रवीत्तु तदा रामं साक्षी लोकस्य पावकः। एषा ते राम वैदेही पापमस्यां न विद्यते॥
en: Thereupon the Deity of Fire, the witness of the people, spoke to Rāma, saying, O Rāma, here is your Vaidehi-no sin has visited her.

sn: नैव वाचा न मनसा नैव बुद्ध्या न चक्षुषा। सुवृत्ता वृत्तशौटीर्यं न त्वामत्यचरच्छुभा॥
en: Neither by words, mind, understanding nor eyes, she, good-natured and beautiful-has deviated from you who has got a good character and is heroic.

sn: रावणेनापनीतैषा वीर्योत्सिकेन रक्षसा। त्वया विरहिता दीना विवशा निर्जने सती।७।।
en: She was in the solitary forest separated from you, poorly and having no control over herself and hence she was carried away by the Raksasa Rāvana having enough prowess in him.

sn: रुद्धा चान्तःपुरे गुप्ता त्वच्चित्ता त्वत्परायणा। रक्षिता राक्षसीभिश्च घोराभिर्घोरबुद्धिभिः।।।। प्रलोभ्यमाना विविधं तय॑माना च मैथिली। नाचिन्तयत तद्रक्षस्त्वद्गतेनान्तरात्मना।९।। विशुद्धभावां निष्पापां प्रतिगृह्णीष्व मैथिलीम्। न किंचिदभिधातव्या अहमाज्ञापयामि ते॥
en: Although shut up in the inner apartment-well protected and guarded by the dreadful shedemons she had always her mind in you and was devoted to you. Although tempted in many a way and remonstrated with she did not think of that Rākşasa in her inner mind. Her heart is pure and she is not spoiled with sin-do you therefore take back Maithilī. Do you not speak otherwise-I do command you.

sn: ततः प्रीतमना रामः श्रुत्वैवं वदतां वरः। दध्यौ मुहूर्त धर्मात्मा हर्षव्याकुललोचनः॥
en: Thereupon hearing those words-the virtuoussouled Rāma, the foremost of those skilled in speech, with his eyes agitated with delight, meditated for sometime.

sn: एवमुक्तो महातेजा धृतिमानुरुविक्रमः। उवाच त्रिदशश्रेष्ठं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः॥
en: Being thus addressed, the highly effulgent and intelligent Rāma, of unmitigated prowess-the foremost of the pious, spoke to that best of celestials saying.

sn: अवश्यं चापि लोकेषु सीता पावनमर्हति। दीर्घकालोषिता हीयं रावणान्तःपुरे शुभा॥
en: Beautiful (Sītā) lived in the inner apartment of Rāvana for a long time so she needs this purification in the presence of all people.

sn: बालिशो वत कामात्मा रामो दशरथात्मजः। इति वक्ष्यति मां लोको जानकीमविशोध्य हि॥
en: If I would take the daughter of Janaka without purifying her, people would say that Rāma the son of king Dasaratha is lustful and ignorant of the morality of the people.

sn: अनन्यहृदयां सीतां मच्चित्तपरिरक्षिणीम्। अहमप्यवगच्छामि मैथिली जनकात्मजाम्॥
en: I know it full well that Maithili, the daughter of king Janaka, has her mind devoted to me and has not given it to any one (else).

sn: इमामपि विशालाक्षीं रक्षितां स्वेन तेजसा। रावणो नातिवर्तेत वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: As the ocean cannot go beyond its banks so Răvaņa could not approach her having expansive eyes protected by virtue of her own chastity.

sn: न च शक्तः सुदुष्टात्मा मनसापि हि मैथिलीम्। प्रधर्षयितुमप्राप्यां दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव॥
en: The greatly vicious-souled one could not even by his mind get Maithili, who was beyond his reach like to the burning flame of fire.

sn: नेयमर्हति वैक्लव्यं रावणान्तःपुरे सती। अनन्या हि मया सीता भास्करस्य प्रभा यथा।॥
en: Her mind could not have been moved although she lived in the inner apartment of Rāvaņa-she belongs to none else; Sītā is mine as the rays belong to the Sun.

sn: विशुद्धा त्रिषु लोकेषु मैथिली जनकात्मजा। न विहातुं मया शक्या कीर्तिरात्मवता यथा॥
en: Maithili-the daughter of Janaka has been purified before the three worlds-So I am incapable of renouncing her as a self controlled person cannot forsake his (own ) reputation.

sn: अवश्यं च मया कार्यं सर्वेषां वो वचो हितम्। स्निग्धानां लोकनाथानामेवं च वदतां हितम्॥
en: It behove me to carry out the well meaning words of you all the lords of people who have spoken them out of affection.

sn: इत्येवमुक्त्वा विजयी महाबलः प्रशस्यमानः स्वकृतेन कर्मणा। समेत्य रामः प्रियया महायशाः सुखं सुखार्होऽनुबभूव राघवः॥
en: Saying this, the victorious, highly powerful, well renowned Rāghava, worthy of enjoying happiness, and having his praise chanted in consequence of his noble action, regaining his spouse, attained to happiness.

sn: एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं राघवेणानुभाषितम्। ततः शुभतरं वाक्यं व्याजहार महेश्वरः॥
en: Hearing those excellent words uttered by Raghava, Mahesvara (Siva) spoke far more important words.

sn: पुष्कराक्ष महाबाहो महावक्षः परंतप। दिष्ट्या कृतमिदं कर्म त्वया धर्मभृतां वर॥
en: O you having lotus-eyes, O you having huge arms and a spacious breast, O you the slayer of enemies, O you the foremost of the pious-it is a good fortune that this has been done by you.

sn: दिष्ट्या सर्वस्य लोकस्य प्रवृद्धं दारुणं तमः। अपवृत्तं त्वया संख्ये रामरावणजं भयम्॥
en: It is by good fortune, O Rama, the dreadful Rāghava, has been removed by you in the encounter.

sn: आश्वास्य भरतं दीनं कौसल्यां च यशस्विनीम्। कैकेयीं च सुमित्रां च दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमातरम्॥ प्राप्य राज्यमयोध्यां च नन्दयित्वा सुहृज्जनम्। इक्ष्वाकूणां कूले वंशं स्थापयित्वा महाबल॥ इष्ट्वा तुरगमेधेन प्राप्य चानुत्तमं यशः। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं दत्त्वा त्रिदिवं गन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Consoling the poor Bharata and the famed Kausalyā, beholding Kaikeyi and Sumitrā the mother of Lakşmaņa, obtaining the kingdom of Ayodhyā, pleasing all your friends, establishing the prestige of your family, you of great strength, performing horse-sacrifices, attaining fair fame and conferring riches upon the Brāhmaṇas do you repair to heaven.

sn: एष राजा दशरथो विमानस्थः पिता तव। काकुत्स्थ मानुषे लोके गुरुस्तव महायशाः।७॥
en: This king Dasaratha stationed on the car is your father. He was your superior on this earth, OKakutstha.

sn: इन्द्रलोकं गतः श्रीमांस्त्वया पुत्रेण तारितः। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा त्वमेनमभिवादय।।।।।
en: Obtaining you as his son, that graceful (king) has repaired to the region of Indra. Do you bow to him with your brother Lakşmaņa.

sn: महादेववचः श्रुत्वा राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः। विमानशिखरस्थस्य प्रणाममकरोत्पितुः॥
en: Hearing the words of Mahadeva, Raghava, along with Laksmana, bowed to their father who was seated on the top of the car.

sn: दीप्यमानं स्वया लक्ष्या विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम्। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा ददर्श पितरं प्रभुः॥
en: He with Lakşmaņa beheld their father shining in his own effulgence and wearing an unsullied cloth.

sn: हर्षेण महताविष्टो विमानस्थो महीपतिः। प्राणैः प्रियतरं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं दशरथस्तदा॥ आरोप्याङ्के महाबाहुर्वरासनगतः प्रभुः। बाहुभ्यां संपरिष्वज्य ततो वाक्यं समाददे॥
en: Thereupon beholding his son dearer than his life, attaining great delight (in consequence thereof) placing him on his lap and embracing him with his arms, the great king Dasaratha, having long arms and seated on an excellent seat in the car, said.

sn: न मे स्वर्गो बहु मतः समानश्च सुरर्षभैः। त्वया राम विहीनस्य सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते॥
en: I am now in heaven and am equal with the celestials, but without you, O Rāma, I do not like it-this is true-I do swear by you.

sn: कैकेय्या यानि चोक्तानि वाक्यानि वदतां वर। तव प्रव्राजनार्थानि स्थितानि हृदये मम॥
en: O you the foremost of those skilled in speech, I have still in my mind the words which were uttered by Kaikeyi for sending you away to the woods.

sn: त्वां तु दृष्ट्वा कुशलिनं परिष्वज्य सलक्ष्मणम्। अद्य दुःखाद्विमुक्तोऽस्मि नीहारादिव भास्करः॥
en: Beholding you all well and embracing you with Lakşmaņa I am now shorn of grief like to the Sun, devoid of dues.

sn: तारितोऽहं त्वया पुत्र सुपुत्रेण महात्मना। अष्टावक्रेण धर्मात्मा कहोलो ब्राह्मणो यथा॥
en: I have been emancipated, O my son, through you-a good and high-souled son, as the virtuoussouled Brāhmaṇa Kahola was by Aștāvakra.

sn: इदानीं च विजानामि यथा सौम्य सुरेश्वरैः। वधार्थ रावणस्येह पिहितं पुरुषोत्तमम्॥
en: O gentle one, I have heard from the celestials, (that you are) the excellent Puruşa in the guise (of a man) for the destruction of Rävaņa.

sn: सिद्धार्था खलु कौसल्या या त्वां राम गृहं गतम्। वनानिवृत्तं संहृष्टा द्रक्ष्यते शत्रुसूदनम्॥
en: Blessed is Kausalyā, O Rāma, who shall be greatly delighted, on beholding you, the slayer of enemies, gone home from the forest.

sn: सिद्धार्थाः खलु ते राम नरा ये त्वां पुरीं गतम्। राज्ये चैवाभिषिक्तं च द्रक्ष्यन्ते वसुधाधिपम्॥
en: Blessed are those men, O Rama, who shall behold you installed in the city as the king of the world.

sn: अनुरक्तेन बलिना शुचिना धर्मचारिणा। इच्छेयं त्वामहं द्रष्टुं भरतेन समागतम्॥
en: I wish to behold you reconciled with Bharata, devoted powerful, pure and performing pious observances.

sn: चतुर्दशः समाः सौम्य वने निर्यातितास्त्वया। वसता सीतया साधं मत्प्रीत्या लक्ष्मणेन च॥
en: O gentle one, you have spent fourteen years in the forest with Sītā and Lakşmaņa.

sn: निवृत्तवनवासोऽसि प्रतिज्ञा पूरिता त्वया। रावणं च रणे हत्वा देवताः परितोषिताः॥
en: The term of your exile is over-your promise has been fulfilled; and slaying Ravana, in the conflict you have pleased the celestials.

sn: कृतं कर्म यशः श्लाघ्यं प्राप्तं ते शत्रुसूदन। भ्रातृभिः सह राज्यस्थो दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुहि ॥
en: You have performed a mighty deed and attained to excellent fame, O slayer of enemies; and placed in charge of your kingdom do you with your brothers attain a long life.

sn: इति ब्रुवाणं राजानं रामः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्। 'कुरु प्रसादं धर्मज्ञ कैकेय्या भरतस्य च॥
en: The king speaking thus Rāma spoke to him with folded hands saying, “O you conversant with piety, do you be propitiated with Bharata and Kaikeyi.

sn: सपुत्रां त्वां त्यजामीति यदुक्ता केकयी त्वया। स शापः केकयीं घोरः सपुत्रां न स्पृशेत्प्रभो॥
en: You did imprecate Kaikeyi, saying, I renounce you with your son, may not that dreadful curse visit her and her son.

sn: तथेति स महाराजो राममुक्त्वा कृताञ्जलिम्। लक्ष्मणं च परिष्वज्य पुनर्वाक्यमुवाच ह॥
en: Saying "so be it" to Rāma with folded hands and embracing Lakşmaņa the great king said to him.

sn: धर्म प्राप्स्यसि धर्मज्ञ यशश्च विपुलं भुवि। रामे प्रसने स्वर्गं च महिमानं तथोत्तमम्॥
en: O you conversant with piety and fame on this earth, you shall attain to heaven and excellent state there.

sn: रामं शुश्रूष भद्रं ते सुमित्रानन्दवर्धन। रामः सर्वस्य लोकस्य हितेष्वभिरतः सदा॥
en: O you the enhancer of Sumitra's joy-do you attend upon Rāma; may good betide you; Rāma is ever engaged in the welfare of all beings.

sn: एते सेन्द्रास्त्रयो लोकाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। अभिवाद्य महात्मानमर्चन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम्॥
en: All these celestials headed by Indra, Siddhas and Great saints, bowing to this high-souled and excellent Purusa, worship him.

sn: एतत्तदुक्तमव्यक्तमक्षरं ब्रह्मसंमितम्। देवानां हृदयं सौम्य गुह्यं रामः परंतपः॥
en: Rāma, the subduer of foes, is the indescribable and undecaying letter Brahmā, which has been described in the Vedas) as the heart and secret of the celestials.

sn: अवाप्तधर्माचरणं यशश्च विपुलं त्वया। एनं शुश्रूषता व्यग्रं वैदेह्या सह सीतया॥
en: For serving him along with Sītā, the daughter of king Videha, you have attained piety and excellent fame.

sn: इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं राजा स्नुषां बद्धाञ्जलिं स्थिताम्। पुत्रीत्याभाष्य मधुरं शनैरेनामुवाच ह॥
en: Addressing Lakşmaņa thus, the king spoke to his daughter-in-law, who was standing before him with folded hands, saying.

sn: कर्तव्यो न तु वैदेहि मन्युस्त्यागमिमं प्रति। रामेणेदं विशुद्ध्यर्थं कृतं वै त्वद्धितैषिणा॥
en: It does not behove you, O Vaidehi, to be enraged (with Rāma) for renouncing you; for purifying you this was done by him ever wishing your welfare.

sn: सुदुष्करमिदं पुत्रि तव चारित्रलक्षणम्। कृतं यत्तेऽन्यनारीणां यशो ह्यभिभविष्यति॥
en: What you have performed, O daughter, to establish the purity of your character, is hard to perform. What you have done, shall glorify all other females.

sn: न त्वं कामं समाधेया भर्तृशुश्रूषणं प्रति। अवश्यं तु मया वाच्यमेष ते दैवतं परम्॥
en: Though there is no necessity for giving you any instruction as regards your duty towards your husband-still I should say that he is your great god.

sn: इति प्रतिसमादिश्य पुत्रौ सीतां च राघवः। इन्द्रलोकं विमानेन ययौ दशरथो नृपः॥
en: Having thus instructed his two sons and Sītā, he repaired, in his car, to the region of Indra.

sn: विमानमास्थाय महानुभावः श्रिया च संहृष्टतनुर्नृपोत्तमः। आमन्त्र्य पुत्रौ सह सीतया च जगाम देवप्रवरस्य लोकम्॥
en: Having advised his two sons along with Sītā, ascending the car, and shining in his effulgence, that excellent king, greatly delighted, repaired to the region of the king of celestials.

sn: प्रतिप्रयाते काकुत्स्थे महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः। अब्रवीत्परमप्रीतो राघवं प्राञ्जलिं स्थितम्॥
en: Dasaratha having repaired, Mahendra greatly delighted spoke to Rāghava, stationed there with folded hands, saying.

sn: अमोघं दर्शनं राम तवास्माकं नरर्षभ। प्रीतियुक्ताः स्म तेन त्वं ब्रूहि यन्मनसेप्सितम्॥
en: O Rama,Oforemost of men, this our presence here, must not be fruitless, we are pleased-do you ask for what you wish.

sn: एवमुक्तो महेन्द्रेण प्रसन्नेन महात्मना। सुप्रसन्नमना हृष्टो वचनं प्राह राघवः॥
en: Being thus accosted by the high-souled Mahendra-delighted, Rāghava spoke, with a pleased heart.

sn: यदि प्रीतिः समुत्पन्ना मयि ते विबुधेश्वर। वक्ष्यामि कुरु मे सत्यं वचनं वदतां वर॥
en: O lord of the celestials, O you the foremost of those skilled in speech, if you are propitiated with me, I shall pray for (my wished for object); do you grant it.

sn: मम हेतोः पराक्रान्ता ये गता यमसादनम्। ते सर्वे जीवितं प्राप्य समुत्तिष्ठन्तु वानराः॥
en: Let all these highly powerful monkeys, who have been despatched to the abode of Death, on my account, regaining their life, stand up.

sn: मत्कृते विप्रयुक्ता ये पुत्रैदारैश्च वानराः। तान्प्रीतमनसः सर्वान्द्रष्टुमिच्छामि मानद॥
en: O you the conferror of honour, I wish to see all those delighted monkeys, who were separated from their wives and children on my account.

sn: विक्रान्ताश्चापि शूराश्च न मृत्युं गणयन्ति च। कृतयत्ना विपन्नाश्च जीवयैतान्पुरंदर।७।।
en: O Purandara, do you revive all these heroic and powerful (monkeys) who did not care for death, and who worked hard and were distressed (for me).

sn: मत्प्रियेष्वभिरक्ताश्च न मृत्युं गणयन्ति ये। त्वत्प्रसादात्समेयुस्ते वरमेतमहं वृणे॥
en: May all those, by your favour, who were ever devoted to me and did not care for death (even) regain their life-this is the boon I pray for.

sn: नीरूजो निव्रणांश्चैव संपनबलपौरुषान्। गोला)लांस्तथक्षांश्च द्रष्टुमिच्छामि मानद॥
en: O conferror of honour, I wish to see all these monkeys, Golarigālas and bears, pale and hurt, unheart and gifted with strength and prowess like before.

sn: अकाले चापि पुष्पाणि मूलानि च फलानि च। नद्यश्च विमलास्तत्र तिष्ठेयुर्यत्र वानराः॥
