en: Let there be flowers, fruits and roots, even out of season wherever these monkeys shall live and let rivers there be full of clear water.

sn: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य राघवस्य महात्मनः। महेन्द्रः प्रत्युवाचेदं वचनं प्रीतिसंयुतम्॥
en: Hearing those words of the high-souled Rāghava Mehendra replied with words instinct with delight.

sn: महानयं वरस्तात यस्त्वयोक्तो रघूत्तम। द्विर्मया नोक्तपूर्वं च तस्मादेतद्भविष्यति॥
en: O my boy, O foremost of the Raghus, mighty is the boon you have prayed for-my words shall never be falsified, so let them be fulfilled.

sn: समुत्तिष्ठन्तु ते सर्वे हता ये युधि राक्षसैः। ऋक्षाश्च सह गोपुच्छैनिकृत्ताननबाहवः॥
en: Let all those bears and Golangulas rise up who were slain in the conflict by Rákşasas and had their heads and arms severed.

sn: नीरुजो निव्रणाश्चैव संपन्नबलपौरुषाः। समुत्थास्यन्ति हरयः सुप्ता निद्राक्षये यथा ॥
en: Let the monkeys gifted with their pristine strength and prowess rise up unhurt and healthy as if after the end of sleep.

sn: सुहृद्भिर्बान्धवैश्चैव ज्ञातिभिः स्वजनेन च। सर्व एव समेष्यन्ति संयुक्ताः परया मुदा॥
en: Being reconciled with their friends, relatives and kinsmen let them attain to excellent joy.

sn: अकाले पुष्पशबलाः फलवन्तश्च पादपाः। भविष्यन्ति महेष्वास नद्यश्च सलिलायुताः॥
en: O you the wielder of a huge bow, all the trees shall be filled with flowers and fruits and all the rivers shall be filled with water even out of season (wherever they shall live).

sn: सव्रणैः प्रथमं गात्रैरिदानी निव्रणैः समैः। ततः समुत्थिता सर्वे सुप्त्वेव हरिसत्तमाः॥
en: Thereupon all these leading monkeys who had their persons wounded but now healed up, rose up like those asleep.

sn: बभूवुर्वानराः सर्वे किं त्वेतदिति विस्मिताः। काकुत्स्थं परिपूर्णार्थं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे सुरोत्तमाः॥ अब्रुवन्परमप्रीताः स्तुत्वा रामं सलक्ष्मणम्। गच्छायोध्यामितो राजन्विसर्जय च वानरान्॥ मैथिली सान्त्वयस्वैनामनुरक्तां यशस्विनीम्। भ्रातरं भरतं पश्य त्वच्छोकाबतचारिणम्॥ शत्रुघ्नं च महात्मानं मातृः सर्वाः परंतप। अभिषेचय चात्मानं पौरान्गत्वा प्रहर्षय॥
en: All those monkeys were greatly wondered, saying, "What is it ?" And beholding Kākutstha of accomplished end and eulogizing Rama and Laksmana, all the celestials, greatly delighted, said, Do you, O king, repair to Ayodhyadespatch all the monkeys-console the famed Maithili, ever devoted to you-behold your brother Bharata observing ascetic vows in consequence of your grief and the high-souled Satrughna and all your mothers,o slayer of foes. And being installed on the throne do you conduce to the joy of all citizens.

sn: एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षो रामं सौमित्रिणा सह। विमानैः सूर्यसंकाशैर्ययौ हृष्टः सुरैः सह ॥
en: Having thus addressed Rāma along with Laksmana, the thousand eyed Deity, delighted, went away along with the celestials, in their cars resembling the Sun (in brilliance.

sn: अभिवाद्य च काकुत्स्थः सर्वांस्तांत्रिदशोत्तमान्। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा रासमाज्ञापयत्तदा॥
en: Saluting all the celestials, Kākutstha, with his brother Lakşmaņa, ordered the encampment of the army.

sn: ततस्तु सा लक्ष्मणरामपालिता महाचमूहष्टजना यशस्विनी। श्रिया ज्वलन्ती विरराज सर्वतो निशा प्रणीतेव हि शीतरश्मिना॥
en: Thereupon that famous and well-pleased huge army of the monkeys protected by Råma and Lakşmaņa, appeared resplendent on all sides like to a night beautified with the rays of the Moon.

sn: तां रात्रिमुषितं रामं सुखोदितमरिंदमम्। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं जयं पृष्ट्वा विभीषणः॥
en: Rāma having spent that night happily and risen up the next morning, Vibhisana, chanting his victory, spoke to that slayer of foes, with folded hands, saying.

sn: स्नानानि चाङ्गरागाणि वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च। चन्दनानि च माल्यानि दिव्यानि विविधानि च॥
en: Here are various articles for bathing, pastes, clothes, ornaments, sandal and various excellent garlands.

sn: अलंकारविदश्चैता नार्यः पद्मनिभेक्षणाः। उपस्थितास्त्वां विधिवत्स्नापयिष्यन्ति राघव॥
en: Here are present women having eyes like lotuses and conversant with the are of decking, Let them perform their duty, O Rāghava.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थः प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम्। हरीन्सुग्रीवमुख्यास्त्वं स्नानेनोपनिमन्त्रय॥
en: Being thus accosted Kākutstha replied to Vibhīşaņa, saying: Do you invite all these monkeys headed by Sugrīva to bath.

sn: स तु ताम्यति धर्मात्मा मम हेतोः सुखोचितः। सुकुमारो महाबाहुर्भरतः सत्यसंश्रयः॥
en: The virtuous-souled Bharata, having huge arms and ever used to comforts, is greatly distressed on my account.

sn: तं विना कैकयीपुत्रं भरतं धर्मचारिणाम्। न मे स्नानं बहुमतं वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च॥
en: Without Bharata the son of Kaikeyi, ever performing pious rites, I do not value bathing or these clothes and ornaments.

sn: एतत्पश्य यथा क्षिप्रं प्रतिगच्छाम तां पुरीम्। अयोध्यां गच्छतो ह्येष पन्थाः परमदुर्गमः।७।।
en: Do you so manage that we may go to the city of Ayodhyă speedity. For difficult is the way leading to Ayodhyā.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थं प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः। अह्ना त्वां प्रापयिष्यामि तां पुरीं पार्थिवात्मज ॥
en: Being thus accosted Vibhīşaņa relied to Kākutstha, O son of the lord of earth, may good betide you, I shall soon take you to that city.

sn: पुष्पकं नाम भद्रं ते विमानं सूर्यसंनिभम्। मम भ्रातुः कुबेरस्य रावणेन बलीयसा॥ हृतं निर्जित्य संग्रामे कामगं दिव्यमुत्तमम्। त्वदर्थं पालितं चेदं तिष्ठत्यतुलविक्रम॥
en: The car Pușpaka resembling the Sun, belonging to my brother Kuvera, was brought by the powerful Răvaņa. you of unequalled prowess, that celestial and excellent car, going everywhere at will, since the destruction of Rāvana in battle, is ready for you.

sn: तदिदं मेघसंकाशं विमानमिह तिष्ठति। येन यास्यसि यानेन त्वमयोध्यां गतज्वरः॥
en: That car resembling the cloud is in the city of Lanka, in which you shaft, relieved of your anxiety, repair to Ayodhyā.

sn: अहं ते यद्यनुग्राह्यो यदि स्मरसि मे गुणान्। वस तावदिह प्राज्ञ यद्यस्ति मयि सौहृदम्॥ लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या भार्यया सह। अर्चितः सर्वकामैस्त्वं ततो राम गमिष्यसि॥
en: If I am worthy of being favoured by you, if remember any accomplishment of mineif you have any friendship for me, do you, o wise one, wait here with your brother Lakşmaņa and spouse Vaidehi till I accomplish all my desires by worshipping you. And then you shall go (to Ayodhyā).

sn: प्रीतियुक्तस्य विहितां ससैन्यः ससुहृद्गणः। सत्क्रियां राम मे तावद्गृहाण त्वं मयोद्यताम्॥
en: O Rāma, I shall worship you with great delight and do your, O Rama, with your friends and army, accept that adoration. did you

sn: प्रणयाद्बहुमानाच्च सौहार्देन च राघव। प्रसादयामि प्रेष्योऽहं न खल्वाज्ञापयामि ते॥
en: O Rāma, out of love, honour, and brotherly feeling, I do crave your premising. I am a servant I cannot command you.

sn: एवमुक्तस्ततो रामः प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम्। रक्षसां वानराणां च सर्वेषामेव शृण्वताम्॥
en: Being thus addressed, Rāma replied to Vibhīşaņa in the presence of all the Rākşasas and monkeys, saying.

sn: पूजितोऽस्मि त्वया वीर साचिव्येन परेण च। सर्वात्मना च चेष्टाभिः सौहार्देन परेण च॥
en: I have been worshipped by you, O hero, with your excellent counsels, with your earnest endeavours and with your great friendship.

sn: न खल्वेतन्न कुर्यां ते वचनं राक्षसेश्वर। तं तु मे भ्रातरं द्रष्टुं भरतं त्वरते मनः॥ मां निवर्तयितुं योऽसौ चित्रकूटमुपागतः। . शिरसा याचतो यस्य वचनं न कृतं मया॥
en: Do not think,O lord of Raksasas, that I do not comply with your request-my heart hastens me to behold my brother Bharata, who, to take me back, did come to the mount Citrakūța, who laid low his crown at my feet and whose words I did not keep.

sn: कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च कैकेयीं च यशस्विनीम्। गुहं च सुहृदं चैव पौराञ्जानपदैः सह ॥
en: (I am anxious to see) Kausalyā, Sumitrā, Kaikeyi, with my friends, citizens and villagers.

sn: अनुजानीहि मां सौम्य पूजितोऽस्मि विभीषण। मन्युर्न खलु कर्तव्यः सखे त्वां चानुमानये॥
en: Do you regard me, O Vibhīşaņa, O gentle one, as worshipped. O friend do you be not angry-I request you.

sn: उपस्थापय मे शीघ्रं विमानं राक्षसेश्वर। कृतकार्यस्य मे वासः कथं स्यादिह संमतः॥
en: Do you speedily bring the car for me, O lord of Räkşasas my work is done-how can I wish to live here long.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः। विमानं सूर्यसंकाशमाजुहाव त्वरान्वितः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, Vibhīşaņa the lord of Rākşasas, speedily brought the car resembling the Sun.

sn: ततः काञ्चनचित्राङ्गं वैदूर्यमणिवेदिकम्। कूटागारैः परिक्षिप्तं सर्वतो रजतप्रभम्॥ पाण्डुराभिः पताकाभिर्ध्वजैश्च समलंकृतम्। काञ्चनं काञ्चनैर्हम्हेमपद्मविभूषितैः॥ प्रकीर्णं किङ्किणीजालैर्मुक्तामणिगवाक्षकम्। घण्टाजालैः परिक्षिप्तं सर्वतो मधुरस्वनम्॥ तं मेरुशिखराकारं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा। बृहद्भिर्भूषितं हम्युर्मुक्तारजतशोभितैः॥ तलैः स्फटिकचित्राङ्गैर्वैदूर्यैश्च वरासनैः। महार्हास्तरणोपेतैरुपपत्रं महाधनैः॥ उपस्थितमनाधृष्यं तद्विमानं मनोजवम्। निवेदयित्वा रामाय तस्थौ तत्र विभीषणः॥
en: Thereupon arrived there the car adorned all over with gold paintings, altars crested with Vaidurya jewels having upper rooms, silvered all over, adorned with white flags and flag-staffs, beautified with gilt lotuses, adorned with golden houses, covered with a network of girdles, having windows made of pearls and jems, girt on all sides with a net of bells, giving forth melodious sound, resembling the summit of the mount Meru, constructed by Viśvakarmā (the architect of the celestials) adorned with huge apartments beautified with silver and pearlshaving its base created with crystal, containing excellent seats made of Vaidūrya, abounding in valuable coverlets and immense wealth, incapable of being broken down and coursing at will. And communicating to Rāma (the arrival of that car) Vibhīşana waited there.

sn: मुपस्थितं भूधरसंनिकाशम्। दृष्ट्वा तदा विस्मयमाजगाम रामः ससौमित्रिरुदारसत्त्वः॥
en: Beholding that flowery car, coursing at will and resembling a huge mountain, Rama, of a generous spirit, along with Saumitri, attained to an excess of astonishment.

sn: उपस्थितं तु तं कृत्वा पुष्पकं पुष्पभूषितम्। अविदूरे स्थितो राममित्युवाच विभीषणः॥ स तु बद्धाञ्जलिपुटो विनीतो राक्षसेश्वरः। अब्रवीत्त्वरयोपेतः किं करोमीति राघवम्॥
en: Having brought that car Puşpaka, adorned with flowers and having stationed himself at a distance, Vibhīşaņa the lord of Rākşasas, being incited to hurry on, humbly and with folded hands, spoke to Rama, saying, "What shall I do, O Rāghava?

sn: तमब्रवीन्महातेजा लक्ष्मणस्योपशृण्वतः। विमृश्य राघवो वाक्यमिदं स्नेहपुरस्कृतम्॥
en: Hearing those words the highly powerful Rāghava, in the presence of Lakşmaņa, gave vent to the following accents out of affection.

sn: कृतप्रयत्नकर्माणः सर्व एव वनौकसः। रत्नैरथैश्च विविधैः संपूज्यन्तां विभीषण॥
en: All these monkeys and bears have brought about the accomplishment of my work with great care. Do you, satisfy them, O Vibhisana, with diverse jewels and riches.

sn: सहामीभिस्त्वया लङ्का निर्जिता राक्षसेश्वरः। हृष्टैः प्राणभयं त्यक्त्वा संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिभिः॥
en: With these and you, I conquered the city of Lanka, O lord of Raksasas. They all fought with a delighted heart, having renounced all fear of life and who did never go away from the battlefield.

sn: त इमे कृतकर्माणः सर्व एव वनौकसः। धनरत्नप्रदानैश्च कर्मैषां सफलं कुरु॥
en: Do you, with a gift of riches and jewel, make good the work of these monkeys and bears who encompassed the accomplishment (of my end).

sn: एवं संमानिताश्चैते नन्द्यमाना यथा त्वया। भविष्यन्ति कृतज्ञेन निवृता हरियूथपाः।७।।
en: Being honoured and delighted by you grateful, all these leading monkeys shall repair (to their, respective quarters).

sn: त्यागिनं संग्रहीतारं सानुक्रोशं जितेन्द्रियम्। सर्वे त्वामभिगच्छन्ति ततः संबोधयामि ते॥
en: (If you are found to be) sacrificing, self-controlled, compassionate and (the just) collector of revenues, all shall be attached to you. For this I do address you (thus).

sn: हीनं रतिगुणैः सर्वैरभिहन्तारमाहवे। सेना त्यजति संविग्ना नृपतिं तं नरेश्वर॥
en: O lord of men, the soldiers, disgusted, renounce that king who is void of all royal accomplishments, and who uselessly slays soldiers in the conflict.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण वानरांस्तान्विभीषणः। रत्नार्थसंविभागेन सर्वानेवाभ्यपूजयत्॥
en: Being thus accosted by Rāma, Vibhīşaņa with a distribution of jewels and riches, honoured all those monkeys.

sn: ततस्तान्पूजितान्दृष्ट्वा रत्नाथैहरियूथपान्। आरुरोह तदा रामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्॥ अङ्केनादाय वैदेही लज्जमानां मनस्विनीम्। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा विक्रान्तेन धनुष्मता॥
en: Beholding all those leading monkeys worshipped with jewels and riches Rāma ascended that excellent car, taking the bashful, and high-minded Vaidehi on his lap and accompanied by his powerful brother Laksmana, a skilled bowman.

sn: अब्रवीत्स विमानस्थः पूजयन्सर्ववानरान्। सुग्रीवं च महावीर्य काकुत्स्थः सविभीषणम्॥
en: Being stationed the Kakutstha honouring all the monkeys, the highly powerful Sugriva and Vibhisana, said.

sn: मित्रकार्य कृतमिदं भवद्भिनिरर्षभाः। अनुज्ञाता मया सर्वे यथेष्टं प्रतिगच्छत॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, you have performed a friendly service-it has been appreciated by medo you repair to your wished-for quarters.

sn: यत्तु कार्य वयस्येन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च। कृतं सुग्रीव तत्सर्वं भवता धर्मभीरुणा॥
en: O Sugrīva, you, ever afraid of impiety, have performed all that a loving and well wishing friend should do.

sn: किष्किन्धां प्रति याह्याशु स्वसैन्येनाभिसंवृतः। स्वराज्ये वस लङ्कायां मया दत्ते विभीषण।। न त्वां धर्षयितुं शक्ताः सेन्ट्रा अपि दिवौकसः॥
en: on car Do you, encircled by your army, proceed towards Kiskindhā. Do you, O Vibhisana live in your kingdom, Lankā, conferred upon you, by me. Not even the celestials, headed by Indra shall be able to assail you.

sn: अयोध्या प्रति यास्यामि राजधानी पितुर्मम। अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि सर्वानामन्त्रयामि वः॥
en: I wish to return to Ayodhyā, the capital of my father's (Kingdom). I wish to obtain your permission (and for this, I have invited you all.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण हरीन्द्रा हरयस्तथा। ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे राक्षसश्च विभीषणः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, all the leading monkeys bears as well as the Rākşasa Vibhīşaņa said with folded hands.

sn: अयोध्यां गन्तुमिच्छामः सर्वात्रयतु नो भवान्। मुधुक्ता विचरिष्यामो वनान्युपवनानि च॥
en: We wish all to go to Ayodhyä. Do you take us. We shall all range with delight at forests and gardens.

sn: दृष्ट्वा त्वामभिषेकाहं कौसल्यामभिवाद्य च। अचिरादागमिष्यामः स्वगृहानृपसत्तम॥
en: Beholding you installed and bowing to Kausalya, we shall soon return to our respective homes, O foremost of kings.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा वानरैः सविभीषणैः। अब्रवीद्वानरान्रामः ससुग्रीवविभीषणान्॥
en: Being thus accosted by the monkeys with Vibhisana, the virtuous-souled Rama, spoke to them and Sugriva and Vibhisana, saying.

sn: प्रियाप्रियतरं लब्धं यदहं ससुहृज्जनः। सर्वैर्भवद्भिः सहितः प्रीतिं लप्स्ये पुरीं गतः॥
en: Dearer than the dear, I shall attain to, when returning my city, along with you all, I shall enjoy in the company of all my friends and relatives.

sn: क्षिप्रमारोह सुग्रीव विमानं सह वानरैः। त्वमप्यारोह सामात्यो राक्षसेन्द्र विभीषण॥
en: O Sugrīva, do you soon ascend the car along with the monkeys. Do you ascend too, O Vibhisana, lord of Raksasas, with all your courtiers.

sn: ततः स पुष्पकं दिव्यं सुग्रीवः सह वानरैः। आरुरोह मुदा युक्तः सामात्यश्च विभीषणः॥
en: Thereupon ascended that celestial car Puş paka, Sugriva, greatly delighted with the monkeys and Vibhisana, with his courtiers.

sn: देवारूढेषु सर्वेषु कौबेरं परमासनम्। राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातमुत्पपात विहायसम्॥
en: They all having got up, the excellent car, of Kuvera at the command of Raghava, rose up in the welkin.

sn: खगतेन विमानेन हंसयुक्तेन भास्वता। प्रहृष्टश्च प्रतीतश्च बभौ रामः कुबेरवत्॥
en: And in that car coursing at will land drawn by effulgent ganders, Rāma greatly delighted appeared like Kuvera (himself).

sn: ते सर्वे वानरांश्च राक्षसाश्च महाबलाः। यथासुखमसंबाधं दिव्ये तस्मिन्नुपाविशन्॥
en: All the monkeys, bears and the highly powerful Rákşasas sat in that celestial car unobstructed and at their pleasure.

sn: अनुज्ञातं तु रामेण तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्। हंसयुक्तं महानादमुत्पपात विहायसम्॥
en: Being commanded by Räma, that excellent car, drawn by ganders, with a huge noise, rose high up in the welkin.

sn: पातयित्वा ततश्चक्षुः सर्वतो रघुनन्दनः। अब्रवीन्मैथिली सीतां रामः शशिनिभाननाम्।२।।
en: Casting his looks on all sides, Rama, the descendant of Raghus, spoke to Sītā, the daughter of the kind of Mithila, having a moonlike countenance, saying.

sn: कैलासशिखराकारे त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थिताम्। लङ्कामीक्षस्व वैदेहि निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा॥
en: O Vaidehi, do you behold Lanka, situate on the summit of the mount Citrakūta, resembling that of Kailasa and constructed by Viswakarma.

sn: एतदायोधनं पश्य मांसशोणितकर्दमम्। हरीणां राक्षसानां च सीते विशसनं महत्॥
en: Behold, O Sītā, that huge arena of battle, bathed in the blood and flesh of the monkeys and Raksasas.

sn: एष दत्तवरः शेते प्रमाथी राक्षसेश्वरः। तव हेतोविशालाक्षि निहतो रावणो मया॥
en: Do you behold, O you having expansive eyes, Rāvaņa, the lord of Rākşasas, the repressor of people and who obtained a boon, lying there, slain by me on your account.

sn: कुम्भकर्मोऽत्र निहतः प्रहस्तश्च निशाचरः। धूम्राक्षश्चात्र निहतो वानरेण हनूमता॥
en: Kumbhakarna was slain there, the night ranger Prahasta, as well, and Dumraksa, were slain by the monkey Hanuman.

sn: विद्युन्माली हतश्चात्र सुषेणेन महात्मना। लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिच्चात्र रावणिनिहतो रणे॥
en: Vidyunmāli was slain there by the high souled Susena-and Indrajit, the son of Ravana, was slain there in the encounter, by Laksmana.

sn: अङ्गदेनात्र निहतो विकटो नाम राक्षसः। विरूपाक्षश्च दुष्प्रेक्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ।।।।
en: The Rākşasa named Vikața was slain there by Angada-and Virūpākșa, hard to look at and Mahāpārśva and Mahodara.

sn: अकम्पनश्च निहतो बलिनोऽन्ये च राक्षसाः। त्रिशिराश्चातिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ॥ युद्धोन्मत्तश्च मत्तश्च राक्षसप्रवरावुभौ। निकुम्भश्चैव कुम्भश्च कुम्भकर्णात्मजौ बली॥ वज्रदंष्ट्रश्च दंष्ट्रश्च बहवो राक्षसा हताः। मकराक्षश्च दुर्धर्षो मया युधि निपातितः॥
en: The powerful Akampana was slain (there) and all other Raksasas-Trisira, Atikaya, Devāntaka and Narāntaka-and the two leading and powerful Rākşasas, mad after conflict-the sons of Kumbhakarna Nikumbha and Kumbha, Vajradanşțra, Danstra and many other Räkşasas were slain and the irrepressible Makarākṣa was slain (there) by me in the conflict.

sn: अकम्पनश्च निहतः शोणिताक्षश्च वीर्यवान्। यूपाक्षश्च प्रजङ्घश्च निहतौ तु महाहवे॥
en: Akampana was slain and the powerful Sonitakşaa. And Yüpākṣa and Prajangha were destroyed (there) in the great conflict.

sn: विद्युज्जिह्वोऽत्र निहतो राक्षसो भीमदर्शनः। यज्ञशत्रुश्च निहतः सुप्तघ्नश्च महाबलः॥
en: The grim-visaged Räkşasa Vidyutjihva was slain there and Yajñaśatru and highly powerful Suptaghna.

sn: सूर्यशत्रुश्च निहतो ब्रह्मशत्रुस्तथापरः। अत्र मन्दोदरी नाम भार्या तं पर्यदेवयत्॥ सपत्नीनां सहस्रेण साग्रेण परिवारिता।
en: (And there was slain) Suryaśatru and Brahmaśatru (And there bewailed for Rāvana) his spouse Mandodarī, surrounded by his thousand other wives.

sn: एतत्तु दृश्यते तीर्थ समुद्रस्य वरानने॥ यत्र सागरमुत्तीर्य तां रात्रिमुषिता वयम्।
en: O you having an excellent countenance, do you behold the descending place of the ocean, where I spent the night after crossing the deep for you.

sn: एष सेतुर्मया बद्धः सागरे लवणार्णवे॥ तव हेतोर्विशालाक्षि नलसेतुः सुदुष्करः।
en: O you having expansive eyes, for you, this difficult construction of the bridge was made by me over the deep by the help of Nala.

sn: पश्य सागरमक्षोभ्यं वैदेहि वरुणालयम्॥ अपारमिव गर्जन्तं शङ्खशुक्तिसमाकुलम्।
en: Do you O Vaidehī, behold the unagitated deep-the abode of Varuņa, appearing as if without the other end, roaring and abounding in conchs and pearl oysters.

sn: हिरण्यनाभं शैलेन्द्रं काञ्चनं पश्य मैथिलि॥ विश्रमार्थं हनुमतो भित्त्वा सागरमुत्थितम्।
en: O Maithili, do you behold the golden mount, which rose above the deep for affording a resting place to Hanumăn.

sn: एतत्कुक्षौ समुद्रस्य स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम्॥ अत्र पूर्व महादेवः प्रसादमकरोद्विभुः।
en: On the bank of this ocean I halted with my soldiers. And here Mahadeva, the lord of the celestials, was propitiated with me.

sn: एतत्तु दृश्यते तीर्थ सागरस्य महात्मनः॥ सेतुबन्ध इति ख्यातं त्रैलोक्येन च पूजितम्। एतत्पवित्रं परमं महापातकनाशनम्॥ अत्र राक्षसराजोऽयमाजगाम विभीषणः।
en: It behove you to behold this descending place as of the high souled Ocean, known Setubandha,* worshipped of the three worlds, highly sacred and destroying even the worst sin. There, Vibhīsaņa, the king of Rākşasas first came to me. *This is still to be seen in the shape of a delapidated bridge near Rameswar a place of pilgrimage. Pilgrims go there Via Madura, a district in South Madras. The Raja of Ramnud in whose Zemindarī it is situate is called Setupati.

sn: एषा सा दृश्यते सीते किष्किन्धा चित्रकानना ॥ सुग्रीवस्य पुरी रम्या यत्र वाली मया हतः।
en: Do you behold, O Sita, Kiskindha, having beautiful gardens, the pleasant city of Sugrīva, where Vālī was slain by me.

sn: अथ दृष्ट्वा पुरी सीता किष्किन्धां वालिपालिताम्॥ अब्रवीत् प्रश्रितं वाक्यं रामं प्रणयसाध्वसा।
en: Beholding the city of Kişkindhā, ruled over by Vālī, Sitā, incited by her love, addressed Rāma, with worthy words, saying

sn: सुग्रीवप्रियभार्याभिस्ताराप्रमुखतो नृप॥ अन्येषां वानरेन्द्राणां स्त्रीभिः परिवृता ह्यहम्। गन्तुमिच्छे सहायोध्यां राजधानी त्वया सह॥
en: O king, I wish to repair to Ayodhyā your capital with you, in the company of Tārā, the dear wife of Sugrīva as well as of the wives of other leading monkeys.

sn: एवमुक्तोऽथ वैदेह्या राघवः प्रत्युवाच ताम्। एवमस्त्विति किष्किन्धां प्राप्य संस्थाप्य राघवः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Vaidehi Rāghava replied-saying, "this shall be done" and getting at Kişkindhă he stopped the car. And having beheld the car stationed he spoke to Sugriva, saying.

sn: विमानं प्रेक्ष्य सुग्रीवं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह। ब्रूहि वानरशार्दूल सर्वान्वानरपुङ्गवान्॥ स्त्रीभिः परिवृताः सर्वे ह्ययोध्यां यान्तु सीतया। तथा त्वमेभिः सर्वाभिः स्त्रीभिः सह महाबल।२८।। अभित्वरय सुग्रीव गच्छामः प्लवगाधिप।
en: O foremost of monkeys, do you speak to all the leading monkeys that they may go to Ayodhyā accompanied by their wives. O you of great strength they may all go with Sīta. Do you hurry them on, O Sugrīva. We shall (soon) go, O you the lord of monkeys.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामेणामिततेजसा॥ वानराधिपतिः श्रीमांस्तैश्च सर्वैः समावृतः। प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं शीघ्रं तारामुद्वीक्ष्य सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, of unmitigated prowess-the beautiful lord of monkeys, encircled by them, entered speedily the inner apartment and beholding lārā there, said.

sn: प्रिये त्वं सह नारीणां वानराणां महात्मनाम्। राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता मैथिलीप्रियकाम्यया॥ त्वर त्वमभिगच्छामो गृह्य वानरयोषितः। अयोध्यां दर्शयिष्यामः सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः॥
en: O dear, at the command of Rāghava and the kind desire of Sītā, do you soon go, taking with you the wives of all the high-souled monkeys. We shall see Ayodhyā and the wives of Dasaratha.

sn: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तारा सर्वाङ्गशोभना। आहूय चाब्रवीत्सर्वा वानराणां तु योषितः॥
en: Hearing the words of Sugrīva, Tårā, having a perfectly beautiful person, assembling all the wives of the monkeys, said.

sn: सुग्रीवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता गन्तुं सर्वैश्च वानरैः। मम चापि प्रियं कार्यमयोध्यादर्शनेन च॥ प्रवेशं चैव रामस्य पौरजानपदैः सह। विभूतिं चैव सर्वासां स्त्रीणां दशरथस्य च॥
en: You have been ordered by Sugrīva to repair (to Ayodhyā) with the monkeys; to behold Ayodhyā, is also a dear object of mine. (“I shall behold) Rāma enter the city with the citizens and villagers and the wealth and riches of the wives of Dasaratha.

sn: तारया चाभ्यनुज्ञाताः सर्वा वानरयोषितः। नेपथ्यविधिपूर्वं तु कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्॥ अध्यारोहन्विमानं तत्सीतादर्शनकाझ्या।
en: Being thus commanded by Tārā, the wives of the monkeys, putting on all their ornaments and circumamubulating (her) ascended the car, with a view to behold Sitā.

sn: ताभिः सहोत्थितं शीघ्रं विमानं प्रेक्ष्य राघवः॥ ऋष्यमूकसमीपे तु वैदेहीं पुनरब्रवीत्।
en: Beholding the car going up with them all, Rāghava again spoke to Sītā, near the mount Rishyamuka, saying.

sn: दृश्यतेऽसौ महान्सीते सविद्युदिव तोयदः॥ ऋष्यमूको गिरिवरः काञ्चनैर्धातुभिर्वृतः।
en: Do you behold there, O Sītā, the huge and foremost mount Rishyamuka abounding in gold and various metals, like to clouds accompanied with lightnings.

sn: अत्राहं वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण समागतः॥ समयश्च कृतः सीते वधार्थ वालिनो मया।
en: There I was joined by Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys. And there I entered into an agreement, O Sita, for the destruction of Vali.

sn: एषा सा दृश्यते पम्पा नलिनीचित्रकानना॥ त्वया विहीनो यत्राहं विललाप सुदुःखितः।
en: There is (the lake) Pampa abounding in lilies and skirted by picturesque forest where separated from you, I bewailed piteously.

sn: अस्यास्तीरे मया दृष्टा शबरी धर्मचारिणी॥ अत्र योजनबाहुश्च कबन्धो निहतो मया।
en: And on its bank I beheld the pious Savari. And you I slew Kabandha and Yojanabāhu.

sn: दृश्यतेऽसौ जनस्थाने श्रीमान्सीते वनस्पतिः।॥ जटायुश्च महातेजास्तव हेतोविलासिनि। रावणेन हतो यत्र पक्षिणां प्रवरो बली॥
en: Behold there, O Sítā, a beautiful tree, in janasthāna, where, O you ever used to luxuries, for you, the highly powerful and energetic Jag ayu, the foremost of birds, was slain by Ravana.

sn: एतत्तदाश्रमपदमस्माकं वरवर्णिनि। पर्णशाला तथा चित्रा दृश्यते शुभदर्शने॥ यत्र त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन हृता बलात्।
en: Do you behold there, O you of a beautiful person, O you of auspicious looks, our hermitage and the beautiful cottage of leaves, where from you had been carried away by force by the lord of Raksasas.

sn: एषा गोदावरी रम्या प्रसन्नसलिला शुभा॥ अगस्त्यस्याश्रमश्चैव दृश्यते कदलीवृतः।
en: Do you behold there the beautiful and sacred river Godāvarī having clear water and the hermitage of Agastya, surrounded by plantain trees.

sn: दृश्यते चैव वैदेहि शरभङ्गाश्रमो महान्॥ उपायतः सहस्राक्षो यत्र शक्रः पुरंदरः। एते ते तापसा देवि दृश्यन्ते तनुमध्यमे॥
en: Do you behold there, O Vaidehi, the great hermitage of Sarabhanga, where came the thousand-eyed, Sakra, the subduer of enemies cities.

sn: अत्रिः कुलपतिर्यत्र सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमः। अस्मिन्देशे महाकायो विराधो निहतो मया॥ अत्र सीते त्वया दृष्टा तापसी धर्मचारिणी। असौ सुतनु शैलेन्द्रश्चित्रकूटः प्रकाशते।॥
en: O worshipful dame, O you having a middle stature-among all those ascetics you behold, there lived Atri, the lord of our familyresembling the fire of the Sun. There was slain the huge bodied Biradha by me. There you did behold, O Sītā, the female astectic (the wife of Attri) ever performing pious observances.

sn: अत्र मां कैकयीपुत्रः प्रसादयितुमागतः। एषा सा यमुना रम्या दृश्यते चित्रकानना॥
en: There come in view, O you having a beautiful person, the king of mountains, Citrakūta, where to propitiate me, came the son of Kaikey.

sn: भरद्वाजाश्रमः श्रीमान्दृश्यते चैष मैथिलि। इयं च दृश्यते गङ्गा पुण्या त्रिपथगा नदी॥
en: Behold the beautiful Yamunā, Yamunā, having picturesque forest on its bank and the pleasant hermitage of Bharadvāja. Behold there the sacred river Ganges, dividing itself into three branches.

sn: शृङ्गबेरपुरं चैतद्गृहो यत्र सखा मम। एषा सा दृश्यते सीते राजधानी पितुर्मम।। अयोध्यां कुरु वैदेहि प्रणामं पुनरागता ॥
en: Behold there the city of ſîngavera, where I made friendship with Guha. Behold there, O Sītā, the capital of my father. Do you bow to Ayodhya, O Vaidehi.

sn: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे राक्षसाः सविभीषणाः। उत्पत्योत्पत्य संहृष्टास्तां पुरीं ददृशुस्तदा॥
en: Thereupon all the monkeys and Rākşasas along with Vibhīşaņa rose up delightedly and saw the city.

sn: ततस्तु तां पाण्डुरहर्नामालिनी विशालकक्ष्यां गजवाजिभिवृताम्। पुरीमपश्यन्प्लवगाः सराक्षसाः पुरी महेन्द्रस्य यथामरावतीम्॥
en: Thereupon the monkeys and Rākşasas beheld the city abounding in white houses having spacious compartments, filled with elephants and horses and looking like Amarāvati, the capital of Mahendra.

sn: अनुज्ञातं तु रामेण तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्। हंसयुक्तं महानादमुत्पपात विहायसम्॥
en: Being commanded by Räma, that excellent car, drawn by ganders, with a huge noise, rose high up in the welkin.

sn: पातयित्वा ततश्चक्षुः सर्वतो रघुनन्दनः। अब्रवीन्मैथिली सीतां रामः शशिनिभाननाम्।२।।
en: Casting his looks on all sides, Rama, the descendant of Raghus, spoke to Sītā, the daughter of the kind of Mithila, having a moonlike countenance, saying.

sn: कैलासशिखराकारे त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थिताम्। लङ्कामीक्षस्व वैदेहि निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा॥
en: O Vaidehi, do you behold Lanka, situate on the summit of the mount Citrakūta, resembling that of Kailasa and constructed by Viswakarma.

sn: एतदायोधनं पश्य मांसशोणितकर्दमम्। हरीणां राक्षसानां च सीते विशसनं महत्॥
en: Behold, O Sītā, that huge arena of battle, bathed in the blood and flesh of the monkeys and Raksasas.

sn: एष दत्तवरः शेते प्रमाथी राक्षसेश्वरः। तव हेतोविशालाक्षि निहतो रावणो मया॥
en: Do you behold, O you having expansive eyes, Rāvaņa, the lord of Rākşasas, the repressor of people and who obtained a boon, lying there, slain by me on your account.

sn: कुम्भकर्मोऽत्र निहतः प्रहस्तश्च निशाचरः। धूम्राक्षश्चात्र निहतो वानरेण हनूमता॥
en: Kumbhakarna was slain there, the night ranger Prahasta, as well, and Dumraksa, were slain by the monkey Hanuman.

sn: विद्युन्माली हतश्चात्र सुषेणेन महात्मना। लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिच्चात्र रावणिनिहतो रणे॥
en: Vidyunmāli was slain there by the high souled Susena-and Indrajit, the son of Ravana, was slain there in the encounter, by Laksmana.

sn: अङ्गदेनात्र निहतो विकटो नाम राक्षसः। विरूपाक्षश्च दुष्प्रेक्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ।।।।
en: The Rākşasa named Vikața was slain there by Angada-and Virūpākșa, hard to look at and Mahāpārśva and Mahodara.

sn: अकम्पनश्च निहतो बलिनोऽन्ये च राक्षसाः। त्रिशिराश्चातिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ॥ युद्धोन्मत्तश्च मत्तश्च राक्षसप्रवरावुभौ। निकुम्भश्चैव कुम्भश्च कुम्भकर्णात्मजौ बली॥ वज्रदंष्ट्रश्च दंष्ट्रश्च बहवो राक्षसा हताः। मकराक्षश्च दुर्धर्षो मया युधि निपातितः॥
en: The powerful Akampana was slain (there) and all other Raksasas-Trisira, Atikaya, Devāntaka and Narāntaka-and the two leading and powerful Rākşasas, mad after conflict-the sons of Kumbhakarna Nikumbha and Kumbha, Vajradanşțra, Danstra and many other Räkşasas were slain and the irrepressible Makarākṣa was slain (there) by me in the conflict.

sn: अकम्पनश्च निहतः शोणिताक्षश्च वीर्यवान्। यूपाक्षश्च प्रजङ्घश्च निहतौ तु महाहवे॥
en: Akampana was slain and the powerful Sonitakşaa. And Yüpākṣa and Prajangha were destroyed (there) in the great conflict.

sn: विद्युज्जिह्वोऽत्र निहतो राक्षसो भीमदर्शनः। यज्ञशत्रुश्च निहतः सुप्तघ्नश्च महाबलः॥
en: The grim-visaged Räkşasa Vidyutjihva was slain there and Yajñaśatru and highly powerful Suptaghna.

sn: सूर्यशत्रुश्च निहतो ब्रह्मशत्रुस्तथापरः। अत्र मन्दोदरी नाम भार्या तं पर्यदेवयत्॥ सपत्नीनां सहस्रेण साग्रेण परिवारिता।
en: (And there was slain) Suryaśatru and Brahmaśatru (And there bewailed for Rāvana) his spouse Mandodarī, surrounded by his thousand other wives.

sn: एतत्तु दृश्यते तीर्थ समुद्रस्य वरानने॥ यत्र सागरमुत्तीर्य तां रात्रिमुषिता वयम्।
en: O you having an excellent countenance, do you behold the descending place of the ocean, where I spent the night after crossing the deep for you.

sn: एष सेतुर्मया बद्धः सागरे लवणार्णवे॥ तव हेतोर्विशालाक्षि नलसेतुः सुदुष्करः।
en: O you having expansive eyes, for you, this difficult construction of the bridge was made by me over the deep by the help of Nala.

sn: पश्य सागरमक्षोभ्यं वैदेहि वरुणालयम्॥ अपारमिव गर्जन्तं शङ्खशुक्तिसमाकुलम्।
en: Do you O Vaidehī, behold the unagitated deep-the abode of Varuņa, appearing as if without the other end, roaring and abounding in conchs and pearl oysters.

sn: हिरण्यनाभं शैलेन्द्रं काञ्चनं पश्य मैथिलि॥ विश्रमार्थं हनुमतो भित्त्वा सागरमुत्थितम्।
en: O Maithili, do you behold the golden mount, which rose above the deep for affording a resting place to Hanumăn.

sn: एतत्कुक्षौ समुद्रस्य स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम्॥ अत्र पूर्व महादेवः प्रसादमकरोद्विभुः।
en: On the bank of this ocean I halted with my soldiers. And here Mahadeva, the lord of the celestials, was propitiated with me.

sn: एतत्तु दृश्यते तीर्थ सागरस्य महात्मनः॥ सेतुबन्ध इति ख्यातं त्रैलोक्येन च पूजितम्। एतत्पवित्रं परमं महापातकनाशनम्॥ अत्र राक्षसराजोऽयमाजगाम विभीषणः।
en: It behove you to behold this descending place as of the high souled Ocean, known Setubandha,* worshipped of the three worlds, highly sacred and destroying even the worst sin. There, Vibhīsaņa, the king of Rākşasas first came to me. *This is still to be seen in the shape of a delapidated bridge near Rameswar a place of pilgrimage. Pilgrims go there Via Madura, a district in South Madras. The Raja of Ramnud in whose Zemindarī it is situate is called Setupati.

sn: एषा सा दृश्यते सीते किष्किन्धा चित्रकानना ॥ सुग्रीवस्य पुरी रम्या यत्र वाली मया हतः।
en: Do you behold, O Sita, Kiskindha, having beautiful gardens, the pleasant city of Sugrīva, where Vālī was slain by me.

sn: अथ दृष्ट्वा पुरी सीता किष्किन्धां वालिपालिताम्॥ अब्रवीत् प्रश्रितं वाक्यं रामं प्रणयसाध्वसा।
en: Beholding the city of Kişkindhā, ruled over by Vālī, Sitā, incited by her love, addressed Rāma, with worthy words, saying

sn: सुग्रीवप्रियभार्याभिस्ताराप्रमुखतो नृप॥ अन्येषां वानरेन्द्राणां स्त्रीभिः परिवृता ह्यहम्। गन्तुमिच्छे सहायोध्यां राजधानी त्वया सह॥
en: O king, I wish to repair to Ayodhyā your capital with you, in the company of Tārā, the dear wife of Sugrīva as well as of the wives of other leading monkeys.

sn: एवमुक्तोऽथ वैदेह्या राघवः प्रत्युवाच ताम्। एवमस्त्विति किष्किन्धां प्राप्य संस्थाप्य राघवः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Vaidehi Rāghava replied-saying, "this shall be done" and getting at Kişkindhă he stopped the car. And having beheld the car stationed he spoke to Sugriva, saying.

sn: विमानं प्रेक्ष्य सुग्रीवं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह। ब्रूहि वानरशार्दूल सर्वान्वानरपुङ्गवान्॥ स्त्रीभिः परिवृताः सर्वे ह्ययोध्यां यान्तु सीतया। तथा त्वमेभिः सर्वाभिः स्त्रीभिः सह महाबल।२८।। अभित्वरय सुग्रीव गच्छामः प्लवगाधिप।
en: O foremost of monkeys, do you speak to all the leading monkeys that they may go to Ayodhyā accompanied by their wives. O you of great strength they may all go with Sīta. Do you hurry them on, O Sugrīva. We shall (soon) go, O you the lord of monkeys.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामेणामिततेजसा॥ वानराधिपतिः श्रीमांस्तैश्च सर्वैः समावृतः। प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं शीघ्रं तारामुद्वीक्ष्य सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, of unmitigated prowess-the beautiful lord of monkeys, encircled by them, entered speedily the inner apartment and beholding lārā there, said.

sn: प्रिये त्वं सह नारीणां वानराणां महात्मनाम्। राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता मैथिलीप्रियकाम्यया॥ त्वर त्वमभिगच्छामो गृह्य वानरयोषितः। अयोध्यां दर्शयिष्यामः सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः॥
en: O dear, at the command of Rāghava and the kind desire of Sītā, do you soon go, taking with you the wives of all the high-souled monkeys. We shall see Ayodhyā and the wives of Dasaratha.

sn: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तारा सर्वाङ्गशोभना। आहूय चाब्रवीत्सर्वा वानराणां तु योषितः॥
en: Hearing the words of Sugrīva, Tårā, having a perfectly beautiful person, assembling all the wives of the monkeys, said.

sn: सुग्रीवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता गन्तुं सर्वैश्च वानरैः। मम चापि प्रियं कार्यमयोध्यादर्शनेन च॥ प्रवेशं चैव रामस्य पौरजानपदैः सह। विभूतिं चैव सर्वासां स्त्रीणां दशरथस्य च॥
en: You have been ordered by Sugrīva to repair (to Ayodhyā) with the monkeys; to behold Ayodhyā, is also a dear object of mine. (“I shall behold) Rāma enter the city with the citizens and villagers and the wealth and riches of the wives of Dasaratha.

sn: तारया चाभ्यनुज्ञाताः सर्वा वानरयोषितः। नेपथ्यविधिपूर्वं तु कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्॥ अध्यारोहन्विमानं तत्सीतादर्शनकाझ्या।
en: Being thus commanded by Tārā, the wives of the monkeys, putting on all their ornaments and circumamubulating (her) ascended the car, with a view to behold Sitā.

sn: ताभिः सहोत्थितं शीघ्रं विमानं प्रेक्ष्य राघवः॥ ऋष्यमूकसमीपे तु वैदेहीं पुनरब्रवीत्।
en: Beholding the car going up with them all, Rāghava again spoke to Sītā, near the mount Rishyamuka, saying.

sn: दृश्यतेऽसौ महान्सीते सविद्युदिव तोयदः॥ ऋष्यमूको गिरिवरः काञ्चनैर्धातुभिर्वृतः।
en: Do you behold there, O Sītā, the huge and foremost mount Rishyamuka abounding in gold and various metals, like to clouds accompanied with lightnings.

sn: अत्राहं वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण समागतः॥ समयश्च कृतः सीते वधार्थ वालिनो मया।
en: There I was joined by Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys. And there I entered into an agreement, O Sita, for the destruction of Vali.

sn: एषा सा दृश्यते पम्पा नलिनीचित्रकानना॥ त्वया विहीनो यत्राहं विललाप सुदुःखितः।
en: There is (the lake) Pampa abounding in lilies and skirted by picturesque forest where separated from you, I bewailed piteously.

sn: अस्यास्तीरे मया दृष्टा शबरी धर्मचारिणी॥ अत्र योजनबाहुश्च कबन्धो निहतो मया।
en: And on its bank I beheld the pious Savari. And you I slew Kabandha and Yojanabāhu.

sn: दृश्यतेऽसौ जनस्थाने श्रीमान्सीते वनस्पतिः।॥ जटायुश्च महातेजास्तव हेतोविलासिनि। रावणेन हतो यत्र पक्षिणां प्रवरो बली॥
en: Behold there, O Sítā, a beautiful tree, in janasthāna, where, O you ever used to luxuries, for you, the highly powerful and energetic Jag ayu, the foremost of birds, was slain by Ravana.

sn: एतत्तदाश्रमपदमस्माकं वरवर्णिनि। पर्णशाला तथा चित्रा दृश्यते शुभदर्शने॥ यत्र त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन हृता बलात्।
en: Do you behold there, O you of a beautiful person, O you of auspicious looks, our hermitage and the beautiful cottage of leaves, where from you had been carried away by force by the lord of Raksasas.

sn: एषा गोदावरी रम्या प्रसन्नसलिला शुभा॥ अगस्त्यस्याश्रमश्चैव दृश्यते कदलीवृतः।
en: Do you behold there the beautiful and sacred river Godāvarī having clear water and the hermitage of Agastya, surrounded by plantain trees.

sn: दृश्यते चैव वैदेहि शरभङ्गाश्रमो महान्॥ उपायतः सहस्राक्षो यत्र शक्रः पुरंदरः। एते ते तापसा देवि दृश्यन्ते तनुमध्यमे॥
en: Do you behold there, O Vaidehi, the great hermitage of Sarabhanga, where came the thousand-eyed, Sakra, the subduer of enemies cities.

sn: अत्रिः कुलपतिर्यत्र सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमः। अस्मिन्देशे महाकायो विराधो निहतो मया॥ अत्र सीते त्वया दृष्टा तापसी धर्मचारिणी। असौ सुतनु शैलेन्द्रश्चित्रकूटः प्रकाशते।॥
en: O worshipful dame, O you having a middle stature-among all those ascetics you behold, there lived Atri, the lord of our familyresembling the fire of the Sun. There was slain the huge bodied Biradha by me. There you did behold, O Sītā, the female astectic (the wife of Attri) ever performing pious observances.

sn: अत्र मां कैकयीपुत्रः प्रसादयितुमागतः। एषा सा यमुना रम्या दृश्यते चित्रकानना॥
en: There come in view, O you having a beautiful person, the king of mountains, Citrakūta, where to propitiate me, came the son of Kaikey.

sn: भरद्वाजाश्रमः श्रीमान्दृश्यते चैष मैथिलि। इयं च दृश्यते गङ्गा पुण्या त्रिपथगा नदी॥
en: Behold the beautiful Yamunā, Yamunā, having picturesque forest on its bank and the pleasant hermitage of Bharadvāja. Behold there the sacred river Ganges, dividing itself into three branches.

sn: शृङ्गबेरपुरं चैतद्गृहो यत्र सखा मम। एषा सा दृश्यते सीते राजधानी पितुर्मम।। अयोध्यां कुरु वैदेहि प्रणामं पुनरागता ॥
en: Behold there the city of ſîngavera, where I made friendship with Guha. Behold there, O Sītā, the capital of my father. Do you bow to Ayodhya, O Vaidehi.

sn: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे राक्षसाः सविभीषणाः। उत्पत्योत्पत्य संहृष्टास्तां पुरीं ददृशुस्तदा॥
en: Thereupon all the monkeys and Rākşasas along with Vibhīşaņa rose up delightedly and saw the city.

sn: ततस्तु तां पाण्डुरहर्नामालिनी विशालकक्ष्यां गजवाजिभिवृताम्। पुरीमपश्यन्प्लवगाः सराक्षसाः पुरी महेन्द्रस्य यथामरावतीम्॥
en: Thereupon the monkeys and Rākşasas beheld the city abounding in white houses having spacious compartments, filled with elephants and horses and looking like Amarāvati, the capital of Mahendra.

sn: अयोध्यां तु समालोक्य चिन्तयामास राघवः। प्रियकामः प्रियं रामस्ततस्त्वरितविक्रमः॥
en: Thereupon beholding Ayodhyā, Råma, the descendant of Raghu, of light movements and desirous of affording delight to others, thought of welcoming (them).

sn: चिन्तयित्वा ततो दृष्टिं वानरेषु न्यपातयत्। उवाच धीमांस्तेजस्वी हनूमन्तं प्लवंगमम्॥
en: Thinking thus the intelligent and effulgent (Rāma) cast his looks towards the monkeys and spoke to Hanumān, saying.

sn: अयोध्यां त्वरितो गत्वा शीघ्रं प्लवगसत्तम। जानीहि कच्चित्कुशली जनो नृपतिमन्दिरे॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, speedily repairing to Ayodhyā do you learn of the welfare of all people in the palace of the king.

sn: शृङ्गवेरपुरं प्राप्य गुहं गहनगोचरम्। निषादाधिपतिं ब्रूहि कुशलं वचनान्मम्॥
en: Arriving at the city of Śộngavera, do you communicate to Guha, the king of Nişādas* having the forest as his kingdom, my well-being, at my command. *A low cast aboriginal Hindu corresponding to our Cāņdālas always living in the forest. The Raja of Ramnud in the district of Madura in Madras traces his descent from this Guha.

sn: श्रुत्वा तु मां कुशलिनमरोगं विगतज्वरम्। भविष्यति गुहः प्रीतः सममात्मसभः सखा॥
en: Hearing that I am hale and hearty and relieved of all troubles, Guha, my friend like my own self, shall attain to delight.

sn: अयोध्यायाश्च ते मार्ग प्रवृत्तिं भरतस्य च। निवेदयिष्यति प्रीतो निषादाधिपतिर्मुहः॥
en: Guha, the lord of Nişādhas, delighted, shall inform you of the way to Ayodhyā and the well being of Bharata.

sn: भरतस्तु त्वया वाच्यः कुशलं वचनान्मम। सिद्धार्थ शंस मां तस्मै सभायं सहलक्ष्मणम्।७।। हरणं चापि वैदेह्या रावणेन बलीयसा। सुग्रीवेण च संवादं बालिनश्च वधं रणे।।। मैथिल्यन्वेषणं चैव यथा चाधिगता त्वया। लवयित्वा महातोयमापगापतिमव्ययम्॥ उपयानं समुद्रस्य सागरस्य च दर्शनम्। यथा च कारितः सेतू रावणश्च यथा हतः॥ वरदानं महेन्द्रेण ब्रह्मणा वरुणेन च। महादेवप्रसादाच्च पित्रा मम समागमम्॥
en: Do you ask of Bharata his well being at my words, and communicate to him my (arrival) with Lakşmaņa and my spouse after having made good the vow(of my sire)-the carrying away of Sītā by the powerful Rāvana-the friendship with Sugrīva and the destruction of Vāli in the conflict-the search of Maithili instituted by you having got over the huge lord of rivers-the advance (of the monkeys) to the banks of the deep-the view of the ocean, the construction of the bridge-the destruction of Rāvaņa, the grant of boon by Mahendra, Brahmā and Varuņa-my meeting with my father by the favour of Mahādeva.

sn: उपयातं च मां सौम्य भरताय निवेदय। सह राक्षसराजेन हरीणामीश्वरेण च ॥ जित्वा शत्रुगणारामः प्राप्य चानुत्तमं यशः। उपायाति समृद्धार्थः सह मित्रैर्महाबलैः॥
en: Do you, O gentle one, communicate to Bharata, my arrival here with the lord of Räks and king of monkeys. (Tell him) ‘vanquishing his foes and attaining to excellent fame Rāma has arrived at the gate of the city with his valiant friends, having satisfied the vow (of his sire).

sn: एतच्छुत्वा यमाकारं भजते भरतस्ततः। स च ते वेदितव्यः स्यात्सर्वं यच्चापि मां प्रति॥
en: You should read the signs expressive of joy or asas sorrow that Bharata shall display on hearing this and infer therefrom his attitude towards me.

sn: ज्ञेयाः सर्वे च वृत्तान्ता भरतस्येङ्गितानि च। तत्त्वेन मुखवणेन दृष्ट्या व्याभाषितेन च॥
en: You should know, from the colour of his countenance, his looks and his words, all the movements and actions of Bharata.

sn: सर्वकामसमृद्धं हि हस्त्यश्वरसंकुलम्। पितृपैतामहं राज्यं कस्य नावर्तयेन्मनः॥
en: Whose mind does not change obtaining such an ancestral kingdom, filled with all prosperity and abounding in elephants, horses and chariots?

sn: संगत्या भरतः श्रीमानराज्येनार्थी स्वयं भवेत्। प्रशास्तु वसुधां सर्वामखिलां रघुनन्दनः॥
en: If the effulgent Bharata, the descendant of Raghu, ruling over it, wish the kingdom for himself, let him lord over the entire earth.

sn: तस्य बुद्धिं च विज्ञाय व्यवसायं च वानर। यावन्न दूरं याताः स्मः क्षिप्रमागन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Therefore, O monkey, it behove you to come back speedily apprised of his intention and movements, before we proceed further.

sn: इति प्रतिसमादिष्टो हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। मानुषं धारयन्रूपमयोध्यां त्वरितो ययौ॥
en: Being thus commanded, Hanumān, the son of Wind-god, assuming a human shape speedily proceeded towards Ayodhyā.

sn: अथोत्पपात वेगेन हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। गरुत्मानिव वेगेन जिघृक्षगुरगोत्तमम्॥
en: Hanumān the son of Maruta rose up in the welkin with velocity like to Garuņa ready to fall upon a huge serpent.

sn: लयित्वा पितृपथं विहगेन्द्रालयं शुभम्। गङ्गायमुनयोर्भीमं समतीत्य समागमम्॥ शृङ्गवेरपुरं प्राप्य गुहमासाद्य वार्यवान्। स वाचा शुभया हृष्टो हनूमानिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then crossing the Wind-path and the abode of the birds, getting over the terrible confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā, reaching the city of Śțrgavera and meeting Guha, the energetic Hanumān, delighted (addressed him) with the following excellent words.

sn: सखा तु तव काकुत्स्थो रामः सत्यपराक्रमः। ससीतः सह सौमित्रिः स त्वां कुशलमब्रवीत्॥ पञ्चमीमद्य रजनीमुषित्वा वचनान्मुनेः। भरद्वाजाभ्यनुज्ञातं द्रक्ष्यस्यत्रैव राघवम् ॥
en: Your friend Rāma, the descendant of Kākutstha, having truth for his prowess, with Sītā and son of Sumitrā, has enquired of your welfare. Having spent five nights* till today, he, having obtained permission from the ascetic Bharadvāja, shall proceed to-morrow. *Having spent five nights after the expire of fourteen years old exile be is living at the hermitage of Varadwaja. He shall leave that place tomorrow.

sn: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजाः संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहः। उत्पपात महावेगाद्वेगवानविचारयन्॥
en: Having said this the highly energetic monkey, not caring for the exhaustion of travel, greatly delighted and with hairs erect, rose up with great velocity.

sn: सोऽपश्यद्रामतीर्थं च नदी बालुकिनी तथा। वरूथीं गोमती चैव भीमं शालवनं तथा॥ प्रजाश्च बहुसाहस्रीः स्फीताञ्जनपदानपि। स गत्वा दूरमध्वानं त्वरितः कपिकुञ्जरः॥ आससाद दुमान्फुल्लानन्दिग्रामसमीपगान्। सुराधिपस्योपवने यथा चैत्ररथे दुमान् ॥ स्त्रीभिः सपुत्रैः पौत्रैश्च रममाणैः स्वलंकृतैः।
en: Beholding the holy river sanctified with the name of Parasurama, the rivers-Balukini, Varuthi, Gomati, the huge forest of Sala trees, the various countries populated with thousands of people, and proceeding a great distance speedily, that foremost of monkeys got at the trees near Nandigrāma* like to those of Caitraratha, the garden of the lord of celestials the flowers whereof were being plucked off by many a damsel accompanied by their children decked in various ornaments.

sn: क्रोशमात्रे त्वयोध्यायाश्चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरम्॥ ददर्श भरतं दीनं कृशमाश्रमवासिनम्। जटिलं मलदिग्धाङ्गं भ्रातृव्यसनकर्शितम्॥ फलमूलाशिनं दान्तं तापसं धर्मचारिणम्। समुन्नतजटाभारं वल्कलाजिनवाससम्॥ नियतं भावितात्मानं ब्रह्मर्षिसमतेजसम्। पादुके ते पुरस्कृत्य प्रशासन्तं वसुंधराम्॥ चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य लोकस्य त्रातारं सर्वतो भयात्। उपस्थितममात्यैश्च शुचिभिश्च पुरोहितैः॥ बलमुख्यैश्च युक्तैश्च काषायाम्बरधारिभिः।
en: He saw at a distance of one crosa from Ayodhyā Bharata wearing the skin of an antelope, poorly, greatly reduced, living in a hermitage, wearing matted hairs, having his body covered with dirt, greatly pulled down in consequence of his brother's disaster, living on roots and fruits, self-controlled, living the life of an ascetic, observing pious observances, with a bundle of clotted hairs on his head, wearing bark and deer skin, having control over his passions and senses, effulgent like Brahmarşis, ruling the earth always placing the sandals before him, protecting people of four Varnas against all fear, with courtiers, priests leading a holy life and soldiers all wearing red clothes around him. *The country of Bharata's maternal uncle.

sn: नहि ते राजपुत्रं तं चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरम्॥ परिभोक्तुं व्यवस्यन्ति पौरा वै धर्मवत्सलाः।
en: All those citizens, fond of piety, did not like to use good clothes beholding the prince use bark and deer skin.

sn: तं धर्ममिव धर्मज्ञं देहबन्धमिवापरम्॥ उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः।
en: Thereupon Hanumān, the son of Māruta spoke with folded hands to him, conversant with piety like virtue incarnate, saying.

sn: वसन्तं दण्डकारण्ये यं त्वं चीरजटाधरम्॥ अनुशोचसि काकुत्स्थं स त्वां कौशलमब्रवीत्। प्रियमाख्यामि ते देव शोकं त्यज सुदारुणम्।।३७ अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते भ्रात्रा त्वं रामेण सह संगतः।
en: (He was then sprinkled by) the Rittigas, Brāhmaṇas, maidens enquired after your welfare. Do you, O worshipful sire speak out your welfare and renounce the dreadful grief. You shall in this moment be reconciled to your brother Rāma.

sn: निहत्य रावणं रामः प्रतिलभ्य च मैथिलीम्॥ उपयाति समृद्धार्थः सह मित्रैर्महाबलैः। लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजा वैदेही च यशस्विनी।। सीता समग्रा रामेण महेन्द्रेण शची यथा।३९।।
en: Slaying Ravana, and regaining Maithili, Rāma, having accomplished his end, has arrived here with his valiant friends. The highly effulgent Lakşmaņa and the famed Vaidehi (have also come). Sītā fare well with Rāma like to Sacī in the company of Mahendra.

sn: एवमुक्तो हनुमता भरतः कैकयीसुतः। पपात सहसा हृष्टो हर्षान्मोहमुपागमत्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Hanumān, Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi, delighted, fell down all on a sudden in a swoon of joy.

sn: ततो मुहूर्तादुत्थाय प्रत्याश्वस्य च राघवः। हनूमन्तमुवाचेदं भरतः प्रियवादिनम्॥ अशोकजैः प्रीतिमयैः कपिमालिङ्गय संभ्रमात्। सिषेच भरतः श्रीमान्विपुलैरश्रुबिन्दुभिः।॥
en: Thereupon rising up in no time, and welcoming him, Bharata, the descendant of Raghu, spoke to Hanuman communicating the pleasant tidings, the following words. And embracing the monkey respectfully the graceful Bharata sprinkled him with profuse tears not out of grief but of joy.

sn: देवो न मानुषो वा त्वमनुक्रोशादिहागतः। प्रियाख्यानस्य ते सौम्य ददामि ब्रुवतः प्रियम्।॥ गवां शतसहस्रं च ग्रामाणां च शतं परम्। सकुण्डलाः शुभाचारा भार्याः कन्यास्तु षोडश॥ हेमवर्णाः सुनासोरूः शशिसौम्याननाः स्त्रियः। सर्वाभरणसंपन्नाः संपन्ना कुलजातिभिः॥
en: He said, Are you a man or god who have kindly come here? O gentle one, I shall confer upon you, who have communicated to me this pleasant tidings, hundreds and thousands of kine, hundreds of prosperous villages, sixteen young wives, pious, wearing excellent Kundalas, golden-hued, having beautiful noses and breast, having mor i like countenances, decked with all ornaments and born of respectable families.

sn: निशम्य रागागमनं नृपात्मजः कपिप्रवीरस्य तदाद्भुतोपमम्। पुनश्च हर्षादिदमब्रवीद्वचः॥
en: And hearing from that leading monkey of that wonderful return of Rāma, the son of the king, delighted became anxious to behold him and again addressed joyously Hanuman with the following words.

sn: बहूनि नाम वर्षाणि गतस्य सुमहद्वनम्। शृणोम्यहं प्रीतिकरं मम नाथस्य कीर्तनम्॥
en: I hear the tidings of my brother affording me great delight who has been living in the huge forest for many a year.

sn: कल्याणी वत गाथेयं लौकिकी प्रतिभाति माम्। एति जीवन्तमानन्दो नरं वर्षशतादपि॥
en: The saying of the people appear to me as instinct with well meaning that a man, if alive, may attain to joy even after a century.

sn: राघवस्य हरीणां च कथमासीत्समागमः। कस्मिन्देशे किमाश्रित्य तत्त्वमाख्याहि पृच्छतः॥
en: Do you relate truly to me, how and in what country the union between Rāghava and the monkeys was brought about.

sn: स पृष्टो राजपुत्रेण बृस्यां समुपवेशितः। आचचक्षे ततः सर्व रामस्य चरितं वने॥
en: Being thus accosted by the prince and seated on Kusa, he, thereupon, began to describe Rama's life in the forest.

sn: यथा प्रव्राजितो रामो मातुर्दत्तौ वरौ तव। यथा च पुत्रशोकेन राजा दशरथो मृतः॥ यथा दूतैस्त्वमानीतस्तूर्णं राजगृहात्प्रभो। त्वयायोध्यां प्रविष्टेन यथा राज्यं न चेप्सितम्॥ चित्रकूटगिरिं गत्वा राज्येनामित्रकर्शनः। निमन्त्रितस्त्वया भ्राता धर्ममाचरता सताम्॥ स्थितेन राज्ञो वचने यथा राज्यं विसर्जितम्। आर्यस्य पादुके गृह्य यथासि पुनरागतः॥ सर्वमेतन्महाबाहो यथावद्विदितं तव। त्वयि प्रतिप्रयाते तु यद्वृत्तं तन्निबोध मे।।।।
en: How Råma was exiled, the two boons conferred upon your mother, how king Dasaratha died in consequence of (his) sons' grief, how by emissaries, O lord, you were brought up from the house of your maternal uncle, how you did not wish for the kingdom having entered Ayodhya, how your brother, the repressor of enemies, was solicited by you for accepting the kingdom, repairing to the mount Citrakūta, who have ever wended the track of the pious, the renouncement of kingdom (by him) abiding by the words of the king, your return after taking the sandals of your revered (brother), all these, O you of long-arms, are known to you. I shall relate to you all that happened after your return.

sn: अपयाते त्वयि तदा समुद्रान्तमृगद्विजम्। परिघूनमिवात्यर्थं तद्वनं समपद्यत॥ तद्धस्तिमृदितं घोरं सिंहव्याघ्रमृगाकुलम्। प्रविवेशाथ विजनं स महद्दण्डकावनम्॥
en: Yourself having returned thence, all the bird and animals were overwhelmed with terror and that forest appeared as if distressed. Thereupon he entered the solitary and huge and dreadful forest Daņdaka distressed by the elephants and abounding in lion, tigers and deer.

sn: तेषां पुरस्ताद्वलवान्गच्छतां गहने वने। विनदन्सुमहानादं विराधः प्रत्यदृश्यत॥
en: Your entering the dense forest there appeared before them the powerful Virādha* emitting a dreadful sound. *A demon of that name.

sn: तमुत्क्षिप्य महानादमूर्ध्वबाहुमधोमुखम्। निखाते प्रक्षिपन्ति स्म नदन्तमिव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Taking him up roaring aloud like an elephant Rāma threw him with his arms upwards and face downwards into a pit.

sn: तत्कृत्वा दुष्करं कर्म भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। सायाह्ने शरभङ्गस्य रम्यमाश्रममीयतुः॥
en: Having accomplished that difficult work the two brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa, arrived in the evening at the pleasant hermitage of Sarabhanga.

sn: शरभङ्गे दिवं प्राप्ते रामः सत्यपराक्रमः। अभिवाद्य मुनीन्सर्वाञ्जनस्थानमुपागमत्॥
en: Śarabhanga having attained to heaven, Rāma, having truth for his prowess, saluting all the ascetics, repaired to Janasthāna.

sn: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि जनस्थाननिवासिनाम्। हतानि वसता तत्र राघवेण महात्मना॥
en: And by the high-souled Rāghava, living there, fourteen thousand inhabitants of janasthāna were slain.

sn: एकेन सह संगम्य रामेण रणमूर्धनि। अह्रश्चतुर्थभागेन निःशेषा राक्षसाः कृताः॥ महाबला महावीर्यास्तपसो विघ्नकारिणः। निहता राघवेणाजौ दण्डकारण्यवासिनः॥
en: In the company of one person only and at the commencement of the fight, by Rāma, within the one fourth part of a day, were exterminated all the highly powerful and valiant inhabitants of the forest of Dandaka always putting obstructions in the way of the ascetics.

sn: राक्षसाश्च विनिष्पिष्टाः खरश्च निहतो रणे। दूषणं चाग्रतो हत्वा त्रिशिरास्तदनन्तरम्॥
en: All the Raksasas were grinded (to death) by Rāghava. Khara was slain in the conflict; Dūşaņa being slain first Triſiră was slain thereafter by him.

sn: पश्चाच्छूर्पणखा नाम रामपार्श्वमुपागता। ततो रामेण संदिष्टो लक्ष्मणः सहसोत्थितः॥ प्रगृह्य खङ्गं चिच्छेद कर्णनासे महाबलः। ततस्तेनार्दिता बाला रावणं समुपागता॥ रावणानुचरो घोरो मारीचो नाम राक्षसः। लोभयामास वैदेहीं भूत्वा रत्नमयो मृगः॥
en: Thereafter (a she-demon) named Surpanakha, came to the side of Rāma. Thereupon being commanded by Rāma, the highly powerful Lakşmaņa rose up all on a sudden and taking a dagger chopped off her ears and nose. Being thus insulted by him that she-demon came to Rāmana. Thereupor a dreadful Rākşasa named Mārīca-an attendant of Rāvaņa, assuming the shape of a jewelled deer, allured Vaidehī.

sn: सा राममब्रवीदृष्ट्वा वैदेही गृह्यतामिति। अयं मनोहरः कान्त आश्रमो नो भविष्यति॥
en: Beholding it, Vaidehī spoke to Rāma, saying, 'Do you catch it; with it when caught our hermitage shall be more charming'

sn: ततो रामो धनुष्पाणिर्मूगं तमनुधावति। स तं जघान धावन्तं शरेणानतपर्वणा॥
en: Thereupon Rāma, with bow in his hand, pursued that deer and with one shaft destroyed it.

sn: अथ सौम्य दशग्रीवो मृगयां याति राघवे। लक्ष्मणे चापि निष्क्रान्ते प्रविवेशाश्रमं तदा॥
en: O gentle one, Räghava going out on hunting, and Lakṣmaṇa having issued out of the hermitage, the Ten-necked (demon) entered therein.

sn: जग्राह तरसा सीतां ग्रहः खे रोहिणीमिव। त्रातुकामं ततो युद्धे हत्वा गृधं जटायुषम्॥ प्रगृह्य सहसा सीतां जगामाशु स राक्षसः।
en: And he speedily got hold of Sītā, like to Rohiņi possessed by the planet in the sky. Thereupon slaying the vulture Jatayu in the conflict desirous of rescuing her and getting hold of Sītā that Rākşasa speedily repaired (to his capital).

sn: ततस्त्वद्भुतसंकाशाः स्थिताः पर्वतमूर्धनि ॥ सीतां गृहीत्वा गच्छन्तं वानराः पर्वतोपमाः। ददृशुर्विस्मिताकारा रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्॥
en: Thereupon some monkeys resembling mountains, stationed on the summit of a mountain, stricken with wondrous fear and astonishment, beheld Ravana, the lord of Rākşasas proceed with Sītā.

sn: ततः शीघ्रतरं गत्वा तद्विमानं मनोजवम्। आरुह्य सह वैदेह्या पुष्पकं स महाबलः॥ प्रविवेश तदा लङ्कां रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः।
en: Ascending the car Puspaka, going at will with Vaidehi and hastening his course that highly powerful Rāvana, the lord of Rākṣasas entered Lankā.

sn: तां सुवर्णपरिष्कारे शुभे महति वेश्मनि॥ प्रवेश्य मैथिली वाक्यैः सान्त्वयामास रावणः।
en: Entering the huge and excellent golden palace Ravana consoled Maithili with (diverse) words.

sn: तृणवद्भाषितं तस्य तं च नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवम्॥ अचिन्तयन्ती वैदेही ह्यशोकवनिकां गता।
en: But she regarded that foremost of Rākşasas and his words as straw. And Vaidehi was placed in the forest of Asoka.

sn: न्यवर्तत तदा रामो मृगं हत्वा तदा वने॥ निवर्तमानः काकुत्स्थो दृष्ट्वा गृधं स विव्यथे। गृधं हतं तदा दृष्ट्वा रामः प्रियतरं पितुः॥
en: Thereupon returned Rāma after having slain the deer in the forest. Having returned and seen the vulture, dearer than his father, slain, Rāma, the descendant of Kākutstha was pained.

sn: मार्गमाणस्तु वैदेहीं राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः। गोदावरीमनुचरन्वनोद्देशांश्च पुष्पितान्॥ आसेदतुर्महारण्ये कबन्धं नाम राक्षसम्। ततः कबन्धवचनाद्रामः सत्यपराक्रमः॥ ऋष्यमूकगिरं गत्वा सुग्रीवेण समागतः।
en: And searching Vaidehi and ranging at the banks of Godaveri and forest-lands covered with flowers, Rāma with Laksmana, met in that huge forest a Rākşasa named Kabandha. Thereupon at the words of Kabandha, Rāma, having truth for his prowess, repairing to the mount Rishyamuka, was united with Sugrīva.

sn: ततः समागमः पूर्वं प्रीत्या हार्दो व्यजायत॥ भ्राता निरस्तः कुद्धेन सुग्रीवो वालिना पुरा। इतरेतरसंवादात्प्रगाढः प्रणयस्तयोः॥
en: There had grown mutual love in them before they were known to each other. Sugrīva was driven away by his angry brother Váli. And informed of each other's affairs their friendship grew closer.

sn: रामः स्वबाहुवीर्येण स्वराज्यं प्रत्यपादयत्। वालिनं समरे हत्वा महाकायं महाबलम्॥
en: Thereupon slaying the huge-bodied and highly powerful Vāli in the conflict by virtue of the strength of his own arms Rāma obtained (for Sugriva) his own kingdom.

sn: सुग्रीवः स्थापितो राज्ये सहितः सर्ववानरैः। रामाय प्रतिजानीते राजपुत्र्यास्तु मार्गणम्॥
en: Being placed on the throne with all the monkeys, Sugrīva promised to Rāma the enquiry of the Princess (Sītā).

sn: आदिष्टा वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण महात्मना। दश कोट्यः प्लवंगानां सर्वाः प्रस्थापिता दिशः॥
en: Being commanded by the high-souled Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys, ten koțis of monkeys repaired to (various) quarters.

sn: तेषां नो विप्रनष्टानां विन्ध्ये पर्वतसत्तमे। भृशं शोकाभितप्तानां महान्कालोऽत्यवर्तत॥
en: Among them some of us lost our way in a cavity of the Vindhya mountain, and were stricken with great terror-and accordingly much time was lost.

sn: भ्राता तु गृध्रराजस्य संपातिर्नाम वीर्यवान्। समाख्याति स्म वसती सीतां रावणमन्दिरे।॥
en: The powerful brother of the king of vultures named Sampāti communicated to us the residence of Sītā in the palace of Rāvaņa.

sn: सोऽहं दुःखपरीतानां दुखं तज्ज्ञातिनां नुदन्। आत्मवीयं समास्थाय योजनानां शतं प्लुतः।। तत्राहमेकामद्राक्षमशोकवनिकां गताम्॥ कौशेयवस्त्रां मलिनां निरानन्दां दृढव्रताम्। तया समेत्य विधिवत्पृष्ट्वा सर्वमनिन्दिताम्॥ अभिज्ञानं मया दत्तं रामनामाङ्गुलीयकम्। अभिज्ञानं मणिं लब्ध्वा चरितार्थोऽहमागतः॥
en: Thereupon removing the grief of my relatives stricken with sorrow and resorting to my own prowess, I jumped over hundred yayanas and beheld her placed in the forest of Asoka, wearing a red cloth, pale, deprived of all joy and observing strict penances. And then nearing her and beholding her of a perfectly blameless person I bestowed upon her an ensign a ring with Rāma's name engraven on it. And obtaining a jewel as an ensign, I, with my object accomplished, returned.

sn: मया च पुनरागम्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। अभिज्ञानं मया दत्तमर्चिष्मान्स महामणिः॥
en: Having returned I presented Råma of unwearied actions with that ensign of a brilliant gem.

sn: श्रुत्वा तां मैथिली रामस्त्वाशशंसे च जीवितम्। जीवितान्तमनुप्राप्तः पीत्वामृतमिवातुरः॥
en: Hearing (of the news of Vaidehi) Rama regained his life like one on the verge of death regaining his being after drinking nectar.

sn: उद्योजययिष्यनुद्योगं दधे लङ्कावधे मनः। जिघांसुरिव लोकान्ते सँल्लिोकान्विभावसुः॥
en: And exciting (his soldiers) for making preparations like to Fire about to destroy all people he made up his mind for the devastation of Lanka.

sn: ततः समुद्रमासाद्य नलं सेतुमकारयत्। अतरत्कपिवीराणां वाहिनी तेन सेतुना॥
en: Thereupon arriving at the banks of the ocean he had a bridge constructed by Nala by which the army of monkey heroes crossed (the deep).

sn: प्रहस्तमवधीत्रीलः कुम्भकर्णं तु राघवः। लक्ष्मणो रावणसुतं स्वयं रामस्तु रावणम्॥
en: Nala destroyed Prahasta, Rāghava slew Kumbhakarņa, Lakşmaņa killed the son of Rāvana and Rāma himself slew Rāvana.

sn: स शक्रेण समागम्य यमेन वरुणेन च। महेश्वरस्वयंभूभ्यां तथा दशरथेन च॥
en: He was then met by Sakra, Yama, Varuna, Siva, Brahmā and Dasaratha.

sn: तैश्च दत्तवरः श्रीमानृषिभिश्च समागतैः। सुरर्षिभिश्च काकुत्स्थो वरॉल्लेभे परंतपः॥
en: That graceful descendant of Kākutstha, the slayer of foes, obtained the boon from them as well as from the saints assembled there (celestial and otherwise).

sn: स तु दत्तवरः प्रीत्या वानरैश्च समागतः। पुष्पकेण विमानेन किष्किन्धामभ्युपागमत् ॥
en: Having obtained the boon he, delighted, met the monkeys and in the car Puspaka reached Kiskindha.

sn: तां गङ्गां पुनरासाद्य वसन्तं मुनिसंनिधौ। अविघ्नं पुष्ययोगेन श्वो रामं द्रष्टुमर्हसि ॥
en: Again reaching the Ganges he is living with the ascetic; it become you to behold him tomorrow under the auspices of Pushya, without any hindrance.

sn: ततः स वाक्यैर्मधुरैर्हनूमतो निशम्य हृष्टो भरतः कृताञ्जलिः। उवाच वाणी मनसः प्रहर्षिणी चिरस्य पूर्णं खलु मे मनोरथः॥
en: Thereupon being delighted with the sweet accents of Hanumān, Bharata addressed him, with folded hands, with words affording delight, saying, "After a long time my desire has been fulfilled.”

sn: श्रुत्वा तु परमानन्दं भरतः सत्यविक्रमः। हृष्टमाज्ञापयामास शत्रुघ्नं परवीरहा॥
en: Hearing those words affording great delight, Bharata, the slayer of enemies, having truth for his prowess, delighted, ordered Satrughna, (saying).

sn: दैवतानि च सर्वाणि चैत्यानि नगरस्य च। सुगन्धमाल्यैर्वादित्रैरर्चन्तु शुचयो नराः॥
en: Let all people being purified worship all the deities and altars of the city with fragrant garlands and diverse music.

sn: सूताः स्तुतिपुराणज्ञाः सर्वे वैतालिकास्तथा। सर्वे वादित्रकुशला गणिकाश्चैव सर्वशः॥ राजदारास्तथामात्याः सैन्याः सेनाङ्गनागणाः। ब्राह्मणाश्च सराजन्याः श्रेणीमुख्यास्तथा गणाः॥ अभिनिर्यान्तु रामस्य द्रष्टुं शशिनिभं मुखम्।
en: Let all the bards conversant with the chanting of the pedigree, the flatterers, all those conversant with music, the dancing girls, the queens, the courtiers, the soldiers with their wives, Brāhmaṇas, Kşaatryas, and people of all other castes, issue out to behold the moon-like countenance of Rama.

sn: भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नः परवीरहाः॥ विष्टीरनेकसाहस्रीश्चोदयामास भागशः। समीकुरुत निम्नानि विषमाणि समानि च॥ स्थानानि च निरस्यन्तां नन्दिग्रामादितः परम्। सिञ्चन्तु पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां हिमशीतेन वारिणा॥
en: Hearing the words of Bharata, Śatrughna, the slayer of enemies, divided the work among the servants, (saying), "Do you level the high and low ground from nandigram to (Ayodhyā). Do you perfectly water the ground with cold water.

sn: ततोऽभ्यवकिरन्त्वन्ये लाजैः पुष्पैश्च सर्वतः। समुच्छ्रितपताकास्तु रथ्याः पुरवरोत्तमे॥ शोभयन्तु च वेश्मानि सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति। स्रग्दाममुक्तपुष्पैश्च सुवर्णैः पञ्चवर्णकैः॥
en: Thereafter sprinkle all the places with flowers and dried paddy; hoist up flags all over the city; decorate all the houses, before the rising of the moon with garlands, jewels, flowers of gold and things of five other colours.

sn: राजमार्गमसंबाधं किरन्तु शतशो नराः। ततस्तच्छासनं श्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नस्य मुदान्विताः॥ धृष्टिर्जयन्तो विजयः सिद्धार्थश्चार्थसाधकः। अशोको मन्त्रपालश्च सुमन्त्रश्चापि निर्ययुः॥ मत्तैर्नागसहस्रैश्च सध्वजैः सुविभूषितैः।
en: Let hundreds of men watch the thoroughfares. Hearing the command of Satrughna, issued out with delight Dhrsti, Jayanta, Vijaya, Siddartha, Arthasadhaka, Asoka, Mantrapala and Sumantra.

sn: अपरे हेमकक्षाभिः सगजाभिः करेणुभिः॥ निर्ययुस्तुरगाक्रान्ता रथैश्च सुमहारथाः।
en: Thereupon issued out men on horse back and in cars with thousands of mad elephants welldecked with pennons and she-elephants with golden seats (on their back).

sn: शक्त्यष्टिपाशहस्तानां सध्वजानां पताकिनाम्॥ तुरगाणां सहस्रैश्च मुख्यैर्मुख्यतरान्वितैः। पदातीनां सहस्त्रैश्च वीराः परिवृता ययुः॥
en: Some heroes proceeded encircled by thousand excellent steeds and persons carrying Sakti, Rşti, maces and pennons and thousands of infantry.

sn: ततो यानान्युपारूढाः सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः। कौसल्या प्रमुख कृत्वा सुमित्रां चापि निर्ययुः॥ द्विजातिमुख्यैर्धर्मात्मा श्रेणीमुख्यैः सनैगमैः। माल्यमोदकहस्तैश्च मन्त्रिभिर्भरतो वृतः॥ शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च वन्दिभिश्चाभिनन्दितः। आर्यपादौ गृहीत्वा तु शिरसा धर्मकोविदः॥ पाण्डुरं छत्रमादाय शुक्लमाल्योपशोभितम्। शुक्ले च वालव्यजने राजार्हे हेमभूषिते॥ उपवासकृशो दीनश्चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरः। भ्रातुरागमनं श्रुत्वा तत्पूर्व हर्षमागतः॥ प्रत्युद्ययौ तदा रामं महात्मा सचिवैः सह । अश्वानां खुरशब्दैश्च रथनेमिस्वनेन च॥
en: Thereupon proceeded Sumitrā and all other wives of Dasaratha placing kausalya before them and seated in excellent conveyances. And hearing of the return of his brother and attaining to delight, the high-souled and pious Bharata, reduced with fasting poorly, wearing bark and skin of an antelope and conversant with religion, issued out to receive back Räma in the company of his counsellors and encircled by the twice born ones, the people of diverse castes, his own relations and kinsmen and ministers with garlands and Modaka* in their hands, eulogized by the bards, having his arrival announced with the sound of conchs and bugles and placing the sandals of his worshipful brother on his head and taking white umbrella adorned with white garlands and white Chowries decked with gold and worthy of being used by the kings.

sn: शङ्खदुन्दुभिनादेन संचचालेव मेदिनी। गजानां बृंहितैश्चापि शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिःस्वनैः॥ कृत्स्नं तु नगरं तत्तु नन्दिग्राममुपागमत्। समीक्ष्य भरतो वाक्यमुवाच पवनात्मजम्॥
en: Thereupon with the sound of the horses hoofs and cars, conchs and hugles the earth shook. And the whole city went to Nandigrāma. And beholding the Wind-god's son, Bharata said.

sn: कच्चिन्न खलु कापेयी सेव्यते चलचित्तता। नहि पश्यामि काकुत्स्थं राममायं परंतपम्॥
en: Did you not resort to the usual fickleness of the monkeys? We do not behold the worshipful Răma, the descendant of Kākutstha the slayer of foes. Nor do we behold the monkeys assuming shapes at will.

sn: कच्चिन्न चानुदृश्यन्ते कपयः कामरूपिणः। अथैवमुक्ते वचने हनूमानिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having been addressed with those words, Hanumăn replied, communicating to Bharata, having truth for his prowess, the truth.

sn: अर्थ्य विज्ञापयन्नेव भरतं सत्यविक्रमम्। सदाफलान्कुसुमितान्वृक्षान्प्राप्य मधुस्रवान्॥ भरद्वाजप्रसादेन मत्तभ्रमरनादितान्। तस्य चैव वरो दत्तो वासवेन परंतप॥ ससैन्यस्य तदातिथ्यं कृतं सर्वगुणान्वितम्।
en: Having reached the trees, covered by the favour of Bhardvaja, with fruits and flowers and pouring honey, the monkeys are emitting noise like maddened black bees. O slayer of foes, this boon was granted him (Rama ) by Vasava (Bharadvāja) is treating him with his army with all hospitality.

sn: निःस्वनः श्रूयते भीमः प्रहृष्टानां वनौकसाम्॥ मन्ये वानरसेना सा नदी तरति गोमतीम्।
en: Hear the dreadful noise of the delighted monkeys. Methinks the monkey host has crossed the river Gomati.

sn: रजोवर्ष समुद्भूतं पश्य सालवनं प्रति॥ मन्ये सालवनं रम्यं लोलयन्ति प्लवंगमाः। तदेतदृश्यते दूराद्विमानं चन्द्रसन्निभम्॥ विमानं पुष्पकं दिव्यं मनसा ब्रह्मनिर्मितम्। रावणं बान्धवैः सार्धं हत्वा लब्धं महात्मना ॥
en: Behold the huge upheaval of dust towards the Sala forest. Methinks the monkeys are agitating the graceful Săla forest. Behold there at the distance the car resembling the Sun. This celestial car Puspaka, constructed by Brahma's mind, was obtained by the high-souled (Rāma) after having slain Rāvana with his friends.

sn: तरुणादित्यसंकाशं विमानं रामवाहनम्। धनदस्य प्रसादेन दिव्यमेतन्मनोजवम्॥
en: This celestial car, resembling the newly risen Sun, coursing at will and carrying Rāma (was gained) by the favour of the Giver of wealth.

sn: एतस्मिन्भ्रातरौ वीरौ वैदेह्या सह राघवौ। सुग्रीवश्च महातेजा राक्षसश्च विभीषणः॥
en: (There are) the two heroic brothers-the descendants of Raghu with Vaidehi, the highly effulgent Sugriva and the Räkşasa Vibhīşana.

sn: ततो हर्षसमुद्भूतो निःस्वनो दिवमस्पृशत्। स्त्रीबालयुववृद्धानां रामोऽयमिति कीर्तिते॥
en: Thereupon with the sound of there is Rama' there arose a joyous noise reaching the abode of the celestials from among women, children, the young and the old.

sn: रथकुञ्जरवाजिभ्यस्तेऽवतीर्य महीं गताः। ददृशुस्तं विमानस्थं नराः सोममिवाम्बरे॥
en: Thereupon descending upon the earth from chariots, elephants and horses all people beheld him (Rāma) stationed on the car like to the moon in the sky.

sn: प्राञ्जलिर्भरतो भूत्वा प्रहृष्टो राघवोन्मुखः। यथार्थेनार्घ्यपाद्याद्यैस्ततो राममपूजयत्॥
en: Facing Rāghava and with folded hands Bharata delightedly worshipped him with agreeable words, Arghya and water to wash his feet.

sn: मनसा ब्रह्मणा सृष्टे विमाने भरताग्रजः। रराज पृथुदीर्घाक्षो वज्रपाणिरिवामरः॥
en: There appeared in the car constructed by Brahmā's mind the elder brother of Bharata having expansive eyes like the immortal wielder of thunder-bolt.

sn: ततो विमानाग्रगतं भरतो भ्रातरं तदा। ववन्दे प्रणतो रामं मेरुस्थमिव भास्करम्॥
en: Thereupon Bharata humbly saluted his brother Rāma seated on the top of the car like to the Sun on the summit (of the mount Meru).

sn: ततो रामाभ्यनुज्ञातं तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्। हंसयुक्तं महावेगं निपपात महीतलम्॥
en: Commanded by Rāma that excellent car drawn by ganders got down on the earth with great velocity.

sn: आरोपितो विमानं तद्भरतः सत्यविक्रमः। राममासाद्य मुदितः पुनरेवाभ्यवादयत्॥
en: Ascending that car, Bharata, having truth for his prowess, reaching Rāma, delighted, again bowed to him.

sn: तं समुत्थाय काकुत्स्थश्चिरस्याक्षिपथं गतम्। अङ्के भरतमारोप्य मुदितः परिषस्वजे॥
en: Raising Bharata up who had been seen after a long time and placing him on his lap Kākutstha, delighted, embraced him.

sn: ततो लक्ष्मणमासाद्य वैदेहीं च परंतपः। अथाभ्यवादयत्प्रीतो भरतो नाम चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon Bharata, the slayer of foes, bowed to Vaidehī and welcomed Lakşmaņa.

sn: सुग्रीवं केकयीपुत्रो जाम्बवन्तमथाङ्गदम्। मैन्दं च द्विविदं नीलमृषभं चैव सस्वजे।॥
en: The son of Kaikeyi (then in turn) embraced Sugrīva, Jāmbavān, Angada, Mainda, Dvivida, Nīla and Rşabha.

sn: सुषेणं च नलं चैव गवाक्षं गन्धमादनम्। शरभं पनसं चैव परितः परिषस्वजे॥ ते कृत्वा मानुषं रूपं वानराः कामरूपिणः। कुशलं पर्यपृच्छंस्ते प्रहृष्टा भरतं तदा॥
en: He then embraced Sușeņa, Nala, Gavākşa, Gandhamadana, Sarabha, and Panasa. And assuming human shapes, those monkeys, assuming shapes at will, delightedly enquired after Bharata's well being.

sn: अथाब्रवीद्राजपुत्रः सुग्रीवं वानरर्षभम्। परिष्वज्य महातेजा भरतो धर्मिणां वरः॥
en: Then embracing Sugrīva, the foremost of monkeys, the highly effulgent prince Bharata, the foremost of the pious, said.

sn: त्वमस्माकं चतुर्णां वै भ्राता सुग्रीवपञ्चमः। सौहृदाज्जायते मित्रमपकारोऽरिलक्षणम्॥
en: O Sugrīva, you are our fifth brother. From brotherliness grow friendship and doing injury is the sign of an enemy.

sn: विभीषणं च भरतः सान्त्ववाक्यमथाब्रवीत्। दिष्ट्या त्वया सहायेन कृतं कर्म सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Bharata then addressed Vibhiṣaṇa with soothing words, “It is by fortune that through your help he has accomplished such a difficult work."

sn: शत्रुघ्नश्च तदा राममभिवाद्य सलक्ष्मणम्। सीतायाश्चरणौ वीरो विनयादभ्यवादयत्॥
en: Thereupon the heroic Satrughna saluting Rāma and Lakşmaņa, respectfully bowed to Sitā.

sn: रामो मातरमासाद्य विवर्णां शोककर्शिताम्। जग्राह प्रणतः पादौ मनो मातुः प्रहर्षयन्।॥
en: Having approached his mother, pale and pulled down with grief, Rāma humbly touched her feet and enhanced her delight.

sn: अभिवाद्य सुमित्रां च कैकेयीं च यशस्विनीम्। स मातृश्च ततः सर्वाः पुरोहितमुपागमत्॥
en: Thereupon saluting Sumitrā, famed Kaikeyi and all his mothers he approached the priests.

sn: स्वागतं ते महाबाहो कौसल्यानन्दवर्धन। इति प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे नागरा राममब्रुवन्॥
en: Thereupon all the citizens with folded hands welcomed him saying, “Welcome are you, O you of long arms! O you the enhancer of Kausalya's joy!"

sn: तान्यञ्जलिसहस्राणि प्रगृहीतानि नागरैः। व्याकोशानीव पद्मानि ददर्श भरताग्रजः॥
en: The elder brother of Bharata observed the folded hands of the citizens like so many blown lotuses.

sn: पादुके ते तु रामस्य गृहीत्वा भरतः स्वयम्। चरणाभ्यां नरेन्द्रस्य योजयामास धर्मवित्॥ अब्रवीच्च तदा रामं भरतः सकृताञ्जलिः।
en: And himself taking the sandals of Rāma, Bharata, conversant with piety, placed them at the feet of that lord of men. Thereupon Bharata with folded hands spoke to Rāma, saying.

sn: एतत्ते सकलं राज्यं न्यासं निर्यातितं मया॥ अद्य जन्म कृतार्थं मे संवृत्तश्च मनोरथः। यत्त्वां पश्यामि राजानमयोध्यां पुनरागतम्॥
en: This all your kingdom, which you did leave to my care, I return you. Blessed is my birth today and accomplished is my desire, since I behold you again as king in Ayodhyā after your return.

sn: अवेक्षतां भवान्कोशं कोष्ठागारं गृहं बलम्। भवतस्तेजसा सर्वं कृतं दशगुणं मया।५६।।
en: Do you examine your wealth treasury, palace and army. By your favour I have increased all these ten fold.

sn: तथा ब्रुवाणं भरतं दृष्ट्वा तं भ्रातृवत्सलम्। मुमुचुनिरा बाष्पं राक्षसश्च विभीषणः॥
en: Hearing Bharata speak in that wise and beholding him devoted to his brother all the monkeys and the Rākşasa Vibhîşana shed tears.

sn: ततः प्रहर्षाद्भरतमङ्कमारोप्य राघवः। ययौ तेन विमानेन ससैन्यो भरताश्रमम्॥
en: Thereupon placing Bharata, in delight, on his lap, Raghava, with his army in that car, proceeded towards Bharata's abode.

sn: भरताश्रममासाद्य ससैन्यो राघवस्तदा। अवतीर्य विमानाग्रादवतस्थे महीतले॥
en: That time reaching Bharata's palace Räghava from the top of the aerial car with his army descended upon the earth.

sn: अब्रवीत्तु तदा रामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्। वह वैश्रवणं देवमनुजानामि गम्यताम्॥
en: Thereupon Rāma said to the excellent car, Do you (now) go to Vaisravana, I do permit you.

sn: ततो रामाभ्यनुज्ञातं तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्। उत्तरां दिशमुद्दिश्य जगाम धनदालयम्॥
en: Thereupon being thus commanded by Rāma, that excellent car, proceeding towards the north, reached the abode of the Giver of wealth.

sn: विमानं पुष्पकं दिव्यं संगृहीतं तु रक्षसा। अगमद्धनदं वेगाद्रामवाक्यप्रचोदितम् ॥
en: That celestial car Puspaka had been taken away by the Raksasa (Ravana); but now at the words Rāma it reached (again) the Giver of wealth.

sn: पुरोहितस्यात्मसखस्य राघवो बृहस्पतेः शक्र इवामराधिपः। निपीड्य पादौ पृथगासने शुभे सदैव तेनोपविवेश वीर्यवान्॥
en: And touching the feet of his priest the powerful Rāghava sat on a separate and excellent seat like to Sakra, the lord of immortals (by the side of) Brhaspati.

sn: शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय कैकेयीनन्दिवर्धनः। बभाषे भरतो ज्येष्ठं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्॥
en: Thereupon having placed her palms on his head Bharata, the enhancer of Kaikeyi's joy spoke to his elder brother Rāma, having truth for his prowess, saying.

sn: पूजिता मामिका माता दत्तं राज्यमिदं मम। तद्ददामि पुनस्तुभ्यं यथा त्वमददा मम॥
en: Abiding by my mother's request you did confer this kingdom upon me; I do return you the kingdom you did give me.

sn: धुरमेकाकिना न्यस्तां वृषभेण बलीयसा। किशोरवद्गुरुं भारं न वोढुमहमुत्सहे॥
en: Like to a young one unable to carry a heavy burden thrown off by a powerful bull I am unable to carry this huge burden of the kingdom).

sn: वारिवेगेन महता भिन्नः सेतुरिव क्षरन्। दुर्बन्धनमिदं मन्ये राज्यच्छिद्रमसंवृतम्॥
en: I do consider this kingdom infested with thieves, difficult to govern, as it is difficult to reconstruct a bridge broken down by a powerful current of water.

sn: गतिं खर इवाश्वस्य हंसस्येव च वायसः। नान्वेतुमुत्सहे वीर तव मार्गमरिंदम ॥
en: As an ass cannot follow the course of a horse and a crow cannot follow that of a gander, so I am unable, O hero, O slayer of foes, to follow your footsteps.

sn: यथा चारोपितो वृक्षो जातश्चान्तनिवेशने। महानपि दुरारोहो महास्कन्धः प्रशाखवान्॥ शीर्येत पुष्पितो भूत्वा न फलानि प्रदर्शयन्। तस्य नानुभवेदर्थं यस्य हेतोः स रोपितः॥ एषोपमा महाबाहो त्वमर्थं वेत्तुमर्हसि। यद्यस्मान्मनुजेन्द्र त्वं भर्ता भृत्यान्न शाधि हि॥
en: If a tree, planted in the inner apartment of a house, growing huge with a big trunk and many branches, is dried up as soon it blossoms without bearing fruits, his object for whom it is planted, becomes fruitless? And this simili, O you of long arms, shall prove good in you, if did you not, our master, govern us, O lord of men, who are your servants.

sn: जगदद्याभिषिक्तं त्वामनुपश्यतु राघव। प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यं मध्याह्ने दीप्ततेजसम्।।।।।
en: Let the world, O Raghava, behold you installed (today) liku to the powerful midday Sun burning in effulgence.

sn: तूर्यसंघातनिर्घोषैः काञ्चीनूपुरनिःस्वनैः। मधुरैर्गीतशब्दैश्च प्रतिबुद्ध्यस्व शेष्व च॥
en: Do you sleep and rise up with the sound of stringed instruments, women's girdles and Nupuras and charming songs.

sn: यावदावर्तते चक्रं यावती च वसुंधरा। तावत्त्वमिह लोकस्य स्वामित्वमनुवर्तय॥
en: Do you govern the people as long as the solar system exists and as far as the earth extends.

sn: भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामः परपुरंजयः। तथेति प्रतिजग्राह निषसादासने शुभे॥
en: Hearing the words of Bharata, Rāma the conqueror of enemies cities, saying, “So be it" sat on an excellent seat.

sn: ततः शत्रुघ्नवचनानिपुणाः श्मश्रुवर्धनाः। सुखहस्ताः सुशीघ्राश्च राघवं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Thereupon at the command of Satrughna, expert, skilful and quick-handed barbers gathered round Rāghava.

sn: पूर्व तु भरते स्नाते लक्ष्मणे च महाबले। सुग्रीवे वानरेन्द्रे च राक्षसेन्द्रे विभीषणे॥ विशोधितजटः स्नातश्चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः। महाहवसनोपेतस्तस्थौ तत्र श्रिया ज्वलन्॥
en: At first, Bharata, the highly powerful Laks maņa, Sugrīva the lord of monkeys, and Vibhīs aņa the lord of Rākşasas bathed. Thereupon shorn of his matted hairs, bathed, with paste excellent garlands and precious clothes on, he appeared there shining in grace.

sn: प्रतिकर्म च रामस्य कारयामास वीर्यवान्। लक्ष्मणस्य च लक्ष्मीवानिक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धनः॥
en: The valiant and graceful Śatrughna the upholder of the dignity of Ikşvāku race, himself got ready the dresses for Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

sn: प्रतिकर्म च सीतायाः सर्वा दशरथस्त्रियः। आत्मनैव तदा चनुमनस्विन्यो मनोहरम्॥
en: All the high-minded wives of Dasaratha with their own hands decked Sītă with various charming (ornaments).

sn: ततो वानरपत्नीनां सर्वासामेव शोभनम्। चकार यत्नात्कौसल्या प्रहृष्टा पुत्रवत्सला॥
en: Thereupon Kausalyā, delighted and fond of her son, herself with great care, decorated the wives of monkeys.

sn: ततः शत्रुघ्नवचनात्सुमन्त्रो नाम सारथिः। योजयित्वाभिचक्राम रथं सर्वाङ्गशोभनम्॥
en: Thereupon at the words of ſatrughna, the charioteer by name Sumantra got ready the perfectly beautiful car.

sn: अग्न्यामलसंकाशं दिव्यं दृष्ट्वा रथं स्थितम्। आरुरोह महाबाहू रामः परपुरंजयः॥
en: Beholding that celestial car, bright as the fire of the sun, stationed before him, Rama, having long arms, the conqueror of enemies cities, ascended it.

sn: सुग्रीवो हनुमांश्चैव महेन्द्रसदृशद्युती। स्नातौ दिव्यनिभैर्वस्त्रैर्जग्मतुः शुभकुण्डलौ॥
en: Sugrīva and Hanuman, graceful like Mahendra, bathed, dressed in celestial clothes and wearing excellent kundalas, proceeded (to view the city).

sn: सर्वाभरणजुष्टाश्च ययुस्ताः शुभकुण्डलाः। सुग्रीवपत्न्यः सीता च द्रष्टुं नगरमुत्सुकाः॥
en: Then went Sītā and all the wives of Sugrīva decorated with all ornaments and wearing excellent Kundalas, anxious to behold the city.

sn: अयोध्यायां च सचिवा राज्ञो दशरथस्य च। पुरोहितं पुरस्कृत्य मन्त्रयामासुरर्थवत्॥
en: All the ministers of king Dasaratha in Ayodhyā began to hold consultation respectfully with the priest.

sn: अशोको विजयश्चैव सिद्धार्थश्च समाहिताः। मन्त्रयनरामवृद्ध्यर्थं वृत्त्यर्थं नगरस्य च॥
en: Asoka, Vijaya and Siddhārtha, with undivided mind, consulted with each other about the welfare of Rāma as well as that of the city.

sn: सर्वमेवाभिषेकार्थं जयाहस्य महात्मनः। कर्तुमर्हथ रामस्य यद्यन्मङ्गलपूर्वकम्॥
en: (Thereupon they ordered the servants) saying, Do you collect materials necessary for the auspicious installation of the high-souled (Rama) worthy of being crowned with victory.

sn: इति ते मन्त्रिणः सर्वे संदिश्य च पुरोहितः। नगरान्निर्ययुस्तूर्णं रामदर्शनबुद्धयः॥
en: The priest and the ministers having ordered thus all speedily issued out of the city to behold Rama.

sn: हरियुक्तं सहस्राक्षो रथमिन्द्र इवानघः। प्रययौ रथमास्थाय रामो नगरमुत्तमम्॥
