sn: उशना त्वब्रवीत्तत्र यज्ञसंपत्समृद्धये। रावणं राक्षसश्रेष्ठं द्विजश्रेष्ठो महातपाः॥
en: Thereupon that foremost of twice-born ones Usanas* of austere penances, wishing the prosperity of the sacrifice, said to Rāvana, the Raksasa chief. *Another name of Sukra. Indrajit took the vow of silence so he thought it improper to disturb him.

sn: अहमाख्यामि ते राजश्रूयतां सर्वमेव तत्। यज्ञास्ते सप्त पुत्रेण प्राप्तास्ते बहुविस्तराः।७।। अग्निष्टोमोऽश्वमेधश्च यज्ञो बहुसुवर्णकः। राजसूयस्तथा यज्ञो गोमेधो वैष्णवस्तथा।।।। माहेश्वरे प्रवृत्ते तु यज्ञे पुंभिः सुदुर्लभे। वरांस्ते लब्धवान्पुत्रः साक्षात्पशुपतेरिह॥
en: Hear, I shall relate to you everything, O king; your son has met with the fruits of many a sacrifice, Agnistoma, Asvamedha, Bahusuvarņaka, Rājsūya, Gomedha and Vaisnava. And being engaged in this Maheśvara sacrifice, which is incapable of being celebrated by men, your son has obtained boon from Pasupati’ himself.

sn: कामगं स्यन्दनं दिव्यमन्तरिक्षचरं ध्रुवम्। मायां च तामसी नाम यया संपद्यते तमः॥
en: He has also obtained illusory powers, which create darkness or ignorance, namely of ranging in the sky, of being eternal, of ascending a celestial car which curses at will and of creating darkness.

sn: एतया किल सङ्ग्रामे मायया राक्षसेश्वर। प्रयुक्तया गतिः शक्या नहि ज्ञातुं सुरासुरैः॥
en: O lord of Rākşasas, these illusory powers being used in a conflict, even the celestials and Asuras shall not be able to perceive his course.

sn: अक्षयाविषुधी बाणैश्चापं चापि सुदुर्जयम्। अस्त्रं च बलवद्राजञ्छत्रुविध्वंसनं रणे॥
en: Besides he has obtained a quiver, the arrows whereof shall never be exhausted, a bow, which is hard of being got by and a dreadful weapon which destroys enemies in a conflict.

sn: एतान्सर्वान्वरांल्लब्ध्वा पुत्रस्तेऽयं दशानन । अद्य यज्ञसमाप्तौ च त्वां दिदृक्षन्स्थितो ह्यहम्॥
en: Having obtained these boons your son, O you having ten faces, and myself, the sacrifice being finished, have been waiting to behold you.

sn: ततोऽब्रवीद्दशग्रीवो न शोभनमिदं कृतम्। पूजिताः शत्रवो यस्माद्रव्यैरिन्द्रपुरोगमाः॥
en: Whereto the Ten-necked demon replied, You have not done well as you have worshipped, with diverse articles my enemies, Indra and others.

sn: एहीदानी कृतं यद्धिसुकृतं तन्त्र संशयः। आगच्छ सौम्य गच्छामः स्वमेव भवनं प्रति॥
en: However, what is done is done, there is virtue in this, no doubt; come, o gentle one, we shall go to our house.

sn: ततो गत्वा दशग्रीवः सपुत्रः सविभीषणः। स्त्रियोऽवतारयामास सर्वास्ता बाष्पगद्गदाः॥ लक्षिण्यो रत्नभूताश्च देवदानवरक्षसाम्। तस्य तासु मतिं ज्ञात्वा धर्मात्मा वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon going there with his son and Vibhișana, the Ten-necked demon got down all those damsels, speechless with tears, gifted with auspicious marks, the precious females of the celestials, Dānavas and Räkşasas. Perceiving his vicious desire for those damsels, the virtuoussouled (Vibhisana) said.

sn: ईदृशैस्त्वं समाचारैर्यशोर्थकुलनाशनैः। धर्षणं प्राणिनां ज्ञात्वा स्वमतेन विचेष्टसे॥
en: You do (still) follow your own whims, knowing that people are injured by these actions which destroy piety, wealth and fame.

sn: ज्ञातींस्तान्धर्षयित्वेमास्त्वयानीता वराङ्गनाः। त्वामतिक्रम्य मधुना राजन्कुम्भीनसी हृता ॥
en: Having slain their kinsmen you past brought these beautiful damsels hither, but disregarding you, O King, Madhu has carried away Kumbhīnasī.

sn: रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं नावगच्छामि किं त्विदम्। कोऽयं यस्तु त्वयाख्यातो मधुरित्येव नामतः।।२०
en: Ravana said:-“I do not understand all this. Who is that Madhu, who has been named by you?"

sn: विभीषणस्तु संक्रुद्धो भ्रातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। श्रूयतामस्य पापस्य कर्मणः फलमागतम्॥
en: Worked up with ire Vibhîşana said to his brother: "Hear, the fruit of your vicious actions has arrived.

sn: मातामहस्य योऽस्माकं ज्येष्ठो भ्राता सुमालिनः। माल्यवानिति विख्यातो वृद्धः प्राज्ञो निशाचरः॥ पिता ज्येष्ठो जनन्या नो ह्यस्माकं चार्यकोऽभवत्। तस्य कुम्भीनसी नाम दुहितुर्दुहिताभवत्॥ मातृष्वसुरथास्माकं सा च कन्यानलोद्भवा। भवत्यस्माकमेवैषा भ्रातृणां धर्मतः स्वसा॥
en: There was an old Räkşasas, celebrated for his wisdom, named Mālyavān, the elder brother of Sumālin, our maternal grandfather. His granddaughter is Kumbhinaşi and is born of our maternal aunt Analā.; so she is virtually our sister.

sn: सा हृता मधुना राजनराक्षसेन बलीयसा। यज्ञप्रवृत्ते पुत्रे तु मयि चान्तर्जलोषिते॥ कुम्भकर्णो महाराज निद्रामनुभवत्यथ। निहत्य राक्षसश्रेष्ठानमात्यानिह संमतान्॥ धर्षयित्वा हृता राजनगुप्ताप्यन्तःपुरे तव।
en: Your son being engaged in the sacrifice and myself being under waters she was stolen away, Oking, by the powerful Rākşasa Madhu. Kumbhakarma, ogreat king, was then asleep. Having slain all the powerful Rākşasas and your councillors, he had stolen her away, O king, who was in your inner apartments.

sn: श्रुत्वापि तन्महाराज क्षान्तमेव हतो न सः॥ यस्मादवश्यं दातव्या कन्या भत्रे हि भ्रातृभिः। तदेतत्कर्मणो ह्यस्य फलं पापस्य दुर्मतेः।२८।। अस्मिन्नेवाभिसंप्राप्तं लोके विदितमस्तु ते।
en: Hearing this even, O great king, we have pardoned and not slain him; an unmarried girl should be given away to her husband by her brothers, but that has not been the case, this is merely the result of your vicious actions, wicked-minded as you are. And this you have met with instantly, so the people say.

sn: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रः स रावणः॥ दौरात्म्येनात्मनोद्भूतस्तप्ताम्भा इव सागरः। ततोऽब्रवीद्दशग्रीवः क्रुद्धः संरक्तलोचनः॥
en: Hearing the words of Vibhīşaņa, Råvana, the lord of Rākşasas, became agitated like an ocean, by the recollection of his vicious deeds. And engaged, with blood-red eyes the ten-necked demon said.

sn: कल्प्यतां मे रथः शीघ्रं शूराः सज्जीभवन्तु नः। भ्राता मे कुम्भकर्णश्च ये च मुख्या निशाचराः॥ वाहनान्यधिरोहन्तु नानाप्रहरणायुधाः। अद्य तं समरे हत्वा मधुं रावणनिर्भयम्॥ सुरलोकं गमिष्यामि युद्धाकाङ्क्षी सुहृद्धृतः।
en: Get my chariot ready soon and let all the heroes of our party be prepared. Let my brother Kumbhakarņa and other leading night-rangers, armed with various weapons, ascend their conveyances. Having slain today in the encounter that Madhu, who is not afraid of Ravana, I shall, encircled by my friends, and desirous of battle, proceed to the region of the celestials.

sn: अक्षोहिणीसहस्राणि चत्वार्यग्र्याणि रक्षसाम्।।३३ नानाप्रहरणान्याशु निर्ययुयुद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम्। इन्द्रजित्त्वग्रतः सैन्यात्सैनिकान्परिगृह्य च॥ जगाम रावणो मध्ये कुम्भकर्णश्च पृष्ठतः। विभीषणश्च धर्मात्मा लङ्कायां धर्ममाचरन्॥ शेषाः सर्वे महाभागा ययुर्मधुपुरं प्रति।
en: Thereupon issued out for battle leading Rākşasas four thousand Akşauhiņi strong taking various weapons. Commanding them Indrajit proceeded the army, Răvaņa went in the middle and Kumbhakarna was in the rear; the virtuoussouled Vibhīşaņa remained in Lankā, being engaged in pious observances. And the rest of the leading Rākşasas proceeded towards the city of Madhu.

sn: शरैरुष्टैर्हयैर्दीप्तैः शिशुमारैर्महोरगैः॥ राक्षसाः प्रययुः सर्वे कृत्वाकाशं निरन्तरम्।
en: All the Rākşasas went covering the sky, some on asses, some on camels, some on horses, some on quick-coursing porpoises and some on huge serpents.

sn: दैत्याश्च शतशस्तत्र कृतवैराश्च दैवतैः ॥ रावणं प्रेक्ष्य गच्छन्तमन्वगच्छन्हि पृष्ठतः। स तु गत्वा मधुपुरं प्रविश्य च दशाननः॥ न ददर्श मधुं तत्र भगिनीं तत्र दृष्टवान्।
en: And beholding Rävaņa proceed, hundreds of Daityas, inimical to the celestials, followed him. Having arrived at the city of Madhu and entered there the ten-necked demon did not behold Madhu but espied his sister.

sn: सा च प्रह्वाञ्जलिर्भूत्वा शिरसा चरणौ गता॥ तस्य राक्षसराजस्य वस्ता कुम्भीनसी तदा।
en: Thereupon being afraid of the king of Raksasas, Kumbhinasi, with folded palms, touched his feet with her crown.

sn: तां समुत्थापयामास न भेतव्यमिति ब्रुवन्॥ रावणो राक्षसश्रेष्ठः किं चापि करवाणि ते।
en: Having raised her up the Rākşasa-chief Ravana said “No fear, what can I do for you?

sn: साब्रवीद्यादि मे राजन्प्रसन्नस्त्वं महाभुज ॥ भर्तारं न ममेहाद्य हन्तुर्महसि मानद। नहीदृशं भयं किंचित्कुलस्त्रीणामिहोच्यते॥ भयानामपि सर्वेषां वैधव्यं व्यसनं महत्।
en: Where to she replied “O King, O you having long arms, if you are pleased with me, do not slay my husband today, Oconfrere of honours. It is said there is no other fear like this for damsels of high pedigree. The greatest of fears is that of being a widow.

sn: सत्यवाग्भव राजेन्द्र मामवेक्षस्व याचतीम्॥ त्वयाप्युक्तं महाराज न भेतव्यमिति स्वयम्।
en: Be you truthful, O king of Kings, do you look towards me, who am thus begging. You have yourself said, O king, "no fear.”

sn: रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्धृष्टः स्वसारं तत्र संस्थिताम्॥ क्व चासौ तव भर्ता वै मम शीघ्रं निवेद्यताम्। सह तेन गमिष्यामि सुरलोकं जयाय हि ॥
en: Being thus addressed Råvana said to his sister there: "Do you tell me speedily where is your husband. I shall go with him for conquests to the region of the celestials."

sn: तव कारुण्यसौहार्दानिवृत्तोऽस्मि मधोर्वधात्। इत्युक्ता सा समुत्थाप्य प्रसुप्तं तं निशाचरम्॥ अब्रवीत्संप्रहृष्टेव राक्षसी सा पतिं वचः।
en: Out of pity and love for you I refrain from slaying Madhu. Being thus accosted, that Raksasi, being pleased, got her sleeping husband, the night-ranger, up and said.

sn: एष प्राप्तो दशग्रीवो मम भ्राता महाबलः॥ सुरलोकजयाकाङ्क्षी साहाय्ये त्वां वृणोति च। तदस्य त्वं सहायार्थं सबन्धुर्गच्छ राक्षस॥
en: Here is my brother, the highly power Dasagrīva. Being desirous of conquering the region of the celestials he prays for your help. Do you therefore proceed to his help, O Raksasa, with all they friends.

sn: स्निग्धस्य भजमानस्य युक्तमर्थाय कल्पितुम्। तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तथेत्याह मधुर्वचः॥
en: It behoves you to help him, who out of affection for me, has prayed for your help.” Hearing those words Madhu said:-"So be it."

sn: ददर्श राक्षसश्रेष्ठं यथान्यायमुपेत्य सः। पूजयामास धर्मेण रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्॥
en: Approaching a little he beheld that foremost of Rākşasas and duly welcomed Rāvana.

sn: प्राप्य पूजां दशग्रीवो मधुवेश्मनि वीर्यवान्। तत्र चैकां निशामुष्य गमनायोपचक्रमे॥
en: Being thus honoured the highly power Dasagrīva spent one night in Madhu's house and then, addressed himself for departure.

sn: ततः कैलासमासाद्य शैलं वैश्रवणालयम्। राक्षसेन्द्रो महेन्द्राभः सेनामुपनिवेशयत्॥
en: Thereupon reaching the hill Kailāsa, the abode of Vaisravana, the lord of Raksasas, resembling Mahendra, encamped his army.

sn: स तु तत्र दशग्रीवः सह सैन्येन वीर्यवान्। अस्तं प्राप्ते दिनकरे निवासं समरोचयत्॥ उदिते विमले चन्द्रे तुल्यपर्वतवर्चसि। प्रसुप्तं सुमहत्सैन्यं नानाप्रहरणायुधम्॥
en: After sunset the highly power Rāvaņa encamped his army there. And the clear moon, brilliant as the mountain, having risen, that huge army, armed with diverse weapons, became asleep.

sn: रावणस्तु महावीर्यो निषण्णः शैलमूर्धनि स ददर्श गुणांस्तत्र चन्द्रपादपशोभितान्॥
en: And lying down on the summit of the mountain, the highly powerful Rāvaņa espied the caves beautified with the rays of the moon and the trees.

sn: कर्णिकारवनैर्दीप्तैः कदम्बवकुलैस्तथा। पद्मिनीभिश्च फुल्लाभिर्मन्दाकिन्या जलैरपि॥ चम्पकाशोकपुंनागमन्दारतरुभिस्तथा। चूतपाटललोधैश्च प्रियङ्ग्वर्जुनकेतकैः॥ तगरैनारिकेरैश्च प्रियालपनसैस्तथा। एतैरन्यैश्च तरुभिरुद्भासितवानान्तरे॥
en: The interior of the forest was beautified with the brilliant groves of Karņikār, with Kadamba and Vakula trees, groves of full blown lotuses, the waters of Mandākini, with Campaka, Asoka, Punnaga, Mandāra, mangoe, Pātala, Lodhra, Priyangu, Arjuna, Ketka, Tagara, Coconut, Pyāla, Panasa and various other trees.

sn: किंनरा मदनेनार्ता रक्ता मधुरकण्ठिनः। समं संप्रजगुर्यत्र मनस्तुष्टिविवर्धनम्॥
en: There sang the Kinnaras, possessed by desire, and having sweet voice, enhancing the delight of the mind.

sn: विद्याधरा मदक्षीवा मदरक्तान्तलोचनाः। योषिद्भिःसह संक्रान्ताश्चिक्रीडुर्जहषुश्च वै॥
en: There danced mirthfully, with their damsels, the Vidyādharas, inebriate and having their eyes reddened with drink.

sn: घण्टानामिव संनादः शुश्रुवे मधुरस्वनः। अप्सरोगणसङ्घानां गायतां धनदालये॥
en: There was audible in the house of the lord of riches, the sweet music of the assembled Apsarās like to the sound of the bell.

sn: पुष्पवर्षाणि मुश्चन्तो नगाः पवनताडिताः। शैलं तं वासयन्तीव मधुमाधवगन्धिनः॥
en: Being shaken by the wind the nectar-smelling trees made the hill fragrant with the shower of flowers.

sn: मधुपुष्परजःपृक्तं गन्धामादाय पुष्कलम्। प्रववौ वर्धयन्कामं रावणस्य सुखोऽनिलः॥
en: And carrying the fragrance rendered salutary with honey and filaments of flowers, the excellent wind blew enhancing Ravana's desire.

sn: गेयात्पुष्पसमृद्ध्या च शैत्याद्वायोगिरेर्गुणात्। प्रवृत्तायां रजन्यां च चन्द्रस्योदयनेन च॥ रावणः स महावीर्यः कामस्य वशमागतः। विनिःश्वस्य विनिःश्वस्य शशिनं समवैक्षत॥
en: Being possessed by desire through songs, richness of flowers, coldness of air, beauty of the hills, and the rising of the moon is night, the highly powerful Rāvana espied again and again the moon with heavy sighs.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र दिव्याभरणभूषिता। सर्वाप्सरोवरा रम्भा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना॥
en: At this time passed by that way the foremost of Apsarās, Rambhā, adorned with excellent ornaments and having a countenance like the full moon.

sn: दिव्यचन्दनलिप्ताङ्गी मन्दारकृतमूर्धजा। दिव्योत्सवकृतारम्भा दिव्यपुष्पविभूषिता॥
en: Her person was sprinkled with excellent sandal paste, her hairs were decked with Mandāra flowers, her body was beautified with other flowers and her movements tended to increase desire.

sn: चक्षुर्मनोहरं पीनं मेखलादामभूषितम्। समुद्वहन्ती जघनं रतिप्राभृतमुत्तमम्॥
en: Her eyes were beautiful and her waist was high, adorned with Mekhala' and was as if the refuge of Rati.? 1. A kind of ornament used on the waist.) 2. Wife of Kama-the god of love in Hindu mythology.

sn: कृतैर्विशेषकैरार्दैः षडतुकुसुमोद्भवैः। बभावन्यतमेव श्रीः कान्तिश्रीद्युतिकीर्तिभिः॥
en: Her forehead and other parts of the countenance were painted with the marks of red sandal and adorned with ornaments of flowers growing in six seasons.

sn: नीलं सतोयमेघाभं वस्त्रं समवगुण्ठिता। यस्या वक्त्रं शशिनिभं भ्रुवौ चापनिभे शुभे॥ ऊरू करिकराकारौ करौ पल्लवकोमलौ। सैन्यमध्येन गच्छन्ती रावणेनोपलक्षिता॥
en: Rambhā appeared like the second tree, in grace and beauty, natural and artificial. She wore green clothes resembling the clouds; her face was like the moon, eye brows like the excellent bows, thighs like the trunks of elephants and palms soft as leaves. She was seen by Rāvana as proceeding in the midst of soldiers.

sn: तां समुत्थाय गच्छन्ती कामबाणवशं गतः। करे गृहीत्वा लज्जन्तीं स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत ॥
en: Having got up and been influenced by lust he took her, shameful as she was, by the hand and smiling said.

sn: क्व गच्छसि वरारोहे कां सिद्धिं भजसे स्वयम्। कस्याभ्युदयकालोऽयं यस्त्वां समुपभोक्ष्यते।।२१
en: Where are you going, O beautiful damsel? Whom are you going of your own accord to satisfy? Whose prosperous time has appeared, with whom you shall enjoy?

sn: त्वदाननरसस्याद्य पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिनः। सुधामृतरस्स्येव कोऽद्य तृप्ति गमिष्यति॥
en: Who shall be satisfied with drinking the nectar of your mouth smelling like lotus?

sn: स्वर्णकुम्भनिभौ पीनौ शुभौ भीरु निरन्तरौ। कस्योरस्थलसंस्पर्श दास्यतस्ते कुचाविमौ ॥
en: Whose breast, O fare damsel, your rising breast beautiful like two golden pots closely placed, shall touch?

sn: सुवर्णचक्रप्रतिमं स्वर्णदामचितं पृथु । अध्यारोक्ष्यति कस्तेऽद्य जघनं स्वर्गरूपिणम्॥
en: Who will go to bestride today your large thigh resembling a disc of gold, encircled by a golden chain and which was like the form of a heaven.

sn: मद्विशिष्टः पुमान्कोऽद्य शक्रो विष्णुरथाश्विनौ। मामतीत्य हि यच्च त्वं यासि भीरु न शोभनम् ॥
en: Who is there so beautiful as I-Indra, Visnu, or two Asvins that you are passing by me?

sn: विश्रम त्वं पृथुश्रोणि शिलातलमिदं शुभम्। त्रैलोक्य यः प्रभुश्चैव मदन्यो नैव विद्यते॥
en: Do you take rest upon this excellent rock, O you having charming waist. There is no other lord, save me, in the three worlds.

sn: तदेवं प्राञ्जलिः प्रबो याचते त्वां दशाननः। भर्तुर्भर्ता विधाता च त्रैलोक्यस्य भजस्व माम्।।२७
en: And Daśānana, the lord of the lords of the three worlds, thus begs you, with folded palms. Do you therefore seek me.

sn: एवमुक्ताब्रवीद्रम्भा वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः। प्रसीद नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशं त्वं हि मे गुरुः॥
en: Being thus addressed, Rambhā, trembling, with folded palms, said:-Be you propitiated; it does not behave you to speak thus, who are my superior.

sn: अन्येभ्योऽपि त्वया रक्ष्या प्राप्नुयां धर्षणं यदि। तद्धर्मतः स्नुषा तेऽहं तत्त्वमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Rather should you protect me if any body else try to oppress me. Virtually I am your daughterin-law. I speak to you the truth.

sn: अथाब्रवीद्दशग्रीवश्चरणाधोमुखीं स्थिताम्। रोमहर्षमनुप्राप्तां दृष्टमात्रेण तां तदा॥
en: Thereupon the Ten-necked demon said to her, standing with her face downwards, and her down standing erect at his very sight,

sn: सुतस्य यदि मे भार्या ततस्त्वं हि स्नषा भवेः। बाढमित्येव सा रम्भा प्राह रावणमुत्तरम्॥ धर्मतस्ते सुतस्याहं भार्या राक्षसपुङ्गव। पुत्रः प्रियतरः प्राणैर्धातुर्वैश्रवणस्य ते॥ विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु नलकूबर इत्ययम्। धर्मतो यो भवेद्विप्रः क्षत्रियो वीर्यतो भवेत्॥ क्रोधाद्यश्च भवेदग्निः क्षान्त्या च वसुधासमः। तस्यास्मि कृतसंकेता लोकपालसुतस्य वै॥
en: “Had you been the wife of my son, you would have been my daughter-in-law.” Whereto Rambha replied. “Truly it is; I am, by virtue, the wife of your son, O foremost of Raksasas. Your brother Vaiśravana has a son, dearer than his life, celebrated in the three worlds under the name of Nalkūbara. In virtue he is like to a Brahmin, in prowess he equals a Kşatriya, in anger he is very fire and in patience he is like the earth. I have been thus directed by that Lokapāla's son.

sn: तमुद्दिश्य तु मे सर्वं विभूषणमिदं कृतम्। यथा तस्य हि नान्यस्य भावो मां प्रति तिष्ठति ॥ तेन सत्येन मां राजन्मोक्तुमर्हस्यरिंदम्। स हि तिष्ठति धर्मात्मा मां प्रतीक्ष्य समुत्सुकः॥
en: For him I have adorned my person with these ornaments. I am not attached to any body else but him. O king, O slayer of foes, by virtue of (this relation) is behove you to save me. And that virtuous-souled one is anxiously expecting me.

sn: तत्र विघ्नं तु तस्येह कर्तुं नार्हसि मुञ्च माम्। सद्भिराचरितं मागं गच्छ राक्षसपुङ्गव॥
en: You should not put obstacle in that; it behove you to let me go; do you, O foremost of Rāksasas, wend the way treaded by the pious.

sn: माननीयो मम त्वं हि पालनीया तथास्मि ते। एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रत्युवाच विनीतवत्॥
en: You are worthy of being reverend by me and I am object of your protection." Being thus addressed Daśagrīva humbly replied.

sn: स्नुषास्मि यदवोचस्त्वमेकपत्नीष्वयं क्रमः। देवलोकस्थितिरियं सुराणां शाश्वती मता॥ पतिरप्सरसां नास्ति न चैकस्त्रीपरिग्रहः।
en: "I am daughter-in-law,” as you have said, is worthy of being said by one who is the only wife. This is the everlasting law of the celestials that the Apsarās have no husband; they cannot be the wife of one husband.

sn: एवमुक्त्वा स तां रक्षो निवेश्य च शिलातले॥ कामभोगाभिसंरक्तो मैथुनायोपचक्रमे। सा विमुक्ता ततो रम्भा भ्रष्टमाल्यविभूषणा॥
en: Having said this, the Raksasa ravished her. Being released from his grasp Rambhā became divested of her ornaments and garland and became like the river agitated by the elephants.

sn: गजेन्द्राक्रीडमथिता नदीवाकुलतां गता। लुलिताकुलकेशान्ता करवेपितपल्लवा।॥ पवनेनावधूतेव लता कुसुमशालिनी। सा वेपमाना लज्जन्ती भीता करकृताञ्जलिः॥ नलकूबरमासाद्य पादयोनिपपात ह।
en: Her hairs were dishevelled and her hands were trembling. Like to a blossoming creeper shaken by the wind, she, trembling and bashful and with folded hands, went to Nalakubara and fell down at his feet.

sn: तदवस्थां च तां दृष्ट्वा महात्मा नलकूबरः॥ अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे पादयोः पतितासि मे।
en: Having seen her in that plight the high-souled Nalakubara said-"O fair one, what is this? Why have you placed yourself at my feet?”

sn: सा वै निःश्वसमाना तु वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः॥ तस्मै सर्वं यथातत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे।
en: Sighing heavily and trembling she with folded palms, related to him everything from the beginning to the end.

sn: एष देव दशग्रीवः प्राप्तो गन्तुं त्रिविष्टपम्॥ तेन सैन्यसहायेन निशेयं परिणामिता। आयान्ती तेन दृष्टास्मि त्वत्सकाशमरिंदम्॥ गृहीता तेन पृष्टास्मि कस्य त्वमिति रक्षसा।
en: O lord, on his way to heaven, Dasagrīva has arrived here and has spent the night with his army. While I was coming to you, O slayer of foes, I was seen by him. Then holding me he said-“Where are you going?"

sn: मया तु सर्वं यत्सत्यं तस्मै सर्वं निवेदितम्॥ काममोहाभिभूतात्मा नाश्रौषित्तद्वचो मम।
en: I related to him everything truly. But being possessed by lust he did not pay heed to my, words.

sn: याच्यमानो मया देव स्नुषा तेऽहमिति प्रभो।॥ तत्सर्वं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा बलात्तेनास्मि धर्षिता।
en: He was again prayed by me, O lord, saying “I am your daughter-in-law." But neglecting that he ravished me.

sn: एवं त्वमपराधं मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि सुव्रतः॥ नहि तुल्यं बलं सौम्य स्त्रियाश्च पुरुषस्य हि।
en: O you of firm vows, it behove you to forgive me for this folly. O gentle one, a woman's strength can never equal that of a man.

sn: एतछुत्वा तु संक्रुद्धस्तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः॥ धर्षणां तां परां श्रुत्वा ध्यानं संप्रविवेश ह।
en: Hearing of this ravishment Vaisravana's son was greatly enraged and entered into meditation.

sn: तस्य तत्कर्म विज्ञाय तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः॥ मुहूर्तात्क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तोयं जग्राह पाणिना।
en: Having ascertained the truth within a moment Vaisravana's son, with eyes reddened with ire, took water in his palms.

sn: गृहीत्वा सलिलं सर्वमुपस्पृश्य यथाविधि॥ उत्ससर्ज तदा शापं राक्षसेन्द्राय दारुणम्।
en: Having taken this and rinsed his mouth duly, he imprecated a dreadful curse upon that lord of Raksasas.

sn: अकामा तेन यस्मात्त्वं बलाद्भद्रे प्रधर्षिता॥ तस्मात्स युवतीमन्यां नाकामामुपयास्यति।
en: O fair one, since you have been ravished by him despite your unwillingness he shall never be able to get by an unwilling damsel.

sn: यदा ह्यकामां कामा” धर्षयिष्यति योषितम्॥ मूर्धा तु सप्तधा तस्य शकलीभविता तदा। तस्मिन्नदाहृते शापे ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभे॥ देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खाच्च्युता।
en: Whenever he shall, stricken by lust, ravish a reluctant damsel, his head shall be sundered into seven pieces. As soon as this curse, like to a burning flame, was uttered, the celestials bugles were sounded and a shower of flowers fell from heavens.

sn: पितामहमुखाश्चैव सर्वे देवाः प्रहर्षिताः॥ ज्ञात्वा लोकगतिं सर्वां तस्य मृत्युं च रक्षसः।
en: Being apprised of the plight of people (brought about by him) and of the death of that Rākşasa the patriarch Brahmă and other gods were greatly delighted.

sn: श्रुत्वा तु स दशग्रीवस्तं शापं रोमहर्षणम्॥ नारीषु मैथुनीभावं नाकामास्वभ्यरोचयत्। तेन नीताः स्त्रियः प्रीतिमापुः सर्वाः पतिव्रताः। नलकूबरनिर्मुक्तं शापं श्रुत्वा मन:प्रियम्॥
en: Hearing of that curse capable of making the down erect, Daśagrīva abstained from entertaining lust for unwilling females. And hearing of the curse imprecated by Nalakübara all the chaste damsels, that were kept captive, attained to great delight.

sn: कैलासं लवयित्वा तु ससैन्यबलवाहनः । आससाद महातेजा इन्द्रलोकं दशाननः॥
en: Having crossed the mount Kailāsa, the highiy powerful Ten-necked demon, with his army, reached the region of Indra.

sn: तस्य राक्षससैन्यस्य समन्तादुपयास्यतः। देवलोके बभौ शब्दो भिद्यमानार्णवोपमः॥
en: There arose in the region of celestials an uproar from the Rākṣasa army, like to the sound of the agitated deep.

sn: श्रुत्वा तु रावणं प्राप्तमिन्द्रश्चलित आसनात्। देवानथाब्रवीत्तत्र सर्वानेव समागतान्॥ आदित्यांश्च वसून्रुद्रान्साध्यांश्च समरुद्गणान्। सज्जा भवत युद्धार्थं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः॥
en: Hearing of the arrival of Rāvana, Indra shook on his throne and said to the assembled gods, Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Sadhyas and Maruts"Prepare yourselves, for fighting with the vicious-souled Ravana."

sn: एवमुक्तास्तु शक्रेण देवाः शक्रसमा युधि। संनह्य सुमहासत्त्वा युद्धश्रद्धासमन्विताः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Sakra, the celestials, his equals in the encounter and gifted with great prowess, armed themselves for fight. some

sn: स तु दीनः परित्रस्तो महेन्द्रो रावणं प्रति। विष्णोः समीपमागत्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: Mahendra, afraid of Ravana, poorly went to: Vişnu and gave vent to the following accents.

sn: विष्णो कथं करिष्यामि रावणं राक्षसं प्रति। अहोऽतिबलवद्रक्षो युद्धार्थमभिवर्तते।७।। वरप्रदानाद्बलवान खल्वन्येन हेतुना । तत्तु सत्यं वचः कार्यं यदुक्तं पद्मयोनिना ॥
en: “How shall I, O Vişņu, withstand, the Rákş asa Rāvaņa? The highly powerful Rākṣasa has come here for battle. It is by virtue of the boon that he is powerful, not for any thing else. It is proper to make the words uttered by Brahmă, truthful.

sn: तद्यथा नमुचित्रोबलिर्नरकशम्बरौ। त्वदलं समवष्टभ्य मया दग्धास्तथा कुरु॥
en: As resorting to your prowess I destroyed Namuci, Vrtra, Bali, Naraka and Sambara, so do you make arrangements (for his destruction).

sn: नह्यन्यो देवदेवेश त्वदृते मधुसूदन। गतिः परायणं चापि त्रैलोक्य सचराचरे।॥ त्वं हि नारायणः श्रीमान्पद्मनाभः सनातनः। त्वयेमे स्थापिता लोकाः शक्रश्चाहं सुरेश्वरः॥
en: There is no other excellent refuge but you in the three worlds, mobile and immobile, O lord, O gods of gods, O slayer of Madhu. You are the graceful, ever-existing Nārāyaṇa, having a lotus naval. By you the worlds have been settled and myself and Sakra, the lord of the celestials.

sn: त्वया सृष्टमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्। त्वामेव भगवन्सर्वे प्रविशन्ति युगक्षये॥
en: You have created the three worlds, the mobile and immobile, and in you all these shall, O glorious deity, end at the time of dissolution.

sn: तदाचक्ष्व यथा तत्त्वं देवदेव मम स्वयम्। असिचक्रसहायस्त्वं योत्स्यसे रावणं प्रति॥
en: Do you tell me, the truth, O god of gods, that I may myself fight; or do you, with your sword and discus, vanquish Ravana.

sn: एवमुक्तः स शक्रेण देवो नारायणः प्रभुः। अब्रवीन्न परित्रासः कर्तव्यः श्रूयतां च मे॥ न तावदेष दुष्टात्मा शक्यो जेतुं सुरासुरैः। हन्तुं चापि समासाद्य वरदानेन दुर्जयः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Śakra the lord Narayana; said, "Do not fear, hear what I say. He is invincible by virtue of the boon, and that vicious-souled one is incapable of being vanquished even by the celestials and Asuras.

sn: सर्वथा तु महत्कर्म करिष्यति बलोत्कटः। राक्षसः पुत्रसहितो दृष्टमेतन्निसर्गतः॥
en: Irrepressible by virtue of his prowess, that Raksasa, with his son, shall accomplish a mighty object. It seems to be real.

sn: यत्तु मां त्वमभाषिष्ठा युद्ध्यस्वेति सुरेश्वर। नाहं तं प्रतियोत्स्यामि रावणं राक्षसं युधि॥
en: O lord of celestials, even if I am requested by you. I shall not withstand the Rākşasa, Rāvana in the conflict.

sn: नाहत्वा समरे शत्रु विष्णुः प्रतिनिवर्तते। दुर्लभश्चैव कामोऽद्य वरगुप्तादि रावणात्॥
en: Without slaying the enemies in the encounter, Vişņu does never go black, but it is hard to fulfil my desire from Rāvaņa, well protected by the boon.

sn: प्रतिजाने च देवेन्द्र त्वत्समीपे शतक्रतो। भवितास्मि यथास्याहं रक्षसो मृत्युकारणम्॥
en: However I do promise before you, O lord of the celestials, O performer of hundred sacrifices, I shall, soon become the cause of this Räkşasa's death.

sn: अहमेव निहन्तास्मि रावणं सपुरःसरम्। देवता नन्दयिष्यामि ज्ञात्वा कालमुपागतम्॥ एतत्ते कथितं तत्त्वं देवराज शचीपते। युद्ध्यस्व विगतत्रासः सुरैः सार्धं महाबल॥
en: I shall soon destroy Rāvana with his family in due time and afford delight to the celestials, O lords of ſacī; do you divested of fear, O you gifted with great strength, along with the celestials.

sn: ततो रुद्राः सहादित्या वसवो मरुतोऽश्विनौ। संनद्धा निर्ययुस्तूर्णं राक्षसानभितः पुरात्॥
en: Thereupon having issued out of the city, Rudras, Adityas, Vasus, Maruts and Asvins well armed with mails, appeared before the Raksasas.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नादः शुश्राव रजनीक्षये। तस्य रावणसैन्यस्य प्रयुद्धस्य समन्ततः॥
en: Meanwhile at the latter part of the night there was audible the uproar of Rāvana's army fighting on all sides.

sn: ते प्रबुद्धा महावीर्या अयोन्यमभिवीक्ष्य वै। संग्राममेवाभिमुखा अभ्यवर्तन्त हृष्टवत्॥
en: Having got up and cast their looks upon one another the highly powerful Rākşasas waited there for the battle, delighted.

sn: ततो दैवतसैन्यानां संक्षोभः समजायत। तदक्षयं महासैन्यं दृष्ट्वा समरमूर्धनि॥
en: Thereupon beholding that inexhaustible huge army at the commencement of the battle the celestial host lost heart.

sn: ततो युद्धं समभवद्देवदानवरक्षसाम्। घोरं तुमुलनिर्हादं नानाप्रहरणोद्यतम्॥
en: Thereupon there ensued a conflict, setting up a terrible sound, with various weapons between the Räksasas and gods.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरा राक्षसा घोरदर्शनाः। युद्धार्थं समवर्तन्त सचिवा रावणस्य ते॥
en: In the interval issued out for another encounter the heroic and grim-visaged Räksasas, Rāvana's councillors.

sn: मारीचश्च प्रहस्तश्च महापार्श्वमहोदरौ। अकम्पनो निकुम्भश्च शुकः सारण एव च॥ संहादो धूमकेतुश्च महादंष्ट्रो घटोदरः। जम्बुमाली महाह्रादो विरूपाक्षश्च राक्षसः॥ सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च दुर्मुखो दूषणः खरः। त्रिशिराः करवीराक्षः सूर्यशत्रुश्च राक्षसः॥ महाकायोऽतिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ। एतैः सर्वै परिवृतो महावीर्यैर्महाबलः॥ रावणस्यार्यकः सैन्यं सुमाली प्रविवेश ह। स दैवतगणान्सर्वानानाप्रहरणैः शितैः॥
en: And encircled by Mārīca, Prahasta, Mahāparśva, Mahodara, Akampana, Nikumbha, Suka, Sarana, Sanghrāda, Dhumaketu, Mahadanstra, Gatodara, Jambumali, Mahahrada, Virūpākșa, Şuptaghna, Yajñakopa, Durmukha, Khara, Trisira, Karaviraksa, Süryasatru Mahakāya, Atikāya, Devāntaka, Narāntaka, all those of gifted with great prowess, there entered the battle-field, the highly powerful Sumālin, Rāvana's maternal grandfather.

sn: व्यध्वंसयत्समं कुद्धो वायुर्जलधरानिर। तदैवतबलं राम हन्यमानं निशाचरैः॥
en: With various sharp-pointed weapons, he, highly angered, began to assail the celestial host like to the winds scattering clouds.

sn: प्रणुन्नं सर्वतो दिग्भ्यः सिंहनुन्ना मृगा इव। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरो वसूनामष्टमो वसुः। सावित्र इति विख्यातः प्रविवेश रणाजिरम्॥ सैन्यैः परिवृतो हृष्टै नाप्रहरणोद्यतैः। त्रासयशत्रुसैन्यानि प्रविवेश रणाजिरम्॥
en: Being thus distressed by the night-rangers the hoist of the gods fled away into diverse directions like a herd of deer attacked by a lion. In the meantime, entered the battle-field, the heroic and brave Såvitra, the eight Vasu, encircled by soldiers and striking terror into the hearts of the enemies.

sn: तथादित्यौ महावीर्यो त्वष्टा पूषा च तौ समम्। निर्भयौ सह सैन्येन तदा प्राविशतां रणे॥
en: Then the two Ādityas, the highly powerful Tvaştă, and Puşă undaunted and united with the forces entered the arena.

sn: ततो युद्धं समभवत्सुराणां सह राक्षसैः। क्रुद्धानां रक्षसां कीर्तिं समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम्॥
en: Thereupon there arose with Rākşasas a terrible encounter of the celestials unable to bear their fame in battle.

sn: ततस्ते राक्षसाः सर्वे विबुधान्समरे स्थितान्। नानाप्रहरणैोरैर्जघ्नुः शतसहस्रशः॥
en: Then the Rākşasas, with thousands of terrible weapons, began to belabour the deities in the encounter.

sn: देवाश्च राक्षसान्धोरान्महाबलपराक्रमान्। समरे विमलैः शस्त्रैरुपनिन्युर्यमक्षयम्॥
en: The celestials, as well, began to send the redoubtable, powerful and terrific Räkşasas, with the stroke of blameless weapons, to the abode of Death.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम सुमाली नाम राक्षसः। नानाप्रहरणैः क्रुद्धस्तत्सैन्यं सोऽभ्यवर्तत॥ स दैवतबलं सर्वं नानाप्रहरणैः शितैः। व्यध्वंसयत संक्रुद्धो वायुर्जलधरं यथा॥
en: In the interim, O Rāma, a Rākşasa, Sumāli, by name, getting enraged, and with diverse weapons, ran amok of the soldiery. As the winds scatter clouds, so he, under the influence of rage, with various sharpened weapons, committed a havoc among the celestial soldiers.

sn: ते महाबाणवषैश्च शूलप्रासैः सुदारुणैः। हन्यमानाः सुराः सर्वे न व्यतिष्ठन्त संहताः।॥
en: Thereupon being assailed by a downpour of huge shafts, maces, Prāsas and diverse dreadful weapons, the celestials could not keep their ground upon the field of warfare.

sn: ततो विद्राव्यमाणेषु दैवतेषु सुमालिना। वसूनामष्टमः क्रुद्धः सावित्रो वै व्यवस्थितः॥ संवृतः स्वैरथानीकैः प्रहरन्तं निशाचरम्। विक्रमेण महातेजा वारयामास संयुगे॥
en: The celestials being thus distressed by Sumāli the eighth of Vasu, Savitra stood there enraged. And encircled by his own car-warriors that highly powerful one, with his prowess, repulsed the striking night-rangers.

sn: ततस्तयोर्महद्युद्धमभवल्लोमहर्षणम्। सुमालिनो वसोश्चैव समरेष्वनिवर्तिनोः॥
en: Thereupon there arose a terrible encounter, capable of making down erect, between Sumālin and the Vasu, who did not retire from the field of battle.

sn: ततस्तस्य महाबाणैर्वसुना सुमहात्मना। निहतः पन्नगरथः क्षणेन विनिपातितः।४६॥
en: His chariot drawn by serpents was pulled down and destroyed by the high-souled Vasu by means of his huge shafts.

sn: हत्वा तु संयुगे तस्य रथं बाणशतैश्चितम्। गदां तस्य वधार्थाय वसुर्जग्राह पाणिना॥ ततः प्रगृह्य दीप्तायां कालदण्डोपमां गदाम्। । मूर्धि पातयामास सावित्रो वै सुमालिनः॥
en: Having destroyed his car in the warfare with hundreds of arrows Vasu took up mace in his hands for his destruction. Having taken up that mace having a burning head and resembling the rod of Death Sāvitra struck Sumálin on his head there with.

sn: सा तस्योपरि चोल्काभा पतन्ती विवभौ गदा। इन्द्रप्रमुक्ता गर्जन्ती गिराविव महाशनिः॥
en: Having fallen on his head that mace shone like a fire-brand as the thunderbolt discharged by Indra, falls roaring on the summit of a mountain.

sn: तस्य नैवास्थि न शिरो न मांसं ददृशे तदा। गदया भस्मतां नीतं निहतस्य रणाजिरे॥
en: By the stroke of that mace his person was reduced to ashes and therefore, there was not seen in the battle field either his bone, head or flesh.

sn: तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं संख्ये राक्षसास्ते समन्ततः। व्यद्रवन्सहिताः सर्वे क्रोशमानाः परस्परम्। विद्राव्यमाणा वसुना राक्षसा नावतस्थिरे॥
en: Having beheld him slain in the warfare the Räkşasas bewailing ran about on all sides and being distressed by Vasu they could not stay in the battle field.

sn: सुमालिनं हतं दृष्ट्वा वसुना भस्मसात्कृतम्। स्वसैन्यं विद्रुतं चापि लक्षयित्वादितं सुरैः॥ ततः स बलवान्क्रुद्धो रावणस्य सुतस्तदा। निवर्त्य राक्षसान्सन्मेिघनादो व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Beholding Sumali slain and reduced to ashes by Vasu and being assailed by the deities the Räksasa host fled into diverse directions. And collecting all the Rākşasas stood there the highly powerful Meghanāda, enraged, the son of Ravana.

sn: स रथेन महार्हेण कामगेन महारथः। अभिदुद्राव सेनां तां वनान्यग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: Like to flaming fire approaching towards forest that great car-warrior encountered the enemies in a precious car coursing at will.

sn: ततः प्रविशतस्तस्य विविधायुधधारिणः। विदुद्रुवुर्दिशः सर्वा दर्शनादेव देवताः॥
en: As soon as he, armed with various weapons, entered the field the celestials, at his very sight. And away to all directions.

sn: न बभूव तदा कश्चिद्युयुत्सोरस्य संमुखे। सर्वानाविद्ध्य वित्रस्तांस्ततः शक्रोऽब्रवीत्सुरान्।।५
en: None could stand before him, well-versed in war-fare. Thereupon beholding the deities terrified and pierced with shafts, Indra, the king of gods, said.

sn: न भेतव्यं न गन्तव्यं निवर्तध्वं रणे सुराः। एष गच्छति पुत्रो मे युद्धार्थमपराजितः॥
en: Be not afraid, O you celestials; do not fly away; come back to the battle; this my son, who has never been vanquished, goes to battle.

sn: ततः शक्रसुतो देवो जयन्त इति विश्रुतः। रथेनाद्भुतकल्पेन सङ्ग्रामे सोऽभ्यवर्तत।७।।
en: Thereupon Sakra's son, known as divine Jayanta, proceeded towards the field of action by a wondrous car.

sn: ततस्ते त्रिदशाः सर्वे परिवार्य शचीसुतम्। रावणस्य सुतं युद्धे समासाद्य प्रजनिरे।।।।।
en: Having encircled Saci's son and encountered Rāvana's son, the deities began to assail him.

sn: तेषां युद्धं समभवत्सदृशं देवरक्षसाम्। महेन्द्रस्य च पुत्रस्य राक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्य च ॥
en: The encounter between Mahendra's son Jayanta and Rāvana's son Meghanāda was like one between gods and demons.

sn: ततो मातलिपुत्रस्य गोमुखस्य स रावणिः। सारथेः पातयामास शरान्कनकभूषणान्॥
en: Thereupon Rāvana's son began to assail, with shafts feathered in gold, his (Jayanta's) charioteer Gomukha, Mātali's son.

sn: शचीसुतश्चापि तथा जयन्तस्तस्य सारथिम्। तं चापि रावणिः क्रुद्धः समन्तात्प्रत्यविध्यता ॥ स हि क्रोधसमाविष्टो बली विस्फारितेक्षणः। रावणिः शक्रतनयं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Sacīs son too, enraged, assailed on all sides, Rāvana's son and his charioteer. And the powerful Rāvani, stricken with ire and with eyes expanded, covered Sakra's son with arrows.

sn: ततो नानाप्रहरणाञ्छितधारान्सहस्रशः। पातयामास संक्रुद्धः सुरसैन्येषु रावणिः॥ शतघ्नीमुसलप्रासगदाखङ्गपरश्वधान्। महान्ति गिरिशृङ्गाणि पातयामास रावणिः॥
en: Thereupon Rāvana's son struck the celestial host with thousands of huge mountain summits, Śataghnīs, maces, Prāsas, Prāsas, clubs, daggers, Paraśus and various other sharp pointed weapons.

sn: ततः प्रव्यथिता लोकाः संजज्ञे च तमस्ततः। तस्य रावणपुत्रस्य शत्रुसैन्यानि निघ्नतः॥
en: Rāvana's son thus striking Indra's army the quarters were enshrouded with darkness by his illusory power.

sn: ततस्तदैवतबलं समन्तात्तं शचीसुतम्। बहुप्रकारमस्वस्थमभवच्छरपीडितम्॥
en: Being overpowered with arrows on all sides the celestial army, leaving aside Jayanta, became restless.

sn: नाभ्यजानन्त चान्योन्यं रक्षो वा देवताथवा। तत्र तत्र विपर्यस्तं समन्तात्परिधावत ॥
en: The deities or the Rākşasas, they could not recognise one another. And being distressed they ran about on all sides.

sn: देवा देवानिजघ्नुस्ते राक्षसान्राक्षसास्तथा। संमूढास्तमसा छन्ना व्यद्रवनपरे तथा॥
en: Being enveloped with darkness and having their senses bewildered the celestials killed their own kith and the Rākṣasas their own men, and others fled away.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरः पुलोमा नाम वीर्यवान्। दैत्येन्द्रस्तेन संगृह्य शचीपुत्रोऽपवाहितः॥
en: In the interim a heroic and powerful Daityachief, Pulomā, be name, taking ſacī's son disappeared.

sn: संगृह्य तं तु दौहित्रं प्रविष्टः सागरं तदा। आर्यकः स हि तस्यासीत्पुलोमा येन सा शची।।२०
en: Taking his own grand-son he entered into the ocean, Puloma was his grand-father for by him Śaci was begotten.

sn: ज्ञात्वा प्रणाशं तु तदा जयन्तस्याथ देवताः। अप्रहृष्टास्ततः सर्वा व्यथिताः संप्रदुद्रुवुः॥
en: Thinking that Jayanta was slain all the deities greatly sorry and distressed fled away on all sides.

sn: रावणिस्त्वथ संक्रुद्धो बलैः परिवृतः स्वकैः। अभ्यधावत देवांस्तान्मुमोच च महास्वनम्॥
en: Thereupon Rāvana's son, enraged and encircled by his own powerful followers, pursued the celestials emitting loud cries.

sn: दृष्ट्वा प्रणाशं पुत्रस्य दैवतेषु च विद्वतन्। मातलिं चाह देवेशो रथः समुपनीयताम्॥
en: Not beholding his son and observing the flight of the deities the king of the celestials said to Mātali, “Bring the car."

sn: स तु दिव्या महाभीमः सज्ज एव महारथः। उपस्थितो मातलिना बाह्यमानो महाजवः॥
en: By Mātali was brought, the celestial, highly dreadful, huge and quick-coursing chariot, that was ready.

sn: ततो मेघा रथे तस्मिंस्तडित्त्वन्तो महाबलाः। अग्रतो वायुचपला नेदुः परमनिःस्वनाः॥
en: (And he having) ascended the car, the huge clouds, with lightening, being driven by winds, began to emit forth loud mutterings before the chariot.

sn: नानावाद्यानि वाद्यन्त गन्धर्वाश्च समाहिताः। ननृतुश्चाप्सरःसङ्घा निर्याते त्रिदशेश्वरे॥
en: The Gandharvas began to play on various instruments and the Apsarās began to dance.

sn: रुद्रैर्वसुभिरादित्यैरश्विभ्यां समरुद्गणैः। वृतो नानाप्रहरणैर्निर्ययौ त्रिदशाधिपः॥
en: Taking up various weapons, Indra, the king of divinities, set out for the field of action, in the company of Rudras, Vasus, Adityas, the two Asvins and Maruts.

sn: निर्गच्छतस्तु शक्रस्य परुषः पवनो ववौ। भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चैव महोल्काश्च प्रपेदिरे॥
en: He, having set out for battle, the winds began to blow high, the sun was divested of its brilliance and the huge fire-brands began to send out flames.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरो दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्। आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा।२९।। पन्नगैः सुमहाकायैर्वेष्टितं लोमहर्षणैः। येषां निःश्वासवातेन प्रदीप्तमिव संयुगे॥
en: In the interval the heroic and the highly powerful Daśagrīva ascended the celestial car, constructed by the Architect of the deities, encircled by the huge-bodied serpents capable of making down erect and by whose breath the battle-field was ablaze.

sn: दैत्यैनिशाचरैश्चैव स रथः परिवारितः। समराभिमुखो दिव्यो महेन्द्रं सोऽभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Surrounded by demons and night-rangers and with the celestial car he encountered Mahendra in the battle-field.

sn: पुत्रं तं वारयित्वा तु स्वयमेव व्यवस्थितः। सोऽपि युद्धाद्विनिष्क्रम्य रावणिः समुपाविशत्॥
en: Having desisted his son he himself stood there. And having coming out from the field of action Ravana's son too stood silent.

sn: ततो युद्धं प्रवृत्तं तु सुराणां राक्षसैः सह। शस्त्राणि वर्षतां तेषां मेघनामिव संयुगे॥
en: Thereupon there arose an encounter between the Räkşasas and the deities and there began a downpour of weapons in the conflict like clouds.

sn: कुम्भकर्णस्तु दुष्टात्मा नानाप्रहरणोद्यतः। नाज्ञायत तदा राजन्युद्धं केनाभ्यपद्यत॥
en: The vicious-souled Kumbhakarņa armed with various weapons came you, but he did not know,* O king, with whom the conflict was going on. *For he was asleep till then so he was not acquainted with the particulars war-fare. He used to sleep for six months at a time.

sn: दन्तैः पादैर्भुजैर्हस्तैः शक्तितोमरमुद्गरैः। येन तेनैव संक्रुद्धस्ताडयामास देवताः॥
en: And by him enraged, the celestials were assailed with his teeth, feet, arms, hands, Saktis, Tomaras and clubs or any weapon whatsoever.

sn: स तु रुदैर्महाघोरैः संगम्याथ निशाचरः। प्रयुद्धस्तैश्च संग्रामे क्षतः शस्त्रैर्निरन्तरम्॥
en: Thereupon the night-ranger engaged with the highly powerful Rudra and was wounded, in the conflict, with incessant strokes of weapons.

sn: ततस्तद्राक्षसं सैन्यं प्रयुद्धं समरुद्गणैः। रणे विद्रावितं सर्वं नानाप्रहरणैस्तदा॥
en: Thereupon the Rākşasas army began to fight with Maruts and they were overwhelmed in the encounter with the stroke of various weapons.

sn: केचिद्विनिहताः कृत्ताश्चेष्टन्ति स्म महीतले। वाहनेष्ववसक्ताश्च स्थिता एवपारे रणे॥ रथानागान्खराष्ट्रान्पन्नगांस्तुरगांस्तथा। शिशुमारान्वराहांश्च पिशाचवदनानपि॥ तान्समालिङ्गय बाहुभ्यां विष्टब्धाः केचिदुत्थिताः। देवैस्तु शस्त्रसंभिन्ना मनिरे च निशाचराः॥ चित्रकर्म इवाभाति सर्वेषां रणसंप्लवः। निहतानां प्रसुप्तानां राक्षसानां महीबले॥
en: Some fell down on earth of their carriers in the battle. And they all stood there in a halfsensible mood, some holding the car, some elephants, some asses, some boars, some Piśācamouthed animals and some embracing the Pannagas. And other night-rangers, having their bodies sundered by the deities gave up their being. The Rakşasas being slain and lying down on earth the action appeared wondrous like a painting.

sn: शोणितोदकनिष्पन्दा काकगृध्रसमाकुला। प्रवृत्ता संयुगमुखे शस्त्रग्राहवती नदी॥
en: There issued out in the battle-field a river from weapons, having blood for its silent waters and infested with crows and vultures.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्। निरीक्ष्य तु बलं सर्वं दैवतैर्विनिपातितम्॥ स तं प्रतिविगाह्याशु प्रवृद्धं सैन्यसागरम्। त्रिदशान्समरे निघ्नशक्रमेवाभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Having beheld his own army slain by the deities the highly powerful Daśänana, enraged beholding the army slain by gods, entered the ocean of celestial army and slaying the deities in the conflict confronted Sakra.

sn: ततः शक्रो महच्चापं विस्फार्य सुमहास्वनम्। यस्य विस्फारनिर्घोषैः स्तनन्ति स्म दिशो दश।।४५
en: Thereupon Śakra took up his huge bow by the twang where-of the ten quarters were filled.

sn: तद्विकृष्य महच्चापमिन्द्रो रावणमूर्धनि। पातयामास स शरान्पावकादित्यवर्चसः॥
en: Having unstrung his huge bow Indra struck Răvaņa, on his head, with arrows resembling the flame of fire and the rays of the sun.

sn: तथैव च महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवो निशाचरः। शक्रं कार्मुकविभ्रष्टैः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: And the Rākşasa-chief Daśānana, having long arms, also assailed Indra with hundreds of shafts discharged off his bow.

sn: प्रयुध्यतोरथ तयोर्बाणवषैः समन्ततः। नाज्ञायत तदा किंचित्सर्वं हि तमसा वृतम्॥
en: They having been thus engaged with each other with the downpour of dreadful shafts, all the quarters were filled with darkness and in consequence thereof nothing was visible.

sn: ततस्तमसि संजाते सर्वे ते देवराक्षसाः। आयुद्ध्यन्त बलोन्मत्ताः : सूदयन्तः परस्परम्॥
en: Thereupon darkness having set in all the celestials and Rākşasas, maddened with their strength, began to fight rushing one another.

sn: इन्द्रश्च रावणश्चैव रावणिश्च महाबलः। तस्मिंस्तमोजालवृते मोहमीयुर्न ते त्रयः॥ स तु दृष्ट्वा बलं सर्वं रावणो निहतं क्षणात्। क्रोधमभ्यगमतीव्र महानादं च मुक्तवान्॥
en: And in that darkness-Indra, Ravana and Meghanāda— these three were not possessed by the influence of illusion. Beholding his whole army slain in a moment, Ravana, worked up with dreadful ire, sent out terrible roars.

sn: क्रोधात्सूतं च दुर्धर्षः स्यन्दनस्थमुवाच ह। परसैन्यस्य मध्येन यावदन्तो नयस्व माम्॥
en: And in anger, that irrepressible one said to the charioteer, stationed on the car, “Do you take me to the other end of the enemies' host."

sn: अद्यैव त्रिदशान्सर्वान्विक्रमैः समरे स्वयम्। नानाशस्त्रमहासारैर्नयामि यमसादनम्॥
en: I shall soon in the field of battle, with the stroke of various weapons despatch all the deities to the abode of Death,

sn: अहमिन्द्रं वधिष्यामि धनदं वरुणं यमम्। त्रिदशान्विनिहत्याशु स्वयं स्थास्याम्यथोपरि॥
en: I shall slay Indra, Kubera, Varuna and Yama, what to speak of more, I shall soon destroy all the deities and place myself above them.

sn: विषादो नैव कर्तव्यः शीघ्रं वाहय मे रथम्। द्विः खलु त्वां ब्रवीम्यद्य यावदन्तं नयस्व माम्॥
en: Be not sorry; do you soon drive my chariot. To-day I have told you twice to take me to the end of the enemy's army.

sn: अयं स नन्दनोद्देशो यत्र वर्तावहे वयम्। नय मामद्य तत्र त्वमुदयो यत्र पर्वतः॥
en: We are now waiting near the Nandana grove, do you take me to the hill when the sun rises.

sn: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तुरगान्स मनोजवान्। आदिदेशाथ शत्रुणां मध्येनैव च सारथि।।।।।
en: Hearing his words the charioteer drove the steeds, coursing at will through the enemies' host.

sn: तस्य तं निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा शक्रो देवेश्वरस्तदा। रथस्थः समरस्थस्तान्देवान्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon being apprised of his intention, Śakra, the king of the celestials, stationed on car, said to the deities, in the field of battle.

sn: सुराः शृणुत मद्वाक्यं यत्तावन्मम रोचते। जीवन्नेव दशग्रीवः साधु रक्षो निगृह्यताम्॥
en: O you deities-bear my words, what appear to me best. This Ten-necked demon must be vanquished by us while alive.

sn: एष ह्यतिबलः सैन्ये रथेन पवनौजसा। गमिष्यति प्रवृद्धोर्मिः समुद्र इव पर्वणि ॥
en: Ascending his car, gifted with the velocity of the wind, the highly powerful one is proceeding among the army like to the deep with waves rising during Parva.

sn: नह्येष हन्तुं शक्योऽद्य वरदानात्सुनिर्भयः। तद्ग्रहीष्यामहे रक्षो यत्ता भवत संयुगे॥
en: It is not possible to slay him now, for he shall not meet with death in consequence of the boon. So let us make him captive-and we should all exert to that end.

sn: यथा बलौ निरुद्धे च त्रैलोक्यं भुज्यते मया। एवमेतस्य पापस्य निरोधो मम रोचते॥
en: Bali being held captive, I am enjoying the three worlds-and I think proper to obstruct the course of this vicious-souled one.

sn: ततोऽन्यं देशमास्थाय शक्रः संत्यज्य रावणम्। अयुध्यत महाराज राक्षसांस्त्रासयरणे॥
en: Having said this and left aside Råvaņa, Sakra went to another side, O King, and fought terrifying the Rākşasas in the conflict.

sn: उत्तरेण दशग्रीवः प्रविवेशानिवर्तकः। दक्षिणेन तु पार्श्वेन प्रविवेश शतनुतुः॥
en: Dasagriva, incapable of being thwarted, entered by the northern route and the performer of hundred sacrifices by the southern.

sn: ततः स योजनशतं प्रविष्टो राक्षसाधिपः। देवतानां बलं सर्वं शरवरवाकिरत्॥
en: Thereupon having entered into the army up to a hundred leagues the lord of Rākşasas overpowered the celestial host with a downpour of shafts.

sn: ततः शक्रो निरीक्ष्याथ प्रनष्टं तु स्वकं बलम्। न्यवर्तयदसंभ्रान्तः समावृत्य दशाननम्॥
en: Thereupon beholding his own army slain Sakra, returned fearlessly and obstructed the Ten-necked demon.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नादो मुक्तो दानवराक्षसैः। हा हताः स्म इति ग्रस्तं दृष्ट्वा शक्रेण रावणम्॥
en: In the interim beholding Rāvaņa brought under his grasp by Śakra the demons and Raksasas cried aloud, “Alas we are slain."

sn: ततो रथं समास्थाय रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। तत्सैन्यमतिसंक्रुद्धः प्रविवेश सुदारुणम्॥
en: Thereupon ascending his car Ravana's son, became senseless by his wrath and beside himself with rage, entered the dreadful flank.

sn: तां प्रविश्य महामायां प्राप्तां पशुपतेः पुरा। प्रविवेश सुसंरब्धस्तत्सैन्यं समभिद्रवत्॥
en: Having resorted to the illusory powers, conferred upon him yore by Pasupati he entered into the enemies' camp and belaboured them.

sn: स सर्वा देवतास्त्यक्त्वा शक्रमेवाभ्यधावत। महेन्द्रश्च महातेजा नापश्यच्च सुतं रिपोः॥
en: Having left behind all other deities he pursued Indra and the highly effulgent Mahendra too espied his enemy's son.

sn: विमुक्तकवचस्तत्र बध्यमानोऽपि रावणिः। त्रिदशैः सुमहावीनं चकार च.किंचन ॥
en: And albeit assailed by the highly powerful deities, Ravanas son, divested of mail, entertained no fear.

sn: स मातलिं समायान्तं ताडयित्वा शरोत्तमैः। महेन्द्रं बाणवर्षेण भूय एवाभ्यवाकिरत्॥
en: Having overpowered the approaching charioteer Måtalt, with many excellent arrows he covered Mahendra with a downpour of shafts.

sn: ततस्त्यक्त्वा रथं शक्रो विससर्ज च सारथिम्। ऐरावतं समारुह्य मृगयामास रावणिम्॥
en: Thereat having left his car and charioteer Indra mounted his elephant Airāvata and ran about in search of Ravana's son.

sn: स तत्र मायाबलवानदृश्योऽथान्तरिक्षगः। इन्द्रं मायापरिक्षिप्तं कृत्वा स प्राद्रवच्छरैः॥
en: Being invisible in the welkin by virtue of his illusory powers and having brought Indra under the influence thereof he struck him with hundreds of arrows.

sn: स तं यदा परिश्रान्तमिन्द्रं जज्ञेऽथ रावणिः। तदैनं मायया बद्ध्वा स्वसैन्यमभितोऽनयत्॥
en: When Råvaņa's son came to know that Indra was exhausted he, having bound him up by virtue of illusion, proceeded towards his army.

sn: तं तु दृष्ट्वा बलात्तेन नीयमानं महारणात्। महेन्द्रममराः सर्वे किं नु स्यादित्यचिन्तयन्॥
en: Having seen Mahendra carried away by force from the battle field the deities thought“What is this?”

sn: दृश्यते न स मायावी शक्रजित्समितिंजयः। विद्यावानपि येनेद्रो माययापहृतो बलात्॥
en: That conqueror of Śakra and subduer of enemies, conversant with illusory powers, was not visible, by whom, Indra, although master of many illusions, was carried away by force.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धाः सर्वे सुरगणास्तदा। रावणं विमुखीकृत्य शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्॥
en: In the meantime, the celestials, all enraged, covered Rāvana with a downpour of shafts and belaboured him.

sn: रावणस्तु समासाद्य आदित्यांश्च वसूंस्तदा। न शशाक स सङ्गामे योद्धं शत्रुभिरदितः॥
en: And being worn out in the encounter with the Ādityas and Vasus he was not capable of fighting any more.

sn: स तं दृष्ट्वा परिम्लानं प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृतम्। रावणिः पितरं युद्धे दर्शनस्थोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Beholding his father thus distressed and assailed in warfare with strokes, Ravana's son, although invisible, said.

sn: आगच्छ तात गच्छामो रणकर्म निवर्तताम्। जितं नो विदितं तेऽस्तु स्वस्थो भव गतज्वरः।।३३
en: Do you come, O father, our work in the battle field is finished; know, we have achieved victory; be you consoled and divested of agonies.

sn: अयं हि सुरसैन्यस्य त्रैलोक्यस्य च यः प्रभुः। स गृहीतो देवबलाद्भग्नदर्पाः सुराः कृताः॥
en: By virtue of my illusory powers I have made Mahendra captive the lord of the three worlds and of the celestial host and have crushed down the pride of the deities.

sn: यथेष्टं भुक्ष्व लोकांस्त्रीनिगृह्यारातिमोजसा। वृथा किं ते श्रमेणेह युद्धमद्य तु निष्फलम्॥
en: Having subdued your enemy by virtue of your prowess do you enjoy the three worlds at your pleasure. What is the use of labouring again? And useless it is to fight again.

sn: ततस्ते दैवतगणा निवृत्ता रणकर्मणः। तच्छ्रुत्वा रावणेर्वाक्यं शक्रहीनाः सुरा गताः॥
en: Hearing the words of Rāvana's son the deities retired from the battle field, and went away without Sakra.

sn: दशरिपुः प्रथितो निशाचरेन्द्रः। स्वसुतवचनमादृतः प्रियं तत्समनुनिशम्य जगाद चैव सूनुम्॥
en: And hearing the sweet words of his son, the lord of the night-rangers, the enemy of the celestials, having great prowess and wide spread fame, desisted from fighting and affectionately said to his son.

sn: अतिबलसदृशैः पराक्रमैस्त्वं मम कुलवंशविवर्धनः प्रभो। यदयमतुलबलस्त्वयाद्य वै त्रिदशपतिस्त्रिदशाश्च निर्जिताः॥
en: You have enhanced the glory of our race displaying the prowess like a highly powerful man. You have vanquished the celestials and their king of unequalled might.

sn: नय रथमधिरोप्य वासवं नगरमितो व्रज सेनया वृतस्त्वम्। अहमपि तव पृष्ठतो दुतं सह सचिवैरनुयामि हृष्टवत्॥
en: Do you set out hence for the city, taking Indra on your chariot and surrounded by soldiers. I shall, soon, delighted, follow you with my councillors.

sn: त्रिदशपतिं परिगृह्य रावणिः। स्वभवनमधिगम्य वीर्यवान् कृतसमरान्विससर्ज राक्षसान्॥
en: Thereupon having returned home with his army and chariots and taking the king of the celestials, the powerful son of Rāvana dismissed the victorious warriors.

sn: जिते महेन्द्रेऽतिबले रावणस्य सुतेन वै। प्रजापति पुरस्कृत्य ययुर्लङ्कां सुरास्तदा॥
en: The highly powerful Mahendra being thus defeated by Ravana's son, all the celestials, taking the patriarch Brahmä before them, went to Lanka.

sn: तत्र रावणमासाद्य पुत्रभ्रातृभिरावृतम्। अब्रवीद्गगने तिष्ठन्सामपूर्व प्रजापतिः॥
en: Having obtained Rāvana encircled by his sons and brothers the Patriarch, stationed in the welkin, calmly said.

sn: वत्स रावण तुष्टोऽस्मि पुत्रस्य तव संयुगे। अहोऽस्य विक्रमौदार्य तव तुल्योऽधिकोऽपि वा।।३
en: My son, Ravana, I have been pleased with your son in the conflict. Oh! what wonderful prowess, what strength-equal or greater than your.

sn: जितं हि भवता सर्व त्रैलोक्यं स्वेन तेजसा। कृता प्रतिज्ञा सफला प्रीतोऽस्मि ससुतस्य ते।४॥
en: You have, by your own prowess, conquered the three worlds — your promise has borne fruits-I have been pleased with you-both the father and son.

sn: अयं च पुत्रोऽतिबलस्तव रावण वीर्यवान्। जगतीन्द्रजिदित्येव परिख्यातो भविष्यति॥
en: O Rāvana, this your son is highly powerful and gifted with great strength and he shall be celebrated in the world under the appellation of 'Indrajit' or the conqueror of Indra.

sn: बलवान्दुर्जयश्चैव भविष्यत्येव राक्षसः। यं समाश्रित्य ते राजहन्स्थापितास्त्रिदशा वशे॥
en: The Raksasa shall be powerful and irrepressible, by those help, O King, the celestials have been brought under your subjection.

sn: तन्मुच्यतां महाबाहो महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः। किंचास्य मोक्षणार्थाय प्रयच्छन्तु दिवौकसः॥
en: Do you therefore, O you having long arms, release Mahendra, she chastiser of Pāka and for setting him free what do you want from the celestials?

sn: अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा इन्द्रजित्समितिंजयः। अमरत्वमहं देव वृणे योष मुच्यते॥
en: Thereupon the highly powerful Indrajit-the subduer of enemies, said: "If do you say so, O god, I pray for immortality."

sn: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा मेघनादं प्रजापतिः। नास्ति सर्वामरत्वं हि कस्यचित्प्राणिनो भुवि॥ पक्षिणश्चतुष्पदो वा भूतानां वा महौजसाम्।
en: Thereat the highly powerful patriarch said to Meghanāda, “There is none perfectly immortal on earth among created beings, birds, quadrupeds and other highly powerful beings.”

sn: श्रुत्वा पितामहेनोक्तमिन्द्रजित्प्रभुणाव्ययम्॥ अथाब्रवीत्स तत्रस्थं मेघनादो महाबलः।
en: Hearing the words uttered by the grandfather, the highly powerful Meghanāda said to the eternal lord.

sn: श्रूयतां वा भवेत्सिद्धिः शतक्रतुविमोक्षणे॥ ममेष्टं नित्यशो हव्यैर्मन्त्रैः संपूज्य पाचकम्। सङ्ग्राममवततुं च शत्रुनिर्जयकाङ्क्षिणः॥ अश्वयुक्तो रथो मह्यमुत्तिष्वेत्त विभावसोः। तत्स्थस्यामरता स्यान्मे एष मे निश्चितो वरः॥
en: Hear, then, what I want in exchange for releasing Sakra. May a chariot with horses rise up from fire when I shall offer sacrifices to it, being desirous of vanquishing my enemies in the conflict. And may I be immortal as long as I shall remain on that car. This is the boon I have resolved upon praying for.

sn: तस्मिन्यद्यसमाप्ते च जप्यहोमे विभावसौ। युध्येयं देव संग्रामे तदा मे स्याद्विनाशनम्॥
en: May I meet with destruction, O deity, whenever I shall engage in fight without finishing my offerings to fire.

sn: सर्वो हि तपसा देव वृणोत्यमरतां पुमान्। विक्रमेण मया त्वेतदमरत्वं प्रवर्तितम्॥
en: All others, O god, attain to immortality by virtue of devout penances but I shall acquire that by dint of my own prowess.

sn: एवमस्त्विति तं चाह वाक्यं देवः पितामहः। मुक्तश्चेन्द्रजिता शक्रो गताश्च त्रिदिवं सुराः॥
en: Where to the grand-father replied saying "so be it." Thereupon Meghanäda released Indra and the celestials returned to their own abode.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम दीनो भ्रष्टामरद्युतिः। इन्द्रश्चिन्तापरीतात्मा ध्यानतत्परतां गतः॥
en: In the interval, O Rāma, Indra became poorly, divested of his immortal brilliance, stricken with anxiety and pensive.

sn: तं तु दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतं प्राह देवः पितामहः। शतक्रतो किमु पुरा करोति स्म सुदुष्कृतम्॥
en: Beholding him in that plight the grand-father of the deities said:-O performer of hundred sacrifices, why did you formerly perpetrate that mighty iniquity?

sn: अमरेन्द्र मया बुद्ध्या प्रजाः सृष्टास्तथा प्रभो। एकवर्णाः समाभाषा एकरूपाश्च सर्वशः॥
en: O Chief of the immortals! O lord!, some creatures were all of the same colour, same speech, and same appearance.

sn: तासां नास्ति विशेषो हि दर्शने लक्षणेऽपि वा। ततोऽहमेकाग्रमनास्ताः प्रजाः समचिन्तयम्॥
en: There was no difference visible in their appearance or marks. Thereupon, with wholeminded-ness, I began to think of these created beings.

sn: सोऽहं तासां विशेषार्थं स्त्रियमेकां विनिर्ममे। यद्यत्प्रजानां प्रत्यङ्गं विशिष्टं तत्तदुद्धृतम्॥ ततो मया रूपगुणैरहल्या स्त्री विनिर्मिता। हलं नामेह वैरूप्यं हल्यं तत्प्रभवं भवेत्॥ यस्य च विद्यते हल्यं तेनाहल्येति विश्रुता। अहल्येत्येव च मया तस्या नाम प्रकीर्तितम्॥
en: And I created a female distinct from them. Collecting all those limbs that were most excellent among the created, I made a female under the name of Ahalyä. Hal means uglinessone born from Hal is called Halya. That female was known as Ahalyā because she had nothing blameable in her, I gave her that name.

sn: निर्मितायां च देवेन्द्र तस्यां नायाँ सुरर्षभ। भविष्यतीति कस्यैषा मम चिन्ता ततोऽभवत्।।२४
en: Having created that female I was thinking, O king of the celestials! O foremost of the deities!, on whom I should confer her.

sn: त्वं तु शक्र तदा नारी जानीषे मनसा प्रभो। स्थानाधिकतया पत्नी ममैषेति पुरंदर॥
en: Being proud of dignity, O Sakra, O lord, O Purandara you did regard her in your mind as your spouse.

sn: सा मया न्यासभूता तु गौतमस्य महात्मनः। न्यस्ता बहूनि वर्षाणि तेन निर्यातिता च ह॥
en: I placed her under the care of the high-souled Gautama and he rendered her back after many long years.

sn: ततस्तस्य परिज्ञाय महास्थैर्य महामुनेः। ज्ञात्वा तपसि सिद्धिंच पत्न्यर्थं स्पर्शिता तदा॥
en: Thereupon considering the patience and accomplished asceticism of Gautama I married her with him.

sn: स तया सह धर्मात्मा रमते स्म महामुनिः। आसन्निराशा देवास्तु गौतमे दत्तया तया॥
en: That virtuous-souled, great ascetic enjoyed her company; and for my thus conferring her upon Gautama alll the celestials disappointed.

sn: त्वं क्रुद्धस्त्विह कामात्मा गत्वा तस्याश्रमं मुनेः। दृष्टवांश्च तदा तां स्त्री दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव॥
en: But being enraged and possessed by lust you did repair to the hermitage of the ascetic and see her resplendent like the flaming fire.

sn: सा त्वया धर्षिता शक्र कामार्तेन समन्युना। दृष्टस्त्वं स तदा तेन आश्रमे परमर्षिणा॥
en: Maddened with lust and ire you did ravish her and you was seen in that hermitage by the great ascetic. were

sn: ततः कुद्धेन तेनासि शप्तः परमतेजसा। गतोऽसि येन देवेन्द्र दशाभागविपर्ययम्॥ यस्मान्मे धर्षिता पत्नी त्वया वासव निर्भयात्। तस्मात्त्वं समरे शक्र शत्रुहस्तं गमिष्यसि॥
en: You were then imprecated by him, enraged and gifted with great effulgence saying, 'O lord of the celestials, you have attained to a change of circumstances-for which, O Vásava, you have fearlessly ravished my spouse. You shall, therefore, O Sakra, go under the arms of the enemies, in conflict.

sn: अयं तु भावो दुर्बुद्धे यस्त्वयेह प्रवर्तितः। मानुषेष्वपि लोकेषु भविष्यति न संशयः॥
en: And this vile desire, O you having a vicious intellect, which you have first created, shall undoubtedly spread in the world of mortals.

sn: तत्रार्धं तस्य यः कर्ता त्वय्यर्धं निपतिष्यति। न च ते स्थावरं स्थानं भविष्यति न संशयः॥
en: Whoever shall commit this crime, shall be half responsible for it and the other half shall descend upon you; and forsooth your position shall not be permanent.

sn: यश्च यश्च सुरेन्द्रः स्यार्बुवः स न भविष्यति। एष शापो मया मुक्त इत्यसौ त्वां तदाब्रवीत्॥
en: Whoever shall be the lord of the celestials, shall not have his position secure. This is the curse I give, which I have communicated to you.

sn: तां तु भार्यां सुनिर्भर्म्य सोऽब्रवीत्सुमहातपाः। दुर्विनीते विनिध्वंस ममाश्रमसमीपतः॥ रूपयौवनसंपन्न यस्मात्त्वमनवस्थिता। तस्मादूपवती लोके न त्वमेका भविष्यति॥
en: Having remonstrated with his wife that one of devout penances said to her-'O vicious one, let your beauty be spoiled in the vicinity of the hermitage. You are gifted with beauty and youth but your mind is fickle; so you shall not continue as the single beautiful damsel in the world.

sn: रूपं च ते प्रजाः सर्वा गमिष्यन्ति न संशयः। यत्तदेकं समाश्रित्य विभ्रमोऽयमुपस्थितः॥
en: All created beings shall participate your beauty; your matchless beauty has brought about this mischief.' Thenceforward all created beings were gifted with beauty.

sn: तदाप्रभृति भूयिष्ठं प्रजा रूपसमन्विता। सा तं प्रसादयामास महर्षि गौतमं तदा॥ अज्ञानाद्धर्षिता विप्र त्वद्रूपेण दिवौकसा। न कामकाराद्विप्रर्षे प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Thereupon she propitiated the ascetic Gautama saying, “O twice-born one, I was unwittingly ravished by Indra, assuming your form. I have not committed this willingly, O ascetic-so do you be propitiated with me.”

sn: अहल्यया त्वेवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच स गौतमः। उत्पत्स्यति महातेजा इक्ष्वाकूणां महारथः॥ रामो नाम श्रुतो लोके वनं चाप्युपयास्यति। ब्राह्मणार्थे महाबाहुर्विष्णुर्मानुषविग्रहः।॥ तं द्रक्ष्यसि यदा भद्रे ततः पूता भविष्यसि। स हि पावयितुं शक्तस्त्वया यदुष्कृतं कृतम्॥
en: Ahalyā having said this, Gautama replied:In the race of Ikşvākus, there shall be born a highly effulgent and mighty car-warrior, known in the world as Răma; for performing the rites of a Brahmana, the mighty-armed Visnu, assuming a human form, shall repair to the forest. You shall be purified when you shall behold him, O fair damsel. He shall be able to purify you from the iniquity perpetrated.

sn: तस्यातिथ्यं च कृत्वा वै मत्समीपं गमिष्यसि। वत्स्यसि त्वं मया सार्धं तदा हि वरवर्णिनी।॥
en: Having treated him as a guest when you shall come to me again, you shall live with me, O you having a fair countenance.

sn: एवमुक्त्वा स विप्रषिराजगाम स्वमाश्रमम्। तपश्चचार सुमहत्सा पत्नी ब्रह्मवादिनः॥
en: Having said this that ascetic returned to his hermitage. And thenceforward the wife, of that ascetic chanting the themes of Brāhmaṇa, engaged in austere penances.

sn: शापोत्सर्गाद्धितस्येदं मुनेः सर्वमुपस्थितम्। तत्स्मर त्वं महाबाहो दुष्कृतं यत्त्वया कृतम्॥
en: You have met with all this in consequence of the imprecation of that ascetic. Therefore, O you having long arms, do you think of your past iniquity.

sn: तेन त्वं ग्रहणं शत्रोर्यातो नान्येन वासव। शीघ्रं वै यज यज्ञं त्वं वैष्णवं सुसमाहितः॥
en: For that curse and nothing else, O Vasava, you have been brought under the grasp of enemies. Having controlled your senses, do you soon undertake a sacrifice in honour of Vişņu.

sn: पावितस्तेन यज्ञेन यास्यसे त्रिदिवं ततः। पुत्रश्च तव देवेन्द्र न विनष्टो महारणे॥ नीतः संनिहितश्चैव आर्यकेण महोदधौ।
en: You shall be purified by that sacrifice and go to heaven; and your son, O lord of celestials, has not been destroyed in the conflict. He has been taken into the ocean by his grand father.

sn: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महेन्द्रस्तु यज्ञमिष्ट्वा च वैष्णवम्॥ पुनस्त्रिदिवमाक्रामदन्वशासच्च देवराट्।
en: Hearing this and having celebrated the sacrifice in honour of Vişnu he again went to the region of celestials and reigned there as their king.

sn: एतदिन्द्रजितो नाम बलं यत्कीर्तितं मया॥ निर्जितस्तेन देवेन्द्रः प्राणिनोऽन्ये तु किं पुनः।
en: I have thus described to you the strength of Indrajit-what to speak of others he vanquished even Indra-the king of the celestials.

sn: आश्चर्यमिति रामश्च लक्ष्मणश्चाब्रवीत्तदा॥ अगस्त्यवचनं श्रुत्वा वानरा राक्षसास्तदा। बिभीषणस्तु रामस्य पार्श्वस्थो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ आश्चर्यं स्मारितोऽस्म्यद्य यत्तदृष्टं पुरातनम्।
en: Hearing the words of Agastya, Rāma, Lakşmaņa, Vānaras and Rākşasas all said wonderful it is; and Vibhīşaņa, who was by the side of Rama, said:-After a long time, the old recollections have come to my mind.

sn: अगस्त्यं त्वब्रवीद्रामः सत्मेतच्छ्रुतं च मे॥ एवं राम समुद्भुतो रावणो लोककण्टकः। सपुत्रो येन सङ्गामे जितः शक्रः सुरेश्वरः॥
en: Thereupon Rāma said to Agastya-All, you have said, is true. And Agastya said Rāma, Rāvaņa, the thorn of people, then grew in power, by whom, in the company of his son, Indra, the lord of the celestials, was defeated.

sn: ततो रामो महातेजा विस्मयात्पुनरेव हि। उवाच प्रणतो वाक्यमगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम्॥
en: Thereupon having bowed to Agastya the foremost of ascetics, the highly effulgent Rāma again surprisingly said.

sn: भगवनराक्षसः क्रूरो यदाप्रभृति मेदिनीम्। पर्यटत्किं तदा लोकाः शून्या आसन्द्विजोत्तम॥ राजा वा राजमात्रो वा किं तदा नात्र कश्चन। धर्षणं यत्र न प्राप्तो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः॥
en: "O Brāhmaṇa, O foremost of twice-born ones, when that cruel Rāvana journeyed over the earth, was it void of people? Was there no king, or prince on earth to administer punishment to him?

sn: उताहो हतवीर्यास्ते बभूवुः पृथिवीक्षितः। बहिष्कृता वरास्त्रैश्च बहवो निर्जिता नृपाः॥
en: Were all the kings then shorn of their strength and prowess? And many kings I (hear) were vanquished an driven out by him with various excellent weapons.

sn: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा अगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः। उवाच रामं प्रहसन्पितामह इवेश्वरम्॥
en: Hearing the words of Rāghava, the ascetic Agastya, having six sorts of wealth, laughing said, like to Brahmā, speaking to Rudra

sn: इत्येवं बाधमानस्तु पार्थिवान्पार्थिवर्षभ। चचार रावणो राम पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते॥ ततो माहिष्मती नाम पुरीं स्वर्गपुरीप्रभाम्। संप्राप्तो यत्र सांनिध्यं सदासीद्वसुरेतसः॥ तुल्य आसीन्नृपस्तस्य प्रभावाद्वसुरेतसः। अर्जुनो नाम यत्राग्निः शरकुण्डेशयः सदा॥
en: O Rāma, O lord of earth, traversing the earth, Rāvana arrived at the city of Māhismatī, resembling the city of the celestials, where lived perpetually the deity of fire. There reigned a king named Arjuna, effulgent like fire which was kept perpetually in a well covered with Sara.

sn: तमेव दिवसं सोऽथ हैहयाधिपतिर्बली। अर्जुनो नर्मदा रन्तुं गतः स्त्रीभिः सहेश्वरः॥
en: One day the highly powerful Arjuna, the king of Haihayas, repaired to the river Narmadā, with his wives to sport.

sn: तमेव दिवसं सोऽथ रावणस्तत्र आगतः। रावणो राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु तस्यामात्यानपृच्छत॥
en: At the very same day, Ravana, the lord of Rākṣasas, arrived there and asked his councillors saying.

sn: क्वार्जुनो नृपतिः शीघ्रं सम्यगाख्यातुमर्हथ। रावणोऽहमनुप्ताप्तो युद्धेप्सुनुवरेण ह॥
en: Where is the king Arjuna? Do you speedily tell me; I am Rāvana, I have come to fight with your king.

sn: ममागमनमप्यग्रे युष्माभिः संनिवेद्यताम्। इत्येवं रावणेनोक्तास्तेऽमात्याः सुविपश्चितः॥ अब्रुवनराक्षसपतिमसांनिध्यं महीपतेः।
en: Do you, at first, communicate to him the news of my arrival. Being thus addressed by Ravana, the learned ministers informed the lord of Raksasas, of the absence of the king.

sn: श्रुत्वा विश्रवसः पुत्रः पौराणामर्जुनं गतम्॥ अपसृत्यागतो बिन्ध्यं हिमवत्संनिभं गिरिम्।
en: Hearing of the absence of the king from the citizens Viśravasa's son came out of the city and reached the Vindhya mountain resembling the Himalayas.

sn: स तमभ्रमिवाविष्टमुद्धान्तमिव मेदिनीम्॥ अपश्यद्रावणो विन्ध्यमालिखन्तमिवाम्बरम्। सहस्रशिखरोपेतं सिंहाध्युषितकंदरम्॥ प्रपातपतितैः शीतैः साट्टहासमिवाम्बुभिः। देवदानवगन्धर्वैः साप्सरोभिः सकिंनरैः॥ स्वस्त्रीभिः क्रीडामानैश्च स्वर्गभूतं महोच्छ्रयम्। नदीभिः स्यन्दमानाभिः स्फटिकप्रतिमं जलम्।।१७ फणाभिश्चलजिह्वाभिरनन्तमिव विष्ठितम्। उत्क्रामन्तं दरीवन्तं हिमवत्संनिभं गिरिम्॥ पश्यमानस्ततो विन्ध्यं रावणो नर्मदां ययौ। चलोपलजला पुण्यां पश्चिमोदधिगामिनीम्॥ महिषैः सृमरैः सिंहै: शार्दूलर्भगजोत्तमैः। उष्णाभितप्तैस्तृषितैः संक्षोभितजलाशयाम्॥
en: He espied the mountain extending over the welkin like to clouds and rising up as if riving the earth and obstructing the sky. The mountain had a thousand summits and the lions were residing in the caves and hundreds of fountain were falling from it; the mountain was as if laughing aloud and the celestials, Gandharvas, Apsarās and Kinsaras were sporting there with their females, and it appeared in consequence thereof) like the region of celestials; and rivers, with waters transparent like crystal, were flowing. And it therefore appeared like a thousand serpents having trembling tongues. And casting his looks upon Vindhya mountain, resembling the Himalayas and having huge caves, Ravana, the king of Raksasas, reached the river Narmadā, of holy waters and going rapidly to the western ocean. Her waters were being agitated by buffaloes, deer, tigers, lions, bears and elephants distressed by heat.

sn: चक्रवाकैः सकारण्डैः सहसजलकुक्कुटैः। सारसैश्च सदा मत्तैः कूजद्भिः सुसमावृताम्॥
en: Having covered her, Cakravakas, Karandavas, swans, water-cocks and Sārasas, maddened, were emitting notes.

sn: फुल्लदुमकृतोत्तंसां चक्रवाकयुगस्तनीम्। विस्तीर्णपुलिनश्रोणी हंसावलिसुमेखलाम्॥ पुष्परेण्वनुलिप्ताङ्गी जलफेनामलांशुकाम्। जलावगाहसुस्पशा फुल्लोत्पलशुभेक्षणाम्॥ पुष्पकादवरुह्याशु नर्मदां सरितां वराम्। इष्टामिव वरां नारीमवगाह्य दशाननः॥ स तस्याः पुलिने रम्ये नानामुनिनिषेविते। उपोपविष्टः सचिवैः सार्धं राक्षसपुङ्गवः॥
en: The charming Narmadā appeared like a beautiful damsel-having blossoming trees for her waist, the row of swans for Mekhala, filaments of flowers for paste, watery foams for white silken cloth, the pleasure of descending into water for the pleasure of touch and fullblown lotuses for white eyes. Having descended from his car and bathed in the waters of Narmadā, the foremost of streams, resembling a fair one, Ravana, the lord of Raksasas, with his councillors, sat on her coast resided by many an ascetic.

sn: प्रख्याय नर्मदां सोऽथ गङ्गेयमिति रावणः। नर्मदादर्शने हर्षमाप्तवान्स दशाननः॥ उवाच सचिवांस्तत्र सलीलं शुकसारणौ। एष रश्मिसहस्रेण जगत्कृत्वेव काञ्चनम्॥ तीक्ष्णतापकरः सूर्यो नभसो मध्यमास्थितः।
en: Delighted at her beauty and having spoken highly of Narmadā like to Gangă he addressed his ministers Suka and Sāraṇa with gestures, saying:-“Behold, having rendered the earth pale, with his many rays, the sun, emitting parching heat, is in the sky.

sn: मामासीनं विदित्यैव चन्द्रायति दिवाकरः॥ नर्मदाजलशीतश्च सुगन्धिः श्रमनाशनः। मद्भयादनिलो ह्येष वात्यसौ सुसमाहितः॥
en: But seeing me here seated, his rays have become cool like those of the moon. At my fear, even the wind is blowing carefully, being cold and fragrant by the touch of the waters of the Narmadā and removing our toil.

sn: इयं वापि सरिच्छेष्टा नर्मदा शर्मवर्धिनी। नक्रमीनविहंगोर्मिः सभयेवाङ्गना स्थिता॥
en: This charming Narmadā, abounding in crocodiles, fishes and birds, though a natural stream, is standing still like a terrified damsel.

sn: तद्भवन्तः क्षताः शस्त्रैर्नृपैरिन्द्रसमैयुधि । चन्दनस्य रसेनेव रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः॥
en: Being wounded in conflicts with many a king your persons have been pasted with blood.

sn: ते यूयमवागहध्वं नर्मदां शर्मदां शुभाम्। सार्वभौममुखा मत्ता गङ्गामिव महागजाः॥
en: Therefore like to Särvabhauma and other infuriated elephants going down into the water of the Ganges, do you descend into the water of Narmadā conferring auspiciousness and health.

sn: अस्यां स्नात्वा महानद्यां पाप्मनो विप्रमोक्ष्यथ। अहमप्यद्य पुलिने शरदिन्दुसमप्रभे॥ पुष्पोपहारं शनकैः करिष्यामि कपर्दिनः।
en: Bathing in this stream you shall be cleansed from sins. I shall, also on the coast of this river, like the rays of the autumnal moon, reverentially worship with flowers Mahādeva, holding Pināka in his hands.

sn: रावणेनैवमुक्तास्तु प्रहस्तशुकसारणाः॥ समहोदरधूम्राक्षा नर्मदां विजगाहिरे।
en: Hearing the words of Ravana, Prahasta, Suka, Sarana, Mahodara, Dhumraksa and other councillors descended into the waters of Narmada.

sn: राक्षसेन्द्रगजैस्तैस्तु क्षोभिता नर्मदा नदी॥ वामनाञ्जनपद्मद्यैर्गङ्गा इव महागजैः।
en: She was agitated by those elephant like leading Rākşasas like to the Gargā by Vămana, Anjana, Padma and other elephants.

sn: ततस्ते राक्षसाः स्नात्वा नर्मदायां महाबलाः॥ उत्तीर्य पुष्पाण्याजवुर्बल्यर्थं रावणस्य तु।
en: Thereupon having got up from the waters the highly powerful Rākşasas culled flowers for Ravana's offerings.

sn: नर्मदापुलिने हृद्ये शुभ्राभ्रसदृशप्रभे॥ राक्षसैस्तु मुहुर्तेन कृतः पुष्पमयो गिरिः।
en: In a moment the Rākṣasas collected heaps of flowers on the picturesque banks of Narmadā, resembling the white clouds.

sn: पुष्पेषूपहतेष्वेवं रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः॥ अवतीर्णो नदी स्नातुं गङ्गामिव महागजः। तत्र स्नात्वा च विधिवज्जप्त्वा जप्यमनुत्तमम्॥ नर्मदासलिलात्तस्मादुत्ततार स रावणः।
en: Flowers being thus collected, Rāvana, the king of Rākşasas descended into the Narmadā for bathing like a huge elephant into the Gangā. And having bathed he got up, reciting excellent incantations.

sn: ततः क्लिन्नाम्बरं त्यक्त्वा शुक्लवस्त्रसमावृतः।।४० रावणं प्राञ्जलिं यान्तमन्वयुः सर्वराक्षसाः। तद्गतीवशमापन्ना मूर्तिमन्त इवाचलाः॥
en: Thereupon having left off his wet cloth he put on a white one. And to find out place for worshipping, he, with folded hands, proceeded towards the banks. And the Răkşasas too, like to so many moving mountains, followed him.

sn: यत्र यत्र च याति स्म रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः। जाम्बूनदमयं लिङ्गं तत्र तत्र स्म नीयते॥
en: Wherever Rāvana went the golden Siva Linga was brought.

sn: वालुकावेदिमध्ये तु तल्लिङ्गं स्थाप्य रावणः। अर्चयामास गन्धैश्च पुष्पैश्चामृतगन्धिभिः॥
en: Thereupon Rāvaņa placed that upon a heap of sands and began to worship it with various nectar-smelling flowers and sandal.

sn: ततः सतामार्तिहरं परं वरं वरप्रदं चन्द्रमयूखभूषणम्। समर्चयित्वा स निशाचरो जगौ प्रसार्य हस्तान्प्रणनर्त चाग्रतः॥
en: Having finished the worship of Siva, the foremost of deities, having ww moon on his crown, the conferrer of boons and the remover of miseries, the night-ranger danced with uplifted hands and sang before it.

sn: नर्मदापुलिने यत्र राक्षसेन्द्रः स दारुणः। पुष्पोपहारं कुरुते तस्माद्देशाददूरतः॥ अर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठो माहिष्मत्याः पतिः प्रभुः। क्रीडते सह नारीभिर्नर्मदातोयमाश्रितः॥
en: At no distance from where on the banks of the river Narmadā, that dreadful lord of Rākşasas collected the flowers, Arjuna, the King of Māhismatī, and the foremost of the victorious, was sporting with his wives in the water.

sn: तासां मध्यगतो राजा रराज न तदार्जुनः। करेणूनां सहस्रस्य मध्यस्थ इव कुञ्जरः॥
en: And being encircled by them the king Arjuna appeared like a leading elephant surrounded by a thousands of she elephants.

sn: जिज्ञासुः स तु बाहूनां सहस्रस्योत्तमं बलम्। रुरोध नर्मदावेगं बाहुभिर्बहुभिर्वृतः॥
en: In order to measure the strength of his thousand arms the King of Haihayas obstructed the course of Narmadă.

sn: कार्तवीर्यभुजासक्तं तज्जलं प्राप्य निर्मलम्। कूलोपहारं कुर्वाणं प्रतिस्रोतः प्रधावति॥
en: Being obstructed by the arms of Kārtavīryarjuna and having flooded the banks with her pure waters, Narmadā flowed in an opposite direction.

sn: समीननक्रमकरः सपुष्पकुशसंस्तरः। स नर्मदाम्भसो वेगः प्रावृट्काल इवाबभौ॥
en: The currents of Narmadā, rising high as during the rainy season flowed with fishes, and crocodiles.

sn: स वेगः कार्तवीर्येण संप्रेषित इवाम्भसः। पुष्पोपहारं सकलं रावणस्य जहार ह।७।।
en: That stream, as if driven against Rävaņa by Kārtavīryarjuna, carried away his collection of flowers.

sn: रावणोऽर्धसमाप्त तमुत्सृज्य नियमं तदा। नर्मदां पश्यते कान्तां प्रतिकूलां यथा प्रियाम्॥ पश्चिमेन तु तं दृष्ट्वा सागरोद्गारसंनिभम्। वर्धन्तमम्भसो वेगं पूर्वामाशां प्रविश्य तु।९।। ततोऽनुद्धान्तशकुनां स्वभावे परमे स्थिताम्। निर्विकाराङ्गनाभासामपश्यद्रावणो नदीम्॥
en: Having given up his worship which was halffinished Rāvana looked towards Narmadā looking like an unwilling damsel and saw that she, with rising currents, was flowing towards the east from the west and the waters beyond that were in a natural state like a quiet lady and the birds were seated there without any anxiety.

sn: सव्येतरकराङ्गुल्या ह्यशब्दास्यो दशाननः। वेगप्रभावमन्वेष्टुं सोऽदिशच्छुकसारणौ॥
en: Thereupon being anxious to learn the cause of the rise of the river, the Ten-necked demon, with his right finger, hinted Suka and Sarana.

sn: तौ तु रावणसंदिष्टौ भ्रातरौ शुकसारणौ। व्योमान्तरगतौ वीरौ प्रस्थितौ पश्चिमामुखौ॥
en: Being commanded by Rāvana, the two brothers, the heroic Suka and Sāraņa proceeded towards the west by the aerial way.

sn: अर्धयोजनमात्रं तु गत्वा तौ रजनीचरौ। पश्येतां पुरुष तोये क्रीडन्तं सहयोषितम्॥
en: And going half a league, the two night-rangers espied a man sporting in the waters with some females.

sn: बृहत्सालप्रतीकाशं तोयव्याकुलमूर्धनम्। मदरक्तान्तनयनं मदव्याकुलचेतसम्॥
en: He was huge as a Sāla tree, his hairs were floating on the water, he was inebriate and his eyes were reddened in consequence thereof.

sn: नदी बाहुसहस्रेण रुन्धन्तमरिमर्दनम्। गिरिं पादसहस्रेण रुन्धन्तमिव मेदिनीम्॥
en: Like to Sumeru holding the earth with his thousand feet he obstructed the current of the river with his thousand arms.

sn: बालानां वरनारीणां सहस्रेण समावृतम्। समदानां करेणूनां सहस्रेणेव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: He was surrounded by a thousands of beautiful damsels like an elephant by a thousands of she-elephants.

sn: तदद्भुततरं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसौ शुकसारणौ। संनिवृत्तावुपागम्य रावणान्तमथोचतुः॥
en: Beholding that dreadful spectacle, the Rākṣasas-Śuka and Sāraṇa came back and approaching Rāvaņa communicated (all) to him.

sn: बृहत्सालप्रतीकाशः कोऽप्यसौ राक्षसेश्वर। नर्मदां रोधवद्ध्वा क्रीडापयति योषितः॥
en: O lord of Rākşasas, an unknown person, huge as a Sāla tree, is sporting with females obstructing the course of Narmadā like to a dam.

sn: तेन बाहुसहस्रेण संनिरुद्धजला नदी सागरोद्रागरसंकासानुद्गारान्सृजते मुहुः॥
en: Being withheld by the thousand arms of that man the waters of Narmadā were continually throwing up high waves.

sn: इत्येवं भाषमाणौ तौ निशम्य शुकसारणौ। रावणोऽर्जुन इत्युक्त्वा स ययौ युद्धलालसः॥
en: Hearing the words of śuka and Sarana, Ravana exclaimed “This is Arjuna' and proceeded to fight with him.

sn: अर्जुनाभिमुखे तस्मिन्रावणे राक्षसाधिपे। चण्डः प्रवाति पवनः सनादः सरजस्तथा॥
en: Ravana, the lord of Raksasas, having set out with a hostile intention against Kārtavīryarjuna, the wind mixed with dust began to blow high with tumultuous sound.

sn: सकृदेव कृतो रावः सरक्तपृषतो घनैः। महोदरमहापार्श्वधूम्राक्षशुकसारणैः॥ संवृतो राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु तत्रागाद्यत्र चार्जुनः।
en: The clouds began to mutter with a downpour of rain. And the lord of Räkşasas proceeded against Arjuna with Mahodara. Mahāparáva, Dhumraksa, Suka and Sarana.

sn: अदीर्घेणैव कालेन स तदा राक्षसो बली॥ तं नर्मदाह्वदं भीममाजगामाञ्जनप्रभः। स तत्र स्त्रीपरिवृतं वासिताभिरिव द्विपम्॥ नरेन्द्रं पश्यते राजा राक्षसानां तदार्जुनम्।
en: Within a short time the dreadful Raksasa, powerful as the elephant Arjuna, reached the banks of Narmada and espied there Arjuna encircled by females as an elephant surrounded by she-elephants.

sn: स रोषाद्रक्तनयनो राक्षसेन्द्रो बलोद्धतः॥ इत्येवमर्जुनामात्यानाह गम्भीरया गिरा।
en: At the very sight the eyes of the lord of Raksasas, proud of his prowess, grew red and addressing the councillors of the king Arjuna he said.

sn: अमात्याः क्षिप्रमाख्यात हैहयस्य नृपस्य वै॥ युद्धार्थ समनुप्राप्तो रावणो नाम मामतः।
en: Do you communicate to the king of Haihayas that Rāvana, the lord of Raksasas, has come to fight with him.

sn: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा मन्त्रिणोऽथार्जुनस्य ते॥ उत्तस्थुः सायुधास्तं च रावणं वाक्यमब्रुवन् ।
en: Hearing the words of Rāvana, the ministers of Arjuna stood up with arms and said.

sn: युद्धस्य कालो विज्ञातः साधु भो साधु रावण ॥ यः क्षीबं स्त्रीगतं चैव योद्धमुत्सहसे नृपम्। स्त्रीसमक्षगतं यत्त्वं योद्धमुत्सहसे नृपम्॥ वासितामध्यगं मत्तं शार्दूल इव कुञ्जरम्। क्षमस्वाद्य दशग्रीव उष्यतां रजनी त्वया। युद्धे श्रद्धा तु यद्यस्ति श्वस्तात समरेऽर्जुनम् ॥ यदि वापि त्वरा तुभ्यं युद्धतृष्णासमावृत। निपात्यास्मानणे युद्धमर्जुनेनोपयास्यसि॥
en: O good Råvaņa, you are well cognisant of the proper time for fighting. Now our king is drunk and is sporting with the females in the waters like an elephant in the circle of female-elephants. And now do you wish to fight with him. Therefore, O Ten-necked one, do you spend the night here, if you are bent upon fighting. Or even if you are anxious to enter speedily into conflict with Arjuna do you slay us all at first, and then fight with the king.

sn: ततस्तै रावणामात्यैरमात्यास्ते नृपस्य तु। सूदिताश्चापि ते युद्धे भक्षिताश्च बुभुक्षितैः॥
en: Thereupon the hungry councillors of Rāvana, slew some of the ministers of the king and devoured some.

sn: ततो हलहलाशब्दो नर्मदातीरगो बभौ। अर्जुनस्यानुयात्राणां रावणस्य च मन्त्रिणाम्॥
