sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तेषामधर्मे चानृते च ह। ततः पूर्वे पुनर्वासमगमन्नृपसत्तम॥
en: O foremost of kings, at the end of the Tretă age, Vaiśyas and Śūdras being fully overpowered by the sin of untruth, the Brāhmaṇas and the Kșatriyas also grew feeble.

sn: ततः पादमधर्मस्य द्वितीयमवतारयत्। ततो द्वापरसंख्या सा युगस्य समजायत॥
en: And the second foot of impiety being ushered into the world the Dvāpara age set in.

sn: तस्मिन्द्वापरसंख्ये तु वर्तमाने युगक्षये। अधर्मश्चानृतं चैव ववृधे पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of men, during this age two legs of piety being cut off, impiety and untruth multiplies.

sn: अस्मिन्द्वापरसंख्याने तपो वैश्यान्समाविशत्। त्रिभ्यो युगेभ्यस्त्रीन्वर्णान्क्रमाद्वै तप आविशत्॥
en: And in Yuga named Dvāpara the Vaisyas engaged in devout penances. In this wise in three ages the three Varnas gradually engaged in ascetic performances.

sn: त्रिभ्यो युगेभ्यस्त्रीन्वर्णान्धर्मश्च परिनिष्ठितः। न शूद्रो लभते धर्म युगतस्तु नरर्षभ॥
en: The piety of asceticism by Yugas gradually became established in three Varmas, But, O foremost of men, in these three Yugas the Sūdras were not entitled to the virtues of devout penances.

sn: हीनवर्णो नृपश्रेष्ठ तप्यते सुमहत्तपः। भविष्यच्छूद्रयोन्यां हि तपश्चर्या कलौ युगे॥
en: O foremost of men, the degraded caste, the Śūdras, during your rege me, have engaged in austere penances. And in the Kali Yuga asceticism shall be established in the Sūdras.

sn: अधर्मः परमो राजन्द्वापरे शूद्रजन्मनः। स वै विषयपर्यन्ते तव राजन्महातपाः॥ अद्य तप्यति दुर्बुद्धिस्तेन बालवधो ह्ययम्। यो ह्यधर्ममकार्य वा विषये पार्थिवस्य तु॥
en: O king, even in Davāpara, devout penances for Śūdras were considered as impiety, what to speak of the Tretāage. O king, one Śūdras, under the influence of vicious understanding, has begun devout penances within your kingdom. And for that reason this boy has met with death.

sn: करोति चाश्रीमूलं तत्पुरे वा दुर्मतिर्नरः। क्षिप्रं च नरकं याति स च राजा न संशयः॥
en: Calamity sets in that kingdom where a vicious-minded person commits an iniquity and that vicious wight and the king forsooth speedily repair to hell.

sn: अधीतस्य च तप्तस्य कर्मणः सुकृतस्य च। षष्ठं भजति भागं तु प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्॥
en: The king, who piously govern his subjects, receive the sixth portion of there study asceticism and good actions.

sn: षड्भागस्य च भोक्तासौ रक्षते न प्रजाः कथम्। स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल मार्गस्व विषयं स्वकम्॥ दुष्कृतं यत्र पश्येथास्तत्र यत्नं समाचर।
en: While the king is entitled to the sixth portion of everything why should he not fully protect his subjects? Therefore, O chief of men, do you bring all informations of your kingdom. And be then studious to repress vices wherever you shall find them.

sn: एवं चेद्धर्मवृद्धिश्च नृणां चायुर्विवर्धनम्। भविष्यति नरश्रेष्ठ बालस्यास्य च जीवितम्॥
en: And by that, O foremost of men, the piety of the subjects shall be increased, the lease of their life shall be prolonged and this boy shall regain his life.

sn: नारदस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वामृतमयं यथा। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे लक्ष्मणं चेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing the sweet words of the celestial saint Nārada, Rāma was greatly delighted and addressing Lakşmaņa said.

sn: गच्छ सौम्य द्विजश्रेष्ठं समाश्वासय सुव्रत। बालस्य च शरीरं तत्तैलद्रोण्यां निधापय॥ गन्धैश्च परमोदारैस्तैलैश्च सुसुगन्धिभिः। यथा न क्षीयते बालस्तथा सौम्य विधीयताम्॥ यथा शरीरो बालस्य गुप्तः सन्क्लिष्टकर्मणः। विपत्तिः परिभेदो वा न भवच्च तथा कुरु॥
en: O gently one, do you console that foremost of twice-born ones and place the dead body of the boy in a jar full of oil. Let this body be protected by sweet-scented oil so that it might not be soiled by any means. See that it is not disfigured, its joints are not loosened and the hairs do not fall off.

sn: एवं संदिश्य काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम्। मनसा पुष्पकं दध्यावागच्छेति महायशाः॥ इङ्गितं स तु विज्ञाय पुष्पको हेमभूषितः। आजगाम मुहूर्तेन समीपे राघवस्य वै॥ सोऽब्रवीत्प्रणतो भूत्वा अयमस्मि नराधिप। वश्यस्तव महाबाहो किंकरः समुपस्थितः॥
en: The highly illustrious Rāma, the descendant of Ikşvākus, thus commanded Lakşmaņa, gifted with auspicious marks, and thought of his car and desired it to come soon. Understanding his intention the golden car appeared before him in no time and saluting him said: O you of long arms, your chariot has come.

sn: भाषितं रुचिरं श्रुत्वा पुष्पकस्य नराधिपः। अभिवाद्य महर्षीन्स विमानं सोध्यरोहत॥ धनुर्गृहीत्वा तूणी च खङ्गं च रुचिरप्रभम्। निक्षिप्य नगरे चैतौ सौमित्रिभरतावुभौ ॥
en: Hearing the sweet words of Puşpaka the king Rāma saluted the great ascetics, ascended the car with his burning bow, quiver and dagger and left Bharata and Lakşmaņa in charge of the city.

sn: प्रायात् प्रतीची हरितं विचिन्वंश्च ततस्ततः। उत्तरामगमच्छीमान्दिशं हिमवतावृताम्॥
en: And searching that Śūdra devotee here and there Rāghava proceeded towards the west. And not beholding him there he went to the North bounded by the Himālayas.

sn: अपश्यमानस्तत्रापि स्वल्पमप्यथ दुष्कृतम्। पूर्वामपि दिशं सर्वामथोऽपश्यन्नराधिपः॥ ।
en: And even there he did not espy the Sūdra ascetic and even the smallest iniquity was not seen there. There upon returning from that quarter the king journeyed the whole of east.

sn: प्रविशुद्धसमाचारामादर्शतलनिर्मलाम्। पुष्पकस्थो महाबाहुस्तदापश्यनराधिपः॥
en: And having sat on the Puspaka car he saw that the eastern quarter was transparent like a looking glass and there was not the best touch of sin.

sn: दक्षिणां दिशमाक्रामत्ततो राजर्षिनन्दनः। शैवलस्योत्तरे पार्श्वे ददर्श सुमहत्सरः॥
en: From the east Răghava proceeded towards the south and espied a big tank by the side of the Saivala mountain.

sn: तस्मिन्सरसि तप्यन्तं तापसं सुमहत्तपः। ददर्श राघवः श्रीमॉल्लम्बमानमधोमुखम्॥ राघवस्तमुपागम्य तप्यन्तं तप उत्तमम्। उवाच च नृपो वाक्यं धन्यस्त्वमसि सुव्रत॥ कस्यां योन्यां तपोवृद्ध वर्तसे दृढविक्रम। कौतूहलात्त्वां पृच्छामि रामो दाशरथिहम्॥
en: On the banks of that pond one ascetic was performing the most austere penances with his legs upwards and head downwards. There upon approaching him, Rama Said O you of good vows, blessed are you; I do ask you, now, O you highly effulgent and grown old in asceticism, in what Varņa you are born. I put this question out of curiosity. I am the son of king Dasaratha and my name is Răma.

sn: कोऽर्थो मनीषितस्तुभ्यं स्वर्गलाभो परोऽथवा। वराश्रयो यदर्थं त्वं तपस्यन्यैः सुदुश्चरम्॥ यमाश्रित्य तपस्तप्तं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तापस। ब्राह्मणो वासि भद्रं ते क्षत्रियो वासि दुर्जयः। वैश्यस्तृतीयो वर्णो ता शूद्रो वा सत्यवाग्भव ॥
en: For what are you going through such hard austerities? Is it heaven or anything else that you pray for? O ascetic, I wish to hear, of the purpose for which you are performing such hard penances. a Brāhmaṇa, or irrepressible Kșatriya or the third caste Vaisyas or a Śūdra? Do you speak the truth and you shall be crowned with auspiciousness Art you an

sn: इत्येवमुक्तः स नराधिपेन अवाक्शिरा दाशरथाय तस्मै। उवाच जातिं नृपपुङ्गवाय यत्कारणं चैव तपःप्रयत्नः॥
en: Hearing the words of Rāma, the ascetic, whose face was downwards, gave out his degraded birth and communicated to him for what he was performing ascetic observances.

sn: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। अवाक्शिरास्तथाभूतो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: Hearing the words of Räma of unwearied actions, the ascetic, with his face downwards, said.

sn: शूद्रयोन्यां प्रजातोऽस्मि तप उग्रं समास्थितः। देवत्वं प्रार्थये राम सशरीरो महायशः॥
en: O highly illustrious Rāma, I am born in the race of sūdras; and with a view to reach the region of the celestials with my body I am going through these austere penances.

sn: न मिथ्याहं वदे राम देवलोकजिगीषया। शूद्रं मां विद्धिकाकुत्स्थ शम्बूको नाम नामतः।।३
en: O Kākutstha, I shall never utter a falsehood since I am willing to conquer the region of gods. I am a Sūdra and my name is Sambūka.

sn: भाषतस्तस्य शूद्रस्य खङ्गं सुरुचिरप्रभम्। निष्कृष्य कोशाद्विमलं शिरश्चिच्छेद राघवः॥
en: The Sūdra ascetic having said this, Rama took out of scabbard a beautiful sharp sword and chopped off his head therewith.

sn: तस्मिशूद्रे हते देवाः सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः। साधुसाध्विति काकुत्स्थं ते शशंसुर्मुहुर्मुहुः॥ पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीदिव्यानां सुसुगन्धिनाम्। पुष्पाणां वायुमुक्तानां सर्वतः प्रपपात ह॥
en: And that Śūdra being slain, Indra, Agni and other celestials praised him again and again and showered flowers.

sn: सुप्रीताश्चाब्रुवरामं देवाः सत्यपराक्रमम्। सुरकार्यमिदं देव सुकृतं ते महामते।७।।
en: And being greatly delighted, the celestials said to Rama, having truth for his prowess:-0 you of a great mind, you have nicely performed this god-like work.

sn: गृहाण च वरं सौम्य यं त्वमिच्छस्यारिंदम। स्वर्गभाङ् नहि शूद्रोऽयं त्वत्कृते रघुनन्दन॥
en: O slayer of foes, do you now crave a boon. O descendant of Raghu, being slain by you this Sūdra has been able to attain to the abode of the celestials.

sn: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः। उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सहस्राक्षं पुरंदरम्॥
en: Hearing the words of the deities, Rāma, having truth for his prowess, said with folded hands to Purandara, of a thousand eyes:

sn: यदि देवाः प्रसन्ना मे द्विजपुत्रः स जीवतु। दिशन्तु वरमेतं मे ईप्सितं परमं मम॥
en: If the celestials are pleased, I beg for this boon that the son of the twice-born one may be restored to life. Do you confer upon me this boon; this is my wished for object.

sn: ममापचाराद्वालोऽसौ ब्राह्मणस्यैकपुत्रकः। अप्राप्तकालः कालेन नीतो वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: It is for my iniquitous conduct that this only son of the Brāhmaṇa has met with untimely death.

sn: तं जीवयथ भद्रं वो नानृतं कर्तुमर्हथ। द्विजस्य संश्रुतोऽर्थो मे जीवयिष्यामि ते सुतम्॥
en: Do you restore him to life. I have promised before that leading twice-born one that I would restore his son to life, do you therefore, make not me a liar.

sn: राघवस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा विबुधसत्तमाः। प्रत्युचू राघवं प्रीता देवाः प्रीतिसमन्वितम्॥ निर्वृतो भव काकुत्स्थ सोऽस्मिन्नहनि बालकः। जीवितं प्राप्तवान्भूयः समेतश्चापि बन्धुभिः॥ यस्मिन्मुहूर्ते काकुत्स्थ शूद्रोऽयं पातितः। तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते बालोऽसौ जीवेन समयुज्यत॥
en: Hearing the words of Rāma the leading celestials delightedly said, Do you return, O Käkutstha, The Brāhmaṇa boy shall immediately gain back his life and be united with his father, mother and friends. Rāghava, with the death of the Sudra the boy has regained his life.

sn: स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रं ते साधु याम नरर्षभ। अगस्त्यस्याश्रमपदं द्रष्टुमिच्छाम राघव॥ तस्य दीक्षा समाप्ता हि ब्रह्मर्षेः सुमहाद्युते। द्वादशं हि गतं वर्षं जलशय्यां समासतः॥
en: Be you at ease; may good betide you. O foremost of men, we too, return with delighted hearts. O Rāghava, we desire to behold the hermitage of the great saint Agastya. Having been initiated, that highly effulgent Brāhmaṇa saint has lived within waters for twelve years; his vow has now terminated.

sn: काकुत्स्थ तद्गमिष्यामो मुनिं समभिनन्दितुम्। त्वं चापि गच्छ भद्रं ते द्रष्टुं तमृषिसत्तमम्॥
en: O Kākutstha, we shall now go to welcome that Muni. Do you also follow us to see that saint.

sn: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय देवानां रघुनन्दनः। आरुरोह विमानं तं पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम्॥
en: Saying 'so be it' to the words of the celestials that descendant of Raghu ascended his golden car Puspaka.

sn: ततो देवाः प्रयातास्ते विमानैर्बहुविस्तरैः। रामोऽप्यनुजगामाशु कुम्भयोनेस्तपोवनम्॥
en: And having ascended spacious cars the celestials proceeded to the hermitage of Agastya born of a Kumbha. Rāma too also followed i them.

sn: दृष्ट्वा तु देवान्संप्राप्तानगस्त्यस्तपसां निधिः। अर्चयामास धर्मात्मा सर्वांस्तानविशेषतः॥
en: There upon beholding the celestials present the virtuous-souled Agastya, the jewel of asceticism, welcomed them particularly.

sn: प्रतिगृह्य ततः पूजां संपूज्य च महामुनिम्। जग्मुस्ते त्रिदशा हृष्टा नाकपृष्ठं सहानुगाः॥
en: Having accepted his worship and adored in return that great Muni, the immortals, delighted, proceeded to their abodes with their followers.

sn: गतेषु तेषु काकुत्स्थः पुष्पकादवरुह्य च। ततोऽभिवादयामास अगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम्॥
en: The celestials having departed Rāma descended from Puspaka and saluted that foremost of Rşis Agastya.

sn: सोऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा। आतिथ्यं परमं प्राप्य निषसाद नराधिपः॥
en: Rāma saluted that high-souled and highly effulgent Rșis Agastya. And having received due hospitality he sat there.

sn: तमुवाच महातेजाः कुम्भयोनिर्महातपाः। स्वागतं ते नरश्रेष्ठ दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि राघव।।२५
en: Thereupon the highly effulgent and leading ascetic Kumbhayoni said: O Rāghava, I have been greatly delighted with your coming, By my good fortune I have seen the today.

sn: त्वं मे बहुमतो राम गुणैर्बहुभिरुत्तमैः। अतिथिः पूजनीयश्च मम राजन्हृदि स्थितः॥
en: O Rāma, I love you because you are gifted with many qualities. O king, you are my worshipful guest. I was thinking of you.

sn: सुरा हि कथयन्ति त्वामागतं शूद्रघातिनम्। ब्राह्मणस्य तु धर्मेण त्वया जीवापितः सुतः॥
en: The celestials informed me that you went coming having slain the Sūdra ascetic. You have observed piety and have given back life to dead child of the Brahmana.

sn: उष्यतां चेह रजनीं सकाशे मम राघव। त्वं हि नारायणः श्रीमांस्त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्।।२८ त्वं प्रभुः सर्वदेवानां पुरुषस्त्वं सनातनः। प्रभाते पुष्पकेण त्वं गन्ता स्वपुरमेव हि॥
en: Do you spend this night with me, O Rāghava. You are the graceful Nārāyaṇa. In you the whole universe is established. You are the lord of all creatures and the eternal Purusha. You shall go to your city next morning in your Pușpaka car.

sn: इदं चाभरणं सौम्य निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा। दिव्यं दिव्येन वपुषा दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा॥
en: This ornament, O gentle one, has been made by the architect of the celestials; its make is very beautiful and it is dazzling by its own lustre.

sn: प्रतिगृह्णीष्व काकुत्स्थ मत्प्रियं कुरु राघव। दत्तस्य हि पुनर्दाने सुमहत्फलमुच्यते॥
en: By accepting this, O Kākutstha, do you satisfy my desire. It is said, that one attains to best fruits if he makes present to his deity, of best articles he gets from another.

sn: भरणे हि भवाशक्तः फलानां महतामपि। त्वं हि शक्तस्तारयितुं सेन्द्रानपि दिवौकसः॥ तस्मात्प्रदास्ये विधिवत्तत्प्रतीच्छ नराधिप।
en: You are the only worthy person to use this ornament. You are alone capable of conferring best fruits. You do protect Indra and other celestials. Therefore I do duly present you with this ornament. O king, do you accept it.

sn: अथोवाच महात्मानमिक्ष्वाकूणां महारथः॥ रामो मतिमतां श्रेष्ठः क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन्। प्रतिग्रहोऽयं भगवन्ब्राह्मणस्याविगर्हितः।। क्षत्रियेण कथं विप्र प्रतिग्राह्यं भवेत्ततः। प्रतिग्रहो हि विप्रेन्द्र क्षत्रियाणां सुगर्हितः।। ब्राह्मणेन विशेषेण दत्तं तद्वक्तुमर्हसि।
en: There upon meditating upon the duties of the Kşatriyas, the heroic Rāma, the foremost of the intelligent, said:-O illustrious Sir, the Brāhmaṇas only can accept presents— how can the Ksatriyas do? To take gifts is the function of the Brāhmaṇas—for Kşatriyas it is a source of censure. Besides, to receive presents from a Brahmana, is highly culpable. Do you therefore tell me, how I may accept this ornament.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण प्रत्युवाच महानृषिः।। आसन्कृतयुगे राम ब्राह्मभूते पुरायुगे। अपार्थिवाः प्रजाः सर्वाःसुराणां तु शतक्रतुः।। ताः प्रजा देवदेवेशं राजार्थं समुपाद्रवन्। सुराणां स्थापितो राजा त्वया देव शतक्रतुः।। प्रयच्छास्मासु लोकेश पार्थिवं नरपुंगवम्। यस्मै पूजां प्रयुञ्जाना धूतपापाश्चरेमहि।।
en: Hearing the words of Rāma, the great saint Agastya replied saying:-0 Rāma, O son of Dasaratha, at the beginning of the golden age, people had no king; but Väsava was the ruler of the celestials. Therefore to obtain a king, men approached Brahmā, the god of gods and said, O deity you have placed Indra as ruler over the celestials; therefore, O lord of creatures, do you also confer upon us a king who shall be foremost among men; by worshipping him we shall be freed from all sins.

sn: न वसामो विना राज्ञा एष नो निश्चयः परः। ततो ब्रह्मा सुरश्रेष्ठो लोकपालान्सवासवान्।। समाहूयाब्रवीत्सवास्तेजोभागान्प्रयच्छत। ततो ददुर्लोकपालाः सर्वे भागान्स्वतेजसः।। अक्षुपच्च ततो ब्रह्मा यतो जातः क्षुपो नृपः। तं ब्रह्मा लोकपालानां समांशैः समयोजयत्।। ततो ददौ नृपं तासां प्रजानामीश्वरं क्षुपम्। तत्रैन्द्रेण च भागेन महीमाज्ञापयन्नृपः।। वारुणेन तु भागेन वपुः पुष्यति पार्थिवः। कौबेरेण तु भागेन वित्तपाभां ददौ तदा।। यस्तु याम्योऽभवद्भागस्तेनशास्ति स्म स प्रजाः।
en: We shall not live without the king-even this is our firm resolution. Thereupon the Patriarch Brahmā sent for Indra and other deities and said:Do you all give a portion of your respective energies. Thereupon the deities gave each a portion of their own energies. Thereupon Brahma made a Kșupa or sneezed and there from originated a king under the name of Kșupa. And in his person Brahmă placed in equal proportions the energies of the deities. There after he made Kșupa the foremost king of men. By virtue of the portion of Indra's energy the king Kșupa brought the earth under his control; by that of Varuna's energy he fostered his own body; by Kubera's portion he conferred riches upon his subjects; and by that of Yama he governed them.

sn: तत्रैन्द्रेण नरश्रेष्ठ भागेन रघुनन्दन।। प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते तारणार्थ मम प्रभो। तद्रामः प्रतिजग्राह मुनेस्तस्य महात्मनः।। दिव्यमाभरणं चित्रं प्रदीप्तमिव भास्करम्। प्रतिगृह्य ततो रामस्तदाभरणमुत्तमम्।। आगमं तस्य दीप्तस्य प्रष्टुमेवोपचक्रमे।
en: Therefore, O Rama, by virtue of Indra's portion, do you accept this omament and confer upon me the salvation. Hearing the words of the Muni, Rāma took from him that brilliant celestial ornament burning like the rays of the Sun. And having taken that excellent ornament, Dāsarathi asked the great saint Kumbhayoni, saying.

sn: अत्यद्भुतमिदं दिव्यं वपुषा युक्तमद्भुतम्॥ कथं वा भवता प्राप्तं कुतो वा केन वा हृतम्। कौतूहलतया ब्रह्मन्पृच्छामि त्वां महायशः ।३५ ।। आश्चर्याणां बहूनां हि निधिः परमको भवान्।
en: When have you obtained this celestial ornamens of a wondrous make? Who have given you this? O Brāhmaṇa, I do accost you thus out of curiosity. You are the mine of many wonders.

sn: एवं ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्। शृणु राम यथावृत्तं पुरा त्रेतायुगे युगे।॥
en: Whereto Agastya replied, saying Hearken, O Rāma, how I did obtain this ornament in the Tretă age.

sn: पुरा त्रेतायुगे राम बभूव बहुविस्तरम्। समन्ताद्योजनशतं विमृगं पक्षिवर्जितम्॥
en: O Răma, in Tretāage, there was a huge forest extending over hundred Yojanas divested of animals and men.

sn: तस्मिन्निर्मानुषेऽरण्ये कुर्वाणस्तप उत्तमम्। अहमाक्रमितुं सौम्य तदारण्यमुपागमम्॥ तस्य रूपमरण्यस्य निर्देष्टुं न शशाक ह। फलमूलैः सुखास्वादैर्बहुरूपैश्च काननैः॥
en: In that forest of without men I used to perform my austere penances. Once on a time I began to roam all over the forest being willing to see well every nook and corner of it. And I saw that it was impossible to ascertain how very pleasant that forest was. In every place there were trees with profuse sweet fruits. and roots.

sn: तस्यारण्यस्य मध्ये तु सरो योजनमायतम्। हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णं चक्रवाकोपशोभितम्॥ पद्मोत्पलसमाकीर्णं समतिक्रान्तशैवलम्। तदाश्चर्यमिवात्यर्थं सुखास्वादमनुत्तमम्॥ अरजस्कं तदाक्षोभ्यं श्रीमत्पक्षिगणायुतम्। तस्मिन्सर:समीपे तु महदद्भुतमाश्रमम्॥ पुराणं पुण्यमत्यर्थं तपस्विजनवर्जितम्।
en: In the middle I espied a pond extending over a Yojana. There was no moss in that deep, calm, clear and sweet water; there were lotuses and lilies and swans, Kārandavas, Cakravākas and many other water fowls were playing in the waters. O lord of creatures, at no distance from that pond I saw an old, holy hermitage but there was no creature or animal around it.

sn: तत्राहमवसं रात्रि नैदाघी पुरुषर्षभ।७।। प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय सरस्तदुपचक्रमे। अथापश्यं शवं तत्र सुपुष्टमरजः क्वचित्॥ तिष्ठन्तं परया लक्ष्या तस्मिंस्तोयाशये नृप।
en: O best among the men, it was summer and I spent that night in that hermitage. Next morning leaving my bed I arrived at the banks of the pond and saw a plump dead body in the waters. None of its limbs was pale and its beauty was not spoiled.

sn: तमर्थं चिन्तयानोऽहं मुहूर्तं तत्र राघव॥ विष्ठितोऽस्मि सरस्तीरे किन्विदं स्यादिति प्रभो। अथापश्यं सुमूर्तात्तु दिव्यमद्भुतदर्शनम्॥ विमानं परमोदारं हंसयुक्तं मनोजवम्। अत्यर्थं स्वर्गिणं त विमाने रघुनन्दन॥ उपास्तेऽप्सरसां वीर सहस्रं दिव्यभूषणम्।
en: Beholding it and standing on the banks I began to mediate upon it. And thought I What is this?' In a moment I espied a beautiful car, swiftcoursing like the mind and drawn by ganders. And I saw in that chariot a celestial person. He was being attended by Apsarās adorned with celestial ornaments and having lotus-eyes.

sn: गायन्ति काश्चिद्रम्याणि वादयन्ति तथापराः॥ मृदङ्गवीणापणवान्नृत्यन्ति च तथापराः। अपराश्चन्द्ररशम्याभैर्हेमदण्डैर्महाधनैः॥ दोधूयुर्वदनं तस्य पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणाः।
en: Some of them were singing, some dancing and some playing on Mşdanga, Vīņā and other musical instruments and some were fanning his lotus-like countenance with valuable, golden chowries, dazzling like the rays of the moon.

sn: ततः सिंहासनं हित्वा मेरुकूटमिवांशुमान्॥ पश्यतो मे तदा राम विमानादवरुह्य च। तं शवं भक्षयामास स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन॥
en: O Rāma, the foremost of Raghu's race, like to the moon renouncing the summit of the Sumeru mount that celestial wight got down from his seat in the car and engaged in devouring the dead body.

sn: ततो भुक्त्वा यथाकामं मांसं बहु सुपीवरम्। अवतीर्य सरः स्वर्गी संस्प्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे॥ उपस्पृश्य यथान्यायं स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन। आरोढुमुपचक्राम विमानवरमुत्तमम्॥
en: And having taken enough flesh he got down into waters and duly performed ablution. O Rāma, there after that heavenly being again addressed himself for ascending the car.

sn: तमहं देवसंकाशमारोहन्तमुदीक्ष्य वै। अथाहमब्रुवं वाक्यं तमेव पुरुषर्षभ॥ को भावन्देवसंकाश आहारश्च विगर्हितः। त्वयेदं भुज्यते सौम्य किमर्थं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: O foremost of men, beholding that heavenly being about to get up I accosted him, saying, Who are you? I see, you have a celestial firm, then why have you taken such an abominable food?

sn: कस्य स्यादीदृशो भाव आहारो देवसंमत। आश्चर्य वर्तते सौम्य श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः। नाहमौपयिकं मन्ये तव भक्ष्यमिमं शवम्॥
en: O you adored of the immortals, persons like you should not take such meals. O gentle one, I have been stricken with great curiosity and wish to hear all. Thine living upon dead body does not appear agreeable to me.

sn: इत्येवमुक्त स नरेन्द्र नाकी कौतूहलात्सूनृतया गिरा च। श्रुत्वा च वाक्यं मम सर्वमेतत् सर्वं तथा चाकथयन्ममेति॥
en: O king, plainly and out of curiosity I put to him these questions. And hearing them, the celestial being related everything to me.

sn: श्रुत्वा तु भाषितं वाक्यं मम राम शुभाक्षरम्। प्राञ्जलिः प्रत्युवाचेदं स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन॥
en: O Rāma, hearing my words pregnant with sound reasoning, that heavenly being, with folded hands, said.

sn: शृणु ब्रह्मन्पुरा वृत्तं ममैतत्सुखदुःखयोः। अन.क्रमागीयं च यथा पृच्छसि मां द्विज॥
en: Hear, O Brāhmaṇa, from what unavoidable cause has proceeded this happy and again painful incident.

sn: पुरा वैदर्भको राजा पिता मम महायशाः। सुदेव इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वीर्यवान्।॥
en: There flourished in the days of yore a highly illustratious and powerful Vidarbha king under the name of Sudeva known over three worlds. He was my father.

sn: तस्य पुत्रद्वयं ब्रह्मन्द्वाभ्यां स्त्रीभ्यामजायत। अहं श्वेत इति ख्यातो यवीयान्सुरथोऽभवत्॥
en: His two queens gave birth to two sons. My name is Sveta and the name of my youngest brother was Suratha.

sn: ततः पितरि स्वर्याते पौरा मामभ्यषेचयन्। तत्राहं कृतवान्राज्यं धयं च सुसमाहितः॥ एवं वर्षसहस्राणि समतीतानि सुव्रत। राज्यं कारयतो ब्रह्मन्प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षतः॥
en: After the decease of my sire the subjects installed me on the throne and I governed them piously and carefully for a thousand years.

sn: सोऽहं निमित्ते कस्मिंश्चिद्विज्ञातायुर्द्विजोत्तम। कालधर्म हृदि न्यस्य ततो वनमुपागमम्॥
en: By some reason I was informed of the extent of my life. And when I perceived that the lease of my life had well-night expired I entered into the life of Vānaprastha.

sn: सोऽहं वनमिदं दुर्ग मृगपक्षिविवर्जितम्। तपश्चर्तुं प्रविष्टोऽस्मि समीपे सरसः शुभे॥ भ्रातरं सुरथं राज्ये अभिषिच्य महीपतिम्। इदं सरः समासाद्य तपस्तप्तं मया चिरम्॥
en: And having placed my brother Suratha on the throne I entered into a dense forest devoid of men and animals at no distance from this pond to perform devout penances. And I performed austerities for a long time near this pond.

sn: सोऽहं वर्षसहस्राणि तपस्त्रीणि महावने। तप्त्वा सुदुष्करं प्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकमनुत्तमम्॥
en: Having performed hard penances in this forest, for three thousand years I at last attained to the region of Brahmā.

sn: तस्येमे स्वर्गभूतस्य क्षुत्पिपासे द्विजोत्तम। बाधेते परमे वीर ततोऽहं व्यथितेन्द्रियः॥
en: And albeit I had reached the Brahmā region I was still being assailed by hunger and thirst. And gradually I grew tired therewith.

sn: गत्वा त्रिभुवन श्रेष्ठं पितामहमुवाच ह। भगवन्ब्रह्मलोकोऽयं क्षुत्पिपासाविवर्जितः॥ कस्यायं कर्मणः पाकः क्षुत्पिपासानुगो ह्यहम्। आहारः कश्च मे देव तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥
en: There upon approaching the patriarch Brahma, the lord of three worlds, I said: O lord, here there is no hunger or thirst; still why have I been brought to their control? Of what iniquity of mine is this fruit? O deity, tell me upon what I shall live.

sn: पितामहस्तु मामाह तवाहारः सुदेवज। स्वादूनि स्वानि मांसानि तानि भक्षय नित्यशः॥
en: Whereto the patriarch replied: O son of Sudeva, do you live upon sweet savoured meat everyday.

sn: स्वशरीरं त्वया, पुष्टं कुर्वता तप उत्तमम्। अनुप्तं रोहते श्वेत न कदाचिन्महामते॥ दत्तं न तेऽस्ति सूक्ष्मोऽपि तप एव निषेवसे। तेन स्वर्गगतो वत्स बाध्यसे क्षुत्पिपासया॥
en: O Śveta, you did only look to the growth of your person when you did perform rigid penances. O you of a great mind, nothing grows, when nothing is sown. You did only perform ascetic penances, but you did not make any gift of charity. It is for that reason, O my son, that you are, even in heaven, being assailed by hunger and thirst.

sn: स त्वं सुपुष्टमाहारैः स्वशरीरमनुत्तमम्। भक्षयित्वामृतरसं तेन वृत्तिर्भविष्यति॥
en: Thereupon do you now live upon your own dead body fostered by various food. By this you shall keep up your being.

sn: यदा तु तद्वनं श्वेत अगस्त्यः स महानृषिः। आगमिष्यति दुर्धर्षस्तदा कृच्छ्राद्विमोक्ष्यते॥
en: O Sveta, you shall be relived from this affliction when the irrepressible, great Saint Agastya shall reach that forest.

sn: स हि तारयितुं सौम्य शक्तः सुरगणानपि। किं पुनस्त्वां महाबाहो क्षुत्पिपासावशं गतम्॥
en: O gentle one, even to the immortals he can give salvation; what wonder it is that he shall relieve you from the miseries of hunger and thirst.

sn: सोऽहं भगवतः श्रुत्वा देवदेवस्य निश्चयम्। आहारं गर्हितं कुर्मि स्वशरीरं द्विजोत्तम॥
en: O foremost of twice-born ones, from the time of hearing those words of the great Brahma, the god of gods, I have been engaged in this cursed work of feeding upon my own dead body.

sn: बहून्वर्षगणान्ब्रह्मन्भुज्यमानमिदं मया। क्षयं नाभ्येति ब्रह्मर्षे तृप्तिश्चापि ममोत्तमा।।२१ तस्य मे कृच्छ्रभूतस्य कृच्छादस्माद्विमोक्षय। अन्येषां न गतिहत्र कुम्भयोनिमृते द्विजम्॥
en: O Brāhmaṇa, for many long years I have been living upon this corpse still I have not done with it. O Saint, I, too, derive satisfaction from it; I now understand that you are the illustrious Agastya born of a Kumbha; for none else is capable of coming here; do you therefore save me from this pain, who am afflicted with great miseries.

sn: इदमाभरणं सौम्य धराणार्थं द्विजोत्तम। प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: O foremost of twice-born ones, O gentle one, do you take this ornament; may good betide you. Do you be propitiated with me.

sn: इदं तावत्सुवर्णं च धनं वस्त्राणि च द्विज। भक्ष्यं भोज्यं च ब्रह्मर्षे ददाम्याभरणानि च॥ सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छामि भोगांश्च मुनिपुङ्गव। तारणे भगवन्मह्यं प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: O Brahmana, I do confer upon you, gold, riches various clothes, eatables, excellent ornaments and diverse other objects of desire and enjoyment. O foremost of Sages, O lord, do you with compassion save me.

sn: तस्याहं स्वर्गिणो वाक्यं श्रुत्वा दुःखसमन्वितम्। तारणायोफ्जग्राह तदाभरणमुत्तमम्॥
en: Hearing those words of the heavenly being, exciting pity, I accepted this ornament for saving him.

sn: मया प्रतिगृहीते तु तस्मिन्नाभरणे शुभे। मानुषः पूर्वको देहो राजर्षेविननाश ह॥
en: And as soon as I took this ornament that human body of the royal saint disappeared.

sn: प्रनष्टे तु शरीरेऽसौ राजर्षिः परया मुदा। तृप्तः प्रमुदितो राजा जगाम त्रिदिवं सुखम्॥
en: And the body being dissolved, the royal saint Śveta, greatly delighted, happily went to the land of immortals.

sn: तेनेदं शक्रतुल्येन दिव्यमाभरणं मम। तस्मिन्निमित्ते काकुत्स्थ दत्तमद्भुतदर्शनम्॥
en: It is for this reason, O Kākutstha, that royal saint, resembling Indra, conferred upon me this wondrous, celestial ornament.

sn: तदद्भुततमं वाक्यं श्रुत्वागस्त्यस्य राघवः। गौरवाद्विस्मयाच्चैव भूयः प्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे॥
en: Hearing the wondrous words of the great saint Kumbhayoni, Rāma, out of great curiosity and importance of the subject, again asked him, saying.

sn: भगवंस्तद्वनं घोरं तपस्तप्यति यत्र सः। श्वेतो वैदर्भको राजा कथं तदमृगद्विजम्॥
en: O Brahmana, why was that dense forest, in which the king Sveta of Vidarbha used to perform hard penances, divested of birds and animals?

sn: तद्वनं स कथ राजा शून्यं मनुजवर्जितम्। तपश्चर्तुं प्रविष्टः स श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: And how did he proceed to that forest devoid of men and animals for undergoing penances? I wish to hear the truth.

sn: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वितम्। वाक्यं परमतेजस्वी वक्तुमेवोपचक्रमे॥
en: Hearing the words of Rāma stricken with curiosity, the highly effulgent saint Agastya said.

sn: पुरा कृतयुगे राम मनुर्दण्डधरः प्रभुः। तस्य पुत्रो महानासीदिक्ष्वाकुः कुलनन्दनः॥
en: O Rāma, formerly in the golden age, Manu was the king. His son was ikṣvāku.

sn: तं पुत्रं पूर्वकं राज्ये निक्षिप्य भुवि दुर्जयम्। पृथिव्यां राजवंशानां भव कर्तेत्युवाच तम्॥ तथैव च प्रतिज्ञातं पितुः पुत्रेण राघव। ततः परमसंतुष्टो मनुः पुत्रमुवाच ह।७।।
en: Ha. ing instaned the irrepressible Iksvāku, Manu said: 'By you the lord over creatures.' Saying so be it Ikşvāku accepted the command. There upon greatly delighted Manu said to his son.

sn: प्रीतोऽस्मि परमोदार कर्ता चासि न संशयः। दण्डेन च प्रजा रक्ष मा च दण्डमकारणे॥
en: I have been highly pleased with you. For sooth you shall become a very liberal price. You shall govern the subjects meting out proper punishment to them, but do not punish them without any fault.

sn: अपराधिषु यो दण्डः पात्यते मानवेषु वै। स दण्डो विधिवन्मुक्तः स्वर्ग नयति पार्थिवम्॥
en: If the punishment, which a king inflicts upon the guilty, be just it becomes the instrumental in taking the giver to heaven.

sn: तस्माद्दण्डे महाबाहो यत्नवान्भव पुत्रक। धर्मो हि परमो लोके कुर्वतस्ते भविष्यति॥
en: Therefore, O my son having large arms, be particularly studious as regards punishment for thereby you shall acquire great piety.

sn: इति तं बहु संदिश्य मनुः पुत्रं समाधिना। जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टो ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम्॥
en: Having in this wise advised Ikşvāku Manu delightedly repaired to the region Brahmā.

sn: प्रयाते त्रिदिवे तस्मिन्निक्ष्वाकुरमितप्रभः। जनयिष्ये कथं पुत्रानिति चिन्तापरोऽभवत्॥
en: After Manu's departure towards the heaven, the effulgent Ikşavku thought of the means for creating progeny.

sn: कर्मभिर्बहुरूपैश्च तैस्तैर्मनुसुतस्तदा। जनयामास धर्मात्मा शतं देवसुतोपमान्॥ तेषामवरजस्तात सर्वेषां रघुनन्दन। मूढश्चाकृतविद्यश्च न शुश्रूषति पूर्वजान्॥
en: Thereupon performing many pious rites Manu's son engendered a hundred sons. O descendant of Raghu, the youngest of all those sons became stupid and ignorant and did not respect his elder brothers.

sn: नाम तस्य च दण्डेति पिता चक्रेऽल्पतेजसः। अवश्यं दण्डपतनं शरीरेऽस्य भविष्यति॥
en: And thinking that he should therefore be punished he named this son 'Danda.'

sn: अपश्यमानस्तं देशं घोरं पुत्रस्य राघव। विन्ध्यसैवलयोर्मध्ये राज्यं प्रादादरिंदम॥
en: Thereupon finding no other province worthy of Danda he allotted the region between Vihdhya and Saivala to him.

sn: स दण्डस्तत्र राजाभूद्रम्ये पर्वतरोधसि। पुरं चाप्रतिमं राम न्यवेशयदनुत्तमम्॥ पुरस्य चाकरोन्नाम मधुमन्तमिति प्रभो। पुरोहितं तूशनसं वरयामास सुव्रतम्॥
en: Danda became king of that picturesque valley. And having reared a fine city there he named it as Madhumanta and appointed śukrācārya of firm views as his priest.

sn: एवं स राजा तद्राज्यमकरोत्सपुरोहितः। प्रहृष्टमनुजाकीर्णं देवराजो यथा दिवि॥
en: Having thus established his kingdom, Danda, with his priest, began to lord over it filled with healthy and delighted people like to the lord of celestials in their region.

sn: ततः स राजा मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रः सार्धं च तेनोशनसा तदानीम्। चकार राज्यं सुमहान्महात्मा शक्रो दिवीवोशनसा समेतः॥
en: O Rāma, like to Mahendra governing his kingdom of heaven under the guidance of Brhaspati, the preceptor of celestials, Danda, the grandson of Manu, governed his own kingdom with the help of Uśanas.

sn: एतदाख्याय रामाय महर्षिः कुम्भसंभवः। अस्यामेवापरं वाक्यं कथायामुपचक्रमे॥
en: Having related this story to Rāma the great saint Agastya again said in this context.

sn: ततः स दण्डः काकुत्स्थ बहुवर्षगणायुतम्। अकरोत्तत्र दान्तात्मा राज्यं निहतकण्टकम्॥
en: O Kākutstha, having subdued his passions, the king Danda, reigned undisturbed in this wise for many long years.

sn: अथ काले तु कस्मिंश्चिद्राजा भार्गवमाश्रमम्। रमणीयमुपाक्रामच्चैत्रे मासि मनोरमे॥
en: Thereupon during spring, in the month of Caitra the king arrived at the picturesque hermitage of the preceptor Sukra.

sn: तत्र भार्गवकन्यां स रूपेणाप्रतिमां भुवि। विचरन्तीं वनोद्देशे दण्डोऽपश्यदनुत्तमाम्॥ स दृष्ट्वा तां सुदुर्मेधा अनङ्गशरपीडितः। अभिगम्य सुसंविग्नः कन्यां वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: At that time, Sukra's daughter, matchless in beauty and grace, was walking in the forest. The king saw that jewel of a girl, and being stricken with lust and growing restless he approached her and said.

sn: कुतस्त्वमसि सुश्रोणि कस्य वासि सुता शुभे। पीडितोऽहमनङ्गेन पृच्छामि त्वां शुभानने॥
en: O you having a beautiful waist, O fair lady, whose daughter are you? O you having a moonlike countenance, I have been assailed by the arrows of Cupid and hence I do accost you thus.

sn: तस्य त्वेवं ब्रुवाणस्य मोहोन्मत्तस्य कामिनः। भार्गवी प्रत्युवाचेदं वचः सानुनयं त्विदम्॥
en: Hearing the words of the vicious-souled Danda, maddened with lust, Sukra's daughter humbly said.

sn: भार्गवस्य सुतां विद्धिदेवस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। अरजां नाम राजेन्द्र ज्येष्ठामाश्रमवासिनीम्॥ मा मां स्पृश बलाद्राजन्कन्या पितृवशा ह्यहम्। गुरुः पिता मे राजेन्द्र त्वं च शिष्यो महात्मनः॥
en: "O king of kings I am the daughter of the humbly Sukra of unwearied actions and my name is Araja. I am living in this hermitage, O king, do not touch me forcibly for I am a maid and hence under the guardianship forcibly for my father. Besides my father is my preceptor, and you are also his disciple.

sn: व्यसनं सुमहत्क्रुद्धः स ते दद्यान्महातपाः। यदि वान्यन्मया कार्य धर्मदृष्टेन सत्पथा॥ वरयस्व नरश्रेष्ठ पितरं मे महाद्युतिम्। अन्यथा तु फलं तुभ्यं भवेद्धोराभिसंहितम्॥
en: Being enraged he shall imprecate you with a curse. O foremost of men, if you do cherish any desire for me, do you honestly and piously pray for it to my sire. Or else you shall suffer dreadful consequences in the long run.

sn: क्रोधेन हि पिता मेऽसौ त्रैलोक्यमपि निर्दहेत्। दास्यते चानवद्याङ्ग तव मा याचितः पिता ॥
en: When worked up with ire, my father can reduce even the three worlds to ashes. O you of a blameless person, if you do pray, my father may make me over to your hands.

sn: एवं ब्रुवाणामरजां दण्डः कामवशं गतः। प्रत्युवाच मदोन्मत्तः शिरस्याधाय चाञ्जलिम्।।१३
en: Arajas having said this, the king Danda, maddened with lust, placing folded palms on his head, said.

sn: प्रसादं कुरु सुश्रोणि न कालं क्षेप्तुमर्हसि। त्वत्कृते हि मम प्राणा विदीर्यन्ते वरानने॥ त्वां प्राप्य तु वधो वापि पापं वापि सुदारुणम्। भक्तं भजस्व मां भीरु भजमानं सुविह्वलम्॥
en: Be you propitiated with me, O you having a graceful person; do not tarry even for a moment. My heart bursts out for you, O you having a moon-like countenance. For acquiring you I can even take upon myself my own destruction or dreadful iniquity. Do you seek me, O fair ladyI am beside myself for you.

sn: एवमुक्त्वा तु तां कन्यां दोभ्यां प्राप्य बलादली। विस्फुरन्तीं यथाकामं मैथुनायोपचक्रमे॥ तमनर्थ महाघोरं दण्डः कृत्वा सुदारुणम्। नगरं प्रययावाशु मधुमन्तमनुत्तमम्॥
en: Having said this the king forcibly ravished her. Having perpetrated such a mighty iniquity he speedily returned to his own city Madhumanta.

sn: अरजापि रुदन्ती सा आश्रमस्याविदूरतः। प्रतीक्षते सुसंत्रस्ता पितरं देवसंनिभम्॥
en: Arajă cried aloud in forest at no distance from the hermitage and waited for here sire who had been away on visiting the celestials. a blameless person, if you do pray, my father may make me over to your hands.

sn: एवं ब्रुवाणामरजां दण्डः कामवशं गतः। प्रत्युवाच मदोन्मत्तः शिरस्याधाय चाञ्जलिम्।।१३
en: Arajas having said this, the king Danda, maddened with lust, placing folded palms on his head, said.

sn: प्रसादं कुरु सुश्रोणि न कालं क्षेप्तुमर्हसि। त्वत्कृते हि मम प्राणा विदीर्यन्ते वरानने॥ त्वां प्राप्य तु वधो वापि पापं वापि सुदारुणम्। भक्तं भजस्व मां भीरु भजमानं सुविह्वलम्॥
en: Be you propitiated with me, O you having a graceful person; do not tarry even for a moment. My heart bursts out for you, O you having a moon-like countenance. For acquiring you I can even take upon myself my own destruction or dreadful iniquity. Do you seek me, O fair ladyI am beside myself for you.

sn: एवमुक्त्वा तु तां कन्यां दोभ्यां प्राप्य बलादली। विस्फुरन्तीं यथाकामं मैथुनायोपचक्रमे॥ तमनर्थ महाघोरं दण्डः कृत्वा सुदारुणम्। नगरं प्रययावाशु मधुमन्तमनुत्तमम्॥
en: Having said this the king forcibly ravished her. Having perpetrated such a mighty iniquity he speedily returned to his own city Madhumanta.

sn: अरजापि रुदन्ती सा आश्रमस्याविदूरतः। प्रतीक्षते सुसंत्रस्ता पितरं देवसंनिभम्॥
en: Arajă cried aloud in forest at no distance from the hermitage and waited for here sire who had been away on visiting the celestials.

sn: स मुहूर्तादुपश्रुत्य देवर्षिरमितप्रभः। स्वमाश्रमं शिष्यवृतः क्षुधातः संन्यवर्तत॥ सोऽपश्यदरजां दीनां रजसा समभिप्लुताम्। ज्योत्स्नामिव ग्रहग्रस्तां प्रत्यूषे न विराजतीम्॥
en: Thereupon having heard everything about Arajă from a disciple, he, surrounded by his pupils, arrived at his own hermitage and beheld her there poorly, soiled with dust and like to the morning rays of the moon possessed by a planet.

sn: तस्य रोषः समभवत्क्षुधार्तस्य विशेषतः। निर्दहत्रिव लोकांस्त्रीशिष्यांश्चैतदुवाच ह॥
en: He was stricken with hunger and was greatly incensed on beholding his daughter in that wretched plight, as if burning the three worlds with rage. Addressing his pupils, he said.

sn: पश्यध्वं विपरीतस्य दण्डस्याविदितात्मनः। विपत्तिं घोरसंकाशां क्रुद्धादग्निशिखामिव॥
en: Do you witness today the dreadful calamity, arising out of my flaming ire, of the vicious Daņda treading the path of immorality.

sn: क्षयोऽस्य दुर्मतेः प्राप्तः सानुगस्य महात्मनः। यः प्रदीप्तां हुताशस्य शिखां वै स्पष्टुमर्हति॥
en: This vicious wight has placed his hands in the burning flame so he shall, along with followers, meet with destruction.

sn: यस्मात्स कृतवान्पापमीदृशं घोरसंहितम्। तस्मात्प्राप्स्यति दुर्मेधाः फलं पापस्य कर्मणः॥
en: Since that vile being has perpetrated such a dreadful crime he shall forsooth suffer the consequence thereof.

sn: सप्तरात्रेण राजासौ सपुत्रबलवाहनः। पापकर्मसमाचारो वधं प्राप्स्यति दुर्मतिः॥
en: Within seven nights, the wicked and vicious Daņda, with his son, soldiers and retinue, shall meet with death.

sn: समन्ताद्योजनशतं विषयं चास्य दुर्मतेः। धक्ष्यते पांसुवर्षेण महता पाकशासनः।।।।।
en: Showering dust Indra shall destroy, to the extent of a hundred Yojana, the territory of this vicious king.

sn: सर्वसत्वानि यानीह स्थावराणि चराणि च। महता पांसुवर्षेण विलयं सर्वतोऽगमन्।।।
en: And all creatures mobile and immobile, wherever they might be, shall be destroyed with this downpour of dust.

sn: दण्डस्य विषयो यावत्तावत्सवं समुच्छ्रयम्। पांसुवर्षमिवालक्ष्यं सप्तरात्रं भविष्यति॥
en: All animals as far as this Daņdas' territory extends, shall be destroyed within seven nights.

sn: इत्युक्त्वा क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तमाश्रमनिवासिनम्। जनं जनपदान्तेषु स्थीयतामिति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Having said this, with eyes reddened with ire, USanas, Bhrgu's son, said to the inmates of his hermitage: Do you all go and wait outside this kingdom.

sn: श्रुत्वा तूशनसो वाक्यं सोऽश्रमावसथो जनः। निषक्रान्तो विषयात्तस्मात्स्थानं चक्रेऽथ बाह्यतः॥
en: Hearing the words of the preceptor Sukra, the inmates left the hermitage and lived at a place beyond the limit of Danda's territories.

sn: स तथोक्त्वा मुनिजनमरजामिदमब्रवीत्। इहैव वस दुर्मेधे आश्रमे सुसमाहिता॥
en: Having thus addressed the inmates of the hermitage the great saint, said to Arajās. O unfortunate girl, with a devoted mind do you wait at this hermitage.

sn: इदं योजनपर्यन्तं सरः सुरुचिरप्रभम्। अरजे विज्वरा भुझ्व कालश्चात्र प्रतीक्ष्यताम्॥
en: Without any anxiety O Arajās, do you wait for the time at the picturesque banks of this pond extending over a Yojana.

sn: त्वत्समीपे च ये सत्त्वा वासमेष्यन्ति तां निशाम्। अवध्याः पांसुवर्षेण ते भविष्यन्ति नित्यदा॥
en: Within seven nights whoever shall approach you, shall be destroyed with this downpour of dust.

sn: श्रुत्वा नियोगं ब्रह्मर्षेः सारजा भार्गवी तदा। तथेति पितरं प्राह भार्गवं भृशदुःखिता॥
en: Hearing the words of the Brāhmaṇa saint and preceptor śukra, Arajās sorrowfully said to her father 'it shall be done.'

sn: इत्युक्त्वा भार्गवो वासमन्यत्र समकारयत्। तच्च राज्यं नरेन्द्रस्य सभृत्यबलवाहनम् ॥ सप्ताहाद्भस्मसाद्भूतं यथोक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना।
en: There upon Sukrācārya went away and lived elsewhere. According to the words of the saint, the entire kingdom of Danda, with servants, army, and conveyances, was destroyed within seven nights.

sn: तस्यासौ दण्डविषयो विन्ध्यशैवलयोनृप॥ शप्तो ब्रह्मर्षिणा तेन वैधर्म्य सहिते कृते। ततः प्रभृति काकुत्स्थ दण्डकारण्यमुच्यते॥
en: O Rāma, in the golden age, the province between the mountains Vindhya and Saivala comprising Danda's territories, imprecated by the Brāhmaṇa saint, in consequence of the iniquity of the vicious souled, was reduced into a desert. From that time it passes by the name of Dandaka forest.

sn: तपस्विनः स्थिता ह्यत्र जनस्थानमतोऽभवत्। एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां पृच्छसि राघव॥
en: And it is otherwise called Janasthāna because the ascetics used to perform austerities there. O Rāghava, I have thus related to you, all you did ask of me.

sn: संध्यामुपासितुं वीर समयो ह्यतिवर्तते। एते महर्षयः सर्वे पूर्णकुम्भाः समन्ततः॥
en: O hero, the time for performing evening rites has come. Behold O foremost of men, having performed ablution, the great saints, on all sides, with jars full of water, are worshipping the sun.

sn: कृतोदका नरव्याघ्र आदित्यं पर्युपासते। स तैाह्मणमभ्यस्तं सहितैर्ब्रह्मवित्तमैः। रविरस्तंगतो राम गच्छोदकमुपस्पृश ॥
en: Having accepted adoration in the shape of Vedic hymns chanted by Brāhmaṇas, wellversed in Vedas, the illustrious Aditya is about to be set. Therefore, O Rāma, do you perform the ceremony.

sn: ऋषेर्वचनमाज्ञाय रामः संध्यामुपासितुम्। अपाक्रामत्सरः पुण्यमप्सरोगणसेवितम्॥ तत्रोदकमुपस्पृश्य संध्यामन्वास्य पश्चिमाम्। आश्रमं प्राविशद्रामः कुम्भयोनेर्महात्मनः॥
en: Hearing the words of the great saint, Rāma, to perform the evening adoration, went to the pond filled with Apsarās; and having performed the worship he again returned to the hermitage of the high-souled Agastya.

sn: तस्यागस्त्यो बहुगुणं कन्दमूलं तथौषधम्। शाल्यादीनि पवित्राणि भोजनार्थमकल्पयत्॥
en: Thereupon the great ascetic offered him food many substantial Kanda, roots, Osadhis and the holy Sali rice.

sn: स भुक्तवान्नरश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम्। प्रीतश्च परितुष्टश्च तां रात्रिं समुपाविशत्॥
en: And taking that nectar-like cooked rice, Rāma, the foremost of men, was greatly delighted and spent the night there.

sn: प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय कृत्वाह्निकमरिंदमः। ऋषि समुपचक्राम गमनाय रघूत्तमः॥ अभिवाद्याब्रवीद्रामो महर्षि कुम्भसंभवम्। आपृच्छे स्वाश्रमं गन्तुं मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥
en: Having got up in the morning and performed the necessary ceremonies he approached the ascetic to bid farewell, and saluting him said: O great Rșis, I do crave for your permission to go to my own habitation. Do you permit me.

sn: धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि दर्शनेन महात्मनः। द्रष्टुं चैवागमिष्यामि पावनाथ महात्मनः॥
en: O high-souled one, I have been highly favoured and blessed by beholding you. I shall come again some other time to free myself from sins.

sn: तथा वदति काकुत्स्थे वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम्। उवाच परमप्रीतो धर्मनेत्रस्तपोधनः।।।।
en: Hearing those wondrous words of Rāma, Agastya having asceticism for his wealth, delightedly said.

sn: अत्यद्भुतमिदं वाक्यं तव राम शुभाक्षरम्। पावनः सर्वभूतानां त्वमेव रघुनन्दन॥
en: O Rāma these words, set in charming letters, are highly wonderful. O descendant of Raghu, you are the purifier of all creatures.

sn: मुहूर्तमपि राम त्वां येऽनुपश्यन्ति केचन। पाविताः स्वर्गभूताश्च पूज्यास्ते त्रिदिवेश्वरैः॥
en: O Rāma, one, who beholds you, even for a moment, becomes pure and worthy of repairing to heaven. Even the leading deities worship him.

sn: ये च त्वां घोरचक्षुभिः पश्यन्ति प्राणिनो भुवि। हतास्ते यमदण्डेन सद्यो निरयगामिनः॥
en: Those on earth, who cast dreadful looks on you, are immediately brought under the control of Yama and are constrained to go to hell.

sn: ईदृशस्त्वं रघुश्रेष्ठ पावनः सर्वदेहिनाम्। भुवि त्वां कथयन्तो हि सिद्धिमेष्यन्ति राघव॥
en: O foremost of Raghus, you are the purifier of all creatures; people become perfect even if they only chant your glories.

sn: त्वं गच्छारिष्टमव्यग्रः पन्थानमकुतोभयम्। प्रशाधि राज्यं धर्मेण गतिहि जगतो भवान्॥
en: Kākutstha, do you now go with ease and fearlessly, and govern your kingdom righteously. O Rāma you are the refuge of the world.

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिना प्राञ्जलिः प्रग्रहो नृपः। अभ्यवादयत प्राज्ञस्तमृषि सत्यशीलिनम्॥ अभिवाद्य ऋषिश्रेष्ठं तांश्च सर्वांस्तपोधनान्। अध्यारोहत्तदव्यग्रः पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम्॥
en: Hearing the words of the great and truthful Rşis the wise Rāma, with folded hands, saluted him and other Rșis, and with serene air ascended the golden car Puşpaka.

sn: तं प्रयान्तं मुनिगणा आशीर्वादैः समन्ततः। अपूजयन्महेन्द्राभं सहस्राक्षमिवामराः॥
en: Like to the immortals welcoming the Chief of the deities the Rșis showered blessings upon Rāma from all sides while he was proceeding.

sn: स्वस्थः स ददृशे रामः पुष्पके हेमभूषिते। शशी मेघसमीपस्थो यथा जलधरागमे॥
en: And seated on golden car, he appeared like the moon, after the expiry of the rainy season.

sn: ततोऽदिवसे प्राप्ते पूज्यमानस्ततस्ततः। अयोध्यां प्राप्य काकुत्स्थो मध्यकक्षामवातरत्।।१८
en: Thereupon being welcomed by the villagers on his way he reached Ayodhyā at noon and descended at the middle apartment.

sn: ततो विसृज्य रुचिरं पुष्पकं कामगामिनम्। विसर्जयित्वा गच्छेति स्वस्ति तेऽस्त्विति च प्रभुः।।१९।
en: And having permitted the charming chariot coursing at will to go away he said: Do you now go; may good betide you.

sn: कक्षान्तरस्थितं क्षिप्रं द्वास्थं रामोऽब्रवीद्वचः। लक्ष्मणं भरतं चैव गत्वा तौ लघुविक्रमौ। ममागमनमाख्याय शब्दापयत मा चिरम्॥
en: Thereupon Rama said to the warder, Do you speedily go and having communicated my arrival to Lakşmaņa and Bharata bring them here.

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। द्वास्थः कुमारावाहूय राघवाय न्यवेदयत्॥
en: According to the command of Räma of unwearied actions, the warders went to the princes and communicated to them (the arrival).

sn: दृष्ट्वा तु राघवः प्राप्तावुभौ भरतलक्ष्मणौ। परिष्वज्य ततो रामो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: Beholding Bharata and Lakşmaņa present, Rāma embraced them and said.

sn: कृतं मया यथा तथ्यं द्विजकार्यमनुत्तमम्। धर्मसेतुमथो भूयः कर्तुमिच्छामि राघवौ॥ अक्षयश्चाव्ययश्चैव धर्मसेतुर्मतो मम। धर्मप्रवचनं चैव सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्॥
en: I have, as promised, performed the work of the excellent twice-born one. I wish now to perform a Rājasūya sacrifice, the source of religious glory, the destroyer of all sins, inexhaustible and un-ending.

sn: युवाभ्यामात्मभूताभ्यां राजसूयमनुत्तमम्। सहितो यष्टुमिच्छामि तत्र धर्मस्तु शाश्वतः॥
en: Therefore, with you like my own self, I wish to engage in the most excellent and eternal Rājasūya sacrifice.

sn: इष्ट्वा तु राजसूयेन मित्रः शत्रुनिबर्हणः। सुहुतेन सुयज्ञेन वरुणत्वमुपागमत्॥
en: O slayer of foes, by celebrating Rājasūya, Mitra attained to the dignity of Varuņa.

sn: सोमश्च राजसूयेन इष्ट्वा धर्मेण धर्मवित्। प्राप्तश्च सर्वलोकेषु कीर्ति स्थानं च शाश्वतम्॥
en: And having celebrated the Soma sacrifice, conversant with piety, established eternal fame in the three worlds.

sn: अस्मिन्नहनि यच्छ्रेयश्चिन्त्यतां तन्मया सह । हितं चायतियुक्तं च प्रयतौ वक्तुमर्हथः॥
en: Do you therefore consult with me even today as to what is proper. Do you consider carefully and tell me what is auspicious and productive of well-being in the long run.

sn: श्रुत्वा तु राघवस्यैतद्वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः। भरतः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह।।।।। त्वयि धर्मः परः साधो त्वयि सर्वा वसुंधरा। प्रतिष्ठिता महाबाहो यशश्चामितविक्रम॥
en: Hearing the words of Raghava, Bharata, wellskilled in the are of speech, with folded hands, said O pious Sir, in you are established piety, earth and fame.

sn: महीपालाश्च सर्वे त्वां प्रजापतिमिवामराः। निरीक्षन्ते महात्मानं लोकनाथं यथा वयम्॥ पुत्राश्च पितृवद्राजन्पश्यन्ति त्वां महाबल। पृथिव्या गतिभूतोऽसि प्राणिनामपि राघव॥ स त्वमेवंविधं यज्ञमाहर्तासि कथं नृप। पृथिव्या राजवंशानां विनाशो यत्र दृश्यते॥
en: O you of unmitigated prowess, as the deities honour the patriarch so other kings hold you in reverence. O king, all creatures mobile and immobile consider you as their father. O you of great strength, you are the refuge of all animals and of the universe. Therefore of what use is such a sacrifice to you? In such a sacrifice all the royal families meet with ruin.

sn: पृथिव्यां ये च पुरुषा राजन्पौरुषमागताः। सर्वेषां भविता तत्र संक्षयः सर्वकोपजः॥
en: O king! all those men, who are proud of manliness, being incensed with great ire on the occasion of this sacrifice, shall bring ruin upon all.

sn: सर्वं पुरुषशार्दूल गुणैरतुलविक्रम। पृथिवी नार्हसे हन्तुं वशे हि तव वर्तते॥
en: O foremost of men, the whole earth has been brought under your subjection so it is not proper to devastate it.

sn: भरतस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वामृतमयं यथा। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे रामः सत्यपराक्रमः॥ उवाच च शुभं वाक्यं कैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनम्। प्रीतोऽस्मि परितुष्टोऽस्मि तवाद्य वचनेऽनघ।।१७
en: Hearing those sweet accents of Bharata, Rāma, having truth for his prowess, attained to incomparable delight, and addressed the enhancer of Kaikeyi's delight with kind words, saying: O you freed from sins, I have been greatly delighted with you.

sn: इदं वचनमक्लीबं त्वया धर्मसमागतम्। व्याहृतं पुरुषव्याघ्र पृथिव्याः परिपालनम्॥
en: O foremost of men, for the preservation of earth, you have given vent to words, without any hesitation, pregnant with manliness and piety.

sn: एष्यदस्मदभिप्रायाद्राजसूयात्क्रतूत्तमात्। निवर्तयामि धर्मज्ञ तव सुव्याहृतेन च॥
en: O you conversant with piety, according to your wise counsels, I refrain from celebrating this Rājasūya sacrifice.

sn: लोकपीडाकरं कर्म न कर्तव्यं विचक्षणैः। बालानां तु शुभं वाक्यं ग्राह्यं लक्ष्मणपूर्वज। तस्माच्छृणोमि ते वाक्यं साधु युक्तं महाबल।।२०
en: The wise should never undertake all those works which give affliction to people. O elder brother of Lakşmaņa, it is proper to take wise counsels even from a boy. O you of great strength, I therefore, hear your speech

sn: तथोक्तवति रामे तु भरते च महात्मनि। लक्ष्मणोऽथ शुभं वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनम्॥
en: After the conversation between Råma and Bharata had been over, Laksmana, with reasonable words, said to the former.

sn: अश्वमेधो महायज्ञः पावनः सर्वपाप्मनाम्। पावनस्तव दुर्धर्षो रोचतां रघुनन्दन ॥
en: O Rāma, among sacrifices Aśvamedha is the best and the remover of all sins; it is my prayer therefore that your desire might be turned towards this great and highly purifying sacrifice.

sn: श्रूयते हि पुरावृत्तं वासवे सुमहात्मनि। ब्रह्महत्यावृतः शक्रो हयमेधेन पावितः॥
en: It is said in this Purānas, that Purandara, sullied by the sin consequent upon slaying a Brāhmaṇa, was again purified by celebrating a horse sacrifice.

sn: पुरा किल महाबाहो देवासुरसमागमे। वृत्रो नाम महानासी तेयो लोकसंमतः।।।।
en: O you having long arms, formerly, during the war between gods and demons there flourished a highly honoured Asura under the name of Vſtra.

sn: विस्तीर्णो योजनशतमुच्छ्रितस्त्रिगुणं ततः। अनुरागेण लोकांस्त्रीस्नेहात्पश्यति सर्वतः॥
en: The breadth of his body was a hundred Yojanas and the height there of was three hundred Yojanas. Considering all under his subjection he used to regard them with affection.

sn: धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च बुद्ध्या च परिनिष्ठितः। शशास पृथिवीं स्फीतां धर्मेण सुसमाहितः॥
en: He was pious, grateful and used to perform nothing without proper deliberation. And treading tracks he used to govern his subjects very carefully.

sn: तस्मिन्प्रशासति तदा सर्वकामदुधा मही। रसवन्ति प्रसूनानि मूलानि च फलानि च।७।।
en: During his administration earth produced all wished-for objects; roots and fruits were tasteful and flowers were fragrant.

sn: अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सुसंपन्ना महात्मनः। स राज्यं तादृशं भुङ्क्ते स्फीतमद्भुतदर्शनम्॥
en: Without being cultivated earth used to yield crops. In this wise for many long years he governed a prosperous and wonderful kingdom.

sn: तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना तपः कुर्यामनुत्तमम्। तपो हि परमं श्रेयः संमोहमितरत्सुखम्॥
en: Thereupon he determined upon performing a hard penance. He considered asceticism as the best of all and regarded all other things as mere illusions.

sn: स निक्षिप्य सुतं ज्येष्ठं पौरेषु मधुरेश्वरम्। तप उग्रं समातिष्ठत्तापयन्सर्वदेवताः॥
en: Having resolved thus and placed his son Madhureśvara on the throne Vſtra engaged in austerities creating terror to all deities.

sn: तपस्तप्यति वृत्रे तु वासवः परमार्तवत्। विष्णुं समुपसंक्रम्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: He being thus engaged in asceticism, Indra, greatly terrified, approached Vişņu and said.

sn: तपस्यता महाबाहो लोकाः सर्वे विनिर्जिताः। बलवान्स हि धर्मात्मा नैनं शक्ष्यामि शासितुम्॥
en: O you having long arms, by virtue of his asceticism Vſtra is about to conquer all the worlds. He is pious, so I cannot subdue him.

sn: यद्यसौ तप आतिष्ठेद्भूय एव सुरेश्वर। यावल्लोका धरिष्यन्ति तावदस्य वशानुगाः॥
en: O illustrious Sir, if his ascetic powers grow more we shall be constrained to live under his control for ever from the creation.

sn: तं चैनं परमोदारमुपेक्षसि महाबल। क्षणं हि न भवेत्रः क्रुद्ध त्वयि सुरेश्वर॥
en: Do you therefore not neglect any longer this highly Generous Asura. They self being enraged, O lord of deities, Vſtra shall not live even for a moment.

sn: यदा हि प्रीतिसंयोगं त्वया विष्णो समागतः। तदा प्रभृति लोकानां नाथत्वमुपलब्धवान्॥
en: O Vişnu, from the time he succeeded in propitiating you, he has obtained the sovereignty of the three worlds.

sn: स त्वं प्रसादं लोकानां कुरुष्व सुसमाहितः। त्वत्कृते नहि सर्व स्यात्प्रशान्तमरुजं जगत्॥
en: Do you, therefore, be propitiated now; save you none can free this world from thorns and bring it at rest.

sn: इमे हि सर्वे विष्णो त्वां निरीक्षन्ते दिवौकसः। वृत्रघातेन महता तेषां साह्यं कुरुष्व ह॥ त्वया हि नित्यशः साह्यं कृतमेषां महात्मनाम्। असह्यमिदमन्येषामगतीनां गतिर्भवान्॥
en: O Vişnu, all the deities are waiting for you; do you help them by slaying Vộtra. O you having a large mind, you are always the help of these high-souled deities. It is impossible for any one else to accomplish the present work. You are the refuge of the helpless.

sn: लक्ष्मणस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा शत्रुनिबर्हणः। वृत्रघातमशेषेण कथयेत्याह सुव्रत॥
en: Hearing the words of Laksmana, Rama, the slayer of enemies, said:-0 you of firm vows, do you at length, describe the destruction of Vrtra.

sn: राघवेणैवमुक्तस्तु सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः। भूय एव कथां दिव्यां कथयामास सुव्रतः॥
en: Hearing the words of Rāghava, Lakşmaņa, the enhancer of Sumitra's delight, again took up that theme.

sn: सहस्राक्षवचः श्रुत्वा सर्वेषां च दिवौकसाम्। विष्णुर्देवानुवाचेदं सवानिन्द्रपुरोगमान्॥
en: Hearing the words of Indra and other deities Visnu replied.

sn: पूर्व सौहृदबद्धोऽस्मि वृत्रस्येह महात्मनः। तेन युष्मत्प्रियार्थं हि नाहं हन्मि महासुरम्॥
en: From before I am bound with the high-souled Vrtra by the ties of friendship. For this, even for your satisfaction, I shall not (myself) slay him.

sn: अवश्यं करणीयं च भवतां सुखमुत्तमम्। तस्मादुपायमाख्यास्ये सहस्राक्षो वधिष्यति॥
en: Again I am to afford excellent felicity to you. I shall say the solution by which Indra will able to slay him.

sn: वेधाभूतं करिष्यामि आत्मानं सुरसत्तमाः। तेन वृत्रं सहस्राक्षो वधिष्यति न संशयः॥
en: I shall myself divide you into three classes and then forsooth your king shall be able to destroy Vrtra.

sn: एकांशो वासवं यातु द्वितीयो वज्रमेव तु। तृतीयो भूतलं यातु तदा वृत्रं हनिष्यति॥
en: Of those three portions the first will stay in Indra, second into thunderbolt and the third one into the earth, then he will be able to slay him.

sn: तथा ब्रुवति देवेशे देवा वाक्यमथाब्रुवन्।। एवमेतत्र संदेहो यथा वदसि दैत्यहन्॥ भद्रं तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामो वृत्रासुरवधैषिणः। भजस्व परमोदार वासवं स्वेन तेजसा।।।।
en: Visnu, the god of gods, having said this, the deities, replied, saying: O slayer of demons, undoubtedly, what you have said, shall prove true; may victory crown you; we proceed now to slay Vſtra. O highly generous deity, do you now make Våsava powerfully by infusing your own energy.

sn: ततः सर्वे महात्मानः सहस्राक्षपुरोगमाः। तदारण्यमुपाक्रामन्यत्र वृत्रो महासुरः॥
en: There upon the highly powerful immortals headed by Indra entered the forest where the great Asura Vſtra was performing austerities.

sn: तेऽपश्यंस्तेजसा भूतं तपन्तमसुरोत्तमम्। पिबन्तमिव लोकास्त्रीनिर्दहन्तमिवाम्बरम्॥
en: Arriving there they observed that the leading Asura was spreading rays all over, the outcome of his own effulgence, as if devouring the three worlds and burning down the quarters.

sn: दृष्ट्वैव चासुरश्रेष्ठं देवास्त्रासमुपागमन्। कथमेनं वधिष्यामः कथं न स्यात्पराजयः॥
en: Beholding that foremost of Asuras, the deities were greatly terrified and began to thing of plans by which they would be able to slay him and not be defeated.

sn: तेषां चिन्तयतां तत्र सहस्राक्षः पुरंदरः। वज्रं प्रगृह्य पाणिभ्यां प्राहिणोत्रमूर्धनि ॥
en: While they were thus thinking, Indra, of thousand eyes, taking up a thunderbolt, hurled it against Vrtra's head.

sn: कालाग्निनेव घोरेण दीप्तेनेव महार्चिषा। पतता वृत्रशिरसा जगत्त्रासमुपागमत्॥
en: That dreadful burning thunderbolt, like to the fire of dissolution, falling on Vrtra's head, the three worlds were agitated.

sn: असंभाव्यं वधं तस्य वृत्रस्य विबुधाधिपः। चिन्तयानो जगामाशु लोकस्यान्तं महायशाः॥
en: There upon thinking that he has perpetrated an iniquity by slaying Vịtra engaged in asceticism, Indra, out of fear, fled to the other side of Lokāloka mountain, perpetually enshrouded with darkness.

sn: तमिन्द्रं ब्रह्महत्याशु गच्छन्तमनुगच्छति। अपतच्चास्य गात्रेषु तमिन्द्रं दुःखमाविशत्॥
en: And the sin, consequent upon the destruction of a Brahmana, pursuing him vehemently, entered into his person. In this wise Indra became subject to dreadful afflictions.

sn: हतारयः प्रनष्टेन्द्रा देवाः साग्निपुरोगमा:। विष्णुं त्रिभुवनेशानं मुहुर्मुहुरपूजयन्॥ त्वं गतिः परमेशान पूर्वजो जगतः पिता। रक्षार्थं सर्वभूतानां विष्णुत्वमुपजग्मिवान् ॥ हतश्चायं त्वया वृत्रो ब्रह्महत्या च वासवम्। बाधते सुरशार्दूल मोक्षं तस्य विनिर्दिश॥
en: Beholding the enemy slain and Indra fled, the deities headed by fire again and again chanted the glories of Vişņu —the lord of three worlds saying: O great god, you are the refuge of the three worlds. You are the first-born and the father of the universe. For protecting all creatures you have assumed this Vişnu from. You have slain this Vặtra but the sin of slaying a Brahmana has visited Indra. Therefore, O excellent Puruşa, do you so arrange that he may i be freed from sins.

sn: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवानां विष्णुरब्रवीत्। मामेव यजतां शक्रः पावयिष्यामि वज्रिणम्॥
en: Hearing the words of the celestials Vişņu said, Let your Chief celebrate a sacrifice in my honour, and by that he shall be cleansed off the sin.

sn: पुण्येन हयमेधेन मामिष्ट्वा पाकशासनः। पुनरेष्यति देवानामिन्द्रत्वमकुतोभयः॥
en: If the slayer of Pāka celebrates a horse sacrifice, he shall again fearlessly be installed as the chief of deities.

sn: एवं संदिश्य तां वाणी देवानां चामृतोपमाम्। जगाम विष्णुर्देवेशः स्तूयमानस्त्रिविष्टपम्॥
en: Having addressed these nectar-like words to the deities and being glorified by them, Visnu, the god of gods, returned to his abode.

sn: तदा वृत्रवधं सर्वमखिलेन स लक्ष्मणः। कथयित्वा नरश्रेष्ठः कथाशेष प्रचक्रमे॥ ततो हते महावीर्ये वृत्रे देवभयंकरे। ब्रह्महत्यावृतः शक्रः संज्ञां लेभे न वृत्रहा॥
en: Having thus described at length and finished the story of Vſtra's destruction Lakşmaņa said:-The mighty Vţtra, the terror of the deities, being slain, and the slayer Indra being assailed by the sin of Brahmanicide, was bewildered and at a loss to ascertain his duty.

sn: सोऽन्तमाश्रित्य लोकानां नष्टसंज्ञो विचेतनः। कालं तत्रावसत्कंचिद्वेष्टमान इवोरगः॥
en: Being at his wit's end he repaired to the other side of the Lokāloka mountain and remained there for some time like a coiled serpent.

sn: अथ नष्टे सहस्राक्षे उद्विग्नमभवज्जगत्। भूमिश्च ध्वस्तसंकाशा निःस्नेहा शुष्ककानना॥ निःस्रोतसस्ते सर्वे तु हृदाश्च सरितस्तथा। संक्षोभश्चैव सत्त्वानामनावृष्टिकृतोऽभवत्॥
en: And again in consequence of Indra's separation, the whole world was agitated, the forests grew dried and the earth was devoid of water. On account of the rivers being dried up and want of rain all creatures grew impatient.

sn: क्षीयमाणे तु लोकेऽस्मिन्संभ्रान्तनसः सुराः। यदुक्तं विष्णुना पूर्वं तं यज्ञं समुपानयन्॥
en: In this wise, the celestials being stricken with anxiety, according to the previous command of Visnu, engaged in celebrating the sacrifice.

sn: ततः सर्वे सुरगणाः सोपाध्यायाः सहर्षिभिः। तं देशं समुपाजग्मुर्यवेन्द्रो भयमोहितः॥ ते तु दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षमावृतं ब्रह्महत्यया। तं पुरस्कृत्य देवेशमश्वमेधं प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: With Rșis and Rtvikas they fearfully approached Purandra; and beholding him assailed by the sin of Brahmanicide, they with him, at their head, engaged in celebrating a horse-sacrifice.

sn: ततोऽश्वमेधः सुहान्महेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः। ववृते ब्रह्महत्यायाः पावनार्थं नरेश्वर ॥ ततो यज्ञे समाप्ते तु ब्रह्महत्या महात्मनः। अभिगम्याब्रवीद्वाक्यं क्व मे स्थानं विधास्यथ॥ ते तामूचुस्ततो देवास्तुष्टाः प्रीतिसमन्विताः। चतुर्धा विभजात्मानमात्मनैव दुरासदे॥
en: After the sacrifice the sin issued out of Indra's person and addressing the high-souled deities said: Do you all ascertain, where I shall go now. There upon highly pleased the deities replied: Do you divide yourself into four portions.

sn: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्महत्या महात्मनाम्। संदधौ स्थानमन्यत्र वरयामास दुर्वसा ॥ एकेनांशेन वत्स्यामि पूर्णोदासु नदीषु वै। चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्दर्पघ्नी कामचारिणी॥
en: Hearing the words of the high-souled celestials she divided herself into four parts and wishing for a separate habitation said:-By one portion, I shall at my pleasure, live in rivers full of water during rains and shall obstruct people from going there.

sn: भूम्यामहं सर्वकालमेकेनांशेन सर्वदा। वसिष्यामि न संदेहः सत्येनैतद्ब्रवीमि वः॥ । योऽयमंशस्तृतीयो मे स्त्रीषु यौवनशालिषु। त्रिरात्रं दर्पपूर्णासु वसिष्ये दर्पघातिनी॥ हन्तारो ब्राह्मणान्ये तु मृषापूर्वमदूषकान्। तांश्चतुर्थेन भागेन संश्रयिष्ये सरुर्षभाः॥
en: By my second portion I shall live perpetually on lands as Uşara;* I tell you the truth. By my third portion I shall for three nights every month live in youthful women proud of their youth-So that men might not live with them. And by my fourth portion I shall enter into the persons of those who shall slay innocent Bråhmaņas. *(A spot with saline soil.)

sn: प्रत्यूचुस्तां ततो देवा यथा वदसि दुर्वसे। तथा भवतु तत्सर्वं साधयस्व यदीप्सितम्॥
en: Hearing those words the deities said What you have said shall be carried out. Do what you wish.

sn: ततः प्रीत्यान्विता देवाः सहस्राक्षं ववन्दिरे। विज्वरः पूतपाप्मा च वासवः समपद्यत ॥
en: There upon the celestials, delighted, adored their Chief divested of sins and crowned with victory.

sn: प्रशान्तं च जगत्सर्वं सहस्राक्षे प्रतिष्ठिते। यज्ञं चाद्भुतसंकाशं तदा शक्रोऽभ्यपूजयत्॥
en: And Väsava being installed again on the throne, the whole universe was at rest. There upon Indra worshipped Vişnu in the shape of that wonderful sacrifice.

sn: ईदृशो ह्यश्वमेधस्य प्रसादो रघुनन्दन। यजस्व सुमहाभाग हयमेधेन पार्थिव ॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, such is the power of a horse-sacrifice. O honourable king, therefore, you may perform this sacrifice.

sn: इति लक्ष्मणवाक्यमुत्तमं नृपतिरतीव मनोहरं महात्मा। परितोषमवाप हृष्टचेताः स निशम्येन्द्रसमानविक्रमौजाः।।
en: Hearing the charming words of Lakşmaņa, the energetic and high-souled king, Rāma, powerful like Indra, was greatly delighted.

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणेनोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः। प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः प्रहसनराघवो वचः॥
en: Hearing the words of Laksmana and smiling, the highly effulgent descendant of Raghu, Rāma, skilled in the are of speech, replied.

sn: एवमेव नरश्रेष्ठ यथा वदसि लक्ष्मण। वृत्रघातमशेषेण वाजिमेधफलं च यत्॥
en: Lakşmaņa, O foremost of men, you have truly related the story of Vſtra's destruction and the fruits of horse-sacrifice.

sn: श्रूयते हि पुरा सौम्य कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः। पुत्रो वाह्लीश्वरः श्रीमानिलो नाम सुधार्मिकः॥
en: 0gentle one, I have heard, that formerly in the province of Valhīka, the graceful king lla, the son of the patriarch Kardama, was highly pious.

sn: स राजा पृथिवीं सर्वां वशे कृत्वा महायशाः। राज्यं चैव नरव्याघ्र पुत्रवत्पर्यपालयत्॥
en: O foremost of men, having brought the entire earth under his subjects like to his own sons.

sn: सुरैश्च परमोदारैर्दैतेयैश्च महाधनैः। नागराक्षसगन्धर्वैर्यक्षैश्च सुमहात्मभिः॥ पूज्यते नित्यशः सौम्य भयार्ते रघुनन्दन । अबिभ्यश्च त्रयो लोकाः सरोषस्य महात्मनः॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, being terrified, the generous deities, the rich Daityas, the highly powerful Nägas, the irrepressible Rakşasas, Gandharvas and Yakşas used to adore him perpetually. The high-souled Ila being enraged, the three worlds used to be convulsed with terror.

sn: स राजा तादृशोऽप्यासीद्धर्मे वीर्ये च निष्ठितः। बुद्ध्या च परमोदारो बाह्लीकेशो महायशाः॥
en: And albeit so very powerful the highly illustrious king of Vālhika never swerved from the path of morality nor neglected his deities and rather intelligently used to administer all business.

sn: स प्रचक्रे महाबाहुमूंगयां रुचिरे वने। चैत्रे मनोरमे मासे सभृत्यबलवाहनः॥ प्रजघ्ने स नृपोऽरण्ये मृगाञ्छतसहस्रशः। हत्वैव तृप्ति भूच्च राज्ञस्तस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Once on a time in the picturesque season of spring the mighty-armed Ila, with his army and conveyances, entered into a charming forest, and on the pretext of hunting, slew hundreds and thousands of deer. With slaying deer only the high-souled king was not satisfied.

sn: नानामृगाणामयुतं वध्यमानं महात्मना। यत्र जातो माहासेनस्तं देशमुपचक्रमे॥
en: He slew millions of diverse other animals. In this way being engaged in hunting the king Ila arrived where Kārtikeya was born.

sn: तस्मिन्प्रदेशे देवेश शैलराजसुतां हरः। रमयामास दुर्धर्षः सर्वैरनुचरैः सह॥
en: At that time, in that hilly fountain there was sporting in the company of his followers, the irrepressible god of gods, the three-eyed deity with the daughter of the Chief of mountains.

sn: कृत्वा स्त्रीरूपमात्मानमुमेशो गोपतिध्वजः। देव्याः प्रियचिकीर्षुः संस्तस्मिन्पर्वतनिझरे॥
en: Being desirous of satisfying the goddess Umă, her lord. whose emblem is bull, was sporting under the guise of a female.

sn: यत्र यत्र वनोद्देशे सत्त्वाः पुरुषवादिनः। वृक्षाः पुरुषनामानस्ते सर्वे स्त्रीजनाभवन्॥
en: In that forest land, all male animals or trees were metamorphosed into the other sex at that time.

sn: यच्च किंचन तत्सर्वं नारीसंज्ञं बभूव ह। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजा स इल: कर्दमात्मजः॥ निघ्नन्मृगसहस्राणि तं देशमुपचक्रमे। स दृष्ट्वा स्त्रीकृतं सर्व सव्यालमृगपक्षिणम्॥ आत्मानं स्त्रीकृतं चैव सानुगं रघुनन्दन । तस्य दुःखं महच्वासीदृष्ट्वात्मानं तथागतम्॥ उमापतेश्च तत्कर्म ज्ञात्वा त्रासमुपागमत्।
en: A hunting, the king Ila, the son of Kardama, arrived at that place and saw all animals and trees changed into female forms. And immediately the king and his army were changed into similar forms. Finding himself in that plight the king Ila was greatly sorry, and thinking that the misfortune was owing to the influence of the god of gods Umā's lord, he was greatly terrified.

sn: ततो देवं महात्मानं शितिकण्ठं कपर्दिनम्।।१७ जगाम शरणं राजा सभृत्यबलवाहनः।
en: There with his followers and army the king took shelter or the high-souled and red-throated deity.

sn: ततः प्रहस्य वरदः सह देव्या महेश्वरः॥ प्रजापतिसुतं वाक्यमुवाच वरदः स्वयम्।
en: There upon the great god, the conferror of boons, with the goddess, smiling said:

sn: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ राजर्षे कार्दमेय महाबल॥ पुरुषत्वमृते सौम्य वरं वरय सुव्रत। ततः स राजा शोकार्तः प्रत्याख्यातो महात्मना॥ स्त्रीभूतोऽसौ न जग्राह वरमन्यं सुरोत्तमात्।
en: Rise up, O son of Kardama, O you of great strength, O gentle one, do you beg of me any other boon than that of obtaining your manhood. Being thus disappointed by the great deity, the king Ila, metamorphosed into a female, became greatly sorry and did not pray for any other boon.

sn: ततः शोकेन महता शैलराजसुतां नृपः॥ प्रणिपत्य उमां देवीं सर्वेणैवान्तरात्मना। ईशे वराणां वरदे लोकानामसि भामिनी॥ अमोघदर्शने देवी भज सौम्येन चक्षुषा।
en: Being stricken with great sorrow, the king, with whole heart, saluted the daughter of the mountain-chief and said:-0 goddess, you are the protectress of all-you do confer boons on all; seeing you does not become fruitless. Do you therefore have compassion on me.

sn: हृद्गतं तस्य राजर्षेविज्ञाय हरसंनिधौ॥ प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं देवी रुद्रस्य संमता। अर्धस्य देवो वरदो वरार्धस्य तव ह्यहम्॥ तस्मादधं गृहाण त्वं स्त्रीपुंसोर्यावदिच्छसि।
en: There upon, cognisant of that king's intention, the goddess, with Hara's consent, said. Half of the boon, that you shall beg of us both, shall be granted by Mahādeva, and the other half shall be granted by me. Do you therefore beg of me the half.

sn: तदद्भुततरं श्रुत्वा देव्या वरमनुत्तमम्॥ संप्रहृष्टमना भूत्वा राजा वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्। यदि देवि प्रसन्ना मे रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि॥ मासं स्त्रीत्वमुपासित्वा मासं स्यां पुरुषः पुनः।
en: Hearing of that excellent and wondrous boon the king became greatly delighted and said:-If you are pleased with me, O goddess, do you confer upon me this boon, that I may be for one month, a female gifted with wonderful beauty in the three worlds and for another month I may be a male.

sn: ईप्सितं तस्य विज्ञाय देवी सुरुचिरानना॥ प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यमेवमेव भविष्यति। राजन्पुरुषभूतस्त्वं स्त्रीभावं न स्मरिष्यसि॥ स्त्रीभूतश्च परं मासं न स्मरिष्यसि पौरुषम्।
en: There upon understanding king's desire, the beautiful goddess Pārvatī, mercifully said: The boon, according to your desire, shall be granted. O king, when you shall attain to the male figure, you shall not remember anything of your female form. And when you shall a assume the charming female figure you shall forget everything of your male state.

sn: एवं स राजा पुरुषो मासं भूत्वाथ कार्दमिः। त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी नारी मासमेकमिलाभवत्॥
en: O Lakşmaņa, by virtue of this boon, the king Ila for one month used to become a man and for the next used to become female, charming in the three worlds under the name of Ilă.

sn: तां कथामैलसंबद्धां रामेण समुदीरिताम्। लक्ष्मणो भरतश्चैव श्रुत्वा परमविस्मितौ॥ तौ रामं प्राञ्जली भूत्वा तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः। विस्तरं तस्य भावस्य तदा पप्रच्छतुः पुनः॥
en: Having heard of the story of the king Ila from Rāma, Lakşmaņa and Bharata were greatly surprised. And And with folded hands they, requesting the noble king Rāma, for further particulars, said.

sn: कथं स राजा स्त्रीभूतो वर्तयामास दुर्गतिः। पुरुषः स यदा भूतः कां वृत्तिं वर्तयत्यसौ॥
en: How could the king Ila subject himself to those afflictions in the shape of a female? And how did he use to behave himself in his male form?

sn: तयोस्तद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वितम्। कथयामास काकुत्स्थस्तस्य राज्ञो यथागमम्॥
en: Hearing those words begotten of curiosity, Rāma engaged in relating the whole story as he had heard before, saying.

sn: तमेव प्रथमं मासं स्त्री भूत्वा लोकसुन्दरी। तत्काननं विगाह्याशु विजह्वे लोकसुन्दरी। दुमगुल्मलताकीर्णं पद्भ्यां पद्मदलेक्षणा॥ ताभिः परिवृता स्त्रीभिर्येऽस्य पूर्व पदानुगाः।।।।।
en: In the first month, assuming his female form having lotus-eyes and charming the three world, he used to sport in the forest abounding in groves, in the company of his companions metamorphosed into the same form.

sn: वाहनानि च सर्वाणि संत्यक्त्वा वै समन्ततः। पर्वताभोगविवरे तस्मिन्रेमे इला तदा॥
en: Having sent away all his conveyances Ilā used to sport in the mountain vale.

sn: अथ तस्मिन्वनोद्देशे पर्वतस्याविदूरतः। सरः सुरुचिरप्रख्यं नानापक्षिगणायुतम्॥ ददर्श सा इला तस्मिन्बुधं सोमसुतं तदा। ज्वलन्तं स्वेन वपुषा पूर्ण सोममिवोदितम्।।।।
en: Thus roaming, Ila one day espied Budha, a bundle of rays, resembling the full moon in a picturesque pond filled with birds at some distance from the mountain.

sn: तपन्तं च तपस्तीव्रमम्भोमध्ये दुरासदम्। यशस्करं कामकरं कारुण्ये पर्यवस्थितम्॥
en: Having compassion for all creatures Budha, at that time, was performing, hard, glorious and wished-for austerities within waters.

sn: सा तं जलाशयं सर्व क्षोभयामास विस्मिता। सह तैः पूर्वपुरुषैः स्त्रीभूतै रघुनन्दन॥
en: O son of Raghu, on beholding him Ilā was greatly surprised, and with her female companions began to agitate waters.

sn: बुधस्तु तां समीक्ष्यैव कामबाणवशं गतः। नोपलेभे तदात्मानं स चचाल तदाम्भसि ॥ इलां निरीक्षमाणस्तु त्रैलोक्यादधिकां शुभाम्। चित्तं समभ्यतिक्रामत्कान्वियं देवताधिका ॥
en: As soon as Budha saw her he was assailed by the arrows of Cupid. Not being able to control himself he grew impatient within waters and thought. This damsel is far more beautiful even than the celestial girls.

sn: न देवीषु न नागीषु नासुरीष्वप्सरःसु च। दृष्टपूर्वा मया काचिदूपेणानेन शोभिता॥
en: I have never seen before a like among the celestials, Nagas, Asuras and Apsaras.

sn: सदृशीयं मम भवेद्यदि नान्यपरिग्रहः। इति बुद्धिंसमास्थाय जलात्कूलमुपागमत्॥ आश्रमं समुपागम्य ततस्ताः प्रमदोत्तमाः। शब्दापयत धर्मात्मा ताश्चैनं च ववन्दिरे॥
en: If she has not been married before then she is my worthy spouse. With this resolution Budha got up from the waters, and repairing to his hermitage, sent for the fair ones. they all saluted him.

sn: स ताः पप्रच्छ धर्मात्मा कस्यैषा लोकसुन्दरी। किमर्थमागता चैव सर्वमाख्यात मा चिरम्॥
en: Thereupon the virtuous-souled Budha accosted them saying: Whose daughter is this graceful girl among you and for what she has come here? Do not delay-tell me soon.

sn: शुभं तु तस्य तद्वाक्यं मधुरं मधुराक्षरम्। श्रुत्वा स्त्रियश्च ताः सर्वा ऊचुर्मधुरया गिरा॥
en: Hearing those sweet words of Budha, the all females also said in sweet accents.

sn: अस्माकमेषा सुश्रोणी प्रभुत्वे वर्तते सदा। अपतिः काननान्तेषु सहास्माभिश्चरत्यसौ॥
en: This fair damsel is our supreme lady. She has no husband. Journeying she has come here in the forest with us.

sn: तद्वाक्यमाव्यक्तपदं तासां स्त्रीणां निशम्य च। विद्यामावर्तनी पुण्यामावर्तयति स द्विजः॥
en: Hearing those plain words, Budha thought of the learning by which one can perceive everything.

sn: सोऽर्थं विदित्वा सकलं तस्य राज्ञो यथा तथा। सर्वा एव स्त्रियस्ताश्च बभाषे मुनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: And being informed of all inatters regarding the king Ila, thereby that foremost of sages said to the females.

sn: अत्र किंपुरुषीभूत्वा शैलरोधसि वत्स्यथ। आवासस्तु गिरावस्मिञ्शीघ्रमेव विधीयताम्॥
en: Do you all live in this mountain being Kimpurusas; do you make your respective habitations here.

sn: मूलपत्रफलैः सर्वा वर्तयिष्यथ नित्यदा। स्त्रियः किंपुरुषानाम भर्तृन्समुपलप्स्यथ ॥
en: I shall give you always fruits and roots. O you females, you shall have all Kimpuruşas as your husbands.

sn: ताः श्रुत्वा सोमपुत्रस्य स्त्रियः किंपुरुषीकृताः। उपासांचक्रिरे शैलं वध्वस्ता बहुलास्तदा॥
en: According to the words of Budha they lived in that mountains as Kimpuruşas. In this wise many Kimpurusa-Budhas were procreated.

sn: श्रुत्वा किंपुरुषोत्पत्तिं लक्ष्मणो भरतस्तथा। आश्चर्यमिति च ब्रूतामुभौ रामं जनेश्वरम्॥
en: Having heard of the origin of Kimpuruṣas, both Bharata and Lakşmaņa said to Råma: This is a wonderful story.

sn: अथ रामः कथामेतां भूय एव महायशाः। कथयामास धर्मात्मा प्रजापतिसुतस्य वै॥
en: Thereupon the highly illustrious Råma, the foremost of the pious, again began with the story of Ila, the son of the patriarch.

sn: सर्वास्ता विहृता दृष्ट्वा किंनरीषिसत्तमः। उवाच रूपसंपन्नां तां त्रियं प्रहसन्निव ॥
en: Beholding the Kinnarīs repairing to a distance, Buddha the foremost of ascetics, smiling said, to the beautiful Ila:

sn: सोमस्याहं सुदयितः सुतः सुरुचिरानने। भजस्व मां वरारोहे भक्त्या स्निग्धेन चक्षुषा॥
en: O you of a graceful presence, I am the most favourite son of the moon; O fair one, do you, with delight, cast looks upon me.

sn: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शून्ये स्वजनवर्जिते। इला सुरुचिरप्रख्यं प्रत्युवाच महाप्रभम्॥
en: Hearing the words of the highly effulgent and beautiful Budha in the picturesque forest land divested of men and animals, Ila said.

sn: अहं कामचरी सौम्य तवास्मि वशवर्तिनी। प्रशाधि मां सोमसुत यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु॥
en: O gentle one, I am not subject to any body; I surrender myself to you out of my own accord. O son of Soma, you may command me whatever you wish.

sn: तस्यास्तदद्भुतप्रख्यं श्रुत्वा हर्षमुपागतः। स वै कामी सह तया रेमे चन्द्रमसः सुतः॥
en: Hearing those wondrous words, the son of moon, possessed by lust, began to live with her.

sn: बुधस्य माधवो मासस्तामिलां रुचिराननाम्। गतो रमयतोऽत्यर्थं क्षणवत्तस्य कामिनः।।।
en: And living in the company of Ilā, having a graceful countenance, Budha, possessed by desire, spent the entire month of Madhu like a moment.

sn: अथ मासे तु संपूर्णे पूर्णेन्दुसदृशाननः। प्रजापतिसुतः श्रीमाञ्शयने प्रत्यबुध्यत॥ सोऽपश्यत्सोमजं तत्र तपन्तं सलिलाशये। ऊर्ध्वबाहुं निरालम्बं तं राजा प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: There upon after the expiry of a month, the graceful king Ila, son of Soma, engaged from sleep and beholding Budha, the son of Soma, engaged in austerities with uplifted hands in the midst of waters, said.

sn: भगवन्पर्वतं दुर्ग प्रविष्टोऽस्मि सहानुगः। न च पश्यामि तत्सैन्यं क्व नु ते मामका गताः॥
en: 'O illustrious Sir, with my followers I entered this dense forest-I do not see them now anywhere. Where have they gone?

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा तस्य राजर्षेर्नष्टसंज्ञस्य भाषितम्। प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं सान्त्वयन्परया गिरा॥
en: Hearing the words of the royal saint, who had lost all recollection, Budha, with sweet words consoled him and said.

sn: अश्मवर्षेण महता भृत्यास्ते विनिपातिताः। त्वं चाश्रमपदे सुप्तो वातवर्षभयादितः॥
en: All your followers have been destroyed by a downpour of huge rocks; yourself, being afraid of the storm, was also asleep in the hermitage.

sn: समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते निर्भयो विगतज्वरः। फलमूलाशनो वीर निवसेह यथासुखम्॥
en: You have no fear now. Therefore, O hero, being consoled and renouncing all anxiety do you live here happily living upon fruits and roots.

sn: स राजा तेन वाक्येन प्रत्याश्वस्तो महामतिः। प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं दीनो भृत्यजनक्षयात्॥
en: Being comforted by those words, the highminded king Ila, stricken with distress in consequence of the destruction of his servants, poorly replied.

sn: त्यक्ष्याम्यहं स्वकं राज्यं नाहं भृत्यैविनाकृतः। वर्तयेयं क्षणं ब्रह्मन्समनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: O Brāhmaṇa, I shall renounce my own kingdom. Separated from my servants, I shall not be able to live even for a moment. Do you give me permission in this.

sn: सुतो धर्मपरो ब्रह्मज्येष्ठो मम महायशाः। शशबिन्दुरिति ख्यातः स मे राज्यं प्रपत्स्यते॥
en: O Brāhmaṇa, my eldest son, the highly illustrious Sasabindu, the foremost of the pious, shall be the owner of my kingdom.

sn: नहि शक्ष्याम्यहं हित्वा भृत्यदारान्सुखान्वितान्। प्रतिवक्तुं महातेजः किंचिदप्यशुभं वचः॥
en: O Brāhmaṇa, renouncing my servants and wives of the country I shall not be able to wait here. Therefore, O highly effulgent one, do you not give me such an unpleasant command of remaining here.

sn: तथा ब्रुवति राजेन्द्रे बुधः परममद्भुतम्। सान्त्वपूर्वमथोवाच वासस्त इह रोचताम्॥ न संतापस्त्वया कार्यः कार्दमेय महाबल। संवत्सरोषितस्याद्य कारयिष्यामि ते हितम्॥
en: Hearing those wonderful words of the king Ila, Budha consoling him, said:-Do you wait here. Be not aggrieved, O highly powerful son of Kardama. If you do live here for a year, I shall render your well-being.

sn: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा बुधस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। वासाय विदधे बुद्धिंयदुक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना ॥
en: Hearing the words of Budha, of unwearied actions, the king Ila desired to live there.

sn: मासं स स्त्री तदा भूत्वा रमयत्यनिशं सदा। मासं पुरुषभावेन धर्मबुद्धिं चकार सः॥
en: There upon becoming a man for the next month he began to perform ascetic penances.

sn: ततः सा नवमे मासि इला सोमसुतात्सुतम्। जनयामास सुश्रोणी पुरूरवसमूर्जितम्॥ जातमात्रे तु सुश्रोणी पितुर्हस्ते न्यवेशयत्। बुधस्य समवर्णं च इला पुत्रं महाबलम्॥
