en: There upon in the ninth month, Ilă, having a beautiful waist, gave birth to a highly effulgent son, under the name of Pururavă, born of the lions of Budha, and equally graceful like him. and she handed over the highly powerful son to his father Budha.

sn: बुधस्तु पुरुषीभूतं स वै संवत्सरान्तरम्। कथाभी रमयामास धर्मयुक्ताभिरात्मवान्॥
en: There upon after a year Ilā having regained the male form, Budha by means of various words afforded delight to him.

sn: तथोक्तवति रामे तु तस्य जन्म तदद्भुतम्। उवाच लक्ष्मणो भूयो भरतश्च महायशाः॥
en: Rāma having thus described the wonderful birth of Pururavā, the illustrious Bharata and Lakşmaņa asked him again saying.

sn: इला सा सोमपुत्रस्य संवत्सरमथोषिता। अकरोत्कि नरश्रेष्ठ तत्त्वं शंसितुमर्हसि ॥
en: O foremost of men, tell us what did Ila afterwards do after living in the company of Soma's son for a year.

sn: तयोस्तद्वाक्यमाधुर्यं निशम्य परिपृच्छतोः। रामः पुनरुवाचेदं प्रजापतिसुते कथाम्॥
en: Hearing their sweet words Råma again began with the story of Kardama's son and said.

sn: पुरुषत्वं गते शूरे बुधः परमबुद्धिमान्। संवत परमोदारमाजुहाव महायशाः॥ च्यवनं भृगुपुत्रं च मुनिं चारिष्टनेमिनम्। प्रमोदनं मोदकरं ततो दुर्वाससं मुनिम्॥ एतान्सर्वान्समानीय वाक्यज्ञस्तत्त्वदर्शनः। उवाच सर्वान्सुहृदो धैर्येण सुसमाहितान्॥
en: In turn, the heroic Ila, having regained his manhood, the highly illustrious and intelligent Budha, well-informed of birth and well-skilled in the are of speech, sent for the highly liberal Samvarta, Bhrgu's son Cyavana, Aristanemi, the foremost of Munis, Durvasa, capable of affording delight, and other friends gifted with patience and said.

sn: अयं राजा महाबाहुः कर्दमस्य इलः सुतः। जानीतैनं यथाभूतं श्रेयो ह्यत्र विधीयताम्॥
en: You all know well, how this mighty-armed Ila, Kardama's son, attained to this peculiar condition.

sn: तेषां संवदतामेव द्विजैः सह महात्मभिः। कर्दमस्तु महातेजास्तदाश्रममुपागमत्।८।।
en: There upon while those high-souled ones were conversing upon this subject, the highly effulgent Kardama arrived at the hermitage.

sn: पुलस्त्यश्च क्रतुश्चैव वषट्कारस्तथैव च। ओङ्कारश्च महातेजास्वमाश्रममुपागमन्॥
en: Pulastya, Kratu, Vaşatkāra and the highly effulgent Omkāra came there following him.

sn: ते सर्वे हृष्टमनसः परस्परसमागमे। हितैषिणो बाल्हिपतेः पृथग्वाक्यान्यथाब्रुवन्॥
en: Being greatly delighted for their arrival they all gave out their individual opinion for bringing about the well-being of the king of Valhika.

sn: कर्दमस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुतार्थं परमं हितम्। द्विजाः शृणुत मद्वाक्यं यच्छ्रेयः पार्थिवस्य हि॥
en: For the welfare of his son, the patriarch Kardama said: Hear, O twice-born ones, how the well-being of the king Ila may be secured.

sn: नान्यं पश्यामि भैषज्यमन्तरा वृषभध्वजम्। नाश्वमेधात्परो यज्ञः प्रियश्चैव महात्मनः॥
en: For this decease do not find any other good medicine but Umā's lord. And save Aśvamedha there is no other sacrifice more favourite to the high-souled deity.

sn: तस्माद्यजामहे सर्वे पार्थिवार्थे दुरासदम्। कर्दमैवमुक्तास्तु सर्व एव द्विजर्षभाः॥ रोचयन्ति स्म तं यज्ञं रुद्रस्याराधनं प्रति। संवर्तस्य तु राजर्षिः शिष्यः परपुरंजयः॥ मरुत्त इति विख्यातस्तं यज्ञं समुपाहरत्।
en: Let us all therefore celebrate that hard sacrifice on behalf of this king. Thereupon the wors of Kardama, Samvarta's disciple, the royal saint Marutta, the conqueror of enemies, collected all articles for the sacrifice.

sn: ततो यज्ञो महानासीद्धाश्रमसमीपतः॥ रुद्रश्च परमं तोषमाजगाम महायशाः। अथ यज्ञे समाप्ते तु प्रीतः परमया मुदा ।।१६। उमापतिर्द्विजान्सर्वानुवाच इलसंनिधौ।
en: There upon in the vicinity of Budha's hermitage that mighty sacrifice was celebrated. And by that the Great Rudra lord of Umā, attained to delight and said to the twice-born ones, and others at the end of that sacrifice in the presence of the king Ila.

sn: प्रीतोऽस्मि हयमेधेन भक्त्या च द्विजसत्तमाः।।१७। अस्य बाल्हिपतेश्चैव किं करोमि प्रियं शुभम्।
en: O foremost of twice-born ones, I have been greatly delighted with this sacrifice and your devotion. Tell me now, what I can do for this king of Valhika.

sn: तथा वदति देवेशे द्विजास्ते सुसमाहिताः॥ प्रसादयन्ति देवेशं यथा स्यात्पुरुषस्त्विला।
en: Hearing the words of Mahādeva, the Brāhmaṇas having propitiated him with great devotion, prayed for Ila's manhood.

sn: ततः प्रीतो महादेवः पुरुषत्वं ददौ पुनः॥ इलायै सुमहातेजा दत्त्वा चान्तरधीयत।
en: There upon delighted the highly effulgent Mahādeva, having having conferred upon him manhood, disappeared.

sn: निवृत्ते हयमेधे च गते चादर्शनं हरे॥ यथागतं द्विजाः सर्वे तेऽगच्छन्दीर्घदर्शिनः। राजा तु बाह्निमुत्सृज्य मध्यदेशे ह्यनुत्तमम्॥ निवेशयामास पुरं प्रतिष्ठानं यशस्करम्। शशबिन्दुश्च राजर्षिर्बाहिं परपुरंजयः॥ प्रतिष्ठाने इलो राजा प्रजापतिसुतो बली। स काले प्राप्तवॉल्लोकमिलो ब्राह्ममनुत्तमम्॥ ऐलः पुरूरवा राजा प्रतिष्ठानमवाप्तवान्।
en: In this wise the horse-sacrifice being finished and Mahadeva having disappeared, the farseeing and leading twice-born ones repaired to their respective hermitages. And having placed his eldest son Śaśabindu as the king of the country of Valhika, the king Ila reared another city in the middle country. In time Ila attained to the excellent Brahmä region and his son Pururavå obtained that Pratişthāna kingdom.

sn: ईदृशो ह्यश्वमेधस्य प्रभावः पुरुषर्षभ। स्त्रीपूर्वः पौरुषं लेभे।। यच्चान्यदपि दुर्लभम्।।२४
en: O foremost of men, such is the power of the horse-sacrifice, that the king Ila, though converted into a female, regained manhood by virtue thereof.

sn: एतदाख्याय काकुत्स्थो भ्रातृभ्याममितप्रभः। लक्ष्मणं पुनरेवाह धर्मयुक्तमिदं वचः॥
en: Having thus addressed his both brothers, Rāma, the descendant of Kākutstha of unmitigated prowess, again said to Laksmana, in words pregnant with morality.

sn: वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ कश्यपम्। द्विजांश्च सर्वप्रवरानश्वमेधपुरस्कृतान्॥ एतान्सर्वान्समानीय मन्त्रयित्वा च लक्ष्मण। हयं लक्षणसंपन्नं विमोक्ष्यामि समाधिना॥
en: O Laksmana, having invited Vasistha, the foremost of twice-born ones, conversant with all the rites of Aśvamedha, Vāmadeva, Jābāli, and Kaśyapa and consulted with them duly I shall set free a horse gifted with all marks.

sn: तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा त्वरितविक्रमः। द्विजान्सर्वान्समाहूय दर्शयामास राघवम्॥
en: Hearing the words of Rama, Laksmana, of unmitigated prowess, invited all those Brāhmaṇas and approached Rāma.

sn: ते दृष्ट्वा देवसंकाशं कृतपादाभिवन्दनम्। राघवं सुदुराधर्षमाशीभिः समपूजयन्॥
en: Seeing them, Rāma saluted them touching their feet. And the Brāhmaṇas too, beholding the irrepressible celestial, like Rāghava, welcomed him with blessings.

sn: प्राञ्जलिः स तदा भूत्वा राघवो द्विजसत्तमान्। उवाच धर्मसंयुक्तमश्वमेधाश्रितं वचः॥
en: The.. upon Rama, with folded hands, asked of those leading twice-born ones, questions regarding the Aśvamedha sacrifice.

sn: तेऽपि रामस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा नमस्कृत्वा वृषध्वजम्। अश्वमेधं द्विजाः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म सर्वशः॥
en: And hearing the words of Rāma, they, too, saluting the deity Rudra, began to speak highly of the ceremony of horse-sacrifice.

sn: स तेषां द्विजमुख्यानां वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम्। अश्वमेधाश्रितं श्रुत्वा भृशं प्रीतोऽभवत्तदा॥
en: And being informed from the Brāhmaṇas of many unheard of virtues of Aśvamedha, Rāma was greatly delighted.

sn: विज्ञाय कर्म तत्तेषां रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्। प्रेषयस्व महाबाहो सुग्रीवाय महात्मने॥ यथा महद्भिर्हरिभिर्बहुभिश्च वनौकसाम्। सार्धमागच्छ भद्रं ते अनुभोक्तुं महोत्सवम्॥
en: And according to their desire he said to Lakşmaņa:— you having long arms, do you soon send an emissary to the high-souled Sugrīva, communicating to him 'Do you come here to enjoy festivities in the company of all those highly powerful monkeys and hears under you; may good betide you.

sn: बिभीषणश्च रक्षोभिः कामगैर्बहुभिर्वृतः। अश्वमेधं महायज्ञमायात्वतुलविक्रमः॥
en: See that Vibhīşaņa of unequalled prowess, the king of Räkşasas, encircled by his followers coursing at will, may be present at the horse sacrifice.

sn: राजानश्च महाभागा ये मे प्रियचिकीर्षवः। सानुगाः क्षिप्रमायान्तु यज्ञ भूमि निरीक्षकाः॥
en: Let the great kings, wishing my welfare with their followers be present at the sacrifice.

sn: देशान्तरगता ये च द्विजा धर्मसमाहिताः। आमन्त्रयस्व तान्सर्वानश्वमेधाय लक्ष्मण॥
en: O Laksmana, do you also invite carefully, for witnessing the ceremony, other pious foreign kings who are friendly to me.

sn: ऋषयश्च महाबाहो आहूयन्तां तपोधनाः। देशान्तरगताः सर्वे सदाराश्च द्विजातयः॥ तथैव तालावरास्तथैव नटनर्तकाः। यज्ञपाटश्च सुमहान्गोमत्या नैमिषे वने॥
en: O you having long arms, do you also invite the Rșis, having asceticism for their wealth and other pious Brāhmaṇas living in various provinces with their wives. Do you also invite actors and songsters. Do you order that a spacious, sacrificial ground may be made on the banks of the river Gomati in the Naimișa forest, O you having long arms, that part of the country is best suited and holy.

sn: आज्ञाप्यतां महाबाहो तद्धिपुण्यमनुत्तमम्। शान्तयश्च महाबाहो प्रवर्तन्तां समन्ततः॥ शतशश्चापि धर्मज्ञाः क्रतुमुख्यमनुत्तमम्। अनुभूय महायज्ञं नैमिषे रघुनन्दन ॥ तुष्टः पुष्टश्च सर्वोऽसौ मानितश्च यथाविधि। प्रतियास्यति धर्मज्ञ शीघ्रमामन्त्र्यतां जनः॥
en: And let ceremonies, invoking peace, be celebrated everywhere. O you conversant with piety, do you soon invite hundreds of subjects. so that they all, having witnessed the ceremony in the Naimiņa forest, may return delighted and honoured.

sn: शतं वाहसहस्राणां तण्डुलानां वपुष्मताम्। अयुतं तिलमुद्गस्य प्रयात्वग्रे महाबल॥ चणकानां कुलित्थानां माषाणां लवणस्य च। अतोऽनुरूपं स्नेहं च गन्धं संक्षिप्तमेव च॥ सुवर्णकोट्यो बहुला हिरण्यस्य शतोत्तराः। अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे समाधिना ॥
en: O you having long arms, let Bharata go before with a million of beasts carrying rice, sessamun seed, Kindney bean, Chickpea, pulse, Masha (a sort of Kindney bean) salt, oil, clarified butter and a hundred koti of silver and golden coins.

sn: अन्तरापणवीथ्यश्च सर्वे च नटनर्तकाः। सूदा नार्यश्च बहवो नित्यं यौवनशालिनः॥
en: Let merchants, to set up shops on the way, actors, dancers, cooks, and many youthful females follow Bharata.

sn: भरतेन तु साधं ते यान्तु सैन्यानि चाग्रतः। नैगमान्बालवृद्धांश्च द्विजांश्च सुसमाहिताः॥ कर्मान्तिकान्वर्धकिनः कोशाध्यक्षांश्च नैगमान्। मम मातृस्तथा सर्वाः कुमारन्तः पुराणि च ॥ काञ्चनीं मम पत्नी च दीक्षायां ज्ञांश्च कर्मणि। अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे महायशाः॥
en: Let soldiers go before him. And let the highly illustrious Bharata, with children, old men, Brahmanas, citizens, servants, cashiers, mothers, wives and the golden image of my wife to be initiated at the sacrifice, go before.

sn: उपकार्या महाश्चि पार्थिवानां महौजसाम्। सानुगानां नरश्रेष्ठ व्यादिदेश महाबलः॥ अन्नपानानि वस्त्राणि अनुगानां महात्मनाम्। भरतः स तदा यातः शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा॥
en: According to the command of Rāma, Bharata, with Śatrughna, made arrangements for highly valuable quarters, food, drink and clothes.

sn: वानराश्च महात्मानः सुग्रीवसहितास्तदा। विप्राणां प्रवराः सर्वे चक्रुश्च परिवेषणम्॥
en: And the highly powerful monkeys with Sugrīva and Brāhmaṇas engaged in the work of distribution.

sn: बिभीषणश्च रक्षोभिः स्त्रीभिश्च बहुभिर्वृतः। ऋषीणामुग्रतपसां पूजां चक्रे महात्मनाम्॥
en: And Vibhīşaņa, surrounded by various Räkşasas and females, engaged in the service of the high-souled Rsis intent on hard penances.

sn: तत्सर्वमखिलेनाशु प्रस्थाप्य भरताग्रजः। हयं लक्षणसंपन्नं कृष्णसारं मुमोच ह॥ ऋत्विग्भिर्लक्ष्मणं सार्धमश्वे च विनियुज्य च। ततोऽभ्यगच्छत्काकुत्स्थः सह सैन्येन नैमिषम्॥ यज्ञवाटं महाबाहुर्दृष्ट्वा परममद्भुतम्। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे श्रीमानिति च सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Having speedily despatched before all articles of sacrifice, Bharata's elder brother Rāma set free a black horse, gifted with all marks and worthy of the sacrifice and placed Lakşmaņa with Rtvik in charge of it. There upon the mighty-armed Kakuthstha, in the company of his soldiers, proceeded to the Naimiņa forest and beholding the wonderful sacrificial ground attained to an excess of delight and said:-It has become highly charming.

sn: नैमिषे वसतस्तस्य सर्व एव नराधिपाः। आनिन्युरुपहारांश्च तारामः प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: While he remained in the Naimisa forest, all the kings sent him presents and Rāma also made returns.

sn: अन्नपानादिवस्त्राणि सर्वोपकरणानि च। भरतः सह शत्रुघ्नो नियुक्तो राजपूजने॥
en: And diverse food, drink and clothes were offered to the kings when they arrived there with profuse presents. Bharata, with Satrughna, engaged in attending upon the kings.

sn: वानराश्च महात्मानः सुग्रीवसहितास्तदा। परिवेषणं च विप्राणां प्रयताः संप्रचक्रिरे॥
en: The high-souled monkeys, with Sugriva, being self-controlled engaged in attending upon the Brahmanas.

sn: बिभीषणश्च रक्षोभिर्बहुभिः सुसमाहितः। ऋषीणामुग्रतपसां किंकरः समपद्यत॥ उपकार्या महाश्चि पार्थिवानां महात्मनाम्। सानुगानां नरश्रेष्ठो व्यादिदेश महाबलः।।।।
en: Vibhīşaņa, in the company of many Rākşasas, with a collected mind, began to serve the Rşis, having asceticism for their wealth. And the highly powerful Răma, the foremost of men, set aside valuable houses for the accommodation of the high-souled kings.

sn: एवं सुविहितो यज्ञो ह्यश्वमेधो ह्यवर्तत। लक्ष्मणेन सुगुप्ता सा हयचर्या प्रवर्तत।९॥ ईदृशं राजसिंहस्य यज्ञप्रवरमुत्तमम्। नान्यः शब्दोऽभवत्तत्र हयमेधे महात्मनः॥ छन्दतो देहि विस्रब्धो यावत्तुष्यन्ति याचकाः। तावत्सर्वाणि दत्तानि क्रतुमुख्ये महात्मनः॥ विविधानि च गौडानि खाण्डवानि तथैव च।
en: Under these proper arrangements the horsesacrifice commenced. Lakşmaņa engaged in looking after the sacrificial horse. In this wise Rama, a lion among the kings, undertook the celebration of the horse-sacrifice. And in that Aśvamedha of Rama presents were given to people as long as they were not satisfied. There was no other sound audible at that time save that of 'Give! Give!!. In sooth at the horse-sacrifice of the high-souled Rāma, to their fullest satisfaction, sweets and other things were distributed to people.

sn: न निःसृतं भवत्योष्ठाद्वचनं यावदर्थिनाम्॥ तावद्वानररक्षोभिर्दत्तमेवाभ्यदृश्यत। न कश्चिन्मलिनो वापि दीनो वाप्यथवा कृशः॥ तस्मिन्यज्ञवरे राज्ञो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृते। ये च तत्र महात्मानो मुनयश्चिरजीविनः॥ नास्मरंस्तादृशं यज्ञं दानौघसमलंकृतम्।
en: Indeed before words came out from the lips of the beggars, monkeys and Rakşasas satisfied them with gifts. And all the ascetics living for ever and having asceticism for wealth that were present there, could not think of any other sacrifice, accompanied by so profuse presents, they had seen before.

sn: यः कृत्यवान्सुवर्णेन सुवर्णं लभते स्म सः॥ वित्तार्थी लभते वित्तं रत्नर्थी रत्नमेव च। हिरण्यानां सुवर्णानां रत्नानामथ वाससाम्॥ अनिशं दीयमानानां राशिः समुपदृश्यते। न शक्रस्य न सोमस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च ॥ ईदृशो दृष्टपूर्वो न एवमूचुस्तपोधनाः।
en: In that sacrifice, those, who wished for gold, obtained it, those who wished for property got it and those, who longed for jewels, received them. In this wise before all, enough of gold, jewels, and clothes were given away. The ascetics said:We have never seen before a sacrifice like this, Indra's, Soma's, Yama's or Varuna's.

sn: सर्वत्र वानरास्तस्थुः सर्वत्रैव च राक्षसाः॥ वासोधनान्नकामेभ्यः पूर्णहस्ता ददुर्भृशम्।
en: Being present everywhere the Rākşasas and Vänaras gave away enough of riches and clothes even to them who did not want.

sn: ईदृशो राजसिंहस्य यज्ञः सर्वगुणान्वितः। संवत्सरमथो साग्रं वर्तते न च हीयते॥
en: And though this sacrifice, gifted with all marks, of Rama, a lion among kings, continued for a year still his accumulated treasure was not exhausted, but rather was increased.

sn: वर्तमाने तथाभूते यज्ञे च परमाद्भुते। सशिष्य आजगामाशु वाल्मीकिर्भगवानृपिः॥
en: That sacrifice, the like of which was never seen before, having been undertaken the illustrious ascetic Valmiki, with his disciples, came there.

sn: स दृष्ट्वा दिव्यसंकाशं यज्ञमद्भुतदर्शनम्। एकान्त ऋषिसंवातश्चकार उटजाशुभान्॥
en: And beholding this wonderful sacrifice resembling that of the celestials, his followers, the Rşis, made charming cottages in a solitary corner and at no distance.

sn: शकटांश्च बहून्पूर्णान्फलमूलांश्च शोभनान्। वाल्मीकिवाटे रुचिरे स्थापयन्नविदूरतः॥
en: Inside the highly charming cottage of Vālmīki they placed his picturesque car full of various fruits and roots.

sn: स शिष्यावब्रवीद्धृष्टौ युवां गत्वा समाहितौ। कृत्स्नं रामायणं काव्यं गायतां परया मुदा॥ ऋषिवाटेषु पुण्येषु ब्राह्मणावसथेषु च। रथ्यासु राजमार्गेषु पार्थिवानां गृहेषु च॥ रामस्य भवनद्वारि यत्र कर्म च कुर्वते। ऋत्विजामग्रतश्चैव तत्र गेयं विशेषतः॥
en: There upon Vālmīki said to his disciples, Lava and Kuća Do you carefully and delightedly sing the whole of Rāmāyaṇa in the highly holy hermitages, of the Rşis, in the homes where perpetual fire is kept up by the Brāhmaṇas, in streets and palaces, at the gate of Rāma's house, in the sacrificial arena and before all Rtvik.

sn: इमानि च फलान्यत्र स्वादूनि विविधानि च। जातानि पर्वताग्रेषु आस्वाद्यास्वाद्य गायताम्॥
en: And eating all those sweet fruits that are on the summit of the mountain near our hermitage, do you engage in chanting the sweet Rāmāyaṇa.

sn: न यास्यथः श्रमं वत्सौ भक्षयित्वा फलान्यथ। मूलानि च सुमृष्टानि न रागात्परिहास्यथः॥
en: If your begin singing after taking all those sweet fruits you shall not experience exhaustion in singing nor you shall forget measure.

sn: यदि शब्दापयेद्रामः श्रवणाय महीपतिः। ऋषीणामुपविष्टानां यथायोगं प्रवर्तताम्॥
en: If Rāma, the lord of earth, invites you to sing the Rāmāyaṇa, you may fearlessly sing it there in due notes and measures before the assembled ascetics.

sn: दिवसे विंशतिः सर्गा गेया मधुरया गिरा। प्रमाणैर्बहुभिस्तत्र यथोद्दिष्टं मया पुरा ॥
en: During the day do you sing, in your sweet voice, twenty sections out of many I have laid in the Rāmāyaṇa consisting of many ślokas.

sn: लोभश्चापि न कर्तव्यः स्वल्पोऽपि धनवाञ्छया। किं धनेनाश्रमस्थानां फलमूलाशिनां सदा ॥
en: Do not cherish the least longing for riches. Of what avail is wealth to ascetics living perpetually on fruits and roots?

sn: यदि पृच्छेत्स काकुत्स्थो युवां कस्येति दारको। वाल्मीकेरथ शिष्यौ द्वौ ब्रूतमेवं नराधिपम् ॥
en: If Rāma asks you about your father you may say, We are both disciples of the high souled Valmiki.

sn: इमास्तन्त्रीः सुमधुराः स्थानं वापूर्वदर्शनम्। मूर्च्छयित्वा सुमधुरं गायतां विगतज्वरौ॥
en: O Kuśa and Lava, in your proper mood do you sing the sweet song with charming Murchanā accompanied by the sweet notes of Vīņā.

sn: आदिप्रभृति गेयं स्यान्न चावज्ञाय पार्थिवम्। पिता हि सर्वभूतानां राजा भवति धर्मतः॥
en: Before you begin with the song, without disregarding the king, do you bow to him reverentially. Morally the king is the father of all.

sn: तधुवां हृष्टमनसौ श्वः प्रभाते समाहितौ। गायतं मधुरं गेयं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम्॥
en: Do you therefore both, delightedly and with a collected mind, early in the morning, sing the theme in a sweet voice and accompanied by the music of the stringed instrument.

sn: इति संदिश्य बहुशो मुनिः प्राचेतसस्तदा। वाल्मीकिः परमोदारस्तूष्णीमासीन्महामुनिः॥
en: Having in this wise given counsels, the highly generous and great ascetic Vālmīki, son of Pracetā, became silent.

sn: संदिष्टौ मुनिना तेन तावुभौ मैथिलीसुतौ। तथैव करवावेति निर्जग्मतुररिंदमौ॥
en: Being thus commanded by the ascetic, Janakis' son, Lava and Kusa, the slayers of enemies, issued out there from saying. So we shall do."

sn: तामद्भुतां तौ हृदये कुमारी निवेश्य वाणीमृषिभाषितां तदा। समुत्सुकौ तौ सुखमूषतुर्निशां यथाश्विनौ भार्गवनीतिसंहिताम्॥
en: Like to the two Asvins following the moral precepts of Sukra, the two princes, placing those wonderful counsels of Vālmiki in their minds, spent the night with a heart stricken with curiosity.

sn: तौ रजन्यां प्रभातायां स्नातौ हुतहुताशनौ। यथोक्तमृषिणा पूर्व सर्वं तत्रोपगायताम्॥
en: There upon the night being over, having bathed and performed the Homa; both Lava and Kusa, in consonance with Rsi's command, began the song.

sn: तां स सुश्राव काकुत्स्थः पूर्वाचार्यविनिर्मिताम्। अपूर्वां पाठ्यजातिं च गेयेन समलंकृताम्॥ प्रमाणैर्बहुभिर्बद्धां तन्त्रीलयसमन्विताम् । बालाभ्यां राघवः श्रुत्वा कौतूहलपरोऽभवत्॥
en: That song was composed by the first preceptor (Vālmīki) never heard of before, consisting of sounds originating from six places, containing all metres, many proofs and set in accompaniment with the music of a stringed instrument. Hearing such a song from the boys Rāma was stricken with curiosity.

sn: अथ कर्मान्तरे राजा समाहूय महामुनीन्। पार्थिवाश्च नरव्याघ्रः पण्डितान्नैगमांस्तथा।।।। पौराणिकाशब्दविदो ये वृद्धाश्च द्विजातयः। स्वराणां लक्षणज्ञांश्च उत्सुकान्द्विजसत्तमान्॥ लक्षणज्ञांश्च गान्धर्वान्नैगमांश्च विशेषतः। पादाक्षरसमासज्ञांश्छन्दःसु परिनिष्ठितान्॥ कलामात्राविशेषज्ञाज्योतिषे च परं गतान्। क्रियाकल्पविदश्चैव तथा कार्यविशारदान्॥ हेतूपचारकुशलान्हैतुकांश्च बहुश्रुतान्। छन्दोविदः पुराणज्ञान्वैदिकान्द्विजसत्तमान्।।।। चित्रज्ञान्वृत्तसूत्रज्ञान्गीतनृत्यविशारदान्। एतान्सर्वान्समानीय गातारौ समवेशयत्॥
en: There upon taking leave from business for some time and inviting the great ascetic Vālmīki, kings, learned men, persons well-versed in Nyāya, Purāņas and science of words, all old men, twice-born ones those conversant with the signs of music, Brāhmaṇas desirous of hearing the Rāmāyaṇa, persons deep read in palmistry, Gandharvas, citizens, all those who have mastered the use of words, letters and Samāsas, those who have studied well metres, those well informed in the science of music, those wellversed in astronomy, those who are well up in the knowledge of rites and ceremonies, those expert in the despatch of business, logicians whose fame has spread far and wide, those wellversed in reasoning and arguments, poets, historians, Vedic Brahmanas, painters, and songsters Rāma requested Lava and Kusa lovingly to sing the song before the assembly.

sn: तेषां संवदतां तत्र श्रोतृणां हर्षवर्धनम्। गेयं प्रचक्रतुस्तत्र तावुभौ मुनिदारकौ॥ ततः प्रवृत्तं मधुरं गान्धर्वमतिमानुषम्। न च तृप्तिं ययुः सर्वे :श्रोतारो गेयसंपदा॥ हृष्टा मुनिगणाः सर्वे पार्थिवाश्च महौजसः। पिबन्त इव चक्षुभिः पश्यन्ति स्म मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: The audience being seated there and engaged in conversation with one another those two Muni boys began with the song enhancing the delight of all. Wondrous and charming was their song and the audience were not by any means satiated with the hearing thereof. Greatly delighted the highly effulgent ascetics and kings again and again looked towards them as if drinking them up with their eyes.

sn: ऊचुः परस्परं चेदं सर्व एव समाहिताः। उभौ रामस्य सदृशौ बिम्बाद्विम्बमिरोद्धतौ॥ जटिलौ यदि न स्यातां न वल्कलधरौ यदि। विशेष नाधिगच्छामो गायतो राघवस्य च॥ एवं प्रभाषमाणेषु पौरजानपदेषु च। प्रवृत्तमादितः पूर्वसर्ग नारददर्शितम्॥
en: And they all attentively said to one anotherBoth of them take after Rāma, like to a bubble resembling the one it rises from. There would not have been perceived the least difference between them and Rama had they not been clothed in dark and used clotted hair. The citizens and villagers speaking thus with one another Kuśa and Lava chanted twenty sections beginning from the first, pointed out by Narada.

sn: ततः प्रभृति साँश्च यावद्विशत्यगायताम्। ततोऽपराह्णसमये राघवः समभाषत॥ श्रुत्वा विंशतिसाँस्तान्भ्रातरं भ्रातृवत्सलः। अष्टादश सहस्राणि सुवर्णस्य महात्मनो॥
en: Having heard up to twentieth section, Răma, fond of his brother, said to Lakşmaņa in the afternoon, O Kakutstha, do you soon confer upon these two high-souled ones eighteen thousand gold coins and all other-things they wish for.

sn: प्रयच्छ शीघ्रं काकुत्स्थ यदन्यदभिकाङ्क्षितम्। ददौ न शीघ्र काकुत्स्थो बालयो( पृथक्पृथक् ।।१८ दीयमानं सुवर्णं तु नागृह्णीतां कुशीलवौ। ऊचतुश्च महात्मनौ किमनेनेति विस्मितौ॥ वन्येन फलमूलेन निरतौ वनवासिनौ। सुवर्णेन हिरण्येन किं करिष्यावहे वने॥
en: There upon when Lakşmaņa addressed himself in no time to give them gold coins separately Kuśa and Lava, not accepting them and surprisingly said. We are dwellers of a forest, living upon roots and fruits-what shall we do with them (coins)? Therefore living in the forest what shall we do with the gold?

sn: तथा तयोः प्रब्रुवतोः कौतूहलसमन्विताः। श्रोतारश्चैव रामश्च सर्व एव सुविस्मिताः॥ तस्य चैवागमं रामः काव्यस्य श्रोतुमुत्सुकः। पप्रच्छ तौ महातेजास्तावुभौ मुनिदारकौ॥
en: Hearing those words of them, Råma and the audience were greatly worked up with curiosity and surprise. There upon being anxious to learn of the origin of the poem, the highly effulgent Rāma asked the two Muni boys, saying. What is the proof of the story of this poem?

sn: किंप्रमाणमिदं काव्यं का प्रतिष्ठा महात्मनः। कर्ता काव्यस्य महतः क्व चासौ मुनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: How great is his fame who has composed it? What leading ascetic is the author of this great poem?

sn: पृच्छन्तं राघवं वाक्यमूचतुर्मुनिदारको। वाल्मीकिर्भगवान्कर्ता संप्राप्तो यज्ञसंविधम्। येनेदं चरितं तुभ्यमशेष संप्रदर्शितम्॥
en: Ráma having thus asked them those two Muni boys said: The illustrious Vālmīki is the author of this poem. He has described in this poem your endless story. He has of late come to your sacrifice.

sn: संनिबद्धं हि श्लोकानां चतुर्विंशत्सहस्रकम्। उपाख्यानशतं चैव भार्गवेण तपस्विना॥
en: The great ascetic Vālmīki has composed this poem consisting of a hundred stories and twenty four thousand slokas.

sn: आदिप्रभृति वै राजन्पञ्चसर्गशतानि च। काण्डानि षट् कृतानीह सोत्तराणि महात्मना ॥ कृतानि गुरुणास्माकमृषिणा चरितं तव। प्रतिष्ठा जीवितं यावत्तावत्सर्वस्य वर्तते॥
en: O king, that high-minded ascetic is our preceptor. He has described your actions in six books beginning with the first consisting of five hundred sections. All good actions performed by you since your birth have been recorded in this.

sn: यदि बुद्धिः कृता राजञ्छ्वणाय महारथ। कर्मान्तरे क्षणीभूतस्तच्छृणुष्व सहानुजः॥
en: O mighty car-warrior, o king, if you do wish to hear the whole of it, do you, at your leisure, hear it delightedly in the company of your younger brother.

sn: बाढमित्यब्रवीद्रामस्तौ चानुज्ञाप्य राघवौ। प्रहृष्टौ जग्मतुः स्थानं यत्रास्ते मुनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Saying 'so it shall be' Rama bade them adieu and they too, delighted, repaired to where Vālmīki, the foremost of Munis was.

sn: रामोऽपि मुनिभिः सार्धं पार्थिवैश्च महात्मभिः। श्रुत्वा तदीतिमाधुर्यं कर्मशालामुपागमत्॥
en: There upon having heard that charming song in the company of ascetics and kings the highminded Rāma repaired to the place of business.

sn: सुश्राव तचाललयोपपन्नं सर्गान्वितं सुस्वरशब्दयुक्तम्। तन्त्रीलयव्यञ्जनयोगयुक्तं कुशीलवाभ्यां परिगीयमानम्॥
en: He heard the Rāmāyaṇa sung by Kusa and Lava, gifted with musical characteristics, consisting of sections, vowels, and consonant and enchanted in accompaniment with the music of a stringed instrument.

sn: रामो बहून्यहान्येव तद्गीतं परमं शुभम्। शुश्राव मुनिभिः सार्धं पार्थिवैः सह वानरैः॥
en: Rāma heard that highly sacred theme for many long days in the company of ascetics, kings and Vänaras.

sn: तस्मिन्गीते तु विज्ञाय सीतापुत्रौ कुशीलवौ। तस्याः परिषदो मध्ये रामो वचनमब्रवीत्॥ दूताशुद्धसमाचारानाहूयात्ममनीषया। मद्वचो ब्रूत गच्छध्वमितो भगवतोऽन्तिके॥ यदि शुद्धसमाचारा यदि वा वीतकल्मषा। करोत्विहात्मनः शुद्धिमनुमान्य महामुनिम्॥
en: And understanding from the story that Kusa and Lava were Janaki's sons, Rāma mentioning her name said before the assembly:-Send a good emissary to the illustrious Vālmīki and let him communicate to the ascetics that if Janaki is sinless and has lead a pure life in the forest; let her give proof of purity by the great ascetic's permission.

sn: छन्दं मुनेश्च विज्ञाय सीतायाश्च मनोगतम्। प्रत्ययं दातुकामायास्ततः शंसत मे लघु॥
en: Let the emissaries learn well the intention of the ascetic in this and if Sītā is at heart willing to bring in proofs.

sn: श्वः प्रभाते तु शपथं मैथिली जनकात्मजा। करोतु परिषन्मध्ये शोधनार्थं ममैव च॥
en: To uphold her as well as mine purity, let Maithili, the daughter of Janaka, swear before the assembly in the morning of the next day.

sn: श्रुत्वा तु राघवस्यैतद्वचः परममद्भुतम्। दूताः संप्रययुर्बादं यत्र वै मुनिपुङ्गवः॥ ते प्रणम्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तममितप्रभम्। ऊचुस्ते रामवाक्यानि मृदूनि मधुराणि च।।।।।
en: Hearing the words of Rānia, messengers went to Vālmīki and saluting the high-souled (ascetic) burning in his effulgence and of incomparable lustre, communicated to him, in sweet words all what Rāma had said.

sn: तेषां तद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा रामस्य च मनोगतम्। विज्ञाय सुमहातेजा मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing the words of the messengers and understanding Rama's intention the ascetic said.

sn: एवं भवतु भद्रं वो यथा वदति राघवः। तथा करिष्यते सीता दैवतं हि पतिः स्त्रियः॥
en: What Räma has said shall be satisfied. May good betide you. Husband is the greatest god for women. So SIta shall carry out his behests.

sn: तथोक्ता मुनिना सर्वे राजदूता महौजसः। प्रत्येत्य राघवं सर्वं मुनिवाक्यं बभाषिरे॥
en: The great ascetic having said this, the highly powerful emissaries, approaching Rāma, communicated to him what the Muni had said.

sn: ततः प्रहृष्टः काकुत्स्थः श्रुत्वा वाक्यं महात्मनः। ऋषींस्तत्र समेतांश्च राज्ञश्चैवाभ्यभाषत॥
en: Hearing the words of the high-souled Valmiki, Rama was greatly delighted. Having addressed the assembled Rșis and kings he said.

sn: भगवन्तः सशिष्या वै सानुगाश्च नराधिपाः। पश्यन्तु सीताशपथं यश्चैवान्योऽपि काङ्क्षते।।१३
en: The Rșis with their disciples, and the kings with their followers and all others willing shall see Sitā swear here.

sn: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्य महात्मनः। सर्वेषामृषिमुख्यानां साधुवादो महानभूत्॥
en: Hearing the words of the high-souled Rāma, all the high-souled Rșis began to speak of him in high terms and said.

sn: राजानश्च महात्मानः प्रशंसन्ति स्म राघवम्। उपपन्नं नरश्रेष्ठ त्वय्येव भुवि नान्यतः॥
en: O foremost of men, such an action becomes you not any one else.

sn: एवं विनिश्चयं कृत्वा श्वोभूत इति राघवः। विसर्जयामास तदा सास्ताञ्छत्रुसूदनः॥
en: There upon having settled that Sītă would swear next day, Rāma, the slayer of enemies, dismissed them all.

sn: इति संप्रविचार्य राजसिंहः श्वोभूते शपथस्य निश्चयम्। विससर्ज मुनीनृपांश्च सर्वान् स महात्मा महतो महानुभावः॥
en: And having made arrangements that Sītā would go through the trial next day, the highminded, generous king Rama bade adieu to all kings and Rşis.

sn: तस्यां रजन्यां व्युष्टायां यज्ञवाटं गतो नृपः। ऋषीन्सर्वान्महातेजाः शब्दापयति राघवः॥ वसिष्ठो वामदेवश्च जाबालिरथ काश्यप। विश्वामित्रो दीर्घतमा दुर्वासाश्च महातपाः॥ पुलस्त्योऽपि तथा शक्तिर्भार्गश्चैव वामनः। मार्कण्डेयश्च दीर्घायुमौद्गल्यश्च महायशाः॥ गर्गश्च च्यवनश्चैव शतानन्दश्च धर्मवित्। भवद्वाजश्च तेजस्वी अग्निपुत्रश्च सुप्रभः॥ नारदः पर्वतश्चैव गौतमश्च महायशाः। एते चान्ये च बहवो मुनयः संशितव्रताः॥ कौतूहलसमाविष्टाः सर्व एव समागताः। राक्षसाश्च महावीर्या वानराश्च महाबलाः॥ सर्व एव समाजग्मुर्महात्मानः कुतूहलात्। क्षत्रिया ये च शूद्राश्च वैश्याश्चैव सहस्रशः।७।।
en: Next morning Råma, being present in the sacrificial ground and having sent for the Rşis, Vasiştha,-Vamadeva Jābāli, Kasyapa, Visvämitra, carrying on penances for a long time, Durvāsā, Pulastya of hard austerities, Śakti, Bhargava, Markandeya living long, the highly illustrious Maudgalya, Gargya, Gargya, Cyavana, Śatānanda, conversant with religions, effulgent Bharadvaja, Agni's son Vasuprava, Narada, Parvata, the great Gautama and other ascetics of firm vows, assembled with minds possessed by curiosity. The highly powerful Räkșasas and monkeys also came there out of curiosity.

sn: नानादेशगताश्चैव ब्राह्मणाः संशितव्रताः। सीताशपथवीक्षार्थ सर्व एव समागताः॥ तदा समागतं सर्वमश्मभूतमिवाचलम्। श्रुत्वा मुनिवरस्तूर्णं ससीतः समुपागमत्।९॥
en: Besides thousands and thousands of Kșatriyas, Vaiśyas, sadras and Brāhmaṇas of firm tenancies, also hailed there from various parts to witness Sita's trial. Having arrived there they all sat down motionless like mountains. There upon, Valmiki, the foremost of ascetics, speedily came there accompanied by Sitā.

sn: तमृर्षि पृष्ठतः सीता अन्वगच्छदवाङ्मुखी। कृताञ्जलिर्बाष्पकला कृत्वा रामं मनोगतम्॥ तां दृष्ट्वा श्रुतिमायान्ती ब्रह्माणमनुगामिनीम्। वाल्मीकेः पृष्ठतः सीतां साधुवादो महानभूत ।।११
en: With her face downwards, folded palms, eyes full of tears and meditating upon Råma in her mind, Sita, following the Rsis, came before the assembly. There arose a great uproar of eulogy from the assembly when they saw Sità following Vālmīki like to the Śruti following Brahmā.

sn: ततो हलहलाशब्दः सर्वेषामेवमाबभौ। दुःखजन्मविशालेन शोकेनाकुलितात्मनाम् ॥ साधु रामेति केचित्तु साधु सीतेति चापरे। उभावेव च तत्रान्ये प्रेक्षकाः संप्रचुक्रुशुः॥
en: There upon members, stricken with sorrow, made a tumultuous sound. Among the visitors some praised Rāma, some praised $ītā and others eulogised both of them.

sn: ततो मध्ये जनौघस्य प्रविश्य मुनिपुङ्गवः। सीतासहायो वाल्मीकिरिति होवाच राघवम्॥ इयं दाशरथे सीता सुव्रता धर्मचारिणी। अपवादात्परित्यक्ता ममाश्रमसमीपतः॥
en: There upon having entered that huge assemblage in company of Sītā, the great ascetic Valmiki addressed Rāma, saying: O son of Dasaratha, in fear of calumny, you did renounce her near my hermitage, albeit Sitā is pure and follows the ways of morality.

sn: लोकापवादभीतस्य तव राम महाव्रत। प्रत्ययं दास्यते सीता तामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥
en: O Rāma of firm vows, you are afraid of the censure of the people. Sitā has becoming willing to give testimony (of her purity) for removing the calumny of the public; do you mercifully give her permission in this.

sn: इमौ तु जानकीपुत्रावुभौ च यमजातको। सुतौ तवैव दुर्धर्षों सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते॥ प्रचेतसोऽहं दशमः पुत्रो राघवनन्दन। न स्मराम्यनृतं वाक्यमिमौ तु तव पुत्रकौ॥
en: I tell you the truth, O Råma, that these irrepressible twin brothers are your sons, O descendant of Raghu. I am the tenth son of Pracetā, so, far from speaking untruth it does not even spring up in my mind. I therefore know the truth that these twins are your sons.

sn: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि तपश्चर्या मया कृता। नोपाश्नीयां फलं तस्या दुष्टेयं यदि मैथिली॥
en: I have performed austere penances for many thousand years; I now swear before you, that if this Maithili is found touched by any sin I shall not reap the fruit of my ascetic observances extending over many thousand years.

sn: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा भूतपूर्वं न किल्बिषम्। तस्याहं फलमश्नामि अपापा मैथिली यदि॥
en: I have never perpetrated before a crime either, in my mind, body, or speech. If Maithili is found divested of sin I may then partake of the fruits of piety.

sn: अहं पञ्चसु भूतेषु मनःषष्ठेषु राघव। विचिन्त्य सीता शुद्धति जग्राह वननिझरे॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, finding Sitä pure in mind and five elements of body I took her near the spring in the forest.

sn: इयं शुद्धसमाचारा अपापा पतिदेवता। लोकापवादभीतस्य प्रत्ययं तव दास्यति॥
en: Besides this Sitā, of pure ways, divested of sins and ever considering her husband as deity, shall give testimony this day.

sn: तस्मादियं नरवात्मज शुद्धभावा दिव्येन दृष्टिविषयेण मया प्रदिष्टा। लोकापवादकलुषीकृतचेतसा या त्यक्ता त्वया प्रियतमा विदितापि शुद्धा॥
en: You have been afraid of the public calumny. O son of a king, your mind being possessed by the fear of public scandal regarding her husband as a god; I came to know this by virtue of my discriminative knowledge.

sn: वाल्मीकिनैवमुक्तस्तु राघवः प्रत्यभाषत। प्राञ्जलिर्जगतो मध्ये दृष्ट्वा तां वरवर्णिनीम्॥
en: After the great Rșis Vālmīki had said this, Rāma, on beholding the daughter of Janaka resembling a celestial, in the midst of the assembly, with folded hands, said.

sn: एवमेतन्महाभाग यथा वदसि धर्मवित्। प्रत्ययस्तु मम ब्रह्मस्तव वाक्यैरकल्मषैः॥
en: O great one, you are conversant with piety. By your words shorn of sin, I have been convinced that Janaki is of pure ways. Still, O Brāhmaṇa, what you have commanded shall be carried out; let Sītā produce testimony of the purity of her character.

sn: प्रत्ययश्च पुरा वृत्तो वैदेह्याः सुरसंनिधौ। शपथश्च कृतस्तत्र तेन वेश्म प्रवेशिता ॥
en: Because Vaidehi formerly underwent a trial in the city of Lankā before the celestials I brought her home.

sn: लोकापवादो बलवान्येन त्यक्ता हि मैथिली। सेयं लोकभयाद्ब्रह्मनपापेत्यभिजानता। परित्यक्ता मया सीता तद्भवान्क्षन्तुमर्हति ॥
en: O Brāhmaṇa, vilification of the people is very powerful. Although I know that Jānaki has not been touched by any sin still I have renounced her. Do you therefore forgive me.

sn: जानामि चेमौ पुत्रौ मे यमजातौ कुशीलवौ। शुद्धायां जगतो मध्ये मैथिल्यां प्रीतिरस्तु मे॥
en: I know that these twin brothers Kusa and Lava are my sons. Yet if Janaki gives evidence of her own purity before the assembly I shall be greatly satisfied.

sn: अभिप्रायं तु विज्ञाय रामस्य सुरसत्तमाः। सीतायाः शपथे तस्मिन्सर्व एव समागताः॥
en: Being apprised of Rama's intention as to Sītā's trial the celestials all came there on the occasion.

sn: पितामहं पुरस्कृत्य सर्व एव समागताः। आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा विश्वेदेवा मरुद्गणाः॥ साध्याश्च देवाः सर्वे ते सर्वे च परमर्षयः। नागाः सुपर्णाः सिद्धाश्च ते सर्वे हृष्टमानसाः।।।।।
en: The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Visvadeva, Maruts, Sadhyas, Siddhas, Nagas, and Rsis placing Brahmā before them, all came there.

sn: दृष्ट्वा देवानृषींश्चैव राघवः पुनरब्रवीत्। प्रत्ययो मे नरश्रेष्ठ ऋषिवाक्यैरकल्मषैः।।।।। शुद्धायां जगतो मध्ये वैदेह्यां प्रीतिरस्तु मे। सीताशपथसंभ्रान्ताः सर्व एव समागताः॥
en: And beholding the celestials and Rșis assembled there Rama again said to Vālmīki:-O foremost of Munis, the words, of the highsouled Rsis, are divested of sin; therefore on your words only I shall consider Sītā as having pure ways. Still all have come here being anxious to witness Sītā's trial. I shall therefore be greatly delighted if Janaki gives in before them any testimony of her pure character.

sn: ततो वायुः शुभः पुण्यो दिव्यगन्धो मनोरमः। तं जनौघं सुरश्रेष्ठो ह्रादयामास सर्वतः॥ तद्भुतमिवाचिन्त्यं निरैक्षन्त समाहिताः। मानवाः सर्वराष्ट्रेभ्यः पूर्वं कृतयुगे यथा॥
en: As soon as those words were uttered, sweet, fragrant, cold air, the witness of virtue and vice, blowing mildly, excited the joy of the assembly. People, hailing from various countries, with all attention began to witness this wondrous and unthought of event. In the golden age only the celestial wind used to blow, and it now blew even in the Tretā Yuga and forsooth it was a matter of exceeding surprise.

sn: सर्वान्समागतान्दृष्ट्वा सीता काषायवासिनी। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमधोदृष्टिरवाङ्मुखी॥
en: There upon beholding all people assembled there, Janaka's daughter, wearing a red cloth, with her face and looks downwards and folded palms said.

sn: यथाहं राघवादन्यं मनसापि न चिन्तये। तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति ॥
en: I have never thought of any other person in my mind but Rāma; by the strength of this virtue let the goddess Vasundharā give me room.

sn: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा यथा रामं समर्चये। तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति॥
en: I have always with my mind, body and words prayed for Rāma's well-being and by virtue hereof may the goddess Vasundhară give me room in her womb.

sn: यथैतत्सत्यमुक्तं मे वेद्मि रामात्परं न च। तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति॥
en: I have never thought for other than Răma. If it is true, may the goddess Vasundhară give me room in her womb.

sn: तथा शपन्त्यां वैदेह्या प्रादुरासीत्तदद्भुतम्। भूतलादुत्थितं दिव्यं सिंहासनमनुत्तमम्॥
en: As soon as Sītā swore in this wise a wonderful incident took place. From inside the earth a celestial and excellent throne rose up.

sn: ध्रियमाणं शिरोभिस्तु नागैरमितविक्रमैः। दिव्यं दिव्येन वपुषा दिव्यरत्नविभूषितैः॥
en: It was carried on head by the Nāgas of unmitigated prowess, having celestial persons and adorned with celestial jewels and ornaments.

sn: तस्मिंस्तु धरणी देवी बाहुभ्यां गृह्य मैथिलीम्। स्वागतेनाभिनन्द्यैनामासने चोपवेशयत्॥
en: Having stretched out her arms and taken Maithilī, the goddess earth welcomed her and placed her on the throne.

sn: तामासनगतां दृष्ट्वा प्रविशन्ती रसातलम्। पुष्पवृष्टिरविच्छिन्ना दिव्या सीतामवाकिरत्॥
en: And while seated on the throne she was entering the earth, she was covered with the continued showers of celestial flowers.

sn: साधुकारश्च सुमहान्देवानां सहसोत्थितः। साधुसाध्विति वै सीते यस्यास्ते शीलमीदृशम्।।२१ एवं बहुविधा वाचो ह्यन्तरिक्षगताः सुराः। व्याजहुर्राष्टमनसो दृष्ट्वा सीताप्रवेशनम्॥
en: Eulogising her at that time, the celestials said: Oh! highly praiseworthy is your conduct, O Sītā. Being present in the welkin and beholding Sītā enter into the Earth, the celestials again and again eulogised her in various words.

sn: यज्ञवाटगताश्चापि मुनयः सर्व एव ते। राजानश्च नरव्याघ्रा विस्मयानोपरेमिरे॥
en: The Rşis, kings and other leading men present in the sacrificial arena repeatedly expressed their surprise.

sn: अन्तरिक्षे च भूमौ च सर्वे स्थावरजङ्गमाः। दानवाश्च महाकायाः पाताले पनगाधिपाः॥
en: Beholding Sita's censure thus removed all animals, animate or inanimate, either on earth or in the sky, were greatly delighted.

sn: केचिद्विनेदुः संहृष्टाः केचिद्ध्यानपरायणाः। केचिद्रामं निरीक्षन्ते केचित्सीतामचेतसः॥
en: Some cried aloud in joy, some remained silent, and some motionless espied Rāma or Sītā.

sn: सीताप्रवेशनं दृष्ट्वा तेषामासीत्समागमः। तन्मुहूर्तमिवात्यर्थं समं संमोहितं जगत्॥
en: In this wise beholding Sītā's entrance into the Earth the ascetics were greatly delighted. They all attaining to the same state of mind, the whole universe, for a moment, was possessed with the state of equality.

sn: रसातलं प्रविष्टायां वैदेह्यां सर्ववानराः। चुक्रुशुः साधुसाध्वीति मुनयो रामसंनिधौ॥
en: Sītā having entered Rasātala, all the monkeys and Rșis repeatedly eulogised her before Rāma.

sn: दण्डकाष्ठमवष्टभ्य बाष्पव्याकुलितेक्षणः। अवाक्शिरा दीनमना रामो ह्यासीत्सुदुःखितः॥
en: Stricken with sorrow and grief and lowering down his head, Rāma, with eyes full of fears, face downwards, and a dejected mind, sat down.

sn: स रुदित्वा चिरं कालं बहुशो बाष्पमुत्सृजन्। क्रोधशोकसमाविष्टो रामो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: And being possessed by grief and anger and shedding tears he wept for some time and ther said.

sn: अभूतपूर्वं शोकं मे मनः स्पष्टुमिवेच्छति। पश्यतो मे यथा नष्टा सीता श्रीरिव रूपिणी॥
en: My mind is about to be possessed by grief, which I had never experienced before, for in the very presence of mine the graceful Jānaki, like Lakşmī herself, has disappeared from view.

sn: सादर्शनं पुरा सीता लङ्का पारे महोदधेः। ततश्चापि मयानीता किं पुनर्वसुधातलात्॥
en: Formerly, in my absence, Janaki was once carried away into the city her back; what wonder it is that I shall get her back from Pātāla?

sn: वसुधे देवि भवति सीता निर्यात्यतां मम। दर्शयिष्यामि वा रोषं यथा मामवगच्छसि॥
en: O goddess Vasudhā, do you soon bring Sità in my vies, or else, worked up with ire I shall give you the fruits of your negligence.

sn: कामं श्वश्रूर्ममैव त्वं त्वत्सकाशात्तु मैथिली। कर्षता फालहस्तेन जनकेनोद्धृता पुरा ।७।।
en: You are my mother-in-law, since the royal saint Janaka obtained Sītā from your womb while cultivating you with plough share.

sn: तस्मानिर्यात्यतां सीता विवरं वा प्रयच्छ मे। पाताले नाकपृष्ठे वा वसेयं सहितस्तया॥
en: Do you therefore bring back my Sītā or give me a region of the celestials, I wish to live with Sītā in nether world or heaven.

sn: आनय त्वं हि तां सीतां मत्तोऽहं मैथिलीकृते। न मे दास्यसि चेत्सीतां यथारूपां महीतले।।९ सपर्वतवनां कृत्स्नां व्यथयिष्यामि ते स्थितिम्। नाशयिष्याम्यहं भूमिं सर्वमापो भवन्त्विह॥
en: I am beside myself for her; do you therefore bring back Sita. If you do not render back Sītā to me O Vasudha, I shall deluge the earth with Waters, having assailed, destroyed and drowned into water your huge compass with mountains and forests.

sn: एवं ब्रुवाणे काकुत्स्थे क्रोधशोकसमन्विते। ब्रह्मा सुरगणैः सार्धमुवाच रघुनन्दनम्॥
en: Rāma, having given vent to those accents under the influence of ire, the patriarch Brahmā, with the consent of the celestials, said.

sn: राम राम न संतापं कर्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत। स्मर त्वं पूर्वकं भावं मन्त्रं चामित्रकर्शन॥
en: O Rāma of firm vows, O slayer of enemies, you should not grieve thus, Recollect your former state of Vişņu and the counsels.

sn: न खलु त्वां महाबाहो स्मारयेयमनुत्तमम्। इमं मुहूर्त दुर्धर्ष स्मर त्वं जन्म वैष्णवम् ॥
en: I would not have reminded you of this secret but for the present necessity. Do you now once more remember your birth from Vişnu.

sn: सीता हि विमला साध्वी तव पूर्वपरायणा। नागलोकं सुखं प्रायात्त्वदाश्रयतपोबलात्॥
en: By nature, Sītā is pure, chaste and ever dependent upon you. And by virtue of her ascetic dependence upon you she has gone to the region of Nagas.

sn: स्वर्गे ते संगमो भूयो भविष्यति न संशयः। अस्यास्तु परिषन्मध्ये यद्ब्रवीमि निबोध तत्॥
en: You shall again meet her in heaven. Hear, what I communicate to you before the assembly.

sn: एतदेव हि काव्यं ते काव्यानामुत्तमं श्रुतम्। सर्व विस्तरतो राम व्याख्यास्यति न संशयः॥
en: You shall be informed of everything by listening to this excellent poem describing your own actions.

sn: जन्मप्रभृति ते वीर सुखदुःखोपसेवनम्। भविष्यदुत्तरं चेह सर्वं वाल्मीकिना कृतम्॥
en: O hero, Vālmīki had described herein all miseries and joys you have experienced since your birth and what shall happen in future after SIta's entrance into Patala.

sn: आदिकाव्यमिदं राम त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्। नह्यन्योऽर्हति काव्यानां यशोभाग्राघवादृते॥
en: O Rāma, this first epic poem, Rāmāyaṇa, has been composed describing your works. None but you is worthy of the fame of this poem.

sn: श्रुतं ते पूर्वमेतद्धिमया सर्वं सुरैः सह। दिव्यमद्भुतरूपं च सत्यवाक्यमनावृतम्॥
en: Even before you I have heard this complete poem with gods, which is wonderful, truthful and unveiled.

sn: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल धर्मेण सुसमाहितः। शेषं भविष्यं काकुत्स्थ काव्यं रामायणं शृणु।२०
en: O lion among the men, Odescended of Raghu, you may hear the remaining portion of Rāmāyaṇa epic with religious mind.

sn: उत्तरं नाम काव्यस्य शेषमत्र महायशः। तच्छृणुष्व महातेज ऋषिभिः सार्धमुत्तमम्॥ न खल्वन्येन काकुत्स्थ श्रोतव्यमिदमुत्तमम्। परमऋषिणा वीर त्वयैव रघुनन्दन॥
en: O Rāghava, O highly illustrious one, do you hear with the Rsis, Uttarakandam, the last portion of this poem. O descendant of Raghu, this is not worthy of being heard by any but those who are the foremost of the royal saints.

sn: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं ब्रह्मा त्रिभुवनेश्वरः। जगाम त्रिदिवं देवो देवैः सह सबान्धवैः॥ ये च तत्र महात्मान ऋषयो ब्राह्मलौकिकाः। ब्रह्मणा समनुज्ञाता न्यवर्तन्त महौजसः॥ उत्तरं श्रोतुमनसो भविष्यं यच्च राघवे।
en: Having said this, the deity Brahmă, the lord of the three worlds, with other deities, repaired to the region of immortals. The high-souled and the highly effulgent ascetics, living in Brahma's region, who were present in the assembly, obtaining Brahma's permission, waited there, to hear Rama's future career in the Uttarakandam.

sn: ततो रामः शुभां वाणी देवदेवस्य भाषिताम्॥ श्रुत्वा परमतेजस्वी वाल्मीकिमिदमब्रवीत्। भगवश्रोतुमनस ऋषयो ब्राह्मलौकिकाः॥ भविष्यदुत्तरं यन्मे श्वोभूते संप्रवर्तताम्।
en: Hearing the words of the great Patriarch instinct with well-being, the highly effulgent Rāma said to Vālmīki. O illustrious sir, the Rşis living in Brahmă's region have grown desirous of hearing my future history. So let it be taken up next morning.

sn: एवं विनिश्चयं कृत्वा संप्रगृह्य कुशीलवौ॥ तं जनौघं विसृज्याथ पर्णशालामुपागमत्। तामेव शोचतः सीतां सा व्यतीता च शर्वरी॥
en: Having thus settled and taken with him Kuća and Lava and sent away the assembled people he entered his palace and spent the night mourning for Sită.

sn: रजन्यां तु प्रभातायं समानीय महामुनीन्। गीयतामविशङ्काभ्यां रामः पुत्रावुवाच ह॥
en: The night being over and having invited the leading ascetics, Rāma told his sons to sing the poem fearlessly.

sn: ततः समुपविष्टेषु महर्षिषु महात्मसु। भविष्यदुत्तरं काव्यं जगतुस्तौ कुशीलवौ॥
en: There upon the high-souled Rșis having taken their seats Kusa and Lava began the last portion of the Uttarakāņdam.

sn: प्रविष्टायां तु सीतायां भूतलं सत्यसंपदा। तस्यावसाने यज्ञस्य रामः परमदुर्मनाः॥
en: Sītā having entered Pātāla by the strength of her vow, and the sacrifice having terminated, Rāma grew poorly in spirit.

sn: अपश्यमानो वैदेहीं मेने शून्यमिदं जगत्। शोकेन परमायस्तो न शान्ति मनसागमत्॥
en: In Janaki's absence the whuic orld appeared to him as blank. Now being overwhelmed with grief he lost all mental peace.

sn: विसृज्य पार्थिवान्सर्वानृक्षवानरराक्षसान्। जनौघं विप्रमुख्यानां वित्तपूर्वं विसृज्य च॥ ततो विसृज्य तान्सर्वान्रामो राजीवलोचनः। हृदि कृत्वा सदा सीतामयोध्यां प्रविवेश ह॥
en: Having conferred various gifts upon the kings, Rākşasas, monkeys and leading Brāhmaṇas, Räma sent them away and meditating upon Sītā's absence entered Ayodhyā.

sn: न सीतायाः परां भार्यां ववे स रघुनन्दनः। यज्ञे यज्ञे च पल्यर्थं जानकी काञ्चनीभवत्॥
en: And from the time of Sita's entering into Pātāla he did not take any other spouse. And having made a golden image of Sītā he engage in the performance of various sacrifices.

sn: दशवर्षसहस्राणि वाजिमेधानथाकरोत्। वाजपेयान्दशगुणांस्तथा बहुसुवर्णकान्।।।। अग्निष्टोमातिरावाभ्यां गोसवैश्च महाधनैः। ईजे क्रतुभिरन्यैश्च स श्रीमानाप्तदक्षिणैः॥
en: In this wise for thousand years he celebrated many Horse-sacrifices, many Vajapeyas with profuse gold, Agnistomas, Atiratras, numberless Gomedhas and various other sacrifices.

sn: एवं स कालः सुमहानराज्यस्थस्य महात्मनः। धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य व्यतीयाद्राघवस्य च ॥
en: Rāma being engaged in governing the kingdom and performing many pious rites long time passed away.

sn: ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि स्थिता रामस्य शासने। अनुरञ्जन्ति राजानो ह्यहन्यहनि राघवम्॥
en: And being under his subjection, bears monkeys, Raksasa and kings always afforded delight to him.

sn: काले वर्षति पर्जन्यः सुभिक्षं विमला दिशः। हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णं पुरं जनपदास्तथा॥
en: On account of showers in proper time there was enough of food in his kingdom. The quarters were pure and delightful. The citizens and villagers were happy and healthy.

sn: नाकाले म्रियते कश्चिन्न व्याधिः प्राणिनां तथा। नानर्थो विद्यते कश्चिद्रामे राज्यं प्रशासति॥
en: None met with premature death. In fact, in his regime all calamities were removed.

sn: अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य राममाता यशस्विनी। पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृता कालधर्ममुपागमत्॥
en: There upon after many years, the illustrious, Kausalyā, Rāma's mother, surrounded by her sons and grand-sons, breathed her last.

sn: अन्वियाय सुमित्रा च कैकेयी च यशस्विनी। धर्मं कृत्वा बहुविधं त्रिदिवे पर्यवस्थिता॥ सर्वाः प्रमुदिताः स्वर्गे राज्ञा दशरथेन च। समागता महाभागाः सर्वधर्म च लेभिरे॥
en: Performing many pious observances Kaikayi followed her and obtained peace in the land of immortals. Those noble ladies, being united with the king Dasaratha, in heaven, were greatly delighted and obtained all virtues.

sn: तासां रामो महादानं काले काले प्रयच्छति। मातृणामविशेषेण ब्राह्मणेषु तपस्विषु॥ पित्र्याणि ब्रह्मरत्नानि यज्ञान्परमदुस्तरान्। चकार रामो धर्मात्मा पितृन्देवान्विवर्धयन्॥
en: Besides, having worshipped the deities and manes on the occasion of his father's Śrădha ceremony the high-souled Rāma distributed many jewels and engaged in the performance of a very difficult sacrifice.

sn: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि बहून्यथ ययुः सुखम्। यज्ञैर्बहुविधं धर्म वर्धयानस्य सर्वदा॥
en: In this wise having performed many sacrifices and multiplied pieties he spent many thousand years in happiness.

sn: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य युधाजित्केकयो नृपः। स्वगुरुं प्रेषयामास राघवाय महात्मने॥ गाय॑मङ्गिरसः पुत्रं ब्रह्मर्षिममितप्रभम्। दश चाश्वसहस्राणि प्रीतिदानमनुत्तमम्॥ कम्बलानि च रत्नानि चित्रवस्त्रमथोत्तमम्। रामाय प्रददौ राजा शुभान्याभरणानि च॥
en: Once on a time Yudhajit, the king of Kekaya, sent to the high-souled Rāma, Gārgya— son of his own preceptor Angiras-a Brāhmaṇa saint of unmitigated prowess; and with him he sent, as tokens of affections, gifts of ten thousand horses, numberless blankets various jewels, diverse clothes and well washed coverlets.

sn: श्रुत्वा तु राघवो धीमान्महर्षि गार्यमागतम्। मातुलस्याश्वपतिनः प्रहितं तन्महाधनम्॥ प्रत्युद्गम्य च काकुत्स्थः क्रोशमा सहानुजः। गायं संपूजयामास यथा शक्रो बृहस्पतिम् ॥
en: Hearing of the arrival of the great saint Gārgya with above valuable presents sent by his maternal uncle Yudhājit, the intelligent Rāma, with his brothers, proceeded about a Krosa to receive him and adored him particularly likely to the lord of celestials honouring Bịhaspati.

sn: तथा संपूज्य तमृर्षि तद्धनं प्रतिगृह्य च। पृष्ट्वा प्रतिपदं सर्वं कुशलं मातुलस्य च॥ उपविष्टं महाभागं रामः प्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे। किमाह मातुलो वाक्यं यदर्थ भगवानिह ॥ प्राप्तो वाक्यविदां श्रेष्ठः साक्षादिव बृहस्पतिः।
en: Having thus welcomed that foremost of Rșis and accepted the valuable presents sent by his maternal uncle he asked the ascetic about his welfare in every thing. There upon the great Rșis being seated, he said. You are the foremost of those skilled in the are of speech like the very preceptor of the celestials. Since your own self has here My uncle must have commissioned you with a very important message.

sn: रामस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा महर्षिः कार्यविस्तरम्।।।।। वक्तुमद्भुतसंकाशं राघवायोपचक्रमे। मातुलस्ते महाबाहो वाक्यमाह नरर्षभः॥ युधाजित्प्रीतिसंयुक्तं श्रूयतां यदि रोचते।
en: Hearing those words of Rāma the great saint communicated to him the object of his coming, saying. O you having long arms, if you do like, hear what loving words your maternal uncle Yudhājit, the foremost of men, has said.

sn: अयं गन्धर्वविषयः फलमूलोपशोधितः॥ सिन्धोरुभयतः पार्श्वे देशः परमशोभनः। तं च रक्षन्ति गन्धर्वाः सायुधा युद्धकोविदाः॥ शैलूषस्य सुता वीर तिस्रः कोट्यो महाबलाः।
en: The Gandharvas, holding weapons and expert in warfare, guard that beautiful province abounding in fruits and roots on the banks of the come river Sindhu. O hero, those Gandharvas are highly powerful and three kotis in number.

sn: तान्विनिर्जित्य काकुत्स्थ गन्धर्वनगरं शुभम्॥ निवेशय महाबाहो स्वे पुरे सुसमाहिते। अन्यस्य न गतिस्तत्र देशः परमशोभनः। रोचतां ते महाबाहो नाहं त्वामहितं वदे॥
en: Having hoisted your flag of victory and conquered that highly picturesque city of Gandharvas do you include that kingdom within your well-established territories. None can enter there. O you having long arms, I do not request you for any harm of you. Let that highly charming country be liked by you.

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवः प्रीतो महर्षेर्मातुलस्य च। उवाच बाढमित्येव भरतं चान्ववैक्षत॥
en: Hearing the words of the maternal uncle communicated by the great saint, Rāma, with delight, said.

sn: सोऽब्रवीद्राघवः प्रीतः साञ्जलिप्रग्रहो द्विजम्। इमौ कुमारौ तं देशं ब्रह्मर्षे विचरिष्यतः॥ भरतस्यात्मजौ वीरौ तक्षः पुष्कल एव च। मातुलेन सुगुप्तौ तु धर्मेण सुसमाहितौ॥ भरतं चाग्रतः कृत्वा कुमारौ सबलानुगौ। निहत्य गन्धर्वसुतान्द्वे पुरे विभजिष्यतः॥
en: What you have commanded shall be satisfied. Saying this he looked towards Bharata and delightedly and with folded hands said to the Rsis. O Brahmarsi, these two princes are Bharata's sons and their names are Takșa and Puşkala. Being well protected by uncle Yudhājit and preceded by Bharata with army and followers they shall subjugate the Gandharvas and divide the kingdom between them.

sn: निवेश्य ते पुरवरे आत्मजौ संनिवेश्य च। आगमिष्यति मे भूयः सकाशमतिधार्मिकः॥
en: Having established two kingdoms and installed his two sons there Bharata, the foremost of the pious, shall come back to me.

sn: ब्रह्मर्षिमेवमुक्त्वा तु भरतं सबलानुगम्। आज्ञापयामास तदा कुमारौ चाभ्यषेचयत्॥
en: Having thus said to the Brahmarși, Rāma commanded Bharata and welcomed the two princes.

sn: नक्षत्रेण च सौम्येन पुरस्कृत्याङ्गिरःसुतम्। भरतः सह सैन्येन कुमाराभ्यां विनिर्ययौ॥
en: There upon under the auspices of favourable stars, having placed Gargya, son of Aigiras before them, Bharata with the princes and army issued out of the city of Ayodhyā.

sn: सा सेना शक्रयुक्तेव नगरानिर्ययावथ।। राघवानुगता दूरं दुराधर्षा सुरैरपि॥
en: Răma's army unconquerable even by the celestials went out from the city like a celestial host under the command of Indra.

sn: मांसाशिनश्च ये सत्त्वा रक्षांसि सुमहान्ति च। अनुजग्मुर्हि भरतं रुधिरस्य पिपासया॥ भूतग्रामाश्च बहवो मांसभक्षाः सुदारुणाः। गन्धर्वपुत्रमांसानि भोक्तुकामाः सहस्रशः॥
en: Animals, living upon flesh and huge-bodied Rākşasas longing for blood and many terrible and dreadful carnivorous creatures followed Bharata wishing the flesh of Gandharvas.

sn: सिंहव्याघ्रवराहाणां खेचराणां च पक्षिणाम्। बहूनि वै सहस्राणि सेनाया ययुरग्रतः॥
en: Besides many thousand birds, moving in the sky, lions, tigers and boars went before the army.

sn: अध्यर्धमासमुषिता पथि सेना निरामया। हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णा केकयं समुपागमत्॥
en: The army, consisting of delighted and healthy subjects spending half a month in the way, arrived at the Kekaya kingdom in good health. commanded Bharata and welcomed the two princes.

sn: नक्षत्रेण च सौम्येन पुरस्कृत्याङ्गिरःसुतम्। भरतः सह सैन्येन कुमाराभ्यां विनिर्ययौ॥
en: There upon under the auspices of favourable stars, having placed Gargya, son of Aigiras before them, Bharata with the princes and army issued out of the city of Ayodhyā.

en: Răma's army unconquerable even by the celestials went out from the city like a celestial host under the command of Indra.

sn: मांसाशिनश्च ये सत्त्वा रक्षांसि सुमहान्ति च। अनुजग्मुर्हि भरतं रुधिरस्य पिपासया॥ भूतग्रामाश्च बहवो मांसभक्षाः सुदारुणाः। गन्धर्वपुत्रमांसानि भोक्तुकामाः सहस्रशः॥
en: Animals, living upon flesh and huge-bodied Rākşasas longing for blood and many terrible and dreadful carnivorous creatures followed Bharata wishing the flesh of Gandharvas.

sn: सिंहव्याघ्रवराहाणां खेचराणां च पक्षिणाम्। बहूनि वै सहस्राणि सेनाया ययुरग्रतः॥
en: Besides many thousand birds, moving in the sky, lions, tigers and boars went before the army.

sn: अध्यर्धमासमुषिता पथि सेना निरामया। हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णा केकयं समुपागमत्॥
en: The army, consisting of delighted and healthy subjects spending half a month in the way, arrived at the Kekaya kingdom in good health.

sn: श्रुत्वा सेनापति प्राप्तं भरतं केकयाधिपः। युधाजिद्गर्गसहितं परां प्रीतिमुपागमत्॥
en: Hearing of the arrival of the Bharata with the army Gargya and Yudhajit, the king of Kekayas, were greatly delighted.

sn: स निर्ययौ जनौघेन महता केकयाधिपः। त्वरमाणोऽभिचक्राम गन्धर्वान्केकयाधिपः।२।।
en: He, the king of Kekaya, with a huge army they speedily went out for conquering the Gandharvas.

sn: भरतश्च युधांजिच्च समेतौ लघुविक्रमैः। गन्धर्वनगरं प्राप्तौ सबलौ सपदानुगौ॥
en: There upon the highly powerful and lightarmed Bharata and Yudhājit, with the soldiers and followers, arrived at the city of Gandharvas.

sn: श्रुत्वा तु भरतं प्राप्तं गन्धर्वास्ते समागताः। योद्धकामा महावीर्या व्यनदस्ते समन्ततः॥
en: Having heard of the coming of Bharata the highly powerful Gandharvas gathered round and sent up leonine roars.

sn: ततः समभवद्युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। सप्तरात्रं महाभीमं न चान्यतरयोर्जयः॥
en: There upon began the battle capable of making down erect and continued for a week. On neither side there was victory or defeat.

sn: खङ्गशक्तिधनुाहा नद्यः शोणितसंस्रवाः। नृकलेवरवाहिन्यः प्रवृत्ताः सर्वतोदिशम्॥
en: On all sides there flowed streams of blood and there were afloat human bodies. Daggers, Saktis and bows were like the banks of the river.

sn: ततो रामानुजः क्रुद्धः कालस्यास्र सुदारुणम्। संवत नाम भरतो गन्धर्वेष्वभ्यचोदयत्॥
en: There upon enraged Bharata, Rāma's younger brother, discharged a dreadful arrow named Samvarata resembling the fire of dissolution against Gandharvas.

sn: ते बद्धाः कालपाशेन संवर्तेन विदारिताः। क्षणेनाभिहतास्तेन तिस्त्र: कोट्यो महात्मना॥
en: Having bound them all with the noose of death and sundered them with Sangharata, Bharata despatched all the Gandharvas to the abode of death.

sn: तयुद्धं तादृशं घोरं न स्मरन्ति दिवौकसः। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण तादृशानां महात्मनाम्।।। हतेषु तेषु सर्वेषु भरतः केकयीसुतः। निवेशयामास तदा समृद्ध द्वे पुरोत्तमे॥
en: Even the celestials could not recollect if such a dreadful encounter had happened before. In a moment the huge Gandharva host was slain. After the destruction of the Gandharvas, Kaikeyi's son Bharata set up two excellent and prosperous cities in the province of Gandharva.

sn: तक्षं तक्षशिलायां तु पुष्कलं पुष्कलावते। गन्धर्वदेशे रुचिरे गान्धारविषये च सः॥
en: And he placed Takṣa in Takşasilā, the beautiful city of Gandharvas and Puşkala in Puşkalāvati of Gāndhāra province.

sn: धमरत्नौघसंकीर्णे काननैरुपशोभिते। अन्योन्यसंघर्षकृते स्पर्धया गुणविस्तरैः॥
en: Both the cities were filled with profuse riches and jewels and covered with various gardens. As for many ornaments both of them as if vied with one another.

sn: उभे सुरुचिरप्रख्ये व्यवहारैरकिल्बिषैः। उद्यानयानसंपूर्णे सुविभक्तान्तरापणे॥
en: By just purchases and sales, and by the conduct of the people the cities grew highly charming. Both of them were filled with gardens and conveyances. Rows of shops were well arranged by the streets in both the cities.

sn: उभे पुरवरे रम्ये विस्तरैरुपशोभिते। गृहमुख्यैः सुरुचिरैर्विमानैर्बहुभिर्वृते॥ शोभिते शोभनीयैश्च देवायतनविस्तरैः। तालैस्तमालैस्तिलकैर्बकुलैरुपशोभिते॥
en: Both of them were adorned with many excellent fancy articles, picturesque houses, charming palaces and many beautiful and high Tala, Tamāla, Tilaka and Vakula trees.

sn: निवेश्य पञ्चभिर्वर्भरतो राघवानुजः। पुनरायान्महाबाहुरयोध्या केकयीसुतः॥
en: Having reared up those two cities within five years, Rāma's younger brother, the mighty armed Bharata, son of Kaikeyl, returned to Ayodhyā. ?

sn: सोऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं साक्षाद्धर्ममिवापरम्। राघवं भरतः श्रीमान्ब्रह्माणमिव वासवः॥ शशंस च यथावृवं गन्धर्ववधमुत्तमम्। निवेशनं च देशस्य श्रुत्वा प्रीतोऽस्य राघवः॥
en: Like to Vasava saluting Brahmå he adored the high-souled Raghava the very personation of virtue and communicated to him duly the destruction of the Gandharvas and the establishment of the two cities. And hearing the words of Bharata, Råma attained to an excess of delight. are

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा हर्षमापेदे राघवो भ्रातृभिः सह। वाक्यं चाद्भुतसंकाशं भ्रातृन्प्रोवाच राघवः॥
en: Hearing the wonderful words of Bharata both Rāma and Lakşmaņa were greatly delighted. And then Rāma said to Lakşmaņa.

sn: इमौ कुमारौ सौमित्रे तव धर्मविशारदौ। अङ्गदश्चन्द्रकेतुश्च राज्यार्थे दृढविक्रमौ॥
en: O Saumitri, your two sons, Angada and Candraketu well-versed in religions, perfectly qualified in governing the kingdom and highly powerful.

sn: इमौ राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यामि देशः साधु विधीयताम्। रमणीयो ह्यसंबाधो रमेतां यत्र धन्विनौ॥
en: I shall therefore install them on throne. O gentle man, do you find out such country where those two skilful archers may unobstructed roam about.

sn: न राज्ञां यत्र पीडा स्यानाश्रमाणां विनाशनम्। स देशो दृश्यतां सौम्य नापराध्यामहे यथा॥
en: And where if a kingdom is established it might:not disturb the peace of hermitage and happiness of other kings.

sn: तथोक्तवति रामे तु भरतः प्रत्युवाच ह। अयं कारुपथो देशो रमणीयो निरामयः॥
en: Răma, having finished his speech Bharata replied:-The country of Kårupatha is highly picturesque and freed from all thorns.

sn: निवेश्यतां तत्र पुरमङ्गदस्य महात्मनः। चन्द्रकेतोः सुरुचिरं चन्द्रकान्तं निरामयम्॥
en: Let the city for high souled Angada be established there. And let the beautiful and healthy country of Candradkānta be the kingdom of Candraketu.

sn: तद्वाक्यं भरतेनोक्तं प्रतिजग्राह राघवः। तं च कृत्वा वशे देशमङ्गदस्य न्यवेशयत्॥
en: Rāma approved of the words of Bharata and having brought the country of Kārupatha under his subjection gave it to Angada.

sn: अङ्गदीया पुरी रम्याप्यङ्गदस्य निवेशिता। रमणीया सुगुप्ता च रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा।।।
en: He reared a beautiful and well-protected city for Angada.

sn: चन्द्रकेतोश्च मल्लस्य मल्लभूम्यां निवेशिता। चन्द्रकान्तेति विख्याता दिव्या स्वर्गपुरी यथा॥
en: And in the country of Malaya he reared a city for Candraketu, named Candrakāntā highly picturesque and like to the city of celestials.

sn: ततो रामः परां प्रीतिं लक्ष्मणो भरतस्तथा। ययुयुद्धे दुराधर्षा अभिषेकं च चक्रिरे॥ अभिषिच्य कुमारौ द्वौ प्रस्थाप्य सुसमाहितौ। अङ्गदं पश्चिमां भूमिं चन्द्रकेतुमुदङ्मुखम्॥ अङ्गदं चापि सौमित्रिर्लक्ष्मणोऽनुजगाम ह। चन्द्रकेतोस्तु भरतः पार्खािग्राहो बभूव ह॥
en: There upon greatly delighted Rāma, irrepressible in battle, Laksmana and Bharata, having performed the ceremony of installation ordered them to go their respective cities. Angada started towards the West and Candraketu towards the North. Sumitra's son Lakşmana went with Angada and Bharata accompanied Candraketu.

sn: लक्ष्मणस्त्वङ्गदीयायां संवत्सरमथोषितः। पुत्र स्थिते दुराधर्षे अयोध्यां पुनरागमत्॥
en: Having spent a year in Angada's city and finding his son well established in the kingdom Lakşmana returned to Ayodhyā.

sn: भरतोऽपि तथैवोष्य संवत्सरमतोऽधिकम्। अयोध्यां पुनरागम्य रामपादावुपास्त सः॥
en: And Bharata, according to his desire, having spent more than a year in the city of Candrakāntă, came back to Ayodhyā and saluted Rama's feet.

sn: उभौ सौमित्रिभरतौ रामपादावनुव्रतौ। कालं गतमपि स्नेहान्न जज्ञातेऽतिधार्मिकौ॥
en: The pious Laksmana and Bharata— both the brothers, were greatly attached to Råma; and though the spent their days in another place they did not experience any pain in consequence of separation from their sons.

sn: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि दश तेषां ययुस्तदा। धर्मे प्रयतमानानां पौरकार्येषु नित्यदा॥
en: Observing all virtues in this way, Rāma, the foremost of the pious, Bharata and Lakşmaņa governed the subjects for ten thousand years.

sn: विहृत्य कालं परिपूर्णमानसाः श्रिया वृता धर्मपुरे च संस्थिताः। त्रयः समिद्धाहुतिदीप्ततेजसो हुताग्नयः साधुमहाध्वरे त्रयः॥
en: Having spent their days in the city of Ayodhyā, the very city of virtue, the three brothers, appearing graceful like the burning fire receiving oblations in a great sacrifice, attained to joy in the fullness of time.

sn: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य रामे धर्मपरे स्थिते। कालस्तापसरूपेण राजद्वारमुपागमत्॥
en: In this wise the virtuous Rāma having spent some time Kāla, assuming the shape of an ascetic, arrived at the palace gate.

sn: दूतो ह्यतिबलस्याहं महर्षेरमितौजसः। रामं दिदृक्षुरायातः कार्येण हि महाबलः॥
en: I am the messenger of the great saint Atibala of incomparable effulgence. O you of great strength, for a particular business, I have come here to sec Rāma.

sn: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सौमित्रिस्त्वरयान्वितः। न्यवेदयत रामाय तापसं तं समागतम्॥
en: Hearing the words of the great saint, Saumitri speedily went to Råghava and communicated to him the arrival of the ascetic, saying.

sn: जयस्व राजधर्मेण उभौ लोकौ महाद्युते। दूतस्त्वां द्रष्टुमायातस्तपसा भास्करप्रभः॥
en: O you of great effulgence, observing the royal duties, may you acquire victory in both the worlds; one ambassador radiant like the sun by virtue of his asceticism, has come here to visit you.

sn: तद्वाक्यं लक्ष्मणोक्तं वै श्रुत्वा राम उवाच ह। प्रवेश्यतां मुनिस्तात महौजास्तस्य वाक्यधृक् ॥
en: Hearing the words of Laksmana, Rāma said: “Do you speedily bring here the highly effulgent ascetic bringing in a message."

sn: सौमित्रिस्तु तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रावेशयत तं मुनिम्। ज्वलन्तमेव तेजोभिः प्रदहन्तमिवांशुभिः॥
en: There upon saying so be it, Saumitri conducted, the effulgent ascetic to Råma's house.

sn: सोऽभिगम्य रघुश्रेष्ठं दीप्यपानं स्वतेजसा। ऋषिर्मधुरया वाचा वर्धस्वेत्याह राघवम्॥
en: And having approached Rama the foremost? of Raghus, the ascetic, burning in his own energy, said to him, in sweet accents:-0 great king may prosperity crown you.

sn: तस्मै रामो महातेजाः पूजामर्थ्यपुरोगमाम्। ददौ कुशलमव्यग्रं प्रष्टुं चैवोपचक्रमे॥
en: And having welcomed him with water and Argya, the highly effulgent Rāma asked him about his well-being.

sn: पृष्टश्च कुशलं तेन रामेण वदतां वरः। आसने काश्चने दिव्ये निषसाद महायशाः॥
en: Being asked by Rāma as to his welfare, that foremost of ascetics, skilled in the are of speech, sat on a golden seat.

sn: तमुवाच ततो रामः स्वागतं ते महामते। प्रापयास्य च वाक्यानि यतो दूतस्त्वमागतः॥
en: There upon welcoming him Rāma said:-Do you communicate to me his words by whom you have been sent.

sn: चोदितो राजसिंहेन मुनिर्वाक्यमभाषत। द्वन्द्वे ह्येतत्प्रवक्तव्यं हितं वै यद्यवेक्षसे॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, a lion among kings, the ascetic said:-If do you wish to bring about the well-being of the celestials, my earnest desire is that we may talk over it in a solitary place.

sn: यः शृणोति निरीक्षेद्वा स वध्यो भविता तव। भवेद्वै मुनिमुख्यस्य वचनं यद्यवेक्षसे॥
en: And if you have any regard for the words of that foremost of ascetics, do you so order that whoever shall hear or see us, when we shall converse in a solitary place, shall be slain by you.

sn: तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाय रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्। द्वारि तिष्ठ महाबाहो प्रतिहारं विसर्जय॥
en: There upon Rāma promised that it should be done and said to Lakşmaņa:-O you having long arms, sending away the warder do you wait at the gate.

sn: स मे वध्यः खलु भवेद्वाचं द्वन्द्वसमीरितम्। ऋषेर्मम च सौमित्रे पश्येद्वा शृणुयाच्च यः॥
en: When I shall talk with this ascetic in this solitary room whoever, shall hear or see us, shall be slain by me.

sn: ततो निक्षिप्य काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणं द्वारि संग्रहम्। तमुवाच मुने वाक्यं कथयस्वेति राघवः॥ तत्ते मनीषितं वाक्यं येन वासि समाहितः। कथयस्वाविशङ्कस्त्वं ममापि हृदि वर्तते॥
en: Having thus piaced Lakşmaņa at the gate Rama said to that Rsis:-O great saint, tell me what he has communicated to you. O Muni, what is your intention and by what high-souled Rșis you have been sent here. Tell me all this without any fear, I have become anxious to hear it.

sn: शृणु राजन्महासत्व यदर्थमहमागतः। पितामहेन देवेन प्रेषितोऽस्मि महाबल॥
en: There upon the great saint said:-Hear, O king, O you gifted with great energy, for what I have come here. O you of great strength, the great Patriarch has sent me to you.

sn: तवाहं पूर्वके भावे पुत्रः परपुरंजय। मायासंभावितो वीर काल: सर्वसमाहरः॥
en: O hero, I am your son. You did, in your pristine birth, beget me on Maya-I am Kala, the destroyer of all.

sn: पितामहश्च भगवानाह लोकपतिः प्रभुः। समयस्ते कृतः सौम्य लोकान्संपरिरक्षितुम्॥
en: Lord Brahmā, the father of all creatures, has said that you did promise to preserve the three worlds.

sn: सक्षिप्य हि पुरा लोकान्मायया स्वयमेव हि। महार्णवे शयानोऽप्सु मां त्वं पूर्वमजीजनः॥
en: Formerly when having slain all animals by your Māyā you went asleep in the waters of the mighty deep I was born.

sn: भोगवन्तं ततो नागमनन्तमुदकेशयम्। मायया जनयित्वा त्वं द्वौ च सत्त्वौ महाबलौ॥ मधुं च कैटभं चैव ययोरस्थिचयैर्वता। इयं पर्वतसंबाधा मेदिनी चाभवत्तदा॥
en: There after you did create the huge-bodied Ananta, living in the waters as the king of serpents. Then you did create two highly powerful Asuras named Madhu and Kaitabha. At that time the bones of those two Asuras having been scattered far and wide this earth containing many mountains was named Medini.

sn: पद्म दिव्येऽर्कसंकाशे नाभ्यामुत्पाद्य मामपि। प्राजापत्यं त्वया कर्म मयि सर्व निवेशितम्॥
en: Having procreated me in your lotus navel, dazzling in celestial brilliance you did employ me in the work of generation.

sn: सोऽहं संन्यस्तभारो हि त्वामुपास्य जगत्पतिम्। रक्षां विधत्स्व भूतेषु मम तेजस्करो भवान्।।।।
en: I took the charge and procreated men; but finding no other means to preserve them I worshipped you, the lord of the universe and said:-0 lord, you should protect the creatures, for you are my father and giver of energy and therefore irrepressible.

sn: ततस्त्वमसि दुर्धर्षात्तस्माद्भावात्सनातनात्। रक्षां विधास्यन्भूतानां विष्णुत्वमुफ्जग्मिवान्॥
en: Thereupon for concerning means for the preservation of creatures, you did renounce your irrepressible shape and assume Vişņu form.

sn: अदित्यां वीर्यवान्पुत्रो भ्रातॄणां वीर्यवर्धनः। समुत्पन्नेषु कृत्येषु तेषां साह्याय कल्पसे॥
en: And taking your birth from Aditi's powerful son, you went engaged in enhancing the delight of my brothers. You did use to protect the deities whenever they were assailed by any calamity.

sn: स त्वमुज्जास्यमानासु प्रजासु जगतोवर। रावणस्य वधाकाङ्क्षी मानुषेषु मनोऽदधाः॥
en: O lord of the universe, it is for that reason, on beholding the destruction of creatures you went born on earth to slay the Ten-necked demon.

sn: दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशवर्षशतानि च। कृत्वा वासस्य नियमं स्वयमेवात्मना पुरा॥
en: And at that time you did promise that you would live in the land of mortals for eleven thousand years.

sn: स त्वं मनोमयः पुत्रः पूर्णायुर्मानुषेष्विह। कालो नरवरश्रेष्ठ समीपमुपवर्तितुम्॥
en: There upon you did assume a human form to carry out your desire. Now that period is ripe and this is the proper time to inform you of it.

sn: यदि भूयो महाराज प्रजा इच्छस्युपासितुम्। वस वा वीर भद्रं ते एवमाह पितामहः॥ अथ वा विजिगीषा ते सुरलोकाय राघव। सनाथा विष्णुना देवा भवन्तु विगतज्वराः॥
en: O great king, do you wait in this land of mortals if do you wish to govern people for some time more. And if did you wish to repair to the region of immortals, do you again lord over the deities in your Vişņu form and let them be freed from anxiety. O Hero, the Patriarch has sent this intelligence to you.

sn: श्रुत्वा पितामहेनोक्तं वाक्यं कालसमीरितम्। राघवः प्रहसन्वाक्यं सर्वसंहारमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing those unequalled words of the Patriarch from the mouth of Kala, the destroyer of all, Rama smiling said.

sn: श्रुत्वा मे देवदेवस्य वाक्यं परममद्भुतम्। प्रीतिर्हि महती जाता तवागमनसंभवा॥ त्रयाणामपि लोकानां कार्यार्थ मम संभवः। भद्रं तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि यत एवाहमागतः॥
en: I have been greatly pleased and happy for your coming here O my son, I descended on earth to bring about the well-being of the three worlds. May good betide you. I shall now repair to from where I have come here.

sn: हृद्गतो ह्यसि संप्राप्तो न मे तत्र विचारणा। मया हि सर्वकृत्येषु देवानां वशवर्तिनाम्। स्थातव्यं सर्वसंहार यथा ह्याह पितामहः॥
en: I was thinking of this when you did come here. Therefore, I have no doubt in this. O lord of destruction, the immortals are dependent on me, so I shall be with them in all works. The Great Patriarch has said the truth.

sn: तथा तयोः संवदोर्दुर्वासा भगवानृषिः। रामस्य दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी राजद्वारमुपागमत्॥ सोऽभिगम्य तु सौमित्रिमुवाच ऋषिसत्तमः। रामं दर्शय मे शीघ्रं पुरा मेऽर्थोऽतिववर्तते॥
en: While Rāma and Kala were thus conversing with one another, the great ascetic Durvāsā arrived at the gate for seeing Rāma and approaching Laksmana said:-O Saumitri, do you soon take me to Rāma; my time goes away, so do you take me first.

sn: मुनेस्तु भाषितं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। अभिवाद्य महात्मानं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: Hearing the words of the ascetic, Laksmana, the slayer of enemies worshipping the feet of that high-souled one, said.

sn: किं कार्य ब्रूहि भगवन्को ह्यर्थः किं करोम्यहम्। व्यग्रो हि राघवो ब्रह्मन्मुहूर्त परिपाल्यताम्॥
en: O illustrious Sir, kindly mention your business. What is your object? Order me what I am to do. Råma is engaged in some business so kindly wait here for some time.

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषिशार्दूलः क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः। उवाच लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं निर्दहनिव चक्षुषा॥
en: Hearing those words that foremost of Rșis, red eyes:

sn: अस्मिन्क्षणे मां सौमित्रे रामाय प्रतिवेदय। विषयं त्वां पुरं चैव शपिष्ये राघवं तथा॥ भरतं चैव सौमित्रे युष्माकं या च संततिः। न हि शक्ष्याम्यहं भूयो मन्यु धारयितुं हृदि।७।।
en: O Saumitri, if do you not go even this very moment and communicate to Ráma my arrival, I shall imprecate you, Rama, Bharata, Satrughana, your sons and grand-sons. I shall curse also your kingdom and cities. I cannot any longer restrain by growing ire.

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा घोरसंकाशं वाक्यं तस्य महात्मनः। चिन्तयामास मनसा तस्य वाक्यस्य निश्चयम्॥
en: Hearing those dreadful and resolute words of the Rşis, Lakşmaņa thought within himself.

sn: एकस्य मरणं मेऽस्तु मा भूत्सर्वविनाशनम्। इति बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य राघवाय न्यवेदयत्॥
en: My own destruction is far more desirable than that of all. Having thus resolved Lakşmaņa approached Rāma and communicated to him the intelligence.

sn: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामः कालं विसृज्य च। निःसृत्य त्वरितो राजा अत्रेः पुत्रं ददर्श ह॥
en: Hearing the words of Lakşmaņa and having bade adieu, to Kala, Rama soon came out and saw Atri's son.

sn: सोऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा। किं कार्यमिति काकुत्स्थः कृताञ्जलिरभाषत॥
en: And having saluted that great and powerful ascetic he with folded hands, said. What is your business.

sn: तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा मुनिवरः प्रभुः। प्रत्याह रामं दुर्वासाः श्रूयतां धर्मवत्सल॥
en: Hearing the words of Rāma, the highly powerful Durvāsā, the foremost of Munis, said. Hear, O Rāma fond of virtue.

sn: अद्य वर्षसहस्रस्य समाप्तिर्मम राघव। सोऽहं भोजनमिच्छामि यथासिद्धं तवानघ ॥
en: For a thousand years I have carried on the vow of fasting. It has terminated today, so do you give me food as much as possible.

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं राजा राघवः प्रीतमानसः। भोजनं मुनिमुख्याय यथासिद्धमुपाहरत्॥
en: Hearing those words Rāma was greatly delighted and gave proper food to that ascetic.

sn: स तु भुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम्। साधु रामेति संभाष्य स्वमाश्रममुपागमत्॥
en: And feasting on that nectar-like sweet food, Durvāsā, the foremost of Rşis, thanked Rāma and repaired to his own hermitage.

sn: संस्मृत्य कालवाक्यानि ततो दुःखमुपागमत्। दुःखेन च सुसंतप्तः स्मृत्वा तद्धोरदर्शनम्॥ अवाङ्मुखो दीनमना व्याहतुं न शशाक ह। ततो बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य कालवाक्यानि राघवः। नैतदस्तीति निश्चित्य तूष्णीमासीन्ग्रहायशाः॥
en: There upon remembering the words of Kāla, Rāma was greatly sorry. And thinking of those dreadful words he was overwhelmed with grief. And with a poorly heart, and face downwards he remained silent for some time. There upon thinking of Kāla's words and determining that every calamity would befall him, that highly illustrious descendant, of Raghus, summoned patience.

sn: अवाङ्मुखोमथो दीनं दृष्ट्वा सोममिवाप्लुतम्। राघवं लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं हृष्टो मधुरमब्रवीत्॥
en: There upon beholding Räma with his head downwards and poorly like to the moon possessed by Rāhu, Lakşmaņa, delightedly and with sweet words, said.

sn: न संतापं महाबाहो मदर्थं कर्तुमर्हसि। पूर्णनिर्माणबद्धा हि कालस्य गतिरीदृशी॥
en: Be not aggrieved for me, O you having mighty' arms. Such is the course of time; the movements of creatures are destined by their pristine actions, good or bad.

sn: जहि मां सौम्य विस्रब्धं प्रतिज्ञां परिपालय। हीनप्रतिज्ञाः काकुत्स्थ प्रयान्ति नरकं नराः॥
en: O gentle one, do you satisfy your promise of slaying me without any hesitation. O Kakuthstha, those, who cannot carry out their promises, repair to hell.

sn: यदि प्रीतिर्महाराज यद्यनुग्राह्यता मयि। जहि मां निर्विशङ्कस्त्वं धर्म वर्धय राघव॥
en: O great king, if you have any love or affection for me, do you satisfy your promise by fearlessly slaying me.

sn: लक्ष्मणेन तथोक्तस्तु रामः प्रचलितेन्द्रियः। मन्त्रिणः समुपानीय तथैव च पुरोधसः॥ अब्रवीच्च तदा वृत्तं तेषां मध्ये स राघवः। दुर्वासोऽभिगमं चैव प्रतिज्ञां तापसस्य च॥
en: Hearing those words of Lakşmaņa Rāma's mind was greatly moved. There upon having invited his priests and ministers there he communicated to them his priests and ministers there he communicated to them his promise and Durvasa's arrival.

sn: तच्छुत्वा मन्त्रिणः सर्वे सोपाध्यायाः समासत। वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: Hearing it the ministers and priests remained silent. There upon Vasistha, of unmitigated effulgence, said.

sn: दृष्टमेतन्महाबाहो क्षयं ते रोमहर्षणम्। लक्ष्मणेन वियोगश्च तव राम महायशः॥
en: O highly illustrious and mighty armed Rāma, I knew before by virtue of my asceticism, of this your present destruction and separation from Laksmana.

sn: त्यजैनं बलवान्कालो मा प्रतिज्ञां वृथा कृथाः। प्रतिज्ञायां हि नष्टायां धर्मो हि विलयं व्रजेत्।।।।
en: Time is powerful; do not falsify your promise. Promise not carried out brings on the destruction of virtue.

sn: ततो धर्मे विनिष्टे तु त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्। सदेवर्षिगणं सर्व विनश्येत्तु न संशयः॥
en: And on the wane of virtue, forsooth, the three worlds, with celestials, saints, mobile and immobile creations, shall be destroyed.

sn: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल त्रैलोक्यस्याभिपालनात्। लक्ष्मणेन विना चाद्य जगत्स्वस्थं कुरुष्व ह॥
en: Therefore, O foremost of men, do you protect, the universe by suffering separation from Lakşmaņa, in the interest of the preservation of the three worlds.

sn: तेषां तत्समवेतानां वाक्यं धर्मार्थसंहितम्। श्रुत्वा परिषदो मध्ये रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्॥
en: All other ministers and priests agreed with Vasistha's words. There upon hearing their moral counsels, Rama said to Lakşmaņa before the assembly.

sn: विसर्जये त्वां सौमित्रे मा भूद्धर्मविपर्ययः। त्यागो वधो वा विहितः साधूनां ह्युभयं समम्॥
en: O Lakşmaņa, it is not proper to act against morality, I do therefore renounce you; for the pious hold that destruction and renunciation are all the same.

sn: रामेण भाषिते वाक्ये बाष्पव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः। लक्ष्मणस्त्वरितः प्रायात्स्वगृहं न विवेश ह॥
en: Răma saying this, Lakşmaņa did not go to his own house, but with eyes full of tears specially repaired therefrom.

sn: स गत्वा सरयूतीरमुपस्पृश्य कृताञ्जलिः। निगृह्य सर्वस्रोतांसि निःश्वासं न मुमोच ह॥
en: Having reached the banks of Sarayů and rinsed his mouth he stood there with folded palms. And having obstructed all passages he did not breathe any more.

sn: अनिःश्वसन्तं युक्तं तं सशक्राः साप्सरोगणाः। देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे पुष्पैरभ्यकिरंस्तदा॥
en: Laksmana, the younger brother of Rama, being thus engaged in penances, having obstructed his breath, Apsarās, Indra and other deities and Rsis showered flowers on him.

sn: अदृश्यं सर्वमनुजैः सशरीरं महाबलम्। प्रगृह्य लक्ष्मणं शक्रस्त्रिदिवं संविवेश ह॥
en: There upon beyond the sight of men, having taken the highly powerful Lakşmaņa within his body, the king of celestials entered his own city.

sn: ततो विष्णोश्चतुर्भागमागतं सुरसत्तमाः। हृष्टाः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म राघवम्॥
