sn: कष्टं युद्धे दश शेषाः श्रुता मे त्रयोऽस्माकं पाण्डवानां च सप्त। ह्यूना विंशतिराहताऽक्षौहिणीनां तस्मिन् संग्रामे भैरवे क्षत्रियाणाम्॥
en: Alas! I have heard that only ten persons are alive in this war three on our side and seven the side of the Pandavas. Eighteen Akshauhinis of Kshatriyas have been slain in this fearful battle.

sn: तमस्त्वतीव विस्तीर्णं मोह आविशतीव माम्। संज्ञां नोपलभे सूत मनो विह्वलतीव मे॥
en: Utter darkness is all around me, a faintness comes over me. O Suta, consciousness is leaving me, my mind is distracted.

sn: सौतिरुवाच इत्युक्त्वा धृतराष्ट्रोऽथ विलप्य बहुदुःखितः। मूर्च्छितः पुनराश्वस्त: संजयं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sauti said: Bewailing his fate thus, Dhritarashtra was overcome with the greatest sorrow and lost his senses for a time. But being revived, he addressed Sanjaya in these words.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच संजयैवं प्राणांस्त्यक्तुमिच्छामि मा चिरम्। स्तोकं ह्यपि न पश्यामि फलं जीवितधारणे॥
en: Dhritarashtra said: After what has happened, O Sanjaya, I desire to abandon this life without any further delay. I do not see any good by keeping it alive any longer.

sn: सौतिरुवाच तं तथा वादिनं दीनं विलपन्तं महीपतिम्। निःश्वसन्तं यथा नागं मुह्यमानं पुनः पुनः॥ गावल्गणिरिदं धीमान्महार्थं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।
en: Sauti said: While thus talking and bewailing sighing like a serpent and fainting every moment, the wise son of Gavalgana (Sanjaya) addressed the pitiable king of the earth in words instilled with deep meaning.

sn: संजय उवाच श्रुतवानसि वै राजन्महोत्साहान्महाबलान्॥ द्वैपायनस्य वदतो नारदस्य च धीमतः। महत्सु राजवंशेषु गुणैः समुदितेषु च॥ जातान्दिव्यास्त्रविदुषः शक्रप्रतिमतेजसः। धर्मेण पृथिवीं जित्वा यज्ञैरिष्ट्वाप्तदक्षिणैः॥ अस्मिल्लोके यशः प्राप्य ततः कालवशं गतान्।
en: Sanjaya said : From wise Narada and Vyasa you have heard, O king, of immensely powerful men, men of great exertions, men born of great royal dynasties, men full of great qualities, men wellversed in the art of using celestial weapons, men who, having conquered the world by righteous war and perforining sacrifices with proper offerings, obtained fame in this world and finally succumbed to death.

sn: शैव्यं महारथं वीरं संजयं जयतां वरम्॥ सुहोत्रं रन्तिदेवं च काक्षीवन्तमथौशिजम्। वाल्हीकं दमनं चैद्यं शर्यातिमजितं नलम्॥ विश्वामित्रममित्रघ्नमम्बरीषं महाबलम्। मरुत्तं मनुमिक्ष्वाकुं गयं भरतमेव च॥ रामं दाशरथिं चैव शशबिन्दुं भगीरथम्। कृतवीर्यं महाभागं तथैव जनमेजयम्॥ ययातिं शुभकर्माणं देवैर्यो याजितः स्वयम्। चैत्ययूपाङ्किता भूमिर्यस्येयं सवनाकरा॥ इति राज्ञां चतुर्विंशन्नारदेन सुरर्षिणा। पुत्रशोकाभितप्ताय पुरा श्वैत्याय कीर्तितम्॥
en: Such men were Shaivya, the brave carwarrior Srinjaya, the great amongst all conquerors Suhotra, Rantideva, Kakshivanta, greatly glorious, Damana, Balhika, Sharyati, Ajita, Nala, Visvamitra, the killer of enemies, the greatly strong Ambarisha, Maruta, Manu, Ikshvaku, Gaya, Bharata, Parshurama, the son of Dasharatha Rama, Sashabindu, Bhagiratha, Kritavirya, Janamejaya and Yayati of good deeds, who performed sacrifices, assisted by the celestials themselves and by whose sacrificial altars and stakes the habitable and inhabitable regions of this earth were all over marked. When Shaitya was much afflicted for the loss of his children, (the histories of these twenty four Rajas were told to him in the olden time by the celestial sage, Narada.

sn: तेभ्यश्चान्ये गताः पूर्वं राजानो बलवत्तराः। महारथा महात्मानः सर्वैः समुदिता गुणैः॥
en: But besides these, other kings, who were great car-warriors, who were more powerful than the above, who were noble in mind and full of every good quality, had also fallen into the grasp of Death.

sn: पूरुः कुरुर्यदुः शूरो विष्वगश्वो महाद्युतिः। अणुहो युवनाश्वश्च ककुत्स्थो विक्रमी रघुः॥ विजयो वीतिहोत्रोऽङ्गो भव: श्वेतो वृहद्गुरुः। उशीनरः शतरथः कङ्को दुलिQहो द्रुमः॥ दम्भोद्भवः परो वेन: सगरः संकृतिनिमिः। अजेयः परशुःपुण्ड्रः शम्भुर्देवावृधोऽनघः॥ देवाह्वयः सुप्रतिम: सुप्रतीको बृहद्रथः। महोत्साहो विनीतात्मा सुक्रतुर्नैषधो नलः॥ सत्यव्रतः शान्तभयः सुमिः सुबल: प्रभुः। जानुजनोऽनरण्योऽर्कः प्रियभृत्यः शुचिव्रतः॥ बलबन्धुनिरामर्दः केतुशृंगो बृहद्बलः। धृष्टकेतुर्वृहत्केतुर्दीप्तकेतुर्निरामयः॥ अविक्षिच्चपलो धूर्तः कृतबन्धुदृढेषुधिः। महापुराणसंभाव्यः प्रत्यङ्गः परहा श्रुतिः॥ एते चान्ये च राजानः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। श्रूयन्ते शतशश्चान्ये संख्याताश्चैव पद्मशः॥
en: They were Puru, Kuru, Yadu, Shura, Vishagashva, Mahadyuti, Anuha, Yuvanashva, Kakutstha, Vikrami, Raghu, Vijaya, Vitihotra, Anga, Bhava, Shveta, Brihadguru, Ushinara, Shataratha, Kanka, Duliduha, Druma, Dambhodbhava, Para, Vena, Sagara, Sankriti, Nimi, Ajeya, Parashu, Pundra, Shambhu, Devavridha, Anagha, Devahavya, Supratima, Supratika, Brihadratha, Mahotsaha, Vinitatma, Sukratu, the King of Nishadha Nala, Satyavrata, Shantabhaya, Sumitra, Subala, Janujangha, Anaranya, Arka, Priyabhriiya, Shuchivrata, Balabandhu, Niramarda, Ketushringa, Brihadbala, Dhrishtaketu, Brihatketu, Diptaketu, Niramaya, Avikshita, Chapala, Dhurta, Kritabandhu, Drindheshudhi, Mahapuranasambhava, Pratyanga, Paraha and Shruti. These These kings and kings and hundreds and thousands others.

sn: हित्वा सुविपुलाम्भोगान्बुद्धिमन्तो महाबलाः। राजानो निधनं प्राप्तास्तव पुत्रा इव प्रभो॥
en: Who were greatly powerful and wise, met death like your sons, quitting immense wealth and pleasure.

sn: येषां दिव्यानि कर्माणि विक्रमस्त्याग एव च। माहात्म्यमपि चास्तिक्यं सत्यं शौचं दयार्जवम्॥ विद्वद्भिः कथ्यते लोके पुराणे कविसत्तमैः। सर्वर्द्धिगुणसंपन्नास्ते चापि निधनं गताः॥
en: Even those men, who possessed all the noble virtues and whose heavenly valour, generosity, magnanimity, faith, truth, purity, simplicity and mercy, are published in the Puranas by the sacred bards of great learning, gave up their lives.

sn: तव पुत्रा दुरात्मानः प्रतप्ताश्चैव मन्युना। लुब्धा दुर्वृत्तभूयिष्ठा न ताञ्छोचितुमर्हसि॥ श्रुतवानसि मेधावी बुद्धिमान्प्राज्ञसंमतः। येषां शास्त्रानुगाबुद्धिर्न ते मुह्यन्ति भारत॥
en: Your wicked, envious, avaricious, of passionate temperament and vicious disposition; you are well-versed in the Shastras, you are intelligent and wise; those men whose understanding follows the dictates of the Shastras, never succumb to grief or misfortune.

sn: निग्रहानुग्रहो .पि विदितौ ते नराधिप। नात्यन्तमेवानुवृत्तिः कार्या ते पुत्ररक्षणे॥ भवितव्यं तथा तच्च नानुशोचितुमर्हसि। दैवं प्रज्ञाविशेषेण को निवर्तितुमर्हति॥
en: You know, O king, the severity and levity of fate. You know what anxiety you showed sons were for the safety of your sons. Therefore, this grief is unbecoming of you. It is not fit for you to grieve for that which must happen.

sn: विधातृविहितं मागं न कश्चिदतिवर्तते। कालमूलमिदं सर्वं भावाभावौ सुखासुखे॥
en: Who can avert by his cleverness the decrees of fate? None can go beyond the path marked for him by Providence. Existence and non-existence, pleasure and pain, come by Time.

sn: कालः सृजति भूतानि कालः संहरते प्रजाः। संहरन्तं प्रजा: कालं कालः शमयते पुनः॥
en: Time creates all things and Time destroys them all. Time burns all creatures and Time again extinguishes that fire.

sn: कालो हि कुरुते भावान्सर्वलोके शुभाशुभान्। कालः संक्षिपते सर्वाः प्रजा विसृजते पुनः॥
en: All things, good and bad, in the three worlds, are created by Time. Time destroys them and Time creates them again.

sn: कालः सुप्तेषु जागर्ति कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः। कालः सर्वेषु भूतेषु चरत्यविधृतः समः॥
en: Time alone is awake when all are asleep. Time cannot be overcome by any one. Time walks in everything without being retarded.

sn: अतीतानागता भावा ये च वर्तन्ति साम्प्रतम्। तान्कालनिर्मितान् बुद्ध्वा न संज्ञां हातुमर्हसि॥
en: Knowing that all things, past, present and future, are the outcome of Time it is not fit for you to be overcome with grief.

sn: सौतिरुवाच इत्येवं पुत्रशोकार्तं धृतराष्ट्रं जनेश्वरम्। आश्वास्य स्वस्थमकरोत्सूतो गावल्गणिस्तदा॥
en: Sauti said : Gavalgana's son, (Sanjaya), having thus comforted the royal Dhritarashtra, who was overwhelmed with grief for the death of his sons, restored peace to his mind,

sn: अनोपनिषदं पुण्यां कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्। विद्वद्भिः कथ्यते लोके पुराणे कविसत्तमैः॥
en: Great Dvaipayana composed a holy Upanishad on these facts; and it has been published to the world by the learned and sacred bards in the Puranas.

sn: भारताध्ययनं पुण्यमपि पादमधीयतः। श्रद्दधानस्य पूयन्ते सर्वपापान्यशेषतः॥
en: The study of Bharata is such an act of piety that even he who reads only one line of a verse with reverence has his sins all destroyed.

sn: देवादेवर्षयो ह्यत्र तथा ब्रह्मर्षयोऽमलाः। कीर्त्यन्ते शुभकर्माणस्तथा यक्षा महोरगाः॥
en: In this Bharata, sinless and immaculate Devas, Devarshis and Brahmanas have been described as well as Yakshas and great Nagas.

sn: भगवान्वासुदेवश्च कीर्त्यतेऽत्र सनातनः। स हि सत्यमृतं चैव पवित्रं पुण्यमेव च॥
en: In it has also the possessor of six attributes, the eternal Vasudeva, been described. He is true and just, pure and holy.

sn: शाश्वतं ब्रह्मपरमं ध्रुवं ज्योतिः सनातनम्। यस्य दिव्यानि कर्माणि कथयन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: In it is described the eternal Brahma, the great true light, whose great and divine deeds the wise and learned men declare.

sn: असच्च सदसच्चैव यस्माद्विश्वं प्रवर्तते। संततिश्च प्रवृत्तिश्च जन्ममृत्युपुनर्भवाः॥
en: From whom has been produced the nonexistent and existent-non-existent universe with the principle of reproduction and progression, birth, death and rebirth.

sn: अध्यात्मं श्रूयते यच्च पञ्चभूतगुणात्मकम्। अव्यक्तादि परं यच्च स एव परिगीयते॥
en: In it has also been described He who is Adhyatma and who partakes the attributes of the five elements and He to whom unmanifested and other such words cannot be applied.

sn: यत्तद्यतिवरा मुक्ता ध्यानयोगबलान्विताः। प्रतिबिम्बमिवादशैं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्॥
en: And also He whom the Yogis, possessed of meditation and Tapa, behold in their hearts as the reflection of an image in a mirror.

sn: श्रद्दधानः सदायुक्तः सदा धर्मपरायणः। आसेवन्निममध्यायं नरः पापात्प्रमुच्यते॥
en: The man of faith, ever devoted, ever employed in the exercise of virtue, is freed from sin on reading this chapter, of the Bharata.

sn: अनुक्रमणिकाध्यायं भारतस्येममादितः। आस्तिकः सततं शृण्वन कृच्छ्रेष्ववसीदति॥
en: The believer who always hears this introductory chapter, of the Bharata from the beginning, never meets with any difficulties (in this world).

sn: उभे संध्ये जपन्किंचित्त् सद्योमुच्येत किल्विषात्। दहाराव्या च संचितम्॥
en: The man, who repeats any part of its introduction at the inorning and evening twilights, at the time of repeating, is freed from sins collected during the day and night.

sn: भारतस्य वपुर्खेतत्सत्यं चामृतमेव च। नवनीतं यथा दध्मो द्विपदां ब्राह्मणो यथा॥
en: In the body of Bharata this chapter, is truth and ambrosia; as butter is among curds and a Brahmana among bipeds.

sn: आरण्यकं च वेदेभ्य ओषधिभ्योऽमृतं यथा। ह्रदानामुदधिः श्रेष्ठो गौर्वरिष्ठा चतुष्पदाम्॥
en: As Aranyaka among the Vedas, as ambrosia among medicines, as the ocean is great among all lakes, as cow among all quadrupeds.

sn: यथैतानीतिहासानां तथा भारतमुच्यते। यश्चैनं श्रावयेच्छ्राद्धे ब्राह्मणान्पादमन्ततः॥ अक्षय्यमन्नपानं वै पितृस्तस्योपतिष्ठते। इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां वेदं समुपद्व्हयेत्॥
en: So is Bharata, among all histories. He, who causes to be recited by a Brahmana even one line of it during a Shraddha, gives to the dead ancestors his offerings of food and drink which become inexhaustible. The Vedas expounded by the aid of history and Purana.

sn: बिभेत्यल्पश्रुताद् वेदो मामयं प्रहरिष्यति। कार्णं वेदमिमं विद्वाञ्च्छ्रावयित्वार्थमश्नुते॥
en: But the Veda is afraid of men of little learning, lest they hurt it. The learned man. are who recites this Veda, (Bharata) gains advantage.

sn: भ्रूणहत्यादिकं चापि पापं जह्यादसंशयम्। य इमं शुचिरध्यायं पठेत्पर्वणि पर्वणि॥
en: Even the sin of killing embryo is destroyed of those who read it with reverence at every change of the moon.

sn: अधीतं भारतं तेन कृत्स्नं स्यादिति मे मतिः। यश्चैनं शृणुयान्नित्यमार्षं श्रद्धासमन्वितः॥ स दीर्घमायुः कीर्ति च स्वर्गतिं चाप्नुयान्नरः। एकतश्चतुरो वेदा भारतं चैतदेकतः॥ पुरा किल सुरैः सर्वैः समेत्य तुलया धृतम्। चतुर्थ्यः सरहस्येभ्यो वेदेभ्यो ह्यधिकं यदा॥
en: I tell you, the whole Bharata has been read by the man who reads this chapter,. The man who with reverence hears every day these sacred words, gains long life and goes to heaven. In time gone by, the celestials met together and placed the four Vedas on one side and this Bharata on the other side of a scale and the Bharata weighed heavier.

sn: तदा प्रभृति लोकेऽस्मिन् महाभारतमुच्यते। महत्त्वे च गुरुत्वे च ध्रियमाणं यतोऽधिकम्॥
en: From that time, it is called Mahabharata. It is considered superior to the Vedas, both in substance and gravity of import.

sn: महत्त्वाद्धारवत्त्वाच्च महाभारतमुच्यते। निरुक्तमस्य यो वेद सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: It is called Mahabharata from this superiority in substance and gravity of import. He who understands its real meaning, is freed from all sins.

sn: तपो न कल्कोऽध्ययनं न कल्क: स्वाभाविको वेदविधिर्नकल्कः। स्तान्येव भावोपहतानि कल्कः॥
en: Tapa is not a sin, study is not a sin, the ordinances of the Vedas are not sins, the acquisition of wealth by exertion is not a sin: when they are abused, then do they become the sources of evil.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ऋषय ऊचुः समन्तपञ्चकमिति यदुक्तं सूतनन्दन। एतत्सर्वं यथातत्त्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामहे वयम्॥
en: The Rishis said: we wish to hear, O son of Suta, all about the place you called Samantapanchaka.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: सौतिरुवाच शृणुध्वं मम भो विप्रा ब्रुवतश्च कथा: शुभाः। समन्तपञ्चकाख्यं च श्रोतुमर्हथ सत्तमाः॥
en: Sauti said : Hear, O Brahmanas, the sacred words I say, You are fit, O best of men, to hear them.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: त्रेताद्वापरयोः संधौ रामः शस्त्रभृतां वरः। असकृत्यार्थिव क्षत्रं जघानामर्षचोदितः॥
en: At the end of Treta and in the beginning of Dwapara Yuga, the greatest of all that ever wielded arms, Parashurama, being impatient of wrongs, repeatedly destroyed all the Kshatriya races of the world.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: स सर्वं क्षत्रमुत्साद्य स्ववीर्येणानलद्युतिः। समन्तपञ्चके पञ्च चकार रौधिरान्ह्रदान॥
en: That fiery Rama, after destroying the Kshatriyas by his own prowess, made five lakes of blood at Samantapanchaka.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: स तेषु रुधिराम्भ:सुह्रदेषु क्रोधमूर्छितः। पितॄन् संतर्पयामास रुधिरेणेति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard, that being senseless with anger, he offered oblations to the manes of his ancestors, standing in the bloody water of these lakes.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अथचीकादयोऽभ्येत्य पितरो राममब्रुवन्। राम राम महाभाग प्रीताः स्म तव भार्गव॥
en: Thereupon Richika and others of his ancestors appeared and said, "Rama, O blessed Rama, O son of Bhrigu, we are pleased

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अनया पितृभक्त्या च विक्रमेण तव प्रभो। वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यमिच्छसि महाद्युते॥
en: With your filial piety and prowess. O mighty one, blessing be upon you. O illustrious one. Ask the boon you desire to have.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: राम उवाच यदि मे पितरः प्रीता यद्यनुग्राह्यता मयि। यच्च रोषाभिभूतेन क्षत्रमुत्सादितं मया॥ ह्रदाश्च तीर्थभूता मे भवेयुर्भुवि विश्रुताः॥
en: Rama said: If, O fathers, you are pleased with me, the boon, I ask is that I may be freed from the sin of annihilating the Kshatriyas and that the lakes, that I have made, may become celebrated shrines in the world.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: एवं भविष्यतीत्येवं पितरस्तमथाब्रुवन्। तं क्षमस्वेति निषिषिधुस्ततः स विरराम ह॥
en: The ancestors then said, "It would be as you have wished. But be pacified.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: तेषां समीपे यो देशो ह्रदानां रुधिराम्भसाम्। समन्तपञ्चकमिति पुण्यं तत्परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: The region, that lies near those five bloody lakes, has become famous from that day by the name of holy Samantapanchaka.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: येन लिङ्गेन यो देशो युक्तः समुपलक्ष्यते। तेनैव नाम्ना तं देशं वाच्यमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: The wise men have said that every place should be known by a name significant of something which may have made it famous.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अन्तरे चैव संप्राप्ते कलिद्वापरयोरभूत्। समन्तपञ्चके युद्धं कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः॥
en: At the end of Dwapara and in the beginning of Kali, a great battle was fought between the Kurus and the Pandavas, here at this holy Samantapanchaka.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: तस्मिन् परमधर्मिष्ठे देशे भूदोषवर्जिते। अष्टादश समाजग्मुरक्षौहिण्यो युयुत्सया॥
en: In that holy place, where there was not the least raggedness, were assembled eighteen Akshauhinis of soldiers, all eager for battle.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: समेत्य तं द्विजास्ताश्च तत्रैव निधनं गताः। एतन्नामाभिनिर्वृत्तं तस्य देशस्य वै द्विजाः॥
en: an O Brahmanas, they were all killed in that place. Thus, O Brahmanas, its name is explained.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पुण्यश्च रमणीयश्च स देशो वः प्रकीर्तितः। तदेतत्कथितं सर्वं मया ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः। यथा देश: स विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु सुव्रताः॥
en: I have described to you that beautiful and holy place. I have told you, O best of Brahmanas, all about this place, a place famous in the three worlds.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ऋषय ऊचुः अक्षौहिण्य इति प्रोक्तं यत्त्वया सूतनन्दन। एतदिच्छामहे श्रोतुं सर्वमेव यथातथम्॥
en: The Rishis said : We wish to know, O Son of Suta, all about Akshauhini which you have mentioned to us.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अक्षौहिण्याः परीमाणं नराश्वरथदन्तिनाम्। यथावच्चैव नो ब्रूहि सर्वं हि विदितं तव॥
en: Tell us the numbers of foot-soldiers, horses chariots and elephants, which make Akshauhini, for you know every thing.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: सौतिरुवाच एको रथो गजश्चैको नराः पञ्च पदातयः। त्रयश्च तुरगास्तज्ज्ञैः पत्तिरित्यभिधीयते॥
en: Sauti said: One chariot and one elephant, five foot soldiers and three horse-men, form a Patti.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पत्तिं तु त्रिगुणामेतामाहुः सेनामुखं बुधाः। त्रीणि सेनामुखान्येको गुल्म इत्यभिधीयते॥
en: Three Pattis make a Senamukha, three Senamukhas make a Gulma.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: त्रयो गुल्मा गणो नाम वाहिनी तु गणास्त्रयः। स्मृतास्तिस्रस्तु वाहिन्यः पृतनेति विचक्षणैः॥
en: Three Gulmas make a Gana, three Ganas a Vahini, three Vahinis taking together, form a Pritana.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: चमूस्तु पृतनास्तिस्रस्तिस्रश्चम्वस्त्वनीकिनी। अनीकिनी दशगुणा प्राहुरक्षौहिणी बुधाः॥
en: Three Pritanas make a Chamu, three Chamus an Anikini and ten times one Anikini is called by the learned as one Akshauhini.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अक्षौहिण्याः प्रसंख्याता रथानां द्विजसत्तमाः। संख्यागणितत्त्वज्ञैःसहस्राण्येकविंशतिः॥ शतान्युपरिचैवाष्टौ तथा भूयश्च सप्ततिः। गजानां च परीमाणमेतदेव विनिर्दिशेत्॥
en: O best of Brahmanas, mathematicians have calculated that there are twenty one thousand eight hundred and seventy chariots in an Akshauhini. The number of elephants is also the same.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ज्ञेयं शतसहस्रं तु सहस्राणि नवैव तु। नराणामपि पञ्चाशच्छतानि त्रीणि चानघाः॥ पञ्चषष्टिसहस्राणि तथाश्वनां शतानि च। दशोत्तराणि षट्प्राहुर्यथावदिह संख्यया॥
en: Know, the number of foot soldiers is one hundred nine-thousand three hundred and fifty; the number of horses is sixty-five thousand six-hundred and ten.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: एतामक्षौहिणी प्राहुः संख्यातत्त्वविदो जनाः। यां वः कथितवानस्मि विस्तरेण तपोधनाः॥
en: Those who are acquainted with the Principle of number call the above, explained fully by me, the numbers of an Akshauhini.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: एतया संख्यया ह्यासन्कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः। अक्षौहिण्यो द्विजश्रेष्ठाः पिण्डिताष्टादशैव तु॥
en: O best of Brahmanas, the eighteen Akshauhinis of the Kurus and the Pandava soldiers were composed according to this count.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: समेतास्तत्र वै देशे तत्रैव निधनं गताः। कौरवान्कारणं कृत्वा कालेनाद्भुतकर्मणा॥
en: Time brought them all together in this place and making the Kauravas the cause, destroyed thein all.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अहानि युयुधे भीष्मो दशैव परमास्त्रवित्। अहानि पञ्च द्रोणस्तु ररक्ष कुरुवाहिनीम्॥
en: Bhishma, skillfull in arms, fought for ten days. Drona defended the Kuru army for five days.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अहनी युयुधे द्वे तु कर्ण: परबलार्दनः। शल्योऽर्धदिवसं चैव गदायुद्धमतःपरम्॥ तस्यैव दिवसस्यान्तं द्रौणिहार्दिक्यगौतमाः॥
en: The destroyer of enemy's soldiers, Karna, fought for two days; Shalya for half a day and for a half a day then lasted the club-fight of Duryodhana and Bhima. At the close of that day, Ashvathama, Kritavarma and Kripa.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: प्रसुप्तं निशि विश्वस्तं जघ्नुौधिष्ठिरं बलम्। यत्तु शौनकसत्रे ते भारताख्यानमुत्तमम्॥
en: Destroyed the army of Yudhishthira when his soldiers were unsuspectingly sleeping. O Shaunaka, the best of narrations, the Bharata, which is narrated here at your sacrifice,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: जनमेजयस्य तत्सत्रे व्यासशिष्येण धीमता। कथितं विस्तरार्थं च यशो वीर्यं महीक्षिताम्॥
en: Was formerly narrated at the sacrifice of Janamejaya by the learned pupil of Vyasa. In it has been fully described the fame and valour of the kings of the world.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पौष्यं तत्र च पौलोममास्तीकं चादितः स्मृतम्। विचित्रार्थपदाख्यानमनेकसमयान्वितम्॥
en: There are three Parvas in the beginning (of this great work), namely Paushya, Pauloma and Astika, which contain many wonderful dictions and descriptions and senses.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: प्रतिपन्नं नरैः प्राज्ञैर्वैराग्यमिव मोक्षिभिः। आत्मैव वेदितव्येषु प्रियेष्विव हि जीवितम्॥
en: As men desirous of final release, accept Vairagya, so it is accepted by the wise. As Self is among things to be known, as life among things that are dear.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: इतिहासः प्रधानार्थः श्रेष्ठः सर्वागमेष्वयम्। अनाश्रित्येदमाख्यानं कथा भुवि न विद्यते॥
en: So is it the best among all histories and also among all Shastras. There is not a story current in the world which does not depend on it.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: आहारमनपाश्रित्य शरीरस्येव धारणम्। तदेतद्धारतं नाम कविभिस्तूपजीव्यते॥
en: As the body depends on the food it partakes so all poets serve and cherish this Bharata.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: उदयप्रेप्सुभिर्भूत्यैरभिजात इवेश्वरः। इतिहासोत्तमे यस्मिन्नर्पिता बुद्धिमत्तमा॥ स्वरव्यञ्जनयोः कृत्स्ना लोकवेदाश्रयेव वाक्॥
en: As the servant who wishes for promotion serves his master and as the words, constituting the various branches of knowledge and the Vedas, display vowels and consonants only, so this excellent history displays the highest knowledge.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: तस्य प्रज्ञाभिपन्नस्य विचित्रपदपर्वणः। सूक्ष्मार्थन्याययुक्तस्य वेदार्थैर्भूषितस्य च। भारतस्येतिहासस्य श्रूयतां पर्वसंग्रहः॥
en: Hear the outline of the Parvas (chapters) of this Bharata history which is full of subtle meaning and logical connection and which is rich with the meanings of the Vedas.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पर्वानुक्रमणी पूर्वं द्वितीय: पर्वसंग्रहः। पौष्यं पौलोममास्तीकमादिरंशावतारणम्॥
en: The first is called Anukramanika, the second Parva Sangraha; then come Pauloma, Paushya, Astika, Adianshavatarana,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ततः संभवपर्वोक्तमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्। दाहो जतुगृहस्यात्र हैडिम्बं पर्व चोच्यते॥
en: After this the wonderful and thoughtful Sambhava, then Jatugrihadaha, then Hidimba,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ततो बकवधः पर्व पर्व चैत्ररथं ततः। ततः स्वयंवरो देव्याः पाञ्चाल्याः पर्व चोच्यते॥
en: Then Baka-vadha and then Chaitraratha, then Panchali-svayamvara Parva,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: क्षात्रधर्मेण निर्जित्य ततो वैवाहिकं स्मृतम्। विदुरागमनं पर्व राज्यलम्भस्तथैव च॥
en: Then after defeating the rivals in rightful battle Vaivahika Parva, then Viduragamana and Rajya-lambha.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अर्जुनस्य वने वास: सुभद्राहरणं ततः। सुभद्राहरणादूर्ध्वं ज्ञेया हरणहारिका॥
en: Then Arjuna-vanavasa, Subhadraharana, Harana-harika,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ततः खाण्डवदाहाख्यं तत्रैव मयदर्शनम्। सभापर्व ततः प्रोक्तं मन्त्रपर्वं ततः परम्॥
en: Then Khandava-daha and Mayadarshana, then come Sabha Parva and Mantra Parva,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: जरासंधवधः पर्व पर्व दिग्विजयं तथा। पर्व दिग्विजयादूर्ध्वं राजसूयिकमुच्यते॥
en: Then Jarasandha-vadha and Digvijaya; after Digvijaya comes the Parva called Rajasuyika.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ततश्चार्घाभिहरणं शिशुपालवधस्ततः। द्यूतपर्व ततः प्रोक्तमनुद्यूतमतः परम्॥ तत आरण्यकं पर्व किर्मीरवध उच्यते। अर्जुनस्याभिगमनं पर्व ज्ञेयमत: परम्॥
en: Then Arghabhiharana, Shishupalavadha, Dyuta, Anudyuta Parva; Then comes Aranyaka, Kirmira-vadha, Arjunabhigamana;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ईश्वरार्जुनयोयुद्धं पर्व कैरातसंज्ञितम्। इन्द्रलोकाभिगमनं पर्व ज्ञेयमतः परम्॥
en: And then Kairata, in which the battle between Arjuna and Shiva is described; Then Indralokabhigamana.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: नलोपाख्यानमपि च धार्मिकं करुणोदयम्। तीर्थयात्रा ततः पर्व कुरुराजस्य धीमतः॥
en: Then the pathetic, pious and religious story of Nala-upakhyana; Then Tirtha-yatra of the wise king of the Kurus.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: जटासुरवधः पर्व यक्षयुद्धमतः परम्। निवातकवचैर्युद्धं पर्व चाजगरं ततः॥
en: Then Jatasura-vadha, then Yakshayuddha, then Nivatakavacha-yuddha and Ajagara;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: मार्कण्डेयसमास्या च पर्वानन्तरमुच्यते। संवादश्च ततः पर्व द्रौपदीसत्यभामयोः॥
en: Then Markandeya-samasya, then the Parva of the meeting of Draupadi and Satyabhama;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: घोषयात्रा ततः पर्व मृगस्वप्नोद्भवं ततः। व्रीहिद्रौणिकमाख्यानमैन्द्रद्युम्नं तथैव च॥
en: Then Ghoshayatra, Mriga-svapna, then Brihidraunikamakhyana and Aindradyumna;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: द्रौपदीहरणं पर्व जयद्रथविमोक्षणम्। पतिव्रताया माहात्म्यं सावित्र्याश्चैवमद्भुतम्॥
en: Then Draupadi-Harana-Parva, then Jayadratha-Vimochana, then the story of Savitri, illustrating love of husband and chastity;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: रामोपाख्यानमत्रैव पर्व ज्ञेयमतः परम्। कुण्डलाहरणं पर्व ततः परमिहोच्यते॥ चिन्तया।
en: After this the story of Rama, then Kundala-Harana Parva:

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: आरणेयं ततः पर्व वैराटं तदनन्तरम्। पाण्डवानां प्रवेशश्च समयस्य च पालनम्॥
en: That which comes next is Aranya and then Virata, where the Pandavas went (in disguise) and fulfilled their promise.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: कीचकानां वधः पर्व पर्वं गोग्रहणं ततः। अभिमन्योश्च वैराट्याः पर्व वैवाहिकं स्मृतम्॥
en: Then the Kichaka-vadha, then Gograhana, then the marriage of Abhimanyu with the daughter of the king of Virata.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: उद्योगपर्व विज्ञेयमत अर्ध्वं महाद्भुतम्। तत: संजययानाख्यं पर्वज्ञेयमतः परम्॥
en: Then is the most wonderful Parva Udyoga. The next one is Sanjaya-yana.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: प्रजागरं तथा पर्व धृतराष्ट्रस्य पर्व सानत्सुजातं वै गुह्यमध्यात्मदर्शनम्॥
en: Then comes Prajagara, the anxieties of Dhritarashtra, then Sanatsujata, the mysteries of Philosophy.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यानसन्धिस्ततः पर्व भगवद्यानमेव च। मातलीयमुपाख्यानं चरितं गालवस्य च॥
en: Then Yanasandhi, the arrival of Sri Krishna. Then the story of Matali and that of Galava:

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: सावित्रं वामदेव्यं च वैन्योपाख्यानमेव च। जामदग्न्यमुपाख्यानं पर्व षोडशराजकम्॥
en: Then the stories of Savitri, Vamadeva and Vainya; then the stories of Jamadagni and Shodasharajika;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: सभाप्रवेशः कृष्णस्य विदुलापुत्रशासनम्। उद्योग: सैन्यनिर्याणं विश्वोपाख्यानमेव च॥
en: Then the arrival of Krishna at the court, then Vidula-Putra-shasana, then the assemblage of troops and the story of Seta;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ज्ञेयं विवादपर्वात्र कर्णस्यापि महात्मनः। निर्याणं च ततः पर्व कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः॥
en: Then comes the quarrel of the noble Karna, then the march of the Kuru and Pandava armies to the field of battle.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: रथातिरथसंख्या च पर्वोक्तं तदनन्तरम्। उलूकदूतागमनं पर्वामर्षविवर्धनम्॥
en: Then Rathatiratha-Sankhya Parva, then the arrival of wrath-inspiring messenger Uluka;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अम्बोपाख्यानमत्रैव पर्व ज्ञेयमतः परम्। भीष्माभिषेचनं पर्व ततश्चाद्भुतमुच्यते॥ ६७॥
en: Then the story of Amba, then the wonderful installation of Bhishma;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: जम्बूखण्डविनिर्माणं पर्वोक्तं तदन्तरम्। भूमिपर्व ततः प्रोक्तं द्वीपविस्तारकीर्तनम्॥
en: Then (the account of) the creation of Jambukhanda and Bhumi, then the account of island.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पर्वोक्तं भगवद्गीता पर्व भीष्मवधस्ततः। द्रोणाभिषेचनं पर्व संशप्तकवधस्ततः॥
en: Then Bhagavad-Gita Parva, then Bhishmavadha, then the installation of Drona and then the death of Sanshaptakas;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अभिमन्युवधः पर्व प्रतिज्ञापर्व चोच्यते। जयद्रथवधः पर्व घटोत्कचवधस्ततः॥
en: Then Abhimanyu-vadha, then Pratijna Parva, then Jayadratha-vadha and Ghatotkacha-vadha;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ततो द्रोणवधः पर्व विज्ञेयं लोमहर्षणम्। मोक्षो नारायणास्त्रस्य पर्वानन्तरमुच्यते॥
en: Then the hair-stirring Drona-vadha, then the discharge of Narayana weapon;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: कर्णपर्व ततो ज्ञेयं शल्यपर्व ततः परम्। ह्रदप्रवेशनं पर्व गदायुद्धमतः परम्॥
en: Then Karna Parva and then next to it is Shalya Parva. Then Hrida Pravesha Parva, then Gada-Yudha.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: सारस्वतं ततः पर्व तीर्थवंशानुकीर्तनम्। अत ऊर्ध्वं सुबीभत्सं पर्व सौप्तिकमुच्यते॥
en: Then Sarasvata and the description of Tirtha and Vansha and then Sauptika, describing the disgraceful conduct of the Kurus.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ऐषीकं पर्व चोद्दिष्टमत ऊर्ध्वं सुदारुणम्। जलप्रदानिकं पर्व स्त्रीविलापस्ततः परम्॥
en: Then dreadful Aishika Parva, then Jalapradana, then Strivilapa;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: श्राद्धपर्व ततो ज्ञेयं कुरूणामौर्ध्वदेहिकम्। चार्वाकनिग्रहः पर्व रक्षसो ब्रह्मरूपिणः॥
en: Then Shraddha Parva, describing the funeral rites for the killed Kurus; then Charvaka-vadha who was a Rakshasa but appeared as a Brahmana.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: आभिषेचनिकं पर्व धर्मराजस्य धीमतः। प्रविभागो गृहाणां च पर्वोक्तं तदनन्तरम्॥
en: Then the coronation of wise Yudhishthira, then Griha-pravibhagaparva;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: शान्तिपर्व ततो यत्र राजधर्मानुशासनम्। आपद्धर्मश्च पर्वोक्तं मोक्षधर्मस्ततः परम्॥
en: Then Shanti Parva, then Rajadharmanushasana, then Apaddharma and Mokshadharma;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: शुकप्रश्नाभिगमनं ब्रह्मप्रश्नानुशासनम्। प्रादुर्भावश्च दुर्वासः संवादश्चैव मायया॥
en: Then come Shukaprashna-abhigamana, Brahma-prashna-anushasana, the origin of Durvasa and colloquy with Maya.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ततः पर्व परिज्ञेयमानुशासनिकं परम्। स्वर्गारोहणिकं चैव ततो भीष्मस्य धीमतः॥
en: Next Anushasana, then the ascension of wise Bhishma to heaven.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ततोऽश्वमेधिकं पर्व सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्। अनुगीता ततः पर्व ज्ञेयमध्यात्मवाचकम्॥
en: The next is all sin-destroying Ashvamedha and then Anu-Gita, containing spiritual philosophy.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पर्व चाश्रमवासाख्यं पुत्रदर्शनमेव च। नारदागमनं पर्व ततः परमिहोच्यते॥
en: Next Ashramavashika, Putradarshana and the arrival of Narada;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: मौसलं पर्व चोद्दिष्टं ततो घोरं सुदारुणम्। महाप्रस्थानिकं पर्व स्वर्गारोहणिकं ततः॥
en: Then comes Mausala, full of cruel and terrible incidents; then Mahaprasthana; and the ascension to heaven.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: हरिवंशस्ततः पर्व पुराणं खिलसंज्ञितम्। विष्णुपर्व शिशोश्चर्या विष्णोः कंसवधस्तथा॥
en: Then follows the Purana which is called Khila Harivansha, in it is Vishnu Parva, comes one come describing the early life of Vishnu and the destruction of Kansa.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: भविष्यपर्व चाप्युक्तं खिलेष्वेवाद्भुतं महत्। एतत्पर्वशतं पूर्ण व्यासेनोक्तं महात्मना॥
en: The last of all is Bhavishya Parva which contains future prophecies. These are, the one hundred Parvas, composed by the noble and great Vyasa.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यथावत्सूतपुत्रेण लोमहर्षणिना ततः उक्तानि नौमिषारण्ये पर्वाण्यष्टादशैव तु॥
en: Having placed them in eighteen Parvas, the son of Lomaharshana, the descendant of Suta, recited them in the forest of Naimisha;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: समासो भारतस्यायमत्रोक्तः पर्वसंग्रहः। पौष्यं पौलोममास्तीकमादिरंशावतारणम्॥
en: Of which the above is an abridgement. Adi-Parva contains, Paushya, Pauloma, Astika, Adi-anshavatarana,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: संभवो जतुवेश्माख्यं हिडिम्बबकयोर्वधः। तथा चैत्ररथं देव्याः पाञ्चाल्याश्च स्वयंवर॥
en: Sambhava; the burning of the house of lac, the destruction of Hidimba and Baka and Chaitraratha, the Svayamvara of Draupadi;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: क्षात्रधर्मेण निर्जित्य ततो वैवाहिकं स्मृतम्। विदुरागमनं चैव राज्यलणस्तथैव च॥
en: Her marriage after a righteous battle with the rivals, the arrival of Vidura, the regaining of kingdom,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: वनवासोऽर्जुनस्यापि सुभद्राहरणं ततः। हरणाहरणं चैव दहनं खाण्डवस्य च॥
en: Arjuna's exile into jungle, the stealing of Subhadra, the gift and receipt of the inarriage dower, the burning of Khandava forest,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: मयस्य दर्शनं चैव आदिपर्वणि कथ्यते। पौष्ये पर्वणि महात्म्यमुत्तङ्कस्योपवर्णितम्॥
en: The meeting with Maya, these are the contents of Adi Parva. The Paushya Parva contains the greatness of Uttanka.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पौलोमे भृगुवंशस्य विस्तारः परिकीर्तितः। आस्तीके सर्वनागानां गरुडस्य च संभवः॥
en: In Pauloma Parva the account of the Bhrigu and his descendants has been narrated. Astika contains the account of the birth of Garuda all the Nagas,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: क्षीरोदमथनं चैव जन्मोच्चैःश्रवसस्तथा। यजतः सर्पसत्रेण राज्ञः पारिक्षितस्य च॥ कथेयमभिनिर्वृत्ता भरतानां महात्मनाम्। विविधाः संभवा राज्ञामुक्ता: संभवपर्वणि॥ अन्येषां चैव शूराणामृषेद्वैपायनस्य च। अंशावतरणं चात्र देवानां परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: That of the churning of the ocean, the birth of Uchaishrava and last of all, the Bharata dynasty as described at the snake-sacrifice of king Parikshit. Sambhava Parva treats of the births of various kings. sages and heroes and that of the sage, Krishna Dvaipayana, the partial incarnations of the celestials,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: दैत्यानां दानवानां च यक्षाणां च महौजसाम्। नागानामथ सर्पाणां गन्धर्वाणां पतत्रिणाम्॥
en: The births of Daityas, Danavas powerful Yakshas, of Nagas, of Gandharvas of birds,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अन्येषां चैव भूतानां विविधानां समुद्भवः। महर्षेराश्रमपदे कण्वस्य च तपस्विनः॥ शकुन्तलायां दुष्यन्ताद्भरतश्चापि जज्ञिवान्। यस्य लोकेषु नाम्नेदं प्रथितं भारतं कुलम्॥
en: And of all creatures and lastly of the son of Shakuntala by Dushyanta at the hermitage of the sage Kanva, Bharata, the name by which his descendants, are known.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: वसूनां पुनरुत्पत्तिर्भागीरथ्यां महात्मनाम्। शान्तनोर्वेश्मनि पुनस्तेषां चारोहणं दिवि॥
en: It describes the births of the graet Vasus in the house of Shantanu in the womb of Bhagirathi and their again going to heaven.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: तेजोऽशानां च संपातो भीष्मस्याप्यत्र संभवः। राज्यान्निवर्तनं तस्य ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितिः॥
en: And the birth of fiery Bhishma, his renunciation of royalty, his adoption of Brahmacharya,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: प्रतिज्ञापालनं चैव रक्षा चित्राङ्गदस्य च। हते चित्राङ्गदे चैव रक्षा भ्रातुर्यवीयसः॥
en: His adherence to his vow, his protection of Chitrangada, his protection of his younger brother after the death of Chitrangada,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: विचित्रवीर्यस्य तथा राज्ये संप्रतिपादनम्। धर्मस्य नृषु संभूतिरणीमाण्डव्यशापजा॥
en: His placing Vichitravirya on the throne, the birth of Dharma on account of the curse of Animandavya,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: कृष्णद्वैपायनाच्चैव प्रसूतिर्वरदानजा। धृतराष्ट्रस्य पाण्डोश्च पाण्डवानां च संभवः॥
en: The births of Dhritarashtra and Pandu, by the blessing of Krishna Dvaipayana and also the birth of the Pandavas,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: वारणावतयात्रायां मन्त्रो दुर्योधनस्य च। कूटस्य धार्तराष्ट्रेण प्रेषणं पाण्डवान्प्रति॥
en: The conspiracy of Duryodhana to send the Pandavas to Varanavata and other plotting of the sons of Dhritarashtra against the Pandavas;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: हितोपदेशश्च पथि धर्मराजस्य धीमतः। विदुरेण कृतो यत्र हितार्थं म्लेच्छभाषया॥
en: Advice given to Yudhishthira in the language of the Mlecchas by that well-wisher of the Pandavas, Vidura,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: विदुरस्य च वाक्येन सुरङ्गोपक्रमक्रिया। निषाद्याः पञ्चपुत्रायाः सुप्ताया जतुवेश्मनि॥ पुरोचनस्य चात्रैव दहनं संप्रकीर्तितम्। पाण्डवानां वने घोरे हिडिम्बायाश्च दर्शनम्॥
en: Digging of a under-ground passage in consequence of the words of Vidura; the burning of Purochana and the sleeping hunterwoman with her five sons in the house of lac; the meeting of Pandavas with Hidimbi in the forest.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: तत्रैव च हिडिम्बस्य वधो भीमान्महाबलात्। घटोत्कचस्य चोत्पत्तिरत्रैव परिकीर्तिता॥
en: Then the destruction of Hidimba by powerful Bhima; then the birth of Ghatotkacha,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: महर्षेर्दर्शनं चैव व्यासस्यामिततेजसः। तदाज्ञयैकचक्रायां ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने॥
en: The meeting of the Pandavas with Vyasa, their stay according to his advice in a Brahmana's house at Ekachakra.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अज्ञातचर्यया वासो यत्र तेषां प्रकीर्तितः। बकस्य निधनं चैव नागराणां च विस्मयः॥
en: Living in disguise; the destruction of Baka and the astonishment of the people,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: संभवश्चैव कृष्णाया धृष्टद्युम्नस्य चैव ह। ब्राह्मणात्समुपश्रुत्य व्यासवाक्यप्रचोदिताः॥
en: The wonderful births of Krishnaa (Draupadi) and Drishtadyumna; hearing from a Brahmana the news of the Svayamvara and in obedience to the request of Vyasa.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: द्रौपदी प्रार्थयन्तस्ते स्वयंवरदिदृक्षया। पञ्चालानभितो जग्मुर्यत्र कौतूहलान्विताः॥
en: And also moved by the desire to win the hand of Draupadi, the departure of the Pandavas to Panchala;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अङ्गारपर्णं निर्जित्य गङ्गाकूलेऽर्जुनस्तदा। सख्यं कृत्वा ततस्तेन तस्मादेव च शुश्रुवे॥
en: The victory of Arjuna over Angaraparna on the banks of the Bhagirathi; making friendship with him and to hear from him.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: तापत्यमथ वासिष्ठमौर्वं चाख्यानमुत्तमम्। भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वैः पञ्चालानभितो ययौ॥
en: The accounts of Tapati, Vasishtha and Aurva; then the arrival of the Pandavas with all the brothers at Panchala;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पाञ्चालनगरे चापि लक्ष्यं भित्त्वा धनंजयः। द्रौपदी लब्धवानत्र मध्ये सर्वमहीक्षिताम्॥
en: The hitting of the mark at the city of Panchala by Arjuna and the acquisition of Draupadi by him in the midst of all the kings of the world.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: भीमसेनार्जुनौ यत्र संरब्धान् पृथिवीपतीन्। शल्यकर्णौ च तरसा जितवन्तौ महामृधे॥
en: The defeat of Shalya, Karna and all the angry kings by powerful Bhima and Arjuna in the battle that ensued.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: दृष्ट्वा तयोश्च तद्वीर्यमप्रमेयममानुषम्। शङ्कमानौ पाण्डवांस्तान् रामकृष्णौ महामती॥
en: The doubting by Rama and Krishna from the great exploits of the brothers that whether they were Pandavas.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: जग्मतुस्तैः समागन्तुं शालां भार्गववेश्मनि। पञ्चानामेकपत्नीत्वे विमर्शो दुपदस्य च॥
en: Their arrival at the house of the potter where the brothers were living; the grief of Drupada, because Draupadi would be married to five husbands;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पञ्चेन्द्राणामुपाख्यानमत्रैवाद्भुतमुच्यते। द्रौपद्या देवविहितो विवाहश्चाप्यमानुषः॥
en: The story of five Indras told in consequence; the wonderful and divinely arranged marriage of Draupadi;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: क्षत्तुश्च धार्तराष्ट्रेण प्रेषणं पाण्डवान्प्रति। विदुरस्य च संप्राप्तिदर्शनं केशवस्य च॥
en: The sending of Vidura as an envoy to the Pandavas from the sons of Dhritarashtra; his arrival; and his meeting with Krishna;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: खाण्डवप्रस्थवासश्च तथा राज्याधसर्जनम्। नारदस्याज्ञया चैव द्रौपद्याः समयक्रिया॥
en: Living of the Pandavas at Indraprastha and their rule over half of the kingdom; the fixing of time for the five brothers to live with Draupadi as directed by Narada;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: सुन्दोपसुन्दयोस्तद्वदाख्यानं परिकीर्तितम्। अनन्तरं च द्रौपद्या सहासीनं युधिष्ठिरम्॥ अनुप्रविश्य विप्रार्थे फाल्गुनो गृह्य चायुधम्। मोक्षयित्वा गृहं गत्वा विप्रार्थं कृतनिश्चयः॥ समयं पालयन्वीरो वनं यत्र जगाम ह। पार्थस्य वनवासे च उलूप्या पथि संगमः॥
en: The histories of Sunda and Upasunda are narrated; and then the departure of Arjuna to the forest according to the vow and on account of his seeing Yudhishthira and Draupadi sitting together when he entered into the room to take arms to rescue the kine of a Brahmana; the meeting of Arjuna with Ulupi on his way.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पुण्यतीर्थानुसंयानं बभ्रुवाहनजन्म च। तत्रैव मोक्षयामास पञ्चसोऽप्सरसः शुभाः॥
en: It then describes the birth of Babhruvahana; and the account of Arjuna's visit to many holy pilgrimages; the deliverance by Arjuna of the five celestial maidens.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: शापायाहत्वमापन्ना ब्राह्मणस्य तपस्विनः। प्रभासतीर्थे पार्थेन कृष्णस्य च समागमः॥
en: Who had become alligators by the curse of an ascetic Brahmana; the meeting of Arjuna and Krishna at the holy pilgrimage of Prabhasa;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: द्वारकायां सुभद्रा च कामयानेन भामिनी। वासुदेवस्यानुमते प्राप्ता चैव किरीटिना॥
en: Arjuna's taking of Subhadra by force with the permission of Krishna on the car which goes every where at the will of the rider;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: गृहीत्वा हरणं प्राप्ते कृष्णे देवकिनन्दने। अभिमन्योः सुभद्रायां जन्म चोत्तमतेजसः॥
en: Taking the dower of Krishna, Arjuna's departure to Indraprastha; the birth of that prodigy of prowess, Abhimanyu, in the womb of Subhadra;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: द्रौपद्यास्तनयानां च संभवोऽनुप्रकीर्तितः। विहारार्थं च गतयोः कृष्णयोर्यमुनामनु॥
en: The birth of the children of Draupadi; the pleasure trip of Arjuna and Krishna to the banks of the Yamuna;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: संप्राप्तिश्चक्रधनुषोः खाण्डवस्य च दाहनम्। मयस्य मोक्षो ज्वलनाद्भुजङ्गस्य च मोक्षणम्।।
en: The acquisition by them the celebrated bow Gandiva and the discus; the burning of the forest of Khandava; the saving of the life of Maya and the serpent;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: महर्मन्दपालस्य शाङ्गयां तनयसंभवः। इत्येतदादिपर्वोक्तं प्रथमं बहुविस्तरम्॥
en: The giving birth to son by Rishi Mandapala in the womb of a bird, called Sharangi. The Adi-Parva has been described with these various matters.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अध्यायानां शते द्वे तु संख्याते परमर्षिणा। सप्तविंशरध्याया व्यासोनोत्तमतेजसा॥
en: Greatly powerful Vyasa has divided this Parva into two hundred and twenty seven chapters.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अष्टौ श्लोकसहस्राणि अष्टौ श्लोकशतानि च। श्लोकश्च चतुराशीतिर्मुनिनोक्तामहात्मना॥
en: These two hundred and twenty-seven chapters contain eight thousand eight hundred and eighty-four slokas. a

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: द्वितीयं तु सभापर्व बहुवृत्तान्तमुच्यते। सभाक्रिया पाण्डवानां किंकराणां च दर्शनम्॥
en: The second is Sabha Parva which is very extensive and full of matter. It describes the building of the assembly-hall by the Pandavas and the review of their servants;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: लोकपालसभाख्यानं नारदाद्देवदर्शिनः। राजसूयस्य चारम्भो जरासंधवधस्तथा॥
en: The description of the courts of Lokapalas by Narada who knows all the celestial regions; the preparations for the Rajasuya Yajna; the destruction of Jarasandha;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: गिरिव्रजे निरुद्धानां राज्ञां कृष्णेन मोक्षणम्। तथा दिग्विजयोऽत्रैव पाण्डवानां प्रकीर्तितः॥
en: The deliverance by Krishna of all the princes those were kept as prisoners (by Jarasandha) at (his capital city) Girivraja, Then it relates the conquest of the world by the Pandavas;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: राज्ञामागमनं चैव सार्हणानां महाक्रतौ। राजसूयेऽर्धसंवादे शिशुपालवधस्तथा॥
en: The arrival of the chiefs and potentates with tribute at the Rajasuya Yajna; the destruction of Shishupala at the sacrifice, in connection with Arghya giving;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यज्ञे विभूतिं तां दृष्ट्वा दुःखामर्षान्वितस्य च। दुर्योधनस्यावहासो भीमेन च सभातले॥
en: The grief and envy of Duryodhana at the sight of the magnificence of the sacrifice; the joking of Bhima at the expense of Duryodhana in the great assembly.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यत्रास्य मन्युरुद्भूतो येन द्यूतमकारयत्। यत्र धर्मसुतं द्यूते शकुनिः कितवोऽजयत्॥
en: The preparation for the game of dice; the defeat of Yudhishthira at the play by cunning and crafty Shakuni;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यत्र द्यूतार्णवे मग्नां द्रौपदीं नौरिवार्णवात्। धृतराष्ट्रो महाप्राज्ञः स्नुषां परमदुःखिताम्॥
en: The deliverance, by the greatly wise Dhritarashtra, of the sorrowful Draupadi who was drowned in the ocean of distress on account of the game;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: तारयामास तांस्तीर्णाज्ञात्वा दुर्योधनो नृपः। पुनरेव ततो द्यूते समाह्वयत पाण्डवान्॥
en: Seeing this, the attempt of Duryodhana to engage Yudhishthira again in

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: जित्वा स वनवासाय प्रेषयामास तांस्ततः। एतत्सर्वं सभापर्व समाख्यातं महात्मना॥
en: The exile of Yudhishthira with his brothers by the victorious Duryodhana. These are the matters that have been dwelt in the Sabha Parva.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अध्यायाः सप्ततिर्जेयास्तथा चाष्टौ प्रसंख्यया। श्लोकानां द्वे सहस्रे तु पञ्च श्लोकशतानि च॥ श्लोकाश्चैकादश ज्ञेयाः पर्वण्यस्मिन् द्विजोत्तमाः। अतः परं तृतीयं तु ज्ञेयमारण्यकं महत्॥
en: This Parva is divided into seventy eight chapters and it contains, O best of Brahmanas, two thousand five hundred and eleven slokas. Then comes the third Parva, called Aranya.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: वनवासं प्रयातेषु पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु। पौरानुगमनं चैव धर्मपुत्रस्य धीमतः॥
en: It describes the departure of the Pandavas to the forest with the citizens following the wise Yudhishthira;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अन्नौषधीनां च कृते पाण्डवेन महात्मना। द्विजानां भरणार्थं च कृतमाराधनं रवेः॥ धौम्योपदेशात् तिग्मांशुप्रसादादन्नसंभवः। हितं च ब्रुवतः क्षत्तुः परित्यागोऽम्बिकासुतात्॥
en: In order to be gifted with the power of supplying food to the Brahmanas, Yudhishthira's adoration of the Sun by the advice of Dhauinya; the creation of food by this means; the expulsion of Vidura who was always a well-wisher of his master;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: त्यक्तस्य पाण्डुपुत्राणां समीपगमनं तथा। पुनरागमनं चैव धृतराष्ट्रस्य शासनात्॥
en: Vidura's coming to the Pandavas; his return to Dhritarashtra by his request;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: कर्णप्रोत्साहनाच्चैव धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्मतेः। वनस्थान्याण्डवान्हन्तुं मन्त्रो दुर्योधनस्य च॥
en: The conspiracy of Duryodhana, being incited by Karna, to destroy the roving Pandavas;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: तं दुष्टभावं विज्ञाय व्यासस्यागमनं द्रुतम्। निर्याणप्रतिषेधश्च सुरभ्याख्यानमेव च। १४९।।
en: Having learnt this evil intention of Duryodhana, Vyasa's arrival to him. His discussion with Duryodhana on the point of his going to the forest (after the Pandavas); the history of Surabhi related;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: मैत्रेयागमनं चात्र राज्ञश्चैवानुशासनम्। शापोत्सर्गश्च तेनैव राज्ञो दुर्योधनस्य च॥
en: The arrival of Maitreya and his instructions to Dhritarashtra; his curse to Duryodhana;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: किर्मीरस्य वधश्चात्र भीमसेनेन संयुगे। वृष्णीनामागमश्चात्र पञ्चालानां च सर्वशः॥
en: The slaying of Kirmira by Bhima, the arrival of the Panchalas and Vrishnis;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: श्रुत्वा शकुनिना द्यूते निकृत्या निर्जितांश्च तान्। क्रुद्धस्यानुप्रशमनं हरेश्चैव किरीटिना॥
en: Having heard that the Pandavas had been defeated at an unjust game of dice by Shakuni, the arrival of Krishna and Arjuna allaying Krishna's anger.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: परिदेवनं च पाञ्चाल्या वासुदेवस्य सन्निधौ। आश्वासनं च कृष्णेन दुःखार्तायाः प्रकीर्तितम्॥
en: The lamentation of Draupadi before Krishna and his cheering of her;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: तथा सौभवधाख्यानमत्रैवोक्तं महर्षिणा। सुभद्रायाः सपुत्रायाः कृष्णेन द्वारकां पुरीम्॥
en: The account of the fall of Saubhva was described by the great Rishi. Then it describes the departure of Krishna to Dwaraka with Subhadra and her son;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: नयनं द्रौपदेयानां धृष्टद्युम्नेन चैव ह। प्रवेशः पाण्डवेयानां रम्ये द्वैतवने ततः॥
en: The taking of Draupadi's sons by Dhristadyumna to Panchala; the entry of the Pandavas into the beautiful forest of Dvaita.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: धर्मराजस्य चात्रै व संवादः कृष्णया सह। संवादश्च तथा राज्ञा भीमस्यापि प्रकीर्तितः॥
en: It then relates the conversation of Draupadi and Bhima with Yudhishthira.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: समीपं पाण्डुपुत्राणां व्यासस्यागमनं तथा। प्रतिस्मृत्याथ विद्याया दानं राज्ञो महर्षिणा॥
en: The arrival of Vyasa to the Pandavas, the bestowal of power of Pratismriti to Yudhishthira by the great Rishi.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: गमनं काम्यके चापि व्यासे प्रतिगते ततः। अस्त्रहेतोर्विवासश्च पार्थस्यामिततेजसः॥
en: It then describes the departure of Vyasa, the Pandavas' going to the forest of Kamyaka; the rovings of greatly powerful Arjuna in quest of weapons;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: महादेवेन युद्धं च किरातवपुषा सह। दर्शनं लोकपालानामस्त्रप्राप्तिस्तथैव च॥
en: His fight with Shiva who was in the disguise of a hunter; his meeting with the Lokapalas and his receipt of weapons from them;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: महेन्द्रलोकगमनमस्त्रार्थे च किरीटिनः। यत्र चिन्ता समुत्पन्ना धृतराष्ट्रस्य भूयसी॥
en: His journey to the celestial kingdom of Indra and anxiety of Dhritarashtra in consequence.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: दर्शनं बृहदश्वस्य महर्षे वितात्मनः। युधिष्ठिरस्य वार्तस्य व्यसनं परिदेवनम्॥
en: It then relates the lamentations of Yudhishthira in his meeting with the holy sage Brihadashva.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: नलोपाख्यानमत्रैव धर्मिष्ठं करुणोदयम्। दमयन्त्याः स्थितिर्यत्र नलस्य चरितं तथा॥
en: It then contains the holy and most pathetic story of Nala, illustrating the great patience of Damayanti and the character of Nala.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: तथाऽक्षहृदयप्राप्तिस्तस्मादेव महर्षितः। लोमशस्यागमस्तत्र स्वर्गात्पाण्डुसुतान्प्रति॥
en: It then describes how describes how Yudhishthira acquired the mysteries of dice from the great Rishi; then the arrival of great Rishi Lomasha from the celestial region where Arjuna was;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: वनवासगतानां च पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। स्वर्गे प्रवृत्तिराख्याता लोमशेनार्जुनस्य वै॥
en: The receipt from the Rishi by the highsouled dwellers of forest (the Pandavas) the news of the third brother (Arjuna) who was then staying in the celestial regions;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: संदेशादर्जुनस्यात्र तीर्थाभिगमनक्रिया। तीर्थानां च फलप्राप्तिः पुण्यत्वं चापि कीर्तितम्॥
en: The pilgrimages of the Pandavas to various holy places as asked by Arjuna; their attainment of merit and virtue in consequence;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पुलस्त्यतीर्थयात्रा च नारदेन महर्षिणा। तीर्थयात्रा च तत्रैव पांडवानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: The arrival of great sage Narada at the holy shrine of Pulastya; the arrival of the highsouled Pandavas also at that holy pilgrimage.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: कर्णस्य परिमोक्षोऽत्र कुण्डलाभ्यां पुरन्दरात्। तथा यज्ञविभूतिश्च गयस्यात्र प्रकीर्तिता॥
en: Then it relates the account of the deprivation of Karna of his "ear-rings" by Indra and then the sacrificial greatness by Gaya;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: आगस्त्यमपि चाख्यानं यत्र वातापिभक्षणम्। लोपामुद्राभिगमनमपत्यार्थषेस्तथा॥
en: The story of Agastya which relates how he ate up the Asura, Vatapi; his approaching Lopamudra to have an offspring.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ऋष्यशृङ्गस्य चरितं कौमारब्रह्मचारिणः। जामदग्न्यस्य रामस्य चरितं भूरितेजसः॥
en: It then tells the story of Rishyashringa who adopted the life of an ascetic from his boyhood. Then follows the story of greatly powerful Rama, the son of Jamadagni,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: कार्तवीर्यवधो यत्र हैहयानां च वर्ण्यते। प्रभासतीर्थे पांडूनां वृष्णिभिश्च समागमः॥
en: In which is described the death of Kartavirya and Haihayas, then the meeting of the Pandavas and the Vrishnis at the holy pilgrimage of Prabhasa;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: सौकन्यमपि चाख्यानं च्यवनो यत्र भार्गवः। शर्यातियज्ञे नासत्यौ कृतवान् सोमपीतिनौ॥
en: The story Sukanya in which Bhrigu's son, Chyavana, made the Ashvinis drink Soma Juice at the sacrifice of king Sharyati,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ताभ्यां च यत्र स मुनिौवनं प्रतिपादितः। मांधातुश्चाप्युपाख्यानं राज्ञोऽत्रैव प्रकीर्तितम्॥
en: And in which it has been shown how he himself (Chyavana) acquired perpetual youth. Then it relates the history of King Mandhata;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: जन्तूपाख्यानमत्रैव यत्र पुत्रेण सोमकः। पुत्रार्थमयजदाजा लेभे पुत्रशतं च सः॥
en: Then it tells the story of prince Jantu and how king Somaka, by offering up his only son Jantu in sacrifice, got one hundred others.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ततः श्येनकपोतीयमुपाख्यानमनुत्तमम्। इन्द्राग्नी यत्र धर्मश्चाप्यजिज्ञासच्छिविं नृपम्॥
en: Then follows the beautiful story of the hawk and the pegion; then the trial of king Shivi by Indra, Agni and Dharma,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अष्टावक्रीयमत्रैव विवादो यत्र बन्दिना। अष्टावक्रस्य विप्रर्जनकस्याध्वरेऽभवत्। नैयायिकानां मुख्येन वरुणस्यात्मजेन च॥
en: The story of Ashtavakra in which is narrated the great debate between that Rishi and the first of logicians, named Bandi, the son of Varuna at the sacrifice of Janaka.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पराजितो यत्र बन्दी विवादेन महात्मना। विजित्य सागरं प्राप्तं पितरं लब्धवानृषिः। यवक्रीतस्य चाख्यानं रैभ्यस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: The defeat of Bandi and the release of the father of the Rishi (Ashtavakra) from the ocean. Then follows the story of Yavakrita, then that of the great Raibhya,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: गन्धमादनयात्रा च वासो नारायणाश्रमे। नियुक्तो भीमसेनश्च द्रौपद्या गन्धमादने॥
en: Then the departure of the Pandavas for Gandhamadana and their staying at a hermitage called Narayana; Bhima's journey to Gandhamadana by the request of Draupadi;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: व्रजन्पथि महाबाहुर्दृष्टवान् पवनात्मजम्। कदलीषंडमध्यस्थं हनूमन्तं महाबलम्॥
en: His meeting on his way with the Pandava's son, greatly powerful, Hanumana, who was in a grove of bananas;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यत्र सौगन्धिकार्थेऽसौ नलिनी तामधर्षयत्। यत्रास्य युद्धमभवत्सुमहद्राक्षसैः सह॥
en: His bath in the tank and the destruction of its flowers in searching for the sweet-scented the flower Nalini; his fight with powerful Rakshasas,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यक्षैश्चैव महावीर्यैर्मणिमत्प्रमुखैस्तथा। जटासुरस्य च वधो राक्षसस्य वृकोदरात्॥
en: Yakshas, including Manimana; destruction of the Asura Jata by him;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: वृषपर्वणो राजपेस्ततोऽभिगमनं स्मृतम्। आर्टिषेणाश्रमे चैषां गमनं वास एव च॥
en: The meeting (of the Pandavas) with the Royal sage Vrishaparva; their departure for the hermitage of Arshtishena and then their stay there;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: प्रोत्साहनं चपाञ्चाल्या भीमस्यात्र महात्मना। कैलासारोहणं प्रोक्तं यत्र यक्षैर्बलोत्कटैः॥
en: The inciting of Bhima against the Kurus by Draupadi. Then is related the ascent of Kailasa by Bhima, where with the powerful Yakshas,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: युद्धमासीन्महाघोरं मणिमत्प्रमुखैः सह। समागमश्च पाण्डूनां यत्र वैश्रवणेन च। समागमश्चार्जुनस्य तत्रैव भ्रातृभिः सह। अवाप्य दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि गुर्वर्थं सव्यासाचिना॥
en: Headed by Manimana, he fought a great battle; the meeting of the Pandavas with Kubera. Then comes the meeting with Arjuna who had obtained many great weapons.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: निवातकवचैर्युद्धं हिरण्यपुरवासिभिः। निवातकवचैोरैर्दानवैः सुरशत्रुभिः॥
en: Then it relates the battle between Arjuna and the great enemy of the celestials Nivatakavachas, who dwelt in Hiranyapuram.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पौलोमैः कालकेयैश्च यत्र युद्धं किरीटिनः। वधश्चैषां समाख्यातो राज्ञस्तेनैव धीमता॥
en: Then comes the account of Arjuna's fight with Paulomas and Kalkeyas; their death at his hand;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अस्त्रसंदर्शनारम्भो धर्मराजस्य संनिधौ। पार्थस्य प्रतिषेध च नारदेन सुरर्षिणा॥
en: The display of weapons by Arjuna before Yudhishthira and its prevention by the great Rishi Narada;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अवरोहणं पुनश्चैव पांडूनां गन्धमादनात्। भीमस्य ग्रहणं चात्र पर्वताभोगवर्मणा॥
en: The descent of the Pandavas from the Gandhamadana; the seizure of Bhima by a monster mountain-snake;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: भुजगेन्द्रेण बलिना तस्मिन्सुगहने वने। अमोक्षयद्यत्र चैनं प्रश्नानुक्त्वा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The release of Bhima from the snake on answering certain questions of his by Yudhishthira;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: काम्यकागमनं चैव पुनस्तेषां महात्मनाम्। तत्रस्थांश्च पुनर्द्रष्टुं पांडवान् पुरुषर्षभान्॥ वासुदेवस्यागमनमत्रैव परिकीर्तितम्। मार्कण्डेयसमास्यायामुपाख्यानानि सर्वशः॥
en: The return of the Pandavas to the forest of Kamyaka; the arrival of Krishna to see the sons of Pandu; the arrival of Rishi Markandeya; and his various recitals%3B

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पृथोर्वैन्यस्य यत्रोक्तमाख्यानं परमर्षिणा। संवादश्च सरस्वत्यास्तायर्षेः सुमहात्मनः॥
en: The story of Pritha, the son of Vena, was told by the Rishi; also the debate of Sarasvati and that of Rishi Tarkshya.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: मत्स्योपाख्यानमत्रैव प्रोच्यते तदनन्तरम्। मार्कण्डेयसमास्या च पुराणं परिकीर्त्यते॥
en: Then follows the story of Matsya and other old stories recited by Markandeya.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ऐन्द्रद्युम्नमुपाख्यानं धौन्धुमारं तथैव च। पतिव्रतायाश्चाख्यानं तथैवाङ्गिरसं स्मृतम्॥
en: Then come the stories of Indradyumna and Dhundumara, then the story of the chaste wife and the history of Angirasa.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: द्रौपद्याः कीर्तितश्चात्र संवादः सत्यभामया। पुनद्वैतवनं चैव पाण्डवाः समुपागताः॥
en: Then is told the meeting of Draupadi and Satyabhama nd their conversation, the return of the Pandavas to the forest of Dvaita;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: घोषयात्रा च गन्धर्वैर्यत्र बद्धः सुयोधनः। ह्रियमाणस्तु मन्दात्मा मोक्षितोऽसौ किरीटिना॥
en: The procession of the calves and the ! captivity of Duryodhana at the hands of Gandharvas. His rescue by Arjuna when the wretch was being carried away.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: धर्मराजस्य चात्रैव मृगस्वप्ननिदर्शनात्। काम्यके काननश्रेष्ठे पुनर्गमनमुच्यते॥
en: Then follows the dream of the deer by Yudhishthira, then the return of the Pandavas to the forest of Kamyaka.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: व्रीहिद्रौणिकमाख्यानमत्रैव बहुविस्तरम्। दुर्वाससोऽप्युपाख्यानमत्रैव परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: Here follows the long story of Vrihidraunika. Here is related the story of Durvasa.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: जयद्रथेनापहारो द्रौपद्याश्चाश्रमान्तरात्। यत्रैनमन्वयादीमो वायुवेगसमो जवे॥ चक्रे चैनं पञ्चशिखं यत्र भीमो महाबलः। रामायणमुपाख्यानमत्रैव बहुविस्तरम्॥
en: Then is narrated the forcible abduction of Draupadi by Jayadratha from the hermitage; the pursuit of the wretch by Bhima, swift as the air; the shaving of Jayadratha at the hand of Bhima. Then follows the long story of Ramayana,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यत्र रामेण विक्रम्य निहतो रावणो युधि। सावित्र्याश्चाप्युख्यानमत्रैव परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: In which is shown how Ravana was killed by the prowess of Rama. Then is narrated the story of Savitri,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: कर्णस्य परिमोक्षोऽत्र कुण्डलाभ्यां पुरन्दरात्। यत्रास्य शक्तिं तुष्टोऽसावदादेकवधाय च॥
en: Then Karna's deprivation of earrings by Indra and his presentation to him a weapon called Shakti;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: आरणेयमुपाख्यानं यत्र धर्मोऽन्वशात्सुतम्। जग्मुर्लब्धवरा यत्र पाण्डवाः पश्चिमां दिशम्॥
en: The story of Araneya in which Dharma gave advice to his son and in which is related how the Pandavas received a boon and went to the west.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: एतदारण्यकं पर्व तृतीयं परिकीर्तितम्। अत्राध्यायशते द्वे तु संख्यया परिकीर्तित॥ एकोनसप्ततिश्चैव तथाध्यायाः प्रकीर्तिताः। एकादश सहस्राणि श्लोकानां षट् शतानि च॥ चतुःषष्टिस्तथा श्लोकाः पर्वण्यस्मिन् प्रकीर्तिताः। अतःपरं निबोधेदं वैराटं पर्व विस्तरम्॥
en: These matters are all described in the third Parva called Aranyaka. It contains two hundred and sixty-nine chapters. Its numbers of slokas is eleven thousand, six hundred and sixty four. Then comes the extensive Virata Parva.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: विराटनगरे गत्वा श्मशाने विपुलां शमीम्। दृष्ट्वा सन्निदधुस्तत्र पाण्डवा ह्यायुधान्युत॥
en: It described how the Pandavas arrived at the city of Virata and saw a Shami tree in a cremation ground on which they kept hidden their weapons.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यत्र प्रविश्य नगरं छद्मना न्यवसंस्तु ते। पाञ्चाली प्रार्थयानस्य कामोपहतचेतसः॥ दुष्टात्मनो वधो यत्र कीचकस्य वृकोदरात्। पाण्डवान्वेषणार्थ च राज्ञो दुर्योधनस्य च॥
en: Then have been related their entry into the city and their stay in disguise; then the slaying by Bhima of the wicked Kichaka who lustfully aspired for Draupadi; then the attempt of king Duryodhana to find out the Pandavas;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: चाराः प्रस्थापिताश्चात्र निपुणाः सर्वतो दिशम्। न च प्रवृत्तिस्तैर्लब्धा पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: His despatch of clever spies to all countries to trace out the Pandavas; their failure to discover the mighty sons of Pandu;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: गोग्रहश्च विराटस्य त्रिगर्तेः प्रथमं कृतः। यत्रास्य युद्धं सुमहत्तैरासील्लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: First the seizure of Virata's kine by the Trigartas, the fearful battle that followed;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ह्रियमाणश्च यत्रासौ भीमसेनेन मोक्षितः। गोधनं च विराटस्य मोक्षितं यत्र पाण्डवैः॥
en: The capture of Virata by the enemy and his rescue by Bhima; the release of his kine also by the Pandava (Bhima).

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अनन्तरं च कुरुभिस्तस्य गोग्रहणं कृतम्। समस्ता यत्र पार्थेन निर्जिताः कुरवो युधि॥
en: Then seizure of Virata's kine by the Kurus, the defeat of the Kuru warriors by single handed Arjuna,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: प्रत्याहृतं गोधनं च विक्रमेण किरीटिना। विराटेनोत्तरा दत्ता स्नुषा यत्र किरीटिनः॥ अभिमन्युं समुद्दिश्य सौभद्रमरिघातिनम्। चतुर्थमेतद्विपुलं वैराटं पर्व वर्णितम्॥
en: The release of the king's kine by Arjuna's valour; the bestowal by Virata of his daughter to Arjuna for his acceptance of her for his son by Subhadra, Abhimanyu, the destroyer of foes. These are the contents of the extensive fourth Parva Virata.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अत्रापि परिसंख्याता अध्यायाः परमर्षिणा। सप्तषष्टिरथो पूर्णा श्लोकानामपि मे शृणु॥ श्लोकानां द्वे सहस्रे तु श्लोकाः पञ्चाशदेव तु। उक्तानि वेदविदुषा पर्वण्यस्मिन् महर्षिणा॥
en: The great Rishi has composed it in sixty seven chapters and it contains two thousand and fifty slokas.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: उद्योगपर्व विज्ञेयं पञ्चमं शृण्वतः परम्। उपल्पव्ये निविष्टेषु पाण्डवेषु जिगीषया॥
en: Here now, the contents of the fifth Parva, named Udyoga. When the Pandavas were living at Upaplavya,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: दुर्योधनोऽर्जुनश्चैव वासुदेवमुपस्थितौ। साहाय्यमस्मिन्समरे भवान्नौ कर्तुमर्हति॥
en: Desirous of battle, both Arjuna and Duryodhana went to Krishna and said, "You should help us in this war."

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: इत्युक्ते वचने कृष्णो यत्रोवाच महामतिः। अयुध्यमानमात्मानं मन्त्रिणं पुरुषर्षभौ॥
en: When these words were uttered, the highsouled Krishna replied, “O best of men, a counsellor (myself) who will not fight,

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अक्षौहिणी वा सैन्यस्य कस्य किं वा ददाम्यहम्। वत्रे दुर्योधनः सैन्यं मन्दात्मा यत्र दुर्मतिः॥
en: And one Akshauhini of my soldiers, between these two which shall I give to you?" Blind to his own interest, the foolish' Duryodhana asked for the soldiers.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अयुध्यमानं सचिवं वव्रे कृष्णं धनंजयः। मद्रराजं च राजानमायान्तं पाण्डवान्प्रति॥
en: Arjuna chose to possess Krishna as a counsellor, although he will not fight. Then is related the coming of the king of Madra for the assistance of the Pandavas.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: उपहारैर्वञ्चयित्वा वर्मन्येव सुयोधनः। वरदं तं वरं वत्रे साहाय्यं क्रियतां मम॥
en: Having deceived him on the way by present. Duryodhana induced him to grant him a boon and for that boon he asked his help in the war.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: शल्यस्तस्मै प्रतिश्रुत्य जगामोद्दिश्य पाण्डवान्। शान्तिपूर्वं चाकथयधनेन्द्रविजयं नृपः॥
en: Then it narrates how Shalya went to the Pandavas and how he consoled Yudhishthira by recounting the victory of Indra (over Vitra).

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पुरोहितप्रेषणं च पाण्डवैः कौरवान्प्रति। वैचित्रवीर्यस्य वचः समादाय पुरोधसः॥ तथेन्द्रविजयं चापि यानं चैव पुरोधसः। संजयं प्रेषयामास शमार्थी पाण्डवान्प्रति॥
en: Then is told the dispatch of the Purohita by the Pandavas to the Kurus. Greatly powerful Dhritarashtra, having heard the story of Indra's victory from the Purohita, sent Sanjaya to the Pandavas to ask for peace.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यत्र दूतं महाराजो धृतराष्ट्रः प्रतापवान्। श्रुत्वा च पाण्डवान्यत्र वासुदेवपुरोगमान्॥ प्रजागरः सप्रजज्ञे धृतराष्ट्रस्य चिन्तया। विदुरो यत्र वाक्यानि विचित्राणि हितानि च। श्रावयामास राजानं धृतराष्ट्र मनीषिणम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra heard all about the Pandavas, their friends, Krishna and others; and his great anxiety and sleeplessness in consequence. Vidura's sound, wise and various counsels were given to the wise king Dhritarashtra.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: तथा सनत्सुजातेन यत्राध्यात्ममनुत्तमम्॥
en: It then contains the excellent truths of spiritual philosophy that were told by Sanatsujata.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: मास्तापान्वितो राजा श्रावितः शोकलालसः। प्रभाते राजसमितौ संजयो यत्र वा विभो॥
en: To the anxious and sorrowing king. Next morning in the Royal court, Sanjaya spoke.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: ऐकात्म्यं वासुदेवस्य प्रोक्तवानर्जुनस्य च। यत्र कृष्णो दयापन्नः संधिमिच्छन् महामतिः॥
en: Of the great friendship between Arjuna and Krishna. It was then that great Krishna, moved by pity and being desirous of bringing peace.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: स्वयमागाच्छमं कर्तुं नगरं नागसाह्वयम्। प्रत्याख्यानं च कृष्णस्य राज्ञा दुर्योधनेन वै॥
en: Went himself to Hastinapur, the capital of the Kurus. (It then relates) the rejection of the peaceful offer of Krishna by the king Duryodhana.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: शमार्थे याचमानस्य पक्षयोरुभयोर्हितम्। दम्भोद्भवस्य चाख्यानमत्रैव परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: An offer which was for the benefit of both parties. Then is related the the story of Dambhodbhava;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: वरान्वेषणमत्रैव मातलेश्च महात्मनः। महर्षेःचापि चरितं कथितं गालवस्य वै॥
en: Then the search for a bridegroom by Matali for his daughter; then follows the history of the great Rishi Galava.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: विदुलायाश्च पुत्रस्य प्रोक्तं चाप्यनुशासनम्। कर्णदुर्योधनादीनां दुष्टं विज्ञाय मन्त्रितम्॥
en: Then the story of the training of the son of Vidula;. having heard of the evil counsel of Duryodhana and Karna and others;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: योगेश्वरत्वं कृष्णेन यत्र राज्ञां प्रदर्शितम्। रथमारोप्य कृष्णेन यत्र कर्णोऽनुमन्त्रितः॥
en: Krishna's display of his Yoga powers to the kings; then his taking Karna on his chariot and giving him sound advice;

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: उपायपूर्वं शौटीर्यात्प्रत्याख्यातश्च तेन सः। आगम्य हास्तिनपुरादुपप्लव्यमरिंदमः॥
en: Karna's rejection of Krishna's advice out of pride; then the chastiser of his enemies, Krishna returned to Upaplavya from Hastinapur.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: पाण्डवानां यथावृत्तं सर्वमाख्यातवान् हरिः। ते तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा मन्त्रयित्वा च यद्धितम्॥ सांग्रामिकं ततः सर्वं सज्जं चक्रुः परंतपाः। ततो युद्धाय निर्याता नराश्वरथदन्तिनः॥
en: He told the Pandavas all that had happened. It was then the greatly powerful Pandavas, the chastisers of their foes, after consulting properly with one another, inade all preparations for war.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: नगराद्धास्तिनपुरादलसंख्यानमेव च। यत्र राज्ञा लूकस्य प्रेषणं पाण्डवान्प्रति॥
en: Then follows the march of infantry cavalry, elephants and charioteers from Hastinapur; the review of troops by both parties; the sending of Uluka to the Pandavas by the king (Duryodhana).

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: श्वो भाविनि महायुद्धे दौत्येन कृतवान् प्रभुः। रथातिरथसंख्यानमम्बोपाख्यानमेव च॥
en: As an envoy on the day before the great battle; then the number of charioteers of different classes was related. Then is told the story of Amba.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: एतत् सुबहुवृत्तान्तं पञ्चमं पर्व भारते। उद्योगपर्व निर्दिष्टं संधिविग्रहमिश्रितम्॥
en: These are the matters that have been dwelt on, the fifth Parva of the Bharata in full of incidents regarding both peace and war.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अध्यायानां शतं प्रोक्तं षडशीतिर्महर्षिणा। श्लोकानां षट्सहस्राणि तावन्त्येव शतानि च॥ श्लोकाच नवतिः प्रोक्तास्तथैवाष्टौ महात्मना। व्यासेनोदारमतिना पर्वण्यस्मिंस्तपोधनाः॥
en: Great Rishis, the great Vyasa has composed this Parva in one hundred and eighty six chapters. The number of slokas composed in it by the great Rishi is six thousand six hundred and ninety eight.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अतः परं विचित्रार्थं भीष्मपर्व प्रचक्षते। जम्बूखण्डविनिर्माणं यत्रोक्तं संजयेन ह॥
en: Then is told the wonderful Bhishma Parva. Sanjaya related in it the creation of Jambu country.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यत्र यौधिष्ठिरं सैन्यं विषादमगमत् परम्। यत्र युद्धमभूद्घोरं दशाहानि सुदारुणम्॥
en: Then is narrated the great depression of the army of Yudhishthira and the fierce battle that raged for ten successive days.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: कश्मलं यत्र पार्थस्य वासुदेवो महामतिः। मोहजं नाशयामास हेतुभिर्मोक्षदर्शिभिः॥
en: The high-souled Krishna dispelled in this Parva the great compunction which was felt by Arjuna towards his relatives, by citing reasons based on the philosophy of final emancipation.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: समीक्ष्याधोक्षज: क्षिप्रं युधिष्ठिरहिते रतः। रथादाप्लुत्य वेगेन स्वयं कृष्ण उदारधीः॥ प्रतोदपाणिराधावद्भीष्मं हन्तुं व्यपेतभीः। वाक्यप्रतोदाभिहतो यत्र कृष्णेन पाण्डवः॥
en: In it is also narrated how the magnanimous Krishna, seeing the loss inflicted on the Pandava army, jumped from the chariot and ran swiftly, with dauntless breast and his driving whip in hand, to kill Bhishma. In this Parva also, Krishna smote Arjuna.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: गाण्डीवधन्वा समरे सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य यत्र पार्थो महाधनुः॥
en: The bearer of the Gandiva and the greatest warrior in battle among all wielders of weapons. In it also is narrated how the bowman Arjuna, placing Shikhandi before him.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: विनिम्ननिशितैर्बाणै रथाद्भीष्ममपातयत्। शरतल्पगतश्चैव भीष्मो यत्र बभूव ह॥
en: Wounded Bhishma with his sharpest arrows and felled him from his chariot and how Bhishma lay on his bed of arrows.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: षष्ठमेतत् समाख्यातं भारते पर्व विस्तृतम्। अध्यायानां शतं प्रोक्तं तथा सप्तदशापरे॥ पञ्च श्लोकसहस्राणि संख्ययाष्टौ शतानि च। श्लोकाश्च चतुराशीतिरस्मिन्पर्वणि कीर्तिताः॥ व्यासेन वेदविदुषा संख्याता भीष्मपर्वणि। द्रोणपर्व ततश्चित्रं बहुवृत्तान्तमुच्यते॥
en: This extensive Parva is the sixth in the Bharata. It is composed of one hundred and seventeen chapters. Its number of slokas is five thousand eight hundred and eighty-four as composed by Vyasa, well-learned in the Vedas. Then comes Drona Parva, full of wonderful incidents.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: सैनापत्येऽभिषिक्तोऽथ यत्राचार्यः प्रतापवान्। दुर्योधनस्य प्रीत्यर्थं प्रतिजज्ञे पहास्त्रवित्॥ ग्रहणं धर्मराजस्य पाण्डुपुत्रस्य धीमतः। यत्र संशप्तकाः पार्थमपनिन्यू रणाजिरात्॥
en: It relates the installation of greatly powerful instructor Drona as the commander of the army; the vow of making Yudhishthira prisoner was taken by the great warrior to please Duryodhana; Sansaptakas taking Arjuna away from the bettle field.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: भगदत्तो महाराजो यत्र शक्रसमो युधि। सुप्रतीकेन नागेन स हि शान्तः किरीटिना॥
en: The overthrow by Arjuna of the great king Bhagadatta, as great a warrior as Indra himself, with his elephant Supratika.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यत्राभिमन्युं बहवो जजुरेकं महारथाः। जयद्रथमुखा बालं शूरमप्राप्तयौवनम्॥
en: The death of the boy-hero, Abhimanyu in his teens, alone and unsupported at the hand of many great car-warriors including Jayadratha.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: हतेऽभिमन्यौ क्रुद्धेन यत्र पार्थेन संयुगे। अक्षौहिणी: सप्त हत्वा हतो राजा जयद्रथः॥
en: On the death death of Abhimanyu, the destruction by Arjuna of seven Akshauhinis of soldiers alongwith Jayadratha in a great battle.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: यत्र भीमो महाबाहुः सात्यकिश्च महारथः। अन्वेषणार्थं पार्थस्य युधिष्ठिरनृपाज्ञया॥
en: Then in order to search Partha, greatly powerful Bhima and the great car-warrior Satyaki, by command of king Yudhishthira.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: प्रविष्टौ भारती सेनामप्रधृष्यां सुरैरपि। संशप्तकावशेषं च कृतं निःशेषमाहवे॥
en: Entered into the Kaurava ranks, impenetrable even by the celestial; the destruction of the rest of the Sansaptakas.

description: Brief introduction to the story of Mahabharata
sn: अलम्बुषः श्रुतायुश्च जलसन्धश्च वीर्यवान्। सौमदत्तिविराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः॥ घटोत्कचादयश्चान्ये निहता द्रोणपर्वणि। अश्वत्थामाऽपि चात्रैव द्रोणे युधि निपातिते॥
