sn: एवं तयोक्तो भगवान्नीहारमसृजत्प्रभुः। येन देशः स सर्वस्तु तमोभूत इवाभवत्॥
en: Thus addressed by her, the illustrious lord (Parashara) created a fog, by which the whole place was covered with darkness.

sn: दृष्ट्वा सृष्टं तु नीहारं ततस्तं परमर्षिणा। विस्मिता साभवत्कन्या वीडिता च तपस्विनी॥
en: Seeing the sudden creation of the fog by the great Rishi, the girl was very much astonished and became suffused with blushes of bashfulness.

sn: । सत्यवत्युवाच विद्धि मां भगवन्कन्यां सदा पितृवशानुगाम्। त्वत्संयोगाच्च दुष्येत कन्याभावो ममानघ॥
en: Satyavati said : O holy Rishi, know me to be a girl under the control of my father, O sinless man, my virginity will be sullied by accepting your embraces.

sn: कन्यात्वे दूषिते वापि कथं शक्ष्ये द्विजोत्तम। गृहं गन्तुमृषे चाहं धीमन्न स्थातुमुत्सहे॥ एतत्संचिन्त्य भगवन्विधत्स्व यदनन्तरम्।
en: O best of Brahmanas, O Rishi, my virginity being sallied, how shall I be able to return home? I shall not then be able to bear life. O illustrious one, take all this into your (kind) consideration and do what is proper.

sn: वैशंपायन उवाच एवमुक्तवतीं तां तु प्रीतिमानृषिसत्तमः। उवाच मप्रियं त्वा कन्यैव त्वं भविष्यसि॥
en: Vaishampayana said : That best of Brahmanas, (Parashara), having been much pleased with all that she said, replied "you shall remain a virgin even after associating with me.

sn: वृणीष्व च वरं भीरु यं त्वमिच्छसि भाविनि। वृथा हि न प्रसादो मे भूतपूर्वः शुचिस्मिते॥
en: O timid girl, O beauteous maiden, ask from me any boon you desire to have. O beauty of sweet smiles, my favour (boon) has never proved fruitless."

sn: एवमुक्ता वरं वने गात्रसौगन्ध्यमुत्तमम्। स चास्यै भगवान्प्रादान्मनसः काक्षितं भुवि॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the maiden (Satyavati) asked for the boon that her body might be sweet-scented; and the illustrious Rishi granted that wish of her heart.

sn: ततो लब्धवरा प्रीता स्त्रीभावगुणभूषिता। जगाम सह संसर्गमृषिणाद्भुतकर्मणा॥
en: Having obtained the boon, she became exceedingly pleased. She was in her season and she accepted the embraces of that Rishi of wonderful deeds.

sn: तेन गन्धवतीत्येवं नामास्याः प्रथितं भुवि। तस्यास्तु योजनाद्गन्धमाजिघ्रन्त नरा भुवि॥
en: Thenceforth she become known among men by the name of Gandhavati (sweetscented.) Men could smell sweet scent of her body from a distance of a Yojana.

sn: तस्या योजनगन्धेति ततो नामापरं स्मृतम्। ततः परं स भगवान् जगाम स्वगृहं प्रति॥
en: Thence she was also called Yojanagandha. After all this, the illustrious Parashara went away to his home (hermitage).

sn: इति सत्यवती हृष्टा लब्ध्वा वरमनुत्तमम्। पराशरेण संयुक्ता सद्यो गर्भ सुषाव सा॥
en: Satyavati was exceedingly pleased to receive the excellent boon and she thereupon, on that very day, conceived through the embraces of Parashara.

sn: जज्ञे च यमुनाद्वीपे पाराशर्यः स वीर्यवान्। स मातरमनुज्ञाप्य तपस्येव मनो दधे॥
en: She gave birth on an island in the Yamuna, a greatly powerful child, begotten on her by Parashara; and the child with the permission of her mother adopted asceticism.

sn: स्मृतोऽहं दर्शयिष्यामि कृत्येष्विति च सोऽब्रवीत्। एवं द्वैपायनो जज्ञे सत्यवत्यां पराशरात्॥
en: man He went away saying, “As soon as I shall be remembered by you on any occasion, I shall (immediately) appear before you.” Thus was born Dvaipayana in the womb of Satyavati by Parashara.

sn: न्यस्तो द्वीपे स यद्वालस्तस्माद्वैपायनः स्मृतः। पादापसारिणं धर्मं स तु विद्वान्युगे युगे॥
en: Because he was born on an island, he was called Dvaipayana. That learned (Dvaipayana), knowing that Dharma would become lame by one leg at each Yuga,

sn: आयुः शक्तिं च मर्त्यानां युगावस्थामवेक्ष्य च। ब्रह्मणो ब्राह्मणानां च तथानुग्रहकाझ्या॥
en: And that the period of human life and strength would follow the Yuga (by becoming shorter and lesser) and moved by the desire of obtaining the favour of Brahma and the Brahmanas,

sn: विव्यास वेदान्यस्मात्स तस्माद्व्यास इति स्मृतः। वेदानध्यापयामास महाभारतपञ्चमान्॥
en: Arranged the Vedas and thence he came to be called Vyasa. He then taught the Vedas and the fifth Veda Mahabharata.

sn: सुमन्तुं जौमिनि पैलं शुकं चैव स्वमात्मजम्। प्रभुर्वरिष्ठो वरदो वैशंपायनमेव च॥
en: To Sumanta, Jaimini, Paila, his own son Shuka and his disciple Vaishampayana (myself).

sn: संहितास्तैः पृथक्त्वेन भारतस्य प्रकाशिताः। तथा भीष्मः शान्तनवो गङ्गायाममितद्युतिः॥ वसुवीर्यात् समभवन्महावीर्यो महायशाः। वेदार्थविच्च भगवानृषिविप्रो महायशाः॥
en: The Bharata Sanhita was published by him separately through these men. Then was born in the womb of Ganga by Shantanu, Bhishma, of great energy, fame and immeasurable prowess. There was an illustrious and famous Rishi. learned in the interpretation of the Vedas,

sn: शूले प्रोतः पुराणर्षिरचौरचौरशङ्कया। अणीमाण्डव्य इत्येवं विख्यातः स महायशाः॥
en: That greatly famous man was known by the name of Animandavya. Though innocent, he was accused of theft and was put on a Suli.

sn: स धर्ममाहूय पुरा महर्षिरिदमुक्तवान्। इषिकया मया बाल्याद्विद्धा ह्येका शकुन्तिका॥
en: Thereupon, the great Rishi called Dharma and addressed him thus, “In my childhood I pierced a little fly with a blade of grass."

sn: तत्किल्बिषं स्मरे धर्म नान्यत्पापमहं स्मरे। तन्मे सहस्रममितं कस्मान्नेहाजयत्तपः॥
en: O Dharma, I remember this sin of mine; I cannot remember any other. I have since practised asceticism thousand fold. Has not that one sin of mine been expitiated by my great asceticism?

sn: गरीयान्ब्राह्मणवधः सर्वभूतवधाद्यतः। तस्मात्त्वं किल्बिषी धर्म शूद्रयोनौ जनिष्यसि॥
en: The killing of a Brahmana is more heinous than any other sin in the world; (As you kill me) O Dharma, you shall take birth on earth, (and that too) in the Shudra caste.

sn: तेन शापेन धर्मोऽपि शूद्रयोनावजायत। विद्वान्विदुररूपेण धार्मी तनुरकिल्बिषी॥
en: Thus being cursed, Dharma was born as a Shudra as Vidura who was learned, virtuous and pure-bodied.

sn: संजयो मुनिकल्पस्तु जज्ञे सुतो गवल्गणात्। सूर्याच्च कुन्तिकन्याया जज्ञे कर्णो महाबलः॥
en: The Suta, Sanjaya, who was like a Rishi, was begot by Gavalgana and the greatly powerful Karna was begot by Surya of Kunti when she was a maid.

sn: सहजं कवचं बिभ्रत्कुण्डलोद्योतिताननः। अनुग्रहार्थं लोकानां विष्णुर्लोकनमस्कृतः॥
en: He came out of his mother's womb with a natural coat of mail and with a face beautified by ear-rings. For the benefit of the whole world, the world-wide famous.

sn: वसुदेवात्तु देवक्या प्रादुर्भूतो महायशाः। अनादिनिधनो देवः स कर्ता जगतः प्रभुः॥
en: Vishnu himself, the worshipped deity of all the worlds, was begot by Vasudeva on Devaki. He is the great God without birth and death; he is the creator and lord of the universe.

sn: अव्यक्तमक्षरं ब्रह्म प्रधानं त्रिगुणात्मकम्। आत्मानमव्ययं चैव प्रकृति प्रभवं प्रभुम्॥
en: He is called by the learned the invisible cause of all, he knows no deterioration, he is the first Brahma, he is the abode of the three qualities (Satya, Raja and Tama), he is the great soul, he is undeteriorating, he is the first, the cause of the creation, the Nature, the controlling Lord.

sn: पुरुषं विश्वकर्माणं सत्त्वयोगं ध्रुवाक्षरम्। अनन्तमचलं देवं हंसं नारायणं प्रभुम्॥
en: He is the Purusha, the Creator himself, he is the centre of Satya Guna, he is infinite, he is incapable of being moved, he is the deity, he is Lord Narayana;

sn: धातारमजमव्यक्तं यमाहुः परमव्ययम्। कैवल्यं निर्गुणं विश्वमनादिमजमव्ययम्॥
en: He is Dhata, he is undeteriorating, he is effulgent, he is the best, he is the great combiner, the increate, the invisible essence of all and the great immutable. He is bereft of those attributes that are knowable by the senses, he is the universe itself without beginning, birth and decay.

sn: पुरुषः स विभुः कर्ता सर्वभूतपितामहः। धर्मसंवर्धनार्थाय प्रजज्ञेऽन्धकवृष्णिषु॥
en: This great being, possessed of infinite wealth, this Grandsire of all creatures, took his birth in the race of Andhaka Vrishnis, in order to increase the piety in the world.

sn: अस्त्रज्ञौ तु महावीर्यो सर्वशास्त्रविशारदौ। सात्यकिः कृतवर्मा च नारायणमनुव्रतौ॥
en: Satyaki and Kritavarma, learned in the science of arms, possessed of great prowess, well versed in all the Shastras, ever obedient to Narayana,

sn: सत्यकाद्धदिकाच्चैव जज्ञातेऽस्त्रविशारदौ। भरद्वाजस्य-स्कन्नं द्रोण्यां शुक्रमवर्धत॥ महर्षेरुग्रतपसस्तस्माद्रोणो व्यजायत। गौतमान्मिथुनं जज्ञे शरस्तम्बाच्छरद्वतः॥ अश्वत्थाम्नश्च जननी कृपश्चैव महाबलः। अश्वत्थामा ततो जज्ञे द्रोणादेव महाबलः॥
en: And expert in the use of arms, were begot by Satyaki and Hridika. The seed of the great ascetic Rishi Bharadvaja was kept in a pot and there it began to develop. From that seed was born Drona. From the seed of Gautama, fallen on a heap of reeds, were born a twin, Kripa of great strength and (Kripi), the mother of Ashvathama; and then was begotten mighty Ashvathama by Drona.

sn: तथैव धृष्टद्युम्नोऽपि साक्षादग्निसमद्युतिः। वैताने कर्मणि ततः पावकात्समजायत॥
en: Then was born, from the sacrificial fire, Dhristadyumna, as effulgent as the fire itself.

sn: वीरो द्रोणविनाशाय धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्। तत्रैव वेद्यां कृष्णापि जज्ञे तेजस्विनी शुभा॥
en: The mighty hero was bom, a bow in his hand, in order to kill Drona hereafter. From the sacrificial altar was born Krishnaa (Draupadi), resplendent and handsome.

sn: विभ्राजमाना वपुषा बिभ्रती रूपमुत्तमम्। प्रह्लादशिष्यो नग्नजित्सुबलश्चाभवत्ततः॥
en: A girl of fascinating features and great beauty. Then was born the disciples of Pralhad, namely Nagnajit and Subala.

sn: तस्य प्रजा धर्महन्त्री जज्ञे देवप्रकोपनात्। गान्धारराजपुत्रोऽभूच्छकुनिः सौबलस्तथा॥
en: Subala begot a son, named Shakuni, who through the curse of the celestials, became an enemy of virtue and a destroyer of creatures. And (Subala begot) a daughter,

sn: दुर्योधनस्य जननी जज्ञातेऽर्थविशारदौ। कृष्णद्वैपायनाज्जज्ञे धृतराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः॥
en: Who became the mother of Duryodhana and both of them were well versed in acquiring worldly profits. From Krishna Dvaipayana was born Dhritarashtra, the king of men.

sn: क्षेत्रे विचित्रवीर्यस्य पाण्डुश्चैव महाबलः। धर्मार्थकुशलो धीमान्मेधावी धूतकल्मषः॥ विदुरः शूद्रयोनौ तु जज्ञे द्वैपायनादपि। पाण्डोस्तु जज्ञिरे पञ्च पुत्रा देवसमाः पृथक्॥
en: And Pandu of great strength, both in the wombs of the wives of Vichitravirya and from him was also born in the womb of a Shudra woman, the wise and intelligent Vidura, learned in both Dharma and Artha and free from all sins. Five sons were born of Pandu,

sn: द्वयोः स्त्रियोर्गुणज्येष्ठस्तेषामासीधुधिष्ठिरः। धर्माधुधिष्ठिरो जज्ञे मारुताच्च वृकोदरः॥
en: In the wombs of his two wives. Yudhishthira was the son of the eldest. Yudhishthira was born of Dharma, Vrikodara Bhima was born of Maruta;

sn: इन्द्राद्धनंजयः श्रीमान्सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। जज्ञाते रूपसंपन्नावश्विभ्यां च यमावपि॥ नकुलः सहदेवश्च गुरुशुश्रूषणे रतौ। तथा पुत्रशतं जज्ञे धृतराष्ट्रस्य धीमतः॥
en: The first of all, the best wielder of the arms, illustrious Arjuna was born of Indra; and Nakula and Sahadeva of handsome features, ever-engaged in the services of their superiors, were born of the twin Ashvinis. One hundred sons were born to the wise Dhritarashtra,

sn: दुर्योधनप्रभृतयो युयुत्सुः करणस्तथा॥
en: Namely Duryodhana and others and another son, named Yuyutsu (born of a Vaisya woman).

sn: ततो दुःशासनश्चैव दुःसहश्चापि भारत। दुर्मर्षणो विकर्णश्च चित्रसेनो विविंशतिः॥ जयः सत्यव्रतश्चैव पुरुमित्रश्च भारत। वैश्यापुत्रो युयुत्सुश्च एकादश महारथाः॥ अभिमन्युः सुभद्रायामर्जुनादभ्यजायत।
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, amongst those one hundred sons, eleven, namely Dushasana, Dussaha, Durmarshana, Vikarna, Chitrasena, Vivingsati, Jaya, Satyavrata, Purumitra and Yuyutsu of Vaisya wife, were all great car-warriors. Abhimanyu was born of Subhadra,

sn: स्वस्त्रीयो वासुदेवस्य पौत्रः पाण्डोर्महात्मनः। पाण्डवेभ्यो हि पाञ्चाल्यां द्रौपद्यां पञ्च जज्ञिरे॥
en: The sister of Vasudeva (Krishna), begot by Arjuna and therefore he was the grandson of Pandu. Five sons were born to the five Pandavas by Draupadi, the daughter of Panchala.

sn: कुमारा रूपसंपन्नाः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदाः। प्रतिविन्ध्यो युधिष्ठिरात्सुतसोमो वृकोदरात्॥
en: These princes were all very handsome and learned in all the Shastras. From Yudhishthira was born Prativindhya, from Bhima was born Sutasoma,

sn: अर्जुनाच्छ्रुतकीर्तिस्तु शतानीकस्तु नाकुलिः। तथैव सहदेवाच्च श्रुतसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: From Arjuna was born Shrutakirti, from Nakula was born Shatanika and from Sahadeva was born the greatly powerful Shrutasena.

sn: हिडिम्बायां च भीमेन वने जज्ञे घटोत्कचः। शिखण्डी दुपदाज्जज्ञे कन्या पुत्रत्वमागता॥
en: Bhima begot a son in the forest on Hidimba, named Ghatotkacha. Drupada gave birth to a daughter also, named Shikhandini and she was transformed into a male child.

sn: यां यक्षः पुरुषं चक्रे स्थूणः प्रियचिकीर्षया। करुणां विग्रहे तस्मिन्समागच्छन्बहून्यथा॥ राज्ञां शतसहस्राणि योत्स्यमानानि संयुगे। तेषामपरिमेयानां नामधेयानि सर्वशः॥ न शक्यानि समाख्यातुं वर्षाणामयुतैरपि। एते तु कीर्तिता मुख्या यैराख्यानमिदं ततम्॥
en: She was thus transformed into a male child by a Yaksha, named Sthuna, who did it from the desire of doing her good. In that great battle of Kurus assembled many hundred of kings and potentates to fight among one another. I am unable to recount the names of those innumerable hosts. I have named only the principal ones who have been mentioned in this history (Mahabharata).

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: जनमेजय उवाच य एते कीर्तिता ब्रह्मन्ये चान्ये नानुकीर्तिताः। सम्यक् ताञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि राज्ञश्चान्यान्सहस्रशः॥
en: Janamejaya said : O Brahmana, I wish to hear in detail the accounts of those that you have named and of those that you have not named and other kings and potentates by thousands.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: यदर्थमिह संभूता देवकल्पा महारथाः। भुवि तन्मे महाभाग सम्यगाख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: O great man, you should tell me in full the object for which these great car-warriors, all equal to the celestials, were born on earth.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: वैशंपायन उवाच रहस्यं खल्विदं राजन्देवानामिति नः श्रुतम्। तत्तु ते कथयिष्यामि नमस्कृत्वा स्वयंभुवे॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, we have heard that what you ask is a mystery even to the celestials. I shall however, speak of it, after bowing my head to the Self-Born (Brahma).

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: त्रिःसप्तकृत्वः पृथिवीं कृत्वा निःक्षत्रियां पुरा। जामदग्न्यस्तपस्तेपे महेन्द्रे पर्वतोत्तमे॥
en: The son of Jamadagni, (Parshurama), after making the earth bereft of Kshatriyas for twenty-one times, went to the best of the mountains, named Mahendra and began his penances.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: तदा निःक्षत्रिये लोके भार्गवेण कृते सति। ब्राह्मणाक्षत्रिया राजन्सुतार्थिन्योऽभिचक्रमुः॥
en: O king, when the earth was thus bereft of Kshatriyas, the Kshatriya women used to come to the Brahmanas for offspring.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: ताभिः सह समापेतुर्ब्राह्मणाः संशितव्रताः। ऋतावृतौ नरव्याघ्र न कामाननृतौ तथा॥
en: O best of men, the Brahmanas had connections with them only at their seasons and not when they were not in their seasons and they the Brahmans did not do it with lust.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: तेभ्यश्च लेभिरे गर्भ क्षत्रियास्ताः सहस्रशः। ततः सुषुविरे राजन्क्षत्रियान्वीर्यवत्तरान्॥
en: Thus thousands of Kshatriya women conceived through these connections with the Brahmanas and O king, thus were born many Kshatriyas of great prowess,

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: कुमाराश्च कुमारीश्च पुनः क्षत्राभिवृद्धये। एवं तद्ब्राह्मणै क्षत्रं क्षत्रियासु तपस्विभिः॥
en: And many boys and girls, in order to thrive the Kshatriya race. Thus sprang the Kshatriya race from Kshatriya women from their connections with ascetic Brahmanas.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: जातं वृद्धं च धर्मेण सुदीर्घेणायुधान्वितम्। चत्वारोऽपि ततो वर्णा बभूवुर्ब्राह्मणोत्तराः॥
en: The new generation, blessed with long life, began to thrive in virtue and thus were again established the four castes having Brahmanas at their head.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: अभ्यगच्छन्नृतौ नारी न कामानानृतौ तथा। तथैवान्यानि भूतानि तिर्यग्योनिगतान्यपि॥ ऋतौ दारांश्च गच्छन्ति तत्तथा भरतर्षभ। ततो वर्धन्त धर्मेण सहस्रशतजीविनः॥
en: At the time (of which I speak), every man went to his wife only at the time of her season and never from lust or when she was not at her season. Other creatures also, even those that were born in the race of birds, followed this example. O best of the Bharata race, thus were born hundreds and thousands of creatures and they all thrived in virtue.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: ताः प्रजाः पृथिवीपाल धर्मव्रतपरायणाः। आधिभिर्व्याधिभिश्चैव विमुक्ताः सर्वशो नराः॥
en: O lord of the earth, all creatures were virtuous and religious and all men were free from sorrow and disease.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: अथेमां सागरापाङ्गी गां गजेन्द्रगताखिलाम्। अध्यतिष्ठत्पुनः क्षत्रं सशैलवनपत्तनाम्॥
en: O king having the walk of an elephant, thus once more, the wide earth, with the ocean for her boundaries, with her mountains and woods and towns was governed by the Kshatriyas.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: प्रशासति पुनः क्षत्रे धर्मेणेमां वसुंधराम्। ब्राह्मणाद्यास्ततो वर्णा लेभिरे मुदमुत्तमाम्॥
en: When thus the earth was again governed virtuously by the Kshatriyas, the other castes, having Brahmanas at their head, were filled with great joy.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: कामक्रोधोद्भवान्दोषान्निरस्य च नराधिपाः। धर्मेण दण्डं दण्ड्येषु प्रणयन्तोऽन्वपालयन्॥
en: All the kings (of the world), becoming free from vices born of lust and anger and punishing those that deserved punishment, protected the earth.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: तथा धर्मपरे क्षत्रे सहस्राक्ष: शतक्रतुः। स्वादु देशे च काले च वर्षेणापालयत्प्रजाः॥
en: And (Indra) the deity that performed one hundred sacrifices and who has one thousand eyes, seeing that all the Kshatriya sovereigns ruled their kingdoms very virtuously, poured down vivifying showers of rains at the proper time and at the proper place and thus protected all creatures.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: न बाल एव प्रियते सदा कश्चिचज्जनाधिप। न च स्त्रियं प्रजानाति कश्चिदप्राप्तयौवनः॥
en: O king, no one died in early age and none took to wife before attaining to age.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: एवमायुष्मतीभिस्तु प्रजाभिर्भरतर्षभ। इयं सागरपर्यन्ता समापूर्यत मेदिनी॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, thus was filled the earth to the very shores of the sea with long-lived men.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: ईजिरे च महायज्ञैः क्षत्रिया बहुदक्षिणैः। साङ्गोपनिषदान्वेदान्विप्राश्चाधीयते तदा।॥
en: The Kshatriyas performed great sacrifices and bestowed much wealth on the Brahmanas and all the Brahmanas also studied the Vedas and the Vedangas and the Upanishads.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: न च विक्रीणते ब्रह्म ब्राह्मणाश्च तदा नृप। न च शूद्रसमाभ्यासे वेदानुच्चारयन्त्युत॥
en: O king, no Brahmana ever sold the Vedas and none of them ever read them aloud before a Shudra.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: कारयन्तः कृर्षि गोभिस्तथा वैश्याः क्षिताविह। युञ्जते धुरि नो गाश्च कृशां गांश्चाप्यजीवयन्॥
en: The Vaishyas tilled well the earth with the help of bullocks and they never yoked kine to the plough. They carefully fed the lean ones.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: फेनपांश्च तथा वत्सान्न दुहन्ति स्म मानवाः। न कूटमानैर्वणिजः पण्यं विक्रीणते तदा॥
en: Men never milched the cows as long as the calves could not live on the milk of their mothers. No merchant sold his goods with false scales.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: कर्माणि च नरव्याघ्र धर्मोपतानि मानवाः। धर्ममेवानुपश्यन्तश्चक्रुर्धर्मपरायणाः॥
en: O best of men, all men, thus virtuously inclined, did every thing with their eyes fixed on virtue.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: स्वकर्मनिरताश्चासन्सर्वे वर्णा नराधिप। एवं तदा नरव्याघ्र धर्मो न ह्रसते क्वचित्॥
en: O king, all men of all castes were mindful of the respective duties of their respective castes. O best of men, their virtue never sustained any diminution.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: काले गाव: प्रसूयन्ते नार्यश्च भरतर्षभ। भवन्त्य॒तुषु वृक्षाणां पुष्पाणि च फलानि च।॥
en: Both women and kine gave birth to offspring at the proper time and trees bore flowers and fruits at their proper seasons.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: एवं कृतयुगे सम्यग्वर्तमाने तदा नृप। आपूर्यत मही कृत्स्ना प्राणिभिर्बहुभिर्भृशम्॥
en: O king, the Krita (Satya) Yuga having come into the world, the whole earth was filled with numerous beings.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: एवं समुदिते लोके मानुषे भरतर्षभ। असुरा जज्ञिरे क्षेत्रे राज्ञां तु मनुजेश्वर॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O lord of men, when such was the happy state of the world, the Asuras began to take birth in royal dynasties.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: आदित्यैर्हि तदा दैत्या बहुशो निर्जिता युधि। ऐश्वर्याभ्रंशिताः स्वर्गात्संबभूवुः क्षिताविह॥
en: The sons of Diti, (the Asuras), having been continually defeated by the sons of Aditi, (the celestials) and deprived of sovereignty and heaven, began to take birth on earth.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: इह देवत्वमिच्छन्तो मानुषेषु मनस्विनः। जज्ञिरे भुवि भूतेषु तेषु तेष्वसुरा विभो॥ गोष्वश्वेषु च राजेन्द्र खरोष्ट्रमहिषेषु च। क्रव्यात्सु चैव भूतेषु गजेषु च मृगेषु च॥
en: O king, wishing to enjoy sovereignty in this earth, the powerful Asuras took birth among humens, cows, horses, mules, camels, buffaloes, elephants, deer; they also took birth as Rakshasas and others.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: जातैरिह महीपाल जायमानैश्च तैर्मही। न शशाकात्मनात्मानमियं धारयितुं धरा॥
en: O protector of the world, owing to the birth of those (Asuras) that were already born and those that were being born, the Earth became incapable of supporting herself.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: अथ जाता महीपालाः केचिद्बहुमदान्विताः। दितेः पुत्रा दनोश्चैव तदा लोक इहाच्युताः॥
en: Amongst the sons of Diti and Danu, some, being thrown off from heaven, took birth as men and became proud and insolent monarchs on earth.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: वीर्यवन्तोऽवलिप्तास्ते नानारूपधरा महीम्। इमां सागरपर्यन्तां परीयुररिमर्दनाः॥
en: Possessed of great prowess, they covered the earth in various shapes. They, becoming great oppressors, filled the earth to the very shores of the sea.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: ब्राह्मणान्क्षत्रियान्वैश्यान्शूद्रांश्चैवाप्यपीडयन्। अन्यानि चैव सत्त्वानि पीडयामासुरोजसा॥
en: They began to oppress the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras; they began to persecute all other creatures with their strength.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: त्रासयन्तोऽभिनिनन्तः सर्वभूतगणांश्च ते। विचेसः सर्वशो राजन्महीं शतसहस्रशः॥
en: O king, frightening and killing all creatures, they roamed over the earth in hundred and thousands.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: आश्रमस्थान्महर्षीश्च धर्षयन्तस्ततस्ततः। अब्रह्मण्या वीर्यमदा मत्ता मदबलेन च॥
en: Bereft of virtue and truth, proud of their strength, intoxicated with their insolence, they even insulted the holy Rishis in their hermitages.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: एवं वीर्यबलोसिक्तैर्भूरियत्नैर्महासुरैः। पीड्यमाना मही राजन्ब्रह्माणमुपचक्रमे॥
en: O king, the earth, thus oppressed by the Asuras of great strength, energy and abundant means, thought of appealing to Brahma.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: न हमीभूतसत्त्वौघाः पन्नगाः सनगां महीम्। तदा धारयितुं शेकुः संक्रान्तां दानवैर्वलात्॥
en: The united strength of the Naga Shesha and other creatures (such as the tortoise and the elephant), could not support the earth, attacked by the powerful Danavas.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: ततो मही महीपाल भारार्ता भयपीडिता। जगाम शरणं देवं सर्वभूतपितामहम्॥
en: O protector of the world, thereupon the Earth, afflicted with fear and oppressed by the weight (of the Danavas went to the Grandfather of all creatures and asked his protection.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: सा संवृतं महाभागैर्देवद्विजमहर्षिभिः। ददर्श देवं ब्रह्माणं लोककर्तारमव्ययम्॥ गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च दैवकर्मसु निष्ठितः। वन्द्यमानं मुदोपेतैर्ववन्दे चैनमेत्य सा॥
en: She saw the divine Brahma, the creator of the worlds, who is undeteriorating, seated (on his seat), surrounded by the celestials and great and illustrious Rishis and adored by the delighted Gandharvas and Apsaras who are always engaged in the services of the celestials.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: अथ विज्ञापयामास भूमिस्तं शरणार्थिनी। संनिधौ लोकपालानां सर्वेषामेव भारत॥
en: The Earth adored the Grandsire and O best of the Bharata race, telling him all that had happened, before all the regents of the world she asked his protection.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: तत्प्रधानात्मनस्तस्य भूमेः कृत्यं स्वयंभुवः। पूर्वमेवाभवद्राजन्विदितं परमेष्ठिनः॥
en: O king, the object (for which she came) was already known beforehand to the Omniscient, Self-created and Supreme Lord.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: स्रष्टा हि जगतः कस्मान्न संबुध्यते भारत। ससुरासुरलोकानामशषेण मनोगतम्॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race he is the creator of the universe, why should he not know fully what is in the minds of the creatures, including the very Devas and the Danavas?

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: तामुवाच महाराज भूमि भूमिपतिः प्रभुः। प्रभवः सर्वभूतानामीशः शंभुः प्रजापतिः॥
en: O great king, the Lord of the earth, Prajapati, Isha, Shambhu, then thus spoke to her.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: ब्रह्मोवाच यदर्थमभिसंप्राप्ता मत्सकाशं वसुंधरे। तदर्थं संनियोक्ष्यामि सर्वानेव दिवौकसः॥
en: Brahma said: O Vasundhara (the holder of wealth,) I shall appoint all the dwellers of heaven in the work for which you have come to me.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: वैशंपायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा स महीं देवो ब्रह्मा राजन्विसृज्य च। आदिदेश तदा सर्वान्विबुधान्भूतकृत्स्वयम्॥ अस्या भूमेनिरसितुं भारं भागैः पृथक्पृथक्। अस्यामेव प्रसूयध्वं विरोधायेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, having thus addressed the Earth, the divine Brahma, bade her farewell. Then the Creator commanded all the celestials, saying, "All of you go and take your birth on earth to free her from her burden. Go according to your respective parts and seek battles (with the Danavas).

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: तथैव च समानीय गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणान्। उवाच भगवान्सर्वानिदं वचनमर्थवत्॥
en: Then the creator of all the creatures, calling all the tribes of the Gandharvas and Apsaras, spoke to them thus, “All of you go and take your birth amongst men according to your respective parts and in the forms you prefer.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: ब्रह्मोवाच स्वैः स्वैरंशैः प्रसूयध्वं यथेष्टं मानुषेषु च। अथ शक्रादयः सर्वे सर्वे श्रुत्वा सुरगुरोर्वचः। तथ्यमर्थ्यं च पथ्यं च तस्य ते जगृहुस्तदा॥
en: All the celestials with Indra at their head, having heard these words of the lord of the celestials, words that were true, that were desirable under the circumstances and which were fraught with benefit, accepted them.

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: अथ ते सर्वशोऽशैः स्वैर्गन्तुं भूमि कृतक्षणाः। नारायणममित्रघ्नं वैकुण्ठमुपचक्रमुः॥
en: Having then resolved to take birth on the earth according to their respective parts, they all went to Vaikuntha to the slayer of foes, Narayana,

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: यः स चक्रगदापाणि: पीतवासा: शितिप्रभः। पद्मनाभः सुरारिघ्नः पृथुचार्वञ्चितेक्षणः॥
en: Who bears the discus and the mace in his hands, who wears yellow coloured cloth, who is greatly effulgent, who has the lotus in his navel, who is the slayer of the foes of the celestials, who is fixedly staring at his wide chest,

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: प्रजापतिपतिर्देवः सुरनाथो महाबलः। श्रीवत्साङ्को हृषीकेशः सर्वदैवतपूजितः॥
en: Who is the lord of the Prajapati (Brahma) himself, who is the sovereign of all the gods, who is of infinite strength, who has the mark of the auspicious wheel on his breast, who is the central force of every one's faculties and who is adored by all the deities;

description: Brief account of incarnation of gods etc.
sn: तं भुव: शोधनायेन्द्र उवाच पुरुषोत्तमम्। अंशेनावतरेत्येवं तथेत्याह च तं हरिः॥
en: To him, this most exalted of all persons, Indra said, “Be incarnate." And Hari replied, "Be it so."

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: वैशंपायन उवाच अथ नारायणेनेन्द्रश्चकार सह संविदम्। अवतर्तुं महीं स्वर्गादंशतः सहितः सुरैः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon, Hari held a consultation with Indra regarding his incarnation on earth with all the celestials according to their respective parts.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: आदिश्य च स्वयं शक्रः सर्वानेव दिवौकसः। निर्जगाम पुनस्तस्मात्क्षयान्नारायणस्य ह॥
en: Having then ordered the celestials, (what they should all do), Indra returned from the abode of Hari (Vaikuntha).

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: तेऽमरारिविनाशाय सर्वलोकहिताय च। अवतेरुः क्रमेणैव महीं स्वर्गादिवौकसः॥
en: races The dwellers of heaven then, one after the other, took birth on earth for the destruction of the Asuras and for the welfare of the three worlds.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: ततो ब्रह्मार्षिवंशेषु पार्थिवर्षिकुलेषु च। जज्ञिरे राजशार्दूल यथाकामं दिवौकसः॥
en: O best of kings, the celestials, as each preferred, took birth in the of Brahmarshis and Rajarshis.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: दानवानाक्षसांश्चैव गन्धर्वान्पन्नागांस्तथा। पुरुषादानि चान्यानि जनुः सत्त्वान्यनेकशः॥
en: They killed the Danavas, Rakshasas, Gandharvas, Nagas and other cannibals and creatures.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: दानवा राक्षसाश्चैव गन्धर्वाः पन्नगास्तथा। न तान्बलस्थान्बाल्येऽपि जघ्नुर्भरतसत्तम॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the Danavas, Rakshasas, Gandharvas and Nagas could not kill the (incarnate) celestials, even in their infancy, so strong were they.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: जनमेजय उवाच देवदानवसङ्घानां गन्धर्वाप्सरसां तथा। मानवानां च सर्वेषां तथा वै यक्षरक्षसाम्॥ श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वेन संभवं कृत्स्नमादितः। प्राणिनां चैव सर्वेषां संभवं वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Janamejaya said : I desire to hear the accounts of the births of the Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Apsaras, Manavas, Yakshas and Rakshasas from their beginning. Therefore, you should tell me all about the births of creatures.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: वैशंपायन उवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि नमस्कृत्य स्वयंभुवे। सुरादीनामहं सम्यग्लोकानां प्रभवाप्ययम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Bowing down my head to the Self-created (Brahma), I shall narrate to you in detail the origin of the celestials and of all creatures.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: ब्रह्मणो मानसाः पुत्रा विदिता षण्महर्षयः। मरीचिरत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः॥
en: Brahma had six mind-born sons, (created out of his mind), namely Marichi, Atri, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha and Kratu.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: मरीचेः कश्यपः पुत्रः कश्यपात्तु इमाः प्रजाः। प्रजज्ञिरे महाभागा दक्षकन्यास्त्रयोदश॥
en: Marichi had a son, named Kashyapa and from Kashyapa have sprung all creatures. Daksha begot thirteen illustrious daughters.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: अदितिदितिर्दनुः काला दनायुः सिंहिका तथा। क्रोधा प्राधा च विश्वा च विनता कपिला मुनिः॥ कदूश्च मनुजव्याघ्र दक्षकन्यैव भारत। एतासां वीर्यसंपन्नं पुत्रपौत्रमनन्तकम्॥
en: O best of kings, the daughters, of Daksha, were Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kala, Danayu, Sinhika, Krodha, Pradha, Vishva, Vinata, Kapila, Muni and Kadru. The sons and grandsons of these daughters, all of exceeding prowess, were infinite in number.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: अदित्यां द्वादशादित्याः संभूता भुवनेश्वराः। ये राजन्नामतस्तांस्ते कीर्तयिष्यामि भारत॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, from Aditi were born the twelve. Adityas, who were all lords of the Universe. I shall now mention them to you according to their names.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: धाता मित्रोऽर्यमा शक्रो वरुणस्त्वंश एव च। भगो विवस्वान्पूषा च सविता दशमस्तथा॥
en: (They were) Dhata, Mitra, Aryama, Shakra, Varuna, Ansha, Bhaga, Vivasvan, Pusha and Savita, the tenth.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: एकादशस्तथा त्वष्टा द्वादशो विष्णुरुच्यते। जघन्यजस्तु सर्वेषामादित्यानां गुणाधिकः॥
en: The eleventh was Tvashtri and the twelvth was Vishnu. The youngest, however, was the best in merit.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: एक एव दितेः पुत्रो हिरण्यकशिपुः स्मृतः। नाम्नाख्यातास्तु तस्येमे पञ्च पुत्रा महात्मनः॥
en: Diti had only son, named Hiranyakashipu and the illustrious Hiranyakashipu had five sons, famous all over the world.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: प्रह्लादः पूर्वजस्तेषां संह्लादस्तदनन्तरम्। अनुह्लादस्तृतीयोऽभूत्तस्माच्च शिबिबाष्कलौ॥
en: one The eldest was Prahlada, the next was Sanhlada, the third was Anuhlada, the fourth was Sibi and the youngest was Bashkala.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: प्रह्लादस्य त्रयः पुत्राः ख्याता: सर्वत्र भारत। विरोचनश्च कुम्भश्च निकुम्भश्चेति भारत॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, it is known everywhere that Prahlada had three sons, namely Virochana, Kumbha and Nikumbha.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: विरोचनस्य पुत्रोऽभूद्वलिरेकः प्रतापवान्। बलेश्च प्रथित: पुत्रो बाणो नाम महासुरः॥
en: Virochana's son was greatly powerful Bali and the son of Bali was the great Asura Bana.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: रुद्रस्यानुचरः श्रीमान्महाकालेति यं विदुः। चतुस्त्रिंशद् दनोः पुत्राः ख्याताः सर्वत्र भारत॥
en: He (Bana) was blessed with great fortune; he was a follower of Rudra and was, also known by the name of Mahakala.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: तेषां प्रथमजो राजा विप्रचित्तिर्महायशाः। शम्बरो नमुचिश्चैव पुलोमा चेति विश्रुतः॥ असिलोमा च केशी च दुर्जयश्चैव दानवः। अय:शिरा अश्वशिरा अश्वशङ्कुश्चवीर्यवान्॥ तथा गगनमूर्धा च वेगवान्केतुमांश्चसः। स्वर्भानुरश्वोऽश्वपतिवृषपर्वाजकस्तथा॥ अश्वग्रीवश्च सूक्ष्मश्च तुहुण्डश्च महाबलः। इषुपादेकचक्रश्च विरूपाक्षहराहरौ॥ निचन्द्रश्च निकुम्भश्च कुपटः कपटस्तथा। शरभः शलभश्चैव सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ तथा। एते ख्याता दनोवंशे दानवाः परिकीर्तिताः॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, Danu had thirty four sons, the eldest of them was the famous King Viprachitti. The others were Sambara, Namuchi, Puloma, Asiloma, Keshi, Durjaya, Ayashiras, Ashvashiras, Ashvashanku, Gaganamurdhan, Vegavan, Ketuman, Svarbhanu, Ashva, Ashvapati, Vrishaparva, Ajaka, Ashvagriva, Sukshma, Tuhunda, Ekapada, Ekachakra, Virupaksha, Hara, Ahara, Nichandra, Nikumbha, Kupata, Kapata, Sharabha, Shalabha, Surya and Chandrama.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: अन्यौ तु खलु देवानां सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ स्मृतौ। अन्यौ दानवमुख्यानां सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ तथा॥ इमे च वंशाः प्रथिताः सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः। दनुपुत्रा महाराज दश दानववंशजाः॥ एकाक्षो मृतपा वीरः प्रलम्बनरकावपि।
en: These were the well-known sons of Danu. Surya and Chandrama (the sun and the moon) of the celestials were other persons and they were not the sons of Danu. Besides the above, there were ten more powerful and great sons of Danu, namely Ekaksha, heroic Mritapa, Pralamba, Naraka.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: वातापी शत्रुतपन: शठश्चैव महासुरः। गविष्ठश्च वनायुश्च दीर्घजिह्वश्च दानवः॥
en: Vatapi, Shatrutapana, the great Asura Satha, Gavishtha, Vanayu and the Danava, named Dirghajihva.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: असंख्येयाः स्मृतास्तेषां पुत्राः पौत्राश्च भारत। सिंहिका सुषुवे पुत्रं राहुं चन्द्रार्कमर्दनम्॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, the sons and grandsons of the above were numberless. Simhika gave birth to a son, called Rahu, the persecutor of the sun and the moon,

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: सुचन्द्रं चन्द्रहर्तारं तथा चन्द्रप्रमर्दनम्। क्रूरस्वभावं क्रूरायाः पुत्रपौत्रमनन्तकम्॥
en: And (she gave birth to) three others, namely Suchandra, Chandraharta and Chandrapramardana. The numberless progeny of Krura was much wicked as she herself was.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: गणः क्रोधवशो नाम क्रूरकर्मारिमर्दनः। दनायुषः पुनः पुत्राश्चत्वारोऽसुरपुङ्गवाः॥
en: Their race was wrathful, of crooked deeds and the persecutors of foes. Danayu had four sons, the best among the Asuras.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: विक्षरो बलवीरौ च वृत्रश्चैव महासुरः। कालायाः प्रथिताः पुत्राः कालकल्पा प्रहारिणः।३४।
en: (They were) Vikshara, Bala, Vira and the great Asura Vritra. The sons of Kala were like Yama himself, all the slayers of their enemies.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: प्रविख्याता महावीर्या दानवेषु परंतपाः। विनाशनश्च क्रोधश्च क्रोधहन्ता तथैव च॥
en: They were greatly famous and powerful amongst the Danavas and were great oppressors of their enemies.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: क्रोधशत्रुस्तथैवान्ये कालकेया इति श्रुताः। असुराणामुपाध्यायः शुक्रस्त्वृषिसुतोऽभवत्॥
en: (They were) Vinashana, Krodha, Krodhahanta and Krodhashatru. These were the sons of Kala. As it is heard, there were also many others among the sons of Kala. Shukra, the son of a Rishi was the great preceptor of all the Asuras.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: ख्याताश्चोशनसः पुत्राश्चत्वारोऽसुरयाजकाः। त्वष्टाधरस्तथात्रिश्च द्वावन्यौ रौद्रकर्मिणौ॥
en: The illustrious Shukra had four sons who were also the preceptors of the Asuras. Their names were Tvashtadhara and Atri and two others of fearful deeds.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: तेजसा सूर्यसंकाशा ब्रह्मलोकपरायणाः। इत्येष वंशप्रभवः कथितस्ते तरस्विनाम्। असुराणां सुराणां च पुराणे संश्रुतो मया॥ एतेषां यदपत्यं तु न शक्यं तदशेषतः। प्रसंख्यातुं महीपाल गुणभूतमनन्तकम्॥
en: They were as effulgent as the sun himself. They were always engaged in acquiring the regions of Brahma. Thus have I narrated to you, as I heard them from the Purana, the accounts of the progeny of the Devas and the Danavas of great strength and power. The sons and grandsons, of these (Devas and Danavas) were so numberless that I am incapable of counting them.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: ताय॑श्चारिष्टनेमिश्च तथैव गरुडारुणौ। आरुणिर्वारुणिश्चैव वैनतेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः। शेषोऽनन्तो वासुकिश्च तक्षकश्च भुजंगमः॥
en: O protector of the world, the Tarkshya, Arishtanemi, Garuda, Arun, Aruni and Varuni were known to be the sons of Vinata. Shesha of Ananta, Vasuki, Takshaka,

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: कूर्मश्च कुलिकश्चैव काद्रवेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः। भीमसेनोग्रसेनौ च सुपर्णो वरुणस्तथा॥
en: Kurma and Kulika are known to be the sons of Kadru, Bhimasena, Ugrasena, Suparna, Varuna,

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: गोपतिधृतराष्ट्रश्च सूर्यवर्चाश्च सप्तमः। सत्यवागर्कपर्णश्च प्रयुतश्चापि विश्रुतः॥
en: Gopati, Dhritarashtra, Suryavarcha, Satyavarcha, Arkaparna, Prayuta,

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: भीमश्चित्ररथश्चैव विख्यातः सर्वविद्वशी। तथा शालिशिरा राजन्पर्जन्यश्च चतुर्दशः॥
en: Bhima and Chitraratha, all greatly famous, learned and self-controlled, then O king, was Shalishira, then fourteenth in the least, Parjanya,

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: कलिः पञ्चदशस्तेषां नारदश्चैव षोडशः। इत्येते देवगन्धर्वा मौनेयाः परिकीर्तिताः॥
en: The fifteenth, Kali and the sixteenth Narada; these Devagandharvas were known to be the sons of Muni.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: अथ प्रभूतान्यन्यानि कीर्तयिष्यामि भारत। अनवद्यां मनुं वंशामसुरां मार्गणप्रियाम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata race, I shall now mention many others. Anavadhya, Manu, Vansha, Asura, Marganapriya,

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: अरूपां सुभगां भासीमिति प्राधा व्यजायत। सिद्धं पूर्णश्च बर्हिश्च पूर्णायुश्च महायशाः॥
en: Arupa, Subhaga and Bhasi were the daughters of Pradha. Siddha, Purna, Barhi and famous Purnayu,

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: ब्रह्मचारी रतिगुणः सुपर्णश्चैव सप्तमः। विश्वावसुश्च भानुश्च सुचन्द्रो दशमस्तथा॥
en: Brahmachari, Ratiguna and Suparna, Vishvavasu, Bhanu and Suchandra:

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: इत्येते देवगन्धर्वाः प्राधायाः परिकीर्तिताः। मं त्वप्सरसां वंशं विदितं पुण्यलक्षणम्॥ प्राधाऽसूत महाभागा देवी देवर्षितः पुरा। अलम्बुषा मिश्रकेशी विद्युत्पर्णा तिलोत्तमा॥
en: These Devas and Gandharvas were also known to be the progeny of Pradha. It is also known that, that lady of good fortune Pradha, through the celestial Rishi (Kashyapa), brought forth the holy race of Apsaras, namely, Alambusha. Mishrakeshi, Vidyutaparna, Tilottama,

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: अरुणा रक्षिता चैव रम्भा तद्वन्मनोरमा। केशिनी च सुबाहुश्च सुरता सुरजा तथा॥ सुप्रिया चातिबाहुश्च विख्यातौ च हाहा हूहूः। तुम्बुस्चेति चत्वारः स्मृता गन्धर्वसत्तमाः॥
en: Aruna, Rakshita, Rambha, Manorama, Keshini, Subahu, Surata, Suraja and Supriya, these were the daughters (of Pradha). And Atibahu, celebrated Haha-Huhu and Tumburu, these four best of Gandharvas (were also the sons of Pradha.)

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: अमृतं ब्राह्मणा गावो गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा। अपत्यं कपिलायास्तु पुराणे परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: The Ambrosia, Brahmanas, the kine the Gandharvas and Apsaras were the offspring of Kapila, so is stated in the Purana.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: इति ते सर्वभूतानां संभवः कथितो मया। यथावत्संपरिख्यातो गन्धर्वाप्सरसां तथा॥
en: Thus have been narrated to you duly the births of all the creatures and of the Gandharvas, Apsaras.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: भुजंगानां सुपर्णानां रुद्राणां मरुतां तथा। गवां च ब्राह्मणानां च श्रीमतां पुण्यकर्मणाम्॥
en: Nagas, Suparnas, Rudras and Maruts, of the kine and of the fortunate and holy Brahmanas.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: आयुष्यश्चैव पुण्यश्च धन्यः श्रुतिसुखावहः। श्रोतव्यश्चैव सततं श्राव्यश्चैवानसूयता॥
en: This history, (if read or heard) extends period of life. It is sacred, it is worthy of all praise, it gives pleasure, if heard. It should be always heard and recited to others in a proper frame of mind.

description: Narration of race of Aditya etc.
sn: इमं तु वंशं नियमेन यः पठेत् महात्मनाः ब्राह्मणदेवसंनिधौ। अपत्यलाभं लभते स पुष्कलम् श्रियं यशः प्रेत्य च शोभनां गतिम्॥
en: He, who properly reads in the presence of the deities and Brahmanas, this account of the births of noble creature, obtains large progeny, good fortune and fame. He attains to the higher worlds hereafter.

sn: वैशंपायन उवाच ब्रह्मणो मानसाः पुत्रा विदिताः षण्महर्षयः। एकादश सुता: स्थाणोः ख्याता: परमतेजसः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : It is known that the mind-born sons of Brahma were six great Rishis. There was another (mind-borm son of Brahma,) named Sthanu. He had eleven sons gifted with great energy,

sn: मृगव्याधश्च सर्पश्च निर्ऋतिश्च महायशाः। अजैकपादहिर्बुघ्यः पिनाकी च परंतपः॥
en: Namely, Mrigavyadha, Sarpa, famous Niriti, Ajaikapada, Ahirbudhnya, the chastiser of his foes Pinaki.

sn: दहनोऽथेश्वरश्चैव कपाली च महाद्युतिः। स्थाणुर्भगश्च भगवान्रुद्रा एकादश स्मृताः॥
en: Dahana, Ishvara and greatly effulgent Kapali, Sthanu and the illustrious Bhaga. These eleven are called eleven Rudras.

sn: मरीचिरङ्गिरा अत्रिः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः। षडेते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा वीर्यवन्तो महर्षयः॥
en: (It has been already said that) Marichi, Angiras, Atari, Pulastya, Pulaha and Kratu, these powerful Rishis were six mind-born sons of Brahma.

sn: त्रयस्त्वङ्गिरसः पुत्रा लोके सर्वत्र विश्रुताः। बृहस्पतिरुतथ्यश्च संवर्तश्च धृतव्रताः॥
en: It is well-known in the world that the sons of Angiras were three, namely Brihaspati, Utathya and Samvarta, all of great asceticism.

sn: अत्रेस्तु बहवः पुत्राः श्रयून्ते मनुजाधिप। सर्वे वेदविदः सिद्धाः शान्तात्मानो महर्षयः॥
en: O king, it is said that the sons of Atri were countless, they were all great Rishis and they were all learned in the Vedas, they were crowned with ascetic successes and their souls were in perfect peace.

sn: राक्षसाश्च पुलस्त्यस्य वानराः किंनरास्तथा। यक्षाश्च मनुजव्याघ्र पुत्रास्तस्य च धीमतः॥
en: O best of kings, the offspring of greatly wise Pulastya were the Rakshas, Monkeys, Kinnaras and Yakshas.

sn: पुलहस्य सुता राजञ्च्छलभाश्च प्रकीर्तिताः। सिंहाः किंपुरुषा व्याघ्रा ऋक्षा ईहामृगास्तथा॥
en: O king, the offspring of Pulaha were, it is said, the Shalabhas (the winged-insects) the lions, the Kimpurushas (half lions and half men) tigeres, bears and wolves.

sn: क्रतोः क्रतुसमाः पुत्राः पतङ्गसहचारिणः। विश्रुतास्त्रिषु लोकेषु सत्यव्रतपरायणाः॥
en: The sons of Kratu (Valakhilyas), who were as sacred as sacrifice, were the companions of Surya. They were known to the three worlds and they were all devoted to truth and vows,

sn: दक्षस्त्वजायताङ्गुष्ठाद्दक्षिणाद्भगवानृषिः। ब्रह्मणः पृथिवीपाल शान्तात्मा सुमहातपाः॥
en: O protector of the world, the illustrious Rishi Daksha, having his soul in complete peace and possessing great asceticism, sprang from the right thumb of Brahma.

sn: वामादजायताङ्गुष्ठाद्भार्या तस्य महात्मनः। तस्यां पञ्चाशतं कन्याः स एवाजनयन्मुनिः॥
en: The wife of the illustrious Daksha sprang from the left toe of Brahma. He then begot fifty daughters on her.

sn: ताः सर्वास्त्वनवद्याङ्ग्यः कन्या: कमललोचनाः। पुत्रिकाः स्थापयामास नष्टपुत्रः प्रजापतिः॥
en: They were all lotus-eyed and of faultless features and limbs. As he (Daksha) had no sons of his own, he made these daughters his Putrikas.

sn: ददौ स दश धर्माय सप्तविंशतिमिन्दवे। दिव्येन विधिना राजन्कश्यपाय त्रयोदश॥
en: He (Daksha) bestowed in due form, ten of his daughters on Dharma twenty-seven on Chandra and thirteen on Kashyapa.

sn: नामतो धर्मपत्न्यस्ताः कीर्त्यमाना निबोध मे। कीर्तिर्लक्ष्मीधृतिर्मेधा पुष्टि श्रद्धा क्रिया तथा॥ कालस्य नयने
en: Hear, O king, the names of the wives of Dharma as I mention them. (They were) Kirti, Lakshmi, Dhriti, Medha, Pushti, Shraddha, Kriya.

sn: बुद्धिर्लज्जा मतिश्चैव पन्यो धर्मस्य ता दश। द्वाराण्येतानि धर्मस्य विहितानि स्वयंभुवा॥
en: Buddhi, Lajja and Mati. These were the ten wives of Dharma, as appointed by the selfcreated (Brahma).

sn: सप्तविंशतिः सोमस्य पत्न्यो लोकस्य विश्रुताः। युक्ताः सोमपत्न्यः शुचिव्रताः॥
en: It is known throughout the world that the wives of Chandra were twenty-seven. They were all of rigid and holy vows, they were employed to indicate time.

sn: सर्वा नक्षत्रयोगिन्यो लोकयात्रा विधानतः। पैतामहो मुनिर्देवस्तस्य पुत्रः प्रजापतिः॥
en: They are the Nakshatras and yoginis. They were engaged in assisting the course of nature. The Grandsire (Brahma) had another son, named Muni. His son was Prajapati.

sn: तस्याऽष्टौ वसवः पुत्रास्तेषां वक्ष्यामि विस्तरम्। धरो ध्रुवश्च सोमश्च अहश्चैवानिलोऽनलः॥
en: The sons of Prajapati were eight and they were called the Vasus. I shall name them in detail. (They were) Dhara, Dhruva, Soma, Aha, Anila, Anala,

sn: प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवोऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः। धूम्रायास्तु धरः पुत्रो ब्रह्मविद्यो ध्रुवस्तथा॥
en: Pratyusha and Prabhasa. These are known to be the eight Vasus. Dhara and the Brahmaknowing Dhruva were born of Dhumra.

sn: चन्द्रमास्तु मनस्विन्याः श्वासायाः श्वसनस्तथा। रतायाश्चाप्यहः पुत्रः शाण्डिल्याश्च हुताशनः॥
en: Soma was born of Manasvini and Anila was born of the wise Shvasa. Aha was the son of Rata and Anala of Shandilya.

sn: प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च प्रभातायाः सुतौ स्मृतौ। धरस्य पुत्रो द्रविणो हुतहव्यवहस्तथा॥
en: Pratyusha and Prabhasa were the sons of Prabhata. Dhara had two sons, namely, Dravina and Hutahavyavaha. was

sn: ध्रुवस्य पुत्रो भगवान्कालो लोकप्रकाशनः। सोमस्य तु सुतो वर्चा वर्चस्वी येन जायते॥
en: Dhruva's son was the illustrious Kala, the destroyer of the world. Soma's son Varcha, Varcha's daughter is Varchasvi.

sn: मनोहरायाः शिशिरः प्राणोऽथ रमणस्तथा। अह्नः सुतस्तथा ज्योतिः : शमः शान्तस्तथा मुनिः।।२३।
en: The fascinating Varchasvi had three sons, namely Shishira, Prana and Ramana. The sons of Aha were Jyoti, Shama, Shanta and Muni.

sn: अग्नेः पुत्रः कुमारस्तु श्रीमाञ्च्छरवणालयः। तस्य शाखो विशाखश्च नैगमेयश्च पृष्ठजः॥ कृत्तिकाभ्युपपत्तेश्च कार्तिकेय इति स्मृतः। अनिलस्य शिवा भार्या तस्याः पुत्रो मनोजवः॥
en: Agni's son was the handsome Kumara who was born in the forest and as he was reared up by Kirtika and others, he was called Kartikeya. After him were (born his three brothers, namely) Shakha, Vishakha and Naigameya, Anila's wife was Shiva and her sons were Manojava.

sn: अविज्ञातगतिश्चैव द्वौ पुत्रावनिलस्य तु। प्रत्यूषस्य विदुः पुत्रमृषि नाम्नाथ देवलम्॥
en: And Avijnatagati. These two were the sons of Anila. Know, Pratyush's son was the Rishi, named Devala.

sn: द्वौ पुत्रौ देवलस्यापि क्षमावन्तौ मनीषिणौ। बृहस्पतेस्तु भगिनी वरस्त्री ब्रह्मवादिनी॥
en: And Devala had two sons, both greatly wise and forgiving, The sister of Brihaspati, the first of women, the utterer of the sacred truth.

sn: योगसक्ता जगत्कृत्स्नमसक्ता विचचार ह। प्रभासस्य तु भार्या सा वसूनामष्टमस्स्य ह॥
en: And an austere ascetic, roamed over the world, having no attraction for the world, She (the sister of Brihaspati) became the wife of the ! eighth Vasu, Prabhasa.

sn: विश्वकर्मा महाभागो जज्ञे शिल्पप्रजापतिः। कर्ता शिल्पसहस्राणां त्रिदशानां च वर्धकिः॥ भूषाणानां च सर्वेषां कर्ता शिल्पवतां वरः। यो दिव्यानि विमानानि त्रिदशानां चकार ह॥
en: She gave birth to the illustrious Vishvakarma, the founder of all arts, the creator of thousand arts, the artist of the celestials, the maker of all kinds of ornaments, the best of all artists and the maker of the celestials cars of the gods.

sn: मनुष्याश्चोपजीवन्ति यस्य शिल्पं महात्मनः। पूजयन्ति च यं नित्यं विश्वकर्माणमव्ययम्॥
en: Mankind was enabled to live in consequence of the arts of this illustrious man and for this reason he was worshipped by all men. This Vishvakarma is everlasting and immutable,

sn: स्तनं तु दक्षिणं भित्त्वा ब्रह्मणो नरविग्रहः। निसृतो भगवान्धर्मः सर्वलोकसुखावहः॥
en: The illustrious Dharma, the dispenser of all happiness, came out of the right breast of Brahma, assuming the form of a man.

sn: त्रयस्तस्य वराः पुत्राः सर्वभूतमनोहराः। शमः कामश्च हर्षश्च तेजसा लोकधारिणः॥
en: He (Dharma) had three excellent sons, charming to all creatures. (They were) Shama, Kama and Harsha, who supported the worlds by their energy.

sn: कामस्य तु रतिर्भार्या शमस्य प्राप्तिरङ्गना। नन्दा तु भार्या हर्षस्य यासु लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥
en: The wife of Kama was Rati, that of Shama was Prapti and that of Harsha was Nanda; upon these the worlds were made to depend.

sn: मरीचेः कश्यपः पुत्रः कश्यपस्य सुरासुराः। जज्ञिरे नृपशार्दूल लोकानां प्रभवस्तु सः॥
en: Kashyapa was the son of Marichi and Kashyapa's offspring were the Suras (celestial) and Asuras. O best of kings, therefore, he is the progenitor of all the worlds.

sn: त्वाष्ट्री तु सवितुर्भार्या वडवारूपधारिणी। असूयत महाभागा सान्तरिक्षेऽश्विनावुभौ॥
en: Tvashtri, who had the form of a mare, became the wife of Savita. She gave birth in the sky to a twin Ashvinis.

sn: द्वादशैवादितेः पुत्राः शक्रमुख्या नराधिप। तेषामवरजो विष्णुर्यत्र लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥ ४१॥
en: O king, the sons of Aditi were twelve with Indra at their head. The youngest of them was Vishnu, upon whom the worlds depend.

sn: त्रयस्त्रिंशत इत्येते देवास्तेषामहं तव। अन्वयं संप्रवक्ष्यामि पक्षश्च कुलतो गणान्॥
en: These were the thirty-three celestials. I shall now mention to you their progeny according their Pakshas, Kulas and Ganas.

sn: रुद्राणामपरः पक्ष साध्यानां मरुतां तथा। वसूनां भार्गवं विद्याद्विश्वेदेवांस्तथैव च॥
en: The Rudras, the Sadhyas, the Marutas, the Vasus, the Bhargavas and the Visvedevas were each a Paksha.

sn: वैनतेयस्तु गरुडो बलवानरुणस्तथा। बृहस्पतिश्च भगवानादित्येष्वैव गण्यते॥
en: Vinata's son, Garuda and the Aruna also and illustrious Brihaspati were counted amongst the Adityas.

sn: अश्विनौ गुह्यकान्विद्धि सर्वोषध्यस्तथा पशून्। एते देवगणा राजन्कीर्तितास्तेऽनुपूर्वशः॥४
en: The Ashvinis, all annual plants and all beasts were counted among the Guhyakas. O king, these are the Ganas of the celestials, narrated to you.

sn: यान्कीर्तयित्वा मनुजः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते। ब्रह्मणो हृदयं भित्त्वा निःसृतौ भगवान्भृगुः॥ भृगोः पुत्रः कविर्विद्वाञ्छुक्रः कविसुतो ग्रहः। त्रैलोक्यप्राणयात्रार्थं वर्षावर्षे भयाभये। स्वयंभुवा नियुक्तः सम्भुवनं परिधावति॥ योगाचार्यो महाबुद्धिर्दैत्यानामभवद्गुरुः। सुराणां चापि मेधावी ब्रह्मचारी यतव्रतः॥
en: Which narration cleanses men of all their sins. The illustrious Bhrigu sprang forth, ripping open the breast of Brahma. Bhrigu's son was the learned Shukra, a poet himself and the son of a poet. He, being commanded by the Self-created (Brahma) to pour rain and withhold it and to dispense and remit calamities, became a planet and he (still) traverses the sky in order to sustain the lives of all creatures Yoga philosophy, that greatly intelligent man, that wise and self-controlled Brahmachari became the preceptor of the Devas and the Danavas.

sn: तस्मिन्नियुक्ते विधिना योगक्षेमाय भार्गवे। अन्यमुत्पादयामास पुत्रं भृगुरनिन्दितम्॥
en: Thus appointed by Brahma to look after the welfare (of Daityas), Bhrigu's son (Shukra) begot another son.

sn: च्यवनं दीप्ततपसं धर्मात्मानं यशस्विनम्। यः स रोषाच्च्युतो गर्भान्मातुर्मोक्षाय भारत॥
en: Named Chyavana, who was greatly famous, very virtuous minded and as effulgent as the sun. O descendant of the Bharata race, he came out of his mother's womb in anger and thus released his mother.

sn: आरुषी तु मनोः कन्या तस्य पत्नी मनीषिणः। और्वस्तस्यां समभवदूरुं भित्त्वा महायशाः॥
en: Arushi, the daughter of Manu, became the wife of the wise Chyavana and the greatly illustrious Aurva was born in her, ripping open her thighs.

sn: महातेजा महावीर्यो बाल एव गुणैर्युतः। ऋचीकस्तस्य पुत्रस्तु जमदग्निस्ततोऽभवत्॥
en: His (Aurva's) son was Richika, who became, even in his boyhood, very powerful, energetic and virtuous. He (Richika) begot Jamadagni.

sn: जमदग्नेस्तु चत्वार आसन्पुत्रा महात्मनः। रामस्तेषां जघन्योऽभूदजघन्यैर्गुणैर्युतः॥
en: The illustrious Jamadagni had four sons, the youngest of them was Parshurama. He was superior to all his other brothers in good qualities.

sn: सर्वशस्त्रेषु कुशलः क्षत्रियान्तकरो वशी। और्वस्यासीत्पुत्रशतं जमदग्निपुरोगमम्॥
en: He was self-controlled, but was expert in the use of all weapons and he became the destroyer of the Kshatriyas. Aurva had one hundred sons, the eldest of them being Jamadagni.

sn: तेषां पुत्रसहस्राणि बभूवुर्भुवि विस्तरः। द्वौ पुत्रौ ब्रह्मणस्त्वन्यौ ययोस्तिष्ठति लक्षणम्॥
en: These hundred sons begot offspring by thousands and filled the whole world. Brahma had two other sons, who had victory as their signification.

sn: लोके धाता विधाता च यौ स्थितौ मनुना सह। तयोरेव स्वसा देवी लक्ष्मीः पद्मगृहा शुभा॥
en: They are known as Dhata and Vidhata, who lived with Manu. Their sister is the auspicious Lakshmi who lives in the abode of lotuses.

sn: तस्यास्तु मानसाः पुत्रास्तुरगा व्योमचारिणः। वरुणस्य भार्या या ज्येष्ठा शुक्राद्देवी व्यजायत॥
en: The mind-born sons of Lakshmi are the sky-ranging horses. Varuna's eldest wife was the daughter of Shukra, named Devi.

sn: तस्याः पुत्रं बलं विद्धि सुरां च सुरनन्दिनीम्। प्रजानामनकामानामन्योन्यपरिभक्षणात्॥ अधर्मस्तत्र संजातः सर्वभूतविनाशकः। तस्यापि निर्ऋतिर्भार्या नैर्ऋता येन राक्षसा॥
en: She gave birth to a son, called Bala and a daughter, named Sura, who gives joy to the celestials. And all destroying Adharma was born (of her), when creatures began to devour one another. Niriti was his wife, from whom were born the Rakshasas, called Nairitas.

sn: घोरास्तस्यास्त्रयः पुत्राः पापकर्मरताः सदा। भयो महाभयश्चैव मृत्युर्भूतान्तकस्तथा॥
en: She had also three other fearful and cruel sons, always engaged in sinful deeds. (They were) Bhaya, Mahabhaya and Mrityu, the destroyer of every created thing.

sn: न तस्य भार्या पुत्रो वा कश्चिदस्त्यन्तको हि सः। काकी श्येनी तथा भासी धृतराष्ट्रीं तथा शुकीम्॥
en: This all-destroying being (Mrityu) had no wife or son. Kaki, Shyeni, Bhasi, Dhritarashtri and Shuki.

sn: ताम्रा तु सुषुवे देवी पञ्चैता लोकविश्रुताः। उलूकान्सुषुवे काकी श्येनी श्येनान्व्यजायत॥
en: These five are known in the world as the daughters of Tamra. Kaki brought forth the crows, Shyeni the hawks,

sn: भासी भासानजनयद्गृध्रांश्चैव जनाधिप। धृतराष्ट्रीं तु हंसांश्च कलहंसांश्च सर्वशः॥
en: Bhasi gave birth to the cocks and the vultures and Dhritarashtra all ducks and swans.

sn: चक्रवाकांश्च भद्रा तु जनयामास सैव तु। शुकी च जनयामास शुकानेव यशस्विनी॥ कल्याणगुणसंपन्ना सर्वलक्षणपूजिता। नव क्रोधवशा नारी: प्रजज्ञे क्रोधसंभवाः॥
en: And she gave birth to also the Chakrvakas. The fair and illustrious Shuki of amiable qualities and auspicious signs gave birth to all parrots. Krodhavasha gave birth to nine daughters of wrathful temper.

sn: मृगी च मृगमन्दा च हरी भद्रमना अपि। मातङ्गी त्वथ शार्दूली श्वेता सुरभिरेव च॥
en: They were Mrigi, Mrigamada, Hari, Bhadramana, Matangi, Sharduli, Shveta, Surabhi.

sn: सर्वलक्षणसंपन्ना सुरसा चैव भामिनी। अपत्यं तु मृगाः सर्वे मृग्या नरवरोत्तम॥
en: And the beautiful Surasa of every auspicious sign. O best of men, the offspring of Mrigi are all beasts of deer species.

sn: ऋक्षाश्च मृगमन्दायाः सृमराश्च परंतप। ततस्त्वैरावतं नागं जज्ञे भद्रमनाः सुतम्॥
en: O chastiser of foes, the offspring of Mrigamada are all beasts of bear species and also of those beasts, called Srimara. Bhadramana gave birth to her son Airavata.

sn: ऐरावतः सुतस्तस्या देवनागो महागजः। हर्याश्च हरयोऽपत्यं वानराश्च तरस्विनः॥
en: And Airavata is the great celestial elephant. The offspring of Hari are the horses and the beasts of the monkey kind which are endued with great activity.

sn: गोलांगूलांश्च भद्रं ते हर्याः पुत्रान्प्रचक्षते। प्रजज्ञे त्वथ शार्दूली सिंहान् व्याघ्राननेकशः॥
en: Those animals that are called Golangula also are said to be the offspring of Hari. Sharduli gave birth to innumerable lions and tigers,

sn: द्वीपिनश्च महासत्वान्सर्वानेव न संशयः। मातङ्ग्यपि च मातङ्गानपत्यानि नराधिप॥
en: And also to leopards and all other animals. O king, the offspring of Matangi are all elephants.

sn: दिशां गजं तु श्वेतारव्यं श्वेताजनयदाशुगम्। तथा दुहितरौ राजन् सुरभिर्वै व्यजायत॥
en: And Shveta gave birth to the large elephant, known by the name of Shveta which possesses great speed. O king, Surabhi gave birth to two daughters,

sn: रोहिणीं चैव भदंते गन्धर्वी तु यशस्विनीम्। विमलामपि भद्रं ते अनलामपि भारत॥ रोहिण्यां जज्ञिरे गावः गन्धयां वाजिनः सुताः। सप्त पिण्डफलान्वृक्षाननलापि व्यजायत॥
en: Namely, the beautiful Rohini and illustrious Gandharví. O descendant of the Bharata race, she had two other daughters, named, Vimala and Anala. All kine were born from Rohini and all horses from Gandharvi. And Anala gave birth to the seven kinds of trees which produce pulpy fruits.

sn: अनलायाः शुकी पुत्री कङ्कस्तु सुरसासुतः। अरुणस्य भार्या श्येनी तु वीर्यवन्तौ महाबलौ॥ संपातिं जनयामास वीर्यवन्तं जटायुषम्। सुरसाजनयन्नागान्कएँः पुत्रांस्तु पन्नगान्॥
en: Anala had another daughter named Shuki. Surasa gave birth to a son, named Kanka. Aruna's wife Shyeni gave birth to two very energetic and powerful sons, named Sampati and the mighty Jatayu. Surasa also gave birth to the Nagas and Kadru the Pannagas.

sn: द्वौ पुत्रौ विनतायास्तु विख्यातौ गरुडारुणौ। इत्येषः सर्वभूतानां महतां मनुजाधिप॥ प्रभवः कीर्तितः सम्यङ्मया मतिमतांवर॥ यं श्रुत्वा पुरुषः सम्यङ्मुक्तो भवति पाप्मनः। सर्वज्ञतां च लभते गतिमग्र्यं च विन्दति॥
en: Vinata had two sons, the world known Garuda and Aruna. O king of men, O best of all wise men, thus have I fully described to you the genealogy of all the principal creatures. He who hears it is cleansed of all his sins. He acquires great knowledge and finally attains to the highest state in after-life.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: जनमेजय उवाच देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरंगरक्षसाम्। सिंहव्याघ्रमृगाणां च पन्नगानां पतत्रिणाम्॥ सर्वेषां चैव भूतानां संभवं भगवन्नहम्। श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वेन मानुषेषु महात्मनाम्। जन्म कर्म च भूतानामेतेषामनुपूर्वशः॥
en: Janamejaya said : Worshipful Sir, I desire to hear from you in detail the accounts of the births and deeds and achievements among men, of the Devas, the Danavas, the Rakshasas, the Gandharvas, the lions, the tigers, the snakes, the birds and other animals and in short of all creatures, that became incarnate in human forms.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: वैशंपायन उवाच मानुषेषु मनुष्येन्द्र संभूता ये दिवौकसः। प्रथमं दानवांश्चैव तास्ते वक्ष्यामि सर्वशः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king of men, I shall first tell you all about those Devas and the Danavas who were born amongst men.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: विप्रचित्तिरितिख्यातो य आसीद्दानवर्षभः। जरासन्ध इति ख्यातः स आसीन्मनुजर्षभः॥
en: The best of the Danavas, who was known by the name of Viprachitti, became that best of men who is known as Jarasandha.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: दितेः पुत्रस्तु यो राजन्हिरण्यकशिपुः स्मृतः। स जज्ञे मानुषे लोके शिशुपालो नरर्षभः॥
en: O king, that son of Diti, who was known by the name of Hiranyakashipu, became (that king) who was known in this world by the name of powerful Shishupala.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: संह्लाद इति विख्यातः प्रह्लादस्यानुजस्तु यः। स शल्य इति विख्यातो जज्ञे बाह्रीकपुङ्गवः॥
en: The younger brother of Prahlada who was known as Sanhlada, became among men that best of Balhikas, known as famous Shalya.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: अनुहादस्तु तेजस्वी योऽभूत्ख्यातो जघन्यजः। धृष्टकेतुरिति ख्यातः स बभूव नरेश्वरः॥
en: The youngest (brother of Prahlada) known as Anuhrada, became famous in this world as Dhristaketu.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: यस्तु राजञ्च्छिबिर्नाम दैतेयः परिकीर्तितः। द्रुम इत्यभिविख्यातः स आसीद्भुवि पार्थिवः॥
en: O king, that son of Diti who was known as Shibi, became the famous monarch Druma on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: बाष्कलो नाम यस्तेषामासीदसुरसत्तमः। भगदत्त इति ख्यातः स जज्ञे पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: O best of men, that best of Asuras, who was known as Bashkala, became the great Bhagadatta on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: अयःशिरा अश्वशिरा अयःशङ्कश्च वीर्यवान्। तथा गगनमूर्धा च वेगवांश्चात्र पञ्चमः॥
en: The five powerful and swift Asuras, namely Ayahshira, Ashvashira, Ayahshanku, Gaganmurdha and Vegavan,

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: पञ्चैते जज्ञिरे राजन्वीर्यवन्तो महासुराः। केकयेषु महात्मान: पार्थिवर्षभसत्तमाः॥
en: O king, these powerful great Asuras were all born in the illustrious dynasty of Kekaya and became great kings.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: केतुमानिति विख्यातो यस्ततोऽन्यः प्रतापवान्। अमितौजा इति ख्यातः सोग्रकर्मा नराधिपः॥
en: The mighty Asura, who was known as Ketuman, became the king Amitauja of terrible deeds.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: स्वर्भानुरिति विख्यातः श्रीमान्यस्तु महासुरः। उग्रसेन इति ख्यात उग्रकर्मा नराधिपः॥
en: The great and fortunate Asura, who was known as Svarbhanu, became the king Ugrasena of fearful deeds.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: यस्त्वश्व इति विख्यातःश्रीमानासीन्महासुरः। अशोको नाम राजाभून्महावीर्योऽपराजितः॥
en: The great and fortunate Asura who was known as Ashva, became the invincible king Ashoka of great prowess.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: तस्मादवरजो यस्तु राजन्नश्वपतिः स्मृतः। दैतेयः सोऽभवद्राजा हार्दिक्यो मनुजर्षभः॥
en: O king, that son of Diti, the younger brother of Ashva, who was known as Ashvapati, became the mighty king Hardikya.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: वृषपर्वेति विख्यातः श्रीमान्यस्तु महासुरः। दीर्घप्रज्ञ इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां सोऽभवनृपः॥
en: The great and fortunate Asura who was known as Vishaparva, became king Dhirghaprajna on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: अजकस्त्ववरो राजन्य आसीवृषपर्वणः। स शाल्व इति विख्यातः पृथिव्यामभवनृपः॥
en: O king, the younger brother of Vrishaparva, who was known as Ajaka, became Shalva on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: अश्वग्रीव इति ख्यातः सत्त्ववान्यो महासुरः। रोचमान इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां सोऽभवनृपः॥
en: The great Asura who was known as Ashvagriva, became king Rochamana on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: सूक्ष्मस्तु मतिमानराजन्कीर्तिमान्यः प्रकीर्तितः। बृहद्रथ इति ख्यातः क्षितावासीत्स पार्थिवः॥
en: O king, the intelligent and illustrious Asura who was known as Sukshma, became the illustrious king Brihadratha on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: तुहुण्ड इति विख्यातो य आसीदसुरोत्तमः। सेनाबिन्दुरिति ख्यातः स बभूव नराधिपः॥
en: That best of Asuras, who was known as Tuhunda, became the king Senabindu on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: इषुपान्नाम यस्तेषामसुराणां बलाधिकः। नग्नजिन्नाम राजासीद्भुवि विख्यातविक्रमः॥
en: That great strong Asura, who was known as Ishupada, became king Nagnajita of worldknown prowess.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: एकचक्र इति ख्यात आसीद्यस्तु महासुरः। प्रतिविन्ध्य इति ख्यातो बभूव प्रथितः क्षितौ॥
en: The great Asura who was known as Ekachakra, became known on earth as Prativindhya.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: विरूपाक्षस्तु दैतेयश्चित्रयोधी महासुरः। चित्रधर्मेति विख्यातः क्षितावासीत्स पार्थिवः॥
en: The great Asura, capable of displaying various modes of fight and known as Virupaksha, became known as king Chitradharman on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: हरस्त्वरिहरो वीर आसीद्यो दानवोत्तमः। सुबाहुरिति विख्यातः श्रीमानासीत्स पार्थिवः॥
en: That best of Danavas, known as the heroic Hara, became the famous and fortunate king Subahu on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: अहरस्तु महातेजाः शत्रुपक्षक्षयंकरः। बाह्रीको नाम राजा स बभूव प्रथितः क्षितौ॥
en: That Asura of great prowess, the chastiser of his foes, known as Ahara, became king Bahlika on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: निचन्द्रश्चन्द्रवक्रस्तु य आसीदसुरोत्तमः। मुञ्जकेश इति ख्यातः श्रीमानासीत्स पार्थिवः॥
en: That best of Asuras, who was known as Nichandra and whose face was as beautiful as the moon, became the fortunate king Munjakesha on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: निकुम्भस्त्वजिताः संख्ये महामतिरजायत। भूमौ भूमिपतिः श्रेष्ठो देवाधिप इति स्मृतः॥
en: That great intelligent and invincible Asura, who was known as Nikumbha, became the best of kings Devadhipa on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: शरभो नाम यस्तेषां दैतेयानां महासुरः। पौरवो नाम राजर्षिः स बभूव नरोत्तमः॥
en: That Asura who was known as Sarabha amongst the sons of Diti, became the royal sage Pourava on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: कुपटस्तु महावीर्यः श्रीमान्राजन्महासुरः। सुपार्श्व इति विख्यातः क्षितौ जज्ञे महीपतिः॥
en: O king, that greatly powerful and fortunate Asura who was as Kupata, became the famous king Suparshva on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: क्रथस्तु राजनराजर्षिः क्षितौ जज्ञे महासुरः। पार्वतेय इति ख्यातः काञ्चनाचलसन्निभः॥
en: O king, the great Asura who was known as Kratha, became the royal sage Parvateya, as effulgent as a golden mountain.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: द्वितीयः शलभस्तेषामसुराणां बभूव ह। प्रह्लादो नाम वाह्लीकः स बभूव नराधिपः॥
en: That Asura, who was known as Shalabha the second, became king Prahlada in the land of the Bahlikas on earth. was as

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: चन्द्रस्तु दितिजश्रेष्ठो लोके ताराधिपोपमः। चन्द्रवर्मेति विख्यातः काम्बोजानां नराधिपः॥
en: That best of the Diti's sons, who was known as Chandra and who was as handsome as the lord of the stars (moon), became Chandravarman, the king of Kambojas on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: अर्क इत्यभिविख्यातो यस्तु दानवपुङ्गवः। ऋषिको नाम राजर्षिर्बभूव नृपसत्तमः॥
en: O king, that best of Danavas, who was known as Arka, became the royal sage Rishika on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: मृतपा इति विख्यातो स आसीदसुरोत्तमः। पश्चिमानूपकं विद्वि तं नृपं नृपसत्तम॥
en: O best of kings, that best of Asuras, who known Mritapa, became king Paschimanupaka on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: गविष्ठस्तु महातेजा यः प्रख्यातो महासुरः। दुमसेन इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां सोऽभवन्नृपः॥
en: That greatly powerful Asura, known as Gavishtha, became king Drumasena on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: मयूर इति विख्यातः श्रीमान्यस्तु महासुरः। स विश्व इति विख्यातो बभूव पृथिवीपतिः॥
en: That great and fortunate Asura, who was known as Mayura, became king Vishva on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: सुपर्ण इति विख्यातस्तस्मादवरजस्तु यः। कालकीर्तिरिति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां सोऽभवनृपः॥
en: That Asura who was the younger brother of Mayura and who was known as Suparna, became king Kalakirti on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: चन्द्रहन्तेति यस्तेषां कीर्तितः प्रवरोऽसुरः। शुनको नाम राजर्षिः स बभूव नराधिपः॥
en: The greatly powerful, Asura, who was known as Chandrahanta, became king Sunaka on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: विनाशनस्तु चन्द्रस्य य आख्यातो महासुरः। जानकिर्नाम विख्यातः सोऽभवन्मनुजाधिपः॥
en: The great Asura, who was known as Chandravinashana, became king Janaki on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: दीर्घजिह्वस्तुकौरव्य य उक्तो दानवर्षभः। काशिराजः स विख्यातः पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपते॥
en: O king of the Kuru race, that best of the Danayas who was known as Dirgajihva, became king Kashiraja on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: ग्रहं तु सुषुवे यं तु सिंहिकार्केन्दुमर्दनम्। स क्राथ इति विख्यातो बभूव मनुजाधिपः॥
en: That Asura (Rahu) who was born of Singhika and who persecuted the sun and the moon, became king Kratha on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: दनायुधस्तु पुत्राणां चतुर्णां प्रवरोऽसुरः। विक्षरो नाम तेजस्वी वसुमित्रो नृपः स्मृतः॥
en: The eldest of the four sons of Danayu, who was known as Vikshara, became the powerful king Vasumitra of earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: द्वितीयो विक्षरावस्तु नराधिप महासुरः। पाण्ड्यराष्ट्रधिप इति विख्यातः सोऽभवन्नृपः॥
en: The second brother of Vikshara, the great Asura, became the king of the country called Pandya.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: बली वीर इति ख्यातो यस्त्वासीदसुरोत्तमः। पौण्ड्रमात्स्यक इत्येवं बभूव स नराधिपः॥
en: That best of Asuras, who was known by the name of Vira, became king Paundramatsyaka on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: वृत्र इत्यभिविख्यातो यस्तु राजन्महासुरः। मणिमानाम राजर्षिः स बभूव नराधिपः॥
en: O king, that great Asura who was known as Vritra became the royal sage Manimala on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: क्रोधहन्तेति यस्तस्य बभूवावरजोऽसुरः। दण्ड इत्यभिविख्यातः स आसीनृपतिः क्षितौ॥
en: That Asura, who was the younger brother of Vritra and was known as Krodhahanta, became king Danda on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: क्रोधवर्धन इत्येवं यस्त्वन्यः परिकीर्तितः। दण्डधार इति ख्यातः सोभऽवन्मनुजर्षभः॥
en: That Asura who was known as Krodhavardhana became king Dandadhara on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: कालेयानां तु ये पुत्रास्तेषामष्टौ नराधिपाः। जज्ञिरे राजशार्दूल शार्दूलसमविक्रमाः॥
en: O best of kings, the eight sons of the Asura Kaleyas were all born on earth and they all became great kings as powerful as tigers.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: मगधेषु जयत्सेनस्तेषामासीत्स पार्थिवः। अष्टानां प्रवरस्तेषां कालेयानां महासुरः॥
en: Of the eight great Kaleya Asuras, the eldest Jayatsena became the king of Magadha.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: द्वितीयस्तु ततस्तेषां श्रीमान्हरिहयोपमः। अपराजित इत्येवं स बभूव नराधिपः॥
en: The second, as powerful as Indra, became king Aparajita on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: तृतीयस्तु महातेजा महामायो महासुरः। निषादाधिपतिर्जज्ञे भुवि भीमपराक्रमः॥
en: The third was a great Asura, endued with great prowess and power of deception, (Magical powers) and he became the greatly powerful king of the Nishadas.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: तेषामन्यतमो यस्तु चतुर्थः परिकीर्तितः। श्रेणिमानिति विख्यातः क्षितौ राजर्षिसत्तमः॥
en: The fourth of the brothers became the best of royal sages, Shrenimana.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: पञ्चमस्त्वभवत्तेषां प्रवरो यो महासुरः। महौजा इति विख्यातो बभूवेह परंतपः॥
en: That great Asura, the fifth (brother) became king Mahauja, the oppressor of his foes on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: षष्ठस्तु मतिमान्यो वै तेषामासीन्महासुरः। अभीरुरिति विख्यातः क्षितौ राजर्षिसत्तमः॥
en: That greatly intelligent and powerful Asura who was the sixth (brother) became the vest of royal sages Abhiru on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: समुद्रसेनस्तु नृपस्तेषामेवाभवद्गणात्। विश्रुतः सागरान्तायां क्षितौ धर्मार्थतत्त्ववित्॥
en: The seventh of the brothers) became king Samudrasena, famous all over the earth from its centre to the sea and he was learned in the Shastras.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: बृहन्नामाष्टमस्तेषां कालेयानां नराधिप बभूव राजा धर्मात्मा सर्वभूतहिते रतः॥
en: O king, the eighth of the Kaleyas, who was known as Brihata became a virtuous king, ever engaged in doing good to all creatures,

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: कुक्षिस्तु राजन्विख्यातो दानवानां महाबलः। पार्वतीय इति ख्यातः काञ्चनाचलसंनिभः॥
en: That mighty Danava, who was known as Kukshi, became king Parvatiya, as effulgent as a golden mountain.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: क्रथनश्च महावीर्यः श्रीमानराजा महासुरः। सूर्याक्ष इति विख्यातः क्षितौ जज्ञे महीपतिः॥
en: That mighty and powerful Asura, who was known as Krathana, became king Suryaksha on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: असुराणां तु यः सूर्यः श्रीमांश्चैव महासुरः। दरदो नाम बाल्हीको वरः सर्वमहीक्षिताम्॥
en: That handsome Asura, who was known as Surya, became on earth that best of all kings Darada the king of the Bahlikas.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: गण: क्रोधवशो नाम यस्ते राजप्रकीर्तितः। तत: संजज्ञिरे वीराः क्षिताविह नराधिपाः॥
en: O king, many heroic monarchs, were born on earth form the race of Asuras, called Krodhavasha, of whom I have already spoken to you.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: मद्रकः कर्णवेष्टश्च सिद्धार्थः कीटकस्तथा। सुवीरश्च सुबाहुश्च महावीरोऽथ बाह्निकः॥ क्रथो विचित्रः सुरथः श्रीमान्नीलश्च भूमिपः। चीरवासाश्च कौरव्य भूमिपाश्चैव नामतः॥ दन्तवक्त्रश्च नामासीर्जयश्चैव दानवः। रुक्मी च नृपशार्दूलो राजा च जनमेजयः॥ आषाढो वायुवेगश्च भूरितेजास्तथैव च। एकलव्य सुमित्रश्च वाटधानोऽथ गोमुखः॥ कारूषकाश्च राजानः क्षेमधूर्तिस्तथैव च। श्रुतायुरुद्वहश्चैव बृहत्सेनस्तथैव च॥ क्षेमोग्रतीर्थः कुहरः कलिङ्गेषु नराधिपः। मतिमांश्च मनुष्येन्द्र ईश्वरश्चेति विश्रुतः॥
en: (They were) were) Madraka, Karmaveshta, Siddhartha, Kitaka, Suvira, Subahu, Mahavira, Bahlika, Kratha, Vichitra, Suratha, handsome Nila, Chiravasa, Bhumipala, Dantavaktra, Durjaya, Rukmi, Janamejaya, Ashada, Vayuvega, Bhuriteja, Ekalavya, Sumitra, Vatadhana, Gomukha, Karushakas, Kshemdhurti, Shrutayu, Udvaha, Brihatsena, Kshema, Ugratirtha, the king of Kalinga and Matimana, the king who was known as Ishvara.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: गणात्क्रोधवशादेष राजपूगोऽभवक्षितौ। जातः पुरा महाभागो महाकीर्तिर्महाबलः॥
en: These greatly fortunate, powerful and illustrious and best of monarchs were all born on earth of the race of Asuras, called Krodhavasha.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: कालनेमिरिति ख्यातो दानवानां महाबलः। स कंस इति विख्यात उग्रसेनसुतो बली॥
en: That great Danava who was known as Kalanemi became the son of Ugrasena, king Kamsa, on earth.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: यस्त्वासीद्देवको नाम देवराजसमद्युतिः। स गन्धर्वपतिर्मुख्यः क्षितौ जज्ञे नराधिपः॥
en: The best of the kings of the Gandharvas was born on earth as Devaka who was as effulgent as Indra himself.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: बृहस्पतेवृहत्कीर्तेर्देवर्षेर्विद्धि भारत। अंशाद्रोणं समुत्पन्नं भारद्वाजमयोनिजम्॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, Drona, the son of Bharadvaja, who was not born of any woman, sprang from the celestial Rishi Brihaspati.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: धन्विनां नृपशार्दूल यः सर्वास्त्रवित्तमः। महाकीर्तिर्महातेजा: स जज्ञे मनुजेश्वर॥
en: O best of kings, he was a hero of great achievements and the best of all those that were learned in the ways of using arms. He was most illustrious and most powerful.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: धनुर्वेदे च वेदे च यं तं वेदविदो विदुः। वरिष्ठं चित्रकर्माणं द्रोणं स्वकुलवर्धनम्॥
en: He was called learned, in the Vedas, as well as in the Science of arms by all men wellversed in the Vedas. He was a doer of wonderful deeds and a pride of his race.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: महादेवान्तकाभ्यां च कामात्क्रोधाच्च भारत। एकत्वमुपपन्नानां जज्ञे शूरः परंतपः॥ अश्वत्थामा महावीर्यः शत्रुपक्षभयावहः। वीरः कमलपत्राक्षः क्षितावासीन्नराधिप॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, O king, his son, the heroic, surpassingly energetic and lotus-eyed Ashvathama, the terror of all his foes and the great oppressor of all enemies, was born on earth from the united portions of Mahadeva, Yama, Kama and Krodha.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: जज्ञिरे वसवस्त्वष्टौ गङ्गायां शान्तनोः सुताः। वसिष्ठस्य च शापेन नियोगाद्वासवस्य च॥
en: Begot by her husband Shantanu, the eight Vasus were given birth to by Ganga, on account of the curse of Rishi Vasistha and also from the command of Indra.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: तेषामवरजो भीष्मः कुरूणामभयंकरः। मतिमान्वेदविद्वाग्मी शत्रुपक्षक्षयंकरः॥
en: The youngest of them was Bhishma, who was the dispeller of the fears of the Kurus, who was greatly intelligent, who was a great scholar in the Vedas and a best of speakers and the destroyer of the enemy's ranks.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: जामदग्न्येन रामेण सर्वास्त्रविदुषां वरः। योऽयुध्यत महातेजा भार्गवेण महात्मना॥
en: That best of men, being learned in the science of arms and endued with great energy, fought with the illustrious (Parshu) Rama, the son of Jamadagni.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
sn: यस्तु राजन्कृपो नाम ब्रह्मर्षिरभवक्षितौ। रुद्राणां तु गणाद्विद्धि संभूतमतिपौरुषम्॥
en: O king, that Brahmana Rishi, who was known in the world as Kripa, was the embodiment of all manliness, was born of the Rudraganas.

description: Descent of the Celestials, Gandharvas, Danavas etc.
