sn: प्रतर्दन उवाच पृच्छामि त्वां स्पृहणीयरूप प्रतर्दनोऽहं यदि मे सन्ति लोकाः। यद्यन्तरिक्षे यदि वा दिवि श्रिताः क्षेत्रज्ञं त्वां तस्य धर्मस्य मन्ये॥
en: Pratardana said : O handsome one, I am Pratardana by name. I ask you, is there any region for me in heaven or in the firmament to enjoy as fruits of my virtues? You know everything.

sn: ययातिरुवाच सन्ति लोका बहवस्ते नरेन्द्र अप्येकैकः सप्तसप्ताप्यहानि। स्ते नान्तवन्तः प्रतिपालयन्ति॥
en: Yayati said : O king, innumerable regions, as effulgent as the solar disc and full of great felicity, await you. If you live only for seven days in each, they will never be exhausted.

sn: प्रतर्दन उवाच तांस्ते ददानि मा प्रपत प्रपातं ये मे लोकास्तव ते वै भवन्तु। स्तानाक्रम क्षिप्रमपेतमोहः॥
en: Pratardana said : I give to you all of them. Therefore, though falling, you must not fall. Let all the regions for me to enjoy be yours, whether they may be in heaven or in the firmament. Take them soon and let your sorrow cease.

sn: ययातिरुवाच न तुल्यतेजाः सुकृतं कामयेत् योगक्षेमं पार्थिव पार्थिवः सन्। श्चरेनृशंसं न हि जातु राजा॥
en: Yayati said : O king, no king of equal energy should ever desire to accept in gift the religious merits of another king acquired by Yoga. No king, if wise, should act in a censurable way, though afflicted with calamity.

sn: धर्म्य मार्ग यतमानो यशस्यं कुर्यानृपो धर्ममवेक्षमाणः। न मद्विधो धर्मबुद्धिः प्रजानन् कुर्यादेवं कृपणं मां यथाऽऽत्थ॥
en: A king should keep his eyes fixed on virtue and walk in the path of piety and thus increase his fame. A virtuous man like me, who know what are his duties, should not act so meanly as you ask me to do.

sn: विधिसमानः किमु तत्र साधु। ब्रुवाणमेनं नृपतिं ययाति नृपोत्तमो वसुमानब्रवीत् तम्॥
en: When others, desirous of acquiring religious merit, do not accept gifts, how can I do it what they do not? When the best of kings, Yayati, said this, he was thus addressed by Vasuman.

sn: वसुमानुवाच यद्यस्ति लोको दिवि मे नरेन्द्र। यद्यन्तरिक्षे प्रथितो महात्मन् क्षेत्रज्ञं त्वां तस्य धर्मस्य मन्ये॥
en: Vasuman said: I am Vasuman, the son of Ushadashva. I ask you, O king, is there any region for me to enjoy either in heaven or in the firmament, as fruits of my virtuous acts? O high-souled one, you know all holy regions.

sn: ययातिरुवाच यदन्तरिक्षं पृथिवी दिशश्च यत्तेजसा तपते भानुमांश्च। लोकास्तावन्तो दिवि संस्थिता वै ते नान्तवन्तः प्रतिपालयन्ति॥
en: Yayati said : The extensive regions, as extensive as those in the firmament, on earth and ten points of heaven that are illuminated by the sun, are all waiting for you.

sn: वसुमानुवाच तांस्ते ददानि मा प्रपत प्रपातं ये मे लोकास्तव ते वै भवन्तु। क्रीणीष्वैतांस्तृणकेनापि राजन् प्रतिग्रहस्ते यदि धीमन् प्रदुष्टः॥
en: Vasuman said : I give them all to you. Let those regions that are mine be all yours. O king, if it is improper for you to accept them in gift, then pur hase them with a straw.

sn: ययातिरुवाच न मिथ्याहं विक्रयं वै स्मरामि वृथा गृहीतं शिशुकाच्छङ्कमानः। विधिसमानः किमु तत्र साधु॥
en: Yayati said : I do not remember to have ever bought or sold any thing in an unfair way. This has also never been done by other kings. How shall I do it then?

sn: वसुमानुवाच तांस्त्वं लोकान् प्रतिपद्यस्व राजन् मया दत्तान् यदि नेष्टः क्रयस्ते। अहं न तान् वै प्रतिगन्ता नरेन्द्र सर्वे लोकास्तव ते वै भवन्तु॥
en: Vasuman said: O king, if to purchase them be considered by you improper, take them from me as gifts. I for myself speak, that I shall never go to those regions that are for me. Let thein, therefore, be yours.

sn: शिबिरुवाच पृच्छामि त्वां शिबिरौशीनरोऽहं ममापि लोका यदि सन्तीह तात। यद्यन्तरिक्षे यदि वा दिवि श्रिताः क्षेत्रज्ञं त्वां तस्य धर्मस्य मन्ये॥
en: Sibi said : I am Sibi, the son of Ushinara. I ask you, O king, O sire, is there any region in heaven or in the firmament for me to enjoy? You know every region that one may enjoy as the fruit of his religious merit.

sn: ययातिरुवाच यत् त्वं वाचा हृदयेनापि साधून् परीप्समानान् नावमंस्था नरेन्द्र। तेनानन्ता दिवि लोकाः श्रितास्ते विद्युदूपाः स्वनवन्तो महान्तः॥
en: Yayati said: You have never disregarded either in mind or by speech the honest and the virtuous men that ever applied to you. There are infinite worlds for you to enjoy in heaven, all blazing like lightning.

sn: शिबिरुवाच तांस्त्वं लोकान् प्रतिपद्यस्व राजन् मया दत्तान् यदि नेष्टः क्रयस्ते। न चाहं तान् प्रतिपत्स्ये ह दत्त्वा यत्र गत्वा नानुशोचन्ति धीराः॥
en: Sibi said : If you consider their purchase as improper, I give them to you as gifts. O king, take them all. I shall never go to the region where the wise never feel the least grief.

sn: ययातिरुवाच स्ते चाप्यनन्ता नरदेव लोकाः। तथाद्य लोके न रमेऽन्यदत्ते तस्माच्छिबे नाभिनन्दामि देयम्॥
en: Yayati said : O Sibi, you have indeed obtained for yourself infinite worlds, possessed as you are of the prowess of Indra. But I do not wish to enjoy regions given to me by others. Therefore, I cannot accept your gifts.

sn: अष्टक उवाच न चेदेकैकशो राजंल्लोकान् नः प्रतिनन्दसि। सर्वे प्रदाय भवते गन्तारो नरकं वयम्॥
en: Ashtaka said: O king, each of us has expressed our desire to give you the regions that each of us has acquired by his religious merits. You refuse to accept them. We leave them for you and we shall now descend into the earth-hell.

sn: ययातिरुवाच यदोऽहं तद् यदध्वं सन्तः सत्याभिनन्दिनः। अहं तन्नाभिजानामि यत् कृतं न मया पुरा॥
en: Yayati said : You are all truth-loving and wise. Give me that which I desire to have. I shall not be able to do what I have not done before.

sn: अष्टक उवाच कस्यैते प्रतिदृश्यन्ते रथाः पञ्च हिरण्मयाः। यानारुह्य नरो लोकानभिवाञ्छति शाश्वतान्॥
en: Ashtaka said : To whom does these fine cars belong that we see before us? Do men ride on them who go to the regions of everlasting bliss?

sn: ययातिरुवाच युष्मानेते वहिष्यन्ति रताः पञ्च हिरण्मयाः। उच्चैः सन्तः प्रकाशन्ते ज्वलन्तोऽग्निशिखा इव॥
en: Yayati said : These fine golden cars, as blazing as fire and displaying great glory, will carry you to regions of bliss.

sn: अष्टक उवाच आतिष्ठस्व रथान् राजन् विक्रमस्व विहायसम्। वयमप्यनुयास्यामो यदा कालो भविष्यति॥
en: Ashtaka said: O king, get on these cars and go to heaven. We shall also follow you in time.

sn: ययातिरुवाच सरिदानी गन्तव्यं सह स्वर्गजितो वयम्। एष नो विरजाः पन्था दृश्यते देवसद्मनः॥
en: Yayati said: We can now all go together. All of us have conquered heaven . Behold, the glorious path to heaven becomes visible.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तेऽधिरुह्य स्थान् सर्वे प्रयाता नृपसत्तमाः। आक्रमन्तो दिवं भाभिर्धर्मेणावृत्य रोदसी॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Illuminating the whole firmament by the glory of their virtues, those excellent kings got on those cars and set out in order to get admittance into heaven.

sn: अष्टक उवाच अहं मन्ये पूर्वमेकोऽस्मि गन्ता सखा चेन्द्रः सर्वथा मे महात्मा। मेकोऽत्यगात् सर्ववेगेन वाहान्॥
en: Ashtaka said: I always thought that Indra was my special friend and that I shall, of all others, first obtain admittance into heaven. But how is it that Sibi, the son of Ushinara, has already left us behind?

sn: ययातिरुवाच अददद् देवयानाय यावद् वित्तमविन्दता उशीनरस्य पुत्रोऽयं तस्माच्छ्रेष्ठो हि वः शिबिः॥ दानं तपः सत्यमथापि धर्मो ही: श्रीः क्षमा सौम्यमथो विधित्सा। राजन्नेतान्यप्रमेयाणि राज्ञः शिबेः स्थितान्यप्रतिमस्य बुद्ध्या॥ एवंवृत्तो ह्रीनिषेवश्च यस्मात् तस्माच्छिबिरत्यगाद् वै रथेन।
en: Yayati said : This son of Ushinara had given all he possessed to attain to the region of Brahma. Therefore, he is the foremost among all of you. Shibi's liberality, asceticism, truth, virtue, modesty, good fortune, forgiveness, amiability and desire of performing good acts, have been so great that none can measure them. The king Sibi is crowned with righteousness and is bashful, therefore he is foremost among all of us.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच मातामहं कौतुकेनेन्द्रकल्पम्॥ पृच्छामि त्वां नृपते ब्रूहि सत्यं कुतश्च कश्चासि सुतश्च कस्य। कृतं त्वया यद्धि न तस्य कर्ता लोके त्वदन्यः क्षत्रियो ब्राह्मणो वा॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Ashtaka, impelled by curiosity, again asked his maternal grandfather, who was like Indra himself, “O king, I ask you, tell me truly, whence have you come? Who are you? and whose son are you?

sn: ययातिरुवाच ययातिरस्मि नहुषस्य पुत्रः पूरोः पिता सार्वभौमस्त्विहासम्। गुह्यं चार्थं मामकेभ्यो ब्रवीमि मातामहोऽहं भवतां प्रकाशम्॥
en: Yayati said: I tell you truly, I am Yayati, the son of Nahusha and the father of Puru. I was a Sarvabhauma (Universal monarch) on earth. You are my kinsmen. I am your maternal grandfather.

sn: सर्वामिमां पृथिवीं निर्जिगाय प्रादामहं छादनं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः। स्तदा देवाः पुण्यभाजो भवन्ति॥
en: Having conquered the whole earth, I gave clothes to the Brahmanas. I gave them also one hundred horses fit for sacrificial offerings. For such pious acts the celestials become propitious to those that perform them.

sn: अदामहं पृथिवीं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः पूर्णामिमामखिलां वाहनेन। स्तदाददं गाः शतमर्बुदानि।२४॥
en: gave also to Brahmanas this whole earth with her horses, elephants, kine, gold and all kinds of wealth. I gave away also one hundred Arbudas, the excellent milk cows.

sn: सत्येन वै द्यौश्च वसुन्धरा च तथैवाग्निर्चलते मानुषेषु। न मे वृथा व्यहृतमेव वाक्यं सत्यं हि सन्तः प्रतिपूजयन्ति॥
en: The firmament and earth still exist owing to my truth and virtue. Fire and burns owing to my truth and virtue. Never a word has been uttered by me which is not true. The wise, therefore, adore truth.

sn: यदष्टक प्रब्रवीमीह सत्यं प्रतर्दनं चौषदश्विं तथैवा सर्वे च लोका मुनयश्च देवाः सत्येन पूज्या इति मे मनोगतम्॥
en: O Ashtaka, all that I have told you, Pratardana and Vasuman, the son of Uşadasva is the truth itself. I know that all the worlds, all the Rishis and all the celestials are adorable only because Truth characterises them all.

sn: यो नः स्वर्गजितः सर्वान् यथा वृत्तं निवेदयत्। अनुसूयुर्द्विजायेभ्यः स लभेन्नः सलोकताम्॥
en: He who will duly read to the good Brahmanas, the account of our ascension to heaven without malice shall himself attain to the same worlds with us.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं राजा स महात्मा ह्यतीव स्वैर्दोहित्रैस्तारितोऽमित्रसाहः। त्यक्त्वा महीं परमोदारकर्मा स्वर्गं गतः कर्मभिर्व्याप्य पृथ्वीम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus ascended to heaven that illustrious man (Yayati) of great achievements. Rescued by his kinsmen, he left the earth and filled the three worlds with the fame of his deeds.

sn: जनमेजय उवाच भगवच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि पूरोर्वंशकरान् नृपान्। यद्वीर्यान् यादृशांश्चापि यावतो यत्पराक्रमान्॥
en: Janamejaya said : Adorable Sir, I desire to hear the history of those kings who were descended from Puru. Tell me what powers and what achievements each possessed?

sn: न ह्यस्मिन् शीलहीनो वा निर्वीर्यो वा नराधिपः। प्रजाविरहितो वापि भूतपूर्वः कथंचन॥
en: I have heard that in the dynasty of Puru there was not a single king who was deficient in good behaviour or in prowess. There was none who has no sons.

sn: तेषां प्रथितवृत्तानां राज्ञां विज्ञानशालिनाम्। चरितं श्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तरेण तपोधन॥
en: O great ascetic, I desire to hear in detail the account of these kings who were endued with great learning and who possessed all accomplishments.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि। पूरोर्वंशधरान् वीराज्छक्रप्रतिमतेजसः। भूरिद्रविणविक्रान्तान् सर्वलक्षणपूजितान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: As you ask me I shall tell you all about the heroic kings of Puru's royal dynasty, who were all equal to Indra in power. They possessed great affluence and commanded the respect of all, on account of their many accomplishments.

sn: प्रवीरेश्वररौद्राश्वास्त्रयः पुत्रा महारथाः। पूरोः पौष्ट्यामजायन्त प्रवीरो वंशकृत् ततः॥
en: Puru begot on his wife Paushti three great car-warriors, namely Pravira, Ishvara and Raudrashva. Amongst these three, Pravira kept up the line.

sn: मनस्युरभवत् तस्माच्छूरसेनीसुतः प्रभुः। पृथिव्याश्चतुरन्ताया गोप्ता राजीवलोचनः॥
en: Pravira begot on his wife Shuraseni, a son named Manasyu. This lotus-eyed king had his sovereignty over the whole earth bounded by the four seas.

sn: शक्तः संहननो वाग्मी सौवीरीतनयास्त्रयः। मनस्योरभवन् पुत्राः शूराः सर्वे महारथाः॥
en: Manasyu begot on his wife Sauviri three sons, namely Shakta, Sanhanana and Vagmi; they were all great heroes and car-warriors.

sn: अन्वम्भानुप्रभृतयो मिश्रकेश्यां मनस्विनः। रौद्राश्वस्य महेष्वासा दशाप्सरसि सूनवः॥ यज्वानो जज्ञिरे शूराः प्रजावन्तो बहुश्रुताः। सर्वे सर्वास्त्रविद्वांसः सर्वे धर्मपरायणाः॥
en: The wise and virtuous Raudrashva begoi on Apsara Mishrakeshi ten sons who were all great bow-men. They were great heroes and performed many sacrifices in honour of the celestial; they were learned in all the Shastras and were virtuous. All of them begot sons.

sn: ऋचेयुरथ कक्षेयुः कृकणेयुश्च वीर्यवान्। स्थण्डिलेयुर्वनेयुश्च जलेयुश्च महायशाः॥ तेजेयुर्बलवान् धीमान् सत्येयुश्चेन्द्रविक्रमः। धर्मेयुः संनतेयुश्च दशमो देवविक्रमः॥
en: They were Richeyu, Kaksheyu, powerful Krikaneyu, Sthandileyu, Vaneyu, greatly famous Jaleyu, intelligent and strong Tejeyu, Indra-like powerful Satyeyu, Dharmeyu and celestial-like powerful Sannateyu.

sn: अनाधृष्टिरभूत् तेषां विद्वान् भुवि तथैकराट्। ऋचेयुरथ विक्रान्तो देवानामिव वासवः॥
en: Amongst them all, Richeyu became the sole lord of the whole earth and was known by the name of Anadhrishti. He was in prowess like Indra.

sn: अनाधृष्टिसुतस्त्वासीद् राजसूयाश्वमेधकृत्। मतिनार इति ख्यातो राजा परमधार्मिकः॥
en: Anadhrishti had a son, named Matinara who became a very virtuous king and greatly famous. He performed both Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifices.

sn: मतिनारसुता राजश्चत्वारोऽमितविक्रमाः। तंसुर्महानतिरथो दुह्यश्चाप्रतिमद्युतिः॥
en: Matinara had four greatly powerful sons, namely Tansu, Mahan, Atiratha and immeasurably glorious Druhyu.

sn: तेषां तंसुर्महावीर्यः पौरवं वंशमुद्वहन्। आजहार यशो दीप्तं जिगाय च वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Amongst them, greatly powerful Tansu became the perpetuator of Puru's line. He subjugated the whole earth and gained great fame and splendour.

sn: ईलिनं तु सुतं तंसुर्जनयामास वीर्यवान्। सोऽपि कृत्स्नामिमां भूमिं विजिग्ये जयतां वरः॥
en: Tansu begot a greatly powerful son, named Ilina. He also became the foremost of all conquerors and subjugated the whole world.

sn: रथन्तर्यां सुतान् पञ्च पञ्चभूतोपमांस्ततः। ईलिनो जनयामास दुष्यन्तप्रभृतीन् नृपान्॥
en: Ilina begot on his wife, Rathantari, five sons, Dushyanta being the eldest. They were all as great in power as the five elements.

sn: दुष्यन्तं शूरभीमौ च प्रवसुं वसुमेव च। तेषां श्रेष्ठोऽभवद् राजा दुष्यन्तो जनमेजय॥
en: (They were) Dushyanta, Shura, Bhima, Pravasu and Vasu. O Janamejaya, amongst them the eldest Dushyanta became king.

sn: दुष्यन्ताद् भरतो जज्ञे विद्वाञ्छाकुन्तलो नृपः। तस्माद् भरतवंशस्य विप्रतस्थे महद् यशः॥
en: Dushyanta begot on his wife, Shakuntala, a learned son, named Bharata who became king. From him was the Bharata dynasty and from his spread its great fame.

sn: भरतस्तिसृषु स्त्रीषु नव पुत्रानजीजनत्। नाभ्यनन्दत तान् राजा नानुरूपा ममेत्युत॥
en: Bharata begot on his three wives nine sons, but none of them was like his father and Bharata was not satisfied with any of them.

sn: ततस्तान् मातरः क्रुद्धाः पुत्रान् निन्युर्यमक्षयम्। ततस्तस्य नरेन्द्रस्य वितथं पुत्रजन्म तत्॥
en: Thereupon their mothers, becoming angry, killed them all. Therefore, the procreation of that great king was in vain.

sn: ततो महद्भिः क्रतुभिरीजानो भरतस्तदा। लेभे पुत्रं भरद्वाजाद् भुमन्युं नाम भारत॥
en: The king then performed a great sacrifice and obtained a son, named Bhumanyu through the grace of Bharadvaja.

sn: ततः पुत्रिणमात्मानं ज्ञात्वा पौरवनन्दनः। भुमन्युं भरतश्रेष्ठ यौवराज्येऽभ्यषेचयत्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the descendant of Puru, regarding himself as really possessing a son, installed him as his heir-apparent.

sn: ततो दिविरथो नाम भुमन्योरभवत् सुतः। सुहोत्रश्च सुहोता च सुहविः सुयजुस्तथा॥ पुष्करिण्यामचीकश्च भुमन्योरभवन् सुताः। तेषां ज्येष्ठः सुहोत्रस्तु राज्यमाप महीक्षिताम्॥
en: Bhumanyu begot on his wife Pushkarini six sons, namely Suhotra, Suhota Suhavi, Suyaju, Richika and Diviratha. The eldest of them Suhotra obtained the throne of the world.

sn: राजसूयाश्वमेधाद्यैः सोऽयजद् बहुभिः सवैः। सुहोत्रः पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां बुभुजे सागराम्बराम्॥ पूर्णां हस्तिगजाश्चैश्च बहुरत्नसमाकुलाम्। मम व मही तस्य भूरिभारावपीडिता॥ हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पूर्णा मनुष्यकलिला भृशम्। सुहोने राजनि तदा धर्मतः शासति प्रजाः॥
en: He performed many Rajasuya and Horsesacrifices. He subjugated the whole earth bounded by the four seas, And full of elephants, kine, horses and great wealth of gems and gold. The earth was, as it were, sinking with the weight of numberless human beings, elephants, horses and cars. Suhotra virtuously ruled over all his subjects.

sn: चैत्ययूपाङ्किता चासीद् भूमिः शतसहस्रशः। प्रवृद्धजनसस्या च सर्वदैव व्यरोचत॥
en: During his reign, the surface of the whole earth was dotted all over with hundreds and thousands of sacrificial stakes. The earth became full of corns and human beings.

sn: ऐक्ष्वाकी जनयामास सुहोत्रात् पृथिवीपतेः। अजमीढं सुमीढं च पुरुमीढं च भारत॥
en: O descendent of the Bharata race, the lord of the earth Suhotra begot on his wife, Aikshvaki three sons, namely Ajamidha, Sumidha and Purumidha.

sn: अजमीढो वरस्तेषां तस्मिन् वंशः प्रतिष्ठितः। षट् पुत्रान् सोऽप्यजनयत् तिसृषु स्त्रीषु भारत॥
en: The eldest of them Ajamidha became the perpetuator of the royal line. O descendant of the Bharata race, he begot six sons upon his three wives.

sn: ऋक्षं धूमिन्यथो नीली दुष्यन्तपरमेष्ठिनौ। केशिन्यजनयजह्ल सुतौ व्रजनरूपिणौ॥
en: Riksha was born in the womb of Dhumini, Dushyanta and Parameshti in that of Nili and Jahnu, Jala and Rupina in that of Keshini.

sn: तथेमे सर्वपञ्चाला दुष्यन्तपरमेष्ठिनोः। अन्वयाः कुशिका राजन् जह्रोरमिततेजसः॥
en: All the Panchalas were descended from Dushyanta and Parameshti. The Kushikas were the descendants of the greatly effulgent Jahnu.

sn: जलरूपिणयोज्येष्ठमृक्षमाहुर्जनाधिपम्। ऋक्षात् संवरणो जज्ञे राजन् वंशकरः सुतः॥
en: Riksha was elder than Jala and Rupina; he begot Samvarana, who was the perpetuator of the line.

sn: आर्भे संवरणे राजन् प्रशासति वसुंधराम्। संक्षयः सुमहानासीत् प्रजानामिति न श्रुतम्॥ व्यशीर्यत ततो राष्ट्रं क्षयैर्नानाविधैस्तदा। क्षुन्मृत्युभ्यामनावृष्ट्या व्याधिभिश्च समाहतम्॥
en: O king, it has been heard by us that when Samvarana, the son of Riksha, was ruling the earth, there occurred a great loss of people on account of famine, plague, draught and disease.

sn: अभ्यघ्नन् भारतांश्चैव सपत्नानां बलानि च। चालयन् वसुधां चेमां बलेन चतुरङ्गिणा॥ अभ्ययात् तं च पाञ्चाल्यो विजित्य तरसा महीम्। अक्षौहिणीभिर्दशभिः स एनं समरेऽजयत्॥
en: The Bharata princes were defeated by the armies of their enemies; and the Panchalas, set out with their four kinds of troops to conquer the earth. They soon brought the whole earth under their sway and with their ten Akshauhinis of soldiers the king of the Panchalas defeated the princes of Bharata.

sn: ततः सदारः सामात्यः सपुत्रः ससुहृजनः। राजा संवरणस्तस्मात् पलायत महाभयात्॥
en: Samvarana then fled in fear with his wife, sons, relatives and ministers from that place.

sn: सिन्धोर्नदस्य महतो निकुञ्जे न्यवसत् तदा। नदीविषयपर्यन्ते पर्वतस्य समीपतः॥
en: He took shelter in the forest on the banks of the river Sindhu which extended up to the foot of the mountain.

sn: तत्रावसन् बहून् कालान् भारता दुर्गमाश्रिताः। तेषां निवसतां तत्र सहस्रं परिवत्सरान्॥
en: There lived the Bharatas within their fort for many years; and thus full one thousand years: and thus full one thousand years passed away.

sn: अथाभ्यगच्छद् भरतान् वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः। तमागतं प्रयत्नेन प्रत्युद्गम्याभिवाद्य च॥ अध्यमभ्याहरंस्तस्मै ते सर्वे भारतास्तदा। निवेद्य सर्वमृषये सत्कारेण सुवर्चसे॥ तमासने चोपविष्टं राजा ववे स्वयं तदा। पुरोहितो भवान् नोऽस्तु राज्याय प्रयतेमहि॥
en: (And when they were living there), the illustrious Rishi Vasistha one day came to those exiled Bharatas. On his approach, they went out and duly worshipped him. All the Bharatas offered him Arghya and entertaining him with reverence, they told every thing to the great Rishi. When he was seated on his seat, the king himself addressed him thus, "O illustrious man, be our priest. We shall try to regain our kingdom."

sn: ओमित्येवं वसिष्ठोऽपि भारतान् प्रत्यपद्यत। अथाभ्यषिञ्चत् साम्राज्ये सर्वक्षत्रस्य पौरवम्॥ विषाणभूतं सर्वस्यां पृथिव्यामिति नः श्रुतम्। भरताध्युषितं पूर्वं सोऽध्यतिष्ठत् पुरोत्तमम्॥
en: Vasistha replied to the Bharatas by saying Om. We have heard that Vasistha installed the best of the Pauravas (Samvarana) as the lord over all the Kshatriya races. The king retook the capital that was lost.

sn: पुनर्बलभृतश्चैव चक्रे सर्वमहीक्षितः। ततः स पृथिवीं प्राप्य पुनरीजे महाबलः॥ आजमीढो महायज्ञैर्बहुभिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः। ततः संवरणात् सौरी तपती सुषुवे कुरुम्॥
en: He then began to make all the other kings of the world to pay tribute to him. That powerful monarch, thus getting possession of the whole earth, performed many sacrifices in which great presents were made to the Brahmanas. Samvarana begot on his wife Tapati, the daughter of Surya, a son named Kuru.

sn: राजत्वे तं प्रजाः सर्वा धर्मज्ञ इति वव्रिरे। तस्य नाम्नाभिविख्यातं पृथिव्यां कुरुजाङ्गलम्॥
en: As Kuru was greatly virtuous, he was installed as the king by all the people. It is after his name that Kuru Jangala has become so famous in the world.

sn: कुरुक्षेत्रं स तपसा पुण्यं चक्रे महातपाः। अश्ववन्तमभिष्यन्तं तथा चैत्ररथं मुनिम्॥ जनमेजयं च विख्यातं पुत्रांश्चास्यानुशुश्रुम। पञ्चैतान् वाहिनी पुत्रान् व्यजायत मनस्विनी॥ :।
en: That great ascetic made Kurukshetra famous by his asceticism there. We have heard that Avikshit, Abhishyanta, Chaitraratha, Muni and famous Janamejaya were the five sons begot by him on his highly intelligent wife Vahini.

sn: अविक्षितः परिक्षित् तु शबलाश्वस्तु वीर्यवान्। आदिराजो विराजश्च शाल्मलिश्च महाबलः॥ उचैःश्रवा भड्कारो जितारिश्चाष्टमः स्मृतः। एतेषामन्ववाये तु ख्यातास्ते कर्मजैर्गुणैः। जनमेजयादयः सप्त तथैवान्ये महारथाः॥
en: Avikshit begot Parikshit, powerful Sabalashva, Adiraja, Viraja, greatly strong Shalmali, Uchchaishrava, Bhangakara and the eighth Jitari. In the race of these (eight heroes) were born, as the fruits of their many virtuous acts, seven greatly powerful car-warriors, Janamejaya being at the head.

sn: परिक्षितोऽभवन् पुत्राः सर्वे धर्मार्थकोविदाः। कक्षसेनोग्रसेनौ तु चित्रसेनश्च वीर्यवान्॥ इन्द्रसेनः सुषेणश्च भीमसेनश्च नामतः। जनमेजयस्य तनया भुवि ख्याता महाबलाः॥ धृतराष्ट्रः प्रथमजः पाण्डुर्बाह्नीक एव च। निषधश्च महातेजास्तथा जाम्बूनदो बली।॥ कुण्डोदरः पदातिश्च वसातिश्चाष्टमः स्मृतः। सर्वे धर्मार्थकुशलाः सर्वभूतहिते रताः॥
en: Parikshit had sons who were all learned Dharma and Artha. They were Kakshasena, Ugrasena and greatly effulgent Chitrasena, Indrasena, Sushena and Bhimasena. All the sons of Janamejaya were famous in the world as being greatly powerful (princes). They were Dhritarashtra, the eldest, Pandu, Balhika, greatly effulgent Nishada, the mighty Jambunada, Kundodara, Padati and the eighth Vasati. They were all learned in Dharma and Artha and engaged in doing good to all creatures.

sn: धृतराष्ट्रोऽथ राजाऽऽसीत् तस्य पुत्रोऽथ कुण्डिकः। हस्ती वितर्कः क्राथश्च कुण्डिनश्चापि पञ्चमः॥ हविःश्रवास्तथेन्द्राभो भुमन्युश्चापराजितः। धृतराष्ट्रसुतानां तु त्रीनेतान् प्रथितान् भुवि॥ प्रतीपं धर्मनेत्रं च सुनेत्रं चापि भारत। प्रतीपः प्रथितस्तेषां बभूवाप्रतिमो भुवि॥
en: Amongst them Dhritarashtra became king and he had eight sons, namely Kundika, Hasti, Vitarka, Kratha, Kundina, Havishrava, Indrabha and the invincible Bhumanyu. Amongst the sons of Dhritarashtra only three were famous. O descendant of Bharata, (they were) Pratipa, Dharmanetra and Sunetra. Amongst the three Pratipa became unrivalled of all.

sn: प्रतीपस्य त्रयः पुत्रा जज्ञिरे भरतर्षभ। देवापिः शान्तनुश्चैव बाह्लीकश्च महारथः॥ देवापिश्च प्रवव्राज तेषां धर्महितेप्सया। शान्तनुश्च महीं लेभे बाह्रीकश्च महारथः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, Pratipa begot three sons, namely Devapi, Shantanu and mighty car-warrior Balhika. Devapi adopted asceticism, impelled by the desire to do good to his brothers. Consequently the kingdom was obtained by Shantanu and the mighty carwarrior Balhika.

sn: भरतस्यान्वये जाताः सत्त्ववन्तो नराधिपाः। देवर्षिकल्पा नृपते बहवो राजसत्तमाः॥
en: O king, besides these (I have mentioned), there were born in the Bharata race many other good monarchs all greatly effulgent and all like the celestial Rishis in virtue and ascetic power.

sn: एवंविधाश्चाप्यपरे देवकल्पा महारथाः। जाता मनोरन्ववाये ऐलवंशविवर्धनाः॥
en: In this way were born in the race of Manu, many mighty car-warriors like the celestials themselves and who by their number greatly increased the Aila dynasty.

sn: जनमेजय उवाच क्षुतस्त्वत्तो मया ब्रह्मन् पूर्वेषां सम्भवो महान्। उदाराश्चापि वंशेऽस्मिन् राजानो मे परिश्रुताः॥
en: Janamejaya said : O Brahmana, I have heard from you the great history of my ancestors. I have also heard from you about the great kings that were born in my dynasty.

sn: किंतु लध्वर्थसंयुक्तं प्रियाख्यानं न मामति। प्रीणात्यतो भवान् भूयो विस्तरेण ब्रवीतु मे॥ एतामेव कथां दिव्यामाप्रजापतितो मनोः। तेषामाजननं पुण्यं कस्य न प्रीतिमावहेत्॥
en: But I am not still satiated with this charming account, for it is so short. Therefore, narrate to me in detail. This delightful history, commencing from Prajapati Manu. Who will not feel delight in hearing such an account, sacred as it is.

sn: सद्धर्मगुणमाहात्म्यैरभिवर्धितमुत्तमम्। विष्टभ्य लोकांस्त्रीनेषां यशः स्फीतमवस्थितम्॥
en: The fame of these monarchs covered the three on account of their wisdom, virtue, accomplishments and high characters.

sn: गुणप्रभाववीयौजःसत्त्वोत्साहवतामहम्। न तृप्यामि कथां शृण्वन्नमृतास्वादसम्मिताम्॥
en: Having heard of their liberality, prowess, physical strength, mental vigour, energy and perseverance, this history, sweet as ambrosia, I have not been satiated.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच शृणु राजन् पुरा सम्यङ्मया द्वैपायनाच्छुतम्। प्रोच्यमानमिदं कृत्स्नं स्ववंशजननं शुभम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, hear the auspicious history, of your own race as I recite it to you in detail and just as I heard it before from Dvaipayana.

sn: दक्षाददितिरदितेर्विवस्वान् विवस्वतो मनुमनोरिला इलायाः पुरूरवाः पुरूरवस आयुरायुषो नहुषो नहुषाद् ययातिः; ययातेद्वैभार्ये बभूवतुः॥ उशनसो दुहिता देवयानी; वृषपर्वणश्च दुहिता शर्मिष्ठा नाम॥
en: Daksha, begot Aditi, Aditi begot Vivasvat. Vivasvat begot Manu. Manu begot lla. Ila begot Pururava, Pururava begot Ayusha, Ayusha begot Nahusha, Nahusha begot Yayati, Yayati had two wives, namely Devayani, the daughter of Ushanas (Shukra) and Sharmishtha, the daughter of Vrishaparva.

sn: अत्रानुवंशश्लोको भवति यदुं च तुर्वसुं चैव देवयानी व्यजायत। दुह्यु चानुं च पूरुं च शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी॥
en: This is a Sloka about this line-Devayani gave birth to Yadu and Turvasu; and Sharmishtha, the daughter of Vrishaparva, gave birth to Druhyu, Anu and Puru.

sn: तत्र यदोर्यादवाः पूरोः पौरवाः॥
en: From Yadu, the Yadavas were descended and from Puru and Pauravas.

sn: पूरोस्तु भार्या कौसल्या नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे जनमेजयो नाम; यस्त्रीनश्वमेधानाजहार, विश्वजिता चेष्टवा वनं विवेश॥
en: Puru had a wife, named Kaushalya and he begot on her a son named Janamejaya. He performed three great Horse-sacrifices and a sacrifice called Vishvajit. He then retired into a forest.

sn: जनमेजयः खल्वनन्तां नामोपयेमे माधवीम्। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे प्राचिन्वान्; यः प्राची दिशं जिगाय यावत् सूर्योदयात्, ततस्तस्य प्राचिन्वत्त्वम्॥
en: Janamejaya married Ananta, the daughter of Madhava. He begot on her a son, named Prachinvan. He was so called because he conquered all the countries in the east even where the sun rises.

sn: प्राचिन्वान् खल्वश्मकीमुपयेमे यादवीम्। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे संयातिः॥
en: Prachinvan married Ashmaki, the daughter of the Yadavas and she gave birth to a son, named Sanyati.

sn: संयातिः खलु दृषद्वतो दुहितरं वराङ्गी नामोपयेमे। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे अहंयातिः॥
en: Sanyati married Varangi, the daughter of Drishadvata and she gave birth to a son called Ahamyati.

sn: अहंथातिः खलु कृतवीर्यदुहितरमुपयेमे भानुमती नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे सार्वभौमः॥
en: Ahamyati married Bhanumati, the daughter of Kritavirya and he begot on her a son, named Sarvabhauma.

sn: सार्वभौमः खलु जित्वा जहार कैकेयीं सुनन्दा नाम। तामुपयेमे। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे जयत्सेनो नाम॥
en: Sarvabhauma married Sunanda, the daughter of Kekaya who was taken by force and she gave birth to a son, named Jayatsena.

sn: जयत्सेनो खलु वैदर्भीमुपयेमे सुश्रवां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे अवाचीनः॥
en: Jayatsena married Sushrava, the daughter of the Vidarbha king and she gave birth to a son, named Avachina.

sn: अवाचीनोऽपि वैदर्भीमपरामेवोपयेमे मर्यादां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे अरिहः॥
en: Avachina married another princess of the Vidharbha kings, called Maryada and she gave birth to a son, named Ariha.

sn: अरिहः खल्वाङ्गीमुपयेमे। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे महाभौमः।।
en: Ariha married Angi and she gave birth to a son, named Mahabhauma.

sn: महाभौमः खलु प्रासेनजितीमुपयेमे सुयज्ञां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे अयुतनायी; यः पुरुषमेधानामयुतमानयत्, तेनास्यायुतनायित्वम्॥
en: Mahabhauma married Suyajna, the daughter of Prasenjit and she gave birth to a son, named Ayutanayi. He was so called, because he performed a sacrifice in which the fat of one Ayuta male beings was required.

sn: अयुतनायी खलु पृथुश्रवसो दुहितरमुपयेमे कामां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे अक्रोधनः॥
en: Ayutanayi married Kama, the daughter of Prithushrava and she gave birth to a son, called Akrodhana.

sn: स खलु कालिङ्गीं करम्भां नामोपयेमे। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे देवातिथिः॥
en: Akrodhana married Karambha, the daughter of the king of Kalinga and she gave birth to a son, called Devatithi.

sn: देवातिथिः खलु वैदेहीमुपयेमे मर्यादां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे अरिहो नाम॥
en: Devatithi married Maryada, the princess of Videha and she gave birth to a son, named Ariha.

sn: अरिहः खल्वाङ्गेयीमुपयेमे सुदेवां नाम। तस्यां पुत्रमजीजनदृक्षम्॥
en: Ariha married Sudeva, the princess of Anga and she gave birth to a son, Riksha.

sn: ऋक्षः खलु तक्षकदुहितरमुपयेमे ज्वाला नाम। तस्यां पुत्रं मतिनारं नामोत्पादयामास॥
en: Riksha married Jvala, the daughter of Takshaka and she gave birth to a son, named Matinara.

sn: मतिनारः खलु सरस्वत्यां गुणसमन्वितं द्वादशवार्षिकं सत्रमाहरत्। समाप्ते च सत्रे सरस्वत्यभिगम्य तं भर्तारं वरयामास। तस्यां पुत्रमजीजनत् तंसुं नाम॥
en: Matinara performed the most efficacious twelve years' sacrifice on the banks of the Sarasvati. At the conclusion of the sacrifice, the Sarasvati herself appeared before him and chose him as her husband. He begot on her a son, named Tansu.

sn: अत्रानुवंशश्लोको भवति-तंसुं सरस्वती पुत्रं मतिनारादजीजनत्। ईलिनं जनयामास कालिङ्गयां तंसुरात्मजम्॥
en: Here is Sloka describing Tansu's descendants. Tansu begot on his wife, the princess of Kalinga, a son, named Ilina.

sn: ईलिनस्तु रथन्तर्यां दुष्यन्ताद्यान् पञ्च पुत्रानजीजनत्॥
en: Ilana begot on his wife, Rathantari, five sons, Dushyanta being the eldest of them.

sn: दुष्यन्तः खलु विश्वामित्रदुहितरं शकुन्तलां नामोपयेमे। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे भरतः॥
en: Dushyanta married Shakuntala, the daughter of Vishvamitra and she gave birth to a son, named Bharata.

sn: अत्रानुवंशश्लोकौ भवतःभस्त्रा माता पितुः पुत्रो येन जातः स एव सः। भरस्व पुत्रं दुष्यन्त मावमंस्थाः शकुन्तलाम्॥
en: Here are two Slokas, describing the descendants of Bharata. "O Dushyanta, the mother is but a sheath of flesh (within which the son dwells). The son sprung from the father is the father himself. Therefore, cherish your son. Do not insult Shakuntala.

sn: रेतोधाः पुत्र उन्नयति नरदेव यमक्षयात्। त्वं चास्य धाता गर्भस्य सत्यमाह शकुन्तला॥
en: "O best of men, the son, begotten by one's own self, rescues him from the abode of Yama. You are the father of this son. Shakuntala has spoken the truth."

sn: ततोऽस्य भरतत्वम्। भरतः खलु काशेयीमुपयेमे सार्वसेनी सुनन्दा नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे भुमन्युः॥
en: It is for this reason he was called Bharata. Bharata married Sunanda, the daughter of Sarvasena, the king of Kashi and she gave birth to a son, called Bhumanyu.

sn: भुमन्युः खलु दाशाहीमुपयेमे विजयां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे सुहोत्रः॥
en: Bhumanyu married Vijaya, the daughter of Dasarha and she gave birth to a son, named Suhotra.

sn: सुहोत्रः खल्विक्ष्वाकुकन्यामुपयेमे सुवर्णां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे हस्ती; य इदं हास्तिनपुरं ख्यापयामास। एतदस्य हास्तिनपुरत्वम्॥
en: Suhotra married Suvarna, the daughter of Ikshaku and she gave birth to a son, named Hasti, who founded this city, called after his name Hastinapur.

sn: हस्ती खलु रैगर्तीमुपयेमे यशोधरां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे विकुण्ठनो नाम॥
en: Hasti married Yashodhara, the princess of Trigarta and she gave birth to a son, named Vikunthana.

sn: विकुण्ठनः खलु दाशार्हामुपयेमे सुदेवां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे अजमीढो नाम॥
en: Vikunthana married Sudeva, the princess of Dasarha and she gave birth to a son, named Ajamidha.

sn: अजमीढस्य चतुर्विशं पुत्रशतं बभूव कैकेय्यां गान्धार्यां विशालायामृक्षायां चेति। पृथक् पृथग् वंशधरा नृपतयः। तत्र वंशकरः संवरणः॥
en: Ajamidha had four wives, namely Kaikeyi, Gandhari, Vishala and Riksha and he begot on them two thousands and one hundred sons. And Amongst them all, Samvarana became the perpetuator of the dynasty,

sn: संवरणः खलु वैवस्वतीं तपती नामोपयेमे। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे कुरुः॥
en: Samvarana married Tapati, the daughter of Vivasvata and she gave birth to a son, named Kuru.

sn: कुरुः खलु दाशार्हामुपयेमे शुभाङ्गी नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे विदूरः॥
en: Kuru married Shubhangi, the princess of Dasarha and she gave birth to a son, named Vidura.

sn: विदूरस्तु माधवीमुपयेमे सम्प्रियां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे अनश्वा नाम॥
en: Vidura married Sungpriya, the daughter of Madhava and she gave birth to a son, named Anashva.

sn: अनश्वा खलु मागधीमुपयेमे अमृतां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे परिक्षित्॥
en: Anashva married Amrita, the daughter of the Magadhas and she gave birth to a son, named Parikshit.

sn: परिक्षित् खलु वाहुदामुपयेमे सुयशां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे भीमसेनः॥
en: Parikshit married Suyasha, the daughter of Vahuda and she gave birth to a son, named Bhimasena.

sn: भीमसेनः खलु कैकेयीमुपयेमे कुमारी नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे प्रतिश्रवा नाम॥
en: Bhimasena married Kumari, the princess of Kekaya and she gave birth to a son, named Pratishrava.

sn: प्रतिश्रवसः प्रतीपः खलु। शैव्यामुपयेमे सुनन्दा नाम। तस्यां पुत्रानुत्पादयामास देवापिं शान्तनुं बाह्लीकं चेति॥
en: Pratishrava begot Pratipa; Pratipa married Sunanda, the daughter of Sibi and she gave birth to three sons, namely Devapi, Shantanu and Balhika.

sn: देवापि खलु बाल एवारण्यं विवेश। शान्तनुस्तु महीपालो बभूव॥
en: Devapi retired into a forest as a hermit when he was still a boy. Therefore, Shantanu became king.

sn: अत्रानुवंशश्लोको भवति यं यं कराभ्यां स्पृशति जीर्णं स सुखमश्नुते। पुनर्युवा च भवति तस्मात् तं शान्तनुं विदुः।। इति तदस्य शान्तनुत्वम्॥
en: Here occurs a Sloka, describing Shantanu. "Those that were touched by this king with his hands, felt indescribable pleasure. They became restored to youth. Therefore, this king was called Shantanu."

sn: शान्तनुः खलु गङ्गां भागीरथीमुपयेमे। तस्थामस्य जज्ञे देवव्रतो नाम यामाहुर्भीष्ममिति॥
en: Shantanu married Ganga and she gave birth to a son, named Devavrata, who was afterwards called Bhishma.

sn: भीष्मः खलु पितुः प्रियचिकीर्षया सत्यवतीं मातरमुदवाहयत्; यामाहुर्गन्धकालीति॥
en: Bhishma, being desirous of doing good to his father, got him married to Satyavati, who was also called Gandhakali.

sn: तस्यां पूर्वं कानीनो गर्भः पराशराद् द्वैपायनोऽभवत्। तस्यामेव शान्तनोरन्यौ द्वौ पुत्रौ बभूवतुः॥
en: In her maidenhood she gave birth to a son by Parashara, named Dvaipayana. Shantanu begot two more sons on her.

sn: विचित्रवीर्यश्चित्राङ्गदश्च। तयोरप्राप्तयौवन एव चित्राङ्गदो गन्धर्वेण हतः; विचित्रवीर्यस्तु राजाऽऽसीत्॥
en: Namely Vichitravirya and Chitrangada. But before they attained to their youth, Chitrangada was killed by the Gandharvas. Therefore, Vichitravirya became king.

sn: विचित्रवीर्यः खलु कौसल्यात्मजे अम्बिकाम्बालिके काशिराजदुहितरावुपयेमे॥
en: Vichitravirya married the two daughters of the king of Kashi born of Kaushalya, named Amyika and Ambalika.

sn: विचित्रवीर्यस्त्वनपत्य एव विदेहत्वं प्राप्तः। ततः सत्यवत्यचिन्तयन्मा दौष्यन्तो वंश उच्छेदं व्रजेदिति॥
en: Vichitravirya died childless. Thereupon, Satyavati began to think how the dynasty of Dushyanta might be perpetuated.

sn: सा द्वैपायनमृषि मनसा चिन्तयामास। स तस्याः पुरतः स्थितः, किं करवाणीति॥
en: She then thought of Rishi Dvaipayana in her mind. He stood before her and said, "What are you commands?”'

sn: सा तमुवाच-भ्राता तवानपत्य एव स्वर्यातो विचित्रवीर्यः। साध्वपत्यं तस्योत्पादयेति॥
en: She told him, “Your brother Vichitravirya has gone to heaven childless. Beget virtuous children for him.”

sn: स तथेत्युक्त्वा त्रीन् पुत्रानुत्पादयामास; धृतराष्ट्र पाण्डु विदुरं चेति॥
en: Dvaipayana consented to do it and he begot three sons, namely Dhritarashtra, Pandu and Vidura.

sn: तत्र धृतराष्ट्रस्य राज्ञः पुत्रशतं बभूव गान्धार्यां वरदानाद् द्वैपायनस्य॥
en: The king Dhritarashtra begot one hundred sons on his wife Gandhari on account of the boon granted by Dvaipayana.

sn: तेषां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राणां चत्वारः प्रधाना बभूवुः; दुर्योधनो दुशासनो विकर्णचित्रसेनश्चेति॥
en: Amongst those one hundred sons, four became famous; (they were) Duryodhana, Dushasana, Vikarna and Chitrasena.

sn: पाण्डोस्तु द्वे भार्ये बभूवतुः कुन्ती पृथा नाम माद्री च इत्युभे स्त्रीरत्ने॥
en: Pandu had two best jewels of wives, namely Kunti, also called Pritha and Madri.

sn: अथ पाण्डुर्मंगयां चरन् मैथुनगतमृषिमपश्यन्मृगयां वर्तमानम्। तथैवाद्भुतमनासादितकामरसमतृप्त बाणेनाजघान॥
en: Pandu one day went to hunt and saw a deer with its mate. It was s Rishi in the form of a deer. He killed it with his arrow in that state, when his desire was not satiated.

sn: स बाणविद्ध उवाच पाण्डुम चरता धर्ममिमं येन त्वयाभिज्ञेन कामरसम्याहमनवाप्तकामरसो निहतस्तस्मात् त्वमप्येतामवस्थामासाद्यानवाप्तकामरस: पञ्चत्वमाम्यसि क्षिप्रमेवेति। स विवर्णरूपस्तथा पाण्डुः शापं परिहरमाणो नोपासर्पत भार्ये। वाक्यं चोवाच-॥
en: Wounded with the arrow of the king, the deer quickly changed its form and became a Rishi. He said to Pandu, "You are virtuous and you know the pleasure derived from the gratification of one's desire. My desire is not yet satisfied, but you have killed me. Therefore, you will also die when you will be so engaged and when your desire will not be gratified.” Pandu became pale to hear this curse. And from that time he did not go to his wives.

sn: स्वचाप्लयादिदं प्राप्तवानहं शृणोमि च शृणोमि च नानपत्स्य लोकासन्तीति। सा त्वं मदर्थे पुत्रानुत्पादयेति कुन्तीमुवाच। सा तथोक्ता पुत्रानुत्पादयामासा धर्माद् युधिष्ठिरं मारुताद् भीमसेनं शक्रादर्जुनमिति॥
en: He told them, “I have been cursed by my fault. But I have heard that there are no regions hereafter for those who are childless." Therefore, he asked Kunti to raise offspring for him. Kunti said, “Let it be so." By Dharma she had Yudhishthira, by Maruta Bhima and by Indra Arjuna.

sn: तां संहृष्टः पाण्डुरुवाच इयं ते सपल्यनपत्या; साध्वस्या अपत्यमुत्पाद्यतामिति। एवमस्त्विति कुन्ती तां विद्यां मात्र्याः प्रायच्छत्॥
en: Pandu was much pleased with her and said, “This your sister (my co-wife) is also childless. Therefore, cause her to give birth to children.” Kunti said, “Let it be so," and she imparted unto Madri the Mantra of invocation.

sn: माभ्यामश्विभ्यां नकुलसहदेवावुत्पादितौ॥
en: And Madri gave birth by the Ashvinis, the twins Nakula and Sahadeva.

sn: माद्रीं खल्वलंकृतां दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुर्भावं चक्रे च तां स्पृष्ट्वैव विदेहत्वं प्राप्तः॥ तत्रैनं चिताग्निस्थं माद्री समन्वारुरोह उवाच कुन्तीम; यमयोरप्रमत्तया त्वया भवितव्यमिति॥
en: One day Pandu saw Madri decked in ornaments and his desire was kindled, As soon as he touched her, he died. Thereupon, Madri ascended, his funeral pyre. She said to Kunti, “Let my twin sons be affectionately brought up by you."

sn: ततस्ते पाण्डवा कुन्त्या सहिता हास्तिनपुरमानीय तापसैर्भीष्मस्य च विदुरस्य च निवेदिताः। सर्ववर्णानां च निवेद्यान्तर्हितास्तापसा बभूवुः प्रेक्ष्यमाणानां तेषाम्॥
en: Some time after, the Pandu princes, with their mother Kunti, were taken by the ascetics to Hastinapur and they were introduced to Bhishma and Vidura. After introducing them to all the orders, the ascetics disappeared in the very sight of all.

sn: तच वाक्यमुपश्रुत्य भगवतामन्तरिक्षात् पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात; देवदुन्दुभयश्च प्रणेदुः॥
en: After the conclusion of the speech of these ascetics, flowers were showered down upon the place and celestial drums were beaten in the sky.

sn: व्यवसितः; न प्रतिगृहीताश्च पाण्डवाः पितुर्निधनमावेदयन् तस्यौर्ध्वदेहिकं न्यायतश्च कृतवन्तः। तांस्तत्र निवसतः पाण्डवान् बाल्यात् प्रभृति दुर्योधनो नामर्षयत्॥
en: The Pandavas were, thereupon, accepted (by all). They then represented the death of their father and duly performed his obsequies. As they were brought up there in their boyhood, Duryodhana became very jealous of them.

sn: पापाचोर राक्षसी बुद्धिमाश्रितोऽनेकैरूपायैरुद्धर्तुं च भावित्याचार्थस्य शकितास्ते समुद्धर्तुम्॥
en: The sinful (Duryodhana), acting like a Rakshasa, attempted by various means to drive them away, but what is to be can never be prevented.

sn: ततश्च धृतराष्ट्रेण व्याजेन वारणावतमनुप्रेषिता गमनमरोचयन्॥
en: Dhritarashtra then by an act of deception sent them to Varanavata. They also went gladly there.

sn: तत्रापि जतुगृहे दग्धुं समारब्धा न शकिता विदुरमन्त्रितेनेति॥
en: An attempt was there made to burn them to death, but they were saved through the warning counsel of Vidura.

sn: तस्माच हिडिम्बमन्तरा हत्वा एकचक्रां गताः॥
en: After this Hidimba was killed and they then went to a place, called Ekachakra.

sn: तस्यामप्येकचक्रायां बकं नाम राक्षसं हत्वा पाञ्चालनगरमधिगताः॥
en: They killed at Ekachakra a Rakshasa, named Baka. They then went to Panchala city.

sn: तत्र द्रौपदी भार्यामविन्दन्, स्वविषयं चाभिजग्मुः॥
en: There they obtained Draupadi as their wife and they returned to their own kingdom.

sn: कुशलिनः पुत्रांश्चोत्पादयामासुः। प्रतिविध्यं युधिष्ठिरः, सुतसोमं वृकोदरः, श्रुतकीर्तिमर्जुन:, शतानीकं नकुलः, श्रुतकर्माणं सहदेव इति॥
en: They lived in peace there (in Hastinapur) and begot sons. Yudhishthira begot Prativindhya, Bhima (begot) Sutasoma, Arjuna (begot) Shrutakirti, Nakula (begot) Shatanika and Sahadeva (begot) Shrutakarmana.

sn: युधिष्ठिरस्तु गोवासनस्य शैव्यस्य देविकां नाम कन्यां स्वयंवरे लेभे। तस्यां पुत्रं जनयामास यौधेयं नाम॥ भीमसेनोऽपि काश्यां बलन्धरां नामोपयेमे वीर्यशुल्काम्। तस्यां पुत्रं सर्वगं नामोत्यादयामास॥
en: Yudhishthira obtained in Svayamvara for his wife Devika, the daughter of Govasana of the Shaivya race and he begot on her a son, named Yaudheya. Bhima also obtained for his wife Balandhara, the daughter of the king of Kashi, by offering as his dower his own great prowess. He begot on her a son, named Sarvaga.

sn: अर्जुनः खलु द्वारवतीं गत्वा भगिनीं वासुदेवस्य सुभद्रां भद्रभाषिणी भार्यामुदावहत्। स्वविषयं चाभ्याजगाम कुशली। तस्यां पुत्रमभिमन्युमतीव गुणसम्पन्नं दयितं वासुदेवस्याजनयत्॥
en: Arjuna went to Dwarika and there he married by force the sweet-speeched Subhadra, the sister of Vasudeva (Krishna). He begot on her a son, named Abhimanyu, who was endued with all accomplishments and who was dear to Vasudeva himself.

sn: नकुलस्तु चैद्यां करेणुमती नाम भार्यामुदावहत्। तस्यां पुत्रं निरमित्रं नामाजनयत्॥
en: Nakula obtained for his wife Karenumati, the princess of Chedi and he begot on her a son, named Niramitra.

sn: सहदेवोऽपि माद्रीमेव स्वयंवरे वियां नामोपयेमे मद्रराजस्य द्युतिमतो दुहितरम्। तस्यां पुत्रमजनयत् सुहोत्रं नाम॥ पुत्राः।
en: Sahadeva obtained in Svayamvara Vijaya, the daughter of Dyutimata, the king of Madra. He begot a son on her, named Suhotra.

sn: भीमसेनस्तु पूर्वमेव हिडिम्बायां राक्षसं घटोत्कचं पुत्रमुत्पादयामास॥
en: Bhima begot some time before on Hidimba a son, named Ghatotkacha.

sn: इत्येत एकादश पाण्डवानां तेषां वंशकरोऽभिमन्युः॥
en: These were the eleven sons, begot by the Pandavas. Amongst them Abhimanyu was the perpetuator of the dynasty.

sn: स विराटस्य दुहितरमुपयेमे उत्तरां नाम। तस्यामस्य परासुर्गर्भोऽभवत्। तमुत्सङ्गेन प्रतिजग्राह पृथा नियोगात् पुरुषोत्तमस्य वासुदेवस्य, पाण्मासिकं गर्भमहमेनं जीवयिष्यामीति॥
en: He married Uttara, the daughter of the king of Virata. She gave birth to a dead child, whom Pritha (Kunti) took up on her lap at the command of Krishna, who said, "I will revive this child of six months.”

sn: स भगवता वासुदेवेनासंजातबलवीर्यपराक्रमोऽकालजातोऽस्त्राग्निना दग्धस्तेजसा स्वेन संजीवितः। जीवयित्वा चैनमुवाचपरिक्षीणे कुले जातो भवत्वयं परिक्षिन्नामेति॥ परिक्षित् खलु माद्रवती नामोपयेमे त्वन्मातरम्। तस्यां भवान् जनमेजयः॥
en: Though born before time, having been burnt by the fire of the weapon (hurled by Ashvathama), though deprived of life, strength and energy, he was revived by Vasudeva and was given strength, energy and prowess. After thus making him alive, Vasudeva said, “As this child is born in an extinct race, let him be called Parikshit.” Parikshit married Madravati, your mother and she gave birth to you, Janamejaya.

sn: भवतो वपुष्टमायां द्वौ पुत्रौ जज्ञाते; शतानीक: शकुकर्णश्च। शतानीकस्य वैदेह्यां पुत्र उत्पन्नोऽश्वमेधदत्त इति॥
en: You have begotten two sons on your wife Vapushtama, named Shatanika and Shankukarna. And Shatanika has also begotten a son on the princess of Videha, named Ashvamedhadatta.

sn: एष पूरोर्वंशः पाण्डवानां च कीर्तितः; धन्यः पुण्यः परमपवित्रः सततं श्रोतव्यो ब्राह्मणैर्नियमवद्भिरनन्तरं क्षत्रियैः स्वधर्मनिरतैः प्रजापालनतत्परैर्वैश्यैरपि श्रोतव्योऽधिगम्यश्च तथा शूद्रैरपि त्रिवर्णशुश्रूषुभिः श्रद्दधानैरिति॥
en: Thus have I narrated to you the history of the Kuru and Pandu dynasty. It is excellent, virtue-increasing and greatly sacred. It should always be heard by the vow-observing Brahmanas and Kshatriyas devoted to the duties of their subjects. (It should be heard) also by Vaishyas with attention and with reverence by Shudras, whose chief duties are to wait upon the three other orders.

sn: इतिहासमिमं पुण्यमशेषतः श्रावयिष्यन्ति ये नराः श्रोष्यन्ति वा नियतात्मानो विमत्सरा मैत्रा वेदपरास्तेऽपि स्वर्गजित: पुण्यलोका भवन्ति सततं देवब्राह्मणमनुष्याणां मान्याः सम्पूज्याश्च॥
en: Those Brahmanas, learned in the Vedas and all those men who will recite or listen to this holy history with attention and reverence, will conquer the heaven and attain to the abode of the blessed. They will be always respected and adored by the celestials, Brahmanas and all other men.

sn: परं हीदं भारतं भगवता व्यासेन प्रोक्तं पावनं ये ब्राह्मणादयो वर्णाः श्रद्दधाना अमत्सरा मैत्रा वेदसम्पन्नाः श्रोष्यन्ति, तेऽपि स्वर्गजितः सुकृतिनोऽशोच्याः कृताकृते भवन्ति॥
en: This holy history, Bharata, has been told by the illustrious Vyasa. The Brahmanas, learned in the Vedas and all those men who hear it recited with reverence and without malice, conquer the heavens and earn great virtues. Though sinning, he is not disrespected by any.

sn: भवति चात्र श्लोकः इदं हि वेदैः समितं पवित्रमपि चोत्तमम्। धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं श्रोतव्यं नियतात्मभिः॥
en: Here occurs a sloka. “This Bharata is equal to the Vedas. It is holy and good. It gives wealth, fame and life. Therefore, it should be heard by men with great attention.”

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवो राजाऽऽसीत् पृथिवीपतिः। महाभिष इति ख्यातः सत्यवाक् सत्यविक्रमः॥ सोऽश्वमेधसहस्रेण राजसूयशतेन च। तोषयामास देवेशं स्वर्ग लेभे ततः प्रभुः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: There was bom a king in the race of Ikshvaku and he was known by the name of Mahabhisha. He, a man, a lord of the world, was truthful and was truly powerful. By performing one thousand Ashvamedha and one hundred Rajasuya sacrifices, he pleased the lord of the celestials. Then he ascended to heaven.

sn: ततः कदाचिद् ब्रह्माणमुपासांचक्रिरे सुराः। तत्र राजर्षयो ह्यासन् स च राजा महाभिषः॥
en: Once upon a time, the celestials were one day worshipping Brahma. Many royal sages and king Mahabhisha were also present there.

sn: अथ गङ्गा सरिच्छेष्ठा समुपायात् पितामहम्। तस्या वासः समुद्भूतं मारुतेन शशिप्रभम्॥
en: The queen of the rivers, Ganga also came there to pay her adorations to the Grandsire. Her garments, as white as the moon, were blown away by the winds.

sn: ततोऽभवन् सुरगणाः सहसावाङ्मुखास्तदा। महाभिषस्तु राजर्षिरशङ्को दृष्टवान् नदीम्॥
en: As her person thus became exposed, the celestials bent down their heads, but the royal sage Mahabhisha rudely continued to stare at her.

sn: सोऽपध्यातो भगवता ब्रह्मणा तु महाभिषः। उक्तश्च जातो मत्र्येषु पुनर्लोकानवाप्स्यसि॥
en: For this (ude act), Mahabhisha was cursed by Brahma . He said, "You will be born on earth and you shall then again attain to these regions."

sn: ययाऽऽहत्तमनाश्चासि गङ्गया त्वं हि दुर्मते। सा ते वै मानुषे लोके विप्रियाण्याचरिष्यति॥ यदा ते भविता मन्युस्तदा शापाद् विमोक्ष्यसे।
en: "When you anger on Ganga, than you also free from his curse."

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच स चिन्तयित्वा नृपतिर्नुपानन्यांस्तपोधनान्॥ प्रतीपं रोचयामास पितरं भूरितेजसम्। महाभिषं तु तं दृष्ट्वा नदी धैर्याच्च्युतं नृपम्॥ तमेव मनसा ध्यायन्त्युपावर्तत् सरिद्वरा। सा तु विध्वस्तवपुषः कश्मलाभिहतान् नृप।॥ ददर्श पथि गच्छन्ती वसून् देवान् दिवौकसः। तथारूपांश्च तान् दृष्ट्वा पप्रच्छ सरितां वरा॥
en: The king (Mahabhisha) then remembered all the monarchs and ascetics on earth and wished to be born as the son of the greatly powerful Pratipa. The best of the rivers, (Ganga) seeing the king Mahabhisha lose his firmness, went away thinking him in her mind. She saw on her way those dwellers of heaven, the Vasus, who were dejected and who had lost heaven.

sn: किमिदं नष्टरूपाः स्थ कचित् क्षेमं दिवौकसाम्। तामूचुर्वसवो देवाः शप्ताः स्मो वै महानदि॥ अल्पेऽपराधे संरम्भाद् वसिष्ठेन महात्मना। विमूढा हि वयं सर्वे प्रच्छन्नमृषिसत्तमम्॥ संध्यां वप्तिष्ठमासीनं तमत्यभिसृताः पुरा। तेन कोपाद् वयं शप्ता योनौ सम्भवतेति ह॥
en: The best of rivers, seeing them in that state them, "O dwellers of heaven, why do you look dejected? Is every thing all right with you?" The celestial Vasus replied to her, “O great river, we have been cursed for our little fault by the illustrious Vasistha in anger. Vasishtha was engaged in his Sandhya (twilight worship); that best of Rishis was not seen by us. We in our ignorance crossed him. Therefore, he cursed us in anger, saying, 'Be born as men.'

sn: न निवर्तयितुं शक्यं यदुक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना। त्वमस्मान् मानुषी भूत्वा सृज पुत्रान् वसून् भुवि॥१५
en: We are not able to frustrate what has been said by that Brahma-knowing Rishi. Kindly make us, the Vasus, your sons by becoming a woman on earth.

sn: न मानुषीणां जठरं प्रविशेम वयं शुभे। इत्युक्ता तैश्च वसुभिस्तथेत्युक्त्वाब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: O amiable one, we are unwilling to enter the womb of any human female.” Having been thus addressed she said :

sn: गङ्गोवाच मर्येषु पुरुषश्रेष्ठः को वः कर्ता भविष्यति।
en: Ganga said : Who is that best of men who will be your father?

sn: वसव ऊचुः प्रतीपस्य सुतो राजा शान्तनुर्लोकविश्रुतः। भविता मानुषे लोके स नः कर्ता भविष्यति॥
en: The Vasus said : There will be born on earth a son to Pratipa who will be a greatly famous king. He will be our father on earth.

sn: गङ्गोवाच ममाप्येवं मतं देवा यथा मां वदतानघाः। प्रियं तस्य करिष्यामि युष्माकं चैतदीप्सितम्॥
en: Ganga said: O celestials, this is also my wish which you sinless ones have expressed. I shall do the favourite works of that king. It is also your wish as just expressed.

sn: वसव ऊचुः जातान् कुमारान् स्वानप्सु प्रक्षेप्तुं वै त्वमर्हसि। यथा न चिरकालं नो निष्कृतिं स्यात् त्रिलोकगे॥
en: The Vasus said : O lady of three courses (celestial, terrestrial and subterranean), you should throw your children into water just after their birth, so that we may not have to live for long on earth.

sn: गङ्गोवाच एवमेतत् करिष्यामि पुत्रस्तस्य विधीयताम्। नास्य मोघः संगमः स्यात् पुत्रहेतोर्मया सह॥
en: Ganga said : I shall do as you desire. But so that my companionship with him may not be entirely fruitless, do this that one son may live.

sn: वसव ऊचुः तुरीयार्धं प्रदास्यामो वीर्यस्यैकैकशो वयम्। तेन वीर्येण पुत्रस्ते भविता तस्य चेप्सितः॥
en: The Vasus said : We shall each give one eighth part of our respective energies and from it a son will be born to you who will live according to your and his wishes.

sn: न सम्पत्स्यति मत्र्येषु पुनस्तस्य तु संततिः। तस्मादपुत्रः पुत्रस्ते भविष्यति स वीर्यवान्॥
en: But this son will not beget any children on earth. Therefore, your that powerful son will be childless.

sn: एवं ते समयं कृत्वा गङ्गया वसवः सह। जग्मुः संहृष्टमनसो यथासंकल्पमञ्जसा॥
en: The Vasus making this arrangement with Ganga, went away in delight to the place where they lived.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रतीपो राजाऽऽसीत् सर्वभूतहितः सदा। निषसाद समा बह्वीर्गङ्गाद्वारगतो जपन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: There was a king, named Pratipa, engaged in doing good to all creatures. He spent many years in ascetic penances, going to the source of (the river)Ganga.

sn: तस्य रूपगुणोपेता गङ्गा स्त्रीरूपधारिणी। उत्तीर्य सलिलात् तस्माल्लोभनीयतमाकृतिः॥ अधीयानस्य राजर्षेर्दिव्यरूपा मनस्विनी। दक्षिणं शालसंकाशमूरूं भेजे शुभानना॥
en: The accomplished and beautiful Ganga, in the form of a tempting woman, rose from the water and came to the king. That beautifulfeatured lady, that intelligent celestial maiden, endued with ravishing beauty, sat upon the right thigh of the king which was like a Shala tree.

sn: प्रतीपस्तु महीपालस्तामुवाच यशस्विनीम्। करोमि किं ते कल्याणि प्रियं यत् तेऽभिकासितम्॥
en: Thereupon, the king Pratipa asked that famous "O fortunate lady, what good can I do to you and which you desire?"

sn: स्व्युवाच त्वामहं कामये राजन् भजमानां भजस्व माम्। त्यागः कामवतीनां हि स्त्रीणां सद्भिर्विगर्हितः॥
en: The Maiden said: O king, I desire to have you. I offer myself, accept me. To reject a woman who is full of desire is never considered good by the wise.

sn: प्रतीप उवाच नाहं परस्त्रियं कामाद् गच्छेयं वरवर्णिनी। न चासवर्णा कल्याणि धर्म्यमेतद्धि मे व्रतम्॥
en: Pratipa said: O beautiful lady, I never go to another man's wife out of lust. O fortunate maiden, this is my solemn vow.

sn: स्व्युवाच नाश्रेयस्यस्मि नागम्या न वक्तव्या च कर्हिचित्। जन्ती भज मां राजन् दिव्यां कन्यां वरस्त्रियम्॥
en: The Maiden said : I am neither inauspicious, not ugly, nor a detestable maiden. I am a celestial damsel of great beauty, O king, I offer myself, accept me.

sn: प्रतीप उवाच त्वया निवृत्तमेतत् तु यन्मां चोदयसि प्रियम्। अन्यथा प्रतिपन्नं मां नाशयेद् धर्मविप्लवः॥
en: Pratipa said : I have abstained from the course to which you would in ite me. If I break my vow, its sin wili destroy me.

sn: प्राप्य दक्षिणमूरूं मे त्वमश्लिष्टा वराङ्गने। अपत्यानां स्नुषाणां च भीरु विद्ध्येतदासनम्॥
en: O beautiful lady, you have sat upon my right thigh. O timid girl, it is the seat for daughters and daughters-in-law.

sn: सव्योरुः कामिनीभोग्यस्त्वया स च विवर्जितः। तस्मादहं नाचरिष्ये त्वयि कामं वराङ्गने॥
en: The left thigh is the seat for the wife, but you have rejected it. Therefore, O best lady, I cannot accept you.

sn: स्नुषा मे भव सुश्रोणि पुत्रार्थं त्वां वृणोम्यहम्। स्नुषापदं हि वामोरु त्वमागम्य समाश्रिता॥
en: O beautiful girl, be my daughter-in-law. I accept you for my son. The left thigh is for the wife which you have not accepted.

sn: स्त्र्युवाच एवमष्यस्तु धर्मज्ञ संयुज्येयं सुतेन ते। त्वद्भक्त्या तु भजिष्यामि प्रख्यातं भारतं कुलम्॥
en: The Maiden said: O virtuous man, let it be as you say. Let me be united with your son. Out of respect for you, I shall be a wife of the famous Bharata race.

sn: पृथिव्यां पार्थिवा ये च तेषां यूयं परायणम्। गुणा न हि मया शक्या वक्तुं वर्षशतैरपि॥
en: You are the refuge of all the monarchs of the earth. I am incapable of reciting your qualifications even in one hundred years.

sn: कुलस्य ये वः प्रथितास्तत्साधुत्वमथोत्तमम्। समयेनेह धर्मज्ञ आचरेयं च यद् विभो॥ तत् सर्वमेव पुत्रस्ते न मीमांसेत कर्हिचित्। एवं वसन्ती पुढे ते वर्धयिष्याम्यहं रतिम्॥ पुत्रैः पुण्यैः प्रियैश्चैव स्वर्ग प्राप्स्यति ते सुतः।
en: O virtuous man, the greatness and goodness of many celebrated monarchs of (your) this race is unlimited. But, O lord, this must be the term (of my becoming your daughter-in-law) that your son shall not be able to judge the propriety for my acts. Living thus with your son, I shall make him happy and do him good. He shall finally ascend heaven in consequence of his virtues and good conduct and of the sons I shall bear him.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथेत्युक्ता तु सा राजंस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥ पुत्रजन्म प्रतीक्षन् वै स राजा तदधारयत्। एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु प्रतीपः क्षत्रियर्षभः॥ तपस्तेपे सुतस्यार्थे सभार्यः कुरुनन्दन।
en: Vaishampayana said: O King, having said this, the celestial maiden then and there disappeared. The king also waited for the birth of his son, so that he could fulfil his promise. Some time after, the best of Kshatriyas, that light of the Kuru race, Pratipa, was engaged with his wife in ascetic penances with the desire of a son.

sn: तयोः समभवत् पुत्रो वृद्धयोः स महाभिषः॥ शान्तस्य जज्ञे संतानस्तस्मादासीत् स शान्तनुः।
en: When they grew old, a son was born to them and this son was Mahabhisha. He was called Shantanu, because he was born when his father had controlled his passions by asceticism.

sn: संस्मरंश्चाक्षयाँल्लोकान् विजातान् स्वेन कर्मणा॥ पुण्यकर्मकृदेवासीच्छान्तनुः कुरुसत्तमः। प्रतीपः शान्तनुं पुत्रं यौवनस्थं ततोऽन्वशात्॥
en: The best of Kurus, Shantanu, knowing that the regions of indestructible happiness could be gained only by virtuous deeds, devoted himself to virtue. When Shantanu grew up to be a youth, Pratipa told him-

sn: पुरा स्त्री मां समभ्यागाच्छान्तनो भूतये तव। त्वामाव्रजेद् यदि रहः सा पुत्र वरवर्णिनी॥ कामयानाभिरूपाढ्या दिव्या स्त्री पुत्रकाम्यया। सा त्वया नानुयोक्तव्या कासि कस्यासि चाङ्गने॥ यच कुर्यान्न तत् कर्म सा प्रष्टव्या त्वयानघ। मन्नियोगाद् भजन्तीं तां भजेथा इत्युवाच तम्॥
en: "O Shantanu, some time before, a celestial damsel came to me for good. If you meet that beautiful celestial damsel in secret and if she solicits you to beget offspring on her, accept her as your wife. O sinless one, judge not the propriety of impropriety of anything she does. Ask not who she is, whom she belongs to and whence she comes. But accept her as your wife at my command."

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं संदिश्य तनयं प्रतीपः शान्तनुं तदा। स्वे च राज्येऽभिषिच्यैनं वनं राजा विवेश ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having thus commanded his son Shantanu and installed him on his throne, that king, Pratipa, retired into a forest.

sn: स राजा शान्तनुर्धीमान् देवराजसमद्युतिः। बभूव मृगयाशील: शान्तनुर्वनगोचरः॥
en: That greatly intelligent king Shantanu, as effulgent as the king of the celestials, became a lover of hunting and passed much of his time in the woods.

sn: स मृगान् महिषांश्चैव विनिघ्नन् राजसत्तमः। गङ्गामनुचचारैकः सिद्धचारणसेविताम्॥
en: That best of kings many deer and buffaloes. Wandering along the banks of the Ganges, he came upon a place frequented by Siddhas and Charanas.

sn: स कदाचिन्महाराज ददर्श परमां स्त्रियम्। जाज्वल्यमानां वपुषा साक्षाच्छ्रियमिवापराम्॥
en: There did the great king meet with one day a lovely damsel of blazing beauty like Sree herself.

sn: सर्वानवद्यां सुदतीं दिव्याभरणभूषिताम्। सूक्ष्माम्बरधरामेकां पद्मोदरसमप्रभाम्॥
en: She was endowed with a faultless beauty and beautiful teeth. She was decked with celestial ornaments. She wore garments as fine and beautiful as the filaments of lotus.

sn: तां दृष्ट्वा हृष्टरोमाभूद् विस्मितो रूपसम्पदा। पिबन्निव च नेत्राभ्यां नातृप्यत नराधिपः।२९॥
en: The king was surprised to see that damsel of great beauty; and his hair all over his body stood up in rapture. His steadfast gaze drank her charms, but it failed to satiate him.

sn: सा च दृष्ट्वैव राजानं विचरन्तं महाद्युतिम्। स्नेहादागतसौहार्दा नातृष्यत विलासिनी॥
en: The maiden also, seeing that king of great effulgence move about in great agitation, was moved and felt for him an affection and friendship. She gazed at him and longed to gaze at him more.

sn: तामुवाच ततो राजा सान्त्वयश्लक्ष्णया गिरा। देवी वा दानवी वा त्वं गन्धर्वी चाथ वाप्सराः॥ यक्षी वा पन्नगी वापि मानुषी वा सुमध्यमे। याचे त्वां सुरगर्भाभे भार्या मे भव शोभने॥
en: The king then addressed her in sweet words. "O beautiful one, O beauty of slender waist, be you a lady of the Deva or Danavas race, be you a maiden of the race of the Gandharvas or the Apsaras, be you a damsel of the Yakshas or the Nagas, or be you a human female, I solicit you to be my wife.

sn: तामुवाच ततो राजा सान्त्वयश्लक्ष्णया गिरा। देवी वा दानवी वा त्वं गन्धर्वी चाथ वाप्सराः॥ यक्षी वा पन्नगी वापि मानुषी वा सुमध्यमे। याचे त्वां सुरगर्भाभे भार्या मे भव शोभने॥
en: The king then addressed her in sweet words. "O beautiful one, O beauty of slender waist, be you a lady of the Deva or Danavas race, be you a maiden of the race of the Gandharvas or the Apsaras, be you a damsel of the Yakshas or the Nagas, or be you a human female, I solicit you to be my wife.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो राज्ञः सस्मितं मृदु वल्गु च। वसूनां समयं स्मृत्वाथाभ्यगच्छदनिन्दिता॥ उवाच चैव राज्ञः सा ह्लादयन्ती मनो गिरा। भविष्यामि महीपाल महिषी ते वशानुगा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard these soft and sweet words of the smiling king, that faultless maiden remembered the promise she had made to the Vasus. She spoke to the king, sending a thrill of pleasure; (she said), “O protector of the world, I shall become your wife and obey your commands.

sn: यत् तु कुर्यामहं राजञ्छुभं वा यदि वाशुभम्। न तद् वारयितव्यास्मि न वक्तव्या तथाप्रियम्॥
en: But O king, you must not interfere in any of my acts, whether they be agreeable or disagreeable to you. You most not also speak to me in harsh words.

sn: एवं हि वर्तमानेऽहं त्वयि वत्स्यामि पार्थिवा वारिता विप्रियं चोक्ता त्यजेयं त्वामसंशयम्॥
en: O king, so long you will act in the way I ask you to do, I shall live with you. But I shall certainly leave you as soon as you interfere with me or use harsh words towards me."

sn: तथेति सा यदा तूक्ता तदा भरतसत्तम। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे प्राप्य तं पार्थिवोत्तमम्॥
en: The best of the Bharata race, the king said, "Be it so." Thereupon, the maiden was exceedingly glad to get that excellent king for her husband.

sn: आसाद्य शान्तनुस्तां च बुभुजे कामतो वशी। न प्रष्टव्येति मन्वानो न स तां किंचिदूचिवान्॥
en: King Shantanu also was exceedingly pleased to get her for his wife. He fully enjoyed her sweet company. Adhering to his promise, he refrained refrained from asking her anything.

sn: स तस्याः शीलवृत्तेन रूपौदार्यगुणेन च। उपचारेण च रहस्तुतोष जगतीपतिः॥
en: The lord of the world, king Shantanu, became very much pleased with her beauty, conduct, magnanimity and attention to comforts.

sn: दिव्यरूपा हि सा देवी गङ्गा त्रिपथगामिनी। मानुषं विग्रहं कृत्वा श्रीमन्तं वरवर्णिनी॥ भाग्योपनतकामस्य भार्या चोपनताभवत्। शान्तनोनृपसिंहस्य देवराजसमद्युतेः॥
en: That celestial lady, Ganga of the three courses, assuming a human form of exceeding beauty and excellent feature. Lived happily as the wife of Shantanu, having as the fruit of her virtues, obtained that best of kings, as effulgent as the king of the celestials.

sn: सम्भोगस्नेहचातुर्यैर्हावभावसमन्वितैः। राजानं रमयामास यथा रेमे तथैव सः॥
en: She pleased the king with her attractiveness and love, with her affection and wits, her music and dance and king was exceedingly pleased with her.

sn: स राजा रतिसक्तत्वादुत्तमस्त्रीगुणैर्हतः। संवत्सरानृतून् मासान् बुबुधे न बहून् गतान्॥
en: The king was so much sunk in the beauty of his wife, that months, seasons and years rolled away without his being conscious of them.

sn: रममाणस्तया साधं यथाकामं नरेश्चरः। अष्टावजनयत् पुत्रांस्तम्यापमरसंनिभान्॥
en: When the king was thus enjoying himself with his wife, eight sons were born to him. They were all like the celestial.

sn: जातं जातं च सा पुत्रं क्षिपत्यम्भसि भारत। प्रीणाम्यहं त्वामित्युक्त्वा गङ्गा स्रोतस्यमज्जयत्॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, as soon as they were born, they were one after the other thrown into the river by Ganga, who said, when she threw them into the stream. “ This is done for your good.”

sn: तस्य तन्न प्रियं राज्ञः शान्तनोरभवत् तदा। न च तां किंचनोवाच त्यागाद् भीतो महीपतिः॥
en: The king Shantanu could not be pleased with such conduct, but he did not speak a word to her for the fear of losing her.

sn: अथैनामष्टमे पुत्रे जाते प्रहसतीमिव। उवाच राजा दुःखार्तः परीप्सन् पुत्रमात्मनः॥
en: When the eighth son was born and when Ganga was smiling (before she threw it into the river), the king, desiring to protect his son, said in sorrow-

sn: मा वधीः कस्य कासीति किं हिनत्सि सुतानिति। पुत्रनि सुमहत् पापं सम्प्राप्तं ते सुगर्हितम्॥
en: "Do not kill it. Who are you? To whom do you belong? Why do you kill your own sons? Murderess of your sons, you are earning great sins by your improper acts."

sn: गङ्गोवाच पुत्रकाम न ते हन्मि पुत्रं पुत्रवतां वर। जीर्णस्तु मम वासोऽयं यथा स समयः कृतः॥
en: Ganga said : As you desire for a son, I shall not kill this child. You have become the foremost of fathers. But there must be an end of my stay with you according to our agreement.

sn: अहं गङ्गा जह्वसुता महर्षिगणसेविता। देवकार्यार्थसिद्ध्यर्थमुषिताहं त्वया सह॥
en: I am Ganga, the daughter of Jahnu, worshipped by all great Rishis. I have so long lived with your for accomplishing the purpose of the celestials.

sn: इमेऽष्टौ वसवो देवा महाभागा महौजसः। वसिष्ठशापदोषेण मानुषत्वमुपागताः॥
en: These sons were the eight celestials, the illustrious and greatly effulgent Vasus. They had to assume human form in consequence of the curse of Vasistha.

sn: तेषां जनयिता नान्यस्त्वदृते भुवि विद्यते। मद्विधा मानुषी धात्री लोके नास्तीह काचन॥
en: There is none on earth who desires to be their progenitor. There is none among human females like me who may be their mother.

sn: तस्मात् तजननीहेतोर्मानुषत्वमुपागता। जनयित्वा वसूनष्टौ जिता लोकास्त्वयाक्षयाः॥
en: Therefore, I assumed the human form, to become their mother. You have acquired great regions of celestial bliss by becoming the progenitor of the eight Vasus.

sn: देवानां समयस्त्वेष वसूनां संश्रुतो मया। जातं जातं मोक्षयिष्ये जन्मतो मानुषादिति॥
en: My agreement with the celestials Vasus was that I should free them from their human birth as soon as each would be born.

sn: तत् ते शापाद् विनिर्मुक्ता आपवस्य महात्मनः। स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि पुत्रं पाहि महाव्रतम्॥
en: Thus have I freed them from the curse of the illustrious Rishi Apava (Vasistha.) Be blessed, I leave you now. Rear this child of rigid vows.

sn: एष पर्यायवासो मे वसूनां संनिधौ कृतः। मत्प्रसूतिं विजानीहि गङ्गादत्तमिमं सुतम्॥
en: I promised to the Vasus to live with you so long (as I have lived). Let this child of mine be known by the name of Gangadatta.

sn: शान्तनुरुवाच आपवो नाम को न्वेष वसूनां किं च दुष्कृतम्। यस्याभिशापात् ते सर्वे मानुषीं योनिमागताः॥
en: Shantanu said : Who was Apava and what fault was committed by the Vasus that they had to be born among men in consequence of his curse?

sn: अनेन च कुमारेण त्वया दत्तेन किं कृतम्। यस्य चैव कृतेनायं मानुषेषु निवत्स्यति॥
en: What also had this child done that he should have to live among men?

sn: ईशा वै सर्वलोकस्य वसवस्ते च वै कथम्। मानुषेषूदपद्यन्त तन्ममाचक्ष्व जाह्नवि॥
en: Why also the lord of the three worlds, the Vasus, were condemned to be born among men? O daughter of Jahnu, tell me all.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ता तदा गङ्गा राजानमिदमब्रवीत्। भर्तारं जाह्नवी देवी शान्तनुं पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed, the celestial lady, the daughter of Jahnu, Ganga, replied to her husband, the best of men, Shantanu.

sn: गनोवाच यं लेभे वरुणः पुत्रं पुरा भरतसत्तम। वसिष्ठनामा स मुनिः ख्यात आपव इत्युत॥
en: Ganga said: O best of the Bharata race, the son that was formerly born of Varuna, was the Rishi named Vasistha. He was subsequently known by the name of Apava.

sn: तस्याश्रमपदं पुण्यं मृगपक्षिसमन्वितम्। मेरोः पार्श्वे नगेन्द्रस्य सर्वर्तुकुसुमावृतम्॥
en: His hermitage stood by the side of the best of mountains, the Meru. The place. was holy and abounded in deer and birds. It was covered with all the best flowers.

sn: स वारुणिस्तपस्तेपे तस्मिन् भरतसत्तम। वने पुण्यकृतां श्रेष्ठः स्वादुमूलफलोदके।॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, that foremost of all virtuous men, the son of Varuna, practised his penances in that forest, abounding in sweet roots, fruits and water.

sn: दक्षस्य दुहिता या तु सुरभीत्यभिशब्दिता। गां प्रजाता तु सा देवी कश्यपाद् भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Daksha had a daughter who was known as Surabhi. O best of the Bharata race, that lady gave birth to a cow by Kashyapa.

sn: अनुग्रहार्थं जगतः सर्वकामदुहां वरा। तां लेभे गां तु धर्मात्मा होमधेनुं स वारुणिः॥
en: The virtuous-minded son of Varuna, obtained that best of kine, capable of granting every desire, for the purpose of his Homa rites and for benefiting the world,

sn: सा तस्मिंस्तापसारण्ये वसन्ती मुनिसेविते। चचार पुण्ये रम्ये च गौरपेतभया तदा॥
en: That cow dwelt in that forest adored of all the Rishis. She roamed fearlessly in those sacred and delightful woods.

sn: अथ तद् वनमाजग्मुः कदाचिद् भरतर्षभ। पृथ्वाद्या वसवः सर्वे देवा देवर्षिसेवितम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, once on a time came to that forest adored by the celestials Rishis, all the celestial Vasus, Prithu being at then head.

sn: ते सदारा वनं तच्च व्यचरन्त समन्ततः। रेमिरे रमणीयेषु पर्वतेषु वनेषु च॥
en: They roamed with their wives into that forest and enjoyed themselves in those delightful woods and mountains.

sn: तत्रैकस्याथ भार्या तु वसोर्वासवविक्रम! संचरन्ती वने तस्मिन् गां ददर्श सुमध्यमा॥
en: O Indra like powerful man, one of the slender-waisted of the Vasus saw that cow roaming in the forest.

sn: नन्दिनी नाम राजेन्द्र सर्वकामधुगुत्तमाम्। सा विस्मयसमाविष्टा शीलद्रविणसम्पदा॥ द्यवे वै दर्शयामास तां गां गोवृषभेक्षण। आपीनां च सुदोग्ध्रीं च सुबालधिखुरां शुभाम्॥ उपपन्नां गुणैः सर्वैः शीलेनानुत्तमेन च। एवंगुणसमायुक्तां वसवे वसुनन्दिनी॥ दर्शयामास राजेन्द्र पुरा पौरवनन्दन। द्यौस्तदा तां तु दृष्ट्वैव गां गजेन्द्रेन्द्रविक्रम॥ उवाच राजस्तां देवीं तस्या रूपगुणान् वदन्। एषा गौरुत्तमा देवी वारुणेरसितेक्षणा॥ ऋषेस्तस्य वरारोहे यस्येदं वनमुत्तमम्। अस्याः क्षीरं पिबेन्मर्त्यः स्वादु यो वै समुध्यमे॥ दशवर्षसहस्राणि स जीवेत् स्थिरयौवनः। एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु सा देवी नृपोत्तम सुमध्यमा॥ तमुवाचानवद्याङ्गी भर्तारं दीसतेजसम्। अस्ति मे मानुषे लोके नरदेवात्मजा सखी॥ नाम्ना जितवती नाम रूपयौवनशालिनी। उशीनरस्य राजर्षेः सत्यसंधस्य धीमतः॥ दुहिता प्रथिता लोके मानुषे रूपसम्पदा। तस्या हेतोर्महाभाग सवत्सां गां ममेप्सिताम्॥
en: O king, her name was Nandini and she could grant every desire; she possessed the wealth of all accomplishments and large eyes, full udders, fine tail, handsome hoop and every auspicious signs. She gave much milk. Seeing her such, the wife of the Vasu showed her in astonishment to her husband named Dyonai. O descendant of Puru, o king, this cow of many qualifications was formerly shown by the daughter of the Vasus to the Vasu. O elephantlike powerful man, when that cow was shown to Dyonai, o king, he began to admire her qualities and thus spoke to the lady (his wife). “O black-eyed lady of beautiful thighs, this excellent cow belongs to the Rishi, the son of Varuna, to whom belongs this excellent wood. O slender-waisted lady, he who drinks the milk of this cow lives young for ten-thousand years." O best of kings, having heard this, that lady of slender-waist thus addressed her husband of burning effulgence. I have a friend among men on earth, named Jitavati, the daughter of a king, who possesses great beauty and youth. She is daughter of the royal sage, truthful and intelligent Ushinara. Her wealth of beauty is famous all over the world. O illustrious one, for her, I desire to posses this cow with her calf.

sn: आनयस्वामरश्रेष्ठ त्वरितं पुण्यवर्धन! यावदस्याः पयः पीत्वा सा सखी मम मानद॥ मानुषेषु भवत्वेका जरारोगविवर्जिता। एतन्मम महाभाग कर्तुमर्हस्यनिन्दित॥
en: O best of the celestials, O virtue increasing one, bring her soon. So that my that human friend, drinking her milk, becomes the only person on earth free from disease and decrepitude. O illustrious god, O blameless god, you should grant me my this desire.

sn: प्रियं प्रियतरं ह्यस्मानास्ति मेऽन्यत् कथंचन। एतच्छुत्वा वचस्तस्या देव्याः प्रियचिकीर्षया॥ पृथ्वाद्यैर्धातृभिः सार्धं द्यौस्तदा तां जहार गाम्। तया कमलपत्राक्ष्या नियुक्तो द्यौस्तदा नृप॥ ऋषेस्तस्य तपस्तीनं न शशाक निरीक्षितुम्। हृता गौः सा तदा तेन प्रपातस्तु न तर्कितः॥
en: "There is nothing which would be more agreeable to me." Having heard her these words, Dyo, in order to please that celestial lady, stole the cow with the help of Prithu and his other brothers. O king, commanded by his lotus-eyed wife, Dyo did her bidding, for getting the great ascetic merits of the Rishi who owned her (the cow). He did not know then that he would have to fall foe the sin of stealing the cow.

sn: अथाश्रमपदं प्राप्तः फलान्यादाय वारुणिः। न चापश्यत् स गां तत्र सवत्सां काननोत्तमे।॥
en: When in the evening the son of Varuna returned to his hermitage with the fruits he had collected, he did not find the cow and its calf. Then he began to search for her in that excellent wood.

sn: ततः स मृगयामास वने तस्मिंस्तयोधनः। नाध्यगच्छच मृगयंस्तां गां मुनिरुदारधीः॥
en: The noble-minded and greatly intelligent ascetic searched for the cow everywhere in the woods; but though he searched long, yet he could he not find her.

sn: ज्ञात्वा तथापनीतां तां वसुभिर्दिव्यदर्शनः। ययौ क्रोधवशं सद्यः शशाप च वसूंस्तदा॥
en: The man of ascetic vision then found that she had been stolen by the Vasus. His anger was at once roused and he cursed the Vasus-

sn: यस्मान्मे वसवो जहाँ वै दोग्ध्रीं सुवालधिम्। तस्मात् सर्वे जनिष्यन्ति मानुषेषु न संशयः॥
en: Saying, “As the Vasus have stolen my cow sweet milk and handsome tail, they shall certainly be born as men on earth.”

sn: एवं शशाप भगवान् वसुंस्तान् भरतर्षभ। वशं क्रोधस्य समप्राप्त आपवो मुनिसत्तमः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the illustrious Apava, the best of Rishis, thus cursed the Vasus out of anger.

sn: शप्त्वा च तान् महाभागस्तपस्येव मनो दधे। एवं स शप्तवान् राजन् वसूनष्टौ तपोधनः॥ महाप्रभावो ब्रह्मर्षिर्दैवान् क्रोधसमन्वितः। अथाश्रमपदं प्राप्तास्ते वै भूयो महात्मनः॥ शप्ताः स्म इति जानन्त ऋषिं तमुपचक्रमुः। प्रसादयन्तस्तमृषि वसवः पार्थिवर्षभ।॥ लेभिरे न च तस्मात् ते प्रसादमृषिसत्तमात्। आपवात् पुरुषव्याघ्र सर्वधर्मविशारदात्॥
en: Having thus cursed them, the illustrious man again engaged himself in asceticism. O king, when the celestial Vasus were thus cursed in anger by that Brahmarshi and ascetic of great power. They soon came to the hermitage of the illustrious man; as soon as they came to know of it. O best of men, Apava, learned in the ruled of every virtue. O best of kings, the Vasus tried to pacify that Rishi, but they failed to obtain grace from that best of Rishis.

sn: उवाच च स धर्मात्मा शप्ता यूयं धरादयः। अनुसंवत्सरात् सर्वे शापमोक्षमवाप्स्यथ॥
en: The virtuous Rishi said, “You have been cursed by me along with Dhara and others. But you shall be freed from my curse within a year of your birth among men.

sn: अयं तु यत्कृते यूयं मया शप्ताः स वत्स्यति। द्यौस्तदा मानुषे लोके दीर्घकालं स्वकर्मणा॥
en: But he for whose act you have all been cursed by me, that Dyo, will have to remain on earth for long for his own (sinful) act.

sn: नानृतं तचिकीर्षामि क्रुद्धो युष्मान् यदब्रुवम्। न प्रजास्यति चाप्येष मानुषेषु महामनाः॥
en: I shall not make my words futile though uttered in anger. But Dyo shall not beget offspring when dwelling on earth.

sn: भविष्यति च धर्मात्मा सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः। पितुः प्रियहिते युक्तः स्त्रीभोगान् वर्जयिष्यति॥
en: "He will be virtuous-minded and learned in all Shastras. He will be very obedient to his father and abstain from the pleasure of women."

sn: एवमुक्त्वा वसून् सर्वान् स जगाम महानृषिः। ततो मामुपजग्मुस्ते समेता वसवस्तदा॥
en: Thus addressing all the Vasus, the great Rishi, went away. And the Vasus all came to me.

sn: अयाचन्त च मांराजन् वरं तच्च मया कृतम्। जाताजातान् प्रक्षिपास्मान् स्वयं गङ्गे त्वमम्भसि॥
en: O king, they prayed to me for a boon, saying, "O Ganga, as soon as each of us will, be born, you yourself should throw us into the water."

sn: एवं तेषामहं सम्यक् शप्तानां राजसत्तम। मोक्षार्थं मानुषाल्लोकाद् यथावत् कृतवत्यहम्॥
en: O best of kings, I did act accordingly. (I threw them into the waters) in order to free them from their earthly life, the effect of that curse.

sn: अयं शापादृषेस्तस्य एक एव नृपोत्तम। द्यौ राजन् मानुषे लोके चिरं वत्स्यति भारत॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, O excellent king, the only one, namely Dyo himself, is to live earth on account of the Rishi's curse.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतदाख्याय सा देवी तत्रैवान्तरधीयत। आदाय च कुमार तं जगामाथ यथेप्सितम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this, the goddess disappeared then and there. Taking her son with her, she went away to the place she wished to go.

sn: स तु देवव्रतो नाम गाङ्गेय इति चाभवत्। धुनामा शान्तनोः : पुत्रः शान्तनोरधिको गुणैः॥
en: That son of Shantanu was named both Gangeya and Devavrata and he excelled his father in all accomplishments.

sn: शान्तनुश्चापि शोकार्तो जगाम स्वपुरं ततः। तस्याहं कीर्तयिष्यामि शान्तनोरधिकान् गुणान्॥
en: Shantanu then went to his own capital with a sorrowful heart. I shall now narrate to you the many accomplishments of Shantanu,

sn: महाभाग्यं च नृपते रतस्य महात्मनः। यस्येतिहासो द्युतिमान् महाभारतमुच्यते॥
en: And the great fortune of the illustrious king of the Bharata race, the history of whom is called this effulgent Mahabharata.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच स राजा शान्तनु/मान् देवराजर्षिसत्कृतः। धर्मात्मा सर्वलोकेषु सत्यवागिति विश्रुतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The king Shantanu, adored of the celestials and the royal sages, was famous in all the worlds as being virtuous-minded and truthful.

sn: दमो दानं क्षमा बुद्धिहींकृतिस्तेज उत्तमम्। नित्यान्यासन् महासत्त्वे शान्तनौ पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Self-control, liberality, forgiveness, intelligence, modesty, patience and superior energy ever dwelt in that best of men, Shantanu.

sn: एवं स गुणसम्पन्नो धर्मार्थकुशलो नृपः। आसीद् भरतवंशस्य गोप्ता सर्वजनस्य च॥
en: That king endued with such accomplishments. He was learned in both Dharma and Artha. He was both the protector of the Bharata race and all the people,

sn: कम्बुग्रीवः पृथुव्यंसो मत्तवारणविक्रमः। अन्वितः परिपूर्णार्यैः सर्वैर्नृपतिलक्षणैः॥ :॥
en: His neck was like the conch shell, his shoulder was broad, he was as powerful as a mad elephant. All the auspicious signs of royalty dwelt in his person and they considered that to be their best abode.

sn: तस्य कीर्तिमतो वृत्तमवेक्ष्य सततं नराः। धर्म एव परः कामादर्थाचेति व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: The people, seeing the (virtuous) acts of that king of great achievements, came to know that virtue was ever superior to pleasure and profit. was

sn: एतान्यासन् महासत्त्वे शान्तनौ पुरुषर्षभे! न चास्य सदृशः कश्चिद् धर्मतः पार्थिवोऽभवत्॥
en: These accomplishments were all in that best of men, Shantanu and no other king was to equal him in virtue.

sn: वर्तमानं हि धर्मेषु सर्वधर्मभृतां वरम्। तं महीषा महीपालं राजराज्येऽभ्यषेचयन्॥
en: All the kings of the earth, seeing him devoted to all kinds of virtues, installed him as the king of kings.

sn: वीतशोकभयाबाधाः सुखस्वप्ननिबोधनाः। पतिं भारत गोतारं समपद्यन्त भूमिपा:॥
en: All the kings were free from misery, fear and anxiety of all kinds during the reign of that lord-protector of the Bharata race. They all slept in peace and rose in peace after happy dreams,

sn: तेन कीर्तिमता शिष्टाः शक्रप्रतिमतेजसा। यज्ञदानक्रियाशीला: समपद्यन्त भूमिपाः॥
en: All the kings became virtuous and devoted to liberality and religious acts and sacrifices from the great example set by that great king of wonderful achievements (Shantanu) who was like Indra himself.

sn: शान्तनुप्रमुखैर्गुप्ते लोके नृपतिभिस्तदा। नियमात् सर्ववर्णानां धर्मोत्तरमवर्तत॥
en: When the earth was ruled by Shantanu and other kings like him, the religious merits of every order greatly increased.

sn: ब्रह्म पर्यचरत् क्षत्रं विशः क्षत्रमनुव्रताः। ब्रह्मक्षत्रानुरक्ताश्च शूद्राः पर्यचरन् विशः॥
en: The Brahmanas were served by the Kshatriyas; the Kshatriyas were served by the Vaishyas; the Shudras, adoring both the Brahmanas and the Kshatriyas, served the Vaishyas.

sn: स हास्तिनपुरे रम्ये कुरूणां पुटभेदने। वसन् सागरपर्यन्तामन्वशासद् वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Shantanu lived in Hastinapur, the beautiful capital of the Kurus; he ruled over the whole earth bounded by the sea.

sn: स देवराजसदृशो धर्मज्ञः सत्यवागृजुः। दानधर्मतपोयोगाच्छ्रिया परमया युतः॥
en: He was truthful and virtuous like the king of the celestial; and from his liberality, virtues and asceticism he acquired great fortune.

sn: अरागद्वेषसंयुक्तः सोमवत् प्रियदर्शनः। तेजसा सूर्यकल्पोऽभूद् वायुवेगसमो जवे। अन्तकप्रतिमः कोपे क्षमया पृथिवीसमः॥
en: He was free from anger and malice, he was as handsome as Soma himself. He was as effulgent as the sun and as courageous as the Vayu. He was like Yama in anger and like Earth in patience.

sn: वधः पशुवराहाणां तथैव मृगपक्षिणाम्। शान्तनौ पृथिवीपाले नावर्तत तथा नृप॥
en: O king, when Shantanu ruled the earth, no deer, beers, birds or other animals were needlessly killed.

sn: ब्रह्मधर्मोत्तरे राज्ये शान्तनुर्विनयात्मवान्। समं शशास भूतानि कामरागविवर्जितः॥
en: The virtue of kindness reigned in the kingdom of Shantanu, who himself was full of mercy and free from anger. He equally protected all creatures.

sn: देवर्षिपितृयज्ञार्थमारभ्यन्त तदा क्रियाः। न चाधर्मेण केषांचित् प्राणिनामभवद् वधः॥
