sn: ततो व्यासस्थली नाम तत्र व्यासेनधीमता॥ पुत्रशोकाभितप्तेन देहत्यागे कृता मतिः। ततो देवैस्तु राजेन्द्र पुनरुत्थापितस्तदा॥ अभिगत्वा स्थलीं तस्य गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्।
en: One should then go to the Tirtha named Vyasasthali where the wise Vyasa. Afflicted as he was with the grief for the death of his son, determined to give up his being and where, O king of kings, he was cheered up by the celestials. Going to (Vyasa) sthali one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: किंदत्तं कूपमासाद्य तिलप्रस्थं प्रदाय च॥ गच्छेत परमां सिद्धिमृणैर्मुक्तः कुरूद्वह। वेदीतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Going to the well, called Kindatta, he who throws into it one Prastha of sesamum, O perpetuator of the Kuru race, obtains the highest success and he is freed from all his debts. Bathing in the Vedi Tirtha,, one obtains the fruit of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: अहश्च सुदिनं चैव द्वे तीर्थे लोकविश्रुते। तयोः स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र सूर्यलोकमवाप्नुयात्॥१००।
en: There are two celebrated Tirthas called Ahan and Sudina. O foremost of men, bathing there one goes to the regions of Surya.

sn: मृगधूमं ततो गच्छेत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत गङ्गायां नृपसत्तम॥
en: One should then go to Mrigadhuma, celebrated all over the there worlds. O best of kings, one should bathe there in the Ganges.

sn: अर्चयित्वा महादेवमश्वमेधफलं लभेत्। देव्यास्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Worshipping there Mahadeva, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha. Bathing in the Devi Tirtha, a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: ततो वामनकं गच्छेत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। तत्र विष्णुपदे स्नात्वा अर्चयित्वा च वामनम्॥ सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति। कुलम्पुने नरः स्नात्वा पुनाति स्वकुलं ततः॥
en: One should then go to Vamanaka, celebrated over the three worlds. Bathing there in the Vishnupada and worshipping Vamana. One, being free from all his sins and his soul being purified goes to the region of Vishnu. Bathing in the Kulampuna one purifies his own race.

sn: पवनस्य ह्रदे स्नात्वा मरुतां तीर्थमुत्तमम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र विष्णुलोके महीयते॥
en: Going to the lake of Pavana, which is a excellent Tirtha called Maruta and bathing there, O foremost of men, one is adored in the regions of Vayu.

sn: अमराणां ह्रदे स्नात्वा समभ्यामराधिपम्। अमराणां प्रभावेण स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: Bathing in the lake of the immortals and worshipping the lord of the immortals, one is adored in the celestials region through the prowess of the immortals.

sn: शालिहोत्रस्य तीर्थे च शालिसूर्ये यथाविधि। स्नात्वा नरवरश्रेष्ठ गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Bathing according to the ordinance in the Shalisurya of Shalihotra, O king of kings, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: श्रीकुझं च सरस्वत्यास्तीर्थं भरतसत्तम। तत्र स्नात्वा नरश्रेष्ठ अग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, bathing in the Tirtha called Srikunja in the Sarasvati, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sn: ततो नैमिषकुझं च समासाद्य कुरूद्वह। ऋषयः किल राजेन्द्र नैमिषेयास्तपस्विनः॥ तीर्थयात्रां पुरस्कृत्य कुरक्षेत्रं गताः पुरा। ततः कुञ्जः सरस्वत्याः कृतो भरतसत्तम॥
en: O perpetuator of the Kuru race, then going to the Naimishakunja, the ascetic Rishis had in the days of yore left Naimisha. And going to a visit of Tirthas, they went to Kurukshetra. O best of the Bharata race, there on the banks of the Sarasvati, a grove was made.

sn: ऋषीणामवकाशः स्याद् यथा तुष्टिकरो महान्। तस्मिन् कुञ्जे नरः स्नात्वा अग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्।१११।।
en: It served as a resting place for them and it was very delightful to all of them. Bathing in that Kunja, a man obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sn: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ कन्यातीर्थमनुत्तमम्। कन्यातीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: O virtuous man, one should then go to the excellent Tirtha, called Kanya. Bathing in the Kanya Tirtha a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मणस्तीर्थमुत्तमम्। तत्र वर्णावरः स्नात्वा ब्राह्मण्यं लभते नरः॥ ब्राह्मणश्च विशुद्धात्मा गच्छेत परमां गतिम्।
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent Tirtha, called Brahma. Bathing there, the other three orders obtain the states of Brahmana. And if a Brahman bathes there, he becomes pure-souled and obtains the highest refuge.

sn: ततो गच्छेन्नरश्रेष्ठ सोमतीर्थमनुत्तमम्॥ तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् सोमलोकमवाप्नुयात्।
en: O foremost of men, one should then go to the excellent Tirtha, called Soma. O king, bathing there, a man goes to the regions of Soma.

sn: सप्तसारस्वतं तीर्थं ततो गच्छेन्नराधिप॥ यत्र मङ्कणकः सिद्धो महर्षिर्लोकविश्रुतः। पुरा मङ्कणको राजन् कुशाचेणेति नः श्रुतम्॥ क्षतः किल करे राजंस्तस्य शाकरसोऽस्रवत्। स वै शाकरसं दृष्ट्वा हर्षाविष्टः प्रनृत्तवान्॥
en: O ruler of men, one should then go to the Tirtha, called Sapta-Sarasvata. Where the celebrated great Rishi Mankanaka obtained success in asticism. O king, we have heard that in the days of yore Mankanaka cut his hand with kusha grass and from his that wound vegetable juice flowed out (instead of blood). O king, seeing that vegetable juice, he began to dance in joy.

sn: ततस्तस्मिन् प्रनृत्ते तु स्थावरं जंगमं च यत्। प्रनृत्तमुभयं वीर तेजसा तस्य मोहितम्॥
en: When he thus began to dance, all the mobile and immobile creatures began to dance.

sn: ब्रह्मादिभिः सुरै राजऋषिभिश्च तपोधनैः। विज्ञप्तो वै महादेव ऋषेरथ नराधिप॥
en: O ruler of men, O king, then Brahma and other celestials and the ascetic Rishis all went to Mahadeva and represented to him all about the Rishi.

sn: नायं नृत्येद् यथा देव तथा त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि। तं प्रनृत्तं समासाद्य हर्षाविष्टेन चेतसा। सुराणां हितकामार्थमृषि देवोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: (They said), “O deity, you should do that by which the Rishi may not dance." Coming to the dancing Rishi who was senseless in joy, the deity thus spoke to him in order to do good to the celestials.

sn: भो भो महर्षेधर्मज्ञ किमर्थं नृत्यते भवान्। हर्षस्थानं किमर्थं वा तवाद्य मुनिपुङ्गव॥
en: Shiva said: O great Rishi, O virtuous man, why are you dancing? O foremost of Rishis, why are you so much delighted?

sn: ऋषिरुवाच तपस्विनोधर्मपथे स्थितस्य द्विजसत्तम। किं न पश्यसि मे ब्रह्मन् कराच्छाकरसं स्रुतम्॥ यं दृष्ट्वा सम्प्रनृत्तोऽहं हर्षेण महतान्वितः।
en: The Rishis said: O foremost of Brahmanas, I am an ascetic ever steady in the path of virtue. O Brahmana, do you not see that vegetable-juice is flowing from the wound of my hand? Seeing which i am dancing in great joy.

sn: तं प्रहस्याब्रवीद् देव ऋषि रागेण मोहितम्॥
en: To that Rishi who was blinded by emotion, the deity smilingly thus spoke,

sn: अहं तु विस्मयं विप्र न गच्छामीति पश्य माम्। एवमुक्त्वा नरश्रेष्ठ महादेवेनधीमता॥ अङ्गुल्यचेण राजेन्द्र स्वाङ्गुष्ठस्ताडितोऽनघ। ततो भस्म क्षताद् राजन् निर्गतं हिमसंनिभम्॥
en: "O Brahmana, I am not at all astonished. Behold me." O foremost of men, O sinless king, having thus addressed him, Mahadeva pressed his thumb by the tip of his own finger. O king, then from that wound came out ashes white as snow.

sn: तद् दृष्ट्वा वीडितो राजन् स मुनिः पादयोर्गतः। नान्यद् देवात् परं मेने रुद्रात् परतरं महत्॥
en: O king, seeing this the Rishi became filled with shame and fell at his feet. Believing that there was nothing better and greater than the Rudra, (he thus adored him).

sn: सुरासुरस्य जगतो गतिस्त्यमसि शूलधृक्। त्वया सर्वमिदं सृष्टं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्॥
en: “O wielder of trident, you are the refuge of the celestials and the Asuras, may of the whole universe. You have created the three worlds with their mobile and immobile creatures.

sn: त्वमेव सर्वान् चससि पुनरेव युगक्षये। देवैरपि न शक्यस्त्वं परिज्ञातुं कुतो मया॥
en: It is you again who swallow everything at the end of the Yuga. You are incapable of being known by the celestials, what to speak of me!

sn: त्वयि सर्वे प्रदृश्यन्ते सुरा ब्रह्मादयोऽनघ। सर्वस्त्वमसि लोकानां कर्ता कारयिता च ह॥
en: O sinless one, the celestials with Brahma are displayed in you. You are everything, the creator himself and the ordainer of the world,

sn: त्वत्प्रसादात् सुराः सर्वे मोदन्तीहाकुतोभयाः। एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवभूषिर्वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: It is through your favour that the celestials sport without anxiety or fear.” Having thus adored Mahadeva, the Rishi thus spoke to him;

sn: त्वत्प्रसादान् महादेव तपो मे न क्षरेत वै। ततो देवः प्रहृष्टात्मा ब्रह्मर्षिमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: “O god of gods, grant me your grace, so that my asceticism may not diminish.” Thereupon the deity, becoming glad in heart, thus spoke to that Brahmana Rishi,

sn: तपस्ते वर्धतां विप्र मत्प्रसादात् सहस्रधा। आश्रमे चेह वत्स्यामि त्वया सह महामुने॥
en: “O Brahmana, let your asceticism increase thousand-fold through my grace. O great Rishi, I shall live with you in your hermitage.

sn: सप्तसारस्वते स्नात्वा अर्चयिष्यन्ति ये तु माम्। न तेषां दुर्लभं किंचिदिहलोके परत्र च॥
en: Bathing in Sapta-Sarasvata, those that will worship me will obtain everything however difficult to get here and hereafter.

sn: सारस्वतं च ते लोकं गमिष्यन्ति न संशयः। एवमुक्त्वा महादेवस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: They will, without doubt, attain to the Sarasvata region.” Having said this, Mahadeva disappeared then and there.

sn: ततस्त्वौशनसं गच्छेत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः॥
en: One should then go to Asanasha, celebrated all over the world, where Brahma and other celestials and ascetic Rishis.

sn: कार्तिकेयश्च भगवांस्त्रिसंध्यं किल भारत। सांनिध्यमकरोन्नित्यं भार्गवप्रियकाम्यया॥
en: And the illustrious Kartikeya, O descendant of Bharata, impelled by the desire to do good to the descendant of Bhrigu, are ever present during the three Sandhyas.

sn: कपालमोचनं तीर्थं सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: O foremost of men, bathing in the Tirtha called Kapalamochana which cleanses off one's sins, one is freed from all his sins.

sn: अग्नितीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् तत्र स्नात्वा नरर्षभ। अग्निलोकमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: O best of men, one should then go to the Tirtha called Agni. Bathing there, one goes to the region of Agni and saves his own race.

sn: विश्वामित्रस्य तत्रैव तीर्थं भरतसत्तम। तत्र स्नात्वा नरश्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मण्यमधिगच्छति॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, there is a Tirtha of Vishvamitra. O best of men, bathing there, one obtains the status of a Brahmana.

sn: ब्रह्मयोनि समासाद्य शुचिः प्रयतमानसः। तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र ब्रह्मलोकं प्रपद्यते॥ पुनात्यासप्तमं चैव कुलं नास्त्यत्र संशयः।
en: Going to the Brahmayoni with purity and with subdued soul and, O best of men, bathing there one goes to the region of Brahma. There is no doubt that, he thus sanctifies his seven generations upwards and downwards.

sn: ततो गच्छेत् राजेन्द्र तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्॥ पृथूदकमिति ख्यातं कार्तिककेयस्य वै नृप। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत पितृदेवार्चने रतः॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the Tirtha, celebrated all over the world, which is known by the name of Prithudaka belonging to Kartikeya. O king, by bathing there and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials.

sn: अज्ञानाज्ज्ञानतो वापि स्त्रिया वा पुरुषेण वा। यत् किंचिदशुभं कर्म कृतं मानुषबुद्धिना॥ तत् सर्वं नश्यते तत्र स्नातमात्रस्य भारत। अश्वमेधफलं चास्य स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Whatever bad acts one, whether a man or a woman, has committed willingly unwittingly, impelled by human motives. O descendant of Bharata, are all destroyed. He obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha (sacrifice) and also goes to heaven. or

sn: पुण्यमाहुः कुरुक्षेत्रं कुरुक्षेत्रात् सरस्वती। सरस्वत्याश्च तीर्थानि तीर्थेभ्यश्च पृथूदकम्॥
en: The learned men say that Kurukshetra is holy, holier than Kurukshetra is the Sarasvati, holier than the Sarasvati are all the Tirthas put together and holier than all the Tirthas is the Prithudaka.

sn: उत्तमं सर्वतीर्थानां यस्त्यजेदात्मनस्तनुम्। पृथूदके जप्यपरो नैव श्वो मरणं तपेत्॥
en: He, who by the recitation of prayers casts off his body at Prithadaka which is the best of all the Tirthas, becomes an immortal.

sn: गीतं सनत्कुमारेण व्यासेन च महात्मना। एवं स नियतं राजन्नभिगच्छेत् पृथूदकम्॥
en: It has been sung by Sanatkumara and the illustrious Vyasa. O king, it is in the Vedas also, that one should go to the Prithudaka with subdued soul.

sn: पृथूदकात् तीर्थतमं नान्यत् तीर्थं कुरूद्वह। तन्मेध्यं तत् पवित्रं च पावनं च न संशयः॥
en: O perpetuator of the Kuru race, no Tirtha is superior to Prithudaka. There is no doubt that, that Tirtha is purifying, holy and sindestroying.

sn: तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति येऽपि पापकृतो नराः। पृथूदके नरश्रेष्ठ एवमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: O foremost of men, O best of the Bharata race, bathing in the Prithudaka (even) sinful men go to heaven. Thus say all wise men.

sn: मधुस्रवं च तत्रैव तीर्थं भरतसत्तम। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O king, there is another Tirtha called Madhusrava. Bathing there, a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थं मेध्यं यथाक्रमम्। सरस्वत्यरुणायाश्च संगमं लोकविश्रुतम्॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go in due order to the celebrated and sacred Tirtha where the Sarasvati and the Aruna are united together.

sn: त्रिरात्रोपोषितः स्नात्वा मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया। अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यां फलं विन्दति मानवः॥ आसप्तमं कुलं चैव पुनाति भरतर्षभ।
en: The man who bathes there fasting for three nights, is cleansed of even the sin of killing a Brahmana. He obtains the fruits greater than those of Agnishtoma and the Atiratha (sacrifices). O best of the Bharata race, he saves his ancestors seven generations upwards and downwards.

sn: अर्धकीलं च तत्रैव तीर्थं कुरुकुलोद्वह॥ विप्राणामनुकम्पार्थं दर्भिणा निर्मितं पुरा। व्रतोपनयनाभ्यां चाप्युपवासेन वाप्युत॥ क्रियामन्त्रैश्च संयुक्तो ब्राह्मणः स्यान्न संशयः। क्रियामन्त्रविहीनोऽपि तत्र स्नात्वा नरर्षभा चीर्णव्रतो भवेद् विद्वान् दृष्टमेतत् पुरातनैः॥
en: O perpetuator of the Kuru race, there is another Tirtha, called Ardhakila. Darbhi created it in the days of yore from compassion for the Brahmans. By vows, by taking the sacred thread, by lasts. By rites and by Mantras, one certainly becomes a Brahman. ) foremost of inen, it has been seen by the ancients that by bathing there, men learned and are endued with the fruits of observing the VOWS.

sn: समुद्राश्चापि चत्वारः समानीताश्च दर्भिणा। तेषु सातो नरश्रेष्ठ न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात्॥ फलानि गोसहस्राणां चतुर्णां विन्दते च सः।
en: O foremost of men, Darbhi had brought there also the four oceans. Bathing in them one does not meet with any calamity. He obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ तीर्थं शतसहस्रकम्॥ साहस्रकं च तत्रैव द्वे तीर्थे लोकविश्रुते। उभयोहि नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥ दानं वाप्युपवासो वा सहस्रगुणितं भवेत्।
en: O virtuous man, one should then go to the two celebrated Tirtha called Sata-Sahasrakam and Sahasraha. Bathing in them one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine. Fasts and gifts there multiply themselves thousandfold.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र रेणुकातीर्थमुत्तमम्॥ तीर्थाभिषेकं कुर्वीत पितृदेवार्चने रतः। सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा अग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent Tirtha called Renuka. Bathing there and being engaged there in worshipping the celestials and the Pitris, one becomes puresouled. His sins being all destroyed, he obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma.

sn: विमोचनमुपस्पृश्य जितमन्युर्जितेन्द्रियः। प्रतिग्रहकृतैर्दोषैः सर्वैः स परिमुच्यते॥
en: Bathing there in the Tirtha called Vimochana with passions and senses subdued, one is cleansed of all his sins derived from receiving gifts.

sn: ततः पञ्चवटीं गत्वा ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः। पुण्येन महता युक्तः सतां लोके महीयते॥
en: Then going to Panchavati with passions controlled and with Brahmacharya life, one becomes greatly virtuous and is adored in the region of the virtuous.

sn: यत्र योगेश्वरः स्थाणुः स्वयमेव वृषध्वजः। तमर्चयित्वा देवेशं गमनादेव सिध्यति॥
en: There the lord of Yoga, Vrishdhvaja, Sthanu himself is always is present. Going there he who worships the lord of the celestials obtains success.

sn: तैजसं वारुणं तीर्थं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा। यत्र ब्रह्मादिभिर्देवैर्ऋषिभिश्च तपोधनैः॥ सैनापत्येन देवानामभिषिक्तो गुहस्तदा। तैजसस्य तु पूर्वेण कुरुतीर्थं कुरूद्वह॥
en: One should then go to the Tirtha, called Taijasa, belonging to Varuna blazing in its own effulgence. There Brahma and the other celestials installed Guha in the command of the celestials army. O perpetuator of the Kuru race, in the east of Taijasa, there is a Tirtha called Kuru.

sn: कुरुतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः। सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा ब्रह्मलोकं प्रपद्यते॥
en: Bathing in the Kuru-Tirtha with passions controlled and with life of a Brahmachari, his soul being purified and his sins being all destroyed, one goes to the region of Brahma.

sn: स्वर्गद्वारं ततो गच्छेन्नियतो नियताशनः। स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: One should then go with regulated diet and subdued soul to Svarga-dvara. He obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine and goes to the region of Brahma.

sn: ततो गच्छेदनरकं तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात्॥ तत्र ब्रह्मा स्वयं नित्यं देवैः सह महीपते। अन्वास्ते पुरुषव्याघ्र नारायणपुरोगमैः॥
en: O ruler of men, then the pilgrim should go to Anaraka. O king, bathing there one never meets with any difficulty. O ruler of earth, O foremost of men, there Brahma himself accompanied by the celestials with Narayana at their head is always present.

sn: सांनिध्यं तत्र राजेन्द्र रुद्रपल्याः कुरूद्वह। अभिगम्य च तां देवीं न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: O king of kings, O perpetuator of the Kuru race, the wife of Rudra is also present there. He who beholds that goddess never meets with any calamity.

sn: तत्रैव च महाराज विश्वेश्वरमुमापतिम्। अभिगम्य महादेवं मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः॥
en: O king, there is (an image) of the husband of Uma, the lord of the universe. He who sees that great god is cleansed of all his sins.

sn: नारायण चाभिगम्य पद्मनाभमरिदम। राजमानो महाराज विष्णुलोकं च गच्छति॥ तीर्थेषु सर्वदेवानां स्नातः स पुरुषर्षभ। सर्वदुःखैः परित्यक्तो द्योतते शशिवन्नरः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, O great king, seeing the lotus-navelled Narayana, one blazes forth and goes to the region of Vishnu. O foremost of men! having taken bath in tirths of celestials men become free from all grieves and endued with enlightenment like the moon.

sn: ततः स्वस्तिपुरं गच्छेत् तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: O king, then the pilgrim should go to the Tirtha, called Sashtipura. Walking round it, he obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: पावनं तीर्थमासाद्य तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः। अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, going to the Tirtha, called Pavana and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sn: गङ्गाह्रदश्च ततैव कूपश्च भरतर्षभ। तिस्रः कोट्यस्तु तीर्थानां तस्मिन् कूपे महीपते॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O ruler of earth, there is Gangahrada and another well (Tirtha); in that well thirty millions of Tirthas are present.

sn: तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् स्वर्गलोकं प्रपद्यते। आफगायां नरः स्नात्वा अर्चयित्वा महेश्वरम्॥ गाणपत्यमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्।
en: O king, bathing there, a man goes to the celestials region. Bathing in Apaga and worshipping Maheshvara. A man obtains the state of Ganapatya and saves his race.

sn: ततः स्थाणुवटं गच्छेत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्॥ तत्रा स्नात्वा स्थितो रात्रि रुद्रलोकमवाप्नुयात्।
en: One should then go to the Tirtha called Sthanuvata, celebrated all over the three worlds. Bathing there a man goes to the celestials region.

sn: बदरीपाचनं गच्छेद् वसिष्ठस्याश्रमं ततः॥ बदरी भक्षयेत् तत्र त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः। सम्यग् द्वादशवर्षाणि बदरी भक्षयेत् तु यः॥ त्रिरात्रोपोषितस्तेन भवेत् तुल्यो नराधिप। रुद्रमार्ग समासाद्य तीर्थसेवी नराधिप॥ अहोरात्रोपवासेन शक्रलोके महीयते।
en: O king, One should then go Badaripachana, the herinitage of Vasishtha. A man, fasting there for three nights, should eat Badari (Jujubes). He who lives on Badari for twelve years. And, O ruler of men, he who fasts there for three nights, obtains equal merits. O king, going to Rudra-marga, the pilgrim is adored in the region of Indra by fasting one day and night. to

sn: एकरात्रं समासाद्य एकरात्रोषितो नरः॥ नियतः सत्यवादी च ब्रह्मलोके महीयते।
en: Going to Ikaratra, he who lives there for one night with regulated vows and truthfulness, becomes adored in the region of Brahma.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्॥ आदित्यस्याश्रमो यत्र तेजोराशेर्महात्मनः। तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयित्वा विभावसुम्॥ आदित्यलोकं व्रजति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्।
en: Where there is the hermitage of Aditya, the illustrious deity of great effulgence, (there is also another Tirtha). Bathing in it and worshipping there the god of light a man, goes to the region of Soma and saves his race.

sn: सोमतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा तीर्थसेवी नराधिप॥ सोमलोकमवाप्नोति नरो नास्त्यत्र संशयः।
en: O ruler of men, bathing in the Soma Tirtha, the pilgrim goes to the region of Soma without any doubt.

sn: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ दधीचस्य महात्मनः॥ तीर्थं पुण्यतमं राजन् पावनं लोकविश्रुतम्। यत्र सारस्वतो यातः सोऽङ्गिरास्तपसो निधिः॥
en: O virtuous man, one should then go to the illustrious Dadhichi's sacred Tirtha called Pavana, celebrated all over the world. Here was born that ocean of asceticism, Angiras, of the Sarasvata race.

sn: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा वाजिमेधफलं लभेत्। सारस्वतीं गतिं चैव लभते नात्र संशयः॥
en: Bathing in that Tirtha, a man obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice and he without any doubt obtains the region of Sarasvati.

sn: ततः कन्याश्रमं गच्छेन्नियतो ब्रह्मचर्यवान्। त्रिरात्रोपोषितो राजन् नियतो नियताशनः॥ लभेत् कन्याशतं दिव्यं स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति।
en: One should then go with regulated vows and with the life of Brahmacharya to Kanyasrama. O king, living there three nights with regulated diet and subdued soul. One obtains one hundred celestials damsels and goes to the region of Brahma.

sn: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ तीर्थं संनिहतीमपि॥
en: O virtuous one, one should then go to the Tirtha called Sannihati.

sn: तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः। मासि मासि समायान्ति पुण्येन महतान्विताः॥
en: Brahma and other celestials and ascetic Rishis go there every month and earn great virtue.

sn: संनिहत्यामुपस्पृश्य राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे। अश्वमेधशतं तेन तत्रेष्टं शाश्वतं भवेत्॥
en: Bathing in Sannihati during a solar eclipse, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice and of other sacrifices that are everlasting.

sn: पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि अन्तरिक्षचराणि च। नद्यो ह्रदास्तडागाश्च सर्वप्रस्रवणानि च॥ उदपानानि वाप्यश्च तीर्थान्यायतनानि च। नि:संशयममावास्यां समेष्यन्ति नराधिप॥ मासि मासि नरव्याघ्र संनिहत्यां च संशयः। तीर्थसंनिहनादेव संनिहत्येति विश्रुता॥
en: Whatever Tirtha exists on earth or in the sky, all the rivers, lakes, ponds, springs, large and small tanks and all other Tirtha sacred to particular gods, O ruler of men, all come here without doubt on the day of new moon, And they certainly mix with Sannihati every month. It is therefore that this Tirtha is known by the name of Sannihati.

sn: तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च स्वर्गलोके महीयते। अमावस्यां तु तत्रैव राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे॥ यः श्राद्धं कुरुते मर्त्यस्तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु। अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य सम्यगिष्टस्य यत् फलम्॥ स्नात एव समाप्नोति कृत्वा श्राद्धं च मानवः। यत् किंचिद् दुष्कृतं कर्म स्त्रिया वा पुरुषेण वा।१९८॥ स्नातमात्रस्य तत् सर्वं नश्यते नात्र संशयः। पावर्णेन यानेन ब्रह्मलोकं प्रपद्यते॥
en: He who bathes there and drinks its water is adored in the celestials region. In a solar ecclipse on the new moon. He who performs Sraddha ceremony here after having bathed obtains the fruits of the performance of one thousand horse-sacrifices. Whatever sins a man or a woman commits are without doubt all destroyed as soon as one bathes and performs Sraddha ceremony in this Tirtha. He also goes to the region of Brahma on a lotus coloured car.

sn: अभिवाद्य ततो यक्षं द्वारपालं मचक्रुकम्। कोटितीर्थमुपस्पृश्य लभेद् बहुसुवर्णकम्॥
en: Bathing then in Koti Tirtha after having worshipped the Yaksha door-keeper, Machakruka, one obtains the fruits of giving away gold in abundance.

sn: गङ्गाह्रदश्च तत्रैव तीर्थं भरतसत्तम। तत्र स्नायीतधर्मज्ञ ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः॥ राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां फलं विन्दति मानवः।
en: O best of the Bharata race, there is a Tirtha called Gangahrada. O virtuous man, bathing there with subdued soul and with Brahmacharya life, a man obtains the fruits of Rajasuya and Ashavamedha sacrifice.

sn: पृथिव्यां नैमिषं तीर्थमन्तरिक्षे च पुष्करम्॥ त्रयाणामपि लोकानां कुरुक्षेत्रं विशिष्यते। पांसवोऽपि कुरुक्षेत्राद् वायुना समुदीरिताः॥ अपि दुष्कृतकर्माणं नयन्ति परमां गतिम्। दक्षिणेन सरस्वत्या उत्तरेण दृषद्वतीम्॥ ये वसन्ति कुरुक्षेत्रे ते वसन्ति त्रिविष्टपे।
en: On earth the Tirtha called Naimisha and in the sky the Tirtha called Pushkara (are great). But in all the three worlds Kurukshetra is the greatest. Even the dust of Kurukshetra carried by wind takes away the sinful men to the highest state. In the north (of it) flows the Drishadvati and in the south the Sarasvati.

sn: कुरुक्षेत्रे गमिष्यामि कुरुक्षेत्रे वसाम्यहम्॥ अप्येकां वाचमुत्सृज्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते।
en: He who lives in this region really lives in heaven. "I will go to Kurukshetra, I will live in Kurukshetra,” he who utters these words even once becomes cleansed of all his sins.

sn: ब्रह्मवेदी कुरुक्षेत्रं पुण्यं ब्रह्मर्षिसेवितम्॥ तस्मिन् वसन्ति ये मा न ते शोच्याः कथंचन।२०७॥
en: The sacred Kurukshetra which is adored by the celestials is considered the sacrificial altar of the gods. Those mortals that live there have nothing to make them miserable at any time.

sn: तरन्तुकारन्तुकयोर्यदन्तरं रामह्रदानां च मचक्रुकस्य च। एतत् कुरुक्षेत्रसमन्तपञ्चक पितामहस्योत्तरवेदिरुच्यते॥
en: The region that lies between Tarnatuka and Arantuka and the lakes of Rama and Machakruka is (called Kurukshetra). It is also called Samantapanchaka. It is said to be the northern sacrificial altar of the Grandsire (Brahma).

sn: पुलस्त्य उवाच ततो गच्छेन्महाराजधर्मतीर्थमनुत्तमम्। यत्रधर्मो महाभागस्तप्तवानुत्तमं तपः॥
en: Pulastya said : O great king, one should then go to the excellent Tirtha, called Dharma where the greatly exalted Dharma performed excellent asceticism.

sn: तेन तीर्थं कृतं पुण्यं स्वेन नाम्ना च विश्रुतम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन्धर्मशीलः समाहितः॥ आसप्तमं कुलं चैव पुनीते नात्र संशयः।
en: It is for this reason he made the place a sacred Tirtha and made it known after his own name. O king, bathing there a virtuous-man with subdued soul purifies without doubt his ancestors seven generations upwards and downwards.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र ज्ञानपावनमुत्तमम्॥ अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति मुनिलोकं च गच्छति।
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent Gyanapavana (going there) one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma and goes to the region of Munis.

sn: सौगन्धिकवनं राजंस्ततो गच्छेत मानवः॥
en: O king, a man should then go to Saugandikvana.

sn: तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः। सिद्धचारणगन्धर्वाः किंनराश्च महोरगाः॥
en: There live Brahma and other celestials, the Rishis, the ascetics, the Siddhas, the Charanas, the Gandharvas, the Kinnaras and the great Nagas.

sn: तद् वनं प्रविशन्नेव सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते। ततश्चापि सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा नदीनामुत्तमा नदी॥ प्लक्षादेवी स्रता राजन् महापुण्या सरस्वती। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत वल्मीकान्निःसृते जले॥
en: As soon as one enters that forest all sins are destroyed. There flows that best of streams, that foremost river of all rivers, that sacred goddess, O king, which is known (there) by the name of Plaksha Devi; bathing there in the water issuing forth from the bill.

sn: अर्चयित्वा पितृन् देवानश्वमेधफलं लभेत्। ईशानाध्युषितं नाम तत्र तीर्थं सुदुर्लभम्॥
en: And worshipping the Pitris and the celestials, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice. There is a a very inaccessible Tirtha, called Ishanadhyushita.

sn: घट्सु शम्यानिपातेषु वल्मीकादिति निश्चयः। कपिलानां सहस्रं च वाजिमेधं च विन्दति॥ तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र दृष्टमेतत् पुरातनैः।
en: Lying from the anthill at the distance of six throws of a Shamya (wooden sacrificial stick). O foremost of men, it is seen in the Puranas that as soon as one bathes in it, one obtains the iruits of giving away one thousand Kapila kine and also those of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sn: सुगन्धां शतकुम्भां च पञ्चयज्ञां च भारत॥ अभिगम्य नरश्रेष्ठ स्वर्गलोके महीयते।
en: O descendant of Bharata, next are the Tirthas called Sugandha, Shatakumbha and Panchayajna.

sn: त्रिशूलखातं तत्रैव तीर्थमासाद्य भारत॥ तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत पितृदेवार्चने रतः। गाणपत्यं च लभते देहं त्यक्त्वा न संशयः॥
en: One going there, O king, becomes adored in the celestials region. O descendant of Bharata, going there to the Tirtha called Trishulakhata and bathing there and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials, there is no doubt one obtains the state of Ganapatya after giving up his body.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र देव्याः स्थानं सुदुर्लभम्। शाकम्भरीति विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent celestials region which is known all over the three worlds by the name of Shakambhari.

sn: दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं हि शाकेन किल सुव्रता। आहारं सा कृतवती मासि मासि नराधिप॥ ऋषयोऽभ्यागतास्तत्र देव्या भक्त्या तपोधनाः। आतिथ्यं च कृतं तेषां शाकेन किल भारत॥
en: O ruler of men, for one thousand celestials years, that lady of excellent vows lived month after month on herbs. Many ascetic ladies who were devoted to that goddess came there. O descendant of Bharata, they were all entertained by her with herbs.

sn: ततः शाकम्भरीत्येव नाम तस्याः प्रतिष्ठितम्। शाकम्भरी समासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः॥ त्रिरात्रमुषितः शाकं भक्षयित्वा नरः शुचिः। शाकाहारस्य यत् किंचिद् वर्षेञदशभिः कृतम्॥ तत् फलं तस्य भवति देव्याश्छन्देन भारत।
en: O descendant of Bharata, it is for this she was given the name of Shakambhari. Going to Shakambhari with rapt attention and with Brahmacharya life and living in purity three nights there on herbs alone, the merit of living on herbs for twelve years a man obtains at the will of the goddess.

sn: ततो गच्छेत् सुवर्णाख्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्॥ तत्र विष्णुः प्रसादार्थं रुद्रमाराधयत् पुरा। वरांश्च सुबहल्लेभे दैवतेषु सुदुर्लभान्॥
en: Then one should go to the Tirtha called Suvarna, celebrated all over the three worlds. There Vishnu in the days of yore worshipped Rudra in order to get his grace. He obtained many boons difficult to be got by even the celestials.

sn: उक्तश्च त्रिपुरघ्नेन परितुष्टेन भारत। अपि च त्वं प्रियतरो लोके कृष्ण भविष्यसि॥ त्वन्मुखं च जगत् सर्वं भविष्यति न संशयः। तत्राभिगम्य राजेन्द्र पूजयित्वा वृषध्वजम्॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति गाणपत्यं च विन्दति। धूमावतीं ततो गच्छेत् त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः॥ मनसा प्रार्थितान् कामाँल्लभते नात्र संशयः।
en: O descendant of Bharata, having been thus gratified, the destroyer of Tripura said, “O Krishna, you shall certainly be very beloved on earth. There is no doubt you will be the foremost being in the universe." O king of kings, going there and worshipping Vrishadhvaja (Shiva). One obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha (sacrifice) and acquires the state of Ganapatya. Then one should go to Dhumavati and fasting there for three nights, a man obtains without doubt all the desires that he entertains in his mind.

sn: देव्यास्तु दक्षिणार्धेन रथावर्तो नराधिप॥ तत्रारोहेतधर्मज्ञ श्रद्दधानो जितेन्द्रियः। महादेवप्रसादाद्धि गच्छेत परमां गतिम्॥
en: O ruler of men, in the southern side of this Tirtha, belonging to this Tirtha, there exists a Tirtha called Rathavarta. O virtuous man, one should go there with reverential mood and with passions all subdued. He then obtains through the grace of Mahadeva the highest state.

sn: प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य गच्छेत भरतर्षभ। धारां नाम महाप्राज्ञः सर्वपापप्रमोचनीम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O greatly wise one, walking round it, one should, go to the Tirtha called Dhara which destroys all sins.

sn: तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र न शोचति नराधिप।
en: O foremost of men, O king, bathing there, one becomes freed from fall sorrow.

sn: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ नमस्कृत्य महागिरिम्॥ स्वर्गद्वारेण यत् तुल्यं गङ्गाद्वारं न संशयः। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत कोटितीर्थे समाहितः॥
en: O virtuous one, one should then go, after bowing to the great mountain. To the source of the Ganges which is certainly like the gate of heaven. There one should with controlled soul bathe in the Tirtha called Koti.

sn: पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्। उष्यैकां रजनीं तत्र गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: He then obtains the fruits of Pundarika sacrifice and saves his own race. Living there for one night, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: सप्तगङ्गे त्रिगङ्गे च शक्रावर्ते च तर्पयन्। देवान् पितॄश्च विधिवत् पुण्ये लोके महीयते॥
en: Offering oblations according to the ordinance to the Pitris and the celestials at Saptaganga, Triganga and Shakravarta, one becomes adored in the regions of the virtuous.

sn: ततः कनखले स्नात्वा त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then bathing in Kanakhala and fasting there for three nights one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and goes to the celestials region.

sn: कपिलावटं ततो गच्छेत् तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। उपोष्य रजनीं तत्र गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: O ruler of men, then the pilgrim should go to Kapilavata; and fasting there for one night, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: नागराजस्य राजेन्द्र कपिलस्य महात्मनः। तीर्थं कुरुवरश्रेष्ठ सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुतम्॥
en: O king of kings, O best of the Kurus, one should then go to the illustrious Kapila, the king of the Nagas who is celebrated all over the three worlds.

sn: तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत नागतीर्थे नराधिप। कपिलानां सहस्रस्य फलं विन्दति मानवः॥
en: O ruler of men, bathing in the Naga-Tirtha, a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand Kapila kine.

sn: ततो ललितकं गच्छेच्छान्तनोस्तीर्थमुत्तमम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Then one should go to the Tirtha of Shantanu, called Lalitaka. O king, bathing there a man never meets with calamity.

sn: गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये स्नाति यः संगमे नरः। दशाश्वमेधानाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: The man, who bathes at the confluence of the Ganga and the Yamuna, obtains the fruits of ten Ashvamedha sacrifice and saves his own race.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र सुगंधां लोकविश्रुताम्। सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा ब्रह्मलोके महीयते॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to Sugandhaka celebrated all over the world. His soul being purified and his sins all destroyed cile becomes adored in the region of Brahma.

sn: रुद्रावर्तं ततो गच्छेत् तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: O ruler of men, then the pilgrim should go to the Rudravarta. O king, bathing there one goes to the celestials region.

sn: गङ्गायाश्च नरश्रेष्ठ सरस्वत्याश्च संगमे। स्नात्वाश्वमेधं प्राप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: O foremost of men, bathing at the confluence of the Ganges and the Sarasvati one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and goes to the celestials region.

sn: भद्रकर्णेश्वरं गत्वा देवमर्च्य यथाविधि। न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति नाकपृष्ठे च पूज्यते॥
en: Going to Bhadrakarneshvara and worshipping the celestials according to proper rites, one never meets with any calamity; and becomes adored in the celestials region.

sn: ततः कुब्जाम्रकं गच्छेत् तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। गोसहस्रमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: O ruler of men, one should then go to Kubjamraka; one then obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine and goes to the celestials region.

sn: अरुन्धतीवटं गच्छेत् तीर्थसेवी नराधिप। सामुद्रकमुपस्पृश्य ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः। गोसहस्रफलं विद्यात् कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: O ruler of men, then the pilgrim should go to Arundhantivata. Bathing at Samudrava with concentrated soul and with Brahmacharya life and fasting there for three nights, a man obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice. He obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine and saves his own race.

sn: ब्रह्मावर्तं ततो गच्छेद् ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति सोमलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: One should then go with concentrated mind and with Brahmacharya life to Brahmavarta. He obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and goes to the region of Soma.

sn: यमुनाप्रभवं गत्वा समुपस्पृश्य यामुनम्। अश्वमेधफलं लब्ध्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: Going to Yamunaprabhva he who bathes in the Yamuna obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and becomes adored in the celestials region.

sn: दर्वीसंक्रमणं प्राप्य तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम्। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then going to the Tirtha called Darvisankramana which is adored by all the three worlds, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and goes to the celestials region.

sn: सिन्धोश्च प्रभवं गत्वा सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम्। तत्रोष्य रजनीः पञ्च विन्देद् बहुसुवर्णकम्॥
en: Going to Sindhu which is frequented by the Siddhas and the Gandharvas and living there for five nights, one obtains the fruits of giving away much gold.

sn: अथ वेदी समासाद्य नरः परमदुर्गमाम्। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then going to the very inaccessible Vedi, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and goes to the celestials region.

sn: ऋषिकुल्यां समासाद्य वासिष्ठं चैव भारत। वासिष्ठी समतिक्रम्य सर्वे वर्णा द्विजातयः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, going to Rishikulya and Vasishtha and by visiting Vasishtha, all the other orders attain to Brahmanhood.

sn: ऋषिकुल्या समासाद्य नरः स्नात्वा विकल्मषः। देवान् पितॄश्चार्चयित्वा ऋषिलोकं प्रपद्यते॥
en: Going to Rishikulya, the man who bathes there becomes freed from all his sins and by worshipping there the Pitris and the celestials, he goes to the region of the Rishis.

sn: यदि तत्र वसेन्मासं शाकाहारो नराधिप। भृगुतुङ्गं समासाद्य वाजिमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: O ruler of men, if one lives there for a month subsisting on herbs (he too goes to the Rishi's land). Going then to Bhrigutunga, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha (sacrifice).

sn: गत्वा वीरप्रमोक्षं च सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते। कृत्तिकामघयोश्चैव तीर्थमासाद्य भारत॥ अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यां फलमाप्नोति मानवः। तत्र संध्यां समासाद्य विद्यातीर्थमनुत्तमम्॥ उपस्पृश्य च वै विद्यां यत्र तत्रोपपद्यते। महाश्रमे वसेद् रात्रिं सर्वपापप्रमोचने॥ एककालं निराहारो लोकानावसते शुभान्।
en: Going to Virapramoksha one is cleansed of all his sins. O descendant of Bharata, going then to the Tirtha, called Kirtika and Magha, a man obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma and Atiratha (sacrifices). Then going to the excellent Tirtha called Vidya in the evening. He who bathes there obtain every kind of knowledge. Then one should live one night at Mahasrama, which is capable of destroying all sins. By taking a single meal there a man obtains many blessed regions.

sn: षष्ठकालोपवासेन मासमुष्य महालये॥ सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा विन्देद् बहुसुवर्णकम्। दशापरान् दश पूर्वान् नरानुद्धरते कुलम्॥
en: Fasting there for six days and living there for a month at Mahalaya, his soul being purified and all his sins destroyed, one obtains the fruits of giving away much gold and saves ten preceding and ten succeeding generations of his race.

sn: अथ वेतसिकां गत्वा पितामहनिषेविताम्। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति गच्छेदौशनसीं गतिम्॥
en: Then going to Vetasika frequented by the Grandsire obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and acquires the state of Ganas.

sn: अथ सुन्दरिकातीर्थं प्राप्य सिद्धनिषेवितम्। रूपस्य भागी भवति दृष्टमेतत् पुरातनैः॥
en: Then going to the Tirtha called Sundarika, frequented by the Siddhas, it is seen in the Puranas, one obtains personal beauty. one

sn: ततो वै ब्राह्मणीं गत्वा ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः। पावर्णेन यानेन ब्रह्मलोकं प्रपद्यते॥
en: Then going to Brahmani with one's passions controlled and with Brahmacharya life, one goes to the region of Brahma on a lotus coloured car.

sn: ततस्तु नैमिषं गच्छेत् पुण्यं सिद्धनिषेवितम्। तत्र नित्यं निवसति ब्रह्मा देवगणैः सह॥
en: Then one should go to the sacred Naimisha, frequented by the Siddhas, where Brahma with the celestials always dwells.

sn: नैमिषं मृगयानस्य पापस्यार्धं प्रणश्यति। प्रविष्टमात्रस्तु नरः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: Only by wishing to go to Naimisha, half of one's sins is destroyed. As soon as a man enters it, he is cleansed of all his sins.

sn: तत्र मासं वसेद्धीरो नैमिषे तीर्थतत्परः। पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि तानि तीर्थानि नैमिषे॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the heroic pilgrim should live in Naimisha for one month; for all the Tirthas are in Naimisha.

sn: कृताभिषेकस्तत्रैव नियतो नियताशनः। गवां मेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, bathing there with regulated diet and subdued soul, one obtains the fruits of many sacrifices.

sn: पुनात्यासप्तमं चैव कुलं भरतसत्तम। यस्त्यजेन्नैमिषे प्राणानुपवासपरायणः॥ स मोदेत् सर्वलोकेषु एवमाहुर्मनीषिणः। नित्यं मेध्यं च पुण्यं च नैमिषं नृपसत्तम॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, he sanctifies his race for seven generations upwards and downwards. He who gives up his life in Naimisha by fasting. The wise men say, sports in the celestials region. O foremost of kings, Naimisha is ever sacred and holy.

sn: गङ्गोद्भेदं समासाद्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः। वाजपेयमवाप्नोति ब्रह्मभूतो भवेत् सदा॥
en: Going to Gangodbheda and fasting there for three nights, a man obtains fruits of Vajapeya and becomes like Brahma himself.

sn: सरस्वतीं समासाद्य तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः। सारस्वतेषु लोकेषु मोदते नात्र संशयः॥
en: Going to the Sarasvati, he who offers libations to the Pitris and the celestials, no doubt sports in the regions of Sarasvati.

sn: ततश्च बाहुदां गच्छेद् ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। तत्रोष्य राजनीमेकां स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥ देवसत्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति कौरवा
en: Then one should with Brahmacharya life go to Bahuda. Living there for one night, one becomes adored in celestials region. O descendant of Kuru, he obtains the fruits of the Devasatra sacrifice.

sn: ततः क्षीरवतीं गच्छेत् पुण्यां पुण्यतरैर्वृताम्॥ पितृदेवार्चनपरो वाजपेयमवाप्नुयात्।
en: Then one should go to the holy Kshiravati surrounded by holier beings. Worshipping there the Pitris and the celestials one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice).

sn: विमलाशोकमासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः॥ तत्रोष्य रजनीमेकां स्वर्गलोके महीयते।
en: Then going to Vimalashoka lake with concentrated mind and with Brahmacharya life and living there for one night, one becomes adored in the celestials region.

sn: गोप्रतारं ततो गच्छेत् सरय्वास्तीर्थमुत्तमम्॥ यत्र रामो गत: स्वर्गं सभृत्यबलवाहनः। स च वीरो महाराज तस्य तीर्थस्य तेजसा॥
en: One should then go to Gopratara, the excellent Tirtha in the Sarayu. Where Rama went to heaven with all his servants, soldiers and beasts of burden. By giving up one's body, O king, he obtains the great effulgence of the Tirtha.

sn: रामस्य च प्रसादेन व्यवसायाच्च भारत। तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा गोप्रतारे नराधिप॥ सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा स्वर्गलोके महीयते।
en: O descendant of Bharata, through the grace of Rama and through one's own virtuous deeds. O ruler of men, the man who bathes in that Tirtha called Gopratara, his body being purified and his sins being destroyed, becomes adored in the celestials region.

sn: रामतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा गोमत्यां कुरुनन्दन॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति पुनाति च कुलं नरः।
en: O descendant of Kuru, bathing in the Rama Tirtha in the Gomati, a man, obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice and sanctifies his own race.

sn: शतसाहस्रकं तीर्थं तत्रैव भरतर्षभ॥ तत्रोपस्पर्शनं कृत्वा नियतो नियताशनः। गोसहस्रफलं पुण्यं प्राप्नोति भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, there is a Tirtha called Satasahasraka. Bathing there with regulated diet and subdued soul. O best of the Bharata race, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र भर्तृस्थानमुत्तमम्। अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः॥
en: O king, one should then go to Bhatri Tirtha, a man obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sn: कोटितीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा अर्चयित्वा गुहं नृप। गोसहस्रफलं विद्यात् तेजस्वी च भवेन्नरः॥
en: O king, bathing in the Koti Tirtha and worshipping Guha, a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine and becomes effulgent.

sn: ततो वाराणसीं गत्वा अर्चयित्वा वृषध्वजम्। कपिलाह्रदे नरः स्नात्वा राजसूयमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Then going to Varanasi and worshipping Vrishadhvaja (Shiva) and then bathing in the Kapalihrada a man obtains the fruits of Rajasuya sacrifice.

sn: अविमुक्तं समासाद्य तीर्थसेवी कुरूद्वह। दर्शनाद् देवदेवस्य मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया॥ प्राणानुत्सृज्य तत्रैव मोक्षं प्राप्नोति मानवः।
en: O perpetuator of the Kuru race, going to Avimukta, the pilgrim is cleansed of even the sin of killing a Brahmana as soon as he sees the god of gods (Shiva). A man who gives up his life there obtains final salvation.

sn: मार्कण्डेयस्य राजेन्द्र तीर्थमासाद्य दुर्लभम्॥ गोमतीगङ्गयोश्चैव संगमे लोकविश्रुते। अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: O king of kings, then going to the inaccessible Tirtha of Markandeya situated at the confluence of the Gomati and the Ganges, ever celebrated over the world, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma (sacrifice) and saves his race.

sn: ततो गयां समासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: Then going to Gaya with concentrated mind and with Brahmacharya life, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and also saves his race.

sn: तत्राक्षयवटो नाम त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः। तत्र दत्तं पितृभ्यस्तु भवत्यक्षयमुच्यते॥
en: There is the Tirtha called Aksayavata, celebrated all over the three worlds. Whatever is offered there to the Pitris is said to become inexhaustible.

sn: महानद्यामुपस्पृश्य तर्पयेत् पितृदेवताः। अक्षयान् प्राप्नुयाल्लोकान् कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: Bathing in the Mahanadi and offering their oblations to the Pitris and the celestials, one obtains eternal region and also saves his race.

sn: ततो ब्रह्मसरो गत्वाधर्मारण्योपशोभितम्। ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नोति प्रभातामेव शर्वरीम्॥
en: Then going to Brahmasara adorned with the woods of Dharma, one goes to the region of Brahma as soon as the night is gone.

sn: ब्रह्मणा तत्र सरसि यूपश्रेष्ठः समुच्छ्रितः। यूपं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा वाजपेयफलं लभेत्॥
en: A best sacrificial pillar was built on that lake by Brahma. He who walks round that pillar obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice).

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्रधेनुकं लोकविश्रुतम्। एकरात्रोषितो राजन् प्रयच्छेत् तिलधेनुकाम्॥ सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा सोमलोकं व्रजेध्रुवम्।
en: O king of kings, one should go to Dhenuka celebrated over the world. O king, living there one night and giving away sesamum and kine. His soul being purified and his sins being all destroyed, a man certainly goes to the region of Soma.

sn: तत्र चिह्न महद् राजन्नद्यापि सुमहद् भृशम्॥ कपिलायाः सवत्सायाश्चरन्त्याः पर्वते कृतम्। सवत्सायाः पदानि स्म दृश्यन्तेऽद्यापि भारत॥
en: O king, there is still to be seen a greatly wonderful mark. The Kapilas with their calves used to roam over that mountain. O descendant of Bharata, the hoof-marks of Kapilas with their calves are to be seen there even up to date.

sn: तेषूपस्पृश्य राजेन्द्र पदेषु नृपसत्तम। यत् किंचिदशुभं कर्म तत् प्रणश्यति भारत॥
en: O king of kings, O foremost of monarchs, bathing in these hoof-marks, O descendants of Bharata, whatever sin is committed is all destroyed.

sn: ततो गृध्रवटं गच्छेत् स्थानं देवस्यधीमतः। स्नायीत भस्मना तत्र अभिगम्य वृषध्वजम्॥
en: Then one should go to Gridhravata which is the region of the god, the wielder of trident. Going to Vrishadhvaja (Shiva), one should rub his body with ashes.

sn: ब्राह्मणेन भवेच्चीर्णं व्रतं द्वादशवार्षिकम्। इतरेषां तु वर्णानां सर्वपापं प्रणश्यति॥
en: If he is a Brahmana, he will obtain the fruit of observing twelve years vows and if he is of other castes, all his sins will be destroyed.

sn: उद्यन्तं च ततो गच्छेत् पर्वतं गीतनादितम्। सावित्र्यास्तु पदं तत्र दृश्यते भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, one should then go to Udyanta mountain resounding with melodious notes. The foot-prints of Savitri are still to be seen there.

sn: तत्र संध्यामुपासीत ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः। तेन ह्युपास्ता भवति संध्या द्वादशवार्षिकी॥
en: The Brahmana of rigid vows who recites his Sandhya (prayers) there but once obtains the merit of reciting Sandhya for twelve years.

sn: योनिद्वारं च तत्रैव विश्रुतं भरतर्षभ। तत्राभिगम्य मुच्येत पुरुषो योनिसंकटात्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, there is the Tirtha known by the name of Yonidvara. Going there a man is freed from the pain of rebirth.

sn: कृष्णशुल्कावुभौ पक्षौ गयायां यो वसेन्नरः। पुनात्यासप्तमं राजन् कुलं नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: O king, the man who lives at Gaya during both the white and the black fortnight, no doubt sanctifies the seven generations of his race upwards and downwards.

sn: एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा यद्येकोऽपि गयां व्रजेत्। यजेत वाश्वमेधेन नीलं वा वृषमुत्सृजेत्॥
en: One should desire for many sons, so that one may go to Gaya or perform Ashvamedha or offer a Nila bull.

sn: ततः फल्गुं व्रजेद् राजस्तीर्थसेवी नराधिय। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति सिद्धिं च महतीं व्रजेत्॥
en: O king, O ruler of men, the pilgrim should then go to Falgu; he obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha (sacrifice) and attains to great success.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्रधर्मप्रस्थं समाहितः। तत्रधर्मो महाराज नित्यमास्ते युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go with concentrated mind to Dharmaprastha. O great king ever steady in war, Dharma is always present there.

sn: तत्र कूपोदकं कृत्वा तेन स्नातः शुचिस्तथा। पितॄन् देवांस्तु संतर्प्य मुक्तपापो दिवं व्रजेत्॥
en: Drinking there the water of the well and purifying one's self there by a bath and also offering oblations to the Pitris and the celestials, one, being cleansed of his sins, goes to heaven.

sn: मतङ्गस्याश्रमस्तत्र महर्षे वितात्मनः। तं प्रविश्याश्रमं श्रीमच्छ्रमशोकविनाशनम्॥ गवामयनयज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः। धर्म तत्राभिसंस्पृश्य वाजिमेधमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: There is the hermitage of Matanga the Rishi of controlled passions. By entering that charming hermitage which is capable of destroying all grief's and sorrows. A man obtains the the fruits of the Gavamayana (sacrifice). By touching (the image of) Dharma there, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मस्थानमनुत्तमम्। तत्राभिगम्य राजेन्द्र ब्रह्माणं पुरुषर्षभ॥ राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां फलं विन्दति मानवः।
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent region of Brahma. O king, going there by that foremost of Purushas, Brahma. A man obtains the fruits of Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifices.

sn: ततो राजगृहं गच्छेत् तीर्थसेवी नराधिप॥ उपस्पृश्य ततस्तत्र कक्षीवानिव मोदते। यक्षिण्या नैत्यकं तत्र प्राश्नीत पुरुषः शुचिः॥ यक्षिण्यास्तु प्रसादेन मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया।
en: O ruler of men, the pilgrim should then go to Rajagriha. Bathing there one rejoices (in heaven) like (the Rishi) Kakshivan. A man with purity should take there the offerings daily made to Yakshini. Through the favour of Yakshini one is cleansed of the sin of even killing a Brahmana.

sn: मणिनागं ततो गत्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: There going to Maninaga one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: तैर्थिकं भुञ्जते यस्तु मणिनागस्य भारत्। दष्टस्याशीविषेणापि न तस्य क्रमते विषम्॥ तत्रोष्य रजनीमेकां गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्।
en: O descendant of Bharata, he who eats anything belonging to that Tirtha does not die even if he is bitten by a venomous snake. Living there for one night, the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: ततो गच्छेत ब्रह्मौतमस्य वनं प्रियम्॥ अहल्याया ह्रदे स्नात्वा व्रजेत परमां गतिम्। अभिगम्याश्रमं राजन् विन्दते श्रियमात्मनः॥
en: Then one should go to the charming forest of the Brahmarshi Gautama. Bathing in the lake Ahalya one attains to most excellent state; attaining to Sree, O king, one obtains best prosperity.

sn: तत्रोदपानधर्मज्ञ त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। तत्राभिषेकं कृत्वा तु वाजिमेधमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: O virtuous man, there is a well celebrated all over the three worlds. Bathing there one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice).

sn: जनकस्य तु राजर्षेः कूपस्त्रिदशपूजितः। तत्राभिषेकं कृत्वा तु विष्णुलोकमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: There is (another) well sacred to the royal sage Janaka worshipped by the celestials. Bathing there one goes to the region of Vishnu.

sn: ततो विनशनं गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्। वाजपेयमवाप्नोति सोमलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then one should go to Vinashana which destroys all sins. He obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice) and goes to the region of Soma.

sn: गण्डकी तु समासाद्य सर्वतीर्थजलोद्भवाम्। वाजपेयमवाप्नोति सूर्यलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Going then to Gandaki which was produced by the water of all Tirthas, one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice) and goes to the region of Surya.

sn: ततो विशल्यामासाद्य नदीं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुताम्। अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then going to the river Vishalya, celebrated over the three worlds, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice and goes to the celestials region.

sn: ततोऽधिवॉधर्मज्ञ समाविश्य तपोवनम्। गुह्यकेशु महाराज मोदते नात्र संशयः॥
en: O virtuous man, than going to the forest of the ascetics called Adhivanga. O great king, one rejoices without doubt among the Guhyakas.

sn: कम्पनां तु समासाद्य नदी सिद्धनिषेविताम्। पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then going to the river named Kampana frequented by the Siddhas one obtains the fruits of Pundarika sacrifice and goes to the celestials region.

sn: अथ माहेश्वरीधारां समासाद्यधराधिप। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: O ruler of earth, then going to the stream, called Maheshvari, one obtains the fruits of Ashvarmedha (sacrifice) and saves his own race.

sn: दिवौकसां पुष्करिणीं समासाद्य नराधिप। न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति वाजिमेधं च विन्दति॥
en: O ruler of men, going to the tank, of the celestials, one never meets with any calamity; he obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sn: अथ सोमपदं गच्छेद् ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। माहेश्वरपदे स्नात्वा वाजिमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: Then one should go with concentrated mind and with Brahmacharya life to Somapada. Bathing in Maheshvara pada, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sn: तत्र कोटिस्तु तीर्थानां विश्रुता भरतर्षभ। कूर्मरूपेण राजेन्द्र ह्यसुरेण दुरात्मना॥ ह्रियमाणा हृता राजन् विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत तीर्थकोट्यां युधिष्ठिर॥ पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति विष्णुलोकं च गच्छति।
en: O best of the Bharata race, it is well-known there is in that Tirtha, ten millions of Tirthas. O king of kings, a wicked-minded Asura in the form of a tortoise, was stealing it away, when, O king, it was recovered from hiin by Vishnu. O hero steady in war, bathing in that Tirtha. One obtains the fruits of Pundarika (sacrifice) and goes to the region of Vishnu.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र स्थानं नारायणस्य च॥ सदा संनिहितो यत्र विष्णुर्वसति पारत। यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः॥ आदित्य वसवो रुद्रा जनार्दनमुपासते। शालग्रम इति ख्यातो विष्णुरद्भुतकर्मकः॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the region of Narayana, O descendant of Bharata, near which Vishnu always dwells. There Brahma and other celestials, the ascetic Rishis, the Adityas, the Vasus and the Rudras adore Janardana (Krishna). (In that Tirtha) Vishnu of wonderful deeds has become known Shaligrama.

sn: अभिगम्य त्रिलोकेशं वरदं विष्णुमव्ययम्। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति विष्णुलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Going to the lord of the three worlds, the giver of boons, the eternal Vishnu, one obtains as the fruits of Ashvamedha and goes to the region of Vishnu,

sn: तत्रोदपानधर्मज्ञ सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्। समुद्रास्तत्र चत्वारः कूपे संनिहिताः सदा॥
en: O virtuous man, there is a well which is capable of destroying all sins; in that well four seas always dwell.

sn: तत्रोपस्पृश्य राजेन्द्र न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात्। अभिगम्य महादेवं वरदं रुद्रमव्ययम्॥ विराजति यथा सोमो मेधैर्मुक्तो नराधिप। जातिस्मरमुपस्पृश्य शुचिः प्रयतमानसः॥
en: O king of kings, bathing in it, one does not meet with any calamity; going to the giver of boons, the great god, the eternal Rudra, where, O king, he always dwells, one shines like the moon emerged from the clouds. Bathing in Jatismara with subdued mind and with purity.

sn: जातिस्मरत्वमाप्नोति स्नात्वा तत्र न संशयः। माहेश्वरपुरं गत्वा अर्चयित्वा वृषध्वजम्॥ ईप्सिताल्लभते कामानुपवासान्न संशयः। ततस्तु वामनं गत्वा सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्॥ अभिगम्य हरिं देवं न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात। कुशिकास्वाश्रमं गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्॥
en: One obtains without doubt the recollections of his former life by his bath there. Going to Maheshvarpura and worshipping Vrishadhvaja (Shiva). One obtains without doubt the fulfillment of his desire by fasting (in that Tirtha). Then going to Vamana which destroys all sins and going to the deity Hari one never meets with any calamity. Then one should go to the hermitage called Kushika, which is capable of destroying all sins.

sn: कौशिकी तत्र गच्छेत महापापप्रणाशिनीम्। राजसूयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः॥
en: Then going there to Kaushiki which destroys the greatest of sins, a man obtains the fruits of Rajasuya sacrifice.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र चम्पकारण्यमुत्तमम्। तत्रोष्य रजनीमेकां गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent forest called Champaka. Living there for one night one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: अथ ज्येष्ठिमासाद्य तीर्थं परमदुर्लभम्। तत्रोष्य रजनीमेकां गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Then going to the inaccessible Tirtha, called Jyeshthila and living there for one night one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: तत्र विश्वेश्वरं दृष्ट्वा देव्या सह महाद्युतिम्। मित्रावरुणयोर्लोकानाप्नोति पुरुषर्षभ॥ त्रिरात्रोपोषितस्तत्र अग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्।
en: O foremost of men, seeing there the lord of the universe with his goddess of great effulgence, one goes to to the region of Mitravaruna. Fasting there for three nights one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sn: कन्यासंवेद्यमासाद्य नियतो नियताशनः॥ मनोः प्रजापतेर्लोकानाप्नोति पुरुषर्षभ। कन्यायां ये प्रयच्छन्ति दानमण्वपि भारत॥ तदक्षय्यमिति प्राहुर्ऋषयः संशितव्रताः।
en: Going to Kanyasamveda with regulated diet and subdued soul. O foremost of men, one goes to the region of Manu, the lord of creation. O descendant of Bharata, whatever is given away (in charity) at (the Tirtha, named) Kanya, the Rishis of rigid vows say, becomes everlasting.

sn: निश्चीरां च समासाद्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताम्॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति विष्णुलोकं च गच्छति। ये त दानं प्रयच्छन्ति निश्चीरासंगमे नराः॥ ते यान्ति नरशार्दूल शक्रलोकमनामयम्। तत्राश्रमो वसिष्ठस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः॥
en: Going to Nischira which is celebrated all over the three worlds, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice and goes to the region of Vishnu. The man, who gives away in charity at the confluence of Nischira. O foremost of men, goes to the blessed region of Brahma. There is the hermitage of Vasishtha, celebrated all over the world.

sn: तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वाणो वाजपेयमवाप्नुयात्। देवकूटं समासाद्य ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम्॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्।
en: Bathing there one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya sacrifice. Going to Devakuta, frequented by the celestials Rishis, one obtains the fruit of Ashvamedha (sacrifice) and saves his race.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र कौशिकस्य मुनेह्रदम्॥ यत्र सिद्धि परां प्राप्तो विश्वामित्रोऽथ कौशिकः। तत्र मासं वसेद् वीर कौशिक्यां भरतर्षभ॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the lake of the Rishi Kaushika, where in days of yore Kaushika's son Vishvamitra obtained success (in asceticism). O best of the Bharata race, the hero who lives at Kaushika for one month.

sn: अश्वमेधस्य यत् पुण्यं तन्मासेनाधिगच्छति। सर्वतीर्थवरे चैव यो वसेत महाह्रदे॥ न दुर्गतिमवाणोति विन्देद् बहु सुवर्णकम्।
en: Obtains in one month without doubt the virtue which is the fruit of Ashvamedha (sacrifice). He who lives in that foremost of all Tirthas, called Mahahrada. Never meets with any calamity and obtains the fruits of giving away much gold.

sn: कुमारमभिगम्याथ वीराश्रमनिवासिनम्॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति नरो नास्त्यत्र संशयः।
en: Seeing Kumara (Kartikeya) who lives in Virasrama, a man obtains without doubt the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sn: अग्निधारां समासाद्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताम्॥ तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वाणो ह्यग्निष्टोममवाप्नुयात्।
en: Going then to Agnidhara, celebrated all over the three worlds and bathing there, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sn: अधिगम्य महादेवं वरदं विष्णुमव्ययम्॥
en: Going to the great god, the giver of boons, the eternal Vishnu,

sn: पितामहसरो गत्वा शैलराजसमीपतः। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वाणो ह्यग्निष्टोममवाप्नुयात्॥
en: And going to the tank, sacred to the Grandsire (Brahma) (situate) near the king of mountains and bathing there, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sn: पितामहस्य सरसः प्रस्रुता लोकपावनी। कुमारधारा तत्रैव त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता॥
en: Issuing from the Grandsire's tank, that holds the sanctifying (stream) Kumaradhara celebrated all over the three worlds.

sn: यत्र स्नात्वा कृतार्थोऽस्मीत्यात्मानमवगच्छति। षष्ठकालोपवासेन मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया॥
en: And bathing there one considers in his mind that all his desires are fulfilled. Fasting for six days, one is cleansed of the sin of even killing a Brahmana.

sn: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ तीर्थसेवनतत्परः। शिखरं वै महादेव्या गौर्यास्त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्॥
en: O virtuous man, the pilgrim should then go to the peak of the great goddess Gauri, celebrated all over the world.

sn: समारुह्य नरश्रेष्ठ स्तनकुण्डेषु संविशेत्। स्तनकुण्डमुपस्पृश्य वाजपेयफलं लभेत्॥
en: O foremost of men, ascending it one should go to Stanakunda Bathing in Stanakunda, one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice).

sn: तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वाणः पितृदेवार्चने रतः। हयमेधमवाप्नोति शक्रलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Bathing there and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha (sacrifice) and goes to the region of Sakra (Indra).

sn: ताम्रारुणं समासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then going to the well, called Tamraruna, frequented by the celestials, O ruler of men, one obtains the virtue that is the fruit of a mansacrifice.

sn: नन्दिन्यां च समासाद्य कूपं देवनिषेवितम्। नरमेधस्य यत् पुण्यं तदाप्नोति नराधिप॥
en: O best of kings! then going to the well of celestials in the Nandini tirtha, one gets the fruit equal to the Naramedha sacrifice.

sn: कालिकासंगमे स्नात्वा कौशिक्यरुणयोर्गतः। त्रिरात्रोपोषितो राजन् सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: Bathing at the confluence of the Kalika and the Kaushika and the Aruna and fasting there for three nights, a learned man is cleared of all his sins.

sn: उर्वशीतीर्थमासाद्य ततः सोमाश्रमं बुधः। कुम्भकर्णाश्रमं गत्वा पूज्यते भुवि मानवः॥
en: Going to the Tirtha called Urvashi and then to Somasrama and bathing at Kumbhakarnasrama a wise man becomes adored on earth.

sn: कोकामुखमुपस्पृश्य ब्रह्मचारी यतव्रतः। जातिस्मरत्वमाप्नोति दृष्टमेतत् पुरातनैः॥
en: Bathing in Kokamukha with Brahmacharya life and well observed vows, it is seen in the Puranas, one obtains the recollection of his former births.

sn: प्राड्नदीं च समासाद्य कृतात्मा भवति द्विजः। सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा शक्रलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Going to Prangnadi, a twice-born becomes successful in his wishes and his soul being purified and sins being all destroyed he goes to the region of Shakra (Indra).

sn: ऋषभद्वीपमासाद्य मेध्यं क्रौञ्चनिषूदनम्। सरस्वत्यामुपस्पृश्य विमानस्थो विराजते॥
en: Going then to the island called Rishabha and Kraunchanishudana which destroys all sins and bathing in the Sarasvati one blazes forth in heaven.

sn: औद्दालकं महाराज तीर्थं मुनिनिषेवितम्। तत्राभिषेकं कृत्वा वै सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: O great king, bathing then in the Tirtha, called Auddalaka, frequented by the Rishis one is cleansed of all his sins.

sn: धर्मतीर्थं समासाद्य पुण्यं ब्रह्मर्षिसेवितम्। वाजपेयमवाप्नोति विमानस्थश्च पूज्यते॥
en: Going then to the sacred Dharma Tirtha, frequented by the Brahmarshis, one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice) and becomes adored in heaven.

sn: पुलस्त्य उवाच अथ संध्यां समासाद्य संवेद्यं तीर्थमुत्तमम्। उपस्पृश्य नरो विद्यां लभते नात्र संशयः॥
en: Pulastya said : Then going to the excellent Tirtha called Samveda in the evening and bathing there, a man obtains without doubt great learning.

sn: रामस्य च प्रभावेण तीर्थं राजन् कृतं पुरा। तल्लौहित्यं समासाद्य विन्द्याद् बहु सुवर्णकम्॥
en: O king, going then to Tollouhitya, Tirtha created in the days of yore by the prowess of Rama, one obtains the fruits of giving away much gold.

sn: करतोयां समासाद्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति प्रजापतिकृतो विधिः॥
en: Going to the Karatoya and fasting there for three nights, a man obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha, this is the injunction of the lord of creation.

sn: गङ्गायास्तत्र राजेन्द्र सागरस्य च संगमे। अश्वमेधं दशगुणं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: O king of kings, it has been said by the wise men that he who goes to the place where the Ganges has joined the sea, one obtains ten times the merit of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sn: गङ्गायास्त्वपरं पारं प्राप्य यः स्नाति मानवः। त्रिरात्रमुषितो राजन् सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: O king, going to the opposite bank of the Ganges and living there for three nights, one is cleansed of all his sins.

sn: ततो वैतरणी गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रमोचनीम्। विरजं तीर्थमासाद्य विराजति यथा शशी॥
en: Then one should go to Vaitarini, which destroys all sins. Going then to the Tirtha, called Viraja, one shines like the moon.

sn: प्रतरेच्च कुलं पुण्यं सर्वपापं व्यपोहति। गोसहस्रफलं लब्ध्वा पुनाति स्वकुलं नरः॥
en: Sanctifying his own race, he is cleansed of all his sins. Receiving the fruits of giving away one thousand kine, a man sanctifies his race.

sn: शोणस्य ज्योतिरथ्यायाः संगमे नियतः शुचिः। तर्पयित्वा पितृन् देवानग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्॥
en: Living with purity at the confluence of the Shona and the Jyotirathi and offering oblations to the Pitris and the celestials, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sn: शोणस्य नर्मदायाश्च प्रभवे कुरुनन्दन। वंशगुल्म उपस्पृश्य वाजिमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, bathing in Vanshagulma which is the source of the Shona and the Narmada one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sn: ऋषभं तीर्थमासाद्य कोसलायां नराधिप। वाजपेयमवाप्नोति त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः॥ गोसहस्रफलं विन्द्यात् कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्।
en: O ruler of men, going to the Tirtha, called Rishabha in Kosala and fasting there for three nights, a man obtains the fruits of Vajapeya sacrifice. He obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine and saves his race.

sn: कोसलां तु समासाद्य कालतीर्थमुपस्पृशेत्॥ वृषभैकादशफलं लभते नात्र संशयः। पुष्पवत्यामुपस्पृश्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः॥ गोसहस्रफलं लब्ध्वा पुनाति स्वकुलं नृप।
en: Going to Kosala and bathing in the Tirtha called Kala. One obtains without doubt the fruits of giving away eleven bulls. Bathing at Pushpavati and fasting there for three nights, a man, receiving the fruits of giving away one thousand kine, sanctifies his race.

sn: ततो बदरिकातीर्थं स्नात्वा भरतसत्तम॥ दीर्घमायुरवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति।
en: O best of the Bharata race, then bathing in the Tirtha called Badarika, one obtains long life and goes to the celestials region.

sn: अथ चम्पां समासाद्य भागीरथ्यां कृतोदकः॥ दण्डाख्यमभिगम्यैव गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्।
en: Going then to Champa and offering oblations in Bhagirathi and going to Danda Tirtha, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: लपेटिकां ततो गच्छेत् पुण्यां पुण्योपशोभिताम्॥ वाजपेयमवाप्नोति देवैः सर्वैश्च पूज्यते।
en: Then one should go to the sacred Lapetika graced by the presence of the virtuous. One obtains the fruits of Vajapeya sacrifice and becomes adored by the celestials.

sn: ततो महेन्द्रमासाद्य जामदग्न्यनिषेवितम्॥ रामतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा अश्वमेधफलं लभेत्।
en: Then going to Mahendra, frequented by the son of Jamadagni and bathing at the Rama Tirtha, a man obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sn: मतङ्गस्य तु केदारस्तत्रैव कुरुनन्दन॥ तत्र स्नात्वा कुरुश्रेष्ठ गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्।
en: O descendant of Kuru, there is Matanga's Tirtha called Kedara, bathing there one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: श्रीपर्वतं समासाद्य नदीतीरमुपस्पृशेत्॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति पूजयित्वा वृषध्वजम्।
en: Going to the mountain, called Sri, one should bathe in the river. Worshipping Vrishadhvaja, a (Shiva) one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sn: श्रीपर्वते महादेवो देव्या सह महाद्युतिः॥ न्यवसत् परमप्रीतो ब्रह्मा च त्रिदशैः सह। तत्र देवह्रदे स्नात्वा शुचिः प्रयतमानसः॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति परां सिद्धिं च गच्छति। ऋषभं पर्वतं गत्वा पाण्ड्ये दैवतपूजितम्। वाजपेयमवाप्नोति नाकपृष्ठे च मोदते॥
en: The greatly effulgent Mahadeva lives with his wife on the Sri mountain. There dwell also with great pleasure Brahma and the celestials. Then bathing in the Devahrada with purity and subdued mind, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and attains to the highest state. Going to the Rishabha mountain in Pandya adored by the celestials, one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice) and rejoices in heaven.

sn: ततो गच्छेत कावेरी वृतामप्सरसां गणैः। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Then one should go to Kaveri, surrounded by the Apsaras. O king, bathing there a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: ततस्तीरे समुद्रस्य कन्यातीर्थमुपस्पृशेत्। तत्रोपस्पृश्य राजेन्द्र सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: Then one should bathe in the Tirtha called Kanya on the sea coast. O king of kings, bathing there one is cleansed of all his sins.

sn: अथ गोकर्णमासाद्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। समुद्रमध्ये राजेन्द्र सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम्॥ यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः। भूतयक्षपिशाचाश्च किंनराः समहोरगाः॥ सिद्धचारणगन्धर्वमानुषाः पन्नगास्तथा। सरितः सागराः शैला उपासन्त उमापतिम्॥
en: The going to Gokarna, celebrated all over the three worlds and, O king of kings, which is situated in the midst of the ocean and is reverenced by all the worlds. Where Brahma and other celestials, the ascetic Rishis, the Bhutas, the Yakshas, the Kinnaras, the great Nagas, the Siddhas, the Charanas, the Gandharvas, the men, the snakes, the rivers, the seas and the hills, worship the lord of Uma.

sn: तत्रेशानं समभ्यर्च्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति गाणपत्यं च विन्दति॥
en: Worshipping thcre Ishana and fasting for three nights, a man obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice and attains to the state of Ganapatya.

sn: उष्य द्वादशरात्रं तु पूतात्मा च भवेन्नरः। तत एव च गायत्र्याः स्थानं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम्॥
en: Living there for twelve nights a man becomes purified in his soul. Then one should go to the region of Gayatri adored by all the three worlds.

sn: त्रिरात्रमुषितस्तत्र गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्। निदर्शनं च प्रत्यक्षं ब्राह्मणानां नराधिप॥
en: Living there for three nights, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine. O ruler of men, a strange phenomenon as regards Bralumanas is scen there.

sn: गायत्री पठते यस्तु योनिसंकरजस्तथा। गाथा च गाथिका चापि तस्य सम्पद्यते नृप॥
en: O king, if a Brahmana whether born of a Brahmana woman or of a woman of any other caste, recites Gayitri there, his recitation becomes rhythmical and musical.

sn: अब्राह्मणस्य सावित्री पठतस्तु प्रणश्यति। संवर्तस्य तु विप्रर्वापीमासाद्य दुर्लभाम्॥ रूपस्य भागी भवति सुभगश्च प्रजापते।
en: A man who is not a Brahmana cannot properly recite it at all. Going then to the inaccessible tank of the Brahmana Rishi Samvarta, one obtains personal beauty and great prosperity.

sn: ततो वेणां समासाद्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः॥ मयूरहंससंयुक्तं विमानं लभते नरः।
en: Then going to Vena one should offer oblations to the Pitris and the celestials. (By doing this) a man obtains a car drawn by peacocks and cranes.

sn: ततो गोदावरी प्राप्य नित्यं सिद्धनिषेविताम्॥ गवां मेधमवाप्नोति वासुकेर्लोकमुत्तमम्। वेणायाः संगमे स्नात्वा वाजिमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: Then going to the Godavari, always frequented by the Siddhas. One obtains the fruits of a cow-sacrifice and goes to the excellent region of Vasuki. Bathing at the confluence of Vena one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya sacrifice.

sn: वरदासंगमे स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्। ब्रह्मस्थानं समासाद्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः॥ गोसहस्रफलं विन्द्यात् स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति।
en: Bathing at the confluence of Varada one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine. Going to Brahmasthana and living there for three nights a man. Obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine and goes to the celestials region.

sn: कुशप्लवनमासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः॥ त्रिरात्रमुषितः स्नात्वा अश्वमेधफलं लभेत्।
en: Going to Kushaplavana with concentrated mind and with Brahmacharya life. And fasting there for three nights and bathing there, one obtain the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sn: ततो देवह्रदेऽरण्ये कृष्णवेणाजलोद्भवे॥ जातिस्मरहदे स्नात्वा भवेज्जातिस्मरो नरः।
en: Then bathing in the charining Devahrada supplied with water by Krishna Vena. And also bathing in the Jatismarahrada, a man obtains the recollection of his former births.

sn: यत्र क्रतुशतैरिष्ट्वा देवराजो दिवं गतः॥ अग्निष्टोमफलं विन्द्याद् गमनादेव भारत। सर्वदेवह्रदे स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Here the king of the celestials performed one hundred sacrifices and went to heaven. O descendant of Bharata, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma by simply going here. Bathing in the Sarvadevahrada, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: ततो वापी महापुण्यां पयोष्णीं सरितां वराम्। पितृदेवार्चनरतो गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Then going to that best of water, that lake, called Payoshni and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: दण्डकारण्यमासाद्य पुण्यं राजन्नुपस्पृशेत्। गोसहस्रफलं तस्य स्नातमात्रस्य भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, O king going to the sacred Dandakas forest, one should bathe there. One obtains the fruits of giving away (in charity) as soon as one bathes there.

sn: शरभङ्गाश्रमं गत्वा शुकस्य च महात्मनः। न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति पुनाति च कुलं नरः॥
en: Going to the hermitage called Sharbhanga of the high-souled Shukra, a man never meets with any calamity and sanctifies his race.

sn: ततः शूर्पारकं गच्छेज्जामदग्न्यनिषेवितम्। रामतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा विन्द्याद् बहुसुवर्णकम्॥
en: Then one should go to Surparka frequented by the son of Jamadagni. Then bathing in that Rama-Tirtha a man obtains the fruits of giving away much gold.

sn: सप्तगोदावरे स्नात्वा नियतो नियताशनः। महत् पुण्यमवाप्नोति देवलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Bathing in the Sapta Godavari with regulated diet and subdued soul, one obtains great virtue and goes to the celestials region.

sn: ततो देवपथं गत्वा नियतो नियताशनः। देवसत्रस्य यत् पुण्यं तदेवाप्नोति मानवः॥
en: Then going to the Devapatha with regulated diet and subdued soul, a man obtains the merit that is the fruit of Deva sacrifice.

sn: तुङ्गकारण्यमासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः। वेदानध्यापयत् तत्र ऋषिः सारस्वतः पुरा॥
en: Going to Tungakaranya with passions under control and with Brahmacharya life, where in the days of yore, Rishi Sarasvta taught the Vedas to the ascetics.

sn: तत्र वेदेषु नष्टेषु मुनेरङ्गिरसः सुतः। ऋषीणामुत्तरीयेषु सूपविष्टो यथासुखम्॥
en: There when the Vedas were lost, the son of Rishi Angirasa, sitting comfortably on the upper garments of the Rishis.

sn: ओङ्कारेण यथान्यायं सम्यगुच्चारितेन ह। येन यत् पूर्वमभ्यस्तं तत् सर्वं समुपस्थितम्॥
en: Pronounced distinctly and with emphasis the word Om. At this, the ascetics again recollected all that they had learnt before.

sn: ऋषयस्तत्र देवाश्च वरुणोऽग्निः प्रजापतिः। हरिर्नारायणस्तत्र महादेवस्तथैव च।॥
en: There the Rishis, the Devas, Varuna, Agni, Prajapati, Hari, Narayana and also Mahadeva.

sn: पितामहश्च भगवान् देवैः सह महाद्युतिः। भृगु नियोजयामास याजनार्थे महाद्युतिम्॥
en: And the exalted and the greatly effulgent Grandsire, with the celestials appointed the greatly effulgent Bhrigu to perform their sacrifice.

sn: ततः स चक्रे भगवानृषीणां विधिवत् तदा। सर्वेषां पुनराधानं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥ आज्यभागेन तत्राग्नि तर्पयित्वा यथाविधि। देवाः स्वभवनं याता ऋषयश्च यथाक्रमम्॥ तदरण्यं प्रविष्टस्य तुङ्गकं राजसत्तम्। पापं प्रणश्यत्यखिलं स्त्रियो वा पुरुषस्य वा॥
en: Gratifying Agni with libations of ghee poured according to the ordinance, the highsouled Bhrigu once more performed the Agnidhyana sacrifice for all those Rishis. After which both they and the celestials went away to their respective homes one after another. O foremost of kings, he who enters the forest of Tungaka, whether male or female, is cleansed of all his sins.

sn: तत्र मासं वसेद्धीरो नियतो नियताशन:। ब्रह्मलोकं व्रजेद् राजन् कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥
en: O hero, there in that Tirtha one should live for a month with regulated diet and subdued soul.

sn: मेधाविकं समासाद्य पितृन् देवांश्च तर्पयेत्। अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति स्मृति मेधां च विन्दति॥
en: Going then to Medhavika, one should offer oblations to the Pitris and the celestials. By doing this, obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma (sacrifices) and also obtains memory and intellect.

sn: अत्र कालञ्जरं नाम पर्वतं लोकविश्रुतम्। तत्र देवह्रदे स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: There in that Tirtha is the celebrated mountain called Kalanjara. Bathing in the celestials lake there, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: योः स्नातः साधयेत् तत्र गिरौ कालञ्जरे नृप। स्वर्गलोके महीयेत नरो नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: O king, he who after a bath offers there oblations to the Pitris and the celestials is without doubt adored in heaven.

sn: ततो गिरिवरश्रेष्ठे चित्रकूटे विशाम्पते। मन्दाकिनी समासाद्य सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम्॥ तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वाणः पितृदेवार्चने रतः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति गतिं च परमां व्रजेत्॥
en: O king, going then to the river Mandakini which destroys sins and which is on that best of mountain called Chitrakuta, he who bathes there and worships the Pitris and the celestials obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and attains to the best state.

sn: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ भर्तृस्थानमनुत्तमम्। यत्र नित्यं महासेनो गुहः संनिहितो नृप॥
en: O virtuous man, one should then go to the excellent Bhartristhana where, O king, heaven's generalissimo always lives.

sn: तत्र गत्वा नृपश्रेष्ठ गमनादेव सिध्यति। कोटितीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: O best of kings, only going there one obtains success. Bathing in the Koti Tirtha, a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sn: प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य ज्येष्ठस्थानं व्रजेन्नरः। अभिगम्य महादेवं विराजति यथा शशी॥
en: After walking round it a man should then to go Jyeshtasthana. Seeing Mahadeva there, one looks like the moon.

sn: तत्र कूपे महाराज विश्रुता भरतर्षभ। समुद्रास्तत्र चत्वारो निवसन्ति युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O great king, ever steady in war O best of the Bharata race, O Yudhishthira, there is a celebrated well, in which four seas exist.

sn: तत्रोपस्पृश्य राजेन्द्र पितृदेवार्चने रतः। नियतात्मा नरः पूतो गच्छेत परमां गतिम्॥
en: O king of kings, bathing there and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials with subdued soul, one being purified, obtains the highest state.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र शृङ्गवेरपुरं महत्। यत्र तीर्णो महाराज रामो दाशरथिः पुरा॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the great Sringapur where, O great king, Dasharatha's son Rama formerly crossed (the Ganges).

sn: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महाबाहो स्नात्वा पापैः प्रमुच्यते। गङ्गायां तु नरः स्नात्वा ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः॥ विधूतपाप्मा भवति वाजपेयं च विन्दति।
en: O mighty-armed hero, bathing in that Tirtha one is cleansed of his sins. Bathing in the Ganges with concentrated mind and with Brahmacharya life. One is cleansed of all his sins and obtains the fruits of Vajapeya sacrifice.

sn: ततो मुञ्जवटं गच्छेत् स्थानं देवस्यधीमतः॥ अभिगम्य महादेवमभिवाद्य च भारत। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्॥ तस्मिस्तीर्थे तु जाह्नव्यां स्नात्वा पापैः प्रमुच्यते।
en: Then one should go to Munjavata, the region of the intelligent deity (Shiva). O descendant of Bharata, seeing there Mahadeva and worshipping him and also walking round it, one attains to the state of Ganapatya. Bathing in that Tirtha in the Janhavi, one is cleansed of all his sins.

sn: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र प्रयागमृषिसंस्तुतम्॥ तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा दिशश्च सदिगीश्वराः। लोकपालाश्च साध्याश्च पितरो लोकसम्मताः॥ सनत्कुमारप्रमुखास्तथैव परमर्षयः। अङ्गिरःप्रमुखाश्चैव तथा ब्रह्मर्षयोऽमलाः॥ तथा नागाः सुपर्णाश्च सिद्धाश्चक्रचरास्तथा। सरितः सागराश्चैव गन्धर्वाप्सरसोऽपि च॥ हरिश्च भगवानास्ते प्रजापतिपुरस्कृतः। तत्र त्रीण्यग्निकुण्डानि येषां मध्येन जाह्नवी॥ वेगेन समतिक्रान्ता सर्वतीर्थपुरस्कृता। तपनस्य सुता देवी त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता॥ यमुना गड्या साधू संगता लोकपावनी। गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्यं पृथिव्या जघनं स्मृतम्॥
en: Then, O king of kings, one should go to Prayaga which is highly praised by the Rishis. Here live Brahma and other celestials, the quarters with their presiding deities, the Lokapalas, the Saddhyas, the Pitris adored by the world, the grcat Rishis, Sanatkumar and others, the stainless Brahmarshis, Angiras and others, the Nagas, the Suparnas, the Siddhas, the snakes, the rivers, the seas, the Gandharvas, the Apsaras and the exalted Hari with the lord of creatures (Brahma) in front. There are three fiery caverns between which Janhavi, the foremost of Tirthas, rolls rapidly onward. The daughter of Tapana, celebrated all over the three worlds, the world purifying Yamuna unites here with the Ganges. The country between the Ganges and the Yamuna is considered as the Jaghana of the earth.
