sn: विगाह्य तत् परानीकं गजवाजिरथाकुलम्। शस्त्रप्रतापनिर्वीर्यान् कुरूढिीत्वाऽऽनये पशून्॥
en: Entering into the hostile army filled with elephants, horses and chariots and defeating the Kurus who are weak in power and weapons I shall bring back the animals.

sn: दुर्योधनं शान्तनवं कर्णं वैकर्तनं कृपम्। द्रोणं च सह पुत्रेण महेष्वासान् समागतान्॥ वित्रासयित्वा संग्रामे दानवानिव वज्रभृत्। अनेनैव मुहूर्तेन पुनः प्रत्यानये पशून्॥
en: Having struck terror into Duryodhana, the son of Shantanu, (Bhishma) Vikartana's son (Kripa), Karna, Drona with his son and other powerful bowmen assembled there, like the wielder of thunderbolt afflicting the Danavas I shall this very moment bring back the kine.

sn: शून्यमासाद्य कुरवः प्रयान्त्यादाय गोधनम्। किं नु शक्यं मया कर्तुं यदहं तत्र नाभवम्॥
en: Finding none the Kurus are taking away the precious kine; what can I do when I am not there?

sn: पश्येयुरद्य मे वीर्यं कुरवस्ते समागताः। किं नु पार्थोऽर्जुन: साक्षादयमस्मान् प्रबाधते॥
en: The assembled Kurus shall see today my prowess: (and they shall say). “Is it Arjuna's self who is contending us?”

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा तदर्जुनो वाक्यं राज्ञः पुत्रस्य भाषतः। अतीतसमये काले प्रियां भार्यामनिन्दिताम्॥ दुपदस्य सुतां तन्वीं पाञ्चालीं पावकात्मजाम्। सत्यार्जवगुणोपेतां भर्तुः प्रियहिते रताम्॥ उवाच रहसि प्रीतः कृष्णां सर्वार्थकोविदः। उत्तरं ब्रूहि कल्याणि क्षिप्रं मद्वचनादिदम्॥ अयं वै पाण्डवस्यासीत् सारथिः सम्मतो दृढः। महायुद्धेषु संसिद्धः स ते यन्ता भविष्यति॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing the words of the Prince, Arjuna, informed of all, after some time delightedly spoke in private to his beloved and faultless wife Krishna the princess of Panchala, the slender-made daughter of Drupada, born of sacrifice, gifted with the virtues of truthfulness and honesty and ever devoted to the well-being of her husband. "O auspicious lady, speak quickly to Uttara, at my request, that this (Brihannala) was formerly the firm and approved charioteer of Pandu's son (Arjuna); experienced in very many great battles he shall be your charioteer.”

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्य तद् वचनं स्त्रीषु भाषतश्च पुनः पुनः। न सामर्षत पाञ्चाली बीभत्सोः पकिकीर्तनम्॥
en: Hearing him speak again and again thus to women Panchali could not bear his reference to Arjuna.

sn: अथैनमुपसंगम्य स्त्रीमध्यात् सा तपस्विनी। व्रीडमानेव शनकैरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then stepping out from the midst of the women, the poor (princess) bashfully and gently gave vent to the following words.

sn: योऽसौ बृहद्वारणाभो युवा सुप्रियदर्शनः। बृहन्नलेति विख्यातः पार्थस्यासीत् स सारथिः॥
en: "This greatly beautiful youth resembling a huge elephant and known under the name Brihannala was the charioteer of Partha.

sn: धनुष्यनवरचासीत् तस्य शिष्यो महात्मनः। दृष्टपूर्वो मया वीर चरन्त्या पाण्डवान् प्रति॥
en: A mighty bowman he was the disciple of the high-souled (Arjuna); O hero, I saw him before while I was living with the Pandavas.

sn: यदा तत् पावको दावमदहत् खाण्डवं महत्। अर्जुनस्य तदानेन संगृहीता हयोत्तमाः॥
en: While the fire consumed the forest of Khandava it was he who governed the excellent steeds of Arjuna.

sn: तेन सारथिना पार्थः सर्वभूतानि सर्वशः। अजयत् खाण्डवप्रस्थे न हि यन्तास्ति तादृशः॥
en: Having him as his charioteer Partha vanquished all creatures at Khandavaprastha; indeed there is no charioteer like him.

sn: उत्तर उवाच सैरन्ध्र जानासि तथा युवानं नपुंसको नैव भवेद् यथासौ। अहं न शक्नोमि बृहन्नला शुभे वक्तुं स्वयं यच्छ हयान् ममेति वै॥
en: Uttara said You know this youth, O Sairandhri whether he is of neuter sex or otherwise; O fair lady, I shall not be able myself to request him to govern my horses.

sn: द्रौपद्युवाच येयं कुमारी सुश्रोणी भगिनी ते यवीयसी। अस्याः स वीर वचनं करिष्यति न संशयः॥
en: Draupadi said O hero, he shall, forsooth, satisfy the words of your younger sister, a maiden of beautiful hips.

sn: यदि वै सारथिः स स्यात् कुरून् सर्वान् न संशयः। जित्वा गाश्च समादाय ध्रुवमागमनं भवेत्॥
en: If he becomes your charioteer, you will undoubtedly come back with kine having vanquished the Kurus.

sn: एवमुक्तः स सैरन्ध्या भगिनीं प्रत्यभाषत। गच्छ त्वमनवद्याङ्गि तामानय बृहन्नलाम्॥
en: Accosted thus by Sairandhri he said to his sister: "O fair (sister), go and bring Brihannala.”

sn: सा भ्रात्रा प्रेषिता शीघ्रमगच्छन्नर्तनागृहम्। यत्रास्ते स महाबाहुश्छन्नः सत्रेण पाण्डवः॥
en: Sent by her brother she quickly went to the dancing hall where that mighty-armed son of Pandu was waiting in disguise.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच सा प्राद्रवत् काञ्चनमाल्यधारिणी ज्येष्ठेन भ्रात्रा प्रहिता यशस्विनी। सुदक्षिणा वेदिविलग्नमध्या सा पद्मपत्राभनिभा शिखण्डिनी॥ तन्वी शुभाङ्गी मणिचित्रमेखला मत्स्यस्य राज्ञो दुहिता श्रिया वृता। तन्नर्तनागारमरालपक्षमा शतह्रदा मेघमिवान्वपद्यत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Dispatched by her elder brother, the illustrious daughter of the king of Matsya's, wearing a golden necklace, ever obedient, having a waist slender like that of a wasp, beautiful like Lakshmi, adorned with the plumes of a peacock, of a slender make, beautiful limbs, wearing a zone of pearls, graceful, having slightly curved eye-lashes, speedily went to the dancing-hall like a flash of lightning towards of clouds.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: सा हस्तिहस्तोपमसंहितोरूः स्वनिन्दिता चारुदती सुमध्यमा। आसाद्य तं वै वरमाल्यधारिणी पार्थं शुभा नागवधूरिव द्विपम्॥
en: That blameless, youthful (daughter of Virata) having beautiful teeth, and thighs close like the trunk of an elephant and wearing an excellent garland, she sought for Partha like a she-elephant seeking an elephant.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: सा रत्नभूता मनसः प्रियार्चिता सुता विराटस्य यथेन्द्रलक्ष्मीः। सुदर्शनीया प्रमुखे यशस्विनी प्रीत्याब्रवीदर्जुनमायतेक्षणा॥
en: That beautiful and illustrious daughter having large eyes, like a precious jem, or the prosperity of Indra, delightedly said to Arjuna.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: सुसंहतोरुं कनकोज्ज्वलत्वचं पार्थः कुमारी स तदाभ्यभाषत। किमागमः काञ्चनमाल्यधारिणी मृगाक्षि किं त्वं त्वरितेव भामिनि।। माचक्ष्व तत्त्वं मम शीघ्रमङ्गने॥
en: Partha asked the Princess of close thighs and golden hue saying: "Why have you come here, O you wearing a golden garland? Why are you in a hurry, O you having the eyes of a deer? O fair lady, why your face is so cheerless? Tell me all this quickly.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच स तां दृष्ट्वा विशालाक्षीं राजपुत्री सखीं तथा। प्रहसन्नब्रवीद राजन् किमागमनमित्युत॥
en: Beholding his friend the princess of expansive eyes in that condition, her friend (Arjuna) o king, smilingly asked her of the cause of coming.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: तमब्रवीद् राजयुत्री समुपेत्य नरर्षभम्। प्रणयं भावयन्ती सा सखीमध्य इदं वचः॥
en: Then approaching that best of men, that princess, bending low with humility addressed to him (the following) words in the midst of her companions.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: गावो राष्ट्रस्य कुरुभिः काल्यन्ते नो बृहन्नले। ता विजेतुं मम भ्राता प्रयास्यति धनुर्धरः॥
en: O Brihannala, the kine of this kingdom are being carried away by the Kurus; my brother is about to start for their discomfiture, with bow in hand.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: नाचिरं निहतस्तस्य संग्रामे रथसारथिः। तेन नास्ति समः सूतो योऽस्य सारथ्यमाचरेत्॥
en: Very recently the charioteer of his car was slain in battle; there is none equal to him who can act as his (my brother's) charioteer.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: तस्मै प्रयतमानाय सारथ्यर्थं बृहन्नले। आचचक्षे हयज्ञाने सैरन्ध्री कौशलं तव॥
en: O Brihannala, while he was trying to find out a charioteer, Sairandhri spoke to him about your skill in the management of horses.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: अर्जुनस्य किलासीस्त्वं सारथिर्दयितः पुरा। त्वयाजयत् सहायेन पृथिवीं पाण्डवर्षभः॥
en: Formerly you were the favourite charioteer of Arjuna and with you as his help that foremost of Pandavas conquered the earth; O good Brihannala, act (therefore) as the charioteer of my brother.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: सा सारथ्यं मम भ्रातुः कुरु साधु बृहन्नले। पुरा दूरतरं गावो ह्रियन्ते कुरुभिर्हि नः॥
en: Our kine (by this time) have been taken away to a greater distance by the Kurus. If you do not comply with my words as requested.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: अथैतद् वचनं मेऽद्य नियुक्ता न करिष्यसि। प्रणयादुच्यमाना त्वं परित्यक्ष्यामि जीवितम्॥
en: I, who have asked you for this, shall give up my life. Being thus accosted by his friend of fair hips, that slayer of foes,

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: एवमुक्तस्तु सुश्रोण्या तया सख्या परंतपः। जगाम राजपुत्रस्य सकाशममितौजसः॥ तमाव्रजन्तं त्वरितं प्राभन्नमिव कुवारम्। अन्वगच्छद् विशालक्षी गजं गजवधूरिव॥
en: Of incomparable energy went to the prince. The large eyed (princess) followed him who was proceeding quickly like an elephant in rut as a she-elephant runs after its young one. Seeing him from a distance the prince said.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: दूरादेव तु तां प्रेक्ष्य राजपुत्रोऽभ्यभाषत। त्वया सारथिना पार्थः खाण्डवेऽग्निमतर्पयत॥
en: Having got you as his charioteer, Kunti's son Partha, the conqueror of the god of riches, offered oblation to Khandava fire and completely subjugated the world.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: पृथिवीमजयत् कृत्स्नां कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। सैरन्ध्री त्वां समाचष्टे सा हि जानाति पाण्डवान्।।१७।
en: Sairandhri spoke of you to me; she knows the Pandavas; O Brihannala, govern in the same way, my horses,

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: संयच्छ मामकानश्वांस्तथैव त्वं बृहन्नले। कुरुभिर्योत्स्यमानस्य गोधनानि परीप्सतः॥
en: Who am desirous of fighting with the Kurus and rescuing the precious kine. You were formerly the favourite charioteer of Arjuna.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: अर्जुनस्य किलासीस्त्वं सारथिर्दयित: पुरा। त्वयाजयत् सहायेन पृथिवीं पाण्डवर्षभः॥
en: By your help, that foremost of the Pandavas conquered the world. Brihannala replied to the prince who had said this.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: एवमुक्ता प्रत्युवाच राजपुत्रं बृहन्नला। का शक्तिर्मम सारथ्यं कर्तुं संग्राममूर्धनि॥ गीतं वा यदि वा नृत्यं वादिनं वा पृथग्विधम्। तत् करिष्यामि भद्रं ते सारथ्यं तु कुतो मम॥
en: (Saying): “What power have I that I can act as your charioteer in the field of battle. If it were singing, dancing, musical instruments or any other similar thing I could have entertained you. But how can I work as a charioteer?”

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच बृहन्नले गायनो वा नर्तनो वा पुनर्भव। क्षिप्रं मे रथमास्थाय निगृह्णीष्व हयोत्तमान्॥
en: Uttara said O Brihannala, a singer or a dancer, whatever you may be, quickly ascend my chariot and restrain the best of horses.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच स तत्र नर्मसंयुक्तमकरोत् पाण्डवो बहु। उत्तरायाः प्रमुखतः सर्वं जाननरिंदमः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Although knowing everything, that slayer of foes, the son of Pandu, as if to make a fun, committed many mistakes before Uttara.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: ऊर्ध्वमुत्क्षिप्य कवचं शरीरे प्रत्यमुञ्चत। कुमार्यस्तत्र तं दृष्ट्वा प्राहसन् पृथुलोचनाः॥
en: And while by raising it upwards he tried to put the coat of mail on his body, the large-eyed maidens, seeing it, began to laugh.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: स तु दृष्ट्वा विमुह्यन्तं स्वयमेवोत्तरस्ततः। कवचेन महार्हेण समनह्यद् बृहन्नलाम्॥
en: Beholding him bewildered Uttara himself dressed Brihannala with a highly precious coat of mail.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: स बिभ्रत् कवचं चाइयं स्वयमप्यंशुमत्प्रभम्। ध्वजं च सिंहमुच्छ्रिस्य सारथ्ये समकल्पयत्॥
en: Himself putting on an armour effulgent like the sun and hoisting the lion flag he appointed him (Brihannala, as his charioteer).

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: धनूंषि च महार्हाणि बाणांश्च रुचिरान् बहून्। आदाय प्रययौ वीरः स बृहन्नलसारथिः॥
en: With Brihannala as his charioteer and taking many costly bows and beautiful arrows the hero issued out.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: अथोत्तरा च कन्याश्च सख्यस्तामब्रुवंस्तदा। बृहन्नले आनयेथा वासांसि रुचिराणि च॥ पाञ्चालिकार्थं चित्राणि सूक्ष्माणि च मृदूनि च। विजित्य संग्रामगतान् भीष्मद्रोणमुखान् कुरून्॥
en: His friend Uttara and other maidens then said:-"O Brihannala, bring for our dolls fine, beautiful and soft cloths of various kinds (when you will come back) after defeating the Kurus in battle headed by Bhishma and Drona.”

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: एवं ता ब्रुवतीः कन्याः सहिताः पाण्डुनन्दनः। प्रत्युवाच हसन् पार्थो मेघदुन्दुभिनि:स्वनः॥
en: The maidens thus speaking, Partha, the son of Pandu, smilingly replied in words deep as the muttering of clouds.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: बृहन्नलोवाच यद्युत्तरोऽयं संग्रामे विजेष्यति महारथान्। अथाहरिष्ये वासांसि दिव्यानि रुचिराणि च।॥
en: Brihannala said If Uttara can defeat those mighty carwarriors I shall bring many beautiful clothes for you.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु बीभत्सुस्ततः प्राचोदयद्धयान्। कुरूनभिमुखः शूरो नानाध्वजपताकिनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this the heroic Arjuna drove the horses towards the Kuru army over which were flowing many flags.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: तमुत्तरं वीक्ष्य रथोत्तरे स्थितं बृहन्नलायाः सहितं महाभुजम्। स्त्रियश्च कन्याश्च द्विजाश्च सुव्रताः प्रदक्षिणं चक्रुरथोचुरङ्गनाः॥
en: Beholding the mighty-armed Uttara seated on the excellent car along with Brihannala, the females, the maidens and the Brahmanas of hard vows, went round the car.

description: The going out of Uttara in Goharana
sn: यदर्जुनस्यर्षभतुल्यगामिनः पुराभवत् खाण्डवदाहमङ्गलम्। कुरून् समासाद्य रणे बृहन्नले सहोत्तरेणाद्य तदस्तु मङ्गलम्॥
en: "(They said) 0 Brihannala, may that victory, which Arjuna, walking like a bull obtained in the days of yore at the time of the burning of the forest of Khandava, come to you today when you shall with Uttara meet the Kurus.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच स राजधान्या निर्याय वैराटिरकुतोभयः। प्रयाहीत्यब्रवीत् सूतं यत्र ते कुरवो गताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having come out of the metropolis the brave son of Virata said to his charioteer:-"Go where the Kurus are."

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: समवेताम् कुरून् सर्वाढिागीषूनवजित्य वै। गास्तेषां क्षिप्रमादाय पुनरेष्याम्यहं पुरम्॥
en: Having vanquished all the Kurus who have come here for victory and quickly rescued the kine I shall come back to the city of Virata.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: ततस्तांश्चोदयामास सदश्वान् पाण्डुनन्दनः। ते हया नरसिंहेन नोदिता वातरंहसः। आलिखन्त इवाकाशमूहः काञ्चनमालिनः॥
en: Thereupon the son of Pandu urged on the beautiful horses. Being urged on by that foremost of men, those horses, endued with the velocity of wind.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: नातिदूरमथो गत्वा मत्स्यपुत्रधनंजयौ। अवेक्षताममित्रघ्नौ कुरूणां बलिनां बलम्॥
en: Adorned with gold necklaces, seemed to run through the sky. And not going very far, the son of Matsya and Dhananjaya.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: श्मशानमभितो गत्वा आससाद कुरूनथ। तां शमीमन्ववीक्षेतां व्यढानीकांश्च सर्वशः॥
en: Those two repressors of enemies espied the army of the powerful Kurus. And going towards the cremation ground they reached the Kurus.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: तदनीकं महत् तेषां विबभौ सागरोपमम्। सर्पमाणमिवाकाशे वनं बहुलपादपम्॥
en: And they saw their army arranged in battle array. That huge army appeared like an ocean.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: ददृशे पार्थिवो रेणुर्जनितस्तेन सर्पता। दृष्टिप्रणाशो भूतानां दिवस्पृक् कुरुसत्तम॥
en: Or like a forest full of many trees moving through the sky. Then was seen the dust of the earth raise by the moving army.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: तदनीकं महद् दृष्ट्वा गजाश्वरथसंकुलम्। कर्णदुर्योधनकृपैर्गुप्तं शान्तनवेन च॥
en: Which destroyed the vision of creatures and touched the sky, O best of Kurus. Then beholding that huge army abounding in elephants, horses and chariots.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: द्रोणेन च सपुत्रेण महेष्वासेन धीमता। हृष्टरोमा भयोद्विग्नः पार्थं वैराटिरब्रवीत्॥
en: And protected by Karna, Duryodhana, Bhishma, the highly intelligent and great bowman Drona with his son, Virata's son, worked up with fear and having hairs erect, said to Partha.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच नोत्सहे कुरुभिर्योद्धं रोमहर्षं हि पश्य मे। बहुप्रवीरमत्युग्रं देवैरपि दुरासदम्॥ प्रतियोद्धं न शक्ष्यामि कुरुसैन्यमनन्तकम्। नाशंसे भारती सेनां प्रवेष्टुं भीमकार्मुकम्॥ रथनागाश्वकलिलां पत्तिध्वजसमाकुलाम्। दृष्ट्वैव हि परानाजौ मनः प्रव्यथतीव मे॥
en: Uttara said I dare not fight with the Kurus: see the hairs of my body have stood erect. I am unable to fight with the vast Kuru army, consisting of many irrepressible heroes and hard to be vanquished even by the celestials. I dare not enter into the army of the Bharatas consisting of the dreadful bowmen, horses, elephants, chariots infantry and flags. My mind is pained at the view of the enemy in the battle-field.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: यत्र द्रोणच भीष्मश्च कृपः कर्णो विविंशतिः। अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सोमदत्तश्च बा िकः॥
en: Where (stand) Drona, Bhishma, Karna, Kripa, Vivinshati, Ashvatthama, Vikarana, Somadatta, Balhika.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: दुर्योधनस्तथा वीरो राजा च रथिनां वरः। द्युतिमन्तो महेष्वासाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः॥
en: The heroic king Duryodhana, the foremost of car-warriors and other effulgent, great bowmen, all skilled in warfare.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: दृष्ट्वैव हि कुरूनेतान् व्यूढानीकान् प्रहारिणः। हृषितानि च रोमाणि कश्मलं चागतं मम॥
en: Beholding these Kurus, expert in fight, arrayed in battle order I am beside myself with fear and my hairs have stood erect.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच अविजातो विजातस्य मौाद् धूर्तस्य पश्यतः। परिदेवयते मन्दः सकाशे सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said The coward and foolish Uttara began to bewail out of foolishness before Savyasachin who was high-spirited and disguised. Uttara said

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: त्रिगर्तान् मे पिता यातः शून्ये सम्प्रणिधाय माम्। सर्वां सेनामुपादाय न मे सन्तीह सैनिकाः॥
en: My sire has gone out to fight with Trigartas taking the entire army with him and leaving me alone in the empty city there are no soldiers for me.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: सोऽहमेको बहून् बालः कृतास्त्रानकृतश्रमः। प्रतियोद्धुं न शक्ष्यामि निवर्तस्व बृहन्नले॥
en: Single-handed and a mere stripling as I am I have not toiled much over the use of arms. I am not capable of fighting with all these skilled in arms; desist therefore, O Brihannala.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: बृहन्नलोवाच भयेन दीनरूपोऽसि द्विषतां हर्षवर्धनः। न च तावत् कृतं कर्म परैः किंचिद् रणाजिरे॥
en: Brihannala said You are pale with fear; why do you increase the delight of your enemies? Even now you have done nothing with your enemies in the field of action.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: स्वयमेव च मामात्य वह मां कौरवान् प्रति। सोऽहं त्वां तत्र नेष्यामि यत्रैते बहुला ध्वजाः॥
en: You yourself told me "Take me to the Kauravas” and I shall take you there where there are many flags.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: मध्यमामिषगृध्राणां कुरूणामाततायिनाम्। नेष्यामि त्वां महाबाहो पृथिव्यामपि युध्यताम्॥
en: 0 you having large arms, I shall take you to the Kurus ready to fight (for kine) like hawks for meat, (even) if they are prepared to fight for the earth.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: तथा स्त्रीषु प्रतिश्रुत्य पौरुषं पुरुषेषु च। कत्थमानोऽभिनिर्याय किमर्थं न युयुत्ससे॥
en: Vaunting of your manliness while starting before men and women, why do you not desire to fight?

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: न चेद् विजित्य गास्तास्त्वं गृहान् वै प्रतियास्यसि। प्रहसिष्यन्ति वीरास्त्वां नरा नार्यश्च संगताः॥
en: If you, without defeating them and taking back your kine, return home, all men and women, O hero, when they will meet, will laugh at you.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: अहमप्यत्र सैरन्ध्या ख्याता सारथ्यकर्मणि। न च शक्ष्याम्यनिर्जित्य गाः प्रयातुं पुरं प्रति॥
en: As for me I had been highly spoken of by Sairandhri for my skill as a charioteer. I shall not therefore be able to return to the city without taking the kine. correction compelete

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: स्तोत्रेण चैव सैरन्ध्यास्तव वाक्येन तेन च। कथं न युध्येयमहं कुरून् सर्वान् स्थिरो भव॥
en: For Sairandhri's eulogy, and your words (I have come here); why should I not therefore fight with the Kurus; be quiet.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच कामं हरन्तु मत्स्यानां भूयांसः कुरवो धनम्। प्रहसन्तु च मां नार्यो नरा वापि बृहन्नले॥
en: Uttara said Let the Kurus take away the profuse riches of the Matsya's a they like; let men and women laugh at me, O Brihannala.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: संग्रामे न च कार्यं मे गावो गच्छन्तु चापि मे। शून्यं मे नगरं चापि पितुश्चैव बिभेग्यहम्॥
en: Let the kine go any where, let my city be desolate, let me fear my father, but I shall not enter into battle.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा प्राद्रवत् भीतो रथात् प्रस्कन्ध कुण्डली। त्यक्त्वा मानं च दर्षं च विसृज्य सशरं धनुः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Saying this, that one, adorned with earrings, got down from the chariot, and leaving behind, in fear, his bow and arrows fled away at the sacrifice of his honour and pride.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: बृहन्नलोवाच नैष शूरैः स्मृतो धर्मः क्षत्रियस्य पलायनम्। श्रेयस्तु मरणं युद्धे न भीतस्य पलायनम्॥
en: Brihannala said To fly is not the practice of the brave and the Kshatriyas; death in battle is preferable to flight in fear.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु कौन्तेयः सोऽवप्लुत्य रथोत्तमात्। तमन्वधावद् धावन्तं राजपुत्रं धनंजयः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Saying this Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti, coming down from the excellent car, pursued the prince who was thus running away.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: दीर्घा वेणी विधुन्वानः साधु रक्ते च वाससी। विधूय वेणी धावन्तमजानन्तोऽर्जुनं तदा॥ सैनिकाः प्राहसन् केचित् तथारूपमवेक्ष्य तम्। तं शीघ्रमभिधावन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य कुरवोऽब्रुवन्॥
en: His long braid of hair and pure white garments were fluttering in the air. Not knowing that Arjuna was running with his long braid of hair flowing and seeing him some soldiers burst out into laughter. And seeing him thus run quickly the Kurus said.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: क एष वेषसंच्छन्नो भस्मन्येव हुताशनः । किंचिदस्य यथा पुंसः किंचिदस्य यथा स्त्रियः॥
en: Who is this man who is concealed like fire in ashes. He is partly a man and partly a woman.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: सारूप्यमर्जुनस्येव क्लीपरूपं बिभर्ति च। तदेवैतच्छिरो ग्रीवं तौ बाहू परिघोपमौ। तद्वदेवास्य विक्रान्तं नायमन्यो धनंजयात्॥
en: Although assuming a neuter form he appears like Arjuna. His is the same, head, same neck, and are the same arms resembling maces.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: अमरेष्विव देवेन्द्रो मानुषेषु धनंजयः। एकः कोऽस्मानुपायायादन्यो लोके धनंजयात्॥
en: His movement is also like his; he cannot be but Dhananjaya. As Indra is amongst the immurtals so is Dhananjaya amongst men.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: एकः पुत्रो विराटस्य शून्ये संनिहितः पुरे। स एष किल निर्यातो बालभावान्न पौरुषात्॥
en: Excepting Dhananjaya who, in this world, alone can come to fight with us? Only one son of Virata has been left in the empty city.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: सत्रेण नूनं छन्नं हि चरन्तं पार्थमर्जुनम्। उत्तर: सारथिं नगराद् बहिः॥ स नो मन्यामहे दृष्ट्वा भीत एष पलायते। तं नूनमेष धावन्तं जिघृक्षति धनंजयः॥
en: He has come out of childishness and not of heroism. Uttara must have issued out of the city making Arjuna the son of Pritha his charioteer who is living in disguise. It appears to us that he, seeing us, is flying away in fear. And forsooth Dhananjaya is following him to bring him back.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच इति स्म कुरवः सर्वे विमृशन्तः पृथक् पृथक्। न च व्यवसितुं किंचिदुत्तरं शक्नुवन्ति ते॥ छन्नं तथा तं सत्रेण पाण्डवं प्रेक्ष्य भारत। उत्तरं तु प्रधावन्तमभिद्रुत्य धनंजयः। गत्वा पदशतं तूर्णं केशपक्षे परामृशत्॥ सोऽर्जुनेन परामृष्टः पर्यदेवयदार्तवत्। बहुलं कृपणं चैव विराटस्य सुतस्तदा॥ कृत्वा निर्यातो
en: O Bharata, seeing the son of Pandu in disguise all the Kurus thus thought separately but they could not arrive at a conclusion. Dhananjaya however, quickly following the fleeing Uttara, seized him within a hundred steps by the hair. Held by Arjuna the son of Virata began to lament piteously like one forlorn.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच शृणुयास्त्वं हि कल्याणि बृहन्नले सुमध्यमे। निवर्तय रथं क्षिप्रं जीवन् भद्राणि पश्यति॥
en: Uttara said Hear, O youthful Brihannala, turn back the chariot. He, who lives, secures prosperity.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: शातकुम्भम्य शुद्धस्य शतं निष्कान् ददामि ते। मणीनष्टौ च वैदूर्यान् हेमबद्धान् महाप्रभान्॥ हेमदण्डप्रतिच्छन्नं रथं युक्तं च सुव्रतैः। मत्तांश्च दश मातङ्गान् मुञ्च मां त्वं बृहन्नले॥
en: I will give you a hundred coins of pure gold, eight highly brilliant jems Vaidurya set with gold, one car with a golden flag-staff and drawn by excellent horses and ten infuriated elephants. Release me, Brihannala.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमादीनि वाक्यानि विलपन्तमचेतसम्। प्रहस्य पुरुषव्याघ्रो रथस्यान्तिकमानयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Holding him forcibly who was bewailing in these strains being beside himself that foremost of men brought him near the car.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: अथैनमब्रवीत् पार्थो भयार्तं नष्टचेतसम्। यदि नोत्सहसे योद्धं शत्रुभिः शत्रुकर्षण। एहि मे त्वं हयान् यच्छ युध्यमानस्य शत्रुभिः॥
en: Partha then said to him who was stricken with fear and deprived of his senses. “O repressor of foes, if you do not like to fight with your enemies, come, govern the horses while I fight with them.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: प्रयाह्येतद् रथानीकं मद्बाहुबलरक्षितः। अप्रधृष्यतमं घोरं गुप्तं वीरैमहारथैः॥ मा भैस्त्वं राजपुत्राय क्षत्रियोऽसि परंतप।
en: Protected by the strength of my arms do you enter into the dreadful and inaccessible collection of arms guarded by brave and powerful horses. Fear not, O repressor of foes, for you are the foremost of princes and a Kshatriya.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: कथं पुरुषशार्दूल शत्रुमध्ये विषीदसि॥ अहं वै कुरुभिर्योत्स्ये विजेष्यामि च ते पशून्।
en: Why are you pulled down in the midst of enemies O foremost of men? I shall fight with the Kurus and release your animals.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: प्रविश्यैतद् रथानीकमप्रधृष्यं दुरासदम्॥ यन्ता भव नरश्रेष्ठ योत्स्येऽहं कुरुभिः सह।
en: Entering into the formidable and impenetrable army. Be you my charioteer, O foremost of men, I shall fight with the Kurus.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: एवं ब्रुवाणो बीभत्सुर्वैराटिमपराजितः। समाश्वास्य मुहूर्तं तमुत्तरं भरतर्षभ॥
en: Thus speaking to Uttara, the son of Virata, Bibhatsu, never defeated in battle, excited him for the time being, O foremost of Viratas.

description: The chastisement of Uttara in Goharana
sn: तत एनं विचेष्टन्तमकामं भयपीडितम्। रथमारोपयामास पार्थः प्रहरतां वरः॥
en: Then Partha, the foremost of repressors took upon the car that unwilling and fainting prince, assailed with fear.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तं दृष्ट्वा क्लीबवेषेण रथस्थं नरपुङ्गवम्। शमीमभिमुखं यान्तं रथमारोप्य चोत्तरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Beholding that foremost of men seated on car in the dress of a person of the neuter sex, going towards the Shami tree, having placed Uttara on the chariot.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: भीष्मद्रोणमुखास्तत्र कुरवो रथिसत्तमाः। वित्रस्तमनसः सर्वे धनंजयकृताद् भयात्॥
en: All the mighty car-warriors of the Kurus headed by Bhishma and Drona had their minds agitated by the fear of Dhananjaya.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: तानवेक्ष्य हतोत्साहानुत्पातानपि चाद्भुतान्। गुरुः शस्त्रभृतां श्रेष्ठो भारद्वाजोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Seeing them dispirited and many wonderful omens, the preceptor Drona, the foremost of wielders of weapon, Bharadvaja's son, said.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: चण्डाश्च वाता: संवान्ति रूक्षाः शर्करवर्षिणः। भस्मवर्णप्रकाशेन तमसा संवृतं नमः॥
en: Violent and dreadful winds are blowing, showering profuse gravels. The sky is also enshrouded with darkness of ashy colour.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: रुक्षवर्णाश्च जलदा दृश्यन्तेऽद्भुतदर्शनाः। निःसरन्ति च कोशेभ्यः शस्त्राणि विविधानि च।॥
en: The wonderful clouds are looking dry and divine weapons are as if coming out of their cases.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: शिवाश्च विनदन्त्येता दीप्तायां दिशि दारुणाः। हयाश्चाश्रूणि मुञ्चन्ति ध्वजाः कम्पन्त्यकम्पिताः॥
en: Frightened by the conflagration on all sides the jackals are yelling hideously, the horses are shedding tears and flags are being shaken although moved by none.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: यादृशान्यत्र रूपाणि संदृश्यन्ते बहूनि च। यत्ता भवन्तस्तिष्ठन्तु साध्वसं समुपस्थितम्॥
en: Since many such dreadful omens are being seen, a mighty calamity is at hand.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: रक्षध्वमपि चात्मानं व्यूहध्वं वाहिनीमपि। वैशसं च प्रतीक्षध्वं रक्षध्वं चापि गोधनम्॥
en: Protect yourselves and arrange the army, Expect a slaughter and guard well the kine.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: एष वीरो महेष्वासः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। आगतः क्लीबवेषेण पार्थो नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: This great bowman, this best of heroes, who has come in the guise of a person of the ncuter sex is undoubtedly the son of Pritha.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: नगाह्वयो नाम नगारिसूनुः। एषोऽङ्गनावेषधरः किरीटी जित्वा वयं नेष्यति चाद्य गावः॥
en: O you born of a river (Bhishma), this man dressed as a woman, is Kiriti (Arjuna) the son of the enemy of mountains (Indra) and having on his banner the emblem of the destroyer of Lanka's gardens. Defeating us today he will surely take away the kine.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: स एष पार्थो विक्रान्तः सव्यसाची परंतपः। नायुद्धेन निवर्तेत सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः॥
en: He is the powerful Partha, Savyasachin, the repressor of enemies he does no desist even in the encounter with all the celestials.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: क्लेशितश्च वने शूरो वासवेनापि शिक्षितः। अमर्षवशमापन्नो वासवप्रतिमो युधि। नेहास्य प्रतियोद्धारमहं पश्यामि कौरवाः॥
en: The hero suffered hardships in the forest and was instructed by Indra. Indignant (as he is) he is equal to Vasava in battle.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: महादेवोऽपि पार्थेन श्रूयते युधि तोषितः। किरातवेषप्रच्छन्नो गिरौ हिमवति प्रभुः॥
en: O Kauravas, I do not see here any one who can withstand him in battle. It is heard, that on the mountain Himavan, the lord Mahadeva too, disguised as a hunter, was pleased by Partha in battle.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: कर्ण उवाच सदा भवान् फाल्गुनस्य गुणैरस्मान् विकत्यसे। न चार्जुनः कलापूर्णो मम दुर्योधनस्य च॥
en: Karna said You always make light of us by speaking of Phalguni's accomplishments. He is not even one sixteenth of either myself or Duryodhana.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: दुर्योधन उवाच योष पार्थो राधेय कृतं कार्यं भवेन्मम। ज्ञाताः पुनश्चरिष्यन्ति द्वादशाब्दान् विशाम्पते॥
en: Duryodhana said If he be Partha, O son of Radha, then my work is fulfilled. If found out the Pandavas shall have to live in the forest for twelve yeas again.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: अथैष कश्चिदेवान्यः क्लीबवेषेण मानवः। शरैरेनं सुनिशितैः पातयिष्यामि भूतले॥
en: If he be any one else in a eunuch's guise I shall soon place him on the ground with sharp arrows.

description: The praise of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्मिन् ब्रुवति तद् वाक्यं धार्तराष्ट्रे परंतप। भीष्मो द्रोणः कृपो द्रौणिः पौरुषं तदपूजयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Oslayer of foes, on Duryodhana saying this, Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, and Drona's son all spoke highly of his manliness.

description: The description of Arjuna's weapon in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तां शमीमुपसंगम्य पार्थो वैराटिमब्रवीत्। सुकुमारं समाज्ञाय संग्रामे नातिकोविदम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having approached the Shami tree and found out that the son of Virata was highly delicate and inexperienced in battle Partha said to him.

description: The description of Arjuna's weapon in Goharana
sn: समादिष्टो मया क्षिप्रं धनूंष्यवहरोत्तर। नेमानि हि त्वदीयानि सोढुं शक्ष्यन्ति मे बलम्। भारं चापि गुरुं वोढुं कुवारं वा प्रमर्दितुम्॥
en: Commanded by me, O Uttara, bring down some arrows that are on the tree. These your shafts cannot stand my strength.

description: The description of Arjuna's weapon in Goharana
sn: मम वा बाहुविक्षेपं शत्रूनिह विजेष्यतः। तस्माद् भूमिजयारोह शमीमेतां पलाशिनीम्॥
en: Heavy as it is when I grind the horses, elephants and the stretch of my arms when I defeat the enemies.

description: The description of Arjuna's weapon in Goharana
sn: अस्यां हि पाण्डुपुत्राणां धनूंषि निहितान्युत। युधिष्ठिरस्य भीमस्य बीभत्सोर्यमयोस्तथा॥ ध्वजाः शराश्च शूराणां दिव्यानि कवचानि च।
en: Therefore, O prince, climb this tree full of fruits for in it are tied the bows, shafts, banners and beautiful armours of the heroic sons of Pandu, Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna and the twins.

description: The description of Arjuna's weapon in Goharana
sn: अत्र चैतन्महावीर्यं धनुः पार्थस्य गाण्डिवम्॥ एकं शतसहस्रेण सम्मितं राष्ट्रवर्धनम्।
en: There is also the mighty bow, Gandiva, of Partha, which alone is equal to hundred thousand of others and is capable of extending kingdom.

description: The description of Arjuna's weapon in Goharana
sn: व्यायामसहमत्यर्थं तृणराजसमं महत्॥ सर्वायुधमहामात्रं शत्रुसम्बाधकारकम्। सुवर्णविकृतं दिव्यं श्लक्ष्णमायतमव्रणम्॥ अलं भारं गुरुं वोढुं दारुणं चारुदर्शनम्।
en: Capable of standing the greatest exercise, huge like a palmyra tree, the largest of all weapons, capable of withstanding the enemy, embellished with gold, celestials, smooth broad without a knot, beautiful and straight and capable of bearing a heavy weight.

description: The description of Arjuna's weapon in Goharana
sn: तादृशान्येव सर्वाणि बलवन्ति दृढानि च। युधिष्ठिरस्य भीमस्य बीभत्सोर्यमयोस्तथा॥
en: The other bows, that there of Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna and twins are equally strong and tough. are

description: The attempt of getting down weapons in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच अस्मिन् वृक्षे किलोद्वद्धं शरीरमिति नः श्रुतम्। तदहं राजपुत्रः सन् स्पृशेयं पाणिना कथम्॥
en: Uttara said It is heard that a corpse is tie to the tree. How can I, being a prince, touch it with my own hands.

description: The attempt of getting down weapons in Goharana
sn: नैवंविधं मया युक्तमालब्धु क्षत्रयोनिना। महता राजपुत्रेण मन्त्रयज्ञविदा सता॥
en: To touch it does not become me who am born in the Kshatriya race, a mighty prince and observant of Mantras and vows.

description: The attempt of getting down weapons in Goharana
sn: स्पृष्टवन्तं शरीरं मां शववाहमिवाशुचिम्। कथं वा व्यवहार्यं वै कुर्वीथास्त्वं बृहन्नले॥
en: Why should you, O Brihannala, make my body sullied and unclean by making me touch this corpse?

description: The attempt of getting down weapons in Goharana
sn: बृहन्नलोवाच व्यवहार्यश्च राजेन्द्र शुचिश्चैव भविष्यसि। धनूंष्येतानि मा भैस्त्वं शरीरं नात्र विद्यते॥
en: Brihannala said You shall remain clean and unpolluted, O foremost of kings. Fear not, there are only bows on this tree and not a corpse.

description: The attempt of getting down weapons in Goharana
sn: दायादं मत्स्यराजस्य कुले जातं मनस्विनाम्। त्वां कथं निन्दितं कर्म कारयेयं नृपात्मज॥
en: O prince, why should I make you do a cursed deed, born as you are of a noble family and a heir to the king of Matsya's.

description: The attempt of getting down weapons in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः स पार्थेन रथात् प्रस्कन्द्य कुण्डली। आरुरोह शमीवृक्षं वैराटिरवशस्तदा॥
en: Thus addressed by Partha, Virata's son, adorned with ear-rings, got down from the car and climbed up the Shami tree unwillingly.

description: The attempt of getting down weapons in Goharana
sn: तमन्वशासच्छत्रुनो रथे तिष्ठन् धनंजयः। अवरोपय वृक्षाग्राद् धनूंष्येतानि मा चिरम्॥
en: Dhananjaya, the slayer of enemies, waiting on the car, ordered him:-“Quickly bring down those bows from the top of the tree."

description: The attempt of getting down weapons in Goharana
sn: परिवेष्टनमेतेषां क्षिप्रं चैव व्यपानुदा सोऽपहृत्य महार्हाणि धनूंषि पृथुवक्षसाम्। परिवेष्टनपत्राणि विमुच्य समुपानयत्॥ तथा संनहनान्येषां परिमुच्य समन्ततः।
en: Cut off soon the wrappers of all these. Cutting off the covering and the ropes with which they were tied on all sides he brought those valuable bows having spacious rods.

description: The attempt of getting down weapons in Goharana
sn: अपश्यद् गाण्डिवं तत्र चतुर्भिरपरैः सह॥ तेषां विमुच्यमानानां धनुषामर्कवर्चसाम्। विनिश्चेरुः प्रभा दिव्या ग्रहाणामुदयेष्विव॥ स तेषां रूपमालोक्य भोगिनामिव जृम्भताम्। हृष्टरोमा भयोद्विग्नः क्षणेन समपद्यत॥ संस्पृश्य तानि चापानि भानुमन्ति बृहन्ति च। वैरारिर्जुनं राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: He saw there Gandiva along with four other bows. The celestials effulgence of these bows resplendent like the rays of the sun, when got out, appeared like that of the planet at the time of rising. Beholding their forms like sighing snakes he, in time, overwhelmed with fear and the hairs of his body stood on ends. Then touching those huge and mighty lustrous bows Virata's son said to Arjuna. no was

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच बिन्दवो जातरूपस्य शतं यस्मिन् निपातिताः। सहस्रकोटि सौवर्णाः कस्यैतद् धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: Uttara said To what illustrious hero does this excellent bow belong, having a hundred golden bosses and shining ends?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: वारणा यत्र सौवर्णाः पृष्ठे भासन्ति दंशिताः। सुपार्श्व सुग्रहं चैव कस्यैतद् धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: Whose is this most excellent bow of good sides and easy hold, on the staff of which shine golden elephants with such a brilliance?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: तपनीयस्य शुद्धस्य षष्टिर्यस्येन्द्रगोपकाः। पृष्ठे विभक्ताः शोभन्ते कस्यैतद् धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: Whose is this excellent bow embellished with three scores of golden insects placed with proper divisions on its back?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: सूर्या यत्र च सौवर्णास्त्रयो भासन्ति दंशिताः। तेजसा प्रज्वलन्तो हि कस्यैतद् धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: Whose is this most excellent bow burning in lustre on which shine three suns of great effulgence?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: शलभा यत्र सौवर्णास्तपनीयविभूषिताः। सुवर्णमणिचित्रं च कस्यैतद् धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: Whose is this most excellent weapon variegated with gold and gems on which are golden insects set with brilliant stones?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: इमे च कस्य नाराचाः साहस्रा लोमवाहिनः। समन्तात् कलधौदाग्रा उपासंगे हिरण्मये॥
en: Whose are these thousand winged arrows having golden points and put in golden quivers?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: विपाठा: पृथवः कस्य गार्धपत्राः शिलाशिताः। हारिद्रवर्णाः सुमुखा: पीताः सर्वायसाः शराः॥
en: Whose are these huge shafts, thick-winged like vultures, whetted, of yellow hue entirely made of iron, and sharp?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: कम्पायमसितश्चापः पञ्चशार्दूललक्षणः। वराहकर्णव्यामिश्रान् शरान् धारयते दश॥
en: Whose is this sable bow having the emblem of five tigers, with boar-eared arrows numbering ten?.

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: कस्येमे पृथवो दीर्घाश्चन्द्रबिम्बार्धदर्शनाः। शतानि सप्त तिष्ठन्ति नाराचा रुधिराशनाः॥
en: Whose are these long and thick five hundred arrows like the crescent shaped moon, capable of drinking blood?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: कस्येमे शुकपत्राभैः पूर्वैरभैः सुवाससः। उत्तरैरायसैः पीतैर्हेमपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Whose are these gold feathered arrows whetted on stone, the lower halves of which are embellished with wings of the colour of a parrot's feathers and the upper halves of which are made of well-tempered steel?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: गुरुभारसहो दिव्यः शात्रवाणां भयंकरः। कस्यायं सायको दीर्घः शिलीपृष्ठः शिलीमुखः॥
en: Whose is this celestial long sword, capable of having heavy weight, irresistible, dreadful to the enemies, having the mark of a bee on it and with the head of a bee?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: वैयाघ्रकोशे निहितो हेमचित्रो दुरासदः। सुफलचित्रकोशश्च किङ्किणीसायको महान्॥
en: Whose is this huge sword of excellent blade, variegated with gold and tinkling bells and put in a variegated sheath of tiger skin?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: कस्य हेमत्सरुर्दिव्यः खङ्गः परमनिमलः। कस्यायं विमलः खड्गो गव्ये कोशे समर्पितः॥
en: Whose is this beautiful scimitar of goiden hilt, celestials and highly polished and cased in a scab-bard cf cow-skin?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: हेमत्सरुरनाधृष्यो नैषध्यो भारसाधनः। कस्य पाचनखे कोशे सायको हेमविग्रहः॥
en: Whose is this sword made of gold, manufactured in the country of Nishadas, capable of bearing heavy weight and cased in a sheath of goat skin?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: प्रमाणरूपसम्पन्नः पीत आकाशसंनिभः। कस्य हेममये कोशे सुतप्ते पावकप्रभ॥
en: Whose is this sword sable like the cloud and cased in a case of burning gold shining like fire?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: निस्त्रिंशोऽयं गुरुः पीतः सायक: परनिर्वणः। कस्यायमसितः खड्गो हेमबिन्दुभिरावृतः॥
en: Whose is this huge sable Nishtringha capable of assaulting others? Whose is this iron sword covered with golden points.

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: आशीविषसमस्पर्शः परकायप्रभेदनः। गुरुभारसहो दिव्यः सपत्नानां भयप्रदः॥
en: Dreadful in touch like a serpent capable of piercing other's bodies and bearing heavy weight, celestial and creating terror in the minds of the enemies?

description: The seeing of weapon by Uttara in Goharana
sn: निर्दिशस्व यथातत्त्वं मया पृष्टा बृहन्नले। विस्मयो मे परो जातो दृष्ट्वा सर्वमिदं महत्॥
en: O Brihannala, asked by me, speak out the real truth; great is my wonder on seeing all these.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: बृहन्नलोवाच यन्मां पूर्वमिहापृच्छः शत्रुसेनापहारिणम्। गाण्डीवमेतत् पार्थस्य लोकेषु विदितं धनुः॥
en: Brihannala said The one about which you first enquired is the world-wide known Gandiva bow of Arjuna, capable of destroying the enemy's army.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: सर्वायुधमहामात्रं शातकुम्भपरिष्कृतम्। एतत् तदर्जुनस्यासीद् गाण्डीवं परमायुधम्॥
en: Polished like pure gold, the greatest of all weapons this is the greatest of all weapons this is the great weapon of Arjuna, Gandiva.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: यत् तच्छतसहस्रेण सम्मितं राष्ट्रवर्द्धनम्। येन देवान् मनुष्यांश्च पार्थो विजयते मृधे॥
en: It is equal to a hundred thousand bows and capable of extending kingdoms: by this Partha defeated in battle celestials and men.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: चित्रमुच्चावचैवर्णैः श्लक्ष्णमायतमव्रणम्। देवदानवगन्धर्वैः पूजितं शाश्वतीः समाः॥
en: Adored repeatedly by the celestials, demons and Gandharvas, and variegated with excellent colours, the huge and smooth bow is .without any stain or knot.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: एतद् वर्षसहस्रं तु ब्रह्मा पूर्वमधारयत्। ततोऽनन्तरमेवाथ प्रजापतिरधारयत्॥ त्रीणि पञ्चशतं चैव शक्रोऽशीति च पञ्च च। सोमः पञ्चशतं राजा तथैव वरुणः शतम्।
en: Brahma held it first for a thousand years and thereafter Prajapati held it for five hundred and three years. Afterwards Shakra did it for five and eighty years. Soma did it for five hundred years and Varuna for a hundred.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: पार्थः पञ्च च षष्टिं च वर्षाणि श्वेतवाहनः॥ महावीर्यं महादिव्यमेतत् तद् धनुरुत्तमम्।
en: And lastly Partha, having white steeds, has held, for sixty five years, this highly powerful, heavenly and most excellent bow.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: एतत् पार्थमनुप्राप्तं वरुणाच्चारुदर्शनम्॥ पूजितं सुरमत्र्येषु बिभर्ति परमं वपुः।
en: This beautiful bow has come to Partha from Varuna. Worshipped by god and men it has taken a handsome form.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: सुपार्श्व भीमसेनस्य जातरूपग्रहं धनुः। येन पार्थोऽजयत् कृत्स्नां दिशं प्राची परंतपः॥
en: That bow of beautiful sides and golden handle belongs to Bhima with which, the son of Pritha, the slayer of enemies, conquered the entire eastern region.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: इन्द्रगोपकचित्रं च यदेतच्चारुदर्शनम्। राज्ञो युधिष्ठिरस्यैतद् वैराटे धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: the other most excellent and beautiful bow, variegated with insects, belongs to the king Yudhishthira.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: सूर्या यस्मिंस्तु सौवर्णाः प्रकाशन्ते प्रकाशिनः। तेजसा प्रज्वलन्तो वै नकुलस्यैतदायुधम्॥
en: The other, in which golden suns of brilliant effulgence shed lustre all around, belongs to Nakula.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: शलभा यत्र सौवर्णास्तपनीय विचित्रिताः। एतन्माद्रीसुतस्यापि सहदेवस्य कार्मुकम्॥
en: The bow, embellished with golden images of insects and set also with jems and stones, belongs to that son of Madri who is called Sahadeva.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: ये त्विमे क्षुरसंकाशाः सहस्रा लोमवाहिनः। एतेऽर्जुनस्य वैराटे शराः सर्पविषोपमाः॥
en: The thousand winged shafts, sharp as razors and dreadful like the venom of snakes, belong to Arjuna, O son of Virata.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: एते ज्वलन्तः संग्रामे तेजसा शीघ्रगामिनः। भवन्ति वीरस्याक्षय्या व्यूहतः समरे रिपून्।॥
en: These swift arrows, of the hero burning in energy in battle when discharged against the enemies, become inexhaustible.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: ये चेमे पृथवो दीर्घाश्चन्द्रबिम्बार्धदर्शनाः। एते भीमस्य निशिता रिपुक्षयकराः शराः॥
en: These sharp, long and heavy arrows, resembling the crescent of the moon in shape and capable of destroying the enemies, belong to Bhima.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: हारिद्रवर्णा ये त्वेते हेमपुङ्खाः शिलाशिताः। नकुलस्य कलापोऽयं पञ्चशार्दूललक्षणः॥
en: The quiver, having the five images of tigers full of yellow, gold winged shafts whetted on stone, belongs to Nakula.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: येनासौ व्यजयत् कृत्स्ना प्रतीची दिशमाहवे। कलापो ह्येष तस्यासीन्माद्रीपुत्रस्य धीमतः॥
en: This quiver belongs to the intelligent son of Madri with which he had conquered the entire western region.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: ये त्विमे भास्कराकाराः सर्वपारसवाः शराः। एते चित्रक्रियोपेताः : सहदेवस्य धीमतः॥
en: These arrows, lustrous like the sun, painted all over with various colours and capable of destroying enemies by thousands, belong to Sahadeva.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: ये त्विमे निशिताः पीताः पृथवो दीघवाससः। हेमपुङ्खास्त्रिपर्वाणो राज्ञ एते महाशराः॥
en: These great arrows, sharpened, yellow, heavy, long, gold feathered and consisting of three knots, belong to the king (Yudhishthira).

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: यस्त्वयं सायको दीर्घः शिलीपृष्ठः शिलीमुखः। अर्जुनस्यैष संग्रामे गुरुभारसहो दृढः॥
en: This long sword, with the emblem of a bee on its back and sharp as the sting of a bee, firm and capable of bearing heavy weight in battle, belongs to Arjuna.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: वैयाघ्रकोशः सुमहान् भीमसेनस्य सायकः। गुरुभारसहो दिव्यः शात्रवाणां भयंकरः॥
en: This celestials huge sword, cased in tiger skin, capable of bearing heavy weight and dreadful to the enemies, belongs to Bhimasena.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: सुफलचित्रकोशश्च हेमत्सरुरनुत्तमः। निस्त्रिंशः कौरवस्यैष धर्मराजस्य धीमतः॥
en: This most excellent sword, of a sharp blade, golden hilt and cased in a painted sheath, belongs to the intelligent Dharmaraja of the Kuru race.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: यस्तु पाञ्चनखे कोशे निहिताश्चित्रयोधने। नकुलस्यैष निस्त्रिंशो गुरुभारसहो दृढः॥
en: This strong sword, capable of bearing heavy weight intended for various forms of fight and cased in a sheath of goat-skin belongs to Nakula.

description: The description of weapons in Goharana
sn: यस्त्वयं विपुलः खड्गो गव्ये कोशे समर्पितः सहदेवस्य विद्ध्येनं सर्वभारसहं दृढम्॥
en: This huge, strong and dreadful sword, capable of bearing heavy weight and put in a sheath of cow-skin, belongs to Sahadeva.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच सुवर्णविकृतानिमान्यायुधानि महात्मनाम्। रुचिराणि प्रकाशन्ते पार्थानामाशुकारिणाम्॥
en: Uttara said Truly these golden weapons, belonging to the light handed and noble sons of Pritha, are greatly beautiful.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: क्व नु स्विदर्जुन: पार्थः कौरव्यो वा युधिष्ठिरः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः॥
en: But where are that Arjuna, the son of Pritha, Yudhishthira of the Kuru race, Nakula, Sahadeva and Bhimasena the son of Pandu?

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: सर्व एव महात्मानः सर्वामित्रविनाशनाः। राज्यमक्षैः पराकीर्य न श्रूयन्ते कथंचन॥
en: We never hear of all those noble (heroes), capable of destroying all enemies, who lost their kingdom at dice.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: द्रौपदी क्व च पाञ्चली स्त्रीरत्नमिति विश्रुता। जितानक्षैस्तदा कृष्णा तानेवावगमद् वनम्॥
en: Where is Draupadi, the princess of Panchala, known as a jewel of a female who followed them to woods after their defeat at dice.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच अहमसम्यर्जुनः पार्थः सभास्तारो युधिष्ठिरः। बल्लवो भीमसेनस्तु पितुस्ते रसपाचकः॥
en: Arjuna said I am Arjuna, the son of Pritha, your father's courtier is Yudhishthira and the clever cook of your father, Ballava, is Bhimasena.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: अश्वबन्धोऽथ नकुलः सहदेवस्तु गोकुले। सैरन्ध्रीं द्रौपदीं विद्धि यत्कृते कीचका हताः॥
en: Nakula is in charge of steeds and Sahadeva is in cow-pen and know Sairandhri as Draupadi for whom Kichaka's were slain.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच दश पार्थस्य नामानि यानि पूर्वं श्रुतानि मे। प्रब्रूयास्तानि यदि मे श्रद्दध्यां सर्वमेव ते॥
en: Uttara said I shall place confidence in your words if you can mention the ten names of Partha of which I had heard before.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच हन्त तेऽहं समाचक्षे दश नामानि यानि मे। वैराटे शृणु तानि त्वं यानि पूर्वं श्रुतानि ते॥
en: Arjuna said I shall tell you my ten names; hear them, O son of Virata, which you heard before.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: एकाग्रमानसो भूत्वा शृणु सर्वं समाहितः। अर्जुनः फाल्गुनो जिष्णुः किरीटी श्वेतवाहनः। बीभत्सुर्विजयः कृष्णः सव्यसाची धनंजयः॥
en: Hear all with concentrated mind and attention-Arjuna, Phalguni, Jishnu, Kiritin Shvetavahana, Bibhatsu, Vijaya, Krishna, Savyasachin, Dhananjaya.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच केनासि विजयो नाम केनासि श्वेतवाहनः। किरीटी नाम केनासि सव्यसाची कथं भवान्।॥
en: Uttara said name Why is your Vijaya? Why Shvetavahana? Why is your name Kiritin and why Savyasachi?

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: अर्जुनः फाल्गुनो जिष्णुः कृष्णो बीभत्सुरेव च। धनंजयश्च केनासि ब्रूहि तन्मम तत्त्वतः॥
en: Tell me all truly why your names are Arjuna, Phalguni, Jishnu, Krishna, Bibhatsu and Dhananjaya.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: श्रुता मे तस्य वीरस्य केवला नामहेतवः। तत् सर्वं यदि मे बूयाः श्रद्दध्यां सर्वमेव ते॥
en: I have heard o the origin of the names of the hero; if you can tell them all I shall confide in your words.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच सर्वाजानपदाञ्जित्वा वित्तमादाय केवलम्। मध्ये धनस्य तिष्ठामि तेनाहुर्मी धनंजयम्॥
en: Arjuna said Having conquered all countries, and collected their wealth I lived in the midst of riches and so they call me Dhananjaya.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: अभिप्रयामि संग्रामे यदहं युद्धदुर्मदान्। नाजित्वा विनिवर्तामि तेन मां विजयं विदुः॥
en: When I go out to fight with invincible kings I never return without defeating them; hence they call me Vijaya.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: श्वेताः काञ्चनसंनाहा रथे युज्यन्ति मे हयाः। संग्रामे युध्यमानस्य तेनाहं श्वेतवाहनः॥
en: When I fight in the battle field the steeds that are yoked to my car are white and golden hued and hence they call me Shvetavahana.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: उत्तराभ्यां फल्गुनीभ्यां नक्षत्राभ्यामहं दिवा। जातो हिमवतः पृष्ठे तेन मां फाल्गुनं विदुः॥
en: I was born on the Himavat when the constellation Uttara Phalguna was on the ascendant and hence they call me Phalguni.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: पुरा शक्रेण मे दत्तं युध्यतो दानवर्षभैः। किरीटं मूर्ध्नि सूर्याभं तेनाहुर्मी किरीटिनम्॥
en: A diadem, brilliant like the sun, was formerly placed on my head by Indra during my fight with the Danavas and hence they call me Kiritin.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: न कुर्यां कर्म बीभत्सं युध्यमानः कथंचन। तेन देवमनुष्येषु बीभत्सुरिति विश्रुतः॥
en: I have never committed a hateful work in the field of battle and hence I am known as Bibhatsu amongst men and celestials. I

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: उभौ मे दक्षिणौ पाणी गाण्डीवस्य विकर्षणे। तेन देवमनुष्येषु सव्यसाचीति मां विदुः॥
en: Both of my hands are capable of drawing Gandiva: hence they know me as Savyasachi amongst men and celestials.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: पृथिव्यां चतुरन्तायां वर्णो मे दुर्लभः समः। करोमि कर्म शुक्लं च तस्मान्मामर्जुन: विदुः॥
en: My complexion is rare on earth with four boundaries and I perform pure deeds and hence they call me Arjuna.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: अहं दुरापो दुर्धर्षो दमनः पाकशासनिः। तेन देवमनुष्येषु जिष्णुर्नामास्मि विश्रुतः॥
en: am unapproachable, irrepressible, dreadful and the chastiser of Paka; hence I am known as Vishnu amongst men and celestials.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: कृष्ण इत्येव दशमं नाम चक्रे पिता मम। कृष्णावदातस्य ततः प्रियत्वाद् बालकस्य वै॥
en: Krishna, my tenth name, was given to me by my father out of affection for a black boy of great purity.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः स पार्थं वैराटिरभ्यवादयदन्तिकात्। अहं भूमिजयो नाम नाम्नाहमपि चोत्तरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then approaching Partha the son of Virata said "I am Bhuminjaya by name as well as Uttara.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: दिष्ट्या त्वां पार्थ पश्यामि स्वागतं ते धनंजय। लोहिताक्ष महाबाहो नागराजकरोपम॥
en: By good luck I have seen you, O Partha, Welcome, O Dhananjaya, O you with red eyes and mighty arms resembling the trunk of elephants.

description: The recognition of Arjuna in Goharana
sn: यदज्ञानादवोचं त्वां क्षन्तुमर्हसि तन्मम। यतस्त्वया कृतं पूर्वं चित्रं कर्म सुदुष्करम्। अतो भयं व्यतीतं मे प्रीतिश्च परमा त्वयि॥
en: You should pardon me for what I said out of ignorance. You performed before many wonderful and difficult fears: hence my fears have been removed and I bear a great love for you.”

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच आस्थाय रुचिरं वीर रथं सारथिनां मया। कतमं यास्यसेऽनीकमुक्तो यास्याम्यहं त्वया॥
en: Uttara said O hero, mounting this beautiful car with me as the charioteer, which division would you enter into? Commanded by you I shall take you there.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच प्रीतोऽस्मि पुरुषव्याघ्र न भयं विद्यते तव। सर्वान् नुदामि ते शत्रून् रणे रणविशारद॥
en: Arjuna said I am pleased with you, O best of men, you have no fear. I shall disperse all your enemies in battle, O you conversant with all forms of warfare.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: स्वस्थो भव महाबाहो पश्य मां शत्रुभिः सह। युध्यामानं विमर्देऽस्मिन् कुर्वाणं भैरवं महत्॥
en: Be at ease, O you mighty armed hero, behold me fighting with your enemies in battle, making a dreadful feat.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: एतान् सर्वानुपासङ्गान् क्षिप्रं बध्नीहि मे रथे। एकं चाहर निस्त्रिंशं जातरूपपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: The quickly all these quivers to my chariot and take a sword of polished blade embellished with gold.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच अर्जुनस्य वचः श्रुत्वा त्वरावानुत्तरस्तदा। अर्जुनस्यायुधान् गृह्य शीघेणावातरत् ततः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing those words of Arjuna, Uttara became active He quickly got down from the tree with Arjuna's weapon.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच अहं वै कुरुभिर्योत्स्याम्यवजेष्यामि ते पशून्॥ संकल्पपक्षविक्षेपं बाहुप्राकारतोरणम्।
en: Arjuna said I will fight with the Kurus and bring back your animals. Guarded by me the top of this car shall be like a citadel to you; these my arms shall be like ramparts and gates.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: त्रिदण्डतूणसम्बाधमनेकध्वजसंकुलम्॥ ज्याक्षेपणं क्रोधकृतं नेमीनिनददुन्दुभि।
en: This treble pole and this my quiver will be like defensive works; here are my many flags; the twang of my bow, when I am in anger, will be like the sound of Dundhubi.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: नगरं ते मया गुप्तं रथोपस्थं भविष्यति॥ अधिष्ठितो मया संख्ये रथो गाण्डीवधन्वना। अजेयः शत्रुसैन्यानां वैराटे व्येतु ते भयम्॥
en: Such a city of yours, protected by me, will be on the car driven by me; holding the bow of Gandiva it will be incapable of being vanquished by the hostile army. So, O son of Virata, let your fear be dispelled.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच बिभेमि नाहमेतेषां जानामि त्वां स्थिरं युधि। केशवेनापि संग्रामे साक्षादिन्द्रेण वा समम्॥
en: Uttara said I do not fear all these-I know your steadiness in battle like that of Keshava or Indra himself.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: इदं तु चिन्तयन्नेवं परिमुह्यामि केवलम्। निश्चयं चापि दुर्मेधा च गच्छामि कथंचन॥
en: Thinking of this I am continually bewildered. Foolish as I am I cannot get a definite conclusion,

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: एवं युक्ताङ्गरूपस्य लक्षणैः सूचितस्य च। केन कर्मविपाकेन क्लीबत्वमिदमागतम्॥
en: By what adverse circumstances may such a handsome person, gifted with all auspicious marks, become deprived of men hood?

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: मन्ये त्वां क्लीबवेषेण चरन्तं शूलपाणिनम्। गन्धर्वराजप्रतिमं देवं वापि शतक्रतुम्॥
en: I think you are a Mahadeva, or Indra, or the king of the Gandharvas living in the guise of a eunuch.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच भ्रातुर्नियोगाज्ज्येष्ठस्य संवत्सरमिदं व्रतम्। चरामि व्रतचर्यं च सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Arjuna said To tell you the truth I am observing this vow for one year in satisfaction of the command of my elder brother,

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: नास्मि क्लीबो महाबाहो परवान् धर्मसंयुतः। समाप्तव्रतमुर्तीर्णं विद्धि मां त्वं नृपात्मज॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, I am not in reality a eunuch; (but I observe this vow) for acquiring religious merit and the satisfaction of another's will. Know, O prince, that I have completed my vow.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच परमोऽनुग्रहो मेऽद्य यतस्तर्को न मे वृथा। न हीदृशाः क्लीबरूपा भवन्ति तु नरोत्तम॥
en: Uttara said you have done me a great favour today for I now see that my suspicion was not altogether unfounded. Persons like you, O foremost of men, cannot be eunuchs.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: सहायवानस्मि रणे युध्येयममरैरपि। साध्वसं हि प्रणष्टं मे किं करोमि ब्रवीहि मे।॥
en: I have now got one to help me in battle; I can fight with the immortals. My fears have been dispelled. Tell me what I shall do.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: अहं ते संग्रहीष्यामि हयान् शत्रुरथारुजान्। शिक्षितो ह्यस्मि सारथ्ये तीर्थतः पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: I have been trained in horsemanship by a good teacher, O foremost of men; I shall govern your horses that are capable of breaking the ranks of enemy's cars.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: दारुको वासुदेवस्य यथा शक्रस्य मातलिः। तथा मां विद्धि सारथ्ये शिक्षितं नरपुङ्गव॥
en: Know me, O best of men, as clever a charioteer as Daruka of Vasudeva or Matali of Shakra.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: यस्य याते न पश्यन्ति भूमौ क्षिप्तं पदं पदम्। दक्षिणां यो धुरं युक्तः सुग्रीवसदृशो हयः॥
en: The horse, that is yoked to the right pole (of your car) and whose hoofs, as they are placed on the ground are hardly visible when running, is like Sugriva of Krishna.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: योऽयं धुरं धुर्यवरो वामा वहति शोभनः। तं मन्ये मेघपुष्पस्य जवेन सदृशं हयम्॥
en: The other beautiful steed, the best of its race, that is yoked to the left pole, is, I think, equal in speed to Meghapushpa.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: योऽयं काञ्चनसंनाहः पाणिं वहति शोभन:। समं शैब्यस्य तं मन्ये जवेन बलवत्तरम्॥
en: The beautiful horse, clad in golden mail, that draws the car by the rear pole, is equal to Shaivya in speed but superior in strength.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: योऽयं वहति मे पार्णि दक्षिणामभितः स्थितः। बलाहकादपि मतः स जवे वीर्यवत्तरः॥
en: This fourth, yoked to the rear pole on the right, is considered superior to Balahaka in both speed and strength.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: त्वामेवायं रथो वोढुं संग्रामेऽर्हति धन्विनम्। त्वं चेमं रथमास्थाय योद्धुम) मतो मम॥
en: This car is capable of carrying a bowman like you in battle and you are also worthy of fighting on this car. This is my conviction.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो विमुच्य बाहुभ्यां वलयानि स वीर्यवान्। चित्रे काञ्चनसंनाहे प्रत्यमुञ्चत् तदा तले॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then taking off from his arms the bracelets, the powerful (Arjuna) put on his hands a pair of beautiful gloves embroidered with gold.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: कृष्णान् भङ्गिमतः केशान् श्वेतेनोद्ग्रथ्य वाससा। अथासौ प्राङ्मुखो भूत्वा शुचिः प्रयतमानसः। अभिदध्यौ महाबाहुः सर्वास्त्राणि रथोत्तमे॥ ऊचुश्च पार्थं सर्वाणि प्राञ्जलीनि नृपात्मजम्।
en: He then tied his black and curling locks with a piece of white cloth. Then seated on that excellent car with his face turned towards the east the mighty-armed hero, purifying his body and controlling his mind, thought of all his weapons. Then all the weapons said to the prince, the son of Pritha.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: इमे स्म परमोदाराः किंकराः पाण्डुनन्दन॥ प्रणिपत्य ततः पार्थः समालभ्य च पाणिना। सर्वाणि मानसानीह भवतेत्यभ्यभाषत॥
en: "We are here, O illustrious one, we are your servants, O son of Pandu.” Then saluting and taking them with his hands he said "Do you all live in my memory." Then taking all those weapons he became of delighted countenance.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: प्रतिगृह्य ततोऽस्त्राणि प्रहृष्टवदनोऽभवत्। अधिज्यं तरसा कृत्वा गाण्डीवं व्याक्षिपद् धनुः॥ तस्य विक्षिप्यमाणस्य धनुषोऽभून्महाध्वनिः। यथा शैलस्य महतः शैलेनैवावजघ्नतः॥
en: Quickly stringing his bow Gandiva he twanged it. Then from the twang of the bow was produced a great sound like that of a mountain clashed by another mighty one. Dreadful was the sound that filled the earth and impetuous was the wind that blew on all sides.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: स निर्घातोऽभवद् भूभिद् दिक्षु वायुर्ववौ भृशम्। पपात महती चोल्का दिशो न प्रचकाशिरे। भ्रान्तध्वजं खं तदासीत् प्रकम्पितमहाद्रुमम्॥
en: Big fire-brands fell down, quarters were not clear, birds began to move about in the skies and the trees began to tremble.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: तं शब्दं कुरवोऽजानन् विस्फोटमशनेरिवा यदर्जुनो धनुःश्रेष्ठं बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपद् रथे॥
en: From that sound great as it was like that of thunder, the Kurus came to know that Arjuna drew, with his hands, the string of the best of his bows from the car.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच एकस्त्वं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठ बहूनेतान् महारथान्। कथं जेष्यसि संग्रामे सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रपारगान्॥
en: Uttara said You are alone, O best of Pandavas, and those powerful car-warriors are many. How will you vanquish in battle those who have mastered all art of fighting?

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: असहायोऽसि कौन्तेय ससहायाश्च कौरवाः। अतएव महाबाहो भीतस्तिष्ठामि तेऽग्रतः॥
en: You have none to help you, O son of Kunti, but Kurus have many to help them. Therefore, O mighty-armed hero, I wait before you afraid.

description: The beginnings of Arjuna's fighting in Goharana
sn: उवाच पार्थो मा भैषीः प्रहस्य स्वनवत् तदा।३५॥ युध्यमानस्य मे वीर गन्धर्वैः सुमहाबलैः। सहायो घोषयात्रायां कस्तदाऽऽसीत्सखा मम॥ तथा प्रतिभये तस्मिन् देवदानवसंकुले। खाण्डवे युध्यमानस्य कस्तदाऽऽसीत्सखा मम॥ निवातकवचैः सार्धं पौलोमैश्च महाबलैः। युध्यतो देवराजार्थे कः सहायस्तदाभवत्॥ स्वयंवरे तु पाञ्चाल्या राजभिः सह संयुगे। युध्यतो बहुभिस्तात कः सहायस्तदाभवत्॥ उपजीव्य गुरुं द्रोणं शक्रं वैश्रवणं यमम्। वरुणं पावकं चैव कृपं कृष्णं च माधवम्॥ पिनाकपाणिनं चैव कथमेतान् न योधये। रथं वाहय मे शीघ्रं व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः॥
en: Then smiling Partha said to him-"What friendly follower I had, O hero, while fighting with the powerful Gandharvas on the occasion of Ghoshayatra? Who was my friend while fighting at a terrible battle at Khandava with so many celestials and Danavas? Who was my friend, when I fought for the celestials with the powerful Nivatakavachas and the Paulamas? And who was my friend when I fought with the numberless kings at the Svayamvara of the princess of Panchala? Learning the art of fighting from the preceptor Drona, Shakra, Vaishravana, Yama, Varuna, Agni, Kripa, Krishna of Madhu's race and the holder of trident why shall I not fight with these? Drive this car speedily-and let the fears of your heart be removed.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच उत्तरं सारथि कृत्वा शमीं कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम्। आयुधं सर्वमादाय प्रययौ पाण्डवर्षभः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Making Uttara his charioteer and going round the Shami tree the son of Pandu taking all his weapons set out.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: ध्वजं सिंहं स्थात् तस्मादपनीय महारथिः। प्रणिधाय शमीमूले प्रायादुत्तरसारथः॥
en: Having taken down the banner with the lion's figure and placed it at the foot of the Shami tree the mighty car-warrior set out with Uttara as his charioteer,

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: दैवीं मायां रथे युक्तां विहितां विश्वकर्मणा। काञ्चनं सिंहलाङ्गलं ध्वजं वानरलक्षणम्॥
en: He hoisted on his chariot the golden flag having the emblem of a monkey which was a celestials illusion created by Vishvakarman.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: मनसा चिन्तयामास प्रसादं पावकस्य च। स च तच्चिन्तितं ज्ञात्वा ध्वजे भूतान्यदेशयत्॥
en: As soon as he thought of the favour of Agni in his mind the deity, knowing his desire, ordered the creatures (to sit) on the flag.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: सपताकं विचित्राङ्गं सोपासङ्गं महाबलम्। खात् पपात रथे तूर्णं दिव्यरूपं मनोरमम्॥
en: A celestial and charming flag-staff adorned with gold, furnished with a handsome banner and quivers attached to it, immediately fell on the car from the sky.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: रथं तमागतं दृष्ट्वा दक्षिणं प्राकरोत् तदा। रथमास्थाय बीभत्सुः कौन्तेयः श्वेतवाहनः॥ बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणः प्रगृहीतशरासनः। ततः प्रायादुदीचिं च कपिप्रवरकेतनः॥
en: Seeing the banner reach his car the hero went round it reverentially. Then getting on his car, Bibhatsu, the son of Kunti, having white steeds and the emblem of a monkey on his banner, having his fingers protected by the gloves of Inguana skin, and taking up his bow and arrows, started in a northerly direction.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: स्वनवन्तं महाशङ्ख बलवानरिमर्दनः। प्राधमद् बलमास्थाय द्विषतां लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: Then that highly powerful repressor of foes, energetically blew his large conch-shell of thundering sound, capable of making the hairs of the body of his enemies stand erect.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: ततस्ते जवना धुर्या जानुभ्यामगमन्महीम्। उत्तरश्चापि संत्रस्तो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्॥
en: At that sound the quick-coursing horses dropped down their knees on earth. Uttara too, stricken with fear, sat down on the car.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: संस्थाप्य चाश्वान् कौन्तेयः समुद्यम्य च रश्मिभिः। उत्तरं च परिष्वज्य समाश्वासयदर्जुनः॥
en: Then raising the horses up with reins and keeping them in their proper places and embracing Uttara, Arjuna, the son of Kunti, consoled him.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच मा भैस्त्वं राजपुत्राग्य क्षत्रियोऽसि परंतप। कथं तु पुरुषव्याघ्र शत्रुमध्ये विषीदसि॥
en: Arjuna said O foremost of princes, O slayer of foes, be not afraid; you are a Kshatriya; why do you look sorry, O foremost of men, in the midst of enemies?

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: श्रुतास्ते शङ्खशब्दाश्च भेरीशब्दाश्च पुष्कलाः। कुञ्चराणां च नदतां व्यूढानीकेषु तिष्ठताम्॥
en: You have heard enough of the sound of my conch shells as well as that of trumpets and the roar of many elephants in the midst of soldiers arranged for battle.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: स त्वं कथमिहानेन शङ्खशब्देन भीषितः। विवर्णरूपो वित्रस्तः पुरुषः प्राकृतो यथा॥
en: Why are you therefore, so dispirited agitated and terrified by the sound of the conch like an ordinary man.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: उत्तर उवाच श्रुता मे शङ्खशब्दाश्च भेरीशब्दाश्च पुष्कलाः। कुट्ठाराणां निनदतां व्यूढानीकेषु तिष्ठताम्॥ नैवंविधः शङ्खशब्दः पुरा जातु मया श्रुतः। ध्वजस्य चापि रूपं मे दृष्टपूर्वं न हीदृशम्॥
en: Uttara said I have heard the sound of many a conch and many a trumpet and the roar of many an elephant in the battle field but never have I heard the sound of such a conch. Never have I seen before a flag like this.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: धनुष्श्चैव निर्घोषः श्रुतपूर्वो न मे क्वचित्। अस्य शङ्खस्य शब्देन धनुषो निस्वनेन च॥ अमानुषाणां शब्देन भूतानां ध्वजवासिनाम्। रथस्य च निनादेन मनो मुह्यति मे भृशम्॥
en: Never have I heard before the twang of such a bow. With the blowing of this conch, the twang of this bow, the superhuman cries of creatures placed on the banner, and with the rattle of this chariot my mind has been greatly agitated.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: व्याकुलाश्च दिशः सर्वा हृदयं व्यथतीव मे। ध्वजेन पिहिताः सर्वा दिशो न प्रतिभान्ति मे॥ गाण्डीवस्य च शब्देन की मे बधिरीकृतौ। स मुहूर्त प्रयातं तु पार्थो वैराटिमब्रवीत्॥
en: All the quarters have been agitated and my mind has been pained; all the quarters have been covered with flags and thus do not come to my view. With the twang of the Gandiva my ears have been deafened.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच एकान्तं रथमास्थाय पद्भ्यां त्वमवपीडयन्। दृढं च रश्मीन् संयच्छ शङ्खध्मास्याम्यहं पुनः॥
en: Arjuna said Stand you firmly on this chariot, pressing your feet on it. Get hold lightly of the reins for I will blow the conch again.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः शङ्खमुपाध्मासीद् दारयन्निव पर्वतान्। गुहा गिरीणां च तदा दिशः शैलांस्तथैव च।
en: Vaishampayana said Arjuna blew the conch again which caused grief in the enemies and increased the delight of the friends.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: उत्तरश्चापि संलीनो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्॥ तस्य शङ्खस्य शब्देन स्थनेमिस्वनेन च।
en: (It seemed to rend) the caves of the mountains, hills and the quarters. Uttara too, clinging to it, sat on the car.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: गाण्डीवस्य च घोषेण पृथिवी समकम्पत॥ तं समाश्वासयामास पुनरेव धनंजयः॥
en: The earth shook with the sound of the conch, rattle of the car and the twang of the Gandiva. And Dhananjaya again consoled him.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: द्रोण उवाच यथा रथस्य निर्घोषो यथा मेघ उदीर्यते। कम्पते च यथा भूमि षोऽन्यः सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: Drona said From the rattle of the car, from the way in which the clouds have appeared, and in which the earth shakes he is none other than Savyasachin.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: शस्त्राणि न प्रकाशन्ते न प्रहृष्यन्ति वाजिनः। अग्नयश्च न भासन्ते समिद्धास्तन्न शोभनम्॥
en: Our arms do not shine, our horses are dispirited and our fires, although fuel is added to them, do not blaze up.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: प्रत्यादित्यं च नः सर्वे मृगा घोरप्रवादिनः। ध्वजेषु च निलीयन्ते वायसास्तन्न शोभनम्॥
en: All the animals, looking towards the sun, are yelling dreadfully and the crows are perching on our banners. This is not auspicious.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: शकुनाश्चापसव्या नो वेदयन्ति महद् भयम्॥ गोमायुरेष सेनांयां रुदन् मध्येन धावति।
en: The vultures and kites are in the right path and presage a great danger. And the jackal too crying runs about in the midst of the army.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: अनाहतश्च निष्क्रान्तो महद् वेदयते भयम्॥ भवतां रोमकूपाणि प्रहृष्टान्युपलक्षये।
en: An they go out openly. It presages a great calamity. The hairs of your bodies are seen to stand on their ends.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: ध्रुवं विनाशो युद्धेन क्षत्रियाणां प्रदृश्यते॥ ज्योतींषि न प्रकाशन्ते दारुणा मृगपक्षिणः।
en: Forsooth this presages a great destruction of the Kshatriyas in battle; the shining objects do not come in view and the birds and beasts appear frightful.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: उत्पाता विविधा घोरा दृश्यन्ते क्षत्रनाशनाः॥ विशेषत इहास्माकं निमित्तानि विनाशने।
en: Many portents are seen presaging the destruction of the Kshatriyas. And this particularly portends a great havoc amongst ourselves.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: उल्काभिश्च प्रदीप्ताभिर्बाध्यते पृतना तव। वाहनान्यप्रहृष्टानि रुदन्तीव विशाम्पते॥
en: Your army is assailed by these burning meteors and the animals, O king, seem to be shorn of cheerfulness and are as if weeping.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: उपासते च सैन्यानि गृध्रास्तव समन्ततः। तप्स्यसे वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा पार्थवाणप्रपीडिताम्। पराभूता च वः सेना न कश्चिद् योद्भुमिच्छति॥
en: Vulture and kites are moving all around your army. You will repent when you will see your soldiers assailed by Partha's shafts.

description: The seeing of omens in Goharana
sn: विवर्णमुखभूयिष्ठाः सर्वे योधा विचेतसः। गाः सम्प्रस्थाप्य तिष्ठामो व्यूढानीकाः प्रहारिणः॥
en: Our army is already defeated for, none wishes to fight. All the soldiers appear pale and dispirited. Placing the kine before, we should all stand here arranged in battle array, and ready to strike.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच अथ दुर्योधनो राजा समरे भीष्ममब्रवीत्। द्रोणं च रथशार्दूलं कृपं च सुमहारथम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then the king Duryodhana said in the battle field to Bhishma, Drona, the foremost of warriors and as also to the mighty car-warrior Kripa.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: उक्तोऽयमर्थ आचार्यो मया कर्णेन चासकृत्। पुनरेव प्रवक्ष्यामि न हि तृष्यामि तं ब्रुवन्॥
en: Both myself and Karna had said this to the preceptor. I mention it again for I am not satisfied with speaking (once).

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: पराभूतैर्हि वस्तव्यं तैश्च द्वादश वत्सरान्। वने जनपदे ज्ञातैरेप एव पणो हि नः॥
en: This was the condition that if defeated at dice the Pandavas will live in woods and countries for twelve years unknown to us.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: तेषां न तावन्निर्वृत्तं वर्तते तु त्रयोदशम्। अज्ञातवासो बीभत्सुरथास्माभिः समागतः॥
en: The thirteenth year is still going on and not yet complete. Bibhatsu, who is living in disguise, has come to us.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: अनिवृत्ते तु निर्वासे यदि बीभत्सुरागतः। पुनादश वर्षाणि वने वत्स्यन्ति पाण्डवाः॥
en: Now if Bibhatsu comes before the term of exile is over, the Pandavas shall have to pass another twelve years in the forest.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: लोभाद् वा ते न जानीयुरस्मान् वा मोह आविशत्। हीनातिरिक्तमेतेषां भीष्मो वेदितुमर्हति॥
en: Whether by covetousness they have forgotten it or whether it is a mistake on our part, it is proper that Bhishma should calculate the shortness or excess (of the fixed period).

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: अर्थानां च पुनद्वैध नित्यं भवति संशयः। अन्यथा चिन्तितो ह्यर्थः पुनर्भवति सोऽन्यथा।॥
en: Doubt always exists in one of the alternatives of an object; an object, thought of in one way, becomes another (in the end). Even persons, conversant with morality, are confounded in their own acts; (we have come) to fight with the Matsya's stationed in the north.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: उत्तरं मार्गमाणानां मत्स्यानां च युयुत्सताम्। यदि बीभत्सुरायातस्तदा कस्यापरानुमः॥ त्रिगर्तानां वयं हेतोर्मत्स्यान् योद्भुमिहागताः।
en: If however Bibhatsu has come what fault is ours? We have here to fight with the Matsya's on behalf of the Trigartas.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: मत्स्यानां विप्रकारांस्ते बहूनस्मानकीर्तयन्॥ तेषां भयाभिभूतानां तदस्माभिः प्रतिश्रुतम्। प्रथमं तैर्ग्रहीतव्यं मत्स्यानां गोधनं महत्। सप्तम्यामपराठे वै तथा तैस्तु समाहितम्॥
en: Various were the oppressions of the Matsya's described to us-and we promised them help, assailed with fear as they were. And the arrangement with them was that they should first, on the afternoon of the seventh lunar day, seize the great collection of the precious kine of the Matsya's.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: अष्टम्यां पुनरस्माभिरादित्यस्योदयं प्रति। इमा गावो ग्रहीतव्या गते मत्स्ये गवां पदम्॥
en: And at sun-rise of the eighth lunar day we should seize these kine when the king of Matsya's would be pursuing those seized first,

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: ते वा गाश्चानयिष्यन्ति यदि वा स्युः पराजिताः। अस्मान् वा [पसंधाय कुर्युर्मत्स्येन संगतम्॥
en: It may be that they are bringing the kine, or being defeated are coming to us for negotiating peace with the Matsya's.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
