sn: अथवा तानपाहाय मत्स्यो जानपदैः सह। सर्वया सेनया साधु संवृतो भीमरूपया। आयातः केवलं रात्रिमस्मान् योद्भुमिहागतः॥ तेषामेव महावीर्यः कश्चिदेष पुरःसरः। असमाढोतुमिहायातो मत्स्यो वापि स्वयं भवेत्॥ यद्येष राजा मत्स्यानां यदि बीभत्सुरागतः। सर्योद्धव्यमस्माभिरिति नः समयः कृतः॥ अथ कस्मात् स्थिता ह्येते रथेषु रथसत्तमाः। भीष्मो द्रोणः कृपश्चैव विकर्णो द्रौणिरेव च॥ सम्भ्रान्तमनसः सर्वे काले ह्यस्मिन् महारथाः।
en: Or it may be that having driven them off, the king of Matsya's, leading his people and his army of fierce warriors, income to make upon us night attacks. Perhaps someone powerful amongst them or even the king of Matsya's himself is coming to defeat us. Be he the king of Matsya's or Bibhatsu, we must all fight with him. This is our condition. Why are all these leading car-warriors Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Vikarana and Drona's son now sitting panic-stricken on their cars?

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: नान्यत्र युद्धाच्छ्रेयोऽस्ति तथाऽऽत्मा प्रणिधीयताम्॥१७ आच्छिन्ने गोधनेऽस्माकमपि देवेन वज्रिणा। यमेन वापि संग्रामे को हास्तिनपुरं व्रजेत्॥ शरैरेभिः प्रणुनानां भग्नानां गहने वने। को हि जीवेत् पदातीनां भवेदश्वेषु संशयः॥ दुर्योधनवचः श्रुत्वा राधेयस्त्वब्रवीद् वचः। आचार्य पृष्ठतः कृत्वा तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम्॥
en: There is no other help but fighting now. Make up your minds, therefore, Even, for seizing these precious kine, we have got to fight with the Divine holder of thunder-bolt or with Yama. Who is there that will be able to go to Hastinapur? Pierced by my shafts, when running away from the battle field through the woods, who amongst the infantry shall be able to escape with his life, while that of the cavalry is so doubtful? Keeping, the preceptor behind, do you make all arrangements.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: जानाति हि मतं तेषामतस्त्रासयतीह नः। अर्जुने चास्य सम्प्रीतिमधिकामुपलक्षये।॥
en: He knows their views and strikes terror into our minds. I perceive his affection for Arjuna is very great.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: तथा हि दृष्ट्वा बीभत्सुमुपायान्तं प्रशंसति। यथा सेना न भज्येत तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम्॥ हृषितं ह्यपशृण्वाने द्रोणे सर्वं विघदृितम्।
en: Seeing him only come he sings the praises of Bibhatsu. Make such arrangements that our army may not break up. Every thing has been confused for Drona's having heard of his horses' neighs.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: अदेशिका महारण्ये ग्रीष्मे शत्रु वशं गताः। यथा न विभ्रमेत् सेना तथा नीतिविधीयताम्॥
en: Make such arrangement that these soldiers, coming to a distant country in the summer, and in the midst of this huge forest, may not be routed and vanquished by the enemy.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: इष्टा हि पाण्डवा नित्यमाचार्यस्य विशेषतः आसयनपरार्थाश्च कथ्यते स्म स्वयं तथा॥
en: The Pandavas are always the favourites of the preceptor. He betrays by his words that he is for others.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: अश्वानां हृषितं श्रुत्वा कः प्रशंसापरो भवेत्। स्थाने वापि व्रजन्तो वा सदा द्वेषन्ति वाजिनः।२५॥
en: Hearing only the neighs of horses who would ever praise a man? Whether walking or standing the horses neigh.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: सदा च वायवो वान्ति नित्यं वर्षति वासवः। स्तनयित्नोश्च निर्घोषः श्रूयते बहुशस्तथा॥
en: The winds always blow and Indra always showers rain and the roar of the clouds may be heard many times.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: किमत्र कार्यं पार्थस्य कथं वा स प्रशस्यते। अन्यत्र कामाद् द्वेषाद् वा रोषादस्मासु केवलात्॥
en: What has Partha to do with these and why should he be praised? It is so either for the desire of doing good to him or for hatred and anger towards us.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: आचार्या वै कारुणिकाः प्राज्ञाश्चापापदर्शिनः। नैते महाभये प्राप्ते सम्प्रष्टव्याः कथंचन॥
en: Preceptors are wise, virtuous and very kind to all creatures but they should not be consulted in hours of danger.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: प्रासादेषु विचित्रेषु गोष्ठीषूपवनेषु च। कथा विचित्राः कुर्वाणाः पण्डितास्तत्र शोभनाः।।२९।
en: It is in beautiful places, assemblies and gardens where beautiful speeches are to be made that the learned men seem to be in their proper places.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: बहून्याश्चर्यरूपाणि कुर्वाणा जनसंसदि। इज्यास्त्रे चोपसंधाने पण्डितास्तत्र शोभनाः॥
en: The learned shine in the concourse of men, where they perform many wonderful things and there where sacrificial vessels and their uses are necessary.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: परेषां विवरज्ञाने मनुष्यचरितेषु च। हस्त्यश्वरथचर्यासु खरोष्ट्राजाविकर्मणि।॥ गोधनेषु प्रतोलीषु वरद्वारमुखेषु च। अन्नसंस्कारदोषेषु पण्डितास्तत्र शोभनाः॥
en: In the knowledge of learning the weak points of others, in studying the characters of men, in the science of horses, elephants and cars, in treating the diseases of asses, camels, goats, sheep and kine, in making plans of buildings and gates, in pointing out the defects of food and drink the learned are truly in their elements.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: पण्डितान् पृष्ठतः कृत्वा परेषां गुणवादिनः। विधीयतां तता नीतिर्यथा वध्यो भवेत् परः॥
en: Leaving behind the learned who speak highly of the heroism of the enemy, do you so arrange that the enemy may be killed.

description: The words of Duryodhana, in Goharana
sn: गावश्च सम्प्रतिष्ठाप्य सेनां व्यूह्य समन्ततः। आरक्षाश्च विधीयन्तां यत्र योत्स्यामहे परान्॥
en: Keeping the kine secure arrange the army in battle array. Keep guards in proper places so that we may fight with the enemy.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: कर्ण उवाच सर्वानायुष्मतो भीतान् संत्रस्तानिव लक्षये। अयुद्धमनसश्चैव सर्वांश्चैवानवस्थितान्॥
en: Karna said I see all of you looking as if terrified and panic-stricken, not resolute and reluctant to fight.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: यद्येष राजा मत्स्यानां यदि बीभत्सुरागतः। अहमावारयिष्यामि वेलेव मकरालयम्॥
en: If he be the king of Matsya's or Bibhatsu that has come I shall resist him as the banks resist the waving sea.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: मम चापप्रयुक्तानां शराणां नतपर्वणाम्। नावृत्तिर्गच्छतां तेषां सर्पाणामिव सर्पताम्॥
en: These straight and shooting shafts, like gliding snakes that are discharged from my bow, never miss their aim.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: रुक्मपुङ्खाः सुतीक्ष्णाग्रा मुक्ता हस्तवता मया। छादयन्तु शराः पार्थं शलभा इव पादपम्॥
en: Discharged by my light hand these shafts, having highly sharpened points and feathered in gold, shall cover Partha like locusts covering a tree.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: शराणां पुखसक्तानां मौर्व्याभिहतया दृढम्। श्रूयतां तलयोः शब्दो भेर्योराहतयोरिव॥
en: Struck firm by these winged shafts the bow string will cause these gloves to produce a sound that will be heard to resemble that of a couple of kettle-drums.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: समाहितो हि बीभत्सुर्वर्षाण्यष्टौ च पञ्च च। जातस्नेहश्च युद्धेऽस्मिन् मयि सम्प्रहरिष्यति॥
en: Bibhatsu was engaged in religious meditation for the last thirteen years and so he will strike me mildly in the conflict.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: पात्रीभूतश्च कौन्तेयो ब्राह्मणो गुणवानिव। शरौघान् प्रतिगृह्णातु मया मुक्तान् सहस्रशः॥
en: Like a Brahmana, gifted with good qualities the son of Kunti has become the proper person to receive quietly thousands of arrow shot by me.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: एष चैव महेष्वासस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः। अहं चापि नरश्रेष्ठादर्जुनान्नावरः क्वचित्॥
en: This powerful bowman is known all over the three worlds and I am by no means inferior to Arjuna, that best of men.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: इतश्चेतश्च निर्मुक्तैः काञ्चनैर्गार्धवाजितैः। दृश्यतामद्य वै व्योम खद्योतैरिव संवृतम्॥
en: Golden arrows having the wings of vultures being discharged on all sides let the sky today appear as filled with fire flies.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: अद्याहमृणमक्षय्यं पुरा वाचा प्रतिश्रुतम्। धार्तराष्ट्राय दास्यामि निहत्य समरेऽर्जुनम्॥
en: Killing Arjuna in battle I shall satisfy, to day, the debt which it is hard to repay, I made formerly to Duryodhana.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: अन्तराच्छिद्यमानानां पुडानां व्यतिशीर्यताम्। शलभानामिवाकाशे प्रचारः सम्प्रदृश्यताम्॥
en: Who is there even amongst the celestials and Asura who is capable of withstanding the straight arrows discharged from my bow? Let my shooting arrows, winged and depressed at the middle, present the view of the fire flies passing through the sky.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शेर्महेन्द्रसमतेजसम्। अर्दयिष्याम्यहं पार्थमुल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Like a person assailing an elephant with fire-brands I shall grind Partha, hard as Indra's thunderbolt and equally equally energetic like Mahendra.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: रथादतिरथं शूरं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। विवशं पार्थमादास्ये गरुत्मानिव पन्नगम्॥
en: From my car I shall get hold of the unresisting Partha, a heroic car-warrior and the foremost of the holders of weapon like Garuda catching snakes.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: तमग्निमिव दुर्धर्षमसिशक्तिशरेन्धनम्। पाण्डवाग्निमहं दीप्तं प्रदहन्तमिवाहितम्॥ अश्ववेगपुरोवातो रथौघस्तनयित्नुमान्। शरधारो महामेघः शमयिष्यामि पाण्डवम्॥
en: Irrepressible like fire, excited by the fuel of swords, darts and arrows, that burning Pandava fire that consumes all enemies, I shall put out myself who am like a hue cloud continually pouring showers of arrows-the number of cars forming its thunder, and the speed of my horses being the wind going before.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: मत्कार्मुकविनिर्मुक्ता: पार्थमाशीविषोपमाः। शराः समभिसर्पन्तु वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः॥
en: Shot from my bow the arrows, resembling venomous snakes, will pierce Partha like serpents going through ant hills.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: सुतेजनै रुक्मपुकैः सुधौतेर्नतपर्वभिः। आचितं पश्य कौन्तेयं कर्णिकारिवाचलम्॥
en: Struck by gold-feathered, strong, straight and powerful arrows, behold the son of Kunti adorned like a hill covered with Karnikara flowers.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: जामदग्न्यान्मया शस्त्रं यत् प्राप्तमृषिसत्तमात्। तदुपाश्रित्य वीर्यं च युध्येयमपि वासवम्॥
en: Having obtained from that foremost of ascetic, the son of Jamadagni, my weapons, I would, depending upon their strength, fight even with the celestials.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: ध्वजाग्रे वानरस्तिष्ठन् भल्लेन निहतो मया। अद्यैव पततां भूमौ विनदन् भैरवान् रवान्॥
en: Struck with javelin, the monkey placed on his banner, shall fall down on the earth, uttering dreadful cries.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: शत्रोर्मया विपन्नानां भूतानां ध्वजवासिनाम्। दिशः प्रतिष्ठमानानामस्तु शब्दो दिवंगमः॥
en: The sky will be filled with the cries of the animals placed on the enemy's flag-staff and assailed by me they will fly away in all directions.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: अद्य दुर्योधनस्याहं शल्यं हृदि चिरस्थितम्। समूलमुद्धरिष्यामि बीभत्सुं पातयन् रथात्॥
en: I shall eradicate today the dart from Duryodhana's heart existing for a long time by dislodging Bibhatsu from his car.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: हताश्वं विरथं पार्थं पौरुषे पर्यवस्थितम्। निःश्वसन्तं यथा नागमद्य पश्यन्तु कौरवाः॥
en: The Kauravas will see today Partha with his car broken, steeds killed, the bravery gone and himself sighing like a serpent.

description: The words of Karna in Goharana
sn: कामं गच्छन्तु कुरवो धनमादाय केवलम्। रथेषु वापि तिष्ठन्तो युद्धं पश्यन्तु मामकम्॥
en: Let the Kauravas at their own will go away with the precious kine; if they wish let them remain on the chariot and behold the encounter.

description: The words of Kripa in Goharana
sn: कृप उवाच सदैव तव राधेय युद्धे क्रूरतरा मतिः। नार्थानां प्रकृति वेत्सि नानुबन्धमवेक्षसे॥
en: Kripa said O son of Radha, your crooked mind is always for the war. You do not understand the time and nature of things as well as their consequences.

description: The words of Kripa in Goharana
sn: माया हि बहवः सन्ति शास्त्रमाश्रित्य चिन्तिताः। तेषां युद्धं तु पापिष्ठं वेदयन्ति पुराविदः॥
en: There are many contrivances mentioned in the scriptures. Of them persons acquainted with the past history have mentioned battle as the most sinful.

description: The words of Kripa in Goharana
sn: देशकालेन संयुक्तं युद्धं विजयदं भवेत्। हीनकालं तदेवेह फलं न लभते पुनः। देशे काले च विक्रान्तं कल्याणाय विधीयते॥
en: It is only when undertaken in (proper) time and place that a battle produces success. This is not a favourable time and you will get no good fruit. Prowess, when manifested in proper hour and place, leads to well-being.

description: The words of Kripa in Goharana
sn: आनुकूल्येन कार्याणामन्तरं संविधीयते। भारं हि रथकारस्य न व्यवस्यन्ति पण्डिताः॥ परिचिन्त्य त पार्थेन संनिपातो न नः क्षमः।
en: It is by favourable signs that the advisability of an action is determined upon. Learned men never act depending upon the words of a car maker. Taking all this into consideration it is not proper for us to enter into an encounter with Partha.

description: The words of Kripa in Goharana
sn: एकः कुरूनभ्यगच्छदेक्श्चाग्निमतर्पयत्॥ एकश्च पञ्च वर्षाणि ब्रह्मचर्यमधारयत्।
en: Alone did he save the Kurus from the Gandharvas) and alone did he gìatify fire. And alone did he for five years lead the life of a Brahmacharin.

description: The words of Kripa in Goharana
sn: एकः सुभद्रामारोप्य द्वैरथे कृष्णमाह्वयत्॥ एकः किरातरूपेण स्थितं रुद्रमयोधयत्।
en: Taking Subhadra on his car alone did he challenge Krishna to a duel. And alone did he fight with Rudra who came before him in the disguise of a hunter.

description: The words of Kripa in Goharana
sn: अस्मिन्नेव वने पार्थो हतां कृष्णामवाजयत्॥ एकश्च पञ्च वर्षाणि शनादस्त्राण्यशिक्षत।
en: It was in this forest that he rescued Draupadi when she was being carried away (by Jayadratha). It is alone he that for five years studied the science of arms under Indra.

description: The words of Kripa in Goharana
sn: एकः सोऽयमरि जित्वा कुरूणामकरोद् यशः॥ एको गन्धर्वराजानं चित्रसेनमरिंदमः। विजिग्ये तरसा संख्ये सेनां प्राप्य सुदुर्जयाम्॥ तथा निवातकवचाः कालखढाश्च दानवाः। दैवतैरप्यवध्यास्ते एकेन युधि पातिताः॥ एकेन हि त्वया कर्ण किं नामेह कृतं पुरा। एकैकेन यथा तेषां भूमिपाला वशे कृताः॥ इन्द्रोऽपि हि न पार्थेन संयुगे योद्धुमर्हति।
en: Defeating alone all the enemies he has spread the glory of the Kurus. Alone did that chastiser of foes defeat in battle Chitrasena, the king of the Gandharvas and in a moment his invincible army also. He defeated alone in battle the dreadful Nivatakavachas and Kalakhanjas who were both incapable of being slain even by the celestials. What however, O Karna, have you accomplished single-handed like any one of the sons of Pandu each of whom had vanquished many kings? Even Indra is unable to face Partha in battle.

description: The words of Kripa in Goharana
sn: यस्तेनाशंसते योद्धं कर्तव्यं तस्य भेषजम्॥ आशीविषस्य क्रुद्धस्य पाणिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम्। अवमुच्य प्रदेशिन्या दंष्ट्रामादातुमिच्छसि॥ अथवा कुद्द्वारं मत्तमेकं एव चरन् वने। अनङ्कुशं समारुह्य नगरं गन्तुमिच्छसि॥ समिद्धं पावकं चैव घृतमेदोवसाहुतम्। घृताक्तश्चारवासास्त्वं मध्येनोत्तर्तुमिच्छसि॥ आत्मानं कः समुद्बद्ध्य कण्ठे बद्ध्वा महाशिलम्।
en: He who wishes to fight with Arjuna should take some medicine. You desire to take out the fangs of an angry, venomous snake by stretching out your right hand and extending your fore-finger. Or going alone in the forest you wish to ride an infuriated elephant and go to a town without a hook in hand. Or rubbed over with clarified butter and clad in silken raiment you wish to go through a burning fire blazing with fat, tallow and clarified butter.

description: The words of Kripa in Goharana
sn: समुद्रं तरते दोभ्यां तत्र किं नाम पौरुषम्॥ अकृतास्त्रः कृतास्त्रं वै बलवन्तं सुदुर्बलः। तादृशं कर्ण यः पार्थं योद्धुमिच्छेत् स दुर्मतिः॥ अस्माभिर्वेष निकृतो वर्षाणीह त्रयोदश। सिंहः पाशविनिर्मुक्तो न नः शेषं करिष्यति॥ एकान्ते पार्थमासीनं कूपेऽग्निमिव संवृतम्। अज्ञानादभ्यवस्कन्ध प्राप्ताः स्मो भयमुत्तमम्॥ सह युध्यामहे पार्थमागतं युद्धदुर्मदम्।
en: Who, binding himself hand and foot and tying a huge stone to his neck, would wish to swim across the ocean with his bare arms? What manliness is there? O Karna, a fool is he, who, without strength and skill in arms, desires to fight with Partha who is so powerful and skilled in weapons? Oppressed by us and freed from thirteen years' exile, will he not destroy us like a lion liberated from the noose? Having unknowingly come to a place where Partha lay hidden like fire we have been exposed to a great danger. Although dreadful in battle we should fight against him.

description: The words of Kripa in Goharana
sn: सैन्यास्तिष्ठन्तु संनद्धा व्यूढानीकाः प्रहारिणः॥ द्रोणो दुर्योधनो भीष्मो भवान् द्रौणिस्तथा वयम्। सर्वे युध्यामहे पार्थं कर्ण मा साहसं कृथाः॥ वयं व्यवसितं पार्थं वज्रपाणिमिवोद्यतम्। षड्रथाः प्रतियुध्येम तिष्ठेम यदि संहताः॥ व्यूढानीकानि सैन्यानि यत्ताः परमधन्विनः। युध्यामहेऽर्जुनं संख्ये दानवा इव वासवम्॥
en: Let our army, clad in coats of mail, stand here in battle array ready to strike. Let Drona, Duryodhana, Bhishma, yourself, Drona's son and ourselves all fight with Partha. Do not, O Karna, act rashly. If we six are united and set forth our energy we may fight with or stand before Partha, fierce like the wielder of thunderbolt. With our soldiers in battle array, we, great bowmen as we are, will fight carefully with Arjuna as the Danavas fought with Vasava.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: अश्वत्थामोवाच न च तावज्जिता गावो न च सीमान्तरं गताः। न हास्तिनपुरं प्राप्तास्त्वं च कर्ण विकत्थसे॥
en: Ashvathama said The kine have not yet been acquired. Nor have they gone over the boundary. Nor have they gone to Hastinapur. Why do you, Karna, boast?

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: संग्रामांश्च बहूञ्जित्वा लब्ध्वा च विपुलं धनम्। विजित्य च परां सेनां नाहुः किंचन पौरुषम्॥
en: Even having won many a battle, amassed a vast fortune, vanquished their enemies, armies, truly heroic men do not utter a single word of their prowess.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: दहत्यग्निरवाक्यस्तु तूष्णीं भाति दिवाकरः। तूष्णीं धारयते लोकान् वसुधा सचराचरान्॥
en: Fire burns silently and silently does the sun shine. And the earth does bear creatures mobile and immobile without a single word.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य कर्माणि विहितानि स्वयम्भुवा। धनं यैरधिगन्तव्यं यच्च कुर्वन् न दुष्यति॥
en: The actions of the four orders have been ordained by the Self Sprung (Brahma) so that they may acquire wealth without committing a sinful act.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: अधीत्य ब्राह्मणो वेदान् याजयेत यजेत वा। क्षत्रियो धनुराश्रित्य यजेच्चैव न याजयेत्॥
en: Having studied the Vedas, the Brahmanas should perform sacrifices and officiate as priests. Resorting to their vows the Kshatriyas should perform sacrifices and never officiate as priests.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: वैश्योऽधिगम्य वित्तानि ब्रह्मकर्माणि कारयेत्। शूद्रः शुश्रूषणं कुर्यात् त्रिषु वर्णेषु नित्यशः। वन्दनायोगविधिभिर्वैतसी वृत्तिमास्थितः॥
en: Having amassed wealth the Vaishyas should perform the Vedic rites there with. A Shudra should always attend to and serve the other three orders, having recourse to flattery as the means of livelihood and behaving (cringlingly) like the cane.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: वर्तमाना यथाशास्त्रं प्राप्य चापि महीमिमाम्। सत्कुर्वन्ति महाभागा गुरून् सुविगुणानपि॥
en: Duly following the the scriptures they obtained this entire earth and those great men always act respectfully to their elders even if the latter prove adverse to them,

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: प्राप्य द्यूतेन को राज्यं क्षत्रियस्तोष्टुमर्हति। तथा नृशंसरूपोऽयं धार्तराष्ट्रश्च निघृणः॥
en: What Kshatriya on this earth expresses joy for having acquired a kingdom by gambling like this wicked and shameless son of Dhritarashtra?

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: तथाधिगम्य वित्तानि को विकत्थेद् विचक्षणः। निकृत्या वञ्चनायोगैश्चरन् वैतंसिको यथा।॥
en: Having acquired riches in this way by deceit and fraud like a seller of meat what wise man would boast of it?

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: कतमद् द्वैरथं युद्धं यत्राजैषीर्धनंजयम्। नकुलं सहदेवं वा धनं येषां त्वया हतम्॥
en: In what single combat did you ever defeat Dhananjaya, Nakula or Sahadeva although you have robbed them of their riches?

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: युधिष्ठिरो जित: कस्मिन् भीमश्च बलिनां वरः। इन्द्रप्रस्थं त्वया कस्मिन् संग्रामे निर्जितं पुरा॥
en: Has Yudhishthira, or Bhima the foremost of the strong, been defeated by you? In what battle was Indraprastha conquered by you?

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: तथैव कतमद् युद्धं यस्मिन् कृष्णा जिता त्वया। एकवस्त्रा सभां नीता दुष्टकर्मन् रजस्वला॥
en: By what battle did you win Krishna, that, O you of wicked deeds, you did drag her to the assembly when she was in her course and had one cloth on?

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: मूलमेषां महत् कृत्तं साराथी चन्दनं यथा। कर्म कारयिथाः सूत तत्र किं विदुरोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: You have cut the great root of the Sala tree. Actuated by greed when you made them work as slaves what did Vidura say?

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: यथाशक्ति मनुष्याणां शममालक्षयामहे। अन्येषामपि सत्त्वानामपि कीटपिपीलिकैः।
en: Men and others, even insects and ants show forgiveness as much as lies in their power.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: द्रौपद्याः सम्परिक्लेशं न क्षन्तुं पाण्डवोऽर्हति॥ क्षयाय धार्तराष्ट्राणां प्रादुर्भूतो धनंजयः।
en: The Pandava can never forgive your distressing Draupadi. Dhananjaya is born for the destruction of Dhritarashtra's sons.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: त्वं पुनः पण्डितो भूत्वा वाचं वक्तुमिहेच्छसि॥ वैरान्तकरणो जिष्णुर्न नः शेषं करिष्यति॥
en: Appearing as a learned man you are making speeches, but will not Bibhatsu, the slayer of enemies, exterminate us all?

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: नैष देवान् न गन्धर्वान् नासुरान् न च राक्षसान्। भयादिह न युध्येत कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti, never from fear, withdraws himself from fighting even if it be with the Gandharvas, Asuras or Rakshasas.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: यं यमेषोऽतिसंक्रुद्धः संग्रामे निपतिष्यति। वृक्षं गरुत्मान् वेगेन विनिहत्य तमेष्यति॥
en: On whom he will fall enraged in battle he will over-throw him like a tree by the velocity of Garuda.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: त्वत्तो विशिष्टं वीर्येण धनुष्यमरराट्समम्। वासुदेवसमं युद्धे तं पार्थं को न पूजयेत्॥
en: Who will not praise Partha, who is superior to yourself in prowess, equal to the king of the gods in bowmanship and equal to Vasudeva himself in battle?

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: देवं दैवेन युध्येत मानुषेण च मानुषम्। अस्त्रं ह्यस्त्रेण यो हन्यात् कोऽर्जुनेन समः पुमान्।।२०
en: What man is equal to Arjuna who counteracts the celestials weapons with celestials and human weapons with human?

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: पुत्रादनन्तरं शिष्य इति धर्मविदो विदुः। एतेनापि निमित्तेन प्रियो द्रोणस्य पाण्डवः॥
en: Persons conversant with virtue say that a disciple is not different from a son. It is for this reason Arjuna is favourite with Drona.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: यथा त्वमकरो तमिन्द्रप्रस्थं यथाऽऽहरः। यथाऽऽनैषीः सभां कृष्णां तथा युध्यस्व पाण्डवम्॥
en: Do you fight with the Pandavas in the same way by which you defeated them at dice, by which you conquered Indraprastha and dragged Krishna to the assembly hall.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: अयं ते मातुल: प्राज्ञः क्षत्रधर्मस्य कोविदः। दुर्दूतदेवी गान्धारः शकुनियुध्यतामिह॥
en: Let your uncle the deceitful gambler Shakuni, the prince of Gandhara, fully versed in the duties of the Kshatriyas, fight now.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: नाक्षान् क्षिपति गाण्डीवं न कृतं द्वापरं न च। ज्वलतो निशितान् बाणांस्तांस्तान् क्षिपति गाण्डिवम्॥
en: The Gandiva (bow) does not cast dice such as, the Krita or Dwapara but it discharges burning and sharpened arrows.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: न हि गाण्डीवनिर्मुक्ता गार्धपक्षाः सुतेजनाः। नान्तरेष्ववतिष्ठन्ते गिरीणामपि दारणाः॥
en: The dreadful arrows, shot from Gandiva of great might and winged like vultures, can rend even the mountains.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: अन्तकः पवनो मृत्युस्तथाग्निर्वडवामुखः। कुर्युरेते क्वचिच्छेषं न तु क्रुद्धो धनंजयः॥
en: The regent of Dead, the god of air and the horse-faced god of fire, leave some thing behind but Dhananjaya, worked up with anger, never does so.

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: यथा सभायां द्यूतं त्वं मातुलेन सहाकरोः। तथा युध्यस्व संग्रामे सौबलेन सुरक्षितः॥
en: As backed by your uncle you played at dice in the assembly hall so do you now fight well-protected by Subala's son?

description: The words of Ashvathama in Goharana
sn: युध्यन्तां कामतो योधा नाहं योत्स्ये धनंजयम्। मत्स्यो ह्यस्माभिरायोध्यो यद्यागच्छेद् गवां पदम्॥२८।
en: Let any one else, if he likes, fight, I shall not fight with Dhananjaya. We shall fight with the king of Matsya's if he comes following the track of kine.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: भीष्म उवाच साधु पश्यति वै द्रौणिः कृपः साध्वनुपश्यति। कर्णस्तु क्षत्रधर्मेण केवलं योद्भुमिच्छति॥
en: Bhishma said Drona's son observes well. Kripa observes well. Only for the observance of Kshatriya duties Karna wishes to fight.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: आचार्यो नाभिवक्तव्यं पुरुषेण विजानता। देशकालौ तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य योद्धव्यमिति मे मतिः॥
en: No wise man can find fault with the preceptor. In my view we must fight considering time and place.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: यस्य सूर्यसमाः पञ्च सपत्नाः स्युः प्रहारिणः। कथमभ्युदये तेषां न प्रमुह्येत पण्डितः॥
en: Why should not a wise man be bewildered who has five adversaries effulgent as the sun, who are experts in smiting and have just come out from adversity?

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: स्वार्थे सर्वे विमुह्यन्ति येऽपि धर्मविदो जनाः। तस्माद् राजन् ब्रवीम्येष वाक्यं ते यदि रोचते॥
en: Even persons, conversant with morality, are bewildered in their own interests. It is for this I tell you, O king, whether my words be acceptable to you or not.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: कर्णो हि यदवोचत् त्वां तेजः संजननाय तत्। आचार्यपुत्रः क्षमतां महत् कार्यमुपस्थितम्॥
en: What Karna said to you was for inciting our energy. The preceptor's son should forgive us for a very important business is present.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: नायं कालो विरोधस्य कौन्तेये समुपस्थिते। क्षन्तव्यं भवता सर्वमाचार्येण कृपेण च॥
en: When the son of Kunti has come it is not the time for dissension. Yourself and the preceptor and Kripa should forgive everything

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: भवतां हि कृतास्त्रत्वं यथाऽऽदित्ये प्रभा तथा। यथा चन्द्रमसो लक्ष्मीः सर्वथा नापकृष्यते॥ एवं भवत्सु ब्राह्मण्यं ब्रह्मास्त्रं च प्रतिष्ठितम्। चत्वार एकतो वेदाः क्षात्रमेकत्र दृश्यते॥
en: The mastery of weapons is in you as the rays are in the sun. As Lakshmi is never separated from the moon, so the Vedas and the Brahma weapons are always established in you. It is seen that the four Vedas exist in one place and all the attributes of a Kshatriya exist in another place.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: नैतत् समस्तमुभयं कस्मिंसश्चिदनुशुश्रुम। अन्यत्र भारताचार्यात् सपुत्रादिति मे मतिः॥
en: We have never heard of these two living together in any man than in the preceptor of the Bharata's race and his son. This is my conviction.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: वेदान्ताश्च पुराणानि इतिहासं पुरातनम्। जामदग्न्यमृते राजन् को द्रोणादधिको भवेत्॥
en: In Vedantas, in Puranas and in Itihasas, who, O king except Jamadagni, is superior to Drona?

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: ब्रह्मास्त्रं चैव वेदाश्च नैतदन्यत्र दृश्यते। आचार्यपुत्रः क्षमतां नायं कालो विभेदने॥ सर्वे संहत्य युध्यामः पाकशासनिमागतम्॥
en: The (mastery) of Brahma weapons and (the knowledge of) the Vedas combined are not seen in any other person than that best of men, the preceptor of Bharatas. The preceptor's son should forgive us. This is not the time for disunion. Let us all united fight with the son of the chastiser of Paka (Arjuna) who has come here.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: बलस्य व्यसनानीह यान्युक्तानि मनीषिभिः। मुख्यो भेदो हि तेषां तु पापिष्ठो विदुषां मतः॥
en: Of all the dangers to an army described by the intelligent the worst is the disunion amongst the leaders.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: अश्वत्थामोवाच नैव न्याय्यमिदं वाच्यमस्माकं पुरुषर्षभ। किं तु रोषपरीतेन गुरुणा भाषिता गुणाः॥
en: Ashvatthama said O foremost of men, the words that you have spoken to us are all just. The preceptor, filled with anger, has dilated upon his (Arjuna's) accomplishments.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: शत्रोरपि गुणा ग्राह्या दोषा वाच्या गुरोरपि। सर्वथा सर्वयत्नेन पुत्रे शिष्ये हितं वदेत्॥
en: The accomplishments even of the enemies should be mentioned and the defect of a preceptor should be pointed out. Therefore, one should, to the best of his power, describe the merit of his son or disciple.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: दुर्योधन उवाच आचार्य एव क्षमतां शान्तिरत्र विधीयताम्। अभिद्यमाने तु गुरौ तद् वृत्तं रोषकारितम्॥
en: Duryodhana said May the preceptor forgive us and establish peace. If the preceptor is not alienated everything would be done.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो दुर्योधनो द्रोणं क्षपयामास भारत। सह कर्णेन भीष्मेण कृपेण च महात्मना॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon, O Bharata, along with Karna, Bhishma and the high-souled Kripa Duryodhana made Drona to forgive them.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: द्रोण उवाच यदेतत् प्रथमं वाक्यं भीष्मः शान्तनवोऽब्रवीत्। तेनैवाहं प्रसन्नो वै नीतिरत्र विधीयताम्॥ यथा दुर्योधनं पार्थो नोपसर्पति संगरे।
en: Drona said I have already been pleased by the words, which Bhishma, the son of Shantanu at first gave vent to. Such a procedure should now be resorted to that the son of Pritha may not approach Duryodhana in the encounter and the latter may not pass into the hands of the enemies,

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: साहसाद् यदि वा मोहात् तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम्॥ वनवासे ह्यनिर्वृत्ते दर्शयेन धनंजयः।
en: Either through bravery or through foolishness. Let such a procedure be adopted. Arjuna shall not bring himself into our view before the expiration of the period of exile.

description: The words of Drona in Goharana
sn: धनं चालभमानोऽत्र नाद्य तत् क्षन्तुमर्हति॥ यथा नायं समायद्याद् धार्तराष्ट्रान् कथंचन। न च सेनाः पराजय्यात् तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम्॥ उक्तं दुर्योधनेनापि पुरस्ताद् वाक्यमीदृशम्। तदनुस्मृत्य गाङ्गेय यथावद् वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: By (merely) recovering the kine he will not forgive us. let therefore such a procedure be adopted that he can, by no means, vanquish the sons of Dhritarashtra and defeat our army. Similarly did Duryodhana speak before. Remembering all this, O Bhishma, tell us what you think proper.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: भीष्म उवाच कलाः काष्ठाश्च युज्यन्ते मुहूर्ताश्च दिनानि च। अर्धमासाश्च मासाश्च नक्षत्राणि ग्रहास्तथा॥ ऋतक्श्चापि युज्यन्ते तथा संवत्सरा अपि।
en: Bhishma said The wheel of time revolves with various divisions such as Kalas, Kashthas, Muhurtas, days, fortnights months, stars, planets, seasons and years.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: एवं कालविभागेन कालचक्र प्रवर्तते॥ तेषां कालातिरेकेण ज्योतिषां च व्यतिक्रमात्। पञ्चमे पञ्चमे वर्षे द्वौ मासावुपजायतः॥
en: On account of the excess of time and the constellations going on their courses there is an increase of two months in every five years.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: एषामभ्यधिका मासाः पञ्च च द्वादश क्षपाः। त्रयोदशानां वर्षाणामिति मे वर्तते मतिः॥
en: I think, calculating in this way, there will be an addition of five months and twelve nights within thirteen vears.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: सर्वं यथावच्चरितं यद् यदेभिः प्रतिश्रुतम्। एवमेतद् ध्रुवं ज्ञात्वा ततो बीभत्सुरागतः॥
en: They all have duly acted up to what they promised. Knowing all for certain Arjuna has come here.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: सर्वे चैव महात्मानः सर्वे धर्मार्थकोविदाः। येषां युधिष्ठिरो राजा कस्माद् धर्मेऽपराध्नुयुः॥
en: All of them are noble and well acquainted with virtue and worldly profit. They have Yudhishthira as their king. How can they injure virtue?

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: अलुब्धाश्चैव कौन्तेयाः कृतवन्तश्च दुष्करम्। न चापि केवलं राज्यमिच्छेयुस्तेऽनुपयतः॥
en: The sons of Kunti are not avaricious and they have performed a work which it is greatly difficult to do. They do not wish to acquire kingdom by unfair means.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: तदैव ते हि विक्रान्तुमीषुः कौरवनन्दनाः। धर्मपाशनिबद्धास्तु न चेलुः क्षत्रियव्रतात्॥
en: (If so) the descendants of Kuru would have liked to show their prowess at that time; virtuous as they are, they did not deviate from the duties of the Kshatriyas.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: यच्चानृत इति ख्यायाद् यः स गच्छेत् पराभवम्। णुयुर्मरणं पार्था नानृतत्वं कथंचन॥
en: Whoever will regard them as dishonest will meet with discomfiture today. The sons of Pritha will rather invite death but will never speak an untruth.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: प्राप्तकाले तु प्राप्तव्यं नोत्सृजेयुनरर्षभाः। अपि वज्रभृता गुप्तं तथावीर्या हि पाण्डवाः॥
en: Those great men, the Pandavas, powerful like him (Indra), will never part with a thing that comes to them in due time even if it is protected by the holder of thunder (Indra).

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: प्रतियुध्येम समरे सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। तस्माद् यदत्र कल्याणं लोके सिद्धिरनुष्ठितम्। तत् संविधीयतां शीघ्रं मा वो ह्यर्थोऽभ्यगात् परम्।। न हि पश्यामि संग्रामे कदाचिदपि कौरव। एकान्तसिद्धिं राजेन्द्र सम्प्राप्तश्च धनंजयः॥ सम्प्रवृत्ते तु संग्रामे भावाभावौ जयाजयौ। अवश्यमेकं स्पृशतो दृष्टमेतदसंशयम्॥
en: We shall have to content against, in battle, the foremost of all of all heroes; let such arrangements be made speedily, which are good and approved by the honest so that our properties may not pass into the hands of the enemies. O Kaurava, O emperor, I have never seen a battle in which one party is sure to come off victorious. (Besides) Arjuna has come. When a battle begins there is victory and defeat, prosperity and adversity. Therefore one must have either of the two. I have observed it without doubt.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: तस्माद् युद्धोचितं कर्म कर्म वा धर्मसंहितम्। क्रियतामाशु राजेन्द्र सम्प्राप्तश्च धनंजयः॥
en: Whether it is right or not you should, O king, make arrangements speedily for the battle for Arjuna has come.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: दुर्योधन उवाच नाहं राज्यं प्रदास्यामि पाण्डवानां पितामह। युद्धोपचारिक यत् तु तच्छीघ्रं प्रविधीयताम्॥
en: Duryodhana said I shall not, O grandfather, give back their kingdom to Pandavas. Therefore without delay, make arrangements for the battle.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: भीष्म उवाच अत्र या मामिका बुद्धिः श्रूयतां यदि रोचते। सर्वथा हि मया श्रेयो वक्तव्यं कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Bhishma said Hear what I think about this, if you like. I should always speak what is good, O descendant of Kuru.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: क्षिप्रं बलचतुर्भागं गृह्य गच्छ पुरं प्रति। ततोऽपरश्चतुर्भागो गाः समादाय गच्छतु॥
en: Quickly proceed towards the city with onefourth of the army. Let the other fourth part go away with the kine.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: वयं चार्धन सैन्यस्य प्रतियोत्स्याम पाण्डवम्। अहं द्रोणश्च कर्णश्च अश्वत्थामा कृपस्तथा। प्रतियोत्स्याम बीभत्सुमागतं कृतनिश्चयम्॥ मत्स्यं वा पुनरायातमागतं वा शतक्रतुम्। अहमावारयिष्यामि वेलेव मकरालयम्॥
en: With half the army we shall fight with Arjuna. Myself, Drona, Karna, the son of Drona, as well as Sharadvata's son, Shall firmly fight with Arjuna or the king of Matsya if he has come back or even with the performer of hundred sacrifices. I shall face them like the bank (obstructing the motion of the) ocean.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तद वाक्यं रुरुचे तेषां भीष्मेणोक्तं महात्मना। तथा हि कृतवान् राजा कौरवाणामनन्तरम्।॥
en: Vaishampayana said These words of the great Bhishma found favour with them and the king of Kauravas immediately carried them out.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: भीष्मः प्रस्थाप्य राजानं गोधनं तदनन्तरम्। सेनामुख्यान् व्यवस्थाप्य व्यूहितुं सम्प्रचक्रमे॥
en: Having sent away the king and thereafter the precious kine Bhishma addressed himself for arranging his troops in battle array.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: भीष्म उवाच आचार्य मध्ये तिष्ठ त्वमश्वत्थामा तु सव्यतः। कृपः शारद्वतो धीमान् पार्श्व रक्षतु दक्षिणम्॥
en: Bhishma said Stand you, O preceptor, in the middle; let Ashvathama defend the left wing and the intelligent son of Sharadvata Kripa protect the right wing.

description: The arrangement of troops by Bhishma
sn: अग्रतः सूतपुत्रस्तु कर्णस्तिष्ठतु दंशितः। अहं सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य पश्चात् स्थास्यामि पालयन्।।२३
en: Let Karna, the son of charioteer, clad in a coat of mail, stand in the front. And I shall command the entire army in the rear.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु कौरवेयेषु भारत। उपायादर्जुनस्तूर्णं रथघोषेण नादयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said After the mighty car-warriors of the Kurus had arrayed themselves in battle, sending out the rattle of their chariots, he quickly proceeded towards them.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: ददृशुस्ते ध्वजाग्रं वै शुश्रुवुश्च महास्वनम्। दोधूयमानस्य भृशं गाण्डीवस्य च निस्वनम्॥
en: They saw the top of his banner, heard the rattle of his car and the twang of his Gandiva bow, stretched greatly by him.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: ततस्तु सर्वमालोक्य द्रोणो वचनमब्रवीत्। महारथमनुप्राप्तं दृष्ट्वा गाण्डीवधन्विनम्॥
en: Observing all this and that the great carwarrior, the holder of the Gandiva bow has come, Drona said:

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: द्रोण उवाच एतद् ध्वजाग्रं पार्थस्य दूरतः सम्प्रकाशते। एष घोषः स रथजो रोरवीति च वानरः॥
en: The top of the banner which shines at a distance belongs to Arjuna; this is the rattle of his chariot and this is the monkey which is roaring.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: एष तिष्ठन् रथश्रेष्ठे रथे च रथिनां वरः। उत्कर्षति धनुः श्रेष्ठं गाण्डीवमशनिस्वनम्॥
en: The monkey strikes great terror into the hearts of all the soldiers. And sitting on that best of cars, the foremost of car-warriors.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: इमौ च बाणौ सहितौ पादयोर्मे व्यवस्थतौ। अपरौ चाप्यतिक्रान्तौ कर्णौ संस्पृश्य मे शरौ॥
en: Draws his best of bows Gandiva, that emits the sound of thunder. Those two arrows coming together touch my feet.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: निरुष्य हि वने वासं कृत्वा कर्मातिमानुषम्। अभिवादयते पार्थः श्रोत्रे च परिपृच्छति॥
en: Passing by others they touch my ears. Having completed the term of his exile in the forest and performed superhuman deeds,

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: चिरदृष्टोऽयमस्माभिः प्रज्ञावान् बान्धवप्रियः। अतीव ज्वलितो लक्ष्म्या पाण्डुपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Partha salutes me and speaks to my ears. After a long time we have seen the wise son of Pandu, Dhananjaya, ever a favourite to his friends and greatly shining in prosperity.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: रथी शरी चारुतली निषङ्गी शङ्खी पताकी कवची किरीटी। खड्गी च धन्वी च विभाति पार्थः शिखी वृतः स्रुग्भिरिवाज्यसिक्तः॥
en: Possessed of chariot and shafts, beautiful gloves and quivers, conch, flag, armour; and adorned with a crest, scimitar and bow Partha shines like fire fed with clarified butter and sacrificial laddles.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच इषुपाते च सेनाया हयान् संयच्छ सारथे। यावत् समीक्षे सैन्येऽस्मिन् क्वासौ कुरुकुलाधमः॥१०
en: “O charioteer, stop your horses at a place from which my arrows may reach the soldiers so long I do not single out from among them the wretch of the Kuru race (Duryodhana).

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: सर्वानेताननादृत्य दृष्ट्वा तमतिमानिनम्। तस्य मूर्ध्नि पतिष्यामि तत एते पराजिताः॥
en: Disregarding all these I shall find that vain wretch out and strike him down and then all these will be defeated.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: एष व्यवस्थितो द्रोणो द्रौणिश्च तदनन्तरम्। भीष्मः कृपश्च कर्णश्च महेष्वासाः समागताः॥
en: There stands Drona and thereafter his son and then those great bowmen Bhishma, Kripa and Karna.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: राजानं नात्र पश्यामि गाः समादाय गच्छति। दक्षिणं मार्गमास्थाय शङ्के जीवपरायणः॥ उत्सृजैतद् रथानीकं गच्छ यत्र सुयोधनः। तत्रैव योत्स्ये वैराटे नास्ति युद्धं निरामिषम्। तु तं जित्वा विनिवर्तिष्ये गा: समादाय वै पुनः॥
en: I do not see the king, I am afraid, anxious to save his life he is going by the southern road. Leaving the car-warriors here go where Suyodhana is. I shall fight there, O son of Virata, for it will not be without result. Vanquishing him I will come back with the kine.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः स वैराटिर्हयान् संयम्य यत्नतः। नियम्य च ततो रश्मीन् यत्र ते कुरुपुङ्गवाः। अचोदयत् ततो वाहान् यत्र दुर्योधनो गतः॥ उत्सृज्य रथवंशं प्रयाते श्वेतवाहने।
en: Thus addressed the son of Virata, carefully governing the horses and holding the reins, took the horses where the leading Kurus and the king Suyodhana were. As Arjuna, having white steeds, left that place,

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: अभिप्रायं विदित्वा च कृपो वचनमब्रवीत्॥ नैषोऽन्तरेण राजानं बीभत्सुः स्थातुमिच्छति।
en: Kripa, understanding his object, said: “Bibhatsu does not like to stand at a distance from the king."

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: तस्य पाणिं ग्रहीष्यामो जवेनाभिप्रयास्यतः॥ न ह्येनमतिसंक्रुद्धमेको युध्येत संयुगे।
en: We shall attach his sides who is advancing quickly. None can alone fight with him in battle when worked up with anger

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: अन्यो देवात् सहस्राक्षात् कृष्णाद् वा देवकीसुतात्। आचार्याश्च सपुत्राद् वा भारद्वाजान्महारथात्॥
en: Except the thousand-eyed Deity, Krishna, the son of Devaki, the preceptor his son, and the mighty car-warrior, the son of Bharadvaja.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: किं नो गावः करिष्यन्ति धनं वा विपुलं तथा। दुर्योधनः पार्थजले पुरा नौरिव मज्जति॥
en: What shall we do with these kine or the vast wealth if Duryodhana were to sink like a bark in the Partha water.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: तथैव गत्वा बीभत्सुर्नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः। शलभैरिव तां सेनां शरैः शीघ्रमवाकिरत्॥
en: (In the mean time) going there ard announcing himself as Bibhatsu by name he speedily covered the soldiers with shafts like a swarm of locusts.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: कीर्यमाणाः शरौघैस्तु योधास्ते पार्थचोदितैः। नापश्यन्नावृतां भूमिं नान्तरिक्षं च पत्रिभिः॥
en: Assailed by the mass of shafts discharged by Partha the warriors couldn't see anything, the sky and the earth being covered therewith.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: तेषामापततां युद्धे नापयानेऽभवन्मतिः। शीघ्रत्वमेव पार्थस्य पूजयन्ति स्म चेतसा॥
en: They who came to fight were so confounded that they even could not prepare themselves to fly away and began quickly to adore Partha in their minds.

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: ततः शङ्ख प्रदध्मौ स द्विषतां लोमहर्षणम्। विस्फार्य च धनुःश्रेष्ठं ध्वजे भूतान्यचोदयत्॥
en: He then blew the conch which made the hairs of the enemies stand erect; then twanging his most excellent bow he made the creatures on his flag staff (to cry aloud).

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: तस्य शङ्खस्य शब्देन रथनेमिस्वनेन च। गाण्डीवस्य च घोषेण पृथिवी समकम्पत॥
en: The earth shook with the sound of his conch, the rattle of his chariot and the twang of his Gandiva bow,

description: The return of the kine in the Goharana
sn: अमानुषाणां भूतानां तेषां च ध्वजवासिनाम्। ऊर्ध्वं पुच्छान् विधुन्वाना रेभमाणाः समन्ततः। गावः प्रतिन्यवर्तन्त दिशमास्थाय दक्षिणाम्॥
en: As well as with the cries of all the superhuman creatures placed on the flag staff. Then raising up their tails and running to and fro the king came back by the southern road.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच स शत्रुसेनां तरसा प्रणुद्य गास्ता विजित्याथ धनुर्धरा. गोषु प्रयातासु दुर्योधनायाभिमुखं प्रयातो भूयो रणं सोऽभिचिकीर्षमाणः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having quickly routed the enemy's host and recovered the kine, that foremost of bowmen, with a view to fight again, proceeded towards Duryodhana.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: जवेन मत्स्यान् किरीटिनं कृतकार्यं च मत्वा। दुर्योधनायाभिमुखं प्रयातं कुरुप्रवीराः सहसा निपेतुः॥
en: Seeing the kine run towards the city of Matsya's and considering Kiritin successful, the heroic Kurus all on a sudden withstood him who was proceeding towards Duryodhana.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: तेषामनीकानि बहूनि गाढं व्यूढानि दृष्ट्वा बहुलध्वजानि। मत्स्यस्य पुत्रं द्विषतां निहन्ता वैराटिमामन्त्र्य ततोऽभ्युवाच॥
en: Beholding their army and various well arranged divisions as well as numberless flags, that destroyer of enemies, addressing the son of Virata, the king of Matsya's, said,

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: एतेन तूर्णं प्रतिपादयेमान् श्वेतान् हयान् काञ्चनरश्मियोक्त्रान्। जवेन सर्वेण कुरु प्रयत्नमासादयेऽहं कुरुसिंहवृन्दम्॥
en: Soon take these white horses by this way, governed by golden reins. Do you quickly and carefully take me to the row of the leading Kuru heroes.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: गजो गजेनेव मया दुरात्मा योद्धं समाकाङ्क्षति सूतपुत्रः। तमेव मां प्रापय राजपुत्र दुर्योधनापाश्रयजातदर्पम्॥
en: The wicked-souled son of the charioteer (Karna) wishes to fight with me as an elephant does with another (elephant). Do you take me to him, O prince, who has grown insolent for the protection afforded to him by Duryodhana.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: स तैर्हयैर्वातजवैर्वृहद्धिः पुत्रो विराटस्य सुवर्णकः। व्यध्वंसयत् तद् रथिनामनीकं ततोऽवहत् पाण्डवमाजिमध्ये॥
en: Then breaking through the array of carwarriors with big horses fleet as the wind the son of Virata took Arjuna to the middle of the battle field.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: तं चित्रसेनो विशिखैर्विपाठः संग्रामजिच्छत्रुसहो जयश्च। प्रत्युद्ययुर्भारतमापतन्तं महारथाः कर्णमभीप्समानाः॥
en: Seeing this, those powerful car-warriors, Chitrasena, Sangramajit, Shatrusaha and Jaya with a view to help Karna, rushed towards the advancing Arjuna.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: ततः स तेषां पुरुषप्रवीरः शरासनार्चिः शरवेगतापः। वातं रथानामदहत् समन्युर्वनं यथाग्निः कुरुपुङ्गवानाम्॥
en: Thereupon worked up with anger that foremost of men began to consume, with blazing shafts, discharged from his bow, the cars of the leading Kurus like fire consuming the forest.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: तस्मिंस्तु युद्धे तुमुले प्रवृत्ते पार्थ विकर्णोऽतिरथं रथेन। विपाठवर्षेण कुरुप्रवीरो भीमेन भीमानुजमससाद॥
en: When the battle grew dreadful, Vikarana, a leading Kuru hero, getting upon his own chariot, moved towards that mighty carwarrior, Partha, the younger brother of Bhima with a dreadful downpour of shafts.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: ततो विकर्णस्य धनुर्विकृष्य जाम्बूनदाङ्मयोपचितं दृढज्यम्। च्छिन्नध्वजः सोऽप्यपयाज्ज्वेन।॥
en: Then cutting off his bow with a strong string and having its tops covered with gold he sundered-his Flag-staff. Then with his Flagstaff broken down he quickly took to heels.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: तं शात्रवाणां गणबाधितारं कर्माणि कुर्वन्तममानुपाणि। शत्रुतपः पार्थममृष्यमाण: समार्दयच्छर वर्षेण पार्थम्॥
en: Unable to check his anger, Shatruntapa, with a downpour of shafts, began to afflict Partha-the obstructor of the enemies and the author of superhuman deeds.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: स तेन राज्ञातिरथेन विद्धो विगाहमानो ध्वजिनी कुरूणाम्। शतपं पञ्चभिराशु विद्धा 'ततोऽस्य सूतं दशभिर्जघान॥
en: Then wounded by that king a mighty carwarrior and drowned as it were in the Kuru army he wounded Shatruntapa with five arrows and then killed his charioteer with ten.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: ततः स विद्धो भरतर्षभेण बाणेन गात्रावरणातिगेन। गतासुराजौ निपपात भूमौ नगो नगाग्रादिव वातरुग्णः॥
en: Then wounded by that foremost of Bharatas with a greatly piercing shaft the king leaving his armour fell down dead on the ground like a rock from the mountain summit clapped by the wind.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: नरर्षभास्तेन नरर्षभेण वीरा रणे वीरतरेण भग्नाः। चकम्पिरे वातवशेन काले प्रकम्पितानीव महावनानि॥
en: Assailed by the foremost of men, a greater hero, those heroic leaders of the Kurus began to tremble in battle like a huge forest shaken by the wind at the time of the universal dissolution.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: तास्तु पार्थेन नरप्रवीरा गतासवोर्त्यां सुषुपुः सुवेषाः। वसुप्रदा वासवतुल्यवीर्याः पराजिता वासवजेन संख्ये॥
en: Vanquished in battle and slain by Partha, the son of Indra, those heroes, givers of wealth and endued with the prowess of Vasava and well-dressed, slept on the ground, deprived of their lives,

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: सुवर्णकार्णायसवर्मनद्धा नागा यता हैमवता: प्रवृद्धाः। तथा स शत्रून् समरे विनिघ्नन्। गाण्डीवधन्वा पुरुषप्रवीरः॥
en: Like huge Himalaya elephants dressed with armours made of black steel decked with gold. Thus slaying his enemies in battle that heroic man, the holder of Gandiva bow,

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: चचार संख्ये विदिशो दिशश्च दहन्निवाग्निर्वनमातपान्ते। प्रकीर्णपर्णानि यथा वसन्ते विशातयित्वा पवनोऽम्बुदांश्च॥
en: Began to move about in the field in all direction like fire consuming a forest at the end of summer. As the wind blows in the spring scattering the withered leaves and clouds.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: तथा सपत्नान् विकिरन् किरीटी चचार संख्येऽतिरथो रथेन। शोणाश्ववाहस्य हयान् निहत्य वैकर्तनभ्रातुरदीनसत्त्वः। एकेन संग्रामजितः शरेण किरीटमाली।॥
en: So the mighty car-warrior Kiritin ranged in the battle field in his chariot dispersing his enemies. Then killing the horses of the brother of Vikartana's son, that one of undeteriorating energy. Ever victorious in battle and decked with a brilliant diadem, with one shaft, speedily cut off his head.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: तस्मिन् हते भ्रातरि सूतपुत्रो वैकर्तनो वीर्यमथाददानः। प्रगृह्य दन्ताविव नागराजो महर्षभं व्याघ्र इवाभ्यधावत्॥ (कर्तनः शीघ्रमथो जघान। शिरो जहाराथ
en: His brother being slain, the son of Suta, Vikartana's son, gathering his energy. Rushed towards that foremost of men like an elephant chief, with the two tusks out or like a tiger. And Vikartana's son quickly wounded Arjuna with twelve arrows.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: विव्याध गात्रेषु हयांश्च सर्वान् विराटपुत्रं च करे निजघ्ने॥ तमापतन्तं सहसा किरीटी वैकर्तनं वै तरसाभिपत्य। प्रगृह्य वेगं न्यपतज्जवेन नागं गरुत्मानिव चित्रपक्षः॥
en: All the horses on their bodies, and the son of Virata on the hand. Furiously hastening towards Vikartana's son who was quickly proceeding towards him, Kiritin attacked him with great force like Garuda of variegated plumage falling upon snakes.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: तावुत्तमौ सर्वधनुर्धराणां महाबलौ सर्वसपत्नसाहौ। कर्णस्य पार्थस्य निशम्य युद्धं दिदृक्षमाणाः कुरवोऽभितस्थुः॥
en: Both of them were best of bowmen, were greatly powerful and capable of killing all enemies. Understanding that an encounter was soon to take place between Karna and Partha, the Kurus, wishing to witness it, stood at a distance.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: स पाण्डवस्तूर्णमुदीर्णकोपः कृतागसं कर्णमुदीक्ष्य हर्षात्। मन्तर्दधे घोरशरौघवृष्ट्या॥
en: Seeing the iniquitous Karna, Arjuna, excited with anger, in great pleasure, quickly made him, his horses and his charioteer invisible by a thick downpour of arrows.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: ततः सुविद्धाः सरथाः सनागा योधा विनेदुर्भरतर्षभाणाम्। अन्तर्हिता भीष्ममुखाः सहाश्वाः किरीटिना कीर्णरथाः पृषत्कैः॥
en: The warriors of the Bharatas, headed by Bhishma, with their horses, elephants and chariots rendered invisible and pierced and having their cars broken by Kiritin with shafts, began to bewail.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: छराज्छरौघैः प्रतिहत्य वीरः। तस्थौ महात्मा सधनुः सबाणः सविस्फुलिङ्गोऽग्निरिवाशु कर्णः॥
en: Then baffaling with his own arrows those shot by the hands of Arjuna the hero, the highsouled Karna, all on a sudden came into view with his bow and arrow like fire with scintillations.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: ततस्त्वभूद् वै तलतालशब्दः सशङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणादः। प्रक्ष्वेडितज्यातलनिस्वनं तं वैकर्तनं पूजयतां कुरूणाम्॥
en: Then there arose the sound of the clapping of hands and that of conchs, trumpets and bugles while the Kurus spoke highly of Vikartana's son who filled the welkin with the sound of his bow-string striking against his gloves.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: ध्वजोत्तमांसाकुलभीषणान्तम्। गाण्डीवनिर्हादकृतप्रणादं किरीटिनं प्रेक्ष्य ननाद कर्णः॥
en: Then seeing Kiritin fill the sky with the twang of his Gandiva bow, the upraised tail of the monkey that was on his Flag-staff and the dreadful creatures yelling hideously from the Flag-staff, Karna sent up a shout.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: स चापि वैकर्तनमर्दयित्वा साश्वं ससूतं सरथं पृषत्कैः। तमाववर्ष प्रसभं किरीटी पितामहं द्रोणकृपौ च दृष्ट्वा॥ (कर्तनो मेघ इवाभ्यवर्षत्। तथैव कर्णं च किरीटमाली संछादयामास शितैः पृषत्कैः॥
en: Then assailing with his arrows Vikartana's son, together with his horses, car and charioteer, Arjuna showered a downpour of shafts on him, casting his looks on Bhishma, Drona and Kripa Vikartana's son too covered Partha with a downpour of shafts like a cloud.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: तयोः सुतीक्ष्णान् सृजतोः शरौधान् महाशरौघास्त्रविवर्धने रणे। रथे विलग्नाविव चन्द्रसूर्यो घनान्तरेणानुददर्श लोकः॥
en: And he too, decked with a diadem, covered Karna with sharp arrows. Creating clouds of sharp arrows in a battle rendered furious by huge weapons and shafts.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: अथाशुकारी चतुरो हयांश्च विव्याध को निशितैः किरीटिनः। त्रिभिश्च यन्तारममृष्यमाणो विव्याध तूर्णं त्रिभिरस्य केतुम्॥
en: The two, stationed on cars, appeared to men like the sun and the moon covered by clouds. Then the light-handed and intelligent Karna wounded the horses of Partha with shafts,

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: ततोऽभिविद्धः समरावमर्दी प्रबोधितः सिंह इव प्रसुप्तः। मजिह्मगैः कर्णमियाय जिष्णुः॥
en: Assailed his driver with three arrows and struck down his Flag-staff with three. Thus struck like a sleeping lion awaking, that repressor of enemies in battle,

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: शरास्त्रवृष्ट्या निहतो महात्मा प्रादुश्चकारातिमनुष्यकर्म। र्लोकानिमान् सूर्यं इवांशुजालैः॥
en: The holder of Gandiva, the heroic Vishnu, assailed Karna with straight shafts, And assailed with a downpour of arrows and weapons the high-souled performer of superhuman deeds displayed (mighty feats).

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: स हस्तिनेवाभिहतो गजेन्द्रः प्रगृह्य भल्लान् निशितान् निषङ्गात्। आकर्णपूर्णं च धनुर्विकृष्य विव्याध गात्रेष्वथ सूतपुत्रम्॥
en: He covered Karna's car with shafts like the sun covering the regions with its rays. Like a lion attacked by an elephant he, taking out sharpened arrows from the quiver.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: अंथास्य बाहूरुशिरोललाट ग्रीवां वराङ्गानि परावमर्दी। शितैश्च बाणैर्युधि निर्बिभेद गाण्डीवमुक्तैरशनिप्रकाशैः॥
en: And drawing the bow to his ear wounded the charioteer's son on every part of his body. Then that repressor of enemies pierced Karna's arms, thighs, head, forehead and other parts of his body with sharpened arrows fleet as the thunderbolt, shot from his Gandiva bow.

description: The discomfiture of Karna in Goharana
sn: स पार्थमुक्तैरिषुभिः प्रणुन्नो गजो गजेनेव जितस्तरस्वी। विहाय संग्रामशिरः प्रयातो वैकर्तनः पाण्डवबाणतप्तः॥
en: Thus wounded by the arrows shot by Partha, the son of Pandu, Vikartana's son lef the battle-field and took to his heels like a elephant defeated by another.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच अपयाते तु राधेये दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः। अनीकेन यथास्वेन शनैरार्छन्त पाण्डवम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said After the son of Radha had fled away fi the battle-field all other heroes, headed Duryodhana attacked Arjuna with respective detachments.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: बहुधा तस्य सैन्यस्य व्यूढस्याप्ततः शरैः। अधारयत वेगं स वेलेव तु महोदधेः॥
en: Like the bank (obstructing the surging) deep he withstood the various well-arranged divisions of the army falling upon him with arrows.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: ततः प्रहस्य बीभत्सुः कौन्तेयः श्वेतवाहनः। दिव्यमस्त्रं प्रकुर्वाणः प्रत्यायाद् रथसत्तमः॥
en: Then smiling, the foremost of car-warriors Bibhatsu, the son of Kunti, having white, steeds, advanced (towards them) displaying celestials weapons.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: यथा रश्मिभिरादित्यः प्रच्छादयति मेदिनीम्। तथा गाण्डीवनिर्मुक्तैः शरैः पार्थो दिशो दश॥
en: Partha soon filled the ten quarters with arrows shot from his Gandiva bow as the sun covers the earth with its rays.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: न रथानां न चाश्वानां न गजानां न वर्मणाम्। अनिविद्धं शितैर्बाणैरासीद द्वयङ्गुलमन्तरम्॥
en: Of the chariots, horses, elephants and coats of mail there was not space measuring even two fingers that was nor pierced with shafts.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: दिव्ययोगाच्च पार्थस्य हयानामुत्तरस्य च। शिक्षाशिल्पोपपन्नत्वादस्त्राणां च परिक्रमात्।
en: On account of his cleverly handling the celestials weapons, the training of his horses, the skill of Uttara and the coursing of his weapons.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: वीर्यवत्त्वं दुतं चाग्नयं दृष्ट्वा जिष्णोरपूजयन्॥ कालाग्निमिव बीभत्सुं निर्दहन्तमिव प्रजाः।
en: And seeing him endued with energy prowess and quick motion people began to adore Vishnu like fire burning at the time of the universal dissolution.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: नारयः प्रेक्षितुं शेकुर्व्वलन्तमिव पावकम्॥ तानि ग्रस्तान्यनीकानि रेजुरर्जुनमार्गणैः।
en: None amongst the enemies could look at Arjuna shining like the burning fire. Assailed by the shafts of Arjuna the various divisions of the army appeared.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: शैलं प्रति बलाभ्राणि व्याप्तानीवार्करश्मिभिः॥ अशोकानां वनानीवच्छननानि बहुशः शुभैः।
en: Like the newly risen clouds on a mountain, filled with the rays of the sun or like the gioves of the Ashoka trees covered with full blown flowers.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: रेजुः पार्थशरैस्तत्र तदा सैन्यानि भारत॥ स्रजोऽर्जुनशरैः शीर्णं शुष्यत्पुष्पं हिरण्मयम्। छत्राणि च पताकाश्च खे दधार सदागतिः॥
en: Thus assailed by Partha's shafts the army appeared, O Bharata, like a garland from which the withered but golden flowers drop down.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: स्वबलत्रासनात्रस्ता: परिपेतुर्दिशो दश। रथाङ्गदेशानादाय पार्थच्छिन्नयुगा हयाः॥ कर्णकक्षविषाणेषु अन्तरोष्ठेषु चैव ह। मर्मस्वङ्गेषु चाहत्यापातयत् समरे गजान्॥ कौरवाग्रगजानां तु शरीरैर्गतचेतसाम्। क्षणेन संवृता भूमिर्मेधैरिव नभस्तलम्॥ युगान्तसमये सर्वं यथा स्थावरजङ्गमम्। कालक्षयमशेषेण दहत्यग्रशिखः शिखी। तद्वत् पार्थो महाराज ददाह समरे रिपू॥ ततः सर्वास्त्रतेजोभिर्धनुषो निस्वनेन च शब्देनामानुषाणां च भूतानां ध्वजवासिनाम्।
en: The wind carried away to the sky the umbrellas and the flags. Terrified at the destruction of their own species and having their reins cut off by Partha's arrows the horses, taking with them, portions of cars, fled away in different directions. Struck on their ears, ribs, tusks, the lower lips and other vital parts the elephants began to drop down in the battle-field. Filled in no time with the dead elephants of the Kurus the earth looked like the sky filled with black clouds. As the blazing fire burns up all mobile and immobile, at the time of the universal dissolution, so did Partha, O king, consume the enemies in battle. Then with the power of all his weapons, the twang of his bow and superhuman cries of the creatures stationed on his Flag-staff.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: भैरवं शब्दमत्यर्थं वानरस्य च कुर्वतः॥ दैवारिपाच्च बीभत्सुस्तस्मिन् दौर्योधने वने। भयमुत्पादयामास बलवानरिमर्दनः॥ रथशक्तिममित्राणां प्रागेव निपतद् भुवि।
en: And the dreadful yell of the monkey, Bibhatsu struck terror into the hearts of Duryodhana's soldiers. A highly powerful repressor of enemies as he was, he had already crushed to the ground the strength of the hostile heroes.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: सोऽपयात् सहसा पश्चात् साहसाच्चाभ्युपेयिवान्॥ शरवातैः सुतीक्ष्णाप्रैः समादिष्टैः खगेरिव।
en: He all on a sudden from behind attacked the army with a net of sharpened arrows like birds ordered (by fowlers).

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: अर्जुनस्तु खमावतें लोहितप्राशनैः खगैः॥ अत्र मध्ये यथार्कस्य रश्मयस्तिग्मतेजसः। दिशासु च तथा राजन्नसंख्याताः शरास्तदा।॥ सकृदेवानतं शेकू स्थमभ्यसितुं परे।
en: Arjuna covered the entire sky with blooddrinking arrows. As the fierce rays of the sun are within a small vessel. O king, those numberless shafts of his were in the sky. They could see once his car only when brought near.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: अलभ्यः पुनस्श्वैस्तु रथात् सोऽतिप्रपादयेत्॥ ते शरा द्विट्शरीरेषु यथैव न ससज्जिरे।
en: And no sooner they saw him he felled them from the chariot with their horses. As his arrows were not impeded by the bodies of his enemies.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: द्विडनीकेषु बीभत्सोर्न ससज्जे रथस्तदा॥ स तद् विक्षोभयामास ह्यरातिबलवासा।
en: So the car of Bibhatsu was not obstructed by the army of the enemy. He, with great force, began to agitate the army of the enemy.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: अनन्तभोगो भुजगः क्रीडन्निव महार्णवे॥ अस्यतो नित्यमत्यर्थं सर्वमेवातिगस्तथा। अश्रुतः श्रूयते भूतैर्धनुर्घोषः किरीटिनः॥ संततास्तत्र मातङ्गा बाणैरल्पान्तरान्तरे। संवृतास्तेन दृश्यन्ते मेघा इव गभस्तिभिः॥ दिशोऽनुभ्रमतः सर्वाः सव्यदक्षिणमस्यतः। सततं दृश्यते युद्धे सायकासनमण्डलम्॥
en: Like the thousand headed serpent Vasuki sporting in the great ocean. As Kiriti continually shot his arrows such was the twang of his bow, going above every sound that the like of if was never heard by creatures. The elephants, that were there with their bodies thickly covered with arrows, looked like black clouds filled with the rays of the sun. Moving in all directions and shooting arrows right and left Arjuna's bow was always seen in the battle like a circle.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: पतन्त्यरूपेषु यथा चक्षूर्षि न कदाचन। नालक्ष्येषु शराः पेतुस्तथा गाण्डीवधन्वनः॥ मार्गो गजसहस्रस्य युगपद् गच्छतो वने। यथा भवेत् तथा जज्ञे रथमार्गः किरीटिनः॥ नूनं पार्थजयैषित्वाच्छक्रः सर्वामरैः सह। हन्त्यस्मानित्यमन्यन्त पार्थेन निहताः परे॥ कालमर्जुनरूपेण संहरन्तमिव प्रजाः॥
en: The arrows of the holder of the Gandiva bow never fell upon anything except the aim as the eye does not fall upon anything except what is beautiful. As the passage for a thousand of elephants is made of itself when they simultaneously pass through a forest so the track of the chariot of Kiritin was made out. Greatly assailed by Partha the enemies thought, “Desirous of securing victory to Partha forsooth, Indra, in the company of all the immortals, is destroying us."

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: घ्नन्तमत्यर्थमहितान् विजयं तत्र मेनिरे। कुरुसेनाशरीराणि पार्थेनैवाहतान्यपि। सेदुः पार्थहतानीव पार्थकर्मानुशासनात्॥ ओषधीनां शिरांसीव द्विषच्छीर्षाणि सोऽन्वयात्।
en: They also took Vijaya, who was making a dreadful havoc all round, to be Death himself, who in the guise of Arjuna, was putting an end to all creatures around. And wounded by Partha the bodies of the Kuru soldiers were distressed like those slain by Partha by his superhuman deed. He sundered the heads of the enemies like the tops of Oshadhis.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: अवनेशुः कुरूणां हि वीर्याण्यर्जुनजाद् भयात्॥ अर्जुनानिलभिन्नानि वनान्यर्जुनविद्विषाम्। चक्रुर्लोहितधाराभिर्धरणी लोहितान्तराम्॥ लोहितेन समायुक्तः पांसुभिः पवनोद्धृतैः। बभूवुर्लोहितास्तत्र भृशमादित्यरश्मयः॥ सार्क खं तत्क्षणेनासीत् संध्यायामिव लोहितम्।
en: The Kurus lost all their energy in fear of Arjuna. Uprooted by Arjuna wind, the trees of the Arjuna's enemies reddened the earth with purple secretions. And with the dust saturated with blood and raised up by the wind the rays of the sun were greatly reddened. The sky with the sun being reddened soon appeared like the evening.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: अप्यस्तं प्राप्य सूर्योऽपि निवर्तेत न पाण्डवः॥ तान सर्वान् समरे शूरः पौरुषे समवस्थितान्। दिव्धरस्त्रैरचिन्त्यात्मा सर्वानाछेद् धनुर्धरान्॥ स तु द्रोणं त्रिसप्तत्या क्षुरप्राणां समार्पयत्। दुःसहं दशभिर्बाणैौणिमष्टाभिरेव च।॥ दुःशासनं द्वादशभिः कृपं शारद्वतं त्रिभिः।
en: Even the sun ceases to pour its rays when he sets but the son of Pandu did not cease to discharge his arrows. In the battle that hero of incomprehensible energy assailed with celestials weapons all the heroic and leading bow men. He discharged seventy arrows, sharp as razors at Drona, Twelve at Dushasana and three at Kirpa, the son of Sharadvata.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: भीष्मं शान्तनवं षष्ट्या राजानं च शतेन ह। कर्णं च कर्णिना कर्णे विव्याध परवीरहा॥
en: That slayer of hostile heroes pierced with six shafts Bhishma, the son of Shantanu and the king Duryodhana with hundred and Karna in the car with a bearded shaft.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: तस्मिन् विद्धे महेष्वासे कर्णे सर्वास्त्रकोविदे। हताश्वसूते विरथे ततोऽनीकमभज्यत॥
en: When that great bowman Karna expert in the use of all weapons, was thus pierced and his steeds, chariot and charioteer destroyed, his army were routed.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: तत् प्रभन्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा पार्थमाजिस्थितं पुनः। अभिप्रायं समाज्ञाय वैराटिरिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Beholding the army thus routed and with a view to decipher Partha intention the son of Virata addressed Partha in the battle-field saying:

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: आस्थाय रुचिरं जिष्णो रथं सारथिना मया। कतमं यास्यसेऽनीकमुक्तो यास्याम्यहं त्वया॥
en: O Partha, stationed on this beautiful car with myself as charioteer, towards what division of the army shall I go?

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच लोहिताश्वमरिष्टं यं वैयाघ्रमनुपश्यसि। नीलां पताकामाश्रित्य रथे तिष्ठन्तमुत्तर॥ कृपस्यैतदनीकाग्न्यं प्राप्यस्वैतदेव माम्। एतस्य दर्शयिष्यामि शीघ्रास्त्रं दृढधन्विनः॥
en: Arjuna said O Uttara, the hero, whom you see before, clad in a coat of tiger-skin, on a car with blue flag drawn by red horses, is Kripa-and there is the van of his army. Do you take me there. I shall show that great bowman my light handedness in the use of weapons.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: ध्वजे कमण्डलुर्यस्य शातकौम्भमयः शुभः। आचार्य एष हि द्रोण: सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: That hero, on whose flag is the emblem of a beautiful golden water pot, is the preceptor Drona-the foremost of the wielders of all weapons.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: सदा ममैष मान्यस्तु सर्वशस्त्रभृतामपि। सुप्रसन्नं महावीरं कुरुष्वैनं प्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: He is ever worshipful to me as well as to other heroes. Do you cheerfully go round him the foremost of the Kuru warriors.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: अत्रैव वावरोहैनमेष धर्मः सनातनः। यदि मे प्रथमं द्रोणः शरीरे प्रहरिष्यति। ततोऽस्य प्रहरिष्यामि नास्य कोपो भवेदिति॥ अस्याविदूरे हि धनुर्ध्वजाये यस्य दृश्यते!
en: I shall salute him there for such is the ever abiding duty. If Drona at first strikes my body. I shall strike him then and he will not be angry for it. Near him at whose flag the mark of a bow is seen.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: आचार्यस्यैष पुत्रो वै अश्वत्थामा महारथः॥ सदा ममैष मान्यस्तु सर्वशस्त्रभृतामपि।
en: Is the preceptor's son, the mighty carwarrior Ashvathama, who is always worthy of my respect as well as other heroes.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: एतस्य त्वं रथं प्राप्य निवर्तेथाः पुनः पुनः॥ य एष तु स्थानीके सुवर्णकवचावृतः।
en: When you meet his car stop again and again. That warrior on the car clad in a golden coat of mail.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: सेनाग्न्येण तृतीयेन व्यावहार्येण तिष्ठति॥ यस्य नागो ध्वजाग्रेऽसौ हेमकेतनसंवृतः।
en: Who stands there surrounded by the third portion of the army, the flower (of the entire army) on whose flag is the emblem of an elephant on the ground of gold,

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: धृतराष्ट्रात्मजः श्रीमानेष राजा सुयोधनः॥ एतस्याभिमुखं वीर रथं पररथारुजम्।
en: Is the son of Dhritarashtra, the graceful king Duryodhana. O hero, take before him this car that is capable of destroying other cars of the enemies.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: प्रापयस्वैष राजा हि प्रमाथी युद्धदुर्मदः॥ एष द्रोणस्य शिष्याणां शीघ्रास्त्रे प्रथमो मतः।
en: The king is irrepressible in battle and capable of grinding (enemies); in lightness of hand he is regarded as the foremost amongst the disciples of Drona.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: एतस्य दर्शयिष्यामि शीघ्रास्त्रं विपुलं रणे॥ नागकक्षा तु रुचिरा ध्वजाग्रे यस्य तिष्ठति। एष वैकर्तनः कर्णो विदितः पूर्वमेव ते॥ एतस्य रथमास्थाय राधेयस्य दुरात्मनः।
en: I shall in battle show him my superior light handedness in the discharge of arrows. That warrior, on whose flag is the emblem of a strong rope for binding elephants, is Karna, the son of Vikartana, already known to you. When you come near the car of the wicked-souled son of Radha

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: यत्तो भवेथाः संग्रामे स्पर्धते हि सदा मया॥ यस्तु नीलानुसारेण पञ्चतारेण केतुना। हस्तावापी बृहद्धन्वा रथे तिष्ठति वीर्यवान्॥ यस्य तारार्कचित्रोऽसौ ध्वजो स्थवरे स्थितः।
en: Be you very careful for he always challenges me to fight. That hero, whose flag is blue and on which is the emblem of five stars and who, powerful as he is, waits on his car with a huge bow in his hands with gloves and on whose car is placed a Flag-staff variegated with the sun and stars.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: यस्यैतत् पाण्डुरं छत्रं विमलं मूर्ध्नि तिष्ठति॥ महतो रथवंशस्य नानाध्वजपताकिनः।
en: And over whose head is an umbrella of pure white and who stands at the head of a great collection of cars with diverse flags and pennons

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: बलाहकाये सूर्यो वा य एष प्रमुखे स्थितः॥ हैमं चन्द्रार्कसंकाशं कवचं यस्य दृश्यते।
en: Like the sun before the collection of clouds and whose golden coat of mail looks like the sun or moon

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: जातरूपशिरस्त्राणं मनस्तापयतीव मे॥ एष शान्तनवो भीष्मः सर्वेषां नः पितामहः।
en: And who with golden crest pains me greatly, is Shantanu's son Bhishma, our grandfather.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: राजश्रियाभिवृद्धश्च सुयोधनवशानुगः॥ पश्चादेष प्रयातव्यो न मे विजकरो भवेत्।
en: Always treated with regal prosperity he is a follower of Duryodhana. You should approach him last for he will never injure me.

description: Arjuna's pointing out of Kurus to Uttara i Goharana
sn: एतेन युध्यमानस्य यत्त: संयच्छ मे हयान्॥ ततोऽभ्यवहदव्यग्रो वैराटिः सव्यसाचिनाम्। यत्रातिष्ठत् कृपो राजन् योत्स्यमानो धनंजयम्॥
en: While fighting with him you should carefully restrain your horses. Thus addressed by him the son of Virata carefully drove Savyasachi's car, O king, to where Kripa stood in anticipation of the battle.

description: The arrival of the deities at the battle field in Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तान्यनीकान्यदृश्यन्त कुरूणामुग्रधन्विनाम्। संसर्पन्ते यथा मेघा धर्मान्ते मन्दमारुताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said The infantry of those dreadful Kuru bowmen looked like the clouds in the rains moving about before the gentle wind.

description: The arrival of the deities at the battle field in Goharana
sn: अभ्याशे वाजिनस्तस्थुः समारूढाः प्रहारिणः। भीमरूपाश्च मातङ्गास्तोमराङ्कुशनोदिताः। महामात्रैः समारूढा विचित्रकवचोज्ज्वलाः॥ ततः शक्रः सुरगणैः समारुह्य सुदर्शनम्। सहोपायात् तदा राजन् विश्वाश्चिमरुतां गणैः॥ तद् देवयक्षगन्धर्वमहोरगसमाकुलम्। शुशुभेऽभ्रविनिर्मुक्तं ग्रहाणामिव मण्डलम्॥ अस्त्राणां च बलं तेषां मानुषेषु प्रयुञ्जताम्। तच्च भीमं महद् युद्धं कृपार्जुनसमागमे। द्रष्टुमभ्यागता देवाः स्वविमानैः पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: And near them stood the enemy's cavalry managed by warriors. There were also terrible looking elephants bedecked with beautiful armours governed by clever heroes and urged by Tomaras and gaudas. There came on a beautiful car Shakra accompanied by the celestials, Vishvas and Maruts, O king. Filled with the celestials, Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Nagas the sky looked resplendent as it does when freed from cloud sand crested with stars. The celestials came there in their respective cars to witness the efficacy of their weapons in a human battle as well as the dreadful and great fight between Kripa and Arjuna.

description: The arrival of the deities at the battle field in Goharana
sn: शतं शतसहस्राणां यत्र स्थूणा हिरण्मयी। मणिरत्नमयी चान्या प्रासादं तदधारयत्॥ ततः कामगमं दिव्यं सर्वरलविभूषितम्। विमानं देवराजस्य शुशुभे खेचरं तदा॥
en: The celestial car of the king of the celestials coursing at will, crested with pearls and jewels and the roof of which was upheld by hundreds and thousands of golden pillars and the one which was made of pearls and jewels, shone in the clear sky.

description: The arrival of the deities at the battle field in Goharana
sn: तत्र देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशत् तिष्ठन्ति सहवासवाः। गन्धर्वा राक्षसाः सर्पाः पितरश्च महर्षिभिः॥
en: There were the thirty three deities headed by Vasava and with Gandharvas, Rakshasas, Nagas, Pitris and the great Rishis.

description: The arrival of the deities at the battle field in Goharana
sn: तथा राजा वसुमना बलाक्षः सुप्रतर्दनः। अष्टकश्च शिविश्चैव ययातिर्नहुषो गयः॥ मनुः पूरू रघुर्भानुः कृशाश्वः सगरो नलः। विमाने देवराजस्य समदृश्यन्त सुप्रभाः॥
en: There shone on the car of the king of the celestials the king Vasumanas, Balakshas, Supratardana, Ashtaka, Shibi, Yayati, Nahusha, Gaya, Manu, Puru, Raghu, Bhanu, Krishashva, Sagara and Nala.

description: The arrival of the deities at the battle field in Goharana
sn: अग्नेरीशस्य सोमस्य वरुणस्य प्रजापतेः। तथा धातुर्विधातुश्च कुबेरस्य यमस्य च॥ अलम्बुषोग्रसेनानां गन्धर्वस्य च तुम्बुरोः। यथामानं यथोद्देशं विमानानि चकाशिरे॥
en: There appeared also in a beautiful array the chariots of Agni, Isha, Soma, Varuna, Prajapati, Dhatri, Vidhatri, Kubera, Yama, Alambusha, Ugrasena and others and of the Gandharva Tumvuru.

description: The arrival of the deities at the battle field in Goharana
sn: सर्वदेवनिकायाच सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। अर्जुनस्य कुरूणां च द्रष्टुं युद्धमुपागताः॥
en: All the deities, the Siddhas and the great Rishis came there to witness the fight between Arjuna and the Kurus.

description: The arrival of the deities at the battle field in Goharana
sn: दिव्यानां सर्वमाल्यानां गन्धः पुण्योऽथ सर्वशः। प्रससार वसन्ताग्रे वनानामिव भारत॥
en: The holy fragrance of the celestial garlands spread all over like the odour of the blossoming trees in the beginning of the spring.

description: The arrival of the deities at the battle field in Goharana
sn: तत्र रत्नानि देवानां समदृश्यन्त तिष्ठताम्। आतपत्राणि वासांसि सजश्च व्यजनानि च॥
en: The umbrellas, clothes, flags, fans, and the jewels of the deities shone there when they came.

description: The arrival of the deities at the battle field in Goharana
sn: उपाशाम्यद् रजो भौमं सर्वं व्याप्तं मरीचिभिः। दिव्यगन्धानुपादाय वायुर्योधानसेवत॥
en: The dust of the earth was removed and every where was permeated by the lustre. And carrying the divine odour the wind gratified the warriors.

description: The arrival of the deities at the battle field in Goharana
sn: प्रभासितमिवाकाशं चित्ररूपमलंकृतम्। सम्पतद्धिः स्थितैश्चापि नानारत्नविभासितैः॥ विमानैर्विविधैश्चित्ररुपानीतैः सुरोत्तमैः। वज्रभृच्छुशुभे तत्र विमानस्थैः सुरैर्वृतः॥ बिभ्रन्मालां महातेजाः पद्मोत्पलसमायुताम्। विप्रेक्ष्यमाणो बहुभिर्नातृप्यत् सुमहाहवम्॥
en: The sky appeared as if ablaze and beautiful, being decked with already arrived and coming cars lighted with various gems and of diverse make, led by the leading celestials. Encircled by the deities, and wearing garland of lotuses and lillies, the mighty holder of thunder appeared exceedingly beautiful on his car. And although he looked continually at his son he was not satiated therewith.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच दृष्ट्वा व्यूढान्यनीकानि कुरूणां कुरुनन्दन। तत्र वैराटिमामन्त्र्य पार्थो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Seeing the Kuru army arranged in order of battle, the son of Pandu, Partha, addressing Virata's son said :

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: जाम्बूनदमयी वेदी ध्वजे यस्य प्रदृश्यते। तस्य दक्षिणतो याहि कृपः शारद्वतो यतः॥
en: Do you go where Kripa, the son of Sharadvata is, by the southern side of the car the flag of which has an emblem of a golden altar.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच धनंजयवचः श्रुत्वा वैराटिस्त्वरितस्ततः। हयान् रजतसंकाशान् हेमभाण्डानचोदयत्॥
en: Hearing the words of Arjuna, Virata's son, without loss of time, urged his silver white steeds decked in golden armour.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: आनुपूर्व्यात् तु तत् सर्वमास्थाय जवमुत्तमम्। प्राहिणोच्चन्द्रसंकाशान् कुपितानिव तान् हयान्॥
en: Making them one by one proceed by swifter course, he urged those those horses resembling the moon as if they were angry.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: स गत्वा कुरुसेनायाः समीपं हयकोविदः। पुनरावर्तयामास तान् हयान् वातरंहसः॥
en: Well-versed in the management of horses, Uttara, having neared the Kuru army, turned back his horses, fleet as the wind.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य मण्डलं सव्यमेव च। कुरून् सम्मोहयामास मत्स्यो यानेन तत्त्ववित्॥
