en: A skillful charioteer as he was the Matsya Prince, sometimes wheeling about, sometimes proceeding in circles and again turning to the left, bewildered the Kurus.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: कृपस्य रथमास्थाय वैराटिरकुतोभयः। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य तस्थौ तस्याग्रतो बली॥
en: Going round, the powerful and fearless son of Virata, approached Kripa's car and stood before him.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: ततोऽर्जुनः शङ्खवरं देवदत्तं महारवम्। प्रदध्मौ बलमास्थाय नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः॥
en: Then Arjuna with force blew that great conch Devadatta emitting a great sound and announced his name.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: तस्य शब्दो महानासीद् धम्यमानस्य जिष्णुना। तथा वीर्यवता संख्ये पर्वतस्येव दीर्यतः॥
en: Blown on the battle-field by the powerful Vishnu the sound of that conch appeared like that of the clapping of a mountain.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: पूजयांचक्रिरे शङ्ख कुरवः सहसैनिकाः। अर्जुनेन तथा ध्मातः शतधा यन्न दीर्यते॥
en: Seeing that the conch was not broken into a hundred pieces when blown by Arjuna, the Kuru warriors spoke highly of it.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: दिवमावृत्य शब्दस्तु निवृत्तः शुश्रुवे पुनः। सृष्टो मघवता वज्रः प्रपतन्निव पर्वते॥
en: Having reached the very sky that sound came back and was heard again like that of thunderbolt when hurled by Indra against a mountain.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरो बलवीर्यसमन्वितः। अर्जुनं प्रति संरब्धः कृपः परमदुर्जयः। अमृष्यमाणस्तं शब्दं कृपः शारद्वतस्तदा॥ अर्जुनं प्रति संरब्धो युद्धार्थी स महारथः। महोदधिजमादाय दध्मौ वेगेन वीर्यवान्॥
en: Unable to bear that sound and desirous of fighting that heroic, powerful and undaunted car-warrior, Sharadvata's son Kripa of great strength and prowess, enraged with Arjuna, took up the conch born in a great ocean and blew it with great force.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: स तु शब्देन लोकांस्त्रीनावृत्य रथिनां वरः। धनुरादाय सुमहज्ज्याशब्दमकरोत् तदा॥
en: Covering the three worlds with the sound thereof and taking up the huge bow he twanged it.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: तौ रथौ सूर्यसंकाशौ योत्स्यमानौ महाबलौ। शारदाविव जीमूतौ व्यरोचेतां व्यवस्थितौ॥
en: While those two highly powerful carwarriors, resembling the sun, fought with each other they appeared like two autumnal clouds.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: ततः शारद्वतस्तूर्णं पार्थं दशभिराशुगैः। विव्याध परवीरघ्नं निशितैर्मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: Then Sharadvata's son speedily wounded Partha, the slayer of hostile heroes with ten swift coursing sharpened arrows capable of piercing into the very vitals.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: पार्थोऽपि विश्रुतं लोके गाण्डीवं परमायुधम्। विकृष्य चिक्षेप बहून् नाराचान् मर्मभेदिनः॥
en: And drawing his huge bow Gandiva wellknown in the world Partha too discharged many Narachas capable of piercing into the very vitals.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: तान् प्राप्ताञ्छितैर्बाणैर्नाराचान् रक्तभोजनान्। कृपश्चिच्छेद पार्थस्य शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Then with sharpened arrows "Kripa sundered into hundreds and thousands of pieces those blood-drinking shafts before they could reach (him).

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: ततः पार्थस्तु संक्रुद्धश्चित्रान् मार्गान् प्रदर्शयन्। दिशः संछादयन् बाणैः प्रदिशश्च महारथः। एकच्छायमिवाकाशमकरोत् सर्वतः प्रभुः॥
en: Thereupon displaying various movements in anger, the great car-warrior Partha covered all sides with a downpour of arrows.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: प्राच्छादयदमेयात्मा पार्थः शरशतैः कृपम्। स शरैरर्दितः क्रुद्धः शितैरग्निशिखोपमैः॥
en: Covering the entire sky with his arrows, that powerful warrior of exceeding energy, the son of Pritha assailed Kripa with hundreds of shafts.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: तूर्णं दशसहस्रेण पार्थमप्रतिमौजसम्। अर्दयित्वा महात्मानं ननर्द समरे कृपः॥ ततः कनकपर्वाग्रैर्वीरः संनतपर्वभिः। त्वरन् गाण्डीवनिर्मुक्तैरर्जुनस्तस्य वाजिनः॥ चतुर्भिश्चतुरस्तीक्ष्णैरविध्यत् परमेषुभिः। हया निशितैर्बाणैर्व्वलद्भिरिव पन्नगैः। उत्पेतुः सहसा सर्वे कृपः स्थानादथाच्यवत्॥ च्युतं तु गौतमं स्थानात् समीक्ष्य कुरुनन्दनः।
en: Afflicted with those sharpened shafts resembling flame of fire and worked up with anger, Kripa, assailing soon the high-souled Partha of incomparable energy with ten thousand shafts, sent out a war cry in battle. Then the heroic Arjuna taking up his bow speedily bored through the four horses of his enemy with four dreadful straight and gold winged arrows shot from the Gandiva. Then pierced by sharpened arrows resembling flames of fire those horses all on a sudden sprang up and Kripa fell off from his place. Then seeing Gautama dislodged the son of Kunti.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: ते नाविध्यत् परवीरघ्नो रक्षमाणोऽस्य गौरवम्॥ स तु लब्ध्वा पुनः स्थानं गौतमः सव्यसाचिनम्। विव्याध दशभिर्बाणैस्त्वरितः कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥ ततः पार्थो धनुस्तस्य भल्लेन निशितेन ह। चिच्छेदैकेन भूयश्च हस्तावापमथाहरत्॥ अथास्य कवचं बाणैर्निशितैर्मर्मभेदिभिः। व्यधमन्न च पार्थोऽस्य शरीरमवपीडयत्॥ तस्य निर्मुच्यमानस्य कवचात् काय आवभौ।
en: The slayer of hostile heroes, did not wound him for keeping his prestige. Again regaining his position Gautama speedily pierced Savyasachin with ten sharpened and Kanka feathered arrows. Then with one sharpened arrow Partha cut off his bow and gloves. Then he cut off Kripa's coat of mail with sharp arrows capable of piercing to the very vitals but he did not wound him. Then divested of the coat of mail his body appeared.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: समये मुच्यमानस्य सर्पस्येव तनुर्यथा॥ छिन्ने धनुषि पार्थेन सोऽन्यदादाय कार्मुकम्।
en: Like a serpent casting off its coating at the proper time. On his bow being cut off by Partha, taking up another.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: चकार गौतमः सज्यं तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥ स तदप्यस्य कौन्तेयश्चिच्छेद नतपर्वणा।
en: Gautama made it ready. And it appeared wonderful. The son of Kunti cut off that too with arrows having depressed knots.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: एवमन्यानि चापानि बहूनि कृतहस्तवत्। शारद्वतस्य चिच्छेद पाण्डवः परवीरहा॥
en: In this way that slayer of hostile heroes, the son of Pandu, cut off other bows as soon as they were taken up, one after the other, by the son of Sharadvata.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: सच्छिन्नधनुरादाय रथशक्तिं प्रतापवान्। प्राहिणोत् पाण्डुपुत्राय प्रदीप्तामशनीमिव।॥
en: Having all his bows thus sundered that highly powerful hero took up a javelin from his car resembling a lightning and hurled it at the son of Pandu.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: तामर्जुनस्तदाऽऽयान्तीं शक्तिं हेमविभूषिताम्। वियद्गतां महोल्काभां चिच्छेद दशभिः शरैः॥
en: While that golden javelin came coursing through the sky, burning like a huge fire-brand Arjuna cut it off with ten arrows.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: सापतद् शतधा छिन्ना भूमौ पार्थेन धीमता॥ युगपच्चैव भल्लैस्तु ततः सज्यधनुः कृपः।
en: As soon as that fell on the ground sundered into a hundred pieces by the intelligent Partha, Kripa took up another ready bow.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: तमाशु निशितैः पार्थं बिभेद दशभिः शरैः॥ ततः पार्थो महातेजा विशिखानग्नितेजसः। चिक्षेप समरे क्रुद्धस्त्रयोदश शिलाशितान्॥ अथास्य युगमेकेन चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्। षष्ठेन च शिरः कायाच्छरेण रथसारथेः॥ त्रिभिस्त्रिवेणुं समरे द्वाभ्यामक्षं महारथः।
en: And immediately struck Partha with ten sharp arrows. Then the highly energetic Partha, worked up with rage, discharged thirteen sharp and fiery arrow3; with one he cut off the yoke, with four the four horses and with the sixth he cut off the head of the charioteer with three, the great car-warrior, pierced in battle, the three bamboo poles, and with two his two wheels.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Kripa
sn: द्वादशेन तु भल्लेन चकर्तास्य ध्वजं तदा॥ ततो वज्रनिकाशेन फाल्गुनः प्रहसन्निव। त्रयोदशेनेन्द्रसमः कृपं वक्षस्यविध्यत॥ सच्छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः। गदापाणिरवप्लुत्य तूर्णं चिक्षेप तां गदाम्॥ सा च मुक्ता गदा गुर्वी कृपेण सुपरिष्कृता। अर्जुनेन शरैर्नुन्ना प्रतिमार्गमथागमत्॥ तं तु योधाः परीप्सन्तः शारद्वतममर्षणम्। सर्वतः समरे पार्थं शरवर्षेरवाकिरन्॥ ततो विराटस्य सुतः सव्यमावृत्य वाजिनः। यमकं मण्डलं कृत्वा तान् योधान् प्रत्यवारयत्॥ ततः कृपमुपादाय विरथं ते नरर्षभाः। अपजहुर्महावेगा कुन्तीपुत्राद् धनंजयात्॥
en: With the twelfth arrow he cut off his most excellent standard, and with the thirteenth resembling the thunder-bolt, Phalguni the equal of Indra, as if smiling, struck Kripa on the breast. Then with his bow cut off, dislodged from his car, his horses and charioteer slain, leaping down and taking up a mace, he soon hurled it at Arjuna. That shining and greatly polished mace hurled by him, came back baffled by Arjuna's shafts. Then to rescue the revengeful son of Sharadvata, all the soldiers covered Partha in battle on all sides with a downpour of shafts. Then turning the horses to the left and making the circle called Yamaka, Virata's son withstood all those warriors. Then taking Kripa with them, who had been dislodged from his car, all those leading warriors led him away from Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti. f

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच कृपेऽपनीते द्रोणस्तु प्रगृह्य सशरं धनुः। अभ्यद्रवदनाधृष्यः शोणाश्वः श्वेतवाहनम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said After Kripa had been taken away, the irrepressible Drona, having red horses, taking up his bow to which an arrow had already been set, rushed towards Arjuna of white horses.

sn: स तु रुक्मरथं दृष्ट्वा गुरुमायान्तमन्तिकात्। अर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठ उत्तरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing near him the preceptor moving on in hi golden chariot, Arjuna the foremost of victors, addressed Uttara saying

sn: अर्जुन उवाच यत्रैषा काञ्चनी वेदी ध्वजे यस्य प्रकाशते। उच्छ्रिता प्रवरे दण्डे पताकाभिलरकृता। अत्र मां वह भद्रं ते द्रोणानीकाय सारथे॥ अश्वाः शोणाः प्रकाशन्ते बृहन्तश्चारुवाहिनः। स्निग्धविदुमसंकाशास्ताम्रास्याः प्रियदर्शनाः। युक्ता रथवरे यस्य सर्वशिक्षाविशारदाः॥
en: May you fare well, O charioteer; take m before Drona's army, on whose high standard appears the emblem of a golden altar and around which flags are streaming, whose car is drawn by red, big, highly beautiful, trained, pleasant-looking and quiet horses of the colour of coral and having copper-coloured faces.

sn: दीर्घबाहुर्महातेजा बलरूपसमन्वितः। सर्वलोकेषु विक्रान्तो भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Of large arms, great energy, endued with beauty and strength, the powerful son of Bharadvaja is known in all the worlds for his prowess.

sn: बुद्ध्या तुल्यो ह्युशनसा बृहस्पतिसमो नये। वेदास्तथैव चत्वारो ब्रह्मचर्यं तथैव च॥
en: In intelligence he is like Shukra, and in the knowledge of moral laws like Brihaspati. He is equally well-read in the four Vedas, and follows the Brahmacharya mode of life.

sn: ससंहाराणि सर्वाणि दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि मारिष। धनुर्वेदश्च कात्र्येन यस्मिन् नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: All the celestials weapons with the means of their withdrawal, and the entire science of archery always reside in him.

sn: क्षमा दमश्च सत्यं च आनृशंस्यमथार्जवम्। एते चान्ये च बहवो यस्मिन् नित्यं द्विजे गुणाः॥
en: Forgiveness, self-control, truthfulness, disinclination to injury and straight forwardness these and various other accomplishments always live in that twice-born one.

sn: तेनाहं योद्धमिच्छामि महाभागेन संयुगे। तस्मात् तं प्रापयाचार्यं क्षिप्रमुत्तर वाहय॥
en: I wish to fight with that great one in battle. Therefore, O Uttara, take me soon to the preceptor.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच अर्जुननैवमुक्तस्तु वैराटिहेमभूषणान्। चोदयामास तानश्वान् भारद्वाजथं प्रति॥
en: Thus accosted by Arjuna, Virata's son urged the horses adorned with gold towards the car of Bharadvaja's son.

sn: तमापतन्तं वेगेन पाण्डवं रथिनां वरम्। द्रोणः प्रत्युद्ययौ पार्थं मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम्॥
en: Drona rushed with great force towards Partha, the son of Pandu, the foremost of carwarriors, who was advancing like a mad elephant rushing at another such.

sn: ततः प्राध्मापयच्छङ्ख भेरीशतनिनादिनम्। प्रचुक्षुभे बलं सर्वमुद्भूत इव सागरः॥
en: Drona then blew his conch, the sound of which resembled that of a hundred trumpets. And the whole army was agitated thereat like the ocean.

sn: अथ शोणान् सदश्वांस्तान् हंसवर्णैमनोजवैः। मिश्रितान् समरे दृष्ट्वा व्यस्मयन्त रणे नराः॥
en: Beholding his excellent red horses mixing with those (of Arjuna) white as swans and fleet as the mind in the encounter, all people were filled with surprise.

sn: तौ स्थौ वीर्यसम्पन्नौ दृष्ट्वा संग्राममूर्धनि। आचार्यशिष्यावजितौ कृतविद्यौ मनस्विनौ॥ समाश्लिष्टौ तदान्योन्यं द्रोणपार्थो महाबलौ। दृष्ट्वा प्राकम्पत मुहुर्भरतानां महद् बलम्॥
en: Beholding those car-warriors, in the field of battle, the preceptor and disciple, Drona and Partha, both endued with prowess, irrepressible, learned, high-minded and greatly powerful, engaged with each other, the huge army of the Bharatas continually trembled (in fear).

sn: हर्षयुक्तस्ततः पार्थः प्रहसन्निव वीर्यवान्। रथं रथेन द्रोणस्य समासाद्य महारथः॥
en: Reaching Drona's car by his own, the mighty car-warrior and highly energetic Partha was filled with joy, and smiled.

sn: अभिवाद्य महाबाहुः सामपूर्वमिदं वचः। उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा कौन्तेयः परवीरहा।॥
en: Saluting him, the mighty-armed son of Kunti, the slayer of hostile heroes, said in sweet and becoming words.

sn: उषिताः स्मो वने वासं प्रतिकर्म चिकीर्षवः। कोपं नार्हसि नः कर्तुं सदा समरदुर्जय॥
en: Having spent out the term of our exile in the woods, we wish to take revenge. O you irrepressible in battle, it does not behove you to be always angry.

sn: अहं तु प्रहते पूर्वं प्रहरिष्यामि तेऽनघ। इति मे वर्तते बुद्धिस्तद् भवान् कर्तुमर्हति॥
en: O gentle one, I will not strike you unless you strike me first. This is my determination. Do what you like.

sn: ततोऽस्मै प्राहिणोद् द्रोणः शरानधिकविंशतिम्। अप्राप्तांश्चैव तान् पार्थश्चिच्छेद कृतहस्तवत्॥
en: Thus addressed, Drona discharged at him more than twenty shafts. But the light-handed Partha severed them all before they could fall down on him.

sn: ततः शरसहस्रेण रथं पार्थस्य वीर्यवान्। अवाकिरत् ततो द्रोणः शीघ्रमस्त्रं विदर्शयन्॥
en: Displaying his weapons the energetic Drona soon covered Partha's chariot on all sides with thousands of arrows.

sn: हयांश्च रजतप्रख्यान कङ्कपत्रैः शिलाशितैः। अवाकिरदमेयात्मा पार्थं संकोपयन्निव॥
en: As if to work up Partha with anger, that one of incomparable energy covered his horses of silvery hue with sharpened and Kankafeathered arrows.

sn: एवं प्रववृते युद्धं भारद्वाजकिरीटिनोः। समं विमुञ्चतो संख्ये विशिस्वान् दीप्ततेजसः॥
en: When the encounter thus took place between Drona and Arjuna, they equally discharged in battle fiery arrows.

sn: तावुभौ ख्याकर्माणावुभौ वायुसमौ जवे। उभौ दिव्यास्त्रविदुषावुभावुत्तमतेजसौ।
en: Both of them were equally illustrious and equal to the wind in speed, equally conversant with celestials weapons and gifted with great energy.

sn: क्षिपन्तौ शरजालानि मोहयामासतुर्नुपान्॥ व्यस्मयन्त ततो योधा ये तत्रासन् समागताः।
en: When they spread a net-work of arrows, they bewildered the kings. And all the warriors, that were present there, were filled with wonder.

sn: शरान् विसृजतोस्तूर्णं साधु साध्वित्यपूजयन्॥ द्रोणं हि समरे कोऽन्यो योद्धुमर्हति फाल्गुनात्।
en: (They all) admired Drona who quickly shot arrows, exclaiming “Well done! well done! Who else can fight with Drona in battle except Phalguni (Arjuna)?

sn: रौद्रः क्षत्रियधर्मोऽयं गुरुणा यदयुध्यता इत्यब्रुवढानास्तत्र संग्रामशिरसि स्थिताः॥
en: Surely the duty of a Kshatriya is very hard, since he fights with his preceptor.” Thus did the people, stationed in the battle field, say.

sn: वीरौ तावभिसंरब्धौ संनिकृष्टौ महाभुजौ। छादयेतां शरव्रातैरन्योन्यमपराजितौ॥
en: Worked up with anger those two longarmed heroes, confronting each other, and each capable of vanquishing the other, covered each other with arrows.

sn: विस्फार्य सुमहच्चापं हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम्। भारद्वाजोऽथ संक्रुद्धः फाल्गुनं प्रत्यविध्यत॥
en: Then inflated with anger, the son of Bharadvaja, drawing his huge bow plated with gold and hard to be severed, struck Phalguni.

sn: स सायकमयैर्जालैरर्जुनस्य रथं प्रति। भानुमद्भिः शिलाघौतैर्भानोराच्छादयत् प्रभाम्॥
en: Then shooting at Arjuna's car a goodly number of sharp arrows, bright as the sun, he covered the rays of the sun.

sn: पार्थं च सुमहाबाहुर्महावेगैर्महारथः। विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैर्मेघो वृष्ट्येव पर्वतम्॥
en: That mighty car-warrior of large arms wounded Partha with sharpened arrows, as the clouds discharge showers on a mountain.

sn: तथैव दिव्यं गाण्डीवं धनुरादाय पाण्डवः। शत्रुघ्नं वेगवान् हृष्टो भारसाधनमुत्तमम्॥
en: Taking up the best of bows, the celestials Gandiva, capable of destroying enemies and carrying a heavy weight, the son of Pandu delightedly.

sn: विससर्ज शरांश्चित्रान् सुवर्णविकृतान् बहून्। नाशयन् शरवर्षाणि भारद्वाजस्य वीर्यवान्।
en: Shot a number of variegated golden arrows; and that energetic (hero) baffled the downpour of shafts made by Bharadvaja's son.

sn: तूर्णं चापविनिर्मुक्तैस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥ स रथेन चरन् पार्थः प्रेक्षणीयो धनंजयः।
en: And speedily discharged arrows from the bow that appeared as wonderful. Moving about in his car, Dhananjaya the son of Pritha, worthy of being looked at.

sn: युगपद् दिक्षु सर्वासु सर्वतोऽस्त्राण्यदर्शयत्॥ एकच्छायमिवाकाशं बाणैश्चक्रे समन्ततः।
en: Displayed his weapons simultaneously in all the quarters. He converted the sky, with his arrows, into one (expansive) shade.

sn: नादृश्यत तदा द्रोणो नीहारेणेव संवृतः॥ तस्याभवत् तदा रूपं संवृतस्य शरोत्तमैः।
en: Drona was not visible (like the sun) enshrouded mist. Thereupon covered on all sides with excellent arrows, he appeared.

sn: जाज्वल्यमानस्य तदा पर्वतस्येव सर्वतः॥ दृष्ट्वा तु पार्थस्य रणे शरैः स्वरथमावृतम्।
en: Like a burning mountain. Beholding his own chariot enveloped in the battle by the shafts of Partha.

sn: स विस्फार्य धनुः श्रेष्ठं मेघस्तनितनिस्वनम्॥ अग्निचक्रोपमं घोरं व्यकर्षत् परमायुधम्।
en: He, drawing his excellent bow making a sound like that of clouds, took up a huge weapon like a wheel of fire.

sn: व्यशातयच्छरांस्तांस्तु द्रोणः समितिशोभनः॥ महानभूत् ततः शब्दो वंशानामिव दह्यताम्॥
en: Then Drona, ornament of an assembly, discharged sharpened arrows. Then arose a sound like that of bamboo's when set on fire.

sn: जाम्बूनदमयैः पुढेश्चित्रचापविनिर्गतैः। प्राच्छादयदमेयात्मा दिशः सूर्यस्य च प्रभाम्॥
en: That of immeasurable energy enveloped all the quarters and the lustre of the sun with gold-winged arrows discharged from a variegated bow. one

sn: ततः कनकपुङ्खानां शराणां नतपर्वणाम्। वियच्चराणां वियति दृश्यन्ते बहरो व्रजाः॥
en: Those arrows, with depressed knots and golden wings, when they passed through the sky, looked like so many birds.

sn: द्रोणस्य पुङ्खसक्ताच प्रभवन्तः शरासनात्। एको दीर्घ इवादृश्यदाकाशे संहतः शरः॥
en: The arrows shot from Drona's bow touching one another by the wings appeared like one long-extending row of arrows in the sky.

sn: एवं तौ स्वर्णविकृतान् विमुञ्चन्तौ महाशरान्। आकाशं संवृतं वीरावुल्काभिरिव चक्रतुः॥
en: Those heroes, then shooting their golden arrows, enveloped, as it were the welkin with a downpour of fire-brands.

sn: शरास्तयोस्तु विबभुः कङ्कबर्हिणवाससः। पङ्क्त्यः शरदि खस्थानां हंसानां चरतामिव॥
en: Decked with the feathers of Kanka birds, these arrows looked like a number of cranes wandering in the autumnal sky.

sn: युद्धं समभवत् तत्र सुसंरब्धं महात्मनोः। द्रोणपाण्डवयो?रं वृत्रवासवयोरिव॥
en: Then there ensued a highly terrific encounter between the high-souled Drona and Arjuna like that between Vritra and Vasava.

sn: तौ गजाविव चासाद्य विषाणाप्रैः परस्परम्। शरैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः॥
en: They wounded each other with arrows shot from bows drawn to the highest stretch like two elephants assailing each other with their tusks.

sn: तौ व्यवाहरतां युद्धे संरब्धौ रणशोभिनौ। उदीरयन्तौ समरे दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि भागशः॥
en: Those two angry heroes, ornamenting the battle-field, fighting according to the practice, showed many celestials weapons in due order.

sn: अथ त्वाचार्यमुख्येन शरान् सृष्टाञ्छिलाशितान्। न्यवारयच्छितैर्बाणैर्जुनो जयतां वरः॥
en: one Arjuna, the foremost of victors, warded off, with sharp arrows, the sharpened arrows shot by the foremost of preceptors.

sn: दर्शयन् वीक्षमाणानामस्त्रमुग्रपराक्रमः। इषुभिस्तूर्णमाकाशं बहुभिश्च समावृणोत्॥
en: Showing many weapons to the spectators, that of dreadful prowess speedily enveloped the sky with many arrows.

sn: जिघांसन्तं नरव्याघ्रमर्जुनं तिग्मतेजसम्। आचार्यमुख्यः समरे द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः। अर्जुनेन सहाक्रीडच्छरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि वर्षन्तं तस्मिन् वै तुमुले रणे। अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य फाल्गुनं समयोधयत्॥ तयोरासीत् सम्प्रहारः क्रुद्धयोर्नरसिंहयोः। अमर्षिणोस्तदान्योन्यं देवदानवयोरिव॥ ऐन्द्र वायव्यमाग्नेयमस्त्रमस्त्रेण पाण्डवः। द्रोणेन मुक्तमानं तु ग्रसति स्म पुनः पुनः॥ एवं शूरौ महेष्वासौ विसृजन्तौ शिताञ्छरान्। एकच्छायं चक्रतुस्तावाकाशं शरवृष्टिभिः॥ तत्रार्जुनेन मुक्तानां पततां वै शरीरिषु। पर्वतेष्विव वज्राणां शराणां श्रूयते स्वनः॥ ततो नागा रथाश्चैव वाजिनश्च विशाम्पते। शोणिताक्ता व्यदृश्यन्त पुष्पिता इव किंशुकाः॥ बाहुभिश्च सकेयूरैर्विचित्रैश्च महारथैः। सुवर्णचित्रैः कवचैर्ध्वजैश्च विनिपातितैः॥ योधैश्च निहतैस्तत्र पार्थबाणप्रपीडितैः। बलमासीत् समुद्घान्तं द्रोणार्जुनसमागमे॥ विधुन्वानौ तु तौ तत्र धनुषी भारसाधने। आच्छादयेतामन्योन्यं ततक्षतुरथेषुभिः॥ तयोः समभवद् युद्धं तुमुलं भरतर्षभ। द्रोणकौन्तेययोस्तत्र बलिवासवयोरिव॥ अथ पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। व्यदारयेतामन्योन्यं प्राणद्यूते प्रवर्तिते॥ अथान्तरिक्षे नादोऽभूद् द्रोणं तत्र प्रशंसताम्।
en: (Beholding) Arjuna, the foremost of men, of fierce energy, discharging celestials weapons in that great battle and killing (soldiers) the foremost of preceptors and warriors Drona, played with Arjuna with arrows of depressed knots. And warding off his weapons with his, Bharadvaja's son fought with Arjuna. Then there ensued an encounter between those two foremost of men, worked up with anger and striking each other, like that between the celestials and demons. Arjuna repeatedly warded off with his own, the weapons Aindra, Vayavya and Agneya discharged by Drona. Shooting sharp arrows, those two great heroes converted the sky, with a shade. Coming down on the bodies of the enemy's heroes, the shafts, discharged by Arjuna, made a sound like that of thunderbolt striking against a mountain. Then, o king, the elephants, cars and horses, covered with blood, looked like Kinsuka trees crested with flowers. And in that encounter between Drona and Partha, the field being filled with arms adorned with variegated bangles, mighty car-warriors' golden coats of mail, banners struck down, and warriors slain and assailed by Partha's shafts, the army were terrified. And moving their bows capable of bearing stain, they covered each other with shafts. O foremost of Bharatas, there took place a great encounter between Drona and Arjuna like that between Bali and Vasava. Then with arrows of depressed knots shot from the bows fully drawn, they struck each other even at the risk of their lives. There was heard a voice in the sky speaking highly of Drona.

sn: दुष्करं कृतवान् द्रोणो यदर्जुनमयोधयत्॥ प्रमाथिनं महावीर्यं दृढमुष्टिं दुरासदम्।
en: Drona has performed a difficult feat for he fights with Arjuna, of great energy, firmhanded, irrepressible and an afflicter of foes.

sn: जेतारं देवदैत्यानां सर्वेषां च महारथम्॥ अविभ्रमं च शिक्षां च लाघवं दूरपातिताम्। पार्थस्य समरे दृष्ट्वा द्रोणस्याभूच्च विस्मयः॥ अथ गाण्डीवमुद्यम्य दिव्य धनुरमर्षणः। विचकर्ष रणे पार्थो बाहुभ्यां भरतर्षभ॥ तस्य बाणमयं वर्षं शलभानामिवायतिम्। दृष्ट्वा ते विस्मिताः सर्वे साधु साध्वित्यपूजयन्॥६५। न च बाणान्तरे वायुरस्य शक्नोति सर्पितम्।
en: The conqueror of the celestials and Daityas and of all mighty car-warriors. Beholding in battle Partha's certain aim, training, lightness of hand and the range (of his arrows), Drona was stricken greatly with wonder. Then taking up with his hands the celestials bow Gandiva, the energetic Partha, O foremost of Bharatas, drew it. Beholding the downpour of his shafts coming down like a swarm of locusts, they, all filled with wonder, exclaimed “Well done! well done!" Even the very air could not penetrate into the space intervening between his arrows.

sn: अनिशं संदधानस्य शरानुत्सृजतस्तथा॥ ददर्श नान्तरं कश्चित् पार्थस्याददतोऽपि च॥
en: The on-lookers could not mark any cessation between Partha's taking up arrows and shooting them.

sn: तथा शीघ्रास्त्रयुद्धे तु वर्तमाने सुदारुणे। शीघ्रं शीघ्रतरं पार्थः शरानन्यानुदीरयत्॥
en: In that dreadful battle of quickly discharged weapons Partha, speedily and more speedily, shot arrows.

sn: ततः शतसहस्राणि शराणां नतपर्वणाम्। युगपत् प्रापतस्तत्र द्रोणस्य रथमन्तिकात्॥
en: Then simultaneously hundreds and thousands of arrows with depressed knots came down upon the car of Drona.

sn: कीर्यमाणे तदा द्रोणे शरैर्गाण्डीवधन्वना। हाहाकारो महानासीत् सैन्यानां भरतर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of Bharatas, beholding Drona entirely enveloped with shafts shot by the holder of the Gandiva bow, the army set a mighty lamentation.

sn: पाण्डवस्य तु शीघ्रास्त्रं मघवा प्रत्यपूजयत्। गन्धर्वाप्सरसाचैव ये च तत्र समागताः॥
en: Even Indra spoke highly of the lighthandedness Arjuna in the discharge of arrows, as also the Gandharvas and Apsaras who came there.

sn: ततो वृन्देन महता स्थानां रथयूथपः। आचार्यपुत्रः सहसा पाण्डवं पर्यवारयत्॥
en: Then encircled by a vast array of cars, the mighty car-warrior, the son of the preceptor obstructed Partha.

sn: अश्वत्थामा तु तत् कर्म हृदयेन महात्मनः। पूजयामास पार्थस्य कोपं चास्याकरोद् भृशम्॥
en: Though greatly enraged with him, Ashvathama praised in his mind that deed of the high-souled Arjuna.

sn: स मन्युवशमापन्नः पार्थमभ्यद्रवद् रणे। किरज्छरसहस्राणि पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्॥
en: Then possessed by wrath, he encountered Partha in battle and discharged at him a downpour of arrows like clouds discharging their watery contents.

sn: आवृत्य तु महाबाहुर्यतो द्रौणिस्ततो हयान्। अन्तरं प्रददौ पार्थो द्रोणस्य व्यपसर्पितुम्॥
en: Then turning his horses towards Drona's son, Partha offered Drona an opportunity to retreat.

sn: स तु लब्ध्वान्तरं तूर्णमपायाज्जवनैर्हयैः। छिन्नवर्मध्वजः शूरो निकृत्तः परमेषुभिः॥
en: Securing an opportunity, he too, with his coat of mail and banner shattered, and wounded with great arrows, quickly went away on his swiftly-coursing horses.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो द्रौणिर्महाराज प्रययावर्जुनं रणे। तं पार्थः प्रतिजग्राह वायुवेगमिवोद्धतम्।
en: Vaishampayana said Then, Drona's son, O king, encountered Arjuna in battle. Partha then faced him, moving like the wind.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: शरजालेन महता वर्षमाणमिवाम्बुदम्॥ तयोर्देवासुरसमः संनिपातो महानभूत्।
en: With a downpour of shafts like the raincharged clouds. There ensued a mighty encounter like that between the gods and demons.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: किरतोः शरजालानि वृत्रवासवयोरिव॥ न स्म सूर्यस्तदा भाति न च वाति समीरणः।
en: The sun then did not pour its rays and the wind did not blow. And they covered each other with a net-work of arrows, like Vritra and Vasava.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: शरजालावृते व्योम्निच्छायाभूते समन्ततः॥ महांश्चटचटाशब्दो योधयोर्हन्यमानयोः।
en: The sky was enveloped with shafts and there was a shade all around. When the two combatants fought with each other, there was a mighty cracking sound.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: दह्यतामिव वेणूनामासीत् परपुरंजय॥ हयानस्यार्जुनः सर्वान् कृतवानल्पजीवितान्।
en: Like that of bamboo's when on fire. O conqueror of enemies' cities, greatly assailed by Arjuna, his horses.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: राजन् न प्रजानन्त दिशं काञ्चन मोहिताः॥ ततो द्रौणिर्महावीर्यः पार्थस्य विचरिष्यतः। विवरं सूक्ष्ममालोक्य ज्यां चिच्छेद क्षुरेण ह। तदस्यापूजयन् देवाः कर्म दृष्ट्वातिमानुषम्॥
en: Were so bewildered, that they could not make out which way to go. Then finding out the weak point of Partha, who was roving about, the highly powerful son of Drona cut off his bow-string with a sharp arrow. Beholding his superhuman deed, the deities spoke highly of him.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: द्रोणो भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्चैव महारथाः। साधु साध्विति भाषन्तोऽपूजयन् कर्म तस्य तत्॥
en: Exclaiming "Well-done Well-done" Drona, Bhishma, Karna, and the mighty carwarrior Kripa too, applauded his deed.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: ततो द्रौणिर्धनुः श्रेष्ठमपकृष्य स्थर्षभम्। पुनरेवाहनत् पार्थं हृदये कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥ ते
en: Then drawing his that best of bows, the son of Drona again wounded Partha, the foremost of car-warriors, on the breast with Kanka-feathered shafts.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: ततः पार्थो महाबाहुः प्रहस्य स्वनवत् तदा। योजयामास नवया मौळ गाण्डीवमोजसा॥
en: Then, laughing, the mighty-armed Partha set a strong and fresh string to his Gandiva.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: ततोऽर्धचन्द्रमावृत्य तेन पार्थः समागमत्। वारणेनेव मत्तेन मत्तो वारणयूथपः॥
en: Then drawing his bow to the shape of a crescent, Partha proceeded as an infuriated leader of an elephant herd when met by another.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं पृथिव्यामेकवीरयोः। रणमध्ये द्वयोरेवं सुमहल्लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: Then there took place a great hair-stirring encounter between those two heroes peerless on earth.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: तौ वीरौ ददृशुः सर्वे कुरवो विस्मयान्विताः। युध्यमानौ महावीर्यो यूथपाविव संगतौ॥
en: The Kurus, all filled with wonder, saw those two highly powerful heroes like two elephant chiefs.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: तौ समाजघ्नतुर्वीरावन्योन्यं पुरुषर्षभौ। शरैराशीविषाकारैर्बलद्धिरिव पन्नगैः॥
en: With burning arrows of the shape of serpents, those two foremost of men struck each other.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: अक्षय्याविषुधी दिव्यौ पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः। तेन पार्थो रणे शूरस्तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥
en: And because the high-souled son of Pandu, Partha, has a pair of inexhaustible celestials quivers, he remained in battle unmoved like a mountain.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: अश्वत्थाम्नः पुनर्बाणा: क्षिप्रमभ्यस्यतो रणे। जग्मुः परिक्षयं तूर्ममभूत् तेनाधिकोऽर्जुनः॥
en: Ashvathama's arrows however, being speedily discharged, were all exhausted and for this Arjuna beat him down.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: ततः कर्णो महाचापं विकृष्याभ्यधिकं तदा। अवाक्षिपत् ततः शब्दो हाहाकारो महानभूत्॥
en: Then drawing to its full his huge bow, Karna twanged it, and thee arose exclamations of Alas!"

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: ततश्चक्षुर्दधे पार्थो यत्र विस्फार्यते धनुः। ददर्श तत्र राधेयं तस्य कोपो व्यवर्धत॥
en: Then Partha looked forward to where from came the twang of the bow and saw the son of Radha, at which his anger was excited.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: स रोषवशमापन्नः कर्णमेव जिघांसया। तमैक्षत विवृत्ताभ्यां नेत्राभ्यां कुरुपुङ्गवः॥
en: Desirous of slaying Karna and possessed by anger, that foremost of Kurus looked towards him with expanded eyes.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: तथा तु विमुखे पार्थे द्रोणपुत्रस्य सायकान्। त्वरिताः पुरुषा राजन्नुपाजह्वः सहस्रशः॥
en: Then Partha going away from the son of Drona, his men, o king, shot thousands of arrows at him (Partha).

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: उत्सृज्य च महाबाहुद्रौणपुत्रं धनंजयः। अभिदुद्राव सहसा कर्णमेव सपत्नजित्॥
en: Leaving behind the son of Drona, the mighty-armed Dhananjaya, the conqueror of enemies, rushed towards Karna.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Ashvathaman
sn: तमभिद्रुत्य कौन्तेयः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। कामयन् द्वैरथं तेन युद्धं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Approaching him and desiring a duel, the son of Kunti, having his eyes reddened with anger, said.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: यत् ते सभामध्ये अर्जुन उवाच कर्ण बहु वाचा विकत्थितम्। न मे युधि समोऽस्तीति तदिदं समुपस्थितम्॥
en: Arjuna said O Karna, this is the time for you to make good the boastful words you gave vent to in the midst of assembly, 'there is none equal to me in fight.'

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: सोऽद्य कर्ण मया साधु व्यवहृत्य महामृधे। ज्ञास्यस्यबलमात्मानं न चान्यानवमंस्यसे॥
en: Fighting with me today in the encounter, O Karna, you will know your strength and will never disregard others.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: अवोचः परुषा वाचो धर्ममुत्सृज्य केवलम्। इदं तु दुष्करं मन्ये यदिदं ते चिकीर्षितम्॥
en: Disregarding piety, you had given vent to many harsh words. But I consider what you wish to do today as difficult.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: यत् त्वया कथितं पूर्व मामनासाद्य किंचना तदद्य कुरु राधेय कुरुमध्ये मया सह॥
en: Fighting with me today in the midst of the Kurus, do you make good the insulting words that you used towards me before.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: यत् सभायां स पाञ्चालीं क्लिश्यमानां दुरात्मभिः। दृष्टवानसि तस्याद्य फलमाप्नुहि केवलम्॥
en: Do you reap now the fruit of your suffering the Panchala princess to-be distressed by the wicked-souled one in the court.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: धर्मपाशनिबद्धेन यन्मया मर्षितं पुरा। तस्य राधेय कोपस्यं विजयं पश्य मे मृधे॥
en: Being bound by the noose of piety, I desisted, before, from taking revenge. Do you now see the result of my restrained anger in battle.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: वने द्वादश वर्षाणि यानि सोढानि दुर्मते। तस्याद्य प्रतिकोपस्य फलं प्राप्नुहि सम्प्रति॥
en: O wicked one, we have undergone many miseries in the forest for twelve years. Do you now reap the fruit of our vengeance today

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: एहि कर्ण मया साधू प्रतियुध्यस्व सङ्गरे। प्रेक्षकाः कुरवः सर्वे भवन्तु तव सैनिकाः॥
en: Do you fight with me, O Karna, in the battle. Let the Kurus and your soldiers witness it.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: कर्ण उवाच ब्रवीषि वाचा यत् पार्थ कर्मणा तत् समाचर। अतिशेते हि ते वाक्यं कर्मैतत् प्रथितं भुवि॥
en: Karna said Do you carry out your words into action, O Partha. That your words exceed your deeds is known in the world.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: यत् त्वया मर्षितं पूर्वं तदशक्तेन मर्षितम्। इतो गृह्णीमहे पार्थ तव दृष्ट्वा पराक्रमम्॥
en: What you deed suffer formerly was in consequence of your inability. We can admit today by seeing your prowess, O Partha.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: धर्मपाशनिबद्धेन यत् त्वया मर्षितं पुरा। तथैव बद्धमात्मानमबद्धमिव मन्यसे॥
en: If you had suffered the miseries by having been bound by the noose or morality, you are equally bound so even now though you consider yourself free.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: यदि तावद् वने वासो यथोक्तश्चरितस्त्वया। तत् त्वं धर्मार्थवित् क्लिष्टः स मया योद्भुमिच्छसि।
en: If you had passed your exile in the same way as you said, and being distressed (for practising austerities) why do you conversant with Dharma and Artha as you are, wish to fight with me?

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: यदि शक्रः स्वयं पार्थ युध्यते तव कारणात्। तथापि न व्यथा काचिन्मम स्याद् विक्रमिष्यतः।।१३।
en: If Shakra himself, O Partha, fight on your behalf, still, there will be no obstruction to my displaying my prowess.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: अयं कौन्तेय कामस्ते नचिरात् समुपस्थितः। योत्स्यसे हि मया सार्धमद्य द्रक्ष्यसि मे बलम्॥
en: Your wish O son of Kunti, is about to be fulfilled. You will fight with me today and see my prowess.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच इदानीमेव तावत् त्वमपयातो रणान्मम। तेन जीवसि राधेय निहतस्त्वनुजस्तव॥
en: Arjuna said Up to now you had always fled from the battle while fighting with me. For this, you are still alive; but your younger brother has been slain, O son of Radha.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: भ्रातरं घातयित्वा कस्त्यक्त्वा रणशिरच कः। त्वदन्यः कः पुमान् सत्सु ब्रूयादेवं व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Having seen his younger brother slain, what other man except you, would retreat from the battle-field, and then boast as you do in the midst of good men?

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच इति कर्ण ब्रुवन्नेव बीभत्सुरपराजितः। अभ्ययाद् विसृजन् बाणान् कायावरणभेदिनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having thus spoken to Karna, unconquerable Bibhatsu, encountered him, discharging arrows capable of piercing the coats of mail.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: प्रतिजग्राह तं कर्णः प्रीयमाणो महारथः। महता शरवर्षेण वर्षमाणमिवाम्बुदम्॥
en: The mighty car-warrior Karna delightedly received it with a heavy downpour of arrows like a shower of clouds.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: उत्पेतुः शरजालानि घोररूपाणि सर्वशः। अविध्यदश्वान बाह्वोच हस्तावापं पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: That dreadful network of arrows covered, on all sides, piercing severally, the horses, arms and gloves (of the hero).

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: सोऽमृष्यमाण: कर्णस्य निषङ्गस्यावलम्बनम्। चिच्छेद निशिताग्रेण शरेण नतपर्वणा॥
en: Unable to bear the attack of Karna, Arjuna cut off the string of his quiver with a keenedged and straight arrow.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: उपासनादुपादाय कर्णो बाणानथापरान्। विव्याध पाण्डवं हस्ते तस्य मुष्टिरशीर्यत॥
en: Then taking out other arrows from his quiver, Karna struck Arjuna with them on his hand, and the latter lost hold of his bow.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: ततः पार्थो महाबाहुः कर्णस्य धनुरच्छिनत्। स शक्तिं प्राहिणोत् तस्मै तां पार्थो व्यधमच्छरैः॥
en: Then the large-armed Arjuna cut off Karnas bow into pieces. He then struck (Arjuna) with a Shakti, but Partha cut it off with his arrows.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: ततोऽनुपेतुर्बहवो राधेयस्य पदानुगाः। तांश्च गाण्डीवनिर्मुक्तैः प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्॥
en: Then the heroes who followed Karna all attacked Arjunat who killed them with arrows shot from his Gandiva bow.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: ततोऽस्याश्वाञ्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बीभत्सु रसाधनैः। आकर्णमुक्तैरवधीत् ते हताः प्रापतन् भुवि॥
en: Then Bibhatsu killed his horses with sharpened arrows shot from his bow drawn to the ears, and they all fell down slain on earth.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: अथापरेण बाणेन ज्वलितेन महौजसा। विव्याध कर्णं कौन्तेयस्तीक्ष्णेनोरसि वीर्यवान्॥
en: Then taking up another strong, sharp, and powerful arrow, the powerful son of Kunti struck Karna with it on his breast.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: तस्य भित्त्वा तनुत्राणं कायमभ्यगमच्छरः। ततः स तमसाऽऽविष्टो न स्म किंचित् प्रजज्ञिवान्॥
en: Boring through his coat of mail, that arrow penetrated into his body and he was deprived of the power of perception and consciousness.

description: The retreat of Karna in the Goharana
sn: स गाढवेदनो हित्वा रणं प्रायादुदङ्मखः। ततोऽर्जुन उदक्रोशदुत्तरश्च महारथः॥
en: Experiencing a great pain and leaving the battle-field, he fled towards the north. Then Arjuna and the mighty car-warrior Uttara began to scoff him.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो वैकर्तनं जित्वा पार्थो वैराटिमब्रवीत्। एतन्मां प्रापयानीकं यत्र तालो हिरण्मयः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon having vanquished Vaikartanas son (Karna), Arjuna said to Virata's son (Uttara). "Take me to that army where is seen the emblem of golden palmyra.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अत्र शान्तनवो भीष्मो रथेऽस्माकं पितामहः। काङ्क्षमाणो मया युद्धं तिष्ठत्यमरदर्शनः॥
en: There our grand-father, Bhishma the son of Shantanu looking like an immortal, wait on his car, desirous of an encounter with me.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अथ सैन्यं महद् दृष्ट्वा रथनागहयाकुलम्। अब्रवीदुत्तरः पार्थमपविद्धः शरैर्भृशम्॥
en: Then beholding the huge army consisting of cars, elephants and iorses, and being wounded greatly with arrows Uttara said to Partha.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: नाहं शक्ष्यामि वीरेह नियन्तुं ते हयोत्तमान्। विषीदन्ति मम प्राणा मनो विह्वलतीव मे॥
en: "O hero, I am incapable of restraining here your excellent horses. My vital breaths are being exhausted and my mind is bewildered.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अस्त्राणामिव दिव्यानां प्रभावः सम्प्रयुज्यताम्। त्वया च कुरुभिश्चैव द्रवन्तीव दिशो दश॥
en: The ten quarters appear as if melting away on account of the effulgence of the celestials weapon used by you as well as by the Kurus.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: गन्धेन मूर्च्छितश्चाहं वसारुधिरमेदसाम्। द्वैधीभूतं मनो मेऽद्य तव चैव प्रपश्यतः॥
en: I am beside myself with the smell of flesh, blood and fat. Beholding your feat, my mind has been divided in twain.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अदृष्टपूर्वः शूराणां मया संख्ये समागमः। पदापातेन महता शङ्खानां निस्वनेन च॥
en: I had never seen before in battle such an assemblage of heroes. By the great sound of the clashing of maces, the blare of conchs

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: सिंहनादैश्च शूराणां गजानां बृंहितैस्तथा। गाण्डीवशब्देन भृशमशनिप्रतिमेन च।
en: By the war-cries of the heroes, the roars of elephants, by the twang of the Gandiva resembling the sound of lightning.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: श्रुतिः स्मृतिश्च मे वीर प्रणष्टा मूढचेतसः॥ अलातचक्रप्रतिमं मण्डलं सततं त्वया। व्याक्षिप्यमाणं समरे गाण्डीवं च प्रकर्षता। दृष्टिः प्रचलिता वीर हृदयं दीर्यतीव मे॥
en: I have been so stupified, O hero, that I have been deprived of the power hearing and recollecting. Beholding you making, a circle in battle while drawing your Gandiva bow my vision is growing dilated, O hero, and my heart is rending asunder.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: वपुश्चोग्रं तव रणे क्रुद्धस्येव पिनाकिनः। व्यायच्छतस्तव भुजं दृष्ट्वा भीमं भवत्यपि॥
en: Beholding your dreadful figure in battle resembling that of the holder of Pinaka when worked up with anger and as well as the terrible arrows discharged by you, I am filled with fear.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: नाददानं न संधानं न मुञ्चन्तं शरोत्तमान्। त्वामहं सम्प्रपश्यामि पश्यन्नपि न चेतनः॥
en: I am at a loss to find out when you take up your fine arrows, set them on your bowstring and shoot them. Deprived of my consciousness, I do not see you, although before my eyes.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अवसीदन्ति मे प्राणा भूरियं चलतीव च। न च प्रतोदं रश्मींश्च संयन्तुं शक्तिरस्ति मे॥
en: My vitality is sinking and the earth seems moving before me. I have no power to hold the reins of these horses.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच मा भैषीः स्तम्भयात्मानं त्वयापि नरपुङ्गवा अत्यद्भुतानि कर्माणि कृतानि रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Arjuna said Do not fear; cheer yourself up. You too, O foremost of men, performed many wonderful deeds in the battle-field.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: राजपुत्रोऽसि भद्रं ते कुले मत्स्यस्य विश्रुते। जातस्त्वं शत्रुदमने नावसीदितुमर्हसि।॥
en: May you fare well. You are a prince born, in the well-known race of Matsya, for vanquishing your enemies. You should not therefore be dispirited.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: धृतिं कृत्वा सुविपुलां राजपुत्र रथे मम। युध्यमानस्य समरे हयान् संयच्छ शत्रुहन्।॥
en: Stationed on my car, call up your great energy, O prince. Restrain my horses in battle, O slayer of enemies.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्वैराटि नरसत्तमः। अर्जुनो रथिनां श्रेष्ठ उत्तरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having thus addressed the son of Virata, the foremost of men Arjuna the best of carwarriors again said to Uttara.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: सेनाग्रमाशु भीष्मस्य प्रापयस्वैतदेव माम्। आच्छेत्स्याम्यहमेतस्य धनुर्ध्यामपि चाहवे॥
en: Take me again before Bhishma's army. I shall cut off his bowstring in battle.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अस्यन्तं दिव्यमस्त्रं मां चित्रमद्य निशामय। शतह्रदामिवायान्तीं स्तनयित्नोरिवाम्बरे॥
en: You will see today the divine weapons, aglow with beauty, shot by me, flashing like lightning in the midst of clouds in the sky.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: सुवर्णपृष्ठं गाण्डीवं द्रक्ष्यन्ति कुरवो मम। दक्षिणेनाथ वामेन कतरेण स्विदस्यति॥ इति मां सङ्गताः सर्वे तर्कयिष्यन्ति शत्रवः। शोणितोदां रथावर्ती नागनक्रां दुरत्ययाम्। नदी प्रस्कन्दयिष्यामि परलोकप्रवाहिनीम्॥ पाणिपादशिरः पृष्ठबाहुशाखानिरन्तरम्। वनं कुरूणां छेत्स्यामि शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ जयतः कौरवीं सेनामेकस्य मम धन्विनः। शतं मार्गा भविष्यन्ति पावकस्येव कानने॥ मया चक्रमिवाविद्धं सैन्यं द्रक्ष्यसि केवलम्।
en: The Kurus shall see my Gandiva with back made of gold. The enemies assembled together shall discuss by saying "By which hand of his, right or left, does he discharge arrows." I shall make a terrible river to flow today towards the other world, with blood for its water, the cars for the eddies and the elephants for the sharks. I shall, with arrows of depressed knots, cut off the Kuru forest having hands feet, heads, backs and arms for the branches of the trees. And vanquishing alone the Kuru army with a bow in hand, there will be a hundred roads to me as to fire in the forest. Struck by me, you will see, the army whirling only like a wheel.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: इष्वस्त्रे शिक्षितं चित्रमहं दर्शयितास्मि ते॥ असम्भ्रान्तो रथे तिष्ठ समेषु विषमेषु च। दिवमावृत्य तिष्ठन्तं गिरिं भिन्द्यां स्म पत्रिभिः॥
en: I shall show you today my most accomplished training in archery and the use of weapons. Stand firmly on my car, whether the ground be even or uneven. I can pierce with my winged arrows even the Sumeru mountain that rises up to the sky.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अहमिन्द्रस्य वचनात् संग्रामेऽभ्यहनं पुरा। पौलोमान् कालखढ्वांश्च सहस्राणि शतानि च॥ अहमिन्द्राद् दृढां मुष्टिं ब्रह्मणः कृतहस्तताम्। प्रगाढे तुमुलं चित्रमिति विद्धि प्रजापतेः॥
en: Formerly at Indra's command I killed hundreds and thousands of Paulomas and Kalakhajs in battle. I have obtained the firmness of grasp from Indra and successful aim from Brahma.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अहं पारे समुद्रस्य हिरण्यपुरवासिनाम्। जित्वा षष्टिं सहस्राणि रथिनामुग्रधन्विनाम्॥ शीर्यमाणानि कूलानि प्रवृद्धेनेव वारिणा। मया कुरूणां वृन्दानि पात्यमानानि पश्य वै॥ ध्वजवृक्षं पत्तितृणं रथसिंहगणायुतम्। वनमादीपयिष्यामि कुरूणामस्वतेजसा॥ तानहं रथनीडेभ्यः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। यत्तान् सर्वानतिबलान् योत्स्यमानानवस्थितान्। एकः संकालयिष्यामि वज्रपाणिरिवासुरान्।।३
en: I have learnt from Prajapati the diverse kinds of fierce warfare. On the other side of the ocean, I defeated sixty thousand car-warriors all dreadful archers living in Hiranyapura. Behold me, today striking down the vast number of Kurus like a high wind scattering a heap of cotton. By the power of my arrows I shall set fire to the Kuru forest having standards for the trees, the infantry for the shrubs and the car-warriors for the beasts of prey. Like the holder of thunder routing the demons alone shall I today with my straight arrows strike down from the nests of their cars the Kurus fighting to the best of their power in battle.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: रौद्र रुद्राद्रहं शस्त्रं वारुणं वरुणादपि। अस्त्रमाग्नेयमग्नेश्च वायव्यं मातरिश्वनः। वज्रादीनि तथास्त्राणि शक्रादहमवाप्तवान्॥
en: I have obtained from Rudra, the Rudra, from Varuna the Varuna from Agni, the Agneya, from Vayu, the Vayavya, and from Indra the thunderbolt and other weapons.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: धार्तराष्ट्रवनं घोर नरसिंहाभिरक्षितम्। अहमुत्पाटयिष्यामि वैराटे व्येतु ते भयम्॥
en: I shall forsooth eradicate the dreadful Dhritarashtra forest although protected by many powerful heroes. Therefore remove your fear, O son of Virata."

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमाश्चासितस्तेन वैराटिः सव्यसाचिना। व्यवागाहद् स्थानीकं भीमं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्॥
en: Thus consoled by Savyasachin the son of Virata entered into that dreadful array of cars protected by Bhishma.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तमायान्तं महाबाहुं जिगीषन्तं रणे कुरून्। अभ्यवारयदव्यग्रः कूरकर्माऽऽपगासुतः॥
en: The patient Bhishma (the son of river) withstood the mighty armed Arjuna advancing with a view to vanquish the Kurus in battle.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तस्य जिष्णुरुपावृत्य ध्वजं मूलादपातयत्। विकृष्य कलधौताप्रैः स विद्धः प्रापतद् भुवि॥
en: Then approaching him and drawing out a sharp arrow, Vishnu cut off with it the root of his banner. Struck down it fell on the ground.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तं चित्रमाल्याभरणाः कृतविद्या मनस्विनः। आगच्छन् भीमधन्वानं चत्वारच महाबलाः॥ दुःशासनो विकर्णश्च दुःसहोऽथ विविंशतिः। आगत्य भीमधन्वानं बीभत्सुं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: At this the four powerful heroes Dushasana, Vikarana, Dussaha and Vivinshati, skilled in the use of weapons, gifted with great energy and adorned with beautiful garlands and ornaments, approaching, withstood that dreadful bowman Bibhatsu.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: दुःशासनस्तु भल्लेन विद्ध्वा वैराटमुत्तरम्। द्वितीयेनार्जुनं वीरः प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Having pierced Virata's son Uttara with a dart, the heroic Dushasana struck Arjuna on the breast with a second one.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तस्य जिष्णुरुपावृत्य पृथुधारेण कार्मुकम्। चकर्त गापत्रेण जातरूपपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: Confronting him, Vishnu with a greatly sharpened arrow with the wings of a vulture, cut off his bow made of burnished gold.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अथैनं पञ्चभिः पश्चात् प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे। सोऽपयातो रणं हित्वा पार्थबाणप्रपीडितः॥
en: He then wounded him on his breast with five arrows. Assailed by the arrows of Partha, he left the battle-field.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तं विकर्णः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्गध्रपत्रैरजिह्मगैः। विव्याध परवीरनमर्जुनं धृतराष्ट्रजः॥
en: Then with sharp and straight arrows having the wings of vultures, Dhritarashtra's son Vikarana sounded Arjuna, the slayer of hostile heroes.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: ततस्तमपि कौन्तेयः शरेणानतपर्वणा। ललाटेऽभ्यहनत् तूर्णं स विद्धः प्रापतद् रथात्॥
en: Immediately also the son of Kunti wounded him on his forehead with straight arrows. Thus wounded, he fell down from his chariot.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: ततः पार्थमभिद्रुत्य दुःसहः सविविंशतिः। अवाकिरच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैः परीप्सुर्धातरं रणे॥
en: With a view to rescue his brother in battle, Dussaha, accompanied by Vivinshati, approached Partha and covered him with sharp arrows.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तावुभौ गार्धपत्राभ्यां निशिताभ्यां धनंजयः। विद्ध्वा युगपदव्यग्रस्तयोर्वाहानसूदयत्॥
en: Not the least excited Dhananjaya simultaneously struck both of them with a pair of sharp arrows and destroyed the horses of the both.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तौ हताश्वौ विभिनाङ्गौ धृतराष्ट्रात्मजावुभौ। अभिपत्य रथैरन्यैरपनीतौ पदानुगैः॥
en: Having their horses slain and persons wounded, both the sons of Dhritarashtra were taken away by their followers who came there with other chariots.

description: The battle between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: सर्वा दिशश्चान्यपतद् बीभत्सुरपराजितः। किरीटमाली कौन्तेयो लब्धलक्षो महाबलः॥
en: Bibhatsu, never defeated in battle-the highly powerful son of Kunti, adorned with a diadem and having sure aim, covered all the quarters with his arrows.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच अथ संगम्य सर्वे ते कौरवाणां महारथाः। अर्जुनं सहिता यत्ताः प्रत्ययुध्यन्त भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said O descendant of Bharata, then united together all the mighty car-warriors of the Kuru army began to strike Arjuna collectively.

sn: स सायकमयैर्जालैः सर्वतस्तान् महारथान्। प्राच्छादयदमेयात्मा नीहारेणेव पर्वतान्॥
en: That one of incomparable energy covered, on all sides, all those mighty car-warriors with a net-work of arrows as the mountains are covered with dews.

sn: नदद्धिश्च महानागैर्हेषमाणैश्च वाजिभिः। भेरीशङ्खनिनादैश्च स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्॥
en: The huge elephants roaring, the horses neighing and the bugles and conchs being sounded, there arose a great tumult.

sn: नराश्वकायान् निर्भिद्य लौहानि कवचानि च। पार्थस्य शरजालानि विनिष्पेतुः सहस्रशः॥
en: Piercing the bodies of elephants and horses as also the iron coats of mail, the arrows of Partha dropped down in thousands.

sn: त्वरमाणः शरानस्यन् पाण्डवः प्रबभौ रणे। मध्यंदिनगतोऽर्चिष्माञ्छरदीव दिवाकरः॥
en: Shooting speedily his arrows, the son of Pandu looked in battle like the blazing mid-day sun of the autumn.

sn: उपपल्वन्ति चित्रस्ता रथेभ्यो रथिनस्तथा। सादिनचाश्वपृष्ठेभ्यो भूमौ चैव पदातयः॥
en: Possessed by fear, the car-warriors began to leap down from their cars, the horse-men from horse-back, and the infantry to fly away.

sn: शरैः संछिद्यमानानां कवचानां महात्मनाम्। ताम्रराजतलौहानां प्रादुरासीन्महास्वनः॥
en: There arose a great sound when the arrows of the high-souled Arjuna pierced the copper, silver and iron made coats of mail.

sn: छन्नमायोधनं सर्वं शरीरैर्गतचेतसाम्। गजाश्वसादिनां तत्र शितबाणात्तजीवितैः॥
en: The field was soon filled with the corpses of the warriors mounted on elephants and horses, killed by sharpened arrows.

sn: रथोपस्थाभिपतितैरास्तृता मानवैर्मही। प्रनृत्यतीव संग्रामे चापहस्तो धनंजयः॥
en: The earth was covered with dead bodies of men fallen down from the chariots where they were. Dhananjaya as if danced in the battlefield with bow in his hand.

sn: श्रुत्वा गाण्डीवनिर्घोषं विस्कूर्जितमिवाशनेः। त्रस्तानि सर्वसैन्यानि व्यपागच्छन् महाहवात्॥
en: Hearing the twang of Gandiva like the rumble of thunder and being possessed by fear, all the soldiers fled away from the battle-field.

sn: कुण्डलोष्णीषधारीणि जातरूपस्रजस्तथा। पतितानि स्म दृश्यन्ते शिरांसि रणमूर्धनि॥
en: 1 There were seen, fallen in the battle-field, heads having earrings and helmets and golden necklaces.

sn: विशिखोन्मथितैर्गात्रैर्बाहुभिश्च सकार्मुकैः। सहस्ताभरणैश्चान्यैः प्रच्छन्ना भादि मेदिनी॥
en: The earth was covered with human bodies mangled by shafts, arms with bows and hands with ornaments.

sn: शिरसां पात्यमानानामन्तरा निशितैः शरैः। अश्मवृष्टिरिवाकाशादभवद् भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, on account of the heads cut off by sharpened arrows, falling continually on the ground, it appeared that a shower of stones fell from the sky.

sn: दर्शयित्वा तथाऽऽत्मानं रौद्रं रुद्रपराक्रमः। अवरुद्धोऽचरत् पार्थो वर्षाणि त्रिदशानि च।
en: Displaying his own fierce prowess, Partha of dreadful prowess ranged in the battle-field pouring his celestials weapons.

sn: क्रोधाग्निमुत्सृजन् वीरो धार्तराष्ट्रेषु पाण्डवः॥ तस्य तद् दहतः सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा चैव पराक्रमम्।
en: The dreadful son of Pandu discharging his fire of anger at the sons of Dhritarashtra and beholding his dreadful prowess burning down the army.

sn: सर्वे शान्तिपरा योधा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य पश्यतः॥ वित्रासयित्वा तत् सैन्यं द्रावयित्वा महारथान्।
en: They all became terrified in the presence of the son of Dhritarashtra. Having struck terror into the army and routed the mighty carwarriors.

sn: अर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठः पर्यवर्तत भारत॥ प्रावर्तयन्नदी घोरां शोणितोदां तरङ्गिणीम्।
en: Arjuna, the foremost of victors, ranged in the battle-field. He made a river of mighty currents having blood for the water to flow,

sn: अस्थिशैवालसम्बाधां युगान्ते कालनिर्मिताम्॥
en: Like that created by Time at the end of Yuga having bones for the moss and the dreadful hair of the dead, slain by the arrows, for the straws;

sn: शरचापप्लवां घोरां केशशैवलशाद्वलाम्। तनुत्रोष्णीषसम्बाधाः नागकूर्ममहाद्विपाम्॥
en: Having coats of mail and turbans floating on the surface, the elephants standing for islands. The marrow, fat and blood constituted the greatly terrific currents.

sn: मेदोवसाहप्रवहां महाभयविवर्धिनीम्। रौद्ररूपां महाभीमां श्वापदैरभिनादिताम्॥
en: It was dreadful and highly terrific, resounding with the yells of ferocious beasts. It was filled with sharpened weapons forming its crocodiles, and was frequented by cannibals.

sn: तीक्ष्णशस्त्रमहाग्राहां क्रव्यादगणसेविताम्। मुक्ताहारोर्मिकलिलां चित्रालंकारबुबुदाम्॥
en: Strings of pearls formed its ripples and diverse other ornaments the bubbles. The arrows were the eddies, the elephants were the crocodiles, and it was incapable of being got over.

sn: शरसंघमहावर्ती नागनक्रां दुरत्ययाम्। महारथमहाद्वीपां शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिस्वनाम्। चकार च तदा पार्थो नदी दुस्तरशोणिताम्॥
en: The mighty car-warriors were the islands and it was filled with the sound of bugles and conchs. Thus Partha made a river of blood which it was so hard to cross.

sn: आददानस्य हि शरान् संधाय च विमुञ्चतः। विकर्षतश्च गाण्डीवं न कश्चिद् ददृशे जनः॥
en: People could not make out when Partha took up arrows, when he drew the Gandiva bow and discharged them.

description: The fight of Arjuna, in the Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो दुर्योधनः कर्णो दुःशासनविविंशती। द्रोणश्च सह पुत्रेण कृपश्चापि महारथः॥ पुनर्ययुश्च संरब्धा धनंजयजिघांसवः। विस्फारयन्तश्चापानि बलवन्ति दृढानि च।॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then Duryodhana, Karna, Dushasana, Vivinshati, the mighty car-warrior Kripa, Drona, with his son, holding out their strong and powerful bows, rushed with anger towards Dhananjaya with a view to kill him.

description: The fight of Arjuna, in the Goharana
sn: तान् विकीर्णपताकेन रथेनादित्यवर्चसा। प्रत्युद्ययौ महाराज समन्ताद् वानरध्वजः॥
en: O great king, then on his car effulgent like the rays of the sun, the standard of which was struck down, Arjuna, having the emblem of a monkey on his car, encountered them.

description: The fight of Arjuna, in the Goharana
sn: ततः कृपश्च कर्णश्च द्रोणश्च रथिनां वरः। तं महास्त्रैर्महावीर्यं परिवार्य धनंजयम्॥ शरोधान सम्यगस्यन्तो जीमूता इव वार्षिकाः। ववर्षुः शरवर्षाणि पातयन्तो धनंजयम्॥
en: Then covering Dhananjaya with highly powerful weapons, Kripa, Karna, Drona, the foremost of car-warriors, showered a downpour of shafts, like clouds, on him, and struck him.

description: The fight of Arjuna, in the Goharana
sn: इषुभिर्बहुभिस्तूर्णं समरे लोमवाहिभिः। अदूरात् पर्यवस्थाप्य पूरयामासुरादृताः॥
en: Waiting at a distance they speedily covered him in battle with numberless arrows crowned with feathers.

description: The fight of Arjuna, in the Goharana
sn: तथा तैरवकीर्णस्य दिव्यैरस्त्रैः समन्ततः। न तस्य व्यङ्गुलमपि विवृतं सम्प्रदृश्यते॥
en: He being thus covered with celestials weapons, not even a space measuring two fingers was seen on him.

description: The fight of Arjuna, in the Goharana
sn: ततः प्रहस्य बीभत्सुर्दिव्यमैन्द्रं महारथः। अस्त्रमादित्यसंकाशं गाण्डीवे समयोजयत॥
en: Then smiling, the mighty car-warrior Bibhatsu set the Aindra weapon, effulgent like the sun, on his Gandiva bow.

description: The fight of Arjuna, in the Goharana
sn: शररश्मिरिवादित्यः प्रतस्थे समरे बली। किरीटमाली कौन्तेयः सर्वान प्राच्छादयत् कुरून्॥
en: Like the sun covering (the earth) with rays, the powerful son of Kunti, decked with a diadem, remained in the battle-field covering all with arrows.

description: The fight of Arjuna, in the Goharana
sn: यथा बलाहके विद्युत् पावको वा शिलोच्चये। तथा गाण्डीवमभवदिन्द्रायुधमिवानतम्॥
en: As lightning in the clouds, as fire in the rock, so the Gandiva shone like the rain-bow.

description: The fight of Arjuna, in the Goharana
sn: द्योतयन्ती दिशः सर्वाः पृथिवीं च समन्ततः॥ तथा दश दिशः सर्वाः पतद्गाण्डीवमावृणोत्। नागाश्च रथिनः सर्वे मुमुहुस्तत्र भारत॥
en: Gandiva bow had covered all the ten directions in number, by shooting volley of arrows as the lightening glows in sky while raining and it illumines all directions including the earth from all sides. O Barata! all soldiers including elephant riders and car riders were loosing their conscious.

description: The fight of Arjuna, in the Goharana
sn: सर्वे शान्तिपरा योधाः स्वचित्तानि न लेभिरे। संग्रामे विमुखाः सर्वे योधास्ते हतचेतसः॥
en: They all were stunned (inert and dumb) with no conscious at all. All soldiers discouraged to carry on fight and showed their back to the battle-field.

description: The fight of Arjuna, in the Goharana
sn: एवं सर्वाणि सैन्यानि भग्नानि भरतर्षभ। व्यद्रवन्त दिशः सर्वा निराशानि स्वजीविते॥
en: O the best in Bharata dynasty, ) Janamejaya! thus the war-craft/strategy of the whole army shattered. The soldiers began departing under sheer despair wherever they found the way to escape and defend their life.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मो भरतानां पितामहः। वध्यमानेषु योधेषु धनंजयमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said The warriors being thus slain, Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, the grandfather of Bharatas, rushed at Dhananjaya,

sn: प्रगृह्य कार्मुकश्रेष्ठं जातरूपपरिष्कृतम्। शरानादाय तीक्ष्णाग्रान् मर्मभेदान् प्रमाथिनः॥
en: Taking up the best of bows made of burnished gold, and sharp arrows capable of piercing to the very vitals.

sn: पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि। शुशुभे स नरव्याघ्रो गिरिः सूर्योदये यथा।॥
en: And on account of a white umbrella being held over his head, that foremost of men shone like a hill at sun-rise.

sn: प्रध्याय शङ्ख गाङ्गेयो धार्तराष्ट्रान् प्रहर्षयन्। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य बीभत्सुं समवारयत्॥
en: Blowing his conch and cheering up the son of Dhritarashtra, the son of Ganga encountered Bibhatsu.

sn: तमुदीक्ष्य समायान्तं कौन्तेयः परवीरहा। प्रत्यगृह्णात् प्रहृष्टात्मा धाराधरमिवाचलः॥
en: Seeing him approach, that slayer of hostile heroes, the son of Kunti received him gladly like a hill receiving a cloud.

sn: ततो भीष्मः शरानष्टौ ध्वजे पार्थस्य वीर्यवान्। समार्पयन्महावेगाञ्छ्वसमानानिवोरगान्॥
en: Then the greatly energetic Bhishma discharged eight quick arrows, sighing like serpents, at Partha's flag.

sn: ते ध्वजं पाण्डुपुत्रस्य समासाद्य पतत्रिणः। ज्वलन्तं कपिमाजघ्नुर्ध्वजाग्रनिलयांश्च तान्॥
en: Reaching the flag-staff of the son of Pandu, those winged arrows struck the blowing monkey and other creatures stationed on the flag-staff.

sn: ततो भल्लेन महता पृथुधारेण पाण्डवः। छत्रं चिच्छेद भीष्मस्य तूर्णं तदपतद् भुवि॥
en: Then with a huge and sharp dart, the son of Pandu quickly cut off Bhishma's umbrella and it fell down on the ground.

sn: ध्वजं चैवास्य कौन्तेयः शरैरभ्यहनन् भृशम्। शीघ्रकृद् रथवाहांश्च तथोभौ पार्ष्णिसारथी॥
en: The son of Kunti, with arrows, struck his flag-staff, his two horses and her driver that protected his flanks.

sn: अमृष्यमाणस्तद् भीष्मो जानन्नपि स पाण्डवम्। दिव्येनास्त्रेण महता धनंजयप्रवाकिरत्॥
en: Unable to bear this, Bhishma though he knew Arjuna's prowess covered Dhananjaya, the son of Pandu with celestials weapons.

sn: तथैव पाण्डवो भीष्मे दिव्यमस्त्रमुदीरयन्। प्रत्यगृह्णादमेयात्मा महामेघमिवाचलः॥
en: Then discharging a celestials weapon at Bhishma, Pandava, of incomparable energy, received him like a hill receiving a huge mass of cloud.

sn: तयोस्तदभवद् युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। प्रेक्षन्त कुरवः भीष्मस्य सह पार्थेन बलिवासवयोरिव।॥
en: There was a mighty and hair-stirring encounter between Partha and Bhishma like that between Bali and Vasava,

sn: सर्वे योधाश्च सहसैनिकाः भल्लैर्भल्लाः समागम्य भीष्मपाण्डवयोर्युधि। अन्तरिक्षे व्यराजन्त खद्योताः प्रावृषीव हि॥ अग्निचक्रमिवाविद्धं सव्यदक्षिणमस्यतः। गाण्डीवमभवद् राजन् पार्थस्य सृजतः शरान्॥ ततः संछादयामास भीष्मं शरशतैः शितैः। पर्वतं वारिधाराभिश्छादयन्निव तोयदः॥ तां स वेलामिवोद्धतां शरवृष्टिं समुत्थिताम्। व्यधमत् सायकैर्भीष्मः पाण्डवं समवारयत्॥ ततस्तानि निकृत्तानि शरजालानि भागशः। समरे च व्यशीर्यन्त फाल्गुनस्य रथं प्रति॥ ततः कनकपुङ्खानां शरवृष्टिं समुत्थिताम्। पाण्डवस्य रथात् तूर्णं शलमानामिवायतिम्। व्यधमत् तां पुनस्तस्य भीष्मः शरशतैः शितैः॥
en: The Kuru warriors, with their soldiers witnessed that encounter between Bhishma and Partha attacking each other with darts. Partha shooting arrows with both the hands, the Gandiva bow looked like a continuous circle of fire. The son of Kunti enveloped Bhishma with hundreds of sharp arrows like a cloud covering the mountain with rain. Bhishma with his own arrows counteracted that shower of arrows like banks resisting the surging deep, and covered Arjuna with shafts. Those shafts, sundered into a thousand pieces, fell on Arjuna's car. Then arose a downpour of gold-winged shafts going through the sky like a swarm of locusts. He then pierced Bhishma with hundred sharpened shafts.

sn: ततस्ते कुरवः सर्वे साधु साध्विति चाब्रुवन्। दुष्करं कृतवान् भीष्मो यदर्जुनमयोधयत्॥
en: All Kauravas at that moment thanked Bhishma by saying-"Hurrah! Bhishma has showed this rare valour as to wage battle against Arjuna. a

sn: बलवांस्तरुणो दक्षः क्षिप्रकारी धनंजयः। कोऽन्यः समर्थः पार्थस्य वेगं धारयितुं रणे॥ ऋते शान्तनवाद् भीष्मात् कृष्णाद् वा देवकीसुतात्। आचार्यप्रवराद् वापि भारद्वाजान्महाबलात्॥
en: Arjuna is mighty, young, efficient and quick in shooting arrows. Hence, who otherwise than Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, Srikrishna, the son of Devaki or Drona, the son of Bharadvaja, mighty and great preceptor (Acharya), can face Partha in battle.

sn: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य क्रीडन्तौ भरतर्षभौ। चढूंषि सर्वभूतानां मोहयन्तौ महाबलौ॥
en: Both the mighty warriors, crown to the Bharata's dynasty were detouring or splitting the weapons shot by each other as if it was a play not war for them and the spectators were dazed to see it.

sn: प्राजापत्यं तथैवैन्द्रमाग्नेयं रौद्रदारुणम्। कौबेरं वारुणं चैव याम्यं वायव्यमेव च। प्रयुञ्जानौ महात्मानौ समरे तौ विचेरतुः॥
en: Both of the great warriors were thus engaged in battle-field by shooting the weapons Prajapatya, Aiendra, Agneya, Raudra, Kaubera, Varuna, Yama and Vayavya.

sn: विस्मितान्यथ भूतानि तौ दृष्ट्वा संयुगे तदा। साधु पार्थ महाबाहो साधु भीष्मेति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: All spectators to that battle could not resist them saying frequently, Ogreat warrior Partha! we thank you. O great warrior Bhishma! We thank you (viz. we appreciate your war-craft and expertise).

sn: नायं युक्तो मनुष्येषु योऽयं संदृश्यते महान्। महास्त्राणां सम्प्रयोगः समरे भीष्मपार्थयोः॥
en: The great use of specific divine arms and weapons as it is being seen in the battle of Bhishma and Partha, impossible to anywhere and amid other warriors.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं सर्वास्त्रविदुषोरस्त्रयुद्धमवर्तत। अस्त्रयुद्धे तु निर्वृत्ते शरयुद्धमवर्तत॥
en: see O Janamejaya! a battle with divine arms between Bhishma and Arjuna both experts kept on incessant for a certain time. A battle with arrows then started.

sn: अथ जिष्णुरुपावृत्य क्षुरधारेण कार्मुकम्। चकर्त भीष्मस्य तदा जातरूपपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: The victorious Arjuna then marched closer to Bhishma and cut in pieces the gold studded bow of him by shooting an arrow having sword like blade.

sn: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण भीष्मोऽन्यत् कार्मुकं रणे। समादाय महाबाहुः सज्यं चक्रे महारथः। शरांश्च सुबहून् क्रुद्धो मुमोचाशु धनंजये॥
en: The great warrior Bhishma with his huge arms picked-up just at an eye-wink another bow, tied it with string and shot a volley of arrows at Arjuna in sheer anger.

sn: अर्जुनोऽपि शरांस्तीक्ष्णान् भीष्माथ निशितान् बहून्। चिक्षेप सुमहातेजास्तथा भीष्मश्च पाण्डवे॥
en: Arjuna, the great valorous also shot several acute arrows at Bhishma and Bhishma in reaction also shot numerous arrows at Arjuna.

sn: तयोदिव्यास्त्रविदुषोरस्यतोर्निशिताञ्छरान्। विशेषस्तदा राजल्लँक्ष्यते स्म महात्मनोः॥
en: O king! both of the warriors were expert in divine arms and weapons and therefore, shooting at each other acute arrows. No difference anyway was seen them at that time viz. both were equally valorous.

sn: अथावृणोद् दश दिशः शरैरतिरथस्तदा। किरीटमाली कौन्तेयः शूरः शान्तनवस्तथा॥
en: Arjuna, the son of Kunti holding a crown on head and Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, both were Atirathi warrior. They had covered the directions, ten in number with the arrows shot at each other.

sn: अतीव पाण्डवो भीष्मं भीष्मश्चातीव पाण्डवम्। बभूव तस्मिन् संग्रामे राजंल्लोके तदद्भुतम्॥
en: o king Janamejaya! it was really a phenomenon to see of this world that at one time Arjuna, the son of Pandu was seen overlapping Bhishma while Bhishma overlapping Arjuna on the other moment.

sn: पाण्डवेन हताः शूरा भीष्मस्य स्थरक्षिणः। शेरते स्म तदा राजन कौन्तेयस्याभितो स्थम्॥
en: O king! the chivalrous soldiers protecting the chariot of Bhishma were fell down dead both side of that chariot as Arjuna had killed them.

sn: ततो गाण्डीवनिर्मुक्ता निरमित्रं चिकीर्षवः। आगच्छन् पुडसंश्लिष्टाः श्वेतवाहनपत्रिणः॥
en: The arrows bearing wings then started moving forward at their release from the bow named Gandiva of Arjuna rode on the white chariot. They started coming from all sides as if intended to make this entire universe free from enemies.

sn: निष्यतन्तो रथात् तस्य धौता हिरण्यवाससः। आकाशे समदृश्यन्त हंसानामिवपङ्क्तयः॥
en: The white arrows with golden wings appears as a row of swans in the sky when they flew from the side where Arjuna's chariot was existed.

sn: तस्य तद् दिव्यमस्त्रं हि विगाढं चित्रमस्यतः। प्रेक्षन्ते स्मान्तरिक्षस्थाः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः॥
en: Arjuna was shooting divine arms capable to pierce the heart in an excellent manner and Indra etc. all gods were watching his war-craft from the sky where they had come and stood to see this phenomenal battle,

sn: तं दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतो गन्धर्वश्चित्रमद्भुतम्। शशंस देवराजाय चित्रसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: The chivalrous Gandharva Chitrasena was impressed highly with Arjuna and he said Indra, the king of gods in appreciation of his excellent and phenomenal war-craft.

sn: पश्येमान् पार्थनिर्मुक्तान् संसक्तानिव गच्छतः। चित्ररूपमिदं जिष्णोदिव्यमस्त्रमुदीर्यतः॥
en: O sovereign king! see that forwarding swiftly and compact with each other on release from Arjuna's bow. This arrows strategy of Arjuna is really excellent and splendid as he is expert in using divine arms.

sn: नेदं मनुष्याः संदध्युन हीदं तेषु विद्यते। पौराणानां महास्त्राणां विचित्रोऽयं समागमः॥
en: As this arm is not with other people, they cannot use this divine arm for battle. An excellent conglomeration of the powerful arms has been made only in this battle here.

sn: आददानस्य हि शरान् संधाय च विमुञ्चतः। विकर्षतश्च गाण्डीवं नान्तरं समदृश्यत॥
en: Nobody could measure the difference of time between the acts of picking up arrows from holster, putting on bow, shooting and giving tension to the bow.

sn: मध्यंदिनगतं सूर्यं प्रतपन्तमिवाम्बरे। नाशक्नुवन्त सैन्यानि पाण्डवं प्रति वीक्षितुम्॥ तथैव भीष्मं गाङ्गेयं द्रष्टुं नोत्सहते जनः॥
en: The soldiers on part of Kauravas have lost courage even to see straight way at valorous son of Pandu as nobody can gaze at the sun glowing in sky with acute rays in the noon. Similarly, nobody can dare to look straight at Bhishma, the son of Ganga.

sn: उभौ विश्रुतकर्माणावुभौ तीव्रपराक्रमौ। उभौ सदृशकर्माणावुभौ युधि सुदुर्जयौ॥
en: Both warriors are famous for their excellent deeds through the world. Both are aggressively valorous. Both equally chivalours and tough to defeat in the battle.

sn: इत्युक्तो देवराजस्तु पार्थभीष्मसमागमम्। पूजयामास दिव्येन पुष्पवर्षेण भारत॥
en: O Bharata! Indra, the king of gods revealed honour for this excellent battle between Arjuna and Bhishma with showing flowers on them when so reported by Chitrasena.

sn: ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मो वाम पार्श्वमताडयत्। पश्यतः प्रतिसंधाय विध्यतः सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: Bhishma, the son of Shantanu suddenly penetrated the left collateral of Arjuna's body who had wounded the Kauravas' army in course of the fierce battle so fought. are

sn: ततः प्रहस्य बीभत्सुः पृथुधारेण कार्मुकम्। चिच्छेद गार्धपत्रेण भीष्मस्यादित्यतेजसः॥
en: The smiling Bibhatsu with sharp shafts furnished with vulture feathers cut off the bow of Bhishma resembling the sun in effulgence.

sn: अथैनं दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे। यतमानं पराक्रान्तं कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Then with ten shafts Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti, wounded him, brave as he was, on the breast.

sn: स पीडितो महाबाहुर्गृहीत्वा रथकूबरम्। गाङ्गेयो युद्धदुर्धर्षस्तस्थौ दीर्घमिवान्तरम्॥
en: Thus assailed, the powerful son of Ganga stood leaning for a long time on the pole of the car.

sn: तं विसंज्ञमपोवाह संयन्ता रथवाजिनाम्। उपदेशमनुस्मृत्य रक्षमाणो महारथम्॥
en: Beholding him senseless, his charioteer remembering his instructions took away the mighty car-warrior.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच भीष्मे तु संग्रामशिरो विहाय पलायमाने धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रः। उत्सृज्य केतुं विनदन् महात्मा धनुर्विगृह्यार्जुनमाससाद॥
en: Vaishampayana said After Bhishma had fled away from the battle-field, the illustrious Duryodhana, hoisting up his flag, approached Arjuna with bow in hand, and sending up a loud roar.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: स भीमधन्वानमुदप्रवीर्यं धनंजयं शत्रुगणे चरन्तम्। आकर्णपूर्णायतचोदितेन विव्याध भल्लेन ललाटमध्ये।।
en: Then with a dart shot from the bow drawn to the ear, he wounded, on the forehead, Dhananjaya of fierce energy, and a terrible bowman ranging in the midst of the enemies.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: स तेन बाणेन समर्पितेन जाम्बूनदाग्रेण सुसंहितेन। रराज राजन् महनीयकर्मा यथैकपर्वा रुचिरैकशृङ्गः॥३
en: And wounded with a sharp golden arrow on his forehead, that illustrious hero shone like a hill with a single peak.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: अथास्य बाणेन विदारितस्य प्रादुर्बभूवासृगजस्रमुष्णम्। स तस्य जाम्बूनदपुडचित्रो भित्त्वा ललाटं सुविराजते स्म॥
en: Severed by his arrow warm life-blood gushed out of the wound. And piercing his forehead, that golden shaft appeared beautiful.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: दुर्योधनश्चापि तमुग्रतेजाः पार्थश्च दुर्योधनमेकवीरः। अन्योन्यमाजौ पुरुषप्रवीरौ समौ समाजग्मतुराजमीढौ॥
en: Duryodhana of fierce energy, attacked Partha, and Partha attacked him. Thus two foremost of men, born in the family of Ajamidha, struck each other in the battle.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: ततः प्रभिन्नेन महागजेन महीधराभेन पुनर्विकर्णः। रथैश्चतुर्भिर्गजपादरक्षैः कुन्तीसुतं जिष्णुमथाभ्यधावत्॥
en: Then supported by four cars, Vikarna rushed on an infuriated elephant, huge as a mountain, against Jishnu, the son of Kunti.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: तमापतन्तं त्वरितं गजेन्द्र धनंजयः कुम्भविभागमध्ये। आकर्णपूर्णेन महायसेन बाणेन विव्याध महाजवेन॥
en: Seeing him come quickly, Dhananjaya struck that elephant-chief on the head, between the temples, with a fierce iron shaft, discharged from the bow drawn to the ear.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: पार्थेन सृष्टः स तु गापत्र आपुलदेशात् प्रविवेश नागम्। विदार्य शैलप्रवरं प्रकाशं यथाशनिः पर्वतमिन्द्रसृष्टः॥
en: Like thunderbolt, hurled by Indra, smiting a hill, the arrow, with vulture wings, shot by Partha, penetrated up to the very feathers into the huge elephant.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: शरप्रतप्तः स तु नागराज: प्रवेपिताङ्गो व्यथितान्तरात्मा। संसीदमानो निपपात मह्यां वज्राहतं शृङ्गमिवाचलस्य॥
en: Struck by the arrow that elephant-chief, greatly pained began to tremble; and being cxhausted, it fell down on the earth like a nountain summit clapped by a thunderbolt.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: निपातिते दन्तिवरे पृथिव्यां त्रासाद् विकर्णः सहसावतीर्य। तूर्णं पदान्यष्टशतानि गत्वा विविंशते: स्यन्दनमासरोह॥
en: All on a sudden, getting down in great fear from the car, Vikarana ran full eight hundred paces and got on the car of Vivinshati.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: निहत्य नागं तु शरेण तेन वज्रोपमेनाद्रिवराम्बुदाभम्। तथाविधेनैव शरेण पार्थो दुर्योधनं वक्षसि निर्बिभेद॥
en: Having killed with that thunderbolt shaft, that elephant, huge as a hill, and resembling a mass of clouds the son of Pritha struck Duryodhana on the breast, with another arrow of the same kind.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: ततो गजे राजनि चैव भिन्ने भग्ने विकर्णे च सपादरक्षे। स्ते योधमुख्याः सहसापजग्मुः॥
en: The elephant and the king having thus been both wounded and Vikarana having fled away with the followers, other warriors, smitten with the shafts discharged from the Gandiva, fled from the field in panic.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: दृष्ट्वैव पार्थेन हतं च नागं योधांश्च सर्वान् द्रवतो निशम्य। रथं समावृत्य कुरुप्रवीरो रणात् प्रदुद्राव यतो न पार्थः॥
en: Having seen the elephant slain by Partha, and all other heroes running away, Duryodhana, the foremost of Kurus, turning his chariot, immediately fled where Partha was not.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: तं भीमरूपं त्वरितं द्रवन्तं दुर्योधनं शत्रुसहोऽभिषगात्। प्रास्फोटयद् योद्धमनाः किरीटी बाणेन विद्धं रुधिरं वमन्तम्॥
en: While Duryodhana was thus taking to his heels, in great terror, pierced by that arrow, and throwing up blood, Kiritin, still eager for battle and capable of withstanding every enemy, censured him.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: अर्जुन उवाच विहाय कीर्ति विपुलं यशश्च युद्धात् परावृत्य पलायसे किम्। न तेऽद्य तूर्याणि समाहतानि तथैव राज्यादवरोपितस्या॥
en: Arjuna said Renouncing your great fame and glory, why do you take to your heels? Why are not your trumpet blown in the same way as when you started from your kingdom.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: युधिष्ठिस्यास्मि निदेशकारी पार्थस्तृतीयो युधि संस्थितोऽस्मि। तदर्थमावृत्य मुखं प्रयच्छ नरेन्द्रवृत्तं स्मर धार्तराष्ट्र॥
en: I am the obedient servant of Yudhishthira. I am the third son of Pritha, standing here for battle. Turning back, show me your face. Remember the conduct of kings, O son of Dhritarashtra.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: मोघं तवेदं भुवि नामधेयं दुर्योधनेतीह कृतं पुरस्तात्। न हीह दुर्योधनता तवास्ति पलायमानस्य रणं विहाया।१७।।
en: The name Duryodhana, given to you, is thus made meaningless. Where is your persistence in battle-time. Your run away leaving the battle-field.

description: The retreat of Duryodhana in the Goharana
sn: न ते पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतो वा पश्यामि दुर्योधन रक्षितारम्। अपेहि युद्धात् पुरुषप्रवीर प्राणान् प्रियान् पाण्डवतोऽद्य रक्ष॥
en: O Duryodhana! As no guard is seen either in front or back of you. Hence, O chivalrous man! Immediately depart from the battle-field and save your life before you die in the hands of Arjuna.

description: The return of Uttara to his city in the Goharana
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच आहूयमानश्च स तेन संख्ये महात्मना वै धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रः। निवर्तितस्तस्य गिराङ्कुशेन महागजो मत्त इवाङ्कुशेन॥
en: Vaishampayana said-"O Janamejaya! Duryodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra again returned like an intoxicant elephant injured by goad when great Arjuna challenged him so far the bathe as his harsh words acted like a goad on him.

description: The return of Uttara to his city in the Goharana
sn: सोऽमृष्यमाणो वचसाभिमृष्टो महाराथनातिरथस्तरस्वी। पर्याववाथ रथेन वीरो भोगी यथा पादतलाभिमृष्टः॥
en: As the son of Kunti had humiliated him with harsh words, he, the chivalours warrior (Atirathi) could not endure and returned immediately with his chariot to like revenge like a snake crushed under feet.

description: The return of Uttara to his city in the Goharana
sn: तं प्रेक्ष्य कर्णः परिवर्तमानं निवर्त्य संस्तथ्य च विद्धगात्रम्। ॥ दुर्योधनस्योत्तरतोऽभ्यगच्छत् पार्थं नृवीरो युधि हेममाली॥
en: Having seen Duryodhana so returned for battle, Karna too anyhow energised his injured body, covered the left collateral of Duryodhana to defend him and marched forward so as to face Arjuna. The chivalrous Karna was duly held of a garland made of gold.

description: The return of Uttara to his city in the Goharana
sn: भीष्मस्ततः शान्तनवो विवृत्य हिरण्यकक्षस्त्वरयाभिषङ्गी। दुर्योधनं पश्चिमतोऽभ्यरक्षत् पार्थान्महाबाहुरधिज्यधन्वा॥
en: Bhishma, the son of Shantanu with a golden sheet of cloth covering his body came immediately there as he had turned chariot speedily. He was capable to defeat the enemy. He began defending Duryodhana from the attack made by Arjuna at the west or backside with his bow ready to shoot acute arrows.

description: The return of Uttara to his city in the Goharana
sn: द्रोणः कृपश्चैव विविंशतिश्च दुःशासनश्चैव विवृत्य शीघ्रम्। सर्वे पुरस्ताद् विततोरुचापा दुर्योधनार्थं त्वरिताऽभ्युपेयुः॥
