sn: दिष्टभावं गतस्यापि विषये मोदते प्रजा। य आत्मनः प्रियसुखे हित्वा मृगयते श्रियम्॥ अमात्यानामथो हर्षमादधात्यचिरेण सः॥
en: May be subject to the influence of his fate but even in such a case his subjects rejoice; for he who leaving his own happiness hunts for the prosperity (of his kingdom) very contributes to the rejoicing of his ministers. soon

description: Injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: पुत्र उवाच किं नु ते मामपश्यन्त्याः पृथिव्या अपि सर्वया। किमाभरणकृत्यं ते किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा॥
en: The son said If you do not behold me, what is this entire earth to you; what will your ornaments do for you, and what is the use of enjoyments and what even of life itself.

description: Injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: मातोवाच किमद्यकानां ये लोका द्विषन्तस्तानवाप्नुयुः। ये त्वादृतात्मनां लोकाः सुहृदस्तान् ब्रजन्तु नः॥
en: The mother said The world which is (reserved) for the poor and miserable, may our enemies attain to; and may our well-wishers roam about in the earth which is (reserved) for respected souls.

description: Injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: भृत्यैविहीयमानानां परपिण्डोपजीविनाम्। कृपणानामसत्त्वानां मा वृत्तिमनुवर्तिथाः॥
en: Do not follow the life of those who are devoid of attendants, who subsist on the food given by others (by way of charity); who are miserable and who are devoid of strength and prowess.

description: Injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अनु त्वां तात जीवन्तु ब्राह्मणाः सुहृदस्तथा। पर्जन्यमिव भूतानि देवा इव शतक्रतुम्॥
en: May the Brahmanas and your wellwishers, my son, live depend on you as living creatures depend on the clouds (rain) and as the gods depend on the performer of a hundred sacrifices.

description: Injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: यमाजीवन्ति पुरुषं सर्वभूतानि संजय। पक्वं दुममिवासाद्य तस्य जीवितमर्थवत्॥
en: The man, depending on whom all living creatures depend, O Sanjaya as (birds) on a tree with ripe fruits, has his life rendered useful.

description: Injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: यस्य शूरस्य विक्रान्तैरेधन्ते बान्धवाः सुखम्। त्रिदशा इव शक्रस्य साधु तस्येह जीवितम्॥
en: The hero, by whose prowess his friends attain to happiness like the gods attaining to happiness through Shakra has his life blessed.

description: Injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: स्वबाहुबलमाश्रित्य योऽभ्युज्जीवति मानवः। स लोके लभते कीर्ति परत्र च शुभां गतिम्॥
en: That son of Manu, who lives on the strength of his arms, gets renown in this world and a blissful one here after.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: विदुलोवाच अर्थतस्यामवस्थायां पौरुषं हातुमिच्छसि। निहीनसेवितं मागं गमिष्यस्यचिरादिव॥
en: Vidula said If under these circumstances you desire to abandon manliness, you will soon be following the path followed by the mean and the low.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: यो हि तेजो यथाशक्ति न दर्शयति विक्रमात्। क्षत्रियो जीविताकाङ्क्षी स्तेन इत्येव तं विदुः॥
en: That Kshatriya, who being desirous of life, does not exercise his energy and power to the best of his ability, is said to be like a thief.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अर्थवन्त्युपपन्नानि वाक्यानि गुणवन्ति च। नैव सम्प्राप्नुवन्ति त्वां मुमूर्षुमिव भेषजम्॥
en: Like medicine to one at the point of death these words which are conducive to your interest and are otherwise well suited, do not act in your mind.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: सन्ति वै सिन्धुराजस्य संतुष्टा न तथा जनाः। दौर्बल्यादासते मूढा व्यसनौघप्रतीक्षिणः॥
en: The men, under the king of the Sindhus, are not contented and those fools are, owing to their own weakness, waiting for some calamity to their master, on which they will effect their deliverance.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: सहायोपचितिं कृत्वा व्यवसाय्य ततस्ततः। अनुदुष्येयुरपरे पश्यन्तस्तव पौरुषम्॥
en: Having collected their forces one by one, his enemies will join you at seeing your prowess.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: तैः कृत्वा सह संघातं गिरिदुर्गालयं चर। काले व्यसनामाकाङ्क्षन् नैवायमजरामरः॥
en: Having united yourself with them wander about in the caverns and fastness of the mountains and in proper time he will meet with calamities for he is neither without old age nor is immortal.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: संजयो नामतश्च त्वं न च पश्यामि तत् त्वयि। अन्वर्थनामा भव मे पुत्र मा व्यर्थनामकः॥
en: By name you are Sanjaya but I do not see Jaya (victory) in you; follow the meaning of your name and do not make it false.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: सम्यग्दृष्टिर्महाप्राज्ञो बालं त्वां ब्राह्मणोऽब्रवीत्। अयं प्राप्य महत् कृच्छ्रे पुनर्वृद्धिं गमिष्यति॥
en: A very wise man, possessing great foresight, said to you while you were a child: "After meeting with great difficulties, he will again meet with prosperity.”

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: तस्या स्मरन्ती वचनमाशंसे विजयं तव। तस्मात् तात व्रवीमि त्वां वक्ष्यामि च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Remembering these words I expect your victory, therefore do I speak this to you, my dear son, and am telling you this again and again.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: यस्य ह्याभिनिवृत्तौ भवन्त्याप्यायिताः परे। तस्यार्थसिद्धिर्नियता नयेष्वर्थानुसारिणः॥
en: He, in the success of whose object others become interested, is sure to have his object crowned with success if he follows it according to the ordinary rules of prudence.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: समृद्धिरसमृद्धिर्वा पूर्वेषां मम संजय। एवं विद्वान् युद्धमना भव मा प्रत्युपाहर॥
en: “Whether there be increase or decrease I will fight,"O Sanjaya, engage in fight with this thought and do not turn back.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: नातः पापीयसीं कांचिदवस्थां शम्बरोऽब्रवीत्। यत्र नैवाद्य न प्रातर्भोजनं प्रतिदृश्यते॥
en: There is no condition more frightful than this, said Shamvara, namely that in which the food for today and that for the morrow are not seen.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: पतिपुत्रवधादेतत् परमं दुःखमब्रवीत्। दारिद्र्यमिति यत् प्रोक्तं पर्यायमरणं हि तत्॥
en: He said that this as a greater troubles than the death of one's husband and sons; what is called poverty is another form of death.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अहं महाकुले जाता ह्रदाद्धदमिवागता। ईश्वरी सर्वकल्याणी भ; परमपूजिता॥
en: I am born in a great family and have come from a lake; I am the mistress over many persons, endued with all blessings and very much esteemed by my husband.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: महार्हमाल्याभरणां सुमृष्टाम्बरवाससम्। पुरा हृष्टः सुहृद्वर्गो मामपश्यत् सुहृद्गताम्॥
en: My group of friends saw me in days of old among friends, with a cheerful heart, decked with costly garlands and ornaments, with my body well washed, and attired in good clothes.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: यदा मां चैव भार्यां च द्रष्टाऽसि भृशदुर्बलाम्। न तदा जीवितेनार्थो भविता तव संजय॥
en: When you will see myself your wife very weak (owing to the want of nourishment) then of what use will life be to you, O Sanjaya?

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: दासकर्मकरान् भृत्यानाचार्यविक्पुरोहितान्। अवृत्त्याऽस्मान् प्रजहतो दृष्ट्वा किं जीवितेन ते॥
en: Seeing our servants who used to attend on us doing mineral offices, our preceptors, and our priests go away leaving us, what is the good of life to you?

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: यदि कृत्यं न पश्यामि तवाद्याहं यथा पुरा। श्लाघनीयं यशस्यं च का शान्तिर्हृदयस्य मे॥
en: If I do not now see you following such duties as you observed in days gone by which were laudable and conducive to your renown what peace of mind can I get?

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: नेति चेद् ब्राह्मणं ब्रूयां दीर्येत हृदयं मम। न ह्यहं न च मे भर्ता नेति ब्राह्मणमुक्तवान्॥
en: If I have to say. “No” to a Brahmana (asking for a favour) it will rend my heart. Neither myself nor my husband ever said “No” to a Brahmana.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: वयमाश्रयणीयाः स्म नश्रोतारः परस्य च। सान्यमासाद्य जीवन्ती परित्यक्ष्यामि जीवितम्॥
en: We are the proper refuge to others but never depended on others ourselves. Such being the case, if I now have to live as a dependent on another, I shall sacrifice my life.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अपारे भव नः पारमप्लवे भव नः प्लवः। कुरुष्व स्थानमस्थाने मृतान् संजीवयस्व नः॥
en: Be the means of our crossing that which cannot be crossed and be our boat where there is no boat. Make room for us where there is at present no room and revive us that are dead.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: सर्वे ते शत्रवः शक्या न चेज्जीवितुमिच्छसि। अथ चेदीदृशीं वृत्तिं क्लीबवामभ्युपपद्यसे॥
en: All your enemies are capable of being opposed by you; if not, it is not proper that you should live on. You are now following a course of life which is fit only for eunuchs.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: निर्विण्णात्मा हतमना मुञ्चैतां पापजीविकाम्। एकशत्रुवधेनैव शूरो गच्छति विश्रुतिम्॥
en: Cast off this wicked and despicable life which you are leading with a troubled soul and depressed heart. By slaying only one enemy does a hero gain renown.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: इन्द्रो वृत्रवधेनैव महेन्द्रः समपद्यत। माहेन्द्रं च गृहं लेभे लोकानां चेश्वरोऽभवत्॥
en: Indra became the great Indra only by slaying Vritra and obtained the lordship over the gods and the celestial cup for drinking wine and became the lord of the worlds.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: नाम विश्राव्य वै संख्ये शत्रूनाहूय दंशितान्। सेनाग्रं चापि विद्राव्य हत्वा वा पुरुषं वरम्॥
en: Making his name heard in the battle, and summoning the enemies clad in coats of mail to fight, killing the foremost of the hostile army of illustrious men,

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: यदैव लभते वीरः सुयुद्धेन महद् यशः। तदैव प्रव्यथन्तेऽस्य शत्रवो विनमन्ति च॥
en: When a hero obtains great renown in fair fight then do his enemies feel pain and bow down to him.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मानं रणे दक्षं शूरं कापुरुषा जनाः। अवशास्तर्पयन्ति स्म सवकामसमृद्धिभिः॥
en: Men, who are cowards being beside themselves, contribute by giving their own wealth to the fulfillment of every desire of the hero experienced in battle and who does not fight for selfish consideration.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: राज्यं चाप्युग्रविभ्रंशं संशयो जीवितस्य वा। न लब्धस्य हि शत्रोर्वे शेषं कुर्वन्ति साधवः॥
en: Even when the kingdom is in a terrible danger or the life even doubtful, the good men do not desist without making an end of his enemy who is within his grasp.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: स्वर्गद्वारोपमं राज्यमथवाप्यमृतोपमम्। युरुद्धमेकायनं मत्वा पतोल्मुक इवारिषु॥
en: A kingdom is like the gate of heaven or like neckar itself and thinking that the heaven is shut against you and that you van get into it through one door, fall like a fire brand among the enemies.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: जहि शत्रून् रणे राजन् स्वधर्ममनुपालय। मा त्वा दृशं सुकृपणं शत्रूणां भयवर्धनम्॥
en: Defeat your enemies in battle; O king, and follow the duties of your own order, and do not in this way, look dejected, O you enhance of the fears of your enemies.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अस्मदीयैश्च शोचद्भिर्नदद्धिश्च परैर्वृतम्। अपि त्वां नानुपश्येयं दीनाद् दीनमिव स्थितम्॥
en: Let me not is sorrow see you surrounded by our party grieving and the enemies rejoicing.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: हृष्य सौवीरकन्याभिः श्लाघस्वार्थेर्यथा पुरा। मा च सैन्धवकन्यानामवसनो वशं गमः॥
en: Rejoice in the company of the daughter of heroes and make yourself amiable by the possessions of wealth as in days gone by and do not let yourself be under the rule of the daughters of the Saindhavas.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: युवा रूपेण सम्पन्नो विद्ययाभिजनेन च। यत् त्वादृशो विकुर्वीत यशस्वी लोकविश्रुतः॥
en: A young man, endued with beauty, with learning and possessing powerful friends, should do only what is conducive to renown and heard and talked about in the world.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अधुर्यवच्च वोढव्ये मन्ये मरणमेव तत्। यदि त्वामनुपश्यामि परस्य प्रियवादिनम्॥
en: If in the matter of bearing burdens he acts like a vicious bull, I think this to be death itself. If I see you hereafter speaking well of enemy.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: पृष्ठतोऽनुव्रजन्तं वा का शान्तिर्हदयस्य मे। नास्मिन् जातु कुले जातो गच्छेद् योऽन्यस्य पृष्ठतः।।३५।
en: Or wandering about behind him, what peace can my heart have. No one born in this race behind another for support.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: न त्वं परस्यानुचरस्तात जीवितुमर्हसि। अहं हि क्षत्रहदयं वेद यत् परिशाश्वतम्॥
en: O my dear son, it is not proper that you should live on being the subject of another. I know what the eternal essence of the heart of a Kshatriya is?

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: पूर्वैः पूर्वतरैः प्रोक्तं परैः परतरैरपि। शाश्वतं चाव्ययं चैव प्रजापतिविनिर्मितम्॥
en: As described by our forefathers and by men before them, as also by men after them and after them again; it is highly praise worthy since it has been ordained by the lord of creatures himself.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: यो वै कश्चिदिहाजातः क्षत्रियः क्षत्रकर्मवित्। भयाद् वृत्तिसमीक्षो वा न नमेदिह कस्यचित्॥
en: The Kshatriya, who is born in this world knowing the duties of a Kshatriya, does not bow to any one from fear or from consideration of livelihood.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: उद्यच्छेदेव न नमेदुद्यमो ह्येव पौरुषम्। अप्यपर्वणि भज्येत न नमेतेह कस्यचित्॥
en: He should stand erect and never bend down for energy is manliness. One away break down at his knots (weak points) but he should not bend down.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: मातङ्गो मत्त इव च परीयात् समहामनाः। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नमेन्नित्यं धर्मायैव च संजय॥
en: That great-minded man the Kshatriya should move about like an infuriated elephant and he should ever bow down to Brahmanas for virtue. O Sanjaya.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: नियच्छन्नितरान् वर्णान् विनिघ्नन् सर्वदुष्कृतः। ससहायोऽसहायो वा यावज्जीवं तथा भवेत्॥
en: Ruling ever all the other orders and slaying all evil doers he should live though out his life, whether he be with support or without it,

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: पुत्र उवाच कृष्णायसस्येव च ते संहत्य हृदयं कृतम्। मम मातस्त्वकरुणे वीरप्रज्ञे घमर्षणे।।।।
en: The son said Your heart is made of steel shaped into that from, O my mother, who have no pity or compassion in you, who are wrathful and are of the wisdom of soldier.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अहो क्षत्रसमाचारो यत्र मामितरं यथा। नियोजयसि युद्धाय परमातेव मां तथा॥
en: Fie on the custom of the Kshatriyas since you, being own mother, urge me to go to battle as if were a stranger and you the mother of another.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: ईदृशं वचनं ब्रूयाद् भवती पुत्रमेकजम्। किं नु ते मामपश्यन्त्याः पृथिव्या अपि सर्वया॥
en: Such cruel words are spoken by you to your only son; if cease to see me of what good is even the entire earth to you?

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: किमाभरणकृत्येन किं भोगै वितेन वा। मयि वा संगरहते प्रियपुत्रे विशेषतः॥
en: What is the use of ornaments? What of enjoyments and what even of life especially when you are deprived of the company of myself, your dear son.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: मातोवाच सर्वावस्था हि विदुषां तात धर्मार्थकारणात्। तावेवाभिसमीक्ष्याहं संजय त्वामचूचुदम्॥
en: The mother said All the doings, of those who are wise, are for the attainment of either virtue or worldly profit or both; and with my eye to these two along have urged you, O Sanjaya.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: स समीक्ष्यक्रमोपेतो मुख्यः कालोऽयमागतः। अस्मिश्चेदागते काले कार्यं न प्रतिपद्यसे॥
en: This is the time now for showing your prowess; and this suitable time having now arrived, if you do not resort to the proper action,

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: असम्भावितरूपस्त्वमानृशंस्यं करिष्यसि। तं त्वामयशसा स्पृष्टं न ब्रूयां यदि संजय॥
en: You will be showing a degree of compassion inconsistent with your birth; and if I do not speak out of affection, O Sanjaya, to you who are already contaminated by infamy,

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: खरीवात्सल्यमाहुस्तन्निः सामर्थ्य महेतुकम्। सद्धिर्विगर्हितं मागं त्यज मूर्खनिषेवितम्॥
en: Then that affection would be called an ass' for her young one,; it would besides be false and unreasonable, abandon the path trodden by the ignorant and held in contempt by the good.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अविद्या वै महत्यस्ति यामिमां संश्रिताः प्रजाः। तव स्याद् यदि सद्वृत्तं तेन मे त्वं प्रियो भवेः॥
en: Great is the ignorance in this world in which all living creatures have taken refuge; if your habits life be praise worthy, then will you win my esteem by that means,

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: धर्मार्थगुणयुक्तेन नेतरेण कथंचन। दैवमानुपयुक्तेन सद्भिराचरितेन च॥
en: Namely, if you are endued with the accomplishments of virtue and seek worldly but by following the path trodden by the gods and men and by the honest.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: यो ह्येवमविनीतेन रमते पुत्र नप्तृणा। अनुत्थानवता चापि दुर्विनीतेन दुर्धिया॥
en: He who is pleased with such a son or a grandson not endued with humility, not given to exerting for himself, rebellious and badhearted.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: रमते यस्तु पुत्रेण मोघं तस्य प्रजाफलम्। अकुर्वन्तो हि कर्माणि कुर्वन्तो निन्दितानि च॥
en: And he who is pleased with a son who does only such acts as are unrighteous, has the object of his begetting children rendered unsuccessful.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: सुखं नैवेह नामुत्र लभन्ते पुरुषाधमाः। युद्धाय क्षत्रियः सृष्टः संजयेह जयाय च॥
en: The wretch does not attain to happiness in this world nor in the other, O Sanjaya; a Kshatriya has been created for fighting in this world and for gaining victories.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: जयन् वावध्यमानो वा प्राप्नोतीन्द्रसलोकताम्। न शक्रभवने पुण्ये दिवि तद् विद्यते सुखम्।
en: Whether he is victorious or is slain he attains to the world of Indra. And that happiness does not exist in heaven or in the sacred region of Indra;

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: यदमित्रान् वशे कृत्वा क्षत्रियः सुखमेधते॥ मन्युना दह्यमानेन पुरुषेण मनस्विना। निकृतेनेह बहुशः शत्रून् प्रतिजिगीषया॥
en: Namely the happiness to which a Kshatriya attains by bringing his friends under his influence (according to some readings it would be by subjugating his enemies). A spirited man, who has been defeated many times, should live on with the hope of vanquishing his enemy and consumed by wrath,

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: आत्मानं वा परित्यज्य शत्रु वा विनिपात्य च। अतोऽन्येन प्रकारेण शान्तिरस्य कुतो भवेत्॥
en: He should either abandon self or vanquish his enemy; how can there be peace in any other way save this.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: इह प्राज्ञो हि पुरुषः स्वल्पमप्रियमिच्छति। यस्य स्वल्पं प्रियं लोके ध्रुवं तस्याल्पमप्रियम्॥
en: In this world a wise man regards little as undesirable; the man to whom little is sufficient soon becomes weary of that little (and wishes for more).

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: प्रियाभावाच्च पुरुषो नैव प्राप्नोति शोभनम्। ध्रुवं चाभावमभ्येति गत्वा गङ्गेव सागरम्॥
en: A man does not attain to happiness who has not got what he desires; and in fact he certainly feels his want as does the Ganga on losing herself in the ocean.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: पुत्र उवाच नेयं मतिस्त्वया वाच्या मातः पुत्रे विशेषतः। कारुण्यमेवात्र पश्य भूत्वेह जडमूकवत्॥
en: The son said You should not speak in this strain, O mother, especially to your son; exercise your compassion only in this case like a silent and dumb woman.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: मातोवाच अतो मे भूयसी नन्दिर्यदेवमनुपश्यसि। चोद्यं मां चोदयस्येतद् भृशं वै चोदयामि ते॥
en: The mother said It is indeed a matter of great pleasure to me that you understand what I say. You urge me in my duty and therefore should I urge you all the more in yours.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अथत्वां पूजयिष्यामि हत्वा वै सर्वसैन्धवान्। अहं पश्यामि विजयं कृच्छ्रभावितमेव ते॥
en: When you have slain all the Saindhavas and are thus victorious and beyond all your troubles, I shall honour you.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: पुत्र उवाच अकोशस्यासहायस्य कुतः सिद्धिर्जयो मम। इत्यवस्थां विदित्वैतामात्मनाऽऽत्मनि दारुणाम्॥
en: The son said Having no wealth, having no friends, how can I gain success and victory. Knowing these circumstances I have thus dealt harshly with myself.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: राज्याद् भावो निवृत्तो मे त्रिदिवादिव दुष्कृतः। ईदृशं भवती कंचिदुपायमनुपश्यति॥
en: I am without exertion in recovering the kingdom as a sinful man makes no attempt to get into heaven. Such being the case, do you see any way to my fighting with the enemy.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: तन्मे परिणतप्रज्ञे सम्यक् प्रबूहि पृच्छते। करिष्यामि हि तत् सर्वं यथावदनुशासनम्॥
en: Speak to me who are asking you in detail of that, O you of ripe and practical wisdom-I shall perform in a suitable manner all that you command me.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: मातोवाच पुत्र नात्मावमन्तव्यः पूर्वाभिरसमृद्धिभिः। अभूत्वा हि भवन्त्यर्था भूत्वा नश्यन्ति चापरे।
en: The mother said O son, your mind should not be insulted by anticipation's of failure. Objects unattained at first are gained subsequently and other objects attained at first are lost afterwards.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अमर्षेणैव चाप्यर्था नारब्धव्याः सुबालिशैः॥ सर्वेषां कर्मणां तात फले नित्यमनित्यता। अनित्यमिति जानन्तो न भवन्ति भवन्ति च॥
en: An object should not be pursued in wrath or with folly; my dear son, there is always uncertainly in the results of all actions. To those who know that the result is uncertain objects are sometimes successful and sometimes not.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अथ ये नैव कुर्वन्ति नैव जातु भवन्ति ते। ऐकगुण्यमनीहायामभावः कर्मणां फलम्॥
en: To those who do not make any attempt success does not come in the absence of exertion; there is only result of actions.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अथ द्वैगुण्यमीहायां फलं भवति वा न वा। यस्य प्रागेव विदिता सर्वार्थानामनित्यता॥
en: To those who make attempts there are two results, namely success or failure. He, to whom is know from the very first the uncertainly of the result of all actions,

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: नुदेद् वृद्ध्यसमृद्धी स प्रतिकूले नृपात्मजा उत्थातव्यं जागृतव्यं योक्तव्यं भूतिकर्मसु॥
en: Fails to obtain success and prosperity; O you who have been born of the soul of a ruler of men, in every act should one engage himself with energy and wakefulness.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: भविष्यतीत्येव मनः कृत्वा सततमव्यथैः। मङ्गलानि पुरस्कृत्य ब्राह्मणांश्चेश्वरैः सह॥
en: Resolving within himself-This must beand ever without any depression of heart. One who placing auspicious signs before him and in company with the Brahmanas and the gods (engages in action),

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: प्राज्ञस्य नृपतेराशु वृद्धिर्भवति पुत्रक। अभिवर्तति लक्ष्मीस्तं प्राचीमिव दिवाकरः॥
en: To that wise king does prosperity soon come, my dear son. The goddess of prosperity and grace comes to him like the sun coming to the east.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: निदर्शनान्युपायांश्च बहून्युद्धर्षणानि च। अनुदर्शितरूपोऽसि पश्यामि कुरु पौरुषम्॥
en: I see, you have shown yourself fit to appreciate many examples, expedients and words given vent to excite your energy-now show your manliness.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: पुरुषार्थमभिप्रेतं समाहर्तुमिहार्हसि। क्रुद्धाल्लुब्धान् परिक्षीणानवलिप्तान् विमानितान्॥
en: It is proper that you should attain to your desired object which is indeed desired by every man. Those who entertain angry feelings against your enemy, those who covet his prosperity, those who have been weakened by him or have been eclipsed by him or insulted by him,

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: स्पर्धिनश्चैव ये केचित् तान् युक्त उपधारय। एतेन त्वं प्रकारेण महतो भेत्स्यसे गणान्॥
en: Those who look on him with contempt and all others against him, do you bring together, and with their help will you be able to break the thick ranks of your enemy,

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: महावेग इवोद्भूतो मातरिश्वा बलाहकान्। तेषामग्रप्रदायी स्याः कल्योत्थायी प्रियंवदः॥
en: Like a tempest of great force scattering the clouds. Make payments to them (your allies) before such payments are due, use your energy, and speak to them mildly.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: ते त्वां प्रियं करिष्यन्ति पुरोधास्यन्ति च ध्रुवम्। यदैव शत्रुर्जानीयात् सपन्नं त्यक्तजीवितम्। तदैवास्मादुद्विजते सर्पाद् वेश्मगतादिव॥
en: Then will they do what is desirable to you and will surely stand before you to take on themselves the charge of the battle). As soon as the enemy knows that you have grown careless of life, he will begin to fear you as a snake entering his house.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: तं विदित्वा पराक्रान्तं वशे न कुरुते यदि। निर्वादैनिर्वदेदेनमन्ततस्तद् भविष्यति॥
en: Knowing him to be powerful if one (his enemy) does not subjugate him, he should at least conciliate him, by friendliness and the like.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: निर्वादादास्पदं लब्वा धनवृद्धिर्भवष्यति। धनवन्तं हि मित्राणि भजन्ते चाश्रयन्ति च॥
en: Attaining to prosperity by these friendly means, there occurs an increase in wealth. Friends seeks the refuge of the wealthy and worship him.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: स्खलितार्थ पुनस्तात संत्यजन्ति च बान्धवाः। अप्यस्मिन् नाश्वसन्ते च जुगुप्सन्ते च तादृशम्॥
en: And again friends abandon him who is deprived of his wealth and they even view with suspicion and contempt such a man.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: शत्रु कृत्वा यः सहायं विश्वासमुपगच्छति। स न सम्भाव्यमेवैतद् यद् राज्यं प्राप्नुयादिति॥
en: He, who making an ally of his enemy, lives confidently, cannot be possibly expected to regain his kingdom.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: मातोवाच नैव राज्ञाः दरः कार्यों जातु कस्याञ्चिदापदि। अथ चेदपि दीर्णः स्यान्नैव वर्तेत दीर्णवत्॥
en: The mother said By a king should fear never be entertained in whatever calamity he may fall; even if his heart should rend with fear he should not show that he had been stuck with fear.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: दीर्णं हि दृष्ट्वा राजानं सर्वमेवानुदीर्यते। राष्ट्र बलममात्याश्च पृथक् कुर्वन्ति ते मती:॥
en: Seeing a king struck with fear, all are struck with fear-the entire kingdom, the army, the ministers and the earth are divided into factions.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: शत्रूनेके प्रपद्यन्ते प्रजहत्यपरे पुनः। अन्ये तु प्रजिहीर्षन्ति ये पुरस्ताद् विमानिताः॥
en: One party takes the side of the enemy, another abandons the king, a third again rejoices namely those who have been treated insultingly.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: य एवात्यन्तसुहृदस्त एनं पर्युपासते। अशक्तयः स्वस्तिकामा बद्धवत्सा इला इव॥
en: He, who is sincere well wisher, alone remains attached to his side a cow which wishers to free her calf which has been tied up, but is unable to do it.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: शोचन्तमनुशोचन्ति पतितानिव बान्धवान्। अपि ते पूजिताः पूर्वमपि ते सुहृदो मताः॥
en: They grieve for their lord who is grieving as they would grieve for friends plunged into distress. You have got many friends as true as you could wish whom you had done honors before.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: ये राष्ट्रमभिमन्यन्ते राज्ञो व्यसनमीयुषः। मा दीदरस्त्वं सुहृदो मा त्वां दीर्णं प्रहासिषुः॥
en: Who feel for your lost kingdom and who desire to have on themselves a portion of your troubles. Do not give way to fear; let not your friends abandon you, as they will do if you are struck with fear.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: प्रभावं पौरुषं बुद्धिं जिज्ञासन्त्या मया तव। विदधत्या समाश्वासमुक्तं तेजोविवृद्धये॥
en: Desiring to know your might, manliness and intelligence, has all this been said by me as also for supporting your failing courage, sustaining your hope and for enhancing your energy.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: यदेतत् संविजानासि यदि सम्यग् ब्रवीम्यहम्। कृत्वासौम्यमिवात्मानं जयायोत्तिष्ठ संजय॥
en: If you are confident that I have spoken the truth, then rise up, O Sanjaya, tranquilizing your mind with a view to gain victory.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अस्ति नः कोशनिचयो महान् ह्यविदितस्तव। तमहं वेद नान्यस्तमुपसम्पादयामि ते॥
en: We have got a large treasury unknown to you. I know that and no body else and I shall place it at your command.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: सन्ति नैकतमा भूयः सुहृदस्तव संजय। सुखदुःखसहा वीर संग्रामादनिवर्तिनः॥
en: You have got many hence well wishers, O Sanjaya, who are heroes, competent equally to endure happiness and misery and who would not turn back from the field.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: तादृशा हि सहाया वै पुरुषस्य बुभूषतः। इष्टं जिहीर्षतः किंचित् सचिवाः शत्रुकर्शन॥
en: Such are the fitting allies of a man seeking his welfare and desirous of attaining what he wants and are also good councillors, 0 chastiser of your foes.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: कुन्त्युवाच यस्यास्त्वीदृशकं वाक्यं श्रुत्वाऽपि स्वल्पचेतसः। तमस्त्वपागमत् तस्य सुचित्रार्थपदाक्षरम्॥
en: Kunti said Hearing this her speech pregnant with sense and consisting of weighty letters and words, the despair that had overtaken him, feeble-minded as he was, immediately vanquished.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: पुत्र उवाच उदके भूरियं धार्या मर्तव्यं प्रवणे मया। यस्य मे भवती नेत्री भविष्यद्धतिदर्शिनी॥
en: The son said I shall rescue my kingdom that is sunk in water or die in the attempt-I, who have for my guide yourself who have a great knowledge of the future.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अहं हि वचनं त्वत्तः शुश्रूषुरपरापरम्। किंचित् किंचित् प्रतिवदंस्तूष्णीमासं मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: I remained silent while hearing your words with the desire of hearing more from you and only spoke a few words by way of reply.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अतृप्यन्नमृतस्येव कृच्छ्राल्लब्धस्य बान्धवात्। उद्यच्छाम्येष शत्रूणां नियमार्थं जयाय च॥
en: Like one unsatiated with nectar I am not satiated with hearing your words. Having gained friends in my distress behold I rise up for subjugating my enemies and gaining victories over them.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: कुन्त्युवाच सदश्व इव स क्षिप्तः प्रणुन्नो वाक्यसायकैः। तच्चकार तथा सर्वं यथावदनुशासनम्॥
en: Kunti said Like a horse of good breed he became excited, being struck with these arrows in the shape of words and performed all that his mother had instructed him to do.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: इदमुद्धर्षणं भीमं तेजोवर्धनमुत्तमम्। राजानं श्रावयेन्मन्त्री सीदन्तं शत्रुपीडितम्॥
en: A minister should make a king, who is depressed with despair being troubled by his enemies, hear of this story than which nothing is better in increasing energy and infusing fierce might.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: जयो नामेतिहासोऽयं श्रोतव्यो विजीगीषुणा। महीं विजयते क्षिप्रं श्रुत्वा शत्रूश्च मर्दति॥
en: This story which is called Jaya (victory) should be heard by one who is desirous of victory; and hearing it one conquers the world speedily and vanquishes his enemies.

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: इदं पुंसवनं चैव वीराजननमेव च। अभीक्ष्णं गर्भिणी श्रुत्वा ध्रुवं वीरं प्रजायते॥
en: This story makes a woman bring forth a son and a heroic, son; a pregnant woman hearing it repeated many times certainly bring forth a hero,

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: विद्याशूरं तप:शूरं दानशूरं तपस्विनम्। ब्राह्मया श्रिया दीप्यमानं साधुवादे च सम्मतम्॥
en: Who is a hero in knowledge, a hero in devotion, a hero in liberality, a performer of austerities blazing with Brahmic prosperity and honored in speeches of the honest,

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: अर्चिष्मन्तं बलोपेतं महाभागं महारथम्। धृतिमन्तमनाधृष्यं जेतारमपराजितम्॥
en: Endued with fame, endued with might, of great attributes, a great car warrior, endued with wisdom, incapable of being vanquished, winner of victories, but himself sustaining no defeat;

description: The injunctions of Vidura to his son
sn: नियन्तारमसाधूनां गोप्तारं धर्मचारिणाम्। ईदृशं क्षत्रिया सूते वीरं सत्यपराक्रमम्॥
en: Subjugator of the disreputable, a protector of those that practice virtues, such a son of true prowess does a Kshatriya lady bring forth.

sn: कुन्त्युवाच अर्जुन केशव ब्रूयास्त्वयि जाते स्म सूतके। उपोपविष्टा नारीभिराश्रमे परिवारिता॥शा
en: Kunti said OKeshava, speak this to Arjuna “At the time of your birth when I was seated: in the lying-in-room in the asylum surrounded by females,

sn: अथान्तरिक्षे वागासीद् दिव्यरूपा मनोरमा। सहस्राक्षसमः कुन्ति भविष्यत्येष ते सुतः॥
en: There was heard a voice in the sky which seemed to be celestial and which pleased the heart; it said: 0 Kunti, this son of yours will be equal to him of a thousand eyes.

sn: एष जेष्यति संग्रामे कुरून् सर्वान् समागतान्। भीमसेनद्वितीयश्च लोकमुद्वर्तयिष्यति॥
en: He will conquer in fight all the Kurus assembled together and with Bhimasena as his second will grind his enemies.

sn: पुत्रस्ते पृथिवीं जेता यशश्चास्य दिवं स्पृशेत्। हत्वा कुरूच संग्रामे वासुदेवसहायवान्॥
en: Your son will be the subjugator of the world and his fame will touch the heavens; having slain the Kurus in battle with the assistance of Vasudeva,

sn: पित्र्यमंशं प्रणष्टं च पुनरप्युद्धरिष्यति। भ्रातृभिः सहितः श्रीमांस्त्रीन् मेधानाहरिष्यति॥
en: He will regain the paternal share of the kingdom which shall have been lost; and along with his brothers this one endued with prosperity will perform perform three sacrificial ceremonies.

sn: स सत्यसंधो बीभत्सुः सव्यसाची यथाऽच्युत। तथा त्वमेव जानासि बलवन्तं दुरासदम्॥
en: You know how devoted to truth is Vibhatsu, how mighty is Savyasachin of unimpairing glory and how hard it is to resist him.

sn: तथा तदस्तु दाशार्ह यथा वागभ्यभाषत। धर्मश्चेदस्ति वार्ष्णेय तथा सत्यं भविष्यति॥
en: Let it therefore be, Oscion of the Dasharha race, as that voice said; if there is virtue then, O scion of the Vrishni race, will it be true.

sn: त्वं चापि तत् तथा कृष्ण सर्वंसम्पादयिष्यसि। नाहं तदभ्यसूयामि यथा वागभ्यभाषत॥
en: You too, O Krishna, will do all that has been said by that voice, I do not doubt the truth of what the voice has said.

sn: नमो धर्माय महते धर्मो धारयति प्रजाः। एतद् धनंजयो वाच्यो नित्योद्युक्तो वृकोदरः॥ यदर्थं क्षत्रिया सूते तस्य कालोऽयमागतः। न हि वैरं समासाद्य सीदन्ति पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: I bow down to the great Dharma for it is Dharma that sustains the living creatures. Speak this to Dhananjaya; and Vrikodara who is ever ready for action should also thus be spoken to the object for which a Kshatriya lady brings forth a child is come; best of men do not grieve when they meet with an enemy.

sn: विदिता ते सदा बुद्धिर्भीमस्य न स शाम्यति। यावदन्तं न कुरुते शत्रूणां शत्रुकर्शन॥
en: It is known to you what the bent of Bhima's mind is; he is not to be calmed down till he has not made an end of his enemies, O you chastiser of foes.

sn: सर्वधर्मविशेषज्ञां स्नुषां पाण्डोर्महात्मनः। ब्रूया माधव कल्याणी कृष्ण कृष्णां यशस्विनीम्॥
en: O Madhava, O Krishna, tell that blessed lady of renown-the daughter-in-law of the great-souled Pandu, who is especially conversant with all virtues.

sn: युक्तमेतन्महाभागे कुले जाते यशस्विनि। यन्मे पुत्रेषु सर्वेषु यथावत् त्वमवर्तिथाः॥
en: O you endued with great qualities, O you born in a high family, O you of renown, the conduct you adopt towards my sons of befitting for and worthy of yourself.

sn: माद्रीपुत्रौ च वक्तव्यौ क्षत्रधर्मरतावुभौ। विक्रमेणार्जितान् भोगान् वृणीतं जीवितादपि॥
en: The two sons Madri, both of whom observe the duties of a Kshatriya, should also be thus spoken to Enjoyment earned by the exercise of prowess should be preferred to life itself.

sn: विक्रमाधिगता ह्याः क्षत्रधर्मेण जीवतः। मनो मनुष्यस्य सदा प्रीणन्ति पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: Objects gained by the exercise of prowess always please the heart of a man following the duties of a Kshatriya.

sn: यच्च वः प्रेक्षमाणानां सर्वधर्मापचायिनाम्। पाञ्चाली परुषाण्युक्ता को नु तत् क्षन्तुमर्हति॥
en: Engaged in your own duties before your very presence the princess of Panchala following every virtue was spoken to harshly-it is not proper for you to forgive that insult.

sn: न राज्यहरणं दुःखं छूते चापि पराजयः। प्रव्राजनं सुतानां वा न मे तद् दुःखकारणम्॥
en: The loss of the kingdom was not so painful to me on the defeat at dice nor even the exile of my sons was so painful to me,

sn: यत्र सा बृहती श्यामा सभायां रुदती तदा। अश्रौषीत् परुषा वाचस्तन्मे दुःखतरं महत्॥
en: As the weeping of the noble lady Krishna in the assembly at that time who was made to hear very harsh words; this was the source of a pain greater to me than all this.

sn: स्त्रीधर्मिणी वरारोहा क्षत्रधर्मरता सदा। नाध्यगच्छत् तदा नाथं कृष्णा नाथवती सती॥
en: Krishna, of beautiful hips, endued with all the virtues of a female, who ever followed the virtues of a Kshatriya lady, got at the time no protection of her lords though she had so many protectors.

sn: तं वै ब्रूहि महाबाहो सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। अर्जुनं पुरुषव्याघ्रं द्रौपद्याः पदवी चर॥
en: O you of long arms, speak to him who is the foremost of all wielders of arms, to Arjuna, that best among men “Follow the path indicated by Draupadi.”

sn: विदितं हि तवात्यन्तं क्रुद्धाविव यमान्तकौ। भीमार्जुनौ नयेतां हि देवानपि परां गतिम्॥
en: It is known to you that the two, Bhima and Arjuna when excited with wrath would even lead the very gods to obtain eternal salvation.

sn: तयोश्चैतदवज्ञानं यत् सा कृष्णा समागता। दुःशासनश्च यद् भीमं कटुकान्यभ्यभाषत॥
en: The insult that was offered to Krishna, when she was made to enter the council hall and the harsh and frightful words that Dushasana addressed to her, were also insulting to them,

sn: पश्यतां कुरुवीराणां तच्च संस्मारयेः पुनः। पाण्डवान् कुशलं पृच्छेः सपुत्रान् कृष्णया सह॥
en: Offered within the range of the sight of the heroes among the Kurus. Remember that and ask about the health of the Pandavas and of Krishna with her sons.

sn: मां च कुशलिनी ब्रूयास्तेषु भूयो जनार्दन। अरिष्टं गच्छ पन्थानं पुत्रान् मे प्रतिपालय॥
en: And tell them, Janardana, that I am very well indeed. Go on your auspicious errand and protect my sons.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच अभिवाद्याथ तां कृष्णः कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्। निश्चक्राम महाबाहुः सिंहखेलगतिस्ततः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Krishna, with long arms, then having saluted her and having gone round her, departed from there with the gait of a sportive lion.

sn: ततो विसर्जयामास भीष्मादीन् कुरुपुङ्गवान्। आरोप्याथ रथे कर्णं प्रायात् सात्यकिना सह॥
en: Then he sent away those best among the Kuru race Bhishma and others and getting up on the chariot he departed with Satyaki.

sn: तत: प्रयाते दाशार्ह कुरवः संगता मिथः। जजल्पुर्महदाश्चर्यं केशवे परमाद्भुतम्॥
en: The scion of the Dasharha race having departed, the Kurus assembled together and conversed on the greatly wonderful thing which had happened in connection with Krishna.

sn: मृत्युपाशवशीकृता। दुर्योधनस्य बालिश्यान्नैतदस्तीति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: The entire earth, having been deprived of senses, has been brought under the influence of death. In consequence of folly this has already ceased to exist-so did they say.

sn: ततो निर्याय नगरात् प्रययौ पुरुषोत्तमः। मन्त्रयामास च तदा कर्णेन सुचिरं सह॥
en: Having gone out of the town that best among men departed and began to consult Karna for some time.

sn: विसर्जयित्वा राधेयं सर्वयादवनन्दनः। ततो जवेन महता तूर्णमश्वानचोदयत्।॥
en: And having dismissed the son of Radha, that delighter of all the Yadavas soon urged his horses to great speed.

sn: ते पिबन्त इवाकाशं दारुकेण प्रचोदिताः। हया जग्मुर्महावेगा मनोमारुतरंहसः॥ प्रमूढा पृथिवी सर्वा
en: The horses being urged by Daruka went along with the speed of a wink, drinking as it were the sky.

sn: ते व्यतीत्य महाध्वानं क्षिप्रं श्येना इवाशुगाः। उच्चैर्जग्मुरुपल्पव्यं शार्ङ्गधन्वानमावहन्॥
en: Having traversed a long way speedily like quick-coursing hawks the horses reached Upaplavya, bearing the wielders of the Shranga bow.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच कुन्त्यास्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा भीष्मद्रोणौ महारथौ। दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यमूचतुः शासनातिगम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing the words of Kunti the great carwarriors Bhishma and Drona, said these words of Duryodhana who had grown unaccustomed to obey their orders.

sn: श्रुतं ते पुरुषव्याघ्र कुन्त्याः कृष्णस्य संनिधौ। वाक्यामर्थवदत्युग्रमुक्तं धर्म्यमनुत्तमम्॥
en: It has been heard by you, O foremost of men, what inciting words Kunti has said to Krishna, than which nothing is more excellent and which lead to virtue.

sn: तत् करिष्यन्ति कौन्तेया वासुदेवस्य सम्मतम्। न हि ते जातु शाम्येरवृते राज्येन कौरव॥
en: The sons of Kunti will do that with the approval of Vasudeva and they will not be pacified without the kingdom, O son of Kuru.

sn: क्लेशिता हि त्वया पार्था धर्मपाशसितास्तदा। सभायां द्रौपदी चैव तैश्च तन्मर्षितं तव॥
en: The sons of Pritha had been persecuted by you in the Assembly-hall, but being bound by the ties of virtue they over-looked all that at the time.

sn: कृतास्त्रं ह्यर्जुनं प्राप्य भीमं च कृतनिश्चयम्। गाण्डीवं चेषुधी चैव रथं च ध्वजमेव च।॥
en: Having however now obtained the master of all weapons, Arjuna, and Bhima of fast determination and the Gandiva bow and the two quivers and the chariot and flag.

sn: नकुलं सहदेवं च बलवीर्यसमन्वितौ। सहायं वासुदेवं च न ऑस्यति युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: And Nakula and Sahadeva, both endued with might and energy and Vasudeva as his allies, Yudhishthira will not forgive anything.

sn: प्रत्यक्षं ते महाबाहो यथा पार्थेन धीमता। विराटनगरे पूर्वं सर्व स्म युधि निर्जिताः॥
en: You are an witness, O you of long arms, how before this in the city of Virata, all of us were vanquished in battle by the wise son of Pritha.

sn: दानवा घोरकर्माणो निवातकवचा युधि। रौद्रमस्त्रं समादाय दग्धा वानरकेतुना॥
en: Those Danavas of fierce deeds called Nivatakavachas were consumed by him, who has the emblem of monkeys on his banner, in battle with a number of fierce weapons.

sn: कर्णप्रभृतयश्चेमे त्वं चापि कवची रथी। मोक्षितो घोषयात्रायां पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: Karna and all of your councillors and yourself clad in coats of mail and seated on a chariot were liberated (from the grasp of the Gandharvas) on your expedition against cattle which is a sufficient proof,

sn: प्रशाम्य भरतश्रेष्ठ भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डवैः। रक्षेमां पृथिवीं सर्वां मृत्योर्दष्ट्रान्तरं गताम्॥ ज्येष्ठो भ्राता धर्मशीलो वत्सलः श्लक्ष्णवाक् कविः।
en: O foremost among the Bharatas, make peace along with your brothers with the sons of Pandu. Save this entire earth which has come under the very jaws of death. Your elder brother is of virtuous habits of life, affectionate, sweet of speech and wise.

sn: तं गच्छ पुरुषव्याघ्रं व्यपनीयेह किल्बिषम्॥ दृष्टश्च त्वं पाण्डवेन व्यपनीतशरासनः।
en: Seek you therefore the protection of that foremost of men abandoning these sinful intentions. If by the son of Pandu, you are seen to have laid aside your bow,

sn: प्रशान्तभृकृटिः श्रीमान् कृता शान्तिः कुलस्य नः।।१२ तमभ्येत्य सहामात्यः परिष्वज्य नृपात्मजम्।
en: And with the wrinkles of rage smoothed down, and looking happy as if endued with prosperity then will the peace of our race have been effected. Having gone to him with your ininisters and embracing that son of a ruler of men.

sn: अभिवादय राजानं यथापूर्वमरिंदम॥ अभिवादयमानं त्वां पाणिभ्यां भीमपूर्वजः। प्रतिगृह्णातु सौहार्दात् कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Salute that king as you used to do before, O chastiser of foes, and let the elder brother of Bhima, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti hold you when saluting, by his two hands out of affection.

sn: सिंहस्कन्धोरुबाहुस्त्वां वृत्तायतमहाभुजः। परिष्वजतु बाहुभ्यां भीमः प्रहरतां वरः॥
en: Let also that one, possessed of the shoulders of a lion and round thighs and arms and of long arms, namely Bhima, the foremost among smiters, with his arms embrace you.

sn: कम्बुग्रीवो गुडाकेशस्ततस्त्वां पुष्करेक्षणः। अभिवादयतां पार्थः कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Let also the son of Kunti, Partha or Dhananjaya of eyes like the leaves of the lotus, with a neck like the conch and of curling hairs, also respectfully salute you.

sn: आश्विनेयौ नरव्याघ्रौ रूपेणाप्रतिमौ भुवि। तौ च त्वां गुरुवत् प्रेम्णा पूजया प्रत्युदीयताम्॥
en: Let the two sons of Ashvini also those foremost among men, who are of unrivaled beauty in this world-let them also offer you worship out of love, as to their elder brother.

sn: मुञ्चन्त्वानन्दजाश्रूणि दाशार्हप्रमुखा नृपाः। संगच्छ भ्रातृभिः सार्धं मानं संत्यज्य पार्थिव॥
en: Let also these rulers among men with the scion of the Dasharha race shed tears of joy (at the union); having abandoned your vanity, O ruler of the earth, be united with your brothers.

sn: प्रशाधा पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां ततस्त्वं भ्रातृभिः सह। समालिङ्ग्य च हर्षेण नृपा यान्तु परस्परम्॥
en: Rule this earth united together with your brothers and let the rulers of men return to their, kingdoms after embracing one another (in a friendly way)

sn: अलं युद्धेन राजेन्द्र सुहृदां शृणु वारणम्। ध्रुवं विनाशो युद्धे हि क्षत्रियाणां प्रदृश्यते॥
en: War is not necessary, O chief among kings; listen to the dissuasion of your well wishers; sure destruction stares the Kshatriyas in the face in case of fight.

sn: ज्योतींषि प्रतिकूलानि दारुणा मृगपक्षिणः। उत्पाता विविधा वीर दृश्यन्ते क्षत्रनाशनाः॥
en: The stars and planets are against us; animals and birds of ill omen as also many sorts of disturbances portending the massacre of the Kshatriyas are seen.

sn: विशेषत इहास्माकं निमित्तानि निवेशने। उल्काभिहि प्रदीप्ताभिर्बाध्यते पृतना तव॥
en: Especially are these omens seen in our encampment. Burning meteors again are coming in the way of your army.

sn: वाहनान्यप्रहृष्टानि रुदन्तीव विशाम्पते। गृध्रास्ते पर्युपासन्ते सैन्यानि च समन्ततः॥
en: Our soldiers are cheerless and weeping as it were, O lord of the universe and vultures are constantly wheeling around our army.

sn: नगरं न यथापूर्वं तथा राजनिवेशनम्। शिवाश्चाशिवनि?षां दीप्तां सेवन्ति वै दिशम्॥
en: The town has lost its old appearance as also the palace of the king; jackals too with constant howls are prowling about in every direction which is blazing.

sn: कुरु वाक्यं पितुर्मातुरस्माकं च हितैषिणाम्। त्वय्यायत्तो महाबाहो शमो व्यायाम एव च।॥
en: Listen therefore to the advice of your father and of your mother as also of ourselves for we desire your wellbeing. At your discretion, O you of long arms, lies peace or war.

sn: न चेत् करिष्यसि वचः सुहृदामरिकर्शन। तप्स्यसे वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा पार्थबाणप्रपीडिताम्॥
en: If you do not follow the advice of your well wishers you will come to grief having seen your army afflicted by the arrows of the son of Pritha,

sn: भीमस्य च महानादं नदतः शुष्मिणो रणे। श्रुत्वा स्मर्तासि मे वाक्यं गाण्डीवस्य च निः स्वनम् यद्येतदपसव्यं ते वचो मम भविष्यति॥
en: As also by the loud and frequent roars of Bhima in battle. Hearing also the twang of the Gandiva bow you will remember our words and if all this is not followed by you, what we say will come to pass.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु विमनास्तिर्यग्दृष्टिरधोमुखः। संहत्य च भ्रुवोर्मध्यं न किंचिद् व्याजहार ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said Duryodhana, being thus addressed, seemed absorbed in thoughts, with his face hanging down and casting oblique glances; he began to contract the space between the two eye-brows and said not a word.

sn: त वै विमनसं दृष्ट्वा सम्प्रेक्ष्यान्योन्यमन्तिकात्। पुनरेवोत्तरं वाक्यमुक्तवन्तौ नरर्षभौ॥
en: Seeing him absent-minded those two best among men glancing at each other again said the following words.

sn: भीष्म उवाच शुश्रूषुमनसूयं च ब्रह्मण्यं सत्यवादिनम्। प्रतियोत्स्यामहे पार्थमतो दुःखतरं नु किम्॥
en: Bhishma said That we shall have to fight against the son of Pritha who is devoted to the service of his elders, without jealousy, conversant with Brahma and a speaker of truth-what can be more painful than this.

sn: द्रोण उवाच अश्वत्थाम्नि यथा पुत्रे भूयो मम धनंजये। बहुमानः परो राजन् संनतिश्च कपिध्वजे॥
en: Drona said My affection for Dhananjaya is greater than what I bear to my son Ashvathama; and the one, having the figure of a monkey on his banner, too has great respect and deference for me, Oking.

sn: तं च पुत्रात् प्रियतमं प्रतियोत्स्ये धनंजयम्। क्षात्रं धर्ममनुष्ठाय धिगस्तु क्षत्रजीविकाम्॥
en: With him who is dear to me than my son namely Dhananjaya, shall I have to fight in observing the duties of a Kshatriya. Fie on the profession of a Kshatriya.

sn: यस्य लोके समो नास्ति कश्चिदन्यो धनुर्धरः। मत्प्रसादात् स बीभत्सुः श्रेयानन्यैर्धनुर्धरैः॥
en: He who is equaled by no bowman in this earth-it is through my grace and favour, is superior to other wielders of the bow.

sn: मित्रध्रुग् दुष्टभावश्च नास्तिकोऽथानृजुः शठः। न सत्सु लभते पूजां यज्ञे मूर्ख इवागतः॥
en: One who injures the interests of friends, who is of a wicked habit, an atheist, crooked and a deceitful man, does not get worship among the honest as an ignorant man coming to a sacrificial ceremony.

sn: वार्यमाणोऽपि पापेभ्यः पापात्मा पापमिच्छति। चोद्यमानोऽपि पापेन शुभात्मा शुभमिच्छति॥
en: A wicked-souled man inclines to wicked deeds though dissuaded from them and a virtuous-souled man, though urged to vice, desires to do good deeds.

sn: मिथ्योपचरिता ह्येते वर्तमाना ह्यनु प्रिये। अहितत्वाय कल्पन्ते दोषा भरतसत्तम॥
en: These sons of Pandu, though treacherously dealt with by you, now desire only what is good for you who cherish wicked intentions, O you best among the Bharatas, for your own injury.

sn: त्वमुक्तः कुरुवृद्धेन मया च विदुरेण च। वासुदेवेन च तथा श्रेयो नैवाभिमन्यसे॥
en: You have been spoken to by the oldest among the Kurus, and by myself and by Vidura as also by Vasudeva but you do not accept what is beneficial to you.

sn: अस्ति मे बलमित्येव सहसा त्वं तितीर्षसि। सग्राहनक्रमकरं गङ्गावेगमिवोर्णगे॥
en: "I have got an army” with this thought you desire to overcome the Pandavas as the current of the Ganga flows into the ocean, full of sharks, alligators and crocodiles during the rainy season.

sn: वास एव यथा त्यक्तं प्रावृण्वानोऽभिमन्यसे। स्रजं त्यक्तामिव प्राप्य लोभाद् यौधिष्ठिरीं श्रियम्॥ द्रौपदीसहितं पार्थं सायुधैर्धातृभिर्वृतम्।
en: Putting on as it were cast off clothes you have taken on yourself the cast off prosperity of Yudhishthira and think it to be your own. The son of Pritha in company with Draupadi and surrounded by his brothers,

sn: वनस्थमपि राज्यस्थः पाण्डवं को विजेष्यति॥ निदेशे यस्य राजानः सर्वे तिष्ठन्ति किङ्कराः।
en: Though he is staying in the forest who is there enjoying a kingdom though that can vanquish? Under whose command there are all the Yakasha kings as if his servants or slaves,

sn: तमैलविलमासाद्य धर्मराजो व्यराजत॥ कुबेरसदनं प्राप्य ततो रत्नान्यवाप्य च।
en: That virtuous king shone resplendent even when in the abode of that Ailavila; going to the abode of Kubera he obtained gems and wealth therefrom.

sn: स्फीतमाक्रम्य ते राष्ट्र राज्यमिच्छन्ति पाण्डवाः॥ दत्तं हुतमधीतं च ब्राह्मणास्तर्पिता धनैः।
en: The Pandavas are prepared to attack your prosperous territories wishing the kingdom for themselves. Gifts have been made, the holy books studied, and Brahmanas gratified with wealth by us two.

sn: आवयोर्गतमायुश्च कृतकृत्यौ च विद्धि नौ॥ त्वं तु हित्वा सुखं राज्यं मित्राणि च धनानि च।
en: The length our life too has fairly run out; know also that our work is done. But yourself abandoning happiness, kingdom, friends and wealth,

sn: विग्रहं पाण्डवैः कृत्वा महद् व्यसनमाप्स्यसि॥ द्रौपदी यस्य चाशास्ते विजयं सत्यवादिनी।
en: And fighting with the sons of Pandu will fall into a great trouble. Whose victory is prayed for by that speaker of truth Draupadi,

sn: तपोधोरव्रता देवी कथं जेष्यसि पाण्डवम्॥ मन्त्री जनार्दनो यस्य भ्राता यस्य धनंजयः। सर्वशस्त्रभृतां श्रेष्ठः कथं जेष्यसि पाण्डवम्॥
en: That lady devoted to austere asceticismhow can you defeat that son of Pandu. Him whose adviser is Janardana, whose brother is Dhananjaya, the foremost among all wielders of weapon-how will you defeat that son of Pandu.

sn: सहाया ब्राह्मणा यस्य धृतिमन्तो जितेन्द्रियाः। तमुग्रतपसं वीरं कथं जेष्यसि पाण्डवम्॥
en: Him on whose side Brahmanas, endued with wisdom and who have controlled their senses, have declared themselves, how can you defeat that son of Pandu, that hero of rigid austerities.

sn: पुनरुक्तं च वक्ष्यामि यत् कार्यं भूतिमिच्छता। सुहृदा मज्जमानेषु सुहृत्सु व्यसनार्णवे॥
en: I tell you again, according to the policy that ought to be adopt by a well-wisher who wishes the prosperity of a friend sunk into ocean of distress,

sn: अलं युद्धेन तैर्वीरैः शाम्य त्वं कुरुवृद्धये। मा गमः ससुतामात्यः सबलश्च पराभवम्॥
en: That there is no necessity to fight with these heroes; make peace for the sake of prosperity of the Kurus; do not invite along with your sons and ministers and your army, defeat.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच राजपुत्रैः परिवृतस्तथा भृत्यैश्च संजय। उपारोप्य रथे कर्णं निर्यातो मधुसूदनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Surrounded by princes and by dependents, O Sanjaya, did Madhusudana (Krishna) go away making Karna ascend his chariot.

sn: किमब्रवीदमेयात्मा राधेयं परवीरहा। कानि सान्त्वानि गोविन्दः सूतपुत्रे प्रयुक्तवान्॥
en: What did that one god immeasurable soul, that slayer of heroes on the enemy's side, say to the son of Radha? What comforting words did Govinda say to the son of Suta?

sn: उद्यन्मेघस्वनः काले कृष्णः कर्णमथाब्रवीत्। मृदु वा यदि वा तीक्ष्णं तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Speaking with the roar of cloud during the rains, what Krishna told Karna, in words sharp or mind, tell me, O Sanjaya.

sn: संजय उवाच आनुपूर्वेण वाक्यानि तीक्ष्णानि च मृदूनि च। प्रियाणि धर्मयुक्तानि सत्यानि च हितानि च॥
en: Sanjaya said In due order those words which were sharp and mild, sweet, leading to virtue, truthful and conducive to benefit,

sn: हृदयग्रहणीयानि राधेयं मधुसूदनः। यान्यप्रवीदमेयात्मा तानि मे शृणु भारत॥
en: And acceptable to the heart, which the slayer of Madhu, that one of immeasurable soul said to the son of Radha-hear from me, O Bharata.

sn: वासुदेव उवाच उपासितास्ते राधेय ब्राह्मण वेदपारगाः। तत्त्वार्थं परिपृष्टाश्च नियतेनानसूयया।॥
en: Vasudeva said Many Brahmanas conversant with the Vedas have been worshipped by you, O son of Radha and they have also been asked about truth by you with your mind attentive and free from jealousy.

sn: त्वमेव कर्ण जानासि वेदवादान् सनातनान्। त्वमेव धर्मशास्त्रेषु सूक्ष्मेषु परिनिष्ठितः॥
en: You, O Karna, Karna, know the eternal instruction of the Vedas, and you are fully conversant with all the subtleties of the holy books.

sn: कानीनश्च सहोदश्च कन्यायां यश्च जायते। वोढारं पितरं तस्य प्राहुः शास्त्रविदो जनाः॥
en: The two classes of sons called Kanina and Sahoda, which are begotten on a girl (before her marriage) have for their father, the man married by their mother-so it is said by people conversant with holy books.

sn: सोऽसि कर्ण तथा जातः पाण्डोः पुत्रोऽसि धर्मतः। निग्रहाद् धर्मशास्त्राणामेहि राजा भविष्यसि॥
en: You, O Karna, are born in that way and you are therefore morally the son of Pandu; and according to the rulings of the holy books, come and be a king.

sn: पितृपक्षे च ते पार्था मातृपक्षे च वृष्णयः। द्वौ पक्षावभिजानीहि त्वमेतौ पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: On your father's side are the sons of Pritha and on your mother's side are the Vrishnis; and know that these two races to belong to your own side, O best among men.

sn: मया सार्धमितो यातमद्य त्वां तात पाण्डवाः। अभिजानन्तु कौन्तेयं पूर्वजातं युधिष्ठिरात्॥
en: Let the sons of Pandu, my dear friend, know you, accompanying me from here to be the son of Kunti born before Yudhishthira,

sn: पादौ तव ग्रहीष्यन्ति भ्रातरः पञ्च पाण्डवाः। द्रौपदेयास्तथा पञ्च सौभद्रश्चापराजितः॥
en: The king and princes, assembled on the side of the Pandayas, will accept your feet as also all the Andhakas and the Vrishnis.

sn: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च पाण्डवार्थं समागताः। पादौ तव ग्रहीष्यन्ति सर्वे चान्धकवृष्णयः॥
en: The five Pandava brothers will accept your feet, as also the five sons of Draupadi as also the son of Subhadra who has never sustained a defeat.

sn: हिरण्मयांश्च ते कुम्भान् राजतान् पार्थिवांस्तथा। ओषध्यः सर्वबीजानि सर्वरत्नानि वीस्थः॥ राजन्या राजकन्याश्चाप्यानयन्त्वाभिषेचनम्॥ षष्ठे त्वां च तथा काले द्रौपद्युपगमिष्यति।
en: Golden water pots as also silver and earthen ones I filled with water) and medicinal herbs and all sorts of seeds and jems, Let the wives of kings and daughters of kings bring for your annointment (in the kingship). During the sixth period Draupadi too will come to you as to a husband.

sn: अग्नि जुहोतु वै धौम्यः संशितात्मा द्विजोत्तमः। अद्य त्वामभिषिञ्चन्तु चातुर्वैद्या द्विजातयः॥
en: Let that best among the twice born, Dhaumya who has controlled his soul, pour libations on the fire and let also the twice born conversant with all the four Vedas anoint you today.

sn: पुरोहितः पाण्डवानां ब्रह्मकर्मण्यवस्थितः। तथैव भ्रातरः पञ्च पाण्डवाः पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: Let the family priest of the Pandavas ever engaged in the performance of Brahma rites as also the brothers, the five sons of Pandu, these foremost among men,

sn: द्रौपदेयास्तथा पञ्च पञ्चालाश्चेदयस्तथा। अहं च त्वाभिषेक्ष्यामि राजानं पृथिवीपतिम्॥
en: As also the five sons of Draupadi and the princes of Panchala and Chedi and myself also anoint you as king in the lordship of the universe.

sn: युवराजोऽस्तु ते राजा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। गृहीत्वा व्यजनं श्वेतं धर्मात्मा संशितव्रतः॥
en: Let also king Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma be your hair-apparent; having taken the white chamara let that virtuous-souled one, of restrained senses,

sn: उपान्वारोहतु रथं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। छत्रं च ते महाश्वेतं भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, drive in the chariot behind you. Let also the son of Kunti, Bhimasena of great strength,

sn: अभिषिक्तस्य कौन्तेयो धारयिष्यति मूर्धनि। किङ्किणीशतनिर्घोषं वैयाघ्रपरिवारणम्॥
en: Hold over your head the big white umbrella; and your chariot so ringing with a hundred tinkling bells and covered with tiger skins,

sn: रथं श्वेतहयैर्युक्तमर्जुनो वाहयिष्यति। अभिमन्युश्च ते नित्यं प्रत्यासन्नो भविष्यति॥
en: Having been yoked with white horses will be driven by Arjuna; Abhimanyu too will ever remain near you.

sn: नकुलः सहदेवश्च द्रौपदेयाश्च पञ्च ये। पञ्चालाश्चानुयास्यन्ति शिखण्डी च महारथः॥
en: Nakula and Sahadeva, and the five sons of Draupadi, the princes of Panchala, and the great car-warrior Shikhandin will follow you.

sn: अहं च त्वाऽनुयास्यामि सर्वे चान्धकवृष्णयः। दाशार्हाः परिवारास्ते दाशार्णाश्च विशाम्पते॥
en: I too shall follow you as also all the Andhakas and the Vrishinis and the members of the Dasharha race as also of the Dasharna race will be among the members of your family, O lord of the universe.

sn: भुवं राज्यं महाबाहो भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डवैः। जपैमैश्च संयुक्तो मङ्गलैश्च पृथग्विधैः॥
en: Enjoy the kingdom, O you of long arms, in company with your brothers, the sons of Pandu ever practising devotion and Homa and the several sorts of auspicious ceremonies.

sn: पुरोगमाश्च ते सन्तु द्रविडाः सह कुन्तलैः। आन्ध्रास्तालचराश्चैव चूचुपा वेणुपास्तथा॥
en: Let also the people of Dravida and Kuntala and the Andharas and Talacharas, Chuchupas and Venupas precede you.

sn: स्तुवन्तु त्वां च बहुभिः स्तुतिभिः सूतमागधाः। विजयं वसुषेणस्य घोषयन्तु च पाण्डवाः॥
en: Let professional bards and singers also sing your praise in various songs and let the Pandavas proclaim the victory of the Vasusenas.

sn: स त्वं परिवृतः पार्थैर्नक्षत्रैरिव चन्द्रमाः। प्रशाधि राज्यं कौन्तेष कुन्तीं च प्रतिनन्दय॥
en: Surrounded by the sons of Pritha as the moon is by the stars, rule over this kingdom, O son of Kunti and delight the heart of Kunti.

sn: मित्राणि ते प्रहृष्यन्तु व्यथन्तु रिपवस्तथा। सौमात्रं चैव तेऽद्यास्तु भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डवैः॥
en: Let your friends rejoice in the same way let your enemies feel pained; let there be today brotherly feelings with your brothers, the sons of Pandu.

sn: कर्ण उवाच असंशयं सौहृदान्मे प्रणयाच्चात्थ केशव। सख्येन चैव वार्ष्णेय श्रेयस्कामतयैव च।॥
en: Karna said Undoubtedly, 0 Keshava, you have spoken those words out of good will, love and friendship, O best of the Vrishni race as also from the desire of my benefit.

sn: सर्वं चैवाभिजानामि पाण्डोः पुत्रोऽस्मि धर्मतः। निग्रहाद् धर्मशास्त्राणां यथा त्वं कृष्ण मन्यसे॥
en: I too know all this, namely that morally speaking I am the son of Pandu owing to the rulings laid down in the holy books, as you say and think, O Krishna.

sn: कन्या गर्भ समाधत्त भास्करान्यां जनार्दन। आदित्यवचनाच्चैव जातं मां सा व्यसर्जयत्॥
en: Before her wedding (with Pandu) did she (Kunti) bear me in her womb owing to her intercourse with the sun and at his command again she abandoned me as soon as I was born.

sn: सोऽस्मि कृष्ण तथा जातः पाण्डोः पुत्रोऽस्मि धर्मतः। कुन्त्या त्वहमपाकीर्णो यथा न कुशलं तथा॥
en: O Krishna, in this way was I born and I am therefore morally the son of Pandu. I was however left destitute by Kunti who thought not of my welfare,

sn: सूतो हि मामधिरथो दृष्ट्वैवाभ्यानयद् गृहान्। राधायाश्चैव मां प्रादात् सौहार्दान्मधुसूदन॥
en: As soon as Adhiratha saw me who was just born, he took me to his house and out of affection for me presented me to Radha, O slayer of Madhu.

sn: मत्स्नेहाच्चैव राधायां सद्यः क्षीरमवातरत्। सा मे मूत्रं पुरीषं च प्रतिजग्राह माधव॥
en: Out of affection for me, Radha too got milk in her bosom and she held my urine and excrete, O Madhava.

sn: तस्याः पिण्डव्यपनयं कुर्यादस्मद्विधः कथम्। धर्मविद् धर्मशास्त्राणां श्रवणे सततं रतः॥
en: How can one, like myself ever engaged in hearing the injunctions of the holy books and conversant with virtue, neglect her Pinda (offerings for the soul of the departed).

sn: तथा मामभिजानाति सूतश्चाधिरथः सुतम्। पितरं चाभिजानामि तमहं सौहृदात् सदा॥
en: Therefore does Adhiratha the Suta look upon me as his son and I too, out of love, ever consider him to be my father.

sn: स हि मे जातकर्मादि कारयामास माधव। शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना पुत्रप्रीत्या जनार्दन॥
en: He had the necessary ceremonies, during childhood, enjoined by the holy books, performed, O Madhava, in a suitable manner cut of paternal love, O Janardana.

sn: नाम वै वसुषेणेति कारयामास वै द्विजैः। भार्याश्चोढा मम प्राप्ते यौवने तत्परिचहात्॥
en: He had me named as Vasudeva by the twice born; on attaining my youth too did I marry wives according to his choice.

sn: तासु पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च मम जाता जनार्दन। तासु मे हृदयं कृष्णं संजातं कामबन्धनम्॥
en: On them have been begotten sons and grandsons by me, O Janardana, and on them has the affection of my heårt been fastened, O Krishna.

sn: न पृथिव्या सकलया न सुवर्णस्य राशिभिः। हर्षाद् भयाद् वा गोविन्द मिथ्या कर्तुं तदुत्सहे॥
en: Not for the sake of this entire earth nor for heaps of gold, nor for pleasure, nor owing to fear can I venture to break off those ties.

sn: धृतराष्ट्रकुले कृष्ण दुर्योधनसमाश्रयात्। मया त्रयोदश समा भुक्तं राज्यमकण्टकम्॥
en: In the family of Dhritarashtra, O Krishna, owing to my being under the protection of Duryodhana, has sovereignty been enjoyed by me for thirteen years without any thorn.

sn: इष्टं च बहुभिर्यज्ञैः सह सूतैर्मयाऽसकृत्। आवाहाच विवाहाच सह सूतैर्मया कृताः॥
en: Many sacrifices have been performed by me in company with Suta's and all my connections and marriage, have been formed with the Suta's.

sn: मां च कृष्ण समासाद्य कृतः शस्त्रसमुद्यमः। दुर्योधनेन वार्ष्णेय विग्रहश्चापि पाण्डवैः॥
en: Getting me on his side too, O Krishna, has the preparation of the weapons been made by Duryodhana and ( you scion of the Vrishni race, also of the war with the Pandavas.

sn: तस्माद् रणे द्वैरथे मां प्रत्युद्यातारमच्युत। वृतवान् परमं कृष्णं प्रतीपं सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: Therefore have I, O Achyuta, in a single fight between two car warriors in the ensuing battle, been selected as the best opened and match of Savyasachi.

sn: वधाद् बन्धाद् भयाद् वापि लोभाद् वापि जनार्दन। अनृतं नोत्सहे कर्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य धीमतः॥
en: From a fear of being slain, from a fear of being captured or from covetousness even, O Janardana, I do not dare behave treacherously to the intelligent son of Dhritarashtra.

sn: यदि ह्यद्य न गच्छेयं द्वैरथं सव्यसाचिना। अकीर्तिः स्याद्धृषीकेश मम पार्थस्य चोभयोः॥
en: If I do not fight with Savyasachi now in a single fight, then will infamy be mine, O Hrishikesha, and of the son of Pritha, in fact of both.

sn: असंशयं हितार्थाय ब्रूयास्त्वं मधुसूदन। सर्वं च पाण्डवाः कुर्युस्त्वद्वशित्वान्न संशयः॥
en: Doubtless, O you slayer of Madhu, you are speaking for my own good and the Pandavas too will obey all your instructions, there is no doubt about it.

sn: मन्त्रस्य नियमं कुर्यास्त्वमत्र मधुसूदन। एतदत्र हितं मन्ये सर्वं यादवनन्दन॥
en: But you should not give out this conversation between ourselves, 0 slayer of Madhu, for I think that this alone leads to good in this instance, O delighted of all Yadavas.

sn: यदि जानाति मां राजा धर्मात्मा संयतेन्द्रियः। कुन्त्याः प्रथम पुत्रं न स राज्यं ग्रहीष्यति॥
en: If that king, virtuous-souled and controller of his senses as he is knows me to be the eldest son of Kunti, then he will not accept the kingdom.

sn: प्राप्य चापि महद् राज्यं तदहं मधुसूदन। स्फीतं दुर्योधनायैव सम्प्रदद्यामरिंदम॥
en: And even if I get this large and prosperous kingdom, I shall offer it to Duryodhana alone, Oslayer of Madhu, O chastiser of foes.

sn: स एव राजा धर्मात्मा शाश्वतोऽस्तु युधिष्ठिरः। नेता यस्य हृषीकेशो योद्धा यस्य धनंजयः॥
en: May the virtuous-souled king Yudhishthira, whose guide is Hrishikesha and who has Dhananjaya for his warrior, live for ever.

sn: पृथिवी तस्य राष्ट्रं च यस्य भीमो महारथः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च द्रौपदेयाश्च माधवः॥
en: Let the earth and kingdom be his who has on his side the great car-warrior Bhima, and Nakula and Sahadeva, and the five sons of Draupadi, O Madhava,

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पाञ्चाल्यः सात्यकिश्च महारथः। उत्तमौजा युधामन्युः सत्यधर्मा च सौमकिः॥
en: And Dhrishtadyumna, and the princes of Panchala and the great car-warriors Satyaki, Uttamanjus, Yudhamanyu and the virtuous prince of Somakas,

sn: चैद्यश्च चेकितानश्च शिखण्डी चापराजितः। इन्द्रगोपकवर्णाश्च केकया भ्रातरस्तथा।
en: And the princes of the Chedis and Chekitana and Shikandi who has never sustained a defeat and the princes of Kaikeya, brothers to one another, of the colour of Indragopa insects;

sn: इन्द्रायुधसवर्णश्च कुन्तिभोजो महामनाः॥ मातुलो भीमसेनस्य श्येनजिच्च महारथः। शङ्खः पुत्रो विराटस्य निधिस्त्वं च जनार्दन॥
en: And the great minded Kuntibhoja, the maternal uncle of Bhimasena, possessed of horses of the colors of the rainbow and the great car-warrior Shayenajit, Shankha the king of Virata and yourself like an ocean of resources, O Janardana.

sn: महानयं कृष्णं कृतः क्षत्रस्य समुदानयः। राज्यं प्राप्तमिदं दीप्तं प्रथितं सर्वराजसु॥
en: O Krishna, this assembly of Kshatriyas is great indeed; this blazing kingdom known among all kings is already won (by Yudhishthira).

sn: धार्तराष्ट्रस्य वार्ष्णेय शस्त्रयज्ञो भविष्यति। अस्य यज्ञस्य वेत्ता त्वं भविष्यसि जनार्दन॥
en: O you scion of the Vrishni race, there will be a sacrificial ceremony of weapons performed by the son of Dhritarashtra and in that sacrifice (the supervisor of the ceremonies) will be yourself, O Janardana.

sn: आध्वर्यवं च ते कृष्ण क्रतावस्मिन् भविष्यति। होता चैवात्र वीभत्सुः संनद्धः स कपिध्वजः॥
en: o Krishna, when the sacrifice is performed, you will also be the Adhvaryu; and in this Vibhatsu, that hero who has the figure of a monkey on his banner, clad in a coat of mail will be the Hotri (the guide in giving offerings).

sn: गाण्डीवं स्रुक् तथा चाज्यं वीर्यं पुंसां भविष्यति। ऐन्द्रं पाशुपतं ब्राझं स्थूणाकर्णं च माधव। मन्त्रास्तत्र भविष्यन्ति प्रयुक्ताः सव्यसाचिना॥
en: The Gandiva bow will be the sacrificial ladle and the might of men will constitute the clarified butter to be poured as libation on the fire. The weapons Aindra, Pashupata, Brahma, and Sthunakarna, O Madhava, used by Savyasachi will be the incantations (Mantras) in the sacrifice.

sn: अनुयातश्च पितरमधिको वा पराक्रमे। गीतं स्तोत्रं स सौभद्रः सम्यक् तत्र भविष्यति॥
en: Equal to his father or even superior to him in prowess the son of Subhadra will be the Vedic hymn recited there.

sn: उद्गाताऽत्र पुनर्भीमः प्रस्तोता सुमहाबलः। विनदन् स नरव्याघ्रो नागानीकान्तकृद् रणे॥
en: The repeater (Udgatri) of those incantations again will be Bhima, who will also be the Prastori (the prepare), that foremost of men, that destroyer of the elephants in the army, making loud roars in battle.

sn: स चैव तत्र धर्मात्मा शश्वद् राजा युधिष्ठिरः। जपैोमैश्च संयुक्तो ब्रह्मत्वं कारयिष्यति॥
en: And the virtuous-souled king Yudhishthira, engaged in making Japa and Homa, will perform the office of a Brahmana in the sacrificial rite.

sn: शङ्खशब्दा: समुरजा भेर्यश्च मधुसूदन। उत्कृष्टसिंहनादश्च सुब्रह्मण्यो भविष्यति॥
en: The sounds of conch shells, of labors and drums and the roars of lions will announce the hour of dinner in that sacrifice.

sn: नकुलः सहदेवश्च माद्रीपुत्रो यशस्विनौ। शामित्रं तौ महावी? सम्यक् तत्र भविष्यतः॥
en: Nakula and Sahadeva, the two sons of Madri endued with fame-these two heroes of great strength will be duly the sacrifices of animals in that sacrifice.

sn: कल्माषदण्डा गोविन्दं विमलारथपङ्क्तयः। यूपा: समुपकल्पन्तामस्मिन् यज्ञे जनार्दन॥
en: Furnished with flag staffs of various colors, spotless rows of carriage, O Govinda, will be the Yupas (staff for fastening sacrificial animals) in this sacrifice, at the end of the principal ceremony, O Janardana.

sn: कर्णिनालीकनाराचा वत्सदन्तोपबृंहणाः। तोमराः सोमकलशाः पवित्राणि धनूंषि च॥
en: Karnir (arrows with barbs) Nalikas (a rude sorts of muskets) Narachas (daggers fastened to sticks) and arrows like the spoons and vessels for the Soma juice; while bows will be substitutes for Pavitrus ((Kusha leaves for springing clarified butter).

sn: असयोऽत्र कपालानि पुरोडाशाः शिरसि च। हविस्तु रुधिरं कृष्ण तस्मिन् यज्ञे भविष्यति॥
en: The swords will be substitutes for the Kapalas and the heads of soldiers killed in the field will be those for Purodashas; the bloods of warrior will be the clarified butter, O Krishna in that sacrificial ceremony.

sn: इध्माः परिधयश्चैव शक्तयो विमला गदाः। सदस्या द्रोणशिष्याच कृपस्य च शरद्वतः॥
en: The lances will be the substitutes for Paridhas (vessels for depositing the offerings) and the maces will be those for Shakti's (the wood work for protecting the offerings), the part of assisting priests will be performed by the disciples of Drona and Kripa and Sharadvata.

sn: इषवोऽत्र परिस्तोमा मुक्ता गाण्डीवधन्वना। महारथप्रयुक्ताश्च द्रोणद्रौणिप्रचोदिताः॥
en: The arrows, let loose by the wielder of the Gandiva bow and shot also by car-warriors urged by Drona and his son will act for ladles in their sacrifice.

sn: प्रतिप्रास्थानिकं कर्म सात्यकिस्तु करिष्यति। दीक्षितो धार्तराष्ट्रोऽत्र पली चास्य महाचमूः॥
en: Satyaki will do the duties of the chief assistant to the head priest; the son of Dhritarashtra will be the performer and his large army will take the place of his wife.

sn: घटोत्कचोऽत्र शामित्रं करिष्यति महाबलः। अतिरात्रे महाबाहो वितते यक्षकर्मणि॥
en: Ghatotkacha, of great strength, will be the slayer of the sacrificial animals at the commencement of this sacrificial rite at an advanced hour of the night, O you of long arms.

sn: दक्षिणा त्वस्य यज्ञस्य धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान्। वैतानिके कर्ममुखे जातो यः कृष्ण पावकात्॥
en: The Dakshina ((final gifts to the priest) of that sacrifice will be Dhrishtadyumna of great energy, for O Krishna, he was born out of fire in a sacrifice having for its mouth the rites celebrated with Mantras.

sn: यदब्रुवमहं कृष्ण कटुकानि स्म पाण्डवान्। प्रियार्थं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य तेन तप्ये ह्यकर्मणा॥
en: What harsh words, I said to the sons of Pandu, O Krishna, were for the gratification of the son of Dhritarashtra and I am now struck with remorse for that misdeed.

sn: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि मां कृष्ण निहतं सव्यसाचिना। पुनश्चितिस्तदा चास्य यज्ञस्याथ भविष्यति॥
en: When you will see me, O Krishna, slain by Savyasachi, then will the Punaschiti (the second part of the ceremonies) commence, O Janardana.

sn: दुःशासनस्य रुधिरं यदा पास्यति पाण्डवः। आन नर्दतः सम्यक् तदा सूयं भविष्यति॥
en: When the sons of Pandu will drink the blood of Dushashana repeatedly making loud roars, then will the drinking of the Soma juice of the sacrifice have been finished.

sn: यदा द्रोणं च भीष्मं च पाञ्चाल्यौ पातयिष्यतः। तदा यज्ञावसानं तद् भविष्यति जनार्दन॥
en: When Drona and Bhishma will be overthrown by the two princes of Panchala, then will the ceremonies connected with the sacrifice of the son of Dhritarashtra be brought to an end, O Janardana.

sn: दुर्योधनं यदा हन्ता भीमसेनो महाबलः। तदा समाप्स्यते यज्ञो धार्तराष्ट्रस्य माधव॥
en: When Bhimasena of great strength will be the slayer of Duryodhana then will the ceremonies be finished.

sn: नुषाश्च प्रस्नुषाश्चैव धृतराष्ट्रस्य सङ्गत्ताः। हतेश्वरा नष्टपुत्रा हतनाथाश्च केशव॥
en: When the daughter-in-law and the grand daughter-in-law (wives of grandsons) of Dhritarashtra will assemble together being deprived of their protectors, their sons and their husbands, O Keshava,

sn: रुदत्यः सह गान्धार्या श्वगृध्रकुरराकुले। स यज्ञेऽस्मिन्नवभृथो भविष्यति जनार्दन।॥
en: Weeping loudly with Gandhari in the field of battle frequented by dogs and vultures and other carnivorous animals then will the final bath in connection with the sacrifice have taken place, OJanardana.

sn: विद्यावृद्धा वयोवृद्धाः क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभ। वृथा मृत्युं न कुर्वीरंस्त्वत्कृते मधुसूदन॥
en: Do not let those best of the Kshatriyas, who are old in learning and old in age meet with an useless death on account of your doings, O slayer of Madhu.

sn: शस्त्रेण निधनं गच्छेत् समृद्धं क्षत्रमण्डलम्। कुरुक्षेत्रे पुण्यतमे त्रैलोक्यस्यापि केशव॥
en: The entire race of Kshatriyas will meet with death by weapons in Kurukshetra, the holiest spot in all the these worlds, O Keshava.

sn: तदत्र पुम्डरीकाक्ष विधत्स्व यदभीप्सितम्। यथा कार्येन वार्ष्णेय क्षत्रं स्वर्गमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: O you of lotus-eyes, manage things in such a way in this case that we may gain our endthat united together the Kshatriyas go to heaven, O you of the Vrishni race.

sn: यावत् स्थास्यन्ति गिरयः सरितश्च जनार्दन। तावत् कीर्तिभवः शब्दः शाश्वतोऽयं भविष्यति॥
en: So long as mountains and lakes will exist, O Janardana, so long will the fame of this event last-that is for ever.

sn: ब्राह्मणाः कथयिष्यन्ति महाभारतमाहवम्। समागमेषु वार्ष्णेय क्षत्रियाणां यशोधनम्॥
en: The Brahmanas will tell the world of the great battle of Mahabharata. The wealth of Kshatriyas, O you of the Vrishni race, is what they win in the field of battle.

sn: समुपानय कौन्तेयं युद्धायं मम केशव। मन्त्रसंवरणं कुर्वन् नित्यमेव परंतप॥
en: Bring here the son of Kunti for me to fight, O Keshava, for ever keeping this conversation secret, О chastiser of foes.

sn: संजय उवाच कर्णस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा केशवः परवीरहा। उवाच प्रहसन् वाक्यं स्मितपूर्वमिदं यथा॥
en: Sanjaya said Keshava, that slayer of heroes of the enemies, hearing the words of Karna said these words laughingly.

sn: श्रीभगवानुवाच अपि त्वां न लभेत् कर्ण राज्यलम्भोपपादनम्। मया दत्तां हि पृथिवीं न प्रशासितुमिच्छसि॥
en: "Desire you not then to gain this kingdom by the means I have indicated, O Karna? Desire you not to rule this earth given by me to you.

sn: ध्रुवो जयः पाण्डवानामितीदं न संशयः कश्चन विद्यतेऽत्र। जयध्वयो दृश्यते पाण्डवस्य समुच्छ्रितो वानरराज उग्रः॥
en: The sure success of the Pandavas will follow in this case, there is no doubt of it; the fierce triumphal banner, of the son of Pandu who has the figure of the monkey on his banner, is already hoisted.

sn: दिव्या मयाया विहिता भौमनेन समुच्छ्रिता इन्द्रकेतुप्रकाशा। दिव्यानि भूतानि जयावहानि दृश्यन्ति चैवात्र भयानकानि॥
en: It rises up into the air, endued with celestial illusion by Bhaumana for in the banner are seen many fierce celestial creatures indicating victory.

sn: न सज्जते शैलवनस्पतिभ्य ऊर्ध्वं तिर्यगयोजनमात्ररूपः। श्रीमान् ध्वजः कर्ण धनंजयस्य समुच्छ्रितः पावकतुल्यरूपः॥
en: It is not impeded by hills or trees and it occupies the space of a Yojana upwards as also all around; this prosperous banner banner of Dhananjaya, O Karna, is hosted up and looks like fire itself.

sn: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे श्वेताश्रं कृष्णसारथिम्। ऐन्द्रमस्त्रं विकुर्वाणमुभे चाप्यग्निमारुते॥
en: When you will see in the battle Arjuna, driving on a chariot drawn by white horses and driven by Krishna, making use of the Aindra weapon, as also the weapons of Agni and Marut.

sn: गाण्डीवस्य च निर्घोषं विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः। न तदा भविता त्रेता न कृतं द्वापरं न च॥
en: And when you will hear the twang of the Gandiva bow piercing as it were the sky like the thunder, then will the Treta, Krita and Dvapara Yugas pass away.

sn: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। जपहोमसमायुक्तं स्वां रक्षन्तं महाचमूम्॥
en: When you will see Yudhishthira the son of Kunti in battle, endued with Japa and Homa and engaged in protecting his own vast army.

sn: आदित्यमिव दुर्धर्षं तपन्तं शत्रुवाहिनीम्। न तदा भविता त्रेता न कृतं द्वापरं न च॥
en: Hard to be vanquished like Aditya and trembling the army of his enemy, then will the Treta, Krita, and Dvapara Yuga pass away.

sn: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे भीमसेनं महाबलम्। दुःशासनस्य रुधिरं पीत्वा नृत्यन्तमाहवे॥
en: When you will see Bhimasena of great strength in the field dancing in this great battle drinking the blood of Dushasana,

sn: प्रभिन्नमिव मातङ्गं प्रतिद्विरदघातिनम्। न तदा भविता त्रेता न कृतं द्वापरं न च॥
en: Like an infuriated elephant with his temples rent after vanquishing an opponent then will the Treta, Krita and Dvapara Yugas pass away.

sn: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे द्रोणं शान्तनवं कृपम्। सुयोधनं च राजानं सैन्धवं च जयद्रथम्॥
en: When you will see in the battle Drona, and the son of Shantanu and Kripa, Suyodhana, the king of the Sindhus and Jayadratha,

sn: युद्धायापततस्तूर्णं वारितान् सव्यसाचिना। न तदा भविता त्रेता न कृतं द्वापरं न च॥
en: Rushing to the fight with great impetuosity opposed by Savyasachin Yugas pass away.

sn: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि संग्रामे माद्रीपुत्रौ महाबलौ। वाहिनीं धार्तराष्ट्राणां क्षोभयन्तौ गजाविव॥
en: When you will see in the battle the two sons of Madri endued with great strength making a havoc in the army of the sons of Dhritarashtra like two elephants.

sn: विगाढे शस्त्रसम्पाते परवीररथारुजौ। न तदा भविता त्रेता न कृतं द्वापरं न च॥
en: Those car-warriors driving on engaged in the throwing of weapons then will the Treta, Kripa and Dvapara Yugas cease to exist.

sn: ब्रूयाः कर्ण इतो गत्वा द्रोणं शान्तनवं कृपम्। सौम्योऽयं वर्तते मासः सुप्रापयवसेन्धनः॥
en: Going from here, O Karna, tell Drona, the son of Shantanu and Kripa that the present month is a charming one with plenty of food, drink and fuel. a car

sn: सौषधिवनस्फीतः फलवानल्पमक्षिकः। निष्पको रसवत्तोयो नात्युष्णशिशिरः सुखः॥
en: All plants and herbs are luxuriant in their growth now, the trees are laden with fruits and there are flies; the ponds are free from mire and their water pleasant to drink and neither hot nor cold, for it is a pleasant time.

sn: सप्तमाच्चापि दिवसादमावास्या भविष्यति। संग्रामो युज्यतां तस्यां तामाहुः शक्रदेवताम्॥
en: In seven days will there be full moon and on that day let us engage in fight; for this is the day favorite to Shakra.

sn: तथा राज्ञो वदेः सर्वान् ये युद्धायाभ्युपागताः। यद् वो मनीषितं तद् वै सर्वं सम्पादयाम्यहम्॥
en: Then speak also to all the kings who are assembled to fight what you desire. I shall fulfill your wishes in every way.

sn: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च दुर्योधनवशानुगाः। प्राप्य शस्त्रेण निधनं प्राप्स्यन्ति गतिमुत्तमाम्॥
