en: The king and princes, who are under the leadership of Duryodhana, will meet, by coming in contact with weapons, with death and attain to very excellent salvation.

sn: संजय उवाच केशवस्य तु तद् वाक्यं कर्णः श्रुत्वा हितं शुभम्। अब्रवीदभिसम्पूज्य कृष्णं तं मधुसूदनम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Hearing these beneficial and auspicious words of Keshava, Karna said after duly worshipping that slayer of Madhu.

sn: जानन् मां किं महाबाहो सम्मोहयितुमिच्छसि। योऽयं पृथिव्याः कात्स्येन विनाशः समुपस्थितः॥
en: Knowing everything why do you wish to confound me and lead me to folly? You know that the destruction of the entire world is at hand.

sn: निमित्तं तत्र शकुनिरहं दुःशासनस्तथा। दुर्योधनश्च नृपतिधृतराष्ट्रसुतोऽभवत्॥
en: The cause of this are Shakuni, myself and Dushasana and also Duryodhana the son of Dhritarashtra, the ruler of men,

sn: असंशयमिदं कृष्णं महद् युद्धमुपस्थितम्। पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च घोरं रुधिरकर्दमम्॥
en: Without doubt, O Krishna, a great calamity is at hand, the blood of the Pandavas and the Kurus will be the fierce clay.

sn: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च दुर्योधनवशानुगाः। रणे शस्त्राग्निना दग्धाः प्राप्स्यन्ति यमसादनम्॥
en: The kings and princes, following the leadership of Duryodhana, consumed by the fire of weapons in the battle, will go to the abode of Yama, the king of death.

sn: स्वप्ना हि बहवो घोरा दृश्यन्ते मधुसूदन। निमित्तानि च घोराणि तथोत्पाताः सुदारुणाः॥
en: Many fierce dreams are dreamt, O slayer of Madhu, as also are seen fierce omens and very great disturbances.

sn: पराजयं धार्तराष्ट्रे विजयं च युधिष्ठिरे। शंसन्त इव वार्ष्णेय विविधा रोमहर्षणाः॥
en: Events occur which make the hair stand on end which, O you scion of the Vrishni race, portend defeat to the son of Dhritarashtra and victory of Yudhishthira.

sn: प्राजाप्तयं हि नक्षत्रं ग्रहस्तीक्ष्णो महाद्युतिः। शनैश्चरः पीडयति पीडयन् प्राणिनोऽधिकम्॥
en: That active planet of great effulgence Shanaishchara (Saturn) troubles the star Prajapatya indicating greater troubles to living creatures.

sn: कृत्वा चाङ्गारको वक्र ज्येष्ठायां मधुसूदन। अनुराधां प्रार्थयते मैत्रं संगमयन्निव॥
en: The planet Angaraka travels obliquely to the constellation Jyeshtha, O Slayer of Madhu, and goes towards Anuradha as if seeking its friendship.

sn: नूनं महद्भयं कृष्णं कुरूणां समुपस्थितम्। विशेषेम हि वार्ष्णेय चित्रा पीडयते ग्रहः॥
en: Surely, O Krishna, a great calamity for the Kurus at hand especially as the planets go against Chitra.

sn: सोमस्य लक्ष्म व्यावृत्तं राहुरर्कमुपैति च। दिवचोल्काः पतन्त्येताः सनिर्घाताः सकम्पनाः॥
en: Rahu comes to the sun which has covered the path of the moon and from the heavens fall down meteors with loud noise and making the earth shake.

sn: निष्टनन्ति च मातङ्गा मुञ्चन्त्यश्रूणि वाजिनः। पानीयं यवसं चापि नाभिनन्दन्ति माधव॥
en: Elephants are making terrific yells and horses are shedding tears and do not take delight in food and drink, Madhava.

sn: प्रादुर्भूतेषु चैतेषु भयमाहुरुपस्थितम्। निमित्तेषु महाबाहो दारुणं प्राणिनाशनम्॥
en: When such omens prevail, it is said, that a great calamity is at hand causing, O you of long arms, a very great massacre of living beings.

sn: अल्पे भुक्ते पुरीषं च प्रभूतमिह दृश्यते। वाजिनां वारणानां च मनुष्याणां च केशव॥
en: Though taking but little food, it is seen that the evacuations of horses, of horses elephants and men are very great in quantity, OKeshava.

sn: धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु सर्वेषु मधुसूदन। पराभवस्य तल्लिङ्गमिति प्राहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: The wise have said, O Slayer of Madhu, that these are signs of the defeat of the entire army of the soon of Dhritarashtra.

sn: प्रहृष्टं वाहनं कृष्णं पाण्डवानां प्रचक्षते। प्रदक्षिणा मृगाश्चैव तत् तेषां जयलक्षणम्॥
en: The army, of the sons of Pandu how ever are seen to be cheerful; the deer go to their right and that is a sign of their victory.

sn: अपसव्या मृगाः सर्वे धार्तराष्ट्रस्य केशव। वाचश्चाप्यशरीरिण्यस्तत् पराभवलक्षणम्॥
en: But all the animals go to the left of Duryodhana's army, O Keshava, and there are also unearthly voices heard which are the signs of defeat.

sn: मयूराः पुण्यशकुना हंससारसचातकाः जीवंजीवकसङ्घाश्चाप्यनुगच्छन्ति पाण्डवान्॥
en: Auspicious birds such as peacocks, swans, Sarasas, Chatakas and groups of Jivajivas and cranes follow the Pandavas.

sn: गृध्राः कङ्काः वकाः श्येना यातुधानास्तथा वृकाः। मक्षिकाणां च सङ्घाता अनुधावन्ति कौरवान्॥
en: Vultures, Kankas, Bakas hawks and birds of prey, Yatudhanas and wolves, and bees follow the Kauravas.

sn: धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु भेरीणां नास्ति निःस्वनः। अनाहताः पाण्डवानां नदन्ति पटहाः किल॥
en: In the army of the son of Dhritarashtra, no sound comes from the drums while those of the Pandavas give forth sounds when even not struck.

sn: उदपानाश्च नर्दन्ति यथा गोवृषभास्तथा। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु तत् पराभवलक्षणम्॥
en: Reservoirs of waters produce sounds similar to those of cows and bulls; that is a sign of defeat to the army of the son of Dhritarashtra.

sn: मांसशोणितवर्षं च वृष्टं देवेन माधव। तथा गन्धर्वनगरं भानुमत् समुपस्थितम्॥
en: Down pours of flesh and blood are poured by the gods, O Madhava, and the city of Gandharvas appears shining like the sun in the sky,

sn: सप्राकारं सपरिखं सवप्रं चारुतोरणम्। कृष्णश्च परिघस्तत्र भानुमावृत्य तिष्टति॥
en: With walls, with trenches, with beautiful porticoes and pillars dirty in the sky is seen to surround the sun.

sn: उदयास्तमने संध्ये वेदयन्ती महद्भयम्। शिवा च वाशते घोरं तत् पराभवलक्षणम्॥
en: At the conjunction of day and night namely when the sun rises and sets are seen terrific sights; the jackals tertific howls and these are the signs of a defeat.

sn: एक पक्षाक्षिचरणाः पक्षिणो मधुसूदन। उत्सृजन्ति महद् घोरं तत् पराभवलक्षणम्॥
en: Birds, having but one wing, or one eye or one leg, O slayer of Madhu, make terrific shrieks and these are the signs of a defeat.

sn: कृष्णग्रीवाश्च शकुना रक्तपादा भयानकाः। संध्याममिमुखा यान्ति तत् पराभवलक्षणम्॥
en: Birds, with black neck read feet, which are terrible looking, go towards the army, in the evening and these are the signs of a defeat.

sn: ब्राह्मणान् प्रथमं द्वेष्टि गुरूंश्च मधुसूदन। भृत्यान् भक्तिमतश्चापि तत् पराभवलक्षणम्॥
en: First he treats the Brahmanas with contempt and his elders, O slayer of Madhu, and then his servants who are attached to him and these are the signs if a defeat.

sn: पूर्वा दिग् लोहिताकारा शस्त्रवर्णा च दक्षिणा। आमपात्रप्रतीकाशा पश्चिमा मधुसूदन। उत्तरा शङ्खवर्णाभा दिशां वर्णा उदाहृताः॥
en: The eastern direction looks red and the southern is the colour of weapons while the western looks the earth, O slayer of Madhu. North looks like the conch. These are the colours of all directions.

sn: प्रदीप्ताश्च दिशः सर्वा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य माधव। महद् भयं वेदयन्ति तस्मिन्नुत्पातदर्शने॥
en: All the directions the encampment of the son of Dhritarashtra are ablaze as if in conflagration, O Madhava and the sight of these disturbances presages a great calamity.

sn: सहस्रपादं प्रासादं स्वप्नान्ते स्म युधिष्ठिरः। अधिरोहन् मया दृष्टं सह भ्रातृभिरच्युत॥
en: In a dream dreamt by me, O Achyuta, I saw Yudhishthira in company with his brothers ascending a palace having a thousand pillars.

sn: श्वेतोष्णीषाश्च दृश्यन्ते सर्वे वै शुक्लवाससः। आसनानि च शुभ्राणि सर्वेषामुपलक्षये॥
en: They appeared to me all with white headdresses and white garments and Saw all of them on white seats.

sn: तव चापि मया कृष्ण स्वप्नान्ते रुधिराविला। अन्त्रेण पृथिवी दृष्टा परिक्षिप्ता जनार्दन॥
en: You, O Krishna, were seen by me in that ocean throwing weapons on the earth which was covered with blood, O Janardana.

sn: अस्थिसंचयमारूढचामितौजा युधिष्ठिरः। सुवर्णपात्र्यां संहृष्टो भुक्तवान् घृतपायसम्॥
en: Yudhishthira, of immeasurable energy, having ascended a heap of human bones, was cheerfully eating payas (rice boiled in milk and sugar) mixed clarified butter out of a golden vessel.

sn: युधिष्ठिरो मया दृष्टो ग्रसमानो वसुन्धराम्। त्वया दत्तामिमां व्यक्तं भोक्ष्यते स वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Yudhishthira was seen by me to be swallowing this earth and this indicates that he will enjoy this earth given by you.

sn: उच्चं पर्वतमारूढो भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः। गदापाणिर्नरव्याघ्रो ग्रसन्निव महीमिमाम्॥
en: Vrikodara, of terrible actions, having ascended a high mountain, that best among men, mace in hand, stood as if swallowing this earth.

sn: क्षपयिष्यति नः सर्वान् स सुव्यक्तं महारणे। विदितं मे हृषीकेश यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः॥
en: This plainly indicates that in the great battle he will kill all of us. It is known to me, O Hrishikesha, that where there is virtue there is victory.

sn: पाण्डुरं गजमारूढो गाण्डीवी स धनंजयः। त्वया सार्धं हृषीकेश श्रिया परमया ज्वलन्॥
en: Dhananjaya, that wielder of the Gandiva with you, O Hrishikesha, shining with great effulgence.

sn: यूयं सर्वे वधिष्यध्वं तत्र मे नास्ति संशयः। पार्थिवान् समरे कृष्ण दुर्योधनपुरोगमान्॥
en: You will all slay the rulers of the earth having at their head Duryodhana in the battle-I have doubt as to that.

sn: नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः। शुक्लकेयूरकण्ठत्राः शुक्लमाल्याम्बरावृताः॥
en: Nakula and Sahadeva and the great carwarrior Satyaki, decked with white ornaments and putting on white garlands and white garments,

sn: अधिरूढा नरव्याघ्रा नरवाहनमुत्तमम्। त्रय एते मया दृष्टाः पाण्डुरच्छत्रवाससः॥
en: These best among men ascending a vehicle by human beings which had nothing better than it, were seen by me with a white umbrella over their heads and with white robes on. were

sn: श्वेतोष्णीषाश्च दृश्यन्ते त्रय एते जनार्दन धार्तराष्ट्रषु सैन्येषु तान् विजानीहि केशव॥
en: These there were seen also with white head gears the army of the son of Dhritarashtra; know their, names, O Keshava.

sn: अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः। रक्तोष्णीषाश्च दृश्यन्ते सर्वे माधव पार्थिवाः॥
en: they Ashvathama, Kripa and Kritavarman of the Satvata race; all other king of the earth were seen with blood coloured dresses, O Madhava.

sn: उष्ट्रप्रयुक्तमारूढो भीष्मद्रोणी महारथौ। मया साधु महाबाहो धार्तराष्ट्रेण वा विभो॥
en: Ascending camels the ten great carwarriors, Bhishma and Drona along with myself, O you of arms, and also with the son of Dhritarashtra, O lord,

sn: अगस्त्यशास्तां च दिशं प्रयाताः स्म जनार्दन। अचिरेणैव कालेन प्राप्स्यामो यमसादनम्॥
en: Were going towards the direction ruled by Agastya, O Janardana, and in a short time we reached the abode of Yama.

sn: अहं चान्ये च राजानो यच्च तत् क्षत्रमण्डलम्। गाण्डीवाग्नि प्रवेक्ष्याम इति मे नास्ति संशयः॥
en: Myself and all those other kings making this assembly of Kshatriyas shall enter the Gandiva fire-in this I have no doubt.

sn: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच उपस्थितविनाशेयं नूनमद्य वसुन्धरा। यथा हि मे वचः कर्ण नोपैति हृदयं तव॥
en: Krishna said This world will truly come to an end, since my words, O Karna, do not seem acceptable to you.

sn: सर्वेषां तात भूतानां विनाशे प्रत्युपस्थिते। अनयो नयसंकाशो हृदयानापसर्पति॥
en: When the destruction of all creatures, my dear friend, is at hand, that which/is wrong is not removed from the heart, having the appearance of right.

sn: कर्ण उवाच अपि त्वां कृष्ण पश्याम जीवन्तोऽस्मान्महारणात्। समुत्तीर्णा महाबाहो वीरक्षत्रविनाशनात्॥
en: Karna said If I am alive, O Krishna, I shall see you after this great battle, destructive of Kshatriya heroes, which is come on us, O you of long arms.

sn: अथवा सङ्गमः कृष्ण स्वर्गे नो भविता ध्रुवम्। तत्रेदानी समेष्यामः पुनः सार्धं त्वयागऽनघ॥
en: Else there will be a meeting between us surely in heaven. I now see that I shall meet you there only, O sinless one.

sn: संजय उवाच इत्युक्त्वा माधवं कर्णः परिष्वज्य च पीडितम्। विसर्जितः केशवेन रथोपस्थादवातरत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Saying this Karna, having having closely embraced Krishna, and been dismissed by Keshava, dismounted from the chariot.

sn: ततः स्वरथमास्थाय जाम्बूनदविभूषितम्। सहास्माभिर्निववृते राधेयो दीनमानसः॥
en: Then having seated himself on his own car bedecked with gold he returned in company with his own followers, with a sad heart.

sn: ततः शीघ्रतरं प्रायात् केशवः सहसात्यकिः। पुनरुच्चारयन् वाणी याहि याहीति सारथिम्॥
en: Then did Keshava along with Satyaki proceed with greater speed saying again and again to his driver "go-go”.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच असिद्धानुनये कृष्णे कुरुभ्यः पाण्डवान् गते। अभिगम्य पृथां क्षत्ता शनैः शोचन्निवाब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said The object of Krishna having proved vrsuccessful and he having left the Kurus, the Kshattri having approached Pritha said to her slowly and sadly,

sn: जानासि मे जीवपुत्रि भावं नित्यमविग्रहे। क्रोशतो न च गृह्णीते वचनं मे सुयोधनः॥
en: "O you whose children are alive, you know that I am ever inclined to the reverse of war but though I am caring myself horse, Suyodhana does not act up to my words.

sn: उपपन्नो ह्यसौ राजा चेदिपाञ्चालकेकयैः। भीमार्जुनाभ्यां कृष्णेन युयुधानयमैरपि।॥
en: The king (Yudhishthira) has on his side the kings of the Chedis, the Panchalas, and the Kaikeyas and Bhima and Arjuna and Krishna and Yuyudhana and the twins.

sn: उपप्लेव्य निविष्टोऽपि धर्ममेव युधिष्ठिरः। काक्षते ज्ञातिसौहार्दाद् बलवान् दुर्बलो यथा॥
en: Yudhishthira is staying at Upaplavya like Dharma himself and desires the good will of his kinsmen as the weak desire the good will of the strong.

sn: राजा तु धृतराष्ट्रोऽयं वयोवृद्धो न शाम्यति। मत्तः पुत्रमदेनैव विधर्मं पथि वर्तते॥
en: This king Dhritarashtra too, old in years, does not make peace, and follows the wrong path being intoxicated with the pride of sons.

sn: जयद्रथस्य कर्णस्य तथा दुःशासनस्य च। सौबलस्य च दुर्बुद्ध्या मिथो भेदोः प्रपत्स्यते॥
en: The dispute in this instance has its rise in the wicked intelligence of Jayadratha, Karna, and Dushasana, as also of the son of Subala.

sn: अधर्मेण हि धर्मिष्ठं कृतं वैकार्यमीदृशम्। येषां तेषामयं धर्मः सानुबन्धो भविष्यति॥
en: These, who act with unrighteousness towards him who is righteous, have the fruit of such act of theirs.

sn: क्रियमाणे बलाद् धर्मं कुरुभिः को न संज्वरेत्। असाम्ना केशवे याते समुद्योक्ष्यन्ति पाण्डवाः॥
en: Who is there who would not grieve at the prostitution of virtue by the Kurus? When Keshava goes without having established peace the sons of Pandu will make preparation for war.

sn: ततः कुरूणामनयो भविता वीरनाशनः। चिन्तयन् न लभे निद्रामहः सु च निशासु च॥
en: Thereupon the misdeed of the Kurus will be the cause of a massacre of heroes; thinking of such things, I do not get sleep during day nor during night.”

sn: श्रुत्वा तु कुन्ती तद्वाक्यमर्थकामेन भाषितम्। सा निःश्वसन्ती दुःखार्ता मनसा विममर्श ह॥
en: Kunti too, hearing these words of his, which were spoken with the desire of benefit, began to sigh, being struck with sorrow and became depressed in mind also.

sn: धिगस्त्वर्थं यत्कृतेऽयं महान् ज्ञातिवधः कृतः। वय॑ते सुहृदां चैवं युद्धेऽस्मिन् वै पराभवः॥
en: "Fie on this interest" which is the cause of a great massacre of kinsmen-in this was those that are friends will meet with defeat.

sn: पाण्डवाश्चेदिपञ्चाला यादवाश्च समागताः। भारतैः सह योत्स्यन्ति किं नु दुःखमतः परम्॥
en: The sons of Pandu, the Chedis, the Panchalas and the Yadavas, united together will fight with the Bharatas; what can be a greater cause of sorrow than this?

sn: पश्ये दोषं ध्रुवं युद्धे तथाऽयुद्धे पराभवम्। अधनस्य मृतं श्रेयो न हि ज्ञातिक्षयो जयः॥
en: Behold, there is certainly demerit in war, as defeat in it the death of a man who is without wealth is better for him but the loss of kinsmen is no victory.

sn: इति मे चिन्तयन्त्या वै हृदि दुःखं प्रवर्तते। पितामहः शान्तनव आचार्यश्च युधां पतिः॥
en: Thinking this, sorrow comes to my heart; this grand father, Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, the preceptor who is the foremost among soldiers,

sn: कर्णश्च धार्तराष्ट्रार्थं वर्धयन्ति भयं मम। आचार्यः कामवान् शिष्यैोणो युद्धयेत जातुचित्॥
en: And Karna also being united with the party of the son of Dhritarashtra it enhances my fear. The preceptor Drona will by no means fight willingly with his disciple. son

sn: पाण्डवेषु कथं हार्द कुर्यान्न च पितामहः। अयं त्वेको वृथादृष्टिर्धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्मतेः॥
en: Why should not also the grand father show sympathy to the son of Pandu. This one man only therefore (namely Karna) follows the delusion of the of the wicked-souled of Dhritarashtra of vain foresight.

sn: मोहानुवर्ती सततं पापो द्वेष्टि च पाण्डवान्। महत्यनर्थं निर्बन्धो बलवांश्च विशेषतः॥
en: The wretch also ever hates the sons of Pandu. He is obstinate in working for their injury, besides he is very powerful.

sn: कर्णः सदा पाण्डवानां तन्मे दहति सम्प्रति। आशंसे त्वद्य कर्णस्य मनोऽहं पाण्डवान् प्रति॥
en: Karna is ever against the sons of Pandu, and this fact now is burning me up; and I today expect. ((by the course I take) to incline the heart of Karna towards the sons of Pandu.

sn: प्रसादयितुमासाद्य दर्शयन्ती यथातथम्। तोषितो भगवान् यत्र दुर्वासा मे वरं ददौ॥
en: For I shall today approach him with a view to please him and tell him everything as it actually happened. The divinely holy Durvasa, being gratified by me, granted me a boon,

sn: आह्वानं मन्त्रसंयुक्तं वसन्त्याः पितृवेश्मनि। साहमन्तःपुरे राज्ञः कुन्तिभोजपुरस्कृता॥
en: Empowering me to invoke any body with the help of certain incantations ((mantras) when I was residing in my father's place, namely in the inner apartments of the king Kuntibhoja.

sn: चिन्तयन्ती बहुविधं हृदयेन विदूयता। बलाबलं च मन्त्राणां ब्राह्मणस्य च वाग्बलम्॥
en: With diverse thoughts and fearing in my heart and reflecting on the strength or weakness of the incantation as also of the efficacy of the Brahmana's boon.

sn: स्त्रीभावाद् बालभावाच्च चिन्तयन्ती पुनः पुनः। धाच्या विस्रब्धया गुप्ता सखीजनवृता तदा॥
en: And owing to my nature as a woman, especially owing to being a child I thought again and again, at the time being carefully guarded over by my nurse and surrounded by my companions.

sn: मे दोषं परिहरन्ती च पितुश्चारित्र्यरक्षिणी। कथं नु सुकृतं स्यानापराधवती कथम्॥
en: How I could avoid all blame and save the reputation of my father and how I could myself be visited with good fortune without being a sinner in any way.

sn: भवेयमिति संचिन्त्य ब्राह्मणं तं नमस्य च। कौतूहलात् तु तं लब्ध्वा बालिश्यादाचरं तदा। कन्या सती देवमर्कमासादयमहं ततः॥
en: And thinking of that Brahmana and bowing to him in my mind out of curiosity and behaving as a child at the time I came in contact with the god Surya though yet an unmarried girl.

sn: योऽसौ कानीनगर्भो मे पुत्रवत् परिरक्षितः। कस्मान्न कुर्याद् वचनं पथ्यं भ्रातृहितं तथा॥
en: Why should not he therefore, whom I bore in my womb when an unmarried girl, act according to my words leading to benefit and at the same time accomplish the good of his brothers?

sn: इति कुन्ती विनिश्चित्य कार्यनिश्चयमुत्तमम्। कार्यार्थमभिनिश्चित्य ययौ भागीरथी प्रति॥
en: Kunti, thus thinking on an excellent course of action, went towards the Bhagirathi for the attainment of her objects.

sn: आत्मजस्य ततस्तस्य घृणिनः सत्यसङ्गिनः। गङ्गातीरे पृथाऽश्रौषीद् वेदाध्ययननिःस्वनम्॥
en: Then on the banks of the Ganga did Pritha hear the sound of chanting the Vedas made by her son who had great kindness in him and who was attached to truth.

sn: प्राङ्मुखस्योर्ध्वबाहोः सा पर्यतिष्ठत पृष्ठतः। जप्यावसानं कार्यार्थं प्रतीक्षन्ती तपस्विनी॥
en: She waited behind Karna, who with arms upraised had his face turned to the east, till the end of the devotions of that devotee.

sn: अतिष्ठत् सूर्यतापार्ता कर्णस्योत्तरवाससि। कौरव्यपत्नी वार्ष्णेयी पद्ममालेव शुष्यती॥
en: She the wife of the Kauravya and the daughter of the Vrishni race waited troubled by the rays of the sun behind the clothes of Karna, becoming pale like a garland of lotuses.

sn: आपृष्ठतापाज्जप्त्वा स परिवृत्य यतव्रतः। दृष्ट्वा कुन्तीमुपातिष्ठदभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: That one, who used to say his prayers regularly, having been engaged in devotion till his back became heated with the rays of the sun, then turned and seeing Kunti he did honour her by saluting her and folding his hands before her.

sn: यथान्यायं महातेजा मानी धर्मभृतां वरः। उत्समयन् प्रणतः प्राह कुन्तीं वैकर्तनो वृषः॥
en: As was custom that best among men, the son of Vikartana, endued with great energy and pride, that foremost of all virtuous persons, with surprise, said to Kunti.

sn: कर्ण उवाच राधेयोऽहमाधिरथिः कर्णस्त्वामभिवादये। प्राप्ता किमर्थं भवती ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते॥
en: Karna said I am Karna, the son of Radha and the son of Adhiratha and I salute you. Why are you come here? Tell me what I shall do for you.

sn: कुन्त्युवाच कौन्तेयस्त्वं न राधेयो न तवाधिरथः पिता। नासि सूतकुले जातः कर्ण तद् विद्धि मे वचः॥
en: Kunti said You are the son of Kunti and not the son of Radha; nor is Adhiratha your father; you are not born in the race of Suta; know this word of mine to be true.

sn: कानीनस्त्वं मया जातः पूर्वजः कुक्षिणा धृतः। कुन्तिराजस्य भवने पार्थस्त्वमसि पुत्रक॥
en: You were begotten on me when I was an unmarried girl and you were the first held in my womb; you were born in the palace of Kuntiraja, my dear son.

sn: प्रकाशकर्मा तपनो योऽयं देवो विरोचनः। अजीजनत् त्वां मय्येष कर्ण शस्त्रभृतां वरम्॥
en: The god Tapana or Virochana (Surya) whose duty it is to make everything visible, begot you on me, O Karna, O you foremost of wielders of weapons.

sn: कुण्डली बद्धकवचो देवगर्भः श्रिया वृतः। जातस्त्वमसि दुर्धर्षं मया पुत्र पितुर्गुहे॥
en: O my son, you who are hard to conquer, were brought forth in my father's place by me, and you then wore earrings, and were clad in coats of mail, like a divine being endued with great beauty.

sn: स त्वं भ्रातृनसम्बुद्ध्य मोहाद् यदुपसेवसे। धार्तराष्ट्रान् न तद्युक्तं त्वयि पुत्र विशेषतः॥
en: You, who are such, are now, without recognizing your brothers owing to ignorance (of the true story), serving the sons of Dhritarashtra; it is not proper and especially for you, my son.

sn: एतद् धर्मफलं पुत्र नराणां धर्मनिश्चये। यत् तुष्यन्त्यस्य पितरो माता चाप्येकदर्शिनी॥
en: It is certainly the duty of men inclined to virtue, my son, to gratify one's father and mother who alone can view things in their proper light.

sn: अर्जुनेनार्जितां पूर्वं हृतां लोभादसाधुभिः। आच्छिद्य धार्तराष्ट्रेभ्यो भुक्ष्व यौधिष्ठिरीं श्रियम्॥
en: Snatching from the son of Dhritarashtra, the royal dignity of Yudhishthira, which was originally earned by Arjuna but has now been usurped from them by dishonest persons out of avarice, you enjoy it yourself.

sn: अद्य पश्यन्ति कुरवः कर्णार्जुनसमागमम्। सौभ्रात्रेण समालक्ष्य संनमन्तामसाधवः॥
en: Let the Kurus see today the union between Karna and Arjuna and seeing the establishment of brotherly feelings between them let dishonest men bow down.

sn: कर्णार्जुनौ वै भवेतां यथा रामजनार्दनौ। आस्थ्यं किं तु लोके स्याद् युवयोः संहितात्मनोः।।१०।
en: Karna and Arjuna being united like Rama and Janardana what is there which can not be performed by you in the world?

sn: कर्ण शोभिष्यसे नूनं पञ्चभिर्धातृभिर्वृतः। देवैः परिवृतो ब्रह्मा वेद्यामिव महाध्वरे॥
en: O Karna, you will surely shine surrounded by your five brothers like Brahma surrounded by the gods seated on the dais on the occasion of a great sacrificial ceremony.

sn: उपपन्नो गुणैः सर्वैयेष्ठः श्रेष्ठेषु बन्धुषु। सूतपुत्रेति मा शब्दः पार्थस्त्वमसि वीर्यवान्॥
en: Endued with all accomplishments you are eldest among all my best relatives; do not use again the term “the son of a Suta" for you are the son of Pritha, endued with prowess.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सूर्यानिश्चरितां कर्णः शुश्राव भारतीम्। दुरत्ययां प्रणयिनी पितृवद् भास्करेरिताम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then did Karna hear an affectionate voice issue from the solar disc from afar, spoken with the affection of a father by Surya himself.

sn: सत्यमाह पृथा वाक्यं कर्ण मातृवचः कुरु। श्रेयस्ते स्यान्नरव्याघ्र सर्वमाचरतस्तथा।॥
en: O Karna, Pritha has spoken the truth; act according to the advice of your mother; then will you get benefit, O best among men, namely by acting in that way in every detail.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्य मात्रा च स्वयं पित्रा च भानुना। चचाल नैव कर्णसय मतिः सत्यधृतेस्तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Being thus spoken to by his mother, and by his father Bhanu himself, the resolve, formed by Karna, who was ever devoted to truth, did not undergo any change.

sn: कर्ण उवाच न चैतच्छ्रद्दधे वाक्यं क्षत्रिये त्वया। धर्मद्वारं ममैतत् स्यान्नियोगकरणं तव॥
en: Karna said O Kshatriya, lady, I do not respect the words spoken by you, namely the way to virtue lies in my case to do what you urge me to do.

sn: अकरोन्मयि यत् पापं भवती सुमहात्ययम्। अपाकीर्णोऽस्मि यन्मातस्तद् यशःकीर्तिनाशनम्॥
en: The behaviour that you adopted towards me was a greatly sinful one, and (owing to that) I have sustained what is tantamount to the destruction of fame and renown.

sn: अहं चेत् क्षत्रियो जातो न प्राप्तः क्षत्रसत्क्रियाम्। त्वत्कृते किं पापीयः शत्रुः कुर्यान्ममाहितम्॥
en: Myself being born of a Kshatriya I did not obtain rites of a Kshatriya (for my birth); it was all on account of your doings; what enemy can possibly do me a greater injury?

sn: क्रियाकाले त्वनुक्रोशमकृत्वा त्वमिमं मम। हीनसंस्कारसमयमद्य मां समचूचुदः॥
en: Without showing any mercy to me when it ought to have been shown, you now come to me, deprived of my due rites, when an opportunity arises for you, to urge me.

sn: न वै मम हितं पूर्वं मातृवच्चेष्टितं त्वया। सा मां सम्बोधयस्यद्य केवलात्महितैषिणी॥
en: My good was never sought for by you as a mother and you now come to address me desiring the good of yourself,

sn: कृष्णेन सहितात् को वै न व्यथेत धनंजयात्। कोऽद्य भीतं न मां विद्यात् पार्थानां समितिं गतम्॥
en: Who am not afraid of Dhananjaya united with Krishna; and who would not consider me to be struck with fear if I go over to the side of the sons of the Pritha.

sn: अभ्राता विदितः पूर्वं युद्धकाले प्रकाशितः। पाण्डवान् यदि गच्छामि किं मां क्षत्रं वदिष्यति॥
en: Unknown as a brother before, and known to be so on the eve of battle, if I go over to the side of the sons of Pandu who will call me a Kshatriya.

sn: सर्वकामैः संविभक्तः पूजितश्च यथासुखम्। अहं वै धार्तराष्ट्राणां कुर्यां तदफलं कथम्॥
en: All my my desires were granted and worshipped by them; I was happy and comfortable; how can I make that worship of the sons of Dhritarashtra vain?

sn: उपनह्य परैर्वैरं ये मां नित्यमुपासते। नमस्कुर्वन्ति च सदा वसवो वासवं यथा॥
en: They, who having declared hostilities with others, ever seek to please me and ever bow down before me as the Vasus bow down to Vasava,

sn: मम प्राणेन ये शत्रूशक्ताः प्रतिसमासितुम्। मन्यन्ते ते कथं तेषामहं छिन्द्यां मनोरथम्॥
en: They, think that with my help they can withstand their enemies-how can I act against their cherished desire.

sn: मया प्लवेन संग्रामं तितीर्षन्ति दुरत्ययम्। अपारे पारकामा ये त्यजेयं तानहं कथम्॥
en: Making me as their boat, they desire to cross the sea of war, which is broad and expansive; how can I abandon them that are desirous of crossing that which can not be crossed.

sn: अयं हि कालः सम्प्राप्तो धार्तराष्ट्रोपजीविनाम्। निर्वेष्टव्यं मया तत्र प्राणानपरिरक्षता॥
en: This is the time come for those who have earned their living from the son of Dhritarashtra, (to show their fidelity) and I should engaged in that even at the risk of my life.

sn: कृतार्थाः सुभृता ये हि कृत्यकाले झुपस्थिते। अनवेक्ष्य कृतं पापा विकुर्वन्त्यनवस्थिताः॥
en: Those wretches who, well cared for and well-supported, at the approach of the time when something should be done in return for these acts of kindness, act in an ungraceful manner,

sn: राजकिल्बिषिणां तेषां भर्तृपिण्डापहारिणाम्। नैवायं न परो लोको विद्यते पापकर्मणाम्॥
en: Untrue to the bread of their lord, as they are, these faithless servants of their kings have neither this world nor the next for their good.

sn: धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राणामर्थे योत्स्यामि ते सुतैः। बलं च शक्तिं चास्थाय न वै त्वय्यनृतं वदे॥
en: On the side of the sons of Dhritarashtra, shall I fight with your sons with all my might and prowess; I do not speak untruely to you.

sn: आनृशंस्यमथो वृत्तं रक्षन् सत्पुरुषोचितम्। अतोऽर्थकरमप्येतन्न करोम्यद्य ते वचः॥
en: At the same time however showing due kindness and observing proper duties which ought to be observed by good men, I shall not act up to your words now as they are beneficial.

sn: न च तेऽयं समारम्भो मयि मोघो भविष्यति। वध्यान् विषह्यान् संग्रामे न हनिष्यामि ते सुतान्॥
en: But at the same time this appeal to me by you shall not be entirely useless. I shall not kill such of your sons as are capable of being withstood and killed by me, in the battle.

sn: युधिष्ठिरं च भीमं च यमौ चैवार्जुनादृते। अर्जुनेन समं युद्धमपि यौधिष्ठिरे बले॥
en: There are Yudhishthira, Bhima, and the twins, in fact every one save Arjuna; Arjuna alone in the army of Yudhishthira is worthy to fight with me.

sn: अर्जुनं हि निहत्याजौ सम्प्राप्तं स्यात् फलं मया। यशसा चापि युज्येयं निहत: सब्यसाचिना॥
en: Having killed Arjuna I shall achieve a reputation for great prowess; or being myself killed by Savyasachin I shall endued with renown.

sn: न ते जातु न शिष्यन्ति पुत्राः पञ्च यशस्विनि। निरर्जुनाः सकर्णा वा सार्जुना वा हते मयि।॥
en: O lady of renown, your five sons will not decrease; either you will be with Karna and not Arjuna or if I am slain, you will be with Arjuna (and without Karna).

sn: इति कर्णवचः श्रुत्वा दुःखात् प्रवेपती। उवाच पुत्रमाश्लिष्य कर्णं धैर्यादकम्पनम्॥
en: Hearing these words of Karna Kunti trembled with sorrow and said to his after embracing him who being possessed of fortitude trembled not.

sn: एवं वै भाव्यमेतेन क्षयं यास्यन्ति कौरवाः। यथा त्वं भाषसे कर्ण दैवं तु बलवत्तरम्॥
en: What you say may happen; the Kurus will meet with destruction, O Karna, destiny is the most powerful.

sn: त्वया चतुर्णां भ्रातृणामभयं शत्रुकर्शन। दत्तं तत् प्रतिजानीहि संगरप्रतिमोचनम्॥
en: By you has the pledge of safety been given to four of your brothers, O grinder of foes; remember the boon therefore which you have granted when weapons are being shot in the battle.

sn: अनामयं स्वस्ति चेति पृथाऽथो कर्णमब्रवीत्। तां कर्णोऽथ तथेत्युक्त्वा ततस्तौ जग्मतुः पृथक्॥
en: Pritha at last said to Karna “May you be blessed and may all be well with you” and Karna too saying the same thing to her, the two went in separate directions.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच आगम्य हास्तिनपुरादुप्लव्यमरिंदमः। पाण्डवानां यथावृतं केशवः सर्वमुक्तवान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said The chastiser of foes having come to Upaplavya from Hastinapura, Keshava told all about what had happened to the sons of Pandu.

sn: सम्भाष्य सुचिरं कालं मन्त्रयित्वा पुनः पुनः। स्वमेव भवनं शौरिर्विश्रामार्थं जगाम ह॥
en: Consulting together for a long time and holding repeated conferences Shouri went to his own place for rest.

sn: विसृज्य सर्वान् नृपतीन् विराटप्रमुखांस्तदा। पाण्डवा भ्रातरः पञ्च भानावस्तं गते सति॥
en: Then after sending all the rulers of men headed by king Virata, the five Pandavas brothers, when the sun had set,

sn: संध्यामुपास्य ध्यायन्तस्तमेव गतमानसाः। आनाय्य कृष्णं दाशार्ह पुनमन्त्रममन्त्रयन्॥
en: Having said their evening prayers began to think of him (Krishna) with their minds fixed on him, and getting Krishna of the Dasharha race, they again held a consultation.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवच त्वया नागपुरं गत्वा सभायां धृतराष्ट्रजः। किमुक्तः पुण्डरीकाक्ष तन्नः शंसितुमर्हसि॥
en: Yudhishthira said Having gone to Nagapur what did you, O you of lotus eyes, say to him who is born of Dhritarashtra in the council? It is proper that you should tell us that.

sn: वासुदेव उवाच मया नागपुरं गत्वा सभायां धृतराष्ट्रजः। तथ्यं पथ्यं हितं चोक्तो न च गृह्णाति दुर्मतिः॥
en: Vasudeva said Going to Nagapur I said to him who is born of Dhritarashtra words which are true, opportune and conducive to his interests but he of wicked mind did not accept them.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच तस्मिन्नुत्पथमापन्ने कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः। किमुक्तवान् हृषीकेश दुर्योधनममर्पणम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said To the one who is following the wrong course, namely the wrathful Duryodhana what did the oldest among the Kurus, our grandfather, say, O Hrishikesha?

sn: आचार्यो वा महाभाग भारद्वाजः किमब्रवीत्। पिता वा धृतराष्ट्रस्तं गान्धारी वा किमब्रवीत्॥
en: What did the preceptor, endued with noble attributes, the son of Bharadvaja, what did his father and mother-or Dhritarashtra and Gandhari say?

sn: पिता यवीयानस्माकं क्षत्ता धर्मविदां वरः। पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तः किमाह धृतराष्ट्रजम्॥
en: What did our uncle Kshattri, that foremost among those conversant with virtue, who is stricken with grief for his sons (at our exile) say to him who is born of Dhritarashtra?

sn: किं च सर्वे नृपतयः सभायां ये समासते। उक्तवन्तो यथातत्त्वं तद् ब्रूहि त्वं जनार्दन।॥
en: What also did all those rulers of men who were seated in the council say? You tell us, O Janardana, exactly how they happened.

sn: उक्तवान् हि भवान् सर्वं वचनं कुरुमुख्ययोः। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य तेषां हि वचनं कुरुसंसदि॥
en: You have already told us all the world spoken by the principal members of the Kuru race in the assembly of the Kurus to the son of Dhritarashtra,

sn: कामलोभाभिभूतस्य मन्दस्य प्राज्ञमानिनः। अप्रियं हृदये मह्यं तन्न तिष्ठति केशव॥
en: Who is overpowered by lust and avarice, who is a fool and who is vain of his wisdom; but as they are not fit, they do not yet retain a place in my mind.

sn: तेषां वाक्यानि गोविन्द श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं विभो। यथा च नाभिपद्येत कालस्तात तथा कुरु। भवान् हि नो गतिः कृष्ण भवान् नाथो भवान् गुरुः॥
en: Their words, O Govinda, do I desire to hear O lord, and act in such a way that time may not be lost, my dear friend; you are our refuge, O Krishna, you are lord, and you are our preceptor.

sn: वासुदेव उवाच शृणु राजन् यथा वाक्यमुक्तो राजा सुयोधनः। मध्ये कुरूणां राजेन्द्र सभायां तन्निबोध मे॥
en: Vasudeva said Hear, O king, the words that were said by me to the king Suyodhana in the midst of the kings in that council; listen to them, O chief among kings.

sn: मया विश्राविते वाक्ये जहास धृतराष्ट्रजः। अथ भीष्मः सुसंक्रुद्ध इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: The one born of Dhritarashtra however laughed at them; and then Bhishma, being excited with wrath, said these words.

sn: दुर्योधन निबोधेदं कुलार्थं यद् ब्रवीमि ते। तच्छ्रुत्वा राजशार्दूल स्वकुलस्य हितं कुरु॥
en: O Duryodhana, listen to these words, which I say for the benefit of my race and hearing that, O best among kings, effect the benefit of your race.

sn: मम तात पिता राजन् शान्तनुर्लोकविश्रुतः। तस्याहमेक एवासं पुत्रः पुत्रवतां वरः॥
en: My father, my dear son, was Shantanu, well known in this world, O king. I was his only son at first-of that best among those who had sons.

sn: तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना द्वितीयः स्यात् कथं सुतः। एकपुत्रमपुत्रं वै प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: A desire rose in his mind "How shall I have a second son, for wise men speak of one son as no son at all.

sn: न चोच्छेदं कुलं यायाद् विस्तीर्येच्च कथं यशः। तस्याहमीप्सितं बुद्ध्वा काली मातरमावहम्॥
en: Let my family be not extinct; how can my fame spread?” I coming to know of this desire of his got Kali as my stepmother.

sn: प्रतिज्ञां दुष्करां कृत्वा पितुरर्थं कुलस्य च। अराजा चोर्ध्वरेताश्च यथा सुविदितं तव। प्रतीतो निवसाम्येष प्रतिज्ञामनुपालयन्॥
en: My hard determination, for the sake of my father and for the sake of my race, of never being a king and of never throw in down vital fluid by the regular passage, is well known to you; observing these vows I am now living in joy.

sn: तस्यां जज्ञे महाबाहुः श्रीमान् कुरुकुलोद्वहः। विचित्रवीर्यो धर्मात्मा कनीयान् मम पार्थिव॥
en: In her was born my younger brother endued with prosperity, of long arms and the supporter of the Kuru race, the virtuous-souled Vichitravirya, O ruler of this eartlı.

sn: स्वर्यातेऽहं पितरि तं स्वराज्ये संन्यवेशयम्। विचित्रवीर्यं राजानं भृत्यो भूत्वा ह्यधश्चरः॥
en: My father having gone to heaven I placed that Vichitravirya at the head of my own kingdom and myself become a subordinate to him.

sn: तस्याहं सदृशान् दारान् राजेन्द्र समुपाहरम्। जित्वा पार्थिवसङ्घातमपि ते बहुशः श्रुतम्॥
en: I found out suitable wives for him, O chief among kings, after conquering an assemblage of the rulers of the earth; you heave heard of all that many times.

sn: ततो रामेण समरे द्वन्द्वयुद्धमुपागमम्। स हि रामभयादेभिर्नागरैर्विप्रवासितः॥
en: Then did I engage myself in a single combat with Rama and he fled away from the city from fear of Rama.

sn: दारेष्वप्यतिसक्तश्च यक्ष्माणं समपद्यता यदा त्वराजके राष्ट्रे न ववर्ष सुरेश्वरः। तदाभ्यधावन् मामेव प्रजाः क्षुद्भयपीडिताः॥
en: He was soon attacked with pthysis for being too much attached to his wives, and in that kingdom without a king the lord of the gods did not pour rain."

sn: प्रजा ऊचुः उपक्षीणाः प्रजाः सर्वा राजा भव भवाय नः। ईतीः प्रणुद भद्रं ते शान्तनोः कुलवर्धन॥
en: The subjects said All the subjects are weakened, you be our king for our good and put an end to this draught and other calamities; and it will be well with you, O son of Shantanu, O perpetuator of your race.

sn: पीड्यन्ते ते प्रजाः सर्वा व्याधिभिभृशदारुणैः। अल्पावशिष्ठा गाङ्गेय ताः परित्रातुमर्हसि॥
en: All your subjects are being very much troubled by serve diseases and 0 son of Ganga, it is proper that you should save the few that are alive.

sn: व्याधीनं प्रणुद् वीर त्वं प्रजा धर्मेण पालय। त्वयि जीवति मा राष्ट्रं विनाशमुपगच्छतु॥
en: Put an end to these calamities, O hero, and rule over your subjects with justice; yourself being alive let not this kingdom meet destruction.

sn: भीष्म उवाच प्रजानां क्रोशतीनां वै नैवाक्षुभ्यत मे मनः। प्रतिज्ञां रक्षमाणस्य सद् वृत्तं स्मरतस्तथा॥ ततः पौरा महाराज माताकाली च मे शुभा।
en: Bhishma said My heart remained unmoved at that grief of the subjects remembering that the observance of a vow is the duty of a good man. Then did my citizens, O great king, and my mother, the blessed Kali,

sn: भृत्याः पुरोहिताचार्या ब्राह्मणाश्च बहुश्रुताः। मामूचु शसंतप्ता भव राजेति संततम्॥
en: My servants, my priests, my preceptors and other Brahmanas well versed in holy books said to me, being struck with great sorrow "Yourself be the king.

sn: प्रतीपरक्षितं राष्ट्रं त्वां प्राप्य विनशिष्यति। स त्वमस्मद्धितार्थं वै राजा भव महामते।॥
en: The kingdom protected by Pratipa is being ruined, though it can claim you as its ruler; therefore do you, for the good of ourselves, be the king, O you of great intelligence.”

sn: इत्युक्तः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा दुःखितो भृशमातुरः। तेभ्यो न्यवेदयं तत्र प्रतिज्ञां पितृगौरवात्॥
en: Being thus spoken to an having joined my hands and being very much stuck with sorrow I represented to them the vow I was observing for the respect of my father.

sn: ऊर्ध्वरेता राजा च कुलस्यार्थं पुनः पुनः। विशेषतस्त्वदर्थं च धुरि मा मां नियोजय॥
en: Namely that I would not throw my seminal fluid through the regular passage and that I would not be a king for the sake of my race; I said this again and again, and requested them not to yoke me to the kingdom especially for their good.

sn: ततोऽहं प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा मातरं सम्प्रसादयम्। नाम्ब शान्तनुना जातः कौरवं वंशमुद्वहन्॥
en: Then clasping my hands I gratified my mother by saying thus “O mother, I shall not, being begotten by Shantanu and being a supporter of the Kuru family.

sn: प्रतिज्ञां वितयां कुर्यामिति राजन् पुनः पुनः। विशेषतस्त्वदर्थं च प्रतिज्ञां कृतवानहम्॥
en: Be false to my determination;" O king, I said this again and again and also said-"It was especially for your sake that I made that determination.

sn: अहं प्रेष्यश्च दासश्च तवाद्य सुतवत्सले। एवं तामनुनीयाहं मातरं जनमेव च॥
en: I am now your slave, waiting to be commanded by you, O you who are very affectionate to your children.” Having thus respectfully addressed my mother and my subjects,

sn: अयाचं भ्रातृदारेषु तदा व्यासं महामुनिम्। सह मात्रा महाराज प्रसाद्य तमृषिं तदा॥
en: I begged the great Muni Vyasa, along with my mother, O great king, after having gratified that Rishi, with the wives of my brother,

sn: अपत्यार्थ महाराज प्रसादं कृतवांश्च सः। त्रीन् स पुत्रानजनयत् तदा भरतसत्तम॥
en: To beget children, and great king he too complied with our request and then did he beget children, O you best among the Bharatas.

sn: अधः करणहीनत्वान्न वै राजा पिता तव। राजा तु पाण्डुरभवन्महात्मा लोकविश्रुतः॥
en: Being blind and therefore deprived of the usual rites, your father could not be a king and the great souled Pandu, well known in this world, became the king.

sn: स राजा तस्य ते पुत्राः पितुर्दायाद्यहारिणः। मा तात कलहं कार्षी राज्यस्यार्धं प्रदीयताम्॥
en: Himself being a king these sons of his must get a share of their paternal wealth; do not, my dear son, quarrel over the matter but give them half of the kingdom.

sn: मयि जीवति राज्यं कः सम्प्रशासेत् पुमानिह। मावमंस्था वचो मां शममिच्छामि वः सदा॥
en: When I am alive what other man can rule over this kingdom? Do not treat slightingly my words for we ever wish peace.

sn: न विशेषोऽस्ति मे पुत्र त्वयि तेषु च पार्थिव। मतमेतत् पितुस्तुभ्यं गान्धार्या विदुरस्य च॥
en: There is no difference between my treatment to you and that to them, o ruler of the earth; and the same is the opinion of your father, of Gandhari, as also of Vidura.

sn: श्रोतव्यं खलु वृद्धानां नाभिशङ्कीर्वचो मम। नाशयिष्यसि मा सर्वमात्मानं पृथिवी तथा॥
en: The words of the aged should be listened to; and do not treat slightingly these words of mine for otherwise will you destroy all that have, as also this earth."

sn: वासुदेव उवाच भीष्मेणोक्ते ततो द्रोणो दुर्योधनमभाषत। मध्ये नृपाणां भद्रं ते वचनं वचनक्षमः॥
en: Vasudeva said Bhishma having spoken thus, Drona, who was competent to speak, spoke these words to Duryodhane in the midst of those rulers of men. May it be well with you.

sn: प्रातीपः शान्तनुस्तात कुलस्यार्थ यथा स्थितः। यथा देवव्रतो भीष्मः कुलस्यार्थं स्थितोऽभवत्॥
en: As Shantanu, the son of Pratipa, ever acted with the interests of his race at heart and as Bhishma, who had taken a divine vow, ever acted with the interests of his race at heart,

sn: तथा पाण्डुनरपतिः सत्यसंधो जितेन्द्रियः। राजा कुरूणां धर्मात्मा सुव्रतः सुसमाहितः॥
en: So did that ruler of men Pandu, attached to truth, who had his senses under control-that virtuous-souled king of the Kurus who ever made and observed good vows and was interested in everything good.

sn: ज्येष्ठाय राज्यमदाद् धृतराष्ट्राय धीमते। यवीयसे तथा क्षत्रे कुरूणां वंशवर्धनः॥
en: To his elder brother the wise Dhritarashtra, that perpetuator of the Kuru race gave the kingdom as also to his younger brother Vidura.

sn: ततः सिंहासने राजन् स्थापयित्वैनमच्युतम्। वनं जगाम कौरव्यो भार्याभ्यां सहितो नृपः॥
en: Then having established him (Dhritarashtra) who never strayed away from the right path on the throne, that ruler of men (Pandu) son of the Kuru race went to woods with his two wives.

sn: नीचैः स्थित्वा तु विदुर उपास्ते स्म विनीतवत्। प्रेष्यवत् पुरुषव्याघ्रो वालव्यजनमुक्षिपन्॥
en: Vidura then taking up an humble position in the kingdom humbly served the king like a slave fanning him with the branch of a young tree, O best among men.

sn: ततः सर्वाः प्रजास्तात् धृतराष्ट्रं जनेश्वरम्। अन्वपद्यन्त विधिवद् यथा पाण्डं जनाधिपम्॥
en: Then did all the subjects, my dear son, duly acknowledge the sovereignty of their king in a suitable manner as they had done that of Pandu, the ruler of men.

sn: विसृज्य धृतराष्ट्राय राज्यं सविदुराय च। चचार पृथिवीं पाण्डुः सर्वां परपुरञ्जयः॥
en: Having made over the kingdom to Dhritarashtra and Vidura Pandu, that conqueror of the cities of his enemies, wandered over the earth.

sn: कोशसंवनने दाने भृत्यानां चान्ववेक्षणे। भरणे चैव सर्वस्य विदुरः सत्यसङ्गरः॥
en: The one, ever devoted to truth namely Vidura, took charge of treasury, gifts and presents and the supervision over the subordinates and the feeding of all.

sn: संधिविग्रहसंयुक्तो राज्ञां संवाहनक्रियाः। अवैक्षत महातेजा भीष्मः परपुरञ्जयः॥
en: Bhishma, of great energy, that conqueror of the cities of his enemies, looked over the making of war and peace with kings and of giving or withholding presents to them.

sn: सिंहासनस्थो नृपतिद्धृतराष्ट्रो महाबलः। अन्वास्यमानः सततं विदुरेण महात्मना॥
en: That ruler of men, Dhritarashtra of great strength, while on the throne, was ever followed by the great souled Vidura.

sn: कथं तस्य कुले जातः कुलभेदं व्यवस्यसि। सम्भूय भ्रातृभिः सार्धं भुड्क्ष्वभोगान् जनाधिप॥
en: How do you, born in his family, dare bringing about a dissension between the united with your brothers, enjoy objects of enjoyment, O lord of men.

sn: ब्रवीम्यहं न कार्पण्यानार्थहेतोः कथंचन। भीष्मेण दत्तमिच्छामि न त्वया राजसत्तम॥
en: I do not say all this from weakness or cowardice or for the attainment of any particular selfish object of mine. I desire to earn my living from Bhishma and not from what you can give me, O best among kings.

sn: नाहं त्वत्तोऽभिकाक्षिष्ये वृत्त्युपायं जनाधिप। यतो भीष्मस्ततो द्रोणो यद् भीष्मस्त्वाह तत् कुरु॥
en: I do not desire, O lord of men, to earn the means of living from you. Do that which Bhishma told you to do and Drona is ever on the side to which Bhishma inclines.

sn: दीयतां पाण्डुपुत्रेभ्यो राज्यामिरिकर्शन। सममाचार्यकं तात तव तेषां च मे सदा॥
en: Give to the sons of Pandu half of the kingdom, O grinder of your enemies; the office of a preceptor has been filled by me equally for both yourself and them, my dear son,

sn: अश्वत्थामा यथा मह्यं तथा श्वेतहयो मम। बहुना किं प्रलापेन यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः॥
en: What Ashvathama is to me, so is he with white horses (Arjuna); what is the necessity of talking much; where there is virtue there is victory.

sn: वासुदेव उवाच एवमुक्ते महाराज द्रोणेनामिततेजसा। व्याजहार ततो वाक्यं विदुरः सत्यसङ्गरः। पितुर्वदनमन्वीक्ष्य परिवृत्य च धर्मवित्॥
en: Vasudeva said Words like these having been spoken by Drona of immeasurable energy, Vidura, ever devoted to truth, then said these words turning towards his father's uncle and looking at him.

sn: विदुर उवाच देवव्रत निबोधेदं वचनं मम भाषतः। प्रणष्टः कौरवो वंशस्त्वयाऽयं पुनरुद्भूतः॥
en: Vidura said O you of divine vows, listen to these words spoken by me; this race of Kurus made extinct by you, had again been saved from extermination.

sn: तन्मे विलपमानस्य वचनं समुपेक्षसे। कोऽयं दुर्योधनो नाम कुलेऽस्मिन् कुलपांसनः॥
en: on Therefore do you not treat slightingly the words spoken by me who am lamenting. Who is this one named Duryodhana in this race but a stain,

sn: यस्य लोभाभिभूतस्य मतिं समनुवर्तसे। अनार्यस्याकृतज्ञस्य लोभेन हृतचेतसः॥
en: Whose inclination overpowered by avarice you follow? He leads a dishonest life, is ungrateful and deprived of his senses by avarice.

sn: अतिक्रामति यः शास्त्रं पितुर्धर्मार्थदर्शिनः। एते नश्यन्ति कुरवो दुर्योधनकृतेन वै॥
en: He does not obey the commands of his father who follows the path of virtue and worldly benefit. Duryodhana will bring on the destruction of the Kurus by his acts.

sn: यथा ते न प्रणश्येयुर्महाराज तथा कुरु। मां चैव धृतराष्ट्रं च पूर्वमेव महामते॥
en: Do that, O great king, which will not bring their extermination. Myself and Dhritarashtra, you before, O lord of the earth,

sn: चित्रकार इवालेख्यं कृत्वा स्थापितवानसि। प्रजापतिः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा यथा संहरते तथा॥
en: Brought into being as a painter does a picture. Do not act like the lord of creatures, who having created living beings again destroys them.

sn: नोपेक्षस्व महाबाहो पश्यमानः कुलक्षयम्। अथ तेऽद्य मतिर्नष्टा विनाशे प्रत्युपस्थिते॥
en: Do not look with indifference on this impending massacre of your race; ruin being now near at hand, your intellect is lost to you.

sn: वनं गच्छ मया साधु धृतराष्ट्रेण चैव ह। बद्ध्वा वा निकृतिप्रज्ञं धार्तराष्ट्र सुदुर्मतिम्॥
en: Go to the woods in company with myself and Dhritarashtra, or binding down the very wretched intentioned son of Dhritarashtra, whose wisdom is lost,

sn: शीधीदं राज्यमद्याशु पाण्डवैरभिरक्षितम्। प्रसीद राजशार्दूल विनाशो दृश्यते महान्॥
en: Rule over this kingdom now, protected and supported by the sons of Pandu. O best among kings, rest satisfied that a great massacre is near at hand,

sn: पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च राज्ञाममिततेजसाम्। विररामैवमुक्त्वा तु विदुरो दीनमानसः। प्रध्यायमानः स तदा निःश्वसंश्च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Of the sons of Panda, the Kurus, and of kings of immeasurable energy.” Saying this Vidura stopped with his heart sad. And thinking of the situation he began to sign again and again.

sn: ततोऽथ राज्ञः सुबलस्य पुत्री धर्मार्थयुक्तं कुलनाशभीता। दुर्योधनं पापमतिं नृशंसं राज्ञां समक्षं सुतमाह कोपात्॥
en: Then did the daughter of king Subala, afraid of the extinction of her race, said out of anger these words which were virtuous and conducive to the benefit of her inhuman and wicked-souled son Duryodhana in the midst of these kings.

sn: ये पार्थिवा राजसभां प्रविष्टा ब्रह्मर्षयो ये च सभासदोऽन्ये। शृण्वन्तु वक्ष्यामि तवापराधं पापस्य सामात्यपरिच्छदस्य॥
en: "Let these rulers of the earth, who have entered this royal council as also these regenerate Rishis and all others in this council, hear what I am going to say about the sin committed by yourself. O wretch and your ministers and followers.

sn: राज्यं कुरूणामनुपूर्वभोज्यं क्रमागतो नः कुलधर्म एषः। त्वं पापबुद्धेऽतिनृशंसकर्मन् राज्य कुरूणामनयाद् विहंसि॥
en: The kingdom is obtainable by us in a certain fixed order; this has been the custom with our race, but you, O you of sinful intellect and of very inhuman deeds, desire unjustly to ruin the kingdom of the Kurus.

sn: राज्ये स्थितो धृतराष्ट्रो मनीषी तस्यानुजो विदुरो दीर्घदर्शी। एतावतिक्रम्य कथं नृपत्वं दुर्योधन प्रार्थयसेऽद्य मोहात्॥
en: The wise Dhritarashtra is now established on the throne and under him as a subordinate is Vidura of great foresight; superseding these two how can you, O Duryodhana, desire the kingdom out of folly?

sn: राजा च क्षत्ता च महानुभावौ भीष्मे स्थिते परवन्तौ भवेताम्। अयं तु धर्मज्ञतया महात्मा न कामयेद् यो नृवरो नदीजः॥
en: The king himself and Vidura of great soul, are so long as Bhishma is alive, but his subordinates; in fact owing to his being conversant with virtue, the one born of the river (Ganga), that foremost of kings does not desire the kingship.

sn: राज्यं तु पाण्डोरिदमप्रधृष्यं तस्याद्य पुत्राः प्रभवन्ति नान्ये। राज्यं तदेतन्निखिलं पाण्डवानां पैतामहं पुत्रपौत्रानुगामि॥
en: This kingdom, incapable of being subjugated, belongs to Pandu and now his sons are lords over it and none else. This entire kingdom, coming from their father, goes to the sons of Pandu, and to their sons of grandsons.

sn: यद् वै ब्रूते कुरुमुख्यो महात्मा देवव्रतः सत्यसंधो मनीषी। सर्वं तदस्माभिरहत्य कार्य राज्यं स्वधर्मान् परिपालयद्भिः॥
en: What, that foremost among the Kurus, that great-souled one of divine vows, ever attached to truth, endued with intelligence, says, should is its entirely, be done by us, for the sake of our kingdom, and the duties of our order.

sn: अनुज्ञया चाथ महाव्रतस्य ब्रूयावृपोऽयं विदुरस्तथैव। कार्यं भवेत् तत् सुहृद्भिनियोज्यं धर्मं पुरस्कृत्य सुदीर्घकालम्॥
en: Let this ruler of men as also Vidura by the command of the one of great vows speak the same thing; that is an act that should be done by our well wishers who should place virtue above all consideration.

sn: न्यायागतं राज्यमिदं कुरूणां युधिष्ठिरः शास्तु वै धर्मपुत्रः। प्रचोदितो धृतराष्ट्रेण राज्ञा पुरस्कृतः शान्तनवेन चैव॥
en: Let the son of Dharma Yudhishthira rule over the kingdom of the Kurus, obtained justly, led by Dhritarashtra and placing the son of Shantanu at the helm of affairs."

sn: वासुदेव उवाच एवमुक्ते तु गान्धार्या धृतराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः। दुर्योधनमुवाचेदं राजमध्ये जनाधिप॥
en: Vasudeva said Words like these having been spoken by Gandhari that lord of men, Dhritarashtra in the midst of the kings, O lord of men.

sn: दुर्योधन निबोधेदं यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि पुत्रक। तथा तत् कुरु भद्रं ते यद्यस्ति पितृगौरवम्॥
en: "O Duryodhana, listen to what I am going to say, my dear son, and act according to that if you entertain respect for your father. It will be well with you.

sn: सोमः प्रजापतिः पूर्व कुरूणां वंशवर्धनः। सोमाद् बभूव षष्ठोऽयं ययातिनहुधात्मजः॥
en: That lord of creatures, Soma was the first who begot the race of Kurus, and sixth in descent from Soma was Yayati the son of Nahusa.

sn: तस्य पुत्रा बभूवुर्हि पञ्च राजर्षिसत्तमाः। तेषां यदुर्महातेजा ज्येष्ठः समभवत् प्रभुः॥
en: He had five sons, the best among royal sages and of them Yadu of great energy was the firs, and was the lord.

sn: पुर्यवीयांश्च ततो योऽस्माकं वंशवर्धनः। शर्मिष्ठया सम्प्रसूतो दुहित्रा वृषपर्वणः॥
en: Younger than he was Puru and he was our ancestor; he was brought forth by Sharmishtha, the daughter of Vrishaparvan.

sn: यदुश्च भरतश्रेष्ठ देवयान्याः सुतोऽभवत्। दौहित्रस्तात शुक्रस्य काव्यस्यामिततेजसः॥
en: Yadu, O foremost among the Bharatas, was the son of Devayani, and was therefore the grandson of Shukra, the wise Rishi of immeasurable energy.

sn: यादवानां कुलकरो बलवान् वीर्यसम्मतः। अवमेने स तु क्षत्रं दर्पपूर्णः सुमन्दधीः॥
en: The ancestor of the Yadavas, endued with strength and prowess as he was, being full of pride and vanity and wicked intelligence, insulted the Kshatriyas.

sn: न चातिष्ठत् पितुः शास्त्रे बलदर्पविमोहितः। अवमेने च पितरं भ्रातूंश्चाप्यपराजितः॥
en: He did not act up to the instructions of his father being stupified by the pride of his strength; and having never sustained a defeat he insulted his father and his brothers.

sn: पृथिव्यां चतुरन्तायां यदुरेवाभवद् बली। वशे कृत्वा स नृपतीन् न्यवसन्नागसाह्वये॥
en: In the four quarters of the globe, Yadu was the strongest man and having brought all the rulers of men under subjection he lived in the city called after the elephant.

sn: तं पिता परमक्रुद्धो ययातिर्नहुषात्मजः। शशाप पुत्रं गान्धारे राज्याच्चापि व्यरोपयत्।॥
en: His father, Yayati, born of Nahusha being very much angry with him, cursed his son, O son of Gandhari and exiled him from the kingdom.

sn: ये चैनमन्ववर्तन्त भ्रातरो बलदर्पिताः। शशाप तानभिक्रुद्धो ययातिस्तनयानथ॥
en: These brothers of his also who followed the lead of the elder brother vain of his strength, Yayati also cursed. Having cursed these sons of his that best among the rulers of men,

sn: यवीयासं ततः पूरूं पुत्रं स्ववशवर्तिनम्। राज्ये निवेशयामास विधेयं नृपसत्तमः॥
en: Then did place his second son Puru, who remained devoted to him, on the throne which was suitable.

sn: एवं ज्येष्ठोऽप्यथोत्सितो न राज्यमभिजायते। यवीयांसोऽपि जायन्ते राज्यं वृद्धोपसेवया॥
en: Thus can even the eldest son be superseded and deprived of the kingdom; and even a younger son can get the kingdom for his attentions to the aged.

sn: तथैव सर्वधर्मज्ञः पितुर्मम पितामहः। प्रतीपः पृथिवीपालस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः॥
en: Thus also the grandfather of my father, conversant with all virtues, Pratipa the ruler of the universe and known in the three worlds,

sn: तस्य पार्थिवसिंहस्य राज्यं धर्मेण शासतः। त्रयः प्रजज्ञिरे पुत्रा देवकल्पा यशस्विनः॥
en: That lion among the rulers of the earth while ruling his kingdom virtuously had born to him three sons of renown and having the attributes of the gods.

sn: देवापिरभवच्छेष्ठो बाह्रीकस्तदनन्तरम्। तृतीयः शान्तनुस्तात धृतिमान मे पितामहः॥
en: Of them Devapi was the foremost (eldest) and then came Balhika; and the third Shantanu; that wise man was my grandfather.

sn: देवापिस्तु महातेजास्त्वग्दोषी राजसत्तमः। धार्मिकः सत्यवादी च पितुः शुश्रूषणे रतः॥
en: Devapi, that best among kings though endued in his skin; but he was a virtuous man, a speaker of truth and ever devoted to attending on his father.

sn: पौरजानपदानां च सम्मतः साधुसत्कृतः। सर्वेषां बालवृद्धानां देवापिर्हदयंगमः॥
en: Devapi was honoured by all the subjects and citizens and respected by the good and he was loved by all-the old and the young.

sn: वदान्यः सत्यसंधश्च सर्वभूतहिते रतः। वर्तमानः पितुः शास्त्रे ब्राह्मणानां तथैव च॥
en: He was benevolent, attached to truth and devoted to the good of all creatures and ever obeyed the command of his father as also of the Brahmanas.

sn: बाह्रीकस्य प्रियो भ्राता शान्तनोश्च महात्मनः। सौभ्रात्रं च परं तेषां सहितानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: He was the dear brother of Balhika and also of the great souled Shantanu; in fact among all those great-souled men excellent brotherly feelings existed.

sn: अथ कालस्य पर्याये वृद्धो नृपतिसत्तमः। सम्भारानभिषेकार्थं कारयामास शास्त्रतः॥
en: In course of time, that old king, the best among rulers of men, had all arrangements made for the installation according to the holy books ((of his son).

sn: कारयामास सर्वाणि मङ्गलार्थानि वै विभुः। तं ब्राह्मणाश्च वृद्धाश्च पौरजानपदैः सह॥
en: That lord had all auspicious arrangements made, but the Brahmanas and the old men among the citizens with the subjects of the province,

sn: सर्वे निवारयामासुर्देवापेरभिषेचनम्। स तच्छ्रुत्वा तु नृपतिरभिषेकनिवारणम्। अश्रुकण्ठोऽभवद् राजा पर्यशोचत चात्मजम्॥
en: All dissuaded him from installing Devapi; and that ruler of men, having heard of the exclusion of his elder son from the installation, had his voice choked with tears and became sorrowful for his son.

sn: एवं वदान्यो धर्मज्ञः सत्यसंधश्च सोऽभवत्। प्रियः प्रजानामपि संस्त्वग्दोषेण प्रदूषितः॥
en: Though he was benevolent, conversant with virtue, attached to truth, and loved by his subjects yet he has a defect in his skin.

sn: हीनाङ्गं पृथिवीपालं नाभिनन्दन्ति देवताः। इति कृत्वा नृपश्रेष्ठं प्रत्यषेधन् द्विजर्षभाः॥
en: The gods do not approve of that ruler of men who has a defeat in his limbs." So saying those foremost among the twice born dissuaded that foremost among the rulers of men.

sn: ततः प्रव्यथिताङ्गोऽसौ पुत्रशोकसमन्वितः। निवारितं नृपं दृष्ट्वा देवापिः संश्रितो वनम्॥
en: Devapi, too who was defective of one limb, seeing, that ruler of men with his heart pained and struck with grief for son, dissuaded from carrying out his intentions, went to the woods.

sn: बाह्रीको मातुलकुलं त्यक्त्वा राज्यं समाश्रितः। पितृभ्रातृन् परित्यज्य प्राप्तवान् परमर्द्धिमत्॥
en: Balhika, too giving up his kingdom, established himself in the family of his maternal uncle, and abandoning his father and brother he obtained a very wealthy kingdom.

sn: बाह्रीकेन त्वनुज्ञातः शान्तनुर्लोकविश्रुतः। पितर्युपरते राजन् राजा राज्यमकारयत्॥
en: Being commanded by Balhika, Shantanu, well known in this world, on the retirement of his father, become, O king the king in that kingdom.

sn: तथैवाहं मतिमता परिचिन्त्येह पाण्डुना। ज्येष्ठः प्रभ्रंशितो राज्याद्धीनाङ्क इति भारत॥
en: In the same way, myself though the eldest, was excluded from the kingdom owing to the defeat in my limbs, O Bharata, in favour of Pandu, endued with good understanding, after due reflection.

sn: पाण्डुस्तु राज्यं सम्प्राप्तः कनीयानपि सन् नृपः। विनाशे तस्य पुत्राणामिदं राज्यमरिंदम।॥
en: That ruler of men Pandu too obtained the kingdom though he was younger and at his death this kingdom, O chastiser of foes, belongs to his sons.

sn: मय्यभागिनि राज्याय कथंत्वं राज्यमिच्छसि। अराजपुत्रो ह्यस्वामी परस्व हर्तुमिच्छसि॥
en: Myself having never participated in the kingdom, now do you desire it, being the son of one who was never a king. You are not a king, and yet you desire to take another's property.

sn: युधिष्ठिरो राजपुत्रो महात्मा न्यायागतं राज्यमिदं च तस्य। स कौरवस्यास्य कुलस्य भर्ता प्रशासिता चैव महानुभावः॥
en: Yudhishthira is the son of a king and has a great soul; and this kingdom justly goes to him. He being endued with great attributes is the lord of the Kuru race as also the ruler of the kingdom.

sn: स सत्यसंधः स तथाऽप्रमत्तः शास्त्रे स्थितो बन्धुजनस्य साधुः। प्रियः प्रजानां सुहृदानुकम्पी जितेन्द्रियः साधुजनस्य भर्ता॥
en: He is attached to truth and in never beside his senses; he follows the teachings of the holy books and does good to his friends; he is an honest man and is dear to his subjects; he feels for his well-wishers has his senses under control and is the lord of honest men.

sn: क्षमा तितिक्षा दम आर्जवं च सत्यव्रतत्वं श्रुतमप्रमादः। भूतानुकम्पा ह्यनुशासनं च युधिष्ठिरे राजगुणाः समस्ता॥
en: Forgiveness, patience, self restraint sincerity, devotion to truth, a good appreciation of the holy books, benevolence, love to creature and ability to rule justly, all these attributes of a king are in Yudhishthira.

sn: अराजपुत्रस्त्वमनार्यवृत्तो लुब्धः सदा बन्धुषु पापबुद्धिः। क्रमागतं राज्यमिदं परेषां हर्तुं कथं शक्ष्यसि दुर्विनीत॥
en: You, on the other hand, are the son of one who has never been a king; you lead the life of a dishonorable man, you are covetous, ever have wicked intentions towards your friends; O you not endued with humility, how under these circumstances can you take this kingdom which belongs to others and which comes to the successors according to a certain order.

sn: प्रयच्छ राज्यार्धमपेतमोहः सवाहनं त्वं सपरिच्छदं च। ततोऽवशेषं तव जीवितस्य सहानुजस्यैव भवेन्नरेन्द्र।॥
en: With your folly removed, give over one half of the kingdom with its animals and royal garments; and the remainder will be enough for your own living and that of your younger brothers.

sn: वासुदेव उवाच एवमुक्ते तु भीष्मेण द्रोणेन विदुरेण च। गान्धार्या धृतराष्ट्रेण न वै मन्दोऽन्वबुद्ध्यत॥
en: Vasudeva said Though thus spoken to by Bhishma and Drona and Vidura and Gandhari and Dhritarashtra, the fool was yet not brought to his senses.

sn: अवधूयोत्थितो मन्दः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। अन्वद्रवन्त तं पश्चाद् राजानस्त्यक्तजीविताः॥
en: On the other hand that fool, with his eyes red with anger, disregarding them all, went away; and after him the kings who had abandoned all hopes of life followed.

sn: आज्ञापयच्च राज्ञस्तान् पार्थिवान् नष्टचेतसः। प्रयाध्वं वै कुरुक्षेत्रं पुष्योऽद्येति पुनः पुनः॥
en: The king also again and again said to these rulers of men who had lost their senses: "Go to: the Kurukshetra, today is the constellation Pushya on the ascendant.

sn: ततस्ते पृथिवीपालाः प्रययुः सहसैनिकाः। भीष्मं सेनापतिं कृत्वा संहृष्टाः कालचोदिताः॥
en: Then did those rulers of the earth along with their commander. They looked cheerful as if urged by death himself.

sn: अक्षोहिण्यो दशैका च कौरवाणां समागताः। तासां प्रमुखतो भीष्मस्तालकेतुळरोचत॥
en: Eleven Akshauhinis have assembled for the Kurus and in the foremost ranks of those is shining Bhishma who has a flag-staff as high as a palm tree.

sn: यदत्र युक्तं प्राप्तं च तद् विधत्स्व विशाम्पते। उक्तं भीष्मेण यद् वाक्यं द्रोणेन विदुरेण च॥
en: Do that, O lord, which is suitable in this crisis, and under the present circumstances. The worlds that had been said by Bhishma, those by Drona and by Vidura,

sn: गान्धार्या धृतराष्ट्रेण समक्षं मम भारत। एतत् ते कथितं राजन् यद् वृत्तं कुरुसंसदि।॥
en: And by Gandhari and by Dhritarashtra in my presence, O Bharata, in fact every thing that took place in the assembly of the Kurus, I have told you, O king.

sn: साम्यमादौ प्रयुक्तं मे राजन् सौभ्रात्रमिच्छता। अभेदायास्य वंशस्य प्रजानां च विवृद्धये॥
en: All the means commencing with conciliation have been employed by me, desirous of bringing on brotherly feelings among you, so that there might not be a dispute and a destruction of the human race.

sn: पुनर्भेदश्च मे युक्तो यदा साम न गृह्यते। कर्मानुकीर्तनं चैव देवमानुषसंहितम्॥
en: When I saw that conciliation was not acceptable, I employed "disunion” (i.e. I sought to effect my purpose by creating disunion among his warriors) and I described your deeds, ordinary and superhuman.

sn: यदा नाद्रियते वाक्यं सामपूर्वं सुयोधनः। तदा मया समानीय भेदिताः सर्वपार्थिवाः॥
en: When I saw that Suyodhana did not accept my words of conciliation, I had all the rulers of the earth brought before me and tried to create disunion among them.

sn: अद्भुतानि च घोराणि दारुणानि च भारत। अमानुषाणि कर्माणि दर्शितानि मया विभो॥
en: 0 lord, strange, fierce and hard manifestations beyond human capabilities were shown by me, O Bharata.

sn: निर्भर्त्सयित्वा राज्ञस्तांस्तृणीकृत्य सुयोधनम्। राधेयं भीषयित्वा च सौबलं च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Finding fault with these and holding up Suyodhana to ridicule, describing him as a straw again and again I tried to frighten the son of Radha and the son of Subala.

sn: द्युततो धार्तराष्ट्राणां निन्दां कृत्वा तथा पुनः। भेदयित्वा नृपान् सर्वान् वाग्भिर्मन्त्रेण चासकृत्॥
en: Then again finding fault with the match at dice of the sons of Dhritarashtra I tried to create disunion among those rulers of the earth by means of eloquence and by intrigues.

sn: पुनः सामाभिसंयुक्तं सम्प्रदानमथाब्रुवम्। अभेदात् कुरुवंशस्य कार्ययोगात् तथैव च॥ ते
en: Then again did I speak of conciliation and then of gifts so that there might not be any disunion in the race of the Kurus and our object be accomplished.

sn: शूरा धृतराष्ट्रस्य भीष्मस्य विदुरस्य च। तिष्ठेयुः पाण्डवाः सर्वे हित्वा मानमधश्चराः॥
en: I said-"Those heroes, the sons of Pandu, will remain dependent on Dhritarashtra, Bhishma and Vidura as their subordinates, abandoning their pride.

sn: प्रयच्छन्तु च ते राज्यमनीशास्ते भवन्तु च। यथाऽऽह राजा गाङ्गेयो विदुरश्च हितं तव॥
en: Let the kingdom be given to you and let them not be lords of the kingdom. What the king (Dhritarashtra) and the son of Ganga and Vidura said is beneficial to you.

sn: सर्वं भवतु ते राज्यं पञ्च ग्रामान् विसर्जय। अवश्यं भरणीया हि पितुस्ते राजसत्तम॥
en: Let the entire kingdom be yours but give up only five villages; for surely they ought to be supported be your father, O best of kings.

sn: एवमुक्तोऽपि दुष्टात्मा नैव भागं व्यमुञ्चत। दण्डं चतुर्थं पश्यामि तेषु पापेषु नान्यथा॥
en: Even thus spoken to the wicked-souled one did not give up any share and I can only see the forth means (punishment) for these wickedsouled ones and nothing else.

sn: निर्याताश्च विनाशाय कुरुक्षेत्रं नराधिपाः। एतत् ते कथितं राजन् यद् वृत्तं कुरुसंसदि॥
en: The lords of men have set out for Kurukshetra-only to meet with destruction; I have now toid you what happened in the assembly of the Kurus.

sn: न ते राज्यं प्रयच्छन्ति विना युद्धेन पाण्डव। विनाशहेतवः सर्वे प्रत्युपस्थितमृत्यवः॥
en: They will not give up the kingdom without war, O son of Pandu. All, of them being the cause of a universal massacre, are coming within the very pale of death.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच जनार्दनवचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। भ्रातृनुवाच धर्मात्मा समक्षं केशवस्य ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said The virtuous-souled king Yudhishthira the just, having heard these words of Janardana, said to his brothers in the presence of Keshava.

sn: श्रुतं भवद्भिर्यद् वृत्तं सभायां कुरुसंसदि। केशवस्यापि यद् वाक्यं तत् सर्वमवधारितम्॥
en: You have heard what happened in that assemblage of the Kurus and you have also understood what words Keshava has said.

sn: तस्मात् सेनाविभागं मे कुरुध्वं नरसत्तमाः। अक्षौहिण्यश्च सप्तैताः समेता विजयाय वै॥
en: Therefore do you, O best among men, make a division of my army; these are the seven Akshauhinis who have assembled for my victory.

sn: तासां ये पतयः सप्त विख्यातास्तान् निबोधत। दुपदश्च विराटश्च धृष्टद्युम्नशिखण्डिनौ॥
en: Listen to the names of those renowned who to be their respective commanders. Drupada, Virata, Dhrishtadyumna and Shikhandin,

sn: सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च भीमसेनश्च वीर्यवान्। एते सेनाप्रणेतारो वीराः सर्वे तनुज्यजः॥
en: Satyaki, Chekitana and Bhimasena endued with strength, these heroes who are prepared to sacrifice their lives will be the commanders of my army.

sn: सर्वे वेदविदः शूरोः सर्वे सुचरितव्रताः। ह्रीमन्तो नीतिमन्तश्च सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः॥
en: All of then are conversant with the Vedas, and all those heroes have made and observed excellent vows; all of them know very well the science of war and are endued with modesty and know diplomacy. men are

sn: इष्वस्त्रकुशलाः सर्वे तथा सर्वास्त्रयोधिनः। सप्तानामपि यो नेता सेनानां प्रविभागवित्॥
en: All of them besides can fight with all weapons and are skillful in the use of arrows and other weapons. He who will command these seven division must have a knowledge of all the divisions of the army.

sn: यः सहेत रणे भीष्मं शरार्चिः पावकोपमम्। तं तावत् सहदेवात्र प्रब्रूहि कुरुनन्दन। स्वमतं पुरुषव्याघ्र को नः सेनापतिः क्षमः॥
en: He must besides withstand the flame of his arrows similar to those of fire. Speak out, O Sahadeva, O delighted of the Kuru race, your own opinion as to who has these qualifications, O best among men, and who is competent to be our general?

sn: सहदेव उवाच संयुक्तं एकदुःखश्च वीर्यवांश्च महीपतिः। यं समाश्रित्य धर्मज्ञं स्वमंशमनुयुज्महे॥
en: Sahadeva said Bound to us by a tie and having the same cause for sorrow as ourselves, the ruler of the earth, endued with prowess, the one conversant with virtue taking refuge with whom we seek to gain our share.

sn: मत्स्यो विराटो बलवान् कृतास्त्रो युद्धदुर्मदः। प्रसहिष्यति संग्रामे भीष्मं तांश्च महारथान्॥
en: That mighty king of the Matsya's, Virata, a master in the use of weapons and hard to vanquish in battle, will withstand in battle Bhishma and those mighty car-warriors.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथोक्ते सहदेवेन वाक्ये वाक्यविशारदः। नकुलोऽनन्तरं तस्मादिदं वचनमाददे॥
en: Vaishampayana said These words being spoken by Sahadeva, Nakula who was eloquent, said these words.

sn: वयसा शास्त्रतो धैर्यात् कुलेनाभिजनेन च। ह्रीमान् बलान्वितः श्रीमान् सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः॥
en: “In age, in a knowledge of the holy books, in patience, in nobility of birth and in high connections, he, who is respectable, who is well versed in all the holy books and sciences,

sn: वेद चास्त्रं भरद्वाजाद् दुर्धर्षः सत्यसङ्गरः। यो नित्यं स्पर्धते द्रोणं भीष्मं चैव महाबलम्॥
en: He who learnt the handing of weapons from Bharadvaja, he who is hard to vanquish and ever devoted to truth, who ever challenges Drona as also Bhishma endued with great strength,

sn: श्लाध्यः पार्थिववंशस्य प्रमुखे वाहिनीपतिः। पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतः शतशाख इव द्रुमः॥
en: He who is enviable in the races of the rulers of the earth, the foremost of all leaders of armies and who surrounded by sons and grandsons is like a tree with a hundred branches,

sn: यस्तताप तपो घोरं सदारः पृथिवीपतिः। रोषाद् द्रोणविनाशाय वीरः समितिशोभनः॥
en: The lord of the earth who in company with his wife practiced hard austerities for destroying Drona, that hero who adorns an assembly,

sn: पितेवास्मान् समाधत्ते यः सदा पार्थिवर्षभः। श्वशुरो द्रुपदोऽस्माकं सेनाग्रं स प्रकर्षतु॥
en: That best among the rulers of the earth who ever supports us as a father, our father-inlaw Drupada, should stand at the head of our army.

sn: स द्रोणभीष्मावायातौ सहेदिति मतिर्ममा स हि दिव्यास्त्रविदं राजा सखा चाङ्गिरसो नृपः॥
en: He will be able to withstand both Drona and Bhishma. Such has been my opinion; that king is familiar with the use of celestial weapons and the king is the friend of Angiras.”

sn: माद्रीसुताभ्यामुक्ते तु स्वमते कुरुनन्दनः। वासविर्वासवसमः सव्यसाच्यब्रवीद् वचः॥
en: The two sons of Madri having spoken out their own opinions, that delighter of the Kuru race, Savyasachin, the son of Vasava, equal to Vasava himself, said these words.

sn: योऽयं तपःप्रभावेण ऋषिसंतोषणेन च। दिव्यः पुरुष उत्पन्नो ज्वालावर्णो महाभुजः॥
en: He, who by the virtue of his austerity and by his gratification of the Rishis, that celestial being of long arms came out, looking like fire,

sn: धनुष्मान् कवची खड्गी रथमारुह्य दंशितः। दिव्यैर्हयवरैर्युक्तमग्निकुण्डात् समुत्थितः॥
en: Armed with bows and swords, clad in amours and ascending a chariot drawn by celestial horses of superior breed, from the hole of the sacrificial fire.

sn: गर्जनिव महामेघो स्थधोघेण वीर्यवान्। सिंहसंहननो वीरः सिंहतुल्यपराक्रमः॥
en: That man endued with strength, whose chariot rattle is like the roar of the large masses of clouds, that hero, who endued with the strength of lions, is capable of slaying a lion;

sn: सिंहोरस्कः सिंहभुजः सिंहवक्षा महाबलः। सिंहगर्जनो वीरः सिंहस्कन्धो महाद्युतिः॥
en: That one of great effulgence and strength who has the heart of a lion, the arms of a lion, the chest of a lion, the roars of a lion as also the shoulders of a lion,

sn: सुभूः सुदंष्ट्रः सुहनुः सुबाहुः सुमुखोऽकृशः। सुजत्रुः सुविशालाक्षः सुपादः सुप्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: That man who has beautiful eyebrows, beautiful teeth, beautiful cheeks, beautiful arms, beautiful face, beautiful feet and beautiful frame of body,

sn: अभेद्यः सर्वशस्त्राणां प्रभिन्न इव वारणः। जज्ञे द्रोणविनाशाय सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Who can not be pierced by any weapon, like an infuriated elephant-this one, a speaker of truth, and a restrainer of his senses, was born for slaying Drona.

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नमहं मन्ये सहेद् भीष्मस्य सायकान्। वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शान् दीप्तास्यानुरगानिव॥
en: I think that this Dhrishtadyumra will be able to withstand the arrows of Bhishma, which strike with the force the thunderbolt and which look like blazing serpents,

sn: यमदूतसमान् वेगे निपाते पावकोपमान्। रामेणाजौ विषहितान् वज्रनिष्पेषदारुणान्॥
en: Which in force are equal to the messengers of Yama and in causing havoc are like fire and which falling as they do with the heaviness of the thunderbolt could be borne only by Rama.

sn: पुरुषं तं न पश्यामि यः सहेत महाव्रतम्। धृष्टद्युम्नमृते राजनिति मे धीयते मतिः॥
en: That man I do not see who can withstand that one of great vows (Bhishma) save and except Dhrishtadyumna, o king; and such is my opinion.

sn: क्षिप्रहस्तश्चित्रयोधी मत: सेनापतिर्मम। अभेद्यकवचः श्रीमान् मातङ्ग इव यूथपः॥
en: In my opinion this warrior, who is like the chief elephant of a herd, and endued with prosperity, lightness of hand, clad in a coat of mail that cannot be pierced, well versed in the use of all weapons, should be my commander,

sn: भीमसेन उवाच वधार्थं यः समुत्पन्नः शिखण्डी दुपदात्मजः। वदन्ति सिद्धा राजेन्द्र ऋषयश्च समागताः॥
en: Bhimasena said That Shikhandin, the son of Drupada who is born for the destruction ((of Bhishma) as it is used to be said, O chief among kings, by the assembled Siddhas and Rishis,

sn: यस्य संग्राममध्ये तु दिव्यमस्त्रं प्रकुर्वतः। रूपं द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुरुषा रामस्येव महात्मनः॥
en: Whose form in the midst of the fight, while displaying celestial weapons, people will see to be like that of the great-souled Rama (should be the commander).

sn: न तं युद्धे प्रपश्यामि यो भिन्द्यात् तु शिखण्डिनम्। शस्त्रेण समरे राजन् संनद्धं स्यन्दने स्थितम्॥
en: I do not see that man who could in battle subjugate Shikhandin while under arms, O king, and seated on his chariot clad in mail.

sn: द्वैरथे समरे नान्यो भीष्मं हन्यान्महाव्रतम्। शिखण्डिनमृते वीरं स मे सेनापतिर्मतः॥
en: In hand single combat, no one save Shikhandin could slay that hero, Bhishma, of great vows and it is my opinion that he should be our general.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सर्वस्य जगतस्तात् सारासारं बलाबलम्। सर्वं जानाति धर्मात्मा मतमेषां च केशवः॥
en: Yudhishthira said The truth or untruth, the strength and weakness of the entire world, my dear, brothers and the minds of these, the great souled Keshava knows.

sn: यमाह कृष्णो दाशार्हः सोऽस्तु सेनापतिर्ममा कृतास्त्रोऽष्यकृतास्त्रो वा वृद्धो वा यदि वा युवा।।३४।
en: He, whom Krishna, of the Dasharha race, will name, should be my general whether he is a master in the use of weapons or otherwise or whether he is old or young.

sn: एष नो विजये मूलमेष तात विपर्यये। अत्र प्राणाश्च राज्यं च भावाभावौ सुखासुखे॥
en: He, my dear brothers, in the root of our victory or our defeat and on him depend our lives, our kingdom, our success, our want, our happiness and our misery.

sn: एष धाता विधाता च सिद्धिरत्र प्रतिष्ठिता। यमाह कृष्णो दाशार्हः सोऽस्तु नो वाहिनीपतिः॥
en: He is the lord he is the ordainer and on him depends success and let him, who is named by Krishna of the Dasharha race, be the leader of my forces.

sn: ब्रवीतु वदतां श्रेष्ठो निशा समभिवर्तते। ततः सेनापतिं कृत्वा कृष्णस्य वशवर्तिनः॥
en: Let the foremost of speakers speak, for it is now almost night; having selected our general, under the guidance of Krishna,

sn: रात्रेः शेषे व्यतिक्रान्ते प्रयास्यामो रणाजिरम्। अधिवासितशस्त्राश्च कृतकौतुकमङ्गलाः॥
en: We shall at the end of this night march to the field of battle after having worshipped our weapons and duly performed all the auspicious ceremonies.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा धर्मराजस्य धीमतः। अब्रवीत् पुण्डरीकाक्षो धनंजयमवेक्ष्य ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing those words of the wise and virtuous king, the one of lotus eyes said looking on Dhananjaya.

sn: ममाप्येते महाराज भवद्भिर्य उदाहृताः। नेतारस्तव सेनाया मता विक्रान्तयोधिनः॥
en: In my opinion too, O great king, these powerful warriors who have been named by you, should be the leaders of your army.

sn: सर्वं एवं समर्था हि तव शत्रु प्रबाधितुम्। इन्द्रस्यापि भयं ह्येते जनयेयुर्महाहवे॥
en: All of them are competent to withstand your enemies and they will beget fear in even Indra in the great war,

sn: किं पुनर्धार्तराष्ट्राणां लुब्धानां पापचेतसाम्। मयाऽपि हि महाबाहो त्वत्प्रियार्थं महाहवे॥
en: What to speak of those sons of Dhritarashtra of wicked heart who are acting from covetousness. By me too, O you of long arms, has been taken great pains for your benefit in the forth-coming great war.

sn: कृतो यत्नो महांस्तत्र शमः स्यादिति भारत। धर्मस्य गतमानृण्यं न स्म वाच्या विवक्षताम्॥
en: With that view, I have taken great pains so that there might be peace, O Bharata, and we have thus paid off the debt we owned to virtue and can besides not be blamed by fault-finding persons.

sn: कृतास्त्रं मन्यते बाल आत्मानमविचक्षणः। धार्तराष्ट्रो बलस्थं च पश्यत्यात्मानमातुरः॥
en: That boy thinks himself wise and a master in the use of weapons, and though the son of Dhritarashtra considers himself strong yet in reality he is weak.

sn: युज्यतां वाहिनी साधु वधसाध्या हि मे मताः। न धार्तराष्ट्राः शक्ष्यन्ति स्थातुं दृष्ट्वा धनंजयम्॥
en: Array your troops for battle for in my opinion it is possible to slay them. The son of Dhritarashtra will not be able to continue in their present attitude after seeing Dhananjaya.

sn: भीमसेनं च संक्रुद्धं यमौ चापि यमोपमौ। युयुधानद्वितीयं च धृष्टद्युम्नममर्षणम्॥
en: As also when he sees Bhimasena excited with anger, and the twins who are like Yama himself and the wrathful Dhrishtadyumna having Yuyudhana for his second,

sn: अभिमन्युं द्रौपदेयान् विराटदुपदावपि। अक्षौहिणीपतींश्चान्यान् नरेन्द्रान् भीमविक्रमान्॥
en: And Abhimanyu and the sons of Draupadi and Virata and Drupada and other chiefs of men of fierce strength, each the commander of an Akshauhini.

sn: सारवद् बलमस्माकं दुष्प्रधर्षं दुरासदम्। धार्तराष्ट्रबलं संख्ये हनिष्यति न संशयः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नमहं मन्ये सेनापतिमरिंदम।
en: Our army has great strength and is besides hard to vanquish and is hard to withstand and I think that in the battle will slay the army of the son of Dhritarashtra-there is no doubt about it. O chastiser of foes, I consider that Dhrishtadyumna should be our general.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ते तु कृष्णेन सम्प्राहृष्यन्नरोत्तमाः॥ तेषां प्रहृष्टमनसां नादः समभवन्महान्।
en: Vaishampayana said Krishna having said this all those best among men were highly rejoiced and there was a great shout sent up by these whose minds had been made cheerful.

sn: योग इत्यथ सैन्यानां त्वरतां सम्प्रधावताम्॥ हयवारणशब्दाश्च नेमिघोषाश्च सर्वतः।
en: There was a speedy moving about among the soldiers all crying "Dravup" and there was everywhere the roar of elephants, the neighing of horses and the clatter of the wheels of the chariots.

sn: शङ्खदुन्दुभिघोषाश्च तुमुलाः सर्वतोऽभवन्॥ तदुग्रं सागरनिभं क्षुब्धं बलसमागमम्।
en: There was everywhere a loud uproar caused by the sounds of conches and of drums, and the assembling of that army caused a din like that of the sea in a tempest.

sn: रथपत्तिगजोदग्रं महोर्मिभिरवाकुलम्॥ धावतामाह्वयानानां तनुत्राणि च बनताम्।
en: The army, composed of chariots, infantry and cavalry, with the soldiers running about summoning one another and buckling on their Armour.

sn: प्रयास्यतां पाण्डवानां ससैन्यानां समन्ततः॥ गड्डेव पूर्णा दुर्धर्षा समदृश्यत वाहिनी। अग्रानीके भीमसेनो माद्रीपुत्रौ च दंशितौ॥
en: And the Pandavas moving about, looked like the Ganga troubled by great waves and full to the brim. The army seemed to be hard to vanquish. In front of the army were Bhimasena and the two sons of Madri clad in coats of mail,

sn: सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। प्रभद्रकाश्च पञ्चाला भीमसेनमुखा ययुः॥
en: And the son of Subhadra and the (five) sons of Draupadi and Dhrishtadyumna, the son of Parshata race, the Prabhadrakash and the Panchalas under the leadership of Bhimasena.

sn: ततः शब्दः समभवत् समुद्रस्येव पर्वणि। हृष्टानां सम्प्रयातानां घोषो दिवमिवास्पृशत्॥
en: The sound proceeding from these was like the roar of the sea on the day of the new moon; and the shouts, sent by the cheerful soldiers proceeding along, touched the very heavens as it were.

sn: प्रहृष्टा दंशिता योधाः परानीकविदारणाः। तेषां मध्ये ययौ राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The cheerful soldiers, clad in coats of mail, were capable of piercing the hostile armies and in the midst of those went Yudhishthira the son of Kunti,

sn: शकटापणवेशाश्च यानयुग्यं च सर्वशः। कोशं यन्त्रायुधं चैव ये च वैद्याश्चिकित्सकाः॥
en: With carts and transport cars, and all descriptions of vehicles, the treasury, weapons and machines and physicians and surgeons,

sn: फल्गु यच्च बलं किंचिद् यच्चापि कृशदुर्बलम्। तत् संगृह्य ययौ राजा ये चापि परिचारकाः॥
en: The few invalids that there were in the army and all those that were weak and powerless-taking all these the king went with those that served him as attendants.

sn: उपप्लव्ये तु पाञ्चाली द्रौपदी सत्यवादिनी। सह स्त्रीभिर्निववृते दासीदाससमावृता॥
en: The truthful princess of Panchali, the daughter of Drupada in company with other ladies and surrounded by servant and maids remained at Upaplavya.

sn: कृत्वा मूलप्रतीकारं गुल्मैः स्थावरजङ्गमः। स्कन्धावारेण महता प्रययुः पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥
