sn: वज्रादीनि च मुख्यानि नानाप्रहरणानि च। दानवानां सहस्राणि हिरण्यपुरवासिनाम्॥
en: And several foremost weapons for attack, the thunderbolt. Thousands of Danavas living in Hiranyapura,

sn: हतान्येकरथेनाजौ कस्तस्य सदृशो रथः। एष हन्याद्धि संरम्भी बलवान् सत्यविक्रमः॥
en: Where slain by him riding on a single chariot. What car-warrior is there who can be equal to him? Endued with wrath, strong and of true prowess the one of long arms will slay,

sn: तव सेनां महाबाहुः स्वां चैव परिपालयन्। अहं चैनं प्रत्युदियामाचार्यो वा धनंजयम्॥
en: Your army, protecting his own. Myself or the preceptor can advance against this Dhananjaya.

sn: न तृतीयोऽस्ति राजेन्द्र सेनयोरुभयोरपि। य एनं शरवर्षाणि वर्षन्तमुदियाद् रथी।॥
en: There is no third car-warrior, O chief among kings, in both these armies who can advance against him while he pours showers of amrows.

sn: जीमूत इव धर्मान्ते महावातसमीरितः। समायुक्तस्तु कौन्तेयो वासुदेवसहायवान्। तरुणश्च कृती चैव जीर्णावावामुभावपि॥
en: Showing arrows like clouds at the close of the hot season urged by mighty winds the son of Kunti, having Vasudeva for his ally, is waiting for battle. He is young and experienced while both of us are worn out.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु भीष्मस्य राज्ञां दध्वंसिरे तदा। काञ्चनाङ्गदिन: पीना भुजाश्चन्दनरूषिताः॥ मनोभिः सह संवेगैः संस्मृत्य च पुरातनम्। सामर्थ्यं पाण्डवेयानां यथा प्रत्यक्षदर्शनात्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words of Bhishma and at the time recollecting with their trembling hearts the old might of the sons of Pandu they had themselves witnessed, the fleshly arms, of those kings pasted with sandal, hang down shorn of prowess.

sn: भीष्म उवाच द्रौपदेया महाराज सर्वे पञ्च महारथाः। वैराटिरुत्तरचैव रथोदारो मतो मम॥
en: Bhishma said O great king, all the five sons of Draupadi are Maharathas. The son of Virata, Uttara is also a mighty Ratha; such is my opinion.

sn: अभिमन्युर्महाबाहू रथयूथपयूथपः। समः पार्थेन समरे वासुदेवेन चारिहा॥
en: Abhimanyu, of long arms, is a leader of commanders of groups of chariots and that slayer of enemies is equal in battle to the son of Pritha or Vasudeva,

sn: लब्धास्त्रश्चित्रयोधी च मनस्वी च दृढव्रतः। संस्मरन् वै परिक्लेशं स्वपितुर्विक्रमिष्यति॥
en: Quick in the use of arms, capable of using diverse weapons, spirited and of firm vows, he will show forth his prowess today remembering the sufferings of his father.

sn: सात्यकिर्माधवः शूरो रथयूथपयूथपः। एष वृष्णिप्रवीराणाममर्षी जितसाध्वसः॥
en: The hero, Satyaki of the race of Madhu, is a leader of commanders of groups of chariots. He is wrathful among the heroes of the Vrishni race and has conquered fear.

sn: उत्तमौजास्तथा राजन् रथोदारो मतो मम। युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्तो रतोदारो मतो मम॥
en: In the same way, O king, Uttamaujas is a mighty Ratha is my opinion; and the powerful Yudhishthira too is a mighty Ratha.

sn: एतेषां बहुसाहस्रा रथा नागा हयास्तथा। योत्स्यन्ते तनुंस्त्यक्त्वा कुन्तीपुत्रप्रियेप्सया॥
en: Many thousand chariots, elephants and horses of these will fight, casting away all hopes of life, with the desire of securing the interests of the sons of Kunti,

sn: पाण्डवैः सह राजेन्द्र तव सेनासु भारत। अग्निमारुतवद् राजन्नाह्वयन्तः परस्परम्॥
en: United with the sons of Pandu, O chief among kings, O Bharata, they will sweep through your army like fire and wind challenging them.

sn: अजेयौ समरे वृद्धौ विराटदुपदौ तथा। महारथौ महावीर्यो मतौ मे पुरुषर्षभौ॥
en: The two, Virata and Drupada, invincible and experienced in battle. They are are great car-warriors and these two foremost among men are endued with great energy.

sn: वयोवृद्धावपि हि तौ क्षत्रधर्मपरायणौ। यतिष्येते परं शक्त्या स्थितौ वीरगते पथि।॥
en: Though old in age they observe the duties of Kshatriya order and they will try, with all their might, to stay in the path walked over by heroes.

sn: सम्बन्धकेन राजेन्द्र तौ तु वीर्यबलान्वयात्। आर्यवृत्तौ महेष्वासौ स्नेहवीर्यसितावुभौ॥
en: Owing to their relationship with the Pandavas, O chief among king, those two great bowmen will get an increase of their energy.

sn: कारणं प्राप्य तु नरा: सर्व एव महाभुजाः। शूरा वा कातरा वापि भवन्ति कुरुपुङ्गव॥
en: All men of long arms become heroes or cowards, O foremost among the Kurus, according to the cause for which they fight.

sn: एकायनगतावेतौ पार्थिवौ दृढधन्विनौ। प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा परं शक्त्या घट्टितारो परंतप॥
en: These two rulers, of the earth, of firm grasp on the bow, with a singleness of purpose, will try with all their might, casting off all desire for life, in slaying your troops, O chastiser of foes.

sn: पृथगक्षौहिणीभ्यां तावुभौ संयति दारुणौ। सम्बन्धिभावं रक्षन्तौ महत् कर्म करिष्यतः॥
en: Each, at the head of their separate Akshauhini, will make fierce attempt and observing the duties of the relationship they will do great deeds.

sn: लोकवीरौ महेष्वासौ त्यक्तात्मानौ च भारत। प्रत्ययं परिरक्षन्तौ महत् कर्म करिष्यतः॥
en: The two heroes among men, the mighty bowmen, disregarding their lives, O Bharata, will perform great deeds making good the trust.

sn: भीष्म उवाच पञ्चालराजस्य सुतो राजन् परपुरंजयः। शिखण्डि रथमुख्यो मे मतः पार्थस्य भारत॥
en: Bhishma said The son of the king of Panchala, that conqueror of enemy's cities, Shikhandin is one of the foremost of Rathas on the side of the son of Pritha, in my opinion, O Bharata.

sn: एष योत्स्यति संग्रामे नाशयन् पूर्वसंस्थितम्। परं यशो विप्रथयंस्तव सेनासु भारत॥
en: He will fight in battle destroying what he was before (a woman) and earning great fame in your army, O Bharata.

sn: एतस्य बहुलाः सेनाः पञ्चालाश्च प्रभद्रकाः। तेनासौ रथवंशेन महत् कर्म करिष्यति॥
en: His large army consists of the Panchalas and the Prabhadrakas and with the help of these groups of cars he will do great deeds.

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नश्च सेनानीः सर्वसेनासु भारत। मतो मेऽतिरथो राजन् द्रोणशिष्यो महारथः॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna, the leader of all the (Pandava) armies, O Bharata, that great carwarrior, the pupil of Drona, is also an Atiratha, in my opinion, O king.

sn: एष योत्स्यति संग्रामे सूदयन् वै परान् रणे। भगवानिव संक्रुद्धः पिनाकी युगसंक्षये॥
en: He will fight in the battle destroying the enemies in the fight like the wrathful god, bearing the Pinaka at the time of the universal destruction.

sn: एतस्य तदु स्थानीकं कथयन्ति रणाप्रियाः। बहुत्वात् सागरप्रख्यं देवानामिव संयुगे॥
en: Those, who are fond of fights, will speak of the chariot arrangement of his army resembling that of the very gods engaged in battle and as also the ocean in its numerical strength. son

sn: क्षत्रधर्मा तु राजेन्द्र मतो मेऽर्धरथो नृप। धृष्टद्युम्नस्य तनयो बाल्यानातिकृतश्रमः॥
en: The of Dhrishtadyumna, Kshatradharman, O chief among kings, is in my opinion only half a Ratha, O ruler of men, owing to his youth and want of training.

sn: शिशुपालसुतो वीश्चेदिराजो महारथः। धृष्टकेतुर्महेष्वासः सम्बन्धी पाण्डवस्य ह॥
en: Dhrishtaketu, the king of the Chedis, the son of Shishupala, is a Maharatha and is also a mighty bowman; besides he is related to the Pandu king.

sn: एष चेदिपतिः शूरः सह पुत्रेण भारत। महारथानां सुकरं महत् कर्म करिष्यति॥
en: This hero, the king of the Chedis, along with his son, O Bharata, will do great deeds which can be done by Maharathas alone.

sn: क्षत्रधर्मरतो मह्यं मतः परपुरंजयः। क्षत्रदेवस्तु राजेन्द्र पाण्डवेषु रथोत्तमः॥
en: Kshatradharman, in my opinion, O king, is a conquerror of the enemies towns, and Kshatradeva, O chief of kings, is the best of Rathas among the Pandavas.

sn: जयन्तश्चामितौजाश्च सत्यजिच्च महारथः। महारथा महात्मानः सर्वे पाञ्चालसत्तमाः॥
en: All those best among the Panchalas, namely Jayanta, Amitauja and the mighty carwarrior Satyajit are Maharathas and have great souls.

sn: योत्स्यन्ते समरे तात संरब्धा इव कुञ्जराः। अजो भोजश्च विक्रान्तौ पाण्डवार्थं महारथौ॥
en: They will fight in the battle, my dear son, like infuriated elephants. The two powerful men, Aja and Bhoja, in the side of the Pandavas, are Maharathas.

sn: योत्स्येते बलिनौ शूरौ परं शक्त्या क्षयिष्यतः। शीघ्रास्त्राश्चित्रयोद्धारः कृतिनो दृढविक्रमाः॥
en: The two powerful heroes will fight with all their might and the two, who are quick in arms, who can fight with diverse weapons, are skillful and of firm strength will mete out destruction.

sn: केकयाः पञ्च राजेन्द्रः भ्रातरो दृढविक्रमाः। सर्वे चैव रथोदाराः सर्वे लोहितकध्वजाः॥
en: The five brothers, the Kaikeyas, O chief among kings, are of great prowess. All of them are mighty car-warriors and all of them have blood-red banners.

sn: काशिकः सुकुमारश्च नीलो यश्चापरो नृप। सूर्यदत्तश्च शङ्खश्च मदिराश्वश्च नामतः॥
en: Kashika, Sukumara, and the other ruler of men Nila and Suryadatta and Shankha and he who goes by the name of Madirashva,

sn: सर्व एव रथोदाराः सर्वे चाहवलक्षणाः। सर्वास्त्रविदुषः सर्वे महात्मानो मता मम॥
en: All of these are mighty car-warriors and possessed of every accomplishment that goes towards making a good soldier, conversant with all sciences, and in my opinion large souled.

sn: वार्धक्षेमिर्महाराज मतो मम महारथः। चित्रायुधश्च नृपतिर्मतो मे रथसत्तमः॥
en: Vardhakshemi, O great king, in my opinion, is a Maharatha; that ruler of men can fight with diverse weapons and is the best of car-warriors in my opinion.

sn: स हि संग्रामशोभी च भक्तश्चापि किरीटिनः। चेकितानः सत्यधृति पाण्डवानां महारथौ। द्वाविमौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ रथोदारौ मतौ मम॥
en: He is an ornament in battle and an admirer of Arjuna. Chekitana and Satyadhriti are two Maharathies, among the Pandavas and these two foremost of men are mighty car-warriors in my opinion.

sn: व्याघ्रदत्तश्च राजेन्द्र चन्द्रसेनश्च भारत। मतौ मम रथोदारौ पाण्डवानां न संशयः॥
en: Vyaghradatta, O king among kings, and Chandrasena, O Bharata, are in my opinion two Maharathas on the side of the Pandavas, there is no doubt about it.

sn: सेनाबिन्दुश्च राजेन्द्र क्रोधहन्ता च नामतः। यः समो वासुदेवेन भीमसेनेन वा विभो॥
en: Senabindu, O chief among kings, and he who is named 'Krodhahanta who is equal to Vasudeva or Bhimasena, O lord,

sn: स योत्स्यति हि विक्रम्य समरे तव सैनिकैः। मां च द्रोणं कृपं चैव यथा सम्मन्यते भवान्॥
en: Will fight with your soldiers with all his might in the battle. As you think myself Drona and Kripa,

sn: तथा स समरश्लाघी मन्तव्यो रथसत्तमः। काश्यः परमशीघ्रास्त्रः श्लाघनीयो नरोत्तमः॥
en: So should also that best among carwarriors, who is proud of his velour in battle should be thought by you. That best among men Kashya is endued with extreme quickness of hand and is worthy of praise.

sn: रथ एकगुणो मह्यं ज्ञेयः परपुरंजयः। अयं च युधि विक्रान्तो मन्तव्योऽष्टगुणो रथः॥
en: Myself ought to be known as being equal to a single Ratha but this conqueror, of enemies' town who is very powerful in battle, should be regarded as equal to eight times a Ratha.

sn: सत्यजित् समरश्लाघी दुपदस्यात्मजो युवा। गतः सोऽतिरथत्वं हि धृष्टद्युम्नेन सम्मितः॥
en: The youthful son of Drupada, Satyajit, is proud of velour in battle, and being equal to Dhrishtadyumna should be included among the Atirathas.

sn: पाण्डवानां यशस्कामः परं कर्म करिष्यति। अनुरक्तश्च शूरच रथोऽयमपरो महान्।॥
en: Being desirous of the fame of the sons of Pandu he will do great deeds. Here is another great Ratha, a hero who is their follower.

sn: पाण्ड्यराजो महावीर्यः पाण्डवानां धुरंधरः। दृढधन्वा महेष्वासः पाण्डवानां महारथः॥
en: The king Pandya endued with great energy and foremost among the Pandavas. Of firm grasp on the bow is he a Maharatha on the side of the Pandavas.

sn: श्रेणिमान् कौरवश्रेष्ठ वसुदानश्च पार्थिवः। उभावेतावतिरथौ मतौ परपुरंजयौ॥
en: Shrenimat, that foremost among the Kurus, and Vasudeva that ruler of the earth, both of these are Atirathas in my opinion and both are the conquerors of enemy's towns.

sn: भीष्म उवाच रोचमानो महाराज पाण्डवानां महारथः। योत्स्यतेऽमरवत् संख्ये परसैन्येषु भारत॥
en: Bhishma said Rochamana, O great king, is a Maharatha on the side of the Pandavas and in the battle he will fight with the inimical hosts like a god, O Bharata.

sn: पुरुजित् कुन्तिभोजश्च महेष्वासो महाबलः। मातुलो भीमसेनस्य स च मेऽतिरथो मतः॥
en: The conqueror of enemies, Kuntibhoja, that great bowman, endued with great strength, the maternal uncle of Bhimasena too, is an Atiratha, in my opinion.

sn: एष वीरो महेष्वासः कृती च निपुणश्च ह। चित्रयोधी च शक्तश्च मतो मे रथपुङ्गवः॥
en: This hero is a great bowman, is skillful and experienced and can fight with diverse weapons; he is capable too, and in my opinion the foremost of Rathas.

sn: स योत्स्यति हि विक्रम्य मघवानिव दानवैः। योधा ये चास्य विख्याताः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः॥
en: He will fight, showing his prowess like Indra with the Danavas and those who are soldiers under him are well known names and are all well versed in the science of warfare.

sn: भागिनेयकृते वीरः स करिष्यति संगरे। सुमहत् कर्म पाण्डूनां स्थितः प्रियहिते रतः॥
en: For the sake of his nephew the hero will do great deeds in the battle for he is ever on the side of the Pandavas and devoted to their interests.

sn: भैमसेनिर्महाराज हैडिम्बो राक्षसेश्वरः। मतो मे बहुमायावी रथयूथपयूथपः॥
en: That lord of the Rakshasas, the son of Bhimasena, born of Hidimba, is endued with great powers of illusion and in my opinion is a commander of leaders of groups of chariots.

sn: योत्स्यते समरे तात मायावी समरप्रियः। ये चास्य राक्षसा वीराः सचिवा वशवर्तिनः॥
en: The one who has powers of illusions, will fight, my dear son, in battle for he is fond of weapons. Those Rakshasas, too, who follow him, are heroes.

sn: एते चान्ये च बहवो नानाजनपदेश्वराः। समेताः पाण्डवस्यार्थं वासुदेवपुरोगमाः॥
en: These and many other lords of cities have been united together for the sake of the Pandavas headed by Vasudeva.

sn: एते प्राधान्यतो राजन् पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः। स्थाश्चातिस्थाश्चैव ये चान्येऽर्धरथा नृप॥
en: The great souled ones are the chief Rathas, and Atirathas, O king, on the side of the Pandava and these others are only half a Ratha, O ruler of men.

sn: नेष्यन्ति समरे सेनां भीमा यौधिष्ठिरी नृप। महेन्द्रेणेव वीरेण पाल्यमानां किरीटिना॥
en: These will lead the terrible army of Yudhishthira, O ruler of men, protected by Kiritin (Arjuna) as by that hero namely the great Indra.

sn: तैरहं समरे वीर मायाविद्भिर्जयैषिभिः। योत्स्यामि जयमाकाङ्क्षनथवा निधनं रणे॥
en: With them capable of powers of illusion, and actuated by desire for victory shall I fight in battle, O hero, desiring either victory or death in battle.

sn: वासुदेवं च पार्थं च चक्रगाण्डीवधारिणौ। संध्यागताविवार्केन्दू समेष्येते रथोत्तमौ॥
en: I shall fight against those two best among car-warriors, Vasudeva and Partha, wielding respectively the discus and the Gandiva, coming together as the Sun and Moon at the evening.

sn: ये चैव ते रथोदाराः पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकाः। सहसैन्यानहं तांश्च प्रतीयां रणमूर्धनि॥
en: I shall advance also against these who are mighty car-warriors in the army of the son of Pandu along with their armies at the time of battle.

sn: एते स्थाश्चातिरथाश्च तुभ्यं यथाप्रधानं नृप कीर्तिता मया। तथापरे येऽर्धरथाश्च केचित् तथैव तेषामपि कौरवेन्द्र॥
en: These are the more notable Rathas and Atirathas as has been described in due order by me to you, as also these others who are only half Rathas, O chief among the Kauravas.

sn: अर्जुनं वासुदेवं च ये चान्ये तत्र पार्थिवाः। सर्वांस्तान् वारयिष्यामि यावद् द्रक्ष्यामि भारत॥
en: Arjuna and Vasudeva and all those rulers of the earth that are on that side, I shall stand against, O Bharata.

sn: पाञ्चाल्यं तु महाबाहो नाहं हन्यां शिखण्डिनम्। उद्यतेषुमथो दृष्ट्वा प्रतियुध्यन्तमाहवे॥
en: But, O you of long arms, I shall not slay Shikhandin, the prince of Panchala even though I see him advancing against me ready to strike.

sn: लोकस्तं वेद यदहं पितुः प्रियचिकीर्षया। प्राप्तं राज्यं परित्यज्य ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितः॥
en: The word knows the fact that I desirous of doing what was agreeable to my father, abandoned a kingdom which I had obtained and observed the vow of Brahmacharya.

sn: चित्राङ्गदं कौरवाणामाधिपत्येऽभ्यषेचयम्। विचित्रवीर्यं च शिशुं यौवराज्येऽभ्यषेचयम्॥
en: I installed Chitrangada in the lordship over the Kauravas and also installed the infant Vichitravirya as the heir presumptive,

sn: देवव्रतत्वं विज्ञाप्य पृथिवीं सर्वराजसु! नैव हन्यां स्त्रियं जातु न स्त्रीपूर्वं कदाचन॥
en: Having proclaimed my religious vows among all the kings in the earth, “I shall never slay a woman or one that has been a woman.”

sn: स हि स्त्रीपूर्वको राजन् शिखण्डी यदि ते कन्या भूत्वा पुमान् जातो न योत्स्ये तेन भारत।॥
en: That Shikhandin, Oking, has formerly been a woman, perhaps you have heard of it; being originally a female he afterwards became a male and I shall not fight with him, O Bharata.

sn: श्रुतः। सर्वांस्त्वन्यान् हनिष्यामि पार्थावान् भरतर्षभ यान् समेष्यामि समरे न तु कुन्तीसुतान् नृप॥
en: all other rulers of the earth, I shall slay, O foremost among the Bharatas, those whom I meet in battle, but not the son of Kunti, O ruler of men.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: दुर्योधन उवाच किमर्थं भरतश्रेष्ठ नैव हन्याः शिखण्डिनम्। उद्यतेषुमथो दृष्ट्वा समरेष्वाततायिनम्॥
en: Duryodhana said For what reason, ( chief among the Bharatas, will you not slay Shikhandin even though you see him ready to strike you in battle.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: पूर्वमुक्त्वा महाबाहो पञ्चालान् सह सोमकैः। हनिष्यामीति गाङ्गेय तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामहः॥
en: You said before, O you of long arms: I shall slay the Panchalas with the Somakas. O son of Ganga, tell me how is this, O grand father.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: भीष्म उवाच शृणु दुर्योधन कथां सहैभिर्वसुधाधिपः। यदर्थं युधि सम्प्रेक्ष्य नाहं हन्यां शिखण्डिनम्॥३।
en: Bhishma said Listen, O Duryodhana, to that story along with these rulers of the universe, namely the reason for which I shall not slay Shikhandin even though I see him in battle.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: महाराजो मम पिता शान्तनुर्लोकविश्रुतः। दिष्टान्तमाप धर्मात्मा समये भरतर्षभ॥
en: 0 great king, my father the virtuoussouled Shantanu, well known in this world, went the way of the world in due time, O best among the Bharatas.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: ततोऽहं भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रतिज्ञां परिपालयन्। चित्राङ्गदं भ्रातरं वै महाराज्येऽभ्यषेचयम्॥
en: Then did I, O chief among the Bharatas, observing my vows, install my brother Chitrangada on the throne.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: तस्मिंश्च निधनं प्राप्ते सत्यवत्या मते स्थितः। विचित्रवीर्यं राजानमभ्यषिञ्च यथाविधि॥
en: He too being dead, following the wishes of Satyavati 1 duly appointed Vichitravirya in the kingship.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: मयाभिषिक्तो राजेन्द्र यवीयानपि धर्मतः। विचित्रवीर्यो धर्मात्मा मामेव समुदैक्षत॥
en: Installed by me, O chief among kings, my younger brother the virtuous souled Vichitravirya looked up to me in everything.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: तस्य दारक्रियां तात चिकीर्षुरहमप्युत। अनुरूपादिव कुलादित्येव च मनो दधे॥
en: I, too being desirous of getting his wives, set my heart on procuring suitable girls from good families.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: तथाऽश्रौषं महाबाहो तिस्रः कन्याः स्वयंवराः। रूपेणाप्रतिमाः सर्वाः काशिराजसुतास्तदा।
en: At the time, I heard, O you of long arms, that these were three girls, the daughters of the king of the Kashis going to elect bridegrooms, all of whom were unrivaled in beauty.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: अम्बां चैवाम्बिकां चैव तथैवाम्बालिकामपि॥ राजानश्च समाहूताः पृथिव्यां भरतर्षभ। अम्बा ज्येष्ठाभवत् तासामम्बिकात्वथ मध्यमा॥
en: They were Amba, Ambika, and Ambalika and all the rulers of the earth were invited, O foremost of the Bharatas. Amba was the elder among them, Ambika the second,

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: अम्बालिका च राजेन्द्र राजकन्या यवीयसी। सोऽहमेकरथेनैव गतः काशिपतेः पुरीम्॥
en: And Ambalika, O chief among kings, was the youngest princess. Then did I on a single chariot, go to the capital of the king of the Kashis,

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: अपश्यं ता महाबाहो तिस्रः कन्या: स्वलंकृताः। राज्ञश्चैव समाहूतान् पार्थिवान् पृथिवीपते॥
en: And saw, O you of long arms, the three girls with their persons ornamented and the kings of the carth who were invited, O lord of the world

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: ततोऽहं तान् नृपान् सर्वानाहूय समरे स्थितान्। रथमारोपयांचने कन्यास्ता भरतर्षभ॥
en: Then did I, challenging all those rulers of the earth to fight, carried by force, the girls to my chariot, O best of the Bharatas.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: वीर्यशुल्काश्च ता ज्ञात्वा समारोप्य रथं तदा। अवोचं पार्थिवान् सर्वानहं तत्र समागतान्।
en: Knowing that prowess constituted their dower, I took them over to my chariot and said to all those rulers of the earth who were assembled there.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: भीष्मः शान्तनवः कन्या हरतीति पुनः पुनः॥ ये यतध्वं परं शक्त्या सर्वे मोक्षाय पार्थिवाः। प्रसह्य हि हराम्येष मिषतां वो नरर्षभाः॥
en: Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, again and again takes these girls away by force; try, 0 rulers of the earth, with all your might to liberate them. By force do I take them away, O best among men, in your very sight,

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: ततस्ते पृथिवीपालाः समुत्पेतुरुदायुधाः। योगो योग इति क्रुद्धाः सारथीनभ्यचोदयन्॥
en: Then did those lords of the earth rise up with weapons open and wrathfully they urged their drivers, saying, “Make ready the cars, make ready the cars."

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: ते स्थैर्गजसंकाशैर्गजैश्च गजयोधिनः। पुष्टैश्चाश्चैर्महीपालाः समुत्पेतुरुदायुधाः॥
en: Then did they rise up with weapons ready, car-warriors on chariots resembling herds of elephant-warriors on elephants and others ruler of the earth on plump horses.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: ततस्ते मां महीपाला: सर्व एवं विशाम्पते। रथवातेन महता सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Then did all those rulers of the earth, O lord of the universe, surround me on an all sides with a large troupe of chariots.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: तानहं शरवर्षेण समन्तात् पर्यवारयम्। सर्वान् नृपांश्चाप्यजयं देवराडिव दानवान्॥
en: Then, with a shower of arrows I arrested their rush and vanquished all those rulers of the earth like of the gods vanquishing the Danavas.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: अपातयं शरैर्दीप्तैः प्रहसन् भरतर्षभ। तेषामापततां चित्रान् ध्वजान् हेमपरिष्कृतान्॥
en: By blazing arrows did I laughingly fell down their diverse banners ornamented with gold, O best among the Bharatas.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: एकैकेन हि बाणेन भूमौ पातितवानहम्। हयांस्तेषां गजांश्चैव सारथींचाप्यहं रणे॥
en: By one arrow did I lay each to the ground with their horses, elephants, and drivers in battle.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: ते निवृत्ताश्च भग्नाश्च दृष्ट्वा तल्लाघवं मम। अथाहं हास्तिनपुरमायां जित्वा महीक्षितः॥
en: Seeing that lightness of hand on my part, they broke up and turned back and vanquishing those kings I came to the city called after the elephant.

description: Duryodhana enquires of Bhishma's refusal to strike Shikhandin
sn: ततोऽहं ताश्च कन्या वै भ्रातुरर्थाय भारत। तच्च कर्म महाबाहो सत्यवत्यै न्यवेदयम्॥
en: Then did I make over, O Bharata, those girls to my brother, and submitted that deed, O you of long arms, to Satyavati for information.

sn: भीष्म उवाच ततोऽहं भरतश्रेष्ठ मातरं वीरमातरम्। अभिगम्योपसंगृह्य दाशेयीमिदमब्रुवम्॥
en: Bhishma said Approaching then, chief among the Bharatas, my mother, the mother of heroes, who was the daughter of the Dasha race and saluting her I said these words.

sn: इमाः काशिपतेः कन्या मया निर्जत्य पार्थिवान्। विचित्रवीर्यस्य कृते वीर्यशुल्का हृता इति।॥
en: These daughters, of the king of the Kashis having prowess for their dower, have been taken away by me after vanquishing the ruler of the earth.

sn: ततो मूर्धन्युपाघ्राय पर्यश्रुनयना नृप। आह सत्यवती हृष्टा दिष्ट्या पुत्र जितं त्वया।॥
en: Then smelling my head, with eyes full of tears Satyavati cheerfully said to me. “By luck you have conquered them, my son."

sn: सत्यवत्यास्त्वनुमते विवाहे समुपस्थिते। उवाच वाक्यं सव्रीडा ज्येष्ठा काशिपतेः सुता॥
en: The wedding day fixed by permission of Satyavati being near at hand the eldest of the girls of the king of Kashis said these words with modesty.

sn: भीष्म त्वमसि धर्मज्ञः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः। श्रुत्वा च वचनं धर्म्यं मह्यं कर्तुमिहार्हसि॥
en: O Bhishma, you are conversant with virtue and all sciences and it is proper that you should do the right thing after hearing me.

sn: मया शाल्वपतिः पूर्वं मनसाऽभिवृतो वरः। तेन चास्मि वृता पूर्वं रहस्यविदिते पितुः॥
en: By me was the king of the Shalvas chosen as my bridegroom in my mind and by him before was I selected (as his future wife) in private, unknown to my father.

sn: कथं माम न्यकामां त्वं राजधर्ममतीत्य वै। वासयेथा गृहे भीष्म कौरवः सन् विशेषतः॥
en: How, O king, acting against the dictates of virtue will you make me, who am desirous of being united with another, reside in your household, O Bhishma, especially born as you are in the Kaurava race.

sn: एतद् बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य मनसा भरतर्षभ। यत् क्षमं ते महाबाहो तदिहारब्धुमर्हसि॥
en: Setting, in your mind, something suitable to this turn of affairs, 0 best among the Bharatas, it is proper that you should do what you can for me, O you of long arms.

sn: स मां प्रतिक्षते व्यक्तं शाल्वराजो विशाम्पते। तस्मान्मां त्वं कुरुश्रेष्ठ समनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: It is evident, O lord of the universe, that the king of the Shalvas is expecting me; it is proper for you therefore to permit me to go, O foremost among the Kurus.

sn: कृपां कुरु महाबाहो मयि धर्मभृतां वर। त्वं हि सत्यव्रतो वीर पृथिव्यामित नः श्रुतम्॥
en: Act towards me with kindness, O you of long arms, O foremost among the supporters of virtue. It has been heard by us that you are a hero of truthful vows in this world.

sn: भीष्म उवाच ततोऽहं समनुज्ञाप्य काली गन्धवतीं तदा। मन्त्रिणचर्विजश्चैव तथैव च पुरोहितान्॥
en: Bhishma said Then did I, submitted the matter before our advisers, priests and spiritual guides,

sn: समनुज्ञासिषं कन्यामम्बां ज्येष्ठां नराधिप। अनुज्ञाता ययौ सा तु कन्या शाल्वपतेः पुरम्॥
en: Grant that eldest among the girls, Amba to go away, 0 ruler of men; and the girl too, obtaining the permission, went to the capital of the king of the Shalvas.

sn: वृद्धैर्द्विजातिभिर्गुप्ता धात्र्या चानुगता तदा। अतीत्य च तमध्वानमासाद्य नृपति तथा॥
en: She was escorted by old twice born men and followed by maid servants; and after traveling the whole distance she reached the presence of that king.

sn: सा तमासाद्य राजानं शाल्वं वचनमब्रवीत्। आगताऽहं महाबाहो त्वामुद्दिश्य महामते॥
en: She, going to the king of the “Shalvas, said these words:-"I have come, O you of long arms, expecting to be united with you, O you of great intelligence."

sn: तामब्रवीच्छाल्वपतिः स्मयन्निव विशाम्पते। त्वयान्यपूर्वया नाहं भार्यार्थी वरवर्णिनि॥
en: The king of the Shalvas, however said to him with a laughter, O lord of the universe, "O you of good complexion, I do not desire to take you for my wife for you had before been taken by another.

sn: गच्छ भद्रे पुनस्तत्र सकाशंभीष्मकस्य वै। नाहमिच्छामि भीष्मेण गृहीतां त्वां प्रसह्य वै॥
en: Go therefore, gentle lady, again to Bhishma. I dot desire to have you who had been taken away by Bhishma by force.

sn: त्वं हि भीष्मेण निर्जित्य नीता प्रीतिमती तदा। परामृश्य महायुद्धे निर्जित्य पृथिवीपतीन्॥
en: At that time were you cheerfully led away by Bhishma who vanquished all the kings.

sn: नाहं त्वय्यन्यपूर्वायां भार्यार्थी वरवर्णिनि। कथमस्मद्विधो राजा परपूर्वां प्रवेशयेत्॥
en: O you of fair complexion, I do not desire as my wife, yourself who had been accepted by another, for how can a king like us accept a girl

sn: नारी विदितविज्ञानः परेषां धर्ममादिशन्। यथेष्टं गम्यतां भद्रे मा त्वां कालोऽत्यगादयम्॥
en: A king, who is familiar with every science and who lays down laws for others. Go wherever you please, gentle lady, and do not waste your time.”

sn: अम्बा तमब्रवीद् राजन्ननङ्गशरपीडिता। नैवं वद महीपाल नैतदेवं कथंचन॥
en: Amba, being struck with the darts of love, said to that king:-“Do not speak thus, O ruler of the earth, it can not be so by any means.

sn: नास्मि प्रीतिमती नीता भीष्मेणामित्रकर्शन। बलान्नीताऽस्मि रुदती विद्राव्य पृथिवीपतीन्॥
en: Never was I cheerfully led away by Bhishma, O chastiser of enemies. Weeping, I was led away by force after he had vanquished the lords of the earth.

sn: भजस्व मां शाल्वपते भक्ता बालामनागसम्। भक्तानां हि परित्यागो न धर्मेषु प्रशस्यते॥
en: Accept me, O lord of the Shalvas, accept a girl who is innocent. No religion approves of the direction of the devoted.

sn: साऽहमामन्त्र्य गाङ्गेयं समरेष्वनिवर्तिनम्। अनुज्ञाता च तेनैव ततोऽहं भृशमागता॥
en: I have come here without any loss of time after taking leave of the son of Ganga, who never turns back from the field of battle and with his permission.

sn: न स भीष्मो महाबाहुर्मामिच्छति विशाम्पते। भ्रातृहेतोः समारम्भो भीष्मस्येति श्रुतं मया॥
en: That Bhishma of long arms does not want me, O lord of the universe and this exertion of Bhishma is for the sake of his brother, I have heard.

sn: भगिन्यौ मम ये नीते अम्बिकाम्बालिके नृप। प्रादाद् विचित्रवीर्याय गाङ्गेयो हि यवीयसे॥
en: Those two sisters of mine, Ambika, and Ambalika, who had been led away, have been made over by the son of Ganga to his younger brother Vichitravirya.

sn: यथा शाल्वपते नान्यं वरं व्यामि कथंचन। त्वामृते पुरुषव्याघ्र तथा मूर्धानमालभे॥
en: I do not, O lord of the Shalvas, desire any husband save yourself, O foremost among men, I swear by my heart.

sn: न चान्यपूर्वा राजेन्द्र त्वामहं समुपस्थिता। सत्यं ब्रवीमि शाल्वैतत् सत्येनात्मानमालभे॥
en: O chief among kings, I do not come to you as one who has before been ravished by another. I am speaking the truth, O lord of the Shalvas, I swear by my soul and by truth.

sn: भजस्व मां विशालाक्ष स्वयं कन्यामुपस्थिताम्। अनन्यपूर्वां राजेन्द्र त्वत्प्रसादाभिकाक्षिणीम्॥
en: Accept me, O you of big eyes, who am a girl and have come of my own will desirous of your favours, and without having been ravished by another, O chief among kings."

sn: तामेवं भाषमाणां तु शाल्व: काशिपते: सुताम्। अत्यजद् भरतश्रेष्ठ जीर्णां त्वचमिवोरगः॥
en: Shalva however abandoned that daughter of the ruler of the Kashis who spoke thus, O chief among the Bharatas, like a serpent casting off its slough.

sn: एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैर्याच्यमानस्तया नृपः। नाश्रद्दधच्छाल्वपतिः कन्यायां भरतर्षभ।॥
en: The king of the Shalvas did not look graciously on that girl who spoke in this and several other strains.

sn: ततः सा मन्युनाऽऽविष्टा ज्येष्ठा काशिपतेः सुता। अब्रवीत् साश्रुनयना बाष्यविप्लुतया गिरा।॥
en: Then did that eldest daughter of the ruler of the Kashis struck with grief say with eyes bathed in tears in a voice choked with tears.

sn: त्वया त्यक्ता गमिष्यामि यत्र तत्र विशाम्पते। तत्र मे गतयः सन्तु सन्तः सत्यं यथा ध्रुवम्॥
en: Being abandoned by you I shall go wherever I please, O lord of the universe, making the righteous my refuge, for truth is indestructible.

sn: एवं तां भाषमाणां तु कन्यां शाल्वपतिस्तदा। परितत्याज कौरव्य करुणं परिदेवतीम्॥
en: At that time the lord of the Shalvas thus abandoned that girl, O Kaurava, who spoke to him plaintively.

sn: गच्छ गच्छेति तां शाल्वः पुनः पुनरभाषत। बिभेमि भीष्मात् सुश्रोणि त्वं च भीष्मपरिग्रहः॥
en: Shalva said to her again and again “go, go, I fear Bhishma, O you of beautiful hips, for you are Bhishma's capture."

sn: एवमुक्ता तु सा तेन शाल्वेनादीर्घदर्शिना। निश्चक्राम पुराद् दीना रुदती कुररी यथा॥
en: Being thus spoken to by that Shalva of short foresight, she issued out of that city sorrowing, weeping like a she osprey.

sn: भीष्म उवाच निष्क्रामन्ती तु नगराच्चिन्तयामास दुःखिता। पृथिव्यां नास्ति युवतिर्विषमस्थतरा मया॥
en: Bhishma said As she sorrowfully issued out of the capital she thought within herself: “In this world there is no young woman in a more difficult situation than myself.

sn: बन्धुभिर्विप्रहीणास्मि शाल्वेन च निराकृता। न च शक्यं पुनर्गन्तुं मया वारणसाह्वयम्॥
en: I have been robbed of my friends and wronged by Shalva nor am I capable of going back to the city called after the elephant.

sn: अनुज्ञाता तु भीष्मेण शाल्वमुद्दिश्य कारणम्। किं नु गर्हाम्यथात्मानमथ भीष्मं दुरासदम्॥
en: The reason being that I was permitted by Bhishma to leave him with the object of going to Shalva. Whom shall I blame, myself or Bhishma who is hard to be approached,

sn: अथवा पितरं मूढं यो मेऽकार्षीत् स्वयंवरम्। मयाऽयं स्वकृतो दोषो याऽहं भीष्मरथात् तदा॥
en: Or that foolish father who made arrangements for the selection of a husband by myself. It was a fault of mine own that at that time from Bhishma's chariot,

sn: प्रवृत्ते दारुणे युद्धे शाल्वार्थं नापतं पुरा। तस्येयं । ननिर्वृत्तिर्यदापन्नाऽस्मि मूढवत्॥
en: I did not leap down to join Shalva, when Bhishma was engaged in fierce battle. The result of that is this, namely that I have been made a fool of.

sn: धिग् भीष्मं धिक् च मे मन्दं पितरं मूढचेतसम्। येनाहं वीर्यशुल्केन पण्यस्त्रीव प्रचोदिता॥
en: Shame on Bhishma, shame on my idiotic father of foolish heart that fixed velour to be my dower as if I were a woman who could be sold at a price,

sn: धिमां धिक् शाल्वराजानं धिग् धातारमथापि वा। येषां दुर्नीतभावे प्राप्ताऽस्यापदमुत्तमाम्॥
en: Shame on myself, shame on king Shalva, shame also on the creator through whose fault I am now placed in this difficulty.

sn: सर्वथा भागधेयानि स्वानि प्राप्नोति मानवः। अनयस्यास्य तु मुखं भीष्मः शान्तनवो मम॥
en: In all circumstances does a man go through his share of worldly happiness and misery but Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, is the prime cause of this difficulty.

sn: सा भीष्मे प्रतिकर्तव्यमहं पश्यामि साम्प्रतम्। तपसा वा युधा वाऽपि दुःखहेतुः स मतः॥
en: I now see that for the present I should have revenge on that Bhishma either by austerities or by battle, for in my opinion he is the cause of my misery.

sn: को नु भीष्मं युधा चेदुमुत्सहेत महीपतिः। एवं सा परिनिश्चित्य जगाम नगराद् बहिः॥
en: What ruler of the earth would venture to fight with Bhishma." Thinking thus she went out of the city,

sn: आश्रमं पुण्यशीलानां तापसानां महात्मनाम्। ततस्तामवसद् रात्रिं तापसैः परिवारिता॥
en: To a hermitage of a great souled anchorite of virtuous ways of life and she stayed there for the night surrounded by anchorites.

sn: मे आचख्यौ च यथावृत्तं सर्वमात्मनि भारत। विस्तरेण महाबाहो निखिलेन शुचिस्मिता। हरणं च विसर्गं च शाल्वेन च विसर्जनम्॥
en: That lady of sweet smiles told them, everything about herself in due order, O Bharata, in detail, the story of her abduction, her liberation and her abandonment by Shalva.

sn: ततस्तत्र महानासीद् ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः। शैखावत्यस्तपोवृद्धः शास्त्रे चारण्यके गुरुः॥
en: There lived a great Brahmana of rigid vows Shaikhavatya by name, old in devotion and a preceptor of the holy books and the Arariyakas.

sn: आर्ती तामाह स मुनिः शैखावत्यो महातपाः। निःश्वसन्ती सती बालां दुःखशोकपरायणाम्॥
en: That anchorite, of eminent devotion, said to that chaste lady who was in extreme difficuity and who was sighing in grief and distress.

sn: एवं गते तु किं भद्रे शक्यं कर्तुं तपस्विभिः। आश्रमस्थैर्महाभागे तपोयुक्तर्महात्मभिः॥
en: Such being the case, gentle lady, what can be done by devotees residing in this hermitage, of great parts and great souled though they be?

sn: सा त्वेनमब्रवीद् राजन् क्रियतां मदनुग्रहः। प्राव्राज्यमहमिच्छामि तपस्तप्स्यामि दुश्चरम्॥
en: She however thus replied, O king: "Show me this favour. I desire to wander about and to practice hard devotion.

sn: मयैव यानि कर्माणि पूर्वदेहे तु मूढया। कृतानि नूनं पापानि तेषामेतत् फलं ध्रुवम्॥
en: The deeds that had been done by me in a previous life out of folly are certainly misdeeds and this is surely the result of that.

sn: नोत्सहे तु पुनर्गन्तुं स्वजनं प्रति तापसाः। प्रत्याग्याता निरानन्दा शाल्वेन च निराकृता॥
en: I do not venture to go back to my kindred, O devctees, rejected and rendered cheerless and y. nged by Shalva.

sn: उपदिष्टमिहेच्छामि तापस्यं वीतकल्मषाः। युष्माभिर्देवसंकाशैः कृपा भवतु वो मयि॥
en: I wish to be instructed here (in asceticism), O ascetics, whose sins have been washed off by you who are god-like; let kindness be shown to me."

sn: स तामाश्वासयत् कन्यां दृष्टान्तागमहेतुभिः। सान्त्वयामास कार्यं च प्रतिजज्ञे द्विजैः सह॥
en: He then comforted that lady by citing instances and examples and consoled her by promising to do her work along with others among the twice-born.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: भीष्म उवाच ततस्ते तपासाः सर्वे कार्यवन्तोऽभवंस्तदा। तां कन्यां चिन्तयन्तस्ते किं कार्यमिति धर्मिणः॥
en: Bhishma said Then did all those anchorites engage themselves in their respective duties and those virtuous ones thought as to what they should do for that lady.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: केचिदाहुः पितुर्वेश्म नीयतामिति तापसाः। केचिदस्मदुपालम्भे मतिं चक्रुर्हि तापसाः॥
en: Some among them then said “Let us take her to her father's place," and some of the anchorites thought of finding fault with ourselves.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: केचिच्छाल्वपतिं गत्वा नियोज्यमिति मेनिरे। नेति केचिद् व्यवस्यन्ति प्रत्याख्याता हि तेन सा॥
en: Some thought of going to the king of the Shalvas and ask him to accept the girl: some said 'nay' to this proposal for she was rejected by him.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: एवं गते तु किं शक्यं भद्रे कर्तुं मनीषिभिः। पुनरूचुश्च तां सर्वे तापसाः संशितव्रताः॥
en: Then did all those anchorites say again to her:-It being so, gentle lady, what can these anchorites do for you, endued with intelligence and self-control though they are?

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: अलं प्रव्रजितेनेह भद्रे शृणु हितं वचः। इतो गच्छस्व भनं ते पितुरेव निवेशनम्॥
en: There is no need for you to roam about in these woods: Listen to wards that are of benefit to you and go hence to your father's place; may you fare well.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: प्रतिपत्स्यति राजा स पिता ते यदनन्तरम्। तत्र वत्स्यसि कल्याणि सुखं सर्वगुणान्विता॥
en: The king, your father, will do what is proper for you and, O blessed lady, you will live there in happiness, endued with all accomplishments as you are.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: न च तेऽन्या गतिाय्या भवेद् भद्रे यथा पिता। पतिर्वापि गतिर्नार्याः पिता वा वरवर्णिनि॥
en: There is no other proper refuge for you, O gentle lady, save your father; for either the father or the husband is the refuge of a woman, O you or fair complexion.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: गतिः पतिः समस्थाया विषमे च पिता गतिः। प्रव्रज्या हि सुदुःखेयं सुकुमार्या विशेषतः॥
en: A husband is a woman's refuge under smoother circumstances and in a difficult situation a father is the refuge; roaming about is a hard task, especially for those brought up in luxury.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: राजपुत्र्याः प्रकृत्या च कुमार्यास्तव भामिनि। भद्रे दोषा हि विद्यन्ते बहवो वरवर्णिनि॥
en: Being a princess, you are naturally delicate, O romantic lady; there are many disadvantages, O you of beautiful complexion,

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: आश्रमे वै वसन्त्यास्ते न भवेयुः पितुर्गुहे। ततस्त्वन्येऽब्रुवन् वाक्यं तापसास्तां तपस्विनीम्॥
en: In a life in the hermitage while there will be none in your father's place. Then did other anchorites say to that female devotee these

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: त्वामिहैकाकिनी दृष्ट्वा निर्जने गहने वने। प्रार्थयिष्यन्ति राजानस्तस्मान्मैवं मनः कृथाः॥
en: Seeing yourself alone in these dreary and solitary woods kings will court you; therefore do not set your heart on such a life.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: अम्बोवाच न शक्यं काशिनगरं पुनर्गन्तुं पितुर्ग्रहान्। अवज्ञाता भविष्यामि बान्धवानां न संशयः॥
en: Amba said I cannot go to the city of Kashi to my father's place for I shall doubtless to disgraced by my friends.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: उषिताऽस्मि तथा बाल्ये पितुर्वेश्मनि तापसाः। नाहं गमिष्ये भद्रं वस्तत्र यत्र पिता मम। तपस्तप्तुमभीप्सामि तापसैः परिरक्षिता॥
en: O ascetics, in my childhood did I live in my father's place but now I shall not go where my father is; may you fare well.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: यथा परेऽपि मे लोके न स्यादेवं महात्ययः। दौर्भाग्यं तापसश्रेष्ठास्तस्मात् तप्स्याम्यहं तपः॥
en: I desire to practice asceticism protected by anchorites so that in the next world too I may not meet with such dire calamities. O foremost among ascetics, therefore am I desirous of practicing asceticism.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: भीष्म उवाच इत्येवं तेषु विप्रेषु चिन्तयत्सु यथातथम्। राजर्षिस्तद् वनं प्राप्तस्तपस्वी होत्रवाहनः॥
en: Bhishma said While those regenerate persons were thus thinking of the merit of the case, the royal sage Hotravahana came into that forest.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: ततस्ते तापसाः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म तं नृपम्। पूजाभिः स्वागताधाभिरासनेनोदकेन च॥
en: Then did all those ascetics worship that ruler of men and welcome him with their greetings, seat and water.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: तस्योपविष्टस्य सतो विश्रान्तस्योपशृण्वतः। पुनरेव कथां चक्रुः कन्यां प्रति वनौकसः॥
en: Then did those dwellers of the forest again address that lady in the hearing of that sage after he had taken his seat and rested himself a little.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: अम्बायास्तां कथां श्रुत्वा काशिराज्ञश्च भारत। राजर्षिः स महातेजा बभूवोद्विग्नमानसः॥ पिता तदा।
en: Hearing those words of Amba, the daughter of the king of the Kashis, O Bharata, that royal sage of great energy became filled with pity.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: तां तथावादिनीं श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा च स महातपाः। राजर्षिः कृपयाऽऽविष्टो महात्मा होत्रवाहनः॥
en: That king of great austerities, the greatsouled royal sage Hotravahana, seeing her and hearing her speak in that way, became filled with pity.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: स वेपमान उत्थाय मातुस्तस्याः तां कन्यामङ्कमारोप्य पर्यश्वासयत् प्रभो॥
en: The father of her mother then rose trembling (with rage) and placing her on his lap began to comfort her.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: स तामपृच्छत् कात्स्येन व्यसनोत्पत्तिमादितः। सा च तस्मै यथावृत्तं विस्तरेण न्यवेदयत्॥
en: He asked her the story of her wrongs from its origin and in detail and she too submitted to him everything as it had happened in detail.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: ततः स राजर्षिरभूद् दुःखशोकसमन्वितः। कार्यः च प्रतिपेदे तन्मनसा सुमहातपाः॥
en: Then was that royal sage filled with grief and distress and that one of great asceticism resolved, within himself, on his course of action.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: अब्रवीद् वेषमानश्च कन्यामाः सुदुःखितः। मा गाः पितुर्गृहं भद्रे मातुस्ते जनको ह्यहम्॥
en: Trembling, he said to that distressed and sorrowful girl: "Do not go to your father's place, gentle lady. I am the father of your mother.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: दुःखं छिन्द्यामहं ते वै मयि वर्तस्व पुत्रिके। पर्याप्तं ते मनो वत्से यदेवं परिशुष्यसि॥
en: I shall remove your sorrow, depend on me, dear daughter. You have enough of grief, child, since you are so lean.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: गच्छ मद्वचनाद् रामं जामदग्न्यं तपस्विनम्। रामस्ते सुमहद् दुःखं शोकं चैवापनेष्यति॥
en: By my advice go to the ascetic Rama, the son of Jamadagni. Rama will remove this heavy and horrible grief of yours.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: हनिष्यति रणे भीष्मं न करिष्यति चेद् वचः। तं गच्छ भार्गवश्रेष्ठं कालाग्निसमतेजसम्॥
en: He will slay Bhishma in battle if he does not act up to his words; go to him, that foremost of the Bhrigu race, who, in energy, is equal to the fire that rages at the time of the universal destruction.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: प्रतिष्ठापयिता स त्वां समे पथि महातपाः। ततस्तु सुखरं बाष्पमुत्सृजन्ती पुनः पुनः॥
en: That great anchorite will place you on the even path.” Then shedding tears profusely,

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: अब्रवीत् पितरं मातुः सा तदा होत्रवाहनम्। अभिवादयित्वा शिरसा गमिष्ये तव शासनात्॥
en: And saluting with her head the father of her mother, Hotravahana, she said "By your command I shall go there.

description: Amba's meeting with royal sage Hotravahana
sn: अपि नामाद्य पश्येयमार्यं तं लोकविश्रुतम्। कथं च तीव्र दुःखं मे नाशयिष्यति भार्गवः। एतदिच्छाम्यहं ज्ञातुं यथा यास्यामि तत्र वै॥
en: But shall I be able to see that respected man known throughout the world and how shall he of Bhrigu's race remove my grave sorrow? I desire to know this since I am going there.

sn: होत्रवाहन उवाच रामं द्रक्ष्यसि भद्रे त्वं जामदग्न्यं महावने। उग्रे तपसि वर्तन्तं सत्यसंधं महाबलम्॥
en: Hotravahana said “You will see Rama, the son of Jamadagni, devoted to truth and endued with great strength in the great forest, practicing hard asceticism.

sn: महेन्द्रं वै गिरिश्रेष्ठं रामो नित्यमुपास्ति ह। ऋषयो वेदविद्वांसो गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा।।
en: Rama ever dwells on that highest among the mountains, called Mahendra. Rishis conversant with the Vedas and Gandharavas and Apsaras also live there.

sn: तत्र गच्छस्व भद्रं ते ब्रूयाश्चैनं वचो मम। अभिवाद्य च तं मूर्धां तपोवृद्धं दृढव्रतम्॥
en: Go there and may you fare well. Tell him these words of mine after saluting that old devotee of firm vows by bowing down your head.

sn: ब्रूयाचैनं पुनर्भद्रे यत् ते कार्यं मनीषितम्। मयि संकीतिते रामः सर्वं तत् ते करिष्यति॥
en: Tell him what you want, gentle ladyhearing my name Rama will do all you ask of him.

sn: मम रामः सखा वत्से प्रीतियुक्तः सुहृच्च मे। जमदग्निसुतो वीरः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: Rama is my friend, child, and he is my well-wisher and is highly pleased with me that hero, the son Jamadagni and the foremost of all wielders of weapons.

sn: एवं ब्रुवति कन्यां तु पार्थिवे होत्रवाहने। अकृतव्रणः प्रादुरासीद् रामस्यानुचरः प्रियः॥
en: While Hotravahana that ruler of the earth was thus speaking to that girl, the devoted follower of Rama, Akritavrana, presented himself there.

sn: ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे समुत्तस्थुः सहस्रशः। स च राजा वयोवृद्धः सृञ्जयो होत्रवाहनः॥
en: Then did all those Rishis by thousands as also Hotravahana, the king of the Srinjayas, old in years, stand up.

sn: ततो दृष्ट्वा कृतातिथ्यमन्योन्यं ते वनौकसः। सहिता भरतश्रेष्ठ निषेदुः परिवार्य तम्॥
en: Seeing him those dwellers of the forest united together did him the rites of hospitality and then sat down surrounding him, O chief among the Bharatas.

sn: ततस्ते कथयामासुः कथास्तास्ता मनोरमाः। धन्या दिव्याश्च राजेन्द्र प्रीतिहर्षमुदा युताः॥
en: Then they began to converse cheerfully and delightfully on subjects that delighted one's heart and which were blessed and divine, O chief among kings.

sn: ततः कथान्ते राजर्षिर्महात्मा होत्रवाहनः। राम श्रेष्ठं महर्षीणामपृच्छदकृतव्रणम्॥
en: Then at the end of the conversation, the royal sage Hotravahana, endued with a large soul, asked Akritavrana about Rama the foremost among the great Rishis.

sn: क्व सम्प्रति महाबाहो जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्। अकृतव्रण शक्यो वै दुष्टुं वेदविदां वरः॥
en: “Where can I see at present the mighty son of Jamadagni, O you of long arms, 0 Akritavrana, that foremost among those conversant with the Vedas.

sn: अकृतव्रण उवाच भवन्तमेव सततं रामः कीर्तयति प्रभो। सृञ्जयो मे प्रियसखो राजर्षिरिति पार्थिव॥
en: Akritavrana said Rama ever speaks of you, my lord, saying: The royal sage Srinjaya, that ruler of the earth, is my dear friend.

sn: इह रामः प्रभाते श्वो भवितेति मतिर्मम। द्रष्टास्येनमिहायान्तं तवं दर्शनकाझ्या॥
en: I think Rama will be here on the morrow. You will see him come here owing to your desire for seeing him.

sn: इयं च कन्या राजर्षे किमर्थं वनमागता। कस्य चेयं तव च का भवतीच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: O royal sage, why is the lady come to the forest, whose daughter is she and what is she to you? I desire to know it.

sn: होत्रवाहन उवाच दौहित्रीयं मम विभो काशिराजसुता प्रिया। ज्येष्ठा स्वयंवरे तस्थौ भगिनीभ्यां सहानघ॥
en: Hotravahana said She is my grand child, my lord, the beloved daughter of the king of the Kashis. O sinless one, she was desirous of choosing her own husband along with her two sisters.

sn: इयमम्बेति विख्याता ज्येष्ठा काशिपतेः सुता। अम्बिकाम्बालिके कन्ये कनीयस्यौ तपोधन॥
en: This eldest daughter of the ruler of the Kashis is known as Amba and, O you whose only wealth is devotion, his two younger daughters are called Ambika and Ambalika.

sn: समेतं पार्थिवं क्षत्रं काशिपूर्यां ततोऽभवत्। कन्यानिमित्तं विप्रर्षे तत्रासीदुत्सवो महान्॥
en: Then was there assembled in the city of Kashi, the entire body of Kshatriya rulers of the earth and there were great rejoicing there, O regenerate Rishi of those princes.

sn: ततः किल महावीर्यो भीष्मः शान्तनवो नृपान्। अधिक्षिप्य महातेजास्तिस्रः कन्या जहारताः॥
en: Then did Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, endued with great heroism and energy overthrowing all those rulers of the earth, take away the three girls by force.

sn: निर्जित्य पृथिवीपालानथं भीष्मो गजाह्वयम्। आजगाम विशुद्धात्मा कन्याभिः सह भारतः॥
en: Bhishma of sinless soul, having conquered those rulers of the earth came to the city called after the elephant in company with those girls, OBharata.

sn: सत्यवत्यै निवेद्याथ विवाहं समनन्तरम्। भ्रातुर्विचित्रवीर्यस्य समाज्ञापयत प्रभुः॥
en: That lord after submitting the case to Satyavati ordered for the wedding of his brother Vichitravirya.

sn: तं तु वैवाहिकं दृष्ट्वा कन्येयं समुपार्जितम्। अब्रवीत् तत्र गाङ्गेयं मन्त्रिमध्ये द्विजर्षभ॥
en: This girl, seeing all the arrangements made for the wedding, said there to the son of Ganga in the midst of his councillors, O best among the twice-born.

sn: मया शाल्वपतिर्वीरो मनसाभिवृतः पतिः। न मामर्हसि धर्मज्ञ दातुं भ्रात्रेऽन्यमानसाम्॥
en: The heroic king of Shalva has been chosen by me as my husband; O you conversant with virtue, it is not proper that you should give me, who am desirous of another, up in your brother.

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं भीष्मः सम्मन्त्र्य सह मन्त्रिभिः। निश्चित्य विससर्जेमां सत्यवत्या मते स्थितः॥
en: Bhishma, hearing those words and consulting with his ministers, came to a decision and following the opinion of Satyavati sent her away,

sn: अनुज्ञाता तु भीष्मेण शाल्वं सौभपतिं ततः। कन्येयं मुदिता तत्र काले वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Permitted by Bhishma this girl rejoicing went to Shalva the lord of Saubha in due time and said these words:

sn: विसर्जिताऽस्मि भीष्मेण धर्मं मां प्रतिपादय। मनसाभिवृतः पूर्वं मया त्वं पार्थिवर्षभ॥
en: I have been dismissed by Bhishma; act righteously towards me for you had before been chosen by me as my husband, O best among the rulers of the earth.

sn: प्रत्याचख्यौ च शाल्वोऽस्याश्चारित्रस्याभिशङ्कितः। सेयं तपोवनं प्राप्ता तापस्येऽभिरता भृशम्॥
en: Shalva, however being suspicious about her character, rejected her and she, coming to this hermitage, has become greatly bent on practicing asceticism.

sn: मया च प्रत्यभिज्ञाता वंशस्य परिकीर्तनात्। अस्य दुःखस्य चोत्पत्तिं भीष्ममेवेह मन्यते॥
en: She was recognized by me owing to her describing her parentage and she thinks Bhishma as the origin of this calamity of hers.

sn: अम्बोवाच भगवन्नेवमेवेह यथाऽऽह पृथिवीपतिः। शरीरकर्ता मातुर्मे सृञ्जयो होत्रवाहनः॥
en: Amba said O lord, it is even as this ruler of the earth has said; the progenitor of my mother's self is this Hotravahana of the Srinjaya race.

sn: न झुत्सहे स्वनगरं प्रतियातुं तपोधन। अपमानभयाच्चैव व्रीडया च महामुने॥
en: I do not desire to go back to my father's city, O you whose wealth consists in asceticism, from fear of disgrace and out of shame, O great Muni.

sn: यत् तु मां भगवान् रामो वक्ष्यति द्विजसत्तम। तन्मे कार्यतमं कार्यमिति मे भगवन् मतिः॥
en: 0 best among the twice-born, it is my opinion that what the lord Rama points out to me would be my supreme duty, my lord.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: अकृतव्रण उवाच दुःखद्वयमिदं भद्रे कतरस्य चिकीर्षसि। प्रतिकर्तव्यमबले तत् त्वं वत्से वदस्व मे॥
en: Akritavrana said For which of these two sorrows do you desire a remedy, O lady. Tell me that truly, 0 child.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: यदि सौभपतिर्भद्र नियोक्तव्यो मतस्तव नियोक्ष्यति महात्मा स रामस्त्वद्धितकाम्यया।॥
en: If in your opinion gentle lady, the lord of the Suabhas should be urged, the great-souled Rama, desirous of your good, will urge him.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: अथापगेयं भीष्मं त्वं रामेणेच्छसि धीमता। रणे विनिर्जितं द्रष्टुं कुर्यात् तदपि भार्गवः॥
en: Or if you desire to see the blamable Bhishma vanquished in battle by the wise Rama, he, of Bhrigu's family, will do that too.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: सृञ्जयस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तव चैव शुचिस्मिते। यदत्र ते भृशं कार्यं तदद्यैव विचिन्त्यताम्॥
en: Hearing the words of Srinjaya, and of yours, O you of beautiful smiles, let what ought to be done this very day be settled.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: अम्बोवाच अपनीताऽस्मि भीष्मेण भगवन्नविजानता। नाभिजानाति मे भीष्मो ब्रह्मन् शाल्वगतं मनः॥
en: Amba said Led away I had been by Bhishma, but he knew not the true state of my feelings. Bhishma did not know, O Brahmana, that my mind learned towards Shalva.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: एतद् विचार्य मनसा भवानेतद् विनिश्चयम्। विचिनोतु यथान्यायं विधानं क्रियतां तथा॥
en: Thinking of this in your mind you should settle about this; do what you think is just.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: भीष्मे वा कुरुशार्दूले शाल्वराजेऽथवा पुनः। उभयोरेव वा ब्रह्मन् युक्त यत् तत् समाच॥
en: Do that wish is just and reasonable towards that best among the Kurus and to the king Shalva or to both.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: निवेदितं मया ह्येतद् दुःखमूलं यथातथम्। विधानं तत्र भगवन् कर्तुमर्हसि युक्तितः॥
en: The root of my distress, as it is, had now been submitted by me and it is proper that you should do in this matte what is reasonable.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: अकृतव्रण उवाच उपपन्नमिदं भद्रे यदेवं वरवर्णिनि। धर्मं प्रति वचो ब्रूयाः शृणु चेदं वचो मम॥
en: Akritavrana said It is indeed praiseworthy, gentle lady, that you are speaking these words with your eye towards virtue, O you of fair complexion; listen to these words of mine.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: यदि त्वामापगेयो वै न नयेद् गजसाह्वयम्। शाल्वस्त्वां शिरसा भीरु गृह्णीयाद् रामचोदितः॥
en: If the blamable one had not led you to the city called after the elephant, Shalva would have accepted you, O timid lady, with his head bowed down, urged by Rama.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: तेन त्वं निर्जिता भद्रे यस्मानीताऽसि भाविनि। संशयः शाल्वराजस्य तेन त्वयि सुमध्यमे॥
en: But since you, gentle lady, had been taken away by him after gaining a victory, O romantic lady, the king Shalva has therefore doubts in you, o you of beautiful waist.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: भीष्मः पुरुषमानी च जितकाशी तथैव च। युक्ता भीष्मे कारयितुं तव॥
en: Bhishma is proud of his bravery and success and therefore it stands to reason that your remedy lies in Bhishma.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: अम्बोवाच ममाप्येष सदा ब्रह्मन् हृदि कामोऽमिवर्तते। घातयेयं यदि रणे भीष्ममित्येव नित्यदा॥ तस्मात् प्रतिक्रिया
en: Amba said This desire has ever obtained in my heart. O Brahmana, that I would have but Bhishma slain in battle.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: भीष्मं वा शाल्वराजं वा यं वा दोषेण गच्छसि। प्रशाधि तं महाबाहो यत्कृतेहं सुदुःखिता॥
en: Whoever is blamable, Bhishma to the king of the Shalvas, punish him who has brought about this great distress, O you of long arms.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: भीष्म उवाच एवं कथयतामेव तेषां स दिवसो गतः। रात्रिश्च भरतश्रेष्ठ सुखशीतोष्णमारुता॥
en: Bhishma said The day passed away while they were conversing on this as also the night which was marked by pleasant breezes that were neither too hot nor too cold, O chief among the Bharatas.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: ततो रामः प्रादुरासीत् प्रज्वलन्निव तेजसा। शिष्यैः परिवृतो राजन् जटाचीरधरो मुनिः॥
en: Then did Rama come there as if blazing with energy, the anchorite having matted hairs wearing deer skin was surrounded by his disciples.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: धनुष्पाणिरदीनात्मा खङ्गं बिभ्रत् परश्वधी। विरजा राजशार्दूल सृञ्जयं सोऽभ्ययानृपम्॥
en: The great-souled one came, bow in hand, and holding a sword and battle-axe; and the sinless one approached that ruler of men, Srinjaya, O best among kings.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: ततस्तं तापसा दृष्ट्वा स च राजा महातपाः। तस्थुः प्राञ्चलयो राजन् सा च कन्या तपस्विनी॥
en: Seeing him the ascetics and the king of great asceticism stood up with clasped hands; so also did that girl.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: पूजयामासुरव्यचा मधुपर्केण भार्गवम्। अर्चितश्च यथान्यायं न पिसाद सहैव तैः॥
en: Earnestly they adored him of the Bhrigu race, with honey and curds and being duly honored he sat down with them.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: ततः पूर्वव्यतीतानि कथयन्तौ स्म तावुभौ। आसातां जामदग्न्यश्च सृञ्जयश्चैव भारत॥
en: Then the two Srinjaya and the son of Jamadagna, sat together conversing on past matters.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: तथा कथान्ते राजर्षि गुश्रेष्ठं महाबलम्। उवाच मधुरं काले रामं वचनमर्थवत्॥
en: At the end of their discourse, the royal sage in proper time said these sweet words pregnant with meaning to Rama, the foremost in the race of Bhrigu, endued with great strength.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: रामेयं मम दौहित्री काशिराजसुता प्रभो। अस्याः शृणु यथातत्त्वं कार्यं कार्यविशारद॥
en: O Rama this is my grand daughter, the daughter of the king of the Kashis, my lord; hear what she has to say and settle what can be done for her, O you skillful in deeds.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: परमं कथ्यतां चेति तां रामः प्रत्यभाषत। तत: साभ्यगमद् रामं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्॥
en: Rama said to her, “Repeat your grand story"; thereupon she said to Rama who was blazing like fire.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: ततोऽभिवाद्य चरणौ रामस्य शिरसा शुभौ। स्पृष्ट्वा पद्मदलामाभ्यां पाणिभ्यामग्रतः स्थिता॥
en: Saluting the holy feet of Rama with her head she touched them with her lotus like hands and stood in front of him.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: सरोद सा शोकवती बाष्पव्याकुललोचना। प्रपेदे शरणं चैव शरण्यं भृगुनन्दनम्॥
en: Being stricken with grief she wept aloud and with her eyes bathed in tears she betook herself to the refuge of the delighter of Bhrigu's race who was of a worthy refuge.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: राम उवाच यथा त्वं सृञ्जयस्यास्य तथा मे त्वं नृपात्मजे। ब्रूहि यत् ते मनोदुःखं करिष्ये वचनं तव॥
en: Rama said You are the same to me, O princess, as you are to Srinjaya; speak out the grief you have in your mind, I shall act up to your words.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: अम्बोवाच भगवशरणं त्वाद्य प्रपन्नाऽस्मि महाव्रतम्। शोकपङ्कार्णवान्मग्नां घोरादुद्धर मां विभो॥
en: Amba said My lord, I be take myself now to your refuge for you are of great vows, Tell me, my lord, who am fallen into the mire of grief and liberate me from the heavy calamity.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: भीष्म उवाच तस्याश्च दृष्ट्वा रूपं च वपुश्चाभिनवं पुनः। सौकुमार्यं परं चैव रामश्चिन्तापरोऽभवत्॥
en: Bhishma said Seeing her beauty and again her youthful person and her extreme delicacy of mold, Rama became engaged in deep thought.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: किमियं वक्ष्यतीत्येवं विममर्श भृगूद्वहः। इति दध्यौ चिरं रामः कृपयाभिपरिप्लुतः॥
en: "What shall this one say?" So thought Bhrigu; thinking thus Rama was silent for a long time filled with pity.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: कथ्यतामिति सा भूयो रामेणोक्ता शुचिस्मिता। सर्वमेव यथातत्त्वं कथयामास भार्गवे॥
en: The lady, of sweet smiles being again asked to recite her story, said everything as had happened to him of Bhrigu's race.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा जामदग्न्यस्तु राजपुत्र्या वचस्तदा। उवाच ता वरारोहां निश्चित्यार्थविनिश्चयम्॥
en: The son of Jamadagni too hearing those words of the princess first settled as to what he should do and then said to her of beautiful hips.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: राम उवाच प्रेषयिष्यामि भीष्माय कुरुश्रेष्ठाय भाविनि। करिष्यति वचो मह्यं श्रुत्वा च स नराधिपः॥
en: Rama said O beautiful lady, I shall send words to that foremost among the Kurus, Bhishma, and that ruler among men. Hearing them will do, my bidding.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: न चेत् करिष्यति वचो मयोक्तं जाह्नवीसुतः। धक्ष्याम्यहं रणे भद्रे सामात्यं शस्त्रतेजसा॥
en: If the son of Jahnavi does not do what I say then shall I consume him in battle, O gentle lady, along with his ministers, by the blaze of my weapons.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: अथवा ते मतिस्तत्र राजपुत्रि न वर्तते। यावच्छाल्वपतिं वीरं योजनयाम्यत्र कर्माणि॥
en: If, O princess, you are not of that opinion, I shall urge that hero, the king of the Shalvas, to the present matter.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: अम्बोवाच विसर्जिताऽहं भीष्मेण श्रुत्वैव भृगुनन्दन। शाल्वराजगतं भावं मम पूर्वं मनीषितम्॥
en: Amba said O delighter of Bhrigu's race, I had been dismissed by Bhishma as soon as he heard that my mind already had been to the king of the Shalvas.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: सौमराजमुपेत्याहमवोचं दुर्वचं वचः। न च मां प्रत्यगृह्णात् स चारित्र्यपरिशङ्कितः॥
en: Approaching then the king of Saubha I addressed him in improper words, but he did not accept me being suspicious of my character.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: एतत् सर्वं विनिश्चित्य स्वबुद्ध्या भृगुनन्दन। यदत्रौपयिकं कार्यं तच्चिन्तयितुमर्हसि॥
en: Thinking on all this, it is proper should think of the means of remedying this by your own knowledge, O delighter of Bhrigu's that you race.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: मम तु व्यसनस्यास्य भीष्मो मूलं महाव्रतः। येनाहं वशमानीता समुक्षिप्य बलात् तदा॥
en: The root of this distress of mine is Bhishma of great vows, since by him was I brought under subjection taking me up by force.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: भीष्मं जहि महाबाहो यत्कृते दुःखमीदृशम्। प्राप्ताहं भृगुशार्दूल चराम्यप्रियमुत्तमम्॥
en: Slay Bhishma, O you of long arms, for it is by his doings that I am fallen into such distress, O you foremost among the race of Bhrigu, and that I continue in this growing distress.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: स हि लुब्धश्च नीचश्च जितकाशी च भार्गव। तस्मात् प्रतिक्रिया कर्तुं युक्ता तस्मै त्वयाऽघ॥
en: He is covetous, mean, spirited, and boastful of success, O you of Bhrigu's race; therefore is it reasonable that you should take revenge on him, O sinless one.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: एष मे क्रियमाणाया भारतेन तदा विभो। अभवद्भदि संकल्पो घातयेयं महाव्रतम्॥
en: When I was being taken away by Bharata, my lord, I made this resolution in my heart, namely, that I should cause this one of great vows to be slain.

description: Rama and Bhishma in the field of Kurukshetra
sn: तस्मात् कामं ममायेमं राम सम्पादयानघ। जहि भीष्मं महाबाहो यथा वृत्रं पुरंदरः॥
en: Therefore do you fulfill this desire of mine, O sinless Rama; slay Bhishma, O you of long arms, as Purandara slew Vritra.

sn: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तस्तदा रामो जहि भीष्ममिति प्रभो। उवाच रुदती कन्यां चोदयन्तीं पुनः पुनः॥
en: Bhishma said “O Rama, slay Bhishma, “having been thus addressed, my lord, he said to that weeping girl who urged him again and again.

sn: काश्ये न कामं गृह्णामि शस्त्रं वै वरवर्णिनि। ऋते ब्रह्मविदां हेतोः किमन्यत् करवाणि ते॥
en: "O princess of Kashi, I do not take up arms from my own desire, O you of fair complexion, except at the bidding of those conversant with the Vedas; what else shall I do for you?

sn: वाचा भीष्मश्च शाल्वश्च मम राज्ञि वसानुगौ। भविष्यतोऽनवद्याङ्गि तत् करिष्यामि मा शुचः॥
en: O Princess, both Bhishma and Shalva act up to my words and I shall accomplish this work, Do not grieve.

sn: न तु शस्त्रं ग्रहीष्यामि कथंचिदपि भाविनि। ऋते नियोगाद् विप्राणामेष मे समयः कृतः॥
en: But I shall not on any account take up arms except at the bidding of regenerate persons; for this is the vow I have made.

sn: अम्बोवाच मम दुःखं भगवता व्यपनेयं यतस्ततः। तच्च भीष्मप्रसूतं मे तं जहीश्वर मा चिरम्॥
en: Amba said By some means or other, my distress has its origin in Bhishma; slay him therefore without delay, my lord.

sn: राम उवाच काशिकन्ये पुनर्बंहि भीष्मस्ते चरणावुभौ। शिरसा वन्दना.ऽपि ग्रहीयष्यति गिरा मम॥
en: Rama said O princess of Kashi, I tell you again that thought Bhishma is worthy of your worship, he will, at my word, take up both your feet on his head.

sn: अम्बोवाच जहि भीष्मं रणे राम गर्जन्तमसुरं यथा। समाहूतो रणे राम मम चेदिच्छसि प्रियम्। प्रतिश्रुतं च यदपि तत् सत्यं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Amba said Kill Bhishma in battle, O Rama, for he roars like an Asura, after challenging him to fight if you desire, what is pleasing to me, O Rama; besides it is proper that you should perform what you have promised.

sn: भीष्म उवाच तयोः संवदतोरेवं राजन् रामाम्बयोस्तदा। ऋषिः परमधर्मात्मा इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Bhishma said While the two, Amba and Rama, were thus conversing together, the Rishi, of extremely virtuous soul, said these words:

sn: शरणागतां महाबाहो कन्यां न त्यक्तुमर्हसि। यदि भीष्मो रणे राम समाहूतस्त्वया मृधे॥
en: This is not proper for you, O you of long arms, to abandon a girl who has taken refuge with you. If, O Rama, Bhishma being challenged by you in fight,

sn: निर्जितोऽस्मीति वा ब्रूयात् कुर्याद् वा वचनं तव। कृतमस्या भवेत् कार्यं कन्याया भृगुनन्दन॥
en: Either says “I am vanquished" or acts !p to your words then the object of this lady will be fulfilled, O delighter of the Bhrigu race.

sn: वाक्यं सत्यं च ते वीर भविष्यति कृतं विभो। इयं चापि प्रतिज्ञा ते तदा राम महामुने॥
en: And your promise, my lord, will be redeemed, At the time (of war with the Kshatriyas), this was your promise, O Rama, O great sage.

sn: जित्वा वै क्षत्रियान् सर्वान् ब्राह्मणेषु प्रतिश्रुता। ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रश्चैव रणे यदि॥
en: Having conquered all the Kshatriyas at the time you made this promise to the Brahmanas. "If a Brahmana or a Kshatriya or a Vaishya or a Shudra in battle,

sn: ब्रह्मद्विड भविता तं वै हनिष्यामीति भार्गव। शरणार्थं प्रपन्नानां भीतानां शरणार्थिनाम्॥
en: Becomes the destroyer of a Brahmana I shall slay him" O you of Bhrigu's race, Then, who out of fear will take refuge with me,

sn: न शक्ष्यामि परित्यागं कर्तुं जीवन् कथंचन। यश्च कृत्स्नं रणे क्षत्रं विजेष्यति समागतम्॥
en: I shall never be able to abandon by any means so long I have some alive, even if a Kshatriyas comes to war with me.

sn: दीप्तात्मानमहं तं च हनिष्यामीति भार्गव। स एवं विजयी राम भीष्मः कुरुकुलोद्वहः। तेन युध्यस्व संग्रामे समेत्य भृगुनन्दन।॥
en: "I shall slay that one, of blazing self though he be" O you of Bhrigu's race. O Rama, that Bhishma, the supporter of the Kuru race, is even such, Fight with him in battle therefore, O Rama.

sn: राम उवाच स्मराम्यहं पूर्वकृतां प्रतिज्ञामृषिसत्तम। तथैव च चरिष्यामि यथा साम्नैव लप्स्यते॥
en: Rama said I remember the promise that I made before, O you best among the Rishis, but in this instance I shall act in such a way that I may gain my object by peaceful means.

sn: कार्यमेतन्महद् ब्रह्मन् काशिकन्यामनोगतम्। गमिष्यामि स्वयं तत्र कन्यामादाय यत्र सः॥
en: This work, aimed at by the princess of Kashis, is indeed great, Taking this lady, I shall go myself there where he is.

sn: यदि भीष्मो रणश्लाघी न करिष्यति मे वचः। हनिष्याम्येनमुद्रिक्तमिति मे निश्चिता मतिः॥
en: If Bhishma, proud of his feats in war, does not act up to my commands I shall certainly slay that arrogant one.

sn: न हि बाणा मयोत्सृष्टाः सज्जन्तीह शरीरिणाम्। कायेषु विदितं तुभ्यं पुरा क्षत्रियसंगरे॥
en: The arrows, shot forth by me, do not stick in the body of living creatures (but pass clearly through them); it is known to you in the with the Kshatriyas.

sn: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामः सह तैर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः। प्रयाणाय मतिं कृत्वा समुत्तस्थौ महातपाः॥
en: Rama saying this, along with those conversant with Brahma, those great devotees rose up intending to depart.

sn: ततस्ते तामुषित्वा तु रजनीं तत्र तापसाः। हुताग्नयो जप्तजप्याः प्रतस्थुर्मज्जिघांसया॥
en: Then those devotees, staying there for the night, performed their Homa and other ceremonies and went away with the desire of taking my life.

sn: अभ्यगच्छत् ततो रामः सह तैब्रह्मवादिभिः। कुरुक्षेत्रं महाराज कन्यया सह भारत॥
en: Then did Rama depart accompanied by those utters of Brahma, making for Kurukshetra, O great king, and taking that girl with him.

sn: न्यविशन्त ततः सर्वे परिगृह्य सरस्वतीम्। तापसास्ते महात्मानो भृगुश्रेष्ठपुरस्कृताः॥
en: All of them, namely those great-souled ascetics with that foremost among the race of Bhrigu at their head, having reached the river Sarasvati, encamped there.

sn: भीष्म उवाच ततस्तृतीये दिवसे संदिदेश व्यवस्थितः। कुरु प्रियं स मे राजन् प्राप्तोऽस्मीति महाव्रतः॥
en: Bhishma said On the third day of their encampment, the one of great vows sent me words: "I am come, do what is agreeable to me.”

sn: तमागतमहं श्रुत्वा विषयान्तं महाबलम्। अभ्यगच्छं जवेनाशु प्रीत्या तेजोनिधिं प्रभुम्॥
en: Hearing of the arrival of that one endued with great strength at the boundary of my kingdom I went to that lord, the ocean of energy, with great cheerfulness,

sn: गां पुरस्कृत्य राजेन्द्रं ब्राह्मणैः परिवारितः। ऋत्विभिर्देवकल्पैश्च तथैव च पुरोहितैः॥
en: With a cow before me and surrounded by Brahmanas, priests and preceptors who were equal to the gods themselves.

sn: स मामभिगतं दृष्ट्वा जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्। प्रतिजग्राह तां पूजां वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: The son of Jamadagni, endued with luster, seeking me, accepted that worship and said these words,

sn: राम उवाच भीष्म कां बुद्धिमास्थाय काशिराजसुता तदा। अकामेन त्वयाऽऽनीता पुनश्चैव विसर्जिता॥
en: Rama said I Bhishma, in what frame of mind was the daughter of the king of Kashis led away by you though you wanted her not; and why was she again sent away.

sn: विभ्रंशिता त्वया हीयं धर्मादास्ते यशस्विनी। परामृष्टां त्वया हीमां को हि गन्तुमिहार्हति॥
en: By you has this lady of spotless fame been robbed of virtue; for touched by you as she has been, for whom would it be proper to marry her?

sn: प्रत्याख्याता हि शाल्वेन त्वयाऽऽनीतेति भारत। तस्मादिमा मन्नियोगात् प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भारत॥
en: Having been once led away by you she has been rejected by Shalva; therefore do at my words accept her, O Bharata.

sn: स्वधर्मं पुरुषव्याघ्र राजपुत्री लभत्वियम्। न युक्तस्त्ववमानोऽयं राज्ञां कर्तुं त्वयानघ॥
en: Let this princess fulfill her object, О best among men, and it is not proper, O king, that she should be disgraced by you, O sinless one.

sn: ततस्तं वै विमनसमुदीक्ष्याहमथाब्रुवम्। नाहमेनां पुनर्दद्यां ब्रह्मन् भ्रात्रे कथंचन॥
en: Seeing him absent-minded on her account I said, “I cannot again offer her to my brother by any means, O Brahmana,"

sn: शाल्वस्याहमिति प्राह पुरा मामेव भार्गव। मया चैवाभ्यनुज्ञाता गतेयं नगरं प्रति॥
en: To me she said before, I belong to Shalva, you of the Bhrigu race, and permitted by me went towards his capital.

sn: न भयान्नाप्यनुक्रोशान्नार्थलोभान्न काम्यया। क्षात्रं धर्ममहं जह्यामिति मे व्रतमाहितम्॥
en: Not out of fear, nor out of pity, nor out of avarice and nor out of a desire to gain my object shall I abandon the duties of the Kshatriya order, such has been the vow made by me.

sn: अथ मामब्रवीद् रामः क्रोधपर्याकुलेक्षणः। न करिष्यसि चेदेतद् वाक्यं मे नरपुङ्गव॥
en: Then did Rama say to me with eyes expanded with wrath:-“If you do not act up to my words, O best among men,

sn: हनिष्यामि सहामात्यं त्वामद्येति पुनः पुनः। संरम्भादब्रवीद् रामः क्रोधपर्याकुलेक्षणः॥
en: I shall slay you along with your ministers;" he said thus to me again and again with eyes expanded with anger.

sn: तमहं गीीरिष्टाभि पुनः पुनररिंदम। अयाचं भृगुशार्दूलं न चैव प्रशशाम सः॥
en: I again and again entreated that best among the Bhrigu race with sweet words, O chastiser among foes, but could not calm him down.

sn: प्रणम्य तमहं मूर्धा भूयो ब्राह्मणसत्तमम्। अब्रूवं कारणं किं तद् यत् त्वं युद्धं मयेच्छसि॥
en: I then bowing my head to him said again to the best among the Brahmanas; "What is the reason of your proclaiming war with me?

sn: इष्वस्त्रं मम बालस्य भवतैव चतुर्विधम्। उपदिष्टं महाबाहो शिष्योऽस्मि तव भार्गव॥
en: In my childhood had you taught me the use of four kinds of arms, and I am thus your pupil, O you of Bhrigu race."

sn: ततो मामब्रवीद् रामः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। जानी मां गुरुं भीष्म गृह्णासीमां न चैव ह॥
en: Then did Rama say to me with eyes red with anger, “You know me to be your preceptor, O Bhishma, and yet you will not accept this lady,

sn: सुतां काश्यस्य कौरव्य मत्प्रियार्थं महामते। न हि ते विद्यते शान्तिरन्यथा कुरुनन्दन॥
en: The daughter of the king of the Kashis for my gratification, O son of Kuru, endued with great intelligence. There is no other way of gratifying me, O delighter of Kuru's race.

sn: गृहाणेमां महाबाहो रक्षस्व कुलमात्मनः। त्वया विभ्रंशिता हीयं भर्तारं नाधिगच्छति॥
en: Accept this lady, O you of long arms, and perpetuate your family. Being severed from the path of rectitude by yourself she gets no husband."

sn: तथा ब्रूवन्तं तमहं रामं पुरपुरंजयम्। नैतदेवं पुनर्भावि ब्रह्मर्षे किं श्रमेण ते॥
en: I said to Rama, the conqueror of hostile cites who was speaking thus: “This will not be, O regenerate Rishi, what is the use of labouring towards it.

sn: गुरुत्वं त्वयि सम्प्रेक्ष्य जामदग्न्य पुरातनम्। प्रसादये त्वां भगवस्त्यक्तैषा तु पुरा मया॥
en: O son of Jamadagni, considering that you were my preceptor in days of old I sought to gratify you before, my lord.

sn: को जातु परभावां हि नारी व्यालीमव स्थिताम्। वासयेत गृहे जानन् स्त्रीणां दोषो महात्ययः॥
en: Who will permit a woman, who sighs for another and who is therefore like a poisonous snake, to remain in his house knowing the great evils thereof.

sn: न भयाद् वासवस्यापि धर्म जह्यां महाव्रत। प्रसीद मा वा यद्वा ते कार्यं तत्कुरु मा चिरम्॥
en: O you of great vows, I shall not for fear of Vasava even forsake my duties; either be gratified with me or do what you please without loss of time.

sn: अयं चापि विशुद्धात्मन् पुराणे श्रूयते विभो। मरुत्तेन महाबुद्धे गीतः श्लोको महात्मना॥
en: My lord of pure heart, even this Sloka is heard in the Puranas, sung by Maruta endued with a large soul.

sn: गुरोरप्यवलिप्तस्य कार्याकार्यमजानतः। उत्पथप्रतिपन्नस्य परित्यागो विधीयते॥
en: The abandonment of a preceptor is provided when he is vain or has swerved from the right path or who does not know what his duties are.

sn: स त्व गुरुरिति प्रेम्णा मया सम्मानितो भृशम्। गुरुवृत्तिं न जीनीघे तस्माद योत्स्यामि वै त्वया॥
en: I respected you very much so long because you were my preceptor; but since you do not know the duties of a preceptor, therefore shall I fight with you.

sn: गुरुं न हन्यां समरे ब्राह्मणं च विशेषतः। विशेषतस्तपोवृद्धमेवं क्षान्तं मया तव॥
en: I shall not slay a preceptor in battle, especially as he is a Brahmana and you have been forgiven by me since you are old in devotion.

sn: उद्यतेषुमथो दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रबन्धुवत्। यो हन्यात् समरे क्रुद्धं युध्यन्तमपलायिनम्॥
en: One, who seeing a Brahmana, ready to fight like a friend of the Kshatriyas, wrathfully slays him who flies not from the fled,

sn: ब्रह्महत्या न तस्य स्यादिति धर्मेषू निश्चयः। क्षत्रियाणां स्थितो धर्मं क्षत्रियोऽस्मि तपोधन॥
en: Is not guilty of slaying a Brahmana, such has been authoritatively laid down in the holy books, O you whose only wealth is asceticism, I am a Kshatriya observing the duties of my order.

sn: यो यथा वर्तते यस्मिंस्तस्मिन्नेव प्रवयर्तयन्। नाधर्मं समवाप्नोति न चाश्रेयश्च विन्दति॥
en: Such a one as myself who treats such according to his merit does not act unrighteously and does not come by evils.

sn: अर्थं वा यदि वा धर्म समर्थो देशकालवित्। अर्थसंशयमापन्नः श्रेयान्निः संशयो नरः॥
en: When one, able to discriminate the propriety of time and place and knowing both virtue and worldly good, is doubtful of his course, he should without hesitation do that which is virtuous.

sn: यस्मात् संशयितेऽप्यर्थेऽयथान्यायं प्रवर्तसे। तस्माद् योत्स्यामि सहितस्त्वया राम महाहवे॥
en: Since you act unrighteously towards me in a matter connected with profit, I shall certainly fight with you in a great battle.

sn: पश्य मे बाहुवीर्यं विक्रमं चातिमानुषम्। एवं गतेऽपि तु मया यच्छक्यं भृगुनन्दन।॥
en: Behold the strength of my arms and superhuman prowess and what I am capable of, under such circumstances.

sn: तत् करिष्ये कुरुक्षेत्रे योत्स्ये विप्र त्वया सह। द्वन्द्वे राम यथेष्टं मे सज्जीभव महाद्युते॥
en: I shall do what I can and O regenerate one, I shall fight with you in Kurukshetra; and since you are desirous to fight, be prepared for battle.

sn: तत्र त्वं निहतो राम मया शरशतार्दितः। प्राप्स्यसे निर्जिताँल्लोकान् शस्त्रपूतो महारणे॥
en: Go, O you who are fond of war, and return to the field of Kurukshetra and I shall go there to fight with you, O you whose only wealth is devotion.

sn: स गच्छ विनिवर्तस्व कुरुक्षेत्रं रणप्रिय। तत्रैष्यामि महाबाहो युद्धाय त्वांत पोधन॥
en: Being slain by a hundred arrows shot by me, you will obtain those regions earned by your asceticism, being sanctified by my weapons in the battle.

sn: अपि तत्र त्वया राम कृतं शौचं पुरा पितुः। तत्राहमपि हत्वा त्वां शौचं कर्ताऽस्मि भार्गव॥
en: Where in days of days of old, you sanctified the name of your fathers, even there shall I sanctify you, O you of Bhrigu's race.

sn: तत्र राम समागच्छ त्वरितं युद्धदुर्मदा व्यपनेष्यामि ते दर्थं पौराणं ब्राह्मणब्रुव॥ राम बहुशः
en: Therefore come there quickly, O you who are hard to vanquish in battle and I shall destroy your boast of days of old, which is even now referred to by Brahmanas,

sn: यच्चापि कत्थसे परिवत्सरे। निर्जिताः क्षत्रिया लोके मयैकेनेति तच्छृणु॥
en: The boast that you have indulged in for a long time past, namely the entire body of Kshatriyas have been conquered by me alone, listen to the cause thereof.

sn: न तदा जातवान् भीष्मः क्षत्रियो वापि मद्विधः। पश्चाज्जातानि तेजांसि तृणेषु ज्वलितं त्वया।॥
en: At that time Bhishma was not born not even a Kshatriya like myself, energetic beings were created afterwards, you consumed only straw.

sn: यस्ते युद्धमयं दधैं कामं च व्यपनाशयेत्। सोऽहं जातो महाबाहो भीष्मः परपुरंजयः। व्यपनेष्यामि ते दर्प युद्धे राम न संशयः॥
en: He, who will remove your boasts of velour and desire for war, is now born. He is myself, Bhishma, the subjugator of hostile cities and I shall destroy your pride in battle. There is no doubt about it.

sn: भीष्म उवाच ततो मामब्रवीद् रामः प्रहसन्निव भारत। दिष्ट्या भीष्म मया साधू योद्धुमिच्छसि संगरे॥
en: Bhishma said Then did Rama say to me with a laugh, O Bharata:-It is fortunate, O Bhishma that you want to fight with me in battle.

sn: अयं गच्छामि कौरव्य कुरुक्षेत्रं त्वया सह। भाषितं ते करिष्यामि तत्रागच्छ परंतप॥
en: I shall now go, O son of Kuru, to Kurukshetra with you. I shall do what you say. Go there, O chastiser of foes.

sn: तत्र त्वां निहतं माता मया शरशताचितम्। जाह्नवी पश्यतां भीष्म गृध्रकङ्कबलाशनम्॥
en: There will your mother Jahnavi see yourself slain by my hundred arrows, O Bhishma, and be made the food of vultures and other birds of prey.

sn: कृपणं त्वामभिप्रेक्ष्य सिद्धचारणसेविता। मया विनिहतं देवी रोदतामद्य पार्थिव॥
