en: O ruler of the earth, let your mothe worshipped by Siddhas and Charanas seeing yourself slain by me, weep today.

sn: अतदर्हा महाभागा भगीरथसुताऽधा। या त्वामजीजनन्मन्दं युद्धकामुकमातुरम्॥
en: Your mother of great parts, the daughter of Bhagiratha that gave birth to you, fool that you are, and affected by the desire of fight, is however undeserving of such a sight.

sn: एहि गच्छ मया भीष्म युद्धकामुद दुर्मद। गृहाण सर्वं कौरव्य रथादि भरतर्षभ॥
en: Come and let us go together, O Bhishma, who are hard to vanquish in battle and desirous of war; take, O son of Kuru, your chariots etc. O foremost among the Bharatas,

sn: इति ब्रवाणां तमहं रामं परपुरंजयम्। प्रणम्य शिरसा राममेवमस्त्वित्यथाब्रुवम्॥
en: To Rama the conquered of enemies towns who thus said then I bowed my head and said "Be it so."

sn: एवमुक्त्वा ययौ रामः कुरुक्षेत्रं युयुत्सया। प्रविश्य नगरं चाहं सत्यवत्यै न्यवेदयम्॥
en: Rama, saying this, went to Kurukshetra with the desire of war and I too entering the city submitted every thing to Satyavati.

sn: ततः कृतस्वस्त्ययनो मात्रा च प्रतिनन्दितः। द्विजातीन् वाच्य पुण्याहं स्वस्ति चैव महाद्युते॥
en: Then after performing propitiatory rites and being blessed by my mother and asking the twice born to bless me,

sn: रथमास्थाय रुचिरं राजतं पाण्डुरैर्हयैः। सूपस्करं स्वधिष्ठानं वैयाघ्रपरिवारणम्॥
en: I mounted a beautiful chariot made of silver and drawn by white horses, beautiful to look at, furnished with good seats, and covered with tiger skins.

sn: उपपन्नं महाशस्त्रैः सर्वोपकरणान्वितम्। तत्कुलीनेन वीरेण हयशास्त्रविदाणे॥
en: It was also furnished with great weapons and all other necessary things and guided by a charioteer of good birth well versed in the art of the management of horses,

sn: यत्तुं सूतेन शिष्टेन बहुशो दृष्टकर्मणा। दंशितः पाण्डुरेणाहं कवचेन वपुष्मता॥
en: Careful and well trained in battle and who had seen many deeds of bravery. I too, with my body covered with a white coat of mail,

sn: पाण्डुरं कार्मुकं गृह्य प्राया भरतसत्तम। पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि॥
en: And taking a white bow, went out, O best among the Bharatas with a white umbrella held over my head.

sn: पाण्डुरैश्चापि व्यजनैर्वीज्यमानो नराधिप। शुक्लवासाः सितोष्णीषः सर्वशुक्लविभूषणः॥
en: I was also fanned by white fans, O ruler of men. I was clad with white garments, white head dress and all my ornaments were white.

sn: स्तूयमानो जयाशीभिनिष्क्रम्य गजसाह्वयात्। कुरुक्षेत्रं रणक्षेत्रमुपायां भरतर्षभ॥
en: I went out of the city called after the elephant, being eulogized with prayers for my victory and approached the site of battle namely Kurukshetra.

sn: ते हयाश्चोदितास्तेन सूतेन परमाहवे। अवहन् मां भृशं राजन् मनोमारुतरंहसः॥
en: Those horses fleet as the mind or the wind, urged by that charioteer, took me, O king, to the great battle.

sn: गत्वाहं तत् कुरुक्षेत्रं स च रामः प्रतापवान्। युद्धाय सहसा राजन् पराक्रान्तौ परस्परम्॥
en: Myself as also that Rama endued with luster having reached Kurukshetra was each desirous of showing our prowess.

sn: ततः संदर्शनेऽतिष्ठं रामस्यातितपस्विनः। प्रगृह्य शङ्खप्रवरं ततः प्राधममुत्तमम्॥
en: Coming within the sight of that excellent ascetic Rama, I took my good conch and loudly blew it.

sn: ततस्तत्र द्विजा राजंस्तापसाश्च वनौकसः। अपश्यन्त रणं दिव्यं देवाः सेन्द्रगणास्तदा॥
en: At the time, O king, there were ascetics and other dwellers of the forest as well as groups of gods with Indra at their head to see that fight.

sn: ततो दिव्यानि माल्यानि प्रादुरासंस्ततस्ततः। वादित्राणि च दिव्यानि मेघवृन्दानि चैव ह॥
en: There were seen at the time divine garlands and divine music and masses of clouds.

sn: ततस्ते तापसाः सर्वे भार्गवस्यानुयायिनः। प्रेक्षकाः समपद्यन्त परिवार्य रणाजिरम्॥
en: Then did all the devotees, the followers of the scion of Bhrigu's race, become the spectators and surround us.

sn: ततो मामब्रवीद् देवी सर्वभूतहितैषिणी। माता स्वरूपिणी राजन् किमिदं ते चिकीर्षितम्॥
en: Then did my divine mother, doing good to all creatures, in her own form say to me, O king, "what is this desired by you?

sn: गत्वाहं जामदग्न्यं तु प्रयाचिष्ये कुरूद्वह। भीष्मेण सह मा योत्सी: शिष्येणेति पुनः पुनः॥
en: O supporter of the Kuru race, going to the son of Jamadagni I shall beg of him again and again saying: Do not fight with Bhishma.

sn: मा मैवं पुत्र निर्बन्धं कुरु विप्रेण पार्थिव। जामदग्न्येन समरे योद्धमित्येव भद्यत्॥
en: Do not, my son fight thus with a Brahmana, O ruler of the earth, do not fight with the son of Jamadagni;" it was thus that she reproved me.

sn: किन्न वै क्षत्रियहणो हरतुल्यपराक्रमः। विदितः पुत्रः रामस्ते यतस्तं योद्भुमिच्छसि॥
en: He has strength similar to that of Hara and he is the exterminator of the Kshatriya race, Rama with whom you desire to fight is well known to you.

sn: ततोऽहमब्रुवं देवीमभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः। सर्वं तद् भरतश्रेष्ठ यथावृत्तं स्वयंवरे॥
en: Then did I say to that goddess after bowing to her and clasping my hands all that had happened in the election of husband, O foremost among the Bharatas.

sn: यथा च रामो राजेन्द्र मया पूर्वं प्रचोदितः। काशिराजसुतायाश्च यथा कर्म पुरातनम्॥
en: I told her also the way Rama had been spoken to by me, O chief among kings, and the old doings of the daughter of the king of the Kashis.

sn: ततः सा राममभ्येत्य जननी मे महानदी। मदर्षं तमृर्षि वीक्ष्य क्षमयामास भार्गवम्॥
en: Then my mother, the great river, going to Rama and trying to entreat that Rishi, that scion of Bhrigu's race for my sake,

sn: भीष्मेण सह मा योत्सीः शिष्येणेति वचोऽब्रवीत्। स च तामाह याचन्तीं भीष्ममेव निवर्तय। न च मे कुरुते काममित्यहं तमुपागमम्॥
en: Said these words: “Do not fight with Bhishma for he is your pupil” and he too said to her who was beseeching him. “Turn back the purpose of Bhishma. I am here because he does not perform what I desire."

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो गङ्गा सुतस्नेहाद् भीष्मं पुनरुपागमत्। न चास्याश्चाकरोद् वाक्यं क्रोधपर्याकुलेक्षणः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then did Ganga, out of affection for her son, come again to Bhishma but he with eyes expanded with wrath did not attend to her words.

sn: अथादृश्यत धर्मात्मा भृगुश्रेष्ठो महातपाः। आह्वयामास च तदा युद्धाय द्विजसत्तमः॥
en: Then did the great devotee of virtuous soul, the foremost of the race of Bhrigu present himself to his view and that best among the twice born summoned him to fight.

sn: भीष्म उवाच तमहं स्मयन्निव रणे प्रत्यभाष व्यवस्थितम्। भूमिष्ठं नोत्सहे योद्धं भवन्तं रथमास्थितः॥
en: Bhishma said Laughingly I said to him who stood there for battle: Myself riding on a chariot I do not venture to fight with you who are on the ground.

sn: आरोह स्यन्दनं वीर कवचं च महाभुजा बधान समरे राम यदि यो« मयेच्छसि॥
en: Mount on a chariot, O hero, and adjust your coat of mail, O you of long arms if, O Rama, you desire to fight with me.

sn: ततो मामब्रवीद् रामः स्मयमानो रणाजिरे। रथो मे मेदिनी भीष्म वाहा वेदाः सदश्ववत्॥
en: Then did Rama say to me laughingly in the field of battle: "The earth is chariot, O Bhishma, and the Vedas carry me like good horses.

sn: सूतश्च मातरिश्वा वै कवचं वेदमातरः। सुसंवीतो रणे ताभिर्योत्स्येऽहं कुरुनन्दन॥
en: The wind is my driver, and the mothers of the Vedas (Gayatri, Savitri and Sarasvati) constitute my coat of mail. Well protected by these, in battle, I shall fight, O you delighter of the Kurus."

sn: एवं ब्रुवाणो गान्धारे रामो मां सत्यविक्रमः। शरवातेन महता सर्वतः प्रत्यवारयत्॥
en: Saying thus, O son of Gandhari, Rama of true prowess covered me on all sides with a thick shower of arrows.

sn: ततोऽपश्यं जामदग्न्यं रथमध्ये व्यवस्थितम्। सर्वायुधवरे श्रीमत्यद्भुतोपमदर्शने॥
en: Then did I see the son of Jamadagni seated on a car holding all the principal weapons, endued with beauty and appearing wonderful to the sight.

sn: मनसा विहते पुण्ये विस्तीर्णे नगरोपमे। दिव्याश्चयुजि संनद्धे काञ्चनेन विभूषिते॥
en: The car was created by his will force and was like a holy and spacious city with celestial horses yoked to it and well protected and ornamented with gold.

sn: कवचेन महाबाहो सोमार्ककृतलक्ष्मणा। धनुर्धरो बद्धतूणो बद्धगोधाङ्गलित्रवान्॥
en: He was also clad in a coat of mail, O you of long arms, looking like the sun and moon, wielding a bow furnished with a quiver and with his fingers protected by gloves.

sn: सारथ्यं कृतवांस्त्र युयुत्सोरकृतव्रणः। सखा वेदविदत्यन्तं दयितो भार्गवस्य ह॥
en: Akritavrana, desirous of fighting, performed the office of the charioteer in that battle. He was the dear friend of that descendant Bhrigu and very well versed in Vedas.

sn: आह्वयानः स मां युद्धे मनो हर्षयतीव मे। पुनः पुनरभिक्रोशन्नभियाहीति भार्गवः॥
en: When he challenged me to fight my heart was very much pleased. The descendant of Bhrigu said to me again and again "come, come.”

sn: तमादित्यमिवोद्यन्तमनाधृष्यं महाबलम्। क्षत्रियान्तकरं राममेकमेकः समासदम्॥
en: Then did I approach him who was blazing like the sun, incapable of being vanquished and endued with great strength. Alone I approached Rama, the exterminator of the Kshatriya race.

sn: ततोऽहं बाणपातेषु त्रिषु वाहान् निगृह्य वै। अवतीर्यं धनुय॑स्य पदातिर्ऋषिसत्तमम्॥
en: After receiving three showers of arrows I stopped my horses and dismounting and putting aside my bow, I went on foot to that best among the Rishis.

sn: अभ्यागच्छं तदा राममर्चिष्यन् द्विजसत्तमम्। अभिवाद्य चैनं विधिवदब्रुवं वाक्यमुत्तमम्॥
en: And coming before him I worshipped Rama the best among the twice born and after saluting him addressed him suitably in these excellent words.

sn: योत्स्ये त्वया रणे राम सदृशेनाधिकेन वा। गुरुणा धर्मशीलेन जयमाशास्व मे विभो॥
en: Whether you are equal to me or superior I shall fight with you, my lord, though you are my virtuous preceptor. Bless me that I may obtain victory.

sn: राम उवाच एवमेतत् कुरुश्रेष्ठ कर्तव्य भूतिमिच्छता! धर्मो ह्येष महाबाहो विशिष्टैः सह युध्यताम्॥
en: Rama said O foremost among the Kurus, such should be done by one who desires prosperity. It is virtuous, O you of long arms, to fight with those that are well known.

sn: शपेयं त्वां न चेदेवमागच्छेथा विशाम्पते। युध्यस्व त्वं रणे यत्तो धैर्यमालम्ब्य कौरव॥
en: If, O lord of the universe, you had not thus come to me I would have cursed you; fight you in battle with patience, O son of Kuru.

sn: न तु ते जयमाशासे त्वां विजेतुमहं स्थितः। गच्छ युध्यस्व धर्मेण प्रीतोऽस्मि चरितेन ते॥
en: I cannot bless you for victory, for I myself am standing here to vanquish you Go, fight fairly, I am pleased with your conduct.

sn: ततोऽहं तं नमस्कृत्य रथमारुह्य सत्वरः। प्राध्यापयं रणे शङ्ख पुनर्हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: Then did I, after saluting him, quickly mount my chariot and again blew loudly my conch in the field of battle, a conch set with gold.

sn: ततो युद्धं समभवन्मम तस्य च भारत। दिवसान् सुबहून् राजन् परस्परजिगीषया।॥
en: Then did the fight take place between myself and him, O Bharata for a great many days, O king, during which each was desirous of vanquishing the other.

sn: स मे तस्मिन् रणे पूर्वं प्राहरत् कङ्कपत्रिभिः। षष्ट्या शतैश्च नवभिः शराणां नतपर्वणाम्॥
en: In the battle, he first struck me with straight arrows with wings of vulture to the number of six hundred and nine.

sn: चत्वारस्तेन मे वाहाः सूतश्चैव विशाम्पते। पर्तिरुद्धास्तथैवाहं समरे दंशितः स्थितः॥
en: By that shower, my four horses as also my chariot, O lord of the universe, completely covered; but clad in a coat of mail, I myself remained calm.

sn: नमस्कृत्य च देवेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो विशेषतः। तमहं स्मयन्निव रणे प्रत्यभाषं व्यवस्थितम्॥
en: Bowing to the gods and especially to the Brahmanas I laughingly said to him who was standing there for battle. were

sn: ते आचार्यता मानिता मे निर्मर्यादे ह्यपि त्वयि। भूयश्च शृणु मे ब्रह्मन् सम्पदं धर्मसंग्रह।॥
en: I have shown sufficient respect to yourself as a preceptor, though you have paid little regard to me. Listen again, O Brahmana, to what should be done if you want to acquire virtue.

sn: ये ते वेदाः शरीरस्था ब्राह्मण्यं यच्च ते महत्। तपश्च महत् तप्तं न तेभ्यः प्रहराम्यहम्॥
en: The Vedas that are in your body and the great spirit of Brahma that is there and the great asceticism practiced by you, I do not strike at.

sn: प्रहरे क्षत्रधर्मस्य यं राम त्वं समाश्रितः। ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियत्वं हि याति शस्त्रसमुद्यमात्॥
en: I shall strike at your Kshatriya-hood since, O Rama, you have adopted the life of a Kshatriya; a Brahmana becomes a Kshatriya owing to his taking up arms.

sn: पश्य मे धनुषो वीर्यं पश्य बाह्वोर्बलं मम। एष ते कार्मुकं वीर छिनधि निशितेषुणा॥
en: Behold now the strength of my bow; and behold the might of my arms. O hero, I shall cut asunder this bow of yours by my arrows.

sn: तस्याहं निशितं मल्लं चिक्षेप भरतर्षभ। तेनास्य धनुषः कोटि छित्त्वा भूमावपातयम्॥
en: Then did I hurl towards him a broad headed arrow and by it his bow broke into a million pieces and fell to the ground.

sn: तथैव च पृषत्कानां शतानि नतपर्वणाम्। चिक्षेप कङ्कपत्राणां जामदग्न्यरथं प्रति॥
en: In the same way, I shot a hundred arrows furnished with the wings of a vulture on the son of Jamadagni.

sn: काये विषक्तास्तु तदा वायुना समुदीरिताः। चेलुः क्षरन्तो रुधिरं नागा इव च ते शराः॥
en: Piercing through his body and carried along by the wind the arrows sped along dropping blood and acting like serpents.

sn: क्षतजोक्षितसर्वाङ्गः क्षरन् स रुधिरं रणे। बभौ रामस्तदा राजन् मेरुातुमिवोत्सृजन्॥
en: Rama, then with all his body wondered and covered all over with blood, shone in battle like a mountain dropping melted metal.

sn: हेमन्तान्तेऽशोक एव रक्तस्तबकमण्डितः। बभौ रामस्तथा राजन् प्रफुल्ल इव किंशुकः॥
en: He looked like the Ashoka tree, at the end of winter, covered with bunches of red flowers or, O king, like the Kinshuka tree when laden with flowers.

sn: ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय रामः क्रोधसमन्वितः। हेमपुङ्कान् सुनिशिताशरांस्तान् हि ववर्ष सः॥
en: Then did Rama, wrathfully taking up another bow, shoot forth arrows well sharpened and furnished with golden wings.

sn: ते समासाद्य मां रौद्रा बहुधा मर्मभेदिनः। अकम्पयन् महावेगाः सर्पानलविषोपमाः॥
en: Those fierce arrows, which were like flames and poisonous serpents coming from several sides, caused me to tremble at their great force and pierced my very vitals.

sn: तमहं समवष्टभ्य पुनरात्मानमाहवे। शतसंख्यैः शरैः क्रुद्धस्तदा राममवाकिरम्॥
en: Then did I, with wrath, shoot on Rama arrows, hundred in number after summoning all my patience and addressing myself to battle.

sn: स तैरग्न्यर्कसंकाशैः शरैराशीविषोपमैः। शितैरभ्यर्दितो रामो मन्दचेता इवाभवत्॥
en: Rama, struck with those arrows which were like fire or the sun and like poisonous snakes, became like one senseless.

sn: ततोऽहं कृपयाऽऽविष्टो विष्टभ्यात्मानमात्मना। धिग्धिगित्यब्रुवं युद्धं क्षत्रधर्मं च भारत॥
en: Then was I filled with pity and stopped of my own will and said: "Fie, fie on battle and on Kshatriya practices." O Bharata.

sn: असकृच्चाब्रुवं राजन् शोकवेगपरिप्लुतः। अहो बत कृतं पापं मयेदं क्षत्रधर्मणा॥
en: Being filled with grief I said, “I am a vicious man and what sins have been committed by me for observing the duties of a Kshatriya. one

sn: गुरुर्द्विजातिधर्मात्मा यदेवं पीडितः शरैः। ततो न प्राहरं भूयो जामदग्न्याय भारत॥
en: For I have hurt with my arrows my preceptor who is a Brahmana of a virtuous soul. After that O Bharata I did not strike at Jamadagni's son.

sn: अथावताप्य पृथिवीं पूषा दिवससंक्षये। जगामास्तं सहस्रांशुस्ततो युद्धमुपारमत्॥
en: At this time, at the end of day, the sun of a thousand rays after heating the earth, went to his rooms and the fight too closed for the day.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: भीष्म उवाच आत्मनस्तु ततः सूतो हयानां च विशाम्पते। मम चापनयामास शल्यान् कुशलसम्मतः॥
en: Bhishma said Then did the charioteer, o lord of the universe, who was regarded as being skillful in such matters, draw forth the arrows from his own body and those of the horses as well as that of myself.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: स्नातापवृत्तैस्तुरगैर्लब्धतोयैरविह्वलैः। प्रभाते चोदिते सूर्ये ततो युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: In the morning, the sun having risen the fight commenced again, the horses (of both parties) having been bathed and allowed to roll on the ground, and given water and thereby refreshed,

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: दृष्ट्वा मां तूर्णमायान्तं दंशितं स्यन्दने स्थितम्। अकरोद् रथमत्यर्थं रामः सज्ज प्रतापवान्॥
en: Seeing me coming quickly with my coat of mail on and seated on my chariot Rama, of great luster, got ready his car very carefully.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततोऽहं राममायान्तं दृष्ट्वा समरकाक्षिणम्। धनुः श्रेष्ठं समुत्सृज्य सहसाऽवतरं स्थात्॥
en: I too, seeing Rama, who was desirous of fight, approaching, keeping aside that best of bows, at once dismounted from my chariot.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: अभिवाद्य तथैवाहं रथमारुह्य भारत। युयुत्सुर्जामदग्न्यस्य प्रमुखे वीतभी: स्थितः॥
en: Having bowed down to him I got on it again and desirous of fight stood before Jamadgna, past the reach of fear.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततोऽहं शरवर्षेण महता समवाकिरम्। स च मां शरवर्षेण वर्षन्तं समवाकिरत्॥
en: Then did I, all on a sudden, cover him with a great shower of arrows: and he too covered me with shower of arrows.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: संक्रुद्धो जामदग्न्यस्तु पुनरेव सुतेजितान्। सम्प्रेषीन्मे शरान् घोरान् दीप्तास्यानुरगानिवा॥
en: The son of Jamadagni worked up with wrath, again shot forth on me fearful and sharp arrows having months blazing like those of serpents.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततोऽहं निशितैर्भल्लैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। अच्छिदं सहसा राजन्नन्तरिक्षे पुनः पुनः॥
en: Then did I at once again and again cut them asunder, O king, by my hundred and thousands of arrows, when they were still in the air.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततस्त्वस्त्राणि दिव्यानि जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्। मयि प्रयोजयामास तान्यहं प्रत्यषेधयम्॥
en: Then did the illustrious son of Jamadagni shoot at me celestial weapons but I thwarted them off, O you of long arms.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: अस्त्रैरेव महाबाहो चिकीर्षनधिकां क्रियाम्। ततो दिवि महान् नादः प्रादुरासीत् समन्ततः॥
en: In fact, O you of long arms, I performed mightier tasks by my weapons on which there was a loud commotion all about, oking.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततोऽहमस्त्रं वायव्यं जामदग्न्ये प्रयुक्तवान्। प्रत्याजघ्ने च तद् रामो गुह्यकास्त्रेण भारत॥
en: Then did I shoot at the son of Jamadagni the weapons called Vayavya but Rama, O Bharata, warded if off by the weapon called Guhyaka.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततोऽहमस्त्रमाग्नेयमनुमन्त्र्य प्रयुक्तवान्। वारुणेनैव तद् रामो वारयामास मे विभुः॥
en: Then did I after repeating suitable incantations shoot the weapon called Agneya ine was but Rama thwarted that weapon called Agneya but Rama thwarted that weapon of mine by one called Varuna, O lord.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: एवमस्त्राणि दिव्यानि रामस्याहमवारयम्। रामश्च मम तेजस्वी दिव्यास्त्रविदरिंदमः॥
en: In this way did I ward off the heavenly weapons of Rama and the energetic Rama too, that chastiser of enemies, conversant with celestial weapons, thwarted off the weapons of mine.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततो मां सव्यतो राजन् रामः कुर्वन् द्विजोत्तमः। उरस्यविध्यत् संक्रुद्धो जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्॥
en: There did that best among the twice-born, Rama, the son of Jamadagni, suddenly turning to the right, pierce me in my breast.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततोऽहं भरतश्रेष्ठ संन्यषीदं रथोत्तमे। ततो मां कश्मलाविष्टं सूतस्तूर्णमुदावहत्॥
en: Then did I foremost among the Bharatas, faint on that best of cars. My charioteer quickly removed who deprived of consciousness.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ग्लायन्तं भरतश्रेष्ठ रामबाणप्रपीडितम्। ततो मामपयातं वै भृशं विद्धमचेतसम्॥
en: O chief among the Bharatas, seeing me afflicted and struck with the arrows of Rama and removed, being deprived of consciousness,

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: रामस्यानुचरा हृष्टाः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा विचुक्रुशुः। अकृतव्रणप्रभृतयः काशिकन्या च भारत॥
en: All the followers of Rama, Akri avrana and others and the daughter of the king of the Kashis all set up a loud shout.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततस्तु लब्धसंज्ञोऽहं ज्ञात्रा सूतमथाब्रुवम्। याहि सूत यतो राम; सज्जोऽहं गतवेदनः॥
en: My consciousness (after a time) having come back I said to my charioteer "O charioteer go where Rama is, I am prepared (for battle) for I have now no pains.”

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततो मामवहत् सूतो हयैः परमशोभितैः। नृत्यद्भिरिव कौरव्य मारुतप्रतिमैर्गतौ॥
en: Then did the charioteer bear me by means of exceedingly beautiful horses which went on dancing as it were, O scion of the Kuru race, and which were of the speed similar of that of the wind.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततोऽहं राममासाद्य बाणवर्षेच कौरव। अवाकिरं सुसंरब्धः संरब्धं च जिगीषया॥
en: Having then come near Rama and being wrathful I shot forth a shower of arrows, O Kaurava, with the desire of gaining victory over that wrathful one.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: तानापतत एवासौ रामो बाणानजिह्मगान्। बाणैरेवाच्छिनत् तूर्णमेकैकं त्रिभिराहवे।॥
en: But that Rama cut asunder those arrows which went along in straight lines, when they were in still in the air, by shooting three arrows for each of mine.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततस्ते सूदिताः सर्वे मम बाणाः सुसंशिताः। रामबाणैर्द्विधा छिन्नाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Then were all of them (Rama's followers) rejoiced at seeing my well furnished arrows cut asunder in two by hundreds and thousands.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततः पुनः शरं दीप्तं सुप्रभं कालसम्मितम्। असृजं जामदग्न्याय रामायाहं जिघांसया॥
en: Then did I shoot at Rama, the son of Jamadgna with the desire of killing him, blazing arrows of good appearance, guided by death itself.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: तेन त्वभिहतो गाढं बाणवेगवशं गतः। मुमोह समरे रामो भूमौ च निपपात ह॥
en: Struck with its force and owing to its impetus, Rama fainted in the field and fell on the ground.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततो हाहाकृतं सर्वं रामे भूतलमाश्रिते। जगद् भारत संविग्नं यथार्कपतने भवेत्॥
en: Rama falling on the ground all began to cry out Alas, Alas, as might be the case, O Bharata, if the sun were to fall on the earth.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: तत एनं समुद्विग्नाः सर्व एवाभिदुद्रुवुः। तपोधनास्ते सहसा काश्या च कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Then did all those ascetics and the princess of Kashi,Odelighter of the race of Kuru, being filled with anxiety, began to comfort him,

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: तत एनं परिष्वज्य शनैराश्वासयंस्तदा। पाणिभिर्जलशीतैश्च जयाशीभिच कौरव॥
en: By embracing him and slowly passing over the palms of their hands rendered cold by water and by blessings of victory, OKaurava.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततः स विह्वलं वाक्यं राम उत्थाय चाब्रवीत्। तिष्ठ भीष्म हतोऽसीति बाणं संधाय कार्मुके।॥
en: Then did Rama, rising up, give vent to these wrathful words:-"Stay, O Bhishma, you are already killed" fixing an arrow to his bow.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: स मुक्तो न्यपतत् तूर्णं सव्ये पार्श्वे महाहवे। येनाहं भृशमुद्विग्नो व्याघूर्णित इव दुमः॥
en: In that great battle that arrow, shot by him, quickly fell on my right side owing to which I was as much agitated as a tree is shaken by a gale.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: हत्वा हयांस्ततो रामः शीघ्रास्त्रेण महाहवे। अवाकिरन्मां विस्रब्धो बाणैस्तैोमवाहिभिः॥
en: Then did Rama, after killing my horses in that great battle, cover me up with clusters of arrows shot with lightness of hand and with such precision that each could carry away with it a single hair of my body,

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततोऽहमपि शीघ्रास्त्रं समरप्रतिवारणम्। अवासृज महाबाहो तेऽन्तराधिष्ठिता: शराः॥
en: Then did I too shoot my weapons with lightness of hand so as toward off his arrows, O you of long arms, and those arrows (of mine and of Rama) stayed in the air (without falling down.)

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: रामस्य मम चैवाशु व्योमावृत्य समन्ततः। न स्म सूर्यः प्रतपति शरजालसमावृतः॥
en: The arrows shot by Rama and myself completely covered the sky so that even the sun, covered by a net of arrows, could not give forth its heat.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: मातरिश्वा ततस्तस्मिन् मेघरुद्ध इवाभवत्। ततो वायोः प्रकम्पाच्च सूर्यस्य च गभस्तिभिः॥
en: The very wind then shut up in that net could not pass through it. Then owing to the wind being shut up, and the sun too not being able to impart its rays,

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: अभिघातप्रभावाच्च पावकः समजायत। शराः स्वसमुत्थेन प्रदीप्ताचित्रभानुना॥ ते
en: And from the clashing of weapons there sprang up a fire and those arrows were ablaze owing to the fire brought into existence by them.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: भूमौ सर्वे तदा राजन् भस्मभूताः प्रपेदिरे। तदा शतसहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च॥
en: At the time, O king, every body on earth, was reduced to ashes. At that time, hundreds and thousands, and tens of thousands and hundreds of thousands,

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: अयुतान्यथ खर्वाणि निखर्वाणि च कौरव। रामः शराणां संक्रुद्धो मयि तूर्णं न्यपातयत्॥
en: And millions and hundreds of millions of Rama's arrows were shot by that wrathful one, all in quick succession.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततोऽहं तानपि रणे शरैराशीविषोपमैः। संछिद्य भूमौ नृपते पातयेयं नगानिव॥
en: In that battle, I too, by my arrows resembling poisonous snakes, cutting asunder those arrows, made them fill up the earth like snakes cut up in fragments, O ruler of men.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: एवं तदभवद् युद्धं तदा भरतसत्तम। संध्याकाले व्यतीते तु व्यपायात् स च मे गुरुः॥
en: Such was the wonderful fight that took place at the time, O best among the Bharatas. Evening having passed away my preceptor also retired.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: भीष्म उवाच समागतस्य रामेण पुनरेवातिदारुणम्। अन्येधुस्तुमुलं युद्धं तदा भरतसत्तम॥
en: Bhishma said O best among the Bharatas, the next day a hard and terrible fight took place with Rama who had come back.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततो दिव्यास्त्रविच्छूरो दिव्यान्यस्त्राण्यनेकशः। अयोजयत् स धर्मात्मा दिवसे दिवसे विभुः॥
en: On that occasion did that virtuous souled hero, conversant with celestial weapons, hurl at me, day by day, many celestial weapons.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: तान्यहं तत्प्रतीघातैरस्त्रैरस्त्राणि भारत। व्यधमं तुमुले युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा सुदुस्त्यजान्॥
en: Those weapons I met by weapons capable of meeting them, o Bharata, in that terrific struggle, casting off hopes of life which is so hard to sacrifice.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: अस्त्रैरस्त्रेषु बहुधा हतेष्वेव च भारत। अक्रुध्यत महातेजास्त्यक्तप्राणः स संयुगे॥
en: When in this way many weapons were neutralized and baffled by other weapons, O Bharata, Rama, of great energy, fought in that battle with me, casting off hopes of life.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततः शक्तिं प्राहिणोद् घोरूपामस्त्रे रुद्ध जामदग्न्यो महात्मा। कालोत्सृष्टां प्रज्वलितामिवोल्का संदीप्तानां तेजसा व्याप्य लोकम्॥
en: Seeing his weapons thus baffled then did the great-souled son of Jamadagni hurl at me the fire weapon called Shakti with its extremely ablaze and shining like a meteor which came to have been shot by Death himself and which pervaded the earth with its effulgence.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततोऽहं तामिषुभिर्दीप्यमानां समायान्तीमन्तकालार्कदीप्ताम्। छित्त्वा त्रिधा पातयामास भूमौ ततो ववौ पवनः पुण्यगन्धिः॥
en: I too cut asunder that blazing weapon which was coming against me like the blazing sun at the time of the destruction of the universe and felled it to the earth cut up into three pieces by my felled it to the earth cut of into three pieces by my arrows: then did sweetsmelling breeze blow about me.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: तस्यां छिन्नायां क्रोधदीप्तोऽथ रामः शक्ती?राः प्राहिणोद् द्वादशान्याः। तासां रूपं भारत नोत शक्यं तेजस्वित्वाल्लाघवाच्चैव वक्तुम्॥
en: That one being cut asunder, Rama excited with wrath, hurled twelve other fierce weapons at me. Their appearance, O Bharata, I cannot describe owing to their effulgence and speed.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: किं त्वेवाहं विह्वलः सम्प्रदृश्य दिग्भ्यः सर्वास्ता महोल्का इवाग्नेः। नानारूपास्तेजसोग्रेण दीप्ता यथाऽऽदित्या द्वादश लोकसंक्षये॥
en: How indeed can I do so? I was struck with fear at seeing all those arrows flying towards me from diverse directions and assuming diverse forms and blazing with effulgence as the twelve suns that rise at the time of the destruction of the universe.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततो जालं बाणमयं विवृत्तं संदृश्य भित्त्वा शरजालेन राजन्। द्वादशेषून् प्राहिणवं रणेऽहं ततः शक्तीरप्यधमं घोररूपाः॥
en: Seeing myself surrounded by a net of arrows, I neutralized them by another net of arrows from myself, O king and then in that battle, I shot twelve arrows by which I neutralized even those terrible looking arrows.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततो राजञ्जामदग्न्यो महात्मा शक्ती?रा व्याक्षिपद्धेमदण्डाः। विचित्रिताः काञ्चनपट्टनद्धा यथा महोल्का ज्वलितास्तथा ताः॥
en: Then did the great souled of Jamadagni, O king, hurl at me fierce arrows having golden handles which were variegated and furnished with golden wings. They were blazing like great meteors.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ताश्चाप्युचाश्चमर्णा वारयित्वा खड्ड्रेनाजौ पातयित्वा नेरन्द्र। बाणैर्दिव्यैर्जामदग्न्यस्य संख्ये दिव्यानश्वानभ्यवर्ष ससूतान्॥
en: These too, O chief among men, I caused to fall to the ground with the heel of my sword and shield and then shot forth celestial arrows at the celestial horses of Rama and his charioteer in that battle.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: निर्मुक्तानां पन्नागानां सरूपा दृष्ट्वा शक्तीहेमचित्रा निकृत्ताः। प्रादुश्चक्रे दिव्यमस्त्रं महात्मा क्रोधाविष्टो हैहयेशप्रमाथी॥
en: son Seeing those arrows, decked with gold, flying at him like serpents let loose from their holes, the great-souled smiter of the lord of the Haihayas became excited with wrath and again brought forth celestial weapons.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततः श्रेण्यः शलभानामिवोग्राः समापेतुर्विशिखाना प्रदीप्ताः। समाचिनोच्चापि भृशं शरीरं हयान् सूतं सरथं चैव मह्यम्॥
en: Then did a cluster of blazing and fierce arrows looking like a swarm of locusts completely overwhelm my body and my horses and chariot.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: रथः शरैर्मे निचितः सर्वतोऽभूत् तथा वाहाः सारथिश्चैव राजन्। युगं रथेषां च तथैव चक्रे तथैवाक्षः शरकृत्तोऽथ भग्नः॥
en: By those arrows were my chariot, and all the horses and the charioteer completely covered. The yoke, shaft, wheels and wheel spoken were all broken by the force of that downpour of arrows.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: ततस्तस्मिन् बाणवर्षे व्यतीते शरौघेण प्रत्यवर्षं गुरुं तम्। स विक्षतो मार्गणैर्ब्रह्मराशिदेहादसक्तं मुमुचे भूरि रक्तम्॥
en: That down pour of arrows having been finished, I too showered arrows on my preceptor. The mass of Brahmic merit pierced with the shower of arrows began to give forth copious discharges of blood.

description: The combat between Bhishma and Rama
sn: स्तथैवाहं सुभृशं गाढविद्धः। ततो युद्धं व्यरमच्चापरावे भानावस्तं प्रति याते महीध्रम्॥
en: But in the same measure as Rama was overwhelmed with my arrows, was I also pierced hard with his. When the sun set in the afternoon behind the hills in the west, our combat came to an end.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: भीष्म उवाच ततः प्रभाते राजेन्द्र सूर्ये विमलतां गते। भार्गवस्य मया सार्धं पुनयुद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Bhishma said In the morning when the sun had risen, there again began the fight between myself and the scion of the Bhrigu's race.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततोऽभ्रान्ते रथे तिष्ठन् रामः प्रहरतां वरः। ववर्ष शरजालानि मयि मेघ इवाचले॥
en: That foremost of smiters, Rama then seated on a quick-going car, showered nets of arrows on me that fell like clouds on a mountain.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततः सूतो मम सुहच्छरवर्षेण ताडितः। अपयातो रथोपस्थान्मनो मम विषादयन्॥
en: Then that well-wisher of mine, my charioteer, overpowered by that shower of arrows, fell down from his place in the car causing anxiety of my mind.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततः सूतो ममात्यर्थं कश्मलं प्राविशन्महत्। पृथिव्यां च शराघातानिपपात मुमोह च॥
en: Then did my charioteer fall into a deep trance and by reason of his being struck with arrows fell down in the earth and became senseless.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततः सूतोऽजहात् प्राणान् रामबाणप्रपीडितः। मुहूर्तादिव राजेन्द्र मां च भीराविशत् तदा॥
en: Then did the charioteer give up his life being struck with the arrows of Rama and for an instant, О chief among kings, I too was afraid at the time.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततः सूते हते तस्मिन् क्षिपतस्तस्य मे शरान्। प्रमत्तमनसो रामः प्राहिणोन्मृत्युसम्मितम्॥
en: On my charioteer being killed, and my mind being excited Rama hurled at me arrows charged with death.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततः सूतव्यसनिनं मां स भार्गवः। शरेणाभ्यहनन् गाढं विकृष्य बलवद्धनुः॥
en: Then did that scion of the Bhrigu race having drawn up his bow with great force hurtle an arrow at me who was overwhelmed at the calamity of my charioteer.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: स मे भुजान्तरे राजन् निपत्य रुधिराशनः। मयैव सह राजेन्द्र जगाम वसुधातलम्॥
en: That blood-drinking shaft, having fallen on my arrow, came down on the earth taking me along with it.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: मत्वा तु निहतं रामस्ततो मां भरतर्षभ। मेघवद् विननादोच्चैहषे च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Rama too, thinking me to be dead, O best among the Bharatas, roared aloud like the clouds and sent again and again forth a loud shout along with his followers.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: तथा तु पतिते राजन् मयि रामो मुदा युतः। उदक्रोशन्महानादं सह तैरनुयायिभिः॥
en: Myself having fallen down, Rama, being pleased, gave forth a loud shout along with his followers.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: मम तत्राभवन् ये तु कुरवः पार्श्वतः स्थिताः। आगता अपि युद्धं तज्जनास्तत्र दिदृक्षवः। आर्तिं परमिकां जग्मुस्ते तदा पतिते मयि॥
en: The Kurus who were there at my side and those who came there desirous of seeing the fight, became overwhelmed with deep sorrow at my fall.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततोऽपश्यं पतितो राजसिहं द्विजानष्टौ सूर्यहुताशनाभान्। परिवार्य तस्थुः स्वबाहुभिः परिधार्याजिमध्ये॥
en: When I had fallen down, I saw O lion among kings, eight twice-born ones blazing like the sun. They there surrounding me and supporting me by their arrows in the midst of the field.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: रक्ष्यमाणश्च तैविप्रैर्नाहं भूमिमुपास्पृशम्। अन्तरिक्षे धृतो ह्यस्मि तैर्विप्रैर्बान्धवैरिव॥
en: Being supported by the twice-born, I did not touch the ground and was held in the air by them as by friends.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: श्वसन्निवान्तरिक्षे च जलबिन्दुभिरुक्षितः। ते मां समन्तात् ततस्ते ब्राह्मणा राजन्नब्रुवन् परिगृह्य माम्॥
en: They sprinkled drops of water on me as I was breathing heavily and then those Brahmanas, bearing me up, said to me.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: मामैरिति समं सर्वे स्वस्ति तेऽस्त्विति चासकृत्। ततस्तेषामहं वाग्भिस्तर्पितः सहसोत्थितः। मातरं सरिता श्रेष्ठामपश्यं रथमास्थिताम्॥
en: "Fear not, you will still be prosperous" and I suddenly stood up, comforted at those words of theirs, and saw my mother, the best among river, seated on the car.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: हयाश्च मे संगृहीतास्तयासन् महानद्या संयति कौरवेन्द्र। पादौ जनन्याः प्रतिगृह्य चाहं तथा पितॄणां रथमभ्यरोहम्॥
en: I also saw my heroes held by that great river, O chief among the son of Kuru. Having touched the feet of my mother and worshipping the memory of my ancestors, I ascended my chariot.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ररक्ष सा मां सरथं हयाश्चोपस्कराणि च। तामहं प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा पुनरेव व्यसर्जयम्॥
en: She protected myself with my chariot and horses and the weapons for battle and with clasped hands I sent her away.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततोऽहं स्वयमुद्यम्य हयांस्तान् वातरंहसः। अयुध्यं जामदग्न्येन निवृत्तेऽहनि भारत॥
en: I then myself held the reins of those horses which had the speed of the wind and fought with the son of Jamadagni till the close of the day.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततोऽहं भरतश्रेष्ठ वेगवन्तं महाबलम्। अमुचं समरे बाणं रामाय हृदयच्छिदम्॥
en: Then O foremost among the Bharatas, in that battle, I shot forth an arrow of great strength and speed on Rama that struck his heart.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततो जगाम वसुधां मम बाणप्रपीडितः। जानुभ्यां धनुरुत्सृज्य रामो मोहवशं गतः॥
en: He then fell down on his knees on the earth, overwhelmed by my arrow with his bow loosened from his grasp, and swooned away.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततस्तस्मिन् निपतिते रामे भूरिसहस्रदे। आवर्जलदा व्योम क्षरन्तो रुधिरं बहु॥
en: When Rama, the giver of thousands, had fallen down, clouds covered the sky discharging copious blood.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: उल्काश्च शतश: पेतुः सनिर्घाता: सकम्पनाः। अर्कं च सहसा दीप्तं स्वर्भानुरभिसंवृणोत्॥
en: Meteors too fell by hundreds and thousands and roared, making everything shake. And suddenly Rahu swallowed the shining sun.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ववुश्च वाताः परुषाश्चलिता च वसुन्धरा। गृध्रा बलाच कङ्काश्च परिपेतुर्मुदा युताः॥
en: High winds blew and the earth trembled and the cultures and cranes and crowns came down with joy.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: दीप्तायां दिशि गोमायुर्दारुणं मुहुरुन्नदत्। अनाहता दुन्दुभयो विनेदु शनि:स्वनाः॥
en: The cardinal points were ablaze and jackals began to cry aloud every moment; and drums untouched began to give forth harsh sound.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: एतदौत्पातिकं सर्वं घोरमासीद् भयंकरम्। विसंज्ञकल्पे धरणीं गते रामे महात्मनि॥
en: All these frightful omens occurred on the high-souled Rama falling down on the earth in a swoon.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततो वै सहसोत्थाय रामो मामभ्यवर्तत। पुनयुद्धाय कौरव्य विह्वलः क्रोधमूर्छितः॥
en: Then Rama, rising up suddenly, approached me, with a view to a renewal of fight, O son of Kuru, being himself excited and made senseless by anger.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: आददानो महाबाहुः कार्मुकं तालसंनिभम्। ततो मय्याददानं त राममेव न्यवारयन्॥
en: The one of long arms took up his bow which was strong and also took up an arrow; but I withstood Rama equipped as he was.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: महर्षयः कृपायुक्ताः क्रोधाविष्टोऽथ भार्गवः। स मेऽहरदमेयात्मा शरं कालानलोपमम्॥
en: The great Rishis were filled with pity and that descendant of Bhrigu was filled with anger and he, the one of immeasurable soul, too neutralized my arrow which was like the fire that rages at the time of the universal destruction.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततो रविर्मन्दमरीचिमण्डलो जगामास्तं पांसुपुञ्जावगूढः। निशा व्यगाहत् सुखशीतमारुता ततो युद्धं प्रत्यवहारयावः॥
en: Then did the sun, covered by dust and its effulgence clouded, slowly set and night came on with its cool breezes and then we desisted from war.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: एवं राजन्नवहारो बभुव ततः पुनर्विमलेऽभूत् सुघोरम्। कल्यं कल्यं विंशतिं वै दिनानि तथैव चान्यानि दिनानि त्रीणि॥
en: In this way, Oking, was there an end to the fight and again was there a fierce encounter at the dawn of day and so on day after day for three twenty days.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: भीष्म उवाच ततोऽहं निशि राजेन्द्र प्रणम्य शिरसा तदा। ब्राह्मणानां पितॄणां च देवतानां च सर्वशः॥
en: Bhishma said Then during the night, 0 great king, having bowed to all the Brahmanas, my fore fathers, all the gods,

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: नक्तंचराणां भूतानां राजन्यानां विशाम्पते। शयनं प्राप्य रहिते मनसा समचिन्तयम्॥
en: To all those beings that walk about in the night, to all elements, earth, water, fir, air and the sky, and to all kings, O lord of earth, I lay down on my bed, and being all alone, I began to reflect (thus).

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: जामदग्न्येन मे युद्धमिदं परमदारुणम्। अहानि च बहून्यद्य वर्तते सुमहात्ययम्॥
en: This terrible battle, between myself and Jamadgnya, being as it is of high and mighty consequence, lasted for many a day.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: न च रामं महावीर्यं शक्नोमि रणमूर्धनि। विजेतुं समरे विप्रं जामदग्न्यं महाबलम्॥
en: And yet I have not been able to vanquish, in fight on the field of battle, this twice-born Rama, known as Jamadgnya who is of great might and energy.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: यदि शक्यो मया जेतुं जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्। दैवतानि प्रसन्नानि दर्शयन्तु निशां मम॥
en: I indeed, it lies in my power to vanquish this powerful son of Jamadagni, let the gods, well-pleased, show themselves to me during the night.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततो निशि च राजेन्द्र प्रसुप्तः शरविक्षतः। दक्षिणेनेह पार्श्वन प्रभातसमये तदा।॥
en: Then, O great king, mangled with arrows, as I lay asleep that night on my right, at about dawn came,

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततोऽहं विप्रमुख्यैस्तैर्यैरस्मि पतितो रथात्। उत्थापितो धृतश्चैव मा भैरिति च सान्त्वितः॥
en: Those foremost of Brahmanas by whom I had been raised up when I had fallen down from chariot, and who had held me and comforted me, saying, “Fear not.”

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: त एव मां महाराज स्वप्नदर्शनमेत्य वै। परिवार्याब्रुवन् वाक्यं तन्निबोध कुरूद्वह॥
en: Even they, O great king, showing themselves to me (during my sleep) in a dream, stood around me, and spoke these words; Hear them, O perpetuator of Kuru's race,

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: उत्तिष्ठ मा भैर्गाङ्गेय न भयं तेऽस्ति किंचन। रक्षामहे त्वां कौरव्य स्वशरीरं हि नो भवान्॥
en: Rise up and do not fear, O son of Ganga, you have not the least fear, for we will protect you, O son, who are own body.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: न त्वां रामो रणे जेता जामदग्न्यः कथंचन। त्वमेव समरे रामं विजेता भरतर्षभ॥
en: Rama, the son of Jamadagni, by no means will vanquish you in battle. (Rather), you will vanquish Rama in battle, O best of Bharata's race.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: इदमस्त्रं सुदयितं प्रत्यभिज्ञास्यते भवान्। विदितं हि तवाप्येतत् पूर्वस्मिन् देहधारणे॥
en: This well-beloved weapon you will recognize for it was known to you in your previous birth.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: प्राजापत्यं विश्वकृतं प्रस्वापं नाम भारत। न हीदं वेद रामोऽपि पृथिव्यां वा पुमान् क्वचित्।।१२
en: It appertains to the lord of all creatures (Brahma) and was manufactured by the divine architect; it is named Prasvapa, O Bharata. It is not known even to Rama nor to any body else on the earth.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: तत् स्मरस्व महाबाहो भृशं संयोजयस्व च। उपस्थास्यति राजेन्द्र स्वयमेव तवानघ॥
en: Recollect it therefore, O you of mighty arms, and apply it steadily and with all your strength. It will come to you of itself, O you great king and sinless one.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: येन सर्वान् महावीर्यान् प्रशासिष्यसि कौरव। न च रामः क्षयं गन्ता तेनास्त्रेण नराधिप॥
en: By this weapon, by which O son of Kuru, you will hold in check all persons of mighty energy, Rama will not be killed outright, O king of men.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: एनसा न तु संयोग प्राप्स्यसे जातु मानद। स्वप्स्यते जामदग्न्योऽसौ त्वद्वाणबलपीडितः॥
en: No crime will therefore attach to you o giver of honors. And this son of Jamadagni will fall asleep, afflicted by the might of this weapon of yours.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततो जित्वा त्वमेवैनं पुनरुत्थापयिष्यसि। अस्त्रेण दयितेनाजो भीष्म सम्बोधनेन वै॥
en: Having thus vanquished him, you yourself will raise him up again to the battle-field by that dear weapon, O Bhishma, known as Samabodhana.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: एवं कुरुष्व कौरव्य प्रभाते रथमास्थितः। प्रसुप्तं वा मृतं वेति तुल्यं मन्यामहे वयम्॥
en: Do as we tell you, O son of Kuru, seated on your chariot at day-break. Asleep or dead, We consider it to be the same.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: न च रामेण मर्तव्यं कदाचिदपि पार्थिव। ततः समुत्पन्नमिदं प्रस्वापं युज्यतामिति॥
en: O king, Rama will not die by any means. Apply therefore, this (weapon) Prasvapa, happily brought for you.

description: The fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: इत्युक्त्वाऽतर्हिता राजन् सर्व एव द्विजोत्तमाः। अष्टौ सदृशरूपास्ते सर्वे भासुरमूर्तयः॥
en: Having said this all those best of Brahmanas vanished, O king. They were eight in number, resembling one another in appearance, and shone brightly, having no material bodies.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: भीष्म उवाच ततो रात्रो व्यतीतायं प्रतिबुद्धोऽस्मि भारत। ततः संचिन्त्य वै स्वप्नमवापं हर्षमुत्तमम्॥
en: Bhishma said When they had passed away, I awoke. O Bharata; I was filled with great joy as I thought of the dream.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततः समभवद् युद्धं मम तस्य च भारत। तुमुलं सर्वभूतानां लोमहर्षणमद्भुतम्॥
en: Then begin that mighty battle between him and me, O Bharata, which was wonderful and which made the hairs of all creatures stand on end.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततो बाणमयं वर्ष ववर्ष मयि भार्गवः। न्यवारयमहं तच्च शरजालेन भारत॥
en: Then Bhargava rained on me a shower of arrows, which I baffled by a (like) shower of arrows, O Bharata.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततः परमसंक्रुद्धः पुनरेव महातपाः। ह्यस्तनेन च कोपेन शक्ति वै प्राहिणोन्मयि॥
en: Thereupon he, of great asceticism, was greatly incensed and remembering what had happened the day before, he hurled, with anger, a dart at me,

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शी यमदण्डसमप्रभाम्। ज्वलन्तीमग्निवत् संख्ये लेलिहानां समन्ततः॥
en: Which was as hard as Indra's thunderbolt, was equal in effulgence, to the mace of Yama, (god of death) blazing like a flaming fire and licking as it were with its tongue, all quarters of the battle-field.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: पर्वतः॥ ततो भरतशार्दूल घिष्ण्यमाकाशगं यथा। स मामभ्यवधीत् तूर्णं जत्रुदेशे कुरूद्वह॥
en: Then, O best among Kurus, it struck me on my shoulder, even then, O perpetuator of Kuru's race, like a lightning ranging in the sky.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: अथास्रमस्रवद् घोरं गिरेगैरिकधातुवत्। रामेण सुमहाबाहो क्षतस्य क्षतजेक्षण॥
en: Thus wondered by Rama, O red-eyed one of mighty arms, blood flowed freely like streams of red earth from a mountain.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततोऽहं जामदग्न्याय भृशं क्रोधसमन्वितः। चिक्षेप मृत्युसंकाशं बाणं सर्पविषोपमम्॥
en: Greatly incensed , I darted, at the son of Jamadagni, a deadly shaft, comparable to the poison of a serpent only.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: स तेनाभिहतो वीरो ललाटे द्विजसत्तमः। अशोभत महाराज सशृङ्ग इव
en: That hero, the best of the twice-born, struck by it on the forehead, shone beautiful as a mountain with its peak.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: स संरब्धः समावृत्य शरं कालान्तकोपमम्। संदधे बलवत् कृष्य घोरं शत्रुनिबर्हणम्॥
en: Filled with great wrath he turned round, and drawing his bow with great strength aimed at me a terrible shaft, resembling death himself and capable of grinding all enemies.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: स वक्षसि पपातोग्रः शरो व्याल इव श्वसन्। महीं राजंस्ततश्चाहमगमं रुधिराविलः॥
en: That fierce shaft struck me on the breast hissing (through the air) like a serpent, and I fell down to the earth, O king, covered with blood.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: सम्प्राप्य तु पुनः संज्ञां जामदग्न्याय धीमते। प्राहिण्वं विमलां शक्तिं ज्वलन्तीमशनीमिव॥
en: Regaining my consciousness, I hurled at that intelligent son of Jamadagni a dart, bright and blazing as the lighting flesh.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: सा तस्य द्विजमुख्यस्य निपपात भुजान्तरे। विह्वलश्चाभवद् राजन् वेपथुश्चैनमाविशत्॥
en: That dart fell on the chest of that best of Brahmanas. And, O king, having fainted (from pain) he began to tremble all over.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: तत एनं परिष्वज्य सखा विप्रो महातपाः। अकृतव्रणः शुभैर्वाक्यैराश्वासयदनेकधा॥
en: Then his friend, that twice-born and great ascetic named Akritavrana, embraced him again and again and soothed him with words of auspicious import.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: समाश्वस्तस्ततो रामः क्रोधामर्षसमन्वितः। प्रादुश्चक्रे तदा ब्राह्म परमास्त्रं महाव्रतः॥
en: Thus comforted, Rama was filled with anger and vindictiveness, and that keeper of all observances brought forth a mighty weapon of Brahma.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततस्तत्प्रतिघातार्थं ब्राह्ममेवास्त्रमुत्तमम्। मया प्रयुक्तं जज्वाल युगान्तमिव दर्शयत्॥
en: Then, for the purpose of baffling also, I aimed the same excellent weapon of Brahma, which blazed forth, appearing like what happens at the end of the Yuga (at the final destruction).

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: तयोर्ब्रह्मास्त्रयोरासीदन्तरा वै समागमः। असंप्राप्यैव रामं च मां च भारतसत्तम॥
en: Then those two Brahmic weapons met each other in mid-air, without being able to reach either Rama or myself, 0 best of Bharata's race.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततो व्योम्नि प्रादुरभूत् तेज एव हि केवलम्। भूतानि चैव सर्वाणि जग्मुराति विशाम्पते॥
en: Thereupon, in mid-welkin, only a flame blazed forth, and 0 lord of earth, all creatures becomes greatly afflicted,

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ऋषयश्च सगन्धर्वा देवताश्चैव भारत। संतापं परमं जग्मुरस्त्रतेजोऽभिपीडिताः॥
en: The Rishis, and the gods together with the Gandharvas, 0 Bharata, became greatly afflicted, struck by the blazing effulgence.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततश्चचाल पृथिवी सपर्वतवनद्रुमा। संतप्तानि च भूतानि विषादं जग्मुरुत्तमम्॥
en: Then the earth, with the mountains, forests and trees, began to tremble, and all creatures, becoming heated, became highly afflicted.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: प्रजज्वाल नमो राजन् धूमायन्ते दिशो दश। न स्थातुमन्तरिक्षे च शेकुराकाशगास्तदा॥
en: The firmament, О king, began to burn the ten points of the compass were filled with smoke. At that moment, those creatures that range the sky could not stay there.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततो हाहाकृते लोके सदेवासुरराक्षसे। इदमन्तरमित्येवं मोक्तुकामोऽस्मि भारत॥
en: While during this time all creatures, with the gods, the Asuras and Rakshasas began uttering exclamations of woe, O Bharata, “This is the time,” thought I and become desirous of shooting,

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: प्रस्वापमस्त्रं त्वरितो वचनाद् ब्रह्मवादिनाम्। विचित्रं च तदस्त्रं मे मनसि प्रत्यभात् तदा॥
en: That weapon Prasvapa speedily, according to the words of command of the speakers of Brahma. And the Mantras also for using that weapon suddenly came to my mind.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: भीष्म उवाच ततो हलहलाशब्दो दिवि राजन् महानभूत्। प्रस्वापं भीष्म मा स्राक्षीरिति कौरवनन्दन॥
en: Bhishma said Then when I had thus made up my mind there arose a mighty din of tumultuous voices in the sky, O king, saying, “O Bhishma, O son of Kuru's race do not let go that weapon Prasvapa."

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: अयुञ्जमेव चैवाहं तदस्त्रं भृगुनन्दने। प्रस्वापं मां प्रयुञ्जानं नारदो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: But for all that I still aimed that weapon at the descendant of Bhrigu. As I was aiming it, Narada addressed me, saying

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: एते वियति कौरव्य दिवि देवगणाः स्थिताः। ते त्वां निवारयन्त्यद्य प्रस्वापं मा प्रयोजयः॥
en: These gods are stationed yonder in the sky, O son of Kuru's race. They are forbidding you today, do not aim the weapon Prasvapa.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: रामस्तपस्वी ब्रह्मण्यो ब्राह्मणश्च गुस्थं ते। तस्यावमानं कौरव्य मा स्म कार्षीः कथंचन॥
en: Rama is an ascetic, possessed of the attributes of Brahma; he is a Brahmana, and moreover your preceptor. Do not son of Kuru, inflict humiliation on him, by any means,

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततोऽपश्यं दिविष्ठान् वै तानष्टौ ब्रह्मवादिनः। ते मां स्मयन्तो राजेन्द्र शनकैरिदमब्रुवन्॥
en: Then I saw those eight speakers of the Brahma, stationed in the sky. O great king, smilingly they spoke these words to me slowly.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: यथाऽऽह भरतश्रेष्ठ नारदस्तत् तथा कुरु। एतद्धि परमं श्रेयो लोकानां भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best among Bharata's race, do as Narada has spoken to you, for this, O best among the Bharatas, is highly beneficial to all creatures.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततश्च प्रतिसंहृत्य तदस्त्रं स्वापनं महत्। ब्रह्मास्त्रं दीपयांचक्रे तस्मिन् युधि यथाविधि॥
en: Thereupon, withdrawing that mighty weapon Prasvapa, I made the Brahma weapon to blaze forth according to the ordinance.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततो रामो हृषितो राजसिंह दृष्ट्वा तदस्त्रं विनिवर्तितं वै।। रित्येव वाक्यं सहसा व्यमुञ्चत्॥ ततोऽपश्यत् पितरं जामदग्न्यः पितुस्तथा पितरं चास्य मान्यम्। रूचुश्चैनं सान्त्वपूर्व तदानीम्॥
en: Thereupon Rama, beholding that the Prasvapa weapon was withdrawn, was greatly excited and suddenly gave out these words, Fool that I am, I am vanquished, O Bhishma. Then the son of Jamadagni saw his father, and the venerable father of his father, who stood there surrounding him, and consoling him,

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: पितर ऊचुः मा स्मैवं साहसं तात पुनः कार्षीः कथंचना भीष्मेण संयुगं गन्तुं क्षत्रियेण विशेषतः॥
en: The father said Do not display such rashness again 0 son, by any means, especially of going to battle with Bhishma, who is a Kshatriya.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: क्षत्रियस्य तु धर्मोऽयं यद् युद्धं भृगुनन्दन। स्वाध्यायो व्रतचर्याऽथ ब्राह्मणानां परं धनम्॥
en: This is the duty of a Kshatriya, viz., to fight; O descendant of Bhrigu, study and the observance of religious austerities are the best wealth of the Brahmanas.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: इदं निमित्ते कस्मिंश्चिदस्माभिः प्रागुदाहृतम्। शस्त्रधारणमत्युगं तच्चाकार्यं कृतं त्वया॥
en: This (taking up of arms) was ordered by us to you for some special reasons before this. Then you had taken up your arms most fiercely and performed that unenviable deed (the extermination of the whole Kshatriya race).

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: वत्स पर्याप्तमेतावद् भीष्मेण सह संयुगे। विमर्दस्ते महाबाहो व्यपयाहि रणादितः॥
en: What time you have fought with Bhishma has been enough, O son. 0 you of mighty arms, desist from this combat, leave the battlefield.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: पर्याप्तमेतद् भद्रं ते तव कार्मुकधारणम्। विसर्जयैतद् दुर्धर्ष तपस्तप्यस्व भार्गव॥
en: Blessing be to you, let this be enough of taking up the bow. But desist from this now, O invincible Practice austerities, 0 Bhargava.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: एष भीष्मः शान्तनवो देवैः सर्वैर्निवारितः। निवर्तस्व रणादस्मादिति चैव प्रसादितः॥
en: Here is Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, who has been made to desist from battle by all the gods, who are endeavoring to pacify him by saying "Desist from this battle."

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: रामेण सह मा योत्सीगुरुणेति पुनः पुनः। न हि रामो रणे जेतुं त्वया न्याय्यः कुरूद्वह॥
en: "Do not fight with Rama, your preceptor", again and again (saying this). It is not becoming for you, O perpetuator of the race of Kuru, to vanquish Rama in battle. one.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: मानं कुरुष्व गाड्नेय ब्राह्मणस्य रणाजिरे। वयं तु गुरवस्तुभ्यं तस्मात् त्वां वारयामहे॥
en: O son of Ganga, do honour to this Brahmana on the field of battle. We are your superiors and therefore forbid you.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: भीष्मो वसूनामन्यतमो दिष्ट्या जीवसि पुत्रका गाङ्गेयः शान्तनोः पुत्रो वसुरेष महायशाः॥
en: Bhishma is one of the foremost of the Vasus. It is only by good luck that you are still living. This Shantanu's son by Ganga is a celebrated Vasu,

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: कथं शक्यस्त्वया जेतुं निवर्तस्वेह भार्गव। अर्जुनः पाण्डवश्रेष्ठः पुरंदरसुतो बली॥
en: How can he be vanquished by you? Desist at this point, O descendant of Bhrigu. That best among Pandavas, Arjuna, who is the powerful son of Indra,

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: नरः प्रजापतिर्वीरः पूर्वदेवः सनातनः। सव्यसाचीति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वीर्यवान्। भीष्ममृत्युर्यथाकालं विहितो वै स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: Who is Nara, who is the lord of all creatures, a hero, who was before this a god, who is without beginning and end, and who, mighty as he is, is known throughout the three worlds as Savyasachin, is ordained by the selfcreate (Brahma) to be the death of Bhishma in the ripeness of time.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तः स पितृभिः पितॄन् रामोऽब्रवीदिदम्। नाहं युधि निवर्तेयमिति मे व्रतमाहितम्॥
en: Bhishma said Being thus spoken by his ancestors, Rama thus spoken to them, “I will not desist from the combat, this is the vow I have taken upon myself.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: न निवर्तितपूर्वश्च कदाचिद् रणमूर्धनि) निवर्त्यतामापगेयः कामं युद्धात् पितामहाः॥
en: Before this, I had never been made to turn beak (from combat) on the field of battle. O grandsires, make the Ganga's son of desist from the battle, if it so pleases you.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: न त्वहं विनिवर्तिष्ये युद्धादस्मात् कथंचन। ततस्ते मुनयो राजनृचीकप्रमुखास्तदा॥
en: "But as for me, I will never hold back from this combat.” Then those ascetics, O king, with Richeeka at their head,

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: नारदेनैव सहिताः समागम्येदमब्रुवन्। निवर्तस्व रणात् तात मानयस्व द्विजोत्तमम्॥
en: And accompanied by Narada, came up (to me) and thus spoke "Desist from the battle, O son. Honour that foremost of Brahmanas.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: इत्यवोचमहं तांश्च क्षत्रधर्मव्यपेक्षया। मम व्रतमिदं लोके नाहं युद्धात् कदाचन॥ विमुखो विनिवर्तेयं पृष्ठतोऽभ्याहतः शरैः। नाहं लोभान्न कार्पण्यान्न भयानार्थकारणात्॥
en: “No” I said to them “according to the duty of a Kshatriya, this is my vow, that never from battle, I will turn back or suffer my back to be wondered by arrows. Not from covering any objects of desire, nor from fear, nor for the sake of wealth,

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: त्यजेयं शाश्वतं धर्ममिति मे निश्चिता पतिः। सर्वे नारदप्रमुखा नृप।॥
en: Shall i abandon my eternal duty, this is my fixed resolution.” Then all those ascetics, O king, with Narada at their head,

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: भागीरथी च मे माता रणमध्यं प्रपेदिरे। तथैवात्तशरो धन्वी तथैव दृढनिश्चयः। स्थिरोऽहमाहवे योद्ध ततस्ते राममब्रुवन्॥
en: And Bhagirathi, my mother, occupied the field of battle (between myself and Rama). I however, stood with my bow and arrows as before, and with fixed resolution as before, on the battle-field, to go on fighting. Then they said to Rama.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: समरे भृगुनन्दनम्। नावनीतं हि हृदयं विप्राणां शाम्य भार्गव॥
en: Once more, all them together, going up to the descendant of Bhrigu, on the battle-field said, “The hearts of the Brahmanas are as soft as butter, O son of Bhrigu; be pacified.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: राम राम निवर्तस्व युद्धादस्माद् द्विजोत्तम। अवध्यो वै त्वया भीष्यस्त्वं च भीष्मस्य भार्गव॥ ततस्ते मुनयः समेत्य सहिता भूयः
en: O Rama, O Rama, O best of Brahmanas, desist from this battle. Bhishma is incapable of being killed by you, as you by Bhishma, O son of Bhrigu's race.”

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: एवं ब्रुवन्तस्ते सर्वे प्रतिरुथ्य रणाजिरम्। न्यासयांचक्रिरे शस्त्रं पितरो भृगुनन्दनम्॥
en: Addressing him with these words, and obstructing the battle-field, his forefathers made the descendant of Bhrigu lay aside his weapons.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततोऽहं पुनरेवायथ तानष्टौ ब्रह्मवादिनः। अद्राक्षं दीप्यमानान् वै ग्रहानष्टाविवोदितान्॥
en: And then I again saw those eight revealers of Brahmana, blazing like eight constellations risen (in the sky).

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ते मां सप्रणयं वाक्यमब्रुवन् समरे स्थितम्। प्रैहि रामं महाबाहो गुरुं लोकहितं कुरु॥
en: They then spoke these words with affection to me, who stood on the field of combat, “O you of mighty arms, go up to Rama, your preceptor. Do what is good to all the world."

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: दृष्ट्वा निवर्तितं रामं सुहृद्वाक्येन तेन वै। लोकानां च हितं कुर्वन्नहमप्याददे वचः॥
en: Beholding that Rama desisted (from battle) at the words of his well-wishers, I also, for the good of the worlds, accepted (their) words.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: ततोऽहं राममासाद्य ववन्दे भृशविक्षतः। रामश्चाभ्युत्स्मयन् प्रेम्णा मामुवाच महातपाः॥
en: Thereupon severely wondered as I was, I went up to Rama, and bowed down to him. Rama also that great ascetic, smiling with love, spoke to me.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: त्वत्समो नास्ति लोकेऽस्मिन् क्षत्रियः पृथिवीचरः। गम्यतां भीष्म युद्धेऽस्मिंस्तोषितोऽहं भृशं त्वया॥
en: "There is no Kshatriya among all men equal to you on the face of the earth. Go you, O Bhishma, for in this combat I have been highly pleased with you.

description: Story of the fight between Rama and Bhishma
sn: मम चैव समक्षं तां कन्यामाहूय भार्गवः। उक्तवान् दीनया वाचा मध्य तेषां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Then in my presence, summoning that maiden (the daughter of Kashi), the descendant of Bhrigu, spoke (to her) in these modest words, before all the high-souled ones.

sn: राम उवाच प्रत्यक्षमेतल्लोकानां सर्वेषामेव भाविनि। यथाशक्त्या मया युद्धं कृतं वै पौरुषं परम्॥
en: Bhishma said In the very sight of all these persons O maiden, I have done better, according to the best of my power, and displayed my highest prowess.

sn: न चैवमपि शक्नोमि भीष्मं शस्त्रभृतां वरम्। विशेषयितुमत्यर्थमुत्तमास्त्राणि दर्शयन्॥
en: And yet I have been unable to gain any superiority over Bhishma, that foremost of all wielders of weapons, though I have exerted to the very of my power.

sn: एषा मे परमा शक्तिरेतन्मे परमं बलम्। यथेष्टं गम्यतां भद्रे किमन्यद् वा करोमि ते॥
en: This (which you have seen) is my highest might, this is greatest strength. Go whiter you like, O blessed lady. What else can I do for you?

sn: भीष्ममेव प्रपद्यस्व न तेऽन्या विद्यते गतिः। निर्जितो ह्यस्मि भीष्मेण महास्त्राणि प्रमुञ्चता॥
en: Take refuge even with Bhishma himself; there exists no other for you. I am vanquished by Bhishma on account of his using such mighty weapons.

sn: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामो विनिःश्वस्य महामनाः। तूष्णीमांसीत् ततः कन्या प्रोवाच भृगुनन्दनम्॥
en: Then the high-souled Rama, having thus spoken, fetched a deep sign and remained silent. Then that maiden spoke to the descendant of Bhrigu.

sn: भगवन्नेवमेवैतद् यथाऽऽहं भगवांस्तथा। अजेयो युधि भीष्मोऽयमपि देवरुदारधीः॥
en: "O holy one, it is even as your holy self has said. This Bhishma, of varied intelligence, is invincible in battle even by the very gods.

sn: यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं मम कार्यं कृतं त्वया। अनिवार्य रणे वीर्यमस्त्राणि विविधानि च।॥
en: To the best of your power and to the best of your energy you have accomplished my work, and in this battle you have shown irresistible might and diverse kinds of weapons.

sn: न चैव शक्यते युद्धे विशेषयितुमन्ततः। न चाहमेनं यास्यामि पुनर्भीष्मं कथंचन॥ गमिष्यामि तु तत्राहं यत्र भीष्मं तपोधन। समरे पातयिष्यामि स्वयमेव भृगूद्वह॥
en: You have yet been unable to show any superiority (over Bhishma). As for me I shall not go again to this Bhishma. Thither, however, shall I repair, where, O you whose wealth is asceticism, I shall be able myself to (obtain the means to fell down in battle this Bhishma, O you the perpetuator of the race of Bhrigu."

sn: एवमुक्त्वा ययौ कन्या रोषव्याकुललोचना। तापस्ये धृतसंकल्या सा मे चिन्तयती वधम्॥
en: Having spoken thus, that maid went away with eyes agitated with wrath, and intending to bring about my death she firmly resolved to practice asceticism,

sn: ततो महेन्द्रं सह तैर्मुनिभिर्भृगुसत्तमः। यथाऽऽगतं तथा सोऽगान्मामुपामन्त्र्य भारत॥
en: Then that foremost one among Bhrigu's defendants, accompanied by those ascetics, departed, after bidding me farewell for the mountain of Mahendra, O Bharata, whence he had come.

sn: ततो रथं समारुह्य स्तूयमानो द्विजातिभिः। प्रविश्य नगरं मात्रे सत्यवत्यै न्यवेदयम्॥
en: Thereupon, sending my chariot, and praised by the twice-born, I entered the city and immediately informed Satyavati, my mother,

sn: यथावृत्तं महाराज सा च मां प्रत्यनन्दत। पुरुषांश्चादिशं प्राज्ञान् कन्यावृत्तान्तकर्मणि॥
en: Every thing as it had happened, O great king, and she (in her turn) uttered words and congratulations to me. I then appointed intelligent and wise men to watch the proceedings of that maiden.

sn: दिवसे दिवसे ह्यस्या गतिजल्पितचेष्टितम्। प्रत्याहरंश्च मे युक्ताः स्थिताः प्रियहिते सदा॥
en: Day after day, they went and learnt whatever she did, being devoted and always stationed at their duty, and brought them to me, always their well-wisher.

sn: यदैव हि वनं प्रायात् सा कन्या तपसे धृता। तदैव व्यतितो दीनो गतचेता इवाभवम्॥
en: Even at the time when that maiden went to the woods best on practicing asceticism, I became melancholy and poorly with pain.

sn: न हि मां क्षत्रियः कश्चिद् वीर्येण व्यजयद् युधि। ऋते ब्रह्मविदस्तात तपसा संशितव्रतात्॥
en: No Kshatriya has ever by mere prowess vanquished me in battle, except one acquainted with Brahma, O my son and observant of vows and austerities.

sn: अपि चैतन्मया राजन् नारदेऽपि निवेदितम्। व्यासे चैव तथा कार्यं तौ चोभौ मामवोचताम्॥
en: I then informed even Narada, O king, and also Vyasa of the doings (of that daughter of the king of Kashi), and both of them said to me.

sn: न विषादस्त्वया कार्यो भीष्म काशिसुतां प्रति। दैवं पुरुषकारेण को निवर्तितुमुत्सहेत्॥
en: "O Bhishma, you need not be depressed on account of the daughter of Kashi. Who can have the power to alter the course of destiny by individual resolution?

sn: सा कन्या तु महाराज प्रविश्याश्रममण्डलम्। यमुनातीरमाश्रित्य तपस्तेपेऽतिमानुषम्।॥
en: That maiden, O great king, having entered the pale of a secluded pot, began practicing austerities of superhuman endurance, on the banks of the Yamuna,

sn: निराहारा कृशा सक्षा जटिला मलपङ्किनी। षण्मासान् वायुभक्षा च स्थाणुभूता तपोधना॥ यमुनाजलमाश्रित्य संवत्सरमथापरम्। उदवासं निराहारा पारयामास भाविनी॥
en: And she remained in the water of the Yamuna for one year, and another year, that lady remained fasting without food. Without food and emaciated, rough skined, and bronzed, with matted locks, and begrimed with the mud (of the river), that lady, whose wealth consisted in asceticism, remained fixed and motionless for six months, her only food being the air.

sn: शीर्णपणेन चैकेन पारयामास सा परम्। संवत्सरं तीव्रकोपा पादाङ्गुष्ठाग्रधिष्ठिता॥
en: And after this she broke her fast by eating a single dry leaf, and then she the great river on one foot fire with indignation as she was.

sn: एवं द्वादश वर्षाणि तापयामास रोदसी। निवर्त्यमानापि च सा ज्ञातिभि:व शक्यते॥
en: And thus she continued for twelve years (her austerities) and made the heaven not. Nor could she be made to desist from the course by her relatives.

sn: ततोऽगमद् वत्सभूमि सिद्धचारणसेविताम्। आश्रमं पुण्यशीलानां तापसानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Then she went to Vatsabhumi, resorted to by Siddhas and Charanas, and the retreat of high-souled ascetics of pious deeds.

sn: तत्र पुण्येषु तीर्थेषु साऽऽप्लुताङ्गी दिवानिशम्। व्यचरत् काशिकन्या सा यथाकामविचारिणी॥
en: And there, in the sacred waters of pilgrimages, she bathed herself night and day, and that daughter of the lord of Kashi roamed about, fierce as she was, according to her desire.

sn: नन्दाश्रमे महाराज तथोलकाश्रमे शुभे। च्यवनस्याश्रमे चैव ब्रह्मणः स्थान एव च॥
en: Proceeding next to the hermitage of Narada, and then to the auspicious hermitage of Uluka, and to that of Chyavana, and even to the sacred spot of Brahma,

sn: प्रयागे देवजयने देवारण्येषु चैव ह। भोगवत्यां महाराज कौशिकस्याश्रमे तथा॥
en: And to Prayaga, the sacrificial spot of the gods, and to the forest sacred to the gods and to Bhogavati, O monarch, as also to the hermitage of Kaushika,

sn: माण्डव्यस्याश्रमे राजन् दिलीपस्याश्रमे तथा। रामहदे च कौरव्य पैलगर्गस्य चाश्रमे॥
en: And to the hermitage of Mandvya O king, as also to the hermitage of Dilipa to the (sacred) water of Rama's lake, O Kauravya, and to the hermitage of Pailagarga,

sn: एतेषु तीर्थेषु तदा काशिकन्या विशाम्पते। आप्लावयत गात्राणि व्रतमास्थाय दुष्करम्॥
en: In these sacred places of pilgrimages that maiden of Kashi, O lord of earth, bathed her body, and all this while practicing the austerities difficult of performance.

sn: तामव्रवीच्च कौरव्य मम माता जले स्थिता। किमर्थं क्लिश्यसे भद्रे तथ्यमेव वदस्व मे॥
en: (One day) my mother, (Ganga) while in the waters, spoke these words, O Kaurava why do you take so much pains, O blessed one! Tell me the truth.

sn: सैनामथाब्रवीद् राजन् कृताञ्जलिरनिन्दिता। भीष्मेण समरे रामो निर्जितश्चारुलोचने।॥
en: She then spoke, of whom no one can speak evil, with hands folded to my mother “O faireyed one, Rama has been vanquished in battle by Bhishma.

sn: कोऽन्यस्तमुत्सहेज्जेतुमुद्यतेषु महीपतिः। साहं भीष्मविनाशाय तपस्तप्स्ये सुदारुणम्॥
en: Who else, though a lord of earth, can attempt to vanquish him when he stands forward with his arrows? And I am practicing these sever austerities for the destruction of Bhishma.

sn: विचरामि महीं देवि यथा हन्यामहं नृपम्। एतद् व्रतफलं देवि परमस्मिन् यथा हि मे॥
en: I wander about in the earth, O goddess, with the one purpose of obtaining the means of death of that king, and this is the vow I have taken, O goddess, in everything else that I do.”

sn: ततोऽब्रवीत् सागरगा जिह्यं चरसि भाविनि। नैष कामोऽनवद्याङ्गि शक्यः प्राप्तुं त्वयाऽबले॥
en: Thereupon the ocean, going (Ganga my mother) spoke: “O lady, you are acting crookedly. O faultless one, this object of yours you shall not be able to attain, O weak one.

sn: यदि भीष्मविनाशाय काश्ये चरसि वै व्रतम्। व्रतस्था च शरीरं त्वं यदि नाम विमोक्ष्यसि।॥
en: O daughter of Kashi, if you hold to this vow for the destruction of Bhishma, and even if you take leave of your body while performing these austerities.

sn: नदी भविष्यसि शुभे कुटिला वार्षिकोदका। दुस्तीर्था न तु विज्ञेया वार्षिकी नाष्टमासिकी॥
en: You shall be turned to a tortuous river, O fair one, with water (only in the rains. Your water shall be inaccessible and unknown, and (as you shall be) with water only during the rainy season, you shall be dry for eight months (in the year);

sn: भीमग्राहवती घोरा सर्वभूतभयङ्करी। एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन् काशिकन्यां न्यवर्तत॥ माता मम महाभागा स्मयमानेव भाविनी। कदाचिदष्टमे मासि कदाचिद् दशमे तथा। न प्राश्नीतोदकमिप पुनः सा वरवर्णिनी॥
en: Filled with dreadful alligators and yourself dreadful, and inspiring terror in all creatures." Having thus spoken, O king, my mother, that lady of great fortune pretending to smile, dismissed the daughter of Kashi. Thereupon that highly fair one did not even drink water, sometimes for eight months and sometimes for ten months.

sn: सा वत्सभूमि कौरव्य तीर्थलोभात् ततस्ततः। पतिता परिधावन्ती पुनः काशिपतेः सुता॥
en: And the daughter of the king of Kashi, o Kauravya, on account of her love of pilgrimage came to Vatsabhumi, and there she fell down and began to run down (as a river.)

sn: सा नदी वत्सभूम्यां तु प्रथिताम्बेति भारत। वार्षिकी चाहबहुला दुस्तीर्था कुटिला तथा॥
en: And O Bharata, it is recorded that the river in Vatsabhumi, was filled with water only during the rains, and abounded in alligators, was difficult to ford and tortuous in her course).

sn: सा कन्या तपसा तेन देहार्धेन व्यजायत। नदी च राजन् वत्सेषु कन्या चैवाभवत् तदा॥
en: O king, by merit of her austerities that maiden became a river by only half her body, while by the other half she remained a maiden in Vatsabhumi, as before.

sn: भीष्म उवाच ततस्ते तापसाः सर्वे तपसे धृतनिश्चयाम्। दृष्ट्वा न्यवर्तयंस्तात् किं कार्यमिति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: Bhishma said to Then all the ascetics (living in Vatsabhumi), perceiving her firmly resolved on practicing austerities, dissuaded her, and they said "O child, what do you mean to do?"

sn: तानुवाच ततः कन्या तपोवृद्धानृषीस्तदा। निराकृतास्मि भीष्मेण भ्रंशिता पतिधर्मतः॥
en: Then those Rishis hoary with asceticism, spoke the maiden : “I have been undone by Bhishma, and despoiled of those virtues that would have been mine by living with my husband.

sn: वधार्थं तस्य दीक्षा मे न लोकार्थं तपोधनाः। निहत्य भीष्मं गच्छेयं शान्तिमित्येव निश्चयः॥
en: My observance of vows is for his destruction, and not for the sake of the worlds of happiness, O you that have asceticism for your wealth. Having slain Bhishma I shall attain peace (of mind); this is my resolve.

sn: यत्कृते दुःखवसतिमिमां प्राप्तास्मि शाश्वतीम्। पतिलोकाद् विहीना च नैव स्त्री न पुमानिह॥
en: Him by whom this existence has become one of continuous misery, by whom I have been deprived of the region where my husband is, for whom I am neither a woman nor a man in this life,

sn: नाहत्वा युधि गाङ्गेयं निवर्तिध्ये तपोधनाः। एष मे हृदि संकल्पो यदिदं कथितं मया।॥
en: Without slaying in battle that son of Ganga, I will not desist, O you whose wealth is asceticism. That which I have here spoken in wards, even that is the resolve in my heart within.

sn: स्त्रीभावे परिनिर्विण्णा पुंस्त्वार्थं कृतनिश्चया। भीष्मे प्रतिचिकीर्षामि नास्मि वार्येति वै पुनः॥
en: I am disgusted with remaining in this state of mine as a woman, and I am firmly resolved upon attaining the state of a man. I will be revenged upon Bhishma. I should not be dissuaded any more.

sn: तां देवो दर्शयामास शूलपाणिरुमापतिः। मध्ये तेषां महर्षीणां स्वेन रूपेणा तापसीम्॥
en: To that ascetic lady, the god who holds the trident in his hand, and who is the husband of Uma, showed himself in his own form in the midst of those Maharshis.

sn: छन्द्यमाना वरेणाथ सा वने मत्पराजयम्। हनिष्यसीति तां देवः प्रत्युवाच मनस्विनीम्॥
en: Being asked to solicit her wished for boon, she prayed of the god my defeat. “You will slay him”, thus that god answered that lady of firm resolution.

sn: ततः सा पुनरेवाथ कन्या रुद्रमुवाच हा उपपद्येत कथं देव स्त्रिया युधि जयो मम॥
en: “Thereupon again she said to Rudra, How can it happen, that mine shall be the victory in battle, O god, as I am, a woman?

sn: स्त्रीभावेन च मे गाढं मनः शान्तमुमापते। प्रतिश्रुतश्च भूतेश त्वया भीष्मपराजयः॥
en: O lord of Uma, my mind is perfectly calm, so far as regards a woman. And you have also promised, O lord of all creatures, the defeat of Bhishma.

sn: यथा स सत्यो भवति तथा कुरु वृषध्वज। यथा हन्यां समागम्य भीष्मं शान्तनवं युधि॥
en: Act in such a way that this (promise) may be true, O god who has the bull for the mark, and so that on encountering Bhishma, the son of Shantanu in battle, I may slay him.”

sn: तामुवाच महादेवः कन्यां किल वृषध्वजः। न मे वागनृतं प्राह सत्य भद्रे भविष्यति॥
en: To that maiden Mahadeva (the great god) having the bull for his carrier thus spoke truly, “My words can not be false. They shall turn out true, O blessed one.

sn: हनिष्यासि रणे भीष्मं पुरुषत्वं च लप्स्यसे। स्मरिष्यसि च तत् सर्वं देहमन्यं गता सती॥
en: You will slay Bhishma in battle, for you will attain the state of a man. And you will recollect all this, when you go to another body.

sn: दुपदस्य कुले जाता भविष्यसि महारथः। शीघ्रास्त्रश्चित्रयोधी च भविष्यसि सुसम्मतः॥
en: Borne in the race of Drupada, you shall be a Maharatha, quick in the use of weapons, skilled in fighting in various ways, and a fierce warrior.

sn: यथोक्तमेव कल्याणि सर्वमेतद् भविष्यति। भविष्यसि पुमान् पश्चात् कस्माच्चित्कालपर्ययात्॥
en: As I have spoken, O blessed one, so shall it all be. You will be a man after some time has elapsed."

sn: एवमुक्त्वा महादेवः कपर्दी वृषभध्वजः। पश्यतामेव विप्राणां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: So saying, Mahadeva, otherwise, known as Kapardin, and having the bull for his carrier, vanished even then and there while the Brahmanas were looking on.

sn: ततः सा पश्यतां तेषां महर्षीणामनिन्दिता। समाहृत्य वनात् तस्मात् काष्ठानि वरवर्णिनी॥
en: Thereupon that faultless damsel of fairest complexion, in the very sight of those great Rishis, having gathered fuel from that wood,

sn: चितां कृत्वा सुमहतीं प्रदाय च हुताशनम्। प्रदीप्तेऽग्नौ महाराज रोषदीप्तेन चेतसा॥
en: And making a large funeral pyre and having set fire (to it), O monarch, with a mind burning with wrath, even in that flaming fire,

sn: उक्त्वा भीष्मवधायेति प्रविवेश हुताशनम्। ज्येष्ठा काशिसुता राजन् यमुनामभितो नदीम्॥
en: That eldest daughter of the king of Kashi, O king, entered the fire on the banks of the river Yamuna, saying (as she did so) “For the destruction of Bhimasena.

sn: दुर्योधन उवाच कथं शिखण्डी गाङ्गेय कन्या भूत्वा पुरा तदा। पुरुषोऽभूद् युधिश्रेष्ठ तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Duryodhana said Tell me, O grandsire, how Shikhandin, who had been before a daughter, O son of Ganga, became a man. O foremost of warriors.

sn: भीष्म उवाच भार्या तु तस्य राजेन्द्र दुपदस्य महीपतेः। महिषी दयिता ह्यासीदपुत्रा च विशाम्पते।॥
en: Bhishma said The chosen and beloved queen of king Drupada, O great king, was childless at first, O monarch.

sn: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु दुपदो वै महीपतिः। अपत्यार्थ महाराज तोषयामास शङ्करम्॥
en: And during this time the highly intelligent king Drupada, pleased by worship, O mighty king, the God Shankara for the sake of offspring.

sn: अस्मद्वधार्थ निश्चित्य तपो घोरं समास्थितः। ऋते कन्यां महादेव पुत्रो मे स्यादिति ब्रुवन्॥
en: Resolving to bring about my destruction, he took to the severest penances, and said “Let mine be a son, and not a daughter, 0 Mahadeva;

sn: भगवन् पुत्रमिच्छामि भीष्मं प्रतिचिकीर्षया। इत्युक्तो देवदेवेन स्त्रीपुमांस्ते भविष्यति॥
en: O God, I desire a son, to revenge myself on Bhishma.” Then this was said (to him) by Mahadeva, "Your son shall be both male and female.

sn: निवर्तस्व महीपाल नैतज्जात्वन्यथा भवेत्। स तु गत्वा न नगरं भार्यामिदमुवाच ह॥
en: Desist therefore, O protector of the earth, it shall never be otherwise." He (king Drupada) entering his city said to his wife.

sn: कृतो यत्नो महादेवस्तपसाऽऽराधितो मया। कन्या भृत्वा पुमान् भावी इति चोक्तोऽस्मि शम्भुना।।७।
en: "I have made a great exertion; O goddess, I have worshipped Shambhu by penances, and I have been told by him. “Your offspring) will first be a female and will then become a man."

sn: पुनः पुनर्याच्यमानो दिष्टमित्यब्रवीच्छिवः। न तदन्यच्च भविता भवितव्यं हि तत् तथा॥
en: Though repeatedly solicited, Shiva only said “It is decreed by destiny. It shall not be otherwise, but when as I have told you”.

sn: ततः सा नियता भूत्वा ऋतुकाले मनस्विनी। पत्नी दुपदराजस्य दुपदं प्रविवेश ह॥
