en: Thereupon that lady of great force of mind kept her mind rigidly pure and the wife of king Drupada, at the proper time went to king Drupada.

sn: लेभे गर्भ यथाकालं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा। पार्षतस्य महीपाल यथा मां नारदोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Agreeably to the decrees of destiny the wife of Prishata, in due time, conceived, as Narada informed me, O ruler of the Earth.

sn: ततो दधार सा देवी गर्भ राजीवलोचना। तां स राजा प्रियां भार्यां दुपदः कुरुनन्दन॥
en: And that goddess, whose eyes resembled the petals on the lotus, continued to hold her fetus. And to that dear wife, O son of Kuru, king Drupada,

sn: पुत्रस्नेहान्महाबाहुः सुखं पर्यचरत् तदा। सर्वानभिप्रायकृतान् भार्याऽलभत कौरव॥
en: The mighty-armed one, on account of his affection for his son, ordered all that was agreeable. And O Kaurava, his wife obtained everything that she desired.

sn: अपुत्रस्य सतो राज्ञो दुपदस्य महीपतेः। यथाकालं तु सा देवी महिषी दुपदस्य ह॥
en: And in due time that goddess, the queen of the childless lord of earth, king Drupada,

sn: कन्यां प्रवररूपां तु प्राजायत नराधिपा अपुत्रस्य तु राज्ञः सा दुपदस्य मनस्विनी॥
en: Even that lady of great force of mind, O lord of men, gave birth to a daughter of great beauty.

sn: ख्यापयामास राजेन्द्रं पुत्रो ह्येष ममेति वै। ततः स राजा द्रुपदः प्रच्छन्नाया नराधिप॥
en: O great king, thereupon the king Drupada gave out to all, this is my son, and for this daughter, who was concealed.

sn: पुत्रवत् पुत्रकार्याणि सर्वाणि समकारयत्। रक्षणं चैव मन्त्रस्य महिषी द्रुपदस्य सा॥ चकार सर्वयत्नेन ब्रुवाणा पुत्र इत्युत। न च तां वेद नगरे कश्चिदन्यत्र पार्षतात्॥
en: O lord of men, (he) caused all the necessary rites to be performed just as if it were a son. And the imperial wife of Drupada protected the secret with all due care, saying, "This is a son indeed.” And neither did any one else other than the son of Prishata know (the child to be a) daughter, in all that city.

sn: श्रद्दधानो हि तद्वाक्यं देवस्याच्युततेजसः। छादयामास तां कन्यां पुमानिति च सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Reverencing the words of that god of immeasurable glory, he kept to himself that she was a daughter, and said, “This is a male child."

sn: जातकर्माणि सर्वाणि कारयामास पार्थिवः। पुंवद्विधानयुक्तानि शिखण्डीति च तां विदुः॥
en: And that king caused all the rites prescribed for a son during infancy to be performed according to all due ordinances, and named her Shikhandin.

sn: अहमेकस्तु चारेण वचनान्नारदस्य च। ज्ञातवान् देववाक्येन अम्बायास्तपसा तथा॥
en: I alone, by means of spies, and through the words of Narada, and through the words of the god (Shiva) and also from the austerities of Amba, was informed (of the child being a son).

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: भीष्म उवाच चकार यत्नं द्रुपदः सुतायाः सर्वकर्मसु। ततो लेख्यादिषु तथा शिल्पेषु च परंतप॥
en: Bhishma said Drupada bestowed all possible care on all the (necessary) accomplishments of his daughter, O vanquisher of foes, teaching her writing, painting and all the arts.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: इष्वस्त्रे चैव राजेन्द्र द्रोणशिष्यो बभूव ह। तस्य माता महाराज राजानं वरवर्णिनी॥ चोदयामास भार्यार्थं कन्यायाः पुत्रवत् तदा। ततस्तां पार्षतो दृष्ट्वा कन्यां सम्प्राप्तयौवनाम्। स्त्रियं मत्वा ततश्चिन्तां प्रपेदे सह भार्यया॥
en: And in (the practice of) arrows and (other) weapons O great king, she became a disciple of Drona. And O great king, the mother of that child, a lady of the fairest complexion, urged the king for a wife for that daughter, as if she were a son. Thereupon the sin of Prishata, perceiving her to have attained youth, became thoughtful along with his wife, considering her to be a female.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: दुपद उवाच कन्या ममेयं सम्प्राप्ता यौवनं शोकवर्धिनी। मया प्रच्छादिता चेयं वचनाच्छूलपाणिनः॥
en: Drupada said This daughter of mine, who now adds to my woe, has attained her youth. And she has been concealed by me on the strength of the) words of the holders of the trident.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: भार्योवाच न तन्मिथ्या महाराज भविष्यति कथंचन। त्रैलोक्यकर्ता कस्माद्धि वृथा वक्तुमिहार्हति॥
en: His wife said Ogreat king, that (word) will never prove false. How can it be proper for the Creator of the three worlds to speak anything false on this earth?

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: यदि ते रोचते राजन् वक्ष्यामि शृणु मे वचः। श्रुत्वेदानीं प्रपद्येथाः स्वां मतिं पृषतात्मज॥
en: If it pleases you, O king, hear what I say. And then having listened to it, the descendant of Prishata may take to his own wisdom.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: क्रियतामस्य यत्नेन विधिवद् दारसंग्रहः। भविता तद्वचः सत्यमिति मे निश्चिता मतिः॥
en: According to due rites, cause him to take a wife, with all care. Those words of him (Shiva) will turn out true, even this is my firm belief.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: ततस्तौ निश्चयं कृत्वा तस्मिन् कार्येऽथ दम्पती। वरयांचक्रतुः कन्यां दशार्णाधिपतेः सुताम्॥
en: Then that royal couple, making a firm resolution as regards that work, chose as a bride the maiden daughter of the king Dasharnakas.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: ततो राजा द्रुपदो राजसिंहः सर्वान् राज्ञः कुलतः संनिशाम्य। दशार्णकस्य नृपतेस्तनूजां शिखण्डिने वरयामास दारान्॥
en: Thereupon the king Drupada, the lion among kings, having heard of the (respective) purity if descent of the lineage of all kings, chose the daughter of the king of the Dasharnaka territory as the wife of Shikhandin.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: हिरण्यवर्मेति नृपो योऽसौ दाशार्णकः स्मृतः। स च प्रादान्महीपालः कन्यां तस्मै शिखण्डिने।॥
en: That king Dasharnaka, known Hiranyavarman (or the golden-armoured) even that ruler of earth gave away his daughter to that Shikhandin.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: स च राजा दशार्णेषु महानासीत् सुदुर्जयः। हिरण्यवर्मा दुर्धर्षो महासेनो महामनाः॥
en: And throughout all the Dasharnaka territories that king was a mighty one, and incapable of being conquered. He protected by a golden Armour, was irresistible, had a large army and was high-souled.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: कृते विवाहे तु तदा सा कन्या राजसत्तम! यौवनं समनुप्राप्ता सा च कन्या शिखण्डिनी॥
en: And some time after the wedding had been performed, that daughter, O best of kings, attained her youth; and that daughter, Shikhandin, had also attained her youth.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: कृतदारः शिखण्डी च काम्पिल्यं पुनरागमत्। ततः सा वेद तां कन्या कञ्चित् कालं स्त्रियं किल॥१३ हिरण्यवर्मणः कन्या ज्ञात्वा तां तु शिखण्डिनीम्।
en: as was And Shikandin, being wedded, returned to Kampilya. And then after a certain time she (daughter of Hiranyavarma) came to know her to be a woman. And the daughter of Hiranyavarman, knowing Shikhandin to be a woman,

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: धात्रीणां च सखीनां च वीडमाना न्यवेदयत्। कन्यां पञ्चालराजस्य सुतां तां वै शिखण्डिनीम्॥
en: Represented to her nurses and lady companions with shame (this fact) about the maiden daughter of the king of the Panchalas, viz. Shikhandin.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: ततस्ता राजशार्दूल धात्र्यो दाशार्णिकास्तदा। जग्मुरार्ति परां प्रेष्याः प्रेषयामासुरेव च॥
en: Then those nurses from the Dasharnaka territories, O best among kings, became greatly afflicted, and dispatched emissaries (to their king).

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: ततो दशार्णाधिपतेः प्रेष्याः सर्वा न्यवेदयन्। विप्रलम्भं यथावृत्तं स च चुक्रोध पार्थिवः॥
en: Thereupon all the emissaries to the king of the Dasharnaka territories informed him of the deception that had been practice, as it had happened. And that king became filled with anger.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: शिखण्ड्यपि महाराज पुंवद् राजकुले तदा। विजहार मुदा युक्तः स्त्रीत्वं नैवातिरोचयन्॥
en: And, O great king, Shikhandin also at that time conducted himself like a male at the royal court with great joy, setting aside as it were his feminine nature.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: ततः कतिपयाहस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा भरतर्षभ। हिरण्यवर्मा राजेन्द्र रोषादार्ति जगाम ह॥
en: After the lapse of a few days, O best of the race of Bharata, on hearing of this fact (Shikhandin bearing himself like a male), Hiranyavarman, O great king, was afflicted with anger.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: ततो दाशार्णको राजा तीव्रकोपसमन्वितः। दूतं प्रस्थापयामास दुपदस्य निवेशनम्॥
en: Thereupon the king of Dasharna country, being filled with terrible anger, sent an ambassador to the court of king Drupada.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: ततो द्रुपमासाद्य दूतः काञ्चनवर्मणः। एक एकान्तमुत्सार्य रहो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then the ambassador of the goldenarmoured king having alone approached the king Drupada, took him aside and spoken these words to him in private.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: दाशार्णराजो राजंस्त्वामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। अभिषङ्गात् प्रकुपितो विप्रलब्धस्त्वयाऽघ॥
en: The king of the Dasharna country, O king, has spoken these words to you, being deceived by you and enraged with you at the deception, O sinless one.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: अवमन्यसे मां नृपते नूनं दुर्मन्त्रितं तव। यन्मे कन्यां स्वकन्यार्थते मोहाद् याचितवानसि॥
en: "You have insulted me. Surely it was not considerately done that you wanted my daughter for your daughter from folly.

description: Story of Shikhandin's birth, Arival of messenger of Hiranyavarman
sn: तस्याद्य विप्रलम्भस्य फलं प्राप्नुहि दुर्मते। एष त्वा सजनामात्यमुद्धरामि स्थिरो भव॥
en: Take now the fruit of that act of deception, O wicked one, for I will now slay you with all your relatives and ministers. Wait a bit.”

sn: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तस्य दूतेन दुपदस्य तदा नृप। चोरस्येव गृहीतस्य न प्रावर्तत भारती॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by that messenger, O king, the king Drupada, like a thief caught (red handed), could not utter a word.

sn: स यत्नमकरोत् तीव्र सम्बन्धिन्यनुमानने। दूतैर्मधुरसम्भाषैर्न तदस्तीति संदिशन्॥
en: He made great efforts, for the purpose of pacifying his son's (daughter) father-in-law, by means of messengers, instructing them to say sweetly and persuasively, 'It is not so.'

sn: स राजा भूय एवाथ ज्ञात्वा तत्त्वमथागमत्। कन्येति पाञ्चालसुतां त्वरमाणो विनिर्ययौ।॥
en: That king (Hiranyavarman), thereupon once more ascertained the real fact, that the offspring of the king of the Panchalas was a daughter, and went forth (out of his city) without delay.

sn: ततः सम्प्रेषयामास मित्राणाममितौजसाम्। दुहितुर्विप्रेलम्भं तं धात्रीणां वचनात् तदा॥
en: He then sent information to all his friends (who were) of immeasurable strength, regarding the deception that had been practiced upon his daughter, according to the massage of the nurses.

sn: ततः समुदयं कृत्वा बलानां राजसत्तमः। अभियाने मतिं चक्रे दुपदं प्रति भारत॥
en: Then that best of kings, having mustered a large army, formed the resolution of marching against the king Drupada, O Bharata.

sn: ततः सम्मन्त्रयामास मन्त्रिभिः स महीपतिः। हिरण्यवर्मा राजेन्द्र पाञ्चाल्यं पार्थिवं प्रति॥
en: Then that ruler of the earth, Hiranyavarman held a consultation with his ministers, O great king (as to the course to be taken) against the king of the Panchalas.

sn: तत्र वै निश्चितं तेषामभूद् राज्ञां महात्मनाम्। तथ्यं भवति चेदेतत् कन्या राजन् शिखण्डिनी॥ बद्ध्वा पञ्चालराजानमानयिष्यामहे गृहम्। अन्यं राजानमाधाय पञ्चालेषु नरेश्वरम्॥
en: It was then and there resolved with certainly among those high-souled kings "If this be really true that Shikhandin is a daughter, O king, then having bound the king of the Panchalas, we shall drag him (here) and having installed another king who will rule over the people,

sn: घातयिष्याम नृपतिं पाञ्चालं सशिखण्डिनम्॥ तत् तदाऽनृतमाज्ञाय पुनर्वृतान्नराधिपः। प्रास्थापयत् पार्षताय निहन्मीति स्थिरो भव॥
en: We will slay thịś king of the Panchalas along with Shikhandin. Knowing this to be the fixed resolve the king (Hiranyavarman) once more sent messengers to the son of Prishata, (with the message). “I shall slay you, wait a little."

sn: भीष्म उवाच स हि प्रकृत्या वै भीतः किल्बिषी च नराधिपः। भयं तीव्रमनुप्राप्तो दुपदः पृथिवीपतिः॥
en: Bhishma said That king was by nature not courageous, and was quiet. King Drupada, through a ruler of the earth, was dreadfully alarmed.

sn: विसृज्य दूतान् दाशार्णे दुपदः शोकमूर्छितः। समेत्य भार्या रहिते वाक्यमाह नराधिपः॥
en: Having despatched messengers of the Dasharna king, king Drupada, fainting with grief, approached his wife in secret and spoke these words.

sn: भयेन महताऽऽविष्टो हृदि शोकेन चाहतः। पाञ्चालराजो दयितां मातरं वै शिखण्डिनः॥
en: Being filled, as the Panchala king was, with great fear and struck with grief at his heart, he said to the beloved mother of Shikhandin.

sn: अभियास्यति मां कोपात् सम्बन्धी सुमहाबलः। हिरण्यवर्मा नृपतिः कर्षमाणो वरूथिनीम्॥
en: “My son's father-in-law, king Hiranyavarman, having mustered a large army, is advancing against me with anger, powerful as he is.

sn: किमिदानीं करिष्यावो मूढौ कन्यामिमां प्रति। शिखण्डी किल पुत्रस्ते कन्येति परिशङ्कितः॥
en: Fools that we both (of us) are, what are we to do now, as regards this daughter of ours? Your son Shikhandin is very much suspected to be a daughter.

sn: इति संचिन्त्य यत्नेन समित्रः सबलानुगः। वञ्चितोऽस्मीति मन्वानो मां किलोद्धर्तुमिच्छति॥
en: Under this suspicion, (king Hiranyavarman), thinking, I have been deceived, wants to slay me with his friends and army carefully mustered.

sn: किमत्र तथ्यं सुश्रोणि मिथ्या किं ब्रूहि शोभने। श्रुत्वा त्वत्तः शुभं वाक्यं संविधास्याम्यहं तथा॥
en: ( you of beautiful hips, tell me what is truth is (this case) and O beautiful lady, what is false. O auspicious one, having heard from you, I will make arrangements (how to act).

sn: अहं हि संशयं प्राप्तो बाला चेयं शिखण्डिनी। त्वं च राज्ञि महत् कृच्छ्रे सम्प्राप्ता वरवर्णिनि॥
en: I have been thrown in danger, as well this daughter Shikhandin. You also, O imperial lady of the finest complexion, are in great danger.

sn: सा त्वं सर्वविमोक्षाय तत्त्वमाख्याहि पृच्छतः। तथा विदध्यां सुश्रोणि कृत्यमाशु शुचिस्मिते॥
en: As I ask you, tell me that the truth is, for the relief of all (of us). O lady with beautiful hips and fair smiles, it depends on your words as to what ought to be speedily done.

sn: शिखण्डिनि च मा भैस्त्वं विधास्ये तत्र तत्त्वतः। कृपयाऽहं वरारोहे वञ्चितः पुत्रधर्मतः॥
en: Do you not fear, neither (let) Shikhandin (fear), for I will make suitable arrangements through kindness through I have been deprived from the duties to a son.

sn: मया दाशार्णको राजा वञ्चितः स महीपतिः। तदाचक्ष्व महाभागे विधास्ये तत्र यद्धितम्॥
en: That ruler of the earth, the king of the Dasharna country has been deceived by me. Speak, therefore O highly blessed lady, so that I may do what should be for the benefit (of all).'

sn: जानता हि नरेन्द्रेण ख्यापनार्थं परस्य वै। प्रकाशं चोदिता देवी प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम्॥
en: That goddess-like lady, being thus addressed before all the ministers by the king, for the proclamation of his innocence to others, though he knew everything, replied to the lord of the earth.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: भीष्य उवाच ततः शिखण्डिनो माता यथातत्त्वं नराधिप। आचचक्षे महाबाहो भर्ने कन्यां शिखण्डिनीम्॥
en: Bhishma said The mother of Shikhandin, O mightyarmed ruler of men, related to her husband all about her daughter Shikhandin in accordance with the real facts.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: अपुत्रया मया राजन् सपत्नीनां भयादिदम्। कन्या शिखण्डिनी जाता पुरुषो वै निवेदिता॥
en: Childless as I was, O great king, and from fear of my companion, wives, my daughter Shikhandin, when born, was represented to you as a son,

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: त्वया चैव नरश्रेष्ठ तन्मे प्रीत्यानुमोदितम्। पुत्रकर्म कृतं चैव कन्यायाः पार्थिवर्षभ॥
en: O best of men, you had, also, from love of me, corroborated it and O best among kings, the rites belonging to a son were performed for this daughter.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: भार्या चोढा त्वया राजन् दशार्णाधिपतेः सुता। मया च प्रत्यभिहितं देववाक्यार्थदर्शनात्। कन्या भूत्वा पुमान् भावीत्येवं चैतदुपेक्षितम्॥
en: And a wife was given to her, O king viz., the daughter of the king of the Dasharna territories and it was approved of by me; seeing as I did the meaning of the words of that dirty, "Born as a maiden, she will become a male" we ignored this fact of her being a daughter.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: एतच्छ्रुत्वा दुपदो यज्ञसेनः सर्वं तत्त्वं मन्त्रविद्भयो निवेद्या मन्त्रं राजा मन्त्रयामास राजन् यथायुक्तं रक्षणे वै प्रजानाम्॥
en: Hearing this, king Drupada known as Yagasena, having conformed all his councillors of all these facts, held a consultation, O king, as to the best means of protecting his subjects.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: सम्बन्धकं चैव समर्थ्य तस्मिन् दाशार्णके वै नृपतौ नरेन्द्र। काग्रो निश्चयं वै जगाम॥
en: Although he had himself deceived the king of the Dasharna country, yet sanctioning the alliance as quite proper, he began to settle his plans with concentrated attention.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: स्वभावगुप्तं नगरमापत्काले तु भारत। गोपयामास राजेन्द्र सर्वत: समलंकृतम्॥
en: Naturally well-defended, O Bharata, (he) began to fortify his city, at the time of danger, in all possible ways, and adorned it (with works of defense).

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: आर्ति च परमां जगाम सह भार्यया। दशार्णपतिना सार्धं विरोधे भरतर्षभ। टा
en: But the king was nevertheless afflicted with great grief, together with his queen, O best among Bharata's race, at this enmity with the king of Dasharna territories.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: कथं सम्बन्धिना सार्धं न मे स्याद् विग्रहो महान्। इति संचिन्त्य मनसा देवतामर्चयत् तदा॥
en: Considering in his mind as to how there might not be this great enmity with his son's father-in-law, he began to worship the gods.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: तं तु दृष्ट्वा तदा राजन् देवी देवपरं तदा। अर्चा प्रयुञ्जानमथो भार्या वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon, perceiving him to be devoted to the gods, O king, and paying his worship, his wife, that goddess like lady spoke these words.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: देवानां प्रतिपत्तिश्च सत्या साधुमता सताम्। किमु दुःखार्णवं प्राप्य तस्मादर्चयतां गुरून्॥
en: Though in prosperity, the worship of gods is truly prescribed by all righteous men, what then (ought to bu said) about those who are in distress? Therefore, worship your superiors.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: दैवतानि च सर्वाणि पूज्यन्तां भूरिदक्षिणम्। अग्नयश्चापि हूयन्तां दाशार्णप्रतिषेधने॥
en: Pay worship also to all the gods with large presents (to the Brahmanas) and let the sacred fires be ablaze, to pacify the Dasharna king.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: अयुद्धेन निवृत्तिं च मनसा चिन्तय प्रभो। देवतानां प्रसादेन सर्वमेतद् भविष्यति॥
en: O my lord, think in your mind (about a way) for pacification without involving a war. Through the grace of the gods, all this will happen.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रितं सार्धं त्वया पृथुललोचना पुरस्यास्याविनाशाय यच्च राजंस्तथा कुरु॥
en: Do as you had been counseled when you consulted with your ministers, O you with large eyes, for the preservation of this city, O king.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: दैवं हि मानुषोपेतं भृशं सिद्ध्यति पार्थिव। परस्परविरोधाद्धि सिद्धिरस्ति न चैतयोः॥
en: When earthy power is joined to godly power, it will surely succeed, O king. But there is no success when these are against each other,

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: तस्माद् विधाय नगरे विधानं सचिवैः सह। अर्चयस्व यथाकामं दैवतानि विशाम्पते॥
en: Therefore, having taken the necessary steps as regard this city with your ministers, pay adoration, O lord of earth, to the gods according to your desire.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: एवं संभाषमाणौ तु दृष्ट्वा शोकपरायणौ। शिखण्डिनी तदा कन्या वीडितेव तपस्विनी॥
en: Perceiving those two, overwhelmed with grief, talking to each other, that daughter Shikhandin, ascetic as she was, filled with shame.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: ततः सा चिन्तयामास मत्कृते दुःखितावुभौ। इमाविति ततश्चक्रे मतिं प्राणविनाशने।॥
en: Thereupon she thought (within herself), "these two (my father and mother) are afflicted with grief on my account.” Then she made up her mind for destroying her own life.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: एवं सा निश्चयं कृत्वा भृशं शोकपरायणा। निर्जगाम गृहं त्यक्त्वा गहनं निर्जनं वनम्॥
en: Having firmly taken this resolution and been deeply afflicted with grief, she went out to a deep and lonely forest, abandoning her house.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: यक्षेणमिता राजन् स्थूणाकर्णेन पालितम्। तद्भयादेव च जनो विसर्जयति तद् वनम्॥
en: That forest, O king, was inhabited by a very rich and powerful Yaksha named Sthunakarna a and it was through his fear that men forsook that forest.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: तत्र च स्थूणभवनं सुधामृत्तिकलेपनम्। ताजोल्लापिकधूमाढ्यमुच्चप्राकारतोरणम्॥
en: And there was the abode of Sthuna, washed with lime, from which issued smoke bearing the smell of fried paddy, and (surrounded) with high walls with a gate way.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: तत् प्रविश्य शिखण्डी सा दुपदस्यात्मजा नृप। अनश्नाना बहुतिथं शरीरमुदशोषयत्॥
en: Entering it, the daughter of king Drupada Shikhandin, O king, began to reduce her body by remaining without food for many a day.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: दर्शयामास तां यज्ञः स्थूणो मार्दवसंयुतः। किमर्थोऽयं तवारम्भः करिष्ये ब्रूहि मा चिरम्॥
en: That Yaksha Sthuna, who was endued with kindliness, showed himself to her (and said), "for what purpose have you began this proceeding? Tell me and do not make delay, for I will do it."

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: अशक्यमिति सा यक्षं पुनः पुनरुवाच ह। करिष्यामीति वै क्षिप्रं प्रत्युवाचाथ गुह्यकः॥
en: "It cannot be performed”, she replied to the Yaksha again and again. But that Guhyaka returned her answer immediately (by saying) “I shall surely do it."

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: धनेश्वरस्यानुचरों वरदोऽस्मि नृपात्मजे। अदेयमपि दास्यामि ब्रूहि यत् ते विवक्षितम्॥
en: “O daughter of the king, I am an attendant of the god of wealth, and I can grant boons. I will bestow even what is unbestowable. So tell me what you desire."

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: ततः शिखण्डी तत् सर्वमखिलेन न्यवेदयत्। तस्मै यक्षप्रधानाय स्थूणाकर्णाय भारत॥
en: Thereupon Shikhandin related to that chief of the Yakshas, named Sthunakarma, 0 Bharata, everything in detail.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: शिखण्डिन्युवाच अपुत्रो मे पिता यक्ष न चिरान्नाशमेष्यति। अभियास्यति सक्रोधो दशार्णधिपतिर्हि तम्॥
en: Shikhandin said “O Yaksha, my father, bereft of a son, will very soon meet with destruction, for the lord of the Dasharna territories is marching against him with anger.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: महाबलो महोत्साहः सहेमकवचो नृपः। तस्माद् रक्षस्व मां यक्षं मातरं पितरं च मे॥
en: That golden-armoured king is very powerful, and of great energy. Therefore protect me, O Yaksha, and my father and mother.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: प्रतिज्ञातो हि भवता दुःखप्रतिशमो मम। भवेयं पुरुषो यक्ष त्वत्प्रसादादनिन्दितः॥
en: The pacification of my grief has been promised by you. Let me become a man, O Yaksha, through your grace, O faultless one.

description: Story of Shikhandini, she meets a Yaksha named Sthulakarna
sn: यावदेव स राजा वै नोपयाति पुरं मम। तावदेव महायक्ष प्रसादं कुरु गुह्यकः॥
en: So long as that king does not depart from my city, bestowed your grace, O great Yaksha and Guhyaka.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: भीष्म उवाच शिखण्डिवाक्यं श्रुत्वाऽथ स यक्षो भरतर्षभ। प्रोवाच मनसा चिन्त्य दैवेनोपनिपीडितः॥
en: Bhishma said At length the Yaksha, hearing the words of Shikhandin, said, afflicted by destiny, after considering in his mind,

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: भवितव्यं तथा तद्धि मम दुःखाय कौरव। भद्रे कामं करिष्यामि समयं तु निबोध मे॥
en: Truly, it was decreed to be so for my (Bhishma's) grief, O Kaurava. "O fair one I will accomplish your wish, but listen to a condition.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: किंचित् कालान्तरे दास्ये पुल्लिङ्ग स्वमिदं तव। आगन्तव्यं त्वया काले सत्यं चैव वदस्व मे॥
en: I will bestow upon you my own manhood, for a certain period. But, (after its lapse) you will have to come in (due) time. Now, speak the truth to me.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: प्रभुः संकल्पसिद्धोऽस्मि कामचारी विहङ्गमः। मत्प्रसादात् पुरं चैव त्राहि बन्धूंश्च केवलम्॥
en: Master as I am, I have the power to do whatever I wish; I can range in the sky for I can roam about freely according to my will. Through my grace, save your city and your friends completely.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: स्त्रीलिङ्गं धारयिष्यामि तदेवं पार्थिवात्मजे। सत्यं मे प्रतिजानीहि करिष्यामि प्रियं तव॥
en: I will take on myself this your maidenhood, O daughter of a king. Pledge yourself to me (as to the condition) and I will do what is dear to you.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: शिखण्डिन्युवाच प्रतिदास्यामि भगवन् पुंल्लिङ्गं तव सुव्रत। किञ्चित्कालान्तरं स्त्रीत्वं धारयस्व निशाचर॥
en: Shikhandin said O you of good vows, I will return to you your manhood, O God. Only for a certain period bear by womanhood, O night ranger.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: प्रतियाते दशार्णे तु पार्थिवे हेमवर्मणि। कन्यैव हि भविष्यामि पुरुषस्त्वं भविष्यसि॥
en: On the departure of the Dashara king, who is known as the golden-armoured heroes, I will become a woman, and you will become a man.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्त्वा समयं तत्र चक्राते तावुभो नृप। अन्योऽन्यस्याभिसंदेहे तौ संक्रामयतां ततः॥
en: Bhishma said Having spoken thus, they two made an agreement O king, and they transferred to each other their (respective) sexes.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: स्त्रीलिङ्गं धारयामास स्थूणायक्षोऽथ भारत। यक्षरूप च तद् दीप्ते शिखण्डी प्रत्यपद्यत॥
en: The Yaksha Sthuna took upon himself (her) maidenhood, O Bharata, and Shikhandin obtained the blazing form of the Yaksha.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: ततः शिखण्डी पाञ्चाल्यः पुंस्त्वमासाद्य पार्थिव विवेश नगरं हृष्टः पितरं च समासदत्॥
en: Thereupon Shikhandin, the Panchalya, having obtained manhood, O king, entered the city and went to his father with great joy.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: यथावृत्तं तु तत् सर्वमाचख्यौ दुपदस्य तत्। दुपदस्तस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा हर्षमाहारयत् परम्॥
en: And he related everything as it had fallen out to the king Drupada. Hearing this he became filled with exceeding joy.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: सभार्यास्तच्च सस्मार महेश्वरवचस्तदा। ततः सम्प्रेषयामास दशार्णाधिपतेर्नृपः॥
en: And together with his wife, he recollected the words of Maheshvara. Then he sent words to the king of the Dasharna land, O king.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: पुरुषोऽयं मम सुतः श्रद्धत्तां मे भवानिति। अथ दाशार्णको राजा सहसाऽयागमत् तदा॥
en: "This offspring is a male. May you believe this." At length the Dasharnaka king suddenly approached,

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: पञ्चालराजं द्रुपदं दुःखशोकसमन्वितः। ततः काम्पिल्यमासाद्य दशार्णाधिपतिस्ततः॥
en: Drupada the king of the Panchalas, being filled with grief and sorrow. Thereupon having reaching Kampilya, the lord of Dasharna,

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: प्रेषयामास सत्कृत्य दूतं ब्रह्मविदां वरम्। ब्रूहि मद्वचनाद् दूत पाञ्चाल्यं तं नृपाधमम्॥
en: Sent a messenger, one of the best of those who know the Vedas, after having paid him (due) honors. Tell that most wretched king of the Panchalas according to my words,

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: यन्मे कन्यां स्वकन्यार्थं वृतवानसि दुर्मते। फलं तस्यावलेपस्य द्रक्ष्यस्यद्य न संशयः॥
en: That as you selected my daughter for your daughter, O wicked one, so you will see the fruit of that insult very soon, no doubt,

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: एवमुक्तश्च तेनासौ ब्राह्मणौ राजसत्तम। दूतः प्रयातो नगरं दाशार्णनृपचोदितः॥
en: Thus addressed, that Brahmana messenger, dispatched by that Dasharna king, traveled towards the city, O best of kings.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: तत आसादयामास पुरोधा दुपदं पुरे। तस्मै पाञ्चालको राजा गामर्थ्य च सुसत्कृतम्॥
en: That priest then arrived at the city of Drupada. And to him, the Panchala king paid all homage by offering a cow and the Arghya (a mixture of honey, milk &c paid as a homage on one's arrival at a house).

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: प्रापयामास राजेन्द्र सह तेन शिखण्डिना। तां पूजां नाभ्यनन्दतं स वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह॥
en: And (the Panchala king) went up to him along with Shikhandin, O great king. But he (the messenger) did not accept that homage, but said these words,

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: यदुक्तं तेन वीरेण राज्ञा काञ्चनवर्मणा। यत् तेऽहमधमाचार दुहित्राऽस्म्यभिवञ्चितः॥
en: Which had been communicated by that warrior king, the golden-armored one. As I have been deceived, O you of vile conduct, by you daughter,

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: तस्य पापस्य करणात् फलं प्राप्नुहि दुर्मते। देहि युद्धं नरपते ममाद्य रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Receive, therefore, O wicked one, the (fruit) an account of the criminal act (of yours); give battle, O king, to me, on the field of battle, without delay.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: उद्धरिष्यामि ते सद्य: सामात्यसुतबान्धवम्। तदुपालम्भसंयुक्तं श्रावितः किल पार्थिवः॥
en: I will forthwith slay your ministers, offspring and friends. The king having heard this, the result of that insult,

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: दशार्णपतिना चोक्तो मन्त्रिमध्ये पुरोधसा। अभवद् भरतश्रेष्ठ दुपदः प्रणयानतः॥
en: And being thus addressed by the king of Dasharna through his priest, in the presence of his ministers, Drupada assumed a tone of friendship, O best of Bharata's race.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: यदाह मां भवान् ब्रह्मन् सम्बन्धिवचनाद् वचः। अस्योत्तरंप्रतिवचो दूतो राज्ञे वदिष्यति॥
en: What you have spoken, O Brahmana, according to the words of my kinsman (son's father-in-law) receive its reply, my messenger will give the answer to the king.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: ततः सम्प्रेषयामास दुपदोऽपि महात्मने। हिरण्यवर्मणे दूतं ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम्॥
en: King Drupada then despatched a Brahmana messenger, versed in all the Vedas to the high-souled golden armored one.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: तमागम्य तु राजानं दशार्णाधिपतिं तदा। तद् वाक्यमाददे राजन् यदुक्तं द्रुपदेन ह॥
en: Approaching the king, viz., the lord of the Dasharna land he gave the reply, O king, as it had been spoken, O king, by Drupada.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: आगमः क्रियतां व्यक्तः कुमारोऽयं सुतो मम। मिथ्यैतदुक्तं केनापि तदश्रद्धेयमित्युत॥
en: Make an enquiry and let this be made clear that this prince, is my son. You have been misinformation by some body; but this is surely unworthy of belief

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: ततः स राजा दुपदस्य श्रुत्वा विमर्षयुक्तो युवतीर्वरिष्ठाः। सम्प्रेषयामास सुचारुरूपाः शिखण्डिनं स्त्री पुमान् वेति वेत्तुम्॥
en: Thereupon that king, hearing (the words) of the Drupada, became dejected, and sent some choice, youthful ladies of great beauty to Shikhandin to ascertain whether he was a man or a woman.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: ताः प्रेषितास्तत्त्वभावं विदित्वा प्रीत्या राज्ञे तच्छशंसुर्हि सर्वम्। शिखण्डिनं पुरुषं कौरवेन्द्र दाशार्णराजाय महानुभावम्॥
en: Those ladies, who had been despatched, having learnt the truth, praised all about Shikhandin who was a man of great strength, O best of Kuru's race, to the king of the Dasharna country.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: ततः कृत्वा तु राजा स आगमं प्रीतिमानथ। सम्बन्धिना समागम्य हृष्टो वासमुवास ह॥
en: Having made this test, the king gladdened at heart, going up to his kinsman (his daughter's father-in-law) lived with him (some time) with gladness.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: शिखण्डिने च मुदितः प्रादाद् वित्तं जनेश्वरः। हस्तिनोऽश्वांश्चगाश्चैव दास्योऽथ बहुलास्तथा॥
en: And that lord of men gave away with joy to Shikhandin great wealth, and elephants, horses and cattle and slaves also in large numbers.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: पूजितश्च प्रतिययौ निर्भय॑ तनयां किल। विनीतकिल्बिषे प्रीते हेमवर्मणि पार्थिवे।
en: And he departed, being worshipped after having rebuked his daughter. After the gladdened king with the golden Armour, on being pacified,

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: प्रतियाते दशाणे तु हृष्टरूपा शिखण्डिनी॥ कस्याचित् त्वथ कालस्य कुबेरो नरवाहनः। लोकयात्रां प्रकुर्वाणाः स्थूणस्यागान्निवेशनम्॥
en: Had made his departure, Shikhandin was filled with joy for some time. After the lapse of a certain period, Kubera, who had been for his bearers, making a journey through the earth, came to the abode of Sthuna.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: स तद्गृहस्योपरि वर्तमान आलोकयामास धनाधिगोप्ता। स्थूणस्य यक्षस्य विवेश वेश्म स्वलंकृतं माल्यगुणैर्विचित्रैः॥
en: Moving to and fro over his abode, the protector of all wealth observed that the mansion of the Yaksha Sthuna was beautifully adorned with devise sorts of garlands;

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: लाज्यैश्च गन्धैश्च तथा वितानैरभ्यर्चितं धूपनधूपितं च। ध्वजैः पताकाभिरलंकृतं च भक्ष्यानपेयामिषदन्तहोमम्॥
en: And with fragrant roots (of plants) and scented with the smoke of sweet incense, and ornamented with banners and well supplied with food and drink.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: तत् स्थानं तस्य दृष्ट्वा तु सर्वतः समलंकृतम्। मणिरत्नसुवर्णानां मालाभिः परिपूरितम्॥
en: Seeing that spot of his, ornamented in every way, and (everywhere filled with garlands of gems and precious stones and gold,

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: नानाकुसुमगन्धाढ्यं सिक्तसम्मृष्टशोभितम्। अथाब्रवीद् यक्षपतिस्तान् यक्षाननुगांस्तदा॥
en: And breathing with the fragrance of various sorts of flowers, and looking beautiful being well-swept and watered, the lord of all Yakshas at length spoke to his attendant Yakshas.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: स्वलंकृतमिदं वेश्म स्थूणस्यामितविक्रमाः। नोपसर्पति मां चैव कस्मादद्य स मन्दधीः॥
en: This mansion of Sthuna is well-adorned, O you (followers) of immeasurable powers. Why does not this fool, however, approach me?

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: यस्माज्जानन् स मन्दात्मा मामसौ नोपसर्पति। तस्मात् तस्मै महादण्डो धार्यः स्यादिति मे मतिः।।३९।
en: As this fool does not approach me, though knowing (that I am here), therefore he should be inflicted on a severe punishment. This is what I think.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: यक्षा ऊचुः दुपदस्य सुता राजन् राज्ञो जाता शिखण्डिनी। तस्या निमित्ते कस्मिंश्चित् प्रादात् पुरुषलक्षणम्॥
en: The Yakshas said Oking, a daughter was born to king Drupada, by name Shikhandin. For her sake, on some account, he has given away his manhood.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: अग्रहील्लक्षणं स्त्रीणां स्त्रीभूतो तिष्ठते गृहे। नोपसर्पति तेनासौ सब्रीडः स्त्रीसरूपवान्॥
en: Having taken her womanhood (on himself) he remains in this abode, being a woman. He does not approach (you), bashful on account of her holding the form of a woman.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: एतस्मात् कारणाद् राजन् स्थूणो न त्वाद्य सर्पति। श्रुत्वा कुरु यथान्यायं विमानमिह तिष्ठताम्॥
en: It is for this reason, O king, that Sthuna does not approach you today. Having (now) heard (this) do as it seems proper. “Let the car be stopped here."

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: आनीयतां स्थूण इति ततो यक्षाधिपोऽब्रवीत्। कर्तास्मि निग्रहं तस्य प्रत्युवाच पुनः पुनः॥
en: "Let Sthuna be brought, I shall inflict punishment on him." Said thus the lord of the Yakshas again and again.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: सोऽभ्यगच्छत यक्षेन्द्रमाहूतः पृथिवीपते। स्त्रीसरूपो महाराज तस्थौ व्रीडासमन्वितः॥
en: Being summoned, O lord of the earth, he came before the king of the Yakshas; and O great king, having the form of a female, he stood bashfully.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: तं शशापाथ संक्रुद्धो धनदः कुरुनन्दन। एवमेव भवत्वद्य स्त्रीत्वं पापस्य गुह्यकाः॥
en: Then the giver of wealth crushed him in his anger, O descendant of Kuru's race, “even never thus let the womanhood of this sinful one remain, O Guhyakas!"

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: ततोऽब्रवीद् यक्षपतिर्महात्मा यस्माददास्त्ववमन्येह यक्षान्। शिखण्डिने लक्षणं पापबुद्धे स्त्रीलक्षणं चाग्रही: पापकर्मन्॥
en: And then that high-souled lord of Yakshas (again) said, “As you have humiliated all Yakshas by giving away your own sex of Shikhandin, O you of sinful understanding and by taking her female sex, O you of sinful deeds,"

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: अप्रवृत्तं सुदुर्बुद्धे यस्मादेतत् त्वया कृतम्। तस्मादद्य प्रभृत्येव स्त्री त्वं सा पुरुषस्तथा॥
en: As you have perpetrated this, you of evil understanding, which had been attempted by any one (before this), so from this day forth you shall remain a woman, and she a man.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: ततः प्रसादयामासुर्यक्षा वैश्रवणं किला स्थूणस्यार्थं कुरुष्वान्तं शापस्येति पुनः पुनः॥
en: The Yakshas then began to appease (the anger of) Vaishravana, for the sake of Sthuna Karna, (saying) "set a limit to your course" again and again.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: ततो महात्मा यक्षेन्द्रः प्रत्युवाचानुगामिनः। सर्वान् यक्षगणांस्तात शापस्यान्तचिकीर्षया॥
en: Then that high-souled lord of the Yakshas, o son, answered his followers, all those Yakshas, with the desire of setting a limit to (his) curse.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: शिखण्डिनि हते यक्षाः स्वं रूपं प्रतिपत्स्यते। स्थूणो यक्षो निरुद्वेगो भवत्विति महामनाः॥
en: On the death of Shikhandin 0 you Yakshas of high minds, he shall regain his own form. Therefore let the Yaksha Sthuna be free from anxiety.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् देवो यक्षराजः सुपूजितः। प्रययौ सहितः सर्वैनिमेषान्तरचारिभिः॥
en: Having thus spoken, that mighty god, king of the Yakshas, departed well honored, with all those followers, who traveled (a great distance) in a moment.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: स्थूणस्तु शापं सम्प्राप्य तत्रैव न्यवसत् तदा। समये चागमत् तूर्णं शिखण्डी तं क्षपाचरम्॥
en: Sthuna, having received this curse, he stayed there. In due time Shikhandin came to that Rakshasa.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: सोऽभिगम्याब्रवीद् वाक्यं प्राप्तोऽस्मि भगवन्निति। तमब्रवीत् ततः स्थूण: प्रीतोऽस्मीति पुनः पुनः॥
en: Approaching him, he said these words” I am come to you) O god. “Thereupon Sthuna said to him again and again, I am pleased (with you).”

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: आर्जवेनागतं दृष्ट्वा राजपुत्रं शिखण्डिनम्। सर्वमेव यथावृत्ताचचक्षे शिखण्डिने॥
en: Seeing that prince Shikhandin come to him without guile, he related to Shikhandin everything as it had happened.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: यक्षा उवाच ऊचुः शप्तो वैश्रवणेनाहं त्वत्कृते पार्थिवात्मज। गच्छेदानीं यथाकामं चर लोकान् यथासुखम्॥
en: The Yaksha said It is not your fault, O princess, that I have (thus) been crushed by Vaishravana (but of my own destiny). Depart now according to your pleasure, and live with all happiness on this earth.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: दिष्टमेतत् पुरा मन्ये न शक्यमतिवर्तितुम्। गमनं तव चेतो हि पौलस्त्यस्य च दर्शनम्॥
en: It is my belief that it was ordained before hand, and is incapable of being altered, viz., his coming here and my seeing Paulastya (the god of wealth).

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तः शिखण्डी तु स्थूणयक्षेण भारत। प्रत्याजगाम नगरं हर्षेण महता वृतः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by the Yaksha Sthuna o Bharata, Shikhandin went back to the city filled with great joy.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: पूजयामास विविधैर्गन्धमाल्यैर्महाधनैः। द्विजातीन् देवताश्चैव चैत्यानथ चतुष्पथान्॥
en: he And worshipped with great sumptuousness and with scents and garlands of all sorts, all those of the twice-born, and the gods and the (sacred) trees and cross-ways.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: दुपदः सह पुत्रेण सिद्धार्थेन शिखण्डिना। मुदं च परमां लेभे पाञ्चाल्यः सह बान्धवैः॥
en: And Drupada, the king of Panchalas, became exceedingly joyful, with his son Shikhandin who had obtained his desire and as well as with his friends.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: शिष्यार्थ प्रददौ चाथ द्रोणाय कुरुपुङ्गवा शिखण्डिनं महाराज पुत्रं स्त्रीपूर्विणं तथा॥
en: And then he gave away to Drona as a disciple, O best of the race, his son Shikhandin, who had been before (this) a daughter, O king.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: प्रतिपेदे चतुष्पादं धनुर्वेदं नृपात्मजः। शिखण्डी सह युष्माभिधृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥
en: And the king's son, Shikhandin, obtained (the knowledge) of the science of arms with its four divisions (receiving, holding, using, and baffling weapons), as also yourselves and Dhrishtadyumna of Prishata's race.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: मम त्वेतच्चरास्तात यथावत् प्रत्यवेदयन्। जडान्धबधिराकारा ये मुक्ता द्रुपदे मया॥
en: To me however, my spies who had been set on Drupada by me, (in the guise of) being idiots, who were blind and deaf, related all things as they happened, O son.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: एवमेष महाराज स्त्रीपुमान् दुपदात्मजः। स सम्भूतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ शिखण्डी रथसत्तमः॥
en: In this way it is, O great king, that the son of Drupada is both a man and woman, and he was born as Shikhandin, O best of Kurus, and as the best of car-warriors.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: ज्येष्ठा काशिपतेः कन्या अम्बानामेति विश्रुता। द्रुपदस्य कुले जाता शिखण्डी भरतर्षभ॥
en: (Thus it happened), 0 best among Bharata's race, that the eldest daughter of the king of Kashi, known by the name of Amba, is born in the family of Drupada as Shikhandin.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: नाहमेनं धनुष्पाणिं युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम्। मुहूर्तमपि पश्येय प्रहरेयं न चाप्युत॥
en: I will not look for a single moment nor even strike, though appearing before me with his bow in his hand with the desire of

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: व्रतमेतन्मम सदा पृथिव्यामपि विश्रुतम्। स्त्रियां स्त्रीपूर्वके चैव स्त्रीनाम्नि स्त्रीसरूपिणि॥
en: This is the vow which I have taken for all time, and it is known to all the earth, that on women, or on those who had been women before, on those whose names were those of women, or even those whose appearance resembles that of a woman,

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: न मुञ्चेयमहं बाणमिति कौरवनन्दन। न हन्यामहमेतेन कारणेन शिखण्डिनम्॥
en: I will not let go my weapons, O son of Kuru's race, I will not, for this reason, slay this Shikhandin.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: एतत् तत्त्वमहं वेद जन्म तात शिखण्डिनः। ततो नैनं हनिष्यामि समरेष्वाततायिनम्॥
en: I know this truth about the birth of Shikhandin, O son, and therefore I will not slay him in any battle, through with weapon in his hand.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: यदि भीष्मः स्त्रियं हन्यात् सन्तः कुर्युर्विगर्हणम्। नैनं तस्माद्धनिष्यामि दृष्ट्वापि समरे स्थितम्॥
en: If Bhishma slays a woman, all rightminded men will censure him and therefore I will not slay him, even if I see him standing on the battle field.

description: The exchanges of sexes and Shikhandin's return to his city
sn: वैशम्पयान उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौरव्यो राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। मुहूर्तमिव स ध्यात्वा भीष्मे युक्तममन्यत॥
en: Vaishampayana said On hearing this, king Duryodhana, a descendant of Kuru's race, having reflected for a moment, considered this to be fitting in Bhishma.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: संजय उवाच प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां पुनरेव सुतस्तव। मध्ये सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य पितामहमपृच्छत॥
en: Sanjaya said When the night had dawned, your son again, in the midst of all the army, asked his Grandsire.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: पाण्डवेयस्य गाङ्गेय यदेतत् सैन्यमुद्यतम्। प्रभूतनरनागाश्वं महारथसमाकुलम्॥
en: This army O the son of Pandu, O son of Ganga, ready for fight, abounding in men and elephants, and crowded with mighty chariotwarriors,

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: भीमार्जुनप्रभृतिभिर्महेष्वासैर्महाबलैः। लोकपालसमैर्गुप्तं धृष्टद्युम्नपुगेगमैः॥
en: Protected by such great archers of mighty strength as Bhima and Arjuna, equal to the legends (of the worlds) and Dhrishtadyumna is its leader,

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: अप्रधृष्यमनावार्यमुद्भूतमिव सागरम्। सेनासागरमक्षोभ्यमपि देवैर्महाहवे॥
en: Which is incapable of being vanquished and irresistible and appearing like a raging ocean, this ocean of soldiers, incapable of being rifled even by the very gods in a mighty battle.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: केन कालेन गाङ्गेय क्षपयेथा महाद्युते। आचार्यो वा महेष्वासः कृपो वा सुमहाबलः॥
en: By what time, O son of Ganga, of great effulgence, can you annihilate and (in what time) the mighty archer (our preceptor) Drona or Kripa, of great strength.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: कर्णो वा समरश्लाघी द्रौणिर्वा द्विजसत्तमः। दिव्यास्त्रविदुषः सर्वे भवन्तो हि बले मम॥
en: Or Karna, who globes in battle, or that best of the twice-borm, the son of Drona, (can destiny it)? You that are well versed in celestial weapons, are in my army.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: एतदिच्छाम्यहं ज्ञातुं परं कौतूहलं हि मे। हृदि नित्यं महाबाहो वक्तुमर्हसि मन्मम॥
en: I very much desire to know this have a mighty curiosity in my heart always (to know this). (O mighty-armed one,) it is met for you to tell me this.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: भीष्म उवाच अनुरूपं कुरुश्रेष्ठ त्वय्येतत् पृथिवीपते। बलाबलममित्राणां तेषां यदिह पृच्छसि॥
en: Bhishma said This is, indeed, becoming just like yourself 0 best of Kurus, and O lord of the earth that you desire to know the strength and weakness of your enemies.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: शृणु राजन् मम रणे या शक्तिः परमा भवेत्। शस्त्रवीर्यं रणे यच्च भुजयोश्च महाभुज॥
en: Hear therefore, o king, of my utmost power which I can exert in battle, both with reference to the power of my weapons in battle, and also that of my arms, you of mighty arms.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: आर्जवेनैव युद्धेन योद्धव्य इतरो जनः। मायायुद्धेन मायावी इत्येतद् धर्मनिश्चयः॥
en: Ordinary men ought to be fought without artifice, and with deceptive artifices one versed in them; this is the rule that has been settled,

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: हन्यामहं महाभाग पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्। दिवसे दिवसे कृत्वा भागं प्रागह्निकं मम॥
en: O highly blessed one, I can slay the army of the Pandavas, by making a division of the day, and taking the morning each day for my share,

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: योधानां दशसाहस्रं कृत्वा भागं महाद्युते। सहस्रं रथिनामेकमेष भागो मतो मम॥
en: Ten thousand soldiers, by this division, O you of great effulgence, and of car-warriors, one thousand, this I think (I can take as) my share.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: अनेनाहं विधानेन संनद्धः सततोत्थितः। क्षपयेयं महत् सैन्यं कालेनानेन भारत॥
en: According to this way, being always with my Armour, and always (spending my time) in action, I can annihilate this huge army in a certain period, O Bharata.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: मुञ्चेयं यदि वास्त्राणि महान्ति समरे स्थितः। शतसाहिस्रघातीनि हन्यां मासेन भारत॥
en: But if I shoot my mighty weapons I can slay (at once) hundreds and thousands; being stationed in battle, I can slay (the army) in a month, O Bharata.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: संजय उवाच श्रुत्वा भीष्मस्य तद् वाक्यं राजा दुर्योधनस्ततः। पर्यपृच्छत राजेन्द्र द्रोणमङ्गिरसां वरम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Hearing these words of Bhishma king Duryodhana then asked Drona, the foremost of Angira's race, O great king,

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: आचार्य केन कालेन पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकान्। निहन्या इति तं द्रोणः प्रत्युवाच हसन्निव॥
en: “O preceptor, in what time can you annihilate the soldiers of the son of Pandu?” Drona replied to him, as if smilingly.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: स्थविरोऽस्मि महाबाहो मन्दप्राणविचेष्टितः। शस्त्रग्निना निर्दहेयं पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥
en: I am old and my energy and prowess of exertion have become weak, O mighty-armed one. I can consume this army of the Pandavas by the fire of my weapons,

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: यथा भीष्मः शान्तनवो मासेनेति मतिर्मम। एषा मे परमा शक्तिरेतन्मे परमं बलम्॥
en: Just like Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, by a month's time; so I think. This is my utmost power, this is my greatest strength.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: द्वाभ्यामेव तु मासाभ्यां कृपः शारद्वतोऽब्रवीत्। द्रौणिस्तु दशरात्रेण प्रतिजज्ञे बलक्षयम्॥
en: Then Sharadvata's son, Kripa replied “In two month's time." And the son of Drona promised the destruction of the army in ten nights.

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: कर्णस्तु पञ्चरात्रेण प्रतिजज्ञे महास्त्रवित्। तच्छ्रुत्वा सूतपुत्रस्य वाक्यं सागरगासुतः॥
en: Karna, knowing as he did (the use of) mighty weapons, promised it in five nights. Hearing those words of the son of Suta, the son of the ocean, going (Ganga),

description: Description of the streinght of Pandavas
sn: जहास सस्वनं हासं वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह। न हि यावद् रणे पार्थं बाणशङ्खधनुर्धरम्॥ वासुदेवसमायुक्तं रथेनायान्तमाहवे। समागच्छसि राधेय तेनैवमभिमन्यसे। शक्यमेवं च भूयश्च त्वया वक्तुं यथेष्टतः॥
en: Laughed an audible laugh, and spoke these words. "As long as the son of Pritha, holding his weapons and conch and bows in battle, You do not encounter, O son of Radha, coming as he does in battle, on his chariot guided by Vasudeva, so long can you think so. You indeed capable of saying anything again, even what you please.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौन्तेयः सर्वान् भ्रातृनुपह्वरे। आहूष भरतश्रेष्ठ इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing this, the son of Kunti (Yudhishthira) summoned all his brothers. Having summoned (them), O best of the Bharata race, he spoke these words.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु ये चारपुरुषा मम। ते प्रवृत्तिं प्रयच्छन्ति ममेमां व्युषितां निशाम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said The spies, whom I have in the army of the son of Dhritarashtra, brought me this news when the night has passed away.

sn: दुर्योधनः किलापृच्छदापगेयं महाव्रतम्। केन कालेन पाण्डूनां हन्याः सैन्यमिति प्रभो॥
en: 'Duryodhana asked the son of Ganga of high vows, "O lord! in what time can you annihilate the army of the sons of Pandu?"

sn: मासेनेति च तेनोक्तो धार्तराष्ट्रः सुदुर्मतिः। तावता चापि कालेन द्रोणोऽपि प्रतिजज्ञिवान्॥
en: And the wicked son of Dhritarashtra was answered, "In a month." And in that same time Drona also has promised.

sn: गौतमो द्विगुणं कालमुक्तवानिति नः श्रुतम्। द्रोणिस्तु दशरात्रेण प्रतिजज्ञे महास्त्रवित्॥
en: And we have heard that the son of Gautama has promised the same in double that time, and the son of Drona has promised (the same) in ten nights, acquainted as he is with mighty weapons.

sn: तथा दिव्यास्त्रवितं कर्णः सम्पृष्टः कुरुसंसदि। पञ्चमिर्दिवसैर्हन्तुं ससैन्यं प्रतिजज्ञिवान्॥
en: Then Karna, who knows (the use of) celestial weapons, being asked in the army of the Kurus, has pledged himself to slay us with our armies in five days.

sn: तस्मादहमपीच्छामि श्रोतुमर्जुन ते वचः। कालेन कियता शत्रून् क्षपयेरिति फाल्गुन॥
en: On this account, I also desire, to hear your words, O Arjuna, in what time you are able to destroy our enemies, O Falguna.'

sn: एवमुक्तो गुडाकेशः पार्थिवेन धनंजयः। वासुदेवं समीक्ष्येदं वचनं प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Thus addressed Dhananjaya, with thick hair, looking towards Vasudeva, spoke these words.

sn: सर्व एते महात्मानः कृतास्त्राश्चित्रयोधिनः। असंशयं महाराज हन्युरेव न संशयः॥
en: All these high-minded heroes accomplished in arms, and capable of fighting in desire ways, and they can, no doubt O great king, slay us.

sn: अपैतु ते मनस्तापो यथा सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम्। हन्यामेकरथेनैव वासुदेवसहायवान्॥
en: But let your mind be free from anxiety; I say truly that I can with the aid of Vasudeva, root out, on a single car,

sn: सामरानपि लोकांस्त्रीन् सर्वान् स्थावरजङ्गमान्। भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च निमेषादिति मे मतिः॥
en: The three words with all their celestial and all things movable, and all beings that were, or are to b, in the twinkling of an eye; such is what I think.

sn: तद् घोरं पशुपतिः प्रादादस्त्रं महन्मम। कैराते द्वन्द्वयुद्धे तु तदिदं मयि वर्तते॥
en: That terrible and mighty weapon which the lord of all gods bestowed on me in the combat are hand-to-hand, with (Mahadeva in the guise of) a hunter, even that (weapon) is with me.

sn: यद् युगान्ते पशुपतिः सर्वभूतानि संहरन्। प्रयुङ्क्ते पुरुषव्याघ्र तदिदं मयि वर्तते॥
en: That (weapon) which the lord of all gods uses when he annihilates all forms of existence, even that O best among men, is with me.

sn: तन्न जानाति गाङ्गेयो न द्रोणो न च गौतमः। न च द्रोणसुतो राजन् कुत एव तु सूतजः॥
en: The son of Ganga does not know the (weapon), nor Drona, nor the son of Gautama, neither also the son of Drona; O king, whence, then, can the son of Suta (know)?

sn: न तु युक्तं रणे हन्तुं दिव्यैरस्त्रैः पृथग्जनम्। आर्जवेनैव युद्धेन विजेष्यामो वयं परान्॥
en: It is not, however, proper to annihilate in a battle, by means of celestial weapons ordinary men. We will by artless fighting vanquish our foes.

sn: तथेमे पुरुषव्याघ्राः सहायास्तत्र पार्थिव। सर्वे दिव्यास्त्रविद्वांसः सर्वे युद्धाभिकाक्षिणः॥
en: Again, these foremost among men are your allies, O king. They are all acquainted with celestial weapons, and all of them, are desirous of battle.

sn: वेदान्तावभृथस्नाताः सर्व एतेऽपराजिताः। निहन्युः समरे सेनां देवानामपि पाण्डवः॥
en: All of them have performed sacrificial rites in company with their wives, after they had become versed respectively in Vedas, and have never been conquered. They can destroy the army of even the gods in battle, O son of Pandu.

sn: शिखण्डी युयुधानश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। भीमसेनो यमौ चोभौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ॥
en: And Shikhandin, Yuyudhana, and Dhrishtadyumna, of Prishata's race, and Bhimasena, and these twins, Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas,

sn: विराटदुपदौ चोभौ भीष्मद्रोणसमौ युधि। शङ्खश्चैव महाबाहु डिम्बश्च महाबलः॥
en: And both of them viz., Virata and Drupada, who are equal to Bhishma and Drona (respective) in battle, and the powerful Shankha and the son of Hidimba of great strength,

sn: पुत्रोऽस्याञ्जनपर्वा तु महाबलपराक्रमः। शैनेयश्च महाबाहुः सहायो रणकोविदः॥
en: And his son Anjanaparva, of great strength and prowess, and the descendant of Shini's race, well versed in fighting, and who is your ally,

sn: अभिमन्युश्च बलवान् द्रौपद्याः पञ्च चात्मजाः। स्वयं चापि समर्थोऽसि त्रैलोक्योत्सादनेऽपि च॥
en: And the powerful Abhimanyu, and the five sons of Draupadi are also at your service. And you to are alone capable of annihilating even the three words.

sn: क्रोधाद् यं पुरुषं पश्येस्तथा शकसमाते। स क्षिप्रं न भवेद् व्यक्तमिति त्वां वेनि कौरव॥
en: O you of effulgence equal to Shakra (Indra), that person on whom you cast a look of anger, surely meets with death for it has been seen and so I know, O Kaurava.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रभाते विमले धार्तराष्ट्रेण चोदिताः। दुर्योधनेन राजानः प्रययुः पाण्डवान् प्रति॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then, the next morning, when all was cloudy, all the kings, advanced against the son of Pandu, being excited by Duryodhana the son of Dhritarashtra.

sn: आप्लाव्य शुचयः सर्वे स्रग्विणः शुक्लवाससः। गृहीतशास्त्रा ध्वजिनः स्वस्ति वाच्य हुताग्नयः॥
en: And they were all purified by having bathed and (decked) with garlands, and clothed in white raiment's, And having taken their weapons, and raised banners they received the blessings, after the sacred fires had been lighted.

sn: सर्वे ब्रह्मविदः शूराः सर्वे सुचरितव्रताः। सर्वे कामकृतश्चैव सर्वे चाहवलक्षणाः॥
en: All of them were versed in the Vedas, and were powerful warriors, and all of them had always ably observed their vows, and all could do as they pleased, and all showed signs of having (previously) fought.

sn: आहवेषु पराँल्लोकान् जिगीषन्तो महाबलाः। एकाचमनसः सर्वे श्रद्दधानाः परस्परम्॥
en: Desirous of earning for themselves regions of bliss in the next world, and in battle, might and strenght, they had their attention fixed and had faith in each other.

sn: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ केकया बाह्निकैः सह। प्रययुः सर्व एवैते भारद्वाजपुरोगमा:॥
en: (First of all) Vinda and Anuvinda, both of Avanti, and the Kaikeyas with the Balhika's went out with Bharadvaja at their head.

sn: अश्वत्थामा शान्तनवः सैन्धवोऽथ जयद्रथः। दाक्षिणात्याः प्रतीच्याच पार्वतीयाश्च ये नृपाः॥
en: Then (came) Ashvathama and the son of Shantanu, and Jayadratha of the Sindhu country, and those kings who came from the south and west and other mountainous territories.

sn: गान्धारराजः शकुनिः प्राच्योदीच्याश्च सर्वशः। शकाः किराता यवनाः शिवयोऽथ वसातयः॥
en: And then the Gandharva king named Shakuni and all those who came from the east and north from all parts, and the Shakas, Kiratas, Yavanas, Shibis and the Vasatis,

sn: स्वैः स्वैरनीकैः सहिताः परिवार्य महारथम्। एते महारथाः सर्वे द्वितीये निर्ययुले॥
en: All these with their respective forces, surrounded their Maharathas, and all the Maharathas went out in the second division of the army.

sn: कृतवर्मा सहानीकस्त्रिगर्तश्च महारथः। दुर्योधनश्च नृपतिर्भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः॥
en: Then (came) Kritavarman with his forces, and the great car-warrior Trigarta, and king Duryodhana, surrounded by his brothers.

sn: शलोभूरिश्रवाः शल्य: कौसल्योऽथ बृहद्रथः। एते पश्चादनुगता धार्तराष्ट्रपुरोगमाः॥
en: And Shalya and Brihadratha the monarch of the Kausalya, marched in the rear, led by the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sn: ते समेत्य यथान्यायं धार्तराष्ट्रा महाबलाः। कुरुक्षेत्रस्य पश्चार्धे व्यवातिष्ठन्त दंशिताः॥
en: And these followers of the great and mighty son of Dhritarashtra, uniting together according to the proper mode took up their station, all clad in Armour, on the back part of the plains of Kurukshetra.

sn: दुर्योधनस्तु शिबिरं कारयामास भारत। यथैव हास्तिनपुरं द्वितीयं समलंकृतम्॥
en: And Duryodhana caused his camp to be so made, O Bharata, as to look like a second Hastinapur, well-ornamented.

sn: न विशेषं विजानन्ति पुरस्य शिविरस्य वा। कुशला अपि राजेन्द्र नरा नगरवासिनः॥
en: And, O great king, even the clever men who lived in the city could not detect any distinguishing feature if their encampment from the city.

sn: तादृशान्येव दुर्गाणि राज्ञामपि महीपतिः। कारयामास कौरव्यः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: And the descendant of Kuru, a lord of the earth, caused camps similar to this, inaccessible (to others). to be made, by hundreds and thousands, for the kings.

sn: पञ्चयोजनमुत्सृज्य मण्डलं तद्रणाजिरम्। सेनानिवेशास्ते राजन्नाविशञ्छतसंधशः॥
en: That encampment of war stood on a circular area of five Yojanas. And into them,O king, he made soldiers with their horses &c., enter in groups of hundreds.

sn: तत्र ते पृथिवीपाला यथोत्साहं यथाबलम्। विविशुः शिबिराण्यत्र द्रव्यवन्ति सहस्रशः॥
en: Therein those rulers of earth entered, according to their respective strength and prowess, in camps which abounded in things by thousands.

sn: तेषां दुर्योधनो राजा ससैन्यानां महात्मनाम्। व्यादिदेश सवाह्यानां भक्ष्यभोज्यमनुत्तमम्॥
en: And king Duryodhana ordered provisions of the best kind for high-souled (warriors) with their forces, consisting of infantry.

sn: सनागाश्वमनुष्याणां ये च शिल्पोपजीविनः। ये चान्येऽनुगतास्तत्र सूतमागधबन्दिनः॥
en: And elephants, horses and other men. Those who lived by mechanical arts and those who followed them there as bards, singers and panegyrists.

sn: वणिजो गणिकाचारा ये चैव प्रेक्षका जनाः। सर्वांस्तान् कौरवो राजा विधिवत् प्रत्यवेक्षत॥
en: And merchants and prostitutes and spies, and those who came as sight-seers, the Kuru king looked into (the needs of) all of them, with all proper care.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथैव राजा कौन्तेयो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। धृष्टद्युम्नमुखान् वीरांश्चोदयामास भारत।।।।
en: Vaishampayana said In the same way the virtuous king Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, urged the warriors headed by Dhrishtadyumna, O Bharata.

sn: चेदिकाशिकरूषाणां नेतारं दृढविक्रमम। सेनापतिममित्रघ्नं धृष्टकेतुमथादिशत्॥
en: He ordered the leaders and commander of the Chedis, Kashis, and Karushas, Dhrishtaketu, of steady prowess, and the slayer of foes,

sn: विराटं दुपदं चैव युयुधान् शिखण्डिनम्। पाञ्चाल्यौ च महेष्वासौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ॥
en: And Virata, and Drupada and Yuyudhana and Shikhandin, and the mighty archers, rulers of Panchalas, the two Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas (to advance).

sn: ते शूराश्चित्रवर्माणस्तप्तकुण्डलधारिणः। आज्यावसिक्ताज्वलिताधिष्ण्येष्विव हुताशनाः॥
en: Those warriors, clad in variegated armours, and bearing golden ear-rings shone like clarified butter is poured (or them).

sn: अशोभन्त महेष्वासा ग्रहाः प्रज्वलिता इव। अथ सैन्यं यथायोगं पूजयित्वा नरर्षभः॥
en: Those mighty archers shone beautiful like burning constellations. At length having paid due homage to the army, that best among men,

sn: दिदेश तान्यनीकानि प्रयाणाय महीपतिः। तेषां युधिष्ठिरो राजा ससैन्यानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: The ruler of the earth, ordered those forces to advance. And king Yudhishthira ordered for those high-souled (warriors) with forces, consisting of infantry.

sn: व्यादिदेश सवाह्यानां भक्ष्यभोज्यमनुत्तमम्। सगजाश्वमनुष्याणां ये च शिल्पोपजीविनः॥
en: Together with elephants and steeds and other followers, provisions of the best kind, as well as for those who lived by means of mechanical arts.

sn: अभिमन्यु बृहन्तं च द्रौपदेयांश्च सर्वशः। धृष्टद्युम्नमुखानेतान् प्राहिणोत् पाण्डुनन्दनः॥
en: And the son of Pandu ordered Abhimanyu and Brihanta and all Draupadeyas, (the five sons of Draupadi), headed by Dhrishtadyumna, to advance.

sn: भीमं च युयुधानं च पाण्डवः च धनंजयम्। द्वितीयं प्रेषयामास बलस्कन्धं युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: And then he sent forth the second division of the army with Bhima, Yuyudhana and Dhananjaya, the son of Pandu.

sn: भाण्डं समारोपयतां चरतां सम्प्रधावताम्। हृष्टानां तत्र योधानां शब्दो दिवमिवास्पृशत्।।१०
en: And the noise of the warriors as they put on the equipment's of war, and moved and ran about, cheered as they were, reached the very heavens.

sn: स्वयमेव ततः पश्चाद् विराटदुपदान्वितः। अथापरैर्महीपालैः सह प्रायान्महीपतिः॥
en: Last of all, that ruler of the earth himself went forth in the rear, with other rulers of the earth, accompanied by Virata and Drupada.

sn: भीमधन्वायनी सेना धृष्टद्युम्नेन पालिता। गड्डेच पूर्णा स्तिमिता स्यन्दमाना व्यदृश्यत॥
en: Then that army, of terrible archers commanded by Dhrishtadyumna, as it moved to and fro, looked like the full Ganga, silently rushing on.

sn: ततः पुरननीकानि न्ययोजयत बुद्धिमान्। मोहयन् धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राणां बुद्धिनिश्चयम्॥
en: Then the intelligent (Yudhishthira) again arranged his troops (in a different order), confounding the knowledge of the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sn: द्रौपदेयान् महेष्वासानभिमन्युं च पाण्डवः। नकुलं सहदेवं च सर्वाश्चैव प्रभद्रकान्॥ दश चाश्वसहस्राणि द्विसहस्राणि दन्तिनाम्। अयुतं च पदातीनां रथाः पञ्चशतं तथा॥ भीमसेनस्य दुर्धर्ष प्रथमं प्रादिशद् बलम्। मध्यमे च विराटं च जयत्सेनं च पाण्डवः॥
en: And the son of Pandu ordered the five sons of Draupadi who were mighty bowmen, and Abhimanyu Nakula and Sahadeva, and all the Prabhadraka, and ten thousand horses and elephants; and ten thousand foot-soldiers, and five hundred chariots, to be the first division of the ariny, under the irresistible Bhimasena. And the son of Pandu (ordered) in the middle (division of his army) Virata and Jayatsena,

sn: महारथौ च पाञ्चाल्यौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ। वीर्यवन्तौ महात्मानौ न गदाकार्मुकधारिणौ॥
en: And the two Maharathas, the ruler of Panchala, Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas, who were high-souled (warriors) of great prowess holding clubs and bows.

sn: अन्वयातां तदा मध्ये वासुदेवधनंजयौ। बभूवुरतिसंरब्धाः कृतप्रहरणा नराः॥
en: And in this middle division followed Vasudeva and Dhananjaya. And these were men well-accomplished in arms, burning with anger.

sn: तेषां विंशतिसाहस्रा हयाः शूरैरधिष्ठिताः। पञ्च नागसहस्राणि स्थवंशाच सर्वशः॥
en: Amongst them were twenty thousand horses ridden by brave warriors, and five thousand elephants and cars on all sides round.

sn: पदातयश्च ये शूराः कार्मुकासिगदाधराः। सहस्रशोऽन्वयुः पञ्चादग्रतश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: Those warriors who composed the infantry, armed with bows, swords, and maces, followed by thousands in the vanguard, and thousands in the rear.

sn: युधिष्ठिरो यत्र सैन्ये स्वयमेव बलार्णवे। तत्र ते पृथिवीपाला भूयिष्ठं पर्यवस्थिताः॥
en: And in that part of that ocean of forces, where Yudhishthira himself (was), stationed a large number of rulers of the earth.

sn: तत्र नागसहस्राणि हयानामयुतानि च। तथा रथसहस्राणि पदातीनां च भारत॥
en: And in that part (were) thousands of elephants, and ten thousands of steeds, as well as thousands of cars and foot-soldiers O Bharata.

sn: चेकितानः स्वसैन्येन महता पार्थिवर्षभ। धृष्टकेतुश्च चेदीनां प्रणेता पार्थिवो ययौ॥
en: And Chekitana, with his own mighty force, O best among kings, and king Dhrishtaketu, the leader of the Chedis, marched forth.

sn: सात्यकिश्च महेष्वासो वृष्णीनां प्रवरो रथः। वृतः शतसहस्रेण रथानां प्रणुदन् बली॥
en: And there (was) also Satyaki, that archer and the best of the car-warriors among the Vrishnis, surrounded by hundreds and thousands of chariots, and leading (them) forward, powerful as he was.

sn: क्षत्रदेवब्रह्मदेवो रथस्थौ पुरुषर्षभौ। जघनं पालयन्तौ च पृष्ठतोऽनुप्रजग्मतुः॥
en: And those foremost among men, seated on their chariots, Kshatradeva and Brahmadeva, followed behind, protecting the rear.

sn: शकटापणवेशाश्च यानं युग्यं च सर्वशः। तत्र नागसहस्राणि हयानामयुतानि च। फल्गु सर्वं कलत्रं च यत्किञ्चित् कृशदुर्बलम्॥
en: And there were (in the rear) carts shops, vehicles, and beast of burden of all kinds and thousands of elephants and ten thousands of steeds. And all the children and women, and those who were emaciated and weak.

sn: कोशसंचयवाहांश्च कोष्ठागारं तथैव च। गजानीकेन संगृह्य शनैः प्रायाद् युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: And with the animals carrying his treasures, and his granaries and uniting all these by means of an army of elephants, king Yudhishthira slowly marched forward.

sn: तमन्वयात् सत्यधृतिः सौचित्तियुद्धदुर्मदः। श्रेणिमान् वसुदानश्च पुत्रः काश्यस्य वा विभुः॥
en: Him (Yudhishthira) followed Suchitta, an unswerving adherent of truth, and who was invincible in battle, and Shrenimat and Vasudeva, and Vibhu, the son of the Kashis.

sn: रथा विंशतिसाहस्रा ये तेषामनुयायिनः। हयानां दश कोट्यश्च महतां किंकिणीकिनाम्॥
en: And they followed him, with twenty thousand chariots, and a hundred million steeds (of that mighty army) with great bells,

sn: गजा विंशतिसाहस्रा ईषादन्ताः प्रहारिणः। कुलीना भिन्नकरटा मेघा इव विसर्पिणः॥
en: And twenty thousand elephants who smote with their tusks resembling plowshares all of good breed, and with spit temples and moving about like masses of clouds.

sn: षष्टि गसहस्राणि दशान्यानि च भारत। युधिष्ठिरस्य यान्यासन् युधि सेना महात्मनः॥
en: And besides these, O Bharata, thousand elephants which were in the seven divisions of the army of Yudhishthira in that battle,

sn: क्षरन्त इव जीमूताः प्रभिन्नकरटामुखाः। राजानमन्वयुः पश्चाच्चलन्त इव पर्वताः॥
en: With temporal juice flowing down and with the temples rent, followed the king like so many moving mountains.

sn: एवं तस्य बलं भीमं कुन्तीपुत्रस्य धीमतः। यदाश्रित्याथ युयुधे धार्तराष्ट्र सुयोधनम्॥
en: Such was the terrible array of forces of that wise son of Kunti, relying on the help of which he fought with Suyodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra.

sn: ततोऽन्ये शतशः पश्चात् सहस्रायुतशो नराः। नर्दन्तः प्रययुस्तेषामनीकानि सहस्रशः॥
en: And above these, other men, by hundreds and thousands and tens of thousands of groups o thousands, followed their (sons of Pandu) forces, roaring loudly.

sn: तत्र भेरीसहस्राणि शङ्खानामयुतानि च। न्यवादयन्त संहृष्टाः सहस्रायुतशो नराः॥
en: And those men by thousands and tens of thousand, filled with joy, beat their drums by thousands, and blew their conches by tens of thousands.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं चैव ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted the Supreme Deity (Narayana), and the highest of all male beings (Nara) and also the goddess of Learning (Sarasvati), let us cry success!

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: जनमेजय उवाच कथं युयुधिरे वीराः कुरुपाण्डवसोमकाः। पार्थिवाः सुमहात्मानो नानादेशसमागताः॥
en: Janamejaya said How did those great warriors, the Kurus, the Pandavas and the Somakas and the other illustrious kings who assembled from various countries fight?

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच यथा युयुधिके वीराः कुरुपाण्डवसोमकाः। कुरुक्षेत्रे तपःक्षेत्रे शृणु त्वं पृथिवीपते॥
en: Vaishampayana said ruler of carth, hear how those great warriors, the Kurus, the Pandavas and the Somakas foughton the holy field of Kurukshetra.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: तेऽवतीर्य कुरुक्षेत्रं पाण्डवाः सहसोमकाः। कौरवाः समवर्तन्त जिगीषन्तो महाबलाः॥
en: Arriving at Kurukshetra, the powerful Pandavas, accompanied with the Somakas, advanced against the Kurus with the desire of victory.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: वेदाध्ययनसम्पन्नाः सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। आशंसन्तो जयं युद्धे बलेनामिमुखा रणे॥
en: Learned in the Vedas, they all took great delight in battle. Being eager to secure success in the battle, they with their soldiers advanced to the fight.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: अभियाय च दुर्धर्षां धार्तराष्ट्रस्य वाहिनीम्। प्राङ्मुखाः पश्चिमे भागे न्यविशन्त ससैनिकाः॥
en: Coming near the army of Dhritarashtra's son those invincible heroes encamped with their troops on the Western part (of the field), their faces turned towards the East.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: समन्तपञ्चकाद् बाह्यं शिविराणि सहस्रशः। कारयामास विधिवत् कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The son of Kunti Yudhishthira ordered tents to be pitched duly be thousands beyond the region called Samantapanchaka.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: शून्या च पृथिवी सर्वा बालवृद्धावशेषिता। निरश्वपुरुषेवासीद् रथकुञ्जरवर्जिता॥
en: The whole earth appeared to be empty, having been destitute of men and horses, and of chariots and elephants. Only the children and the old remained (in their houses).

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: यावत्तपति सूर्यो हि जम्बूद्वीपस्य मण्डलम्। तावदेव समायातं बलं पार्थिवसत्तम॥
en: O foremost of kings, from all parts of Jambudvipa over which the sun shines was collected that great force.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: एकस्थाः सर्ववर्णास्ते मण्डलं बहुयोजनम्। पर्याक्रामन्त देशांश्च नदी: शैलान् वनानि च।॥
en: Men of all races assembled there, and they occupied an area extending many Yojanas over fields, rivers, hills and woods.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: तेषां युधिष्ठिरो राजा सर्वेषां पुरुषर्षभ। व्यादिदेश सबाह्यानां भक्ष्यभोज्यमनुत्तमम्॥
en: That foremost of men, king Yudhishthira ordered to be supplied to them in excellent edibles and other things of enjoyment.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: शय्याश्च विविधास्तात तेषां रात्रौ युधिष्ठिरः। एवंवेदी वेदितव्यः पाण्डवेयोऽयमित्युत॥
en: Yudhishthira fixed various appellation so that by uttering them they might be known to others that they belong to the Pandava force.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: अभिज्ञानानि सर्वेषां संज्ञाश्चाभरणानि च। योजयामास कौरव्यो युद्धकाल उपस्थिते॥
en: That Kuru prince also fixed names and emblems for all of them, so that they might be recognised at the time of battle.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: दृष्ट्वा ध्वजाग्रं पार्थस्य धार्तराष्ट्रो महामनाः। सह सर्वैर्महीपालैः प्रत्यव्यूहत पाण्डवम्॥ पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि। मध्ये नागसहस्रस्य भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः॥
en: Seeing (from a distance) the top of the flatstaff of Pritha's son, the illustrious son of Dhritarashtra with a white umbrella held over his head stood surrounded by his one hundred brothers in the midst of a thousand elephants and began with all the kings to array his troops against the Pandavas.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनं हृष्टाः पञ्चाला युद्धनन्दिनः। दध्मुः प्रीता महाशवान् भेर्यश्च मधुरस्वनाः॥
en: Seeing the Duryodhana, the Panchalas, who ever liked fighting, were filled with delight, They blew their loud-sounding conchs and sweet sounding cymbals.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: ततः प्रहृष्टां तां सेनामभिवीक्ष्याथ पाण्डवाः। बभूवुर्हष्टमनसो वासुदेवश्च वीर्यवान्॥
en: Seeing the (Panchala) troops in great delight, the Pandavas and the greatly effulgent Vasudeva (Krishna) were filled with joy.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: ततो हर्ष समागम्य वासुदेवधनंजयौ। दध्मतुः पुरुषव्याघ्रौ दिव्यौ शङ्खौ रथे स्थितौ॥
en: Those lion of men, Vasudeva and Arjuna who were seated on one car felt the greatest joy and both blew their celestial conchs.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: पाञ्चजन्यस्य निर्घोषं देवदत्तस्य चोभयोः। श्रुत्वा तु निनदं योधाः शकृन्मूत्रं प्रसुस्रुवुः॥
en: Having heard the loud sound of the conchs of those two heroes, the soldiers passed urine and excrete.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: यथा सिंहस्य नदतः स्वनं श्रुत्वेतरे मृगाः। त्रसेयुर्निनदं श्रुत्वा तथाऽसीदत तद्बलम्॥
en: As animals are afflicted with fear in hearing the voice of the roaring lion, so were that force on hearing those sounds.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: उदतिष्ठद् रजो भौमं न प्राज्ञायत किंचन। अस्तगत इवादित्ये सैन्येन सहसाऽऽवृते॥
en: A fearful dust arose and every thing became invisible. The sun, becoming suddenly shrouded by it appeared as if it had set.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: ववर्ष तत्र पर्जन्यो मांसशोणितवृष्टिमान्। दिक्षु सर्वाणि सैन्यानि तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: A black clouds of flesh and blood showered a down pour over that vast assemblage of troops. Every thing appeared to be wonderful.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: वायुस्ततः प्रादुरभून्नीचैः शर्करकर्षणः। विनिस्तान्यनीकानि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: A fearful wind blow carrying over the earth innumerable stones and afflicting thousands and thousands of soldiers.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: उभे सैन्ये च राजेन्द्र युद्धाय मुदिते भृशम्। कुरुक्षेत्रे स्थिते यत्ते सागरक्षुभितोपमे॥
en: O king, both armies stood for battle in the field of Kurukshetra like two agitated oceans.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: तयोस्तु सेनयोरासीदद्भुतः स तु संगमः। युगान्ते समनुप्राप्ते द्वयोः सागरयोरिव॥
en: That great battle of the two enemies was exceedingly wonderful, like two oceans at the end of the Yuga.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: शून्याऽऽसीत् पृथिवी सर्वा वृद्धबालावशेषिता। निरश्वपुरुषेवासीद् रथकुञ्जरवर्जिता॥
en: The whole earth was empty for only the children and the old remained in their houses, others having joined the Kuru armies.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: तेन सेनासमूहेन समानीतेन कौरवैः। ततस्ते समयं चक्रुः कुरुपाण्डवसोमकाः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, then the Kurus, the Pandavas and the Somakas made certain agreements and settled some rules regarding the different kinds of fight.

description: JAMBUKHANDA VINIRMANA PARVA Placing of soldiers in the Jambukhanda
sn: धर्मान् संस्थापयामासुर्युद्धानां भरतर्षभ। निवृत्ते विहिते युद्धे स्यात् प्रीतिर्नः परस्परम्॥
