sn: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान् गुणान्। कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु॥
en: Self, dwelling in Nature (having a material body), enjoys the qualities that are born in Nature. The cause of the birth in good or in evil works is its connection with such qualities.

sn: उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः। परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन् पुरुषः परः॥
en: The supreme Purusha in then (human) body is the surveyor, adviser, supporter, and enjoyer; he is the mighty Lord and Supreme Self.

sn: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह। सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते॥
en: He who thus knows Prakriti and Purusha with the qualities, in whatever state he may be, is never born again.

sn: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना। अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे॥
en: Some by mediation see the Self in his(own) self by (his own)self by (his own) Self. Some again(see) by Sankhya Yoga and some again by Karma Yoga.

sn: अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वाऽन्येभ्य उपासते। तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्यु श्रुतिपरायणाः॥
en: Others again worship Him, hearing of Him from others, although they do not know this (Mystery of Yoga). Even these men, if devoted to what is heard of the true Knowledge, pass over death, (and attain to final emancipation).

sn: यावत् संजायते किंचित् सत्त्वं स्थावटजङ्गमम्। क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात् तद् विद्धि भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, know whatever entity, movable and immovable comes into existence, it is out of the connection of Kshetra and Kshetrajna.

sn: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्। विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति॥
en: He sees truly who sees the supreme Lord alike in all beings and who sees the Imperishable in the perishable.

sn: सं पश्यन् हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्। न हिनस्त्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्॥
en: For he who sees the Great Lord dwelling alike in every thing and every where, does not destroy himself by himself and thus reaches the highest goal.

sn: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः। यः पश्यति तथाऽऽत्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति॥
en: He sees truly who sees all actions worked by Nature alone, and self not to be the doer.

sn: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति। तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा।॥
en: When one sees the various entities existing in One, and the birth of every thing from that one, he is then said to attain to Brahma.

sn: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात् परमात्माऽयमव्ययः। शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते॥
en: This inexhaustible Supreme Self, O son of Kunti, without having beginning and without having attributes, does not act at all. It is in no way stained, even when it remains in (human body).

sn: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्मयादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते। सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यते॥
en: As space for its subtility and as it is ubiquitous is never tainted, so Self stationed in every body, is never tainted.

sn: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः। क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत॥
en: As the single sun, O Bharata, lights up all this entire world, so Purusha lights up the entire sphere of matters.

sn: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा। भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्॥
en: Those who, by the eye of knowledge, know the distinction between Prakriti and Purusha, and the release from the nature of all entities, attain to the Supreme.

sn: श्रीभगवानुवाच परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्। यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः॥
en: The Great one said “I shall again speak to you that great Science of all Sciences, that excellent Science, knowing which all the Rishis have attained to the highest (and final) emancipation from this body.

sn: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः। सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च।॥
en: Resorting to this great Science, and thus attaining to My Nature, men have no more rebirths, not even at the time of a new Creation. They are not disturbed even at the dissolution of the universe.

sn: मम योनिर्महद् ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्हम्। सम्भवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत॥
en: The Great Brahma is the womb in which I place the germ. Thence, O Bharata, take place the births of all beings.

sn: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः। तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता॥
en: Whatever is born, O son of Kunti, of them is Brahma the womb, and I the seed-imparting Sire.

sn: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः। निबन्धन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्॥
en: Sattva, Raja and Tama, these three qualities of Nature, O mighty-armed, bind down the Eternal Self in the body of beings.

sn: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात् प्रकाशकमनायम्। सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ॥
en: Amongst the three, Sattva from its untainted nature, from its being enlightening, and as it is free from misery, keeps the Self bound with the attachment of happiness and knowledge.

sn: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्। तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्॥
en: Raja, having desire for its essence, is born of thirst and attachment; therefore, O son of Kunti, it binds the embodied Self with the attachment of work.

sn: तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्। प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत।॥
en: Tama is born of ignorance, and therefore it deludes all embodied selves. O Bharata, it binds the Self with error, indolence, and sleep.

sn: सत्त्वं सुखे संजयति रजः कर्मणि भारत। ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे संजयत्युत॥
en: Sattva unites the Self with pleasure, Raja, with work; but O Bharata, Tama, shadowing knowledge, binds Self with error.

sn: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत। रजः सत्त्व तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा।॥
en: Sattva remains if Raja and Tama are repressed. Tame remains if Sattva and Raja are repressed' and, Oh Bharata, Raja remains if Tama and Sattva are repressed.

sn: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन् प्रकाश उपजायते। ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद् विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत॥
en: When in this body knowledge pervades all, then should one know that Sattva has been developed.

sn: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा। रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ॥
en: When, O chief of Bharata's race, avarice, activity, fondness of works, want of tranquility, and desire, are born in this body, then should one know that Raja has been developed.

sn: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च। तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन॥
en: When, O son of the Kuru race gloom, inactivity, error, and delusion, are born in this body, then should one know that Tama has been developed.

sn: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्। तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान् प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: When a man dies when his Sattva is developed, he goes to the sinless region of those that know the supreme.

sn: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते। तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते॥
en: Dying, when Raja prevails, he goes among those who are attached to works. Dying in Tama he is born in the womb that produces ignorant men.

sn: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्। रजसस्तु फलंदुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्॥
en: The fruit of Sattva is good and untainted; the fruit of Raja is misery, and that of Tama is ignorance.

sn: सत्त्वात् संजायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च। प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च॥
en: From Sattva is produced knowledge from Raja avarice, and from Tama error, delusion and ignorance.

sn: ऊर्ध्वगच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः। जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः॥
en: Those that live in Sattva go on high those that are addicted to Raja live in the middle; and those that are of Tama, having the lowest quality, go down.

sn: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति। गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति॥
en: When an observing man comes to know these three qualities to be the only agents of all works, and recognize him who is beyond all qualities, he then attains to My Nature.

sn: गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन् देही देहसमुद्भवान्। जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते॥
en: The embodied self (man) by transcending three qualities, which are the source of all bodies, attains immortality, being freed from birth, death, old age, decay and misery."

sn: अर्जुन उवाच कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन् गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो। किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन् गुणानतिवर्तते॥
en: Arjuna said What are the characteristic, O Lord, of that man who has transcended the three qualities? What is his conduct? How can a man transcend these three qualities?

sn: श्रीभगवानुवाच प्रकाश: च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव। न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति॥
en: The great One said He who has no aversion for knowledge, work or ignorance (the results of the three qualities) when they are present, and he who does not desire them when they are absent, has transcended the three qualities.

sn: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते। गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते॥
en: He, who remains all unconcerned, being not shaken by the three qualities who sits and moves not, thinking that it is the qualities and not he, who is engaged in their functions, has transcended the three qualities.

sn: समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः। तुल्यप्रियाप्रियोधीरस्तुल्यनिन्दाऽऽत्मसंस्तुति॥
en: He, to whom pain and pleasure are alike who is self-restrained, to whom a sod of earth, a stone, a piece of gold, are all alike; to whom agreeable and the disagreeable are the same, to whom praise and censure are alike, has transcended the three qualities.

sn: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः। सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते॥
en: He, to whom honour and dishonour are same, to whom friends and foes are alike; who has discernment, and who has renounced all self-exertion, has transcended the three qualities.

sn: मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते। स गुणान् समतीत्यैतान् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
en: He who worships Me with exclusive devotion, transcends the three qualities and becomes fit for admission into the nature of Brahma.

sn: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाहममृतस्याव्यस्य च। शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च॥
en: For, I am the embodiment of Brahma, of immortality, of imperishability, of eternal piety and ever-continuing felicity.

sn: श्रीभगवानुवाच ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्। छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्॥
en: The great One said They say that the Ahsvatha tree with its roots above and branches below is (like the) eternal. Its leaves are the Chandas. He who knows it knows the Vedas.

sn: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः। अधश्च मूलान्यनुसंततानि कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके॥
en: Its branches which are enlarged by the qualities stretched upwards and downwards; its sprouts are the objects of senses. Its roots, leading to actions, are extended downward to this world of men.

sn: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते नान्तो न चादिर्न च सम्प्रतिष्ठा। मसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा॥ ततः पदं तत् परिमार्गितव्यं यस्मिन् गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः। तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी॥
en: Its from cannot be known in this world, nor its end, its beginning, for its support. Cutting this Ahsvatha of strong roots with a sharp weapon, one should seek for that place going whither none returns again-resolving, “I shall seek the protection of that Primeval Sire from whom the original course of this worldly life has flowed.

sn: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः। गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत्॥
en: Those that are free from delusion and pride, that have subdued the evil of attachments, that are steady in contemplation of the relation of the Supreme to the individual Self, from whom desires have gone away, and who is free from the pairs of opposites, go undeluded to that eternal seat.

sn: न तद् भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः। यद् गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद् धाम परमं मम॥
en: The sun lights not that place, nor the Moon, nor the fire. Going there none returns, that is my Supreme seat.

sn: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः। मनः षष्ठानीन्द्रीयाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति॥
en: An everlasting portion of Me (My Self) becoming an individual Self in this world, draws to itself the five senses with the mind as the sixth. They all depend on Nature.

sn: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः। गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्॥
en: When (this Self) the king of the body, assumes or quits the body, it departs taking them away, as the wind takes away the fragrance.

sn: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च। अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते॥
en: Presiding over the ear, the eye, the organs of touch, taste and smell, and the mind. It (the Self) enjoys all objects of senses.

sn: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जान् वा गुणान्वितम्। विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः॥
en: Those that are deluded do not see It when It remains in the body, or when It quits it, when It enjoys or when It is joined with qualities. But those see it who have the eye of knowledge.

sn: यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्। यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः॥
en: Devotees who are trying to attain to emancipation see It in their own bodies. But those that are senseless, and whose minds are not restrained, do not see It, although they too are trying for emancipation.

sn: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद् भासयतेऽखिलम्। यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चागग्नौ तत् तेजो विद्धि मामकम्॥
en: The refulgence in the Sun which illuminates the vast universe, that which is in the Moon, and in the Fire, know it to be mine.

sn: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा। पुष्णामि चौषश्वीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वारसात्मकः॥
en: Entering into the earth I uphold every thing by My Force, and becoming Savoury Moon, I nourish all plants.

sn: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः। प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्॥
en: Becoming the vital heat in the bodies of creatures, and mixing with the upward and downward breaths, I digest the four kinds of food.

sn: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि संनिविष्टो मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च। वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो वेदान्तकृद् वेदविदेव चाहम्॥
en: I am in the hearts of all. Memory and knowledge, and the loss of both, are all from Me. I am the objects of knowledge to be known from the Vedas. I am the author of the Vedantas, and again I alone am the object to be known of the Vedas.

sn: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च। क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते॥
en: There are two entities in this universe, namely the Perishable and the Imperishable. All creatures are the Perishable, and the unconcerned One is the Imperishable.

sn: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः। यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः॥
en: But there is another, namely the Supreme Being, called Paramatma, who being the everlasting Lord, and pervading the three worlds, sustains them.

sn: यस्तात् क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः। अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: As I transcend the Perishable, and as I am higher then even the Imperishable, I am celebrated in the world and sung in the Vedas as Purushottama.

sn: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्। स सर्वविद् भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत॥
en: He, who without being deluded, knows Me to be this Highest Being, O Bharata, knowing all this, worships Me with all thoughts.

sn: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयानघ। एतद् बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान् स्यात् कृतकृत्यश्च भारत॥
en: I have thus, O holy one, declared to you this knowledge, the greatest of all mysteries. Knowing this, O Bharata, one becomes gifted with intelligence, and he has done all that he needs do".

sn: श्रीभगवानुवाच अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः। दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्॥
en: The great one said Fearlessness, purity of heart, perseverance, Yoga meditation, gifts, self restraint, sacrifice, study of the Vedas, penances, uprightness.

sn: अहिंसां सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्। दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्॥
en: Non-doing of injury, truth, freedom from anger, renunciation, tranquility, freedom from fault-finding, compassion for all, absence of covetousness, gentleness, modesty, absence of restlessness.

sn: तेजः क्षमाः धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता। भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत॥
en: Vigor, forgiveness, firmness, cleanliness, absence of quarrel sameness, freedom from vanity, O Bharata, all these belong to him who is god-like.

sn: दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च। अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम्॥
en: Hypocrisy, pride, conceit, wrath, rudeness, and ignorance, O Partha, belong to him who is demoniac.

sn: दैवी सम्पद् विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता। मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव॥
en: Godliness is considered to be the means for emancipation, and demoniacness for bondage of births. You need not grieve, O son of Pandu, for Dushasana you are born to be god-like.

sn: द्वौ भूतस! लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च। दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे शृणु॥ प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः। न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते॥
en: There are two kinds of created beings in this world, namely God-like and demoniac. The God-like has been fully described by me. Now hear from me, Partha, something of the demoniac. Persons of demoniac nature know now what is action and what is inaction. Neither purity, nor good conduct, nor truth exists in them.

sn: असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्। अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत् कामहैतुकम्॥
en: The demoniac say, the universe is void of truth, of a guiding principle and of a ruler. They say universe has been produced only by the union of one another and by lust.

sn: एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः। प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः॥
en: Believing and demanding on this, these men of lost self, of little intelligence, and of fearful deeds, these enemies of the world, are born for the destruction of the piety of the universe.

sn: काममाश्रित्य दुष्पुरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः। मोहाद् गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान् प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः॥
en: Being endued with hypocrisy, conceit and folly, and cherishing insatiable desires, they believe in false things, and perform sinful practices.

sn: चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः। कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः॥
en: Cherishing boundless thoughts which are limited by death only and considering the enjoyment of their desires as the highest aim of life, they believe that this is all.

sn: आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः। ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसंचयान्॥
en: Bound in hundred nooses of Hope, and addicted to lust and wrath, they eagerly desire to possess unfair hoards of wealth, so that they may gratify their desire.

sn: इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्। इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्॥
en: This is obtained today by Me-I shall obtain this to-morrow, I have this wealth, this wealth again will be mine in addition to what I already possess.

sn: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि। ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी॥
en: This enemy of mine has been killed by me, I shall kill other enemies also, I am the lord, I am the enjoyed, I am successful, I am powerful and happy.

sn: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया। अक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः॥
en: I am wealthy, I am nobly born, who is there in this world as I am, I shall sacrifice, I shall make gifts, I shall be merry, (thus say the demoniac), deluded by ignorance.

sn: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः। प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ॥
en: Tossed about by innumerable thoughts, enveloped by delusion, and attached to the enjoyment of desire, these men sink into the lowliest hell.

sn: आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः। यजयन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्॥
en: These men, being self conceited, stubborn, and full of pride and intoxication of wealth, perform Sacrifices, that are nominal, that rest on hypocrisy, and do not follow the prescribed rules.

sn: अहंकारं बलं दर्प कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः। मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः॥
en: These men, the servitors, being full of vanity, power, pride, lust and wrath, hate Me in their own bodies as well as in those of others.

sn: तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान् संसारेषु नराधमान्। क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु॥
en: These cruel heaters of Me, these sinful, vilest men among men, are hurled continually down by Me into demoniac wombs (to be demoniac in their next births).

sn: आसुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि। मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमा गतिम्॥
en: O son of Kunti, these men, taking births into demoniac womb, deluded birth after birth, ge down to the vilest state.

sn: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः। काम: क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत् त्रयं त्यजेत्॥
en: Threefold is the way to hell, ever ruinous to self, namely, lust, and avarice. Therefore, one should, above all, renounces these three.

sn: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः। आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्॥
en: Being freed from these three gates of darkness, O son of Kunti, a man works out his own good. He then reaches the highest goal.

sn: यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः। न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्॥
en: He who renounces the ordinance of the Vedas, acts only under the impulse of desire. Such a man can never attain to perfection, happiness, or the highest goal.

sn: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाण ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ। ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि॥
en: Therefore, the Vedas should be your authority in determining what you should do and what you should not do. It is your duty to work in this world, having ascertained what are the ordinances of the Vedas”.

sn: अर्जुन उवाच ये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः। तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः॥
en: Arjuna said What is the state, Krishna, of those that neglects the ordinance of the scriptures and perform sacrifices with faith? Is it one of Sattva, Raja or Tama?

sn: श्रीभगवानुवाच त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा। सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेतितां शृणु॥
en: The great one said The faith of man is of three kinds. They are born according to his individual nature. They are also of Sattva, Raja, and Tama. Hear what they are.

sn: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत। श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः॥
en: The faith of man, O Bharata is according to his own nature. A man may be full of faith, and as his faith is so he will be.

sn: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान् यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः। प्रेतान् भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः॥
en: Those who are of the Sattva quality worship the celestial, those of Raja worship Yakshas and Rakshasas, and those of Tama do the same to departed spirits and ghosts.

sn: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः। दम्भाहंकारसंयुक्तः कामरागबलान्विताः॥
en: Those who practice severe penances not ordained by the Vedas, who are full of hypocrisy and pride, desire, attachment and violence.

sn: कर्शयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः। मां चैवान्तः शरीरस्थं तान् विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्॥
en: Who has no discernment, but who torture their physical organs, thereby torturing Me who seat within the body, should be known to be of demoniac nature.

sn: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः। यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं शृणु।॥
en: Food which is dear to all is also of three kinds. Sacrifice, penance, and gifts are also of three kinds. Hear from Me their distinction, one

sn: आयुः सत्त्ववलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः। रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः।।
en: The food that increase longevity, energy, strength, health, and well-being and joy, and which is savoury, indigenous, and agreeable, is liked by men of Sattva nature.

sn: कट्वाललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः। आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः॥
en: The food which is bitter, sour, salted, overhot, pungent, dry and burning, and which produces pain, grief and disease, is desired by a man of Raja temperament.

sn: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्। उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्॥
en: The food which is cold, not savory, stinky, corrupt, filthy and a refuse, is liked by men of Tama.

sn: अफलाकाक्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते। यष्टव्यमेवेति मन: समाधाय स सात्त्विकः॥
en: Sattva Sacrifice is which being prescribed by the Shastras, is performed by a man who desires no fruit from it, and who performs it by believing it to be only a duty.

sn: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्। इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्॥
en: But O chief son of Bharata, Raja Sacrifice is that which is performed in expectation of receiving fruits from it and for ostentatious show.

sn: विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम्। श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते॥
en: And Tama sacrifice is that which is performed against the ordinances of the Shastras in which food is not distributed, Mantras are not recited, fees are not paid to the assisting priests and which is void of faith.

sn: देवदविजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम्। ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते॥
en: Reverence to Celestial, regenerate ones, preceptors, and learned men, and purity, uprightness, the practices of a Brahmachary, and abstention from injury, constitute the penance of body.

sn: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्। स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वारड्मयं तप उच्यते॥
en: The words that does not disturb any body and which is agreeable, true and beneficial, and the diligent study of the Vedas, is the penance of speech.

sn: मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः। भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत् तपो मानसमुच्यते॥
en: Serenity of mind, gentleness, taciturnity, self restraint, and purity of disposition, constitute the penance of mind.

sn: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत् त्रिविधं नरैः। अफलार्काक्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते॥
en: Now Sattva Penance is that in which this three-fold penance is performed with perfect faith, with devotion and without the desire for fruit.

sn: सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत्। क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम्॥
en: Raja Penance is that which is performed with hypocrisy for gaining respect honour, and revenue, and which is unstable and transient.

sn: मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत् पीडया क्रियते तपः। परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत् तामसमुदाहृतम्॥
en: Tama Penance is that which is performed under a deluded belief, and with torture of one's self, and for the destruction of another,

sn: दातव्यमिति यद् दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे। देशे काले च पात्रे च तद् दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम्॥
en: Sattva gift is that which is given because it ought to be given; it is given to one who cannot return it in any way; it is given in a proper place, at a proper time, and to a proper person.

sn: यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः। दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद् दानं राजसं स्मृतम्॥
en: Raja gift is that which is given reluctantly, for return of some sort of service or benefit, and with an eye to fruit.

sn: अदेशकाले यद् दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते। श्रऊसत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत् तामसमुदाहृतम्॥
en: Tama gift is that which is given without respect and with contempt to an unworthy object in an improper place and at an improper time.

sn: ॐ तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः। ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा॥
en: Om, Tat, Sat, these are the threefold designation of Brahma. The Brahmanas, the Vedas and the Yajnas are all ordained in ancient time by Brahma.

sn: तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपः क्रियाः। प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्॥
en: Therefore, uttering the syllable, Om, all utterers of Brahma begin their sacrifices, fits and penances, as ordained in the Shastras.

sn: तदित्यनभिसंधाय फलं यज्ञतप:क्रियाः। दानक्रियाश्च विविधा क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाक्षिभिः॥
en: Uttering TAT, the various sacrifices, gifts and penances are performed by those who desire emancipation, and who do not without expectation of fruit.

sn: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत् प्रयुज्यते। प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते॥
en: Sat denotes existence and goodness, O Partha; it is used in any suspicious acts.

sn: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते। कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते॥
en: Constancy in sacrifices, penances and gifts is also called SAT. For its sake an act is also called SAT.

sn: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्। असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत् प्रेत्य नो इह॥
en: Whatever oblation is offered in a sacrifice, whatever is given away, whatever penance is performed, and whatever is done, if done without faith, is, O Partha the opposite of SAT. It (opposite of SAT) will do no good to the life in this world or hereafter in the next.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: अर्जुन उवाच संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्। त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक् केशिनिषूदन॥
en: Arjuna said O mighty-armed, I desire to know the true nature of Sanyasa (Renunciation) and Tyaga (Abandonment). O slayer of Keshi, I want to know them distinctly.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: श्रीभगवानुवाच काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः। सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः॥
en: The great one said Rejection of works with some desire is known by the learned as Sanyasa. But the abandonment of the desire for the fruit of all works, is called Tyaga, by the discerning man.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः। यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे॥
en: Some wise men say that work itself should be abandoned considering it to be evil; others say that the works of sacrifice, gifts and penance should not be renounced.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम। त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः सम्प्रकीर्तितः॥
en: 0 best of Bharata's son, listen to my opinion about Tyaga, for powerful of men, Tyaga is of three kinds.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्। यज्ञो दान तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्॥
en: The works of sacrifice, gifts and penance should not be renounced. They should indeed be performed, for, sacrifices, gifts and penances are the means for the purification of the wise.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च। कर्तव्यानीति में पार्थ निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम्॥ निश्चयं शृणु
en: But these works should be performed without attachment and without the desire for fruits. Partha, this is my decided opinion.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते। मोहात् तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः॥
en: The Renunciation of work is not proper. It is the result of delusion and arises from Tama.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: दुःखमित्येव यत् कर्म कायक्लेशभयात् त्यजेत्। स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत्॥
en: When work is abandoned from bodily fear and froin the consideration of pain, such abandonment arises from Raja, and one who makes such abandonment never obtains the fruit of Tyaga.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: कार्यमित्येव यत् कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन। सङ्गत्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः॥
en: The abandonment of attachment and the fruit of actions which are performed because they are prescribed in the Shastras. O Arjuna, is considered to be of the quality of Sativa.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते। त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः॥
en: He, who has such Tyaga, being possessed of intelligence and with doubts dispelled, has no aversion for an unpleasant action, and has no attachment for pleasant ones.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः। यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते॥
en: Actions cannot be absolutely a abandoned by man; therefore he, who abandons the fruit of actions, is a true Tyagi.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्। भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित्॥
en: Those, that do not abandon the desire for the fruit of actions, have after death threefold fruits, good, bad and indifferent.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे। सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम्॥
en: Listen to me, O mighty armed (I shall declare to you) the five causes for the completion of actions, as told in the Sankhya which treats with the annihilation of actions.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: अधिष्ठान तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्। विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम्॥
en: Substratum (body), Agency (mind). Organs (physical), Efforts (vital breaths) and Duties (senses), these are the five causes.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: शरीरवाड्मनोभिर्यत् कर्म प्रारभते नरः। न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः॥
en: With body, speech or mind, whatever work, good or bad, a man performs these five are their causes.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः। पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्यान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः॥
en: Such being the case, he who, owing to his uncultivated understanding and dull mind, sees his own self as the sole agency of all actions, sees nothing.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते। हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते॥
en: He who has no egoism, and whose mind is not sullied, does not kill, or fettered by action, if he kills all these people.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना। करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः॥
en: Knowledge, the Object of knowledge and the Knower, from the threefold impulse of action.. Instrument. Action and Agent from the threefold complements of action.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः। प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि॥
en: Knowledge, Action and Agent have threefold enumeration, according to the difference of qualities. Listen to them now.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते। अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्॥
en: Sattva Knowledge is that by which One Eternal Essence undivided in the divided is seen in all things.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान् पृथग्विधान्। वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्॥
en: Raja Knowledge is that which sees various Essences of different things, on account of their separateness.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन् कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम्। अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत् तामसमुदाहृतम॥
en: Tama Knowledge is that which sees each single object as if it were the whole which is without reason and without truth, and which is mean and low.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम्। अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत् सात्त्विकमुच्यते॥
en: Sattva Action is that which is prescribed in the Shastras, which is performed without attachment, desire or aversion, and without the desire for any fruit by the performer.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहंकारेण वा पुनः। क्रियते बहुलायासं तद् राजसमुदाहृतम्॥
en: Raja Action is that which is attended with great trouble and which is performed by one who desires for the fruit of action and who is filled with egoism.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनवेक्ष्य च पौरुषम्। मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत् तामसमुच्यते॥
en: Tama Action is that which is performed from delusion, without regard to consequences and with one's own loss and injury as well as of others.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः। सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते॥
en: Sattva Agent is he who is free from attachment, and egoism, who is full of constancy and energy and who is unmoved both in success and failure.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः। हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः॥
en: Raja Agent is he who is full of affections, who desires for the fruit of actions, who is covetous, cruel and impure, and feels both joy and sorrow.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैकृतिकोऽलसः। विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते॥
en: Tama Agent is he who is void of application, who is without discernment, who is obstinate, deceitful malicious, idle, desponding, and procrastinating.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: बुद्धेर्थेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु। प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनंजयः॥
en: Listen to three fold division of intellect and constancy. O Dhananjaya, I shall exhaustively and distinctly speak to you on this matter.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये। बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी॥
en: Sattva Intellect, O Partha, is that which knows action and inaction, what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, and which knows fear and fearfulness, bondage and deliverance.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्य चाकार्यमेव च। अयथावत् प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी॥
en: Raja Intellect, O Partha, is that by which one imperfectly discerns right and wrong, and what ought to be done and what ought not to be done.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसाऽवृता। सर्वार्थान् विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी॥
en: Tama Intellect, O Partha, is that by which, being one covered by ignorance, considers wrong to be right, and sees all things in a reverse state.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः। योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी॥
en: Sattva constancy, O Partha, is that by which through devotion one controls the function of the mind, the life-breaths and the senses.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: यया तु धर्मकामार्थान् धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन। प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाक्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी॥
en: Raja constancy, O Partha, is that by which through attachment one holds to religion, and profit, washing for fruit.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च। न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी॥
en: Tama Constancy, O Partha, is that thought which undiscerning person does not abandons sleep, fear, sorrow, dependency and folly.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: सुखं त्विदानी त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ। अभ्यासाद् रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति॥ यत्तदने विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम्। तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम्॥
en: Now hear from Me, O best of Bharata race, what are the three kinds of happiness. Sattva Happiness is that in which one finds pleasure from repetition of enjoyment, which brings an end to all pain, which is like poison in the beginning, but ambrosia afterwards, which is born out of serenity, and is produced by knowledge.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद् यत्तदचेऽमृतोपमम्। परिणामे विषमिव तत् सुखं राजसं स्मृतम्॥
en: Raja Happiness is that which arise from the contact of the senses with their objects and which ambrosia in the beginning and poison next.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः। निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्॥
en: Tama Happiness is that which deludes the self in the beginning and in its consequences, and which arises from sleep, condolence and foolishness.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः। सत्त्व प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात् त्रिभिर्गुणैः॥
en: There is none, either among the beings on earth or among be celestial in heaven, which is free from these three qualities born of Nature.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप। कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, the duties of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, and Shudras are each distinguished by these three qualities, born of nature.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च। ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम्॥
en: Tranquility, self restraint, penances purity, forgiveness, rectitude, knowledge, experience and faith, these are the distinctive features of a Brahmana.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम्। दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम्॥
en: Bravery, energy, firmness, skill, firmness in battle, liberality, majesty, these are distinctive features of a Kshatriya.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम्। परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम्॥
en: Agriculture, tending of cattle and trade, these are the duties of a Vaishya. The natural duty of a Shudra is service.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धि लभते नरः। स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धि यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु।॥
en: Every man, if he engages in his own natural duty, attains to perfection. Hear, how man attains to perfection by performing him own natural duties,

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्। स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धि विन्दति मानवः॥
en: Worshipping Him, from whom are the life of beings, and by whom all the universe is pervaded, by the performance of his own duty man is sure to attain to perfection.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: श्रेयान् स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात् स्वनुष्ठितात्। स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन् नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्॥
en: Better is one's own duty, though performed imperfectly, than another's duty wellperformed. Man incurs no sin by performing his duty prescribed by Nature.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्। सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः॥
en: Man must not, O son of Kunti abandon his natural duties, however bad they might be-for all actions are enveloped by error as fire by smoke.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः । नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धि परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति॥
en: He whose mind is unattached to any thing, who has subdued his self, and whose desire is gone, through Sanyasa, obtains the supreme perfection of freedom from action.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: सिद्धि प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाऽऽप्नोति निबोध मे। समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा॥
en: Learn in brief, O son of Kunti, how a man, obtaining perfection, attains to Brahma, the Supreme End of Knowledge.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च। शब्दादीन् विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौव्युदस्य च॥
en: Having a pure mind, restraining his self by constancy, renouncing all objects of sense, and casting off affection and aversion.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: विविक्तसेवी लध्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः। ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः॥
en: He who resides in a lonely place, cats little, restrains his speech, body and mind, who is ever intent on meditation and abstraction, who is unconcerned.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: अहंकार बलं दर्प कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्। विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
en: Who is free from egoism, violence, pride, lust, wrath, surroundings, who is devoid of selfishness and is tranquil, become fit for assimilation with Brahma.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति। समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्ति लभते पराम्॥
en: Becoming one with Brahma, and obtaining tranquility in spirit, man grieves not and desires not. Seeing all beings alike, he obtains the highest devotion to Me.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान् यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः। ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्॥
en: By devotion he truly knows Me, truly what I am and who I am. Then knowing Me truly, he forthwith enters into Me.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्यपाश्रयः। मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्॥
en: Even performing all actions at all times, such a man, having his refuge in Me, obtains through My favour that state which is eternal and imperishable.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः। बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव॥
en: Mentally dedicating all actions to Me, restoring to mental abstraction, being devoted to Me, fix your thoughts constantly on Me.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात् तरिष्यसि। अथ चेत् त्वमहंकारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनक्ष्यसि॥
en: Fixing your thoughts on Me, you will surmount all difficulties through My favour. But if from self-conceit you do not listen to Me, you will surely perish.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: यदहंकारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे। मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति॥
en: If out of self-conceit you think “I will not fight,” your this resolution will be in vain, for surely will Nature rule you.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा। कर्तुनेच्छसि यन्मोहात् करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत्॥
en: Bound by your own Duty, ordained by Nature, you will involuntarily do not, which, out of delusion, you do not wish to do.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति। भ्रामयन् सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया॥
en: The Lord, O Arjuna, as if mounted on a machine, sits in the heart of all beings, turning them as He pleases by His illusive powers.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत। तत्प्रसादात् परां शान्ति स्थान प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्॥
en: O Bharata, seek shelter under Him in every way. By his favour, you will get Supreme Peace and the Eternal Seat.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद् गुह्यतरं मया। विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु॥
en: I have thus declared to you the knowledge which is more mysterious than any other mystery. Reflect on it fully, and then act as you like.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः। इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्॥
en: Once more hcar My supernatural words, the most mysterious mystery of all. You are very dear to Me; therefore, I tell you what is good for you.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु। मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे॥
en: Fix your heart on Me, become My devotee, sacrifice to Me, bow down to Me, you will then come to Me. I tell you the truth, for you are very dear to Me.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: सर्वधर्मान् परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रजा अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः॥
en: Forsaking all religious duties, come to Me, come to Me as your sole refuge. I shall deliver yo:l from all your sins. Do not grieve.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन। न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति॥
en: This knowledge that I have told you must not be declared by you to one who does not practice penances, who is not a devotee, who never waits on a preceptor, and who always culminates Mc.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति। भक्तिं मयि परां मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः॥
en: He, who will inculcate this supreme knowledge to those who are devoted to Me, offering Me his highest devotion, being freed from all doubts, will come to Me.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः। भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि॥
en: Amongst men none can be dearer to Me than such a man. None on earth can do Me greater service also than he.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः। ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः॥
en: And he, who will study this holy conversation between us, will offer to Me the sacrifice of knowledge. This is my opinion.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः। सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान् प्राप्नुयात् पुण्यकर्मणाम्।।
en: Even he, who with faith and without evil, will hear it, being freed from (the bond of births), will obtain the blessed seat of those that perform pious acts.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा। कच्चिदज्ञानसम्मोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनंजय॥
en: Have you heard, O Partha, this knowledge with mind undirected to any other object? Has, O Dhananjaya, your delusion, caused by ignorance, been destroyed?

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: अर्जुन उवाच नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाऽच्युत। स्थितोऽस्मि गतसंदेहः करिष्ये वचनं तव॥
en: Arjuna said O undecaying One, through your favour my delusion is gone, I now know what I am. I am now firm. My doubts have been dispelled. I will obey you. I will do your bidding.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: संजय उवाच इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः। संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्॥
en: Sanjay said O king, I heard this wonderful and hairstirring words of Vasudeva and Partha.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद् गुह्यमहं परम्। योगयोगेश्वरात् कृष्णात् साक्षात् कथयतः स्वयम्॥
en: Through the favour of Vyasa, I myself heard this mysterious, great and best words from the very lips of the Lord of Yoga, Srikrishna.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: राजन् संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्। केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: O king, I am feeling more and more pleasure as much as I am remembering the holy and wonderful words between Srikrishna and Arjuna.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः। विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः॥
en: O king, I am feeling more and more pleasure as much as I am remembering the wonderful manifestation of Srikrishna.

parva: BHAGAVADGITA PARVA)-Continued Three types of Sannnyasa (Renunciation
sn: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः। तत्र श्रीविजयो भूतिर्बुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम॥
en: Wherever exist the Lord of Yoga Srikrishna and the great bowman Arjuna, there certainly do wealth, victory and glory exist.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच गीता सुगीता कर्तव्या किमन्यैः शास्त्रसंग्रहैः। या स्वयं पद्मनाभस्य मुखपद्माद् विनिःसृता॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O Janamejaya! What is the need to collect a pile of scriptures? Gita should be duly listened, recited, read, taught, understood and retained properly as it has emanated directly from the lotus lips of god Padmanabha himself.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: सर्वशास्त्रमयी गीता सर्वदेवमयो हरिः। सर्वतीर्थमयी गङ्गा सर्ववेदमयो मनुः॥
en: Gita consists of all scriptures (viz. the vital essence of all scriptures is embedded within Gita). God Sri Hari is in the form of all gods. Ganga holds within her all holy places and Manu (His Manusmriti) holds within it, all Vedas.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: गीता गङ्गा च गायत्री गोविन्देति हृदि स्थिते। चतुर्गकारसंयुक्ते पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते॥
en: A man enjoys freedom from the cycle of rebirth when the four names bearing "Ga" i.e. Gita, Gayatri, Govinda and Ganga are duly retained by him in his heart and mind.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: षट्शतानि सविंशानि श्लोकानां प्राह केशवः। अर्जुन: सप्तपञ्चाशत् सप्तषष्टिं तु संजयः॥ धृतराष्ट्रः श्लोकमेकं गीताया मानमुच्यते।
en: God Krishna has chanted six hundred twenty hymns, Arjuna has chanted fifty seven hymns, Sanjaya has chanted sixty seven and a single hymn has been chanted by Dhritarashtra in this Gita. It is stated the dimension/ expansion of Gita.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: भारतामृतसर्वस्वगीताया मथितस्य च। सारमुद्धृत्य कृष्णेन अर्जुनस्य मुखे हुतम्॥
en: God Krishna churned Gita, the sole essence of the nectar in form of Bharata and the vital essence so extracted has been inserted in the mouth (in mind and savvy through ears) of Arjuna by him.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: संजय उवाच ततो धनंजयं दृष्ट्वा बाणगाण्डीवधारिणम्। पुनरेव महानादं व्यसृजन्त महारथाः॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing Dhananjaya (Arjuna) take up once again his Gandiva and arrows, the great carwarriors (of the Pandava army) sent up a tremendous shout.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: पाण्डवाः सोमकाश्चैव ये चैषामनुयायिनः। दध्मुश्च मुदिताः शङ्खान् वीराः सागरसम्भवान्॥
en: Those heroes, the Pandavas, and the Somakas, and those that followed them, blew their sea-born conchs in great delight.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: ततो भेर्यश्च पेश्यश्च क्रकचा गोविषाणिकाः। सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त ततः शब्दो महानभूत्।॥
en: Drums and Peshis and Krakachas and cowhorns were beat and blown together and the uproar made was very loud.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: तथा देवाः सगन्धर्वाः पितरच जनाधिप। सिद्धचारणसंघाश्च समीयुस्ते दिदृक्षया॥
en: O ruler of men, then there came the celestial, the Gandharvas, the Pitris, the Siddhas and the Charanas with the desire of witnessing (the battle).

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: ऋषयश्च महाभागाः पुरस्कृत्य शतक्रतुम्। समीयुस्तत्र सहिता द्रष्टुं तद् वैशसं महत्॥
en: The highly blessed Rishis came there in a body with Shatakratu (Indra) at their head, so that they might see the great slaughter.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: ततो युधिष्ठिरो दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय समवस्थिते। ते सेने सागरप्रख्ये मुहुः प्रचलिते नृप॥ विमुच्य कवचं वीरो निक्षिष्य च वरायुधम्। अवरुह्य रथात् क्षिप्रं पद्भ्यामेव कृताञ्जलिः॥ पितामहमभिप्रेक्ष्य धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। वाग्यतः प्रययौ येन प्राङ्मुखो रिपुवाहिनीम्॥
en: O king, seeing the two armies, which resembled two oceans, ready for the battle and marching continually forward, the brave king Yudhishthira, Dharmaraja, put off his Armour and cast aside his excellent weapons. Then soon alighting from his chariot, he proceeded with joined hands, and with restrained speech towards the direction where the hostile host stood loO king at the grand father and facing the east.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: तं प्रयान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। अवतीर्य रथात् तूर्णं भ्रातृभिः सहितोऽन्वयात्॥
en: Seeing him proceed, the son of Kunti, Dhananjaya, soon alighted from his car and followed him accompanied by all his brothers.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: वासुदेवश्च भगवान् पृष्ठतोऽनुजगाम तम्। तथा मुख्याश्च राजानस्तच्चित्ता जग्मुरुत्सुकाः॥
en: The lord Vasudeva also followed him. The chief kings also (of Yudhisthira's army) followed him in great anxiety.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: अर्जुन उवाच किं ते व्यवसितं राजन् यदस्मानपहाय वै। पद्भ्यामेव प्रयातोऽसि प्राङ्मुखो रिपुवाहिनीम्॥
en: Arjuna said O king, what is this you are doing that abandoning us you proceed on foot, face eastwards to the enemy's army.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: भीमसेन उवाच क्व गमिष्यसि राजेन्द्र निक्षिप्तकवचायुधः। दंशितेष्वरिसैन्येषु भ्रातृनुत्सृज्य पार्थिव॥
en: Bhima said O great king, where are you going, O ruler of earth, putting aside your Armour and weapons, you go towards the enemy's warriors clad in Armour, thus abandoning your brothers,

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: नकुल उवाच एवं गते त्वयि ज्येष्ठ मम भ्रातरि भारत। भीमें दुनोति हृदयं ब्रूहि गन्ता भवान् क्व नु॥
en: Nakula said O descendant of Bharata, you are my eldest brother. Fear troubles my heart on account of your this proceeding (towards the enemy); Tell us where you are going.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: सहदेव उवाच अस्मिन् रणसमूहे वै वर्तमाने महाभये। उत्सृज्य क्क नु गन्तासि शत्रूनभिमुखो नृप॥
en: Sahadeva said o kin, when these hostile troops, both numerous and terrible, stand here to fight with us, where do you go to their directions?

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: संजय उवाच एवमाभाष्यमाणोऽपि भ्रातृभिः कुरुनन्दनः। नोवाच वाग्यतः किंचिद् गच्छत्येव युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Sanjaya said O descendant of Kuru, though he was thus addressed by his brothers, yet he continued to proceed without uttering a word.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: तानुवाच महाप्राज्ञो वासुदेवो महामनाः। अभिप्रायोऽस्य विज्ञातो मयेति प्रहसन्निर॥
en: To them then the high-souled and the greatly wise Vasudeva thus smilingly spoke "His intention is known to me".

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: एष भीष्मं तथा द्रोणं गौतमं शल्यमेव च। अनुमान्य गुरून् सर्वान् योत्स्यते पार्थिवोऽरिभिः॥
en: Having (first) paid his respects to all the Gurus, such as Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and Shalya, he will fight with the enemy.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: श्रूयते हि पुराकल्पे गुरूनननुमान्य यः। युध्यते स भवेद् व्यक्तमपध्यातो महत्तरैः॥ अनुमान्य यथाशास्त्रं यस्तु युध्येन्महत्तरैः। ध्रुवस्तस्य जयो युद्धे भवेदिति मतिर्मम॥ एवं ब्रुवति कृष्णेऽत्र धार्तराष्ट्रचमूं प्रति। हाहाकारो महानासीन्निःशब्दास्त्वपरेऽभवन्॥ दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरं दूराद् धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैनिकाः। मिथः संकथयाञ्चक्रुरेषो हि कुलपांसनः॥
en: It is heard in the old history that he, who, having paid his respects to the reverend preceptors and relatives, according to the Shastras, fights with those that are his superiors, is certain to win victory in battle. This is my opinion. When Krishna was saying this, a loud uproar of “Alas" and "Oh" rose in the ranks of the troops remained quiet. Seeing Yudhishthira, the heroic warriors of Dhritarashtra's son thus talked amongst themselves. “This fellow is an infamous wretch of his race. It is apparent that this king is coming in terror to Bhishma.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: व्यक्ति भीत इवाभ्येति राजासौ भीष्ममन्तिकम्। युधिष्ठिरः ससोदर्यः शरणार्थं प्रयाचकः॥ धनंजये कथं नाथे पाण्डवे च वृकोदरे। नकुले सहदेवे च भीतिरभ्येति पाण्डवम्॥ न नूनं क्षत्रियकुले जातः सम्प्रथिते भुवि। यथाऽस्य हृदयं भीतमल्यसत्त्वस्य संयुगे॥
en: Yudhishthira with his brothers has become a sceker after Bhishma's protection. When Dhananjaya is protector and the sons of Pandu, Vrikodara (Bhima), Nakula and Sahadeva, why does this Pandavas (Yudhishthira) come (to Bhishma) in fear. Though celebrated in the world, this one could never have been born in the Kshatriya order, for he is weak and his heart is filled with fear of battle”. Then those warriors all praised the Kurus.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: ततस्ते सैनिकाः सर्वे प्रशंसन्ति स्म कौरवान्। हृष्टाः सुमनसो भूत्वा चैलानि दुधुवुश्च ह॥ व्यनिन्दश्च तथा सर्वे योधास्तव विशाम्पते। युधिष्ठिरं ससोदर्यं सहितं केशवेन हि॥ ततस्तत् कौरवं सैन्यं धिक्कृत्वा तु युधिष्ठिरम्। निःशब्दमभवत् तूर्णं पुनरेव विशाम्पते॥
en: Becoming greatly pleased, all of them waved their garments with cheerful hearts, 0 king, all the warriors then blamed Yudhishthira with his brothers along with Keshava (Krishna), O king, then the Kuru army crying shame to Yudhishthira again became quiet. What will this king say? What will Bhishma say in reply?

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: किं नु वक्ष्यति राजासौ किं भीष्मः प्रतिवक्ष्यति। किं भीमः सपरश्लीघी किं नु कृष्णार्जुनाविति॥ विवक्षितं किमस्येति संशयः सुमहानभूत्। उभयोः सेनयो राजन् युधिष्ठिरकृते तदा।॥ सोऽवगाह्य चमूं शत्रोः शरशक्तिसमाकुलाम्। भीष्ममेवाभ्ययात् तूर्णं भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः॥ तमुवाच ततः पादौ कराभ्यां पीड्य पाण्डवः। भीष्मं शान्तनवं राजा युद्धाय समुपस्थितम्॥
en: What will Bhima who is ever boastful of his prowess in battle and what Krishna and Arjuna say? What has Yudhishthira to say? O great king, the curiosity of both the armies in respect of Yudhishthira was great. (In the mean time) the king entered the hostile army full of arrows and darts. He then quickly proceeded towards Bhishma, surrounded by his brothers. Seizing his feet with his two hands, the king (Yudhishthira), the son of Pandu, then thus spoke to Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, who was then ready for battle.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आमन्त्रये त्वां दुर्धर्ष त्वया योत्स्यामहे सहा अनुजानीहि मां तात आशिषश्च प्रयोजय॥
en: Yudhishthira said O invincible one, I bow to you. We shall fight with you. Grant us your permission; give us your blessings.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: भीष्म उवाच यद्येवं नाभिगच्छेथा युधि मां पृथिवीपते। शपेयं त्वां महाराज पराभावाय भारत॥
en: Bhishma said Oruler of earth, O great king, O descendant of Bharata, if you had not come to me in this battle, I would have cursed you for bringing about your defeat.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: प्रीतोऽहं पुत्र युध्यस्व जयमाप्नुहि पाण्डव। यत् तेऽभिलषितं चान्यत् तदवाप्नुहि संयुगे॥
en: O son, I am pleased with you. O son of Pandu, fight and obtain victory. Whatever else you have desired to obtain, get them all in this battle.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: वियतां च वरः पार्थ किमस्मत्तोऽभिकाडक्षसि। एवंगते महाराज न तवास्ति पराजयः॥
en: O son of Pritha, ask for a boon which you desire to get. O great king, if it so happens, then defeat will not be yours.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: अर्थस्य पुरुषो दासो दासस्त्वर्थो न कस्यचित्। इति सत्यं महाराज बद्धोऽस्म्यर्थेन कौरवैः॥
en: O king, a man is the slave of wealth, but wealth is no one's slave. This is very true. I am bound to the Kurus by wealth.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: अत्स्त्वां क्लीबवद् वाक्यं ब्रवीमि कुरुनन्दन। भृतोऽस्म्यर्थेन कौरव्य युद्धादन्यत् किमिच्छसि॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, it is for this I am, like a eunuch, uttering these words that I am bound to the Kurus by wealth. Except battle, What do you desire?

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मन्त्रयस्व महाबाहो हितैषी मम नित्यशः। युध्यस्व कौरवस्यार्थे ममैष सततं वरः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O greatly wise one, desiring my welfare from day to day look after my interest. Fight for the sake of the Kurus, this is my prayer.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: भीष्म उवाच राजन् किमत्र साह्यं ते करोमि कुरुनन्दन। कामं योत्स्ये परस्यार्थे ब्रूहि यत् ते विवक्षितम्॥
en: Bhishma said O king, O descendant of Kuru, what can I do for you. I shall of course fight on behalf of your enemies. Tell me what can I do for you?

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं जयेयं संग्रामे भवन्तभपराजितम्। एतन्मे मन्त्रय हितं यदि श्रेयः प्रपश्यसि॥
en: Yudhishthira said O sire, I bow to you. I ask you (tell us) how we shall be able to vanquish you who are invincible. Tell me this, it is for my benefit, if you see any good in it.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: भीष्म उवाच नैनं पश्यामि कौन्तेय यो मां युध्यन्तमाहवे। विजयेत पुमान् कश्चित् साक्षादपि शतक्रतुः॥
en: Bhishma said O son of Kunti, I do not see the person who, even if he be the lord of the celestial-can defeat me in battle when I fight.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच हन्त पृच्छामि तस्मात् त्वां पितामह नमोऽस्तु ते। वधोपायं ब्रवीहि त्वमात्मनः समरे परैः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O grandfather, I bow to you. I ask you, tell us how your death might be caused by your enemy.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: भीष्म उवाच न स्म तं तात पश्यामि समरे यो जयेत माम्। न तावन्मृत्युकालोऽपि पुनरागमनं कुरु॥
en: Bhishma said O sire, I do not find the man who can defeat me in battle. The time for my death is not yet come. (On some future occasion) come to me.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: संजय उवाच ततो युधिष्ठिरो वाक्यं भीष्मस्य कुरुनन्दन। शिरसा प्रतिजग्राह भूयस्तमभिवाद्य च॥
en: Sanjaya said O descendant of Kuru, Yudhishthira then once more saluted him and accepted his words with bent head.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: प्रायात् पुनर्महाबाहुराचार्यस्य रथं प्रति। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां मध्येन भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: That mighty-armed hero surrounded by his brother then went towards the chariot of the preceptor (Drona) through the fines of soldiers who all looked at him.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: स द्रोणमभिवाद्याथ कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम्। उवाच राजा दुर्धर्षमात्मनिःश्रेयसं वचः॥
en: Then bowing down to Drona and walking round him, he spoke these words to that invincible hero, words beneficial to him.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: आमन्त्रये त्वां भगवन् योत्स्ये विगतकल्मषः। कथं जये रिपून् सर्वाननुज्ञातस्त्वया द्विज॥
en: Yudhishthira said "O invincible hero, I ask you, (tell me) how I may fight without incurring any sin, and how, O Brahmana, with your permission I may vanquish all my enemies".

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: द्रोण उवाच यदि मां नाभिगच्छेया युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः। शपेयं त्वां महाराज पराभावाय सर्वशः॥
en: Drona said O king, if having resolved to fight, you filled to have come to me, I would have cursed you for bringing about your defeat.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: तद् युधिष्ठिर तुष्टोऽस्मि पूजितश्च त्वयाऽनघ। अनुजानामि युध्यस्व विजयं समवाप्नुहि॥
en: O Yudhishthira, O sinless one, I am now pleased and honoured by you. I give you permission. Fight and win victory.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: करवाणि च ते कामं ब्रूहि त्वमभिकाक्षितम्। एवंगते महाराज युद्धादन्यत् किमिच्छसि॥
en: I shall also fulfill your desire. Tell me what you have to say. Battle excepted tell me what you desire to get.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: अर्थस्य पुरुषोदासो दासस्त्वर्थो न कस्यचित्। इति सत्यं महाराज बद्धोऽस्यर्थेन कौरवैः॥
en: A man is the slave of wealth, but wealth is the slave of none. O king, this is a great truth. I am bound to the Kurus by their wealth.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: ब्रवीम्येतत् क्लीववत् त्वां युद्धादन्यत् किमिच्छसि। योत्स्येऽहं कौरवस्यार्थे तवाशास्यो जयो मया॥ जपमाशास्व ब्रह्मन् मन्त्रयस्व च यद्धितम्। युद्ध्यस्व कौरवस्यार्थे वर एष वृतो मया॥
en: It is for this like a cunuch I am telling you the following-“Battle excepted what do you wish to get” I shall fight on behalf of the Kurus; but I shall pray for your victory. O Brahmana, pray for my victory and advise me what is good to me. Fight for the Kurus. This is the boon I ask from you.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: मे द्रोण उवाच ध्रुवस्ते विजयो राजन् यस्य मन्त्री हरिस्तव। अहं त्वामभिजानामि रणे शत्रून् विमोक्ष्यसे॥
en: Yudhishthira said O king, victory is certain to you-who have Krishna as your counselor. I wish that you will defeat your enemy in this battle.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: यतो धर्मस्ततः कृष्णो यत: कृष्णस्ततो जयः। युद्ध्यस्व गच्छ कौन्तेये पृच्छं मां किं ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Drona said Where there is righteousness there is Krishna. Where there is Krishna, victory is certain to be there. O son of Kunti, go and fight. Ask me, what shall I speak to you?

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पृच्छामि त्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठ शृणु यन्मेऽभिकाक्षितम्। कथं जयेयं संग्रामे भवन्तमपराजितम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O foremost of Brahmanas, I ask you, hear what I have to say. How shall we in battle defeat you who are invincible?

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: द्रोण उवाच न तेऽस्ति विजयस्तावद् यावद् युद्ध्याम्यहं रणे। ममाशु निधने राजन् यतस्व सह सोदरैः॥
en: Drona said As long as I fight, so long victory cannot be yours. O king, therefore with the help of your brothers try to kill me soon.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच हन्त तस्मान्महाबाहो बधोपायं वदात्मनः। आचार्य प्रणिपत्यैष पृच्छामि त्वां नमोऽस्तु ते॥
en: Yudhishthira said O mighty-armed one, tell us the means of your death. O preceptor, prostrating myself to your feet I ask you this. I bow to you.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: द्रोण उवाच न शत्रु तात पश्यामि यो मां हन्याद् रथे स्थितम्। युध्यमानं सुसंरब्धं शरवर्षांघवर्षिणम्॥
en: arms Drona said O son, I cannot see such an antagonist who may kill me when I stand in battle, when I fight with my anger excited and when I scatter incessantly shower of arrows.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: ऋते प्रायगतं राजन्न्यस्तशस्त्रमचेतनम्। हन्यान्मां युधि योधानां सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: O king, except when I shall be prepared for death, having abandoned my and withdrawing myself from all surrounding sights, none will be able to kill me. What I tell you in true.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: शस्त्रं ग्राहं रणे जह्यां श्रुत्वा महदप्रियम्। श्रद्धेयवाक्यात् पुरुषादेतत् सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I tell you also that having heard something very disagreeable from some creditable source, I will abandon my arms in the battle.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: संजय उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा महाराज भारद्वाजस्य धीमतः। अनुमान्य तमाचार्य प्रायाच्छारद्वतं प्रति॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, having heard these words of the wise son of Bharadvaja and also having honoured the preceptor, he (Yudhishthira) went towards the son of Sharadvata (Kripa).

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: सोऽभिवाद्य कृपं राजा कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्। उवाच दुर्धर्षतमं वाक्यं वाक्यविदां वरः॥
en: Bowing down to Kripa and walking round him, O king, Yudhishthira, accomplished in speech, thus spoke to that greatly brave warrior.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अनुमानये त्वां योत्स्येऽहं गुरो विगतकल्मषः। जयेयं च रिपून् सर्वाननुज्ञातस्त्वयाऽनघ॥
en: Yudhishthira said "O preceptor, with your permission I will fight without incurring sin. O sinless one, if I get your permission, I shall (certainly) defeat my enemy.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: कृप उवाच यदि मां नाभिगच्छेथा युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः। शपेयं त्वां महाराज पराभावाय सर्वशः॥
en: Kripa said "If having resolved to fight, you failed to have come to me, I would have cursed you, O king, for bringing about your defeat.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: अर्थस्य पुरुषो दासो दासस्त्वर्थो न कस्यचित्। इति सत्यं महाराज बद्धोऽस्म्यर्थेन कौरवैः॥
en: A man is the slave of wealth, but wealth is the slave of none. O king, this is the truth. I am bound to the Kurus by wealth.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: तेषामर्थे महाराज योद्धव्यमिति मे मतिः। अतस्त्वां क्लीबवद् ब्रूयां युद्धादन्यत् किमिच्छसि॥
en: O king, I must fight for them. I therefore speck like a eunuch in telling you, “Battle excepted, what do you desire to get?"

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच हन्त पृच्छामि ते तस्मादाचार्य शृणु मे वचः।
en: Yudhishthira said O preceptor, I ask you therefore, listen to me.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: इत्युक्त्वा व्यथितो राजा नोवाच गतचेतनः॥ संजय उवाच तं गौतमः प्रत्युवाच विज्ञायास्य विवक्षितम्। अवध्योऽहं महीपाल युद्ध्यस्व जयमाप्नुहि॥
en: Sanjaya said Saying this, the king became greatly agitated. Being deprived of his sense, he stood silent. knowing however what he desired to say, the son of Gautama (Kripa) thus spoke to him, "O king, I am incapable of being killed. Fight and win victory.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: प्रीतस्तेऽभिगमेनाहं जयं तव नराधिप। आशासिष्ये सदोत्थाय सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I am pleased by your coming. O king, rising every day (from my bed), I shall pray for your victory. I truly speak this to you.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महाराज गौतमस्य विशाम्पते। अनुमान्य कृपं राजा प्रययौ येन मद्रराट्॥
en: O king, having heard these words of Gautama (Kripa) and after having paid him due respect, the king went to the place where the Madra king was.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: स शल्यमभिवाद्याथ कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम्। उवाच राजा दुर्धर्शमात्मनिःश्रेयसं वचः॥
en: Bowing to Shalya and walking round him, the king spoke to that invincible warrior these words beneficial to him.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: अनुमानये त्वां दुर्धर्ष योत्स्ये विगतकल्मषः। जयेयं नु परान् राजन्ननुज्ञातस्त्वया रिपून्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O invincible hero, if I fight with your perinission, I will not incur sin. With your permission I shall defeat my enemies.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: शल्य उवाच यदि मां नाधिगच्छेथा युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः। शपेयं त्वां महाराज पराभावाय वै रणे॥
en: Shalya said If having resolved to fight, O king, you failed to have come to me, I would have then cursed you for brining about your defeat.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: तुष्टोऽस्मि पूजितश्चास्मि यत् काङ्क्षसि तदस्तु ते। अनुजानामि चैव त्वां युध्यस्व जयमाप्नुहि॥
en: I am very much pleased with you. I am much honoured by you. Let it be as you desire, I give you permission, fight and win victory.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: ब्रूहि चैव परं वीरं केनार्थः किं ददामि ते। एवंगते महाराज युद्धादन्यत् किमिच्छसि॥
en: O hero, speck, what do you want? What shall I give you. O king, battle excepted, what do you desire to get?

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: अर्थस्य पुरुषो दासो दासस्त्वर्थो न कस्यचित्। इति सत्यं महाराज बद्धोऽस्म्यर्थन कौरवैः॥
en: A man is the slave of wealth, but wealth is the slave of none, O king, this is the truth. I am bound to the Kurus by wealth.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: करिष्यामि हि ते कामं भागिनेय यथेप्सितम्। ब्रवीम्यतः क्लीबवत् त्वां युद्धादन्यत् किमिच्छसि।।८३।
en: O nephew, it is for this I am speaking to you like a eunuch. I shall do as you desire. Battle excepted, what do you wise to get?

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मन्त्रयस्व महाराज नित्यं मद्धितमुत्तमम्। कामं युद्ध्य परस्यार्थे वरमेतं वृणोम्यहम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O king, think daily of what is beneficial to me. Fight as you please with the focs. This is the boon I ask from you.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: शल्य उवाच किमत्र ब्रूहि साह्यं ते करोमि नृपसत्तम। कामं योत्स्ये परस्यार्थे बद्धोऽस्म्यर्थेन कौरवैः॥
en: Shalya said O fire of kings, in the present circumstances what help can I render to you? I shall of course fight on behalf of your enemy, for I have been made one of their party by the Kurus with their wealth.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच स एव मे वरः शल्य उद्योगे यस्त्वया कृतः। सूतपुत्रस्य संग्रामे कार्यस्तेजोवधस्त्वया॥
en: Yudhishthira said O Shalya, this was the boon I asked during the preparations for this battle. The prowess of the Suta's son (Karna) should be weakened by you in battle.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: शल्य उवाच सम्पत्स्यत्येष ते कामः कुन्तीपुत्र यथेप्सितम्। गच्छ युध्यस्व विश्रब्धः प्रतिजाने वचस्तव॥
en: Shalya said O Yudhishthira, O son of Kunti, your this desire will be fulfilled. Go, fight as you please. I shall pray for your victory.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: संजय उवाच अनुमान्याथ कौन्तेयो मातुलं मद्रकेश्वरम्। निर्जगाम महासैन्याद् भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having received the permission of his maternal uncle (Shalya) the king of the Madra, the son of Kunti (Yudhishthira), surrounded by his brothers, came out of the vast (Kuru) army.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: वासुदेवस्तु राधेयमाहवेऽभिजगाम वै। तत एनमुवाचेदं पाण्डवार्थे गदाग्रजः॥
en: Vasudeva (Krishna) then went to Radha's son (Karna) on the field of battle for the sake of the Pandavas, the eldest brother of Gada, then thus spoke to Karna.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: श्रुतं मे कर्ण भीष्मस्य द्वेषात् किल न योत्स्यसे। अस्मान् वरय राधेय यावद् भीष्मो न हन्यते॥
en: "O Karna, I have heard that from the hatred you bear for Bhishma you will not fight. O son of Radha, come to our side, so long Bhishma is not killed.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: हते तु भीष्मे राधेय पुनरेष्यसि संयुगम्। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य साहाय्यं यदि पश्यसि चेत् समम्॥
en: O son of Radha, when Bhishma will be killed, you may come back and fight on Duryodhana's side, if you have no particular lcaning for any party.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: कर्ण उवाच वचनं कृष्णः न विप्रियं करिष्यामि धार्तराष्ट्रस्य केशव। त्यक्तप्राणं हि मां विद्धि दुर्योधनहितैषिणम्॥
en: Karna said O Keshava, I shall not do anything that is disagreeable to Dhritarashtra's son (Duryodhana), I am ever devoted to him, know, that my life has been cast off for him.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: संजय उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा सन्यवर्तत भारत। युधिष्ठिरपुरोगैश्च पाण्डवैः सह संगतः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having heard these words, Krishna stopped. O descendant of Bharata, he then returned to the Pandavas headed by Yudhishthira.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: अथ सैन्यस्य मध्ये तु प्राक्रोशत् पाण्डवाग्रजः। योऽस्मान् वृणोति तमहं वरये साह्यकारणात्॥
en: Then, in the midst of all the warriors the eldest Pandava thus loudly exclaimed "He, who will choose us, will be considered by us as our ally".

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: अथ तान् समभिप्रेक्ष्य युयुत्सुरिदमब्रवीत्। प्रीतात्मा धर्मराजाः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Thereupon Yuyutsu thus spoke with a cheerful heart to the son of Kunti, Dharamraja Yudhishthira.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: अहं योत्स्यामि भवतः संयुगे धृतराष्ट्रजान्। युष्मदर्थं महाराज यदि मां वृणुषेऽनघ॥
en: I shall fight under you in this battle. O sinless one. I shall fight on your side, if you accept me.

description: Honour of Bhishma and others by Yudhisthira
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच एह्येहि सर्वे योत्स्यामस्तव भ्रातूनपण्डितान्। युयुत्सो वासुदेवश्च वयं च ब्रूम सर्वशः॥
