en: O best of the Bharata race, then your father. seeing that great car-warrior Shveta, though he was then surrounded by those foremost of men (the Pandava warriors) with Bhimasena at their head.

sn: अभ्यवर्तत गाङ्गेयः श्वेतं सेनापतिं द्रुतम्। आपतन्तं ततो भीष्मो भीमसेनं प्रतापवान्॥ आजघ्ने विशिखैः षष्ट्या सेनान्यं स महारथः। अभिमन्युं च समरे पिता देवव्रतस्तव॥ आजम्ने भरतश्रेष्ठस्त्रिभिः संनतपर्वभिः।
en: The son of Ganga (Bhishma), rushed forward to attack Shveta alone. Seeing Bhishma coming, the greatly powerful Bhimasena wounded him with sixty arrows. But that great car-warrior, your father Devavrata, checked Bhimasena, Abhimanyu and other carwarriors with some fearful arrows. He then struck him (Shveta) with three straight arrows.

sn: सात्यकिं च शतेनाजौ भरतानां पितामहः॥ धुष्टद्युम्नं च विंशत्या कैकेयं चापि पञ्चभिः।
en: The (Kuru) grandfather, struck Satyaki in that great battle with one hundred arrows, Dhrishtadyumna with twenty and the Kaikeya brothers with five.

sn: तांश्च सर्वान् महेष्वासान् पिता देवव्रतस्तव॥ वारयित्वा शरैोरैः श्वेतमेवाभिदुद्रुवे।
en: Having thus checked all those great bowmen with fearful arrows, your father Devavrata rushed towards Shveta alone.

sn: ततः शरं मृत्युसमं भारसाधनमुत्तमम्॥ विकृष्य बलवान् भीष्मः समाधत्त दुरासदम्।
en: Then taking up an arrow which resembled Death himself which was capable of being a great strain and which was incapable of being resisted, the mighty Bhishma placed it on his bow-string.

sn: ब्रह्मस्त्रेण सुसंयुक्तं त शरं लोमवाहिनम्॥ ददृशुर्देवगन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः।
en: That winged arrow, endued with the force of the Brahma weapon, was seen by the celestial, the Gandharvas, the Pishachas, the Uragas and the Rakshasas.

sn: स तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा हृदयं चामितौजसः॥ जगाम धरणी बाणो महाशनिरिव ज्वलन्।
en: That arrow, as effulgent as the fire went through his armour and struck into the earth with a flash like that of the thunder-bolt.

sn: अस्तं गच्छन् यथाऽऽदित्यः प्रभामादाय सत्वरः॥ एवं जीवितमादाय श्वेतदेहाज्जगाम ह।
en: As the sun hurriedly retires to his western chamber taking with him the rays of light, so did it pass away out of Shveta's body taking with it his life.

sn: तं भीष्मेण नरव्याघ्र तथा विनिहतं युधि॥ प्रपतन्तमपश्याम गिरेः शृङ्गमिव च्युतम्।
en: When he was thus killed by Bhishma in that battle, we saw him fall down like a loosened peak of a mountain.

sn: अशोचन् पाण्डवास्तत्र क्षत्रियाश्च महारथाः॥ प्रहृष्टाश्च सुतास्तुभ्यं कुरवश्चापि सर्वशः।
en: All the great Kshatriya car warriors, on the Pandava side lamented (for his death). But your son and all the Kurus were filled with great delight.

sn: ततो दुःशासनो राजश्वेतं दृष्ट्वा निपातितम्॥ वादित्रनिनदैोरैर्नृत्यति स्म समन्ततः।
en: o king, seeing Shveta killed, Dushasana danced in joy over the field of battle in accompaniment of the loud music of conchs and druins.

sn: तस्मिन् हते महेष्वासे भीष्मेणाहवशोभिना॥ प्रावेपन्त महेष्वासाः शिखण्डिप्रमुखा रथाः।
en: When that great bowman, was killed by that ornament of battle, Bhishma, the great bowmen of the Pandava side, with Shikhandin at their head, trembled in fear.

sn: ततो धनंजयो राजन् वार्ष्णेयश्चापि सर्वशः॥ अवहारं शनैश्चक्रुनिहते वाहिनीपतौ।
en: O king, when the general (Shveta) was killed, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) and the Vrishni chief (Krishna) slowly withdrew their troops.

sn: ततोऽवहारः सैन्यानां तव तेषां च भारत॥ तावकानां परेषां च नर्दतां च मुहुर्मुहुः।
en: O descendant of Bharata, both your troops and theirs withdrew and both your troops and theirs frequently sent up loud shouts.

sn: पार्था विमनसो भूत्वा न्यवर्तन्त महारथाः। चिन्तयन्तो वधं घोरं द्वैरथेन परंतपाः॥
en: O chastiser of foes the great (Pandava) car warriors entered their camp in great cheerlessness, thinking of the great slaughter made by their general (Shveta) in that great single combat.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच श्वेते सेनापतौ तात संग्रामे निहते परैः। किमकुर्वन् महेष्वासाः पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, when their general Shveta was killed by the foe in that battle, what did those great bowmen, the Panchalas and the Pandavas do?

sn: सेनापतिं समाकर्ण्य श्वेतं युधि निपातितम्। तदर्थं यततां चापि परेषां प्रपलायिनाम्॥
en: When they heard that their general Shveta had been killed, what took place between those that fought to kill him and those that retreated before them.

sn: मनः प्रीणाति मे वाक्यं जयं संजय शृण्वतः। प्रत्युपायं चिन्तयो लज्जां प्राप्नोति मे न हि॥
en: O Sanjaya, your words please me for they speck of our victory. My heart does not feel any shame in remembering our transgression.

sn: स हि वीरोऽनुरक्तश्च वृद्धः कुरुपतिस्तदा। कृतं वैरं सदा तेन पितुः पुत्रेण धीमता॥ तस्योद्वेगभयाचापि संश्रितः पाण्डवान् पुरा। सर्वं वलं परित्यज्य दुर्ग संश्रित्य तिष्ठति॥
en: The old Kuru chief (Bhishma) is ever cheerful and devoted to us. Though he (Duryodhana) provoked hostilities with that intelligent son of his uncle, (Yudhishthira), yet he once sought the protection of the Pandavas. At that time abandoning every thing, he lived in misery.

sn: पाण्डवानां प्रतापेन दुर्गं देशं निवेश्य च। सपत्नान् सततं बाधन्नार्यवृत्तिमनुष्ठितः॥ आश्चर्यं वै सदा तेषां पुरा राज्ञां सुदुर्मतिः। ततो युधिष्ठिरे भक्तः कथं संजय सूदितः॥
en: In consequence of the prowess of the Pandavas and in consequence of placing himself amid entanglement, Duryodhana had recourse (for sometime) to honourable behaviour. Once that wicked-minded prince had to seek their protection, why, therefore. O Sanjaya, had Shveta, who was devoted to Yudhishthira, been killed?

sn: प्रक्षिप्तः सम्मतः क्षुद्रः पुत्रो मे पुरुषाधमः। न युद्धं रोचयेद् भीष्मो न चाचार्यः कथंचन॥
en: This narrow minded prince (Duryodhana) with all his prosperity has been hurled to the nether regions by a number of wretches. Bhishma did not like this war, nor did the preceptor (Drona).

sn: न कृपो न च गान्धारी नाहं संजय रोचये। न वासुदेवो वार्ष्णेयो धर्मराजश्च पाण्डवः॥
en: Nor did Kripa, nor Gandhari, nor did I, O Sanjaya, like it. Nor did the Vrishni chief, Vasudeva (Krishna), nor that son of Pandu, Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira).

sn: न भीमो नार्जुनश्चैव न यमौ पुरुषर्षभौ। वार्यमाणो मया नित्यं गान्धार्या विदुरेण च॥ जामदग्न्येन रामेण व्यासेन च महात्मना। दुर्योधनो युध्यमानो नित्यमेव हि संजय॥ कर्णस्य मतमास्थाय सौबलस्य च पापकृत्। दुःशासनस्य च तथा पाण्डवान् नान्वचिन्तयत्॥
en: Nor did Bhima, nor Arjuna, nor those two foremost of men, the twins Nakula and Sahadeva. Though always forbidden by me, by Gandhari, by Vidura, by Rama the son of Jamadagni, and by the illustrious Vyasa, yet, O Sanjaya, the wicked-minded and sinful Duryodhana with Dushasana always followed the evil counsels of Karna and Subala's son (Shakuni), and behaved maliciously with the Pandavas.

sn: तस्याहं व्यसनं घोरं मन्ये प्राप्तं तु संजय। तस्य च विनाशेन भीष्मस्य विजयेन च॥ संक्रुद्धः कृष्णसहितः पार्थः किमकरोद् युधि। अर्जुनाद्धि भयं भूयस्तन्मे तात न शाम्यति॥
en: O Sanjaya, I think that he has fallen into great distress. After the death of Shveta and the victory of Bhishma, what did Partha, accompanied by Krishna, in anger do? O child, it is Arjuna whom I fear, and my that fear cannot be dispelled.

sn: स हि शूरश्च कौन्तेयः क्षिप्रकारी धनंजयः। मन्ये शरैः शरीराणि शत्रूणां प्रमथिष्यति॥
en: The son of Kunti, Dhananjaya, is brave, and he possesses great activity. I have no doubt he will, with his arrows, cut into fragments the bodies of his enemies.

sn: ऐन्द्रिमिन्द्रानुजसमं महेन्द्रसदृशं बले। अमोघक्रोधसंकल्पं दृष्ट्वा वः किमभून्मनः॥
en: Seeing that son of Indra, who is equal in battle to Upendra, the younger brother of Indra, who is a warrior whose wrath and purpose are never futile, what became the state of your mind?

sn: तथैव वेदविच्छूरो ज्वलनार्कसमद्युतिः। इन्द्रास्त्रविदमेयात्मा प्रपतन् समितिजयः॥
en: He is brave, he is learned in the Vedas, he is as effulgent as the fire and the sun. He possesses the knowledge of Indra weapon; that high-souled warrior is ever victorious when he falls upon his foe.

sn: वज्रसंस्पर्शरूपाणामस्त्राणां च प्रयोजकः। स खड्गाक्षेपहस्तस्तु घोषं चक्रे महारथः॥
en: His weapons always fall on the foe with the force of the thunder-bolt. His arms astonishingly quick to draw the bowstring. That son of Kunti is a great car-warrior.

sn: स संजय महाप्राज्ञो द्रुपदस्यात्मजो बली। धृष्टद्युम्न: किमकरोच्छ्वेते युधि निपातिते॥
en: O Sanjaya, the invincible son of Drupada also is exceedingly wise. What did Dhrishtadyumna do when Shveta had been killed in battle.

sn: पुरा चैवापराधेन वधेन च चमूपतेः। मन्ये मनः प्रजज्वाल पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: I have no doubt that in consequence of the wrongs they suffered before, and in consequence of the death of their general, the hearts of the Pandavas blazed up.

sn: तेषां क्रोधं चिन्तयंस्तु अहःसु च निशासु च। न शान्तिमधिगच्छामि दुर्योधनकृतेन हि। कथं चाभून्महायुद्धं सवेमाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: O Sanjaya, thinking of their anger, I never, by day or by night, enjoy any peace of mind on account of Duryodhana. How did the great battle take place? Tell me all about it.

sn: संजय उवाच शृणु राजन् स्थिरो भूत्वा तवापनयनो महान्। न च दुर्योधने दोषमिममाधातुमर्हसि॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, hear about your great transgressions. You should not put all blame on Duryodhana.

sn: गतोदके सेतुबन्धो यादृक् तादृड्मतिस्तव। संदीप्ते भवने यद्वत् कूपस्य खननं तथा॥
en: Your understanding is like building an embankment when the waters have escaped. It is like the digging of a well when the house is on fire.

sn: गतपूर्वाह्नभूयिष्ठे तस्मिन्नहनि दारुणे। तावकानां परेषां च पुनर्युद्धमवर्तत॥ श्वेतं तु निहतं दृष्ट्वा विराटस्य चमूपतिम्।
en: 0 descendant of Bharata, when the forenoon had passed away and the general Shveta had been killed by Bhishma in that great fearful battle.

sn: कृतवर्मणा च सहितं दृष्ट्वा शल्यमवस्थितम्॥ शङ्खः क्रोधात् प्रजज्वाल हविषा हव्यवाडिव। स विस्फार्य महच्चापं शक्रचापोपमं बली।॥
en: That chastiser of foes, Shankha, the son of Virata, that hero who always took delight in battle, seeing Shalya stationed with Kritavarman. Blazed up in anger as fire with Ghee. That great car-warrior, having stretched his bow that resembled the bow of Indra himself.

sn: अभ्यधावज्जिघांसन् वै शल्यं मद्राधिपं युधि। महता रथसंघेन समन्तात् परिरक्षितः॥
en: Rushed upon the Madra king with the intention of killing him. He was supported on all sides by innumerable car-warriors.

sn: सृजन् बाणमयं वर्ष प्रायाच्छल्यरथं प्रति। तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य मत्तवारणविक्रमम्॥ तावकानां रथाः सप्त समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्। मद्रराजं परीप्सन्तो मृत्योर्दष्ट्रान्तरं गतम्॥
en: Pouring a shower of arrows. Shankha rushed towards the car of Shalya. Seeing him advance like a mad elephant, seven great carwarriors on your side surrounded him in order to rescue the Madra king who was almost within the jaws of death.

sn: बृहद्बलश्च कौसल्यो जयत्सेनश्च मागधः। तथा रुक्मरथो राजन् पुत्रः शल्यस्य मानितः॥ विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ काम्बोजश्च सुदक्षिणः। बृहत्क्षत्रस्य दायादः सैन्धवश्च जयद्रथः॥
en: O king! The names of those chariot holders are-Brihadbala, the king of Kosala, Jayatsena the king of Magadha, Rukinaratha the valorous son of Shalya, Vinda and Anuvinda (the princes of Avanti), Sudakshina, the king of Kamboja and Jayadratha, the king of Sindhu and son of Brihatkshatra.

sn: नानाधातुविचित्राणि कार्मुकाणि महात्मनाम्। विस्फारितान्यदृश्यन्त तोयदेष्विव विद्युतः॥
en: The excellent bows stretched by these great warriors were of different colour and shapes. Those were appeared as if lightening in the clouds.

sn: ते तु बाणमयं वर्षं शङ्खमूर्षि न्यपातयन्। निदाघान्तेऽनिलोद्धृता मेघा इव नगे जलम्॥
en: These all started shooting volley of arrows targeted the head of Shankha. It seerned that scenario as if the clouds rain on the mountain when they are pushed by the strong wind in the end of summer.

sn: ततः क्रुद्धो महेष्वासः सप्तभल्लैः सुतेजनैः। धनूंषि तेषामाच्छिद्य ननर्द पृतनापतिः॥
en: The great archer and army commander Shankha furiated on this. He shot seven bhalla arrows duly sharpened which cut-off the bows of those seven chariot holders. He then challenged them for another attack.

sn: ततो भीष्मो महाबाहुर्विनद्य जलदो यथा। तालमात्रं धनुर्गृह्य शङ्खमभ्यद्रवद् रणे॥
en: The long armed Bhishma challenged in reciprocation with his voice thundering like clouds, picked up a bow measuring four hands length and attacked on Shankha in the battlefield.

sn: तमुद्यन्तमुदीक्ष्याथ महेष्वासं महाबलम्। संत्रस्ता पाण्डवी सेना वातवेगहतेव नौः॥
en: The Pandavas' army shivered like a boat dwindling due to strong wind when it saw mighty archer Bhishma ready to fight fiercely. Seeing that great car-warrior and great bowman thus rush (towards) Shankha, the Pandava army began to tremble like a boat tossed by the tempest.

sn: ततोऽर्जुनः संत्वरितः शङ्खस्यासीत् पुरःसरः। भीष्माद् रक्ष्योऽयमद्येति ततो युद्धमवर्तत॥ (हाहाकारो महानासीद् योधानां युधि युध्यताम्। तेजस्तेजसि सम्पृक्तमित्येवं विस्मयं ययुः॥)
en: Then Arjuna quickly advanced and placed himself in front of Shankha in order to protect him from Bhishma. Then a great battle was fought between Bhishma and Arjuna.

sn: अथ शल्यो गदापाणिरवतीर्य महारथात्। शङ्खस्य चतुरो वाहानहनद् भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, then Shalya jumped down from his large car with his mace in hand, and killed the four horses of Shankha's car.

sn: स हताश्वाद् स्थात् तूर्णं खड्गमादाय विद्रुतः। बीभत्सोश्च रथं प्राप्य पुनः शान्तिमविन्दत॥
en: Shankha leaped down from his car thus deprived of its horses, and taking a sword, he ran towards the car of Vibhatsu. He then got on it and once more was at his ease.

sn: ततो भीष्मरथात् तूर्णमुत्पतन्ति पतत्रिणः। यैरन्तरिक्षं भूमिश्च सर्वतः समवस्तृता॥
en: There was shot from Bhishma's innumerable arrows with which both the sky and the earth were covered.

sn: पञ्चालानथ मत्स्यांश्च केकयांश्च प्रभद्रकान्। भीष्मः प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठः पातयामास पत्रिभिः॥
en: That foremost of heroes, Bhishma killed with his arrows innumerable troops of the Panchalas, the Matasya's, the Kaikeyas and the Prabhadraka hosts.

sn: उत्सृज्य समरे राजन् पाण्डवं सव्यसाचिनम्। अभ्यद्रवत पाञ्चाल्यं दुपदं सेनया वृतम्॥ प्रियं सम्बन्धिनं राजशरानवकिरन् बहून्।
en: Abandoning the battle with the son of Pandu viz., Savyasachin (Arjuna), Bhishima rushed towards Drupada, the Panchala king, who stood surrounded by his troops.

sn: अग्निनेव प्रदग्धानि वनानि शिशिरात्यये॥ शरदग्धान्यदृश्यन्त सैन्यानि द्रुपदस्य ह। अत्यतिष्ठद् रणे भीष्मो विधूम इव पावकः॥ मध्यंदिने यथाऽऽदित्यं तपन्तमिव तेजसा। न शेकुः पाण्डवेयस्य योधा भीष्मं निरीक्षितुम्॥
en: As a forest in consumed by fire at the end of winter, so were the troops of Drupada scen to be consumed (by Bhishma). Bhishina stood in that battle like a blazing fire without smoke, or like the sun at mid-day, scorching every thing around. The Pandava troops could not even look at Bhishma.

sn: वीक्षांचक्रुः समन्तात् ते पाण्डवा भयपीडिताः। त्रातारं नाध्यगच्छन्त गावः शीतार्दिता इव॥
en: Afflicted with fear, the Pandava troops looked around, and not finding any protector, they appeared like a herd of kine afflicted with cold.

sn: सा तु यौधिष्ठिरी सेना गाड्नेयशरपीडिता। सिंहेनेव विनिर्भिन्ना शुक्ला गौरिव गोपते॥
en: Afflicted with the arrows of son of Ganga (Bhishma) the army of Yudhishthira appeared like a kine of white colour afflicted by lion.

sn: हते विप्रदुते सैन्ये निरुत्साहे विमर्दिते। हाहाकारो महानासीत् पाण्डुसैन्येषु भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, being slaughtered in great numbers and crushed when retreating, the Pandava troops cried “Oh” and “Alas”.

sn: ततो भीष्मः शान्तनवो नित्यं मण्डलकार्मुकः। मुमोच बाणान् दीप्ताचानहीनाशीविषानिव॥ शरैरेकायनीकुर्वन् दिशः सर्वा यतव्रतः। जघान पाण्डवरथानादिश्यादिश्य भारत।॥
en: Then the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, with his bow always drawn to a circle, poured a continuous shower of arrows that resembled so many poisonous snakes. Creating continuous lines of arrows in all directions, that vowobserving hero killed innumerable car-warriors of the Pandava's.

sn: ततः सैन्येषु भग्नेषु मथितेषु च सर्वशः। प्राप्ते चास्तं दिनकरे न प्राज्ञायत किंचन॥
en: When the Pandava troops were thus routed and crushed all over the field, the sun set, the night came, and nothing could be seen.

sn: भीष्मं च समुदीर्यन्तं दृष्ट्वा पार्थ महाहवे। अवहारमकुर्वन्त सैन्यानां भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, seeing Bhishma still proudly standing in battle, the sons of Pritha withdrew their forces.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: संजय उवाच कृतेऽवहारे सैन्यानां प्रथमे भरतर्षभ। भीष्मे च युद्धसंरब्धे हृष्टे दुर्योधने तथा॥
en: Sanjaya said O best of the Bharata race, when the troops were withdrawn on the first day (of battle) and when Duryodhana was exceedingly glad in seeing Bhishma angry in the field of battle.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: धर्मराजस्ततस्तूर्णमभिगम्य जनार्दनम्। भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वैः सर्वैश्चैव जनेश्वरैः॥
en: Dharmaraja Yudhishthira soon went to Janardana with all his brothers and with all the kings of his side.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: शुचा परमया युक्तश्चिन्तयानः पराजयम्। वार्ष्णेयमब्रवीद् राजन् दृष्ट्वा भीष्मस्य विक्रमम्॥
en: Being greatly afflicted with the defeat and seeing Bhishma's prowess, O king, he thus spoke to the Vrishni chief (Krishna).

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: कृष्ण पश्य महेष्वासं भीष्मं भीमपराक्रमम्। शरैर्दहन्तं सैन्यं मे चीष्मे कक्षमिवानलम्॥
en: O Krishna, behold the greatly powerful and mighty bowman Bhishma. He consumes my troops with his arrows as fire consumes dry grass.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: कथमेनं महात्मानं शक्ष्यामः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्। लेलिह्यमानं सैन्यं मे हविष्मन्तमिवानलम्॥
en: How shall we even look at that illustrious one who is consuming my troops like fire fed with Ghee..

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: एतं हि पुरुषव्याघ्र धनुष्मन्तं महाबलम्। दृष्ट्वा विप्रद्रुतं सैन्यं समरे मार्गणाहतम्॥
en: Seeing that foremost of men, that great warrior, armed with bow, my troops afflicted with his arrows, fly away (in all directions).

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: शक्यो जेतुं यमः क्रुद्धो वज्रपाणिश्च संयुगे। वरुणः पाशभृद् वापि कुबेरो वा गदाधरः॥
en: Even angry Yama himself, or the wielder of the thunder-bolt (Indra) or the wielder of the noose, Varuna, or the holder of the mace, Kubera, may be defeated in battle.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: न तु भीष्मो महातेजाः शक्यो जेतुं महाबलः। सोऽहमेवंगते मग्नो भीष्मागाधजलेऽप्लवे॥
en: But the greatly effulgent and mighty carwarrior Bhishma is incapable of being defeated. Such being the case, I am sinking in the fathomless ocean (Bhishma) without a boat.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: आत्मनो बुद्धिदौर्बल्याद् भीष्ममासाद्य केशव। वनं यास्यामि वार्ष्णेय श्रेयो मे तत्र जीवितुम्॥ न त्वेतान् पृथिवीपालान् दातुं भीष्माय मृत्यवे। क्षपयिष्यति सेनां मे कृष्ण भीष्मो महास्त्रवित्॥
en: O Keshava, O Govinda, when Bhishma is my foe, it is preferable for me to entire into the forest and live there. It is wrong to sacrifice these rulers of earth to death in the person of Bhishma. Learned as he is in all weapons. O Krishna, he will annihilate my army.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: यथानलं प्रज्वलितं पतङ्गाः समभिद्रुताः। विनाशायोपगच्छन्ति तथा मे सैनिको जनः॥
en: As insects rush into the blazing fire for their own destruction, so do my troops in this fearful battle.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: क्षयं नीतोऽस्मि वार्ष्णेय राज्यहेतोः पराक्रमी। भ्रातरश्चैव मे वीराः कर्शिताः शरपीडिताः॥ मत्कृते भ्रातृहार्देन राज्याद् भ्रष्टास्तथा सुखात्। जीवितं बहु मन्येऽहं जीवितं ह्यद्य दुर्लभम्॥ जीवितस्य च शेषेण तपस्तप्स्यामि दुश्चरम्। न घातयिष्यामि रणे मित्राणीमानि केशव॥
en: O Vrishni chief, using prowess for the sake of acquiring a kingdom, I am being (unconsciously) led to destruction. My heroic brothers are all wounded with arrows for my sake. They are deprived of both sovereignty and happiness only through the great love they bear for their eldest brother. We highly regard life, for, under the circumstances. Life is very precious. During the reminder of my days I will practice the severest asceticism. O Keshava, I shall not bring about the destruction of my friends.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: रथान् मे बहुसाहस्रान् दिव्यैरस्त्रैर्महाबलः। घातयत्यनिशं भीष्मः प्रवराणां प्रहारिणाम्॥
en: The mighty Bhishma continuously kills with his celestial weapons many thousands of my car-warriors who are foremost of heroes.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: किं नु कृत्वा हितं मे स्याद् ब्रूहि माधव माचिरम्। मध्यस्थमिव पश्यामि समरे सव्यसाचिनम्॥
en: O Madhava, tell me soon what should be done for my good. As regards Arjuna, I see he is indifferent in this battle, he behaves like a spectator.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: एको भीमः परं शक्त्या युध्यत्येव महाभुजः। केवलं बाहुवीर्येण क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन्॥
en: The greatly powerful Bhishma alone, remembering Kshatriya duties, fights with all the prowess of his arms and to the utmost of his Power.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: गदया वीरघातिन्या यथोत्साहं महामनाः। करोत्यसुकरं कर्म रथाश्वनरदन्तिषु॥
en: With his great mace that kills the heroes, this illustrious one (Bhishma), with the best of his powers, achieves the most difficult feats on foot-soldiers, horses, car and elephants.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: नालमेष क्षयं कर्तुं परसैन्यस्य मारिष। आर्जवेनैव युद्धेन वीर वर्षशतैरपि॥
en: O sire, this hero, however, is incapable of destroying in a fair fight the troops of our army if he tries for one hundred years.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: एकोऽस्त्रवित सखा तेऽयं सोऽप्यस्मान् समुपेक्षते। निर्दह्यमानान् भीष्मेण द्रोणेन च महात्मना॥
en: This your friend (Arjuna) alone is learned in all weapons. Seeing us consumed by Bhishma and the illustrious Drona, he only looks on us with indifference.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि भीष्मस्य द्रोणस्य च महात्मनः। धक्ष्यन्ति क्षत्रियान् सर्वान् प्रयुक्तानि पुनः पुनः॥
en: The celestial weapons of Bhishma and those of the illustrious Drona are continuously consuming all the Kshatriyas.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: कृष्ण भीष्मः सुसंरब्धः सहितः सर्वपार्थिवैः। क्षपयिष्यति नो नूनं यादृशोऽस्य पराक्रमः॥
en: OKrishna, such is the prowess of Bhishma; if he is angry, he will, with the help of the kings (on his side), certainly annihilate us.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: स त्वं पश्य महाभाग योगेश्वर महारथम्। भीष्मः यः शमयेत् शंख्ये दावाग्नि जल्दो यथा।॥
en: O lord of Yoga, search out that great bowman, that mighty car-warriors who will be able to extinguish Bhishma's prowess, as rain charged clouds extinguish a forest-fire.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: तव प्रसादाद् गोविन्द पाण्डवा निहतद्विषः। स्वराज्यमनुसम्प्राप्ता मोदिष्यन्ते सबान्धवा॥
en: 0 Govinda, through your grace the Pandavas will recover their kingdom when their enemies will be killed and they will be happy with their kinsmen.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: पार्षतः। एवमुक्त्वा ततः पार्थो ध्यायन्नास्ते महामनाः। चिरमन्तर्मना भूत्वा शोकोपहतचेतनः।
en: Having said this, the high-souled son of Pritha, in great grief, remained silent for a long time in a reflected mood.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: शोकार्तं तमथो ज्ञात्वा दुःखोपहतचेतसम्॥ अब्रवीत् तत्र गोविन्दो हर्षयन् सर्वपाण्डवान्।
en: Seeing the Pandava (Yudhishthira) afflicted with grief and deprived of his senses by sorrow, Govinda thus spoke giving excessive delight to all.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: मा शुचो भरतश्रेष्ठ न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि॥ यस्य ते भ्रातरः शूराः सर्वलोकेषु धन्विनः।
en: "O best of the Bharata race, do not grieve. You would not grieve, when all your brothers are heroes and illustrious bow-men.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: अहं च प्रियकृद् राजन् सात्यकिश्च महायशाः॥ विराटद्रुपदौ चेमौ धृष्टद्युम्नश्च
en: I am also engaged in doing good to you, so are the great car-warriors Satyaki, the revered Virata and Drupada and also the descendant of Prishata, Dhrishtadyumna.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: तथैव सबलाश्चेमे राजानो राजसत्तम॥ त्वत्प्रसादं प्रतीक्षन्ते त्वद्भक्ताश्च विशाम्पते।
en: O best of kings, O monarch, all these kings with their troops are all in your favour. They are all devoted to you.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: एष ते पार्षतो नित्यं हितकाम: प्रिये रतः॥ सैनापत्यमनुप्राप्तो धृष्टद्युम्नो महाबलः।
en: This great car-warrior, this descendant of Prishata, this Dhrishtadyumna, who had been placed in command of your troops, is always desirous of your welfare. He is ever engaged in doing what is agreeable to you.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: शिखण्डी च महाबाहो भीष्मस्य निधनं किल॥ एतच्छ्रुत्वा ततो राजा धृष्टद्युम्नं महारथम्।
en: O mighty armed hero, so also is Shikhandin who is certain to be the slayer of Bhishma”. Having heard this the king (Yudhishthira) thus spoke to that great warrior Dhrishtadyumna. car

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: अब्रवीत् समितौ तस्यां वासुदेवस्य शृण्वतः॥ धृष्टद्युम्न निबोधेदं यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि मारिष।
en: In that assembly and in the hearing of Vasudeva. "O Dhrishtadyumna, O descendant of Prishata, mark the words I speak to you.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: नातिक्रम्यं भवेत् तच्च वनचं मम भीषितम्॥ भवान् सेनापतिर्मह्यं वासुदेवेन सम्मितः।
en: The words uttered by me should not be transgressed. You have been appointed to commander of our force with the approval of Vasudeva.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: कार्तिकेयो यथा नित्यं देवानामभवत् पुरा॥ तथा त्वमपि पाण्डूना सेनानी: पुरुषर्षभ।
en: O foremost of men, as in the days of yore, Kartikeya was the commander of the celestial army, so are you commander of the Pandava army.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल विक्रम्य जहि कौरवान्॥ अहं च तेऽनुयास्यामि भीमः कृष्णश्च मारिष।
en: O foremost of men, putting forth your prowess, kill of Kurus, O sire, I shall follow you Bhima and Krishna,

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: माद्रीपुत्रौ च सहितौ द्रौपदेयाश्च दंशिताः॥ ये चान्ये पृथिवीपालाः प्रधानाः पुरुषर्षभ।
en: The sons of Madri, the sons of Draupadi clad in armour and also all the other foremost of kings, O best of men, (will also follow you)"

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: तत उद्धर्षयन् सर्वान् दृष्टद्युम्नोऽभ्यभाषत॥ अहं द्रोणान्तकः पार्थ विहितः शम्भुना पुरा।
en: Then giving delight to all who heard him, Dhrishtadyumna thus spoke; “O son of Pritha, I am the ordained slayer of Drona."

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: रणे भीष्मं कृपं द्रोणं तथा शल्यं जयद्रथम्॥ सर्वानद्य रणे दृप्तान् प्रतियोत्स्यामि पार्थिव।
en: O king! I shall now fight with Bhishma. Drona, Kripa, Shalya, Jayadratha and all the other proud kings.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: अथोत्क्रुष्टं महेष्वासैः पाण्डवैर्युद्धदुर्मदैः॥ समुद्यते पार्थिवेन्द्रे पार्षते शत्रुसूदने। तमब्रवीत् ततः पार्थः पार्षतं पृतनापितम्॥ व्यूहः क्रौञ्चारुणो नाम सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणः।
en: When the chastiser of foes, that foremost of princes, that descendant of Pritha (Dhrishtadyumna) defiantly spoke thus, the Pandava warriors, who were all greatly powerful, who were all incapable of being defeated, sent forth a loud shout. Then the son of Pritha, Yudhishthira, thus spoke to the descendant of Prishat (Dhrishtadyumna), the commander of his army, "A Vyuha called Krauncharuna which is destructive of all foes.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: यं बृहस्पतिरिन्द्राय तदा देवासुरेऽब्रवीत्॥ तं यथावत् प्रतिव्यूह परानीकविनाशनम्।
en: and which was spoken of by Brihaspati to Indra in the days of old when the celestial and the Asuras fought, kindly now from that Vyuha destructive of the hostile troops.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: अदृष्टपूर्व राजानः पश्यन्तु कुरुभिः सह॥ यथोक्तः स नृदेवेन विष्णुर्वज्रभृता यथा।
en: It was never before seen by any one. Now let the kings see it with the Kurus”. Having been thus addressed by that foremost of men, as Vishnu is addressed by the wielder of thunder bolt.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: प्रभाते सर्वसैन्यानामग्रे चक्रे धनंजयम्॥ आदित्यपथगः केतुस्तस्याद्भुतमनोरमः। शासनात् पुरुहूतस्य निर्मितो विश्वकर्मणा॥ इन्द्रायुधसवर्णाभिः पताकाभिरलकृतः। आकाशग इवाकाशे गन्धर्वनगरोपमः॥ नृत्यमान इवाभाति रथचर्यासु मारिष।
en: He (Dhrishtadyumna) placed Dhananjaya in front of the whole army in the next morning. The standard of Dhananjaya, (Arjuna) which had been made by the celestial artificial at the command of Indra, looked exceedingly beautiful when it moved through the sky. Adorned with banners of the rain-bow colours, when it coursed through the air like a arranger of the skies, loO king like a fleeting vapoury mansion in the sky. O sire, it appeared to glide dancingly along the path by which the car went.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: तेन रत्नवता पार्थः स च गाण्डीवधन्वना॥ बभूव परमोपेतः सुमेरुरिव भानुना।
en: Arjuna was graced by that flag studded with gems and that flag was graced by Arjuna by that flag studded with gems and that flag was graced by Arjuna holding Gandiva bow. It was just the same as sun god is graced by Meru mountain and Meru mountain receives grandeur from the presence of sun god.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: शिरोऽभूद् द्रुपदो राजन् महत्या सेनया वृतः॥ कुन्तिभोजश्च चैद्यश्च चक्षुर्ध्या तौ जनेश्वरौ।
en: The king Drupada, surrounded by a large number of troops, stood at the head of that Vyuha, becoming as if its head. The two kings Kuntibhoja and Shaivya became its two eyes.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: दाशार्णकाः प्रभद्राश्च दाशेरकगणैः सह॥ अनूपका: किराताश्च ग्रीवायां भरतर्षभ।
en: O best of the Bharata race, the ruler of the Dasharhas, the Prayagas, the Dasherakas, the Anupakas and the Kiratas were placed in its neck.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: पटच्चरैश्च पौण्ड्रैश्च राजन् पौरवकैस्तथा॥ निषादैः सहितश्चापि पृष्ठमासीद् युधिष्ठिरः।
en: O king, Yudhishthira with the Patachcharas, the Pundras, the Puravakas and the Nishadas, became its back.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: पक्षौ तु भीमसेनश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥ द्रौपदेयाभिमन्युश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः।
en: Bhimasena, the descendant of Prishat Dhrishtadyumna, the sons of Draupadi, Abhimanyu, and that great car-warrior Satyaki became its two wings.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: पिशाचा दारदाश्चैव पुण्ड्राः कुण्डीविषैः सह।॥ मारुता धेनुकाश्चैव तङ्गणाः परतङ्गणाः। बालिकास्तित्तिराश्चैव चोलाः पण्ड्याश्च भारत॥ एते जनपदा राजन् दक्षिणं पक्षमाश्रिताः। अग्निवेश्यास्तु हुण्डाश्च मालवा दानभारयः॥ शबरा उद्भसाश्चैव वत्साश्च सह नाकुलैः।
en: They were backed, (descendant of Bharata, by the Pishachas, the Daradas, the Pundras, the Kundivishas, the Marulas, the Dhenukas, the Tanganas, the further Tanganas, the Balhikas, the Tittiras, the Chola, the Pandyas, the Udbhas, the Shabaras, Tumbhumas, the Vatsas, and the Nakula's.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: नकुलः सहदेवश्च वामं पदं समाश्रिताः॥ रथानामयुतं पक्षौ शिरस्तु नियुतं तथा। पृष्ठमर्बुदमेवासीत् सहस्राणि च विंशतिः॥ ग्रीवायां नियुतं चापि सहस्राणि च सप्ततिः।
en: Nakula and Sahadeva stood in the left wing. O the joints of the wings stood ten thousand car-warriors and on the head stood one hundred thousand and on the back one hundred millions and on the neck one hundred and seventy thousand.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: पक्षकोटिप्रपक्षेषु पक्षान्तेषु च वारणा:॥ जग्मुः परिवृता राजंश्चलन्त इव पर्वताः।
en: On the joints of the wings, on the wings and the extremities of the wings, stood innumerable elephants loO king like so many blazing mountains.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: जघनं पालयामास विराटः सह केकयैः॥ काशिराजश्च शैब्यश्च स्थानामयुतैस्त्रिभिः।
en: The rear was protected by Virata's backed by the Kaikeyas, the ruler of the Kashi's, and with the king of the Chedi, with thirty thousand cars.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: युद्धाय दंशिताः। एवमेनं महाव्यूहं व्यूह्य भारत पाण्डवाः॥ सूर्योदयं त इच्छन्तः स्थिता
en: O descendant of Bharata, thus forming this great Vyuha the Pandavas, all clad in armour waited for the morning.

description: Krauncha Vyuha making of the Pandavas
sn: तेषामादित्यवर्णानि विमलानि महान्ति च। श्वेतच्छत्राण्यशोभन्त वारणेषु रथेषु च॥
en: Their clean, costly and white umbrellas, as brilliant as the sun, shone on the back of their elephants and over their chariots.

sn: संजय उवाच क्रौञ्चं दृष्ट्वा ततो व्यूहमभेद्यं तनयस्तव। रक्ष्यमाणं महाघोरं पार्थेनामिततेजसा।।शा आचार्यमुपसंगम्य कृपं शल्यं च पार्थिव। सौमदत्तिं विकर्णं च सोऽश्वत्थामानमेव च॥ दुःशासनादीन् भ्रातृ॑श्च सर्वानेव च भारत। अन्यांश्च सुबहूशूरान् युद्धाय समुपागतान्॥ प्राहेदं वचनं काले हर्षयंस्तनयस्तव। नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वै युद्धविशारदाः॥ एकैकशः समर्था हि यूयं सर्वे महारथाः।
en: Sanjaya said O Sire, O descendant of Bharata, seeing that great and fearful Vyuha, formed by the immeasurably powerful Pandava, your son (Duryodhana) came to the preceptor, Kripa, Shalya, Somadatta's son, Vikarna, Ashvathama and all his brothers headed by Dushasana, and also all other mighty heroes, assembled there for battle, spoke these words giving great pleasures to all, “You are armed with various kinds of weapons, you are learned in the Shastras. O great car-warriors, each of you singly is capable of destroying the Pandavas with all their troops.

sn: पाण्डुपुत्रान् रणे हन्तुं ससैन्यान् किमु संहताः॥ अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्। पर्याप्तमिदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम्॥
en: How easy it is for you then (to destroy them) when you are united. Our army protected by Bhishma is unlimited and their army protected by Bhima is limited.

sn: संस्थानाः शूरसेनाश्च वेत्रिकाः कुकुरास्तथा। आरोचकास्त्रिगर्ताश्च मद्रका यवनास्तथा॥ शत्रुजयेन सहितास्तथा दुःशासनेन च। विकर्णेन च वीरेण तथा नन्दोपनन्दकैः॥ चित्रसेनेन सहिताः सहिताः पारिभद्रकैः। भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु सहसैन्यपुरस्कृताः॥
en: Let the Samsthanas, the Shurasenas, the Vetarikas, the Kukuras, the Rechakas, the Trigartas, the Madrakas, the Yavanas, with Shatrunjaya and Dushasana, and with also that great hero Vikarna, Nanda, Upananda, and Chitrasena, with the Paribhadrakas protect Bhishma with their respective troops”.

sn: ततो भीष्मश्च द्रोणश्च तव पुत्राश्च मारिष अव्यूहन्त महाव्यूहं पाण्डूनां प्रतिबाधकम्॥
en: O Sire, then Bhishma, Drona and your sons formed a great Vyuha to resist that of the sons of Pritha.

sn: भीष्मः सैन्येन महता समन्तात् परिवारितः। ययौ प्रकर्षन् महतीं वाहिनीं सुरराडिव॥
en: Then, like the lord of the celestial (Indra), Bhishma surrounded by innumerable troops, advanced at the head of a mighty army,

sn: तमन्वयान्महेष्वासो भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। कुन्तलैश्च दशार्ङ्गश्च मागधैश्च विशाम्पते॥ विदर्भमैकलैश्चैव कर्णप्रावरणैरपि। सहिताः सर्वसैन्येन भीष्ममाहवशोभिनम्॥ गान्धाराः सिन्धुसौवीराः शिवयोऽथवसातयः। शकुनिश्च स्वसैन्येन भारद्वाजमपालयत्॥
en: O king, that great bowman, that greatly powerful son of Bharadvaja (Drona) followed him with the Kuntalas, the Dasharnas, the Magadhas, the Vidarbhas, the Mekalas, the Karnas, and the Paravarnas, the Gandharvas, the Sindhusauviras, the Shibis, and the Vasati with their all combatants, Shakuni with all his troops protected the son of Bharadvaja.

sn: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सहितः सर्वसोदरैः। अश्वातकैविकर्णैश्च तथा चाम्बष्ठकोसलैः॥ दरदैश्च शकैश्चैव तथा क्षुद्रकमालवैः। अभ्यरक्षत संहष्टः सौबलेयस्य वाहिनीम्॥
en: Then king Duryodhana with all his brothers accompanied by the Ashvatakas, the Vikarnas, the Ambashta, the Kosalas, the Daradas, the Shaka, the Kshudrakas and the Malavas, Cheerfully advanced against the Pandava army.

sn: भूरिश्रवाः शलः शल्यो भगदत्तश्च मारिषः। विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ वामं पार्श्वमपालयन्॥
en: O sire, Bhurishrava, Shala and Shalya, Bhagadatta, Vinda and Anuvinda of Avanti protected the left wing.

sn: सौमदत्तिः सुशर्मा च काम्बोजश्च सुदक्षिणः। श्रुतायुश्चाच्युतायुश्च दक्षिणं पक्षमास्थिताः॥
en: Somadatta, Susharma, the ruler of Kambojas, Sudakshina, Shrutayus and Achyutayu protected the right wing.

sn: अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः। महत्या सेनया साधु सेनापृष्ठे व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: Ashvathama, Kripa, the Satvata hero Kritvarma, with large number of troops protected the rear.

sn: पृष्ठगोपास्तु तस्यासन् नानादेश्या जनेश्वराः। केतुमान् वसुदानश्च पुत्रः काश्यस्य चाभिभूः॥
en: Behind them stood many chiefs, Ketumata, Vasudana and the powerful prince of Kashi.

sn: ततस्ते तावकाः सर्वे हृष्टा युद्धाय भारत। दध्मुः शङ्खान् मुदा युक्ताः सिंहनादांस्तथोन्नदन्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, then all your troops, when they were cheerfully waiting for like roars.

sn: तेषां श्रुत्वा तु हृष्टानां वृद्धः कुरुपितामहः। सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्ख दध्मौ प्रतापवान्॥
en: Hearing these shouts, the greatly powerful and the venerable Kuru grandsire uttered a lion-like roar and then blew his conch in great delight.

sn: ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पेश्यश्च विविधाः परे। आनकाश्चाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्॥
en: Their conchs, drums, Peshis and cymbals were sounded by all, which created a fearful din all over the field of battle.

sn: ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ। प्रदध्मतुः शङ्खवरौ हेमरत्नपरिष्कृतौ॥
en: Krishna and Arjuna riding on the same car yoked with (four) white horses, blew their excellent conchs adorned with gold and jewel.

sn: पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनंजयः। पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्ख भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः॥
en: Hrishikesha (Krishna) blew the conch called Panchajanya and Dhananjaya Devadatta. That doer of fearful deeds, Vrikodara (Bhima) blew his huge conch, called Paundra.

sn: अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ॥
en: The son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, blew the conch called Anantavijaya, Nakula and Sahadeva blew Sughosha and Manipushpaka.

sn: काशिराजश्च शैब्यश्च शिखण्डी च महारथः। धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः॥ पाञ्चाल्याश्च महेष्वासा द्रौपद्याः पञ्च चात्मजाः। सर्वे दध्मुर्महाशङ्खान् सिंहनादांश्च नेदिरे॥
en: The king of Kashi, and Shaivya and Shikhandin, the great car-warrior Dhrishtadyumna and Virata and the great carwarrior Satyaki and the great bowman the Panchala king, and also the five sons of Draupadi, all blew their large conches and sent forth lion-like roars.

sn: स घोषः सुमहांस्तत्र वीरैस्तैः समुदीरितः। नभश्च पृथिवीं चैव तुमुलो व्यनुनादयत्॥ एवमेते महाराज प्रहृष्टाः कुरुपाण्डवाः। पुनयुद्धाय संजग्मुस्तापयानाः परस्परम्॥
en: That great uproar, thus uttered by those heroes resounded through the sky. O great king, thus again the Kurus and the Pandavas advanced against each other with the intention of fighting a great battle. hinTrn-0

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच एवं व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु मामकेष्वितरेषु च। कथं प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठाः सम्प्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे॥श।
en: Dhritarashtra said When my troops and the troops of our foe were thus placed in battle array, how did then the foremost of warriors Bhishma begin to strike?

sn: संजय उवाच समं व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु संनद्धरुचिरध्वजम्। अपारमिव संदृश्य सागरप्रतिमं बलम्॥
en: Sanjaya said When all the troops were thus placed in battle array, the warriors all clad in armours waited with their excellent standards upraised.

sn: तेषां मध्ये स्थितो राजन् पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। अब्रवीत् तावकान् सर्वान् युद्ध्यध्वमिति दंशिताः॥
en: O king, seeing his army look like the infinite ocean, your son Duryodhana, who stood within it, spoke thus to all his troops “You are all clad in armour. Now begin the fight".

sn: ते मनः क्रूरमाधाय समभित्यक्तजीविताः। पाण्डवानभ्यवर्तन्त सर्व एवोच्छ्रितध्वजाः॥
en: Then all the (Kuru) warriors, full of cruel intentions and devoid of the desire of living, rushed upon the Pandavas with their standards all upraised.

sn: ततो युद्धं समभवत् तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। तावकानां परेषां च व्यतिषक्तरथद्विपम्॥
en: Then a fearful hair-stirring battle took place. The cars and elephants all go mixed up.

sn: मुक्तास्तु रथिभिर्बाणा रुक्मपुङ्खाः सुतेजसः। संनिपेतुरकुण्ठाचा नागेषु च हयेषु च॥
en: Arrows with beautiful feathers and with sharp points shot by the car-warriors fell on the elephants and the horses.

sn: तथा प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे धनुरुद्यम्य दंशितः। अभिपत्य महाबाहुर्भीष्मो भीमपराक्रमः॥ सौभद्रे भीमसेने च सात्यकौ च महारथे। कैकेये च विराटे च धृष्टद्युम्ने च पार्षते॥ एतेषु नरवीरेषु चेदिमत्स्येषु चाभिभूः। ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि वृद्धः कुरुपितामहः॥
en: When the battle thus began, the venerable Kuru grandfather, the mighty-armed and terribly powerful Bhishma, clad in armour, took up his bow and rushed upon them. He poured a shower of arrows on the heroic son of Subhadra, on Bhimasena, on the great carwarrior Arjuna, on the ruler of the Kaikeyas, Virata, Prishata prince Dhrishtadyumna and also on the Chedi and the Matsya warriors.

sn: अभिद्यत ततो व्यूहस्तस्मिन् वीरसमागमे। सर्वेषामेव सैन्यानामासीद् व्यतिकरो महान्॥
en: The great (Pandava) Vyuha wavered at that great attack made by that (Kuru) hero. The battle that was then fought by the combatants was fearful.

sn: सादिनो ध्वजिनश्चैव हताः प्रवरवाजिनः। विप्रद्रुतस्थानीकाः समपद्यन्त पाण्डवाः॥
en: Many horsemen and car warriors and best of horses fell in quick succession. Many carwarriors of the Pandava began to run away.

sn: अर्जुनस्तु नरव्याघ्रो दृष्ट्वा भीष्मं महारथम्। वाळूमयब्रवीत् क्रुद्धो याहि यत्र पितामहः॥
en: Then that lion among the men, Arjuna, seeing the great car-warrior Bhishma (destroying the Pandava troops) thus angrily spoke to the Vrishni prince (Krishna his charioteer) "Go to the place where the grandfather is".

sn: एष भीष्मः सुसंक्रुद्धो वार्ष्णेय मम वाहिनीम्। नाशयिष्यति सुव्यक्तं दुर्योधनहिते रतः॥
en: O descendant of Vrishni, it is apparent that Bhishma, in anger, will annihilate our troops for the good of Duryodhana.

sn: एष द्रोणः कृपः शल्यो विकर्णश्च जनार्दन। धार्तराष्ट्राश्च सहिता दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः॥ पञ्चालान् निहनिष्यन्ति रक्षिता दृढधन्वना। सोऽहं भीष्मं वधिष्यामि सैन्यहेतोर्जनार्दन॥
en: O Janardana, Drona, Kripa, Shalya, Vikarna with the sons of Dhritarashtra headed by Duryodhana and protected by this great bowman (Bhishma) will destroy the Panchalas. OJanardana, I shall, therefore, kill Bhishma for the good of my troops.

sn: तमब्रवीद् वासुदेवो यत्तो भव धनंजय। एष त्वां प्रापयिष्यामि पितामहरथं प्रति॥
en: To him thus spoke Vamdeva, "O Dhananjaya, O hero, be careful, for I shall soon take you near the grandfather's car".

sn: एवमुक्त्वा ततः शौरी रथं तं लोकविश्रुतम्। प्रापयामास भीष्मस्य रथं प्रति जनेश्वर॥
en: O king, having said this, Shaurin (Krishna) took that world-renowned chariot in front of Bhishma's car.

sn: चलद्बहुपताकेन बलाकावर्णवाजिना। समुच्छ्रितमहाभीमनदद्वानरकेतुना॥ महता मेघनादेन रथेनामिततेजसा। विनिघ्नं कौरवानीकं शूरसेनांश्च पाण्डवः॥
en: With countless banners flying, with horses as handsome as a flight of cranes, with the standard upraised; with the ape (on that standard) roaring fearfully, that son of Pandu (Arjuna) came slaughtering the Kurus and the Shurasenas on his large car as effulgent as the sun; the rattle of the car-wheel of which resembled that of the clouds.

sn: प्रायाच्छरणदः शीघ्रं सुहृदां हर्षवर्धनः। तमापतन्तं वेगेन प्रभिन्नमिव वारणम्॥ त्रासयन्तं रणे शूरान् मर्दयन्तं च सायकैः। सैन्धवप्रमुखैर्गुप्तः प्राच्यसौवीरकेकयैः॥ सहसा प्रत्युदीयाय भीष्मः शान्तनवोऽर्जुनम्। को हि गाण्डीवधन्वानमन्य: कुरुपितामहात्॥ द्रोणवैकर्तनाभ्यां वा रथी संयातुमर्हति। ततो भीष्मो महाराज सर्वलोकमहारथः॥
en: That enhancer of the joy of his friends soon came to the fight. The son of Shantanu, Bhishma, protected the warriors headed by the Sindhu king and by the warriors of the east and also by the Kaikeyas impetuously met him who was rushing like a mad elephant, thus frightening the brave warriors and destroying the troops with his sharp arrows. Except the Kuru grandsire, and those car-warriors, Drona and Vikartana's son, who else was able to withstand in battle the wielder of Gandiva? O king of kings, Bhishma, the grandfather of the Kurus.

sn: अर्जुनं सप्तसप्तत्या नाराचानां समाचिनोत्। द्रोणश्च पञ्चविंशत्या कृपः पञ्चाशता शरैः॥
en: Struck Arjuna with seventy-seven arrows, Drona struck him with twenty-five, Kripa with fifty,

sn: दुर्योधनश्चतुःषष्ट्या शल्यश्च नवभिः शरैः। सैन्धवो नवभिश्चैव शकुनिश्चापि पञ्चभिः॥ विकर्णो दशभिर्भल्लैः राजन् विव्याध पाण्डवम्। तं तैर्विद्धो महेष्वासः समन्तानिशितैः शरैः॥
en: Duryodhana with sixty-four, Shalya with nine, Drona's son (Ashvathama) that foremost of men, with sixty, Vikarna with three, the Sindhu king with nine, and Shakuni with five; O king, Vikarna then struck the Pandava with ten broad-headed arrows. Though struck on all sides, with sharp arrows, that great bowman,

sn: न विव्यथे महाबाहुर्भिद्यमान इवाचलः। स भीष्मं पञ्चविंशत्या कृपं च नवभिः शरैः॥ द्रोणंषष्ट्या नरव्याघ्रो विकर्णं च त्रिभिः शरैः। शल्यं चैव त्रिभिर्बाणै राजानं चैव पञ्चभिः॥ प्रत्यविध्यदमेयात्मा किरीटी भरतर्षभ। तं सात्यकिविराटश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥ द्रौपदेयाऽभिमन्युश्च परिवQर्धनंजयम्। ततो द्रोणं महेष्वासं गाङ्गेयस्य प्रिये रतम्॥ अभ्यवर्ततं पाञ्चाल्यः संयुक्तः सह सोमकैः। भीष्मस्तु रथिनां श्रेष्ठो राजन् विव्याध पाण्डवम्॥
en: That mighty-armed one, stood unmoved as a mountain. Thereupon, that greatly powerful hero (Arjuna), of immeasurable strength, pierced Bhishma with twenty five, Kripa with nine, Drona with sixty, Vikarna with three, Artayani with three and also the king (Duryodhana) with five arrows. Then Satyaki, Virata, Prishata prince Dhrishtadyumna, the sons of Draupadi, and Abhimanyu all came there to help him. Then the Panchala prince, supported by the Somakas, rushed upon the great bowman Drona who was aiding the son of Ganga (Bhishma). Then Bhishma, that best of all car-warriors, soon wounded that son of Pandu.

sn: अशीत्या निशितैर्बाणैस्ततोऽक्रोशन्त तावकाः। तेषां तु निनदं श्रुत्वा सहितानां प्रहृष्टवत्॥ प्रविवेश ततो मध्यं नरसिंहः प्रतापवान्। तेषां महारथानां स मध्यं प्राप्य धनंजयः॥ चिक्रीड धनुषा राजैल्लक्षं कृत्वा महारथान्। ततो दुर्योधनो राजा भीष्ममाह जनेश्वरः॥ पीड्यमानं स्वकं सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा पार्थेन संयुगे। एष पाण्डुसुतस्तात कृष्णेन सहितो बली॥ यततां सर्वसैन्यानां मूलं नः परिकृन्तति। त्वयि जीवति गाङ्गेय द्रोणे च रथिनां वरे॥
en: With eighty sharp arrows, on seeing which your warriors were all very much delighted. Having heard the joyous shouts of the warriors, that foremost of car-warriors. O king, he sported with his bow aiming (with success) his arrows at those great car-warriors. Then, that ruler of men, Duryodhana, seeing his troops much afflicted by that son of Pandu, spoke thus to Bhishma, “O sire, O son of Ganga, this mighty Pandava, accompanied by Krishna, cuts down our roots by destroying our troops though you and that foremost of car-warriors, Drona, are alive.

sn: त्वत्कृते चैव कर्णोऽपि न्यस्तशस्त्रो विशाम्पते। न युध्यति रणे पार्थं हितकाम: सदा मम॥
en: O king, it is only for you that Karna has laid aside his weapons and does not fight with the son of Pritha, though he is a great friend of mine.

sn: स तथा कुरु गाङ्गेय यथा हन्येत फाल्गुनः। एवमुक्तस्ततो राजन् पिता देवव्रतस्तव।॥
en: O son of Ganga, therefore do that by which this Phalguna (Arjuna) might be killed”. O king, having been thus addressed, your father Devavrata.

sn: धिक् क्षात्रं धर्ममित्युक्त्वा प्रायात् पार्थरथं प्रति। उभौ श्वेतहयौ राजन् संसक्तौ प्रेक्ष्य पार्थिवाः॥ सिंहनादान् भृशं चक्रुः शङ्खान् दध्मुश्च मारिष। द्रौणिर्दुर्योधनश्चैव विकर्णश्च तवात्मजः॥
en: Said “Fie to Kshatriya usage” and then he went towards the car of Partha. O king, all the chiefs, then seeing both those two warriors face to face for fight with white horses yoked to their chariots, sent up a lion-like roar. They also blew their conchs. Then Drona's son and your son, Duryodhana and Vikarna.

sn: परिवार्य रणे भीष्मं स्थिता युद्धाय मारिष। तथैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे परिवार्य धनंजयम्॥ स्थिता युद्धाय महते ततो युद्धमवर्तत। गाङ्गेयस्तु रणे पार्थमानछेत्रवभिः शरैः॥
en: All stood, O sire, surrounding Bhishma in that great battle. So did the Pandavas also stand surrounding Dhananjaya in that fearful battle. The fight then began. The son of Ganga wounded Partha with nine arrows.

sn: तमर्जुनः प्रत्यविध्यद् दशभिर्मर्मभेदिभिः। ततः शरसहस्रेण सुप्रयुक्तेन पाण्डवः॥ अर्जुनः समरश्लाघी भीष्मस्यावारयद् दिशः। शरजालं ततस्तत् तु शरजालेन मारिष॥ वारयामास पार्थस्य भीष्मः शान्तनवस्तदा। उभौ परमसंहृष्टावुभौ युद्धाभिनन्दिनौ॥ निर्विशेषमयुध्येतां कृतप्रतिकृतैषिणौ। भीष्मचापविमुक्तानि शरजालानि संघसः॥ शीर्यमाणान्यदृश्यन्त भिन्नान्यर्जुनसायकैः। तथैवार्जुनमुक्तानि शरजालानि सर्वशः॥ गाङ्गेयशरनुन्नानि प्रापतन्त महीतले। अर्जुनः पञ्चविंशत्या भीष्ममाछैच्छितैः शरैः॥ भीष्मोऽपि समरे पार्थं विव्याध निशितैः शरैः।
en: Arjuna wounded him in return with ten arrows. Then with one thousand arrows wellshot, the Pandava Arjuna, ever celebrated for his skill in arms, covered Bhishma on all sides. That net of arrow of Partha, O king, was soon dispelled by another counter net of arrows shot by the son of Shantanu, Bhishma. Both being well pleased and both taking delight in battle fought with each other, none of them gaining any advantage over the other. The continuous downpour of arrows shot from Bhishma's bow were all baffled by those shot from the bow of Arjuna. So also the shower of arrows shot by Arjuna, was all cut down to the ground by the Ganga's son. Arjuna then wounded Bhishma with twenty five sharp arrows Bhishma also in that battle wounded Partha in return with very sharp arrows.

sn: अन्योन्यस्य हयान् विद्ध्वा ध्वजौ च सुमहाबलौ॥ रथेषां रथचक्रे च चिक्रीडतुररिंदमौ। ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज भीष्मः प्रहरतां वरः॥ वासुदेवं त्रिभिर्बाणैराजघान स्तनान्तरे। भीष्मचापच्युतैस्तैस्तु निर्विद्धो मधुसूदनः॥ विरराज रणे राजन् सुपष्प इव किंशुकः।
en: Those two great warriors, those two chastisers of foes, wounded each other's horses, and cut down each other's car-wheels and shafts. Then, O king, Bhishma, that best of heroes, struck Vasudeva on his breast with three arrows. O king, struck with three arrows the slayer of Madhu (Krishna) shone like a budded Kinshuka tree.

sn: ततोऽर्जुनो भृशं क्रुद्धो निर्विद्धं प्रेक्ष्य माधवम्॥ सारथिं कुरुवृद्धस्य निर्बिभेद शितैः शरैः। यतमानौ त तौ वीरावन्योन्यस्य वधं प्रति॥ न शक्नुतां तदाऽन्योन्यमभिसंधातुमाहवे। तौ मण्डलानि चित्राणि गतप्रत्यागतानि च॥ अदर्शयेतां बहुधा सूतसामर्थ्यलाघवात्। अन्तरं च प्रहारेषु तर्कयन्तौ परस्परम्॥ राजन्नन्तरमार्गस्थौ स्थितावास्तां मुहुर्मुहुः। उभौ सिंहरवोन्मित्रं शङ्खशब्दं च चक्रतुः॥
en: Then seeing Madhava thus pierced, Arjuna wounded the charioteer of the son of Ganga with three arrows. Trying to strike each other's charioteers, they could not take aim at each other in that fight. O king, for the great ability and dexterity of the charioteers of both those warriors, their cars made beautiful circle by advancing and retreating. O king, seeking opportunity to strike each other, they often changed their positions to take aim at each other. Both of them blew their conchs and often sent forth lion-like roars.

sn: तथैव चापनिर्घोषं चक्रतुस्तौ महारथौ। तयोः शङ्खनिनादेन रथनेमिस्वनेन च॥ दारिता सहसा भूमिश्चकम्पे च ननाद च। नोभयोरन्तरं कश्चिद् ददृशे भरतर्षभ।५८।।
en: With the sound of their conchs and the rattle of their car-wheels, the very earth appeared to be rent asunder. She began to tremble. Subterranean noise was heard. O foremost of the Bharata race, none could detect any defect in any of them.

sn: बलिनौ युद्धदुर्धर्षावन्योन्यसदृशावुभौ। चिह्नमात्रेण भीष्मं तु प्रजजुस्तत्र कौरवाः॥
en: Both of them possessed great prowess and great courage in battle. Each was other's match. Seeing his (Bhishma's) standard alone, the Kurus could come near him.

sn: तथा पाण्डुसुताः पार्थं चिह्नमात्रेण जज्ञिरे। तयोवरयोदृष्ट्वा तादृशं तं पराक्रमम्॥ विस्मयं सर्वभूतानि जग्मुर्भारत संयुगे। न तयोविवरं कश्चिद् रणे पश्यति भारत॥ धर्मेस्थितस्य हि यथा न कश्चिद् वृजिनं क्वचित्। उभौ च शरजालेन तावदृश्यौ बभूवतुः॥
en: So could the Pandavas also come to Partha by recognising his standard alone. O king, seeing the prowess thus displayed by those two foremost of men, O descendant of Bharata, all persons in that great battle were filled with wonder. None marked any difference between the two. Both of them were perfectly invisible by their continuous showers of arrows.

sn: प्रकाशौ च पुनस्तूर्णं बभूवतुरुभौ रणे। तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाश्चारणाश्चर्षिभिः सह॥ अन्योन्यं प्रत्यभाषन्त तयोर्दृष्ट्वा पराक्रमम्। न शक्यौ युधि संरब्धौ जेतुमेतौ कथञ्चन॥ सदेवासुरगन्धर्वैर्लोकैरपि महारथौ। आश्चर्यभूतं लोकेषु युद्धमेतन्महाद्भुतम्॥
en: Soon again both of them became visible. Seeing their great prowess, the Gandharvas, the Charanas, the great Rishis and the celestials thus spoke to one another, “Those (two) great car-warriors, when angry, are incapable of being vanquished cven by all the worlds including the celestials, the Gandharvas and the Asuras. This exceedingly wonderful battle will be considered wonderful by all the worlds”.

sn: नेतादृशानि युद्धानि भविष्यन्ति कथश्चन। न हि शक्यो रणे जेतुं भीष्मः पार्थेन धीमता॥ सधनुः सरथः साश्वः प्रवपन् सायकान् रणे। तथैव पाण्डवं युद्धे देवैरपि दुरासदम्॥ न विजेतुं रणे भीष्म उत्सहेत धनुर्धरम्। आलोकादपि युद्धं हि सममेतद् भविष्यति॥
en: Such a battle as this will never take place again. Bhishma is incapable of being vanquished in battle by the greatly wise Partha though he showers his arrows on the bow, car and steed of the forms. So also is that great bowman, the Pandava (Arjuna), incapable of being vanquished in battle by even the celestials. Bhishma is not competent to defeat him. As long as the world would last, so long would this battle be fought equally on both the sides.

sn: इति स्म वाचोऽश्रूयन्त प्रोच्चरन्त्यस्ततस्ततः। गाङ्गेयार्जुनयोः संख्ये स्तवयुक्ता विशाम्पते॥
en: O king, we heard these words full of praise of both the son of Ganga and the son of Pritha.

sn: त्वदीयास्तु तदा योधाः पाण्डवेयाश्च भारत। अन्योन्यं समरे जनुस्तयोस्तत्र पराक्रमे॥ शितधारैस्तथा खड्नेविमलैश्च परश्वधैः। शरैरन्यैश्च बहुभिः शस्त्रैर्नानाविधैरपि॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, when these two were fighting with each other warriors of your side and of that of the Pandavas killed one another with sharp swords and polished battleaxes, with innumerable arrows and various kinds of other weapons.

sn: उभयोः सेनयोः शूरा न्यकृन्तन्त परस्परम्। वर्तमाने तथा घोरे तस्मिन् युद्धे सुदारुणे। द्रोणपाञ्चाल्ययो राजन् महानासीत् समागमः॥
en: So long that fearful battle continued, heroic warriors of both sides cut one another down. O king, the battle that was fought between Drona and the Panchala prince was also very fearful.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं द्रोणो महेष्वासः पाञ्चाल्यश्चापि पार्षतः। उभौ समीतयुर्यत्तौ तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, tell me how that great bowman Drona and the Panchala prince, the scion of the Prishata race, fought with each other in that great battle.

sn: दिष्टमेव परं मन्ये पौरुषादिति मे मतिः। यत्र शान्तनवो भीष्मो नातरद् युधि पाण्डवम्॥
en: When Shantanu's son, Bhishma, could not escape the son of Pandu (Arjuna) in battle, O Sanjaya, I consider Destiny to be supreme over exertion.

sn: भीष्मो हि समरे क्रुद्धो हन्याल्लोकांश्चराचरान्। स कथं पाण्डवं युद्धे नातरत् संजयौजसा॥
en: When enraged in battle Bhishma could destroy all the mobile and immobile creatures; O Sanjaya, why could he not then escape the Pandava (Arjuna) in battle with his great prowess?

sn: संजय उवाच शृणु राजन् स्थिरो भूत्वा युद्धमेतत् सुदारुणम्। न शक्याः पाण्डवा जेतुं देवैरपि सवासवैः॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, hear about this fearful battle. The son of Pandu (Arjuna) is incapable of being vanquished by even the celestials with Indra at their head.

sn: द्रोणस्तु निशितैर्बाणैधृष्टद्युम्नमविध्यत। सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपातयत्॥
en: With various kinds of arrows, Drona wounded Dhrishtadyumna and he cut down his charioteer from his place on the car.

sn: तथाऽस्य चतुरो वाहांश्चतुर्भिः सायकोत्तमैः। पीडयामास संक्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नस्य मारिष॥
en: O sire, the angry warrior, (Drona) also with four arrows, wounded the four excellent horses of Dhrishtadyumna.

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्ततो द्रोणं नवत्या निशितैः शरैः। विव्याध प्रहसन् वीरस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: The brave Dhrishtadyumna also wounded Drona with nine sharp arrows, exclaiming “Wait" "Wait".

sn: ततः पुनरमेयात्मा भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। शरैः प्रच्छादयामास धृष्टद्युम्नममर्षणम्॥
en: Thereupon the greatly powerful and high souled son of Bharadvaja (Drona) covered with his arrows the angry Dhrishtadyumna.

sn: आददे च शरं घोरं पार्षतान्तचिकीर्षया। शक्राशनिसमस्पर्श कालदण्डमिवापरम्॥
en: He then took up a terrible arrow for the destruction of the Prishata prince. It resembled in force the thunder-bolt of Shakra. It looked like a second rod of Yama.

sn: हाहाकारो महानासीत् सर्वसैन्येषु भारत। तमिषु संधितं दृष्ट्वा भारद्वाजेन संयुगे॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, seeing that arrow aimed by the son of Bharadvaja, all the troops cried "Oh" and "Alas".

sn: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम धृष्टद्युम्नस्य पौरुषम्। यदेकः समरे वीरस्तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥
en: But we then saw the great prowess of Dhrishtadyumna. He stood immovable like a mountain in that battle.

sn: तं च दीप्तं शरं घोरमायान्तं मृत्युमात्मनः। चिच्छेदं शरवृष्टिं च भारद्वाजे मुमोच ह॥
en: He cut down that terrible and blazing arrow which was rushing towards him like his own death. He then poured a shower of arrows on the son of Bharadvaja.

sn: तत उच्चुक्रुशुः सर्वे पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह। धृष्टद्युम्नेन तत् कर्म कृतं दृष्ट्वा सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Seeing that very great difficult feat achieved by Dhrishtadyumna, the Panchalas and the Pandavas were all filled with delight. They, again and again, sent forth loud shouts.

sn: ततः शक्तिं महावेगां स्वर्णवैदूर्यभूषिताम्। द्रोणस्य निधनाकाक्षी चिक्षेप स पराक्रमी॥
en: Then with the desire of killing him, that greatly powerful prince shot at Drona a dart of great force adorned with gold and Vaidurya gems.

sn: तामापतन्ती सहसा शक्तिं कनकभूषिताम्। त्रिधा चिच्छेद समरे भारद्वाजो हसन्निव॥
en: Thereupon the son of Bharadvaja smilingly cut down into three parts that dart adorned with gold and gems that was coming towards him with great force.

sn: शक्तिं विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान्। ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि द्रोणं प्रति जनेश्वर॥
en: O king, having seen his dart thus baffled, and greatly powerful Dhrishtadyumna poured a shower of arrows on Drona.

sn: शरवर्षं ततस्तत् तु संनिवार्य महायशाः। मध्ये चिच्छेद कार्मुकम्॥
en: Then that great car-warrior, Drona, baffling that shower of arrows, cut off the bow of the son of Drupada at a favourable opportunity.

sn: स च्छिन्नधन्वा समरे गदां गुर्वी महायशाः। द्रोणाय प्रेषयामास गिरिसारमयीं बली॥
en: When his bow was thus cut off in that battle, that highly and illustrious warriors hurled on Drona a mace with the firmness of a mountain.

sn: सा गदा वेगवन्मुक्ता प्रायाद् द्रोणजिघांसया। तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम भारद्वाजस्य विक्रमम्॥
en: Having been thus hurled by his hand, that fearful mace flew through the sky for the destruction of Drona. Then again we saw the wonderful prowess of Bharadvaja's son.

sn: द्रोणो दुपदपुत्रस्य लाघवाद् व्यंसयामास गदां हेमविभूषिताम्। व्यंसयित्वा गदां तां च प्रेषयामास पार्षतम्॥ भल्लान् सुनिशितान् पीतान् रुक्मपुंखान् सुदारुणान्। ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा पपुः शोणितमाहवे॥
en: He baffled that mace decked with gold, and having baffled it, he shot at the Prishata prince many sharp arrows well tempered, and furnished with golden wings. Penetrating the armour of the Prishata prince, they drank his blood.

sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः। द्रोणं युधि पराक्रम्य शरैर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः॥
en: Then the illustrious Dhrishtadyumna took up another bow, and with all his strength he wounded Drona with five arrows.

sn: रुधिराक्तौ ततस्तौ तु शुशुभाते नरर्षभौ। वसन्तसमये राजन् पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ॥
en: Then those two foremost of men, covered with blood, looked as beautiful as the Kinshuka flowers in spring.

sn: अमर्षितस्ततो राजन् पराक्रम्य चमूमुखे। द्रोणो द्रुपदपुत्रस्य पुनश्चिच्छेद कार्मुकम्॥ अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। अभ्यवर्षदमेयात्मा वृष्ट्या मेघ इवाचलम्॥
en: Then that high-souled hero, (Drona) cut down his bow and with countless arrows covered the Prishata prince (Dhrishtadyumna) on all sides as clouds shower rains on a mountain.

sn: सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपातयत्। अथास्य चतुरो वाहांश्चतुर्भिनिशितैः शरैः॥ पातयामास समरे सिंहनादं ननाद च। ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन हस्ताच्चापमथाच्छिनत्॥
en: He felled his adversary's charioteer from his place, he also cut down his four horses with four sharp arrows. With another arrows he cut off the leathern fence of Dhrishtadyumna's hand.

sn: स च्छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः। गदापाणिरवारोहत् ख्यापयन् पौरुषं महत्॥
en: When his bow was thus cut down again, when he was thus deprived of his car and when his steeds were thus killed and his charioteer overthrown, the Panchala prince, displaying great prowess, jumped down from his car with a mace in hand.

sn: तामस्य विशिखैस्तूर्णं पातयामास भारत। रथादनवरूढस्य तदद्भूतमिवाभवत्॥
en: But, O descendant of Bharata, before he could come down from his car, Drona cut down his mace into may fragments. It was a wonderful feat.

sn: ततः स विपुलं चर्म शतचन्द्रं च भानुमत्। खङ्गं च विपुलं दिव्यं प्रगृह्य सुभुजो बली।॥
en: Then the mighty armed Panchala prince took up a large and beautiful shelf decked with hundred (golden) moons and also a large sword of excellent make.

sn: अभिदुद्राव वेगेन द्रोणस्य वधकाझया। आमिषार्थी यथा सिंहो वने मत्तमिव द्विपम्॥
en: He, then with great impetuosity, rushed towards Drona with the intention of killing hiin, as a hungry lion runs towards a mad elephant in the forest.

sn: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम भारद्वाजस्य पौरुषम्। लाघवं चास्त्रयोगं च बलं बाह्वोश्च भारत॥ यदेनं शरवर्षेण वारयामास पार्षतम्। न शशाक ततो गन्तुं बलवानपि संयुगे॥
en: Then we again saw the wonderful prowess of Bharadvaja's son, wonderful was the lightness of hands in using the weapon, and also his strength of arms. He alone checked the Prishata prince with a shower of arrows. Though he possessed great prowess, he could not proceed further.

sn: निवीरितस्तु द्रोणेन धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः। न्यवारयच्छरौघांस्तांश्चर्मणा कृतहस्तवत्॥
en: We then saw that the great car-warrior Dhrishtadyumna stood where he was. He warded off those showers of arrows using his arms with great dexterity.

sn: ततो भीमो महाबाहुः सहसाऽभ्यपतद् बली। साहाय्यकारी समरे पार्षतस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Then the greatly strong and mighty Bhimasena soon came there with the desire of helping the Prishata prince in that combat.

sn: स द्रोणं निशितैर्बाणै राजन् विव्याध सप्तभिः। पार्षतं च रथं तूर्णं स्वकमारोहयत् तदा॥
en: O king, he wounded Drona with seven sharp arrows. He soon took up the Prishata prince on a car.

sn: ततो दुर्योधनो राजन् भानुमन्तमचोदयत्। सैन्येन महता युक्तं भारद्वाजस्य रक्षणे॥
en: Then king Duryodhana asked the ruler of Kalinga to go to the rescue of Bharadvaja's son with a large number of troops.

sn: ततः सा महती सेना कलिङ्गानां जनेश्वर। भीममभ्युद्ययौ तूर्णं तव पुत्रस्य शासनात्॥
en: O lord of men, then those countless Kalingas rushed against Bhima at the command of your son.

sn: पाञ्चाल्यमथं संत्यज्य द्रोणोऽपि रथिनां वरः। विराटदुपदौ वृद्धौ वारयामास संयुगे।॥
en: Then that foremost of car-warriors Drona abandoned the Panchala prince and met Virata and Drupada both together.

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नोऽपि समरे धर्मराजानमभ्ययात्। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna then went to support Yudhishthira in battle. Then a fearful and hair stirring battle was fought.

sn: कलिङ्कानां च समरे भीमस्य च महात्मनः। जगतः प्रक्षयकरं घोररूपं भयावहम्॥
en: Between the Kalingas and the illustrious Bhima, a battle which was fearful and all destroying.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तथा प्रतिसमादिष्टः कालिङ्गो वाहिनीपतिः। कथमद्भुतकर्माणं भीमसेनं महाबलम्॥ चरन्तं गदया वीरं दण्डहस्तमिवान्तकम्। योधयामास समरे कालिङ्गः सह सेनया॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How did the Kalinga king, that commander of a large army, having been asked by my son and supported by his troops, fight in battle with that doer of wonderful deeds, the mighty Bhimasena, that hero who roved over the field of battle with his club?

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: संजय उवाच पुत्रेण तव राजेन्द्र स तथोक्तो महाबलः। महत्या सेनया गुप्तः प्रायाद् भीमरथं प्रति॥
en: Sanjaya said O great king, thus asked by your son the mighty Kalinga king accompanied by large army, advanced towards the chariot of Bhima.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: तामापतन्ती महती कलिङ्गानां महाचमूम्। स्थाश्वनागकलिलां प्रगृहीतमहायुधाम्॥ भीमसेनः कलिङ्गानामाझेद् भारत वाहिनीम्। केतुमन्तं च नैषादिमायान्तं सह चेदिभिः॥
en: Odescendant of Bharata, Bhimasena, then supported by the Chedis, rushed towards that large and mighty Kalinga army consisting of many cars, horses, and elephants. It was armed with great weapons. It was advancing towards him with Ketumat, the son of the Nishada king, at its head.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: ततः श्रुतायुः संक्रुद्धो राज्ञा केतुमता सह। आससाद रणे भीमं व्यूढानीकेषु चेदिषु॥
en: Inflamed in anger, Shrutayu, clad in armour, followed by his troops in battle array and accompanied by king Ketumat, came in front of Bhima.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: रथैरनेकसाहौः कलिङ्गानां नराधिप। अयुतेन गजानां च निषादैः स केतुमान्॥
en: The Kalinga king with many thousands cars, and Ketumat with ten thousand elephants and also the Nishadas.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: भीमसेनं रणे राजन् समन्तात् पर्यवारयत्। चेदिमत्स्यकरूषाश्च भीमसेनपदानुगाः॥
en: All, O king, surrounded Bhimasena on all sides. Then the Chedis, the Matsyas, and the Karushas with Bhimasena at their head,

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: अभ्यधावन्त समरे निषादान् सह राजभिः। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं घोररूपं भयावहम्॥
en: And with many other kings, rushed with great force against the Nishadas. Then took place a fearful and terrible battle.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: न प्राजानन्त योधाः स्वान् परस्परजिघांसया। घोरमासीत् ततो युद्धं भीमस्य सहसा परैः॥
en: Between the warriors of booth the sides, all rushing forward with the desire to kill one another. Fearful was the battle that was fought between Bhima and his adversaries.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: यथेन्द्रस्य महाराज महत्या दैत्यसेनया। तस्य सैन्यस्य संग्रामे युध्यमानस्य भारत॥ बभूव सुमहान् शब्दः सागरस्येव गर्जतः। अन्योन्यं स्म तदा योधा विकर्षन्तो विशाम्पते॥ महीं चक्रुश्चितां सर्वां शशलोहितसंनिभाम्। योधांश्च स्वान् परान् वापि नाभ्यजानञ्जिघांसया॥
en: O great king, it resembled the battle that was fought between Indra and the great host of the Danavas. O descendant of Bharata, loud uproar rose from that mighty army fighting in that battle. It resembled the sound of the roaring ocean. O king, they cut down one another and made the whole field resemble a crematorium strewn with flesh and blood. Impelled by the desire to kill, they could not distinguish friends from foes.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: स्वानप्याददते स्वाश्च शूराः परमदुर्जयाः। विमर्दः सुमहानासीदल्पानां बहुभिः सह॥
en: Those brave warriors who were incapable of being easily defeated, cut down even their own friends. Fierce was the struggle that took place between the few and the many.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: कलिङ्गैः सह चेदीनां निषादैश्च विशाम्पते। कृत्वा पुरुषकारं तु यथाशक्ति महाबलाः॥
en: Between the Chedis and the Kalingas with the Nishadas, Displaying their prowess to the best of their power, the powerful.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: भीमसेनं परित्यज्य संन्यवर्तन्त चेदय। सर्वैः कलिङ्गैरासन्नः संनिवृत्तेषु चेदिषु॥ स्वबाहुबलमास्थाय संन्यवर्तत पाण्डवः। न चचाल रथोपस्थाद् भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: Chedis abandoned Bhimasena and turned back. When the Chedis turned back, that son of Pandu, Bhimsena met all the Kalingas. He did not turn back depending on the strength of his own arms. The greatly powerful Bhimasena did not move; from his car.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: शितैरवाकिरद् बाणैः कलिङ्गानां वरूथिनीम्। कालिङ्गस्तु महेष्वासः पुत्रश्चास्य महारथः॥
en: He covered the Kalingas with showers of sharp arrows. Then that great bowman, the Kalinga king and that car-warriors, his son.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: शक्रदेव इति ख्यातो जनतुः पाण्डवं शरैः। ततो भीमो महाबाहुर्विधुन्वन् रुचिरं धनुः॥
en: Named Shakradeva, both attacked the Pandava (Bhima) with ten arrows. But shaking his beautiful bow. the mighty armed Bhimasena.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: योधयामास कालिङ्गं स्वबाहुबलमाश्रितः। शक्रदेवस्तु समरे विसृजन् सायकान् बहून्॥
en: Fought with the Kalinga king, depending only on his own prowess of arms. Shakradeva shot innumerable arrows in that battle.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: अश्वाञ्जधान समरे भीमसेनस्य सायकैः। तं दृष्ट्वा विस्थं तत्र भीमसेनमरिंदमम्॥
en: And killed Bhimasena's horses with them. Seeing that chastiser of foes deprived of his car.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: शक्रदेवोऽभिदुद्राव शरैरवकिरशितैः। भीमस्योपरि राजेन्द्र शक्रदेवो महाबलः॥ ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि तपान्ते जलदो यथा।
en: Shakradeva rushed upon him; and shot many sharp arrows, O great king, on Bhimasena; the mighty Shakradeva poured a shower of arrows as clouds pour rain after the summer is gone.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: हताश्वे तु रथे तिष्ठन् भीमसेनो महाबलः॥ शक्रदेवाय चिक्षेप सर्वशैक्यायसीं गदाम्।
en: But the greatly strong Bhima stayed on that car, the horses of which had been killed. He hurled from it at Shakradeva a mace made of the hardest iron.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: स तया निहतो राजन् कालिङ्गत्तनयो रथात्॥ सध्वजः सह सूतेन जगाम धरणीतलम्।
en: Killed by that fearful mace, O king, the son of the Kalinga king fell down with his standard and charioteer.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: हतमात्मसुतं दृष्ट्वा कलिङ्गानां जनाधिपः॥ रथैरनेकसाहस्रीमस्यावारयद् दिशः। ततो भीमो महावेगां त्यक्त्वा गुर्वी महागदाम्॥ निस्त्रिंशमाददे घोरं चिकीर्षुः कर्म दारुणम्। चर्म चाप्रतिमं राजन्नार्षभं पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Then that great car-warrior the Kalinga king, seeing his son killed. Surrounded Bhima on all sides with innumerable troops, then the greatly strong and mighty armed Bhima took up a sword with the desire of performing a great feat. O king, that foremost of men also took up a matchless shield made of the hide of a bull.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: नक्षत्रैरर्धचन्दैश्च शातकुम्भमयैश्चितम्। कालिङ्गस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो धनुामवमृज्य च॥ प्रगृह्य च शरं घोरमेकं सर्पविषोपमम्। प्राहिणोद् भीमसेनाय वधाकाङ्क्षी जनेश्वरः॥
en: It was adorned with stars and crescents made of gold. The Kalinga king also in great anger rubbed his bow string and took up a poisoned Shakti. He shot it at Bhimasena with the desire of killing him.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: तमापतन्तं वेगेन प्रेरितं निशितं शरम्। भीमसेनो द्विधा राजंश्चिच्छेद विपुलासिना॥
en: O king, Bhimsena however soon with his big sword cut down that sharp arrow which was rushing towards him with great impetuosity.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: उदक्रोशच्च संहृष्टस्त्रासयानो वरूथिनीम्। कालिङ्गोऽथ ततः क्रुद्धो भीमसेनाय संयुगे॥
en: He then a great delight sent up a loud shout which filed the troops with terror. The Kalinga king, being very much enraged in fighting with Bhimasena.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: तोमरान् प्राहिणोच्छीघ्रं चतुर्दश शिलाशितान्। तानप्राप्तान् महाबाहुः खगतानेव पाण्डवः॥ चिच्छेद सहसा राजन्नसम्भ्रान्तो वरासिना। निकृत्य तु रणे भीमस्तोमरान् वै चतुर्दश॥
en: Soon hurled upon his fourteen darts with heads made of stone. The mighty armed Pandava (Bhima) soon cut them down into many fragments, O king, before they could reach him. Having cut down in that battle those fourteen arrows Bhima,

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: भानुन्मतं ततो भीमः प्राद्रवत् पुरुषर्षभः। भानुमांस्तु ततो भीमं शरवर्षेण च्छादयन्॥ ननाद बलवन्नादं नादयानो नभस्तलम्। न च तं ममृषे भीमः सिंहनादं महाहवे॥
en: That foremost of men, on seeing Bhanumat rushed upon him. Bhanumat thereupon covered Bhima with a shower of arrows. He set up a loud shout making the sky resound with it. Bhima however could not bear that lion-like shout in that battle.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: ततः शब्देन महता विननाद महास्वनः। तेन नादेन वित्रस्ता कलिङ्गानां वरूथिनी॥
en: Possessing as he does a fearfully loud voice, he also sent up a very loud shout. At his fearful shouts, the Kalingas were filled with great alarm.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: न भीमं समरे मेने मानुषं भरतर्षभ। ततो भीमो महाबाहुर्नर्दित्वा विपुलं स्वनम्॥
en: O best of men, they no longer considered Bhima as a human being. O king of kings, then setting up a loud shout, Bhima.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: सासिर्वेगवदाप्लुत्य दन्ताभ्या वारणोत्तमम्। आरुरोह ततो मध्यं नागराजस्य मारिष॥ ततो मुमोच कालिङ्गः शक्तिं तामकरोद् द्विधा। खङ्गेन पृथुना मध्ये भानुमन्तमथाच्छिनत्॥
en: With a sword in his hand, jumped upon the excellent elephant (of Bhanumat); and with the help of the tusk of that great elephant, he got on its back. Then with his huge sword, he cut down Bhanumat in two distinct parts. Having killed the Kalinga prince, that chastiser of foes,

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: सोऽन्तरायुधिनं हत्वा राजपुत्रमरिंदमः। गुरुं भारसहं स्कन्धे नागस्यासिमपातयत्॥
en: made his huge sword, which was capable of bearing a great strain, descend on the neck of the elephant. His head thus cut off, that great elephant fell with a tremendous roar,

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: छिन्नस्कन्धः स विनदन् पपात गजयूथपः। आरुग्णः सिन्धुवेगेन सानुमानिव पर्वतः॥ ततस्तस्मादवप्लुत्य गजाद् भारत भारतः।
en: As a mountain peak falls when eaten up by (the waves of the) sea. O descendant of Bharata, jumping down from that falling elephant, that descendant of Bharata.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: खड्गपाणिरदीनात्मा तस्थौ भूमौ सुदंशितः॥ स चचार बहून् मार्गानभितः पातयन् गजान्। अग्निचक्रमिवाविद्धं सर्वतः प्रत्यदृश्यत॥ अश्ववृन्देषु नागेषु रथानीकेषु चाभिभूः। पदातीनां च संघेषु विनिमशोणितोक्षितः॥ श्येनवद् व्यचरद् भीमो रणेऽरिषु बलोत्कटः। छिन्दस्तेषां शरीराणि शिरांसि च महाबलः॥ खड्गेन शितधारेण संयुगे गजयोधिनाम्।
en: Clad in armour, stood on the ground with his sword in his hand. Cutting down many elephants on all sides, he roved about making his way (through the troops of the enemy). He appeared to be like a moving wheel of fire. He slaughtered innumerable horsemen, elephants and car-warriors and foot soldiers. That foremost of men, the mighty Bhima was seen to move about the field with the speed of the hawk, cutting off with his sharp sword the bodies and heads of countless men (on foot) and also of those who were on elephant.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: पदातिरेकः संक्रुद्धः शत्रूणां भयवर्धनः॥ सम्मोहयामास स तान् कालान्तकयमोपमः।
en: Thus fighting on foot in great rage like Yama himself at the universal dissolution, he struck terror into the hearts of his enemies. Those brave warriors all became confounded.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: मूढाश्च ते तमेवाजौ विनदन्तः समाद्रवन्॥ सासिमुत्तमवेगेन विचरन्तं महारणे।
en: Only those that were foolish came rushing at him who was roving about that field of battle with sword in his hand.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: निकृत्य रथिनां चाजौ रथेषाश्च युगानि च॥ जघान रथिनश्चापि बलवान् रिपुमर्दनः।
en: That mighty chastiser of foes, cut off the shafts and yokes of those warriors on their cars, and he then killed them.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: भीमसेनश्चरन् मार्गान् सुबहून् प्रत्यदृश्यत॥ भ्रान्तमाविद्धमुद्धान्तमाप्लुतं प्रसृतं प्लुतम्।
en: O descendant of Bharata, Bhimasena was seen to display various kinds of motions. He wheeled about and whirled about on high. He made side-thrusts, jumped forward, ran above and leapt high.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: सम्पातं समुदीर्णं च दर्शयामास पाण्डवः॥ केचिदचासिना छिन्नाः पाण्डवेन महात्मना।
en: O descendant of Bharata, he was seen to rush forward and rush upward. Some, mangled by that illustrious son of Pandu with his sword,

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: विनेदुर्भिन्नमर्माणो निपेतुश्च गतासवः॥ छिन्नदन्ताग्रहस्ताश्च भिन्नकुम्भास्तथा परे। वियोधाः स्वान्यनीकानि जघ्नुर्भारत वारणाः॥ निपेतुरुवा॒ च तथा विनदन्तो महारवान्।
en: Shrieked aloud; some mortally wounded, fell down and was killed. O descendant of Bharata, many elephants some with their trunks and the tusks cut off, others with their temporal globes cut open, fell down uttering fearful cries.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: छिन्नांश्च तोमरान् राजन् महामात्यशिरांसि च॥ परिस्तोमान् विचित्रांश्च कक्ष्याश्च कनकोज्ज्वलाः। चैवेयाण्यथ शक्तीश्च पताकाः कणपांस्तथा॥ तूणीरानथ यन्त्राणि विचित्राणि धनूंषि च। भिन्दिपालानि शुभ्राणि तोत्राणि चाकुशैः सह॥ घण्टाश्च विविधा राजन् हेमग स्त्सरूनपि। पततः पातितांश्चैव पश्यामः सह सादिभिः॥ छिन्नगात्रावरकरैनिहतैश्चापि वारणैः। आसीद् भूमिः समास्तार्णा पतितैर्भूधरैरिव॥
en: O king, broken lances, heads of elephantsdrivers, beautiful housing of elephants, chords as shining as gold, collars darts, mallets, quivers, various kinds of machines, beautiful bows, short arrows with polished heads, hooks and screws various sorts of bells and belts decked with gold, these were seen falling or already fallen on the field of battle. With elephants having the fore parts and hind parts of their bodies and trunks cut off or entirely killed, the battle field appeared to be strewn with fallen cliffs.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: विमृद्यैवं महानागान् ममर्दान्यान् महाबलः। अश्वारोहवरादंश्चैव पातयामास संयुगे॥
en: Having thus killed many huge elephants that foremost of men then began to destroy the horses. O descendant of Bharata, that hero felled many foremost of horse-men.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: तद् घोरमभवद् युद्धं तस्य तेषां च भारत। खलीनान्यथ योक्त्राणि कक्ष्याश्च कनकोज्ज्वलाः॥ परिस्तोमाश्च प्रासाश्च ऋष्टयश्च महाधनाः। कवचान्यथ चर्माणि चित्राण्यास्तरणानि च॥ तत्र तत्रापविद्धानि व्यदृश्यन्त महाहवे।
en: O sire, that battle was fought between him and those soldiers was exceedingly fearful. Hilts, traces, golden saddles girths, covers for the horses, bearded darts costly swords, armours, shields, and beautiful ornaments, were seen by us strewn over the ground in that great battle.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: प्रासैर्यन्त्रैविंचित्रैश्च शस्त्रैश्च विमलैस्तथा॥ स चक्रे वसुधां कीर्णां शबलैः कुसुमैरिव। आप्लुत्य रथिनः कांश्चित् परामृश्य महाबलः॥ पातयामास खड्ड्रेन सध्वजानपि पाण्डवः।
en: He caused the earth to be covered with blood, thus making her look as if she were variegated with lilies. The might Pandava, jumping high and dragging down some carwarriors, cut them down with their standards.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: मुहुरुत्पततो दिक्षु धावतश्च यशस्विनः॥ मार्गाश्च चरतश्चित्रं व्यस्मयन्त रणे जनाः। स जघान पदा कांश्चिद् व्याक्षिप्यान्यानपोथयत्॥
en: Often jumping up and frequently rushing on all sides, that greatly powerful hero roved about and filled all the troops with wonder. Some he killed by his legs, some he dragged down and pressed them into the earth,

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: खङ्गेनान्यांश्च चिच्छेद नादेनान्यांश्च भीषयन्। उरुवेगेन चाप्यन्यान् पातयामास भूतले॥
en: Others he cut down with his sword, others again he frightened with his terrible roars. Others he threw down by the force of his thighs.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: अपरे चैनमालोक्य भायत् पञ्चत्वमागताः। एवं सा बहुला सेना कलिङ्गानां तरस्विनाम्॥ परिवार्य रणे भीष्मं भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत्। तत: कालिङ्गसैन्यानां प्रमुखे भरतर्षभ।६७॥ श्रुतायुषमभिप्रेक्ष्य भीमसेनः समभ्ययात्। तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य कालिङ्गो नवभिः शरैः॥ भीमसेनममेयात्मा प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे। कालिङ्गबाणाभिहतस्तोत्रादित इव द्विपः॥
en: Others again fled away on simply seeing him. It was thus that the great and powerful army of the Kalingas surrounded Bhimasena and rushed upon him. O best of the Bharata race, seeing, the Shrutayu at the head of the Kalinga troops, Bhimasena rushed at him. Seeing Shrutayu at the head of the Kalinga troops Bhimsena rushed at him. Seeing him come, the Kalinga king wounded Bhimasena with nine arrows. Wounded by those arrows shot by the Kalinga king, like an elephant pierced by the hook.

description: The death of the Kalinga king
sn: भीमसेनः प्रजज्वाल क्रोधेनाग्निरिवैधितः। अथाशोकः समादाय रथं हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥ भीमं सम्पादयामास रथेन रथसारथिः। तमारुह्य रथं तूर्णं कौन्तेयः शत्रुसूदनः॥
