sn: यदा च त्वां महाबाहो गन्धर्वैर्हतमोजसा। अमोचयत् पाण्डुसुतः पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: When, O mighty-armed hero, that son of Pandu released, with force, you captured by the Gandharvas, that indeed, is indication enough (of his prowess)

sn: द्रवमाणेषु शूरेषु सोदरेषु तव प्रभो सूतपुत्रे च राधेये पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: On that occasion when your uterine brothers of great heroism, as also, O lord, Radha's son of Suta race had fled forsaking you, the rescue effected by Arjuna is indeed indication enough of his prowess.

sn: यच्च नः सहितान् सर्वान् विराटनगरे तदा। एक एव समुद्यातः पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: That in the kingdom of Virata, singlehanded, he encountered our assembled host is indication enough.

sn: द्रोणं च युधि संरब्धं मां च निर्जित्य संयुगे। वासांसि स समादत्त पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: That vanquishing the wrathful Drona and myself in battle, he succeeded in taking off our raiment's, is indication enough.

sn: तथा द्रौणि महेष्वासं शारद्वतमथापि च। गोग्रहे जितवान् पूर्वं पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: That he conquered the great bowman, the son of Drona as also the son of Sharadvata on the occasion of the capture of the capture of Virata's kine, is indeed indication enough.

sn: विजित्य च यदा कर्णं सदा पुरुषमानिनम्। उत्तरायै ददौ वस्त्रं पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: That conquering Karna ever bragging of his manliness, he gave robes to Uttara is a sufficient indication.

sn: निवातकवचान् युद्धे वासवेनापि दुर्जयान्। जितवान् समरे पार्थः पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: That the son of Pritha vanquished in battle the Nivatakavacha brothers difficult of vanquishment by Indra himself is indication enough of his velour.

sn: को हि शक्तो रणे जेतुं पाण्डवं रभसं तदा। यस्य गोप्ता जगद्गोप्ता शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः॥
en: What man is capable of conquering the mighty son of Pandu, who is protected by the Protector of the worlds, the wielder of the conch, discus and the mace divine.

sn: वासुदेवोऽनन्तशक्तिः सृष्टिसंहारकारकः। सर्वेश्वरो देवदेवः परमात्मा सनातनः॥
en: The son of Vasudeva is of infinite prowess, and is the Destroyer of this creation. He is the Lord of all, the God of Gods, the Supreme Soul and Eternal.

sn: उक्तोऽसि बहुशो राजन् नारदाद्यैर्महर्षिभिः। त्वं तु मोहान्न जानीषे वाच्यावाच्यं सुयोधन॥
en: Diversely, O king, has He been described by Narada and other illustrious sages. But through your folly, O Suyodhana, you do not seem to recognise what you should do and what you should not.

sn: मुमूर्षुर्हि नरः सर्वान् वृक्षान् पश्यति काञ्चनान्। तथा त्वमपि गान्धारे विपरीतानि पश्यसि॥
en: A man on the brink of death sees everything to be made of gold; so also, O son of Gandhari, you see everything to be invested with a yellow hue.

sn: स्वयं वैरं महत् कृत्वा पाण्डवैः सह संजयैः। युद्ध्यस्व तानन रणे पश्यामः पुरुषो भव॥
en: You have yourself sowed implacably enmity between yourself on the one side and the Pandavas and Srinjayas on the other. Let us now see you fight with them in battle. Display your manliness.

sn: अहं तु सोमकान् सर्वान् पञ्चालांश्च समागतान्। निहनिष्ये नरव्याघ्र वर्जयित्वा शिखण्डिनम्॥
en: I, however, O foremost of men, shall slay the assembled Panchalas and Somakas excepting only Shikhandin.

sn: तैर्वाऽहं निहत: संख्ये गमिष्ये यमसादनम्। तान् वा निहत्य समरे प्रीतिं दास्याम्यहं तव॥
en: Either slain by them in battle, I shall go to the mansion of Death or slaying them I shall afford delight to you.

sn: पूर्वं हि स्त्री समुत्पन्ना शिखण्डी राजवेश्मनि। वरदानात् पुमाञ्जातः सैषा वै स्त्री शिखण्डिनी॥
en: In the palace of Draupada, Shikhandin was first born as a woman; then through the virtue of a boon he became a male being. This one is the Shikhandin of old.

sn: तमहं न हनिष्यामि प्राणत्यागेऽपि भारत! याऽसौ प्रानिर्मिता धात्रा सैषा वै स्त्री शिखण्डिनी।।
en: Even if I were to loose my life, O Bharata, I shall not slay him. This now is the same Shikhandin whom the creator made a female.

sn: सुखं स्वपिहि गान्धारे श्वोऽपि कर्ता महारणम्। यं जनाः कथयिष्यन्ति यावत् स्थास्यति मेदिनी॥
en: Pass the night in tranquil sleep, O son of Gandhari; tomorrow I shall fight a terrible fight, of which men shall speak so long as the earth will endure."

sn: एवमुक्तस्तव सुतो निर्जगाम जनेश्वर। अभिवाद्य गुरुं मूर्धा प्रययौ स्वं निवेशनम्॥
en: This spoken to, your son, O ruler of men, came out and saluting the reverend signor, with his head, he (your son) replied to his own tent.

sn: आगम्य तु ततो राजा विसृज्य च महाजनम्। प्रविवेश ततस्तूर्णं क्षयं शत्रुक्षयङ्करः॥
en: Thereafter the king reaching his own tent, and ordering his illustrious officers to retire, that destroyer of foes entered his own camp.

sn: प्रविष्टः स निशां तां च गमयामास पार्थिवः। प्रभातायां च शर्वर्यां प्रातरुत्थाय तान् नृपः॥
en: There in his tent that ruler of men passed the night. When the night had passed away, the king, rising at the break of day,

sn: राज्ञः समाज्ञापयत सेनां योजयतेति हा अद्य भीष्मो रणे क्रुद्धोनिहनिष्यति सोमकान्॥
en: Ordered, his royal warriors saying 'Arrange the forces in battle-order. Today, waxing irascible in battle, Bhishma shall slay the Somakas.'

sn: दुर्योधनस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा रात्रौ विलपितं बहु। मन्यमानः स तं राजन् प्रत्यादेशमिवात्मनः॥
en: Having heard those copious lamentation of Duryodhana in the night, and regarding them, O king, as commands to himself,

sn: निर्वेदं परमं गत्वा विनिन्द्य परवश्यताम्। दीर्घ दध्यौ शान्तनवो योद्धकामोऽर्जुनं रणे॥
en: The son of Shantanu was greatly depressed; and he censored the life of dependency and reflected for a long time, desirous of encountering Arjuna in battle.

sn: इङ्गित्तेन तु तज्ज्ञात्वा गाङ्गेयेन विचिन्तितम्। दुर्योधनो महाराज दुःशासनमचोदयत्।॥
en: Coming to know from outward expressions what the son of Ganga had been thinking of, Duryodhana, O mighty monarch ordered Dushasana saying.

sn: दुःशासन रथास्तूर्णं युज्यन्तां भीष्मरक्षिणः। द्वाविंशतिमनीकानि सर्वाण्येवाभिचोदय॥
en: "O Dushasana, without delay draw up our chariots for protecting Bhishma. Urge to battle all our two and twenty divisions.

sn: इदं हि समनुप्राप्तं वर्षपूगाभिचिन्तितम्। पाण्डवानां ससैन्यानां वधो राज्यस्य चागमः॥
en: Even that for which we have been longing all these yards, have now come to pass, viz., the slaughter of the Pandavas with all their troops and the acquisition of the kingdom by ourselves.

sn: तत्र कार्यतमं मन्ये भीष्मस्यैवाभिरक्षणम्। स नो गुप्तः सहायः स्याद्वन्यात् पार्थांश्च सयुगे॥
en: Therefore, I now consider our highest duty to be the protection of Bhishma. Protected and assisted by us, he will slay the Parthas in battle.

sn: अब्रवीद्धि विशुद्धात्मा नाहं हन्यां शिखण्डिनम्। स्त्रीपूर्वको ह्यसौ राजस्तस्माद् वयॊ मया रणे॥
en: That pure-souled one had said 'I will not slay Shikhandin; for this one was a female before, O king, so I should avoid him in battie.

sn: लोकस्तद् वेद यदहं पितुः प्रियचिकीर्षया। राज्यं स्फीतं महाबाहो स्त्रियश्च त्यक्तवान् पुरा॥ श्रुतः।
en: All the world know, that to compass the pleasure of my father, O mighty armed one, I formerly relinquished a swelling kingdom and the company of woman.

sn: नैवं ग्राहं स्त्रियं जातु न स्त्रीपूर्वं कथंचन। हन्यां युधि नरश्रेष्ठ सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Therefore, O foremost of men, I will not slay in battle females or those who were females before. I tell this truly.

sn: अयं स्त्रीपूर्वको राजच्छिखण्डी यदि ते उद्योगे कथितं यत्तत् तथा जाता शिखण्डिनी॥
en: Before the commencement of the battle I have told you, and you have heard that this Shikhandin was born formerly as a female and was called Shikhandin.

sn: कन्या भूत्वा पुमाञ्जातः स च मां योधयिष्यति। तस्याहं प्रमुखे बाणान् न मुञ्चेयं कथंचन॥
en: Born as a female child she has come to be a man. If now I am to fight with him I will sped my shafts towards him on no account.

sn: युद्धे हि क्षत्रियांस्तात पाण्डवानां जयैषिणः। सर्वानन्यान् हनिष्यामि सम्प्राप्तान रणमूर्धनि॥
en: I will, O sire, slay all other Kshatriyas in battle, who, desirous of victory to the Pandavas, shall happen to encounter me in the van of the battle.'

sn: एवं मां भरतश्रेष्ठ गाङ्गेयः प्राह शास्त्रवित्। तत्र सर्वात्मना मन्ये गाङ्गेयस्यैव पालनम्॥
en: Thus did that foremost of the Bharatas, accomplished in the Vedas, namely the son of Ganga address me. So I consider our foremost duty to be the protection of Ganga's son to the best of our abilities.

sn: अरक्ष्यमाणं हि वृको हन्यात् सिंहं महाहवे। मा वृकेणेव गांगेयं घातयेम शिखण्डिना॥
en: If left unprotected, in a great forest, even a wolf can slay a lion. We should not allow Ganga's son to be slain by Shikhandi like a lion slain by a wolf.

sn: मातुल: शकुनिः शल्यः कृपो द्रोणो विविंशतिः। यत्ता रक्षन्तु गाङ्गेय तस्मिन् गुप्ते ध्रुवो जयः॥ ।
en: Our maternal uncle Shakuni, Shalya, Kripa, Drona, and Vivingshati, should protect, putting forth their best energies, the son of Ganga. If he is duly protected, victory indubitably will be ours."

sn: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु ते सर्वे दुर्योधनवचस्तदा। सर्वतो रथवंशेन गाङ्गेयं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Hearing these words of Duryodhana, all those warriors surrounded on all sides with a host of cars, the son of Ganga.

sn: पुत्राश्च तव गाङ्गेय परिवार्य युयुर्मुदा। कम्पयन्तो भुवं द्यां च क्षोभयन्तश्च पाण्डवान्॥
en: Then your sons, surrounding Ganga's son, proceeded to battle shaking the earth and the heavens and agitating the Pandavas.

sn: ते रथैः सुसम्प्रयुक्तैर्दन्तिभिश्च महारथाः। परिवार्य रणे भीष्मं दंशिताः समवस्थिताः॥
en: The mighty car-warriors of the Kurus, clad in Armour, and supported by those cars and many elephants formed themselves in battlearray encircling Bhishma.

sn: यथा देवासुरे युद्धे त्रिदशा वज्रधारिणम्। सर्वे ते स्म व्यतिष्ठन्ति रक्षन्तस्तं महारथम्॥
en: Protecting that mighty car-warrior Bhishma, they stood like the celestial protecting the wielder of the thunder-bolt in the battle between themselves and the Asuras.

sn: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा पुनर्घातरमब्रवीत्। सव्यं चक्रं युधामनुरुत्तमौजाश्च दक्षिणम्॥ गोप्तारावर्जुनस्यैतावर्जुनोऽपि शिखण्डिनः। रक्ष्माणः स पार्थेन तथास्माभिर्विवर्जितः॥ यथा भीष्मं न नो हन्याद् दुःशासन तथा कुरु। भ्रातुस्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा पुत्रो दुःशासनस्तव॥
en: Thereafter king Duryodhana addressing his brothers once more said “Yudhamanyu protects the left wheel of Arjuna's chariot and Uttamaujas protects the right. Thus protected, Arjuna protects Shikhandin. O Dushasana, so arrange, that Shikhandin, thus protected by Arjuna, may not slay Bhishma left unprotected by ourselves.” Hearing the words of his brothers, your son Dushasana,

sn: भीष्मं प्रमुखतः कृत्वा प्रययौ सह सेनया। भीष्मं तु रथवंशेन दृष्ट्वा समभिसंवृतम्।।५०।
en: Placing Bhishma at the van proceeded to battle, surrounded by the troops. Beholding Bhishma thoroughly encompassed by a host of cars,

sn: अर्जुनो रथिनां श्रेष्ठो धृष्टद्युम्नमुवाच ह। शिखण्डिनं नरव्याघ्नं भीष्मस्य प्रमुखे नृप। स्थापयस्वाद्य पाञ्चाल्य तस्य गोप्ताहमित्युत॥
en: Arjuna, the foremost of car-warrior said to Dhrishtadyumna; Let, O Prince of the Panchalas, Shikhandin, that foremost of men be placed face to face with Bhishma. I myself will be his protector, O Prince.

sn: संजय उवाच ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मो निर्ययौ सह सेनया। व्यूहं चाव्यूहत महत् सर्वतोभद्रमात्मनः॥शा
en: Sanjaya said Thereafter, Bhishma the son of Shantanu advanced with his troops, and he formed his own troops in the array known as Saravatobhadra.

sn: कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च शैब्यश्चैव महारथः। शकुनिः सैन्धवश्चैव काम्बोजश्च सुदक्षिणः॥
en: Kripa, Kritavarma, the mighty car-warrior Shaivya, Shakuni, the ruler of the Sindhus, and Sudakshina, the ruler of the Kambojas,

sn: भीष्मेण सहिताः सर्वे पुत्रैश्च तव भारत। अग्रतः सर्वसैन्यानां व्यूहस्य प्रमुखे स्थिताः॥
en: All these, O Bharata, accompanied by Bhishma, and along with your sons stationed themselves in the van of all the troops, and in the very head of the Kaurava array.

sn: द्रोणो भूरिश्रवाः शल्यो भगदत्तश्च मारिष। दक्षिणं पक्षमाश्रित्य स्थिता व्यूहस्य दंशिताः॥
en: Drona, Bhurishravas, Shalya and Bhagadatta. O sire, clad in mail, stood defending the right wing of that array.

sn: अश्वत्थामा सोमदत्तश्चावत्यौ च महारथौ। महत्या सेनया युक्ता वामं पक्षमपालयन्॥
en: Ashvathama, Somadatta, and the two princes of Avanti, both mighty car-warriors, supported by a large division, defended the left wing.

sn: दुर्योधनो महाराज त्रिगर्तेः सर्वतो वृतः। व्यूहमध्ये स्थितो राजन् पाण्डवान् प्रति भारत॥
en: King Duryodhana, surrounded by the Trigaretas on all sides, stood, O monarch, O Bharata, in the centre of the array facing the Pandavas.

sn: अलम्बुषो रथश्रेष्ठः श्रुतायुश्च महारथः। पृष्ठतः सर्वसैन्यानां स्थितो व्यूहस्य दंशितौ॥
en: That foremost of car-warriors Alambusha, and the mighty car-warrior Shrutayu, cased in Armour, stood in the rear of the array behind all the troops.

sn: एवं च तं तदा व्यूहं कृत्वा भारत तावकाः। संनद्धाः समदृश्यन्त प्रतपन्त इवाग्नयः॥
en: Thus, O Bharata, your warriors, having formed this mighty array and cased in Armour, appeared as if leaping forward.

sn: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च माद्रीपुत्रावुभावपि॥
en: Then king Yudhishthira and that son of Pandu, Bhimasena, and Nakula and Sahadeva the two sons of Madri,

sn: अग्रतः सर्वसैन्यानां स्थिता व्यूहस्य दंशिताः। धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः॥
en: All cased in mail, stood in the van of their array at the front of all the troops. Dhrishtadyumna, Virata, the mighty carwarrior Satyaki.

sn: स्थिताः सैन्येन महता परानीकविनाशनाः। शिखण्डी विजयश्चैव राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः॥
en: All these warriors stood prepared for battle, with their mighty divisions desirous of destroying the ranks of the enemy. Shikhandin, Arjuna, the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha,

sn: चेकितानो महाबाहुः कुन्तिभोजश्च वीर्यवान्। स्थिता रणे महाराज महत्या सेनया वृताः॥
en: The mighty-armed Chekitana, the highly puissant Kuntibhoja, all these, o mighty monarch, stood ready for fight, surrounded by their large divisions.

sn: अभिमन्युर्महेष्वासो द्रुपदश्च महाबलः। युयुधानो महेष्वासो युधामन्युश्च वीर्यवान्॥
en: That fierce bow-man Abhimanyu, the highly powerful Draupada, and the Kaikeya brothers, cased in Armour, stood ready for combat.

sn: केकया भ्रातरश्चैव स्थिता युद्धाय दंशिताः। एवं तेऽपि महाव्यूहं प्रतिव्यूह्य सुदुर्जयम्॥
en: Thus the heroic Pandavas forming this mighty and invincible contrary, stood, cased in mail, prepared for the ensuing struggle.

sn: पाण्डवाः समरे शूराः स्थिता दशिताः। तावकास्तु रणे यत्ताः सहसेना नराधिपाः॥
en: Your warriors, o king, supported by large divisions and placing Bhishma at their head, charged, putting forth all their energies, the sons of Pritha on the field.

sn: अभ्युद्ययू रणे पार्थान् भीष्मं कृत्वाऽग्रतो नृप। तथैव पाण्डवा राजन् भीमसेनपुरोगमा:॥
en: So also, O king, the Pandavas headed by Bhimasena himself, and desirous of wining victory, rushed to battle with a view to cncounter Bhishma.

sn: भीष्मं योद्धृममीप्सन्तः संग्रामे विजयैषिणः। क्ष्वेडाः किलकिलाः शङ्खान् क्रकचान् गोविषाणिकाः।।
en: With their war-cries and confused uproars and the blarc of Krakachas and sound of drums, cymbals, cow-horns, and panavas, and the roars of their elephants.

sn: भेरीमृदङ्गपणवान् नादयन्तश्च पुष्करान्। पाण्डवा अभ्यवर्तन्त नदन्तो भैरवान् स्वान्॥
en: And with fierce yells, the Pandavas rushed to battle. With the sound of our drums, cyrnbals conchs, Dundubhis,

sn: भैरीमृदङ्गशङ्खानां दुन्दुभीनां च निःस्वनः। उत्कृष्टसिंहनादैश्च वल्गितैश्च पृथग्विधैः॥
en: With fierce war-dries, and other kinds of shouts, hastily did we advance to meet the foe,

sn: वयं प्रतिनदन्तस्तानगच्छाम त्वरान्विताः। सहसैवाभिसंक्रुद्धास्तदाऽऽसीत् तुमुलं महत्॥
en: All inflamed with rage. Thereupon ensued an awful and fierce engagement, in which the soldiers, rushing at one another, smote one another down.

sn: ततोऽन्योन्यं प्रधावन्तः सम्प्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे। ततः शब्देन महता प्रचकम्पे वसुन्धरा॥
en: Then the earth began to tremble with the loud din. Birds uttering fierce shrieks hovered over our heads.

sn: पक्षिणश्च महाघोरं व्याहरन्तो विबभ्रषुः। सप्रभचोदितः सूर्यो निष्प्रभः समपद्यत॥
en: The sun that had risen in all splendor, now became bedimmed in effulgence; and dreadful winds began to blow portending ominous results.

sn: वबुश्च वातास्तुमुलाः शंसन्तः सुमहद् भयम्। घोराश्च घोरनिर्हादाः शिवास्तत्र ववाशिरे॥
en: Fearful jackets yelling terribly roved there, harbingering, Omighty monarch, a great carnage.

sn: वेदयन्त्यो महाराज महद् वैशसमागतम्। दिशः प्रज्वलिता राजन् पांसुवर्ष पपात च॥
en: The points of the compass, 0 king, appeared to be blazing, and showers of bones mixed copiously with blood.

sn: रुधिरेण समुन्मिश्रमस्थिवर्षं तथैव च। रुदतां वाहनानां च नेत्रेभ्यः प्रापतज्जलम्॥
en: Tears dropped from the eyes of the animals that were all weeping; and O ruler of men, preyed upon by anxiety, they frequently discharged urine.

sn: सुस्रुवुश्च शकृन्मूत्रं प्रध्यायन्तो विशाम्पते। अन्तर्हिता महानादाः श्रूयन्ते भरतर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, fierce war-cries of heroes were drowned by the terrible uproar uttered by Rakshasas and cannibals.

sn: रक्षसां पुरुषादानां नदतां भैरवान् रवान्। सम्पतन्तश्च दृश्यन्ते गोमायुबलवायसा॥
en: Jackals, vultures, crows and dogs yelling various shrieks, began, O sire, to pounce and swoop down the ranks of soldiers.

sn: श्वानश्च विविदैर्नादैर्वाशन्तस्त्र मारिष। ज्वलिताश्च महोल्का वै समाहत्य दिवाकरम्। निपेतुः सहसा भूमौ वेदयन्त्यो महद् भयम्॥
en: Blazing meteors, striking against the solar disc, began to drop down suddenly on earth portending mighty terrors.

sn: महान्त्यनीकानि महासमुच्छुये ततस्तयोः पाण्डवधार्तराष्ट्रयोः। चकम्पिरे शङ्खमृदङ्गनि:स्वनैः प्रकम्पितानीव वनानि वायुना॥
en: Thereafter the two mighty arrays of the Pandavas and the Kauravas, during that dreadful fight, began to shake owing to the tremendous din produced by the blare of conchs and the sound of drums, like forests shaken by the tempest.

sn: मभ्यायतीनामशिवे मुहूर्ते। बभूव घोषस्तुमुलश्चमूनां वातोद्भुतानामिव सागराणाम्॥
en: The din that was produced by the two armies teeming with royal warriors, and horses, which have encountered each other in an inauspicious moment, became deafening, like that made by the ocean when it is lashed into fury by the tempest.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: संजय उवाच अभिमन्यू रथोदारः पिशङ्गैस्तुरगोत्तमैः। अभिदुद्राव तेजस्वी दुर्योधनबलं महत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereafter the generous hero Abhimanyu borne by excellent steeds of tawny colour, rushed against the mighty divisions of Duryodhana,

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: विकिरशरवर्षाणि वारिधारा इवाम्बुदः। न शेकुः समरे क्रुद्धं सौभद्रमरिसूदनम्॥ शस्त्रौघिणं गाहमानं सेनासागरमक्षयम्। निवारयितुमप्याजौ त्वदीयाः कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Showering an arrow downpour like the clouds showering rain. All your warriors, O scion of the Kuru race, were not able to resist that slayer of foes, that enraged son of Subhadra, who had then, armed with weapor plunged into the illimitable ocean of the Kaurava army.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तेन मुक्ता रणे राजशराः शत्रुनिबर्हणाः। क्षत्रियाननयशूरान् प्रेतराजनिवेशनम्॥
en: Arrows .capable of crushing the foes, O king being discharged by him in that battle, conveyed many heroic Kshatriyas to the mansion of the king of the departed.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: यमदण्डोपमान् घोराज्वलिताशीविषोपमान्। सौभद्रः समरे क्रुद्धः प्रेषयामास सायकान्॥
en: Inflamed with rage, Subhadra's discharged in that battle fierce arrows that resembled the mace of Death, and blazing snakes of Virulent venom.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: सरथान् रथिनस्तूर्णं हयांश्चैव ससादिनः। गजारोहांश्च सगजान् दारयामास फाल्गुनिः॥
en: That son of Phalguna, soon shattered into pieces may cars with their rider and many elephant-warriors with the elephants they rode upon.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तस्य तत् कुर्वतः कर्म महत् संख्ये महीभृतः। पूजयांचक्रिरे हृष्टाः प्रशशंसुश्च फाल्गुनिम्॥
en: When he was achieving these wonderful feats in battle, the rulers of earth greatly delighted worshipped and applauded the son of Phalguna.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तान्यनीकानि सौभद्रो द्रावयामास भारत। तूलराशीनिवाकाशे मारुतः सर्वतो दिशम्॥
en: son That son of Subhadra, O Bharata, scattered your divisions, like the tempest scattering a heap of cotton on all sides in the firmament,

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तेन विद्राव्यमाणानि तव सैन्यानि भारत। त्रातारं नाध्यगच्छन्त पङ्के मग्ना इव द्विपाः॥
en: Thus scattered by him, your troops, O Bharata, could not find a protector, like elephants suck deep in mire.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: विद्राव्य सर्वसैन्यानि तावकानि नरोत्तम। अभिमन्युः स्थितो राजन् विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: Thus counting all your troop. O foremost of men, Abhimanyu stood, O king, like a blazing fire with not a streak of smoke.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: न चैनं तावका राजन् विषेहुररिघातिनम्। प्रदीप्तं पावकं यद्वत् पतङ्गाः कालचोदिताः॥
en: Your troops, O king, could not bear that slayer of foes, like insects failing to bear a blazing fire, when urged on by Fate.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: प्रहरन् सर्वशत्रुभ्यः पाण्डवानां महारथः। अदृश्यत महेष्वासः सवज्र इव वासवः॥
en: That mighty car-warrior of the Pandava host smiting all his opponents, appeared like Vasava the wielder of the thunder bolt.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: हेमपृष्ठं धनुश्चास्य ददृशे विचरद् दिशः। तोयदेषु यथा राजन् राजमाना शतह्रदा॥
en: His bow of golden stave, moving on all sides, appeared beautiful, O king, like flashes of lightning illumining the rain clouds.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: शराश्च निशिताः पीता निश्चरन्ति स्म संयुगे। वनात् फुल्लद्रुमाद् राजन् भ्रमराणामिव व्रजाः॥
en: Arrows, well-sharpened and well-tempered, shot from that bow, in that battle, appeared, O king, like flights of bees coming out from a blossoming tree in a forest.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तथैव चरतस्तस्य सौभद्रस्य महात्मनः। रथेन काञ्चनाङ्गेन ददृशुर्नान्तरं जनाः॥
en: When that high-souled son of Subhadra thus careered through the field on his car of golden sides, his foes could not detect any weakness in him.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: मोहयित्वा कृपं द्रोणं च सबृहद्बलम्। सैन्धवं च महेष्वासो व्यग्ररल्लघु सुष्ठु च॥
en: Confounding Kripa, Drona, Drona's son of great prowess, and the ruler of the Sindhus, that fierce bow-man began to move with celerity and grace on the field of battle.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: मण्डलीकृतमेवास्य धनुः पश्याम भारत। सूर्यमण्डलसंकाशं दहतस्तव वाहिनीम्॥
en: When, O Bharata, he thus consumed your ranks, I saw his bow drawn as to resembled a circle and the solar disc of effulgence.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तं दृष्ट्वा क्षत्रियाः शूराः प्रतपन्तं तरस्विनम्। द्विफाल्गुनमिमं लोकं मेनिरे तस्य कर्मभिः॥
en: Beholding him fall upon them with celerity, the heroic Kshatriyas considered, in consequence of the feats accomplished by him, that the world contained two Phalguna.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तेनार्दिता महाराज भारती सा महाचमूः। व्यभ्रमत् तत्र तत्रैव योषिन्मदवशादिव॥
en: Thus crushed by him, O monarch, the mighty army of the Bharatas, reeled here and there like a woman intoxicated with drink.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: द्रावयित्वा महासैन्यं कम्पयित्वा महारथान्। नन्दयामास सुहृदो मयं जित्वेव वासवः॥
en: Thus shattering the mighty hostile army and causing the mighty car-warriors to tremble, the delighted his forces like queered Maya.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तेन विद्राव्यमाणानि तव सैन्यानि संयुगे। चक्रुरास्विनं घोरं पर्जन्यनिनदोपमम्॥
en: Crushed by him, your troops in that battle, uttered terrible cries of distress resembling the rumbling of the rain clouds.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तं श्रुत्वा निनदं घोरं तव सैन्यस्य भारत। मारुतोद्भूतवेगस्य सागरस्येव पर्वणि॥
en: Then 0 Bharata, hearing that fierce distressful shrink uttered by your troops, that resembled the roar of the tempest-tossed ocean in a Parva,

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: दुर्योधनस्तदा राजन्नार्घ्यशृङ्गिमभाषत। एष कर्णिमहाबाहो द्वितीय इव फाल्गुनः॥
en: Your son Duryodhana, O king, addressing Rishyashringa's son said 'Single-handed the nephew of Krishna, O mighty-armed hero, like a second Phalguna,

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: चमू द्रावयते क्रोधात् वृत्रो देवचमूमिव। तस्य चान्यन्न पश्यामि संयुगे भेषजं महत्॥
en: Is tossing in rage my army like Vritra tossing the celestial host. I do not see any other efficacious medicine for him in battle,

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: ऋते त्वां राक्षसश्रेष्ठं सर्वविद्यासु पारगम्। स गत्वा त्वरितं वीरं जहि सौभद्रमाहवे॥
en: Save and except, ( foremost of the Rakshasas, your oneself who have seen the end of all learning. So encountering without delay the heroic son of Subhadra, do you slay him in battle.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: वयं पार्थं हनिष्यामो भीष्मद्रोणपुरोगमाः। स एवमुक्तो बलवान् राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: We on the other hand headed by Bhishma and Drona shall slay Arjuna in battle.” Thus spoken to that prince of the Rakshasas, possessed of might and prowess,

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: प्रययौ समरे तूर्णं तव पुत्रस्य शासनात्। नर्दमानो महानादं प्रावृषीव बलाहकः॥
en: Complying with the commands of your son, speedily rushed to battle uttering deafening roars like those of clouds in the rainy season.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तस्य शब्देन महता पाण्डवानां बलं महत्। प्राचलत् सर्वतो राजन् वातोद्भूत इवार्णवः॥
en: In consequence of those fierce roars of his, the mighty army of the Pandavas became agitated in all parts, like the ocean becoming agitated by the tempest.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: बहवश्च महाराज तस्य नादेन भीषिताः। प्रियान् प्राणान् परित्यज्य निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥
en: Many were they, O king, who terrified at his roars, fell down on the surface of he carth giving up their dear lives.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: कार्णािश्चापि मुदा युक्तः प्रगृह्य सशरं धनुः। नृत्यन्निव रथोपस्थे तद् रक्षः समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: The nephew of Krishna, filled with delight grasping a bow with arrows fixed on the string, rushed against the Rakshasa, as if dancing in the terrace of his car.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: ततः स राक्षसः क्रुद्धः सम्प्राप्यैवार्जुनि रणे। नातिदूरे स्थितां तस्य द्रावयामास वै चमूम्॥
en: Then that Rakshasa, encountering the son of Arjuna, began to crush, in rage, the latter's divisions even, those that were not far from him.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तां वध्यमानां च तथा पाण्डवानां महाचमूम्। प्रत्युद्ययौ रणे रक्षो देवसेनां यथा बलः॥
en: Thus slaughtering the vast army of the Pandavas, the Rakshasas mashed at it like Vala rushing at the celestial host.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: विमर्दः सुमहानासीत् तस्य सैन्यस्य मारिष। रक्षसा घोररूपेण वध्यमानस्य संयुगे।॥
en: Great was the carnage that produced, O sire, in the ranks of the enemy., when they were assigned and slaughtered by the Rakshasas of fearful of fearful aspect.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: ततः शरसहस्रेस्तां पाण्डवानां महाचमूम्। व्यद्रावयद् रणे रक्षो दर्शयन् स्वपराक्रमम्॥
en: Then with thousand arrows, the Rakshasas ruled the vast army of the Pandavas, displaying the superiority of the prowess.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: सा वध्यमाना च तथा पाण्डवानामनीकिनी। रक्षसा घोररूपेण प्रदुद्राव रणे भयात्॥
en: Thus slaughtered by that Rakshasas of dreadful expression, the division of the Pandavas fled in all directions out of great apprehension.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: प्रमृद्य च रणे सेनां पद्मिनी वारणो यथा। ततोऽभिदुद्राव रणे द्रौपदेयान् महाबलान्॥
en: Thus crushing the troops in battle bike an elephant crushing a lotus, that highly puissant Rakshasas rushed against the sons Draupadi.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: ते तु क्रुद्धा महेष्वासा द्रौपदेयाः प्रहारिणः। राक्षसं दुद्रुवुः संख्ये ग्रहाः पञ्च रविं यथा।॥
en: Thereat inflamed with rage, the sons of Draupadi, all mighty bowmen accomplished in smiting down the foe, rushed against the Rakshasas, like the five planets rushing at the a sun.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: वीर्यवद्भिस्ततस्तैस्तु पीडितो राक्षसोत्तमः। यथा युगक्षये घोरे चन्द्रमाः पञ्चभिर्ग्रहै:॥
en: Then that foremost of the Rakshasas sorely affected by those warriors endued with prowess, appeared like the moon affected by the five planets at the time of the dreadful dissolution at the end of a Yuga.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: प्रतिविन्ध्यस्ततो रक्षो बिभेद निशितैः शरैः। सर्वपारशवैस्तूर्णैरकुण्ठागैर्महाबलः॥
en: Then the highly powerful Prativindhya penetrated the Rakshasas with whetted arrows, sharp as battle axes and with keen points.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: स तैर्भिन्नतनुत्राणः शुशुभे राक्षसोत्तमः। मरीचिभिरिवार्कस्य संस्यूतो जलदो महान्॥
en: With his Armour penetrated by those arrows, that foremost of the Rakshasas appeared beautiful like a mass of rain cloud fried by the rays of the solar orb.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: विषक्तैः स शरैश्चापि तपनीयपरिच्छदैः। आHशृङ्गिर्बभौ राजन् दीप्तशृङ्ग इवाचलः॥
en: Struck with those arrows furnished with golden wings, the Rishyashringa, O king appeared beautiful like an immovable hill with its crest on fire.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: ततस्ते भ्रातरः पञ्च राक्षसेन्द्रं महाहवे। विव्यधुनिशितैर्वाणैस्तपनीयविभूषितैः॥
en: Thereafter the brothers, in that fierce conflict, that foremost of the Rakshasas, with whetted shafts furnished with golden wings.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: स निर्भिन्नः शरैोरैर्भुजगैः कोपितैरिव। अलम्बुषो भृशं राजन् नागेन्द्र इव चुक्रुधे॥
en: Thus pierced by those dreadful arrows resembling furious snakes, Alambusha, O king, became infuriated like a prince of elephants.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज मुहूर्तमथ मारिष। प्रविवेश तमो दीर्घं पीडितस्तैर्महारथैः॥
en: Thus, O monarch, deeply pierced and sorely afflicted by those mighty car-warrior within a few moments, the Rakshasas remained unconscious in a swoon for, a long time.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां क्रोधेन द्विगुणीकृतः। चिच्छेद सायकांस्तेषां ध्वजांश्चैव धनूंषि च॥
en: Thereafter regaining consciousness, and swelling through fury to double his dimensions, cut the bows, arrows and standards of his adversaries.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: एकैकं पञ्चभिर्बाणैराजघान स्मयन्निव। अलम्बुषो रथोपस्थे नृत्यन्निव महारथः॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior Alambusha as if dancing on the terrace of his car, wounded every one of the brothers with five shafts each, smiling all the while.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: त्वरमाणः सुसंरब्धो हयांस्तेषां महात्मनाम्। जघान राक्षसः क्रुद्धः सारथींश्च महाबलः॥
en: Then that highly powerful Rakshasas excited to the highest pitch of fury slew the steeds and charioteers of his high-souled foes, with great activity.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: बिभेद च सुसंरब्धः पुनश्चैनान् सुसंशितैः। शरैर्बहुविधाकारैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Then again, waxing worth, he pierced them with arrows duly-whetted, of diverse shapes, and discharged by hundreds and thousands.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: विरथांश्च महेष्वासान् कृत्वा तत्र स राक्षसः। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन हन्तुकामो निशाचरः॥
en: Then that Rakshasas that ranger of the nights, depriving those mighty champions of their cars, rushed against them desirous of slaying them.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तानर्दितान् रणे तेन राक्षसेन दुरात्मना। दृष्ट्वार्जुनसुतः संख्ये राक्षसं समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Seeing brother thus afflicted by the wickedsouled Rakshasas in battle, he son of Arjuna rushed the former.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तयोः समभवद् युद्धं वृत्रवासवयोरिव। ददृशुस्तावकाः सर्वे पाण्डवाश्च महारथाः॥
en: Then between them commenced a combat that resembled that between Vritra and Vasava. Your troops as also those o! the Pandavas, all mighty car-warriors, then began to at that fight.

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: तौ समेतौ महायुद्धे क्रोधदीप्तौ परस्परम्। महाबलौ महाराज क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनौ॥
en: Those two highly powerful heroes, O monarch, meeting one another dreadful fight, both bring with rage and with eyes red in rage,

description: Commencement of the ninth day's fight
sn: परस्परमवेक्षतां कालानलसमौ युधि। तयोः समागमो घोरो बभूव कटुकोदयः॥ यथा देवासुरे युद्धे शक्रशम्बरयोः पुरा॥
en: And both resembling the All destructive fire, began to eye one another. That encounter between them became dreadful and destructive forces, like that in the days of old between Shakra and Shambara, during the battle between the gods and the demons,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच आर्जुनि समरे शूरं विनिघ्नन्तं महारथान्। अलम्बुषः कथं युद्धे प्रत्ययुध्यत संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How, O descendant of the Bharata race, did Alambusha fight with the heroic son of Arjuna who had been slaying mighty car-warriors in battle?

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: आर्थ्यशृङ्गिं कथं चैव सौभद्रः परवीरहा। तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन यथावृत्तं स्म संयुगे॥
en: How did also the son of Subhadra that slayer of hostile heroes, fight with the son of Rishyashringa? Describe all this in detail to me as it actually happened in the battle.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: धनंजयश्च किं चक्रे मम सैन्येषु संयुगे। भीमो वा रथिनां श्रेष्ठो राक्षसो वा घटोत्कचः॥ नकुलः सहदेवो वा सात्यकिर्वा महारथः। एतदाचक्ष्व मे सत्यं कुशलो ह्यसि संजय॥
en: What did also Bhima, that foremost of carwarriors and the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha and Nakula and Sahadeva and the car-warriors Satyaki and Dhananjaya do to my troops in that battle? Tell me all this truly, O Sanjaya, for you are well acquainted with the incident of the battle.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: संजय उवाच हन्त तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि संग्राम लोमहर्षणम्। यथाभूद् राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सौभद्रस्य च मारिष॥
en: Sanjaya said I shall describe to you, O sire in detail, the hair-string battle that was fought between the prince of the Rakshasas an the son of Subhadra;

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: अर्जुनश्च यथा संख्ये भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च रणे चक्रुः पराक्रमम्॥
en: As also the prowess that Arjuna and Bhimasena the son of Pandu, and Nakula and Sahadeva did display in battle;

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: तथैव तावकाः सर्वे भीष्मद्रोणपुरःसराः। अद्भुतानि विचित्राणि चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत्॥
en: As also how your warriors, headed by Bhishma and Drona, fearlessly achieved many wonderful feats in battle.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: अलम्बुषस्तु समरे अभिमन्युं महारथम्। विनद्य सुमहानादं तर्जयित्वा मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: In that battle uttering fierce roars Abhimanyu the mighty car-warrior, Alambusha, repeatedly challenging the former,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: अभिदुद्राव वेगेन तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्। अभिमन्युश्च वेगेन सिंहवद् विनदन् मुहुः॥
en: Rushed at him saying “Stop, Stop." Abhimanyu also, incessantly roaring like a lion,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: आर्ण्यशृङ्गिं महेष्वासं पितुरत्यन्तवैरिणम्। ततः समीयतुः संख्ये त्वरितौ नरराक्षसौ॥ रथाभ्यां रथिनौ श्रेष्ठो यथा वै देवदानवौ। मायावी राक्षसश्रेष्ठो दिव्यास्त्रश्चैव फाल्गुनिः॥
en: Rushed at that mighty bowman, the son of Rishyashringa, that implacable enemy of his father. Thereupon these two foremost of carwarriors, man and Rakshasa, impetuously met one another on their respective cars, like a deity and a Danava. The foremost of the Rakshasas was possessed of illusive powers while Phalguna's son was accomplished in the use of celestial weapons. at

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: ततः कार्णिमहाराज निशितैः सायकैस्त्रिभिः। आर्थ्यशृङ्गि रणे विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः॥
en: Thereafter, O mighty monarch, Krishna's nephew, piercing the son of Rishyashringa with three shafts of exceeding sharpness, again pierced him with five,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: अलम्बुषोऽसंक्रुद्धः कार्ष्णि नवभिराशुगैः। हृदि विव्याध वेगेन तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपम्॥
en: Thereupon Alambusha, inflamed with rage, pierced Krishna's nephew on the breast with nine swift-coursing shafts, like a guide piercing a huge elephant with the hook.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: ततः शरसहस्रेण क्षिप्रकारी निशाचरः। अर्जुनस्य सुतं संख्ये पीडयामास भारत॥
en: Then that ranger of the night, endued with great lightness, afflicted Arjuna's son in battle, OBharata, with thousands of arrows.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: अभिमन्युस्ततः क्रुद्धो नवभिनतपर्वभिः। बिभेद निशितैर्बाणै राक्षसेन्द्र महोरसि॥
en: Thereat Abhimanyu, waxing worth, with nine straight-knotted and whetted shafts, pierced that foremost of the Rakshasas on his broad chest.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: ते तस्य विविशुस्तूर्णं कायं निर्भिद्य मर्मसु। त तैर्विभिन्नसर्वाङ्गः शुशुभे राक्षसोत्तमः॥
en: Those shafts, then piercing through his body, penetrated into his very vitals. His body mangled with those shafts, the foremost of the Rakshasas appeared beautiful,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: पुष्पितैः किंशुकै राजन् संस्तीर्ण इव पर्वतः। संधारयाणश्च शरान् हेमपुङ्खान् महाबलः॥
en: Like mountain overgrown with blossoming Kinshuka trees. Struck with those arrows furnished with golden wings, that highly powerful,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: विबभौ राक्षसश्रेष्ठः : सज्वाल इव ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज आHशृङ्गिरमर्षणः॥
en: And foremost Rakshasa, appeared beautiful like a mountain on fire. Thereupon, O monarch, the vindictive son of Rishyashringa, waxing worth, a

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: पर्वतः। पत्रिभिः। महेन्द्रप्रतिमं कार्णि छादयामास तेन ते विशिखा मुक्ता यमदण्डोपमाः शिताः॥
en: Paired, with winged shafts, that nephew of Krishna, who resembled the great Indra himself. Those sharp arrows, resembling the rod of Death, discharged by the Rakshasa,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: अभिमन्युं विनिर्भिद्य प्राविशन्त धरातलम्। तथैवार्जुनिना मुक्ताः शराः कनकभूषणाः॥
en: Piercing through Abhimanyu, penetrated the surface of the earth. So also, gold-decked arrows shot by the son of Arjuna,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: अलम्बुषं विनिर्भिद्य प्राविशन्त धरातलम्। सौभद्रस्तु रणे रक्षः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Piercing Alambusha entered the earth. Then the son of Subhadra with his straight shafts,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: चक्रे विमुखमासाद्य मयं शक्र इवाहवे। विमुखं च ततो रक्षो वध्यमानं रणेऽरिणा॥
en: Compelled the Rakshasa to turn his face away from the field, like Shakra repulsing Maya in the great battle between the celestials and the Asuras. Thus repulsed and afflicted by the foe in battle, the Rakshasas,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: प्रादुश्चक्रे महामायां तामसी परतापनाम्। ततस्ते तमसा सर्वे वृताश्चासन् महीपते॥
en: That afflicter of enemies, created a veil of impenetrable darkness through his illusive prowess. Then O ruler of men, every body was covered by the gloom;

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: नाभिमन्युमपश्यन्त नैव स्वान् न परान् रणे। अभिमन्युश्च तद् दृष्ट्वा घोररूपं महत्तमः॥
en: And none was able to discern Abhimanyu, or his friends or enemies. Then, beholding that palpable darkness of great fearfulness, Abhimanyu,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: प्रादुश्चक्रेऽस्त्रमत्युग्रं भास्करं कुरुनन्दनः। ततः प्रकाशमभवज्जगत् सर्वं महीपते॥
en: That delighter of the Kuru race, invoked into existence the solar weapon of great effulgence. Then, O monarch, the world was again disclosed to the sight.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: तां चाभिजनिवान् मायां राक्षसस्य दुरात्मनः। संक्रुद्धश्च महावीर्यो राक्षसेन्द्रं नरोत्तमः॥ छादयामास समरे शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। बह्वीस्तथान्या मायाश्च प्रयुक्तास्तेन रक्षसा॥
en: And with that weapon Abhimanyu destroyed the illusion of that wicked-souled Rakshasa. Then waxing worth, that foremost of men, endued with great prowess, covered the prince of the Rakshasas in that battle with a net-work of straight-knotted shaft. Various other kinds of illusion was created by that Rakshasas;

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: सर्वास्त्रविदमेयात्मा वारयामास फाल्गुनिः। हतमायं ततो रक्षो वध्यमानं च सायकैः॥
en: But Phalguna's son, of immeasurable should, and versed in the use of all weapons, destroyed them all. Then the Rakshasas, his illusions all neutralised, and himself afflicted with shafts,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: रथं तत्रैव संत्यज्य प्राद्रवन्महतो भयात्। तस्मिन् विनिर्जिते तूर्णं कूटयोधिनि राक्षसे॥
en: Fled out fear, forsaking his chariot even where he was. When that Rakshasas, ever fighting unfairly, had been thus speedily vanquished,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: आर्जुनिः समरे सैन्यं तावकं सम्ममर्द ह। मदान्धो गन्धनागेन्द्रं सपद्मां पद्मिनीमिव॥
en: Then son of Arjuna began to crush your troops in battle like an infuriated excellent elephant agitating a lake having lotuses blooming in its waters.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मः सैन्यं दृष्ट्वाभिविद्रुतम्। महता शरवर्षेण सौभद्रं पर्यवारयत्॥
en: Thereupon Bhishma the son of Shantanu beholding the troops thus routed by the son of Subhadra, choked the latter with a mighty shower of arrows.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: कोष्ठीकृत्य च तं वीरं धार्तराष्ट्रा महारथाः। एकं सुबहवो युद्धे ततक्षुः सायकैदृढम्॥
en: Then the mighty car-warrior of the Dhritarashtra's host encircling that single hero, began to pierce him forcibly with many arrows.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: स तेषां रथिनां वीरः पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमः। सदृशो वासुदेवस्य विक्रमेण बलेन च॥
en: Thereat that hero (Abhimanyu) equal in prowess to his father and to the son of Vasudeva in strength and powers,

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: उभयोः सदृशं कर्म स पितुर्मातुलस्य च। रणे बहुविधं चक्रे सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: That foremost of all wielders of weapon, performed in battle many a wonderful feat worthy of his father and his maternal uncle.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: ततो धनंजयो वीरो विनिमंस्तव सैनिकान्। आससाद रणे भीष्मं पुत्रप्रेप्सुरमर्षणः॥
en: Thereupon that heroic Dhananjaya, highly enraged, desirous of rescuing his son, rushed to the spot where the latter was, slaying your troops as he came.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: तथैव समरे राजन् पिता देवव्रतस्तव। आससाद रणे पार्थं स्वर्भानुरिव भास्करम्॥
en: So also, O monarch your sire Devavrata encountered the son of Pritha in battle, like Rahu meeting the lustrous orb.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: ततः सरथनागाश्वाः पुत्रास्तव जनेश्वर। परिववू रणे भीष्मं जुगुपुश्च समन्ततः॥
en: Thereupon, O ruler of men, your sons with cars, steeds, and and elephants, surrounded Bhishma in battle and began to protect him.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: तथैव पाण्डवा राजन् परिवार्य धनंजयम्। रणाय महते युक्ता दंशिता भरतर्षभ॥
en: So also, O king, the Pandavas, clad in mail, surrounding Dhananjaya, O foremost of the Bharatas, began to put forth all their energies in battle.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: शारद्वतस्ततो राजन् भीष्मस्य प्रमुखे स्थितम्। अर्जुनं पञ्चविंशत्या सायकानां समाचिनोत्॥
en: Then, O king, The son of Sharadvata, who was stationed in front of Bhishma, pierced Arjuna with a number of twenty five arrows.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: प्रत्युद्गम्याथ विव्याध सात्यकिस्तं शितैः शरैः। पाण्डवप्रियकामार्थं शार्दूल इव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Rushing against him like a tiger rushing against an elephant, Satyaki pierced him with whetted shafts, desirous of doing good to the Pandavas.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: गौतमोऽपि त्वरायुक्तो माधवं नवभिः शरैः। हृदि विव्याध संक्रुद्धः कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छदैः। :॥
en: The son of Gautami also great celerity and waxing worth, pierced the descendant of Madhu's race on the breast with nine shafts decked with golden wings.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: शैनेयोऽपि ततः क्रुद्धश्चापमानम्य वेगवान्। गौतमान्तकरं तूर्णं समाधत्त शिलीमुखम्॥
en: Thereat the grandson of Shini also highly inflamed with rage, bending his bow quickly fixed on the bow-string a shaft capable of doing away with the son of Gautami.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: तमापतन्तं वेगेन शक्राशनिसमद्युतिम्। द्विधा चिच्छेद संक्रुद्धो द्रौणिः परमकोपनः॥
en: Then the irate son of Drona seeing the effulgent dare course swiftly like the thunderbolt of Indra, speedily cut it in twain.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: समुत्सृज्याथ शैनेयो गौतमं रथिनां वरः। द्रौणि राहुः खे शशिनं यथा॥
en: Thereupon that foremost of car-warriors the grandson of Shini, forsaking Gautama's son in battle, rushed towards Drona's son, like Rahu in the firmament rushing towards the moon.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: तस्य द्रोणसुतश्चापं द्विधा चिच्छेद भारत। अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं ताडयामास सायकैः॥
en: The son of Drona cut of the bow of Satyaki in twain. O Bharata; then he pierced him whose bow had been cut with numerous shafts.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय शत्रुजं भारसाधनम्। द्रौणि षष्ट्या महाराज बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्।॥
en: Then taking up another capable of slaying the foe and of bearing great stream, Satyaki pierced the son of Drona on the breast and on the arms with a group of sixty shafts, O king.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: स विद्धो व्यथितश्चैव मुहूर्तं कश्मलायुतः। निषसाद रथोपस्थे ध्वजयष्टिं समाश्रितः॥
en: Thus pierced and pained, the latter became unconscious and he sat down on the terrace of his and supported himself by holding the flagstaff.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: अभ्यद्रवद् रणे प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। वार्ष्णेयं समरे क्रुद्धो नाराचेन समार्पयत्॥
en: Then Drona's son possessed of great prowess regaining consciousness and waxing worth, pierced the descendant of the Vrishni race with a Naracha.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: शैनेयं स तु निर्भिद्य प्राविशद् धरणीतलम्। वसन्तकाले बलवान् बिलं सर्पशिशुर्यथा॥
en: That Naracha penetrating Shini's grandson, entered the surface of the earth like a powerful young snake entering its hold in the spring.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: अथापरेण भल्लेन माधवस्य ध्वजोत्तमम्। चिच्छेद समरे द्रौणिः सिंहनादं मुमोच ह॥
en: Then with another broad-headed arrow Drona's down the excellent standard of him of Madhu's race; and then uttered a fierce warcry.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: पुनश्चैनं शरै।रैश्छादयामास भारत। निदाघान्ते महाराज यथा मेघो दिवाकरम्॥
en: One more he covered Satyaki with a dreadful group of arrows, O monarch, like clouds covering the sun at the expiration of the summer season.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: सात्यकोऽपि महाराज शरजालं निहत्य तत्। द्रौणिमभ्यकिरत् तूर्णं शरजालैरनेकधा॥
en: Satyki also, O mighty monarch, destroying that net-work of arrows, speedily scattered on Drona's a large number of arrows.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: तापयामास च द्रौणि शैनेयः परवीरहा। विमुक्तो मेघजालेन यथैव तपनस्तथा॥
en: Then that grandson of Shini, freed from that net-work of arrows, like the sun emerging out of the clouds, began to scorch the son of Drona (with his arrows).

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: शराणां च सहस्रेण पुनरेव समुद्यतः। सात्यकिश्छादयामास ननाद च महाबलः॥
en: Inflamed with ire, the highly puissant Satyaki once again covered Drona's son with a thousand shafts; and then uttered his war-cry.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं च तं ग्रस्तं राहुणेव निशाकरम्। अभ्यद्रवत शैनेयं भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then beholding his son in that plight, like the moon devoured by Rahu, the highly powerful son of Bharadvaja rushed against the grandson of Shini.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: विव्याध च सुतीक्ष्णेन पृषत्केन महामृधे। परीप्सन् स्वसुतं वार्ष्णेयेनाभिपीडितम्॥
en: Then in that great battle, he pierced him of the Vrishni race with arrows of excceding sharpness, desirous of rescuing his own son so afflicted by the latter (Satyaki).

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: सात्यकिस्तु रणे हित्वा गुरुपुत्रं महारथम्। द्रोणं विव्याध विंशत्या सर्वपारशवैः शरैः॥
en: Then abandoning that mighty car-warrior that son of the preceptor Drona, Satyaki, picrced Drona with twenty shafts of sharpness like that battle axe.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: तदन्तरममेयात्मा कौन्तेयः शत्रुतापनः। अभ्यद्रवद् रणे क्रुद्धो द्रोणं प्रति महारथः॥
en: At this crisis, that afflicter of foes that mighty car-warrior the son of Kunti, (Arjuna) waxing worth, rushed against Drona.

description: The encounter between Drona and Arjuna
sn: ततो द्रोणश्च पार्थश्च समेयेतां महामृधे। यथा बुधश्च शुक्रश्च महाराज नभस्तले॥
en: Then Drona and Arjuna met in that fierce battle, like, O mighty monarch, Venus and Jupiter meeting one another on the heavens.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं द्रोणो महेष्वासः पाण्डवश्च धनंजयः। समीयतू रणे यत्तौ तावुभौ पुरुषर्षभौ॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How did those two foremost of men, those two fierce bowmen, namely Drona and Dhananjaya the son of Pandu encountering each other with each other to the best of their abilities?

sn: प्रियो हि पाण्डवो नित्यं भारद्वाजस्य धीमतः। आचार्यश्च रणे नित्यं प्रियः पार्थस्य संजय॥
en: Then son of Pandu is very to the highly intelligent son of Bharadvaja; so also, O Sanjaya, the preceptor always dear to Pritha in battle.

sn: तावुभौ रथिनौ संख्ये हृष्टौ सिंहाविवोत्कटौ। कथं समीयतुर्यत्तौ भारद्वाजधनंजयौ॥
en: Those two foremost of car-warriors ever delighting in battle, namely Dhananjaya and the son of Bharadvaja, how did those two heroes, like two fierce lions encountering one another, fight one another putting forth their energies?

sn: संजय उवाच न द्रोणः पार्थं जानीते प्रियमात्मनः। क्षत्रधर्म पुरस्कृत्य पार्थो वा गुरुमाहवे॥
en: Sanjaya said In battle neither Drona regarded the son of Pritha as dear to him, nor does the son of Pritha, keeping in view the duty of Kshatriyas, regard the preceptor as dear to him.

sn: न क्षत्रिया रणे राजन् वर्जयन्ति परस्परम्। निर्मर्यादं हि युध्यन्ते पितृभिर्धातृभिः सह॥
en: Kshatriyas, O king never shun any one in battle; they fight with their fathers for them.

sn: रणे भारत पार्थेन द्रोणो विद्धस्त्रिभिः शरैः। नाचिन्तयच्च तान् बाणान् पार्थचापच्युतान् युधि॥
en: Then, O Bharata, Drona was pierced in battle with there. shafts by the son of Pritha; but the former regarded not those arrows shot from Arjuna's bow.

sn: शरवृष्ट्या पुनः पार्थश्छादयामास तं रणे। स प्रजज्वाल रोषेण गहनेऽग्निरिवोर्जितः॥
en: Once more did the son of Pritha cover him in that battle with a shower of shafts; and Drona, then blazed then blazed up with anger like raging forest conflagration,

sn: ततोऽर्जुनं रणे द्रोणः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। छादयामास राजेन्द्र नचिरादेव भारत॥
en: Within a short while straight jointed shafts, covered Arjuna in that battle, O foremost of kings, O Bharata.

sn: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सुशर्माणमचोदयत्। द्रोणस्य समरे राजन् पाणिंग्रहणकारणात्॥
en: Thereafter king Duryodhana commanded king Susharına to protect in battle the flanks of Drona.

sn: त्रिगर्तराडपि क्रुद्धो भृशमायम्य कार्मुकम्। छादयामास समरे पार्थं बाणैरयोमुखैः॥
en: Thereupon the ruler of the Trigatas waxing wroth, and stitching his bow full, covered the son of Pritha, O foremost of king, with many shafts tipped with iron.

sn: ताभ्याः मुक्ताः शरा राजन्नन्तरिक्षे विरेजिरे। हंसा इव महाराज शरत्काले नभस्तले॥
en: Those arrows, O king discharged by Drona and Susharma, shone, O mighty monarch, in the heavens like a row of crane in the firmament in Autumn.

sn: ते शराः प्राप्य कौन्तेयं समन्ताद् विविशुः प्रभो। फलभारनतं यद्वत् स्वादुवृक्षं विहङ्गमाः॥
en: Those arrows, reaching, the son of Kunti, entered into him, like, O lord, a flight of birds entering a tree bending with the burden of its tasteful fruits.

sn: अर्जुनस्तु रणे नादं विनद्य रथिनां वरः। त्रिगर्तराजं समरे सपुत्रं विव्यधे शरैः॥
en: Thereupon Arjuna, that foremost of carwarriors, uttering his war-cry in battle pierced the ruler of the Trigaretas and his son with myriad's of shafts.

sn: ते वध्यमानाः पार्थेन कालेनेव युगक्षये। पार्थमेवाभ्यवर्तन्त मरणे कृतनिश्चयाः॥
en: Thus pierced by Partha who then looked like the Destroyer himself at the end of a Yuga, they rushed even towards Partha himself resolved die in battle.

sn: मुमुचुः शरवृष्टिं पाण्डवस्य रथं प्रति। शरवृष्टिं ततस्तां तु शरवर्षेः समन्ततः॥ प्रतिजग्राह राजेन्द्र तोयवृष्टिमिवाचलः। तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम बीभत्सोर्हस्तलाघवम्॥
en: They also poured a shower of arrows towards the chariot of Pandu's son. Then the we son. latter received that shower of arrows, O foremost of kings, with another shower discharged by himself, like a mountain receiving a shower of rain. Then in that battle beheld the wonderful lightness of Vibhatsu's hands.

sn: विमुक्तां बहुभिर्योधैः शस्त्रवृष्टिं दुरासदाम्। यदेको वारयामास मारुतोऽभ्रगणानिव॥
en: In as much as, single-handed, he baffled the indefeasible shower of arrows poured by many, like the wind scattering masses of clouds.

sn: कर्मणा तेन पार्थस्य तुतुषुर्देवदानवाः। अथ क्रुद्धो रणे पार्थस्त्रिगर्तान् प्रति भारत॥
en: The celestial and the Danavas all become pleased with that feat of Pritha's Thereafter Arjuna waxing worth on the Trigaretas, O Bharata,

sn: मुमोचास्त्रं महाराज वायव्यं पृतनामुखे। प्रादुरासीत् ततो वायुः क्षोभयाणो नभस्तलम्॥
en: Discharged, O monarch, the Vayavya weapon at the head of the hostile ranks. Thereupon raged a tempest agitation the whole welkin,

sn: पातयन् वै तरुगणान् विनिघ्नंश्चैव सैनिकान्। ततो द्रोणोऽभिवीक्ष्यैव वायव्यास्त्रं सुदारुणम्॥
en: And felling rows of trees, and killing hosts of troops. Thereat Drona beholding that fierce Vayavya weapon,

sn: शैलमन्यन्महाराज घोरमस्त्रं मुमोच ह। द्रोणेन युधि निर्मुक्ते तस्मिन्नस्त्रे नराधिप।॥
en: Discharged, O mighty monarch, a terrible weapon named Shail. When, O ruler of men, that weapon was shot by Drona in battle,

sn: प्रशशाम ततो वायुः प्रसन्नाश्च दिशो दश। ततः पाण्डुसुतो वीरस्त्रिगर्तस्य रथव्रजान्।॥ निरुत्साहान् रणे चक्रे विमुखान् विपराक्रमान्। ततो दुर्योधनश्चैव कृपश्च रथिनां वरः॥
en: The wind subsided, and points of the compass shone brightly. Thereafter that heroic son of Pandu, made the car-division of the Trigaretas despondent and destitute of prowess, and compelled them to turn their faces away a from the field of battle. Thereat Duryodhana, and Kripa that foremost of car-warriors,

sn: अश्वत्थामा तथा शल्यः काम्बोजश्च सुदक्षिणः। विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ बाह्निकः सह बाल्हिकैः॥
en: Ashvathama, Shalya, Sudakshina the ruler of the Kambojas, the two Avanti princes Vinda and Anuvinda, and Balhika with the Balhikas,

sn: महता रथवंशेन पार्थस्यावारयन् दिशः। तथैव भगदत्तश्च श्रुतायुश्च महाबलः॥
en: These warriors, along with a mighty division of cars, surrounded Pritha's son on all directions. Also Bhagadatta and Shrutayusha, endued with great strength,

sn: गजानीकेन भीमस्य ताववारयतां दिशः। भूरिश्रवाः शलश्चैव सौबलश्च विशाम्पते॥
en: With mighty elephant division, surrounded Bhima on all directions. Also, O ruler of men, Bhurishravas, Sala and Subala's son,

sn: शरौर्घविमलैस्तीक्ष्णैर्माद्रीपुत्राववारयन्। भीष्मस्तु संहतः संख्ये धातराष्ट्रैः ससैनिकैः॥
en: With a shower of resplendent shafts of exceeding sharpness, resisted the two sons of Pandu. In that battle Bhishma, supported by Dhritarashtra's sons along with their divisions,

sn: युधिष्ठिरं समासाद्य सर्वतः पर्यवारयत्। आपतन्तं गजानीकं दृष्ट्वा वृकोदरः॥
en: Reaching near Yudhishthira, surrounded him on all sides. Then Vrikodara the son of Pritha, beholding the elephant division advance towards himself,

sn: लेलिहन् सृक्किणी वीरो मृगराडिव कानने। भीमस्तु रथिनां श्रेष्ठो गदां गृह्य महाहवे॥
en: Licked the corners of his mouth, like the king of beasts in the forest. Thereafter that foremost of car-warriors, grasping his mace, in that fierce battle,

sn: अवप्लुत्य रथात् तूर्णं तव सैन्यान्यभीषयत्। तमुद्वीक्ष्य गदाहस्तं ततस्ते गजसादिनः॥
en: Speedily jumped down from his car and struck terror into the hearts of your troops. Then those elephant-warriors, beholding him stand with mace in hand,

sn: परिववू रणे यत्ता भीमसेनं समन्ततः। गजमध्यमनुप्राप्तः पाण्डवः स व्यराजत॥
en: Surrounded him on all sides with great carefulness. Then that son of Pandu, standing in the midst of that elephant division, appeared beautiful,

sn: मेघजालस्य महतो यथा मध्यगतो रविः। व्यधमत् स गजानीकं गदया पाण्डवर्षभः॥
en: Like the sun shining in the midst of a mass of clouds. Then that foremost of the Pandavas, began to agitate that division of elephants,

sn: महाभ्रजालमतुलं मातरिश्वेव संततम्। ते वध्यमाना बलिना भीमसेनेन दन्तिनः॥
en: Like the tempest scattering away a mighty network of clouds. The those tuskers, slaughtered by the highly powerful Bhimasena in battle,

sn: आर्तनादं रणे चक्रुर्गर्जन्तो जलदा इव। बहुधा दारितश्चैव विषाणैस्तत्र दन्तिभिः॥
en: Began to utter distressful shrieks like masses of roaring clouds. Mangled with the tusks of those elephant in many parts of his body,

sn: फुल्लाशोकनिभः पार्थः शुशुभे रणमूर्धनि। विषाणे दन्तिनं गृह्य निर्विषाणमथाकरोत्॥
en: The son of Pritha appeared beautiful like a blossoming Ashoka tree. Catching the tuskers by their tusks, he rooted the tusks out,

sn: विषाणेन च तेनैव कुम्भेऽभ्याहत्य दन्तिनम्। पातयामास समरे दण्डहस्त इवान्तकः॥
en: And with those tusks wondering the elephants on their frontal globes felled them in battle, like the Destroyer himself wielding his mace.

sn: शोणिताक्ता गदां बिभ्रन्मेदोमज्जाकृतच्छविः। कृताभ्यङ्गः शोणितेन रुद्रवत् प्रत्यदृश्यता॥
en: Wielding his mace bathed in blood, with his person be spattered with fat and marrow, and smeared with gore Bhima appeared beautiful like the Rudra himself.

sn: एवं ते वध्यमानाश्च हतशेषा महागजाः। प्राद्रवन्त दिशो राजन् विमृदन्तः स्वकं बलम्॥
en: Thus slaughtered, the surviving remnant of that huge elephant division ran away in all directions, O king, crushing their own ranks.

sn: द्रवद्भिस्तैर्महानागैः समन्ताद् भरतर्षभ। दुर्योधनबलं सर्वं पुनरासीत् पराङ्मुखम्॥
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, owing to those huge elephants running away in all directions, the army of Duryodhana was once more compelled to turn their faces away from the field of battle.

sn: संजय उवाच मध्यन्दिने महाराज संग्रामः समपद्यत। लोकक्षयकरो रौद्रो भीष्मस्य सह सोमकैः॥
en: Sanjaya said At mid day, 0 mighty monarch, commenced a combat between the Somakas and Bhishma, that become dreadful and destructive of many creatures.

sn: गाङ्गेयो रथिनां श्रेष्ठः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्। व्यधमन्निशितैर्बाणैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: That foremost of car-warriors viz., the son of Ganga began to consume the ranks of the Pandava host, with his sharp shafts discharged by hundreds and thousands.

sn: सम्ममर्द च तत् सैन्यं पिता देवव्रतस्तव। धान्यानामिव लूनानां प्रकरं गोगणा इव॥
en: Then your father Devavrata crushed that army like a herd of heifer grinding (under their tread) a heap of paddy sheaves.

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च विराटो द्रुपदस्तथा। भीष्ममासाद्य समरे शरैर्जघ्नुर्महारथम्॥
en: Then Dhrishtadyumna, Shikhandin, Virata and Draupada, encountering Bhishma in battle began to pierce that mighty car-warriors with numerous shafts.

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नं ततो विध्वा विराटं च शरैस्त्रिभिः। दुपदस्य च नाराचं प्रेषयामास भारत॥
en: Thereat, 0 Bharata, piercing Dhrishtadyumna and Virata with three shafts, Bhishma discharged a Naracha at Draupada.

sn: तेन विद्धा महेष्वासा भीष्मेणामित्रकर्षिणा। चुक्रुधुः समरे राजन् पादस्पृष्टा इवोरगाः॥
en: Then those pierced by Bhishma that girder of foes, waxed worth, O king, in battle like a snake trampled under the feet.

sn: शिखण्डी तं च विव्याध भरतानां पितामहम्। स्त्रीमयं मनसा ध्यात्वा नास्मै प्राहरदच्युतः॥
en: Then Shikhandin pierced the grand father of the Bharatas, but the latter of undeteriorating renown struck him not, remembering his femininity.

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु समरे क्रोधेनाग्निरिव ज्वलन्। पितामहं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्वाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: Then Dhrishtadyumna blazing up with rage like fire, pierced the grandsire, with three shafts on the breast and the arms.

sn: द्रुपदः पञ्चविंशत्या विराटो दशभिः शरैः। शिखण्डी पञ्चविंशत्या भीष्मं विव्याध सायकैः॥
en: Drupada with twenty five, Virata with ten, Shikhandin with twenty five arrows pierced Bhishma.

sn: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज शोणितौघपरिप्लुतः। वसन्ते पुष्पशबलो रक्ताशोक इवाबभौ॥
en: That hero (Bhishma) thus deeply pierced, O mighty monarch, and bathed in copiously flowering blood, appeared beautiful like flowering red Ashoka tree in the spring.

sn: तान् प्रत्यविध्यद् गाङ्गेयस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः। द्रुपदस्य च भल्लेन धनुचिच्छेद मारिष॥
en: Then the son of Ganga pierced them in return each with three straight going shafts; and O sire, he bust open the bow of Drupada with a broad headed arrow.

sn: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय भीष्मं विव्याध पञ्चभिः। सारथिं च त्रिभिर्बाणैः सुशितै रणमूर्धनि॥
en: The latter then taking up another bow pierced Bhishma with five arrows and his charioteer with three whetted shafts on the field of battle.

sn: तथा भीमो महाराज द्रौपद्याः पञ्च चात्मजाः। केकया भ्रातरः पञ्च सात्यकिश्चैव सात्वतः॥
en: Thereupon, O monarch, Bhima, the five sons of Draupadi, the five Kaikeya brothers, and Satyaki of the Satvata race,

sn: अभ्यद्रवन्त गाङ्गेयं युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः। रिरक्षिषन्तः पाञ्चाल्यं धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः॥
en: Headed by king Yudhishthira himself rushed at the son of Ganga, desirous of rescuing the Panchalas headed by Dhrishtadyumna.

sn: तथैव तावकाः सर्वे भीष्मरक्षार्थमुद्यताः। प्रत्युद्ययुः पाण्डुसेनां सहसैन्या नराधिप॥
en: So also, O ruler of men, your warriors anxious for protecting Bhishma, rushed against the Pandava host, supported by their respective divisions.

sn: तत्रासीत् सुमहद् युद्धं तव तेषां च संकुलम्। नराश्वरथनागानां यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम्॥
en: Thereupon ensued a fierce and sanguinary engagement between your army and theirs both teeming with men, steeds chariots and elephants-engagement that considerably swelled the population of Death's domain.

sn: रथी रथिनमासाद्य प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्। तथेतरान् समासाद्य नरनागाश्वसादिनः॥
en: Car-warriors meeting car-warriors dispatched them to the abode of Death; so also others, men, horse-soldiers, elephant riders encountering one another,

sn: अनयन् परलोकाय शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। शरैश्च विविधैर्पोरैस्तत्र तत्र विशाम्पते॥ रथास्तु रथिभि_ना हतसारथयस्तथा। विप्रदुताश्चाः समरे दिशो जग्मुः समन्ततः॥
en: Conveyed one another to the abode of Death, with their straight knotted shafts; and in that field of battle, O ruler of men, many cars deprived of their riders with numerous dreadful arrows, and with their drivers slain, careered on the being dragged on all sides.

sn: मृदन्तस्ते नरान् राजन् हयांश्च सुबहून् रणे। वातायमाना दृश्यन्ते गन्धर्वनगरोपमाः॥
en: Crushing, O king, innumerable men and steeds in that battle, those cars of the velocity of wind appeared beautiful like aerial castles.

sn: रथिनश्च स्थैींना वर्मिणस्तेजसा युताः। कुण्डलोष्णीषिणः सर्वे निष्काङ्गदविभूषणाः॥
en: Many car-warriors deprived of their cars, clad in armour and possessed of strength all decked with ear-rings and turbans and with bracelets and garlands,

sn: देवपुत्रसमाः सर्वे शौर्ये शक्रसमा युधि। ऋद्ध्या वैश्रवणं चाति नयेन च बृहस्पतिम्॥
en: All resembling sons of the gods and equal to Shakra in prowess in battle, prosperous as Vaishravana himself and wise in polity as Brihaspati himself.

sn: सर्वलोकेश्वराः शूरास्तत्र तत्र विशाम्पते। विप्रद्रुता व्यदृश्यन्त प्राकृता इव मानवाः।।२३।
en: Ruling over vast dominions, and all heroic warriors, O ruler of men, flying hither and thither, were slain like ordinary men.

sn: दन्तिनश्च नरश्रेष्ठ हीनाः परमसादिभिः। मृदन्तः स्वान्यनीकानि निपेतुः सर्वशब्दगाः॥
en: Huge tusked elephants also, O foremost of men, deprived of their excellent riders, fell down crushing their own ranks and uttering distressful cries,

sn: चर्मभिश्चामरैश्चत्रैः पताकाभिश्च मारिष। छत्रैः सिहतैर्हमदण्डैश्चामरैश्च समन्ततः॥
en: With their armours, variegated standards, chamaras, white umbrellas with golden staves, and lances shattered, O sire,

sn: विशीर्णैविप्रधावन्तो दृश्यन्ते स्म दिशो दश। नवमेघप्रतीकाशा जलदोपमनिःस्वनाः॥
en: The huge elephants ran in all the ten points of the compass, resembling newly-risen clouds.। and roaring also like them.

sn: तथैव दन्तिभिहींना गजारोहा विशाम्पते। प्रधावन्तोऽन्वदृश्यन्त तव तेषां च संकुले॥
en: So also, O ruler of men, elephant riders, deprived of their elephants, were seen to run in all directions in that general engagement between your army and theirs.

sn: नानादेशसमुत्थांतुरगान हेमभूषितान्। वातायमानानद्राक्षं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: We also beheld steeds born in various regions, decked with golden caparisons, and fleet as the wind itself, by hundreds and by thousands.

sn: अश्वारोहान् हतैरश्चैर्ग्रहीतासीन् समन्ततः। द्रवमाणानपश्याम द्राव्यमाणांश्च संयुगे॥
en: We also beheld horse soldiers, deprived of their charges chase and chased by, one another in that battle, with swords in their grasp.

sn: गजो गजं समासाद्य द्रवमाणं महाहवे। ययौ प्रमृद्य तरसा पादातान् वाजिनस्तथा॥
en: An elephant meeting a flying compeer in that great battle, rushed with velocity crushing foot soldiers and steeds.

sn: तथैव च रथान् राजन् प्रममर्द रणे गजः। रथाश्चैव समासाद्य पतितांस्तुरगान् भुवि॥
en: Also, o king, in that battle one elephant crushed many cars, and car also, passing over fallen steeds, crushed them in battle.

sn: व्यमृद्न् समरे राजंस्तुरगाश्च नरान् रणे। एवं ते बहुधा राजन् प्रत्यमृद्न् परस्परम्॥
en: And also, O king, horses again crushed the foot-soldiers in that battle. Thus, o king, they crushed one another in various modes.

sn: तस्मिन् रौद्रे तथा युद्धे वर्तमाने महाभये। प्रावर्तत नदी घोरा शोणितान्त्रतरङ्गिणी॥
en: When that awful and fierce battle was thus raging, there started up into existence on the field of battle a hideous river, having blood for its stream,

sn: अस्थिसंघातसम्बाधा केशशैवलशाद्वला। रथह्रदा शरावर्ता हयमीना दुरासदा॥
en: Choked with piles of bones, and having the hair (of slain warriors) for its moss and weeds. It had cars for its lakes arrows for its eddies and horses for its fishers; and it was inaccessible.

sn: शीर्षोपलसमाकीर्णा हस्तिग्राहसमाकुला। कवचोष्णीषफेनौघा धनुर्वेगासिकच्छपा॥
en: It abounded in pebbles consisting of the heads of warrior; as also in sharks &c formed by the elephants. It had armours and headgears for its froth and bows for its current and swords for its tortoises;

sn: पताकाध्वजवृक्षाढ्या महँकूलापहारिणी। क्रव्यादहंससंकीर्णा यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनी॥
en: The trees on its banks were formed of the numerous standards; it had men for its banks which it ate away constantly. It was infested by swans consisting of cannibals, and it considerably increased the population of Death's domain.

sn: तां नदी क्षत्रियाः शूरा रथनागहयप्लवैः। प्रतेरुर्बहवो राजन् भयं त्यक्त्वा महारथाः॥
en: Many heroic Kshatriyas all mighty carwarriors crossed that river on their rafts consisting of cars, steeds and elephants, totally driving away fear their hearts.

sn: अपोवाह रणे भीरून् कश्मलेनाभिसंवृतान्। यथा वैतरणी प्रेतान् प्रेतराजपुरं प्रति॥
en: Just as the river Vaitarani conveys all departed spirits to the dominions of the ruler of spirits, so, in that afternoon, that river carried away (with its bloody currents) all cowards that became overwhelmed with a swoon.

sn: प्राक्रोशन् क्षत्रियास्तत्र दृष्ट्वा तद् वैशसं महत्। दुर्योधनापराधेन गच्छन्ति क्षत्रियाः क्षयम्॥
en: Then in that battle the Kshatriyas beholding that awful carnage, exclaimed saying. Through the folly of Duryodhana, Kshatriyas are being thus destroyed.

sn: गुणवत्सु कथं द्वेषं धृतराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः। कृतवान् पाण्डुपुत्रेषु पापात्मा लोभमोहितः॥
en: Why did Dhritarashtra of wicked soul, that ruler of men, infatuated by covetousness, harbor feelings of envy against the sons of Pandu, all endued with many virtues."

sn: एवं बहुविधा वाचः श्रूयन्ते स्म परस्परम्। पाण्डवस्तवसंयुक्ताः पुत्राणां ते सुदारुणाः॥
en: Various exclamations of this kind, purporting to be applause to the Pandavas and censures to your sons, were heard there addressed to one another.

sn: ता निशम्य ततो वाचः सर्वयोधैरुदाहृताः। आगस्कृत् सर्वलोकस्य पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव॥
en: Hearing these exclamations vociferated by all the warriors, your son Duryodhana, that offender of all men,

sn: भीष्मं द्रोणं कृपं चैव शल्यं चोवाच भारत। युध्यध्वमनहंकाराः किं चिरं कुरुथेति च॥
en: Addressing Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and Shalya said, O Bharata “Do you go on fighting with self-confidence? Why do you tarry at all?”

sn: ततः प्रववृत्ते युद्धं कुरूणां पाण्डवैः सह। अक्षद्यूतकृतं राजन् सुघोरं वैशसं तदा॥
en: Then ensued a battle between the Kurus and the Pandavas. O king, that owed its origin to that game at dice and that brought about awful carnage.

sn: यत् पुरा न निगृह्णासि वार्यमाणो महात्मभिः। वैचित्रवीर्य तस्येदं फलं पश्य सुदारुणम्॥
en: Now do you see, O son of Vichitravirya, the dreadful fruit of your refusal to accept the salutary advice (of your friends), though warned against it by many high souled heroes.

sn: न हि पाण्डुसुता राजन् ससैन्याः सपदानुगाः। रक्षन्ति समरे प्राणान् कौरवा वापि संयुगे॥
en: Neither the sons of Pandu, O king, with their soldiers and followers, nor the Kauravas pay any the least head to their lives in that battle.

sn: एतस्मात् कारणाद् घोरो वर्तते स्वजनक्षयः। दैवाद् वा पुरुषव्याघ्र तव चापनयानृप॥
en: For this reason, O foremost of men, a dreadful destruction of men is taking place, brought about by Destiny or by your wicked policy, O king.

sn: संजय उवाच अर्जुनस्तान् नरव्याघ्रः सुशर्मानुचरान् नृपान्। अनयत् प्रेतराजस्य सदनं सायकैः शितैः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then that foremost of of men Arjuna, conveyed, with his whetted shafts, the kings that followed Susharma to the abode of the lord of departed spirits.

sn: सुशर्मापि ततो बाणैः पार्थं विव्याध संयुगे। वासुदेवं च सप्तत्या पार्थं च नवभिः पुनः॥
en: Thereupon in that battle Susharma pierced Pritha's son with many shafts; he then pierced the son of Vasudeva with seventy shafts and Arjuna again with nine.

sn: तं निवार्य शरौघेण शक्रसूनुर्महारथः। सुशर्मणो रणे योद्धान् प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्॥
en: Baffling those arrows with his showers of arrows, that mighty car-warrior, the son of Shakra, dispatched the warriors that supported Susharma to the mansion of Death.

sn: ते वध्यमानाः पार्थेन कालेनेव युगक्षये। व्यद्रवन्त रणे राजन् भये जाते महारथाः॥
en: Thus slaughtered by Pritha's son, as if by the Destroyer himself at the expiration of a Yuga, those mighty car-warriors, seized with panic, ran from the field of battle.

sn: उत्सृज्य तुरगान् केचिद् रथान् केचिच्च मारिष। गजानन्ये समुत्सृज्य प्राद्रवन्त दिशो दश॥
en: Some leaving their horses, some their cars, and some their elephants. O sire, fled in all the directions of the compass.

sn: अपरे तु तदाऽऽदाय वाजिनागरथान् रणे। त्वरया परया युक्ताः प्राद्रवन्त विशाम्पते॥
en: Others, on the other hand, seizing steeds, elephants and chariots in that battle, fled away, O ruler of men, at the top of their speed.

sn: पादाताश्चापि शस्त्राणि समुत्सृज्य महारणे। निरपेक्षा व्यधावन्त तेन तेन स्म भारत॥
en: In that fierce fight, foot-soldiers, abandoning their weapons, and without paying any heed to any one, fled, O Bharata, hither and thither.

sn: वार्यमाणाः सुबहुशस्वैगर्तेन सुशर्मणा। तथान्यैः पार्थिवश्रेष्ठैर्न व्यतिष्ठन्त संयुगे॥
en: Through they were repeatedly forbidden by the Trigarta ruler Susharma as also by many other foremost sovereigns they did not tarry on the field any longer.

sn: तद् बलं प्रद्रुतं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। पुरस्कृत्य रणे भीष्मं सर्वसैन्यपुरस्कृतः॥
en: Seeing that army thus routed, your son Duryodhana, placing Bhishma at the head of all the troops, and himself marching in the van.

sn: सर्वोद्योगेन महता धनंजयमुपाद्रवत्। त्रिगर्ताधिपतेरर्थे जीवितस्य विशाम्पते।॥
en: Assaulted Dhananjaya putting forth all his energies, desirous of saving, o ruler of men, the life of the king of the Trigaretas.

sn: स एकः समरे तस्थौ किरन् बहुविधाञ्शरान्। भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वैः शेषा हि प्रद्रुता नराः॥
en: Susharına alone, accompanied by his brother, was standing against Arjuna in battle, scattering various kinds of shafts, the rest of his men having ran away.

sn: तथैव पाण्डवा राजन सर्वोद्योगेन दंशिताः। प्रययुः फाल्गुनार्थाय यत्र भीष्मो व्यतिष्ठत॥
en: So also, O king, the Pandavas, clad in armour, rushed, with all their energies, to the spot where Bhishma was, desirous of rescuing Partha.

sn: ज्ञायमाना रणे वीर्यं घोरं गाण्डीवधन्वनः। हाहाकारकृतोत्साहा भीष्मं जग्मुः समन्ततः॥
en: Though perfectly cognisant of the dreadful prowess of the Pandava heroes with loud cries of 'Oh!' and 'Alas!' advanced towards Bhishma from all sides.

sn: ततस्तालध्वजः शूरः पाण्डवानां वरूथिनीम्। छादया समरे शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Then that hero, owning the standard bearing the device of the palmyra tree, covered the Pandava host in that battle with straightknotted shafts.

sn: एकीभूतास्ततः सर्वे कुरवः सह पाण्डवैः। अयुध्यन्त महाराज मध्यं प्राप्ते दिवाकरे॥
en: When the sun reached the meridian, O mighty sovereign, the Kurus mingling pell-mell with the Pandavas fought on fiercely.

sn: सात्यकिः कृतवर्माणं विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः। अतिष्ठदाहवे शूरः किरन् बाणान् सहस्रशः॥
en: Then the heroic Satyaki piercing Kritavarina with five swift-coursing arrows stood in the field shooting shafts by hundreds and by thousands.

sn: तथैव दुपदो राजा द्रोणं विद्ध्वा शितैः शरैः। पुनर्विव्याध सप्तत्या सारथिं चास्य पञ्चभिः॥
en: So also king Drupada piercing Drona with sharp shafts again pierced the latter with seventy shafts and his charioteer with five shafts.

sn: भीमसेनस्तु राजानं बाह्रीकं प्रपितामहम्। विद्ध्वा नदन्तमहानादं शार्दूल इव कानने॥
en: Bhimasena, piercing the Balhika king, his great grandsire, uttered his war-cry that resembled the tiger's roar in the woods.

sn: आर्जुनिश्चित्रसेनेन विद्धो बहुभिराशुगैः। अतिष्ठदाहवे शूरः किरन् बाणान् सहस्रशः॥
en: The son of Arjuna being pierced by Chitrasena with many swift-coursing arrows, pierced him in return on the breast with three shafts.

sn: चित्रसेनं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्विव्याध समरे भृशम्। समागतौ तौ तु रणे महामात्रौ व्यरोचताम्॥
en: Encountering one another in battle, those two foremost of men, appeared beautiful, O king, like Venus and Saturn shining in the heavens.

sn: यथा दिवि महाघोरौ राजन् बुधशनैश्चरौ। तस्याश्वांश्चतुरो हत्वा सूतं च नवभिः शरैः॥
en: Then that slayer of hostile heroes, that son of Subhadra, endued with prowess, slaying Chitrasena's four steeds and charioteer with nine shafts, uttered his fierce war-cry.

sn: ननाद बलवन्नादं सौभद्रः परवीरहा। हताश्वात् तु रथात् तूर्णंसोऽवप्लुत्य महारथः॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior Chitrasena, jumping down with agility from the car of which the steeds were slain, ascended with quickness, O ruler of men, the chariot of Durmukha.

sn: आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं दुर्मुखस्य विशाम्पते। द्रोणश्च द्रुपदं भित्त्वा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: The highly puissant Drona also penetrating Draupada with straight shafts, pierced with quickness the latter's charioteer.

sn: सारथिं चास्य विव्याध त्वरमाणः पराक्रमी। पीड्यमानस्ततो राजा द्रुपदो वाहिनीमुखे॥
en: Thereupon king Drupada thus afflicted before the army, fled, borne away by fleet steeds, remembering his former enmity.

sn: अपायाज्जवनैरश्वैः पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्। भीमसेनस्तु राजानं मुहूर्तादिव बाह्निकम्॥
en: Bhimasena in a moment deprived king Balhika of his horses, car and driver, before the very eyes of the troops.

sn: व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः। ससम्भ्रमो महाराज संशयं परमं गतः॥
en: Thus involved in a perilous situation and seized with panic, O mighty monarch, that foremost of me Balhika, jumping down from his own vehicle,

sn: अवप्लुत्य ततो वाहाद् बाह्लीकः पुरुषोत्तमः। आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं लक्ष्मणस्य महारणे॥
en: Ascended, in that fierce battle, that of Lakshmana. Satyaki, having repulsed Kritavarma in battle,

sn: सात्यकिः कृतवर्माणं वारयित्वा महारणे। शरैर्बहुविधै राजन्नाससाद पितामहम्॥
en: Approached the grandsire Bhishma, shooting various kinds of arrows. Then he, having pierced the grandsire with sixty whetted shafts furnished with feathery wings,

sn: न विद्ध्वा भारतं षष्ट्या निशितैर्लोमवाहिभिः। नृत्यन्निव रथोपस्थे विधुन्वानो महद् धनुः॥
en: Seemed to dance on the terrace of his car, wielding his massive bow. Thereupon the grandsire hurled at him a mighty lance made entirely of iron,

sn: तस्यायसीं महाशक्तिं चिक्षेपाथ पितामहः। हेमचित्रां महावेगां नागकन्योपमां शुभाम्॥ तामापतन्ती सहसा मृत्युकल्पां सुदुर्जयाम्। व्यंसयामास वार्ष्णेयो लाघवेन महायशाः॥
en: Decked with gold, charged with great velocity and loO king beautiful like a daughter of a Naga. (Beholding) that irresistible lance swiftly course towards himself like death itself,

sn: अनासाद्य तु वार्ष्णेयं शक्तिः परमदारुणा। न्यपतद् धरणीपृष्ठे महोल्केव महाप्रभा॥
en: That high formed hero of the Vrishni race baffled it with the swiftness (of his movements); and that dreadful lance, even without reaching him of the Vrishni race,

sn: वार्ष्णेयस्तु ततो राजन् स्वां शक्तिं कनकप्रभाम्। वेगवद् गृह्य चिक्षेप पितामहरथं प्रति॥ वार्ष्णेयभुजवेगेन प्रणुन्ना सा महाहवे। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन कालरात्रिर्यथा नरम्॥
en: O king! Satyaki also picked up the Sakti having golden radiance and threw it with full might on the chariot of Bhishma. That Sakti so thrown with full might by Satyaki rushed rapidly towards Bhishma in that great war. It appeared as if the Kalaratri (the night of devastation) is forwarding to grip the man.

sn: तामापतन्ती सहसा द्विधा चिच्छेद भारत। क्षुरप्राभ्यां सुतीक्ष्णाभ्यां सा व्यशीर्यत मेदिनीम्॥
en: Flew swiftly, like the last night (of worldly existence) of a doomed man. Then 0 Bharata, Bhishma cut in twin that swift coursing lance,

sn: छित्त्वा शक्तिं तु गाङ्गेयः सात्यकिं नवभिः शरैः। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः प्रसञ्छत्रुकर्शनः॥ ततः सरथनागाश्वाः पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वजाः। परिववू रणे भीष्मं माघवत्राणकारणात्॥
en: With two sharp arrows having horse shoeheads; and the lance fell down on the ground. Having severed that lance, the son of Ganga, that grinder of foes, waxing wroth and smiling the while, pierced Satyaki on the breast with nine arrows. Thereupon with all their chariots, elephants and horses, the Pandavas, O elder brother of Pandu,

sn: ततः प्रववृते युद्धे तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च समरे विजयैषिणाम्॥
en: Surrounded Bhishma on all sides, in order to rescue him of Madhu's race. Then between the Kurus and the Pandavas, both desirous of securing victory, commenced a fierce fight making the hair stand erect.

sn: संजय उवाच दृष्ट्वा भीष्मं रणे क्रुद्धं पाण्डवैरभिसंवृतम्। यथा मेधैर्महाराज तपान्ते दिवि भास्करम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding, O king, Bhishma inflamed with rage in battle, surrounded by the Pandavas, like the sun in the heavens surrounded by the clouds at the end of the summer,

sn: दुर्योधनो महाराज दुःशासनमभाषत। एष शूरो महेष्वासो भीष्मः शूरनिषूदनः॥
en: Duryodhana, O monarch, said to Dushasana "This heroic Bhishma, this mighty bowman and slayer of heroes,

sn: छादितः पाण्डवैः शूरैः समन्ताद् भरतर्षभ। तस्य कार्यं त्वया वीर रक्षणं सुमहात्मनः॥
en: Is surrounded on all sides, O foremost of the Bharatas, with the heroic Pandava warriors. It behooves you, O hero, to look to the protection of that (high-souled one).

sn: रक्ष्यमाणो हि समरे भीष्मोऽस्माकं पितामहः। निहन्यात् समरे यत्तान् पञ्चालान् पाण्डवैः सह॥
en: Our grandsire Bhishma, being wellprotected in battle, will slay all the Panchalas with the Pandavas.

sn: तत्र कार्यतमं मन्ये भीष्मस्यैवाभिरक्षणम्। गोप्ता ह्येष महेष्वासो भीष्मोऽस्माकं महाव्रतः॥
en: Therefore I think the protection of Bhishma to be our foremost duty. This fierce bowman Bhishma of illustrious vows is our protector.

sn: स भवान् सर्वसैन्येन परिवार्य पितामहम्। समरे कर्म कुर्वाणं दुष्करं परिरक्षतु॥
