sn: अहं त्वामनुयास्यामि परान् विद्रावयशरैः। अभिद्रव सुसंरब्धो भीष्मं भीमपराक्रमम्॥
en: 'I shall fight behind you crushing the enemy with my arrows; now inflamed with wrath, do you assail Bhishma of dreadful prowess.

description: Interchange of words between Bhishma and Shikhandin
sn: न हि ते संयुगे पीडां शक्तः कर्तुं महाबलः। तस्मादद्य महाबाहो यत्नाद् भीष्ममभिद्रव॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, Bhishma will not be able to cause pain to you in battle. Therefore, O mighty hero, do you now assail Bhishma putting forth all your energies.

description: Interchange of words between Bhishma and Shikhandin
sn: अहत्वा समरे भीष्मं यदि यास्यसि महारिष अवहास्योऽस्य लोकस्टः भविष्यसि मया सह॥
en: If, O sire, you do return without slaying Bhishma in battle, you along with myself, shail be exposed to the derision of the world.

description: Interchange of words between Bhishma and Shikhandin
sn: नावहास्या यथा वीरं भवेम परमाहवे। तथा कुरु रणे यत्नं साधयस्व पितामहम्॥
en: O hero, so exert yourself, that we may not be held in ridicule in this fierce battle. Struggling vigorously in battle, do you slay the grandsire.

description: Interchange of words between Bhishma and Shikhandin
sn: अहं ते रक्षणं युद्धे करिष्यामि महाबल। वारयन् रथिनः सर्वान् साधयस्व पितामहम्॥
en: I, myself O mighty hero, shall look to your protection, epulsing all the car-Warriors of the eneray's host. Do you overthrow the grandfather.

description: Interchange of words between Bhishma and Shikhandin
sn: द्रोणं च द्रोणपुत्रं च कृपं चाथ सुयोधनम्। चित्रसेनं विकर्णं च सैन्धर जयद्रथम्॥
en: Drona and his son, Krishna, Suyodhana, Chitresena, Vikarna, Jayadratha the king if the Sindhus,

description: Interchange of words between Bhishma and Shikhandin
sn: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौकाम्बोजं च मदक्षिणम्। भगदत्तं तथा शूरं मागधं च महाबलम्॥
en: The two Avanti princes Vinda and Anuvinda, and Sudakshina the ruler of the Kambojas, the heroic Bhagadatta, the mighty ruler of the Magadhas, son

description: Interchange of words between Bhishma and Shikhandin
sn: सौमदत्तिं तथा शूरमार्थ्यशृङ्गिं च राक्षसम्। त्रिगर्तराजं च रणे सह सर्वैर्महारथैः॥
en: The valiant of Somadatta, the Rakshasa, Alambusha, and the ruler of the Trigarta's along with all the mighty car-warriors,

description: Interchange of words between Bhishma and Shikhandin
sn: अहमावारयिष्यामि बेलेव मकरालयम्। कुरूंश्च सहितान् सर्वान् युध्यमानान् महाबलान्। निवारयिष्यामि रणे साधयस्व पितामहम्॥
en: All these warriors, I will resist like the banks resisting the waves of the mighty main. I will also hold at bay the mighty warriors of the Kuru army all united against us and fighting with us. Do you overthrow the grandsire.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं शिखण्डी गाङ्गेयमभ्यधावत् पितामहम्। पाञ्चाल्यः समरे क्रुद्धो धर्मात्मानं यतव्रतम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How did Shikhandin the prince of the Panchalas waxing wroth in battle rush against the son of Ganga, the grandfather of the Kurus, of illustrious soul and of regulated vows?

sn: के रक्षन् पाण्डवानीके शिखण्डिनमुदाययुधाः। त्वरमाणास्त्वराकाले जिगीषन्तो महारथाः॥
en: Who were those mighty car-warriors that activity defended Shikhandin in that occasion needing great activity, with their weapons upraised and heart longing for victory?

sn: कथं शान्तनवो भीष्मः स तस्मिन् दशमेऽहनि। अयुध्यत महावीर्यः पाण्डवैः सहसृजयैः॥
en: How did also Shantanu's son, Bhishma possessed of great prowess, fought on the tenth day, with the Pandavas and the Srinjayas?

sn: न मृष्यामि रणे भीष्मं प्रत्युद्यातं शिखण्डिना। कच्चिन्न रथभङ्गोऽस्य धनुर्वाशीर्यतास्यतः॥
en: I am unable to brook the thought of Bhishma overthrown by Shikhandin in battle. Was then his (Bhishma's) car shattered on his bow burst?

sn: संजय उवाच नाशीर्यत धनुश्चास्य रथभङ्गो न चाप्यभूत्। युध्यमानस्य संग्रामे भीष्मस्य भारतर्षभ।५॥
en: Sanjaya said Neither was the bow of Bhishma broken nor was his car shattered to fragments, when, O foremost of the Bharata, he fought on with the foe,

sn: निघ्नतः समरे शत्रूशरेः संनतपर्वभिः। अनेकशतसाहस्रास्तावकानां महारथाः॥
en: Slaying them in battle with many shafts of straight knots. Many hundreds and thousands of mighty car-warriors belonging to your army,

sn: तथा दन्तिगणा राजन् हयाश्चैव सुसज्जिताः। अभ्यवर्तन्त युद्धाय पुरस्कृत्य पितामहम्॥
en: Many huge-tusked elephants, O king, as also many well-caparisoned charges, advanced to battle, with the grandsire at their head.

sn: यथाप्रतिज्ञं कौरव्य स चापि समितिञ्जयः। पार्थानामकरोदं भीष्मः सततं समिति क्षयम्॥
en: In perfect harmony with his vow, O foremost of the Kurus, the ever-victorious Bhishma continuously went on slaughtering the troops of the Pandavas.

sn: युध्यमानं महेष्वासं विनिघ्नन्तं पराशरैः। पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सार्धं सर्वे ते नाभ्यवारयन्॥
en: The Panchalas accompanied by the Pandavas were incapable of withstanding that fierce bowman as he fought on, slaying the foe with his shafts.

sn: दशमेऽहनि सम्प्राप्ते ततस्तां रिपुवाहिनीम्। कीर्यमाणां शितैर्बाणैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: When the tenth day arrived, Bhishma scattered the hostile army with his whetted shafts, by hundreds and thousands.

sn: न हि भीष्मं महेष्वासं पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वज। अशक्नुवन् रणे जेतुं पाशहस्तमिवान्तकम्॥
en: Then the Pandavas could not vanquish in battle that fierce bowman that sire of Pandu, who then resembled the Destroyer himself with his noose in hand.

sn: अथोपायान्महाराज सव्यसाची धनंजयः। त्रासयन् रथिनः सर्वान् बीभत्सुपराजितः॥
en: Thereupon, 0 mighty monarch, the invincible Vibhatsu, the conqueror of the god of wealth, who was able to use his weapons even with his left hand, rushed to the spot terrifying all the car-warriors present.

sn: सिंहवद् विनदन्नुच्चैर्धनुर्ध्या विक्षिपन् मुहुः। शरोधान् विसृजन् पार्थोव्यरत् कालवद् रणे॥
en: Then like the Destroyer himself, Pritha's son carried through the field, roaring constantly like a lion, twanging his bow string and shooting myriad's of arrows.

sn: तस्य शब्देन वित्रस्तास्तावका भरतर्षभ। सिंहस्येव मृगा राजन् व्यद्रवन्त महाभयात्॥
en: Terrified at his roars, your warriors, O foremost of the Bharatas, fied, O king, out of panic, like deer flying at the sight of a lion.

sn: जयन्तं पाण्डवं दृष्ट्वा त्वत्सैन्यं चाभिपीडितम्। दुर्योधनस्ततो भीष्ममब्रवीद् भृशपीडितः॥
en: Then beholding the son of Pandu, to be the master of the field, and seeing his own troops greatly afflicted, Duryodhana, oppressed with fear thus addressed Bhishma

sn: एष पाण्डुसुतस्तात श्वेताश्वः कृष्णसारथिः। दहते मामकान् सर्वान् कृष्णवर्मेव काननम्॥
en: Duryodhana said "Yonder stands the son of Pandu, owing cream-coloured steeds and Krishna himself for his charioteer, consuming my ranks, O sire, like fire itself consuming a forest.

sn: पश्य सैन्यानि गाङ्गेय द्रवमाणानि सर्वशः। पाण्डवेन युधां श्रेष्ठ काल्यमानानि संयुगे॥
en: Behold, O son of Ganga, O foremost of warriors, my troops routed and afflicted in battle, on all sides by that son of Pandu.

sn: यथा पशुगणान् पाल: संकलयति कानने। तथेदं मामकं सैन्यं काल्यते शत्रुतापन॥
en: Just as a herd-man be labours his herd in the forest (with a cudgel), so, afflicter of foes, see my army belahored by Arjuna (with his arrows).

sn: धनंजयशरैर्भग्नं द्रवमाणं ततस्ततः। भीमोऽप्येवं दुराधर्षो विद्रावयति मे बलम्॥
en: Routed and shattered by the arrows of Dhananjaya as my troops are, the invincible Bhishma also is slaughtering them.

sn: सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। अभिमन्युः सुविक्रान्तो वाहिनीं द्रवते मम॥
en: Satyaki, Chekitana, the twin sons of Madri by Pandu, and also Abhimanyu of great prowess, all these warriors are crushing my hosts,

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तथा शूरो राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः। व्यद्रावयेतां सहसा सैन्यं मम महारणे॥
en: The heroic Dhrishtadyumna, aná the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha, also forcibly routing and driving away my troops in this fierce battle.

sn: वध्यमानस्य सैन्यस्य सर्वैरतैर्महारथैः। नान्यां गतिं प्रपश्यामि स्थाने युद्धे च भारत॥
en: Of these troops who are being ihus slaughtered by all these mighty car-warriors, i see no other refuge, regarding the staying on the field and fighting with the foe, O Bharata,

sn: ऋते त्वां पुरुषव्याघ्र देवतुल्यपराक्रम। पर्याप्तस्तु भवाशीघ्रं पीडितानां गतिर्भव॥
en: Than yourself, O foremost of men, who are equal to the celestials in battle. Therefore do you speedily confront those warriors, and so became the protector of my afflicted army.”

sn: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तो महाराज पिता देवव्रतस्तव। चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तं तु कृत्वा निश्चयमात्मनः॥
en: Thus spoken to, O mighty monarch, your sire Devavrata, reflecting for a moment only and forming his determination, are

sn: तव संधारयन् पुत्रमब्रवीच्छान्तनोः सुतः। दुर्योधन विजानीहि स्थिरो भूत्वा विशाम्पते॥
en: Spoke these words to your son, consoling him therewith "O Duryodhana, O ruler of men, hear patiently what I now speak to you.

sn: पूर्वकालं तव मया प्रतिज्ञातं महाबल। हत्वा दशसहस्राणि क्षत्रियाणां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Before the battle commenced, O mighty hero, I vowed to you, that slaying ten thousand high-souled Kshatriya warriors.

sn: संग्रामाद् व्यपयातव्यमेतत् कर्म ममाह्निकम्। इति तत् कृतवांश्चाहं यथोक्तं भरतर्षभ॥
en: Every day, I would desist from fighting. O foremost of the Bharatas, I have acted up to my words.

sn: अद्य चापि महत् कर्म प्रकरिष्ये महाबल। अहं वाद्य हतः शेष्ये हनिष्ये वाऽद्य पाण्डवान्॥
en: This day, O highly puissant hero, I shall perform a marvelous feat. Either slain I shall lie on the field, or I will today slay the Pandavas.

sn: अद्य ते पुरुषव्याघ्र प्रतिमोक्ष्ये ऋणं तव। भर्तृपिण्डकृतं राजन् निहतः पृतनामुखे॥
en: Today, O foremost of male being I will liquidate the debt I owe to you, debt arising out of the food you gave me-by shuffling off this mortal coil in the very thick of battle."

sn: इत्युक्त्वा भरतश्रेष्ठ क्षत्रियान् प्रवपञ्छरैः। आससाद दुराधर्षः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥
en: Having thus spoken, o foremost of the Bharatas, that invincible hero scattering his arrows broadcast among the Kshatriyas, rushed against the ranks of the Pandavas,

sn: अनीकमध्ये तिष्ठन्तं गाङ्गेयं भरतर्षभ। आशीविषमिव क्रुद्धं पाण्डवाः प्रत्यवारयन्॥
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, the Pandavas began to resist the son of Ganga wrought up with rage, remaining in the centre of his divisions and loO king like a snake of virulent poison.

sn: दशमेऽहनि भीष्मस्तु दर्शयशक्तिमात्मनः। राजञ्छतसहस्राणि सोऽवधीत् कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Then, O delighter of the Kuru race, on that the tenth day of the battle, Bhishma exhibiting his own prowess, O king, slew hundreds and thousands of warriors.

sn: पञ्चालानां च ये श्रेष्ठा राजपुत्रा महारथाः। तेषामादत्त तेजांसि जलं सूर्य इवांशुभिः॥
en: Of those who were the foremost princes amongst the Panchalas, he robbed the strength, like the sun drawing moisture with its rays.

sn: हत्वा दश सहस्राणि कुञ्जराणां तरस्विनाम्। सारोहाणां महाराज हयानां चायुतं तथा॥
en: Having slain ten thousand swift moving elephants and also, O monarch, ten thousand chargers with their riders,

sn: पूर्णे शतसहस्रे द्वे पादातानां नरोत्तमः। प्रजज्वाल रणे भीष्मो विधूम इव पावकः॥
en: And full hundred thousands of foot soldiers, that foremost of men, Bhishma, seemed to blaze forth like fire without a streak of smoke.

sn: न चैनं पाण्डवेयानां केचिच्छेकुर्निरीक्षितुम्। उत्तरं मार्गमास्थाय तपन्तमिव भास्करम्॥
en: None among the Pandava host was then able to look at him, as he then shone like the lustrous orb of the day shining in the Northern solstice.

sn: ते पाण्डवेयाः संरब्धा महेष्वासेन पीडिताः। वधायाभ्यद्रवन् भीष्मं सुंजयाश्च महारथाः॥
en: Then those Pandava troops and the mighty car-warriors of the Srinjaya clan, thus afflicted by Bhishma, in battle, rushed to slay that fierce bowmen.

sn: संयुद्ध्यमानो बहुभिर्भीष्मः शान्तनवस्तथा। अवकीर्णो महामेरुः शैलो मेधैरिवावृतः॥
en: Then fighting with tremendous odds, Bhishma the son of Shantanu looked like the mount Meru enveloped by clouds on all sides.

sn: पुत्रास्तु तव गाङ्गेयं समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्। महत्या सेनया सार्धं ततो युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Your son of Duryodhana supported by a mighty division protected Ganga's son by surrounding him on all sides.. Then ensued a terrible combat.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: संजय उवाच अर्जुनस्तु रणे राजन् दृष्ट्वा भीष्मस्य विक्रमम्। शिखण्डिनमथोवाच समभ्येहि पितामहम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O king, Arjuna beholding Bhishma's prowess in battle, addressed Shikhandin saying "Confront the grandsire.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: न चापि भीस्त्वया कार्या भीष्मादद्य कथंचना अहमेनं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः पातयिष्ये रथोत्तमात्॥
en: You should entertain no fear from Bhishma today, I will dislodge him from his excellent car with sharp arrows."

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: एवमुक्तस्तु पार्थेन शिखण्डी भरतर्षभ। अभ्यद्रवत गाङ्गेयं श्रुत्वा पार्थस्य भाषितम्॥
en: Thus spoken to by Partha, and having listened to the former's worlds, Shikhandin, O foremost of the Bharatas, rushed against the son of Ganga.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तथा राजन् सौभद्रश्च महारथः। हृष्टावाद्रवतां भीष्मं श्रुत्वा पार्थस्य भाषितम्॥
en: Then also, O king, Dhrishtadyumna and the mighty car-warrior the son of Subhadra, filled with delight at having heard Arjuna's word, rushed against Bhishma.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: विराटदुपदौ वृद्धौ कुन्तिभोजश्च दंशितः। अभ्यद्रवन्त गाङ्गेयं पुत्रस्य तव पश्यतः॥
en: Also the two aged warriors Virata and Drupada, and Kuntibhoja each protected with an armour, rushed against Ganga's son before the very eyes of your son.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: नकुलः सहदेवश्च धर्मराजश्च वीर्यवान्। तथेतराणि सैन्यानि सर्वाण्येव विशाम्पते॥
en: Nakula, and Sahadeva, and the highly powerful Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, as also the other inferior soldiers, O ruler of men,

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: समाद्रवन्त गाङ्गेयं श्रुत्वा पार्थस्य भाषितम्। प्रत्युद्ययुस्तावकाश्च समेतांस्तान् महारथान्॥ यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं तन्मे निगदतः शृणु।
en: All advanced against the son of Ganga. As to your warriors who comforted, to the best of their abilities and to the best of their energies, hose united and mighty car-warriors of the enemy, hear me speak.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: चित्रसेनो महाराज चेकितानं समभ्ययात्॥ भीष्मप्रेप्सुं रणे यान्तं वृषं व्याघ्रशिशुर्यथा।
en: Chitrasena, O king, confronted in battle Chekitana who had been proceeding against Bhishma in battle like a tiger cub rushing against a bull.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नं महाराज भीष्मान्तिकमुपागतम्॥ त्वरमाणं रणे यत्तं कृतवर्मा न्यवारयत्।
en: Kritavarma checked Dhrishtadyumna, O king, who having speedily approached Bhishma was then displaying his prowess in battle.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: भीमसेनं सुसंक्रुद्ध गाङ्गेयस्य वधैषिणम्॥ त्वरमाणो महाराज सौमदत्तिर्यवारयत्।
en: O monarch, then with great activity Somadatta's encountered Bhimasena inflamed with rage and exerting for the slaughter of Ganga's son.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तथैव नकुलं शूरं किरन्तं सायकान् बहून्॥ विकर्णो वारयामास इच्छन् भीष्मस्य जीवितम्।
en: Then Vikarna, desirous of protecting the life of Bhishma checked the heroic Nakula who had been shooting myriads of shafts.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: सहदेवं तथा राजन् यान्तं भीष्मरथं प्रति॥ वारयामास संक्रुद्धः कृपः शारद्वतो युधि।
en: Then Kripa, the son of Sharadvata, wrought up with rage, checked, in battle, Sahadeva proceeding towards the car of Bhishma.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: राक्षसं क्रूरकर्माणं भैमसेनि महाबलम्॥ भीष्मस्य निधनं प्रेप्सुं सुद्रमुखोऽभ्यद्रवद् बली।
en: Then the powerful Durmukha rushed against the highly powerful Rakshasa of fearful deeds, that son of Bhimasena who was desirous of slaying Bhishma. son

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: सात्यकिं समरे यान्तं तव पुत्रो न्यवारयत्॥ अभिमन्यु महाराज यान्तं भीष्मरथं प्रति। सुदक्षिणो महाराज काम्बोजः प्रत्यवारयत्॥ विराटदुपदौ वृद्धौ समेतावरिमर्दनौ। अश्वत्थामा ततः क्रुद्धो वारयामास भारत।॥ तथा पाण्डुसुतं ज्येष्ठं भीष्मस्य वधकाक्षिणम्। भारद्वाजो रणे यत्तो धर्मपुत्रमवारयत्॥ अर्जुनं रभसं युद्धे पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम्। भीष्मप्रेप्सुं महाराज भासयन्तं दिशो दश॥ दुःशासनो महेष्वासो वारयामास संयुगे।
en: Your son (Duryodhana) resisted Satyaki proceeding to battle. Sudakshina, the ruler of the Kamvojas, checked, O king, Abhimanyu as he was rushing against the car of Bhishma. Ashvathama inflamed with wrath, O Bharata, checked the two aged warriors, those crushers of foes, Virata and Drupada. Then the son of Bharadvaja carefully, fighting checked the son of Pandu (Yudhishthira), as he was proceeding desirous of slaying Bhishma. Then, O king, the fierce bow-man Dushasana checked in battle, Arjuna himself, who desirous of reaching near Bhishma was advancing, placing Shikhandin before him, and illumining the ten points of the compass.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अन्ये च तावका योधाः पाण्डवानां महारथान्॥ भीष्मस्याभिमुखान् यातान् वारयामासुराहवे।
en: Other warriors of your host resisted in that battle the mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host as they were proceeding towards Bhishma in battle.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु सैन्यानि प्राक्रोशंस्तु पुनः पुनः॥ अभ्यद्रवत संरब्धा भीष्ममेकं महारथः।
en: Then excited to the highest pitch of fury, the mighty car-warrior Dhrishtadyumna rushed against Bhishma, repeatedly addressing the troops thus in a laud voice,

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: एषोऽर्जुनो रणे भीष्मं प्रयाति कुरुनन्दनः॥ अभ्यद्रवत मा मैष्ट भीष्मो हि प्राप्स्यते न वः।
en: “You delighter of the Kurus Arjuna himself is rushing towards Bhishma. Rush you then upon the latter, and be not afraid. Bhishma will never be able to assail you.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अर्जुनं समरे योद्धं नोत्सहेतापि वासवः॥ किमु भीष्मो रणे वीरा गतसत्त्वोऽल्पजीवितः।
en: Even Vasava himself is not capable of withstanding Arjuna in battle, what to speak of the heroic Bhishma whose energy is gone and life is exhausted?”

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: इति सेनापतेः श्रुत्वा पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥ अभ्यद्रवन्त संहृष्टा गाङ्गेयस्य रथं प्रति।
en: Hearing these words of their generallissimo, the mighty car-warriors.of the Pandava host, with delighted hearts, rushed against the car of the son of Ganga.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: आगच्छमानान् समरे वार्योधान् प्रलयानिव॥ अवारयन्त संहृष्टास्तावकाः पुरुषर्षभाः।
en: Then those warriors of your army, all foremost of men, cheerfully resisted that onslaught of the Pandavas that looked like a furiously advancing mass of living energy.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: दुःशासनो महाराज भयं त्यक्त्वा महारथः॥ भीष्मस्य जीविताकाक्षि धनंजयमुपाद्रवत्।
en: Then, O mighty monarch, the great carwarrior Dushasana, desirous of saying Bhishma's confronted Dhananjaya, dismissing all fear from his mind.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तथैव पाण्डवाः शूरा गाङ्गेयस्य रथं प्रति॥ अभ्यद्रवन्त संग्रामे तव पुत्रान् महारथाः।
en: So also the heroic Pandavas rushing towards the car of Ganga's son, assailed your sons, all mighty car-warriors.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम चित्ररूपं विशाम्पते॥ दुःशासनरथं प्राप्य यत् पार्थो नात्यवर्तत।
en: Then, O monarch, we beheld a wonderful incident, namely that reaching Dushasana's car Partha could not advance further.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: यथा वारयते वेला क्षुब्धतोयं महार्णवम्॥ तथैव पाण्डवं क्रुद्धं तव पुत्रो न्यवारयत्।
en: Just as the banks resist the mighty main with its waters agitated, so did your son resist that son of Pandu inflamed with rage. life,

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: उभो तौ रथिनां श्रेष्ठावुभौ भारत दुर्जयौ॥ उभी चन्द्रार्कसदृशौ कान्त्या दीप्त्या च भारत।
en: Both of them were excellent car-warriors, both were invincible, O Bharata, and both resembled the moon and the sun in splendor and beauty.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तथा तौ जातसंरम्भावन्योन्यवधकाक्षिणौ॥ समीयतुर्महासंख्ये मयशक्रौ यथा पुरा।
en: Then like Maya and Shakra encountering each other in the days of yore, those two heroes encountered each other in battle, highly excited with wrath, and desirous of slaying one another.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: दुःशासनो महाराज पाण्डवं विशिखैस्त्रिभिः॥ वासुदेवं च विंशत्या ताडयामास संयुगे।
en: Then, O monarch, Dushasana wondered the son of Pandu with three shafts in battle, and the soli of Vasudeva with twenty.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: ततोऽर्जुनो जातमन्युष्र्णेयं वीक्ष्य पीडितम्॥ दुःशासनं शतेनाजौ नाराचानां समार्पयत्।
en: Thereat Arjuna waxing wroth upon beholding him of the Vrishni race afflicted with arrows, sped hundred long shafts at Dushasana in that encounter.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा पपुः शोणितमाहवे॥ दुःशासनस्त्रिभिः क्रुद्धः पार्थं विव्याध पत्रिभिः। ललाटे भरतश्रेष्ठ शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ ललाटस्यैस्तु तैर्बाणैः शुशुभे पाण्डवो रणे।
en: Those shafts, penetrating through the letters armour's drank his life-blood. Thereupon, inflamed with rage, Dushasana pierced Pritha's Sual with three shafts. Then again, O foremost of the Bharata, he pierced Arjuna with three shafts of exceeding sharpness, on the forehead. Then with those arrows, struck on the forehead, Pandu's son appeared beautiful like.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: यथा मेरुर्महाराज शृङ्रत्यर्थमुच्छ्रितैः॥ सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासः पुत्रेण तव धन्विना।
en: The mount Meru with its crests towering high in the heavens. Pierced deeply by your son wielding the bow, that mighty bowman.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: व्यराजत रणे पार्थः किंशुकः पुष्पवानिव॥ दुःशासनं ततः क्रुद्धः पीडयामस पाण्डवः।
en: Partha appeared beautiful like the flowering Kinshuka tree. Then that son of Pandu, greatly excited afflicted Dushasana,

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: पर्वणीव सुसंक्रुद्धो राहुः पूर्ण निशाकरम्॥ पीड्यमानो बलवता पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते।
en: Like the enraged Rahu afflicting the full moon on the fifteenth day of the light half of a month. Then thus afflicted by the powerful Partha, your son, O ruler of men,

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: विव्याध समरे पार्थं कङ्कपत्रैः शिलाशितैः॥ तस्य पार्थो धनुश्छित्त्वा रथं चास्य त्रिभिः शरैः। आजघान ततः पश्चात् पुत्रं ते निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Pierced the former with arrows winged with the feathers of the Kanka bird and whetted on stone. Then Partha bursting open Dushasana's bow and shattering his car with his three arrows. Then he pierced many sharpened arrows on him.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय भीष्मस्य प्रमुखे स्थितः। अर्जुनं पञ्चविंशत्या बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: Then he took another shaft and stood before Bhishma. He pierced twentyfive shafts on the chaste of Arjuna

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: तस्य क्रुद्धो महाराज पाण्डवः शत्रुतापनः। अप्रैषीद् विशिखान् घोरान् यमदण्डोपमान् बहून्॥ अप्राप्तानेव तान् बाणांश्चिच्छेद तनयस्तव।
en: Then Arjuna, the afflicter of foes, with enger, O king! shot at him numerous dreadful arrows resembling the mace of Death himself. Then your son cut off those arrows before they could reach him.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: यतमानस्य पार्थस्य तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥ पार्थं च निशितैर्बाणैरविध्यत् तनयस्तव।
en: Sped though they were by Partha excreting his best in battle. Indeed this appeared to be marvelous. Once more your son pierced the son of Pritha with shafts of exceedingly ! sharpness.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे पार्थः शरान् संधाय कार्मुके॥ प्रेषयामास समरे स्वर्णपुडाञ्छिलाशितान्।
en: Thereupon, wrought up with rage Partha fixing on his bow-string arrows full finished with gold wings and whetted on stone, discharged them at your son.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: न्यमज्जंस्ते महाराज तस्य काये महात्मनः॥ यथा हंसा महाराज तडागं प्राप्य भारत।
en: These shafts, O monarch, entered into the body of the illustrious Dushasana, like swans, O Bharata, diving into the waters of a lake.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: पीडितश्चैव पुत्रस्ते पाण्डवेन महात्मना॥ हित्वा पार्थं रणे तूर्णं भीष्मस्य रथमाव्रजत्।
en: Thus your son sorely afflicted by the illustrious son of Pandu, quickly avoiding him proceeded towards the chariot of Bhishma.

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अगाधे मज्जतस्तस्य द्वीपो भीष्मोऽभवत् तदा॥ प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते।
en: Then indeed Bhishma was like an island to him who was sinking into the fathomless deep (of pain): Then, O ruler of men, regaining his senses, your son,

description: The encounter between Arjuna and Dushasana
sn: अवारयत् ततः शूरो भूय एव पराक्रमी॥ शरैः सुनिशितैः पार्थं यथा वृत्रं पुरंदरः। निर्बिभेद महाकायो विव्यथे नैव चार्जुनः॥
en: Endued with bravery, and prowess, again began to check Partha with well-sharpened shafts, like Indra resisting Vritra. Your son of huge stature, penetrated Arjuna through and through but the latter did feel no pain at all.

sn: संजय उवाच सात्यकिं दंशितं युद्धे भीष्मायाभ्युद्यतं रणे। आर्ण्यशृङ्गिर्महेष्वासो वारयामास संयुगे॥
en: Sanjaya said The son of Rishyashringa, that fierce bowman resisted in battle Satyaki, who clad in mail was rushing towards Bhishma in battle.

sn: माधवस्तु सुसंक्रुद्धो राक्षसं नवभिः शरैः। आजघान रणे राजन् प्रहसन्निव भारत॥
en: Thereupon, O king, he of Madhu's race, wrought up with rage, wounded the Rakshasa with nine shafts, as if smiling.

sn: तथैव राक्षसौ राजन् माधवं नवभिः शरैः। अर्दयामास राजेन्द्र संक्रुद्धः शिनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: So also, O king, the enraged Rakshasa with nine shafts afflicted the illustrious grandson of Shini of the race of Madhu.

sn: शैनेयः सरसंघं तु प्रेषयामास संयुगे। राक्षसाय सुसंक्रुद्धो माधवः परवीरहा॥
en: Then that slayer of hostile heroes that descendant of Madhu race viz., the grandson of Shini, excited to the highest pitch of fury, shot numerous shafts at the Rakshasa in battle.

sn: ततो रक्षो महाबाहुं सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम्। विव्याध विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैः सिंहनादं ननाद च।॥
en: Then the mighty-armed Rakshasa, O you uf prowess incapable of being baffled, pierced Satyaki with sharp arrows and uttered aloud his war-cry.

sn: माधवस्तु भृशं विद्धो राक्षसेन रणे तदा। वार्यमाणश्च तेजस्वी जहास च ननाद च॥
en: Then that powerful descendant of Madhu's race also, though deeply pierced by Rakshasa, depending on his own energy, smiled and uttered his war-cry.

sn: भगदत्तस्ततः क्रुद्धो माधवं निशितैः शरैः। ताडयामास समरे तोत्रैरिव महागजम्॥
en: Then, Bhagadatta, wrought up with wrath in battle, pierced with whetted shafts that descendant of Madhu's race, like a guide piercing a huge elephant with a hook.

sn: विहाय राक्षसं युद्धे शैनेयो रथिनां वरः। प्राग्ज्योतिषाय चिक्षेप शरान् संनतपर्वणः॥
en: Then leaving alone the Rakshasa in battle, that foremost of car-warriors namely the grandson of Shini, hurled dares of depressed knots against the ruler of the Pragjyotishas.

sn: तस्य प्राग्ज्योतिषो राजा माधवस्य महद् धनुः। चिच्छेद शतधारेण भल्लेन कृतहस्तवत्॥
en: Then the ruler of the Pragjyotishas with a sharp-edged broad headed shaft cut off the mighty bow of the descendant of Madhu's race, displaying great lightness of hand.

sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय वेगवत् परवीरहा। भगदत्तं रणे क्रुद्ध विव्याध निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Thereupon, that slayer of hostile heroes, taking up another bow of great toughness, pierced the enraged Bhagadatta with sharp shafts in battle.

sn: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासः सृक्किणी परिसंलिहन्। शक्तिं कनकवैदूर्यभूषितामायसीं दृढाम्॥ यमदण्डोपमा घोरां चिक्षेप परमाहवे। तामांपतन्ती सहसा तस्य बाहुबलेरिताम्॥ सात्यकिः समरे राजन् द्विधाचिच्छेद सायकैः। ततः पपात सहसा महोल्केव हतप्रभा॥
en: Thus deeply pierced, that mighty bow man, licking the corners of his mouth, hurled at Satyaki an iron lance decked with gold and lapises, of great toughness, and terrible like the mace of Death. Then Satyaki with his arrows cut off that lance, O king, that had been coursing swiftly towards him, being shot by the force of Bhagadatta's arm. Then that lance fell down with force on the ground like a large meteor shorn of its splendour.

sn: शक्तिं विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते। महता रथवंशेन वारयामास माधवम्॥
en: Beholding that lance to be baffled, your son, O ruler of men, checked him of Madhu's race, surrounding him with a large number of cars,

sn: तथा परिवृतं दृष्ट्वा वार्ष्णेयानां महारथम्। दुर्योधनो भृशं क्रुद्धो भ्रातॄन् सर्वानुवाच ह॥
en: Then seeing that mighty car-warrior of the Vrishni race thus surrounded, king Duryodhana highly excited with rage, thus spoke to his brothers.

sn: तथा कुरुत कौरव्या यथा वः सात्यको युधि। न जीवन् प्रतिनिर्याति महतोऽस्माद् रथव्रजात्॥
en: “Do you all so strive, O Kurus, that this Satyaki may not return back with his life from this mighty host of chariots.

sn: तस्मिन् हते हतं मन्ये पाण्डवानां महद् बलम्। तथेति च वचस्तस्य परिगृह्य महारथाः॥
en: If he be slain, I may then consider the whole host of the Pandavas as nothing more than slain.” Then accepting his words by saying 'yea', the mighty car-warriors,

sn: शैनेयं योधयामासुर्भीष्मायाभ्युद्यतं रणे। काम्बोजराजो बलवान् वारयामास संयुगे॥ आर्जुनिं नृपतिविद्ध्वा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। पुनरेव चतुःषष्ट्या राजन् विव्याध तं नृप॥
en: Stationed in front of Bhishma began to fight with the grandson of Shini. Then the powerful ruler of the Kambojas checked, in battle, Abhimanyu who had been vigorously advancing against Bhishma. Then the son of Arjuna having pierced the king with arrows of depressed knots,

sn: सुदक्षिणस्तु समरे पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः। सारथिं चास्य नवभिरिच्छन् भोष्मस्य जीवितम्॥ तद् युद्धमासीत् सुमहत् तयोस्तत्र समागमे।
en: Once more wounded the king with sixty four arrows. Thereupon Sudakshina also, desirous of saving Bhishma's life in battle, pierced Abhimanyu with five shafts and the latter's charioteer with nine arrows. Then the battle that ensued consequent upon the encounter of those two heroes, exceedingly pierce.

sn: यदाभ्यधावद् गाङ्गेयं शिखण्डी शत्रुकर्शनः॥ विराटदुपदौ वृद्धौ वारयन्तौ महाचमूम्। भीष्मं च युधि संरब्धावाद्रवन्तौ महारथौ॥ अश्वत्थामा रणे क्रुद्धः समायाद्रथसत्तमः।
en: Shikhandin that grinder of foes rushed against the son of Ganga. The two old mighty car-warriors, Draupada and Virata, inflamed with rage, rushed to fight with Bhishma, holding at bay the army of the Kauravas as was they advanced. Thereupon that foremost of carwarriors namely Ashvathama, wrought up with wrath confronted both those warriors in battle.

sn: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तयोस्तस्य च भारत॥ विराटो दशभिर्भल्लैराजघान परंतप।
en: Then, O Bharata, a dreadful fight ensued between him and the old heroes. ( afflicter of foes, with ten broad-headed shafts Virata wondered.

sn: यतमानं मद्देष्वासं द्रौणिमाहवशोभिनम्॥ दुपदश्च त्रिभिर्बाणैर्विव्याध निशितैस्तदा।
en: The mighty bowman, the son of Drona, the ornament of the field of battle as he advanced with velocity towards them. Draupada also with his sharp arrows pierced Ashvathama.

sn: गुरुपुत्रं समासाद्य प्रहरन्तौ महाबलौ॥ अश्वत्थामा ततस्तौ तु विव्याध बहुभिः शरैः।
en: Then Ashvathama pierced with numerous shafts those two mighty warriors who having neared the son of the preceptor, had been wounding him with arrows.

sn: विराटद्रुपदौ वीरौ भीष्मं प्रति समुद्यतः॥ तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम वृद्धयोश्चरितं महत्।
en: Still the heroes Virata and Draupada advanced towards Bhishma; we then beheld an admirable feat achieved by those two old warriors,

sn: यद् द्रौणिसायकान् घोरान् प्रत्यवारयतां युधि॥ सहदेवं तथा यान्तं कृपः शारद्वतोऽभ्ययात्।
en: In as much as they repulsed all the dreadful arrows shot by Drona's son. Then Kripa the son of Sharadvata rushed against the advancing Sahadeva,

sn: यथा नागो वने नागं मत्तो मत्तमुपाद्रवत्॥ कृपश्च समरे शूरो माद्रीपुत्रं महारथम्। आजधान शरैस्तूर्णं सप्तत्या रुक्मभूषणैः॥ तस्य माद्रीसुतश्चापं द्विधा चिच्छेद सायकैः। अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं विव्याध नवभिः शरैः॥
en: Like one infuriated elephants rushing against a compeer in the same state, in the woods. Then the heroic Kripa quickly pierced that mighty car-warrior the son of Madri with seventy shafts all decked with golden wings. Then the son of Madri burst his bow in twain with his strong shafts.

sn: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय समरे भारसाधनम्। माद्रीपुत्रं सुसंहृष्टो दशभिर्निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Then the former pierced the latter whose bow has been cut asunder with nine shafts. The latter then taking up another bow capable of bearing great strain.

sn: आजघानोरसि क्रुद्ध इच्छन् भीष्मस्य जीवितम्। तथैव पाण्डवो राजञ्छारद्वतममर्षणम्॥
en: And desirous of saving the life of Bhishma and excited with anger, struck cheerfully on the breast the son of Madri with ten shafts of exceeding sharpness.

sn: आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो भीष्मस्य वधकाझ्या। तयोर्युद्धं समभवद् घोररूपं भयावहम्॥
en: So also, O king, urged by the desire for slaying Bhishma, the son of Pandu also worked up with rage struck the wrathful son of Sharadvata on his breast.

sn: नकुलं तु रणे क्रुद्धो विकर्णः शत्रुतापनः! विव्याध सायकैः षष्ट्या रक्षन् भीष्मं महाबलम्॥ नकुलोऽपि भृशं विद्धस्तव पुत्रेण धीमता।
en: Then ensued a fierce fight of terrible aspect and capable of inspiring terror. Then that afflicter of foes viz., Vikarna, desirous of rescuing the grandsire, and waxed up with rage, pierced Nakula in battle with no less then sixty shafts. Thus deeply pierced by your highly intelligent son, Nakula also.

sn: विकर्णं सप्तसप्तत्या निर्बिभेद शिलीमुखैः॥ तत्र तौ नरशार्दूलौ भीष्महेतोः परंतपौ। अन्योन्यं जघ्नतुर्वीरो गोष्ठे गोवृषभाविव॥
en: Penetrated Vikarna with seven and sixty sharp arrows. Then for the sake of Bhishma, those two foremost of men, those two afflicters of foes,

sn: घटोत्कचं रणे यान्तं निघ्नन्तं तव वाहिनीम्। दुर्मुखः समरे प्रायाद भीष्महेतोः पराक्रमी॥ हैडिम्बस्तु रणे राजन् दुर्मुखं शत्रुतापनम्। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः शरेणानतपर्वणा॥ भीमसेनसुतं चापि दुर्मुखः सुमुखैः शरैः। षष्ट्या वीरो नदन् हृष्टो विव्याध रणमूर्धनि॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं तथाऽऽयान्तं भीष्मस्य वधकाक्षिणम्। हार्दिक्यो वारयामास रथश्रेष्ठं महारथः॥ हार्दिक्य: पार्षतं चापि विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिरायसैः। पुनः पञ्चाशता तूर्णं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Those two heroes began to assail one another like two heifers among a herd of kine. Then for the sake of protecting Bhishma, the mighty Durmukha confronted the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha, who had been advancing to the fight slaying your troops. Then, O king, the son of Hidimba excited with wrath, struck that afflicter of foes viz., Durmukha on the breast with an arrow of straight knots. Then the heroes Durmukha, having cheerfully pierced Bhimasena's son with sixty keep-pointed arrows, uttered his war-cry, standing at the van of the army. Then that mighty car-warrior, the son of Hridika checked that foremost of carwarriors Dhrishtadyumna as he was advancing desirous of slaying Bhishma. Then the son of Prishata having pierced Hridika's son with five iron dares,

sn: आजघान महाबाहुः पार्षतं तं महारथम्। तं चैव पार्षतो राजन् हार्दिक्यं नवभिः शरैः॥ विव्याध निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैः कङ्कपत्रैरजिह्मगैः। तयोः समभवद् युद्धं भीष्मरुतोर्महाहवे॥
en: Once more quickly struck him between his breasts with fifty shafts. Similarly, O king, Hridika's son pierced the son of Prishata with nine arrow's exceedingly sharp and effulgent and furnished with wings made of the feathers of Kanka birds. Then for the sake of Bhishma, a pierced battle raged between them,

sn: अन्योयातिशये युक्तं यथा वृत्रमहेन्द्रयोः। भीमसेन तथाऽऽयान्त भीष्मं प्रति महारथम्॥ भूरिश्रवाभ्ययात् तूर्णं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्। सौमदत्तिरथो भीममाजघान स्तनान्तरे॥
en: As they struck one another with great ardor, like that between Vritra and the great Indra. Bhurishravas speedily came upon the mighty Bhimasena who had been falling upon Bhishma. Then the son of Somadatta wounded Bhima in the centre of his chest,

sn: नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन रुक्मपुड्वेन संयुगे। उरःस्थेन बभौ तेन भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: With a long shaft of great sharpness and golden wings. With that shaft struck on his breast, the puissant Bhimasena appeared beautiful,

sn: स्कन्दशक्त्या यथा क्रौञ्चः पुरा नृपतिसत्तम। तौ शरान् सूर्यसंकाशान् कर्मारपरिमार्जितान्॥ अन्योन्यस्य रणे क्रुद्धौ चिक्षिपाते नरर्षभौ। भीमो भीष्मवधाकाक्षी सौमदत्तिं महारथम्॥
en: Like the Krauncha mountain, O foremost of kings, in the days of yore bearing the lance of Skanda. Then these two foremost of men, inflamed with fury, sped at one another, arrows of solar effulgence and burnished by the forgers themselves. Then Bhima desirous of slaying Bhishma fought with that mighty carwarrior viz., Somadatta's son,

sn: तथा भीष्मजये गृनुः सौमदत्तिस्तु पाण्डवम्। कृतप्रतिकृते यत्तौ योधयामासतू रणे॥
en: Similarly the latter longing for the victory if Bhishma, struggled with the former, both striving to counteract one another in his feats.

sn: युधिष्ठिरं तु कौन्तेयं महत्या सेनया वृतम्। भीष्माभिमुखमायान्तं भारद्वाजो न्यवारयत्॥
en: The son of Bharadvaja held in check that son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, who was coming upon Bhishma, surrounded by his large division.

sn: द्रोणस्य रथनिर्घोषं पर्जन्यनिनदोपमम्। श्रुत्वा प्रभद्रका राजन् समकम्पन्त मारिष॥
en: Then, O king, hearing the clatter of Drona's chariot, that resembled the rumble of the raincloud Parjanya, the Prabhadrakas, O sire, quaked (with fear).

sn: सा सेना महती राजन् पाण्डुपुत्रस्य संयुगे। द्रोणेन वारिता यत्ता न चचाल पदात् पदम्॥
en: Thus assailed by Drona that mighty division of the son of Pandu could not stir one step forward, though striving vigorously.

sn: चेकितानं रणे यत्तं भीष्मं प्रति जनेश्वर। चित्रसेनस्तव सुतः क्रुद्धरूपमवारयत्॥
en: Then your son Chitrasena, with a fearful expression, checked in battle Chekitana advancing, O ruler of men, against Bhishma.

sn: भीष्महेतोः पराक्रान्तश्चित्रसेनः पराक्रमी। चेकितानं परं शक्त्या योधयामास भारत॥
en: Then for the sake of Bhishma, that mighty car-warriors (Chitrasena) endued with prowess and a praiseworthy quickness of hand, fought, O Bharata, to the best of his abilities, with Chekitana;

sn: तथैव चेकितानोऽपि चित्रसेनमवारयत्। तद् युद्धमासीत् सुमहत् तयोस्तत्र समागमे॥
en: Similarly Chekitana also fought with him with equal ardor. Then fierce was the battle that commenced consequent upon their encountering each other.

sn: अर्जुनो वार्यमाणस्तु बहुशस्तत्र भारत। विमुखीकृत्य पुत्रं ते सेनां तव ममर्द ह।।५६।
en: Then, O Bharata, Arjuna though resisted by your son, repulsed the latter's divisions and began to crush your troops.

sn: दुःशासनोऽषि परया शक्त्या पार्थमवारयत्। कथं भीष्मं न नो हन्यादिति निश्चित्य भारत॥
en: But Dushasana resisted Partha to the best of this powers, determined, O Bharata, that the latter might hot slay Bhishma.

sn: सा वध्यमाना समरे पुत्रस्य तव वाहिनी। लोड्यते रथिभिः श्रेष्ठस्तत्र तत्रैव भारत॥
en: Thus the army of your son being thus slaughtered, the foremost of car-warriors began, O Bharata, to betray sings of agitation.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: संजय उवाच अथ वीरो महेष्वासो मत्तवारणविक्रमः। समादाय महच्चापं मत्तवारणवारणम्॥ विन्धुन्वानो नरश्रेष्ठो द्रावयाणो वरूथिनीम्। पृतनां पाण्डवेयानां गाहमानो महाबलः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then that foremost of men, the valiant Drona, that fierce bow-man possessed of the prowess of an infuriate elephants and of great energy taking up and shaking his bow capable of checking even an infuriate elephant, began to crush the arrayed lines of the Pandavas, having penetrated into their very midst.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: निमित्तानि निमित्तज्ञः सर्वतो वीक्ष्य वीर्यवान्। प्रतपन्तमनीकानि द्रोणः पुत्रमभाषत॥
en: That highly powerful one conversant with the nature of all omens beholding various omens on all sides, thus addressed his son who had also been consuming the ranks of the enemy.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: अयं हि दिवसस्तात यत्र पार्थो महाबलः। जिघांसुः समरे भीष्मं परं यत्नं करिष्यति॥
en: "This indeed is the day, O son, on which the highly powerful son of Pritha desirous of slaying Bhishma in battle, will exert his utmost.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: उत्पतन्ति हि मे बाणा धनुः प्रस्फुरतीव च। योगमस्त्राणि गच्छन्ति क्रूर मे वर्तते मतिः॥
en: My arrows are coming out of their own accord, and my bow seems to gape. My weapons are falling off when I am trying to fix them on the bow-string, and my mind is losing and warmth.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: दिश्वशान्तानि घोराणि व्याहरन्ति मृगद्विजाः। नीचैर्गध्रा निलीयन्ते भारतानां चमूं प्रति॥
en: Animals and birds are emitting fearful and inauspicious cries on all sides. The vultures are swooping down upon the mighty host of the Bharatas.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: नष्टप्रभ इवादित्यः सर्वतो लोहिता दिशः। रसते व्यथते भूमिः कम्पतीव च सर्वशः॥
en: The sun seems to be waned in its effulgence; all the points of the compass have assumed a crimson hue. The earth seems to be pained and to utter cries and to tremble on all sides.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: कङ्का गृध्रा बलाकश्च व्याहरन्ति मुहुर्मुहुः। शिवाश्चैवाशिवा घोरा वेदयन्त्यो महद् भयम्॥
en: The Kanka birds, the vultures and the cranes are incessantly uttering cries. The jackals are uttering inauspicious and dreadful yells foreboding a terrible calamity.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: पपात महती चोल्का मध्येनादित्यमण्डलात्। सकबन्धश्च परिघो भानुमावृत्य तिष्ठति॥
en: Mighty meteors seem to shot out for the centre of the solar disc. The constellation Parigha with irunkless form seems to over-rode the sun.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: परिवेषस्तथा घोरश्चन्द्रभास्करयोरभूत्। वेदयानो भयं घोरं राज्ञां देहावकर्तनम्॥
en: The and the lunar discs have assumed dreadful aspects, foreboding terrible calamity to the kings, in the shape of the mangling of। their bodies.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: देवतायतनस्थाश्च कौरवेन्द्रस्य देवताः। कम्पन्ते च हसन्ते च नृत्यन्ति च रुदन्ति च॥
en: The images of gods consecrating the temples of the Kuru king are laughing trembling and dancing, and lamenting.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: अपसव्यं ग्रहाश्चक्रुरलक्ष्माणं दिवाकरम्। अवाक्शिराश्च भगवानुपातिष्ठत चन्द्रमाः॥
en: The planets are revolving, keeping the inauspicious sun to their left; and the charming deity of the moon is risen with his horns downwards.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: वपूंषि च नरेन्द्राणां विगताभानि लक्षये। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु न च भ्राजन्ति दंशिताः॥
en: The persons of kings belonging to the host Dhritarashtra's son appear to have lost all splendor, and though clad in armour, they do not seem to be shining,

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: सेनयोरुभयोश्चापि समन्ताच्छूयते महान्। पाञ्चजन्यस्य निर्घोषो गाण्डीवस्य च निःस्वनः॥
en: A loud uproar set up by the two armies is heard, as also the blare of the conch Panchajanya, and the twang of bow Gandiva.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: ध्रुवमास्थाय बीभूत्सुरुत्तमास्त्राणि संयुगे। अपास्यान्यान् रणे योधानभ्येष्यति पितामहम्॥
en: Surely Vibhatsu will, with the help of his excellent weapons, leaving, other warriors in battle, confront the grandsire.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: हृष्यन्ति रोमकूपाणि सीदतीव च मे मनः। चिन्तयित्वा महाबाहो भीष्मार्जुनसमागमम्॥
en: The pores, of the hair of my body are being contracted, and my mind mis-gives, thinking, o hero of long arms, of the battle that will ensue between Bhishma and Arjuna.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: तं चेह निकृतिप्रज्ञं पाञ्चाल्यं पापचेतसम्। पुरस्कृत्य रणे पार्थो भीष्मस्यायोधनं गतः॥
en: Placing before him that prince of the Panchalas, who is of sinful and who is ever inclined to deceitful behaviour, Partha is proceeding for battle towards Bhishma.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: अब्रवीच्च पुरा भीष्मो नाहं हन्यां शिखण्डिनम्। स्त्री ह्येषा विहिता धात्रा दैवाच्च स पुनः पुमान्॥
en: Bhishma had said before, I will never slay Shikhandin. He was created a female by the Creator, but has became a man out of chance only.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: अमङ्गल्यध्वजश्चैव याज्ञसेनिर्महाबलः। न ग्रामङ्गलिके तस्मिन् प्रहरेदापगासुतः॥
en: This mighty son of Yajnasena is thus reckoned as an inauspicious sign. The son of the ocean-going Ganga will not therefore strike that inauspicious person.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: एतद् विचिन्तयानस्य प्रज्ञा सीदति मे भृशम्। अभ्युद्यतो रणे पार्थः कुरुवृद्धमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Thus as I reflect, my mind mis-gives, knowing that Arjuna is rushing against the old grandsire of the Kurus, highly wrought up with rage.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: युधिष्ठिरस्य च क्रोधो भीष्मश्चार्जुनसङ्गत्तः। मम चास्त्रसमारम्भः प्रजानामशिवं ध्रुवम्॥
en: These three namely, the wrath of Yudhishthira, the encounter between Bhishma and Arjuna and my exceptions in this battle are surely very harmful to the creatures.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: मनस्वी बलवाञ्छूरः कृतास्त्रो लघुविक्रमः। दूरपाती दृढेषुश्च निमित्तज्ञश्च पाण्डवः॥
en: The son of Pandu is highly intelligent, endued with strength, heroic, accomplished in the use of weapons, possessed of great agility and lightness; he is capable of shooting his arrows to a great distance, and is firm in shooting them and is conversant with the nature of omens.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: अजेयः समरे चापि देवैरपि सवासवैः। बलवान् बुद्धिमांश्चैव जितक्लेशो युधां वरः॥
en: He is invincible in battle cven by the celestial headed by Vasava himself. He is mighty, quick-witted, indefeasible and the foremost of ali warriors;

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: विजयी च रणे नित्यं भैरवास्त्रश्च पाण्डवः। तस्य मार्ग परिहरन् दुतं गच्छ यतव्रत॥
en: He is ever victorious in battle and possessed of dreadful weapons. Avoiding his path do you repair to Bhishma of regulated vows.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: पश्यायैतन्महाघोरे संयुगे वैशसं महत्। हेमचित्राणि शूराणां महान्ति च शुभानि च।॥ कवचान्यवदीर्यन्ते शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। छिद्यन्ते च ध्वजाग्राणि तोमराश्च धनूंषि च॥ प्रासाश्च विमलास्तीक्ष्णाः शक्त्यश्च कनकोज्ज्वला:। वैजयन्त्यश्च नागानां संक्रुद्धेन किरीटिना।॥
en: This day you will behold in battle a terrible massacre. Auspicious, mighty and gold-decked armors of heroes will be splintered into pieces with arrows of close knots; the tops of standards, the tomaras and bows, and resplendent and sharp lances, and dares of the effulgence of gold and the caparisons of elephants shall this day be torn and broken by the enraged diadem decked Arjuna.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: नायं संरक्षितुं काल: प्राणान् पुत्रोपजीविभिः। याहि स्वर्ग पुरस्कृत्य यशसे विजयाय च॥
en: This is not the time, O son for dependents to take care of their own lives. So, keeping paradise in view, do you rush to battle for winning victory and fame.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: रथनागहयावर्ती महाघोरां सुदुर्गमाम्। रथेन संग्रामनदी तरत्येष कपिध्वजः॥
en: Yonder is Arjuna, with his banner bearing the emblem of an ape, crossing on his car the dreadful current of battle, having cars, elephants and chargers for its eddies and which is incapable of being crossed over.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: ब्रह्मण्यता दमो दानं तपश्च चरितं महत्। इहैव दृश्यते पार्थे भ्राता यस्य धनंजयः॥
en: Devotion to the Brahmanas, self control, benevolence, asceticism, and laudable good conduct-these are to be found in that king only who owns for his brothers Dhananjaya.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: भीमसेनश्च बलवान् माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। वासुदेवश्च वार्ष्णेयो यस्य नाथो व्यवस्थितः॥
en: The mighty Bhimasena and the two sons of Pandu begotten upon Madri, and who have the son of Vasudeva of the Vrishni race for his Saviour.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: तस्यैष मन्युप्रभवो धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्मतेः। तपोदग्धशरीरस्य कोपो दहति भारतीम्॥
en: It is the wrath, engendered by grief, of that Yudhishthira whose person have been consumed by the austerities of asceticism, that is consuming the host of the wicked-souled son off Dhritarashtra.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: एष संदृश्यते पार्थो वासुदेवव्यपाश्रयः। दारयन् सर्वसैन्यानि धार्तराष्ट्राणि सर्वशः॥
en: Yonder is seen the son of Pritha having Vasudeva for his protector, and checking all the troops of Dhritarashtra's host.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: एतदालोक्यते सैन्यं क्षोभ्यमाणं किरीटिना। महोर्मिनद्धं सुमहत् तिमिनेव महाजलम्॥
en: You is seen the army agitated by the diadem decked Arjuna, like the waters of the ocean agitated by a mighty whale.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: हाहाकिलकिलाशब्दाः श्रुयन्ते च चमूमुखे। याहि पाञ्चालदायादमहं यास्ये युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Listen to the cries of 'Alas and Oh' and to the shrinks of agony and distress! Go, comfort the son of the Panchala king. I will confront Yudhishthira.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: दुर्गमं ह्यन्तरं राज्ञो व्यूहस्यामिततेजसः। समुद्रकुक्षिप्रतिमं सर्वतोऽतिरथैः स्थितैः॥
en: Protected as it is on all sides with Atirathas, the centre of the very strong array of the mighty king's troops is difficult of being penetrated into, like the bowels of sea being difficult of access.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: सात्यकिश्चाभिमन्युश्च धृष्टद्युम्नवृकोदरौ। पर्यरक्षन्त राजानं यमौ च मनुजेश्वरम्॥
en: Satyaki, Abhimanyu, Dhrishtadyumna and Vrikodara, and the twins Nakula and Sahadeva are all engaged in protecting that foremost of men viz., king Yudhishthira.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: उपेन्द्रसदृशः श्यामो महाशाल इवोद्गतः। एष गच्छत्यनीकाग्रे द्वितीय इव फाल्गुनः॥
en: Blue-complexioned like the younger brother of Indra, and tell like a mighty Sala tree, yonder is Abhimanyu rushing to fight at the head of his division, like a second Phalguna.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: उत्तमास्त्राणि चाधत्स्व गृहीत्वा च महद् धनुः। पार्षतं याहि राजानं युध्यस्व च वृकोदरम्॥
en: Make your excellent weapons ready, grasp your mighty bow, and then rush against the royal son of Prishata and fight also with Vrikodara.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: को हि नेच्छेत् प्रियं पुत्रं जीवन्तं शाश्वतीः समाः। क्षत्रधर्मं तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य ततस्त्वां नियुनज्म्यहम्॥
en: What person wishes not his dear loved son to live for eternal years? But in view of the duties of Kshatriyas, I do command you to fight.

description: The colloquy between Drona and Ashvathama,
sn: एष चातिरणे भीष्मो दहते वै महाचमूम्। युद्धेषु सदृशस्तात यमस्य वरुणस्य च॥
en: Yonder is Bhishma, equal in battle to Death himself or Varuna, O son, consuming the hostile host.

sn: संजय उवाच भगदत्तः कृपः शल्यः कृतवर्मा तथैव च। विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ सैन्धवश्च जयद्रथः॥ चित्रसेनो विकर्णश्च तथा दुर्मर्षणादयः।
en: Sanjaya said Having heard those words of the highsouled Drona, Bhagadatta, Kripa, Shalya, Kritvarma, the princes Vinda and Anuvinda from Avanti, Jayadratha the ruler of the Sindhus, Chitrasena, Vikarna and Durmarshana and others,

sn: दशैते तावका योधा भीमसेनमयोधयन्॥ महत्या सेनया युक्ता नानादेशसमुत्थया।
en: These ten warriors of your army engaged with Bhimasena in battle, supported by a large division consisting of troops recruited from various countries,

sn: भीष्मस्य समरे राजन् प्रार्थयाना महद् यशः॥ शल्यस्तु नवभिर्बाणैर्भीमसेनमताडयत्।
en: And desirous, o king, of winning great fame in that battle for Bhishma's sake. Then Shalya pierced Bhimasena with nine arrows;

sn: कृतवर्मा त्रिभिर्बाणैः कृपश्च नवभिः शरैः॥ चित्रसेनो विकर्णश्च भगदत्तश्च मारिष।
en: Kritavarma pierced him with there shafts, Kripa with nine, and O sire, Chitrasena, Vikarna and Bhagadatta.

sn: दशभिर्दशभिर्बाणैर्भीमसेनमताडयन्॥ सैन्धवश्च त्रिभिर्वाणैर्भीमसेनमताडयत्।
en: Each pierced Bhimasena with ten arrows separately. The ruler of the Sindhus pierced Bhimasena with three arrows.

sn: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः॥ दुर्मर्षणस्तु विंशत्या पाण्डवं निशितैः शरैः।
en: Vinda and Anuvindu pierced the son of Pandu, with five shafts each; and Durmarshana pierced him with twenty shafts of exceeding sharpness.

sn: सतान् सर्वान् महाराज राजमानान् पृथक् पृथक्॥ प्रवीरान् सर्वलोकस्य धार्तराष्ट्रान् महारथान्। जघान समरे वीरः पाण्डवः परवीरहा॥ सप्तभिः शल्यमाविध्यत् कृतवर्माणमष्टभिः।
en: Then, O mighty monarch, that slayer of hostile heroes, viz., the heroic son those mighty car-warriors of the Dhritarashtra host, of world-wide fame. He pierced Shalya with seven arrows, Kritavarma with eight;

sn: कृपस्य सशरं चापं मध्ये चिच्छेद भारत॥ अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः।
en: And, O Bharata, he cut in the middle Kripa's bow with arrows fixed on the string in that battle. Then again he pierced the latter whose bow had been cut in twain with seven shafts.

sn: विन्दानुविन्दौ च तथा त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरताडयत्॥ दुर्मर्षणं च विंशत्या चित्रसेनं च पञ्चभिः।
en: He also wounded Vinda and Anuvinda with three shafts each, and Durmarshana with twenty and Chitrasena with five.

sn: विकर्ण दशभिर्बाणैः पञ्चभिश्च जयद्रथम्॥ विद्ध्वा भीमोऽनदद्धृष्टः सैन्धवं च पुनस्त्रिभिः।
en: Then Bhima having pierced Vikarna with ten arrows and the ruler of the Sindhus with five, roared out in delight; and then again he pierced Jayadratha with three arrows.

sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय गौतमो रथिनां वरः॥ भीमं विव्याध संरब्धो दशभिर्निशितैः शरैः।
en: Therefore that Dhananjaya of car-warriors, that son of Gautami, taking up another bow and waxing worth, pierced Bhima with ten shafts of great sharpness.

sn: स विद्धो दशभिर्बाणैस्तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपः॥ ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्।
en: Then like a huge elephant pierced with the hook, the mighty Bhimasena, pierced with those ten arrows, was worked up with rage, O monarch,

sn: गौतमं ताडयामास शरैर्बहुभिराहवे॥ सैन्धवस्य तथाश्वांश्च सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरैः। प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय कालान्तकसमद्युतिः॥ हताश्वात् तु रथात् तूर्णमवप्लुत्य महारथः। शरांश्चिक्षेप निशितान् भीमसेनस्य संयुगे॥
en: And he pierced the son of Gautami with numerous arrows in battle. Then with three arrows, that one of effulgence like that of the Destroyer himself dispatched to the regions of Death, the steeds and driver of the ruler of the Sindhus. Then that mighty car-warrior quickly jumping down from the car, the steed of which were slain,

sn: तस्य भीमो धनुर्मध्ये द्वाभ्यां चिच्छेद मारिष। भल्लाभ्यां भरतश्रेष्ठ सैन्धवस्य महात्मनः॥ स छिन्नधन्वा विस्थो हताश्वो हतसारथिः।
en: Discharged sharp arrow towards Bhimasena in that battle. Then, O sire, with a couple of broad-headed arrows Bhima cut in twain the bow, O foremost of the Bharatas, of the illustrious ruler of the Sindhus. Then the latter, O king, with his bow burst, his horses and charioteer slain, and deprived of his car,

sn: चित्रसेनरथं राजन्नारुरोह त्वरान्वितः॥ अत्यद्भुतं रणे कर्म कृतवांस्तत्र पाण्डवः।
en: Speedily ascended, o king, the chariot of Chitrasena. Then that son of Pandu achieved marvelous feats in that battle,

sn: महारथाशरैर्विद्ध्वा वारयित्वा च मारिष।॥ विरथं सैन्धवं चक्रे सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः।
en: In as much as piercing all those mighty carwarriors with arrows and resisting them, he deprived, O sire, the ruler of the Sindhus, of his car, before the eyes of all on-lookers.

sn: तदा न ममृषे शल्यो भीमसेनस्य विक्रमम्॥ स संधाय शरांस्तीक्ष्णान् कर्मारपरिमार्जितान्।
en: Then Shalya did not tolerate the prowess of Bhimasena; and fixing sharp arrows burnished of the forgers,

sn: भीमं विव्याध समरे तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥ कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च भगदत्तश्च वीर्यवान्।
en: He pierced Bhima in battle, exclaiming 'Stay, Stay.' Then Kripa and Kritavarma, and the highly powerful Bhagadatta,

sn: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ चित्रसेनश्च संयुगे।॥ दुर्मर्षणो विकर्णश्च सिन्धुराजश्च वीर्यवान्।
en: And Vinda and Anuvinda from Avanti, and Chitrasena, and Durmarshana Vikarna, the valiant ruler of the Sindhus,

sn: भीमं ते विव्यधुस्तूर्णं शल्यहेतोररिंदमाः॥ स च तान् प्रतिविव्याध पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः।
en: All these subduers of foes, then quickly pierced Bhima (with arrows), for rescuing Shalya. He (Bhima) also pierced them in return, each with five shafts,

sn: शल्यं विव्याध सप्तत्या पुनश्च दशभिः शरैः॥ तं शल्यो नवभिर्भित्त्वा पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः।
en: He pierced Shalya also first piercing him with seventy shafts and again with ten shafts. Shalya also first piercing him with nine arrows next wounded him with five.

sn: सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन गाढं विव्याध मर्मणि॥ विशोकं प्रेक्ष्य निर्भिन्नं भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्।
en: Then he pierced Bhima's charioteer deeply into the vitals with a broad-headed shaft. Then the mighty Bhimasena, beholding his charioteer Vishoka thus mangled,

sn: मद्रराजं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्।॥ तथेतरान् महेष्वासांस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः ताडयामास समरे सिंहवद् विननाद च॥ ते हि यत्ता महेष्वासाः पाण्डवं युद्धकोविदम्। त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरकुण्ठाय॒ शं मर्मस्वताडयन्॥ सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासो भीमसेनो न विव्यथे।
en: Wounded the king of the Madras in the breast and arms with three arrows. He then also pierced other bowmen in that battle, each with three shafts, and then roared aloud like a lion. Then all those bowmen, fighting with care, pierced Pandu's son, versed in all modes of warfare, in his vitals, each with three shafts of keen points. Through thus deeply pierced that fierce bowman Bhimasena was not pained in the least,

sn: पर्वतो वारिधाराभिवर्षमाणैरिवाम्बुदैः॥ स तु क्रोधसमाविष्टः पाण्डवानां महारथः।
en: Like a mountain washed with thick shower of rain poured down by the clouds. Then possessed with anger that mighty car-warrior of the Pandavas,

sn: भद्रेश्वरं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्भृशं विद्ध्वा महायशाः॥ कृपं च नवभिर्बाणैर्भृशं विद्ध्वा समन्ततः। प्राग्ज्योतिषं शतैराजौ राजन् विव्याध सायकैः॥
en: Of illustrious fame, having pierced the king of the Madras with three shafts, and having pierced Kripa with nine arrows by all sides and too wounded the ruler of the Pragjyotishas, O king, with hundred shafts in battle.

sn: ततस्तु सशरं चापं सात्वतस्य महात्मनः। क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन चिच्छेद कृतहस्तवत्॥
en: Then that high-famed warrior having pierced Kripa with many arrows, cut off the bow and the arrows of the illustrious descendant of the Satvata race,

sn: तथान्यद् धनुरादाय कृतवर्मा वृकोदरम्। आजघान भ्रुवोर्मध्ये नाराचेन परंतपः॥ भीमस्तु समरे विद्ध्वा शल्यं नवभिरायसैः। भगदत्तं त्रिभिश्चैव कृतवर्माणष्टभिः॥ द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां तु विव्याध गौतमप्रभृतीन् स्थान्।
en: With horse-shoe headed arrow of great lightness, displaying the while great lightness of hands. Then that afflicter of foes Kritavarma taking up another bow, struck Vrikodara between his two brows with a long and sharp shaft. Bhima then wounding Shalya in battle with nine shafts wholly made of iron, pierced, Bhagadatta with three and Kritavarma with eight arrows, and each of the other warriors including the son of Gautami &c, with two shafts.

sn: तेऽपि तं समरे राजन् विव्यधुनिशितैः शरैः॥ स तथा पीड्यमानोऽपि सर्वशस्त्रैर्महारथैः।
en: Those heroes also, O king, pierced him with exceedingly sharp arrows. Through thus pierced by all those mighty car-warriors with all kinds of weapons.

sn: मत्वा तृणेन तांस्तुल्यान् विचचार गतव्यथः॥ ते चापि रथिनां श्रेष्ठा भीमाय निशिताञ्छरान्। प्रेषयामासुरव्यग्राः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ तस्य शक्तिं महावेगां भगदत्तो महारथः। चिक्षेप समरे वीरः स्वर्णदण्डां महामते॥ तोमरं सैन्धवो राजा पट्टिशं च महाभुजः।
en: Yet regarding them as mere straws, he careered through the field without the least pain. Those foremost of car-warriors also patiently sped at Bhima sharp arrows by hundreds and thousands. Then the highly powerful heroic Bhagadatta let go his lance of great velocity and of a golden staff at that illustrious warrior Bhima. The mighty-armed king of the Sindhus hurled at the latter a lance and a battle-axe.

sn: शतघ्नीं च कृपो राजञ्छरं शल्यश्च संयुगे॥ अथेतरे महेष्वासाः पञ्च शिलीमुखान्। भीमसेनं समुद्दिश्य प्रेषयामासुरोजसा॥ तोमरं च द्विधा चक्रे क्षुरप्रेणानिलात्मजः।
en: Kripa hurled at Bhima a Shataghni, and O king, Shalya a fierce dare; of the other warriors cach, aiming at Bhima, forcibly let go five shafts whetted on stone. Then the son of the wind-god (Bhima), with a horse-shoe-headed arrow, cut that lance in twain.

sn: पट्टिशं च त्रिभिर्बाणैचिच्छेद तिलकाण्डवत्॥ स बिभेद शतघ्नीं च नवभिः कङ्कपत्रिभिः। मद्रराजप्रयुक्तं च शरं छित्त्वा महारथः॥
en: He also served that battle-axe as if it were sesame stalk with three arrows; he broke into pieces the Shataghni with nine shafts furnished with wings of the feathers of Kanka birds.

sn: शक्तिं चिच्छेद सहसा भगदत्तेरितां रणे। तथेतराञ्छरान् घोरान् शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ भीमसेनो रणश्लाघी त्रिधैकैकं समाच्छिनत्। तांश्च सर्वान् महेष्वासांस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरताडयत्॥
en: Bhimasena, expert in archery cut down Shakti weapon of Bhagadatta quickly and had splitted the volley of fierce arrows shot by another warriors each in three pieces by shooting a number of arrows having bent knot. Effacing thus, the power of weapons and arms practised by enemies, Bhimasena injured those great archers hitting each by three arrows.

sn: ततो धनंजयस्तत्र वर्तमाने महारणे। आजगाम रथेनाजो भीमं दृष्ट्वा महारथम्॥
en: Then whom the combat was thus raging fiercely, Dhananjaya came there on his car, and beheld Bhima that mighty car-warrior.

sn: निघ्नन्तं समरे शत्रून् योधयानं च सायकैः। तौ तु तत्र महात्मानौ समेतौ वीक्ष्य पाण्डवौ॥
en: Slay in battle his opponents and fight with them with his arrows. Then beholding those two illustrious sons of Pandu together,

sn: न शशंसुजयं तत्र तावकाः पुरुषर्षभाः। अथार्जुनो रणे भीमं योधयन्तं महारथान्॥ भीष्मस्य निधनाकाक्षी पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम्। आससाद रणे वीरांस्तावकान् दश भारत।॥
en: Your warriors, all foremost of men, did not cherish any hope of victory then. Then Arjuna, who was proceeding desirous of slaying Bhishma, with Shikhandin before him, seeing Bhima fight with the ten mighty car-warriors of your army, confronted them in battle.

sn: ये स्म भीमं रणे राजन् योधयन्तो व्यवस्थिताः। बीभत्सुस्तानथाविध्यद भीमस्य प्रियकाम्यया॥
en: Then, O monarch, out of a desire for doing an act pleasurable of Bhima, Vibhatsu pierced those heroes who had been so coolly fighting with Bhima in battle.

sn: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सुशर्माणमचोदयत्। अर्जुनस्य वधार्थाय भीमसेनस्य चोभयोः॥
en: Thereupon king Duryodhana urged king Susharma for bringing about the slaughter of Arjuna as also of Bhima.

sn: सुशर्मन् गच्छ शीघ्रं त्वं बलौघैः परिवारितः। जहि पाण्डुसुतावेतौ धनंजयवृकोदरौ॥
en: Go you, O Susharma, speedily surrounded by a large host of your troops. Slay me these two sons of Pandu, viz., Dhananjaya and Vrikodara.

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य त्रैगर्तः प्रस्थलाधिपः। अभिद्रुत्य रणे भीममर्जुनं चैव धन्विनौ॥
en: Hearing these words of the king, the chief of the Trigarta's, the ruler of Prasthala, assaulting the two bowmen Bhima and Arjuna,

sn: रथैरनेकसाहस्रैः समन्तात् पर्यवारयत्। ततः प्रववृते युद्धमर्जुनस्य परैः सह॥
en: Surrounded them on all sides with many thousand chariots. Then ensured a fierce battle between Arjuna and his opponents.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: संजय उवाच अर्जुनस्तु रणे शल्यं यतमानं महारथम्। छादयामास समरे शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Sanjaya said Arjuna covered over with his arrows of straight knots that mighty car-warrior Shalya who had been fighting very carefully.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: सुशर्माणं कृपं चैव त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरविध्यता प्राग्ज्योतिषं च समरे सैन्धवं च जयद्रथम्॥
en: He pierced Susharma and Kripa, each with three shafts; then in that battle, the ruler of the Pragjyotishas, Jayadratha, the ruler of the Sindhus,

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: चित्रसेनं विकर्णं च कृतवर्माणमेव च। दुर्मर्षणं च राजेन्द्र ह्यावन्त्यौ च महारथौ॥
en: Chitrasena, Vikarna, Kritavarma, Durmarshana and, o king, the foremost carwarriors from I.vanti,

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: एकैकं त्रिभिरानछेत् कङ्कबर्हिणवाजितैः। शरैरतिरथो युद्धे पीडयन् वाहिनीं तव॥
en: All these warriors were pierced each with three shafts winged with Kanka and peacock feathers, by the Atiratha Arjuna, who had been afflicting your army.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: जयद्रथो रणे पार्थं विद्ध्वा भारत सायकैः। भीमं विव्याध तरसा चित्रसेनरथे स्थितः॥
en: Then, O Bharata, Jayadratha who was riding on the car of Chitrasena, having pierced Partha in battle, pierced Bhima also with his arrows.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: शल्यश्च समरे जिष्णु कृपश्च रथिनां वरः। विव्यधाते महाराज बहुधा मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: Shalya and Kripa those foremost of carwarriors also pierced in battle, Jishnu with myriads of shafts. O king, each capable to penetrating into the very vitals.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: चित्रसेनादयश्चैव पुत्रास्तव विशाम्पते। पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिस्तूर्णं संयुगे निशितैः शरैः॥ आजजुरर्जुनं संख्ये भीमसेनं च मारिष। तौ तत्र रथिनां श्रेष्ठौ कौन्तेयौ भरतर्षभौ॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, your sons headed by Chitrasena, in that battle quickly pierced Bhima and Arjuna, O sire, each shooting five arrows of exceeding sharpness. Then these two foremost of car-warriors the two illustrious descendants of the Bharata race, viz., the sons of Kunti.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: अपीडयेतां समरे त्रिगर्तानां महद् बलम्। सुशर्माऽपि रणे पार्थं शरैर्नवभिराशुगैः॥
en: Afflicted in battle the mighty division of Trigarta troops; thereupon Susharma pierced Partha in battle with nine swift causing arrows.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: ननाद बलवन्नादं त्रासयानो महद् बलम्। अन्ये च रथिनः शूरा भीमसेनधनंजयौ॥ विव्यधुनिशितैर्बाणै रुक्मपुखैरजिह्मगैः। तेषां च रथिनां मध्ये कौन्तेयौ भरतर्षभौ॥ क्रीडमानौ रथोदारौ चित्ररूपौ व्यदृश्यताम्। आमिषेप्सू गवां मध्ये सिंहाविव मदोत्कटौ॥
en: And then he roared out his fierce war-cry, striking, terror into the heart of the enemy's host. ther heroic car-warriors pierced Bhimasena and Dhananjaya with straight-going exceedingly sharp arrows, all furnished with golden wings. Those two foremost descendants of the Bharata race, viz., the two sons of Kunti, sporting on their cars amidst those carwarriors, appeared beautiful, and resembled two enraged lions loO king out for flesh amidst a herd of cows.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: छित्त्वा धनूंषि शूराणां शरांश्च बहुधा रणे। पातयामासतुर्वीरौ शिरांसि शतशो नृणाम्॥
en: Cutting off the bows and arrows of the heroes in battle, those two fierce warriors began to fell the heads of men by hundreds.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: रथाश्च बहवो भग्ना हयाच शतशो हताः। गजाश्च सगजारोहा: पेतुरु। महाहवे॥
en: Many cars were shattered; and steeds by hundreds were slain and in that fierce conflict, elephants with their riders fell on the ground by hundreds.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: रथिन: सादिनश्चापि तत्र तत्र निषूदिताः। दृश्यन्ते बहवो राजन् वेपमानाः समन्ततः॥
en: Here and there car-warriors and horse-men were slain; and many were seen to tremble en all sides.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: छत्रैश्च बहुधा छिन्नैर्ध्वजैश्च विनिपातितः। अङ्कुशैरपविद्धैश्च परिस्तोमैश्च भारत॥ केयूरैरङ्गदैर्हारै राङ्कवैर्मृदितैस्तथा। उष्णीषैर्ऋष्टिभिश्चैव चामरव्यजनैरपि॥
en: The earth there was covered with fell down many umbrellas, flags, Ankushas, hunters, the ornaments like Keyura, Angada, garland and gem-studded ear-rings, the delicate hide of Ranku stag, turbans of warriors, Rishti etc. weapons and with Camara and Vyajana etc.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: तत्र तत्रापविद्धैश्च बाहुभिश्चन्दनोक्षितैः। ऊरुभिश्च नरेन्द्राणां समास्तीर्यत मेदिनी॥
en: The battle-field was layered fully with the cut-off and fell everywhere the sandal smeared arms and the legs of the kings slaughtered there.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: हतैर्गजपदात्योधैर्वाजिभिश्च निषूदितैः। स्थैश्च बहुधा भग्नैः समास्तीर्यत मेदिनी॥
en: The earth become strewn over with slain elephants, and mangled foot-soldiers and chargers, and with cars broken into splinters.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम रणे पार्थस्य विक्रमम्। शरैः संवार्य तान् वीरान् यज्जघान महाबलः॥
en: In that battle we bcheld the marvelous prowess of the mighty Arjuna, in as much as, checking those heroes by his shafts, he slew troops by hundreds.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: पुत्रस्तु तव तं दृष्ट्वा भीमार्जुनपराक्रमम्। गाङ्गेयस्य रथाभ्यासमुपजग्मे महाबलः॥
en: Mighty Duryodhana, your son himself was frightened to see that valour as exhibited by Bhimasena and Arjuna. Hence, he rushed soon near the chariot of Bhishma, the son of Ganga.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च सैन्धवश्च जयद्रथः। विन्दानुविन्दाबावन्त्यौ नाजहुः संयुगं तदा॥
en: Then Kripa and Kritavarman, and Jayadratha the ruler of the Sindhus, and Vinda and Anuvinda from Avanti, did not abandon the fight.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: ततो भीमो महेष्वासः फाल्गुनश्च महारथः। कौरवाणां चमू घोरां भृशं दुद्रुवतू रणे॥
en: Then the fierce bowman Bhima and the mighty car-warrior Phalguna began to crush severely the dreadful army of the Kurus.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: ततो बर्हिणवाजनामयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। धनंजयरथे तूर्णं पातयन्ति स्म भूमिपाः॥
en: Thereupon, the rulers of earth quickly began to pour on the car of Dhananjaya thousands and thousands of arrows.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: ततस्ताशरजालेन संनिवार्य महारथान्। पार्थः समन्तात् समरे प्रेषयमास मृत्यवे॥
en: Then checking those mighty car-warriors with the net-work of arrows woven by himself, Partha began to dispatch them to the regions of Death.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: शल्यस्तु समरे जिष्णु क्रीडन्निव महारथः। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Then in that battle, the mighty car-warrior Shalya inflamed with wrath, pierced, as if sporting, Vishnu on the breast with broadheaded and straight-knotted shafts.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: तस्य पार्थो धनुश्छित्त्वा हस्तावापं च पञ्चभिः। अथैनं सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भृशं विव्याध मर्मणि।॥
en: Then Partha having cut off the former's bow and gloves with five arrows, pierced him in his vital parts with arrows of great sharpness.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय समरे भारसाधनम्। मद्रेश्वरो रणे जिष्णु ताडयामास रोषितः॥
en: Thereupon taking up another bow capable of bearing great strain, the ruler of the Madras waxing worth, pierced Vishnu in battle,

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: त्रिभिः शरैर्महाराज वासुदेवं च पञ्चभिः। भीमसेनं च नवभिर्वाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: With three arrows, and the son of Vasudeva with five and Bhimasena on the breast and arms with nine shafts.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: ततो द्रोणो महाराज मागधश्च महारथः। दुर्योधनसमादिष्टौ तं देशमुपजग्मतुः॥
en: Then, O monarch, Drona and the king of the Magadhas, both being commanded by Duryodhana, hide to that spot,

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: यत्र पार्थो महाराज भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः। कौरव्यस्य महासेनां जघ्नतुः सुमहारथौ॥
en: Where the two mighty car-warriors, Partha and Bhimasena, the sons of Pandu, had been slaughtering the mighty divisions of the Kaurava host.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: जयत्सेनस्तु समरे भीमं भीमायुधं युधि। विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैरष्टभिर्भरतर्षभ।॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, then Jayatsena in that battle Bhimasena possessed of terrible weapon, with eight sharp arrows.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: तं भीमो दशभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः। सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपातयत्॥
en: Then Bhima piercing him with ten shafts again pierced him with five, and he felled the latter's charioteer from his seat on the box of the car.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: उद्भ्रान्तैस्तुरगैः सोऽथ द्रवमाणैः समन्ततः। मागधौऽपसृतो राजा सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Then borne by the unrestrained steeds flying hither and thither, the ruler of the Magadhas was carried away from the field of battle even before the every eyes of the onloO king troops.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: द्रोणश्च विवरं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनं शिलीमुखैः। विव्याध बाणैर्निशितैः पञ्चषष्टिभिरायसैः॥
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, Drona availing himself of an weakness of Bhima pierced the latter with eight keen pointed dares whetted on stone.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: तं भीमः समरश्लाघी गुरुं पितृसमं रणे। विव्याध पञ्चभिर्भल्लैस्तथा षष्ट्या च भारत॥
en: Then, O Bharata, Bhima, that hero ever proud in battle, pierced his sire-like preceptor first with five broad-headed arrows and then with another sixty of the same.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: अर्जुनस्तु सुशर्माणं विद्ध्वा बहुभिरायसैः। व्यधमत् तस्य तत्सैन्यं महाभ्राणि यथाऽनिलः॥
en: Arjuna also having pierced king Susharma with many shafts of iron, began to scatter the latter's host like a tempest scattering mighty masses of clouds.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: ततोभीष्मश्च राजा च कौसल्यश्च बृहद्बलः। समवर्तन्त संक्रुद्धा भीमसेनधनंजयौ॥
en: Thereupon Bhishma, king Duryodhana himself, the ruler of the Kosalas and Brihadbala, all excited with rage assailed in a body Bhimasena and Dhananjaya.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: तथैव पाण्डवाः शूरा धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्घतः। अभ्यद्रवन् रणे भीष्म व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम्॥
en: So also the Pandava heroes, Prishata's son Dhrishtadyumna and others, rushed against Bhishma who then resembled Death with mouth wide open.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: शिखण्डी तु समासाद्य भरतानां पितामहम्। अभ्यद्रवत संहृष्टो भयं त्यक्त्वा महारथात्॥
en: Shikhandin also approaching the grandsire of the Bharatas delightedly rushed at him, harboring no fear from that mighty car-warrior.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: युधिष्ठिरमुखाः पार्थाः पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम्। अयोधयन् रणे भीष्मं सहिताः सर्वसुंजयैः॥
en: The Partha's accompanied by the Srinjayas, and headed by Yudhishthira himself, with Shikhandin at their van fought on with Bhishma.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: तथैव तावकाः सर्वे पुरस्कृत्य यतव्रतम्। शिखण्डिप्रमुखान् पार्थान् योधयन्ति स्म संयुगे॥
en: Similarly all your warriors with Bhishma of regulated vows at their forefront fought with the Partha warriors headed by Shikhandin.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कौरवाणां भयावहम्। तत्र पाण्डुसुतैः सार्धं भीष्मस्य विजयं प्रति॥
en: Then the contest that ensued between the sons of Pandu and the Kauravas for the conquest of Bhishma, became terrible to the extreme.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: तावकानां जये भीष्मो ग्लह आसीद् विशाम्पते। तत्र हि द्यूतमासक्तं विजयायेतराय वा॥
en: In that battle, O ruler of men, that may be compared to a game at dice, for the sake of victory or the reverse, Bhishma was the stake of your warriors.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु राजेन्द्र सर्वसैन्यान्यचोदयत्। अभ्यद्रवत गाङ्गेयं मा भैष्टं रथसत्तमाः॥
en: Then, 0 foremost of kings, Dhrishtadyumna urged on the troops to assail Ganga's son exclaiming, “Fear not, O excelient car-warriors.”

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: सेनापतिवचः श्रुत्वा पाण्डवानां वरूथिनी। भीष्मं समभ्यात् तूर्णं प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा महाहवे॥
en: Hearing the words of their generallissimo, the division of the Pandavas disregarding their lives quickly rushed at Bhishma.

description: The prowess of Bhishma and Arjuna
sn: भीष्मोऽपि रथिनां श्रेष्ठः प्रतिजग्राह तां चमूम्। आपतन्ती महाराज वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: Like the banks receiving the surging waves of the mighty main, Bhishma also, O monarch, that foremost of car-warrior, received that assailing host of the enemy.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं शान्तनवो भीष्मो दशमेऽहनि संजय। अयुध्यत महावीर्यः पाण्डवैः सहसृञ्जयैः॥ कुरवश्च कथं युद्धे पाण्डवान् प्रत्यवारयन्। आचक्ष्व मे महायुद्धं भीष्मस्याहवशोभिनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How, O Sanjaya, did the highly puissant son of Shantanu, viz., Bhishma fight on the tenth day with the Pandavas and the Srinjayas? How did also the Kurus, check the Pandavas in battle? Describe to me the fierce battle that Bhishma, that ornament of battlefield, fought with the foe.

sn: संजय उवाच कुरवः पाण्डवैः सार्धं यदयुध्यन्त भारत। यथा च तदभूद् युद्धं तत् तु वक्ष्यामि साम्प्रतम्॥
en: Sanjaya said I shall, O Bharata, rehearse to you as to how did the Kurus fight with the Pandavas, and how also did that battle rage.

sn: गमिताः परलोकाय परमास्त्रैः किरीटिना। अहन्यहनि संक्रुद्धास्तावकानां महारथाः॥
en: Day after day, the irate mighty car-warriors of your armny were conveyed to the regions of the departed by the excellent weapons shot by the diadem-decked Arjuna.

sn: यथाप्रतिज्ञं कौरव्यः स चापि समितिंजयः। पार्थानामकरोद् भीष्मः सततं समितिक्षयम्॥
en: That conqueror of assembled enemies, viz., Bhishma, that foremost of Kuru heroes ever redeeming his vows, also destroyed the hosts of the Pandavas.

sn: कुरुभिः सहितं भीष्मं युध्यमानं परंतप। अर्जुनं च समाञ्चाल्यं संशयो विजयेऽभवत्॥
en: Beholding Bhishma fighting at the head of the Kurus and Arjuna at the head of Panchala troops, we were unable, O afflicter of foes, to divine as to which side would be victorious.

sn: दशमेऽहनि तस्मिंस्तु भीष्मार्जुनसमागमे। अवर्तत महारौद्रः सततं समितिक्षयः॥
en: Then in that battle on the tenth day when Bhishma and Arjuna confronted one another, the carnage that was caused was indeed terrible to the extreme.

sn: तस्मिन्नयुतशो राजन् भूयशश्च परतपः। भीष्मं शान्तनवो योधाञ्जघान परमास्त्रवित्॥
en: Then Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, that hero conversant with excellent weapons, slew, O afflicter of foes, many warriors by millions and thousands.

sn: येषामज्ञातकल्पानि नामगोत्राणि पार्थिवः। ते हतास्तत्र भीष्मेण शूराः सर्वेऽनिवर्तिनः॥
en: Many were the number of those unretreating heroes, heroes, whose names and designations and families were not known, who lay slaughtered by Bhishma on the field of battle.

sn: दशाहानि ततस्तप्त्वा भीष्मः पाण्डववाहिनीम्। निरविद्यत धर्मात्मा जीवितेन परंतप॥
en: Having consumed the Pandava ranks for ten days, the high-souled Bhishma, O afflicter of foes, became disregardful of his life.

sn: स क्षिप्रं वधमन्विच्छन्नात्मनोऽभिमुखो रणे। न हन्यां मानवश्रेष्ठान् संग्रामे सुबहूनिति॥ चिन्तयित्वा महाबाहुः पिता देवव्रतस्तव। अभ्याशस्थं महाराज पाण्डवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then wishing his quick slaughter at the face of the armies, and thinking, 'I will no longer slay foremost of car-warriors in battle,' your mighty-armed father Devavrata, addressing Yudhishthira who was then near him said these words.

sn: युधिष्ठिर महाप्राज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद। शृणुष्व वचनं तात धर्म्य स्वर्यं च जल्पतः॥
en: "O Yudhishthira, O very wise one, O you familiar with all the Shastras! Hear, O sire, I speak these words, that are fraught with moral teachings and that are capable of securing paradise for any one.

sn: निर्विष्णोऽस्मि भृशं तात देहेनानेन भारत। घ्नतश्च मे गतः कालः सुबहून् प्राणिनो रणे॥
en: O Bharata, O sire, I am disgusted with this body of mine. I have passed my days in slaying numerous creatures in battle.

sn: तस्मात् पार्थं पुरोधाय पञ्चालान् संजयांस्तथा। मद्वधे क्रियतां यत्नो मम चेदिच्छसि प्रियम्॥
en: So if you desire to do me a good turn, strive your best for slaying me, placing the Panchalas and Srinjayas with Partha, before yourself."

sn: तस्य तन्मतमाज्ञाय पाण्डवः सत्यदर्शनः। भीष्मं प्रति ययौ राजा संग्रामे सह संजयैः॥
en: Ascertaining that to be the desire of Bhishma, king Yudhishthira of unerring sight rushed against Bhishma in battle with the Srinjayas for his supporters.

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्ततो राजन् पाण्डवश्च युधिष्ठिरः। श्रुत्वा भीष्मस्य तां वाचं चोदयामासतुर्बलम्॥
en: Thereupon, o king, Dhrishtadyumna and Yudhishthira the son of Pandu, having heard those words of Bhishma urged on their forces saying:
