en: At his command the mighty-armed Pandavas, like a flock of swans descending on the breast of a lake, came down upon Drona's car, spreading slaughter as they proceeded.

sn: सरो हंसा इवापेतुर्भ्रान्तो द्रोणरथं प्रति। गृह्णीताद्रवतान्योन्यं विभीता विनिकृन्तत॥
en: Then near the chariot of the invincible Drona, loud cries of “Seize," "Do not fly," "Be not afraid” “Cut to pieces" were heard.

sn: इत्यासीत् तुमुलः शब्दो दुर्धर्षस्य रथं प्रति। ततो द्रोणः कृपः कर्णो द्रौणी राजा जयद्रथः॥
en: Thereupon Drona, Kripa, Karna, Drona's son, king Jayadratha, the two princes from Avanti, viz., Vinda and Anuvinda and Shalya, checked that assault (of the Pandava troops).

sn: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ शल्यश्चैतान् न्यवारयन्। ते त्वार्यधर्मसंरब्धा दुर्निवारा दुरासदाः॥
en: Those irresistible and invincible warriors, the Panchalas and the Pandavas, all inflamed with righteous indignation, did not avoid Drona, though afflicted with showers of arrows.

sn: शरार्ता न जहुर्दोणं पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह। ततो द्रोणोऽतिसंक्रुद्धो विसृजञ्छतश: शरान्॥
en: Thereat Drona, excited to the highest pitch of fury, spread a great carnage among the ranks of the Chedis, the Panchalas and the Pandavas, by means of arrows which he discharged by hundreds.

sn: चेदिपञ्चालपाण्डूनामकरोत् कदनं महत्। तस्य ज्यातलनिर्घोषः शुश्रुवे दिक्षु मारिष॥
en: Then, O sire, the twang of his bow and the slap of his palms were heard in all the points of compass, resembling the rumble of thunder and inspiring terror into the hearts of many a man.

sn: वज्रसंहादसंकाशस्त्रासयन् मानवान् बहून्। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे जिष्णुर्जित्वा संशप्तकान् बहून्॥
en: At this juncture, the ever-victorious Arjuna, having vanquished the numerous host of the Samshaptakas, came to the spot where Drona had been crushing the Pandava ranks.

sn: अभ्ययात् तत्र यत्रासौ द्रोणः पाण्डून् प्रमर्दति। ताञ्छरौघान् महावर्तान् शोणितोदान् महाह्रदान्॥
en: Then Phalguna showed himself in that part of the field, after having vanquished and slain the Samshaptakas and crossed many a lake whose waters were constituted by gore and whose mighty eddies were constituted by the numerous shafts.

sn: तीर्णः संशप्तकान् हत्वा प्रत्यदृश्यत फाल्गुनः। तस्य कीर्तिमतो लक्ष्म सूर्यप्रतिमतेजसः॥
en: Then we beheld the standard, bearing the emblem of the ape, of that one of illustrious renown and equal to the sun in effulgence, shine on that part of the field.

sn: दीप्यमानमपश्याम तेजसा वानरध्वजम्। संशप्तकसमुद्र तमुच्छोष्यास्त्रगभस्तिभिः॥
en: Having dried up the Samshaptaka ocean with his weapons that constituted his rays, that son of Pandu then looking like the sun during the dissolution period at the end of a Yuga, began to scorch the Kaurava ranks.

sn: स पाण्डवयुगान्तार्कः कुरूनप्यभ्यतीतपत्। प्रददाह कुरून् सर्वानर्जुनः शस्त्रतेजसा॥
en: Like the comet risen at the end of a Yuga burning every creature. Arjuna then began to blast with the power of his weapons the Kuru hosts.

sn: युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि धूमकेतुरिवोत्थितः। तेन बाणसहस्रौधैर्गजाश्वरथयोधिनः॥
en: Pierced by him with thousands of shafts, elephant-riders, horse-soldiers and warriors, fell down on the earth, with hair dishevelled and bodies mangled with arrowwounds.

sn: ताड्यमानाः क्षितिं जग्मुर्मुक्तकेशाः शरार्दिताः। केचिदार्तस्वनं चक्रुर्विनेशुरपरे पुनः॥
en: Some uttered distressful cries, some emitted loud roars; others again struck by the shafts of Pritha's son, fell down deprived of life.

sn: पार्थबाणहताः केचिनिपेतुर्विगतासवः। तेषामुत्पतितान् कांश्चित् पतितांश्च पराङ्मुखान्॥
en: Remembering the duties of a warrior, Arjuna then desisted from slaying those among the hostile warrior who were falling or fallen or those who turned away from the field of battle.

sn: न जघानार्जुनो योधान योधव्रतमनुस्मरन्। ते विकीर्णरथाश्चित्राः प्रायश्च पराङ्मुखाः॥
en: The Kuru warriors then, deprived of their cars and filled with wonder and with their faces turned away from the field of battle, began to utter cries of “Oh”! and "Alas" and called upon Karna saying "O Karna, O Karna."

sn: कुरवः कर्ण कर्णेति हाहेति च विचुक्रुशुः। तमाधिरथिराक्रन्दं विज्ञाय शरणैषिणाम्॥
en: The son of Adhiratha then hearing those distressful cries of those who deserved his help, proceeded to face Arjuna, saying at the same time, “Be not afraid, Owarriors."

sn: मा भैष्टेति प्रतिश्रुत्य ययावभिमुखोऽर्जुनम्। स भारतस्थश्रेष्ठः सर्वभारतहर्षणः॥
en: Then that foremost of the Bharata combatants, that delighter of all the Bharata heroes, viz., Karna, that foremost of all conversant with the use of weapons, invoked into existence the Agneya weapon.

sn: प्रादुश्चक्रे तदाग्नेयमस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः। तस्य दीप्तशरौघस्य दीप्तचापधरस्य च॥
en: Dhananjaya however with the network of arrows woven by himself, repulsed the arrowy downpour of that hero (Karna) of bright shafts and effulgent bow.

sn: शरौघाञ्छरजालेन विदुधाव धनंजयः। तथैचाधिरथिस्तस्य बाणाज्वलिततेजसः॥
en: Similarly the son of Adhiratha repulsed the arrows of Arjuna of blazing energy. Thereafter the former repulsing the weapons of the latter with his own weapons and discharging myriad's of shafts, uttered loud roars.

sn: अस्त्रमस्त्रेण संवार्य प्राणदद् विसृजञ्छरान्। धृष्टद्युम्नश्च भीमश्च सात्यविश्च महारथः॥
en: Meanwhile Dhrishtadyumna, Bhima and Satyaki, these mighty car-warriors, having approached Karna, pierced him each with three straight-flying arrows.

sn: विव्यधुः कर्णमासाद्य त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः। अर्जुनास्त्रं तु राधेयः संवार्य शरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: Thereupon Radha's son, having at first resisted Arjuna's weapons by his arrowy showers, cut-off the bow of those three warriors with three darts.

sn: तेषां त्रयाणां चापानिचिच्छेद विशिखैस्त्रिभिः। ते निकृत्तायुधाः शूरा निर्विषा भुजगा इव॥
en: Then with their bows severed, those warriors with three darts appeared like serpents without venom. Then from their respctive cars, hurling lances at the foe, they uttered loud warcries.

sn: रथशक्तीः समुत्क्षिप्य भूशं सिंहा इवानदन्। ता भुजाग्रैर्महावेगा निसृष्टा भुजगोपमाः॥
en: Then those mighty and blazing lances hurled with fury by the arms of those heroes, coursed swiftly towards Adhiratha's son, looking like so many (flying) snakes.

sn: दीप्यमाना महाशक्त्यो जग्मुराधिरथिं प्रति। ता निकृत्य शरव्रातैस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः॥
en: Severing each of those lances with three swift-coursing arrows and speeding at the same time myriad's of shafts at Arjuna the highly puissant Karna uttered a loud roar.

sn: ननाद बलवान् कर्णः पार्थाय विसृजञ्छरान्। अर्जुनश्चापि राधेयं विद्ध्वा सप्तभिराशुगैः॥
en: Then Arjuna also piercing Radha's son with seven swift-flying arrows, slew the younger brothers of Karna with three shafts of great sharpness.

sn: कर्णादवरजं बाणैर्जघान निशितैः शरैः। तत: शत्रुजयं हत्वा पार्थः षड्भिरजिह्मगैः॥
en: Thereafter Pritha's son having slain Satrunjaya also with six straight-going arrows, speedily deprived Vitapa of his head with lances, as the latter stood on his chariot.

sn: जहार सद्यो भल्लेन विपाटस्य शिरो रथात्। पश्यतां धार्तराष्ट्राणामेकेनैव किरीटिना॥
en: Thus those three uterine bothers of Suta's son were slain by the singly-handed diademdecked Arjuna even before the very eyes of all the Dharitarashtras.

sn: प्रमुखे सूतपुत्रस्य सोदर्या निहतास्त्रयः। ततो भीमः समुत्पत्य स्वरथाद् वैनतेयवत्॥
en: Then like second son of Vinata, Bhima jumping down from his chariot, slew with his sword of excellent make five and ten warriors of Karna's party.

sn: वरासिना कर्णपक्षान् जघान दश पञ्च च। पुनस्तु रथमास्थाय धनुरदाय चापरम्॥
en: Then once more ascending his car and taking up a bow he pierced Karna with ten and his horses and charioteer with five shafts.

sn: विव्याघ दशभिः कर्णे सूतमश्वांश्च पञ्चभिः। धृष्टद्युम्नोऽप्यसिवरं चर्म चादाय भास्वरम्॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna also grasping an excellent sword and an effulgent buckler, slew Chandravarman and Vrihatkshatra the ruler of the Nishadha.

sn: जघान चन्द्रवर्माणं बृहत्क्षत्रं च नैषधम्। ततः स्वरथमास्थाय पाञ्चाल्योऽनयच्च कार्मुकम्॥
en: Thereafter mounting on his chariot and taking up a bow, the prince of the Panchalas pierced Karna with seventy-three shafts uttering loud shouts all the while.

sn: आदाय कर्णे विव्याध त्रिसप्त्या नदन् रणे। शैनेयोऽप्यन्यदादाय धनुरिन्दुसमद्युतिः॥
en: the grandson of Sini, of splendour equal to that of Indra himself, also grasping a fresh bow pierced the son of Suta with sixty-four arrows and uttered a roar like that of a lion.

sn: सूतपुत्रं चतुःषष्ट्या विद्ध्वा सिंह इवानदन्। भल्लाभ्यां साधुमुक्ताभ्यां छित्त्वा कर्णस्य कार्मुकम्।।
en: Then with two well-directed broad-headed shafts he burst open Karna's bow; and once more he pierced Karna on the arms and breast with three shafts.

sn: पुनः कर्णं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्। ततो दुर्योधनो द्रोणो राजा चैव जयद्रथः॥
en: Thereupon king Duryodhana, Drona and Jayadratha, with a combined effort, rescued Radha's son who had been sinking in the ocean of Satyaki.

sn: निमज्जमानं राधेयमुज्जह्वः सात्यकार्णवात्। पत्त्यश्वरथमातङ्गास्त्वदीयाः शतशोऽपरे॥
en: Then hundreds of foot-soldiers, horse-men, elephant-riders and car-warriors. all accomplished in smiling, rushed to the rescue of Karna, inspiring terror into the hearts of the enemy.

sn: कर्णमेवाभ्यधावन्त त्रास्यमानाः प्रहारिणः। धृष्टद्युम्नश्च भीमश्च सौभद्रोऽर्जुन एव च॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna, Bhima, Subhadra's son and Arjuna and Nakula and Sahadeva, all then protected Satyaki in that conflict.

sn: रणे। नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकि जुगुपू एवमेष महारौद्रः क्षयार्थं सर्वधन्विनाम्॥
en: Thus for the destruction of all the bowmen, raged the awful battle between your warriors and those of the enemy, in which everybody fought reckless of his life.

sn: तावकानां परेषां च त्यक्त्वा प्राणानभूद् रणः। पदातिरथनागाश्वा गजाश्वरथपत्तिभिः॥
en: Foot-soldiers, car-warriors, elephant-riders and horse-men were engaged with elephantriders horse-men, car-warriors and footsoldiers; car-warriors fought with elephants, infantry and cavalry and cars and infantry were engaged with cars and elephants.

sn: रथिनो नागपत्त्यश्वै रथपत्ती रथद्विपैः। अश्वैरश्वा गजै गा रथिनो रथिभिः सह॥
en: Horses were seen engaged with horses, elephants with elephants, car-warriors with carwarriors and foot-soldiers with foot-soldiers.

sn: संयुक्ताः समदृश्यन्त पत्तयश्चापि पत्तिभिः। एवं सुकलिलं युद्धमासीत् क्रव्यादहर्षणम्। महद्भिस्तैरभीतानां यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम्॥
en: Thus raged between those high-souled and fearless warriors, the fierce fight marked by carnage, enhancing the delight of the fleshcating animals and adding the population of Death's domain.

sn: रनेकशो द्विपस्थपत्तिवाजिनः। गजैर्गजा रथिभिरुदायुधा रथा हयैर्हयाः पत्तिगणैश्च पत्तयः॥
en: In that battle many were the car-warriors, elephant-riders and foot-soldiers and horsemen that were slain. Elephants were crushed by their rivals. Car-warriors with weapons held over head, were slain by car-warriors and horse-men by horse-men and large bodies of infantry by infantry.

sn: रथैर्द्विपा द्विरदवरैर्महाहया हयैनरा वररथिमिश्च वाजिनः। निरस्तजिह्वादशनेक्षणाः क्षितौ क्षयं गताः प्रमथितवर्मभूषणाः॥
en: Elephants were slain by car-warriors, steeds। were crushed by excellent elephants; men were killed by horses and horses again by excellent car-warriors. With their eyes, tongues and teeth protruding out and with their armours and omaments shattered, many a creatures lay on the earth deprived of the vital spark.

sn: हता गताः प्रतिभयदर्शनाः क्षितिम्। विपोथिता हयगजपादताडिता भृशाकुला रथमुखनेमिभिः क्षताः॥
en: Others, again, of dreadful aspect being slain by others armed with various and excellent weapons, fell down on the earth; they then were pressed inside the earth being trod upon by elephants and steeds and being crushed and mangled by sharp edges of car-wheels.

sn: प्रमोदने श्वापदपक्षिरक्षसां जनक्षये वर्तति तत्र दारुणे। महाबलास्ते कुपिताः परस्परं निषूदयन्तः प्रविचेरुरोजसा॥
en: When that dreadful destruction of beings went on enhancing the joys of beasts and birds of prey and cannibals, mighty heroes, inflamed with wrath, coursed over the field of battle smiting one another with impetuosity.

sn: ततो बले भृशलुलिते परस्परं निरीक्षमाणे रुधिरौघसम्प्लुते। रुभे प्रयाते शिबिराय भारत॥
en: When the ranks of both the armies were greatly thinned, the combatants, with bodies bespattered with blood, looked at one another. At that moment, O Bharata, the orb of the day disappearing below the horizon, the two armies slowly returned their respective encampments. to

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: संजय उवाच पूर्वमस्मासु भग्नेषु फाल्गुनेनामितौजसा। द्रोणे च मोघसंकल्पे रक्षिते च युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: Sanjaya said Ourselves being at first broken and routed by Arjuna of immeasurable prowess and also the VOW of Drona being unfulfilled inconsequence of Yudhishthira being well guarded.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: सर्वे विध्वस्तकवचास्तावका युधि निर्जिताः। रजस्वला भृशोद्विग्ना वीक्षमाणा दिशो दश॥
en: All your warriors, with their armours shattered, were then regarded as vanquished. Soiled with dust and sorely pierced with anxiety, they began to look askance at all the ten quarters of heaven.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: अवहारं ततः कृत्वा भारद्वाजस्य सम्मते। लब्धलक्षैः शरैर्भिन्ना भृशावहसिता रणे॥
en: Withdrawing from the field with the consent of Bharadvaja's son, after being vanquished by their adversaries of unerring aim and humiliated by them in the conflict.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: श्लाघमानेषु भूतेषु फाल्गुनस्यामितान् गुणान्। केशवस्य च सौहार्दे कीर्त्यमानेऽर्जुनं प्रति॥
en: They heard, as they retired, the infinite virtues of Phalguna extolled by all beings, as also of the friendship of Keshava for Arjuna spoken of by all.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: अभिशस्ता इवाभूवन् ध्यानमूकत्वमास्थिताः। ततः प्रभातसमये द्रोणं दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत्॥ प्रणयादभिमानाच्च द्विषवृद्ध्या च दुर्मनाः। शृण्वतां सर्वयोधानां संरब्धो वाक्यकोविदः॥
en: Then they passed the night like doomed men, in silence and in anxious contemplation, At the break of day, king Duryodhana depressed at the aggrandisement of the enemy, inflamed with rage, addressed these words, before all those warriors to Drona, out of affection and affectionate angers, "O you learned in the art of speaking.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: नूनं वयं वध्यपक्षे भवतो द्विजसत्तम। तथा हि नाग्रहीः प्राप्तं समीपेऽद्य युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Indubitably, O foremost of the twice-born ones, you have taken us to be men doomed to be slaughtered for your sake, in as much as today getting Yudhishthira near you, you did not seize him.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: इच्छतस्ते न मुच्येत चक्षुःप्राप्तो रणे रिपुः। जिघृक्षतो रक्ष्यमाणः सामरैरपि पाण्डवैः॥
en: The enemy whom you would seize in battle could not escape you if once you get him within sight, even if he be protected by the immortals themselves.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: वरं दत्त्वा मम प्रीतः पश्चाद् विकृतवानसि। आशाभङ्गं न कुर्वन्ति भक्तस्याः कथंचन॥
en: Pleased with me, you accorded me, a boon; but now you seem unwilling to verify your words. Noble men do never falsify the hopes of those who are devoted to them."

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: ततोऽप्रीतस्तथोक्तः सन् भारद्वाजोऽब्रवीनृपम्। नार्हसे मां तथा ज्ञातुं घटमानं तव प्रिये॥
en: Thus spoken to, Bharadvaja's son felt greatly ashamed; then he thus addressed the king in reply-"It behoves you not to entertain such an uncharitable opinion regarding myself, who am ever striving to bring about your good.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: ससुरासुरगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः । नालं लोका रणे जेतुं पाल्यमानं किरीटिना॥
en: All this universe, with all the celestials, Asuras, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the reptiles and the Rakshasas, is not competent enough to conquer that army (of the Pandavas) when it is protected by the diadem-decked Arjuna.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: विश्वसृग् यत्र गोविन्दः पृतनानीस्तथाऽर्जुनः। तत्र कस्य बलं क्रामेदन्यत्र त्रयम्बकात् प्रभोः॥
en: Except that of the three-eyed Mahadeva, whose might can avail anything against that army which number among it Govinda the world's creator and have Arjuna for its generalissimo?

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: सत्यं तात ब्रवीम्यद्य नैतज्जात्वन्यथा भवेत्। अद्यैकं प्रवरं कंचित् पातयिष्ये महारथम्॥
en: But this, O sire, I tell you truly and this will never be false, that today I shall slay a mighty hero, the foremost among the many carwarriors of the enemy.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: तं च व्यूहं विधास्यामि योऽभेद्यस्त्रिदशैरपि। योगेन केनचिद् राजन्नर्जुनस्त्वपनीयताम्॥
en: I will also form an array that will be invulnerable even to the celestials themselves. Do you, by some means or other, take Arjuna away from the field.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: न ह्यज्ञातमसाध्यं वा तस्य संख्येऽस्ति किंचन। तेन छुपात्तं सकलं सर्वज्ञानमितस्ततः॥
en: There is nothing unknown to him, nothing incapable of being achieved by him battle, he who have acquired all knowledge of warfare from different quarters."

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: द्रोणेन व्याहते त्वेवं संशप्तकगणाः पुनः। आह्वयन्नर्जुनं संख्ये दक्षिणामभितो दिशम्॥
en: After Drona had spoken in the above manner, the host of the Samshaptakas, once more challenging Arjuna led him to the southern part of the field.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: ततोऽर्जुनस्याथ परैः सार्धं समभवद् रणः। तादृशोयादृशोनान्यः श्रुतो दृष्टोऽपि वा क्वचित्॥
en: Then there took place a battle between Arjuna and his opponents, the like of which had never been seen or heard of before.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: तत्र द्रोणेन विहितो व्यूहो राजन् व्यरोचत। चरन् मध्यंदिने सूर्यः प्रतपन्निव दुर्दशः॥
en: Then the array formed by Drona is honeresplendent, o king and it appeared incapable of being looked at, like the midday sun shining in the meridian and scorching the world underneath.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: तं चाभिमन्युर्वचनात् पितुर्येष्ठस्य भारत। बिभेद दुर्भिदं संख्ये चक्रव्यूहमनेकधा॥
en: Then, O Bharata, at the command of his father's eldest brother, Abhimanyu penetrated, in that battle, into that impenetrable array of the Kurus) figuring the discus.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: स कृत्वा दुष्करं कर्म हत्वा वीरान् सहस्रशः। षट्सु वीरेषु संसक्तो दौःशासनिवशं गतः॥
en: Having achieved many difficult feats and having slain thousands of warriors, Subhadra's, son encountered six warriors simultaneousiv At last succumbing to Dushasana's son.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: । सौभद्रः पृथिवीपाल जहौ प्राणान् परंतपः। वयं परमसंहष्टाः पाण्डवाः शोककर्शिताः। सौभद्रे निहते राजन्नवहारमकुर्महि॥
en: O ruler of earth, O afflicter of your foes, he gave his life up in battle. At the death of Abhimanyu we were enraptured and the Pandavas were depressed with grief. After Subhadra's son had been slain, the troops were withdrawn by us.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच पुत्रं पुरुषसिंहस्य संजयाप्राप्तयौवनम्। रणे विनिहतं श्रुत्वा भृशं मे दीर्यते मनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Hearing of the death of the youthful son of that foremost of men (Arjuna), my heart, O Sanjaya, seems to be split up into pieces.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: दारुणः क्षत्रधर्मोऽयं विहितो धर्मकर्तृभिः। यत्र राज्येप्सवः शूरा बाले शस्त्रमपातयन्॥
en: Heartless, indeed, are the duties of the Kshatriyas as specified by the law-givers, in as much as these duties even enjoin a hero, desirous of sovereignty, to shoot weapons at a mere child.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: बालमतयन्तसुखिनं विचरन्तमभीतवत्। कृतास्त्रा बहवो जघ्नुइँहि गावल्गणे कथम्॥
en: Describe into me, O Gavalgana's son, how did so many warriors accomplished in the use of weapons, slay that veritable child, brought up in luxury and careering (then) dauntlessly in the field?

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: विभित्सता रथानीकं सौभद्रेणामितौजसा। विक्रीडितं यथा संख्ये तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Tell me, O Sanjaya, how in battle did the dauntless son of Subhadra, endued with immeasurable might sport, having penetrated into our car-division.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: संजय उवाच यन्मां पृच्छसि राजेन्द्र सौभद्रस्य निपातनम्। तत् ते कात्स्येन वक्ष्यामि शृणु राजन् समाहितः॥२६
en: Sanjaya said That which you ask me to describe, O foremost of kings, viz., the slaughter of Subhadra's son, I shall describe in detail, Hear, O king, attentively.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: विक्रीडितं कुमारेण यथानीकं बिभित्सता। आरुग्णाश्च यथा वीरा दुःसाध्याश्चापि विप्लवे॥
en: I shall tell you, how that hero played amidst us, having penetrated into our ranks; as also how, many irresistible heroes inspired with hopes of victory were afflicted by him.

description: The consultation for forming the circular array
sn: दावाग्न्यभिपरीतानां भूरिगुल्मतृणदुमे। वनौकसामिवारण्ये त्वदीयानामभूदू भयम्॥
en: Like the denizens of a wood abounding in numerous copses, creepers and trees, when encompassed by a terrible forest-conflagration, the combatants of your host were then all seized with panic.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: संजय उवाच समरेऽत्युग्रकर्माणः कर्मभिर्व्यञ्जितश्रमाः। सकृष्णाः पाण्डवाः पञ्च देवैरपि दुरासदाः॥
en: Sanjaya said The five Pandavas brothers, all of fierce deeds in battle and all incapable of being overcome by fatigue as is apparent from their achievements, when aided by Krishna, could not be vanquished even by the celestials.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: सत्त्वकर्मान्वयैर्बुद्ध्या कीर्त्या च यशसा श्रिया। नैव भूतो न भविता नैव तुल्यगुणः पुमान्॥
en: In righteousness, in deeds, in lineage, in intelligence, in renown, in fame and in prosperity-in all these virtues, there neither was nor is, nor will be, a person equal to Yudhishthira.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: सत्यधर्मरतो दान्तो विप्रपूजादिभिर्गुणैः। सदैव त्रिदिवं प्राप्तो राजा किल युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: King Yudhishthira is constantly in the enjoyment of heavenly bliss, in consequence of his devotion to truth, righteousness, control passions, worship of the Vipras and such other qualities.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: युगानते चान्तको राजन् जामदग्न्यश्च वीर्यवान्। रथस्थो भीमसेनश्च कथ्यन्ते सदृशास्त्रयः॥
en: The Destroyer at the end of a Yuga, the highly puissant son of Jamadagni and Bhimasena on his car, O king, these three are held to be equal (in prowess).

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: प्रतिज्ञाकर्मदक्षस्य रणे गाण्डीवधन्वनः। उपमां नाधिगच्छामि पार्थस्य सदृशीं क्षितौ॥
en: Of the wielder of Gandiva ever competent to fulfil his vows in battle, of that son of Pritha, I do see no equal on the face of the earth.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: गुरुवात्सल्यमत्यन्तं नैभृत्यं विनयो दमः। नकुलेऽप्रातिरूप्यं च शौर्ये च नियतानि षट्॥
en: Devotion to the elders, secrecy of counsels, modesty, self-control, beauty of person and heroism, these six virtues are ever present in Nakula.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: श्रुतगाम्भीर्यमाधुर्यसत्यरूपपराक्रमैः। सदृशो देवयोर्वीरः सहदेवः किलाश्विनोः॥
en: In knowledge of the Shrutis, in gravity, in humility, in righteousness, in personal beauty and in prowess, the heroic Sahadeva equals the two immortals viz., the twin Asvinis.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: ये च कृष्णेगुणाः स्फीताः पाण्डवेषु च ये गुणा:। अभिमनयौ किलैकस्था दृश्यन्ते गुणसंचयाः॥
en: All those illustrious qualities that are present mostly in Krishna and in the Pandavas, all those qualities were to be seen combined in Abhimanyu.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: युधिष्ठिरस्य वीर्येण कृष्णस्य चरितेन च। कर्मभिर्भीमसेनस्य सदृशो भीमकर्मणः॥
en: Abhimanyu was equal to Yudhishthira in patience, to Krishna in conduct, to Bhima of terrible deeds in his achievements.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: धनंजयस्य रूपेण विक्रमेण श्रुतेन च। विनयात् सहदेवस्य सदृशो नकुलस्य च॥
en: He was equal to Dhananjaya in beauty of person, prowess and scriptural knowledge and to Nakula and Sahadeva in humility.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अभिमन्युमहं सूत सौभद्रमपराजितम्। श्रोतुमिच्छामि कात्स्येन कथमायोधने हतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Suta, I desire to hear in detail how the invincible son of Subhadra, viz., Abhimanyu was slain in battle.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: संजय उवाच स्थिरो भव महाराज शोकं धारय दुर्धरम्। महान्तं बन्धुनाशं ते कथयिष्यामि तच्छृणु॥
en: Sanjaya said Be patient, O mighty monarch. Bear your unbearable burden of grief. I shall speak of the dreadful carnage of your relations. Now hear be attentively.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: चक्रव्यूहो महाराज आचार्येणाभिकल्पितः। तत्र शक्रोपमाः सर्वे राजानो विनिवेशिता॥
en: The circular array, O monarch, was then formed by the preceptor, in which were duly stationed kings, each equal to Indra himself.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: आरास्थानेषु विन्यस्ताः कुमारा: सूर्यवर्चसः। संघातो राजपुत्राणां सर्वेषामभवत् तदा॥
en: At the head of the array (entrance) were stationed all the princes of the effulgence of the sun. Then there was a veritable assembly of princes.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: कृताभिसमयाः सर्वे सुवर्णविकृतध्वजाः। रक्ताम्बरधराः सर्वे सर्वे रक्तविभूषणाः॥
en: All of them sword to help one another, all owned standards decked with gold; all wore red raiment's and all were decorated with crimson ornaments.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: सर्वे रक्तपताकाश्च सर्वे वै हेमालिनः । चन्दनागुरुदिग्घाङ्गाः स्रग्विणः सूक्ष्मवाससः॥
en: All of them possessed crimson flags, all had golden garlands; all were smeared with sandalpaste and other perfumed unguents and all of them wore floral garlands and fine attires.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: सहिताः पर्यधावन्त कार्णिं प्रति युयुत्सवः। तेषां दश सहस्राणि बभूबुदृढधन्विनाम्॥
en: In a serried file, they rushed against Krishna's nephew. desirous of fighting with him. All of them firm bowmen, then numbered no less then ten thousand strong in all.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: पौत्रं तव पुरस्कृत्य लक्ष्मणं प्रियदर्शनम्। अन्योन्यसमदुःखास्ते अन्योन्यसमसाहसाः॥
en: Placing at their head your handsome grandson Lakshmana, they proceeded to battle, resolved to share one another's grief, emulating one another in deeds of valour.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: अन्योन्यं स्पर्धमानाच अन्योन्यस्य हिते रताः। दुर्योधनस्तु राजेन्द्र सैन्यमध्ये व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Striving to out view one another's and intent on one another's good. O foremost of kings, Duryodhana was stationed in the very centre of your troops.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: कर्णदुःशासनकृपैर्वृतो राजा महारथैः। देवराजोपमः श्रीमाञ्छवेतच्छत्राभिसंवृतः॥
en: The king then was surrounded by such mighty warriors as Karna, Dushasana and Kripa, with a white umbrella held over his head, he appeared beautiful like the king of the celestials.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: चाभरव्यजनाक्षेपैरुदयन्निव भास्करः। प्रमुखे तस्य सैन्यस्य द्रोणोऽवस्थितनायकः॥
en: Fanned by the moving yak-tails, he appeared like the sun himself. In the very van of those troops was stationed Drona the generalissimo of the Kuru hosts.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: सिन्धुराजस्तथातिष्ठच्छीमान् मेरुरिवाचलः। सिन्धुरुजस्य पार्श्वस्था आश्वत्थामपुरोगमाः॥
en: There also was stationed the handsome ruler of the Sindhus, immovable like the mount Meru itself. By the side of the ruler of the Sindhus, headed Ashvatthaman.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: सुतास्तव महाराज त्रिंशत्रिदशसंनिभाः। गान्धारराजः कितवः शल्यो भूरिश्रवास्तथा॥
en: Stood, O mighty monarch, your thirty sons, all resembling the celestials themselves. That gamester, the ruler of the Gandharas, Shalya and Bhurishravas.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: पार्श्वत: सिन्धुराजस्य व्यराजन्त महारथाः। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्॥ तावकानां परेषां च मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥
en: These mighty car-warriors shone in the flank of the king of the Sindhus. Then raged a combat between your troops and those of the enemy, combat, that was fierce in the extreme and horripilating and in which the warriors regarded Death to be their goal.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: सुतास्तव महाराज त्रिंशत्रिदशसंनिभाः। गान्धारराजः कितवः शल्यो भूरिश्रवास्तथा॥
en: Stood, O mighty monarch, your thirty sons, all resembling the celestials themselves. That gamester, the ruler of the Gandharas, Shalya and Bhurishravas.

description: The construction of the circular array
sn: पार्श्वत: सिन्धुराजस्य व्यराजन्त महारथाः। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्॥ तावकानां परेषां च मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥
en: These mighty car-warriors shone in the flank of the king of the Sindhus. Then raged a combat between your troops and those of the enemy, combat, that was fierce in the extreme and horripilating and in which the warriors regarded Death to be their goal.

sn: संजय उवाच तदनीकमनाधृष्यं भारद्वाजेन रक्षितम्। पार्थाः समभ्यवर्तन्त भीमसेनपुरोगमा:॥
en: Sanjaya said The Parthas then led by Bhimasena marched against that invincible array of your soldiers protected by the son of Bharadvaja.

sn: सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। कुन्तिभोजश्च विक्रान्तो द्रुपदश्च महारथः॥
en: Then Satyaki, Chekitana, Prishata's son Dhrishtadyumna, the powerful Kuntibhoja, the mighty car-warrior Drupada.

sn: आर्जुनिः क्षत्रधर्मा च बृहत्क्षत्रश्च वीर्यवान्। चेदिपो धृष्टकेतुश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ घटोत्कचः॥
en: The son of Arjuna, Kshatradharman, the puissant Brihat-kshatra, the ruler of the Chedis, Dhristaketu, the two of Madri, Ghatotkacha.

sn: युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्तः शिखण्डी चापराजितः। उत्तमौजाश्च दुर्धर्षो विराटश्च महारथः॥
en: Yudhamanyu of great prowess, the unvanquished Shikhandin, the irrepressible Uttamaujas, the mighty car-warrior Virat. sons

sn: द्रौपदेयाश्च संरब्धाः शैशुपालिश्च वीर्यवान्। केकयाश्च महावीर्याः सृञ्जयाश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: The wrathful sons of Draupadi, the valiant son of Shishupala, the highly powerful Kekayas and the Srinjayas by thousands,

sn: एते चान्ये च सगणाः कृतास्त्रा युद्धदुर्मदाः। समभ्यधावन् सहसा भारद्वाजं युयुत्सवः॥
en: These and many others followed by their respective clansmen, all accomplished in the use of weapons and invincible in battle rushed with impetuosity at the son of Bharadvaja, out of a desire for battling with him.

sn: समीपे वर्तमानांस्तान् भारद्वाजोऽतिवीर्यवान्। असम्भ्रान्तः शरौघेण महता समवारयत्॥
en: The highly puissant son of Bharadvaja getting the warriors within reach dauntlessly checked them with a mighty downpour of arrows.

sn: महौघः सलिलस्येव गिरिमासाद्य दुर्भिदम्। द्रोणं ते नाभ्यवर्तन्त वेलामिव जलाशयाः॥
en: Like a mighty wave of waters checked by an immovable hill or like the swelling ocean checked by the banks, those warriors of the Pandava army were dashed back by Drona.

sn: पीड्यमानाः शरै राजन् द्रोणचापविनिः सृतैः। न शेकुः प्रमुख स्थातुं भारद्वाजस्य पाण्डवाः॥
en: Afflicted, O king, with the shafts shot upon Drona's bow, the Pandavas could not stand in front of Bharadvaja son.

sn: तदद्भुतमपश्याम द्रोणस्य भुजयोर्बलम्। यदेनं नाभ्यवर्तन्त पञ्चालाः सृञ्जयैः सह॥
en: Then we beheld the wonderful strength of Drona's arms, in as much as, the Panchalas aided by the Srinjayas was not able to assail him.

sn: तमायान्तमभिक्रुद्धं द्रोणं दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरः। बहुधा चिन्तयामास द्रोणस्य प्रतिवारणम्॥
en: Beholding then the infuriate Drona rush towards himself, king Yudhishthira reflected upon the diverse measures for resisting the former.

sn: अशक्यं तु तमन्येन द्रोणं मत्वा युधिष्ठिरः। अविषहां गुरुं भारं सौभद्रं समवासृजत्॥
en: At last regarding Drona to be incapable of being checked by any one else, Yudhishthira placed that unbearable heavy burden on the son of Subhadra.

sn: वासुदेवादनवरं फाल्गुनाच्चामितौजसम्। अब्रवीत् परवीरघ्नमभिमन्युमिदं वचः॥
en: Then addressing that slayer of hostile heroes, namely, Abhimanyu, who was in no way inferior to the son of Vasudeva and was superior to Arjuna himself in infiniteness of prowess, king Yudhishthira said these words-

sn: एत्य नो नार्जुनो गर्हेद् यथा तात तथा कुरु। चक्रव्यूहस्य न वयं विद्मो भेदं कथंचन॥
en: "O son, do you so act, that coming back, Arjuna may not have reason to reproach us. The means for breaking the circular array, is not known to any one of us.

sn: त्वं वार्जुनो वा कृष्णो वा भिन्द्यात् प्रद्युम्न एव वा। चक्रव्यूहं महाबाहो पञ्चमो नोपपद्यते॥
en: O mighty-armed one, either you or Arjuna or Krishna or Pradyumna, can penetrate into the circular array. I do not find a fifth man to do it.

sn: अभिमन्यो वरं तात याचतां दातुमर्हसि। पितॄणां मातुलानां च सैन्यानां चैव सर्वशः॥
en: It behoves you, so O son, O Abhimanyu, to accord the boon that your sires, your uncles and all these soldiers beg of you.

sn: धनञ्जयो हि नस्तात गर्हयेदेत्य संयुगगत्। क्षिप्रमस्त्रं समादाय द्रोणानीकं विशातय॥
en: Quickly taking up your arms, smite down this array of Drona so that returning from the fight with the Samshaptakas Dhananjaya may not blame us."

sn: अभिमन्युरुवाच द्रोणस्य दृढमत्युग्रमनीकप्रवरं युधि। पितॄणां जयमाकाडक्षन्नवगाहेऽविलम्बितम्॥
en: Abhimanyu said Desiring victory to my sires, I will, without delay, penetrate into the middle of Drona's firm and fierce and excellent array of troops in this battle.

sn: उपदिष्टो हि मे पित्रा योगोऽनीकविशातने। नोत्सहे हि विनिर्गन्तुमहं कस्यांचिदापदि॥
en: My father has taught me the way to penetrate this kind of array. But I do not know how to come out of the array, if per chance some danger overtake me there.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच भिन्थ्यनीकं युधां श्रेष्ठ द्वारं संजनयस्व नः। वयं त्वानुगमिष्यामो येन त्वं तात यास्यसि॥
en: Yudhishthira said Pierce, O foremost of warriors, this array and create an opening for us to penetrate into it. Pursuing the very track you shall create, we will follow you.

sn: धनंजयसमं युद्धे त्वां वयं तात संयुगे प्रणिधायानुयास्यामो रक्षन्तः सर्वतोमुखाः॥
en: Secing you penetrate the hostile ranks, we will follow you, O sire, who are equal to Dhananjaya himself in battle, protecting you from all sides.

sn: भीम उवाच अहं त्वानुगमिष्यामि धृष्टद्युम्नोऽथ सात्यकिः। पञ्चाला: केकया मत्स्यास्तथा सर्वे प्रभद्रकाः॥
en: Bhima said will follow you. also will Dhrishtadyumna and Satyaki and the Panchalas, the Kekayas, the Matsyas and the Prabhadrakas.

sn: सकृद् भिन्नं त्वया व्यूहं तत्र तव पुनः पुनः। वयं प्रध्वंसयिष्यामो निघ्नमाना वरान् वरान्॥
en: When the array will once be penetrated into by you, we will again and again destroy it, slaying foremost of the enemies' warriors.

sn: अभिमन्युरुवाच अहमेतत् प्रवेक्ष्यामि पतङ्ग इव संक्रुद्धो ज्वलितं जातवेदसम्॥
en: Abhimanyu said I will break through this invincible array of Drona, like an insect under the influence of anger entering into the flames. I so

sn: द्रोणानीकं दुरासदम्। तत् कर्माद्य करिष्यामि हितं यद् वंशयोर्द्वयोः। मातुलस्य च यत् प्रीतिं करिष्यति पितुश्च मे॥
en: I will this day achieve that feat that will redound to the good of both the families (of my father and mother). I will do what will please my sire and my maternal uncle.

sn: शिशुनैकेन संग्रामे काल्यमानानि संघशः। द्रक्ष्यन्ति सर्वभूतानि द्विषत्सैन्यानि वै मया॥
en: All creatures will see the enemies' host crushed in large bodies by myself, an unaided child.

sn: नाहं पार्थेन जातः स्यां न च जातः सुभद्रया। यदि मे संयुगे कश्चिज्जीवितो नाद्य मुच्यते॥
en: I will not consider myself to be begotten by Partha or born of Subhadra, if today, encountering me, anybody escapes with his life.

sn: यदि चैकरथेनाहं समग्र क्षत्रमण्डलम्। न करोम्यष्टधा युद्धे न भवाम्यर्जुनात्मजः॥
en: If today, on a single car I cannot cut the whole race of the Kshatriyas into eight pieces in battle, I will not regard myself as the begotten son of Arjuna.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच एवं ते भाषमाणस्य बलं सौभद्र वर्धताम्। यत् समुत्सहसे भेत्तुं द्रोणानीकं दुरासदम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said May your might, O son of Subhadra, increase even as you speak, in as much as you venture to break through this impenetrable array of Drona.

sn: रक्षितं पुरुषव्याघेर्महेष्वासैर्महाबलैः। साध्यरुद्रमरुत्तुल्यैर्वस्वग्नयादित्यविक्रमैः॥
en: Being protected by these foremost of men, all fierce bowmen possessed of great strength, all resembling the Sadhyas or the Rudras or the Marutas, all who equal the Vasus, the fires and i the Adityas in prowess.

sn: संजय उवाच तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा स यन्तारमचोदयत्। सुमित्राश्वान् रणे क्षिप्रं द्रोणानीकाय चोदया॥
en: Sanjaya said Hearing those words of Yudhishthira, Abhimanyu commanded his charioteer saying-"Quickly urge, O Sumitra, the steeds towards Drona's divisions."

sn: संजय उवाच सौभद्रस्तद् वचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजस्य धीमतः। अचोदयत यन्तारं द्रोणानीकाय भारत॥
en: Sanjaya said The son of Subhadra, having heard the words of the intelligent king Yudhishthira commanded his charioteer to drive his chariot against the army of Drona.

sn: तेन संचोद्यमानस्तु याहि याहीति सारथिः। प्रत्युवाच ततो राजन्नभिमन्युमिदं वचः॥
en: Thus commanded by him with the words "Proceed, proceed", the charioteer, o king, then replied to Abhimanyu saying-

sn: अतिभारोऽयमायुष्मन्नाहितस्त्वयि पाण्डवैः। सम्प्रधार्य क्षणं बुद्ध्या ततस्त्वं योद्भुमर्हसि॥
en: "Heavy is the burden, O long-lived one, that has today been placed on you by the Pandavas. Ascertaining by your judgment as to whether you have the strength to bear it or not, you should engage in the fight.

sn: आचार्यो हि कृती द्रोणः परमास्त्रे कृतश्रमः। अत्यन्तसुखसंवृद्धस्त्वं चायुद्धविशारदः॥
en: The preceptor Drona, by continued labours, has acquired the excellent weapons and he is an adept in the art of warfare. You, on the other hand, have been brought up in all luxury and are unaccustomed to the toils and severities of fight.”

sn: ततोऽभिमन्युः प्रहसन सारथिं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। सारथे को न्वयं द्रोणः समग्र क्षत्रमेव वा॥
en: Thereupon Abhimanyu, with a a smile, replied to his charioteer saying-"O charioteer, who is indeed this Drona? What avails all this vast host of the Kshatriyas?

sn: ऐरावतगतं शक्रं सहामरगणैरहम्। अथवा रुद्रमीशानं सर्वभूतगणार्चिता। योधयेयं रणमुखे न मे क्षत्रेऽद्य विस्मयः॥
en: I would engage even with Indra on the back of his elephant Airavata and attended by the complete host of the immortals. I do not care anything for all this Kshatriyas today,

sn: न ममैतद् द्विषत्सैन्यं कलामर्हति षोडशीम्। अपि विश्वजितं विष्णुं मातुलं प्राप्य सूतज॥ पितरं चार्जुनं युद्धे न भीर्मामुपयास्यति।
en: This host of the enemy is not competent to fight even with the sixteenth part of myself. Getting, O son of a driver, my uncle (maternal), the world-conquering Vishnu or my father, for my antagonist in battle, I will not this day be overcome with terror."

sn: अभिमन्युश्च तां वाचं कद कृत्य सारथः॥ याहीत्येवाब्रवीदेन द्रोणानीकाय मा चिरम्।
en: Thereafter Abhimanyu seeing at naught those words of his charioteer commanded him saying-"Quickly drive towards the division of Drona."

sn: तत: संनोदयामास हयानाशु त्रिहायनान्॥ नातिहष्टमनाः सूतो हेमभाण्डपरिच्छदान्॥
en: Then the charioteer with a heart scarcely cheerful, urged on his steeds, three years of age and decked with caparisons of gold.

sn: ते प्रेषिताः सुमित्रेण द्रोणानीकाय वाजिनः॥ द्रोणमीयद्रवन् राजन् महावेगपराक्रमम्।
en: Then urged on towards the army of Drona by Sumitra, those steeds, endued with great fleetness and, prowess, rushed, O king, against Drona himself.

sn: तमुदीक्ष्य तथाऽऽयान्तं सर्वे द्रोणपुरोगमाः। अभ्यवर्तन्त कौरव्याः पाण्डवाश्च तमन्वयुः॥
en: Beholding Abhimanyu thus advance, all the warriors, headed by Drona, of the Kaurava host, advanced to meet him who was on the other hand followed by the Pandavas.

sn: स कर्णिकारप्रवरोच्छ्रितध्वजः सुवर्णवर्मार्जुनिरर्जुनाद् वरः। युयुत्सया द्रोणमुखान् महारथान् समासदसिंहशिशुर्यथा द्विपान्॥
en: Then like a young lion falling upon a herd of elephants, the son of Arjuna equal to Arjuna in prowess, owning an excellent standard bearing the device of a Karanikara tree, clad in fine coats of mail, fearlessly rushed against Drona, out of a desire for battle.

sn: ते विंशतिपदे यत्ताः सम्प्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे। आसीद् गाङ्ग इवावर्तो मुहूर्तमुदधाविव॥
en: Filled with delight, the warriors of Drona's division began to strike Abhimanyu as he strove to break through their ranks. Then for a moment only there reigned a confusion, that resembled the eddy that produced there where the Ganges stream flows into the waters of the ocean.

sn: शूराणां युध्यमानानां निघ्नतामितरेतरम्। संग्रामस्तुमुलो राजन् प्रावर्तत सुदारुणः॥
en: Then as the heroes fought on and slew one another, O king, there commenced a pell-mell and awful fight.

sn: प्रवर्तमाने संग्रामे तस्मिन्नतिभयंकरे। द्रोणस्य मिषतो व्यूह भित्त्वा प्राविशदार्जुनिः॥
en: When that awful conflict raged fiercely, the son of Arjuna breaking through the enemies' array entered it even before the very eyes of Drona himself.

sn: तं प्रविष्टं विनिघ्नन्तं शत्रुसंधान् महाबलम्। हस्त्यश्वरथपत्त्यौघाः परिवQरुदायुधाः॥
en: Then large bodies of elephant-riders, horsemen, car-warriors and foot-soldiers, all delighted, surrounded that mighty hero who penetrating into the enemies ranks, had already began to smite them down.

sn: नानावादिनिनदैः क्ष्वेडितोत्कृष्टगर्जितैः। हुंकारैः सिंहनादैश्च तिष्ठ तिष्ठति नि:स्वनैः॥
en: With the sound of various musical instruments, with shouts and slappings of armpits and war-cries, with yells, leonine roars, with cries of 'Slay, slay.'

sn: थोरैहलहलाशब्दैर्मा गास्तिष्ठेहि मामिति। असावहममुत्रेति प्रवदन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: With a dreadful and confused din, with exclamation of Do not go, Stop, Come to me, with repeated voices saying, Here am I, come.

sn: बृहितः सिंजितैर्हासैः करनेमिस्वनैरपि। संनादयन्तो वसुधामभिदुद्रुवुरार्जुनिम्॥
en: With roars of elephants, with the tinkling of ornaments, with roars of laughter, with the clatter of car-wheels and horse-hoofs, filling the earth with all these sounds, the Kauravas warriors assailed the son of Arjuna.

sn: धामापततां वीरः शीघ्रयोधी महाबलः। क्षिणास्त्रो न्यवधीट् राजन् मर्मज्ञो मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: That hero endowed with great lightness in discharging weapons and possessed of the knowledge of the vital parts of the body, swiftly and firmly shooting arrows capable of penetrating the very vitals, began to slaughter those advancing warriors of the enemy.

sn: न्यमाना विवशा नानालिङ्गैः शितैः शरै. पेतुः सुबहुशः शलभा इव गावकम्॥
en: Though thus slaughtered by diverse shafts of exceeding sharpness and rendered quit helpless, yet they, in that battle, fell upon Abhimanyu like fights of insects failing upon fire.

sn: ततस्तेषां शरीरैश्च शरीरावयवैश्च सः। तस्तार क्षिति क्षिप्रं कुशैर्वेदिमिवाध्वरे॥
en: Then with their bodies and their severed parts, Abhimanyu covered the earth like a priest covering the alter with Kusha-grass during a sacrifice.

sn: बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणान् सशरासनसायकान्। सासिचाङ्कुशाभीषून् सतोमरपरश्वधान्॥ शादायोगुडआसान् सर्टितोमरपट्टिशान्। सभिन्दिपालपरिधान् सशक्तिवरकम्पनान्॥ सनतोदमहाशवान् सकुन्तान् सकचग्रहान्। समुद्गरक्षेपणीयान् सपाशपरिघोपलान्॥ सकेयूराङ्गदान बाहून् ह्यगन्धानुलेपनान्। संचिच्छेदा निस्तूर्णं त्वदीयानां सहस्रशः॥
en: Then Arjuna's son quickly lopped off by thousands the arms of your warriors; some of these arms were protected with gloves made of iguana skin, some held bows and shafts, some grasped swords or bucklers or iron hooks and reins, some held lances and axes; some clutched maces or iron ball or spears. Some had in their grasps scimitars or crows or battleaxes; some held short darts or shafts of Kampanas; some held goads and huge conchshells, wielded piked lances and Kachagrahas, some had mallets or other kinds of missiles; some had nooses, some heavy clubs and brick-bats. All of these arms again were ornamented with bracelets and bangles and smeared with fragrant perfumes and unguents.

sn: तैः स्फुरद्भिर्महाराज शुशुभे भूः सुलोहितः। पज्ञास्यैः पन्नगेश्छिन्नैर्गरुडेनेव मारिष॥
en: Then covered with those effulgent arms a!! bathed in the crimson laid, the field, sire, 0 mighty monarch, appeared as if strewn over with five-headed serpents torn io pieces by Garuda.

sn: सुनासाननकेशान्तरखणैश्चारुकुण्डलैः। संदष्टौष्ठपुटैः क्रोधात् क्षरद्भिः शोणितं बहु॥ स चारुमुमुटोष्णीधैर्मणिरत्नविभूषितैः। विनालनलिनाकारैर्दिवाकरशशिप्रभैः॥ हितप्रियंवदैः काले बहुभिः पुण्यगन्धिभिः । द्विषच्छिरोभिः पृथिवीं स वैतस्तार फाल्गुनिः॥
en: Then Phalugna's son spread the earth with the severed heads of the enemy-heads graced with beautiful noses and countenances and tresses of hair and without blotches and adorned with ear-rings; heads from which blood flowed copiously and in which the nether lips were bit in anger; heads that appeared like lotuses severed from their stems, owing to their being decked with beautiful garlands and tiaras and turbans and pearls and gems and owing to their being possessed of the splendour of the sun or the moon; heads that laved with fragrant perfumes could speak sweet and salutary words, when the vital spark was in them.

sn: गन्धर्वनगराकारान् विधिवत् कल्पितान् रथान्। वोषामुखान् द्वित्रिवेणून् न्यस्तदण्डकबन्धुरान्॥ विजङ्घाकूबरांस्तत्र विनेमिदशनानपि। विचक्रोपस्करोपस्थान् भग्नोपकरणानपि॥ प्रपातितोपस्तरणान् हतयोधान् सहस्रशः। शरैर्विशकलीकुर्वन् दिक्षु सर्वास्वदृश्यत॥
en: Then, O Bharata, Arjuna's son careered in all directions over the field, having shattered with his arrows, cars, equipt with all the necessaries of war and looking like the vapoury edifices in the air having shafts in front and excellent bamboo poles and looking beautiful with standards mounted on them. They were all deprived of their fanghas, axels, perriferries and Dascias, wheels, standards and terraces; the implements of war in them were all splintered into pieces; the precious clothes that covered them were all blown away and warriors on those cars, were slain by thousands.

sn: पुनर्द्विपान् द्विपारोहान् वैजयन्त्यङ्कुशध्वजान्! तूणान् वर्माण्यथोकक्ष्यावेयांश्च सकम्बलान्॥ घण्टाः शुण्डाविषाणाग्रान छत्रमाला: पदानुगान्। शरैर्निशितधारागः शात्रवाणामशातयत्॥
en: Then again with arrows of keen points and edges he cut down the enemy's elephants, with their riders, standards hooks, banners, quivers, armours, girths, neck-ropes, caparisons, blankets, bells, trunks; and also the footsoldiers that guarded those elephants from the back.

sn: वनायुजान् काम्बोजानथ बालिकान्। स्थिरबालधिकर्णाक्षाञ्जवनान् साधुवाहिनः॥ आरूढाशिक्षितैर्योधैः शक्त्यष्टिप्रासयोधिभिः। विध्वस्तचामरमुखान् विप्रविद्धप्रकीर्णकान्॥ निरस्तजिह्वानयनान् निष्कीर्णान्त्रयकृद्धानान्। हतरोहांश्छिन्नघण्टान् क्रव्यादगणमोदकान्॥ निकृत्तचर्मकवचाशकृन्मूत्रासृगाप्लुतान्। निपातयन्नश्ववरांस्तावकान् स व्यरोचत॥
en: Numerous steeds of the Vanayu the Lilly, the Kamboja and the Balhika breed with tails, ears and eyes fixed and motionless, endued with great fleetness, well-broken, ridden by accomplished warriors armed with swords and spears, were seen to be deprived of the fine ornaments of their heads as also of their fine tails; they were deeply pierced and lay covering the field. Their tongues and their eyes were fixed and their livers and entrails were drawn out; their riders had been slain; their bells torn and they enhanced the delight of flesh-eating animals. Their armours and other leathern fences were cut open and they lay weltering in the urine and excreta they themselves had discharged. Thus slaughtering your steeds steeds and elephants, Abhimanyu appeared highly beautiful.

sn: एको विष्णुरिवाचिन्त्यं कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्। तथा निर्मथितं तेन त्र्यहं तव बलं महत्॥
en: Achieving, single-handed, these mosi difficult of feats, like the incomprehensible Vishnu in the days of old, Abhimanyu crushed your army consisting of three kinds of forces.

sn: यथासुरबलं घोरं त्र्यम्बकेण महौजसा। कृत्वा कर्म रणेऽसह्यं परैरार्जुनिराहवे॥
en: Even like the three-eyed Deity of infinite prowess crushing the Asura host. In that battle, the son of Arjuna having achieved feats incapable of being achieved by the enemy.

sn: अभिनच्च पदात्योघांस्त्वदीयानेव सर्वशः। एवमेकेन तां सेना सौभद्रेण शितैः शरैः॥ भृशं विप्रहतां दृष्ट्वा स्कन्देनेवासुरी चमूम्। त्वदीयास्तव पुत्राश्च वीक्षमाणा दिशो दश॥
en: Began to break through your infantry divisions on all sides. Thus the beholding the army mangled with sharp arrows of the singlehanded son of Subhadra like the army of the Asuras mangled by Skanda, your sons looked vacantly at all the ten points of the compass.

sn: संशुष्कासयाश्चलन्नेत्राः प्रस्विन्ना रोमहर्षिणः। पलायनकृतोत्साहा निरुत्साहा द्विषज्जये॥
en: Their mouths became parched up; their eyes rolled; their persons were covered with drops of perspiration. Desponding to conquer their antagonist, they exerted themselves in flying away from the field.

sn: गोत्रनामभिरन्योन्यं क्रन्दन्तो जीवितैषिणः। हतान् पुत्रान् पितॄन् भ्रातृन् बन्धून् संबन्धिनस्तथा॥४५ प्रातिष्ठन्त समुत्सृज्य त्वरयन्तो हयद्विपान्॥
en: Desirous of saying their lives, they called out one another by their appellation and family-names. Forsaking on the field their wounded fathers, sons, brothers, friends and relations, they strove to fly away from the field urging the horses and elephants that carried them to the top of their speed. of perspiration. Desponding to conquer their antagonist, they exerted themselves in flying away from the field.

sn: गोत्रनामभिरन्योन्यं क्रन्दन्तो जीवितैषिणः। हतान् पुत्रान् पितॄन् भ्रातृन् बन्धून् संबन्धिनस्तथा॥४५ प्रातिष्ठन्त समुत्सृज्य त्वरयन्तो हयद्विपान्॥
en: Desirous of saying their lives, they called out one another by their appellation and family-names. Forsaking on the field their wounded fathers, sons, brothers, friends and relations, they strove to fly away from the field urging the horses and elephants that carried them to the top of their speed.

sn: संजय उवाच तां प्रभग्नां चमूं दृष्ट्वा सौभद्रेणामितौजसा। दुर्योधनो भृशं क्रुद्धः स्वयं सौभद्रमभ्यतात्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then beholding his army routed Subhadra's son of immeasurable energy, king Duryodhana worked up the highest pitch of fury, himself proceeded against the former

sn: ततो राजानमावृत्तं सौभद्रं प्रति संयुगे। दृष्ट्वा द्रोणोऽब्रवीद् योधान् परीप्सध्वं नराधिपम्॥
en: Then seeing the king turn back upon Subhadra's son in battle, Drona addressed the warriors saying "Save the king.

sn: पुराभिमन्युर्लक्ष्यं नः पश्यतां हनित वीर्यवान्। तमाद्रवत मा भैष्ट क्षिप्रं रक्षत कौरवम्॥
en: The highly puissant Abhimanyu is slaying even before our very eyes, every one he is aiming at. Assail him and be not afraid; and rescue the king of the Kurus."

sn: ततः कृतज्ञा बलिनः सुहृदो जितकाशिनः। त्रास्यमाना भयाद् वीरं परिवQस्तवात्मजम्॥
en: Thereupon grateful, mighty and friendly warriors, ever attended with victory though inspired with fears, yet surrounded your heroic son in order to rescue him.

sn: द्रोणो द्रौणिः कृपः कर्णः कृतवर्मा च सौबलः। बृहद्बलो मद्रराजो भूरिभूरिश्रवाः शलः॥ पौरवो वृषसेनश्च विसृजन्तः शिताञ्छरान्। सौभद्रं शरवर्षेण महता समवाकिरन्॥
en: Drona and Drona's son, Kripa, Karna, Kritavarman and Subala's son, Brihadbala, the ruler of the Madras, Bhuri, Bhurishravas and Shala, Paurava and Vrishasena, all shooting sharp arrows, covered Subhadra's son with thick downpour of arrows.

sn: सम्मोहयित्वा तमथ दुर्योधनममोचयन्। आस्याद् ग्रासमिवाक्षिप्तं ममृषे नार्जुनात्मजः॥
en: Then thus confounding the latter, they rescued Duryodhana. But Arjuna's son did not tolerate this snatching away of the monarch from his very mouth.

sn: ताछरौघेण महता साश्वसूतान् महारथान्। विमुखीकृत्य सौभद्रः सिंहनादमथानदत्॥
en: Compelling those mighty car-warriors with their horses and charioteer to turn their faces away from the field of battle, by means of his arrowy downpour, the son of Subhadra sent up a loud war-cry.

sn: तस्य नादं ततः श्रुत्वा सिंहस्येवामिषैषिणः। नामृष्यन्त सुसंस्थाः पुनर्दोणमुखा रथाः॥
en: Hearing that war-cry of his, resembling the roar of a lion desirous of prey, the warriors of your army headed by Drona and inflamed with rage did not brook it.

sn: त एनं कोष्ठकीकृत्य रथवंशेन मारिष। व्यसृजन्निषुजालानि नानालिङ्गानि सङ्घशः॥
en: Completely surrounding Abhimanyu's with their host of cars, your warriors O sire, began to shoot at him myriads of arrows of diverse description all falling in thick showers.

sn: तान्यन्तरिक्षे चिच्छेद पौत्रस्ते निशितैः शरैः। तांश्चैव प्रतिविव्याध तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: But your grandson, with his own sharp arrows severed all these shafts even when the latter were coursing through the sky; in return also he pierced your warriors; indeed that feat then appeared wonderful.

sn: ततस्ते कोपितास्तेन शरैराशीविषोपमैः। परिवर्जिघांसन्तः सौभद्रमपराजितम्॥
en: Thereupon your warriors, excited with wrath in consequence of being wounded with shaft of the touch of fire and desirous of slaying the unretreating son of Subhadra, surrounded him on all sides.

sn: समुद्रमिव पर्यस्तं त्वदीयं तं बलार्णवम्। दधारैकोऽऽर्जुनिर्वाणैवेलेव भरतर्षभ॥
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, with his arrows that served the purpose of banks, Arjuna's son held in check the agitated ocean that was then identified with the vast number of your troops.

sn: शूराणां युध्यमानानां निजतामितरेतरम्। अभिमन्योः परेषां च नासीत् कश्चित् पराङ्मुखः॥
en: None among those heroes, viz., Abhimanyu on one side and all your warriors on the other, who were then fighting with and slaying one another, turned away from the field of battle.

sn: तस्मिंस्तु घोरे संग्रामे वर्तमाने भयंकरे। दुःसहो नवभिर्बाणैरभिमन्युमविध्यत॥ दुःशासनो द्वादशभिः कृपः शारद्वतस्त्रिभिः। द्रोणस्तु सप्तदशभिः शरैराशीविषोपमैः॥
en: Thus when that awful and terrible combat raged fiercely, Dussaha pierced Abhimanyu with nine arrows, Dushasana pierced him with twelve, Kripa and the son of Saradvata with three, Drona with seventeen arrows, all resembling so many snakes of virulent poison.

sn: विविंशतिस्तु सप्तत्या कृतवर्मा च सप्तभिः। बृहबलस्तथाष्टाभिरश्वत्थामा च सप्तभिः॥ भूरिश्रवास्त्रिभिर्बाणैर्मद्रेशः षड्भिराशुगैः। द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां शकुनिस्त्रिभिर्दुर्योधनो नृपः॥
en: Vivinshati pierced him with seventy Kirtavarman with seven, Brihadbala with eight and Ashvatthaman with arrows, Bhurisravas wounded him with three arrows and the king of the Madras with six swiftcoursing shafts. Shakuni pierced him with a couple of shafts and king Duryodhana with three. seven

sn: स तु तान् प्रतिविव्याध त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः। नृत्यन्निव महाराज चापहस्तः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Abhimanyu, on the other hand, O mighty monarch, pierced each of them with three straight-flying arrows, displaying his prowess and appearing to dance all the while with his bow in hand.

sn: ततोऽभिमन्युः संक्रुद्धस्त्रास्यमानस्तवात्मजैः। विदर्शयन् वै सुमहच्छिक्षौरसकृतं बलम्॥
en: Then Abhimanyu, enraged in consequence of your sons seeking to terrify him displayed his marvelous might that he had acquired through his culture and practices.

sn: गरुडानिलरहोभिर्यन्तुर्वाक्यकरैर्हयैः। दान्तैरश्मकदायादस्त्वरमाणो ह्यवारयत्॥ विव्याध दशभिर्बाणैस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठति चाब्रवीत्।
en: Then borne by his well-trained steeds possessed of the fleetness of Garuda or of the wind and perfectly obedient to the behests of him who held their reins, Abhimanyu quickly repulsed the heir of Ashmaka. Standing before him, the prosperous and mighty son of Ashmaka, pierced him with ten arrows, saying all the while, stay stay.

sn: तस्याभिमन्युर्दशभिर्हयान् सूतं ध्वजं शरैः॥ बाहू धनुः शिश्चौा स्मयमानोभ्यपातयत्।
en: Then with ten arrows Abhimanyu smilingly cut down to the earth, his charioteer, horses, standards, arms, bow and head.

sn: ततस्तस्मिन् हते वीरे सौभद्रेणाश्मकेश्वरे॥ संचचाल बलं सर्वं पलायनपरायणम्।
en: When the heroic ruler of the Ashmakas had thus been slain by the son of Subhadra, the whole of his army being completely agitated, took to flight.

sn: ततः कर्णः कृपो द्रोणो द्रौणिर्गान्धारराट्शलः॥ शल्यो भूरिश्रवाः क्राथः सोमदत्तोविविंशतिः। वृषसेनः सुषेणश्च कुण्डभेदी प्रतर्दनः॥ वृन्दारको ललित्थश्च प्रबाहुर्दीर्घलोचनः। दुर्योधनश्च संक्रुद्धः शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्।॥
en: Thereupon Karna, Kripa, Drona, Drona's son, the ruler of the Gandharas, Shala, Shalya Bhurishravas, Kratha, Somadatta, Vivinshati, Vrishasena, Sushena, Kundabhedin, Pratardana, Vrindaraka, Lalittha, Prabahu, Dirghalochana and king Duryodhana, all excited with rage, covered him with a shower of arrows.

sn: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासैरभिमन्युरजिह्मगैः शरमादत्त कर्णाय वर्मकायामभेदिनम्॥
en: Thus deeply pierced with straight-flying arrows by those mighty bowmen, Abhimanyu. Sped at Karna an arrow capable of penetrating through his armour and body.

sn: तस्य भित्त्वा तनुत्राणं देहं निर्भिद्य चाशुगः। प्राविशद् धरणी वेगाद् वल्मीकमिव पन्नगः॥
en: That swift-flying dart piercing through Karna's armour and body. Entered, O king, the

sn: स तेनातिप्रहारेण व्यथितो विह्वलनिव। संचचाल रणे कर्णः क्षितिकम्पे यथाऽचलः॥
en: Pained to the extreme in consequence of that deep wound and over-whelmed with a swoon. Karna trembled in battle like a hili during an earth-quake.

sn: तथान्यैर्निशितैर्बाणैः सुषेण दीर्घलोचनम्। कुण्डभेदिं च संकुद्धस्त्रिभिस्त्रीनवधीद् बली॥
en: Then with other sharp arrows the valiant Abhimanyu inflamed with rage, slew Sushena, Dirghalochana and Kundabhedhin.

sn: कर्णस्तं पञ्चविंशत्या नाराचानां समार्पयत्। अश्वत्थामा च विंशत्या कृतवर्मा च सप्तभिः॥
en: Thereafter Karna pierced him in return, with twenty-five long shafts. Ashvatthaman pierced him with twenty and Kritavarman with seven arrows.

sn: स शराचितसर्वाङ्गः क्रुद्धः शक्रात्मजात्मजः। विचरन् ददृशे सैन्ये पाशहस्त इवान्तकः॥
en: Then that enraged grandson of Shakra, with his body struck all over with arrows. Looked, as he careered through the forces, like the destroyer himself with noose in hand.

sn: शल्यं च शरवर्षेण समीपस्थमवाकिरंत्। उदक्रोशन्महाबाहुस्तव सैन्यानि भीषयन्॥
en: Then he covered Shalya who was standing near him with a thick shower of arrows; and then that mighty-armed hero sent up a loud war-cry, that inspired terror into your troops.

sn: ततः स विद्धोऽस्त्रविदा मर्मभिद्भिरजिह्मगैः। शल्यो राजन् रथोपस्थे निषसाद मुमोह च॥
en: Pierced with straight arrows capable of penetrating to the vitals shot by Abhimanyu accomplished in all weapons. Shalya squatted down on the terrace of his car, o king and fainted away.

sn: तं हि दृष्ट्वा तथा विद्धं सौभद्रेण यशस्विना। सम्प्राद्रवच्चमूः सर्वा भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Beholding him thus deeply pierced by the illustrious son of Subhadra, all the troops began to fly away, even before the very eyes of the son of Bharadvaja.

sn: सम्प्रेक्ष्य तं महाबाहुं रुक्मपुङ्खः समावृतम्। त्वदीयाः प्रपलायन्ते मृगाः सिंहार्दिता इव॥
en: Beholding that mighty-armed hero Shalya, covered with gold-winged shafts, your troops fled like herds of deer frightened by the lion.

sn: स तु रणयशसाभिपूज्यमानः पितृसुरचारणसिद्धयक्षसंधैः। रतिविबभौ हुतभुग्यथाऽऽज्यसिक्त॥
en: Then Abhimanyu, extolled by the ancestral manes, the celestials and Charanas and Siddhas and also by various kinds of beings inhabiting the earth, with eulogies about his heroism and bravery in battle, appeared blazing like fire fed with clarified butter.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तथा प्रमथमानं तं महेष्वासानजिह्मगैः। आर्जुनि मामकाः संख्ये के त्वेनं समवारयन्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said What warriors of my army then tried to resist the son of Arjuna in battle when he was thus crushing my troops with his straight-flying arrows?

sn: संजय उवाच शृणु राजन् कुमारस्य रणे विक्रीडितं महत्। बिभित्सतो रथानीकं भारद्वाजेन रक्षितम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Hear, 0 king, of the wonderful achievements of the prince (Abhimanyu), when he was engaged in breaking through the cardivision protected by by Bharadvaja's himself.

sn: मद्रेशं सादितं दृष्ट्वा सौभद्रेणाशुगै रणे। शल्यादवरजः क्रुद्धः किरन् वाणान् समभ्ययात्॥
en: Sceing Shalya the ruler of the Madras worsted in battle by Subhadra's son with his arrows, his younger brother, inflamed with wrath proceeded to battle, showering shafts in all directions.

sn: सविद्ध्वा दशभिर्बाणैः साश्वयन्तारमा निम्। उदक्रोशन्महाशब्दं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: He shot ten arrows, injured Abhimanyu with horses and charioteer killed, challenge in a loud voice and said-O! stay there undeviated.

sn: तस्यार्जुनिः शिरोग्रीवं पाणिपादं धनुर्हयान्। छत्रं ध्वजं नियन्तारं त्रिवेणं तल्पमेव च॥ चक्रं युगं च तूणीर ह्यनुकर्षं च सायकैः। पताकां चक्रगोप्तारौ सर्वोपकरणानि च॥ लघुहस्तः प्रचिच्छेद ददृशे तं न कश्चन। स पपात क्षितौ क्षीणः प्रविद्धाभरणाम्बरः॥ वायुनेव महाशैलः सम्भग्नोऽमिततेजसा।
en: Thereupon the light-handed son of Arjuna, with his arrows, cut-off his antagonist's head and neck, arms and legs, four steeds, umbrella, standard and charioteer; his triple bamboo pole fixed to the car, his car-terrace, car-wheels, । yokes, shafts, quivers, car-bottom, his banner, his implements of war with which the car was furnished and also the two persons engaged in protecting his car-wheels. No one was then able to discern him in consequence of the swiftness of his movement). Shalya's brother then pierced through his ornaments and antires. fell down dead on the ground, like a mighty mountain-crest broken by the overwhelming vehemence of a tempest.

sn: अनुगास्तस्य वित्रस्ताः प्राद्रवन् सर्वतो दिशः॥ आर्जुनेः कर्म तद् दृष्ट्वा सम्प्रणेदुः समन्ततः । नादेन सर्वभूतानि साधु साध्विति भारत॥
en: His followers then seized with panic, fled in : all directions. Beholding that fcat achieved by Arjuna's son, all creatures were filled with i delight and they applauded him, O Bharata, saying, “Well-done" Well-done".

sn: शल्यभ्रातर्यथारुग्णे बहुशस्तस्य सैनिकाः। कुलाधिवासनामानि श्रावयन्तोऽर्जुनात्मजम्॥ अभ्यधावन्त संक्रुद्धा विविधायुधपाणयः।
en: When Shalya's brother had thus been killed, many of his soldiers, loudly proclaiming their names, places of residence and families, rushed against Arjuna's son, being excited with rage and wielding in their arms various kinds of weapons.

sn: स्थैरश्वैर्गजैश्चान्ये पद्भिश्चान्ये बलोत्कटाः॥ बाणशब्देन महता रथनेमिस्वनेन च। हुंकारैः क्ष्वेडितोत्क्रुष्टैः सिंहनादैः संगर्जितैः॥ ज्यातलत्रस्वनैरन्ये गर्जन्तोऽर्जुननन्दनम्। ब्रुवन्तश्च न नो जीवन् मोक्ष्यसे जीवितादिति॥
en: All those warriors were possessed of great strength, some of them rushed on their car, others on steeds, others on elephants and some on foot. With the whizz of their arrows, with the loud clatter of their car-wheels, with warcries, with roars, whoops and exclamations, with leonine roars and cries with the twang of their bow-strings and with many other kinds of sound-seeking to terrify Arjuna's son, they rushed at him saying, “You shall not escape us today with your life, even if it cost us our own lives."

sn: तांस्तथा ब्रुवतो दृष्ट्वा सौभद्रः प्रहसन्निव। यो योऽस्मै प्राहरत् पूर्वेततं विव्याध पत्रिभिः॥
en: Hearing them thus speak, the son of Subhadra smilingly pierced those with shafts who had smitten him first.

sn: संदर्शयिष्यन्नस्त्राणि विचित्राणि लघूनि च। आणुनिः समरे शूरो मृदुपूर्वमयुध्यत॥
en: Holding diverse kinds of weapons, all beautiful and swift-going, to the gaze of the people, Arjuna's heroic son battled with them mildly.

sn: वासुदेवादुपात्तं यदस्त्रं यच्च धनंजयात्। अदर्शयत तत् कार्ष्णिः कृष्णाभ्यामविशेषवत्॥
en: Then, in no way less than Krishna and Arjuna, Abhimanyu began to display all those weapons he had received from Vasudeva's son and Arjuna.

sn: दूरमस्य गुरुं भारं साध्वसं च पुनः पुनः। संदधद् विसृसंश्चेषून् निर्विशेषमदृश्यत॥
en: Setting at naught the heavy burden he had drawn upon himself and dismissing all fears away, Abhimanyu then scattered his arrows (in all directions). No interval could then be noticed between his taking up and shooting the shafts.

sn: चापमण्डलमेवास्य विस्फुरद् दिक्ष्वदृश्यत। सुदीप्तस्य शरत्काले सवितुर्मण्डलं यथा॥
en: Only his bow drawn to the fullest stretch could then be seen blazing like the burning disc of the sun in the autumnal sky.

sn: ज्याशब्दः शुश्रुवे तस्य तलशब्दश्च दारुणः। महाशनिमुचः काले पयोदस्येव निःस्वनः॥
en: Then, O Bharata, there were heard the twangs of his bow and the slapping of his palms, resembling the rumble of rain-clouds surcharged with the thunder during the rains.

sn: द्वीमानमर्षी सौभद्रो मानकृत् प्रियदर्शनः। सम्मिनानयिषुर्वीरानिष्वस्त्रैश्चाप्ययुध्यत॥
en: Bashful, unenvious, handsome and devoted to the elders, the son of Subhadra, out of respect for his heroic opponents fought on with arrows and other weapons,

sn: मृदुर्भूत्वा महाराज दारुणः समपद्यता वर्षाभ्यतीतो भगवाञ्छरदीव दिवाकरः॥
en: Mildly; but gradually he grew fierce, O king, like the blazing autumnal Sun at the end of the rainy seasons.

sn: शरान् विचित्रान् सुबहून् रुक्मपुङ्खान्छिलाशितान्। मुमोच शतशः क्रुद्धो गभस्तीनिव भास्करः॥
en: Then like the lustrous orb shooting his rays, he, excited with wrath, shot hundreds of diverse kinds of arrows, all whetted on stone and furnished with golden wings.

sn: क्षुप्रैर्वत्सदन्तैश्च विपाठैश्च महायशाः। नाराचैरर्धचन्द्राभैर्भल्लैरञ्जलिकैरपि॥ अवाकिरद् रथानीकं भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः। ततस्तत्सैन्यमभवद् विमुखं शरपीडितम्॥
en: Then with horse-shoe-headed arrows, calftooth-headed shafts, with Vipatas, with long shafts with crescent-headed arrows and with Anjalikas, that illustrious warriors. Began to mangle the car-division of your army, even before the of Bharadvaja's Thereupon the army afflicted with his shafts turned its face away from the field of battle. eyes son.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच द्वैधीभवति मे चित्तं ह्रिया तुष्ट्या च संजय। मम पुत्रस्य यत् सैन्यं सौभद्रः समावारयत्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Upon hearing that Subhadra's son, singleheaded as he was, held in bay the entire army of my son, my heart, my heart, O Sanjaya, is simultaneously filled with shame and delight.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: विस्तरेणैव मे शंस सर्वे गावल्गणे पुनः। विक्रीडितं कुमारस्य स्कन्दस्येवासुरैः सह॥
en: O son of Gavalgani, relate to me in detail the fight with prince Abhimanyu, that seems to be much like that between Skanda and the Asuras.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: संजय उवाच हन्त ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि विमर्दमतिदारुणम्। एकस्य च बहूनां च यथाऽऽसीत्तुमुलो रणः॥
en: Sanjaya said Yes; I will tell you all about the dreadful carnage, the dreadful battle that was fought between the one and the many.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: अभिमन्युः कृतोत्साहः कृतोत्साहानरिंदमान्। रथस्थो रथिनः सर्वोस्तावकानभ्यवर्षयत्॥
en: Then mounted upon his car and exerting his best, Abhimanyu began to shower shafts upon your warriors, all subduers of their foes, mounted on cars and exerting to the best of their might.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: द्रोणं कर्णं कृपं शल्यं द्रौणिं भोजं बृहद्बलम्। दुर्योधनं सौमदत्तिं शकुनि च महाबलम्॥ नानानृपान् नृपसुतान् सैन्यानि विविधानि च। अलातचक्रवत् सर्वांश्चरन् बाणैः समार्पयत्॥
en: Roving like a circle of fire, he then struck his arrows of Drona, Karna, Kripa, Shalya, Drona's son, Bhoja, Brihadbala, Duryodhana, Somadatta's son, the valiant Shakuni and various other kings and princes and diverse kind of troops.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: निघ्नन्नमित्रान् सौभद्रः परमास्त्रैः प्रतापवान्। अदर्शयत तेजस्वी दिक्षु सर्वासु भारत॥
en: With his excellent weapons slaying his focs, the highly puissant son of Subhadra, endued with fierce energy, was then scen, O Bharata, on all directions.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: तद् दृष्ट्वा चरितंतस्य सौभद्रस्यामितौजसः। समकम्पन्त सैन्यानि त्वदीयानि सहस्रशः॥
en: Beholding those feats of Subhadra's son of immeasurable prowess, your troops trembled repeatedly.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: अथाब्रवीन्महाप्राज्ञो भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। हर्षेणोत्फुल्लनयनः कृपमाभाष्य सत्वरम्॥ घट्टयन्निव मर्माणि पुत्रस्य तव भारत। अभिमन्युं रणे दृष्ट्वा तदा रणविशारदम्॥
en: Thereupon the highly wise and valiant son of Bharadvaja, with his eyes blooming forth in delight, addressing Kripa quickly said, beholding then Abhimanyu proficient in battle he said these words of Kripa, O Bharata, thereby seeming to pierce the very vitals of your sons.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: एष गच्छति सौभद्रः पार्थानां प्रथितो युवा। नन्दयन् सुहृदः सर्वान् राजानं च युधिष्ठिरम्॥ नकुलं सहदेवं च भीमसेनं च पाण्डवम्। बन्धून् सम्बन्धिनश्चान्यान् मध्यस्थान् सुहृदस्तथा॥
en: Drona said-Yonder advances the youthful son of Subhadra at the head of the Parthas, imparting delight to all his friends, to king Yudhishthira, to Nakula, to Sahadeva, to Bhimasena the son of Pandu, to his friends, relatives, kinsinen and to all who are passive and neutral spectators.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: नास्य युद्धे समं मन्ये कंचिदन्यं धनुर्धरम्। इच्छन् हन्यादिमां सेनां किमर्थमपि नेच्छति॥
en: I do not regard any other bowman equal to him in fight. If he wills, he can annihilate this vast host; but why does he not wish it?

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: द्रोणस्य प्रीतिसंयुक्तं श्रुत्वा वाक्यं तवात्मजः। आर्जुनि प्रति संक्रुद्धो द्रोणं दृष्ट्वा स्मयन्निव॥ अथ दुर्योधनः कर्णमब्रवीद् बाह्निकं नृपः। दुःशासनं मद्रराजं तांस्तथान्यान् महारथान्॥
en: Thereupon hearing the words of Drona that betrayed how delighted he (at Abhimanyu's feat), your son cnraged with Abhimanyu, smiled looking Drona. Thereafter, king Duryodhana addressing Karna, king Balhika, Dushasana, the ruler of the Madras and many other mighty carwarriors present, said-

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: सर्वमूर्धाभिषिक्तानामाचार्यो ब्रह्मवित्तमः। अर्जुनस्य सुतं मूढं नायं हन्तुमिहेच्छति॥
en: “The preceptor of all venerable Kshatriyas, this one foremost of all those conversant with Brahma, does not, out of affection, wish to slay the son of Arjuna.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: न ह्यस्य समरे युद्ध्य्यदन्तकोऽप्याततायिनः। किमङ्ग पुनरेवान्यो मर्त्यः सत्यं ब्रवीमि वः॥
en: None can escape him in battle, no, not even the Des.royer himself, if he comes as an was at antagonist. What then, O friends, shall we say of a mortal! I say this forsooth.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: अर्जुनस्य सुतं त्वेष शिष्यत्वादभिरक्षति। शिष्याः पुत्राश्च दयितास्तदपत्यं च धर्मिणाम्॥
en: He spares the son of Arjuna for he is his pupil. Pupils, their sons and grandsons, are ever dear to the righteous people.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: संरक्ष्यमाणो द्रोणेन मन्यते वीर्यमात्मनः। आत्मसम्भावितो मूढस्तं प्रमनीत मा चिरम्॥
en: Thus protected by Drona Abhimanyu is prizing his valour highly. Indeed he is a fool proud of himself. Crush him without delay."

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: एवमुक्तास्तु ते राज्ञा सात्वतीपुत्रमभ्ययुः। संरब्धास्ते जिघांसन्तो भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Thus spoken to, O king, they rushed against the son of Subhadra the daughter of the Satvata race, all inspired with wrath and a desire to slay the latter, before the very eyes of Bharadvaja's son.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: दुःशासनस्तु तच्छुत्वा दुर्योधनवचस्तदा। अब्रवीत् कुरुशार्दूल दुर्योधनमिदं वचः॥
en: Then that foremost of the Kurus, viz., Dushasana, having heard the words of Duryodhana, addressed these words to him in reply.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: अहमेनं हनिष्यामि महाराज ब्रवीमि ते। मिषतां पाण्डुपुत्राणां पञ्चालानां च पश्यताम्॥
en: “I tell you, O mighty monarch, I will slay this one before the very eyes of the sons of Pandu and at the sight of the Panchalas themselves.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: ग्रसिष्याम्यद्य सौभद्रं यथा राहुर्दिवाकरम्। उत्क्रुश्य चाब्रवीद् वाक्यं कुरुराजमिदं पुनः॥
en: Today, like the Rahu devouring the maker of the day, I will devour the son of Subhadra.” Then raising his voice, Dushasana once more spoke to the Kuru kings thus.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: श्रुत्वा कृष्णौ मया ग्रस्तं सौभद्रमतिमानिनौ। गमिष्यतः प्रेतलोकं जीवलोकान्न संशयः॥
en: "Hearing that the son of Subhadra has been slain by me, the two Krishnas, both braggards, will surely go to the regions of the departed, leaving this world of animate beings.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: तौ च श्रुत्वा मृतौ व्यक्तं पाण्डोः क्षेत्रोद्भवाः सुताः एकाह्ना ससुहृवर्गाः क्लैब्याद्धास्यन्ति जीवितम्।। २ ।
en: Then it is evident also, that hearing of the death of these latter, the other sons of Pandi, with all their allies and friends, will give up their lives in the course of a single day, out of despair.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: तस्मादस्मिन् हते शत्रौ हताः सर्वेऽहितास्तव। शिवेन मां ध्याहि राजन्नेष हन्मि रिऽस्तव॥
en: It seems therefore, that this one enemy of yours being slain, all the rest of them will be destroyed. Wish me well, O king, even I will slay this your enemy.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: एवमुक्त्वानदद् राजन् पुत्रो दुःशासनस्तव। सौभद्रमभ्ययात् क्रुद्धः शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्॥
en: Having thus spoken, o king, your son Dushasana waxing wroth and sending up a loud war cry, rushed at Subhadra's son, covering him at the same time with a shower of arrows.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: तमतिक्रुद्ध मायान्तं तव पुत्रमरिंदमः। अभिमन्युः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः षड्विंशत्या समार्पयत्॥
en: Then, O subduer of your foes, beholding your wrathful son advance furiously towards himself, Abhimanyu wounded him, with twenty-six arrows of exceeding sharpness.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: दुः:शासनस्तु संक्रुद्धः प्रभिन्न इव कुञ्जरः। अयोधयत सौभद्रमभिमन्युश्च तं रणे॥
en: Then like an elephant with its ternples rent, Dushasana infuriate with rage, fought on with Abhimanyu the illustrious son of Subhadra.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: तौ मण्डलानि चित्राणि रथाभ्यां सव्यदक्षिणम्। चरमाणावयुध्येतां रथशिक्षाविशारदौ॥
en: Then those two heroes well-versed in the art of driving cars, fought on describing beautiful circles, right and left, with their ears.

description: The encounter between Dushasana and Abhimanyu
sn: अथ पणवमृदङ्गदुन्दुभीनां क्रकचमहानकभेरिझर्झराणाम्। लवणजलोद्भवसिंहनादमिश्रम्॥
en: The combatants then set up a loud din, with the sounds of their Pandavas Mridangas Dundubhis, Krakachas, mighty Anakas, Bheris and Jharjharas, mingled with their war-cries, such as is produced by the great reservoir of saline water. The combatants then set up a loud din, with the sounds of their Pandavas Mridangas Dundubhis, Krakachas, mighty Anakas, Bheris and Jharjharas, mingled with their war-cries, such as is produced by the great reservoir of saline water.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: संजय उवाच शरविक्षतगात्रं तु प्रत्यमित्रमवस्थितम्। अभिमन्युः स्मयन् धीमान् दुःशासनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then the highly intelligent Abhimanyu with his body mangled with arrow-wounds smilingly addressing his antagonist Dushasana stationed before him, spoke these words.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: दिष्ट्या पश्यामि संग्रामे मानिनं शूरमागतम्। निष्ठुरं त्यक्तधर्माणमाक्रोशनपरायणम्॥
en: "It is by good luck that today I find before me that vain warrior of cruel deeds and lost righteousness who ever brays loudly in his own applause.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: यत् सभायांत्वया राज्ञो धृतराष्ट्रस्य शृण्वतः। कोपितः परुषैर्वाक्यैर्धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥ जयोन्मत्तेन भीमश्च बह्वबद्धं प्रभाषितः। अक्षकूटं समाश्रित्य सौबलस्यात्मनौ बलम्॥
en: In as much as in the midst of the assembly of courtiers and at the very hearing of king Dhritarashtra, you pierced the very virtuous king Yudhishthira with harsh words and in as much depending on the unfair game at dice and on the skill of Shakuni therein, you, intoxicated with joy, addressed many wild words of Bhima.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: तत् त्वयेदमनुप्राप्तं तस्य कोपान्महात्मनः। परवित्तापहारस्य क्रोधस्याप्रशमस्य च॥ लोभस्य ज्ञाननाशस्य द्रोहस्यात्याहितस्य च। पितॄणां मम राज्यस्य हरणस्योगधन्विनाम्॥ तत् त्वयेदमनुप्राप्तं प्रकोपाद् वै महात्मनाम्। स तस्योगमधर्मस्य फलं प्राप्नुहि दुर्मते॥
en: In consequence of all these acts and in consequence of the wrath of all those illustrious heroes, the present fate has overtaken you. O wicked-minded one, to you now reap the fatal fruits of your robbery of other peoples' possessions, of your wrathful temperaments, of your hatred for peace, of your covetousness, of your ignorance, harmfullness and persecution of others, as also of depriving my sires, all fierce bowmen, of their kingdom and of your own unrighteousness, This day before the eyes of all these warriors I will chastise you with my arrows.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: शासिताम्यद्य ते बाणैः सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः। अद्याहमनृणस्तस्य कोपस्त भविता रणे॥
en: This day I will free myself from the burden of anger I bear against you, as also from the debt I owe to my sires and to the angry Krishna, who ever desire your death.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: अमर्षितायाः कृष्णायाः काक्षितस्य च मे पितुः। अद्य कौरव्य भीमस्य भवितास्म्यनृणो युधि॥
en: Today, O descendant of the Kuru race, I will in battle pay off the debt I owe to Bhima; you shall not this day escape me with life, provided you do not abandon the fight.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: न हि मे मोक्ष्यसे जीवन् यदि नोत्सृजसे रणम्। एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्बाणं दुःशासनान्तकम्॥
en: Having thus spoken, that mighty-armed hero, that slayer of hostile heroes, fixed on his bow-string an arrow, endued with with the effulgence of Yama, Fire or the Windgod and calculated to bring about Dushasana's death.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: संदधे परवीरघ्नः कालाग्न्यनिलवर्चसम्। तस्योरस्तूर्णमासाद्य जत्रुदेशे विभिद्य तम्॥
en: Flying towards Dushasana's breast, that arrow pierced his shoulder-joint up to the very bones, like a snake piercing into an ant hill.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: जगाम सह पुखेन वल्मीकमिव पन्नगः। अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या पुनरेव समार्पयत्॥
en: Then again he struck Dushasana with twenty-five arrows that resembled fire in their away from touch and were shot from his bow drawn back even to his every ears (i.e. fully).

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: शरैरग्निसमस्पर्शेराकर्णसमचोदितैः। स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्॥
en: Thus deeply pierced and painted to the extreme, Dushasana squatted down on the terrace of his chariot and, O mighty monarch, he became unconscious in a swoon.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: दुःशासनो महाराज कश्मलं चाविशन्महत्। सारथिस्त्वरमाणस्तु दुःशासनमचेतनम्॥
en: Thereupon his charioteer quickly carried the field the unconscious Dushasana who had been sorely afflicted by Abhimanyu's arrows.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: रणमध्यादपोवाह सौभद्रशरपीडितम्। पाण्डवा द्रौपदेयाश्च विराटश्च समीक्ष्य तम्॥
en: The Pandavas, the sons of Draupadi and Virat and the Kekayas and the Panchalas, beholding that act of Subhadra's son sent up a loud roar like that of a lion.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: पञ्चलाः केकयाश्चैव सिंहनादमथानदन्। वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि नानालिङ्गानि सर्वशः॥
en: Then filled with joy, the troops of the Pandavas struck up numerous musical instruments of various description and shape, from all sides.

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: प्रावादयन्त संहृष्टाः पाण्डूनां तत्र सैनिकाः। अपश्यन् स्मयमानाश्च सौभद्रस्य विचेष्टितम्॥
en: Beholding that feat achieved by Subhadra's son, they were amazed. Then seeing their most implacable and arrogant adversary thus worsted,

description: The defeat of Karna and Dushasana
sn: अत्यन्तवैरिणं दृप्तं दृष्ट्वा शत्रु पराजितम्। धर्ममारुतशक्राणामश्विनोः प्रतिमास्तथा॥ धारयन्तो ध्वजाग्रेषु द्रौपदेया महारथाः। सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च धृष्टद्युम्नशिखण्डिनौ॥ केकया धृष्टकेतुश्च मत्स्याः पञ्चालसंजयाः। पाण्डवाश्च मुदा युक्ता युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः॥ अभ्यद्रवन्त त्वरिता द्रोणानीकं बिभित्सवः।
