en: The sound then created by the falling of heads on the earth, resembled that produced by the falling of ripe palm fruit.

sn: ततः कबन्धं किंचित् तु धनुरालम्ब्य तिष्ठति। किंचित् खङ्गं विनिष्कृष्य भुजेनोद्यम्य तिष्ठति॥
en: Some headless tiunk were seen standing there, with their bows in grasp. Some again stood, with their drawn swords raised on air (for striking).

sn: पतितानि न जानन्ति शिरांसि पुरुषर्षभाः। अमृष्यमाणाः संग्रामे कौन्तेयं जयगृद्धिनः॥
en: The (surviving) foremost of warriors, all resenting those feats of Arjuna, the son of Kunti and desirous of conquering him in battle, did not pay any regard to the fallen heads (of their brother warriors).

sn: हयानामुत्तमाङ्गैश्च हस्तिहस्तैश्च मेदिनी। बाहुभिश्च शिरोभिश्च वीराणां समकीर्यत॥
en: The Earth became strewn over with the heads of horses, the trunks of elephants and the heads and arms of heroic warriors.

sn: अयं पार्थः कुत पार्थ एष पार्थ इति प्रभो। तव सैन्येषु योधानां पार्थभूतमिवाभवत्॥
en: 'This is Arjuna' 'Where is Partha' 'Here is Pritha's son'-0 master, even thus were the troops of your army then filled with the thought of Partha.

sn: अन्योन्यमपि चाजघ्नुरात्मानमपि चापरे। पार्थभूतममन्यन्त जगत कालेन मोहिताः॥
en: They then began to strike one another and some of them again struck their ownselves. Confounded by Time, they then beheld the world to be full of battle only.

sn: निष्टनन्तः सरुधिरा विसंज्ञा गाढवेदनाः। शयाना बहयो वीराः कीर्तयन्तः स्वबान्धवान्॥
en: Uttering cries of agony, steeped in blood, deprived of consciousness, suffering excruciating plain, many heroes prostrate on the field of battle, began to summon their friends and relatives, for succour.

sn: सभिन्दिपालाः सप्रासा: सशक्त्यृष्टिपरश्वधाः। सनियूहाः सनिस्त्रिंशाः सशरासनतोमराः॥
en: Holding Bhindipalas or lances or darts or swords or battle-axes or piked stakes or scimitars or bows or Tomaras.

sn: सबाणवर्माभरणाः सगदाः साङ्गदा रणे। महाभुजगसंकाशा बाहवः परिघोपमाः॥ उद्वेष्टन्ति विचेष्टन्ति संचेष्टन्ति च सर्वशः। वेगं कुर्वन्ति संरब्धा निकृत्ताः परमेषुभिः॥
en: Or shaft or maces and covered with mail and adorned with Angadas and other ornaments and looking like huge snakes and resembling large bludgeons, hands cut-off with mighty weapons from the trunks, were seen to leap, jump and jerk about with great force, as if in rage.

sn: यो यः स्म समरे पार्थे प्रतिसंचरते नरः। तस्य तस्यान्तको बाणः शरीरमुपसर्पति॥
en: Whoever then ventured to advance in rage against Partha, had a fatal shafts discharged by that hero, stuck deep on his body.

sn: नृत्यतो रथमार्गेषु धनुर्व्यायच्छतस्तथा। न कश्चित् तत्र पार्थस्य ददृशोऽन्तरमण्वपि॥
en: Not the slightest flew was then detected in Pritha's son, as he danced in the terrace of his chariot and stretched his mighty bow.

sn: यत्तस्य घटमानस्य क्षिप्रं विक्षिपतः शरान्। लाघवात् पाण्डुपुत्रस्य व्यस्मयन्त परे जनाः॥
en: The troops belonging to the party hostile to him, were then amazed by beholding the lightness of hands with which he took out his shafts, placed them on the bow-string and discharged them.

sn: हस्तिनं हस्तियन्तारमश्वमाश्विकमेव च। अभिनत् फाल्गुनो बाणै रथिनं च ससारथिम्॥
en: Then Phalguna with his arrows penetrated elephants and their drivers, horses and their riders and car-warriors with their car-drivers.

sn: आवर्तमानमावृत्तं युध्यमानं च पाण्डवः। प्रमुखे तिष्ठमानं च न किंचिन्न निहन्ति सः॥
en: There was none among the hostile troop, whether standing in front of him or exerting in battle or moving about or urged on, whom the arrows discharged by Arjuna did not pierce through.

sn: यथोदयन् वै गगने सूर्यो हन्ति महत् ममः। तथार्जुनो गजानीकमवधीत् कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥
en: Just as the sun rising in the heavens destroys deep darkness (of night), so did Arjuna destroy elephant with his arrows furnished with wings of Kanka-feathers.

sn: हस्तिभिः पतितैर्भिन्नैस्तव सैन्यमदृश्यत। अन्तकाले यथा भूमिळवकीर्णा महीधरैः॥
en: That part of the field occupied by your troops looked like the Earth at the hour of dessolution, covered with hillocks, in consequence of its being strewn over with fallen and mangled elephants.

sn: यथा मध्यन्दिने सूर्यो दुष्प्रेक्ष्यः प्राणिभिः सदा। तथा धनंजयः क्रुद्धो दुष्प्रेक्ष्यो युधि शत्रुभिः॥
en: Just as the sun shining in the meredian is incapable of being looked at by beings, so then in that battle, Dhananjaya inflamed with rage, was incapable of being looked at by his enemies.

sn: तत् तथा तव पुत्रस्य सैन्यं युधि परंतप। प्रभग्नं द्रुतमाविग्नमतीव शरपीडितम्॥
en: Then O scorcher of foes, the troops of your son afflicted with the arrows of Arjuna, deserted their ranks and fled from the field.

sn: मारुतेनेव महता मेघानीकं व्यदीर्यत। प्रकाल्यमानं तत् सैन्यं नाशकत् प्रतिवीक्षितुम्॥
en: Like the tempest scattering and tearing a mass of cloud, Arjuna then routed your army; when he was thus afflicting the army, none could turn his eyes towards him.

sn: प्रतोदैश्चापकोटीभिर्हङ्कारैः साधुवाहितैः। कशापाय॑भिघातैश्च वाग्भिरुग्राभिरेव च॥ चोदयन्तो हयांस्तूर्णे पलायन्ते स्म तावकाः। सादिनो रथिनश्चैव पत्तयश्चार्जुनार्दिताः॥
en: Afflicted by Arjuna, you troops viz., the cavalry, the infantry and the car-warriors, fled in all haste from the field of battle, urging their horses to the top of their speed by goadstrokes, by stroke of the horns of their bows, by growls, by encouraging commands, by who's by (dagger) cuts on their flanks and also by threatening speeches.

sn: पाष्णर्यंङ्गुष्टाङ्कुशे गं चादयन्तस्तथा परे। शरैः सम्मोहिताश्चान्ये तमेवाभिमुखा ययुः। तव योधा हतोत्साहा विभ्रान्तमनसस्तदा।॥
en: Others (riding on elephants) fled urging their huge by pressing their sides with toes or with the stroke of the hooks; others again confounded by Parthas arrows, even fled to the direction of Partha himself. Thus then all your warriors were deprived of sense and their minds also became distracted.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तस्मिन् प्रभग्ने सैन्याने वध्यमाने किरीटिना। के तु तत्र रणे वीराः प्रत्युदीयुर्धनंजयम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When the vanguard of my troops were thus slaughtered and routed by the diadem-decked Arjuna, what heroes of my army then proceeded to fight with Dhananjaya.

sn: आहोस्विच्छकटव्यूहं प्रविष्टा मोघनिश्चयाः। द्रोणमाश्रित्य तिष्ठन्तं प्राकारमकुतोभयम्॥
en: Or did all of them, forgetting their determination, enter into the Sakata array and stood behind the fearless Drona resembling a solid wall?

sn: संजय उवाच तथार्जुनेन सम्भग्ने तस्मिंस्तव बलेऽनघ। हतवीरे हतोत्साहे पलायनकृतक्षणे॥ पाकशासनिनाभीक्ष्णं वध्यमाने शरोत्तमैः। न तत्र कश्चित् संग्रामे शशाकार्जुनमीक्षितुम्॥
en: Sanjaya said When, O sinless one, Arjuna the son of Pakashasani (Indra) had broken and slain with his excellent arrows our own troops, many were the heroes that were slain or fled with depressed hearts. None indeed was able to look upon him.

sn: ततस्तव सुतो राजन् दृष्ट्वा सैन्यं तथागतम्। दुःशासनो भृशं क्रुद्धो युद्धायार्जुनमभ्यगात्॥
en: Then O king your son Dushasana, seeing your troops in that wretched plight became inflamed with rage and advanced towards Arjuna for fighting with the latter.

sn: स काञ्चनविचित्रेण कवचेन समावृतः। जाम्बूनदशिरस्त्राणः शूरस्तीव्रपराक्रमः॥
en: That hero of fierce energy was cased in a coat of mail worked exquisitely with gold and he wore also a helmet of pure gold.

sn: नागानीकेन महता ग्रसन्निव महीमिमाम्। दुःशासनो महाराज सव्यसाचिनमावृणोत्॥
en: 0 mighty monarch, Dushasana then surrounded Savyasachin with a mighty division of elephants that seemed to devour the whole earth.

sn: ह्रादेन गजघण्टानां शङ्खानां निनदेन च। ज्याक्षेपनिनदैश्चैव विरावेण च दन्तिनाम्॥
en: With the booming of the bells tied to the necks of elephants, with the blasts of the conchs, with the twang of bows, with war cried with the roars of tusked elephants.

sn: भूर्दिशश्चान्तरिक्षं च शब्देनासीत् समावृतम्। स मुहूर्ते प्रतिभयो दारुणः समपद्यत॥
en: The earth, the points of the compass and the welkin, became completely filled. The hour appeared to be awful and solemn.

sn: तान् दृष्ट्वा पततस्तूर्णमङ्कुशैरभिचोदितान्। व्यालम्बहस्तान् संरब्धान् सपक्षानिव पर्वतान्॥
en: Beholding those infuriate and huge elephants with extended trunks and urged with hooks make towards himself like so many winged mountains.

sn: सिंहनादेन महता नरसिंहो धनंजयः। गजानीकममित्राणामभीतो व्यधमच्छरैः॥
en: That foremost of men, Dhananjaya sending up a fierce war-cry, fell to agitate that elephant division of his enemy, with his shafts.

sn: महोर्मिणमिवोद्भूतं श्वसनेन महार्णवम्। किरीटी तद् गजानीकं प्राविशन्मकरो यथा॥
en: Then like a Makara entering into the waters of the mighty main lashed into fury by the tempest the diadem-decked Arjuna penetrated into that elephant division.

sn: काष्ठातीत इवादित्यः प्रतपन् स युगक्षये। ददृशे दिक्षु सर्वासु पार्थः परपुरंजयः॥
en: Indeed then Partha that conqueror of hostile fortresses, was seen by every body on every side to resemble the burning sun that rises on the day of dissolution, in contravention of all rules about direction and hour.

sn: खुरशब्देन चाश्वानां नेमिघोषेण तेन च। तेन चोत्कृष्टशब्देन ज्यानिनादेन तेन च॥
en: In consequence of the clatter of horse hoofs, the rattle of car-wheels, the he cries cries of combatants, the twang of bowstrings.

sn: नानावादिवशब्देन पाञ्चजन्यस्वनेन च। देवदत्तस्य घोषेण गाण्डीवनिनदेन च॥
en: The sounds of various musical instruments, the blasts of Panchajanya and Devadatta (the conchs of Arjuna and Krishna) and the crackling of the bow Gandiva.

sn: मन्दवेगा नरा नागा बभूवुस्ते विचेतसः। शरैराशीविषस्पर्शनिर्भिन्नाः सव्यसाचिना॥
en: The troops of your army and the elephants therein, lost all activity and became cheerless. They where pierced by Savyasachin with his arrows whose touch resembled that of snakes of virulent venom.

sn: ते गजा विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्युधि गाण्डीवचोदितैः। अनेकशतसाहस्रः सर्वाङ्गेषु समर्पिताः॥
en: The elephants were pierced on every part of their bodies with the arrows of keen points shot by hundreds and thousands from the bow Gandiva.

sn: आरावं परमं कृत्वा वध्यमानाः किरीटिना। निपेतुरनिशं भूमौ छिन्नपक्षा इवाद्रयः॥
en: Uttering fierce roars when they were being slaughtered by the diadem-decked Arjuna, they began to fall incessantly on the ground like mountains having their wings cut-off.

sn: अपरे दन्तवेष्टेषु कुम्भेषु च कटेषु च। शरैः समर्पिता नागाः क्रोञ्चवद् व्यन्दन् मुहुः॥
en: Other elephants pierced with long shafts in the jaw of frontal globes or temples, began to utter yelling cries resembling the screech of the cranes.

sn: गजस्कन्धगतानां च पुरुषाणां किरीटिना। छिद्यन्ते चोत्तमाङ्गानि भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: The diadem-decked Arjuna then cut-off with bhallas of close knots, the heads of hostile warriors that rode on the neck of these elephants.

sn: सकुण्डलानां पततां शिरसां धरणीतले। पद्यानामिव संघातैः पार्थश्चके निवेदनम्॥
en: Those heads graced with ear-rings falling incessantly on the Earth, looked like so many lotuses that Pritha's son was culling, for an offering of "ods.

sn: यन्त्रबद्धा विकवचा व्रणार्ता रुधिरोक्षिताः। भ्रमत्सु युधि नागेषु मनुष्या विललम्बिरे॥
en: Entangled with the trappings, divested of their armours, lacerated with wounds and smeared with blood, men were then seen hanging from the necks of elephants, as these latter careered over the field.

sn: केचिदेनकेन बाणेन सुयुक्तेन सुपत्रिणा। ह्रौ त्रयश्च विनिर्भिन्ना निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥
en: Sometimes two or three warriors penetrated by a single arrow decked with beautiful feathers and heedfully shot from the Gandiva, fell down on the Earth.

sn: अतिविद्धाश्च नाराचैर्वमन्तो रुधिरं मुखैः। सारोहा न्यपतन् भूमौ दुमवन्त इवाचलाः॥
en: Deeply pierced with Narachas and vomitting blood through the mouth, elephants with their riders, began to fall down on the ground like so many mountains covered with trees.

sn: मौर्वी ध्वजं धनुश्चेव युगमीषां तथैव च। रथिनां कुट्टयामास भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: With his bhallas of straight knots Arjuna then began to sever the bowstrings, the standards, the bows, the yokes and the shafts of many car-warriors.

sn: न संदधन् न चाकर्षन् न विमुञ्जन् न चोद्वहन्। मण्डलेनैव धनुषा नृत्यन् पार्थः स्म दृश्यते॥
en: Nobody was able then to detect when Arjuna took out his arrows or fix them on the string of his bows or drew the string back or discharged them. But Partha was then seen only to dance on the terrace of his chariot with his bow drawn to a circle.

sn: अतिविद्धाश्च नाराचैर्वमन्तो रुधिरं मुखैः। मुहूर्तात्र्यपतन्नन्ये वारणा वसुधातले॥
en: Other elephants again pierced deep with Narachas and vomitting blood in consequence, fell down on the ground as soon as they were struck.

sn: उत्थितान्यगणेयानि कबन्धानि समन्ततः। अदृश्यन्त महाराज तस्मिन् परमसंकुले॥
en: In that dreadful carnage, 0 mighty monarch, innumerable headless trunks were seen to stand up on all sides.

sn: सचापा: साङ्गुलित्राणा सखगाः साङ्गदा रणे। अदृश्यन्त भुजाश्छिन्ना हेमाभरणभूषिताः॥
en: Numerous arms, holding bows, with fingers cased in leathern gloves, with swords in grasp, adorned with Angadas and golden ornaments, were seen scattered about, severed from the trunks.

sn: सूपस्करैरधिष्ठानैरीषादण्डकबन्धुरै :। चक्रैर्विमथितैरक्षैर्भग्नैश्च बहुधा युगे॥
en: With innumerable Upasakas, Adisthanas, shafts, crowns, broken car-wheels shattered Akshas and yokes.

sn: चर्मचापधरैश्चैव व्यवकीर्णैस्ततस्ततः। स्रग्भिराभरणैर्वस्त्रैः पतितैश्च महाध्वजैः॥
en: With warriors armed with shields and bows, with garlands of flowers, with ornaments, garments and fallen standards scattered here and there.

sn: निहतैर्वारणैरश्वैः क्षत्रियैश्च निपातितैः। अदृश्यत मही तत्र दारुणप्रतिदर्शना॥
en: With slain elephants and horses and fallen Kshatriyas, the field of battle appeared exceedingly awful.

sn: एवं दुःशासनबलं वध्यमानं किरीटिना। सम्प्राद्रवन्महाराज व्यथितं सहनायकम्॥
en: Thus, O mighty monarch, the army of Dushasana with its leader, deeply afflicted and extensively slaughtered by the diadem-decked Arjuna, began to fly away.

sn: ततो दुःशासनस्त्रस्तः सहानीकः शरार्दितः। द्रोणं त्रातारमाकाक्षशकटव्यूहमभ्यगात्॥
en: Then Dushasana afraid and afflicted with shafts, with his whole division, feel back upon the Sakata array and looked upon Drona as his only protector.

sn: संजय उवाच दुःशासनबलं हत्वा सब्यसाची महारथः। सिन्धुराज परीप्सन् वै द्रोणानीकमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having slaughtered the division of Dushasana, the mighty-armed Savysachin desirous of getting at the king of the Sindhus, fell upon Drona's division.

sn: स तु द्रोणं समासाद्य व्यूहस्य प्रमुखे स्थितम्। कृताञ्जलिरिदं वाक्यं कृष्णस्यानुमतेऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Approaching Drona who was standing in the mouth of his array, Arjuna, with Krishna's permission, folding his palms thus spoke to Drona.

sn: अर्जुन उवाच शिवेन ध्याहि मां ब्रह्मन् स्वस्ति चैव वदस्व मे। भवतप्रसादादिच्छामि प्रवेष्टुं दुर्भिदां चमूम्॥
en: Arjuna said Wish me well, O Brahmana and bless me saying Svasti, through your grace I desire to penetrate through this impenetrable array.

sn: भवान् पितृसमो मह्यं धर्मराजसमोऽपि च। तथा कृष्णसमश्चैव सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: You are to me even as my own father or the very virtuous king Yudhishthira or as Krishna himself. This I tell you in sooth.

sn: अश्वत्थामा यथा तात रक्षणीयस्त्वयानघ। तथाहमपि ते रक्ष्यः सदैव द्विजसत्तम॥
en: 0 sire, o sinless one, even Ashvatthaman deserves to be protected by you, so also, O foremost of the regenerate ones, I deserve to be protected by you.

sn: तव प्रसादादिच्छेयं सिन्धुराजानमाहवे। निहन्तुं द्विपदां श्रेष्ठ प्रतिज्ञां रक्ष मे प्रभो॥
en: Through your grace, I desire to slay the ruler of the Sindhus in battle, O you foremost as of men. O lord, see that my vow may be fulfiled.

sn: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तस्तदाचार्यः प्रत्युवाच स्मयन्निव। मामजित्वा न बीभत्यो शक्यो जेतुं जयद्रथः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus spoken to, the preceptors then smilingly replied unto Arjuna thus-Vibhatsu you shall not conquer Jayadratha without in the first instance conquering my own self.”

sn: एतावदुक्त्वा तं द्रोणः शरवातैरवाकिरत्। सारथाश्वध्वजं तीक्ष्णैः प्रहसन् वैससारथिम्॥
en: Speaking these words only, Drona with myriads of sharp arrows, covered Arjuna, is chariot, steeds, standards and charioteer, similing all the while.

sn: ततोऽर्जुनः शरवातान् द्रोणस्यावार्य सायकैः। द्रोणमभ्यद्रवद् बाणैर्घोररूमैर्महत्तरैः।
en: Thereat Arjuna repulsing the arrowy showers of Drona with those of his own, proceeded against Drona, discharging mightier and more dreadful shafts.

sn: विव्याध चरणे द्रोणमनुमान्य विशाम्यते। क्षत्रधर्मे समास्थाय नवभिः सायकैः पुनः॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, showing due respect to Drona and observing the duties of the Kshatriya order, Arjuna sped at him nine shafts.

sn: तस्येषूनिषुभिश्छत्त्वा द्रोणो विव्याध तावुभौ। विषाग्निज्वलितप्रख्यैरिषुभिः कृष्णपाण्डवौ॥
en: Then cutting those arrows of Arjuna with those of his own, Drona pierced both Krishna and the son of Pandu with shafts that resembled poison of the blazing tongues of fire.

sn: इयेष पाण्डवस्तस्य बाणैश्छेत्तुं शरासनम्। तस्य चिन्तयतस्त्वेवं फाल्गुनस्य महात्मनः॥
en: The son of Pandu desired to sever the bow string of Drona with his arrows. Even when the illustrious Phalguna as thus thinking of cutting his bow string.

sn: द्रोणः शरैरसम्भ्रान्तो ज्यां विच्छेदाशु वीर्यवान्। विव्याध च हयानस्य ध्वजं सारथिमेव च॥
en: The undaunted Drona endued with prowess, cut-off with his arrows the formers string; he also pierced his horses, standards and charioteer.

sn: अर्जुनं च शरैर्वीरः स्मयमानोऽभ्यवाकिरत्। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे पार्थः सज्यं कृत्वा महद् धनुः॥
en: And smilingly did then Drona cover Arjuna himself with many arrows. Meanwhile having strung his mighty bow, Pritha's son.

sn: विशेषयिष्यन्नाचार्ये सर्वास्त्रविदुषां वरः। मुमोच षट्शतान् बाणान् गृहीत्वैकमिव दुतम्॥
en: That foremost of all men versed in the use of weapons getting the better of his preceptor, quickly discharged six hundred arrows; that looked as if he had taken out and shot only a single arrow.

sn: पुनः सप्तशतानन्यान् सहस्रं चानिवर्तिनः। चिक्षेपायुतशश्चान्यांस्तेऽनन् द्रोणस्य तां चमूम्॥
en: Once more he shot seven hundred other arrows and again a thousand irresistible arrows and ten thousand other arrows. All these dispatched many warriors of Drona's division.

sn: तैः सम्यगस्तैर्वलिना कृतिना चित्रयोधिना। मनुष्यवाजिमातङ्गा विद्धाः पेतुर्गतासवः॥
en: Pierced deep by those shafts shot by the mighty and accomplished Partha versed in all modes of warfare, many men and horses and elephants began to fall down dead.

sn: विसूताश्वध्वजाः पेतुः संछिन्नायुधजीविताः। रथिनो स्थमुख्येभ्यः सहसा शरपीडिताः॥
en: Afflicted with those arrows, car warriors dropped down from their excellent chariots, deprived of horses and standards and weapons and life.

sn: चूर्णिताक्षिप्तदग्धानां वज्रानिलहुताशनैः। तुल्यरूपा गजा: पेतुर्गिर्यग्राम्बुदवेश्मनाम्॥
en: Like mountain-peaks or masses of clouds or mansions crushed, driven or dismantled by the thunder, the tempest or the fire, elephants began to fall down (being pierced with the shafts of Arjuna).

sn: पेतुश्वसहस्राणि प्रहतान्यर्जुनेषुभिः। हंसा हिमवतः पृष्ठे वारिविप्रहता इव।॥
en: Thousands of horses began to fall down being struck by the arrows of Arjuna, like so many swans falling upon the Himavat mountain, being driven down by shower of rain.

sn: स्थाश्वद्विपपत्तयोघाः सलिलौघा इवाद्भुताः। युगान्तादित्यरश्मयाभैः पाण्डवास्त्रशरैर्हताः॥
en: Like the sun that rises at the end of a Yuga, sucking up with its rays large expanses of water, the son of Pandu, by his showers of weapons and shafts, slew large bodies of carwarriors, horses elephants and foot soldiers.

sn: तं पाण्डवादित्यशरांशुजालं कुरुप्रवीरान् युधि निष्टपन्तम्। स द्रोणमेघः शरवृष्टिवेगैः प्राच्छादयन्मेघ इवार्करश्मीन्॥
en: Then like the clouds covering the sun, the Drona-cloud with its down-pour of arrows, covered the Arjuna-sun whose rays in the form of thick shower of arrows, were burning down the foremost ones among the Kurus, in battle.

sn: अथात्यर्थं विसृष्टेन द्विषतामसुभोजिना। आजघ्ने वक्षसि द्रोणो नाराचेन धनंजयम्॥
en: Then the preceptor pierced Dhananjaya on the breast with a Naracha discharged with great force and capable of sucking out the life of every foe.

sn: स विह्वलितसर्वाङ्गः क्षितिकम्पे यथाचलः। धैर्यमालम्ब्य बीभत्सुयॊणं विव्याध पत्रभिः॥
en: Thereupon the latter trembled in all his limbs like a mountain during an earth quake. But (in a while) regaining his composure, he began to pierce Drona with winged arrows.

sn: द्रोणस्तु पञ्चभिर्बाणैर्वासुदेवमताडयत्। अर्जुनं च त्रिसप्तत्या ध्वजं चास्य त्रिभिः शरैः॥
en: Then Drona with five arrows afflicted the son of Vasudeva and he struck Vibhatsu with seventy-three shafts and his standard with three.

sn: विशेषयिष्यशिष्यं च द्रोणो राजन् पराक्रमी। अदृश्यमर्जुनं चक्रे निमेषाच्छरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: Thus, O monarch, the puissant Drona, worsting his disciple within a moment, caused Arjuna to disappear from the view, with his arrowy showers.

sn: प्रसक्तान् पततोऽद्राक्षम भारद्वाजस्य सायकान्। मण्डलीकृतमेवास्य धनुश्चादृश्यताद्भुतम्॥
en: We then beheld the arrows shot by Bharadvaja's son fall in unbroken lines and his bow present the wonderful appearance of always being drawn to a circle.

sn: तेऽभ्ययुः समरे राजन् वासुदेवधनंजयौ। द्रोणसृष्टाः सुबहवः कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छदाः॥
en: Those numerous arrows furnished with wings of Kanka feather and discharged by Drona in that battle, incessantly fell, O monarch, on Dhananjaya and the son of Vasudeva.

sn: तद् दृष्ट्वा तादृशं युद्धं द्रोणपाण्डवयोस्तदा। वासुदेवो महाबुद्धिः कार्यवत्तामचिन्तयत्॥
en: Then beholding that battle between Drona and the son of Pandu, the highly intelligent son of Vasudeva began to think about the accomplishment of the (more important) task (viz., the slaughter of Jayadratha).

sn: ततोऽब्रवीद् वासुदेवो धनंजयमिदं वचः। पार्थ पार्थ महाबाहो न न: कालात्ययो भवेत्॥
en: Thereafter Vasudeva's son thus spoke addressing Dhananjaya "O Partha O Partha,o mighty-armed one, we should not waste time.

sn: द्रोणमुत्सृज्य गच्छामः कृत्यमेतन्महत्तरम्। पार्थश्चाप्यब्रवीत् कृष्णं यथेष्टमिति केशवम्॥
en: Let us proceed leaving Drona alone the more important task must be accomplished.” Then the son of Pritha replied to Krishna saying-"As it lists you, O Keshava."

sn: ततः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा द्रोणं प्रायान्महाभुजम्। परिवृत्तश्च बीभत्सुरगच्छद् विसृजशरान्॥
en: Thereupon leaving the mighty-armed Drona to their right they proceeded onwards; turning his face away, Vibhatsu advanced shooting his shafts.

sn: ततोऽब्रवीत् स्वयं द्रोणः क्वेदं पाण्डव गम्यते। ननु नाम रणे शत्रुमजित्वा न निवर्तसे॥
en: Thereupon Drona addressing Arjuna said "Where are you going, O son of Pandu? Is it not the fact that you never turn back without defeating your adversary?”

sn: अर्जुन उवाच गुरुभवान् न मे शत्रुः शिष्यः पुत्रसमोऽस्मि ते। न चास्ति स पुमाल्लोके यस्त्वां युधि पराजयेत्॥
en: Arjuna said You are my preceptor and not my foe; I am your pupil and like your son. Also there exists not the man in the worlds who can vanquish you in battle.

sn: संजय उवाच एवं ब्रुवाणो बीभत्सुर्जयद्रथवधोत्सुकः। त्वरायुक्तो महाबाहुस्त्वत्सैन्यं समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, the mighty-armed Vibhatsu, intent on slaying Jayadratha, quickly rushed against the hostile troops.

sn: तं चक्ररक्षौ पाञ्चाल्यौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ। अन्वयातां महात्मानौ विशन्तं तावकं बलम्॥
en: And when he penetrated into your army, the two illustrious Panchala princes, Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas, followed him, protecting his car-wheel.

sn: ततो जयो महाराज कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः। काम्बोजश्च श्रुतायुश्च धनञ्जयमवारयन्॥
en: Thereupon, O mighty monarch, Jaya, Kritavarman of the Satva race and the Kamboja king the Shrutayusha-these put themselves on the way of Dhananjaya.

sn: तेषां दश सहस्राणि रथानामनुयायिनाम्। अभीषाहाः शूरसेनाः शिबयोऽथ वसातयः॥
en: Ten thousand car-warriors followed these warriors. The Abhishakas, the Shurasenas, the Shibis, the Vasatis.

sn: मावेल्लका ललित्याश्च केकया मद्रकास्तथा। नारायणाच गोपालाः काम्बोजानां च ये गणाः॥
en: The Mavellakas, the Lalithyuas, the Kaikeyas, the Madra, the Narayanas, the Gopalas and the Kamboja clans.

sn: कर्णेन विजिताः पूर्वं संग्रामे शूरसम्मताः। भारद्वाजं पुरस्कृत्य हृष्टात्मानोऽर्जुनं प्रति॥
en: Who had before been defeated by Karna and who were regarded as heroes, all these warriors placing the son of Bharadvaja at their head and disregardful of their lives, rushed against Arjuna.

sn: पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तं क्रुद्धं मृत्युमिवान्तकम्। त्यजन्तं तुमुले प्राणान् संनद्धं चित्रयोधिनम्॥
en: For opposing that wrathful hero burning with sorrow an account of the death of his son, that warrior resembling the all-destroying Death himself, cased in armour, versed in all modes of warfare, prepared to sacrifice his life in the very thick of the fight.

sn: गाहमानमनीकानि मातङ्गमिव यूथपम्। महेष्वासं पराक्रान्तं नरव्याघ्रमवारयन्॥
en: That foremost of men, fierce bowman, endued with prowess, who resembled the infurrite leader of an elephant and who seemed to plunge into the ranks of your troops.

sn: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। अन्योन्यं वै प्रार्थयतां योधानामर्जुनस्य च॥
en: Then the battle that raged between all those warriors on one side and Arjuna on the other, became exceeding fierce and hair-stirring, inasmuch as each desired to meet the other.

sn: जयद्रथवधप्रेप्सुमायान्तं पुरुषर्षभम्। न्यवारयन्त सहिताः क्रिया व्याधिमिवोत्थितम्॥
en: Then like medicines checking a raging malady, the Kaurava warriors firmly united together began to check that foremost of men proceeding onwards for the slaughter of Jayadratha.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: संजय उवाच संनिरुद्धस्तु तैः पार्थो महाबलपराक्रमः। द्रुतं समनुयातश्च द्रोणेन रथिनां वरः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then that mighty car-warrior viz., Pritha's son, endued with great mighty and prowess, was opposed in the front by those warriors and quickly pursued from behind by Drona himself.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: किरनिषुगणांस्तीक्ष्णान् स रश्मीनिव भास्कर.। तापयामास तत् सैन्यं देहं व्याधिगणो यथा॥
en: Then scattering his sharp shafts like the lustrous orb of the day scattering his rays, he afflicted that host of the Kurus like maladies afflicting the body.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: अश्वो विद्धो रथश्छिन्नः सारोहः पातितो गजः। छत्राणि चापविद्धानि रथाश्चकैर्विना कृताः॥
en: On that occasion, horses were pierced, cars broken, elephants felled with their riders, umbrellas torn and chariots deprived of their wheels.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: विदूतानि च सैन्यानि शरार्तानि समन्ततः। इत्यासीत् तुमुलं युद्धं न प्रज्ञायत किञ्चन॥
en: Afflicted with arrows, troops began to fly in all directions. Thus raged that terrible encounter between Arjuna on the one hand and the Kurus on the other. Nothing could then be distinguished.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तेषां संयच्छता संख्ये परस्परमजिह्मगैः। अर्जुनो ध्वजिनीं राजन्नभीक्ष्णं समकम्पयत्॥
en: Thus when they fought on, piercing one another in battle with straight coursing arrows, Arjuna, O king, made the hostile army tremble before him.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: सत्यां चिकीर्षमाणस्तु प्रतिज्ञां सत्यसंगरः। अभ्यद्रवचद् रथश्रेष्ठं शोणाश्वं श्वेतवाहनः॥
en: Ever firmly devoted to truth, Arjuna of white steeds, desirous of accomplishing his arrows vow rushed furiously against that best of carwarriors viz. Drona owning crimson steeds.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तं द्रोणः पञ्चविंशत्या मर्मभिद्भिरजिह्मगैः। अन्तेवासिनमाचार्यो महेष्वासं समार्पयत्॥
en: The preceptor Drona then pierced his disciple, that great bowman Arjuna, with twenty-five straight-flying that penetrated to the very vitals of the latter.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तु तूणमिव बीभत्सुः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। अभ्यधावदिघूनस्यनिषुवेगविघातकान्॥
en: Thereat that foremost of all wielders of weapons viz., Vibhatsu quickly rushed against Drona shooting at the sametime arrows capable of checking the career of those shot by the latter.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तस्याशुक्षिप्तान् भल्लान् हि भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः। प्रत्यविध्यदमेयात्मा ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदीरयन्॥
en: Then Arjuna of generous soul discharging the Brahma weapons and with his Bhallas of close knots, repulsed the Valas so quickly shot at him by Drona.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तदद्भुतमपश्याम द्रोणस्याचार्यकं युधि। यतमानो युवा नैनं प्रत्यविध्यद् यदर्जुनः॥
en: Then we behold the wonderful skill of the preceptor Drona in the art of fighting, in as much as Arjuna, though youthful in years and exerting his best, could not pierce him in return..

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: क्षरन्निव महामेघो वारिधाराः सहस्रशः। द्रोणमेघः पार्थशैलं ववर्ष शरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: Then like a mighty mass of clouds pouring down incessant showers of rain, the Dronacloud covered the Arjuna-mountain with his shower of arrows.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: अर्जुनः शरवर्षे तद् ब्रह्मास्त्रेणैव मारिष। प्रतिजग्राह तेजस्वी बाणैर्वाणान् निशातयन्।॥
en: Invoking into existence of the Brahma weapon, the puissant Arjuna, O sire, received that shower of arrows, cutting of the arrows shot by his adversary with those of his own.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: द्रोणस्तु पञ्चविंशत्या श्वेतवाहनमार्दयत्। वासुदेवं च सप्तत्या बाह्वोरुरसि चाशुगैः॥
en: Then Drona afflicted him of the white steeds with five and twenty shafts; and with seventy swift-coursing. shafts he pierced Vasudeva's son on the arms and on the chest.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: पार्थस्तु प्रहसन् धीमानाचार्यं सशरौघिणम्। विसृजन्तं शितान् बाणानवारयत तं युधि॥
en: The highly intelligent son of Pritha then smiling the while, checked the preceptor in battle who incessantly shooting sharp arrows, was looking like a sea having shafts or its waves.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: अथ तौ वध्यमानौ तु द्रोणेन रथसत्तमौ। आवर्जयेतां दुर्धर्षे युगान्ताग्निमिवोत्थितम्॥
en: Thus afflicted by Drona, those two foremost of car-warriors (Krishna and Arjuna) shunned him who then resembled the irresistibly raging conflagration that appears at the end of every Yuga.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: वर्जयन् निशितान् बाणान् द्रोणचापिविनिः सृतान्। किरीटमाली कौन्तेयो भोजानीकं व्यशातयत्॥
en: Then avoiding the aim of the whetted shafts shot from Drona's bow, the diadem-decked son of Kunti fell to slaughter the division of the Bhojas.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: सोऽन्तरा कृतवर्माणं काम्बोजं च सुदक्षिणम्। अभ्ययाद् वर्जयन् द्रोणं मैनाकमिव पर्वतम्॥
en: Shunning Drona who stood immovable like the Mainaka mountain, Arjuna then took his stand between Kritavarman and Sudakshina, the ruler of the Kambojas.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: ततो भोजो नरव्याघ्रो दुर्धर्षं कुरुसत्तमम्। अविध्यत् तूर्णमव्यग्रो दशभिः कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥
en: Then that foremost of men, the undaunted ruler of the Bhojas quickly pierced the invincible hero, the foremost of the descendants of Kuru (Arjuna), with ten arrows winged with Kanka feathers.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तमर्जुनः शतेनाजौ राजन् विव्याध पत्रिणाम्। पुनश्चान्यैस्त्रिभिर्बाणैर्मोहयन्निव सात्वतम्॥
en: O king, Arjuna pierced him in battle with sharp shafts again with another three arrows he confounded the descendant of the Satvata race (Kritavarman).

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: भोजस्तु प्रहसन् पार्थे वासुदेवं च माधवम्। एकैकं पञ्चविंशत्या सायकान समार्पयत्॥
en: Thereupon the king of the Bhojas smilingly pierced Pritha's son and Vasudeva of Madhus race, each with a group of twenty-five arrows.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तस्यार्जुनो धनुश्छित्त्वा विव्याधैनं त्रिसप्तभिः। शरैरग्निशिखाकारैः क्रुद्धाशीविषसंनिभैः॥
en: Bursting open his bow, Arjuna pierced him with twenty-one arrows resembling tongues of blazing fire or infuriate snakes of virulent poison.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय कृतवर्मा महारथः। पञ्चभिः सायकैस्तूर्णं विव्याधोरसि भारत॥
en: Thereat, O Bharata, the mighty car-warrior Kritavarman taking up another bow quickly pierced Arjuna on the chest with five arrows.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: पुनश्च निशितैर्बाणैः पार्थे विव्याध पञ्चभिः। तं पार्थो नवभिर्बाणैराजघान स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Then again with another five whetted arrows he pierced Pritha's son deeply. Then Partha also with nine arrows struck him between the breasts.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: दृष्ट्वा विषक्तं कौन्तेयं कृतवर्मरथं प्रति। चिन्तयामास वार्ष्णेयो न नः कालात्ययो भवेत्॥
en: Beholding the son of Kunti engaged with the mighty-warrior Kritavarman, the descendant of the Vrishni race (Krishna) thought that there was no time to waste.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: ततः कृष्णोऽब्रवीत् पार्थे कृतवर्मणि मा दयाम्। कुरु सम्बन्धकं हित्वा प्रमध्यैनं विशातय॥
en: Thereafter Krishna addressing Pritha's son said-"Do not show any mercy to your kinsmen; setting at naught your relationship with him, do you slay and crush him down."

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: ततः स कृतवर्माणं मोहयित्वाऽर्जुनः शरैः। अभ्यगाज्जवनैरश्वैः काम्बोजानामानीकिनीम्॥
en: Thereat Arjuna stupefying Kritavarman with his arrows, plunged into the ranks of the Kamboja division, being borne by fleet steeds.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: अमर्षितस्तु हार्दिक्यः प्रविष्टे श्वेतवाहने। विधुन्वन् सशरं चापं पाञ्चाल्याभ्यां समागतः॥
en: was Beholding Arjuna owning white steeds enter into the Kamboja division, the son of Hridika inflamed with rage. Then stretching his bow with arrows fixed on the string, he came up on the two Panchala princes.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: चक्ररक्षो तु पाञ्चाल्यावर्जुनस्य पदानुगौ। पर्यवारयदायान्तौ कृतवर्मा रथेषुभिः॥
en: Then with his arrows, Kritavarman opposed the two Panchala princes who were following in the wake of Arjuna, for protecting the wheels of his car.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तावविध्यत् ततो भोजः कृतवर्मा शितैः शरैः। त्रिभिरेव युधामन्युं चतुभिश्चोत्तमौजसम्॥
en: The ruler of the Bhojas Kritavarman then pierced them both with sharp arrows, striking Yudhamanyu with three and Uttamaujas with four.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तावप्येनं विविधतुर्दशभिर्दशभिः शरैः। त्रिभरेव युधामन्युरुत्तमौजास्त्रिभिस्तथा॥
en: They both in return pierced him each with ten shafts. Then again Yudhamanyu with three and Uttamaujas with another three arrows.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: संचिच्छिदतुरप्यस्य ध्वज कार्मुकमेव च। अथान्यद् धनुरुदाय हार्दिक्य: क्रोधमूर्छितः॥ कृत्वा विधनुषौ वीरौ शरवर्शेरवाकिरत्। तावन्ये धनुषी सज्ये कृत्वा भोज विजघ्नतुः॥
en: Cut off Kritavarman's bow and standard. Thereat furious with rage and taking up another bow, the son of Hridika. Deprived both those warriors of the use of their bow and shrouded them in a net-work of arrows. They both in a moment having strung another pair of bows, began to strike the king of the Bhojas.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तेनान्तरेण बीभत्सुविंवेशामित्रबाहिनीम्। न लेभाते तु तौ द्वारं वारितौ कृतवर्मणा॥
en: Meanwhile Arjuna had gone into the array of the hostile troops. But his two wheelprotectors held in check by Kritavarman, obtained no admission.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: धार्तराष्ट्रेष्वनीकेषु यतमानौ नरर्षभौ। अनीकान्यर्दयन् युद्धे त्वरितः श्वेतवाहनः॥
en: Into the divisions of the Dhritarashtra army though those two foremost of men exerted to the best of their abilities. Meanwhile that one of white steeds began to afflict in that battle the army opposed to him, with great agility.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: नावधीत् कृतवर्माणं प्राप्तमष्यरिषूदनः। तं दृष्ट्वा तु तथा यान्तं शूरो राजा श्रुतायुधः॥
en: That slayer of foes then did not slay Kritavarman though he had an opportunity for doing so. Then beholding him thus advance, the valorous king Shrutayusha.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: अभ्यद्रवत् सुसंक्रुद्धो विधुन्वानो महद् धनुः। स पार्थं त्रिभिरानर्छत् सप्तत्या च जनार्दनम्॥
en: Burning with rage and twanging his great bow, rushed furiously on him. He then pierced Partha with three and Janardana with seventy shafts.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: क्षुप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन पार्थकेतुमताडयत्। ततोऽर्जुनो नवत्या तु शराणां तनपर्वणाम्॥
en: And again with a sharp razor-headed arrow, he struck the standard of Pritha's son. Then with a group of ninety shafts of depressed knots Arjuna.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: आजघान भृशं क्रुद्धस्तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपम्। स तन्न ममृषे राजन् पाण्डवेयस्य विक्रमम्॥
en: Inflamed with rage, pierced him like a Mahavata piercing a huge elephant with the hook. But, o king, he (Shrutayudha), did not tolerate that display of prowess by the son of Pandu.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: अधैनं सप्तसप्तत्या नाराचानां समार्पयत्। तस्यार्जुनो धनुश्छित्त्वा शरावापं निकृत्य च॥ आजधानोरसि क्रुद्धः सप्तभिर्नतपर्वभिः। अथान्यद् धनुरादाय स राजा क्रोधमूर्छितः॥ वासविं नवभिर्बाणैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्। ततोऽर्जुनः स्मयन्नेव श्रुतायुधमरिंदमः॥ शरैरनेकसाहौः पीडयामास भारत। अश्वांश्वास्यावधीत् तूर्णे सारथं च महारथः॥
en: And with a group of seven and seventy Narachas he struck his adversary. Thereat cutting of Shutrayusha's bow and shafts Arjuna inflamed with rage, struck him on the breast with seven arrows of depressed knots. Thereupon that king overwhelmed with rage and taking up another bow pierced the son of Vasava on the arms and the breast with nine long arrows. Then O Bharata, that subdue of foes viz., Arjuna afflicted Shrutayusha with many thousand, of arrows, smiling all the while; and that mighty car-warrior soon killed the latter's horses and charioteer.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: विव्याध चैनं सप्तत्या नाराचानां महाबलः। हताश्वं रथमुत्सृज्य स तु राजा श्रुतायुधः॥ अभ्यद्रवद् रणे पार्थे गदामुद्यम्य वीर्यवान्। वरुणस्यात्मजो वीरः स तु राजा श्रुतायुधः॥ पर्णाशा जननी यस्य शीततोया महानदी। तस्य माताब्रवीद् राजन् वरुणं पुत्रकारणात्॥
en: And that highly puissant hero also pierced him with seventy Narachas. Thereupon leaving his chariot of which the steeds were slain, king Shrutayusha endued with great energy rushed againsi Pritha's son, heaving his huge mace over his head. The heroic king Shrutayusha and the son of Varuna having for his mother the mighty river of cool waters called Parnasa. O king, her mother, for the benefit of her son, had

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: अवध्योऽयं भवेल्लोके शत्रूणां तनयो मम। वरुणस्त्वब्रवीत् प्रीतो ददाम्यस्मै वरं हितम्॥
en: “Let this son of mine be unslayable in battle by his enemies on earth.” Then Varuna gratified with her, had said-"I accord him the boon that will be highly beneficial to him.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: दिव्यमस्त्रं सुतस्तेऽयं येनावध्यो भविष्यति। नास्ति चाप्यमरत्वं वै मनुष्यस्य कथंचन॥
en: I give to your son a celestial weapon by virtue of which he will be unslayable. Men could never obtain immortality on earth.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: सर्वेणावश्यमर्तव्यं जातेन सरितां वरे। दुर्धर्षस्त्वेष शत्रूणां रणेषु भविता सदा॥
en: O foremost of rivers, every one who has taken his birth on the face of the earth must inevitable fall a prey to death. This son of yours, however, will ever be invincible by his foes in battle.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: अस्त्रस्यास्य प्रभावाद् वै व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः। इतयुक्त्वा वरुणः प्रादाद् गदां मत्रपुरुकृताम्॥
en: By virtue of this weapon; so let the fever corroding your heart he dismissed.” Having thus spoken, Varuna gave him a mace with all necessary aphorisms.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: यामासाद्य दुराधर्षः सर्वलोके श्रुतायुधः। उवाच चैनं भगवान् पुनरेव जलेश्वरः॥
en: Obtaining which Shrutayusha became invincible in all the worlds. The illustrious lord of waters however again addressed him saying

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: अयुध्यति न मोक्तव्या सा त्वय्येव पतेदिति। हन्यादेशा प्रतीपं हि प्रयोक्तारमपि प्रभो॥
en: This mace, O son, should not be directed against one who is not fighting, in which case it will fall back upon yourself; on such occasion, coursing in an opposite direction it will kill him who has hurled it.'

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: न चाकरोत् स तद्वाक्यं प्राप्ते काले श्रुतायुधः। स तया वीरघातिन्या जनार्दनमताडयत्॥
en: But when the time for using it came, Shrutayusha did not pay any heed to that injunction of Varuna and with that mace capable of crushing heroes, be began to strike Janardana.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: प्रतिजग्राह तां कृष्णाः पीनेनांसेन वीर्यवान्। नाकम्पयत शौरि सा विन्ध्यं गिरिमिवानिलः॥
en: The highly puissant Krishna received those strokes on his broad and well-developed shoulders; and that mace could not cause Shauri to tremble even as a tempest cannot shake a mountain.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: प्रत्युद्यान्ती तमेवैषा कृत्येव दुरधिष्ठिता। जघान चास्थितं वीरं श्रुतायुधममर्षणम्॥
en: Like some ill-accomplished feat of conjuration injuring the conjurer the mace turning to Shrutayusha, smote that heroic and enraged monarch stationed in his car.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: हत्वा श्रुतायुधं वीरं धरणीमन्वपद्यत। गदां निवर्तितां दृष्ट्वा निहतं च श्रुतायुधम्॥
en: And slaying that brave warrior it fell down on the ground. Shrutayusha being slain.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: हाहाकारो महांस्तत्र सैन्यानां समजायत। स्वेनास्त्रेण हतं दृष्ट्वा श्रुतायुधमरिंदमम्॥
en: The troops began to utter loud wails of woe, for indeed they had seen that subduer of foes Shrutayusha slain by his own weapon.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: अयुध्यमानाय ततः केशवाय नराधिप। क्षिप्ता श्रुतायुधेनाथ तस्मात् तमवधीदृ गदा॥
en: As Shrutayusha O ruler of men had hurled the mace at Krishna who was not engaged in the battle, it slew him who had hurled it.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: यथोक्तं वरुणेनाजौ तथा स निधनं गतः। व्यसुश्चाप्यपतद् भूमौ प्रेक्षतां सर्वधन्विनाम्॥
en: So Shrutayusha fell on the field even in the manner indicated by the words of Varuna and he fell down deprived of life before the eyes of all the bowmen present.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: पतमानस्तु स बभौ पर्णाशायाः प्रियः सुतः। स भग्न इव वातेन बहुशाखो वनस्पतिः॥
en: When falling, that dear-loved son of Parnasa appeared beautiful like a mighty tree of many branches uprooted by the tempest.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि सेनामुख्याश्च सर्वशः। प्राद्रवन्त हतं दृष्ट्वा श्रुतायुधमरिंदमम्॥
en: Then beholding that subduer of foes slain all the troops and their leading warriors began to fly away in all directions.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: ततः काम्बोजराजस्य पुत्रः शूरः सुदक्षिणः। अभ्ययाज्जवनैरश्वैः फाल्गुनं शत्रुसूदनम्॥
en: Thereafter the heroic Sudakshina the son of the Kamboja king rushed against that slayer of foes viz., Phalguna, being borne by fleet steeds.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तस्य पार्थः शरान् सप्त प्रेषयामास भारत। ते तं शूरं विनिर्भिद्य प्राविशन् धरणीतलम्॥
en: At him, O Bharata, Pritha's son shot seven arrows, which penetrating through that hero, entered the surface of the earth.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: सोऽतिविद्धः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्गाण्डीवप्रेषितैर्मधे। अर्जुनं प्रतिविव्याध दशभिः कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥
en: Pierced deep by those sharp arrows shot from the Gandiva bow, he in return pierced Arjuna in battle with ten shafts furnished with the feathers of the Kanka bird.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तस्य पार्थो धनुश्छित्त्वा केतुं चिच्छेद मारिष॥
en: He once more pierced Vasudeva's son with three and Partha with five arrows, then O Sire, Pritha's son bursting open his bow, cut down his standard;

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: वासुदेवं त्रिभिर्विद्धवा पुनः पार्थं च पञ्चभिः। भल्लाभ्यां भृशतीक्ष्णाभ्यां तं च विव्याध पाण्डवः। स तु पार्थं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा सिंहनादमथानदत्॥
en: And the son of Pandu pierced him with a couple of bhallas of exceeding sharpness. He also having pressed Pritha's son with three such arrows uttered a fierce yell.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: सर्वपारशवीं चैव शक्तिं शूरः सुदक्षिणः। सघण्टां प्राहिणोद् घोरां क्रुद्धो गाण्डीवधन्वने॥
en: Thereafter the brave Sudakshina inflamed with rage hurled at the wielder of the Gandiva bow, a lance, dreadful, tied with bells and made wholly of iron.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: सा जवलन्ती महोल्केव तमासाद्य महारथम्। सविस्फुलिङ्गा निर्भिद्य निपपात महीतले॥
en: Having reached that mighty car-warriors Arjuna, that lance blazing like a mighty meteor and emitting scintillations of fore, penetrated through him and then fell down on the ground.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: शक्त्या त्वभिहतो गाढं मूर्छयाभिपरिप्लुतः। समाश्वास्य महातेजाः सृक्किणी परिलेलिहन्॥
en: Pierced deep with that lance, Arjuna was overwhelmed with a swoon. Then in an instant, that highly puissant hero recovering soon enough began to lick the corners of his mouth.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: तं चतुर्दशभिः पार्थो नाराचैः कङ्कपत्रिभिः। साश्वध्वजधनुः सूतं विव्याधाचिन्त्यविक्रमः॥
en: Then Partha of inconceivable prowess pierced Sudakshina and his steeds standards, bow and charioteer with ten narachas furnished with the feathers of the Kanka bird.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: रथं चान्यैः सुबहुभिश्चक्रे विशकलं शरैः। सुदक्षिणं तं काम्बोजं मोघसंकल्पविक्रमम्॥ बिभेद हदि बाणेन पृथुधारेण पाण्डवः। स भिन्नवर्मा स्रस्ताङ्ग प्रभ्रष्टमुकुटाङ्गदः॥
en: And with innumerable other arrows he rendered the latter's chariot useless and cut it to pieces. The son of Pandu then with an arrow of exceeding sharpness pierced on the chest Sudakshina the Kamboja ruler whose purpose and prowess had both even baffled. Then with his armour shattered, trembling in all his limbs, with his crown and Angadas falling off.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: पपातभिमुखः शूरो यन्त्रमुक्त इव ध्वजः। गिरेः शिखरजः श्रीमान् सुशाखः सुप्रतिष्ठितः॥ निर्भग्न इव वातेन कर्णिकारो हिमात्यये। शेते स्म निहतो भूमौ काम्बोजास्तरणोचितः॥
en: That hero fell with head down wards like a flagstaff loosened from the socket. Like a charming Karnikara tree in the spring growing gracefully on the top of a hill, with beautiful branches, lying on the groved when uprooted by the tempest, the prince of the Kambojas lying on the bare ground deprived of life, through accustomed to sleep on the most precious bed.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: महार्हाभरणोपेतः सानुमानिव पर्वतः। सुदर्शनीयस्ताम्राक्षः कर्णिना स सुदक्षिणः॥ पुत्रः काम्बोजराजस्य पार्थेन विनिपातितः। धारयन्नग्निसंकाशां शिरसा काञ्चनीं स्रजम्॥ अशोभत महाबाहुर्व्यसुर्भूमौ निपातितः
en: Adorned with precious ornaments, graceful, possessing eyes of coppery hue, wearing round the head a tiara of gold radiant like the flames of fire, the mighty armed Sudakshina, the prince of the Kambojas, felled by Partha with his arrows, and lying dead on the ground, appeared beautiful like a charming hill with a flat summit.

description: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Sudakshina
sn: ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि व्यद्रवन्त सुतस्य ते। हतं श्रुतायुधं दृष्ट्वा काम्बोजं च सुदक्षिणम्॥
en: Then beholding Shrutayusha and the prince of the Kambojas slain in battle, all the soldiers of your son's army began to fly in all directions.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: संजय उवाच
en: son

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: हते सुदक्षिणे राजन् वीरे चैव श्रुतायुधे। जवेनाभ्यद्रवन् पार्थं कुपिताः सैनिकास्तव॥
en: Sanjaya said When king Sudakshina and the heroic Shrutayudha had been slain, your warriors inflamed with wrath, furiously rushed against the son of Pritha.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: अभीषाहाः शूरसेनाः शिबयोऽथ वसातयः। अभ्यवर्षेस्ततो राजशरवर्षेर्धनंजयम्॥
en: The Abhishahas, the Surasenas, the Shibis and the Vasatis, o king, then began to pour upon Dhananjaya a veritable shower of arrows.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: तेषां षष्टिशतानन्यान् प्रामथ्नात् पाण्डवः शरैः। ते स्म भीताः पलायन्ते व्याघ्रात् क्षुद्रमृगा इव॥
en: The of Pandu consumed sixty thousands of the these and other warriors, with his arrows; and then the rest greatly frightened, began to fly away like smaller animals flying away from the tiger.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: ते निवृत्ताः पुनः पार्थं सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्। रणे सपनान् निघ्नन्तं जिगीषन्तं परान् युधि॥
en: But soon turning back, they surrounded Partha on all sides, who was slaying his foes in battle and trying to obtain victory over them.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: तेषामापततां तूर्णं गाण्डीवप्रेषितैः शरैः। शिरांसि पातयामास बाहूंश्चापि धनंजयः॥
en: Then as they made quickly towards himself, Dhananjaya, with arrows shot from his Gandiva bow, began to cut down their heads and arms.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: शिरोभिः पातितैस्तत्र भूमिरासीनिरन्तरा। अभ्रच्छायेव चैवासीत् ध्वाक्षगृघ्रबलैयुधि॥
en: The field of battle was thickly strewn over with felled heads; and fights of vultures and crows and ravens formed its cloudy canopy.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: तेषु तूत्साद्यमानेषु क्रोधामर्षसमन्वितौ। श्रुतायुश्चाच्युतायुश्च धनंजयमयुध्यताम्॥
en: Beholding their troops thus extirpated by Arjuna, Shrutayusha and Achyutayush, excited with rage and fury, began to fight vigorously with the former.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: बलिनो स्पर्धिनौ वीरो कुलजौ बाहुशालिनौ। तावेनं शरवर्षाणि सव्यदक्षिणमस्यताम्॥
en: Those two heroes endued with prowess, pride and strength of arms and both born in noble families, began to scatter their arrows right and left.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: त्वरायुक्तौ महाराज प्रार्थयानौ महद् यशः। अर्जुनस्य वधप्रेप्सू पुत्रार्थ तव धन्विनौ॥
en: With great agility, O mighty monarch, desirous of winning great fame and slaying Arjuna and doing good to your son,

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: तावर्जुनं सहस्रेण पत्रिणां नतपर्वणाम् । पूरयामासतुः क्रुद्धौ तटागं जलदौ यथा॥
en: Inflamed with rage, they covered Arjuna with a thousand winged shafts of depressed knots, like clouds filling a lake with torrents of rain.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: श्रुतायुश्च ततः क्रुद्धस्तोमरेण धनंजयम्। आजघान रथश्रेष्ठः पीतेन निशितेन च॥
en: Thereafter that foremost of car-warriors Shrutayusha excited with wrath, struck Dhananjaya with a well-tempered and wellsharpened lance.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुकर्शनः। जगाम परमं मोहं मोहयन् केशवं रणे॥
en: Thus sorely wounded by his powerful adversary, that subduer of the foes viz., Arjuna was overwhelmed with a swoon, confounding thereby Keshava himself.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सोऽच्युतायुर्महारथः। शूलेन भृशतीक्ष्णेन ताडयामास पाण्डवम्॥
en: At this crisis that mighty car-warrior Achyutayusha struck the son of Pandu with a trident of exceeding sharpness.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: क्षते क्षारं स हि ददौ पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः। पार्थोऽपि भृशंसंविद्धो ध्वजयष्टिं समाश्रितः॥
en: Thus he seemed to pour acid upon the wounds of the illustrious son of Pandu; thus deeply pierced, Pritha's son caught hold of his flag-staff for supporting himself.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: ततः सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य तावकस्य विशाम्पते। सिंहनादो महानासीद्धतं मत्वा धनंजयम्॥
en: Thereupon, O ruler of men, a loud and deafening roar was uttered by all your troops, for they considered Dhananjaya to be slain.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: कृष्णश्च भृशसंतप्तो दृष्ट्वा पार्थं विचेतनम्। आश्वासयत् सुहृद्याभिर्वाग्भिस्तत्र धनंजयम्॥
en: Then seeing Partha losing consciousness, Krishna was very much distressed; and then he began to comfort Dhananjaya with words soothing and agreeable.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: ततस्तौ रथिनां श्रेष्ठौ लब्धलक्ष्यौ धनंजयम्। वासुदेवं च वार्ष्णेयं शरवर्षेः समन्ततः॥ सचक्रकूबररथं साश्वध्वजपताकिनम्। अदृश्यं चक्रतुर्युद्धे तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Then those foremost of car-warriors, Shrutayusha and Achyutayush of true aim, scattering their showers of arrows on all sides in that battle, made Dhananjaya and the son Vasudeva of the Vrishni race and their car, carwheels, Kuvaras, steeds, flag-staff and banner, disappear from the view. All this indeed seemed wonderful.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: प्रत्याश्वस्तस्तु बीभत्सुः शनकैरिव भारत। प्रेतराजपुरं प्राप्य पुनः प्रत्यागतो यथा॥१९
en: Then, O Bharata, recovering slowly, like one coming back from a visit to the regions of Death, Vibhatsu.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: संछन्नं शरजालेन रथं दृष्ट्वा सकेशवम्। शत्रु चाभिमुखौ दृष्ट्वा दीप्यमानाविवानलौ॥
en: Saw his chariot and Keshava shrouded with a net-work of arrows; then beholding his two opponents standing before him like two blazing fires.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: प्रादुश्चक्रे ततः पार्थः शाक्रमस्त्रं महारथः। तस्मादासन् सहस्राणि शराणां नतपर्वणाम्॥
en: The mighty car-warrior Partha invoked into existence the terrible Shakra weapon. From that weapon issued out thousands of arrows.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: ते जघ्नुस्तौ महेष्वासौ ताभ्यां मुक्तांश्च सायकान्। विचेरुराकाशगताः पार्थबाणविदारिताः॥
en: Those arrows then struck those two fierce bowmen Shrutayusha and Achyutayush; and the arrows shot by these latter, being cut-off by those of Partha, began to drop down through the sky.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: प्रतिहत्य शरांस्तूर्णं शरवेगेन पाण्डवः। प्रतस्थे तत्र तत्रैव योधयन् वै महारथान्॥
en: Then Pandu's son checking the force of all arrows directed towards him with that of his own shafts, began to run hither and thither over the field encountering mighty car-warriors.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: तौ च फाल्गुनबाणौधैर्विबाहुशिरसौ कृतौ। वसुधामन्वपद्येतां वातनुन्नाविव दुभौ॥
en: Then those two heroes deprived of their arms and heads, by the arrows of Arjuna, fell down on the carth like mighty trees broken down by the wind.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: श्रुतायुषश्च निधनं वधश्चैवाच्युतायुषः। लोकविस्मापनमभूत् समुद्रस्येव शोषणम्॥
en: The slaughter of Shrutayusha and Achyutayush caused a surprise like to what men would fell if the ocean be dried up.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: ततयोः पदानुगान् हत्वा पुनः पञ्चाशतं रथान्। प्रत्यगाद् भारती सेनां निघ्नन् पार्थो वरान् वरान्॥
en: Then, having slain fifty car-warriors, the followers of those two princes, Pritha's son plunged into the army of the Bharatas, crushing down numerous elephants and warriors (at each step).

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: श्रुतायुषं च निहतं प्रेक्ष्य चैवाच्युतायुषम्। नियतायुश्च संक्रुद्धो दीर्घायुश्चैव भारत॥ पुत्रौ तयोर्नरश्रेष्ठौ कौन्तेयं प्रतिजग्मतुः। किरन्तोविविधान् बाणान् पितृव्यसनकर्शितौ॥
en: Beholding Shrutayusha slain, O Bharata, the enraged Niyutayush and Dirghayusha, the sons of the former two heroes both foremost of men, assaulted the son of Kunti, afflicted with calamity that had befallen their sires they proceeded, scattering arrows of diverse description.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: तावर्जुनो मुहूर्तेन शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। प्रेषयत् परमकुद्धो यमस्य सदनं प्रति॥
en: But Arjuna now excited to the highest pitch of fury, with his arrows of depressed knots, sent them instantly to the abode of Death.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: लोडयन्तमनीकानि द्विपं पद्मसरो यथा। नाशक्नुवन् वारयितुं पार्थं क्षत्रियपुङ्गवाः॥
en: Then the foremost Kshatriyas of your army were not able to oppose Pritha's son who had been agitating the troops like an elephant agitating a lake over-grown with lotuses.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: अङ्गास्तु गजवारेण पाण्डवं पर्यवारयन्। क्रुद्धाः सहस्रशो राजशिक्षिता हस्तिसादिनः॥
en: Then thousands of well-trained elephant riders belonging to the divisions of the Angas, excited with rage, O king, surrounded the son of Pandu, with their elephant forces.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: दुर्योधनसमादिष्टाः कुञ्जरैः पर्वतोपमैः। प्राच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्याश्च कलिङ्गप्रमुखा नृपाः॥
en: Commanded by Duryodhana, the easterners, the southerners and other kings hearded by the ruler of the Kalingas surrounded Arjuna with their elephants huge as hills.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: तेषामापततां शीघ्रं गाण्डीवप्रेषितैः शरैः। निचकर्त शिरांस्युग्रो बाहूनपि सुभूषणान्॥
en: But with the arrows shot from his Gandiva bow, Aruna quickly cut-off their heads and arms decked with ornaments, as they were rushing against him.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: तैः शिरोभिर्मही कीर्णा बाहुभिश्च सहाङ्गदैः। वभौ कनकपाषाणा भुजगैरिव संवृतां॥
en: Strewn over with their heads and arms decked with Angadas, the Earth appeared as if covered with golden stones and numerous snakes.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: बाहवोविशिखैश्छिन्नाः शिरांस्युन्मथितानि च। पतमानान्यदृश्यन्त दुमेभ्य इव पक्षिणः॥
en: Arms severed by means of arrows and heads lying crushed, appeared like birds shot down from the top trees.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: शरैः सहस्रशो विद्धा द्विपाः प्रसृतशोणिताः। अदृश्यन्ताद्रयः काले गौरिकाम्बुस्रवा इव॥
en: Pierced with thousands of shafts and covered with profuse blood, elephants looked like mountains during the rainy season, with red-chalk solution streaming down their sides.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: निहताः शेरते स्मान्ये बीभत्सोर्निशितैः शरैः। गजपृष्ठगता म्लेच्छा नानाविकृतदर्शनाः॥
en: Others slain by the whetted arrows of Vibhatsu, lay prostrate on the field of battle. Numerous Mlechhas, riding on the backs of elephants, of ugly appearances.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: नानावेषधरा राजन् नानाशस्त्रौघसंवृताः। रुधिरेणानुलिप्ताङ्गा भान्ति चित्रैः शरैर्हताः॥
en: Attired in various kinds of garments and, O king, armed with numerous weapons and weltering in blood, appeared beautiful, as they lay on the ground deprived of life by means of various kinds of shafts.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: शोणितं निर्वमन्ति स्म द्विपाः पार्थशराहताः। सहस्रशश्छिन्नगात्राः सारोहाः सपदानुगाः॥
en: Thousands of elephants with their bodies mangled and their riders and those who followed them, having been struck with the arrows of Pritha's son, vomitted blood.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: चुक्रुशुश्च निपेतुश्च बभ्रमुश्चापरे दिशः। भृशं त्रस्ताश्व बहवः स्वानेव प्रमृदुर्गजाः॥
en: Or uttered yells of agony, or fell down or careered wildly in all directions. Numerous other elephants greatly frightened, crushed their own ranks.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: सान्तरायुधिनश्चैव द्विपास्तीक्ष्णविषोपमाः। विदन्त्यसुरमायां ये सुघोरा घोरचक्षुषः॥ यवनाः पारदाश्चैव शकाश्च सह बाह्निकैः। काकवर्णा दुराचाराः स्त्रीलोकाः कलहप्रियाः॥ द्राविडास्तत्र युध्यन्ते मत्तमातङ्गविक्रमाः। गोयोनिप्रभवाम्लेच्छा: कालकल्पाः प्रहारिणः॥
en: Many other elephants armed with weapons and fierce like snakes of virulent poison, also did the same. Numerous furious Yavanas, Paradas, Shakas, Balhikas and Mlechhas born of the cow (of Vasishtha) possessed of fearful eyes, accomplished in smitting, looking like emissaries of Death, all versed in the use of illusive powers of the Asuras.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: दातिसारा दरदाः पुण्ड्राश्चैव सहस्रशः। तेन शक्याः स्म संख्यातुं व्रात्याः शतसहस्रशः॥
en: Many other Dravatisaras, Daradas, Pundras, thousands in number in bands of hundreds and thousands and together forming a force that was innumerable.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: अभ्यवर्षन्त ते सर्वे पाण्डवं निशितैः शरैः। अवाकिरंश्च के म्लेच्छा नानायुद्धविशारदाः॥
en: Began to pour on the son of Pandu their sharp arrows. Those Mlechhas also versed in all modes of war, began to shower on Arjuna their countless shafts.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: तेषामपि ससर्जाशु शरवृष्टिं धनंजयः। सृष्टिस्तथाविधा ह्यासीच्छलभानामिवायतिः॥
en: Dhananjaya also poured his arrows or them in quick succession, and the arrows discharged from the Gandiva bow appeared like fights of locusts, as they flew through the air.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: अभ्रच्छायामिव शरैः सैन्ये कृत्वा धनंजयः। मुण्डार्धमुण्डाञ्जटिलानशुचीञ्जटिलाननान्॥ म्लेच्छानशातयत् सर्वान् समेतानस्त्रतेजसा।
en: Having with his arrows created shade of over the troops like to that of the clouds, Dhananjaya slew, by the dint of his weapons, all the Mlechchas, having heads completely shaved or partially shaved of cover with matted hair, filthy in their mode of living and of malicious countenances.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: शरैश्च शतशो विद्धास्ते संघा गिरिचारिणः। प्राद्रवन्त रणे भीता गिरिगह्वरवासिनः॥
en: Pierced with hundreds of shafts, those rangers of the mountains. Those dwellers of caves, began to fly away from the field of battle out of sheer fear.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: गजाश्वसादिम्लेच्छानां पतितानां शितैः शरैः। बलाः कंका वृका भूमावपिबन् रुधिरं मुदा॥
en: Ravens, Kankas, birds and wolves, with great delight, then began to drink the blood of the elephants, horses and their Mlechchas riders, as they lay postrate on the field being cut down by the sharp arrows of Pritha's son.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: पत्त्यश्वरथनागैश्च प्रच्छन्नकृतसंक्रमाम्। शरवर्षप्लवां घोरां केशशैवलशाद्वलाम्। प्रावर्तयन्नदीमुग्रां शोणितौघतरङ्गिणीम्॥ छिन्नाङ्गुलीक्षुद्रमत्स्यां युगान्ते कालसंनिभाम्। प्राकरोद् गजसम्बाधां नदीमुत्तरशोणिताम्॥ देहेभ्यो राजपुत्राणां नागाश्वरथसादिनाम्।
en: Arjuna then caused a river to flow on the field of battle, of which (slain) foot-soldiers, car-warriors, horses and elephants formed and embankments; shower of shafts formed the rafts (wherewith to cross it); hair of (slain) combatants formed the moss and the weed floating on the moss and the weed floating on the surface; and blood formed its surging billows; and that river was dreadful and fierce to look at. The fingers cut-off from the arms of warriors constituted its smaller fishes; it was as dreadful as the Destroyer himself at the end of a Yuga; the bodies of (slain) elephants chocked its flow and that river of blood proceeded towards the kingdom of Yama. The carth was deluged with the blood flowing from the bodies of slain princes, elephants horses, car-warriors and horsemen.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: यथास्थलं च निम्नं च न स्याद् वर्षति वासवे॥ तथासीत् पृथिवी सर्वा शोणितेन परिप्लुता।
en: Its uplands and low-lands could not be distinguished, as if Vasava had poured a torrent of rain over it.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: षट्सहस्रान् हयान् वीरन् पुनर्दशशतान् वरान्॥ प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय क्षत्रियान् क्षत्रियर्षभः।
en: Six thousand brave warriors and many other Kshatriyas were dispatched by that foremost of Kshatriya Arjuna as to the abode of Death.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: शरैः सहस्रशोविद्धा विधिवत्कल्पिता द्विपाः॥ शेरते भूमिमासाद्य शैला वज्रहता इव। सवाजिरथमातङ्गान् निजन् व्यचरदर्जुनः॥ प्रभिन्न इव मातङ्गो मृद्गन् नलवनं यथा।
en: Thousands of elephants equipped according to rule, being pierced with numerous arrows. Lay prostrate on the field like so many mountains struck down by the thunder bolt. Then Arjuna careered over the field slaying horses, car-warriors and elephants. Like an elephant in rut crushing a forest of reeds.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: भूरिदुमलतागुल्मं शुष्केन्धनतृणोलपम्॥ निर्दहेदनलोऽरण्यं यथा वायुसमीरितः। सेनारण्यं तव तथा कृष्णानिलसमीरितः॥ शरार्चिरदहत् क्रुद्धः पाण्डवाग्निर्धनंजयः।
en: Just as fire helped forwarded by the wind, burns down a forest abounding in trees, creepers, brush-woods, dry fuels and grass, so, that fire viz., the enraged Dhananjaya, the son of Pandu, having arrows for his flames and helped forward by the Krishna-wind, consumed the forest constituted by your troops.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: शून्यान् कुर्वन रथापस्थान् मानवै: संस्तरन् महीम्॥५८ प्रानृत्यदिव सम्बाधे चापहस्तो धनंजयः।
en: Emptying the terraces of the cars, Arjuna over-spread the earth with the corpses of men. In that confused encounter Dhananjaya seemed to dance wielding his bow in his hand.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: वज्रकल्पैः शरैर्भूमिं कुर्वन्नुत्तरशोणिताम्॥ प्राविशद् भारती सेनां संकुद्धो वै धनंजयः। तं श्रुतायुस्तथाम्बष्ठो व्रजमानं न्यवारयत्॥
en: Deluging the ground with blood drawn by means of shafts resembling the thunderbolt itself. Dhananjaya, inflamed with wrath, plunged deep into the ranks of the Bharata troops. When he thus advancing, Shrutayudha the ruler of the Ambashtha's then opposed him.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: तस्यार्जुनः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छदैः। न्यपातयद्धयाशीघ्रं यतमानस्य मारिष॥
en: Thereupon, O sire, when he was thus exerting himself against Arjuna, the latter with sharp arrows furnished with wings made of Kanka feathers, speedily cut down his horses.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: धनुश्चास्यापरैश्छित्त्वा शरैः पार्थो विचक्रमे। अम्बष्ठस्तु गदां गृह्य कोपपर्याकुलेक्षणः॥
en: was Then with other arrows cutting off his bow, Arjuna began to career over the field. Thereat the ruler of the Ambashthas, with eyes rolling in rage, took up his mace.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: आससाद रणे पार्थे केशवं च महारथम्। ततः सम्प्रहरन् वीरो गदामुद्यम्य भारत॥
en: And assaulted in that battle Pritha's son and also the mighty car-warrior Keshava. Then O Bharata that hero, up-lifting and striking with his mace.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: रथमावार्य गदया केशवं समताडयत्। गदया ताडितं दृष्ट्वा केशवं परवीरहा॥
en: Checked the progress of Arjuna's car and with it began to strike Keshava; beholding Keshava struck with the mace, that slayer of hostile heroes.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: अर्जुनोऽभृशं क्रुद्धः सोऽम्बष्ठं प्रति भारत। तत शरैर्हेमपुकैः सगदं रथिनां वरम्॥ छादयामास समरे मेघः सूर्यमिवोदितम्। अथापरैः शरैश्चापि गदां तस्य महात्मनः॥ अचूर्णयत् तदा पार्थस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्। अथ तां पतितां दृष्ट्वा गृह्यान्यां च महागदाम्॥
en: Arjuna, O Bharata, excited to the highest pitch of anger, showered over that foremost of car-warriors viz., the ruler of the Ambasthas wielding the mace, numerous shafts furnished with golden wings, like the mass of clouds enshrouding the risen sin. Thereafter with other arrows, Pritha's son splintered into pieces the mace of that illustrious warrior; indeed this feat appeared to be marvellous. Then beholding that mace of his cut down and taking up another heavy one.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: अर्जुनं वासुदेवं च पुनः पुनरताडयत्। तस्यार्जुनः क्षुरप्राभ्यां सगदावुद्यतौ भुजौ॥ चिच्छेदेन्द्रध्वजाकारौ शिरश्चान्येन पत्रिणा। स पपात हतो राजन् वसुधामनुनादयन्।॥
en: The ruler of the Ambashthas began to strike Vasudeva's son and Arjuna, incessantly. Thereat Arjuna with a couple of razor-headed arrows cut-off his upraised arms weilding the pole of Indra; and then with another winged shaft be cut off his head. Then that king, O monarch, fell down on the earth creating a loud noise.

description: The slaughter of Ambashtha king and others
sn: इन्द्रध्वज इवोत्सृष्टो यन्त्रनिर्मुक्तबन्धनः। स्थानीकावगाढच वारणाश्वशतैर्वृतः। अदृश्यत तदा पार्थो धनैः सूर्य इवावृतः॥
en: Like a standard raised in honour of Indra falling down, when the ropes tying it to the engine (on which it is posted) are cut-off. Then plunging deep into the division of cars and surrounded by hundreds upon hundreds of elephants and steeds, the son of Pritha looked like the sun covered with thick masses of clouds.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: संजय उवाच ततः प्रविष्टि कौन्तेये सिंधुराजजिधांसया।।। द्रोणनीकं विनिर्भिद्य भोजानीकं च दुस्तरम्॥
en: Sanjaya said When the son of Kunti, out of a desire for slaying the king of the Sindhus, had penetrated into the Bharata army, after having pierced through the invincible division of Drona and the Bhoja king.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: काम्बोजस्य च दायादे हते राजन् सुदक्षिणे। श्रुतायुधे च विक्रान्ते निहते सव्यसाचिना॥
en: When also, O king, the heir of the king of Kambojas, namely prince Sudakshina, also the powerful Shrutayudha, had been slain by Savyasachin.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: विप्रद्रुतेष्वनीकेषु विध्वस्तेषु समन्ततः। प्रभग्नं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्ते द्रोणमभ्ययात्॥
en: When the divisions of your army had been broken and routed in all directions, your son seeing his troops shattered speedily proceeded towards Drona.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: त्वरन्नेकरथेनैव समेत्य द्रोणमब्रवीत्। गतः स पुरुषव्याघ्रः प्रमथ्यैतां महाचमूम्॥
en: Hastily riding on a single car, he repaired to Drona ‘and addressing him said "That foremost of men Arjuna has already passed through this mighty army, having crushed it completely.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: अथबुद्ध्या समीक्षस्व किन्नु कार्यमनन्तरम्। अर्जुनस्य विघाताय दारुणेऽस्मिञ्जनक्षये॥
en: Now decide with the help of your understanding, what should be done next, for bringing about the slaughter of Arjuna, taking into consideration this fearful carnage.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: यथा स पुरुषव्याघ्रो न हन्येत जयद्रथः। तथा विधत्स्व भद्रं ते त्वं हि न: परमा गतिः॥
en: Do you so arrange that, that foremost of inen may not slay Jayadratha. May good betide you. You are our sole protector.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: असौ धनंजयाग्निर्हि कोपमारुतचोदितः। सेनाकक्षं दहति मे वह्निः कक्षमिवोत्थितः॥
en: Like a raging fire consuming a heap of dry grass and fuel, this Dhananjaya-fire urged on by the wind of his anger, is consuming the grass and fuel formed by my troops.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: अतिक्रान्ते हि कौन्तेये भित्त्वा सैन्यं परंतप। जयद्रथस्य गोप्तारः संशयं परमं गताः॥
en: O afflicter of your foes, being informed that the son of Kunti had passed through the division having pierced through it, the warriors entrusted with the protection of Jayadratha, are being preyed upon by anxiety.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: स्थिरा बुद्धिनरेन्द्राणामासीद् ब्रह्मविदां वर। नातिक्रमिष्यति द्रोणं जातु जीवं धनंजयः॥
en: O you foremost of those conversant with the kings that Dhananjaya would never be able to escape Drona alive.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: योऽसौ पाथे व्यतिक्रान्तो मिषतस्ते महायुते। सर्वे ह्यद्यातुरं मन्ये नेदमस्ति बलं मम॥
en: O you of burning splendour, when Pritha's son has succeeded in penetrating through you division before your very eyes. I consider all my troops to be involved in a great catastrophy Indeed, I think I have no troops.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: जानामि त्वा महाभाग पाण्डवानां हिते रतम्। तथा मुह्यामि च ब्रह्मन् कार्यवत्तां विचिन्तयन्॥
en: I know you, O illustrious one, to be attached to the interests of the Pandavas, therefore, O Brahmana. I am losing my sense in the thought what should be done by me next.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: यथाशक्ति च ते ब्रह्मन् वर्तये वृत्तिमुत्तमाम्। प्रीणामि च यथाशक्ति तच्च त्वं नावबुध्यसे॥
en: To the best of my prowess, O Brahmana, I try to behave well with you. I also, exert to the best of my capabilities for satisfying you; still you do not seem to attach any value to all these.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: अस्मान्न त्वं सदा भक्तानिच्छस्यमितविक्रम। पाण्डवान् सततं प्रीडास्यस्माकं विप्रिये रतान्॥
en: you of prowess infinite, although we are ever devoted to you, you do not wish us well; but you are ever satisfied with the Pandavas who are intent on injuring ourselves.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: अस्मानेवोपजीवंस्त्वमस्माकं विप्रिये रतः। न ह्ययं त्वां विजानामि मधुदिग्धमिव क्षुरं॥
en: Though you live upon our bread, yet you are instrumental in injuring us. I knew not before that, you are but a razor soaked in honey.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: नादास्यच्चेद् वरं मह्यं भवान् पाण्डवनिग्रहे। नाचारयिष्यं गच्छन्तमहं सिन्धुपतिं गृहान्॥
en: If you had not given me assurances of vanquishing the Pandavas, I would never have prevented the ruler of the Sindhus from returning to his own dominions.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: मया त्वाशंसमानेन त्वत्तस्त्राणमबुद्धिना। आश्वासितः सिन्धुपतिर्मोहाद् दत्तश्च मृत्यवे॥
en: Fool that I am, hoping to obtain protection from you, I gave assurances of safety to the kirig of the Sindhus; now I see that I have virtually offered him as a victim to Death.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: यमदंष्ट्रान्तरं प्राप्तो मुच्येतापि हि मानवः। नार्जुनस्य वशं प्राप्तो मुच्येताजौ जयद्रथः॥
en: It possible for a man to escape even when he goes inside the jaws of Death, but there is not the slightest chance of escape for Jayadratha, when he once comes within the reach of Partha in battle.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: स तथा कुरुशोणाश्व यथा मुच्येत सैन्धवः। मम चार्तप्रलापानां मा कुधः पाहि सैन्धवम्॥
en: O you owning crimson steeds, do you so manage that the ruler of the Sindhus may yet be saved. Be not angry with me for all these raving of mine afflicted as I am with grief. Oh! save, save the ruler of the Sindhus!

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: द्रोण उवाच नाभ्यसूयामि ते वाक्यमश्वत्थाम्नासि मे समः। सत्यं तु ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तज्जुषस्व विषाम्पते॥
en: Drona said I do not take your words in ill-part; you are to me like Ashvatthaman himself, I tell you this for sooth. O ruler of men, do you now act up to my advices.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: सारथिः प्रवरः कृष्णः शीघ्राश्चास्य हयोत्तमाः। अल्पं च विवरं कृत्वा तूर्णं याति धनंजयः॥
en: Krishna is the best of all drivers of chariots and his horses are the fleetest and the best of the species. Creating a small breath only, Dhananjaya can pass very quickly through it.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: किं न पश्यसि बाणौधान् क्रोशमाने किरीटिनः। पश्चाद् रथस्य पतितान् क्षिप्ताशीघ्रं हि गच्छत॥
en: Can you not see the innumerable arrows shot by the diadem-decked Arjuna with his Gandiva bow, are falling full two miles behind his car as he is advancing?

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: न चाहं शीघ्रयानेऽद्य समर्थो वयसान्वितः। सेनामुर न च पार्थानामेतद् बलमुपस्थितम्॥
en: Grown up in years, I cannot indeed proceed so has ily. Moreover, there! do you see the whole army of the Parthas assailing our van.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: युधिष्ठिरश्च मे ग्राह्यो मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्। एवं मया प्रतिज्ञातं क्षत्रमध्ये महाभुज॥
en: Yudhishthira also should be captured by myself, before they eyes of all bowmen. Even this, O mighty armed one, has been the vow undertaken by me amidst all Kshatriya warriors.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: धनंजयेन चोत्सृष्टो वर्तते प्रमुखे नृप। तस्माद् व्यूहमुखं हित्वा नाहं योत्स्यामि फाल्गुनम्।।
en: Abandoned by Dhananjaya, O king, he now stands at the head of his divisions. For these reasons I shall not fight with Phalguna, leaving the van of our array uncared for.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: तुल्याभिजनकर्माणं शत्रुनेकं सहायवान्। गत्वा योधय मा भैस्त्वं त्वं ह्यस्य जगतः पतिः॥
en: Duly supported, do you go yourself and fight with your unsupported foe who is equal to you in nobility of birth and in the achievement of feasts. Be not afraid! You are the lord of this world.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: राजा शूरः कृती दक्षो वैरमुत्पाद्य पाण्डवैः। वीर स्वयं प्रयाह्यत्र यत्र पार्थो धनंजयः॥
en: You are a sovereign, a hero, possessed of fame and skilful in defeating (your opponents). O valorous subjugator of hostile fortresses, hie yourself, therefore to that part of the field where Dhananjaya is.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: दुर्योधन उवाच कथं त्वामप्यतिक्रान्तः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। धनंजयो मया शक्य आचार्य प्रतिबाधितुम्॥
en: Duryodhana said O preceptor, how is it possible for me to hold in check that Dhananjaya who has passed even yourself, the foremost of all wielders of weapons?

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: अपि शक्यो रणे जेतुं वज्रहस्तः पुरंदरः। नार्जुनः समरे शक्यो जेतुं परपुरंजयः॥
en: It may be possible for me to conquer in battle Purandara armed with his thunder-bolt, but it is not possible for me to conquer Arjuna that subjugator of hostile towns,

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: येन भोजश्य हार्दिक्यो भवांश्च त्रिदशोपमः। अस्त्रप्रतापेन जितौ श्रुतायुश्च निबर्हितः॥
en: He by whom the son of Hridika, the ruler of the Bhojas and yourself equal to a god, have all been vanquished with the showers of his weapons, he by whom Shrutayusha has been slain.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: सुदक्षिणश्च निहतः स च राजा श्रुतायुधः। श्रुतायुश्चाच्युतायुश्चम्लेच्छाश्चायुतशो हताः॥
en: as He by whom Sudakshina and king Shrutayusha have been slain, also Shrutayusha and Achytayusha and myriads of Mlechchas also have been slain.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: तं कथं पाण्डवं युद्धे दहन्तमिव पावकम्। प्रतियोत्स्यामि दुर्धर्षे तमहं शस्त्रकोविदम्॥
en: How can I encounter that invincible son of Pandu, accomplished in the use of all kinds of weapons and resembling the all-destroying fire itself.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: क्षमं च मन्यसे युद्धं मम तेनाद्य संयुगे। परवानस्मि भवति प्रेष्यवद् रक्ष मद्यशः॥
en: How it is that you today think me competent to fight with him? I am entirely dependent on you and am your slave; Oh! save my honour!

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: द्रोण उवाच सत्यं वदसि कौरव्य दुराधर्षो धनंजयः। अहं तु तत् करिष्यामि यथैनं प्रसहिष्यसि॥
en: Drona said o foremost descendant of the Kuru race, you speak all that is true. Really Dhananjaya is incapable of suffering defeat. But I myself will so act by which you will be able to bear him.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: अद्भुतं चाद्य पश्यन्तु लोके सर्वधनुर्धराः। विषक्तं त्वयि कौन्तेयं वासुदेवस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Let all wielders of bow inhabiting this world, behold today the marvellous fact, of the son of Kunti being held in check by you, even before Vasudeva himself.

description: The donning of the armour on Duryodhana by Drona
sn: एष ते कवचं राजंस्तथा बजामि काञ्चनम्। यथा न बाणा नास्त्राणि प्रहरिष्यन्ति ते रणे॥
