description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: संजय उवाच प्रयाते तव सैन्यं तव सैनयं तु युयुधाने युयत्सया। धर्मराजो महाराज स्वेनानीकेन संवृतः॥
en: Sanjaya said O monarch, when desirous of battle, Yuyudhana had proceeded against your army, king Yudhishthira the virtuous, supported by his troops.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: पार्थिवः। प्रायाद् द्रोणरथं प्रेप्सुर्युयुधानस्य पृष्ठतः। ततः पाञ्चालराजस्य पुत्रः समादुर्मदः॥
en: Followed Yuyudhana from behind, with a view to reach the chariot of Drona. Thereafter, the son of the king of the Panchalas, that invincible warrior.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: प्राक्रोशत् पाण्डवानीके वसुदानश्च आगच्छत प्रहरत द्रुतं विपरिधावत॥
en: And king Vasudana began to shout loudly amidst the Pandava troops. 'Come, strike, rush upon the foe quickly.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: यथा सुखेन गच्छत सात्यकिर्युद्धदुर्मदः। महारथा हि बहवो यतिष्यन्त्यस्य निर्जये॥
en: So that the invincible Satyaki may proceed easily. Many mighty car-warriors will strive hard for vanquishing him.'

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: इति ब्रुवन्तो वेगेन निपेतुस्ते महारथाः। वयं प्रतिजिगीषन्तस्तत्र तान् समभिद्रुताः॥
en: Thus speaking, the mighty car-warriors of the Pandavas impetuously dashed against us. Indeed they then feel upon us exclaiming "we will conquer those who will rush against ourselves."

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: ततः शब्दो महानासीद् युयुधानरथं प्रति। आकीर्यमाणा धावन्ती तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनी॥
en: Then a mighty uproar was heard nec. the car of Yuyudhana. Your son's troops, then covered with the shafts of Satyaki, began to run away from the field of battle.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: सात्वतेन महाराज शतधाभिव्यशीर्यत। तस्यां विदीर्यमाणायां शिनेः पौत्रो महारथः॥
en: O mighty monarch, your troops were then broken to hundred straggling bodies by that hero of the Satvata race. While that army was thus confused, that mighty car-warrior, the grandson of Sini.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: सप्त वीरान् महेष्वासानग्रानीकेष्वपोथयत्। अथान्यानपि राजेन्द्र नानाजनपदेश्वरान्॥ शरैरगलसंकाशैनिन्ये वीरान् यमक्षयम्। शतमेकेन विव्याध शतेनैकं च पत्रिणाम्॥
en: Crushed down seven fierce bowmen all endued with heroism in the vanguard of our army. He also, O monarch, dispatched, with his arrows resembling the tongues of fire, to the abode of death, many heroic rulers of diverse realms. Sometimes he pierced hundred warriors with a single shaft and sometimes a single warriors with a hundred shafts.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: द्विपारोहान् द्विपांश्चैव हयारोहान् हयांस्तथा। रथिनः साश्वसूतांश्च जघानेशः पशूनिव॥
en: Elephant-riders and elephants, horse-men and horses and car-warriors and their steeds and charioteers, Satyaki slew like Rudra slaying the beasts.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: तं तथाद्भुतकर्माणं शरसम्पातवर्षिणम्। न केचनाभ्यधावन् वै सात्यकि सैनिकाः॥
en: None of your troops then ventured to encounter Satyaki who was achieving many feats with extreme lightness and showering torrents of arrows.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: ते भीता मृद्यमानाश्च प्रमृष्टा दीर्घबाहुना। आयोधनं जहुर्वीरा दृष्टवा तमतिमानिनम्॥
en: They were then seized with panic being crushed and mangled by that long-armed hero; and beholding that proud hero, they then began to run quickly away from the field of battle,

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: तमेकं बहुधापश्यन् मोहितास्तस्य तेजसा। रथैर्विमथितैश्चैव भग्नीडैश्च मारिष॥
en: Although Satyaki was alone yet, your troops thought him to be multiplied into many. They were then confounded by his energy. Then with shattered chariots and crushed carniches.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: चक्रैर्विमथितैश्छत्रैर्ध्वजैश्च विनिपातितः। अनुकषैः पताकाभिः शिरस्त्राणैः सकाञ्चनैः॥
en: With Anukarsha, bannerets, golden helmets, broken wheels, torn umbrellas and fallen standards.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: बाहुभिश्चन्दनादिग्धैः साङ्गदैश्च विशाम्पते। हस्तिहस्तोपमैश्चापि भुजङ्गाभोगसंनिभैः॥ ऊरुभिः पृथिवी च्छन्ना मनुजानां नराधिप। शशाङ्कसंनिभैश्चैव वदनैश्चारुकुण्डलैः॥
en: And O ruler of men, with arms decked with sandal-paste, adorned with Angadas, with human thighs, resembling trunks of elephants or the plump bodies of snakes, the earth became literally covered over. With faces resembling the moon and with heads graced with beautiful ear-rings.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: पतितैर्ऋषभाक्षाणां सा बभावति मेदिनी। गजैश्च बहुधा छिन्नैः शयानैः पर्वतोपमैः॥
en: Of warriors possessed of expansive eyes, the earth appeared exceedingly charming. With the mountain-like bodies of huge elephants cut to pieces and fallen on the field.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: रराजातिभृशं भूमिविकीर्णैरिव पर्वतैः। तपनीयमयैर्योक्त्रैर्मुक्ताजालविभूषितैः॥ उरश्छदैर्विचित्रैश्च व्यशोभनत तुरङ्गमाः। गतसत्त्वा महीं प्राप्य प्रमृष्टा दीर्घबाहुना॥
en: The earth appeared beautiful as if strewn over with hillocks. Crushed by that hero of long arms, horses, deprived of life and prostrate on the field of battle, appeared charming with their traces of burnished gold decked with strings of pearls and with their breastplates of excellent make.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: नानाविधानि सैन्यानि तव हत्वा तु सात्वतः। प्रविष्टस्तावकं सैन्यं द्रावयित्वा चमूं भृशम्॥
en: Then he of the Satvata race penetrated into the ranks of your army slaying troops of diverse kinds and crushing your army completely.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: ततस्तेनैव मार्गेण येन यातो धनंजयः। इयेष सात्यकिर्गन्तुं ततो द्रोणेन वारितः॥
en: Then Satyaki desired to go by the very track by which Dhananjaya had gone But he was there opposed by Drona.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: भारद्वाजं समासाद्य युयुधानश्च सात्यकिः। न न्यवर्तते संक्रुद्धो वेलामिव जलाशयः॥
en: Then the war-like Satyaki, inflamed as he was with rage, did not recede getting Drona as an opponent, even as the waters of the ocean does not recede encountering an embankment.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: निवार्य तु रणे द्रोणो युयुधानं महारथम्। विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैः पञ्चभिर्मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: Resisting that mighty car-warrior Yuyudhana in battle, Drona pierced him with five sharp arrows all capable of penetrating to the very vitals.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: सात्यकिस्तु रणे द्रोणं राजन् विव्याध सप्तभिः। हेमपुङ्खैः शिलाधौतैः कङ्कबर्हिणवाजितैः॥
en: Thereupon, O king, Satyaki in that battle, pierced Drona with seven arrows whetted on stone and furnished with golden wings as well as with wings made of the feathers of the Kanka and the peacock.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: तं षभिः सायकैनॊणः साश्वयन्तारमार्दयेत्। स तं न ममृषे द्रोणं युयुधानो महारथः॥
en: Drona in return, with six arrows, afflicted him and his steeds and charioteer. Then that mighty car-warrior Yuyudhana could not brook that act of Drona.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: सिंहनादं ततः कृत्वा द्रोणं विव्याध सात्यकिः। दशभिः सायकैश्चान्यैः षड्भिरष्टाभिरेव च॥
en: Uttering his war-cry aloud, Satyaki then pierced Drona at first with ten, then with six and again with eight arrows.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: युयुधानः पुनद्रोणं विव्याध दशभिः शरैः। एकेन सारथिं चास्य चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्॥
en: Once more Yuyudhana pierced Drona with ten shafts, his charioteer with one, his four steeds with four other arrows.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: ध्वजमेकेन बाणेन विव्याध युधि मारिष। तं द्रोण: साश्वयन्तारं सरथध्वजमाशुगैः॥ त्वरन् प्राच्छादयद् बाणैः शलभानामिव व्रजैः। तथैव युयुधानोऽपि द्रोणं बहुभिराशुगैः॥
en: O sire in that battle, he pierced Drona's standard with another arrows. Thereupon Drona quickly discharging his swift-flying arrows that resembled fights of locusts, covered Satyaki together with his steeds, charioteer, chariot and standard. So also Yuyudhana with countless swift-coursing shafts.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: आच्छादयदसम्भ्रान्तस्ततो द्रोण उवाच हा तवाचार्यो रणं हित्वा गतः कापुरुषो यथा॥
en: Covered Drona fearlessly; then Drona addressing him said-”Your preceptor has gone before, shunning me in battle as a veritable coward.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: युध्यमानं च मां हित्वा प्रदक्षिणमवर्तत। त्वं हि मे युध्यतो नाद्य जीवन् यास्यसि माधव॥
en: He avoided me though I was fighting and proceeded keeping me in the right. You shall not, escape me today with life, provided you also do not shun me fighting, like your cowardly preceptor."

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: सात्यकिरुवाच यदि मां त्वं रणे हित्वा न यास्याचार्यवद्रुतम्। धनंजयस्य पदवीं धर्मराजस्य शासनात्॥
en: Satyaki said At the command of the very virtuous king Yudhishthira, I am proceeding in the track of Dhananjaya. Good betide you, O Brahman. Let me lose no time.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: गच्छामिस्वस्ति ते ब्रह्मन् न मे कालात्ययो भवेत्। आचार्यानुग्रतो मार्ग: शिष्यैरन्वास्यते सदा॥
en: The path which the preceptor follows it that which the pupil should follow. Therefore, I shall quickly follow that which my preceptor has followed.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: संजय उवाच तस्मादेव व्रजाम्याशु यथा मे स गुरुर्गतः। एतावदुक्त्वा शैनेय आचार्य परिवर्जयन्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, that grandson of Sini, dashed forward avoiding the preceptor; and O king, then addressing his charioteer he said

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: प्रयातः सहसा राजन् सारथिं चेदमब्रवीत्। द्रोणः करिष्यते यत्नं सर्वथा मम वारणे॥
en: "Drona will put forth every effort to check me in battle. So proceed very carefully. Hear also these words of mine of grave import.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: यत्तो याहि रणे सूत शृणु चेदं वचः परम्। एतदालोक्यते सैन्यमावन्त्यानां महाप्रभम्॥
en: Yonder is seen the highly resplendent division of the Avantis. Next to them is the mighty host composed of the warriors from the south.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: आस्यानन्तरतस्त्वेतद् दाक्षिणात्यं महद् बलम्। तदनन्तरमेतच बाह्निकानां महद् बलम्॥
en: Beyond this latter array is the division of the Valhikas, beyond which again stand the division of Karna, firmly resolved to fight.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: बाह्निकाभ्याशतो युक्तं कर्णस्य च महद् बलम्। अन्योन्येन हि सैन्यानि भिन्नान्येतानि सारथे॥
en: O charioteer, though these divisions are distinct from one another, yet depending on one another, they are supporting one another.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: अन्योन्यं समुपाश्रित्य न त्यक्ष्यन्ति रणाजिरम्। एतदन्तमासाद्य चोदयाश्वान् प्रहृष्टवत्॥
en: Penetrating into these divisions, do you cheerfully urge the steeds on. O charioteer, carry me in a medium speed to the spot.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: मध्यमं जवमास्थाय वह मामत्र सारथे। वाह्निका यत्र दृश्यन्ते नानाप्रहरणोद्यताः॥ दाक्षिणत्याश्च बहवः सूतपुत्रपुरोगमाः
en: Where the Valhikas are seen stationed with weapons uplifted, where stand the numerous Southerners headed by Suta's son Karna;

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: हस्त्यश्वरथसम्बाधं यचानीकं विलोक्यते॥ नानादेशसमुत्यैश्च पदातिभिरधिष्ठितम्।
en: And where stands that division teeming with elephants, horses and cars and foot-soldiers recruited from various realms.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: एतावदुक्त्वा यन्तारं ब्राह्मणं परिवर्जयन्॥ स व्यतीयाय यत्रोग्रं कर्णस्य च महद् बलम्।
en: Having thus spoken and avoiding the Brahmana, he advanced addressing his charioteer thus, "Pass through the breach between those two divisions towards the mighty and fierce host of Karna.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: तंद्रोणोऽनुययौ क्रुद्धो विकिरन् विशिखान् बहून्॥ युयुधानं महाभागं गच्छन्तमनिवर्तिनम्।
en: Thereupon, inflamed with rage, Drona began to pursue the illustrious Yuyudhana who was proceeding steadily, discharging numerous arrows.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: कर्णस्य सैन्यं सुमहदभिहत्य शितैः शरैः॥ प्राविशद् भारती सेनामर्पयन्तां च सात्यकिः।
en: Then Satyaki afflicting Karna's mighty host with his sharp arrows, plunged into che infinite host of the Bharatas.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: प्रविष्टे युयुधाने तु सैनिकेषु दुतेषु च॥ अमषीं कृतवर्मा तु सात्यकिं पर्यवारयत्।
en: When Yuyudhana had thus entered into the ranks of your soldiers and when your soldiers were breaking away, Kritavarman inspired with rage opposed Satyaki.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: तमापतन्तं विशिखैः षड्भिराहत्य सात्यकिः॥ चतुर्भिश्चतुरोऽस्याश्वानाजघानाशु वीर्यवान्।
en: The highly-puissant Satyaki struck him as he was advancing with six arrows; and then with four other shafts, he slew the latter's four steeds.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: ततः पुनः षोडशभिर्नतपर्वभिराशुगैः॥ सात्यकिः कृतवर्माणं प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे।
en: Then again Satyaki pierced Kritavarman on the breast, with sixteen swift-flying arrows of depressed knots.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: स ताड्यमानो विशिखैर्बहुभिस्तिग्मतेजनैः॥ सात्वतेन महाराज कृतवर्मा न चक्षमे।
en: O mighty monarch, thus pierced with numerous arrows of great fierceness by that Satvata hero, Kritvarman did not brook it. arrow

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: स वत्सदन्तं संधाय जिह्मगानलसंनिभम्॥ आकृष्य राजन्नाकर्णाद् विव्याधोरसि सात्यकिम्।
en: Placing a Vatsadantha, capable of flying straight and resembling fire, O king, on the string of his bow, Kritavarman drew it back to his very ears and with that arrow then pierced Satyaki on the breast.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: स तस्य देहावरणं भित्त्वा देहं च सायकः॥ सपुङ्खपत्रः पृथिवीं विवेश रुधिरोक्षितः।
en: That furnished with beautiful feathery wings, penetrating through the armour and body of Satyaki, entered the earth, being steeped in blood.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: अथास्य बहुर्भिर्बाणैरच्छिनत् परमास्त्रवित्॥ समार्गणगणं राजन् कृतवर्मा शरासनम्।
en: O monarch, then Kritavarman acquainted with many excellent weapons, cut-off by means of his arrows, the bow of Satyaki having arrows fixed on its string.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: विव्याध च रणे राजन् सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमभू॥ दशभिर्विशिस्तीक्ष्णैरभिक्रुद्धः स्तनान्तरे।
en: Then again inflamed with rage, he pierced, O king, Satyaki of indomitable prowess on the chest, with ten shafts of great sharpness.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: ततः प्रशीर्णे धनुषि शक्त्या शक्तिमतां वरः॥ जधान दक्षिण बाहुं सात्यकिः कृतवर्मणः।
en: Thereat that foremost of all creatures endued with prowess, viz., Satyaki, seeing his bow cut asunder, wounded the right arm of Kritavarman with an excellent lance.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: ततोऽन्यत् सुदृढं चापं पूर्णमायम्य सात्यकिः॥ व्यसृजद् विशिखांस्तूर्णे शतथोऽथ सहस्रशाः।
en: Then taking up and stretching a bow of tougher make, Yuyudhana swiftly discharged at his enemy hundreds and thousands of shafts;

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: सरथं कृतवर्माणं समन्तात् पर्यवारयत्॥ छादयित्वारणे राजन् हार्दिक्यं स तु सात्यकिः।
en: And with that arrowy shower, he then completely covered Kritavarman and his chariot. Thus covering the son of Hridika, O monarch, Satyaki in that battle.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: अथास्य भल्लेन शिरः सारथेः समकृन्तत॥ स पपात हतः सूतो हार्दिक्यस्य महारथात्।
en: Cut off with a bhalla the head of the charioteer of his opponent, from his trunk. Thus slain, the driver of Kritavarman fell down from his niche of the chariot.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: ततम्ते यन्तृरहिताः प्राद्रवंस्तुरगा भृशम्॥ अथ भोजस्तु सम्भ्रान्तो निगृह्य तुरगान् स्वयम्।
en: At this, the steeds of Kritavarman no longer guided by the driver's reins, flew away with great speed, from the field of battle. Thereat. greatly annoved, the ruler of the Bhojas, himself checked his horses.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: तस्थौ वीरो धनुष्पाणिस्तत् सैन्यान्यभ्यपूजयन्।।' ८॥ स मुहूर्तमिवाश्वस्य सदश्वान् समनोदयत्।
en: Then that heroic warrior stood bou in hand, ready once more for fight, sceing which your Warrior applauded him highly. Taking respite for a moment only, Kritavarman urged his stecds on.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: व्यपेतभीरमित्राणामावहत् सुमहद् भयम्॥ सात्यकिश्चाभ्यगात् तस्मात् स तु भीममुपाद्रवत्!
en: Himself quite undaunted, he struck terror into the hearts of his enemies. By this time however, Satyaki had proceeded leaving him behind; whereupon Kritavarman fell upon Bhimasena.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: युयुधानोऽपि राजेन्द्र भोजानीकाद् विनिःसृतः॥ प्रययौ त्वरितस्तूर्ण काम्बोजानां महाचमूम्।
en: O mighty monarch, Yuyudhana also cmerging out of the division of the Bhojas, quickly proceeded against the strong host of the Kambojas.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: स तत्र बहुभिः शूरैः संनिरुद्धो महारथैः॥ न चचाल तदा राजन् सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः।
en: There he was opposed by many heroic carwarriors; in consequence whereof, Satyaki of uobaffled prowess could not move even one step forward.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: संधाय च चमू द्रोणो भोजे भारं निवेश्य स॥ अभ्यघावद् रणे यत्तो युयुधानं युयुत्सया।
en: Thereafter uniting his troops and vesting the ruler of the Bhojas' with their command, Drona with a firm resolve for fighting with Yuyudhana, rushed against him.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: तथा तमनुधावन्तं युयुधानस्य पृष्ठतः॥ न्यवारयन्त संहृष्टाः पाण्डुसैन्ये वृहत्तमाः।
en: Then beholding Drona follow Yuyudhana from behind, the foremost warriors among the Kurus filled with delight began to impede his progress.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: सामसाद्य तु हार्दिक्यं रथानां प्रवरं रथम्॥ पञ्चाला विगतोत्साहा भीमसेनपुरोगमाः।
en: Meanwhile the Panchalas commanded by Bhimasena, encountering that foremost of carwarriors viz., Hridika's son, became greatly depressed at heart.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: विक्रम्य वारिता राजन् वीरेण कृतवर्मणा॥ यतमानांश्च तान् सर्वानीषद्विगतचेतसः।
en: O king, then putting forth his energy, the heroic Kritavarman resisted all his focs who though depressed at first were then exerting vigorously.

description: The penetration of the Kaurava host by Satyaki
sn: अभितस्ताशरौघेण कान्तवाहानकारयत्॥ निगृहीतास्तु भोजेन भोजानीकेप्सवो रणे। अतिष्ठन्नार्यवद् वीराः प्रार्थयन्तो महदृशः॥
en: With the shower of his arrows Kritavarman then checked the vehicles of his foes standing before him. The Pandava warriors though thus i afflicted by the Bhoja king, yet stood like noble heroes, desirous on encountering the divisions of the Bhojas and of winning great renown in battle.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच एवं बहुगुणं सैन्यमेवं प्रविचितं बलम्। व्यूढमेवं यथान्यायमेवं बहु च संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Our army is possessed of many excellencies; and it is composed of various kinds of troops; its efficiency is great. O Sanjaya, it is disposed of in order in perfect accordance to the rules of military science and it is strong in numbers.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: नित्यं पूजितमस्माभिरभिकामं च नः सदा। प्रौढमत्यद्भुताकारं पुरस्ताद् दृष्टविक्रमम्॥
en: The warriors therein are ever well-treated by us and they are attached to us very much. The army is not newly recruited and its aspect is wonderful. Its efficiency has been tested previously.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: नातिवृद्धमबालं च नाकृशं नातिपीवरम्। लघुवृत्तायतप्रायं सारगात्रपनामयम्॥ आत्तसंनाहसंछन्नं बहुशस्त्रपरिच्छदम्। शस्त्रग्रहणविद्यासु बह्वीषु परिनिष्ठितम्॥
en: The warriors belonging to it are neither very old, nor very young; they are neither lean nor very corpulent. They are of active habits, well-built, strong-bodied and free from any disease. They are clad in cuirasses and wellequipped with offensive weapons. They are accomplished in the use of various weapons and are well practised in the exercise of all kinds of weapons.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: आरोहे पर्यवस्कन्दे सरणे सान्तरप्लुते। सम्यक्प्रहरणे याने व्यपयाने च कोविदम्॥
en: They are experts in mountain upon and descending from vehicles, in moving forward and in falling back, in striking down effectually and in advancing and retreating.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: नागेष्वश्वेषु बहुशो रथेषु च परीक्षितम्। परीक्ष्य च यथान्यायं वेतनेनोपपादितम्॥
en: They have before been examined in the management of steeds, elephants and cars; and after due examination, they have been employed on pay.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: न गोष्ठ्या नोपकारेण न सम्बन्धनिमित्ततः। नानाहूतं नाप्यभृतं मम सैन्यं बभूव ह॥
en: And no for the sake of family relationship, nor from favour, nor from kinship. They have not come uncalled for, nor are they unpaid soldicrs.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: कुलीनार्यजनोपेतं तुष्टपुष्टमनुद्धतम्। कृतमानोपचारं च यशखि च मनखि च॥
en: They are high-born, respectable, evercontented, well-fed and submissive. They have been duly honoured and rewarded by ourselves. They are all endued with fame and intelligence.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: सचिवैश्चापरैर्मुख्यैर्बहुभिः पुण्यकर्मभिः। लोकपालोपमैस्तात पालितं नरसत्तमैः॥
en: They again, O sire, are defended by our best warriors and other's of pious practices, all of whom are foremost men and resemble the Lokapalas themselves.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: बहुभिः पार्थिवैर्गुप्तस्मत्प्रियचिकार्युभिः। अस्मानभिसृतैः कामात् सबलैः सपदानुगैः॥
en: Numerous kings solicitous of our welfare, who have, out of their own accord, joined us with all their forces and followers, also defend them.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: महोदधिमिवापूर्णमापगभिः समन्ततः। अपक्षैः पक्षिसंकाशे रथैरश्वैश्च संवृतम्॥
en: Truly our army is like the vast ocean swelling with the waters of various stream flowing into it from all sides. It teems with chariot and steeds, which though devoid of wings are still capable of moving through the air like the winged rangers of the sky.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: प्रभिन्नकरटैश्चैव द्विरदैरावृतं महत्। यदहन्यत मे सैन्यं किमन्यद् भागधेयतः॥
en: My army abounds in elephants with the temporal juice flowing down their cheeks. Then to what else, but Destiny, can the slaughter of such an army be attributed?

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: योधाक्षय्यजलं भीमं वाहनोर्मितरङ्गिणम्। क्षेपण्यसिगदाशक्तिशरप्रासझषाकुलम्॥
en: (Ocean-like as our arrmy is), numerous warriors constitute its waters; and the various vehicles constitute its dreadful and surging waves. Innumerable maces, swords, darts, shafts and javelins constitute the oars plied on it.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: ध्वजभूषणसम्बाघरत्नोपलसुसंचितम्। वाहनैरभिधावद्भिर्वायुवेगविकम्पितम्॥
en: Teeming with standards and ornaments, the combatants form the lotuses on it. The swiftmoving steeds and elephants and chargers constitute the tempest that lashes in into fury.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: द्रोणगम्भीरपातालं कृतवर्ममहाह्रदम्। जलसंधमहाग्राहं कर्णचन्द्रोदयोद्धतम्॥
en: Drona forms its fathomless cave, Kritavarman its minghty lake and Jalasandha its dreadful alligator and Karna, the rising of the moon that makes it swell with pride and energy.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: गते सैन्यार्णवं भित्त्वा तरसा पाण्डवर्षभे। संजयैकरथेनैव युयुधाने च मामकम्॥
en: O Sanjaya, on a single car that foremost of the Pandavas viz., Arjuna has gone piercing through my ocean-like host and Yuyudhana also has followed him;

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तत्र शेषं न पश्यामि प्रविष्टे सव्यसाचिनि। सात्वते च रथोदारे मम सैन्यस्य संजय॥
en: And O Sanjaya, when Savyasachin has thus penetrated into my host and also that excellent car-warrior Satyaki of the Satvata race has done so, I do not think that any one of my troops will be able to escape with his life.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तौ तत्र समतिक्रान्तौ दृष्ट्वातीव तरखिनौ। सिन्धुराजं तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य गाण्डीवस्येषुगोचरे॥
en: Beholding those two heroes dash with speed through the vanguards of my troops and seeing the ruler of the Sindhus come within range of arrows shot from the Gandiva bow.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: किं नु वा कुरवः कृत्यं विदधुः कालचोदिताः। दारुणैकायने कालं कथं वा प्रतिपेदिरे॥
en: What course of action did the Kurus, goaded on to destruction by Fate then adopt? What became of them at that hour when the battle raged with fury?

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: ग्रस्तान् हि कौरवान् मन्ये मृत्युना तात संगतान्। विक्रमोऽपि रणे तेषां न तथा दृश्यते हि वै॥
en: O son, I consider the assembled Kaurava host already within the jaws of Death. Their prowess in battle is no longer seen to be what it once was.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: अक्षतौ संयुगे तत्र प्रविष्टौ कृष्णपाण्डवौ। न च वारयिता कश्चित् तयोरस्तीह संजय॥
en: Krishna and the son of Pandu have both entered into our troops, receiving not even the slightest wound. O Sanjaya, there is none also who can resist them.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: भृताश्च बहवो योधाः परीक्ष्यैव महारथाः। वेतनेन यथासोगं प्रियवादेन चापरे॥
en: Many mighty car-warriors and combatants have been admitted into our army after due examination. They all have been gratified by us with due remunerations and agreeable speeches.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: असत्कारभृतस्तात मम सैन्ये न विद्यते। कर्मणा ह्यनुरूपेण लभ्यते भक्तवेतनम्॥
en: There is none among my troops who has been maltreated. Every one receives his pay and ration, according to his abilities.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: न चायोधोऽभवत् कश्चिन्मम सैन्ये तु संजय। अल्पदानभृतस्तात तथा चाभृतको नरः॥
en: O Sanjaya, there is none who is not a good warrior, none who receives remuneration less then what he deserves or none who receives no pay.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: पूजितो हि यथाशक्त्या दानमानासनैर्मया। तथा पुत्रैश्च मे तात ज्ञातिभिश्च सबान्धवैः॥
en: The soldiers are honoured by me to the best of my resources, with gifts, honors and seats. My sons, relatives and my kinsmen, O son, all treat them in the same respectful manner as I do.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: ते च प्राप्यैव संग्रामे निर्जिताः सव्यसाचिना। शैनेयन परामृष्टाः किमन्यद् भागधेयतः॥
en: Even such troops, encountering Savayasachin in battle, are being vanquished by him; they are also being crushed by the grand son of Sini; what can it be but Destiny?

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: रक्ष्यते यश्च संग्रामे ये च संजय रक्षिणः। एकः साधारणः पन्था रक्ष्यस्य सह रक्षिभिः॥
en: Those who are protecting and those who are protected, are following the same road, the dcfender and the defended!

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: अर्जुनं समरे दृष्ट्वा सैन्धवस्याग्रतः स्थितम्। पुत्रो मम भृशं मूढः किं कार्य प्रत्यपद्यत॥
en: Beholding Arjuna stand before the ruler of the Sindhus in hostile attitude, what measure did my highly foolish son adopt?

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: सात्यकिं च रणे दृष्ट्वा प्रविशन्तमभीवत्। किं नु दुर्योधनः कृत्यं प्राप्तकालममन्यत॥
en: Beholding also Satyaki dash through his troops like one fearless, what measures also did Duryodhana consider to be suitable to the situation?

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: सर्वशस्त्रातिगौ सेनां प्रविष्टौ रथितसत्तमौ। दृष्ट्वा कां वै धृति युद्धे प्रत्यपद्यन्त मामकाः॥
en: Beholding those two foremost of carwarriors, both beyond the reach of all weapons, thus penetrate into my host, what resolution did my troops then form

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं तु दाशार्हमर्जुनार्थे व्यवस्थितम्। शिनीनामृषभं चैव मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems, beholding Krishna of the Dasarha race and that foremost of the Sinis, both exerting for the sake of Arjuna, my sons are giving way to grief.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: दृष्ट्वा सेनां व्यतिक्रान्तां सात्वतेनार्जुनेन च। पलायमानांश्च कुरून् मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Beholding him of the Satvata race and Arjuna pass through my divisions and beholding the Kurus fly in all directions, Meseems, my sons are giving way to grief.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: विदुतान् रथिनो दृष्ट्वा निरुत्साहान् द्विषजये। पलायनकृतोत्साहान् मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are giving way to grief, beholding the car-warriors routed and hopeless of conquering their foes and exert themselves in flying away.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: शून्यान् कृतान् रथोपस्थान् सात्वतेनार्जुनेन च। हतांश्च योधान् संदृश्य मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are giving way to grief, beholding the terraces of cars made empty by Satvata and Arjuna and also beholding the warriors slain (by thousands).

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: व्यश्वनागरथान् दृष्ट्वा तत्र वीरान् सहस्रशः। धावमानान् रणे व्यग्रान् मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are lamenting, beholding the steeds, the chariots, the elephants and thousands of heroic soldiers flying away in haste from the field of battle.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: महानागान् विद्रवतो दृष्ट्वार्जुनशराहतान्। पतितान् पततश्चान्यान् मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are lamenting beholding the huge elephants of my army fly away smitten by the arrows of Arjuna and also beholding them fallen and falling.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: विहीनांश्च कृतानश्वान् विस्थांश्च कृतान् नरान्। तत्र सात्यकिपार्थाभ्यां मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are lamenting seeing steeds deprived of riders and warriors deprived of chariots, by Arjuna and Satyaki.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: हयौधान् निहतान् दृष्ट्वा द्रवमाणांस्ततस्ततः। रणे माधवपार्थाभ्यां मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Mescems my sons are lamenting seeing large bodies of steeds slain and routed in all directions in battle, by the son of Pritha and the descendant of Madhu's race.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: पत्तिसंघान् रणे दृष्ट्वा धावमानांश्च सर्वशः। निराशा विजये सर्वे मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are lamenting, hopeless of their victory, by seeing the divisions of infantry fly with haste in all direction.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: द्रोणस्य समतिक्रान्तावनीकमपराजितौ। क्षणेन दृष्ट्वा तौ वीरौ मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems my sons are lamenting beholding those two invincible heroes pass in a moment through the division of Drona.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: सम्मूढोऽस्मि भृशं तात श्रुत्वा कृष्णधनंजयौ। प्रविष्टौ मामकं सैन्यं सात्वतेन सहाच्युतौ॥
en: O son, I am indeed overwhelmed with a stupor upon hearing that Krishna and Arjuna of unfading glory together with Satyaki of the Satvata race, have entered into my divisions.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे पृतनां शिनीनां प्रवरे रथे। भोजानीकं व्यतिक्रान्ते किमकुर्वत कौरवाः।।
en: When that foremost of car-warriors among the Sinis had plunged into my host and when he had passed through the Bhoja division, what, O Sanjaya, did the Kurus do?

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तथा द्रोणेन समरे निगृहीतेषु पाण्डुषु। कथं युद्धमभूत् तत्र तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: O Sanjaya, relate to me also how the battle raged there where Drona began to crush the Pandava host in battle.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: द्रोणो हि बलवाश्रेष्ठः कृतास्त्रो युद्धदुर्मदः। पञ्चालास्ते महेष्वासं प्रत्यविध्यन् कथं रणे॥
en: Drona was a warrior of superior skill; he was endued with strength, accomplished in the use of weapons and indomitable in battle. How was it then possible for the Panchalas to pierce that hero in battle?

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: पद्धवैरास्ततो द्रोणे धनंजयजयैषिणा। भारद्वाजसुतस्तेषु दृढवैरो महारथः॥
en: Solicitious of Dhanajaya's victory, the Panchalas were Drona's implacable foes, so also that mighty car-warrior the son of Bharadvaja was an inveterate enemy of theirs.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: अर्जुनश्चापि यचक्रे सिन्धुराजवधं प्रति। तन्मे सर्व समाचक्ष्व कुशलो ह्यसि संजय॥
en: O Sanjaya, skilful as you are in narration, tell me all that in detail which Arjuna did for bringing about the slaughter of the Sindhu king.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: संजय उताच आत्मापराधात् सम्भूतं व्यसनं भरतर्षभ। प्राप्य प्राकृतवद् वीर न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि॥
en: Sanjaya said O foremost of the Bharatas, it behoves you not to lament like an ordinary person, when you are overtaken, O hero, by a calamity which owes its origin to your own misconduct.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: पुरा यदुच्यसे प्राज्ञैः सुहृद्भिर्विदुरादिभिः। मा हार्षीः पाण्डवान् राजनिति तन्न त्वया श्रुतम्॥
en: Formerly, many of your well-wishers including the wise Vidura, advised you saying, "O king, do not forsake the sons of Pandu's but to those advices you paid no heed."

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: सुहृदां हितकामानां वाक्यं यो न शृणोति ह। समहद् व्यसनं प्राप्य शोचते वैयथाभवान्॥
en: He that sets at nought the advices of wellwishing friends, weeps like yourself when a calamity overtakes him.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: याचितोऽसि पुरा राजन् दाशार्हेण शमं प्रति। न च तं लब्धवान् कामं त्वत्तः कृष्णोमहायशाः॥
en: O king, the descendant of the Dasarha race entreated you for the conclusion of peace. But the highly-renowned Krishna then did not obtain that boon at your hands.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तव निगुर्णतां ज्ञात्वा पक्षपातं सुतेषु च। द्वैधीभावं तथा धर्मे पाण्डवेषु च मत्सरम्॥५ तव जिह्ममभिप्रायं विदित्वा पाण्डवान् प्रति। आप्रिलापांश्च बहून् मनुजाधिपसत्तम॥
en: Knowing your worthlessness, your partiality for your sons, your duplicity in virtue, your animosity against the sons of Pandu and ascertaining your crooked intentions against them and listening to many of your incoherent and delirious bewailings, 0 foremost of kings.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: सर्वलोकस्य तत्त्वज्ञः सर्वलोकेश्वरः प्रभुः। वासुदेवस्ततो युद्धं कुरूणामकरोन्महत्॥
en: That puissant lord of all the worlds, that one conversant with the truth of everything in the worlds, namely, the son of Vasudeva, caused the drums of war to be sounded among the Kurus.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: आत्मापराधात् सुमहान् प्राप्तस्ते विपुलः क्षयः। नैनं दुर्योधने दोषं कर्तुमर्हसि मानद॥
en: This awful destruction has overtaken you through your own faults; O giver of honour, it behoves you not to lay all blames on the shoulders of Duryodhana.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: न हि ते सुकृतं किंचिदादौ मध्ये च भारत। दृश्यते पृष्ठतश्चैव त्वन्मूलो हि पराजयः॥
en: As these incidents developed themselves, no good action was performed by you either in the beginning, in the middle or in the end, O Bharata. The defeat that can be anticipated now, is entirely owing to your fault.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तस्मादवस्थितो भूत्वा ज्ञात्वा लोकस्य निर्णयम्। शृणु युद्धं यथावृत्तं घोरं देवासुरोपमम्॥
en: Therefore, knowing as you do, the fate of this world, quietly and attentively hear how the battle that resembled that between the gods and the Asuras, took place.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: प्रविष्टे तव सैन्यं त शैनेय सत्यविक्रमे। भीमसेनमुखाः पार्थाः प्रतीयुर्वाहिनीं तव॥
en: When Sini's grandson of invincible prowess had entered into your troops, the troops of the Parthas headed by Bhimasena, fell upon your troops.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: आगच्छतस्तान् सहसा क्रुद्धरूपान् सहानुगान्। दधारैको रणे पाण्डून् कृतवर्मा महारथः॥
en: Then the mighty car-warrior Kritavarman, single-headed, received in that battle, the enraged Pandava troops who had been rushing to the battle with their followers.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: यथोद्वत्तं वारयते वेला वै सलिलार्णवम्। पाण्डुसैन्यं तथा संख्ये हार्दिक्यः समवारयत्॥
en: Just as the banks resist the surging waves of the sea, so did the son of Hridika resist the Pandava troops in battle.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम हार्दिक्यस्य पराक्रमम्। यदेनं सहिताः पार्था नातिचक्रमुराहवे॥
en: Then we beheld the wonderful prowess of Hridika's son inasmuch as the united divisions of the Parthas were unable to bear him down in battle.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: ततो भीमस्त्रिभिर्विद्धवा कृतवर्माणमाशुगैः। शङ्ख दध्मौ महाबाहुर्हर्पयन् सर्वपाण्डवान्॥
en: Thereupon the mighty-armed Bhima piercing Kritavarman with three swift-coursing arrows, blew his conch-shell, imparting thereby delight unto the Pandava troops.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: सहदेवस्तु विंशत्या धर्मराजश्च पञ्चभिः। शतेन नकुलश्चापि हार्दिक्यं समविध्यत॥
en: Then Sahadeva pierced Hridika's son with twenty, Yudhishthira the virtuous with five and Nakula with a hundred shafts.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: द्रौपदेयास्त्रिसप्तत्या सप्तभिश्च घटोत्कचः। धृष्टद्युम्नस्त्रिभिश्चापि कृतवर्माणमार्दयत्॥
en: The son of Draupadi pierced him with three and seventy, Ghatotkacha with seven and Dhristadyumna pierced Kritavarman with three arrows.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: विराटो द्रुपदश्चैव याज्ञसेनिश्च पञ्चभिः। शिखण्डी चैव हार्दिक्यं विद्धवा पञ्चभिराशुगैः॥
en: Virata, Drupada and Yajnaseni each pierced him with five shafts, Sikhandin also pierced Hridika's son with five swift flying arrows.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: पुनर्विव्याध विंशत्या सायकानां हसन्निव। कृतवर्मा ततो राजन् सर्वतस्तान् महारथान्॥ एकैकं पञ्चभिर्विद्धवा भीमं विव्याध सप्तभिः। धनुर्ध्वजं चास्य तथा रथाद् भूमावपातयत्॥
en: He then once more smilingly pierced him with twenty shafts. Thereupon, Oking, Kritavarman piercing each of these mighty carwarriors separately with five shafts, pierced Bhima with another seven shafts. Then he felled from the latter's car his standard and cutoff his bow.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं त्वरमाणो महारथः। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः सप्तत्या निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior making haste and burning with rage, pierced Bhima whose bow had been severed, on the breast, with seventy sharp arrows.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: स गाढविद्धो बलवान् हार्दिक्यस्य शरोत्तमैः। चचाल स्थमध्यस्थः क्षितिकम्पे यथाचलः॥
en: That hero (Bhima) endued with prowess, thus deeply pierced by the excellent shafts of Hridika's son, began to tremble in the terrace of his car, like a mountain shaking during an earthquake.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: भीमसेनं तथा दृष्ट्वा धर्मराजपुरोगमाः। विसृजन्तः शरान् राजन् कृतवर्माणमार्दयन्॥
en: Beholding Bhima thus involved in a dangerous situation, O king, the Pandava warriors headed by Yudhishthira, began to afflict Kritavarman by shooting numerous arrows.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तं कथा कोष्ठकीकृत्य रथवंशेन मारिष। विव्यधुः सायकैईष्टा रक्षार्थ मारुतेर्पधे॥
en: Then impaling Kritavarman within a circle of chariots, the Pandava warriors, O sire, filled with delight, began to wound him with their arrows, out of a desire for rescuing the son of Maruta.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां भीमसेनो महाबलः। शक्तिं जग्राह समरे हेमदण्डामयस्मयीम्॥
en: Thereafter the highly puissant Bhimasena regaining his senses, grasped, in that battle, a dreadful lance of golden staff and iron head.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: चिक्षेप च रथात् तूर्ण कृतवर्मरथं प्रति। सा भीमभुजनिर्मुक्ता निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभा॥
en: Then he huried from his own car that lance at the car of Kritavarman, with great force. That lance hurled by the arm of Bhima and resembling a snake that had recently cast off its slough.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: कृतवर्माणमभितः प्रजज्वाल सुदारुणा। तामापतन्ती सहसा युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभाम्॥
en: began to burn dreadfully as it coursed towards Kritavarman. Then as that lance, effulgent like the fire that appears at the end of a Yugu, was coursing swiftly towards.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां हार्दिक्यो निजघान द्विधा तदा। सा छिन्ना पतिता भूमौ शक्तिः कनकभूषणा॥
en: The son of Hridika, he cut it in twain with a couple of arrows. That dart decked with golden ornaments, thus severed, fell down on the earth.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: द्योतयन्ती दिशो राजन् महोल्केव नभश्चयुता। शक्तिं विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा भीमश्चुक्रोध वैभृशम्॥
en: And, O king, it there began to illumine the points of the compass like a mighty meteor dropping from the heavens. Thereat Bhima beholding his lance baffled, became excited to the highest pitch of fury.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय वेगवत् सुमहास्वनम्। भीमसेनो रणे क्रुद्धो हार्दिक्यं समवारयत्॥
en: Thereafter, taking up another bow of great toughness and emitting loud twang, the enraged Bhimasena in that battle began to resist the son of Hridika.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: अथैनं पञ्चभिर्बाणैराजधान स्तनान्तरे। भीमो भीमबलो राजंस्त्व दुर्मत्रितेन च॥
en: Then, Oking, Bhima of awful prowess, pierced Kritavarman, on the centre of his breast, with five arrows. All this is the result of your wicked policy.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: भोजस्तु क्षतसर्वाङ्गो भीमसेनेन मारिष। रक्ताशोक इवोत्फुल्लो व्यभ्राजत रणाजिरे॥
en: Then, O sire, the ruler of the Bhojas wounded on all parts of his body, appeared on the field of battle like a red Ashoka tree covered with blossoms.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: ततः क्रुद्धस्त्रिभिर्बाणैभीमसेनं हसन्निव। अभिहत्य दृढं युद्धे तान् सर्वान् प्रत्यविध्यत॥
en: Thereafter Kritavarman inflamed with rage, smilingly striking Bhimasena with three arrows, began, in return, to pierce the other warriors (with his arrows).

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: त्रिभिस्त्रिभिर्महेष्वासो यतमानान् महारथान्। तेऽपि तं प्रत्यविध्यन्त सप्तभिः सप्तभिः शरैः॥
en: That mighty bowman then pierced those car-warriors exerting their best in battle, each with three shafts. They then also pierced him in return, each with seven shafts.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: शिखण्डिनस्ततः क्रुद्धः क्षुरप्रेण महारथः। धनुश्चिच्छेद समरे प्रहसन्निव सात्वतः॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior of the Satvata race, inflamed with rage, smilingly cut-off the bow of Sikhandin with a razor-headed arrow.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: शिखण्डी तु ततः क्रुद्धश्छिन्ने धनुषि सत्वरः। असिं जग्राह समरे शतचन्द्रं च भाखरम्॥
en: Thereupon on the severance of his bow, Sikhandin burning with rage and hastening as much as possible, took up a sword and a buckler decked with hundreds of moons.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: भ्रामयित्वा महचर्म चामीकरविभूषितम्। तमसिं प्रेषयामास कृतवर्मरथं प्रति॥
en: Whirling that mighty sword decked with gold, Sikhandin hurled it at the chariot of Kritavarman.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: स तस्य सशरं चापं छित्त्वा राजन् महानसिः। अभ्यगाद् धरणी राजंश्च्युतं ज्योतिरिवाम्बरात्॥
en: O king, then that mighty sword, cutting off his bow with arrows placed on its string, dropped, O king, on the ground like a luminous body falling down from the skies.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु त्वरमाणं महारथाः। विव्यधुः सायकैर्गाढं कृतवर्माणमाहवे॥
en: Meanwhile many mighty car-warriors, making haste began to pierce Kritavarman deeply and quickly with their arrows.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय त्यक्त्वा तच महद् धनुः। विशीर्ण भरतश्रेष्ठ हार्दिक्याः परवीरहा॥
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, taking up a fresh bow and leaving the one cut-off, that slayer of hostile heroes, namely Hridika's son.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: विव्याध पाण्डवान् युद्धे त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः। शिखण्डिनं च विव्याध त्रिभिः पञ्चभिरेव च॥
en: Pierced the Pandavas in battle, each with three straight-flying arrows. He then pierced Sikhandin at first with three and then with five arrows.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: धनुरन्यत् समादाय शिखण्डी तु महायशाः। अवारयन् कूर्मनखैराशुगैर्हकित्मजम्॥
en: Then the highly renowned Sikhandin also, taking up another bow, covered the son of Hridika with swift-flying arrows. Furnished with heads resembling the mouth of tortoises.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे राजन् हृदिकस्यात्मसम्भवः। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन याज्ञसेनिं महारथम्॥
en: Then, O king, the son of Hridika, excited with wrath, in that battle, quickly rushed upon that mighty car-warrior that son of Yajnasena.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: भीष्मस्य समरे राजन् मृत्योर्हतुं महात्मनः। विदर्शयन् बलं शूरः शार्दूल इव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Who had been, Oking, the cause of death of the illustrious Bhima. Then the heroic Kritavarman displaying his prowess fell upon Sikhandin like a tiger falling upon an elephant.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तौ दिशां गजसंकाशौ ज्वलिताविव पावकौ। समापेततुरन्योन्यं शरसङ्घररिंदमौ॥
en: Then those to subduers of foes, resembling two elephants guarding the points of the compass and looking like two blazing fires, attacked each other with their showers of arrows.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: विधुन्वानौ धनुःश्रेष्ठे संदधानौ च सायकान्। विसृजन्तौ च शतशो गभस्तीनिव भास्वरौ॥
en: They stretched their two excellent bows and placed many arrows on their bow-strings. Like two suns shooting numerous rays, they also shot myriad arrows.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तापयन्तौ शरैस्तीक्ष्णैरन्योन्यं तौ महारथौ। युगान्तप्रतिमौ वीरौ रेजतुर्भास्कराविव॥
en: Those two mighty car-warriors afflicting one another with their sharp-arrows, appeared beautiful like two suns that rise at the end of a Yuga.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: कृतवर्मा च समरे याज्ञसेनिं महारथम्। विद्ध्वेषुभिस्त्रिसप्तस्या पुनर्विव्याघ सप्तभिः॥
en: In that battle then, Kritavarman pierced that mighty car-warrior the son of Yajanasena at first with seventy three and then again with seven arrowS.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्। विराज्य सशरं चापं मूर्च्छयाभिपरिप्लुतः॥
en: Thus deeply pierced and extremely pained, the latter squatted down on the terrace of his car; and he lost hold of his arrows and bow and was overwhelmed with a swoon.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तं विषण्णं रणे दृष्ट्वा तावकाः पुरुषर्षभ। हार्दिक्यं पूजयामासुर्वासांस्यादुधुवुश्च ह॥
en: Then your troops, O foremost of men, beholding Sikhandin cheerless in battle, began to applaud Hridika's son and they waived their garments in the air.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: शिखण्डिनं तथा ज्ञात्वा हार्दिक्यशरपीडितम्। अपोवाह रणाद् यन्ता त्वरमाणो महारथम्॥
en: Then knowing Sikhandin to be afflicted sore with the arrows of the son of Hridika, his driver, in all haste, carried that mighty carwarrior away from the field of battle.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: सादितं तु रथोपस्थे दृष्ट्वा पार्थाः शिखण्डिनम्। परिव्रवू रथैस्तूर्णं कृतवर्माणमाहवे॥
en: Beholding Sikhandin overthrown on the terrace of his car, the Parthas in that battle quickly surrounded Kritavarman with their chariots.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: तत्राद्भुतं परं चक्रे कृतवर्मा महारथः। यदेकः समरे पार्थान् वारयामास सानुगान्॥
en: Then the mighty car-warrior Kritavarman filled his enemies with wonder, in asmuch as the alone succeeded in resisting the sons of Pritha and their followers in battle.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: पार्थाञ्जित्वाजयचेदीन् पञ्चालान् सृञ्जयानपि। केकयांश्च महावीर्यान् कृतवर्मा महारथः॥
en: Conquering the Parthas, the mighty carwarrior Kritavarman vanquished the Chedis, the Panchaias, the Srinjayas and the valourous Kekayas.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: ते वध्यमानाः समरे हार्दिक्येन स्म पाण्डवाः। इतश्चेतश्च धावन्तो नैव चक्रुतिं रणे॥
en: Thus slaughtered by Hridika's son in battle, the Pandavas began to run hither and thither and they could not then fight steadily.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: जित्वा पाण्डुसुतान् युद्धे भीमसेनपुरोगमान्। हार्दिक्यः समरेऽतिष्ठद् विधूम इव पावकः॥
en: Conquering the son of Pandu viz., Bhimasena in battle, Hridika's son then remained on the field, like a blazing fire free from even a single curl of smoke.

description: The display of the prowess of Kritavarman
sn: ते द्राव्यमाणाः समरे हार्दिक्येन महारथाः। विमुखाः समपद्यन्त शरवृष्टिभिरार्दिताः॥
en: Those mighty car-warriors routed by the son of Hridika, were compelled to turn their faces leack, afflicted as they were with incessant showers of arrows.

sn: संजय उवाच शृणुष्वैकमना राजन् यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि। द्राव्यमाणे बलेतस्मिन् हार्दिक्येन महात्मना॥
en: Sanjaya said Hear, O king, with undivided attention, the reply to the questions you have asked me. When the Pandava troops had been routed by the illustrious son of Hridika.

sn: लज्जयाऽवनते चापि प्रत्दृष्टैश्चापि तावकैः। द्वीपो य आसीत् पांडूनामगाधे गधामेच्छतां॥
en: When then Parthas had been shamefully humiliated and when your troops were filled with delight, it was Satyaki that became the protector of the Pandavas solicitous of protection, for the king was then in the fathomless depth of distress.

sn: श्रुत्वा स निनदं भीमं तावकानां महाहवे। शैनेयस्त्वरितो राजन् कृतवर्माणमभ्ययात्॥
en: That hero viz., the grandson of Sini, hearing that fierce uproar of your army in that dreadful battle, quickly, O monarch, turned back and advanced against Kritavarman.

sn: उवाच सारथिं तत्र क्रोधामर्षसमन्वितः। हार्दिक्याभिमुखं सूत कुरु मे रथमुत्तमम्॥
en: He filled with rage and fury said to the charioteer 0 Suta! Proceed my excellent chariot towards Hardikya.

sn: कुरुते कदनं पश्य पाण्डुसैन्ये ह्यमर्षितः। एनं जित्वा पुनः सूत यास्यामि विजयं प्रति॥
en: Behold, he Angrily is crushing the army of Pandu. O Suta! I will come again with victory on them.

sn: एवमुक्ते तु वचने सूतस्तस्य महामते। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण कृतवर्माणमभ्ययात्॥
en: Having said these words ) intelligent one! He proceeded towards Kritavarman in a moment.

sn: कृतवर्मा तु हार्दिक्य: शैनेयं निशितैः शरैः। अवाकिरत्सुसंक्रुद्धस्ततोऽक्रुद्ध्यत्स सात्यकिः॥
en: Then Hridika's son Kritavarman inflamed with wrath, covered the grandson of Sini with clouds of whetted arrows. Thereupon Satyaki also became excited with rage.

sn: अथाशु निशितं भल्लं शैनेयः कृतवर्मणः। प्रेषयामास समरे शरांश्च चतुरोऽपरान्॥
en: arrows Thereafter the grandson of Sini quickly sped at Kritavarman a whetted bhalla and four other shafts in that battle.

sn: ते तस्य जजिरे ब्राहान् भल्लेनास्याच्छिद्धनुः। पृष्ठरक्षं तथा सूतमविध्यन्निशितैः शरैः॥
en: These slew the steeds of Kritavarman and his bow was cut-off by the bhalla. Thereafter Satyaki pierced his charioteer and the supporter of his rear, with numerous sharp arrows.

sn: ततस्तं विरथं कृत्वा सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। सेनामस्यार्दयामास शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः॥
en: Thereafter depriving Kritavarman of the use of his chariot, Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled, began to afflict his divisions with arrows of depressed knots.

sn: अभज्यताथ पृतना शैनेयशरपीडिता। ततः प्रायात्स त्वरितः सात्यकिःसत्यविक्रमः॥
en: Afflicted with the arrows shot by the grandson of Sini, the army then began to break away. Then Satyaki of unbaffled prowess proceeded with great velocity.

sn: शृणु राजन् यदकरोत् तव सैन्येषु वीर्यवान्। अतीत्य स महाराज द्रोणानीकमहार्णवम्॥
en: Hear, O king, what feats were achieved by that hero endued with great propwess, at the cost of your troops. O mighty monarch, passing through the ocean-like host of Drona.

sn: पराजित्य तु संदृष्टः कृतवर्माणमाहवे। यन्तारमब्रवीच्छूरः शनैर्याहीत्यसंभ्रमम्॥
en: And vanquishing Kritavarman in battle, that hero Satyaki filled with joy, addressed his charioteer saying “Proceed slowly without fear.”

sn: दृष्ट्वा तु तव तत् सैन्यं रथाश्वद्विपसंकुलम्। पदातिजनसंपूर्णमब्रवीत् सारर्थि पुनः॥
en: Then holding that army of yours teeming with car-warriors, horses, elephants and footsoldiers, he again addressed his charioteer sayingयदेतन्मेधसंकाशं द्रोणानीकस्य सव्यतः।

sn: सुमहत् कुञ्जरानीकं यस्य रुक्मरथो मुखम्॥
en: 'Yonder is the mighty division of elephants which you see on the left of Drona's host and which appears like a dark mass of clouds and which is headed by Rukmaratha;

sn: एते हि बहवः सूत दुर्निवाराश्च संयुगे। दुर्योधनसमादिष्टा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः॥
en: O charioteer, they number many and are irresistible in battle. They have been deputed by Duryodhana to oppose me and are ready to cast off their lives any moment,

sn: राजपुत्रा महेष्वासाः सर्वे विक्रान्तयोधिनः। त्रिगर्तानां रथोदाराः सुवर्णविकृतध्वजाः॥
en: They are mounted by princely combatants who are all great bowmen and capable of displaying great prowess in battle. Born in the Trigartta country, they are all illustrious carwarriors owning golden standards.

sn: मामेवाभिमुखा वीरा योत्स्यमाना व्यवस्थिताः। अत्र मां प्रापय क्षिप्रमश्वांश्चोदय सारथे॥
en: Those brave combatants with their faces turned towards me, are waiting for me desirous of battling with me. O charioteer drive the horses, quickly take me to that spot.

sn: त्रिगर्तेः सह योत्स्यामि भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः। ततः प्रायाच्छनैःसूतः सात्वतस्य मते स्थितः॥
en: Before the very eyes of the son of Bharadvaja, I shall fight with the Trigarttas. Then that charioteer obedient to the behests of that hero of the Satvata race, began to proceed as directed.

sn: रथेनादित्यवर्णेन भास्वरेण पताकिना। तमूहुः सारथेवश्य वल्गमाना हयोत्तमाः॥
en: The excellent steeds obedient to the reins of the charioteer, then bore Satyaki to the battle, on an effulgent chariot decked with standards and looking the solar disc.

sn: वायुवेगसमाः संख्ये कुन्देन्दुरजप्रभाः। आपतन्तं रणे तं तु शंखवणैर्हयोत्तमैः॥
en: The steeds yoked to Satyaki's car resembled the wind in fleetness and were of the effulgence of silver or the moon or the lotus. Then as Satyaki advanced in battle being borne be excellent steeds of the hue of conch-shells.

sn: परिवयुस्ततः शूरा गजीनीकेन सर्वतः। किरन्तो विधिधास्तीक्ष्णान् सायकान् लघुवेधिनः॥
en: The brave Kaurava warriors surrounded him with their elephant division, shooting sharp arrows of various kinds, all capable of penetrating through everything.

sn: सात्वतो निशितैर्बाणैर्गजानीकमयोधयत्। पर्वतानिव वर्षेण तपान्ते जलदो महान्॥
en: Satyaki of the Satvata race then fought on with that elephant division, discharging many whetted shafts; and he covered it with his arrows like clouds at the end of summer covering the mountain-breast with torrents of rain.

sn: वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शर्वध्यमानाः शरैर्गजाः। प्राद्रवन् रणमुत्सृज्य शिनिवीरसमीरितैः॥ :॥
en: Wounded with arrows resembling in touch the thunderbolt of Indra shot by the heroic grandson of Sini, those elephants began to fly away leaving the field of battle.

sn: शीर्णदन्ता विरुधिरा भिन्नमस्तकपिण्डिकाः। विशीर्णकर्णास्यकरा विनियन्तृपताकिनः॥
en: With their tusks broken, bodies drenched with blood, heads and frontal globes rent open and ears, faces and trunks cut-off and themselves deprived of their drivers and standards.

sn: संभिन्नमर्मघण्टाश्च विनिकृत्तमहाध्वजाः। हतारोहा दिशो राजन् भेजिरे भ्रष्टकंवला:॥
en: With their skin lacerated their bells broken and their mighty standards cut-off and blankets thrown off, those elephants, O king, having none to ride them, began to fly away in all directions.

sn: रुवन्तो विविधान्नदान जलदोपमनि:स्वना। नाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैश्च भल्लैरञ्जलिकैस्तथा॥
en: They uttered various yells and roars that resembled the rumble of rain clouds. With Narachas, with Vatsadants, with Vallas, with Anja-likas.

sn: क्षुरप्रैरर्धचन्दैश्च सात्वतेन विदारिताः। क्षरन्तोऽसृक् तथा मूत्रं पुरीषं च प्रदुद्रुवुः॥
en: With Kshurapras and cresscet-shaped arrows, they were then ript open by that hero of the Satvata race. Discharging urine and excreta and shedding blood copiously, they then began to fly away.

sn: बभ्रमुश्चस्खलुश्चान्ये पेतुर्मम्लुस्तथाऽपरे। एवं तत् कुञ्जरानीकं युयुधानेन पीडितम्॥
en: Some then began to roll about, some limped, some fell down and some became pale and cheerless. Thus that elephant division afflicted by Yuyudhana.

sn: शरैरग्न्यर्कसंकाशैः प्रदुद्राव समन्ततः। तस्मिन्हते गजानीके जलसन्धो महाबलः॥
en: With his arrows that resembled the sun or the fire, began to fly away in all directions. When that elephant division was being thus slaughtered, the highly powerful Jalasandha.

sn: यत्तः संप्रापयन्नागं रजताश्वरथं प्रति। रुक्मवर्मधरः शूरस्तपनीयांगदः शुचिः॥
en: With great force goaded the elephant he rode to words the car of Yuyudhana yoked with steeds of argentine hue. That hero then covered in a golden coat of mail, adorned with golden Angadas and purified.

sn: कुण्डली मुकुटी खड्गी रक्तचन्दनरूषितः। शिरसा धारयन् दीप्तां तपनीयमी स्रजम्॥
en: And graced with Kundalas and a diadem and armed with a sword and anointed with red sandal paste and wearing round his head an effulgent garland of gold.

sn: उरसा धारयन्निष्कं कण्ठसूत्रं च भास्वरम्। चापं च रुक्मविकृतं विधुन्वन् गजमूर्धनि॥
en: And bearing on his breast a Niska hanging by a lustrous chain round the neck and stretching his golden bow sitting on the back the elephants.

sn: अशोभत महाराज सविद्युदिव तोयदः। तमापतन्तं सहसा मागधस्य गजोत्तमम्॥
en: Appeared as beautiful, O mighty, monarch, as a mass of clouds surcharged with lightning. Then that elephant of the Magadha king, that king was advancing with fury.

sn: सात्यकिर्वारयामास वेलेव मकरालयम्। नागं निवारितं दृष्ट्वा शैनेयस्य शरोत्तमैः॥
en: Satyaki checked like the continent resisting the surging waves of the sea. Then beholding the career of his elephant checked by the excellent arrows shot by Sini's grandson.

sn: अक्रुद्ध्यत रणे राजन् जलसंधो महाबलः। ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज मार्गणै रसाधनैः॥ अविध्यत शिनेः पौत्रं जलसन्धो महोरसि। ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च॥
en: The highly puissant Jalasandha, O king, became greatly enraged. Then O mighty monarch excited with rage, Jalasandha pierced with tough arrows the grandson Sini on his broad breast. Thereafter with a bhalla, well whetted and tempered.

sn: अस्यतो वृष्णिवीरस्य निचकर्त शरासनम्। सात्यकि छिन्नधन्वानं प्रहसन्निव भारत॥ अविध्यन्मागधो वीरः पञ्चभिर्निशितैः शरैः। स विद्धो बहुभिबाणैर्जलसन्धेन वीर्यवान्॥
en: He cut-off the bow of that Vrishni hero (Satyaki). Then O Bharata, the heroic ruler of the Magadhas pierced with five sharp arrows, Satyaki whose bow had been burst open. Then that highly powerful Satyaki being thus pierced with numerous arrows by Jalasandha.

sn: नाकम्पत महाबाहुस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्। अचिन्तयन् वै स शरान्नात्यर्थं सम्भ्रभावली॥
en: Did not tremble in the least; that indeed appeared wonderful. Then that powerful hero thought fearlessly of the shafts he should use.

sn: धनुरन्यत् समादाय तिष्ठ तिष्ठेत्युवाच ह। एतावदुक्त्वा शैनेयो जनसन्धं महोरसि॥
en: Then taking up another bow he said-wait. Having spoken these two words only, the grandson of Sini pierced Jalasandha on his broad chest.

sn: विव्याध पष्ट्या सुभृशं शराणां प्रहसन्निव। क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन मुष्टिदेशे महद्धनुः॥ जलसंधस्य चिच्छेद विव्याध च त्रिभिः शरैः। जलसंधस्तु तत्त्यक्त्वा सशरं वै शरासनम्॥
en: arrows. With a group of sixty arrows, smiling all the while. Then with a razor-headed arrow of great sharpness, he cut-off the mighty bow of Jalasandha and then pierced him with three shafts, thereat Jalasandha casting off that severed bow and the arrows fixed on its string.

sn: तोमरं व्यसृजत्तूर्णं सात्यकिं प्रति मारिष स निर्भिद्य भुजं सव्यं माधवस्य महारणे॥
en: Quickly hurled a Tomara at Satyaki O sire. That Tomora piercing through the left arm of the illustrious Madhava in that battle.

sn: अभ्यगाद्धरणी घोरः श्वसन्निव महोरगः। निर्भिन्ने तु भुजे सव्ये सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः॥
en: Entered the earth, like a mighty and dreadful snake breathing fiercely. When his left arm had been thus pierced Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled.

sn: त्रिंशद्भिर्विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्जलसन्धमताडयत्। प्रगृह्य तु ततः खां जलसन्धो महाबलः॥
en: Wounded Jalasandha with thirty extremely sharp Thereupon the mighty Jalasandha grasped a sword.

sn: आर्षभं चर्म च महच्छतचन्द्रकसंङ्कुलम्। आविध्य च ततः खङ्गं सात्वतायोत्ससर्ज ह॥
en: And a shield made of bull's hide and decked with a hundred moons. Then whirling that sword in the air, he let it go towards the grandson of Sini.

sn: शैनेयस्य धनुश्छित्त्वा स खगोन्यपतन्मर्हाम्। अलातचक्रवश्चैव व्यरोचत महीं गतः॥
en: Cutting off the bow of Sini's grandson, that sword then fell on the ground; and lying on the surface of the earth, it then appeared beautiful like a circle of fire.

sn: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय सर्वकायावदारणम्। शालस्कन्धप्रतीकाशमिन्द्राशनिसमस्वनम्॥
en: Then taking up another bow capable of piercing all kinds of things, large as a Sala offshoot and emitting twang resembling the rumble of Indra's thunder.

sn: विस्फार्य विव्यधे क्रुद्धो जलसन्धं शरेण ह। तत: साभरणौ बाहू क्षुराभ्यां माधवोत्तमः॥
en: race

sn: सात्यकिर्जलसन्धस्य चिच्छेद प्रहसन्निव। तौ बाहू परिधप्रख्यौ पेततुर्गजसत्तमात्॥
en: Satyaki inflamed with rage, began to stretch it; and then he pierced Jalasandha with the shafts shot from that bow. Then Satyaki that illustrious descendant of Madhu's smilingly cut-off the two arms of Jalasandha, decked with various ornaments. Then those arms resembling two bludgeons were seen to fall down from the back of the elephant,

sn: वसुन्धराधरद्धष्टौ पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ। ततः सुदंष्ट्र सुमहश्चारुकुण्डलमण्डितम्॥ क्षुरेणास्य तृतीयेन शिरश्चिच्छेद सात्यकिः। तत्पातितशिरोबाहुकबन्धं भीमदर्शनम्॥
en: Like a couple of five-hooded snakes dropping down from a mountain. Then with another razor-headed arrow Satyaki lopped off his adversary head graced with beautiful teeth and with a pair of charming ear-rings. The headless and armless trunk of dreadful aspect.

sn: द्विरदं जलसन्धस्य रुधिरेणाभ्यषिञ्चत। जलसन्धं निहत्याजौ त्वरयाणस्तु सात्वतः॥
en: Then drenched Jalasandha's elephant with blood. Having slain Jalasandha in battle, he of the Satvata race speedily.

sn: विमां पातयामास गजस्कन्धाद्विशांपते। रुधिरेणावसिक्तांगो जलसन्धस्य कुञ्जरः॥
en: Brought down the wooden structure from the back of that elephant. O king, steeped in blood, that elephant of Jalasandha.

sn: विलम्बमानमवहत् संश्लिष्टं परग्रासनम्। शरादितः सात्वतेन मर्दमान: स्ववाहिनीम्॥
en: Bore that precious seat hanging down from its back. Afflicted with the shafts of the Satvata hero, the huge animal crushed the ranks of its own party.

sn: घोरमार्तस्वरं कृत्वा विदुद्राव महागजः। हाराकारो महानीसीत्तव सैन्यस्य मारिष॥
en: As it careered wildly uttering fierce yells of agony. Then, O sire, loud lamentations arose in the ranks of your soldiers.

sn: जलसन्धं हतं दृष्ट्वा वृष्णीनामृषभेण तु। विमुखाश्चाभ्यधावन्त तव योधाः समन्ततः॥
en: At the sight of Jalasandha slain by that foremost pf the Vrishnis. Your troops then turning away their faces began to fly away in all directions.

sn: पलायनकृतोत्साहा निरुत्साहा द्विषजये। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजन् द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: But hopeless of obtaining victory over the foe they immediately after resolved to fight to the bitter end. Meanwhile, Drona that foremost of all wielders of bow,

sn: अभ्यायञ्जवनैरश्चैर्युयुधानं महारथम्। तमुदीर्णं तथा दृष्ट्वा शैनेयं नरपुङ्गवाः॥
en: Approached the mighty car-warrior Yuyudhana, born by his flect steeds. Many best warriors of the Kuru host, then beholding the grandson of Sini inspired (with pride and fury).

sn: द्रोणेनैव सह क्रुद्धाः सात्यकिं समुपाद्रवन्। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरुणां सात्वतस्य च। द्रोणस्य च रणे राजन् घोरं देवासुरोपमम्॥
en: Rushed at him in rage, accompanied by Drona himself. Then, O king, there ensued a fight between the Kurus headed by Drona on one side and Yuyudhana on the other, that resembled the dreadful battle that was fought in days gone by, between the Gods and the Asuras.

sn: संजय उवाच ते किरन्तः शरवातान् सर्वे यत्ताः प्रहारिणः। त्वरमाणा महाराज युयुधानमयोधयन्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O mighty monarch, all those warriors accomplished in smiting down the foe and united together, began to fight with Yuyudhana quickly discharging numerous arrows.

sn: तं द्रोणः सप्त सप्तत्या जघान निशितैः शरैः। दुर्मर्षणो द्वादशभिर्दुःसहो दशभिः शरैः॥
en: Then Drona pierced Satyaki with seven and seventy shafts of great sharpness; Durmursana pierced him with twelve and Dussaha with ten shafts.

sn: विकर्णश्चापि निशितैस्त्रिंशद्भिः कङ्कपत्रिभिः। विव्याध सव्ये पार्श्वे तु स्तनाभ्यामन्तरे तथा॥
en: Vikarna pierced Satyaki with thirty whetted shafts furnished with wings of Kanka feather, on his lift side and on the centre of his chest.

sn: दुर्मुखो दशभिर्बाणैस्तथा दुःशासनोऽष्टभिः। चित्रसेनश्च शैनेय द्वाभ्यां विव्याध मारिष॥
en: o sire, Durmukha then pierced Sini's grandson with ten shafts, Dushasana pierced him with eight and Chitrasena with a couple of arrows.

sn: दुर्योधनश्च महता शरवर्षेण माधवम्। अपीडयद्रणे राजशूराश्चान्ये महारथाः॥
en: Then with a mighty shower of arrows Duryodhana, O king, afflicted that mighty carwarrior the descendant of Madhu's race. O king, other heroic warriors followed his example.

sn: सर्वतः प्रतिविद्धस्तु तव पुत्रैर्महारथैः। तान् प्रत्यविध्यद्वाष्णैयः पृथक् पृथगजिह्मगैः॥
en: Thus opposed on all sides by your sons, all mighty car-warriors, he of the Vrishni race began to pierce them all in return with distinct groups of straight-going shafts.

sn: भारद्वाजं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्दुःसहं नवभिः शरैः। विकर्णे पञ्चविंशत्या चित्रसेनं च सप्तभिः॥
en: Satyaki pierced the son of Bharadvaja with three arrows, Dussaha with nine, Vikarna with twenty-five, Chitrasena with seven.

sn: दुर्मर्षणं द्वादशभिरष्टाभिश्च विविंशातेम। सत्यव्रतं च नवभिर्विजयं दशभिः शरैः॥
en: Durmarsena with twelve, Vivinsati with eight, Satyavrata with nine and Vijaya with ten shafts.

sn: ततो रुक्मांगदं चारं विधुन्वानो महारथः। अभ्ययात् सात्यकिस्तूर्णं पुत्रं तव महारथम्॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior Satyaki, having pierced Rukmangada, stretching his bow quickly assailed your son Duryodhana who also was a mighty car-warrior.

sn: राजानं सर्वलोकस्य सर्वलोकमहारथम्। शरैरभ्याहनगढं ततो युद्धमभूत्तयोः॥
en: Then with his arrows Satyaki deeply pierced the king of all creatures who is regarded as he best car-warrior in all the worlds. Thereupon a battle commenced between them.

sn: विमुञ्चन्तौ शरांस्तीक्ष्णान् संदधानौ च सायकान्। अदृश्यं समरेऽन्योन्यं चक्रतुस्तौ महारथौ॥
en: Then those two mighty car-warriors discharging sharp arrows and placing other arrows on the bow-string, rendered each other invisible in battle.

sn: सात्यकिः कुरुराजने निर्विद्धो बह्वशोभत। अस्रवदुधिरं भूरि स्वरसं चन्दनो यथा॥
en: Satyaki then pierced sore by the king of the Kurus, appeared highly beautiful. He shed blood copiously like a sandal tree discharging its sap.

sn: सात्वतेन च बाणौधैर्निर्विद्धस्तनयस्तव। शातकुंभमयापीडो बभौ यूप इवोच्छ्रितः॥
en: r'ierced with myriads of shafts by him of the Satvata race, your son appeared beautiful like a golden stake set up at a sacrifice.

sn: माधवस्तु रणे राजन् कुरुराजस्य धन्विनः। धनुश्चिच्छेद समरे क्षुरप्रेण हसन्निव॥
en: Thereafter, Oking, that descendant of Madhu's race, with a razor-headed shaft, cutoff in battle the bow of the Kuru king that best wielder of the bow, smiling all the while.

sn: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं शरैर्बहुभिराचिनोत्। निर्भिन्नश्च शरैस्तेन द्विषता क्षिप्रकारिणा॥
en: Then he pierced the king whose bow had been severed, with numerous shafts. Thereat mangled with the arrows of his light-handed enemy.

sn: नामृष्यत रणे राजा शत्रोविजयलक्षणम्। अथान्यद्धनुरादाय हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम्॥-
en: m In that battle, he could not bear this sign of the success of his enemy. Then taking up another bow of great toughness and golden staff.

sn: विव्याध सात्यकिं तूर्णे सायकानां शतेन ह। सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता तव पुत्रेण धन्विना॥
en: He pierced Satyaki quickly with a group of hundred arrows. Pierced deeply by that great bowman endued with might, viz., your son, Satyaki.

sn: अमर्षवशमापन्नस्तव पुत्रमपीडयत्। पीडितं नृपतिं दृष्ट्वा तव पुत्रा महारथाः॥
en: Under the influence of wrath began to afflict your son severely. Beholding the king thus afflicted, your other sons all mighty carwarriors.

sn: सात्यकि शरवर्षेण छादयामासुरोजसा। स च्छाद्यमानो बहुभिस्तव पुत्रैर्महारथैः॥
en: Covered Satyaki with a shower of mighty arrows. Thus covered by your sons, all mighty car-warriors.

sn: एकैकं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः। दुर्योधनं च त्वरितो विव्याधाष्टभिराशुगैः॥
en: Satyaki piercing each with five arrows, again pierced each with seven shafts. He then quickly pierced Duryodhana with eight swiftcoursing arrows.

sn: प्रहसंश्चास्य चिच्छेद कार्मुकं रिपुभीषणम्। नागं मणिमयं चैव शरैर्ध्वजमपातयत्॥
en: Then smiling he cut-off Duryodhana's bow that used to inspire terror into the hearts of the enemy. Then with his arrows, he cut down the latter's standard and the elephant of pearls embossed thereon.

sn: हत्वा तु चतुरो वाहांश्चतुर्भिनिशितैः शरैः। सारथिं पातयामास क्षुरप्रेण महायशाः॥
en: Then slaying with four sharp arrows the four horses of Duryodhana, that illusirious warrior felled the charioteer of the latter with a razor-headed arrow.

sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चैव कुरुराजं महारथम्। अवाकिरच्छरैर्हष्टो बहुभिर्मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: After this, filled with delight he began to cover the king of the Kurus, that mighty carwarrior, with numerous arrows, all capable of penetrating to the very vitals.

sn: स वध्यमानः समरे शैनेयस्य शरोत्तमैः। प्राद्रवत् सहसा राजन् पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव॥
en: Thus pierced by the excellent shafts of the grandson of Sini, Oking, your son Duryodhana suddenly fled away from the field of battle.

sn: आप्लुतश्च ततो यानं चित्रसेनस्य धन्विनः। हाहाभूतं जगश्चासीद् दृष्ट्वा राजानमाहवे॥
en: He then ascended the car of Chitrasena that great bowman. Then cries of Alas and Oh were uttered by your troops as they beheld the king in that battle.

sn: ग्रस्यमानं सात्यकिना खे सोममिव राहुणा। तं तु शब्दमथ श्रुत्वा कृतवर्मा महारथः॥
en: Devoured by Satyaki, like Soma in the skies devoured by Rahu. Then hearing that woeful exclamation, the mighty car-warrior Kritavarman.

sn: अभ्ययात् सहसा तत्र यत्रास्ते माधवः प्रभुः। विधुन्वानो धनुः श्रेष्ठं चोदयंश्चैव वाजिनः॥
en: Quickly proceeded to the spot where that mighty-descendant of Madhu's race, was fighting. He came stretching his bow and urging his steeds.

sn: भर्त्सयन् सारथिं चाग्रे याहि याहीति सत्वरं। तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम्॥
en: And encouraging his charioteer with the words. Proceed in haste, Proceed in haste. Beholding him come like the Destroyer himself with mouth wide open.

sn: युयुधानो महाराज यन्तारमिदमब्रवीत्। कृतवर्मा रथेनैष द्रुतमापतते शरी॥
en: O mighty Monarch, Yuyudhana addressed his charioteer saying-Yonder is the heroic Kritavarman rushing at me on his chariot.

sn: प्रत्युद्याहि रथेनैनं प्रवरं सर्वधन्विनाम्। ततः प्रजविताश्वेन विधिवत् कल्पितेन च॥
en: Encounter this foremost all wielder of bow and drive your car before him.” Then urging to the top of their speed those horses duly equipped.

sn: आससाद रणे भोज प्रतिमानं धनुष्मताम्। ततः परमसंक्रुद्धौ ज्वलिताविव पावकौ॥
en: The charioteer drove the car towards the king of the Bhojas held in high honor by all bowmen. Then highly excited and looking like two blazing fires.

sn: समेयातां नरव्याघ्रौ व्याघ्राविव तरस्विनौ। कृतवर्मा तु शैनेयं षड्विशत्या समार्पमत्॥
en: Those two foremost of men encountered one another like two tigers endued with great agility. Then Kritavarman wounded the grandson of Sini with twenty-six.

sn: निशितैः सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्यन्तारं चास्य पञ्चभिः। चतुरश्चतुरो वाहांश्चतुर्भिः परमेषुभिः॥ अविध्यत् साधुदान्तान् वै सैन्धवान् सात्वतस्य हि। रुक्मध्वजो रुक्मपृष्ठं महद् विस्फार्य कार्मुकम्॥
en: Sharp arrows all well-whetted; and his charioteer with five shafts. With four excellent shafts he pierced the four steeds of the Satvata hero, steeds whose teeth were graceful and that were of the Sindhu breed. Then stretching his mighty-bow of golden back, that one of golden standards.

sn: रुक्माङ्गदी रुक्मवर्मा रुक्मपुङ्खरवारयत्। ततोऽशीतिं शिनेः पौत्रः सायकान् कृतवर्मणे॥ प्राहिणोत् त्वरया युक्तो द्रष्टकामो धनंजयम्। सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुतापनः॥
en: Decked with golden Angadas and clad in a golden mail, covered Satyaki with arrow of golden wings. Thereafter the grandson of Sini quickly sped numerous shafts at Kritavarman, as he was longing to have a sight of Dhananjaya. Pierced deeply by his powerful adversary, that scorcher of foes.

sn: समकम्पत दुर्घर्षः क्षितिकम्पे यथाचलः। त्रिषष्ट्या चतुरोऽस्याश्वान् सप्तभिः सारथिं तथा॥ विव्याध निशितैस्तूर्णं सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। सुवर्णपुङ्ख विशिखं समाधाय च सात्यकिः॥
en: Began to tremble like a mountain during an earth-quake. Then Stayaki of prowess incapable of being baffled quickly pierced his four steeds with sixty-three and his charioteer with seven sharp arrows. Then Satyaki placed on his bow string a shaft furnished with golden wings.

sn: व्यसृजत् तं महाज्वालं संक्रुद्धमिव पन्नगम्। सोऽविध्यत् कृतवर्माणं यमदण्डोपमः शरः॥
en: That emitted great effulgence and looked like an enraged snake; that arrow that resembled the the dart of Death, wounded Kritavarman sorely.

sn: जाम्बूनदविचित्रं च वर्म निर्भिद्य भानुमत्। अभ्यगाद धरणीमुनो रुधिरेण समुक्षितः॥
en: Then that fierce arrow, penetrating through the effulgent and gold-decked armour of Kritavarman, fell down on the ground, steeped completely in blood.

sn: संजातरुधिरश्चाजौ सात्वतेषुभिरर्दितः। सशरं धनुरुत्सृज्य न्यपतत् स्यन्दनोत्तमात्॥
en: Covered all over with blood and afflicted with the arrows of the of the Satvata hero, Kritavarman, throwing aside his bow and arrow, feil upon his niche on the chariot.

sn: स सिंहदंष्ट्रो जानुभ्यां पतितोऽमितविक्रमः। शरादितः सात्यकिना रथोपस्थे नरर्षभः॥
en: That one of infinite prowess and of teeth resembling those of the lion, that foremost of men, then fell on his knees on the terrace of his car, being afflicted by arrows of Satyaki.

sn: सहस्रबाहुसदृशमक्षोभ्यमिव सागरम्। निवार्य कृतवर्माणं सात्यकिः प्रययौ ततः॥
en: Thereafter Satyaki having successfully checked Kritavarman who reseinbled the thousand-armed Arjuna or the unagitable ocean itself, quickly advanced onwards.

sn: खङ्गशक्तिधनुःकीर्णो गजाश्वरथसंकुलाम्। प्रवर्तितोग्ररुधिरां शतशः क्षत्रियर्षभैः॥ प्रेक्षतां सर्वसैन्यानां मध्येन शिनिपुङ्गवः। अभ्यगाद्वाहिनीं हित्वावृत्रहेवासुरींचमूम्॥
en: Then passing through the division of Kritavarman, bristling with swords, lances and javelins and teeming with elephants, steeds and cars and shedding blood copiously, before the very eyes of all the troops that foremost of the descendants of Sini moved forwards like the slayer of Vritra passing through the Asura host.

sn: समाश्वस्य च हार्दिक्यो गृह्य चान्यन्महद् धनुः। तस्थौ स तत्र बलवान् वारयन् युधि पाण्डवान्॥
en: Meanwhile the son of Hridika regaining his composure and grasping another mighty bow, stood on the field of battle checking the mighty Pandava hosts. cars and shedding blood copiously, before the very eyes of all the troops that foremost of the descendants of Sini moved forwards like the slayer of Vritra passing through the Asura host.

sn: समाश्वस्य च हार्दिक्यो गृह्य चान्यन्महद् धनुः। तस्थौ स तत्र बलवान् वारयन् युधि पाण्डवान्॥
en: Meanwhile the son of Hridika regaining his composure and grasping another mighty bow, stood on the field of battle checking the mighty Pandava hosts.

sn: संजय उवाच काल्यमानेषु सैन्येषु शैनेयेन ततस्ततः। भारद्वाजः शरवातैर्महद्भिः समवाकिरत्॥
en: Sanjaya said When the troops on those parts of the field through which Sini's grandson had passed were compelled by him to tremble, the son of Bharadvaja covered him with a mighty shower of arrows.

sn: स सम्प्रहारस्तुमुलो द्रोणसात्वतयोरभूत्। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां बलिवासवयोरिव॥
en: Then a fierce fight commenced between Drona and him of the Satvata race, before the very eyes of all the troops-fight that resembled that between Bali and Vasava fought in the day's of yore.

sn: ततो द्रोण: पौत्रं चित्रैः सर्वायसैः शरैः। त्रिभिराशीविपाकरैर्ललाटे समविध्यत॥
en: Then Drona pierced Sini's grandson on the forehead with three beautiful shafts wholly made or iron and looking like so many snakes of virulent poison.

sn: तैर्ललाटार्पितैर्वाणैर्युयुधानस्त्वजिह्मगैः। व्यरोचत महाराज त्रिशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः॥
en: O mighty monarch, with those straightgoing shafts struck the forehead, Yuyudhana appeared beautiful like a mountain with three peaks. on

sn: ततोऽस्य बाणानपरानिन्द्राशनिसमस्वनान्। भारद्वाजोऽन्तरप्रेक्षी प्रेषयामास संयुगे॥
en: Then Bharadvaja's son, ever on the watch for an opportunity for defeating his focs, once more sped at Satyaki shafts whose whizz resembled the rumble of Indra's thunder.

sn: तान् द्रोणचापनिर्मुक्तान् दाशार्हः पतत: शरान्। द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां सुषुङ्खाभ्यां चिच्छेद परमास्त्रवित्॥
en: Then he of the Dasarha race conversant with many excellent weapons, cut-off those shafts shot from Drona's bow and coming towards hiin, each with a couple of arrows equipped with excellent wings.

sn: तामस्य लघुतां द्रोण: समवेक्ष्य विशाम्पते। प्रहस्य सहसाविध्यत् त्रिंशता शिनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, Drona beholding his light-handedness, smiled and then pierced that foremost of Sini's descendant with thirty sharp arrows.

sn: पुनः पञ्चाशतेषूणां शितेन च समापयत्। लघुतां युयुधानस्य लाघवेन विशेषयन्॥
en: Then once more he pierced him with fifty and hundred shafts successively, thus surpassing with his own lightness of hands the lightness displayed by Yuyudhana.

sn: समुन्पतन्ति वल्मीकाद् यथाक्रुद्धा महोरगाः। तथा द्रोणरथाद् राजन्नापतन्ति तनुच्छिदः॥
en: Just as, O king, mighty snakes excited to fury, plunge off from the ant-hills, so from the car of Drona numerous shafts were seen to fly.

sn: तथैव युयुधानेन सृष्टाः शतसहस्रशः। अवाकिरन् द्रोणरथं शरा रुधिरभोजनाः॥
en: Similarly hundreds and thousands of shafts all capable of drinking blood, covered the car of Drona being discharged by Yuyudhana.

sn: लाघवाद् द्विजमुख्यस्य सात्वतस्य च मारिष। विशेषं माध्यगच्छाम समावास्तां नरर्षभौ॥
en: O sire, we were then not able to detect which of the two, that foremost of the Brahmanas or he of the Satvata race, excelled the other in lightness of hands; but both of those best of men appeared to be equal.

sn: सात्यकिस्तु ततो द्रोणं नवभिनतपर्वभिः। आजघान भृशं क्रुद्धो ध्वजं च निशितैःशरैः॥
