sn: चण्डवातविभिन्नानां समुद्राणामिव खनः। रणेऽभवद् बलौघानामन्योन्यमभिधावताम्॥
en: Then Bhimasena, Dhrishtadyumna, Nakula, Sahadeva, the virtuous king Yudhishthira, O sire, exclaimed sayingपार्थिवानां समेतानां बहून्यासन् नरोत्तम।

sn: तबले पाण्डवानां च सहस्त्राणि शतानि च॥
en: "Come, strike, rush quickly; the two heroes, scion of Madhu's race and the son of Pandu, have entered into the Kuru army.

sn: संरब्धानां प्रवीराणां समरे दृढकर्मणाम्। तत्रासीत् सुमहाशब्दस्तुमुलो लोमहर्षणः॥
en: Do you so act, as they may proceed easily towards the chariot of Jayadratha. Speaking thus, they urged their troops on.

sn: अथाक्रन्दद् भीमसेनो धृष्टद्युम्नश्च मारिष। नकुलः सहदेवश्च धर्मराजश्च पाण्डवः॥ आगच्छत प्रहरत दुतं विपरिधावत। प्रविष्टावरिसेनां हि वीरौ माधवपाण्डवौ॥
en: (They again said)-"If those two heroes be slain, then the Kurus will have their objects fulfilled and we shall be defeated. Therefore do you united exert yourselves for agitating this host, like the tempest of tremendous vehemence agitating the ocean. O king, urged on by the Panchala prince and by Bhimasena.

sn: यथा सुखेन गच्छेतां जयद्रथ वधं प्रति। तथा प्रकुरुत क्षिप्रमिति सैन्यान्यचोदयन्॥ तयोरभावे कुरवः कृतार्थाः स्युर्वयं जिताः। ते यूयं सहिता भूत्वा तूर्णमेव बलार्णवम्॥ क्षोभयध्वं महावेगा: पवनः सागरं यथा।
en: They fell to slaughter the Kurus thoroughly disregarding their own dear lives. Possessed of i great energy, all of them desiring death in

sn: प्रियान्।
en: battle, at the edge of weapon, with a view to attain to heaven, showed not the least regard for their lives in fighting for the good of their friends, so also, O monarch, your warriors, desirous of great renown.

sn: भीमसेनेन ते राजन् पाञ्चाल्येन च नोदिताः॥ आजघ्नुः कौरवान् संख्ये त्यक्त्वासूनात्मनः
en: And setting their hearts resolutely on battle, remained on the field, determined to to fight to the bitter end. In that dreadful and horible battle.

sn: तस्मिन् सुतुमले युद्धे वर्तमाने भयावहे॥ जित्वा सर्वाणि सैन्यानि प्रायात् सात्यकिरर्जुनम्। कवचानां प्रभास्ता सूर्यरश्मिविराजिताः॥ दृष्टीः संख्ये सैनिकानां प्रतिजघ्नुः समन्ततः। तथा प्रयतमानानां पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥ दुर्योधनो महाराज व्यगाहत महद् वलम्। स संनिपातस्तुमुलस्तेषां तस्य च भारत॥ अभवत् सर्वभूतानामभावकरणो महान्।
en: Satyaki having vanquished all the warriors advanded towards Arjuna. The combatants were compelled to turn their eyes away from the coats of mails covering the warriors, as the reflected the rays of the sun directly. O monarch, Duryodhana then penetrated through the mighty host of the illustrious sons of Pandu striving hard in battle. Then the battle that was there fought between him and them was extremely terrible and the carnage horrible.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथा यातेषु सैन्येषु तथा कृच्छ्रगत: स्वयम्॥ कचिद् दुर्योधनः सूत नाकार्षीत् पृष्ठतो रणम्।
en: Dhritarastra said When the Pandava host was thus advancing and when he was involved in great danger, I hope, O son of a charioteer, Duryodhana did not turn his back on the field of battle.

sn: एकस्य च बहूनां च संनिपातो महाहवे॥ विशेषतो नरपतेर्विषमः प्रतिभाति मे।
en: That battle between the one and the many, that one again being a king by birth, seems to me to be very unfair.

sn: सोऽत्यन्तसुखसंवृद्धो लक्षम्या लोकस्य चेश्वरः॥ एकोबहून् समासाद्य कचिन्नासीत् पराङ्मुखः।
en: Brought up in great luxury, attended with great prosperity and the ruler of the worlds, that single-handed son of mine, I hope, did not turn his face away from the field of battle, encountering odds in battle.

sn: संजय उवाच राजन् संग्राममाश्चर्य तव पुत्रस्य भारत॥ एकस्य बहुभिः सार्ध शृणुष्व गदतो मम।
en: Sanjaya said The battle, O king, that was then fought, between your son on the one side and the numerous Pandavas on the other, was indeed wonderful. Hear me as I relate it.

sn: दुर्योधनेन समरे पृतना पाण्डवी रणे॥ नलिनी द्विरदेनेव समन्तात् प्रतिलोडिता।
en: Then the Pandava troops were completely crushed by Duryodhana like a forest of lotuses destroyed by an elephant.

sn: ततस्तां प्रहितां सेनां दृष्ट्वा पुत्रेण ते नृप॥ भीमसेनपुरोगास्तं पञ्चालाः समुपाद्रवन्।
en: Then, o king, beholding the troops shattered by your son, the Panchalas headed by Bhimasena, rushed upon Duryodhana.

sn: स भीमसेनं दशभिः शरैर्विव्याध पाण्डवम्॥ त्रिभिस्त्रिभिर्यमौ वीरौ धर्मराजं च सप्तभिः।
en: Thereupon your son pierced Bhimasena, the son of Pandu, with ten shafts and each of the twins Nakula and Sahadeva with three and the virtuous king Yudhishthira with seven.

sn: विराटद्रुपदौ षड्भिः शतेन च शिखण्डिनम्॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं च विंशत्या द्रौपदेयांस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः।
en: He pierced Virata and Drupada with six, Sikhadin with a hundred, Dhristadyumna with twenty and the sons of Draupadi with three arrows each.

sn: शतशश्चापरान् योधान् सद्विपांश्च रथान् रणे॥ शरैरवचकर्ताग्रैः क्रुद्धोऽन्तक इव प्रजाः।
en: He then cut-off many other warriors hundreds in number and elephants and cars in

sn: समरे जनाः।
en: battle with his fierce shafts, like the wrathful god of Death slaying the created beings.

sn: न संदधन् विमुञ्चन् वा मण्डलीकृतकार्मुकः॥३ :॥ अदृश्यत रिपून निघ्नञ्छिक्षयास्त्रबलेन च।
en: Owing to his skill acquired through practies and to the powers of his weapons, he appeared, when striking down his foes, to wield his bow, continuously drawn to a circle whether when aiming or discharging his shafts.

sn: तस्य तान् निघ्नतः शत्रून् हेमपृष्ठं महद्धनुः॥ अजस्रं मण्डलीभूतं ददृशुः
en: Then men beheld his mighty bow of golden staff, as he slew his foes, to be always drawn to a circle.

sn: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भल्लाभ्यामच्छिनद् धनुः॥ तव पुत्रस्य कौरव्य यतमानस्य संयुगे।
en: Thereafter king Yudhishthira cut-off with a Pair of Vallas the bow of your son, who had been exerting to the best of his prowess in battle, O foremost of the Kurus.

sn: विव्याध चैनं दशभिः सम्यगस्तैः शरोत्तमैः॥ वर्म चाशु समासाद्य ते भित्त्वा क्षितिमाविशन्।
en: He then pierced the latter with ten excellent shafts all well-directed. But striking against Duryodhana's armour they were shattered into pierces and fell down on the earth.

sn: ततः प्रमुदिताः पार्थाः परिवर्युधिष्ठिरम्॥ यथा वृत्रवधे देवाः पुरा शक्र महर्षयः।
en: Then the Parthas filled with delight surrounded Yudhishthira, like the celestials and the sages surrounding Shakra on the occasion of the slaughter of Vritra.

sn: ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय तव पुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति राजानं ब्रुवन् पाण्डवमभ्ययात्।
en: Thereafter your highly puissant Duryodhana taking up another bow and addressing king Yudhishthira saying "wait wait" rushed against that son of Pandu.

sn: तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य तव पुत्रं महामृधे॥ प्रत्युद्ययुः समुदिताः पञ्चाला जयगृद्धिनः।
en: Then beholding your son rush to battle with fury, the Panchalas always intent on securing victory received him with delight. son

sn: तान् द्रोणः प्रतिजाग्राह परीप्सन् युधि पाण्डवम्॥ चण्डवातोद्भुतान् मेघान् गिरिरम्बुमुचो यथा।
en: Drona then encountered that division of the Panchalas, from a desire for rescuring the king, like a mountain with slanting masses of raincharged clouds driven by the tempest.

sn: तत्र राजन् महानासीत् संग्रामो लोमहर्षणः॥ पाण्डवानां महाबाहो तावकानां च संयुगे।
en: Thereupon, O king, there commenced a awful combat making the hair stand erect between the Pandavas and your troops, O mighty-armed one.

sn: रुद्रस्याक्रीडसदृशः संहारः सर्वदेहिनाम्॥ ततः शब्दो महानासीत् पुनर्येन धनंजयः।
en: The carnage was terrible like that when Rudra slays in sport all creatures at the end of a Yuga. Then arose a loud uproar the place where Dhananjaya was.

sn: अतीव सर्वशब्देभ्यो लोमहर्षकरः प्रभो॥ अर्जुनस्य महाबाहो तावकानां च धन्विनाम्।
en: That sound surpassed all other sounds and O lord, made the hair stand erect. Thus, O mighty-armed one, the battle between Arjuna and your warriors went on (with unmitigated fury).

sn: मध्ये भारतसैन्यस्य माधवस्य महारणे॥ द्रोणस्यापि परैः सार्ध व्यूहद्वारे महारणे।
en: Thus progressed the battle between Satyaki and your men, in the centre of your army and there also raged the battle between Drona and his enemies at the head of his array.

sn: एवमेष क्षयो वृत्तः पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपते। क्रुद्धेऽर्जुने तथा द्रोणे सात्वते च महारथे॥
en: Thus continued that dreadful destruction of creatures when, O ruler of men, Arjuna, Drona and the mighty car-warrior Satyaki were excited with wrath.

sn: संजय उवाच अपराह्ने महाराज संग्रामः सुमहानभूत्। पर्जन्यसमनिर्घोषः पुनद्रोणस्य सोमकैः॥
en: Sanjaya said On the afternoon, O mighty monarch, a terrible battle was fought between Drona and the Somakas, battle whose din resembled the rumble of the rain cloud Parjannya itself.

sn: शोणाश्वं रथमास्थाय नरवीरः समाहितः। समरेऽभ्यद्रवत् पाण्डूञ्जवमास्थाय मध्यमम्॥
en: That best of heroes among men, mounted on his chariot to which were yoked red steeds, viz., Drona then assailed the Pandavas, firmly resolved to fight with them.

sn: तव प्रियहिते युक्तो महेष्वासो महाबलः। चित्रपुङ्खः शितैर्बाणैः कलशोत्तमसम्भवः॥ वरान् वरान् हि योधानां विचिन्वन्निव भारत। आक्रीडत रणे राजन् भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्॥
en: That fierce bowman, endued with great might and energy, that hero ever engaged in doing good to yourself, that one born in an excellent jar, that puissant son of Bharadvaja, slaying, O king, many best of heroes among the enemy, appeared O Bharata, to sport on the field of battle.

sn: तमभ्ययाद् बृहत्क्षत्रः केकयानां महारथः। भ्रातृणां नृप पञ्चानां श्रेष्ठः समरकर्कशः॥
en: Him encountered Vrihadkshatra that mighty car-warrior among the Kekayas, the eldest of his five brothers and difficult of being resisted in battle.

sn: विमुञ्चन् विशिखांस्तीक्ष्णानाचार्ये भृशमार्दयत्। महामेघो यथा वर्ष विमुञ्चन् गन्धमादने॥
en: Discharging sharp arrows incessantly, he afflicted the preceptor sorely, like a mighty cloud afflicting the mountain Gandhamadana by pouring its watery contents on it.

sn: तस्य द्रोणो महाराज स्वर्णपुवाञ्छिलाशितान्। प्रेषयामास संकुद्धः सायकान् दश पञ्च च॥
en: At hin, O mighty monarch, excited with wrath Drona sped ten and five shafts, all whetted on stone and furnished with wings of gold.

sn: तांस्तु द्रोणविनिर्मुक्तान् क्रुद्धाशीविषसंनिभान्। एकैकं पञ्चभिर्बाणैयुद्धि चिच्छेद हृष्टवत्॥
en: Then Vrihadkshatra cheerful cut-off each of those arrows shot by Drona and looking like so many enraged snakes of virulent poison, with five shafts of his own.

sn: तदस्य लाघवं दृष्ट्वा प्रहस्य द्विजपुङ्गवः। प्रेषयामास विशिखानष्टौ संनतपर्वणः॥
en: Then seeing his lightness of hands, that foremost of the regenerate ones smiled and once more, sped at him eight shafts of depressed knots.

sn: तान् दृष्ट्वापततस्तूर्ण द्रोणचापच्युताशरान्। अवारयच्छरैरेव तावद्भिर्निशितैर्मधे॥
en: Beholding those shafts shot from Drona's bow coursing swiftly towards himself, Vrihadkshatra baffled them in battle with an equal number of sharp arrows shot by himself.

sn: ततोऽभवन्महाराज तव सैन्यस्य विस्मयः। कर्म कृतं दृष्ट्वा सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Then your troops, O mighty monarch were filled with surprise, beholding Vrihadkshatra achieve that very difficult feat.

sn: ततो द्रोणे महाराज बृहत्क्षत्रं विशेषयन्। प्रादुश्चक्रे रणे दिव्यं ब्राह्ममस्रं सुदुर्जयम्॥
en: Thereupon, O king, applauding Vrihadkshatra, Drona invoked into existence the invincible Brahma-weapon of celestial make.

sn: कैकेयोऽस्रं समालोक्य मुक्तं द्रोणेन संयुगे। ब्रह्मास्त्रेणैव राजेन्द्र ब्राह्ममस्रमशातयत्॥
en: Beholding that weapon discharged by Drona in battle, the Kekaya prince, O foremost of kings, cut down that weapon with his own Brahma weapon.

sn: बृहत्क्षत्रेण तत् ततोऽस्रे निहते ब्राह्मे बृहत्क्षवस्तु भारत। विव्याध ब्राह्मणं षष्ट्या स्वर्णपुजैः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Then O Bharata, when the Brahma weapon had been baffled, Vrihadkshatra pierced the Brahmana with sixty shafts, whetted on stones and furnished with wings of gold.

sn: तं द्रोणो द्विपदां श्रेष्ठो नाराचेन समार्पयत्। स तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा प्राविशद् धरणीतलम्॥
en: Then that foremost of men Drona directed several Nacharas at him; these Naracharas penetrating through his armour entered the earth.

sn: कृष्णसर्पो यथा मुक्तो वल्मीकं नृपसत्तम। तथात्यगान्महीं बाणो भित्त्वा कैकेयमाहवे॥
en: Like, O best of kings, black snakes freed from their sloughs, entering into their holes in anthills, those arrows penetrating through the Kekaya prince entered the earth.

sn: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज कैकेयो द्रोणसायकैः। क्रोधेन महताऽऽविष्टो व्यावृत्य नयने शुभे॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, deeply pierced with the arrows of Drona, the Kaikaya prince excited to the highest pitch of fury began to roll his charming eyes.

sn: द्रोणं विव्याध सप्तत्या स्वर्णपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः। सारथिं चास्य बाणेन भृशं मर्मस्वताडयत्॥
en: He then pierced Drona with seventy shafts whetted on stone and furnished with golden wings; he pierced the latter's charioteer in his vital parts with (fierce) darts.

sn: द्रोणस्तु बहुभिर्विद्धो बृहत्क्षत्रेण मारिष। असृजद् विशिखांस्तीक्ष्णान् कैकेयस्य रथं प्रति॥
en: O sire, Drona then pierced with numerous arrows by the Kekaya prince Vrihatkshatra, sped at his car many arrows of extreme sharpness.

sn: व्याकुलीकृत्य तं द्रोणो बृहत्क्षत्रं महारथम्। अश्वांश्चतुर्भिर्व्यवधीच्चतुरोऽस्य पतत्रिभिः॥
en: Then confounding that mighty car-warrior Vrihatkshatra, Drona slew his four steeds with four winged shafts.

sn: सूतं चैकेन बाणेन रथनीडादपातयत्। द्वाभ्यां ध्वजं च च्छत्रं च च्छित्वा भूमावपातयत्॥
en: He then felled the former's charioteer from his niche of the car, with a single arrow. Cutting off his standard and umbrella with another two arrows, he felled them on the ground.

sn: ततः साधुविसृष्टेन नाराचेन द्विजर्षभः। हृद्यविध्यद् बृहत्क्षत्रं स च्छिन्नहृदयोऽपतत्॥
en: Then that foremost among the regenerate ones, with a well directed Naracha pierced Vrihatkshatra on his breast, where-upon the latter then fell down, with his heart torn open.

sn: बृहत्क्षत्रे हते राजन् केकयानां महारथे। शैशुपालिरभिक्रुद्धो यन्तारमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: When Brihatkshatra that mighty car-warrior was thus slain, O king the son of Sisupala highly enraged addressing his charioteer said-

sn: सारथे याहि यत्रैष द्रोणस्तिष्ठति दंशितः। विनिघ्नन् केकयान् सर्वान् पञ्चालानां च वाहिनीम्॥
en: "O charioteer, proceed to the spot where the cuirassed Drona stands, slaughtering the Kekaya, the Panchala divisions."

sn: वचनं श्रुत्वा सारथी रथिनां वरम्! द्रोणाय प्रापयामास काम्बोजैर्जवनैर्हयैः॥
en: Hearing those words of that foremost of car-warriors, the charioteer took him to the spot where Drona was, by means of his fleei steeds of Kamboja breed.

sn: धृष्टकेतुश्च चेदीनामृषभोऽतिबलोदितः। वधायाभ्यद्रवद् द्रोणं पतङ्ग इव पावकम्॥
en: Then swelling with his might, that foremost of the Chedis, viz., slaughtering him, like a fly falling upon fire.

sn: सोऽविध्यत तदा द्रोणं षष्ट्या साश्वरथध्वजम्। पुनश्चान्यैः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः सुप्तं व्याघ्रं तुदनिव॥
en: He then pierced Drona and his steeds. And once more he struck his adversary with sharp arrows, like a man rousing a sleeping tiger.

sn: तस्य द्रोणो धनुर्मध्ये क्षुरप्रेण शितेन च। चकर्त गार्धपत्रेण यतमानस्य शुष्मिणः॥ तस्य तद्
en: Then Drona, with a sharp razor-faced arrow winged with feathers of vultures. cut-off in the middle, the bow of that mighty warrior striving in battle.

sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय शैशुपालिमहारथः। विव्याध सायकैलॊणं कङ्कबहिणवाजितैः॥
en: Thereupon that son of Sisupala, that mighty car-warrior, taking up another bow pierced Drona with numerous shafts equipped with wings of the feather of the peacock and the Kanka bird.

sn: तस्य द्रोणो हयान् हत्वा चतुर्भिश्चतुरः शरैः। सारथेश्च शिरः कायाचकर्त प्रहसन्निव॥
en: Then Drona slaying with four arrows his four steeds, smilingly severed the head of his charioteer from his trunk.

sn: अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या सायकानां समार्पयत्। अवप्लुत्य रथाच्चैद्यो गदामादाय सत्वरः॥ भारद्वाजाय चिक्षेप रुषितामिव पन्नगीम्।
en: He then pierced Dhristaketu himself with twenty five arrows. The prince of the Chedis then leaping off from his chariot, grasped a mace.

sn: तामापतन्तीमालोक्य कालरात्रिमिवोद्यताम्॥ अश्मसारमयीं गुर्वी तपनीयविभूषिताम्। शरैरनेकसाहस्रर्भारद्वाजोऽच्छिनच्छितैः॥
en: And hurled it at the son of Bharadvaja like an enraged she-snake. Beholding that heavy mace endued with the strength of adamant and adorned with gold, course towards himself like the last night of a man's existence, the son of Bharadvaja cut it off with many thousands of whetted arrows.

sn: सा छिन्ना बहुभिर्बाणैर्धारद्वाजेन मारिष। गदा पपात कौरव्य नादयन्ती धरातलम्॥
en: Cut off by numerous shafts by the son of Bharadvaja that mace, O sire, fell down, ) Kaurava, filling the earth with the noise it created.

sn: गदां विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा धृष्टकेतुरसर्षणः। तोमरं व्यसृजद् वीरः शक्तिं च कनकोज्ज्वलाम्॥
en: Beholding the mace repulsed, the valiant Dhristaketu hurled at Drona first a lance and then a javelin decked with gold.

sn: तोमरं पञ्चभिर्भित्त्वा शक्तिं चिच्छेद पञ्चभिः। तौ जग्मतुर्महीं छिन्नौ सर्पाविव गरुत्पता॥
en: Drona then cutting off that lance with five shafts, cut-off the dart with another five. Then both those missiles cut-off, dropped on the ground like two snakes torn to pieces by Garuda.

sn: ततोऽस्य विशिखं तीक्ष्णं विधाय वधकाङ्क्षिणः। प्रेषयामास समरे भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Thereafter the highly puissant son of Bharadvaja shot a shaft for the destruction of Dhristaketu who was striving to slay him.

sn: स तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा हृदयं चाभितौजसः। अभ्यगाद् धरणीं बाणो हंसः पद्मवनं यथा॥
en: Penetrating through the breast plate and the breast of Dhristaketu of infinite energy, that dart entered the carth like a swan diving into a lake overgrown with lotuses.

sn: पतङ्गं हि ग्रसेचाषो यथा क्षुद्रं बुभुक्षितः। तथा द्रोणोऽग्रसच्छूरो धृष्टकेतुं महाहवे॥
en: Like a hungry jay catching and devouring a little insect, Drona of great heroism devoured Dhristaketu in that battle.

sn: निहते चेदिराजे तु तत् खण्डं पित्र्यमाविशत्। अमर्षवशमापन्नः पुत्रोऽस्य परमास्रवित्॥
en: When the Chedi ruler was thus slain, his son versed in the use of excellent weapons became excited with wrath and sought to achieve the task his after left undone.

sn: तमपि ग्रहसन् द्रोणः शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्। महाव्याघ्रो महारण्ये मृगशावं यथा बली॥
en: Him also Diona smilingly dispatched to the mansion of Death by means of his shafts, like a large and ferocious tiger slaying a young deer in the deep forest.

sn: तेषु प्रक्षीयमाणेषु पाण्डवेयेषु भारत। जरासंधसुतो वीरः स्वयं द्रोणमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: While the Pandava troops were being thus reduced in number, O Bharata, the brave son of Jarasandha rushed against, Drona.

sn: स तु द्रोणं महाबाहुः शरधाराभिराहवे। अदृश्यमकरोत् तूर्ण जलदो भास्करं यथः॥
en: Then with his arrowy showers he quickly rendered Drona in visible, like the clouds rendering the sun invisible.

sn: तस्य तल्लाघवं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः। व्यसृजत् सायकांस्तूर्ण शतथोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Beholding that lightness of hands displayed by him, Drona, that crusher of Kshatriyas, began to discharge arrows by hundreds and thousands.

sn: छादयित्वा रणे द्रोणो रथस्थं रथिनां वरम्। जारासंधि जघानाशु मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्॥
en: Then Drona completely covering that foremost of car-warrior name. Jarasadha's son riding on a golden chariot, quickly slew him, before the very eyes of all the warriors.

sn: यो यः स्म नीयते तत्र तं द्रोणो द्वन्तकोपमः। आदत्त सर्वभूतानि प्राप्ते काले यथान्तकः॥
en: Whoever was carried before Drona, he became his destroyer. And like Death at the time of the dissolution, he wrested the lives out of all creatures.

sn: ततो द्रोणो महाराज नाम विश्राव्य संयुगे। शरैरनेकसाहौः पाण्डवेयान् समावृणोत्॥
en: Thereupon, 0 mighty monarch, proclaiming his name in the battle, Drona began to cover the Pandava troops with his thousands of shafts.

sn: ते तु नामाङ्किता बाणा द्रोणेनास्ताः शिलाशिताः। नरान् नागान् हयांश्चैवनिजघ्नुः शतशो मृधे॥
en: Shot by Drona, those arrows with his name engraved on them and whetted on stone, began to dispatch men, elephants and horses by hundreds in that battle.

sn: ते वध्यमाना द्रोणेन शक्रेणेव महासुराः। समकम्पन्त पञ्चाला गावः शीतार्दिता इव॥
en: Then like mighty Asuras slain by Takra, they were being slaughtered by Drona. The Panchalas then began to tremble like kine afflicted with the chill of winter,

sn: ततो निष्ठानको घोरः पाण्डवानामजायत। द्रोणेन वध्यमानेषु सैन्येषु भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Who, O foremost of the Bharatas, the Pandava troops were thus being slaughtered by Drona, a loud wail of agony was uttered them.

sn: प्रताप्यमानाः सूर्येण हन्यमानाश्च सायकैः। अन्वपद्यन्त पञ्चालास्तदा संत्रस्तचेतसः॥
en: Scorched with the rays of the sun and wounded with the arrows of Drona, the Panchalas, panic struck as they were, became seized with anxiety.

sn: मोहिता बाणजालेन भारद्वाजेन संयुगे। ऊरुग्राहगृहीतानां पञ्चालानां महारथाः॥
en: Confounded by the net-work of arrows shot by Bharadvaja's son, the Panchala warriors then thought themselves to be seized by the thighs by alligators.

sn: चेदयश्च महाराज सृञ्जयाः काशिकोसलाः। अभ्यद्रवन्त संहृष्टा भारद्वाजं युयुत्सया॥
en: But after a while, O mighty monarch, the Chedis, the Srinjayas, the Kasis and the Kosalas, cheerfully rushed against the son of Bharadvaja from a desire for battle.

sn: ब्रुवन्तश्च रणेऽन्योन्यं चेदिपञ्चालसृञ्जयाः। घ्रत द्रोणं मत द्रोणमिति ते द्रोणमभ्ययुः॥
en: The Chedis, the Pandavas and the Panchalas then addressed another saying-Drona is slain, Drona is slain. Thus speaking they assailed Drona.

sn: यतन्तः पुरुषव्याघ्राः सर्वशत्तया महाद्युतिम्। निनीषवो रणे द्रोणं यमस्य सदनं प्रति॥
en: Then those foremost of men fell upon Drona of great effulgence in that battle, desirous of dispatching the latter to the abodes of Death.

sn: यतमानांस्तुतान् वीरान् भारद्वाजः शिलीमुखैः। यमाय प्रेषयामास चेदिमुख्यान् विशेषतः॥
en: As those heroes were struggling against him, the son of Bharadvaja with his arrows, dispatched them to the regions of Death, specially those foremost among the Chedis. one

sn: तेषु प्रक्षीयमाणेषु चेदिमुख्येषु सर्वशः। पञ्चाला: समकम्पन्त द्रोणसायकपीडिताः॥
en: When the best warrior of the Chedis were becoming reduced in number, the Panchalas began to tremble, being afflicted by the shafts of Drona.

sn: प्राक्रोशन् भीमसेनं ते धृष्टद्युम्नं च भारत। दृष्ट्वा द्रोणस्य कर्माणि तथारूपाणि मारिष॥
en: Beholding those terrible feats of Drona, 0) sire they began to exclaim aloud saying, 'O Bharata,' 'Oh Bhimasena,; 'O Dhrishtadyumna.'

sn: ब्राह्मणेन तपो नूनं चरितं दुश्चरं महत्। तथा हि युधि संक्रुद्धो दहति क्षत्रियर्षभान्॥
en: They said-Surely this Brahmana has practised mighty ascetic austerities, by virtue of which enraged in battle he is consuming these foremost of Kshatriyas.

sn: धर्मो युद्धं क्षत्रियस्य ब्राह्मणस्य परं तपः। तपस्वी कृतविद्यश्च प्रेक्षितेनापि निर्दहेत्॥
en: The duty of a Kshatriya is to fight and that of a Brahmana to practise severe austerities. He nas practised austerities and is skilled in the use of weapons and so he burns down by his very glance.

sn: द्रोणाग्निमस्रसंस्पर्श प्रविष्टाः क्षत्रियर्षभाः। बहवो दुस्तरं घोरं यत्राह्यन्तं भारत॥
en: The foremost of Kshatriyas entering into the blazing fire of Drona, dreadful and unquenchable, are being brunt down, O Bharata.

sn: यथाबलं यथोत्साहं यथासत्त्वं महाद्युतिः। मोहयन् सर्वभूतानि द्रोणो हन्ति बलानि नः॥
en: The highly effulgence Drona putting forth his prowess and his strength, is confounding all creatures and is slaying all our troops.'

sn: तेषां श्रुत्वा क्षत्रधर्मा व्यवस्थितः। अर्धचन्द्रेण चिच्छेद क्षत्रधर्मा महाबलः॥ क्रोधसंविग्नमनसो द्रोणस्य सशरं धनुः। स संरब्धतरो भूत्वा द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः॥ तद् वचनं
en: Hearing those words of the Panchalas, Kshatradharma withstood Drona. Then the mighty Kshatradharma filled with rage, cut-off with a crescent-shaped arrow Drona's bow with shafts fixed on its string. Thereat excited to the highest pitch of fury that crusher of Kshatriyas viz., Drona.

sn: अन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय भास्वरं वेगवत्तरम्। तत्राधाय शरं तीक्ष्णं परानीकविशातनम्॥
en: Took up another bow, resplendent and capable of bearing great strain. Placing on its string a sharp arrow fatal to the foe.

sn: आकर्णपूर्णमाचार्यो बलवानभ्यवासृजत्। स हत्वा क्षत्रधर्माणं जगाम धरणीतलम्॥
en: The puissant Preceptor let it go drawing the bow-string back to the very ears. That arrow then killing Kshatradharman fell down on the Earth's surface.

sn: स भिन्नहृदयो वाहान्नयपतन्मेदिनीतले। ततः सैन्यान्यकम्पन्त धृष्टद्युम्नसुते हते॥
en: With his heart cleft oper, he fell down on the ground from his vehicle. Upon the Death of Dhristadyumna's son, the troops to tremble (in fear).

sn: अथ द्रोणं समारोहचेकितानो महाबलः। स द्रोणंदशभिर्विद्धवा प्रत्यविद्धयत् स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Thereafter the mighty Chekitana-countered Drona and piercing the latter with ten arrows, once more wounded him on the breast.

sn: चतुर्भिः सारथिं चास्य चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्। तमाचार्यसिभिर्बाणैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: He wounded Drona's charioteer with four and his four steeds with another four arrows. The preceptor then pierced the right arm of his adversary with sixteen arrows.

sn: ध्वजं सप्तभिरुन्मथ्य यन्तारमवधीत् त्रिभिः। तस्य सूते हते तेऽश्वा रथमादाय विद्रुताः॥
en: He pierced his standard with sixteen and his charioteer with seven shafts. When Chekitana's charioteer was killed, the horses ran wildly dragging the car along with them.

sn: समरे शरसंवीता भारद्वाजेन मारिष। चेकितानरथं दृष्ट्वा हताश्वं हतसारथिम्॥
en: Then, O sire, beholding the horseless and the driverless chariot of Chekitana covered with Drona's arrow in battle.

sn: तान् समेतान् रणे शूरांश्चेदिपञ्चालसृञ्जयान्। समन्ताद् द्रावयन् द्रोणो वह्वशोभत मारिष॥ आकर्णपलितः श्यामो वयसाशीतिपञ्चकः। रणे पर्यचरद् द्रोणो वृद्धः षोडशवर्षवत्॥
en: The Pandavas and the Panchalas were seized with a great panic; then routing completely those assembled host of heroes consisting of Chedis, Panchalas and the Srinjayas, Drona appeared highly beautiful, O sire. With his hoary locks flowing down to the ear, blue in complexion, full eighty-five years of age.

sn: अथ द्रोणं महाराज विचरन्तमभीतवत्। वज्रहस्तममन्यन्त शत्रवः शत्रुसूदनम्॥
en: The venerable Drona, though burdened with the weight of years then moved on the field like a youth of sixteen. Then O mighty monarch, as Drona careered fearlessly on the field of battle.

sn: ततोऽब्रवीन्महाबाहुपदो बुद्धिमान् नृप। लुब्धोऽयं क्षत्रियान् हन्ति व्याघ्रः क्षुद्रमृगानिव॥
en: His adversaries considered him to be none other than Indra himself armed with the thunder. Then, O king, the intelligent, Drupada

sn: कृच्छ्रान् दुर्योधनो लोकान् पापः प्राप्स्यति दुर्मतिः। यस्य लोभाद् विनिहताः समरे क्षत्रियर्षभाः॥
en: ‘Like a hungry tiger slaying inferior animals, Drona is slaying these Kshatriyas. Surely the wicked Duryodhana will obtain very miserable regions after Death.

sn: शतशः शेरते भूमौ निकृत्ता गोवृषा इव। रुधिरेण परीताङ्गाः श्वशृगालदनीकृताः॥
en: It is through his covetousness that these foremost of the Kshatriyas are lying prostrate on the field of battle being slain by hundreds, like so many quartered bovine bulls.

sn: एवमुक्त्वा महाराज दुपदोऽक्षौहिणीपतिः। पुरस्कृत्य रणेपार्थान् द्रोणमभ्यद्रवद् दुतम्॥
en: Weltering in blood and being the food of the jackals and the dogs.” O mighty monarch, thus speaking, that commander of Aukshauhini, Drupada, placing the Parthas before him, quickly rushed against Drona. a

sn: एवमुक्त्वा महाराज दुपदोऽक्षौहिणीपतिः। पुरस्कृत्य रणेपार्थान् द्रोणमभ्यद्रवद् दुतम्॥
en: Weltering in blood and being the food of the jackals and the dogs.” O mighty monarch, thus speaking, that commander of Aukshauhini, Drupada, placing the Parthas before him, quickly rushed against Drona. a

sn: संजय उवाच व्यूहेष्वालोड्यमानेषु पाण्डवानां ततस्ततः। सुदूरमन्वयुः पार्थाः पञ्चालाः सह सोमकैः॥
en: Sanjaya said When the armies of the Pandavas were thus being agitated on all sides, the Pandavas and the Panchalas, together with the Somakas retreated to a great distance.

sn: वर्तमाने तथा रौद्रे संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे। संक्षये जगतस्तीने युगान्त इव भारत॥
en: When, 0 Bharata, that fierce fierce and horripilating battle was raging furiously, it appeared that the hour of the world's dreadful dissolution had arrived.

sn: द्रोणे युधि पराक्रान्ते नर्दमाने मुहुर्मुहुः। पञ्चालेषु च क्षीणेषु वध्यमानेषु पाण्डुषु॥
en: When Drona was displaying his prowess in battle and constantly roaring and when the Pandus, the Panchalas were being slaughtered and reduced in number.

sn: नापश्यच्छरणं किञ्चिद् धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। चिन्तयामास राजेन्द्र कथमेतद् भविष्यति॥
en: King Yudhishthira the virtuous could not find any protector for himself. And O foremost of kings, he thought-'how will it end.'.

sn: ततो वीक्ष्य दिशः सर्वाः सव्यसाचिदिदृक्षया। युधिष्ठिरो ददर्शाथ नैव पार्थ न माधवम्॥
en: Then longingly looking on all directions with the desire of having a sight of Partha, Yudhishthira was disappointed and saw neither Arjuna nor Madhava.

sn: सोऽपश्यन् नरशार्दूलं वानरर्षभलक्षणम्। गाण्डीवस्य च नि?षमशृण्वन् व्यथितेन्द्रियः॥
en: He could not then find that foremost of men having the money-chief for the device on his banner; and could not also hear the twang of the Gandiva bow. He therefore became greatly depressed.

sn: अपश्यन् सात्यकिं चापि वृष्णीनां प्रवरं रथम्। चिन्तयाभिपरिताङ्गो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Without finding also that foremost of the Vrishnis namely Satyaki, that great car-warrior, king Yudhishthira the virtuous became overwhelmed with anxious thought and his limbs became weak.

sn: नाध्यगच्छत् तदा शान्ति तावपश्यन् नरोत्तमौ। लोकोपक्रोशभीरुत्वाद् धर्मराजो महामनाः॥
en: Then getting no information whatever of those two best of men, the very virtuous king Yudhishthira obtained no peace of mind. The high-souled king then afraid of the reproaches of the world.

sn: अचिन्तयन्महाबाहुः शैनेयस्य रथं प्रति। पदवीं प्रेषितश्चैव फाल्गुनस्य मया रणे॥
en: Began to think of the car of Sini's grandson-"In the track of Phalguna, I have sent.

sn: शैनेयः सात्यकिः सत्यो मित्राणामभयंकरः। तदिदं ह्येकमेवासीद् द्विधा जातं ममाद्य वै॥
en: Sini's grandson Satyaki, that one of true prowess, that giver of assurances to his friends. My anxiety that was for one only, is now for two, Satyaki and Arjuna.

sn: सात्यकिश्च हि विज्ञेयः पाण्डवश्च धनंजयः। सात्यकिं प्रेषयित्वा तु पाण्डवस्य पदानुगम्॥
en: I should now get information both of Satyaki and of Dhananjaya. Having sent Satyaki in the track of Pandu's son Arjuna.

sn: सात्वतस्यापि कं युद्धे प्रेषयिष्ये पदानुगम् करिष्यामि प्रयत्नेन भ्रातुरन्वेषणं यदि॥
en: me Whom shall I now sent in the track of that Satvata hero, If now I strive to get information of my brother only.

sn: युयुधानमनन्विषय लोको मां गर्हयिष्यति। भ्रातुरन्वेषणं कृत्वा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Not taking any care for Yuyudhana, the world will blame any say-"King Yudhishthira the virtuous enquiring after his brother.

sn: परित्यजति वार्ष्णेयं सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम्। लोकापवादभीरुत्वात् सोऽहं पार्थ वृकोदरम्॥ पदवीं प्रेषयिष्यामि माधवस्य महात्मनः। यथैव च मम प्रीतिरर्जुने शत्रुसूदने॥
en: Neglects Satyaki of the Vrishni race, that hero of infallible prowess. Afraid as I am of the reproaches of men, I shall send Pritha's son Vrikodara in the track of the illustrious scion of Madhu's race. The affection I bear for that slayer of foes viz., Arjuna.

sn: तथैव वृष्णिवीरेऽपि सात्वते युद्धदुर्मदे। अतिभारे नियुक्तश्च मया शैनेयनन्दनः॥
en: Is in no way greater than that I bear for that invincible hero of the Satvata race. That delighter of Sini's race, has been entrusted with a commission on my behalf.

sn: स तु मित्रोपरोधने गौरवात्तु महाबलः। प्रविष्टो भारती सेनां मकरः सागरं यथा॥
en: That mighty-warrior has either for the sake of a friend's words or for the sake of his honor, has plunged into the Bharata host, like Makara entering into the ocean.

sn: असौ हि श्रूयते शब्दः शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्। मिथः संयुध्यमानानां वृष्णिवीरेण धीमता॥
en: Hark the loud noise of the battle that the unretreating heroes are fighting with that intelligent champion of the Vrishni race!

sn: प्राप्तकालं सुबलवनिश्चितं बहुधा हि मे। तत्रैव पाण्डवेयस्य भीमसेनस्य धन्विनः॥ गमनं रोचते मह्यं यत्र यातौ महारथौ। न चाप्यसह्यं भीमस्य विद्यते भुवि किंचन॥
en: Surely the odds are too many for him. It is therefore high time that I should think of rescuing him. It appears proper to me that armed with the bow, the son of Pandu viz., Bhimasena should proceed to the spot where those two mighty car-warriors are. There is scarcely anything on earth that Bhima cannot bear.

sn: शक्तो ह्येष रणे यत्तः पृथिव्यां सर्वधन्विनाम्। त्वबाहुवलमास्थाय प्रतिव्यूहितुमासा॥
en: Exerting his best, he alone withstand all the bowmen of the world. Depending on the prowess of his own arms, he can make head against all enemies.

sn: यस्य बाहुबलं सर्वे समाश्रित्य महात्मनः। वनवासानिवृत्ताः स्म न च युद्धेषु निर्जिताः॥
en: With the help of the strength of arms of that hero of illustrious soul, we have been able to come back from our exile and have never been defeated in battle.

sn: इतो गते भीमसेने सात्वतं प्रति पाण्डवे। सनाथौ भवितारौ हि युधि सात्वतफाल्गुनौ॥
en: If now Bhimasena goes to their rescue, Satvata and Phalguna will find a competent protector in his self.

sn: कामं त्वशोचनीयौ तौ रणे सात्वतफाल्गुनौ। रक्षितौ वासुदेवेन स्वयं शस्त्रविशारदौ॥
en: Surely I should not cherish any anxiety of those two heroes, as both of them are versed in the use of all weapons and are protected by the son of Vasudeva himself.

sn: अवश्यं तु मया कार्यमात्मनः शोकनाशनम्। तस्माद् भीमं नियोक्ष्यामि सात्वतस्य पदानुगम्॥
en: However, it is my duty to make myself altogether unaxious on their account. Therefore should I engage Bhima to follow in the track of the Satvata hero.

sn: ततः प्रतिकृतं मन्ये विधानं सात्यकिं प्रति। एवं निश्चित्य मनसा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Having done this, I should think my arrangements for the protection of Satyaki complete.” Thus resolving in his mind, king Yudhishthira the virtues.

sn: यन्तारमब्रवीद् राजा भीमं प्रति नयस्व माम्। धर्मराजवचः श्रुत्वा सारथिर्हयकोविदः॥
en: Thus spoke to his charioteer-"Take me to the spot where Bhima is.” Hearing the words of the virtuous king Yudhishthira, the charioteer versed in the art of horse-driving.

sn: रथं हेमपरिष्कारं भीमान्तिकमुपानयत्। भीमसेनमनुप्राप्य प्राप्तकालमचिन्तयत्॥
en: Drove that chariot adorned with gold, near where Bhimas was. Reaching Bhima, the king remembering the exigencies of the hour.

sn: कश्मलं प्राविशद् राजा बहु तत्र समादिशन्। स कश्मलसमाविष्टो भीममाहूय पार्थिवः॥
en: Became totally overwhelmed with grief and entreated Bhima with numerous prayers. Then overwhelmed as he was with grief, the king summoned Bhima, near him.

sn: अब्रवीद् वचनं राजन् कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। यः सदेवान् सगन्धर्वान् दैत्यांश्चैकरथोऽजयत्॥ तस्य लक्ष्म न पश्यामि भीमसेनानुजस्य ते। ततोऽब्रवीद् धर्मराजं भीमसेनस्तथागतम्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira the son of Kunti addressing him said-"O Bhima, I do not see the banner-device of that younger brother of mine, who on a single car vanquished the celestials, the Gandharvas and the Daityas in battle." Thereupon Bhima addressing the virtuous Yudhishthira who was in that pitiable plight said

sn: नैवाद्राक्षं न चाश्रौषं तव कश्मलमीदृशम्। पुरातिदुःखदीर्णानां भवान् गतिरभूद्धि नः॥
en: “Never before did I seen you afflicted with such great grief. In days gone by, you were our only comforter when we were afflicted with extreme distress.

sn: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ राजेन्द्र शाधि किं करवाणि ते। न ह्यसाध्यमकार्य वा विद्यते मम मानद॥
en: Arise, arise, O foremost of king! Command me what act of yours shall I do? O giver of honours, there is nothing which I cannot accomplish.

sn: आज्ञापय कुरुश्रेष्ठ मा च शोके मनः कृथाः। तमब्रवीदश्रुपूर्णः कृष्णसर्प इव श्वसन्॥ भीमसेनमिदं वाक्यं प्रम्लानवदनो नृपः। यथा शङ्खस्य निर्घोषः पाञ्चजन्यस्य श्रूयते॥
en: O foremost of the Kurus, command me! Let not your heart give way to grief.” Then king Yudhishthira, with a cheerless countenance and tearful eyes, said these words to Bhimasena sighing like a snake. 'In as much as I do hear the blast of the conch Panchajanya.

sn: पूरितो वासुदेवेन संरब्धेन यशखिना। नूनमद्य हतः शेते तव भ्राता धनंजयः॥
en: Filled with the breath of the illustrious and highly courageous son of Vasudeva, I infer that your brother Dhananjaya today is slain on the field of battle.

sn: तस्मिन् विनिहते नूनं युध्यतेऽसौ जनार्दनः। यस्य सत्त्ववतो वीर्य ह्युपजीवन्ति पाण्डवाः॥
en: Upon the slaughter of Arjuna, surely Janardana is fighting. That hero on whose indomitable prowess the Pandavas rely.

sn: यं भयेष्वभिगच्छन्ति सहस्राक्षमिवामराः। स शूरः सैन्धवप्रेप्सुरन्वयाद् भारती चमूम्॥
en: He to whom we turn for help, like the celestials turning to the thousand-eyed deity at the times of our sorest calamities, surely that hero is now agitating the Bharata hosts in search of the ruler of the Sindhus.

sn: तस्य वै गमनं विद्मो भीम नावर्तनं पुनः। श्यामो युवा गुडाकेशो दर्शनीयो महारथः॥
en: O Bhima, we have seen him (Arjuna) gone, but we shall never seen him return! Alas for Arjuna of dark-blue complexion, who is youthful in years, possessed of curling locks exceedingly charming, handsome and a mighty car-warrior.

sn: व्यूढोरस्को महाबाहुर्मत्तद्विरदविक्रमः। चकोरनेत्रस्ताम्रास्यो द्विषतां भयवर्धनः॥
en: Of broad breast, mighty arms, possessed of the tread of an infuriate elephant, of eyes like those of the Chakara, that inspirer of terror into the heart of the foes!

sn: तदिदं मम भद्रं ते शोकस्थानमरिंदम। अर्जुनार्थे महाबाहो सात्वतस्य च कारणात्॥
en: Good betide you! O slayer of foes, this indeed is the cause of my grief, O mighty armed one, for the sake of Arjuna and for that of the Satvata hero.

sn: वर्धते हविषेवाग्निरिध्यमानः पुनः पुनः। तस्य लक्ष्म न पश्यामि तेन विन्दामि कश्मलम्॥
en: My grief is ever increasing, like fire increasing when libation of clarified batter is poured on it. I do not see the device on his banner and this adds to my grief and anxiety all the more.

sn: तं विद्धि पुरुषव्याघ्रं सात्वतं च महारथम्। स तं महारथं पश्चादनुयातस्तवानुजम्॥ तमपश्यन्महाबाहुमहं विन्दामि कश्मलम्।
en: Know him a great car-warrior and lion among the men of Sattvata race, Your younger brother followed him. I do not see him and this adds to my grief and anxiety all the more.

sn: पार्थे तस्मिन् हते चैव युध्यते नूनमग्रणीः॥ सहायो नास्य वै कश्चित् तेन विन्दामि कश्मलम्। तस्मिन् कृष्णे हते नूनं युध्यते युद्धकोविदः॥ न हि मे शुध्यते भावस्तयोरेव परंतप।
en: Upon the slaughter to your brother, surely Krishna conversant with all modes of warfare, is battling with the Kurus. Bring me the intelligence of that foremost of men and of that mighty car-warrior of the Vrishni race. Who has ere now followed in the track of your brother that mighty car-warrior. I am also overwhelmed with distress on account of this last-mentioned mighty arm-hered.

sn: स तत्र गच्छ कौन्तेय यत्र यातो धनंजयः॥ सात्यकिश्च महावीर्यः कर्तव्यं यदि मन्यसे।
en: O son of Kunti! do you hie yourself to the spot where Dhananjaya and Satyaki of great energy, have gone! This indeed is your duty.

sn: वचनं मम धर्मज्ञ भ्राता ज्येष्ठो भवामि ते॥ न तेऽर्जुनस्तथा ज्ञेयो ज्ञातव्यः सात्यकिर्यथा।
en: O my most dutiful brother, carry out my behests as I am your elder brother. Think that Satyaki is dearer to you than your brother Arjuna (so try to help Satyaki the more).

sn: चिकीर्षुर्मत्प्रियं पार्थ स यातः सव्यसाचिनः। पदवी दुर्गमां घोरामगम्यामकृतात्मभिः॥
en: O son of Pritha, desirous of doing me good, he has gone in search of Dhananjaya in an impossible track dreadful and in capable of being followed upon by warriors of inferior skill.

sn: दृष्ट्वा कुशलिनौ कृष्णौ सात्वतं चैव सात्यकिम्। संविदं चैव कुर्यास्त्वं सिंहनादेन पाण्डव॥
en: Beholding Krishna and Arjuna and the Satvata hero Satyaki sound and alive, inform me of the fact, O son of Pandu, by uttering your war-cry aloud.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: भीमसेन उवाच ब्रह्मशानेन्द्रवरुणानवहद् यः पुरा रथः। तमास्थाय गतौ कृष्णौ न तयोर्विद्यते भयम्॥
en: Bhima said Riding on the chariot formerly ridden by Bharata, Ishana, Indra and Varuna, Arjuna and Krishna have proceeded to battle! They can have no fear.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: आज्ञां तु शिरसा बिभ्रदेष गच्छामि मा शुचः। समेत्य तान् नरव्याघ्रांस्तव दास्यामि संविदम्॥
en: However, placing your command on my head, behold, I proceed. do not give way to grief. Returning, I shall bring you intelligence of those foremost of men.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: संजय उवाच एतावदुक्त्वा प्रययौ परिदाय युधिष्ठिरम्। धृष्टद्युम्नाय बलवान् सुहद्भ्यश्च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken, the highly powerful Bhimasena prepared to go having over the charge of protecting Yudhishthira to Dhrishtadyumna and other friends of the Pandavas.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नं चेदमाह भीमसेनो महाबलः। विदितं ते महाबाहो यथा द्रोणो महारथः॥
en: The puissant Bhima then addressing Dhrishtadyumna said these words. "O mightyarmed one, it is all known to you, that Drona the mighty car-warrior.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: ग्रहणे धर्मराजस्य सर्वोपायेन वर्तते। न च मे गमने कृत्यं तादृक् पार्षत विद्यते॥
en: Is ever watchful for capturing the very virtuous king Yudhishthira. O son of Prisata, when I am gone, there should be no other duty of yours.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: यादृशं रक्षणे राज्ञः कार्यमात्ययिकं हि नः। एवमुक्तोऽस्मि पार्थेन प्रतिवक्तुं न चोत्सहे॥
en: Graver than that which enjoins you to look after the king-a duty which is vitally important to ourselves. King Yudhishthira, the son of Pritha, has commanded me to go. I venture not to contradict him.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: प्रयास्ये तत्र यत्रासौ मुमूर्षुः सैन्धवः स्थितः। धर्मराजस्य वचने स्थातव्यमविशङ्कया॥
en: Now I am proceeding to the spot where the doomed ruler of the Sindhus is. It is my duty to carry out the commands of the very virtuous king Yudhishthira to the very letters.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: यास्यामि पदवीं भ्रातुः सात्वतस्य च धीमतः। सोऽद्य यत्तो रणे पार्थ परिरक्ष युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: I am proceeding in the track of my brother and that intelligent scion of the Satvata race, namely Satyaki. So today, do you protect king Yudhisthira the son of Pritha in battle, exerting to the best of your prowess.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: एतद्धि सर्वकार्याणां परमं कृत्यमाहवे। तमब्रवीन्महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नो वृकोदरम्॥
en: This indeed should be your foremost duty in the course of this fight." O mighty monarch, Dhrishtadyumna then replied to Vrikodara

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: ईप्सितं ते करिष्यामि गच्छ पार्थाविचारयन्। नाहत्वा समरे द्रोणो धृष्टद्युम्नं कथञ्चन॥
en: “I will do, O Pritha's son, what you desire me to do. Go you with your heart at rest. Without slaying Dhrishtadyumna in battle, Drona.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: निग्रहं धर्मराजस्य प्रकरिष्यति संयुगे। ततो निक्षिप्य राजानं धृष्टद्युम्ने च पाण्डवम्॥
en: Will never succeed in humiliating king Yudhishthira the virtuous," Thereafter making the charge of protecting the royal son of Pandu over to Dhrishtadyumna.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: अभिवाद्य गुरुं ज्येष्ठं प्रययौ येन फाल्गुनः। परिष्वक्तश्च कौन्तेयो धर्मराजेन भारत॥
en: And saluting his superiors and elder brother, Bhima proceeded in the track of Phalguna. That son of Kunti was then, O Bharata, embraced by the virtuous king Yudhishthira.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: आघ्रातश्च तथा मूर्ध्नि श्रावितश्चाशिषः शुभाः। कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणान् विप्रानर्चितांस्तुष्टमानसान्॥
en: The latter then smelt the crown of his head and pronounced blessings on him. Then circumambulating hosts of Brahmanas gratified and worshipped with presents.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: आलभ्य मङ्गलान्यष्टौ पीत्वा कैरातकं मधु। द्विगुणद्रविणो वीरो मदरक्तान्तलोचनः॥
en: And touching the eight kinds of auspicious articles and drinking Kailataka honey, that hero with his eyes rolling and red in intoxication, felt his strength to be doubled.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: विप्रैः कृतस्वस्त्ययनो विजयोत्पादसूचितः। पश्यन्नेवात्मनो बुद्धिं विजयानन्दकारिणीम्॥
en: The Vipras performed propitiatory rites for his benefit. Omens indicative of victory greeted his sight. Beholding these indications he experienced the pleasures of victory in anticipation.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: अनुलोमानिलैश्चाशु प्रदर्शितजयोदयः। भीमसेनो महाबाहुः कवची शुभकुण्डली॥
en: Auspicious winds began to blow indicating his success in the coming encounter. Then the mighty-armed Bhimasena covered with armour, graced with beautiful ear-rings.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: साङ्गदः सतलत्राणः सरथो रथिनां वरः। तस्य कार्णायसं वर्म हेमचित्रं महर्द्धिमत्॥
en: Adorned with Angadas and his hands protected with leathern gloves mounted on his car. His precious armour made of steel and adorned with gold.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: विबभौ सर्वतः श्लिष्टं सविद्युदिव तोयदः। पीतरक्तासितसितैर्वासोभिश्च सुवेष्टितः॥
en: Looked beautiful like a mighty cloud fringed with streaks of lightning. Attired beautifully in yellow, red, white and sable garments.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: कण्ठमात्रेण च बभौ सेन्द्रायुध इवाम्बुदः। प्रयाते भीमसेने तु तव सैनयं युयुत्सया॥
en: And with his neck protected with a neckprotector, he looked beautiful like a mass of cloud bearing the bow of Indra (rainbow). When Bhima was on the point of proceeding to battle against your troops.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: पाञ्चजन्यरवो घोरः पुनरासीद् विशाम्पते। तं श्रुत्वा निनदं घोर त्रैलोक्यत्रासनं महत्॥
en: The fierce blare of the conch Panchajannya, O ruler of men, was once more heard. Hearing that dreadful blast capable of inspiring terroi into the three worlds.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: पुनर्भीमं महाबाहुं धर्मपुत्रोऽभ्यभाषत। एष वृष्णिप्रवीरेण ध्मातः सलिलजो भृशम्॥
en: The very virtuous king Yudhishthira onca more addressing Bhima of mighty arms said "Hark the sound of the conch (water-born blown by the foremost of the Vrishni race.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च विनादयति शङ्खराट्। नूनं व्यसनमापन्ने सुमहत् सव्यसाचिनि॥
en: Reverberating through the terrestrial an the aerial regions! Surely Savyasachin havin been involved in great danger.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: कुरुभियुध्यते सार्ध सर्वेश्चक्रगदाधरः। आह कुन्ती नूनमार्या पापमद्य निदर्शनम्॥ द्रौपदी च सुभद्रा च पश्यन्त्यौ सह बन्धुभिः। स भीम त्वरया युक्तो याहि यत्र धनंजयः॥
en: The wilder of the mace and the discus battling with the Kurus! Surely numero auspicious omnens are today being seen by mic nerable Kunti and Drupadi and Subhadra and 1 their friends. Therefore, O Bhima, at the top your speed, proceed to the spot where hananjaya is.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: मुह्यन्तीव हि मे सर्वा धनंजयदिदृक्षया। दिशश्च प्रदिशः पार्थ सात्वतस्य च कारणात्॥
en: O son of Pritha, the cardinal and subsidiary uarter appear to me to be void in consequence f my unsatisfied desire to see Dhananjaya and lat hero of the Satvata race."

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: गच्छ गच्छेति गुरुणा सोऽनुज्ञातो वृकोदरः। ततः पाण्डुसुतो राजन् भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then Vrikodara was repeatedly urged on by lis elder brother, with the words “Proceed 'roceed.” Therefore o king, that highly juissant son of Pandu namely Bhimasena.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणः प्रगृहीतशरासनः। ज्येष्ठेन प्रहितो भ्रात्रा भ्राता भ्रातुः प्रियंकरः॥
en: Covering his fingers with protectors made of leather, took up his bow. Urged on by his elder brother, that brother Bhimasena devoted as he was to the interests of his brothers.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: आहत्य दुन्दुभिं भीमः शङ्ख प्रधमाप्य चासकृत्। विनद्य सिंहनादेन ज्यां विकर्षन् पुनः पुनः॥
en: Caused drums to be struck up. Then he blew his conch with great force and uttering his war-cries, began to twang his bow.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: तेन शब्देन वीराणां पातपित्वा मनांस्युत। दर्शयन् घोरमात्मानममित्रान् सहसाभ्ययात्॥
en: With that sound, causing the hearts of his enemies to be depressed, he rushed upon the foe, assuming a dreadful aspect.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: तहूमुर्जवा दान्ता विरुवन्तो हयोत्तमाः। विशोकेनाभिसम्पन्ना मनोमारुतरंहसः॥
en: Fleet steeds, obedient to the reins and of the foremost breed, neighing furiously, bore him. Those steeds of the fleetness of wind or the mind, were driven by Visoka himself.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: आरुजन् विरुजन् पार्थो ज्यां विकर्षश्च पाणिना। सम्प्रकर्षन् विमर्षश्च सेनाग्रं समलोडयत्॥
en: Drawing and rubbing and stretching with his hands the string of his bow, that son of Pritha began to crush and kill the vanguard of the enemy.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: तं प्रयान्तं महाबाहुं पञ्चालाः सहसोमकाः। पृष्ठतोऽनुययुः शूरा मघवन्तमिवामराः॥
en: Then as that mighty-armed one proceeded onwards, the Panchalas together with the Somakas, all endued with heroism, followed him from behind, like the celestials following Maghavat.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: तं समेत्य महाराज तावकाः पर्यवारयन्। दुःशलश्चित्रसेनश्च कुण्डभेदी विविंशतिः॥ दुर्मुखो दुःसहश्चैव विकर्णश्च शलस्तथा। विन्दानुविन्दौ सुमुखो दीर्घबाहुः सुदर्शनः॥ वृन्दारकः सुहस्तश्च सुषेणो दीर्घलोचनः। अभयो रौद्रकर्मा च सुवर्मा दुर्विमोचनः॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, the brothers, Dussala, Chitrasena, Kundavedhi, Vivinsati, Drumukha, Dussaha, Vikarna, Sala, Vindu and Anuvindu, Sumukha, Dirghavahu, Sudarsana, Mandurakas, Suhasta, Susena, Dirghavahu, Abhaya, Raudrakaman, Suvarman and Durvimochana, approaching Bhimasena, surrounded him from all sides.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: शोभन्तो रथिनां श्रेष्ठाः सहसैन्यपदानुगाः। संयत्तः समरे वीरा भीमसेनमुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Those foremost of car-warriors, those heroes and their following troops fighting heedfully and falling upon Bhimasena appeared highly beautiful.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: तैः समन्ताद् वृतः शूरैः समरेषु महारथः। तान् समीक्ष्य तु कौन्तेयो भीमसेनः पराक्रमी। अभ्यवर्तत वेगेन सिंहः क्षुद्रमृगानिव॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior endued with heroism was surrounded by those warriors. Beholding them, the son of Kunti the highly powerful Bhimasena.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: ते महास्राणि दिव्यानि तत्र वीरा अदर्शयन्। छादयन्तः शरैर्भीमं मेघाः सूर्यमिवोदितम्॥
en: Furiously fell upon them like a lion attacking other inferior animals. Then those heroes displaying mighty weapons of celestial make.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: स तानतीत्य वेगेन द्रोणानीकमुपाद्रवत्। अप्रतश्च गजानीकं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Covered Bhima with their arrows like the clouds covering the sun. Passing through all those divisions, Bhima then rushed against that of Drona.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: सोऽचिरेणैव कालेन तद् गजानीकमाशुगैः। दिशः सर्वाः समभ्यस्य व्यधमत् पवनात्मजः॥
en: Then he poured his arrowy shower on the elephant division that was stationed in the front.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: त्रासिताः शरभस्येव गर्जितेन वने मृगाः। प्राद्रवन् द्विरदाः सर्वे नदन्तो भैरवान् रवान्॥
en: The son of the wind-god, mangling in no time that division of elephants, with his shafts, caused it to give way in all directions. Like beasts terrified at the roar of a Sarabha in the forest.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: पुनश्चातीव वेगेन द्रोणानीकमुपाद्रवत्। तमवारयदाचार्यो वेलोद्वृत्तमिवार्णवम्॥
en: Those elephants began to fly away uttering distressful cries. Transgressing that division, he quickly assailed that of Drona.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: ललाटेऽताड्यच्चैनं नाराचेन स्मयन्निव। ऊर्ध्वरश्मिरिवादित्यो विबभौ तेन पाण्डवः॥
en: Him then the preceptor checked like the continent checking the surging waves of the ocean; and then the latter smilingly pierced the former on the forehead with a Naracha.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: स मन्यमानस्त्वाचार्यो ममायं फाल्गुनो यथा। भीमः करिष्यते पूजामित्युवाच वृकोदरम्॥
en: Thereupon that son of Pandu appeared beautiful like the sun shooting his rays only in an upward direction. Then the Preceptor considering that, like Phalguna.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: भीमसेन न ते शक्या प्रवेष्टुमरिवाहिनी। मामनिर्जित्य समरे शत्रुमद्य महाबल॥
en: Bhima would also worship him, addressed the latter saying-'O Bhimasena, you shall never succeed in penetrating into the host of your enemies.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: यदि ते सोऽनुजः कृष्णः प्रविष्टोऽनुमते मम। अनीकं न तु शक्यं मे प्रवेष्टुमिह वै त्वया॥
en: Without, in the first instance defeating myself, O mighty one, who is now your foe. It was with my permission that your younger brother, with Krishna, has penetrated into this array.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: अथ भीमस्तु तच्छुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यमपेतभीः। क्रुद्धः प्रोवाच वै द्रोणं रक्तताप्रेक्षणस्त्वरन्॥
en: But you shall never be able (of allowed) to enter into this division of mine." Thereupon the dauntless Bhima, hearing those words of the preceptor.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: तवार्जुनो नानुमते ब्रह्मबन्धो रणाजिरम्। प्रविष्टः स हि दुर्धर्षः शक्रस्यापि विशेद् बलम्॥ तेन वै परमां पूजां कुर्वता मानितो ह्यसि। नार्जुनोऽहं घृणी द्रोण भीमसेनोऽस्मि॥
en: And waxing worth, quickly replied to Drona with his eyes looking like burnished copper-"O vilest of Brahmanas, it cannot be that Arjuna has entered this array with your permission. He is invincible and is competent even to penetrate through the army of Shakra himself. It was only for honoring you that he offered you worship.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: पिता नस्त्वं गुरुर्बन्धुस्तथा पुत्रास्तु ते वयम्। इति मन्यामहे सर्वे भवन्तं प्रणता स्थिताः॥
en: But, O Drona, I am no lament Arjuna. I am Bhimasena your enemy. We used to regard you as our father, preceptor and friend and we were like your sons.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: अद्य तद्विपरीतं ते वदतोऽस्मासु दृश्यते। यदि त्वं शत्रुमात्मानं मन्यसे तत्तथास्त्विह॥
en: Thinking thus we used to humble ourselves to you. But as you speak such words today, it seems that all that has been changed.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: एष ते सदृशं शत्रोः कर्म भीमः करोम्यहम्। अथोद्भाम्य गदां भीमः कालदण्डमिवान्तकः॥
en: If you take yourself to be our enemy, let it be as you think. Myself am Bhima and shall do towards you what should be done towards you what should be done towards a foe."

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: द्रोणाय व्यसृजद् राजन् स रथादवपुप्लुवे। साश्वसूतध्वजं यानं द्रोणस्यापोथयत् तदा॥
en: Then Bhima whirling his mace that resembled the mace of the Destroyer, let it go, O king, at Drona; but Drona had quickly jumped down from his car.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: प्रामृगाच बहून् योधान् वायुर्वृक्षानिवौजसा। तं पुनः परिवव॒स्ते तव पुत्रा रथोत्तमम्॥
en: The mace then crushed Drona's chariot with his horses, charioteer and standard; then Bhima grinded numerous warriors, like the tempest crushing mighty trees.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: अन्यं तु रथमास्थाय द्रोणः प्रहरतां वरः। व्यूहद्वारं समासाद्य युद्धाय समुपस्थितः॥
en: But once more your sons surrounded that foremost of car warriors. Meanwhile that foremost of smiters, Drona mounting on another car.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज भीमसेनः पराक्रमी। अग्रतः स्यन्दनानीकं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Stationed himself at the gate of the array ready to fight with Bhima. O mighty monarch, thereupon the puissant Bhimasena waxing worth.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: ते वध्यमानाः समरे तव पुत्रा महारथाः। भीमं भीमबला युद्धे योध्यन्ति ज्यैषिणः॥
en: Covered the car division that was then placed before him, with a downpour of arrows. Then those mighty car-warriors, your sons, thus wounded in battle.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: ततो दुःशासन क्रुद्धो रथशक्तिं समाक्षिपत्। सर्वपारसवीं तीक्ष्णां जिघांसुः पाण्डुनन्दनम्॥ आपतन्तीं महाशक्तिं तव पुत्रप्रणोदिताम्। द्विधा चिच्छेद तां भीमस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Endued as they were with great strength, fought on with Bhima, inspired with the hope of victory. Then Dushasana excited with wrath, hurled a lance at Bhima. Desirous of slaying the son of Pandu, he then threw that lance at the former-lance that was made entirely of steed and that was exceedingly sharp. Then the mighty lance hurled by your son when it was coursing towards Bhima.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: अथान्यैर्विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैः संक्रुद्धः कुण्डभेदिनम्। सुषेणं दीर्घनेत्रं च त्रिभित्रीनवधीद् बली॥ ततो वृन्दारकं वीरं कुरूणां कीर्तिवर्धनम्। पुत्राणां तव वीराणां युध्यतामवधीत् पुनः॥ अभयं रौद्रकर्माणं दुर्विमोचनमेव च। त्रिभित्रीनवधीद् भीमः पुनरेव सुतांस्तव॥ वध्यमाना महाराज पुत्रास्तव बलीयसा। भीमं प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठं समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Was cut in twain by the latter and that appeared indeed very wonderful. Then the son of Pandu endued with great prowess, with three sharp arrows, slew the three warriors, Kundavedhin, Susena and Dirghanetra. Then again he slew the heroic Manduraka the bravest of your sons and the enhancer of the glory of the Kurus, then Bhima with another three arrows slew three other of your sons viz., Abhaya, Rudrakarman and Durvimochana.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: ते शरैर्भीमकर्माणं ववर्षः पाण्डवं युधि। मेघा इवातपापाये धाराभिर्धरणीधरम्॥
en: Thus slaughtered by the puissant Bhima, your sons, O mighty monarch. Once more surrounded Bhima that foremost of smiters,

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: स तद् बाणमयं वर्षमश्मवर्षमिवाचलः। प्रतीच्छन् पाण्डुदायादो न प्राव्यथत शत्रुहा॥ विन्दानुविन्दौ सहितौ सुवर्माणं च ते सुतम्। प्रहसन्नेव कौन्तेयः शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥ ततःसुदर्शनं वीरं पुत्रं ते भरतर्षभ। विव्याध समरे तूर्ण स पपात ममार च॥ सोऽचिरेणैव कालेन तद्रथानीकमाशुगैः। दिशः सर्वाः समालोक्य व्यधमत् पाण्डुनन्दनः॥ ततो वै स्थघोषेण गर्जितेन मृगा इव। भज्यमानाश्च समरे तव पुत्रा विशाम्पते॥
en: Then they poured their arrows of Pandu's son of fearful deeds like clouds drenching the mountain breast with their contents at the end of summer. Like a mountain receiving a shower of stones, the son of Pandu then received that arrowy shower and that slayer of foes was none the less worse for it. Then the son of Kunti, as if smiling, dispatched with his arrows, Vinda and Anuvinda together with Suvarman to the abode of death. Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, he pierced in battle, your heroic son Sudarsana, who fell down and died on the spot. Then in no time, the son of Pandu, casting his eyes on all directions, began to agitate that car-host with his (fierce) arrows. Then like a herd of deer, terrified at the loud clatter of ear-wheels.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: प्राद्रवन् सहसा सर्वे भीमसेनभयार्दिताः। अनुयायाच कौन्तेयः पुत्राणां ते महद् बलम्॥
en: Your sons, O ruler of men, began to desert their ranks; and afflicted with the fear of Bhima, they fled with all the speed at their command.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: विव्याध समरे राजन् कौरवेयान् समन्ततः। वध्यमाना महाराज भीमसेनेन तावकाः॥
en: The son of Kunti pursued that mighty army of your sons from behind and, O king, he began to pierce the Kaurava hosts right and left.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: त्यक्त्वा भीमं रणाजग्मुश्चोदयन्तो हयोत्तमान्। तांस्तु निर्जित्य समरे भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: O mighty monarch, your soldiers then thus slaughtered by Bhima, shunning him began to fly away, urging their excellent steeds to the top of their speed.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: सिंहनादरवं चक्रे बाहुशब्दं च पाण्डवः। तलशब्दं च सुमहत् कृत्वा भीमो महाबलः॥
en: Vanquishing them in battle, the highly puissant Bhimasena that son of Pandu, sent up a loud war-cry and began to strike his palms against his arms.

description: The entrance of Bhima in the Kaurava host and the display of his prowess
sn: भीषयित्वा स्थानीकं हत्वा योधान् वरान् वरान्। व्यतीत्य रथिनश्चापि द्रोणानीकमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: The mighty Bhima then having caused that great slapping sound and there by striking terror into the host of the enemy and slaying many best warriors and passing through that division, hied towards of division of Drona.

sn: संजय उवाच समुत्तीर्ण रथानीकं पाण्डवं विहसन् रणे। विवारयिषुराचार्यः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Sanjaya said The Preceptor then, desirous of checking the progress of the son of Pandu, who had now crossed the car-host, began to cover him smilingly with his arrows.

sn: पिबनि शरौधांस्तान् द्रोणचापपरिच्युतान्। सोऽभ्यद्रवत सोदर्यान् मोहयन् बलमायया॥
en: Then seeming to drink in the arrowy showers shot from Drona's bow and confounding your troops by his illusive powers, he began to rush against your sons.

sn: तं मृधे वेगमास्थाय नृपाः परमधन्विनः। चोदितास्तव पुत्रैश्च सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Urged on by your sons, many king all foremost bowmen, rushing with forces began to surround Bhima from all sides.

sn: स तस्तु संवृतो भीमः प्रहसन्निव भारत। उद्यच्छन् स गदां तेभ्यः सुघोरां सिंहवन्नदन्। अवासृजच्च वेगेन शत्रुपक्षविनाशिनीम्॥ इन्द्राशनिरिवेन्द्रेण प्रविद्धा संहतात्मना। प्रामथ्यात् सा महाराज सैनिकांस्तव संयुगे॥ घोषेण महता राजन् पूरयन्तीव मेदिनीम्। ज्वलन्ती तेजसाभीमा त्रासयामास ते सुतान्॥ तां पतन्तीं महावेगां दृष्ट्वा तेजोऽभिसंवृताम्। प्राद्रवंस्तावकाः सर्वे नदन्तो भैरवान् रवान्॥
en: Then, O Bharata, surrounded by them, Bhima smiling and roaring like a lion, took up a dreadful mace. He then with force hurled at them that mace capable of destroying the foe, like Indra hurling his thunder against his enemies. Hurled with force and of great strength. That mace began to crush, Oking, your troops in battle; and O king, it seemed to fill the earth with its loud noise. Burning greatly, that dreadful mace terrified your sons. Then beholding that mace of great momentum wrapt up in blazing flames course towards themselves, your troops began to fly away uttering cries.

sn: तं च शब्दमसह्य वै तस्याः संलक्ष्य मारिष। प्रापतन्मनुजास्तत्र रथेभ्यो रथिनस्तदा॥ ते हन्यमाना भीमेन गदाहस्तेन तावकाः। प्राद्रवन्त रणे भीता व्याघ्रघ्राता मृगा इव।॥ सतान् विद्राव्य कौन्तेयः संख्येऽमित्रान् दुरासदान्। सुपर्ण इव वेगेन पक्षिराडत्यगाचमूम्॥ तथा तु विप्रकुर्वाणं रथयूथपयथूपम्। भारद्वाजो महाराज भीमसेनं समभ्ययात्॥ भीमं तु समरे द्रोणो वारयित्वा शररोर्मिभिः।
en: At the unbearable sound of that mace, O sire men began to fall down on the spot they stood; and many car-warriors dropped down from their cars. Slaughtered by Bhima armed with a mace in his hands, your troops began to fly away terrified from the field of battle, like deer attacked by a tiger. The son of Kunti then causing his brave adversaries to fly away, passed through that division with great force, like Suparna, that king of birds. While Bhima that leader of leaders of car hosts was thus spreading carnage in your troops. O mighty monarch, the son of Bharadvaja, viz., Drona rushed upon Bhima, checking the latter with his showers of arrows.

sn: अकरोत् सहसा नारदं पाण्डूनां भयमादधत्॥ तद् युद्धमासीत् युमहद् घोरं देवासुरोपमम्। द्रोणस्य च महाराज भीमस्य च महात्मनः॥ यदा तु विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्दोणचापविनिः सृतैः।
en: Then he uttered a loud war-cry, inspiring there with the Pandavas with terror. Then a dreadful combat commenced between the highsouled Bhima and Drona, that resembled that between the Gods and Asuras. Then with the sharp shafts shot from the bow of Drona.

sn: वध्यन्ते समरे वीराः शतथोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ ततो रथादवप्लुत्य वेगमास्थाय पाण्डवः।
en: Numerous heroes were slain by hundreds and by thousands. Then jumping down from his car and rushing with fury, the son of Pandu.

sn: वेगमास्थाय बलवान् निमील्य नयने राजन् पदातिनॊणमभ्ययात्॥ अंसे शिरा भीमसेनः करौ कृत्वोरसि स्थिरौ। मनोऽनिलगरुत्मताम्॥ यथा हि गोवृषा वर्ष प्रतिगृह्णाति लीलया। तथा भीमो नरव्याघ्रः शरवर्ष समग्रहीत्॥ स वध्यमानः समरे रथं द्रोणस्य मारिष। ईषायां पाणिना गृह्य प्रचिक्षेप महाबलः॥ द्रोणस्तु सत्वरो राजन् क्षिप्तो भीमेन संयुगे।
en: With his eyes closed, on foot, attacked Drona. Then like a bovine bull receiving a shower of rain without any pain whatsoever. Bhima that foremost of men received that shower of arrows, Proceeding from Drona's car. O sire, although wounded by Drona in battle, that puissant hero, catching hold of the shaft of Drona's car with his hands, over-threw it. Thereupon Drona thus over-thrown with vehemence by Bhima.

sn: रथमन्यं समारुह्य व्यूहद्वारं ययौ पुनः॥ तमायान्तं तथा दृष्ट्वा भग्नोत्साहं गुरुं तदा।
en: Mounted on another car, an flew towards the gate of the array and at that time, his driver urged his steeds to the top of their speed.

sn: गत्वा वेगात् पुनर्भीमो धुरं गृह्य रथस्य तु॥ तमप्यतिरथं भीमश्चिक्षेप भृशरोषितः। एवमष्टौ रथाः क्षिप्ता भीमसेनेन लीलया॥
en: O foremost of the Kurus that feat achieved by Bhimasena was indeed wonderful. Then the mighty Bhimasena, ascending once more his own chariot.

sn: पुनः स्वस्थमास्थितः। दृश्यते तावकर्योधैर्विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनैः॥
en: Rushed furiously upon the division of your son; like a tempest crushing rows of trees, he then began to crush that host of the Kshatriyas.

sn: तस्मिन् क्षणे तस्या यन्ता तूर्णश्वानचोदयत्। भीमसेनस्य कौरव्य तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥ ततः स्वरथमास्थाय भीमसेनो महाबलः। अभ्यद्रवत वेगेन तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम्॥
en: He then proceeded resisting the hostile troops like mountains checking the surging sea;

sn: व्यदृश्यत निमेषेण
en: then coming upon the division of the Bhojas, protected by Hridika's son.

sn: स मृद्गन् क्षत्रियानाजौ वातो वृक्षानिवोद्धतः। आगच्छद् दारयन् सेनां सिन्धुवेगो नगानिव॥ भोजानीकं समासाद्य हार्दिक्येनाभिरक्षितम्। प्रमथ्य तरसा वीरस्तदप्यतिबलोऽभ्ययात्॥ संत्रासयन्ननीकानि तलशब्देन पाण्डवः।
en: O king, Bhimasena crushed it horribly and then passed through it. Terrifying his enemies with the sound of his palm-strokes, O sire.

sn: अजयत् सर्वसैन्यानि शार्दूल इव गोवृषान्॥ भोजानीकमतिक्रम्य दरदानां च वाहिनीम्।
en: Bhima defeated them all like a tiger defeating a herd of bulls. Then passing through the Bhoja and Kamboja divisions.

sn: तथा म्लेच्छगणानन्यान् बहून् युद्धविशारदान्॥ सात्यकिं चैव सम्प्रेक्ष्य युध्यमानं महारथम्। रथेन यत्तः कौन्तेयो वेगेन प्रययौ तदा॥ भीमसेनो महाराज द्रष्टकामो धनंजयम्।
en: And through that of the countless Mlechchas, who were all accomplished in smiting, Bhima obtained sight of Satyaki, the mighty car-warriors engaged in fighting. He then advanced quickly and resolutely, desirous of having a sight of Dhananjaya.

sn: अतीत्य समरे योधांस्तावकान् पाण्डुनन्दनः॥ सोऽपश्यदर्जुनं तत्र युध्मानं महारथम्। सैन्धवस्य वधार्थ हि पराक्रान्तं पराक्रमी॥ तं दृष्ट्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रश्चुक्रोश महतो रवान्।
en: Passing through all your divisions then, the son of Pandu obtained a sight of Dhananjaya engaged in battle. Then the highly puissant Bhima, that foremost of men, seeing Arjuna exerting vigourously for bringing about the slaughter of the king of the Sindhus, sent up a loud war-cry.

sn: प्रावृट्काले कौरव्य भीमसेनस्य संयुगे।॥ तं तस्य निनदं घोरं पार्थः शुश्राव नर्दतः। वासुदेवश्च कौरव्य भीमसेनस्य संयुगे॥
en: Like, O king, the clouds roaring at the rainy seasons. That dreadful roar of the roaring Bhimasena was then heard, O foremost of the Kurus, by Partha and the son of Vasudeva engaged in battle.

sn: तौ श्रुत्वा युगपद् वीरौ निनदं तस्य शुष्मिणः। पुनः पुनः प्राणदतां दिदृक्षन्तौ वृकोदरम्॥ ततः पार्थो महानादं मुञ्चन् वै माधवश्च ह।
en: Those two heroes hearing at the same time the war-cry of the mighty Bhima themselves began to shout their war-cries, desirous of having a sight of Bhimasena. Then Pritha's son Arjuna and he of Madhu's race, both uttering their war-cries.

sn: अभ्ययातां महाराज नर्दन्तौ गोवृषाविव॥ भीमसेनरवं श्रुत्वा फाल्गुनस्य च धन्विनः। अप्रीयत महाराज धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ विशोकश्चाभवद् राजा श्रुत्वा तं निनदं तयोः। धनंजयस्य समरे जयमाशास्तवान् विभुः॥
en: Rushed upon your army, monarch, like two bovine bulls. Hearing the shouts of Bhimasena and those of Phalguna the fierce bowman. The very virtuous king Yudhishthira, O monarch, became greatly delighted. Hearing their shouts the king then was relieved of his burden of anxiety. That sovereign then become hopeful of Dhananjaya's success in the battle.

sn: तथा तु नर्दमाने वै भीमसेने मदोत्कटे। स्मितं कृत्वा महाबाहुधर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ हृद्गतं मनसा प्राह ध्यात्वा धर्मभृतां वरः।
en: While the furious Bhima was thus roaring the mighty-armed Yudhishthira that foremost of all virtuous persons, that son of Dharma, reflected smilingly for a while and then thus worded the thought that then filled his heart.

sn: दत्ता भीम त्वया संवित् कृतं गुरुवचस्तथा॥ न हि तेषां जयो युद्धे येषां द्वेष्टासि पाण्डव। दिष्ट्या जीवति संग्रामे सव्यसाची धनंजयः॥
en: "O Bhima, you have indeed sent me information; you have truly carried out the commands of your superior. O son of Pandu, they cannot have any hope of victory in battle, whose enemy you yourself are. It is indeed fortunate that Savyasachin, that conqueror of Kubera still lives.

sn: दिष्ट्या च कुशली वीरः सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। दिष्ट्या शृणोमि गर्जन्तौ वासुदेवधनंजयौ॥ येन शक्रं रणे जित्वा तर्पितो हव्यवाहनः।
en: It is also fortunate that Satyaki of indomitable prowess is sound and safe. It if fortunate that I hear the roars of the roaring Vasudeva and Dhananjaya. He who having vanquished Shakra in battle, gratified the God of fire. It is fortunate, that slayer of foes Phalguna still lives. He depending upon whose prowess of arms we live.

sn: स हन्ता द्विषतां संख्ये दिष्ट्या जीवति फाल्गुनः॥४२ निवातकवचा येन देवैरपि सुदुर्जयाः। निर्जिता धनुषैकेन दिष्ट्या पार्थः स जीवति॥ कौरवान् सहितान् सर्वान् गोग्रहार्थ समागतान्। योऽजयन्मत्स्यनगरे दिष्ट्या पार्थः स जीवति॥ कालकेयसहस्राणि चतुर्दश महारणे। योऽवधीद् भुजवीर्येण दिष्ट्या पार्थः स जीवति॥ गन्धर्वराजं बलिनं दुर्योधनकृते च वै। जितवान् योऽस्रवीर्येण दिष्ट्या पार्थः स जीवति॥४४ किरीटमाली बलवाञ्छवेताश्वः कृष्णसारथिः।
en: Through good fortune, that Arjuna still lives and is slaughtering his foes. He who vanquished with a single bow the Daityas Nivata Kavacha who were in capable of being defeated even by the celestials themselves, it is indeed fortunate that son of Pritha still lives. He, who in the city of the Matsyas defeated the united Kauravas come with the intent of seizing the cows of the Matasya king, it is indeed fortunate that son of Pritha still lives. He who by the strength of arms slew the fourteen thousand Kekayas in battle, it is fortunate that the son Pritha still lives. He who for the sake of rescuing Duryodhana and vanquished with the force of his weapons the mighty king of the Gandharva, it is fortunate that the son of Pritha still lives. Decked with the diadem and garlands, endued with prowess, owning white steeds and having Krishna for his charioteer.

sn: मम प्रियश्च सततं दिष्ट्या पार्थः स जीवति॥ पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तश्चिकीर्षन् कर्म दुष्करम्।
en: That Arjuna, ever dear to me, through good fortune still lives. Afflicted as he is sorely with the grief caused by the death of his son and striving to achieve a most difficult feat.

sn: जयद्रथवधान्वेषी प्रतिज्ञां कृतवान् हि यः॥ कचित् स सैन्धवं संख्ये हनिष्यति धनंजयः।
en: And even now endeavouring to compass the death of Jayadratha, he that has made a terrible vow, viz., Dhananjaya, will he succeed in slaying the king of the Sindhus in battle.

sn: कचित् तीर्णप्रतिज्ञं हि वासुदेवेन रक्षितम्॥ अनस्तमित आदित्ये समेष्याम्यहमर्जुनम्।
en: Shall I behold Arjuna again before the sun set, when he will return having fulfilled his vow through the help of Vasudeva's son?

sn: कचित् सैन्धवको राजा दुर्योधनहिते रतः॥ नन्दयिष्यत्यमित्रान् हि फाल्गुनेन निपातितः।
en: Will the ruler of the Sindhus ever anxious for achieving the good of king Duryodhana, afford delight unto his foes, being slain by Phalguna.

sn: कश्चिद् दुर्योधनो राजा फाल्गुनेन निपातितम्॥ दृष्ट्वा सैन्धवकं संख्ये शममस्मासु धास्यति।
en: Will king Duryodhana, beholding the ruler of the Sindhus slain by Arjuna, conclude peace with ourselves?

sn: दृष्ट्वा विनिहतान् भ्रातॄन् भीमसेनेन संयुगे॥ कच्चिद् दुर्योधनो मन्दः शममस्मासु धास्यति।
en: Will the wicked Duryodhana beholding his brothers slain in battle by Bhimasena, conclude peace with us?

sn: दृष्ट्वा चान्यान् महायोधान् पातितान् धरणीतले। कचिद् दुर्योधनो मन्दः पश्चात्तापं गमिष्यति॥
en: Will the wicked Duryodhana beholding many other mighty warriors slain and fallen on the field, repent for his own folly.

sn: कश्चिद् भीष्मेण नो वैरं शममेकेन यास्यति। शेषस्य रक्षणार्थ च संधास्यति सुयोधनः॥५५
en: Will our enmity end with the sacrifice of Bhima's self alone? Will Suyodhana conclude peace for the safety of the rest of the Kshatriyas?"

sn: एवं बहुविधं तस्य राज्ञश्चिन्तयतस्तदा। कृपयाभिपरीतस्य घोरं युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: When in his heart overflowing with compassion, king Yudhishthira was thus thinking, on the other part of the field.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच निनदन्तं तथा तं तु भीमसेनं महाबलम्। मेघस्तनितनिर्घोष के वीराः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said What heroes of my army resisted the mighty Bhimasena when he was thus roaring like clouds surcharged with thunder?

sn: न हि पश्याम्यहं तं वै त्रिषु लोकेषु कंचन। क्रुद्धस्य भीमसेनस्य यस्तिष्ठेदग्रतो रणे॥
en: O Sanjaya, I do not find that warrior in the three worlds, who can, stand before Bhimasena when he is excited with rage.

sn: गदां युयुत्समानस्य कालस्येवेह संजय। न हि पश्याम्यहं युद्धे यस्तिष्ठेदग्रतः पुमान्॥
en: I do not, O son, find that warrior who can stand before Bhima when in battle with his mace uplifted, he stands like Death incarnate.

sn: रथं रथेन यो हन्यात् कुञ्जरं कुञ्जरेण च। कस्तस्थ समरे स्थाता साक्षादपि पुरंदरः॥
en: He that slays elephants with elephants, destroys cars with cars, who will stand before that Bhima not excepting Indra of hundredsacrifices?

sn: क्रुद्धस्य भीमसेनस्य मम पुत्रान् जिघांसतः। दुर्योधनहिते युक्ताः समतिष्ठन्त केऽग्रतः॥
en: Who amongst those devoted to the interests of Duryodhana, would withstand Bhimasena in battle, excited as he was with wrath and engaged in slaughtering my sons?

sn: भीमसेनदवाग्नेस्तु मम पुत्रांस्तृणोपमान्। प्रधक्षतो रणमुखे केऽतिष्ठन्नग्रतो नराः॥
en: Or What persons, stood before the Bhimaconflagration when it was engaged in consuming the heaps of straw and grass constituted by my sons?

sn: काल्यमानांस्तु पुत्रान् मे दृष्ट्वा भीमेन संयुगे। कालेनेव प्रजाः सर्वाः के भीमं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Who were they that surrounded Bhima in battle, beholding him crush my sons one after another, like Death's self-destroying all creatures?

sn: न मेऽर्जुनाद् भयं तादृक् कृष्णान्नापि च सात्वतात्। हुतभुग्जन्मनो नैव यादृग्मीमाद् भयं मम॥
en: I do not fear Arjuna or Krishna or Satyaki him born of the sacrificial fire (Dhrishtadyumna) so much as I do Bhimasena.

sn: भीमवह्नेः प्रदीप्तस्य मम पुत्रान् दिधक्षतः। के शूराः पर्यवर्तन्त तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: O Sanjaya relate to me, what heroes advanced against the blazing Bhima-fire which so greatly consumed by sons?

sn: संजय उवाच तथा तु नर्दमानं तं भीमसेनं महाबलम्। तुमुलेनैव शब्देन कर्णोऽप्यभ्यद्रवद्बली॥
en: Sanjaya said When the mighty car-warrior Bhimasena was thus roaring, the mighty Karna rushed at him, himself uttering a loud shout (in response).

sn: व्याक्षिपन् सुमहचातमतिमात्रममर्षणः। कर्णः सुयुद्धमाकाङ्क्षन् दर्शयिष्यन् बलं मृधे॥
en: Unable to bear the roar of Bhima, he began to twang his bow capable of withstanding a great strain. Then the mighty Karna, out of a । desire for battle displaying his strength.

sn: रुरोध मार्ग भीमस्य वातस्येव महीरुहः। भीमोऽपि दृष्ट्वा सावेगं पुरो वैकर्तनं स्थितम्॥
en: Checked the career of Bhima; then beholding the son of Vikartana stand before him with hostile intentions, Vrikodara.

sn: चुकोप बलवद्वीरश्चिक्षेपास्य शिलाशितान्। तान् प्रत्यगृह्णात् कर्णोऽपि प्रतीपं प्रापयच्छरान्॥
en: Became inflamed with wrath; and that mighty hero discharged at him numerous shafts whetted on stone. Karna received all those shafts and sped many in return.

sn: ततस्तु सवर्याधानां यततां प्रेक्षतां तदा। प्रावेपन्निव गात्राणि कर्णभीमसमागमे॥ रथिनां सादिनां चैन तयोः :श्रुत्वा तलखनम्। भीमसेनस्य निनदं श्रुत्वा घोरं रणाजिरे॥
en: In that battle between Bhima and Karna, hearing the sound of their Palm-strokes, the limbs of on-looking and fighting warriors and horsemen and elephants, began to tremble. Hearing the deafening roars uttered by Bhimasena on the field of battle.

sn: खं च भूमिं च संरुद्धां मेनिरे क्षत्रियर्षभाः। पुनरिण नादेन पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: The foremost of the Kshatriyas regarded the welkin and the earth to be filled completely by its echo. Then again at the dreadful cries uttered by the illustrious son of Pandu.

sn: समरे सर्वयोधानां धनूंष्यभ्यपतन् क्षितौ। शस्त्राणि न्यपतन् दोर्थ्यः केषांचिचासवोऽद्रवन्॥ वित्रस्तानि च सर्वाणि शकृन्मूत्रं प्रसुस्रवुः। वाहनानि च सर्वाणि बभूवुर्विमनांसि च॥ प्रादुरासन् निमित्तानि घोराणि सुबहून्युत।
en: The bows of all the warriors fell down on the earth. Then, O mighty monarch, seized with, panic and dejected, the steeds and elephants, repeatedly discharged urine and excreta. Numerous dreadful omens of evil then appeared to view.

sn: गृध्रकङ्कबलैश्चासीदन्तरिक्षं समावृतम्॥ तस्मिन् सुतुमले राजन् कर्णभीमसमागमे।
en: During that fierce fight between Karna and Bhimasena, the sky became covered with flights of vultures and Kankas.

sn: ततः कर्णस्तु विंशत्या शराणां भीममार्दयत्।॥ विव्याध चास्य त्वरितः सूतं पञ्चभिराशुगैः।
en: Karna then pierced Bhima with twenty arrows and next swifty pierced the latter's charioteer with five arrows.

sn: प्रहस्य भीमसेनोऽपि कर्ण प्रत्याद्रवद् रणे॥ सायकानां चतुःष्ट्या क्षिप्रकारी महायशाः।
en: Then the highly puissant Bhimasena endued with great activity smilingly sped at Karna in that battle a set of sixty-four arrows.

sn: तस्य कर्णो महेष्वासः सायंकाश्चतुरोऽक्षिपत्॥ असम्प्राप्तांश्च तान् भीमः सायकैर्नप्तपर्वभिः।
en: Then at him, O mighty monarch, Karna shot four arrows. But before these arrows could reach him, with nine arrows of depressed knots, Bhima.

sn: चिच्छेद बहुधा राजन् दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम्॥ तं कर्णश्छादयामास शरवातैरनेकशः।
en: Cut them in numerous parts, displaying at the same time his great lightness of hands. Karna then shrouded him in a net-work of numerous arrows.

sn: संछाद्यमानः कर्णेन बहुधा पाण्डुनन्दनः॥ चिच्छेद चापं कर्णस्य मुष्टिदेशे महारथः।
