en: Thus although shrouded by Karna on all sides, that mighty car-warrior that son of Pandu, cut-off the bow of Karna near his grasp.

sn: विव्याध चैनं बहुभिः सायकैर्नतपर्वभिः॥ अथान्यद् धनुरादाय सज्यं कृत्वा च सूतजः।
en: He then pierced him with many arrows of close knots. Then taking up another bow and stringing it, the son of the charioteer.

sn: विव्याध समरे भीमं भीमकर्मा महारथः॥ तस्य भीमो भृशं क्रुद्धस्त्रीशरान् नतपर्वणः।
en: That mighty car-warrior of dreadful deeds, pierced Bhima in battle (with many arrows). Thereat highly enraged, with three arrows of depressed knots, Bhima..

sn: निचखानोरसि क्रुद्धः सूतपुत्रस्य वेगतः॥ तैः कर्णोऽराजत शरैरुरोर्मध्यगतैस्तदा।
en: Struck with force on the breast of the son of the charioteer. With those arrows struck on the centre of his breast, Karna appeared beautiful like.

sn: महीधर इवोदग्रस्त्रिशृङ्गो भरतर्षभ।॥ सुस्राव चास्य रुधिरं विद्धस्य परमेषुभिः।
en: A mighty mountain with its three peaks towering high. Pierced as he was with those excellent arrows, streams of blood began to flow down his person.

sn: धातुप्रस्यन्दिनः शैलाद् यथा गैरिकधातवः॥ किंचिद् विचलितः कर्णः सुप्रहाराभिपीडितः।
en: Like streams of liquefied red chalk flowing down the sides of a mountain. Afflicted with that might wound inflicted by Bhima, Karna was a little flurried.

sn: आकर्णपूर्णमाकृष्य भीमं विव्याध सायकैः॥ चिक्षेप च पुनर्बाणाशतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: Then fixing an arrow on his bow, O sire, he pierced Bhima therewith; and then shot arrows by hundreds and thousands.

sn: स शरैरर्दितस्तेन कर्णेन दृढधन्विना। धनुर्ध्यामच्छिनत् तूर्ण भीमस्तस्य क्षुरेण ह॥
en: Thus through then quickly covered with arrows by that resolute bowman namely Karna, yet that son of Pandu smilingly cut-off the bow-string of the former.

sn: सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपातयत्। वाहांश्च चतुरस्तस्य व्यंसूश्चक्रे महारथः॥
en: Then with a broad-headed shaft, Bhima dispatched Karna's charioteer to the abode of Death; then that mighty car-warrior deprived the latter's steeds of their lives.

sn: हताश्वात् तु रथात् कर्णः समाप्लुत्य विशाम्पते। स्यन्दनं वृषसेनस्य तूर्णमापुप्लुवे भयात्॥
en: Jumping down from the car of which the steeds were slain, O ruler of men, the mighty car-warrior Karna ascended the chariot of Vrisasena.

sn: निर्जित्य त रणे कर्ण भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। ननाद बलवान् नादं पर्जन्यनिनदोपमम्॥
en: Then the valiant Bhima, having defeated Karna uttered a loud war-cry, that resembled the roar of the rain-cloud Parjannya.

sn: तस्य तं निन्दं श्रुत्वा प्रहृष्टोऽभूद् युधिष्ठिरः। कर्ण पराजितं मत्वा भीमसेनेन संयुगे॥
en: Hearing that roar of his, Yudhishthira became filled with delight, as he thought that Karna had been defeated, O Bharata by Bhimasena.

sn: समन्ताच्छङ्कुनिनदं पाण्डुसेनाकरोत् तदा। शत्रुसेनाध्वनि श्रुत्वा तावका ह्यनदन् भृशम्॥
en: Then the Pandava troops simultaneously blew their conchs. Hearing that sound of challenge emitted by the enemy, your own troops shouted aloud.

sn: स शङ्खबाणनिनदैर्हर्षाद् राजा स्ववाहिनीम्। चक्रे युधिष्ठिरः संख्ये हर्षनादैश्च संकुलाम्॥ गाण्डीवं व्याक्षिपत् पार्थः कृष्णोऽप्यन्जमवादयत्। तमन्तर्धाय निनदं भीमस्य नदतो ध्वनिः। अश्रूयत तदा राजन् सर्वसैन्येषु दारुणः॥
en: Pritha's son, (Arjuna) then twanged his bow and Krishna blew his water-born conch. But drowning all those sounds, the shout of Bhima rose and

sn: ततो व्यायच्छतामस्त्रैः पृथक् पृथगजिह्मगैः। मृदुपूर्व तु राधेयो दृढपूर्व तु पाण्डवः॥
en: Was heard by all your troops, O sire. Then those two combatants, viz., Karma and Bhima each struck the other with straight-flying arrows. The son of Radha shot his shaft mildly, but the son of Pandu shot those of his with great vehemence.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: संजय उवाच तस्मिन् विलुलिते सैनये सैन्धवायार्जुने गते। सात्वते भीमसेने च पुत्रस्ते द्रोणमभ्ययात्॥ त्वरनेकरथेनैव बहुकृत्यं विचिन्तयन्।
en: Sanjaya said When his army had been shattered and when Arjuna, Bhimasena and the Satvata hero Satyaki had all gone after the ruler of the Sindhus, your son Duryodhana proceeded towards Drona.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: स रथस्तव पुत्रस्य त्वरया परया युतः॥ तूर्णमभ्यद्रवद् द्रोणं मनोमारुतवेगवान्।
en: On a single car and in all haste and reflecting on the various measures to be adopted. That chariot of your son driven with great celerity.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: उवाच चैनं पुत्रस्ते संरम्भाद् रक्तलोचनः॥ ससम्भ्रममिदं वाक्यमब्रवीत् कुरुनन्दनः।
en: And endued with the fleetness of the wind or thought, dashed towards Drona. Then your son with eyes red in rage addressing Drona said

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: अर्जुनो भीमसेनश्च सात्यक्श्चिपराजितः॥ विजित्य सर्वसैन्यानि सुमहान्ति महारथाः।
en: Arjuna and Bhimasena and the invincible Satyaki and many other mighty car-warriors, having defeated all our troops.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: सम्प्राप्ताः सिन्धुराजस्य समीपमनिवारताः॥ व्यायच्छन्ति च तत्रापि सर्व एवापराजिताः। यदि तावद् रणे पार्थो व्यतिक्रान्तो महारथः॥ कथं सात्यकिभीमाभ्यां व्यतिक्रान्तोऽसि मानद।
en: Have succeeded in reaching near the ruler of the Sindhus, O slayer of foes. There they are fighting-all these indomitable and mighty car warriors vanquishing all our troops. But O giver of honour, how is it, that you have today been transgressed by Bhima and Satyaki?

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: आश्चर्यभूतं लोकेऽस्मिन् समुद्रस्येव शोषणम्॥ निर्जयस्तव विप्रण्य सात्वतेनार्जुनेन च।
en: O foremost of the Brahmanas, your defeat by that scion of the Satvata race and by Arjuna is wonderful like the drying up of the ocean itself!

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: तथैव भीमसेनेन लोकः संवदते भृशम्॥ कथं द्रोणो जित: संख्ये धनुर्वेदस्य पारगः। इत्येवं ब्रुवते योधा अश्रद्धेयमिदं तव॥
en: People are saying 'How is it that Drona that master of archery has been defeated by Bhimasena indeed all warriors are thus speaking and it should be disgraceful to you. I see that the destruction of my unfortunate self is inevitable.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: नाश एव तु मे नूनं मन्दभाग्यस्य संयुगे। यत्र त्वां पुरुषव्याघ्रं व्यतिक्रान्तास्रयो रथाः॥ एवं गते तुकृत्येऽस्मिन् ब्रूहि यत् ते विवक्षितम्। यद् गतं गतमेवेदं शेषं चिन्तय मानद॥ यत् कृत्यं सिन्धुराजस्य प्राप्तकालमनन्तरम्। तत् संविधीयतां क्षिप्रं साधु संचिन्त्य नो द्विज॥
en: But when, O foremost of men, all the three mighty car-warriors have transgressed you, tell us what you have to say on the business at hand. Let by gones be by-gones. O giver of honour, now think what is to be done at present. Speak quickly what should next be done for the ruler of the Sindhus on the present crisis and let that also be quickly carried out into action.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: द्रोण उवाच चिन्त्यं बहुविधं तात यत् कृत्यं तच्छृणुष्व मे। त्रयो हि समतिक्रान्ताः पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥
en: Drona said O mighty monarch, there are many things to be thought of, but hear what should be done now. Three mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host have penetrated into our army.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: यावत् तेषां भयं पश्चात् तावदेषां पुरःसरम्। तद् गरीयस्तरं मन्ये यत्र कृष्णधनंजयौ॥
en: We have as much cause of apprehension behind those three as we have before them. But to my mind the cause of apprehension is greater there where both Krishna and Dhananjaya are.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: सा पुरस्ताच पश्चाच गृहीता भारती चमूः। तत्र कृत्यमहं मन्ये सैन्धवस्याभिरक्षणम्॥
en: The Bharata army have simultaneously been attacked both from the van and the rear. At this crisis, I consider our foremost duty is to protect the ruler of the Sindhus,

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: स नो रक्ष्यतमस्तात क्रुद्धाद् भीतो धनंजयात्। गतौ च सैन्धवं भीमौ युयुधानवृकोदरौ॥
en: Afraid as he is of the enraged Dhananjaya, he should be regarded as the primary object of our protection, O sire. The two heroes, Vrikodara and Yuyudhana have also proceeded towards the king of the Sindhus,

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: समप्राप्तं तदिदं द्यूतं यत् तच्छकुनिबुद्धिजम्। न सभायां जपो वृत्तो नापि तत्र पराजयः॥
en: The dire result of the game of dice, planned by the ingenuity of Shakuni, has now overtaken you. There were no actual victory or defeat in the assembly in that game.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: इह नो ग्लहमानानामद्य तावजयाजयौ। यान् स्म तान् ग्लहते घोराज्छकुनिः कुरुसंसदि॥ अक्षान् स मन्यमानः प्राक् शरास्ते हि दुरासदाः।
en: Now that we are engaged in this battle, we will reap victory or defeat. Those innocent things with which Shakuni played in the assembly of the Kurus. And which he knew to be dice, are in reality not dice, but mighty arrows incapable of being defeated. Those dice have now been changed into shafts capable of mangling your bodies.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: यत्र ते बहवस्तात कौरवेया व्यवस्थिताः॥ सेनां दुरोदरं विद्धि शरानक्षान् विशाम्पते।
en: Now in this field where numerous Kurus have been assembled, know the troops to be the players and arrows the dice, O ruler of men.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: ग्लहं च सैन्धवं राजंस्तत्र द्युतस्य निश्चयः॥ सैन्धवे तु महद् द्यूतं समासक्तं परैः सह।
en: In this game of dice, know the ruler of the Sindhus to be the stake. Indeed Jayadratha is the precious stake for which we are fighting today.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: अत्र सर्वे महाराज त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः॥ सैन्धवस्य रणे रक्षा विधिवत् कर्तुमर्हथ।
en: For these reasons, O mighty monarch, it behoves us all to effect the protection of the Sindhu king at the very cost of our own lives.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: तत्र नो ग्लहमानानां ध्रुवौ जयपराजयौ॥ यत्र ते परमेष्वासा यत्ता रक्षन्ति सैन्धवम्।
en: O sire, there indeed will our victory of defeat be known where those fierce bowmen are exerting themselves in protecting the king of the Sindhus.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: ॥ तत्र गच्छ स्वयं शीघ्रं तांश्च रक्षस्व रक्षिणः॥ इहैव त्वहमासिष्ये प्रेषयिष्यामि चापरान्।
en: Therefore do you hie yourself to that spot and endeavour to protect those protectors of the Sindhus king. I shall stay here and dispatch others (for helping the Sindhu king).

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: निरोत्स्यामि च पञ्चालान् सहितान् पाण्डुसृञ्जयैः॥२४ ततोऽदुर्योधनोऽगच्छत् तूर्णमाचार्यशासनात्।
en: I shall also engage with the Panchalas united with the Pandavas and the Srinjaya." Then at the command of the preceptor, Duryodhana quickly proceeded to the spot indicated by the former.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: उद्यम्यात्मानमुग्राय कर्मणे सपदानुगाः॥ चक्ररक्षौ तु पाञ्चाल्यौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ।
en: Attend by his followers and bent on achieving a fierce feat. Mean-while the two protectors of Arjuna's car-wheels, viz., the Panchala princes, Yudhamanyu and Uttamanjas.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: बाह्येन सेनामभ्येत्य जग्मतुः सव्यसाचिनम्॥ यौ तु पूर्व महाराज वारितौ कृतवर्मणा।
en: Were proceeding towards Savyasachin, by the skirts of the Kaurava troops. The two princes o monarch, checked by Kritavarman.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: प्रविष्टे त्वर्जुने राजंस्तव सैन्यं युयुत्सया॥ पार्वे भित्त्वा चमूं वीरौ प्रविष्टौ तव वाहिनीम्। पार्बेन सैन्यमायान्तौ कुरुराजो ददर्श ह॥
en: When they were trying to find Arjuna who had penetrated into your army desirous of battle. The king of the Kurus, saw them proceeding by the skirts of his army.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: ताभ्यां दुर्योधनः सार्धमकरोत् संख्यमुत्तमम्। त्वरितस्त्वरमाणाभ्यां भ्रातृभ्यां भारतो बली॥
en: Then the mighty Duryodhana of the Bharata race quickly began a terrible fight with those two broiners endued with great activity.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: तावेनमभ्यद्रवतामुभावुद्यतकार्मुकौ। महारथसमाख्यातौ क्षत्रियप्रवरौ युधि॥
en: Then those two foremost of the Kshatriyas, both classed as Maharathas has assailed Duryodhana with bows ready for use. were

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: तमविध्यद् युधामन्युत्रिंशताः कङ्कपत्रिभिः। विंशत्या सारथिं चास्य चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्॥
en: Then Yudhamanyu pierced him with thirty arrows furnished with wings of the Kankafeathers; the former then pierced the latter's charioteer with twenty and his four horses with four arrows.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: दुर्योधनो युधामन्योर्ध्वजमेकेषुणाच्छिनत्। एकेन कार्मुकं चास्य चकर्त तनयस्तव॥
en: Then with a single arrows Duryodhana cutoff the standard of Yudhamnya; and then with another arrow your son cut-off the latter's bow.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपाहरत्। ततोऽविध्यच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्॥
en: With a bhalla then he felled his adversary's charioteer from his nich in the car and with four arrows wounded the four steeds.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: युधामन्युश्च संक्रुद्धः शरांत्रिंशतमाहवे। व्यसृजत् तव पुत्रस्य त्वरमाणः स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Thereupon Yudhamanyu excited with wrath pierced your son of the breast with thirty arrows in the quickness.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: तथोत्तमौजा: संक्रुद्धः शरैर्हेमविभूषितैः। अविध्यत् सारथिं चास्य प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्॥
en: Similarly Uttamoujas waxing wroth pierced Duryodhana's charioteer with arrows decked with gold and dispatched him to the abode of Death.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: दुर्योधनोऽपि राजेन्द्र पाञ्चाल्यस्योत्तमौजसः। जघान चतुरोऽस्याश्वानुभौ तौ पाणिसारथी॥
en: Duryodhana also, O foremost of kings, slew the four steeds of the Panchala prince Uttamoujas and also both this Parshni-drives.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: उत्तमौजा हताश्वस्तु हतसूतश्च संयुगे। आरुरोह रथं भ्रातुर्युधामन्योरभित्वरन्॥
en: Having his horses and his charioteer stain, Uttamoujas ascended the car of his brother Yudhamanyu with great celerity.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: स रथं प्राप्य तं भ्रातुर्दुर्योधनहयाशरैः। बहुभिस्ताडयामास ते हताः प्रापतन् भुवि॥
en: Ascending the car of his brother, he wounded the horses of Duryodhana with numerous arrows and the horse then slain fell down dead on the ground.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: हयेषु पतितेष्वस्य चिच्छेद परमेषुणा। युधामन्युर्धनुः शीघ्रं शरावापं च संयुगे॥ हताश्वसूतात् स रथादवतीर्य नराधिपः। गदामादाय ते पुत्रः पाञ्चाल्यावभ्यधावत॥
en: Then that foremost of warriors Duryodhana, jumping down from his chariot of which the steeds were slain rushed at the Panchala princes with a mace in his grasp.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य क्रुद्धं कुरुपतिं तदा। अवप्लुतौ रथोपस्थाद् युधामन्यूत्तमौजसो॥
en: Beholding that enraged subduer of hostile cities make towards themselves, Yudhamanya and Uttamoujas jumped down from the terrace of their cars.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: ततः स हेमचित्रं तं गदया स्यन्दनं गदी। संक्रुद्धः पोथयामास साश्वसूतध्वजं नृप॥
en: Then that one armed with the mace, with a stroke of his weapon pressed that excellent car decked with gold to the ground together with its horses charioteer and standards.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: भक्त्वा रथं स पुत्रस्ते हताश्वो हतसारथिः। मद्रराजरथं तूर्णमारुरोह परंतपः॥
en: Thus having slain the steeds and charioteer of his adversaries, your son that afflicter of his foes having his own horses and charioteer slain, ascended the car of the ruler of Madras.

description: The battle between Duryodhana and the Panchalas princes
sn: पञ्चालानां ततो मुख्यौ राजपुत्रौ महारथौ। रथावन्यौ समारुह्य बीभत्सुमभिजग्मतुः॥
en: Those two foremost of Panchalas, those princes both mighty car-warriors, ascending two others cars, proceeded towards Vibhatsu.

sn: संजय उवाच वर्तमाने महाराज संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे। व्याकुलेषु च सर्वेषु पीड्यमानेषु सर्वशः॥
en: Sanjaya said When that hair-stirring battle continued to be fought and when all the warriors were filled with anxiety and were greatly afflicted.

sn: राधेयो भीममानछेद् युद्धाय भरतर्षभ यथा नागो वने मार्ग मत्तो मत्तमभिद्रवन्॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, Radha's son advanced against Bhima for battle, like one infuriate elephant rushing against a compeer in the same state.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यौ तौ कर्णश्च भीमश्च सम्प्रयुद्धौ महाबलौ। अर्जुनस्य रथोपान्ते कीदृशः सोऽभवद् रणः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How raged the battle, near Arjuna's chariot between those two mighty car-warriors, Bhima and Karna, both possessed of great strength?

sn: पूर्व हि निर्जितः कर्णो भीमसेनेन संयुगे। कथं भूयः स राधेयो भीममागान्महारथः॥
en: Once before, Karna was vanquished by Bhima in battle, how could he then again assail Bhimasena?

sn: भीमो वा सूततनयं प्रत्युद्यातः कथं रणे। महारथं समाख्यातं पृथिव्यां प्रवरं रथम्॥
en: How could Bhima proceed against Suta's son, that mighty car-warriors regarded as the foremost of all warriors on earth.

sn: भीष्मद्रोणवतिक्रम्य धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। नान्यतो भयमादत्त विना कर्णान्महारथात्॥
en: Having worsted Bhisma and Drona, the very virtuous king Yudhishthira entertained not so much apprehension from any body else as he did from Karna.

sn: भयाद्यस्य महाबाहोर्न शेते बहुलाः समाः। चिन्तयन् नित्यशो वीर्य राधेयस्य महात्मनः। तं कथं सूतपुत्रं तु भीमोऽयोधयताहवे॥
en: Thinking of the mighty car-warrior Karna, he passes many sleepless nights from fear. How then could Bhima proceed against that son of Suta?

sn: ब्रह्मण्यं वीर्यसम्पन्नं समरेष्वनिवर्तिनम्। कथं कर्ण युधां श्रेष्ठं योधयामास पाण्डवः॥
en: O Sanjaya, how could indeed Bhima fight with Karna, that best of all warriors, that hero devoted to the Brahmana, endued with prowess and never flying away from fight.

sn: यौ तौ समीयतुर्वीरौ वैकर्तनवृकोदरौ। कथं तावत्र युध्येतां महाबलपराक्रमौ॥
en: How did those two mighty car-warriors Karna and Vrikodara fight with each other, in that combat that raged in the neighborhood of Partha's chariot?

sn: भ्रातृत्वं दर्शितं पूर्व घृणी चापि स सूतजः। कथं भीमेन युयुधे कुन्त्या वाक्यमनुस्मरन्॥
en: Knowing his brotherhood towards the Pandavas and possessing a compassionate temperament and remembering the words of Kunti, how could the son of Şuta fight with Bhimasena?

sn: भीमो वा सूतपुत्रेण स्मरन् वैरं पुरा कृतम्। अयुध्यत कथं शूरः कर्णेन सह संयुगे।॥
en: How did Bhima, that hero, fight with Suta's Karna, keeping alive the memory of the wrongs inflicted on him by the latter in days gone by?

sn: आशास्ते च सदा सूत पुत्रो दुर्योधनो मम। कर्णो जेष्यति संग्रामे समस्तान् पाण्डवानिति॥
en: O Suta, my son Duryodhana fondly cherishes the hope that Karna will obtain victory in battle over the united Pandavas.

sn: जयाशा यत्र पुत्रस्य मम मन्दस्य संयुगे। स कथं भीमकर्माणं भीमसेनमयोधयत्॥
en: How did that one, on whom my wicked son's hope of victory rested, fight with Bhimasena of fierce deeds.

sn: यं समासाद्य पुत्रैर्मे कृतं वैरं महारथैः। तं सूततनयं तात कथं भीमो ह्ययोधयत्॥
en: How did Bhima also fight with that son of Suta, O sire, relying on whom my sons provoked hostilities with many mighty carwarriors?

sn: अनेकान् विप्रकारांश्च सूतपुत्रसमुद्भवान्। स्मरमाणः कथं भीमो युयुधे सूतसूनुना॥
en: How did Bhima fight with that son of a charioteer, remembering the numerous wrongs inflicted on them to have their cause in him?

sn: योऽजयत् पृथिवीं सर्वा रथेनैकेन वीर्यवान्। तं सूततनयं युद्धे कथं भीमो ह्ययोधयत्॥
en: How did Bhima fight with that highly puissant son of Suta, who on a single car had vanquished the three worlds?

sn: यो जात: कुण्डलाभ्यां च कवचेन सहैव च। तं सूतपुत्रं समरे भीमः कथमयोधयत्॥
en: How did Bhima then fight with that son of Suta who was born with a pair of (natural) earrings and covered in a coat of mail.

sn: यथा तयोर्युद्धमभूद् यश्चासीद् विजयी तयोः। तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन कुशलो ह्यसि संजय॥
en: As you are conversant with these topies, O Sanjaya, tell me truly in detail how the battle between these two heroes, was fought and who obtained victory.

sn: संजय उवाच भीमसेनस्तु राधेयमुत्सृज्य रथिनां वरम्। इयेष गन्तुं यत्रास्तां वीरौ कृष्णधनंजयौ॥
en: Sanjaya said Abandoning then that foremost of carwarriors namely, the son of Radha, Bhimasena strove to reach the spot where the heroic Krishna and Dhananjaya were.

sn: तं प्रयान्तमभिद्रुत्य राधेयः कङ्कपत्रिभिः। अभ्यवर्षन्महाराज मेघो वृष्ट्येव पर्वतम्॥
en: Then as he was proceeding, the son of Radha assailing him began to shower shafts furnished with wings of Kanka-feather on him, like clouds showering rain on the mountain.

sn: फुल्लता पङ्कजेनेव वक्त्रेण विहसन् बली। आजुहाव रणे यान्तं भीममाधिरथिस्तदा॥
en: Then the valorous son of Adhiratha, with his beautiful face like a blooming lotus lighted up with a smile, challenged Bhimasena as he

sn: कर्ण उवाच भीमाहितैस्तव रणे स्वप्नेऽपि न विभावितम्। तद् दर्शयसि कस्मान्मे पृष्ठं पार्थदिदृक्षया॥
en: Karna said "O Bhima! your foes never thought of your fighting even in their dreams. Why do you show me your back from a desire for seeing Arjuna.

sn: कुन्त्याः पुत्रस्य सदृशं नेदं पाण्डवनन्दन। तेन मामभितः स्थित्वा शरवर्षैरवाकिर॥
en: O delighter of the Panchalas! this conduct is not worthy of the son of Kunti. Confronting me do you cover me with a shower of arrows."

sn: भीमसेनस्तदाबानं कर्णान्नामर्षयद् युधि। अर्धमण्डलमावृत्य सूतपुत्रमयोधयत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Bhimasena then did not put up with that challenge of Karna tamely. But wheeling his car in a semicircle, be began to fight with the son of Suta.

sn: अवक्रगामिभिर्बाणैरभ्यवर्षन्महायशाः। दंशितं द्वैरथे यत्तं सर्वशस्त्रविशारदम्॥
en: In that combat when that one conversant with all weapons and clad in mail viz., Karna was proceeding against him, the illustrious Bhima pierced him with straight-flying arrows.

sn: विधित्सुः कलहस्यान्तं जिघांसुः कर्णमक्षिणोत्। हत्वा तस्यानुगांस्तं च हन्तुकामो महाबलः॥
en: Desirous of reaching the end of all those hostilities, he began to rob Karna's strength, out of a desire for slaying him. Having slain many other Kauravas the mighty Bhima.

sn: तस्मै व्यसृजदुग्राणि विविधानि परंतपः। अमर्षात् पाण्डवः क्रुद्धः शरवर्षाणि मारिष।॥
en: That vindictive son of Pandu, excited with wrath, that slayer of foes, O sire, began to discharge at Karna many showers of fearful arrows.

sn: तस्य तानीषुवर्षाणि मत्तद्विरदगामिनः। सूतपुत्रोऽस्रमायाभिरग्रसत् परमास्त्रवित्॥
en: Then the highly puissant son of Suta, by means of the illusion of his weapon devoured up all those showers of arrows poured by that one of the gait of an infuriate elephant.

sn: स यथावन्महाबाहुर्विद्यया वै सुपूजितः। आचार्यवन्महेष्वासः कर्णः पर्यचरद् बली॥
en: O mighty monarch, duly favoured by knowledge, then that fierce bowman Karna began to career on the field of battle like a teacher of the military science.

sn: युध्यमानं तु संरम्भाद् भीमसेनं हसन्निवा अभ्यपद्यत कौन्तेयं कर्णो राजन् वृकोदरम्॥
en: The wrathful son of Radha then seemed to insult with his smiles, Bhimasena who was fighting in great anger.

sn: तन्नामृष्यत कौन्तेयः कर्णस्य स्मितमाहवे। युध्यमानेषु वीरेषु पश्यत्सु च समन्ततः॥
en: But the son of Kunti did not brook that derisive smile of Radha's, son in the midst of many other brave warriors, who were looking ai that fight between them.

sn: तं भीमसेनः सम्प्राप्तं वत्सदन्तैः स्तनान्तरे। विव्याध बलवान् क्रुद्धस्तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपम्॥
en: Excited to the highest pitch of rage, the mighty Bhimasena, with several Vatsadantas, pierced Karna on the centre of his chest, like a guide goring a mighty elephant with the hook.

sn: पुनश्च सूतपुत्रं तु स्वर्णपुजैः शिलाशितैः। सुमुक्तेश्चित्रवर्माणं निर्बिभेद त्रिसप्तभिः॥
en: Once more with twenty one whetted shafts furnished with wings and duly discharged, Bhimasena pierced Suta's son of variegated armour.

sn: कर्णो जाम्बूनदैर्जालैः संछन्नान् वातरंहसः। हयान् विव्याध भीमस्य पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः॥
en: Then the heroic Karna pierced each of the steeds of Bhima with five shafts, steeds that were decked with golden caparisons and endued with the fleetness of the wind.

sn: ततो बाणमयं जालं भीमसेनस्थं प्रति। कर्णेन विहितं राजन् निमेषार्धाददृश्यत॥
en: O king, thereafter, a net-work-of arrows was woven, within the twinkling of an eye, around the car of Bhima by the mighty Karna.

sn: सरथः सध्वजस्तत्र ससूतः पाण्डवस्तदा। प्राच्छाद्यत महाराज कर्णचापच्युतैः शरैः॥
en: O mighty monarch, the son of Pandu with his car, standard and charioteer, was covered all over with the arrows shot from Karna's bow.

sn: तस्य कर्णश्चतुःषष्ट्या व्यधमत् कवचं दृढम्। क्रुद्धश्चाप्यहनत् पार्थ नाराचैर्मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: Then with sixty-four arrows, Karna shattered the tough armour of Bhima to pieces; and waxing wroth he wounded Pritha's son with Narachas capable of penetrating through the very vitals.

sn: ततोऽचिन्त्य महाबाहुः कर्णकार्मुकनिःसृतान्। समाश्लिष्यदसम्भ्रान्तः सूतपुत्रं वृकोदरः॥
en: Then the mighty-armed Vrikodara unmindful of all those shafts shot from Karna's bow, began to strike dauntlessly the son of Suta.

sn: स कर्णचापप्रभवानिषूनाशीविषोपमान्। बिभ्रद्र भीमो महाराज न जगाम व्यथां रणे॥
en: Bhima then with the body struck with the arrows discharged from Karna's bow, that resembled snakes of virulent poison did indeed feel no pain, O mighty monarch.

sn: ततो द्वात्रिंशता भल्लैर्निशितैस्तिग्मतेजनैः। विव्याध समरे कर्ण भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then the highly puissant Bhimasena pierced Karna in that battle, with thirty-two Vallas of great sharpness and energy.

sn: अयत्नेनैव तं कर्णः शरैर्भृशमवाकिरत्। भीमसेनं महाबाहुं सैन्धवस्य वधैषिणम्॥
en: Then Karna, indifferently covered Bhima of mighty arms and desirous of the slaughter of the Sindhu king, with a tremendous shower of arrows.

sn: मृदुपूव तु राधेयो भीममाजावयोधयत्। क्रोधपूर्व तथा भीमः पूर्व वैरमनुस्मरन्॥
en: In that battle the son of Radha fought mildly with Bhima, but Bhima fought with the former wrathfully remembering all their former hostilities.

sn: तं भीमसेनो नामृष्यदवमानममर्षणः। स तस्मै व्यसृजत् तूर्ण शरवर्षममित्रहा॥
en: Bhima excited with wrath, did not bear that insult; and that slayer of foes quickly sped a shower of shafts at Karna.

sn: ते शरा: प्रेषितास्तेन भीमसेनेन संयुगे। निपेतुः सर्वतो वीरे कूजन्त इव पक्षिणः॥
en: Those shafts then discharged by Bhimasena in that battle, fell upon the heroic Karna like so many humming birds.

sn: हेमपुङ्खा प्रसन्नाग्रा भीमसेनधनुश्च्युताः। प्राच्छादयंस्ते राधेयं शलभा इव पावकम्॥
en: Furnished with golden wings, keen points and discharged from the bow of Bhimasena, those arrows covered Radha's son like fights of insects covering a blazing fire.

sn: कर्णस्तु रथिनां श्रेष्ठश्छाद्यमानः समन्ततः। राजन् व्यसृजदुग्राणि शरवर्षाणि भारत॥
en: Then that foremost of car-warriors viz., Karna covered on all sides with those arrows, Oking, O Bharata, shot numerous fierce arrows at Bhima.

sn: तस्य तानशनिप्रख्यानिषून् समरशोभिनः। चिच्छेद बहुभिर्भल्लैरसम्प्राप्तान् वृकोदरः॥
en: Vrikodara then cut-off with many shafts all those arrows of Karna that ornaments of battle, arrows that resembled the bolt of heaven, before they could reach him.

sn: पुनश्च शरवर्षेण च्छादयामास भारत। कर्णो वैकर्तनो युद्धे भीमसेनमरिंदमः॥
en: But once more, O Bharata, that subduer of foes viz., Vikartana's son Karna, covered Bhimasena with a shower of arrows.

sn: तत्र भारत भीमं तु दृष्टवन्तः स्म सायकैः। समाचिततनुं संख्ये श्वाविधं शललैरिव॥
en: O Bharata, we then beheld Bhimasena thus pierced all over with arrows, resemble a porcupine with its quills erect.

sn: हेमपुङ्खाच्छिलाधौतान् कर्णचापच्युताञ्छरान्। दधार समरे वीरः खरश्मीनिव रश्मिवान्॥
en: Then that hero Vikodara held all those shafts, furnished with golden wings, whetted on stone and shot from the bow of Karna, like the sun holding his own myriad rays.

sn: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गो भीमसेनो व्यराजत। समृद्धकुसुमापीडो वसन्तेऽशोकवृक्षवत्॥
en: His body steeped in blood, Bhima then appeared beautiful like a Asoka tree in the spring covered all over with blossoms.

sn: तत्तु भीमो महाबाहोः कर्णस्य चरितं रणे। नामृष्यत महाबाहुः क्रोधादुद्वत्तलोचनः॥
en: But the mighty armed Bhima with his eyes roiling in rage, did not for long, bear that conduct of Karna in battle patiently.

sn: स कर्ण पञ्चविंशत्या नाराचानां समार्पयत्। महीधरमिव श्वेतं गूढपादैर्विषोल्बणैः॥
en: Thereafter he pierced Karna in battle with twenty five Narachas; pierced therewith Karna appeared beautiful like a white mountain with his sides covered over with snakes of virulent poison.

sn: पुनरेव च विव्याध षभिरष्टाभिरेव च। मर्मखमरविक्रान्तः सूतपुत्रं तनुत्यजम्॥
en: Then once more that one of prowess resembling that of the immortals, pierced that reckless son of a Suta in his vital limbs with two sets of arrows numbering six and eight respectively.

sn: पुनरन्येन बाणेन भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। चिच्छेद कार्मुकं तूर्णं कर्णस्य ग्रहसन्निव॥
en: Again the valiant Bhimasena with another arrow smilingly cut-off the bow of Karna with great quickness.

sn: जघान चतुरश्चाश्वान् सूतं च त्वरितः शरैः। नाराचैरर्करश्म्याभैः कर्ण विव्याध चोरसि॥
en: Quickly did he then slay with his arrows Karna's four steeds and charioteer. He then pierced Karna on the breast with Narachas of the effulgence of solar rays.

sn: ते जग्मुर्धरणीमाशु कर्ण निर्भिद्य पत्रिणः। यथा जलधरं भित्त्वा दिवाकरमरीचयः॥
en: Those winged shafts piercing Karna through, fell down on the earth like the rays of the sun penetrating through masses of rain clouds.

sn: स वैकव्यं महत् प्राप्य छिन्नधन्वा शराहतः। तथा पुरुषमानी स प्रत्यपायाद् रथान्तरम्॥
en: Wounded with those arrows and with his bow cut open, Karna was afflicted with great pain; although proud of his manliness, he then proceeded to another part of the field.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच स्वयं शिष्यो महेशस्य भृगूत्तमधनुर्धरः। शिष्यत्वं प्राप्तवान् कर्णस्तस्य तुल्योऽस्रविद्यया॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Beholding, O Sanjaya, him on whom the hope of victory of my sons rested, compelled to turn his face away from the field of battle, what did king Duryodhana say?

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: तद्विशिष्टोऽपि वा कर्णः शिष्यः शिष्यगुणैर्युतः। कुन्तीपुत्रेण भीमेन निर्जितः स तु लीलया॥ यस्मिञ्जयाशा महती पुत्राणां मम संजय। तं भीमाद् विमुखं दृष्ट्वा किं नु दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Or that disciple of Parasurama is equipped with the merits as expected in disciple. He is even more valorous than his preceptor yet defeated by the son of Kunti, Bhimasena in play way. O Sanjaya! What did Duryodhana express on seeing the one expected to reap victory, so departing as a result of defeated body by Bhimasena?

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: कथं च युयुधे भीमो वीर्यश्लाघी महाबलः। कर्णो वा समरे तात किमकार्षीत् ततः परम्। भीमसेनं रणे दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्॥
en: How did the puissant Bhima ever proud of prowess, fight then? What did then Karna do, Beholding Bhima blaze forth like a mighty fire in battle?

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: संजय उवाच रथमन्यं समास्थाय विधिवत् कल्पितं पुनः। अभ्ययात् पाण्डवं कर्णो वातोद्भूत इवार्णवः॥
en: Sanjaya said Riding on another duly furnished car, Karna then rushed at Pandu's son, like the ocean lashed into fury by the tempest.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: क्रुद्धमाधिरथिं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रास्तव विशाम्पते। भीमसेनममन्यन्त वैश्वानरमुखे हुतम्॥
en: Then, 0 ruler of men, beholding Adhiratha's son excited with rage, your sons considered Bhimasena to be a libation poured on fire.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: चापशब्दं ततः कृत्वा तलशब्दं च भैरवम्। अभ्यद्रवत राधेयो भीमसेनरथं प्रति॥
en: Then dreadfully slapping his palms and producing whizzes with his arrows, the sons of Radha began to shower arrows on the car of Bhimasena.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: पुनरेव तयो राजन् घोर आसीत् समागमः। वैकर्तनस्य शूरस्य भीमस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: Once more, O king, the encounter between the heroic son of Vikartana and the high-souled Bhima, raged furiously.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: संरब्धौ हि महाबाहु परस्परवधैषिणौ। अन्योन्यमीक्षांचक्राते दहन्ताविव लोचनैः॥
en: Filled with wrath and desirous of slaying one another, O mighty-armed one, they began to look at each other as if to burn each other down with their giances.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: क्रोधरक्तक्षणौ तीव्रौ निःश्वसन्ताविवोरगौ। शूरावन्योन्यमासाद्य ततक्षतुररिंदमौ॥
en: Their eyes became fierce and red in rage and the breathed like two snakes. Those two slayers of enemies, those two heroes, then began to mangle each other with their arrows.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: व्याघ्राविव सुसंरब्धौ श्येनाविव च शीघ्रगौ। शरभाविव संक्रुद्धौ युयुधाते परस्परम्॥
en: They fought on with one another like two furious tigers or two swift-flying hawks or two enraged Sarabhas,

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: ततो भीमः स्मरन् क्लेशानक्षद्यूते वनेऽपि च। विराटनगरे चैव दुःखं प्राप्तमरिंदमः॥
en: Then that subduer of foes, viz., Bhima remembering the hardships undergone by him at the game of dice, during his exile in the woods and residence in the city of Virata;

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: राष्ट्राणां स्फीतरत्नानां हरणं च तवात्मजैः। सततं च परिक्केशान् सपुत्रेण त्वया कृतान्॥
en: And recollecting the despoliation of the kingdom swelling with prosperity and gems by your sons and various other injuries inflicted upon the Pandavas, by yourself and the son of Suta;

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: दग्धुमैच्छच्च यः कुन्तीं सपुत्रां त्वमनागसम्। कृष्णायाश्च परिक्लेशं सभामध्ये दुरात्मभिः॥
en: And bearing in mind the fact that you had conspired to burn the innocent Kunti with her sons and remembering the woes of Krishna in the midst of the assembly at the hands of those wretches;

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: केशपक्षग्रहं चैव दुःशासनकृतं तथा। परुषाणि च वाक्यानि कर्णेनोक्तानि भारत।॥
en: As also the holding of her locks by Dushasana and the abusive speech uttered by Karna, O Bharata.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: पतिमन्यं परीप्सख न सन्ति पतयस्तव। पतिता नरके पार्थाः सर्वे षण्ढतिलोपमाः॥
en: To this effect="Take you another husband, for, all your husbands are dead; the sons of Pritha have merged into hell and are like sesamum seed without kernel."

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: समक्षं तव कौरव्य रव्य यदूचुः कौरवास्तदा। दासीभावेन कृष्णां च भोक्तुकामाः सुतास्तव॥
en: Remembering also those words, O descendant of the Kuru race, that were uttered by the Kauravas in your presence and the fact that your son had been desirous of enjoying Krishna as a slave.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: यचापि तान् प्रव्रजतः कृष्णाजिननिवासिनः। परुषाण्युक्तवान् कर्णः सभायां संनिधौ तव॥
en: Recollecting also those words, harsh and cruel, uttered by Karna, when the sons of Pandu were about to go to the forest, clad in deerskins;

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: तृणीकृत्य यथा पार्थास्तव पुत्रो ववल्ग हा विषमस्थान् समस्थो हि संरब्धो गतचेतनः॥
en: And keeping alive in his remmory the brag your vindictive and foolish son, then in prosperity, indulged in holding the woe stricken sons of Pritha in the light of mere

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: बाल्यात् प्रभृति चारिजः स्वानि दुःखानि चिन्तयन्। निरविद्यत धर्मात्मा जीवितेन वृकोदरः॥
en: Indeed the virtuous-souled Bhima that slayer of opponents recollecting all these hardships and those he had undergone since his childhood, became disregardful of his very life.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: ततो विस्फार्य सुमहद्धेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम्। चापं भरतशार्दूलस्त्यक्तात्मा कर्णमभ्ययात्॥
en: Them, o foremost of the Bharatas, stretching his invincible and gold-decked bow, Bhima rushed at Krishna, reckless of his very life.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: स सायकमयैर्जालैभीमः कर्णरथं प्रति। भानुमद्धि शिलाधौतैर्भानोः प्राच्छादयत् प्रभाम्॥
en: Then with a net-work woven with arrows whetted on stone, lustrous like the rays of the sun spread around the car of Karna, Bhima intercepted the rays of the sun.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: ततः प्रहस्याधिरथिस्तूर्णमस्य शिलाशितैः। व्यधमद् भीमसेनस्य शरजालानि पत्रिभिः॥
en: Thereupon Adhiratha's son, smiling (in contempt) tore away Bhima's net-work of arrows, by means of his own winged shafts whetted on stone.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: महारथो महाबाहुर्महाबाणैर्महाबलः। विव्याधाधिरथिर्भीमं नवभिर्निशितैस्तदा॥
en: Then the mighty car-warrior of mighty arms and great strength, viz., that son of Adhiratha, pierced with nine whetted and mighty shafts that mighty warrior Bhima.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: स तोत्रैरिव मातङ्गो वार्यमाणः पतत्रिभिः। अभ्यधावदसम्भ्रान्तः सूतपुत्रं वृकोदरः॥
en: Assailed with those winged shaft, like an elephant assailed with the hook, Vrikodara then dauntlessly rushed against Suta's son.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: तमापतन्तं वेगेन रभसं पाण्डवर्षभम्। कर्णः प्रत्युद्ययौ युद्धे मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम्॥
en: Then as that foremost of the Pandavas was rushing with fury at him, Karna, excited with wrath, rushed at him like an infuriate elephant rushing at another.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: ततः प्रध्यमाष्य जलजं भेरीशतसमखनम्। अक्षुभ्यत बलं हर्षादूर्भूत इव सागरः॥
en: Then blowing his conch whose blast resembled the sound of a hundred Bheris, he agitated the hostile array that resembled the surging sea.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: तदुद्भूतं बलं दृष्ट्वा नागाश्वरथपत्तिमत्। भीमः कर्णे समासाद्य च्छादयामास सायकैः॥
en: Beholding his army teeming with elephants, horses, cars and infantry then agitated, Bhima approaching Karna began to cover him with arrows.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: अश्वानृक्षसवर्णोच हंसवर्णैर्हयोत्तमैः। व्यामिश्रयद् रणे कर्णः पाण्डवं छादयञ्छरैः॥
en: Karna thereupon caused his own horses of the hue of swans to the mingled with those of Bhimasena of the hue of bears and covered in his turn the son of Pandu, with his shafts.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: ऋक्षवर्णान् हयान् कर्मिश्रान् मारुतरहंसः। निरीक्षय तव पुत्राणां हाहाकृतमभूद् बलम्॥
en: Beholding those steeds of the hue of bears and fleet as the wind, mingled with those of Karna of the hue of swans, cries Oh and Alas, rose among the army of your son.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: ते हया बह्वशोभन्त मिश्रिता वारंहसः। सितासिता महारात यथा व्योम्नि बलाहकाः॥
en: Those horses, fleet as the winds, thus mingled together looked exceedingly beautiful like white and black clouds, O king, mingled together in the firmament.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: संरब्धौ क्रोधताम्राक्षौ प्रेक्ष्य कर्णवृकोदरौ। संत्रस्ताः समकम्पन्त त्वदीयानां महारथाः॥
en: Beholding Karna and Vrikodara burning with rage with, their eyes coppery therewith, your mighty car-warriors began tremble with fear.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: यमराष्ट्रोपमं घोरमासीदायोधनं तयोः। दुर्दर्श भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रेतराजपुरं यथा॥
en: The field of battle where they fought, soon became dreadful like the abode of Yama; and O foremost of the Bharatas, it became as repulsive to the sight as the domain of the king of departed spirits.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: समाजमिव तचित्रं प्रेक्षमाणा महारथाः। नालक्षयञ्जय व्यक्तमेकस्यैव महारणे॥
en: Your warriors, who were then looking upon that battle as upon a sport in an arena could not find any of them get any advantage over other.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: तयोः प्रेक्षन्त सम्मर्द संनिकृष्टं महास्रयोः। तव दुर्मन्त्रिते राजन् सपुत्रस्य विशाम्पते॥
en: They only then saw the clash and the mingling of the mighty weapons shot by those warriors, as the consequence brought about by the wicked policy of you and your sons, O ruler of men.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: छादयन्तौ हि शत्रुनावन्योन्यं सायकैः शितैः। शरजालावृतं व्योम चक्रातेऽद्भुतविक्रमौ॥
en: Those two heroes of wonderful prowess, those two slayers of their foes, then-covering each other with their arrows covered next the welkin with the net-work of their arrows.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: तावन्योन्यं जिघांसन्तौ शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्महारथौ। प्रेक्षणीयतरावास्तां वृष्टिमन्ताविवाम्बुदौ॥
en: Desirous of slaying each other, those two mighty car-warriors shooting sharp arrows at each other became worthy of being looked at like two clouds surcharged with rain.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: ॥ सुवर्णविकृतान् बाणान् विमुञ्चान्तावरिंदमौ। भाखरं व्योम चक्राते महोल्काभिरिव प्रभौ॥
en: O Lord, those two subduers of foes shooting arrows decked with gold, 'illumined the welkin like meteors illumining the skies.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: ताभ्यां मुक्ताः शरा राजन् गार्धपत्राश्चकाशिरे। श्रेण्यः शरदि मत्तानां सारसानामिवाम्बरे॥
en: O king, the arrows, furnished with vulterince wings and discharged by Bhima, appeared beautiful like rows of maddened swans ranging through the welkin.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: संसक्तं सूतपुत्रेण दृष्ट्वा भीममरिंदमम्। अतिभारममन्येतां भीमे कृष्णधनंजयौ॥४
en: Then beholding Bhima that subduer of foes engaged with the son of Suta, Krishna and Dhananjaya considered a heavy burden to be placed on the former.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: तत्राधिरथिभीमाभ्यां शरैर्मुक्तैर्दढे हताः। इषुपातमतिक्रम्य पेतुरश्चनरद्विपाः॥
en: As Karna and Bhima, desirous of baffling each other shot numerous arrows, many elephants, horses and men, wounded therewith, fell down dead;

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: पतद्भिः पतितैश्चान्यैर्गतासुभिरनेकशः। कृतो राजन् महाराज पुत्राणां ते जनक्षयः॥
en: And in consequence of those falling and fallen creatures, deprived of life and shouting by thousands, great was the damage that then spread in the ranks of your army.

description: The battle between Bhima and Karna
sn: मनुष्याश्वगजानां च शरीरैर्गतजीवितैः। क्षणेन भूमिः संजज्ञे संवृता भरतर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, the field became soon covered over with the corpses and carcarsses of slain men, horses and elephants.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अत्यद्भुमहं मन्ये भीमसेनस्य विक्रमम्। यत् कर्ण योधयामास समरे लघुविक्रमम्।
en: Dhritarashtra said Indeed I consider Bhima's prowess to be very wonderful, inasmuch as he fought with Karna of great agility.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: त्रिदशानपि वा युक्तान् सर्वशस्त्रधरान् युधि। वारयेद् यो रणे कर्णः सयक्षासुरमानुषान्॥
en: Indeed that Karna who is competent enough of resisting the celestials together with the Yakshas, Asuras and men all armed with numerous kinds of weapon.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: स कथं पाण्डवं युद्धे भ्राजमानमिव श्रिया। नातरत् संयुगे पार्थ तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: How is it that Karna could not vanquish in battle that son of Pritha, of great effulgence? O Sanjaya tell me all you know about it in detail.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: कथं च युद्धं सम्भूतं तयोः प्राणदुरोदरे। अत्र मन्ये समायत्तो जयो वाजय एव च॥
en: Tell me how the battle them raged-battle in which each staked his very life. Messems each of them was capable of conquering or each mighty have suffered defeat, (at the hand of the other).

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: कर्ण प्राप्य रणे सूत मम पुत्रः सुयोधनः। जेतुमुत्सहते पार्थान् सगोविन्दान् ससात्वतान्॥
en: Obtaining Suta's son Karna to help him, my son Duryodhana is confident of securing victory over the Pandavas with Govinda and the Satwatas.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: श्रुत्व तु निर्जितं कर्णमसकृद भीमकर्मणा। भीमसेनेन समरे मोह आविशतीव माम्॥
en: However, hearing of the repeated defeats of Karna by Bhimasena of dreadful deeds, a swoon seems to overtake me. pervert son

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: विनष्टान् कौरवान् मन्ये मम पुत्रस्य दुर्नयैः। न हि कर्णो महेष्वासान् पार्थाञ्जेष्यति संजय॥
en: I regard the Kauravas as already slain, in consequence of the evil policy of my son. O Sanjaya, Karna will never be able to vanquish the sons of Pritha, those illustrious bowmen.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: कृतवान् यानियुद्धानि कर्णः पाण्डुसुतैः सह। सर्वत्र पाण्डवाः कर्णमजयन्त रणाजिरे॥
en: In all the battles that Karna has fought with the sons of Pandu, the latter have worsted him on the field of battle.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: अजेयाः पाण्डवास्तात देवैरपि सवासवैः। न च तद् बुध्यते मन्दः पुत्रो दुर्योधनो मम॥
en: The Pandavas are incapable of being vanquished even by the celestials led by Vasava himself. But my Duryodhana will not take cognisance of this fact.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: धनं धनेश्वरस्येव हृत्वा पार्थस्य मे सुतः। मधुप्रेप्सुरिवाबुद्धिः प्रपातं नावबुध्यते॥
en: Having robbed Yudhishthira the son of Pritha's who is like the Lord of wealth, of his wealth, my foolish son sees not the impending fall, like a searcher of honey (on the mountains).

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: निकृत्या निकृतिप्रज्ञो राज्यं हत्वा महात्मनाम्। जितमित्येव मन्वानः पाण्डवानवमन्यते॥
en: Having robbed by means of his deceit, the kingdom of those high-souled ones, my son conversant with deceit, thinks it to be irrecoverably his own; and so always insults the Pandavas.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: पुत्रस्नेहाभिभूतेन मया चाप्यकृतात्मना। धर्मे स्थिता महात्मनो निकृताः पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥
en: Those high-souled son of Pandu, who ever treaded the paths of rectitude, were also insulted by myself who am over-fondly attached to my sons and am of selfish temperament.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: शमकामः ससोदो दीर्घप्रेक्षी युधिष्ठिरः। अशक्त इति मत्वा तु मम पुत्रैर्निराकृतः॥
en: The foresighted Yudhishthira that son of Pritha, was ever desirous of peace. But my sons turned him out, taking him to be incapable (of launching on war).

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: तानि दुःखान्यनेकानि विप्रकारंश्च सर्वशः। हृदि कृत्वा महाबाहुर्रमोऽयुध्यत सूतजम्॥
en: Bearing in mind all those hardships and all other insults offered to the Pandavas, the mighty-armed Bhima fought with Suta's son.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: तस्मान्ते संजय ब्रूहि कर्णभीमौ यथा रणे। अयुध्येतां युधि श्रेष्ठौ परस्परवधैषिणौ॥
en: O Sanjaya, relate to me, how Bhima and Karna, those two foremost of warriors fought with each other, desirous of taking each other's life.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: संजय उवाच शृणु राजन् यथावृत्तं संग्रामं कर्णभीमयोः। परस्परवधप्रेप्स्वोर्वनकुञ्जरयोरिव॥
en: Sanjaya said Hear, O king, how the battle between Karna and Bhima raged like that between two elephants desirous of slaughtering each other in the forest.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: राजन् वैकर्तनो भीमं क्रुद्धः क्रुद्धमरिंदमम्। पराक्रान्तं पराक्रम्य विव्याध त्रिंशता शरैः॥
en: O king, the enraged son of Vikartana then pierced with thirty arrows that chastiser of foes viz., Bhimasena who excited with rage, had been putting forth his prowess.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: महावेगैः प्रसन्नाग्रैः शातकुम्भपरिष्कृतैः। अहमद् भरतश्रेष्ठं भीमं वैकर्तनः शरैः॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, Vikartana's son then wounded Bhima with many shafts of keen points and great impetuosity and decked with gold.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: तस्यास्यतो धनुर्भीमश्चकर्त निशितैसिभिः। रथानीडाच यन्तारं भल्लेनापतयत् क्षितौ।॥
en: But when Karna was engaged in wounding him, Bhima cut-off his bow with three sharp shafts and then with a Bhalla felled his charioteer from the niche on the car.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: स काङ्क्षन् भीमसनेसर वधं वैकर्तनो भृशम्। शक्तिं कनकवैदूर्यचित्रदण्डां परामृशत्॥
en: Thereupon Vikartana's son longing to compass the slaughter of Bhimasena, took a lance with a staff variegated with gold and lapises.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: प्रगृह्य च महाशक्तिं कालशक्तिमिवापराम्। समुत्क्षिप्य च राधेयः संधाय च महाबलः॥
en: Taking up that fierce lance that resembled a second dart of Death and tilting it and aiming it, the powerful son of Radha.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: चिक्षेप भीमसेनाय जीवितान्तकरीमिव। शक्तिं विसृज्य राधेयः पुरंदर इवाशनिम्॥
en: Hurled it at Bhimasena, charging it with a force capable of taking out Bhima's life. Then like Indra hurling the bolt of heaven, hurling that lance, the son of Radha.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: नवाद सुमहानादं बलवान् सूतनन्दनः। तं च नादं ततः श्रुत्वा पुत्रास्ते हर्षिताऽभवन्॥
en: That puissant descendant of a charioteer's race, uttered a loud roar; and then your sons hearing that loud shout uttered by Karna, became filled with delight.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: तां कर्णभुजनिर्मुक्तामकैवैश्वानरप्रभाम्। शक्तिं वियति चिच्छेद भीमः सप्तभिराशुगैः॥
en: But as that lance of the radiance of fire or the sun was coursing through the skies, Bhima cut it off with seven swift-arrows.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: छित्त्वा शक्तिं ततो भीमो निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभाम्। मार्गमाण इव प्राणान् सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष॥
en: Cutting off that lance resembling a snake just freed from its slough, Bhima, O sire, as if looking out for the opportunity of wrenching the life-breaths out of Suta's son.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: प्राहिणोत् कृतसंरम्भः शरान् बहिणवाससः। स्वर्णपुङ्खाशिलाधौतान् यमदण्डोपमान् मृधे॥
en: Wrathfully pierced the latter with many arrows furnished with wings of peacock's feathers or of gold and whetted on stone and resembling darts of Death.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: कर्णोऽप्यपद् धनुर्गृह्य हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम्। विकृष्य तन्महचापं व्यसृजत् सायकांस्तदा॥
en: Karna also then taking up another terrible bow of golden staff, began to stretch it; and then that highly energetic one began to discharge arrows at Bhima.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: तान् पाण्डुपुत्रश्चिच्छेद नवभिनतपर्वभिः। वसुषेणेन निर्मुक्तान् इव राजन् महाशरान्॥
en: But the son of Pandu cut-off those shafts, with nine shafts of depressed knots shot by himself. Having cut-off, O foremost of men, those arrows shot by Karna.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: छित्त्वा भीमो महाराज नादं सिंह इवानदत्। तौ वृषाविव नर्दन्तौ बलिनौ वासितान्तरे॥
en: O mighty monarch, Bhima uttered a loud war-cry. Roaring at each other like two bulls for the sake of consorting with the same cow.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: शार्दूलाविव चान्योन्यमामिषार्थेऽभ्यगर्जताम्। अन्योन्यं प्रजिहीर्षन्तावन्योन्यस्यान्तरैषिणौ॥
en: Or like two fierce tigers for the sake of the same peace of meat; they strove vigorously to strike each other and each was desirous of finding out the laches of the other.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: अन्योन्यमभिवीक्षन्तौ गोष्ठेष्विव महर्षभौ। महागजाविवासाद्य विषाणाप्रैः परस्परम्॥
en: Like two mighty bulls in a herd of cows, at times they looked at each other with eyes flashing rage. At another time, like two prodigious elephants striking each other with the point of their tusks.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: शरैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः। निर्दहन्तौ महाराज शस्त्रवृष्ट्या परस्परम्॥
en: They assailed each other with their arrows shot from their bow drawn to the fullest stretch. O king, burning each other with their arrowy shower, they put forth their prowess against each other, at the same time looking at each other in great wrath.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: अन्योन्यमभिवीक्षन्तौ कोपाद् विवृतलोचनौ। प्रहसन्तौ तथान्योन्यं भर्त्सयन्तौ मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: Sometimes they laughed at each other, sometimes reproached each other and sometimes blew their conchs; and in this was they went on fighting.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: शङ्खशब्दं च कुर्वाणौ युयुधाते परस्परम्। तस्य भीमः पुनश्चापं मुष्टौ चिच्छेद मारिष॥ इव क्रोधाद्
en: Oking, then once more Bhima cut-off the bow of Karna near the grasp and with his arrows dispatched the latter's steeds of the hue of conch to the regions of Death.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: शङ्खवर्णाश्च तानश्वान् बाणैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्। सारथिं च तथाप्यस्य रथनीडादपातयत्॥
en: The former then felled the latter's charioteer from his niche on the car. Thereupon Vikartana's son was preyed upon by anxious thoughts.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: ततो वैकर्तनः कर्णश्चिन्तां प्राप दुरत्ययाम्। स च्छाद्यमानः समरे हताश्वो हतसारथिः॥
en: His steeds and his charioteer slain and himself covered and compounded with a network of arrows, he knew what to do.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: मोहितः शरजालेन कर्तव्यं नाभ्यपद्यत। तथा कृच्छ्रगतं दृष्ट्वा कर्ण दुर्योधनो नृपः॥
en: Beholding Karna in that predictment, king Duryodhana trembling in rage, addressing

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: वेपमान व्यादिदेशाथ दुर्जयम्। गच्छ दुर्जय राधेयं पुरो ग्रसति पाण्डवः॥
en: “Durjaya, hie yourself to the spot yonder where Pandu's son is on the point of devouring up as it were, the son of Radha. Slay that beardless eunuch soon and inspire strength into Karna.”

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: जहि तूबरकं क्षिप्रं कर्णस्य बलमादधत्। एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा तव पुत्रं तवात्मजः॥
en: Thus spoken to, your son Durjaya bowed assent to the words of your royal son saying 'So be it then;' and then he rushed at Bhimasena engaged with Karna, covering the former with his arrows.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: अभ्यद्रवद् भीमसेनं व्यासक्तं विकिरज्छरैः। स भीमं नवभिर्बाणैरश्वानष्टभिरापर्यत्॥
en: He wounded Bhima with nine, his horses with eight, his charioteer with six, his standard with three, then again himself (Bhima) with seven shafts.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: षभिः सूतं त्रिभिः केतुं पुनस्तं चापि सप्तभिः। भीमसेनोऽपि संक्रुद्धः साश्वयन्तारमाशुगैः॥
en: Thereat excited with wrath, Bhima dispatched Durjaya, his horses and steeds to the abode of Death, piercing them to the vitals with his arrows.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: दुर्जयं भिन्नमर्माणमनयद् यमसादनम्। स्वलंकृतं क्षितौ क्षुण्णं चेष्टमानं यथोरगम्॥
en: Then Karna lamenting piteously circumambulated your son who decked with ornaments was then writhing like a slain snake on the earth.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: रुदन्नातस्तव सुतं कर्णश्चके प्रदक्षिणम्। स तु तं विरथं कृत्वा स्मयन्नत्यन्तवैरिणम्॥
en: Then having made that inveterate enemy of his (Karna) carless, Bhimasena smilingly covered him with numerous arrows and made him look like a Sataghni with numerous pikes on it.

description: The fight between Karna and Bhima
sn: समाचिनोद बाणगणैः शतनीभिश्च शङ्कुभिः। तथाप्यतिरथः कर्णो भिद्यमानोऽस्य सायकैः॥ न जहौ समरे भीमं क्रुद्धरूपं परंतपः॥
en: Although thus mangled with those arrows, that slayer of foes, the Atiratha Karna, did not avoid the enraged Bhima in battle.

sn: संजय उवाच सर्वथा विरथः कर्णः पुनर्भीमेन निर्जितः। रथमन्यं समास्थाय पुनर्विव्याध पाण्डवम्॥
en: Sanjaya said. Thus though deprived of his car and completely vanquished by Bhima, Karna mounting on another car began speedily to pierce the son of Pandu.

sn: महागजाविवासाद्य विषाणाप्रैः परस्परम्। शरैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः॥
en: Then like two huge elephants goring each other with the ends of their tusks, those two heroes began to pierce each other with arrows shot from bows drawn to the fullest stretch.

sn: अथ कर्णः शरव्रातैर्भीमसेनं समार्पयत्। ननाद च महानादं पुनर्विव्याध चोरसि॥
en: Thereupon Karna covered Bhima with mriyads of shafts and then uttered a loud warcry and once more pierced the latter on his breast.

sn: तं भीमो दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यदजिह्मगैः। पुनर्विव्याध सप्तत्या शराणां नतपर्वणाम्॥
en: In return, Bhima pierced him with ten straight-flying arrows and next with twenty arrows of depressed knots.

sn: कर्ण तु नवभिर्भीमो भित्त्वा राजन् स्तनान्तरे। ध्वजमेकेन विव्याध सायकेन शितेन ह॥
en: Karna again, O king, piercing Bhima on the centre of his chest with nine arrows, struck his enemy's standard with one sharp arrow.

sn: सायकानां ततः पार्थस्रिषष्ट्या प्रत्यविध्यत। तोत्रैरिव महानागं कशभिरिव वाजिनम्॥
en: Then with a group of sixty-three arrows Pritha's son, pierced Karna in return like a driver goring his elephant with so many hooks or a horseman lacerating his animal with so many whips.

sn: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज पाण्डवेन यशस्विना। सृक्किणी लेलिहन् वीरः क्रोधरक्तान्तलोचनः॥
en: Thus deeply pierced, O king, by the highsouled son of Pandu, the heroic Karna began to lick the corners of his mouth and his eyes became red in rage.

sn: ततः शरं महाराज सर्वकायावदारणम्। प्राहिणोद् भीमसेनाय बलायेन्द्र इवाशनिम्॥
en: Therefore, O mighty monarch with a view to bring about the slaughter of Bhima, Karna sped at him an arrow capable of penetrating through all bodies, like Indra hurling the thunder.

sn: स निर्भिद्य रणे पार्थ सूतपुत्रधनुश्च्युतः। अगच्छद् दारयन् भूमिं चित्रपुलः शिलीमुखः॥
en: That shaft or variegated wing shot from the bow of Suta's son pierced through the son of Pritha and then penetrating the earth went inside it.

sn: ततो भीमो महाबाहुः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। वज्रकल्पां चतुष्किष्कुंगुवीं रुक्माङ्गदां गदाम्॥ प्राहिणोत् सूतपुत्राय षडस्रामविचारयन्। तया जघानाधिरथेः सदश्वान् साधुवाहिनः॥ गदया भारतः क्रुद्धो वज्रणेन्द्र इवासुरान्। ततो भीमो महाबाहुः क्षुराभ्यां भरतर्षभ॥
en: Thereupon the mighty-armed Bhima with his eyes red in rage, hurled, without thinking for a moment, at the son of Suta, a heavy sixsided mace adorned with gold, measuring full four cubit in length and looking like the bolt of heaven. With that mace, that enraged descendant of the Bharata race slew the welltrained and excellent steeds of Adhiratha's son, like Indra slaying the Asuras with his thunderbolt. Then O mighty monarch, with a couple of razor-headed arrows, the mighty-armed Bhima.

sn: ध्वजमाधिरथेश्छित्त्वा सूतमभ्यहनच्छरैः। हताश्वसूतमुत्सृज्य सरथं पतितध्वजम्॥
en: Cut down the standard of Adhiratha's son and then with other shafts he slew the latter's charioteer. Leaving that car of which the steeds and the charioteer had been slain and of which the standard had been cut down.

sn: विस्फारयन् धनुः कर्णस्तस्थौ भारत दुर्मनाः। तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम राधेयस्य पराक्रसम्॥
en: O Bharata, Karna with a cheerless heart stood before Bhimasena, stretching his bow. Then we beheld the wonderful prowess of Radha's son.

sn: विरथो रथिनां श्रेष्ठो वारयामास यद् रिपुम्। विरथं तं नरश्रेष्ठं दृष्ट्वाऽऽधिरथिमाहवे॥
en: In as much as that foremost of car-warriors though deprived of his car, was successful in holding his enemy in check. Beholding then that foremost of men, that son of Adhiratha deprived of his car in that battle.

sn: दुर्योधनस्ततो राजन्नभ्यभाषत दुर्मुखम्। एष दुर्मुख राधेयो भीमेन विरथीकृतः॥
en: King Duryodhana, O monarch, addressing Durmukha said-"O Durmukha yonder is the son of Radha rendered carless by Bhimasena!

sn: तं रथेन नरश्रेष्ठ सम्पादय महारथम्। ततो दुर्योधनवचः श्रुत्वा भारत दुर्मुखः॥
en: Do you supply that mighty car-warrior, that foremost of men with a chariot.” Thereupon, O Bharata, hearing the words of Duryodhana, Durmukha.

sn: त्वरमाणोऽभ्ययात् कर्ण भीमं चावारयच्छरैः। दुर्मुखं प्रेक्ष्य संग्रामे सूतपुत्रपदानुगम्॥
en: Quickly rushed to the rescue of Karna, covering at the same time Bhima with his arrows. Beholding Durmukha approach to rescue the son of Suta in battle.

sn: वायुपुत्रः प्रहृष्टोऽभूत् सृक्किणी परिसंलिहन्। ततः कर्ण महाराज वारयित्वा शिलीमुखैः॥
en: The son of the wind god became filled with delight and he began to lick the corners of his mouth. Then, O monarch, holding Karna at bay by means of his keen arrows.

sn: दुर्मुखाय रथं तूर्ण प्रेषयामास पाण्डवः। तस्मिन् क्षणे महाराज नवभिनतपर्वभिः॥
en: The son of Pandu drove his chariot towards Durmukha. Then in the encounter that followed, with nine shafts of depressed knots.

sn: सुमुखैर्दुर्मुखं भीमः शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्। ततस्तमेवाधिरथिः स्यन्दनं दुर्मुखे हते॥ आस्थितः प्रबभौ राजन् दीप्यमान इवांशुमान्। शयानं भिन्नमर्माणं दुर्मुखं शोणितोक्षितम्॥ दृष्ट्वा कर्णोऽश्रुपूर्णाक्षो मुहूर्त नाभ्यवर्तत। तं गतासुमतिक्रम्य कृत्वा कर्णः प्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: And keen points, Bhima dispatched Durmukha to the abode of Death. Then upon the slaughter of Durmukha, the son of Adiratha mounting in the car of this slain hero, looked beautiful like the effulgent fire, O king. Then beholding Durmukha prostrate, with his vital limbs torn off and weltering in his blood, Karna with his eyes overflowing with tears, refrained from the fight for a while. Circumambulating that slain prince and passing over him.

sn: दीर्घमुष्णं श्वसन वीरो न किंचित् प्रत्यपद्यत। तस्मिंस्तु विवरे राजन् नाराचान् गार्धवाससः॥ प्राहिणोत् सूतपुत्राय भीमसेनश्चतुर्दश। ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा स्वर्णचित्रं महौजसः॥
en: The heroic Karna breathed hot and heavily and was embarrassed as to what he should do. At this opportunity O king, Bhimasena struck Suta's son with fourteen Narachas furnished with vulterine feathers. Those Narachas of great impetuosity and furnished with golden wings, pierced through Karna's armour;

sn: हेमपुङ्खा महाराज व्यशोभन्त दिशो दश। अपिबन् सूतपुत्रस्य शोणितं रक्तभोजनाः॥
en: Those blood-drinking arrows decked with gold, then illumined the ten quaters and drank the life-blood of Suta's son.

sn: क्रुद्धा इव मनुष्येन्द्र भुजङ्गाः कालचोदिताः। प्रसर्पमाणा मेदिन्यां ते व्यरोचन्त मार्गणाः॥
en: Then passing through his body those arrows sank into the earth and looked like so many snakes urged on by Death, O foremost of men.

sn: अर्धप्रविष्टाः संरब्धा बिलानीव महोरगाः। तं प्रत्यविध्यद् राधेयो जाम्बूनदविभूषितैः॥ चतुर्दशभिरत्युग्रैर्नाराचैरविचारयन्। ते भीमसेनस्य भुजं सव्यं निर्भिद्य पत्रिणः॥
en: With only half their bodies inserted into their holes. Then the son of Radha, without a moment's reflection, pierced Bhimasena in return with fourteen fierce Narachas decked with gold. Those winged shafts piercing the left arm of Bhimasena.

sn: प्राविशन् मेदिनी भीमाः क्रौचं पत्ररथा इव। ते व्यरोचन्त नारावाः प्रविशन्तो वसुंधराम्॥
en: Entered the earth, like Krouncha birds entering into a grove of trees. Entering the earth, those Narachas looked beautiful.

sn: गच्छत्यस्तं दिनकरे दीप्यमाना इवांशवः। स निर्भिन्नो रणे भीमो नाराचैर्मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: Like the burning rays of the sun while it towards the Western mountains. Pierced in both the arms with those Narachas capable of cutting to the very quick, Bhima.

sn: सुस्राव रुधिरं भूरि पर्वतः सलिलं यथा। स भीमनिभिरायत्त: सूतपुत्रं पतत्रिभिः॥
en: courses

sn: सुवर्णवेर्विव्याध सारथिं चास्य सप्तभिः। स विह्वलो महाराज कर्णो भीमशराहतः॥
en: Shed blood profusely, like mountains ejecting streams of water. Then Bhima pierced Suta's son in return with three winged shafts endued with the energy of Suparna and he then pierced the driver of his enemy with seven arrows. Thereupon, O mighty monarch, afflicted with Bhima's mighty and highly distressed, Karna.

sn: प्राद्रवज्जवनैरश्वै रणं हित्वा महाभयात्। भीमसेनस्तु विस्फार्यं चापं हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥ आहवेऽतिरथोऽतिष्ठज्ज्वलन्निव हुताशनः॥
en: Of illustrious renown fled from the field of battle, being borne away by his fleet steeds. Then Bhimasena, that Atiratha remained the master of the field, with his bow of golden staff stretched and looking like a burning fire.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच दैवमेव परं मन्ये धिक् पौरुषमनर्थकम्। यत्राधिरथिरायत्तो नातरत् पाण्डवं रणे॥
en: Dhritarastra said I consider Destiny to be supreme. Fie on the useless exertions of man, inasmuch the son of Adhiratha striving vigorously, was not able to conquer Pandus's son in battle.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: कर्णः पार्थान् सगोविन्दान् जेतुमुत्सहते रणे। न च कर्णसमं योधं लोके पश्यामि कञ्चन॥
en: Karna is capable of conquering the Parthas together with Govinds himself; no where in the worlds do I find a warrior who is a match for Karna.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: इति दुर्योधनस्याहमश्रौषं जल्पतो मुहुः। कर्णो हि बलवाञ्छूरो दृढधन्वा जितक्लमः॥
en: I have always heard Duryodhana speak in this strain. Karna is mighty, heroic, a resolute bowman and indefatigable in battle. was

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: इति मामब्रवीत् सूत मन्दो दुर्योधनः पुरा। वसुषेणसहायं मां नालं देवाऽपि संयुगे॥
en: O Suta, This did my wretched son Duryodhana speak to me before. “Supported as I am by the heroic Vrisashena, even the celestials themselves will not be able to conquer me in battle.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: किं नु पाण्डुसुता राजन् गतसत्त्वा विचेतसः। तत्र तं निर्जितं दृष्ट्वा भुजङ्गमिव निर्विषम्॥
en: What to speak of the sons of Pandu, whose energy is gone and whose strength has been robbed, o king." (This said by Duryodhana say me.) So beholding Karna crushed like a poisonless snake.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: युद्धात् कर्णमपक्रान्तं किंख्दि दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत्। अहो दुर्मुखमेवैकं युद्धानामविशादरम्॥ प्रावेशयद्भुतवहं पतङ्गमिव मोहितः। अश्वत्थामा मद्रराजः कृपः कर्णश्च संगताः॥
en: And fled from the field of battle, what did then Duryodhana say? Alas, foolishly did Duryodhana send the unsupported Durmukha to battle, ignorant though he was of the mode of fighting, like one throwing in insect upon a blazing fire Ashvatthaman, the Madra-king, Kripa and Karna, all united together.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: न शक्ताः प्रमुखे स्थातुं नूनं भीमस्य संजय। तेऽपि चास्य महाघोरं बलं नागायुतोपमम्॥ जानन्तो व्यवसायं च क्रूरं मारुततेजसः। किमर्थ क्रूरकर्माणं यमकालान्तकोपमम्॥ बलसंरम्भवीर्यज्ञाः कोपयिष्यन्ति संयुगे। कर्णस्त्वेको महाबाहुः स्वबाहुबलदर्पितः॥
en: Are not capable, O Sanjaya, of standing before Bhima. They all know the dreadful prowess, equal to that of ten thousand elephants of Bhima possessed of the energy of Maruta himself. They also know his cruel purposes. Why did then those then those warriors, cognizant of Bhima's mighty anger and energy, incite the anger of the hero of cruel deeds, that warrior resembling Yama at the end of a Yuga? I seems that are mighty-armed Karna, relying on the strength of his own arms.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: भीमसेनमनादृत्य रणेऽयुध्यत सूतजः। योऽजयत् समरे कर्ण पुरंदर इवासुरम्॥
en: Encountered Bhimasena in battle, totally disregarding him. He that has conquered Karna in battle, like Purandara conquering Asuras.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: न स पाण्डुसुतो जेतुं शक्यः केनचिदाहवे। द्रोणं यः सम्प्रमथ्यैक प्रविष्टो मम वाहिनीम्॥
en: That son of Pandu is incapable of being conquered by any one else. He that has entered into my army having vanquished Drona singlehandedly.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: भीमो धनंजयान्वेषी कस्तमाछेजिजीविषुः। को हि संजय भीमस्य स्थातुमुत्सहतेऽग्रतः॥
en: What persons desirous of his life with will venture to stand before that Bhima when he will proceed in search of Dhananjaya? ) Sanjaya, what person venture to stand in front of Bhima.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: उद्यताशनिहस्तस्य महेन्द्रस्येव दानवः। प्रेतराजपुरं प्राप्य निवर्तेतापि मानवः॥
en: For, what Danava will venture to stand before Mahendra with his thunder-bolt uplifted? It is possible for a man to come back from a visit of the regions of Death;

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: न भीमसेनं सम्प्राप्य निवर्तेत कदाचन। पतङ्गा इव वह्निं ते प्राविशन्नल्पचेतसः॥ ये भीमसेनं संक्रुद्धमन्वधावन् विमोहिताः। यत् तत् सभायां भीमेन मम पुत्रवधाश्रयम्॥ उक्तं संरम्भिणोग्रेण कुरूणां शृण्वतां तदा। तन्नूनमभिसंचिन्त्य दृष्ट्वा कर्ण च निर्जितम्॥
en: But it not possible for them to come back alive after an encounter with Bhima. Those who foolishly assail Bhimasena when he is inflamed with rage are-like insects rushing on the blazing flames of a fire. Such thinking what the irate Bhima of fearful hands had said to the assembly in the hearing of the Kurus about the slaughter of my sons and beholding the defeat of Karna.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: दुःशासनः सह भ्रात्रा भयाद् भीमादुपारमत्। यश्च संजय दुर्बुद्धिरब्रवीत् समितौ मुहुः॥ कर्णो दुःशासनोऽहं च जेष्यामो युधि पाण्डवान्। स नूनं विस्थं दृष्ट्वा कर्ण भीमेन निर्जितम्॥
en: Dushasana and his brothers ceased to meet Bhima in battle out of fear. That pervert son of mine, O Sanjaya, who repeatedly said in the assembly these words-Karna and Dushasana and I myself will vanquish the Pandavas in battle-surely beholding Karna vanquished and deprived of his car by Bhima.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: प्रत्याख्यानाच कृष्णस्य भृशं तप्यति पुत्रकः। दृष्ट्वा भ्रातृन् हतान् संख्ये भीमसेनेन दंशितान्॥
en: Is now repenting his rejection of Krishna's offer for peace. Beholding his mail-clad brother's slain in battle by Bhimasena.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: आत्मापराधे सुमहन्नूनं तप्यति पुत्रकः। को हि जीवितमन्विच्छन् प्रतीपं पाण्डवं व्रजेत्॥
en: In consequence of his own fault surely my son is being greatly afflicted. What person willing to live still, with hostile intentions, advance against Pandu's son.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: भीमं भीमायुधं क्रुद्धं साक्षात् कालमिव स्थितम्। वडवामुखमध्यस्थो मुच्येतापि हि मानवः॥
en: Bhima, inflamed with rage and armed with dreadful weapons and standing in battle like Death himself? It is possible for a man to escape from Varava fire.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: न भीममुखसम्प्राप्तो मुच्येदिति मतिर्मम। न पार्था हि पञ्चाला न च केशवसात्यकी॥
en: But it is not possible for one to fly from the presence of the enraged Bhima. Indeed neither Arjuna, nor the Panchalas, nor Keshava, nor Satyaki.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: जानते युधि संरब्धा जीवितं परिरक्षितुम्। अहो मम सुतानां हि विपन्नं सूत जीवितम्॥
en: When excited with rage in battle, pays the least regard to his life. Alas, O son of a charioteer, the very lives of my sons are in danger.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: संजय उवाच यस्त्वं शोचसि कौरव्य वर्तमाने महाभये। त्वमस्य जगतो मूलं विनाशस्य न संशयः॥
en: Sanjaya said O descendant of the Kuru dynasty, why are you now lamenting for the present carnage? Surely you are the root of this destruction of the worlds.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: स्वयं वैरं महत् कृत्वा पुत्राणां वचने स्थितः। उच्यमानो न गृह्णीघे मर्त्यः पथ्यमिवौषधम्॥
en: Accepting the counsels of your sons, it was you who provoked all those fierce hostilities. Though advised on the contrary, you did not pay any heed to those advices, like a dying man refusing to take proper medicines,

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: स्वयं पीत्वा महाराज कालकूटं सुदुर्जरम्। तस्येदानी फलं कृत्स्नमवाप्नुहि नरोत्तम।॥
en: O best of men, Oking, having drunk the fiercest and most indigestible poison, you should now feel the consequences.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: यत् तु कुत्सयसे योधान् युध्यमानान् महाबलान्। तत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि यथा युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: The warriors of your army are fighting to the best of their prowess, yet you speak depreciatingly of them. Hear now, as I go on describing how this battle raged.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: दृष्ट्वा कर्ण तु पुत्रास्ते भीमसेनपराजितम्। नामृष्यन्त महेष्वासाः सोदर्याः पञ्च भारत॥
en: Beholding Karna defeated by Bhimasena, the following five and mighty bowmen all brothers.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: दुर्मर्षणो दुःसहश्च दुर्मदो दुर्धरो जयः। पाण्डवं चित्रसंनाहास्तं प्रतीपमुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Namely, Durmarsena, Dussaha, Durmada, Durdhara and Jaya, all clad in beautiful armours, rushed against the son of Pandu with hostile intentions.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: ते समन्तान्महाबाहुं परिवार्य वृकोदरम्। दिशः शरैः समावृण्वशलभानामिव व्रजैः॥
en: Surrounding the mighty-armed Vrikodara on all sides, they began to cover the quarters with their arrows resembling flights of locusts.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: आगच्छतस्तान् सहसा कुमारान् देवरूपिणः। प्रतिजग्राह समरे भीमसेनो हसन्निव॥
en: Then Bhimasena smilingly received those princes of godly presence as they advanced furiously against him.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: तव दृष्ट्वा तु तनयान् भीमसेनपुरोगतान्। अभ्यवर्तते राधेयो भीमसेनं महाबलम्॥
en: Then beholding your sons before the enraged Bhimasena, Radha's son rushed against the mighty-armed Bhima.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: विसृजन विशिखांस्तीक्ष्णान् स्वर्णपुङ्खाञ्छिलाशितान्। तं तु भीमोऽभ्ययात् तूर्ण वार्यमाणः सुतैस्तव॥
en: Although opposed by your sons, yet Bhima then quickly rushed against Karna shooting sharp arrows, furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: कुरवस्तु ततः कर्ण परिवार्य समन्ततः। अवाकिरन् भीमसेनं शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Thereupon the Kurus surrounding Karna, on all sides, began to shower upon Bhimasena, numerous arrows of depressed knots.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: तान् बाणैः पञ्चविंशत्या साश्वान् राजन् नरर्षभान्। ससूतान् भीमधनुषो भीमो निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥
en: Then that fierce bowman Bhima, with twenty-five arrows dispatched to the abode of Yama, those foremost of men, with their steeds and charioteers.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: प्रापतन् स्यन्दनेभ्यस्ते सार्ध सूतैर्गतासवः। चित्रपुष्पधरा भग्ना वातेनेव महाद्रुमाः॥
en: They then fell down dead from their cars, after their charioteers, like so many mighty trees decked with flowers, overthrown by a hurricane.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम भीमसेनस्य विक्रमम्। संवार्याधिरथिं बाणैर्यञ्जघान तवात्मजान्॥
en: Then we beheld the wonderful prowess of Bhimasena, inasmuch as he succeeded in slaying your sons and withstanding Karna with his arrows simultaneously.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: य वार्यमाणो भीमेन शितैर्बाणैः समन्ततः। सूतपुत्रो महाराज भीमसेनमवैक्षत॥
en: Opposed on all sides by sharp arrows shot by Bhimasena, that son of Suta, O mighty : monarch, began to eye Bhima.

description: Continuous The display of Bhima's prowess
sn: तं भीमसेनः संरम्भात् क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। विस्फार्य सुमहचापं मुहुः कर्णमवैक्षत॥
en: Bhimasena also, with his eyes red in anger and stretching his bow, began to look to Karna.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: संजय उवाच तवात्मजांस्तु पतितान् दृष्ट्वा कर्णः प्रतापवान्। क्रोधेन महताऽऽविष्टो निर्विण्णोऽभूत् स जीवितात्॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding your sons fallen on the field, the puissant Karna, overwhelmed with rage, became regardless of his very life.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: आगस्कृतमिवात्मानं मेने चाधिरथिस्तदा। यत्प्रत्यक्षं तव सुता भीमेन निहता रणे॥
en: The son of Adhiratha then considered himself to be guilty of the slaughter of your sons, in as much as they were slain by Bhima under his very eyes.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: भीमसेनस्ततः क्रुद्धः कर्णस्य निशिताशरान्। निचखान स सम्भ्रान्तः पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्॥
en: Then Bhimasena waxing wroth and remembering their former enmity, dauntlessly struck Karna with numerous sharp arrows.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: स भीमं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा राधेयः प्रहसन्निव। पुनर्विव्याध सप्तत्या स्वर्णपुङः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Thereupon the son of Radha smilingly piercing Bhima with five shafts, once more pierced him with seventy shafts furnished with golden wings whetted on stone.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: अविचिन्त्याथ तान् बाणान् कर्णेनास्तान् वृकोदरः। रणे विव्याध राधेयं शतेनानतपर्वणाम्॥
en: Without taking into consideration those shafts shot by Karna, Vrikodara pierced him with a hundred arrows of depressed knots.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: पुनश्च विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्विद्ध्वा मर्मसु पञ्चभिः। धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष॥
en: Once more, O sire, piercing him on his vital parts with five sharp arrows, Bhima severed the bow of Suta's son with a broad-headed shaft.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय कर्णो भारत दुर्मनाः। इषुभिश्छादयामास भीमसेनं परंतपः॥
en: Thereupon, O Bharata, highly dejected, Karna took up another bow and covered Bhima with arrows on all directions.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: तस्य भीमो हयान् हत्वा विनिहत्य च सारथिम्। प्रजहास महाहासं कृते प्रतिकृते पुनः॥
en: Slaying Karna's horses and his charioteer also, Bhima then laughed a tremendous laugh, having thus counter-balanced the feats of the former.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: इषुभिः कार्मुकं चास्य चकर्त पुरुषर्षभः। तत् पपात महाराज स्वर्णपृष्ठं महाखनम्॥
en: Then that foremost of men, cut-off the bow of Karna with his arrows; and O mighty monarch, that bow of golden staff, fell down, producing a great sound.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: अवारोहद् रथात् तस्मादथ कर्णो महारथः। गदां गृहीत्वा समरे भीमाय प्राहिणोद् रुषा॥
en: Thereupon the mighty car-warrior Karna descended from his chariot and taking up a mace hurled it at Bhimasena with great fury.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: तामापतन्तीमालक्ष्य भीमसेनो महागदाम्। शरैरवारयद् राजन् सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Beholding that mace towards himself with great impetuosity, Vrikodara repulsed it with his arrows before the eyes of all the troops.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: ततो बाणसहस्राणि प्रेषयामास पाण्डवः। सूतपुत्रवधाकाङ्क्षी त्वरमाणः पराक्रमी॥
en: Then the puissant son of Pandu quickly shot thousands of arrows, desirous of accomplishing the death of Suta's son.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: तानिषूनिषुभिः कर्णो वारयित्वा महामृधे। कवचं भीमसेनस्य पाट्यामास सायकैः॥
en: Checking those arrows with his own, in that battle, Karna cut down Bhima's arīnour with numerous arrows. course

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या नाराचानां समार्पयत्। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Then he pierced Bhima with twenty five small shafts before the eyes of all; and that seemed highly wonderful.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: ततो भीमो महाबाहुर्नवभिनतपर्वभिः। प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धः सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष॥
en: Thereupon, O sire, Bhima excited to the highest pitch of fury, sped at the son of Suta nine shafts of depressed knots.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा तथा बाहुं च दक्षिणम्। अध्ययुर्धरणी तीक्ष्णा वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः॥
en: Those sharp arrows penetrating through Karna's armour and piercing his right arm, sank into the earth, like so many fierce snakes entering their holes on ant hills.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: स च्छाद्यमानो बाणौधैर्भीमसेनधनुश्चयुतैः। पुनरेवाभवत् कर्णो भीमसेनात् पराङ्मुखः॥
en: Covered with the myriad shafts shot from Bhima's bow, Karna once more was compelled to turn away from Bhimasena.

description: Continuous The fight between Bhima and Karna
sn: तं पराङमुखमालोक्य पदाति सूतनन्दनम्। कौन्तेयशरसंछन्नं राजा दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Beholding the son of Suta turn away and walk on foot and covered with the arrows shot from the bow of Kunti's son, king Duryodhana
