en: That hero had, for the slaughter of Drona, been obtained by Drupada, that ruler of men, at a great sacrifice, from the God of Fire.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: स धनुर्जेत्रमादाय घोरं जलदनिःस्वनम्। दृढज्यमजरं दिव्यं शरं चाशीविषोपमम्॥ संदधे कार्मुके तस्मिंस्ततस्तमनलोपमम्। द्रोणं जिघांसुः पाञ्चाल्यो महाज्वालमिवम्लम्॥ तस्य रूपं शरस्यासीद् धनुर्ध्यामण्डलान्तरे। द्योततो भास्करस्येव धनान्ते परिवेषिणः॥
en: Impelled by the desire of slaying Drona, he grasped a victory-giving and strong bow, of which the twang resembled the rumble of clouds, of which the string was very tough and which was irrifragible and of celestial make. He then fixed on the bow-string a formidable arrow resembling a snake of virulent poison and endued with the effulgence of fire. That arrow resembled a fire of fierce tongues, while inside the circle of his bow appeared like the autumnal sun of great splendour within an effulgent circle.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: पार्षतेन परासृष्टं ज्वलन्तमिव तद् धनुः। अन्तकालमनुप्राप्तं मेनिरे वीक्ष्य सैनिकाः॥
en: Beholding that resplendent bow bent by the son of Prisata, the soldiers considered that the last hour of the world had come.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: तमिषु संहतं तेन भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। दृष्ट्वामन्यत देहस्य कालपर्यायमागतम्॥
en: Seeing then that arrow directed at him, the mighty son of Bharadvaja considered that the last day of the corporal existence had arrived.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: ततः प्रयत्नमातिष्ठदाचार्यस्तस्य वारणे। न चास्यास्त्राणि राजेन्द्र प्रादुरासन्महात्मनः॥
en: The preceptor then did not endeavour to baffle that shaft, nor did also the celestial was weapons of that high-souled hero appear at his command.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: तस्य त्वहानि चत्वारि क्षपा चैकास्यतो गता। तस्य चाह्नस्त्रिभागेन क्षयं जग्मुः पतत्रिणः॥
en: His weapons had not been exhausted although he had used them for four days and one night; on the expiration of the third part of the fifth day, his stock of arrows exhausted.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: स शरक्षयमासाद्य पुत्रशोकेन चार्दितः। विविधानां च दिव्यानामस्त्राणामप्रसादतः॥
en: Beholding then the exhaustion of his shafts and pained with grief on account of his son's death and in consequence also of the reluctance of the celestial weapons to appear at his command.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: उत्स्रष्टुकामः शस्त्राणि ऋषिवाक्यप्रचोदितः। तेजसा पूर्यमाणश्च युयुधे न यथा पुरा॥
en: He desired to lay his weapon aside urged to do so by the words of the sages. Though still charged with great energy, he was unable to fight as before.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: भूयश्चान्यत् समादाय दिव्यमाङ्गिरसं धनुः। शरांश्च ब्रह्मदण्डाभान् धृष्टद्युम्नमयोधयत्॥
en: Then taking up another bow of celestial make, presented to him by Angiras and several arrows resembling the curses of Brahmanas, he went on fighting with Dhristadyumna.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: ततस्तं शरवर्षेण महता समवाकिरत्। व्यशातयश्च संक्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नममर्षणम्॥
en: Then he covered Dhristadyumna with a thick shower of arrows and filled with rage began to mangle his vindictive antagonist.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: शरांश्च शतधा तस्य द्रोणश्चिच्छेद सायकैः। ध्वजं धनुश्च निशितैः सारथिं चाप्यपातयत्॥
en: Then with his own arrows Drona cut-off those of Dhristadyumna in hundred pieces and then with sharp arrows he felled the standard, the bow and the charioteer of the latter.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रहस्यान्यत् पुनरादाय कार्मुकम्। शितेन चैनं बाणेन प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Thereupon Dhristadyumna smilingly taking up another bow, pierced Drona in return with a sharp arrows in the centre of his breast.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासोऽसम्भ्रान्त इव संयुगे। भल्लेन शितधारेण चिच्छेदास्य पुनर्धनुः॥
en: Thus deeply pierced the mighty bowman (Drona) seemed a little flurried in that combat. But once more with a keen-edged bhalla he cut-off his opponent's bow.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: यचास्य बाणविकृतं धनूंषि च विशाम्पते। सर्वं चिच्छेद दुर्घर्षो गदां खङ्गं च वर्जयन्॥
en: Then indomitable Drona cut-off all the weapons, o king and all the bows of his antagonist, except only his mace and sword.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नं च विव्याध नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः। जीवितान्तकरैः क्रुद्धः क्रुद्धरूपं परंतपः॥
en: Then, O subduer of foes, filled with rage, he pierced the wrathful Dhristadyumna with nine sharp arrows capable of putting an end to the life of every body.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नोऽथ तस्याश्वान् स्वरथावैर्महारथः। व्यामिश्नयदमेयात्मा ब्राह्ममस्त्रमुदीरयन्॥
en: The mighty car-warrior Dhristadyumna of immeasurable soul then invoked into existence the Brahma weapon and thereby caused the horses of his own chariot mix with those of his opponents.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: ते मिश्रा बह्वशोभन्त जवना वातरंहसः। पारावतसवर्णाश्च शोणाश्वा भरतर्षभ॥
en: Possessed of the fleetness of the wind, these steeds of the crimson and pegion colours, O foremost of the Bharatas, thus mingled together, appeared highly beautiful.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: यथा सविद्युतो मेघा नदन्तो जलदागमे। तथा रेजुर्महाराज मिश्रिता रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Like roaring clouds surcharged with flashes of lightning at the commencement of the rainy season, Omighty monarch, those steeds mingled together.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: ईषाबन्धं चक्रबन्धं रथबन्धं तथैव च। प्राणाशयदमेयात्मा धृष्टद्युम्नस्य स द्विजः॥
en: arrows Then that regenerate one of immeasurable soul, destroyed the wheel-joints, the shaftjoints and other car-joints of Dhristadyumna.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: स च्छिन्नधन्वा पाञ्चाल्यो निकृत्तध्वजसारथिः। उत्तमामापदं प्राप्य गदां वीरः परामृशतः॥
en: With his bow cut-off, his car rendered useless, his elephants and driver slain and thus involved in a perilous situation that hero began to whirl his mace.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: तामस्य विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्षिप्यमाणां महारथः। निजधान शरैर्दोणः क्रुद्धः सत्यपराक्रमः॥
en: Then that truly valiant and mighty carwarrior the enraged Drona, destroyed with his sharp that mace hurled by Dhristadyumna.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: तां तु दृष्ट्वा नरव्याघ्रो द्रोणेन निहतां शरैः। विमलं खङ्गमादत्त शतचन्द्रं च भानुमत्॥
en: Beholding that mace of his cut-off by Drona by means of his arrows, that foremost of men, that prince of the Panchalas, quickly took up a clean sword and a resplendent shield with its ground decked with hundred moons.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: असंशयं तथाभूतः पाञ्चाल्य: साध्वमन्यत। वधमाचार्यमुख्यस्य प्राप्तकालं महात्मनः॥
en: Undoubtedly, under these circumstances, the Panchala prince resolved to make an end of that foremost of preceptor, that most illustrious warrior.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: ततः स रथनीडस्थं स्वरथस्य रथेषया। अगच्छदसिमुद्यम्य शतचन्द्रं च भानुमत्॥
en: Then jumping down from the terrace of his chariot and riding on the car-shaft he with his sword and bright shield uplifted, tried to approach the latter seated on his chariot.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: चिकीर्षुर्दुष्करं कर्म धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः। इयेष वक्षो भेत्तुं स भारद्वाजस्य संयुगे।॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior Dhristadyumna, out of foolishness and for achieving a difficult feat, wished to tear open the breast of Bharadvaja's son in battle.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: सोऽतिष्ठद् युगमध्ये वै युगसन्नहनेषु च। जघनार्धेषु चाश्वानां तत् सैन्याः समपूजयन्॥
en: Sometimes he stood on the yoke of Drona's car and sometimes under the haunch's of his red steeds. These motions of his were then greatly praised by all the troops.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: तिष्ठतो युगपालीषु शोणानष्यधितिष्ठतः। नापश्यदन्तरं द्रोणस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: While he thus stood upon the yoke or underneath the haunches of those red steeds, Drona saw no opportunity for striking him. That indeed appeared wonderful.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: क्षिप्रं श्येनस्य चरतो यथैवामिषगृद्धिनः। तद्वदासीदबीसारो द्रोणपार्षतयो रणे॥
en: Then in that battle the movements of both Drona and the son of Prisata resembled those of a hawk flying through the sky in quest of a piece of meat.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: तस्य पारावतानश्वान् रथशक्त्या पराभिनत्। सर्वानेकैकशो द्रोणो रक्तानश्वान् विवर्जयन्॥
en: Thereafter the puissant Drona inflamed with rage, slew one after another the blue-hued steeds of his adversary and then destroyed his car, with a powerful shaft.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: ते हता न्यपतन् भूमौ धृष्टद्युम्नस्य वाजिनः। शोणास्तु पर्यमुच्यन्त रथबन्धाद् विशाम्पते॥
en: The steeds of Dhristadyumna, thus slain fell down on the ground, whereupon the red steeds of Drona himself were set free from the entanglement in the trappings, O ruler of men.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: तान् हयान् निहतान् दृष्ट्वा द्विजाग्र्येण स पार्षतः। नामृष्यत युधां श्रेष्ठो याज्ञसेनिर्महारथः॥
en: Beholding those horses slain by that foremost of regenerate ones, that son of Prisata, that foremost of all warriors, born in virtue of a sacrifice, that mighty car-warrior, did not tolerate it.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: विस्थः स गृहीत्वा तु खङ्गं खगभृतां वर। द्रोणमभ्यपतद् राजन् वैनतेय इवोरगम्॥
en: Then that foremost of sword-men, deprived took up his sword and rushed upon Drona, O king, like Vinata swooping down of his car, upon a snake.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: तस्य रूपं बभौ राजन् भारद्वाजं जिघांसतः। यथा रूपं पुरा विष्णोर्हिरण्यकशिपोर्वधे॥
en: Solicitous of slaying the son of Bharadvaja, O king, his appearance then resembled that of Hari when, in days of yore, he was going to slay the Daitya king Hiranyakasipu.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: स तदा विविधान् मार्गान् प्रवरांश्चैकविंशतिम्। दर्शयामास कौरव्य पार्षतो विचरन् रणे॥
en: He then coursed in various tracks. Indeed, o foremost of the descendants of Kuru, Prisata's son carcering in that battle, displayed the well-known twenty-one kinds of evolution's.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: भ्रान्तमुद्भान्तमाविद्धमाप्लुतं प्रसृतं सृतम्। परिवृत्तं निवृत्तं च खङ्गं चर्म च धारयन्॥ सम्पातं समुदीर्णं च दर्शयामास पार्षतः। भारतं कौशिकं चैव सात्वतं चैव शिक्षया॥ दर्शयन् व्यचरद् युद्धे द्रोणस्यान्तचिकीर्षया। चरतस्तस्य तान् मार्गान् विचित्रान् खड्गचर्मिणः॥
en: Armed with his sword and his buckler in grasp the son of Prisata, wheeled about, whirled his sword in the air, made side thrusts, rushed forward, ran sideways, jumped up, assailed the sides of his foes, fell backwards, ran into close quarters with his enemy and pressed them hard. having practised them well he also exhibited the movements, known as Bharata, Kousika and Satvata, as he coursed in battle for bringing about Drona's death. Beholding those charming movements of Dhristadyumna, as he coursed, armed with shield and sword in battle.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: व्यस्मयन्त रणे योधा देवताश्च समागताः। ततः शरसहस्रेण शतचन्द्रमपातयत्॥ चर्म खङ्गं च सम्बाधे धृष्टद्युम्नस्य स द्विजः। ये तु वैतस्तिका नाम शरा आसन्नयोधिनः॥
en: All the warriors present as also the celestials, were filled with amazement. The twice-born Drona then discharging a thousand arrows in the press of the battle, cut-off Dhristadyumna's sword and shield covered with hundred moons. The arrows that Drona shot in that fight in close quarters were of the length of a span.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: निकृष्टयुद्धे द्रोणस्य नान्येषां सन्ति ते शराः। ऋते शारद्वतात् पार्थाद् द्रौणे(कर्तनात् तथा॥
en: Those arrows were only to be used in a fight in close quarters. No one else had arrows of that kind, except Saradvata's son Kripa, Arjuna, Ashvatthaman and Karna.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: प्रद्युम्नयुयुधानाभ्यामभिमन्योश्च भारत। अथास्येषु समाधत्त दृढं परमसम्मतम्॥ अन्तेवासिनमाचार्यो जिघांसुः पुत्रसम्मितम्। तं शरैर्दशभिस्तीक्ष्णैश्चिच्छेद शिनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Pradyumna ard Yuyudhana possessed such arrows and also Abhimanyu had them. The preceptor then desirous of making an end of his pupil who was to him like his own son, placed on his bow-string, a strong shaft possessed of great violence. Satyaki however cut-off that saft with ten arrows of his own.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: पश्यतस्तव पुत्रस्य कर्णस्य च महात्मनः। ग्रस्तमाचार्यमुख्येन धृष्टद्युम्नममोचयत्॥
en: Before the eyes of your son and of Karna of high-soul, he then thus saved Dhristadyumna who was on the point of falling a victim to Drona.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: चरन्तं रथमार्गेषु सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम्। द्रोणकर्णान्तरगतं कृपस्यापि च भारत॥ अपश्यतां महात्मानौ विष्वक्सेनधनंजयौ। अपूजयेतां वार्ष्णेयं ब्रुवाणौ साधु साध्विति॥ दिव्यान्यस्राणि सर्वेषां युधि निघ्नन्तमच्युतम्। अभिपत्य ततः सेनां विष्वक्सेनधनंजयौ॥
en: Thereafter O Bharata, Kesava and Dhananjaya, both of illustrious soul, beheld Satyaki of prowess incapable of being thwarted, in the track of the Kurus and thus within the range of the shafts of Drona, Karna and Kripa. Then both of them applauded Satyaki of undiminishing fame saying 'excellent,'-him who was then destroying the celestial weapons of all his focs. Then Kesava and Dhananjaya dashed upon the Kaurava warriors.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: धनंजयस्ततः कृष्णमब्रवीत् पश्य केशव। आचार्यरथमुख्यानां मध्ये क्रीडन् मधूद्वहः॥
en: Thereafter Dhananjaya addressing Kesava said-"Behold, O Kesava, that perpetuator of Madhu's race, sporting amidst the hostile warriors headed by the preceptor and other foremost car-warriors.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: आनन्दयति मां भूयः सात्यकिः परवीरहा। माद्रीपुत्रौ च भीमं च राजानं च युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Truly valiant Satyaki is thereby affording great delight to me, the twins, twins, king Yudhishthira and Bhima.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: यच्छिक्षयानुद्धतः सन् रणे चरति सात्यकिः। महारथानुपक्रीडन् वृष्णीनां कीर्तिवर्धनः॥
en: That Satyaki, the enhancer of the glory of the Vrishnis, well-practised in the use of weapons and free from insolence, is thus careering in the midst of the fight, sporting with mighty car-warrior.

description: The battle between Drona and Dhristadyumna
sn: तमेते प्रतिनन्दन्ति सिद्धाः सैन्याश्च विस्मितः। अजय्यं समरे दृष्ट्वा साधु साध्विति सात्यकिम्। योधाश्चोभयतः सर्वे कर्मभिः समपूजयन्॥
en: The Siddhas and the troops filled with delight, are praising him, saying 'excellent, excellent,' as they find that one of the Satvata race invincible. The warriors of both armies are applauding him, O monarch, in consequence of his fcats.

sn: संजय उवाच सात्वतस्य तु तत् कर्म दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनादयः। शैनेयं सर्वतः क्रुद्धा वारयामासुरञ्जसा॥
en: Sanjaya said Then beholding those feats of that one of the Satvata race, Duryodhana and others, filled with rage, quickly encompassed the grandson of Shini on all sides.

sn: कृपकर्णौ च समरे पुत्राश्च तव मारिष। शैनेयं त्वरयाभ्येत्य विनिघ्नन् निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Kripa and Karma and your sons, O sire, quickly assailing Shini's grandson in the battle, began to pierce him with sharp arrows.

sn: युधिष्ठिरस्ततो राजा माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। भीमसेनश्च बलवान् सात्यकि पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Thereupon king Yudhishthira, the two sons of Madri begotten by Pandu and the mighty Bhimasena rushed to protect him of the Satvata race.

sn: कर्णश्च शरवर्षेण गौतमश्च महारथः। दुर्योधनादयस्ते च शैनेयं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Karna and the son of Gotama, that mighty car-warrior and Duryodhana and others, then covered Shini's grandson with their shafts.

sn: तां वृष्टिं सहसा राजन्नुत्थितां घोररूपिणीम्। वारयामास शैनेयो योधयंस्तान् महारथान्॥
en: Then fighting, O king, (fearlessly) on with those warriors, that scion of Shini's race checked that awful shower of pouring arrows which had been begun so suddenly.

sn: तेषामस्राणि दिव्यानि संहितानि महात्मनाम्। वारयामास विधिवद् दिव्यैरस्त्रैर्महामृधे॥
en: In that great battle, with his various celestial weapons, he duly baffled the celestial weapons of his high-souled opponents, that were aimed at him.

sn: क्रूरमायोधनं जज्ञे तस्मिन् राजसमागमे। रुद्रस्येव हि क्रुद्धस्य निघ्नतस्तान् पशून् पुरा॥
en: The field of battle looked dreadful during the progress of that encounter between royal con batants and if resembled the scene of of the field where in days of yore Rudra, filled with rage, had slaughtered all creatures.

sn: हस्तानामुत्तमाङ्गानां कार्मुकाणां च भारत।
en: Human arms and heads and bows and torn umbrellas and chamaras, O Bharata.

sn: छत्राणां चापविद्धानां चामराणां च संचयैः॥ राशयः स्म व्यदृश्यन्त तत्र तत्र रणाजिरे। भग्नचकै रथैश्चापि पातितैश्च महाध्वजैः॥
en: Where seen in heaps on that field of battle. With broken-wheeled cars, with fallen arms.

sn: सादिभिश्च हतैः शूरैः संकीर्णा वसुधाभवत्। बाणपातनिकृत्तास्तु योधास्ते कुरुसत्तम॥
en: And with heroic horsemen lying slain, the earth became impassable. O foremost of the Kurus, the warriors lacerated with the falling shafts.

sn: चेष्टन्तो विविधाचेष्टा व्यदृश्यन्त महाहवे। वर्तमाने तथा युद्धे घोरे देवासुरोपमे॥
en: Were seen to roll in various movements on the ground in that great battle. During the progress of that terrible battle resembling that between the Gods and the Asuras in days of yore.

sn: अब्रवीत् क्षत्रियांस्तत्र धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। अभिद्रवत संयत्ताः कुम्भयोनि महारथाः॥
en: The very virtuous king Yudhishthira addressing the Kshatriyas said-"You mighty car-warriors, rush unitedly upon the pot-born Drona.

sn: एषो हि पार्षतो वीरो भारद्वाजेन संगतः। घटते च यथाशक्ति भारद्वाजस्य नाशने॥
en: Yonder is the heroic son of Prisata engaged with the son of Bharadvaja; he is trying to the best of his endeavours to encompass the death of Drona.

sn: यादृशानि हि रूपाणि दृश्यन्तेऽस्य महारणे। अद्य द्रोणं रणे क्रुद्धो घातयिष्यति पार्षतः॥
en: Judging from the appearances of his mighty battle, it may be inferred that filled with rage the son of Prisata will today over-throw in battle the son of Bharadvaja.

sn: ते यूयं सहिता भूत्वा युध्यध्वं कुम्भसम्भवम्। युधिष्ठिरसमाज्ञप्ताः सृञ्जयानां महारथाः॥
en: Therefore do you unitedly rush upon the pot-born Drona. Thus commanded by Yudhishthira, the mighty car-warriors of the Srinjayas.

sn: अभ्यद्रवन्त संयत्ता भारद्वाजजिघांसवः। तान् समापततः सर्वान् भारद्वाजो महारथः॥ अभ्यवर्तत वेगेन मर्तव्यमिति निश्चितः। प्रयाते सत्यसंधे तु समकम्पत मेदिनी॥
en: Impelled by a desire for slaying the son of Bharadvaja, assailed him. The mighty carwarrior the son of Bharadvaja, then received those advancing hosts in fury, knowing death to be inevitable. When Drona of unfailing aim thus advanced, the earth began to tremble.

sn: ववुर्वाताः सनिर्घातास्रासयाना वरूथिनीम्। पपात महती चोल्का आदित्यानिश्चरन्त्युत॥
en: Fierce winds began to blow filling the troops of the enemy with fear. Mighty meteors began to drop down, seeming to issue out of the solar disc.

sn: दीपयन्ती उभे सेने शंसन्तीव महद् भयम्। जज्वलुश्चैव शस्त्राणि भारद्वाजस्य मारिष॥
en: In their fall they illumined the welkin and foreboded great danger. O sire, the weapons of Bharadvaja's son began to blaze forth.

sn: रथाः स्वनन्ति चात्यर्थं हयाश्चाश्रूण्यवासृजन्। हतौजा इव चाप्यासीद् भारद्वाजो महारथः॥
en: Cars emitted loud clatters and horses began to shed tears. The mighty car-warrior Drona the son of Bhardvaja, appeared to be devoid of his energy.

sn: प्रास्फुरन्नयनं चास्य वाम बाहुस्तथैव च। विमनाश्चाभवद् युद्धे दृष्ट्वा पार्षतमग्रतः॥
en: His eyes and his left arms began to tremble. And beholding Prishata's son before him, he became cheerless.

sn: ऋषीणां ब्रह्मवादानां स्वर्गस्य गमनं प्रति। सुयुद्धेन ततः प्राणानुत्स्रष्टमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Coincide to this a memory to take a departure in the abode of Brahma as stated by Rishis, well-known to Brahman, decided to abandon leave their lives through fighting in the battle field with chivalry.

sn: ततश्चतुर्दिशं सैन्यैर्दुपदस्याभिसंवृतः। निर्दहन् क्षत्रियव्रातान् द्रोणः पर्यचरद् रणे॥
en: Then desirous of the compass were covered with the troops of Drupada's son. Consuming hosts of Kshatriyas Drona then careered on the field of battle. care

sn: हत्वा विंशतिसाहस्रान् क्षत्रियानरिमर्दनः। दशायुतानि करिणामवधीद् विशिखैः शितैः॥
en: Then that crusher of foes having slain twenty thousand Kshatriyas, slew another hundred thousands with whetted shafts of keen points.

sn: सोऽतिष्ठदाहवे यत्तो विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्। क्षत्रियाणामभावाय ब्राह्ममस्रं समास्थितः॥
en: Then exerting himself with he remained in the battle-field and appeared like a blazing fire without even a curl of smoke. For the destruction of the Kshatriyas. he then grasped the Brahma weapons.

sn: पाञ्चाल्यं विरथं भीमो हतसर्वायुधं बली। सुविषण्णं महात्मानं त्वरमाणः समभ्ययात्॥
en: Then the self-controlled Bhima beholding the prince of the Panchalas carless and weaponless, quickly rushed to the rescue of that high-souled warrior.

sn: ततः स्वरथमारोप्य पाञ्चाल्यमरिमर्दनः। अब्रवीदभिसम्प्रेक्ष्य द्रोणमस्यन्तमन्तिकाम्॥
en: Then beholding the prince of the Panchalas strike Drona from a near point Bhima, that subduer of foes, took him up on his car and

sn: न त्वदन्य इहाचार्यं योद्धमुत्सहते पुमान्। त्वरख प्राग् वधायैव त्वयि भारः समाहितः॥
en: Except yourself there is none who can fight with the preceptor in such close quarters; therefore be quick in compassing his slaughter, inasmuch as the burden rests wholly on you.

sn: स तथोक्तो महाबाहुः सर्वभारसहं धनुः। अभिपत्याददे क्षिप्रमायुधप्रवरं दृढम्॥
en: Thus spoken to by Bhima, the mightyarmed Dhristadyumna, quickly took up a strong and new bow of very superior make and capable of bearing a great strain.

sn: संरब्धश्च शरानस्यन् द्रोणं दुर्वारणं रणे। विवारयिषुराचार्यं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Worked up with rage and discharging his arrows in that battle at the indomitable Drona, Dhristadyumna covered the preceptor with arrows with a desire to withstand him.

sn: तौ न्यवारयतां श्रेष्ठौ संरब्धौ रणशोभिनौ। उदीरयेतां ब्राह्माणि दिव्यान्यस्राण्यनेकशः॥
en: Those two ornaments of battle, those two superior warriors, filled with rage, then resisted one another and invoked into existence many celestial and Brahma weapons.

sn: स महास्त्रैर्महाराज द्रोणमाच्छादयद् रणे। निहत्य सर्वाण्यस्राणि भारद्वाजस्य पार्षतः॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, Dhristadyumna covered Drona in that battle with many weapons. Destroying all those weapons of Bharadvaja's son, the prince of the Panchalas.

sn: सवसातीशिबींश्चैव बाह्रीकान् कौरवानपि। रक्षिष्यमाणान् संग्रामे द्रोणं व्यधमदच्युतः॥
en: That warrior of unfading renown, began to consume the Vasatis, the Shinis, the Valhikas and the Kurus who were then engaged in protecting Drona.

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तथा राजन् गभस्तिभिरिवांशुमान्। बभौ प्रच्छादयन्नाशाः शरजालैः समन्ततः॥
en: O king, discharging numerous shafts on all sides, Dhristadyumna at that time appeared beautiful like the sun of myriad rays.

sn: तस्य द्रोणो धनुश्छित्त्वा विद्ध्वा चैनं शिलीमुखैः। मर्माण्यभ्यहनद् भूयः स व्यथां परमामगात्॥
en: Drona however once more cut-off the prince's bow and pierced the vitals of the prince himself with large number of shafts. Thus wounded the prince was greatly pained.

sn: ततो भीमो दृढक्रोधो द्रोणस्याश्लिष्य तं रथम्। शनकैरिव राजेन्द्र द्रोणं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon Bhima of great fury holding the chariot of Drona, distinctly spoke those words to him

sn: यदि नाम न युध्येरशिक्षिता ब्रह्मबन्धवः। स्वकर्मभिरसंतुष्टा न स्म क्षत्रं क्षयं व्रजेत्॥
en: If vile Brahmanas dissatisfied with the duties of their own order but versed in the use of weapons, did not fight, then the Kshatriya a order would not have become reduced in numerical strength.

sn: अहिंसां सर्वभूतेषु धर्म ज्यायस्तरं विदुः। तस्य च ब्राह्मणो मूलं भवांश्च ब्रह्मवित्तमः॥
en: Sparing life has been declared to be most excellent of all virtues. The Brahmana is the toot of that virtue. You are again the foremost of all men conversant with Brahma.

sn: श्वपाकवम्लेच्छगणान् हत्वा चान्याद् पृथग्विधान्। अज्ञानान्मूढवद् ब्रह्मन् पुत्रदारधनेप्सया॥ एकस्यार्थे बहून् हत्वा पुत्रस्याधर्मविद्यया। स्वकर्मस्थान् विकर्मस्थो न व्यपत्रसे कथम्॥
en: Like Chandala, slaying numerous Mlechchas and diverse other warriors, who however are all engaged in performing the duties of their order, moved to the deed by folly and ignorance, O Brahmana and by the desire of benefiting your family and son, indeed for the sake of your only son indeed slaying all like one ignorant of his duties and disregarding your own avocation why do you not feel ashamed?

sn: यस्यार्थे शस्त्रमादाय यमपेक्ष्य च जीवसि। च साद्य पतितः शेते पृष्ठे नावेदितस्तव॥
en: He for whose sake you have taken up arms and for whom you live, he, deprived of life, today lies on the field of battle, unknown to you and behind your back.

sn: धर्मराजस्य तद् वाक्यं नाभिशङ्कितुमर्हसि। एवमुक्तस्ततो द्रोणो भीमेनोत्सृज्य तद् धनुः॥
en: It behoves you not to doubt the words the very virtuous king Yudhishthira has told you, Thus addressed by Bhima, Drona, laid his bow aside.

sn: सर्वाण्यत्राणि धर्मात्मा हातुकामोऽभ्यभाषत। कर्ण कर्ण महेष्वास कृप दुर्योधनेति च॥
en: Then desirous of laying all his weapons aside, Bharadvaja's son of illustrious soul, said aloud-"O Karna, O Karna, Ogreat bowman, O Kripa, O Duryodhana.

sn: संग्रामे क्रियतां यत्नो ब्रवीम्येष पुनः पुनः। पाण्डवेभ्य: शिवं वोऽस्तु शस्रमभ्युत्सृजाम्यहम्॥
en: Exert your best in the battle: this I tell you repeatedly; may no injury befall you from the Pandavas; I am going to lay aside my weapons.

sn: इति तत्र महाराज प्राक्रोशद् द्रौणिमेव च। उत्सृज्य च रणे शस्त्रं रथोपस्थे निविश्य च॥
en: Having spoken thus, O mighty monarch, Drona began to cry out the name of Ashvatthaman at the top of his voice; and laying aside his weapons, he then sat down on the terrace of his car.

sn: अभयं सर्वभूतानां प्रददौ योगमीयिवान्। तस्य तच्छिद्रमाज्ञाय धृष्टद्युम्नः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then betaking to yoga, he assuredly gave safety to creature. Taking advantage of that opportunity. Dhristadyumna collected all his energies.

sn: सशरं तद् धनुर्घोरं संन्यस्याथ रथे ततः। खड्गी रथादवप्लुत्य सहसा द्रोणमभ्ययात्॥
en: Then placing his dreadful bow with arrows fixed on its string on his car, he jumped down from it armed with a sword and then rushed furiously upon Drona.

sn: हाहाकृतानि भूतानि मानुषाणीतराणि च। द्रोणं तथागतं दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नवशं गतम्॥
en: Then men and other creatures beholding Drona on the point of falling a victim to Dhristadyumna, began to utter loud cries of Oh and Alas.

sn: हाहाकारं भृशं चक्रुरहो धिगिति चाब्रुवन्। द्रोणोऽपि शस्त्राण्युत्सृज्य परमं सांख्यमास्थितः॥
en: They bewailed piteously and they cried alas and oh and said fie. Meanwhile Drona, having laid aside his weapons, was peacefully seated on his car.

sn: तथोक्त्वा योगमास्थाय ज्योतिर्भूतो महातपाः। पुराणं पुरुषं विष्णुं जगाम मनसा परम्॥
en: Having spoken as before, Drona, had betaken to yoga. Endued with great splendour and possessed of ascetic merit, he had set his heart on that ancient and paramount being viz., Vishnu.

sn: मुखं किंचित् समुन्नाम्य विष्टभ्य उरमग्रतः। निमीलिताक्षः सत्त्वस्थो निक्षिप्य हृदि धारणाम्॥
en: Slightly bending down his face and throwing his breast forward and shutting his eyes and reposing on the quality of goodness and directing his mind on meditation.

sn: ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म ज्योतिर्भूतो महातपाः। स्मरित्वा देवदेवेशमक्षरं परमं प्रभुम्॥
en: And thinking on the monosyllabic Om representing Brahma and recollecting the mighty, paramount and indestructible god of gods and effulgent Drona of great ascetic merit.

sn: दिवमाक्रामदाचार्यः साक्षात् सद्भिर्द्धराक्रमाम्। द्वौ सूर्याविति नो बुद्धिरासीत् तस्मिस्तथागते॥
en: The preceptor of the Kurus and the Pandavas, went to heaven, which is so difficult of being attained even by the virtuous. Indeed when Drona proceeded to heaven, it appeared to us that there were two suns in the sky.

sn: एकाग्रमिव चासीच ज्योतिर्भिः पूरितं नमः। समपद्यत चार्काभे भारद्वाजदिवाकरे॥
en: The whole welkin was ablaze and appeared to be one vast sheet of equal light when the sun-like Bharadvaja, of solar splendour, proceeded towards heaven.

sn: निमेषमात्रेण च तज्जयोतिरन्तरधीयत। आसीत् किलकिलाशब्दः प्रहृष्टानां दिवौकसाम्॥
en: But within an wink of time however, that light disappeared and then tumultuous noise of the delighted celestials were heard there,

sn: ब्रह्मलोकगते द्रोणे धृष्टद्युम्ने च मोहिते। वयमेव तदाद्राक्ष्म पञ्च मानुषयोनयः॥
en: When Drona thus ascended to heaven, Dhristadyumna was standing beside him stupefied; only we five amongst mortal creatures beheld.

sn: योगयुक्तं महात्मानं गच्छन्तं परमां गतिम्। अहं धनंजयः पार्थो कृपः शारद्वतस्तथा॥
en: The illustrious Drona, lost in yoga and meditation, ascend to the highest regions of blessedness. These five were, myself, Pritha's son Dhananjaya, Ashvatthaman, the son of Drona.

sn: वासुदेवश्च वार्ष्णेयो धर्मपुत्रश्च पाण्डवः। अन्ये त सर्वे नापश्यन् भारद्वाजस्य धीमतः॥ महिमानं महाराज योगयुक्तस्य गच्छतः। ब्रह्मलोकं महद् दिव्यं देवगुह्यं हि तत् परम्॥
en: Vasudeva of the Vrisni race and king Yudhishthira the virtuous son of Pandu, All else could not seen the halo of glory that surrounded the intelligent son of Bharadvaja as he ascended, rapt up in yoga, to the Brahma regions, which are mysterious even to the gods and which is the highest of all celestial regions.

sn: गतिं परमिकां प्राप्तमजानन्तो नृयोनयः। नापश्यन् गच्छमानं हि तं सार्धमृषिपुङ्गवैः॥ आचार्यं योगमास्थाय ब्रह्मलोकमरिंदमम्। वितुन्नाङ्गं शरव्रातैस्तायुधमसृकक्षरम्॥
en: In fact all human beings were then unaware of the fact that Drona had attained to the highest mode of existence. None of them could then descry the preceptor, that subduer of foes, ascend to the region of Brahma, devoted to yoga, in company with the best of sages, his body mangled with arrows and steeped in blood after he had set aside his weapons.

sn: धिक्कृतः पार्षतस्तं तु सर्वभूतैः परामृशत्। तस्य मूर्धानमालम्ब्य गतसत्त्वस्य देहिनः॥
en: Prisata's meanwhile, though all creatures cried fie on him, yet casting his eyes on the lifeless Drona's head, began to drag it (by the hair.)

sn: किंचिद्रब्रुवतः कायाद् विचकर्तासिना शिरः। हर्षेण महता युक्तो भारद्वाजे निपातिते॥
en: Then with his sword he lopped that head off the trunk of his foe who remained silent all the while. Then upon the slaughter of Bharadvaja's son he was filled with delight.

sn: सिंहनादरवं चक्रे भ्रामयन् खङ्गमाहवे। आकर्णपलितः श्यामो वयसाशीतिपञ्चकः॥
en: Dhristadyumna began to send up loud warcries whirling his sword all the while in the air. son With his hoary locks flowing down his ears, of a dark complexion that old man of eighty-five years.

sn: त्वत्कृते व्यचरत् संख्ये स तु षोडशवर्षवत्। उक्तवांश्च महाबाहुः कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: For your sake used to career on the field of battle, like a boy of sixteen. The mighty-armed Dhananjaya, that son of Kunti, had said (before

sn: जीवन्तमानयाचार्य मा वधी?पदात्मजा न हन्तव्यो न हन्तव्य इति ते सैनिकाच ह॥
en: "O son of Drupada, bring the preceptor alive. Do not slay him. He should not be slain, he should not be slain.” Even thus did you troops also.

sn: उत्क्रोशन्नर्जुनश्चैव सानुक्रोशस्तमाव्रजत्। क्रोशमानेऽर्जुने चैव पार्थिवेषु च सर्वशः॥
en: Cry out; especially Arjuna had exclaimed aloud melting with compassion for his preceptor. But unmindful of the cries of Arjuna and those of other rulers of the earth.

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नोऽवधीद् द्रोणं रथतल्पे नरर्षभम्। शोणितेन परिक्लिन्नो रथाद् भूमिमथापतत्॥ लोहिताङ्ग इवादित्यो दुर्धर्षः समपद्यता एवं तं निहतं संख्ये ददृशे सैनिको जनः॥
en: O foremost of men, Dhristadyumna slew Drona in the terrace of his own car. Then that indomitable subduer of foes, his body stained with blood, jumped down from the car on the earth, looking red like the (newly-risen) solar disc. Thus the soldiers behold Drona slain in the battle.

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु तद् राजन् भारद्वाजशिरोऽहरत्। तावकानां महेष्वासः प्रमुखे तत् समाक्षिपत्॥
en: Thereafter, O king, that furied bowman Dhristadyumna, threw that large head of Bharadvaja's son at the front ranks of your troops.

sn: ते तु दृष्ट्वा शिरो राजन् भारद्वाजस्य तावकाः। पलायनकृतोत्साहा दुद्रुवुः सर्वतो दिशम्॥
en: Then the troops beholding that head of Bharadvaja's son, felt inclined to fly and O king, without much hesitation they took to their heels.

sn: द्रोणस्तु दिवमास्थाय नक्षत्रमथमाविशत्। अहमेव तदाद्राक्षं द्रोणस्य निधनं नृप॥
en: Meanwhile Drona proceeding to the heavens entered the stellar path. I only saw the (true circumstances of the) death of Drona.

sn: ऋषेः प्रसादात् कृष्णस्य सत्यवत्याः सुतस्य च। विधूमामिह संयान्तीमुल्कां प्रज्वलितामिव॥ अपश्याम दिवं स्तब्वा गच्छन्तं तं महाद्युतिम्। हते द्रोणे निरुत्साहान् कुरून् पाण्डवसृञ्जयाः॥
en: Through the grace of the sage KrishnaDvaipayana, the son of Satyavati. I then beheld that effulgent one proceeding, after his ascension to the sky, like a blazing flame-beam free from even a curl of smoke flying through the welkin. Upon the slaughter of Drona, the Kurus, the Pandavas and the Srinjayas, all became depressed.

sn: अभ्यद्रवन् महावेगास्ततः सैन्यं व्यदीर्यत। निहता हतभूयिष्ठाः संग्रामे निशितैः शरैः॥
en: And every body fled in great haste. The army then broke away. Many had been slain and many wounded with keen arrows.

sn: तावका निहते द्रोणे गतासव इवाभवन्। पराजयमथावाप्य परत्र च महद् भयम्॥
en: Upon the death of Drona, your troops appeared to be senseless. Having suffered a defeat and being inspired with fear about the future.

sn: उभयेनैव ते हीना नाविन्दन् धृतिमात्मनः। अन्विच्छन्तः शरीरं तु भारद्वाजस्य पार्थिवाः॥
en: The Kurus lost the benefit of this as well as of the next world. Really they lost all selfcontrol. The rulers of earth then searching for the body of Bharadvaja's son.

sn: नान्वगच्छन् महाराज कबन्धायुतसंकुले। पाण्डवास्तु जयं लब्ध्वा परत्र च महद् यशः॥
en: Could not find it out in consequence of the field being covered over with numerous headless trunks. The Pandavas on the other hand, having obtained victory here and prospects of fame in the future.

sn: बाणशङ्खरवांश्चक्रुः सिंहनादांश्च पुष्कलान्। भीमसेनस्ततो राजन् धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥
en: Began to make loud sounds with their arrows and conches conches and they uttered tremendous war-cries. Then Bhimasena and Prisata's son Dhristadyumna.

sn: वरूथिन्यामनृत्येतां परिष्वज्य परस्परम्। अब्रवीच तदा भीमः पार्षतं शत्रुतापनम्॥
en: Embraced each other in the midst of the Pandava host which looked upon them both. Then that afflicter of foes Bhima addressing Prisata's son said

sn: भूयोऽहं त्वां विजयिनं परिष्वज्यामि पार्षत। सूतपुत्रे हते पापे धार्तराष्ट्रे च संयुगे॥
en: "O son of Prisata, I will again embrace your victorious self, when the sinful sons of Suta and Dhritarashtra will be slain in the battle.

sn: एतावदुक्त्वा भीमस्तु हर्षेण महता युतः। बाहुशब्देन पृथिवीं कम्पयामास पाण्डवः॥
en: Having spoken thus much and filled with joy, Pandu's son Bhima, caused the earth to tremble with the sound of his arm-strokes.

sn: तस्य शब्देन वित्रस्ताः प्राद्रवंस्तावका युधि। क्षत्रधर्मं समुत्सृज्य पलायनपरायणाः॥
en: At that sound your troops, panic stricken, began to fly away; and disregarding the duties of Kshatriyas they exerted themselves in flying away.

sn: पाण्डवास्तु जयं लब्ध्वा हृष्टा ह्यासन् विशाम्पते। अरिक्षयं च संग्रामे तेन ते सुखमाप्नुवन्॥
en: The Pandavas, having obtained victory were transported with joy, O ruler of men; and great was their happiness at the destruction of their foes in battle.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: संजय उवाच ततो द्रोणे हते राजन् कुरवः शस्रपीडितः। हतप्रवीरा विध्वस्ता भृशं शोकपरायणाः॥
en: Sanjaya said Upon the slaughter of Drona, O king, the Kurus, afflicted with the weapons of their enemies, their foremost warrior slain and themselves confounded-began to indulge copiously in grief,

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: उदीर्णाश्च परान् दृष्ट्वा कम्पमानाः पुनः पुनः। अश्रुपूर्णक्षणास्रस्ता दीनास्त्वासन् विशाम्पते॥
en: Beholding their enemies then elated with joy and success, they repeatedly trembled in fear. O ruler of men, they were panic-stricken and depressed and their eyes were filled with tears.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: विचेतसो हतोत्साहा: कश्मलाभिहतौजसः। आर्तस्वरेण महता पुत्रं ते पर्यवारयन्॥
en: They were distracted (with sorrow), their courage gone and themselves reduced in splendour under the burden of grief. Uttering piteous wails, they then surrounded your son.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: रजस्वला वेपमाना वीक्षमाणा दिशो दश। अश्रुकण्ठा यथा दैत्या हिरण्याक्षे पुरा हते॥
en: Covered with dust, trembling (in every limbs), gazing (vacantly) at the ten points of the compass, their eyes flooded with tears, they looked like the Daityas upon the fall of Hiranyaksha in days of yore.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: स तैः परिवृतो राजा त्रस्तैः क्षुद्रमृगैरिव। अशक्नुवन्नवस्थातुमपायात् तनयस्तव॥
en: Surrounded by those panic-stricken troops of his, who then looked like puny animals, your son could not stay on the field and went away from it.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: क्षुत्पिपासापरिम्लानास्ते योधास्तव भारत। आदित्येनेव संतप्ता भृशं विमनसोऽभवन्॥
en: Those warriors of yours, O Bharata, worn out with hunger and thirst and scorched by the burning rays of the sun were exceedingly dejected.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: भास्करस्यैव पतनं समुद्रस्येव शोषणम्। विपर्यासं यथा मेरोर्वासवस्येव निर्जयम्॥ अमर्षणीयं तद् दृष्ट्वा भारद्वाजस्य पातनम्। त्रस्तरूपतरा राजन् कौरवाः प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
en: Beholding that unthought-of over-throw of Bharadvaja's son, that was like falling the sun on the earth or the drying up of the ocean or the transplantation of Meru nountain or the defeat of Vasava himself, your troops, O king, began to fly away, panic lending speed to their legs.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: गान्धारराजः शकुनिस्रस्तस्त्रस्ततरैः सह। हतं रुक्मरथं श्रुत्वा प्राद्रवत् सहितौ रथैः॥
en: Beholding him of the golden car slain, Sakuni the king of the Gandharvas, with his terrified and affrighted followers fled in all haste.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: वरूथिनी वेगवतीं विद्रुतां सपताकिनीम्। परिगृह्य महासेनां सूतपुत्रोऽपयाद् भयात्॥
en: Taking with him his numerous divisions that were flying with all their standards, Suta's son also, out of fear, fled away.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: रथनागाश्वकलिलां पुरस्कृत्य तु वाहिनीम्। मद्राणामीश्वरः शल्यो वीक्षमाणोऽपयाद् भयात्॥
en: The ruler of the Madras viz., Salva gathering together his divisions abounding in cars, elephants and steeds and looking vacantly on all sides, fled away, out of fear.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: हतप्रवीरैर्भूयिष्ठैर्ध्वजैर्बहुपताकिभिः। वृतः शारद्वतोऽगच्छत् कष्टं कष्टमिति ब्रुवन्॥
en: Kripa the son of Sharadvata also fled, saying Alas, Alas and taking with him his divisions consisting mostly of elephants and infantry, of which the greater part had been slaughtered.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: भोजानीकेन शिष्टेन कलिङ्गारट्टबाह्निकैः। कृतवर्मा वृतो राजन् प्रायात् सुजवनैर्हयैः॥
en: Kritavarman, surrounded by the Bhoja division and the remnants of the Kalingas, Asratta and Valhikas, fled away borne by his swift steeds.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: पदातिगणसंयुक्तस्रस्तो राजन् भयादितः। उलूकः प्राद्रवत् तत्र दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं निपातितम्॥
en: Beholding Drona slain, Uluka, filled with fear and with his infantry divisions, fled away in great speed.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: दर्शनीयो युवा चैव शौर्येण कृतलक्षणः। दुःशासनो भृशोद्विगनः प्राद्रवद् गजसंवृतः॥
en: Handsome, youthful in years and wellknown for his bravery, Dussassana inspired with great fear, fled away being surrounded by his elephant division.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: रथानामयुतं गृह्य त्रिसाहस्रं च दन्तिनाम्। वृषसेनो ययौ तूर्णं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं निपातितम्॥
en: Beholding Drona overthrown Vrishasena fled in haste, taking away with him ten thousand chariots and three thousand tusked clephants.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: गजाश्वरथसंयुक्तो वृतश्चैव पदातिभिः। दुर्योधनो महाराज प्रायात् तत्र महारथः॥
en: Your the mighty car-warrior Duryodhana also, O king, then fled from the field attended by cars, elephants and steeds and surrounded by foot-soldiers.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: संशप्तकगणान् गृह्य हतशेषान् किरीटिना। सुशर्मा प्राद्रवद् राजन् दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं निपातितम्॥
en: Beholding Drona overthrown, O king, Susarman fled away, taking with him the remmants of the Samshaptakas, slain by the diadem-decked Arjuna.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: गजान् स्थान् समारुह्य व्युदस्य च हयाञ्जनाः। प्राद्रवन् सर्वतः संख्ये दृष्ट्वा रुक्मरथं हतम्॥
en: Beholding him of the golden car slain, men began to fly on all sides, riding on their elephants and cars and urging on their steeds.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: त्वरयन्तः पितृनन्ये भ्रातृनन्येऽथ मातुलान्। पुत्रानन्ये वयस्यांश्च प्राद्रवन् कुरवस्तदा॥
en: son Sonne urging on their sires, others their brothers and others their uncles and others their sons and other companions, the Kurus fled away in haste.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: चोदयन्तश्च सैन्यानि स्वस्रीयांश्च तथापरे। सम्बन्धिनस्तथान्ये च प्राद्रवन्त दिशो दश।॥
en: Some exhorting their troops to make haste and others their nephews and other kinsmen, fled away in all directions.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: प्रकीर्णकेशा विध्वस्ता न द्वावेकर धावतः। नेदमस्तीति मन्वाना हतोत्साहा हतौजसः॥
en: Their hair dishevelled and their accouterments falling off, no two persons were seen to fly together; their courage gone and their splendour destroyed, men then thought that the Kuru army was completely annihilated.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: उत्सृज्य कवचानन्ये प्राद्रवंस्तावका विभो। अन्योन्यं ते समाक्रोशन सैनिका भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Others among your troops fled, O lord, throwing off their coats of mail. O foremost of the Bharatas, then your troops addressing one another loudly said

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति न च ते स्वयं तत्रावतस्थिरे। धुर्यानुन्मुच्य च रथाद्धतसूतात् स्वलंकृतान्। अधिरुह्य हयान् योधाः क्षिप्रं पद्भिरचोदयान्॥
en: "Wait, Wait"'; but none of them who thus spoke remained a moment on the field. Abandoning their vehicles and chariots decked with ornaments.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: द्रवमाणे तथा सैन्ये त्रस्तरूपे हतौजसि। प्रतिस्रोत इव ग्राहो द्रोणपुत्रः परानियात्॥
en: Warriors, mounting on the steeds or using their legs, fled in all possible haste. While the troops, with their splendour lost and filled with fear, were thus flying away.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: तस्यासीत् सुमहद् युद्धं शिखण्डिप्रमुखैर्गणैः। प्रभद्रकैश्च पाञ्चालैश्चेदिभिश्च सकेकयैः॥
en: Only Drona's son Ashvatthman advanced towards the foes, like a huge alligator swimming against the current. He had recently fought a terrible fight with the hostile division headed by Sikhandin.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: हत्वा बहुविधाः सेनाः पाण्डूनां युद्धदुर्मदः। कथंचित् संकटान्मुक्तो मत्तद्विरदविक्रमः॥
en: As also with with the Prabhadrakas the Panchalas and the Chedis accompanied by the Kekayas. Having slain numerous indomitable troops of the Pandavas.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: द्रवमाणं बलं दृष्ट्वा पलायनकृतक्षणम्। दुर्योधनं समासाद्य द्रोणपुत्रोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: And with difficulty extricating himself from his perilous situations, that one of the gait of an infuriated elephant, beholding the troops flying away.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: किमियं द्रवते सेना त्रस्तरूपेव भारत। द्रवमाणां च राजेन्द्र नावस्थापयसे रणे॥
en: Approached Duryodhana; and then that son of Drona said these words to the latter-"Why O Bharata, are the troops flying away, as if in fear?

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: त्वं चापि न यथापूर्वं प्रकृतिस्थो नराधिप। कर्णप्रभृतयश्चेमे नावतिष्ठन्ति पार्थिव॥
en: Why, O king, do you not try to rally them when they are thus flying away? O ruler of men, you also are not in your usual mood.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: अन्येष्वपि च युद्धेषु नैव सेनाद्रवत् तदा। कचित् क्षेमं महाबाहो तव सैन्यस्य भारत॥
en: In consequence of the slaughter of what foremost of warriors of your army have the troops been reduced to this plight? O foremost of the Kurus, tell me all truly.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: कस्मिन्निदं हते राजन् रथसिंहे बलं तवा एतामवस्थां सम्प्राप्तं तन्ममाचक्ष्व कौरव॥
en: O king, even these division headed by Karna and others are not staying on the field. In no previsions battle was the arıny thus broken and routed.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: तत्तु दुर्योधनः श्रुत्वा द्रोणपुत्रस्य भाषितम्। घोरमप्रियमाख्यातुं नाशक्नोत् पार्थिवर्षभः॥
en: 0 Bharata, has any great catastrophe, O mighty monarch, overtaken your army? Thereafter Duryodhana hearing the words of Drona's son.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: भिन्ना नौरिव ते पुत्रो मग्नः शोकमहार्णवे। वाष्पेणापिहितो दृष्ट्वा द्रोणपुत्रं रथे स्थितम्॥
en: Hesitated to communicate that most terrible and disagreeable intelligence to him. Your son, that foremost of kings, was then sunk deep in the ocean of grief, even like a splintered boat in the sea.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: ततः शारद्वतं राजा सव्रीडमिदमब्रवीत्। शंसात्र भद्रं ते सर्वं यथा सैन्यमिदं दुतम्॥
en: At the sight of Drona's son seated on his chariot, the eyes of the king were flooded with tears. Thereafter, O king, your son suffused with shame, said these words to the son of

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: अथ शारद्वतो राजन्नार्तिमार्छन् पुनः पुनः। शशंस द्रोणपुत्राय यथा द्रोणो निपातितः॥
en: “May good betide you. Do you first inform Ashvatthaman of the cause of this flight of our troops. Thereupon o king, Saradvata's son, repeatedly over-whelmed with sorrow, said to Drona's son how Drona had been slain.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: कृप उवाच वयं द्रोणं पुरस्कृत्य पृथिव्यां प्रवरं रथम्। प्रावर्तयाम संग्रामं पञ्चालैरेव केवलम्॥
en: Kripa said Ourselves, placing that foremost of carwarriors on earth viz., Drona before us, commenced the battle with the Panchalas only.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: ततः प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे विमिश्राः कुरुसोमकाः। अन्योन्यमभिगर्जन्तः शस्त्रैर्देहानपातयन्॥
en: During the progress of the battle the Kurus and the Somakas became mingled together and then challenging one another they mangled one another a body with their weapons.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: वर्तमाने तथा युद्धे क्षीयमाणेषु संयुगे। धार्तराष्ट्रेषु संक्रुद्धः पिता तेऽस्रमुदैरयत्॥
en: When the battle thus raged and when the Dhartarashtra troops were being reduced in number, your father, filled with rage, invoked into existence a celestial weapon.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: ततो द्रोणो ब्राह्ममस्रं विकुर्वाणो नरर्षभः। व्यहनच्छात्रवान् भल्लैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Then, O foremost of men, Drona using that Brahma weapon, slow his enemies by hundreds and thousands.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: पाण्डवाः केकया मत्स्याः पञ्चालाच विशेषतः। संख्ये द्रोणरथं प्राप्य व्यनशन् कालचोदिताः॥
en: Impelled forward by Fate the Pandavas, the Kaikayas, the Matsyas and the Panchalas, O foremost of the regenerate ones, approaching the vicinity of Drona's car, were slaughtered (indiscriminately).

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: सहस्रं नरसिंहानां द्विसाहस्रं च दन्तिनाम्। द्रोणो ब्रह्मास्रयोगेन प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥
en: Then with his Brahma weapon Drona dispatched a thousand foremost heroes and two thousand tusked elephants to the abode of Death.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: आकर्णपलित: श्यामो वयसाशीतिपञ्चकः। रणे पर्यचरद् द्रोणो वृद्धः षोडशवर्षवत्॥
en: With his hoary locks flowering down to his ears and of a dark complexion and full eightyfive years of age, Drona then careered on the field with the agility of a boy of sixteen.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: क्लिश्यमानेषु सैन्येषु वध्यमानेषु राजसु। अमर्षवशमापन्नाः पञ्चाला विमुखाऽभवन्॥
en: Their troops fatigued and their kings slain, the Panchalas although burning with rage, were compelled to turn back.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: तेषु किंचित् प्रभग्नेषु विमुखेषु सपत्नजित्। दिव्यमस्रं विकर्वाणो बभूवार्क इवोदितः॥
en: When the enemy's rank was partly broken and when they were compelled to turn their faces away from the field, that conqueror of foes, exhibiting his celestial weapon, looked beautiful like the rising sun.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: स मध्यं प्राप्य पाण्डूनां शररश्मिः प्रतापवान्। मध्यंगत इवादित्यो दुष्प्रेक्ष्यस्ते पिताभवत्॥
en: Penetrating into the centre of the Pandava rank, the puissant hero, your father, shooting his ray-like shafts, became incapable of being looked at like the sun shining in the centre of the heaven.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: ते दह्यमाना द्रोणेन सूर्येणेव विराजता। दग्धवीर्या निरुत्साहा बभूवुर्गतचेतसः॥
en: Our enemies, then scorched by Drona who then appeared beautiful like the sun, were reduced in their energy, deprived of courage and depressed at heart.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: तान् दृष्ट्वा पीडितान् बाणैर्दोणेन मधुसूदनः। जयैषी पाण्डुपुत्राणामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon the slayer of Madhu ever solicitous of the victory of the Pandavas, beholding the troops afflicted by Drona with his shafts spoke these wordsनैष जातु नरैः शक्यो जेतुं शस्रभृतां वरः।

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: अपि वृत्रहणा संख्ये रथयूथपयूथपः॥
en: This leader of the leaders of car-hosts, this foremost of all wielders of bow is incapable of being vanquished in battle even by the slayer of Vritra himself.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: ते यूयं धर्ममुत्सृज्य जयं रक्षत पाण्डवाः। यथा वः संयुगे सर्वान् न हन्याद् रुक्मवाहनः॥
en: Therefore disregarding the rules of fair combat do you strive for the sake of giving victory to the Pandavas, in such a manner that he of the golden car may not slay you all.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: अश्वत्थाम्न हते नैष युध्यदिति मतिर्मम) हतं तं संयुगे कश्चिदाख्यात्वस्मै मृषा नरः॥
en: I think, he will never fight if he hears that Ashvatthamari has been slain in battle. Let therefore some one tell him this falsehood that Ashvatthaman has been slai in battle.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: एतन्नारोचयद् वाक्यं कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। अरोचयंस्तु सर्वेऽन्ये कृच्छ्रेण तु युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: These words did not sound agreeable to the ear of Kunti's son Dhananjaya. Others again approved of their words. King Yudhishthira accepted them after much hesitation.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: भीमसेनस्तु सव्रीडमब्रवीत् पितरं तव। अश्वत्थामा हत इति तं नाबुध्यत ते पिता॥
en: Then Bhimasena suffused with blashes of shame said to your father-"Ashvatthaman has been slain." But your father believed him not.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: स शङ्कमानस्तन्मिथ्या धर्मराजमपृच्छत। हतं वाप्यहतं वाऽऽजौ त्वां पिता पुत्रवत्सलः॥
en: Your father affectionate to his son then doubting the veracity of Bhima's words, questioned very virtuous king Yudhishthira, whether you were really slain or not.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: तमतथ्यभये मग्नो जये सक्तो युधिष्ठिरः। अश्वत्थामानमयोधे हतं दृष्ट्वा महागजम्॥
en: Afraid of tell lies but interested in securing victory, Yudhishthira, then beholding a mighty elephant by name Ashvatthaman slain in battle.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: भीमेन गिरिवाणं मालवस्येन्द्रवर्मणः। उपसृत्य तदा द्रोणमुच्चैरिदमुवाच ह॥
en: By Bhima an elephant belonging to Indravarman the ruler of the Malavas and that was huge as a hill, approached Drona and

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: यस्यार्थे शस्त्रमादत्से यमवेक्ष्य च जीवसि। पुत्रस्ते दयितो नित्यं सोऽश्वत्थामा निपातितः॥
en: “He for whom you are wielding your weapons and looking on whom you live, that dearly-loved son of yours by Ashvauhman has been slain.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: शेते विनिहतो भूमौ वने सिंहशिशुर्यथा॥ जाननप्यनृतस्याथ दोषान् स द्विजसत्तमम्। अव्यक्तमब्रवीद् राजा हतः कुञ्जर इत्युत॥
en: Slain he lies prostrate on the field like a lion-calf in the woods. Cognisant of the evils of falschood that king clearly spoke these words to the foremost of Brahmanas, adding indistinctly the word elephant after them. Hearing that you have been slain and consequently afflicted with great grief.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: स त्वां निहतमाक्रन्दे श्रुत्वा संतापतापितः। नियम्य दिव्यान्यस्राणि नायुध्यत यथा पुरा॥
en: Withdrawing his celestial weapons he ceased to fight. Beholding him greatly anxious and overpowered with grief.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: तं दृष्ट्वा परमोद्विग्नं शोकातुरमचेतसम्। पाजालराजस्य सुतः क्रूरकर्मा समाद्रवत्॥
en: The son of the Panchala king, that perpetrator of vile deeds, assailed him. name Beholding that prince who had been destined to be the cause of his death, Drona, conversant with the truths about men and things.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: तं दृष्ट्वा विहितं मृत्यु लोकतत्त्वविचक्षणः। दिव्यान्यस्राण्यथोत्सृज्य रणे प्रायमुपाविशत्॥
en: Abandoned his celestial weapons and betook to the Praya Joga. Then grasping his hair with his left hand.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: ततोऽस्य केशान् सव्येन गृहीत्वा पाणिना तदा। पार्षतः क्रोशमानानां वीराणामच्छिनच्छिरः॥
en: The son of Prisata lopped off his head disregarding the expostulating cries of the heroes. From all sides they then said-"He should not be slain, He should not be slain.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: न हन्तव्यो न हन्तव्य इति ते सर्वतोऽब्रुवन्। तथैव चार्जुनो वाहादवरुनिमाद्रवत्॥
en: Similarly Arjuna also, jumping down from his chariot quickly rushed towards Dhristadyumna, with his arms raised and

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: उद्यम्य त्वरितो बाहुं ब्रुवाणश्च पुनः पुनः। जीवन्तमानयाचार्य मा वधीरिति धर्मवित्॥
en: "Bring the preceptor alive; conversant with the rules of fair fight, you should not slay aim." Although thus prevented by the Kauravas and Arjuna.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: तथा निवार्यमाणेन कौरवैरर्जुनेन च। हत एव नृशंसेन पिता तव नरर्षभ।॥ सैनिकाश्च ततः सर्वे प्राद्रवन्त भयार्दिताः। वयं चापि निरुत्साहा हते पितरि तेऽनघ॥
en: Your father, O foremost of men, suffered death at the hands of that most heartless warrior (Dhristadyumna). It is for this reason that the troops afflicted with fear are flying away. Similarly, O sinless one, depressed upon the overthrow of your sire.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: संजय उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा द्रोणपुत्रस्तु निधनं पितुराहवे। क्रोधमाहारयत् तीव्र पदाहत इवोरगः॥
en: Sanjaya said we are Then Drona's son, hearing that account of the slaughter of his father in battle, became filled with fury like a snake trembled under ; feet.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे द्रौणि शं जज्वाल मारिष। यथेन्धनं महत् प्राप्य प्राज्वलद्धव्यवाहनः॥
en: Then, O sire, filled with wrath Drona's son appeared to burn on the field, like fire that blazes froth furiously having obtained heaps of fuel to feed it.

description: Communication of the intelligence of Drona's death to Ashvatthama
sn: तलं तलेन निष्यिष्य दन्तैर्दन्तानुपास्पृशत्। निःश्वसन्नुरगो यद्वलोहिताक्षोऽभवत् तदा॥
en: Squeezing one of his hands with the other and grinding his teeth and breathing like a snake his eyes became coppery (in rage).

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अधर्मेण हतं श्रुत्वा धृष्टद्युम्नेन संजय। ब्राह्मणं पितरं वृद्धमश्वत्थामा किमब्रवीत्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Hearing of the slaughter of his aged and Brahma-knowing sire by Dhristadyumna in an unfair battle, 0 Sanjaya, what did Ashvatthaman say.

sn: मानवं वारुणाग्नेयं ब्राह्ममस्त्रं च वीर्यवान्। ऐन्द्र नारायणं चैव यस्मिन् नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: He who is puissant and in whom human and Varuna and Agneya and Brahma and Aindra and Narayana weapons are always present?

sn: तमधर्मेण धर्मिष्ठं धृष्टद्युम्नेन संयुगे। श्रुत्वा निहतमाचार्यं सोऽश्वत्थामा किमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing that the pious preceptor has been slain in battle by unfair means by Dhristadyumna what did that Ashvatthama say?

sn: येन रामादवाप्येह धनुर्वेदं महात्मना। प्रोक्तान्यस्राणि दिव्यानि पुत्राय गुणकाक्षिणा॥
en: The illustrious Drona having mastered the science of bowmanship had imparted its knowledge to that son of his desirous of seeing the latter accomplished in every way.

sn: एकमेव हि लोकेऽस्मिन्नात्मनो गुणवत्तरम्। इच्छन्ति पुरुषाः पुत्रं लोके नान्यं कथंचन॥
en: There is only one person in the world whom people can desire to be superior to themselves in accomplishments and that person is one's own son.

sn: आचार्याणां भवन्त्येव रहस्यानि महात्मनाम्। तानि पुत्राय वा दधुः शिष्यायानुगताय वा॥
en: This is the mystery about all illustrious preceptors, that they impart the knowledge of their respective sciences of their sons or to their beloved pupils.

sn: स शिष्यः प्राप्य तत् सर्वं सविशेषं च संजया शूरः शारद्वतीपुत्रः संख्ये द्रोणादनन्तरः॥
en: O Sanjaya, the heroic son of Saradvata's daughter, being the disciple of his own sire has obtained all that knowledge in every detail and has become a second Drona.

sn: रामस्य तु समः शस्त्रे पुरंदरसमो युधि। कार्तवीर्यसमो वीर्य बृहस्पतिसमो मतौ॥
en: In knowledge of weapons, Ashvatthaman is like Rama himself; in battle he is like Purandar, in prowess he equals Kartavirya and in wisdom hc matches Brihaspati.

sn: महीधरसमः स्थैर्ये तेजसाग्निसमो युवा। समुद्र इव गाम्भीर्ये क्रोधे चाशीविषोपमः॥
en: Youthful in years, he resembles a mountain in endurance and fire in cnergy. In gravity he is equal to the ocean and in anger to a snake of virulent poison.

sn: र रथी प्रथमो लोके दृढधन्वा जितकमः। शीघ्रोऽनिल इवाक्रन्दे चरन् क्रुद्ध इवान्तकः॥
en: He is the first car-warrior in the world and indefatigable and resolute bowman. He equals the wind in speed; and in the thick of fight he careers like the Destroyer in person. or the

sn: अस्यता येन संग्रामे धरण्यभिनिपीडिता। यो न व्यथति संग्रामे वीरः सत्यपराक्रमः॥
en: Shooting his arrows in battle he had afflicted the earth herself. Brave and of great prowess, he is never exhausted in battle.

sn: वेदस्नातो व्रतस्नातो धनुर्वेदे च पारगः। महोदधिरिवाक्षोभ्यो रामो दाशरथिर्यथा॥
en: Purified by the recital of the Vedas and by the observance of the vows, he has thoroughly mastered the science of bow-manship. He is incapable of being ruffled and resembled in this direction the mighty ocean Dasaratha's son Raina himself.

sn: तमधर्मेण धर्मिष्ठं धृष्टद्युम्नेन संयुगे। श्रुत्वा निहतमाचार्यमश्वत्थामा किमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing that the righteous preceptor has been slain in battle by unfair means by Dhristadyumna what indeed did Ashvatthaman sky?

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्य यो मृत्युः सृष्टस्तेन महात्मना। यथा द्रोणस्य पाञ्चाल्यो यज्ञसेनसुतोऽभवत्॥
en: Ashvatthaman was destined to become the slayer of Dhristadyumna the son of Yajnasena, even as this latter was ordained to be the slayer of Drona.

sn: तं नृशंसेन पापेन क्रूरेणादीर्घदर्शिना। श्रुत्वा निहतमाचार्यमश्वत्थामा किमब्रवीत्॥
en: What, alas, did Ashvatthman say, hearing that the Preceptor has been slain by that sinful, cruel and mean Dhristadyumna of little foresight?

sn: संजय उवाच छद्मना निहतं श्रुत्वा पितरं पापकर्मणा। बाष्पेणापूर्यत द्रौणी रोषेण च नरर्षभ।।।।
en: Sanjaya said Hearing that his father has been slain by underhand means by Dhristadyumna of sinful deeds, Drona's son became filled, O foremost of men, with tears as well as with (extreme) rage.

sn: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य राजेन्द्र वपुर्दीप्तमदृश्यत। अन्तकस्येव भूतानि जिहीर्षोः कालपर्यये॥
en: Inflamed as he was with rage, his body, O monarch, appeared to burn like that of the Destroyer himself when at the expiration of a Yuga, he engages himself in slaughtering created beings.

sn: अश्रुपूर्णे ततो नेत्रे व्यपमृज्य पुनः पुनः। उवाच कोपान्निःश्वस्य दुर्योधनमिदं वचः॥
en: Then repeatedly wiping off his eyes shedding copious tears and breathing in rage, he said these words unto king Duryodhana.

sn: पिता मम यथा क्षुदैर्व्यस्तशस्रो निपातितः। धर्मध्वजवता पापं कृतं तद् विदितं मम॥
en: I have been apprised of the fact, how my father was slain after he laid his weapons aside; I have also known how a sinful act has been committed by those who boast of hoisting the standard of virtue.

sn: अनार्यं सुनृशंसं च धर्मपुत्रस्य मे श्रुतम्। युद्धेष्वपि प्रवृत्तानां ध्रुवं जयपराजयौ॥ द्वतमेतद् भवेद् राजन् वधस्तत्र प्रशस्यते। न्यायवृत्तो वधो यस्तु संग्रामे युध्यतो भवेत्॥
en: I have also heard of the vile and ruthless act of the very virtuous king Yudhishthira. Surely either victory or its reverses will fall to the lot of those who engage in fight. Death in battle is ever esteemed. The death overtaking one engaged in fight under fair rules of combat.

sn: न स दुःखाय भवति तथा दृष्टो हि स द्विजैः। गतः स वीरलोकाय पिता मम न संशयः॥
en: Should not become a source of grief, as been observed by the sages. My father, without doubt, has gone to the posthumous regions of the heroes.

sn: न शोच्यः पुरुषव्याघ्र यस्तदा निधनं गतः। यत् तु धर्मप्रवृत्तः सन् केशग्रहणमाप्तवान्॥
en: I should not lament for that foremost of men as he had undergone the most excellent from of death. But when fighting fairly, he was seized by the hair.

sn: पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां तन्मे मर्माणि कृन्तति। मयि जीवति यत् तात: केशग्रहमवाप्तवान्॥
en: Before the eyes of all the troops; this humiliation that he sustained is biting me to the very quick. Whilst I live, my sire was seized by the hair.

sn: कथमन्ये करिष्यन्ति पुत्रेभ्यः पुत्रिणः स्पृहाम्। कामात् क्रोधादविज्ञानाद्धर्षाद् बाल्येन वा पुनः॥
en: Why then should sonless men wish to obtain sons (who can help them in no way)? Moved by lust or wrath or ignorance or hatred or levity.

sn: विधर्मकाणि कुर्वन्ति तथा परिभवन्ति च। तदिदं पार्षतेनेह महादाधर्मिकं कृतम्॥
en: Men perpetrate acts opposed to morality or to humiliate others. This most sinful act has been committed by the son of Prisata.

sn: अवज्ञाय च मां नूनं नृशंसेन दुरात्मना। तस्यानुबन्धं द्रष्टासौ धृष्टद्युम्नः सुदारुणम्॥
en: Of wicked soul and ruthless heart, in utter disregard of myself. Dhristadyumna shall behold the dreadful consequences of his act.

sn: अकार्यं परमं कृत्वा मिथ्यावादी च पाण्डवः। यो ह्यसौ छानाऽऽचार्यं शस्रं संन्यासयत् तदा॥
en: As also the prevaricating sons of Pandu, who have perpetrated a sinful act. He that caused by an underhand underhand measure, the preceptor to lay aside his weapon.

sn: तस्याद्य धर्मराजस्य भूमिः पास्यति शोणितम्। शपे सत्येन कौरव्य इष्टापूर्तेन चैव ह॥
en: The blood of that son of Dharma the earth shall drink today. I swear by my truth, O foremost of the Kurus, as also by the religious merits acquired by my Istha and Purtha acts.

sn: अहत्वा सर्वपाञ्चालान् जीवेयं न कथंचन। सर्वोपायैर्यतिष्यामि पञ्चालानामहं वधे॥
en: That I shall drag on my burden some existence without slaying the Panchalas to the last men. Having re-course to all measures, I shall contend against the Panchalas in great battle,

sn: धृष्टद्युम्नं च समरे हन्ताहं पापकारिणम्। कर्मणा येन तेनेह मृदुनो दारुणेन च॥
en: Either by hook or crook or by violent or mild measures I will achieve the slaughter of Dhristadyumna of evil deeds in battle.

sn: पञ्चालानां वधं कृत्वा शान्तिं लब्धास्मि कौरव। यदर्थं पुरुषव्याघ्र पुत्रानिच्छन्ति मानवाः॥
en: () ruler of the Kuru, exterminating the Panchalas, I shall regain my peace of mind. O foremost of men, people desire to have children.

sn: प्रेत्य चेह च सम्प्राप्तास्रायन्ते महतो भयात्। पित्रा तु मम सावस्था प्राप्ता निर्बन्धुना यथा॥
en: In order that these latter may free them from great danger here and hereafter. But my sire was reduced to a woeful plight like one helpless.

sn: मयि शैलप्रतीकाशे पुत्रे शिष्ये च जीवति। धिङ्ममास्राणि दिव्यानि धिग् बाहू धिक्पराक्रमम्॥
en: While myself his son and disciple, equal to a mountain (in mighty) am still alive. Fie on my weapons of celestial make, fie on my arms, fie on my prowess.

sn: यं स्म द्रोणः सुतं प्राप्य केशग्रहमवाप्तवान्। स तथाहं करिष्यामि तथा भरतसत्तम।॥
en: Inasmuch as getting me for his son, Drona had to suffer the indignity of being seized by the hair. O foremost of the Bharatas, I shall therefore so exert myself that.

sn: परलोकगतस्यापि भविष्याम्यनृणः पितुः। आर्येण हि न वक्तव्या कदाचित् स्तुतिरात्मनः॥
en: I may be free from the debt I still owe to my sire who has proceeded to Heaven. A noble person never indulges in his own praise;

sn: पितुर्वधममृष्यंस्तु वक्ष्यामोह पौरुषम्। अद्य पश्यन्तु मे वीर्यं पाण्डवाः सजनार्दनाः॥
en: But incapable of tolerating the slaughter of my sire, I shall today untter my own praises-Let the Pandavas with Janardana at their head today behold my prowess.

sn: मृद्गतः सर्वसैन्यानि युगान्तमिव कुर्वतः। न हि देवा न गन्धर्वा नासुरा न च राक्षसाः॥
en: As I grind all creatures like the Destroyer himself at the hour of Dissolution. Neither the gods, nor the Gandharvas, nor the Asuras, nor the reptiles, nor the Rakshasas.

sn: अद्य शक्ता रणे जेतुं रथस्थं मां नरर्षभाः। मदन्यो नास्ति लोकेऽस्मिन्नर्जुनाद् वास्त्रवित् क्वचित्।।
en: Will be able today to conquer me as I shall ride on my car, O foremost of men. There is none in the world superior to me or Arjuna in the knowledge of weapons.

sn: अहं हि ज्वलतां मध्ये मयूखानामिवांशुमान्। प्रयोक्ता देवसृष्टानामस्राणां पृतनागतः॥
en: Today at the heart of the hostile troops, like the sun in the midst of scorching rays, I shall discharge my celestial weapons.

sn: भृयामिष्वसनादद्य मत्प्रयुक्ता महाहवे। दर्शयन्तः शरा वीर्य प्रमथिष्यन्ति पाण्डवान्॥
en: In today's mighty battle, shafts shot furiously from by bow will crush and mangle the Pandavas, showing their great energy.

sn: अद्य सर्वा दिशो राजन् धाराभिरिव संकुलाः। आवृताः पत्रिभिस्तीक्ष्णैर्द्रष्टरो मामकैरिह॥
en: My troops shall today bchold the quarters of the compass, shrouded with sharp-winged shafts, as if O king, by shower of rain.

sn: विकिरज्छरजालानि सर्वतो भैरवस्वनान्। शत्रून् निपातयिष्यामि महावात इव दुमान्॥
en: Shooting on all sides shafts of dreadful whirl, I shall fell my foes like the mighty tempest uprooting the trees.

sn: न हि जानाति बीभत्सुस्तदस्त्रं न जनार्दनः। न भीमसेनो न यमौ न च राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥ न पार्षतो दुरात्मासौ न शिखण्डी न सात्यकिः। यदिदं मयि कौरव्य सकल्पं सनिवर्तनम्॥
en: Neither Vibhatsu, nor Janardana, Bhimasena, nor the twins, (Nakula and Sahadeva), nor king Yudhishthira, nor Prisata's son of wicked soul, Sikhandin, nor Satyaki, even know the weapon which I possess, O nor foremost of the Kurus, with the mantras for hurling and withdrawing it.

sn: नारायणाय मे पित्रा प्रणम्य विधिपूर्वकम्। उपहारः पुरा दत्तो ब्रह्मरूप उपस्थितः॥
en: Formerly on one occasion, disguised as a Brahmana, Narayana, came to my father; whereupon my father bowing down unto him presented him offerings in due course and from.

sn: तं स्वयं प्रतिगृह्याथ भगवान् स वरं ददौ। ववे पिता मे परममा नारायणं ततः॥
en: Accepting those offerings that possessor of the six illustrious qualities (the Bhagas) desired to accord a boon to my sire. Thereupon my father asked the boon of getting that most excellent weapon called Narayana.

sn: अथैनमब्रवीद् राजन् भगवान् देवसत्तमः। भविता त्वत्समो नान्यः कश्चिद् युधि नरः क्वचित्।। ३३
en: Thereupon that foremost of all gods, that possessor of the six divine qualities said unto him, O king, “No man shall ever be a match for you in battle.

sn: न त्विदं सहसा ब्रह्मन् प्रयोक्तव्यं कथंचन। न ह्येतदस्रमन्यत्र वधाच्छवोर्निवर्तते॥
en: But, O Brahmana, this weapon should not be used without sufficient deliberation, for it never returns without dispatching the foc at whom it is hurled.

sn: न चैतच्छक्यते ज्ञातुं कं न वध्येदिति प्रभो। अवध्यमपि हन्याद्धि तस्मान्नैतत् प्रयोजयेत्॥
en: O Lord, I know not whom it may not slay. It will even effect the death of him who is unslayable. Therefore it should not be used hastily.

sn: अथ संख्ये रथस्यैव शस्राणां च विसर्जनम्। प्रयाचतां च शूत्रणां गमनं शरणस्य च॥
en: When one abandons his car on weapons in battle or implores for mercy or surrenders himself.

sn: एते प्रशमने योगा महास्रस्य परंतप। सर्वथा पीडितो हि स्यादवध्यान् पीडयन् रणे॥
en: O afflicter of your foes, these are the occasions when this mighty weapon, should not be used. He that wants to afflict the unslayable by this weapon himself becomes afflicted by it.

sn: तज्जग्राह पिता मह्यमब्रवीच्चैव स प्रभुः। त्वं वधिष्यसि सर्वाणि शस्रवर्षाण्यनेकशः॥
en: My puissant father then received that weapon. The lord then thus spoke to me also. "You shall destroy many showers of celestial weapons.

sn: अनेनास्रेण संग्राते तेजसा च ज्वलिष्यसि। एवमुक्तवा स भगवान् दिवमाचक्रमे प्रभुः॥
en: By means of this weapon and you shall blaze forth in effulgence by its virtue." Having thus spoken that Divine Lord ascended to heaven.

sn: एतन्नारायणादस्त्रं तत् प्राप्तं पितृबन्धुना। तेनाहं पाण्डवांश्चैव पञ्चालान् मत्स्यकेकयान्॥ विद्रावयिष्यामि रणे शचीपतिरिवासुरान्। यथा यथाहमिच्छेयं तथा भूत्वा शरा मम॥
en: This is history how my father obtained the Narayana weapon from the god. With the aid of this weapon, I shall crush the Pandavas, the Panchalas, the Matsyas and the Kaikayas in battle like the husband of Sachi crushing the Asuras. Assuming those particular forms which I shall desire them to assume, my arrows.

sn: निपतेयुः सपत्नेषु विक्रमत्स्वपि भारत। यथेष्टमश्मवर्षेण प्रवर्षिष्ये रणे स्थितः॥
en: Will fall upon my foes contending vigorously in battle. Staying in battle I shall shower weapons as it lists men to do.

sn: अयोमुखैश्च विहगैर्द्रावयिष्ये महारथान्। परश्वधांश्च निशितानुत्स्रक्ष्येऽहमसंशयम्॥
en: I will rout the foremost of car-warriors with sky-ranging arrows furnished with iron tips. I will certainly hurl battle axes, bludgeons and various other kinds of weapons.

sn: सोऽहं नारायणस्रेण महता शत्रुतापनः। शत्रून् विध्वंसयिष्यामि कदर्थी कृत्य पाण्डवान्॥
en: An afflicter of foes as I am, with the aid of that Narayana weapon, I shall destroy the foes, completely crushing the Pandavas.

sn: मित्रब्रह्मगुरुद्रोही जाल्मकः सुविगर्हितः। पाञ्चालापसदश्चाद्य न मे जीवन विमोक्ष्यते॥
en: That disgrace to the Panchala race, that contemner of his friends, the Brahmanas and his preceptor, that odious fellow of vilest conduct, shall not escape me alive today.

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा द्रोणपुत्रस्य पर्यवर्तते वाहिनी। ततः सर्वे महाशङ्खान् दध्मुः पुरुषसत्तमाः॥
en: Hearing those words of Drona's son, the army rallied; all foremost of warriors therein blew their mighly conches.

sn: भेरीचाभ्यहनन् हृष्टा डिण्डिमांश्च सहस्रशः। तथा ननाद वसुधा खुरनेमिप्रपीडिता॥
en: Delightedly they began to strike up the Bheris and Dindimas by thousands; the earth then struck with the hoops of horses and whecls of car, rang out loudly.

sn: स शब्दस्तुमुल: खं द्यां पृथिवीं च व्यनादयत्। तं शब्दं पाण्डवाः श्रुत्वा पर्जन्यनिनदोपमम्॥
en: That tremendous din resounded through the welkin. the heavens and the earth. Then hearing that sound that resembled the rumble of rain-clouds, the Pandavas.

sn: समेत्य रथिनां श्रेष्ठाः सहिताश्चाप्यमन्त्रयन्। तथोक्त्वा द्रोणपुत्रस्तु वायुपस्पृश्य भारत॥ प्रादुश्चकार तद् दिव्यमस्र नारायणं तदा।॥
en: Those foremost of car-warriors, uniting together began to consult. The son of Drona aiso, O Bharata, having spoken in the above manner, washed his mouth with water and then invoked into existence that celestial weapon known by the name of Narayana.

sn: संजय उवाच प्रादुर्भूते ततस्तस्मिन्नने नारायणे प्रभो। प्रावात् सपृषतो वायुरनभ्रे स्तनयित्नुमान्॥
en: Sanjaya said When that Narayana weapon had been invoked into existence, the wind began to blow from opposite directions and peals of thunder were heard though the sky was cloudless.

sn: चचाल पृथिवी चापि चुक्षुभे च महोदधिः। प्रतिस्रोतः प्रवृत्ताश्च गन्तुं तत्र समुद्रगाः॥
en: The earth quaked and the oceans became agitated. The ocean-going stream began to flow in contrary directions.

sn: शिखराणि व्यशीर्यन्त गिरीणां तत्र भारत। अपसव्यं मृगाश्चैव पाण्डुसेनां प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: The crests of mountains, O Bharata, began 10 split up. Diverse animals then passed keeping the son of Pandu to their right.

sn: तमसा चावकीर्यन्त सूर्यश्च कलुषोऽभवत्। सम्पतन्ति च भूतानि क्रव्यादानि प्रहृष्टवत्॥
en: The veil of darkness spread over the earth.। The sun became dimmed in splendour. Diverse। kinds of flesh-eating animals began to alight on the field of battle.

sn: देवदानवगन्धर्वास्रस्तास्त्वासन् विशाम्पते। व.थंकथाभवत् तीव्रा दृष्ट्वा तद् व्याकुलं महत्॥
en: O Ruler of men, celestials, the Danavas and the Gandharvas all became filled with fear. Seeing then that tremendous agitation in nature, they began to question one another saying, what is the cause of all this?

sn: व्यथिताः सर्वराजानस्रस्ताश्चासन् विशाम्पते। तद् दृष्ट्वा घोररूपं वै द्रौणेरस्त्रं भयावहम्॥
en: All the kings became filled with anxiety and inspired with terror, O ruler of men, at the sight of that dreadful weapon of affrighting aspect, belonging to Drona's son.

sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच निवर्तितेषु सैन्येषु द्रोणपुत्रेण संयुगे। भृशं शोकाभितत्पेन पितुर्वधममृष्यता॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When unable to brook the slaughter of his sire and overwhelmed with grief, Drona's son did rally the troops.

sn: कुरूनापततो दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नस्य रक्षणे। कोमन्त्रः पाण्डवेष्वासीत् तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Tell me, O Sanjaya, what consultation then the Pandavas held for protecting Dhristadyumna, as they saw the Kurus return to the charge.

sn: संजय उवाच प्रागेव विद्रुतान् दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान् युधिष्ठिरः। पुनश्च तुमुलं शब्दं श्रुत्वार्जुनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said At first having seen the Dhartarashtras routed and again beholding them return to the attack Yudhishthira addressing Arjuna said

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आचार्ये निहते द्रोणे धृष्टद्युम्नेन संयुगे। निहते वज्रहस्तेन यथा वृत्रे महासुरे॥
en: Yudhishthira said Upon the slaughter of the preceptor Drona by Dhristadyumna like the slaughter of the mighly Asura Vrita by the wielder of thunderbolt.

sn: नाशंसन्तो जयं युद्धे दीनात्मनो धनंजय। आत्मत्राणे मतिं कृत्वा प्राद्रवन् कुरवो रणात्॥
en: 0 Dhananjaya, the enemy depressed at heart, gave up all hopes of victory. They fled from the field, intent on saving themselves.

sn: केचिद् भ्रान्तै रथैस्तूर्णं निहतैः पाणियन्तृभिः। विपताकध्वजच्छत्रैः पार्थिवाः शीर्णकूबरैः॥ भग्ननीडैराकुलाश्वैः प्रारुग्णाश्च विशेषतः। भग्नाक्षयुगचक्ष व्याकृष्यन्त समन्ततः॥
en: Some rulers of men fled on chariots borne along irregular courses, with parshni drivers slain, deprived of standards, streamers and umbrellas, with their boxes and Kuvaras shattered and all their decorations displaced. Others again, panic-struck and deprived of reason, goading the steeds of their chariots with their toes, fled in all haste.

sn: भीताः पादैहयान् केचित् त्वरयन्तः स्वयं रथान्। रथान् विशीर्णानुत्सृज्य पद्भिः केचिच विदुताः॥
en: Others overwhelmed with fear, fled on their cars having their axles, wheels and yokes broken. Others fled, hanging half way from their saddles.

sn: हयपृष्ठगताश्चान्ये कृष्यन्तेऽर्धच्युतासनाः। गजस्कन्धेषु संस्यूता नाराचैश्चलितासनाः॥
en: Others again displaced from their seats and riveted with shafts on the necks of elephants, were precipitately borne away by those animals. Others were crushed down by flying elephants, mangled and pierced with arrows.

sn: शरातैर्विदूतैर्नागैर्हताः केचिद् दिशो दश। विशस्रकवचाश्चान्ये वाहनेभ्यः क्षितिं गताः॥
en: Others with their armours taken off and weapons exhausted fell down on the earth from the back of their animals. Others again were mutilated by car-wheels or crushed by steeds of elephants.

sn: संछिन्ना नेमिभिश्चैव मृदिताश्च हयद्विपैः। क्रोशन्तस्तात पुत्रेति पलायन्ते परे भयात्॥
en: Some loudly calling their sires and their sons fled away in fear, without recognising one another and reduced in energy by grief.

sn: नाभिजानन्ति चान्योन्यं कश्मलाभिहतौजसः। पुत्रान् पितॄन् सखीन् भ्रातृन् समारोप्य दृढक्षतान्॥
en: Some causing their sons, fathers, friends and brothers sit (on their vehicles) and doffing their coats of inail were seen to wash them with water.

sn: जलेन क्लेदयन्यन्ये विमुच्य कवचान्यपि। अवस्थां तादृशीं प्राप्य हते द्रोणे द्रुतं बलम्॥
en: After the slaughter of Drona, the enemy's host, falling into great distress, fled away in haste. Who hath rallied it now? Tell me if you know it.

sn: पुनरावर्तितं केन यदि जानासि शंस मे। हयानां हृषतां शब्दः कुञ्जराणां च बुंहताम्॥
en: The sound of neighing steeds and roaring clephants mangled with the clatter of carwheels in heard aloud.

sn: रथनेमिस्वनैश्चात्र विमिश्रः श्रूयते महान्। एते शब्दा भृशं तीव्राः प्रवृत्ताः कुरुसागरे॥
en: These terrible sounds in the ocean of Kuru army, are swelling every moment and causing my troops to tremble.

sn: मुहुर्मुहुरुदीर्यन्ते कम्पयन्त्यपि मामकान्। य एष तुमुल: शब्दः श्रूयते लोमहर्षणः॥
en: This tremendous sound that is assailing our ears, causing our hair to stand erect, Meseems, will devour up the three worlds with their lords.

sn: सेन्द्रानप्येष लोकांस्रीन् ग्रसेदिति मतिर्मम। मन्ये वज्रधरस्यैष निनदो भैरवस्वनः॥
en: I think this to be the tremendous roar of the wielder of the thunder, viz., Vasava, who cnraged at the slaughter of Drona is coming to fight on behalf of the Kauravas.

sn: द्रोणे हते कौरवार्थं व्यक्तमभ्येति वासवः। प्रहृष्टरोमकूपाश्च संविग्ना रथपुङ्गवाः॥
en: ( Dhananjaya, hearing this loud and terrible sound our hairs stand erect and our best car-warriors are becoming filled with anxiety.
