description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: यो प्रीत्या गरीयांसं वशे स्थितम्॥ वशे पापीयसो धत्ते तत् पापमधरोत्तरम्।
en: That person, who makes one, who is a guest out of love and who is most supreme and who, again, is already very obedient, submissive to a very sinful man, surely becomes subject to that sort of crime which is similar to one of confusing the superior with the inferior.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: ब्रह्मणा ब्राह्मणाः सृष्टा मुखात् क्षत्रं च बाहुतः॥ ऊरुभ्यामसृजद् वैश्याशूद्रान पद्भ्यामिति श्रुतिः।
en: This is a truth that Brahma created the twice-born persons from his mouth; and the Kshatriyas (or the people of the warrior class) from his arms, and also he created the Vaisyas (or the merchant class) from his thighs; and the Sudras (or the people of the servile class) from his feet.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: तेभ्यो वर्णविशेषाश्च प्रतिलोमानुलोमजाः॥ अथान्योन्यस्य संयोगाचातुर्वर्ण्यस्य भारत।
en: Thereupon, O descendant of the Bharata race, the particular classes of persons, that is these born of (superior father marrying an inferior mother, or of a inferior father marrying a superior mother), have all originated from these four classes by means of their union with one another.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: गोप्तारः संगृहीतारो दातारः क्षत्रिया:स्मृताः॥ याजनाध्यापनैर्विप्रा विशुद्धैश्च प्रतिग्रहैः। लोकस्युनुग्रहार्थाय स्थापित ब्राह्मण भुवि॥
en: It has often been told that the Kshatriyas are the protectors of the rest of the classes, as also they are the possessors and givers of wealth. The Brahmana, or the regenerate persons, are characterised as presiding at sacrifices, teaching and also by the acceptance of pure gifts and again, the Brahmanas, that is, the twice-born persons, were established upon the earth in order that they would shower forth blessings upon all the people.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: कृषिश्च पाशुपाल्यं च दिशां दानं च धर्मतः। ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां शूद्रा विहिताः परिचारकाः॥
en: According to the Dharma-Shastras the occupations of the Vaisyas are agriculture, the rearing of cattle and gift; whereas the Sudras are ordained to be the servants of the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas and Vaisyas.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: ब्रह्मक्षत्रस्य विहिताः सूता वै परिचारकाः। न क्षत्रियोवै सूतानां शृणुयाच कथञ्चन॥
en: Then, again, the charioteers, indeed are servants to the Kshatriyas; but never the Kshatriyas, O sinless one, are servants to the charioteer class. Do you, therefore, listen to these my words.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: अहं मूर्धाभिषिक्तो हि राजर्षिकुलजो नृपः। महारथः समाख्यातः सेव्यः स्तुत्यश्च वन्दिनाम्॥४९
en: I am that person, who have his head (or hairs) washed off with sanctity and I am born of a high family of royal sage and I am a mighty car-warriors and I am person of great note; as, again, I am worshipped and praised by the eulogists.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: सोऽहमेतादृशो भूत्वा नेहारिबलसूदनः। सूतपुत्रस्य संग्रामे सारथ्यं कर्तुमुत्सहे॥
en: O slayer of the hostile force, when I am such a person as described, I cannot dare act as the charioteer of the son of Suta in the field.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: अवमानमहं प्राप्य न योत्स्यामि कथञ्चन। आपृच्छे त्वाद्य गान्धारे गमिष्यामि गृहाय वै॥
en: Thus having obtained this insult I will never battle in the field, O son of Gandhari, today. I ask your permission, as I am really willing to return home.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: संजय उवाच एवमुक्त्वा महाराज शल्यः समितिशोभन:। उत्थाय प्रयसौ तूर्णे राजमध्यादमर्षितः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus addressed, that foremost of persons, Shalya, who was the ornament of assemblies and who also became highly enraged, immediately went away from the midst of the kings, after having stood up.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: प्रणयाद् बहुमानाश्च तं निगृह्य सुतस्तव। अब्रवीन्मधुरं वाक्यं साम्ना सर्वार्थसाधकम्॥
en: Then your son, having received him (Shalya) with great affection and high respect, addressed him in a friendly manner these sweet expressions, pregnant with very grave ideas.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: यथा शल्य विजानीषे एवमेतदसंशयम्। अभिप्रायस्तु मे कश्चित् तं निबोध जनेश्वर॥
en: O Shalya, this what you utter is doubtlessly true. In this, I have some object in sight. Be you, therefore, O lord of men, acquainted with this,

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: न कर्णोऽभ्यधिकस्त्वत्तो न शके त्वां च पार्थिव। न हि मद्रेश्वरो राजा कुर्याद् यदनृतं भवेत्॥
en: O lord of earth, Karna is in no way higher than what you are; nor that I doubt your conduct. It is sure also that the royal chief of the Madras will not achieve what should be unreal.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: ऋतमेव हि पूर्वास्ते वदन्ति पुरुषोत्तमाः। तस्मादार्तायनिः प्रोक्तो भवानिति मतिर्मम॥
en: Indeed, your ancestors, who were the best of persons, always told the truth; and hence it is my opinion that yourself is said to be the descendant of the truthful persons.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: शल्यभूतस्तु शत्रूणा यस्मात्त्वं युधि मानद। तस्माच्छल्यो हि ते नाम कथ्यते पृथिवीतले॥
en: O you who confer honors, you are like a barbed shaft to your enemies upon this earth. In consequence thereof you are called by the name of Shalya on the surface of the world.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: यदेतद् व्याहतं पूर्व भवता भूरिदक्षिण। तदेव कुरु धर्मज्ञ मदर्थे यद् यदुच्यते॥
en: O you who award ample gifts (to the regenerate persons). O you who are acquainted with virtue, you now achieve for my sake what was told by you before, saying that you would achieve.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: न त त्वत्तो हि राधेयो न चाहमपि वीर्यवान्। वृणेऽहं त्वां हयाग्र्याणां यन्तारमिह संयुगे॥
en: Really neither the son of Radha, nor I am more powerful than you. Hence I solicit you to be the driver of these horses of the best species (yoked to the car of Karna) in this dreadful battle.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: मन्ये चाभ्यधिकं शल्य गुणैः कर्णं धनंजयात्। भवन्तं वासुदेवाश्च लोकोऽयमिति मन्यते॥
en: O sire, even as Karna is reckoned to be superior to Dhananjaya regarding innumerable qualities, so this whole world is of opinion that you are superior to even Vasudeva.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: कर्णो ह्यभ्यधिकः पार्थादस्त्रैरेव नरर्षभः। भवानभ्यधिकः कृष्णादश्वज्ञाने बले तथा॥
en: O foremost of persons, Karna is, indeed, far superior to the son of Pritha respecting the management of weapons; and you, too, are superior to Krishna both in the horse-lore and physical power.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: यथाश्वहृदयं वेद वासुदेवो महामनाः। द्विगुणं त्वं तथा वेत्सि मद्रराजेश्वरात्मज॥
en: As that high-souled Vasudeva is thoroughly versed in the knowledge about horses, even so you, O royal chief of the Madras, is twice acquainted with that knowledge. There is no doubt about it.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: शल्य उवाच यन्मां ब्रवीषि गान्धारे मध्ये सैन्यस्य कौरव। विशिष्टं देवकीपुत्रात् प्रीतिमनम्यहं त्वहि॥
en: Shalya said O son of Gandhari, O descendant of the Kuru race, as you tell me that amongst all these troops there is none more accomplished than the son of Devaki, even so I am highly gratified with you.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: एष सारथ्यमातिष्ठे राधेयस्य यशस्विनः। युध्यतः पाण्डवाग्र्येण यथा त्वं वीर मन्यसे॥
en: Thus I will act as the charioteer of that greatly famous son of Radha, while he will engage in battle with that foremost of the sons of Pandu, even as you, O hero, desire me.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: समयश्च हि मे वीर कश्चिद् वैकर्तनं प्रति। उत्सृजेयं यथाश्रद्धमहं वाचोऽस्य संनिधौ॥
en: But O hero, this should really be my provision towards the son of Vikartana that I will sent froth in his presence such utterances as I will desire.

description: Shalya'a acceptance of the charioteership of Karna
sn: संजय उवाच तथेति राजन् पुत्रस्ते सह कर्णेन भारत। अब्रबीन्मद्रराजस्य मतं भरतसत्तम्॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, O descendant of Bharata, O best of the Bharata race, your son, accompanied by Karna, replied to the son of the king of the Madras, saying-so be it.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: दुर्योधन उवाच भूय एव तु मद्रेश यत्ते वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु। यथा पुरावृत्तमिदं युद्धे देवासुरे विभो॥
en: Duryodhana said Do you. again, O chief of the Madras, O lord, hear all that I will relate to you, namely what had taken place in the days of old in the great war between the celestials and the Asuras.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: यदुक्तवान् पितुर्मह्यं मार्कण्डेयो महानुषिः। तदशेषेण ब्रुवतो मम राजर्षिसत्तम॥ नितोध मनसा चात्र न ते कार्या विचारणा।
en: O foremost of the royal sages, do you not listen to what the great sage Markandeya had related to me as well as to my father which I will, again describe to you in detail. No doubt should be made by you in this.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: देवानामसुराणां च परस्परजिगीषया॥ बभूव प्रथमो राजन् संग्रामस्तारकामयः।
en: O monarch, there had taken place a dreadful battle, that had its root in Taraka, between the celestials and the Asuras, each of which parties was most desirous of defeating : the other.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: निर्जिताच तदा दैत्या दैवतैरिति नः श्रुतम्॥ निर्जितेषु च दैत्येषु तारकस्य सुतास्त्रयः। ताराक्षः कमलाक्षश्च विद्युन्माली च पार्थिव॥ तप उग्रं समास्थाय नियमे परमे स्थिताः।
en: Then it has been heard by us that the Daityas were subdued by the celestials. O monarch, when the Daityas were thus defeated by the celestials, the three sons of Taraka, named Taraksha, Kamalaksha and Vidyunmali. Who had place themselves under severe devotion.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: तपसा कर्षयामसुर्देशन् स्वान् शत्रुतापन॥ दमेन तपसा चैव नियमेन समाधिना। तेषां पितामहः प्रीतो वरदः प्रददौ वरम्॥
en: Who, also, had submitted themselves to the strictest rules liberated their bodies by means of that austere devotion, ( scorcher of enemies. Who was ever the giver of boons, became highly gratified with them on account of their devotion, self-restraint, observance of strict rules and also of divine contemplation and offered them numerous boons.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: अवध्यत्वं च ते राजन् सर्वभूतस्य सर्वदा। सहिता वरयामासुः सर्वलोकपितामहम्॥
en: O monarch, they, have united with one another, asked of the great grandsire of all the worlds that boon, namely that they would not attain death from all creatures always.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: तानब्रवीत्तदा देवो लोकानां प्रभुरीश्वरः। नास्ति सर्वामरत्वं वै निवर्तध्वमितोऽसुराः॥ अन्यं वरं वृणीध्वं वै यादृशं सम्प्ररोचते।
en: Thereupon the lord, the God, that divine master of all the worlds, addressed to them, saying-"O Asuras, there exists no such thing, namely the freedom from death at the hands of all creatures, and therefore do you retain from such a solicitation. Indeed you ask another boon, that you like most.'

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: ततस्ते सहिता राजन् सम्प्रधार्यासकृत प्रभुम्॥ सर्वलोकेश्वरं वाक्यं प्रणम्येदमथाब्रुवन्। अस्मभ्यं त्वं वरं देव सम्प्रयच्छ पितामह॥
en: Thereafter, O monarch, those Asuras after having brooded over the matter conjointly for a long while and settled amongst themselves and also having bowed down to that Lord of all the worlds, addressed him with these words-'O God, O grandsire, do you give us this boon.'

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: दैत्या ऊचुः वयं पुराणि त्रीण्येव समास्थाय महीमिमाम्। विचरिष्याम लोकेऽस्मिस्त्वत्प्रसाद पुरुस्कृताः॥
en: Asuras said 'In this world having kept your grace always in the front we will, living in three different cities, wonder over this entire earth.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: ततो वर्षसहस्रे तु समेष्याम:परस्परम्। एकीभावं गमिष्यन्ति पुराण्येतानि चानघ॥ समागतानि चैतानि यो हन्याद् भगवंस्तदा। एकेषुणाः देववरः स नो मृत्युभविष्यति॥
en: Then after one thousand years we will again unite together; and ( faultless one, these three cities, belonging to ourselves, will also attain the similar condition once more. Whenever, O lord, any one of the celestials will penetrate with a single arrow those cities united into the one that most excellent of celestials will become the cause of our death."

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: एवमस्त्विति तान् देवः प्रत्युक्त्वा प्राविशद् दिवम्। तु लब्धवराः प्रीताः सम्प्रधार्य परस्परम्॥ पुरत्रयबिसृष्टयर्थ मयं वदुर्महासुरम्। विश्वकर्माणमजरं दैत्यदानवपूजितम्॥
en: Then that god, having replied to them, saying-So be it, ascended to heaven. Thereupon they (the three Asuras), being highly gratified for having obtained the boons and also having settled everything amongst themselves, called Maya, who was a mighty Asura and who was the celestial architect and who was also without decay or death and highly respected by the whole lot of the Daityas and the Danavas with a view to have those three cities constructed.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: ततो मयः स्वतपसा चक्रे धीमान् पुराणि च। त्रीणि काञ्चनमेकं वै रौप्यं कार्णायसं तथा॥ ते
en: Thereupon Maya, who was of superior intelligence, constructed the three cities with the help of his own asceticism, the one of the three was inade of gold, the second of silver and the third of black iron.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: काञ्चनं दिवि तत्रासीदन्तरिक्षे च राजतम्। आयसं चाभवद् भौमं चक्रस्थं पृथिवीपते॥
en: The city that was constructed of gold rested in the heaven; and that one of silver was placed in the firmament; and where as the third, that was made of black iron, was established upon the earth. But, O lord of earth, they all were made to rest upon a wheel.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: एकैकं योजनशतं विस्तारायामतः समम्। गृहाट्टालकसंयुक्तं बहुप्राकारतोरणम्॥
en: Each one of them (the three cities) were measured to be one hundred yojanas broad; and contained numerous buildings and houses, as also lofty walls and perches.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: गृहप्रवहसम्बाधमसम्बाधमहापथम्। प्रासादैर्विविधैश्चापि द्वारैश्चैवोपशोभितम्॥
en: Although the foremost of the buildings in them were very closely situated to one another yet the high roads were very spacious and far off from one another. They also were very excellently furnished with the diverse kinds of palaces and beautiful perches.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: पुरेषु चाभवन् राजन् राजानो वै पृथक्-पृथक्। काञ्चनं तारकाक्षस्यचित्रमासीन्महात्मनः॥
en: O monarch, separate kings lived in those cities. The one of gold that was most beautiful had been in the possession of the high-souled Tarakaksha.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: राजतं कमलाक्षस्य विद्युन्मालिन आयसम्। त्रयस्ते दैत्यराजानस्त्रील्लोकानस्त्रतेजसा॥ आक्रम्य तस्थुरूचुश्च कश्च नाम प्रजापतिः।
en: And the other made of silver had been in the possession of Kamalaksha; and the third of black iron belonged to Vidyunmalin. And those three Dailya inonarchs immediately attacked the three worlds with the aid of their prowess and continued to reside; they said also these words, who is that one called Prajapati। (or the creator).

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: तेषां दानवमुख्यानां प्रयुतान्तयर्बुदानि च॥ कोट्यश्चाप्रतिवीराणां समाजग्मुस्ततस्ततः।
en: Thereupon millions and millions of from all directions proceeded against those best of the Danavas who had no hordes to come against them.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: मांसाशिनः सुद्दप्ताश्च सुरैर्विनिकृताः पुरा॥ महदैश्चर्यमिच्छन्तस्त्रिपुरं दुर्गमाश्रिताः।
en: The greatly hanghty and flesh-eating Danavas, who were in the days of yore vanquished by the celestials, now having dwelt in those three well fortified cities, became highly desirous of obtaining immense property.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: सर्वेषां च पुनश्चैषां सर्वयोगवहो मयः॥ तमाश्रित्य हि ते सर्वे वर्तयन्तेऽकुतोभयाः।
en: Now Maya had became the supporter of them all, who have thus united together. Indeed, all of them having been under his protection (Maya's) lived there with perfect fearlessness.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: यो हि यन्मनसा कामं दध्यौ त्रिपुरसंश्रयः॥ तस्मै कामं मयस्तं त विदधे मायया तदा।
en: Thenceforth whoever amongst those dwelling in those cities entertained whatever wish in his heart it was then Maya who fulfilled their desires by aid of his illusory energy.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: तारकाक्षसुतो वीरो हरिर्नाम महाबलः॥ तपस्तेपे परमकं येनातुष्यत् पितामाहः।
en: The heroic and the most powerful son of Tarakaksha, who was known by the name of Hari, practised the most severe devotion, in consequence of which the Grandsire became highly satisfied with him.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: संतुष्टवृणोद् देवं वापी भवतु नः पुरे॥ शस्त्रैर्विनिहता यत्र क्षिप्ताः स्युर्बलवत्तरा।
en: Thus when the God was satisfied with him, he (Hari) asked him the following boon-'Let there be a lake in our city, in which the persons, greatly struck by the weapons, having been dipped, will revive with resembled vigor.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: स तु लब्धा वरं वीरस्तारक्षसुतो हरिः॥ ससृजे तत्र वापी तां मृतानां जीविनीं प्रभो।
en: O lord, after having obtained the boon, that war-like son of Tarakaksha, named Hari, created a lake in that city, which possessed the power of reviving the dead.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: येन रूपेण दैत्यस्यु येन वेषेण चैव ह॥ मृतस्तस्यां परिक्षिप्तस्तादृशेनैव जज्ञिवान्।
en: Indeed, the Daityas, in whatever form and whatever guise they were slaughtered, after having been dipped into that lake, had come back to their life in the same form and guise.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: तां प्राप्य तेपुनस्तास्तु लोकान् सर्वान् बबाधिरे॥ महता तपसा सिद्धाः सुराणां भय वर्धना। न तेषामभवद् राजन् क्षयो युद्धे कदाचन॥
en: Thus after having regained their dead, they (the Daityas), who attained to their ascetic success by means of great devotion and who also enhanced the terrors of all the celestials, now began to oppress all the different worlds. O monarch, there had never been the slightest diminution of their number in the field of battle.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: ततस्ते लोभमोहाभ्यामभिभूता विचेतसः। निर्टीका: संस्थिताः सर्वे स्थापिताः समलूलुपन्॥३३
en: Thereupon they, who had been involved both by covetousness and insensibility and who also were deprived of their sense, now began to destroy the cities and the towns, that were settled upon the whole universe.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: विद्राव्य सगणान् देवांस्तत्र तत्र तदा तदा। विचेसः स्वेन कामेन वरदानेन दर्पिताः॥
en: Having routed all the celestials, along with their attendants, at all times and in all places, those Danavas, who had been rendered hanghty by the attainment of the boons, wandered, according to their option.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: देवोद्यानानि सर्वाणि प्रियाणि च दिवोकसाम्। ऋषीणामाश्रमान् पुण्यान् रभ्याजनपदांस्तथा॥ व्यनाशयन्नमर्यादा दानवा दुष्टचारिणः।
en: All over the celestials, forests and different other regions that had been very dear to celestials themselves and the scared asylums belonging to the sages, as also the most excellent abodes of men. Moreover these Danavas, who behaved most cruelly, had damaged the honour of all.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: पीड्यमानेषु लोकेषु ततः शक्रो मरुवृतः॥ पुराण्यायोधयांचक्रे वज्रपातैः समन्ततः।
en: While thus all the worlds were very greatly oppressed (by the Danavas), then Shakra (Indra), who had been encompassed by all the Maruts, fought against those cities by hurling his thunder (upon them) from all sides.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: नाशकत् तान्यभेद्यानि यदा भेत्तुः पुरंदरः॥ पुराणि वरदत्तानि धात्रा तेन नराधिप। तदा भीतः सुरपतिर्मुक्त्वा तानि पुराण्यथ॥ तैरेव विबुधैः सार्ध पितामहमरिदम्। जगामाथ तदाख्यातुं विप्रकारं सुरेतरैः॥
en: When, O foremost of monarchs, Purandara became incapable to pierce cities, which had been made impenetrable by that creator and which also had received the boons, Then, O subduer of enemies, the terror struck lord of the gods abandoning these cities and celestials, went to the Grandsire with a view to relate to him the great insults wrought out by the Asuras.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: ते तत्त्वं सर्वमाख्याय शिरोभिः सम्प्रणम्य च। वधोपायमपृच्छन्त भगवन्तं पितामहम्॥
en: They then, having described who whole history and also having bowed down to him with their heads, asked the lord grandsire the fitting means of their destruction.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: श्रुत्वा तद् भगवान् देवो देवानिदमुवाच ह। ममापि सोऽपरानोति यो युष्माकामसौम्यकृत्य्॥
en: Having listened to all that, the lord god addressed all the celestials, saying this. That injurious fellow, who offends you, does surely offend me too.'

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: असुरा हि दुरात्मानः सर्व एव सुरद्विष। अपराध्यन्ति सततं ये युष्मान् पीडयन्त्युत॥
en: Indeed the Asuras are all very wickedsouled; and also they are dead against the celestials. And when they commit oppressions against you; they thus afflict me always. can

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: अहं हि तुल्यः सर्वेषां भूतानां नात्र संशयः। अधार्मिकास्तु हन्तव्या इति मे व्रतमाहितम्॥
en: I am, indeed, equally disposed towards all the creatures. There is no doubt about it. My fixed vow is that the unrighteous ones should ever be slaughtered.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: एकेषुणा विभेद्यानि तानि दुर्गाणि नान्यथा। न च स्थाणुमते शक्तो भेत्तुमेकेषुणा पुरः॥
en: Those three fortresses only be penetrated by means of a single shafts; but in no other way can they be pierced. There exists no other person cxcept Stana, who is able to pierce them with a single arrows.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: ते यूयं स्थाणुमीशानं जिष्णुमक्लिष्टकारिणम्। योद्धारं वृणुतादित्याः स तान् हन्तासुरेतरान्॥
en: Then you, O Adityas, select that heroic warrior Stana, also called Ishana, as well as Jishnu, who can hardly be afflicted in the battle. He will surely slaughter these Asuras.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः। ब्रह्माणमग्रतः कृत्वा वृषाङ्कं शरणं ययुः॥
en: Hearing this speech of his, all the celestials, under the leadership of Shakra, placing Brahman at their front, went to scek shelter of that god, who had a bull for his symbol.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: तपो नियममास्थाय गृणन्तो ब्रह्म शाश्वतम्। ऋषिभिः सह धर्मज्ञा भवं सर्वात्मना गताः॥
en: Being accompanied by these Rishis (sages), who practised severe devotion and who also uttered the eternal words of the Vedas, all these righteous gods repaired to Bhava with their whole soul directed towards him.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: तुष्टवुर्वाग्भिरिष्टाभिर्भयेष्वभयदं नृप। सर्वात्मानं महात्मानं येनाप्तं सर्वमात्मना॥
en: Then, O monarch, they began to satisfy him with the high speeches (as found in the Vedas), who is the giver of fearlessness in all fears and who is the soul of all and who himself is highsouled and by whom, again, the entire universe is pervaded through with his eternal soul.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: तपोविशेषैर्विविधैर्योगं यो वेद चात्मनः। यः सांख्यमात्मनो वेत्ति यस्य चात्मा वशे सदा॥४९ तं ते ददृशुरीनां तेजोराशिमुमापतिम्। अनन्यसदृशं लोके भगवन्तमकल्मषम्॥
en: That one, who knows how to meditate upon the Soul by means of special devotional performances and who also knows the capability of the soul, that is, the difference between soul and matter, as also whose soul is ever under his control. That one, named Ishana, that mass of fiery energy, that lord of Uma, that one having had no equal in the world, that cause of all causes, that faultless one, they (the celestials) saw.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: एकं भगवन्तं ते नानरूपमकल्पयन्। आत्मनः प्रतिरूपाणि रूपाण्यथ महात्मनि॥ परस्परस्य चापश्यन् सर्वे परमविस्मिताः।
en: Then there lords conceived innumerable forms in him, although he was but one. Thereafter they all, after having found out all these numerous form as each of them had respectively conceived in their minds, became highly astonished.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: सर्वभूतमयंदृष्ट्वा तमजं जगतः पतिम्॥ देवा ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव शिरोभिर्धरणीं गताः।
en: All the celestials, as well as all the regenerate sages, after having seen that embodiment of all creatures, that unborn person, who was the most supreme of the entire universe, touched the earth with their heads.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: तान् स्वतिवादेनाभ्यर्च्य समुत्थाप्य च शङ्करः॥ ब्रूत ब्रूतेति भगवान् स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत।
en: Then having received them by uttering the worlds you are welcome and also having raised their heads, Lord Shankara smilingly addressed them, saying-do you tell me the purpose of your coming here.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: त्र्यम्बकेणाभ्यनुज्ञातास्ततस्ते स्वस्थचेतसः॥ नमो नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु प्रभो इत्यब्रुवन् वचः।
en: Thereupon having been commanded by the three-eyed deity, the celestials, who became highly gratified, uttered these words to hiin-O lord, let our repeated salutations be to you.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: नमो देवाधिदेवाय धन्विने वनमालिने॥ प्रजापतिखध्नाय प्रजापतिभिरीड्यते। नमः स्तुताय स्तुत्याय स्तूयमानाय शम्भवे॥
en: Let our salutations be to you, who are the lord of all the celestials; let our salutations be to you, who are mighty bowman and to you, who are subject to great rage and also to you, who are the destroyer of the sacrifices of the creator; and to you, again, who are worshipped by all the lords of the creatures. Let our salutations be to you, who are ever present; and to you, who are worthy to be prayed; and to you, who are continuously praised; and to you, who are the death himself; and

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: विलोहिताय रुद्राय नीहग्रीबाय शूलिने। अमोघाय मृगाक्षाय प्रवरायुधयोधिने॥
en: You are possessed of red splendour; and to you, who are dreadful; and to you who are endued with blue throat; and to you, who are furnished with the symbol of a trident; and to you, who are never to be prostrated; and to you, who are furnished with the eyes of a yazelle; and to you, who battle with the best weapons;

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: अर्हाय चैव शुद्धाय क्षयाय क्रथनाय च। दुर्वारणाय शुक्राय ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मचारिणे॥ ईशानायाप्रमेयाय नियन्त्रे चर्मवाससे। तपोरताय पिङ्गाय वतिने कृत्तिवाससे॥
en: And to you, who are worthy of all praises; and to you, who are pure; and to you, who are the very death himself; and to you also, who are the destroyer of all; and to you, who can with difficulty be resisted; and to you who are Shakra himself; and to you, who are also Brahman; and to you who behave like a Brahmachari; and to you who are Ishana; and to you, who are immeasurable; and to you, who are the leader of all; and to you, who are dressed with rages; and to you, who practise cternal vows; and to you, who are tawnycolored; and to you, who carry on severe vows; and to you, who are dressed with the skins of animal:

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: कुमारपित्रे त्र्यक्षाय प्रवकायुधधारिणे। प्रपन्नार्तिविनाशाय ब्रह्मद्विसंघघातिने॥
en: And to you, who are the father of Kumara; and to you, who are furnished with the three eyes, and to you, who are armed with the best of weapons, and to you, who destroy the afflictions of those who have sought your protection; and to you, who bring about the death of those who are enemies to the regenerate persons;

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: वनस्पतीनां पतये नराणां पतये नमः। गवां च पतये नित्यं यज्ञानां पतये नमः॥
en: You are nourisher to vegetation and king to human-beings. You are the defender of cows and governor to all offerings (yajna). Frequent salute to you.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: नमोस्तुते ससैन्याय त्र्यम्बकायामितौजसे। मनोवाक्वर्मभिर्देव त्वां प्रपन्नान् भजस्व नः॥
en: Let our salutations be to you, who are the leader of the troops; and to you, who are furnished with three eyes; and to you, who are possessed of fierce energy; O god, let our salutations be to you with our whole heart, speech and acts. Be you kind to us, who seek your shelter.

description: The history of the three cities of the Danavas
sn: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् स्वागतेनाभिनन्द्य च। प्रोवाच व्येतु वस्त्रासो ब्रूतं किं करवाणि वः॥
en: Thereupon the lord, who became highly gratified, having received them with the words you are welcome, addressed them, saying let your fears be all gone; tell me what am I to do for you all.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: दुर्योधन उवाच पितृदेवर्षिसंघेभ्योऽभये दत्ते महात्मना। सत्कृत्य शङ्करं प्राह ब्रह्मा लोकहितं वचः॥
en: Duryodhana said When fearlessness was given to the whole class of the Pitris, the celestials and the Rishis by that high-souled one (Brahman), he (Brahman), after having adorned Shankara properly uttered these words beneficial to the people of the entire universe.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तवातिसर्गाद् देवेश प्राजापत्यमिदं पदम्। मयाधितिष्ठता दत्तो दानवेभ्यो महान् वरः॥
en: O lord of all, through your grace I have been established in this high situation, namely the creatorship of all creatures. Holding this, a very great boon was given by me to the Danavas.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तानतिक्रान्तमर्यादान् नान्यः संहर्तुमर्हति। त्वामृते भूतभव्येश त्वं ह्येषां प्रत्यरिर्वधे॥
en: O Lord of the past and the future, there exists no one, excepting yourself, who is fit to slaughter these who have gone beyond paying proper respects. Indeed, you are only person, who can slay these antagonists.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स त्वंदेव प्रपन्नानां याचतां च दिवौकसाम्। कुरु प्रसादं देवेश दानवाञ्जहि शङ्कर॥
en: O God, when you are such, do you, therefore, achieve good to the celestials who have fallen into imminent danger and who also solicit your grace. O lord of the celestials. O wielder of the trident, Slaughter these Danavas.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: त्वत्प्रसादाजगत् सर्वं सुखमैधत मानद। शरणयस्त्वं हि लोकेश ते वयं शरणं गताः॥
en: O you, who give honor to all, through your kindness let the entire universes attain bliss. Indeed you are worthy to be taken protection of. O lord of the universe, we all seek your protection.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स्थाणुरुवाच हन्तव्याः शत्रवः सर्वे युष्माकमिति मे मतिः। न त्वेक उत्सहेहन्तुं बलस्था हि सुरद्विषः॥
en: Sthanu said My opinion is that all your enemies should be slain. Being unassisted, I cannot dare slaughter them; for really the antagonists of the celestials are all very powerful.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ते यूयं संहताः सर्वे मदीयेनार्धतेजसा। जयध्वं युधि ताशत्रून् संहता हि महाबलाः॥
en: Having been united, together, all of you, therefore, destroy these enemies in the field of battle with one-self of the strength possessed by me. For union is, indeed, an immense strength.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: देवा ऊचुः अस्मेत्तेजोबलं यावत् तावद्विगुणमाहवे। तेषामिति हि मन्यामो दृष्टतेजोबला हि ते॥
en: The celestials said I have observed energy and prowess of them (the Danavas). From this I am of opinion that the amount of energy and strength possessed by them, is twice the energy and prowess possessed by us.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स्थाणुरुवाच वध्यास्ते सर्वतः पापाये युष्मास्वपराधिनः। मम तेजोबलार्धेन सर्वान् निघ्नत शात्रवान्॥
en: Sthanu said These sinful persons, who have insulted you, all should be slaughtered. Do you kill all these antagonists with one-half of my energy and prowess.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: देवा ऊचुः बिभर्तुं भवतोऽर्धं तु न शक्ष्यामो महेश्वर। सर्वेषां नो बलार्धेन त्वमेव जहि शात्रवान्॥
en: The celestials said O Maheshvara, we are not capable of bearing half of your energy. Do you slaughter the antagonists with one-half of the entire strength, possessed by all of us.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स्थाणुरुवाच यदि शक्तिर्न वः काचिद् बिभर्तु मामकं बलम्। अहमेतान् हनिष्यामि युष्मत्तेजोऽर्धबृंहितः॥
en: Sthanu said If you have not really got the power of bearing my whole force, then, I, endued with only one half of your united energy, slay them all.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततस्तेथेति देवेशस्तैरुक्तो राजसत्तम। अर्धमादाय सर्वेषां तेजसाभ्यधिकोऽभवत्॥
en: Thereupon, O foremost of monarchs, the chief of the celestials was thus addressed by the gods, saying-so be it; and he in this way became superior to all, after having added to his own one-half of the entire energy possessed by them (the celestials) all.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स तु देवो बलेनासीत् सर्वेभ्या बलवत्तरः। महादेव इति ख्यातस्ततः प्रभृति शङ्करः॥
en: That god had really become much more powerful than all others in strength. Thereupon Shankara came to be celebrated under the title of Mahadeva from that time forward.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततोऽब्रवीन्महादेवो धनुर्बाणधरो ह्यहम्। हनिष्यामिरथेनाजौ तान् रिपून् वो दिवौकसः॥
en: At this Mahadeva, who was armed with the bow and arrows, uttered these words; 'O celestials, mounted upon the car, I shall slaughter those enemies of yours in the field of battle.'

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ते यूयं मे रथं चैव धनुर्वाणं तथैव च। पश्यध्वं यावदद्यैतान् पातयामि महीतले॥
en: Do you all now behold my car, the bow and arrow, as also how I cast down today these antagonists upon the surface of the earth.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: देवा ऊचुः मूर्तीः सर्वाः समाधान त्रैलक्यस्य ततस्ततः। रथं ते कल्पयिष्यामो देवेश्वर सुवर्चसम्॥
en: The celestials said O Lord of the celestials, having taken up all forms of the three worlds, we will construct a car for you, that will be endued with immense energy.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तथैव बुद्ध्या विहितं विश्वकर्मकृतं शुभम्। ततो विबुधशार्दूलास्ते च तस्येषु समकल्पयन्॥
en: Thereupon the foremost of the celestials began to construct that car, which was conceived to be a very gigantic cue and also that was, with great intelligence designed by Vishvakarman himself (the celestial artificer).

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: विष्णुंन सोमं हुताशं च तस्येधुं समकल्पयन्। शृङ्गमग्निर्बभूवास्य भल्लः सोमो विशामप्ते॥ कुड्मलश्चाभवद् विष्णुस्तस्मिन्निषुवरे तदा।
en: Then they prepared arrows for him, that were identical with Vishnu, Soma and Hutasha. Agni became the staff of his arrow, and Soma became its head and ruler of earth, then again Vishnu constituted the point of that best of arrows.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: रथं वसुन्धरां देवीं विशालपुरमालिनीम्॥ सपर्वतवनद्वीपां चक्रुर्भूतधरां तदा।
en: Then they made his car to be the same as the goddess earth, that is adorned with garlands of magnificent towns and cities and that is furnished with the mountains, forests and islands and the contained creatures and also that is ornamented with innumerable ups and downs.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: मन्दरः पर्वतश्चाक्षो जङ्घा तस्य महानदी॥ दिशश्च प्रदिशश्चैव परिवारो रथस्य तु।
en: The Mandara mountain was made the axle of that car; and the great river (the Ganges) constituted its Jangha; and the different directions and the subsidiary points constituted its several ornaments.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ईषा नक्षत्रवंशश्च युगः कृतयुगोऽभवत्॥ कूबरश्च रथस्यासीद् वासुकिर्भुजगोत्तमः । अपस्करमधिष्ठाने हिमवान् विन्ध्यपर्वतः उदयास्तावधिष्ठाने गिरी चक्रुः सुरोत्तमाः॥
en: The constellations constituted its shafts; and the Kritayuga constituted its yoke; and Vasuki, (the foremost of all snakes, constituted the Kubara of the car). Then the best of the celestials made the Apaskora and Adhistana of that car to be the same as the Himavat and the Vindhya mountains, and also made the Udaya and Asta mountains to be the wheels of that car.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: समुद्रमक्षमसृजन् दानवालयमुत्तमम्। सप्तर्षिमण्डलं चैवरथस्यासीत् परिष्करः॥
en: The ocean, that was excellent abode of the Danavas, was made to be the other axle of the car; as also the body of the seven Rishis became the protectors of the wheels of that car.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: गङ्गा सरस्वती सिन्धुधुरमाकाशमेव च। उपस्करो रथस्यासन्नाप: सर्वाश्च निम्नगाः॥
en: The Ganga, the Sarasvati and the Sindhu, as well as the firmanent constituted the Dhara of that car; and the water (on the surface of the earth), as also all the other rivers became the Uparkaga of the car (the chains binding its several limbs).

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: अहोरात्रं कलाश्चैव काष्ठाश्च ऋतवस्तथा। अनुकर्षं ग्रहा दीप्ता वरुथं चापि तारकाः॥
en: The whole day and night and several other divisions of the time, namely the Kalas and Kushtas, as also the different seasons of the year constituted the Anakarsha of that car, and again the most resplendent planets and stars constituted its Varutha (the wooden fences).

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: धर्मार्थकामं संयुक्तं त्रिवेणु दारु बन्धुरम्। ओषधीर्वीरुधश्चैव घण्टाः पुष्पफलोपगाः॥
en: Virtue, profit and desire, united together constituted its Trivena. And there the herbs, containing innumerable flowers and fruits, formed its rows of bells.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ कृत्वा चक्रे रथवरोत्तमे। पक्षौ पूर्वापरौ तत्र कृते रात्र्यहनी शुभे॥
en: The Sun and the Moon, having been made equal, were constituted to be the two other wheels of that foremost and most excellent car. The day and the night were made to be the two auspicious wings on the right and left in that car.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: दश नागपतीनीषां धृतराष्ट्रमुखांस्तदा। योक्त्राणि चक्रुर्नागांश्च निश्वसन्तो महोरगान्॥
en: The ten princes of snakes, headed by one, named Dhritarashtra, that were were all very powerful constituted the shafts of that car.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: द्यां युगं युगचर्माणि संवर्तकबलाहकान्। कालपृष्टोऽथ नहुषः कर्कोटकधनंजयौ॥ इतरे चाभवन् नागा हयानां बालबन्धनाः। दिशश्च प्रदिशश्चैव रश्मयो रथवाजिनाम्॥
en: The sky was made to be its yoke; and the clouds, known by the names of Samvartakas and Balahakas, were made its leathern strings. Then also Kalaprishta, Nahusha, Karkotaka and Dhananjaya, as also several other snakes became the chords for binding the manes of those horses. The cardinal points and the subsidiary directions constituted the reins of those horses yoked to that car.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: संध्यां धृतिं च मेधां च स्थिति संनतिमेव च। ग्रहनक्षत्रताराभिश्चर्म चित्रं नभस्तलम्॥
en: The Dhriti the Medha, the Sthiti and the Sannati and the firinament, covered over with the planets, constellations and stars, were made its variegated leathern covers.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: सुराम्बुप्रेतवित्तानां पतील्लोकेश्वरान् हयान्। सिनीवालीमनुमतिं कुहूं राकां च सुव्रताम्॥ योकत्राणिं चक्रुर्वाहानां रोहकांस्तत्र कण्टकान्।
en: The gods made horses for driving that chariot, the four lokapalas i.e. Indra, Varuna, Yama and Kubera. The adored goddesses of Sinivali, Anumati, Kuhu and Raka, all great resolutes were made the yoke for that chariot and the gods governing these goddesses were made the thorns of the bridle to direct those horses.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: धर्मः सत्यं तपोऽर्थश्च विहितास्तत्र रश्मयः॥ अधिष्ठानं मनश्चासीत् परिरथ्या: सरस्वती। नानावर्णाश्च चित्राश्च पताकाः पवनेरिताः॥ विद्युदिन्द्रधनुर्नद्धं रथं दीप्तं व्यदीपयन्।
en: The chords of that car were constituted by Action, Truth, Devotion and Profit. The mind was the situation upon which the car rested; and speech formed its tacks. The beautiful flags of diverse colours undulated in the air and both the lightening and the Indra's bow (the Rainbow) enlightened that resplendent car.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: वषट्कार :प्रतोदोऽभूद्गायत्री शीर्षबन्धना॥
en: The Vashatkara (the chief Vedic sound) formed the goad; and Gayatri formed the chord attacked to the goad.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: यो यज्ञे विहितः पूर्वमीशानस्य महात्मनः। संवत्सरो धनुस्तद् वै सावित्री ज्या महास्वना॥
en: That entire year, which was formerly fixed in the sacrifice of that high-minded Ishana, now constituted the bow of the car; whereas Savitri formed the high sounding bow-string.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: दिव्यं च वर्म विहितं महार्ह रत्नभूषितम्। अभेद्यं विरजस्कं वै कालचक्रबहिष्कृतम्॥
en: A celestial coat of mail was constructed, that was adorned with the most valuable gems and that was impenetrable and that was most resplendent and also that had arisen from the wheel of time.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ध्वजयष्टिरभून्मेरुः श्रीमान् कनकपर्वतः। पताकाश्चाभवन् मेघास्तडिद्भिः समलकृताः॥ रेजुरध्वर्युमध्यस्था ज्वलन्त इव पार्वकाः।
en: That handsome mountain of gold, called the Meru, formed the flag staff; and the chords, that were ornamented with the lightning, became the banners of that car. That car, being thus furnished with all its equipments, looked most resplendent like the blazing fire in the midst of the priests attending a sacrifice.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: क्लृप्तं तु तं रथं दृष्ट्वा विस्मिता देवताऽभवन्॥ सर्वलोकस्य तेजसिं दृष्ट्वैकस्थानि मारिष। युक्तं निवेदयामासुर्देवास्तस्मै महात्मने।॥
en: The celestials also, after having looked at that excellently equipt car, became greatly astonished. O sire, the celestials, after having seen that the energies of the entire universe were united together in one place, informed that high-souled one (Brahman) that the car was ready.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: एवं तस्मिन् महाराज कल्पिते रथसत्तमे। देवैर्मनुजशार्दूल द्विषतामभिमर्दने॥ स्वान्यायुधानि मुख्यानि न्यदधाच्छङ्करो रथे। ध्वजयष्टिं वियत् कृत्वा स्थापयामास गोवृषम्॥
en: O great monarch, O foremost of persons, when that best of cars was thus prepared by all the celestials with a view to crush down their antagonists (the Danavas). Shankara then placed his celestial weapons upon the car; and also having made the entire firmament to be his flag-staff, he placed his bull (the symbol of the Deity) upon it.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ब्रह्मदण्डः कालदण्डो रूद्रदण्डस्तथा ज्वरः। परिस्कन्दा रथस्यासन् सर्वतोदिशमुद्यताः॥
en: Then the rod of Brahman, the rod of Death and the rod of Rudra, as also Fever formed the guards on the sides of that car, that were pointed towards all directions of the horizon.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: अथर्वाङ्गिरसावास्तां चक्ररक्षौ महात्मनः। ऋग्वेदः सामवेदश्च पुराणं च पुरःसराः॥
en: The protectors of the car-wheels of that high-souled personage were the Athurvan and Angiras; and Rigveda, Samaveda and Purana stood at the front of that car.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: इतिहासयजुर्वेदो पृष्ठरक्षौ बभूवतुः। दिव्या वाचश्च विद्याश्च परिपार्श्वचराः स्थिताः॥
en: All histories and the Yajurveda became the guards of the back of the car; and all divine speeches and the and the different branches of knowledge placed themselves on all sides of the car.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स्तोत्रादयश्च राजेन्द्र वषट् कारस्तथैव त। ओंकारच मुखे राजन्नतिशोभकरोऽभवत्॥
en: O king, the hymns and others, as also the principal Vedic sounds, namely, Vashatkara, stood round the car. And O monarch, the syllable Om, having placed at the front of it, became greatly hand-some.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: विचित्रमृतुभिः षड्भिः कृत्वा संवत्सरं धनुः। छायामेवामनश्चक्रे धनुर्ध्यामक्षयां रणे॥
en: Then having made the year, looking exceedingly beautiful with the six seasons, to be his bow, he prepared the string with his own shadow, that was indestructible in the field of battle.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: कालो हि भगवान् रुद्रस्तस्य संवत्सरो धनुः। तस्माद् रौद्री कालरात्रिा कृताः धनुषोऽजरा॥
en: Indeed, that illustrious Rudra is the same as Death himself. The year was his bow; and accordingly the death-night, which was but the shade of Rudra himself, was constituted to be the indestructible string at that bow.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: इषुश्चाप्यभवद् विष्णुर्व्वलनः सोम एव च। अग्नीषोमौ जगत् कृत्स्नं वैष्णवं चोच्यते जगत्॥
en: Vishnu, Agni (the god of fire) and Soma formed the shaft of that bow. The entire was universe of nothing but Agni and Soma. The universe is also to consist of Vishnu.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: विष्णुश्चात्मा भगवतो भवस्यामिततेजसः। तस्माद् धनुासंस्पर्श न विषेहुर्हरस्य ते॥
en: The soul of that illustrious and highly energetic Bhava is identical with Vishnu. They (the Asuras), therefore, could not bear the tough of the bow-string of Hara (Bhava).

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तस्मिशरे तिग्ममन्यु मुमोचासह्यमीश्वरः। भृग्वङ्गिोमन्युभवं क्रोधाग्निमतिदुःसहम्॥
en: Then the fiercely wrathful Lord cast his fire of anger upon that arrow, which anger was most irresistible and also which had sprung from the very wrath of both Bhrigu and Angiras and which, which, again, most intolerable.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स नीललोहितो धूम्रः कृत्तिवासाभयंकरः। आदित्ययुतसंकाशस्तेजोज्वालावृतो ज्वलन्॥
en: That dreadful God, dressed in skins, who was blue, red and of smoke color and who also resembled ten thousand suns in splendour and who again was shrouded over with the flames of energy and blazed forth most brightly.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: दुश्चयावच्यावनो जेता हन्ता ब्रह्मद्विषां हरः। नित्यं त्राता च हन्ता त धर्माधर्माश्रितान् नरान्॥
en: Then that subduer of those, who can with difficulty be subdued, that victor that slayer of the antagonists of Brahman, that universal protector, that slayer of persons, with whom rest both righteousness and unrighteousness that One named Hara.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: प्रामाथिभिर्भीमबलैर्भीमरूपैर्मनोजवैः। विभाति भगवान् स्थाणुस्तैरेवत्मगुणैर्वृतः॥
en: Then having been surrounded by innumerable beings, who were all very powerful to crush the enemies and who were possessed of fierce prowess and dreadful appearances and who, again, were fleet as the mind and who, at last, were endued with the different (fourteen) physical faculties, illustrious Sthanu blazed forth with great splendour.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तस्याङ्गानि समाश्रित्यं विश्वमिदं जगत्। जङ्गमाजङ्गमं राजशुशुभेऽद्भुतदर्शनम्॥
en: Then having taken refuge under the different phases of his body, this entire universe, both mobile and immobile, standing beside him, blazed forth and presented a very extraordinary appearance, O monarch,

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: दृष्ट्वा तु तं रथं युक्तं कवची स शरासनी। बाणमादाय तं दिव्यं सोमविष्णवग्निसम्भवम्॥
en: Seeing that car furnished with all its equipment's, he, coated himself with the armour and armed with the bow, took up that celestial arrow sprung from the deities, Soma, Vishnu and Agni.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तस्य राजस्तदा देवाः कल्पयाञ्चक्रिरे प्रभो। पुण्यगन्धवहं राजश्वसनं देवसत्तमम्॥
en: Thereupon, O monarch, O king, all the celestials ordered Wind, that foremost of the gods, to carry to that highly powerful Deity his pure and fragrant breeze,

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तमास्थाय महादेवस्त्रासयन् दैवतान्यपि। आरुरोह तदा यत्तः कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्॥
en: Then having taken hold of the car, Mahadeva mounted upon it, thus terrifying even the very celestials, and therefrom he caused the whole earth to tremble with dread.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तमारुरुधू देवेशं तुष्टुवः परमर्षयः। गन्धर्वा दैवसङ्घाश्च तथैवाप्सरसां गणाः॥
en: The great Rishis, the Gandharvas, the whole body of the celestials, as well as the different tribes of the Apsaras praised that Lord of the gods, when he was desirous to ascend the car.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ब्रह्मर्षिभिः स्तूयमानो वन्द्यमानश्च वन्दिभिः। तथैवाप्सरसां वृन्दैर्नृत्यद्भिर्नृत्यकोविदैः॥
en: Then the Lord was highly praised by the Brahmanical sages; and he was worshipped by the eulogists; as also he was pleased with the dance of numerous Apsaras, who were all very well-acquainted with the art of dancing.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स शोभमानो वरदः खड्गी बाणी शरासनी। हसन्निवाब्रवीद् देवान् सारथिः को भविष्यति॥
en: Thereupon that beautiful boon-giver, who was excellently armed with the sword, arrow and bow, smilingly addressed the celestials saying-"Who will become my charioteer"'?

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तमब्रुवन् देवगणां यं भवान् संनियोक्ष्यते। स भविष्यति देवेशं सारथिस्ते न संशयः॥
en: The celestials replied him, saying-"O Lord of the gods, he will be your charioteer, whomever you will be pleased to appoint. There is no doubt about it."

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तानब्रवीत् पुनर्देवो मत्तः श्रेष्ठतरो हि यः। तं सारथिं कुरुवं मे स्वयं संचिन्त्य मा चिरम्॥
en: Then the God, again, replied them (the celestials), saying, “Having meditated upon the matter yourselves, without the least hesitation, do you appoint him as my charioteer, who will prove himself superior to myself.”

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: एतच्छ्रुत्वा ततो देवा वाक्यमुक्तं महात्मना। गत्वा पितामाहं देवाः प्रसाद्येदं वचोऽब्रुवन्॥
en: Thereupon the celestials, after having listened to these speeches uttered by that highsouled god and also having repaired to the grandsire propitiated him and said to him these words.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: यथा त्वत्कथितं देव त्रिदशारिविनिग्रह। तथा च कृतमस्माभिः प्रसन्नो नो वृषध्वजः॥
en: O God, what instruction, imparted by you as regards the destruction of the antagonists of the celestials, was thoroughly acted up to by all of us. That Deity having the bovine hull for his symbol, was gratified with us.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: रथश्च विहितोऽस्माभिर्विचित्रायुधसंवृतः। सारथिं च न जानीमः कः स्यात् तस्मिन् रथोत्तमे।।६६
en: Also a car had been constructed by us, that was furnished with the most beautiful and diverse kinds of weapons. But we do not know who will make the best charioteer in this foremost of cars.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तस्माद् विधीयतां कश्चित् सारथिदेवसत्तम। सफलां तान गिरं देवकर्तुमर्हसि नो विभो॥
en: In consequence thereof, do you appoint some such best of the celestials as the charioteer. O illustrious one, it is necessary for you to make good of that word said to us.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: एवमस्मासु हि पुरा भगवन्नुक्तवानसि। हितकार्तस्मि भवतामिति तत् कर्तृमर्हसि॥
en: O illustrious one, you have said to us before to this effect that you would do us some good. Now it is necessary for you to fulfill that promise.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स देव युक्तो रथसत्तमो नो दुराधरो द्रावणः शात्रवाणाम्। पिनाकपाणिर्विहितोऽत्र योद्धा विभीषयन् दानवानुद्यतोऽसौ॥
en: That most invincible and foremost of cars was constructed by us with the best parts of all the celestials in such a way that it was capable of routing our enemies; and that Deity, having Pinaka in his hand, was made the warrior to fight upon it. This One, having terrified the Danavas, is now ready for battle.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तथैव वेदाश्चतुरो हयाग्र्या धरा सशैला च रथो महात्मनः। नक्षत्रवंशानुगतो वरूथी हरो योद्धा सारथि भिलक्ष्यः॥
en: So also, the four Vedas have become the four horses, the best of their species, of that high-souled Deity; and the Earih, among with the numerous mountains, had become his car. The equipments of that car were the constellations. The warrior (who will fight from that car) is Hara. But who will be the charioteer, is still unfound.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तत्र सारथिरेष्टव्यः सवैरेतैर्विशेषवान्। तत्प्रतिष्ठो रथो देव हया योद्धा तथैव च॥
en: For that car's charioteer is to be sought, who will prove himself a specialist amongst all these (celestials). O Lord, this car is constructed to such an importance, as also Hara is the warrior who will fight from it.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: कवचानि सशस्त्राणि कार्मुकं च पितामह। त्वामृतेसारथिं तत्र नान्यं पश्यामहे वयम्॥ त्वं हि सर्वगुणैर्युक्तो दैवतेभ्योऽधिकः प्रभो।
en: O Grandsire, armours, along with the weapons and the bow, have already been obtained. Save yourself, there exists no other charioteer, whom we can find out. O illustrious one, you are, indeed, attended with all accomplishments; and you are superior to all the celestials.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स रथं तूर्णमारुध संयच्छ परमान् हयान्॥ जयाय त्रिदेवशानां वधाय त्रिदशद्विषाम्।
en: Having immediately mounted upon that car, do you guide the horses of the best species with the object of bringing about the victory of the celestials and the destruction of their antagonists.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: इति ते शिरसा गत्वा त्रिलोकेशं पितामहम्॥ देवाः प्रसादयामासुःसारथ्यायेति नः श्रुतम्।
en: It has been heard by us that after bowing down with their heads to the Grandsire, who is the lord of the three worlds, all the celestials began to appease him in order to appoint him as the charioteer (of that car).

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: पितामह उवाच नात्रं किंचिन्मृषा वाक्यं यदुक्तं त्रिदिवौकसः॥ संयच्छामि हयानेषयुध्यतो वै कपर्दिनः।
en: The grandsire said O dwellers of heaven, there is nothing like untruth in this speech uttered by you. While, indeed, Kapardin will engage in battle, I will surely hold the reins of his horses.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततः स भगवान् देवो लोकस्रष्टा पितामहः॥ सारथ्ये कल्पितो देवैरीशानस्य महात्मनः।
en: Thereupon that illustrious person-age, that God, the creator of all creatures, the Grandsire was appointed to the charioteership of highsouled Ishana by the celestials.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तस्मिन्नोरोहति क्षिप्रं स्यन्दने लोकपूजिते॥ शिरोभिरागमन् भूमि ते हया वातरंहसः।
en: Thus while he was immediately ascending that car, which was revered by all persons, those horses, that were as fleet as the wind, bowed down upon the ground with their heads.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: आरुह्य भगवान देवो दीप्यमानः स्वतेजसा।।७८ अभीषून हि प्रतोदं च संजग्राह पितामहः।
en: Having mounted upon that car, the illustrious Grandsire, that God who blazed forth with the splendour of his own, then indeed took up the reins of the horses, as well as the goad.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तत उत्थाप्य भगवास्तान् हयाननिलोपमान्॥ बभाषे च तदा स्थाणुमारोहेति सुरोत्तमः।
en: Thereupon that illustrious God, after having hitted those horses, that resembled the wind in swiftness, they addressed the foremost of the celestials Sthanu saying “Do you ascend.”

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततस्तमिषुमादाय विष्णुमोमग्निसम्भवम्॥ आरुरोह तदा स्थाणुर्धनुषा कम्पयन् परान्।
en: After this, Sthanu, after having taken up that shaft, which was born of Vishnu, Soma and Agni and then also having caused by his bow the numerous enemies to tremble, mounted upon

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तमारूढं तु देवेशं तुष्टुवुः परमर्षयः॥ गन्धर्वा देवसंघाश्च तथैवाप्सरसां गणाः।
en: The great Rishis, that Gandharvas, the whole of the celestials, as also large numbers of the Apsaras, uttered prayers to that Lord of the gods, who had already mounted upon that that car. car.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स शोभमानो वरदः खगी बाणी शरासनी॥ प्रदीपयन् रथे तस्थौ त्रील्लोकान् स्वेन तेजसा।
en: That handsome personage, that giver of boons, that holder of the sword, arrow and bow rested upon that car and looked most resplendent with his own energy shedding lustre upon the three worlds.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततो भूयोऽब्रवीद् देवो देवानिन्द्रपुरोगमान्॥ न हन्यादिति कर्तव्यो न शोको वः कथञ्चन। हतानित्येव जानीत बाणेनानेन तासुरान्॥
en: Thereupon the God once more addressed all the celestials, headed by Indra himself, saying-"Grief should never be felt by you considering that I shall not slaughter the Asuras. Now do you understand that the Asuras have already been slaughtered by this arrow."

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ते देवाः सत्यमित्याहुर्निहता इति चाब्रुवन्। न च तद वचनं मिथ्या यदाऽह भगवान् प्रभुः॥ इति संचिन्त्य वै देवाः परां तुष्टिमवाप्नुवन्।
en: Thereupon those gods considered it to be true; and uttered those words-"That they (Asuras) have been all slaughtered.” Then, indeed, those celestials, considering that the speech what the illustrious Lord had uttered could not be untrue, attained to the highest gratification.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततः प्रयातो देवेशः सर्वैर्देवगणैर्वृतः॥८६॥ रथेन महता राजन्नुपमा नास्ति यस्य ह।
en: Thereupon, O monarch, that lord of the celestials, riding upon that mighty car, which had no equal, proceeded on, having been encompassed by the whole lot of, the celestials.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स्वैश्च पारिषदैर्देवः पूज्यमानो महायशाः॥ नृत्यद्भिरपरैश्चेवः मांसभक्षैर्दुरासदैः। धावमानैः समन्ताच तर्जमानैः परस्परम्॥
en: Then that highly famous God was worshipped by all his companions, as well as by others, who were dancing in his front and who lived on meat and who were invincible in battle and who also were running on all sides of that God and who again shouted with joy at one another.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ऋषयश्च महाभागास्तपोयुक्ता महागुणाः। आशंसुवै जना देवा महादेवस्य सर्वशः॥
en: Thus the great Rishis, who were highly fortunate and who were endued with ascetic merit and best qualities, as well as all the celestials, blessed in every way Mahadeva with Success.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: एवं प्रयाते देवेश लोकानामभयंकरे। तुष्टमासीजगत् सर्वे देवताश्च नरोत्तम॥
en: O foremost of persons, when that boongiving Lord, who destroys the terrors of all creatures of the entire universe, was thus proceeding onwards; the whole universe, as also all the celestials became highly satisfied.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ऋषयस्तत्र देवेशं स्तुवन्तो बहुभिः स्तवैः। तेजश्चास्मै वर्धयन्तो राजन्नासन् पुनः पुनः॥
en: There the great Rishi began to praise that Lord of the celestials with numerous kinds of hymns; as also they were repeatedly increasing His energy and stood up there, O monarch.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: गन्धर्वाणां सहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। वादयन्ति प्रयाणेऽस्य वाद्यानि विविधानि च॥
en: While the Lord was proceeding; millions and millions of the Gandharvas began to play innumerable kinds of musical instruments.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततोऽधिरूढे वरदे प्रयाते चासुरान् प्रति। साधु साध्विति विश्वेशः स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Thereupon when the boon-giving Lord, after mounting upon the car, was advancing towards the Asuras, the Lord of the universe smilingly addressed him saying-"Most excellent! Most excellent!"

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: याहि देव यतो दैत्याश्चोदयाश्वानतन्द्रितः। पश्य बाह्वोर्बलं मेऽद्य निघ्नतः शात्रवान् रणे॥
en: O Lord, do you advance to the spot where the Daityas are waiting. Being highly enlivened, do you urge the heroes. Do you observe the strength of my arms today, while slaughter the antagonists in the field of battle.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततोऽश्वांश्चोदयामास मनोमारुतरंहसः। येन तत् त्रिपुरं राजन् दैत्यदानवरक्षितम्॥
en: Thereupon, O monarch, the Lord urged those horses, that were possessed of the fleetness of wind or mind, towards that triple city, which was excellently protected by both the Daityas and the Danavas.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: पिबद्भिरिव चाकाशं तैर्हयैर्लोकपूजितैः। जगाम् भगवान् क्षिप्रं जयाय त्रिदिवौकसाम्॥
en: Accompanied by those horses, that were highly revered by all the three worlds and also that seemed to drink the skies by their speed, the Lord, endued with great lustre, started immediately with a view to secure victory for the denizens of heaven.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: प्रयाते रथमास्थाय त्रिपुराभिमुखे भवे। ननाद सुमहानादं वृषभः पूरयन् दिशः॥
en: When Bhaga, riding upon that car, proceeded towards that triple city, his bull (symbol of Bhava) uttered a very excellent and loud roar, filling thereby the different directions with the noise.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: वृषभस्यास्य निनदं श्रुत्वा भयकरं महत्। विनाशमगर्मस्तत्र तारकाः सुरशत्रवः॥
en: Having heard that dreadful and loud roar of his (Lord's) bull, there the descendants of Taraka, who were all the enemies of the celestials, attained to their destruction (died).

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: अपरेऽवस्थितास्तत्र युद्धायाभिमुखास्तदा। ततः स्थाणुर्महाराज शूलधृक् क्रोधमूर्छितः॥
en: Then others also took their stations there in his front with the object of battle. Upon this Sthanu, O mighty monarch, that wielder of the trident, became senseless with rage.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: वस्तानि सर्वभूतानि त्रैलोक्यं भूः प्रकम्पते। निमित्तानि च घोराणि तत्र संदधत: शरम्॥
en: All the creatures were filled with terror; and the three worlds began to tremble. And while he was aiming that shaft, numerous dreadful omens appeared there.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तस्मिन् सोमाग्निविष्णूनां क्षोभेण ब्रह्मरुद्रयोः। स रथो धनुषः क्षोभादतीव ह्यवसीदति॥
en: On account of the pressure of Soma Agni and Vishnu in that shaft and that caused by both Brahman and Rudra, as also of great weight of that formidable bow, that car began to sink.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततो नारायणस्तस्माच्छरभागाद् विनिःसृतः। वृषरूपं समास्थाय उनहार महारथम्॥
en: Thereupon Narayana came out of the pointed head of that arrow; and then having taken-up the form of a bull lifted up that huge car.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: सीदमाने रथे चैव नर्दमानेषु शत्रुषु। स सम्भ्रमात तु भगवान् नादं चक्रे महाबलः॥
en: While, indeed, that car was going down and the enemies were uttering loud roars, then the illustrious lord, who was possessed of immense prowess, made a very tremendous roar out of rage.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: वृषभस्य स्थितो मूर्ध्नि हयपृष्ठे त मानद। तदा स भगवान् रुद्रो निरैक्षद् दानवं पुरम्॥
en: O giver of honors, while that illustrious lord Rudra was thus standing at the head of his bull and ou the back of his horses, then he beheld the city belonging to the Danavas.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: वृषभस्यास्थितो रुद्रो हयस्य च नरोत्तम। स्तनांस्तदाऽशातयत खुरांश्चैव द्विधाकरोत्॥
en: O foremost of men, while Rudra was thus standing upon his bull and horses, then he severed the tenis of his horses, then he severed the tents of his horses and separated into two parts the hoofs of his bull.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततः प्रभूति भद्रं ते गवां द्वैधीकृताः खुराः। हयानां च स्तना राजंस्तदाप्रभृति नाभवन्॥ पीडितानां बलवता रुद्रेणाद्भुतकर्मणा।
en: May you be blessed; from that time forward the hoofs of all animals belonging to the bevine species came to be cloven (into two parts). O monarch, froin that time also the teats of horses, that were highly oppressed by that most powered Rudra. performing miraculous deeds, ceased to appear.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: अथाधित्यं धनुः कृत्वा शर्वः संधाय तं शरम्॥ युक्त्वा पाशुपतास्त्रेण त्रिपुरं समचिन्तयत्।
en: Then having filled his bow with the string and also having aimed that arrow and again having united his Pasupata weapon with that shaft, Hare reflected for a while that triple city.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तस्मिन् स्थिते महाराज रुद्रे विधृतकार्मुके॥ पुराणि तानि कालेन जग्मुरेवैकतां तदा।
en: O most powerful monarch, while Rudra was thus standing, grasping his bow, then by that time, those three cities became united together.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: एकीभावं गते चैव त्रिपुरत्वमुपागते॥ बभूव तुमुलो हर्षो देवतानां महात्मनाम्।
en: Thus then the three cities had come to be of similar character after having lost their individual features, there had taken place loud shouts of joy amongst the high-souled celestials.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततो देवगणाः सर्वे सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः॥ जयेति वाचो मुमुचुः संस्तुवन्तो महेश्वरम्।
en: Thereupon all the celestials, the Siddhas and the high-class Rishis uttered the word, success whilst thus praying Maheshvara.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततोऽग्रतः प्रादुरभूत् त्रिपुर निघ्नतोऽसुरान्॥ अनिर्देशयोग्रवपुषो देवस्यासह्यतेजसः।
en: Thereafter that triple city appeared just at the front of that slayer of the Asuras, that deity of dreadful and indescribable form, that god who was indescribable from, that god who was endued with energy that he bore with great difficulty.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स तद् विकृष्य भगवान् दिव्यं लोकेश्वरो धनुः॥ ११२ त्रैलोक्यसारं तमिषु मुमोच त्रिपुरं प्रति।
en: Then that illustrious lord of the three worlds, after having stretched that celestial bow, shot that arrow, which was made of the essence of the three worlds, at the triple city.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: उत्सृष्टे वै महाभाग तस्मिन्निषुवरे तदा॥ महानार्तस्वरो ह्यसीत् पुराणां पततां भुवि। तान् सोऽसुरगणान् दग्ध्वा प्राक्षिपत् पश्चिमार्णवे।। ११४
en: O highly fortunate one, when that best of arrows was shot at the triple city, there had arisen loud wails of grief's as those three cities were trembling down upon the earth. Then having burnt those Asuras, he cast them down in the western ocean.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: एवं तु त्रिपुरं दग्धं दानवाश्चाप्यशेषतः माहेश्वरेण क्रुद्धेन त्रैलोक्यस्य हितैषिणा॥
en: Thus three cities were burnt and the Danavas were all destroyed by wrathful Maheshvara, who had wrought it having the desire for benefiting the three worlds.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स चात्मक्रोधजोवह्निर्हाहेत्युक्त्वा निवारितः। मा कार्भस्म साल्लोकानितित्र्यक्षोऽब्रवीच तम्।।११६
en: That fire, springing from his own wrath, was sooni quenched by the god, saying stop, stop. Then three-eyed deity addressed the fire, saying-O, do you reduce to ashes three worlds.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: ततः प्रकृतिमापन्ना देवा लोकास्त्वथर्षयः। तुष्टुर्वाग्भिग्र्याभिः स्थाणुमप्रतिमौजसम्॥
en: Thereupon all the celestials, the entire universe and the great Rishis, who had now attained to their natural conditions, began to greatly Sthanu, who is endued with unequalled prowess, with the most excellent speeches.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तेऽनुज्ञाता भगवता जग्मुः सर्वे यथागतम्। कृतकामाः प्रयत्नेन प्रजापतिमुखाः सुरा॥
en: When their desires well all fulfilled by such great efforts; and the celestials, headed by the creature, having been permitted by that illustrious lord, went to their respective abodes, they came from.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: एवं स भगवान देवो लोकस्त्रष्टा महेश्वरः। देवासुरगणाध्यक्षो लोकानां विदधे शिवम्॥
en: Thus the illustrious god, that creator of the universe, that superior lord of the gods and the Assuras Maheshvara achieved good for all the worlds.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: यथैव भगवान ब्रह्मा लोकधाता पितामहः। सारथ्यमकरोत्तत्र रुद्रस्य परमोऽव्ययः॥ तथा भवानपि क्षिप्रं रुद्रस्येव पितामहः। संयच्छतु हयानस्य राधेयस्य महात्मन॥
en: Even as the illustrious Brahman, the creator of the universe, the Grandsire, that supreme being, that celestial one, acted as the charioteer of Rudra, So do you hold immediately the reins of the horses, belonging to that high-souled son of Radha, like the Grandsire holding the reins of horses belonging to Rudra.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: त्वं हि कृष्णाय कर्णाच विशिष्टो राजशार्दूल नास्ति तत्र विचारणा॥
en: Chiefly you are, indeed, superior to Krishna and to Karna, as well as to Phalguna, O foremost of monarch, there is no doubt about this.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: युद्धे ह्ययं रुद्रकल्पस्त्वं च ब्रह्मसमो नये। तस्माच्छक्तोभवाञ्जेतुं मच्छयूँ स्तानिवासुरान्॥
en: In the field of battle, this one does really resemble Rudra; and in policy you resemble Brahman. In consequence of this you two, united together, are capable of vanquishing our enemies, who are like those Assuras.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: फाल्गुनाश्च विशेषता यथा शल्याद्य कर्णोऽयं श्वेताश्वं कृष्णसारथिम्। प्रमथ्य हन्यात् कौन्तेयं तथा शीघ्रं विधीयताम्॥
en: O Shalya, even this should immediately be performed, by following which this Karna today, having crushed the son of Kunti, who possesses white horses and has Krishna for his charioteer, should slaughter him.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: त्वयि मद्रेश राज्याशा जीविताशा तथैव च। विजयश्च तथैवाद्य कर्णसाचिव्यकारितः॥
en: O king of Madra country! I am dependent with an ambition to yicld of the state and hope for survival. The victory in anvil as a result of your participation to war as charioteer to Karna also depends on your skilled execution.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: त्वयि कर्णश्च राज्यं च वयं चैव प्रतिष्ठिताः। विजयश्चैव संग्रामे संयच्छाद्य हयोत्तमान्॥
en: The fate of Karna, our kingdom and we ourselves, a well as our victory in the field, rest entirely upon you. Do you, therefore, hold the reins of the foremost of the horses belonging to this warrior.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: इमं चाप्यपरं भूय इतिहासं निबोध मे। पितुर्मम सकाशे यद् ब्राह्मणः प्राह धर्मवित्॥
en: Do you listen to another story, which I will once more relate to you. This (story) a virtuous regenerate person told in the presence of my father.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: श्रुत्वा चैतद् वचश्चित्रं हेतुकार्यार्थसंहितम्। कुरु शल्य विनिश्चित्य माभूदत्र विचारणा॥
en: O Shalya, having listened to that beautiful story, which is full of causes and consequences of actions and also having settled all, do this immediately. There should be made no doubt about this.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: भार्गवाणां कुले जातो जमदग्निर्महायशाः। तस्य रामेति विख्यातः पुत्रस्तेजोगुणान्वितः॥
en: There was one, named Jamadagni, born in the race of Bhrigu and practising severe asceticism. He had a son, celebrated by the name of Rama and who also was endued with energy and excellent qualities.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: स तीव्र तप आस्थाय प्रसादयितवान् भवम्। अस्त्रहेतोः प्रसन्नात्मा नियतः संयतेन्द्रियः॥
en: severe Having practised the most asceticism, that cheerful souled personage, who always observed strict vows and who also had his soul under control, began to gratify Bhava in order to obtain weapon.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: तस्य तुष्टो महादेवो भक्त्या च प्रशमेन च। हृद्गतं चास्य विज्ञाय दर्शयामास शङ्करः॥
en: Mahadeva became highly gratified with him for his devotional performances and coolness of mind and Shankara, becoming conscious of the object in his mind showed himself to him.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: महेश्वर उवाच राम तुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते विदितं मे तवेप्सितम्। कुरुष्व पूतमात्मानं सर्वमेतदवाप्स्यसि॥
en: Mahadeva said O Rama, are you happy? I am exceedingly satisfied with you; and what you desire is known to me. Do you make your soul sanctified. You will obtain all your desire.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: दास्यामि ते तदास्त्राणि यदा पूतो भविष्यसि। अपात्रमसमर्थं च दहन्त्यस्त्राणि भार्गव॥
en: I will give you all these weapons, when you will become pure. For, O son of Bhrigu, these weapons burn that person, who is incompetent and incapable.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: इत्युक्तो जामदग्न्यस्तु देवदेवेन शूलिना। प्रत्युवाच महात्मानं शिरसावनतः प्रभुम्॥
en: The son of Jamadagni, having been thus addressed by the lord of the celestials, that wielder of the trident; reaped to that lord, who was endued with a lofty soul, after bowing down his head to him.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: यदा जानाति देवेशः पात्रं मामस्त्रधारणे। तदा शुश्रूषवेऽस्त्राणि भवान् मे दातुमर्हति॥
en: When I worshipped you always, then you the lord of the celestials, know it very well that I am competent to wield those weapons. So it is necessary for you to give me these weapons.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: दुर्योधन उवाच ततः स तपसा चैव दमेन नियमेन च। पूजोपहारबलिभिर्होममन्त्रपुरस्कृतैः॥ आराधयितवान् शर्वं बहून् वर्षगणांस्तदा।
en: Duryodhana said Thereupon he, by means of severe penances, by subduing his souls and by the observance of vows, as also by means of performing worship, offerings and sacrifices, followed by the performance of Homa; attended with the utterance of the Mantras, began to worship Bhava through many long years.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: प्रसन्नश्च महादेवो भार्गवस्य महात्मनः॥ अब्रवीत् तस्य बहुशो गुणान् देव्याः समीपतः। भक्तिमानेष सततं मयि रामो दृढव्रतः॥
en: Then Mahadeva, who became highly gratified with that lofty minded descendant of Bhrigu's race, enumerated the innumerable virtues of him just in the presence of his divine wife. This Rama is always very devotional towards me and is of firm vows.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
sn: एवं तस्य गुणान् प्रीतो बहुशोऽकथयत् प्रभुः। देवतानां पितॄणां च समक्षमरिसूदन॥
en: The lord, therefore, being thus satisfied with him, enumerated his several virtues in the presence of all the celestials and the Pitris, O slayer of enemies.

description: The history of destruction of the triple city belonging to the Asuras
