en: At last that string of the bow of the son of Pandu being drawn with great might suddenly snapped with a great noise; in the meantime the son of Suta struck Partha with hundred small arrows adorned with feathers.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: निर्मुक्तसर्पप्रतिमैरभीक्ष्णं तैलप्रधौतैः खगपत्रवाजैः॥ मनन्तरं फाल्गुनमष्टभिश्च।
en: Then with sixty sharp arrows that were like snakes set at liberty from sloughs and were slippery as if they were dipped in oil, he pierced Vasudeva. Then again pierced Arjuna with eight arrows.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: पूषात्मजो मर्मसु निर्बिभेद मरुत्सुतं चायुतशः शराग्रयैः॥ कृष्णं च पार्थ च तथा ध्वजं च पार्थानुजान् सोमकान् पातयंश्च।
en: Karna, the son of sun god attacked fiercely on sensitive parts of Bhimasena's body by a volley of ten thousand arrows he shot an Bhimasena. He simultaneously, made an effort to kill Sri Krishna, Arjuna, his brothers and Somakas with cut-off the flag fixed on their chariot.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: प्राच्छादयंस्ते विशिखैः प्रुशक्तैर्जीमूतसंघा नभसीव सूर्यम्॥ आगच्छतस्तान् विशिखैरनेकैर्व्यष्टम्भयत् सूतपुत्रः कृतास्त्रः।
en: As in the sky the sun is covered by the clouds, so they, coming forward, shrouded Karna with their shafts but the son of Suta, 'well versed in the use of weapons, worsted the approaching warriors and covered them by his own shafts.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: तैरस्तमस्त्रं विनिहत्य सर्वं जघान तेषां रथवाजिनागान्॥ नभ्यर्दयन्मार्गणैः सूतपुत्रः।
en: O monarch! Suta's son thus killed all their horses, cars and elephants and distressed many of their best warriors by his own shafts.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: ते भिन्नदेहा व्यसवो निपेतुः कर्णेषुभिर्भूमितले स्वनन्तः॥ सिंहेन क्रुद्धेन यथा श्वयूथ्या महाबला भीमबलेन तद्वत्।
en: As a whole pack of powerful dogs is destroyed by an angry lion of great prowess so those warriors fell down dead on earth with loud noise, their bodies pierced by the arrows of the mighty Karna.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: पुनश्च पाञ्चालवरास्तथान्ये तदन्तरे कर्णधनंजयाभ्याम्॥ प्रस्कन्दन्तो बलिना साधुमुक्तैः कर्णेन बाणैर्निहताः प्रसा।
en: During this cessation of fight between Karna and Dhananjaya, many of the strong and great Panchala warriors became deprived of their lives by the well directed shafts of Karna; and others began to fly.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: स्तलान् निजघ्नुः सिंहनादांश्च नेदुः॥ सर्वे ह्यमन्यन्त वशे कृतौ तौ कर्णेन कृष्णाविति ते विम।
en: Then your troops, believing that Karna has brought Krishna and Arjuna under subjection, thought the great victory to theirs and loudly clapped their hands and gave vent to roars like that of a lion.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: ततो धनुामवनाम्य शीघ्रं शरानस्तानाधिरथेर्विधम्य॥ सुसंरब्धः कर्णशरक्षताङ्गो रणे पार्थः कौरवान् प्रत्यगृह्णात्। चक्रे॥
en: Then Partha, though badly mangled by many arrows, became filled with rage and bending his bowstring soO11 cut-off the shafts of the son of Adhiratha and again attached the Kauravas in the battle.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: ज्यां चानुमृज्याभ्यहनत् तलत्रे बाणान्धकारं सहसा च ८३॥ कर्ण च शल्यं च कुरूंश्च सर्वान् बाणैरविध्यत् प्रसभं किरीटी।
en: Then the diadem-adorned Arjuna, pressing his bowstring with the palm or his hand, covered the world with darkness by innumerable shafts and also struck Karna, Shalya and other Kaurava warriors with them.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: न पक्षिणो बभ्रमुरन्तरिक्षे तदा महास्त्रेण कृतेऽन्धकारे॥ रुवाह दिव्यः सुरभिस्तदानीम्।
en: By those arrows of great swiftness the sky became so dark that even the birds could not take their flights, and gentle and sweet-scented wind began to blow, as if sent by the Heavenly father.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: शल्यं च पार्थो दशभिः पृषत्कै भृशं तनुत्रे प्रहसन्नविध्यत्॥ ततः कर्णं द्वादशभिः सुमुक्तैर्विद्ध्वा पुनः सप्तभिरभ्यविद्ध्यत्।
en: Them, smiling, Partha shot with great force ten shafts against Shalya's armour and struck Karna first with twelve and then with another seven arrows.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: दृढाहत: पत्रिभिरुग्रवैगैः॥ विभिन्नगात्रः क्षतजोक्षिताङ्गः कर्णो बभौ रुद्र इवाततेषुः। प्रकीडमानोऽथ श्मशानमध्ये रौद्रे मुहूर्ते रुधिरागात्रः॥
en: Karna, being thus mangled by winged shafts of great impetuosity from Partha's bow, his limbs pierced and blood streaming down his body, resembled the bloody Rudra sporting son in the midst of a crematorium at the time of destruction.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: ततस्त्रिभिस्तं त्रिदशाधिपोपमं शरैर्बिभेदाधिरर्थिर्धनंजयम्। शरांश्च पञ्च ज्वलितानिवोरगान् प्रवेशयामास जिघांसयाच्युतम्॥
en: Then the of Adhiratha struck Dhananjaya, who was looking like the king of Heaven (Indra) with three arrows and shot five other burning shafts like snakes for the purpose of killing Krishna.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: ते वर्म भित्वा पुरुषोत्तमस्य सुवर्णचित्रा न्यपतन् सुमुक्ताः। वेगेन गामाविविशुः सुवेगाः स्नात्वा च कर्णाभिमुखाः प्रतीयुः॥
en: Those well-directed and mighty shafts, winged with gold, after piercing the armour of that noblest of human beings, entered the earth and having bathed (in the water of Bhogavati) again return towards Karna.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: स्त्रिधा त्रिधैकैकमथोचकर्त। धनंजयास्त्रैर्यपतन् पृथिव्यां महाहयस्तक्षकपुत्रपक्षाः॥
en: Dhananjaya then with ten well-aimed and flat edged shafts, cut each of them into three pieces and thus those five great snakes (friends of the Asvasena the son of Taksha) fell to the earth.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: ततः प्रजज्वाल किरीटमाली क्रोधेन कक्षं प्रदहन्निवाग्निः। थथा विनुन्नाङ्गमवेक्ष्य कृष्णं सर्वेषुभिः कर्णभुजप्रसृष्टैः॥
en: Then seeing the body of Krishna pained by those snakes in the forms of shafts from Karna's hands, Arjuna, who was adorned with crown and garland, burnt with anger like fire kindled with very grass.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: स कर्णमाकर्णविकृष्टसृष्टैः शरैः शरीरान्तकरैवलद्भिः। मर्मस्वरिध्यत् स चचाल दुःखाद् दैवादवातिष्ठत धैर्यबुद्धिः॥
en: He, then drawing the string to his ears, shot many burning and deadly arrows thereby striking Karna in all his vital points, but Karna of great patience, though, he felt very painful, kept his face summoning all his courage.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: ततः शरौघैः प्रदिशो दिशश्च रवेः प्रभा कर्णरथश्च राजन्। अदृश्यमासीत् कुपिते धनंजये तुषारनीहारवृत्तं यथा नभः॥
en: O monarch, Dhananjaya, becoming angry, by his arrows covered all the sides of Karna's car; even the rays of the sun became invisible and the sky looked hazy as in a frosty day.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: स चक्ररथानथ पादरक्षान् पुरःसरान् पृष्ठगोपांश्च सर्वान्। दुर्योधनेनानुमतानरिघ्नः समुद्यतान् स रथान् सारभूतान्॥ द्विसाहस्त्रान् समरे सव्यसाची कुरुप्रवीरानृषभः कुरूणाम्। क्षणेन सर्वान् सरथाश्वसूतान् निनाय राजन् क्षयमेकवीरः॥
en: O monarch, Savyasachin, the greatest of warriors and foremost of the Kuru race, in that fight soon destroyed two thousand great Kuru warriors who were protecting the wings and car wheels of Karna and formed his van and rear guards, with all elephants, cars and horses; they were the select portion of Duryodhana's car warriors and were fighting bravely under his orders.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: ततोऽपलायन्त विहाय कर्णं तवात्मजाः कुरवो येऽवशिष्टाः। हतानपाकीर्य शरतांश्च लालप्यमानांस्तनयान् पितॄश्च॥
en: Then the remnants of the Kaurava army with your sons fled on all directions leaving Karna and even the wounded father and son fled leaving each other in the field.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: स सर्वतः प्रेक्ष्य दिशो विशून्या भयावदीणैः कुरुभिर्विहीनः। न विव्यथे भारत तत्र कर्णः प्रहृष्ट एवार्जुनमभ्यधावत्॥
en: But the great warrior Karna, O King, seeing himself abandoned on all sides and left alone, was not at all afraid but pushed on against Arjuna with a brave heart and with energy.

description: The dual battle between Karna and Arjuna
sn: न विव्यथे भारत तत्र कर्णः प्रहृष्ट एवार्जुनमभ्यधावत्॥
en: But the great warrior Karna, O King, seeing himself abandoned on all sides and left alone, was not at all afraid but pushed on against Arjuna with a brave heart and with energy.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: संजय उवाच मवस्थिताः कुरवो भिन्नसेनाः। विद्युत्प्रकाशं दद्दशुः समन्ताद् धनंजयास्त्रं समुदीर्यमाणम्॥
en: Sanjaya said The broken Kaurava army, when melting away out of fear as wrathful Arjuna began his shots but halted and looked back from a distance at Arjuna's blazing weapon which resembled lightning and was coursing on all sides with increasing energy.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तदर्जुनास्त्रं असति स्म कर्णो वियद्गतं घोरतरैः शरैस्तत्। क्रुद्धेन पार्थेन भृशाभिसृष्टं वधाय कर्णस्य महाविम॥
en: Then Karna swallowed up (destroyed) that weapon when it was flying on the sky and which Arjuna had sped with great force for the purpose of putting an end to his enemy in that fearful contest with a downpour of his own fearful arrows.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: उदीर्यमाणं स्म कुरून् दहन्तं सुवर्णपुङ्खैर्विशिखैर्ममर्द। कर्णस्त्वमोघेष्वसनं दृढज्यं विस्फारयित्वा विसृजञ्छरौघान्॥
en: Drawing his loud-twanging bow the string of which was very strong, Karna, by gold winged arrows, destroyed Arjuna's weapon of increasing energy which was killing the Kurus and shot many other shafts.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: रामादुपात्तेन महामहिम्ना ह्याथर्वणेनारिविनाशनेन। तदर्जुनास्त्रं व्यधमद् दहन्तं कर्णस्तु बाणैर्निशितैर्महात्मा॥
en: He then, with that mighty weapon he had received from Rama, which was vested with the Atharvan rite, worsted that firy weapon of Arjuna and also struck Partha with many other sharp arrows.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततो विमर्दः सुमहान् बभूव तत्रार्जुनस्याधिरथेश्च राजन्। विषाणघातैर्द्विपयोरिवोग्रैः॥
en: O king, then the fight between Arjuna and the son of Adhiratha assumed attacking each other with their tusks, they went on hitting each other with shafts.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तत्रास्त्रसंघातसमावृतं तदा बभूव राजंस्तुमुलं स्म सर्वतः। निरन्तरं चक्रतुरम्बरं तदा॥
en: Then Partha and Karna shot such incessant showers of arrows that all the sides, became dark and even Sun could not be seen; the whole sky was spread over with them and there was no loop hole to be seen.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततो जालं बाणमयं महान्तं सर्वेऽद्राक्षुः कुरवः सोमकाचा नान्यं च भूतं दद्दशुस्तदा ते बाणान्धकारे तुमुलेऽथ किंचित्॥
en: The Kauravas and Somakas only, 'saw a broad net-work of arrows and nothing could be seen through the great darkness caused by them.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तौ संदधानावनिशं च राजन् समस्यन्तौ चापि शराननेकान्। संदर्शयेतां युधि मार्गान् विचित्रान् धनुर्धरौ तौ विविधैः कृतास्त्रैः॥
en: O monarch, those two best of men well versed in the use of weapons, when continually A aiming and shooting hosts of arrows showed may beautiful feats and stratagems.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तयोरेवं युद्ध्यतोराजिमध्ये सूतात्मजोऽभूदधिकः कदाचित्। पार्थः कदाचित् त्वधिकः किरीटी वीर्यस्त्रमायाबलपौरुषेण॥
en: In that fight between them sometimes the Suta's son excelled over his foe and sometimes the crown-adorned Partha excelled over his antagonist in mighty, weapons and lighthandedness.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: दृष्ट्वा तयोस्तं युधि सम्प्रहारं परस्परस्यान्तरमीक्षमाणयोः। र्योधाः सर्वे विस्मयमभ्यगच्छन्॥
en: The other warriors were struck with wonder in seeing that fearful combat between those great warriors who were always trying to take advantage of each other's failings (weak points).

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततो भूतान्यन्तरिक्षस्थितानि तौ कर्णपार्थौ प्रशशंसुर्नरेन्द्र। भोः कर्ण साध्वर्जुन साधु चेति वियत्सु वाणी श्रूयते सर्वतोऽपि॥
en: The creatures of heaven, O monarch, praised Karna and Arjuna and being satisfied called out loudly “Bravo Karna, Bravo Arjuna.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: स्तदाभिघातैर्दलिते हि भूतले। ततस्तु पातालतले शयानो नागोऽश्वसेनः कृतवैरोऽर्जुनेन॥ राजस्तदा खाण्डवदाहमुक्तो विवेश कोपाद् वसुधातले यः। अथोत्पपातोर्ध्वगतिर्जवेन संदृश्य कर्णार्जुनयोर्विमर्दम्॥
en: At that time when this awful fight was raging and the earth was oppressed by the heavy pressure of car-wheels and tread of elephants and horses, the snake Ashvasena, who was Arjuna's enemy, was residing in the subterranean region. O king, that brave snake, who escaped when the Khandava was burnt and who entered the subterranean region, now remembering the death of his mother and the hostile feelings he cherished towards Arjuna, came up with great force to the sky being pable of flying into the sky to see the fight between Karna and Arjuna.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: अयं हि कालोऽस्य दुरात्मनो वै पार्थस्य वैरप्रतियातनाय। संचिन्त्य तूणं प्रविवेश चैव कर्णस्य राजशररूपधारी॥
en: And believing, O monarch, this to be the just time for avenging himself upon the wicked (in his opinion) Partha he summed the shape of an arrows and entered quickly into Karna's quiver.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततोऽस्त्रसंघातसमाकुलं तदा बभूव जन्यं विततांशुजालम्। तत् निरन्तरं चक्रतुरम्बरं तदा॥
en: Karna and Partha now covered the whole sky with showers of arrows; not even a little space was left and it looked like a brilliant and thick net-work of shafts.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तद् बाणजालैकमयं महान्तं सर्वेऽत्रसन् कुरवः सोमकाश्च। नान्यत् किंचिद् दद्दशुः सम्पतद्वै बाणान्धकारे तुमुलेऽतिमात्रम्॥
en: All the Kauravas and Somakas were filled with fear seeing that great net-work of arrows; and nothing could be seen through the darkness made by the net, on account of the dropping of arrows.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततस्तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ सर्वलोकधनुर्धरौ। त्यक्तप्राणौ रणे वीरो युद्धश्रममुपागतौ। समुत्क्षेपैर्वीज्यमानौ सिक्तौ चन्दनवारिणा॥ सवालव्यजनैर्दिव्यैर्दिविस्थैरप्सरोगणैः। शक्रसूर्यकराब्जाभ्यां प्रमार्जितमुखाबुभौ॥
en: Beholding those two heroes the foremost of men and greatest of archers tired in war. The handsome Apsaras in Heaven fanned them with new and fine fans and sprinkled sweet scented sandal water upon them; the Shakra and Surya with their own hands cleansed the faces of those two brave warriors.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: कर्णोऽथ पार्थं न विशेषयद् यदा भृशं च पार्थेन शराभितप्तः। ततस्तु वीरः शरविक्षताङ्गो दधे मनो ह्येकशयस्य तस्य॥
en: Then when he found that he could not excel Partha in fight but was rather badly pained and wounded instead, Karna thought of the snakes weapon that was only left in his quiver.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततो रिपुजं समधत्त कर्णः सुसंचितं सर्पमुखं ज्वलन्तम्। रौद्रं शरं संनतमुग्रधौतं पार्थार्थमत्यर्थचिराभिगुप्तम्॥ सदार्चितं चन्दनचूर्णशायितं सुवर्णतूणीरशयं महार्चिषम्। आकर्णपूर्णं च विकृत्य कर्णः पार्थोन्मुखः संदधे चोत्तमौजाः॥
en: He put on string that fearful, burning, snake-mounted, sharp, well-polished and death-dealing weapon which he had long kept concealed for the purpose of killing Partha. Karna, drawing his bow-string to the full stretch, put on it and aimed at Partha that fiery and mighty shaft that was lying in a quiver of gold filled with sandal dust and which was always worshipped.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: प्रदीप्तमैरावतवंशसम्भवं शिरो जिहीर्युर्युधि सव्यसाचिनः। ततः प्रजज्वाल दिशो नभश्च उल्काच घोराः शतशः प्रपेतः॥
en: The arrows belonging to the Airavata race and the sky and all the ten sides became lighted; and fearful meteors and lightning strokes fell as he aimed that arrow for the purpose of striking Phalguna's head.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तस्मिस्तु नागे धनुषि प्रयुक्ते हाहाकृता लोकपालाः सशक्राः। न चापि तं बुबुधे सूतपुत्रो बाणे प्रविष्टं योगबलेन नागम्॥
en: The son of Suta was not aware that the snake (Ashvasena) had entered his arrow by means of Yoga, but as he aimed that arrow, Shakra and other regents of the sides gave vent to lamentations.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: दशशतनयनोऽहिं दृश्य बाणे प्रविष्टं निहत इति सुतो मे स्त्रस्तगात्रो बभूव। जलजकुसुमयोनिः श्रेष्ठभावो जितात्मा त्रिदशपतिमवोचमा व्यथिष्टा जये श्रीः॥
en: Indra The holder of one thousand eyes, lost courage and became anxious presuming the death of his son when he saw a snake gripped arrow forwarding to Arjuna. Brahma, the louts born, modest and celibate consoled Indra, the king of god with these words-"O god of gods! Don't be anxious in the matter as Arjuna will at last enjoy the fruit of victory.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततोऽब्रवीन्मद्रराजो महात्मा दृष्ट्वा कर्णं प्रहितेषु तमुग्रम्। न कर्ण ग्रीवामिषुरेष लप्सस्यते समीक्ष्य संधस्त शरं शिरोध्रम॥
en: The noble ruler of Madras, seeing Vaikatana aim that shaft, spoke to Karna and said-"O Karna, think well before you shoot this arrow; it will not reach Arjuna's neck."

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: अथाब्रवीत् क्रोधसंरक्तनेत्रो मद्राधिपं सूतपुत्रस्तरस्वी। न संधत्ते द्विः शरं शल्य को न मादृशा जिह्ययुद्धा भवन्ति॥
en: The energetic son of Suta, with wrathful look, told the king of Madra, "O Shalya, Karna never takes his aim twice; with warriors like us it must always be fair play in fight.”

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: इतीदमुक्तवा विससर्ज तं शरं प्रयत्नतो वर्षगणाभिपूजितम्। हतोऽसि वै फाल्गुन इत्यधिक्षिपत्रुवाच चोचैर्गिरमूर्जिता वृषः॥
en: O monarch, speaking the words, "You are killed, O Phalguna,” he, desirous of victory, with care let go that arrow which for many years he had cherished with regard.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: स सायकाः कर्णभुजप्रसृष्टो हुताशनार्कप्रतिमः सुरः। गुणच्युतः कर्णधनुः प्रमुक्तो वियद्गतः प्राज्वलदन्तरिक्षे॥
en: That fiery arrow, of awful sound and shinning like the sun, shot off from Karna's bow, lighted up and divided the sky as a woman divides her crown when combing her hairs.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तं प्रेक्ष्य दीप्तं युधि माधवस्तु त्वरान्वितं सत्वरयैव लीलया। पदा विनिष्पिष्य रथोत्तमं स प्रावेशयत् पृथिवीं किंचिदेव॥ क्षितिं गता जानुभिस्तेऽथ वाहा हेमच्छन्नाश्चन्द्रमरीचिवर्णाः। ततोऽन्तिरक्षे सुमहान् निनादः सम्पूजनार्थं मधुसूदनस्य॥ दिव्यानि पुष्पाण्यथ सिंहनादाः। तस्मिस्तथा वै धरणी निमग्ने रथे प्रयत्नान्मधुसूदनस्य॥
en: Madhava, the slayer of Kansa, seeing that fiery weapon rise in the sky, with his foot quickly pressed down that beautiful car one cubit deep in the earth. The horses, white as silvery moon beams, adorned with gold trappings, with bent knees fell flat to the ground. That mighty and best of men bringing his strength into action put down the car and the horses with bent knees stretched themsclves to the earth and the car sunk into it. The heavenly creatures greatly praised Vasudeva; they gave vent to lion-like shouts and dropped flowery showers upon Krishna when the slayer of Madhu thus pressed the car into the earth by his might.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततः शरः सोऽभ्यहनत् किरीटं तस्येन्द्रदत्तं सुदृढं च धीमतः। अथार्जुनस्योत्तमगात्रभूषण धरावियद्योसलिलेषु विक्षुतम्॥
en: By dint of that arrow, on account of its snaky nature and energy and wrath with which it was discharged the charioteer's son struck down from Arjuna's head the beautiful diadem know all over the earth, heaven and the watery region.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: व्यालास्त्रसर्गोत्तमयत्नमन्युभिः शरेण मूर्ध्न प्रजहार सूतजः। दिवाकरेन्दुज्वलनप्रभत्विषं सुवर्णमुक्तामणिवज्रभूषितम्॥
en: The powerful Brahma had made this headdress for the king of gods himself, with gold and pearls, endued with the effulgence by Indra himself to Parthas. It was given by Indra himself to Partha when the latter killed his enemies.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: पुरन्दरार्थं तपसा प्रयत्नतः स्वयं कृतं यद् विभुना स्वयम्भुवा। महार्हरूपं द्विषता भयंकर बिभर्तुरत्यर्थसुख सुगन्धिनम्॥ जिघांसते देवरिपून सुरेश्वरः स्वयं ददौ यत् सुमनाः किरीटिने। हराम्बुपाखण्डलवित्तगोप्तृभिः पिनाकपाशाशनिस्क्वोत्तमैः॥ सुरोत्तमैरप्यविषामर्दितुं प्रसह्य नागेन जहार तद् वृषः। स दुष्टभावो वितथप्रतिज्ञः किरीटमत्यद्भुतमर्जुनस्या॥ नागो महार्ह तपनीयचित्रं पार्थोत्तमाङ्गात् प्रहरत् तरस्वी।
en: It was so strong that even Rudra, the king of waters, Shakra and Kubera could not smash it by their respective weapons, Pinaka, noose, thunder or other mighty shafts; the very gods could not bear it but it was now taken away by that snaky weapon. That fearful false wicked, but energetic snake, of awful shape, attacked that beautiful crown adorned with stones and diamonds and took it away from Arjuna's head.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तद्धेमजालावततं सुघोषं जाज्वल्यमानं निपपात भूमौ॥ तदुत्तमेषून्मथितं विषग्निना प्रदीप्तमर्चिष्मदथो क्षितौप्रियम्। पपात पार्थस्य किरीटमुत्तम् दिवाकरोऽस्तादिव रक्तमण्डलः॥
en: As the sun, in setting, goes down from the Asta Hills with all the lustre so that handsome, brilliant, adorned diadem of Partha came down to the earth smashed to pieces and burning with that snake's poison.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: स वै किरीटं बहुरत्नभूषितं जहार नागोऽर्जुन मूर्धतो बलात्। गिरेः सुजाताङ्करपुष्तिदुमं महेन्द्रवज्रः शिखरोत्तमं यथा॥
en: O monarch, the snake, by its own prowess, snatched from Partha's head that beautiful ornament of good shape set with precious stones and diamonds, very brilliant to look at and crushed it to pieces as the thunder breaks down mountain tops adorned with fine trees and flowers.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: महीवियद्योसलिलानि वायुना यथा विरुग्णानि नदन्ति भारत। तथैव शब्दं भुवनेषु तं तदा जना व्यवस्यन व्यथिताश्च चस्खलुः॥
en: O Bharata, as during a storm a great noise is heard through out the earth, sky, heaven and the waters, so was the sound heard throughout the world at that time and all the people, though they tried to remain steady, became greatly afraid and stumbled.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: विना किरीटं शुशुभे स पार्थः श्यामो युवा नील इवोचश्रृङ्गः। ततः समुदाय सितेन वाससा स्वमूर्धजानव्यथितस्तदार्जुनः। विभासितः सूर्यमरीचिना दृढं शिरोगतेनोदयपर्वतो यथा॥
en: The dark young man, Dhananjaya, bereft of his crown, looked beautiful like a mountain without top and being not at all afraid stood his ground after binding his hairs with a white cloth.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: गोकर्णासुमुखी कृतेन इषुणा गोपुत्रसम्प्रेषिता गोशाब्दात्मजभूषणं सुविहितं सुव्यक्तगोऽसुप्रभम्। दृष्ट्वा गोगतकं जहार मुकुटं गोशब्दगोपूरि वै गोकर्णासनमर्दनश्च न ययावप्राप्य मृत्योर्वशम्॥
en: Arjuna, dark complexioned and in his youth looked as Nilagiri with high ridges when his crown dropped down in course of battle. He did not feel even a little pain. He tied his hair with a white cloth and continued fighting. As he had tied his hair with white piece of cloth, he looked as if Udayacala is glowing with sun beams.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: स सायकः कर्णभुजप्रसृष्टो हुताशनार्कप्रतिमो महार्हः। महोरगः कृतवैरोऽर्जुनेन किरीटमाहत्य ततो व्यतीयात्॥
en: Crushing down his crown that precious arrows, effulgent like the sun or fire, shot by Karna, the great serpent, who was rendered by Arjuna his enemy, went away.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तं चापि दग्ध्वा तपनीयचित्रं किरीटमाकृत्य तदर्जुनस्या इयेष गन्तु पुनरेव तूणं दृष्टश्च कर्णेन ततोऽब्रवीत तम्॥
en: Having burnt the effulgent and variegated crown shinning on Arjuna's (head) the arrow wanted to enter again into its quiver; but accosted by Karna it said-

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: मुक्तस्त्वयाहं त्वसमीक्ष्य कर्ण शिरो हृतं यन्न मयार्जुनस्य। समीक्ष्य मां मुञ्च रणे त्वमाशु हन्तास्मि शत्रु तव चात्मनश्च॥
en: O Karna, you discharged me without seeing me and hence I could not cut-off his head. Shoot me again immediately in battle after seeing me and I shall slay your enemies as well as mine.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: स एवमुक्तो युधि सूतपुत्रस्तमब्रवीत् को भवानुग्ररूपः। नागोऽब्रवीद् विद्धि कृतागसं मां पार्थेन मातुर्वधजातवैरम्॥ यदि स्वयं वज्रधरोऽस्य गोप्ता ततापि याता पितृराजवेश्मनि।
en: Thus addressed in the battle-field Suta's son said-"who are you of such a terrific form?” The Naga said-"Know me as one whom Partha, has made his enemy by killing my mother. Even if the wielder of thunder-bolt (Indra) protects him, he will go to the kingdom of the Pitris. Do not disregard me. Do what I say and I will kill your enemy. Shoot soon."

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: कर्ण उवाच न नाग कोऽद्य रणे परस्य बलं समास्थाय जयं बुभूषेत्॥ न संदध्यां द्विः शरं चैव नाग यद्यर्जुनानां शतमेव हन्याम्।
en: Karna said “Karna does not wish victory today in battle depending on another's strength. I shall not discharge, O Naga, a shaft twice even if I am to kill a hundred Arjunas.”

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तमाह कर्णः पुनरेव नागं तदाऽऽजिमध्ये रविसूनुसत्त्मः॥ हन्तास्मि पार्थं सुसुखी व्रजत्वम्।
en: Addressing again that Naga in the battlefield that best of Sun's sons said-"By the help of my other weapons and by dint of my energy and wrath I shall kill Partha. Go you away at ease.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: इत्येवमुक्तो युधि नागराजः कर्णेन होषादसंहस्तस्य वाक्यम्॥ स्वयं प्रायात् पार्थवधाय राजन् कृत्वा स्वरूपं विजिघांसुरुमः।
en: Thus addressed by Karna in the battle-field and unable to bear his words in anger that fierce Naga king, proceeded himself for the destruction of Partha, assuming the form of an arrow.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततः कृष्णः पार्थमुवाच संख्ये महोरगं कृतवैरं जहि त्वम्॥ स एवमुक्तो मधुसदनेन गाण्डीवधन्वा रिपुवीर्यसाहः। उवाच को ह्येष ममाद्य नागः स्वयं य आयाद् गरुडस्य वक्त्रम्॥
en: Thereupon Krishna said to Partha in the battle-field “kill the great snake whom you have made an enemy.” Thus spoken to by the slayer of Madhu, the holder of Gandiva bow, ever holding this Naga who, of his own accord, comes against me as if into the mouth of Garuda.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: कृष्ण उवाच योऽसौत्वया खाण्डवे चित्रभानु संतर्पयाणेन धनुर्धरेणा वियद्गतो जननीगुप्तदेहो मत्वैकरूपं निहतास्य माता॥
en: Krishna, said While armed with a bow were gratifying the fire-god in Khandava forest-this snake, having his body covered by his mother's, was in the sky. You killed his mother taking her for a single snake.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: स एष तद् वैरमनुस्मरन वै त्वां प्रार्थयत्यात्मवधाय नूनम्। नभश्चयुतां प्रज्वलितामिवोल्का पश्यैनमायान्तममित्रसाह॥
en: Remembering that hostility, O Partha, he has come today for slaying you. O grinder of enemies, see he is coursing like a burning firebrand droops from the sky.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: संजय उवाच चिच्छेद षड्भिनिशितैः सुधारैः। नागं वियत्तिर्यर्गिवोत्पतन्तं स च्छिन्नगात्रो निपपात भूमौ॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon covering the snake with six sharpened arrows Jishnu cut him off while he was moving in the sky. His body cut-off he dropped down on earth.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: हते च तस्मिन भुजगे किरीटिना स्वयं विभुः पार्थिव भूतलादथ। समुजहाराशु पुनः पतन्तं रथं भुजाज्यां पुरुषोत्तमस्ततः॥
en: After that serpent had been cut-off by Kiritin, the Purusothama himself, O King, of huge arms, raised that car from the earth with his own hands.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तस्मिन् मुहूर्ते दशभिः पृषत्कैः शिलाशितैर्बहिणबर्हवाजितैः। विव्याध कर्णः पुरुषप्रवीरो धनंजय तिर्यगवेक्षमाणः॥
en: In that very moment, Karna, looking askance on Dananjaya, struck that foremost of men with ten arrows whetted on stone and adorned with peacock feathers.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: वराहकणैर्निशितैः समर्प्य। माकर्णपूर्णायतमुत्ससर्ज॥ स चित्रवर्मेषुवरो विदार्य प्राणानिरस्यन्निव साधुमुक्तः। कर्णस्य पीत्वा रुधिरं विवेश वसुन्धरां शोणितदिग्धवाजः॥
en: Then Dhananjaya struck Karna with twelve keen and boar-eared arrows and a powerful Naracha like a virulent snake shot off his fulldrawn bow. Those arrows went though Karna's armour, as if drinking his blood and killing him and entered into the earth with their wings soaked with blood.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततो वृषो बाणनिपातकोपितो महोरगो दण्डविघट्टितो यथा। तदाशुकारी व्यसृजच्छरोत्तमान् महाविष: सर्प इवोत्तमंन विषम्॥ नवैर्नवत्या च शैरस्तथार्जुनम्। शरेण घोरेण पुनश्च पाण्डवं विदार्य को व्यनदजहास च॥
en: Then Vrisha, angered at the stroke of arrow like a scotched snake, discharged most powerful and quick-coursing shafts like a serpent vomiting poison. He struck Janardana with twelve and Arjuna with ninty nine arrows. And striking the latter again with a dreadful arrow Karna laughed.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तमस्य हेह ममृषे न पाण्डवो बिभेद मर्माणि ततोऽस्य मर्मवित्। स्तथा यथेन्द्रो बलमोजसा रणे॥
en: Pandu's son could bear his joy. Then that one, of Indra's power, acquainted with all the vitals parts, cut him to the quick with a hundred winged arrows as did Indra would Bala with great force.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततः शराणां नवति तदार्जुनः ससर्ज कर्णेऽन्तकदण्डसंनिभाम्। तैः पत्रिभिर्विद्धतनुः स विव्यथे तथा यथा वज्रविदारितोऽजलः॥
en: Then Arjuna shot ninety arrows each resembling Yama's rod at Karna. Wounded greatly Karna trembled like a a mountain clapped by a thunder-bolt.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: रलंकृतं चास्य वराङ्गभूषणम्। र्धनजयेनोत्तमकुण्डलेऽपि च॥
en: Karna's head dress, set with costly, gems, his most excellent other ornaments and ear rings were struck down on earth by Arjuna's winged arrows.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: महाधनं शिल्पिवरैः प्रयत्नतः कृतं यदस्योत्तमवर्म भास्वरम्। सुदीर्घकालेन ततोऽस्य पाण्डवः क्षणेन बाणैर्बहुधा व्यशातयत्॥
en: Pandu's son cut-off in no time into pieces the costly and shinning arınour of Karna that had been prepared with great care by clever artists working for a long time.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: स तं विवर्माणमथोत्तमेषुभिः शितैश्चतुर्भिः कुपितः पराभिनत्। स विव्यथेऽत्यर्थमरिप्रताडितो यथातुरः पित्तकफानिलज्वरैः॥
en: Then he again, in anger, struck Karna with four sharp and strong arrows who was devested of his armour. He trembled, thereat, like a person suffering from bile, wind, phlegm and fever.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: महाधनुर्मण्डालनिः सृतैः शितैः क्रियाप्रयत्नप्रितैर्बलेन च। विभेद मर्मस्वपि चार्जुनस्त्वरन्॥
en: Arjuna again cut Karna to the quick with many excellent and keen arrows shot off his circling bow with force, care and skill.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: दृढाहतः पत्रिभिरुग्रवेगैः पार्थेन कर्णो विविधैः शिताः। बभौ गिरिगैरिकधातुरक्तः क्षरन् प्रपातैरिव रक्तमम्भः॥
en: Thus wounded by Partha with many keen and powerful arrows Karna looked like a red chalk mountain with streams of red water pouring down.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततोऽर्जुनः कर्णमवक्रागैर्नवैः सुवर्णपुङ्खः सुदृढैरयस्मयैः। यमाग्निदण्डप्रतिमैः स्तनान्तरे पराभिनत् क्रौञ्चमिवाद्रिमग्निजः॥
en: Then with straight-going, strong, goldfeathered steel arrows resembling the rod of death, Arjuna struck Karna on the breast like Agni's son striking the mount Krouncha.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततः शरावापमपास्य सूतजौ धनुश्च तच्छक्रशरासनोपमम्। ततो रथस्यः स मुमोह च स्खलन् प्रशीर्णमुष्टिः सुभृशाहतः प्रभो॥
en: Then throwing off his bow that resembled Indra's bow and quiver Karna stood inactive and stupefied, suffering great pain and losing his grasp.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: निहन्तुमार्यः पुरुषव्रते स्थितः। दुवाच किं पाण्डव हे प्रमाद्यसे॥
en: The honorable Arjuna, always following the duties of a hero, did not like to kill him in that plight. Then Indra's younger brother respectfully said "why do you make a mistake, OPandu's son?

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: नैवाहितानां सततं विपश्चितः क्षणं प्रतीक्षन्त्यपि दुर्बलीयसाम्। विशेषतोऽरीन् व्यसनेषु पण्डितो निहत्य धर्म च यशश्च विन्दते॥
en: The wise never spare their enemies even for a moment, however weak they may be. A learned man always acquires merit and glory by destroying his distressed enemies.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तदेकवीरं तव चाहितं सदा त्वरस्व कर्णं सहसाभिमर्दितुम्। पुरा समर्थः समुपैति सूतजो भिन्धि त्वमेन नमुचिं यथा हरिः॥
en: Lose no time in discomfiting your enemy Karna immediately who is the foremost of heroes. When all right he will again proceed against you. Kill him therefore like Indra destroying the Asura Namuchi.”

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततस्तेदेवेत्यभिपूज्य सत्वरं जनार्दनं कर्णमविध्यदर्जुनः। स्तथा यथा शम्बरहा पुरा बलिम्॥
en: In pursuance of Krishna's order and i worshipping him the Kuru hero Arjuna again struck Karna with many powerful arrows like Indra striking the Asura Shamvara.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: साश्वं तु कर्ण सरथं किरीटी समाचिनोद भारत वत्सदन्तैः। प्रच्छादयामास दिशश्च बाणैः सर्वप्रयत्नापनीयपुकैः॥
en: Then Kiritin, O descendant of Bharata, covered Karna, his car and horses with calftoothed arrows and the ten quarters with gold winged ones.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: स वत्सदन्तै पृथुपीनवक्षाः समावित सोऽधिरथिर्विभाति। र्यथाचलश्चन्दनकाननायुतः॥
en: Wounded with those calf-toothed arrows the broad-chested son of Adiratha shone like a blossoming Asoka, Palasa or Salmali tree or a mountain leaden with sandal tree or a mountain laden with sandal trees.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: विभाति कर्णः समरे विशाम्पते। महीरुहैराचितसानुकन्दरो यथा गिरीन्द्रः स्फुटकर्णिकारवान्॥
en: His body covered with numberless arrows Karna shone like the mountain-chief covered with trees or adorned with blossoming Karnikaras.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: स बाणसङ्घान् बहुधा व्यवासृजद् विभाति कर्णः शरजालरश्मिवान्। सलोहितो रक्तगभस्तिमण्डलो दिवाकरोऽस्ताभिमुखो यथा तथा॥
en: Discharging numberless arrows Karna, having shafts for his rays, looked like the crimson-coloured sun coursing towards the setting hill.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: बाह्वन्तरादाधिरथेर्विमुक्तान् बाणान् महाहीनिव दाप्यमानान्। व्यध्वंसयनर्जुनबाहुमुक्ताः शराः समासाद्य दिशः शितायाः॥
en: Meeting in the sky the shining and snakelike arrows discharged by Karna, these keen ones, shot by Arjuna, destroyed them.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततः स कर्णः समवाप्य धैर्य बाणान् विमुञ्चन् कुपिताहिकल्पान्। विव्याध पार्थं दशभिः पृषत्कैः कृष्णं च षड्भिः कुपिताहिकल्पैः॥
en: Recovering equanimity of mind and discharging arrows like a serpent Karna struck Arjuna with ten and Krishna with six all resembling angry snakes.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततः किरीटी भृशमुग्रनि:स्वनं महाशरं सर्पविषानलोपमम्। अयस्मयं रौद्रमसहास्त्रसम्भृतं महाहवे क्षेप्तुमना महामतिः॥
en: Then in that great battle Dhananjaya wished to discharge a dreadful, great steel arrow, like a serpent or fire in force and sending forth a sound like that of Indra's thunderbolt.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: निदर्शयन् कर्णवधं ब्रुवाणः। भूमिस्तु चक्रं ग्रसतीत्यवोचत् कर्णस्य तस्मिन् वधकाल आगते॥
en: Then on the arrival of the hour of Karna's death Kala invisibly appeared on his car and reminding him of the Brahmana's course said-“The earth is devouring the wheel of your car."

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततस्तदस्तत्रंन मनसः प्रणष्टं यद् भार्गवोऽस्मै प्रददौ महात्मा। चत्रम्च वामं असते भूमिरस्य प्राप्ते तस्मिन् वधकाले नृवीर॥
en: Really, O King, when the hour of Karna's death approached he forgot the great Brahma weapon which Bhargava had given him. And the Earth was about to devour the left wheel of his car.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततो रथो घूर्णितवान् नरेन्द्र शापत्तदा ब्राह्मणसत्तमस्य। ततश्चक्रमपतत्तस्य भूमौ स विह्वलः समरे सूतपुत्रः॥
en: Having gone deep into the earth and been clogged there like a holy tree with flowers standing on a high land, Karna's car, on account of the great Brahmana's imprecation reeled.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: सवेदिकश्चैत्य इवातिमात्रः सुपुष्पितो भूमितले निमग्नः। घूर्णे रथे ब्राह्मणस्याभिशापाद् रामादुपात्ते त्वविभाति चास्त्रे॥ छिन्ने शरे सर्पमुखे च घोरे पार्थेन तस्मिन विषसाद कर्णः। अमृष्यमाणो व्यसनानि तानि हस्तौ विधुन्वन् स विगर्हमाणः॥
en: When his car began to reel, when the great weapon given by Rama did not shine, when his serpent-faced shaft was broken by Partha, Karna was filled with sadness, Unable to bear those misfortunes he shook his arms and vilified virtue saying.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: धर्मप्रधानं किल पाति धर्म इत्यब्रुवन् धर्मविदः सदैव। वयं च धर्मे प्रयताम नित्यं चर्तुं यथाशक्ति यथाश्रुतं च॥ स चापि निघ्नाति न पाति भक्तान् मन्ये न नित्यं परिपाति धर्मः॥
en: “The virtuous always say that virtue protects the virtuous. We, however, always practice virtue to the best of our knowledge and power. But virtue, instead of protecting us, is now destroying us who are its votaries."

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: एवं ब्रुवन् प्रस्खलिताश्वसूतो विचाल्यमानोऽर्जुनबाणपातैः। मर्माभिघाताच्छिथिल: क्रियासु पुनः पुनर्धर्ममसौ जगह॥
en: While he gave vent to these words he was greatly assailed by Arjuna's shafts. His horses and charioteer were dislodged. He was cut to the quick and became careless about his doings. He again and again spoke ill of virtue in the battle-field.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततः शरैर्भीमतरैरविध्यत् त्रिभिराहवे। हस्ते कृष्णं तथा पार्थमभ्यविध्यच सप्तिभिः॥ ततोऽर्जुनः सप्तदश तिग्मरेगानजिह्यगान्। इन्द्राशनिसमान् घोरानसृजत् पावकोपमान्॥
en: He struck Krishna's arm with three dreadful arrows and Arjuna with seven. Arjuna then discharged seventeen dreadful, straightcoursing and forcible arrows effulgent like fire and resembling Indra's thunder-bolt in impetuosity.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: निर्भिद्य ते भीमेवेगा ह्यपतन् पृथिवीतले। कम्पितात्मा ततः कर्णः शक्त्या चेष्टामदर्शयत्॥
en: Those powerful and dreadful arrows went through Karna's body and dropped on the surface of the earth. Trembling threat Karna showed his activity to the very best of his power.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: बलेनाथ स संस्तभ्य ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदैरयत्। ऐन्द्रं ततोऽर्जुनश्चापि तं दृष्ट्वाभ्युपमन्त्रयत्॥
en: Controlling himself with great exertion he brought the Brahma weapon into requisition beholding which Arjuna invoked the weapon given him by Indra with becoming mantras.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: गाण्डीवं ज्यां च बाणंश्च सोऽनुमन्त्र्य परंतपः। व्यसृजच्छरवर्षाणि वर्षाणीव पुरन्दरः॥
en: Then inspiring his Gandiva, its strings and arrows with mantras that repressor of enemies discharged arrows like Indra pouring down torrents of rain.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततस्तेजोमया बाणा रथात् पार्थस्य निःसृताः। प्रादुरासन् महावीर्याः कर्णस्य रथमन्तिकात्॥
en: Coming out of Arjuna's car those powerful and terrific arrows appeared near Karna's.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तान् कर्णस्त्वग्रतो न्यस्तान् मोघांश्चक्रे महारथः। ततोऽब्रवीद वृष्णिवीरस्तस्मिन्नस्त्रे विनाशिते॥
en: That great car-warrior baffled those arrows which appeared before him. Seeing the arrows

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: विसृजास्त्रं परं पार्थ राधेयो ग्रसते शरान्। ततो ब्रह्मास्त्रमत्युग्रं सम्मन्त्र्य समयोजयत्॥
en: Discharge more powerful weapons, O Partha, Karna makes these your arrows powerless." Then duly invoking it with mantras Arjuna set the Brahma weapon on his string.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: छादयित्वा ततो बाणैः कर्णं प्रत्यस्यदर्जुनः। ततः कर्णः शितैर्बाणैा चिच्छेद सुतेजनैः॥
en: Then covering all the directions with arrows he struck Karna with many. Then with a number of whetted arrows of great power Karna sundered the string of Arjuna's bow.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: द्वितीयां च तृतीयां च चतुर्थी पञ्चमी तथा। षष्ठीमथास्य चिच्छेद सप्तमी च तथाष्टमीम्॥
en: Karna cut-off his string for the second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh and eighth times.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: नवमी दशमी चास्य तथा चैकादशी वृषः। ज्याशतं शतसंघानः स कर्णो नावबुध्यते॥
en: Similarly his string was cut-off by Vrishna for the ninth, tenth and eleventh times. Although capable of discharging hundreds of arrow Karna knew that Arjuna had a century of strings.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततो ज्यां विनिधायान्यामभिमन्त्र्य च पाण्डवः। शरैरवाकिरत् कर्ण दीप्यमानैरिवाहिभिः॥
en: Then setting another string to his bow and shooting innumerable shafts, Arjuna covered Karna with arrows resembly fiery-mouthed serpents.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: तस्य ज्योछेदन कर्णो ज्यावधानं च संयुगे। नान्वबुध्यत शीघ्रत्वात्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: So quickly did Arjuna replace his strings that Karna could not perceive when one was broken and another replaced. The feat was highly wonderful to him.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य प्रनिघ्नन् सव्यसाचिनः। चक्रे चाप्यधिकं पार्थात् स्ववीर्यमतिदर्शयन्॥
en: Radha's son, however, nullified all the arrows of Savyasachin. With his power he got better of Arjuna for the time being.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततः कृष्णोऽर्जुनं दृष्ट्वा कर्णास्त्रेण च पीडितम्। अभ्यसेत्यब्रवीत् पार्थमातिष्ठास्त्रं व्रजेति च॥
en: Seeing Arjuna thus assailed with Karna's arrows Krishna said to him "Go nearer to Karna and strike him with more powerful weapons."

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततोऽग्निसदृशं घोरं शरं सर्पविषोपमम्। अश्मसारमयं दिव्यमबिमन्त्र्य परंतपः॥ रौद्रमस्त्रं समाधाय क्षेप्तुकामः किरीटवान्। ततोऽग्रसन्मही चक्रं राधेयस्य तदा नृप॥
en: Worked up with anger Arjuna invoked the aid of another celestial weapon with mantras which was effulgent like fire, dreadful like venom and hard like adamant. Then uniting it with Raudra weapon he was about to hurl it at his enemy when the earth swallowed up one of the wheels of Karna's car.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ततोऽवतीर्य राधेयो रथादाशु समुद्यतः। चक्रं भुजाभ्यामालम्ब्य समुत्क्षेप्तुमियेष सः॥
en: Then getting down in no time from his car he caught the sunken wheel with two hands and set forth a mighty exertion to extricate it.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: सप्तद्वीपा वसुमती सशैलवनकानना। जीर्णचक्रा समुत्क्षिप्ता कर्णेन चतुरङ्गुलम्॥१०६॥
en: Drawn up forcibly by Karna, the Earth, that had swallowed up his wheel, rose up with her seven insular continents, mountains, rivers and forests to a height of four cubits.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: ग्रस्तचक्रस्तु राधेयः क्रोधाश्रूण्यवर्तयत्। अर्जुनं वीक्ष्यं संरब्धमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing his wheel thus sunk, Karna wept in anger. And seeing Arjuna before him, he, worked up with

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: भो भोः पार्थ महेष्वास मुहूर्तं परिपालय। यावचक्रमिदं ग्रस्तमुद्धरामि महीतलात्॥
en: O Partha, wait for a moment till I extricate anger said-my wheel.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: सव्यं चक्रं महीग्रस्तं दृष्ट्वा देवादिदं मम। पार्थ कापुरुषतीर्णमभिसंधिं विसर्जय॥
en: Seeing my wheel thus accidentally sunken you should give up your idea which is cherished by a coward only.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: न त्वं कापुरुषाचीर्ण मार्गमास्थातचुमर्हसि। ख्यातस्त्वमसि कौन्तेय विशिष्टो रणकर्मसु॥ विशिष्टतरमेव त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि पाण्डव। प्रकीर्णकेशे विमुखे ब्राह्मणेऽथ कृताञ्जलौ॥ शरणागते न्यस्तशस्त्रे यातमाने तथार्जुन। अबाणे भ्रष्टकवचे भ्रष्टभग्नायुधे तथा॥ न विमुञ्चन्ति शस्त्राणि शूराः साधुव्रते स्थितः। त्वं च शूरतमो लोके साधुवृत्तश्च पाण्डवः॥ अभिज्ञो युद्धधर्माणां वेदान्तावभृथाप्लुतः। दिव्यास्त्रविदमेयात्मा कार्तवीर्यसमो युधि॥
en: Brave and pious heroes never shoot their arrows at persons with disheveled hairs, at those who fly away from the battle-field, at a Brahmana, at him who clasps his hands, at him who surrenders, at him who prays for quarter, at one who throws off his weapon, at one whose arrows are all gone, or at one whose weapon has fallen off or been broken. Your are the brave and pious of all in the world. You know all the rules at warfare.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: यावचक्रमिदं ग्रस्तमुद्धरामि महाभुजा न मां रथस्थो भूनिष्ठं विकलं हन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Pray, excuse me for a moment till I go out my wheel from the earth, O Dhananjaya. You are stationed on your car and I am standing helplessly weak on the earth. You should not kill me now.

description: Karna's car swallowed up by earth
sn: न वासुदेवात् त्वत्तो वा पाण्डवेय बिभेम्यहम्। त्वं हि क्षत्रियदायादो महाकुलविवर्धनः। अतस्त्वां प्रब्रवीम्येष मुहूर्तं क्षम पाण्डव॥
en: Neither Krishna, nor you fear me the least. You are a Kshatriya and the scion of an illustrious family. Remembering the dictates of virtue, excuse me for a moment, O son of Pandu.

sn: संजय उवाच तमब्रवीद वासुदेवो रथस्थो राधेय दिष्ट्या स्मरसीह धर्मम्। प्रायेण नीचा व्यमनेषु मग्ना निन्दति दैवं कुकृतं न तु स्वम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then Krishna, who was on the car said to Karna-"Fortunate it is, O son of Radha, that you remember virtue. It is always seen that men, when they are in distress, speak ill of the providence and not of their own evil deeds.

sn: मानाययेस्त्वं च सुयोधनश्च। दुःशासनः शकुनिः सौबलश्च न ते कर्ण प्रत्यभात्तत्र धर्म:॥
en: You, Duryodhana, Dushasana and Subala's son Shakuni, brought Draupadi, clad in one piece of cloth, before the court. Then O Karna, this virtue of yours, did not display itself.

sn: यदा सभायां राजानमनक्षज्ञं युधिष्ठिरम्। अजैषीच्छकुनि नात् क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When Shakuni, a clever hand at dice, defeated Kunit's son Yudhishthira who was innocent of the game where was this virtue of yours?

sn: वनवासे व्यतीते च कर्ण वर्षे त्रयोदशे। न प्रयच्छसि यद् राज्यं क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When the period of exile and the thirteenth year (of concealment) was over and you did not return the Pandavas their kingdom where was his virtue of yours.

sn: यद् भीमसेनंन सपैश्च विषयुक्तैश्च भोजनैः। आचरत् त्वन्मते राजा क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When at your advice the Kuru king attempted to kill Bhima through snakes and poisoned food where was this virtue of yours?

sn: यद् वारणावते पार्थान सुप्ताञ्जतुगृहे तदा। आदीपयस्त्वं राधेय क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When you set fire to the wax-house at Varanavata for burning the sleeping Pandavas to death where was this virtue of yours?

sn: यदा रजस्वलां कृष्णां दुःशासनवशे स्थिताम्। सभायांन प्राहसः कर्ण क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When you laughed at Draupadi while she, spare dressed and in her season, stood before the court at Dusasana's will where was this virtue of yours?

sn: तदनार्यैः पुरा कृष्णां क्लिश्यमानामनागसम्। उपप्रेक्षसि राधेय क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: O son of Radha! Where your religion (rule) was slipped when you once observed Draupadi getting torture in the hands of mean Kauravas.

sn: विनष्टाः पाण्डवः कृष्णे शाश्वतं नरकं गता। पतिमन्यं वृणीष्वेति वदंस्त्वं गजसामिनीम्॥ उपप्रेक्षसि राधेय क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः।
en: When you spoke to the Princess Draupadi, of dignified elephantine gait, “O Draupadi, the Pandavas are lost into eternal hell, choose another husband" and looked on the scene with glee where was this virtue of yours?

sn: राज्यलुब्धः पुनः कर्ण समाव्यथसि पाण्डवान्। यदा शकुनिमाश्रित्य क्क ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When thirsting for the kingdom and relying on the king of Gandharas you invited the Pandavas to a game at dice where was this virtue of yours?

sn: यदाभिमन्युं बहवो युद्दे जघ्नुर्महारथाः। परिवार्य रणे बालं क्क ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When encircling the boy Abhimanyu in battle a number of powerful car-warriors killed him where was the virtue of yours.

sn: यद्येष धर्मस्तत्र न विद्यते हि किं सर्वथा तालुविशोषणेन। अद्येह धाणि विधत्स्व सूत तथापि जीवन विमोक्ष्यसे हि॥
en: If this your virtue, the aid of which you now solicit, was no where on all those Occasions what is the use of drying up your tongue by uttering that word? You now wish to practise virtue, O Suta, but you shall not escape with your life.

sn: नलो ह्यक्षैर्निर्जितः पुष्करेण पुनर्यशो राज्यमवाप वीर्यात्। सर्वेः समेताः परिवृत्तलोभाः॥ निहत्य शूत्रन् समरे प्रवृद्धान् ससोमका राज्यमवाप्नुयुस्ते। तथा गता धार्तराष्ट्रा विनाशं धर्माभिगुप्तैः सततं नृसिंहः॥
en: Like Nala who was vanquished by Pushkara at a game of dice, but who regained his kingdom by dint of his power, the Pandavas, who are free from cupidity, will regain their kingdom by the force of their arms and help of their friends. Having killed their powerful enemies they with the Somakas will regain their kingdom. The sons of Dhritarashtra will be killed by those best of men who are always shielded by virtues.

sn: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तस्तदा कर्णो वासुदेवेन भारत। लज्जयावनतो भूत्वा नोत्तरं किञ्चिदुक्तवान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus accosted by Krishna, O descendant of Bharata, Karna hung down his head in shame and made no reply.

sn: क्रोधात् प्रस्फुरमाणैष्टो धनुरुद्यम्य भारत। योधयामास वै पार्थ महावेगपराक्रमः॥
en: With lips trembling in anger, he, of great energy and prowess, took up his bow and began to fight with Arjuna.

sn: ततोऽब्रवीद् वासुदेव: फाल्गुनं पुरुर्षभम्। दिव्यास्त्रेणैव निर्भिद्य पातयस्व महाबल॥
en: Then Vasudeva's son said to Phalguna, that best of men-"Strike Karna down with a celestial weapon."

sn: एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन क्रोधमागातदार्जुनः। मन्युमभ्याविशद् घोरं स्मृत्वा तत्तु धनंजयः॥
en: Thus accosted by the deity Arjuna was worked up with anger. And recollecting all the incidents Dhananjaya was possessed by a terrific rage.

sn: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य सर्वेभ्यः स्रोतोभ्यस्तेजसोऽतिषः। प्रादुरासंस्तदा राजंस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Then, O king, as if scintillations of fire began to come put from the pores of the angry Partha's body. The scene was exceedingly wondrous.

sn: तत् समीक्ष्य ततः कर्णो ब्रह्मास्त्रेण धनंजयम्। अभ्यवर्षत् पुनर्यनमकरोद् रथसर्जने॥
en: Seeing it Karna invoked the Brahma weapon, shot arrows on Dhananjaya and tried once more to get rid of his car. arrOWS son

sn: ब्रह्मास्त्रेणैव तं पार्थो ववर्ष शरवृष्टिभिः। तदस्त्रमस्त्रेणावार्य प्रजहार च पाण्डवः॥
en: Partha, also, by his Brahma weapon made a down pour of upon Karna. Counteracting the arrows of his enemy with those of his own Pandu's son continued to strike him.

sn: ततोऽन्यदस्त्रं कौन्तेयो दयितं जातवेदसः। मुमोच कर्णमुद्दिश्य तत् प्रजज्वाल तेजसा॥
en: Then aiming at Karna Kunti's discharged another favourite weapon of his powerful as the fire.

sn: वारुणेन ततः कर्णः शमयामास पावकम्। जीमूतैश्च दिशः सर्वाश्चके तिमिरदुर्दिनाः॥
en: Karna, however, put out that fire with Varuna (watery) weapon. Suta's son covered all the directions with clouds created by his arrows and it appeared like a rainy day.

sn: पाण्डेवयस्त्वसम्भ्रातो वायव्यास्त्रेण वीर्यवान्। अपोवाह तदाभ्राणि राधेयस्य प्रपश्यतः॥
en: Then before the very presence of Karna, the powerful son of Pandu scattered those clouds with his Vayavya weapon.

sn: ततः शरं महाघोरं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्। आददे पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सूतपुत्रो जिघांसयां॥
en: Then for killing the son of Pandu, the charioteer's son took up another dreadful arrows shining like the fire.

sn: योज्यमाने ततस्तस्मिन् बाणे धनुषि पूजिते। चचाल पृथिवी राजन् सशैलवनकानना॥
en: When that arrow was set on the bow-string, O king, the earth shook with her mountains, watery expanses and forests.

sn: ववौ सशर्करो वायुर्दिशश्च रजसा वृताः। हाहाकारश्च संजज्ञे सुराणां दिवि भारत॥
en: Violent winds blew scattering pebbles. All the directions were covered with dust and cries of lamentation arose amongst the celestials in the sky.

sn: तमिषु संधितं दृष्ट्वा सूतपत्रेण मारिष। विषादं परमं जग्मुः पाण्डवा दीनचेतसः॥
en: Seeing that arrows aimed by Karna, the Pandavas were worked with depression and sorrow.

sn: स सायकः कर्णभुजप्रमुक्तः शक्राशनिप्रख्यरुचिः शिताग्रः॥ भुजान्तरं प्राप्य धनंजयस्य विवेश वल्मीकमिवोरगोत्तमः।
en: The keen arrows, effulgent like Shakra's thunder-bolt shot off Karna's hands, fell upon Dhananjaya's breast and went into it like a serpent penetrating an ant-hill.

sn: स गाढविद्धः समरे महात्मा विघूर्णमानः श्लथहस्तगाण्डिवः॥ चचाल बीभत्सुरमित्रमर्दनः क्षितेः प्रकम्पे च यथा चलोत्तमः।
en: Thus wounded that chastiser of enemies, the high-souled Vibhatsu began to reel. His grasp became loosened and his bow Gandiva, dropped off his hands. He shook there like the king of mountain in an earth-quake.

sn: तदन्तरं प्राप्य वृषो महारथो रथाङ्गमुर्वीगतमुज्जिहीषुः॥ रथादवल्पुत्य निगृह्य दोर्ध्या शशाक दैवान महाबलोऽपि।
en: During this opportunity the great carwarrior Vrisha leaped down from his chariot to extricate the wheel that had been sunk underneath the earth. Holding it with his two hands he tried his best of get it out. But unfortunately for his bad luck he failed through he was possessed of great strength.

sn: ततः किरीटी प्रतिलभ्य संज्ञा जग्राह बाणं यमदण्डकल्पम्॥ ततोऽर्जुनः प्राञ्जलिकं महात्मा ततोऽब्रवीद् वासुदेवोऽपि पार्थम्। छिन्थ्यस्य मूर्धानमरेः शरेण न यावदारोहति वै रथं वृषः॥
en: In the interval regaining his consciousness the diadem-decked and the high-souled Arjuna took his arrow Anjalika which was fatal as the rod of Death. Thereupon Krishna said to Partha-"Cut-off with this arrow the head of your enemy before he gets upon his car.”

sn: स्तत: शरं प्रज्वलितं प्रगृह्य। जघान कक्षाममलार्कवर्णा महारथे रथचक्रे विमग्ने॥
en: Praising highly those words of Lord Krishna and while the wheel of his enemy was still under the earth the great car-warrior Arjuna took up a highly effulgent, razorheaded arrow and struck down Karna's standard bearing the emblem of an elephant and shining like the spotless sun.

sn: तं हस्तिकक्षाप्रवहं च केतुं सुवर्णमुक्तामणिवज्रपृष्ठम्। ज्ञानप्रकर्षोत्तमशिल्पियुक्तैः कृतं सुरूपं तपनीयचित्रम्॥
en: That standard bearing the elephant was decorated with gold, pearls, gems and diamonds and was made with great skill by the best of artizans. It was highly beautiful and made of pure gold.

sn: ममित्रवित्रासनमीडयरूपम्। विख्यातमादित्यसमं स्म लोके त्विषा समं पावकभानुचन्द्रैः॥
en: That standard always used to inspire your soldiers with courage and fill your enemies with fear. Its form was highly praiseworthy. Known all over the world it was effulgent like the sun.

sn: ततः क्षुरप्रेण सुसंशितेन सुवर्णपुड्वेन हुताग्निवर्चसा। श्रिया ज्वलन्तं ध्वजमुन्ममाथ महारथस्याधिस्थेः किरीटी॥
en: With that keen, gold-winged razor, headed arrow effulgent like fire, fed with libations of clarified butter the diadem-decked Arjuna cutoff that standard of Adhiratha's son, the great car-warrior.

sn: यशश्च दर्पश्च तथा प्रियाणि सर्वाणि कार्याणि च तेन केतुना। साकं कुरूणां हृदयानि चापतन् बभूव हाहेति च निःस्वनो महान्॥
en: With that standard fell the glory, pride, hope of success and everything dear unto the hearts of the Kurus. And cries of lamentations arose in your army.

sn: दृष्ट्वा ध्वजं पातितमाशुकारिणा कुरुप्रवीरेण निकृत्तमाहवे। नाशंसिरे सूतपुत्रस्य सर्वे जयं तदा भारत ये त्वदीया: :॥
en: Seeing that standard struck down by the light-handed Kuru hero your soldiers gave up all hopes of Karna's success.

sn: अथ त्वरन् कर्णवधाय पार्थो महेन्द्रवज्रानलदण्डसंनिभम्। आदत्त चाथाञ्जलिकं निषङ्गात् सहस्ररश्मेरिव रश्मिमुत्तमम्॥
en: Then wishing to kill Karna quickly Arjuna took out from his quiver an Anjlika arrow that was effulgent like Indra's thunder-bolt, Agni's rod or the thousand-rayed sun.

sn: मर्मच्छिदं शोणितमांसदिग्धं वैश्वानरार्कप्रतिमं महार्हम्। नराश्वनागासुहरं त्र्यरत्न षड्वाजमञ्जोगतिमुग्रवेगम्॥ सहस्रनेत्राशतितुल्यवीर्य कालानलं व्यात्तमिवातिघोरम्। पिनाकनाराणचक्रसंनिभं भयङ्करं प्राणभृतां विनाशनम्॥
en: Capable of cutting to the quick, covered with flesh and blood, effulgent like the sun or fire, made of precious ingredients, straightcoursing, impetuous, destructive of men, horses and elephants it was three cubits and six feet in length. Powerful as the thousand-eyed Indra's thunder-bolt, irresistible as the night rangers, the trident or the discus it was highly terrible and capable of destroying all creatures.

sn: जग्राह पार्थः स शरं प्रहृष्टो यो देवसङ्घरपि दुर्निवार्यः। सम्पूजितो यः सततं महात्मा देवासुरान् यो विजयेन्महेषुः॥
en: Partha cheerfully took up that arrow which could not be withstood even by the celestials. This great weapon, capable of discomfiting the celestials and Asuras, was always adored by the son of Pandu.

sn: तं वै प्रमृष्टं प्रसमीक्ष्य युद्धे चचाल सर्वं सचराचरं जगत्। स्तमुद्यतं प्रेक्ष्य महाहवेषुम्॥
en: Seeing that arrow taken up by Partha in battle, the entire universe trembled with its mobile and immobile creations. Beholding that arrow about to be discharged the Rishis cried aloud "Peace be to the universe.

sn: ततस्तु तं वै शरमप्रमेयं गाण्डीवधन्वा धनुषि व्ययोजयत्। युक्तवा महास्त्रेण परेण चापं विकृष्य गाण्डीवमुवाच सत्वरम्॥
en: The holder of the Gandiva then set that peerless arrows his bow united with another highly powerful weapon. Then drawing his Gandiva bow he said.

sn: अयं महास्त्रप्रहितो महाशरः शरीरहवासुहरश्च दुर्हदः। तपोऽस्ति तप्तं गुरवश्च तोषिता पया यदीष्टं सुहृदां श्रुतं तथा॥ अनेन सत्येन निहन्त्वयं शरः सुसंहितः कर्णमरिं ममोर्जितम्। इत्यूचिवांस्तं प्रमुमोच बाणं धनंजयः कर्णवधाय घोरम्॥
en: If I have ever practised penances, if I have ever respected my elders and listened to the counsels of well-wishers let this arrow be powerful enough to destroy the body and heart of my enemy. Let his sharp arrow, adored by me, slay my enemy Karna." Saying this Dhananjaya discharged the arrow for destroying Karna.

sn: कृत्यामथर्राङ्गिरसीमिवोग्रां दीप्तामसह्यां युधि मृत्युनापि। ब्रुवन किरीटी तमतिप्रहृष्टो ह्ययं शरो मे विजयावहोस्तु॥ जिघांसुरर्कन्दुसमप्रभावः कर्ण मयास्तो नयतां यमाय।
en: It was a terrific arrows, efficacious as a rite of the Atharvan of Angiras, effulgent and incapable of being borne by Death himself in battle. Desirous of slaying Karna Partha again cheerfully said-“May this arrow bring on my victory. May it, effulgent like the fire or sun, shot by me, dispatch Karna to the abode of Death.

sn: तेनेषुवर्येण किरीटमाली प्रहृष्टरूपो विजयावहेन॥ जिघांसुरर्केन्दुसमप्रभेण चक्रे विषक्तं रिपुमाततायी।
en: Saying this, Arjuna, adorned with crown and garlands, ever inimical towards Karna and desirous of killing him, struck his enemy with that best of arrows, effulgent like the sun of moon capable of giving victory.

sn: तथा विमुक्तो बलिनार्कतेजाः प्रज्वालयामास दिशो नभश्च। ततोऽर्जुनस्तस्य शिरो जहार वृत्रस्य वज्रेण यथा महेन्द्रः॥
en: Discharged by that mighty heroic that arrow, effulgent like the sun, emblazoned all the quarters. With that arrow Arjuna struck off his enemy's head like Indra striking the head of Vritra with his thunder.

sn: स्तदा महास्त्रप्रतिमन्त्रितेन। पाथोऽपराह्ने शिर उच्चकर्त वैकर्तनस्याथ महेन्द्रसूनुः॥
en: With that powerful Anjalika weapon inspired with mantras Indra's son cut-off the head of Vaikartana in the afternoon.

sn: मथास्य कायो निपपात पश्चात्। तदुद्यतादित्यसमानतेजसं शरन्नभोमध्यगभास्करोपमम्॥ वराङ्गमुक्मपतञ्चमूमुखे दिवाकरोऽस्तादिवरक्तमण्डलः।
en: Thus sundered with Anjalika arrow Karna's trunk dropped down on earth. The head also of the commander of the Kuru army, effulgent like the risen, sun and the meridian sun of the autumn, dropped down on earth like the crimson sun falling down from the setting hill.

sn: ततोऽस्य देहं सततं सुखोचितं सुरूपमत्यर्थमुदारकर्ममः॥ परेण कृच्छ्रेण शिरः समत्यजद् गृहं महर्धीव सुसङ्गमीश्वरः।
en: The head of the illustrious Karna reluctantly left the body, highly beautiful and brought up in luxury like a person unwillingly leaving a big house filled with riches.

sn: शरैर्विभिन्नं व्यसु तत् सुवर्चसः पपात कर्णस्य शरीरमुच्छ्रितम्॥ स्त्रवव्रणं गैरिकतोयविस्त्रवं गिरेर्यथा वज्रहतं महाशिरः। देहाच कर्णस्य निपातितस्य तेजः सूर्य खं वितत्याविवेश॥
en: Cut-off with Arjuna's arrows and shorn of life the tall and shining body of Karna, with blood gushing out of every wound, looked like the summit of a red chalk mount clapped by a thunder-bolt with red streams running down after a shower. Then a light came out of Karna's body, passed though the sky and entered into the sun.

sn: तदद्भुतं सर्वमनुष्ययोधाः संदृष्टवन्तो निहते स्म कर्णे। दृष्ट्वा कर्णं पातितं फाल्गुनन॥
en: This wonderful spectacle was wiinessed by all the on-lookers after Karna's fall. Then seeing Karna slain by Phalguna the Pandavas blew their conchs.

sn: तथैव कृष्णश्च दनंजयश्च हृष्टौ यमौ दध्मतुर्वारिजातौ। तं सोमकाः प्रेक्ष्य हतं शयानं सैन्यैः सार्ध सिंहनादान् प्रचक्रुः॥
en: Likewise Krishna and Dhananjaya, overflowing with joy, blew their conchs. Seeing Karna slain and lying on the battle-field the Somakas were filled the joy and sent-up loud shouts with other soldiers.

sn: तूर्याणि संजघ्नुरतीव हृष्टा वासांसि चैवादुधुवर्भुजांश्च। संवर्धयन्तश्च नरेन्द्र योधाः पार्थं समाजग्मुरतीव हृष्टाः॥ नन्योन्यमाश्लिष्य नदन्त ऊचुः। दृष्ट्वा तु कर्ण भुवि वा विपन्नं कृतं रथात् सायकैरर्जुनस्य॥
en: With great joy the struck their trumphets and shook their arms and garments. Then, O king, approaching Partha, all the warriors began to praise him; other powerful heroes danced embracing each other; and others sending loud shouts said-"By good luck Karna has slain prostrate on earth wounded with arrows."

sn: महानिलेनादिमिरापविद्धं यज्ञावसानेऽग्निमिव प्रशान्तम्। मस्तं गतं भास्करस्येव बिम्बम्॥
en: Karna's head, separated off the body, looked like a mountain top loosened by a storm or like fire put out after the completion of a sacrifice, or the sun after it has risen the setting hill.

sn: शरैराचितसर्वाङ्गः शोणितैधपरिप्लुतः। विभाति देहः कर्णस्य स्वरश्मिभिरिवांशुमान्॥
en: Karna's body filled with all parts arrow penetrated and soaked in blood was getting the grace of sun, the holder of beams and illuminated.

sn: प्रताप्य सेनामामित्री दीप्तैः शरगभस्तिभिः। बलिनार्जुनकालेन नीतोऽस्तं कर्णभास्करः॥
en: After having scorched his enemy's army the Karna-like sun, having arrows for its rays, was caused to be set by Arjuna time.

sn: अस्तं गच्छन् यथादित्यः प्रभामादाय गच्छति। तथा जीवितमादाय कर्णस्येषुर्जगाम सः॥
en: As while moving towards the setting hill the sun withdraws all its rays so (Arjuna's) arrow passed of taking Karna's vital breaths.

sn: अपराह्नेऽपराहोऽस्य सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष। छिन्नमञ्जलिकेनाजौ सोत्सेधमपतच्छिरः॥
en: In the afternoon cut-off with Anjalika in battle the head of the charioteer's son dropped down earth.

sn: उपर्युपरि सैन्यानामस्य शत्रोस्तदञ्जसा। शिर: कर्णस्य सोत्सेधमिषुः सोऽप्यहरद् द्रुतम्॥
en: Before the very presence of the Kaurava troops that weapon speedily took away Karna's head and body.

sn: कर्णं तु शूरं पतितं पृथिव्यां शराचितं शोणितदिग्धगात्रम्। श्छिन्नध्वजेनाथ ययौ रथेन॥
en: Beholding the brave Karna prostrated on earth wounded with shafts and bathed in blood the king of Madras left the battle field on the car deprived of the standard.

sn: हते कर्णे कुरवः प्राद्रवन्त भयार्दिता गाढविद्धाश्च संख्ये। अवेक्षमाणा मुहुरर्जुनस्य ध्वजं महान्तं वपुषा ज्वलन्तम्॥
en: After Karna's fall the Kuru soldiers, wounded with arrows and filled with fear, took to their heels looking again and again on the lofty and shining standard of Arjuna.

sn: सहस्रनेक्षप्रतिमानकर्मणः सहस्रपत्रप्रतिमाननं शुभम्। सहस्ररश्मिर्दिनसंक्षये यथा तथापतत् कर्णशिरो वसुंधराम्॥
en: The beautiful head, having a countenance like a loutus of a thousand petals, of Karna, whose exploits like those of the thousand eyes Indra, drooped down on earth like the thousand-rayed sun in the end of day.

sn: संजय उवाच शल्यस्तु कर्णार्जुनयोर्विमर्दे बलानि दृष्ट्वा मृदितानि बाणैः। ययौ हते चाथिरथौ पदानुगे रथेन संछिन्नपरिच्छदेन॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing the soldiers assailed with shafts in the encounter between Karna and Arjuna, Shalya, worked up with anger, pursued on that car shorn of its equipment's.

sn: निपातितस्यन्दनवाजिनागं बलं च दृष्ट्वा हतसूतपुत्रम्। दुर्योधनोऽश्रुप्रतिपूर्णनेत्रो दीनो मुहुनिःश्वसंश्चार्तरूपः॥
en: Seeing his army deprived of Karna and his cars, horses and elephants destroyed Duryodhana, with tears trickling down his eyes, sighed again and again in agony.

sn: कर्णं तु शूरं पतितं पृथिव्यां शराचितं शोणितदिग्धगात्रम्। यद्दच्छया सूर्यमिवावनिस्थं दिदृक्षवः सम्परिवार्य तस्थुः॥
en: For seeing the brave Karna, wounded with shafts and bathed in blood lying prostrate on earth like the sun dropped from the sky the warriors came there and stood encircling the fallen hero.

sn: प्रहृष्टवित्रस्तविषण्णाविस्मितास्तथा परे शोकहता इवाभवन्। परे त्वदीयथैषां परस्परेण यथायथैषां प्रकृतिस्तथाभवन्॥
en: Amongst them, belonging to your army as well as to the enemy's some showed signs of joy, some of fear, some of sorrow, some of wonder and some of grief.

sn: प्रविद्धवर्माभरणाम्बरायुधं धनंजयेनाभिहतं महौजसम्। हतर्षभा गाव इवाजने वने॥
en: Hearing that the mighty Karna had been slain by Dhananjaya and his armour, ornaments, robes and weapons had been displaced, your soldiers fled away in fight like a herd of kine, overcome with fear at losing their bull.

sn: भीमश्च भीमेन तदा स्वनेन नादं कृत्वा रोदसी: कम्पयानः। आस्फोटयन् बल्गते नृत्यते च हते कर्णे त्रायसन् धार्तराष्ट्रान्॥
en: Then shaking the sky with terrible shouts Bhima began to strike his arm-pits, jump and dance striking terror to the of Dhritarashtras.

sn: तथैव राजन् सोमकाः सृञ्जयाश्च शङ्खान् दध्मुः सस्वजुश्चापि सर्वे। परस्परं क्षत्रिया हृष्टरूपाः सूतात्मजे वै निहते तदानीम्॥
en: The Somakas and Srinjayas also loudly blew their conchs, Seeing the charioteer's son killed all the Kshatriyas embraced one another in delight.

sn: कृत्वा विमर्द महदर्जुनेन कर्णो हत: केसरिणेव नागः। तीर्णा प्रतिज्ञा पुरुषर्षभेण वैरस्यान्तं गतवांश्चापि पार्थः॥
en: After a dreadful fight Karna was killed by Arjuna as an elephant is slain by a lion. The sons best of men Arjuna thus did wreck his vengeance.

sn: स्तूर्ण रथेनापकृतध्वजेन। दुर्योधनस्यान्तिकमेत्य राजन् सबाष्पदुःखाद् वचनं बभाषे॥
en: Approaching Duryodhana speedily on that car devested of standard of the king of Madras, with an aggrieved heart, said sorrowfully.

sn: विशीर्णनागाश्वरथप्रवीरं बलं त्वदीयं यमराष्ट्रकल्पम्। नैराश्वनागैगिरिकूटकल्पैः॥
en: “The elephants, horses and the flowers of your army have been killed. On account of those, great car-warriors, horses and elephants, huge as mountains being destroyed your army looks like kingdom of Death.

sn: नैतादृशं भारत युद्धमासीद् यथा तु कर्णार्जुनयोर्बभूव। ग्रस्तौहि कर्णेन समेत्य कृष्णावन्ये च सर्वे तव शत्रवो ये॥
en: Never before, O descendant of Bharata, such a battle had been fought as that between Karna and Arjuna. Kama assailed the two Krishnas and your other enemies.

sn: दैवं ध्रुवं पार्थवशात् प्रवृत्तं यत् पाण्डवान् पाति हिनस्ति चास्मान्। तवार्थसिद्धयर्थकरास्तु सर्वे प्रसह्य वीरा निहता द्विषद्भिः॥
en: Destiny however is in favour of Partha; she is protecting the Pandavas and destroying us. Many horses, who were resolved upon encompassing your end, have been per force killed by the enemy.

sn: कुबेरेवैवस्वतवासवानं तुल्यप्रभावा नृपते सुवीराः। वीर्येण शौर्येण बलेन तेजसा तैस्ततैस्तु युक्ता विविधैर्गुणौघैः॥ स्तवार्थकामा युधि पाण्डवैयैः। तन्मा युत्रो भारत दिष्टमेतत् पर्याश्चस त्वं न सदास्ति सिद्धिः॥
en: Many heroes resembling Kubera, Yama, Vasava or Varuna in energy, courage and strength, who were accomplished, unslayable and bent upon securing your object, have been killed by the Pandavas. Do not grieve, O descendant of Bharata. It is destiny. Every object is not always crowned with success."

sn: एतद् वचो मद्रपतेर्निशम्य स्वं चाप्यनीतं मनसा निरीक्ष्य। दुर्योधन दीनमना विसंज्ञः पुनः पुनर्व्यश्वसदार्तरूपः॥
en: Hearing the words of the king of Madras and remembering his own misdeeds, Duryodhana, deprived of senses, sighed again and again.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तस्मिंस्तु कर्णर्जुनयोर्विमर्दै दग्धस्य रौद्रेऽहनि विद्रुतस्य। बभूव रूपं कुरुसृञ्जयानां बलस्य बाणोन्मथितस्य कीद्दक्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How did Kuru and Srinjaya army look, when on that dreadful day, it was assailed and consumed with arrows in that encounter between Karna and Arjuna and while it was flying from the action.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: संजय उवाच शृणु राजन्नवहितो यथा वृतो महाक्षयः। घोरो मनुष्यदेहानामाजौ च गजवाजिनाम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Listen, attentively, O king, to the onslaught of men, horses and elephants in that dreadful battle.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: यत्र कर्णे हते पार्थः सिंहनादमथाकरोत्। थदा तव सुतान् राजन्नविवेश महद् भयम्॥
en: When after Karna's fall Partha sent up leonine war-cries your sons were possessed by a mighty fear.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: न संघातुमनीकानि न चैवाशु पराक्रमे। आसीद् बुद्धिर्हते कर्णे तव योधस्य कर्हिचित्॥
en: After Kanra's fall no warrior of your side had a heart of rallying your troops or displaying his prowess.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: वणिजो नापि भिन्नायामगाधे विल्पवे यथा। अपारे पारमिच्छन्तो हते द्वीपे किरिटिना॥
en: On their main stay being destroyed by Arjuna they were like merchants, whose vessels had been wrecked on the deep main, desirous of crossing it.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: सूतपुत्रे हते राजन् वित्रस्ताः शस्त्रविक्षताः। अनाथा नाथमिच्छन्तो मृगाः सिहैविार्दिताः॥
en: After the destruction of the charioteer's son, the Kauravas, terrified and wounded with arrows, having no lord and seeking refuge, locked like a herd of elephants pursued by lion.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: भग्नशृङ्गा वृषा यद्वद् भग्नदंष्ट्रा इवोरगाः। प्रत्यपायाम सायाह्ने निर्जिताः सव्यसचिना॥
en: Discomfited by Savyasachin that evening they took to their heels like bulls with broken horns or serpents with wounded fangs.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: हतप्रवीरा विध्वस्ता निकृता निशितैः शरैः। सूतपुत्रे हते राजन् पुत्रास्ते दुद्रुबुर्भयात्॥
en: Having the beast of their heroes killed, their soldiers all routed and themselves sounded with sharp arrows your sons, on the fall of Karna, fled away in fear.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: विस्त्रस्तयन्त्रकवचाः कांदिग्भूता रिचेतस्ः। अन्योन्यमवमृद्नन्तो वीक्षमाणा भयर्दिताः॥
en: Deprived of their coats of mail and weapons, unconscious of the right direction and bewildered they crushed one another in their flight and cast fearful looks upon one another.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: मामेव नूनं बीभत्सुर्मामेव च वृकोदरः। अभियामिति मन्वाना: पेतुर्मम्लुश्च सम्भ्रमात्॥
en: on The Kauravas, pale with fear, thought “Vibhatsa is following me, Vrikodaras is pursing me" and fell down as they fled.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: हयानन्ये गजानन्ये स्थानन्ये महारथाः। आरुह्य जवसम्पन्नाः पदातीन् प्रजहुर्भयात्॥
en: Thus fled away in fear all the great carwarriors some on cars, some on horses, some on elephants and some on foot.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: कुञ्जरैश्र स्यन्दनाः क्षुण्णा: सादिनश्च महारथैः। पदातिसंघाश्चाश्चौघैः पलायद्भिर्भयार्दितैः॥
en: In their fearful fight cars were shattered by elephants, the cavalry were crushed by carwarriors and the infantry were trampled down by horses.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: व्यालतस्करसंकीर्णे सार्थहीना यथा वने। सूतपुत्रे हते राजंस्तव योधास्तथाभवन्॥
en: After the fall of Karna your warrior behaved like men, having no protector in a forest abounding in beasts of prey and robbers.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: हतारोहा यथा नागाश्छिन्नहस्ता यथा नराः। सर्वे पार्थमयं लोकं सम्पश्यन्तो भयार्दिताः॥
en: They behaved like elephants without riders and men without arms. Stricken with fear they thought that the entire universe was filled with Partha.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: सम्प्रेक्ष्य द्रवतः सर्वान् भीमसेन भयार्दितान्। दुर्योधन स्वं सूतं हा हा कृत्वेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing them thus take to their heels in fear of Bhimasena and his soldiers leave the battle field by thousands, Duryodhana, bewailing, said to his driver.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: नातिक्रमेच मां पार्थो धनुष्पाणिमवस्थितम्। जघने सर्वसैन्यानां शनैरश्वान् प्रचोदय॥
en: "Partha will not be able to go beyond me standing bow in hand. Drive my horses behind all the troops.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: युध्यमानं हि कौन्तेयं हनिष्यामि न संशयः। नोत्सहेन्मातिक्रान्तुं वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: If I fight in the rear of my army forsooth the son of Kunti will not be able to approach me as the ocean is unable to go beyond its banks.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: अद्यार्जुनं सगोविन्दं मानिनं तच वृकोदरम्। हन्यां शिष्टांस्तथा शत्रून कणम्यानृण्यमाप्नुयाम्॥
en: Killing Arjuna, Govinda, the haughty Vrikodara and my other enemies I will repay the debt I owe to Karna."

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा कुरुराजस्य शूरार्यसदृशं वचः। सूतो हेमपरिच्छन्नाशनैरश्वानचोदयत्॥
en: Hearing the words of the Kuru Chief becoming a hero and an honorable man the driver slowly drove his horses adorned with golden trappings.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: रथाश्वनागहीनास्तु पादातास्तव मारिष। पञ्चविंशतिसाहस्त्रा युद्धायैव व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: Then deprived of cars, cavalry and clephants, twenty-five thousand warriors of your army addressed themselves for fighting on foot.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: तान् भीमसेनः संक्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। बलेन चतुरङ्गेन संवृत्याजघ्नतुः शरैः॥
en: Then worked up with anger Bhimasena and Prisata's son Dhristadyumna encircled them with four kinds of forces and began to strike them with their arrows.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: प्रत्ययुध्यन्त समरे भीमसेनं सपार्षतम्। पार्थपार्षतयोश्चान्ये जगृहुस्तत्र नामनी॥
en: Your warriors also fought with Bhimasena and Prisata's son. Some of them challenged both the heroes by calling them by name.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: अक्रुध्यत रणे भीमस्तैस्तदा पर्यवस्थितैः। शोऽवथीर्य रथात्तर्ण गदापाणिरयुध्यत॥
en: Thereat Bhima was worked up with anger. Coming down from his car with a mace in his hand he fought with those warriors standing for battle.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: न तान् रथस्थो भूमिष्ठान् धर्मापेक्षी वृकोदरः। योधयामास कौन्तेयो भुजवीर्यव्यपाश्रयः॥
en: Following the rules of a fair fight, Kunti's son Vrikodara alighted from his car and depending upon the strength of his own arms he began to fight with them on foot.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: जातरूपपरिच्छनानं प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्। अवधीत्तावकान् सर्वान दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः॥
en: Taking up his heavy golden mace he made a havoc on them like Death himself armed with his bludgeon.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: पदातिनोऽपि संत्यज्य प्रियं जीवितमात्मनः। भीमाभ्यद्रवन संख्ये पतङ्गा ज्वलनं यथा॥
en: Then worked up with anger and heedless of their lives the Kuru soldiers rushed upon Bhima like insects falling upon a burning fire.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: आसाद्य भीमसेन तु संरब्धा युद्धदुर्मदाः। विनेशुः सहसा दृष्ट्वा भूतग्रामा इवान्तकम्॥
en: The maddened warriors, whom it was difficult to vanquish in battle, perished in no time like creatures on seeing Death himself,

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: श्येनवद् विचरन् भीमो गदाहस्तो महाबलः। पञ्चविंशतिसाहस्रास्तावकान् समयोथयत्॥
en: Armed with his mace the powerful Bhima moved about like hawk and killed those twenty five thousand warriors.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: हत्वा तत्पुरुषानीकं भीमः सत्यपराक्रमः। धृष्टद्युम्नं पुरस्कृत्य तस्थौ तत्र महाबलः॥
en: Having killed that heroic army Bhima, of great strength, whom it was difficult to defeat in battle, stood there with Dhristadyumna before him.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: धनंजयो रथानीकमभ्यवर्तत वीर्यवान्। माद्रीपुत्रौ तु शकुनि सात्यकिश्च महारथः॥ जवेनाभ्यपतन् हृष्टा नन्तो दौर्योधनं बलम्।
en: The energetic Dhananjaya Dhananjaya proceeded against the remaining car warriors of the Kuru away. Nakula, Sahadeva and Satyaki with great pleasure proceeded against Shakuni and killed the soldiers of Subala's son.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: तस्याश्वसादीन् सुबहूंस्ते निहत्य शितैः शरैः॥ समभ्यधावंस्त्वरितास्तत्र युद्धमभून्महत्।
en: Having killed with sharp arrows his cavalry and elephants they attacked Shakuni himself upon which a great encounter took place.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: धनंजयोऽपि चाभ्येत्य रथानीकं तव प्रभो॥ विश्रुतं त्रिषु लोकेषु गाण्डीवं व्याक्षिपद् धनुः।
en: In the meantime proceeding against your car-warriors Dhananjaya twanged his bow Gandiva known all over the three worlds.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: कृष्णसारथिमायान्तं दृष्ट्वा श्वेतहयं रथम्॥ अर्जुनं चापि योद्धारं त्वदीया प्राद्रवन् भयात्।
en: Seeing his car drawn by white horses and driven by Krishna himself and Arjuna standing on it your soldiers fled away in fear.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: विप्रहीणरथाश्चैव शरैश्च परकर्षिताः॥ पञ्चविंशतिसाहस्त्राः कालमार्थन् पदातयः।
en: Twenty-five thousand foot soldiers, deprived of cars, were killed there with arrows (by Bhima and Dhristadyumna).

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: हत्वा तान् पुरुषव्याघ्रः पाञ्चालानां महारथः॥ पुत्रः पाञ्चालराजस्य धृष्टद्युम्नो महामनाः। भीमसेनं पुरस्कृत्य नचिरात् प्रत्यदृश्यत॥ महाधनुर्धरः श्रीमानमित्रगणतापनः।
en: Having killed them that best of men, the foremost of car-warriors, the heroic son of Panchala king Dhristadyumna again appeared in view with Bhima before him. That great bowman, the destroyer of the enemies, looked there exceedingly beautiful.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नं रणे दृष्ट्वा त्वदीयाः प्राद्रवन् भयात्। पारावतसवर्णाश्वं कोविदारमयध्वजम्॥
en: Seeing Dhristadyumna's car, drawn by horses white as pigeons and bearing a standard made of a Kovidara tree the Kuru soldiers fled away in dismay.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: गान्धारराजं शीघ्रास्त्रमनुसृत्य यशस्विनौ॥ नचिरात् प्रत्यदृश्येतां माद्रीपुत्रौ ससात्यकी।
en: Having pursued the light-handed king of Gandharvas the illustrious twins and Satyaki again appeared (amongst the Pandavas.)

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: चेकितानः शिखण्डी च द्रौपदेयाश्च मारिष।॥ हत्वा त्वदीयं सुमहत् सैन्यं शङ्खांस्तथाधमन्।
en: Having killed your huge army Chikitan, Shikhandin and the five sons of Draupadi blew their conchs.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: ते सर्वे तावकान् प्रेक्ष्य द्रवतोऽपि पराङ्मुखान्॥ अभ्यवर्तन्त संरब्धान् वृषाञ्जित्वा यथा वृषाः।
en: Although they saw your soldiers flying away from the battle-field those heroes pursued i them like bulls pursuing other angry bulls.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: सेनावशेषं तं दृष्ट्वा तव सैन्यस्य पाण्डवः॥ व्यवस्थित: सव्यसाची चुक्रोध बलवान् नृप।
en: Still seeing a portion of your army standing for battle Savyasachin was filled with anger.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: धनंजयो स्थानीकमभ्यवर्तत वीर्यवान्॥ विश्रुतं त्रिषु लोकेषु व्याक्षिपद् गाण्डिवं धनुः।
en: Drawing his bow Gandiva known all over the three worlds the highly energetic Dhananjaya rushed against your car-warriors.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: तत एनाशरवातैः सहसा समवाकिरत्॥ तमसा संवृतेनात न स्म किंचिद व्यदृश्यत।
en: All on a sudden he covered your soldiers with arrows. The dust covered the directions and nothing was discernible.

description: Kuru soldiers fled away from battle-field
sn: अन्धकारीकृते लोके रजोभूते महीतले॥ योधाः सर्वे महाराज तावका: प्राद्रवन् भयात्।
