sn: तथैवायुतशो योधास्तावकाः पाण्डवान् रणे॥ अभ्यवर्तन्त संक्रुद्धा विविधायुधपाणयः।
en: Similarly, thousands of warriors, of your army, armed with various weapons and filled with anger, proceeded against the Pandavas in that battle.

description: The arrangement of Kuru troops under Shalya and the preparation of both parties for a first battle
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच हते भीष्म महेष्वासे द्रोणे कर्णे महारथे॥ कुरुष्वल्पावशिष्टेषु पाण्डवेषु च संयुगे। सुसंरब्धेषु पार्थेषु पराक्रान्तेषु संजय॥ मामकानां परेषां च किं शिष्टमभवद् बलम्।
en: Dhritarashtra said After the fall of the great bowmen Bhishma and Drona and the great car-warrior Karna and after both the Kurus and the Pandavas had been lessened in numbers and when the powerful Parthas became once more angry in battle, what, O Sanjaya, was the strength of each of the armies.

description: The arrangement of Kuru troops under Shalya and the preparation of both parties for a first battle
sn: संजय उवाच यथा वयं परे राजन् युद्धाय समुपस्थिताः॥ यावघासीद् बलं शिष्टं संग्रामे तन्निबोध मे।
en: Sanjaya said Hear, O king, how we and the enemy both stood for battle on that occasion and what was then the relative strength of the two armies.

description: The arrangement of Kuru troops under Shalya and the preparation of both parties for a first battle
sn: एकादश सहस्राणि रथानां भरतर्षभ॥ दश दन्तिसहस्राणि सप्त चैव शतानि च। पूर्णे शतसहस्रे द्वे हयानां तत्र भारत॥ पत्तिकोट्यस्तथा तिस्रो बलमेतत्तवाभवत्।
en: Eleven thousand cars, O best of Bharata's race, ten thousand and seven hundred elephants and two hundred horse and three millions of foot, formed our army.

description: The arrangement of Kuru troops under Shalya and the preparation of both parties for a first battle
sn: रथानां षट्सहस्राणि षट्सहस्राश्च कुञ्जराः॥ दश चाश्वसहस्राणि पत्तिकोटी च भारत। एतद् बलं पाण्डवानामभवच्छेषमाहवे॥ एत एव समाजग्मुर्युद्धाय भरतर्षभ।
en: Six thousand cars, six thousand elephants, ten thousand horse and one million of foot, O Bharata, war the remnant of the Pandava force in that battle. These, O best of Bharata's race, met each other for battle.

description: The arrangement of Kuru troops under Shalya and the preparation of both parties for a first battle
sn: एवं विभज्य राजेन्द्र मद्रराजठशे स्थिताः॥ पाण्डवान् प्रत्युदीयुस्ते जयगृद्धाः प्रमन्यवः।
en: Having divided our armies in this way, O) king, we, worked up with wrath and filled with the desire of victory, rushed against the Pandavas, under the command of the king of the Madras.

description: The arrangement of Kuru troops under Shalya and the preparation of both parties for a first battle
sn: तथैव पाण्डवाः शूराः समरे जितकाशिनः॥ उपयाता नरव्याघ्राः पूर्वां संध्यां प्रति प्रभो।
en: Similarly, the brave Pandavas, those foremost of men, desirous of killing their enemies, encountered one another early in the morning, O king.

description: The arrangement of Kuru troops under Shalya and the preparation of both parties for a first battle
sn: ततः प्रवर्तते युद्धं घोररूपं भयानकम्। तावकानां परेषां च निघ्नतामितरेतरम्॥
en: Then took place a dreadful encounter between your soldiers and the enemy, the warriors being all engaged in striking and slaughtering one another.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: संजय उवाच ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरूणां भयवर्धनम्। संजयैः सह राजेन्द्र घोरं देवासुरोपमम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then took place the battle between the Kurus and the Srinjayas, O king, that was as fierce and awful as that between the celestials and the Asuras.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: नरा रथा गजौघाश्च सादिनश्च सहस्रशः। वाजिनश्च पराक्रान्ता: समाजग्मुः परस्परम्॥
en: Men and cars and elephants and elephantwarriors and horsemen by thousands and horses, all very powerful, encountered one another.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: गजानां भीमरूपाणां द्रवता निःस्वनो महान्। अश्रूयत यथा काले जलदानां नभस्तले॥
en: The loud noise of the rushing of dreadful elephants was then heard there, resembling the roars of the clouds in the sky in the rains.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: नागैरभ्याहता: केचित् सरथा रथिनोऽपतन्। व्यद्रवन्त रणे वीरा द्राव्यमाणा मदोत्कटैः॥
en: Some car-warriors, struck by elephants, were deprived of their cars. Dispersed by those infuriate animals, other brave heroes ran away.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: हयौधन पादरक्षांश्च रथिनस्तत्र शिक्षिताः। शरैः सम्प्रेषयामासुः परलोकाय भारत॥
en: Well-trained car-warriors, O Bharata, with their arrows, killed a number of cavalry and infantry that urged and protected the elephants.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: सादिनः शिक्षिता राजन् परिवार्य महारथान्। विचरन्तो रणेऽभ्यघ्नन् प्रासशक्तवृष्टिभिस्तथा।।६।
en: Well-trained horsemen, king, surrounding great car-warriors, moved about in the field, striking and slaying the latter with spears and draft and swords.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: धन्विनः पुरुषाः केचित् परिवार्य महारथान्। एकं बहव आसाद्य प्रययुर्यमसादनम्॥ नागान् रथवरांश्चान्ये परिवार्य महारथाः। सान्तरायोधिनं जघ्नुर्द्रवमाणं महारथम्॥
en: Some bowmen, surrounding great carwarriors, killed them. Encompassing elephant and great warriors of their own class, other great car-warriors killed some mighty one amongst them that fought in the field moving about on all sides.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: तथा च रथिनं क्रुद्धं विकिरन्तं शरान् बहून्। नागा जघ्नुर्महाराज परिवार्य समन्ततः॥
en: Similarly, O king, elephants, encircling individual car-warriors worked up with rage and shooting arrows, killed them.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: नागो नागमभिद्रुत्य रथी च रथिनं रणे। शक्तितोमरनाराचैर्निजने तत्र भारत॥
en: Elephant-warrior rushing against elephantwarrior and car-warrior against car-warrior, in that battle, killed each other with darts and lances and Narachas, O Bharata.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: पादातानवमृद्नन्तो रथवारणवाजिनः। रणमध्ये व्यदृश्यन्त कुर्वन्तो महादाकुलम्॥
en: Cars and elephants and horses, crushing foot-soldiers in the midst of battle, mad a confusion all over.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: हयाश्च पर्यधावन्त चामरैरुपशोभिताः। हंसा हिमवतः प्रस्थे पिबन्त इव मेदिनाम्॥
en: Adorned with yak-tails, horses rushed on all sides, looking like the swans found on the plains at the foot of Himavat. In their speed they seemed as if ready to devour the very earth.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: तेषां तु वाजिना भूमिः खुरैश्चित्रा विशाम्पते। अशोभत यथा नारी करजैः क्षतविक्षता॥
en: The field, O king, marked with the hoofs of horses, looked beautiful like a beautiful woman bearing the marks of (her lover's) nails on her person.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: वाजिनां खुरशब्देन रथनेमिस्वनेन च। पत्तीनां चापि शब्देन नागानां बृंहितेन च॥ वादित्राणां च घोषेण शङ्खानां निनदेन च। अभवन्नादिता भूमिर्निर्घातैरिव भारत॥
en: With the sound caused by the trampling of horses, the wheels of cars, the shouts of footsoldiers, the grunts of clephants, the beating of drums and other musical instruments and the blare of conchs, the earth began to resound as if with deafening peals of thunder.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: धनुषां कूजमानानां शस्त्रौघानां च दीप्यताम्। कवचानां प्रभाभिश्च न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन॥
en: On account of twanging bows and flashing swords and the glittering armour of the worriors everything was so confused there that nothing could be distinctly seen.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: बहवो बाहवश्छिन्ना नागराजकरोपमाः। उद्वेष्टन्ते विचेष्टन्ते वेगं कुर्वन्ति दारुणम्॥
en: Numerous arms, chooped off from human bodies and looking like the tusks of elephants, jumped up and moved furiously about.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: शिरोभिः पतितै ति पततां धरणीतले। च्युतानामिव तालेभ्यस्तालानां श्रूयते स्वनः॥
en: The sound, made, O monarch, by heads falling on the field of battle, resembled that made by the falling fruits of palmyra trees.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: शिरोभिः पतितै ति रुधिराद्रैर्वसुन्धरा। तपनीयनिभैः काले नलिनैरिव भारत॥ उद्वृत्तनयनैस्तैस्तु गतसत्त्वैः सुविक्षतैः। व्यभ्राजत मही राजन् पुण्डरीकैरिवावृता।॥
en: Covered with those lifeless heads with upturned eyes, that were exceedingly mangled the field of battle, O king, looked resplendent as if covered with full-blown lotuses.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: बाहुभिश्चन्दनादिग्धैः सकेयूरैर्महाधनैः। पतितै ति राजेन्द्र महाशक्रध्वजैरिव॥
en: With the fallen arms of the warriors smeared with sandal and adorned with rich Keyuras, the Earth looked resplendent as if strewn with the rich poles set up in Indra's honours.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: ऊरुभिश्च नरेन्द्राणां विनिकृत्तैर्महाहवे। हस्तिहस्तोपमैरन्यैः संवृतं तद् रणाङ्गणम्॥
en: The battle-field-was covered with the things of kings, cut off in that battle and looking like the trunk of elephants.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: कबन्धशतसंकीर्णं छत्रचामरसंकुलम्। सेनावनं तच्छुशुभे वनं पुष्पाचितं यथा॥
en: Covered with hundreds of headless trunks and strewn with umbrellas and yakyails, that vast army looked beautiful like a blossoming forest.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: तत्र योधा महाराज विचरन्तो ह्यभीतवत्। दृश्यन्ते रुधिराक्ताङ्गाः पुष्पिता इव किंशुकाः॥
en: Then, on the field of battle, O monarch, warriors moved about fearlessly, their limbs bathed in blood and, therefore, looking like flowering Kinshukas.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: मातङ्गाश्चाप्यदृश्यन्त शरतोमरपीडिताः। पतन्तस्तत्र तत्रैव छिन्नाभ्रसदृशा रणे॥
en: Elephants also, wounded with arrows and lances, dropped down here and there like broken clouds dropped from the sky.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: गजानीकं महाराज वध्यमानं महात्मभिः। व्यदीर्यत दिशः सर्वा वातनुन्ना घना इव॥
en: O king, killed by great warriors, elephant divisions were dispersed in all directions like clouds scattered by the wind.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: ते गजा घनसंकाशा: पेतुरुा समन्ततः। वज्रनुन्ना इव बभुः पर्वता युगसंक्षये॥
en: Those elephants, resembling clouds dropped on the earth like mountai is clapped by a thunder, O lord, at the time of the universal dissolution.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: हयानां सादिभिः सार्धं पतितानां महीतले। राशयः स्म प्रदृश्यन्ते गिरिमात्रस्ततस्ततः॥
en: Horses with their drivers lay in masses on the ground like so many mountains.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: संजज्ञे रणभूमौ तु परलोकवहा नदी। शोणितोदा रथावर्ता ध्वजवृक्षास्थिशर्करा॥
en: A river was formed on the field o, battle, flowing towards the other world. Blood formed its waters and cars its eddies, Standards were its trees, the bones its pebbles.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: भुजनक्रा धनुःस्रोता हस्तिशैला हयोपला। मेदोमजाकर्दमिनी छत्रहंसा गदोडुपा॥
en: The arms were its alligators, bows its current, elephants its large rocks and its smaller ones. Fat and marrow constituted its mire, umbrellas its swans and maces its rafts.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: कवचोष्णीषसंच्छन्ना पताकारुचिरदुमा। चक्रचक्रावलीजुष्टा त्रिवेणूरगसंवृता॥
en: Abounding with armour and head-gears, banners formed its beautiful trees. Wheels formed its swarms of Chakravakas and it was covered with Trivenus and Dandas.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: शूराणां हर्षजननी भीरूणां भयवर्धनी। प्रावर्तत नदी रौद्रा कुरुसृञ्जयसंकुला॥
en: Filling the brave with joy and increasing the fears of the timid, that fierce river flowed the shores of which were filled with Kurus and Srinjayas.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: तां नदी परलोकाय वहन्तीमतिभैस्वाम्। तेरुहिननौभिस्तैः : शूराः परिधबाहवः॥
en: Those brave warriors, with arms resembling bludgeons, by the aid of their cars and animals, acting as rafts and boats crossed that dreadful river which flowed towards the region of the deed.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: वर्तमाने तदा युद्धे निर्मयादे विशाम्पते। चतुरङ्गक्षये घोरे पूर्वदेवासुरोपमे॥
en: During the course of that battle, O king, in which no consideration was showed by any body for any one and which with awful destruction of the four fold forces, resembled the battle between the celestials and the Asuras in the days of yore.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: व्याक्रोशन् बान्धवानन्ये तत्र तत्र परंतप। क्रोशाद्भिर्दयितैरन्ये भयार्ता न निवतिरे।॥
en: Some warriors, O scorcher of foes, loudly called upon their kinsmen and friends. Some, called upon by crying kinsmen, returned stricken with fear,

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: निर्मर्यादे तथा युद्धे वर्तमाने भयानके। अर्जुनो भीमसेनश्च मोहयांचक्रतुः परान्॥
en: During the course of that fierce and dreadful battle, Arjuna and Bhimasena stupefied their foes.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: सा वध्यमाना महती सेना तव नराधिप। अमुह्यत्तत्र तत्रैव योषिन्मदवशादिव॥
en: Your army, O king thus destroyed, swooned away on the field, like a woman under the influence of liquor.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: मोहयित्वा च तां सेनां भीमसेनधनञ्जयौ। दध्मतुर्वारिजौ तत्र सिंहनादांश्च चक्रतुः॥
en: Having stupefied that army, Bhimasena and Dhananjaya blew their conchs and sent forth leonine roars.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: श्रुत्वैव तु महाशब्दं धृष्टद्युम्नशिखण्डीनौ। धर्मराजं पुरस्कृत्य मद्रराजमभिद्रुतौ॥
en: On hearing that loud sound Dhristadyumna and Shikhandin, placing king Yudhishthira at their head, rushed against the king of the Madras.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: तत्राश्चर्यमपश्याम घोररूपं विशाम्पते। शल्येन सङ्गताः शूरा यदयुध्यन्त भागशः॥
en: Highly wonderful and terrible, O monarch, was the manner in which those heroes, in a body and separately, fought with Shalya.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: माद्रीपुत्रौ तु रभसौ कृतास्त्रौ युद्धदुर्मदौ। अभ्ययातां त्वरायुक्तौ जिगीषन्तौ परंतप॥
en: The two energetic sons of Madri, masters of weapons and invincible in battle, proceeded quickly against your army worked up with the desire of victory.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: ततो न्यवर्तत बलं तावकं भरतर्षभ। शरैः प्रणुन्नं बहुधा पाण्डवैर्जितकाशिभिः॥
en: Then your army, O best of Bharata's race, wounded greatly with arrows by the Pandavas eager for victory, took to their heels in the battle.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: वध्यमाना चमूः सा तु पुत्राणां प्रेक्षतां तव। भेजे दिशो महाराज प्रणुन्ना शरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: Thus struck and dispersed by strong bowmen, O king, that army fled away on all sides in the presence of your sons.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: हाहाकारो महाञ्जज्ञे योधानां तव भारत। तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाप्यासीद् द्रावितानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Exclamations of Oh and Alas, O Bharata, arose from among your warriors while some illustrious Kshatriyas among the dispersed combatants, desirous of victory, cried out, saying-stop, stop.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: क्षत्रियाणां सहान्योन्यं संयुगे जयमिच्छताम्। प्राद्रवन्नेव सम्भग्नाः पाण्डवैस्तव सैनिकाः॥ त्यक्त्वा युद्धे प्रियान् पुत्रान् भ्रातृनथ पितामहान्। मातुलान् भागिनेयांश्च वयस्यानपि भारत॥
en: Despite it, your troops routed by the Pandavas, fled away leaving behind on the field, their dear sons and brothers and maternal uncles and sisters and relatives by marriage and other kinsmen.

description: The battle between the Kurus and Srinjayas
sn: हयान् द्विपांस्त्वरयन्तो योधा जग्मुः समन्ततः। आत्मत्राणकृतोत्साहास्तावका भरतर्षभ॥
en: Driving their horses and elephants to a great speed, thousands of warriors fled away O foremost of Bharata's race, anxious to secure their personal safety only.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: संजय उवाच तत् प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा मद्रराजः प्रतापवान्। उवाच सारथिं तूर्णं चोदयाश्वान्महाजवान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Beholding the army thus scattered the brave king of the Madras address his driver, saying-Quickly urge these horses fleet as thought.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: एष तिष्ठति वै राजा पाण्डुपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। छत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन पाण्डुरेण विराजता॥
en: There stands king Yudhishthira, the son of Pandu, shining with the uinbrella held over his head.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: अत्र मां प्रापय क्षिप्रं पश्य मे सारथे बलम्। न समर्थो हि मे पार्थः स्थातुमद्य पुरो युधि॥
en: Reach me there quickly driver and witness my power. The Parthas are unable to stand before me in battle."

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: एवमुक्तस्ततः प्रायान्मद्रराजस्य सारथिः। यत्र राजा सत्यसंधो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Thus addressed the driver, of the Madra king, proceeded where stood the righteous king Yudhishthira of sure aim.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: प्रापतत् तच्च सहसा पाण्डवानां महद् बलम्। दधारैको रणे शल्यो वेलोवृत्तमिवार्णवम्॥
en: Shalya suddenly attacked the mighty army of the Pandavas. Alone he withstood it like the continent withstanding the surging deep.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: पाण्डवानां बलौघस्तु शल्यमासाद्य मारिष। व्यतिष्ठत तदा युद्धे सिन्धोर्वेग इवाचलम्॥
en: The huge army of the Pandavas, coming against Shalya, O sire, stood still in that battle, like the rushing deep upon being obstructed by a mountain.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: मद्रराजं तु समरे दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय धिष्ठितम्। कुरवः संन्यवर्तन्त मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥
en: Beholding the king of the Madras standing for battle on the field, the Kouravas returned, making death their goal.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तेषु राजन् निवृत्तेषु व्यूढानीकेषु भागशः। प्रावर्तत महारौद्रः संग्रामः शोणितोदकः॥ समाळुचित्रसेनं तु नकुलो युद्धदुर्मदः।
en: After they had come back, O king and separately taken up their positions in a wellformed array, an awful encounter took place in which blood flowed freely like water. The invincible Nakula encountered Chitrasena.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तौ परस्परमासाद्य चित्रकार्मुकधारिणौ॥ मोघाविव यथोवृत्तौ दक्षिणोत्तरवर्षिणौ। शरतोयैः सिषिचतुस्तौ परस्परमाहवे॥ नान्तरं तत्र पश्यामि पाण्डवस्येतरस्य च।
en: These two heroes, both excellent bowmen, approaching, covered each other with downpours of arrows in that battle, like two pouring clouds risen in the sky on the south and the north. I could mark no difference between the son of Pandu and his antagonist.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: उभौ कृतास्त्रौ बलिनौ रथचर्याविशारदौ॥ परस्परवधे यत्तौ छिद्रान्वेषणतत्परौ।
en: Both of them were masters of weapons, both very powerful and both were experienced car-warriors. Each determined upon killing the other, they carefully looked for each other's weak point.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: चित्रसेनस्तु भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च॥ नकुलस्य महाराज मुष्टिदेशेऽच्छिनद् धनुः।
en: Then, O king, with a broad-headed arrow, well-tempered and sharp Chitrasena cut off Nakula's bow at the handle.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं रुक्मपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः॥ त्रिभिः शरैरसम्भ्रान्तो ललाटे वै समार्पयत्।
en: Fearlessly then the son of Karna struck the bowless Nakula at the forehead with three gold-winged arrows whetted on stone.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: हयांश्चास्य शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥ तथा ध्वजं सारथिं च त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरपातयत्।
en: With a few more sharp arrows he killed Nakula's horses, Next he struck down both the standard and the driver of his antagonist, each with three arrows.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: स शत्रुभुजनिर्मुक्तैर्ललाटस्थैस्त्रिभिः शरैः॥ नकुलः शुशुभे राजंस्त्रिशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः।
en: With those three arrows shot off the arms of his foe and striking his forehead, Nakula, O king, looked beautiful like a mountain of three summits.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: स च्छिन्नधन्वा विरथः खड्गमादाय चर्म च॥ रथादवातरद् वीरः शैलाग्रादिव केसरी।
en: Deprived of his bow and his car, the brave Nakula, taking up a sword, jumped down from his car like a lion from a mountain suminit.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: पझ्यामापततस्तस्य शरवृष्टिं समासृजत्॥ नुकलोऽप्यग्रसत् ता वै चर्मणा लघुविक्रमः।
en: As, however, he rushed on foot, his antagonist discharged a shower of arrows upon him. The highly active Nakula received that downpour of arrows on his shield.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: चित्रसेनरथं प्राप्य चित्रयोधी जितश्रमः॥ आरुरोह महाबाहुः सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः।
en: Getting at the car of Chitrasena, the mightyarmed hero, the untiring son of Pandu, conversant with all modes of warfare, appeared before the troops.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: सकुण्डलं समुकुटं सुमनसं स्वायतेक्षणम्॥ चित्रसेनशिरः कायादपाहरत पाण्डवः। स पपात रथोपस्थे दिवाकरसमद्युतिः॥
en: The son of Pandu then cut off from Chitrasena's trunk his diadem-decked head, adorned with ear-rings and bedecked with a beautiful nose and a pair of large eyes. At this, Chitrasena, effulgent like the Sun, dropped down on the terrace of his car.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: चित्रसेनं विशस्तं तु दृष्ट्वा तत्र महारथाः। साधुवादस्वनांश्चक्रुः सिंहनादांश्च पुष्कलान्॥
en: Beholding Chitrasena killed at the great carwarriors shouted there like lions and lauded him.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: विशस्तं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा कर्णपुत्रौ महारथौ। सुषेणः सत्यसेनश्च मुञ्चन्तौ विविधाशरान्॥
en: Meanwhile, beholding their brother slain, the two sons of Karna, viz., Sushena and Satyasena, both of whom were great carwarriors, made a downpour of sharp arrows.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: ततोऽभ्यधावतां सूर्णं पाण्डवं रथिनां वरम्। जिघांसन्तौ यथा नागं व्याघ्रौ राजन् महावने।॥
en: Those foremost of car-warriors rushed quickly against the son of Pandu like a pair of tigers, O king, in the deep forest rushing against an elephant for slaying him.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तावभ्यधावतां तीक्ष्णौ द्वावप्येनं महारथम्। शरोधान् सम्यगस्यन्तौ जीमूतौ सलिलं यथा।॥
en: Both of them covered the great car-worrier Nakula with keen arrows. When they discharged arrows, they looked like two masses of clouds pouring rain in torrents.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: स शरैः सर्वतो विद्धः प्रहष्ट इव पाण्डवः। अन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय रथमारुह्य वेगवान्॥ अतिष्ठत रणे वीरः क्रुद्धरूप इवान्तकः।
en: Though wounded with arrows all over his body the valiant and heroic son of Pandu cheerfully took up another bow after getting upon another car and stood in battle like the angry Destroyers himself,

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तस्य तौ भ्रातरौ राजशरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ रथं विशकलीकर्तुं समारब्धौ विशाम्पते।
en: Then those two brothers, O kings, with their straight arrows, cut off Nakula's car into pieces.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: ततः प्रहस्य नकुलश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो रणे॥ जघान निशितैर्बाणैः सत्यसेनस्य वाजिनः।
en: Then Nakula, laughing, struck the four horses of Satyasena with four whetted and keen arrows in that encounter.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: ततः संधाय नाराचं रुक्मपुङ्ख शिलाशितम्॥ धनुश्चिच्छेद राजेन्द्र सत्यसेनस्य पाण्डवः।
en: Shooting a long gold-winged shaft the son of Pandu then cut off, O king, the bow of Satyasena.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: अथान्यं रथमास्थाय धनुरादाय चापरम्॥ सत्यसेनः सुषेणश्च पाण्डवं पर्यधावताम्।
en: At this the latter, mounting on another car and taking up another bow, as also his brother Sushena, rushed against the son of Pandu.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: अविध्यत् तावसम्भ्रान्तौ माद्रीपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां महाराज शराभ्यां रणमूर्धनि।
en: The brave son of Madri fearlessly struck each of them, O monarch, with a couple of arrows.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: सुषेणस्तु ततः क्रुद्धः पाण्डवस्य महद् धनुः॥ चिच्छेद प्रहसन् युद्धे क्षुरप्रेण महारथः।
en: Then worked up with wrath, the mighty car-warrior Sushena, cut off, in that battle, the formidable bow of Pandu's son with a razorshaped arrow.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय नकुलः क्रोधमूर्छितः॥ सुषेण पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा ध्वजमेकेन चिच्छिदे।
en: Then Nakula, beside himself with rage, took up another bow and struck Sushena with five arrows and his standard with one.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: सत्यसेनस्य च धनुर्हस्तावापं च मारिष॥ चिच्छेद तरसा युद्धे तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः।
en: Without losing a moment, he then cut off the boy and the leathern fence of Saryasena also, at which all the troops there sent up a loud shout.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय वेगनं भारसाधनम्॥ शरैः संछादयामास समन्तात् पाण्डुनन्दनम्।
en: Satyasena, taking up another foe-slaying and powerful bow, covered the son of Pandu with arrows on all sides.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: संनिवार्य तु तान् बाणान् नकुलः परवीरहा॥ सत्यसेनं सुषेणं च द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यामविध्यत।
en: Baffling those arrows Nakula, that slayer of hostile heroes, struck each of his antagonists with a couple of arrows.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तावेन प्रत्यविध्येतां पृथक् पृथगजिह्मगैः॥ सारथिं चास्य राजेन्द्र शितैर्विव्यधतुः शरैः।
en: Each of the latter separately struck the son of Pandu in return with ma..y straight coursing arrows. Afterwards they struck Nakula's driver also with many keen arrows.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: सत्यसेनो रथेषां तु नकुलस्य धनुस्तथा॥ पृथक्छराभ्यां चिच्छेद कृतहस्त: प्रतापवान्।
en: The brave and light-handed Satyasena then cut off without his brother's help the shafts of Nakula's car and his bow with a couple of arrows.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: स रथेऽतिरथस्तिष्ठन् रथशक्तिं परामृशत्॥ स्वर्णदण्डामकुण्ठायां तैलधौतां सुनिर्मलाम्।
en: The great car warrior Nakula, however, standing on his car, took up a golden mounted and keen dart steeped in oil and exceedingly bright.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: लेलिहानामिव विभो नागकन्यां महाविषाम्॥ समुद्यम्य च चिक्षेप सत्यसेनस्य संयुगे।
en: It resembled, O king, a she-snake of dreadful poison, frequently darting out her tongue. Raising that weapon he hurled it at Satyasena in that battle.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: सा तस्य हृदयं संख्ये बिभेद च तथा नृप॥ स पपात रथाद् भूमिं गतसत्त्वोऽल्पचेतनः।
en: That dart, O king, cut the heart of Satyasena in that battle into a hundred pieces and he fell down dead upon the Earth from his car.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा सुषेणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः॥ अभ्यवर्षच्छरैस्तूर्णं पादातं पाण्डुनन्दनम्। चतुर्भिश्चतुरो वाहान् ध्वजं छित्वा च पञ्चभिः॥ त्रिभिर्वै सारथिं हत्वा कर्णपुत्रो ननाद ह।
en: Beholding his brother killed Sushena, beside himself with rage, suddenly made Nakula careless in that battle. Without losing a moment, he poured arrows over the son of Pandu fighting on foot. He pierced four arrows and destroyed his four cars. Again he pierced five and cut off his flag. Then by three the son of Karna killed charioteer and uttered a loud leonine roar.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: नकुलं विरथं दृष्ट्वा द्रौपदेयो महारथम्॥ सुतसोमोऽभिदुद्राव परीप्सन् पितरं रणे।
en: Seeing Nakula carless, the mighty carwarrior Sutasoma, the son of Draupadi rushed, there for rescuing his father in battle.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: ततोऽधिरुह्य नुकलः सुतसोमस्य तं रथम्॥ शुशुभे भरतश्रेष्ठो गिरिस्थ इव केसरी। अन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय सुषेणं समयोधयत्॥
en: Riding then the car of Sutasoma, Nakula, that hero of Bharata's race, looked beautiful like a lion upon a mountain. Then taking up another bow, he fought with Sushena.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तावुभौ शरवर्षाभ्यां समासाद्य परस्परम्। परस्परवधे यत्नं चक्रतुः सुमहारथौ॥
en: Those two great car-warriors, approaching each other and discharging arrows, tried to kill each other.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: सुषेणस्तु ततः क्रुद्धः पाण्डवं विशिखैस्त्रिभिः। सुतसोमं तु विंशत्या बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: Then Sushena, filled with rage, struck the son of Pandu with three arrows and Sutasoma with twenty in the arms and the chest.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज नकुलः परवीरहा। शरैस्तस्य दिशः सर्वाश्छादयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: At this the impetuous Nakula, O king, that slayer of hostile heroes, covered all the points of the compass with shafts.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: ततो गृहीत्वा तीक्ष्णाग्रमर्धचन्द्रं सुतेजनम्। सुवेगवन्तं चिक्षेप कर्णपुत्राय संयुगे॥
en: Then taking up a sharp and powerful arrow having a semi-circular head, Nakula shot it with great force at Karna's son in that battle.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तस्य तेन शिरः कायाजहार नृपसत्तम। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: With that arrow, O best of kings, the son of Pandu cut off from Sushena's trunk his head before all the troops. That feat was highly wonderful.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: स हतः प्रापतद् राजन् नकुलेन महात्मना। नदीवेगादिवारुग्णस्तीरजः पादपो महान्॥
en: Thus killed by the illustrious Nakula Karna's son drooped down like a tall tree on the bank of a river thrown down by the current of the river.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: कर्णपुत्रवधं दृष्ट्वा नकुलस्य च विक्रमम्। प्रदुद्राव भयात् सेना तावकी भरतर्षभ॥
en: Seeing the destruction of Karna's son and the power of Nakula, your army, O best of Bharatas, fled away in fear.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तां तु सेनां महाराज मद्रराजः प्रतापवान्। अपादयद् रणे शूरः सेनापतिररिंदमः॥
en: Their General however, the brave and valiant king of the Madras, that repressor of foes, then protected, O king, those troops in battle.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: विभीस्तस्थौ महाराज व्यवस्थाप्य च वाहिनीम्। सिंहनादं भृशं कृत्वा धनुःशब्दं च दारुणम्॥
en: Rallying his army, O king, Shalya stood fearlessly in battle sending forth leonine shouts and twanging his bow fiercely.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तावकाः समरे राजन् रक्षिता दृढधन्वना। प्रत्युद्ययुश्च तांस्ते तु समन्ताद् विगतव्यथा:॥
en: Then your soldiers O king, protected in battle by that firm bowman, cheerfully rushed against the enemy once more from all sides.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: मद्रराजं महेष्वासं परिवार्य समन्ततः। स्थिता राजन् महासेना योद्धुकामा समन्ततः॥
en: Those great warriors, encircling that great bowmen, the king of the Madras, stood, O king, desirous of fighting on every side.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: सात्यकिर्भीमसेनश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। युधिष्ठिरं पुरस्कृत्य ह्रीनिषेवमरिंदमम्॥ परिवार्य रणे वीराः सिंहनादं प्रचक्रिरे। बाणशङ्खरवांस्तीवान् श्वेडाश्च विविधा दधुः॥
en: Then Satyaki and Bhimasena and those two Pandavas, the twin sons of Madri, placing that modest chastiser of foes, Yudhishthira, at their head and surrounding him on all sides in that battle, sent up leonine roars. And those heroes also caused a loud sound of the arrows and frequently sent up war-cries.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तथैव तावकाः सर्वे मद्राधिपतिमञ्जसा । परिवार्य सुसंरब्धाः पुनयुद्धमरोचयन्॥
en: Smingly, all your warriors, enraged, quickly encompassed the king of the Madras and stood there for battle.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: ततः प्रववृते युद्ध भीरूणां भयवर्धनम्। तावकानां परेषां च मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥
en: Then took place on encounter filling the coward with fear, between your soldiers and the enemy, both of whom were bent upon meeting with death.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: यथा देवासुरं युद्धं पूर्वमासीद् विशाम्पते। अभीतानां तथा राजन् यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम्॥
en: The battle between fearless combatants resembled, O king that between the gods and the Asuras in days of yore and increased the population of Yama's kingdom.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: ततः कपिध्वजो राजन् हत्वा संशप्तकान् रणे। अभ्यद्रवत तां सेनां कौरवीं पाण्डुनन्दनः॥
en: Then the ape-emblemed son of Pandu, O king, having killed the Samsaptakas in battle, rushed against the Kauravas.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तथैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे धृष्टद्युम्नपरोगमा:। अभ्यधावन्त तां सेनां विसृजन्तः शिताशरान्॥
en: Smiling, all the Pandavas, headed by Dhrishtadyumna, proceeded against the same detachment discharging keen arrows.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: पाण्डवैरवकीर्णानां सम्मोहः समजायत। न च जजुस्त्वनीकानि दिशो वा विदिशस्तथा॥
en: Overpowered by the Pandavas, the Kaurava army were stupefied. Indeed, those divisions then could not distinguish the cardinal and the minor points of the compass.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: आपूर्यमाणा निशितैः शरैः पाण्डवचोदितैः। हतप्रवीरा विध्वस्ता वार्यमाणा समन्ततः॥ कौरव्यवध्यत चमूः पाण्डुपुत्रैर्महारथैः।
en: Covered with keen arrows shot by the Pandavas, the Kaurava ariny, deprived of its foremost warriors, were routed on all sides. Indeed, O Kauravya, your army were killed by the mighty car-warriors of the Pandavas.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: तथैव पाण्डवं सैन्यं शरै राजन् समन्ततः॥ रणेऽहन्यत पुत्रैस्ते शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: Similarly, the Pandava army, O king, were killed in hundreds and thousands in that battle by your sons on every side with their arrows.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: ते सेने भृशसंतप्ते वध्यमाने परस्परम्॥ व्याकुले समपद्येतां वर्षासु सरिताविव।
en: While the two armies, in their excitement, were thus killing each other, they became much agitated like two streams in the rains.

description: Shalya rallies his army and goes against Yudhishthira and the Pandavas. The encounter between the Nakula and Chitra Sena. The former kills the latter. Nakula slays Satyasena and Sushena
sn: आविवेश ततस्तीव्र तावकानां महद् भयम्। पाण्डवानां च राजेन्द्र तथाभूते महाहवे॥
en: During the onset of that dreadful fight, O king, a great fear possessed your warriors as also those of the Pandavas.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: संजय उवाच तस्मिन् विलुलिते सैन्ये वध्यमाने परस्परम्। द्रवमाणेषु योधेषु विद्रवत्सु च दन्तिषु॥ कूजतां स्तनतां चैव पदातीनां महाहवे। निहतेषु महाराज हयेषु बहुधा तदा॥ प्रक्षये दारुणे घोरे संहारे सर्वदेहिनाम्। नानाशस्त्रसमावाये व्यतिषक्तरथद्विपे॥ हर्षणे युद्धशौण्डानां भीरूणां भयवर्धने। गाहमानेषु योधेषु परस्परवधैषिषु॥ प्राणादाने महाघोरे वर्तमाने दुरोदरे। संग्रामे घोररूपे तु यमराष्ट्रविवर्धने॥ पाण्डवास्तावकं सैन्यं व्यदमन्निशितैः शरै। तथैव तावका योधा जघ्नुः पाण्डवसैनिकान्॥
en: Sanjaya said When the troops, killed by one another, were thus agitated, when many of the heroes took to their heels and the elephants sent up loud roars, when the infantry in that dreadful battle began to shout and cry aloud, when the horse, O king, ran in various directions, when the slaughter became dreadful, when a terrible onslaught of creatures took place, when various weapons clashed with one another, when car and elephants were mixed up, when heroes were delighted and cowards became afraid-when warriors encountered. One another in order to kill them-on that awful occasion of carnage, that increased the denizens of Yama's kingdom, the Pandavas killed your troops with keen arrows and similarly your troops slew those of the Pandavas.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: तस्मिंतथा वर्तमाने युद्धे भीरुभयावहे। पूर्वाह्ने चापि सम्प्राप्ते भास्करोदयनं प्रति॥ लब्धलक्षाः परे राजन् रक्षितास्तु महात्मना। अयोधयंस्तव बलं मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥
en: During that awe-inspiring battle, during the progress of the battle faught about the hour of sin-rise, the Pandava heroes, of good aim, protected by the high-souled Yudhishthira, fought with your forces, making death itself their goal.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: बलिभिः पाण्डवैर्दृप्तैर्लब्धलक्षैः प्रहारिभिः। कौरव्यसीदत्पृतना मृगीवाग्निसमाकुला॥
en: The Kuru army, Kuru chief, encountering the proud and powerful Pandavas skilled in striking and of sure aim, became weakened and agitated like a herd of she-deer frightened at a forest fire.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: तां दृष्ट्वा सीदती सेनां पङ्के गामिव दुर्बलाम्। उजिहीर्षुस्तदा शल्यः प्रायात् पाण्डुसुतान् प्रति॥
en: Seeing that army weakened and helpless like a cow sunk in mire, Shalya, desirous of rescuing it, proceeded against the Pandavas army.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: मद्रराजः सुसंक्रद्धो गृहीत्वा धनुरुत्तमम्। अभ्यद्रवत संग्रामे पाण्डवानाततायिनः॥
en: Enraged the king of the Madras, taking up an excellent bow, rushed for battle against the Pandavas.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: पाण्डवा अपि भूपाल समरे जितकाशिनः। मद्रराजं समासाद्य बिभिदुर्निशितैः शरैः॥
en: The Pandavas also, O king, in that battle, filled with the desire of victory, proceeded against the king of the Madras and struck him with keen arrows.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: ततः शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मद्रराजो महारथः। अर्दयामास तां सेनां धर्मराजस्य पश्यतः॥
en: The powerful king of the Madras struck that army with showers of keen arrows before the very eyes of the righteous king.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: प्रादुरासन् निमित्तानि नानारूपाण्यनेकशः। चचाल शब्दं कुर्वाणा मही चापि सपर्वता।॥
en: The Earth, with her mountains, shook, making a loud noise.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: सदण्डशूला दीप्तायाः शीर्यमाणाः समन्ततः। उल्का भूमिं दिवः पेतुराहत्य रविमण्डलम्॥
en: Meteors, keen pointed and bright like lances, dropped on Earth from the sky piercing the air.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: मृगाश्च महिषाश्चापि पक्षिणश्च विशाम्पते। अपसव्यं तदा चक्रुः सेनां ते बहुशो नृप॥
en: Large numbers of deer and buffaloes and birds, O king, passed by the left of your army.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: भृगुसूनुधरापुत्रौ शशिजेन समन्वितौ। चरमं पाण्डुपुत्राणां पुरस्तात् सर्वभूभुजाम्॥
en: The planets Venus and Mars in conjunction with Mercury, appeared at the back of the Pandavas and at the front of all the Kauravas.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: शस्त्राग्रेष्वभवज्ज्वाला नेत्राण्याहत्य वर्षती। शिरःस्वलीयन्त भृशं काकोलूकाश्च केतुषु॥
en: Blazing flames came out from the points of weapons, dazzling the eyes of the warriors. Crows and owls sat upon the heads of the combatants and on the and on the tops of their standards.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: ततस्तद्युद्धमत्युग्रमभवत् सहचारिणाम्। तथा सर्वाण्यनीकानि संनिपत्य जनाधिप॥
en: Then a fierce encounter took place between the Kauravas and the Pandavas assembled together in large bodies.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: अभ्ययुः कौरवा राजन् पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्। शल्यस्तु शरवर्षेण वर्षन्निव सहस्रदृक्॥
en: Then O king, the Kauravas, collecting all their detachments, rushed against the Pandavas.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: अभ्यवर्षत धर्मात्मा कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। भीमसेनं शरैश्चापि रुक्मपुत्रैः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Shalya, who never knew depression, then poured showers of arrows on Yudhishthira the son of Kunti, like the thousand-eyed Indra pouring rain in torrents.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: द्रौपदेयांस्तथा सर्वान् माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। धृष्टद्युम्नं च शैनेयं शिखण्डिनमथापि च॥ एकैकं दशभिर्बाणैर्विव्याध स महाबलः। ततोऽसृजद् बाणवर्षं धर्मान्ते मघवानिव॥
en: He struck Bhimasena, the five sons of Draupadi, the two sons of Madri by Pandu, Dhrishtadyumna, the grand-son of Shini, Shikhandin each with ten gold-winged arrows whetted on stone. Then he, the great powerful wounded every one by ten arrows. Indeed, he began to discharge his arrows like Indra pouring rain at the close of the summer season.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: ततः प्रभद्रका राजन् सोमकाश्च सहस्रशः। पतिताः पात्यमानाश्च दृश्यन्ते शल्यसायकैः॥
en: Then the Prabhadrakas, O king and the Somakas, where killed by thousands by Shalya's arrows.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: भ्रमराणामिव वाताः शलभानामिव व्रजाः। हादिन्य इव मेघेभ्यः शल्यस्य न्यपतशराः॥
en: The arrows of Shalya, as swarms of becs or fights of locusts, were seen to fall, like thunder bolts from the clouds.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: द्विरदास्तुरगाश्चार्ताः पत्तयो रथिनस्तथा। शल्यस्य बाणैरपतन् बभ्रमुळनदंस्तथा॥
en: Elephants and horses and foot-soldiers and car-warriors, assailed with Shalya's arrows, fell down or strayed away bewailing loudly.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: आविष्ट इव मद्रेशो मन्युना पौरुषेण च। प्राच्छादयदरीन् संख्ये कालसृष्ट इवान्तकः॥ विनर्दमानो मद्रेशो मेघह्रादो महाबलः।
en: Beside himself with rage the ruler of the Madras covered his foes in that battle like the Destroyer at the end of the cycle.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: सा वध्यमाना शल्येन पाण्डवानामनीकिनी॥ अजातशत्रु कौन्तेयमभ्यधावद् युधिष्ठिरमा।
en: The Pandava army, thus killed by Shalya, ran towards Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: तां सम्पर्य ततः संख्ये लघुहस्तः शितैः शरैः॥ बाणवर्षेण महता युधिष्ठिरमताडयत्।
en: Light-handed Shalya, having in that battle struck them with whetted arrows, began to assail Yudhishthira with a down-pour of arrows.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: तमापतन्तं पत्त्यश्वैः क्रुद्धो राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥ अवारयच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्महाद्विपमिवाङ्कुशैः।
en: Beholding Shalya rushing towards him with horse and foot, king Yudhishthira, worked up with wrath, checked him with sharp arrows, even as an infuriate elephant is checked with iron-hooks.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: तस्य शल्यः शरं घोरं मुमोचासीविषोपमम्॥ स निर्भिद्य महात्मानं वेगेनाभ्यपतच गाम्।
en: Then Shalya shot a dreadful arrow at Yudhishthira that resembled a a snake of dreadful venom. Piercing through the highsouled son of Kunti, that arrow quickly dropped down the Earth.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: ततो वृकोदरः क्रुद्धः शल्यं विव्याध सप्तभिः॥ पञ्चभिः सहदेवस्तु नकुलो दशभिः शरैः।
en: Then Vrikodara, enraged, pierced Shalya with seven arrows and Sahadeva pierced him with five and Nakula with ten.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: द्रौपदेयाश्च शत्रुघ्नं शूरमार्तायनिं शरैः॥ अभ्यवर्षन् महाराज मेघा इव महीधरम्।
en: The five sons of Draupadi poured upon that heroic and impetuous Artayani, showers of arrows like clouds pouring rain upon a mountain.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: ततो दृष्ट्वा वार्यमाणं शल्यं पार्थैः समन्ततः॥ कृतवर्मा कृपश्चैव संक्रुद्धावभ्यधावताम्।
en: Beholding Shalya struck by the Parthas on every side, both Kritavarman and Kripa proceeded in anger there.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: उलूकश्च महावीर्यः शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥ समागम्याथ शनकैरश्वत्थामा महाबलः। तव पुत्राश्च कात्स्येन जुगुपुः शल्यमाहवे॥
en: The generally energetic Uluka, Shakuni, the son of Subala and the great car-warrior Ashvatthaman smiling and all your sons protected Shalya every way in that battle.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: भीमसेनं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा कृतवर्मा शिलीमुखैः। बाणवर्षेण महता क्रुद्धरूपमवारयत्॥
en: Piercing Bhimasena with three arrows Kritavarman, discharging a mass of arrows, checked that warrior who was as if the personification of wrath.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नं ततः क्रुद्धो बाणवधैरपीडयत्। द्रौपदेयांश्च शकुनिर्यमौ च द्रौणिरभ्ययात्॥
en: Excited with anger, Kripa struck Dhrishtadyumna with numberless arrows. Shakuni rushed against the sons of Draupadi and Ashvathaman against the twins.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: दुर्योधनो युधां श्रेष्ठ आहवे केशवार्जुनौ। समभ्ययादुग्रतेजाः शरैश्चाप्यहनद् बली॥
en: That foremost of warriors, the energetic Duryodhana, rushed in that battle, against Keshava and Arjuna and struck them both with many arrows.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: एवं द्वन्द्वशतान्यासंस्त्वदीयानां परैः सह। घोररूपाणि चित्राणि तत्र तत्र विशाम्पते॥
en: Thus hundreds of dreadful encounters, O king, took place between your ariny and the enemy, on the various parts of the field.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: ऋक्षवर्णाञ्जघानाश्वान् भोजो भीमस्य संयुगे। सोऽवतीर्य रथोपस्थाद्धताश्वात् पाण्डुनन्दनः॥ कालो दण्डमिवोद्यम्य गदापाणिरयुध्यत।
en: The chief of the Bhojas then killed he brown horses of Bhimasena's car in that encounter. The son of Pandu, deprived of his horses, alighting from his car, began to fight with his mace, like the Destroyer himself with his uplifted bludgeon.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: प्रमुखे सहदेवस्य जघानाश्वान् स मद्रराट्॥ ततः शल्यस्य तनयं सहदेवोऽसिनावधीत्।
en: The king of the Madras then killed the horses of Sahadeva before his eyes and then Sahadeva killed Shalya's son with his sword.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: गौतमः पुनराचार्यो धृष्टद्युम्नमयोधयत्॥ असम्भ्रान्तमसम्भ्रान्तो यत्नवान् यत्नवत्तरम्।
en: The preceptor Gautama again fought with Dhristadyumna, both trying their level best.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: द्रौपदेयांस्तथा वीरानैकैकं दशभिः शरैः॥ अविद्ध्यदाचार्यसुतो नातिक्रुद्धो हसन्निव।
en: The preceptor's son Ashvatthama, not excited with anger and as if smiling in that battle, struck each of the five heroic sons of Draupadi with ten arrows.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: पुनश्च भीमसेनस्य जघानाश्वांस्तथाऽऽहवे॥ सोऽवतीर्य रथातूर्णं हताश्वः पाण्डुनन्दनः।, कालो दण्डमिवोद्यम्य गदां क्रुद्धो महाबलः॥ पोथयामास तुरगान् रथं च कृतवर्मणः। कृतवर्मा त्ववप्लुत्य रथात् तस्मादपाक्रमात्॥
en: Again the horses of Bhimasena were killed in that battle. He then quickly got down from his car, took up his mace like the Destroyer his rod in anger and crushed the horses of Kritavarman's car, Jumping down from his chariot Kritavarman fled away.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: शल्योऽपि राजन् संक्रुद्धो निघ्नन् सोमकपाण्डवान्। पुनरेव शितैर्बाणैयुधिष्ठिरमपीडयत्॥
en: Shalya also excited with anger, O king, killed many Somakas and Pandavas and once more assailed Yudhishthira with many sharp arrows.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: तस्य भीमो रणे क्रुद्धः संदश्य दशनच्छदम्। विनाशायाभिसंधाय गजामादाय वीर्यवान्॥
en: Then biting his lips and beside himself with range, the valiant Bhima took up his mace in that battle and aimed it at Shalya for killing him.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: यमदण्डप्रतीकाशां कालरात्रिमिवोद्यताम्। गजवाजिमनुष्याणां देहान्तकरणीमपि॥
en: It resembled the very rod of Yama, in the death-night and was destructive of the lives of elephants and horses and human beings.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तामुल्कां प्रज्वलितामिव। शैक्यां व्यालीमिवात्युग्रां वज्रकल्पामयोमयीम्॥
en: It was coated with a cloth of gold, looked like a burning meteor, furnished with a sling, was fierce as a she-snake, hard as thunder and made entirely of iron.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: चन्दनागुरुपङ्काक्तां प्रमदामीप्सितामिव। वसामेदोपदिग्धाङ्गी जिह्वां वैवस्वतीमिव॥
en: It was smeared with sandal-paste and other unguents like a desirable lady, pasted with marrow and fat and blood and reseinbled the very tongue of Yama.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: पटुघण्टाशतरवां वासवीमशनीमिव। निर्मुक्ताशीविषाकारां पृक्तां गजमदैरपि॥
en: It produced sounds on account of the bells attached to it, like unto the thunder of Indra. It resembled in shape a dreadful serpent that had just cast off its slough, soaked with the temporal juice of elephants.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: त्रासनी सर्वभूतानां स्वसैन्यपरिहर्षिणीम्। मनष्यलोके विख्यातां गिरिशृङ्गविदारणीम्॥
en: It inspired the enemies with terror and the friends with joy. It was celebrated in the world and capable or riving mountain summits.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: यया कैलासभवने महेश्वरसखं वली। आह्वयामास युद्धाय भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: With this mace, the powerful son of Kunti had, in Kailasa, challenged the enraged Lord of Alaka, the friend of Maheshvara.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: यया मायामयान् दृप्तान् सुबहून् धनदालये। जघान गुह्यकान् क्रुद्धो नदन् पार्थो महाबलः॥ निवार्यमाणो बहुभिद्रौपद्याः प्रियमास्थितः।
en: With this weapon Bhima, though resisted by many, had in anger killed a large number of proud Guhyakas endued with powers of illusion on the mount Gandhamadana for the sake of procuring Mandara flowers for Draupadi.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: तां वज्रमणिरत्नौघकल्मषां वज्रगौरवाम्॥ समुद्यम्य महाबाहुः शल्यमभ्यपतद् रणे।
en: Taking up that mace which was set with diamonds and other gems, eight-sided and celebrated as Indra's thunder-the mightyarmed son of Pandu now ruslied against Shalya.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: गदया युद्धकुशलस्तया दारुणनादया॥ पोथयामास शल्यस्य चतुरोऽश्वान् महाजवान्।
en: With that mace of dreadful sound Bhima, skilled in battle, crushed the four quickcoursing horses of Shalya.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: ततः शल्यो रणे क्रुद्धः पीने वक्षसि तोमरम्॥ निचखान नदन वीरो वर्म भित्वा च सोऽभ्ययात्।
en: Then heroic Shalya, worked up with wrath, in that battle, hurled a lance at the broad chest of Bhima and sent fourth a loud war-cry. That lance, cutting through the cost of mail of Pandu's son, entered into his person.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: वृकोदरस्त्वसम्भ्रान्तस्तमेवोद्धृत्य तोमरम्॥ यन्तारं मद्रराज्य निर्बिभेद ततो हृदि।
en: However taking out the weapon fearless Vrikodara struck therewith the driver of Shalya on the chest.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: स भिन्नमर्मा रुधिरं वमन् वित्रस्तमानसः॥ पपाताभिमुखो दीनो मद्रराजस्त्वपाक्रमत्।
en: Cut to the quick, the driver, vomiting blood, fell down with a trembling heart. At this the king of the Madras got down from his car and looked at Bhiina in depression.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: कृतप्रतिकृतं दृष्ट्वा शल्यो विस्मितमानसः॥ गदामाश्रित्य धर्मात्मा प्रत्यमित्रमवैक्षत।
en: Beholding his own attempt thus thwarted, Shalya was struck with wonder. Of quiescent soul, the king of the Madras took up his mace and began to eye his enemy.

description: Shalya strikes the Pandavas who in return strike him. Kritavarma and Kripa go to help Shalya. The fight between various Kuru and Pandava leaders
sn: ततः सुमनसः पार्था भीमसेनमपूजयन्। ते दृष्टा कर्म संग्रामे घोरमकिष्टकर्मणः॥
en: Beholding that terrible fear of his in battle, the Parthas joyfully worshipped Bhima of untiring energy.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: संजय उवाच पतितं प्रेक्ष्य यन्तारं शल्य: सर्वायसी गदाम्। आदाय तरसा राजंस्तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing his charioteer fallen, Shalya, O king, quickly took up his mace made entirely of iron and stood firm as a hill.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तं दीप्तमिव कालाग्निं पाशहस्तमिवान्तकम्। सशृङ्गमिव कैलासं सवज्रमिव वासवम्॥ सशूलमिव हर्यक्षं वने मत्तमिव द्विपम्। जवेनाभ्यपतद् भीम: प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्॥
en: Bhima, however, armed with his mighty mace, rushed impetuously towards Shalya who shone like the blazing Yuga fire or the Destroyer armed with the noose or the Kailasa mountain with his summit or Vasava with this thunder or Mahadeva with his thunder or Mahadeva with his trident or an infuriate elephant in the forest.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: ततः शङ्खप्रणादश्च तूर्याणां च सहस्रशः। सिंहनादश्च संजज्ञे शूराणां हर्षवर्धनः॥
en: At that time there arose the sound of thousands of conchs and trumpets and loud leonine roars increasing the joy of horses.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: प्रेक्षन्तः सर्वतस्तौ हि योधा योधमहाद्विपौ। तावकाश्चापरे चैव साधु साध्वित्यपूजयन्॥
en: The warriors of both armies, looking at those two foremost of heroes from every side, lauded them both, saying-well done! well done.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: न हि मद्राधिपादन्यो रामाद् वा यदुनन्दनात्। सोढुमुत्सहते वेगं भीमसेनस्य संयुगे॥
en: Except the ruler of the Madras or Rama, that delighter of the Yadus, there is none else that can venture to stand the impetuosity of Bhima in battle.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तथा मद्राधिरपस्यापि गदावेगं महात्मनः। सोढुमुत्सहते नान्यो योधो युधि वृकोदरात्॥
en: Similarly except Bhima there is no other warriors that can venture to stand the force of the mace of the illustrious king of the Madras in battle.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तौ वृषाविव नर्दन्तौ मण्डलानि विचेरतुः। आवर्तितौ गदाहस्तौ मद्रराजवृकोदरौ॥
en: Those two varriors Vrikodara and the king of the Madras, roaring the bulls, moved about in circles, frequently leaping up in the air.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: मण्डलावर्तमार्गेषु गदाविहरणेषु च। निर्विशेषमभूद् युद्धं तयोः पुरुषिसंहयोः॥
en: In that encounter between those two best of men, no difference was perceptible between them either in their movement or in the manner of their holding the mace.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तप्तहेममयैः शुभैर्बभूव भयवर्धिनी। अग्निज्वालैरिवाबद्धा पट्टैः शल्यस्य सा गदा॥
en: The mace of Shalya, coated with a shining cloth of gold that looked like a sheet of fire, made the on-lookers afraid.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तथैव चरतो मार्गन् मण्डलेषु महात्मनः। विद्युदभ्रप्रतीकाशा भीमस्य शुशुभे गदा॥
en: The mace of the great Bhima, as he moved about in circles, looked like lighting in the midst of the clouds.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: ताडिता मद्रराजेन भीमस्य गदया गदा। दह्यमानेव खे राजन् साऽसृजत् पावकार्चिषः॥
en: Struck by the king of Madras with his mace, the mace of Bhima, O king, sent forth scintillations of fire in the sky which was as if on fire.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तथा भीमेन शल्यस्य ताडिता गदया गदा। अङ्गारवर्षं मुमुचे तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Similarly struck by Bhima with his mace, the mace of Shalya produced a shower of burning coals.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: दन्तैरिव महानागौ शृङ्गैरिव महर्षभौ। तौत्रैरिव तदान्योन्यं गदाग्राभ्यां निजघ्नतुः॥
en: Like two huge elephants striking each other with their tusks or two huge bulls striking each other with their horns, those two heroes began to strike each other with their maces, like a pair of heroes striking each other with iron clubs.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तौ गदाभिहतैर्गात्रैः क्षणेन रुधिरोक्षितौ। प्रेक्षणीयतरावास्तां पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ॥
en: On being struck with each other's mace, they soon became bathed in blood and looked more beautiful like two blossoming Kinshukas.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: गदया मद्रराजस्य सव्यदक्षिणमाहतः। भीमसेनो महाबाहुन् चचालाचलो तथा॥
en: Struck by the king of the Madras on both his left and right, the mighty-armed Bhimasena stood firın like a mountain.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तथा भीमगदावैगैस्ताड्यमानो मुहुर्मुहुः। शल्यो न विव्यथे राजन् दन्तिनेव महागिरिः॥
en: Similarly, though struck again and again with Bhima's mace, Shalya, O king, moved not like a mountain struck by an elephant with his tusks.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: शुश्रुवे दिक्षु सर्वासु तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः। गदानिपातसंहादो वज्रयोरिव नि:स्वनः॥
en: The sound caused by the strokes of the maces of those two best of men was heard on all sides like peals of thunder.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: निवृत्य तु महावीर्यो समुच्छ्रितमहागदौ। पुनरन्तरमार्गस्थौ मण्डलानि विचेरतुः॥
en: Having stopped for a moment those two energetic warriors once more, with uplifted maces, closed each other.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: अथाभ्येत्य पदान्यष्टौ संनिपातोऽभवत् तयोः। उद्यम्य लोहदण्डाभ्यामतिमानुषकर्मणोः॥
en: Again an encounter took place between those two warriors of superhuman power, each having advanced towards the other by eight steps and each, striking the other with his uplifted iron club.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: पोथयन्तौ तदान्योन्यं मण्डलानि विचेरतुः। क्रियाविशेषं कृतिनौ दर्शयामासतुस्तदा॥
en: Then desiring to reach each other, they once more moved about in circles. Both the expert warriors began to display their superiority of skill.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: अथोद्यम्य गदे घोरे सशृङ्गाविव पर्वतौ। तावाजघ्नतुरन्योन्यं मण्डलानि विचेरतुः॥ क्रियाविशेषकृतिनौ रणभूमितलेऽचलौ।
en: Uplifting their terrible weapons, they again strucks each other like mountains striking each other with their summits at the time of an earthquake.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तौ परस्परसंरम्भाद् गदाभ्यां सुभृशसातौ॥ युगपत् पेततुर्वीरावुभाविन्द्राध्वजाविव।
en: Struck heavily with each other's mace, both of them dropped down simultaneously like a couple of poles set up for Indra's worship.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: उभयोः सेनयोर्वीरास्तदा हाहाकृतोऽभवन्॥ भृशं मर्माण्यभिहताबुभावास्तां सुविह्वलौ।
en: Threat the brave warriors of both armies, cried Oh and Alas. Cut to the quick, both of them had become exceedingly agitated.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: ततः स्वरथमारोप्य मद्राणामृषभं रणे॥ अपोवाह कृपः शल्यं तूर्णमायोधनादथ।
en: Then the powerful Kripa, taking up Shalya, that king of the Madras, on his own car, quickly took him away from the battle field.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: क्षीणवद् विह्वलत्वात् तु निमेषात् पुनरुत्थितः॥ भीमसेनो गदापाणि: समाह्वयत मद्रपम्।
en: Bhimasena, rising up, however, within the twinkling of an eye and still reeling as if drunk, challenged, with an uplifted mace, the king of the Madras.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: ततस्तु तावकाः शूरा नानाशस्त्रसमायुताः॥ नानावादित्रशब्देन पाण्डुसेनामयोधयन्।
en: Then your warriors, armed with various weapons, fought with the Pandavas, causing the blowing and beating of various musical instruments.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: भुजावुच्छ्रित्य शस्त्रं च शब्देन महता ततः॥ अभ्यद्रवन् महाराज दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः।
en: Raising up arms, taking weapons and making a loud noise, O king, your warriors, led by Duryodhana, rushed against the army of the Pandavas.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तदनीकमभिप्रेक्ष्य ततस्ते पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥ प्रययुः सिंहनादेन दुर्योधनपुरोगमान्।
en: Beholding the Kauravas the sons of Pandu, sending up leonine shouts, rushed against those Warriors led by Duryodhana.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तेषामापततां तूर्णं पुत्रस्ते भरतर्षभ॥ प्रासेन चेकितानं वै विव्याध हृदयं भृशम्।
en: Then your son, O foremost of Bharatas, aiming at Chekitana amongst them, cut him deeply with a lance in the chest.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: स पपात रथोपस्थे तव पुत्रेण ताडितः॥ रुधिरौघपरिस्किन्नः प्रविश्य विपुलं तमः।
en: Thus struck by our son, Chekitana dropped in a faint down on his car, bathed in blood.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: चेकितान् हतं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवेया महारथाः॥ असक्तमभ्यवर्षन्त शरवर्षाणि भागशः।
en: Seeing Chekitana slain, the great carwarriors among the Pandavas continually showered arrows (upon the Kauravas).

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तावकानामनीकेषु पाण्डवा जितकाशिनः॥ व्यचरन्त महाराज प्रेक्षणीयाः समन्ततः।
en: Indeed, the Pandavas, filled with the desire of victory, O king, moved about on all sides amongst your soldiers.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च सौबलश्च महारथः॥ अयोधयन् धर्मराजं मद्रराजपुरस्कृताः।
en: Kripa and Kritavarman and the powerful son of Subala, placing the king of the Madras before them, fought with king Yudhishthira.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: भारद्वाजस्य हन्तारं भूरिवीर्यपराक्रमम्॥ दुर्योधनो महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नमयोधयत्।
en: Duryodhana, O king, fought with heroic and powerful Dhrishtadyumna, the slayer of Bharadvaja's son.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: त्रिंसाहस्रास्तथा राजंस्तव पुत्रेण चोदिताः॥ अयोधयन्त विजयं द्रोणपुत्रपुरस्कृताः।
en: Three thousand cars, O king, dispatched by your son and headed by Drona's son, fought with Vijaya.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: विजये धृतसंकल्पाः समरे त्यक्तजीविताः॥ प्राविशंस्तावका राजन् हंसा इव महत् सरः।
en: All those warriors, O king, were bent upon winning victory even at the sacrifice of their lives. Indeed, O king, your warriors entered into the midst of the Pandava army like swans into a large lake.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: ततो युद्धमभूद् घोरं परस्परवधैषिणाम्॥ अन्योन्यवधसंयुक्तमन्योन्यप्रीतिवर्धनम्।
en: A fierce encounter then took place between the Kurus and the Pandavas, the combatants being worked up with the desire of killing one another and deriving great pleasure from giving and receiving blows.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तस्मिन् प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे राजन् वीरवरक्षये॥ अनिलेनेरितं घोरमुक्तस्थौ पार्थिवं रजः।
en: During the progress, O king, of that battle in which great heroes were killed a terrible dust was raised by the wind.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: श्रवणान्नामधेयानां पाण्डवानां च कीर्तनात्॥ परस्परं विजानीमो यदयुद्ध्यन्नभीतवत्।
en: From only the names we heard of the Pandava warriors) that were uttered during that battle and from those of the Kuru warriors) that were uttered by the Pandavas, we knew the heroes that fought with one another fearlessly.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तद्रजः पुरुषव्याघ्र शोणितेन प्रशामितम्॥ दिशश्च विमला जातास्तस्मिंस्तमसि नाशिते।
en: That dust, however, O foremost of men, was soon dispelled by the blood that was shed and all the points of the horizon became once more clear.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तथा प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे घोररूपे भयानके॥ तावकानां परेषां च नासीत् कश्चित् पराङ्मुखः।
en: Indeed, during that terrible and awful battle, no one, among either your warriors or those of the foc, took to his heels.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: ब्रह्मलोकपरा भूत्वा प्रार्थयन्तो जयं युधि॥ सुयुद्धेन पराक्रान्ता नराः स्वर्गमभीप्स्वः।
