en: Desirous of going to the regions of Brahman and longing for victory by fair fight, the warriors displayed their prowess worked up with the hope of heaven.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: भर्तृपिण्डविमोक्षार्थं भर्तृकार्यविनिश्चिताः॥ स्वर्गसंसक्तमनसो योधा युयुधिरे तदा।
en: For paying off the debt they owed to their masters on account of the maintenance received or bent upon achieving the objects of their friends and allies, the warriors, desirous of going to heaven, fought with one another.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: नानारूपाणि शस्त्राणि विसृजन्तो महारथाः॥ अन्योन्यमभिगर्जन्तः प्रहरन्तः परस्परम्।
en: Discharging various weapons, great carwarriors roared at the struck one another.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: हत विध्यत गृह्णीत प्रहरध्वं निकृन्तत॥ इति स्म वाचः श्रूयन्ते तव तेषां च वै बले।
en: Slay, seize, strike, cut off-these were the words that were heard in that battle, ultered by your people and those of the enemy.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: ततः शल्यो महाराज धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥ विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैर्हन्तुकामो महारथम्।
en: Then Shalya, O king, desirous of killing him, struck king Yudhishthira, a mighty carwarrior, with many sharp arrows.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तस्य पार्थो महाराज नाराचान् वै चतुर्दश॥ मर्माण्युद्दिश्य मर्मज्ञो निचखान हसन्निव।
en: Acquainted with the vital parts of the body, the son of Pritha, however, O king, struck the king of the Madras with fourteen cloth-yard shafts, aiming at the latter's vital parts.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: आवार्य पाण्डवं बाणैर्हन्तुकामो महाबलः॥ विव्याध समरे क्रुद्धो बहुभिः कङ्कपत्रिभिः।
en: Resisting the son of Pandu with his arrows the illustrious Shalya, filled with ire and desirous of killing his antagonist, struck hiin in that battle with innumerable Kanka-feathered arrows.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: अथ भूयो महाराज शरेणानतपर्वणा॥ युधिष्ठिरं समाजम्ने सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः।
en: Again, O king, he struck Yudhishthura with a straight shaft in the very presences of all the troops.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैः कङ्कबर्हिणवाजितैः। धर्मराजोऽपि संक्रुद्धो मद्रराजं महायशाः॥
en: King Yudhishthira, possessed of great renown and filled with range, cut the ruler of the Madras with many keen Kanka and peacock feathered arrows.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: चन्द्रसेनं च सप्तात्या सूतं च नवभिः शरैः॥ द्रुमसेनं चतुःषष्ट्या निजघान महारथः।
en: That nighty car-warrior then pierced Chandrasena with seventy arrows and Shalya's driver with nine and Drumasena with sixty four.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: चक्ररथे हते शल्यः पाण्डवेन महात्मना॥ निजघान ततो राजश्चेदीन् वै पञ्चविंशतिम्।
en: When the two protectors of his car-wheels were (thus) killed by the great son of Pandu, Shalya, O king, slew twenty five warriors among the Chedis.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: सात्यकिं पञ्चविशत्या भीमसेनं च पञ्चभिः॥ माद्रीपुत्रौ शतेनाजौ विव्याध निशितैः शरैः।
en: And he struck Satyaki with twenty five keen arrows and Bhimasena with seven and the two sons of Madri with a hundred, in the battle.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: एवं विचरतस्तस्य संग्रामे राजसत्तम॥ सम्प्रेषयच्छितान् पार्थः शरानाशीविषोपमान्।
en: While Shalya was thus fighting in that battle, that best of kings, the son of Pritha, shot at him many arrows that resembled snakes of virulent poison.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: ध्वजाग्रं चास्य समरे कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ प्रमुखे वर्तमानस्य भल्लेनापाहरद् रथात्।
en: With a broad-headed arrow, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, then cut off from his car the standard of his antagonist as the latter stood before him.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: पाण्डुपुत्रेण वै तस्य केतुं छिन्नं महात्मना॥ निपतन्तमपश्याम गिरिशृङ्गमिवाहतम्।
en: We saw the standard of Shalya, which was thus cut off by the son of Pandu in that great battle, drop down like a mountain summit.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: ध्वजं निपतितं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवं च व्यवस्थितम्॥ संक्रुद्धो मद्रराजोऽभूच्छरवर्षं मुमोच ह।
en: Seeing his standard fallen and observing the son of Pandu standing before him, the king of the Madras, worked up with range, shot a number of shafts.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: शल्य: सायकवर्षेण पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्॥ अभ्यवर्षदमेयात्मा क्षत्रियान् क्षत्रियर्षभः।
en: That foremost of Kshatriyas, viz., Shalya of great energy poured over the Kshatriyas in that battle dense. showers of arrows like Indra pouring torrents of rain.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: सात्यकिं भीमसेनं च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥ एकैकं पञ्चभिर्विध्वा युधिष्ठिरमपीडयत्।
en: Piercing Satyaki and Bhimasena and the twin sons of Madri by Pandu, each with five arrows, he assailed Yudhishthira greatly.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: ततो बाणमयं जालं विततं पाण्डवोरसि॥ अपश्याम महाराज मेघजालमिवोद्गतम्।
en: We then, O king, beheld a net of arrows spread before the chest of Pandu's son like a mass of risen clouds.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: तस्य शल्यो रणे क्रुद्धः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ दिशः संछादयामास प्रदिशश्च महारथः।
en: The great car-warrior Shalya, in that battle, filled with rage, covered Yudhishthira with straight shafts.

description: The fight between Shalya and Bhima. Shalya strikes Yudhishthira. The death of Chekitan
sn: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा बाणजालेन पीडितः। बभूवाद्भुतविक्रान्तो जम्भो वृत्रहणा यथा॥
en: At this, king Yudhishthira, afflicted with those arrows, felt himself deprived of his prowess, even as the Asura Jambha had become before the killer of Vritra.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: संजय उवाच पीडिते धर्मराजे तु मद्रराजेन मारिष। सात्यकिर्भीमसेनश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥
en: Sanjaya said When king Yudhishthira was thus assailed by the king of the Madras, Satyaki and Bhimasena and the two sons of Madri by Pandu, encircling Shalya with their cars, began to assail him in that battle.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: परिवार्य रथैः शल्यं पीडयामासुराहवे। तमेकं बहुभिर्दृष्ट्वा पीड्यमानं महारथैः॥ साधुवादो महाञ्जज्ञे सिद्धाश्चासन् प्रहर्षिताः। आश्चर्यमित्यभाषन्त मुनयश्चापि सङ्गताः॥
en: Beholding the helpless Shalya thus assailed by those great car-warriors loud sounds of applause were hcard and the Siddhas became filled with delight. The ascetics, assembled together, declared it wonderful.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: भीमसेनो रणे शल्यं शल्यभूतं पराक्रमे। एकेन विद्ध्वा बाणेन पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः॥
en: Then Bhimasena in that battle, having cut Shalya who had become irresistible with one arrow, next struck him with seven.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: सात्यकिश्च शतेनैनं धर्मपुत्रपरीप्सया। मद्रेश्वरमवाकीर्य सिंहनादमथानदत्॥
en: Satyaki, desirous of rescuing the son of Dharma, strucks Shalya with a hundred arrows and uttered a loud leonine roar.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: नकुलः पञ्चभिश्चैनं सहदेवश्च पञ्चभिः। विद्ध्वा तं तु पुनस्तूर्णं ततो विव्याध सप्तभिः॥
en: Nakula struck him with five arrows and Sahadeva with seven; the latter then once more struck him with as many.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: स तु शूरो रणे यत्तः पीडितस्तैर्महारथैः। विकृत्य कार्मुकं घोरं वेगनं भारसाधनम्॥ सात्यकिं पञ्चविंशत्या शल्यो विव्याध मारिष। भीमसेनं तु सप्तत्या नुकलं सप्तभिस्तथा॥
en: The heroic king of the Madras, struggling carefully in that battle, thus afflicted by those grcat car-warriors, drew a formidable and strong bow capable of imparting great force to the shafts shot from it and pierced Satyaki, with twenty-five arrows and Bhima with seventy-three and Nakula with seven.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: ततः सविशिखं चापं सहदेवस्य धन्विनः। छित्त्वा भल्लेन समरे विव्याधैनं त्रिसप्तभिः॥
en: Then cutting off with a broad-headed arrow the bow, with shaft fixed on the string, of Sahadeva, he struck Sahadeva himself in that battle, with seventy-arrows.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: सहदेवस्तु समरे मातुलं भूरिवर्चसम्। सज्यमन्यद् धनुः कृत्वाः पञ्चभिः समताडयत्॥
en: Sahadeva then, stringing another bow, pierced his maternal uncle with five arrows that resembled snakes of virulent poison or burning fire.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: शरैराशीविषाकारैर्ध्वलज्वलनसंनिभैः। सारथिं चास्य समरे शरेणानतपर्वणा॥ विव्याध भृशसंक्रुद्धस्तं वै भूयस्त्रिभिः शरैः।
en: Worked up with great ire, he then struck his antagonist's driver with a straight shaft in that battle and then Shałya himself once more with three.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: भीमसेनस्तु सप्तत्या सात्यकिर्नवभिः शरैः॥ धर्मराजस्तथा षष्ट्या गात्रे शल्यं समार्पयत्। ।
en: Then Bhimasena pierced the king of the Madras with seventy arrows and Satyaki pierced him with nine and king Yudhishthira with sixty.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: ततः शल्यो महाराज निर्विद्धस्तैर्महारथैः॥ सुस्राव रुधिरं गात्रैगैरिकं पर्वतो यथा।
en: Thus pierced, O king, by those mighty carwarriors, blood began to flow from Shalya's body, like red streams running down the breast of a mountain of red chalk.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: तांश्च सर्वान् महेष्वासान् पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः॥ विव्याध तरसा राजस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्।
en: Shalya, however, quickly struck in return each of those great bowmen with five arrows, O king. Exceedingly wonderful was this feat.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन धर्मपुत्रस्य मारिष॥ धनुश्चिच्छेद समरे सज्यं स सुमहारथः।
en: With another broad-headed arrow, that great car-warrio; then, O sire, cut off the stringed bow, of Dharma's son in that battle.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ साश्वसूतध्वजरथं शल्यं प्राच्छादयच्छरैः।
en: Taking up another bow, that great carwarrior, viz., the son of Dharma, covered Shalya, his horses and driver and standard and car, with many arrows.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: स च्छाद्यमानः समरे धर्मपुत्रस्य सायकैः॥ युधिष्ठिरमथाविध्यद् दशभिर्निशितैः शरैः।
en: Thus covered in that battle by the son of Dharma with his arrows Shalya struck the former with ten keen arrows.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: सात्यकिस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो दर्मपुत्रे शरार्दिते॥ मद्राणामधिपं शूरं शरैविव्याध पञ्चभिः।
en: Then Satyaki, enraged upon beholding the son of Dharma thus assailed with arrows, obstructed the heroic king of the Madras with clouds of arrows.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: स सात्यके प्रचिच्छेद क्षुरप्रेण महद् धनुः॥ भीमसेनमुखांस्तांश्च त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरताडयत्।
en: At this, Shalya cut off with a razor-faced arrow the terrible bow of Satyaki and cut each of the other Pandava warriors with three arrows.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: तस्य क्रुद्धो महाराज सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः॥ तोमरं प्रेषयामास स्वर्णदण्डं महाधनम्।
en: Enraged, O king, the highly powerful Salyaki then discharge at Shalya a golden lance set with many jewels and gems.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: भीमसेनोऽथ नाराचं ज्वलन्तमिव पन्नगम्॥ नकुलः समरे शक्तिं सहदेवो गदां शुभाम्। धर्मराजः शतघ्नीं च जिघासुः शल्यमाहवे॥
en: Bhimasena shot at him a cloth-yard shaft that looked like a blazing snake; Nakula discharged at him a dart, Sahadeva an excellent mace and the son of Dharina a Sataghni, all actuated by the desire of killing him.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: तानापतत एवाशु पञ्चानां वै भुजच्युतान्। वारयामास समरे शस्त्रसङ्घः स मद्रराट्॥
en: The king of the Madras, however speedily counteracted in that battle all those weapons, shot off the arms of those five warriors at him, as these proceeded towards his car.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: सात्यकिप्रहितं शल्यो भल्लैश्चिच्छेद तोमरम्। प्रहितं भीमसेनेन शरं टनकभूषणम्॥
en: With a number of broad-headed arrows Shalya cut off the lance shot by Satyaki. Endued with valour and great lightness of hand, he cut off into two pieces the gold decked arrows shot at him by Bhima.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: द्विधा चिच्छेद समरे कृतहस्तः प्रतापवान्। नकुलप्रेषितां शक्तिं हेमदण्डां भयावहाम्॥
en: He then resisted with arrows the terrible gold-handled dart, that Nakula shot at hiin and the mace also that Sahadeva had hurled.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: गदां च सहदेवेन शरौघैः समवारयत्। शराभ्यां च शतघ्नीं तां राज्ञश्चिच्छेद भारत॥ पश्यतां पाण्डुपुत्राणां सिंहनादं ननाद च। नामृष्यत्तत्र शैनेयः शत्रोविजयमाहवे॥
en: With a couple of other arrows, O Bharata, he cut off the Shataghni shot at him by the king, in the very presence of the sons of Pandu and uttered a loud leonine roar. The grandson of Shini, however, could not bear the defeat of his weapon in that battle.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय सात्यकिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। द्वाभ्यां मद्रेश्वरं विद्ध्वा सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरैः॥
en: Beside himself with age Satyaki took up another bow and cut the king of the Madras with two arrows and his driver with three.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: ततः शल्यो रणे राजन् सर्वास्तान् दशभिः शरैः। विव्याध भृशसंक्रुद्धस्तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपान्॥
en: At this, Shalya, O king, worked up with rage, deeply struck all of them with ten arrows, like persons piercing mighty elephants with sharp pointed lances.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: ते वार्यमाणाः समरे मद्रराज्ञा महारथाः। न शेकुः सम्मुखे स्थातुं तस्य शत्रुनिषूदनाः॥
en: Thus thwarted in that battle by the king of the Madras, O Bharata, those slayers of foes could not stand in front of Shalya.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा दृष्ट्वा शल्यस्य विक्रमम्। निहतान् पाण्डवान् मेने पञ्चालानथ सृञ्जयान्॥
en: Witnessing the prowess of Shalya, king Duryodhana considered the Pandavas, the Panchalas and the Srinjayas as already killed.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: ततो राजन् महाबाहुर्भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। संत्यज्य मनसा प्राणान् मद्राधिपमयोधयत्॥
en: Then, O king, the mighty-armed Bhimasena, determined to kill him, encountered the king of the Madras.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः। परिवार्य तदा शल्यं समन्ताद व्यकिरशरैः॥
en: Nakula and Sahadeva and the powerful Satyaki, encompassing Shalya, shot their arrows at him from all sides.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: स चतुर्भिर्महेष्वासैः पाण्डवानां महारथैः। वृतस्तान् योधयामास मद्राराजः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Though surrounded by those four great bowmen and powerful car-warriors of the Pandavas, the valiant king of the Madras still fought with them.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: तस्य धर्मसुतो राजन् क्षुरप्रेण महाहवे। चक्ररक्षं जघानाशु मद्रराजस्य पार्थिवः॥
en: Then, O king, the son of Dharma, in that dreadful encounter, quickly cut off with a razor-headed arrow one of the guards of Shalya's car-wheels.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: तस्मिंस्तु निहते शूरे चक्ररक्षे महारथे। मद्रराजोऽपि बलवान् सैनिकानावृणोच्छरैः॥
en: When that brave and mighty car-warrior, the protector of Shalya's car-wheel, was thus killed, Shalya enshrouded the Pandava warriors with showers of arrows.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: समावृतांस्ततस्तांस्तु राजन् वीक्ष्य स्वसैनिकान्। चिन्तयामास समरे धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ कथं नु समरे शक्यं तन्माधववचो महत्। न हि क्रुद्धो रणे राजा क्षपयेत बलं मम॥
en: Beholding his troops covered with arrows, O king, king Yudhishthira began to think Verily, how shall those weighty words of Madhava become true. I hope, the king the Madras, worked up with ire, will not destroy my army in battle.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: ततः सरथनागाश्वाः पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वज। मद्रराजं समासेदुः पीडयन्तः समन्ततः॥
en: Then the Pandavas, elder brother of Pandu, with cars and elephants and horses approached the king of the Madras and began to assail him from all sides.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: नानाशस्त्रौघबहुलां शस्त्रावृष्टिं समुद्यताम्। व्यधमत् समरे राजा महाभ्राणीव मारुतः॥
en: Like the wind scattering masses of clouds, the king of the Madras, in that battle, dispersed the shower of arrows and various other weapons.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: ततः कनकपुङ्खां तां शल्यक्षिप्तां वियद्गताम्। शरवृष्टिमपश्याम शलभानामिवायतिम्॥
en: We then saw the downpour of gold-winged arrows shot by Shalya, passing through welkin like as warm of locusts.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: ते शरा मद्रराजेन प्रेषिता रणमूर्धनि। समपतन्तः स्म दृश्यन्ते शलभानां व्रजा इव॥
en: Indeed, those arrows, discharged by the king of the Madras from the rear of the battle, were seen to fall like a flight of birds.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: मद्रराजधनुर्मुक्तैः शरैः कनकभूषणैः। निरन्तरमिवाकाशं सम्बभूव जनाधिप॥
en: With the golden shafts shot off the bow of the Madra king, the sky, O king, was so covered that there was not an inch of empty space.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: न पाण्डवानां नास्माकं तत्र किञ्चिद् व्यदृश्यत। बाणान्धकारे महति कृते तत्र महाहवे॥ मद्रराजेन बलिना लाघवाच्छरवृष्टिभिः।
en: Then a thick darkness was caused by the arrows shot by the powerful king of the Madras in that dreadful battle.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: चाल्यमानं तु तं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवानां बलार्णवम्॥ विस्मयं परमं जग्मुर्देवगन्धर्वदानवाः।
en: And when they saw the vest host of the Pandavas agitated by that hero, the gods and the Gandharvas were stricken with great wonder.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: स तु तान् सर्वतो यत्ताशरैः संछाद्य मारिप॥ धर्मराजमवच्छाद्य सिंहवद् व्यनदन्मुहुः।
en: Assailing vigorously all the Pandava heroes with his with his arrows from every side, O sire, Shalya covered king Yudhishthira and roared repeatedly like a lion.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: ते च्छन्नाः समरे तेन पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥ नाशक्नुवंस्तदा युद्धे प्रत्युद्यातुं महारथम्।
en: Thus covered by Shalya in that battle the great car-warriors of the Pandavas could not proceed against that great hero for fighting with him.

description: Satyaki, Bhima, Nakula and Sahadeva come to Yudhishthira's rescue. Bhima strikes Shalya heavily
sn: धर्मराजपुरोगास्तु भीमसेनमुखा रथाः। न जहुः समरे शूरं शल्यमाहवशोभिनम्॥
en: Those amongst thein that were led by Bhimasena and king Yudhishthira did not fly away from the brave Shalya the ornament of battle.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: संजय उवाच अर्जुनो द्रौणिना विद्धो युद्धे बहुभिरायसैः। तस्य चानुचरैः शूरैस्त्रिगर्तानां महारथैः॥ द्रौणिं विव्याध समरे त्रिभिरेव शिलीमुखैः। तथेतरान् महेष्वासान् द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां धनंजयः॥
en: Sanjaya said In the meantime Arjuna, in that battle, struck with many arrows by the son of Drona as also by the latter's followers the heroic and mighty car-warriors among the Trigartas, pierced Drona's son in return with three arrows and each of the others with two. Again, the mighty armed Dhananjaya covered his enemies with shower of arrows.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: भूयश्चैव महाराज शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्। शरकण्टकितास्ते तु तावका भरतर्षभ॥ न जहुः पार्थमासाद्य ताड्यमानाः शितैः शरैः।
en: Though struck with keen shafts and thought they looked like porcupines on account of those arrows sticking to their body still your soldiers, O foremost of Bharatas did not fly from Partha in that battle.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: अर्जुनं रथवंशेन द्रोणपुत्रपुरोगमाः॥ अयोधयन्त समरे परिवार्य महारथाः।
en: Led by Drona's son they surrounded that great car-warrior and fought with him discharging many arrows.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: तैस्तु क्षिप्ता: शरा राजन् कार्तस्वरविभूषिताः॥ अर्जुनस्य रथोपस्थं पूरयामासुरञ्जसा।
en: The gold-decked arrows, O king, shot by them, quickly filled Arjuna's car.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: तथा कृष्णौ महेष्वासौ वृषभौ सर्वधन्विनाम्॥ शरैर्वीक्ष्य विनुन्नाङ्गौ प्रहृष्टा युद्धदुर्मदाः।
en: Beholding those two great bowmen, those two foremost of all warriors, viz., the two Krishnas, covered with arrows, those invincible (Kaurava) warriors filled with joy.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: कूबरं रथचक्राणि ईषा योक्त्राणि वा विभो॥ युगं चैवानुकर्षं च शरभूतमभूत्तदा।
en: The Kubera, the wheels, the shaft, the terraces, the yoke and the Anukarsha of Arjuna's car, were covered with arrows.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: नैतादृशं दृष्टपूर्वं राजन् नैव च नस श्रुतम्॥ यादृशं तत्र पार्थस्य तावकाः सम्प्रचक्रिरे।
en: Never before, O king, had been either seen or heard the like of what your warriors then did unto Partha.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: स रथः सर्वतो भाति चित्रपुङ्खैः शितैः शरैः॥ उल्काशतैः सम्प्रदीप्तं विमानमिव भूतले।
en: That car shone with those keen arrows of beautiful wings like a celestial car, blazing with hundreds of torches dropped on the carth.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: ततोऽर्जुनो महाराज शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः॥ अवाकिरत्तां पृतनां मघो वृष्ट्येव पर्वतम्।
en: Then Arjuna, O king, covered his enemies with showers of straight arrows like a cloud pouring torrents of rain on a mountain.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: ते वध्यमानाः समरे पार्थनामाङ्कितैः शरैः॥ पार्थभूतममन्यन्त प्रेक्षमाणास्तथाविधम्।
en: Struck in that battle with arrows with Partha's name engraven on them those heroes regarded the battle field as full of Parthas.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: कोपोद्धृतशरज्वालो धनुःशब्दानिलो महान्॥ सैन्येन्धनं ददाहाशु तावकं पार्थपावकः।
en: Then the Partha-fire, having arrows for its wonderful flames and the loud twang of Gandiva for the wind that increased it, began to consume the fuel of your soldiers.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: चक्राणां पततां चापि युगानां च धरातले॥ तूणीराणां पताकानां ध्वजानां च रथैः सह। ईषाणामनुकर्षाणां त्रिवेणूनां च भारत॥ अक्षाणमथ योक्त्राणां प्रतोदानां च सर्वशः। शिरसां पततां चापि कुण्डलोष्णीषधारिणाम्॥ भुजानां च महाभाग स्कन्धानां च समन्ततः। छत्राणां व्यजनैः सार्धं मुकुटानां च राशयः॥ समदृश्यन्त पार्थस्य रथमार्गेषु भारत।
en: Then were seen along the tracks of Partha's car, O Bharata, number of broken wheels, yokes, quivers, banners, standards, with the cars themselves that bore them, of arrows, the Anukarshas, Trivenus, axles, traces and goads, heads of warriors decked with ear-rings and head-gears, arms, things in thousands of umbrellas along with fans and of diadems and crowns.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: तत: क्रुद्धस्य पार्थस्य रथमार्गे विशाम्पते॥ अगम्यरूपा पृथिवी मांसशोणितकर्दमा। भीरूणां त्रासजननी शूराणां हर्षवर्धिनी॥ बभूव भरतश्रेष्ठ रुद्रस्याक्रीडनं यथा।
en: Along the track of the angry Partha's car, the ground, covered with muddy blood, became impassable, O chief of the Bharatas, like the sporting ground of Rudra. The spectacle filled the coward with fear and the brave with joy.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: हत्वा तु समरे पार्थः सहस्रे द्वे परंतपः॥ रथानां सवरूथानां विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्।
en: Having destroyed two thousand cars with their fences, that scorcher of foes, Partha, appeared like a smokeless fire with blazing flames.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: यथा हि भगवानग्निर्जगद् दग्ध्वा चराचरम्॥ विधूमो दृश्यते राजंस्तथा पार्थो धनंजयः।
en: As the illustrious Agni blazes forth for destroying the immobile and the immobile creation so. O king, mighty car-warrior Partha looked.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: द्रौणिस्तु समरे दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवस्य पराक्रमम्॥ रथेनातिपताकेन पाण्डवं प्रत्यवारयत्।
en: Beholding the prowess of Pandu's son in that battle, the son of Drona, on his car adorned with many banners, tried to check him.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ तावुभौ धन्विनां वरौ॥ समीयतुस्तदाऽन्योन्यं परस्परवधैषिणौ।
en: Those two foremost of men both having white horses yoked to their cars quickly encountered each other, each desirous of killing the other.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: तयोरासीन्महाराज बाणवर्षं सुदारुणम्॥ जीमूतयोर्यथा वृष्टिस्तपान्ते भरतर्षभ।
en: The arrows discharged by both became exceedingly terrible and were as thick, O best of Bharatas, as the torrents of rain poured by two masses of clouds at the close of summer.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: अन्योन्यस्पर्धिनौ तौ तु शरैः सन्नतपर्वभि॥ ततक्षतुस्तदाऽन्योन्यं शृङ्गाभ्यां वृषभाविव।
en: Each challenging the other, those two warriors struck each other with straight arrows in that battle, like a couple of bulls tearing cach other with their horns.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: तयोर्युद्धं महाराज चिरं सममिवाभवत्॥ शस्त्राणां सङ्गमश्चैव घोरस्तत्राभवत् पुनः।
en: The battle between them, O king, was equally fought for a long while. The din of weapons was horrible.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: ततोऽर्जुनं द्वादशभी रुक्मपुङ्खैः सुतेजनैः॥ वासुदेवं च दशभिद्रौणिर्विव्याध भारत।
en: The son of Drona then, O Bharata, struck Arjuna with a dozen of powerful gold winged arrows and Vasudeva with ten.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: ततः प्रहर्षाद् बीभत्सुर्व्याक्षिपद् गाण्डिवं धनुः॥ मानयित्वा मुहुर्तं तु गुरुपुत्रं महाहवे।
en: Having shown for a short while some respect for the preceptor's son in that great battle, Vibhatsu then, smiling, drew his bow Gandiva with force.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे सव्यसाची परन्तपः॥ मृदुपूर्वं ततश्चैनं पुनः पुनरताडयत्।
en: Immediately the great car-warrior Savyasachin deprived his antagonist of his horses, driver and car and without the least exertion struck him with three arrows.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: हताश्वे तु रथे तिष्ठन् द्रोणपुत्रस्त्वयस्मयम्॥ मुसलं पाण्डुपुत्राय चिक्षेप परिघोपमम्।
en: Staying on that horseless car Drona's son, smiling, discharged, at the son of Pandu a heavy mallet that looked like a dreadful mace with iron spikes.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: तमापतन्तं सहसा हेमपट्टविभूषितम्॥ चिच्छेद सप्तधा वीरः पार्थः शत्रुनिबर्हणः।
en: Seeing that weapon, which was covered with cloth of gold, come towards him, the heroic Partha, that killer of foes, cut it off into seven pieces.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: स च्छिन्नं मुसलं दृष्ट्वा द्रौणिः परमकोपनः॥ आददे परिघं घोरं नगेन्द्रिशिखरोपमम्। चिक्षेप चैव पार्थाय द्रौणियुद्धविशारदः॥
en: Seeing his mallet cut off, Drona's son, in great anger, took up a terrible mace adorned with iron spikes and looking like a mountain crest. Accomplished in warfare, the son of Drona discharged it at Partha.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: तमन्तकमिव क्रुद्धं परिघं प्रेक्ष्य पाण्डवः। अर्जुनस्त्वरितो जघ्ने पञ्चभिः सायकोत्तमैः॥
en: Seeing that mace come towards him like the Destroyer himself in anger Pandu's son Arjuna quickly cut it off with five excellent arrows.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: स च्छिनः पतितो भूमौ पार्थबाणैर्महाहवे। दारयन् पृथिवीन्द्राणं मनांसीव च भारत॥
en: Cut off with Partha's shaft in that great battle, that weapon dropped down on earth, riving the hearts, as it were, O Bharata, of the inimical kings.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: ततोऽपरैस्त्रिभिर्भल्लैद्रौणिं विव्याध पाण्डवः। सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता पार्थेन सुमहात्मना॥ नाकम्पत तदा द्रौणिः पौरुषे स्वे व्यवस्थितः।
en: The son of Pandu then struck Drona's son with three other arrows. Through deeply cut by the mighty Partha, the highly powerful Drona's son, depending upon his own manliness, displayed on sign of fear or agitation.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: सुरथं च ततो राजन् भारद्वाजो महारथम्॥ अवाकिरच्छरवातैः सर्वक्षत्रस्य पश्यतः।
en: That great car-warrior, the son of Drona then, O king, covered Suratha with showers of arrows before the eyes of all the Kshatriyas.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: ततस्तु सुरथोऽप्याजौ पञ्चालानां महारथः॥ रथेन मेघघोषेण द्रौणिमेवाभ्यधावता
en: At this, Suratha, the great car-warrior among the Panchalas, in that battle, riding upon his car whose rattle was as deep as the muttering of the clouds, proceeded against the son of Drona.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: विकर्षन् वै धनुः श्रेष्ठं सर्वभारसहं दृढम्॥ ज्वलनाशीविषनिभैः शरैश्चैनमवाकिरत्।
en: Drawing his best of bows capable of standing a great strain, the Panchala hero covered Ashvatthaman with arrows resembling flames of fire or snakes of virulent position.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: सुरथन्तं ततः क्रुद्धमापतन्तं महारथम्॥ चुकोप समरे द्रौणिर्दण्डाहत इवोरगः।
en: Seeing the great car-warrior Suratha proceed towards him in anger the son of Drona was filled with range like a scorched snake.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: त्रिशिखां भृकुटीं कृत्वा सृक्किणी परिसंलहन्॥ उद्वीक्ष्य सुरथं रोषाद् धनुर्ध्यामवमृज्य च। मुमोच तीक्ष्णं नाराचं यमदण्डोपमद्युतिम्॥
en: Contracting his eye brow into three lines and licking the corners of his inouth with his tongue, he looked at Suratha in anger and then touched his bowstring and shot a keen clothyard shaft resembling the dreadful rod of Death.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: स तस्य ह्रदयं भित्त्वा प्रविवेशातिवेगितः। शक्राशनिरिवोत्सृष्टो विदार्य धरणीतलम्॥
en: Endued with great force, that shaft struck the heart of Suratha and coming out entered the Earth riving her through like the thunder-bolt of Indra hurled from the sky.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: ततः स पतितो भूमौ नाराचेन समाहतः। वज्रेण च यथा शृङ्ख पर्वतस्येव दीर्यतः॥
en: Struck with that arrow Suratha fell down on the Earth like mountain crest given with thunder.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: तस्मिन् विनिहते वीरे द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। आरुरोह रथं तूर्णं तमेव रथिनां वरः॥
en: After the fall of that hero, the valiant son of Drona, that foremost of car-warriors, speedily got upon the car of his slain enemy.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: ततः सजो महाराज द्रौणिराहवदुर्मदः। अर्जुनं योधयामास संशप्तकवृतो रणे॥
en: Then, O king, that warrior, invincible in batile, the son of Drona, well equipt with armour and weapons and helped by the Samsaptakas, fought with Arjuna.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: तत्र युद्धं महचासीदर्जुनस्य परैः सह। मध्यंदिनगते सूर्ये यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम्॥
en: At noon, that battle between one and the many, increasing the denizens of Yama's abode, became exceedingly fierce.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: तत्राश्चर्यमपश्याम दृष्ट्वा तेषां पराक्रमम्। यदेको युगपद् वीरान् समयोधयदर्जुनः॥
en: The sight was wonderful. Arjuna, alone and unsupported, fought with all his foes simultaneously.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Drona's son. The latter kills Suratha
sn: विमर्दः सुमहानासीदेकस्य बहुभिः सह। शतक्रतुर्यथा पूर्वं महत्या दैत्यसेनया॥
en: The encounter was highly terrific that took place between Arjuna and his enemies, resembling that between Indra, in days of yore and the vast army of the Asuras. The encounter was highly terrific that took place between Arjuna and his enemies, resembling that between Indra, in days of yore and the vast army of the Asuras.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: संजय उवाच दुर्योधनो महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। चक्रतुः सुमहद् युद्धं शरशक्तिसमाकुलम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Duryodhana, O king and Dhrishtadyumna, the son of Prishata, fought a dreadful fight with enough arrows and darts.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: तयोरासन् महाराज शरधारा: सहस्रशः। अम्बुदानां यथा काले जलधाराः समन्ततः॥
en: Both of them, O king shot arrows like showers of rain poured by the clouds in the rainy season.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: राजा च पार्षतं विद्ध्वा शरैः पञ्चभिराशुगैः। द्रोणहन्तारमुरेषु पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः॥
en: Having struck with five arrows the slayer of Drona, viz., Prishata's son the Kuru king again struck him with seven arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु समरे बलवान् दृढविक्रमः। सप्तत्या विशिखानां वै दुर्योधनमपीडयत्॥
en: The powerful and steady Dhrishtadyumna, in that battle, assailed Duryodhana with seventy arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: पीडितं वीक्ष्य राजानं सोदर्या भरतर्षभ। महत्या सेनया सार्धं परिवः स्म पार्षतम्॥
en: Seeing the king thus assailed, O foremost of Bharatas, his brothers, accompanied by a large force, surrounded the son of Prishata.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: स तैः परिवृतः शूर सर्वतोऽतिस्थैर्भृशम्। व्यचरत् समरे राजन् दर्शयन्नस्त्रलाघवम्॥
en: Surrounded by those great warriors on every side, the Panchala hero, O king, moved in the battle-field, displaying his quickness in the use of weapons.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: शिखण्डी कृतवर्माणं गौतमं च महारथम्। प्रभद्रकैः समायुक्तो योधयामास धन्विनौ॥
en: Helped by the Prabhadrakas, Shikhandin fought with the two Kuru bowmen, Kritavarman and the great car-warrior Kripa.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: तत्रापि सुमहद् युद्धं घोररूपं विशाम्पते। प्राणान् सन्त्यजतां युद्धे प्राणद्यूताभिदेवने॥
en: Then, O king, that battle became fierce and awful because the warriors were all bent upon sacrificing their lives.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: शल्यः सायकवर्षाणि विमुञ्चन् सर्वतोदिशम्। पाण्डवान् पीडयामास ससात्यकिवृकोदरान्॥
en: Discharging arrows on all sides Shalya assailed the Pandavas with Satyaki and Vrikodara amongst them.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: तथा तौ तु यमौ युद्धे यमतुल्यपराक्रमौ। योधयामास राजेन्द्र वीर्येणास्त्रबलेन च॥
en: O king, with patience and great strength, the king of the Madras at the same time fought with the twins Nakula and Sahadeva, each of whom was powerful like the Destroyer himself.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: शल्यसायकनुन्नानां पाण्डवानां महामृधे। त्रातारं नाभ्यगच्छन्त केचित्तत्र महारथः॥
en: The great car-warriors among the Pandavas who were wounded in that great battle with the arrows of Shalya, could not find a protector.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: ततस्तु नकुलः शूरो धर्मराजे प्रपीडते। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन मातुलं मातृनन्दनः॥
en: Seeing the just king Yudhishthira greatly assailed the heroic Nakula, the son of Madri, rushed with force against his maternal uncle.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: संछाद्य समरे शल्यं नकुलः परवीरहा। विव्याध चैनं दशभिः स्मयमानः स्तनान्तरे॥ सर्वपारसवैर्बाणैः कर्मारपरिमार्जितैः। स्वर्णपुङ्खः शिलाधौतैर्धनुर्यन्त्रप्रचोदितैः॥
en: Covering Shalya in that batile Nakula, that slayer of hostile heroes, smiling struck him in the breast with ten other arrows, made entirely of iron, polished by the smith, equipt with wings of gold whetted on stone and discharged from his bow with great force.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: शल्यस्तु पीडितस्तेन स्वस्रीयेण महात्मना। नकुलं पीडयामास पत्रिभिर्नतपर्वभिः॥
en: Assailed by his illustrious nephew, Shalya struck him in return with many straight arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भीमसेनोऽथ सात्यकिः। सहदेवश्च माद्रेयो मद्रराजमुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Then king Yudhishthira, Bhimasena, Satyaki and Sahadeva the son of Madri, all rushed against the king of the Madras.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: तानापतत एवाशु पूरयाणान् रथस्वनैः। दिशश्च विदिशश्चैव कम्पयानांश्च मेदिनीम्॥ प्रतिजग्राह समरे सेनापतिरमित्रजित्। युधिष्ठिरं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा भीमसेनं च पञ्चभिः॥
en: That vanquisher of foes, the commander of the Kuru army, received in that battle all those heroes that rushed towards him vehemently filling the cardinal and the subsidiary points of the compass with the rattle of their cars and causing the Earth to tremble.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: सात्यकिं च शतेनाजौ सहदेवं त्रिभिः शरैः। ततस्तु शसरं चापं नुकलस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Striking Yudhishthira with three arrows and Bhima with seven, Shalya pierced Satyaki with a hundred arrows in that battle and Sahadeva with three.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: मद्रेश्वरः क्षुरप्रेण तदा मारिष चिच्छेिदे। तदशीर्यत विच्छिन्नं धनुः शल्यस्य सायकैः॥
en: Then the king of the Madras, O sire, cut off, with a razor-headed arrow, the bow with arrow fixed on it of the great Nakula.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय माद्रीपुत्रो महारथः। मद्रराजरथं तूर्णं पूरयामास पत्रिभिः॥
en: Taking up another bow, Madri's son quickly covered the king of the Madras with winged arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: युधिष्ठिरस्तु मद्रेशं सहदेवश्च मारिष। दशभिर्दशभिर्बाणैरुरस्येनमविध्यताम्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira and Sahadeva, each struck the king of the Madras with ten arrows on the breast.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: भीमेसेनस्तु तं षष्ट्या सात्यकिर्दशभिः शरैः। मद्रराजमभिद्रुत्य जघ्नतुः कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥
en: Rushing at the ruler of the Madras Bhimasena and Satyaki both struck him with Kanka-feathered arrows, the former with sixty and the latter with ten.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: मद्रराजस्ततः क्रुद्धः सात्यकि नवभिः शरैः। विव्याध भूयः सप्तत्या शराणां नतपर्वणाम्॥
en: Enraged at this, the ruler of the Madras struck Satyaki with nine arrows and again with seventy straight arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: अथास्य सशरं चापं मुष्टौ चिच्छेद मारिष। हयांश्च चतुरः संख्ये प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥
en: Then O king, he cut off at the handle the bow, with arrow fixed on it, of Satyaki and then killed the four horses of the latter.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: विरथं सात्यकि कृत्वा मद्रराजो महारथः। विशिखानां शतैनैनमाजघान समन्ततः॥
en: Having made Satyaki carless, that great carwarrior, the king of the Madras, struck him with a hundred arrows from all sides.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: माद्रीपुत्रौ च संरब्धौ भीमसेनं च पाण्डव। युधिष्ठिरं च कौरव्य विव्याध दशभिः शरैः॥
en: He next struck the two angry sons of Madri and Bhimasena the son of Pandu and Yudhishthira, O Kuru chief, with ten arrows each.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम मद्रराजस्य पौरुषम्। यदेनं सहिताः पार्था नाभ्यवर्तन्त संयुगे॥
en: The prowess of the king of the Madras was highly wonderful, since the Parthas, even in a body, could not approach him in that battle.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: अथान्यं रथमास्थाय सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। पीडितान् पाण्डवान् दृष्ट्वा मद्रराजवशंगतान्॥ अभिदुद्राव वेगेन मद्राणामधिपं बलात्।
en: Riding then upon another car, the mighty and powerful Satyaki, seeing the Pandavas assailed and yielding to the king of the Madras, rushed quickly against him.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: आपतन्तं रथं तस्य शल्यः समितिशोभनः॥ प्रत्युद्ययौ रथेनैव मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम्।
en: Shalya rushed, on his car, against the car of Satyaki, like one infuriate elephant against another.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: स संनिपातस्तुमुलो बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः॥ सात्यकिश्चैव शूरस्य मद्राणामधिपस्य च। यादृशो वै पुरा वृत्तः शम्बरामरराजयोः॥
en: The encounter between Satyaki and the heroic king of the Madras, became fierce and wonderful to look at like that which had taken place in the days of yore between the Asura Shambara and Indra.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: सात्यकिः प्रेक्ष्य समरे मद्रराजमवस्थितम्। विव्याध दशभिर्बाणैस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing the king of the Madras stay before him in that battle, Satyaki struck him with ten arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: मद्रराजस्तु सुभृशं विद्धस्तेन महात्मना। सात्यकिं प्रतिविव्याध चित्रपुङः शितैः शरै॥
en: Deeply struck by that great warrior, the king of the Madras struck Satyaki in return with sharp arrows adorned with beautiful feathers.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: ततः पार्था महेष्वासाः सात्वताभिसृतं नृपम्। अभ्यवर्तन रथैस्तूर्णं मातुलं वधकाझ्या॥
en: Beholding the king of the Madras struck by Satyaki those great bowmen the Parthas, quickly rushed towards him with a view to kill him.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: तत आसीत् परामर्दस्तुमुलः शोणितोदकः। शूराणां युध्यमानानां सिंहानामिव नर्दताम्॥ तेषामासीन्महाराज व्यतिक्षेपः परस्परम्। सिंहानामामिषेप्सूनां कूजतामिव संयुगे॥
en: The encounter, between those struggling heroes marked by a great flow of blood, was highly dreadful like that which takes place between a number of roaring lions fighting for a piece of meat.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: तेषां बाणसहस्रौघैराकीर्णा वसुधाभवत्। अन्तरिक्षं च सहसा बाणभूतमभूत्तदा॥
en: With the thick downpour of arrows shot by them, the Earth was entirely covered and the sky was converted into one mass of arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: शरान्धकारं सहसा कृतं तत्र समन्ततः। अभ्रच्छायेव संजज्ञे शरैर्मुक्तैर्महात्मभिः॥
en: Indeed, with the arrows shot by those illustrious warriors a shadow, like that of the clouds was caused there.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: तत्र राजशरैर्मुक्तैर्निर्मुक्तैरिव पन्नगैः। स्वर्णपुङ्खः प्रकाशद्भिर्व्यरोचन्त दिशस्तदा।॥
en: Then, O king, with those shining and gold winged arrows shot by warriors, that resembled snakes that had just cast off their sloughs, the points of the horizon were as if ablaze.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: तत्राद्भुतं परं चक्रे शल्यः शत्रुनिबर्हणः। यदेकः समरे शूरो योधयामास वै बहून्॥
en: Shalya, that slayer of foes, performed a wonderful deed because that hero, Alone, unaided, fought with many arrows in that battle.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: मद्रराजभुजोत्सष्टैः कङ्कबर्हिणवाजितैः। सम्पतद्भिः शरैोरैरवाकीर्यत मेदिनी॥
en: The Earth was covered with the dreadful Kanka and peacock feathered arrows that fell from the hands of the king of the Madras.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and Dhrishtadyumna. The encounter between Shalya and Nakula and Satyaki
sn: तत्र शल्यरथं राजन् विचरन्तं महाहवे। अपश्याम यथापूर्वं शक्रस्यासुरसंक्षये॥
en: Then, O king, we behalf the car of Shalya moving about in that dreadful battle like the car of Shakra in days of yore on the occasion of the destruction of the Asuras.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: संजय उवाच ततः सैन्यास्तव विभो मद्रराजपुरस्कृताः। पुनरभ्यद्रवन् पार्थान् वेगेन महता रणे॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O king, your soldiers, led by Shalya, once more rushed against the Parthas in that battle with great impetuosity.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: पीडितास्तावकाः सर्वे प्रधावन्तो रणोत्कटाः। क्षणेन चैव पार्थस्ते बहुत्वात् समलोडयन्॥
en: Although assailed still those troops, who were fierce in battle, rushing against the Parthas, very soon agitated them on account of the superiority in numbers.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: ते वध्यामानाः समरे पाण्डवा नावतस्थिरे। निवार्यमाणा भीमेन पश्यतोः कृष्णयोस्तदा॥ ततो धनंजयः क्रुद्धः कृपं सह पदानुगैः। अवाकिरच्छरौघेण कृतवर्माणमेव च॥
en: Struck by the Kurus, the Pandava troops, in the very presence of the two Krishnas, could not stand in the field though checked by Bhimasena. Worked up with anger Dhananjaya covered Kripa and his followers, as also Kritavarman, with showers of arrows.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: शकुनि सहदेवस्तु सहसैन्यमवाकिरत्। नकुल: पार्श्वत: स्थित्वा मद्राराजमवैक्षत॥
en: Sahadeva checked Shakuni and his detachment. Nakula looked at the king of the Madras from his flanks.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: द्रौपदेया नरेन्द्रांश्च भूयिष्ठान् समवारयन्। द्रोणपुत्रं च पाञ्चाल्य: शिखण्डी समवारयत्॥
en: The (five) sons of Draupadi opposed numerous kings (of the Kuru army). The Panchala prince Shikhandin checked the son of Drona.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: भीमसेनस्तु राजानं गदापाणिवारयत्। शल्यं तु सह सैन्येनं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Arined with his mace, Bhimasena opposed the king. Kunti's son Yudhishthira resisted Shalya at the head of his army.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: ततः समभवत् सैन्यं संसक्तं तत्र तत्र हा तावकानां परेषां च संग्रामेष्वनिविर्तनाम्॥
en: Again an encounter took place between those pairs as they stood, among your warriors and those of the enemy, none of whom had ever retreated from fight.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तत्र पश्याम्यहं कर्म शल्यस्याति महद्रणे। यदेकः सर्वसैन्यानि पाण्डवानामयोधयत्॥
en: Shalya performed a wonderful feat because alone he fought with the whole Pandava ariny.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: व्यदृश्यत तदा शल्यो युधिष्ठिरसमीपतः। रणे चन्द्रमसोऽभ्याशे शनैश्चर इव ग्रहः॥
en: Shalya, then, as he stood near Yudhishthira in that battle, looked like the planet Saturn near the Moon.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: पीडयित्वा तु राजानं शरैगशीविषोपमैः। अभ्यधावत् पुनर्भीमं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Afflicting the king with arrows that resembled Venomous serpents Shalya proceeded against Bhima, covering him with showers of arrows.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तस्य तल्लाघवं दृष्ट्वा तथैव च कृतास्त्रताम्। अपूजयन्ननीकानि परेषां तावकानि च॥
en: Beholding the lightness of hand and mastery over weapons displayed by Shalya, both the armies spoke highly of him.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: पीड्यमानस्तु शल्येन पाण्डवा भृशविक्षताः। प्राद्रवन्त रणं हित्वा क्रोशमाने युधिष्टिरे॥
en: Assailed by Shalya, the Pandavas, exceedingly wounded, fled away, from the battle, disregarding orders of Yudhishthira to stop them.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: वध्यमानेष्वनीकेषु मद्रराजेन पाण्डवः। अमर्षवशमापन्नो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: While soldiers were thus being killed by the king of the Madras, Pandu's son king Yudhishthira was worked up with rage.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: ततः पौरुषामास्थाय मद्रराजमताडयत्। जयो वास्तु वधो वास्तु कृतबुद्धिर्महारथः॥
en: Relying upon his strength that powerful carwarrior began to assail the king of the Madras being determined upon either gaining victory or meeting with death.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: समाहूयाब्रवीत् सर्वान् भ्रातॄन् कृष्णं च माधवम्। भीष्मो द्रोणश्च कर्णश्च ये चान्ये पृथिवीक्षितः॥ कौरवार्थे पराक्रान्ताः संग्रामे निधनं गताः। यथाभागं यथोत्साहं भवन्तः कृतपौरुषाः॥
en: Summoning all his others and also Krishna he said to them— Bhishma and Drona and Karna and other kings who fought for the Kauravas, have all died in battle. You all have shown valour and courage in the tasks allotted। to you.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: भागोऽविशिष्ट एकोऽयं मम शल्यो महारथः। सोऽहमद्य युधा जेतुमाशंसे मद्रकाधिपम्॥
en: Only one portion about the great carwarrior Shalya remains, I desire to defeat that king of the Madras to-day in battle. I will now tell you my wishes about the accomplishment of that work.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तत्र यन्मानसं मह्यं तत् सर्वं निगदामि वः। चक्ररक्षाविमौ वीरौ मम माद्रवतीसुतौ॥ अजेयौ वासवेनापि समरे शूरसम्मतौ। साध्विमौ मातुलं युद्धे क्षत्रधर्मपुरस्कृतौ॥ मदर्थे प्रतियुद्ध्येतां मानाही सत्यसङ्गरौ!
en: These two heroes, viz., the two sons of Madravati will protect my wheels. They are heroes whom even Vasava himself cannot defeat. Observing the duties of a Kshatriya these two, that deserve every honour and are firm in their vows, will fight with their maternal uncle.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: मां वा शल्यो रणे हन्तां तं वाहं भद्रमस्तु वः॥ इति सत्यामिमां वाणी लोकवीरा निबोधत।
en: Either Shalya will kill me in battle or I will kill him. Blessed be you. Listen to these true words, O foremost of heroes in the world.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: योत्स्येऽहं मातुलेनाद्य क्षात्रधर्मेण पार्थिवाः॥ स्वमंशमभिसंधाय विजयायेतराय च।
en: Observing Kshatriya duties I will fight with my maternal uncle, determined to either win victory or be slain.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तस्य मेऽप्यधिकं शस्त्रं सर्वोपकरणानि च॥ संसज्जन्तु रथे क्षिप्रं शास्त्रवद् रथयोजकाः
en: Let them that furnish car quickly supply my car according to the rules of science, with all kinds of weapons and implements more than what Shalya possesses.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: शैनेयो दक्षिणं चक्रं धृष्टद्युम्नस्तथोत्तरम्॥ पृष्ठगोपो भवत्वद्य मम पार्थो धनंजयः।
en: The grandson of Shini will protect my right wheel and Dhristadyumna my left. Let Pritha's son Dhananjaya guard my rear to-day.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: पुरःसरो ममाधास्तु भीमः शस्त्रभृतां वरः॥ एवमभ्यधिकः शल्याद् भविष्यामि महामृधे।
en: And let Bhima, the foremost of warriors, fight in my front. I shall thus be superior to Shalya in the great battle that will soon take place.”

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: एवमुक्तास्तथा चक्रुस्तदा राज्ञः प्रियैषिणः॥ ततः प्रहर्षः सैन्यानां पुनरासीत् तदा मृधे।
en: Thus accosted by the king, all his wellwishers did what they were asked to do.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: पञ्चालानां सोमकानां मत्स्यानां च विशेषतः॥ प्रतिज्ञां तां तदा राजा कृत्वा मद्रेशमभ्ययात्।
en: Then the Pandava troops were again filled up with joy, especially the Panchalas, the Somakas and the Matsyas.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: ततः शङ्खांश्च भेरीश्च शतशश्चैव पुष्कलान्।॥ अवादयन्त पञ्चालाः सिंहनादांश्च नेदिरे। तेऽभ्यधावन्त संरब्धा मद्रराजं तरस्विनम्॥
en: Having made that vow, the king proceeded against the king of the Madras. The Panchalas then blew and beat numberless conchs and drums and sent up leonine roars.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: महता हर्षजेनाथ नादेन कुरुपुङ्गवाः। ह्रादेन गजघण्टानां शङ्खानां निनदेन च॥ तूर्यशब्देन महता नादयन्तश्च मेदिनीम्।
en: Endued with great activity and worked up with ire they rushed, with loud shouts of joy, against the king of the Madras, that foremost of the Kurus. And they made the earth resound with the noise of the elephant's bells and the loud sound of conchs and trumpets.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तान् प्रत्यगृह्णात् पुत्रस्ते मद्रराजश्च वीर्यवान्॥ महामेघानिव बहूशैलावस्तोदयावुभौ।
en: Then your son and the brave king of the Madras, like the rising the setting hills, received those assailants.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: शल्यस्तु समरश्लाघी धर्मराजमरिंदमम्॥ ववर्ष शरवर्षेण शम्बरं मघवा इव।
en: Bragging Shalya poured a shower of arrows of that chastiser of foes, king Yudhishthira like Indra pouring rain.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तथैव कुरुराजोऽपि प्रगृह्य रुचिरं धनुः॥ द्रोणोपदेशान् विविधान् दर्शयानो महामनाः।
en: Also, having taken up his beautiful bow, the great king of the Kurus displayed various lessons received by him from Drona.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि चित्रं लघु च सुष्ठु च॥ न चास्य विवरं कश्चिद् ददर्श चरतो रणे।
en: And beautifully, quickly and with great skill, he made successive downpours of arrows. As he moved about in battle, none could mark anything in him.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तावुभौ विविधैर्वाणैस्ततक्षाते परस्परम्॥ शार्दूलावामिषप्रेप्सू पराक्रान्ताविवाहवे।
en: The powerful Shalya and Yudhishthira wounded each other, like a couple of igers fighting for a piece of meat.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: भीमस्तु तव पुत्रेण युद्धशौण्डेन संगतः॥ पाञ्चाल्यः सात्यकिश्चैव माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। शकुनिप्रमुखान् वीरान् प्रत्यगृह्णन् समन्ततः॥
en: Bhima fought with your son, the delighter in batlle. Dhristadyumna, Satyaki and the two sons of Madri by Pandu received Shakuni and the other Kuru heroes around.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तदाऽऽसीत् तुमुलं युद्धं पुनरेव जयैषिणाम्। तावकानां परेषां च राजन् दुर्मन्त्रिते तव॥
en: On account of your vile policy, O king, there again occurred a dreadful battle between your people and those of the foe, all of whom were actuated with the desire of victory.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: दुर्योधनस्तु भीमस्य शरेणानतपर्वणा। चिच्छेदादिश्य संग्रामे ध्वजं हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: Aiming at the gold-decked standard of Bhima, Duryodhana then, with a straight arrow, cut it off in that battle.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: स किङ्किणोकजालेन महता चारुदर्शन:। पपात रुचिरः संख्ये भीमसेनस्य पश्यतः॥
en: The beautiful standard of Bhimasena, adorned with many bells, dropped down, O giver of honours.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: पुनश्चास्य धनुश्चित्रं गजराजकरोपमम्। क्षुरेण शितधारेण प्रचकर्त नराधिपः॥
en: Again the king, with a sharp razor-faced arrow, cut off the beautiful bow of Bhima resembling the trunk of an elephant.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: स च्छिन्नधन्वा तेजस्वी रथशक्त्या सुतं तव। बिभेदोरसि विक्रम्य स रथोपस्थ आविशत्॥
en: Gifted with great energy Bhima, who had been deprived of his bow, then displaying his prowess, struck on the chest of your son with a dart. Thereat your son sat down on the terrace of his car.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तस्मिन् मोहमनुप्राप्ते पुनरेव वृकोदरः। यन्तुरेव शिरः कायात् क्षुरप्रेणाहरत् तदा॥
en: When Duryodhana fainted Vrikodara, with a razor-faced arrow, cut off the head of his driver from his trunk.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: हतसूता हयास्तस्य रथमादाय भारत। व्यद्रवन्त दिशो राजन् हाहाकारस्तदाभवत्॥
en: Deprived of their driver the horses, of Duryodhana's car, ran wildly on all sides, O Bharata, dragging the car after them at which the Kurus bewailed loudly.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तमभ्यधावत् त्राणार्थं द्रोणपुत्रो महारथः। कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च पुत्रं तेऽपि पीरप्सवः॥
en: Then the great car-warrior Ashvatthaman and Kripa and Kritavarman, followed the car, with a view to save your son.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तस्मिन् विलुलिते सैन्ये त्रस्तास्तस्य पदानुगाः। गाण्डीवधन्वा विस्फार्य धनुस्यानहनच्छरैः॥
en: Thereat the troops troops were were exceedingly agitated. The followers of Duryodhana were terrified. At that time the wilder or Gandiva, drawing his bow, began to kill them with his arrows.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: युधिष्ठिरस्तु मद्रेशमभ्यधावदमर्षितः। स्वयं संनोयदन्नश्वान् दन्तवर्णान् मनोजवान्॥ तत्राश्चर्यमपश्याम कुन्तीपुत्रे युधिष्ठिरे। पुरा भूत्वा मृदुर्दान्तो यत् तदा दारुणोऽभवत्॥
en: Then filled with rage, Yudhishthira rushed against the king of the Madras, himself driving his horses white as ivory and fleet as mind. We then saw some thing wonderful in Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, for though very mild by nature he then 'ecame highly terrific.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: विवृताक्षश्च कौन्तेयो वेपमानश्च मन्युना। चिच्छेद योधान् निशितैः शरैः शतसहस्रशः॥
en: With eyes opened wide and body trembling in anger the son of Kunti killed hostile warriors in hundreds and thousands with sharp arrows.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: यां यां प्रत्युद्ययौ सेनां तां तां ज्येष्ठः स पाण्डवः। शरैरपातयद् राजन् गिरीन् वज्रेरिवौत्तमैः॥
en: Many soldiers were overthrown by him, O king, like mountain summits broken with thunder.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: साश्वसूतध्वजरथान् रथिनः पातयन् बहून्। अक्रीडदेको बलवान् पवनस्तोयदानिव॥
en: Striking down cars with steeds and drivers and standards and throwing down many carwarriors, Yudhishthira, without any help, began to sport there like a powerful wind dissipating masses of clouds.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: साश्वारोहांश्च तुरगान् पत्तींश्चैव सहस्रधा। व्यपोथयत संग्रामे क्रुद्धो रुद्रः पशूनिव॥
en: Filled with anger, he killed horses with riders and horses without riders and the infantry by thousands in that battle, like Rudra destroying living creatures at the time of the universal dissolution.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: शून्यमायोधनं कृत्वा शरवर्षेः समन्ततः। अभ्यद्रवत मद्रेशं तिष्ठ शल्येति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Having made the field empty by discharging his arrows on all sides, Yudhishthira proceeded against the king of the Madras and said-Wait, Wait.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: तस्य तचरितं दृष्ट्वा संग्रामे भीमकर्मणः। वित्रेसुस्तावकाः सर्वे शल्यस्त्वेनं समभ्ययात्॥
en: Beholding the feats of that hero of terrible deeds, all your warriors were filled with fear. Shalya, however, rushed again him.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: ततस्तौ भृशसंक्रुद्धौ प्रध्माय सलिलौद्भवौ। समाहूय तदान्योन्यं भर्त्सयन्तौ समीयतुः॥
en: Both of them, in anger, blew their respective conchs. Returning and challenging each other, each then met the other.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: शल्यस्तु शरवर्षेण पीडयामास पाण्डवम्। मद्रराजं तु कौन्तेयः शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Then Shalya enshrouded Yudhishthira with showers of arrows. Likewise the son of Kunti covered the king of the Madras with showers of arrows.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: अदृश्येता तदा राजन् कङ्कपत्रिभिराचितौ। उद्भिनरुधिरौ शूरौ मद्रराजयुधिष्ठिरौ॥ पुष्पतौ शुशुभाते वै वसन्ते किंशिकौ यथा। दीप्यमानौ महात्मानौ प्राणद्यूतेन दुर्मदौ॥
en: Then those two horses, Shalya and Yudhishthira, wounded in that battle with each others' arrows and bathed in blood, looked. Like a blossoming Salmali and a Kinshuka, Resplendent and invincible in battle, those two illustrious warriors sent up loud war-cries.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि सैन्यानि नाध्यवस्यंस्तयोर्जयम्। हत्वा मद्राधिपं पार्थो भोक्ष्यतेऽद्य वसुन्धराम्॥ शल्यो वा पाण्डवं हत्वा दद्याद् दुर्योधनाय गाम्। इतीव निश्चयो नाभूद् योधानां तत्र भारत॥
en: Beholding them both, the soldiers could not decide which of them would win. Whether the son of Pritha would enjoy the Earth, having killed the king of the Madras or, Shalya, having slain the son of Pandu, would bestow the Earth on Duryodhana, could not be decided, O Bharata, by the warriors present there.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: प्रदिक्षिणमभूत् सर्वं धर्मराजस्य युध्यतः। ततः शरशतं शल्यो मुमोचाथ युधिष्ठिरे॥ धनुश्चास्य शिताग्रेण बाणेन निरकृन्तत।
en: King Yudhishthira, in the course of that battle, placed his enemy to his right. Then Shalya shot a century of best arrows, at Yudhisthira. With another sharp arrow, he cut off the latter's bow.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय शल्यं शरशतैस्त्रिभिः॥ अविध्यत् कार्मुकं चास्य क्षुरेण निरकृन्तत।
en: Taking up another bow, Yudhishthira struck Shalya with three hundred arrows and cut off the latter's bow with a razor-faced arrow.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: अथास्य निजघानाश्वांश्चतुरो नतपर्वभिः॥ द्वाभ्यामतिसिताग्राभ्यामुभौ तत् पार्ष्णिसारथी।
en: The son of Pandu then killed the four horses of his antagonist with some straight arrows. With two other very sharp arrows he then cut off the two Parshni drivers of Shalya.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: ततोऽस्य दीप्यमानेन पीतेन निशितेन च॥ प्रमुखे वर्तमानस्य भल्लेनापाहरद् ध्वजम्। ततः प्रभग्नं तत् सैन्यं दौर्योधनमरिंदम॥
en: Then with another shining, well-tempered and sharp arrow, he cut off the standard of Shalya who stood before him. Then, O chastiser of foes, the army of Duryodhana were scattered.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: ततो मद्राधिपं द्रौणिरभ्यधावत् तथा कृतम्। आरोप्य चैनं स्वरथे त्वरमाणः प्रदुदुवे॥
en: The son of Drona, at this time, speedily proceeded towards the king of the Madras who had been reduced to that strait and quickly taking him up on his own car, fled away.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: मुहूर्तमिव तौ गत्वा नर्दमाने युधिष्ठिरे। स्मित्वा ततो मद्रपतिरन्यं स्यन्दनमास्थितः॥
en: After the two had gone for a moment, they heard Yudhishthira cry aloud. Stopping, the ruler of the Madras he then got upon another well equipi car.

description: The fight between Arjuna and Kripa and Kritavarman. Shalya alone fights with the entire Pandava army. The fight between Shalya and Yudhishthira
sn: विधिवत् कल्पितं शुभ्रं महाम्बुदनिनादिनम्। सज्जयत्रोपकरणं द्विषतां लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: That best of cars had a rattle deep as the muttering of the clouds. Well furnished with weapons and instruments and all kinds of utensils, that vehicle made the hairs of foes stand erect.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: संजय उवाच अथान्यद् धनुरादाय बलवान् वेगवत्तरम्। युधिष्ठिरं मद्रपतिर्भित्वा सिंह इवानदत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Taking up another very strong bow the king of the Madras struck Yudhishthira and roared like a lion.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततः स शववर्षेण पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्। अभ्यवर्षदमेयात्मा क्षत्रियान् क्षत्रियर्षभः॥
en: Then that best of Kshatriyas, of great cnergy, poured upon all the Kshatriyas showers of arrows even like Indra pouring rain in torrents.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: सात्यकि दशभिर्विद्ध्वा भीमसेनं त्रिभिः शरैः। सहदेव त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा युधिष्ठिरमपीडयत्॥
en: Piercing Satyaki with ten arrows and Bhima with three and Sahadeva with as many, he assailed Yudhishthira greatly.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तांस्तानन्यान् महेष्वासान् साश्वान् सरथकूबरान्। अर्दयामास विशिखैरुल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरान्॥
en: And he assailed all the other great bowmen with their horses and cars and elephants with many arrows like hunters assailing elephants with burning rods.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: कुञ्जरान् कुञ्जरारोहानश्वानश्वप्रयायिनः। रथांश्च रथिनः सार्धं जघान रथिनां वरः॥
en: That foremost of car-warriors destroyed elephants and elephant-riders, horses and horse-men and cars and car-warriors,

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: बाहूंश्चिच्छेद तरसा सायुधान् केतनानि च। चकार च महीं योधैस्तीर्णां वेदी कुशैरिव॥
en: And he cut off the arms of combatants holding weapons and the standards of cars and filled the earth with (slain) warriors like the sacrificial altar with blades of Kusha grass.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तथा तमरिसैन्यानि घ्नन्तं मृत्युमिवान्तकम्। परिवत्रु शं क्रुद्धाः पाण्डुपाञ्चालसोमकाः॥
en: Then the Pandus, the Panchalas and the Somakas, encompassed angrily that hero who was thus killing their soldiers like alldestroying Death.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तं भीमसेनश्च शिनेश्च नप्ता मात्र्याश्च पुत्रौ पुरुषप्रवीरौ। समागतं भीमबलेन राज्ञा पर्याप्तमन्योन्यमथाह्वयन्त॥
en: Bhimasena and the grandson of Shini and those two foremost of men, the two sons of Madri surrounded that hero while he was fighting with the highly powerful (Pandava) king. Ana all of them challenged him to battle.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततस्तु शूराः समरे नरेन्द्र नरेश्वरं प्राप्य युधां वरिष्ठम्। आवार्य चैनं समरे नृवीरा जघ्नुः शरैः पत्रिभिरुग्रवेगैः॥
en: Then those heroes, O king, having obtained the king of the Madras, that best of warriors in battle, opposed that first of men in that encounter and began to strike him with powerful winged arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: संरक्षितो भीमसेनेन राजा माद्रीसुताभ्यामथ माधवेन। मद्राधिपं पत्रिभिरुपवेगैः स्तनान्तरे धर्मसुतो निजघ्ने॥
en: Protected by Bhimasena and the two sons of Madri and Krishna the royal son of Dharma struck the king of the Madras on the chest with powerful winged arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततो रणे तावकानां स्थौधाः समीक्ष्य मद्राधिपतिं शरार्तम्। पार्यवः प्रवरास्ते सुसज्जा दुर्योधनस्यानुमते पुरस्तात्॥
en: Then beholding the king of the Madras greatly wounded with arrows in that battle, the car-warriors and other combatants of your army, clad in mail and armed with weapons, surrounded him on all sides at Duryodhana's behest.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततो द्रुतं मद्रजनाधिपो रणे युधिष्ठिरं सप्तभिरभ्यविद्ध्यत्। विव्याध राजंस्तुमुले महात्मा॥
en: They king of the Madras at this time quickly struck Yudhishthira with seven arrows in that battle. The great son of Pritha. O king, in return, struck his foe with nine arrows in that dreadful battle.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: आकर्णपूर्णायतसम्प्रयुक्तैः शरैस्तदा संयति तैलधौतैः। अन्योन्यमाच्छादयतां महारथौ मद्राधिपश्चापि युधिष्ठिरश्च॥
en: Those two great car-warriors, viz., Shalya and Yudhishthira, began to cover each other with arrows bathed in oil and shot off bows drawn to their ears.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततस्तु तूर्णं समरे महारथौ परस्परस्यान्तरमीक्षमाणौ। शरैर्भृशं विव्यधतुर्नपोत्तमौ महाबलौ शत्रुभिरप्रधृष्यौ॥
en: Those two best of kings, both gifted with great strength, both incapable of being defeated by foes and both foremost of car-warriors looking at each other's loop-holes, quickly and deeply struck each other's shafts.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तयोर्धनातलनिःस्वनो महान् महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यनि:स्वनः। परस्परं बाणगणैर्महात्मनोः प्रवर्षतोर्मद्रपपाण्डुवीरयोः॥
en: The loud noise of their bows, bowstrings and palms, resembled that of Indra's thunder as those great car-warriors showered upon each other innumerable arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तौ चेरतुर्व्याघ्रशिशुप्रकाशौ महावनेष्वामिषगृद्धिनाविव। विषाणिनौ नागवराविवोभौ ततक्षतुः संयति जातदो॥
en: They moved about in the field of battle like two young tigers in the deep forest fighting for a piece of meat. Elated with the pride of prowess, they wounded each other like a couple of infuriate elephants of powerful tusks.
