description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततस्तु मद्राधिपतिर्महात्मा युधिष्ठिरं भीमबलं प्रसह्या विव्याध वीरं हृदयेऽतिवेगं शरेण सूर्याग्निसमप्रभेण॥
en: Displaying his vigor, then the illustrious king of the Madras struck the heroic Yudhishthira of terrible might in the chest with an arrow effulgent like the fire or the sun.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततोऽतिविद्धोऽथ युधिष्ठिरोऽपि सुसम्प्रयुक्तेन शरेण राजन्। जघान मद्राधिपतिं महात्मा मुदं च लेभे ऋषभः कुरूणाम्॥
en: Deeply struck, O king, that best of Kurus, the illustrious Yudhishthira, then struck the king of the Madras with a well aimed arrow and was filled with joy.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततो मुहूर्तादिव पार्थिवेन्द्रो लब्ध्वा संज्ञां क्रोधसंरक्तनेत्रः। शतेन पार्थं त्वरितो जघान सहस्रनेत्रप्रतिमप्रभावः॥
en: Regaining his consciousness within a moment that foremost of kings viz., Shalya, powerful like Indra with eyes reddened in wrath, quickly struck the son of Pritha with a hundred arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: त्वरंस्ततो धर्मसुतो महात्मा शल्यस्य कोपान्नवभिः पृषत्कैः। भित्वा झुरस्तपनीयं च वर्म जघान षड्भिस्त्वपरैः पृषत्कैः॥
en: At this the illustrious son of Dharma, filled with rage, quickly struck Shalya's chest an then, without losing a moment, struck his golden mail with six arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततस्तु मद्राधिपतिः प्रकृष्टं धनुविंकृष्य व्यसृजत् पृषत्कान्। श्चिच्छेद चापं कुरुपुङ्गवस्य॥
en: Filled with joy, the 1. ing of the Madras then, drawing his bow and having discharged many arrows, at last cut off, with a pair of razorfaced shafts, the bow of his royal foe.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: नवं ततोऽन्यत् समरे प्रगृह्य राजा धनुर्घोरतरं महात्मा। शल्यं विव्याध शरैः समन्ताद् यथा महेन्द्रो नमुचिं शिताप्रैः॥
en: The illustrious Yudhishthira then, taking a new and more powerful bow in that battle, struck Shalya with many keen pointed arrows from all sides like Indra striking the Asura Namuchi.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: (मस्य राज्ञश्च युधिष्ठिरस्य। निकृत्य रोक्मे पटुवर्मणी तयो विडदारयामास भुजौ महात्मा।॥
en: Cutting off the golden coats of mail of both Bhima and king Yudhishthira with nine arrows, the illustrious Shalya then struck the arins of both of them.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततोऽपरेण ज्वलनार्कतेजसा क्षुरेण राज्ञो धनुरुन्ममाथा कृपश्च तस्यैव जघान सूतं षड्भिः शरैः सोऽभिमुखः पपात॥
en: With another razor-faced arrow effulgent like the fire of the sun, he then cut off the bow of Yudhishthira. At this time Kripa, with six arrows, killed the king's driver who fell down in front of the car.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: मद्राधिपश्चापि युधिष्ठिरस्य शरैश्चतुर्भिर्निजघान वाहान्। वाहांश्च हत्वा व्यकरोन्महात्मा योधक्षयं धर्मसुतस्य राज्ञः॥
en: The king of the Madras then killed with four arrows the four horses of Yudhishthira. Having slain the horses of the king, the great Shalya then began to kill the soldiers of the royal son of Dharma.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तथा कृते राजनि भीमसेनो मद्राधिपस्याथ ततो महात्मा। छित्त्वा धनुर्वेगवता शरेण द्वाभ्यामविध्यत् सुभृशं नरेन्द्रम्॥
en: When the (Pandava) king had been reduced to that plight, the great Bhimasena, quickly cutting off the bow of the Madra king with an arrow of great force, struck the king himself with a couple of arrows,

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तथापरेणास्य जहार यन्तुः कायाच्छिरः संहननीयमध्यात्। जधान चाश्वांश्चतुरः सुशीघ्रं तथा भृशं कुपितो भीमसेनः॥
en: With another arrow he cut off the head of Shalya's driver from his trunk the middle of which was encased in mail. Beside himself with anger, Bhimasena next killed without a moment's delay, the four horses of his enemy.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: मेकं चरन्तं समरेऽतिवेगम्। भीमः शतेन व्यकिरच्छराणां माद्रीपुत्रः सहदेवस्तथैव॥ तैः सायकैर्मोहितं वीक्ष्य शल्यं भीमः शरैरस्य चकर्त वर्म।
en: That foremost of all bowmen, viz., Bhima, then covered with a hundred arrows that hero who, gifted with great energy, was moving about alone in the field. Sahadeva, the son of Madri, did the same. Beholding Shalya stupefied with those arrows, Bhima cut off his armour with other arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: स भीमसेनेन निकृत्तवर्मा मद्राधिपश्चर्म सहस्रतारम्॥ प्रगृह्य खड्गं च रथान्महात्मा प्रस्कन्ध कुन्तीसुतमभ्यधावत्। छित्त्वा रथेषां नकुलस्य सोऽथ युधिष्ठिरं भीमबलोऽभ्यधावत्॥
en: His armour having been cut off by Bhimasena, the great king of Madras, taking up a sword and a shield adorned with a thousand stars, leaped down from his car and rushed towards the son of Kunti. Cutting off the shaft of Nakula's car, the powerful Shalya rushed towards Yudhishthira.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तं चापि राजानमथोत्पतन्तं क्रुद्धं यथैवान्तकमापतन्तम्। धृष्टद्युम्नो द्रौपदेयाः शिखण्डी शिनेश्च नप्ता सहसा परीयुः॥
en: Beholding him rushing with great force towards the king even like the Destroyer himself rushing in anger, Dhristadyumna and Sikhandin and the (five) sons of Draupadi and the grandson of Sini suddenly advanced towards him.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: अथास्य चर्माप्रतिमं न्यकृन्त भीमो महात्मा नवभिः पृषत्कैः। खड्गं च भल्लैर्निचकर्त मुष्टौ नदन् प्रहृष्टस्तव सैन्यमध्ये॥
en: Then the illustrious Bhima cut off the ten arrows the matchless shield of that hero. With another broad-headed arrow he cut off the sword also of that warrior. Filled with joy at this, he cried aloud in the midst of the army.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: स्ते पाण्डवानां प्रवरां रथौघाः। नादं च चक्रुर्भृशमुत्स्मयन्तः शङ्खांश्च दध्मुः शसिसंनिकाशान्॥
en: Beholding that feat of Bhima, all the foremost car-warriors among the Pandavas were filled with joy. Laughing aloud, they uttered terrible roars and blew their moonwhite conchs.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तेनाथ शब्देन विभीषणेन तथाभितप्तं बलमप्रधृष्यम्। कांदिग्भूतं रुधिरेणोक्षिताङ्गं विसंज्ञकल्पं च तदा विषण्णम्॥
en: At that terrible noise the army, protected by your warriors, were depressed, covered with sweat, bathed in blood, exceedingly melancholy and dispirited.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: स मद्रराजः सहसा विकीर्णो भीमाग्रगैः पाण्डवयोधमुख्यैः। युधिष्ठिरस्याभिमुखं जवेन सिंहो यथा मृगहेतोः प्रयातः॥
en: Assailed by those foremost of Pandava warriors headed by Bhimasena, the king of the Madras proceeded towards Yudhishthira, like a lion going to catch a deer.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: स धर्मराजो निहताश्वसूतः क्रोधेन दीप्तो ज्वलनप्रकाशः। दृष्ट्वा च मद्राधिपतिं स्म तूर्णं समभ्यधावत् तमरिं बलेन॥
en: Deprived of his car and horses, king Yudhishthira, looked like a blazing fire for the anger with which he was then excited. Beholding the king of the Madras before him, he rushed towards that foe with great force.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: गोविन्दवाक्यं त्वरितं विचिन्त्य दधे मतिं शल्यविनाशनाय। स धर्मराजो निहताश्वसूतो रथे तिष्ठशक्तिमेवाभ्यकाक्षत्॥
en: Recollecting the words of Govinda, he quickly set his heart on the destruction of Shalya. Indeed, king Yudhishthira, staying on his steedless and driverless car, waited to take up a dart.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तचापि शल्यस्य निशम्य कर्म महात्मनो भागमथाविशिष्टम्। कृत्वा मनः शल्यवधे महात्मा यथोक्तमिन्द्रावरजस्य चक्रे॥
en: Beholding that feat of Shalya and thinking that the person who had been allotted to him as his share was not yet killed the son of Pandu firmly made up his mind to do what Indra's younger brother had advised him to do.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: स धर्मराजो मणिहेमदण्डां जग्राह शक्तिं कनकप्रकाशाम्। नेत्रे च दीप्ते सहसा विवृत्य मद्राधिपं क्रुद्धमना निरैक्षत्॥
en: King Yudhishthira took up a dart whose handle was made of gold and set with gems and which was bright like gold. Rolling his wide open eyes, he looked at the king of Madras, his heart filled with anger.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: निरीक्षितोऽसौ नरदेव राज्ञा पूतात्मना निहतकल्मषेण। आसीन यह भस्मसान्मद्रराज स्ततद्भुतं मे प्रतिभाति राजन्॥
en: Thus looked at, O god among men, by that king of pure and sinless soul the king of the Madras was not reduced to ashes. This was indeed wonderful, O monarch.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततस्तु शक्तिं रुचिरोग्रदण्डां मणिप्रवेकोज्ज्वलितां प्रदीप्ताम्। चिक्षेप वेगात् सुभृशं महात्मा मद्राधिपाय प्रवरः कुरूणाम्॥
en: The chief of the Kurus then hurled with great force at the king of the Madras that blazing dart of beautiful and fierce handle set with gems and corals.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: दीप्तामथैनां प्रहितां बलेन सविस्फुलिङ्गां सहसा पतन्तीम्। प्रेक्षन्त सर्वे कुरवः समेता दिवो युगान्ते महतीमिवोल्काम्॥
en: All the Kauravas beheld that blazing dart sending forth scintillations of fire as it passed through the sky after having been discharged with great force, like a large meteor dropping from the sky at the end of the cycle.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तां कालरात्रीमिव पाशहस्तां यमस्य धात्रीमिव चोग्ररूपाम्। स ब्रह्मदण्डप्रतिमाममोघां ससर्ज यत्तो युधि धर्मराजः॥
en: King Yudhishthira, in that battle, carefully discharged that dart which resembled the Death-night armed with the dreadful noose or the dreadful mother of Yama himself and which like the Brahmana's curse, was of sure effect.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: रभ्यर्चिता पाण्डुसुतैः प्रयत्नात्। सांवर्तकग्निप्रतिमां ज्वलन्ती कृत्यामथर्वाङ्गिरसीमिवोग्राम्॥
en: Carefully the sons of Pandu had always worshipped that weapon with scents, garland, seats and the best food and drinks. That weapon seemed to born like the Samvartaka fire and was as dreadful as a rite performed according to the Atharvan of Angirasa.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ईशानहेतोः प्रतिनिर्मितां तां त्वष्ट्रा रिपूणामसुदेहभक्ष्याम्। भूम्यन्तरिक्षादिजलाशयानि प्रसह्य भूतानि निहन्तुमीशाम्॥
en: Made by Tashtri the celestial architect for the use of Shiva it destroyed the vital airs and the bodies of all foes. It could destroy by its force the earth, the sky and all the reservoirs of water and animals of every description.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: घण्टापताकामणिवज्रनाला वैदूर्यचित्रां तपनीयदण्डाम्। त्वष्ट्रा प्रयत्नान्नियमेन क्लृप्तां ब्रह्मद्विषामन्तकरीममोघाम्॥
en: Adorned with bells, flags, gems, diamonds, lapis lazuli and equipt with a golden handle, the celestial Architect himself had made it with great care after having practised many vows. This fatal weapon was destructive of all haters of Brahma.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: बलप्रयत्नादधिरूढवेगां मन्त्रैश्च घोरैरभिमन्त्र्य यत्नात्। ससर्ज मार्गेण च तां परेण वधाय मद्राधिपतेस्तदानीम्॥
en: Having inspired it with many mantras and impregnated it with terrible velocity by the exercise of great power and care, king Yudhishthira hurled it by the best path for the destruction of the king of the Madras.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: हतोऽसि पापेत्यभिगर्जमानो रुद्रोऽन्धकायान्तकरं यथेषुम्। प्रसार्य बाहुं सुदृढं सुपाणिं क्रोधेन नृत्यन्निव धर्मराजः॥
en: Saying in a loud voice the words-"you are killed, O wretch”-the king hurled it, even as Rudra had, in days of yore, shot his arrow for the destruction of the Asura Andhaka, extending his strong arm adorned with a beautiful hand and dancing in anger.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तां सर्वशक्त्या प्रहितां सुशक्तिं युधिष्ठिरेणाप्रतिवार्यवीर्यम्। प्रतिग्रहायाभिननर्द शल्यः सम्यग्धुतामग्निरिवाज्यधाराम्॥
en: Shalya cried aloud and tried to catch that excellent dart of great energy hurled by Yudhishthira with all his strength even as a fire laps forth for catching the clarified butter poured over it.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: मुरो विशालं च तथैव भित्त्वा। विवेश गां तोयमिवाप्रसक्ता यशो विशालं नृपतेर्दहन्ती॥
en: Cutting through his very vitals and his fair and broad chest, that dart entered the Earth as easily as it would water without the slightest obstruction and carrying away the world-wide reputation of Shalya.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: नासाक्षिकर्णास्यविनिःसृतेन प्रक्यन्दता च व्रणसम्भवेन। संसिक्तगात्रो रुधिरेण सोऽभूत् क्रौञ्चो यथा स्कन्दहतो महाद्रिः॥
en: Covered with the blood that came out of his nostrils, cyes, ears and mouth and that which flowed from his wound, he looked like the huge Krauncha mountain when it was pierced by Skanda.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: प्रसार्य वाहू च रथाद् गतो गां संछिन्नवर्मा कुरुनन्दनेन। महेन्द्रवाहप्रतिमो महात्मा वज्राहतं शृङ्गमिवाचलस्य॥
en: His armour having been cut off by Yudhishthira the illustrious Shalya, strong as Indra's elephant, stretching his arms, dropped down on the Earth, like a mountain summit clapped by a thunder-bolt.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: बाहू प्रसार्यभिमुखो धर्मराजस्य मद्रराट्। ततो निपतितो भूमाविन्द्रध्वज इवोच्छ्रितः॥ स तथा भिन्नसर्वाङ्गो रुधिरेण समुक्षितः।
en: Stretching his arms, the king of the Madras fell down on the Earth, with his face directed towards king Yudhishthira like Indra's pole dropped down on the ground.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: प्रत्युद्गत इव प्रेम्णा भूम्या स नरपुङ्गवः॥ प्रियया कान्तया कान्तः पतमान इवोरसि।
en: Like a dear wife advancing to reserve her dear husband about to fall on her breast, the Earth as if, out of affection, rose a little for receiving that best of men as he fell down with wounded limbs covered with blood.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: चिरं भुक्त्वा वसुमती प्रियां कान्तामिव प्रभुः॥ सर्वैरङ्गैः समानिश्लष्य प्रसुप्त इव चाभवत्।
en: Having enjoyed long the Earth like a dear wife, the powerful Shalya, now to sleep on the Earth's breast, embraced her.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: धर्म्य धर्मात्मना युद्धे निहतो धर्मसूनुना॥ सम्यग्घुत इव स्विष्टः प्रशान्तोऽग्निरिवाध्वरे।
en: Slain by Dharma's son in a fair fight, Shalya shone like fire lying extinguished on the sacrificial altar.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: शक्त्या विभिन्नह्रदयं विप्रविद्धायुधध्वजम्॥ संशान्तमपि मद्रेशं लक्ष्मी व विमुञ्चति।
en: Though deprived of his weapons and standard and though his heart had been cut and slain still his body was not shorn of beauty.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततो युधिष्ठिरश्चापमादायेन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम्॥ व्यधमद् द्विषतः संख्ये खगराडिव पन्नगान्। देहान् सुनिशितैर्भल्लै रिपूणां नाशयन् क्षणात्॥
en: Taking up his bow resplendent like Indra's bow then Yudhishthira began to destroy his foes in that battle like Garuda killing snakes. With the greatest speed he began to cut off the bodies of his enemies with the keen arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततः पार्थस्य बाणौघेरावृताः सैनिकास्तव। निमीलिताक्षाः क्षिण्वन्तो भृशमन्योन्यमर्दिताः॥ क्षरन्तो रुधिरं देहैर्विपन्नायुधजीविताः।
en: Your troops were entirely covered with the showers of arrows that the son of Pritha then shot. Possessed with fear and with eyes shut, they began to strike one another. With their bodies bathed in blood they were deprived of their offensive and defensive arins and divested of their vital-breaths.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततः शल्ये निपतिते मद्रराजानुजो युवा॥ भ्रातुस्तुल्यो गणैः सर्वै रथी पाण्डवमभ्ययात्।
en: Upon the fall of Shalya, the youthful younger brother of the king of the Madras who equal his brother in every accomplishment and who was a great carwarrior, proceeded against Yudhishthira.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: विव्याध च नरश्रेष्ठो नाराचैर्बहुभिस्त्वरन्॥ हतस्यापचितिं भ्रातुश्चिकीर्षुर्युद्धदुर्मदः।
en: Invincible in battle and desirous of satisfying the last dues of his brother, that foremost of men struck speedily the Pandava with many arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तं विव्याधशुगैः षड्भिर्धर्मराजस्त्वरनिव॥ कार्मुकं चास्य चिच्छेद क्षुराभ्यां ध्वजमेव च।
en: King Yudhishthira immediately struck him with six arrows. He then cut off the bow and the standard of his antagonist with two razorfaced arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततोऽस्य दीप्यमानेन सुदृढेन शितेन च॥ प्रमुखे वर्तमानस्य भल्लेनापाहरच्छिरः।
en: Then with a blazing and keen arrow of great power and broad heat, he cut off the head of his foe who stood before him. was to

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: सकुण्डलं तद् ददृशे पतमानं शिरो रथात्॥ पुण्यक्षयमनुप्राप्य पतन् स्वर्गादिव च्युतः।
en: That head adorned with ear-rings was seen to fall down from the car like a denizen of heaven falling down on the exhaustion of his virtues.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तस्यापकृत्तशीर्षं तु शरीरं पतितं रथात्॥ रुधिरेणावसिक्ताङ्गं दृष्ट्वा सैन्यमभज्यत।
en: Beholding his headless trunk, bathed in blood, fallen down from his car, the Kaurava troops were dispersed.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: विचित्रकवचे तस्मिन् हते मद्रनृपानुजे॥ हाहाकारं प्रकुर्वाणाः कुरवोऽभिप्रदुद्रुवः।
en: Indeed, upon the destruction of the younger brother of the Madras clad in beautiful armour, the Kurus bewailed and fled away quickly.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: शल्यानुजं हतं दृष्ट्वा तावकास्त्यक्तजीविताः॥ वित्रेसुः पाण्डवभयाद् रजोध्वस्तास्तदा भृशम्।
en: Beholding Shalya's younger brother killed your troops, hopeless of their lives; were pursued by the fear of the Pandavas and fled, coated with dust.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तांस्तथा भज्यमानांस्तु कौरवान् भरतर्षभ॥ शिनेर्नप्ता किरन् बाणैरभ्यवर्तत सात्यकिः।
en: Then Shini's grandson Satyaki, O foremost of Bharatas, shooting his arrows, proceeded against the frightened Kauravas in the course of their fight.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तमायान्तं महेष्वासं दुष्प्रसह्य दुरासदम्॥ हार्दिक्यस्तवरितो राजन् प्रत्यगृह्णादभीतवत्।
en: The Hridika's son, O king, quickly and fearlessly opposed that invincible warrior, that irresistible and powerful bowman, as he proceeded against them.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तौ समेतौ महात्मानौ वार्ष्णेयौ वरवाजिनौ॥ हार्दिक्यः सात्यकिश्चैव सिंहाविव बलोत्कटौ।
en: Those two illustrious and invincible Vrishni heroes, Hridika's son and Satyaki, encountered each other like two enraged lions.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: इषुभिर्विमलाभासैश्छादयन्तौ परस्परम्॥ अर्चिभिरिव सूर्यस्व दिवाकरसमप्रभौ।
en: Both effulgent like the sun, they covered each other with burning arrows resplendent like the rays of the sun.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: चापमार्गबलोद्धतान् मार्गणान् वृष्णिसिंहयोः॥ आकाशगानपश्याम पतङ्गानिव शीघ्रगान्।
en: The arrows of those two Vrishni chiefs, shot off their bows, appeared like swiftlycoursing insects in the sky.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: सात्यकि दशभिविद्ध्वा हयांश्चास्य त्रिभिः शरैः॥७४ चापमेकेन चिच्छेद हार्दिक्यो नतपर्वणा।
en: Piercing Satyaki with ten arrows and his horses with three, the son of Hridika cut off his bow with a straight arrow.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तन्निकृत्तं धनुः श्रेष्ठमपास्य शिनिपुङ्गवः॥ अन्यदादत्त वेगेन वेगवत्तरमायुधम्।
en: Casting off his bow which was thus cut off, that heroe, quickly took up another that was stronger than the first.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तदादाय धनुः श्रेष्ठं वरिष्ठः सर्वधन्विनाम्॥ हार्दिक्यं दशभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे।
en: Having taken up that best of bows, that first of bowmen struck the son of Hridika with ten arrows on the chest.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततो रथं युगेषां च च्छित्त्वा भल्लैः सुसंयतैः॥ अश्वांस्तस्यावधीत् तूर्णमूभौ च पार्ष्णिसारथी।
en: Then cutting off his car and the shaft of that car with many well-aimed arrows, Satyaki quickly killed the horses of his antagonist and his two Parshni drivers.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततस्तं विरथं दृष्ट्वा कृपः शारद्वतः प्रभो॥ अपोवाह ततः क्षिप्रं रथमारोप्य वीर्यवान्।
en: O Lord, Saradvat, seeing Hridika's son made carless, the valiant Kripa then, the son Saradvat of speedily carried him away, on his car.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: मद्रराजे हते राजन् विरथे कृतवर्मणि॥ दुर्योधनबलं सर्वं पुनरासीत् पराङ्मुखम्।
en: The king of the Madras being slain and upon Kritavarma having been made carless, the entire arıny of Duryodhana fled away from the battle field.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तत् परे नान्वबुध्यन्त सैन्येन रजसा वृते॥ बलं तु हतभूयिष्ठं तत् तदाऽऽसीत् पराङ्मुखम्।
en: At this time the army was covered with a cloud of dust. We could not perceive anything. The major portion, however, of your army were killed. They, who remained alive, took to their heels from the battle-field.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततो मुहूर्तात् तेऽपश्यन् रजो भीमं समुत्थितम्॥ विविधैः शोणितस्रावैः प्रशान्तं पुरुषर्षभ।
en: Soon it was seen that the cloud of dust was suppressed, O foremost of men, on account of the streams of blood that flowed on all sides.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततो दुर्योधनो दृष्ट्वा भग्नं स्वबलमन्तिकात्॥ जवेनापततः पार्थानेकः सर्वानवारयत्।
en: Then seeing his army routed Duryodhana, alone, resisted all the Parthas advancing furiously.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: पाण्डवान् सरथान् दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नं च पार्षतम्॥ आनर्तं च दुराधर्षं शितैर्बाणैरवारयत्। तं परे नाभ्यवर्तन्त मा मृत्युमिवागतम्॥
en: Beholding the Pandavas on their cars as also Dhrishtadyumna the son of Prishata and the invincible Satyaki, the Kuru king struck them with sharp arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: अथान्यं रथमास्थाय हार्दिक्योऽपि न्यवर्तत। ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा त्वरमाणो महारथः॥
en: The enemy (at that time) could not approach him, like mortals fearing to approach the Death standing before thein. Meanwhile the son of Hridika, riding upon another car, advanced there.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: चतुर्भिनिजघानाश्वान् पत्रिभिः कृतवर्मणः। विव्याध गौतमं चापि षड्भिर्भल्लैः सुतेजनैः॥
en: The great car-warrior Yudhishthira then quickly killed the four horses of Kritavarman with four arrows and struck the son of Gotama with six broad-headed powerful arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: अश्वत्थामा ततो राज्ञा हताश्वं विरथीकृतम्। तमपोवाह हार्दिक्यं स्वरथेन युधिष्ठिरात्॥
en: Then Ashvatthaman, taking upon his car, the son of Hridika who had been deprived of his horses by the (Pandava) king, took him away from Yudhishthira's presence.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: ततः शारद्वतः षड्भिः प्रत्यविद्ध्यद् युधिष्ठिरम्। विव्याध चाश्वान्निशितैस्तस्याष्टाभिः शिलीमुखैः॥
en: The son of Sharadvata struck Yudhishthira in return with eight arrows and his horses also with cight keen arrows.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: एवमेतन्महाराज युद्धशेषमवर्तत। तव दुर्मत्रिते राजन् सह पुत्रस्य भारत॥
en: Thus, O king, the battle raged on all sides on account of the evil policy of yourself and your soni, O Bharata.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: तस्मिन् महेष्वासधरे विशस्ते संग्राममध्ये कुरुपुङ्गवेन। पार्थाः समेताः परमप्रहृष्टाः शङ्खान् प्रदधुमुर्हतमीक्ष्य शल्यम्॥
en: After the destruction of that foremost of bow men on the field of battle by that foremost of Kuru's race, the Parthas, beholding Shalya slain, in a body filled with great joy, blew their conchs.

description: The encounter between Shalya and Yudhishthira. The latter kills Shalya
sn: युधिष्ठिरं च प्रशशंसुराजौ पुरा कृते वृत्रवधे यथेन्द्रम्। चक्रुश्च नानाविधवाद्यशब्दान् निनादयन्तो वसुधा समेताः॥
en: And all of them praised Yudhishthira in that battle, even as the celestials, in days of yore, had praised Indra after the destruction of Vritra. And they beat and blew various kinds of musical instruments, making the Earth resound on all sides.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: संजय उवाच शल्येऽथ निहते राजन् मद्रराजपदानुगाः। रथाः सप्तशता वीरो निर्ययुर्महतो बलात्॥
en: Sanjaya said After the destruction of Shalya, O king, the followers of the Madra king, numbering seventeen hundred brave car-warriors, proceeded for battle with great force.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: दुर्योधनस्तु द्विरदमारुद्याचलसंनिभम्। छत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन वीज्यमानश्च चामरैः॥ ते न गन्तव्यं न गन्तव्यमिति मद्रानवारयत्।
en: Duryodhana, riding upon a huge mountainlike elephant with an umbrella held over his head and fanned with white chowries, forbade the Madraka warriors, saying "Do not proceed, Do not proceed!”

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: दुर्योधनेन ते वीरा वार्यमाणाः पुनः पुनः॥ युधिष्ठिरं जिघांसन्तः पाण्डूना प्राविशन् बलम्।
en: Though repeatedly forbidden by Duryodhana, those heroes, desirous of killing Yudhishthira, entered into the Pandava army.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: तु शूरा महाराज कृतचित्ताश्च योधने।॥ धनुःशब्दं महत् कृत्वा सहायुध्यन्त पाण्डवैः।
en: Those brave warriors, O king, loyal to Duryodhana, twanging their bows loudly fought with the Pandavas.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: श्रुत्वा च निहतं शल्यं धर्मपुत्रं च पीडितम्॥ मद्रराजप्रिये युक्तैर्मद्रकाणां महारथैः। आजगाम ततः पार्थो गाण्डीवं विक्षिपन् धनुः॥ पूरयन् रथघोषेण दिश: सर्वा महारथः।
en: In the meantime hearing that Shalya had been killed and that Yudhishthira had been assailed by the mighty car-warriors of the Madrakas devoted to the well-being of the Madraka king, the great car-warrior Partha came there, stretching his bow Gandiva and filling the Earth with the rattle of his car.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: ततोऽर्जुनश्च भीमश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥ सात्यकिश्च नरव्याघ्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः। धृष्टद्युम्नः शिखण्डी च पञ्चाला: सह सोमकैः॥ युधिष्ठिरं परीप्सन्तः समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्।
en: Then Arjuna, Bhima and the two sons of Madri by Pandu and that foremost of men, Satyaki and the (five) sons of Draupadi and Dhrishtadyumna and Sikhandin and the Panchalas and the Somakas, desirous of rescuing Yudhishthira, encircled him on all sides.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: ते समन्तान् परिवृताः पाण्डवाः पुरुषर्षभाः॥ क्षोभयन्ति स्म तां सेनां मकरा: सागरं यथा। वृक्षानिव महावता: कम्पयन्ति स्म तावकान्॥
en: Having taken their positions round the king, the Pandavas, those foremost of men, began te) agitate the enemy's army like Makaras agitating the ocean. Indecd, they made your army tremble like a mighty tempest shaking the trees.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: पुरोवातेन गड्डेव क्षोभ्यमाणाः महानदी। अक्षोभ्यत तदा राजन् पाण्डूनां ध्वजिनी ततः॥
en: Like the great river Ganges agitated by a hostile wind, the Pandava army, O king, once more were exceedingly agitated,

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: प्रस्कन्ध सेना महतीं महात्मानो महारथाः। बहवशुक्रुशुस्तत्र क स राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Making that powerful army tremble, the illustrious and mighty car-warriors (viz., the Madrakas), all shouted loudly, saying-"Where is that king Yudhishthira?”

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: भ्रातरो वास्य ते शूरा दृश्यन्ते नेह केन च। धृष्टद्युम्नोऽथ शैनेयो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः॥ पाञ्चालाश्च महावीर्याः शिखण्डी च महारथः।
en: Why are not his valiant brothers, viz., the Pandavas, to be seen here? What has become of the highly energetic as also of the great carwarriors Sikhandin? Where are Dhrishtadyumna and the grandson of Sini and those great car-warriros, viz., the (five sons of Draupadi)!

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: एवं तान् वादिनः शूरान् द्रौपदेया महारथाः॥ अभ्यघ्नन् युयुधानश्च मद्रराजपदानुगान्। चक्रैर्विमथितैः केचित् केचिच्छिन्नैर्महाध्वजैः॥ ते दृश्यन्तेऽपि समरे तावका निहताः परैः।
en: Thereat those great car-warriors, viz., the sons of Draupadi, began to kill the followers of the Madra king who were uttering those words i and fighting vigorously. In that battle, some, amongst your troops, where crushed by carwheels and some slain by huge standards.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: आलोक्य पाण्डवान् युद्धे योधा राजन् समन्ततः॥ वार्यमाणा ययुर्वेगात् पुत्रेण तव भारत।
en: Beholding, however, the heroic Pandavas, the brave warriors of your army, O Bharata, though forbidden by your son, still proceeded against them.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: दुर्योधनश्च तान् वीरान् वारयामास सान्त्वयन्॥ न चास्य शासनं केचित्तत्र चक्रुर्महारथाः।
en: Speaking mildly Duryodhana tried to prevent those warriors from fighting with the foe. No great car-warrior, however, amongst them carried out his order.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: ततो गान्धारराजस्य पुत्रः शकुनिरब्रवीत्॥ दुर्योधनं महाराज वचनं वचनक्षमः। किं न सम्प्रेक्षमाणानां मद्राणां हन्यते बलम्। न युक्तमेतत् समरे त्वयि तिष्ठति भारत।
en: Then Sakuni, the eloquent son of the Gandhara king, O king, said to Duryodhana these words:-How is this that we are standing here, while the Madraka army is being killed before our eyes? O Bharata,when you are here, it does not look well!

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: सहितैश्चापि योद्धव्यमित्येष समयः कृतः॥ अथ कस्मात् परानेव नतो मर्षयसे नृप।
en: The contract was that all of us should fight in a body. Why then, O king, do you suffer our foes to kill thus our soldiers?

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: दुर्योधन उवाच वार्यमाणा मया पूर्वं नैते चक्रुर्वचो मम॥ एते विनिहताः सर्वे प्रस्कन्नाः पाण्डुवाहिनीम्।
en: Duryodhana said Though prevented by me before, they did not carry our my order. These men, in a body, have entered into the Pandava army.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: शकुनिरुवाच न भर्तुः शासनं वीरा रणे कुर्वन्त्यमर्षिताः॥ अलं क्रोधुमथैतेषां नायं काल उपेक्षितम्।
en: Sakuni said When worked up with rage in battle, brave warriors do not obcy the bchests of their leaders. You should not be angry with those men. This is not the time to act indifferently.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: यामः सर्वे च सम्भूय सवाजिरथकुञ्जराः॥ परित्रातुं महेष्वासान् मद्रराजपदानुगान्।
en: We shall, therefore, all of us, in a body with our cars and horses and elephants, proceed, for rescuing those great bowmen, viz., the followers of the Madra king.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: संजय उवाच अन्योयं परिरक्षामो यत्नेन महता नृप।॥ एवं सर्वेऽनुसंचिन्त्य प्रययुर्यत्र सैनिकाः।
en: O king, we shall protect one another very carefully. Accepting Shakuani's view all the Kauravas then proceeded where the Madras were.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: एवमुक्तस्तदा राजा बलेन महता वृतः॥ प्रययौ सिंहनादेन कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्।
en: Also encircled by a large force Duryodhana proceeded against the foe, uttering leonine shouts and causing the Earth to resound with that noise.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: हत विद्ध्यत गृह्णीत प्रहरध्वं निकृन्तत॥ इत्यासीत् तुमुल: शब्दस्तव सैन्यस्य भारत।
en: Slay, cut, seize, strike, cut off-these were the words that were heard then, O king, among those troops.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: पाण्डवास्तु रणे दृष्ट्वा मद्रराजपदानुगान्॥ सहितानभ्यवर्तन्त गुल्ममास्थाय मध्यमम्।
en: Meanwhile beholding in that battle the followers of the Madra king assailing them unitedly the Pandavas proceeded against thein, arraying themselves in the Madhyama from.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: ते मुहूर्ताद् रणे वीरा हस्ताहस्ति विशाम्पते॥ निहताः प्रत्यदृश्यन्त मद्रराजपदानुगाः।
en: Fighting hand to hand, O king, for a short time, those heroic warriors, viz., the followers of the Madra king, were killed.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: ततो नः सम्प्रयातानां हता मद्रास्तरस्विनः॥ हृष्टाः किलकिलाशब्दमकुर्वन् सहिताः परे।
en: Then, whilst we were proceeding, the active Pandavas, in a body, completed the slaughter of the Madrakas and filled with delight, sent up joyous shouts.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: उत्थितानि कबन्धानि समदृश्यन्त सर्वशः॥ पपात महती चोल्का मध्येनादित्यमण्डलम्। रथैर्भग्नैर्युगाक्षैश्च निहतैश्च महारथैः॥ अश्चैनिपतितैश्चैव संछन्नाभूद् वसुन्धरा।
en: Then headless forms were seen all around. Large meteors fell down from the solar disc. The earth was covered with cars and broken on yokes and axles and slain car-warriors and lifeless horses.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: वातायमानैस्तुरगैर्युगासक्तैस्ततस्ततः॥ अदृश्यन्त महाराज योधास्तत्र रणाजिरे।
en: Horses, quick-coursing like the wind and still attached to yokes of cars, were seen to drag car-warriors, O king, hither and thither on the field of battie.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: भग्नचक्रान् रथान् केचिदहरंस्तुरगा रणे॥ रथाधु केचिदादाय दिशो दश विबभ्रमुः।
en: Some horses were seen to drag cars with broken wheels, while some ran on all sides, carrying the broken cars.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: तत्र तत्र व्यदृश्यन्त यौकत्रैः श्लिष्टाः स्म वाजिनः॥३४ रथिनः पतमानाश्च दृश्यन्ते स्म नरोत्तमाः। गगनात् प्रच्युता सिद्धाः पुण्यानामिव संक्षये॥
en: Here and there also were seen horses hampered by their traces. Car-warriors dropped down like denizens of heaven the exhaustion of their virtue.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: निहतेषु च शूरेषु मद्रराजानुगेषु वै। अस्मानापततश्चापि दृष्ट्वा पार्था महारथाः॥ अभ्यवर्तन्त वेगेन जयगृद्धाः प्रहारिणः।
en: When the brave followers of the Madra king were killed the great car-warriors of the Parthas, beholding a body of horse advancing towards them, rushed quickly towards it with a view to win victory.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: बाणशब्दरवान् कृत्वा विमिश्राशङ्खनिःस्वनैः॥ अस्मांस्तु पुनरासाद्य लब्धलक्ष्यप्रहारिणः। शरासनानि धुन्वानाः सिंहनादान् प्रचुक्रुशुः॥
en: Shooting their arrows and making various other kinds of noise mingled with the blare of their conchs, those warriors of sure aim, shook bows and uttered leonine shouts.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: ततो हतमभिप्रेक्ष्य मद्रराजबलं महत्। मद्रराजं च समरे दृष्ट्वा शूरं निपातितम्॥ दुर्योधनबलं सर्वं पुनरासीत् पराङ्मुखम्।
en: Seeing then that large force of the Madra king killed as also their heroic king the entire army of Duryodhana once more fled away from the field.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: वध्यमानं महाराज पाण्डवैर्जितकाशिभिः। दिशो भेजेऽथसम्भ्रान्तं भ्रामितं दृढधन्विभिः॥
en: Struck, O king, by those firm bowmen of the Pandavas, the Kuru army, filled with fear, fled away on all sides.

description: The followers of Shalya try to kill Yudhishthira, the routing of the Kuru army
sn: वध्यमानं महाराज पाण्डवैर्जितकाशिभिः। दिशो भेजेऽथसम्भ्रान्तं भ्रामितं दृढधन्विभिः॥
en: Struck, O king, by those firm bowmen of the Pandavas, the Kuru army, filled with fear, fled away on all sides.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: संजय उवाच पातिते युधि दुर्धर्षे मद्रराजे महारथे। तावकास्तव पुत्राश्च प्रायशो विमुखाऽभवन्॥
en: Sanjaya said Upon the destruction of that great king of Madra and great car-warrior, that invincible hero, (viz., Shalya) in battle, your troops and sons almost all fled away from the field.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: वणिजो नावि भिन्नाया यथागाधेऽप्लवेऽर्णवे। अपारे पारमिच्छन्तो हते शूरे महात्मना॥
en: Indeed, upon the slaughter of that hero by the illustrious Yudhishthira, your troops were like ship-wrecked merchants on the deep ocean want to cross it.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: मद्रराजे महाराज वित्रस्ताः शरविक्षताः। अनाथा नाथमिच्छन्तो मृगाः सिंहार्दिता इव॥
en: After the destruction of the Madra king, O monarch, you troops, filled with fear and wounded with arrows, were like men having none to help them and desirous of a protector or a herd of deer assailed by a lion.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: वृषा यथा भग्नशृङ्गाः शीर्णदन्ता यथा गजाः। मध्याह्ने प्रत्यपायाम निर्जिताऽजातशत्रुणा॥
en: Like bulls deprive of their horns or elephants with tusks broken, your troops, defeated by Yudhishthira having no enemies, fled away at mid-day.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: न संधातुमनीकानि न च राजन् पराक्रमे। आसीद् बुद्धिर्हते शल्ये भूयो योधस्य कस्यचित्॥
en: After the fall of Shalya, O king, none amongst your troops had the mind of either rallying the army or displaying his prowess.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: भीष्मे द्रोणे च निहते सूतपुत्रे च भारत। यद् दुखं तव योधानां भयं चासीद् विशाम्पते॥
en: O king, we expressed that grief, which had been ours upon the fall of Bhishma, of Drone and of the Suta's son, O Bharata.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: तद् भयं स च नः शोको भूय एवाभ्यवर्तत। निराशाच जये तस्मिन्हते शल्ये महारथे॥ हतप्रवीरा विध्वस्ता निकृत्ताश्च शितैः शरैः। मद्रराजे हते राजन् योधास्ते प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
en: Giving up hopes of success upon the fall of the great car-warrior Shalya, the Kuru army, with its heroes slain and exceedingly confused, were killed with keen arrows. Upon the destruction of the Madra king, O monarch, your warriors all fled away in fear.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: अश्वानन्ये गजानन्ये रथानन्ये महारथाः। आरुह्य जवसम्पन्नाः पादाताः प्राद्रवंस्तथा॥
en: Some on horse-back, some on elephants, some on cars, great car-warriors and footsoldiers, all fled away in fear.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: द्विसाहस्राश्च मातङ्गा गिरिरूपाः प्रहारिणः। सम्प्राद्रवन् हते शल्ये अङ्कुशाङ्गुष्ठनोदिताः॥
en: Two thousand elephants, looking like hills and capable of smiting, fled away, after Shalya's fall, goaded with hooks and toes.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: रणाद् भरतश्रेष्ठ तावकाः प्राद्रवन् दिशः। धावतश्चाप्यपश्याम श्वसमानाशराहतान्॥
en: Indeed chief of the Bharatas, your soldiers fled on all sides. Stuck with arrows, they were seen to run, breathing hard.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: तान् प्रभग्नान् दुतान् दृष्ट्वा हतोत्साहान् पराजितान्। अभ्यवर्तन्त पञ्चालाः पाण्डवाश्च जयैषिणः॥
en: Beholding them defeated the Pandavas, filled with the desire of victory, pursued them.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: बाणशब्दरवाश्चापि सिंहनादाश्च पुष्कलाः। शङ्खशब्दाश्च शूराणां दारुणः समपद्यत॥
en: The sound of arrows and the loud leonine roars and the blare of conchs, of heroic warriors were heard there,

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: दृष्ट्वा तु कौरवं सैन्यं भयत्रस्तं प्रविद्रुतम्। अन्योन्यं समभाषन्त पञ्चाला: पाण्डवैः सह॥ ते
en: Beholding the Kauravas agitated with fear and flying away, the Panchalas and the Pandavas addressed one another, saying.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: अद्य राजा सत्यधृतिर्हतामित्रो युधिष्ठिरः। अद्य दुर्योधनो हीनो दीप्ताया नृपतिश्रियः॥
en: To day the truthful king Yudhishthira, had defeated his enemies. Today Duryodhana has been divested of his splendour and royal prosperity.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: अद्य श्रुत्वा हतं पुत्रं धृतराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः। विह्वलः पतितो भूमौ किल्विषं प्रतिपद्यताम्॥
en: Today, hearing of his son's death, Dhritarashtra, that king of men, will lose consciousness, lie down on the Earth and feel the keenest pain.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: अद्य जानातु कौन्तेयं समर्थं सर्वधन्विनाम्। अद्यात्मानं च दुर्मेधा गर्हयिष्यति पापकृत्॥
en: Let him know today that the son of Kunti is the most powerful of all bowmen. Today that sinful and wicked-hearted king will blame his own self.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: अद्य क्षत्तुर्वचः सत्यं स्मरतां ब्रुवतो हितम्। अद्यप्रभृति पार्थं च प्रेष्यभूत इवाचरन्॥ विजानातु नृपो दुःखं यत् प्राप्तं पाण्डुनन्दनैः।
en: Let him recollect today the time and wholesome words of Vidura. Let him from this day wait upon the Parthas as their slave. Let that king today feel the grief that had been experienced by the sons of Pandu.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: अद्य कृष्णस्य माहात्म्यं विजानातु महीपतिः॥ अद्यार्जुनधनुर्घोषं घोरं जानातु संयुगे। अस्त्राणां च बलं सर्वं बाह्वोश्च बलमाहवे॥
en: Let that king know today the greatness of Krishna. Let him hear today the terrible twang of Arjuna's bow in battle, as also the force of all his weapons and the strength of his arms in fight.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: अद्य ज्ञास्यति भीमस्य बलं घोरं महात्मनः। हते दुर्योधने युद्धे शक्रेणेवासुरे बले॥
en: Today he will know the dreadful power of the great Bhima when Duryodhana will be slain in battle like the Asura Vali by Indra.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: पार्षतः॥ यत् कृतं भीमसेनेन दुःशासनवधे तदा। नान्यः कर्तास्ति लोकेऽस्मिनृते भीमान्महाबलात्॥
en: Except Bhima there is none else in this world that can achieve that which Bhima accomplished by killing Dushasana.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: अद्य श्रेष्ठस्य जानीतां पाण्डवस्य पराक्रमम्। मद्रराजं हतं श्रुत्वा देवैरपि सुदुःसहम्॥
en: Hearing of the death of the ruler of the Madras who was incapable of defeat by the very celestials, that king will know the prowess of Yudhishthira.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: अद्य ज्ञास्यति संग्रामे माद्रीपुत्रौ सुदुःसहौ। निहते सौबले वीरे प्रवीरेषु च सर्वशः॥
en: After the destruction of the heroic son of Subala and of all the Gandharas he will know the strength, in battle of the two sons of Madri by Pandu.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: कथं जयो न तेषां स्याद् येषां योद्धा धनंजयः। सात्यकिर्भीमसेनश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च द्रौपद्यास्तनयाः पञ्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। शिखण्डी च महेष्वासो राजा चैव युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Why will they not be victorious who have Dhananjaya for their warrior, as also Satyaki and Bhimasena and Dhrishtadyumna the son of Prishata and the five sons of Draupadi and the Iwo sons of and the great bowman Shikhandin and king Yudhishthira.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: येषां च जगतीनाथो नाथः कृष्णो जनार्दनः। कथं तेषाहं जयो न स्याद् येषां धर्मो व्यपाश्रयः॥
en: Why will they be not victorious who have for their protector Krishna, called Janardana, the protector of the universe? Why will they not be victorious who are righteous?

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: भीष्मं द्रोणं च कर्णं च मद्रराजानमेव च। तथान्यान् नृपतीन् वीराशतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ कोऽन्यः शक्तो रणे जेतुमृते पार्थाद् युधिष्ठिरात्। यस्य नाथो हृषीकेशः सदा सत्ययशोनिधिः॥
en: Who else than Yudhishthira the son of Pritha, who has Hrishikesha, the refuge of justice and glory for his protector, is competent to defeat in battle Bhishma, Drona and Karna and the king of the Madras and the other kings by hundreds and thousands.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: इत्येवं वदमानास्ते हर्षेण महता युता। प्रभग्नांस्तावकान्योधान् संहृष्टा पृष्ठतोऽन्वयुः॥
en: Saying these words and filled with joy, the Srinjayas pursued your soldiers in that battle who had been exceedingly wounded with arrows. as

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: धनंजयो रथानीकमभ्यवर्तत वीर्यवान्। माद्रीपुत्रौ च शकुनिं सात्यक्श्चि महारथः॥
en: Then Dhananjaya proceeded against the car-division of the foe. The two sons of Madri and the great car-warrior Satyaki proceeded against Shakuni.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: तान् प्रेक्ष्य द्रवतः सर्वान् भीमसेनभयार्दितान्। दुर्योधनस्तदा सूतमब्रवीद् विजयाय च॥ मामतिक्रमते पार्थो धनुष्याणिमवस्थितम्। जघने सर्वसैन्यानां ममाश्वान् प्रतिपादय॥
en: Beholding them all flying quickly in fear of Bhimasena, Duryodhana, if smiling, addressed his driver, saying-Partha, who is there with his bow, is going before me. Take my horses to the back of the army.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: जघने युध्यमानं हि कौन्तेयो मां समन्ततः। नोत्सहेदभ्यतिक्रान्तुं वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: Like the ocean that cannot go beyond its continents, Kunti's son Dhananjaya will never dare go before me if I stand in the fear.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: पश्य सैन्यं महत् सूत पाण्डवैः समभिद्रुतम्। सैन्यरेणुं समुद्भूतं पश्यस्वैनं समन्ततः॥
en: Look, O driver, at this vast army that is pursued by the Pandavas! Behold this cloud of dust that has arisen on all sides on account of the motion of the troops.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: सिंहनादांश्च बहुशः शृणु घोरान् भयावहान्। तस्माद् याहि शनैः सूत जघनं परिपालय॥
en: Hear, those various leonine roars that are so awful and loud. Therefore, O driver, move slowly and wait in the rear.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: मयि स्थिते च समरे निरुद्धेषु च पाण्डुषु। पुनरावर्तते तूर्णं मामकं बलमोजसा॥ तच्छ्रुत्वा तव पुत्रस्य शूरार्यसदृशं वचः। सारथिहेमसंछन्नाशनैरश्वानचोदयत्॥
en: If I stay in battle and fight the Pandavas, my army, O driver, will rally and fight again vigorously. Hearing these words of your son becoming a hero and a man of honour, the driver slowly drove his horses adorned with gold trappings.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: गजाश्वरथिभित्नास्त्यक्तात्मानः पदातयः। एकविंशतिसाहस्राः संयुगायावतस्थिरे॥
en: One and twenty thousand foot-soldiers, deprived of elephants and horses and carwarriors and who were ready to lose their lives, still stood for battle.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: नानादेशसमुद्भूता नानानगरवासिनः। अवस्थितास्तदा योधाः प्रार्थयन्तो महद् यशः॥
en: Born in different countries and coming from different towns, those warriors maintained their ground, desirous of gaining great fame.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: तेषामापततां तत्र संहृष्टानां परस्परम्। सम्पर्दः सुमहाञ्जज्ञे घोररूपो भयानकः ॥
en: The clash of those rushing warriors elated with joy was loud and exceedingly terrible.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: भीमसेनस्तदा राजन् धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। बलेन चतुरङ्गेण नानादेश्यानवारयत्॥
en: Then Bhimasena, O king and Dhrishtadyumna, the son of Prishata, opposed them with four-fold forces.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: भीममेवाभ्यवर्तन्त रणेऽन्ये तु पदातयः। प्रक्ष्वेड्यास्फोट्य संहृष्टा वीरलोकं यियासवः॥
en: Other foot-soldiers, all actuated with the desire of victory, proceeded against Bhima, uttering loud cries and slapping their armpits, by the desire of going to heaven.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: आसाद्य भीमसेनं संरब्धा युद्धदुर्मदाः। धार्तराष्ट्रा विनेदुर्हि नान्यामकथयन् कथाम्॥ परिवार्य रणे भीमं निजघ्नुस्ते समन्ततः।
en: Filled with rage and invincible in battle those heroes, belonging to your party, approached Bhimasena and cried aloud. They then spoke not to one another. Encircling Bhima in that battle, they began to strike him from all sides.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: स वध्यमानः समरे पदातिगणसंवृतः॥ न चचाल ततः स्थानान्मैनाक इव पर्वतः। तु
en: Encircled by that huge body of infantry and struck by them in that battle Bhima did not stir from where he stood are remained motionless like the Mainaka mountain.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: ते तु क्रुद्धा महाराज पाण्डवस्य महारथम्॥ निग्रहीतुं प्रवृत्ता हि योधांश्चान्यानवारयन्।
en: His antagonists meanwhile, filled with rage, O monarch, tried to assail that great car-warrior of the Pandavas and opposed other combatants (that tried to rescue him).

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: अक्रुध्यत रणे भीमस्तैस्तदा पर्यवस्थितैः॥ सोऽवतीर्य रथात् तूर्णं पदातिः समवस्थितः।
en: Encountered by those warriors, Bhima became furious. And quickly getting down from his car, he proceeded on foot against them.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: जातरूपप्रतिच्छन्नां प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्॥ अवधीत् तावकान् योधान् दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः।
en: Taking up his massive mace adorned with gold, he began to kill your soldiers like the destroyer himself armed with his club.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: विप्रहीणरथाश्वांस्तानवधीत् पुरुषर्षभः॥ एकविंशतिसाहस्रान् पदातीन् समपोथयत्।
en: The mighty Bhiina, with his mace, crushed those twenty one thousand foot-soldiers who deprived of cars and horses and elephants.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: हत्वा तत् पुरुषानीकं भीमः सत्यपराक्रमः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं पुरस्कृत्य नचिरात् प्रत्यदृश्यत।
en: Having killed that strong army 3hima, of great prowess, showed himself with Dhrishtadyumna in his front.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: पादाता निहता भूमौ शिश्यिरे रुधिरोक्षिताः॥ सम्भग्ना इव वातेन कर्णिकाराः सुपुष्पिताः।
en: The foot-soldiers, of your party thus slain, lay down on the ground, bathed in blood, like Karnikaras with their flowers struck down by a storm.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: नानाशस्त्रसमायुक्ता नानाकुण्डलधारिणः॥ नानाजात्या हतास्तत्र नानादेशसमागताः।
en: Adorned with garlands made of various kinds of flowers and with diverse kinds of earrings, those combatants of various races, who were had come from various kingdoms, lay down on the field, lifeless.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: पताकाध्वजसंछन्नं पदातीनां महद् बलम्॥ निकृत्तं विबभौ रौद्रं घोररूपं भयावहम्।
en: Covered with banners and standards, that large army of foot-soldiers looked fierce and terrible and lay prostrate on the field.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: युधिष्ठिरपुरोगाश्च सहसैन्या महारथाः॥ अभ्यधावन् महात्मानं पुत्रं दुर्योधन तव।
en: The great car-warriors, with their followers, that fought under Yudhishthira, all pursued you illustrious son Duryodhana.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: ते सर्वे तावकान् दृष्ट्वा महेष्वासा: पराङ्मुखान्। नात्यवर्तन्त ते पुत्रं वेलेव मकरालयम्।
en: Beholding your troops turn away from the battle, those great bowmen proceeded against Duryodhana, but they could not overcome him even as the ocean cannot go beyond its continents.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: तदद्भुतमपश्याम तव पुत्रस्य पौरुषम्॥ यदेकं सहिताः पार्था न शेकुरतिवर्तितुम्।
en: The prowess of your son was highly wonderful, since all the Parthas, in a body, could not transgress his single self.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: नातिदूरापयातं तु कृतबुद्धिं पलायने॥ दुर्योधनः स्वकं सैन्यमब्रवीद् भृशविक्षतम्। न तं देशं प्रपश्यामि पृथिव्यां पर्वतेषु च॥ यत्र यातान्न वा हन्युः पाण्डवाः किं सृतेन वः।
en: Addressing his own army which had not fled far but which, wounded with arrows, were bent upon flying, Then Duryodhana said these words: "I do not see a place on plain or mountain, where if you fly, the Pandavas will not pursue and kill you. What is the use of flight?

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: अल्पं च बलमेतेषां कृष्णौ च भृशविक्षतौ॥ यदि सर्वेऽत्र तिष्ठामो ध्रुवं नो विजयो भवेत्।
en: The army of the Pandavas had been reduced in nuinbers. The two Krishnas are greatly wounded. If all of us make a stand, we will surely acquire victory.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: विप्रयातास्तु वो भिन्नान् पाण्डवाः कृतविप्रियाः॥ अनुसृत्य हनिष्यन्ति श्रेयानः समरे वधः।
en: If you fly away, in confusion, the sinful Pandavas will pursue you and kill you. If on the other hand we made a bold stand, it will do us good.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: शृण्वन्तु क्षत्रियाः सर्वे यावन्तोऽत्र समागताः॥ यदा शूरं च भीरुं च मारयत्यन्तकः सदा। को नु मूढो न युध्येत पुरुषः क्षत्रियो ध्रुवम्॥
en: Listen, all you Kshatriyas that are here. When Dcath always kills heroes and cowards alike what man is there so foolish that, calling himself a Kshatriya, will not fight.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: श्रेयो नो भीमसेनस्य क्रुद्धस्याभिमुखे स्थितम्। सुखः सांग्रामिको मृत्युः क्षत्रधर्मेण युध्यताम्॥
en: It will be to our interest if we stay before the angry Bhimasena. Death in battle, while fighting in pursuance of the Kshatriya practices, leads to happiness.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: म]नावश्यमर्तव्यं गृहेष्वपि कदाचन। युध्यत: क्षत्रधर्मेण मृत्युरेष सनातनः॥ हत्वेह सुखमाप्नोति हतः प्रेत्य महत् फलम्। न युद्धधर्माच्छ्रेयान् वै पन्थाः स्वर्गस्य कौरवाः॥ अचिरेणैव ताँल्लोकान् हतो युद्धे समश्नुते। श्रुत्वा तद् वचनं तस्य पूजयित्वा च पार्थिवाः॥ पुनरेवाभ्यवर्तन्त पाण्डवानाततायिनः।
en: Gaining victory, one obtains happiness here. If killed, one reaps great fruits in the other world. You Kauravas, there is no better path to heaven than that of battle. Killed in battle, you will in no time obtain all those regions of blessedness.” Hearing those words of his and applauding them highly, the Kuru kings once more rushed against the Pandavas for fighting with them.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: तानापतत एवाशु व्यूढानीकाः प्रहारिणः॥ प्रत्युद्ययुस्तदा पार्था जयगृद्धाः प्रमन्यवः।
en: Seeing them advancing quickly the Parthas, arrayed in order of battle, skilled in smiting, worked up with rage and filled with the desire of victory, proceeded against them.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: धनंजयो रथेनाजावभ्यवर्तत वीर्यवान्॥ विश्रुतं त्रिषु लोकेषु व्याक्षिपन् गाण्डिवं धनुः।
en: Stretching his bow Gandiva celebrated over the three worlds, the brave Dhananjaya proceeded on his car against the foe.

description: The fight between Shakuni and Nakula and Sahadeva and other leaders
sn: माद्रीपुत्रौ च शकुनि सात्यकिश्च महाबलः॥ जवेनाभ्यपतन् हृष्टा यत्ता वै तावकं बलम्॥
en: The two sons of Madri and Satyaki rushed against Shakuni and the other Pandava heroes smilingly proceeded against your army.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: संजय उवाच संनिवृत्ते जनौघे तु शाल्वो म्लेच्छगणाधिपः। अभ्यवर्तत संक्रुद्धः पाण्डवानां महद् बलम्॥ आस्थाय सुमहानागं प्रभिन्नं पर्वतोपमम्। दृप्तमरावतप्रख्यममित्रगणमर्दनम्॥
en: Sanjaya said After the (Kuru) army had been gathered Shalya, the king of the Mlechchhas, filled with rage, rushed against the large army of the Pandavas, riding on a gigantic clephant, with temporal juice trickling, looking like a hill, elated with pride, resembling Airavata himself and capable of crushing large numbers of foes.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: योऽसौ महान्भद्रकुलप्रसूतः सुपूजिते धार्तराष्ट्रेण नित्यम्। सुकल्पितः शास्त्रविनिश्चयज्ञैः सदोपवाह्यः समरेषु राजन्॥
en: Shalya's animal was of a good breed, was always adored by Dhritarashtra's sons and was properly equipped and properly trained for battle, O king, by persons well conversant with the science of elephant training. Riding on that elephant, that foremost of kings looked like the morning sun at the close of summer.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: तमास्थितो राजवरो बभूव यथोदयस्थः सविता क्षपान्ते। भ्युद्ययौ पाण्डुसुतान्समेतान्॥
en: Riding that best of elephants, O king, he went against the Pandavas and began to strike them on all sides with keen and dreadful arrows resembling Indra's thunder in force.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: महेन्द्रवज्रप्रतिमैः सुघोरैः। ततः शरान् वै सृजतो महारणे योधांश्च राजन् नयतो यमालयम्॥
en: While he discharged his arrows in that battle and killed the hostile warriors neither the Kauravas nor the Pandavas could mark any defect in him, even as the Daityas, O king, could not notice any in Vasava, the wielder of the thunder, in the days of yore while he killed them.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: नास्यान्तरं ददृशुः स्वे परे वा यथा पुरा वज्रधरस्य दैत्याः। दैत्याः पुरा वासवस्येव राजन्॥ ते पाण्डवाः सोमकाः सृञ्जयाश्च तमेकनागं ददृशुः समन्तात्। सहस्रशो वै विचरन्तमेकं यथा महेन्द्रस्य गजं समीपे॥
en: The Pandavas, the Somakes and the Srinjayas, saw one elephant look like a thousand elephants moving around them as the enemies of the gods had in days of yore seen the elephant of Indra in battle.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: संद्राव्यमाणं तु बलं परेषां परीतकल्पं विबभौ समन्ततः। नैवावतस्थे समरे भृशं भयाद् विमृद्यमानं तु परस्परं तदा॥
en: The army so driven by thai elephant seemed as if trapped from all sides. It could not stay for moments in the battle-field on account of sheer fright. All soldiers started crushing in hue and cry over mutual pull and push.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: ततः प्रभग्ना सहसा महाचमू: सा पाण्डवी तेन नराधिपेन। दिशश्चतस्रः सहसा विधाविता गजेन्द्रवेगं तमपारयन्ती॥
en: Agitated by that animal, the hostile army looked life-less. Unable to stand in battle, they then fled away in great fear, crushing one another. Then the huge army of the Pandavas, routed by king Shalya, suddenly fled on all sides unable to stand the vigor of that elephant.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: दृष्ट्वा च तां वेगवतीं प्रभग्नां सर्वे त्वदीया युधि योधमुख्याः। अपूजयस्ते तु नराधिपं तं दध्मुश्च शङ्खाशशिसंनिकाशान्॥
en: Seeing the Pandava army routed and flying away quickly all your leading warriors worshipped king Shalya and blew their moonwhite conchs.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: श्रुत्वा निनादं त्वथ कौरवाणां हर्षाद् विमुक्तं सह शङ्खशब्दैः। सेनापतिः पाण्डवसृञ्जयानां पाञ्चालपुत्रो ममृषे न कोपात्॥
en: Hearing the war-cries of the Kauravas uttered in joy and the blare of their conchs, the commander of the Pandava and the Srinjaya forces, viz., the Panchala prince Dhrishtadyumna could not, from wrath, bear it.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: ततस्तु तं वै द्विरदं महात्मा प्रत्युद्ययौ त्वरमाणो जयाय। जम्भो यथा शक्रसमागमे वै नागेन्द्रमैरावणमिन्द्रवाह्यम्॥
en: The illustrious Dhrishtadyumna then quickly proceeded for defeating that elephant, as the Asura Jainbha had proceed against Airavata, the carrier of Indra, while he fought with Indra.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: तमापतन्तं सहसा तु दृष्ट्वा पाञ्चालपुत्रं युधि राजसिंहः। तं वै द्विपं प्रेषयामास तूर्णं वधाय राजन् दुपदात्मजस्य॥
en: Beholding the king of the Pandavas proceed against him, Shalya, the foremost of kings, quickly urged his elephant, O king, for the destruction of Drupada's son.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: मविध्यदग्निप्रतिमैः पृषत्कैः कर्मारधौतैर्निशितैर्व्वलद्भि ाराचमुख्यैस्त्रिभिरुपवेगैः॥
en: Seeing the animal approaching the latter struck it with three best arrows, polished, keen, blazing, powerful and resembling fire itself in effulgence and force.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: ततोऽपरान् पञ्चशतान् महात्मा नाराचमुख्यान् विससर्ज कुम्भे। स तैस्तु विद्धः परमद्विपो रणे तदा परावृत्य भृशं प्रदुद्रुवे॥
en: Then that illustrious hero struck the animal on the trunk with five other whetted and best arrows. Struck therewith, that prince of elephants, turning away from the battle, ran quickly away.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: तं नागराजं सहसा प्रणुन्नं विद्राव्यमाणं विनिवर्त्य शाल्वः। तोत्राङ्कुशैः प्रेषयामास तूर्णं पाञ्चालराजस्य रथं प्रदिश्य॥
en: Suddenly checking that foremost of elephants which had been greatly wounded and compelled to retreat Shalya, however, caused it to turn back and with hooks and keen lances urged it forward against the car of the Panchala king, pointing it out to the infuriate animal.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: दृष्ट्वाऽऽपतन्तं सहसा तु नागं धृष्टद्युम्नः स्वरथाच्छ्रीघ्रमेव। गदां प्रगृह्योग्रजवेन वीरो भूमिं प्रपन्नो भयविह्वलाङ्गः॥
en: Beholding the animal rushing forcibly at him, the heroic Dhrishtadyumna, taking up a mace, quickly leaped down on the Earth from his car, his limbs benumbed with fear.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: स तं रथं हेमविभूषिताङ्गं साश्वं ससूतं सहसा विमृद्या उत्क्षिप्य हस्तेन नदन् महाद्विपो विपोथयामास वसुन्धरातले॥
en: That huge elephant, meanwhile, suddenly crushing that gold-decked car with its horses and driver, raised it up in the air with his trunk and then dashed it down on the Earth.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: पाञ्चालराजस्य सुतं च दृष्ट्वा तदार्दितं नागवरेण तेना तमभ्यधावत् सहसा जवेन भीमः शिखण्डी च शिनेश्च नप्ता॥
en: Beholding the driver of Panchala king thus crushed by that best of elephants. Bhima and Shikhandin and the grandson of Shini rushed with great force against that animal.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: शरैश्च वेगं सहसा निगृह्य तस्याभितो व्यापततो गजस्य। स संगृहीतो रथिभिर्गजो वै चचाल तैर्वार्यमाणाश्च संख्ये॥
en: With their arrows they quickly restrained that animal. Thus restrained by them in battle, the elephant began to tremble.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: ततः पृषत्कान् प्रववर्ष राजा सूर्यो यथा रश्मिजालं समन्तात्। तैराशुगैर्वध्यमाना रथौधाः प्रदुद्रुवुः सहितास्तत्र तत्र॥
en: Meanwhile king Shalya began to discharge arrows like the Sun shedding his rays on all sides. Struck with those arrows, the (Pandava) car-warriors began to fly away.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: तत् कर्म शाल्वस्य समीक्ष्य सर्वे पाञ्चालपुत्रा नृप सृञ्जयाश्च। हाहाकारैर्नादयन्ति स्म युद्धे द्विपं समन्ताद् रुरुधुनराग्र्याः॥
en: Beholding that feat of Shalya, the Panchalas, the Srinjayas and the Matsyas. O king, bewailed aloud in that battle. All those foremost of men however, surrounded the animal entirely.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: पाञ्चालपुत्रस्त्वरितस्तु शूरो गदां प्रगृह्याचलशृङ्गकल्पाम्। ससम्भ्रमं भारत शत्रुघाती जवेन वीरोऽनुससार नागम्॥
en: Then, taking up his mace resembling the crest of a mountain, the brave Panchalas appeared there. Fearlessly, O king, that hero, that striker of foes, rushed quickly against the clephant.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: ततस्तु नागं धरणीधराभं मदं स्रवन्तं जलदप्रकाशम्। गदां समाविद्ध्य भृशं जघान पाञ्चालराजस्य सुतस्तरस्वी॥ तु तदा गजेन्द्रे
en: The active prince of the Panchala, approaching, began to strike with his mace that animal which was huge as a hill and which shed temporal juice like a mass of pouring clouds.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: स भिन्नकुम्भः सहसा विनद्य मुखात् प्रभूतं क्षतजं विमुञ्चन्। पपात नागो धरणीधराभः क्षितिप्रकम्पाञ्चलितो यथाऽद्भिः॥
en: Its trunk cut open, the animal cried aloud; and vomiting enough blood, the animal, huge as a hill, suddenly dropped down as a mountain falling down during an earthquake.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: निपात्यमाने हाहाकृते तव पुत्रस्य सैन्ये। स शाल्वराजस्य शिनिप्रवीरो जहार भल्लेन शिरः शितेन॥
en: While that best of elephants was falling down and while your son's ariny were bewailing at the spectacle, that best of warriors among the Shinis cut off the head of king Shalya with a sharp and broad-headed arrow.

description: The death of Shalya, the king of Mlechchhas
sn: हृतोत्तमाङ्गो युधि सात्वतेन पपात भूमौ सह नागराज्ञा। यथाद्रिशृङ्गं सुमहत् प्रणुन्नं वज्रेण देवाधिपचोदितेन॥
en: His head having been sundered by the Satwata hero, Shalya dropped down on the Earth along with his best of elephants, like a mountain summit suddenly clapped by the thunder-bolt discharged by the best of the celestials.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: संजय उवाच तस्मिंस्तु निहते शूरे शाल्वे समिति शोभने। तवाभज्यद् बलं वेगाद् वातेनेव महाद्रुमः॥
en: Sanjaya said After the heroic Shalya, that flower of the court, had been killed your ariny were dispersed like a huge tree broken by the force of the storm.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: तत् प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा कृतवर्मा महारथः। दधार समरे शूरः शत्रुसैन्यं महाबलः॥
en: Seeing the army routed, the great carwarrior, Kritavarına, opposed the hostile force in that battle.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: सन्निवृत्तास्तु ते शूरा दृष्ट्वा सात्वतमाहवे। शैलोपमं स्थिरं राजन् कीर्यमाणं शरैर्युधि॥
en: Seeing the Satwata hero, O king, standing in battle like a hill though struck with arrows (by the foe), the Kuru heroes, who had fled away, rallied and came back.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरूणां पाण्डवैः सह। निवृत्तानां महाराज मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥
en: Then, O king, an encounter which took place between the Pandavas and the Kurus who were determined upon meeting with death.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: तत्राश्चर्यमभूद् युद्धं सात्वतस्य परैः सह। यदेको वारयामास पाण्डुसेनां दुरासदाम्॥
en: Wonderful was that fierce encounter which took place between the Satwata hero and his foes, since alone hc opposed the invincible ariny of the Pandavas.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: तेषामन्योन्यसुहृदां कृते कर्मणि दुष्करे। सिंहनादः प्रहृष्टानां दिविस्पृक् सुमहानभूत्॥
en: Seeing this most difficult feat friends, filled with delight, set up leonine shouts that sceined to reach the very heavens.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ताः पञ्चालान् भरतर्षभ। शिनेर्नप्ता महाबाहुरन्वपद्यत सात्यकिः॥
en: At those sounds and Panchalas, O foremost of Bharata's race, were filled with fear. Then Satyaki, the grandson of Shini, came there.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: स समासाद्य राजानं क्षेमधूर्ति महाबलम्। सप्तभिर्निशितैर्बाणैरनयद् यमसादनम्॥
en: Approaching the powerful king Kshemakirti, Satyaki killed him with seven keen arrows.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: तमायान्तं महाबाहुं प्रवपन्तं शिताशरान्। जवेनाभ्यपतद् धीमान् हार्दिक्यः शिनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: Then the intelligent son of Hridika, rushed quickly against the best of Shinis, that mightyarmed warrior, as the latter came discharging his whetted shafts.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: सात्वतौ च महावी? धन्विनौ रथिनां वरौ। अन्योन्यमभिधावेतां शस्त्रप्रवरधारिणौ॥
en: Those two bowmen, those two foremost of car-warriors roared like lions and met each other, both being armed with best of weapons.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: पाण्डवाः सहपञ्चाला योधाश्चान्ये नृपोत्तमाः। प्रेक्षकाः समपद्यन्त तयोघरि समागमे॥
en: The Pandavas, the Panchalas and the other warriors, witnessed that terrible encounter between the two heroes.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: नाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैश्च वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथौ। अभिजघ्नतुरन्योन्यं प्रहृष्टाविव कुञ्जरौ॥
en: Those two Vrishni and Andhaka heroes, like two elephants filled with delight, struck each other with long arrows and arrows with calf-toothed heads.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: चरन्तौ विविधान् मार्गान् हार्दिक्यशिनिपुङ्गवौ। मुहुरन्तर्दधाते तौ बाणवृष्ट्या परस्परम्॥
en: Moving about in various ways the son of Hridika and that foremost of Shini's race soon covered each other with showers of arrows.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: चापवेगबलोद्धृतान् मार्गणान् वृष्णिसिंहयोः। आकाशे समपश्याम पतङ्गानिव शीघ्रगान्॥
en: The arrows discharged forcibly from the bows of the two Vrishni heroes were seen by us in the sky to resemble fights of quickcoursing insects.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: तमेकं सत्यकर्माणमासाद्य हृदिकात्मजः। अविध्यन्निशितैर्बाणैश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्॥
en: Approaching the powerful Satyaki of true prowess, the son of Hridika struck the four horses of the former with four keen arrows.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: स दीर्घबाहुः संक्रुद्धस्तोत्रादित इव द्विपः। अष्टभिः कृतवर्माणमविद्ध्यत् परमेषुभिः॥
en: Enraged at this like an elephant struck with a lance, the long-armed Satyaki struck Kritavarman with eight best arrows.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: ततः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः कृतवर्मा शिलाशितैः। सात्यकि त्रिभिराहत्य धनुरेकेन चिच्छिदे॥
en: Then Kritavarman struck Satyaki with three arrows whetted on stone and shot off his bow drawn to its fullest stretch and then cut of his bow with another arrow.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: निकृत्तं तद् धनुः श्रेष्ठमपास्य शिनिपुङ्गवः। अन्यदादत्त वेगेन शैनेयः सशरं धनुः॥
en: Casting off his broken bow, that Shini hero quickly took up another with an arrow set on it.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: तदादाय धनुः श्रेष्ठं वरिष्ठः सर्वधन्विनाम्। आरोग्य च धनुः शीघ्रं महावीर्यो महाबलः॥ अमृष्यमाणो धनुषश्छेदनं कृतवर्मणा। कुपितोऽतिरथः शीघ्रं कृतवर्माणमभ्ययात्॥
en: Having taken up that best of bows and stringed it, that foremost of all bowmen, that warrior of great energy, intelligence and strength, unable to bear the cutting of his bow by Kritavarman, quickly and furiously rushed against the latter.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: ततः सुनिशितैर्बाणैर्दशभिः शिनिपुङ्गवः। जघान सूतं चाश्वांश्च ध्वजं च कृतवर्मणः॥
en: With ten keen arrows that Shini chief then struck the driver, the horses and the standard of Kritavarman.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: ततो राजन् महेष्वासः कृतवर्मा महारथः। हताश्वसूतं सम्प्रेक्ष्य रथं हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥ रोषेण महताऽऽविष्टः शूलमुद्यम्य मारिष। चिक्षेप भुजवेगेन जिघांसुः शिनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: At this, O king, the great bowinan and carwarrior Kritavarman, beholding his golddecked car made driverless and horseless, was filled with rage. Taking up a pointed lance, he discharged it with all might at that best of Shini's race, desirous of killing him.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: तच्छूलं सात्वतो ह्याजौ निर्भिद्य निशितैः शरैः। चूर्णितं पातयामास मोहयन्निव माधवम्॥
en: Striking that lance with many keen arrows, Satyaki sundered it off into pieces and caused it to fall down. Stupefying Kritavarinan of Madhu's race with another broad-headed arrow he then struck Kritavarman on the chest.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन हृद्येनं समताडयत्। स युद्धे युयुधानेन हताश्वो हतसारथिः॥
en: Deprived of his horses and driver in that battle by Yuyudhana, skilled in weapons, Kritavarınan came down on the Earth.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: कृतवर्मा कृतस्तेन धरणीमन्वपद्यत। तस्मिन् सात्यकिना वीरे द्वैरथे विरथीकृते॥ समपद्यत सर्वेषां सैन्यानां सुमहद् भयम्।
en: The heroic Kritavarman, having been deprived of his car by Satyaki in that single combat, all the (Kaurava) soldiers were possessed by a great fear.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: पुत्रस्य तव चात्यर्थं विषादः समजायत॥ हतसूते हताश्वे तु विरथे कृतवर्मणि।
en: A mighty fear overtook your sons, when Kritavarman was thus made steedless and driverless and carless.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: हताश्वं च समालक्ष्य हतसूतमरिंदम॥ अभ्यधावत् कृपो राजञ्जिघांसुः शिनिपुङ्गवम्।
en: Beholding that chastiser of foes made steedless and driverless, Kripa, O king, rushed at that best of Shini's race, desirous of killing him.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: तमारोप्य रथोपस्थे मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्॥ अपोवाह महाबाहुं तूर्णमायोधनादपि।
en: Taking Kritavarman upon his car before all the bowmen, the mighty-armed Kripa took him away from the battlefield.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: शैनेयेऽधिष्ठिते राजन् विरथे कृतवर्मणि॥ दुर्योधनबलं सर्वं पुनरासीत् पराङ्मुखम्।
en: After Kritavarman had been made carless and the grandson of Shini had grown powerful on the field, the entire army of Duryodhana took to their heels.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: तत् परे नान्वबुध्यन्त सैन्येन रजसा वृताः॥ तावकाः प्रद्रुता राजन् दुर्योधनमृते नृपम्।
en: The enemy, however, did not see it for the Kuru army was then covered with a cloud of dust. All your warriors fled, O king, except king Duryodhana.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: दुर्योधनस्तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य भग्नं स्वबलमन्तिकात्॥ जवेनाभ्यपत् तूर्णं सर्वांश्चैको न्यवारयत्।
en: Beholding his own army thus routed he quickly rushed and assailed the victorious enemy, alone opposing them all.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: पाण्डूंश्च सर्वान् संक्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नं च पार्षतम्॥ शिखण्डिनं द्रौपदेयान् पञ्चालाना च ये गणाः। केकयान् सोमकांश्चैव सृञ्जयांश्चैव मारिष॥ असम्भ्रमं दुराधर्षः शितैर्वाणैरवाकिरत्। अतिष्ठदाहवे यत्तः पुत्रस्तव महाबलः॥
en: Filled with rage, that invincible warrior assailed with keen arrows all the Pandus and Dhrishtadyumna the son of Prishata and Shikhandin and the son of Draupadi and the large numbers of the Panchalas and the Kaikeyas and the Somakas.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: यथा यज्ञे महानग्निमन्त्रपूतः प्रकाशवान्। तथा दुर्योधनो राजा संग्रामे सर्वतोऽभवत्॥
en: With strong determination your powerful son stood in battle. even as blazing and mighty fire on the sacrificial platform purified with mantras, king Duryodhana moved in the field, in that battle.

description: The fight between the various leaders of both the armies
sn: तं परे नाभ्यवर्तन्त मा मृत्युमिवाहवे। अथान्यं रथमास्थाय हार्दिक्यः समपद्यत॥
en: His enemies could not approach him then, like creatures unable to approach the Death. Then the son of Hridika came there, on another car.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: संजय उवाच पुत्रस्तु ते महाराज रथस्थो रथिनां वरः। दुरुत्सहो बभौ युद्धे यथा रुद्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Filled with the courage of despair, that best of car-warriors, O king viz., your son, looked resplendent on his car in that battle like Rudra himself.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तस्य बाणसहस्रैस्तु प्रच्छन्ना ह्यभवन्मही। परांश्च सिषिचे बाणैर्धाराभिरिव पर्वतान्॥
en: With the thousands of arrows shot by him, the Earth was completely covered. He drenched his enemies with showers of arrows like the clouds pouring rain on mountain breasts.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
