sn: न च सोऽति पुमान् कश्चित् पाण्डवानां बलार्णवे। यो गजो रथो वापि यः स्याद् बाणैरविक्षतः॥
en: There was then not a man amongst the Pandavas in that great battle or a horse or an elephant or a car, who or which was not struck with Duryodhana's arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: यं यं हि समरे योधं प्रपश्यामि विशाम्पते। स स बाणैश्चितोऽभूद्वै पुत्रेण तव भारत॥
en: O king, amongst the warriors every one, O Bharata, was struck by your son with his arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: यथा सैन्येन रजसा समुद्भूतेन वाहिनी। प्रत्यदृश्यत संछन्ना तथा बाणैर्महात्मनः॥
en: The Pandava army was then covered with the arrows of that great warriors even as a army is covered with the dust it raises while marching for battle.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: बाणभूतामपश्याम पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते। दुर्योधनेन प्रकृतां क्षिप्रहस्तेन धन्विना॥
en: The Earth then, O king, was as if converted into one sheet of arrows by your son Duryodhana, that bowman endued with great lightness of hand.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तेषु योधसहस्रेषु तावकेषु परेषु च। एको दुर्योधनो ह्यासीत् पुमानिति मतिर्मम॥
en: Amongst those thousands of warriors on the field, of your side or that of the enemy, it appeared as if Duryodhana was then the only man.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम तव पुत्रस्य विक्रमम्। यदेकं सहिताः पार्था नाभ्यवर्तन्त भारत।॥
en: The prowess displayed by your son was highly wonderful, since the Parthas, even in a body, could not approach him who was single.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: युधिष्ठिरं शतेनाजी विव्याध भरतर्षभ। भीमसेनं च सप्तत्या सहदेवं च पञ्चभिः॥
en: He struck Yudhishthira, O best of Bharata's race, with a hundred arrows and Bhimasena with seventy and Sahadeva with seven.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: नकुलं त चतुःषष्ट्या धृष्टद्युम्नं च पञ्चभिः। सप्तभिद्रौपदेयांश्च त्रिभिर्विव्याध सात्यकिम्॥ धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन सहदेवस्य मारिष।
en: And he struck Nakula with sixty four and Dhrishtadyumna with five and the sons of Draupadi with seven and Satyaki with three arrows. With a broad-headed arrow, he then, O king, cut off the bow of Sahadeva.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तदपास्य धनुश्छिन्नं माद्रीपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ अभ्यद्रवत राजानं प्रगृह्यान्यन्महद् धनुः। ततो दुर्योधनं संख्ये विव्याध दशभिः शरैः॥
en: Casting off that broken bow, the heroic son of Madri, took up another formidable bow and rushing against the king, viz., Duryodhana struck him with ten arrows in that battle.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: नकुलस्तु ततो वीरो राजानं नवभिः शरै। घोररूपैर्महेष्वासो विव्याध च ननाद च॥
en: The great and brave bowman Nakula then struck the king with nine terrible arrows and uttered a loud war cry.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: सात्यकिश्चैव राजानं शरेणानतपर्वणा। द्रौपदेयास्त्रिसप्तत्या धर्मराजश्च पञ्चभिः॥ अशीत्या भीमसेनश्च शरै राजानमार्पयन्।
en: Satyaki struck the king with a single straight shaft; the sons of Draupadi struck him with seventy three and king Yudhishthira struck him with five. And Bhimasena assailed the king with eighty arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: समन्तात् कीर्यमाणस्तु बाणसंधैर्महात्मभिः॥ न चचाल महाराज सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः।
en: Though struck thus from all sides with numerous arrows by those illustrious warriors, Duryodhana still, O king, did not waver, in the presence of all the soldiers assembled there.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: लाघवं सौष्ठवं चापि वीर्यं चापि पहात्मनः॥ अति सर्वाणि भूतानि ददृशुः सर्वमानवाः।
en: The quickness, the skill and the prowess of that illustrious warrior excelled those of every man.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: धार्तराष्ट्रा हि राजेन्द्र योधास्तु स्वल्पमन्तरम्॥ अपश्यमाना राजानं पर्यवर्तन्त दंशिताः।
en: Meanwhile the Dhartarashtras, O king, who had not fled far away, beholding the king, rallied and returned there, clad in mail.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तेषामापततां घोरस्तुमुलः समपद्यत॥ क्षुब्धस्य हि समुद्रस्य प्रावृट्काले यथा स्वनः।
en: The noise made by them when they returned was exceedingly awful, like the roar of the surging deep during the rainy season.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: समासाद्य रणे ते तु राजानमपराजितम्॥ प्रत्युद्ययुर्महेष्वासाः पाण्डवानाततायिनः।
en: Approaching their invincible king in that battle, those great bowmen rushed against the Pandavas for fight.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: भीमसेनं रणे क्रुद्धो द्रोणपुत्रो न्यवारयत्॥
en: The son of Drona opposed in that battle the angry Bhimasena.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: नानाबाणैर्महाराज प्रमुक्तैः सर्वतोदिशम्। नाज्ञायन्त रणे वीरा न दिशः प्रदिशः कुतः॥
en: With the arrows, O king, that were shot in that battle, all the points of the horizon were completely covered, so that the brave warriors could not distinguish the cardinal from the subsidiary points of the compass.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तावुभौ क्रूरकर्माणावुभौ भारत दुःसहौ। घोररूपमयुध्येतां कृतप्रतिकृतैषिणौ॥ त्रासयन्तौ दिशः सर्वा ज्याक्षेपकठिनत्वचौ।
en: As regards Ashvatthaman and Bhimasena, O Bharata, both of them performed wonderful feats. Both of them were invincible in battle. The arms of both continued marks of bowstring for having repeatedly drawn the same. Opposing each other, they fought on, frightening the entire universe.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: शकुनिस्तु रणे वीरो युधिष्ठिरमपीडयत्॥ तस्याश्वांश्चतुरो हत्वा सुबलस्य सुतो विभो। नादं चकार बलवत् सर्वसैन्यानि कोपयन्॥
en: The heroic Shakuni struck Yudhishthira in that battle. Having killed the four horses of the king the powerful son of Subala uttered a loud roar, making all the soldiers tremble with fear.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरं राजानमपराजितम्। अपोवाह रथेनाजौ सहदेवः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Meanwhile the valiant Şahadeva carried away the heroic but defeated king on his car from that battle.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: अथान्यं रथमास्थाय धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। शकुनि नरभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध पञ्चभिः॥ ननाद च महानादं प्रवरः सर्वधन्विनाम्।
en: Then riding on another car, returned king Yudhishthira and having pierced Shakuni at first with nine arrows, once more struck him with five. And that best of all bowmen then sent up a loud roar.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तद् युद्धमभवचित्रं घोररूपं च मारिष॥ प्रेक्षतां प्रीतिजननं सिद्धचारणसेवितम्।
en: That battle presented a wonderful spectacle, It filled the spectators with delight and was praised by the Siddhas and the Charanas.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: उलूकस्तु महेष्वासं नकुलं युद्धदुर्मदम्॥ अभ्यद्रवदमेयात्मा शरवर्षेः समन्ततः।
en: Heroic Uluka rushed against the mighty bowman Nakula, in that battle, discharging showers of arrows from all sides.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तथैव नकुलः शूरः सौबलस्य सुतं रणे॥ शरवर्षेण महता समन्तात् पर्यवारयत्।
en: The heroic Nakula, however, in that battle opposed the son of Shakuni with a dense shower of arrows from every side.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तौ तत्र समरे वीरो कुलपुत्रौ महारथौ॥ योध्यन्तावपश्येतां कृतप्रतिकृतैषिणौ।
en: Both those heroes were born in high family and both were great car-warriors. They were seen to fight with each other, each enraged with the other.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तथैव कृतवर्माणं शैनेयः शत्रुतापनः॥ योधयशुशुभे राजन् बलिं शक्र इवाहवे।
en: Similarly Kritavarman, O king, fighting with the grandson of Shini, that scorcher of foes, shone like Shakra fighting with the Asura Vala.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: दुर्योधनो धनुश्छित्त्वा धृष्टद्युम्नस्य संयुगे॥ अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं विव्याध निशितैः शरैः।
en: Having cut off Dhrishtadyumna's bow in that battle, Dhrishtadyumna struck his bowless antagonist with kcen arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नोऽपि समरे प्रगृह्य परमायुधम्॥ राजानं योधयामास पश्यतां सर्वधन्विनाम्।
en: Then, in that battle, having taken up a formidable bow, Dhrishtadyumna fought with the king before all the bowmen.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तयोर्युद्धं महचासीत् संग्रामे भरतर्षभ।॥ प्रभिन्नयोर्यथा सक्तं मत्तयोर्वरहस्तिनोः।
en: The encounter between those two heroes was exceedingly dreadful, O best of Bharata's race, like that between two wild and infuriate elephants with temporal juice trickling down.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: गौतमस्तु रणे क्रुद्धो द्रौपदेयान् महाबलान्॥ विव्याध बहुभिः शूरः शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः।
en: Worked up with rage in that battle, the heroic Gautama struck the mighty sons of Draupadi with many straight arrows.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तस्य तैरभवद् युद्धमिन्द्रियैरिव देहिनः॥ घोररूपमसंवार्य निर्मर्यादमवर्तत।
en: The encounter that took place between him and those five resembled that which takes place between a man and his five senses. It was awful and fierce and no party showed any consideration for the other.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: ते च सम्पीडयामासुरिन्द्रियाणीव बालिशम्॥ स च तान् प्रति संरब्धः प्रत्ययोधयदाहवे।
en: The five sons of Draupadi assailed Kripa like the senses afflicting a foolish man. He, on the other hand, fighting with thein, opposed them vigorously.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: एवं चित्रमभूद् युद्धं तस्य तैः सह भारत॥ उत्थायोत्थाय हि यथा देहिनामिन्द्रयैर्विभो।
en: That battle between him and them was indeed wonderful because it resembled the struggles, O king, between men and their Senses.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: नराश्चैव नरैः सार्धं दन्तिनो द तभिस्तथा॥ हया हयैः समासक्ता रथिनो राथभिः सह। संकुलं चाभवद् भूयो घोररूपं विशाम्पते॥
en: Men fought with men, elephants with elephants, horses with horses and car-warriors with car-warriors. Once more O king, that encounter became general and dreadful.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: इदं चित्रमिदं घोरमिदं रौद्रमिति प्रभो। युद्धान्यासन् महाराज घोराणि च बहूनि च॥
en: Here an encounter was beautiful, there another was dicadful and there another was exceedingly fierce. O lord, many dreadful encounters took place in course of that battle.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: ते समासाद्य समरे परस्परमरिंदमाः। व्यनदंश्चैव जघ्नुश्च समासाद्य महाहवे।॥
en: Belonging to both armies and encountering one another, those chastisers of foes struck and killed one another in that dreadful battle.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: तेषां पत्रसमुद्भूतं रजस्तीव्रमदृश्यत। वातेन चोद्धतं राजन् धावद्भिश्चाश्वसादिभिः॥
en: A thick cloud of dust was raised by the cars and the animals. Thick dust was also raised by the running of the horses, a dust that was carried from one place to another by the wind.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: रथनेमिसमुद्भूतं निःश्वासैश्चापि दन्तिनाम्। रजः संध्याभ्रकलिलं दिवाकरपथं ययौ॥
en: A dust, thick as an evening cloud, was caused in the sky by the wheels of cars and the breaths of the elephants.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: रजसा तेन सम्पृक्तो भास्करो निष्प्रभः कृतः। संछादिताऽभवद् भूमिस्ते च शूरा महारथाः॥
en: On that dust being raised and the sun himself hidden therewith, the Earth became shrouded and the heroic and great car-warriors were not visible.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: मुहूर्तादिव संवृत्तं नीरजस्कं समन्ततः। वीरशोणितसिक्तायां भूमौ भरतसत्तम॥
en: That dust disappeared and everything became clear when the Earth, O best of the Bharatas, was covered with the blood of heroes.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: उपाशाम्यत् ततस्तीवं तद् रजो घोरदर्शनम्। ततोऽपश्यमहं भूयो द्वन्द्वयुद्धानि भारत॥ यथाप्राणं यथाश्रेष्ठं मध्याह्ने वै सुदारुणे। वर्मणां तत्र राजेन्द्र व्यदृश्यन्तोज्ज्वला: प्रभाः॥
en: When that dense and awful cloud of dust was put down there were seen many single encounters, O Bharata, that the heroes fought at the noon each according to his strength and his rank. They were all exceedingly fierce. The sheen of the weapons in those encounters, O king, appeared full in view.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: शब्दश्च तुमुल: संख्ये शराणां पततामभूत्। महावेणुवनस्येव दह्यमानस्य पर्वते॥
en: Loud noise, of the falling shafts in that battle, resembled that of a vast forest of bamboo's while burning on every side.

description: The fight between Duryodhana and the sons of Pandu
sn: शब्दश्च तुमुल: संख्ये शराणां पततामभूत्। महावेणुवनस्येव दह्यमानस्य पर्वते॥
en: Loud noise, of the falling shafts in that battle, resembled that of a vast forest of bamboo's while burning on every side.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: संजय उवाच वर्तमाने तदा युद्धे घोररूपे भयानके। अभज्यत बलं तत्र तव पुत्रस्य पाण्डवैः॥
en: Sanjaya said During the progress of that terrible and awful battle, the army of your son were routed by the Pandavas.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: तास्तुं यत्नेन महता संनिवार्य महारथान्। पुत्रस्ते योधयामास पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥
en: Rallying their great car-warriors however, with vigorous exertions, your sons continued to fight with the Pandava army.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: निवृत्ताः सहसा योधास्तव पुत्रजयैषिणः। सन्निवृत्तेषु तेष्वेवं युद्धमासीत् सुदारुणम्॥ तावकानां परेषां च देवासुररणोपमम्। परेषां तव सैन्ये वा नासीत् कश्चित् पराङ्मुखः॥
en: The Kuru warriors, seeking your son's welfare, suddenly came back. Upon their return, the battle once more became fearful, between your warriors and those of the foe, resembling that between the gods and the Asuras in the days of yore. Neither amongst the enemies nor amongst your people was there a single warrior who fled away from the field.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: अनुमानेन युध्यन्ते संज्ञाभिश्च परस्परम्। तेषां क्षयो महानासीद् युध्यतामितरेतरम्॥
en: The warriors fought, knowing one another by the names they uttered. A great onslaught took place there.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा क्रोधेन महता युतः। जिगीषमाणः संग्रामे धार्तराष्ट्रान् सराजकान्॥ त्रिभिः शारद्वतं विद्ध्वा रुक्मपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः। चतुर्भिनिजघानाश्वान् नाराचैः कृतवर्मणः॥
en: Filled with great anger and desirous of defeating the Dhartarashtras and their king in that battle, king Yudhishthira struck the son of Sharadvata with three gold winged arrows whetted on stone and next killed with four others the four horses of Kritavarman.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: अश्वत्थामा तु हार्दिक्यमपोवाह यशस्विनम्। अत शारद्वतोऽष्टाभिः प्रत्यविद्ध्यद् युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Then Ashvatthaman carried away the celebrated son of Hridika. Sharadvat's son struck Yudhishthira in return with eight arrows.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा रथान् सप्तशतान् रणे। प्रेषयद् यत्र राजासौ धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Then king Duryodhana sent seven hundred cars to the place where king Yudhishthira was fighting.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ते रथा रथिभिर्युक्ता मनोमारुतरंहसः। अभ्यद्रवन्त संग्रामे कौन्तेयस्य रथं प्रति॥
en: Those cars, driven by excellent warriors and quick-coursing like the wind or thought, rushed in that battle against the car of Kunti's son.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ते समन्तान्महाराज परिवार्य युधिष्ठिरम्। अदृश्य सायकैश्चक्रुर्मेघा इव दिवाकरम्॥
en: Encircling Yudhishthira on all sides they made him invisible with their arrows like clouds hiding the sun from the view.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: दृष्ट्वा धर्मराजानं कौरवेयैस्तथा कृतम्। नामृष्यन्त सुसंरब्धाः शिखण्डिप्रमुखा रथाः॥
en: Then Pandava heroes, led by Shikhandin, beholding king Yudhishthira assailed in that way by the Kauravas, were filled with rage and unable to put up with it.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: रथैरश्ववरैर्युक्तैः किङ्किणीजालसंवृतः। आजग्मुरथ रक्षन्तः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Desirous of rescuing Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, they came there on their cars possessed of great speed and adorned with rows of bells.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ततः प्रववृते रौद्रः संग्रामः शोणितोदकः। पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनः॥ ते दृष्ट्वा
en: Then took place an awful battle, in which blood flowed as water, between the Pandavas and the Kurus, that increased the denizens of Yama's region.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: रथान् सप्तशतान् हत्वा कुरूणामाततायिनाम्। याण्डवाः सह पञ्चालैः पुनरेवाभ्यवारयन्॥
en: Killing those seven hundred hostile carwarriors of the Kuru army, the Pandavas and the Panchalas once more resisted (the whole Kuru ariny).

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: तत्र युद्धं महचासीत् तव पुत्रस्य पाण्डवैः। न च तत् तादृशं दृष्टं नैव चापि परिश्रुतम्॥
en: There took place a fierce encounter between your son and the Pandavas. We had never before seen or heard of its like.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: वर्तमाने तदा युद्धे निर्मर्यादे समन्ततः। वध्यमानेषु योधेषु तावकेष्वितरेषु च॥ विनदत्सु च योधेषु शङ्खवर्यैश्च पूरितैः। उत्क्रुष्टैः सिंहनादैश्च गर्जितैश्चैव धन्विनाम्॥
en: During the onset of that battle in which no consideration was shown by any party for another and while the warriors of your army and those of the foe were being killed quickly, the coinbatants were all shouting and blowing their conchs. The bowmen were roaring and uttering loud noises of diverse kinds.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: अतिप्रवृत्ते युद्धे च छिद्यमानेषु मर्मसु। धावमानेषु योधेषु जयगृद्धिषु मारिष॥
en: The very vitals of the combatants were being struck, during that fight and the troops, O sire, desirous of victory, were rushing with speed.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: संहारे सर्वतो जाते पृथिव्यां शोकसम्भवे। बह्वीनामुत्तमस्त्रीणां सीमन्तोद्धरणे तथा॥
en: Everything on carth was under-going ai woeful destruction, during that battle when numberless ladies of birth and beauty were being made widows.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: निर्मर्यादे महायुद्धे वर्तमाने सुदारुणे। प्रादुरासन् विनाशाय तदोत्पाताः सुदारुणाः॥
en: During the progress of that fierce encounter in which the warriors fought without any consideration for friends and foes, evil omens appeared, presaging the destruction of everything.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: चचाल शब्दं कुर्वाणा सपर्वतवना मही। सदण्डा: सोल्मका राजन् कीर्यमाणाः समन्ततः॥ उल्का पेतुर्दिवो भूमावाहत्य रविमण्डलम्।
en: The earth, with her mountains and forests, shook making a loud noise. Meteors, like burning brands equipt with handles, dropped from the sky, O king, on every side of the earth as if from the solar disc.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: विष्वग्वाताः प्रादुरासन् नीचैः शर्करवर्षिणः॥ अश्रूणि मुमुचुर्नागा वेपथु चास्पृशन् भृशम्।
en: There blew a hurricane on all sides, carrying away hard pebbles along its lower course. The elephants shed profuse tears and trembled greatly.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: एतान् घोराननादृत्य समुत्पातान् सुदारुणान्॥ पुनर्युद्धाय संयत्ताः क्षत्रियास्तस्थुरव्यथाः। रमणीये कुरुक्षेत्रे पुण्ये स्वर्ग यियासवः॥
en: Disregarding all those fierce and awful omens, the Kshatriyas, consulting with one another, cheerfully stood on the field of Kurukshetra, desirous of going to heaven.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ततो गान्धारराजस्य पुत्रः शकुनिरब्रवीत्। युद्ध्यध्वमग्रतो यावत् पृष्ठतो हन्मि पाण्डवान्॥ ततो नः सम्प्रयातानां मद्रयोधास्तरस्विनः। हृष्टाः किलकिलाशब्दमकुर्वन्ता परे तथा॥
en: Then Shakuni, the son of the Gandhara king, said-"Fight you all in front! I, however, will kill the Pandavas from behind!”_-Then the active Madraka warriors, amongst those on our side that were advancing, were filled with joy and uttered various cries. Others also did the same.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: अस्मांस्तु पुनरासाद्य लब्धलक्षा दुरासदाः। शरासनानि धुन्वन्तः शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्॥
en: The invincible and sure-armed Pandavas, once more coming against us, shook their bows and enshrouded us with showers of arrows.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ततो हतं परैस्तत्र मद्रराजबलं तदा। दुर्योधनबलं दृष्ट्वा पुनरासीत् पराङ्मुखम्॥
en: The army of the Madrakas then were killed by the foc. Beholding this, the troops of Duryodhana once more fled from the battle.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: गान्धारराजस्तु पुनर्वाक्यमाह ततो बली। निवर्तध्वमधर्मज्ञा युध्यध्वं किं सृतेन वः॥ अनीकं दशसाहस्रमश्वानां भरतर्षभ। आसीद् गान्धारराजस्य विशालप्रासयोधिनाम्॥
en: The might king of the Gandharas, however, once more said these words-"Stop, you sinful wretches, fight with the foe. What use is there of fight.” At that time, O foremost of Bharata's race, the king of the Gandharas had full ten thousand horsemen capable of fighting with bright lances.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: बलेन तेन विक्रम्य वर्तमाने जनक्षये। पृष्ठतः पाण्डवानीकमभ्यघ्ननिशितैः शरैः॥
en: During the onset of that great carnage, Shakuni, aided by the force, displayed his valor and assailed the Pandava army at the rear, killing it with his keen arrows.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: तदभ्रमिव वातेन क्षिप्यमाणं समन्ततः। अभज्यत महाराज पाण्डूनां सुमहद् बलम्॥
en: The huge force of the Pandus then, O king, were dispersed even as a mass of clouds of all sides by a powerful wind.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ततो युधिष्ठिर: प्रेक्ष्य भग्नं स्वबलमन्तिकात्। अभ्यनादयदव्यग्रः सहदेवं महाबलम्॥ असौ सुबलपुत्रो नो जघनं पीड्य दंशितः। सैन्यानि सूदयत्येष पश्य पाण्डव दुर्मतिम्॥
en: Then beholding his own army rouled, Yudhishthira coolly urged the mighty Sahadeva, saying-"Yonder the son of Subala, afflicting our rear, stands clad in mail. He kills our forces. Behold that wicked man, O son of Pandu.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: गच्छ त्वं द्रौपदेयैश्च शकुनि सौबलं जहि। रथनीकमहं धक्ष्ये पञ्चालसहितोऽनघ॥
en: Helped by the sons of Draupadi proceed towards him and kill Shakuni, the son of Subala. Supported by the Panchalas, O sinless one, I will meanwhile kill the car-force of the enemy.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: गच्छन्तु कुञ्जरा: सर्वे वाजिनश्च सह त्वया। पादाताश्च त्रिसाहस्राः शकुनि तैर्वृतो जहि॥ ततो गजाः सप्तशताश्चापपाणिभिरास्थिताः। पञ्च चाश्वसहस्राणि सहदेवश्च वीर्यवान्॥ पादाताश्च त्रिसाहस्रा द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः। रणे ह्यभ्येद्रवंस्ते तु शकुनि युद्धदुर्मदम्॥
en: Let all the elephants and all the horse and three thousand foot go with you. Helped by these, slay Shakuni.” At this seven hundred elephants ridden by bowmen and five thousand horse and the valiant Sahadeva and three thousand foot-soldiers and the son of Draupadi, all proceeded against invincible Shakuni.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ततस्तु सौबलो राजन्नभ्यतिक्रम्य पाण्डवान्। जघान पृष्ठतः सेनां जयगृद्धः प्रतापवान्॥
en: However, O king, overpowering the Pandavas and longing for victory, Subala's son, of great valour, began to slay their forces from the back.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: अश्वरोहास्तु संरब्धाः पाण्डवानां तरस्विनाम्। प्राविशन् सौबलानीकमभ्यतिक्रम्य तान् रथान्॥
en: The horsemen, beside themselves with rage, of the Pandavas penetrated the division of Subala's son, overpowering the latter's carwarriors.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ते तत्र सादिनाः शूराः सौबलस्य महद् बलम्। रणमध्ये व्यतिष्ठन्त शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्॥
en: Those heroic horsemen, staying in the midst of their own elephants, enshrouded the large host of Subala's son with showers of arrows.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: तदुद्यतगदाप्रासमाकपुरुषसेवितम्। प्रावर्तत महद् युद्धं राजन् दुर्मन्त्रिते तव॥
en: On account of your evil counsels, O king, a dreadful battle took place in which maces and lances were used and in which heroes only took part.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: उपारमन्त ज्याशब्दाः प्रेक्षका रथिनोऽभवन्। न हि स्वेषां परेषां वा विशेषः प्रत्यदृश्यत॥
en: The twang of bows was no longer heard there, for all the car-warriors stood there as spectators. At that time no difference could be seen between the opposing parties.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: शूरबाहुविसृष्टानां शक्तीनां भरतर्षभ। ज्योतिषामिव सम्पातमपश्यन् कुरुपाण्डवाः॥
en: Both the Kurus and the Pandavas, O foremost of Bharatas, saw the darts, shot off heroic arms, pass like meteors through the sky.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ऋष्टिभिर्विमलाभिश्च तत्र तत्र विशाम्पते। सम्पतन्तीभिराकाशमावृतं बह्वशोभत॥
en: The entire sky, O king, covered with falling and bright sword, appeared highly beautiful.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: प्रासानां पततां राजन् रूपमासीत् समन्ततः। शलभानामिवाकाशे तदा भरतसत्तम॥
en: The view presented, O best of the Bharatas, by the lances hurled all around, was like that of swarms of locusts in the sky.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गा विप्रविद्धैर्नियन्तृभिः। हयाः परिपतन्ति स्म शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Horses, with limbs covered with blood on account of wounds inflicted by horsemen themselves struck with arrows, dropped down on all sides in hundreds and thousands.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: अन्योयं परिपिष्टाश्च समासाद्य परस्परम्। आविक्षताः स्म दृश्यन्ते वमन्तो रुधिरं मुखैः॥
en: They all remained huddled together. many of them were wounded and many vomited blood. A thick darkness set in there when the troops were covered with a cloud of dust.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ततोऽभवत्तमो घोरं सैन्येन रजसा वृते। तानपाक्रमतोऽद्राक्षं तस्माद् देशादरिंदम॥
en: When that darkness covered everything, O king, we saw those brave heroes, horses and men move away from that spot.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: अश्वान् राजन् मनुष्यांश्च रजसा संवृते सति। भूमौ निपतिताश्चान्ये वमन्तो रुधिरं बहु॥
en: Others dropped down on the earth vomiting blood profusely. Many warriors, entangled with one another by their locks, could not move.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: केशाकेशि समालग्ना न शेकुश्चेष्टितुं नराः। अन्योन्यमश्वपृष्ठेभ्यो विकर्षन्तो महाबलाः॥ मल्ला इव समासाद्य निजघ्नुरितरेतरम्।
en: Many powerful heroes dragged one another from the backs of their horses and encountering one another thus, killed one another like wrestlers. Many, deprived of life, were carried away by the horses they rode.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: अश्वैश्च व्यपकृष्यन्त बहवोऽत्र गतासवः॥ रक्तोक्षितैश्छिन्नभूजैरवकृष्टशिरोरुहैः।
en: Many men, elated with the pride of courage and inspired with the desire of victory, dropped down on the earth.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: व्यदृश्यत मही कीर्णा शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ दूरं न शक्यं तत्रासीद् गन्तुमश्वेन केनचित्।
en: The earth was covered with hundreds and thousands of blessing warriors, deprived of limbs and divested of hairs.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: साश्वारोहैर्हतैरश्वैरावृते वसुधातले॥ रुधिरोक्षितसन्नाहैरात्तशस्त्रैरुदायुधैः। नानाप्रहरणै?रैः परस्परवधैषिभिः॥
en: The surface of the earth being covered with clephant-riders and horsemen and killed horses and warriors with blood-stained armours and those armed with weapons and those who had tried to kill one another with various kinds of terrible weapons, all lying in a mass in that lifedestroying battle, no warrior could proceed far on his horse.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: सुसंनिकृष्टैः संग्रामे हतभूयिष्ठसैनिकैः। स मुहूर्तं ततो युद्ध्वा सौबलोऽथ विशाम्पते॥ षट्साहस्रर्हयैः शिष्टैरपायाच्छकुनिस्ततः। तथैव पाण्डवानीकं रुधिरेण समुक्षितम्॥ षट्साहौर्हयैः शिष्टैरपायाच्छान्तवाहनम्।
en: Having fought for a little while, Shakuni, the son of Subala, O king, went away from that spot with the remnant of his cavalry, six thousand in number. Similarly the Pandava force, covered with blood and its animals worn out, moved away from there with its remnant consisting of six thousand horse.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: अश्वारोहाच पाण्डूनामब्रुवन् रुधिरोक्षिताः॥ भूमौ निपतिताश्चान्ये बहवो विजयैषिणः। तत्र तत्र व्यदृश्यन्त पुरुषाः शूरमानिनः॥ सुसंनिकृष्टे संग्रामे भूयिष्ठे त्यक्तजीविताः। न हि शक्यं स्थैर्योधं कुत एव महागजैः॥ रथानेव रथा यान्तु कुञ्जराः कुञ्जरानपि।
en: Horsemen, covered with blood of the Pandava army then, determined upon fighting and prepared to sacrifice their lives, said-"It is no longer possible to fight here on cars; how much more difficult it is then to fight here on elephants against elephants.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: प्रतियातो हि शकुनिः स्वमनीकमवस्थितः॥ न पुनः सौबलो राजा युद्धमभ्यागमिष्यति।
en: Having retreated Shakuni is now staying within his own detachment. The royal son of Subala will not again come to fight.”

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ततस्तु द्रौपदेयाश्च ते च मत्ता महाद्विपाः॥ प्रययुर्यत्र पाञ्चाल्यो धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः।
en: Then the sons of Draupadi and those infuriate elephants went where the Panchala prince Dhrishtadyumna, that great car-warrior, was.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: सहदेवोऽपि कौरव्य रजोमेघे समुत्थिते॥ एकाकी प्रययौ तत्र यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः।
en: Sahadeva also, when that cloud of dust set in, went alone where king Yudhishthira was.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ततस्तेषु प्रयातेषु शकुनिः सौबलः पुनः॥ पार्श्वतोऽभ्यहनत् क्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नस्य वाहिनीम्।
en: After all those had departed Shakuni the son of Subala, worked up with wrath, once more attacked. Dhrishtadyumna's division and began to strike it.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: तत् पुनस्तुमुलं युद्धं प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वाभ्यवर्तत॥ तावकानां परेषां च परस्परवधैषिणाम्।
en: Again a dreadful encounter took place, in which the combatants did not care for their lives, between your soldiers and those of the foe, all of whom were desirous of killing one another.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ते चान्योन्यमवैक्षन्त तस्मिन् वीरसमागमे॥ योधा:पर्यपतन् राजन् शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: In that encounter of heroes, the combatants first looked at one another steadfastly and then rushed, O king and attacked one another in hundreds and thousands.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: असिभिश्छिद्यमानानां शिरसां लोकसंक्षये॥ प्रादुरासीन्महाशब्दस्तालानां पततामिव।
en: In that onslaught, heads, cut off with swords, dropped down with a noise like that of falling palmyra fruits.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: विमुक्तानां शरीराणां छिन्नानां पततां भुवि॥ सायुधानां च बाहूनामुरूणां च विशाम्पते। आसीत् कटकटाशब्दः सुमहाँल्लोमहर्षणः॥
en: Loud noise also arose making the very hairs stand erect, of bodies falling down on the ground, divested of armours and wounded with weapons and of falling weapons also, O king and of arms and thighs cut off from the trunk.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: निघ्नन्तो निशितैःशस्त्रैर्धातॄन् पुत्रान् सखीनपि। योधाः परिपतन्ति स्म यथामिषकृते खगाः॥
en: Assailing brothers and sons and even fathers with keen weapons, the combatants fought like birds, for a piece of meat.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: अन्योन्यं प्रतिसंरब्धा समासाद्य परस्परम्। अहं पूर्वमहं पूर्वमिति न्यघ्नन् सहस्रशः॥
en: Worked up with rage, thousand of warriors attacked one another in that battle.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: संघातेनासनभ्रष्टैरश्वारोहैर्गतासुभिः। हयाः परिपतन्ति स्म शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Hundreds and thousands of combatants, pressed down by slain horsemen while falling down from their horses, fell down on the field.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: स्फुरतां प्रतिविष्टानामश्वानां शीघ्रगामिनाम्। स्तनतां च मनुष्याणां सन्नद्धानां विशाम्पते॥ शक्त्वृष्टिप्रासशब्दश्च तुमुल: समपद्यत। भिन्दतां परमर्माणि राजन् दुर्मत्रिते तव॥
en: There arose loud noise of neighing horses of great flectness and of shouting men clad in mail and of the falling darts and swords, O king, of combatants desirous of cutting one another to the very quick on account, O monarch, of your evil policy.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: श्रमाभिभूताः सरंब्धाः श्रान्तवाहाः पिपासवः। विक्षताश्च शितैः शस्त्रैरभ्यवर्तन्त तावकाः॥
en: At that time, your soldiers, exhausted and worked up with rage, their animals fatigued, themselves thirsty, wounded with sharp weapons, began to turn away from the battle.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: मत्ता रुधिरगन्धेन बहवोऽत्र विचेतसः। जघ्नुः परान् स्वसांश्चैव प्राप्तान प्राप्ताननन्तरान्॥
en: Maddened with the smell of blood, many became so insensible that they killed friends and foes alike, in fact, every one they could lay hold on.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: बहवश्च गतप्राणाः क्षत्रिया जयगृद्धिनः। भूमावभ्यपतन् राजन् शरवृष्टिभिरावृताः॥
en: O king, actuated with the desire of victory, large numbers of Kshatriyas were struck down with arrows and lay prostrate on the earth.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: वृकगृध्रशृगालानां तुमुले मोदनेऽहनि। आसीद् बलक्षयो घोरस्तव पुत्रस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Wolves, vultures and jackals began to yell hideously in joy. In the very presence of your son your son army suffered a great loss.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: नराश्वकायैः संछन्ना भूमिरासीद् विशाम्पते। रुधिरोदकचित्रा च भीरूणां भयवर्धिनी॥
en: The earth, O king, was covered with the bodies of men and horses and over-flown with rivers of blood that struck terror to the timid,

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: असिभिः पट्टिशैः शूलैस्तक्षमाणाः पुनः पुनः। तावकाः पाण्डवेयाश्च न न्यवर्तन्त भारत॥
en: Struck and wounded repeatedly with swords and battle-axes and lances, your warriors, as also the Pandavas, O Bharata, ceased to approach one another.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: प्रहरन्तो यथाशक्ति यावत् प्राणस्य धारणम्। योधाः परिपतन्ति स्म वमन्तो रुधिरं व्रणैः॥
en: Striking one another according to their might and fighting to the last combatants dropped down, bleeding.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: शिरो गृहीत्वा केशेषु कबन्धः स्म प्रदृश्यते। उद्यम्य च शितं खड्ग रुधिरेण परिप्लुतम्॥
en: Headless from were seen, catching the hair of their heads and holding swords stained in blood.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: तथोत्थितेषु बहुषु कबधेषु नराधिप। तथा रुधिरगन्धेन योधाः कश्मलमाविशन्॥ मन्दीभूते ततः शब्दे पाण्डवानां महद् बलम्। अल्पावशिष्टैस्तुरगैरभ्यवर्तत सौबलः॥
en: When many headless forms, O king, had thus rise up, when the smell of blood had made the warriors almost senseless and the loud noise had somewhat subsided, Subala's son again approached the large army of the Pandavas, with the small remnant of his cavalry.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: ततोऽभ्यधावंस्त्वरिताः पाण्डवा जयगृद्धिनः। पदातयश्च नागाश्च सादिनश्चोधतायुधाः॥
en: Thereat actuated with the desire of victory and endued with great activity, Pandavas rushed towards Shakuni, with foot-soldiers and elephants and cavalry all with uplifted weapons.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: कोष्ठकीकृत्य चाप्येनं परिक्षिप्य च सर्वशः। शस्त्रैर्नानाविधैर्जघ्नुर्युद्धपारं तितीर्षवः॥
en: Desirous of terminating the hostilities, the Pandavas, forming a wall, encircled Shakuni on all sides and began to strike him with various kinds of weapons.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: त्वदीयास्तांस्तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य सर्वतः समभिद्रुतान्। रथाश्वपत्तिद्विरदाः पाण्डवनभिदुद्रुवुः॥
en: Beholding your soldiers assailed from every side, the Kauravas, with horse, foot, elephants and cars, rushed towards the Pandavas.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: केचित् पदातयः पद्भिर्मुष्टिभिश्च परस्परम्। निजघ्नुः समरे शूराः क्षीणशस्त्रास्ततोऽपतन्॥
en: Some brave foot-soldiers, destitute of weapons, attacked their foes in that battle, with feet and fists and struck them down.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: रथेभ्यो रथिन: पेतुर्द्विपेभ्यो हस्तिसादिनः। विमानेभ्यो सिद्धाः पुण्यक्षयादिव॥
en: Car-warriors dropped down from cars and elephant-men from elephants, like virtuous persons falling down from their celestial vehicles upon the wane of their virtue.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: एवमन्योन्यमायत्ता योधा जघ्नुर्महाहवे। पितृन भ्रातृन् वयस्यांश्च पुत्रानापि तथा परे॥
en: Thus the warriors fought with one another in that great battle and killed fathers and brothers and friends and sons.

description: The fight between Yudhishthira and the Kurus. The fight of Shakuni
sn: एवमासीदमर्यादं युद्धं भरतसत्तम। प्रासासिबाणकलिलं वर्तमाने सुदारुणे॥ दिवो भ्रष्ट्राः
en: Thus took place that battle, ( best of Bharatas, in which no consideration was shown by any body for any one and in which lances, swords and arrows dropped down fast on every side and presented a terrific spectacle. Thus took place that battle, ( best of Bharatas, in which no consideration was shown by any body for any one and in which lances, swords and arrows dropped down fast on every side and presented a terrific spectacle.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: संजय उवाच तस्मिशब्दे मृदौ जाते पाण्डवैनिहते बले। अश्वैः सप्तशतैः शिष्टहरुपावर्तत सौबलः॥
en: Sanjaya said When the loud noise of battle had somewhat subsided and the Pandavas had killed large numbers of their foes Subala's son once more came with the remnant of his cavalry, seven hundred in number.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: स यात्वा वाहिनीं तूर्णमब्रवीत् त्वरयन् युधि। युद्ध्यध्वमिति संहृष्टाः पुनः पुनररिंदमाः॥
en: Spcedily approaching his own soldiers and urging them to fight, he again and again said-"You chastisers of enemies, fight merrily.”

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: अपृच्छत् क्षत्रियांस्तत्र क्व नु राजा महाबलः। शकुनेस्तद् वचः श्रुत्वा तमूचुर्भरतर्षभ।।३। असौ तिष्ठति कौरव्यो रणमध्ये महाबलः। यत्रैतत् सुमहच्छत्रं पूर्णचन्द्रसमप्रभम्॥ यत्र ते सतनुत्राणा रथास्तिष्ठन्ति दंशिताः। यत्रैष तुमुलः शब्दः पर्जन्यनिनदोपमः॥ तत्र गच्छ द्रुतं राजंस्ततो द्रक्ष्यसि कौरवम्। एवमुक्तस्तु तैर्योधैः शकुनिः सौबलस्तदा॥ प्रययौ तत्र यत्रासौ पुत्रस्तव नराधिप। सर्वतः संवृत्तो वीरैः समरे चित्रयोधिभिः॥
en: And he asked the Kshatriyas assembled there, saying-"Where is the king that great carwarrior!"-Hearing those words of Shakuni, O foremost of Bharatas, they replied saying "There stands the great car-warrior, viz., the Kuru king-there the large umbrella, effulgent like the full moon, is seen, —there where those car-warriors, clad in mail, are staying-there where that loud noise, deep as the muttering of clouds, is being heard. Go quickly thither, O king and you will see the Kuru king."-Thus spoken to by those brave warriors. Subala's son Shakuni, O king, proceeded where your son was waiting, surrounded on all sides by unretreating heroes.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: ततो दुर्योधनं दृष्ट्वा रथीनीके व्यवस्थितम्। स रथांस्तावकान् सर्वान् हर्षयशकुनिस्ततः॥ दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यं हृष्टरूपो विशाम्पते। कृतकार्यमिवात्मानं मन्यमानोऽब्रवीनृपम्॥ जहि राजन् रथानीकमश्वाः सर्वे जिता मया। नात्यक्त्वा जीवितं संख्ये शक्यो जेतुं युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Beholding Duryodhana stationed in the midst of the car-force, Shakuni, checring up your car-warriors, O king, said these words to Duryodhana, in a manner which showed that he considered all his purposes to have been already accomplished. "Slay, O king, the carwarriors of the Pandavas. All their horse have been defeated by me. Yudhishthira is incapable of being defeated in battle unless one is prepared to sacrifice his life.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: हते तस्मिन् रथानीके पाण्डवेनाभिपालिते। गजानेतान् हनिष्यामः पदातींश्चेतरांस्तथा॥
en: When that car-army, protected by the son of Pandu, will have been destroyed, we shall then kill all those elephants and foot-soldiers and others."

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य तावका जयगृद्धिनः। जवेनाभ्यपतन् हृष्टाः पाण्डवानामनीकिनाम्॥
en: Hearing those words your warriors, actuated with the desire of victory, cheerfully proceeded against the Pandava army.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: सर्वे विवृततूणीरा: प्रगृहीतशरासनाः। शरासनानि धुन्वानाः सिंहनादान्प्रणेदिरे॥१३॥
en: With quivers on their backs and bows in their hands, all of them shook their bows and sent up leonine war-cries.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: ततो ज्यातलनिर्घोषः पुनरासीद् विशाम्पते। प्रादुरासीच्छाराणां च सुमुक्तानां सुदारुणः॥
en: Again O king, the fierce twang of bows and the slapping of palms and the sound of arrows shot forcibly was heard.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: चोदयाश्वानसम्भ्रान्तः प्रविशैतद् बलार्णवम्। अन्तमद्य गमिष्यामि शत्रूणां निशितैः शरैः॥ तान् समीपगतान् दृष्ट्वा जवेनोद्यतकार्मुकान्। उवाच देवकीपुत्रं कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Beholding those Kuru heroes approach the Pandava army with uplifted bows, Kunti's son, Dhananjaya, said to the son of Devaki-"Drive the horse fearlessly and enter this deep of troops. With my keen arrows I shall to-day terminate these hostilities.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: अष्टादश दिनान्यद्य युद्धस्यास्य जनार्दन।
en: Today is the eighteenth day, O Janarddana, of this great battle.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: वर्तमानस्य महतःसमासाद्य परस्परम्॥ अनन्तकल्पा ध्वजिनी भूत्वा ह्येषां महात्मनाम्।
en: The numberless army of those great heroes has been almost destroyed. Mark the course of Destiny.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: क्षयमद्य गता युद्ध पश्य दैवं यथाविधम्॥ समुद्रकल्पं च बलं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य माधव। अस्मानासाद्य संजातं गोष्पदोपममच्युत॥
en: The army of Dhritarashtra's son, O Madhava, which was vast as the deep, has O Achyuta, became, after meeting ourselves, even like a pit caused by a cow's hoof.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: हते भीष्मे तु संदध्याच्छिवं स्यादिह माधव। न च तत् कृतवान् मूढो धार्तराष्ट्रः सुबालिशः॥
en: If peace had been made after Bhishma's fall, O Madhava, everything would have fared well. The foolish and wicked-minded Duryodhana, however, did not make peace.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: उक्तं भीष्मेण यद वाक्यं हितं तथ्यं च माधव। तचापि नासौ कृतवान् वीतबुद्धिः सुयोधनः॥
en: The words, that were given vent to by Bhishma, O Madhava, were beneficial and should have been accepted. Suyodhana however, who had lost his understanding, did not follow them.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: तस्मिंस्तु तुमुले भीष्मे प्रच्युते धरणीतले। न जाने कारणं किं तु येन युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: After Bhishma had been struck down on the carth, I do not know why the battle was fought on.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: मूढांस्तु सर्वथा मन्ये धार्तराष्ट्रान् सुबाललिशान्। पतिते शान्तनोः पुत्रे येऽकार्षुः संयुगं पुनः॥
en: I regard the son of Dhritarashtra as foolish and of weak understanding by every means since they continued the battle even after the fall of Shantanu's son.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: अनन्तरं च निहते द्रोणे ब्रह्मविदां वरे। राधेये च विकर्णे त नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: After that when Drona, that foremost of Brahmanas, as fell, as also the son of Radha and Vikartana, the battle did not stop.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: अल्पावशिष्टे सैन्येऽस्मिन् सूतपुत्रे च पातिते। सपुत्रे वै नरव्याघ्र नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: Even, when a residue only of the Kaurava army remained after the fall of that best of men, viz., Karna, with his sons the battle did not stop.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: श्रुतायुषि हते वीरे जलसन्धे च पौरवे। श्रुतायुधे च नृपतौ नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: After the fall of even the heroic Shrutayush, of also Jalasandha of Puru's race and of king Shrutayudha, the slaughter did not still cease.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: भूरिश्रवसि शल्ये च शाल्वे चैव जनार्दन। आवन्त्येषु च वीरेषु नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: After the death of Bhurishravas, of Shalya, O Janarddana and of the Avanti heroes, the slaughter did not still stop.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: जयद्रथे च निहते राक्षसे चाप्यलायुधे। बाह्निके सोमदत्ते च नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: After the fall of Jayadratha, of the Rakshasa Alayudha, of Valhika and of Somadatta the killing battle did not still stop.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: भगदत्ते हते शूरे काम्बोजे च सुदारुणे। दुःशासने च निहते नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: After the fall of the heroic Bhagadatta, of the Kamboja chief Sudakshina and of Dusshasana, the all-destroying battle did not still stop.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: दृष्ट्वा विनिहताशूरान् पृथड्याण्डलिकान् नृपान्। बलिनश्च रणे कृष्ण नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: Seeing the many heroic and powerful kings, each master of extensive territories' killed in a battle, the all-destroying battle, O Krishna, did not still stop.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: अक्षौहिणीपतीन् दृष्ट्वा भीमसेननिपातितान्। मोहाद् वा यदि वा लोभान्नैवाशाम्यत वैशसम्॥
en: Beholding even a full Akshauhini of troops slain by Bhimasena in battle, the all-destroying battle did not still stop on account of either the folly or the covetousness of the sons of Dhritarashtra.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: को नु राजकुले जातः कौरवेयो विशेषतः। निरर्थकं महद् वैरं कुर्यादन्यः सुयोधनात्॥
en: What king, born in noble family cspecially as one like that of Kuru, except the foolish Duryodhana, would thus create useless hostilities.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: गुणतोऽभ्यधिकाज्ञात्वा वलतः शौर्यतोऽपि वा। अमूढः को नु युद्ध्येत जानन् प्राज्ञो हिताहितम्॥
en: Who is there reasonable and wise and capable of distinguishing between good and evil, that would thus make a war, knowing his foes to be superior to him in merit, strength and bravery.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: यन्न तस्य मनो ह्यासीत् त्वयोक्तस्य हितं वचः। प्रशमे पाण्डवैः सार्ध सोऽन्यस्य शृणुयात् कथम्॥३४
en: How could he listen to the advice of another when, indeed, he could not make up his mind to make peace with the Pandavas following your advice.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: येन शान्तनवो वीरो द्रोणो विदुर एव च। प्रत्याख्याताः शमस्यार्थे किं नु तस्याद्य भेषजम्॥
en: What medicine can be agreeable to that man today who discovered Bhishma, the son of Shantanu and Drona and Vidura, while they urged him to make peace.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: मौाद येन पिता वृद्धः प्रत्याख्यातो जनार्दन। तथा माता हितं वाक्यं भाषमाणा हितैषिणी॥
en: How can be accept good advice who out of folly, O Janarddana, insolently disobeyed his own old father as also his own good mother who spoke wholesome words to him.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: प्रत्याख्याता ह्यसत्कृत्य स कस्मै रोचयेद् वचः। कुलान्तकरणो व्यक्तं जात एष जनार्दन॥
en: It is evident, O Janarddana, that Duryodhana is born for rooting out his family. His conduct and his policy, at least, speak the same, O lord. He will not give us our kingdom yet. This is my opinion, O Achyuta.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: तथास्य दृश्यते चेष्टा नीतिश्चैव विशाम्पते। नैष दास्यति नो राज्यमिति मे मतिरच्युत॥
en: The great Vidura, O sire, told me many a time that as long as Duryodhana would live, he would never give us our share of the kingdom.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: उक्तोऽहं बहुशस्तात विदुरेण महात्मना। न जीवन् दास्यते भागं धार्तराष्ट्रस्तु मानद॥ यावत् प्राणा धरिष्यन्ति धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्मतेः।
en: Vidura also told me-"As long as Dhritarashtra will live, O giver of honours that sinful man will act sinfully towards you.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: तावद् युष्मास्वपायेषु प्रचरिष्यति पापकम्॥ न च युक्तोऽन्यथा जेतुमृते युद्धेन माधव।
en: You will never succeed in defeating Duryodhana without battle." Thus, O Madhava, did the far-seeing Vidura often speak to me.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: इत्यब्रवीत् सदा मां हि विदुरः सत्यदर्शनः॥ तत् सर्वमद्य जानामि व्यवसायं दुरात्मनः।
en: All the Acts of that wicked man, I now find, to be exactly as the great Vidura had said.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: यदुक्तं वचनं तेन विदुरेण महात्मना॥ यो हि श्रुत्वा वचःपथ्यं जामदग्न्याद् यथातथम्। अवामन्यत दुर्बुद्धिर्बुवं नाशमुखे स्थितः॥
en: That wicked man, who having listened to the beneficial and proper worlds of Jamadagni's son, disobeyed them, should certainly be regarded as standing in the face of destruction.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: उक्तं हि बहुशः सिद्धैर्जातमात्रे सुयोधने। एनं प्राप्य दुरात्मानं क्षयं क्षत्रं गमिष्यति॥
en: Many saints and ascetics said, as soon as Duryodhana was born, that the entire Kshatriya race would be exterminated for that wretch.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: तदिदं वचनं तेषां निरुक्तं वै जनार्दन। क्षयं याता हि राजानो दुर्योधनकृते भृशम्॥ सोऽद्य सर्वान् रणे योधान् निहनिष्यामि माधव।
en: Those words of the sages, O Janarddana, have now borne fruits, because the Kshatriyas are undergoing almost entire extermination on account of Duryodhana's miss-deeds. I shall, O Madhava, kill all the warriors today.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: क्षत्रियेषु हतेष्वाशु शून्ये च शिबिरे कृते॥ वधाय चात्मनोऽस्माभिः संयुगं रोचयिष्यति।
en: After all the Kshatriyas will have been killed and the (Kaurava) camp made empty, Duryodhana will then wish for a battle with us for his own destruction.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: तदन्तं हि भवेद् वैरमनुमानेन माधव॥ एवं पश्यामि वार्ष्णेय चिन्तयन् प्रज्ञया स्वया। विदुरस्य च वाक्येन चेष्टया च दुरात्मनः॥ तस्माद् याहि चमू वीर यावद्धन्मि शितैः शरैः। दुर्योधनं महाबाहो वाहिनीं चास्य संयुगे॥
en: That will terminate these hostilities. Exercising my reason, O Madhava and reflecting in my own mind, O Vrishni heroe, thinking of Vidura's words and taking into account the acts of the wicked Duryodhana himself, I have arrived at this conclusion. Enter into Kuru division, O hero, for I shall kill the wicked Duryodhana and his army today with my keen arrows.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: क्षेममद्य करिष्यामि धर्मराजस्य माधव। हत्वैतद् दुर्बलं सैन्यं धार्तरष्ट्रस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Slaying this weak army in the very presence of Dhritarashtra's son, I shall today do what is for Yudhishthira's good."

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: संजय उवाच अभीषुहस्तो दाशार्हस्तथोक्तः सव्यसाचिना। तद् बलौघममित्राणामभीतः प्राविशद् बलात्॥
en: Thus addressed by Arjuna, the Dasharha heroe, with reins in hand, fearlessly penetrated that vest hostile army for battle.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: कुन्तखड्गशरै।रं शक्तिकण्टकसंकुलम्। गदापरिघपन्थानं रथनागमहाद्रुमम्॥
en: It was a terrible forest of bows. Darts were its prickles. Maces and bludgeons were its paths, Cars and elephants were its huge trees.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: हयपत्तिलताकीर्णं गाहमानो महायशाः। व्यचरत्तत्र गोविन्दो रथेनातिपताकिना॥
en: Cavalry and infantry were its creepers. And the illustrious Keshava, as he entered that forest on that car adorned with many banners and pennons, shone exceedingly resplendent.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: ते हयाः पाण्डुरा राजन् वहन्तोऽर्जुनमाहवे। दिक्षु सर्वास्वदृश्यन्त दाशार्हेण प्रचोदिताः॥
en: Those white horses, O king, bearing Arjuna in battle, were seen moving about on all sides urged by the Dasharha heroe.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: ततः प्रायाद् रथेनाजौ सव्यसाची परंतपः। किरशरशतांस्तीक्ष्णान् वारिधारा घनो यथा॥ प्रादुरासीन्महाशब्दः शराणां नतपर्वणाम्। इषुभिश्छाद्यमानानां समरे सव्यसाचिना॥ असज्जन्तस्तनुत्रेषु शरौघा: प्रापतन् भुवि।
en: Then that scorcher of foes, viz., Savyasachin, proceeded on his car, discharging hundreds of keen arrows like a cloud pouring showers of rain. Loud noise was produced by those straight arrows as also by those combatants that were covered with them in that battle by Savyasachin. Showers of arrows, piercing through the armour of the warriors, dropped down on the Earth.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शा गाण्डीवप्रेषिताः शराः॥ नरान् नागन् समाहृत्य हयांश्चापि विशाम्पते। अपतन्त रणे वाणाः पतङ्गा इव घोषिणः॥
en: Shot off the Gandiva, arrows, whose touch resembled that of Indra's thunder, striking men and elephants and horses, O king, fell in that battle with a noise like that of winged insects.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: आसीत् सर्वमवच्छन्नं गाण्डीवप्रेषितैः शरैः। न प्राज्ञायन्त समरे दिशो वा प्रदिशोऽपि वा॥ सर्वमासीजगत् पूर्णं पार्थनामाङ्कितैः शरैः।
en: Everything was covered with those shafts shot from Gandiva. In that battle, the points of the horizon could not be distinguished.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: रुक्मपुङस्तैलधौतैः कर्मारपरिमार्जितैः॥ ते दह्यमानाः पार्थेन पावकेनेव कुञ्जराः।
en: The entire earth was as if covered with gold-winged arrows, steeped in oil, polished by the hands of the smith and with Partha's name engraven on it.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: पार्थ न प्रजहुर्घोरा वध्यमानाः शितैः शरैः॥ शरचापधरः पार्थ: प्रज्वलन्निवः भास्करः। ददाह समरे योधान् कक्षमग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: Struck with those keen arrows and burnt therewith by Partha even as a herd of elephants is burnt with burning brands, the Kauravas were dispirited and weakened. Armed with bow and arrows, Partha, resembling the burning sun, consumed the hostile heroes in that battle like a blazing fire consuming a heap of dry grass.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: यथा वनान्ते वनपैर्विसृष्टः कक्षं दहेत् कृष्णगतिः सुघोषः। भूरिदुमं शुष्कलतावितानं भृशं समृद्धो ज्वलन: प्रतापी॥ एवं स नाराचगणप्रतापी शरार्चिरुचावचतिग्मतेजाः। ददाह सर्वां तव पुत्रसेना ममृष्यमाणस्तरसा तरस्वी॥
en: As increasing and blazing fire of great energy, thrown on the outskirts of a forest by its inhabitants, quickly consumes those woods abounding with tree and heaps oi dry creepers, even so that active and energetic hero, endued with prowess of weapons and having arrows his flames, quickly consumed all the troops of your son from anger.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: तस्येषवः प्राणहराः सुमुक्ता नासज्जन् वै वर्मसु रुक्मपुङ्खाः। न च द्वितीयं प्रमुमोच बाणं नरे हये वा परमद्विपे वा॥
en: His powerful gold-winged arrows, discharged with care, could not be baffled by any armour. He had not to discharge a second arrow at a man, horse or a huge elephant.

description: Arjuna bewails before Krishna, Arjuna goes to the field for killing Duryodhana
sn: अनेकरूपाकृतिभिर्हि बाणै महारथानीकमानुप्रविश्य। स एव एवैकस्तव पुत्रस्य सेनां जघान दैत्यानिव वज्रपाणिः॥
en: Like Indra, the wilder of thunderbolt, striking down the Daityas, Arjuna, alone entering that division of great car-warriors, destroyed it with arrows of various froms.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: संजय उवाच पश्यतां यतमानानां शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्। संकल्पमकरोन्मोघं गाण्डीवेन धनंजयः॥
en: Sanjaya said With his Gandiva, Dhananjaya baffled the purpose of those unretreating heroes struggling in battle and striking their enemies.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: इन्द्राशनिसमस्र्शानविषह्यान् महौजसः। विसृजन् दृश्यते बाणान् धारा मुञ्चनिवाम्बुदः॥
en: The arrows shot by Arjuna, irresistible and endued with great force and whose touch was like that of the thunder, resembled torrents of rain poured by a cloud.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: तत् सैन्यं भरतश्रेष्ठ वध्यमानं किरीटिना। सम्प्रदुद्राव संग्रामात् तव पुत्रस्य पश्यतः॥
en: That army, O chief of the Bharatas' thus struck by Kiritin, fled away before the very eyes of your son.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: पितॄन् भ्रातृन् परित्यज्य वयस्यानपि चापरे। हतधुर्या रथाः केचिद्धतसूतास्तथा परे॥
en: Some deserted their father and brothers and others their comrades. Some car-warriors lost their animals. Others lost their drivers. Some had their poles or yokes of wheels broken, O king.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: भग्नाक्षयुगचक्रेषाः केचिदासन्विशांपते। अन्येषां सायकाः क्षीणास्तथान्ये बाणपीडिताः॥ अक्षता युगपत् केचित् प्राद्रवन् भयपीडितः।
en: The arrows of some were exhausted. Some were assailed with arrows. Some, though unwounded, fled in a body, stricken with fear.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: केचित् पुत्रानुपादाय हतभूयिष्ठबान्धवः॥ विचुक्रुशुः पितुंस्त्वन्ये सहायानपरे पुनः।
en: Some tried to rescue their sons, having lost all their kinsmen and animals. Some loudly called their father, some their comrades and followers.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: बान्धवांश्च नरव्याघ्र भ्रातॄन् सम्बन्धिनस्तथा॥ दुद्रुवः केचिदुत्सृज्य तत्र तत्र विशाम्पते।
en: Some fled, leaving behind their kinsmen, O foremost of men and brothers and other relatives.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: बहवोऽत्र भृशं विद्धा मुह्यमाना महारथाः॥ निश्वसन्ति स्म दृश्यन्ते पार्थबाणहता: नराः।
en: Many great car-warriors, struck with Partha's arrows and deeply wounded therewith, breathed hard, deprived of their senses.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: तानन्ये रथमारोप्य ह्याश्वास्य च मुहूर्तकम्॥ विश्रान्ताश्च वितृष्णाश्च पुनर्युद्धाय जग्मिरे।
en: Others, taking them up on their own cars and soothing them for some time and resting them and satisfying their thirst by offering them drink, once more proceeded to battle.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: तानपास्य गताः केचित् पुनरेव युयुत्सवः॥ कुर्वन्तस्तव पुत्रस्य शासनं युद्धदुर्मदाः।
en: Leaving behind the wounded, some, incapable of being easily defeated in battle once more advanced to battle desirous of carrying out the commands of your son.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: पानीयमपरे पीत्वा पर्याश्वास्य च वाहनम्॥ वर्माणि च समारोप्य केचिद् भरतसत्तम। समाश्वास्यापरे भ्रातॄन् निक्षिप्य शिबिरेऽपि च॥ पुत्रानन्ये पितॄनन्ये पुनयुद्धमरोचयन्।
en: Some, having satisfied their thirst or rested their animals and some wearing (flesh) armours, O chief of the Bharatas and some, having comforted their brothers and sons and father and placed them in camp, once more came to battle.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: सजयित्वा रथान् किचिद् यथा मुख्यं विशाम्पते॥ आप्लुत्य पाण्डवानीकं पुनयुद्धमरोचयन्।
en: Some, arranging their cars in order, O king, of superiors and inferiors, proceeded against the Pandavas once more for battle.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: शूराः किङ्किणीजालैः समाच्छन्ना बभासिरे॥ त्रैलोक्यविजये युक्ता यथा दैतेयदानवाः। ते
en: On their cars adorned with rows of bells, those heroes shone like Daityas and Danavas desirous of conquering the three worlds.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: आगम्य सहसा केचिद् रथैः स्वर्णविभूषितैः॥ पाण्डवानामनीकेषु धृष्टद्युम्नमयोधयन्।
en: Some, advancing quickly on their cars decked with gold, fought with Dhrishtadyumna amid the Pandava army.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नोऽपि पाञ्चाल्यः शिखण्डी च महारथः॥ नाकुलिस्तु शतानीको रथानीकमयोधयन्।
en: The Panchala prince Dhrishtadyumna and the great car-warrior Shikhandin and Shatanika the son of Nakula, fought with the car-division of the enemy.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: पाञ्चाल्यस्तु ततः क्रुद्धः सैन्येन पहाताऽऽवृतः॥ अभ्यद्रवत् सुसंक्रुद्धस्तावकान् हन्तुमुद्यतः।
en: Worked up with rage and supported by a large army, the Panchala prince rushed against your infuriated soldiers from desire of killing them.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: ततस्त्वापततस्तस्य तव पुत्रो जनाधिप॥ बाणसंघाननेकान् वै प्रेषयामास भारता
en: Then your son, O king, discharged many arrows, O Bharata, at the Panchala prince thus rushing at hiin.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्ततो राजंस्तव पुत्रेण धन्विना॥ नाराचैरर्धनाराचैर्बहुभिः क्षिप्रकारिभिः।
en: Then O king, Dhrishtadyumna was quickly cut with many arrows in his arms and chest by your son fighting with his bow.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: वत्सदन्तैश्च बाणैश्च कर्मारपरिमार्जितैः॥ अश्वांश्च चतुरो हत्वा बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्। सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासस्तोत्रादित इव द्विपः॥ तस्याश्वांश्चतुरो बाणैः प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे। सारथेश्चास्य भल्लेन शिरः कायादपाहरत्॥
en: Deeply cut therewith like an elephant with pointed lances, then great bowman then killed with his arrows the four horses of Duryodhana. With another broad-headed arrow he sundered, from his trunk; the head of his enemy's driver.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा पृष्ठमारुह्य वाजिनः। अपाक्रामद्धतरथो नातिदूरमरिंदमः॥ ते
en: Then that grinder of foes, viz., king Duryodhana, having thus lost his car, rode on horseback and retreated to a little distance.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: दृष्ट्वा तु हतविक्रान्तं स्वमनीकं महाबलः। तव पुत्रो महाराज प्रययौ यत्र सौबलः॥
en: Beholding his own army thus enfeebled, your son, the mighty Duryodhana, O king, proceeded where Subala's son was.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: ततो रथेषु भग्नेषु त्रिसाहस्रा महाद्विपाः। पाण्डवान् रथिनः सर्वान् समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्॥
en: When the Kaurava cars were broken, the thousand huge elephants encompassed those car-warriors, viz., the five Pandavas.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: वृताः समरे पञ्च गजानीकेन भारत) अशोभन्त महाराज ग्रहा व्याप्ता घनैरिव॥
en: Encompassed by that elephant, O Bharata, the five brothers looked beautiful, O foremost of men, like the planets surrounded by the clouds.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: ततोऽर्जुनो महाराज लब्धलक्षो महा पुजः। विनिर्ययो रथेनैव श्वेताश्वः कृष्णसारथिः॥
en: Then the mighty-armed Arjuna, O king, of sure aim, having Krishna for his driver and white horses, advanced on his car.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: तैः समन्तात् परिवृतः कुञ्जरैः पर्वतोपमैः। नाराचैर्विमलैस्तीक्ष्णैर्गजानीकमयोधयत्॥
en: Surrounded by mountain-like elephants he began to destroy those animals with his keen and polished arrows.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: तत्रैकबाणनिहतानपश्याम महागजान्। पतितान् पात्यमानांश्च निर्भिन्नान् सव्यसाचिना॥
en: Each killed with a single arrows, we saw those huge elephants fallen or falling down, wounded by Savyasachin.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: भीमसेनस्तु तान् दृष्ट्वा नागान् मत्तगजोपमः। करेणादाय महतीं गदामभ्यपतद् बली॥ अथाप्लुत्य रथात् तूर्णं दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः।
en: The powerful Bhimasena, himself like an infuriate elephant, seeing those elephants, took up his formidable mace and rushed at them, quickly jumping down from his car, like the Destroyer armed with his club.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: तमुद्यतगदं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवानां महारथम्॥ वित्रेसुस्तावका: सैन्याः शकृन्मूत्रे च सुस्रवुः।
en: Seeing that great car-warrior of the Pandavas with uplifted mace, your soldiers were possessed by fear and passed urine and excreta.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: आविग्नं च बलं सर्वं गदाहस्ते वृकोदरे॥ गदया भीमसेनेव भिन्नकुम्भान् रजस्वलान्। धावमानानपश्याम कुञ्जरान् पर्वतोपमान्॥
en: The whole army were agitated upon seeing Bhimasena armed with mace. We then saw those elephants, huge as hills, running hither and thither, with their frontal globes cut open by Bhima with his mace and all their limbs covered with blood.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: प्राद्रवन् कुञ्जरास्ते तु भीमेसेनगदाहताः। पेतुरार्तस्वरं कृत्वा छिन्नपक्षा इवाद्रयः॥
en: Struck with Bhima's mace, those elephants, running off from him, dropped down crying like mountains with their wings cut off.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: प्रभिन्नकुम्भास्तु बहून् द्रवमाणानितस्ततः। पतमानांश्च सम्प्रेक्ष्य वित्रेसुस्तव सैनिकाः॥
en: Beholding those numberless elephants, with their frontal globes cut open, running hither and thither or falling down your soidiers were possessed by fear.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: युधिष्ठिरोऽपि संक्रुद्धो माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। गार्धपत्रै:शितैर्बाणैर्निन्युर्वै यमसादनम्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira also, worked up with anger and the two sons of Madri, began to kill those elephant-warriors with arrows having wings like those of vultures.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु समरे पराजित्य नराधिपम्। अपक्रान्ते तव सुते हयपृष्ठं समाश्रिते॥ दृष्ट्वा च पाण्डवान् सर्वान् कुञ्जरैः परिवारितान्।
en: Dhrishtadyumna, after the defeat of the Kuru king in battle and after the fight of the latter from that spot of horse-back, saw that the Pandavas had all been encircled by the Kaurava elephants.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज सहसा समुपाद्रवत्॥ पुत्रः पञ्चालराजस्य जिघांसुः कुञ्जरान् ययौ।
en: Beholding this, O king, Dhrishtadyumna, the son of the Panchala king proceeded towards those elephants to kill them.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: अदृष्ट्वा तु स्थानीके दुर्योधनमरिंदमम्॥ अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः। अपृच्छन् क्षत्रियांस्तत्र क्व नु दुर्योधनो गतः॥
en: In the meantime not seeing Duryodhana in the midst of the car-force, Ashvathaman and Kripa, the Kritavarman of the Satwata race, asked all the Kshatriyas, saying-"Where had Duryodhana gone.'

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: ते पश्यमाना राजानं वर्तमाने जनक्षये। मन्वाना निहतं तत्र तव पुत्रं महारथाः॥ विवर्णवदना भूत्वा पर्यपृच्छन्त ते सुतम्।
en: Not seeing the king in the midst of that onslaught all those great car-warriors took him for dead and therefore with sorrowful faces, they enquired after him.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: आहुः केचिद्धते सूते प्रयातो यत्र सौबलः॥ हित्वा पञ्चालराजस्य तदनीकं दुरुत्सहम्।
en: Some told them that after the destruction of his driver, he had gone to Subala's son.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: अपरे त्वब्रुवंस्तत्र क्षत्रिया भृशविक्षताः॥ दुर्योधनेन किं कार्य द्रक्ष्यध्वं यदि जीवति। युद्ध्यध्वं सहिताः सर्वे किं वो राजा करिष्यति॥४४
en: Others, who had been greatly wounded said-"What necessity is there with Duryodhana. See, if he is yet alive. Do you all fight in a body, what will the king do to you."

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: ते क्षत्रियाः क्षतैर्गात्रैर्हतभूयिष्ठवाहनाः। शरैःसम्पीड्यमानास्तु नातिव्यक्तमथाब्रुवन्॥
en: Other Kshatriyas, who were greatly wounded and who had lost many of their relatives and who were still being struck with the arrows of the enemy, said these words indistinctly.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: इदं सर्व बलं हन्मो येन स्म परिवारिताः। एते सर्वे गजान हत्वा उपयान्ति स्म पाण्डवाः॥
en: "Let us kill these forces by whom we are encircled. See the Pandavas are coming here after having killed the elephants.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषामश्वत्थामा महाबलः। भित्वा पाञ्चालराजस्य तदनीकं दुरुत्सहम्॥ कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च प्रययौ यत्र सौबलः। रथानीकं परित्यज्य शूराः सुदृढधन्विनः॥
en: Hearing these words, the powerful Ashvatthaman, cutting through that irresistible force of the Panchala king, went with Kripa and Kritavarman, where Subala's son was. Infect leaving the car-force, those heroes, those firm bowmen, went to find out Duryodhana.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: ततस्तेषु प्रयातेषु धृष्टद्युम्नपुरस्कृताः। आययुः पाण्डवा राजन् विनिघ्नन्तः स्म तावकम्॥४९
en: After their departure, the Pandavas, headed by Dhrishtadyumna, advanced, O king and began to kill their enemies.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: दृष्ट्वा तु तानापततः सम्प्रहृष्टान् महारथान्। पराक्रान्तास्ततो वीरा निराशा जीविते तदा॥
en: Beholding those brave, heroic and powerful car-warriors rushing joyously towards them, your soldiers, whose faces grew pale, became despondent of their lives.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: विवर्णमुखभूयिष्ठमभवत् तावकं बलम्। परिक्षीणायुधान् दृष्ट्वा तानहं परिवारितान्॥ राजन् बलेन व्यतेन त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः। आत्मना पञ्चमोऽयुद्ध्यं पाञ्चालस्य बलेन ह॥ तस्मिन् देशे व्यवस्थाय यत्र शारद्वतः स्थितः।
en: Beholding those soldiers of ours almost deprived of weapons and surrounded by the enemy, I myself, O king, having only two kinds of forces and caring for life, joined the five leaders of our army and fought with the forces of the Panchala prince and placed our men where Sharadvata's son was.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: सम्प्रदुता वयं पञ्च किरीटिशरपीडिताः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं महारौद्रं तत्र नोऽभूद् रणो महान्। जितास्तेन वयं सर्वे व्यपयाम रणात् ततः॥
en: We had been cut with the arrows of Arjuna and still a fierce encounter took place between us and the army of Dhrishtadyumna. At last, defeated by the latter, all of us retreated from that battle.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: अथापश्यं सात्यकि तमुपायान्तं महारथम्। रथैश्चतु:शतैर्वीरो मामभ्यद्रवदाहवे॥
en: I then beheld the great car-warrior Satyaki rushing against us. With four hundred cars that hero pursued me in battle.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नादहं मुक्तः कथंचिच्छ्रान्तवाहनात्। पतिता माधवानीकं दुष्कृती नरकं यथा॥ तत्र युद्धमभूद् घोरं मुहूर्तमतिदारुणम्।
en: Having escaped with difficulty from Dhrishtadyumna whose horses had been exhausted, I feel among the soldiers of Madhava even as a sinner falleth into hell. There a fierce and terrible encounter took place for a short time.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: सात्यकिस्तु महाबाहुर्मम हत्वा परिच्छदम्॥ जीवग्राहमगृह्णान्मां मूर्छितं पतितं भुवि।
en: The mighty-armed Satyaki, having cut off my armour, thought of taking me alive. He caught me while I lay down on the ground insensible.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: ततो मुहूर्तादिव तद् गजानीकमविध्यत॥ गदया भीमसेनेन नाराचैरर्जुनेन च।
en: Then within a short time that elephant force was killed by Bhimasena with his mace and Arjuna with his arrows.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: अभिपिष्टैर्महानागैः समन्तात् पर्वतोपमैः॥ नातिप्रसिद्धैव गतिः पाण्डवानामजायत।
en: On account of those mighty elephants, huge as hills, falling down on every side with wounded limbs, the Pandava warriors found their way entirely blocked up.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: रथमार्ग ततश्चक्रे भीमसेनो पहाबलः॥ पाण्डवानां महाराज व्यपाकर्षन्महागजान्।
en: Then the powerful Bhimasena, O king, dragging away those huge elephants, made a way for the Pandavas.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः॥ अपश्यन्तो स्थानीके दुर्योधनमरिंदमम्। राजानं मृगयामासुस्तव पुत्रं महारथम्॥
en: Meanwhile not seeing that chastiser of foes Duryodhana amid the car-division, Ashvatthaman and Kripa and Kritavarman of the Satwata race, tried to find out your royal son.

description: The fight between Dhristadyumna and Duryodhana
sn: परित्यज्य च पाञ्चाल्यं प्रयाता यत्र सौबलः। राज्ञोऽदर्शनसंविग्ना वर्तमाने जनक्षये॥
en: Leaving the prince of the Panchalas they proceeded where Subala's son was, anxious to see the king during that terrible onslaught.

sn: संजय उवाच गजानीके हते तस्मिन् पाण्डुपुत्रेण भारत। वध्यमाने बले चैव भीमसेनेन संयुगे॥ चरन्तं च तथा दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनमरिंदमम्। दण्डहस्तं यथा क्रुद्धमन्तकं प्राणहारिणम्॥ समेत्य समरे राजन् हतशेषाः सुतास्तव। अदृश्यमाने कौरव्ये पुत्रे दुर्योधने तव॥
en: Sanjaya said On the elephant division being destroyed, O Bharata, by the son of Pandu and while your army was being thus killed by Bhimasena in battle beholding the latter, that chastiser of foes-moving about like the all-killing. Destroyer himself in rage armed with his club, your remaining sons, O king, united together at that time, when your son Duryodhana could not be seen, rushed against Bhimasena.

sn: सोदर्याः सहिता भूत्वा भीमसेनमुपाद्रवन्। दुर्मर्षणः श्रुतान्तश्च जैत्रौ भूरिबलो रविः॥ जयत्सेनः सुजातश्च तथा दुर्विषहोऽरिहा। दुर्विमोचननामा च दुष्प्रधर्षस्तथैव च॥
en: They were Durmarshana, Shrutants, Jaitra, Bhurivala, Ravi, Jayatsena Sujata and that slayer of foes, viz., Durvishaha and he called Durvimochana and Dushpradharsha and the mighty-armed Shrutarvan. A:l of them were experts in battle.

sn: श्रुतर्वा च महाबाहुः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः। इत्येते सहिता भूत्वा तव पुत्राः समन्ततः॥
en: These sons of thine, in a body, rushed against Bhimasena and encircled him.

sn: भीमसेनमभिद्रुत्य रुरुधुः सर्वतोदिशम्। ततो भीमो महाराज स्वरथं पुनरास्थितः॥
en: Then Bhima, O monarch, once more getting on his own car, began to shoot keen arrows at the vital limbs of your sons.

sn: मुमोच निशितान् बाणान् पुत्राणां तव मर्मसु। ते कीर्यमाणा भीमेन पुत्रास्तव महारणे॥
en: Those sons of yours, covered with arrows by Bhimasena in that dreadful encounter, began to drag that warrior like men dragging an elephant from the crossing point.

sn: भीमसेनमुपासेदुः प्रवणादिव कुञ्जरम्। ततः क्रुद्धो रणे भीमः शिरो दुर्मर्षणस्य ह॥
en: Worked up with anger, Bhimasena, quickly cut off the head of Durmarshana with a razorheaded arrow and threw it on the Earth.

sn: क्षुरप्रेण प्रमथ्याशु पातयामास भूतले। ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन सर्वावरणभेदिना॥ श्रुतान्तमवधीद् भीमस्तव पुत्रं महारथः।
en: With another broad-headed arrow capable of cutting through every armour, Bhima next killed the great car-warrior, viz., your son Shrutanta.

sn: जयत्सेनं ततो विद्ध्वा नाराचेन हसन्निव॥ पातायामास कौरव्यं रथोपस्थादरिंदमः। स पपात स्थाद् राजन् भूमौ तूर्णं ममार च॥
en: Then striking Jayatsena easily with a clothyard shaft, that chastiser of foes, viz., the son of Pandu, struck down that action of Kuru's race from his car. The prince, O king, dropped down and immediately died.

sn: श्रुतर्वा तु ततो भीमं क्रुद्धो विव्याध मारिष। शतेन गृध्रवाजानां शराणां नतपर्वणाम्॥
en: Thereat your son Shrutarvan, worked up with rage, struck Bhima with a hundred straight arrows winged with feathers of vultures.

sn: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे भीमो जैत्रं भूरिबलं रविम्। त्रीनेतांस्त्रिभिरानईद द्विषाग्निप्रतिमैः शरैः॥
