en: Then Bhima, worked up with rage, struck Jaitra and Ravi and Bhuribala, with three arrows resembling poison or fire.

sn: ते हता न्यपतन् भूमौ स्यन्दनेभ्यो महारथाः। वसन्ते पुष्पशबला निकृत्ता इव किंशुकाः॥
en: Those great car-warrior, thus struck, dropped down from their cars like Kinshukas blossoming in the spring.

sn: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन तीक्ष्णेन च परंतपः। दुर्विमोचनमाहत्य प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥
en: Then that scorcher of foes, with another broad-headed and keen arrow, struck Durvimochana and killed him.

sn: स हतः प्रापतद् भूमौ स्वरथाद् रथिनां वरः। गिरेस्तु कूटजो भग्नो मारुतेनेव पादपः॥
en: Thus struck, that best of car-warriors fell down on the ground from his car, like a tree growing on the summit of a mountain uprooted by the storm.

sn: दुष्प्रधर्षं ततश्चैव सुजातं च सुतं तव। एकैकं न्यहनत् संख्ये द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां चमूमुखे॥ तौ शिलीमुखविद्धाङ्गौ पेततू रथसत्तमौ। ततः पतन्तं समरे अभिवीक्ष्य सुतं तव॥
en: The son of Pandu next struck your other two leading their forces, viz., Dushpradharsha and Sajata, each with a couple of arrows in that battle. Those two best of carwarriors, struck with those arrows, feil down.

sn: भल्लेन पातयामास भीमो दुर्विषहं रणे। स पपात हतो वाहात् पश्यतां सर्वधन्विनाम्॥
en: Beholding another son of yours viz., Durvishaha and rushing at him, Bhima struck him with a broad-headed arrow in that battle. That prince dropped down from his car before all the bowmen.

sn: दृष्ट्वा तु निहतान् भ्रातॄन् बहूनेकेन संयुगे। अमर्षवशमापन्नः श्रुतर्वा भीममभ्ययात्॥ विक्षिपन् सुमहसचापं कार्तस्वरविभूषितम्। विसृजन सायकांश्चैव विषाग्निप्रतिमान् बहून॥
en: Beholding so many of his brothers killed by Bhima alone in that battle, Shrutarvan, worked up with rage, rushed at Bhima, stretching his dreadful bow docket with gold and discharging a large number of arrows resembling poison or fire. sons

sn: स तु राजन् धनुश्छित्त्वा पाण्डवस्य महामृधे। अथैन छिन्नधन्वानं विंशत्या समवाकिरत्॥
en: Cutting off the bow of Pandu's son in that dreadful encounter, the Kuru prince struck the bowless Bhima with twenty arrows.

sn: ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय भीमसेनो महाबलः। अवाकिरत् तव सुतं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Then Bhimasena, that great car-warrior, taking up another bow, covered your son with arrows and said to him "Wait, wait."

sn: महदासीत् तयोर्युद्धं चित्ररूपं भयानकम्। यादृशं समरे पूर्वं जम्भवासवयोर्युधि॥
en: The encounter between the two was beautiful and dreadful, like that which took place in days of yore between Vasava and the Asura Jambha, O lord.

sn: तयोस्तत्र शितैर्मुक्तैर्यमदण्डनिभैः शरैः। समाच्छन्ना धरा सर्वा खं दिशो विदिशस्तथा॥
en: With the sharp arrows, resembling the dreadful rod of Yama, shot by those two warriors, the earth, the sky and all the points of the horizon were covered.

sn: ततः श्रुतर्वा संक्रुद्धो धनुरादाय सायकैः। भीमसेन रणे राजन् बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: Then excited with rage, Shrutarvan took up his bow and struck Bhimasena in that battle, O king, with many arrows on his arms and chest.

sn: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज तव पुत्रेण धन्विना। भीमः संचुक्षुभे क्रुद्धः पर्वणीव महोदधिः॥
en: Deeply cut, О king by your son armed with the bow, Bhima grew exceedingly agitated like the ocean at the full or the new moon.

sn: ततो भीमो रुषाविष्ट पुत्रस्य तव मारिष। सारथि चतुरश्वाश्वाशरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥
en: Excited with ire Bhima then, O sire, killed with his arrows the driver and the four horses of your son.

sn: विरथं तं समालक्ष्य विशिखैोमवाहिभिः। अवाकिरदमेयात्मा दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम्॥
en: Beholding him carless and displaying the lightness of his hand the great son of Pandu covered him with winged arrows.

sn: श्रुतर्वा विरथो राजन्नाददे खड्गचर्मणी। अथास्याददतः खङ्गं शतचन्द्रं च भानुमत्॥ क्षुरप्रेण शिरः कायात् पातायामास पाण्डवः।
en: The carless Shrutarvan then, O king, took up a sword and shield. As the prince, however, moved about with his sword and shinning shield effulgent like a hundred moons, the son of Pandu cut off his head with a razor-headed arrow and dropped it on the earth.

sn: छिन्नोत्तमाङ्गस्य ततः क्षुरप्रेण महात्मना॥ पपात कायः स रथाद् वसुधामनुनादयन्।
en: The trunk of that great warrior, whose head was cut off by that razor-headed arrow, fell down from his car filling the earth with a loud noise.

sn: तस्मिन् निपतिते वीरे तावका भयमोहिताः॥ अभ्यद्रवन्त संग्रामे भीमसेनं युयुत्सवः।
en: Upon the death of that hero, your soldiers, though terror-stricken, rushed in that battle against Bhimasena for fighting with him.

sn: तानापतत एवाशु हतशेषाद् बलार्णवात्॥ दंशितान्प्रतिजग्राह भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। ते तु तं वै समासाद्य परिववः समन्ततः॥
en: The brave Bhimasena, clad in mail, received those warriors rushing quickly at him who were not killed amongst that ocean of troops. Approaching him, those warriors, encircled that hero on all sides.

sn: ततस्तु संवृतो भीमस्तावकान् निशितैः शरैः। पीडयामास तान् सर्वान् सहस्राक्ष इवासुरान्॥
en: Thus surrounded by those warriors, Bhima began to assail them all with sharp arrows like the thousand-eyed deity assailing the Asuras.

sn: ततः पञ्चशतान् हत्वा सवरूथान् महारथान्। जघान कुञ्जरानीकं पुनः सप्तशतं युधि॥
en: Having destroyed five hundred great cars with their fences, he again killed seven hundred elephants in that battle.

sn: हत्वा शतसहस्राणि पत्तीनां परमेषुभिः। वाजिनां च शतान्यष्टौ पाण्डवः स्म विराजते॥
en: Slaying next ten thousand infantry with his strong shafts, as also eight hundred horses, the son of Pandu shone there.

sn: भीमसेनस्तु कौन्तेयो हत्वा युद्धे सुतांस्तव। मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं सफलं जन्म च प्रभो॥
en: Indeed, having killed your sons in that battle, Bhimasena, the son of Kunti, regarded his object accomplished, O lord and birth fruitful.

sn: तं तथा युद्ध्यमानं च विनिघ्नन्तं च तावकान्। ईक्षितुं नोत्सहन्ते स्म तव सैन्या नराधिप॥
en: Your soldiers, at that time, O Bharata, dared not even took at that warrior who was fighting in that fashion and killing your men in that way.

sn: विद्राव्य च कुरुन् सर्वांस्तांश्च हत्वा पदानुगान्। दोर्ध्या शब्दं ततश्चक्रे त्रासयानो महाद्विपान्॥
en: Scattering all the Kurus and killing their followers Bhima then slapped his armpits, terrifying the huge elephants with the noise.

sn: हतभूयिष्ठयोधा तु तव सेना विशाम्पते। किंचिच्छेषा महाराज कृपणं समपद्यत॥
en: Then your army, O king, which had lost a very large number of men and consisted of a very few soldiers, became highly depressed. O king.

sn: भीमसेनस्तु कौन्तेयो हत्वा युद्धे सुतांस्तव। मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं सफलं जन्म च प्रभो॥
en: Indeed, having killed your sons in that battle, Bhimasena, the son of Kunti, regarded his object accomplished, O lord and birth fruitful.

sn: तं तथा युद्ध्यमानं च विनिघ्नन्तं च तावकान्। ईक्षितुं नोत्सहन्ते स्म तव सैन्या नराधिप॥
en: Your soldiers, at that time, O Bharata, dared not even took at that warrior who was fighting in that fashion and killing your men in that way.

sn: विद्राव्य च कुरुन् सर्वांस्तांश्च हत्वा पदानुगान्। दोर्ध्या शब्दं ततश्चक्रे त्रासयानो महाद्विपान्॥
en: Scattering all the Kurus and killing their followers Bhima then slapped his armpits, terrifying the huge elephants with the noise.

sn: हतभूयिष्ठयोधा तु तव सेना विशाम्पते। किंचिच्छेषा महाराज कृपणं समपद्यत॥
en: Then your army, O king, which had lost a very large number of men and consisted of a very few soldiers, became highly depressed. O king.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: संजय उवाच दुर्योधनो महाराज सुदर्शश्चापि ते सुतः। हतशेषौ तदा संख्ये वाजिमध्ये व्यवस्थितौ॥
en: Sanjaya said Duryodhana, O king and your Sudarsha, the only two of your children who were not killed, were at that time in the midst of the Kauravas cavalry.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: ततो दुर्योधनं दृष्ट्वा वाजिमध्ये व्यवस्थितम्। उवाच देवकीपुत्रः कुन्तीपुत्रं धनंजयम्॥ शत्रवो हतभूयिष्ठा ज्ञातयः परिपालिताः। गृहीत्वा संजयं चासौ निवृत्तः शिनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Seeing Duryodhana in the midst of the cavalry, Krishna said to Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti:-"A large number of our enemies, relations that had received our protection, have been killed. There that best of Shini's race is returning, having taken Sanjaya captive.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: परिश्रान्तश्च नकुलः सहदेवश्च भारत। योधयित्वा रणे पापान् धार्तराष्ट्रान् सहानुगान्॥
en: Both Nakula and Sahadeva, O Bharata, are worn out having fought with the wretched। Dhartarashtras and their followers.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: दुर्योधनमभित्यज्य त्रय एते व्यवस्थिताः। कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च द्रौणिश्चैव महारथः॥
en: Those there, viz., Kripa and Kritavarman and the great car-warrior Ashvatthaman, have left Duryodhana's side and taken up their positions elsewhere.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: असौ तिष्ठति पाञ्चाल्यः श्रिया परमया युतः। दुर्योधनबलं हत्वा सह सर्वैः प्रभद्रकैः॥
en: Having killed Duryodhana's soldiers, the beautiful Panchala prince is waiting there in the midst of the Prabhadrakas.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: असौ दुर्योधनः पार्थ वाजिमध्ये व्यवस्थितः। छत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन प्रेक्षमाणो मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: There, O Partha, Duryodhana is in the midst of his cavalry, with the umbrella held over his head and looking all around.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: प्रतिव्यूह्य बलं सर्वं रणमध्ये व्यवस्थितः। एनं हत्वा शितैर्बाणैः कृतकृत्यो भविष्यसि॥
en: Having re-arranged the remnant of his army, he waits in the midst of his forces. Killing this one with your keen arrows you may achieve all your objects.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: गजानीकं हतं दृष्ट्वा त्वां च प्राप्तमरिंदम। यावन्न विद्रवन्त्यते तावञ्जहि सुयोधनम्॥
en: As long as these troops do not fly away seeing you in their midst and witnessing also the destruction of their elephant force, do you, O chastiser of foes, try to kill Duryodhana.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: यातु कश्चित्तु पाञ्चाल्यं क्षिप्रमागम्यतामिति। परिश्रान्तबलस्तात नैष मुच्येत किल्विषी॥
en: Let somebody go to the Panchala prince and ask him to come here. The Kaurava troops are all exhausted. O sire, the sinful Duryodhana will never succeed in escaping.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: हत्वा तव बलं सर्वं संग्रामे धृतराष्ट्रजः। जितान् पाण्डुसुतान् मत्वा रूपं धारयते महत्॥
en: Having killed a large number your soldiers in battle the son of Dhritarashtra looks highly delighted as if he believes that the Pandavas have been defeated.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: निहतं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा पीडितं चापि पाण्डवैः। ध्रुवमेष्यति संग्रामे वधायैवात्मनो नृपः॥ एवमुक्तः फल्गुनस्तु कृष्णं वचनमब्रवीत। धृतराष्ट्रसुताः सर्वे हता भीमेन माधव॥ यावेतावास्थितौ कृष्ण तावद्य न भविष्यतः।
en: Seeing his own soldiers assailed and killed by the Pandavas, the Kuru king will certainly come to battle for his own destruction.”—Thus addressed by Krishna, Phalguna said to him:"almost all the sons of Dhritarashtra, O giver of honours, have been killed by. Bhirna. Only these two still survive; they however, O Krishna, shall also be killed today.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: हतो भीष्मो हतो द्रोणः कर्णो वैकर्तनो हतः॥ मद्रराजो हत: शल्यो हतः कृष्ण जयद्रथः।
en: Bhishma has been killed, Drona has been killed, Karna has been killed, Shalya, the king of the Madras, has been killed and Jayadratha also, O Krishna, has been killed.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: हयाः पञ्चशताः शिष्टाः शकुनेः सौबलस्य च॥ रथानां तु जनार्दन। दन्तिनां च शतं साग्रं त्रिसाहस्राः पदातयः॥
en: Only five hundred cavalry constitute the army of Shakuni the son of Subala. Only two hundred still remain, of cars, O Janarddana. Of elephants the only remnant is a hundred and of foot only three thousand.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव त्रिगर्ताधिपतिस्तथा। उलूकः शकुनिश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः॥
en: There remain also Ashvatthaman and Kripa and the king of the Trigartas and Uluka and Shakuni and Kritavarman of the Satwata race.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: एतद् बलमभूच्छेष धार्तराष्ट्रस्य माधव। मोक्षो न नूनं कालात् तु विद्युते भुवि कस्यचित्।
en: These, O Madhava, are the remnant of Duryodhana's army. Truly no body will escape from death.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: शते शिष्टे द्वे एव तु अद्याह्ना हि महाराजो हतामित्रो भविष्यति॥ न हि मे मोक्ष्यते कश्चित् परेषामिह चिन्तये।
en: Although such a great slaughter has taken place. Duryodhana is still alive. Today king Yudhishthira, however, will be shorn of all his foes. None of my enemies will escape me, today.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: त्वद्य समरं कृष्ण न हास्यन्ति मदोत्कटाः॥ तान् वै सर्वान् हनिष्यामि यद्यपि स्युर्न मानुषाः।
en: Even if they be superhuman beings, O Krishna! I shall yet kill all those warriors today if only they do not fly away from the battlefield.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: अद्य युद्धे सुसंक्रुद्धो दीर्घं राज्ञा प्रमागरम्॥ अपनेष्यामि गान्धारं घातयित्वा शितैः शरैः।
en: Worked up with wrath in today's battle, I shall, by killing the prince of Gandhara with my keen arrows, remove that sleeplessness which the king has suffered from for a long time.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: निकृत्या वै दुराचारो यानि रत्नानि सौबलः॥ सभायामहरद् द्यूते पुनस्तान्याहराम्यहम्।
en: I shall regain all those valuable properties which Subala's wicked son won from us at the gambling match.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: अद्य ता अपि रोत्स्यन्ति सर्वा नागपुरे स्त्रियः॥ श्रुत्वा पतींश्च पुत्रांश्च पाण्डवैर्निहतान् युधि।
en: Hearing of the destruction of their husbands and sons at the hands of the Pandavas in battle, all the ladies of Hastinapur will cry.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: समाप्तमद्य वै कर्म सर्वं कृष्ण भविष्यति॥ अद्य दुर्योधनो दीप्ता श्रियं प्राणांश्च मोक्ष्यति
en: Today, O Krishna, our task will be finished. Today Duryodhana shall be divorced from his prosperity and life.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: नापयाति भयात् कृष्णं संग्रामाद् यदि चेन्मम॥ निहतं विद्धि वार्ष्णेय धार्तराष्ट्रं सुबालिशम्।
en: take the foolish of Dhritarashtra as dead, O Vrishni hero, if, O Krishna, he does not today fly away from the battle,

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: मम ह्येतदशक्तं वै वाजिवृन्दमरिन्दम॥ सोढुं ज्यातलनिर्घोषं याहि यावनिहन्म्यहम्।
en: You may son Those horses cannot bear the twang of my bow and the slaps of my palms. Proceed there, OKrishna, for I will kill them.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: एवमुक्तस्तु दाशार्हः पाण्डवेन यशस्विना॥ अचोदयद्धयान् राजन् दुर्योधनबलं प्रति।
en: Thus accosted by Pandu's son of great mental strength, the Dasarha heroe urged his horses, O king, towards Duryodhana's detachment.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: तदनीकमभिप्रेक्ष्य त्रयः सज्जा महारथाः॥ भीमसेनोऽर्जुनश्चैव सहदेवश्च मारिष। प्रययुः सिंहनादेन दुर्योधनजिघांसया॥
en: Beholding that force, three great carwarriors prepared themselves for striking it, for Bhimasena and Arjuna and Sahadeva, O sire, in a body, proceeded against it with loud leonine roars in order to kill Duryodhana.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: तान् प्रेक्ष्य सहितान् सर्वाञ्जवेनोद्यतकार्मुकान्। सौबलोऽभ्यद्रवद् युद्धे पाण्डवानाततायिनः॥
en: Beholding those three warriors rushing quickly together with uplifted bows, Subala's son proceeded against the Pandavas.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: सुदर्शनस्तव सुतो भीमसेनं समभ्ययात्। सुशर्मा शकुनिश्चैव युयुधाते किरीटिना॥ सहदेवं तव सुतो हयपृष्ठगतोऽभ्ययात्।
en: Your son Sudarshana rushed against Bhimasena. Susharman and Shakuni met with Kiritin. Your son Duryodhana on horse back proceeded against Sahadeva.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: ततो हि यत्नतः क्षिप्रं तव पुत्रो जनाधिप॥ प्रासेन सहदेवस्य शिरसि प्राहरद् भृशम्।
en: Then your son, O king, with great speed and care, forcibly struck Sahadeva's head with a lance.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: सोपाविशद् रथोपस्थे तव पुत्रेण ताडितः॥ रुधिराप्लुतसर्वाङ्ग आशीविष इव श्वसन्।
en: Thus struck by your son, Sahadeva sat down on his car, all his limbs being covered with blood and himself breathing like a snake.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञा सहदेवो विशाम्पते॥ दुर्योधनं शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः संक्रुद्धः समवाकिरत्।
en: Reigning his consciousness then, O king, Sahadeva, in anger, covered Duryodhana with keen shafts.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: पार्थोऽपि युधि विक्रम्य कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥ शूराणामश्वपृष्ठेभ्यः शिरांसि निचकर्त ह।
en: Kunti's son Dhananjaya, otherwise called Partha, displaying his prowess, sundered the heads of many brave warriors on horse back.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: तदनीकं तदा पार्थो व्यधमद् बहुभिः शरैः॥ पातयित्वा हयान् सर्वास्त्रिगर्तानां रथान् ययौ।
en: Indeed, Partha, with many arrows, destroyed that (cavalry). Having. killed all the horses, he then proceeded against the cars of the Trigartas.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: ततस्ते सहिता भूत्वा त्रिगर्तानां महारथाः॥ अर्जुनं वासुदेवं च शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्।
en: Thereat the great car warriors of the Trigartas, in a body, covered Arjuna and Vasudeva with showers of arrows.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: सत्यकर्माणमाक्षिप्य क्षुरप्रेण महायशाः॥ ततोऽस्य स्यन्दनस्येषां चिच्छिदे पाण्डुनन्दनः।
en: Assailing Satyakarman with a razor-headed arrow, the illustrious son of Pandu, sundered his antagonist's car-shafts.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: शिलाशितेन च विभो क्षुरप्रेण महायशाः॥ शिरश्चिच्छेद सहसा तप्तकुण्डलभूषणम्।
en: With another razor-headed arrow, O lord whetted on stone, that illustrious hero, smiling cut off his antagonist's head crown adorned with a golden.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: सत्येषुमध चादत्त योधानां मिषतां ततः॥ यथा सिंहो वने राजन् मृगं परिबुभुक्षितः।
en: He next attacked Satyeshu before all the warriors, like hungry lion, O king, in the forest, attacking a deer.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: तं निहत्य ततः पार्थः सुशर्माण: त्रिभिः शरैः॥ विद्ध्वा तानहनत् सर्वान् रथान् रुक्मविभूषितान्।
en: Having killed him, Partha struck Susharman with three arrows and then killed all those carwarriors bedecked with golden ornaments.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: ततः प्रायात् त्वरन् पार्थो दीर्घकालं सुसंवृतम्॥ मुञ्चन् क्रोधविषं तीक्ष्णं प्रस्थलाधिपतिं प्रति।
en: He then proceeded with great force against Susharman the king of Prasthala, displaying his anger cherished for many long years.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: तमर्जुनः पृषत्कानां शतेन भरतर्षभ॥ पूरयित्वा ततो वाहान् प्राहरत् तस्य धन्विनः।
en: Covering him, first, O foremost of Bharata's race, with a hundred arrows Arjuna then killed all the horses of that bowman,

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: ततः शरं समादाय यमदण्डोपमं तदा॥ सुशर्माणं समुद्दिश्य चिक्षेपाशु हसन्निव।
en: Fixing then a strong arrow that resembled the rod of Yama, Partha, smiling, quickly shot it at Susharman, aiming it at him.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: स शरः प्रेषितस्तेन क्रोधदीप्तेन धन्विना॥ सुशर्माण समासाद्य बिभेद हृदयं रणे।
en: Shot by that bowman chaffing with wrath, that arrow reaching Susharman, passed through his heart in that battle.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: स गतासुमहाराज पपात धरणीतले॥ नन्दयन् पाण्डवान् सर्वान् व्यथयंश्चापि तावकान्।
en: O king, Susharman fell down dead on the earth, gladdening all the Pandavas and distressing all your warriors.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: शुशर्माणं रणे हत्वा पुत्रानस्य महारथान्॥ सप्त चाष्टौ च त्रिंशच्च सायकैरनयत् क्षमम्।
en: Having killed Susharman in that battle, Partha then, with his arrow, killed the five and thirty sons of that king, all of whom were great car-warriors.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: ततोऽस्य निशितैर्बाणैः सर्वान् हत्वा पदानुगान्॥ अभ्यगाद् भारती सेनां हतशेषां महारथः।
en: Killing next all the followers, of Susharman with his keen arrows, the great car-warrior Arjuna proceeded against the remnant of the Bharata army.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: भीमस्तु समरे क्रुद्धः पुत्रं तव जनाधिप॥ सुदर्शनमदृश्यं तं शरैश्चक्रे हसन्निव।
en: In that battle, filled with rage, O king, Bhima covered Sudarshana with his arrows.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: ततोऽस्य प्रहसन् क्रुद्धः शिरः कायादपाहरत्॥ क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन स हतः प्रापतद् भुवि।
en: Filled with rage, the son of Pandu, smiling, cut off his antagonist's head with a sharp razorheaded arrow. The prince fell down dead on the earth.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: तस्मिंस्तु निहते वीर ततस्तस्य पदानुगाः॥ परिववू रणे भीमं किरन्तो विविधाशरान्।
en: Upon the fall of that (Kuru) hero, his followers encircled Bhima in that battle, making a downpour of whetted arrows.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: ततस्तु निशितैर्बाणैस्तवानीकं वृकोदरः॥ इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शः : समन्तात् पर्यवाकिरत्। ततः क्षणेन तद् भीमो न्यहनद् भरतर्षभ॥
en: With keen arrows Vrikodara, however, whose touch resembled that of Indra's thunder, enshrouded the army around him. Within a very short time, Bhima killed them all, O foremost of Bharata's race.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: तेषु तूत्साद्यमानेषु सेनाध्यक्षा महारथाः। भीमसेनं समासाद्य ततोऽयुद्ध्यन्त भारत॥
en: Whilst they were being thus slain, many powerful Kaurava warriors, O Bharata, approached Bhima and began to fight with him.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: स तान् सर्वाशरैघोरैरवाकिरत पाण्डवः। तथैव तावका राजन् पाण्डवेयान् महारथान्॥
en: The son of Pandu, O king, enshrouded all of them with his arrows. In the same way your warriors, O king, covered the great carwarriors of the Pandavas with arrows from all sides.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: शरवर्षेण महता समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्। व्याकुलं तदभूत् सर्वं पाण्डवानां परैः सह॥
en: All the warriors then, of both sides thus fighting with one another, became exceedingly agitated.

description: The fights between Bhima and Sudarsha and the encounter of other warriors son
sn: तावकानां च समरे पाण्डवेयैर्युयुत्सताम्। तत्र योधास्तदा पेतुः परस्परसमाहताः। उभयोः सेनयो राजन् संशोचन्तः स्म बान्धवान्॥
en: Struck by one another, the warriors of both armies, O king, began to drop down, lamenting for their (deceased) relatives.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: संजय उवाच तस्मिन् प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे गजवाजिनरक्षये। शकुनिः सौबलो राजन् सहदेवं समभ्ययात्॥
en: Sanjaya said During the course of that battle which was so destructive of men and horses and elephants, Subala's son Shakuni, O king, proceeded against Sahadeva.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: ततोऽस्यापततस्तूर्णं सहदेवः प्रतापवान्। शरौघान् प्रेषयामास पतङ्गानिव शीघ्रगान्॥ उलूकश्च रणे भीमं विव्याध दशभिः शरैः।
en: The valiant Sahadeva, as Shakuni rushed quickly towards him, discharged shower of quick-coursing arrows at that warrior like a swarm of insects. At that time Uluka also met Bhima and struck him with ten arrows.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: शकुनिश्च महाराजं भीमं विद्ध्वा त्रिभिः शरैः॥ सायकानां नवत्या वै सहदेवमवाकिरत्।
en: O king, having struck Bhima with three arrows, Shakuni, meanwhile, covered Sahadeva with ninety.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: ते शूराः समरे राजन् समासाद्य परस्परम्॥ विव्यधुनिशितैर्बाणैः कङ्कबर्हिणवाजितैः। स्वर्णपुजैः शिलाधौतेराकर्णप्रहितैः शरैः॥
en: Indeed, O king, encountering one another in that battle, those heroes, struck one another with many Kanka and peacock feathered keen arrows winged with gold, whetted on stone and shot off the bow-string drawn to their ears.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: तेषां चापभुजोत्सृष्टा शरवृष्टिविशाम्पते। आच्छादयद् दिशः सर्वा धारा इव पयोमुचः॥
en: Those showers of arrows discharged from their bows and arms, O monarch, covered all the points of the horizon like a thick downpour of rain poured from the clouds.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे भीमः सहदेवश्च भारत। चेरतुः कदनं संख्ये कुर्वन्तौ सुमहाबलौ॥
en: Then Bhima, worked up with rage and the brave Sahadeva, both very powerful, moved about in that battle making a great onslaught.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: ताभ्यां शरशतैश्छन्नं तद् बलं तव भारत। सान्धकारमिवाकाशमभवत् तत्र तत्र ह॥
en: That army, O Bharata, was shrouded with hundreds of arrows by those two warriors and the sky, on many parts of the field, was shrouded with darkness.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: अश्वैर्विपरिधावद्भिः शरच्छन्नैर्विशाम्पते। तत्र तत्र वृतो मार्गो विकर्षद्भिर्हतान् बहून्॥
en: The horses struck with arrows, dragging after them as they ran a large number of killed warriors the passage in the battle-field was entirely blocked up.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: निहतानां हयानां च सहैव हयसादिभिः। वर्मभिर्विनिकृत्तैश्च प्रासैश्छिन्नैश्च मारिष॥
en: Covered with horses slain with their riders, with broken shields and lances and with swords and darts and spears all around the earth appeared to have been strewn with flowers.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: ऋष्टिभिः शक्तिभिश्चैव सासिप्रासपरश्वधैः। संछन्ना पृथिवी जज्ञे कुसुमैः शबला इव॥
en: The warriors, O king, meeting one another, moved about in battle exercised with wrath and killing one another.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: योधास्तत्र महाराज समासाद्य परस्परम्। व्यचरन्त रणे क्रुद्धा विनिघ्नन्तः परस्परम्॥
en: Soon the field was covered with heads, beautiful as the filaments of the lotus, bedecked with ear-rings and having faces set with eyes upturned in wrath and lips bit in rage.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: उत्तनयनै रोषात् संदष्टौष्ठपुटैर्मुखैः। सकुण्डलैर्मही च्छन्ना पद्मकिञ्जल्कसंनिभैः॥ भुजैश्छिन्नैर्महाराज नागराजकरोपमैः। साङ्गदैः सतनुत्रैश्च सासिप्रासपरश्वधैः॥ कबन्धैरुत्थितैश्छिन्नैर्नृत्यद्भिश्चापरैर्युधि। क्रव्यादगणसंछन्ना घोराभूत् पृथिवी विभो॥
en: Covered also, O king, with the arms of warriors resembling the trunks of huge elephants, that were bedecked with Angada and coated in leathern fences and that still held swords and lances and battle-axes and with headless bodies standing on their feet and bleeding and dancing on the field and abounding with various carnivorous animals, the earth, O king, appeared exceedingly terrific.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: अल्पावशिष्टे सैन्ये तु कौरवेयान् महाहवे। प्रहृष्टाः पाण्डवा भूत्वा निन्यिरे यमसादनम्॥
en: After the Bharata army had bcen reduced to a small number, the Pandavas, filled with delight in that dreadful battle, began to slay the Kauravas.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरः सौबलेयः प्रतापवान्। प्रासेन सहदेवस्य शिरसि प्राहरद् भृशम्॥
en: Meanwhile the heroic and brave son of Subala forcibly struck Sahadeva in the head with a lance.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: स विह्वलो महाराज रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्।
en: Greatly exercised, O king, for that blow, Sahadeva sat down on the terrace of his car.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: सहदेवं तथा दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्॥ सर्वसैन्यानि संक्रुद्धो वारयामास भारत।
en: Beholding Sahadeva in that condition the valiant Bhima, worked up with rage, O Bharata, obstructed the entire Kuru army.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: निर्बिभेद च नाराचैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ विनिर्भिद्याकरोचैव सिंहनादमरिंदमः।
en: With his cloth-yard shafts he struck hundreds and thousands of hostilo warriors and having struck them so, that chastiser of foes sent up a leonine roar.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता: सर्वे सहयवारणाः॥ प्राद्रवन् सहसा भीताः शकुनेश्च पदानुगाः।
en: Terrified at that roar, all the followers of Shakuni, with their horses and elephants immediately fled away in fear.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: प्रभग्नानथ तान् दृष्ट्वा राजा दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत्॥ निवर्तध्वमधर्मज्ञा युध्यध्वं किं सृतेन वः।
en: Seeing them routed, king Duryodhana said to them-"Stop, you immoral Kshatriyas! fight! What is the use of fight?

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: इह कीर्ति समाधाय प्रेत्य लोकान् समश्नुते॥ प्राणाञ्जहाति यो धीरो युद्धे पृष्ठमदर्शयन्। एवमुक्तास्तु ते राज्ञा सौबलस्य पदानुगाः॥ पाण्डवानभ्यवर्तन्त मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्।
en: That hero, who unretreatingly sacrifices his life in battle, achieves fame here and enjoyes blissful regions hereafter!"-Thus exhorted by the king, the followers of Subala's son once more proceeded against the Pandavas, determined upon ineeting with death.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: द्रवद्भिस्तत्र राजेन्द्र कृतः शब्दोऽतिदारुणः॥ क्षुब्धसागरसंकाशा: क्षुभिताः सर्वतोऽभवन्।
en: O monarch, the noise made by those rushing warriors was terrible and resembled that of the agitated ocean. Thereat the field of battle was agitated all around.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: तांस्तथा पुरतो दृष्ट्वा सौबलस्य पदानुगान्॥ प्रत्युद्ययुर्महाराज पाण्डवा विजयोद्यता:।
en: Beholding those followers of Subala's son thus proceeding to battle, the victorious Pandavas, O monarch rushed against them.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: प्रत्याश्वस्य च दुर्धर्षः सहदेवो विशाम्पते॥ शकुनि दशभिर्विद्ध्वा हयांश्चास्य त्रिभिः शरैः। धनुश्चिच्छेद च शरैः सौबलस्य हसन्निव॥
en: Relieved a little, the invincible Sahadeva, O monarch, struck Shakuni with ten arrows and his horses with three. He, without the slightest exertion, then cut off the bow of Subala's son with a number of other arrows.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय शकुनिर्युद्धदुर्मदः। विव्याध नकुलं षष्ट्या भीमसेनं च सप्तभिः॥
en: Invincible in battle, Shakuni, however, took up another bow and struck Nakula with sixty arrows and then Bhimasena with seven.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: उलूकोऽपि महाराज भीमं विव्याध सप्तभिः। सहदेवं च सप्तत्या परीप्सन् पितरं रणे॥
en: Uluka also, O king, desirous of rescuing his father in that battle, struck Bhima with seven arrows and Sahadeva with seventy.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: तं भीमसेनः समरे विव्याध नवभिः शरैः। शकुनि च चतुःषष्ट्या पार्श्वस्थांश्च त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः॥
en: Bhimasena, in that battle, struck Uluka with many keen arrows and Shakuni with four and sixty and each of the other warriors who fought around them with three arrows.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: हन्यमाना भीमेन नाराचैस्तैलपायितैः। सहदेवं रणे क्रुद्धाश्छादयशरवृष्टिभिः॥ पर्वतं वारिधाराभिः सविद्युत इवाम्बुदाः।
en: Struck by Bhimasena with arrows steeped in oil, the Kauravas, exercised with rage in that battle, covered Sahadeva with showers of arrows like clouds accompanied with lightnings pursing rain on a mountain breast.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: ततोऽस्यापततः शूराः सहदेवः प्रतापवान्॥ उलूकस्य महाराज भल्लेनापाहरच्छिरः।
en: The heroic and brave Sahadeva then, O king, cut off, with a broad-headed arrow, the head of Uluka as the latter proceeded against him.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: स जगाम रथाद् भूमि सहदेवेन पातितः॥ रुधिराप्लुतसर्वाङ्गो नन्दयन् पाण्डवान् युधि।
en: Killed by Sahadeva, Uluka, cheering the Pandavas in that battle, dropped down on the earth from his car, covered with blood.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: पुत्रं तु निहतं दृष्ट्वा शकुनिस्तत्र भारत॥ साश्रुकण्ठो विनिःश्वस्य क्षत्तुर्वाक्यमनुस्मरन्।
en: Seeing his son slain, Shakuni, O Bharata, with voice suppressed in tears and sighing heavily, recollected the words of Vidura.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तं स बाष्पपूर्णेक्षणः श्वसन्॥ सहदेवं समासाद्य त्रिभिर्विव्याध सायकैः।
en: Having thought for a moment with tearful eyes, Shakuni, breathing heavily, approached Sahadeva and struck him with three arrows.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: तानपास्य शरान् मुक्ताशरसंधैः प्रतापवान्॥ सहदेवो महाराज धनुश्चिच्छेद संयुगे।
en: Counteracting those arrows shot by Subala's son with another downpour the brave Sahadeva, O king, sundered his antagonist's blow in that battle.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: छिन्ने धनुषि राजेन्द्र शकुनिः सौबलस्तदा॥ प्रगृह्य विपुलं खड़ सहदेवाय प्राहिणोत्।
en: Seeing his bow sundered, O king, Shakuni, the son of Subala, took up a formidable scimitar and discharged it at Sahadeva.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: तमापतन्तं सहसा घोररूपं विशाम्पते।॥ द्विधा चिच्छेद समरे सौबलस्य हसन्निव।
en: The latter, however, O king, easily cut off in twain that terrible scimitar of Subala's son as it went towards him in that skirmish.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: असिं दृष्ट्वा तथा च्छिन्नं प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्॥ प्राहिणोत् सहदेवाय सा मोघा न्यपतद् भुवि।
en: Beholding his sword cut in two parts Shakuni took up a dreadful mace and discharged it at Sahadeva. That mace also dropped down on the earth unsuccessful.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: ततः शक्तिं महाघोरां कालरात्रीमिवोद्यताम्॥ प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धः पाण्डवं प्रति सौबलः।
en: After this, Subala's son, worked up with rage threw at the son of Pandu a dreadful dart resembling an imminent death-night.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: तामापतन्तीं सहसा शरैः कनकभूषणैः॥ त्रिधा चिच्छेद समरे सहदेवो हसन्निव।
en: With great facility Sahadeva, in that battle, cut off, with his golden arrows, that dart into three pieces as it went swiftly towards him.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: सा पपात त्रिधा च्छिन्ना भूमौ कनकभूषणा॥ शीर्यमाणा यथा दीप्ता गगनाद् वै शतह्रदा।
en: Cut off into piece that golden dart fell down on the earth like a burning thunder-bolt from the sky sending forth many flashes.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: शक्ति विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा सौबलं च भयार्दितम्॥ दुद्रुवुस्तावका: सर्वे भये जाते ससौबलाः।
en: Seeing that dart unsuccessful and Subala's so possessed by fear, all your soldiers fled away. Subala's son also joined them.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: अथोत्क्रुष्टं महचासीत् पाण्डवैर्जितकाशिभिः॥ धार्तराष्ट्रास्ततः सर्वे प्रायशो विमुखाभवन्।
en: The Pandavas then, anger for victory, sent up loud war-cries. As regards the Dhartarashtras, almost all of them fled away from the field.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: तान् वै विमनसो दृष्ट्वा माद्रीपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ शरैरनेकसाहस्रर्वारयामास संयुगे।
en: Seeing them so dispirited the brave son of Madri, with many thousand arrows, opposed them in that battle.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: ततो गान्धारकैर्गुप्तं पुष्टैरश्वैर्जये धृतम्॥ आससाद रणे यान्तं सहदेवोऽथ सौबलम्।
en: Then Sahadeva attacked Subala's son as the latter, who was still sanguine of success, was flying away guarded by the picked cavalry of the Gandharas.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: स्वमंशमवशिष्टं तं संस्मृत्य शकुनि नृप॥ रथेन काञ्चनाङ्गेन सहदेवः समभ्ययात्।
en: Recollecting, O king, that Shakuni, who had to be slain by him, was still alive, Sahadeva, on his car adorned with gold, pursued that warrior.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: अधिज्यं बलवत् कृत्वा व्याक्षिपन् सुमहद् धनुः॥ स सौबलमभिदुत्य गार्धपत्रैः शिलाशितैः। भृशमभ्यहनत् क्रुद्धस्तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपम्॥ उवाच चैनं मेधावी विगृह्य स्मारयन्निव।
en: Stringing his formidable bow and drawing it vehemently Sahadeva, in rage, pursued the son of Suvala and struck him with many arrows winged with vulturine feathers and whetted on stone, like a person striking a powerful elephant with pointed lances.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: क्षत्रधर्मे स्थिरो भूत्वा युध्यस्व पुरुषो भव॥ यत् तदा हृष्यसे मूढ ग्लहन्नक्षैः सभातले। फलमद्य प्रपश्यस्व कर्मणस्तस्य दुर्मते॥ निहत्तास्ते दुरात्मानो येऽस्मानवहसन् पुरा।
en: The energetic Sahadeva, having assailed his foes thus, addressed him, recollecting (his past misdeeds), in these words:-"Observing the duties of a Kshatriya, fight with me and show yourself to be a man! You, O fool, rejoiced greatly in the midst of the assembly, while gambling with dice. Receive now, O wicked man, the fruit of the act.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: दुर्योधनः कुलाङ्गारः शिष्टस्त्वं चास्य मातुलः॥ अद्य ते निहनष्यामि क्षुरेणोन्मथितं शिरः।
en: All those wicked men, that had ridiculed us then, have died. Only that vile wretch of his family viz., Duryodhana still and you his maternal uncle survive.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: वृक्षात् फलमिवाविद्धं लगुडेन प्रमाथिना॥ एवमुक्त्वा महाराज सहदेवो महाबलः। संक्रुद्धो रणशार्दूलो वेगेनाभिजगाम तम्॥
en: Today I shall kill you cutting off your head with a razor-headed arrow like a person plucking a fruit from a tree with a struck." Saying these words, O king, powerful Sahadeva, that foremost of men, filled with anger, rushed against Shakuni.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: अभिगम्य सुदुर्धर्षः सहदेवो युधां पतिः। विकृष्य बलवच्चापं क्रोधेन प्रज्वलन्निव॥
en: Approaching his enemy, the invincible Sahadeva, that best of warriors, forcibly drawing his bow and as if consuming his enemy with anger.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: शकुनि दशभिर्विद्ध्वा चतुर्भिश्चास्य वाजिनः। छत्रं ध्वजं धनुश्चास्य च्छित्त्वा सिंह इवानदत्॥
en: Struck Shakuni with ten arrows and his horses with four. Then cutting off his umbrella and standard and bow, he roared like a lion.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: छिन्नध्वजधनुश्छत्रः सहदेवेन सौबलः। कृतो विद्धश्च बहुभिः सर्वमर्मसु सायकैः॥
en: His standard and bow and umbrella being thus cut off by Sahadeva, Subala's son was struck with many arrows in all his vital parts.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: ततो भूयो महाराज सहदेवः प्रतापवान्। शकुनेः प्रेषयामास शरवृष्टिं दुरासदाम्॥
en: Again, O king, the brave Sahadeva discharged at Shakuni an irresistible shower of arrows.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: ततस्तु क्रुद्ध सुबलस्य पुत्रो माद्रीसुतं सहदेवं विमर्दे। प्रासेन जाम्बूनदभूषणेन जिघांसुरेकोऽभिपपात शीघ्रम्॥
en: Filled with anger the son of Subala, then single-handed, rushed, impetuously against Sahadeva in that encounter, desirous of killing the latter with lance adorned with gold.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: माद्रीसुतस्तस्य समुद्यतं तं प्रासं सुवृत्तौ च भुजौ रणाये। भल्लैस्त्रिभिर्युगपत् संचकर्त ननाद चोचैस्तरसाऽऽजिमध्ये॥
en: However with three broad-headed arrows, the son of Madri cut off at the same time without losing a moment that uplifted lance as also the two plump arms of his enemy and then sent up a loud war-cry.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: तस्याशुकारी सुसमाहितेन सुवर्णपुढेन दृढायसेन। भल्लेन सर्वावरणातिगेन शिरः शरीरात् प्रममाथ भूयः॥
en: The heroic and active Sahadeva then, with a broad-headed arrow made of hard iron, adorned with wings of gold, capable of cutting every arinour and shot with great force and care, cut off from his trunk his enemy's head.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: शरेण कार्तस्वरभूषितेन दिवाकराभेण सुसंहितेन। हृतोत्तमाङ्गो युधि पाण्डवेन पपात भूमौ सुबलस्य पुत्रः॥
en: Deprived of head by the son of Pandu with that gold-decked and sharp arrow, effulgent like the Sun, Subala's son dropped down on the earth in that battle.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: स तच्छिरो वेगवता शरेण सुवर्णपुड्वेन शिराशितेन। प्रावेरयत् कुपित पाण्डुपुत्रो यत्तत् कुरूणामनयस्य मूलम्॥
en: Indeed, the son of Pandu, worked up with rage, struck off that head which was the root of the evil policy of the Kurus, with that powerful arrow winged with gold and whetted on stone.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: भुजौ सुवृत्तौ प्रचकर्त वीरः पश्चात् कबन्धं रुधिरावसिक्तम्। विस्पन्दमानं निपपात घोरं रथोत्तमात् पार्थिव पार्थिवस्य॥ हृतोत्तमाकं शकुनि समीक्ष्य भूमौ शयानं रुधिराईगात्रमा योधास्त्वदीया भयनष्टसत्त्वा दिशः प्रजग्मुः प्रगृहीतशस्त्राः॥
en: Beholding Shakuni lying headless on the ground and all his limbs bathed in blood your warriors, insert with fear, fled away on all sides with weapons in their hands.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: प्रविदुताः शुष्कमुखा विसंज्ञा गाण्डीवघोषेण समाहताश्चा भयार्दिता भग्नरथाश्वनागाः पदातयश्चैव सधार्तराष्ट्राः॥
en: At that time your sons, with cars, elephants, horse and foot, entirely routed, heard the twang of Gandiva and fled away with dried faces, possessed by fear and senseless.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: ततो रथाच्छुकुनिं पातयित्वा मुदान्विता भारत पाण्डवेयाः। शङ्खान् प्रदध्मुः समरेऽतिहष्टाः सकेशवाः सैनिकान् हर्षयन्तः॥
en: Having thrown down Shakuni from his car, the Pandavas, were filled with joy. Rejoicing with Keshava amongst them, they blew their conchs in that battle, cheering up their troops.

description: Sahadeva fights with Shakuni and kills him
sn: तं चापि सर्वे प्रतिपूजयन्तो दृष्ट्वा ब्रुवाणाः सहदेवमाजौ। दिष्ट्या हतो नैकृतिको महात्मा सहात्मजो वीर रणे त्वयेति॥
en: All of them, gladly worshipped Sahadeva and said-"By good luck, O hero, the wicked Shakuni, that one of evil policy, has, with his son, been killed by you."

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: संजय उवाच ततः क्रुद्धा महाराज सौवलस्य पदानुगाः। त्यक्त्वा जीवितमाक्रन्दे पाण्डवान् पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Sanjaya said After this, the followers of Subala's son, O king, were worked up with rage. Prepared to sacrifice their lives in that dreadful encounter, they began to oppose the Pandavas.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तानर्जुनः प्रत्यगृह्णात् सहदेवजये धृतः। भीमसेनश्च तेजस्वी क्रुद्धाशीविषदर्शनः॥
en: Resolved to help Sahadeva in his victory, the energetic Arjuna and Bhimasena, resembling an infuriated venomous serpent, received those warriors.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: शक्त्यृष्टिप्रासहस्तानां सहदेवं जिघांसताम्। संकल्पमकरोन्मोघं गाण्डीवेन धनंजयः॥ ते
en: With his Gandiva, Dharianjaya baffled the object of those warrior who, armed with darts and swords and lances, desired to kill Sahadeva.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: संगृहीतायुधान् वाहून् योधानामभिधावताम्। भल्लैश्चिच्छेद बीभत्सुः शिरांस्यपि हयानपि॥
en: Vibhatsu, with his broad-headed arrows, cut off the horses, the heads and the arms, with weapons in grasp, of those rushing warriors.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: हयाः प्रत्यपद्यन्त वसुधां विगतासवः। चरता लोकवीरेण प्रहताः सव्यसाचिना॥
en: The powerful horses of those great heroes, struck by Savyasachin, dropped down on the earth, dead.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा दृष्ट्वा स्वबलसंक्षयम्। हतशेषान् समानीय क्रुद्धो रथगणान् बहून्॥ कुञ्जरांश्च हयांश्चैव पादातांश्च समन्ततः। उवाच सहितान् सर्वान् धार्तराष्ट्र इदं वचः॥ समासाद्य रणे सर्वान् पाण्डवान् ससुहृद्गणान्। पाञ्चाल्यं चापि सबलं हत्वा शघ्रं न्यवर्तत॥
en: Beholding that onslaugh of his own soldiers. O lord, King Duryodhana was filled with rage. Collecting the residue of his cars which was still many hundreds in number, as also his elephants and horse and foot, O scorcher of foes, your son said to those warriors:-"Meeting all the Pandavas with their friends and allies, in this battle and the Panchala prince also with his own army and killing them speedily turn back from the field.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तस्य ते शिरसा गृह्य वचनं युद्धदुर्मदाः। अभ्युद्ययू रणे पार्थांस्तव पुत्रस्य शासनात्॥
en: Respectfully obeying that mandate, those invincible warriors proceeded once against the Parthas in that battle.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तानभ्यापततः शीघ्रं हतशेषान् महारणे। शरैराशीविषाकारैः पाण्डवाः समवाकिरन्॥
en: The Pandavas, however, enshrouded with their arrows resembling venomous snakes, all the remnant of the Kaurava army, that thus rushed quickly against them in that dreadful battle. more

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तत् सैन्यं भरतश्रेष्ठ मुहूर्तेन महात्मभिः। अवध्यत रणं प्राप्य त्रातारं नाभ्यविन्दत॥
en: That army, O Bharata chief, as it came to battle, was in no time killed by those great warriors, for it had no protector.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: प्रतिष्ठमानं तु भयान्नावतिष्ठति दंशितम्। अश्वैर्विपरिधावद्भिः सैन्येन रजसा वृते॥
en: These horses running hither and thither that were all covered with the dust raised by the army, the cardinal and they subsidiary points of the horizon could not be discerned.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: न प्राज्ञायन्त समरे दिश: सप्रदिशस्तथा। ततस्तु पाण्डवानीकान्निःसृत्य बहवो जनाः॥
en: Coming out of the Pandava army, O Bharata, many warriors killed your soldiers in a moment in that battle.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अभ्यघ्नंस्तावकान् युद्धे मुहूदिव भारत। ततो नि:शेषमभवत् तत् सैन्यं तव भारत॥ अक्षौहिण्यः समेतास्तु तव पुत्रस्य भारत। एकादश हता युद्धे ताः प्रभो पाण्डुसृञ्जयैः॥
en: Eleven Akshauhinis, O Bharata, of troops had been collected for your son. All those O lord, were killed by the Pandus and the Srinjayas.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तेषु राजसहस्रेषु तावकेषु महात्मसु। एको दुर्योधनो राजन्नदृश्यत भृशं क्षतः॥
en: Amongst those thousands and thousands of great kings belonging to your party, only Duryodhana now, O king, exceedingly mangled, survives.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ततो वीक्ष्य दिशः सर्वा दृष्ट्वा शून्यां च मेदिनीम्। विहीनः सर्वयोधैश्च पाण्डवान् वीक्ष्य संयुगे॥ मुदितान् सर्वतः सिद्धान् नर्दमानान् समन्ततः। बाणशब्दरवांश्चैव श्रुत्वा तेषां महात्मनाम्॥ दुर्योधनो महाराज कश्मलेनाभिसंवृतः। अपयाने मनश्चक्रे विहीनबलवाहनः॥
en: Looking on all sides and seeing the earth vacant, himself deprived all his troops while the Pandavas were joyously roaring aloud for the fulfillment of all their objects, Duryodhana, O king, unable to bear the sound of arrows discharged by those great heroes, became stupefied. Deprived of troops and animals, he made up his mind to fly from the field.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच निहते मामके सैन्ये निःशेषे शिबिरे कृते। पाण्डवानां बले सूतं किं नु शेषमभूत् तदा।॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When my soldiers were killed and our camp made entirely empty, what was the strength. O Suta, of the remnant the Pandavas army? 1 desire of know this. Therefore, tell me O Sanjaya, for you are a skillful narrator.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: एतन्मे पृच्छतो ब्रूहि कुशलो ह्यसि संजय। यच दुर्योधनो मन्दः कृतवांस्तनयो मम॥ बलक्षयं तथा दृष्ट्वा स एकः पृथिवीपतिः।
en: Tell me also, O Sanjaya, that which was done by my son, the wicked Duryodhana, that king of the earth, the sole survivor of so many men, when he saw his army entirely destroyed.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: संजय उवाच स्थानां द्वे सहस्रे तु सप्त नागशतानि च॥ पञ्च चाश्वसहस्राणि पत्तीनां च शतं शताः। एतच्छेषमभूद् राजन् पाण्डवानां महद् बलम्॥ परिगृह्य हि यद् युद्धे धृष्टद्युम्नो व्यवस्थितः।
en: Sanjaya continued Two thousand cars, hundred elephants, five thousand horse and ten thousand foot-soldiers was the remnant, O king, of the mighty army of the Pandavas. Looking after this army Dhrishtadyumna waited in that battle.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: एकाकी भरतश्रेष्ठ ततो दुर्योधनो नृपः॥ नापश्यत् समरे कंचित् सहायं रथिनां वरः।
en: Meanwhile, O chief of the Bharatas, king Duryodhana, that best of car-warriors, did not find a single warrior on his side.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: नर्दमानान् परान् दृष्ट्वा स्वबलस्य संक्षयम्॥ तथा दृष्ट्वा महाराज एकः स पृथिवीपतिः। हतं स्वहयमुत्सृज्य प्राङ्मुखः प्राद्रवद् भयात्॥
en: Seeing his enemies roaring aloud and the destruction of his own army, that lord of earth Duryodhana, without a comrade, left off his seven slain horse and fled from the field with face turned eastwards.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: एकादशचमूभर्ता पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। गदामादाय तेजस्वी पदातिः प्रस्थितो हृदम्॥
en: That lord of eleven Akshauhinis, viz., the energetic Duryodhana, taking up his mace, fled on foot towards a lake.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: नातिदूरं ततो गत्वा पद्भ्यामेव नराधिपः। सस्मार वचनं क्षत्तुर्धर्मशीलस्य धीमतः॥ इदं नूनं महाप्राज्ञो विदुरो दृष्ट्वान् पुरा। महद् वैशसमस्माकं क्षत्रियाणां च संयुगे॥ एवं विचिन्तयानस्तु प्रविविक्षुर्हदं नृपः। दुःखसंतप्तहृदयो दृष्ट्वा राजन् बलक्षयम्॥
en: Before he had proceeded far on foot, the king remembered the words of the intelligent and virtuous Vidura. "Forsooth, this had been foreseen by the wise Vidura viz., this great destruction of Kshatriyas and of ourselves in battle.” Reflecting on this, the king, with heart burning in grief at having seen the extermination of his army, desired to go into the depths of that lake.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: पाण्डवास्तु महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः। अभ्यद्रवन्त संक्रुद्धास्तव राजन् बलं प्रति॥
en: The Pandavas, O king, with Dhrishtadyumna at their head, worked up with anger, rushed against the residue of your army.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: शक्त्वृष्टिप्रासहन्तानां बलनामभिगर्जताम्। शंकल्पमकरोन्मोघं गाण्डीवेन धनंजयः॥
en: With his Gandiva, Dhananjaya baffled the object of the Kaurava troops, who, armed with darts and swords and {ances, were crying aloud.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तान् हत्वा निशितैर्वाणैः सामात्यान् सह बन्धुभिः। रथे श्वेतहये तिष्ठन्नर्जुनो बह्वशोभत॥
en: Having, with his sharp arrows, killed those troops with allies and relatives, Arjuna, as he stood on his car having white horses yoked to it, shone highly beautiful.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: सुबलस्य हते पुत्रे सवाजिरथकुञ्जरे। महावनमिव च्छिन्नमभवत् तावकं बलम्॥
en: Upon the death of Subala's on along with horse, cars and elephants, your army looked like a large forest divested by a storm.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अनेकशतसाहस्र बले दुर्योधनस्य ह। नान्यो महारथो राजन् जीवमानो व्यदृश्यत॥ द्रोणपुत्रादृते वीरात् तथैव कृतवर्मणः। कृपाच गौतमाद् राजन् पार्थिवाच तवात्मजात्॥
en: In Duryodhana's army then, O monarch, which had many hundred thousands of warriors, not one single car-warrior was alive, save the heroic son of Drona and Kritavarman and Kripa the son of Gotama, the lord of earth viz., your son.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु मां दृष्ट्वा हसन् सात्यकिमब्रवीत्। किमनेन गृहीतेन नानेनार्थोऽस्ति जीवता॥
en: Seeing me, Dhrishtadyumna, laughingly addressed Satyaki, saying-What is the use of seizing the man. We will gain nothing by keeping him alive.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: धृष्टद्युम्नवचः श्रुत्वा शिनेर्नप्ता महारथः। उद्यम्य निशितं खड्गं हन्तुं मामुद्यतस्तदा॥
en: Hearing these words of Dhrishtadyumna, the grandson of Shini, that great car-warrior, raising up his sharp sword, was ready to kill me.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तमागम्य महाप्राज्ञः कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्। मुच्यता संजयो जीवन्न हन्तव्यः कथंचन॥
en: Just at the neck of time the wise Vyasa, coming there, said-Let Sanjaya be sent away alive. On no account he should be killed.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: द्वैपायनवचः श्रुत्वा शिनेर्नप्ता कृताञ्जलिः। ततो मामब्रवीन्मुक्त्वा स्वस्ति संजय साधय॥
en: Hearing these words of Vyasa, the grandson of Shini joined his hands and then setting me free, said to me-Peace to you, O Sanjaya, you may go away.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अनुज्ञातस्त्वहं तेन न्यस्तवर्मा निरायुधः। प्रातिष्ठं येन नगरं सायढे रुधिरोक्षितः॥
en: Permitted by him, myself then putting off my armour and surrendering my weapons, started in the evening for the city, my limbs covered with blood.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: क्रोशमात्रमपक्रान्तं गदापाणिमवस्थितम्। एकं दुर्योधनं राजन्नपश्यं भृशविक्षतम्॥
en: After I had come about two miles O king I beheld Duryodhana, standing alone, mace in hand and greatly wounded.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: स तु मामश्रुपूर्णाक्षो नाशक्नोदभिवीक्षितुम्। उपप्रैक्षत मां दृष्ट्वा तथा दीनमवस्थितम्॥
en: His eyes were full of tears and, therefore, he could not see me. I stood depressed before him. He saw me but could not recognise me.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तं चाहमपि शोचन्तं दृष्ट्वैकाकिनमाहवे। मुहूर्तं नाशकं वक्तुमतिदुःखपरिप्लुतः॥
en: Beholding him standing alone on the field, I also, laden with grief could not speak a single word for some time.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ततोऽस्मै तदहं सर्वमुक्तवान् ग्रहणं तदा। द्वैपायनप्रसादाच जीवतो मोक्षमाहवे॥
en: Then I described to him everything about my own capture and my release by the favour of Vyasa.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा प्रतिलभ्य च चेतनाम्। भ्रातूंश्च सर्वसैन्यानि पर्यपृच्छत मां ततः॥
en: Having reflected for a moment and regained his consciousness he enquired of me after his brother and his soldiers.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तस्मै तदहमाचक्षे सर्वं प्रत्यक्षदर्शिवान्। भ्रातंश्च निहतान् सर्वान् सैन्यं च विनिपातितम्॥
en: I had seen everything with my eyes and therefore, told him everything viz., that his brothers had all been killed and that his entire army destroyed.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: त्रयः किल रथाः शिष्टास्तावकानां नराधिप। इति प्रस्थानकाले मां कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: I told the king that we had that time only three car-warriors left alive, for Vedavyasa told me so when I set out (froin the Pandaya camp).

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: स दीर्घमिव निःश्वस्य प्रत्यवेक्ष्य पुनः पुनः। असौ मां पाणिना स्पृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्ते पर्यभाषत॥ त्वदन्यो नेह संग्रामे कश्चिज्जीवति संजय। द्वितीयं नेह पश्यामि ससहायाश्च पाण्डवाः॥
en: Sighing heavily and looking repeatedly at me, your son touched me with his hand and said-"Save you, O Sanjaya, no one else is alive, amongst those engaged in this battle. See there is no one on my side, while the Pandavas have their allies living.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ब्रूयाः संजय राजानं प्रज्ञाचक्षुषमीश्वरम्। दुर्योधनस्तव सुतः प्रविष्टो हृदमित्युत॥
en: Say, O Sanjaya, to the blind king Dhritarashtra, that his son Duryodhana has entered into a lake.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: सुहृद्धिस्तादृशै_नः पुत्रैर्धातृभिरेव च। पाण्डवैश्च हृते राज्ये को नु जीवेत मादृशः॥
en: Shorn of friends, deprived of sons and brothers and seeing his kingdom taken by the Pandavas who is there like me that would desire to live.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: आचक्षीथाः सर्वमिदं मां च मुक्तं महाहवात्।, अस्मिंस्तोयह्रदे गुप्तं जीवन्तं भृशविक्षतम्॥
en: Say all this to the king and tell him further that I have escaped with life from that dreadful battle and that, alive, though exceedingly mangled, I shall live within the lake."

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: एवमुक्त्वा महाराज प्राविशत् तं महाह्रदम्। अस्तम्भयत तोयं च मायया मनुजाधिपः॥
en: Saying this to me, O king, the king, entered that lake. By his power of illusion king Duryodhana charmed the waters of the lake, making room for him.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तस्मिन् ह्रदं प्रविष्टे तु त्रीन् रथान् श्रान्तवाहनान्। अपश्यं सहितानेकस्तं देशं समुपेयुधः॥
en: After he had entered that lake, myself, without anybody on my side, saw those three car-warriors coming together there with their tired animals.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: कृपं शारद्वतं वीरं द्रौणिं च रथिनां वरम्। भोजं च कृतवर्माणं सहिताशरविक्षतान्॥
en: They were Kripa, the son of Saradvat and the heroic Ashvatthaman, that best of carwarriors and Kritavarman of Bhoja's race. Wounded with arrows, all of them came together there.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ते सर्वे मामभिप्रेक्ष्य तूर्णमश्वाननोदयन्। उपायाय तु मामूचुर्दिष्ट्या जीवसि संजय॥
en: Seeing me, they all urged their horses to greater speed and coming up to me, said-By good luck, O Sanjaya, you are still alive.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अपृच्छंश्चैव मां सर्वे पुत्रं तव जनाधिपम्। कच्चिद् दुर्योधनो राजा स नो जीवति संजय॥
en: All of them then enquired after your son, saying—"Is our king Duryodhana still alive, O Sanjaya?"

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: आख्यातवानहं तेभ्यस्तदा कुशलिनं नृपम्। तचैव सर्वमाचक्षं यन्मां दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत्॥ ह्रदं चैवाहमाचक्षं यं प्रविष्टो नराधिपः।
en: I then told them that the king was physically well. I also related to them everything that Duryodhana had said to me. I also pointed out to them the lake where the king had entered.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अश्वत्थामा तु तद् राजन् निशम्य वचनं मम॥ तं ह्रदं विपुलं प्रेक्ष्य करुणं पर्यदेवयत्। अहो धिक् स न जानाति जीवतोऽस्मान् नराधिपः॥६१ पर्याप्ता हि वयं तेन सहं योधयितुं परान्।
en: O king, having heard those words, then Ashvatthaman looked at that extensive lake and began to wail in grief, saying, "Alas, Alas, the king knew not that we are still alive! With him amongst us, we are still quite competent to fight with our enemies."

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ते त तत्र चिरं कालं विलय न महारथाः॥ प्राद्रवन् रथिनां श्रेष्ठा दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुसुतान् रणे।
en: Having wept there for a long time, those great car-warriors fled away seeing the sons of Pandu.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ते तु मां रथमारोप्य कृपस्य सुपरिष्कृतम्॥ सेनानिवेशमाजग्मुर्हतशेषास्त्रयो स्थाः।
en: Those three car-warriors, the remnant of our army, took me up on the well-adorned car of Kripa and then set out for the Kuru camp.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तत्र गुल्मा: परित्रस्ताः सूर्ये चास्तमिते सति॥ सर्वे विचुक्रुशुः श्रुत्वा पुत्राणां तव संक्षयम्।
en: The sun had set a little before. Learning that all your sons had been killed the troops, forming the outposts of the camp, wept aloud.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ततो वृद्धा महाराज योषितां रक्षिणो नराः॥ राजदारानुपादाय प्रययुनगरं प्रति।
en: Then, O king, the old men, that had been engaged to look after the ladies of the royal household, set out for the city, taking the princesses after them.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तत्र विक्रोशमानानां रुदतीनां च सर्वशः॥ प्रादुरासीन्महाशब्दः श्रुत्वा तद् बलसंक्षयम्।
en: The attendants and ladies wept aloud when they heard of the destruction of the whole army.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ततस्ता योषितो राजन् क्रन्दन्त्यो वै मुहुर्मुहुः॥ कुरर्य इव शब्देन नादयन्त्यो महीतलम्।
en: O king, crying ceaselessly, the women caused the earth to resound with their voices like a warm of she-ospreys.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: आजघ्नुः करजैश्चापि पाणिभिश्च शिरांस्युत॥ लुलुचुश्च तदा केशान् क्रोशत्यस्तत्र तत्र ह।
en: They tore their bodies with their nails and struck their heads with their hands and loosened their braids, crying all the while aloud.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: हाहाकारविनादिन्यो विनिघ्नन्त्य उरांसि च॥ शोचन्त्यस्तत्र रुरुदुः क्रन्दमाना विशाम्पते।
en: Filling the sky with exclamations of grief and beating their breasts, they cried aloud and wept, O king.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ततो दुर्योधनामात्याः साश्रुकण्ठा भृशातुराः॥ राजदारानुपादाय प्रययुर्नगरं प्रति।
en: Then the friends of Duryodhana, deeply afflicted and their voice suppressed by their tears, started for the city, taking the royal ladies with them.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: वेत्रव्यासक्तहस्ताश्च द्वाराध्यक्षा विशाम्पते॥ शयनीयानि शुभ्राणि स्पास्तरणवन्ति च।
en: The camp-guards quickly fled towards the city, taking with them many white beds covered with rich sheets.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: समादाय ययुस्तूर्णं नगरं दाररक्षिणः॥ आस्थायाश्वतरीयुक्तान् स्यन्दनानपरे पुनः। स्वान् स्वान् दारानुपादाय प्रययुनगरं प्रति॥
en: Others, Placing their wives on cars drawn my mules, set out for the city.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अदृष्टपूर्वा या नार्यो भास्करेणापि वेश्मसु। ददृशुस्ता महाराज जना याताः पुरं प्रति॥
en: Those ladies, O king, who were not before seen even by the sun, were not, as they started for the city, exposed to the view of the common people.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ताः स्त्रियो भरतश्रेष्ठ सौकुमार्यसमन्विताः। प्रययुर्नगरं तूर्णं हतस्वजनबान्धवाः॥
en: Those women, O head of the Bharatas, who were very delicate, now proceeded quickly towards the city, having lost their dear ones and kinsmen.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: आलोपालाविपालेभ्यो द्रवन्तो नगरं प्रति। ययुर्मनुष्याः सम्भ्रान्ता भीमसेनभयार्दिताः॥
en: The very cowherds and shepherds and common men, stricken with panic for the fear of Bhimasena, fled towards the city.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अपि चैषां भयं तीव्र पार्थेभ्योऽभूत् सुदारुणम्। प्रेक्षमाणास्तदान्योन्यमाधावनगरं प्रति॥
en: They were also filled with a great fear of the Parthas. Looking at one another, all of them fled towards the city.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने विद्रवे भृशदारुणे। युयुत्सुः शोकसम्मूढः प्राप्तकालमचिन्तयत्॥
en: During that general flight accompanied with fear, Yuyutsu, beside himself with grief, thought upon what he should do under the present circumstances.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: जितो दुर्योधनः संख्ये पाण्डवैर्भीमविक्रमैः। एकादशचमूभर्ता भ्रातरश्चास्य सूदिताः॥
en: Duryodhana has been defeated in battle by the powerful Pandavas. He had eleven Akshauhinis of soldiers under hiin. All his brothers have been killed.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: हताश्च कुरवः सर्वे भीष्मद्रोणपुरःसराः। अहमेको विमुक्तस्तु भाग्ययोगाद् यदृच्छया॥
en: All the Kauravas, led by Bhishma and Drona, have died. By good luck, only I have been saved.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: विदूतानि च सर्वाणि शिविराणि समन्ततः। इतस्तत: पलायन्ते हतनाथा हतौजसः॥
en: All those that were in the Kuru camp have fled. Alas, dispirited and helpless they are flying on all sides.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अदृष्टपूर्वा दुःखार्ता भयव्याकुललोचनाः। हरिणा इव वित्रस्ता वीक्षमाणा दिशो दशः॥
en: Such a spectacle had never been witnessed before. Assailed with sorrow, with eyes anxious in fear, they are flying away on all directions like a herd of deer looking at one another.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: दुर्योधनस्य सचिवा ये केचिदवशेषिताः। राजदारानुपादाय प्रययुनगरं प्रति॥
en: Amongst the counsellors of Duryodhana those, that are yet alive, have fled towards the city, taking with them the royal ladies.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: प्राप्तकालमहं मन्ये प्रवेश तैः सह प्रभुम्। युधिष्ठिरमनुज्ञाय वासुदेवं तथैव च॥ एतम) महाबाहुरुभयो:स न्यवेदयत्।
en: I think, O lord, that the time has appeared when I also should enter the city with them, after taking the permission of Yudhishthira and Vasudeva. For this purpose that powerful prince appeared before both those heroes.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तस्य प्रीतोऽभवद् राजा नित्यं करुणवेदिता॥ परिष्वज्य महाबाहुर्वैश्यापुत्रं व्यसर्जयत्।
en: King Yudhishthira, who is always kind,। became highly pleased with him. The powerful Pandava embraced that child of a Vaishya mother and sent him away affectionately.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ततः स रथमास्थाय दुतमश्वानचोदयत्॥ संवाहयितवांश्चापि राजदारान् पुरं प्रति।
en: Getting upon his own car, he urged on his horse. He then looked after the departure of the ladies of the royal seraglio for the city.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तैश्चैव सहित: क्षिप्रमस्तं गच्छति भास्करे॥ प्रविष्टो हास्तिनपुरं बाष्पकण्ठोऽश्रुलोचनः।
en: The sun was setting. With those ladies, Yuyutsu entered the city of Hastinapur, with tearful eyes and with voice suppressed in grief.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अपश्यत महाप्राज्ञं विदुरं साश्रुलोचनम्॥ राज्ञः समीयान्निष्क्रान्तं शोकोपहतचेतसम्।
en: He then saw the highly wise Vidura sitting with tearful eyes. He had come away from Dhritarashtra, his heart possessed by great sorrow.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: तमब्रवीत् सत्यधृतिः प्रणतं त्वग्रतः स्थितम्॥ दिष्ट्या कुरुक्षये वृत्ते अस्मिस्त्वं पुत्र जीवसि।
en: Saluting Vidura, he stood before him. Truthful Vidura said to him-"By good luck, O son you have survived the Kurus.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: युयुत्सुरुवाच विना राज्ञः प्रेवशाद् वै किमसि त्वमिहागतः॥ एतद् वै कारणं सर्वं विस्तरेण निवेदय। निहते शकुनौ तत्र सज्ञातिसुतबान्धवे॥ हतशेषपरीवारो राजा दुर्योधनस्ततः। स्वकं स हयमुत्सृज्य प्राङ्मुखः प्राद्रवद् भयात्॥
en: Why, however have you come without king Duryodhana, in your company? Tell me in detail the cause thereof. "Yuyutsu then said." After the destruction of Shakuni, O sire, with all his relations and friends, king Duryodhana, leaving behind his horse, fled away in fear towards the east.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अपक्रान्ते तु नृपतौ स्कन्धावारनिवेशनात्। भयव्याकुलितं सर्वं प्राद्रवन्नगरं प्रति॥
en: After the king's flight, all the Kuru people, worked up with fear, fled towards the city.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ततो राज्ञः कलत्राणि भ्रातृणां चास्य सर्वतः। वाहनेषु समारोप्य अध्यक्षाः प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
en: Then the guards of the ladies, placing the wives of the king, as also those of his brothers, on vehicles, fled away in fear.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: ततोऽहं समनुज्ञाप्य राजानं सहकेशवम्। प्रविष्टो हास्तिनपुरं रक्षन्ल्लोकान् प्रधावितान्॥
en: With the permission of king Yudhishthira and Keshava, I started for Hastinapura, for protecting the people thus flying away.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं वैश्यापुत्रेण भाषितम्। प्राप्तकालमिति श्रुत्वा विदुरः सर्वधर्मवित्॥ अपूजयदमेयात्मा युयुत्सुं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।
en: Hearing those words of the son of Dhritarashtra's Vaishya wife the great Vidura, conversant with practices and feelings for the hour, praised the eloquent Yuyutsu. come

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: प्राप्तकालमिदं सर्वं ब्रुवता भरतक्षये॥ रक्षितः कुलधर्मश्च सानुक्रोशतया त्वया।
en: And he said-"You have acted properly, thinking what has about of this destruction of all the Bharatas. You have also, from pity, maintained the honour of your family.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: दिष्ट्या त्वामिह संग्रामादस्माद् वीरक्षयात् पुरम्॥ समागतमपश्याम ांशुमन्तमिव प्रजाः।
en: By good luck we see you alive in this terrible battle in which heroes have been killed like creatures beholding the blazing sun.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अन्धस्य नृपतेर्यष्टिर्लुब्धस्य दीर्घदर्शिनः॥ बहुशो याच्यमानस्य दैवोपहतचेतसः। त्वमेको व्यसानर्तस्य ध्रियसे पुत्र सर्वथा॥
en: O son, you are now the only support of the blind king shorn of foresight, afflicted with calamity, struck by Destiny and who though repeatedly dissuaded, could not abstain from following his evil policy.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: अद्य त्वमिह विश्रान्तः श्वोऽभिगन्ता युधिष्ठिरम्। एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं विदुरः साश्रुलोचनः॥
en: Take rest here for this day. Tomorrow you may go to Yudhishthira."-Having said these words, Vidura, with tearful eyes.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: पौरजानपदैर्दुःखाद्धाहेति भृशनादितम्॥ निरानन्दं गतश्रीकं हृताराममिवाशयम्।
en: Took leave of Yuyutsu and entered the palace of the king which was filled with the lamentations of woe-stricken citizens.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: शून्यरूपमपध्वस्तं दुःखाद् दुःखतरोऽभवत्॥ विदुरः सर्वधर्मज्ञो विकुवेनान्तरात्मना।
en: The cheerless place was shorn of beauty, comfort and happiness. It was all empty and disorderly. Already filled with grief, Vidura's sorrow increased at that spectacle.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: विवेश नगरे राजन् निःशश्वास शनैः शनैः॥
en: Dutiful Vidura, with a sorrowful heart, entered the palace, sighing heavily.

description: Sanjaya's grief and colloquy between Vidura and Sanjaya
sn: युयुत्सुरपि तां सात्रिं स्वगृहे न्यवसत् तदा। वन्द्यमानः स्वकैश्चापि नाभ्यनन्दत् सुदुःखितः। चिन्तयानः क्षयं तीव्र भरतानां परस्परम्॥
en: As regards Yuyutsu, he passed that night in his own house. Possessed by miscry, he could find no delight at the panegyrics with which he was welcomed. He passed the time, thinking of the terrible onslaught of the Bharatas.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच हतेषु सर्वसैन्येषु पाण्डुपुत्रै रणाजिरे। मम सैन्यावशिष्टास्ते किमकुर्वत संजय॥ कृतवर्मा कृपश्चैव द्रोणपुत्रश्च वीर्यवान्। दुर्योधनश्च मन्दात्मा राजा किमकरोत् तदा॥
en: Dhritarashtra said After all the Kaurava soldiers had been killed by the sons of Pandu on the field of battle, what did those survivors of may party viz., Kritavarman and Kripa and the brave son of Drona do? What also did the wicked king Duryodhana them do?'

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: संजय उवाच सम्प्राद्रवत्सु दारेषु क्षत्रियाणां महात्मनाम्। विदुते शिबिरे शून्ये भृशोद्विग्नास्त्रयो रथाः॥
en: Sanjaya said After the flight of the ladies of those great Kshatriyas and after the Kaurava camp had become entirely empty, the three car-warriors were stricken with anxiety.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: निशम्य पाण्डुपुत्राणां तदा वै जयिनां स्वनम्। विद्रुतं शिबिरं दृष्ट्वा सायाह्ने राजगृद्धिनः॥ स्थानं नारोचयंस्तत्र ततस्ते ह्रदमभ्ययुः।
en: Hearing the shouts of the victorious sons of Pandu and beholding the camp empty in the evening, those three warriors of our side, desirous of rescuing the king and unable to stand on the field, proceeded towards the lake.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: युधिष्ठिरोऽपि धर्मात्मा भ्रातृभिः सहितो रणे॥ हृष्टः पर्यचरद् राजन् दुर्योधनवधेप्सया।
en: The virtuous Yudhishthira, with his brothers in that battle, felt great joy and wandered Over the field for killing Duryodhana.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: मार्गमाणास्तु संक्रुद्धास्तव पुत्रं जयैषिणः॥ यत्नतोऽन्वेषमाणास्ते नैवापश्यञ्जनाधिपम्।
en: Filled with anger the Pandavas, desirous of victory, searched for your son. Though however, they searched carefully for him, they could not discover the Kuru king.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: स हि तीव्रण वेगेन गदापाणिरपाक्रमत्॥ तं ह्रदं प्राविशचापि विष्टभ्यापः स्वमायया।
en: With a mace in hand, he had fled quickly from the field of battle and entered into that lake, having by his power of illusion converted the water into a solid substance.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: यदा तु पाण्डवाः सर्वे सुपरिश्रान्तवाहनाः॥ ततः स्वशिबिरं प्राप्य व्यतिष्ठन्त ससैनिकाः।
en: When at last the animals of the Pandavas were very much tired, the latter proceeded to their camp and took rest there along with their soldiers.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: ततः कृपश्च द्रौणिश्च कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः॥ संनिविष्टेषु पार्थेषु प्रयातास्तं ह्रदं शनैः।
en: After the Parthas had gone to their camp, Kripa and Drona's son and Kritavarman of the Satwata race slowly went towards that lake.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: ते तं ह्रदं समासाद्य यत्र शेते जनाधिपः॥ अभ्यभाषन्त दुर्धर्षं राजानं सुप्तमम्भसि। राजन्नुत्तिष्ठ युद्ध्यस्व सहास्माभिर्युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Approaching the lake within which was the king, they addressed that invincible king of men asleep within the water, saying-"Arise, O king and fight with Yudhishthira. Either obtaining victory enjoy the Earth or killed proceed to heaven.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: जित्वा वा पृथिवीं भुड्क्ष्व हतो वा स्वर्गमाप्नुहि। तेषामपि बलं सर्वं हतं दुर्योधन त्वया॥ प्रतिविद्धाश्च भूयिष्ठं ये शिष्टास्तत्र सैनिकाः।
en: The force of the Pandavas also, O Duryodhana, have all been killed by you. The survivors have been greatly wounded.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: न ते वेगं विषहितुं शक्तास्तव विशांपते॥ अस्माभिरपि गुप्तस्य तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ भारत।
en: They will not be able, O King, to withstand you specially when you will be protected by us. Arise therefore, O Bharata.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: दुर्योधन उवाच दिष्ट्या पश्यामि वो मुक्तानीदृशात् पुरुषक्षयात्॥ पाण्डुकौरवसम्मर्दान्जीवमानान् नरर्षभान्।
en: Duryodhana said By good luck, I see you, O foremost of men, come back alive from this destructive battle between the Pandavas and the Kauravas.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: विजेष्यामो वयं सर्वे विश्रान्ता विगतकुमाः॥ भवन्तश्च परिश्रान्तां वयं च भृशविक्षताः। उदीर्णं च बलं तेषां तेन युद्धं न रोचये॥
en: After we have taken rest for a while and removed our fatigue, we shall meet the enemy and defeat him. You also are tired and I myself am greatly wounded. The army of the Pandavas is increasing in strength. And therefore I do not like to fight now.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: न त्वेदतद्भुतं वीरा यद् वो महदिदं मनः। अस्मासु च परा भक्तिर्न तु कालः पराक्रमे॥
en: It is no wonder, O heroes, that you are extolling me thus for your hearts are noble. Your devotion to me is also great. This, however, is not the proper time for displaying power.

description: Duryodhana lives in a lake. Drona, Kripa and Ashvatthaman meet him there. The Pandavas learn the whereabouts of Duryodhana from the hunters. They go to the lake and vilify him
sn: विश्रम्यैकां निशामद्य भवद्भिः सहितो रणे। प्रतियोत्स्याम्यहं शत्रूञ्चो न मेऽस्त्यत्र संशयः॥
