sn: प्राणानुपासृजद् वीरः सुहृदां दुःखमुत्सृजन्। अपाक्रामद् दिवं पुण्यां शरीरं क्षितिमाविशत्॥
en: Casting off his sorrow for all his killed kinsmen, he then breathed his last. His soul went to holy heaven, while his body only remained on Earth.

description: The three heroes go to Duryodhana and find him still alive. The pitiable state of the Kuru king. The lamentations of the three heroes. Lamentations of Kripa. Ashvatthaman informs him of the slaughter of the Pandava army. Duryodhana's satisfaction at the news. His death
sn: एवं ते निधनं यातः पुत्रो दुर्योधनो नृप। अग्रे यात्वा रणे शूरः पश्चाद् विनिहतः परैः॥
en: Thus, O king, you son Duryodhana died. Having caused the battle first, he was killed by his enemies.

description: The three heroes go to Duryodhana and find him still alive. The pitiable state of the Kuru king. The lamentations of the three heroes. Lamentations of Kripa. Ashvatthaman informs him of the slaughter of the Pandava army. Duryodhana's satisfaction at the news. His death
sn: तथैव ते परिष्वक्ताः परिष्वज्य च ते नृपम्। पुनः पुनः प्रेक्षमाणाः स्वकानारुरुहू रथान्॥
en: The three heroes repeatedly embraced the king and looked steadfastly at him. They then got upon their cars.

description: The three heroes go to Duryodhana and find him still alive. The pitiable state of the Kuru king. The lamentations of the three heroes. Lamentations of Kripa. Ashvatthaman informs him of the slaughter of the Pandava army. Duryodhana's satisfaction at the news. His death
sn: इत्येवं द्रोणपुत्रस्य निशम्य करुणां गिरम्। प्रत्यूषकाले शोकार्तः प्राद्रवन्ननगरं प्रति॥
en: Having heard the piteous cries of Drona's son, I came away early in the morning towards the city.

description: The three heroes go to Duryodhana and find him still alive. The pitiable state of the Kuru king. The lamentations of the three heroes. Lamentations of Kripa. Ashvatthaman informs him of the slaughter of the Pandava army. Duryodhana's satisfaction at the news. His death
sn: एवमेष क्षयोः वृत्तः कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः। घोरो विशसनो रौद्रो राजन् दुर्मन्त्रिते तव॥
en: Thus the armies of the Kurus and the Pandavas have been killed. Great and terrible has been that destruction, O king, brought on by your evil policy.

description: The three heroes go to Duryodhana and find him still alive. The pitiable state of the Kuru king. The lamentations of the three heroes. Lamentations of Kripa. Ashvatthaman informs him of the slaughter of the Pandava army. Duryodhana's satisfaction at the news. His death
sn: तव पुत्रे गते स्वर्गं शोकार्तस्य ममानघ। ऋषिदत्तं प्रणष्टं तद् दिव्यदर्शित्वमद्य वै॥
en: After your son's death, I was stricken with grief and the spiritual insight which the Rishi gave, has been lost by me.”

description: The three heroes go to Duryodhana and find him still alive. The pitiable state of the Kuru king. The lamentations of the three heroes. Lamentations of Kripa. Ashvatthaman informs him of the slaughter of the Pandava army. Duryodhana's satisfaction at the news. His death
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिः पुत्रस्य निधनं तदा। निःश्वस्य दीर्घमुष्णं च ततश्चिन्तापरोऽभवत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said "Hearing of his son's death, the king, sighed heavily and was stricken with great anxiety."

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां धृष्टद्युम्नस्य सारथिः। शशंस धर्मराजाय सौप्तिके कदनं कृतम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said “After the termination of the night, the driver of Dhrishtadyumna's car communicated to king Yudhishthira the great slaughter that had been caused during the hour of sleep.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: सूत उवाच द्रौपदेया हता राजन् दुपदस्यात्मजैः सह। प्रमत्ता निशि विश्वस्ताः स्वपन्तः शिविरे स्वके॥
en: The Driver said The sons of Draupadi, O king, have been killed, with all the children of Drupada himself, while they were carelessly and trustfully asleep in their own camp.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: कृतवर्मणा नृशंसेन गौतमेन कृपेण च। अश्वत्थाम्ना च पापे हतं वः शिविरं निशि॥
en: During the night, O king, your camp has been exterminated by the cruel Kritavarman, and Kripa the son of Gotama, and the sinful Ashvatthaman.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: एतैर्नरगजाश्वानां प्रासशक्तिपरश्वधैः। सहस्राणि निकृन्तद्भिनि:शेषं ते बलं कृतम्॥
en: Killing thousands of men and elephants and horses with lances and darts and battle-axes, those men have rotted out your army.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: छिद्यमानस्य महतो वनस्येव परश्वधैः। शुश्रुषे सुमहाशब्दो बलस्य तव भारत॥
en: While your army was being killed like a forest hewn down with axes, a loud cry of lamentation was heard rising from your camp.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: अहमेकोऽवशिष्टस्तु तस्मात् सैन्यान्महामते। मुक्तः कथंचिद् धर्मात्मन् व्यग्राच कृतवर्मणः॥
en: I am the sole survivor, O king, of that vast host. I have escaped with difficulty from Kritavarman at a time when he was careless.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: तच्छुत्वा वाक्यमशिवं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। पपात मह्यां दुर्धर्षः पुत्रशोकसमन्वितः॥
en: Hearing this evil news, Kunti's son Yudhishthira, however endued with fortitude, dropped down on the Earth, stricken with grief at the loss of his sons.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: पतन्तं तमतिक्रम्य परिजग्राह सात्यकिः। भीमसेनोऽर्जुनश्चैव माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ।॥
en: Going forward, Satyaki clasped the king. Bhimasena and Arjuna and the two sons of Madri also stretched out their arıms.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: लब्धचेतास्तु कौन्तेयः शोकविह्वलया गिरा। जित्वा शत्रूञ्जितः पश्चात् पर्यदेवयदार्तवत्॥
en: Having regained his senses, the son of Kunti bewailed in grief. Alas, having defeated the enemy, we have ourselves been defeated in the end.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: दुर्विदा गतिरर्थानामपि ये दिव्यचक्षुषः। जीयमाना जयन्त्यन्ये जयमाना वयं जिताः॥
en: The course of evens cannot even be ascertained even by persons possessing spiritual insight. The enemies who were defeated have become victorious. Ourselves, again, while victorious are defeated.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: हत्वा भ्रातॄन् वयस्यांश्च पितॄन् पुत्रान् सुहृद्गणान्। बन्धूनमात्यान् पौत्रांश्च जित्वा सर्वाञ्जिता वयम्॥
en: Having killed brothers and friends, fathers, sons, well-wishers, kinsmen, counsellors, and having defeated them all, we ourselves are defeated at last.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: अनर्थो ह्यर्थसंकाशसतथानर्थोऽर्थदर्शनः। जयोऽयमजयाकारो जयस्तस्मात् पराजयः॥
en: Misery appears like prosperity, and prosperity looks like misery. This our victory is twined into defeat. Our victory therefore, had terminated in defeat.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: यजित्वा तप्यते पश्चादापन्न इव दुर्मतिः। कथं मन्येत विजयं ततो जिततरः परैः॥
en: Having gained the victory, I am obliged to grieve as an afflicted wretch. How, can I consider it as a victory? In sooth, I have been doubly defeated by the enemy.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: येषामर्थाय पापं स्याद् विजयस्य सुहृद्वधैः। निर्जितैरप्रमत्तैर्हि विजिता जितकाशिनः॥
en: They for whose sake we gained the sinful victory by killing our kinsmen and friends, after acquired victory, have been defeated by vanquished foes that were hecdful.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: कर्णिनालीकदंष्ट्रस्य खड्गजिह्वस्य संयुगे। चापव्यात्तस्य रौद्रस्य ज्यातलस्वननादिनः॥ क्रुद्धस्य नरसिंहस्य संग्रामेष्वपलायिनः। ये व्यमुञ्चन्त कर्णस्य प्रमादात् त इमे हताः॥
en: Alas, through carelessness have they been killed who had escaped from even Karna, that warrior who had barbed arrows and Nalikas for his teeth, the sword for his tongue, the bow for his mouth, and the twang of the bow, and the sound of palms for his roars-that angry Karna who never took to heels from battle, and : who was foremost of men.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: रथहृदं शरवर्षोर्मिमन्तं रत्नाचितं वाहनवाजियुक्तम्। शक्त्वृष्टिमीनध्वजनागनकं शरासनावर्तमहेषुफेनम्॥ संग्रामचन्द्रोदयवेगवेलं द्रोणार्णवं ज्यातलनेमिघोषम्। स्ते राजपुत्रा निहताः प्रमादात्॥
en: Alas, those princes who succeeded in crossing, by boats made by their own excellent weapons, the great Drona-ocean having cars for its deep lakes, arrows for its waves, the ornaments of warriors for its gems, car-horses for its animals, darts and swords for its fishes, elephants for its alligators, bows for its whirlpools, powerful weapons for its foam, and the sign of battle for its moonrise causing it to swell with energy, and the twang of the bow and the sound of palms for its roar,-alas, even those princes have been killed from carelessness.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: न हि प्रमादात् परमस्ति कश्चिद् वधो नराणामिह जीवलोके। ते प्रमत्तमर्था हि नरं समन्तात् त्यजन्त्यनाश्च समाविशन्ति॥
en: There is, in this world, no greater cause of death, for men, than carelessness. Prosperity leaves off a careless men from every side, and every king of misery befalls him.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: ध्वजोत्तमायोच्छ्रितधूमकेतुं शराचिष कोपमहासमीरम्। महाधनुातल नेमिघोषं तनुत्रनानाविधशस्त्रहोमम्॥ महाचमूकक्षदवाभिपन्नं महाहवे भीष्ममयाग्निदाहम्। ये सेहुरात्तायुधतीक्ष्णवेगं राजपुत्रा निहताः प्रमादात्॥
en: The tall standard with beautiful top that stood on his car was the wreath of smoke that certainly indicated the Bhishma-fire. Arrows formed its flames, and anger was the wind that fanned it. The twang of his terrible bow and the sound of his palms formed the roar of that fire. Armour and various kinds of weapons were the homa libations that were poured into it. The huge hostile army was the heap of dry grass that was consumed by that fire. Alas, even they who had borne that fierce fire whose terrible power was represented by the mighty weapons in Bhishma's hands, have at last fallen through carelessness.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: न हि प्रमत्तेन नरेण शक्यं विद्या तपः श्रीर्विपुलं यशो वा। पश्याप्रमादेन निहत्य शत्रून् सर्वान् महेन्द्रं सुखमेधमानम्॥
en: A careless person gain knowledge, asceticism, prosperity, or fame. See, Indra has acquired great felicity after killing all his enemies carefully.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: इन्द्रोपमान पार्थिवपुत्रपौत्रान् पश्याविशेषेण हतान् प्रमादात्। तीर्खा समुद्रं वणिज: समृद्धा मग्नाः कुनद्यामिव हेलमानाः॥
en: See, the few survivors among our enemies have, through our carelessness, killed so many can never sons and grandsons of kings each of whom resembled Indra himself. Alas, they have died like merchants with rich good, dying through carelessness in a shallow river after having crossed the great deep.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: अमर्षितैर्ये निहताः शयाना नि:संशयं ते त्रिदिवं प्रपन्नाः। कृष्णां तु शोचामि कथं नु साध्वी शोकार्णवे साद्य विनश्यतीति॥
en: They whose bodies and now lying on the naked ground, killed by those vindictive wretches, have, forsooth, gone to heaven. I lament for the princess Krishna. Alas, she will be drowned to-day in a sea of sorrow.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: भ्रातूंश्च पुत्रांश्च हतान् निशम्य पाञ्चालराजं पितरं च वृद्धम्। ध्रुवं विसंज्ञा पतिता पृथिव्यां सा शोष्यते शोककृशाङ्गयष्टिः॥
en: Hearing of the destruction of her brothers and sons and her revered father, the king of the Panchalas, forsooth, she will drop down senseless on the Earth. She will not rise again with her body emaciated by grief.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: तच्छोकजं कथं भविष्यत्युचिता सुखानाम्। पुत्रक्षयभ्रातृवधप्रणुन्ना प्रदह्यमानेन हुताशनेन॥
en: Unable to bear such affliction, and ever worthy of happiness, alas, what will be her condition. Painted greatly by the destruction of her sons and brothers, she will be like one scorched by fire.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: इत्येवमातः परिदेवयन् स राजा कुरूणां नकुलं बभाषे। गच्छानयनामिह मन्दभाग्यां समातृपक्षामिति राजपुत्रीम्॥
en: Bewailing thus with sorrow, that king of Kuru's race, then addressed Nakula, saying,-'Go and bring the helpless princess Draupadi here with all her maternal relations.'

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: दुःखमषारयन्ती माद्रीसुतस्तत् परिगृह्य वाक्यं धर्मेण धर्मप्रतिमस्य राज्ञः। ययौ रथेनालयमाशु देव्याः पाञ्चालराजस्य च यत्र दाराः॥
en: Following the mandate of the king who was righteous like Yama himself, Nakula speedily proceeded on his car to the palace of Draupadi where that princess lived with all the wives of the Panchala king.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: प्रस्थाप्य माद्रीसुतमाजमीढः शोकार्दितस्तैः सहितः सुहृद्धिः। रोरूयमाणः प्रययौ सुतानामायोधनं भूतगणानुकीर्णम्॥
en: Having sent the son of Madri, Yudhishthira, moved by grief, proceeded, with tearful eyes and accompanied by his friends to the field on which his sons had fought and which was filled with various kinds of creatures.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: स तत् प्रविश्याशिवमुग्ररूपं ददर्श पुत्रान् सुहृदः सखींश्च। भूमौ शयानान् रुधिरागात्रान् विभिन्नदेहान् प्रहृतोत्तमाङ्गान्॥
en: Having entered that cursed field, containing many dreadful sights, the king saw his sons, well-wishers, and friends, all lying on the ground, bathed in blood, their bodies wounded, and heads severed from their trunks.

description: The lamentations of Yudhishthira. Nakula his driver Bhima sets out in pursuit of Ashvatthaman. Krishna requests Yudhishthira to make arrangements of Bhima's safety as Ashvatthaman has the Brahmashira weapon. The story of the acquisition of that weapon.
sn: स तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा भृशमार्तरूपो युधिष्ठिरो धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठः। उच्चैः प्रचुक्रोश च कौरवाश्य: पपात चोर्ध्या सगणो विसंज्ञः॥
en: Seeing them in that condition, Yudhishthira, that best of pious men, become deeply afflicted. That Kuru chief then began to weep aloud and dropped down on the Earth, senseless along with all his followers."

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच स दृष्ट्वा निहतान् संख्ये पुत्रान् पौत्रान् सखींस्तथा। महादुःखपरीतात्मा बभूव जनमेजय॥
en: Vaishampayana said “Seeing his sons, grandsons, and friends, all killed in battle, the king was filled with great grief, O Janamejaya.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: ततस्तस्य महाशोकः प्रादुरासीन्महात्मनः। स्मरत: पुत्रपौत्राणां भ्रातृणां स्वजनस्य ह॥
en: Recollecting those sons and grandsons and brothers and allies, the king was stricken with a deep sorrow.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: तमश्रुपरिपूर्णाक्षं वेपमानमचेतसम्। सुहृदो भृशसंविग्नाः सान्त्वयाशकिरे तदा॥
en: Senseless and trembling, his eyes were full of tears. His friends then, began anxiously to comfort him.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: ततस्तस्मिन् क्षणे कल्पो रथेनादित्यवर्चसा। नकुलः कृष्णया सार्धमुपायात् परमार्तया॥
en: At that time, Nakula, a skillful messenger, arrived there on his car effulgent like the sun, accompanied by the princess Krishna in great affliction.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: उपप्लव्यं गता सा तु श्रुत्वा सुमहदप्रियम्। तदा विनाशं सर्वेषां पुत्राणां व्यथिताभवत्॥
en: She had been living at Upaplavya. Having heard that heart-rending news about the destruction of all her sons, she became exceedingly moved.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: कम्पमानेव कदली वातेनाभिसमीरिता। कृष्णा राजानमासाद्य शोकार्ता न्यपतद् भुवि॥
en: Trembling like a plantain tree shaken by the wind, the princes Krishna, arrived before Yudhishthira, and fell down afflicted with sorrow.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: बभूव वदनं तस्याः सहसा शोककर्षितम्। फुल्लपद्मपलाशाक्ष्यास्तमोग्रस्त इवांशुमान्॥
en: Her face, having eyes like full-blown lotuses, seemed to be darkened by sorrow like the Sun himself when covered with darkness.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: ततस्तां पतितां दृष्ट्वा संरम्भी सत्यविक्रमः। बाहुभ्यां परिजग्राह समुत्पत्य वृकोदरः॥
en: Seeing her prostrate on the Earth, the wrathful Vrikodara, advancing hastily, raised her up and clasped her with his arms.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: सा समाश्वासिता तेन भीमसेनेन भामिनी। रुदती पाण्डवं कृष्णा सा हि भारतमब्रवीत्॥ दिष्ट्या राजन्नवाप्येमामखिला भोक्ष्यसे महीम्। आत्मजान् क्षत्रधर्मेण सम्प्रदाय यमाय वै॥
en: The beautiful lady, comforted by Bhimasena, began to weep, and addressing Yudhishthira with his brothers, said,ट 'By whole Earth, you will enjoy her after the death of your brave sons while observing the Kshatriya duties.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: दिष्ट्या त्वं कुशली पार्थ मत्तमातङ्गगामिनीम्। अवाप्य पृथिवीं कृत्स्ना सौभद्रं न स्मरिष्यसि॥
en: By good luck, O son of Pritha, you are happy to think that you have obtained the whole Earth. By good luck, your thoughts do not dwell on Subhadra's son whose movement was like that of an infuriate elephant.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: आत्मजान् क्षत्रधर्मेण श्रुत्वा शूरान् निपातितान्। उपप्लव्ये मया सार्धं दिष्ट्या त्वं न स्मरिष्यसि॥
en: By good luck, you do not like myself while living at Upaplavya, recollect your heroic sons killed while following Kshatriya duties.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: प्रसुप्तानां वधं श्रुत्वा द्रौणिना पापकर्मणा। शोकस्तपति मां पार्थ हुताशन इवाश्रयम्॥
en: O son of Pritha, hearing of the slaughter of those sleeping heroes by Drona's sinful son, grief burns me as if I were in the midst of fire.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: तस्य पापकृतो द्रौणेर्न चेदद्य त्वया रणे। ह्रियते सानुबन्धस्य युधि विक्रम्य जीवितम्॥ इहैव प्रायमासिष्ये तन्निबोधत पाण्डवाः। न चेत् फलमवाप्नोति द्रौणिः पापस्य कर्मणः॥
en: If Drona's son is not compelled to reap the fruit of his sinful deed, if, displaying your prowess in battle, you do not kill that sinful wretch, along with his followers,—then, listen to me, ye Pandavas, I shall sit here in Praya.'

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: एवमुक्त्वा ततः कृष्णा पाण्डवं प्रत्युपाविशत्। युधिष्ठिरं याज्ञसेनी धर्मराजं यशस्विनी॥
en: Saying so, the helpless Krishna, the daughter of Yajnasena, sat by the side of king Yudhishthira the just.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: दृष्ट्वोपविष्टां राजर्षिः पाण्डवो महिषीं प्रियाम्। प्रत्युवाच स धर्मात्मा द्रौपदी चारुदर्शनाम्॥ धर्म्य धर्मेण धर्मज्ञे प्राप्तास्ते निधनं शुभे। पुत्रास्ते भ्रातरश्चैव तान्न शोचितुमर्हसि॥
en: Seeing his dear queen sit in Praya, the royal and pious sage Yudhishthira addressed her, saying,-'O auspicious lady, you do not follow the code of morality, your sons and brothers have met with a noble death. You should not grieve for them.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: स कल्याणि वनं दुर्गं दूरं द्रौणिरितो गतः। तस्य त्वं पातनं संख्ये कथं ज्ञास्यसि शोभने॥
en: Regarding Drona's son, he had gone to a distant forest, O beautiful princess. How can you then, O lady, bring about his fall in battle.'

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: द्रौपद्युवाच द्रोणपुत्रस्य सहजो मणिः शिरसि मे श्रुतः। निहत्य संख्ये तं पापं पश्येयं मणिमाहृतम्॥ राजशिरसि ते कृत्वा जीवेयमिति मे मतिः।
en: I have heard that Drona's son has a gem on his head, born with him. I shall see that gem brought to me after his death in battle. Placing that gem on your head, O king, I shall live. This is my resolution.'

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: इत्युक्त्वा पाण्डवं कृष्णा राजानं चारुदर्शना॥ भीमसेनमथागत्य परमं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। त्रातुमर्हसि मां भीम क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन्॥ जहि तं पापकर्माणं शम्बरं मघवानिव।
en: Having said these words to the royal son of Pandu, the beautiful Krishna approached Bhimasena and said these importent words to him:-"Remembering the Kshatriya, O Bhima, you should help me. Kill that sinful wretch like Magavat slaying Sharmvara. were

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: न हि ते विक्रमे तुल्यः पुमानस्तीह कश्चन॥ श्रुतं तत् सर्वलोकेषु परमव्यसने यथा। द्वीपोऽभूस्त्वं हि पार्थानां नगरे वारणावते॥ हिडिम्बदर्शने चैव तथा त्वमभवो गतिः।
en: There is no one in this world equal to you in prowess. It is known throughout the world how during a great calamity you became at the town of Varanavata the refuge of all the Parthas. When again we seen by Hidimva, it was you who rescued us.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: तथा विराटनगरे कीचकेन भृशार्दिताम्॥ मामप्युद्धृतवान् कृच्छ्रात् पौलोमी मघवानिव।
en: Like Indra rescuing his wife, the daughter of Puloma, you saved me in Virata's city, from a great danger.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: यथैतान्यकृथाः पार्थ महाकर्माणि वै पुरा॥ तथा द्रौणिममित्रघ्न विनिहत्य सुखी भव। तस्या बहुविधं दुःखान्निशम्य परिदेवितम्॥ नामर्षयत कौन्तेयो भीमसेनो महाबलः।
en: Like those great deeds, O Partha, performed by you forinerly, kill now, O slayer of foes, the son of Drona and be happy.'-Hearing these and other piteous cries of the princess, Kunti's son the powerful Bhima, could not bear them.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: स काञ्चनविचित्राङ्गमारुरोह महारथम्॥ आदाय रुचिरं चित्रं समार्गणगुणं धनुः।
en: He got upon his great golden car, and took his beautiful bow with its arrow fixed on the string.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: नकुलं सारथिं कृत्वा द्रोणपुत्रवधे धृतः॥ विस्फार्य सशरं चापं तूर्णमश्वानचोदयत्। ते हयाः पुरुषव्याघ्र चोदिता वातरंहसः॥
en: Making Nakula his. chariotecr, and determined upon killing the son of Drona, he began to draw his bow and made his horses to be urged without delay. Those horses, flect as the wind, urged, run at a furious speed.

description: Nakula brings Draupadi from Upaplavya city. She falls down in a swoon. She insists upon Ashvatthaman's slaughter and deprivation of gem from his head.
sn: वेगेन त्वरिता जग्मुर्हरयः शीघ्रगामिनः। शिविरात् स्वाद् गृहीत्वा स रथस्य पदमच्युतः॥
en: Brave and energetic as he was, Bhima started from the Pandava camp and proceeded quickly along the track of Ashvatthaman's car." quickly along the track of Ashvatthaman's car."

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्मिन् प्रयाते दुधेर्षे यदूनामृषभस्ततः अब्रवीत् पुण्डरीकाक्षः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥ एष पाण्डव ते भ्राता पुत्रशोकपरायणः। जिघांसुद्रौणिमाक्रन्दे एक एवाभिधावति॥
en: Vaishampayana said After the brave Bhimasena had started, that Yadu hero, having eyes like lotus petals, addressed Kuru's son, Yudhishthira, saying,-O son of Pandu, beside himself with grief at the death of his sons, this brother of yours, goes alone to battle for killing son of Drona.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: भीमः प्रियस्ते सर्वेभ्यो भ्रातृभ्यो भरतर्षभ। तं कृच्छ्रगतमद्य त्वं कस्मान्नाभ्युपपद्यसे॥
en: O Bharata chief, of all your brothers, Bhima is dearest. Seeing him in a great danger, why do you not stir yourself.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: यत् तदाचष्ट पुत्राय द्रोणः परपुरञ्जयः। अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरो नाम दहेत पृथिवीमपि॥
en: The weapon, called Brahmashira, which Drona, gave his son, is capable of consuming the whole world.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: तन्महात्मा महाभागः केतुः सर्वधनुष्मताम्। प्रत्यपादयदाचार्यः प्रीयमाणो धनंजयम्॥
en: Pleased with Dhananjaya, the illustrious preceptor, that foremost of all wielders of bows, and given him that very weapon.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: तं पुत्रोऽप्येक एवैनमन्वयाचदमर्पणः। ततः प्रोवाच पुत्राय नातिहष्टमना इव॥
en: His only son also then begged it of him. Unwillingly he communicated the knowledge of that weapon to Ashvatthaman.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: विदितं चापलं ह्यासीदात्मजस्य दुरात्मनः। सर्वधर्मविदाचार्यः सोऽन्वशात् स्वसुतं ततः॥ परमापद्रतेनापि न स्म तात त्वया रणे। इदमस्त्रं प्रयोक्तव्यं मानुषेषु विशेषतः॥
en: The illustrious Drona knew very well the restlessness of his son, and accordingly commanded him, saying,-~Even when overtaken by the greatest calamity, O child, in the midst of battle, you should never use this weapon, specially against men.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: इत्युक्तवान् गुरुः पुत्रं द्रोणः पश्चादयोक्तवान्। न त्वं जातु सतां मार्गे स्थातेति पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Thus the preceptor Drona spoke to his son. Some time after he again spoke, saying,-O foremost of men, it seems, you will not, follow the path of the righteous.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: स तदाज्ञाय दुष्टात्मा पितुर्वचनमप्रियम्। निराश: सर्वकल्याणैः शोकात् पर्यचरन्महीम्॥
en: Hearing those bitter words of his father the wicked Ashvatthaman, giving up all hopes of prosperity, began to wander sorrowfully over the Earth.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: ततस्तदा कुरुश्रेष्ठ वनस्थे त्वयि भारत। अवसद् द्वारकामेत्य वृष्णिभिः परमार्चितः॥
en: Then, O Kuru chief, while you were living in the forest, he came to Dwaraka and lived there, adored of the Vrishnis.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: स कदाचित् समुद्रान्ते वसन् द्वारवतीमनु। एक एकं समागम्य मामुवाच हसन्निव॥ यत् तदुग्रं तपः कृष्ण चरन् सत्यपराक्रमः। अगस्त्याद् भारतचार्यः प्रत्यपद्यत मे पिता॥ अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरो नाम देवगन्धर्वपूजितम्। तदद्य मयि दाशार्ह यथा पितरि मे तथा॥
en: One day, after he had settled in Dwaraka, he came to me, alone when I mysclf was also alone on the sea-coast, and there smilingly said, O Krishna, that weapon, called Brahmashira adored of gods and Gandharvas, which my father the preceptor of the Bharatas, having prowess capable of being baffled, had obtained from Agastya after practising the severest penances, is now with me, as it is with my father.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: अस्मत्तस्तदुपादाय दिव्यमस्त्रं यदूत्तम। ममात्यस्त्रं प्रयच्छ त्वं चक्रं रिपुहणं रणे॥
en: O foremost one of Yadu, in exchange for that celestial weapon, give me your discus which is capable of killing all enemies in battle.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: स राजन् प्रीयमाणेन मयाप्युक्तः कृताञ्जलिः। याचमानः प्रयत्नेन मत्तोऽस्त्रं भरतर्षभ।१६।। देवदानवगन्धर्वमनुष्यपतगोरगाः। न समा मम वीर्यस्य शतांशेनापि पिण्डिताः॥
en: While with joined hands he thus begged of me my discus, myself, for pleasing him, told him these words,-Gods, Danavas, Gandharvas, men, birds and snakes, assembled together, cannot equal even a hundredth part of iny energy

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: इदं धनुरियं शक्तिरिदं चक्रमियं गदा। यद्यदिच्छसि चेदस्त्रं मत्तस्तत् तद् ददामि ते॥
en: I have this bow, this arrow, this discus, and the mace! I will give you whichever amongst them you wish to have from me.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: यच्छक्नोषि समुद्यन्तुं प्रयोक्तुमपि वा रणे। तद् गृहाण विनास्त्रेण यन्मे दातुमभीप्सति॥
en: Without giving me the weapon you wish to give, take from among these weapons of mine that which you will be able to wield and use in battle.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: स सुनाभं सहस्रारं वज्रनाभमयस्मयम्। ववे चक्रं महाभागो मत्तः स्पर्धन्मया सह॥
en: Thus addressed, the illustrious son of Drona, as if challenging me, wanted my discus of excellent have and hard as thunder, having thousand spokes, and made of iron.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: गृहाण चक्रमित्युक्तो मया तु तदनन्तरम्। जग्राहोत्पत्य सहसा चक्र सव्येन पाणिना॥
en: I said to him take it. Thus spoken to, he rose all on a sudden and seized the discus with his left hand.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: न चैनमशकत् स्थानात् संचालयितुमप्युत। अथैनं दक्षिणेनापि गृहीतुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: He could not, however, even move the weapon where it lay. He then tried to catch it with his right hand.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: सर्वयत्नबलेनापि गृह्णन्नेवमिदं ततः। ततः सर्वबलेनापि यदैनं न शशाक ह॥ उद्यन्तुं वा चालयितुं द्रौणिः परमदुर्मनाः। कृत्वा यत्नं परिश्रान्तः स न्यवर्तत भारत॥
en: Having caught it then very firmly and displaying all his strength, he still failed to either wield or move it. At this, Drona's son became sorry. Being worn out with the exertions he stooped.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: निवृत्तमनसं तस्मादभिप्रायाद् विचेतसम्। अहमामन्त्र्य संविग्नमश्वत्थामानमब्रुवम्॥ यः सदैव मनुष्येषु प्रमाणं परमं गतः। गाण्डीवधन्वा श्वेताश्वः कपिप्रवरकेतनः॥ यः साक्षाद् देवदेवेशं शितिकण्ठमुमापतिम्। द्वन्द्वयुद्धे पराजिष्णुस्तोषयामास शङ्करम्॥ यस्मात् प्रियतरो नास्ति ममान्यः पुरुषो भुवि। नादेयं यस्य मे किञ्चिदपि दारा: सुतास्तथा।॥ तेनापि सुहृदा ब्रह्मन् पार्थेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। नोक्तपूर्वमिदं वाक्यं यत् त्वं मामभिभाषसे॥
en: When he ceased cherishing that desire i addressed the anxious and senseless Ashvatthaman and said,-He who is always known as the best of all men that holder of Gandiva, that warrior having white horses yoked to his car, that hero having the emblem of a monkey of his standard, that hero who, desirous of defeating a wrestling encounter the god of gods, viz., the blue-throated lord of Uma, pleased the great Shankara himself, that Phalguna than whom I have no dearer friend on Earth, that friend to whom there is nothing that I cannot give including my very wives and children, that dear friend Partha of pure deeds, never said to me, O Brahmana, such words as these which you have said.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: ब्रह्मचर्यं महद् घोरं तीर्खा द्वादशवार्षिकम्। हिमवत्पार्श्वमास्थाय यो मया तपसार्जितः॥ समानव्रतचारिण्यां रुक्मिण्यां योऽन्वजायत। सनत्कुमारस्तेजस्वी प्रद्युम्नो नाम मे सुतः॥ तेनाप्येतन्महद् दिव्यं चक्रमप्रतिमं रणे। न प्रार्थितमभून्मूढ यदिदं प्रार्थितं त्वया॥
en: That son whom I got by practising ascetic penances and observing the austere Brahmacharya for twelve years on the Himavat where I had gone for the purpose, that son of mine, viz., the energetic Pradyumna a portion of Sanatkumara himself, begotten by me upon my wife Rukmini who had practised vows as austere as mine, that hero even never wanted this best of objects, viz., this peerless discus, which you foolish, as you are have wanted.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: रामेणातिबलेनैतन्त्रोक्तपूर्वं कदाचन। न गदेन न साम्बेन यदिदं प्रार्थितं त्वया॥
en: The highly powerful Rama never said such words to me! Neither Gada nor Shamva, have ever asked for this.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: द्वारकावासिभिश्चान्यैर्वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथैः। नोक्तपूर्वमिदं जातु यदिदं प्रार्थितं त्वया॥
en: None among the other great car-warriors of the Vrishni and the Andhaka race living in Dwaraka has ever asked this of me.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: भारताचार्यपुत्रस्त्वं मानित: सर्वयादवैः। चक्रेण रथिनां श्रेष्ठ कं नु तात युयुत्ससे॥
en: You are the son of the preceptor of the Bharatas, you are esteemed by all the Yadavas! Let me ask you, O best of car-warriors, with whom do you wish to fight with this weapon?'

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: एवमुक्तो मया द्रौणिर्मामिदं प्रत्युवाच ह। प्रयुज्य भवते पूजां योत्सये कृष्ण त्वया सह॥
en: Thus addressed by rne, Drona's son replied, saying,-'After adoring you O Krishna, it was my desire of fight with you, you of unfading glory.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: प्रार्थितं ते मया चक्रं देवदानवपूजितम्। अजेयः स्यामिति विभो सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: It was for this, O Krishna, that I prayed for your discus which is worshipped by gods and Danavas! Had I got it I would then have become invincible in the world.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: त्वत्तोऽहं दुर्लभं काममनवाप्यैव केशव। प्रतियास्यामि गोविन्द शिवेनाभिवदस्व माम्॥
en: Having failed, O Keshava, to my almost unattainable desire, I wish to leave you, O Govinda! Address me plainly now.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: एतत् सुभीमं भीमानामृषभेण त्वया धृतम्। चक्रममतिचक्रेण भुवि नान्योऽभिपद्यते॥
en: This terrible weapon is with you, who are the foremost of all terrible persons! You are unrivaled for this weapon. There is none else in this world capable of having it.'

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: एतावदुक्त्वा द्रौणिर्मी युग्यानश्वान् धनानि च। आदायोपययौ काले रत्नानि विविधानि च॥
en: Having said so the son of Drona taking many horses and much wealth and various kinds of gems, left Dvaraka.

description: The Pandavas with Krishna follow Bhima. They ask him to stop, but he refuses. The Pandavas find Ashvatthaman sitting with Vyasa. Ashvatthaman discharges and Brahmashira wcapons. Arjuna shoots his Brahma weapon
sn: स संरम्भी दुरात्मा च चपलः क्रूर एव च। वेद चास्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरस्तस्माद् रक्ष्यो वृकोदरः॥
en: He is wrathful, wicked, restless, and very cruel. He knows the use of the weapon called Brahmashira. Vrikodara should be saved.”

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा युधां श्रेष्ठः सर्वयादवनन्दनः। सर्वायुधवरोपेतमारुरोह रथोत्तमम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said “Having said to that foremost of all wielders of weapons, viz., that delighter of all the Yadavas, got on his excellent car, well furnished with all sorts of powerful weapons.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: युक्तं परमकाम्बोजैस्तुरगैर्हेममालिभिः। आदित्योदयवर्णस्य धुरं रथवरस्य तु॥
en: Two pairs of best horses of the Kamvoja breed were yoked to that car and they were adorned with garlands of gold. The Dhur of that best of cars was of the colour of the morning sun.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: दक्षिणामवहच्छब्यः सुग्रीवः सव्यतोऽभवत्। पाणिवाहौ तु तस्यास्तां मेघपुष्पबलाहकौ॥
en: On the right was yoked and horse known as Shaivya; on the left was placed Sugriva; the who Parshni was drawn by two others called Meghapushpa and Valahaka.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: विश्वकर्मकृता दिव्या रत्नधातुविभूषिता। उच्छ्रितेव रथे माया ध्वजयष्टिरदृश्यत॥
en: There was on that car celestial standard adorned with gems and gold and made by the celestial Architect, and standing high like the Maya of Vishnu.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: वैनतेयः स्थितस्तस्यां प्रभामण्डलरश्मिवान्। तस्य सत्यवतः केतुर्भुजगारिरदृश्यत॥
en: Upon that standard was Vinata's son, Garuda, that enemy of snakes perched on the standard-top of of Keshava is the embodiment of truth.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: अथारोहद्धृषीकेशः केतुः सर्वधनुष्मताम्। अर्जुनः सत्यकर्मा च कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The Hrishikesha, that foremost of all bowmen, got upon that car. After him Arjuna of irresistible deeds and Yudhishthira the king of the Kurus, got upon the same car,

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: अशोभेतां महात्मानौ दाशार्हमभितः स्थितौ। रथस्थं शार्ङ्गधन्वानमश्विनाविव वासवम्॥
en: Seated on that car. by the side of that Dasharha's hero, who held the bow called Sharnga, the two sons of Pandu shone highly beautiful, like the two Ashvins seated by the side of Vasava.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: तावुपारोप्य दाशार्हः स्यन्दनं लोकपूजितम्। प्रतोदेन जवोपेतान् परमाश्चानचोदयत्॥
en: Making them got on that car of his which was adored by all the world, the Dasharha hero urged those best of fleet horses.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: ते हयाः सहसोत्पेतुर्गृहीत्वा स्यन्दनोत्तमम्। आस्थितं पाण्डवेयाभ्यां यदूनामृषभेण च॥
en: Those horses then suddenly ran taking after them that excellent vehicle ridden by the two sons of Pandu and by that foremost of Yadu's race.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: वहतां शार्ङ्गधन्वानमश्वानां शीघ्रगामिनाम्। प्रादुरासीन्महाशब्दः पक्षिणां पततामिव॥
en: Greatly quick-coursing, as those animals, were, bore away the wilder of Sharnga, a loud noise was caused by their motion, like that of birds passing through the air.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: ते समाईनरव्याघ्राः क्षणेन भरतर्षभ। भीमसेनं महेष्वासं समनुद्रुत्य वेगिताः॥
en: Running very quickly, they soon met, O foremost of Bharata's race, the mighty bowman Bhimasena in whose wake they had followed.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: क्रोधदीप्तं तु कौन्तेयं द्विषदर्थे समुद्यतम्। नाशक्नुवन् वारयितुं समेत्यापि महारथाः॥
en: Although those great car-warriors met Bhima, they could not stop that son of Kunti, for filled with anger, he proceeded fiercely towards the enemy.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: स तेषां प्रेक्षतामेव श्रीमतां दृढधन्विनाम्। ययौ भागीरथीतीरं हरिभि शवेगितैः॥
en: Before the very presence of those illustrious and firm bowmen, Bhima, by means of his very quick-coursing horses, proceeded towards the bank of the river Bhagirathi.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: यत्र स्म श्रूयते द्रौणिः पुत्रहन्ता महात्मनाम्। स ददर्श महात्मानमुदकान्ते यशस्विनम्॥
en: he saw the great and illustrious and darkcomplexioned and island-born Vyasa sitting near the edge of the water encircled by many Rishis.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: कृष्णद्वैपायनं व्यासमासीनमृषिभिः सह। तं चैव क्रूरकर्माणं घृताक्तं कुशचीरिणम्॥ रजसा ध्वस्तमासीनं ददर्श द्रौणिमन्तिके।
en: And he also saw Drona's wicked son sitting by them, covered with dust, clad in a piece of cloth made of Kusha grass, and smeared all over with clarified butter.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: तमभ्यधावत् कौन्तेयः प्रगृह्य सशरं धनुः॥ भीमसेनो महाबाहुस्तिष्ठ निष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्।
en: Taking up his bow with arrows on it, the mighty-armed Bhimasena, the son of Kunti, rushed towards Ashvatthaman, and said, 'Wait, wait!'

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: स दृष्ट्वा भीमधन्वानं प्रगृहीतशरासनम्॥ भ्रातरौ पृष्ठतश्चास्य जनार्दनरथे स्थितौ। व्यथितात्माभवद् द्रौणिः प्राप्तं चेदममन्यत॥ स तद् दिव्यमदीनात्मा परमास्त्रमचिन्तयत्।
en: Seeing that terrible bowman coming towards him bow in hand, and his tow brothers on Janarddana's car, Drona's son became exceedingly anxious and thought his end was night. Never to be depressed, he thought of that high weapon which he had obtained form his father.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: जग्राह च स चैषीकां द्रौणिः सव्येन पाणिना॥ स तामापदमासाद्य दिव्यमस्त्रमुदैरयत्।
en: He then took up a blade of grass with his left hand. Overcome with misfortune, he inspired that blade of grass with proper mantras and converted it into that powerful celestial weapon.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: अमृष्यमाणस्ताञ्छूरान् दिव्यायुधवरान् स्थितान्॥ अपाण्डवायेति रुषा व्यसृजद् दारुणं वचः।
en: Unable to bear the arrows of the Pandavas and the presence of those wielders of celestial weapons, he cried in anger saying,-For the destruction of the Pandavas.'

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: इत्युक्त्वा राजशार्दूल द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ सर्वलोकप्रमोहार्थं तदस्त्रं प्रमुमोच ह।
en: Having said these words, O foremost of kings, the brave son of Drona discharged that weapon for stupefying all the worlds.

description: The Pandavas with Sri Krishna follow Dhima. They ask him to stop. Ashvatthaman discharges Brahmasira weapon, but Arjuna shoots it.
sn: ततस्तस्यामिषीकायां पावकः समजायत। प्रधक्ष्यन्निव लोकांस्त्रीन् कालान्तकयमोपमः॥
en: A fire then was begotten of that blade of grass, which appeared capable of destroying the three worlds like the all-destroying Yama at the end of the cycle."

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच इङ्गितेनैव दाशार्हस्तमभिप्रायमादितः। द्रौणेर्बुद्ध्वा महाबाहुरर्जुनं प्रत्यभाषत॥ अर्जुनार्जुन यदिव्यमस्त्रं ते हृदि वर्तते। द्रोणोपदिष्टं तस्यायं काल: सम्प्रति पाण्डव॥
en: Vaishampayana said "In the very beginning the powerful hero of Dasharha's, race understood from sings the intention of Drona's son. He said to Arjuna, O son of Pandu, the time is come for the use of that celestial weapon, the use of which was given to you by Drona.

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: भ्रातृणामात्मनश्चैव परित्राणाय भारत। विसृजैतत् त्वमप्याजावस्त्रमस्त्रनिवारणम्॥
en: For protecting yourself as also your brothers, O Bharata, discharge in this battle that weapon which is capable of counteracting all other weapons.

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: केशवेनैवमुक्तोऽथ पाण्डवः परवीरहा। अवातरद् रथात् तूर्णं प्रगृह्य सशरं धनुः॥
en: Thus addressed by Keshava, Arjuna that destroyer of hostile heroes, quickly got down from the car, taking with him his bow with arrow fixed on string.

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: पूर्वमाचार्यपुत्राय ततोऽनन्तरमात्मने। भ्रातृभ्यश्चैव सर्वेभ्य स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा परंतपः॥ देवताभ्यो नमस्कृत्य गुरुभ्यश्चैव सर्वशः। उत्ससर्ज शिवं ध्यायन्नस्त्रमस्त्रेण शाम्यताम्॥
en: Wishing good to the preceptor's son of himself, and to all his brothers, that destroyer of foes then bowed to all the gods and all his superiors and discharged his weapon, thinking of the well-being of all the words and saying, 'Let this weapon neutralise Ashvatthaman's weapon.'

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: ततस्तदस्त्रं सहसा सृष्टं गाण्डीवधन्वना। प्रजज्वाल महार्चिष्मद् युगान्तानलसंनिभम्॥
en: Quickly discharged by the wider of Gandiva, that weapon blazed up with fierce flames like the all-destroying fire that appears at the end of a cycle.

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: तथैव द्रोणपुत्रस्य तदस्त्रं तिग्मतेजसः। प्रजज्वाल महाज्वालं तेजोमण्डलसंवृतम्॥
en: Likewise the weapon that had been discharged by Drona's energetic son, blazed up with dreadful flames within a huge sphere of fire.

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: निर्घाता बहवश्चासन् पेतुरुल्काः सहस्रशः। महद् भयं च भूतानां सर्वेषां समजायत॥
en: Peals of thunder were heard; thousands of meteors, dropped down and all living creatures were filled with great fear.

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: सशब्दमभवद् व्योम ज्वालामालाकुलं भृशम्। चचाल च मही कृत्स्ना सपर्वतवनदुमा॥
en: The entire sky was filled with noise and put on a terrible appearance with those flames of fire. The entire earth shook with her mountains, rivers and trees.

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: स त्वस्त्रतेजसी लोकांस्तापयन्ती व्यवस्थिते। महर्षी सहितौ तत्र दर्शयामासतुस्तदा॥ नारदः सर्वभूतात्मा भरतानां पितामहः। उभौ शमयितुं वीरौ भारद्वाजधनंजयौ॥
en: Seeing those two weapons consuming the three worlds, the two great Rishis, viz., Narada who is the soul of every creature, and Vyasa, the grandfather of all the Bharata princes, came there. The two Rishis tried to pacify the two heroes, Ashvatthaman and Dhananjaya.

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: तौ मुनी सर्वधर्मज्ञौ सर्वभूतहितैषिणौ। दीप्तयोरस्त्रयोर्मध्ये स्थितौ परमतेजसौ। १३॥
en: Cognizant of all duties and desirous of the well-being of all creatures, the two energetic sages, stood in the midst of those two blazing weapons.

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: तदन्तरमथाधृष्यावुपगम्य यशस्विनौ। आस्तामृषिवरौ तत्र ज्वलिताविव पावकौ॥
en: Incapable of being moved by any force, those two great Rishis, placing themselves between the two weapons, stood like two burning fires.

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: प्राणभृद्भिरनाधृष्यौ देवदानवसम्मतौः अस्त्रतेजः शमयितुं लोकानां हितकाम्यया॥
en: Incapable of being checked by any living creatures, and worshipped of gods and Danavas, they two acted in this way, counteracting the power of the two weapons and doing good to all the world.

description: The extraordinary portents of nature. For saving the three worlds Narada and Vyasa stand between the two fires generated by the two weapons.
sn: ऋषी ऊचतुः नानाशस्त्रविदः पूर्वे येऽप्यतीता महारथाः। नैतदस्त्रं मनुष्येषु तैः प्रयुक्तं कथंचन। किमिदं साहसं वीरौ कृतवन्तौ महात्ययम्॥
en: The two Rishis said Those great car-warriors who have died in this battle were masters of diverse kinds weapons. They, however, never shot such a weapon upon men. What rash act is this, O heroes, that you have done.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच दृष्टैव नरशार्दूल तावग्निसमतेजसौ। गाण्डीवधन्वा संचिन्त्य प्राप्तकालं महारथः। संजहार शरं दिव्यं त्वरमाणो धनंजयः॥
en: Vaishampayana said "O foremost of men, seeing those two Rishis effulgent like fire, Dhananjaya quickly resolved to withdraw his celestial arrows.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: उवाच भरतश्रेष्ठ तावृषी प्राञ्जलिस्तदा। प्रमुक्तमस्त्रमस्त्रेण शाम्यतामिति वै मया॥
en: Joining his hands, he said to those Rishis,'I discharged this weapon, saying,—Let it neutralise the enemy's weapon.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: संहते परमास्त्रेऽस्मिन् सर्वानस्मानशेषतः। पापकर्मा ध्रुवं द्रौणिः प्रधक्ष्यत्यस्त्रतेजसा॥
en: If I withdraw this great weapon. Drona's sinful son will then, forsooth, consume us all with the power of his weapon.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: यदत्र हितस्माकं लोकानां चैव सर्वथा। भवन्तौ देवसंकाशौ तथा सम्मन्तुमर्हतः॥ इत्युक्त्वा संजहारास्त्रं पुनरेवं धनंजयः। संहारो दुष्करस्तस्य देवैरपि हि संयुगे॥
en: You two are like gods. You should find out some means by which our well-being, as also that of the three worlds may be secured.'-Saying so Dhananjaya withdrew his weapon. The withdrawal of that weapon can with difficulty be made by the gods themselves in battle.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: विसृष्टस्य रणे तस्य परमास्त्रस्य संग्रह। अशक्तः पाण्डवादन्यः साक्षादपि शतक्रतुः॥
en: Not excepting the great Indra himself, there was none save the son of Pandu, who could withdraw that high weapon after it had one been discharged.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: ब्रह्मतेजोद्भवं तद्भि विसृष्टमकृतात्मना। न शक्यमावर्तयितुं ब्रह्मचारिव्रतादृते॥
en: That weapon was begotten of Brahma energy. No person of impure soul can withdraw it after it is once discharged. Only one who leads the life of a Brahmacharin can do it.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: अचीर्णब्रह्मचर्यो यः सृष्ट्वा वर्तयते पुनः। तदस्त्रं सानुबन्धस्य मूर्धानं तस्य कृन्तति॥
en: If one who had not practised the vow of Brahmacharya tries to withdraw it after having shot it, it strikes off his own head and kills him with all his equipment's.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: ब्रह्मचारी व्रती चापि दुरवापमवाप्य तत्। परमव्यसनार्तोऽपि नार्जुनोऽस्त्रं व्यमुञ्चत॥
en: Arjuna was a Brahmacharin and an observer of vows. Having secured that almost unattainable weapon, he had tiever used it even when put into the greatest of difficulties.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: सत्यव्रतधरः शूरो ब्रह्मचारी च पाण्डवः। गुरुवर्ती च तेनास्त्रं संजहारार्जुनः पुनः॥
en: Truthful, heroic, and leading the life of a Brahmacharin, the son of Pandu was ever obedient to all his superiors. It was for this that he could withdrew his weapon.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: द्रौणिरप्यथ सम्प्रेक्ष्य तावृषी पुरतः स्थितौ। न शशाक पुनर्घोरमस्त्रं संहर्तुमोजसा॥
en: Seeing those two Rishis standing before him, Drona's son could not by his energy withdraw his own dreadful weapon.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: अशक्तः प्रतिसंहारे परमास्त्रस्य संयुगे। द्रौणिर्दीनमना राजन् द्वैपायनमभाषत॥
en: Unable to withdraw the great weapon in battle, Drona's son, O king, with a depressed heart, said to the Rishi, Vyasa.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: उत्तमव्यसनातन प्राणत्राणमभीप्सुना। मयैतदस्त्रमुत्सृष्टं भीमसेनभयान्मुने॥
en: In fear of a great calamity, and desirous of saving my life, I discharged this weapon, through fear of Bhimasena, O Sage.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: अधर्मश्च कृतोऽनेन धार्तराष्ट्र जिघांसता। मिथ्याचारेण भगवन् भीमसेनेन संयुगे।॥
en: This Bhimasena acted sinfully, and dishonestly while killing the son of Dhritarashtra in battle.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: अतः सृष्टमिदं ब्रह्मन् मयास्त्रमकृतात्मना। तस्य भूयोऽद्य संहारं कर्तुं नाहमिहोत्सहे॥
en: It is for this, O Rishi, I discharged this weapon! I dare not, however, withdraw it now.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: विसृष्टं हि मया दिव्यमेतदस्त्रं दुरासदम्। अपाण्डवायेति मुने वह्नितेजोऽनुमन्त्र्य वै॥
en: Having put into this irresistible and celestial weapon the energy of fire, I discharged it for the destruction of the Pandavas.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: तदिदं पाण्डवेयानामन्तकायाभिसंहितम्। अद्य पाण्डुसुतान् सर्वान् जीविताद् भ्रंशयिष्यति॥
en: Discharged for the destruction of the Pandavas, this weapon, therefore, will take away the lives of all the sons of Pandu.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: कृतं पापमिदं ब्रह्मन् रोषाविष्टेन चेतसा। वधमाशास्य पार्थानां मयास्त्रं सृजता रणे॥
en: O Rishi, I have, under the influence of anger, done this sinful deed! I invoked this weapon in battle for the destruction of the Pandavas!'

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: व्यास उवाच अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरस्तात विद्वान् पार्थो धनंजयः। उत्सृष्टवान्न रोषेण न नाशाय तवाहवे॥
en: Pritha's son Dhananjaya, O child, knew the use of the weapon called Brahmashira. Neither from anger, nor for your destruction in battle, did he discharge that weapon.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: अस्त्रमस्त्रेण तु रणे तव संशमयिष्यता। विसृष्टमर्जुनेनेदं पुनश्च प्रतिसंहृतम्॥
en: Arjuna, on the other hand, let it off for baffling your weapon. He has again withdrawn it.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: ब्रह्मास्त्रमण्यवाप्यैतदुपदेशात् पितुस्तव। क्षत्रधर्मान्महाबाहुर्नाकम्पत धनंजयः॥
en: Having obtained even the Brahma weapon through your fathers instructions the powerful Dhananjaya did not deviate from a Kshatriya's duties.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: एवं धृतिमतः साधोः सर्वास्त्रविदुषः सतः। सभ्रातृबन्धोः कस्मात् त्वं वधमस्य चिकीर्षसि॥
en: Arjuna is endued with such patience, and honesty. He is, besides, a master of every weapon. Why do you try to bring about the destruction of such a man with all his brothers.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरो यत्र परमास्त्रेण वध्यते। समा द्वादश पर्जन्यस्तद्राष्ट्र नाभिवर्षति॥
en: The region where the weapon Brahmashira is counteracted by another high weapon, suffers from a drought for twelve years, for the clouds do not pour a drop of water you.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: एतदर्थं महाबाहुः शक्तिमानपि पाण्डवः। न विहन्त्येतदस्त्रं तु प्रजाहितचिकीर्षया।॥
en: Therefore the mighty-armed son of Pandu, although he had the power, would not still, for doing good of living creatures, baffle your weapon with his.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: पाण्डवास्त्वं च राष्ट्रं च सदा संरक्ष्यमेव हि। तस्मात् संहर दिव्यं त्वमस्त्रमेतन्महाभुज॥
en: The Pandavas should be protected; your self should be protected; the kingdom also should be protected. Therefore, withdraw this your celestial weapon.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: अरोषस्तव चैवास्तु पार्थाः सन्तु निरामयाः। न ह्यधर्मेण राजर्षिः पाण्डवो जेतुमिच्छति॥
en: Drive away from your heart, and let the Pandavas be self! The royal sage Yudhishthira never wishes to gain victory be perpetrating any sinful act.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: मणिं चैव प्रयच्छाद्य यस्ते शिरसि तिष्ठति। एतदादाय ते प्राणान् प्रतिदास्यन्ति पाण्डवाः॥
en: Give them that gem which is on your head. Taking that, the Pandavas will grant in return your life.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: द्रौणिरुवाच पाण्डवैर्यानि रत्नानि यच्चान्यत् कौरवैर्धनम्। अवाप्तमिह तेभ्योऽयं मणिर्मम विशिष्यते॥
en: Drona's son said This my gem is more valuable than all the wealth that has ever been acquired by the Pandavas and the Kauravas.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: यमाबध्य भयं नास्ति शस्त्रव्याधिक्षुधाश्रयम्। देवेभ्यो दानवेभ्यो वा नागेभ्यो वा कथंचन॥
en: Whenever this gem is used, the wearer entertains no fear from weapons or discase or hunger. He ceases to have any fear of celestials and Danavas and Nagas.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: न च रक्षोगणभयं न तस्करभयं तथा। एवंवीर्यो मणिरयं न मे त्याज्यः कथंचन॥
en: He does not fear the Rakshasas and the robbers, these are the virtues of my gem.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: यत्तु मे भगवानाह तन्मे कार्यमनन्तरम्। अयं मणिरयं चाहमीषिका तु पतिष्यति॥ गर्भेषु पाण्डवेयानाममोघं चैतदुत्तमम्। न च शक्तोऽस्मि भगवन् संहर्तुं पुनरुद्यतम्॥ एतदस्त्रमतश्चैव गर्भेषु विसृजाम्यहम्। न च वाक्यं भगवतो न करिष्ये महामुने॥
en: I cannot, by any means, part with it. Whatever, O holy one, you command me, should be done by me. Here is this gem! Here is myself! This blade of grass, converted into a dreadful weapon, will, however, fall into the wombs of the Pandava women, for this weapon is high and powerful, and cannot be baffled. O Rishi, I am unable to withdraw it, having once discharged it. I will not throw this weapon into the wombs of the Pandava women. As regards your other commands, O Rishi, I will obey them.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: व्यास उवाच एवं कुरु न चान्या तु बुद्धिः कार्या त्वयानघ। गर्भेषु पाण्डवेयानां विसृज्यैतदुपारम॥
en: Vyasa said Do then this. Do not, however, cherish any other purpose, O sinless one. Stop throwing this weapon into the wombs of the Pandava women.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः परममस्त्रं तु द्रौणिरुद्यतमाहवे। द्वैपायनवच : श्रुत्वा गर्भेषु प्रमुमोच ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard these words of Dvaipayana Vyasa, the son of Drona threw that uplifted weapon into the wombs of the Pandava women.

description: Arjuna revives the child. The curse of Krishna on Ashvatthaman. Vyasa's approval of Krishna's curse. Drona's son accepts the curse and gives up the gem on his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi, who requests Yudhishthira to place the gem on his head
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः परममस्त्रं तु द्रौणिरुद्यतमाहवे। द्वैपायनवच : श्रुत्वा गर्भेषु प्रमुमोच ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard these words of Dvaipayana Vyasa, the son of Drona threw that uplifted weapon into the wombs of the Pandava women.

description: Krishna's curse on Ashvatthaman, he accepts the curse and give up the gem of his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तदाज्ञाय हृषीकेशो विसृष्टं पापकर्मणा। हृष्यमाण इदं वाक्यं द्रौणिं प्रत्यब्रवीत्तदा॥ विराटस्य सुतां पूर्वं स्नुषां गाण्डीवधन्वनः उपप्लव्यगतां दृष्ट्वा व्रतवान् ब्राह्मणोऽब्रवीत्॥ परिक्षीणेषु कुरुषु पुत्रस्तव भविष्यति। एतदस्य परिक्षित्त्वं गर्भस्थस्य भविष्यति॥
en: Vaishampayana said “Knowing that weapon was thrown into the wombs of the Pandava women by Drona's sinful son, Hrishikesha, with a cheerful heart, said these words of him:-'Seeing Virata's daughter who is now daughter-in-law to Arjuna, while she was at Upaplavya, a certain pious Brahmana said, while the Kuru line will became extinct, a son will be born to you. This your son, for the reason, will be called by the name of Parikshit.

description: Krishna's curse on Ashvatthaman, he accepts the curse and give up the gem of his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi.
sn: तस्य तद् वचनं साधोः सत्यमेतद् भविष्यति। परिक्षिद् भविता ह्येषां पुनर्वंशकरः सुतः॥
en: The words of that pious man shall be fulfilled. The Pandavas shall have a son called Parikshit.'

description: Krishna's curse on Ashvatthaman, he accepts the curse and give up the gem of his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi.
sn: एवं ब्रुवाणं गोविन्दं सात्वतां प्रवरं तदा। द्रौणिः परमसंरब्धः प्रत्युवाचेदमुत्तरम्॥ नैतदेवं यथाऽऽत्य त्वं पक्षपातेन केशव। वचनं पुण्डरीकाक्ष न च मद्वाक्यमन्यथा॥
en: While Govinda, that foremost one of the Satwata race, saying these words, Drona's son, filled with anger, replied, saying,-"This, O Keshava, which you say from your partiality for the Pandavas, shall never take place. O you having eyes like lotus petals, my words cannot but be fulfilled.

description: Krishna's curse on Ashvatthaman, he accepts the curse and give up the gem of his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi.
sn: पतिष्यति तदस्त्रं हि गर्भे तस्या मयोद्यतम्। विराटदुहितुः कृष्ण यं त्वं रक्षितुमिच्छसि॥
en: Taken up by me, this weapon of mine shall fall on the foetus that is in the womb of Virata's daughter,—which, O Krishna, you are so desirous of protecting.'

description: Krishna's curse on Ashvatthaman, he accepts the curse and give up the gem of his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi.
sn: श्रीभगवानुवाच अमोघः परमास्त्रस्य पातस्तस्य भविष्यति। स तु गर्भो मृतो जातो दीर्घमायुरवाप्स्यति॥
en: Krishna said The fall of this mighty weapon will not be useless. The foetus will die. But being dead, it will revive and have a long life.

description: Krishna's curse on Ashvatthaman, he accepts the curse and give up the gem of his head. Pandavas return to Draupadi.
sn: त्वां तु कापुरुषं पापं विदुः सर्वे मनीषिणः। असकृत्पापकर्माणं बालजीवितघातकम्॥ तस्मात्त्वमस्य पापस्य कर्मणः फलमा जुहि।
