sn: चार्वाक उवाच इमे प्राहुर्द्विजाः सर्वे समारोप्य वचो मयि। धिग् भवन्तं कुनृपतिं ज्ञातिघातिनमस्तु वै॥
en: Charvaka said Making me their spokesman all these Brahmanas, are saying,-Fie on you. You are a wicked king. You are a destroyer of kinsmen.

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: किं तेन स्याद्धि कौन्तेय कृत्वेमं ज्ञातिसंक्षयम्। घातयित्वा गुरूंश्चैव मृतं श्रेयो न जीवितम्॥
en: What will you gain, O son of Kunti, by having thus exterminated your race? Having killed also your elders and preceptor, it is proper for you to cast away your life.

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: इति ते वै द्विजाः श्रुत्वा तस्य दुष्टस्य रक्षसः। विव्यथुश्चुक्रुशुश्चैव तस्य वाक्यप्रधर्षिताः॥
en: 'Hearing these words of that wicked Rakshasa, the Brahmanas there were greatly moved. Cut to the quick by that speech, they set up a loud uproar.

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे स च राजा युधिष्ठिरः। वीडिताः परमोद्विग्नास्तूष्णीमासन् विशाम्पते॥
en: And all those Brahmanas, with king Yudhishthira, O king, became silent from anxiety and shame.

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच प्रसीदन्तु भवन्तो मे प्रणतस्याभियाचतः। प्रत्यासन्नव्यसनिनं न पां धिक्कर्तुमर्हथ।॥
en: Yudhishthira said I bow down to you and solicit you humbly, to be pleased with me. You should not cry fie on me. I shall soon cast off my life. not

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो राजन् ब्राह्मणास्ते सर्व एव विशाम्पते। ऊचुनैतद् वचोऽस्माकं श्रीरस्तु तव पार्थिव॥
en: Vaishampayana said O lord of men, then all those Brahmanas, loudly said,-These are our words. Prosperity to you, O king.

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: जजुश्चैव महात्मानस्ततस्तं ज्ञानचक्षुषा। ब्राह्मणा वेदविद्वांसस्तपोभिर्विमलीकृताः॥
en: Those great persons, well read in the Vedas, with understandings rendered clear by penances, then learnt the disguise of the speaker by means of their spiritual sight.

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: ब्राह्मणा ऊचु: एव दुर्योधनसखा चार्वाको नाम राक्षसः। परिव्राजकरूपेण हितं तस्य चिकीर्षति॥
en: This is the Rakshasa Charvaka, the friend of Duryodhana. Having put on the guise of a religious mendicant, he seeks the well-being of his friend Duryodhana.

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: वयं ब्रूमो न धर्मात्मन् व्येतु ते भयमीदृशम्। उपतिष्ठतु कल्याणं भवन्तं भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: We have not, O you righteous soul, said anything of the kind. Drive away your anxiety. May prosperity be with you and your brothers.

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे हुंकारैः क्रोधमूर्छिताः। निर्भर्त्सयन्तः शुचयो निजघ्नुः पापराक्षसम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Those Brahmanas then, beside themselves with anger, uttered the sound hum. Freed off of all sins, they censured the sinful Rakshasa and killed him there.

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: पपात विनिर्दग्धस्तेजसा ब्रह्मवादिनाम्। महेन्द्राशनिनिर्दग्धः पादपोऽङ्कुरवानिव॥
en: Consumed by by the power of those Brahmavadins, Charvaka fell down dead, like a tree with all its blasted spouts by the thunder of Indra.

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: पूजिताश्च ययुर्विप्रा राजानमभिनन्द्य तम्। राजा च हर्षमापेदे पाण्डवः ससुहृज्जनः॥
en: Duly adored the Brahmanas went away, having pleased the king with their blessing. The royal son of Pandu also, with all his friends, became highly happy. tree with all its blasted spouts by the thunder of Indra.

description: Vyasa ask Yudhishthira, on being asked, to enquired of Bhishma the duties of the four orders.
sn: पूजिताश्च ययुर्विप्रा राजानमभिनन्द्य तम्। राजा च हर्षमापेदे पाण्डवः ससुहृज्जनः॥
en: Duly adored the Brahmanas went away, having pleased the king with their blessing. The royal son of Pandu also, with all his friends, became highly happy.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तत्र तु राजानं तिष्ठन्तं भ्रातृभिः सह। उवाच देवकीपुत्रः सर्वदर्शी जनार्दनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then Devaki's son Janardana endued with universal knowledge said to king Yudhishthira who stood there with his brothers,

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: वासुदेव उवाच ब्राह्मणास्तात लोकेऽस्मिन्नर्चनीयाः सदा मम। एते भूमिचरा देवा वाग्विषाः सुप्रसादकाः॥
en: Vasudeva said In this world, O friend, I adore only the Brahmanas. They are gods on Earth, have venom in their words, and are exceedingly easy to gratify.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: पुरा कृतयुगे राजंश्चार्वाको नाम राक्षसः। तपस्तेपे महाबाहो बदाँ बहुवार्षिकम्॥
en: Formerly, in the Krita age, O king, a Rakshasa of the name of Charvaka, O mightyarmed one, practised austere penances for many years in Badari.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: वरेण च्छन्द्यमानश्च ब्रह्मणा च पुनः पुनः। अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो वरयामास भारत॥
en: Brahma repeatedly asked him to ask for boons. At last the Rakshasa prayed for the boon, O Bharata, of being freed from fear of every being in the universe.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: द्विजावमानादन्यत्र प्रादाद् वरमनुत्तमम्। अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो ददौ तस्मै जगत्पतिः॥
en: The Lord of the universe granted that high boon of freedom from fear of all creatures, subject to the only condition that he should be careful of how he offended the Brahmanas.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: स तु लब्धवरः पापो देवानमितविक्रमः। राक्षसस्तापयामास तीव्रकर्मा महाबलः॥
en: Having obtained that boon, the sinful and powerful Rakshasa of terrific deeds and great power began to assail the gods.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: ततो देवाः समेताश्च ब्रह्माणामिदमब्रुवन्। वधाय रक्षसस्तस्य बलविप्रकृतास्तदा॥
en: The gods, oppressed by the power of the Rakshasa, assembling together, approached Brahman, for bringing about their enemy's destruction.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: तानुवाच ततो देवो विहितस्तत्र वै मया। यथास्य भविता मृत्युरचिरेणेति भारत॥
en: The eternal god answered them, O Bharata, saying,-I have already arranged the means by which the death of this Rakshasa may soon be encompassed.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: राजा दुर्योधनो नाम सखास्य भविता नृषु। तस्य स्नेहावबद्धोऽसौ ब्राह्मणानवमंस्यते॥
en: There will be a king of the name of Duryodhana. Among men, he will be the friend of this creature. Out of affection towards him, the Rakshasa will insult the Brahmanas.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: तत्रै रुषिता विप्रा विप्रकारप्रधर्षिताः। धक्ष्यन्ति वाग्बला: पापं ततो नाशं गमिष्यति॥
en: Pained by the wrong he will inflict upon them, the Brahmanas, whose power is in speech, will in anger censure him, at which he will die.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: स एष निहतः शेते ब्रह्मदण्डेन राक्षसः। चार्वाको नृपतिश्रेष्ठ मा शुचो भरतर्षभ॥
en: That Rakshasa Charvaka, foremost of kings, killed by the curse of the Brahmanas, lies there, dead. Do not, O foremost of Bharata's race, grieve.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: हतास्ते क्षत्रधर्मेण ज्ञातयस्तव पार्थिव। स्वर्गताश्च महात्मानो वीराः क्षत्रियपुङ्गवाः॥
en: Your kinsinen, O king, have all died while perforining the Kshatriya duties, Those leading Kshatriyas, those high-souled heroes, have all gone to heaven.

description: The Pandavas enter the city. Charvaka condemns the king.
sn: स त्वमातिष्ठ कार्याणि मा तेऽभूद् ग्लानिरच्युत। शत्रून् जहि प्रजा रक्ष द्विजांश्च परिपूजय॥
en: Do you attend to your duties now, O you of unfading glory, do not grieve, Kill your enemies, protect your subjects, and worship the Brahmanas.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तत: कुन्तीसुतो राजा गतमन्युर्गतज्वरः। काञ्चने प्राङ्मुखो हृष्टो न्यषीदत् परमासने॥
en: Vaishampayana said Shorn of grief and anxiety the royal son of Kunti, took his seat, with face eastwards, on an excellent seat made of gold.

sn: तमेवाभिमुखो पीठे प्रदीप्ते काञ्चने शुभे। सात्यकिर्वासुदेवश्च निषीदतुररिन्दमौ॥
en: On another seat, beautiful and shining and made of gold, sat, with face directed towards him, those two destroyer of foes, viz., Satyaki and Vasudeva.

sn: मध्ये कृत्वा तु राजानं भीमसेनार्जुनावुभौ। निषीदतुर्महात्मानौ श्लक्ष्णयोर्मणिपीठयोः॥
en: Placing the king in their midst, on his two sides sat Bhima and Arjuna upon two beautiful seats set with gerns.

sn: दान्ते सिंहासने शुभ्रे जाम्बूनदविभूषिते। पृथापि सहदेवेन सहास्ते नकुलेन च॥ कौरवः।
en: Upon a white ivory throne, decked with gold, sat Pritha with Sahadeva and Nakula.

sn: सुधर्मा विदुरो धौम्यो धृतराष्ट्रश्च निषेदुर्व्वलनाकारेष्वासनेषु पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: Sudharman, and Vidura, and Dhaumya, and the Kuru king Dhritarashtra, each sat separately on separate seats that shone with the effulgence of fire.

sn: युयुत्सुः संजयश्चैव गान्धारी च यशस्विनी। धृतराष्ट्रो यतो राजा ततः सर्वे समाविशन्॥
en: Yuyutsu and Sanjaya and the illustrious Gandhari, all sat down where king Dhritarashtra had sat.

sn: तत्रोपविष्टो धर्मात्मा श्वेताः सुमनसोऽस्पृशत्। स्वस्तिकानक्षतान् भूमि सुवर्ण रजतं मणिम्॥
en: Seated there, the righteous king, touched the beautiful white flowers, Swastikas, vessels full of various articles, earth, gold, silver, and gems.

sn: ततः प्रकृतयः सर्वाः पुरस्कृत्य पुरोहितम्। ददृशुर्धर्मराजानमादाय बहुमङ्गलम्॥
en: Then headed by the priest all the subjects came to see king Yudhishthira, bringing with them various kinds of sacred articles,

sn: पृथिवीं च सुवर्णं च रत्नानि विविधानि च। आभिषेचनिकं भाण्डं सर्वसम्भारसम्भृतम्॥
en: Then earth and gold, and many sorts of gems, and all other articles in profusion which were necessary for the performance of the coronation rite, were brought there.

sn: काञ्चनोदुम्बरास्तत्र राजताः पृथिवीमयाः। पूर्णकुम्भाः सुमनसो लाजा बहीषि गोरसम्॥ शमीपिप्पलपालाशसमिधो मधुसर्पिषी। स्रुव औदुम्बरः शङ्खस्तथा हेमविभूषितः॥
en: There were golden jars briinful with water, those made of copper and silver and earth, ' flowers, fried paddy, Kusha grass, cow's milk, (sacrificial) fuel consisting of the wood of Shami, Pippala, and Palasa, honey, clarified ! butter, (sacrificial) ladles made of Udumbara, and conchs adorned with gold.

sn: दाशार्हेणाभ्यनुज्ञातस्तत्र धौम्यः पुरोहितः। प्रागुदवप्रवणां वेदी लक्षणेनोपलिख्य च॥
en: Then requested by Krishna, the priest Dhaumya, constructed according to rule, an alter gradually inclining towards the east and the north.

sn: व्याघ्रचर्मोत्तरे शुक्ले सर्वतोभद्र आसने। दृढपादप्रतिष्ठाने हुताशनसमत्विषि॥ उपवेश्य महात्मानं कृष्णां च दुपदात्मजाम्। जुहाव पावकं धीमान् विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम्॥
en: Making the great Yudhishthira then, with Krishna the daughter of Drupada, seated upon a handsome seat, called Sarvatobhadra, with firm feet and covered with tiger-skin and effulgent, began to pour libations of clarified butter upon the sacrificial fire with proper Mantras.

sn: तत उत्थाय दाशार्हः शङ्खमादाय पूजितम्। अभ्यषिञ्चत् पतिं पृथ्व्याः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥ धृतराष्ट्रश्च राजर्षिः सर्वाः प्रकृतयस्तथा। अनुज्ञातोऽथ कृष्णेन भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डवः॥ पाञ्चजन्याभिषिक्तश्च राजामृतमुखोऽभवत्। ततोऽनुवादयामासुः पणवानकदुन्दुभीन्॥
en: Then rising from his seat, Krishna took up the sanctified conch, poured the water it continued upon the head of king Yudhishthira the son of Kunti. The royal sage Dhritarashtra and all the subjects also did the same as requested by Krishna. Thus bathed with the sanctified water of the conch, the son of Pandu then, with his brothers, looked highly beautiful.

sn: धर्मराजोऽपि तत् सर्वं प्रतिजग्राह धर्मतः। पूजयामास तांश्चापि विधिवद् भूरिदक्षिणः॥
en: Then Pandavas and Anakas and drums were beat. King Yudhishthira duly accepted the present made to him by the subjects. Always making enough of presents in profusion in all his sacrifices, the king honoured his subjects in return.

sn: ततो निष्कसहस्रेण ब्राह्मणान्स्वस्ति वाचयन्। वेदाध्ययनसम्पन्नान् धृतिशीलसमन्वितान्॥
en: He gave a thousand nishkas to the Brahmanas who utiered blessings on him. All of them had studied the Vedas and were wise and well-behaved.

sn: ते प्रीता ब्राह्मणा राजन् स्वस्त्यूचुर्जयमेव च। हंसा इव च नर्दन्तः प्रशशंसुर्युधिष्ठिरम्॥ युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो दिष्ट्या जयसि पाण्डव।
en: Pleased (with presents), the Brahmanas, O king, wished him prosperity and victory, and with voice melodious like that of swans, chanted his praises, saying-O Yudhishthira of mighty arms, by good luck, O son of Pandu, you have acquired victory. By good luck, O highly effulgent hero, you have regained your position through prowess.

sn: दिष्ट्या स्वधर्मं प्राप्तोऽसि विक्रमेण महाद्युते॥ दिष्ट्या गाण्डीवधन्वा च भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः। त्वं चापि कुशली राजन् माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥ मुक्ता वीरक्षयात् तस्मात् संग्रामाद् विजितद्विषः। क्षिप्रमुत्तरकार्याणि कुरु सर्वाणि भारत॥
en: By good luck, the wielder of Gandiva, and Bhimasena, and yourself, O king, and the two sons of Madri, are all well, having killed your foes and escaped alive from this battle, destructive of heroes. Do you, () Bharata, attend forthwith to those acts that should next be done.

sn: ततः प्रत्यर्चितः सद्भिर्धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। प्रतिपेदे महद् राज्यं सुहृद्भिः सह भारत॥
en: Thus worshipped by those pious men, king Yudhishthira, with his friends, became installed on the throne of a large kingdom, O Bharata.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच प्रकृतीनां च तद् वाक्यं देशकालोपबृंहितम्। श्रुत्वा युधिष्ठिरो राजा चोत्तरं प्रत्यभाषत॥ धन्याः पाण्डुसुता नूनं येषां ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवाः। तथ्यान् वाप्यथवातथ्यान् गुणानाहुः समागताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having listened to those words suitable to the hour and place, of his subjects, king Yudhishthira answered them saying,-"Great indeed must be the son of Pandu, whose merits, true or false, are thus recited by such foremost of Brahmanas assembled together.

sn: अनुग्राह्या वयं नूनं भवतामिति मे मतिः। यदेवं गुणसम्पन्नानस्मान् बूथ विमत्सराः॥
en: Forsooth, we are all your favourites, since you so freely describe us as possessing those accomplishment

sn: धृतराष्ट्रो महाराजः पिता मे दैवतं परम्। शासनेऽस्य प्रिये चैव स्थेयं मत्प्रियकाक्षिभिः॥
en: King Dhritarashtra, however, is our father and god. If you wish to do what is pleasing to me, always obey him and do what he likes.

sn: एतदर्थं हि जीवामि कृत्वा ज्ञातिवधं महत्। अस्य शुश्रूषणं कार्यं मया नित्यमतन्द्रिणा॥
en: Having killed all my kinsmen, I live for him alone. My great duty is to always serve him with particular care.

sn: यदि चाहमनुग्राह्यो भवतां सुहृदां तथा। धृतराष्ट्रे यथापूर्वं वृत्तिं वर्तितुमर्हथ॥
en: If you, as also my friends, think that I should be a favourite with you and them, let me then request you all to treat Dhritarashtra as you used to do before.

sn: एष नाथो हि जगतो भवतां च मया सह। अस्यैव पृथिवी कृत्स्ना पाण्डवाः सर्व एव च॥
en: He is the master of the world, of yourselves, and of myself. The whole world with the Pandavas, is his.

sn: एतन्मनसि कर्तव्यं भविद्भर्वचनं मम। अनुज्ञाप्याथ तान् राजा यथेष्टं गम्यतामिति॥
en: You should always remember those words of mine.' The king then asked them to go where they liked.

sn: पौरजानपदान् सर्वान् विसृज्य कुरुनन्दनः। यौवराज्येन कौन्तेयं भीमसेनमयोजयत्॥
en: Having sent away the citizens and the people of the provinces, the Kuru king appointed his brother Bhimasena as Yuvaraja.

sn: मन्त्रे च निश्चये चैव षाड्गुण्यस्य च चिन्तने। विदुरं बुद्धिसम्पन्न प्रीतिमान् स समादिशत्॥
en: And he gladly appointed the highly intelligent Vidura for helping him with his advice and for looking after the sixfold requirements of the state.

sn: कृताकृतपरिज्ञाने तथाऽऽयव्ययचिन्तने। संजयं योजयामास वृद्धं सर्वगुणैर्युतम्॥ बलस्य परिमाणे च भक्तवेतनयोस्तथा। नकुलं व्यादिशद् राजा कर्मणां चान्ववेक्षणे॥
en: And he appointed the old Sanjaya endued with every accomplishment, the superintendent of finances. He appointed Nakula superintendent of the forces, for giving them food and pay and for looking after other affairs of the army.

sn: परचक्रोपरोधे च दुष्टानां चावमर्दने। युधिष्ठिरो महाराज फाल्गुनं व्यादिदेश ह॥
en: King Yudhishthira appointed Phalguna for resisting hostile forces and punishing the wicked.

sn: द्विजानां देवकार्येषु कार्येष्वन्येषु चैव हा धौम्यं पुरोधसां श्रेष्ठं नित्यमेव समादिशत्॥
en: He appointed Dhaumya, the foremost of priests to attend daily to the Brahmanas and perform all rites in honour of the gods and all other religious rites.

sn: सहदेवं समीपस्थं नित्यमेव समादिशत्। तेन गोप्यो हि नृपतिः सर्वावस्थो विशाम्पते॥
en: He appointed Sahadeva to always remain by his side, for the king thought, O king, that he should always be protected by that brother of his. as

sn: यान् यानमन्यद् योग्यांश्च येषु येष्विह कर्मसु। तांस्तास्तेष्वेव युयुजे प्रीयमाणो महीपतिः॥
en: The king cheerfully supported others in various other affairs according to their gratification.

sn: विदुरं संजयं चैव युयुत्सुं च महामतिम्। अब्रवीत् परवीरघ्नो धर्मात्मा धर्मवत्सलः॥ उत्थायोत्थाय तत् कार्यमस्य राज्ञः पितुर्मम। सर्वं भवद्भिः कर्तव्यमप्रमत्तैर्यथायथम्॥
en: That destroyer of hostile heroes, viz., the righteous-souled king Yudhishthira, devoted to virtue, commanded Vidura and the high-souled Yuyutsu, saying,-'You should always with attention and care do everything that my royal father Dhritarashtra desires.

sn: पौरजानपदानां च यानि कार्याणि सर्वशः। राजानं समनुज्ञाप्य तानि कर्माणि भागशः॥
en: Everything for the citizens and the residents of the provinces should be done by you in your respective departments, after the king's permission. ever

description: Yudhishthira requests all to treat Dhritarashtra as king-Distribution of offices.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा ज्ञातीनां ये हता युधि। श्राद्धानि कारयामास तेषां पृथगुदारधीः॥
en: Vaishampayana said After this the noble king Yudhishthira caused the Shraddha rites to be performed for every one of his kinsmen killed in battle.

description: Yudhishthira requests all to treat Dhritarashtra as king-Distribution of offices.
sn: धृतराष्ट्रो ददौ राजा पुत्राणामौर्ध्वदेहिकम्। सर्वकामगुणोपेतमन्नं गाश्च धनानि च॥
en: King Dhritarashtra also distributed, for the good of his dead sons, excellent food, and kine, and immense wealth, and many beautiful and costly gems amongst the Brahmanas.

description: Yudhishthira requests all to treat Dhritarashtra as king-Distribution of offices.
sn: रत्नानि च विचित्राणि महार्हाणि महायशाः। युधिष्ठिरस्तु द्रोणस्य कर्णस्य च महात्मनः॥ धृष्टद्युम्नाभिमन्युभ्यां हैडिम्बस्य च रक्षसः। विराटप्रभृतीनां च सुहृदामुपकारिणाम्॥ द्रुपदद्रौपदेयानां द्रौपद्या सहितो ददौ।
en: Yudhishthira, accompanied by Draupadi, distributed much wealth for the sake of Drona and the great Karna, of Dhrishtadyumna and Abhimanyu, of the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha the son of Hidimba, and of Virata, and his other well-wishers who had served him loyally, and of Drupada and the five sons of Draupadi.

description: Yudhishthira requests all to treat Dhritarashtra as king-Distribution of offices.
sn: ब्राह्मणानां सहस्राणि पृथगेकैकमुद्दिशन्॥ धनै रत्नैश्च गोभिश्च वस्त्रैश्च समतर्पयत्।
en: For each of these, the king pleased thousands of Brahmanas with presents of wealth, gems, kine and clothes.

description: Yudhishthira requests all to treat Dhritarashtra as king-Distribution of offices.
sn: ये चान्ये पृथिवीपाला येषां नास्ति सुहृज्जनः॥ उद्दिश्योद्दिश्य तेषां च चक्रे राजौर्ध्वदेहिकम्।
en: The king performed the Shraddha rite for the good, in the next world, of every one of those kings also who had been killed in the battle without a single excepted kinsman or friend.

description: Yudhishthira requests all to treat Dhritarashtra as king-Distribution of offices.
sn: सभाः प्रपाश्च विविधास्तटाकानि च पाण्डवः॥ सुहृदां कारयामास सर्वेषामौर्ध्वदेहिकम्।
en: And the king also, for the good of the souls of all his friends, set up houses for the distribution of food, and erected places for the distribution of water, and tanks to be excavated in their names.

description: Yudhishthira requests all to treat Dhritarashtra as king-Distribution of offices.
sn: स तेषामनृणो भूत्वा गत्वा लोकेष्ववाच्यताम्॥ कृतकृत्योऽभवद् राजा प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्।
en: Thus satisfying the debt he owed to them and warding off the chance of censure in the world, the king became happy and began to protect his subjects virtuously.

description: Yudhishthira requests all to treat Dhritarashtra as king-Distribution of offices.
sn: धृतराष्ट्रं यथापूर्वं गान्धारी विदुरं तथा॥ सर्वांश्च कौरवान् मान्यान् भृत्यांश्च समपूजयत्।
en: He showed due honour as before, to Dhritarashtra, and Gandhari, and Vidura, and to all the Kaurava elders and to all the officers.

description: Yudhishthira requests all to treat Dhritarashtra as king-Distribution of offices.
sn: याच तत्र स्त्रियः काश्चिद्धतवीरा हतात्मजाः॥ सर्वास्ताः कौरवो राजा सम्पूज्यापालयद् घृणी।
en: The kind Kuru king honoured and protected all those ladies also who had, for the battle, been deprived of their heroic husbands and sons.

description: Yudhishthira requests all to treat Dhritarashtra as king-Distribution of offices.
sn: दीनान्धकृपणानां च गृहाच्छादनभोजनैः॥ आनृशंस्यपरो राजा चकारानुग्रहं प्रभुः।
en: The powerful king showed kindness towards the destitute and the blind and the helpless by giving them food, clothes and protection.

description: Yudhishthira requests all to treat Dhritarashtra as king-Distribution of offices.
sn: स विजित्य महीं कृत्स्नामानृण्यं प्राप्य वैरिषु। निःसपत्नः सुखी राजा विजहार युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Freed from foes and having vanquished the whole Earth, king Yudhishthira began to enjoy great happiness."

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच अभिषिक्तो महाप्राज्ञो राज्यं प्राप्त युधिष्ठिरः। दाशार्ह पुण्डरीकाक्षमुवाच प्राञ्जलिः शुचिः॥ तव कृष्ण प्रसादेन नयेन च बलेन च। बुद्ध्या च यदुशार्दूल तथा विक्रमणेन च॥ पुनः प्राप्तमिदं राज्यं पितृपैतामहं मया। नमस्ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष पुनः पुनररिन्दम॥
en: Having regained the kingdom, the highly pure and wise king Yudhishthira, after the ceremony of installation had been over, joining his hands together, addressed the louts-eyed Krishna of Dasharha's race, saying,-"Through your grace, O Krishna through your policy, might, intelligence and prowess, O foremost of the Yadus, I have regained this ancestral kingdom of mine. O you having lotus-eyes, I repeatedly bow to you, O chastiser of foes.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: त्वामेकमाहुः पुरुषं त्वामाहुः सात्वतां पतिम्। नामभिस्त्वां बहुविधैः स्तुवन्ति प्रयता द्विजाः॥
en: You have been called the One only Being. You are the refuge of all worshippers. The Rishis worship you under various names.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: विश्वकर्मन् नमस्तेऽस्तु विश्वात्मन् विश्वसम्भव। विष्णो जिष्णो हरे कृष्ण वैकुण्ठ पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: Salutation to you, O Creator of the Universe. You are the soul of the Universe. You are the soul of the Universe and the Universe has originated from you. You are Vishnu, you are Jishnu, you are Hari, you are Krishna, you are Vaikuntha, and you are the greatest of all beings.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: अदित्याः सप्तधा त्वं तु पुराणो गर्भतां गतः। पृश्निगर्भस्त्वमेवैकस्त्रियुगं त्वां वदन्त्यपि॥
en: You have, as said in the Puranas, taken your birth seven times in the womb of Aditi. You also took birth in the womb of Prishni. The learned say that you are the three Yugas.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: शुचिश्रवा हृषीकेशो घृताहिँस उच्यते। त्रिचक्षुः शम्भुरेकस्त्वं विभुर्दामोदरोऽपि च॥
en: All your deeds are sacred. You are the master of our senses. You are the great Lord worshipped in sacrifices. You are called the great swan. You are three-eyed Shambhu. You are One, though known as Vibhu and Damodara.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: वराहोऽग्निवृहद्भानुवृषभस्तार्क्ष्यलक्षणः। अनीकसाहः पुरुषः शिपिविष्ट उरुक्रमः॥
en: You are the great Boar you are Fire, you are the Sun, you have the emblem of bull on your banner, and you have Garuda also for your emblem. You are the grinder of inimical armies, you are the Being who perineates every form in the universe, and you are of irresistible power.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: वरिष्ठ उग्रसेनानी: सत्यो वाजसनिर्गुहः। अच्युतश्च्यावनोऽरीणां संस्कृतो विकृतिवृषः॥
en: You are the foremost of all things, you are dreadful, you are the commander of food, and you are Guha (the celestial commander-inchief). You yourself never suffer deterioration, you cause your enemies to fade and waste. You are the Brahmana of pure blood, and you are the issues of intermarriage. You are great.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: कृष्णधर्मस्त्वमेवादिवृषदर्भो वृषाकपिः। सिन्धुर्विधर्मस्त्रिककुप् त्रिधामा त्रिदिवाञ्च्युतः॥
en: You move in the sky, you are called Vrishadarbha and Vrishakapi. You are Ocean, you are without attributes, you have three huinps, you have three abodes, and you create human forms of Earth, coming down from heaven.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: सम्राड् विराट् स्वराट् चैव सुरराजो भवोद्भवः। विभुर्भूरतिभूः कृष्णः कृष्णवर्मा त्वमेव च ॥
en: You are Emperor, you are superior to Emperor, and even superior to him. You are King of the gods, and you are the root of Universe. You are all-powerful you are existence in every form, you are formless, you are Krishna, and you are fire.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: स्विष्टकृद् भिषगावर्तः कपिलस्त्वं च वामनः। यज्ञो ध्रुवः पतङ्गश्च यज्ञसेनस्त्वमुच्यसे॥
en: You are the Creator, you are the father of the celestial physicians, you are (the sage) Kapila, and you are the Dwarf. You are Sacrifice embodied, you are Dhruva, you are called Yajnasena.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: शिखण्डी नहुषो बभ्रुर्दिवःस्पृक् त्वं पुनर्वसुः। सुबभू रुक्मयज्ञश्च सुषेणो दुन्दुभिस्तथा॥
en: You are Shikhandin, you are Nahusha, and you are Babhru. You are the constellation Punarvasu residing in the sky. You are of iwany colour, you are the sacrifice of Uktha, you are Sushena, you are the drum.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: गभस्तिनेमिः श्रीपद्यः पुष्करः पुष्पधारणः। ऋभुर्विभुः सर्वसूक्ष्मश्चारित्रं चैव पठ्यसे॥
en: are The track of your car-wheels is light. You are the lotus of Prosperity, you are the cloud Pushkara, and you are adorned with garlands. You are rich, you are powerful you are the most subtile, and you are described in the Vedas.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: अम्भोनिधिस्त्वं ब्रह्मा त्वं पवित्रं धाम धामवित्। हिरण्यगर्भ त्वामाहुः स्वधा स्वाहा च केशव॥
en: You are the great sea, you are Brahman, you are the sacred refuge, and you know the residences of all. You called Hiranyagarbha, you are the sacred mantras swadha and svaha, you are Keshava.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: योनिस्त्वमस्य प्रलयश्च कृष्ण त्वमेवेदं सृजसे विश्वमग्रे। विश्वं चेदं त्वद्वशे विश्वयोने नमोऽस्तु ते शाईचक्रासिपाणे॥
en: You are the cause of all, and you are its dissolution. In the beginning you created the universe. This universe is under your sway, O Creator of the universe. Salutations to you, O wielder of Sharanga bow, discus, and sword.

description: The funeral rites of the departed kingsmen.
sn: एवं स्तुतो धर्मराजेन कृष्णः सभामध्ये प्रीतिमान् पुष्कराक्षः। तमभ्यनन्दद् भारतं पुष्कलार्भि र्वाग्भिर्येष्ठं पाण्डवं यादवाय्यः॥
en: Thus hymned by king Yudhishthira in the midst of the assembly, the lotus-eyed Krishna became pleased. That foremost one of the Yadavas then began to cheer up the eldest son of Pandu with many sweet speeches.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो विसर्जयामास सर्वाः प्रकृतयो नृपः। विविशुश्चाभ्यनुज्ञाता यथास्वानि गृहाणि ते॥
en: Vaishampayana said, The king sent away all his subjects, who, ordered by the king, came back to their respective abodes.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भीमं भीमपराक्रमम्। सान्त्वयन्नब्रवीच्छीमानर्जुनं यमजौ तथा॥ शत्रुभिर्विविधैः शस्त्रैः क्षतदेहा महारणे। श्रान्ता भवन्तः सुभृशं तापिताः शोकमन्युभिः॥
en: Solacing his brothers, Yudhishthira, shining with beauty, then addressed highly powerful brothers Bhima, Arjuna and the twins, saying,-Your bodies have, in the great battle, been wounded with various weapons by the foe. You are greatly tired, sorrow and anger have burnt your hearts.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: अरण्ये दुःखवसतीमत्कृते भरतर्षभाः। भवद्भिरनुभूता हि यथा कुपुरुषैस्तथा॥
en: Through my fault, O foremost of Bharata's race, you have suffered the miseries of banishment in the forests like ordinary men.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: यथासुखं यथाजोषं जयोऽयमनुभूयताम्। विश्रान्ताल्लंब्यविज्ञानाश्वः समेतास्मि वः पुनः॥
en: With great joy and ease enjoy this victory. After taking rest and refreshing your faculties, meet me again in the morning.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: ततो दुर्योधनगृहं प्रासादैरुपशोभितम्। बहुरत्नसमाकीर्णं दासीदाससमाकुलम्॥ धृतराष्ट्राभ्यनुज्ञातं भ्रात्रा दत्तं वृकोदरः। प्रतिपेदे महाबाहुर्मन्दिरं मघवानिव॥
en: After this, the mighty-armed Vrikodara, like Indra entering his own beautiful mansion, entered the palace of Duryodhana, that was decorated with many excellent buildings and rooms, that abounded with gems of various kinds, and that was full of servants male and female with the consent of Dhritarashtra.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: यथा दुर्योधनगृहं तथा दुःशासनस्य तु। प्रासादमाला संयुक्तं हेमतोरणभूषितम्॥ दासीदाससुसम्पूर्ण प्रभूतधनधान्यवत्। प्रतिपेदे महाबाहुरर्जुनो राजशासनात्॥
en: The Mighty-armed Arjuna also, at the king's behest obtained the palace of Dushasana which was not inferior to Duryodhana's and which considered of many excellent mansions and was adorned with a golden gate-way, and which was full of riches and attendant of both sexes.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: दुर्मर्षणस्य भवनं दुःशासनगृहाद् वरम्। कुबेरभवनप्रख्यं मणिहेमविभूषितम्॥
en: The palace of Durmarshana was even superior to that Dushasana. Resembling the palace of Kubera himself, it was adorned with gold and every sort of gem.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: नकुलाय वराहय कर्शिताय महावने। ददौ प्रीतो महाराज धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: King Yudhishthira gladly gave it to Nakula who deserved it best and who had been reduced with sufferings in the great forest.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: दुर्मुखस्य च वेश्माग्र्यं श्रीमत् कनकभूषणम्। पूर्णपद्मदलाक्षीणां स्त्रीणां शयनसंकुलम्॥
en: The best of palaces belonging to Durmukha was highly beautiful and adorned with gold. It was full of beds and beautiful women having eyes like lotus-petals.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: प्रददौ सहदेवाय सततं प्रियकारिणे। मुमुदे तच्च लघ्वासौ कैलासं धनदो यथा।॥
en: The king gave it to Sahadeva who was ever busy with doing what was agreeable to him. Obtaining it, Sahadeva became pleased as the king treasures upon obtaining Kailasa.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: युयुत्सुर्विदुरश्चैव संजयश्च विशाम्पते। सुधर्मा चैव धौम्यश्च यथास्वान् जग्मुरालयान्॥
en: Yuyutsu and Vidura and Sanjaya, O king, and Sudharman and Dhaumya, proceeded to their foriner abodes.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: सह सात्यकिना शौरिरर्जुनस्य निवेशनम्। विवेश पुरुषव्याघ्रो व्याघ्रो गिरिगुहामिव॥
en: Like a tiger entering his cave in the hills that foremost of men, viz., Krishna, accompanied by Satyaki, entered the palace of Arjuna.

description: Yudhishthira describes the various manifestations of Krishna.
sn: तत्र भक्ष्यान्नपानैस्ते मुदिताः सुसुखोषिताः। सुखप्रबुद्धा राजानमुपतस्थुर्युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Feasting on the dishes and drinks, the princess passed the night in merriment. Awaking in the morning with delighted hearts, they approached the presence of the king Yudhishthira.

sn: जनमेजय उवाच प्राप्य राज्यं महाबाहुर्धर्मपुत्रौ युधिष्ठिरः। यदन्यदकरोद् विप्र तन्मे वक्तुमिहार्हसि॥
en: Janamejaya said You should, O learned Brahmana, tell me what was next done by Yudhishthira the mighty-armed son of Dharma after he had regained his kingdom.

sn: भगवान् वा हृषीकेशस्त्रैलोक्यस्य परो गुरुः। ऋषे यदकरोद्वीरस्तच्च व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: You should tell me also, O Rishi, what the heroic Hrishikesha, the supreme lord of the three worlds, did after this.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच शृणु तत्त्वेन राजेन्द्र कीर्त्यमानं मयानघ। वासुदेवं पुरस्कृत्य यदकुर्वत पाण्डवाः॥
en: Hear me, O king, as I narrate fully, O sinless one, what the Pandavas, headed by Vasudeva did after this.

sn: प्राप्य राज्यं महाराज कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। चातुर्वण्र्यं यथायोग्यं स्वे स्वे स्थाने न्यवेशयत्॥
en: Having regained his kingdom, O monarch, Kunti's son Yudhishthira made each of the four orders of men perform their respective duties.

sn: ब्राह्मणानां सहस्रं च स्नातकानां महात्मनाम्। सहस्रं निष्कमेकैकं दापयामास पाण्डवः॥
en: The (eldest) son of Pandu gave a thousand great Brahmanas of the Snataka order a thousand gold coins each.

sn: तथाऽनुजीविनो भृत्यान् संश्रितानतिथीनपि। कामैः संतर्पयामास कृपणांस्तर्ककानपि॥
en: He then pleased the servants who were dependent on him and the guests who came to him, including persons who were undeserving, by satisfying their wishes.

sn: पुरोहिताय धौम्याय प्रादादयुतशः स गा:। धनं सुवर्ण रजतं वासांसि विविधान्यपि॥
en: He gave to his priest Dhaumya kine in thousands, and immense wealth and gold and silver and dresses of various kinds.

sn: कृपाय च महाराज गुरुवृत्तिमवर्तत। विदुराय च राजासौ पूजां चक्रे यतव्रतः॥
en: O monarch, the king treated Kripa like a preceptor. Ever observing vows the king continued to honour Vidura highly.

sn: भक्ष्यानपानैर्विविधसैर्वासोभिः शयनासनैः। सर्वान् संतोषयामास संश्रितान् ददतां वरः॥
en: That foremost of charitable men satisfied all persons with presents of food and drink and dresses of various kinds and beds and seats.

sn: लब्धप्रशमनं कृत्वा स राजा राजसत्तम। युयुत्सोर्धार्तराष्ट्रस्य पूजां चक्रे महायशाः॥
en: Having restored peace to his kingdom the highly illustrious king, O best of monarchs, paid due honours to Yuyutsu and Dhritarashtra.

sn: धृतराष्ट्राय तद् राज्यं गान्धार्थ विदुराय च। निवेद्य सुस्थवद् राजा सुखमास्ते युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Placing his kingdom at the disposal of Dhritarashtra, of Gandhari, and of Vidura, king Yudhishthira spent his days happily.

sn: तथा सर्वं स नगरं प्रसाद्य भरतर्षभ। वासुदेवं महात्मानमभ्यगच्छत् कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Having pleased everybody, including the citizens, in this way, Yudhishthira, O foremost of Bharata's race, approached with joined hands the presence of the great Vasudeva.

sn: ततो महति पर्यङ्के मणिकाञ्चनभूषिते। ददर्श कृष्णमासीनं नीलमेघसमद्युतिम्॥
en: He saw Krishna, of the hue of a blue cloud, seated on a large sofa bedecked with gold and gems.

sn: जाज्वल्यमानं वपुषा दिव्याभरणभूषितम्। पीतकौशेयवसनं हेम्नेवोपगतं मणिम्॥
en: Clad in yellow silk robes and adorned with celestial ornaments, his person shone effulgent like a jewel set on gold.

sn: कौस्तुभेनोरसिस्थेन मणिनाभिविराजितम्। उद्यतेवोदयं शैलं सूर्येणाभिविराजितम्॥
en: His bosom adorned with the Kaustubha gem, he shone like the mountain with the rising Sun.

sn: नौपम्यं विद्यते तस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु किंचन। सोऽभिगम्य महात्मानं विष्णुं पुरुषविग्रहम्॥ उवाध मधुरं राजा स्मितपूर्वमिदं तदा। सुखेन ते निशा कच्चिद् व्युष्टा बुद्धिमतां वर॥
en: There was no equal of his beauty in three worlds, Approaching the great one who was an incarnation of Vishnu, king Yudhishthira addressed him sweetly and smilingly saying,-'O foremost of intelligent men, have you passed the night happily?

sn: कच्चिज्ज्ञानानि सर्वाणि प्रसन्नानि तवाच्युत। तथैवोपश्रिता देवी बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतां वर॥
en: O you of unfading glory, have all your faculties been fully invigorated? O foremost of intelligent persons, is it all right with your understanding?

sn: वयं राज्यमनुप्राप्ताः पृथिवी च वशे स्थिता। तव प्रसादाद् भगवंस्त्रिलोकगतिविक्रम॥ जयं प्राप्ता यशश्चयं न च धर्मच्युता वयम्।
en: We have regained our kingdom and the whole Earth has come under our sway, O divine lord, through your favour, O refuge of the three worlds and, O you of three steps. Through your favour we have gained victory and obtained great fame and have not transgressed the duties of our order.'

sn: तं तथा भाषमाणं तु धर्मराजमरिंदमम्। नोवाच भगवान् किंचिद् ध्यानमेवान्वपद्यत॥
en: The divine Krishna did not speak a single word to that chastiser of enemies, king Yudhishthira, for he was then rapt in meditation.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किमिदं परमाश्चर्यं ध्यायस्यमितविक्रम। कच्चिल्लोकत्रयस्यास्य स्वस्ति लोकपरायण।।शा
en: Yudhishthira said 'Wonderful it is, o you of immeasurable prowess, that you are rapt in meditation. O great refuge of the universe, is it all well with the three worlds?

sn: चतुर्थं ध्यानमार्ग त्वमालम्ब्य पुरुषर्षभ। अपक्रान्तो यतो देवस्तेन मे विस्मितं मनः॥
en: When you have, O god, withdrawn yourself from the world, having, O foremost of men, adopted the fourth state (of perfect unconsciousness of the world) my mind has been filled with wonder.

sn: निगृहीतो हि वायुस्ते पञ्चकर्मा शरीरगः। इन्द्रियाणि प्रसन्नानि मनसि स्थापितानि ते॥
en: The five vital airs which act within the body have been controlled by you. You have controlled your senses within your mind.

sn: वाक् च सत्त्वं च गोविन्द बुद्धौ संवेशितानि ते। सर्वे चैव गुणा देवाः क्षेत्रज्ञे ते निवेशिताः॥
en: Both words and mind, O Govinda, have been concentered within your understanding. All your senses, have been withdrawn into your self.

sn: नेङ्गन्ति तव रोमाणि स्थिरा बुद्धिस्तथा मनः। काष्ठकुड्यशिलाभूतो निरीहश्चासि माधवा॥
en: The hair on your body stands erect. Your mind and understanding are both calm. You are as immobile now, O Madhava, as an wooden post or a stone?

sn: यथा दीपो निवातस्था निरिङ्गो ज्वलते पुनः। तथासि भगवन् देव पाषाण इव निश्चलः॥
en: O illustrious god, you are as calm as the flame of a lamp burning in a place where there is no wind. You are as immobile as a rock.

sn: यदि श्रोतुमिहार्हामि न रहस्यं च ते यदि। छिन्धि मे संशयं देव प्रपन्नायाभियाचते॥
en: If I am fit to hear the cause, and if it is no secret, remove, O god, my doubt, for I beg this। favour from you.

sn: त्वं हि कर्ता विकर्ता च क्षरं चैवाक्षरं च हि। अनादिनिधनश्चाद्यस्त्वमेव पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: You are the Creator and you are the Destroyer. You are destructible and you indestructible. You are without beginning and you are without end. You are the first and the foremost of beings.

sn: त्वत्प्रपन्नाय भक्ताय शिरसा प्रणताय च। ध्यानस्यास्य यथा तत्त्वं ब्रूहि धर्मभृतां वर॥
en: O foremost of pious men, tell me the cause of this abstraction. I solicit your favour, and am your devoted worshipper, and am bending my head to you.

sn: ततः स्वे गोचरे न्यस्य मनोबुद्धिन्द्रियाणि सः। स्मितपूर्वमुवाचेदं भगवान् वासवानुजः॥
en: Thus accosted the illustrious younger brother of Vasava, reinstating his mind, understanding and the senses in their proper places, said these words similingly.

sn: वासुदेव उवाच शरतल्पगतो भीष्मः शाम्यन्निव हुताशनः मां ध्याति पुरुषव्याघ्रस्ततो मे तद्गतं मनः॥
en: Vasudeva said 'That foremost men, viz., Bhishma, who is now lying on a bed of arrows, and who is now like a fire that is about to be extinguished, is thinking of me. It is therefore my mind also was concentrated on him.

sn: यस्य ज्यातलनिर्घोषं विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः। न सेहे देवराजोऽपि तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: My mind was fixed in him the twang of whose bow and the sound of whose palms Indra himself was unable to bear.

sn: येनाभिजित्य तरसा समस्तं राजमण्डलम्। ऊढास्तिस्त्रस्तु ताः कन्यास्तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: I was thinking of him who having defeated in a moment all the assembled kings, carried the three princesses of Kashi for the marriage of his brother Vichitravirya.

sn: त्रयोविंशतिरात्रं यो योधयामास भार्गवम्। न च रामेण निस्तीर्णस्तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: I was thinking of him who fought continually for twenty-three days with Rama himself of Bhrigu's race and whom Rama could not defeat.

sn: एकीकृत्येन्द्रियग्राम मनः संयम्य मेधया। शरणं मामुपागच्छत् ततो मे तद्गतं मनः॥
en: Controlling all his senses and concentrating his mind by the aid of his understanding, he sought my refuge. It was for this that I had fixed my mind upon him.

sn: यं गङ्गा गर्भविधिना धारयामास पार्थिव। वसिष्ठशिक्षितं तात तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: I was thinking of him whom Ganga conceived and gave birth to, according to ordinary human laws and whom Vasishtha took as a pupil.

sn: दिव्यास्त्राणि महातेजा यो धारयति बुद्धिमान्। साङ्गांश्च चतुरो वेदांस्तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: I was thinking of that powerful hero of great intelligence who is a master of all the celestial weapons as also of the four Vedas with all their auxiliaries.

sn: रामस्य दयितं शिष्यं जामदग्न्यस्य पाण्डव। आधारं सर्वविद्यानां तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: I was thinking of him, O son of Pandu, who is the favourite disciple of Rama the son of Jamadagni, and who is the master of all the sciences.

sn: स हि भूतं भविष्यच्च भवच्च भरतर्षभ। वेत्ति धर्मविदां श्रेष्ठं तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: I was thinking of that best of all persons conversant with morality and duty, of him, O foremost of Bharatas, who knows the Past, the Future, and the Present.

sn: तस्मिन् हि पुरुषव्याघ्ने कर्मभिः स्वैर्दिवं गते। भविष्यति मही पार्थ नष्टचन्द्रेव शर्वरी॥
en: After the ascension to heaven of that foremost of kings for his own achievements the Earth, O son of Pritha, will took like a moonless night.

sn: तद् युधिष्ठिर गाङ्गेयं भीष्मं भीमपराक्रमम्। अभिगम्योपसंगृह्य पृच्छ यत् ते मनोगतम्॥
en: Therefore, O Yudhishthira, humbly approaching Ganga's son, viz., Bhishma, ask him about what you may wish to learn.

sn: चातुर्विद्यं चातुर्होत्रं चातुराश्रम्यमेव च। राजधर्मांश्च निखिलान् पृच्छैनं पृथिवीपते॥
en: O king enquire of him about the four branches of knowledge, about sacrifices and the rites sanctioned for the four castes, about the four modes of life, and about the duties of kings.

sn: तस्मिन्नस्तमिते भीष्मे कौरवाणां धुरंधरे। ज्ञानान्यस्तं गमिष्यन्ति तस्मात्त्वां चोदयाम्यहम्॥
en: When Bhishma, that foremost one of Kuru's race, will disappear from the world every kind of knowledge will go away with him. It is, therefore, that I urge you to do it.

sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा वासुदेवस्य तथ्यं वचनमुत्तमम्। साश्रुकण्ठः स धर्मज्ञो जनार्दनमुवाच ह॥ यद् भवानाह भीष्मस्य प्रभावं प्रति माधव। तथा तन्नात्र संदेहो विद्यते मम माधव।॥
en: Hearing these wholesome and pregnant words of Vasudeva, the righteous Yudhishthira, with voice suppressed with tears, answered Janardana saying—'What you have said, O Madhava, about the greatness of Bhishma, is perfectly true. I have not the least doubt about it.

sn: महाभाग्यं च भीष्मस्य प्रभावश्च महाद्युते। श्रुतं मया कथयतां ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: I had heard of the piety and greatness, of the illustrious Bhishma from great Brahmanas talking about it.

sn: भवांश्च कर्ता लोकानां यद् ब्रवीत्यरिसूदन। तथा तदनभिध्येयं वाक्यं यादवनन्दन॥
en: You, O killer of foes, are the Creator of all the worlds, There, cannot, therefore, O delighter of the Yadavas, be the least doubt in what you say.

sn: यदि त्वनुग्रहवती बुद्धिस्ते मयि माधव। त्वामग्रतः पुरस्कृत्य भीष्मं यास्यामहे वयम्॥
en: If you are pleased to show us favour, O Madhava, then we shall go to Bhishma with yourself at our head.

sn: आवृते भगवत्यर्के स हि लोकान् गमिष्यति। त्वदर्शनं महाबाहो तस्मादर्हति कौरवः॥
en: When the divine Sun shall have turned towards the north, Bhishma will leave (this world) for those blissful regions which he has acquired. That descendant of Kuru's race, therefore, O mighty-armed one, deserves to see you.

sn: तव चाद्यस्य देवस्य क्षरस्यैवाक्षरस्य च। दर्शनं त्वस्य लाभः स्यात् त्वं हि ब्रह्ममयो निधिः।।
en: Bhishina will then see you who are the first of gods, and who destructible and indestructible. Indeed, O lord, you are the vast receptacle of Brahma.

sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वैवं धर्मराजस्य वचनं मधुसूदनः। पार्श्वस्थं सात्यकिं प्राह रथो मे युज्यतामिति॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words of king Yudhishthira, the destroyer of Madhu addressed Satyaki who was sitting by him, saying,–'Let my car be yoked.

sn: सात्यकिस्त्वाशु निष्क्रम्य केशवस्य समीपतः। दारुकं प्राह कृष्णस्य युज्यतां रथ इत्युत।॥
en: are At this Satyaki quickly left Keshava's company and going out, ordered Daruka, saying,-'Let Krishna's car be made ready.'

sn: स सात्यकेराशु वचो निशम्य रथोत्तमं काञ्चनभूषिताङ्गम्। विभूषितं हेमनिबद्धचक्रम्॥ दिवाकरांशुप्रभमाशुगामिन विचित्रनानामणिभूषितान्तरम्। नवोदितं सूर्यमिव प्रतापिनं विचित्रता_ध्वजिनं पताकिनम्॥ मनोजवैः काञ्चनभूषिताङ्गैः। संयुक्तमावेदयदच्युताय कृताञ्जलिर्दारुको राजसिंह॥
en: Hearing the words of Satyaki, Daruka immediately yoked Krishna's car. That best of cars, adorned with gold, decked with profuse emeralds, and moon-gems and sun-gems furnished with golden wheels, effulgent, fleet as the wind, set in the middle with various other kinds of jewels, beautiful as the morning sun, equipped with a beautiful standard bearing the emblem of Gar::da, and numberless other banners, was yoked with those best of horses quick coursing as thought, viz., Sugriva and Saivya and the other two, in trappings of gold. Having yoked it, О tiger among kings, Daruka with joined palms, informed Krishna of the fact

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: जनमेजय उवाच शरतल्पे शयानस्तु भरतानां पितामहः। कथमुत्सृष्टवान् देहं कं च योगमधारयत्॥
en: How did the grandfather of Bharatas, who lay on a bed of arrows, cast off his body and what sort of Yoga did he adopt?

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच शृणुष्वावहितो राजशुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः। भीष्मस्य कुरुशार्दूल देहोत्सर्ग महात्मनः॥
en: Listen, O king, with pure heart and rapt attention, as to how, O foremost of the Kurus, the great Bhishma renounced his body.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: निवृत्तमात्रे त्वयन उत्तरे वै दिवाकरे। समावेशयदात्मानमात्मन्येव समाहितः॥
en: As soon as the Sun, passing the solstitial point entered in his northerly course, Bhishma with rapt attention, caused his soul (as connected with and independent of the body) to enter into the Universal Soul.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: विकीर्णारिवादित्यो भीष्मः शरशतैश्चितः। शुशुभे परया लक्ष्या वृतो ब्राह्मणसत्तमैः॥
en: Surrounded by many foremost of Brahmanas, that hero, his body cut with innumerable arrows, shone like the sun with his innumerable rays.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: व्यासेन वेदविदुषा नारदेन सुरर्षिणा। देवस्थानेन वात्स्येन तथाश्मकसुमन्तुना॥ तथा जैमिनिना चैव पैलेन च महात्मना। शाण्डिल्यदेवलाभ्यां च मैत्रेयेण च धीमता॥ असितेन वसिष्ठेन कौशिकेन महात्मना। हारीतलोमशाभ्यां च तथाऽऽत्रेयेण धीमता॥ बृहस्पतिश्च शुक्रश्च च्यवनश्च महामुनिः। सनत्कुमारः कपिलो वाल्मीकिस्तुम्बुरुः कुरुः॥ मौद्गल्यो भार्गवो रामस्तृणबिन्दुमहामुनिः। पिप्पलादोऽथ वायुश्च संवर्तः पुलहः कचः॥ काश्यपश्च पुलस्त्यश्च ऋतुर्दक्षः पराशरः। मरीचिरङ्गिराः काश्यो गौतमो गालवो मुनिः॥ धौम्यो विभाण्डो माण्डव्यो धौनः कृष्णानुभौतिकः। उलूकः परमो विप्रो मार्कण्डेयो महामुनिः॥ भास्करिः पूरणः कृष्णः सूतः परमधार्मिकः। एतैश्चान्यैर्मुनिगणैर्महाभागैर्महात्मभिः॥ श्रद्धादमशमोपेतैर्वृतश्चन्द्र इव ग्रहैः।
en: Surrounded by Vyasa conversant with the Vedas, by the celestial Rishi Narada, by Devasthana, by Ashmakasumantu, by Jaimini, by the great Paila, by Shandilya, by Devarata, by the highly intelligent Maitreya, by Asita and Vasishtha and the great Kaushika, by Harita and Lomasa and the highly intelligent Atri's son, by Brihaspati and Shukra and the great sage Chyavana, by Sanatkumara and Kapila and Valmiki and Tumvuru and Kuru, By Maudgalya and Rama of Bhrigu's race, and the great sage Trinavindu, by Pippalada and Vayu and Samvarta and Pulaha and Kacha, by Kashyapa and Pulastya and Kratu and Daksha and Parashara, by Marichi and Angiras and Kashyapa and Gautama and the sage Galava, by Dhaumya and Vibhanda and Mandavya and Dhaumra and Krishnanubhautika, by Uluka, that foremost of Brahmanas and the great sage Markandeya, by Bhaskari and Purana and Krishna and Suta, —that foremost of pious men, surrounded by these and many other saintly sages of great souls and endued with faith and self-control and equanimity of mind, the Kuru hero looked like the Moon surrounded by the planets and the stars.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: भीष्मस्तु पुरुषव्याघ्रः कर्मणा मनसा गिरा॥ शरतल्पगतः कृष्णं प्रदध्यौ प्राञ्जलिः शुचिः।
en: Lying on his bed of arrows, that foremost of men, Bhishma, with pure hearts and joined hands, thought of Krishna in mind, word, and deed.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: स्वरेण हृष्टपुष्टेन तुष्टाव मधुसूदनम्॥ योगेश्वरं पद्मनाभं विष्णुं जिष्णुं जगत्पतिम्।
en: With a cheerful and strong voice he sang the encomium of the destroyer of Madhu, that lord of Yoga, the lotus-navelled deity, that lord of the universe, called Vishnu and Jishnu.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा वाग्विदां प्रवरः प्रभुः॥ भीष्मः परमधर्मात्मा वासुदेवमथास्तुवत्।
en: With joined hands, that foremost of orators, that powerful Bhishma of highly virtuous soul, thus praised Vasudeva.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: भीष्म उवाच आरिराधयिषुः कृष्णं वाचं जिगदिधामि याम्॥ तया व्याससमासिन्या प्रीयतां पुरुषोत्तमः।
en: Bhishma said "O Krishna, O foremost of Beings, be pleased with words with I utter, in brief and in full, from desire of singing your praises.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: शुचिं शुचिपदं हंसं तत्पदं परमेष्ठिनम्॥ युक्त्वा सर्वात्मनाऽऽत्मानं तं प्रपद्ये प्रजापतिम्।
en: You are pure and purity. You transcend all. You are what people say to be THAT. You are the Supreme Lord. With my entire heart I seek your refuge, O universal Soul and Lord of all creatures!

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: अनाद्यन्तं परं ब्रह्म न देवा नर्षयो विदुः॥ एको यं वेद भगवान् धाता नारायणो हरिः।
en: You are without beginning and without end. You are the greatest of the great and Brahma. Neither the celestials nor the Rishis know you. The divine Creator, Narayana or Hari, alone knows you.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: नारायणादृषिगणास्तथा सिद्धमहोरगाः॥ देवा देवर्षयश्चैव यं विदुः परमव्ययम्।
en: Through Narayana, the Rishis, the Siddhas, the great Nagas, the gods, and the celestial Rishis, know a little of you. You are the greatest of the great and undecaying.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: देवदानवगन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः॥ यं न जानन्ति को ह्येष कुतो वा भगवानिति।
en: The celestials, the Danavas, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the Pannagas, do not know who you are and whence you have sprung.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यस्मिन् विश्वानि भूतानि तिष्ठन्ति च विशन्ति च॥ गुणभूतानि भूतेशे सूत्रे मणिगणा इव।
en: All the worlds and all created things live in you and enter you at the time of dissolution. Like gems strung together in a thread, all things possessing attributes exist in you, the Supreme Lord.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यस्मिन् नित्ये तते तन्तौ दृढे स्रगिव तिष्ठति॥ सदसद्ग्रथितं विश्वं विश्वाङ्गे विश्वकर्मणि।
en: Having the universe for your work and the universe for your limbs, this universe consisting of mind and matter exists in your eternal and all-pervading soul like flowers strung together in a strong thread.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: हरिं सहस्रशिरसं सहस्रचरणेक्षणम्॥ सहस्रबाहुमुकुटं सहस्रवदनोज्ज्वलम्।
en: You are called Hari, have a thousand heads, thousand feet, thousand eyes, thousand arms, thousand crowns, and thousand effulgent faces. You are called Narayana, the deity, and the refuge of the universe.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: प्राहुर्नारायणं देवं यं विश्वस्य परायणम्॥ अणीयसामणीयांसं स्थविष्ठं च स्थवीयसाम्।
en: You are the subtilest of the subtile, grossest of the gross, the heaviest of the heavy, and the highest of the high.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: गरीयसां गरिष्ठं च श्रेष्ठं च श्रेयसामपि॥ यं वाकेष्वनुवाकेषु निषत्सूपनिषत्सु च।
en: In the Vaks, the Anuvaks, the Nishads, and the Upanishads, you are regarded as the Supreme Being of irresistible power. In the Samans also, which are always true, you are known as Truth's self.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: गृणन्ति सत्यकर्माणं सत्यं सत्येषु सामसु॥ चतुर्भिश्चतुरात्मानं सत्त्वस्थं सात्वतां पतिम्।
en: You are of quadruple soul, Supreme soul, individual soul, mind and consciousness. You manifest yourself only in the understanding of all creatures. You are the Lord of your votaries. O god, you are worshipped under four good, high, and secret names, Vasudeva, Sankarshana, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यं दिव्यैर्देवमर्चन्ति गुरैः परमनामभिः॥ यस्मिन् नित्यं तपस्तप्तं यदङ्गेष्वनुतिष्ठति।
en: Penances are always present in you, penances, live in your form. You are the Universal Soul. You are omniscient. You are the universe. You are the creator of everything in the universe.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: सर्वात्मा सर्ववित् सर्वः सर्वज्ञः सर्वभावनः॥ यं देवं देवकी देवी वसुदेवादजीजनत्।
en: Like two sticks creating a blazing fire, you have been born of the divine Devaki and Vasudeva for the protection of Brahma on Earth.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: भौमस्य ब्रह्मणो गुप्त्यै दीप्तमग्निमिवारणिः॥ यमनन्यो व्यपेताशीरात्मानं वीतकल्मषम्।
en: For his eternal liberation, the devout worshipper, withdrawing his mind from everything else and renouncing all desires, beholds you, O Govinda, who are the pure Soul, in his own soul.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: दृष्ट्यानन्त्याय गोविन्दं पश्यत्यात्मानमात्मनि॥ अतिवाविन्द्रकर्माणमतिसूर्यातितेजसम्।
en: You excel the sun in glory. You are beyond the perception of the senses and the understanding. O lord of all creatures, I place myself in your hands.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: अतिबुद्धीन्द्रियात्मानं तं प्रपद्ये प्रजापतिम्॥ पुराणे पुरुषं प्रोक्तं ब्रह्म प्रोक्तं युगादिषु। क्षये संकर्षणं प्रोक्तं तमुपास्यमुपास्महे॥
en: In the Puranas, you have been described as Purusha. In the beginning of cycles, you are said to be Brahma, and at the time of universal dissolution you are spoken of as Sankarshana. You are worshipful therefore I worship you. are

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यमेकं बहुधाऽऽत्मानं प्रादुर्भूतमधोक्षजम्। नान्यभक्ताः क्रियावन्तो यजन्ते सर्वकामदम्॥
en: Though one, you have yet many forms. You have your passions under complete control. Faithfully performing the rites laid down in the scriptures, your votaries sacrifice to you, O giver of every wish.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यमाहुर्जगतः कोशं यस्मिन् संनिहिताः प्रजाः। यस्मिल्लोकाः स्फुरन्तीमे जले शकुनयो यथा॥
en: You are designated the sac within which the universe lies. All created things reside in you. Like swans and ducks swimming on the water, all the worlds are seen floating in you.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: ऋतमेकाक्षरं ब्रह्म यत् तत् सदसतोः परम्। अनादिमध्यपर्यन्तं न देवा नर्षयो विदुः॥
en: You are Truth. Truth. You One and Undecaying. You are Brahma. You are beyond mind and matter. You are without beginning, middle, and end. Neither the gods nor the Rishis know you.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यं सुरासुरगन्धर्वाः सिद्धा ऋषिमहोरगाः। प्रयता नित्यमर्चन्ति परमं दुःखभेषजम्॥
en: The gods, the Asuras, the Gandharvas, the Siddhas, the Rishis, and the great Uragas, with concentrated minds, always worship you. You are the great panacea for all sorrow.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: अनादिनिधनं देवमात्मयोनि सनातनम्। अप्रेक्ष्यमनभिज्ञेयं हरि नारायणं प्रभुम्॥
en: You are without birth and death. You are Divine. You are self-born. You are eternal. You are invisible and beyond perception. You are called Hari and Narayana, O powerful one.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यं वै विश्वस्य कर्तारं जगतस्तस्थुषां पतिम्। वदन्ति जगतोऽध्यक्षमक्षरं परमं पदम्॥
en: The Vedas describe you as the Creator of the universe and the Lord of everything existing in the universe. You are the Supreme Protector of the universe. You are Undecaying and that which is called the Highest.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: हिरण्यवर्णं यं गर्भमदितेर्दैत्यनाशनम्। एकं द्वादशधा जज्ञे तस्मै सूर्यात्मने नमः॥
en: You are gold-hued. You are the killer of Asuras. Though One, Aditi gave birth to you in twelve forms. Salutations to you who are the Soul of the Sun.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: शुक्ले देवान् पितृन् कृष्णे तर्पयत्यमृतेन यः यश्च राजा द्विजातीनां तस्मै सोमात्मने नमः॥
en: Salutations to you in your form of Soma who is the highest of Rishis and who gratified with nectar the gods in the light fortnight and the Pitris in the dark fortnight.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: महतस्तमसः पारे पुरुषं ह्यतितेजसम्। यं ज्ञात्वा मृत्युमत्येति तस्मै ज्ञेयात्मने नमः॥
en: You are the One Being of transcendent effulgence dwelling beyond darkness Knowing you one has no fear of death. Salutations of you in that form which is an object of knowledge.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यं वृहन्तं बृहत्युक्थे यमग्नौ यं महाध्वरे। यं विप्रसंघा गायन्ति तस्मै वेदात्मने नमः॥
en: In the grand Ukthya sacrifice, the Brahmanas worship you as the great Rich. In the great fire-sacrifice, they describe you as the chief (priest). You are the soul of the Vedas. Salutations to you.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: ऋग्यजुःसामधामानं दशाहविरात्मकम्। यं सप्ततन्तुं तन्वन्ति तस्मै यज्ञात्मने नमः॥
en: The Rishis, the Yajus, and the Samans are your habitation. You are the five sorts of pure libations. You are the five sorts of pure libations. You are the seven words used in the Vedas. Salutations to you in your form of Sacrifice.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: चतुर्भिश्च चतुर्भिश्च द्वाभ्यां पञ्चभिरेव च। हूयते च पुनर्वाभ्यां तस्मै होमात्मने नमः॥
en: Libations are poured on the Homa fire accompanied with seventeen Mantras. You are the soul of the Homa. Salutations to you.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यः सुपर्णा यजुर्नाम च्छन्दोगात्रस्त्रिवृच्छिराः। रथन्तरं वृहत् साम तस्मै स्तोत्रात्मने नमः॥
en: You are the Purusha described in the Vedas. Your name is Yajus. The Vedic metres are your limbs. The sacrifices laid down in the three Vedas forın your three heads. The great sacrifices called Rathantara is your voice expressing your gratification. Salutations to you in your form of sacred hymns.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यः सहस्रसमे सत्रे जज्ञे विश्वसृजामृषिः। हिरण्यपक्षः शकुनिस्तस्मै हंसात्मने नमः॥
en: You are the Rishi who had appeared in the great sacrifice extending for a thousand years celebrated by the Patriarchs. You are the great swan with wings of gold. Salutations to you in your form of a swan.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: पादाङ्गं संधिपर्वाणं स्वरव्यञ्जनभूषणम्। यमाहुरक्षरं दिव्यं तस्मै वागात्मने नमः॥
en: Roots with all kinds of affixes and suffixes form your limbs. The Sandhis are your joints. The consonants and vowels are your ornaments. The Vedas have described you as the divine word. Salutations to you in your form as the Word.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यज्ञाङ्गो यो वराहो वै भूत्वा गामुज्जहार हा लोकत्रयहितार्थाय तस्मै वीर्यात्मने नमः॥
en: Assuming the form of a boar whose limbs were Sacrifice, you had raised the submerged Earth for the behoof of the three worlds. Salutations to you in your form of infinite power.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यः शेते योगमास्थाय पर्यङ्के नागभूषिते। फणासहस्ररचिते तस्मै निद्रात्मने नमः॥
en: You sleep in Yoga on your snake sofa formed by the thousand hoods (of the Naga). Salutations to you in your forms of sleep.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यस्तनोति सतां सेतुमृतेनामृतयोनिना। धर्मार्थव्यवहाराङ्गैस्तस्मै सत्यात्मने नमः॥
en: You make the bridge for crossing the sea of life with Truth, with the means of emancipation, and with the means by which the senses may be controlled. Salutations to thee in your form of Truth.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यं पृथग्धर्मचरणाः पृथग्धर्मफलैषिणः। पृथग्धः समर्चन्ति तस्मै धर्मात्मने नमः॥
en: Men following various religions moved by desire of various fruits, worship you with various rites. Salutations to you in your form of religion.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यतः सर्वं प्रसूयन्ते ह्यनङ्गात्माङ्गदेहिनः। उन्मादः सर्वभूतानां तस्मै कामात्मने नमः॥
en: From you have originated all things. You move all creatures having physical frames and cherishing desires to action. Salutations to thee in your form of Excitement.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यं च व्यक्तस्थमव्यक्तं विचिन्वन्ति महर्षयः। क्षेत्रे क्षेत्रज्ञमासीनं तस्मै क्षेत्रात्मने नमः॥
en: The great Rishis seek your unmanifest self within the manifest. Called Kshetrajna, you sit in Kshetra. Salutations to you in your form of Kshetra.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यं त्रिधाऽऽत्मानमात्मस्थं वृतं षोडशभिर्गुणैः। प्राहुः सप्तदशं सांख्या स्तस्मै सांख्यात्मने नमः॥
en: Though always conscious and present in self, the Sankhyas still describe you as existing in the three states of wakefulness, dream and sleep. They further describe you as possessed of sixteen attributes and representing the number seventeen. Salutations to your form as described by the Sankhyas.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यं विनिद्रा जितश्वासाः सत्त्वस्थाः संयतेन्द्रियाः। ज्योतिः पश्यन्ति युञ्जानास्तस्मै योगात्मने नमः॥
en: Casting off sleep, restraining vital airs, Yogins of controlled senses see you as eternal light. Salutations to you in your Yoga form.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: अपुण्यपुण्योपरमे यं पुनर्भवनिर्भयाः। शान्ताः संन्यासिनो यान्ति तस्मै मोक्षात्मने नमः॥
en: Peaceful Sannyasins, freed from fear of rebirth on account of the extinction of all their sins and merits, obtain you. Salutations to you in your form of emancipation.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: योऽसौ युगसहस्रान्ते प्रदीप्तार्चिविभावसुः। सम्भक्षयति भूतानि तस्मै घोरात्मने नमः॥
en: At the end of a thousand cycles, you assume the form of a fire with blazing flames and consume all creatures. Salutations to you in your form of fierceness.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: सम्भक्ष्य सर्वभूतानि कृत्वा चैकार्णवं जगत्। बालः स्वपिति यश्चैकस्तस्मै मायात्मने नमः॥
en: Having consumed all creatures and converted the universe into one sheet of water, you sleep on the waters in the form of a child. Salutations to you in your form as Maya (illusion).

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: तद् यस्य नाभ्यां सम्भूतं यस्मिन् विश्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्। पुष्करे पुष्कराक्षस्य तस्मै पद्मात्मने नमः॥
en: From the navel of the Self-born having eyes like lotus leaves, sprung a lotus. On that lotus is situate this universe. Salutations to you in your form as lotus.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: सहस्रशिरसे चैव पुरुषायामितात्मने। चतुःसमुद्रपर्याययोगनिद्रात्मने नमः॥
en: You have a thousand heads. You permeate everything. You are of immeasurable soul. You have conquered the four kinds of desire that are as vast as the four seas. Salutations to you in your form of Yoga sleep.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यस्य केशेषु जीमूता नद्यः सर्वाङ्गसंधिषु। कुक्षौ समुद्राश्चत्वारस्तस्मै तोयात्मने नमः॥
en: The clouds are in the hair of your head. The rivers are in the several joints of your limbs. The four oceans are in your stomach. Salutations to you in your form as water.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यस्मात् सर्वाः प्रसूयन्ते सर्गप्रलयविक्रियाः। यस्मिंश्चैव प्रलीयन्ते तस्मै हेत्वात्मने नमः॥
en: Birth and death originate from you. All things, again, at the universal dissolution, are dissolved in you. Salutations to your form as cause.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: निषण्णो भवेद् रात्रौ दिवा भवति विष्ठितः। इष्टानिष्टस्य च द्रष्टा तस्मै द्रष्ट्रात्मने नमः॥
en: You sleep not in the night. You are engaged in day time also. You witness the good and the bad actions (of all), Salutations to you in your form of (universal) observer.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: अकुण्ठं सर्वकार्येषु धर्मकार्यार्थमुद्यतम्। वैकुण्ठस्य च तद् रूपं तस्मै कार्यात्मने नमः॥
en: There is no act which you cannot do. You are again, always ready to do righteous acts. Salutations to you in your form of Work, the form, viz., which is called Vaikuntha.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: त्रि:सप्तकृत्वो यः क्षत्रं धर्मव्युत्क्रान्तगौरवम्। क्रुद्धो निजघ्ने समरे तस्मै क्रौर्यात्मने नमः॥
en: In anger you had in battle, rooted out twenty-one times the Kshatriyas who had trodden virtue and authority under their feet, Salutations to you in your form of Cruelty.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: विभज्य पञ्चधाऽऽत्मानं वायुर्भूत्वा शरीरगः। यश्चेष्टयति भूतानि तस्मै वाय्वात्मने नमः॥
en: Dividing yourself into five parts you have become the five vital airs which work within every body and cause every living creature to inove. Salutations to you in your form of air.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: युगेष्वावर्तते योगैर्मासर्वयनहायनैः। सर्गप्रलययोः कर्ता तस्मै कालात्मने नमः॥
en: You appear in very cycle in the forms called month and season and half-year and year, and are the cause of both creation and dissolution. Salutations to you in your form of Time.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: ब्रह्म वक्त्रं भुजौ क्षत्रं कृत्स्नमूरूदरं विशः। पादौ यस्याश्रिताः शूद्रास्तस्मै वर्णात्मने नमः॥
en: Brahmanas are your mouth, Kshatriyas are your two arms., Vaishyas are your stomach and thighs, and Shudras are your feet. Salutations to you in your form of caste.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यस्याग्निरास्यं द्यौर्मूर्धा खं नाभिश्चरणौ क्षितिः। सूर्यश्चक्षुर्दिशः श्रोत्रे तस्मै लोकात्मने नमः॥
en: Fire is your mouth. The heavens are the crown of your head. The sky in your navel. The Earth is your feet. The Sun is your eye. The points of horizon are your ears. Salutations to you in your form as the three worlds.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: परः कालात् परो यज्ञात् परात् परतरश्च यः। अनादिरादिविश्वस्य तस्मै विश्वात्मने नमः॥
en: You are superior to Time. You are superior to Sacrifice. You are higher than the highest. Having yourself no origin, you are the origin of the Universe. Salutations to you in your form as Universe.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: विषये वर्तमानानां यं ते वैशेषिकैर्गुणैः। प्राहुर्विषयगोप्तारं तस्मै गोप्वात्मने नमः॥
en: People according to the attributes assigned to you by the Vaisheshika theory, consider you as the Protector of the world. Salutations to you in your form of Protector.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: अन्नपानेन्धनमयो रसप्राणविवर्धनः। यो धारयति भूतानि तस्मै प्राणात्मने नमः॥
en: Assuming the forms of food, drink, and fuel, you multiply the humours and the vital airs of creatures and keep up their existence. Salutations to you in your form of life.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: प्राणानां धारणार्थाय योऽनं भुक्के चतुर्विधम्। अन्तर्भूतः पचत्यग्निस्तस्मै पाकात्मने नमः॥
en: For supporting the life you eat the four kinds of food. Assuming also the form of Agni within the Stomach, you digest that food. Salutations to you in you form of digesting fire.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: पिङ्गेक्षणसटं यस्य रूपं दंष्ट्रनखायुधम्। दानवेन्द्रान्तकरणं तस्मै दृप्तात्मने नमः॥
en: Assuming the form of man-lion with twany eyes and twany manes with teeth and claws for your weapons, you had killed the king of the Asuras. Salutations to your form of great subtility.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यं न देवा न गन्धर्वा न दैत्या न च दानवाः। तत्त्वतो हि विजानन्ति तस्मै सूक्ष्मात्मने नमः॥
en: The gods, the Gandharvas, Daityas and Danavas are not able understand that form corectly, I salute that form of subtile.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: रसातलगतः श्रीमाननन्तो भगवान् विभुः। जगद् धारयते कृत्स्नं तस्मै वीर्यात्मने नमः।७६॥
en: Assuming the form of the beautiful, illustrious, and powerful Ananta in the neither region, you uphold the universe. Salutations to your form of power.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यो मोहयति भूतानि स्नेहपाशानुबन्धनैः। सर्गस्य रक्षणार्थाय तस्मै मोहात्मने नमः॥
en: You stupefy all creatures by the letters of affection and love for the continuance of the creation. Salutations to you in your form of stupefaction.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: आत्मज्ञानमिदं ज्ञानं ज्ञात्वा पञ्चस्ववस्थितम्। यं ज्ञानेनाभिगच्छन्ति तस्मै ज्ञानात्मने नमः॥
en: Knowing that knowledge which knows the five elements to be the true Self-knowledge people approach you by knowledge. Salutations to you in your form of Knowledge.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: अप्रमेयशरीराय सर्वतोबुद्धिचक्षुषे। अनन्तपरिमेयाय तस्मै दिव्यात्मने नमः॥
en: Your body cannot be measured. Your understanding and eyes see every thing. You are infinite and immeasurable. Salutations to you in your form of vastness.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: जटिने दण्डिने नित्यं लम्बोदरशरीरिणे। कमण्डलुनिषङ्गाय तस्मै ब्रह्मात्मने नमः॥
en: You had assumed the form of a hermit with matted locks on head, staff in hand, a long stomach, and having alms bowl for your quiver. Salutations to your form of Brahma.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: शूलिने त्रिदशेशाय त्र्यम्बकाय महात्मने। भस्मदिग्धाङ्गलिङ्गाय तस्मै रुद्रात्मने नमः॥
en: You carry the trident, you are the lord of the celestials, you have three eyes, and you are great. Your body is always besmeared with ashes. Salutations to you in your form of Rudra.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: चन्द्रार्धकृतशीर्षाय व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिने। पिनाकशूलहस्ताय तस्मा उग्रात्मने नमः॥
en: The crescent forms the ornament of your forehead. You have snakes for the holy thread round your neck. You are armed with Pinaka and trident. Salutations to your form of dreadfulness.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: सर्वभूतात्मभूताय भूतादिनिधनाय च। अक्रोधद्रोहमोहाय तस्मै शान्तात्मने नमः॥
en: You are the soul of all creatures. You are the Creator and the Destroyer of all creatures. You are without anger, without enmity, without affection. Salutations to you in your form of Peace.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यस्मिन् सर्वं यतः सर्वं यः सर्वं सर्वतश्च यः। यश्च सर्वमयो नित्यं तस्मै सर्वात्मने नमः॥
en: Everything is in you. Everything originates from you. You are Everything. Everywhere are you. You are always the All. Salutations to you in your form as Everything.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: विश्वकर्मन् नमस्तेऽस्तु विश्वात्मन् विश्वसम्भव। अपवर्गोऽसि भूतानां पञ्चानां परतः स्थितः॥
en: Salutations to you whose work is the universe, to you who are the soul of the universe, to you from whom has originated the universe, to you who are the dissolution of all things, to you who are beyond the five elements.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: नमस्ते त्रिषु लोकेषु नमस्ते परतस्त्रिषु। नमस्ते दिक्षु सर्वासु त्वं हि सर्वमयो निधिः॥
en: Salutations to you who are the three worlds to you who are above the three worlds! Salutations to you who are all the directions. You are all you are the one refuge of All.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: नमस्ते भगवन् विष्णो लोकानां प्रभवाप्यया त्वं हि कर्ता हृषीकेश संहर्ता चापराजितः॥
en: Salutations to you. O divine Lord, O Vishnu, and, O eternal origin of all the worlds. You, O Hrishikesha, are the Creator, you are the Destroyer, and you are invincible.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: न हि पश्यामि ते भावं दिव्यं हि त्रिषु वर्त्मसु। त्वां तु पश्यामि तत्त्वेन यत् ते रूपं सनातनम्॥
en: I cannot see that divine form in which you are manifest in the Past, Present, and Future. I can, however, see truly your eternal form.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: दिवं ते शिरसा व्याप्तं पद्भ्यां देवी वसुन्धरा। विक्रमेण त्रयो लोकाः पुरुषोऽसि सनातनः॥
en: You have filled heaven with your head, and Earth with your, and feet the three worlds with your energy. You are Eternal. and permeate everything in the universe.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: दिशो भुजा रविश्चक्षुर्वीर्ये शुक्रः प्रतिष्ठितः। सप्त मार्गा निरुद्धास्ते वायोरमिततेजसः॥
en: The directions are your arms, the Sun is your eye, and prowess is your arms, the Sun is your eye, and prowess is your vital fluid. You are the lord of all creatures. You stand closing the seven paths of the Wind whose power is immeasurable.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: अतसीपुष्पसंकाशं पीतवाससमच्युतम्। ये नमस्यन्ति गोविन्दं न तेषां विद्यते भयम्॥
en: Those who worship you, are freed from all fears, O Govinda of undecaying prowess, you are clad in yellow robes of the colour of the Atasi flower.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: एकोऽपि कृष्णस्य कृतः प्रणामो दशाश्वमेधावभृथेन तुल्यः। कृष्णप्रणामी न पुनर्भवाय॥
en: The lowering of head to you for once. O Krishna, is equal to the completion of ten Horse-sacrifices. The man who has celebrated ten Horse-sacrifices is not freed from the obligation of re-birth.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: कृष्णव्रताः कृष्णमनुस्मरन्तो रात्रौ च कृष्णं पुनरुत्थिता ये। माज्यं यथा मन्त्रहुतं हुताशे॥
en: The man, however, that salutes Krishna is freed from re-birth. They who have Krishna for their vow, they who think of Krishna in the night, and upon getting up from sleep, may be said to have Krishna for their body. Those people (after death) enter Krishna's self even as libations of clarified butter sanctified with mantras enter the burning fire.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: नमो नरकसंत्रासरक्षामण्डलकारिणे। संसारनिम्नगावर्ततरिकाष्ठाय विष्णवे॥
en: Salutations to you who remove the fear of hell, to you. O Vishnu, that are a boat to them who are sunk in the eddies of the ocean of worldly life.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: नमो ब्रह्मण्यदेवाय गोब्राह्मणहिताय च। जगद्धिताय कृष्णाय गोविन्दाय नमो नमः॥
en: Salutations to you, O God, that are the Brahmana's self, to you who are the benefactor of Brahmanas and kine, to you that are the benefactor of the universe, to you that are Krishna and Govinda.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: प्राणकान्तारपाथेयं संसारोच्छेदभेषजम्। दुःखशोकपरित्राणं हरिरित्यक्षरद्वयम्॥
en: The two syllables Hari are the purse of those who sojourn through the wilderness of life and the panacea that effectually cures all worldly attachments, and the Manas which remove sorrow and grief.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: यथा विष्णुमयं सत्यं यथा विष्णुमयं जगत्। यथा विष्णुमयं सर्वं पाप्मा मे नश्यतां तथा॥
en: As Truth is full of Vishnu, as the universe is full of Vishnu, as everything full of Vishnu, so let my soul be full of Vishnu, and my sins be dissipated.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: त्वां प्रपन्नाय भक्ताय गतिमिशं जिगीषवे। यच्छ्रेयः पुण्डरीकाक्ष तद् ध्यायस्व सुरोत्तम॥
en: I seek your refuge and am devoted to you, desirous of obtaining a happy end. O you having eyes like lotus petals, O best of gods, do you think of what will be for my well-being.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: इति विद्यातपोयोनिरयोनिर्विष्णुरीडितः। वाग्यज्ञेनार्चितो देवः प्रीयतां मे जनार्दनः॥
en: Having yourself no origin, O Vishnu, you are the origin of Knowledge and Penances. You are thus lauded, O Janardana, thus adored by me in the Sacrifice of words only, be O god, gratified with me.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: नारायणः परं ब्रह्म नारायणपरं तपः। नारायणः परो देवः सर्वं नारायणः सदा।।१००।
en: The Vedas are devoted to Narayana. Penances are devoted to Narayana. The gods are devoted to Narayana. Everything else is Narayana.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं भीष्मस्तद्गतमानसः। नम इत्येव कृष्णाय प्रणाममकरोत् तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said these words, Bhishma, with mind fixed upon Krishna, said,-'Salutations to Krishna.' And bowed to him.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
