sn: अभिगम्य तु योगेन भक्ति भीष्मस्य माधवः। त्रैलोक्यदर्शनं ज्ञानं दिव्यं दत्त्वा ययौ हरिः॥
en: Learning by his Yoga power of the devotion of Bhishma, Madhava, called also Hari, (entering his body) conferred upon him divine knowledge of the Past, the Present, and the Future, and went away.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: तस्मिन्नुपरते शब्दे ततस्ते ब्रह्मवादिनः। भीष्मं वाग्भिर्बाष्पकण्ठास्तमानचुमहामतिम्॥
en: When Bhishma became silent, the Brahmavadins, with voices suppressed with tears, worshipped that great chief of the Kurus in excellent words.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: ते स्तुवन्तश्च विप्रागया: केशवं पुरुषोत्तमम्। भीष्मं च शनकैः सर्वे प्रशशंसुः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Those foremost of Brahmanas lauded Krishna also, that first of Beings and then continued silently to praise Bhishma repeatedly.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: विदित्वा भक्तियोगं तु भीष्मस्य पुरुषोत्त्मः। सहसोत्थाय संहृष्टो यानमेवान्वपद्यत॥ केशवः सात्यकिश्चापि रथेनैकेन जग्मतुः। अपरेण महात्मानौ युधिष्ठिरधंजयौ॥
en: Learning of the devotion of Bhishma towards him, that foremost of Beings, viz., Madhava, suddenly rose from his seat and got on his car, Keshava and Satyaki proceeded on one car. On another proceeded those two great princess, viz., Yudhishthira and Dhananjaya.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: भीमसेन यमौ चोभौ रथमेकं समाश्रिताः। कृपो युयुत्सुः सूतश्च संजयश्च परंतपः॥ ते स्थैर्नगराकारैः प्रयाताः पुरुषर्षभाः। नेमिघोषेण महता कम्पयन्तो वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Bhimasena and the twin rode on a third; while those foremost of men, viz., Kripa and Yuyutsu, and that scorcher of foes, viz., Sanjaya of the charioteer caste, proceeded on their respective cars, each of which looked like a town. And all of then went on, inaking the Earth trembled with the rattle of their carwheels.

description: Vasudeva asks Yudhishthira to receive instructions from Bhishma.
sn: ततो गिरः पुरुषवरस्तवान्विता द्विजेरिता: पथि सुमनाः स शुश्रुवे। कृताञ्जलिं प्रणतमथापरं जनं स केशिहा मुदितमनाभ्यनन्दत॥
en: That foremost of men, as he went on, cheerfully listened to the laudatory, speeches uttered by the Brahmanas. The destroyer of Keshi, with a cheerful heart, saluted the people waiting by the road side with joined hands and bent heads.

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः स च हृषीकेशः स च राजा युधिष्ठिरः। कृपादयश्च ते सर्वे चत्वारः पाण्डवाश्च ते॥ रथैस्तैर्नगरप्रख्यैः : पताकाध्वजशोभितैः। ययुराशु कुरुक्षेत्रं वाजिभिः शीघ्रगामिभिः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then Hrishikesha, and king Yudhishthira, and all those persons headed by Kripa, and the four Pandavas, riding on those cars resembling fortified cities and adorned with stands and banners, quickly went to Kurukshetra with the help of their quick-coursing horses.

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: तेऽवतीर्य कुरुक्षेत्र केशमज्जास्थिसंकुलम्। देहन्यासः कृतो यत्र क्षत्रियैस्तैर्महात्मभिः॥
en: They descended on that field of Kuru, which was covered with hair, marrow and bones, and where millions of great Kshatriyas had died.

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: गजाश्वदेहास्थिचयैः पर्वतैरिव संचितम्। नरशीर्षकपालैश्च शङ्कुरिव च सर्वशः॥
en: It also contained many hills made of the bodies and bones of elephants and horses, and human heads and skulls were scattered over it like conch-shells.

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: चितासहस्रप्रचितं वर्मशस्त्रसमाकुलम्। आपानभूमिं कालस्य तथा भुक्तोज्झितामिव॥
en: interspersed with thousands of funeral pyres and containing masses of armour and weapons, the vast field looked like the drinking site of the Destroyer himself used and left of late.

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: भूतसंघानुचरितं रक्षोगणनिषेवितम्। पश्यन्तस्ते कुरुक्षेत्रं ययुराशु महारथाः।॥
en: The powerful car-warriors quickly proceeded, seeing the field of battle haunted by crowds of spirits and thronged with Rakshasas,

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: गच्छन्नेव महाबाहुः स वै यादवनन्दनः। युधिष्ठिराय प्रोवाच जामदग्न्यस्य विक्रमम्॥
en: While proceeding, the powerful Keshava, that delighter of all the Yadavas, spoke to Yudhishthira about the prowess of Jamadagni's son.

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: अमी रामहृदाः पञ्च दृश्यन्ते पार्थ दूरतः। तेषु संतर्पयामास पितॄन् क्षत्रियशोणितैः॥
en: 'Yonder, at a distance, O Partha' are the five lakes of Rama. There Rama offered oblations of Kshatriya blood to his departed manes.

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो वसुधां कृत्वा निःक्षत्रियां प्रभुः। इहेदानीं ततो रामः कर्मणो विरराम ह॥
en: It was here that the powerful Rama, having freed the Earth of Kshatriyas for twenty-one times, accomplished his task.'

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच त्रि:सप्तकृत्वः पृथिवी कृता निःक्षत्रिया पुरा। रामेणेति तथाऽऽत्थ त्वमत्र मे संशयो महान्॥
en: Yudhishthira said I have doubt very much of what you say about Rama's having twenty-one times rooted the Kshatriyas in days of yore.

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: क्षत्रबीजं यथा दग्धं रामेण यदुपुङ्गव। कथं भूयः समुत्पत्तिः क्षत्रस्यामितविक्रम॥
en: When the very Kshatriya seed was burnt by Rama, O foremost of the Yadus, how was the Kshatriya order revived?

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: महात्मना भगवता रामेण यदुपुङ्गव। कथमुत्सादितं क्षत्रं कथं वृद्धिमुपागतम्॥
en: How, O best of the Yadus, was the Kshatriya order exterminated by the illustrious and great Rama, and how did it again grow?

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: महता रथयुद्धेन कोटिशः क्षत्रिया हताः। तथाभूच्च मही कीर्णा क्षत्रियैर्वदतां वर॥
en: In dreadful car-encounters millions of Kshatriyas were killed. The Earth, O foremost of orators, was covered with the corpses of Kshatriyas.

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: किमर्थं भार्गवेणेदं क्षत्रमुत्सादितं पुरा। रामेण यदुशार्दूल कुरुक्षेत्रे महात्मना॥ एतन्मे छिन्धि वार्ष्णेय संशयं तार्क्ष्यकेतन। आगमो हि परः कृष्ण त्वत्तो नो वासवानुज॥
en: Why was the Kshatriya order thus rooted out in day of old by Rama, the great descendant of Bhrigu, oforemost of the Yadus. O Vrishni hero, remove this doubt of mine, O Garuda-fanned hero. O Krishna, O younger brother of Vasudeva, the highest knowledge is from you.'

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो यथावत् स गदाग्रजः प्रभुः शशंस तस्मै निखिलेन तत्त्वतः। युधिष्ठिरायाप्रतिमौजसे तदा यथाभवत् क्षत्रियसंकुला मही॥
en: Vaishampayana said The powerful elder brother of Gada then described fully to Yudhishthira everything that had taken place, as to how the Earth had become filled with Kshatriyas.

description: Pandavas to Bhishma, who describes the prowess of Krishna.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो यथावत् स गदाग्रजः प्रभुः शशंस तस्मै निखिलेन तत्त्वतः। युधिष्ठिरायाप्रतिमौजसे तदा यथाभवत् क्षत्रियसंकुला मही॥
en: Vaishampayana said The powerful elder brother of Gada then described fully to Yudhishthira everything that had taken place, as to how the Earth had become filled with Kshatriyas.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: वासुदेव उवाच शृणु कौन्तेय रामस्य प्रभावो यो मया श्रुतः। महर्षीणां कथयतां विक्रमं तस्य जन्म च।।।।
en: Vasudeva said Listen, O son of Kunti, to the story of Rama's energy and powers and birth as I heard from great Rishis discoursing upon the subject.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: यथा च जामदग्न्येन कोटिशः क्षत्रिया हताः। उद्भूता राजवंशेषु ये भूयो भारते हताः॥
en: Listen to the story of how millions of Kshatriyas were killed by Jamadagni's son and how those that were born again in the various royal houses in Bharata were again killed.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: जह्रोरजस्तु तनयो बलाकाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः। कुशिको नाम धर्मज्ञस्तस्य पुत्रो महीपते।॥
en: Jahnu had a son named Rajas. Rajas had a son named Balakashva. King Balakashva had a pious son named Kushika.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: अग्र्यं तपः समातिष्ठत् सहस्राक्षसमो भुवि। पुत्रं लभेयमजितं त्रिलोकेश्वरमित्युत॥
en: Resembling the thousand-eyed Indra on Earth, Kushika, practised the austerest of penances from desire of getting the lord of the three worlds for a son.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: तमुग्रतपसं दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षः पुरंदरः। समर्थं पुत्रजनने स्वयमेवान्वपद्यत॥
en: Seeing him engaged in the hardest of penances and capable of begetting a son, the thousand-eyed Purandara himself inspired the king with his energy.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: पुत्रत्वमगमद् राजस्तस्य लोकेश्वरेश्वरः। गाधिर्नामाभवत् पुत्रः कौशिकः पाकशासनः॥
en: The great lord of the three worlds, viz., the chastiser of Paka, o king, then became Kushika's son known by the name of Gadhi.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: तस्य कन्याभवद् राजन् नाम्ना सत्यवतीप्रभो। तां गाधिर्भुगुपुत्राय सर्चीकाय ददौ प्रभुः॥
en: Gadhi had a daughter, O king, by the name of Satyavati. The powerful Gadhi married her to Richika a descendant of Bhrigu.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: तस्याः प्रीतः स शौचेन भार्गवः कुरुनन्दन! पुत्रार्थं अपयामास चरुं गाधेस्तथैव च॥
en: Her husband of Bhrigu's race, O delighter of the Kurus, became highly pleased with her for the purity of her conduct. He cooked charu the sacrificial food of milk and rice for giving to Gandhi a son.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: आहूयोवाच तां भार्यां सर्चीको भार्गवस्तदा। उपभोज्यश्चरुरयं त्वया मात्राप्ययं तव॥
en: Calling his wife, Richika of Bhrigu's race, said,This portion of the sanctified food should be taken by you, and this (the other) portion by your mother.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: तस्या जनिष्यते पुत्रो दीप्तिमान् क्षत्रियर्षभः। अजय्यः क्षत्रियैर्लोके क्षत्रियर्षभसूदनः॥
en: An energetic son will be born of her who will be the foremost of the Kshatriyas, Invincible by Kshatriyas on Earth, he will be the destroyer of the foremost of Kshatriyas.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: तवापि पुत्रं कल्याणि धृतिमन्तं शमात्मकम्। तपोऽन्वितं द्विजश्रेष्ठं चरुरेष विधास्यति॥
en: As regards you, O blessed lady, this portion of the food will give you a son of great wisdom, a personification of tranquillity, endued with ascetic penances, and the foremost of Brahmanas.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: इत्येवमुक्त्वा तां भार्यां सर्चीको भृगुनन्दनः। तपस्यभिरतः श्रीमाजगामारण्यमेव हि॥
en: Having said these words to his wife, the blessed Richika of Bhrigu's race, setting his heart on penances, entered into the woods.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु तीर्थयात्रापरो नृपः। गाधिः सदारः सम्प्राप्तः सर्चीकस्याश्रमं प्रति॥
en: About this time, king Gandhi, making a pilgrimage to the sacred waters, arrived with his queen at the hermitage of Richika.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: चरुद्वयं गृहीत्वा च राजन् सत्यवती तदा। भर्तुर्वाक्यं तदाव्यग्रा मात्रे हृष्टा न्यवेदयत्॥
en: O king, thereupon taking the two portions of the sanctified food, Satyavati cheerfully and quickly, represented the words of her husband to her inother.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: माता तु तस्याः कौन्तेय दुहिने स्वं चकं ददौ। तस्याश्चरुमथाज्ञानादात्मसंस्थं चकार ह॥
en: The queen-mother, O son of Kunti, gave the portion reserved for herself to her daughter, and herself took unwittingly the portion intended for the latter.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: अथ सत्यवती गर्भ क्षत्रियान्तकरं तदा। धारयामास दीप्तेन वपुषा घोरदर्शनम्॥
en: Thereupon Satyavati, her body blazing with lustre, conceived a child of dreadful form intended to become the exterminator of the Kshatriyas.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: तामृचीकस्तदा दृष्ट्वा तस्या गर्भगतं द्विजम्। अब्रवीद् भृगुशार्दूलः स्वां भार्यां देवरूपिणीम्॥
en: Seeing the Brahmana child lying within her womb, that foremost of the Bhrigus said to his wife of heavenly beauty these wordsमात्रासि व्यंसिता भद्रे चरुव्यत्यासहेतुना।

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: भविष्यति हि ते पुत्रः क्रूरकर्मात्यमर्षणः॥ उत्पत्स्यति च ते भ्राता ब्रह्मभूतस्तपोरतः।
en: You have been imposed upon by your mother, O blessed lady, by the substitution of the sanctified food. Your son will become a man of cruel deeds and vindictive heart. Your brother again (born of your mother) will be Brahmana ever devoted to ascetic penances.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: विश्वं हि ब्रह्म सुमहच्चरौ तव समाहितम्॥ क्षत्रवीर्यं च सकलं तव मात्रे समर्पितम्।
en: The seed of the supreme and universal Brahma had been placed into the sanctified food intended for you, while into that intended for your mother had been placed the sum-total of Kshatriya energy.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: विपर्ययेण ते भद्रे नैतदेवं भविष्यति॥ मातुस्ते ब्राह्मणो भूयात् तव च क्षत्रियः सुतः।
en: On account of the substitution of the two parts, O blessed lady, that which had been intended will not happen. Your mother will got a Brahmana child while you will get a son that will become a Kshatriya.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: सैवमुक्ता महाभागा भ; सत्यवती तदा॥ पपात शिरसा तस्मै वेपन्ती चाब्रवीदिदम्। नार्होऽसि भगवन्नद्य वक्तुमेवंविधं वचः। ब्राह्मणापसदं पुत्रं प्राप्स्यसीति हि मां प्रभो॥
en: Thus addressed by her husband the highly blessed Satyavati bent down her head to his feet and tremblingly said,-You should not, O holy one, speak such words to me, viz.,-You will obtain a wretch among Brahmanas for your son.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ऋचीक उवाच नैष संकल्पितः कामो मया भद्रे तथा त्वयि। उग्रकर्मा समुत्पन्नश्चरुव्यत्यासहेतुना॥
en: Richika said This was not intended by me, o blessed lady, for you. A son of terrific deeds has been conceived by you for the substitution of the sanctified food.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: सत्यवत्युवाच इच्छल्लोकानपि मुने सृजेथाः किं पुनः सुतम्। शामात्मकमजुं पुत्रं दातुमर्हसि मे प्रभो॥
en: If you wish, O sage, you can create other worlds, what shall I say of a child? You should, O powerful one, give me a son who will be pious and peaceful.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ऋचीक उवाच नोक्तपूर्वानृतं भद्रे स्वैरेष्वपि कदाचन। किमुताग्निं समाधाय मन्त्रवच्चरुसाधने॥
en: Richika said 'I had never uttered even in jest, O blessed lady, an untruth. What need then be said of a time for preparing sanctified food with the help of Vedic formulae after lighting a fire?

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: दृष्टमेतत् पुरा भद्रे ज्ञातं च तपसा मया। ब्रह्मभूतं हि सकलं पितुस्तव कुलं भवेत्॥
en: It was ordained of yore by destiny, O lovely damsel. I have known it all by my penances. All the descendants of your father will be endued with Brahmanic virtues.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: सत्यवत्युवाच काममेवं भवेत् पौत्रो ममेह तव च प्रभो। शमात्मकमहं पुत्रं लभेयं जपतां वर॥
en: O powerful one, let our grandson be such, but, O foremost of ascetics, let me have a quiet son.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ऋचीक उवाच पुत्रे नास्ति विशेषो मे पौत्रे च वरवर्णिनि। यथा त्वयोक्तं वचनं तथा भद्रे भविष्यति॥
en: Richika said O fair lady, I see no distinction, between a son and a grandson. It will be, O lovely lady, as you say.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: वासुदेव उवाच ततः सत्यवती पुत्रं जनयामास भार्गवम्। तपस्यभिरतं शान्तं जमदग्निं यतव्रतम्॥
en: Vasudeva said, Then Satyavati gave birth to a son in Bhrigu's race who was devoted to penances and peaceful occupations, viz., Jamadagni of regulated vows.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: विश्वामित्रं च दायादं गाधिः कुशिकनन्दनः। यः प्राप ब्रह्मसमितं विश्वैर्ब्रह्मगुणैर्युतम्॥
en: Kaushika's son Gadhi begot a son named Vishvamitra. Possessed of every attribute of a Brahmana, that son though a Kshatriya by birth was equal to a Brahmana.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ऋचीको जनयामास जमदग्निं तपोनिधिम्। सोऽपि पुत्रं ह्यजनयज्जमदग्निः सुदारुणम्॥
en: Richika (thus) beget Jamadagni, that sea of penances. Jamadagni begot a son of dreadful deeds.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: सर्वविद्यान्तगं श्रेष्ठं धनुर्वेदस्य पारगम्। रामं क्षत्रियहन्तारं प्रदीप्तमिव पावकम्॥
en: The foremost of men, that son mastered all the sciences, including that of arms. Like a burning fire, that son was Rama, the exterminator of the Kshatriyas.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: तोषयित्वा महादेवं पर्वते गन्धमादने। अस्त्राणि वरयामास परशुं चातितेजसम्॥
en: Having satisfied Mahadeva the mountains of Gandhamadana, he begged from that deity for weapons, especially the axe of fierce power in his hands.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: स तेनाकुण्ठधारेण ज्वलितानलवर्चसा। कुठारेणाप्रमेयेण लोकेष्वप्रतिमोऽभवत्॥
en: For that peerless axe of fiery splendour and irresistible sharpness, he became unequalled on Earth.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कृतवीर्यात्मजो बली। अर्जुनो नाम तेजस्वी क्षत्रियो हैहयाधिपः॥ दत्तात्रेयप्रसादेन राजा बाहुसहस्रवान्। चक्रवर्ती महातेजा विप्राणामाश्वमेधिके॥ ददौ स पृथिवीं सर्वां सप्तद्वीपां सपर्वताम्। स्वबाह्वस्त्रबलेनाजौ जित्वा परमधर्मवित्॥
en: Meanwhile the powerful son of Kritavirya, the king of the Haihayas, endued with great power, highly pious, and possessed of a on thousand arms through the favour of the great Rishi) Dattatreya, having conquered in battle, by the strength of his own arms, the entire Earth with her mountains and seven islands, became a very powerful sovereign and (at iast) gave away the Earth to the Brahmanas in a house-sacrifice.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: तृषितेन च कौन्तेय भिक्षितश्चित्रभानुना। सहस्रबाहुर्विक्रान्तः प्रादाद् भिक्षामथाग्नये॥
en: Once begged by the thirsty god of fire, O son of Kunti, the thousand-armed king of great prowess gave alms to that deity.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ग्रामान् पुराणि राष्ट्राणि घोषांश्चैव तु वीर्यवान्। जज्वाल तस्य बाणाग्राच्चित्रभानुर्दिधक्षया।॥
en: Originating from the point of his arrow, the highly powerful god of fire, desirous of consuming (what was offered) burnt villages and towns and kingdoms and hamlets of cowherds.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: स तस्य पुरुषेन्द्रस्य प्रभावेण महौजसः। ददाह कार्तवीर्यस्य शैलानथ वनस्पतीन्॥
en: Through the prowess of that foremost of inen, viz., the powerful Kartavirya, the god of fire consumed mountains and great forests.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: स शून्यमाश्रमं रम्यमापवस्य महात्मनः। ददाह पवनेनेद्धश्चित्रभानुः सहैहयः॥
en: Helped by the king of the Haihayas the god of fire, increased more by the wind, consumed the uninhabited but the charming hermitage of the high-souled Apava.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: आपवस्तु ततो रोषाच्छशापार्जुनमच्युत। दग्धेऽऽश्रमे महाबाहो कार्तवीर्येण वीर्यवान्॥ त्वया न वर्जितं यस्मान्नमेदं हि महद् वनम्। दग्धं तस्माद् रणे रामो बाहूंस्ते छेत्स्यतेऽर्जुन॥
en: O mighty-armed king, seeing his hermitage consumed by the powerful Kshatriya, the highly energetic Apava cursed that monarch in anger, saying,-Since, O Arjuna, without reserving these my woods, you have burnt them, therefore, Rama (of Bhrigu's race), will cut your thousand arins.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: अर्जुनस्तु महातेजा बली नित्यं शमात्मकः। ब्रह्मण्यश्च शरण्यश्च दाता शूरश्च भारत॥ नाचिन्तयत् तदा शापं तेन दत्तं महात्मना। तस्य पुत्रास्तु बलिनः शापेनासन् पितुर्वर्धे॥ निमित्तादवलिप्ता वै नृशंसाश्चैव सर्वदा। जमदग्निधेन्वास्ते वत्समानिन्युर्भरतर्षभ॥ अज्ञातं कार्तवीर्येण हैहेयेन्द्रेण धीमता। तनिमित्तमभूद् युद्धं जामदग्नेर्महात्मनः॥
en: The powerful Arjuna, however, of great prowess, always devoted to peace, ever obedient to Brahmanas and ready to protect all classes, and charitable brave, O Bharata, did not think of that curse imprecated on him by that great Rishi. His powerful sons, always proud and cruel, on account of that curse, became the indirect cause of his death. The princes, O foremost of Bharata's race, caught and brought away the calf of Jamadagani's Homa COW, against the knowledge of Kartavirya the king of the Haihayas. For this reason a dispute took place between the great Jamadagni and the Haihayas.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ततोऽर्जुनस्य बाहूंस्तांश्छित्त्वा रामो रुषान्वितः। तं भ्रमन्तं ततो वत्सं जामदग्न्यः स्वमाश्रमम्॥ प्रत्यानयत राजेन्द्र तेषामन्तःपुरात् प्रभुः।
en: The powerful Rama, the son of Jamadagni, filled with anger cut off the arms of Arjuna and brought back, O king, his father's calf which was grazing within the inner appointment of the king's mansion.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: अर्जुनस्य सुतास्ते तु सम्भूयाबुद्धयस्तदा॥ गत्वाऽऽश्रममसम्बुद्धा जमदग्नेर्महात्मनः। अपातयन्त भल्लाप्रैः शिरः कायान्नराधिप।॥ समित्कुशार्थं रामस्य निर्यातस्य यशस्विनः।
en: Then the foolish sons of Arjuna, going in a body to the hermitage of the great Jamadagni, cut with their lances, O king, the head of that Rishi from off his trunk while the celebrated Rama had gone out for fetching sacred fuel and grass.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ततः पितृवधामर्षाद् रामः परममन्युमान्॥ निःक्षत्रियां प्रतिश्रुत्य महीं शस्त्रमगृह्वत।
en: Worked up with anger at the death of his father and filled with vengeance, Rama vowed to rid the Earth of Kshatriyas and took up arms.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ततः स भृगुशार्दूलः कार्तवीर्यस्य वीर्यवान्॥ विक्रम्य निजघानाशु पुत्रान् पौत्रांश्च सर्वशः।
en: Then that foremost of the Bhrigus, endued with great energy, displaying his prowess, quickly killed all the sons and grandsons of Kartavirya.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: स हैहयसहस्राणि हत्वा परममन्युमान्॥ चकार भार्गवो राजन् महीं शोणितकर्दमाम्।
en: Killing thousand of Haihayas in anger, the descendant of Bhrigu, o king, covered the Earth with blood.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: स तथाऽऽशु महातेजाः कृत्वा निःक्षत्रियां महीम्।।५४। कृपया परयाऽऽविष्टो वनमेव जगाम ह।
en: Highly energetic, he speedily freed the Earth of all Kshatriyas. Filled then with pity, he retired into the woods.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ततो वर्षसहस्रेषु समतीतेषु केषुचित्॥ क्षेपं सम्प्राप्तवांस्तत्र प्रकृत्या कोपन: प्रभुः।
en: Afterwards, after the expiry of some thousands of years, the powerful Rama, who was angry by nature, was accused of cowardice.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: विश्वामित्रस्य पौत्रस्तु रैभ्यपुत्रो महातपाः।। परावसुर्महाराज क्षिप्त्वाऽऽह जनसंसदि। ये ते ययातिपतने यज्ञे सन्तः समागताः॥ प्रतर्दनप्रभृतयो राम किं क्षत्रिया न ते।
en: The grandson of Vishvamitra and son of Raivya, possessed of great ascetic merit, named Paravasu, O king, began to accuse Rama publicly, saying,-O Rama, were not those pious men, viz., Pratardana and others, who were assembled at a sacrifice at the time of Yayati's death, Kshatriyas by birth?

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञो राम त्वं कत्थसे जनसंसदि॥ भयात् क्षत्रियवीराणां पर्वतं समुपाश्रितः।
en: You are not truthful, O Rama! You simply brag before people. For fear of Kshatriya heroes you have betaken yourself to the mountains.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: सा पुनः क्षत्रियशतैः पृथिवी सर्वतः स्तृता॥ परावसोर्वचः श्रुत्वा शस्त्रं जग्राह भार्गवः।
en: Hearing these words of Paravashu, the descendant of Bhrigu, once more took up arms and once more covered the Earth with hundreds of Kshatriya bodies.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ततो ये क्षत्रिया राजन् शतशस्तेन वर्जिताः॥ ते विवृद्धा महावीर्याः पृथिवीपतयोऽभवन्।
en: Those Kshatriyas, however, king counting by hundreds, that were not killed by Rama, multiplied (in time) and became powerful monarchs on Earth.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: स पुनस्ताञ्जघानाशु बालानपि नराधिप॥ गर्भस्थैस्तु मही व्याप्ता पुनरेवाभवत् तदा।
en: Rama once more killed them quickly, not sparing even the very children, O king. The Earth again was covered with the bodies of Kshatriya children of premature birth.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: जातं जातं स गर्भं तु पुनरेव जघान ह॥ अरक्षंश्च सुतान् कांश्चित् तदा क्षत्रिययोषितः।
en: As soon as Kshatriya children were born, Rama killed them. Some Kshatriya ladies, however, succeeded in hiding their children from Rama.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: त्रिःसप्तकृत्वः पृथिवीं कृत्वा निःक्षत्रियां प्रभुः॥ दक्षिणामश्वमेधान्ते कश्यपायाददत् ततः।
en: Having made the Earth shorn of Kshatriyas for twenty-one times, the powerful Bhargava, at the completion of a horse-sacrifice, gave away the Earth the Earth as sacrificial present to Kashyapa.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: स क्षत्रियाणां शेषार्थं करेणोद्दिश्य कश्यपः॥ स्रुक्प्रग्रहवता राजंस्ततो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्। गच्छ तीरं समुद्रस्य दक्षिणस्य महामुने॥ न ते मद् विषये राम वस्तव्यमिह कर्हिचित्।
en: For preserving the residence of the Kshatriyas, Kashyapa, O king, pointing with his hand that still held the sacrificial ladle, said these words,-Ogreat sage, go to the shores of the southern ocean. You should not, O Rama, live within my kingdom.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ततः शूर्पारकं देशं सागरस्तस्य निर्ममे॥ सहसा जामदग्न्यस्य सोऽपरान्तमहीतलम्।
en: At these words, Ocean all on a sudden made for Jamadagni's son, on his other shore, a region called Surparaka.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: कश्यपस्तां महाराज प्रतिगृह्य वसुन्धराम्॥ कृत्वा ब्राह्मणसंस्थां वै प्रविष्टः सुमहद् वनम्।
en: Kashyapa also, O king, having accepted the Earth in gift, and made a present of it to the Brahmanas, entered into woods.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ततः शूद्राश्च वैश्याश्च यथा स्वैरप्रचारिणः॥ अवर्तन्त द्विजाग्र्याणां दारेषु भरतर्षभ।
en: Then Shudras and Vaishyas, began wilfully to know, O foremost of Bharata's race, the wives of Brahmanas.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: अराजके जीवलोके दुर्बला बलवत्तरैः॥ पीड्यन्ते न हि विप्रेषु प्रभुत्वं कस्यचित् तदा।
en: When anarchy begins on Earth, the weak are oppressed by the strong, and no man is master of his own possessions.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: ततः कालेन पृथिवी पीड्यमाना दुरात्मभिः॥ विपर्ययेण तेनाशु प्रविवेश रसातलम्। अरक्ष्यमाणा विधिवत् क्षत्रियैर्धर्मरक्षिभिः॥
en: By the course of Time, the earth was assailed by wicked men. Unprotected duly by the virtuous Kshatriyas, and oppressed by the wicked for that disorder, the Earth quickly sank to the lowest depths.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: तां दृष्ट्वा द्रवतीं तत्र संत्रासात् स महामनाः। ऊरुणा धारयामास कश्यपः पृथिवीं ततः॥ धृता तेनोरुणा येन तेनोर्वाति मही स्मृता।
en: Seeing the Earth sinking from fear, the great Kashyapa held her on his lap; and because the great Rishi held her on his lap (uru) therefore is the Earth known by the name of Urvi.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: रक्षणार्थं समुद्दिश्य ययाचे पृथिवी तदा॥ प्रसाद्य कश्यपं देवी वरयामास भूमिपम्।
en: The goddess Earth for securing protection, pleased Kashyapa and begged of him a king.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: पृथिव्युवाच सन्ति ब्रह्मन् मया गुप्ताः स्त्रीषु क्षत्रियपुङ्गवाः॥ हैहयानां कुले जातास्ते संरक्षन्तु मां मुने।
en: The Earth said-There are, O Rishi, some leading Kshatriyas concealed by me among women. They were born in the family of the Haihayas. Let them, O sage, protect me.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: अस्ति पौरवदायादो विदूरथसुतः प्रभो॥ ऋक्षैः संवर्धितो विप्र ऋक्षवत्यथ पर्वते।
en: There is another person of Puru's family, viz., Viduratha's son, O powerful one, who has been brought up among bears in the Rikshavat mountains.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: तथानुकम्पमानेन यज्वनाथामितौजसा॥ पराशरेण दायादः सौदासस्याभिरक्षितः।
en: Another, viz., the son of Saudasa, has been protected, through pity, by the highly energetic Parashara ever engaged in sacrifices.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: सर्वकर्माणि कुरुते शूद्रवत् तस्य स द्विजः॥ सर्वकर्मेत्यभिख्यातः स मां रक्षतु पार्थिवः।
en: Though born in the family of a twice-born one, yet like a Shudra he does everything for that Rishi and has, therefore been named servant of all work.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: शिबिपुत्रो महातेजा गोपतिर्नाम नामतः॥ वने संवर्धितो गोभिः सोऽभिरक्षतु मां मुने।
en: Shivi's energetic son Gopati, has, been brought up in the forest among kine. Let him, O sage, protect me.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: प्रतर्दनस्य पुत्रस्तु वत्सो नाम महाबलः॥ वत्सैः संवर्धितो गोष्ठे स मां रक्षतु पार्थिवः।
en: Pratradana's highly powerful son named Vatsa has been brought up among calves in a cowpen. Let that Kshatriya protect me.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: दधिवाहनपौत्रस्तु पुत्रो दिविरथस्य च॥ गुप्तः स गौतमेनासीद् गङ्गाकूलेऽभिरक्षितः।
en: Dadhivahana's grandson and Diviratha's son was kept hidden on the banks of Ganga by the sage Gautama.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: बृहद्रथो महातेजा भूरिभूतिपरिष्कृतः॥ गोलाङ्गलैर्महाभागो गृध्रकूटेऽभिरक्षितः।
en: His name is Brihadratha. Possessed of great energy and endued with numerous accomplishments, that blessed princes has been protected by wolves and the mountains of Griddhrakuta.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: मरुत्तस्यान्ववाये च रक्षिता: क्षत्रियात्मजाः॥ मरुत्पतिसमा वीर्ये समुद्रेणाभिरक्षिताः।
en: Many Kshatriyas of the race of Marutta have been protected. Equally energetic like the lord of Maruts, they have been brought up by Ocean.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: एते क्षत्रियदायादास्तत्र तत्र परिश्रुताः॥ धोकारहेमकारादिजातिं नित्यं समाश्रिताः। यदि मामभिरक्षन्ति ततः स्थास्यामि निश्चला॥
en: These children of the Kshatriyas have been heard of as housing in different places. They are residing with artisans and goldsmiths. If they protect me I shall then remain unmoved.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: एतेषां पितरश्चैव तथैव च पितामहाः। मदर्थं निहता युद्धे रामेणाक्लिश्कर्मणा॥ तेषामपचितिश्चैव मया कार्या महामुने।
en: Their fathers and grandfathers have been killed for my sake by the highly powerful Rama. It is my duty, O great sage, to see that their funeral rites are properly performed.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: न ह्यहं कामये नित्यमतिक्रान्तेन रक्षणम्। वर्तमानेन वर्तेयं तत् क्षिप्रं संविधीयताम्॥
en: I do not desire that I should be protected by my present kings. Do you, O sage, quickly make such arrangements that I may remain (as before).

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: वासुदेव उवाच ततः पृथिव्या निर्दिशंस्तान् समानीय कश्यपः। अभ्यषिञ्चन्महीपालान् क्षत्रियान् वीर्यसम्मतान्॥
en: Vasudeva said are Then finding out those energetic Kshatriyas whom the goddess had named, the sage Kashyapa installed them duly as kings.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च येषां वंशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः। एवमेतत् पुरावृत्तं यन्मां पृच्छसि पाण्डव॥
en: Those Kshatriya races that are now in existence the offsprings of those princes.-What you have questioned me son of Pandu, thus took place in days of yore.

description: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about how the Kshatriyas multiplied after being exterminated by Rama.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं ब्रुवंस्तं च यदुप्रवीरो युधिष्ठिरं धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठम्। रथेन तेनाशु ययौ महात्मा दिशः प्रकाशम्भगवानिवार्कः॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Conversing thus with Yudhishthira, that foremost of pious men, the great Yadava hero proceeded quickly on thai car lighting up all the quarters like the divine Sun himself.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो रामस्य तत् कर्म श्रुत्वा राजा युधिष्ठिरः। विस्मयं परमं गत्वा प्रत्युवाच जनार्दनम्॥ अहो रामस्य वार्ष्णेय शक्रस्येव महात्मनः। विक्रमो वसुधा येन क्रोधान्निःक्षत्रिया कृता॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing of those wonderful deeds of Rama, king Yudhishthira became stricken with wonder and said to Janardana,-'O you of Vrishni's race, the prowess of the great Rama, who in anger had freed the Earth of Kshatriyas was like that of Shakra himself.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: गोभिः समुद्रेण तथा गोलाकुलर्भवानरैः। गुप्ता रामभयोद्विग्नाः क्षत्रियाणां कुलोद्वहाः॥
en: The sons of Kshatriyas, stricken with the fear of Rama, were concealed (and brought up) by kine, Ocean, pards, bears, and monkeys.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: अहो धन्यो नृलोकोऽयं सभाग्याश्च नरा भुवि। यत्र कर्मेदृशं धर्म्यं द्विजेन कृतमित्युत॥
en: Indeed, Praiseworthy is this world of men and fortunate are they that live in it where such a wonderful but righteous deed was performed by a Brahinana.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: तथावृत्तौ कथां तात तावच्युतयुधिष्ठिरौ। जग्मतुर्यत्र गाङ्गेयः शरतल्पगतः प्रभुः॥
en: After this discourse, those two illustrious heroes, viz., Krishna of undecaying glory and Yudhishthira proceeded where the powerful son of Ganga lay on his bed of arrows.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: ततस्ते ददृशुर्भीष्मं शरप्रस्तरशायिनम्। स्वरश्मिजालसंवीतं सायंसूर्यसमप्रभम्॥
en: They then saw Bhishma lying on his arrowy bed and shining like the evening Sun covered with his own rays.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: उपास्यमानं मुनिभिर्देवैरिव शतक्रतुम्। देशे परमधर्मिष्ठे नदीमोघवतीमनु॥७
en: The Kuru hero was encircled by many ascetics like Indra of a hundred sacrifices by the denizens of heaven. The spot on which he lay was highly sacred, for it was situate on the banks of the river Oghavati.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: दूरादेव तमालोक्य कृष्णो राजा च धर्मजः। चत्वारः पाण्डवाश्चैव ते च शारद्वतादयः॥ अवस्कन्द्याथ वाहेभ्यः संयम्य प्रचलं मनः। एकीकृत्येन्द्रियग्राममुपतस्थुर्महामुनीनन॥
en: Seeing him from a distance, Krishna and Dharma's royal son, the four Pandavas, and the others headed by Shwaradwat, got down from their cars and restraining their minds and concentrating all their senses, approached the great Rishis.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: अभिवाद्य तु गोविन्दः सात्यकिस्ते च पार्थिवाः। व्यासादीनृषिमुख्यांश्च गाङ्गेयमुपतस्थिरे॥
en: Saluting those foremost of Rishis headed by Vyasa, Govinda and Satyaki and the others came to the son of Ganga.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: ततो वृद्धं तथा दृष्ट्वा गाङ्गेयं यदुकौरवाः। परिवार्य ततः सर्वे निषेदुः पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: Seeing Ganga's son of great ascetic merit, the Yadu and Kuru princes, took their seats, around him.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: ततो निशाम्य गाङ्गेय शाम्यमानमिवानलम्। किंचिद् दीनमना भीष्ममिति होवाच केशवः॥
en: Seeing Bhishma resembling a fire about to be extinguished, Keshava with a rather depressed heart addressed him as follows.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: केशव उवाच कच्चिज्ज्ञानानि सर्वाणि प्रसन्नानि यथा पुरा। कच्चिन्न व्याकुला चैव बुद्धिस्ते वदतां वर॥
en: Keshava said Is your understanding now as clear as before? I hope your understanding, O foremost of orators, is not clouded?

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: शराभिघातदुःखात् ते कच्चिद् गात्रं न दूयते। मानसादपि दुःखाद्धि शारीरं बलवत्तरम्॥
en: I hope your limbs are not afflicted by the pain originating from the wounds inflicted by arrows? Mental grief also weakens the body.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: वरदानात् पितुः कामं छन्दमृत्युरसि प्रभो। शान्तनोधर्मनित्यस्य न त्वेतन्मम कारणम्॥
en: By virtue of the boon granted to you by your father, the righteous Shantanu, your death, O powerful hero, depends on your own will. I myself have not that merit for which you have obtained this boons.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: सुसूक्ष्मोऽपि तु देहे वै शल्यो जनयते रुजम्। किं पुनः शरसंघातैश्चित्तस्य तव पार्थिव॥
en: Even the smallest Pin when put into the body produces pain. What need then be said, O king, hundreds of arrows that have pierced you?

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: काम नैतत् तवाख्येयं प्राणिनां प्रभवाप्ययौ। उपदेष्टुं भवाशक्तो देवानामपि भारत॥
en: Surely, pain cannot be said to assail you, You can, O Bharata, instruct the very celestials regarding the origin and dissolution of living creatures.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: यच्च भूतं भविष्यं च भवच्च पुरुषर्षभ। सर्वं तज्ज्ञानवृद्धस्य तव भीष्म प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: Possessed of great knowledge, you know everything belonging to the Past, the Future and the Present.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: संहारश्चैव भूतानां धर्मस्य च फलोदयः। विदितस्ते महाप्राज्ञ त्वं हि धर्ममयो निधिः॥
en: The dissolution of created beings and the mode of righteousness, are well known to you, O you of great wisdom, for you are an ocean of virtue and duty.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: त्वां हि राज्ये स्थितं स्फीते समग्राङ्गमरोगिणम्। स्त्रीसहस्रैः परिवृतं पश्यामीवोर्ध्वरेतसम्॥
en: While living in the climax of prosperity. I saw you forego female intercourse though surrounded by female companions.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: ऋते शान्तनवाद् भीष्मात् त्रिषु लोकेषु पार्थिव। सत्यधर्मान्महावीर्याच्छूराद् धर्मेकतत्परात्॥ मृत्युमावार्य तपसा शरसंस्तरशायिनः। निसर्गप्रभवं किंचिन्न च तातानुशुश्रुम॥
en: Except Shantanu's highly powerful son Bhishma firmly devoted to righteousness, possessed of heroism and having virtue for the only object of life, we have never heard of any other person in the three worlds who could, by his power of asceticism, though lying on a bed of arrows and on the point of death, prevent death (from attacking him).

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: सत्ये तपसि दाने च यज्ञाधिकरणे तथा। धनुर्वेदे च वेदे च नीत्यां चैवानुरक्षणे॥ अनृशंस शुचिं दान्तं सर्वभूतहिते रतम्। महारथं त्वत्सदृशं न कंचिदनुशुश्रुम॥
en: We have never heard of anyone else who was so devoted to truth, to penances, to gifts, to the celebration of sacrifices, to the sciences of arms, to the Vedas, and to the protection of persons begging for the same, and who abstained from injuring any creature, so pure in conduct, so self-controlled, and so bent upon doing good to all creatures, and who was also so great a car-warrior as you.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: त्वं हि देवान् सगन्धर्वानसुरान् यक्षराक्षसान्। शक्तस्त्वेकरथेनैव विजेतुं नात्र संशयः॥
en: Forsooth, you are competent to defeat, on a single car, the gods, Gandharvas, Asuras, Yakshas, and Rakshasas.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: स त्वं भीष्म महाबाहो वसूनां वासवोपमः। नित्यं विप्रैः समाख्यातो नवमोऽनवमो गुणैः॥
en: O mighty-armed Bhishma, you are described by the Brahinanas as the ninth of the Vasus. By your virtues, however, you have excelled them all and are equal to Vasava himself.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: अहं च त्वाभिजानामि यस्त्वं पुरुषसत्तम। त्रिदशेष्वपि विख्यातस्त्वं शक्त्या पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: I know, O best of persons, that you are celebrated for your prowess, O foremost of beings, among even the very abstracts.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: मनुष्येषु मनुष्येन्द्र न दृष्टो न च मे श्रुतः। भवतो वा गुणैर्युक्तः पृथिव्यां पुरुष: क्वचित्॥
en: Among men on Earth, O foremost of men, we have never seen nor heard of any one endued with such accomplishments.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: त्वं हि सर्वगुणै राजन् देवानप्यतिरिच्यसे। तपसा हि भवाशक्तः स्रष्टुं लोकांश्चराचरान्॥ किं पुनश्चात्मनो लोकानुत्तमानुत्तमैर्गुणैः।
en: O Kshatriya chief, you excell the gods themselves in these accomplishments. By your ascetic power you can create a universe of mobile and immobile creatures. What is the use of saying that you have acquired many blessed regions by means of your foremost of virtues?

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: तदस्य तप्यमानस्य ज्ञातीनां संक्षयेन वैः॥ ज्येष्ठस्य पाण्डुपुत्रस्य शोकं भीष्म व्यपानुद।
en: Remove now the sorrow of the eldest son of Pandu who is burning with sorrow on account of the destruction of his kinsinen.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: ये हि धर्माः समाख्याताश्चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य भारत॥ चातुराश्रभ्यसंयुक्ताः सर्वे ते विदितास्तव।
en: All the duties that have been laid down for the four orders about the four modes of life and well known to you.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: चातुर्विद्ये च ये प्रोक्ताश्चातुर्होत्रे च भारत॥ योगे सांख्ये च नियता ये च धर्माः सनातनाः। चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य यश्चोक्तो धर्मो न स्म विरुध्यते॥ सेव्यमानः सवैयाख्यो गाङ्गेय विदितस्तव।
en: Everything again that is in the four branches of learning, in the four Hotras, O Bharata, as also those eternal duties that are laid down in Yoga and Sankhya philosophy, the duties too of the four orders and those duties that are not inconsistent with their practices, all these, along with their interpretations,-O son of Ganga, are known to you.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: प्रतिलोमप्रसूतानां वर्णानां चैव यः स्मृतः॥ देशजातिकुलानां न जानीषे धर्मलक्षणम्। वेदोक्तो यश्च शिष्टोक्तः सदैव विदितस्तव॥
en: The duties that have been laid down for the issues of intermarriages and those laid down for particular countries and tribes and families, and those declared by the Vedas and the wise men, are all well known to you.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: इतिहासपुराणार्थाः कार्येन विदितास्तवा धर्मशास्त्रं च सकलं नित्यं मनसि ते स्थितम्॥
en: You are the master-topics of histories and the Puranas. All the scriptures treating of duty and practice are centered in your memory.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: ये च केचन लोकेऽस्मिन्नर्थाः संशयकारकाः। तेषां छेत्ता नास्ति लोके त्वदन्यः पुरुषर्षभ।॥
en: Except you, O foremost of men, there is no other person that can dispell the doubts that may arise regarding the subjects of knowledge studied in the world.

description: The fresh birth of Kshatriya on earth described.
sn: स पाण्डवेयस्य मनः समुत्थितं नरेन्द्र शोकं व्यपकर्ष मेधया। भवद्विधा ह्युत्तमबुद्धिविस्तरा विमुह्यमानस्य नरस्य शान्तये॥
en: With the help of your intelligence, do you, O prince of men, drive the sorrow felt by the son of Pandu. Persons endued with so great and such varied knowledge live only for solacing those whose minds have been stupefied.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा तु वचनं भीष्मो वासुदेवस्य धीमतः। किंचिदुन्नाम्य वदनं प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing those words of the highly intelligent Vasudeva, Bhishma, raising his head a little, said these words with joined hands.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: भीष्म उवाच नमस्ते भगवन् कृष्ण लोकानां प्रभवाप्यय। त्वं हि कर्ता हृषीकेश संहर्ता चापराजितः॥
en: Bhishma said 'Salutations to you, O divine Krishna! You are the origin and the dissolution of all the worlds. You are the Creator and you are the Destroyer. You, O Hrishikesha, cannot be defeated by any one.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: विश्वकर्मन् नमस्तेऽस्तु विश्वात्मन् विश्वसम्भव। अपवर्गोऽसि भूतानां पञ्चानां परतः स्थितः॥
en: The universe is the work of your hand. You are the soul of the universe and the universe has originated from you. Salutations to you. You are the end of all created things. You are above the five elements.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: नमस्ते त्रिषु लोकेषु नमस्ते परतस्त्रिषु। योगेश्वर नमस्तेऽस्तु त्वं हि सर्वपरायणः॥
en: Salutations to you who are the three worlds and that are again above the three worlds. O lord of Yogins, salutations to you who are the refuge of all.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: मत्संश्रितं यदाऽऽत्थ त्वं वचः पुरुषसत्तम। तेन पश्यामि ते दिव्या भावान् हि त्रिषु वर्त्मसु॥ तच्च पश्यामि गोविन्द यत् ते रूपं सनातनम्।
en: O foremost of beings, those words which you have said regarding me have enabled me to see your divine attributes as manifest in the three worlds. O Govinda, I also behold your eternal image.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: सप्त मार्गा निरुद्धास्ते वायोरमिततेजसः॥ दिवं ते शिरसा व्याप्तं पद्भ्यां देवी वसुन्धरा।
en: You stand closing the seven paths of the powerful Wind. The sky is occupied by your head, and the Earth by your feet.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: दिशो भुजा रविश्चक्षुर्वीर्ये शुक्रः प्रतिष्ठितः॥ अतसीपुष्पसंकाशं पीतवाससमच्युतम्। वपुर्खनुमिमीमस्ते मेघस्येव सविद्युतः॥ त्वत्प्रपन्नाय भक्ताय गतिमिशं जिगीषवे। यच्छ्रेयः पुण्डरीकाक्ष तद् ध्यायस्व सुरोत्तम॥
en: The quarters are your two arms, and the Sun is your eye, and Shakra is your prowess. O you of undecaying glory, your body clad in yellow robes that resemble the colour of the Atasi flower, seem to us to be like a could charged with flashes of lightning. Think of that, O best of gods, which would be good, O you having lotus eyes, for my humble self who am devoted to you, who seek refuge with you, and who am desirous of acquiring a blissful end.'

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: वासुदेव उवाच यतः खलु पुरा भक्तिर्मयि ते पुरुषर्षभ। ततो मया वपुर्दिव्यं त्वयि राजन् प्रदर्शितम्॥
en: Vasudeva said-'Since, O foremost of men, your devotion to me is very great, for this, O prince, I have shown my divine form to you.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: न ह्यभक्ताय राजेन्द्र भक्तायानृजवे न च। दर्शयाम्यहमात्मानं च चाशान्ताय भारत॥
en: I do not, O foremost of kings, display myself to one which is not my votary, or to a devotee who is not sincere, or to one, O Bharata, who has not restrained his soul.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: भवांस्तु मम भक्तश्च नित्यं चार्जवमास्थितः। दमे तपसि सत्ये च दाने च निरतः शुचिः॥
en: You are devoted to me and always observe righteousiness, Of a pure heart, you are always self-restrained and ever practice penances and make gifts.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: अर्हस्त्वं भीष्म मां द्रष्टुं तपसा स्वेन पार्थिव। तव ह्युपस्थिता लोका येभ्यो नावर्तते पुनः॥
en: Through your own penances, O Bhishma, you are competent to see me. Those regions from which no one returns, O King, are ready for you.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: पञ्चाशतं षट् च कुरुप्रवीर शेष दिनानां तव जीवितस्या ततः शुभैः कर्मफलोदयैस्त्वं समेष्यसे भीष्म विमुच्य देहम्॥
en: Fifty-six days, O foremost of Kuru's race, still remain for you to live. Renouncing your body, you shall then, O Bhishma, obtain the blessed meed of your deeds.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: एते हि देवा वसवो विमार्ना न्यास्थाय सर्वे ज्वलिताग्निकल्पा:। अन्तर्हितास्त्वां प्रतिपालयन्ति काष्ठां प्रपद्यन्तमुदक्पतङ्गम्॥
en: See, those deities and the Vasus, all having fiery forms, riding on their cars, are waiting for you invisibly till the moment of the Sun's entering on his northerly course.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: व्यावर्तमाने भगवत्युदीची सूर्ये दिशं कालवशात् प्रपन्ने। गन्तासि लोकान् पुरुषप्रवीर नावर्तते यानुपलभ्य विद्वान्॥
en: Subject to universal time, when the divine Sun turns to his northerly course, you, O foremost of men, shall go to those regions whence no man returns to this Earth.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: अमुं च लोकं त्वयि भीष्म याते ज्ञानानि नंक्ष्यन्त्यखिलेन वीर। अतस्तु सर्वे त्वयि संन्निकर्ष समागता धर्मविवेचनाय॥
en: When you, O Bhishma, will leave this world all knowledge, O hero, will end with you. It is, therefore, that all these persons, assembled together, have approached you for listening to discourses on duty and morality.

description: Krishna and Yudhishthira approach the bed of arrows and the former acquires of Bhishma if his understanding was all right.
sn: तज्ज्ञातिशोकोपहतश्रुताय सत्याभिसंधाय युधिष्ठिराय। प्रब्रूहि धर्मार्थसमाधियुक्तं सत्यं वचोऽस्यापनुदाशु शोकम्॥
en: Do you then speak words of truth, containing morality and profit and Yoga, to Yudhishthira who is firm in truth but whose learning has been clouded by consequent on the destruction of his kinsmen, and do you by this, speedily remove that grief of his. sorrow

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः कृष्णस्य तद् वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम्। श्रुत्वा शान्तनवो भीष्मः प्रत्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Hearing these words of Krishna pregnant with morality and worldly profit, Shantanu's son Bhishma answered him thus. Bhishma said

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: लोकनाथ महाबाहो शिव नारायणाच्युत। तव वाक्यमुपश्रुत्य हर्षेणास्मि परिप्लुतः॥
en: O lord of all the worlds, O mighty-armed one, O Shiva, O Narayana, O you of undecaying glory, hearing your words I have been filled with joy.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: किं चाहमभिधास्यामि वाक्यं ते तव संनिधौ। यदा वाचोगतं सर्वं तव वाचि समाहितम्॥
en: But what words, O master of speech, can I communicate in your presence, when especially all the subjects of speech have been treated in your specch?

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: यच्च किंचित् क्व चिल्लोके कर्तव्यं क्रियते च यत्। त्वत्तस्तन्निःसृतं देव लोके बुद्धिमतो हि ते॥
en: Whatever in either world should be done or is done, emanates from your intelligent self, O god.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: कथयेद् देवलोकं यो देवराजसमीपतः। धर्मकामार्थमोक्षाणां सोऽर्थं ब्रूयात् तवाग्रतः॥
en: That person, who can speak on the subject of heaven before the king of the celestials, himself is able to deal with morality and desire and profit and liberation in your presence.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: शराभितापाद् व्यथितं मनो मे मधुसूदन। गात्राणि चावसीदन्ति न च बुद्धिः प्रसीदति॥
en: My mind, O destroyer of Madhu, is greatly agitated by the pain of wounds inflicted by arrows. My limbs are weak, My understanding is not clear.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: न च मे प्रतिभा काचिदस्ति किंचित् प्रभाषितुम्। पीड्यमानस्य गोविन्द विषानलसमैः शरैः॥
en: I am so afflicted, O Govinda, by these arrows resembling poison or fire that I have not the power to speak anything.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: बलं मे प्रजहातीव प्राणाः संत्वरयन्ति च। मर्माणि परितप्यन्ति भ्रान्तचित्तस्तथा ह्यहम्॥
en: My strength is leaving me. My vital airs are about to leave me. The very vitals of my body are being consumed. My understanding is clouded.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: दौर्बल्यात् सज्जते वाङ्मे स कथं वक्तुमुत्सहे। साधु मे त्वं प्रसीदस्व दाशार्हकुलवर्धन॥
en: From weakness my words are becoming indistinct. How then can I dare speak? O lord of Dasharha's race, be pleased with me.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: तत् क्षमस्व महाबाहो न बयां किंचिदच्युत। त्वत्संनिधौ च सीदेद्धि वाचस्पतिरपि ब्रुवन्॥
en: O mighty-armed one, I will not say anything. Pardon me. Even the lord of speech (Brihaspati) will hesitate to speak before you.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: न दिशः सम्प्रजानामि नाकाशं न च मेदिनीम्। केवलं तव वीर्येण तिष्ठामि मधुसूदन॥
en: I cannot any longer decipher the points of the compass, nor distinguish the sky from the earth. Through your energy, O slayer of Madhu, I am only alive.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: स्वयमेव भवांस्तस्माद् धर्मराजस्य यद्धितम्। तद् ब्रवीत्वाशु सर्वेषामागमानां त्वमागमः॥
en: Do you, therefore, yourself speak for the behoof of king Yudhishthira, for you are the ordainer of all the ordinances.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: कथं त्वयि स्थिते कृष्णे शाश्वते लोककर्तरि। प्रब्रूयान्मद्विधः कश्चिद् गुरौ शिष्य इव स्थिते॥
en: How, O Krishna, when you, the eternal creator of the universe, are present, can one like me speak like a disciple before his preceptor?

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: वासुदेव उवाच उपपन्नमिदं वाक्यं कौरवाणां धुरन्धरे। महावीर्ये महासत्त्वे स्थिरे सर्वार्थदर्शिनि॥
en: Vasudeva said Your words become you only who are the foremost of Kuru's race, who are endued with great energy, who are of great soul, and who are possessed of great patience and conversant with every subject.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: यच्च मामात्थ गाड्नेय बाणघातरूज प्रति। गृहाणात्र वरं भीष्म मत्प्रसादकृतं प्रभो॥
en: Regarding what you have said about the pain of wounds, receive, O Bhishma, this boon what I grant you, O powerful one, from favour.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: न ते ग्लानिन ते मूर्छा न दाहो न च ते रुजा। प्रभविष्यन्ति गाङ्गेय क्षुत्पिपासे न चाप्युत॥
en: Uneasiness, stupefaction, burning pain, hunger and thirst shall not, O son of Ganga, assail you, O you of undecaying glory.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: ज्ञानानि च समग्राणि प्रतिभास्यन्ति तेऽनघ। न च ते क्व चिदासक्तिर्बुद्धेः प्रादुर्भविष्यति॥
en: Your perception and memory, Osinless one, shall be unclouded. Your understanding shall not disappear.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: सत्त्वस्थं च मनो नित्यं तव भीष्म भविष्यति। रजस्तमोभ्यां रहितं घनैर्मुक्त इवोडुराट्॥
en: Your mind, O Bhishma, freed from the qualities of darkness and ignorance will always be subject to the quality of goodness, like the moon coming out of the clouds.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: यद् यच्च धर्मसंयुक्तमर्थयुक्तमथापि च। चिन्तयिष्यसि तत्राग्र्या बुद्धिस्तव भविष्यति॥
en: Your understanding will penetrate every subject regarding duty, morality, or profit, you will think upon.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: इमं च राजशार्दूल भूतग्रामं चतुर्विधम्। चक्षुर्दिव्यं समाश्रित्य द्रक्ष्यस्यमितविक्रम॥
en: O foremost of kings, acquiring choice vision, you will, O you of incomparable prowess, succeed in seeing the four orders of created things.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: संसरन्तं प्रजाजालं संयुक्तो ज्ञानचक्षुषा। भीष्म द्रक्ष्यसि तत्त्वेन जले मीन इवामले॥
en: Possessing the eye of knowledge, you will, O Bhishma, see, like fishes in a limpid stream, all created things that you will try to recollect.'

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ते व्याससहिताः सर्व ऋग्यजुःसामसहितैर्वचोभिः कृष्णमार्चयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Then those great Rishis, with Vyasa amongst them, worshipped Krishna with hymns from the Richs, the Yajus, and the Samans.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: ततः सर्वार्तवं दिव्य पुष्पवर्ष नभस्तलात्। पपात यत्र वार्ष्णेयः सगाङ्गेय सपाण्डवः॥
en: A shower of celestial flowers of all seasons fell on that spot where the Vrishni hero with Ganga's son and the son of Pandu were.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि जगुश्चाप्सरसां गणाः। न चाहितमनिष्टं च किञ्चित्तत्र प्रदृश्यते॥
en: All kinds of celestial instruments played in the sky and the Apsaras began to sing. No evil portent appeared there.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: एव महर्षयः। भीष्ममामन्त्रयाञ्चक्रू ववौ शिवः सुखो वायुः सर्वगन्धवहः शुचिः। शान्तायां दिशि शान्ताश्च प्रावदन् मृगपक्षिणः॥
en: An auspicious, pleasant and pure breeze, carrying every kind of fragrance, began to blow. All the points of the horizon became clear and quiet, and all the animals and birds began to move about peacefully.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: ताते मुहूर्ताद् भगवान् सहस्रांशुर्दिवाकरः। दहन वैनमिवैकान्ते प्रतीच्या प्रत्यदृश्यत॥
en: Soon after, like a fire at the outskirt of a great forest, the divine Sun of a thousand rays was seen to descend westwards.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: ततो महर्षयः सर्वे समुत्थाय जनार्दनम्। राजानं च युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Then, rising up, the great Rishis saluted Janardana and Bhishma and king Yudhishthira.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: ततः प्रणाममकरोत् केशवः सहपाण्डवः। सात्यकिः संजयश्चैव स च शारद्वत: कृपः॥
en: Upon this, Keshava, the sons of Pandu, Satyaki, Sanjaya, and Sharadwat's son Kripa, bowed reverentially to those sages.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: ततस्ते धर्मनिरताः सम्यक् तैरभिपूजिताः। श्वः समेष्याम इत्युक्त्वा यथेष्टं त्वरिता ययुः॥
en: Always righteous those sages, thus adored by Keshava and others, quickly went to their respective habitations saying-We will return tomorrow.'

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: तथैवामन्त्र्य गाङ्गेयं केशवः पाण्डवास्तथा। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य रथानारुरुहुः शुभान्॥
en: After this, Keshava and the Pandavas, saluting Bhishma and going round him, got upon their beautiful cars.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: ततो रथैः काञ्चनचित्रकूबरै महीधराभैः समदैश्च दन्तिभिः। हयैः सुपर्णैरिव चाशुगामिभिः पदातिभिश्चात्तशरासनादिभिः॥
en: Those heroes then went out, accompanied by many other cars adorned with golden Kuvaras, and infuriate elephants resembling mountains, and horses quick-coursing as Garudas, and the infantry armed with bows and weapons.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: ययौ स्थानां पुरतो हि सा चर्मू स्तथैव पश्चादतिमात्रसारिणी। पुरश्च पश्चाच्च यथा महानदी तमृक्षवन्तं गिरिमेत्य नर्मदा॥
en: That army, moving quickly, proceeded in two detachments, one in the van and the other in the rear of those princes. The spectacle shone like two currents of the great river Narmada at the point where it is divided by the Rikshavat mountains standing across it.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: ततः पुरस्ताद्भगवान्निशाकरः समुत्थितस्तामभिहर्षयंश्चमूम्। दिवाकरापीतरसा महौषधी: पुनः स्वकेनैव गुणेन योजयन्॥
en: Cheering up that great army the divine Moon rose before it in the sky, once more giving moisture, by his own force, to the terrestrial herbs and plants whose juice has been drunk up by the Sun.

description: Bhishma describes the universal form of Krishna who asks the former to deliver instructions.
sn: ततः पुरं सुरपुरसम्मितद्युति प्रविश्य ते यदुवृषपाण्डवास्तदा। यथोचितान् भवनवरान् समाविशञ् श्रमान्विता मृगपतयो गुहा इव॥
en: Then that foremost of Yadu's race and the sons of Pandu, entering the (Kuru) city which was shining like that of the city of Indra itself, proceeded to their respective edifices like tired lions seeking their caves.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः शयनमाविश्य प्रसुप्तो मधुसूदनः। याममात्रार्धशेषायां यामिन्यां प्रत्यबुद्ध्यत॥ स ध्यानपथमाविश्य सर्वज्ञानानि माधवः। अवलोक्य ततः पश्चाद् दध्यौ ब्रह्म सनातनम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Retiring to his bed the destroyer of Madhu slept happily. Awaking when half a period was wanting for the approach of the day, he made himself ready for meditation. Concentrating all his senses, he meditated on the eternal Brahma.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: ततः स्तुतिपुराणज्ञा रक्तकण्ठाः सुशिक्षिताः। अस्तुवन् विश्वकर्माणं वासुदेवं प्रजापतिम्॥
en: Then a number of well-trained and sweet voiced persons conversant with hymns and the Puranas, began to sing the praises of Vasudeva, the master of all creatures and the creator of the universe.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: पठन्ति पाणिस्वनिकास्तथा गायन्ति गायनाः। शङ्खानथ मृदङ्गांश्च प्रवाद्यन्ति सहस्रशः॥
en: Others, keeping time by the clapping of hands, began to sing sweet hymns, and vocalists began to sing. Thousands of conchshells and drums were blown and beat.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: वीणापणववेणूनां स्वनश्चातिमनोरमः। सहास इव विस्तीर्णः शुश्रुवे तस्य वेश्मनः॥
en: The charming sound also of Vinas; Panavas, and bamboo flutes, was heard. The spacious edifice of Krishna, seemed, as if to laugh with music.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: ततो युधिष्ठिरस्यापि राज्ञो मङ्गलसंहिताः। उच्चेरुर्मधुरा वाचो गीतवादिनि:स्वनाः॥
en: In the mansion of King Yudhishthira also melodious voices were heard, exclaiming auspicious wishes, and the sound of songs too and musical instruments.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: तत उत्थाय दाशार्हः स्नातः प्राञ्जलिरच्युतः। जप्त्वा गुह्यं महाबाहुरग्नीनाश्रित्य तस्थिवान्॥
en: Then the Dasharha here performed his ablutions. Joining his hands, the mighty armed hero, of undecaying glory, silently recited his sacred Mantras, and lighting up a fire poured libations of clarified butter upon it.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: ततः सहस्रं विप्राणां चतुर्वेदविदां तथा। गवां सहस्रेणैकैकं वाचयामास माधवः॥
en: Distributing a thousand kine amongst a thousand Brahmanas all of whom were masters of the four Vedas, he made them utter benedictions upon him.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: मङ्गलालम्भनं कृत्वा आत्मानमवलोक्य च। आदर्श विमले कृष्णस्ततः सात्यकिमब्रवीत्॥ गच्छ शैनेय जानीहि गत्वा राजनिवेशनम्। अपि सज्जो महातेजा भीष्मं द्रष्टुं युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Touching next various sorts of sacred articles and beholding himself in a clear mirror, Krishna addressed Satyaki, saying,—'Go, O descendant of Shini, and repairing to Yudhishthira's palace, ascertain whether if the king is dressed for visiting Bhishma.'

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: ततः कृष्णस्य वचनात् सात्यकिस्त्वरितो ययौ। उपगम्य च राजानं युधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥ युक्तो रथवरो राजन् वासुदेवस्य धीमतः। समीपमापगेयस्य प्रयास्यति जनार्दनः॥
en: Thus commanded by Krishna, Satyaki, proceeding quickly to the royal son of Pandu, said to him-'The foremost of cars, belonging to the highly intelligent Vasudeva, is ready, O king, for Janardana will go to see Ganga's son.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: भवत्प्रतीक्षः कृष्णोऽसौ धर्मराज महाद्युते। यदत्रानन्तरं कृत्यं तद् भवान् कर्तुमर्हति॥ एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः।
en: O righteous, great, and powerful king! Krishna is waiting for you. You should now do what should be done next. Thus addressed, Dharma's son Yudhishthira answered as follows.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच युज्यतां मे रथवरः फाल्गुनाप्रतिमद्युते॥ न सैनिकैश्च यातव्यं यास्यामो वयमेव हि।
en: ‘O Phalguna of matchless splendour, let my best of cars be made ready. We should not be accompanied by the soldiers, but we shall proceed alone.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: न च पीडयितव्यो मे भीष्मो धर्मभृतां वरः॥ अतः पुरःसराश्चापि निवर्तन्तु धनंजय।
en: That best or righteous person viz., Bhishma, should not be vexed. Let not the guards, therefore, O Dhananjaya accompany us today.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: अद्यप्रभृति गाङ्गेयः परं गुह्यं प्रवक्ष्यति॥ अतो नेच्छामि कौन्तेय पृथग्जनसमागमम्।
en: From this day Ganga's son will discourse on things that are great mysteries, I do not, therefore, O son of Kunti, wish that there should be a miscellaneous assembly.'

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच स तद्वाक्यमथाज्ञाय कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥ युक्तं रथवरं तस्मा आचचक्षे नरर्षभः।
en: Hearing these words of the king, Kunti's son Dhananjaya, that best of men went out and returning said to him that his best of cars stood ready for him.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा यमौ भीमार्जुनावपि॥ भूतानीव समस्तानि ययुः कृष्णनिवेशनम्।
en: King Yudhishthira, the twins Bhima and Arjuna, the five resembling the five elements, then proceeded towards Krishna's mansion.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: आगच्छत्स्वथ कृष्णोऽपि पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु॥ शैनेयसहितो धीमान् रथमेवान्वपद्यत।
en: While the great Pandavas were coming, Krishna accompanied by the grandson of Shini, got upon his car.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: रथस्थाः संविदं कृत्वा सुखां पृष्ट्वा च शर्वरीम्॥ मेघघोषै रथवरैः प्रययुस्ते नरर्षभाः।
en: Saluting one another from their cars and each enquiring of the other whether he had passed the night happily, those foremost of men proceeded, without stopping, on those foremost of cars whose rattle resembled the roar of the clouds.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: बलाहकं मेघपुष्पं शैब्यं सुग्रीवमेव च॥ दारुकश्चोदयामास वासुदेवस्य वाजिनः। ते हया वासुदेवस्य दारुकेण प्रचोदिताः।२२॥ गां खुरागैस्तथा राजंल्लिखन्तः प्रययुस्तदा।
en: Krishna's horses, viz., Balahaka, Meghapushpa, Shaivya and Sugriva were driven by Daruka. The animals, urged by him, O king, ran on marking the Earth with their hoofs.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: ते ग्रसन्त इवाकाशं वेगवन्तो महाबलाः॥ क्षेत्रं धर्मस्य कृत्स्नस्य कुरुक्षेत्रमवातरन्। ततो ययुर्यत्र भीष्मः शरतल्पगतः प्रभुः॥ आस्ते महर्षिभिः सार्धं ब्रह्मा देवगणैर्यथा।
en: Highly strong and quick-coursing, they flew onwards, devouring as if the very skies. Traversing the sacred field of Kuru, the princes went to that spot where the powerful Bhishma was lying on his bed of arrows, surrounded by those great Rishis, like Brahman himself in the midst of the celestials.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: ततोऽवतीर्य गोविन्दो रथात् स च युधिष्ठिरः॥ भीमो गाण्डीवधन्वा च यमौ सात्यकिरेव च। ऋषीनभ्यर्चयामासुः करानुद्यम्य दक्षिणान्॥
en: Then Govinda, Yudhishthira. Bhima, and the wielder of Gandiva, the twins and Satyaki, getting down from their cars, saluted the Rishis by raising their right hands.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: स तैः परिवृतो राजा नक्षत्रैरिव चन्द्रमाः। अभ्याजगाम गाङ्गेयं ब्रह्माणमिव वासवः॥
en: Encircled by them, king Yudhishthira, like the moon in the midst of the stars, approached Ganga's son like Vasava proceeding towards Brahman.

description: Bhishma expresses his inability, but Krishna presses him. Then the Pandavas leave the camp
sn: शरतल्पे शयानं तमादित्यं पतितं यथा। स ददर्श महाबाहुं भयाच्चागतसाध्वसः।२८॥
en: Possessed by fear, the king timidly cast his eyes on the mighty-armed hero lying on his bed of arrows like the Sun himself dropped from the sky.

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: जनमेजय उवाच धर्मात्मनि महावीर्ये सत्यसंधे जितात्मनि। देवव्रते महाभागे शरतल्पगतेऽच्युते॥ शयाने वीरशयने भीष्मे शान्तनुनन्दने। गाङ्गेये पुरुषव्याघ्र पाण्डवैः पर्युपासिते॥ काः कथाः समवर्तन्त तस्मिन् वीरसमागमे। हतेषु सर्वसैन्येषु तन्मे शंस महामुने॥
en: Janamejaya said When that foremost men, of righteous soul and great energy, strictly devoted to truth and with passions restrained, viz., the son of Shantanu and Ganga, named Devavrata or Bhishma of undecaying glory, lay on a hero's bed with the sons of Pandu sitting around him, tell me, O great sage, what conversation took place in that meeting of heroes after the destruction of all the soldiers.

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच शरतल्पगते भीष्मे कौरवाणां धुरन्धरे। आजग्मुर्ऋषयः सिद्धा नारदप्रमुखा नृप॥
en: Vaishampayana said When Bhishma, that chief of the Kurus, lay on his bed of arrows, many Rishis and Siddhas, O king, headed by Narada, came there.

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: हतशिष्टाश्च राजानो युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः। धृतराष्ट्रश्च कृष्णश्च भीमार्जुनयमास्तथा॥
en: The residue of the king with Yudhishthira at their head, Dhritarashtra, Krishna, Bhima, Arjuna and the twins also came there.

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: तेऽभिगम्य महात्मानो भरतानां पितामहम्। अन्वशोचन्त गाङ्गेयमादित्यं पतितं यथा॥
en: Approaching the grandfather of the Bharatas who shone like the Sun himself dropped from the sky, those great persons began to bewail for him.

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: मुहूर्तमिव च ध्यात्वा नारदो देवदर्शनः। उवाच पाण्डवान् सर्वान् हतशिष्टांश्च पार्थिवान्॥ प्राप्तकालं समाचक्षे भीष्मोऽयमनुयुज्यताम्। अस्तमेति हि गाङ्गेयो भानुमानिव भारत॥
en: Then reflecting for a moment, Narada, of divine features, addressed all the Pandavas and the residue of the kings, saying, 'The time, I think, has come for you to question Bhishma for Ganga's son is about to die like the Sun that is on the point of setting.

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: अयं प्राणानुत्सिसृक्षुस्तं सर्वेऽभ्यनुपृच्छत। कृत्स्नात् विविधान् धर्मांश्चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य वेत्त्ययम्॥
en: He is about to give up his ghost. Do you all, therefore, request him to discourse to you. He is acquainted with the various duties of all the four orders.

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: एष वृद्धः पराँल्लोकान् सम्प्राप्नोति तनुं त्यजन्। तं शीघ्रमनुयुजीध्वं संशयान् मनसि स्थितान्॥
en: Aged as he is, after renouncing his corporeal frame he will attain to high regions of bliss. Request him, therefore, forthwith to clear the doubts that exist in your minds.

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ते नारदेन भीष्ममीयुर्नराधिपः। प्रष्टुं चाशक्नुवन्तस्ते वीक्षां चक्रुः परस्परम्॥
en: Thus accosted by Narada, those princes approached Bhishina, but unable to ask him anything looked at one another.

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: अथोवाच हृषीकेशं पाण्डुपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। नान्यस्तु देवकीपुत्राच्छक्तः प्रष्टुं पितामहम्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira the son of Pandu, addressing Hrishikesha, said,-"There is no one else then Devaki's son who can question the grandfather.

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: प्रव्याहर यदुश्रेष्ठ त्वमग्रे मधुसूदन। त्वं हि नस्तात सर्वेषां सर्वधर्मविदुत्तमः॥
en: O foremost one of Yadu's race, do you, therefore, O destroyer of Madhu, speak first. You are the foremost of us all and are conversant with every duty and practice.'

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: एवमुक्तः पाण्डवेन भगवान् केशवस्तदा। अभिगम्य दुराधर्षं प्रव्याहारयदच्युतः॥
en: Thus addressed by the son of Pandu, the illustrious Keshava of undecaying glory, approaching the unconquerable Bhishma, spoke to him as follows.

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: वासुदेव उवाच कच्चित् सुखेन रजनी व्युष्टा ते राजसत्तम। विस्पष्टलक्षणा बुद्धिः कच्चिच्चोपस्थिता तव॥
en: Have you, O best of kings passed the night happily? Has your understanding become unclouded?

description: Yudhishthira with all the Pandavas go again to Bhishma.
sn: कच्चिज्ज्ञानानि सर्वाणि प्रतिभान्ति च तेऽनघ। न ग्लायते च हृदयं न च ते व्याकुलं मनः॥
