sn: अराजकेषु राष्ट्रेषु धर्मो न व्यवतिष्ठते। परस्परं च खादन्ति सर्वथा धिगराजकम्॥
en: In kingdoms torn by anarchy, righteousness cannot live. The denizens devour one another. An anarchy is the worst of all conditions.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: इन्द्रमेव प्रवृणुते यद्राजानमिति श्रुतिः। यथैवेन्द्रस्तथा राजा सम्पूज्यो भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: The Shrutis say that in crowning a king, it is Indra that is crowned in the person of the king. A person, who seeks his own prosperity, should adore the king as he should adore Indra himself.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: नाराजकेषु राष्ट्रेषु वस्तव्यमिति रोचये। नाराजकेषु राष्ट्रेषु हव्यमग्निर्वहत्युत॥
en: No one should live in kingdoms torn by anarchy. Agni does not carry the libations that are poured upon him in kingdoms where anarchy reigns.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: अथ चेदाभिवर्तेत राज्यार्थी बलवत्तरः। अराजकाणि राष्ट्राणि हतवीर्याणि वा पुनः॥ प्रत्युद्गम्याभिपूज्यः स्यादेतदत्र सुमन्त्रितम्। न हि पापात् परतरमस्ति किञ्चिदराजकात्॥
en: If a powerful king approaches kingdoms weakened by anarchy, with a view to annex them to his dominions, the people should go forward and receive the invader with honour. Such conduct would be quite of a piece with wise counsels. There is no evil greater than anarchy.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: स चेत् समनुपश्येत समग्रं कुशलं भवेत्। बलवान् हि प्रकुपितः कुर्यान्निःशेषतामपि॥
en: If the powerful invader be a little just, everything will be right. If however, he be exercised with may exterminate all.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: भूयांसं लभते क्लेशं या गौर्भवति दुर्दुहा। अथ या सुदुहा राजन् नैव तां वितुदन्त्यपि॥
en: That cow which cannot be easily milked suffer much pain. On the other hand, that cow which is easily milked, has not to suffer any pain whatever.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: यदतप्तं प्रणमते नैतत् संतापमर्हति। यत् स्वयं नमते दारु न तत् संनामयन्त्यपि॥
en: The wood that bends easily need not be heated. The tree that bends easily, is not required to suffer any torture. anger he

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: एतयोपमया वीर संनमेत बलीयसे। इन्द्राय स प्रणमते नमते यो बलीयसे॥
en: Guided by these examples, O hero, men should bend before those that are powerful. The man who bends his head to a powerful person really bends his head to Indra.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: तस्माद् राजैव कर्तव्यः सततं भूतिमिच्छता। न धनार्थो न दारार्थस्तेषां येषामराजकम्॥
en: For these reasons, men, seeking prosperity, should (elect and) crown some person as their king. They who live in countries where anarchy reigns cannot enjoy there wealth and wives.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: प्रीयते हि हरन् पापः परवित्तमराजके। यदास्य उद्धरन्त्यन्ये तदा राजानमिच्छति॥
en: During times of anarchy, the sinful man enjoys by robbing the wealth of other people. When however, his ill acquired riches are taken away by others, he wishes for a king.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: पापा ह्यपि तदा क्षेमं न लभन्ते कदाचन। एकस्य हि द्वौ हरतो द्वयोश्च बहवोऽपरे॥
en: It is clear therefore, that in times of anarchy the very wicked even cannot be happy. The wealth of one is taken away by two. That of those two is taken away by many acting in concert.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: अदासः क्रियते दासो ह्रियन्ते च बलात् स्त्रियः। एतस्मात् कारणाद् देवाः प्रजापालान् प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: He who is not a slave is made a slave. Women, again, are forcibly carried away. For these reasons the gods created kings for protecting the people.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: राजा चेन्न भवेल्लोके पृथिव्यां दण्डधारकः। जले मत्स्यानिवाभक्ष्यन् दुर्बलं बलवत्तराः॥
en: If there were no king on Earth for holding the rod of punishment, the strong would then have oppressed the weak after the manner of fishes in the water.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: अराजका: प्रजाः पूर्वं विनेशुरिति नः श्रुतम्। परस्परं भक्षयन्तो मत्स्या इव जले कृशान्॥ समेत्य तास्ततश्चक्रुः समयानिति नः श्रुतम्। वाक्शूरो दण्डपरुषो यश्च स्यात् पारजायिकः॥ यः परस्वमथादद्यात् त्याज्या नस्तादृशा इति।
en: We have heard that men, in days of yore, in consequence of anarchy, were ruined, devouring one another like stronger fishes devouring the weaker ones in the water. We have heard that a few amongst them then, assembling together, made certain agreements saying,-He who becomes harsh in speech, or violent in temper, he who seduces other people's wives or robs other's wealth should be renounced by us.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: विश्वासार्थं च सर्वेषां वर्णानामविशेषतः। तास्तथा समयं कृत्वा समयेनावतस्थिरे॥
en: For inspiring confidence among all classes of the people, they made such an agreement and lived for some time.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: सहितास्तास्तदा जग्मुरसुखार्ताः पितामहम्। अनीश्वरा विनश्यामो भगवनीश्वरं दिश॥
en: Assembling after some time they proceeded in great miseries to the Grandfather, saying, Without a king, O divine lord, we are meeting with ruin. Appoint some one as our king.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: यं पूजयेम सम्भूय यश्च नः प्रतिपालयेत्। ततो मनुं व्यादिदेश मनुर्नाभिननन्द ताः॥
en: All of us shall adore him and he shall protect us. Thus prayed for the Grandfather asked Manu. Manu, however, did not agree to the proposal.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: मनुरुवाच बिभेमि कर्मणः पापाद् राज्यं हि भृशदुस्तरम्। विशेषतो मनुष्येषु मिथ्यावृत्तेषु नित्यदा॥
en: Manu said 'I fear all sinful deeds. To govern a kingdom is highly difficult, especially among men who are always false and deceitful in their conduct.'

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: भीष्म उवाच तमब्रुवन् प्रजा मा भैः कर्तृनेनो गमिष्यति। पशूनामधिपञ्चाशद्धिरण्यस्य तथैव च।॥ धान्यस्य दशमं भागं दास्यामः कोशवर्धनम्। कन्यां शुल्के चारुरूपां विवाहेषूद्यतासु च॥
en: Bhishma said The denizens of the Earth then said to him.-Do not fear. The sins that men commit will affect those only that commit them. For the increase of your wealth, we will give you a fiftieth part of our animals and precious metals and a tenth part of our gain. When our maidens also will become desirous of marrying we shall, when the question of marriage comes up, give you the most beautiful ones among them.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: मुखेन शस्त्रपत्रेण ये मनुष्या: प्रधानतः। भवन्तं तेऽनुयास्यन्ति महेन्द्रमिव देवताः॥
en: Those amongst men who will become the foremost of all in the use of weapons and in riding animals, and other conveyances, shall go behind you like the deities behind Indra.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: स त्वं जातबलो राजा दुष्प्रधर्षः प्रतापवान्। सुखे धास्यसि नः सर्वान् कुबेर इव नैर्ऋतान्॥
en: With your strength increased in this way, and becoming invincible and endued with great power, you will be our king and protect us happily like Kuvera protecting the Yakshas and the Rakshasas.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: यं च धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति प्रजा राज्ञा सुरक्षिताः। चतुर्थं तस्य धर्मस्य त्वत्संस्थं वै भविष्यति॥
en: A fourth part of the merit which men will acquire under your protection will belong to you.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: तेन धर्मेण महता सुखं लब्धेन भावितः। पाह्यस्मान् सर्वतो राजन् देवानिव शतक्रतुः॥
en: Strengthened by that merit so easily acquired by you do you protect us, o king, like Indra of a hundred sacrifices protecting the gods.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: विजयाय हि निर्याहि प्रतपन् रश्मिवानिव। मानं विधम शत्रूणां जयोऽस्तु तव सर्वदा॥
en: Like the Sun burning down everything with his rays, do you set out acquiring victories. Crush the pride of enemies and let righteousness always be victorious (in the world).

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: स निर्ययौ महातेजा बलेन महता वृतः। महाभिजनसम्पन्नस्तेजसा प्रज्वलनिव॥
en: Thus addressed by those denizens of the Earth, Manu, endued with great energy, proceeded, accompanied by a large army-Born of a great family he seemed then to shine with power.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: तस्य दृष्ट्वा महत्त्वं ते महेन्द्रस्येव देवताः। अपतत्रसिरे सर्वे स्वधर्मे च ददुर्मनः॥ ततो महीं परिययौ पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्। शमयन् सर्वतः पापान् स्वकर्मसु च योजयन्॥
en: Seeing the power of Manu, like the gods seeing the might of Indra, the inhabitants of the Earth became stricken with fear and began to follow their respective duties. Manu then went round the world suppressing everywhere all acts of wickedness and compelling all men to follow their respective duties, like a cloud surcharged with rain.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: एवं ये भूतिमिच्छेयुः पृथिव्यां मानवाः क्वचित्। कुर्दू राजानमेवाग्रे प्रजानुग्रहकारणात्॥
en: 'Thus, O Yudhishthira, men on Earth seeking prosperity should first elect and crown a king for the protection of all.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: नमस्येरंश्च तं भक्त्या शिष्या इव गुरुं सदा। देवा इव च देवेन्द्रं तत्र राजानमन्तिके॥
en: Like disciples bowing themselves down before their preceptors or the gods before Indra, all men should humble themselves before the king.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: सत्कृतं स्वजनेनेह परोऽपि बहु मन्यते। स्वजनेन त्ववज्ञातं परे परिभवन्त्युत॥
en: One who is respected by his own people becomes an object of esteem with his enemies also, while one who is disregarded by his own is set at naught by enemies.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: राज्ञः परैः परिभवः सर्वेषामसुखावहः। तस्माच्छत्रं च पत्रं च वासांस्याभरणानि च॥ भोजनान्यथ पानानि राज्ञे दधुर्गृहाणि च। आसनानि च शय्याश्च सर्वोपकरणानि च॥
en: If the king be disregarded by his enemies, all his subjects become unhappy. Therefore, umbrellas, vehicles, external ornaments, foods, drinks, palaces, seats, beds, and all utensils for use and show, should be dedicated to the king.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: गोप्ता तस्माद् दुराधर्षः स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषिता। आभाषितश्च मधुरं प्रत्याभाषेत मानवान्॥
en: By such means, the king will better discharge his duties of protection and become irresistible. He should always smilingly be spoken to by others and he should speak to others sweetly.

description: The principal duties of a kingdom.
sn: कृतज्ञो दृढभक्तिः स्यात् संविभागी जितेन्द्रियः। ईक्षितः प्रतिवीक्षेत मृदु वल्गु च सुष्ठु च॥
en: Grateful, firmly devoted, and with subdued passions, he should give to others their due. Eyed by others, he should look at them mildly, sweetly, and beautifully.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किमाहुर्दैवतं विप्रा राजानं भरतर्षभ। मनुष्याणामधिपतिं तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said 'Why, O foremost of Bharata's race, have the Brahmanas declared that the king, that ruler of men, is a god.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। बृहस्पतिं वसुमना यथा पप्रच्छ भारत।॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old story, O Bharata, of the discourse of Brihaspati and Vasumanas..

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: राजा वसुमना नाम कौसल्यो धीमतां वरः। महर्षि किल पप्रच्छ कृतप्रज्ञं बृहस्पतिम्॥
en: There was a highly intelligent king of Koshala, named Vasumanas. On a certain occasion he questioned the great wise sage Brihaspati.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: सर्वं वैनयिकं कृत्वा विनयज्ञो बृहस्पतिम्। दक्षिणानन्तरो भूत्वा प्रणम्य विधिपूर्वकम्॥ विधिं पप्रच्छ राज्यस्य सर्वलोकहिते रतः। प्रजानां सुखमन्विच्छन् धर्मशीलं बृहस्पतिम्॥
en: Always humble, king Vasumanas ever devoted to well-being of all, having observed the proper humilities, and having gone round the great sage and bowed to him duly enquired of the virtuous Brihaspati about the institutes of a kingdom, actuated by the desire of securing the happiness of men.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: वसुमना उवाच केन भूतानि वर्धन्ते क्षयं गच्छन्ति केन वा। कमर्चन्तो महाप्राज्ञ सुखमव्ययमाप्नुयुः॥ एवं पृष्टो महाप्राज्ञः कौसल्येनामितौजसा। राजसत्कारमव्यग्रं शशंसास्मै बृहस्पतिः॥
en: Vasumanas said By what means do creatures grow and by what are they destroyed? (you of great wisdom, by worshipping whom do they succeed in acquiring eternal happiness. Thus questioned by the highly powerful Koshala king Brihaspati of great wisdom described to him coolly about the regard which should be paid to kings.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: बृहस्पतिरुवाच राजमूलो महाप्राज्ञ धर्मो लोकस्य लक्ष्यते। प्रजा राजभयादेव न खादन्ति परस्परम्॥
en: Brihaspati said The duties of all men, you of great wisdom, originate from the king. It is through fear of the king only that men do not devour one another.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: राजा ह्येवाखिलं लोकं समुदीर्णं समुत्सुकम्। प्रसादयति धर्मेण प्रसाद्य च विराजते॥
en: It is the king who establishes peace on Earth through due observances of duties by checking all disregard for healthy restraints and all kinds of lust. Acquiring this he shines in glory.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: यथा ह्यनुदये राजन् भूतानि शशिसूर्ययोः। अन्धे तमसि मज्जेयुरपश्यन्तः परस्परम्॥ यथा ह्यनुदके मत्स्या निराक्रन्दे विहङ्गमाः। विहरेयुर्यथाकामं विहिंसन्तः पुनः पुनः॥ विमथ्यातिक्रमेरंश्च विषह्यापि परस्परम्। अभावमचिरेणैव गच्छेयुर्नात्र संशयः॥ एवमेव विना राज्ञा विनश्येयुरिमाः प्रजाः। अन्धे तमसि मज्जेयुरगोपाः पशवो यथा॥
en: As, o king, all creatures cannot see one another and sink in utter darkness if the sun and the moon do not rise, as fishes in shallow water and birds in a safe place dart and move about as they please (for a time) and repeatedly attack and grind one another with force and then are destroyed so men sink in utter darkness and meet with destruction if they have no king to protect them like a herd of cattle without the herdsman to take care of them.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: हरेयुर्बलवन्तोऽपि दुर्बलानां परिग्रहान् हन्युक्यच्छमानांश्च यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: If the king did not observe the duty of protection, the strong would by would by force misappropriate the properties of the weak, and if the latter refuse to surrender to them easily their very lives would be taken,

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: ममेदमिति लोकेऽस्मिन् न भवेत् सम्परिग्रहः। न दारा न च पुत्रः स्यान्न धेनं न परिग्रहः।
en: Nobody then, about any of his belongings would be able to say — This is mine.-Wives, sons, food, and other kinds of property, would cease to exist.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: विष्वग्लोपः प्रवर्तेत यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥ ममेदमिति लोकेऽस्मिन् न भवेत् सम्परिग्रहः। यानं वस्त्रमलङ्कारान् रत्नानि विविधानि च।
en: Ruin would befall everything if the king did not observe the duty of protection. Wicked men would by force appropriate the cars, dresses, ornaments, precious stones and other kinds of property belonging to others, if the king did not protect.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: हरेयुः सहसा पापा यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥ पतेद् बहुविधं शस्त्रं बहुधा धर्मचारिषु।
en: In the absence of protection by the king, various kinds of weapons would fall upon righteous persons and unrighteousness would prevail everywhere.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: अधर्मः प्रगृहीतः स्याद् यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥ मातरं पितरं वृद्धमाचार्यमतिथिं गुरुम्।
en: In the absence of king's protection men would disobey or even injure their very parents if aged, their very preceptors, guests and elders.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: क्लि श्नीयुरपि हिंस्युर्वा यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥ वधबन्धपिरक्लेशो नित्यमर्थवतां भवेत्।
en: If the king did not protect, all persons possessing wealth would have to meet with death, imprisonment and persecution and the very idea of property would be lost.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: ममत्वं च न विन्देयुर्यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥ अन्ताश्चाकाल एव स्युर्लोकोऽयं दस्युसाद् भवेत्।
en: If the king did not protect, everything would be destroyed untimely and every part of the country would be laid waste by robbers, and everybody would fall into dreadful hell.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: पतेयुर्नरकं घोरं यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥ न योनिदोषो वर्तेत न कृषिर्न वणिक्पथः। मज्जेद् धर्मस्त्रयी न स्याद् यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: If the king did not protect, all restrictions about marriage and intercourse would disappear; all matters of agriculture and trade would fall into confusion; morality and the three Vedas would disappear.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: न यज्ञाः सम्प्रवर्तेयुर्विधिवत् स्वाप्तदक्षिणाः। न विवाहाः समाजो वा यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: Sacrifices, duly finished with presents according to the ordinance, would no longer be celebrated and no marriage would take place; society itself would cease to exist, if the king did not observe the duty of protection.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: न वृषा: सम्प्रवर्तेरन् न मध्येरंश्च गर्गराः। घोषाः प्रणाशं गच्छेयुर्यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: The bulls would not know cows and milk jars would not be churned, and men living by rearing kine would be ruined, if the king did not exercise the duty of protection.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: त्रस्तमुद्विग्नहृदयं हाहाभूतमचेतनम्। क्षणेन विनशेत् सर्वं यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: In the absence of king's protection, all things, filled with fear and anxiety and becoming senseless and uttering cries of misery would be ruined in no time.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: न संवत्सरसत्राणि तिष्ठेयुरकुतोभयाः। विधिवद् दक्षिणावन्ति यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: No sacrifices extending for a year and finished with presents according to the ordinance would take place if the king did not observe the duty of protection.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: ब्राह्मणाश्चतुरो वेदान् नाधीयोरंस्तपस्विनः। विद्यास्नाता व्रतस्नाता यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: In the absence of king's protection Brahmanas would never study the four Vedas or practise austerities or be purified by knowledge and rigid vows.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: न लभेद् धर्मसंश्लेषं हतविप्रहतो जनः। हर्ता स्वस्थेन्द्रियो गच्छेद् यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: In the absence of king's protection the destroyer of a person guilty of Brahmanicide would not get any reward; rather the person. Guilty of Brahmanicide, would would not be punished. an

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: हस्ताद्धस्तं परिमुषेद् भिद्येरन् सर्वसेतवः। भयार्त विद्रवेत् सर्वं यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: In the absence of king's protection, men would take away other people's wealth from their very hands, and all healthy restrictions would be abolished, and everybody, stricken with, fear would seek safety in flight.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: अनयाः सम्प्रवर्तेरन् भवेद् वै वर्णसंकरः। दुर्भिक्षमाविशेद् राष्ट्रं यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥
en: In the absence of king's protection, all kinds of injustice would commence; intermixture of castes would occur; and famine would devastate the kingdom.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: विवृत्य हि यथाकामं गृहद्वाराणि शेरते। मनुष्या रक्षिता राज्ञा समन्तादकुतोभयाः।॥
en: Again by virtue of royal protection, men can everywhere sleep fearlessly at their ease without shutting their houses and doors with bolts and bars.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: नाक्रुष्टं सहते कश्चित् कुतो वा हस्तलाघवम्। यदि राजा न सम्यग् गां रक्षयत्यपि धार्मिकः॥
en: Nobody would stand the evil words of others far less assaults, if the king did not righteously protect the Earth.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: स्त्रियश्चपुरुषा मार्ग सर्वालङ्कारभूषिताः। निर्भयाः प्रतिपद्यन्ते यदि रक्षति भूमिपः॥
en: If the king observes the duty of protection, women adorned with ornaments may fearlessly walk about everywhere without male relatives to guard them.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: धर्ममेव प्रपद्यन्ते न हिंसन्ति परस्परम्। अनुगृह्णन्ति चान्योन्यं यदा रक्षति भूमिपः॥
en: Men become righteous and without injuring serve one another because the king observes the duty of protection.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: यजन्ते च महायज्ञैस्त्रयो वर्णाः पृथग्विधैः। युक्ताश्चाधीयते विद्यां यदा रक्षति भूमिपः॥
en: By virtue of royal protection the members of the three castes can celebrate high sacrifices and engage themselves in the acquisition of learning with attention.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: वार्तामूलो ह्ययं लोकस्त्रय्या वै धार्य ते सदा। तत् सर्वं वर्तते सम्यग् यदा रक्षति भूमिपः॥
en: The world depends upon agriculture and trade and is protected by the Vedas. All these again are duly protected by the king exercising his principal duty.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: यदा राजा धुरं श्रेष्ठामादाय वहति प्रजाः। महता बलयोगेन तदा लोकः प्रसीदति॥
en: Since the king, taking a heavy burden upon himself, protects his subjects with the help of a mighty force, it is therefore that the people are able to live in happiness.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: यस्याभावेन भूतानामभावः स्यात् समन्ततः। भावे च भावो नित्यं स्यात् कस्तं न प्रतिपूजयेत्॥
en: Who is there who will not worship him on whose existence depends the existence of the people and by whose destruction the people are destroyed?

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: तस्य यो वहते भारं सर्वलोकभयावहम्। तिष्ठन् प्रियहिते राज्ञ उभौ लोकाविमौ जयेत्॥
en: That person who does what is agreeable and beneficial to the king and who participates in the burden of kingly duties which fill every caste with fear, conquers both this and the other world.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: यस्तस्य पुरुषः पापं मनसाप्यनुचिन्तयेत्। असंशयमिह क्लिष्टः प्रेत्यापि नरकं व्रजेत्॥
en: That man who even thinks of injuring the king, forsooth meets with grief here and goes to hell hereafter.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: न हि जात्ववमन्तव्यो मनुष्य इति भूमिपः। महती देवता ह्येषा नररूपेण तिष्ठति॥
en: No one should obey the king by taking him for a man, for he is in sooth a great god in human form.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: कुरुते पञ्चरूपाणि कालयुक्तानि यः सदा। भवत्यग्निस्तथाऽऽदित्यो मृत्युर्वैश्रवणो यमः॥
en: The king puts on five different forms according to five different occasions. He energy the becomes Agni, Aditya, Mrityu, Vaishravana, and Yama.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: यदा ह्यासीदत: पापान् दहत्युग्रेण तेजसा। मिथ्योपचरितो राजा तदा भवति पावकः॥
en: When the king, imposed on by falsehood, consumes with his dreadful offenders before him, he is said to put on the form of Agni.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: यदा पश्यति चारेण सर्वभूतानि भूमिपः। क्षेमं च कृत्वा व्रजति तदा भवति भास्करः॥
en: When he marks through his spies the acts of all persons and does what is for the general behoof, he is said to put on the form of Aditya.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: अशुचीश्च यदा क्रुद्धः क्षिणोति शतशो नरान्। सपुत्रपौत्रान् सामात्यांस्तदा भवति सोऽन्तकः॥
en: When he kills in anger hundreds of wicked men with their sons, grandsons, and relatives, he is then said to put on the form of the Destroyer.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: यदा त्वधार्मिकान् सर्वांस्तीक्ष्णैर्दण्डैनियच्छति। धार्मिकांश्चानुगृह्णाति भवत्यथ यमस्तदा॥
en: When he suppresses the the wicked by punishing them severely and favours the righteous by giving them rewards, he is then said to put on the form of Yama.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: यदा तु धनधाराभिस्तर्पयत्युपकारिणः। आच्छिनत्ति न रत्नानि विविधान्यपकारिणाम्॥ श्रियं ददाति कस्मैचित् कस्माच्चिदपकर्षति। तदा वैश्रवणो राजा लोके भवति भूमिपः॥
en: When he pleases with profuse gifts of riches those who have done him valuable services, and takes away the riches and precious stones of those who have offended him, indeed, when he confers wealth upon some and takes it away from others, he is then, O king, said to put on the form of Kubera on Earth.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: नास्यापवादे स्थातव्यं दक्षेणाक्लिश्कर्मणा। धर्म्यमाकाङ्क्षता लोकमीश्वरस्यानसूयता॥ न हि राज्ञः प्रतीपानि कुर्वन् सुखमवाप्नुयात्। पुत्रो भ्राता वयस्यो वा यद्यप्यात्मसमो भवेत्॥
en: No person which is clever, who is capable of work, who wishes to acquire virtue, and who is shorn of malice, should ever spread evil reports about the king. No person, by acting against the king, can ever make himself happy, even if he be the king's son or brother or companion or one whom the king considers as his second self. Fire, increased by the wind, blazing forth, may leave a residue.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: कुर्यात् कृष्णगतिः : शेषं ज्वलितोऽनिलसारथिः। न तु राजाभिपन्नस्य शेषं क्वचन विद्यते॥
en: The anger of the king, however, leaves not anything to the person who happens to incur it. Everything that belongs to the king should be avoided from a distance.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: तस्य सर्वाणि रक्ष्याणि दूरतः परिवर्जयेत्। मृत्योरिव जुगुप्सेत राजस्वहरणान्नरः॥
en: One should turn away from the king's property as he would from death itself. A person, by taking what belongs to the king, soon meets with destruction like a deer upon touching poison.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: नश्येदभिमृशन् सद्यो मृगः कूटमिव स्पृशन्। आत्मस्वमिव रक्षेत राजस्वमिह बुद्धिमान्॥
en: An intelligent man should protect as his own what belongs to the king.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: महान्तं नरकं घोरमप्रतिष्ठमचेतनम्। पतन्ति चिररात्राय राजवित्तापहारिणः॥
en: Those, who take wealth belonging to the king, sink senseless into a deep hell of eternal darkness and infamy.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: राजा भोजो विराट् सम्राट क्षत्रियो भूपतिर्नृपः। य एभिः स्तूयते शब्दैः कस्तं नार्चितुमर्हति॥
en: Who is there who will not adore the king who is described by terms,–'delighter of the people,' 'bestower of happiness, possessor of prosperity, the best of all, healer of injuries, master of Earth,' and protector of men?

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: तस्माद् बुभूषुर्नियतो जितात्मा नियतेन्द्रियः। मेधावी स्मृतिमान् दक्षः संश्रयेत महीपतिम्॥
en: That man, therefore, who seeks his own prosperity, who satisfies all healthy restraints, who has his soul under control, who has subdued his passions, who is gifted with intelligence and memory, and who is a clever (business man), should always be attached to the king.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: कृतज्ञं प्राज्ञमक्षुद्रं दृढभक्तिं जितेन्द्रियम्। धर्मनित्यं स्थितं नीत्यं मन्त्रिणं पूजयेन्नृपः॥
en: The king should duly honour the minister who is grateful, wise, large-hearted loyal, a master of his senses, virtuous, and observant of the dictates of policy.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: दृढभक्तिं कृतप्रज्ञं धर्मज्ञं संयतेन्द्रियम्। शूरमक्षुद्रकर्माणं निषिद्धजनमाश्रयेत्॥
en: The king should entertain the man who is loyal, grateful, virtuous, self-controlled, brave, noble, and competent to complete works without the help of others.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: राजा प्रगल्भं कुरुते मनुष्यं राजा कृशं वै कुरुते मनुष्यम्। राजाभिपन्नस्य कुतः सुखानि राजाभ्युपेतं सुखिनं करोति॥
en: Knowledge makes men proud. The king makes men humble. The man who is assailed by the king can never enjoy happiness. On the other hand, the man who gets royal favours becomes happy.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: राजा प्रजानां हृदयं गरीये गतिः प्रतिष्ठा सुखमुत्तमं च। समाश्रिता लोकमिमं परं च जयन्ति सम्यक् पुरुषा नरेन्द्र॥
en: The king is the heart of his people; he is their great refuge; he is their glory; and he is their greatest happiness. Those men, O king, who are attached to the king, can conquer both this and the next world.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: नराधिपश्चाप्यनुशिष्य मेदिनी दमेन सत्येन च सौहृदेन। महद्भिरिष्ट्वा क्रतुभिर्महायर्शा स्त्रिविष्टपे स्थानमुपैति शाश्वतम्॥
en: Having governed the Earth with the help of the qualities of self-control, truth, and friendship, and having worshipped the deities by great sacrifices, the king, acquiring great glory, acquires an eternal abode in heaven.

description: The duties of a king; why is he called a god.
sn: स एवमुक्तोऽङ्गिरसा कौसल्यो राजसत्तमः। प्रयत्नात् कृतवान् वीरः प्रजानां परिपालनम्॥
en: That best of kings viz., the heroic Vasumanas, king of Koshala, thus instructed by Brihaspati the son of Angiras, began thenceforth to protect his subjects.'

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पार्थिवेन विशेषेण किं कार्यमवशिष्यते। कथं रक्ष्यो जनपदः कथं जेयाश्च शत्रवः॥
en: Yudhishthira said 'What other special duties remain for the king to satisfy? How should he protect his kingdom and how vanquish his foes.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: कथं चारं प्रयुञ्जीत वर्णान् विश्वासयेत् कथम्। कथं भृत्यान् कथं दारान् कथं पुत्रांश्च भारत॥
en: How should he engage his spies? How should he create confidence in the four orders of his subjects, his own servants, wives, and sons, O Bharata?

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: भीष्म उवाच राजवृत्तं महाराज शृणुष्वावहितोऽखिलम्। यत् कार्यं पार्थिवेनादौ पार्थिवप्रकृतेन वा॥
en: Bhishma said 'Listen, O king, with attention to the various duties of kings,-to those acts which the king or one who is in his position should first do.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: आत्मा जेयः सदा राज्ञा ततो जेयाश्च शत्रवः। अजितात्मा नरपतिविजयेत कथं रिपून्॥
en: The king should first conquer himself and then try to subdue his enemies. He can a king who has not been able to conquer his own self be able to conquer his enemies?

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: एतावानात्मविजयः पञ्चवर्गविनिग्रहः। जितेन्द्रियो नरपतिर्बाधितुं शक्नुयादरी॥
en: The conquest of these, viz., the five objects, is tantamount to the conquest of self. The king who has governed his senses is capable to resist his enemies.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: न्यसेत गुल्मान् दुर्गेषु सन्धौ च कुरुनन्दन। नगरोपवने चैव पुरोद्यानेषु चैव ह॥ संस्थानेषु च सर्वेषु पुरेषु नगरेषु च। मध्ये च नरशार्दूल तथा राजनिवेशने॥
en: He should place infantry in his forts, frontiers, towns, parks, and pleasure gardens, O delighter of the Kurus, as also, in all places where he himself goes, and within his own palace, O foremost of men.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: प्रणिधींश्च ततः कुर्याज्जडान्धबधिराकृतीन्। पुंसः परीक्षितान् प्राज्ञान् क्षुत्पिपासाश्रमक्षयान्॥
en: He should appoint as spies men looking like idiots or like those who are blind and deaf. These should all be well-tried persons who are endued with wisdom, and who are able to bear hunger and thirst.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: अमात्येषु च सर्वेषु मित्रेषु विविधेषु च। पुत्रेषु च महाराज प्रणिदध्यात् समाहितः॥ पुरे जनपदे चैव तथा सामन्तराजसु। यथा न विद्युरन्योन्यं प्रणिधेयास्तथा हि ते॥
en: With proper attention the king should engage his spies to watch the actions of all his counsellors and friends and sons, in his city and the provinces, and in the territories of feudatory chiefs. His spies should be so employed that they may not know one another.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: चारांश्च विद्यात् प्रहितान् पुरेण भरतर्षभ। आपणेषु विहारेषु समाजेषु च भिक्षुषु॥ आरामेषु तथोद्याने पण्डितानां समागमे। देशेषु चत्वरे चैव सभास्वावसथेषु च॥
en: He should also, O foremost of Bharatas, know the spies of his enemies by himself placing spies in shops and places of amusement, amid gatherings of people, among beggars, in his pleasure gardens and parks, in meetings and assemblages of the learned, in the country, in public places, in the court, and in the houses of the citizens.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: एवं विचिनुयाद् राजा परचारं विचक्षणः। चारे हि विदिते पूर्वं हितं भवति पाण्डव॥
en: An intelligent king may thus ascertain the spies sent by his enemies. If these be known, the king may derive iinmense benefit, O son of Pandu.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: यदा तु हीनं नृपतिर्विद्यादात्मानमात्मना। अमात्यैः सह सम्मन्त्र्य कुर्यात् संधि बलीयसा॥
en: When the king, after seeing everything finds himself weak, he should then, consulting with his ministers make peace with a stronger foe.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: अज्ञायमाने हीनत्वे संधिं कुर्यात् परेण वै। लिप्सुर्वा कंचिदेवार्थं त्वरमाणो विचक्षणः॥
en: The wise king should quickly make peace with enemies even when he knows that he is not weak, if he can derive any advantage out of it.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: गुणवन्तो महोत्साहा धर्मज्ञाः साधवश्च ये। संदधीत नृपस्तैश्च राष्ट्र धर्मेण पालयन्॥
en: Engaged in protecting his kingdom piously the king should make peace with accomplished persons capable of great work, virtuous and honest.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: उच्छिद्यमानमात्मानं ज्ञात्वा राजा महामतिः। पूर्वापकारिणो हन्याल्लोकद्विशंश्च सर्वशः॥
en: When the king finds himself overtaken with danger and about to be ruined, he should kill all offenders whom he had overlooked before and all such persons as are marked out by the people.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: यो नोपकर्तुं शक्नोति नोपकर्तुं महीपतिः। न शक्यरूपश्चोद्धर्तुमुपेक्ष्यस्तादृशो भवेत्॥
en: A king should not deal with a person who can neither benefit nor injure him, or with one who cannot save himself from distress,

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: यात्रायां यदि विज्ञातमनाक्रन्दमनन्तरम्। व्यासक्तं च प्रमत्तं च दुर्बलं च विचक्षणः॥ यात्रामाज्ञापयेद् वीरः कल्यः पुष्टबलः सुखी। पूर्वं कृत्वा विधानं च यात्रायां नगरे तथा॥
en: As regards military operations, a king, who knows his own strength, should, commanding a large army cheerfully and courageously give the order to march, without announcing his destination, against one shorn of allies and friends or already at war with another and hence careless or one weaker than himself, having first made arrangements for the protection of his own city.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: न च वश्यो भवेदस्य नृपो यश्चातिवीर्यवान्। हीनश्च बलवीर्याभ्यां कर्षयंस्तत्परो वसेत्॥
en: A king should not for ever live under a more powerful king. Though weak, he should try to assail the stronger and resolved upon this continue to rule his own.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: राष्ट्रं च पीडयेत् तस्य शस्त्राग्निविषमूर्च्छनैः। अमात्यवल्लभानां च विवादास्तस्य कारयेत्॥
en: He should assail the kingdom of the stronger one by neans of weapons fire, and the administering of poison. He should also create dissensions amongst his ministers and servants.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: वर्जनीयं सदा युद्धं राज्यकामेन धीमता। उपायैस्त्रिभिरादानमर्थस्याह बृहस्पतिः॥
en: Brihaspati has said that an intelligent king should always avoid war for the acquisition of territory. The acquisition of territories should be made by the three well-known means (of conciliation, gift, and dissension).

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: सान्त्वेन तु प्रदानेन भेदेन च नराधिप। यदर्थं शक्नुयात् प्राप्तुं तेन तुष्येत पण्डितः॥
en: The wise king should be satisfied with those acquisitions that are made by means of conciliation, gift, and dissension.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: आददीत बलिं चापि प्रजाभ्यः कुरुनन्दन। स षड्भागमपि प्राज्ञस्तासामेवाभिगुप्तये॥
en: The king, O delighter of the Kurus, should take a sixth of the incomes of his subjects as tribute for performing the duties of their protection.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: दशधर्मतेभ्यो यद् वसु बह्वल्पमेव च। तदाददीत सहसा पौराणां रक्षणाय वै॥
en: He should also take away by force the wealth, much or little, of the ten sorts of offenders mentioned in the scriptures, for the protection of his subjects.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: यथा पुत्रास्तथा पौत्रा द्रष्टव्यास्ते न संशयः। भक्तिश्चैषां न कर्तव्या व्यवहारे प्रदर्शिते॥
en: A king should, forsooth, consider his subjects as his own children. In settling their disputes, however, he should not show any mercy.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: श्रोतुं चैव न्यसेद् राजा प्राज्ञान् सर्वार्थदर्शिनः। व्यवहारेषु सततं तत्र राज्यं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: For hearing the charges and defences in judicial suits, the king should always appoint wise persons endued with a knowledge of worldly affairs, for the state really depends upon a proper administration of justice.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: आकरे लवणे शुल्के तरे नागबले तथा। न्यसेदमात्यान् नृपतिः स्वाप्तान् वा पुरुषान् हितान्।।२९
en: The king should appoint honest and trustworthy men to look after his mines, salt, grain, ferries, and elephant corps.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: सम्यग्दण्डधरो नित्यं राजा धर्ममवाप्नुयात्। नृपस्य सततं दण्डः सम्यग् धर्मः प्रशस्यते॥
en: The king, who always judiciously holds the rod of punishment, acquires great merit. The proper regulation of punishment is the great duty of kings and deserves great praise.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: वेदवेदाङ्गवित् प्राज्ञः सुतपस्वी नृपो भवेत्। दानशीलश्च सततं यज्ञशीलश्च भारत॥
en: The king should master the Vedas and their auxiliaries, be possessed of wisdom, engaged in penances, charitable, and devoted to the celebration of sacrifices.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: एते गुणाः समस्ताः स्युपस्य सततं स्थिराः। व्यवहारलोपे नृपतेः कुतः स्वर्गः कुतो यशः॥
en: All these qualities should always be in a king. If the king fails to administer justice, he can neither acquire heaven nor fame.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: यदा तु पीडितो राजा भवेद् राजा बलीयसा। तदाभिसंश्रयेद् दुर्गं बुद्धिमान् पृथिवीपतिः॥
en: If a king be attacked by a stronger one, the former, if intelligent, should seek refuge in a fort.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: विधावाक्रम्य मित्राणि विधानमुपकल्पयेत्। सामभेदान् विरोधार्थं विधानमुपकल्पयेत्॥
en: Collecting his friends for consultation, he should devise proper means. Adopting the policy of conciliation and of creating dissensions, he should devise means for fighting with the assailants.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: घोषान् न्यसेत मार्गेषु ग्रामानुत्थापयेदपि। प्रवेशयेच्च तान् सर्वान् शाखानगरकेष्वपि॥
en: He should place the inhabitants of the woods on the high roads, and, it, necessary, cause whole villages to be removed, removing all the inhabitants of minor towns or on the outskirts of great cities.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: ये गुप्ताश्चैव दुर्गाश्च देशास्तेषु प्रवेशयेत्। धनिनो बलमुख्यांश्च सान्त्वयित्वा पुनः पुनः॥
en: Giving repeated assurances to his wealthy subjects and the principal officers of the army, he should make the dwellers of the open country to take refuge in well-protected forts.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: शस्याभिहारं कुर्याच्च स्वयमेव नराधिपः। असम्भवे प्रवेशस्य दहेद् दावाग्निना भृशम्॥
en: He should deposit all sorts of grain in his forts. If that is impossible, he should destroy them completely by fire.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: क्षेत्रस्थेषु च सस्येषु शत्रोरुपजयेन्नरान्। विनाशयेद् वा तत् सर्वं बलेनाथ स्वकेन वा॥
en: He should engage men for destroying the crops on the fields of the enemy. Failing to do this, he should destroy those crops to do this, he should destroy those crops by means of his own men.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: नदीमार्गेषु च तथा संक्रमानवसादयेत्। जलं विस्त्रावयेत् सर्वमविस्त्राव्यं च दूषयेत्॥
en: He should destroying all the bridges over the rivers in his kingdom. He should draw out the waters of all the tanks in his territories, or, if incapable to do so, cause them to be poisoned.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: तदात्वेनायतीभिश्च निवसेद् भूम्यनन्तरम्। प्रतीघातं परस्याजौ मित्रकार्येऽप्युपस्थिते।॥
en: Disregarding the duty of protecting his friends, he should, considering present and future circumstances, seek the protection of another king who may happen to be the foe of his foe and who may be capable to fight with his enemy on the field of battle.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: दुर्गाणां चाभितो राजा मूलच्छेदं प्रकारयेत्। सर्वेषां क्षुद्रवृक्षाणां चैत्यवृक्षान् विवर्जयेत्॥
en: He should demolish all the minor forts in his kingdom. He should also cut down all the smaller trees except those called Chaitya.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: प्रवृद्धानां च वृक्षाणां शाखां प्रच्छेदयेत् तथा। चैत्यानां सर्वथा त्याज्यमपि पत्रस्य पातनम्॥
en: He should cause the branches of all large threes to be cut off, but he should not touch the very leaves of Chaitya ones.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: प्रगण्डीः कारयेत् सम्यगाकाशजननीस्तदा। आपूरयेच्च परिखां स्थाणुनक्रझषाकुलाम्॥
en: He should erect outer ramparts round his forts, and fill his trenches with water, putting pointed stakes at their bottom and filling them with crocodiles and sharks.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: संकटद्वारकाणि स्युरुच्छ्वासार्थं पुरस्य च। तेषां च द्वारवद् गुप्तिः कार्या सर्वात्मना भवेत्॥
en: He should keep small outlets in his walls for firing guns from his fort, and carefully make arrangements for their defence like that of the greater gates.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: द्वारेषु च गुरूण्येव यन्त्राणि स्थापयेत् सदा। आरोपयेच्छतघ्नीश्च स्वाधीनानि च कारयेत्॥
en: In all his gates he should place destructive engines. He should place on ramparts Shataghnis and other weapons.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: काष्ठानि चाभिहार्याणि तथा कूपांश्च खानयेत्। संशोधयेत् तथा कूपान् कृतपूर्वान् पयोऽर्थिभिः॥
en: He should lay by wood for fuel and dig and repair wells for supply of water to the garrison.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: तृणच्छन्नानि वेश्मानि पङ्केनाथ प्रलेपयेत्। निहरेच्च तृणं मासि चैत्रे वह्निभयात् तथा॥
en: He should have all houses made of grass and straw plastered over with mud, and if it is summer, he should, from fear of fire, collect in a safe place all the stores of grass and straw.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: नक्तमेव च भक्तानि पाचयेत नराधिपः। न दिवा ज्वालयेदग्निं वर्जयित्वाऽऽग्निहोत्रिकम्॥
en: He should order all food to be cooked at night. No fire should be lighted during the day, except for the daily Homa.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: कर्मारारिश्शालासु ज्वलेदग्निः सुरक्षितः। गृहाणि च प्रवेश्यान्तर्विधेयः स्याद्भुताशनः॥
en: Particular care should be taken of the fires lighted in smitheries and lying-in chambers. Fires in the houses of the inhabitants should be well covered.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: महादण्डश्च तस्य स्याद् यस्याग्निवै दिवा भवेत्। प्रघोषयेदथैवं च रक्षणार्थं पुरस्य च॥
en: For the better protection of the city, it should be announced that a person, lighting fires in the day time, will be sufficiently punished.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: भिक्षुकांश्चाक्रिकांश्चैव क्लीवोन्मत्तान् कुशीलवान्। बाह्यान् कुर्यान्नरश्रेष्ठ दोषाय स्युर्हि तेऽन्यथा॥
en: During such times, all beggars, cartmen, eunuchs, lunatics, should, O foremost of men, be driven out of the town, for if they are allowed to remain, evil will come.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: चत्वरेष्वथ तीर्थेषु सभास्वावसथेषु च। यथार्थवर्णं प्रणिधिं कुर्यात् सर्वस्य पार्थिवः॥
en: In places of public resort, in Tirthas, in assemblies and in the houses of the citizens, the king should keep capable spies.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: विशालान् राजमार्गाश्च कारयीत नराधिपः। प्रपाश्च विपणांश्चैव यथोद्देशं समाविशेत्॥
en: The king should have wide roads constructed, and open up shops, and places for the distribution of water, at proper stations.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: भाण्डागारायुधागारान् योधागारांश्च सर्वशः। अश्वागारान् गजागारान् बलाधिकरणानि च॥ परिखाश्चैव कौरव्य प्रतोलीनिष्कुटानि च। न जात्वन्यः प्रपश्येत मुह्यमेतद् युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Shops of necessary articles, arsenals, camps and quarters for soldiers, stables for horses and elephants, encampments, of soldiers, trenches, streets and lanes, houses and pleasure gardens should be so made that their situations may not be known to others, O Yudhishthira.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: अर्थसंनिचयं कुर्याद् राजा परबलार्दितः। तैलं वसा मधु घृतमौषधानि च सर्वशः॥
en: A king, who is attacked by a hostile army, should collect wealth, and store oil and fat and honey, and clarified butter, and medicines of all sorts,

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: अङ्गारकुशमुजानां पलाशशरवर्णिनाम्। यवसेन्धनादिग्धानां कारयीत च संचयान्॥ आयुधानां च सर्वेषां शक्त्य॒श्विासवर्मणाम्। संचयानेवमादीनां कारयीत नराधिपः॥
en: And charcoal and munja grass, leaves, arrows, scribes and draftsmen, grass, fuel, poisoned arrows, weapons of all sorts such as darts, swords, lances and others, The king should store such articles.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: औषधानि च सर्वाणि मूलानि च फलानि च। चतुर्विधांश्च वैद्यान् वै संगृह्णीयाद् विशेषतः॥ नटांश्च नर्तकांश्चैव मल्लान् मायाविनस्तथा। शोभयेयुः पुरवरं मोदयेयुश्च सर्वशः॥
en: He should especially keep ready various drugs, roots and fruits, the four kinds of physicians, actors and dancers, athletes, and persons capable of assuming various disguises. He should adorn his capital and please all his subjects.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: यतः शङ्का भवेच्चापि भृत्यतोऽथापि मन्त्रितः। पौरेभ्यो नृपतेर्वापि स्वाधीनान् कारयीत तान्॥
en: The king should speedily subjugate such persons as may cause fear, be they his servants or counsellors or citizens or neighbouring kings.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: कृते कर्मणि राजेन्द्र पूजयेद् धनसंचयैः। दानेन च यथार्हेण सान्त्वेन विविधेन च॥
en: Whenever any of his work is done the king should reward those who have helped in its accomplishment with wealth and other becoming presents and grateful speeches.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: निर्वेदयित्वा तु परं हत्वा वा कुरुनन्दन। ततोऽनृणो भवेद् राजा यथा शास्त्रे निदर्शितम्॥
en: It has been laid down in the scriptures, O delighter of the Kurus, that a king satisfies his debt when he defeats his foe or kills him at once.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: राज्ञा सप्तैव रक्ष्याणि तानि चैव निबोध मे। आत्मामात्याश्च कोशाश्च दण्डो मित्राणि चैव हि॥ तथा जनपदाश्चैव पुरं च कुरुनन्दन। एतत् सप्तात्मकं राज्यं परिपाल्यं प्रयत्नतः॥
en: A king should take care of seven things. Listen to me as I name them. They are his own self, his ministers, his treasury, his servants for inflicting punishments, his friends, his provinces, and his capital. He should carefully protect his kingdom consisting of these seven limbs.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: पाङ्गद्धण्यं त्रिवर्गं च त्रिवर्गपरमं तथा। यो वेत्ति पुरुषव्याघ्र स भुक्कते पृथिवीमिमाम्॥
en: That king, O foremost of man, who is conversant with the collection of six and three objects, and the high collection of three, gains the sovereignty of the whole Earth.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: पाड्गुण्यमिति यत् प्रोक्तं तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर। संधानासनमित्येव यात्रासंधानमेव च॥ विगृह्यासनमित्येव यात्रां सम्परिगृह्य च। द्वैधीभावस्तथान्येषां संश्रयोऽथ परस्य च॥
en: Hear, O Yudhishthira, what is called the aggregate of six. They are ruling peacefully after making a treaty (with the foe), marching to battle, creating disunion among the enemy, concentration of army for filling the enemy with fear, preparation for war with readiness for peace, and alliances with others.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: त्रिवर्गश्चापि यः प्रोक्तस्तमिहैकमनाः शृणु। क्षयः स्थानं च वृद्धिश्च त्रिवर्गः परमस्तथा॥ धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च सेवितव्योऽथ कालतः। धर्मेण च महीपालश्चिरं पालयते महीम्॥
en: Listen now with attention to what are the triple objects. They are decrease, maintenance of what is, and growth. The great three fold objects consist of religion, Profit and Pleasure. These should be followed judiciously. By the help of religion a king succeeds in ruling the Earth for ever.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: अस्मिन्नर्थे च श्लोकौ द्वौ गीतावङ्गिरसा स्वयम्। यादवीपुत्र भद्रं ते तावपि श्रोतुमर्हसि॥
en: Regarding this matter, Angirasa's son Brihaspati himself has recited two verses. Blessed be you, O son of Devaki, you should

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: कृत्वा सर्वाणि कार्याणि सम्यक् सम्पाल्य मेदिनीम्। पालयित्वा तथा पौरान् परत्र सुखमेधते॥
en: 'Having satisfied all his duties and having protected the Earth, and having also protected the cities, a king enjoys great happiness in heaven.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: किं तस्य तपसा राज्ञः किं च तस्याध्वरैरपि। सुपालितप्रजो यः स्यात् सर्वधर्मविदेव सः॥
en: Of what use are penances to that king, and what need has he of sacrifices who protects his people properly? Such a king should be known as one conversant with every virtue.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच दण्डनीतिश्च राजा च समस्तौ तावुभावपि। कस्य किं कुर्वतः सिद्ध्येत् तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said There is the science of punishment; there is the king, and there are the subjects. Tell me, O grandfather, what advantage is derived by one of those from the others.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: भीष्म उवाच महाभाग्यं दण्डनीत्याः सिद्धः शब्दैः सहेतुकैः। शृणु मे शंसतो राजन् यथावदिह भारत॥
en: Bhishma said Listen to me, O king, as I describe, O Bharata, the great virtues of the science of punishment in weighty and sacred words.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: दण्डनीतिः स्वधर्मेभ्यश्चातुर्वण्र्यं नियच्छति। प्रयुक्ता स्वामिना सम्यगधर्मेभ्यो नियच्छति॥
en: The science of punishment compels all men to satisfy the duties of their respective orders. Properly administered, it compels people to perform virtuous acts.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: चातुर्वर्ण्य स्वकर्मस्थे मर्यादानामसंकरे। दण्डनीतिकृते क्षेमे प्रजानामकुतोभये॥ स्वाम्ये प्रयत्नं कुर्वन्ति त्रयो वर्णा यथाविधि। तस्मादेव मनुष्याणां सुखं विद्धि समाहितम्॥
en: When the four orders perform their respective duties, when all healthy restrictions are kept up, when peace and happiness emanate from the science of punishment when the people are shorn of all fear, and the three higher orders try according to their respective duties, to preserve harmony people become truly happy at such times.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: कालो वा कारणं राज्ञो राजा वा कालकारणम्। इति ते संशयो मा भूद् राजा कालस्य कारणम्।।७९।
en: You should not doubt whether it is the king that makes the age, or, it is the age that makes the king; the truth is that the king makes the age.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: दण्डनीत्यां यदा राजा सम्यक् कात्स्न्येन वर्तते। तदा कृतयुगं नाम कालसृष्टं प्रवर्तते॥
en: When the king rules depending entirely on the science of punishment the foremost of ages called Krita is then said flourish.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: ततः कृतयुगे धर्मो नाधर्मो विद्यते क्वचित्। सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां नाधर्मे रमते मनः॥
en: Righteousness prevails in the Krita age. Nothing unrighteous exists then; the four orders are not inclined to take any pleasure in unrighteousness.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: योगक्षेमाः प्रवर्तन्ते प्रजानां नात्र संशयः। वैदिकानि च सर्वाणि भवन्त्यपि गुणान्युत॥
en: Forsooth, all men succeed in acquiring the objects they seek and preserving those that have been acquired. All the Vedic rites yield merit.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: ऋतवश्च सुखाः सर्वे भवन्त्युत निरामयाः। प्रसीदन्ति नराणां च स्वरवर्णमनांसि च॥
en: All the seasons are delightful and free from evil. The voice pronunciation, and minds of all men became clear and delightful.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: व्याधयो न भवन्त्यत्र नाल्पायुर्दृश्यते नरः। विधवा न भवन्त्यत्र कृपणो न तु जायते॥
en: Ailments disappear and all men enjoy long lives. Wives do not become widows, and no person becomes a miser.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी भवन्त्योषधयस्तथा। त्वक्पत्रफलमूलानि वीर्यवन्ति भवन्ति च॥
en: The Earth yield crops without being cultivated and herbs and plants grow abundantly. Barks, leaves, fruits, and roots, become strong and profuse.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: नाधर्मो विद्यते तत्र धर्म एव तु केवलम्। इति कार्तयुगानेतान् धर्मान् विद्धि युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: No unrighteousness is seen. Nothing but righteousness exists. These are the characteristics, O Yudhishthira, of the Krita.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: दण्डनीत्यां यदा राजा त्रीनंशाननुवर्तते। चतुर्थमंशमुत्सृज्य तदा त्रेता प्रवर्तते॥
en: When the king depends upon only three of the four parts of the science of punishment leaving out a fourth, the age called Treta sets in.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: अशुभस्य चतुर्थांशस्त्रीनंशाननुवर्तते। कृष्टपच्यैव पृथिवी भवन्त्योषधयस्तथा॥
en: A fourth part of unrighteousness sets in by the observance of the great science by threefourths. The Earth gives crops but waits for cultivation; the herbs and plants grow by cultivation.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: अर्धं त्यक्त्वा यदा राजा नीत्यर्धमनुवर्तते। ततस्तु द्वापरं नाम स कालः सम्प्रवर्तते॥
en: When the king follows the great science by only a half, leaving out the other half, then the age that sets in is called Dvapara.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: अशुभस्य यदा त्वधं द्वावंशावनुवर्तते। कृष्टपच्यैव पृथिवी भवत्यर्धफला तथा॥
en: A half of unrighteousness follows the observance of the great science by half. The Earth yields crops by half and that even by tillage.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: दण्डनीतिं परित्यज्य यदा कात्स्येन भूमिपः। प्रजाः क्लिश्नात्ययोगेन प्रवर्तेत तदा कलिः॥
en: When the king, leaving aside the great science altogether, oppresses his subjects by all manner and means the age that sets in is called Kali.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: कलावधर्मो भूयिष्ठं धर्मो भवति न क्वचित्। सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां स्वधर्माच्च्यवते मनः॥
en: During the age called Kali, unrighteousness assumes the full proportion and nothing of righteousness is seen. The hearts of men of all the orders, are disinclined to their respective duties.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: शूद्रा भैक्षेण जीवन्ति ब्राह्मणाः परिचर्यया। योगक्षेमस्य नाशश्च वर्तते वर्णसंकरः॥
en: Shudras live by adopting lives of mendicancy, and Brahmanas live by serving others. Men cannot acquire the objects they seek and preserve those already acquired. Intermixture of the four castes takes place.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: वैदिकानि च कर्माणि भवन्ति विगुणान्युत। ऋतवो न सुखाः सर्वे भवन्त्यामयिनस्तथा॥
en: Vedic rites fail to yield fruits. All the seasons eases to the delightful and visited by evils.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: ह्रसन्ति च मनुष्याणां स्वरवर्णमनांस्युत। व्याधयश्च भवन्त्यत्र म्रियन्ते च गतायुषः॥
en: The voice, pronunciation, and minds of men lose power. Diseases appear, and men die untimely.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: विधवाश्च भवन्त्यत्र नृशंसा जायते प्रजा। क्व चिद् वर्षति पर्जन्यः क्वचित् सस्यं प्ररोहति॥
en: Wives become widows, and many cruel men appear; the clouds do not rain in seasons and crops fail.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: रसाः सर्वे क्षयं यान्ति यदा नेच्छति भूमियः। प्रजाः संरक्षितुं सम्यग् दण्डनीतिसमाहितः॥
en: All kinds of moisture also fail, when the king does not, by duly following the great science, protect the subjects.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: राजा कृतयुगस्रष्टा त्रेताया द्वापरस्य च। युगस्य च चतुर्थस्य राजा भवति कारणम्॥
en: The king is the creator of the Krita age, of the Treta, and of the Dvapara. The king is the creator of the fourth age (called Kali).

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: कृतस्य करणाद् राजा स्वर्गमत्यन्तमश्नुते। त्रेतायाः करणाद् राजा स्वर्गं नात्यन्तमश्नुते॥
en: If he creates the Krita age, he acquires eternal heaven. If he creates the Treta age, he acquires heaven for a limited period.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: प्रवर्तनाद् द्वापरस्य यथाभागमुपाश्नुते। कलेः प्रवर्तनाद् राजा पापमत्यन्तमश्नुते॥
en: If he creates the Dvapara, he attains to blessedness in heaven in proportion to his merits. By creating the Kali age, the king incurs a heavy sin.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: ततो वसति दुष्कर्मा नरके शाश्वतीः समाः। प्रजानां कल्मषे मग्नोऽकीर्तिं पापं च विन्दति॥
en: Sullied by wickedness, he suffers in hell for numberless years, for being drowned in the sins of his subjects, he incurs great sin and infamy himself.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: दण्डनीतिं पुरस्कृत्य विजानन् क्षत्रियः सदा। अनवाप्तं च लिप्सेत लब्धं च परिपालयेत्॥
en: Following the great science the learned Kshatriya should try to acquire those objects which he seeks and protect those which he has already acquired.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: लोकस्य सीमन्तकरी मर्यादा लोकभाविनी। सम्यड्नीता दण्डनीतिर्यथा माता यथा पिता॥
en: The science of punishment, which establishes all men in the observance of their respective duties, which is the basis of all healthy distinctions, and which truly keeps up the world and sets it agoing if properly administered, protects all men like parents protecting their children.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: यस्यां भवन्ति भूतानि तद् विद्धि मनुजर्षभ। एष एव परो धर्मो यद् राजा दण्डनीतिमान्॥
en: Know, O foremost of men, that the very lives of creatures depend upon it. The greatest merit of a king consists in his acquaintance with the science of punishment and administering it properly.

description: The duties of a king, further described.
sn: तस्मात् कौरव्य धर्मेण प्रजा: पालय नीतिमान्। एवंवृत्तः प्रजा रक्षन् स्वर्ग जेतासि दुर्जयम्॥
en: Therefore, O you of Kuru's race, protect your subjects righteously, with the help of that great science. By protecting your subjects and adopting such a conduct, you will, forsooth, attain to such blessedness in heaven which cannot be easily acquired.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच केन वृत्तेन वृत्तज्ञ वर्तमानो महीपतिः। सुखेनार्थान् सुखोदर्कानिह च प्रेत्य चाप्नुयात्॥
en: Yudhishthira said By following what conduct, O you who are a master of every kind of behaviour, can a king succeed in easily acquiring, both in this world and in the next, objects which yield happiness in the end?

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: भीष्म उवाच अयं गुणानां षट्त्रिंशत्पट्त्रिंशद्गुणसंयुतः। यान् गुणांस्तु गुणोपेतः कुर्वन् गुणमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Bhishma said There are thirty-six virtues which a king should practise. There are another thirty-six related with these.. A virtuous person, by following these virtues, can certainly acquire great merit.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: रेद् धर्मानकटुको मुञ्चेत् स्नेहं न चास्तिकः। अनृशंसश्चरेदर्थं चरेत् काममनुद्धतः॥
en: The king should follow his duties without any malice. He should not cast off mercy. He should have faith. He should earn wealth without persecution and cruelty. He should seek pleasure without attachment.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: प्रियं ब्रूयादकृपणः शूरः स्यादविकत्थनः। दाता नापात्रवर्षी स्यात् प्रगल्भः स्यादनिष्ठुरः॥
en: He should cheerfully speak out what is pleasant, and be brave without brag. He should be liberal, but should not make gifts to unworthy persons. He should exercise power without cruelty.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: संदधीत न चानायैर्विगृह्णीयान्न बन्धुभिः। नाभक्तं चारयेच्चारं कुर्यात् कार्यमपीडया॥
en: He should make alliances, but not with the wicked. He should not act inimically towards his friends. He should never employ persons who are not devoted to him as his spies and secret emissaries. He should never accomplish his works by oppression.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: अर्थं ब्रूयान्न चासत्सु गुणान् ब्रूयान्न चात्मनः। आदद्यान्न च साधुभ्यो नासत्पुरुषमाश्रयेत्॥
en: He should never give out his purposes before the wicked persons. He should speak of the merits of others but never his own. He should take money from his subjects but never from those who are good. He should never take the assistance of wicked persons.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: नापरीक्ष्य नयेद् दण्डं न च मन्त्रं प्रकाशयेत्। विसृजेन्न च लुब्धेभ्यो विश्वसेन्नापकारिषु॥
en: He should never inflict punishment without making careful enquiry. He should never give out his counsels. He should distribute money, but not amongst covetous persons. He should place confidence in others, but never in those who have injured him.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: अनीर्षुर्गुप्तदारः स्याच्चोक्षः स्यादघृणी नृपः। स्त्रियः सेवेत नात्यर्थं मृष्टं भुञ्जीत नाहितम्॥
en: He should not entertain malice. He should protect his married wives. He should be pure and should not always be exercised by compassion. He should not seek too much female companionship. He should take wholesome food and never that which is bad.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: अस्तब्धः पूजयेन्मान्यान् गुरून् सेवेदमायया। अर्चेद् देवानदम्भेन श्रियमिच्छेदकुत्सिताम्॥
en: He should without pride pay respect to worthy persons, and serve his preceptors and seniors with sincerity. He should seek prosperity, but never do anything that brings calumny.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: सेवेत प्रणयं हित्वा दक्षः स्यान्न त्वकालवित्। सान्त्वयेन च मोक्षाय अनुगृह्णन्न चाक्षिपेत्॥
en: He should serve his elders with humility. He should be clever in business but should always wait for the opportune moment. He should solace men and never send them away with empty words. Having favoured a person, he should not case him off.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: प्रहरेन्न त्वविज्ञाय हत्वा शत्रून् न शोचयेत्। क्रोधं कुर्यान्न चाकस्मान्मृदुः स्यान्नापकारिषु॥
en: He should never strike in ignorance. Having killed his enemy he should never be sorry. He should display anger, but should never do so when there is no occasion. He should be mild, but never to the offenders.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: एवं चरस्व राज्यस्थो यदि श्रेय इहेच्छसि। अतोऽन्यथा नरपतिर्भयमृच्छत्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: Behave thus while ruling your kingdom if you wish to enjoy prosperity. The king that behaves otherwise is visited by great calamities.

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: इति सर्वान् गुणानेतान् यथोक्तान् योऽनुवर्तते। अनुभूयेह भद्राणि प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते॥
en: That king, who observes all these virtues that I have mentioned, enjoys many blessings of Earth and great rewards in heaven.'

description: The thirty-six virtues of a king.
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच इदं वचः शान्तनवस्य शुश्रुवान् युधिष्ठिरः पाण्डवमुख्यसंवृतः। तदा ववन्दे च पितामहं नृपो यथोक्तमेतच्च चकार बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words of Shantanu's son, king Yudhishthira, always obedient in receiving instructions, endued with great intelligence, and protected by Bhima and others, then adored his grandfather and from that time began to rule according to his dictates.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं राजा प्रजा रक्षन्नाधिबन्धेन युज्यते। धर्मेण नापराध्नोति तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, how should the king protect his subjects so as to be able to avoid grief and so as not to militate against fairness?

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: भीष्म उवाच समासेनैव ते राजन् धर्मान् वक्ष्यामि शाश्वतान्। विस्तरेणैव धर्माणां न जात्वन्तमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Bhishma said-'I shall recite in brief, O king, those eternal duties, for, if I were to mentioned them fully, I would never finish them.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: धर्मनिष्ठाश्रुतवतो वेदव्रतसमाहितान्। अर्चयित्वा यजेथास्त्वं गृहे गुणवतो द्विजान्॥
en: You should always worship those Brahmanas who are ardent in the performance of their duties, are learned, regular in adoring the gods, observant of high vows, and gifted with other accomplishments, when they come to your mansion, engage them in officiating in your sacrifices.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: प्रत्युत्थायोपसंगृह्य चरणावभिवाद्य च। अथ सर्वाणि कुर्वीथाः कार्याणि सपुरोहितः॥
en: With your priest accompanying you, you should rise up when they approach you, and touch and adore their feet, and do every other necessary act.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: धर्मकार्याणि निर्वर्त्य मङ्गलानि प्रयुज्य च। ब्राह्मणान् वाचयेथास्त्वमर्थसिद्धिजयाशिषः॥
en: Doing these acts of piety and performing other acts that are for your own well-being, you should (by presents) make those Brahmanas utter benedictions on you for the success of your object.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: आर्जवेन च सम्पन्नो धृत्या बुद्ध्या च भारत। यथार्थं प्रतिगृह्णीयात् कामक्रोधौ च वर्जयेत्॥
en: Gifted with sincerity, wisdom and intelligence, O Bharata, you should follow truth and avoid lust and anger.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: कामक्रोधौ पुरस्कृत्य योऽर्थं रजानुतिष्ठति। न स धर्मं न चाप्यर्थं प्रतिगृह्णाति बालिशः॥
en: That foolish king, who pursues Profit without being shorn of lust and anger, fails to win virtue and ultimately losses Profit as well.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: मा स्म लुब्धांश्च मूल्श्च च प्रयूयुजः। अलुब्धान् बुद्धिसम्पन्नान् सर्वकर्मसु योजयेत्॥
en: Never appoint persons covetous and foolish in matters of Pleasure and profit. You should always appointmen who are free from covetousness and intelligent.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: मूर्यो ह्यधिकृतोऽर्थेषु कार्याणामविशारदः। प्रजाः क्लिश्नात्ययोगेन कामक्रोधसमन्वितः॥
en: Possessed of lust and anger and raw in the transaction of business, foolish persons, if vested with power in matters of Profit, always oppress the people by various mischievous means,

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: बलिषष्ठेन शुल्केन दण्डेनाथापराधिनाम्। शास्त्रानीतेन लिप्सेथा वेतनेन धनागमम्॥
en: With a sixth part, making a fair calculation of the produce of the soil, as his tribute, with fines and forfeitures collected from offenders, with the other taxes, according to the scriptures, upon merchants and traders in exchange for the safety granted to them, a king should fill his treasury.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: दापयित्वा कर धऱ्या राष्ट्र नीत्या यथाविधि। तथैतं कल्पयेद् राजा योगक्षेममतन्द्रितः॥
en: Realising these just taxes and governing the kingdom properly, the king should carefully act in such a way that his subjects may not suffer from want.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: गोपायितारं दातारं धर्मनित्यमतन्द्रितम्। अकामद्वेषसंयुक्तमनुरज्यन्ति मानवाः॥
en: Men become deeply attached to that king who satisfies the duty of protection properly, who is liberal, who is steady in the observance of righteousness, who is vigilant, and who is shorn of lust and hate.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: मा स्माधर्मेण लोभेन लिप्सेथास्त्वं धनागमम्। धर्मार्थावध्रुवौ तस्य यो न शास्त्रपरो भवेत्॥
en: Never desire to fill your treasury by acting unfairly or from covetousness. That king who does not follow the scriptures fails to acquire riches and religious merit.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: अपशास्त्रपरो राजा धर्मार्थान्नाधिगच्छति। अस्थाने चास्य तद् वित्तं सर्वमेव विनश्यति॥
en: That king, who is negligent about the means of acquiring riches, never succeeds in acquiring both religious merit and wealth. The wealth again that he acquires (by such means) is spent lavishly on unworthy objects.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: अर्थमूलोऽपि हिंसां च कुरुते स्वयमात्मनः। करैरशास्त्रदृष्टैर्हि मोहात् सम्पीडयन् प्रजाः॥
en: That avaricious king, who foolishly oppresses his subjects by levying taxes not sanctioned by scriptures, is said to wrong his own self.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: ऊपश्छिन्द्यात् तु यो धेन्वाः क्षीरार्थी न लभेत् पयः। एवं राष्ट्रमयोगेन पीडितं न विवर्धते॥
en: As a person wanting milk never gets any by cutting off the udders of a cow, similarly a kingdom, assailed by improper taxes, never gives any profit to the king.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: यो हि दोग्ध्रीमुपास्ते च स नित्यं विन्दते पयः। एव राष्ट्रमुपायेन भुञ्जानो लभते फलम्॥
en: He, who treats a milch cow with kindness, always obtains milk from it. Likewise the king, who rules his kingdom by proper means, gets much fruits from it.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: अथ राष्ट्रमुपायेन भुज्यमानं सुरक्षितम्। जनयत्यतुलां नित्यं कोशवृद्धिं युधिष्ठिर॥
en: By protecting a kingdom properly and ruling it judiciously a king, O Yudhishthira, may succeed in always acquiring immense wealth.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: दोग्ध्री धान्यं हिरण्यं च मही राज्ञा सुरक्षिता। नित्यं स्वेभ्यः परेभ्यश्च तृप्ता माता यथा पयः॥
en: The Earth, well protected by the king, yields crops and gold like a mother giving milk willingly to her child.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: मालाकारोपमो राजन् भव माऽऽङ्गारिकोपमः। तथायुक्तश्चिरं राज्यं भोक्तं शक्ष्यसि पालयन्॥
en: Follow the example, O king, of the flower vendor and not of the charcoalmaker. Acting thus and satisfying the duty of protection you may be able to enjoy the Earth for ever.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: परचक्राभियानेन यदि ते स्याद् धनक्षयः। अथ साम्नैव लिप्सेथा धनमब्राह्मणेषु यत्॥
en: If in attacking an enemy's kingdom your treasury is exhausted, you may replenish it by taking wealth from all except Brahmanas.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: मा स्म ते ब्राह्मणं दृष्ट्वा धनस्थं प्रचलेन्मनः। अन्त्यायामप्यवस्थायां किमु स्फीतस्य भारत।॥
en: Your heart should not be agitated even when you are in great distress, upon seeing Brahmanas having wealth. I need not mention then of what you should do when you are well off.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: धनानि तेभ्यो दद्यास्त्वं यथाशक्ति यथार्हतः। सान्त्वयन् परिरक्षश्च स्वर्गमाप्स्यसि दुर्जयम्॥
en: You should give them wealth to the best of your power and according to their worthiness, and protect them, comforting them at all times. By acting thus you may acquire regions which are acquired with difficulty.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: एवं धर्मेण वृत्तेन प्रजास्त्वं परिपालय। स्वन्तं पुण्यं यशो नित्यं प्राप्स्यसे कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Behaving thus virtuously you should protect your subjects. You may then acquire, O delighter of the Kurus, fame that is eternal, high, and pure.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: धर्मेण व्यवहारेण प्रजाः पालय पाण्डव। युधिष्ठिर यथा युक्तो नाधिबन्धेन योक्ष्यसे।॥
en: Protect your subjects piously, O son of Pandu, for you will then suffer no regret or pain.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: एष एव परो धर्मो यद् राजा रक्षति प्रजाः। भूतानां हि यथा धर्मो रक्षणं परमा दया॥
en: Protection of the subject is the greatest duty of the king, since mercy for all creatures and protecting them from injury has been said to be the highest merit.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: तस्मादेवं परं धर्मं मन्यन्ते धर्मकोविदाः। यो राजा रक्षणे युक्तो भूतेषु कुरुते दयाम्॥
en: Persons, conversant with duties, consider that to be the greatest merit of the king, when, engaged in protecting all creatures, he shows mercy towards them.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: यदह्ना कुरुते पापमरक्षन् भयतः प्रजाः। राजा वर्षसहस्रेण तस्यान्तमधिगच्छति॥
en: The sin, a king incurs by neglecting for a single day to protect his subjects from fear, is such that his sufferings are not terminated in hell till after a thousand years.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: यदह्ना कुरुते धर्मं प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्। दशवर्षसहस्राणि तस्य भुक्ते फलं दिवि॥
en: The merit, of a king by protecting his subjects righteously for a single day, is such that he enjoys its reward in heaven for ten thousand years.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: स्विष्टिः स्वधीतिः सुतपा लोकाञ्जयति यावतः। क्षणेन तानवाप्नोति प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्॥
en: A king, by only protecting his subjects virtuously, soon gains those regions that are acquired by persons leading duly the Garhasthya, the Brahmacharya, and the Vanaprastha modes of life.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: एवं धर्मं प्रयत्नेन कौन्तेय परिपालय। ततः पुण्यफलं लब्ध्वा नाधिबधेन योक्ष्यसे॥ स्वर्गलोके सुमहतीं श्रियं प्राप्स्यसि पाण्डव।
en: Do you, O son of Kunti, follow with great care this duty (of protection). You will then obtain the reward of righteousness and suffer no grief and pain. You shall,, O son of Pandu, obtain great prosperity in heaven.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: असम्भवश्च धर्माणामीदृशानामराजसु॥ तस्माद् राजैव नान्योऽस्ति यो धर्मफलमाप्नुयात्।
en: Persons who are not kings do not gain merit like this. A person, therefore, who is a king, and no other can earn such rewards of virtue.

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: स राज्यं धृतिमान् प्राप्य धर्मेण परिपालय। इन्द्रं तर्पय सोमेन कामैश्च सुहृदो जनान्॥
en: Endued with intelligence, you have obtained a kingdom. Do you protect your subjects righteously. Please Indra with offerings of Soma and your friends and wellwishers with the objects they desire for.'

description: How should a king protect his subjects.
sn: स राज्यं धृतिमान् प्राप्य धर्मेण परिपालय। इन्द्रं तर्पय सोमेन कामैश्च सुहृदो जनान्॥
en: Endued with intelligence, you have obtained a kingdom. Do you protect your subjects righteously. Please Indra with offerings of Soma and your friends and wellwishers with the objects they desire for.'

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: भीष्म उवाच य एव तु सतो रक्षेदसतश्च निवर्तयेत्। स एव राज्ञः कर्तव्यो राजन् राजपुरोहितः॥
en: Bhishma said A king should appoint that person as his priest who would protect the good and punish the wicked.

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। पुरूरवस ऐलस्य संवादं मातरिश्वनः॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old story about the discourse between Pururavas the son of Aila and Matarishvan.

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: पुरूरवा उवाच कुत:स्विद् ब्राह्मणो जातो वर्णाश्चापि कुतस्त्रयः। कस्माच्च भवति श्रेष्ठस्तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Pururavas said Whence has the Brahmana originated and whence the three other orders? Why also has the Brahmana become the foremost? You should tell me all this.

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: मातरिश्वोवाच ब्राह्मणो मुखतः सृष्टो ब्रह्मणो राजसत्तम। बाहुभ्यां क्षत्रियः सृष्ट ऊरुभ्यां वैश्य एव च।॥
en: Matarishvan answered The Brahmana. O best of kings, has originated from the mouth of Brahman. The Kshatriya has originated from his two arms, and the Vaishya from his two thighs.

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: वर्णानां परिचर्यार्थं त्रयाणां भरतर्षभ। वर्णश्चतुर्थः पश्चात् तु पद्भ्यां शूद्रो विनिर्मितः॥
en: For serving these three orders, O king, a fourth order, viz., the Shudra, came into being created from the feet (of Brahman).

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: ब्राह्मणो जायमानो हि पृथिव्यामनुजायते। ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां धर्मकोशस्य गुप्तये॥
en: Thus created the Brahmana is born on Earth as the lord of all creatures, his duty being to preserve the Vedas and the other scriptures.

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: अतः पृथिव्या यन्तारं क्षत्रियं दण्डधारिणम्। द्वितीयं वर्णमकरोत् प्रजानामनुगुप्तये॥
en: Then, for ruling the Earth and holding the rod of punishment and protecting all creatures, the second order, viz., the Kshatriya was created.

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: वैश्यस्तु धनधान्येन त्रीन् वर्णान् विध्यादिमान्। शूद्रो ह्येतान् परिचरेदिति ब्रह्मानुशासनम्॥ ऐल उवाच
en: The Vaishya was created for supporting the two other orders and himself by cultivation and trade, and finally it was ordained by Brahman that the Shudra should serve the three orders as a servant.

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: द्विजस्य क्षत्रबन्धोर्वा कस्येयं पृथिवी भवेत्। : सह वित्तेन सम्यग् वायो प्रचक्ष्व मे॥
en: Pururavas said Tell me, truly, O god of Wind, to whom does this Earth fairly belong, Does it belong to the Brahmana or to the Kshatriya.

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: वायुरुवाच विप्रस्य सर्वमेवैतद् यत् किञ्चिज्जगतीगतम्। ज्येष्ठेनाभिजनेनेह तद्धर्मकुशला विदुः॥
en: The god of Wind said Everything that exists in the universe belongs to the Brahmana on account of his birth and precedence. Persons, conversant with morality, declare it.

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: धर्मतः सह स्वमेव ब्राह्मणो भुक्ते स्वं वस्ते स्वं ददाति च। गुरुर्हि सर्ववर्णानां ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठश्च वै द्विजः॥
en: What the Brahmana eats is his own. The place he dwells is his own. What he gives away is his own. He deserves the respect of all the (other) orders. He is the first-born and the foremost.

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: पत्यभावे यथैव स्त्री देवरं कुरुते पतिम्। एष ते प्रथमः कल्प आपद्यन्यो भवेत् ततः॥
en: As a woman, in the absence of her husband, marries his younger brother, even so the Earth, for the refusal of the Brahmana, has accepted his next-born, viz., the Kshatriya, for her master. This is the first rule. In times, however, of distress, there is exception of this.

description: The divine right of the king. How should he appoint a priest
sn: यदि स्वर्ग परं स्थानं स्वधर्मं परिमार्गसि। यत् किञ्चिज्जयसे भूमिं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदया॥ श्रुतवृत्तोपपन्नाय धर्मज्ञाय तपस्विने। स्वधर्मपरितृप्ताय यो न वित्तपरो भवेत्॥
