He should select a third from among recluses in the forests, and a fourth from among those living in his tributary kingdoms.

description: The description of the city in which a king should live.
sn: तेषु सत्कारमानाभ्यां संविभागांश्च कारयेत्। परराष्ट्राटवीस्थेषु यथा स्वविषये तथा॥
en: He should treat them hospitably and honour them and assign them the means of maintenance. He should treat the ascetics living in the kingdoms of enemies in the forests in the same way as those that live in his own kingdom.

description: The description of the city in which a king should live.
sn: ते कस्याञ्चिदवस्थायां शरणं शरणार्थिने। राज्ञे दधुर्यथाकामं तापसाः संशितव्रताः॥
en: Engaged in penances and of rigid vows, they would, if calamity befalls the king and if he prays for protection, grant him what he wants.

description: The description of the city in which a king should live.
sn: एष ते लक्षणोद्देशः संक्षेपेण प्रकीर्तितः। यादृशे नगरे राजा स्वयमावस्तुमर्हति॥
en: I have now told you briefly the characteristics of the city in which the king should live.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच राष्ट्रगुप्तिं च मे राजन् राष्ट्रस्यैव तु संग्रहम्। सम्यग्जिज्ञासमानाय प्रब्रूहि भरतर्षभ॥
en: Yudhishthira said How, O king, may a kingdom be firmly established, and how should it be protected? I wish to know this. Tell me all this, O foremost of Bharata's race.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: भीष्म उवाच राष्ट्रगुप्तिं च सम्यग् राष्ट्रस्यैव तु संग्रहम्। हन्त सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि तत्त्वमेकमनाः शृणु॥ ते
en: Bhishma said 'Listen to me with close attention. I shall tell you how a kingdom may be consolidated, and how also it may be protected.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: ग्रामस्याधिपतिः कार्यो दशग्राम्यास्तथा परः। द्विगुणायाः शतस्यैवं सहस्रस्य च कारयेत्॥
en: A headman should be selected for each village. Over ten villages (or ten headmen) one superintendent should be appointed. Over two such superintendents there should be one officer. Above the latter should be appointed persons under each of whom should be a hundred villages; and above the last kind of officers, should be appointed men each of whom should given a thousand villages.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: ग्रामीयान् ग्रामदोषांश्च ग्रामिकः प्रतिभावयेत्। तान् ब्रूयाद् दशपायासौ स तु विंशतिपाय वै॥
en: The headman should determine the characteristics of every person in the village and all the crimes also that demand punishment. He should report everything to the officer in charge of ten villages. The latter, again, should report the same to the officer in charge of twenty villages.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: सोऽपि विंशत्यधिपतिर्वृत्तं जानपदे जने। ग्रामाणां शतपालाय सर्वमेव निवेदयेत्॥
en: The latter, again, should report the conduct of all the persons with in his province to the officer in charge of a hundred villages.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: यानि ग्राम्याणि भोज्यानि ग्रामिकस्तान्युपाश्रियात्। दशपस्तेन भर्तव्यस्तेनापि द्विगुणाधिपः॥
en: The village headman should control over all the produce and the properties of the village. Every headman should contribute his quota for maintaining the chief of ten villages, and the laiter should do the same for maintaining the chief of twenty villages.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: ग्रामं ग्रामशताध्यक्षो भोक्तुमर्हति सत्कृतः। महान्तं भरतश्रेष्ठ सुस्फीतं जनसंकुलम्॥
en: The lord of a hundred villages should receive all honours from the king and should have for his support a large village, O chief of the Bharatas, populous and rich.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: तत्र होनकपायत्तं राज्ञो भवति भारत। शाखानगरमर्हस्तु सहस्रपतिरुत्तमः॥
en: Such a village, so given to a lord of a hundred villages, should be, however, with the jurisdiction of the chief of a thousand villages. That high officer, again, viz., the lord of a thousand villages, should have a small town for his support.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: धान्यहैरण्यभोगेन भोक्तुं राष्ट्रियसङ्गतः। तेषां संग्रामकृत्यं स्याद् ग्रामकृत्यं च तेषु यत्॥
en: He should use for his ownself the grain and gold and other things derivable from it. He should perform all the duties relating to its wars and manage all its other internal affairs.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: धर्मज्ञः सचिवः कश्चित् तत् तत्पश्येदतन्द्रितः। नगरे नगरे वा स्यादेकः सर्वार्थचिन्तकः॥
en: Some pious minister, should carefully supervise the administrative affairs and mutual relations of those officers. In every town, again, there should be an officer for looking after all matters relating to his jurisdiction.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: उच्चैः स्थाने घोररूपो नक्षत्राणामिव ग्रहः। भवेत् स तान् परिक्रामेत् सर्वानेव सभासदः॥
en: Like some dreadful planet moving above all the asterisms below, the last mentioned officer should move and act above all the officers subordinate to him. Such an officer should learn the conduct of those under him through his spies.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: तेषां वृत्तिं परिणयेत् कश्चिद् राष्ट्रेषु तच्चरः। जिघांसवः पापकामाः परस्वादायिनः शठाः॥
en: Such high officers should protect the people from all persons having murderous inclination, all wicked men, all robbers, and all cheats, and all of whom are regarded to be possessed by the devil.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: रक्षाभ्यधिकृता नाम तेभ्यो रक्षेदिमाः प्रजाः। विक्रयं क्रयमध्वानं भक्तं च सपरिच्छदम्॥
en: Looking after sales and the purchases, the state of the roads, the food and dress, and the stocks and profits, and the traders, the king should impose taxes on them.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: योगक्षेमं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य वणिजां कारयेत् करान्। उत्पत्तिं दानवृत्तिं च शिल्पं सम्प्रेक्ष्य चासकृत्॥ शिल्पं प्रति करानेवं शिल्पिनः प्रति कारयेत्।
en: Knowing every time the quantity of the manufacturers, the receipts and expenses of the manufacturers, and the state of the arts, the king should levy taxes upon the artisans regarding the arts they follow.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: उच्चावचकरा दाप्या महाराज्ञा युधिष्ठिर॥ यथा यथा न सीदेरंस्तथा कुर्यान्महीपतिः।
en: The king, O Yudhishthira, may levy high taxes, but he should never levy such taxes as would oppress his people.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: फलं कर्म च सम्प्रेक्ष्य ततः सर्वं प्रकल्पयेत्॥ फलं कर्म च निर्हेतु न कश्चित् सम्प्रवर्तते।
en: No tax should be levied without determining the out-turn and the amount of labour necessary for its production. Nobody would work without sufficient causes.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: यथा राजा च कर्ता च स्यातां कर्मणि भागिनौ॥ संवेक्ष्य तु तथा राज्ञा प्रणेयाः सततं कराः।
en: The king should, after proper thought, impose taxes in such a way that he and the person who labours to produce the article taxed may both partake of the out-turn.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: नोच्छिन्द्यादात्मानो मूलं परेषां चापि तृष्णया॥ ईहाद्वाराणि संस्थ्य राजा सम्प्रीतदर्शनः।
en: The king should not, by his greediness, destroy his own foundations as well as those of others. He should always avoid those acts for which he may incur the hatred of his people. Indeed, by acting thus he may win popularity.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: प्रद्विषन्ति परिख्यातं राजानमतिखादिनम्॥ प्रद्विष्टस्य कुतः श्रेयो नाप्रियो लभते फलम्।
en: The subjects hate that king who becomes notorious for greediness. How can a king who is hated acquire prosperity? Such a king can never secure what is for his well-being.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: वत्सौपम्येन दोग्धव्यं राष्ट्रमक्षीणबुद्धिना॥ भृतो वत्सो जातबल: पीडां सहति भारत।
en: An intelligent king should milk his kingdom like calves. If the calf be permitted to suck, it grows strong, O Bharata, and carries heavy loads.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: न कर्म कुरुते वत्सो भृशं दुग्धो युधिष्ठिर॥ राष्ट्रमप्यतिदुग्धं हि न कर्म कुरुते महत्।
en: If, on the other hand, O Yudhishthira, the cow is milked too much, the calf becomes lean and incapable of making itself very useful to its owner. Similarly, if the kingdom be drained inordinately, the subjects become helpless and incapable of achieving any great act.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: यो राष्ट्रमनुगृह्णाति परिरक्षन् स्वयं नृपः॥ संजातमुपजीवन् स लभते सुमहत् फलम्।
en: That king who protects his kingdom himself and shows leniency to his subjects and supports himself upon what is easily got, succeeds in doing much.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: आपदर्थं च निर्यातं धनं त्विह विवर्धयेत्॥ राष्ट्रं च कोशभूतं स्यात् कोशो वेश्मगतस्तथा।
en: Does not the king then acquire wealth enough to meet his wants? The entire kingdom becomes then to him his treasury, and his treasury becomes his bed room.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: पौरजानपदान् सर्वान् संश्रितोपाश्रितांस्तथा। यथाशक्त्यनुकम्पेत सर्वान् स्वल्पधनानपि॥
en: If the denizens of the cities and the provinces be poor, the king should, whether they depend upon him directly or indirectly, show them mercy to the best of his power.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: बाह्यं जनं भेदयित्वा भोक्तव्यो मध्यमः सुखम्। एवं नास्य प्रकुप्यन्ति जनाः सुखितदुःखिताः॥
en: Punishing all robbers who infest the boundaries, the king should protect the people of his villages and make them happy. Partaking of the king's happiness and misery, the subjects become greatly pleased with him.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: प्रागेव तु धनादानमनुभाष्य ततः पुनः। संनिपत्य स्वविषये भयं राष्ट्र प्रदर्शयेत्॥
en: First of all, for making collection, the king should visit the principal centres of his kingdom one after another and try to fill his people with fear.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: इयमापत्समुत्पन्ना परचक्रभयं महत्। अपि चान्ताय कल्पन्ते वेणोरिव फलागमाः॥
en: He should tell them, Here, a great danger threatens us. Our enemies have engendered a great calamity for us! I have every reason, however, to hope that the danger will pass away, for the enemy, like a flowering bamboo, will very soon be destroyed.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: अरयो मे समुत्थाय बहुभिर्दस्युभिः सह। इदमात्मवधायैव राष्ट्रमिच्छन्ति बाधितुम्॥
en: Many enemies of mine, having risen up and combined with a large body of robbers, wish to put our kingdom into difficulties, for themselves being destroyed.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: अस्यामापदि घोरायां सम्प्राप्ते दारुणे भये। परित्राणाय भवतः प्रार्थयिष्ये धनानि वः॥
en: To meet this calamity and dreadful danger, I seek your wealth for concerting measures for your protection

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: प्रतिदास्ये च भवतां सर्वं चाहं भयक्षये। नारयः प्रतिदास्यन्ति यद्धरेयुर्बलादितः॥
en: When the danger passes away, I will repay you what I now take. Our foes, however, will not return what they (if unopposed) will take from you by force.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: कलत्रमादितः कृत्वा सर्वं वो विनशेदिति। अपि चेत् पुत्रदारार्थमर्थसंचय इष्यते॥
en: On the other hand, they will even kill all your relatives with your very wives. Forsooth, you wish wealth for the sake of your children and wives.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: नन्दामि वः प्रभावेण पुत्राणामिव चोदये। यथाशक्त्युपगृह्णामि राष्ट्रस्यापीडया च वः॥
en: I am happy to see your prosperity, and I solicit you as I would my own children. I shall take from you what you can easily spare for me. I do not wish to give pain to any one.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: आपत्स्वेव च वोढव्यं भवद्भिः पुणवैरिव। न च प्रियतरं कार्यं धनं कस्याञ्चिदापदि॥
en: In seasons of danger, you should, like strong bulls, bear such burdens. In seasons of distress, you should not value wealth too highly.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: इति वाचा मधुरया श्लक्ष्णया सोपचारया। स्वरश्मीनभ्यवसृजेद् योगमाधाय कालवित्॥
en: A king knowing Time should, with such agreeable, sweet, and complimentary words, send his agents and make collections from his subjects.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: प्राकारं भृत्यभरणं व्ययं संग्रामतो भयम्। योगक्षेमं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य गोंमिनः कारयेत् करम्॥
en: Pointing out to them the necessity of repairing his forts and of meeting the expenses of his establishment and other heads, striking them with the fear of foreign invasion, and pointing to them the necessity that exists for protecting them and enabling them to ensure the means of living in peace, the king should impose taxes upon the Vaishyas of his kingdom.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: उपेक्षिता हि नश्येयुर्गोमिनोऽरण्यवासिनः। तस्मात् तेषु विशेषेण मृदुपूर्वं समाचरेत्॥
en: If the king does not care the Vaishyas, they become lost to him, and leaving his dominions retire into the woods. The king should, therefore, treat them leniently.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: सान्त्वनं रक्षणं दानमवस्था चाप्यभीक्ष्णशः। गोमिनां पार्थ कर्तव्यः संविभागः प्रियाणि च॥
en: The king, O son of Pritha, should always conciliate and protect the Vaishyas, take measures for filling them with a sense of security and for ensuring them in the enjoyment of what they possess, and always do what they like.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: अजस्त्रमुपयोक्तव्यं फलं गोमिषु भारत। प्रभावयन्ति राष्ट्रं च व्यवहारं कृषि तथा॥
en: The king, O Bharata, should always so treat the Vaishyas that their power to multiply money may be enhanced. The Vaishyas enhance the strength of a kingdom, improve its agriculture, and develop its trade.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: तस्माद् गोमिषु यत्नेन प्रीतिं कुर्याद् विचक्षणः। दयावानप्रमत्तश्च करान् सम्प्रणयन् मृदून्॥
en: A wise king, therefore, should always please them. Acting with carefulness and leniency, he should impose mild taxes upon them.

description: How a kingdom should be protected
sn: सर्वत्र क्षेमचरणं सुलभं नाम गोमिषु। न ह्यतः सदृशं किंचिद् वरमस्ति युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: It is always easy to treat the Vaishyas kindly. There is nothing which does greater good to a kingdom, O. Yudhishthira, than such treatment of the Vaishyas of the kingdom.'

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यदा राजा समर्थोऽपि कोशार्थी स्यान्महामते। कथं प्रवर्तेत तदा तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Tell me, O grandfather, how should the king behave if, despite his great wealth, he seeks more!

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: भीष्म उवाच यथादेशं यथाकालं यथाबुद्धि यथाबलम्। अनुशिष्यात् प्रजा राजा धर्मार्थी तद्धिते रतः॥
en: Bhishma said A king desirous of acquiring religious merit, should seek the good of his subjects and protect them according to considerations of place and time and to the best of his intelligence and power.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: यथा तासां च मन्येत श्रेय आत्मन एव च। तथा कर्माणि सर्वाणि राजा राष्ट्रेषु वर्तयेत्॥
en: He should, in his kingdom, adopt such measures as would in his view secure their good as also his own.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: मधुदोहं दुहेद् राष्ट्र भ्रमरा इव पादपम्। वत्सापेक्षी दुहेच्चैव स्तनांश्च न विकुट्टयेत्॥
en: A king should milk his kingdom like a bee collecting honey from plants. He should act like the cow-herd who takes milk from her without boring her udders and without starving the calf.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: जलौकावत् पिबेद् राष्ट्र मृदुनैव नराधिपः। व्याघ्रीव च हरेत् पुत्रान् संदशेन्न च पीडयेत्॥
en: The king should act like the leech taking blood mildly. He should treat his subjects like a tigress carrying her cubs, touching them with her teeth but never cutting them therewith.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: यथा शल्यकवानाखुः पदं धूनयते सदा। अतीक्ष्णेनाभ्युपायेन तथा राष्ट्र समापिबेत्॥
en: He should behave like a mouse which although has got sharp and pointed teeth yet cuts the feet of sleeping animals in such a way that they do not at all become conscious of it.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: अल्पेनाल्पेन देयेन वर्धमानं प्रदापयेत्। ततो भूयस्ततो भूयः क्रमवृद्धिं समाचरेत्॥
en: Little by little should be drained from a prosperous subject. The demand should then be gradually increased till it reaches a fair amount.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: दमयत्रिव दम्यानि शश्वद् भारं विवर्धयेत्। मृदुपूर्व प्रयत्नेन पाशानभ्यवहारयेत्॥
en: The king should increase the burden of his subjects by and by like a person gradually increasing the load of a young bullock. Treating them with care and mildness, he should at last put the reins on them.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: सकृत्पाशावकीर्णास्ते न भविष्यन्ति दुर्दमाः। उचितेनैव भोक्तव्यास्ते भविष्यन्ति यत्नतः॥
en: If the reins are thus put, they would not refuse to to bear them. Indeed, sufficient measures should be taken for making them obedient. Mere entreaties to bring them to subjection would be of no avail.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: तस्मात् सर्वसमारम्भो दुर्लभः पुरुषं प्रति। यथामुख्यान सान्त्वयित्वा भोक्तव्य इतरो जनः॥
en: It is impossible to treat all equally. Conciliating the leaders only, the ordinary people should be reduced to obedience.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: ततस्तान् भेदयित्वा तु परस्परविवक्षितान्। भुजीत सान्त्वयंश्चैव यथासुखमयत्नतः॥
en: Creating dissensions among the common people who are to carry the burdens, the king should himself come forward to conciliate them and then enjoy happily what he would draw from them.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: न चास्था ने न चाकाले करांस्तेभ्यो निपातयेत्। आनुपूर्वेण सान्त्वेन यथाकालं यथाविधि॥
en: The king should never impose taxes in a bad form and on persons who cannot pay them. He should impose them gradually and with mildness, in proper time and according to due forms.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: उपायान् प्रब्रवीम्येतान् न मे माया विवक्षिता। अनुपायेन दमयन् प्रकोपयति वाजिनः॥
en: The ways I suggest you are the legitimate means of king craft. They are not known as deceitful means. One who tries to control horses by unfair methods only makes them furious.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: पानागारनिवेशाच वेश्याः प्रापणिकास्तथा। कुशीलवाः सकितवा ये चान्ये केचिदीदृशाः॥ नियम्याः सर्व एवैते ये राष्ट्रस्योपघातकाः। एते राष्ट्रेऽभितिष्ठन्तो बाधन्ते भद्रिकाः प्रजाः॥
en: Drinking-shops, public women, pimps, actors, gamblers, and keepers of gambling houses, and other persons, of this sort, who always create disorders to the states, should all be checked. Living within the kingdom, these afflict and injure the better classes of the subjects.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: न केनचिद् याचितव्यः कश्चित्किञ्चिदनापदि। इति व्यवस्था भूतानां पुरस्तान्मनुना कृता॥
en: No one should ask anything of any one when on distress prevails. Manu himself in days of yore has laid down this injunction regarding all men.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: सर्वे तथानुजीवेयुर्न कुर्युः कर्म चेदिह। सर्व एव इमे लोका न भवेयुरसंशयम्॥
en: If all men were to live on alms and abstain from work, the world would, forsooth, come to an end.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: प्रभुर्नियमने राजा य एतान् न नियच्छति। भुक्कते स तस्य पापस्य चतुर्भागपिति श्रुतिः॥
en: The king alone is able to restrain and check. That king who does not prevent his subjects (from committing sins) is visited by a fourth part of the sins committed by them. This is the injunction of the Shrutis.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: भोक्ता तस्य तु पापस्य सुकृतस्य यथा तथा। नियन्तव्याः सदा राज्ञा पापा ये स्युनराधिप॥
en: Since the king shares the sins of his subjects like their merits, he should, therefore, O king, check his sinful subjects.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: कृतपापस्त्वसौ राजा य एतान् न नियच्छति। तथा कृतस्य धर्मस्र चतुर्भागमुपारनुते॥
en: The king who fails to restrain himself commits a sin. He is visited by a fourth part of their sins as he does acquire a fourth part of their merits.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: स्थानान्येतानि संयम्य प्रसंगो भूतिनाशनः। कामे प्रसक्तः पुरुषः किमकार्यं विवर्जयेत्॥
en: The following sins of which I speak should be checked. they are such as bring on penury on every one. What wicked act is there that a person under the influence of passion would not commit.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: मद्यमांसपरस्वानि तथा दारा धनानि च। आहरेद् रागवशगस्तथा शास्त्रं प्रदर्शयेत्॥
en: A person under the control of passion indulges in stimulants and meat, and appropriates the wives and the wealth of other people, and sets a bad example to others.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: आपद्येव त याचन्ते येषां नास्ति परिग्रहः। दातव्यं धर्मतस्तेभ्यस्त्वनुक्रोशाद् भयान तु॥
en: They who do not live upon alms may beg at the time of distress. The righteous king should make gifts to them from mercy but not from fear.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: मा ते राष्ट्रे याचनका भूवनमा चापि दस्यवः। एषां दातार एवैते नैते भूतस्य भावकाः॥
en: Let there be no beggars or robbers in your kingdom. It is only the robbers who give to the beggars. Such givers are not benefactors of men.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: ये भूतान्यनुगृह्णन्ति वर्धयन्ति च ये प्रजाः। ते ते राष्ट्रेषु वर्तन्त मा भूतानामभावकाः॥
en: Let such men live in your kingdom as advance the interests of others and do them good, but not such as root out others.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: दण्ड्यास्ते च महाराज धनादानप्रयोजकाः। प्रयोगं कारयेयुस्तान् यथाबलिकरांस्तथा॥
en: Those officers, O king, who realize from the subjects more than what is due should be punished. You should then appoint others who will take only what is due.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं यच्चान्यत् किंचिदीदृशम्। पुरुषैः कारयेत् कर्म बहुभिः कर्मभेदतः॥
en: Agriculture, tending of cattle trade and similar other acts, should be pursued by many persons in such a way that tey may not suffer injury.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: नरश्चेत्कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं चाप्यनुष्ठितः। संशयं लभते किंचित् तेन राजा विगीते॥
en: If a person engaged in agriculture, cattletending, or trade, feels a sense of insecurity, the king, incirs infamy thereby.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: धनिनः पूजयेन्नित्यं पानाच्छादनभोजनैः। वक्तव्य.शानुगृह्णीध्वं प्रजाः सह मयेति वै॥
en: The king should always honour his rich su.bjects and should say to them,-Do you, with me, advance the interests of the people!

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: अङ्गमेतन्महद् राज्ये धनिनो नाम भारत। ककुदं सर्वभूतानां धनस्थो नात्र संशयः॥
en: In every kingdom, the wealthy form an estate in the realm. Forsooth, a wealthy person is the foremost of men.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: प्राज्ञः शूरो धनस्थश्च स्वामी धार्मिक एव च। तपस्वी सत्यवादी च बुद्धिमांश्चापि रक्षति॥
en: He who is wise, or brave or rich. a influential, or righteous, or engaged in penances or truthful in speech, or endued with intelligence, assists in protecting his fellowsubjects,

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: तस्मात् सर्वेषु भूतेषु प्रीतिमान् भव पार्थिव सत्यमार्जवमक्रोधमानृशस्यं च पालय॥
en: For these reasons, O king, do you love all creatures, and show the qualities of truth, creatures, and show the qualities of truth, men. sincerity, absence of anger and abstention from injury.

description: How should a king collect money from his subjects
sn: एवं दण्डं च कोशं च मित्रं भूमि च लप्स्यसि। सत्यार्जवपरो राजन् मित्रकोशबलान्वितः॥
en: You should thus hold the rod of punishment, and multiply your treasury. and support your friends and consolidate your kingdom thus, practising the qualities of truthfulness and sincerity and supported by your friends, treasury, and army. sincerity, absence of anger and abstention from injury.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: भीष्म उवाच वनस्पतीन् भक्ष्यफलान्न च्छिन्द्युर्विषये तव। ब्राह्मणानां मूलफलं धर्म्यमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: Bhishma said “Let not fruit growing trees be cut down in your dominions. Fruits and roots are the property of the Brahmanas. The sages have declared this as an injunction of religion.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: ब्राह्मणेभ्योऽतिरिक्तं च भुञ्जीरनितरे जनाः। न ब्राह्मणापराधेन हरेदन्यः कथंचन॥
en: The residue, after supporting the Brahmanas, should be devoted to the support of other people, Nobody should take by inuring the Brahmanas.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: विप्रश्चेत् त्यागमातिष्ठेदात्मार्थे वृत्तिकर्शितः। परिकल्प्यास्य वृत्तिः स्यात् सदारस्य नराधिप॥
en: If a Brahmana, for want of support, wishes to leave a kingdom for securing maintenance elsewhere, the king, O monarch, should, with love and respect, give him the means of sustenance.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: स चेन्नोपनिवर्तेत वाच्यो ब्राह्मणसंसदि। कस्मिन्निदानी मर्यादामयं लोकः करिष्यति॥
en: If he does not still abstain from leaving the kingdom, the king should repair to a concourse of Brahmanas and say-Such a Brahmana is leaving the kingdom. In whom shall my subjects then find an authority for guiding them?

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: असंशयं निवर्तेत न चेद् वक्ष्यत्यतः परम्। पूर्वं परोक्षं कर्तव्यमेतत् कौन्तेय शाश्वतम्॥
en: If alter this, he does not renounce his intention of leaving, and does not say anything, the king should say to him-Forget the past!—This, O son of Kunti, is the eternal way of the royal duty.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: आहुरेतज्जना नित्यं न चैतच्छ्रद्दधाम्यहम्। निमन्त्र्यश्च भवेद् भोगैरवृत्त्या च तदाचरेत्॥
en: The king should further say to him,-Indeed, O Brahmana, people say that only that which is sufficient should be assigned to a Brahmana to maintain him. I, however, do not hold that opinion. On the other hand, I think that if a Brahmana seeks to abandon a kingdom for the king neglecting to provide him with means of support, such means should be assigned to him, and, further, if he wishes to take that step for procuring the means of luxury, he should still be requested to stay and supplied with those luxuries.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं लोकानामिह जीवनम्। ऊर्ध्वं चैव त्रयी विद्या सा भूतान् भावयत्युत।॥
en: Agriculture, cattle-tending, and trade, suppiy all men with the means of subsistence. A knowledge of the Vedas, however, supply them with the means of acquiring heaven.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: तस्यां प्रवर्तमानायां ये स्युस्तत्परिपन्थिनः। दस्यवस्तद्वधायेह ब्रह्मा क्षत्रमथावृजत्॥
en: They, therefore, that impede the study of the Vedas and the Vedic practices, are known as enemies of society. For exterminating these that Brahman created Kshatriyas.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: शत्रून् जय प्रजा रक्ष यजस्व ऋतुधिर्नृप। युध्यस्व समरे वीरो भूत्वा कौरवनन्दन॥
en: Subdue your foes, protect your subjects, adore the gods in sacrifices, and fight battles bravely, O delighter of the Kurus!

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: संरक्ष्यान् पालयेद् राजा स राजा राजसत्तमः। ये केचित् तान् न रक्षन्ति तैरर्थो नास्ति कश्चन॥
en: A king should protect those who are worthy of protection. The king who does this is the best of rulers. Those kings who do not perform the duty of protection live uselessly.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: सदैव राज्ञा योद्धव्यं सर्वलोकाद् युधिष्ठिर। तस्माद्धेतोर्हि युञ्जीत मनुष्यानेव मानवः॥
en: For the behoof of all his subjects the king should always seek to learn the acts and thoughts of all, O Yudhishthira; and for the reason he should engage spies and secret agents.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: आन्तरेभ्यः परान् रक्षन् परेभ्यः पुनरान्तरान्। परान् परेभ्यः स्वान् स्वेभ्यः सर्वान् पालय नित्यदा॥१२
en: Protecting others from your own, and your own from others, as also others from others, and your own from your own, do you always maintain your subjects.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: आत्मानं सर्वतो रक्षन् राजन् रक्षस्व मेदिनीम्। आत्ममूलमिदं सर्वमाहुवै विदुषो जनाः॥
en: Guarding his own self first from every one, the king should protect the Earth. Men of knowledge have said that everything originate from self.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: किं छिद्रं को नु सङ्गो मे किं वास्त्यविनिपातितम्। कुतो मामाश्रयेद् दोष इंति नित्यं विचिन्तयेत्॥
en: The king should always think of these, viz.,-What are his shortcomings to what evil habits he is addicted, what are the sources of his weakness, and what are the sources of his follies.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: अतीतदिवसे वृत्तं प्रशंसन्ति न वा पुनः। गुप्तैश्चारैरनुमतैः पृथिवीमनुसारयेत्॥
en: The king should make secret and trusted agents travel through the kingdom for ascertaining whether his conduct of the previous day has, or has not, met with the approbation of the subjects.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: जानीयुर्यदि ते वृत्तं प्रशंसन्ति न वा पुनः। कच्चिद् रोचेज्जनपदे कच्चिद् राष्ट्रे च मे यशः॥ धर्मज्ञानां धृतिमतां संग्रामेष्वपलायिनाम्।
en: Indeed, he should know whether his conduct is or is not, generally applauded, or is, or is not, liked by the people of the provinces, and whether he has, or has not, succeeded in gaining a good name in his kingdom.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: राष्ट्रे तु येऽनुजीवन्ति ये तु राज्ञोऽनुजीविनः॥ अमात्यानां च सर्वेषां मध्यस्थानां च सर्वशः। ये च त्वाभिप्रशंसेयुर्निन्देयुरथवा पुनः॥ सर्वान् सुपरिणीतांस्तान् कारयेथा युधिष्ठिर।
en: Amongst the virtuous and wise, amongst those who never retreat from battle, and those who do not live in your kingdom, those who depend on you, and those who are your ministers, as well as those who do not follow party, they who praise or blame you should never be disregarded by you, O Yudhishthira!

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: एकान्तेन हि सर्वेषां न शक्यं तात रोचितुम्। मित्रामित्रमथो मध्यं सर्वभूतेषु भारत॥
en: No man, O sire, can acquire the golden opinion of all persons in the world. All persons have friends, foes, and indifferent ones, O Bharata.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच तुल्यबाहुबलानां च तुल्यानां च गुणैरपि। कथं स्यादधिकः कश्चित् स च भुजीत मानवान्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Of persons all of whom are equal in strength of arms and accomplishments' how does one reign supreme over all the others, and how does he succeed in lording over them all.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: भीष्म उवाच यच्चरा ह्यचरानधुरंदष्ट्रान् दंष्ट्रिणस्तथा। आशीविषा इव क्रुद्धा भुजङ्गान् भुजगा इव॥
en: Bhishma said The mobile creatures devour things that are immobile; animals having teeth devour those that have none; angry snakes of dreadful venom devour smaller ones of their own species.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: एतेभ्यश्चाप्रमत्तः स्यात् सदा शत्रोर्युधिष्ठिर। भारुण्डसदृशा ह्येते निपतन्ति प्रमादतः॥
en: The king, O Yudhishthira, should always be careful of his subjects as also of his eremies. If he becomes careless, they attack him like vultures.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: कच्चित् ते वणिजो राष्ट्रे नोद्विजन्ति करार्दिताः। क्रीणन्तो बहुनाल्पेन कान्तारकृतविश्रमाः॥
en: Take care, O king, that the traders in your kingdom, who purchase articles for purposes of trade at prices high and low, and who while itenerating have to sleep or take rest in forests and inaccessible regions, may not suffer from the imposition of heavy taxes.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: कच्चित् कृषिकरा राष्ट्रं न जहेत्यतिपीडिताः। ये वहन्ति धुरं राज्ञां ते भरन्तीतरानपि॥
en: Let not the agriculturists in your kingdom leave it through oppression; they, who bear the burden of the king, support the other residents also of the kingdom.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: इतो दत्तेन जीवन्ति देवाः पितृगणास्तथा। मानुषोरगरक्षांसि वयांसि पशवस्तथा॥
en: The gifts made by you in this world support the gods, Pitris, men, Nagas, Rakshasas, birds, and animals.

description: The duties of a king described.
sn: एषा ते राष्ट्रवृत्तिश्च राज्ञां गुप्तिश्च भारत। एतमेवार्थमाश्रित्य भूयो वक्ष्यामि पाण्डव॥
en: These, O Bharata, are the instruments of governing a kingdom and protecting its king. I shall again talk to you on the subject, son of Pandu."

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: भीष्म उवाच यानङ्गिराः क्षत्रधर्मानुतथ्यो ब्रह्मवित्तमः। मान्धात्रे यौवनाश्वाय प्रीतिमानभ्यभाषत॥
en: Bhishma said That best of all persons conversant with the Vedas, viz., Utatthya of Angirasa's family, discoursed gladly to Yuvanashva's son Mandhatri.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: स यथानुशशासैनमुतथ्यो ब्रह्मवित्तमः। तत् ते सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि निखिलेन युधिष्ठिर॥
en: I shall now, O Yudhishthira, relate to you every thing that Utatthya, that foremost of all perscns conversant with the Vedas, had said to that king.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: उतथ्य उवाच धर्माय राजा भवति न कामकरणाय तु। मान्धातरिति जानीहि राजा लोकस्य रक्षिता॥
en: Utatthya said One becomes a king for advancing the cause of virtue and not for acting capriciously. Know this, O Mandhatri; the king is, indeed, the protector of the world.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: राजा चरति चेद् धर्मं देवत्वायैव कल्पते। स चेदधर्मं चरति नरकायैव गच्छति॥
en: If the king acts piously, he attains to the dignity of a god. If, however, he acts unrighteously, he sinks into hell.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: धर्मे तिष्ठन्ति भूतानि धर्मो राजनि तिष्ठति। तं राजा साधु यः शास्ति स राजा पृथिवीपतिः॥ राजा परमधर्मात्मा लक्ष्मीवान् धर्म उच्यते। देवाश्च नहीं गच्छन्ति धर्मो नास्तीति चोच्यते॥
en: All cri itures depends upon righteousness. Righteousness again depends upon the king. men That king, therefore, who maintains righteousness, is truly a king, that king who has a pious soul and posseses every kind of accomplishments is said to be an embodiment of virtue. If a king fails to punish iniquity, the god leave his palace and he incurs disreputation among men.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: स्वधर्मे वर्तमानानामर्थसिद्धिः प्रदृश्यते। तदेव मङ्गलं लोकः सर्वः समनुवर्तते॥
en: The endeavours of men who observe their own duties are always successful. Therefore all try to obey the injunctions of righteousness which yield prosperity.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: उच्छिद्यते धर्मवृत्तमधर्मो वर्तते महान्। भयमाहुर्दिवारानं यदा पापो न वार्यते॥
en: When sin is not restrained righteousness disappears and unrighteousness multiplies itself.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: ममेदमिति नैवैतत् साधूनां तात धर्मतः। वै व्यवस्था भवति यदा पापो न वार्यते॥
en: When sin is not restrained, no one can, in view of the rights of property as sanctioned by the scriptures, say,-This thing is mine and this is not mine.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: नैव भार्या न पशवो न क्षेत्रं न निवेशनम्। संदृश्येत मनुष्याणां यदा पापबलं भवेत्॥
en: When sinfulness reigns rampant in the world, men cannot own and enjoy their own wives and animals and fields and houses.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: देवा: पूजां न जानन्ति न स्वधां पितरस्तदा। न पूज्यन्ते ह्यतिथयो यदा पापो न वार्यते॥
en: When sin is not restrained the deities get no adorations, the Pitris no offerings in Shraddhas, and guests no hospitality.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: न वेदानधिगच्छन्ति व्रतवन्तो द्विजातयः। न यज्ञांस्तन्वते विप्रा यदा पापो न वार्यते॥
en: When sinfulness is not restrained, the twice-born ones do not study the Vedas, or practise high vows, or perform sacrifices.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: वृद्धानामिव सत्त्वानां मनो भवति विह्वलम्। मनुष्याणां महाराज यदा पापो न वार्यते॥
en: When sin is not restrained, the minds of men, O king, become weak and bewildered like those of persons wounded with weapons.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: उभौ लोकावभिप्रेक्ष्य राजानमृषयः स्वयम्। असृजन् सुमहद् भूतमयं धर्मो भविष्यति॥
en: Looking on both the worlds, the Rishis made the king, that best of men, with a view that he should be righteousness incarnate on Earth.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: यस्मिन् धर्मो विराजेत तं राजानं प्रचक्षते। यस्मिन् विलीयते धर्मस्तं देवा वृषलं विदुः॥
en: He is called Rajan in whom righteousness predominates. That king, again, in whom there is no righteousness, is called a Vrishala.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: वृषो हि भगवान् धर्मो यस्तस्य कुरुते ह्यलम्। वृषं तं विदुर्देवास्तस्माद्धर्मं विवर्धयेत्॥
en: Righteousness has another name, viz., Vrisha. He who weakens Vrisha passes by the name of Vrishala. A king should, therefore, further the cause of Righteousness.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: धर्मे वर्धति वर्धन्ति सर्वभूतानि सर्वदा। तस्मिन् ह्रसति ह्रीयन्ते तस्माद् धर्मं न लोपयेत्॥
en: All creatures prosper by the growth of righteousness and deteriorate with its decay. Righteousness, therefore, should never be suffered to decay.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: धनात् स्त्रवति धर्मो हि धारणाद् वेति निश्चयः। अकार्याणां मनुष्येन्द्र स सीमान्तकरः स्मृतः॥
en: Righteousness is called Dharma, because it helps the acquisition and preservation of wealth. The sages, O king, have declared that the Dharma restrains and limits all evils acts of men.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: प्रभवार्थं हि भूतानां धर्मः सृष्टः स्वयम्भुवा। तस्मात् प्रवर्तयेद् धर्म प्रजानुग्रहकारणात्॥
en: The Self-create created Dharma for the aggrandisement and growth of creatures. Therefore, a king should follow the dictates of Dharma for benefiting his people.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: तस्माद्धि राजशार्दूल धर्मः श्रेष्ठतरः स्मृतः। स राजा यः प्रजाः शास्ति साधुकृत् पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Therefore also, O foremost of kings' Dharma has been said to be the highest of all things. That best of men who governs his subjects righteously is called a king.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: कामक्रोधावनादृत्य धर्ममेवानुपालय। धर्मः श्रेयस्करतमो राज्ञां भरतसत्तम॥
en: Disregarding lust and anger follow the dictates of righteousness. Of all things, O chief of Bharata's race, which secure the prosperity of kings, righteousness is the foremost.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: धर्मस्य ब्राह्मणो योनिस्तस्मात् पूजयेत् सदा। ब्राह्मणानां च मान्धातः कुर्यात् कामानमत्सरी॥
en: Dharma, again, has originated from the Brahmana. Therefore, the Brahmana should always be adored. You, should, O Mandhatri, satisfy humbly the wishes of Brahmanas.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: तेषां ह्यकामकरणाद् राज्ञः संजायते भयम्। मित्राणि न च वर्धन्ते तथामित्रीभवन्त्यपि॥
en: Neglecting to please Brahmanas the king brings danger on himself, for such neglect, he cannot acquire friends while his enemies multiply.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: ब्राह्मणानां सदासूयाद् बाल्याद् वैरोचनो बलिः। अथास्माच्छीरपाक्रामद् यास्मिन्नासीत् प्रतापिनी॥
en: For entertaining malice out of folly towards the Brahmanas, the goddess of prosperity who had formerly lived with him became irate and deserted the Asura Vali the son of Virochana.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: ततस्तस्मादपाक्रम्य सागच्छत् पाकशासनम्। अथ सोऽन्वतपत् पश्चाच्छ्रियं दृष्ट्वा पुरन्दरे॥
en: Deserting the Asura she went to Indra the king of gods. Seeing the goddess living with Purandara, Vali regretted idly.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: एतत् फलमसूयाया अभिमानस्य वा विभो। तस्माद् बुध्यस्व मान्धातर्मा त्वां जह्यात् प्रतापिनी॥
en: This, O powerful one, is the outcome of malice and pride. Be you awakened, O Mandhatri, so that the goddess of prosperity ! may not in anger desert you.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: दर्पो नाम श्रियः पुत्रो जज्ञेऽधर्मादिति श्रुतिः। तेन देवासुरा राजन् नीता: सुबहवो व्ययम्॥
en: The Shrutis say that unrighteousness beget a son named Pride upon the goddess of prosperity. This Pride, O king, brought ruin upon many among the gods and the Asuras.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: राजर्षयश्च बहवस्तथा बुध्यस्व पार्थिव। राजा भवति तं जित्वा दासस्तेन पराजितः॥
en: Many royal sages were ruined for him. Do you, therefore, awaken, O king, He who can conquer him becomes a king. He, however, who suffers himself to be conquered by him, becomes a slave.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: स यथा दर्पसहितमधर्मं नानुसेवते। तथा वर्तस्व मान्धातश्चिरं चेत् स्थातुमिच्छसि॥
en: If, O Mandhatri, you wish to enjoy a life of perpetual happiness, live as a king should who does not indulge these two, viz., Pride and Unrighteousness.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: मत्तात्प्रमत्तात् पौगण्डादुन्मत्ताच्च विशेषतः। तदभ्यासादुपावर्त संहितानां च सेवनात्॥
en: Do not associate with him,—who is intoxicated with pride, who does not follow honesty, who scoffs at religion, who is insensate and negligent in paying homage to all of them even when united.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: निगृहीतादमात्याच्च स्त्रीभ्यश्चैव विशेषतः। पर्वताद् विषमाद् दुर्गाद्धस्तिनोऽश्वात् सरीसृपात्॥ एतेभ्यो नित्ययत्तः स्यान्नक्तंचर्यां च वर्जयेत्। अत्यागं चाभिमानं च दम्भं क्रोधं च वर्जयेत्॥
en: Keep yourself aloof from the company of ministers whom you have once punished and especially of women, as also from mountains and uneven lands and inaccessible forts and elephants and horses and reptiles. You should never wander in the night, and avoid stinginess, vanity, boastfulness, and anger.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: अविज्ञातासु च स्त्रीषु क्लीबासु स्वैरिणीषु च। परभार्यासु कन्यासु नाचरेन्मैथुनं नृपः॥
en: You should never know unknown women, or the eunuchs, or those who are lewd, or those who are the wives of other men, or those who are unmarried.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: कुलेषु पापरक्षांसि जायन्ते वर्णसंकरात्। अपुमांसोऽङ्गहीनाश्च स्थूलजिह्वा विचेतसः॥
en: When the king does not restrain vice, an intermixture of castes follows, and sinful Rakshasas, eunuchs, children destitute of limbs or possessed of thick tongues, and idiots, begin to take birth in even respectable families,

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: एते चान्ये च जायन्ते यदा राजा प्रमाद्यति। तस्माद् राज्ञा विशेषेण वर्तितव्यं प्रजाहिते॥
en: Therefore, the king should take particular care to act righteously for the behoof of his people.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: क्षत्रियस्य प्रमत्तस्य दोषः संजायते महान्। अधर्माः सम्प्रवर्धन्ते प्रजासंकरकारकाः॥
en: If a king acts heedlessly, it produces a great evil. Unrighteousness multiplies causing an intermixture of castes.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: अशीते विद्यते शीतं शीते शीतं न विद्यते। अवृष्टिरतिवृष्टिश्च व्याधिश्चाप्याविशेत् प्रजाः॥
en: Cold appears during the summer months, and disappears in its proper season. Drought and flood and pestilence attack the people.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: नक्षत्राण्युपतिष्ठन्ति ग्रहा घोरास्तथागते। उत्पाताश्चात्र दृश्यन्ते बहवो राजनाशनाः॥
en: Evil stars arise and dreadful comets appear on such occasions. Various other portents, presaging destruction of the kingdom, appear.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: अरक्षितात्मा यो राजा प्रजाश्चापि न रक्षति। प्रजाश्च तस्य क्षीयन्ते ततः सोऽनुविनश्यति॥
en: If the king does not take steps for his own safety and does not protect his subjects, the latter first meet with destruction which ultimately overtakes the king himself.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: द्वावाददाते ह्येकस्य द्वयोः सुबहवोऽपरे। कुमार्यः सम्प्रलुप्यन्ते तदाहुपदूषणम्॥
en: Two persons in unision take away the wealth of one, and many acting together rob the two. The virginity of maidens is destroyed. Such a state of things originate from the king's faults.

description: The duties of king as described by Utathya
sn: ममेदमिति नैकस्य मनुष्येष्ववतिष्ठति। त्यक्त्वा धर्मं यदा राजा प्रमादमनुतिष्ठति॥
en: All rights of property are destroyed among men, when the king, forsaking righteousness, acts heedlessly.

sn: उतथ्य उवाच कालवीं च पर्जन्यो धर्मचारी च पार्थिवः। सम्पद् यदेषा भवति सा बिभति सुखं प्रजाः॥
en: Utatthya said If the god of the clouds pours rain in season and the king acts virtuously, the prosperity that comes keeps the subjects in happiness.

sn: यो न जानाति हर्तुं वा वस्त्राणां रजको मलम्। रक्तानां वा शोधयितुं यथा नास्ति तथैव सः॥
en: That washerman who does not know how to wash away the dirt of cloth without destroying its dye, is very unskilful in his profession.

sn: एवमेतद् द्विजेन्द्राणां क्षत्रियाणां विशां तथा। शूद्रश्चतुर्थो वर्णानां नानाकर्मस्ववस्थितः॥
en: That person among Brahmanas Kshatriyas or Vaishyas who, having deviated from the proper duties of his caste, has become a Shudra, is truly to be compared to such a washerman.

sn: कर्म शूद्रे कृषिवैश्ये दण्डनीतिश्च राजनि। ब्रह्मचर्यं तपो मन्त्राः सत्यं चापि द्विजातिषु॥
en: Menial service is the duty of the Shudra; agriculture is that of the Vaishya; the science of punishment of the Kshatriya and Brahmacharya, penances, Mantras, and truth, belong to the Brahmana. or

sn: तेषां यः क्षत्रियो वेद वस्त्राणामिव शोधनम्। शीलदोषान् विनिर्हर्तुं स पिता स प्रजापतिः॥
en: That Kshatriya who knows how to correct the wrong-doings of the other castes and to wash them clean like a washerman, is really their father and deserves to be their king.

sn: कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्च भरतर्षभ। राजवृत्तानि सर्वाणि राजैव युगमुच्यते॥
en: The various cycles called Krita, Treta, Dvapara, and Kali, O foremost of Bharata's race, all depend on the conduct of the king. It is the king who makes the cycles.

sn: चातुर्वण्र्यं तथा वेदाश्चातुराश्रम्यमेव च। सर्वं प्रमुह्यते ह्येतद् यदा राजा प्रमाद्यति॥
en: The four castes, the Vedas, and the duties of the four modes of life, all suffer from confusion and weakness when the king becomes heedless.

sn: अग्नित्रेता त्रयी विद्या यज्ञाश्च सहदक्षिणाः। सर्व एव प्रमाद्यन्ति यदा राजा प्रमाद्यति॥
en: The three kinds of fire, the three Vedas, and sacrifices with Dakshina, all disappear when the king becomes careless.

sn: राजैव कर्ता भूतानां राजैव च विनाशकः। धर्मात्मा यः स कर्ता स्यादधर्मात्मा विनाशकः॥
en: The king is the creator of all creatures, and is their destroyer. That righteous king is regarded as the creator, while the sinful one is regarded as the destroyer.

sn: राज्ञो भार्याश्च पुत्राश्च बान्धवाः सुहृदस्तथा। समेत्य सर्वे शोचन्ति यदा राजा प्रमाद्यति॥
en: The king's wives, sons, kinsmen, and friends, all become unhappy and grieve when the king becomes careless.

sn: हस्तिनोऽश्वाश्च गावचाप्युष्ट्राश्वतरगर्दभाः। अधर्मभूते नृपतौ सर्वे सीदन्ति जन्तवः॥
en: Elephants, horses, kine, camels, mules, asses and other animals all lose their vigour when the king becomes sinful.

sn: दुर्बलार्थं वलं सृष्टं धात्रा मान्धातरुच्यते। अबलं तु महद्भूतं यस्मिन् सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: It is said, O Mandhatri, that the Creator created Power for for protecting Weakness. Weakness is, really, a great being, for every thing depends upon it.

sn: यच्च भूतं सम्भजते ये च भूतास्तदन्वयाः। अधर्मस्थे हि नृपतौ सर्वे शोचन्ति पार्थिव॥
en: All creatures adore the king. All creatures are the children of the king. If, therefore, O monarch, the king becomes unrighteous, all creatures meet with ruin.

sn: दुर्बलस्य च यच्चक्षुर्मुनेराशीविषस्य च। अविषह्यतमं मन्ये मा स्म दुर्बलमासदः॥
en: The eyes of the Weak, of the Muni, and of the venomous snake, should be considered as unbearable. Do not, therefore, meet the Weak as you would do an enemy.

sn: दुर्बलांस्तात बुध्येथा नित्यमेवाविमानितान्। मा त्वां दुर्बलचढूंषि प्रदहेयुः सबान्धवम्॥
en: You should regard the Weak as being subject to humiliation. Take care that the eyes of the Weak do not burn you with your kinsmen.

sn: न हि दुर्बलदग्धस्य कुले किंचित् प्ररोहति। आमूलं निर्दहन्त्येव मा स्म दुर्बलमासदः॥
en: In a family scorched by the eyes of the Weak, no children are born. Such eyes burn the family to its very roots. Do not, therefore, treat the weak inimically.

sn: अबलं वै बलाच्छ्रेयो यच्चातिबलवबलम्। बलस्याबलदग्धस्य न किंचिदवशिष्यते॥
en: Weakness is more powerful than even the greatest Power, for that Power which is scorched by Weakness is absolutely rotted out.

sn: विमानितो हतः क्रुश्स्त्रातारं चेन विन्दति। अमानुषकृतस्तत्र दण्डो हन्ति नराधिपम्॥
en: If a person, who has been humiliated or struck, fails, while crying for help, to get a protector, divine punishment over takes the king and brings about his fall.

sn: मा स्म तात रणे स्थित्वा भुञ्जीथा दुर्बलं जनम्। मा त्वां दुर्बलचक्षूषि दहन्त्वग्निरिवाश्रयम्॥
en: Do not, 'O sire, while excersing Power, take wealth from the Weak, Take care that the eyes of the Weak do not burn you like a burning fire.

sn: यानि मिथ्याभिशस्तानां पतन्त्यश्रूणि रोदताम्। तानि पुत्रान् पशून् नन्ति तेषां मिथ्याभिशंसनात्॥
en: The tears shed by weeping men afflicted with falsehood kill the children and animals of those that have uttered those lies.

sn: यदि नात्मनि पुत्रेषु न चेत् पौत्रेषु नप्तृषु। न हि पापं कृतं कर्म सद्यः फलति गौरिव॥
en: Like a cow a sinful act does not yield immediate truits. If the fruit is not seen in the perpetrator himself, it is seen in his son or in his grand-son or daughter's son.

sn: यत्राबलो वध्यमानस्त्रातारं नाधिगच्छति। महान् दैवकृतस्तत्र दण्डः पतति दारुणः॥
en: When a Weak person fails to find a protector the great rod of divine punishment overtakes the king.

sn: युक्ता यदा जानपदा भिक्षन्ते ब्राह्मणा इव। अभीक्ष्णं भिक्षुरूपेण राजानं मन्ति तादृशाः॥
en: When all the subjects of a king are compelled by distress to live like Brahmanas, by begging, such mendicancy brings destruction upon the king.

sn: राज्ञो यदा जनपदे बहवो राजपूरुषाः। अनयेनोपवर्तन्ते तद् राज्ञः किल्बिषं महत्॥
en: When all the officers of the king living in the provinces unite together and act unfairly, the king is then said to bring about a state of unredeeming evil upon his kingdom.

sn: यदा युक्त्या नयेदर्थान् कामादर्थवशेन वा। कृपणं याचमानानां तद् राज्ञो वैशसं महत्॥
en: When the officers of the king extort money, hy unfair mean, or acting from lust or avarice, from persons pitcously praying for mercy, a great destruct' on, jorsooth, be.ails the king.

sn: महान् वृक्षो जायते वर्धते च तं चैव भूतानि समाश्रयन्ति। यदा वृक्षश्छिद्यते दह्यते च तदाश्रया अनिकेता भवन्ति॥
en: A huge tree, just growing, assumes large proportions, Numberless creatures then come and seek its shelter. When, however, it is cut down or burnt, those who had taken its shelter become all houseless.

sn: यदा राष्ट्रे धर्ममयं चरन्ति संस्कारं वा राजगुणं ब्रुवाणा:। तैरेवाधर्मश्चरितो धर्ममोहात् तूर्णं जह्यात् सुकृतं दुष्कृतं च॥
en: When the denizens of a kingdom perform pious acts and all religious rites, and praise the good qualities, of the king, the latter acquires riches. When, however, the residents, out of ignorance forsake righteousness and act unrighteously, the king suffers from misery.

sn: यत्र पापा ज्ञायमानाश्चरन्ति सतां कलिविन्दते तत्र राज्ञः। स्तदा राज्यं वर्धते भूमिपस्य॥
en: When sinful men of known acts are allowed to move among the righteous, Kali then overtakes the kings of those kingdoms. When the king punishes all wicked people, his kingdom prospers.

sn: यश्चामात्यान् मानयित्वा यथार्थ मन्त्रे च युद्धे च नृपो नियुङ्ग्यात्। विवर्धते तस्य राष्ट्र नृपस्य भुक्के महीं चाप्यखिलां चिराय॥
en: Forsooth, the kingdom of that king certainly prospers who honours his ministers and employs them in policy and in battles. Such a king enjoys the wide Earth or ever.

sn: यच्चापि सुकृतं कर्म वाचं चैव सुभाषिताम्। समीक्ष्य पूजयन् राजा धर्मं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: That king who duly honours at good acts and good speeches acquires great merit.

sn: संविभज्य यदा भुक्के नामात्यानवमन्यते। निहन्ति बलिनं दृप्तं स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: The enjoyment of good things with others, paying proper honours to the ministers, and subjugations of persons who are proud of their strength, are the great duty of a king.

sn: त्रायते हि यदा सर्वं वाचा कायेन कर्मणा। पुत्रस्यापि न मृष्येच्च स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Protecting all men by words, body, and deeds, and never forgiving even his offending son himself, form the duty of the king.

sn: संविभज्य यदा भुक्के नृपतिर्दुर्बलान् नरान्। तदा भवन्ति बलिनः स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: The maintenance of the Weak by sharing with them the things he has and thereby increasing their strength, form the duty of the king.

sn: यदा रक्षति राष्ट्राणि यदा दस्यूनपोहति। यदा जयति संग्रामे स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Protection of the kingdom, extermination of robbers, and conquest form the duty of the king.

sn: पापमाचरतो यत्र कर्मणा व्याहृतेन वा। प्रियस्यापि न मृष्येत स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Not to forgive a person, however dear if he has committe an offence, by act or word, forms the duty of the king.

sn: यदा शारणिकान् राजा पुत्रवत् परिरक्षति। भिनत्ति च न मर्यादां स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Protecting those who seek refuge with him as he would protect his own children, and never depriving one of the honours to which he is entitled, form the duty of the king.

sn: यदाऽऽप्तदक्षिणैर्यज्ञैर्यजते श्रद्धयान्वितः। कामद्वेषावनादृत्य स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Adoring the gods, with devotion in sacrifices completed by presents, and subduing lust and envy, from the duty of the king.

sn: कृपणानाथवृद्धानां यदाश्रु परिमार्जति। हर्ष संजनयन् नृणां स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Wiping the tears of the distressed, the helpless, and the old, and filling them with joy, form the duty of the king.

sn: विवर्धयति मित्राणि तथारीश्चापि कर्षति। सम्पूजयति साधूंश्च स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Advancing friends, weakening enemies, and honouring the good, form the duty of the king.

sn: सत्यं पालयति प्रीत्या नित्यं भूमिं प्रयच्छति। पूजयेदतिथीन् भृत्यान् स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Cheerfully adhering to truth, always making presents of land, entertaining guests, and maintaining dependents, form the duty of the king.

sn: निग्रहानुग्रहौ चोभौ यत्र स्यातां प्रतिष्ठितौ। अस्मिन् लोके परे चैव राजा स प्राप्नुते फलम्॥
en: That king who favours those who deserve favours, and punishes those who deserve chastisement, acquires great merit both here and hereafter.

sn: यमो राजा धार्मिकाणां मान्धातः परमेश्वरः। संयच्छन् भवति प्राणानसंयच्छंस्तु पातुकः॥
en: The king is Yama himself. He is, O Mandhatri, the god (incarnate) to all righteous persons. By controlling his senses he acquires great riches. By not subduing them he commits sin.

sn: ऋत्विक्पुरोहिताचार्यान् सत्कृत्यानवमन्य च। यदा सम्यक् प्रगृह्णाति स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Paying proper honours to Ritwijas and priests and preceptors, and doing them good, form the duty of the king.

sn: यमो यच्छति भूतानि सर्वाण्येवाविशेषतः। तथा राज्ञानुकर्तव्यं यन्तव्या विधिवत् प्रजाः॥
en: Yama governs all creatures without any distinction. The king should imitate him in his conduct by restraining all his subjects duly.

sn: सहस्राक्षेण राजा हि सर्वथैवोपमीयते। स पश्यति च यं धर्म स धर्मः पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: The king is said to resemble the Thousandeyed (Indra). O foremost of men, that which is regarded by the king as Righteousness is accepted as such by all.

sn: अप्रमादेन शिक्षेथाः क्षमां बुद्धिं धृति मतिम्। भूतानां चैव जिज्ञासा साध्वसाधु च सर्वदा॥
en: You should diligently cultivate forgiveness, intelligence, patience and the love of all creatures. You should also determine the strength and weakness of all men and learn to distinguish between right and wrong.

sn: संग्रहः सर्वभूतानां दानं च मधुरं वचः। पौरजानपदाचैव गोप्तव्यास्ते यथासुखम्॥
en: You should behave properly towards all creatures, make gifts, the utter agreeable and sweet words. You should maintain the residents of your city and the provinces in happiness.

sn: न जात्वदक्षो नृपतिः प्रजाः शक्नोति रक्षितुम्। भारो हि सुमहांस्तात राज्यं नाम सुदुष्करम्॥
en: A king, who is not clever, can never protect his subjects. Sovereignty, O sire, is a very heavy burden.

sn: तद्दण्डविन्नृपः प्राज्ञः शूरः शक्नोति रक्षितुम्। न हि शक्यमदण्डेन क्लीबेनाबुद्धिनापि वा॥
en: Only that king who is endued with wisdom and courage, and who is a master of the science of punishment, can protect a kingdom. He, on the other hand, who is devoid of energy and intelligence, and who is not versed in the great science, cannot bear the burden of sovereignty.

sn: अभिरूपैः कुले जातैर्दक्षैर्भक्तैर्बहुश्रुतैः। सर्वा बुद्धीः परीक्षेपास्तापसाश्रमिणामपि॥
en: Helped by ministers of beautiful features and good birth, clever in business, devoted to their masters, and highly learned, you should examine the hearts and acts of all men including the very hermits.

sn: अतस्त्वं सर्वभूतानां धर्मं वेत्स्यसि वै परम्। स्वदेशे परदेशे वा न ते धर्मो विनक्षयति॥
en: Behaving thus, you will be able to learn the duties of all orders of men. This will help you in observing your own duties whether when you are in your country or when you go to other kingdoms.

sn: तस्मादर्थाच्च कामाच्च धर्म एवोत्तरो भवेत्। अस्मिल्लोके परे चैव धर्मात्मा सुखमेधते॥
en: Amongst these three objects, viz., Virtue, Profit, and Pleasure, Virtue is the foremost. He, who is of virtuous soul, acquires great happiness both here and hereafter.

sn: त्यजन्ति दारान् पुत्रांश्च मनुष्याः परिपूजिताः। संग्रहश्चैव भूतानां दानं च मधुरा च वाक्॥ अप्रमादश्च शौचं च राज्ञो भूतिकरं महत्। एतेभ्यश्चैव मान्धातः सततं मा प्रमादिथाः॥
en: If men are treated with honour, they can abandon their very wives and sons. By winning over good men, by gifts, sweet words, carefulness, and purity of conduct, a king may acquire for himself great prosperity. Do not, therefore, O Mandhatri, be negligent of these qualities and acts.

sn: अप्रमत्तो भवेद् राजा छिद्रदर्शी परात्मनोः। नास्यच्छिद्रं परः पश्येच्छिद्रेषु परमन्वियात्॥
en: The king should never neglect to look after his own weak points as also after those of his foes. He should act in such a way that his enemies may not be able to discover his weak points, and he should himself assail them when theirs are seen.

sn: एतद् वृत्तं वासवस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च। राजर्षीणां च सर्वेषां तत् त्वमप्यनुपालय॥
en: In this way Vasava, and Yama, and Varuna and all the great royal sages have acted. Do you follow the same conduct.

sn: तत् कुरुष्व महाराज वृत्तं राजर्षिसेवितम्। आतिष्ठ दिव्यं पन्थानमह्नाय पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Do you, O great king, follow the conduct of those royal sages. Do you soon, O foremost of Bharata's race, follow this heavenly road.

sn: धर्मवृत्तं हि राजानं प्रेत्य चेह च भारत। देवर्षिपितृगन्धर्वाः कीर्तयन्ति महौजसः॥
en: The gods, the Rishis, the Pitris, and the Gandharvas, possessed of great energy, chant the praises, both here and hereafter, of that king who is righteous!

sn: भीष्म उवाच स एवमुक्तो मान्धाता तेनोतथ्येन भारत। कृतवानविशङ्कश्च एकः प्राप च मेदिनीम्॥
en: Bhishma said nus spoken to by Utatthya, O Bharata, Mandhatri unhesitatingly did as he as he was directed, and became the soul king of the wide Earth.

sn: भवानपि तथा सम्यङ्मान्धातेव महीपते। धर्म कृत्वा महीं रक्ष स्वर्गे स्थानमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: Do you also, O king, act righteously like Mandhatri. You will then, after ruling the Earth, live in heaven!

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं धर्मे स्थातुमिच्छन् राजा वर्तेत धार्षिकः। पृच्छामि त्वं कुरुश्रेष्ठ तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: How should a righteous king, who wishes to follow the ways of righteousness, behave? I ask you this, O foremost of men! Answer me, O grand-father!

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। गीतं दृष्टार्थतत्त्वेन वामदेवेन धीमता॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old story of what the highly intelligent Vamadeva acquainted with the true import of everything sang in days of yore.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: राजा वसुमना नाम ज्ञानवान् धृतिमाशुचिः। महर्षि परिपप्रच्छ वामदेवं तपस्विनम्॥
en: Once upon a time, king Vasumanas, endued with knowledge, fortitude, purity of conduct, asked the great Rishi Vamadeva of great ascetic merit, sayingधर्मार्थसहितैर्वाक्यैर्भगवन्ननुशाधि माम्।

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: येन वृत्तेन वै तिष्ठन् न हीयेयं स्वधर्मतः॥
en: Instruct me, O holy one, in words fraught with fairness and great significance as to what that conduct is by observing which I may not deviate from the duties prescribed for me!

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: तमब्रवीद् वामदेवस्तेजस्वी तपतां वरः। हेमवर्णं सुखासीनं ययातिमिव नाहुषम्॥
en: To him having a golden hue and seated at his ease like Yayati the son of Nahusha, that foremost of ascetics, viz., Vamadeva of great energy, said as follows.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: वासुदेव उवाच धर्ममेवानुवर्तस्व न धर्माद् विद्यते परम्। धर्मे स्थिता हि राजानो जयन्ति पृथिवीमिमाम्॥
en: Vamadeva said Do you act righteously. There is nothing superior to Righteousness. The righteous kings succeed in conquering the whole Earth.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: अर्थसिद्धेः परं धर्मं मन्यते यो महीपतिः। वृद्ध्यां च कुरुते बुद्धिं स धर्मेण विराजते॥
en: That king who considers Righteousness as the most effectual instrument for accomplishing his objects, and who follows the advice of the righteous, shines with righteousness.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: अधर्मदर्शी यो राजा बलादेव प्रवर्तते। क्षिप्रमेवापयातोऽस्मादुभौ प्रथममध्यमौ॥
en: That king who neglects Righteousness and wishes to act with brute force, soon falls away from Righteousness and loses both Virtue and Profit.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: असत्पापिष्ठसचिवो वध्यो लोकस्य धर्महा। सहैव परिवारेण क्षिप्रमेवावसीदति॥
en: That king who follows the advice of a vicious and sinful minister becomes a destroyer of righteousness and deserves to be killed by his subjects with all his family. Indeed, he very soon meets with destruction,

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: अर्थानामननुष्ठाता कामचारी विकत्यनः। अपि सर्वां महीं लब्ध्वा क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति॥
en: That king who cannot satisfy his royal duties, who is governed by caprice in all his acts, and who vaunts, soon meets with destruction even if he happen to be the king of whole Earth.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: अथाददानः कल्याणमनसूयुर्जितेन्द्रियः। वर्धते मतिमान् राजा स्त्रोतोभिरिव सागरः॥
en: That king, however, who seeks prosperity, who is shorn of malice, who has his senses under restraint, and who is endued with intelligence, rolls in wealth like the ocean swelling with the waters put into it by a hundred rivers.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: न पूर्णोऽस्मीति मन्येत धर्मतः कामतोऽर्थतः। बुद्धितो मित्रतश्चापि सततं वसुधाधिपः॥
en: He should never consider himself as possessing enough of Virtue, enjoyment, wealth, intelligence, and friends.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: एतेष्वेव हि सर्वेषु लोकयात्रा प्रतिष्ठिता। एतानि शृण्वल्लभते यशः कीर्ति श्रियं प्रजाः॥
en: Upon these depends the word. By listening to this advice, a king acquires fame, great deeds, prosperity and subjects.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: एवं यो धर्मसंरम्भी धर्मार्थपरिचिन्तकः। अर्थान् समीक्ष्य भजते स ध्रुवं महदश्नुते॥
en: Being virtuous that king, who tries to acquire virtue and wealth by such means, and who undertakes all his measures after thinking upon their objects, succeeds in acquiring great prosperity.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: अदाता ह्यनतिस्नेहो दण्डेनावर्तयन् प्रजाः। साहसप्रकृती राजा क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति॥
en: That king, who is illiberal, and shorn of affection, who oppresses his subjects by undue punishment, and who is rash in his acts, soon meets with destruction.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: अथ पापकृतं बुद्ध्या न च पश्यत्यबुद्धिमान्। अकीर्त्याभिसमायुक्तो भूयो नरकमश्नुते॥
en: That king, who is not intelligent, fails to see his own faults. Best with infamy here, he sinks into hell hereafter.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: अथ मानयितुर्दाम्नः श्लक्ष्णस्य वशवर्तिनः। व्यसनं स्वमिवोत्पन्नं विजिघांसन्ति मानवाः॥
en: If the king honours them properly that deserve it, makes gifts, and recognises the value of sweet speeches by himself uttering them always, his subjects then remove the calamities that overtake him as if these had fallen upon themselves.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: यस्य नास्ति गुरुर्धर्मे न चान्यानपि पृच्छति। सुखतन्त्रोऽर्थलाभेषु न चिरं सुखमश्नुते॥
en: The king, who has none to instruct him in the ways of righteousness and who never seeks advice from others, and who seeks to acquire wealth by means that caprice suggests, never enjoys happiness long.

description: The conduct of king who seeks virtues and described by Vasudeva.
sn: गुरुप्रधानो धर्मेषु स्वयमर्थानवेक्षिता। धर्मप्रधानो लाभेषु स चिरं सुखमश्नुते॥
en: That king, on the other hand, who follows the advice of his preceptors in matters of virtue, who supervises the affairs of his kingdom himself, and who in all his acquisitions follows virtue, succeeds in enjoying happiness for a long time.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: वामदेव उवाच यत्राधर्मं प्रणयते दुर्बले बलवत्तरः। तां वृत्तिमुपजीवन्ति ये भवन्ति तदन्वयाः॥
en: When the king, who is powerful acts unfairly towards the Weak, persons born in his family imitate the same conduct.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: राजानमनुवर्तन्ते तं पापाभिप्रवर्तकम्। अविनीतमनुष्यं तत् क्षिप्रं राष्ट्र विनश्यति॥
en: Others, again, imitate that wretch who commits sins. Such imitation of the man who does not care for restraints soon brings destruction upon the kingdom.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: यद् वृत्तमुपजीवन्ति प्रकृतिस्थस्य मानवाः। तदेव विषमस्थस्य स्वजनोऽपि न मृष्यते॥
en: The conduct of a king, who observes his proper duties, is accepted by men in general as a model for imitation. The conduct, however, of a king, who deviates from his duties, is not tolerated by his very kinsmen.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: साहसप्रकृतिर्यत्र किंचिदुल्बणमाचरेत्। अशास्त्रलक्षणो राजा क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति॥
en: That rash king, who, neglecting the injunctions laid down in scriptures, acts with high-handedness in his kingdom, very soon meets with fall.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: योऽत्यन्ताचरितां वृत्तिं क्षत्रियो नानुवर्तते। जितानामजितानां च क्षत्रधर्मादपैति सः॥
en: That Kshatriya, who does not follow the conduct observed from days of yore by other Kshatriyas conquered or unconquered, deviates from Kshatriyas duties.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: द्विषन्त कृतकल्याणं गृहीत्वा नृपतिं रणे। यो न मानयते द्वेषात् क्षत्रधर्मादपैति सः॥
en: Having captured in battle a royal enemy that did some good to the conqueror on a former occasion, that king, who, does not, out of malice, honour him, is said to deviate from Kshatriya duties.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: शक्तः स्यात् सुसुखो राजा कुर्यात् करणमापदि। प्रियो भवति भूतानां न च विभ्रश्यते श्रियः॥
en: The king should show his power, live merrily, and do what is necessary in times of danger. Such a king is loved of all creatures and never falls away from prosperity.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: अप्रियं यस्य कुर्वीत भूयस्तस्य प्रियं चरेत्। नचिरेण प्रियः स स्याद् योऽप्रियः प्रियमाचरेत्॥
en: If you do evil to any person, you should, when the times comes, do him good. One who is not loved becomes an object of love if he does what is good.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: मृषावादं परिहरेत् कुर्यात् प्रियमयाचितः। न कामान च संरम्भान्न द्वेषाद् धर्ममुत्सृजेत्॥
en: Falsehoods should be avoided. You should do good to others without being asked for the same. You should never abandon righteousness from lust or anger or malice.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: नापत्रपेत प्रश्नेषु नाविभाव्यां गिरं सृजेत्। न त्वरेत न चासूयेत् तथा संगृह्यते परः॥
en: Do not reply harshly when questioned by anybody. Do not utter mean words. Never be in a hurry to do anything. Never cherish malice. By such means an enemy is won over.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: प्रिये नातिभृशं हृष्येदप्रिये न च संज्वरेत्। न तप्येदर्थकृच्छ्रेषु प्रजाहितमनुस्मरन्॥
en: Do not be overjoyed when anything pleasant occurs, nor give away to sorrow when anything disagreeable occurs. Never grieve when your wealth is exhausted, and always remember the duty of doing good to your subjects.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: यः प्रियं कुरुते नित्यं गुणतो वसुधाधिपः। तस्य कर्माणि सिद्ध्यन्ति न च संत्यज्यते श्रिया॥
en: That king, who always does what is agreeable by natural inclination, acquires success in all his undertakings and is never shorn of prosperity.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: निवृत्तं प्रतिकूलेषु वर्तमानमनुप्रिये। भक्तं भजेत नृपतिः सदैव सुसमाहितः॥
en: The king should always, carefully, cherish that devoted servant who abstains from doing injury to his master and who always does what is for his good.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: अप्रकीर्णेन्द्रियग्राममत्यन्तानुगतं शुचिम्। शक्तं चैवानुरक्तं च युज्यान्महति कर्मणि॥
en: He should employ in responsible offices persons who have controlled their senses, who are devotedly loyal and of pure conduct, and who are able.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: एवमेतैर्गुणैर्युक्तो योऽनुरज्यति भूमिपम्। भर्तुरर्थेष्वप्रमत्तं नियुज्यादर्थकर्मणि॥
en: That person, who by possessing such qualifications, pleases the king and who never neglects to take care of the interests of his master, should be appointed by the king in the affairs of his kingdom.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: मूढमैन्द्रियकं लुब्धमनार्यचरितं शठम्। अनतीतोपधं हिस्त्रं दुर्बुद्धिमबहुश्रुतम्॥ त्यक्तोदात्तं माद्यरतं यतस्त्रीमृगयापरम्। कार्ये महति युञ्जानो हीयते नृपतिः श्रिया॥
en: On the other hand, the king becomes shorn of prosperity by appointing to important offices men who are fools and slaves of their senses, who are covetous and of disreputable conduct, who are deceitful and hypocritical, who are minded, and addicted to drink, gambling, women, and hunting.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: रक्षितात्मा च यो राजा रक्ष्यान् यश्चानुरक्षति। प्रजाश्च तस्य वर्धन्ते ध्रुवं च महदश्नुते॥
en: That king, who, first protecting his own self, protects others worthy of protection, feels the satisfaction of seeing his subjects prosper. Such a king succeeds also in acquiring greatness.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: ये केचिद् भूमिपतयः सर्वांस्तानन्ववेक्षयेत्। सुहृद्भिरनभिख्यातैस्तेन राजातिरिच्यते॥
en: A king should, by devoted secret agents, watch the conduct and acts of other kings. By such means can he acquire superiority.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: अपकृत्य बलस्थस्य दूरस्थोऽस्मीति नाश्वसेत्। श्येनाभिपतनैरेते निपतन्ति प्रमाद्यतः॥
en: Having injured a powerful king, one should not comfort himself with the idea that the injurer lives at a great distance from the injured. Such kings when injured attack the injurer like the hawk swooping down upon its : prey, in careless moments.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: दृढमूलस्त्वदुष्टात्मा विदित्वा बलमात्मनः। अबलानभियुञ्जीत न तु ये बलवत्तराः॥
en: A king, whose power has been consolidated and who is confident of his own strength, should attack a neighbour who is weaker than himself but never who is stronger.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: विक्रमेण महीं लब्ध्वा प्रजा धर्मेण पालयेत्। आहवे निधनं कुर्याद् राजा धर्मपरायणः॥
en: Having acquired the sovereignty of the Earth by prowess, a virtuous king should protect his subjects fairly and kill enemies in battle

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: मरणान्तमिदं सर्वं नेह किञ्चिदनामयम्। तस्माद् धर्मे स्थितो राजा प्रजा धर्मेण पालयेत्॥
en: Everything belonging to this world is liable to destruction. Nothing here is lasting. Therefore, the king, following righteousness, should protect his subjects righteously.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: रक्षाधिकरणं युद्धं तथा धर्मानुशासनम्। मन्त्रचिन्ता सुखं काले पञ्चभिर्वर्धते मही॥
en: The defence of forts, battle, administration of justice, consultations on questions of policy, and keeping the subjects of happiness, these five increase the dominions of a king.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: एतानि यस्य गुप्तानि स राजा राजसत्तमः। सततं वर्तमानोऽत्र राजा धत्ते महीमिमाम्॥
en: That king who takes proper care of these is considered to be the best of kings. By always doing these, a king succeeds in protecting his kingdom.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: नैतान्येकेन शक्यानि सातत्येनानुवीक्षितुम्। तेषु सर्वं प्रतिष्ठाप्य राजा भुक्के चिरं महीम्॥
en: It is impossible, however, for one man to look after all these matters at all times. Transferring such supervision to his ministers, a king may govern the Earth for ever,

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: दातारं संविभक्तारं मार्दवोपगतं शुचिम्। असंत्यक्तमनुष्यं च तं जनाः कुर्वते नृपम्॥
en: The people select such a person as their king who is liberal, who shares all objects of enjoyment with others, who is mild by nature, who is of pure conduct, and who will never forsake his subjects.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: यस्तु निःश्रेयसं श्रुत्वा ज्ञानं तत् प्रतिपद्यते। आत्मनो मतमुत्सृज्य तं लोकोऽनुविधीयते॥
en: He is obeyed in the world who, having listened to the advice of the wise, accepts them, leaving aside his own opinions.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: योऽर्थकामस्य वचनं प्रातिकूल्यान मृष्यते। शृणोति प्रतिकूलानि सर्वदा विमना इव॥ अग्राम्यचरितां वृत्तिं यो न सेवेत नित्यदा। जितानामजितानां च क्षत्रधर्मादपैति सः॥
en: That king, who does not accept the advice of a well-wisher for its being opposed to his own views, who listens with inattention to what is said to him in opposition to his views, and who does not always follow the conduct of high and noble persons conquered or unconquered, deviates from the duties of Kshatriyas.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: निगृहीतादमात्याच्च स्त्रीभ्यश्चैव विशेषतः। पर्वताद् विषमाद् दुर्गाद्धस्तिनोऽश्वात् सरीसृपात्। एतेभ्यो नित्ययुक्तः सन् रक्षेदात्मानमेव तु॥ मुख्यानमात्यान् यो हित्वा निहीनान् कुरुते प्रियान्। स वै व्यसनमासाद्य गाधमार्तो न विन्दति॥
en: From ministers, who have once been chastised, from women in particular, from mountains and inaccessible quarrels, from elephants and horses and reptiles, the king should always carefully guard himself. That king, who, leaving his chief ministers, makes favourites of low persons, soon falls into distress and never succeeds in attaining his objects.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: यः कल्याणगुणाज्ञातीन् प्रद्वेषान्नो बुभूषति। अदृढात्मा दृढक्रोधः स मृत्योर्वसतेऽन्तिके॥
en: That weak king, who, under the influence of anger and malice, does not love and honour those amongst his kinsmen, who are endued never with good qualities, is said to live on the very brink of destruction.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: अथ यो गुणसम्पन्नान् हृदयस्याप्रियानपि। प्रियेण कुरुते वश्यांश्चिरं यशसि तिष्ठति॥
en: That king, who wins over accomplished persons by doing good to them even though he may not like them heartily, succedes in enjoying fame for ever.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: नाकाले प्रणयेदर्थान्नाप्रिये जातु संज्वरेत्। प्रिये नातिभृशं तुष्येद् युज्येतारोग्यकर्मणि।॥
en: You should impose taxes unseasonably. You should not be sorry at the occurrence of anything disagreeable, nor rejoice exceedingly at anything agreeable. You should always try to accomplish good acts.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: के वानुरक्ताः राजानः के भयात् समुपाश्रिताः। मध्यस्थदोषाः के चैषामिति नित्यं विचिन्तयेत्॥
en: You should always determine who amongst the dependent kings is truly devoted to you, and who is loyal to you from fear, and who amongst them has faults.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: न जातु बलवान् भूत्वा दुर्बले विश्वसेत् क्वचित्। भारुण्डसदृशा ह्येते निपतन्ति प्रमाद्यतः॥
en: The king, even if he be powerful, should trust the weak, for in moments of carelessness the weak may attack the powerful like a flock of vultures seizing their prey.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: अपि सर्वगुणैर्युक्तं भर्तारं प्रियवादिनम्। अभिद्रुह्यति पापात्मा न तस्माद् विश्वसेज्जनात्॥
en: A sinful man seeks to injure his master even if the latter be sweet-speeched and endued with every accomplishment. Do not, therefore, repose confidence in such men.

description: How should a king guard himself
sn: एवं राजोपनिषदं ययातिः स्माह नाहुषः। मनुष्यविषये युक्तो हन्ति शत्रूननुत्तमान्॥
en: Nahusha's son Yayati, in describing the mysteries of king-craft, said that a person in ruling men should kill even contemptible foes.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अयुद्धेनैव विजयं वर्धयेद् वसुधाधिपः। जघन्यमाहुर्विजयं युद्धेन च नराधिप॥
en: Yudhishthira said The king should acquire victories without battles. Victories won by battles are not spoken of highly, O king, by the wise.

sn: न चाप्यलब्धं लिप्सेत मूले नातिदृढे सति। न हि दुर्बलमूलस्य राज्ञो लाभो विधीयते॥
en: When the sovereign's own power has not been consolidated, he should not try to make new acquisitions. It is not proper that a king whose power has not been confirmed should try to make such acquisitions.

sn: यस्य स्फीतो जनपदः सम्पन्नः प्रियराजकः। संतुष्टपुष्टसचिवो दृढमूलः स पार्थिवः॥
en: The power of that king whose territories are vast and contain immense wealth, whose subjects are loyal and contented, and who has a large number of officers, is said to be confirmed.

sn: यस्य योधाः सुसंतुष्टाः सान्त्विताः सूपधास्थिताः। अल्पेनापि स दण्डेन महीं जयति पार्थिवः॥
en: That king whose soldiers are contented, gratified and competent to impose on foes, can, with even a small force, subjugate the whole Earth.

sn: पौरजानपदा यस्य भूतेषु च दयालवः। सधना धान्यवन्तश्च दृढमूलः स पार्थिवः॥
en: The power of that king, whose subjects whether living in the cities or the provinces, have mercy for all creatures, and posses wealth and gain, is said to be confirmed.

sn: प्रतापकालमधिकं यदा मन्येत चात्मनः। तदा लिप्सेत मेधावी परभूमिधनान्युत॥
en: When the king thinks that his power is greater than that of an enemy, he should then, helped by his intelligence, seek to acquire the latter's territories and wealth.

sn: भोगेषूदयमानस्य भूतेषु च दयावतः। वर्धते त्वरमाणस्य विषयो रक्षितात्मनः॥
en: A king, whose resources are increasing, who is compassionate to all creatures, who never loses time by idleness, and who is careful in protecting his own self, succeeds in advancing himself.
