sn: श्रियो हि कारणाद् राजा सक्रियां लभते पराम्। सास्य गृहति पापानि वासो गुह्यमिव स्त्रियाः॥
en: By riches, the king acquires great honours. Indeed, riches conceal his very sins, as a dress conceals such parts of a female form as should not be exposed to the public gaze.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: ऋद्धिमस्यानु तप्यन्ते पुरा विप्रकृता नराः। शालावृका इवाजस्त्रं जिघांसुमेव विन्दति॥
en: The former enemies of the king become stricken with grief on seeing his newly acquired riches. Like dogs they once more serve him, and though they only seek an opportunity to kill him, he treats them as if nothing has taken place.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: ईदृशस्य कुतो राज्ञः सुखं भवति भारत। उद्यच्छेदेव न नमेदुद्यमो ह्येव पौरुषम्॥
en: How, O Bharata, can such a king enjoy happiness? The king should always try for acquiring greatness.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: अप्यपर्वणि भज्येत न नमतेह कस्यचित्। अप्यरण्यं समाश्रित्य चरेन्मृगगणैः सह॥
en: He should never bend low in humility. Exertion is manliness. He should rather break when an unfavourable opportunity comes than bend low before any one. He should rather go to the forest and live there with wild animals.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: न त्वेवोज्झितमर्यादैर्दस्युभिः सहितश्चरेत्। दस्यूनां सुलभा सेना रौद्रकर्मसु भारत॥
en: But he should not, however, live in the midst of ministers and officers who have like robbers transgressed all restraints. Even the wild robbers may supply a large number of soldiers for the performance of the fiercest of deeds. O Bharata.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: एकान्ततो ह्यमर्यादात् सर्वोऽप्युद्विजते जनः। दस्यवोऽप्यभिशङ्कन्ते निरनुक्रोशकारिणः॥
en: If the king disregards all healthy restraints, all people are filled with terror. They very robbers who know not what mercy is, fear such a king.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: स्थापयेदेव मर्यादां जनचित्तप्रसादिनीम्। अल्पेऽप्यर्थे च मर्यादा लोके भवति पूजिता॥
en: Therefore, the king, should always set down rules and restraints for pleasing his subjects. People always welcome rules even regarding insignificant matters.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: नायं लोकोऽस्ति न पर इति व्यवसितो जनः। नालं गन्तुं हि विश्वासं नास्तिके भयशङ्किते॥
en: There are men who hold that this world is nothing and the future also is a myth. He, who is such an undeliever, though his heart is moved by secret fears, should never be trusted.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: यथा सद्भिः परादानमहिंसा दस्युभिः कृता। अनुरज्यन्ति भूतानि समर्यादेषु दस्युषु॥
en: If the wild robbers, while observing other virtues, commit robberies, in respect of properties those deeds may be considered as innocent. The lives of thousands of creatures are protected when robbers follow such restraints.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: अयुद्ध्यमानस्य वधो दारामर्षः कृतघ्नता। ब्रह्मवित्तस्य चादानं निःशेषकरणं तथा॥ स्त्रिया मोषः पतिस्थानं दस्युष्वेतद् विगर्हितम्। संश्लेषं च परस्त्रीमिर्दस्युरेतानि वजयेत्॥
en: Killing a retreating enemy, ravishment of wives, ingratitude, plundering the property of a Brahmana, depriving a person of his entire property, violation of maidens, continued occupation of villages and towns as their lawful lords, and adultery with other people's wives.-these are known as sinful acts among even robbers, and robbers should always stand aloof from them.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: अभिसंदधते ये च विश्वासायास्य मानवाः। अशेषमेवोपलभ्य कुर्वन्तीति विनिश्चयः॥
en: It is again certain that those kings, who try to create confidence in robbers, succeed, after watching all their ins and outs, in rooting them out.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: तस्मात् सशेषं कर्तव्यं स्वाधीनमपि दस्युभिः। न बलस्थोऽहमस्मीति नृशंसानि समाचरेत्॥
en: Therefore, in dealing with robbers, it is necessary that they should not be destroyed outright. They should be gradually brought under the king's sway. The king should never treat them cruelly, thinking that he is more powerful than they.

description: How should a king replenish his Treasury in emergency
sn: स शेषकारिणस्तत्र शेषं पश्यन्ति सर्वशः। निःशेषकारिणो नित्यं निःशेषकरणाद् भयम्॥
en: Those kings, who do not root them out outright have no fear of their ruin, They, however, that do root them out, stand always in dread of them.'

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: भीष्म उवाच अत्र धर्मानुवचनं कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः। प्रत्यक्षावेव धर्मार्थो क्षत्रियस्य विजानतः॥ तत्र न व्यवधातव्यं परोक्षा धर्मयापना।
en: Bhishma said 'Regarding it, persons well read in the scriptures declare this text about duty, viz., for a learned and intelligent Kshatriya, (the acquisition) of religious merit and wealth is his obvious duty. By ingenuous discussions on duty and about the future world, he should not, abstain from performing those two duties.

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: अधर्मो धर्म इत्येतद् यथा वृकपदं तथा॥ धर्माधर्मफले जातु ददर्शेह न कश्चन।
en: As it is useless, upon seeing certain footprints on the ground, to argue, whether they are the wolf's or not, is all discussion regarding the nature of righteousness and unrighteousness. Nobody in this world ever witnesses the fruits of righteousness and unrighteousness.

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: बुभूषेद् बलमेवैतत् सर्वं बलवतो वशे॥ श्रियो बलममात्यांश्च बलवानिह विन्दति।
en: A Kshatriya, therefore, should try to acquire power. A powerful person is master of everything. Wealth secures the possession of an army. He, who is powerful, gets intelligent advisers.

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: यो ह्यनाढ्यः स पतितस्तदुच्छिष्टं यदल्पकम्॥ बह्वपथ्यं बलवति न किंचित् क्रियते भयात्। उभौ सत्यधिकारस्थौ त्रायते महतो भयात्॥
en: He is truly degraded who has no wealth. A little is considered as the filthy residue of a feast. If a strong men commits even many bed deeds, nobody, through fear, speaks ill of him. If Righteousness and Power be associated with Truth, they can save men from great dangers.

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: अतिधर्माद् बलं मन्ये बलाद् धर्मः प्रवर्तते। बले प्रतिष्ठितो धर्मो धरण्यामिव जङ्गमम्॥
en: If, however, the two be compared, Power will appear as superior to Righteousness. From Power originates Righteousness. Righteousness depends upon Power as all immobile things upon the Earth.

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: धूमो वायोरिव वशे बलं धर्मोऽनुवर्तते। अनीश्वरो बले धर्मो दुमे वल्लीव संश्रिता॥
en: As smoke depends upon the wind, so Righteousness depends upon Power. Righteousness which is the weaker of the two depends upon a tree.

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: वशे बलवतां धर्मः सुखं भोगवतामिव। नास्त्यसाध्यं बलवतां सर्वं बलवतां शुचि॥
en: Righteousness depends on the powerful does as pleasure on the pleasure hunters. There is nothing which powerful men cannot do. Everything is pure with the powerful.

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: दुराचारः क्षीणबलः परित्राणं न गच्छति। अथ तस्मादुद्विजते सर्वो लोको वृकादिव॥
en: By committing evil acts, a powerless men, can never escape. Men fear his conduct even as they are alarmed on seeing a wolf.

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: अपध्वस्तो ह्यवमतो दुःखं जीवति जीवितम्। जीवितं यदपक्रुष्टं यथैव मरणं तथा॥
en: One becoming poor after being rich leads a life of humiliation and sorrow. A life of humiliation and censure is like death itself.

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: यदेवमाहुः पापेन चारित्रेण विवर्जितः। सुभृशं तप्यते तेन वाक्शल्येन परिक्षतः॥
en: The learned have said that when on account of one's sinful deeds he is forsaken by friends and companions, he is cut again and again by the wordy arrows of others and has to burn with grief on that account.

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: अत्रैतदाहुराचार्याः पापस्य परिमोक्षणे। त्रयीं विद्यामवेक्षेत तथोपासीत वै द्विजान्॥ प्रसादयेच्चक्षुषा वाचा चाप्यथ कर्मणा। महामनाश्चापि भवेद् विवहेच्च महाकुले॥ इत्यस्मीति वदेदेवं परेषां कीर्तयेद् गुणान्। जपेदुदकशीलः स्यात् पेशलो नातिजल्पकः॥ ब्रह्मक्षत्रं सम्प्रविशेद् बहु कृत्वा सुदुष्करम्। उच्यमानो हि लोकेन बहुकृत् तदचिन्तयन्॥
en: Teachers of scriptures have held that for the expiation of sins one should study the three Vedas, serve and adore the Brahmanas, please all men by looks, words, and acts, shake off all meanness, merry in high families, sing the praises of others while admitting his own worthlessness, recite Mantras, perform the usual water-rites, assume a mildness of conduct, and abstain from too much speaking, and practise austere penances, seek refuge with the Brahmanas and Kshatriyas. Indeed, one who has perpretrated many evil acts, should do all this, without being angry at the censures of other man.

description: The acquisition of power by a Kshatriya
sn: अपापो ह्येवमाचारः क्षिप्रं बहुमतो भवेत्। सुखं च चित्रं भुञ्जीत कृतेनैकेन गोपयेत्॥ लोके च लभते पूजां परत्रेह महत् फलम्॥
en: By behaving thus, one is soon purged off of all his sins and wins the esteem of the world. Indeed, one acquires great respect in this world and meed in the next, and enjoys various sorts of happiness here by behaving thus and by sharing his riches with others.'

sn: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। यथा दस्युः समर्यादः प्रेत्यभावे न नश्यति॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old story of a robber who having in this world observed restraints was not ruined in the next.

sn: प्रहर्ता मतिमाशूरः श्रुतवाननृशंसवान्। रक्षन्नाश्रमिणां धर्मं ब्रह्मण्यो गुरुपूजकः॥ निषाद्यां क्षत्रियाज्जातः क्षत्रधर्मानुपालकः। कायव्यो नाम नैषादिर्दस्यत्वात् सिद्धिमाप्तवान्।॥
en: There was a robber by name Kayavya, born of a Kshatriya father and a Nishada mother. Kayavya followed Kshatriya duties. Capable of grinding, endued with intelligence and bravery, well-read in the scriptures, shorn of cruelty, devoted to the Brahmanas, and adoring his elders and preceptors with respect, he protected the ascetics who practised religious penances. Though a robber, he still acquired happiness in the celestial region.

sn: अरण्ये सायं पूर्वाह्ने मृगयूथप्रकोपिता। विधिज्ञो मृगजातीनां नैषादानां च कोविदः॥
en: Morning and evening he used to excite the anger of the deer by chasing them. He knew very well the practises of the hunters as also of all animals living in the wilderness.

sn: सर्वकालप्रदेशज्ञः पारियात्रचरः सदा। धर्मज्ञः सर्वभूतानाममोघेषुटुंढायुधः॥
en: Well acquainted with the requirements of time and place, he roamed over the mountains. Knowing full well the habits of all animals, his never missed their aim, and his weapons were strong.

sn: अप्यनेकशता सेनामेक एव जिगाय सः। स वृद्धावन्धवधिरौ महारण्येऽभ्यपूजयत्॥
en: Alone, he could defeat many hundreds of soldiers. He adored daily his old, blind, and deaf parents in the forest.

sn: मधुमांसैर्मूलफलैरन्नरुच्चावचैरपि। सत्कृत्य भोजयामास मान्यान् परिचचार च॥
en: With honey, meat, fruits, roots and other kinds of excellent food, he hospitably treated all persons worthy of honour and did them many good offices.

sn: आरण्यकान् प्रव्रजितान् ब्राह्मणान् परिपूजयन्। अपि तेभ्यो गृहान् गत्वा निनाय सततं वने।॥
en: arrows He showed great reverence for those Brahmanas who had retired from the world for living in the forest. Killing the deer, he often took meat to them.

sn: येऽस्मान्न प्रतिगृह्णन्ति दस्युभोजनशङ्कया। तेषामासज्य गेहेषु कल्य एव स गच्छति॥
en: As regards those who were reluctant, from fear of others, to accept gifts from him for the profession he followed, he used to repair to their houses before dawn and leave meat at their doors.

sn: बहूनि च सहस्राणि ग्रामणित्वेऽभिवतिरे। निर्मर्यादानि दस्यूनां निरनुक्रोशवर्तिनाम्॥
en: One day many thousands of irregular and merciless robbers desired to let him as their leader.

sn: दस्यव ऊचुः मुहूर्तदेशकालज्ञः प्राज्ञः शूरो दृढव्रतः। ग्रामणीर्भव नो सर्वेषामेव सम्मतः॥ मुख्यः
en: The robbers said You are acquainted with the requirements of place and time. You have wisdom and courage. Great is your firmness in everything you take up! Be you our chief of leaders, adored by all of us!

sn: यथा यथा वक्ष्यसि नः करिष्यामस्तथा तथा पालयास्मान् यथान्यायं यथा माता यथा पिता।॥
en: We will follow your behest! Protect us duly, even as a father or a another.

sn: कायव्य उवाच मा वधीस्त्वं स्त्रियं भीरूं मा शिष्टुं मा तपस्विनम्। नायुद्ध्यमानो हन्तव्यो न च ग्राह्या बलात् स्त्रियः॥
en: Kayavya said Never kill you, a woman, or a person who retreats in fear from fight, or a child, or an ascetic! You should not kill one who abstains from fight, nor should you seize or carry women by force.

sn: सर्वथा स्त्री न हन्तव्या सर्वसत्त्वेषु केनचित्। नित्यं तु ब्राह्मणे स्वस्ति योद्धव्यं च तदर्थतः॥
en: None of you should ever kill a woman amongst all creatures. Let Brahmanas be always blessed and you should always fight for their well-being.

sn: सत्यं च नापि हर्तव्यं सारविघ्नं च मा कृथाः। पूज्यन्ते यत्र देवाश्च पितरोऽतिथयस्तथा॥
en: You should never sacrifice truth. You should never obstruct the marriages of men. You should never injure those houses in which the deities, the Pitris, and guests and adored.

sn: सर्वभूतेष्वपि च वै ब्राह्मणो मोक्षमर्हति। कार्या चोपचितिस्तेषां सर्वस्वेनापि या भवेत्॥
en: Amongst creatures, Brahmanas should always be exempted by you in your plunders. By giving away everything you have you should adore them.

sn: यस्य ह्येते सम्प्ररुष्टा मन्त्रयन्ति पराभवम्। न तस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु त्राता भवति कश्चन॥
en: He, who incurs the anger of the Brahmanas, he, whose discomfiture they seek, cannot find a rescuer in the three worlds.

sn: यो ब्राह्मणान् परिवदेद् विनाशं चापि रोचयेत्। सूर्योदय इव ध्वान्ते ध्रुवं तस्य पराभवः॥
en: He, who vilifies the Brahmanas and wishes for their destruction, is himself ruined like darkness at sunrise.

sn: इहैव फलमासीनः प्रत्याकाङ्क्षेत सर्वशः। ये ये नो न प्रदास्यन्ति तांस्तांस्तेनाभियास्यसि॥
en: Living here, you shall acquire the fruits of your valour. Troops will be sent against those who will refuse to give us our dues.

sn: शिष्ट्यर्थं विहितो दण्डो न वृद्ध्यर्थं विनिश्चयः। ये च शिष्टान् प्रबाधन्ते दण्डस्तेषां वधः स्मृतः॥
en: The rod of punishment is intended for the wicked. It is not intended for self-seeking. They who oppress the good should be killed.

sn: ये च राष्ट्रोपरोधेन वृद्धिं कुर्वन्ति केचन। तदैव तेऽनुमार्यन्ते कुणपे कृमयो यथा॥
en: They who seek to multiply their fortunes by afflicting kingdoms unscrupulously, are as vermins in a dead body.

sn: ये पुनर्धर्मशास्त्रेण वर्तेरनिह दस्यवः। अपि ते दस्यवो भूत्वा क्षिप्रं सिद्धिमवाप्नुयुः॥
en: Those robbers, again, who would follow the restraints of the scriptures, would soon acquire salvation although leading a plundering life.

sn: भीष्म उवाच ते सर्वमेवानुचुः कायव्यस्यानुशासनम्। वृद्धिं च लेभिरे सर्वे पापेभ्यश्चाप्युपारमन्॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed, those robbers obeyed all the commands of Kayavya. By desisting from sin, they acquired great prosperity.

sn: कायव्यः कर्मणा तेन महतीं सिद्धिमाप्तवान्। साधूनामाचरन् क्षेमं दस्यून् पापान्निवर्तयन्॥
en: By behaving thus, by thus doing good to the honest and by thus restraining the robbers from bad practices, Kayavya acquired great success (in the next world).

sn: इदं कायव्यचरितं यो नित्यमनुचिन्तयेत्। नारण्येभ्यो हि भूतेभ्यो भयं प्राप्नोति किंचन॥
en: He, who always meditates on this narrative of Kayavya will have no fear from the forestrangers, in fact, from any earthly creature.

sn: न भयं तस्य भूतेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यश्चैव भारत। नासतो विद्यते राजन् स शरण्येषु गोपतिः॥
en: Such a man will have no fear from any creature, O Bharata. He will have no fear from wicked men. If such a man goes to the forest, he will be able to live there as securely as a king.

description: How should a king fill his Treasury
sn: भीष्म उवाच अत्र गाथा ब्रह्मगीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः। येन मार्गेण राजा वै कोशं संजनयत्युत॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding the way in which a king should fill his treasury, persons will read in the scriptures of olden days, cite the following verses sung by Brahmana himself.

description: How should a king fill his Treasury
sn: न धनं यज्ञशीलानां हार्यं देवस्वमेव च। दस्यूनां निष्क्रियाणां च क्षत्रियो हर्तुमर्हति॥
en: The wealth of persons who celebrate sacrifices, as also the wealth dedicated to the deities, should never be taken. A Kshatriya should take the wealth of such persons as never perform religious rites and sacrifices, and who are, therefore, considered to be equal to robbers.

description: How should a king fill his Treasury
sn: इमाः प्रजाः क्षत्रियाणां राज्यभोगाश्च भारत। धनं हि क्षत्रियस्यैव द्वितीयस्य न विद्यते॥
en: All the creatures of the Earth and all the enjoyments of sovereignty, O Bharata, belong to the Kshatriyas. All the wealth of the Earth is the Kshatriya's and not any one's else.

description: How should a king fill his Treasury
sn: तदस्य स्याद् बलार्थ वा धनं यज्ञार्थमेव च। अभोग्याश्चौषधीश्छित्त्वा भोग्या एव पचन्त्युत॥
en: The Kshatriya should use that wealth for mairtaining his army and for the celebration of sacrifices. Tearing up useless creepers and plants, men burn them for cooking vegetables of food.

description: How should a king fill his Treasury
sn: यो वै न देवान् न पितृन् न मान् हविषार्चति। अनर्थकं धनं तः प्राहुर्धर्मविदो जनाः॥
en: Men knowing duty have said that useless is his wealth who does not, with libations of clarificd butter, feed the gods, the Pitris, and men.

description: How should a king fill his Treasury
sn: हरेत् तद् द्रविणं राजन् धार्मिकः पृथिवीपतिः। ततः प्रीणयते लोकं न कोशं तद्विधं नृपः॥
en: O king, A virtuous ruler, should appropriate such riches. By that wealth, a large number of good people can be pleased. He should not, however, amass that wealth in his treasury.

description: How should a king fill his Treasury
sn: असाधुभ्योऽर्थमादाय साधुभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति। आत्मानं संक्रमं कृत्वा कृत्स्नधर्मविदेव सः॥
en: He, who is the instrument of acquisition and, taking away wealth from the wicked, gives them to those that are good, knows well the science of virtue.

description: How should a king fill his Treasury
sn: तथा तथा जयेल्लोकाशक्त्या चैव यथा यथा। उद्भिज्जा जन्तवो यद्वच्छुक्लजीवा यथा यथा॥ अनिमित्तात् सम्भवन्ति तथाऽयज्ञः प्रजायते॥
en: A king should conquer the next world according to the measure of his power, and as gradually as vegetables grow. As some ants are seen to originate from an insignificant cause, even so sacrifice springs from insufficient wealth.

description: How should a king fill his Treasury
sn: यथैव दंशमशकं यथा चाण्डपिपीलिकम्। सैव वृत्तिरयज्ञेषु यथा धर्मो विधीयते॥
en: As flies, gnats, and ants are driven off from the bodies of kine and other domestic animals, so should all persons, who are averse to the celebration of sacrifices, should be similarly driven off from the kingdom. This is quite of a piece with morality.

description: How should a king fill his Treasury
sn: यथा ह्यकस्माद् भवति भूमौ पांसुर्विलोलितः। तथैवेह भवेद् धर्मः सूक्ष्मः सूक्ष्मतरस्तथा॥
en: As being pounded between two stones, the dust becomes finer and finer, so questions of morality, the more they are discussed, becomes subtler and subtler.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: भीष्म उवाच अनागतविधाता च प्रत्युत्पन्नमतिश्च यः। द्वावेव सुखमेधेते दीर्घसूत्री विनश्यति॥
en: Bhishma said 'The two, viz., one, who provides for the future, and one, who has presence of mind—always enjoy happiness. An idle man gains nothing.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: अत्रैव चेदमव्यग्रं शृणुष्वाख्यानमुत्तमम्। दीर्घसूत्रमुपाश्रित्य कार्याकार्यविनिश्चये॥
en: About it, listen attentively to the following excellent story of an idle person, who is expert to take decision in good or bed deeds.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: नातिगाधे जलाधारे सुहृदः कुशलास्त्रयः। प्रभूतमत्स्ये कौन्तेय बभूवुः सहचारिणः॥
en: In shallow lake which abounded with fishes, there lived three Shakula fishes who were friends and constant companions.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: तत्रैको दीर्घकालज्ञ उत्पन्नप्रतिभोऽपरः। दीर्घसूत्रश्च तत्रैकस्त्रयाणां सहचारिणाम्॥
en: Of those three, one had much fore-thought always liked to provide for the future. Another had great presence of mind. The third was idle.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: कदाचित् तं जलस्थायं मत्स्यबन्धाः समन्ततः। निस्त्रावयामासुरथो निम्नेषु विविधैर्मुखैः॥
en: One day certain fishermen came to that lake and began to draw out its waters to a lower ground through various channels,

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: प्रक्षीयमाणं तं दृष्ट्वा जलस्थायं भयागमे। अब्रवीद् दीर्घदर्शी तु तावुभौ सुहृदौ तदा॥
en: Seeing the water of the lake gradually decreasing, the fish that had much foresight, said to his two companions about the coming danger.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: इयमापत् समुत्पन्ना सर्वेषां सलिलौकसाम्। शीघ्रमन्यत्र गच्छामः पन्था यावन्न दुष्यति॥
en: A great danger is about to befall the aquatic animals living in this lake. Let us quickly go to some other place before our path becomes obstructed.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: अनागतमनर्थं हि सुनयैर्यः प्रबाधयेत्। स न संशयमाप्नोति रोचतां भो व्रजामहे॥
en: He, who resists future evil by the help of good policy, never meets with serious danger. You follow my advice. Lest us all quit this place.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: दीर्घसूत्रस्तु यस्तत्र सोऽब्रवीत् सम्यगुच्यते। न त कार्या त्वरा तावदिति मे निश्चिता मतिः॥
en: That one, amongst the three, who was idle then answered,-It is well said. There is, however, no necessity of such haste. This is my opinion.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: अथ सम्प्रतिपत्तिज्ञः प्राब्रवीद् दीर्घदर्शिनम्। प्राप्ते काले न मे किंचिन्यायतः परिहास्यते॥
en: Then the other fish, who had presence of mind, said to his idle companion,-When the time for anything comes, I take the necessary precautions.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: एवं श्रुत्वा निराक्रम्य दीर्घदर्शी महामतिः। जगाम स्रोतसा तेन गम्भीरं सलिलाशयम्॥
en: Hearing the replies of his two companions, the one, which had fore-thought and intelligence, immediately started by a current and reached another deep lake.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: ततः प्रसृततोयं तं प्रसमीक्ष्य जलाशयम्। बबन्धुर्विविधैर्योगैर्मत्स्यान् मत्स्योपजीविनः॥
en: Seeing that all the water had been drawn out, the fishermen shut in the fishes which remained by various means.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: विलोड्यमाने तस्मिंस्तु स्रुततोये जलाशये। अगच्छद् बन्धनं तत्र दीर्घसूत्रः सहापरैः॥
en: Then they began to agitate the little remaining water, and as they began to catch the fish, the idle Shakula was caught with many others.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: उद्याने क्रियमाणे तु मत्स्यानां तत्र रज्जुभिः। प्रविश्यान्तरमेतेषां स्थितः सम्प्रतिपत्तिमान्॥ गृह्यमेव तदुद्यानं गृहीत्वा तं तथैव सः। सर्वानेव च तांस्तत्र ते विदुर्ग्रथितानिति॥
en: When the fishermen began to tie up the fishes they had caught, the Shakula who was known for presence of mind placed himself in the midst of those that had been so tied and remained quietly among them, biting the string, for he thought that by it they would take him to have been caught. The fisherman believed that all the fishes tied to the string had been caught.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: ततः प्रक्षाल्यमानेषु मत्स्येषु विपुले जले। मुक्त्वा रज्जु प्रमुक्तोऽसौ शीघ्रं सम्प्रतिपत्तिमान्॥
en: They then removed them to a deep, water for washing them, Just then the Shakula known for presence of mind, left the string, and quickly escaped.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: दीर्घसूत्रस्तु मन्दात्मा हीनबुद्धिरचेतनः। मरणं प्राप्तवान् मूढो यथैवोपहतेन्द्रियः॥
en: That fish, however, who had been idle. foolish, and senseless and without intelligence, and, therefore, unable to escape, met with his death.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: एवं प्राप्ततमं कालं यो मोहान्नावबुद्ध्यते। स विनश्यति वै क्षिप्रं दीर्घसूत्रो यथा झषः॥
en: Like the idle fish, who from want of intelligence could not forsee the danger, every one meets with destruction.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: आदौ न कुरुते श्रेयः कुशलोऽस्मीति यः पुमान्। स संशयमवाप्नोति यथा सम्प्रतिपत्तिमान्॥
en: Again, a man, who knowing himself as clever, does not seek his own good improper time, is visited by great dangers like the Shakula who had presence of mind.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: अनागतविधाता च प्रत्युत्पन्नमतिश्च यः। द्वावेव सुखमेधेते दीर्घसूत्रो विनश्यति॥
en: Therefore these two only, viz., he, who has much forethought and he, who has presence of mind, can secure happiness. An idle person, however, meets with destruction.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: काष्ठाः कला मुहूर्ताश्च दिवा रात्रिस्तथा लवाः। मासाः पक्षाः षड् ऋतवः कल्प: संवत्सरास्तथा॥
en: There are various divisions of time, such as Kashtha, Kala, Muhurta, day, night, Lava, inonth, fortnight, the six seasons, Kalpa, year.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: पृथिवी देश इत्युक्तः कालः स च न दृश्यते। अभिप्रेतार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं ध्यायते यच्च तत्तथा॥
en: The divisions of the Earth are called place. Time is not seen. Regarding the success of any object or purpose, it is gained or not gained according to the manner in which the mind is engaged to think of it.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: एतौ धर्मार्थशास्त्रेषु मोक्षशास्त्रेषु चर्षिभिः। प्रधानाविति निर्दिशै कामे चाभिमतौ नृणाम्॥
en: Therefore, the person of forethought and the person of presence of mind, have been described by the Rishis, to be the foremost of men in all works on virtue, profit and emancipation.

description: The excellent story of an idle man
sn: परीक्ष्यकारी युक्तश्च स सम्यगुपपादयेत्। देशकालावभिप्रेतौ ताभ्यां फलमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: One, however, who does everything after reflection and scrutiny, one, who takes the advantage of proper means for the achievement of his objects, always succeeds in achieving much. Those, again, who work with proper attention to time and place, succeed in acquiring fruits better than the mere man of foresight and the man of presence of mind.'

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सर्वत्र बुद्धिः कथिता श्रेष्ठा ते भरतर्षभ। अनागता तथोत्पन्ना दीर्घसूत्रा विनाशिनी॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have, O foremost of Bharata's race, said that, that intelligence which provides for the future, as well as that which can meet present difficulties, is always superior, while idleness brings about destruction.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तदिच्छामि परां श्रोतुं बुद्धिं ते भरतर्षभ। यथा राजा न मुह्येत शत्रुभिः परिवारितः॥ धर्मार्थकुशलो राजा धर्मशास्त्रविशारदः। पृच्छामि त्वां कुरुश्रेष्ठ तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: I wish, O grandfather, to hear of that superior intelligence by which king, conversant with the scriptures and well-versed in virtue and profit, may not be stupefied even when surrounded by many enemies. I ask you this, O Kuru chief! You should describe it to a me.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: शत्रुभिर्बहुभिर्गस्तो यथा वर्तेत पार्थिवः। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं सर्वमेव यथाविधि।॥
en: I wish to hear everything in connection with the duties of king when he is attacked by many foes, as has been laid down in the scriptures.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: विषमस्थं हि राजानं शत्रवः परिपन्थिनः। बहवोऽप्येकमुद्धर्तुं यतन्ते पूर्वतापिताः॥
en: When a king meets with distress, a large number of enemies, provoked by his past deeds, rise against him and try to defeat him.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: सर्वत्र प्रार्थ्यमानेन दुर्बलेन महाबलैः। एकेनैवासहायेन शक्यं स्थातुं भवेत् कथम्॥
en: How can king, weak and alone, hold his own, when attacked on all sides by many powerful kings joined in a body?

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: कथं मित्रमरिं चापि विन्दते भरतर्षभ। चेष्टितव्यं कथं चात्र शत्रोमित्रस्य चान्तरे॥
en: How does a king at such times make friends and enemies? How should he, O foremost of Bharata's race, treat at such a time, both his friends and enemies?

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: प्रज्ञातलक्षणे मित्रे तथैवामित्रतां गते। कथं तु पुरुषः कुर्यात् कृत्वा किं वा सुखी भवेत्॥
en: When those, who are friends really become his enemies, what should the king then do if he is to secure happiness?

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: विग्रहं केन वा कुर्यात् संधिं वा केन योजयेत्। कथं वा शत्रुमध्यस्थो वर्तेत बलवानपि॥
en: With whom should he make war and with whom should he make peace? Even if he be strong, how should he act by his foes?

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: एतद् वै सर्वकृत्यानां परं कृत्यं परंतप। नैतस्य कश्चिद् वक्तास्ति श्रोता वापि सुदुर्लभः॥ ऋते शान्तनवाद् भीष्मात् सत्यसंधाज्जितेन्द्रियात्। तदन्विष्य महाभाग सर्वमेतद् वदस्व मे।" ।।
en: O scorcher of foes, this I consider to be the most momentous of all questions regarding the satisfaction of royal duties. There are few men, who wish to listen to the answer of this question, and none answer it except Shantanu's truthful son Bhishma, who has ail his senses under control. O you, who are highly blessed, think on it and describe it to me. to

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: भीष्म उवाच त्वयुक्तोऽयमनुप्रश्नो युधिष्ठिर सुखोदयः। शृणु मे पुत्र कात्स्र्थेन गुह्यमापत्सु भारत॥
en: 'O Yudhishthira, this question certainly becomes you. Its answer yields great happiness. Listen to me, O son, as I describe to you, O Bharata, all the duties which are not generaliy known, but which should be practised in times of distress.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अमित्रो मित्रतां याति मित्रं चापि प्रदुष्यति। सामर्थ्ययोगात् कार्याणामनित्या वै सदा गतिः॥
en: An enemy becomes a friend, and a friend also becomes an enemy. Through combination of circumstances, human actions become uncertain.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तस्माद् विश्वसितव्यं च विग्रहं च समाचरेत्। देशं कालं च विज्ञाय कार्याकार्यविनिश्चये॥
en: Regarding what should be done and what should not, it is necessary that in view of the requirements of time and place, one should either trust one's enemies or make war.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: संधातव्यं बुधैर्नित्यं व्यवस्य च हितार्थिभिः। अमित्रैरपि संधेयं प्राणा रक्ष्या हि भारत॥
en: Trying his very best, one should make friends with intelligent and wise men who desire his welfare. one should make peace with even his enemy, when, O Bharata his life cannot be saved by any other means.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यो ह्यमित्रैर्नरो नित्यं न संदध्यादपण्डितः। न सोऽर्थं प्राप्नुयात् किंचित् फलान्यपि च भारत॥
en: That foolish wight, who never makes peace with enemies, cannot acquire any profit or any of those fruits for which others try.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यस्त्वमित्रेण संदध्यान्मित्रेण च विरुद्ध्यते। अर्थयुक्तिं समालोक्य सुमहद् विन्दते फलम्॥
en: He, again, who makes peace with enemies and falls out with even friends after carefully considering all circumstances, acquires great fruits.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। मार्जारस्य च संवादं न्यग्रोधे मूषिकस्य च॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old story of the conversation between a cat and mouse at the foot of a banian tree.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: वनो महति कस्मिंश्चिन्यग्रोधः सुमहानभूत्। लताजालपरिच्छिन्नो नानाद्विजगणान्वितः॥
en: Bhishma said There was a huge banian tree in the midst of a vast forest. Covered with many sorts of creepers, and various sorts of birds used to live on it.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: स्कन्धवान् मेघसङ्काशः शीतच्छायो मनोरमः। अरण्यमभितो जातः स तु व्यालमृगाकुलः॥
en: It had a large trunk from which numerous branches spread on all sides. Delightful to look at, its shade was very refreshing. It stood in the midst of the forest, and various animals lived on it.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तस्य मूलं समाश्रित्य कृत्वा शतमुखं बिलम्। वसति स्म महाप्राज्ञः पलितो नाम मूषिकः॥
en: A highly wise mouse, named Palita, lived at the foot of that tree, having made a hole there with a hundred outlets.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: शाखां तस्य समाश्रित्य वसति स्म सुखं पुरा। लोमशो नाम मार्जारः पक्षिसंघातखादकः॥
en: On the branches of the tree there lived happily a cat, by name Lomasha, daily devouring large number of birds.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तत्र चागत्य चाण्डालो शरण्ये कृतकेतनः प्रयोजयति चोन्माथं नित्यमस्तंगते रवौ॥
en: Sometime after, a Chandala came to that forest and built a hut for himself. Every evening after sunset he spread his traps.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तत्र स्नायुमयान् पाशान् यथावत् संविधाय सः। गृहं गत्वा सुखं शेते प्रभातामेति शर्वरीम्॥
en: Spreading his nets made a leathern strings, he returned to his hut, and, passing the night happily in sleep, returned thert at the dawn of day.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तत्र स्म नित्यं बध्यन्ते नक्तं बहुविधा मृगाः। कदाचिदत्र मार्जारस्त्वप्रमत्तो व्यबध्यत॥
en: Various sorts of animals fell into his traps nightly. And it so took place that one day the cat in a moment of carelessness was caught in the trap.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तस्मिन् बधे महाप्राणे शत्रौ नित्याततायिनि। तं कालं पलितो ज्ञात्वा प्रचचार सुनिर्भयः॥
en: O you of great wisdom, when his enemy the cat, who is always an enemy of the mice, was thus caught in the trap, the mouse Palita came out of his hole and began to move about fearlessly.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तेनानुचरता तस्मिन् वने विश्वस्तचारिणा। भक्ष्यं मृगयमाणेन चिराद् दृष्टं तदामिषम्॥
en: While confidently passing through the forest in search of food, the mouse after a little while saw the meat.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: स तमुन्माथमारुह्य तदामिषमभक्षयत्॥ तस्योपरि सपत्नस्य बद्धस्य मनसा हसन्।
en: Getting upon the trap, the little animal began to eat the flesh. Laughing in his mind, he even got upon his enemy caught in the net.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: आमिषे तु प्रसक्तः स कदाचिदवलोकयन्॥ अपश्यदपरं घोरमात्मनः शत्रुमागतम्।
en: Busy with eating the flesh, did not see his own danger, and as he suddenly cast his eyes, he saw there a dreadful enemy of his.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: शरप्रसूनसङ्काशं महीविवरशायिनम्॥ नकुलं हरिणं नाम चपलं ताम्रलोचनम्।
en: It was a restless mongoose of coppery eyes, of the name of Harita. Living in holes underneath, its body resembled the flower of a reed.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तेन मूषिकगन्धेन त्वरमाणमुपागतम्॥ भक्ष्यार्थं संलिहानं तं भूमावूर्ध्वमुखं स्थितम्। शाखागतमरिं चान्यमपश्यत् कोटरालयम्॥ उलूकं चन्द्रकं नाम तीक्ष्णतुण्डं क्षपाचरम्। गतस्य विषयं तत्र नकुलोलूकयोस्तथा॥ अथास्यासीदियं चिन्ता तत् प्राप्य सुमहद्भयम्।
en: Tempted to come there by the scent of the mouse, the animal came quickly for devouring his pray. He stood on his haunches, with head raised up and licking the corners of his mouth with his tongue. The mouse saw at the same time another enemy living in the holes of trees, then sitting on the branch of the banian. It was night-ranging owl, by name Chandraka having sharp beaks. Being seen both by the mongoose and the owl, the mouse, in great fear, began to think thus.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: आपद्यस्यां सुकशयां मरणे प्रत्युपस्थिते॥ समन्ताद् भय उत्पन्ने कथं कार्यं हितैषिणा।
en: In such a great danger, when death itself is staring me in the face, when fear prevails on every side, how should one act who seeks his own well being?

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: स तथा सर्वतो रुद्धः सर्वत्र भयदर्शनः॥ अभवद् भयसंतप्तश्चक्रे च परमां मतिम्।
en: Beset with danger, and seeing fear on all sides, the mouse, stricken with fear for his safety, made a high resolution.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: आपद्विनाशभूयिष्ठं गतैः कार्यं हि जीवितम्॥ समन्तात् संशयात् सैषा तस्मादापदुपस्थिता।
en: Preventing numberless dangers by hundreds of means, one should always save his life. Danger, now, besets me on every side.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: गतं मा सहसा भूमिं नकुलो भक्षयिष्यति॥ उलूकश्छेह तिष्ठन्तं मार्जार: पाशसंक्षयात्।
en: If I were to descend from this trap on the ground, without sufficient precautions, the mongoose will surely catch and devour me. If I remain on this trap, the owl will surely catch me. If, again, the cat can free himself for the net, he, also, is certain to devour me.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न त्वेवास्मद्विधः प्राज्ञः सम्मोहं गन्तुमर्हति॥ करिष्ये जीविते यत्नं यावद् युक्त्या प्रतिग्रहात्।
en: It is not proper, therefore, that a person intelligent like myself should lose his wits. I shall, therefore, try me best to save my life, by having recourse to proper means and intelligence.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न हि बुद्ध्यान्वितः प्राज्ञो नीतिशास्त्रविशारदः॥ निमज्जत्यापदं प्राप्य महतीं दारुणामपि॥
en: An intelligent and wise person and conversant with the science of policy never sinks, however great and terrible may be the danger which threatens him.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न त्वन्यामिह मार्जाराद् गतिं पश्यामि साम्प्रतम्। विषमस्थो ह्ययं शत्रुः कृत्यं चास्य महन्मया॥
en: At present, however, I do not see any other refuge than this cat. He is an enemy. But he is in difficulty. The service that I can do him is verygreat.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: जीवितार्थी कथं त्वद्य शत्रुभिः प्रार्थितस्त्रिभिः। तस्मादेनमहं शत्रु मार्जारं संश्रयामि वै॥
en: Three enemies are trying to devour me, and how should I now act for saving my life? I should now seek refuge with one of those enemies, viz., the cat.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: नीतिशास्त्रं समाश्रित्य हितमस्योपवर्णये। येनेमं शत्रुसंघातं मतिपूर्वेण वञ्चये॥
en: Following policy, let me advice the cat for his behoof, so that I may, with my intelligence, escape from all three.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अयमत्यन्तशत्रुर्मे वैषम्यं परमं गतः। मूढो ग्राहयितुं स्वार्थं सङ्गत्या यदि शक्यते॥ कदाचिद् व्यसनं प्राप्य संधि कुर्यान्मया सह!
en: The cat is my great enemy, but the danger into which he has fallen is very great. Let me see if I can make this foolish creature understand his own interests. Having fallen into such difficulty he may make peace with me.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: बलिना संनिकृष्टस्य शत्रोरपि परिग्रहः॥ कार्य इत्याहुराचार्या विषमे जीवितार्थिना।
en: A person, when attacked by a stronger one, should make peace with even an enemy. People conversant with policy say that such should be the conduct of one, who being beset with danger seeks to save his life.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: श्रेष्ठो हि पण्डितः शत्रुर्न च मित्रमपण्डितः॥ मम त्वमित्रे माजरि जीवितं सम्प्रतिष्ठितम्।
en: It is better to have a learned person for an enemy than a fool for a friend. As for myself, my life now depends entirely on the hands of my enemy the cat.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: हन्तास्मै सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि हेतुमात्माभिरक्षणे॥ अपीदानीमयं शत्रुः सङ्गत्या पण्डितो भवेत्।
en: I shall now speak to the cat about his own liberation. Perhaps, now it would not be wrong to consider the cat an intelligent and learned enemy. Thus did that mouse, surrounded by foes, think.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: एवं विचिन्तयामास मूषिकः शत्रुचेष्टितम्॥ ततोऽर्थगतितत्त्वज्ञः संधिविग्रहकालवित्। सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वाक्यं मार्जारं मूषिकोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Having thought thus, the mouse, well-read in the science of Profit and well-acquainted with times when war should be declared and peace made, gently spoke to the cat, saying,

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: सौहृदेनाभिभाषे त्वां कच्चिन्मार्जार जीवसि। जीवितं हि तवेच्छामि श्रेयः साधारणं हि नौ॥
en: I speak to you as a friend. O cat! Are you alive? I wish you to live! I seek the good of us both.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न ते सौम्य भयं कार्यं जीविष्यसि यथासुखम्। अहं त्वामुद्धरिष्यामि यदि मां न जिघांससि॥
en: O amiable one, you have no cause for fear. You will live in happiness! I shall save you, If, indeed, you do not kill me.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अस्मि कश्चिदुपायोऽत्र दुष्करः प्रतिभाति मे। येन शक्यस्त्वया मोक्षः प्राप्तुं श्रेयस्तथा मया॥
en: There is a very good means I see by which you may obtain escape and I may acquire great benefit.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: मयाप्युपायो दृष्टोऽयं विचार्य मतिमात्मनः। आत्मार्थं च त्वदर्थं च श्रेय: साधारणं हि नौ॥
en: By thinking I have found out this expedient for your sake and for my sake, for it will do us both good.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: इदं हि नकुलोलूकं पापबुद्ध्याभिसंस्थितम्। न धर्षयति मार्जार तेन मे स्वस्ति साम्प्रतम्॥
en: There are the mongoose and the owl, both waiting with evil desire. O cat, so long as they do not attack me, my life is safe.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: कूजंश्चपलनेत्रोऽयं कौशिको मां निरीक्षते। नगशाखाग्रगः पापस्तस्याहं भृशमुद्विजे॥
en: There that wretched owl with restless looks and dreadful cries is seeing me from the branch of that tree! I am stricken with great fear.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: सतां साप्तपदं मैत्रं स सखा मेऽसि पण्डितः। सांवास्यकं करिष्यामि नास्ति ते भयमद्य वै॥
en: Good men become friends by walking together only seven steps. Highly wise as you are, you are my friend. I shall treat you as a friend. You need have no fear now.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न हि शक्तोऽसि मार्जार पाशं छेत्तुं मया विना। अहं छेत्स्यामि पाशांस्ते यदि मां त्वं न हिंससि॥
en: Without my help, O cat, you will not be able to tear the net. I, however, shall cut the net for serving you, if you do not kill me.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: त्वमाश्रितो दुमस्याग्रं मूलं त्वहमुपाश्रितः। चिरोषितावुभावावां वृक्षेऽस्मिन् विदितं च ते॥
en: You have lived on this tree and I have lived at its foot. Both of us have lived here for many long years, All this is known to you.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यस्मिन्नाश्वासते कश्चिद् यश्च नाश्वसिति क्वचित्। न तो धीराः प्रशंसन्ति नित्यमुद्विग्नमानसौ॥
en: The wise never laud him whom nobody trusts, nor him who never trusts another. Both of them are unhappy.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तस्माद् विवर्धतां प्रीतिर्नित्यं संगतमस्तु कालातीतमिहार्थं तु न प्रशंसन्ति पण्डिताः॥
en: Therefore, let our love for each other increase, and let us be united. The wise never speak highly of the attempt of doing an act when its opportunity is gone.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अर्थयुक्तिमिमां तत्र यथाभूतां निशामय। तव जीवितमिच्छामि त्वं ममेच्छसि जीवितम्॥ नौ।
en: Know this to be the proper time for such a compact between us. I wish that you should live, and you also wish that I should live.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: कश्चित् तरति काष्ठेन सुगम्भीरां महानदीम्। स तारयति तत् काष्ठं स च काष्ठेन तार्यते॥
en: A men crosses a deep and large river by a piece of wood. It is seen there that the man takes the piece of wood to the other side, and the piece of wood also takes the man to the other side.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: ईदृशो नौ समायोगो भविष्यति सुविस्तरः। अहं त्वां तारयिष्यामि मां च त्वं तारयिष्यसि॥
en: Like this, our agreement will lead to our happiness. I will save you, also, and you also will save me.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: एवमुक्त्वा तु पलितस्तमर्थमुभयोर्हितम्। हेतुमद् ग्रहणीयं च कालापेक्षी न्यवेक्ष्य च॥
en: Having said so, which was beneficial to both of them, highly reasonable and acceptable, the mouse Palita waited for an answer.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अथ सुव्याहृतं श्रुत्वा तस्य शत्रोविचक्षणः। हेतुमद् ग्रहणीयार्थं मार्जारो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing these well-selected, reasonable and good words of the mouse, the mouse's enemy, endued with judgement and forethought, the cat said these words in reply.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: बुद्धिमान् वाक्यसम्पन्नस्तद्वाक्यमनुवर्णयन्। स्वामवस्थां समीक्ष्याथ साम्नैव प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: Reflecting upon his own condition, the highly intelligent and eloquent cat praised the words of the speaker and honoured him by gentle words.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: ततस्तीक्ष्णाग्रदशनो मणिवैदूर्यलोचनः। मूषिकं मन्दमुवीक्ष्य मार्जारो लोमशोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Quietly looking at the mouse, the cat, called Lomasha, having sharp foreteeth and having eyes that resemble the stones called lapis lazuli answered as followsनन्दामि सौम्य भद्रं ते यो मां जीवितुमिच्छसि।

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: श्रेयश्च यदि जानीषे क्रियतां मा विचारय॥
en: I am pleased with you, O amiable one! Blessed be you who wish me to live! Do that, without hesitation, which you think would do us good.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अहं हि भृशमापन्नस्त्वमापनतरो मम। द्वयोरापन्नयोः संधिः क्रियतां मा चिराय च॥
en: I am surely in great distress. You are, if possible, in greater distress still! Let there be an agreement made between us forthwith.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: विधास्ये प्राप्तकालं यत् कार्य सिद्धिकरं विभो। मयि कृच्छ्राद् विनिर्मुक्ते न विनक्ष्यति ते कृतम्।।७०।
en: I will do that which is opportune and necessary for the success of our business, O powerful one! If you save me, your service will not go for nothing.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न्यस्तमानोऽस्मि भक्तोऽस्मि शिष्यस्त्वद्धितकृत्तथा। निदेशवशवर्ती च भवन्तं शरणं गतः॥
en: I leave myself in your hands I am devoted to you. I shall attend and serve you like a disciple. I seek refuge with you and shall always obey you.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: इत्येवमुक्तः पलितो मार्जारं वशमागतम्। वाक्यं हितमुवाचेदमभिनीतार्थमर्थवित्॥
en: Thus accosted, the mouse Palita, speaking again to the cat, who was entirely under his control, said these highly significant and wise words-

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: उदारं यद् भवानाह नैतच्चित्रं भवद्विधे। विहितो यस्तु मार्गो मे हितार्थं शृणु तं मम॥
en: You have spoken most magnanimously. It could be expected from one like you. Hear I shall describe the expedient I have thought of for benefiting both of us.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अहं त्वानुप्रवेक्ष्यामि नकुलान्मे महद् भयम्। त्रायस्व भो मा वधीस्त्वं शक्तोऽस्मि तव रक्षणे॥
en: I will crouch myself beneath your body. I am in great fear of the mongoose. Do you save me. Kill me not. I am capable to save you.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: उलूकाच्चैव मां रक्ष क्षुद्रः अहं छेत्स्यामि ते पाशान् सखे सत्येन ते शपे॥ प्रार्थयते हि माम्।
en: O friend, this owl is also wishing for my life, so you may protect me. I shall cut the strings at that it is true.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तद्वचः संगतं श्रुत्वा लोमशो युक्तमर्थवत्। हर्षादुद्वीक्ष्य पलितं स्वागतेनाभ्यपूजयत्॥
en: Hearing the words of the mouse at that proper time, knowing very useful Lomasha praised him looking with a smile.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तं सम्पूज्याथ पलितं मार्जारः सौहृदे स्थितः। स विचिन्त्याब्रवीद् धीरः प्रीतस्त्वरित एव च॥
en: Having praised Palita, the cat which was friendly disposed, thought for a moment, and gladly said without losing any time,-

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: शीघ्रमागच्छ भद्रं ते त्वं मे प्राणसमः सखा। तव प्राज्ञ प्रसादाद्धि प्रायः प्राप्स्यामि जीवितम्॥
en: Come quickly to me. Blessed be you, who are, indeed, a friend dear to me as life.o you of great wisdom, through your grace I have almost regained my life.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यद् यदेवंगतेनाद्य शक्यं कर्तुं मया तव। तदाज्ञापय कर्तास्मि संधिरेवास्तु नौ सखे।॥
en: Whatever I can do, tell me and I shall do it for your. Let there be peace between us, O friend.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अस्मात् तु संकटान्मुक्तः समित्रगणबान्धवः। सर्वकार्याणि कर्ताऽहं प्रियाणि च हितानि च॥
en: Freed from this danger, I shall with all iny friends and relatives, do what is agreeable and good to you.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: मुक्तश्च व्यसनादस्मात् सौम्याहमपि नाम ते। प्रीतिमुत्पादयेयं च प्रीतिकर्तुश्च सक्रियाम्॥
en: O amiable one, freed from this danger, I shall surely try to please you, and adore and honour you on every occasion in return for your good offices.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: प्रत्युपकुर्वन् बह्वपि न भाति पूर्वोपकारिणा तुल्यः। एकः करोति हि कृते निष्कारणमेव कुरुतेऽन्यः॥
en: By returning even sufficient services a man cannot equal the person who did him good in the first instance. The former does them for the sake of services rendered. The latter, however, acted without any such motive.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: भीष्म उवाच ग्राहयित्वा तु तं स्वार्थं मार्जारं मूषिकस्तथा। प्रविवेश तु विश्रभ्य क्रोडमस्य कृतागसः॥
en: Bhishma said Having thus made the cat understand his own interests, the mouse truthfully crouched beneath his enemy's body.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: एवमाश्वासितो विद्वान् मारिण स मूषिकः। मार्जारोरसि विस्त्रब्धः सुष्वाप पितृमातृवत्॥
en: Learned, and thus assured by the cat, the mouse confidently laid himself thus under the breast of the cat as if it were the lap of his father or of his mother.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: लीनं तु तस्य गात्रेषु मार्जारस्य च मूषिकम्। दृष्ट्वा तौ नकुलोलूको निराशौ प्रत्यपद्यताम्॥
en: Seeing him thus enclosed within the body of the cat, the mongoose and the owl both gave up hopes of catching their prey.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तथैव तौ सुसंत्रस्तौ दृढमागततन्द्रितौ। दृष्ट्वा तयोः परां प्रीति विस्मयं परमं गतौ॥
en: Marking that close intimacy between the mouse and the cat, both Harita and Chandraka became stricken with fear and wonder.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: बलिनौ मतिमन्तौ च सुवृत्तौ चाप्युपासितौ। अशक्तौ तु नयात् तस्मात् सम्प्रधर्षयितुं बलात्॥
en: Both of them were endued with strength and intelligence. Clever in catching their prey, though near, the mongoose and the owl could not make the mouse and the cat break that agreement.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: कार्यार्थं कृतसंधी तौ दृष्ट्वा मार्जारमूषिको। उलूकनकुलौ तूर्णं जग्मतुस्तौ स्वमालयम्॥
en: Indeed, seeing the cat and the mouse make that agreement for fulfilling their mutual object, the mongoose and the owl both left that spot and repaired to their respective quarters.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: लीनः स तस्य गात्रेषु पलितो देशकालवित्। चिच्छेद पाशान् नृपते कालापेक्षी शनैः शनैः॥
en: Thereafter, the mouse Palita, who knew well the requirements of time and place, began, as he lay under the body of the cat, to cut the strings of the noose slowly, waiting for the proper time to finish his work.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अथ बन्धपरिक्लिष्टो मार्जारो वीक्ष्य मूषिकम्। छिन्दन्तं वै तदा पाशानत्वरन्तं त्वरान्वितः॥
en: Pained by the strings that fettered him, the cat became impatient upon seeing the mouse slowly cutting away the noose.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तमत्वरन्तं पलितं पाशानां छेदने तथा। संचोदयितुमारेभे मार्जारो मूषिकं तदा॥ किं सौम्य नातित्वरसे किं कृतार्थोऽवमन्यसे। छिन्धि पाशानमित्रघ्न पुरा श्वपच एति च॥
en: Seeing the mouse so slow in the work, the cat wishing to hurry it on, said-How is it, O amiable one, that you do not proceed quickly with your work? Do you disregard me now, having accomplished your own work? O slayer of foes, cut off these strings quickly! The hunter will soon come hereइत्युक्तस्त्वरता तेन मतिमान् पलितोऽब्रवीत्।

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: मार्जारमकृतप्रज्ञं पथ्यमात्महितं वचः॥
en: Thus addressed by the impatient cat, the intelligent mouse said these beneficial words to the cat who did not seem to possess much wisdom-

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तूष्णीं भव न ते सौम्य त्वरा कार्या न सम्भ्रमः। वयमेवात्र कालज्ञा न कालः परिहास्यते॥
en: Wait silently, O amiable one! Quickness is not necessary. Remove all your fears. We know the requirements of time. We are not wasting time.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अकाले कृत्यमारब्धं कर्तुर्नार्थाय कल्पते। तदेव काल आरब्धं महतेऽर्थाय कल्पते॥
en: When a work is begun at an improper time, it never becomes profitable when finished. That act, however, which is undertaken at the proper time, yields rich fruits.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अकाले विप्रमुक्तान्मे त्वत्त एव भयं भवेत्। तस्मात् कालं प्रतीक्षस्व किमिति त्वरसे सखे॥
en: If you are freed at an improper time, I shall have to fear you. Therefore, do you wait for the proper moment. Do not be impatient, О friend.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यदा पश्यामि चाण्डालमायान्तं शस्त्रपाणिनम्। ततश्छेत्स्यामि ते पाशान् प्राप्ते साधारणे भये॥
en: When I shall see the hunter come here armed with weapons, I shall cut the strings at that very moment of fear to both of us.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तस्मिन् काले प्रमुक्तस्त्वं तरुमेवाधिरोक्ष्यसे। न हि ते जीवितादन्यत् किंचित् कृत्यं भविष्यति॥
en: Freed then, you will get upon the tree and not think of anything else except the safety of your own life.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: ततो भवत्यपक्रान्ते त्रस्त भीते च लोमश। अहं बिलं प्रवेक्ष्यामि भवान् शाखां भजिष्यति॥
en: And when you, O Lomasha, will fly away in fear, I shall enter my hole and you will ascend the tree.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: एवमुक्तस्तु मार्जारो मूषिकेणात्मनो हितम्। वचनं वाक्यतत्त्वज्ञो जीवितार्थी महामतिः॥
en: Thus addressed by the mouse with these beneficial words, the intelligent and eloquent cat, impatient of saving his life, addressed the mouse in the following words.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अथात्मकृत्ये त्वरितः सम्यक् प्रश्रितमाचरन्। उवाच लोमशो वाक्यं मूषिकं चिरकारिणम्॥
en: Indeed, the cat, who had quickly and properly carried his own part of the agreement, addressing the mouse who was not quick enough in fulfilling his part, said,-

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न ह्येवं मित्रकार्याणि प्रीत्या कुर्वन्ति साधवः। यथा त्वं मोक्षितः कृच्छ्रात् त्वरमाणेन वै मया॥
en: I saved you from a great danger with considerable promptness. Alas, honest persons never thus do the business of their friends. Filled with joy while doing it, they do it otherwise.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तथा हि त्वरमाणेन त्वया कार्यं हितं मम्। यत्नं कुरु महाप्राज्ञ यथा रक्षाऽऽवयोर्भवेत्॥
en: You should do quickly what is for my wellbeing. O you of great wisdom, do you try a little so that good may be done to both of us.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अथवा पूर्ववैरं त्वं स्मरन् कालं जिहीर्षसि। पश्य दुष्कृतकर्मंस्त्वं व्यक्तमायुःक्षयं तव॥
en: If, however, remembering our former hostility you are only allowing the time to slip away, know, O wicked creature, that the consequence of this your act will surely lessen your own life.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यदि किंचिन्मयाज्ञानात् पुरस्ताद् दुष्कृतं कृतम्। न तन्मनसि कर्तव्यं क्षामये त्वां प्रसीद मे॥
en: If I have ever, before this, unknowingly done you any wrong, you should not bear it in mind. I beg your pardon. Be pleased with me.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तमेवंवादिनः प्राज्ञः शास्त्रबुद्धिसमन्वितः। उवाचेदं वचः श्रेष्ठं मार्जार मूषिकस्तदा॥
en: After the cat had said these words, the intelligent and wise mouse, well-read in the

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: श्रुतं मे तव मार्जार स्वमर्थं परिगृह्णतः। ममापि त्वं विजानासि स्वमर्थं परिगृह्णतः॥
en: I have, O cat, heard what you have said to further your own object. Listen, however, to me as I tell you what is proper for my own objects.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यन्मित्रं भीतवत्साध्यं यन्मित्रं भयसंहितम्। सुरक्षितव्यं तत् कार्यं पाणिः सर्पमुखादिव॥
en: That friendship which is beset with fear and which cannot be maintained without fear, should be preserved with great caution like the hand (of the snake-charmer) from the snake's fangs!

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: कृत्वा बलवता संधिमात्मनं यो न रक्षति। अपथ्यमिव तद् भुक्तं तस्य नार्थाय कल्पते॥
en: The person that does not protect himself after having made an agreement with a stronger individual, sees that is yields instead of good.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न कश्चित् कस्यचिन्मित्रं न कश्चित् कस्यचिद् रिपुः। अर्थतस्तु निबद्ध्यन्ते मित्राणि रिपवस्तथा॥
en: Nobody is nobody's friend; nobody is nobody's enemy; persons becomes friends or enemies only from motives of interest.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अथैरा निबद्ध्यन्ते गजैर्वनगजा इव। न च कश्चित् कृते कार्ये कर्तारं समवेक्षते॥ तस्मात् सर्वाणि कार्याणि सावशेषाणि कारयेत्।
en: Interest brings interest even as tame elephants catch wild elephants. Again, when a work is done, the doer is hardly thought of. Therefore, all works should be so done that something may remain undone.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तस्मिन् कालेऽपि च भवान् दिवाकीर्तिभयादितः॥११२। मम न ग्रहणे शक्तः पलायनपरायणः। छिन्नं तु तन्तुबाहुल्यं तन्तुरेकोऽवशेषितः॥ छेत्स्याम्यहं तमप्याशु निर्वृतो भव लोमश।
en: When I shall liberate you, you will, from fear of the hunter, fly away for your life without ever thinking of catching me. See, all the strings of this net have been cut by me. Only one remains to be cut. I will cut that also soon. Be comforted, O Lomasha.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तयोः संवदतोरेवं तथैवापन्नयोर्द्वयोः॥ क्षयं जगाम सा रात्रिर्लोमशं त्वाविशद् भयम्।
en: While the mouse and the cat were thus conversing, both in serious danger, the night gradually passed away. A great fear, however, possessed the heart of the cat.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: ततः प्रभातसमये विकृतः कृष्णपिङ्गलः॥ स्थूलस्फिग् विकृतो रूक्षः श्वयूथपरिवारितः। शंकुकर्णो महावक्त्रो मलिनो घोरदर्शनः॥ परिघो नाम चाण्डाल: शस्त्रपाणिरदृश्यत।
en: When the dawn set in, the Chandala, whose name was Parigha, came there. His appearance was terrible. His hair was black and tawny. His hips were huge and his look was very fierce. Of a large mouth extending from ear to ear, and highly filthy, his ears were very long. man Armed with weapons and accompanied by a pack of dogs, the grim-visaged man came there.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तं दृष्ट्वा यमदूताभं मार्जारस्त्रस्तचेतनः॥ उवाच वचनं भीतः किमिदानीं करिष्यसि।
en: Seeing that who resembled a messenger of Yama, the cat was stricken with fear. Filled with fear, he addressed Palita, saying,-What will you do now?

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अथ तावपि संत्रस्तौ तं दृष्ट्वा घोरसंकुलम्॥ क्षणेन नकुलोलूको नैराश्यमुपजग्मतुः। बलिनौ मतिमन्तौ च संघाते चाप्युपागतौ॥ अशक्तौ सुनयात् तस्मात् सम्प्रधर्षयितुं बलात्। कार्यार्थे कृतसंधानौ दृष्ट्वा मार्जारमूषिकौ॥ उलूकनकुलौ तत्र जग्मतुः स्वं स्वमालयम्।
en: The two were afraid seeing dreadful Chandala, mongoose and owl came in to hopeless. Indeed they were very strong and intelligent but could not over-press on strength less but with good conduct cat and mouse. Therefore, they both owl and mangoose left for their own place.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: ततश्चिच्छेद तं पाशं मार्जारस्य च मूषिकः॥ विप्रमुक्तोऽथ मार्जारस्तमेवाभ्यपतद् दुमम्। स तस्मात् सम्भ्रमावर्तान्मुक्तो घोरेण शत्रुणा॥ बिलं विवेश पलितः शाखां लेभे स लोमशः।
en: The mouse very quickly cut the remaining string which held fast that cat. Freed from the noose, the cat run quickly and got upon the banian. Palita also, freed from that perilous position and from the presence of a terrible enemy quickly fled and entered his hole. Lomasha meanwhile had got upon the high tree.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: उन्माथमप्यथादाय चाण्डालो वीक्ष्य सर्वशः॥ विहताशः क्षणेनास्ते तस्माद् देशादपाक्रमत्।
en: Seeing everything, the hunter took up his net. His hopes defeated, he also quickly left that place.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: जगाम स स्वभवनं चाण्डालो भरतर्षभ॥ ततस्तस्माद् भयान्मुक्तो दुर्लभं प्राप्य जीवितम्। बिलस्थं पादपाग्रस्थः पलितं लोमशोऽब्रवीत्॥ अकृत्वा संविदं काञ्चित् सहसा समवप्लुतः। कृतज्ञं कृतकर्माणं कच्चिन्मां नाभिशंकसे॥
en: Indeed, O foremost of Bharata's race, the Chandala returned to his house freed from that great danger, and having regained his precious life, the cat from the branches of that tree addressed the mouse Palita then living with in the hole, and said,-Without having talked to me, you have suddenly run away. I hope you do not suspect me of any evil motive. I am certainly grateful and you have done me a great service.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: गत्वा च मम विश्वासं दत्त्वा च मम जीवितम्। मित्रोपभोगसमये किं मां त्वं नोपसर्पसि॥
en: Having created confidence in me and having given me my life, why do you not come to me at a time when friends should enjoy the sweets of friendship?

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: कृत्वा हि पूर्वं मित्राणि यः पश्चान्नानुतिष्ठति। न स मित्राणि लभते कृच्छ्रास्वापत्सु दुर्मतिः॥
en: Having made friends, he who forgets them afterwards, is a wicked person and never gets friends at times of danger and necessity.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: सत्कृतोऽहं त्वया मित्र सामर्थ्यादात्मनः सखे। स मां मित्रत्वमापन्नमुपभोक्तुं त्वमर्हसि॥
en: I have been, O friend, respected and served by you to the best of your power. You should now enjoy the company of my poor self who has become your friend.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यानि मे सन्ति मित्राणि ये च सम्बन्धिबान्धवाः। सर्वे त्वां पूजयिष्यन्ति शिष्या गुरुमिव प्रियम्॥
en: Like disciples adoring their preceptor, all the friends I have, all my relatives and kinsmen, will respect and adore you.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अहं च पूजयिष्ये त्वां समित्रगणबान्धवम्। जीवितस्य प्रदातारं कृतज्ञः को न पूजयेत्॥
en: I myself too shall adore you with all your friends and kinsmen. What grateful person is there who will not adore the giver of his life.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: ईश्वरो मे भवानस्तु स्वशरीरगृहस्य च। अर्थानां चैव सर्वेषामनुशास्ता च मे भव॥
en: Be you the master of both my body and home! Be you the disposer of all my wealth and properties.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अमात्यो मे भव प्राज्ञ पितेवेह प्रशाधि माम्। न तेऽस्ति भयमस्मत्तो जीवितेनात्मनः शपे॥
en: Be you my respected adviser and do you govern me like a father! I swear by my life that you need not fear us.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: बुद्ध्यात्वमुशना साक्षाद् बलेनाधिकृता वयम्। त्वं मन्त्रबलयुक्तो हि दत्त्वा जीवितमद्य मे॥
en: In intelligence you are like Ushanas himself. By the power of your understanding you have conquered us. Clever in policy, you have given us our life.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: एवमुक्तः परां शान्ति मारिण स मूषिकः। उवाच परमन्त्रज्ञः श्लक्ष्णमात्महितं वचः॥
en: Accosted thus with sweet words by the cat, the mouse, who knew all which produces the highest good, replied in these sweet words that were beneficial to himself.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यद् भवानाह तत् सर्वं मया ते लोमश श्रुतम्। ममापि तावद् ब्रुवतः शृणु यत् प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: I have heard, O Lomasha, all that you have, said. Listen now as I say what I think.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: वेदितव्यानि मित्राणि विज्ञेयाश्चापि शत्रवः। एतत् सुसूक्ष्मं लोकेऽस्मिन् दृश्यते प्राज्ञसम्मतम्॥
en: Friends should be well tried. Enemies also should be well studied. In this world, a task like this is considered by even the learned as a difficult one requiring sharp intelligence.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: शत्रुरूपा हि सुहृदो मित्ररूपाश्च शत्रवः। संधितास्ते न बुद्ध्यन्ते कामक्रोधवशं गताः॥
en: Friends appear like enemies, and enemies appear like friends. When agreements of friendship are made, it is difficult for the parties to know whether they are really actuated by lust and anger.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: नास्ति जातु रिपुर्नाम मित्रं नाम न विद्यते। सामर्थ्ययोगाज्जायन्ते मित्राणि रिपवस्तथा॥
en: There is no such thing as a friend. It is circumstances which make friends and enemies.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यो यस्मिन् जीवति स्वार्थं पश्येत् पीडां न जीवति। स तस्य मित्रं तावत्स्याद् यावन्न स्याद् विपर्ययः॥१४०
en: He, who considers his own interests safe as long as another lives, and thinks himself in danger when the latter dies takes him as his friend so long as those interests of his are not clashed against.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: स्ति मैत्री स्थिरा नाम न च ध्रुवमसौहृदम्। अर्थयुक्त्यानुजायन्ते मित्राणि रिपवस्तथा॥
en: There is no condition that passes for ever by the name either of friendship or enemies. Both friends and enemies arise from considerations of interest and gain.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: मित्रं च शत्रुतामेति कस्मिंश्चित् कालपर्यये। शत्रुश्च मित्रतामेति स्वार्थो हि बलवत्तरः॥
en: Friendship becomes enmity in the course of time. An enemy also becomes a friend. Selfinterest is very powerful.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यो विश्वसिति मित्रेषु न विश्वसिति शत्रुषु। अर्थयुक्तिमविज्ञाय यः प्रीतौ कुरुते मनः॥ मित्रे वा यदि वा शत्रौ तस्यापि चलिता मतिः।
en: He, who blindly places confidence in friends and always treats enemies mistrustfully without paying any heed to considerations of policy, finds his life unsafe. He, who, neglecting all considerations of policy, seeks either friends or foes, is regarded as a person whose understanding has been unhinged.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न विश्वसेदविश्वस्ते विश्वस्ते नातिविश्वसेत्॥ विश्वासाद् भयमुत्पन्नमपि मूलानि कृन्तति।
en: One should not trust a person undeserving of truth, nor should one trust too much a person worthy of trust. The anger from blind confidence is such that it cuts the very roots.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अर्थयुक्त्या हि जायन्ते पिता माता सुतस्तथा॥ मातुला भागिनेयाश्च तथा सम्बन्धिबान्धवाः।
en: The father, the mother, the son, the maternal uncle, the sister's son, and other relatives and kinsmen, are all moved by interest and profit.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: पुत्रं हि मातापितरौ त्यजतः पतितं प्रियम्॥ लोको रक्षति चात्मानं पश्य स्वार्थस्य सारताम्।
en: Father and mother may be seen to discard the dear son if he is addicted to irregular practices. People take care of their own selves. See the efficacy of self-interest.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: सामान्या निष्कृतिः प्राज्ञ यो मोक्षात् प्रत्यनन्तरम्॥१४७। कृतं मृगयसे शत्रु सुखोपायमसंशयम्।
en: O highly wise one, his escape is very difficult, who, immediately after he is freed from danger, seeks the means of his enemy's happiness.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अस्मिन् निलय एव त्वं न्यग्रोधादवतारितः॥ पूर्वं निविष्टमुन्मार्थ चपलत्वान्न बुद्धवान्।
en: You have come down from the top of the tree to this very spot. You could not, from foolishness know that a net had been spread here.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: आत्मनश्चपलो नास्ति कुतोऽन्येषां भविष्यति॥ तस्मात् सर्वाणि कार्याणि चपलो हन्त्यसंशयम्।
en: A person, who has no sense, cannot protect his own self. How can be protect others? Such a person, forsooth, ruins all his acts.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: ब्रवीषि मधुरं यच्च प्रियो मेऽद्य भवानिति॥ तन्मित्र कारणं सर्वं विस्तरेणापि मे शृणु।
en: You speak sweetly that I am very dear to you. Hear me, however, O friends, the reasons which I have on my side.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: कारणात् प्रियतामेति द्वेष्यो भवति कारणात्॥ अर्थार्थी जीवलोकोऽयं न कश्चित् कस्यचित् प्रियः।
en: One becomes dear from a sufficient cause. One becomes an enemy from sufficient cause. The entire world of creatures is actuated by the desire of gain. One never becomes dear to another without cause.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: सख्यं सोदर्ययोर्धात्रोर्दम्पत्योर्वा परस्परम्॥ कस्यचिन्नाभिजानामि प्रीति निष्कारणामिह। यद्यपि भ्रातरः क्रुद्धा भार्या वा कारणान्तरे॥ स्वभावतस्ते प्रीयन्ते नेतरः प्रीयते जनः।
en: The friendship between two uterine brothers, the love between husband and wife, rests upon interest. I do not know any kind of love amongst persons that does not depend upon some motive of self-interest. It is sometimes seen that uterine brothers or husband and wife having quarrelled are united again from a natural affection. But such a thing is not to be seen in persons who are not connected with one another.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: प्रियो भवति दानेन प्रियवादेन चापरः॥ मन्त्रहोमजपैरन्यः कार्यार्थं प्रीयते जनः।
en: One becomes dear for his liberality. Another becomes dear for his sweet words. A third becomes so for his religious acts. Generally, a person becomes dear for the purpose he serves.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: उत्पन्ना कारणे प्रीतिरासीनौ कारणान्तरे॥ प्रध्वस्ते कारणस्थाने सा प्रीतिर्विनिवर्तते।
en: The love between us originated from an adequate cause, That cause no longer exists. On the other hand, from sufficient reasons that friendship between us has terminated,

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: किं नु तत् कारणं मन्ये येनाहं भवतः प्रियः॥ अन्यत्राभ्यवहारार्थं तत्रापि च बुधा वयम्।
en: What is that reason, I ask, for which I have become so dear to you, besides your desire for eating me up? You should know that I am not forgetful of this.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: कालो हेतुं विकुरुते स्वार्थस्तमनुवर्तते॥ स्वार्थं प्राज्ञोऽभिजानाति प्राज्ञं लोकोऽनुवर्तते। न त्वीदृशं त्वया वाच्यं विदुषि स्वार्थपण्डिते॥
en: Time spoils reasons. You seek your own interests. Otherwise men, again, understand their own interests. The world is guided by the example of the wise. You should not thus speak to a person who is learned and capable of understanding his own interests.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अकाले हि समर्थस्य स्नेहहेतुरयं तव। तस्मान्नाहं चले स्वार्थात् सुस्थिरः संधिविग्रहे॥ अभ्राणामिव रूपाणि विकुर्वन्ति क्षणे क्षणे। अद्यैव हि रिपुर्भूत्वा पुनरद्यैव मे सुहृत्॥ पुनश्च रिपुरद्यैव युक्तीनां पश्य चापलम्।
en: You are powerful. The reason which you show for your love for me now is ill-timed. Moved, however, by my own interests, I am always very strong about peace and war that are themselves very unstable. The circumstances under which peace is to be made or war declared change as speedily as the clouds change their form. This very day you were my enemy. This every day again, you becaiae my friend. This very day you have again become my enemy. Mark the considerations that move living creatures!

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: आसी-मैत्री तु तावन्नौ यावद्धतुरभूत् पुरा॥ सा गता सह तेनैव कालयुक्तेन हेतुना।
en: There was friendship between us as long as there was necessity for the same. That reason, the outcome of time, is gone. Without it, that friendship also has passed away.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: त्वं हि मे जातितः शत्रुः सामर्थ्यान्मित्रतां गतः॥ तत् कृत्यमभिनिवर्त्य प्रकृतिः शत्रुतां गता।
en: You are by nature my enemy. From circumsiances you became my friend. That state of things has gone away. The old but natural state of enmity has returned.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: सोऽहमेवं प्रणीतानि ज्ञात्वा शास्त्राणि तत्त्वतः॥ प्रविशेयं कथं पाशं त्वत्कृते तद् वदस्व मे।
en: I am well-read in the dictates of policy; tell me, why shall I enter to-day, for your sake, the net that is spread for me?

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: त्ववीर्येण प्रमुक्ताऽहं मदूवीर्येण तथा भवान्॥ अन्योन्यानुग्रहे वृत्ते नास्ति भूयः समागमः।
en: Through your power I was freed from a great danger. Through my power you have। been freed from a similar danger. Each of us has served the other. There is no need for us for becoming friends again.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: त्वं हि सौम्य कृतार्थोऽद्य निर्वृत्तार्थास्तथा वयम्॥ न तेऽस्त्यद्य मया कृत्यं किंचिदन्यत्र भक्षणात्।
en: O amiable one, your object has been accomplished. The object I had, has also been accomplished. You do not require me except to make me your food.
