description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अहमन्नं भवान् भोक्ता दुर्बलोऽहं भवान् बली॥ नावयोर्विद्यते संधिर्वियुक्ते विषमे बले।
en: I am your food. You are the eater. I am weak. You are strong. There cannot be any friendship between us when we are so unevenly placed.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: स मन्येऽहं तव प्रज्ञां यन्मोक्षात् प्रत्यनन्तरम्॥ भक्ष्यं मृगयसे नूनं सुखोपायेन कर्मणा।
en: I understand your wisdom. Having been released from the net, you speak highly of me so that you may easily make food to me.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: भक्ष्यार्थं ह्यवबद्धस्त्वं स मुक्तः पीडितः क्षुधा॥ शास्त्रजां मतिमास्थाय नूनं भक्षयिताध माम्।
en: You were entangled in the net for the sake of food. You have been freed from it. You feel now the pangs of hunger. Following wisdom of the scriptures, you try to eat me up to-day.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: जानामि क्षुधितं दु त्वामाहारसमयश्च ते॥ स त्वं मानभिसंधाय भक्ष्यं मृगयसे पुनः।
en: I know that you are hungry. I know that this is the time of you taking food. You are seeking your prey, and you have your eyes on me.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: त्वं चापि पुत्रदारस्थो यत् संधि सृजसे मयि॥ शुश्रूषां यतसे कर्तुं सखे मम न तत् क्षमम्।
en: You have sons and wives, You still try to make friends hip srith me and wish to treat me with affection anu do me vices. O friend, I carnot accept this proposal.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: त्वया मां सहितं दृष्ट्वा प्रिया भार्या सुताश्च ते॥ कस्मात् ते मां न खादेयुर्हशः प्रणयिनस्त्वयि।
en: Seeing me with you, why will not your dear wife and your loving children cheerfully eat me up?

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: नाहं त्वया समेष्यापि वृत्तो हेतुः समागमे॥ शिवं ध्यायस्व मे स्वस्थः सुकृतं स्मरसे यदि।
en: I shall not, therefore, make friendship with you. There is no reason any longer for such a union. If, indeed, you do not forget my good offices, think of what will be good for me and be comfortable.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: शत्रोरनार्यभूतस्य क्लिष्टस्य क्षुधितस्य च॥ भक्ष्यं मृगयमाणस्य कः प्राज्ञो विषयं व्रजेत्।
en: What sane man will place himself under the power of an enemy who is not well-known for virtue, who is hungry, and who is in search of a prey?

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि दूरादपि तवोद्विजे॥ विश्वस्तं वा प्रमत्तं वा एतदेव कृतं भवेत्।
en: If you think that I have done you a service, do me a friend's work when I may happen to move trustfully or carelessly. Even that will be gratitude in you.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: बलवत्संनिकर्षो हि न कदाचित् प्रशस्यते॥ नाहं त्वया समेष्यामि निवृत्तो भव लोमश।
en: Be happy then, I will presently leave you. I am afraid even to see you from a distance. I shall not mix with you, give up your attempts, OLomasha!

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यदि त्वं सुकृतं वेत्सि तत् सख्यमनुसारय॥ प्रशान्तादपि मे पापाद् भेतव्यं बलिन: सदा।
en: To live near a powerful and strong person is never praiseworthy. Even if the estimated danger no longer exists, I should always fear one more powerful than myself.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: यदि स्वार्थं न ते कार्यं ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते॥ कामं सर्वं प्रदास्यामि न त्वाऽऽत्मानं कदाचन।
en: If you do not seek your own interests, tell me then what is there that I can do for you. I shall certainly give you everything save my life.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: आत्मार्थे संततिस्त्याज्या राज्यं रत्नं धनानि च॥ अपि सर्वस्वमुत्सृज्य रक्षेदात्मानमात्मना।
en: For protecting one's own self one should abandon his very children, kingdom, jewels, and wealth. One should sacrifice one's all for protecting one's own self.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: ऐश्वर्यधनरत्नानां प्रत्यमित्रे निवर्तताम्॥ दृष्ट्वा हि पुनरावृत्ति वतामिति नः श्रुतम्।
en: If a person lives he can recover all the wealth that he may have to give to enemies for protecting his life.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न त्वात्मनः सम्प्रदानं धनरलवदिष्यते॥ आत्मा हि सर्वदा रक्ष्यो दारैरपि धनैरपि।
en: It is not desirable to abandon life like one's riches. Indeed, one's own self should always be protected by, as I have already said, even removing his wives and wealth.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: आत्मरक्षणतन्त्राणां सुपरीक्षितकारिणाम्॥ आपदो नोपपद्यन्ते पुरुषाणां स्वदोषजाः।
en: Persons who care to protect their own selves and who do all their works after a proper consideration, never suffer from dangers as the consequence of their acts.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: शत्रून् सम्यग् विजानन्ति दुर्बला ये बलीयसः॥ न तेषां चाल्यते बुद्धिः शास्त्रार्थकृतनिश्चया।
en: The weak always regard the powerful as their enemies. Their understanding, based firmly on the truths of the scriptures, is never unhinged.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: इत्यभिव्यक्तमेवं स पलितेनाभिभर्त्तितः॥ मार्जारो वीडितो भूत्वा मूषिकं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus rebuked by the mouse palita the cat, hushing with shame, said to the mouse.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: लोमश उवाच सत्यं शपे त्वयाहं वै मित्रद्रोहो विगर्हितः। तन्मन्येऽहं तव प्रज्ञा यस्त्वं मम हिते रतः॥
en: Lomasha said Truly I swear by you that I conside it highly censurable to injure a friend. I know your wisdom. I know also that you are devoted to my self-being.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: उक्तवानर्थतत्त्वेन मयासम्भिन्नदर्शनः। न तु मामन्यथा साधो त्वं ग्रहीतुमिहार्हसि॥
en: Guided by the science of profit, you have said that there is sufficient cause for a breach between you and me. You should not, however, O good friend, take me for what I am not!

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: प्राणप्रदानजं त्वत्तां मयि सौहृदमागतम्। धर्मज्ञोऽस्मि गुणज्ञोऽस्मि कृतज्ञोऽस्मि विशेषतः॥
en: I consider you a great friend for your having saved my life. I am, again, familiar with duties. I always appreciate other people's merits. I am very grateful for services received.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: मित्रेषु वत्सलश्चास्मि त्वद्भक्तश्च विशेषतः। तस्मादेवं पुन: साधो मय्याचरितुमर्हसि॥
en: I am devoted to the service of friends. I am, again, especially devoted to you. For these reasons, O good friend, you should reunite yourself with me.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: त्वया हि वाच्यमानोऽहं जह्यां प्राणान् सबान्धवः। विश्रम्भो हि बुधैर्दृष्टो मद्विधेषु मनस्विषु॥ तदेतद् धर्मतत्त्वज्ञ न त्वं शङ्कितुमर्हसि।
en: If I am ordered by you, I can, with all my kinsmen and relatives, sacrifice my very life. The learned and wise see sufficient reasons for reposing their confidence in persons of such mental disposition as ourselves. O you who are a master of the truths of morality, you should not suspect me.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: इति संस्तूयमानोऽपि मारिण स मूषिकः॥ मनसा भावगम्भीरो मार्जारं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।
en: Thus addressed by the cat, the mouse, thinking a while, said these weighty words to the former.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: साधुर्भवाश्रुतार्थोऽस्मि प्रीये च न च विश्वसे॥ संस्तवैर्वा धनौधैर्वा नाहं शक्यः पुनस्त्वया।
en: You are highly good. I have heard all that you have said and am glad to hear you. For all that, however, I cannot trust you. It is impossible for you, by such eulogiums or by present of great wealth, to induce me to unite with you again.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न ह्यमित्रे वशं यान्ति प्राज्ञा निष्कारणं सखे॥ अस्मिन्नर्थे च गाथे द्वे निबोधोशनसा कृते।
en: I tell you, O friend, that the wise never place themselves, without sufficient reason, under the power of an enemy. Regarding this, two stories have been recited by Sage Usanasa. Listen carefully.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: शत्रुसाधारणे कृत्ये कृत्वा संधि बलीयसा॥ समाहितश्चरेद् युक्त्या कृतार्थश्च न विश्वसेत्।
en: Having made an agreement with a stronger one, when both are threatened by enemies, a weak person should act carefully after considerations of policy. Having gained his object, the weaker of the two parties should not again trust the stronger.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न विश्वसेदविश्वस्ते विश्वस्ते नातिविश्वसेत्॥ नित्यं विश्वासयेदन्यान् परेषां तु न विश्वसेत्।
en: One should never trust a person unworthy of trust. Nor should one blindly trust a person deserving of trust. One should always try to secure other's confidence. One should not, however, himself trust his foes.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तस्मात् सर्वास्ववस्थासु रक्षेज्जीवितमात्मनः॥ द्रव्याणि संततिश्चैव सर्वं भवति जीवितः।
en: For these reasons one should, under every circumstances, protect his own self. One's possessions, children and everything else are so long valuable as he is alive.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: संक्षेपो नीतिशास्त्राणामविश्वासः परो मतः॥ नृषु तस्मादविश्वास: पुष्कलं हितमात्मनः।
en: In short, the highest truth of all works on policy is Mistrust. Therefore, mistrust of all persons yields the greatest good.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: वध्यन्ते न ह्यविश्वस्ताः शत्रुभिर्दुर्बला अपि॥ वि तास्तेषु वध्यन्ते बलवन्तोऽपि दुर्बलैः।
en: However weak people may be, if they mistrust their enemies, the latter, even if strong, never succeed in reigning supreme over them.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: त्वद्विधेभ्यो मया ह्यात्मा रक्ष्यो मार्जार सर्वदा॥ रक्ष त्वमपि चात्मानं चाण्डालाज्जातिकिल्बिषात्।
en: O cat, one like myself should always guard his life from persons like you. Do you also

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: स तस्य ढवतस्त्वेवं संत्रासाज्जातसाध्वसः॥ शाखां हित्वा जवेनाशु मारिः प्रययौ ततः।
en: While the mous, thus spoke, the cat frightened at the mention of the hunter, hastily left the branch of the tree, ran away with great speed.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: ततः शास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञो बुद्धिसामर्थ्यमात्मनः।।२००। विश्राव्य पलितः प्राज्ञो बिलमन्यज्जगाम ह।
en: Having thus shown his power of understanding, the mouse Palita also, who was conve. sant with the trists of scripture and endued with wisdom, entered another hole.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: एवं प्रज्ञावता बुद्ध्या दुर्बलेन महाबलाः॥ एकेन बहवोऽमित्राः पलितेनाभिसंधिताः।
en: Bhishma continued Thus did the wise mouse Palita, though weak, and alone, succeed in baffling many powerful enemies.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अरिणापि मर्थेन संधि कुर्वीत पण्डितः॥ मूषिकश्च बिडालश्च मुक्तावन्योन्यसंश्रयात्।
en: An intelligent and learned man should make peace with a powerful enemy. The mouse and the cat escaped by their reliance upon each other's services.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: इत्येवं क्षात्रधर्मस्य मया मार्गो निदर्शितः॥ विस्तरेण महाराज संक्षेपमपि मे शृणु।
en: I have thus pointed out to you fully the course of Kshatriya duties. Listen now to me in brief.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अन्योन्यकृतवैरी तु चक्रतुः प्रीतिमुत्तमाम्॥ अन्योन्यमभिसंधातुं सम्बभूव तयोर्मतिः।
en: When two persons who were once enemy 1.1ake peace with each other, it is certain that each of them has it in his heart to control the other.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तत्र प्राज्ञोऽभिसंधत्ते सम्यग् बुद्धिसमाश्रयात्॥ अभिसंधीयते प्राज्ञः प्रमादादपि वा बुधैः।
en: In such a case the wise man succeeds by the power of his understanding in controlling the other. He, on the other hand, who has no। wisd m suffers himself, for his carelessness, to be defeated by the wise.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तस्मादभीतवद् भीगो विश्वस्त्वदविश्वसन्॥ न ह्यप्रमत्तश्चलति चलितो वा तिनश्यति।
en: It is necessary, therefore, that in fear one should appear to be fearless, and, while really mistrusting others, one should seem to be truthful. One, who acts with such carefulness nev r loses his steps, or, even losing it, is never ruined.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: कालन रिपुणा संधिः काले मित्रेण विग्रहः॥ कार्य इत्ये व संधिज्ञाः प्राहुर्नित्यं नराधिप।
en: When the opportunity presents its-self, one should make peace with an enemy; and when the time comes, one should make war with even a friend. Those, who are well read in peace and war, say that one should conduct hiinself thus, O king.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: एतज्ज्ञात्वा महाराज शास्त्रार्थमभिगम्य च।२०८॥ अभियुक्तोऽप्रमत्तश्च प्राग्भयाद् भीतवच्चरेत्।
en: knowing this, O king, and remembering the truths of scripture, one should, ser:sibly and carefully, act like a person in fear before the cause of fear actually arrives.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: भीतवत् संनिधिः कार्यः प्रतिसंधिस्तथैव च॥ भयादुत्पद्यते बुद्धिरप्रमत्ताभियोगजा।
en: One should before the cause of fear actually arrived, act like a person in fear, and make peace with enenies. Such fear and carefulness beget keenness of understanding.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: न भयं विद्यते राजन् भीतस्यानागते भये॥ अभीतस्य च विश्रम्भात् सुमहज्जायते भवम्।
en: If one acts like a man in fear before the cause of fear is so near, one is never filled with fear when that cause actually arrives. And from the fear of a person, who always acts with "carlessness, very great fear criginates.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अभीश्चरति यो नित्यं मन्त्रोऽदेयः कथंचन॥ अविज्ञानाद्धि विज्ञातो गच्छेदास्पददर्शिषु।
en: Never cherish fear,-such an advice should never be given to any one. The person, who entertains fear from a consciousness of his weakness, always seuks the advice of wise and experienced men.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: तस्मादभीतवद् भीतो विश्वस्तवदविश्वसन्॥ कार्याणां गुरुतां प्राप्य नानृतं किंचिदाचरेत्।
en: For these reasons, one should, when afraid, appear to be fearless and when mistrusting (others', should seem to be truthful. One should not, even iil serious acts, !reat others with falsehood.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: एवमेतन्मया प्रोक्तमितिहासं युधिष्ठिर॥ श्रुत्वा त्वं सुहृदां मध्ये यथावत् समुपाचर।
en: Thus have recited to you, O Yudhishthira, the old story (of the mouse and the cat). Havii.g listened to it, do you: act properly in the midst of your friends and kinsmen.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: उपलभ्य मतिं चाय्यामरिमित्रान्तरं तथा॥ संधिविग्रहकालौ च मोक्षोपायस्तथैव च।
en: Deriving a great lesson from that story, and learning the difference between friend and enemy and the proper time for war and peace, You will discover means of escape when beset with dangers.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: शत्रुसाधारणे कृत्ये कृत्वा संधि बलीवसा॥ समागतश्चरेद् युक्त्या कृतार्थो न च विश्वसेत्।
en: Making peace, at a time of common danger, with a powerful enemy, you should act with proper consideration when uniting yourself with hin (when the common danger is gone). Indeed, having gained your objeci, you should not trust the enemies again.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: अविरुद्धां त्रिवर्गेण नीतिमेतां महीपते॥ अभ्युत्तिष्ठ श्रुतादस्माद् भूयः संरक्षयन् प्रजाः।
en: This path of policy is quite of a piece with the three-fold objects of life, (viz., Virtue, Profit, and Pleasure) O king! Guided by this Shruti, do you acquire prosperity by once more protecting your subjects.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: ब्राह्मणैश्चापि ते सार्धं यात्रा भवतु पाण्डव॥ ब्राह्मणा वै परं श्रेयो दिवि चेह च भारत।
en: O son of Pandu, always try to associate with Brahmanas in all your acts! Brahmanas give great benefit both in this world and the next.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: एते धर्मस्य वेत्तारः कृतज्ञा. सततं प्रभो॥ पृजिताः शुभकर्तारः पूजयेत् तान् नराधिप।
en: They are teachers of duty and morality. They are always grateful, O powerful one! If adored, they are sure to do you good. Therefore, o king, you should always adore them.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: राज्यं श्रेयः परं राजन् यशः कीर्ति च लप्स्यसे॥ कुलस्य संततिं चैव यथान्यायं यथाक्रमम्॥
en: You will then, O king, duly acquire ki'igdom, great food, fame, achievements, and offspring in their proper order.

description: How should a king act when attacked by any enemies, with whom should he make war
sn: द्वयोरिमं भारत संगिविग्रहं सुभाषितं बुद्धिविशेष कारकम्। यथा त्ववेक्ष्य क्षितिपेन सर्वदा निगेवितव्यं नृप शत्रुमण्डले॥
en: Always looking at this history of peace and war between the mouse and the cat, written in excellent words and capable of sharpening the intelleci, a king should always act in thie midst of his enemies,

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उक्तो मन्त्रो महाबाहो विश्वासो नास्ति शत्रुषु। कथं हि राजा वर्तेत यदि सर्वत्र नाथसेत्॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have prescribed, O mighty one, that no confidence should be reposed in enemy. But how would the king maintain himself if he were not to confide in anybody?

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: विश्वासाद्धिं पर राजन् राज्ञामुत्पद्यते भयम्। कथं हि नाश्वसन् राजा शत्रून् जयति पार्थिवः॥
en: O king, you have said, great danger arises to kings from confidence. But how, ) monarch, can a king, without trust on others, conquers his enemies.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि मतिर्मे सम्प्रमुह्यति। अविश्वासकथामेतामुपश्रुत्य पितामह॥
en: Kindly dispel this doubt of mine. My mind is confused, O grandfather, at what I have heard you say on the subject of mistrust.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: भीष्म उवाच शृणुष्व राजन् यद् वृत्तं ब्रह्मदत्तनिवेशने। पूजन्या सह संवादं ब्रह्मदत्तस्य भूपतेः॥
en: Bhishma said Hear, O king, what took place at the residence of Brahmadatta, viz., the conversation between Pujani and king Brahmadatta.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: काम्पिल्ये ब्रह्मदत्तस्य त्वन्तःपुरनिवासिनी। पूजनी नाम शकुनिर्दीर्घकालं सहोषिता॥
en: There was a bird named Pujani who lived for a considerable time with king Brahmadatta in the inner apartments of his palace at Kampilya.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: रुतज्ञा सर्वभूतानां यथा वै जीवजीवकः। सर्वज्ञा सर्वतत्त्वज्ञा तिर्यग्योनिं गतापि सा॥
en: Like the bird Jivajivaka, Pujani could imitate the cries of all animals. Though a bird by birth, she had acquired great knowledge and was conversant with every truth.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: अभिप्रजाता सा तत्र पुत्रमेकं सुवर्चसम्। समकालं च राज्ञोऽपि देव्यां पुत्रो व्यजायत॥
en: While residing there, she brought forth a highly effulgent young one. simultancously the king also beget on his queen a son.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: तयोरर्थे कृतज्ञा सा खेचरी पूजनी सदा। समुद्रतीरं सा गत्वा आजहार फलद्वयम्॥
en: Out of gratefulness for the shelter of the king's roof, Pujani used to go daily to the shores of the ocean and bring a couple of fruits for the nourishment of her own young one and the infant prince.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पुष्ट्यर्थं च स्वपुत्रस्य राजपुत्रस्य चैव हा फलमेकं सुतायादाद् राजपुत्राय चापरम्॥ अमृतास्वादसदृशं बलतेजोऽभिवर्धनम्। आदायादाय सैवाशु तयोः प्रादात् पुनः पुनः॥
en: She gave one of those fruits to her own child and the other to the prince. The fruits she brought were sweet like ambrosia, and capable of increasing strength and energy. Every day she brought them and every day she distributed them in the same way. The infant prince gained great strength from the fruit which Pujani give him.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: ततोऽगच्छत् परां वृद्धिं राजपुत्रः फलाशनात्। ततः स धाच्या कक्षेण उह्यमानो नृपात्मजः॥ ददर्श तं पक्षिसुतं बाल्यादागत्य बालकः। ततो बाल्याच्च यत्नेन तेनाक्रीडत पक्षिणा॥
en: One day the infant prince, while carried by the nurse on her arms saw the little young one of Pujani. Going down from the nurse's arms, the child ran towards the bird, and out of childish impulse, began to sport with it, liking the same very much.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: शून्ये च तमुपादाय पक्षिणं समजातकम्। हत्वा ततः स राजेन्द्र धात्र्या हस्तमुपागतः॥
en: At length, raising the bird which was to the same age with himself with his hands, the prince pressed it to death and then returned to his nurse.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: अथ सा पूजनी राजन्नागमत् फलहारिणी। अपश्यन्निहतं पुत्रं तेन बालेन भूतले॥
en: The bird, O king, who had as usual been out in her search of fruits, returning to the palace, and saw her young one lying on the ground, killed by the prince.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: वाष्पपूर्णमुखी दीना दृष्ट्वा तं रुदती सुतम्। पूजनी दुःखसंतप्ता रुदती वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ क्षत्रिये सगतं नास्ति न प्रीतिर्न च सौहृदम्। कारणात् सान्त्वयन्त्येते कृतार्थाः संत्यजन्ति च॥
en: Seeing her son dead, Pujani, with tears trickling down her cheeks, and heart burning with grief, wept bitterly and said,-Alas nobody should live with a Kshatriya or contract friendship with him, or take pleasure in having any connection with him! When they have any object in view, they behave with courtesy. When that object is accomplished, they abandon the instrument.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: क्षत्रियेषु न विश्वासः कार्यः सर्वापकारिषु। अपकृत्यापि सततं सान्त्वयन्ति निरर्थकम्॥
en: The Kshatriyas do evil to all. They should never be trusted. Even after doing an injury they always try to solace and assure the injured for nothing.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: अहमस्य करोम्यद्य सदृशीं वैरयातनाम्। कृतघ्नस्य नृशंसस्य भृशं विश्वासघातिनः॥
en: I shall, forsooth, wreak vengeance, for this act of enmity upon this truthless and ungrateful betrayer of trust.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: सहसंजातवृद्धस्य तथैव सहभोजिनः। शरणागतस्य च वधस्त्रिविधं ह्येव पातकम्॥
en: He has been guilty of three-fold sins taking the life of one that was born on the same day with him and that was being brought up with him in the same place, that used to eat with him, and that depended on him for protection.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: इत्युक्त्वा चरणाभ्यां नेत्रे नृपसुतस्य सा। भित्त्वा स्वस्था तत इदं पूजनी वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ इच्छयेह कृतं पापं सद्यस्तं चोपसर्पति। कृतं प्रतिकृतं येषां न नश्यति शुभाशुभम्॥
en: Having said these words aside, Pujani, with her talons, pierced the eyes of the prince, and finding some comfort from that act of vengeance, once more said,-A sinful deed, committed with deliberation, assails the doer without any loss of time. They, however, who avenge an injury, never lose their merit.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पापं कर्म कृतं किंचिद् यदि तस्मिन् न दृश्यते। नृपते तस्य पुत्रेषु पौत्रेष्वपि च नतृषु॥
en: If the fruits of a sinful act be not seen in the perpetrator himself, they would certainly be seen. O king, in his sons; or son's sons, ci daughter's sons!

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: तु ब्रह्मदत्तः सुतं दृष्ट्वा पूजन्याहृतलोचनम्। कृते प्रतिकृतं मत्वा पूजनीमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing his son blinded by Pujani, and considering the act to have been proper vengeance for what his son nad done, Brahmadatta said these words to Pujani.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: ब्रह्मदत्त उवाच अस्ति वै कृतमस्माभिरस्ति प्रतिकृतं त्वया। उभयं तत् समीभूतं वस पूजनि मा गमः॥
en: An injury, was done by us to you. You have avenged it by doing an injury in return. The account is settled. Do not leave your present residence. On the other hand, continue to live here, O Pujani.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पूजन्युवाच सकृत् कृतापराधस्य तत्रैव परिलम्बतः। न तद् बुधाः प्रशंसन्ति श्रेयस्तत्रापसर्पणम्॥
en: The learned never speak high of the conduct of a person, who having once injured another continues to live with that other. Under such circumstances it is always better for the injurer to quit his old place.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: सान्त्वे प्रयुक्ते सततं कृतवैरे न विश्वसेत्। क्षिप्रं स बध्यते मूढो न हि वैरं प्रशाम्यति॥
en: One should never trust the soothing assurances received from an injured party. The fool that trusts such assurances is soon ruined. Enmity is not quickly cooled.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: अन्योन्यकृतवैराणां पुत्रपौत्रं नियच्छति। पुत्रपौत्रविनाशे च परलोकं नियच्छति॥
en: The very sons and grandsons of persons, who have injured each other, meet with destruction. For such destruction of their children, they lose the next world also.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: सर्वेषां कृतवैराणामविश्वासः सुखोदयः। एकान्ततो न विश्वासः कार्यो विश्वासघातकैः॥
en: Amongst imn who have injured one another, distrust would yield happiness. One who has betrayed confidence should never be trusted in the least.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: न विश्वसेदविश्वस्ते विश्वस्ते नातिविश्वसेत्। विश्वासाद् भयमुत्पन्नमपि मूलं निकृन्तति। कामं विश्वासयेदन्यान् परेषां च न विश्वसेत्॥
en: One, who is not worthy of confidence should not be trusted; nor should too much trust be reposed in a person worthy of trust. The danger originating from blind confidence engenders absolute destruction. One should try to sccure the confidence of others. One, however, should never place confidence in others.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: माता पिता बान्धवानां वरिष्ठौ भार्या जरा बीजमात्रं तु पुत्रः। भ्राता शत्रुः क्लित्रपाणिर्वयस्य आत्मा ह्येकः सुखदुःखस्य भोक्ता॥
en: The parents only are the best of friends. The wife is merely a soil for sowing seeds. The son is only one's seed. The brother is an enemy. The friend or companion wants to have his palms oiled if he is to continue so. One's own self enjoys or suffers one's happiness or misery.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: अन्योन्यकृतवैराणां न संधिरुपपद्यते। स च हेतुरतिक्रान्तो यदर्थमहमावसम्॥
en: Real peace cannot live amongst persons who have injured one another. No such necessity exists any longer for which I livea here.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पूजितस्यार्थमानाभ्यां जन्तोः पूर्वापकारिणः। मनो भवत्यविश्वस्तं कर्म त्रासयतेऽबलान्॥
en: The mind of a person who has once injured another, becomes naturally filled with want of confidence, if he sees the injured person adoring him with gifts and honours. Such conduct especially when shorn by the strong, always strikes the weak with fear.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पूर्वं सम्मानन, यत्र पश्चाच्चैव विमानना। जह्यात् तत् सत्त्ववान् स्थानं शत्रो:सम्मानितोऽपिसन्।।
en: An intelligent person should leave that place where he first meets with honour in order to meet next with dishonour and injury. Despite any subsequent honour that he might get from his enemy, he should act thus.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: उषितास्मि तवागारे दीर्घकालं समर्चिता। तदिदं वैरमुत्पन्नं सुखमाशु व्रजाम्यहम्॥
en: I have lived in your house for a long time, respected all along by you. a cause of eninity, however, has at last taken place. I should, therefore, quit this place without any hesitation.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: ब्रह्मदत्त उवाच यः कृते प्रतिकुर्याद् वै न स तत्रापरानुयात्। अनृणस्तेन भवति वस पूजनि मा गमः॥
en: Brahmadatta said One, who does return injury for an injury, is never considered as offending. Indeed, the avenger closes his account by such behaviour. Therefore, O Pujani, continue to live here without quitting this place!

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पूजन्युवाच न कृतस्य तु कर्तुश्च सख्यं संधीयते पुनः हृदयं तत्र जानाति कर्तुश्चैव कृतस्य च॥
en: Pujani said No friendship can again be formed between a person who has injured and him who has inflicted an injury in return. The hearts cannot forget what has taken place.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: ब्रह्मदत उवाच कृतस्य चैव कर्तुश्च सख्यं संधीयते पुनः। वैरस्योपशमो दृष्टः पापं नोपाप्नुते पुनः॥
en: It is necessary that an injurer and the avenger of the injury should be united. Mutual enmity upon such a union has been seen to cool down. Usually, no fresh injury occurs.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पूजन्युवाच नास्ति वैरमतिक्रान्तं सान्त्वितोऽस्मीति नाश्वसेत्। विश्वासाद् वसते लोके तस्माच्छ्रेयोऽप्यदर्शनम्॥
en: Enmity originating from mutual injuries can never die. The person injured should never trust his enemies, drinking-O I have been comforted with assurances of good will!-In this world, men frequently suffer destruction for (misplaced) confidence. Therefore, it is necessary that we should no longer meet each other.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: तरसा ये न शक्यन्ते शस्त्रैः गुनिशितैरपि। साम्ना तेऽपि निगृह्यन्ते गजा इव करेणुभिः॥
en: Those, who cannot be subdued by force and Sharp weapons, can be conquered by insincere professions of love like (wild) elephants through a (tame) she-elephant.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: ब्रह्मदत्त उवाच संवासाज्जायते स्नेहो जीवितान्तकरेष्वपि।  अन्योन्यस्य च विधास: श्वपधेन शुनो पथा॥
en: For two persons living together, even if one indlicts upon the other deadly injury, fraternal love and mutual trist naturally raise between them, as in the case of the Chandala and the dog.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: अन्योन्कृतवैराणां संवासान्मृदुतां गतम्। नैव तिष्ठति तद् वैरं पुष्करस्थमिवोदकम्॥
en: Amongst persons who have ir jured one another, living together blunts the sharpness of enmily. Indeed, that enmity does not last long, but disappears quickly like water poured upon the leaf of a louts.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पूजन्युवाच वैरं पञ्चसमुत्थानं तच्च बुध्यन्ति पण्डिताः। स्त्रीकृतं वास्तुजं वाजं ससापत्नापराधजम्॥
en: Pujani said Emmity originates from five causes. Learned persons know it. Those five catises are woman, land, harsh words, natural disagreement, and injury.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: तत्र दाता न हन्तव्यः क्षत्रियेणशेषतः। प्रकाशं वाप्रकाशं वा बुद्दा दोषबलाबलम्॥
en: When the person, with whom enmity takes place, happens to be a liberal man, he should never be killed, particularly by a Kshatriya, openly or by hidden means. In such a case, the man's fault should be duly considered.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: कृतवैरे न विश्वासः कार्यस्विह सुहृद्यपि। छन्नं संतिष्ठते वैरं गूढोऽग्निरिव दारुषु।:४४॥
en: When enmity has arisen with even a friend, no further trust should be placed in him. Feelings of enmity lie hidden like fire in forest.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: न वित्तेन न पारुष्यैर्न सान्त्वेन न च श्रुतैः। कोपाग्निः शाम्यते राजस्तोयाग्निरिव सागरे॥
en: Like the Aurvya fire within the waters of the ocean, the fire of enmity can never be put out by presents of riches, by display of prowess, by conciliation or by scriptural learning.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: न हि पैधानिसस्त: कर्न चाप्यपराधजम्। शाम्यत्यदग्ध्वा नृपते विना टेकतर६. पात्॥
en: The fire of eninity, once lighted.-the result of an injury once inflicted,-is never extinguished, O king, without destroying the right one of the parties.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: सत्कृतस्यार्थमानाभ्यां तत्र पूर्वापकारिणः। नादेयोऽमित्रविश्वास: कर्म त्रासयतेऽबलान्॥
en: One, having injured a person, should never trust him again as his friend, even inough he might have (after the infliction of the injury) adored him with wealth and honours. Injury thus inflicted fills the injurer with fear,

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: नैवापकारे कस्मिंश्चिदहं त्वयि तथा भवान्। उषितास्मि गृहेऽहं ते नेदानी विश्वसाम्यहम्॥
en: I never injured you, You also did never do me an injury. Therefore. I lived in your house. All that is changed, ind at present I cannot trust you.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: ब्रह्मदत्त उवाच कालेन क्रियते कार्य तथैव विविधाः क्रियाः। कालेनैते प्रवर्तन्ते कः कस्येहापराध्यति॥
en: Brahmadatta said It is Time that does every work. There are various sorts all of which proceed form Time. Who, therefore, injures whom?

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: तुल्यं चोभे प्रवर्तेते मरणं जन्म चैव ह। कार्यते चैव कालेन तन्निमित्तं न जीवति॥
en: Birth and Death take place in the same way. Creatures act under the influence of Time, and it is in consequence also of Time that they cease to live.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: वध्यन्ते युगपत् केचिदेकैकस्य न चापरे। कालो दहति भूतानि सम्प्राप्याग्निरिवेन्धनम्॥
en: Some are seen to die at once. Some die one at a time. Some are seen to live for a long time. Like fire consuming the fuel it gets, Time destroys all creatures.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: नाहं प्रमाणं नैव त्वमन्योन्यं कारणं शुभे। कालो नित्यमुपादत्ते सुखं दुःखं च देहिनाम्॥
en: O blessed lady, I am, therefore, not the cause of your sorrow, nor are you the cause of inine. It is time which always ordains the happiness and misery of embodied creatures.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: एवं वसेह सस्नेहा यथाकाममर्हिसिता। यत् कृतं तत् तु मे क्षान्तं त्वंच वै क्षम पूजनि॥
en: Do you then continue to live here at your pleasure, with love for me and without fear of any injury from me. What you have done has been forgiven by me. Do you also forgive me, O Pujani.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पूजन्युवाच यदि कालः प्रमाणं ते न वैरं कस्यचिद् भवेत्। कस्मात् त्वपचितिं यान्ति बान्धवा बान्धवैहतैः॥
en: If Time, as you say, be the cause of all acts, then, of course, nobody can entertain fevlings of enmity towards anybody on earth. I ask, however, why do friends and kinsmen, when friends and kinsmen are killed, try to avenge the latter.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: कस्माद् देवासुराः पूर्वमन्योन्यमभिजन्निरे। यदि कालेन निर्याणं सुखं दुःखं भवाभवौ॥ भिषजो भैषजं कर्तुं कस्मादिच्छन्ति रोगिणः। यदि कालेन पच्यन्ते भेषजैः किं प्रयोजनम्॥
en: Why also did the gods and the Asuras in days of old kill each other in battle? If it is Time that begets happiness and misery and birth and death, why do physicians then seek to administer medicines to the sick? If it is Time that is shaping the course of everything, what need is thereof medicines,

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: प्रलापः सुमहान् कस्मात् क्रियते शोकमूच्छितैः। यदि कालः प्रमाणं ते कस्माद् धर्मोऽस्ति कर्तुषु॥
en: Why do people, deprived of their senses by grief, indulge in such lamentations? If Time, as you say, be the cause of all works, how can religious merit be acquired by persons performing religious acts?

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: तव पुत्रो ममापत्यं हतवान् स हतो मया। अनन्तरं त्वयाहं च हन्तव्या हि नराधिप॥
en: Your son killed my child. I have injured him for that. I have by inat act, o king, become liable to be killed by you.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: अहं हि पुत्रशोकेन कृतपापा तवात्मजे। यथा त्वया प्रहर्तव्यं तथा तत्त्वं च मे शृणु॥
en: Moved by grief for my son, I have thus injured your son. Listen now to the reason why I should be killed by you.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: भक्ष्यार्थं क्रीडनार्थं च नरा वाञ्छन्ति पक्षिणः। तृतीयो नास्ति संयोगो वधबन्धादृते क्षमः॥
en: Men wish either to kill birds for food or to keep them in cages for sport. There is no third reason except killing or caging for which men would seek birds.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: वधबन्धभयादेते मोक्षतन्त्रमुपाश्रिताः। जनीमरणजं दुःखं प्राहुर्वेदविदो जनाः॥
en: Birds again, from fear of being either killed or put into cage by rnen, seek safety in flight.। Persons conversant with the Vedas have said। that death and imprisonment both painful.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: सर्वस्य दयिताः प्राणाः सर्वस्य दक्षिाः सुता। दुःखादुद्विजते सर्वः सर्वस्य सुखमीप्सितम्।।६२।
en: Life is dear to all. All creatures are made miserable by grief and pain. All creatures wish for happiness.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: दुःखं जरा ब्रह्मदत्त दुःखमर्थविपर्ययः। दुःखं चानिष्टसंवासो दुःखमिवियोजनम्॥
en: Misery originates from various sources. Decrepitude, O Brahmadatta, is misery. The loss of wealth is misery. The nearness of anything disagreeable or evil is misery. Separation or dissociation from friends and beloved objects is misery.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: वधबन्धकृतं दुःखं स्त्रीकृतं सहजं तथा। दुःख सुतेन सततं जनान् विपरिवर्तते॥
en: Misery originates from death and imprisonment. Misery arises from women and from other natural causes. The misery that originates from the death of children changes and afflicts all creatures very greatly.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: न दुःखं परदुःखे वै केचिदाहुरबुद्धयः। यो दुःखं नाभिजानाति स जल्पति महाजने॥
en: Some foolish persons say that there is no misery in seeing other's misery. Only he wno has not felt any misery himself can say so before men.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: यस्तु शोचति दुःखार्तः स कथं वक्तुमुत्सहेत्। रसज्ञः सर्वदुःखस्य यथाऽऽत्मनि तथा परे॥
en: He, however, who has felt sorrow and misery, would never venture to say so. One, who has felt the pangs of all sorts of misery, sympathises with the misery of others.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: यत् कृतं ते मया राजंस्त्वया च मम यत् कृतम्। न तद् वर्षशतैः शक्यं व्यपोहितुमरिंदम्॥
en: What I have done to you, O king, and what you have done to me, cannot be washed away by even a century.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: आवयोः कृतमन्योन्यं पुनः संधिर्न विद्यते। स्मृत्वा स्मृत्वा हि ते पुत्रं नवं वैरं भविष्यति।६८॥
en: There cannot be a reconciliation after what we have done to each other. Whenever you will thirt of your son, .'our enmity towards me will become fresh.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: वैरपन्तिकमासाद्य यः प्रीति कर्तुमिच्छति। मृन्मयस्येव भग्नस्य यथा संधिर्न विद्यते॥
en: If a person after avenging an injury, wishes to make peace with the injured, the parties cannot be properly reunited even like the pieces of an earthen vessel.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: निश्चयः स्वार्थशास्त्रेषु विश्वासश्चासुखोदयः। उशना चैव गाथे द्वे प्रह्लादायाब्रवीत् पुरा॥
en: Men well read in scriptures have laid it down that trust never yields happiness. Ushanas himself sang two verses to Prahlada in days of yore.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: ये वैरिणः श्रद्दधते सत्ये सत्येतरेऽपि वा। वध्यन्ते श्रद्दधानास्तु मधु शुष्कतृणैर्यथा॥
en: He, who trust the words, true or false, of an enemy, meets with destruction like a seeker of honey, in a pit covered with dry grass.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: न हि वैराणि शाम्यन्ति कुले दुःखगतानि च। आख्यातारश्च विद्यन्ते कुले वै ध्रिप्ते पुमान्॥
en: Enmities outlive the enemies, for there is no want of persons who speak of the quarrels of deceased fathers before their surviving children.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: उपगृह्य तु वैराणि सान्त्वयन्ति नराधिप। अथैनं प्रतिपिंषन्ति पूर्णं घटमिवाश्मनि॥
en: Kings kill animosities by means of conciliation but, when the opportunity presents itself, they break their enemies tu pieces like earthen jars full of water dashed against stone.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: सदा न विश्वसेद् राजन् पापं कृत्वेह कस्यचित्। अपकृत्य परेषां हि विश्वासाद् दुःखमश्नुते॥
en: If the king injures any one, he should never trust him again. By trusting a person who has been injured, one suffers great misery.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: ब्रह्मदत्त उवाच नाविश्वासाद् विन्दतेऽर्थानीहते चापि किंचन। भयात् त्वेकतरान्नित्यं मृतकल्पा भवन्ति च॥
en: No man can secure the fruitfulness of any object by distrusting others. By cherishing fear one always is compelleu to live as a dead person.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पूजन्नुवाच यस्येह व्रणिनी पादौ पद्भ्यां च परिसर्पति। खन्येते तस्य तौ पादौ सुगुप्तमिह धावत:॥
en: He whose feet have become sore, certainly meets with a fall if he seeks to move, however cautiously he may do it.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: नेत्राभ्यां सरुजाभ्यां यः प्रतिवातमुदीक्षते। तस्य वायुरुन्दात्यर्थं नेत्रयोर्भवति ध्रुवम्॥
en: By opening his eyes against the wind, a man, who has got sore ejus, finds them greatly pained by the wind.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: दुष्टं पन्थानमासाद्य यो मोहादुपपद्यते। आत्मनो बलभज्ञाय तदन्तं तस्य जीवितम्॥
en: He, who, without knowing his own । strength, treads a wicked path and persists in wa'king along it, soon loses his very life as the result of it.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: यस्तु वर्षमविज्ञाय क्षेत्रं कर्षति कर्षकः। हीन: पुरुषकारेण सस्यं नैवाश्नुते ततः॥
en: The man, who, shorn of exertion, tills his land, without taking care of the season of rain, never reaps a harvest.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: यस्तु तिक्तं कषायं वा स्वादु वा मधुरं हितम्। आहारं कुरुते नित्यं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते।॥
en: He, who takes daily nutritive food, be it bitter or astringent or palatable or sweet, lives long.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पथ्यं मुक्त्वा तु यो मोहाद् दुष्टमश्नाति भोजनम्। परिणाममविज्ञाय तदन्तं तस्य जीवितम्॥
en: He, on the other hand, who neglects wholesome food and takes injurious ones regardless of consequences, soon meets with death.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: दैवं पुरुषकारश्च स्थितावन्योन्यसंश्रयात्। उदाराणां तु सत्कर्म दैवं क्लीबा उपासते॥
en: Destiny and Exertion depend upon each other. The high-minded perform good and grcat feats, while eunuchs only flatters Destiny.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: कर्म चात्महितं कार्य तीक्ष्णं वा यदि वा मृदु। ग्रस्यतेऽकर्मशीलस्तु सदान\ रकिञ्चनः॥
en: Whether it is harsh or mild, a beneficial act should be done. The unfortunate man of inaction, however, is always assailed with all sorts of calamity.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: तस्मात् सर्वं व्यपोह्यार्थं कार्य एव पराक्रमः। सर्वस्वमपि संत्यज्य कार्यमात्महितं नरैः॥
en: Therefore casting of everything else, one should display his energy. Indeed, disregarding everything, men should do what does good to themselves.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: विद्या शौर्यं च दाक्ष्यं च बलं धैर्यं च पञ्चमम्। मित्राणि सहजान्याहुर्वर्तयन्तीह तैर्बुधाः॥
en: Knowledge, courage, cleverness, strength and patience, are one's natural friends. The wise live in this world with the help of those five.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: निवेशनं च कुप्यं व क्षेत्रं भार्या सुहज्जनः। एतान्युपहितान्याहुः सर्वत्र लभते पुमान्॥
en: Houses, precious metals, land, wife, ar.J friends,-these are spoken by the learned as the secondary sources of good. A man may obtain them everywhere.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: सर्वत्र रमते प्राज्ञः सर्वत्र च विराजते। न विभीपयते कश्चिद् भीषितो न बिभेति च॥
en: A wise man may be delighted everywhere. Such a mari shines everywhere. He never strikes anybody with fear. If tried to be frightened, he never yields to fear himself.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: नित्यं बुद्धिमतोऽप्यर्थः स्वल्पकोऽपि विवर्धते। दाक्ष्ये' कुर्वतः कर्म मंयपात् प्रतितिष्ठति॥
en: The wealth, however little, of an intelligent man is certain to increase. Such a man does every act cleverly. By self-restraint he acquires great fame.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: गृहस्नेहावबद्धानां नराणामल्पमेधसाम्। कुस्त्री खादति मांसानि माघमां सेगवा इव॥ गृहं क्षेत्राणि मित्राणि स्वदेश इति चापरे। इत्येवमवसीदन्ति नरा बुद्धिविपर्यये॥
en: Home-sick foolish wights have to put ur with shrew wives who eat up their flesh like the young ones of a crab eating up their mothers. There are men v ho through loss of understanding become very disspirited at the prospect of leaving home. They say,-These are our friends! This is our country! Alas, how shall we leave thesc?

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: उत्पतेत् सहजाद् देशाद् व्याधिदुर्भिक्षपीडितात्। अन्यत्र वस्तुं गच्छेद् वा वसेद् वा नित्यमानितः॥
en: One should, forsooth, leave his mothercountry if it be affected by plague or famine. One should live in one's own country, re.ipected of all, or go to a foreign country for living there.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: तस्मादन्यत्र यास्यामि वस्तुं नाहमिहोत्सहे। दृतमेतदनार्यं मे तव पुत्रे च पार्थिव॥
en: I shall, therefore, repair to some other region. I do not venture to live any longer in this place, for I have greatly injured your child, O king.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: कुभार्यां च कुपुत्रं च कुराजानं कुसौहृदम्। कुसम्बन्धं कुदेशं च दूरतः परिवर्जयेत्॥
en: One should from a distance renounce a bad wife, a bad son, a bad king, a bad friend, a bad allie and a bad country.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: कुपुत्रे नास्ति विश्वासः कुभार्यायां कुतो रतिः। कुराज्ये निर्वृतिर्नास्ति कुदेशे नास्ति जीविका॥
en: One should not confide in a bad son. One cannot find delight in a bad wife. There can be no happiness in a had kingdom. One cannot obtain a livelihood in a bad country.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: कुमित्रे संगतिर्नास्ति नित्यमस्थिरसौहदे। अवमानः कुसम्बन्धे भवत्यर्थविपर्यये॥
en: There can be no permanent friendship with a bad friend whose attachinent is very uncertain. There is disgrace in a bad connection, when there is no necessity for it.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: सा भार्या प्रियं ब्रूते स पुत्रो यत्र निर्वृतिः। तन्मित्रं यत्र विश्वासः स देशो यत्र जीव्यते॥
en: She, indeed, is a wife who speaks only what is pleasant. He is a son who makes the father happy. He is a friend whoin one can trust. That, indeed, is one's country where one acquires his living.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: यत्र नास्ति बलात्कारः स राजा तीव्रशासनः। भीरेव नास्ति सम्बन्धो दरिद्रं यो बुभूषते॥
en: He is a strict king who does not oppress, who supports the indigent and in whose kingdom there is no fear.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: भार्या देशोऽथ मित्राणि पुत्रसम्बन्धिबान्धवाः। एते सर्वे गुणवति धर्मनेत्रे महीपतौ॥
en: One can have wife, country, friends, son, kinsmen, and relatives, if the king be accomplished and virtuous.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: अधर्मज्ञस्य विलयं प्रजा गच्छन्ति निग्रहात्। राजा मूलं त्रिवर्गस्य स्वप्रमत्तोऽनुपालयेत्॥
en: If the king happens to be sinful, his subjects, for his oppressions, meet with destruction. The king is the root of threefold objects, i.e., Virtue, Wealth, and Pleasure. He should protect his subject carefully.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: बलिषड्भागमुद्धृत्य बलिं समुपयोजयेत्। न रक्षति प्रजाः सम्यग् यः स पार्थिवतस्करः॥
en: Taking from his subjects a sixth part of their riches, he should protect them all. That king, who does not protect his subjects, is indeed, a thief.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: दत्त्वाभयं यः स्वयमेव राजा न तत् प्रमाणं कुरुतेऽर्थलोभात्। स सर्वलोकादुपलभ्य पापं सोऽधर्मबुद्धिर्निरयं प्रयाति॥
en: That king, who, after holding out hopes of protection, does not, from rapacity satisfy them, that sinful king is visited by the sins of all his subjects and ultimately goes into hell.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: दत्त्वाभयं स्वयं राजा प्रमाणं कुरुते यदि। स सर्वसुखकृज्ज्ञेयः प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्॥
en: On the other hand, that king, who, having given hopes of protection, fulfils them, is honoured as a universal benefactor in consequence of his protecting all his subjects.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: माता पिता गुरुर्गोप्ता वह्निर्वैश्रवणो यमः। सप्त राज्ञो गुणानेतान् मनुराह प्रजापतिः॥
en: The lord of all creatures, viz., Manu, has declared that the king has seven attributes : he is mother, father, preceptor, protector, fire, Vaishravana, and Yama.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: पिता हि राजा राष्ट्रस्य प्रजाना योऽनुकम्पनः। तस्मिन् मिथ्याविनीतो हि तिर्यग् गच्छति मानवः।।१०४
en: The king by treating his people mercifully is called their father. The subject who plays him false, is born in his next life as an animal or a bird.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: सम्भावयति मातेव दीनमप्युपपद्यते। दहत्यग्निरिवानष्टान् यमयन्नसतो यमः॥
en: By doing good to them and by supporting the poor, the king becomes a mother to his people. By consuming the wicked he is regarded as fire, and by restraining the sinful he is called Yama.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: इष्टेषु विसृजन्नर्थान् कुबेर इव कामदः। गुरुर्धर्मोपदेशेन गोप्ता च परिपालयन्॥
en: By making presents of riches to his dear ones, the king is regarded as Kubera, the grantor of wishes. By delivering instructions of morality and virtue, he becomes a preceptor, and by exercising the duty of protection he becomes the preceptor.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: यस्तु रञ्जयते राजा पौरजानपदान् गुणैः। न तस्य भ्रमते राज्यं स्वयं धर्मानुपालनात्॥
en: That king who pleases the inhabitants of his cities and provinces by means of his virtues, is never divested of his kingdom for observing such a duty.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: स्वयं समुपजानन् हि पौरजानपदार्चनम्। स सुखं प्रेक्षते राजा इह लोके परत्र च॥
en: That king who knows how to honour his subjects, never suffers misery either in this world or in the next.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: नित्योद्विग्नाः प्रजा यस्य करभारप्रपीडिताः। अनथैविप्रलुप्यन्ते स गच्छति पराभवम्॥
en: That king whose subjects are always stricken with anxiety or laden with taxes, and overwhelmed with all sorts of evils is defeated by his enemies.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: प्रजा यस्य विवर्धन्ते सरसीव महोत्पलम्। स सर्वफलभाग् राजा स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: That king, on the other hand, whose subjects grow like a large lotus in a lake, acquires every reward here and at last meets with łonour in the celestial region.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: बलिना विग्रहो राजन् न कदाचित् प्रशस्यते। बलिना विग्रहो यस्य कुतो राज्यं कुतः सुखम्॥१११।
en: Enmity with a powerful person, O king, is never spoken highly of. That king who has incurred the hostility of one more powerful than himself, loses both kingdom and happiness.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: भीष्म उवाच सैवमुक्त्वा शकुनिका ब्रह्मदत्तं नराधिप। राजानं समनुज्ञाप्य जगामाभीप्सितां दिशम्॥
en: O monarch, having said so to Brahmadatta, the bird, took the king's leave and went away of her pleasure.

description: How should a king act without trusting others
sn: एतत् ते ब्रह्मदत्तस्य पूजन्या सह भाषितम्। मयोक्तं नृपतिश्रेष्ठ किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: I have thus recited to you, O foremost of kings, the conversation between Brahmadatta and Pujani. What else do you wish to hear.'

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच युगक्षयात् परिक्षीणे धर्मे लोके च भारत। दस्युभिः पीड्यमाने च कथं स्थेयं पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said When both virtue and men, O Bharata, suffer for the gradual lapse of a cycle and when the world is assailed by robbers, how, O Grandfather should a king then behave.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि नीतिमापत्सु भारत। उत्सृज्यापि घृणां काले यथा वर्तेत भूमिपः॥
en: Bhishma said 'I shall tell you, O Bharata, the policy the king should pursue amid such distress. I shall tell you how he should behave himself at such a time, casting off mercy.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। भारद्वाजस्य संवादं राज्ञः शत्रुजयस्य च॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old story of the conversation between Bharadwaja and king Shatrunjaya.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: राजा शत्रुजयो नाम सौवीरेषु महारथः । भारद्वाजमुपागम्य पप्रच्छार्थविनिश्चयम्॥ अलब्धस्य कथं लिप्सा लब्धं केन विवर्धते। वर्धितं पाल्यते केन पालितं प्रणयेत् कथम्॥
en: There was a king name Shatrunjaya among the Sauviras. He was a great car-warrior. Going to Bharadwaja, he asked the Rishi about the truths of the science of Profit, saying,-How can an unattained object be attained. How, again, when acquired, can it be multiplied? How also, when increased, can it be protected? And how, when protected, should it be used.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: तस्मै विनिश्चितार्थाय परिपृष्टोऽर्थनिश्चयम्! उवाच ब्राह्मणो वाक्यमिदं हेतुमदुत्तमम्॥
en: Thus accosted about the truths of the science of Profit, the twice-born one said the following reasonable words to that king for explaining those truths.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: ऋषि उवाच नित्यमुद्यतदण्डः स्यानित्यं विवृतपौरुषः। अच्छिद्रश्छिद्रदर्शी च परेषां विवरानुगः॥
en: The king should always remain with the rod of punishment in his hand. He should always show his prowess. Himself without shortcomings, he should mark those of his enemies. Indeed, his eye should always be used for that object.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: नित्यमुद्यतदण्डस्य भृशमुद्विजते नरः। तस्मात् सर्वाणि भूतानि दण्डेनैव प्रसाधयेत्॥
en: On seeing a king who has the rod of punishment ever uplifted in his hand, every one is filled with fear. Therefore, the king should rule all creatures with the rod of punishment.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: एवं दण्डं प्रशंसन्ति पण्डितास्तत्त्वदर्शिनः। तस्माच्चतुष्टये तस्मिन् प्रधानो दण्ड उच्यते॥
en: Men endued with learning and knowledge of truth speak high of Punishment. Hence, of the four-fold means, viz., Conciliation, Gift, Dissension and Punishment, Punishment is said to be the foremost.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: छिन्नमूले त्वधिष्ठाने सर्वेषां जीवनं हतम्। कथ हि शाखास्तिष्ठेयुश्छिन्नमूले वनस्पतौ॥
en: When the root of a refuge is cut off, all the refugees die. When the root of a tree cut off, how would the branches live?

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: मूलमेवादितश्छिन्द्यात् परपक्षस्य पण्डितः। ततः सहायान् पक्षं च मूलमेवानुसाधयेत्॥
en: A wise king should cut off the very roots of his enemy. He should then win over and bring under his control the allies and partisans of that enemy.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: सुमन्त्रितं सुविक्रान्तं सुयुद्धं सुपलायितम्। आपदास्पदकाले तु कुर्वीत न विचारयेत्॥
en: When calamities befall the king, he should advise wisely, show his prowess properly, fight with ability, and even retreat with wisdom.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: वाङ्मात्रेण विनीतः स्याद्धृदयेन यथा क्षुरः। श्लक्ष्णपूर्वाभिभाषी च कामक्रोधौ विवर्जयेत्॥
en: In words only should the king show his humility, but at heart he should be sharp as a razol. He should renounce lust and anger, and speak sweetly and mildly.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: सपत्नसहिते कार्ये कृत्वा सन्धि न विश्वसेत्। अपक्रामेत् ततः शीघं कृतकार्यो विचक्षणः॥
en: When the time for cominunication with an enemy arrives, a far-sighted king should make peace, without tn.sting hirr blindly. When thi: transaction is finished. he should speedily renounce the new ally.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: शत्रु च मित्ररूपेण सान्त्वेनैवाभिसान्त्वयेत्। नित्यशश्नोद्विजेत् तस्माद् गृहात् सर्पयुतादिव॥
en: One should conciliate an enemy with sweet assurances as if he were a friend. One, however, should always fear that enemy like a room within which there is a snake.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: यस्य बुद्धिः परिभवेत् तमतीतेन सान्त्वयेत्। अनागतेन दुष्प्रज्ञं प्रत्युत्पन्नेन पण्डितम्॥
en: You should assure him with references to the past whose sense you want to control. A wicked man should be assured by promises of future well-being.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: अञ्जलिं शपथं सान्त्वं प्रणम्य शिरसा वदेत्। अश्रुप्रमार्जनं चैव कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: The wise person should be assured by present services. The person who is desirous of acquiring prosperity should join hands, swear, use sweet words, adore by bending down his head, and shed tears.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: वहेदमित्रं स्कन्धेन यावत्कालस्य पर्ययः। प्राप्तकालं तु विज्ञाय भिन्द्याद् घटमिवाश्मनि॥
en: one should carry his enemy, on his shoulders as long as time is unfavourable. When, however, the opportunity presents itself, one should break him into pieces like an earthcn jar on a stone.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: मुहूर्तमपि राजेन्द्र तिन्दुकालातवज्ज्वलेत्। न तुषाग्निरिवानर्चिधूमायेत चिरं नरः॥ नानार्थिकोऽर्थसम्बन्धं कृतघ्नेन समाचरेत्।
en: It is better, O monarch, that a king should burn up for the time being like charcoal of ebony-wood than that he should smoulder and sinoke like chaff for many years.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: अर्थी तु शक्यते भोक्तुं कृतकार्योऽवमन्यते। तस्मात् सर्वाणि कार्याणि सावशेषाणि कारयेत्॥
en: A man who has many things to do, should not hesitatu to deal with even an ungrateful person. If successful, one can enjoy happiness. If unsuccessful, one loses respect.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: कोकिलस्य वराहस्य मेरो: शून्यस्य वेश्मनः। नटस्य भक्तिमित्रस्य यच्छ्रेचस्तत् समाचरेत्॥
en: Therefore, in doing the work of such persons, one should, without finishing them completely, always keep something undone. A king should do what is for his well-being, imitating a kokila, a boar, the mountains of Meru, and empty chamber, an actor, and a devoted friend.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: उत्थायोत्याय गच्छेत नित्ययुक्तो रिपोर्गृहान्। कुशलं चास्य पृच्छेत यद्यप्यकुशलं भवेत्॥
en: The king should, always, with careful application, go to the houses of his enemies, and even if calamities overtake them, ask them about their well-being.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: नालसाः प्राप्नुवन्त्यर्थान् न क्लीबा नाभिमानिनः। न च लोकरवाद् भीता न वै शश्वत् प्रतीक्षिणः।।२३।
en: Those who are idle never acquire ricnes; nor those who are shorn of manliness and exertion; nor those who are vain; nor those who fear unpopularity; nor those who arc always dilatory.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: नात्मच्छिद्रं रिपुर्विद्याद् विहाच्छिद्रं परस्य तु। गृहेत् कूर्म इवाङ्गानि रक्षेद् विवरमात्मनः॥
en: The king should act in such way that his foe may not see his shortcomings. He should, however, himself notice the weak points of his enemy. He should imitate the tortoise which conceals its limbs. He should always keep hidden his own holes.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: बकवच्चिन्तयेदर्थान् सिंहतच्च पराक्रमेत्। वृकवच्चावलुम्पेत शरवच्च विनिष्पतेत्॥
en: He should think of all financial matters like a crane. He should show his prowess like a lion. He should lie in ambush like a wolf and attack and pierce his foes like an arrow.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: पानमक्षास्तथा नार्यो मृगया गीतवादितम्। एतानि युक्त्या सेवेत प्रसंगो ह्यत्र दोषवान्॥
en: He should be careful in his enjoyments regarding drink, dice, women, hunting, and music. Addiction to these produces evil.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: कुर्यात् तृणमयं चापं शयीत मृगशायिकाम्। अन्धः स्यादन्धवेलायां बाधिर्यमपि संश्रयेत्॥
en: He should make his bow of bamboos; he should sleep like the deer; he should be blind when it is necessary for him to be so, or he should even be deaf when it is necessary to be deaf.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: देशकालौ समासाद्य विक्रमेत विचक्षणः। देशकालव्यतीतो हि विक्रमो निष्फलो भवेत्॥
en: The wise king should display his prowess, considering time and place. If these are not favourable, prowess becomes useless.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: कालाकालौ सम्प्रधार्य बलाबलमथात्मनः। परस्य च बलं ज्ञात्वा तत्रात्मानं नियोजयेत्॥
en: Noting the opportune and inopportune moment, reflecting upon his own strength by comparing it with that of the enemy, the king should take up his work.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: दण्डेनोपनतं शत्रु यो राजा न नियच्छति। स मृत्युमुपगृह्णाति गर्भमश्वतरी यथा॥
en: That king who does not crush down an enemy by military force, provides for his own death like the crab when she conceives.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: सुपुष्पितः स्यादफलः फलवान् स्याद् दुरारुहः। आमः स्यात् पक्वसंकाशो न च शीर्येत कस्यचित्॥
en: The king should show blossoms but not fruits. When showing fruits he should be difficult of climbing; and though unripe he should seem to be ripe. If he acts thus he would succeed in upholding himself against all enemies. then put man

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: आशां कालवर्ती कुर्यात् तां च विघ्न योजयेत्। विघ्नं निमित्ततो ब्रूयानिमित्तं चापि हेतुतः॥
en: The king should first strengthen the hopes (of the suitors). He should impediments in the way of the fulfilment of those hopes. He should say that those impediments are merely due to time. He should next represent that those occasions are really the outcome of weighty causes.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: भीतवत् संविधातव्यं यावद् भयमनागतम्। आगतं तु भयं दृष्ट्वा प्रहर्तव्यमभीतवत्॥
en: As long as the cause of fear does not actually arrive, the king should make all his arrangements like a person filled with fear. When, however, the cause of fear arrives, he should smite fearlessly.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: न संशयमनारुह्य नरो भद्राणि पश्यति। संशयं पुनरारुह्य यदि जीवति पश्यति॥
en: No can derive benefit without incurring danger. If, again, he succeeds in preserving his life in the midst of danger's he is sure to acquire great benefits.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: अनागतं विजानीयाद् यच्छेद् भयमुपस्थितम्। पुनर्वृद्धिभयात् किंचिदनिवृत्तं निशामयेत्॥
en: A king should determine all future dangers; when they are present, he should conquer them; and lest they may grow again, he should, even after conquering them, consider them, as unconquered.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: प्रत्युपस्थितकालस्य सुखस्य परिवर्जनम्। अनागतसुखाशा च नैव बुद्धिमतां नयः॥
en: The relinquishing of present happiness and the pursuit of the future one, is never the policy of an intelligent person.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: योऽरिणा सह संधाय सुखं स्वपिति विश्वसन्। स वृक्षाग्रे प्रसुप्तो वा पतितः प्रतिबुद्ध्यते॥
en: That king who having made peace with an enemy sleeps happily and confidently is lįke a man who sleeping on the top of a iree awakes after a fall,

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: कर्मणा येन तेनैव मृदुना दारुणेन च। उद्धरेद् दीनमात्मानं समर्थो धर्ममाचरेत्॥
en: When one is in distress, he should raise himself by any means in his power. mild or stern; and after such advancement, he should, if able, practise virtue.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: ये सपत्नाः सपत्नानां सर्वोस्तानुपसेवयेत्। आत्मनश्चापि बोद्धव्याचारा विनिहताः परैः॥
en: The king should always honour the enemies of his foes. He should consider his own spies as agents employed by his enemies,

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: चारस्त्वविदितः कार्य आत्मनोऽथ परस्य च। पाषण्डांस्तापसादींश्च परराष्ट्र प्रवेशयेत्॥ उद्यानेषु विहारेषु प्रपास्वावसथेषु च। पानागारे प्रवेशेषु तीर्थेषु च सभासु च॥ धर्माभिचारिणः पापाश्चौरा लोकस्य कण्टकाः। समागच्छन्ति तान् बुद्धवा नियच्छेच्छमयीत च॥
en: The king should see that his own spies are not made out by his enemy. He should appoint atheists and ascetics as spies and despatch them to kingdom of his enemies. Sinful thieves, who violate the laws of virtue and who are thorns with every person, enter gardens and places of amusement and houses set up for giving drinking water to thirsty travellers and public restaurants and drinking spots and houses of ill fame and Tirthas and public assemblies. These should be recognised and arrested and suppressed.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: न विश्वसेदविश्वस्ते विश्वस्ते नातिविश्वसेत्। विश्वासाद् भयमभ्येति नापरीक्ष्य च विश्वसेद्॥
en: The king should not confide in an unworthy person; nor should he over confide in a person who is worthy of trust. Danger originates from confidence. Confidence should never be placed without previous examination.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: विश्वासयित्वा तु परं तत्त्वभूतेन हेतुना। अथास्य प्रहरेत् काले किंचिद् विचलिते पदे॥
en: Having by ostensible created confidence in the enemy, the king should strike him when he makes a mistake. reasons

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: अशङ्कयमपि शङ्केत नित्यं शङ्केत शङ्कितात्। भयं ह्यशङ्कितात्जातं समूलमपि कृन्तति॥
en: The king should fear him from whom there is no fear; he should also always fear them who should be feared. Fear rising from a person who is not feared, may bring on total extermination.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: अवधानेन मौनेन काषायेण जटाजिनैः। विश्वासयित्वा द्वेशरमवलुम्पेद् यथा वृकः॥
en: By devotion to religious pursuits, by taciturnity, by assuming the orange grab of monks, and wearing matted locks skins, one should create confidence in his enemy, and then, when the time comes, should pounce upon him like the wolf.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: पुत्रो वा यदि वा भ्राता पिता वा यदि वा सुहृत्। अर्थस्य विनं कुर्वाणा हन्तव्या भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: A king seeking prosperity should not hesitate to kill son or brother or father or friend, if any of these seek to thwart his objects.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: गुरोरप्यवलिप्तस्य कार्याकार्यमजानतः। उत्पथं प्रतिपन्नस्य दण्डो भवति शासनम्॥
en: The very preceptor, if he is haughty, ignorant of what should be done and what should not, and an impious person, should be restrained by Punishment.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: अभ्युत्थानाभिवादाभ्यां सम्प्रदानेन केनचित्। प्रतिपुष्पकलाघाती तीक्ष्णतुण्ड इव द्विजः॥
en: As sharp-stinged insects cut off all the flowers and fruits of the trees on which they sit, the king should, after having created confidence in his enemies by honours, salutations and gifts, go against him and deprive him of everything.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: नाच्छित्त्वा परमर्माणि नाकृत्वा कर्म दारुणम्। नाहत्वा मत्स्यधातीव प्राप्नोति महतीं श्रियम्॥
en: Without cutting the very vitals of others, without killing living creatures like fishermen, one cannot win great prosperity.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: नास्ति जात्या रिपु म मित्रं वापि न विद्यते। सामर्थ्ययोगाज्जायन्ते मित्राणि रिपवस्तथा॥
en: There is no separate order of creatures called enemies or friends. Persons become friends or enemies according to the trend of circumstances.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: अमित्रं नैव मुञ्चेत वदन्तं करुणान्यपि। दुःखं तत्र न कर्तव्यं हन्यात् पूर्वापकारिणम्॥
en: The king should never allow his enemy to escape even if he bewails piteously. He should never be moved by these; on the other hand, he should destroy the person who has done him an injury.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: संग्रहानुग्रहे यत्नः सदा कार्योऽनसूयता। निग्रहश्चापि यत्नेन कर्तव्यो भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: A king seeking prosperity should studiously win over as many men as he can, and do them good. In his conduct towards his subjects he should always be shorn of malice. He should also studiously punish and restrain the wicked and disaffected.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: प्रहरिष्यन् प्रियं ब्रूयात् प्रहृत्यैव प्रियोत्तरम्। असिनापि शिरश्छित्त्वा शोचेत च रुदेत च॥
en: When he wishes to take wealth, he should say what is agreeable. Having collected wealth, he should say similar things. Having severed one's head with his sword, he should grieve and shed tears.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: निमन्त्रयीत सान्त्वेन सम्मानेन तितिक्षया। लोकाराधनमित्येतत् कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: A king seeking posperity should win over others by sweet words, honours, and gifts. Thus should he take men into his service.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: न शुष्कवैरं कुर्वीत बाहुभ्यां न नदी तरेत्। अनर्थकमनायुष्यं गोविषाणस्य भक्षणम्। दन्ताश्च परिमृज्यन्ते रसश्चापि न लभ्यते॥
en: The king should never engage in idle disputes. He should never cross a river with the help only of his two arms. To eat cow-horns is useless and never gives strength. By eating them one's teeth are broken while the taste is not gratified.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: त्रिवर्गे त्रिविधा पीडानुबन्धास्त्रय एव च। अनुबन्धाः शुभा ज्ञेया: पीडाश्च परिवर्जयेत्॥
en: The three-fold objects have triple disadvantageous adjuncts. Carefully considering them, the disadvantages should be avoided.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: ऋणशेषमाग्निशेषं शत्रुशेषं तथैव च। पुनः पुनः प्रवर्धन्ते तस्माच्छेषं न धारयेत्॥
en: The unpaid residue of a debt, the unquenched remnant of a fire, and the unkilled remnant of foes, by and by grow and increase. Therefore, all those should be completely rooted out.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: वर्धमानमृणं तिष्ठेत् परिभूताश्च शत्रवः। जनयन्ति भयं तीव्र व्याधयश्चाप्युपेक्षिताः॥
en: Debt which always multiplies is sure to remain unless it is wholly paid up. Likewise are the defeated foes and neglected diseases. These always create great fear.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: नासम्यक्कृतकारी स्यादप्रमत्तः सदा भवेत्। कण्टकोऽपि हि दुश्छिन्नो विकारं कुरुते चिरम्॥
en: Every work should be done completely. One should be always careful. If extracted badly, such a minute thing as a thorn leads to obstinate gangrene.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: वधेन च मनुष्याणां मार्गाणां दूषणेन च। अगाराणां विनाशैश्च परराष्ट्रं विनाशयेत्॥
en: By killing its inhabitants, by breaking its roads and otherwise injuring them, and by burning and pulling down its houses, a king should devastate an enemy's realm.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: गृध्रदृष्टिर्बकालीनः श्वचेष्टः सिंहविक्रमः। अनुद्विग्नः काकशङ्की भुजङ्गचरितं चरेत्॥
en: A king should be far-sighted like the vulture, stable like a crane, watchful like a dog, brave like a lion, dreadful like a crow, and enter into the kingdom of his enemies like a snake with ease and without anxiety.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: शूरमञ्जलिपातेन भीरुं भेदेन भेदयेत्। लुब्धमर्थप्रदानेन समं तुल्येन विग्रहः॥
en: A king should win over a hero by clasping his hands, a coward by terrorising him, and a covetous man by presents of money, and with an equal he should wage war carefully.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: श्रेणीमुख्योपजायेषु वल्लभानुनयेषु च। अमात्यान् परिरक्षेत भेदसंघातयोरपि॥
en: He should take care to create dissension among the leaders of sects and of conciliating those that are dear to him. He should protect his ministers from dissension and destruction,

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: मृदुरित्यवजानन्ति जीक्ष्ण इत्युद्विजन्ति च। तीक्ष्णकाले भवेत् तीक्ष्णो मृदुकाले मृदुर्भवेत्॥
en: If the king becomes mild, the people disrespect him. If he becomes stern, the people afflicted. The rule is that he should be stern when sternness is necessary, and mild when mildness is necessary.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: मृदुनैव मृदुं हन्ति मृदुना हन्ति दारुणम्। नासाध्यं मृदुना किंचित् तस्मात् तीक्ष्णतरो मृदुः॥
en: By mildness the mild should be conquered. By mildness one may destroy that which is dreadful. There is nothing which mildness cannot do. Therefore, mildness is said to be sharper than fierceness.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: काले मृदुर्यो भवति काले भवति दारुणः। प्रसाधयति कृत्यानि शत्रु चाप्यधितिष्ठति॥
en: That king who becomes mild when mildness is necessary and who becomes stern when sternness is necessary, gains all his ends, and represses his enemies.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: पण्डितेन विरुद्धः सन् दूरस्थोऽस्मीति नाश्वसेत्। दी? बुद्धिमतो बाहू याभ्यां हिंसति हिंसितः॥
en: Having created an enemy in a person endued with knowledge and wisdom, one should not be satisfied with the belief that he is at a distance from his foe. The arms of an intelligent man are extensive by which he injures when injured.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: न तद्धरेद् यत् पुनराहरेत् परः। न तं हन्याद् यस्य शिरो न पातयेत्॥
en: The uncrossable should not be sought to be crossed. That which the enemy would be able to recover should not be snatched from him. One should not try to dig at all if by digging one could get at the root of the thing for which one digs. One should never strike him whose head one would not cut off.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: इतीदमुक्तं वृजिनाभिसंहितं न चैतदेवं पुरुषः समाचरेत्। परप्रयुक्ते न कथं विभावर्ये दतो मयोक्तं भवतो हितार्थिना॥
en: A king should not always act in this way. The course of conduct that I have pointed out should be followed only in times of distress. Actuated with the desire of doing you good I have said this for instructing you as to how you should act when attacked by enemies.

description: The duty of a king when his kingdom is attacked by robbers
sn: यथावदुक्तं वचनं हितार्थिना निशम्य विप्रेण सुवीरराष्ट्रपः। तथाकरोद् वाक्यमदीनचेतनः श्रियं च दीप्तां बुभुजे सबान्धवः॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words given vent to by that Brahmana with the desires of doing him good, the king of Sauviras obeyed those instructions gladly and attained with his kinsmen and friends shining prosperity.

description: The duties of a king when sin prevails in his kingdom
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच हीने परमके धर्मे सर्वलोकाभिलचिते। अधर्मे धर्मतां नीते धर्मे चाधर्मतां गते॥ मर्यादासु विनष्टासु क्षुभिते धर्मनिश्चये। राजभिः पीडिते लोके परैर्वापि विशाम्पते॥ सर्वाश्रमेषु मूढेषु कर्मसूपहतेषु च। कामाल्लोभाच्च मोहाच्च भयं पश्यत्सु भारत॥ अविश्वस्तेषु सर्वेषु नित्यं भीतेषु पार्थिव। निकृत्या हन्यमानेषु वञ्चयत्सु परस्परम्॥ सम्प्रदीप्तेषु देशेषु ब्राह्मणे चातिपीडिते। अवर्षति च पर्जन्ये मिथो भेदे समुत्थिते॥ सर्वस्मिन् दस्युसाद् भूते पृथिव्यामुपजीवने। केनस्विद् ब्राह्मणो जीवेज्जघन्ये काल आगते॥ अतितिक्षुः पुत्रपौत्राननुक्रोशान्नराधिप। कथमापत्सु वर्तेत तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह।॥ कथं च राजा वर्तेत लोके कलुषतां गते। कथमर्थाच्च धर्माच्च न हीयेत परंतप।॥
