en: Seeing the king of gods, viz., Indra, thus seated on the back of Airavata and surrounded by the several orders of the celestials, the king of the Daityas displayed no signs of sorrow or agitation.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: दृष्ट्वा तमविकारस्थं तिष्ठन्तं निर्भयं बलिम्। अधिरूढो द्विपश्रेष्ठमित्युवाच शतक्रतुः॥
en: Seeing Vali unmoved and fearless, Indra also addressed him from the back of his king of elephants, saying,-

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: दैत्य न व्यथसे शौर्यादथवा वृद्धसेवया। तपसा भावितत्वाद् वा सर्वथैतत् सुदुष्करम्॥
en: How is it, O Daitya, that you are so unmoved? Is it owning to your heroism or to your having waited reverentially upon elders? Is it owning to your mind having been purified by penances? To whatever cause it may be due, this mood of mind is surely very difficult to attain.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: शत्रुभिर्वशमानीतो हीनः स्थानादनुत्तमात्। वैरोचने किमाश्रित्य शोचितव्ये न शोचसि॥
en: Hurled from the highest position, you are now shorn of all your possessions and have been brought under the sway of your enemies. O Virochana's son what is that by adopting which you to do not grieve although it is time for grief.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: श्रैष्ठ्यं प्राप्य स्वजातीनां महाभोगाननुत्तमान्। हतस्वरत्नराज्यस्त्वं ब्रूहि कस्मान्न शोचसि॥
en: Formerly, when you were the king of your own order, you enjoyed matchless pleasures. Now, however, you are shorn of your riches and jewels and sovereignty. Tell us why you arc so unmoved.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: ईश्वरो हि पुरा भूत्वा पितृपैतामहे पदे। तत्त्वमद्य हृतं दृष्ट्वा सपत्नैः किं न शोचसि॥
en: You were ere this a god, seated on the throne of your father and grandfathers. Finding yourself deprived to-day by your enemies, why do you not grieve?

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: बद्धश्च वारुणैः पाशैर्वज्रेण च समाहतः। हतदारो हृतधनो ब्रूहि कस्मान्न शोचसि॥
en: You are fettered with Varuna's noose and has been struck with my thunderbolt. Your wives and riches have been taken away. Tell us why you do not grieve.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: नष्टश्रीविभवभ्रष्टो यन्न शोचसि दुष्करम्। त्रैलोक्यराज्यनाशे हि कोऽन्यो जीवितुमुत्सहेत्॥
en: Shorn of prosperity and fallen away from affluence, you do not gricve. This indeed, is something very remarkable. Who else, O Vali, then one like you, could dare lives thus after being shorn of the sovereignty of the three worlds?

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: एतच्चान्यच्च परुषं ब्रुवन्तं परिभूय तम्। श्रुत्वा सुखमसम्भ्रान्तो बलिवैरोचनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing without any pain these and other cutting words that Indra said asserting the while his own superiority over him. Vali the son of Virochana fearlessly answered him thus.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: बलिरुवाच निगृहीते मयि भृशं शक्र किं कत्थितेन ते। वज्रमुद्यम्य तिष्ठन्तं पश्यामि त्वां पुरंदर॥
en: When calamities have assailed me, O Shakra, what do you gain by such brag now? To-day I see you, O Purandara stand before me with the thunder-bolt upraised in your hand.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अशक्तः पूर्वमासीस्त्वं कथञ्चिच्छक्ततां गतः। कस्त्वदन्य इमां वाचं सुत्रां वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: Formerly, however, you could not behave so. Now you have somehow gained that power. Indeed, who else save you could give vent to such cruel words?

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: यस्तु शत्रोर्वशस्थस्य शक्तोऽपि कुरुते दयाम्। हस्तप्राप्तस्य वीरस्य तं चैव पुरुषं विदुः॥
en: That person who, though able to punish, shows mercy towards a heroic enemies, defeated and brought under his control, is indeed a great man.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अनिश्चयो हि युद्धेषु द्वयोर्विवदमानयोः। एकः प्राप्नोति विजयमेकश्चैव पराजयम्॥
en: When two persons fight, victory is indeed doubtful. One of the two surely becomes victorious, and the other is defeated.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: मा च तेऽभूत् स्वभावोऽयमिति ते देवपुङ्गवा ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां विक्रमेण जितो बलात्॥
en: O king of gods, let not your nature be so. Do not think that you have become the king of all creatures after having defeated all with your might and prowess.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: नैतदस्मत्कृतं शक्र नैतच्छक कृतं त्वया। यत् त्वमेवंगतो वज्रिन् यद्वाप्येवंगता वयम्॥
en: That we have become so is not, O Indra, the result of our acts. That you have become so, ) holder of the thunderbolt, is not the result of any act of yours.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अहमासं यथाद्य त्वं भविता त्वं यथा वयम्। मावमंस्था मया कर्म दुष्कृतं कृतमित्युत।॥
en: What I am now you will be in time. Do not disregard me, thinking that you have performed a highly difficult feat.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सुखदुःखे हि पुरुषः पर्यायेणाधिगच्छति। पर्यायेणासि शक्रत्वं प्राप्तः शक्र न कर्मणा॥
en: A person gets happiness and misery one after another in course of Time. You have, O Shakra, gained sovereignty of the universe in courses of Time but not by virtue of any particular merit in you.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: काल: काले नयति मां त्वां च कालोनयत्ययम्। तेनाहं त्वं यथा नाद्यं त्वं चापि न यथा वयम्॥
en: It is Time that leads me on in his course. That same time leads you also onward. It is, therefore, that I am not what you are to-day, and you also are not what we are.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: न मातृपितृशुश्रूषा न च दैवतपूजनम्। नान्यो गुणसमाचारः पुरुषस्य सुखावहः॥
en: Dutiful services to parents, respectful adoration of deities, due practice of any good quality,-none of these can confer happiness on any one.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: न विद्या न तपो दानं न मित्राणि न बान्धवाः। शक्नुवन्ति परित्रातुं नरं कालेन पीडितम्॥
en: Neither knowledge nor penances, nor gifts, nor friends, nor kinsmen, can save one who is afflicted by Time.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: नागामिनमनर्थं हि प्रतिघातशतैरपि। शक्नुवन्ति प्रतिव्योढुमृते बुद्धिबलान्नराः॥
en: Even by a thousand means, men cannot avert an impending danger. Intelligence and strength are useless in such cases.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: पर्यायैर्हन्यमानानां परित्राता न विद्यते। इदं तु दुःखं यच्छक कर्ताहमिति मन्यसे॥
en: None can save men who are afflicted by Time's course. Because, O Shakra, you consider yourself as the actor therefore it is the root of all sorrow.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: यदि कर्ता भवेत् कर्ता न क्रियेत कदाचन। यस्मात्तु क्रियते कर्ता तस्मात् कर्ताप्यनीश्वरः॥
en: If the seeming performner of an act is the real actor thereof, that doer then would not himself be the creation of some one else (viz., the God). Therefore, because the seeming doer is himself the creation of another, that another is the Supreme Being superior to whom there is nothing else.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: कालेनाहं त्वामजयं कालेनाहं जितस्त्वया। गन्ता गतिमतां काल: कालः कलयति प्रजाः॥
en: Helped by Time I had defeated you. Helped by time you have defeated me. It is Time which moves all beings.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: इन्द्र प्राकृतया बुद्ध्या प्रजलयं नावबुद्ध्यसे। केचित् त्वां बहु मन्यन्ते श्रेष्ठ्यं प्राप्तं स्वकर्मणा।॥
en: O Indra, because your intelligence is very mean you do not see that destruction awaits all things! Some, indeed, respect you as one who has acquired by his own acts the sovereignty of the universe.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: कथमस्मद्विधो नाम जानल्लोकप्रवृत्तयः। कालेनाभ्याहतः शोचेन्मुह्येद् वाप्यथ विभ्रमेत्॥
en: But, how can one like us who know the course of the world, grieve for having been afflicted by Time, or allow our understanding to be stupefied, or give way to the influence of error?

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: नित्यं कालपरीतस्य मम वा मद्विधस्य वा। बुद्धिर्व्यसनमासाद्य भिन्ना नौरिव सीदति॥
en: Even when we are possessed by Time, coming in contact with a calamity, shall my understanding or that of one like me allow itself to be destroyed like a wrecked vessel at sea.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अहं च त्वं च ये चान्ये भविष्यन्ति सुराधिपाः। ते सर्वे शक यास्यन्ति मार्गमिन्द्रशतैर्गतम्॥
en: Myself, yourself, and all those who will in future become the kings of the deities, shall have, O Shakra, to follow the way along which hundreds of Indras have gone before you.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: त्वामप्येवं सुदुर्धर्षं ज्वलन्तं परया श्रिया। काले परिणते कालः कालयिष्यति मामिव॥
en: When your hour will be full, Time will surely destroy you like me,-who are now so invincible and who now shine with matchless splendour.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: बहूनीन्द्रसहस्राणि दैवतानां युगे युगे। अभ्यतीतानि कालेन कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः॥
en: In time's course many thousands of Indras and of gods have been swept off cycle after cycle. Time, Indeed, is irresistible.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: इदं तु लब्ध्वा संस्थानमात्मानं बहु मन्यसे। सर्वभूतभवं देवं ब्रह्माणमिव शाश्वतम्॥
en: Having secured your present position, you think too much of yourself, even as the Creator of all beings, the divine and eternal Brahman.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: न चेदमचलं स्थानमनन्तं वापि कस्यचित्। त्वं तु बालिशया बुद्ध्या ममेदमिति मन्यसे॥
en: Having secured your present position of yours. With none did it last for ever. On account of a foolish understanding, you consider it immutable and eternal.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अविश्वस्ते विश्वसिषि मन्यसे वाध्रुवे ध्रुवम्। नित्यं कालपरीतात्मा भवत्येवं सुरेश्वर॥
en: You trust in that which is not worthy of trust. You consider that to be eternal which is not eternal. O king of the gods, one who is possessed and stupefied by Time really considers himself thus.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: ममेयमिति मोहात् त्वं राजश्रियमभीप्ससि। नेयं तव न चास्माकं न चान्येषां स्थिरा सदा॥
en: Actuated by folly you consider your present regal prosperity as yours. Know, however, that it is not permanent either for me or for you or for others.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अतिक्रम्य बहूनन्यांस्त्वयि तावदियं गता। कंचित् कालमियं स्थित्वा त्वयि वासव चञ्चला॥ गौर्निपानमिवोत्सृज्य पुनरन्यं गमिष्यति।
en: It had belonged to numberless persons before you. Passing over them it has now become yours. It will say with you, O Vasava, for sometime and then prove its fickleness. Like a cow leaving one drinking ditch for another, it will surely leave you for somebody else.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: राजलोका ह्यतिक्रान्ता यान्न संख्यातुमुत्सहे॥ त्वत्तो बहुतराश्चान्ये भविष्यन्ति पुरंदर।
en: So many kings have gone before you that I venture not to calculate them. In the future also, O Purandara, numberless sovereigns will rise after you.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सवृक्षौषधिरत्नेयं सहसत्त्ववनाकरा॥ तानिदानीं च पश्यामि यैर्भुक्तेयं पुरा मही।
en: I do not see those kings now that had formerly enjoyed this Earth with her trees, plants, gems, living creatures, waters and mines.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: पृथुरैलो मयो भीमो नरकः शम्बरस्तथा॥ अश्वग्रीवः पुलोमा च स्वर्भानुरमितध्वजः। प्रह्लादो नमुचिर्दक्षो विप्रचित्तिर्विरोचनः॥ ह्रीनिषेवः सुहोत्रश्च भूरिहा पुष्पवान वृषः। सत्येषुर्ऋषभो बाहुः कपिलाश्वो विरूपकः॥ बाणः कार्तस्वरो वह्निविश्वदंष्ट्रोऽथ नैऋतिः। संकोचोऽथ वरीताक्षो वराहाश्वो रुचिप्रभः॥ विश्वजित् प्रतिरूपश्च वृषाण्डो विष्करो मधुः। हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव कैटभश्चैव दानवः॥ दैतेया दानवाश्चैव सर्वे ते नैर्ऋतैः सह। एते चान्ये च बहव पूर्वे पूर्वतराश्च ये॥ दैत्येन्द्रा दानवेन्द्राश्च यांश्चान्याननुशुश्रुम। बहवः पूर्वदैत्येन्द्राः संत्यज्य पृथिवीं गताः॥ कालेनाभ्याहताः सर्वे कालो हि बलवत्तरः।
en: Prithu, Aila, Maya, Bhima, Naraka, Shamvara, Ashvagriva, Puloman, Svarbhanu, whose standard was of immeasurable height, Prahrada, Namuchi, Daksha, Vipprachitti, Virochana, Hrinisheva, Suhotra, Bhurihan, Pushavat, Vrisha, Satyepsu, Rishava, Vahu, Kapilashva, Virupaka, Vana, Karttashvara, Vahni, Vishvadangshtra, Nairiti, Sankocha, Varitaksha, Varaha, Ashva, Ruchiprabha, Vishvajit, Pratirupa, Vrishanda, Vishkara, Madhu, Hiranyakashipu, the Danava Kaitabha, and many others that were Daityas and Danavas and Rakshasas, these and many more not named, of remote and remoter ages, great Daityas and foremost of Danavas, whose names we have heard,-indeed, many foremost of Daityas of former times,-have passed away, leaving the Earth. All of them were possessed by Time. Time proved mere powerful than all of them.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सर्वैः ऋतुशतैरिष्टं न त्वमेकः शतक्रतुः॥ सर्वे धर्मपराश्चासन् सर्वे सततसत्रिणः।
en: All of them had adored the Creator in hundreds of sacrifices. You are not the only person that has done so. All of them were given to righteousness and all of them always celebrated great sacrifices.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अन्तरिक्षचराः सर्वे सर्वेऽभिमुखयोधिनः॥ सर्वे संहननोपेताः सर्वे परिघबाहवः।
en: All of them were capable of passing through the welkin and all were heroes that never retreated from the battle field. All of them had very strong bodies and all had arms resembling heavy bludgeons.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सर्वे मायाशतधराः सर्वे ते कामरूपिणः॥ सर्वे समरमासाद्य न श्रूयन्ते पराजिताः।
en: All of them were adepts in hundreds of illusions, and all could assume any form they liked. We have never heard that having undertaken a battle any of them had ever met with defeat.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सर्वे सत्यव्रतपराः सर्वे कामविहारिणः॥ सर्वे वेदव्रतपराः सर्वे चैव बहुश्रुताः।
en: All observed the vow of truth, and all of them sported as they wished. Devoted to the Vedas and Vedic rites, all of them were endued with great learning.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सर्वे सम्मतमैश्वर्यमीश्वराः प्रतिपेदिरे॥ न चैश्वर्यमदस्तेषां भूतपूर्वो महात्मनाम्।
en: Endued with great might, all of them had gained the highest prosperity and affluence. But none of those great kings lead the pride of sovereignty.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सर्वे यथार्हदातारः सर्वे विगतमत्सराः॥ सर्वे सर्वेषु भूतेषु यथावत् प्रतिपेदिरे।
en: All of them were liberal giving to each what each deserved. All of them behaved properly and duly by all creatures.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सर्वे दाक्षायणीपुत्राः प्राजापत्या महाबलाः॥ ज्वलन्तः प्रतपन्तश्च कालेन प्रतिसंहृताः।
en: All of them were the offspring of Daksha's daughters. Gifted with great strength, all were lords of the creation. Burning all things with their energy, all of them shone greatly. Yet all of them were carried away by Time.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: त्वं चैवेमां यदा भुक्त्वा पृथिवीं त्यक्षसे पुनः॥ न शक्ष्यसि तदा शक्र नियन्तुं शोकमात्मनः।
en: As regards you. ( Shakra, it is clear that when you shall have, after enjoying the Earth, to leave her you will not be able to control your grief.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: मुञ्चेञ्छां कामभोगेषु मुञ्चेमं श्रीभवं मदम्॥६४! एवं स्वराज्यनाशे त्वं शोकं सम्प्रसहिष्यसि।
en: Relinquish this desire for objects of affection and enjoyment. Relinquish this pride begotten by prosperity. If you act thus, you will then be able to bear the grief consequent on the loss of sovereignty.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: शोककाले शुचो मा त्वं हर्षकाले च मा हृषः॥ अतीतानागतं हित्वा प्रत्युत्पन्नेन वर्तय।
en: When the hour of sorrow comes, do not give way to it. Likewise, when the hour of joy comes, do not rejoice. Not thinking of both the past and the future, live contentedly with the present.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: मां चेदभ्यागतः कालः सदा युक्तमतन्द्रितः॥ क्षमस्व नचिरादिन्द्र त्वामप्युपगमिष्यति।
en: When Time that never sleeps came upon me that had always been mindful of my duties, bend you heart to the ways of peace, O Indra, for that same Time will very soon meet you.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: त्रासयन्निव देवेन्द्र वाग्भिस्तक्षसि मामिह॥ संयते मयि नूनं त्वमात्मानं बहू मन्यसे।
en: You cut me to the quick with your words, and you seem deterinined to terrorise me. Indeed, finding me calm, you think very highly of you.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: कालः प्रथममायान्मां पश्चात् त्वामनुधावति॥ तेन गर्जसि देवेन्द्र पूर्वं कालहते मयि।
en: Time had first attacked me. It is even now behind you. I was at first defeated by Time. It was therefore that you did afterwards succeed in defeating me for which you are bragging thus.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: को हि स्थातुमलं लोके मम क्रुद्धस्य संयुगे॥ कालस्तु बलवान् प्राप्तस्तेन तिष्ठसि वासव। यत् तद् वर्षसम्रान्तं पूर्णं भवितुमर्हति॥ यथा मे सर्वगात्राणि न सुस्थानि महौजसः।
en: Formerly, when I used to become angry, what person was there on Earth who could stand before me in battle? Time however, is stronger. He has overwhelmed me. It is therefore, O Vasava, that you are able to stand before me. Those thousand celestial years, over which your reign extends will surely come to an end.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अहमैन्द्राच्च्युतः स्थानात् त्वमिन्द्रः प्रकृतोदिवि॥ सुचित्रे जीवलोकेऽस्मिन्नुपास्यः कालपर्ययात्। किं हि कृत्वा त्वमिन्द्रोऽद्य किं वा कृत्वा वयं च्युताः।
en: You will then fall and your limbs will become as miserable as mine now even though I am endued with great energy. I have fallen away from the high place that is occupied by the king of the three worlds. You are not the real Indra in heaven.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: त्वमेव हि पुरा काल: कर्ता विकर्ता च सर्वमन्यदकारणम्। नाशं विनाशमैश्वर्यं सुखं दुःखं भवाभवौ॥
en: By virtue of Time's course, you are now an object of universal adoration in this charming world of living beings. Can you say what is that by having done which you have become Indra to-day and what also is that by having done which we have falls off from the position we had occupied.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: विद्वान् प्राप्यैवमत्यर्थं न प्रहृष्येन्न च व्यथेत्। त्वमेव हीन्द्र वेत्थास्मान् वेदाहं त्वां च वासव॥
en: Time is the one creator and destroyer. Nothing else is cause. By encountering any of these, viz.. decline, fall, sovereignty, happiness, misery, birth, and death a learned person neither rejoices nor grieves. You, O Indra, know us. We also, O Vasava, know you.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: किं कत्थसे मां किं च त्वं कालेन निरपत्रपः। वेत्थ यत् तदा पौरुषं मम॥
en: Why then do you brag thus before me, forgetting, O shameless one, that it is Time that has made you what you are? You yourself saw what my prowess was in those days.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: समरेषु च विक्रान्तं पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्। आदित्याश्चैव रुद्राश्च साध्याश्च वसुभिः सह॥ मया विनिर्जिताः पूर्वं मरुतश्च शचीपते। त्वमेव शक्र जानासि देवासुरसमागमे॥ नियतं कालपाशेन बद्धं शक्र विकस्थसे। समेता विबुधा भग्नास्तरसा समरे मया। पर्वताश्चासकृत् क्षिप्ताः सवनाः सवनौकसः॥
en: The energy and might used to display in all my battles, prove it clearly. The Adityas, the Rudras, the Saddhyas, the Vasus, and the Maruts, O lord of Shachi, were all defeated by me. You know it well yourself, O Shakra, that in the great battle between the gods and the Asuras, the assembled gods were speedily। routed by me by the fury of my attack. Mountains with their forests and the denizens, were repeatedly hurled by us.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सटङ्कशिखरा भग्नाः समरे मूलि ते मया। किं नु शक्यं मया कर्तुं कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः॥
en: I broke on your head, many mountain summits with craggy edges. What, however, can I do now? Time cannot be resisted.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: न हि त्वां नोत्सहे हन्तुं सवज्रमपि मुष्टिना। न त विक्रमकालोऽयं क्षमाकालोऽयमागतः॥
en: If it were not so, do not think that I would not have dared to kill you with that thunderbolt of yours with even a blow of my fist. The present, however, is not the hour when I should display my prowess. The present hour is such that I should remain silent and tolerate everything.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: तेन त्वां मर्षये शक्र दुर्मर्षणतरस्त्वया। तं मां परिणते काले परीतं कालवह्निना॥
en: It is therefore, O Shakra, that I put up with all this insolence of yours. Know, however, that I am less able to bear insolence than even you.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अयं स पुरुषः श्यामो लोकस्य दुरतिक्रमः॥ बद्ध्वा तिष्ठति मां रौद्रः पशुं रशनया यथा।
en: There stands that dark individual who cannot be resisted by the world. There he of fierce form; stands, having bound me like an inferior animal bound with ropes.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: लाभालाभौ सुखं दुःखं कामक्रोधौ भवाभवौ॥ वधबन्धप्रमोक्षं च सर्वं कालेन लभ्यते।
en: Gain and loss, happiness and misery, lust and anger, birth and death, captivity and release,-these all one meets in Time's course.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: नाहं कर्ता न कर्ता त्वं कर्ता यस्तु सदा प्रभुः॥ सोऽयं पचति कालो मां वृक्षे फलमिवागतम्।
en: I am not the actor. You are not the actor, He is the actor who is omnipotent. Time ripens me like a fruit that is on a tree.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: यान्येव पुरुषः कुर्वन् सुखैः कालेन युज्यते॥ पुनस्तान्येव कुर्वाणो दुःखै कालेन युज्यते।
en: There are certain acts by doing which one person enjoys happiness in Time's course. By doing those very acts another reaps misery in the course of Time.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: न च कालेन कालज्ञः स्पृष्टः शोचितुमर्हति॥ तेन शक्र न शोचामि नास्ति शोके सहायता। यदा हि शोचत: शोको व्यसनं नापकर्षति॥ सामर्थ्य शोचतो नास्तीत्यतोऽहं नाद्य शोचिमि।
en: Conversant as I am with the virtues of Time, I should not grieve when it is Time that has attacked me. It is therefore, O Shakra, that I do not grieve. Grief can do us no good. The grief of one that indulges in grief never dissipates his calamity. On the other hand, grief destroys his power. It is therefore that I do not grieve.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: एवमुक्तः सहस्राक्षो भगवान् पाकशासनः॥ प्रतिसंहृत्य संरम्भमित्युवाच शतक्रतुः।
en: Thus addressed by the kings of the Daityas, the god of a hundred sacrifices, viz., the powerful and thousand-eyed chastiser of Paka, checked his anger and said these words.'

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सवज्रमुद्यतं बाहुं दृष्ट्वा पाशांश्च वारुणान्॥ कस्येह न व्यथेद् बुद्धिर्मृत्योरपि जिघांसतः।
en: Shakra said Seeing this upraised arm of mine, equipt with the thunderbolt, and those nooses of Varuna, who is there whose understanding is not moved, including the very Destroyer himself who brings about the death of all beings.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सा ते न व्यथते बुद्धिरचला तत्त्वदर्शिनी॥ ध्रुवं न व्यथसेऽद्य त्वं धैर्यात् सत्यपराक्रम।
en: Your understanding, however, so firm and so endued with visions of the truth has not been moved. 0 you of invincible prowess, verily you are unmoved to-day on account of your fortitude.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: को हि विश्वासमर्थेषु शरीरे वा शरीरभृत्॥ कर्तुमुत्सहते लोके दृष्ट्वा सम्प्रस्थितं जगत्।
en: Seeing all things in this universe as transient, who is there in it, endued with body, that would venture to place confidence on either his body or all the objects of his desire?

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अहमप्येवमेवैनं लोकं जानाम्यशाश्वतम्॥ कालाग्नावाहितं घोरे गुह्ये सततगेऽक्षरे।
en: Like yourself I also know that this universe is not eternal, and that it has been thrown into Time's fire that is dreadful though hidden from the view, that is perpetually burning, and that is indeed endless.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: न चात्र परिहारोऽस्ति कालस्पृष्टस्य कस्यचित्॥ सूक्ष्माणां महतां चैव भूतानां परिपच्यताम्।
en: Every one is attacked here by Time. Nothing among subtile or gross beings can escape from Time's away. All things are being cooked in Time's pot.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अनीशस्याप्रमत्तस्य भूतानि पचत: सदा॥ अनिवृत्तस्य कालस्य क्षयं प्राप्तो न मुच्यते।
en: Time has no master. Time is ever vigilant. Time is always coO king every thing within itself. No one who has once entered the kingdom of Time which is perpetually going on, can escape therefrom.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अप्रमत्तः प्रमत्तेषु कालो जागर्ति देहिषु॥ प्रयत्नेनाप्यपक्रान्तो दृष्टपूर्वो न केनचित्।
en: All embodied beings may be careless of Time, but Time is careful and is wide awake behind them. No one has ever been seen to have driven off Time from him.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: पुराण: शाश्वतो धर्मः सर्वप्राणभृतां समः॥ कालो न परिहार्यश्च न चास्यास्ति व्यतिक्रमः।
en: Ancient eternal and the embodiment of Justice, Time is always equal about all living creatures. Time cannot be shunned and there is no retrogression in its course.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अहोरात्रांश्च मासांश्च क्षणान् काष्ठा लवान् कलाः॥ सम्पीडयति यः कालो वृद्धिं वाधुषिको यथा।
en: Like a usurer summing up his interest, Time sums up its subtile portions represented by Kalas, lavas, Kashthas, Kshanas, months, and days and nights.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: इदमद्य करिष्यामिश्वः कर्तास्मीति वादिनम्॥ कालो हरति सम्प्राप्तो नदीवेग इव दुमम्।
en: Like the current of river washing away a tree whose roots it can get at time, approaching him who says,-This I will do to-day but this I will do tomorrow-sweeps him always.'

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: इदानीं तावदेवासौ मया दृष्टः कथं मृतः॥ इति कालेन ह्रियतां प्रलापः श्रूयते नृणाम्।
en: Time carries away one and men say-I saw him a little while before How has he died?'

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: नश्यन्त्यर्थास्तथा भोगा: स्थानमैश्वर्यमेव च॥ जीवितं जीवलोकस्य कालेनागम्य नीयते।
en: Wealth, comforts, rank, prosperity, all are destroyed by Time. Approaching every living creature. Time takes away his life. All things which haughtily raise their heads high are sure to crumble down.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: उच्छ्राया विनिपातान्ता भावोऽभावः स एव च॥ अनित्यमध्रुवं सर्वं व्यवसायो हि दुष्करः।
en: What is existent is only another form of the non-existent. Every thing is transitory and unstable. It is difficult to arrive at such a conviction.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सा ते न व्यथते बुद्धिरचला तत्त्वदर्शिनी॥ अहमासं पुरा चेति मनसापि न बुद्ध्यते।
en: Your understanding, firm and endued with true vision, is unmoved. You do not, even in your mind realise what you were sometime before.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: कालेनाक्रम्य लोकेऽस्मिन् पच्यमाने बलीयसा॥ अज्येष्ठमकनिष्ठं च क्षिप्यमाणो न बुद्ध्यते।
en: Attacking the universe, powerful Time cooks it within itself and sweeps away every thing without caring for age or otherwise. Therefore, one who is being dragged by Time is unconscious of the noose put round one's neck.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: ईर्ष्याभिमानलोभेषु कामक्रोधभयेषु च॥ स्पृहामोहाभिमानेषु लोकः सक्तो विमुह्यति।
en: to People, wedded jealousy, vanity, cupidity, lust, anger, fear, desire, carelessness, and pride, allow themselves to be stupefied.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: भवांस्तु भावतत्त्वज्ञो विद्वान् ज्ञानतपोऽन्वितः॥ कालं पश्यति सुव्यक्तं पाणावामलकं यथा।
en: You, however, know the truth of existence. You are learned and endued with wisdom and penance. You sec Time as clearly like an embolic myrobalan on the palm of your hand.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: कालचारित्रतत्त्वज्ञः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः॥ विवेचने कृतात्मासि स्पृहणीयो विजानताम्।
en: O son of Virochana, you know full well Time's conduct! You are well versed in all branches of knowledge. You are of purified Soul and a perfect master of your passions. You are a favourite of all wise persons.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सर्वलोको ह्ययं मन्ये बुद्ध्या परिगतस्त्वया॥ विहरन् सर्वतो मुक्तो न क्वचित् परिषज्जते।
en: With your understanding you have full understood the entire universe. Though you have enjoyed every sort of happiness, you were never attached to anything, and hence you have not been sullied by anything.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: रजश्च हि तमश्च त्वां स्पृशते न जितेन्द्रियम्॥ निष्प्रीतिं नष्टसंतापमात्मानं त्वमुपाससे।
en: The qualities of Darkness and Ignorance do not soil you, for you have conquered your senses. You wait only upon your soul which is divested of both joy and sorrow.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां निर्वैरं शान्तमानसम्॥ दृष्ट्वा त्वां मम संजाता त्वय्यनुक्रोशिनी मतिः।
en: I feel mercy for you, because you are the friend of all creatures, without animosity, and your heart being full of tranquillity.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: नाहमेतादृशं बुद्धं हन्तुमिच्छामि बन्धने॥ आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मो ह्यनुक्रोशश्च मे त्वयि।
en: I do not wish to afflict an enlightened person like you by keeping him in chains. Abstention from injury is the greatest religion. I feel mercy for you.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: मोक्ष्यन्ते वारुणाः पाशास्तवेमे कालपर्ययात्॥ प्रजानामपचारेण स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु महासुर।
en: Those nooses of Varuna, with which you have been fettered, will loosen in Time's course on account of the misconduct of inen. Blessed be you, O great Asura.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: यदाश्वयूं स्नुषा वृद्धां परिचारेण योक्ष्यते।११२।। पुत्रश्च पितरं मोहात् प्रेषयिष्यति कर्मसु। ब्राह्मणैः कारयिष्यन्ति वृषला: पादधावनम्॥ शूद्राश्च ब्राह्मणी भार्यामुपयास्यन्ति निर्भया:। वियोनिषु विमोक्ष्यन्ति बीजानि पुरुषा तदा॥ संकरं कांस्यभाण्डैश्च बलिं चैव कुपात्रकैः। चातुर्वण्र्यं यदा कृत्स्नममर्यादं भविष्यति॥ एकैकस्ते तदा पाशः क्रमशः परिमोक्ष्यते।
en: When the daughter-in-law will make the aged mother-in-law work, when the son, through delusion, will order his father to work for him. When Shudras will have their feet washed by Brahmanas and know fearlessly the women of twice-born ones, when men will know forbidden women, when the refuse of houses will begin to be carried upon plates and vessels made of white brass, and when sacrificial offerings intended for the gods will begin to be carried upon impure vessels, when all the four castes will transgress all restrictions, then these fetters of yours will begin one by one, to loosen.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: अस्मत्तस्ते भयं नास्ति समयं प्रतिपालय। सुखी भव निराबाधः स्वस्थचेता निरामयः॥
en: You have no fear from us. Wait quietly. Be happy, Be shorn of all sorrow. Let your heart be cheerful. May you not suffer from illness.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: तमेवमुक्त्वा भगवाञ्छतक्रतुः प्रतिप्रयातो गजराजवाहनः। विजित्य सर्वानसुरान् सुराधिपो ननन्द हर्षेण बभूव चैकराट॥
en: Having said these words to him, the divine Indra, having the prince of elephants for his vehicle, left that place. Having defeated all the Asuras, the king of the gods rejoiced greatly and became the sole master of all the worlds.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: महर्षयस्तुष्टुवुरजसा च तं वृषाकपि सर्वचराचरेश्वरम्। हिमापहो हव्यमुवाह चाध्वरे तथामृतं चार्पितमीश्वरोऽपि हि॥
en: The great Rishis lauded that lord of all mobile and immobile creatures. The Fire-God Once more began to carry the libations of clarified butter that were poured into his visible form, and the great god took charge of the nectar that was placed to his care.

description: What is the good for a man who is the distress for loss of friends of kingdom
sn: द्विजोत्तमैः सर्वगतैरभिष्टुतो विदीप्ततेजा गतमन्युरीश्वरः। प्रशान्तचेता मुदितः स्वमालयं त्रिविष्टपं प्राप्य मुमोद वासवः॥
en: Lauded by the foremost of Brahmanas engaged in sacrifices, the lord Indra, shining with effulgence, his anger quelled and his heart tranquillised, became glad, and returning to his own abode in heaven, began to pass his days in great happiness.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पूर्वरूपाणि मे राजन् पुरुषस्य भविष्यतः। पराभविष्यतश्चैव तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhisthira said Tell me, O grandfather, the marks of future greatness and future degeneration of a person.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: भीष्म उवाच मन एव मनुष्यस्य पूर्वरूपाणि शंसति। भविष्यतश्च भद्रं ते तथैव न भविष्यतः॥
en: Bhishma said Blessings to you, the mind itself indicates the symptoms of one's future prosperity and future fall.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। श्रिया शक्रस्य संवादं तं निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Shree and Shakra. Listen to it, O Yudhishthira.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: महतस्तपसो व्युष्ट्या पश्यँल्लोको परावरौ। सामान्यमृषिभिर्गत्वा ब्रह्मलोकनिवासिभिः॥ ब्रह्मेवामितदीप्तौजाः शान्तपाप्मा महातपाः। विचचार यथाकामं त्रिषु लोकेषु नारदः॥
en: The great and energetic ascetic Narada, whose effulgence is as immeasurable as Brahma itself, with sins all dissipated, capable of seeing through the power of his penances both this and the other world at once, and the equal of the celestial Rishis living in the region of the Creator, roamed at his pleasure through the three worlds.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: कदाचित् प्रातरुत्थाय पिस्पृक्षुः सलिलं शुचि। ध्रुवद्वारभवां गङ्गां जगामावततार च॥
en: One day, rising up early in the morning, he wished to perform his ablutions and for that purpose went to the river Ganga as the issued out of the pass called Dhruva, and plunged into the stream.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: सहस्रनयनश्चापि वज्री शम्बरपाकहा। तस्या देवर्षिजुष्टायास्तीरमभ्याजगाम ह॥
en: At that time the thousand-eyed Indra also, the holder of the thunder-bolt, and the destroyer of Shamvara and Paka, came to the very shore where Narada was.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: तावाप्लुत्य यतात्मानौ कृतजप्यौ समासतः। नद्याः पुलिनमासाद्य सूक्ष्मकाञ्चनवालुकम्॥
en: The Rishi and the god, both of whom had perfectly controlled their minds, finished their ablutions, and having completed their silent recitations, sat together.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: पुण्यकर्मभिराख्याता देवर्षिकथिताः कथाः। चक्रतुस्तौ तथाऽऽसीनौ महर्षिकथितास्तथा॥ पूर्ववृत्तव्यपेतानि कथयन्तौ समाहितौ।
en: They spent the hour in reciting and listening to the excellent narratives told by the great celestial Rishis describing many good and high deeds. Indeed, with rapt attention the two were engaged in such lively discourse on ancient history.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: अथ भास्करमुद्यन्तं रश्मिजालपुरस्कृतम्॥ पूर्णमण्डलमालोक्य तावुत्थायोपतस्थतुः।
en: While sitting there they saw the rising Sun casting his thousand rays right before him. Seeing the full orb, both of them stood up and lauded him.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: अभितस्तूदयन्तं तमर्कमर्कमिवापरम्॥ आकाशे ददृशे ज्योतिरुद्यतार्चिःसमप्रभम्। तयोः समीयं तं प्राप्तं प्रत्यदृश्यत भारत॥
en: Just at that time they saw in the sky, in a direction opposite to that of the rising star of day, some luminous object, resplendent as burning fire which seemed to be a second star of day. And they saw, O Bharata, that that luminous object was gradually approaching them both.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: तत् सुपर्णार्कचरितमास्थितं वैष्णवं पदम्। भाभिरप्रतिमं भाति त्रैलोक्यमवभासयत्॥
en: Riding upon Vishnu's vehicle adorned with Garuda and Surya himself, that object shone forth with matchless splendour and seemed to the three worlds.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: तत्राभिरूपशोभाभिरप्सरोभिः पुरस्कृताम्। बृहतीमंशुमत्प्रख्यां बृहद्भानोरिवार्चिषम्॥
en: The object they beheld was none other than Shree herself, attended by many Apsaras gifted with splendid beauty. Indeed, she looked like a large solar discherself, effulgent like fire.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: नक्षत्रकल्पाभरणां तां मौक्तिकसमस्रजम्। श्रियं ददृशतुः पद्मां साक्षात् पद्मदलस्थिताम्॥
en: Decorated with ornaments that appeared like veritable stars, she wore a wreath resembling a garland of pearls. Indra saw that goddess called Padma living in the midst of lotuses. light up

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: सावरुद्य विमानाग्रादङ्गनानामनुत्तमा। अभ्यागच्छत् त्रिलोकेशं देवर्षि चापि नारदम्॥
en: Getting down from her foremost of cars, that peerless lady began to approach towards the lord of the three worlds and the celestial Rishi Narada.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: नारदानुगतः साक्षान्मघवांस्तामुपागमत्। कृताञ्जलिपुटो देवी निवेद्यात्मानमात्मना॥ चक्रे चानुपमां पूजां तस्याश्चापि स सर्ववित्। देवराजः श्रियं राजन् वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह॥
en: Followed by Narada, Indra also proceeded towards that lady. With joined hands, he offered himself up to her, and versed as he was with all things, he adored her with unsurpassed reverence and sincerity. The adorations over, the king of gods, O king, addressed Shree thus.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: शक्र उवाच का त्वं केन च कार्येण सम्प्राप्ता चारुहासिनि। कुतश्चागम्यते सुभ्र गन्तव्यं क्व च ते शुभे॥
en: Shakra said-'O you of sweet smiles, who, indeed, are you and for what have you come here? O you of fair brows, whence do you come and where will you go, O auspicious lady?'

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: श्रीरुवाच पुण्येषु त्रिषु लोकेषु सर्वे स्थावरजङ्गमाः। ममात्मभावमिच्छन्तो यतन्ते परमात्मना॥
en: 'In the three worlds full auspiciousness, all creatures, mobile and immobile, try with their whole hearts to gain a companionship with me.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: साहं वै पङ्कजे जाता सूर्यरश्मिविबोधिते! भूत्यर्थं सर्वभूतानां पद्मा श्री: पद्ममालिनी॥
en: I am that Padma, that Shree adorned with lotuses, who originated from the lotus that blooms at the touch of the rays of the Sun-god, for the prosperity of all creatures.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: अहं लक्ष्मीरहं भूति: श्रीश्चाहं बलसूदन। अहं श्रद्धा च मेधा च संनतिर्विजितिः स्थितिः॥
en: I am called Lakshmi, Bhuti, and Sree, O killer of Vala! I am Faith, I am Intelligence, I am Affluence, I am Victory, and I am Immutability.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: अहं धृतिरहं सिद्धिरहं त्विड् भूतिरेव च। अहं स्वाहा स्वधा चैव संस्तुतिर्नियतिः स्मृतिः॥
en: I am Patience. I am Success, and I am prosperity. I am Svaha, I am Svadha, I am Reverence, and I am Fate, and, I am Memory.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: राज्ञां विजयमानानां सेनाग्रेषु ध्वजेषु च। निवासे धर्मशीलानां विषयेषु पुरेषु। च॥
en: I live at the van and on the standards of victorious and virtuous kings, as well as in their homes, cities, and kingdoms.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: जितकाशिनि शूरे च संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिनि। निवसामि मनुष्येन्द्रे सदैव बलसूदन।॥
en: I always live, O killer of Vala, with those foremost of men, the heroes longing for victory and unretrcating from battle.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: धर्मनित्ये महाबुद्धौ ब्रह्मण्ये सत्यवादिनि। प्रश्रिते दानशीले च सदैव निवसाम्यहम्॥
en: I also live for every with persons who are steadfastly attached to virtue, who are highly intelligent, who are devoted to Brahma, who are truthful in speech, who are possessed of humility, and who are liberal.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: असुरेष्ववसं पूर्वं सत्यधर्मनिबन्धना विपरीतांस्तु तान् बुद्ध्वा त्वयि वासमरोचयम्॥
en: Formerly I lived with the Asuras on account of their being full of truth and merit. Seeing, however, that the Asuras have assumed adverse natures, I have left them and wish to live in you.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: शक्र उवाच कथंवृत्तेषु दैत्येषु त्वमवात्सीर्वरानने। दृष्ट्वा च किमिहागास्त्वं हित्वा दैतेयदानवान्॥
en: Shakra said 'O you of fair face, for what conduct of the Asuras did you live with them? What did you see there for which you have come here, having left the Daityas and the Danavas?

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: श्रीरुवाच स्वधर्ममनुतिष्ठत्सु धैर्यादचलितेषु च। स्वर्गमार्गाभिरामेषु सत्त्वेषु निरता ह्यहम्॥
en: Shree said I am devoted to those who follow the duties of their own order, to those who never fall away from patience, to those who take a pleasure in walking along the path leading to heaven.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: दानाध्ययनयज्ञेज्यापितृदैवतपूजनम्। गुरूणामतिथीनां च तेषां सत्यमवर्तत॥
en: I always live with those who are famous for liberality, for study of the scriptures, for sacrifices, for other scriptural rites, and for adoration of Pitris, gods, preceptors, elders, and guests.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: सुसम्मृष्टगुहाश्चासन् जितस्त्रीका हुताग्नयः। गुरुशुश्रूषका दान्ता ब्रह्मण्याः सत्यवादिनः॥
en: Formerly the Danavas used to keep their houses clean, to keep their women in control, to pour libations on the sacrificial fire, to wait dutifully on their preceptors, to control their passions, to be obedient to the Brahmanas, and to be truthful in speech.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: श्रद्दधाना जितक्रोधा दानशीलानसूयवः। भृतपुत्रा भृतामात्या भृतदारा ह्यनीर्षवः॥
en: They were full of faith; they kept their anger under control; they practised the virtue of charity; they never envied others; they used to maintain their friends and advisers, and their wives they were never jealous.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: अमर्षेण न चान्योन्यं स्पृहयन्ते कदाचन। न च जातूपतप्यन्ति धीराः परसमृद्धिभिः॥
en: Formerly they never attacked one another, filled with anger. They were all contented and never felt pain on seeing other people's affluence and prosperity,

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: दातारः संगृहीता आर्याः करुणवेदिनः। महाप्रसादा ऋजवो दृढभक्ता जितेन्द्रिया:॥
en: They were all charitable and economical of respectable conduct; and endued with mercy. They were full of mercy, endued with simplicity of conduct, steadfast in faith, and had their passions under complete control. smear

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: संतुष्टभृत्यसचिवाः कृतज्ञाः प्रियवादिनः। यथार्हमानार्थकरा ह्रीनिषेवा यतव्रताः॥
en: They used to keep their servants and counsellors contented, and were grateful and sweet-speeched. They used to serve every one according to his position and honour. They had shame. They were of rigid vows.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: नित्यं पर्वसु सुस्नाताः स्वनुलिप्ताः स्वलंकृताः। उपवासतप:शीलाः प्रतीता ब्रह्मवादिनः॥
en: They used to perform their ablutions on every sacred day. They used to themselves properly with perfumes and sacred unguents. They used to adorn their persons duly. They used to observe fasts and penances, were trustful, and utterers of Vedic hymns.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: नैनानभ्युदियात् सूर्यो न चाप्यासन् प्रगेशयाः। रात्रौ दधि च सक्तूंश्च नित्यमेव व्यवर्जयन्॥
en: The Sun never rose while they lay asleep. They never slept when the Moon went away. They always abstained from curds and pounded barley.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: कल्यं घृतं चान्ववेक्षन् प्रयता ब्रह्मवादिनः। मङ्गल्यान्यपि चापश्यन् ब्राह्मणांश्चाप्यपूजयन्॥
en: They used every morning to look at clarified butter and other auspicious articles and with senses controlled they used to recite the Vedas and adore Brahmanas with gifts.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: सदा हि वदतां धर्मं सदा चाप्रतिगृह्णताम्। क्षधं च रात्र्याः स्वपतां दिवा चास्वपतां तथा॥
en: Their topic was always virtuous, and they never accepted gifts. They always went to sleep al midnight and never slept during the day.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: कृपणानाथवृद्धानां दुर्बलातुरयोषिताम्। दयां च संविभागं च नित्यमेवान्वमोदताम्॥
en: They always used to take pleasure in showing mercy for the distressed, the helpless, the aged, the weak, the sick, and women, and enjoyed all their properties by sharing these with them.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: त्रस्तं विपण्णमुद्विग्नं भयार्तं व्याधितं कृशम्। हतस्वं व्यसनार्तं च नित्यमाश्वासयन्ति ते॥
en: They always used to assure and cheer up the agitated, the cheerless, the anxious, the terrified, the diseased, the emaciated, the ; robbed, and the afflicted.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: धर्ममेवान्ववर्तन्त न हिंसन्ति परस्परम्। अनुकूलाश्च कार्येषु गुरुवृद्धोपसेविनः॥
en: They followed virtue and never injured one another. They were ready and well-disposed for every kind of action. They lised to serve and wait reverentially upon elders and aged individuals.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: पितॄन् देवातिथींश्चैव यथावत् तेऽभ्यपूजयन्। अवशेषाणि चाश्नन्ति नित्यं सत्यतपोधृताः॥
en: They duly adored Pitris, gods and guests, and ate every day what was left after pleasing these. They were firmly devoted to truth and penances.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: नैकेऽश्नन्ति सुसम्पन्नं न गच्छन्ति परस्त्रियम्। सर्वभूतेष्ववर्तन्त यथाऽऽत्मनि दयां प्रति॥
en: None amongst them ate singly any food that was good, and none had known other people's wives. They treated all creatures as to their own selves.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: नैवाकाशे न पशुषु वियोनौ च न पर्वसु। इन्द्रियस्य विसर्ग ते रोचयन्ति कदाचन॥
en: They never allowed the emission of the seminal fluid into empty space, into inferior animals, into forbidden wombs, or on sacred days.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: नित्यं दानं तथा दाक्ष्यमार्जवं चैव नित्यदा। उत्साहोऽथानहंकारः परमं सौहृदं क्षमा॥
en: They were always famous for gifts, for cleverness, for simplicity, for hopeful exertion, for humility, for friendliness, for forgiveness.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: सत्यं दानं तपः शौचं कारुण्यं वागनिष्ठुरा। मित्रेषु चानभिद्रोहः सर्वं तेष्वभवत् प्रभो॥
en: And, O powerful one, truth, charity, penance, purity, inercy, sweet speeches, and absence of animosity towards friends, all these always lived in them.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: निद्रा तन्द्रीरसम्प्रीतिरसूयाथानवेक्षिता। अरतिश्च विषादश्च स्पृहा चाप्यविशन्न तान्॥
en: Sleep, idleness, fruitfulness, envy, want of foresight, discontent, melancholy, cupidity, never attacked them.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: साहमेवंगुणेष्वेव दानवेष्ववसं पुरा। प्रजासर्गमुपादाय नैकं युगविपर्ययम्॥
en: On account of the Danavas being famous for these good qualities, I lived with them from the beginning of the creation for many cycles.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: तत: कालविपर्यासे तेषां गुणविपर्ययात्। अपश्यं निर्गतं धर्मं कामक्रोधवशात्मनाम्॥
en: Times were changed, and that change brought about an alteration in the character of the Danavas. I saw that virtue and morality left them and that they began to give way to lust and anger.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: सभासदां च वृद्धानां सतां कथयतां कथाः। प्राहसन्नभ्यसूयंश्च सर्ववृद्धान् गुणावराः॥
en: Persons of inferior attainments, began to cherish animosities towards elders possessed of superior qualifications, and while the latter, endued with virtue and merit, used to discourse on proper topics in the midst of assemblies, the former began to ridicule or laugh at them.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: युवानश्च समासीना वृद्धानपि गतान् सतः। नाभ्युत्थानाभिवादाभ्यां यथापूर्वमपूजयन्॥
en: When reverend elders came, the younger individuals, scated at their ease, refused to worship the former by rising up and saluting them respectfully.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: वर्तयत्येव पितरि पुत्रः प्रभवते तथा। अमित्रभृत्यतां प्राप्य ख्यापयन्त्यनपत्रपाः॥
en: In the presence of fathers, sons began to exercise power. Not receiving wages persons accepted service and shamelessly proclaimed the fact.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: तथा धर्मादपेतेन कर्मणा गर्हितेन ये। महतः प्राप्नुवन्त्यर्थांस्तेषां तत्राभवत् स्पृहा॥
en: Those amongst them who could amassing great wealth by doing unrighteous and censurable deeds came to be respected.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: उच्चैश्चाभ्यवदन् रात्रौ नीचैस्तत्राग्निरज्वलत्। पुत्राः पितृनत्यचरन् नार्यश्चात्यचरन् पतीन्॥
en: During the night they began to cry aloud, Their homa fires ceased to send up bright flames. Sons began to govern their fathers and wives lorded over husbands.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: मातरं पितरं वृद्धमाचार्यमतिथिं गुरुम्। गुरुत्वान्नाभ्यनन्दन्त कुमारान् नान्वपालयन्॥
en: Mothers, fathers, aged seniors, preceptors, guests and guides ceased to get respect for their exalted position. People ceased to rear with love their own offspring but began to leave them.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: भिक्षां बलिमदत्त्वा च स्वयमन्नानि भुञ्जते। अनिष्ट्वासंविभज्याथ पितृदेवातिथीन् गुरून्॥
en: Without distributing the fixed portion in alms and reserving the fixed portion for offering it to the gods, every one ate what he had. Indeed, without offering their articles to the gods, in sacrifices and without sharing them with the Pitris, the gods, guests, and reverend elders they appropriated them to their own use shamelessly.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: न शौचमनुरुद्ध्यन्त तेषां सूदजनास्तथा। मनसा कर्मणा वाचा भक्ष्यमासीदनावृतम्॥
en: Their cooks no longer cherished any consideration for purity of mind, deed, and word. They ate what had been left uncovered.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: विप्रकीर्णानि धान्यानि काकमूषिकभोजनम्। अपावृतं पयोऽतिष्ठदुच्छिष्टाश्चास्पृशन् घृतम्॥
en: Their corn lay scattered in yards, being deviated by crows and rats. Their milk remained in an open place and they began to touch clarified butter with hands unwashed after eating.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: कुद्दालं दात्रपिटकं प्रकीर्णं कांस्यभाजनम्। द्रव्योपकरणं सर्वं नान्ववैक्षत् कुटुम्बिनी॥
en: Their spades, domestic knives, baskets and dishes and cups of white brass, and other utensils lay scattered in their houses.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: प्राकारागारविध्वंसान्न स्म ते प्रतिकुर्वते। नाद्रियन्ते पशून् बद्ध्वा यवसेनोदकेन च॥
en: Their housewife did not look after these. Tlicy no longer cared for the repairs of their houses and walls. Tethering their animals they did not give them food and drunk.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: बालानां प्रेक्षमाणानां स्वयं भक्ष्यमभक्षयन्। तथा भृत्यजनं सर्वमसंतर्प्य च दानवाः॥
en: Disregarding children that only looked, on, and without having fed their dependants, the Danavas ate what they had.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: पायसं कृसरं मांसमपूपानथ शष्कुलीः। अपाचयनात्मनोऽर्थे वृथा मांसान्यभक्षयन्॥
en: They began to prepare payasa and kricara and dishes of meat and cakes and shashkuli for their own selves, and began to eat the flesh of animals not slain in sacrifices.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: उत्सूर्यशायिनश्चासन् सर्वे चासन् प्रगेनिशाः। अवर्तन् कलहाश्चात्र दिवारानं गृहे गृहे॥
en: They used to sleep even after sunrise. They slept in the mornings Day and night, disputes and quarrels raged in every house.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: अनार्याश्चार्यमासीनं पर्युपासन्न तत्र ही आश्रमस्थान् विधर्मस्थाः प्राद्विषन्त परस्परम्॥ संकराश्चाभ्यवर्तन्त न च शौचमवर्तत।
en: Those who were not respectable amongst them no longer showed any respect for them deserving of the same while the latter were seated in any place. Deviating from their fixed duties, they ceased to respect those who had returned into the forest for leading a life of peace and divine meditation. Intermixture of castes freely took place among them. They cared not for purity of body or mind.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: ये च वेदविदो विप्रा विस्पष्टमनृचश्च ये॥ निरन्तरविशेषास्ते बहुमानावमानयोः।
en: Brahmanas, learned in the Vedas, did not receive any respect among them. Those again who were ignorant of the Richs were not condemned or punished. Both, namely, those who deserved respect and those who were unworthy of the same, were treated equally.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: हारमाभरणं वेषं गतः स्थितमवेक्षितम्॥ असेवन्त भुजिष्या वै दुर्जनाचरितं विधिम्।
en: Their servant girls became wicked, and began to wear golden necklaces and other ornaments and fine dresses, and used to remain in their houses or go away before their very eyes.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: स्त्रियः पुरुषवेषेण पुंसः स्त्रीवेषधारिणः॥ क्रीडारतिविहारेषु परां मुदमवाप्नुवन्।
en: They began to derive great pleasure from sports and plays in which their women were dressed as men and their men as women.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: प्रभवद्भि: पुरा दायानहेभ्यः प्रतियादितान्॥ नाभ्यवर्तन्त नास्तिक्या वर्तन्तः सम्भवेष्वपि।
en: Those of their ancestors who were very rich had made gifts of wealth to worthy persons. The descendants of the donors, even when in affluence began to take back, for their unbelief, those gifts.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: मित्रेणाभ्यर्थितं मित्रमर्थसंशयिते क्वचित्॥ बालकोट्यग्रमात्रेण स्वार्थेनाघ्नत तद वसु।
en: When difficulties were anticipated for the fulfilment of any object and friend sought the advice of friend, that purpose was frustrated by the latter even if he had any slightest selfinterest to fulfil by frustrating it.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: परस्वादानरुचयो विपणव्यवहारिणः॥ अदृश्यन्तार्यवर्णेषु शूद्राश्चापि तपोधनाः।
en: Even amongst their better classes have appeared traders and dealers in goods, beni upon misappropriating others. The Shudras began to practise penances.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: अधीयते केचिद् वृथा व्रतमथापरे॥ अशुश्रूषुर्गुरोः शिष्यः कश्चिच्छिष्यसखोगुरुः।
en: Some have begun to study, without fixing any rules for regulating their hours and food. Other have begun to study, making useless rules. Disciples have refrained from rendering obedience and service to preceptors. Preceptors again have come to treat disciples as friends.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: पिता चैव जनित्री च श्रान्तौ वृत्तसोत्सवाविव॥ अप्रभुत्वे स्थितौ वृद्धावन्नं प्रार्थयतः सुतान्।
en: Fathers and mothers are tired with work, and do not enjoy festivities. Aged parents having no power over sons, have been compelled to beg their food of the latter.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: तत्र वेदविदः प्राज्ञा गाम्भीर्ये सागरोपमाः७४।। कृप्यादिष्वभवन् सक्ता मूर्खाः श्राद्धान्यभुञ्जत।
en: Amongst them, even wise persons wellread in the Vedas, and resembling the ocean itself in gravity, have begun to follow agriculture and similar callings Illiterate and ignorant persons have begun to be fed at Shraddhas.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: प्राः प्रातश्च सुप्रश्नं कल्पनं प्रेषणक्रियाः॥ शिष्यानप्रहितास्तेषामकुर्वन् गुरवः स्वयम्।
en: Disciples instead of approaching preceptors, every morning for making dutiful enquiries, for determing what acts are to be performed, and for seeking commissions which they are to discharge, preceptors wait upon them to perform all those functions.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: श्वश्रूश्वशुरयोरने वधूः प्रेष्यानशासत॥ अन्वशासच्च भर्तारं समाहूयाभिजल्पति।
en: Daughter-in-law, in the presence of their husband's mothers and fathers, rebuke and chastise servants and maids, and calling their husbands lecture and rebuke them.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: प्रयलेनापि चारक्षच्चितं पुत्रस्य वै पिता॥ व्यभजच्चापि संरम्भाद् दुःखवासं तथावसत्।
en: Fathers, with great care, try to keep sons in good humour, or, through fear, distributing their wealth among children, live in misery and affliction.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: अग्निदाहेन चोरैर्वा राजभिर्वा हृतं धनम्॥ दृष्ट्वा द्वेषात् प्राहसन्त सुहृत्सम्भाविता ह्यपि।
en: Even the friends of the victims, seeing the latter deprived of riches in fire or by robbers or by the king, have begun to jeer.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: कृतघ्ना नास्तिकाः पापा गुरुदाराभिमर्शिनः॥ अभक्ष्यभक्षणरता निर्मर्यादा हतत्विषः।
en: They have become ungrateful and athestical and sinful and have begun to commit adultery with the wives of their preceptors. They have begun to take forbidden food. They hav. transgressed all bounds and restraints. They have become shorn of that splendour which had made them famous before.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: तेष्वेवमादीनाचारानाचरत्सु विपर्यये॥ नाहं देवेन्द्र वत्स्यामि दानवेष्विति मे मतिः।
en: On account of these and other marks of wicked conduct and the change of their former nature, I shall not, O king of the gods, live among them any longer.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: तन्मां स्वयमनुप्राप्तामभिनन्द शचीपते॥ त्वयार्चितां मां देवेश पुरो धास्यन्ति देवताः।
en: I have, therefore, come to you of my own accord. Receive me with reverence, O lord of Sachi! Respected by you, O king of the gods, I shall receive honour from all other gods.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: यत्राहं तत्र मत्कान्ता मद्विशिष्टा मदर्पणाः॥ सप्त देव्यो जयाष्टम्यो वासमेष्यन्ति तेऽष्टधा।
en: There where I live the seven other goddesses with Jaya for the eighth, who love me, who are inseparably associated with me, and who depend upon me, wish to live.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: आशा श्रद्धा धृतिः शान्तिर्विजितिः संनतिः क्षमा॥ अष्टमी वृत्तिरेतासां पुरोगा पाकशासन।
en: They Hope, Faith, Intelligence, Contentment, Victory, Advancement, Forgiveness. She who is the eighth, viz., Jaya, occupies the foremost place amongst them, O chastiser of Paka.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: ताश्चाहं चासुरांस्त्यक्त्वा युष्मद्विषयमागता:।1८४॥ त्रिदशेषु निवत्स्यामो धर्मनिष्ठान्तरात्मसु।
en: Having left the Asuras, all of them and myself have come to your kingdom. We shall henceforth live among the gods who are given to righteousness and faith.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: इत्युक्तवचनां देवीं प्रीत्यर्थं च ननन्दतुः॥ नारदश्चात्र देवर्षिवृत्रहन्ता च वासवः।
en: After the goddess had said so, the celestial Rishi Narada, and Vasava the killer of Vritra, for pleasing her, offered her a joyful welcome.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: ततोऽनलसखो वायुः प्रववौ देववर्त्मसु॥ इष्टगन्धः सुखस्पर्शः सर्वेन्द्रियसुखावहः।
en: The Wind-God-that friend of Agni, then began to blow gently through the sky, carrying sweet odors, refreshing all creatures with whom he came into contact, and contributing to the pleasure of every one of the senses.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: शुचौ वाभ्यर्थिते देशे त्रिदशाः प्रायशः स्थिताः॥ लक्ष्मीसहितमासीनं मघवन्तं दिदृक्षवः॥
en: All the gods, (hearing the news) gathered together in a pure and desirable spot and waited there for seeing Maghavat seated with Lakshmi beside him.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: ततो दिवं प्राप्य सहस्रलोचनः श्रियोपपन्नः सुहृदा महर्षिणा। रथेन हर्यश्वयुजा सुरर्षभः सदः सुराणामभिसत्कृतो ययौ॥
en: Then the thousand eyed king of the gods, accompanied by Shree and his friend the great Rishi, and riding upon a splendid car drawn by green horses, caine into that concourse of the celestials, receiving honour from all.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: अथेगितं वज्रधरस्य नारदः श्रियश्च देव्या मनसा विचारयन्। श्रियै शशंसामरदृष्टपौरुषः शिवेन तत्रागमनं महर्षिभिः॥
en: Observing a sign that the holder of the thunder-bolt made and which Shree herself approved of, then the great Rishi Narada, whose prowess all the gods knew, welcomed the approach of the goddess there and announced it as highly auspicious.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: ततोऽमृतं द्यौः प्रववर्ष भास्वती पितामहस्यायतने स्वयम्भुवः। अनाहता दुन्दुभयोऽथ नेदिरे तथा प्रसन्नाव दिशश्चकाशिरे॥
en: Heaven's sky became clear and bright and began to shower ambrosia upon the region of the self-create Grand-father. The celestial keule-druns, though struck by none, began to beat, and all the cardinal points, becoming clear, seemed ablaze with splendour.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: यथर्तु सस्येषु ववर्ष वासवो न धर्ममार्गाद् विचचाल कश्चन। अनेकरलाकरभूषणा च भूः सुघोषघोषा भुवनौकसां जये॥
en: Indra began to pour rain upon crops that sprouted up at its proper season. No one then disgraced the path of righteousness. The Earth was bedecked with many mines filled with jewels and gems, and the chanting of Vedic recitations and other sweet sounds swelled up on the occasion of that success of the gods.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: क्रियाभिरामा मनुजा मनस्विनो बभुः शुभे पुण्यकृतां पथि स्थिताः। नरामराः किन्नरयक्षराक्षसाः समृद्धिमन्तः सुमनस्विनोऽभवन्॥
en: Human beings, gifted with firm minds, and all following the sacred path trodden by the righteous, began to find pleasure in Vedic and other religious rites and acts. Men, Celestials, Kinnaras Yakshas and Rakshasas, all became endued with prosperity and cheerfulness.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: न जात्वकाले कुसुमं कुतः फलं पपात वृक्षात् पवनरितादपि। रसप्रदा: कामदुघाश्च धेवनो न दारुणा वाग् विचचार कस्यचित्॥
en: Not a flower,. what to speak of fruits, dropped untimely from a tree even if the WindGod shook it with force. All the kine began to give sweet milk whenever milked by men and cruel and harsh words were not given vent to by any one.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: इमां सपर्यां सह सर्वकामदैः श्रियश्च शक्रप्रमुखैश्च दैवतैः। पठन्ति ये विप्रसदःसमागताः समृद्धकामाः श्रियमाप्नुवन्ति ते॥
en: They who, seeking advancement, appear before assemblies of Brahmanas, and read this description of the glorification of Shree by all the gods headed by Indra,-deities competent to grant every wish, succeed in acquiring great prosperity.

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: त्वया कुरूणां वर यत् प्रचोदितं भवाभवस्येह परं निदर्शनम्। तदद्य सर्वं परिकीर्तितं मया परीक्ष्य तत्त्वं परिगन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: These then, O king of the Kurus are the foremost marks of prosperity and adversity. Requested by you, I have told you all. You should now act according to the instructions conveyed herein, understanding them after careful reflection,

description: The marks of future greatness and degeneration
sn: त्वया कुरूणां वर यत् प्रचोदितं भवाभवस्येह परं निदर्शनम्। तदद्य सर्वं परिकीर्तितं मया परीक्ष्य तत्त्वं परिगन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: These then, O king of the Kurus are the foremost marks of prosperity and adversity. Requested by you, I have told you all. You should now act according to the instructions conveyed herein, understanding them after careful reflection,

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किंशील: किंसमाचार: किंविद्यः किंपराक्रमः। प्राप्नोति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं यत्परं प्रकृतेर्बुवम्॥
en: Yudhisthira said By what nature, what course of duties, what knowledge, and what energy, does one succeed in attaining to Brahma which is immutable and is beyond the reach of nature.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: भीष्म उवाच मोक्षधर्मेषु नियतो लध्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः। प्राप्नोति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं तत्परं प्रकृतेर्बुवम्॥
en: Bhishma said One who practises the religion of renunciation, who eats sparingly, and who has his senses under complete control, can attain to Brahma which is immutable and which is above nature.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। जैगीषव्यस्य संवादमसितस्य च भारत॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Jaigishavya and Asita, O Bharata.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: जैगीषव्यं महाप्रज्ञं धर्माणामागतागमम्। अक्रुध्यन्तमहष्यन्तमसितो देवलोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Once on a time Asita-Devala addressed Jaigishavya who was endued with great wisdom and fully acquainted with the truths of duty and morality.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: देवल उवाच न प्रीयसे वन्धमानो निन्द्यमानो न कुप्यसे। का ते प्रज्ञा कुतश्चैषा किं ते तस्याः परायणम्॥
en: Devala said You are not pleased when lauded, you do not give way to anger when blamed or censured. What, indeed, is your wisdom? whence have you got it? And what, indeed, is the refuge of that wisdom?

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: भीष्म उवाच इति तनानुयुक्तः स तमुवाच महातपाः। महद्वाक्यमसंदिग्धं पुष्कलार्थपदं शुचि॥
en: Bhishma said Thus accosted by Devala, the pure Jaigishavya of austere penances, said those words of great import, fraught with full faith, and deep significance.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: जैगीषव्य उवाच या गतिर्या परा काष्ठा या शान्तिः पुण्यकर्मणाम्। तां तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि महतीमृषिसत्तम॥
en: Jaigishavya said.. O foremost of Rishis, I shall tell you of what is the highest end, that which is the supreme goal, that which is tranquility, as regarded by all pious persons.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: निन्दत्सु च समा नित्यं प्रशंसत्सु च देवल। निहुवन्ति च ये तेषां समयं सुकृतं च यत्॥ उक्ताश्च न वदिष्यन्ति वक्तारमहिते हितम्। प्रतिहन्तुं न चेच्छन्ति हन्तारं वै मनीषिणः॥
en: They, O Devala, who treat equally those who praise them and those who blame them, they who conceal their own vows and good acts, they who never indulge in vilifications, they who never say even what is good when it is calculated to injure (instead of producing any benefit), they who do not desire to retaliate injury are said to be wise men.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: नाप्राप्तमनुशोचन्ति प्राप्तकालानि कुर्वते। न चातीतानि शोचन्ति न चैव प्रतिजानते॥
en: They never grieve for what is yet to come. They are concerned with only what is present and act as they should. They never grieve for the past or even recollect it.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: सम्प्राप्तानां च पूज्यानां कामादर्थेषु देवला यथोपपत्तिं कुर्वन्ति शक्तिमन्तः कृतव्रताः॥
en: Endued with power and controlled minds, they do at their pleasure, in the way in which it should be done, what they should do, O Devala, if solicited respectfully thereto.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: पक्वविद्या महाप्राज्ञा जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः। मनसा कर्मणा वाचा नापराध्यन्ति कर्हिचित्॥
en: Of mature knowledge, of great wisdom, with anger under complete control, and with their passions subjugated, they never commit an injury to any one in thought, word, or deed.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: अनीर्षवो न चान्योन्यं विहिंसन्ति कदाचन। न च जातूपतप्यन्ते धीराः परसमृद्धिभिः॥
en: Shorn of envy, they never injure others, and gifted with self-control, ihey are never pained on seeing other people's prosperity.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: निन्दाप्रशंसे चात्यर्थं न वदन्ति परस्य ये। न च निन्दाप्रशंसाभ्यां विक्रियन्ते कदाचन॥
en: Such men never indulge in exaggerated speeches, or laud others, or speak ill of them. They are again never influenced by praise and censure showered on them.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: सर्वतश्च प्रशान्ता ये सर्वभूतहिते रताः। न क्रुद्ध्यन्ति न हृष्यन्ति नापराध्यन्ति कर्हिचित्॥
en: They are tranquil regarding all their desires, and are engaged in the well being of the creatures. They never give way to anger to indulge in joy, or injure any creature.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: विमुच्य हृदयग्रन्थिं चक्रमन्ति यथासुखम्। न येषां बान्धवाः सन्ति ये चान्येषां न बान्धवाः॥
en: Loosening all the knots of their hearts, they pass on very happily. They have no friends nor are they the friends of others.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: अमित्राश्च न सन्त्येषां ये चामित्रा न कस्यचित्। य एवं कुर्वते माः सुखं जीवन्ति सर्वदा॥
en: They have no enemies nor are they the enemies of other creatures. Indeed men who can live in this way can pass their days in perpetual happiness.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: ये धर्म चानुरुद्ध्यन्ते धर्मज्ञा द्विजसत्तम। ये ह्यतो विच्युता मार्गात् ते हृष्यन्त्युद्विजन्ति च॥
en: O foremost of twice-born ones, they who acquire a knowledge of the rules of morality and righteousness, and who observe those rules in practice, acquire joy, while they who deviate from the path or righteousness are afflicted by anxieties and sorrow.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: आस्थितस्तमहं मार्गमसूयिष्यामि कं कथम्। निन्द्यमानः प्रशस्तो वा हृष्येऽहं केन हेतुना॥
en: I now follow the path of righteousness. Decried by others, why shall I be annoyed with them, or lauded by others, why shall I be pleased?

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: यद् यदिच्छन्ति तत् तस्मादपि गच्छन्तु मानवाः। न मे निन्दाप्रशंसाभ्यां ह्रासवृद्धी भविष्यतः॥
en: Let men get whatsoever objects they please from whatsoever callings they pursue. Praise and censure cannot secure my advancement or the reverse.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: अमृतस्येव संतृप्येदवमानस्य तत्त्ववित्। विषस्येवोद्विजेन्नित्यं सम्मानस्य विचक्षणः॥
en: He who has understood the truths of things, becomes pleased with even disregard as if it were nectar. The wise man is indeed annoyed with regard as if it were poison.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: अवज्ञातः सुखं शेते इह चामुत्र चाभयम्। विमुक्तः सर्वदोषेभ्यो योऽवमन्ता स बध्यते॥
en: He who is freed from all shortcomings sleeps fearlessly both here and hereafter even if insulted by others, On the other hand, he who insults him, meets with destruction.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: परां गतिं च ये केचित् प्रार्थयन्ति मनीषिणः। एतद् व्रतं समाश्रित्य सुखमेधन्ति ते जनाः॥
en: The wise men who seek to attain to the highest end, succeed in obtaining it following such a conduct.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: सर्वतश्च समाहृत्य ऋतून् सर्वान् जितेन्द्रियः। प्राप्नोति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं यत्परं प्रकृतेर्बुवम्॥
en: The man who has controlled all his senses is considered to have performed all the sacrifices. Such a person attains to Brahma, which is eternal and which is above the reach of nature.

description: How does a man attain to Brahma
sn: नास्य देवा न गन्धर्वा न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः। पदमन्ववरोहन्ति प्राप्तस्य परमां गतिम्॥
en: The very gods, the Gandharvas, the Pishachas, and the Rakshasas, cannot attain to the end of one who has attained to the hightest end.

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच प्रियः सर्वस्य लोकस्य सर्वसत्त्वाभिनन्दिता। गुणैः सर्वैरुपेतश्च को न्वस्ति भुवि मानवः॥
en: Yudhishthira said What man is there who is dear to all, who pleases all persons, and who is gifted with every merit and every accomplishment?

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि पृच्छतो भरतर्षभ। उग्रसेनस्य संवादं नारदे केशवस्य च॥
en: Bhishma said About it I shall recite to you the words that Keshava, asked by Ugrasena, said to him on a former occasion.

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: उग्रसेन उवाच यस्य संकल्पते लोको नारदस्य प्रकीर्तने। मन्ये स गुणसम्पन्नो ब्रूहि तन्मम पृच्छतः॥
en: Ugrasena said All persons seem to be auxious to describe of the merits of Narada. I think that celestial Rishi must really be endued with every sort of merit. I ask you tell me this, O Keshava.

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: वासुदेव उवाच कुकुराधिप यान् मन्ये शृणु तान् मे विवक्षतः। नारदस्य गुणान् साधून् संक्षेपेण नराधिप॥
en: Vasudeva said O chief of the Kukuras, listen to me as I describe shortly those good qualities of Narada which I know, I king! Narada is as well-read in the scriptures as he is good and pious in his conduct

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: न चारित्रनिमित्तोऽस्याहंकारो देहतापनः। अभिन्नश्रुतचारित्रस्तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: And yet, he is not proud of his conduct, which makes one's blood so hot. It is for this that he is adored everywhere.

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: अरतिः क्रोधचापल्ये भयं नैतानि नारदे। अदीर्घसूत्रः शूरश्च तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: Discontent, anger, levity, and fear, do not exist in Narada. He is free from procrastination, and endued with courage. For this he is adored everywhere.

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: उपास्यो नारदो बाढं वाचि नास्य व्यतिक्रमः कामतो यदि वा लोभात् तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: Narada deserves the respectful adorations of all. He never retracts his words through desire of cupidity. For this he is adored everywhere.

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: अध्यात्मविधितत्त्वज्ञः क्षान्तः शक्तोजितेन्द्रियः। ऋजुश्च सत्यवादी च तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: He is fully conversant with the knowledge of the soul, bent on peace, endued with great energy, and a master of his senses. He is free from guile, and truthful in words. For this he is adored with respect everywhere.

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: तेजसा यशसा बुद्ध्या ज्ञानेन विनयेन च। जन्मना तपसा वृद्धस्तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: He is distinguished by energy, fame, intelligence, knowledge, humility, birth, by penances, and years. For these he is everywhere adored with respect.

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: सुशीलः सुखसंवेशः सुभोजः स्वादरः शुचिः। सुवाक्यश्चाप्यनीर्घ्यश्च तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: He is of good conduct. He dresses and houses himself well. He cats pure food. He loves all. He is pure in body and mind. He is sweet-speeched. He is free from envy and malice. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: कल्याणं कुरुते बाढं पापमस्मिन्न विद्यते। न प्रीयते परानर्थस्तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
en: He is, forsooth, always employed in doing good to all people. No sin is in him. He never rejoices at other people's misfortunes. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

description: The conversation between Krishna land Ugrasena about the man who pleases all
sn: वेदश्रुतिभिराख्यानैरानभिजिगीषति। तितिक्षुरनवज्ञाता तस्मात् सर्वत्र पूजितः॥
