sn: पुरुषत्वे सुता यूयं स्त्रीत्वे चेमे शतं सुताः। एकत्र भुज्यतां राज्यं भ्रातृभावेन पुत्रकाः॥ सहिता भ्रातरस्तेऽथ राज्यं बुभुजिरे तदा। तान् दृष्ट्वा भ्रातृभावेन भुञ्जानान् राज्यमुत्तमम्॥
en: Thus commanded by their parent, all the brothers, in a body, began to enjoy the kingdom as their joint property. Seeing those children of the king all jointly enjoying the kingdom as brothers born of the same parents, the king of the gods, filled with anger, began to reflect, by transforming this royal sage into a woman, I have, it appears, done him good instead of an injury:

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: चिन्तयामास देवेन्द्रो मन्युनाऽथ परिप्लुतः। उपकारोऽस्य राजर्षेः कृतो नापकृतं मया।॥
en: Saying this, the king of the gods, viz., Indra of a hundred sacrifices, assuming the form of a Brahmana, went to the capital of the king and meeting all the children succeeded in creating dissensions amongst them.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: ततो ब्राह्मणरूपेण देवराजः शतक्रतुः। भेदयामास तान् गत्वा नगरं वै नृपात्मजान्॥
en: He said to them, Brothers never remain at peace even when they are the children of the same father. The sons of the sage Kashyapa, viz., the gods and the Asuras, fell out with each other on account of the sovereignty of the three worlds.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: भ्रातृणां नास्ति सौभ्रात्रं येष्वेकस्य पितुः सुताः। राज्यहेतोर्विवदिताः कश्यपस्य सुरासुराः॥
en: As regards you princes, you are the children of the royal sage Bhangasvana. These others are the children of an ascetic. The gods and the Asuras are children of even one common father.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: यूयं भङ्गास्वनापत्यास्तापसस्येत्तरे सुताः। कश्यपस्य सुराश्चैव असुराश्च सुतास्तथा॥
en: This kingdom, your paternal property is being enjoyed by these children of an ascetic with these words, Indra succeeded in creating disunion amongst them, so that they very soon engaged in battle and killed each other.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: युष्माकं पैतृकं राज्यं भुज्यते तापसात्मजैः। इन्द्रेण भेदितास्ते तु युद्धेऽन्योन्यमपातयन्।॥ तच्छुत्वा तापसी चापि संतप्ता प्ररुरोद ह। ब्राह्मणच्छद्मनाभ्येत्य तामिन्द्रोऽथान्वच्छत॥
en: Hearing this, king Bhangasvana, who was living as an ascetic woman, burning with grief and began to bewail. The king of the gods, viz., Indra, assuming the form of a Brahmana, came where the ascetic lady was living, and meeting her, said you having a beautiful face, with what grief do you burn so that you are thus bewailing? Seeing the Brahmana, the lady told। him in a piteous tone.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: केन दुःखेन संतप्ता रोदिषि त्वं वरानने। ब्राह्मणं तं ततो दृष्ट्वा सा स्त्री करुणमब्रवीत्॥
en: Two hundred sons of mine, O twiceborn one, have been killed by Time. I was formerly a king, O learned Brahmana and in that state had a hundred sons.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: पुत्राणां वे शते ब्रह्मन् कालेन विनिपातिते। अहं राजाभवं विप्र तत्र पूर्वं शतं मम॥
en: These were begotten by me after my own form, O best of twiceborn persons! On one occasion I went on a hunting expedition, Stupefied, I travelled amidst a thick forest.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: समुत्पन्नं स्वरूपाणां पुत्राणां ब्राह्मणोत्तम। कदाचिन्मृगयां यात उद्भान्तो गहने वने॥
en: Seeing at last a lake, I plunged into it. Rising, O foremost of Brahmanas, I found that I had become a woman. Returning to my capital I installed my sons in the kingdom and then left for the forest.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: अवगाढश्च सरसि स्त्रीभूतो ब्राह्मणोत्तम। पुत्रान् राज्ये प्रतिष्ठाप्य वनमस्मि ततो गतः॥
en: Changed into a woman, I bore a hundred sons to my husband who is a great ascetic. All of them were born in the ascetic's retreat. I took them to the capital.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: स्त्रियाश्च मे पुत्रशतं तापसेन महात्मना। आश्रमे जनितं ब्रह्मन् नीतं तन्नगरं मया॥
en: My children, through the influence of time, fell out with each other, O twiceborn one! Thus afflicted by Destiny, I am bewailing.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: तेषां च वैरमुत्पन्नं कालयोगेन वै द्विजा एतच्छोचाम्यहं ब्रह्मन् दैवेन समभिप्लुता॥
en: Indra addressed him in these harsh words In former days, O lady, you gave me great pain, for you did perform a sacrifice that is disliked by Indra.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: इन्द्रस्तां दुःखितां दृष्ट्वा अब्रवीत् परुषं वचः। पुरा सुदुःसहं भद्रे मम दुःखं त्वया कृतम्॥
en: Indeed, though I was present, you did not invoke me with honours. I am that Indra, O you of wicked understanding! It is I with whom you sought hostilities.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: इन्द्रद्विष्टेन यजता मामनाहूय धिष्ठितम्। इन्द्रोऽहमस्मि दुर्बुद्धे वैरं ते पातितं मया॥
en: Seeing Indra, the royal sage fell at his feet, touching them with his head, and said Be pleased with me, O foremost of gods. The sacrifice of which you speak was performed from a desire of offspring.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: इन्द्रं दृष्ट्वा तु राजर्षिः पादयोः शिरसा गतः। प्रसीद त्रिदशश्रेष्ठ पुत्रकामेन स क्रतुः॥
en: You should, therefore, pardon me. Seeing the transformed king prostrate himself thus to him, Indra became pleased with him and wished to give him a boon.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: इष्टस्त्रिदशशार्दूल तत्र मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि। प्रणिपातेन तस्येन्द्रः परितुष्टो वरं ददौ॥
en: Which of your sons, O king, do you wish, should revive, those whom you gave birth to as a woman, or those who were begotten by you asa man.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: पुत्रास्ते कतमे राजन् जीवन्त्वेतत् प्रचक्ष्व मे। स्त्रीभूतस्य हि ये जाताः पुरुषस्याथ येऽभवन्॥
en: Joining her hands, the ascetic lady, answered Indra, saying O Vasava, let those sons of mine revive who were borne by me as a woman.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: तापसी तु ततः शक्रमुवाच प्रयताञ्जलिः। स्त्रीभूतस्य हि ये पुत्रास्ते मे जीवन्तु वासव।॥
en: Filled with wonder at this reply. Indra once more asked the lady Why do you cherish less affection for those children of yours who were begotten by you as a man?

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: इन्द्रस्तु विस्मितो दृष्ट्वा स्त्रियं पप्रच्छ तां पुनः। पुरुषोत्पादिता ये ते कथं द्वेष्याः सुतास्तव॥
en: Why is it that you love more those children that were borne by you in your changed state? I wish to hear the reason of this difference in your love. You should tell me everything.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: स्त्र्युवाच स्त्रीभूतस्य हि ये जाताः स्नेहस्तेभ्योऽधिकः कथम्। कारणं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तन्मे वक्तुमिहार्हसि॥
en: The lady said The affection that is cherished by a woman is much greater than that which is cherished by a man. Therefore, O Shakra, I wish those children to revive that were borne by me as a woman.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: भीष्म उवाच स्त्रियास्त्वभ्यधिकः स्नेहो न तथा पुरुषस्य वै। तस्मात् ते शक्र जीवन्तु ये जाताः स्त्रीकृतस्य वै।४७
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed, Indra became highly pleased and said to her O truthful lady, let all your children come back into life.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: एवमुक्तस्ततस्त्विन्द्रः प्रीतो वाक्यमुवाच ह। सर्व एवेह जीवन्तु पुत्रास्ते सत्यवादिनि॥
en: Do you take another boon, o foremost of kings whatever you like, O you of excellent vcws. Do you take from me whatever dignity you choose, that of woman or of man.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: स्त्युवाच वरं च वृणु राजेन्द्र यं त्वमिच्छसि सुव्रत। पुरुषत्वमथ स्त्रीत्वं मत्तो यदभिकांक्षते॥ स्त्रीत्वमेव वृणे शक्र पुंस्त्वं नेच्छामि वासव। एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन्द्रस्तां स्त्रियं प्रत्युवाच ह॥ पुरुषत्वं कथं त्यक्त्वा स्त्रीत्वं चोदयसे विभो। एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच स्त्रीभूतो राजसत्तमः॥ स्त्रियाः पुरुषसंयोगे प्रीतिरभ्यधिका सदा। एतस्मात् कारणाच्छक स्त्रीत्वमेव वृणोम्यहम्॥
en: The lady said I wish to remain a woman, O Shakra. In fact, I do not wish to become a man, O Vasava.Hearing this answer, Indra once more asked her, saying Why is it, O powerful one, that leaving aside the dignity of manhood you seek for that of womanhood? Thus accosted that foremost of kings transformed into a woman, answered In sexual intercourse, the pleasure that women enjoy is always much greater than what is enjoyed by men. Therefore, O Shakra, I wish to continue a woman.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: रमिताऽभ्यधिकं स्त्रीत्वे सत्यं वै देवसत्तम। स्त्रीभावेन हि तुष्यामि गम्यतां त्रिदशाधिप॥
en: O foremost of the gods, truly do I say to you that I derive greater pleasure in my present state of womanhood. I am quite content with this state of womanhood that I now have. Do you leave me now, O king of heaven.

description: -continued Whether man or woman gets greater pleasure from an act of union
sn: एवमस्त्विति चोक्त्वा तामापृच्छच्य त्रिदिवं गतः। एवं स्त्रिया महाराज अधिका प्रतिरुच्यते॥
en: Hearing these words of hers, the lord of the gods answered So be it and bidding her farewell, went to heaven. Thus, o king, it is known that woman derives much greater pleasure than men under the circumstances you have asked.

description: The means for passing happily through this world and the next
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किं कर्तव्यं मनुष्येण लोकयात्राहितार्थिना। कथं वै लोकयात्रां तु किंशीलश्च समाचरेत्॥
en: Yudhishthira said What should a man do in order to pass happily through this and the other world. How, indeed, should one act? What practices should one follow with this view?

description: The means for passing happily through this world and the next
sn: भीष्म उवाच कार्येन त्रिविधं कर्म वाचर चापि चतुर्विधम्। मनसा त्रिविधं चैव दशकर्मपथांस्त्यजेत्॥
en: Bhishma said One should avoid the three deeds which are done with the body, the four which are done with words, the three which are done with the mind, and the ten roads of action.

description: The means for passing happily through this world and the next
sn: प्राणातिपात: स्तैन्यं च परदारानथापि च। त्रीणि पापानि कायेन सर्वतः परिवर्जयेत्॥
en: The three deeds which are done with the body and should be wholly avoided are the destruction of the lives of other creatures, theft or misappropriation of others properties, and the enjoyment of other people's wives.

description: The means for passing happily through this world and the next
sn: असत्प्रलाप पारुष्यं पैशुन्यमनृतं तथा। चत्वारि वाचा राजेन्द्र न जल्पेन्नानुचिन्तयेत्॥
en: The four acts which are done with words, O king, and which should never be done or even thought of, are evil conversation, harsh words, giving other people's faults, and falsehood.

description: The means for passing happily through this world and the next
sn: अनभिघ्या परस्वेषु सर्वसत्त्वेषु सौहृदम्। कर्मणां फलमस्तीति त्रिविधं मनसा चरेत्॥
en: Coveting the possessions of others, doing harm to others, and disbelief in the Vedas, are the three deeds done with the mind which should always be avoided.

description: The means for passing happily through this world and the next
sn: तस्माद् वाक्कायमनसा नाचरेदशुभं नरः। शुभाशुभान्याचरन् हि तस्य तस्याश्नुते फलम्॥
en: Hence, one should never do any evil deed in speech, body, or mind. By doing good and evil deeds, one is sure to enjoy or reap the just consequences thereof. Nothing can be more certain than this.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच त्वयाऽऽपगेय नामानि श्रुतानीह जगत्पतेः। पितामहेशाय विभो नामान्याचक्ष्व शम्भवे॥
en: Yudhishthira said O son of the River Ganga, you have heard all the names of the Lord of the universe. Tell us, O grandfather, all the names that are applied, O powerful one, to Him who is called Isha and Shambhu.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: बभ्रवे विश्वरूपाय महाभाग्यं च तत्त्वतः। सुरासुरगुरौ देवे शंकरेऽव्यक्तयोनये॥
en: Tell us all those names which are applied to him who is called Babhru or vast, Him who has the universe for his form, Him who is the illustrious Lord of all the gods and the Asuras, who is called Shankara, and who has an origin that is unmanifest. Tell us also of the power of Mahadeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: भीष्म उवाच अशक्तोऽहं गुणान् वक्तुं महादेवस्य धीमतः। यो हि सर्वगतो देवो न च सर्वत्र दृश्यते॥
en: Bhishma said I am quite incompetent to recite the virtues of the highly intelligent Mahadeva. He pervades all things in the universe and yet is not seen anywhere.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ब्रह्मविष्णुसुरेशानां स्रष्टा च प्रभुरेव च। ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ता यं हि देवा उपासते॥
en: He is the creator of Brahman. Vishnu, and Indra, and he is their lord. All the gods, from Brahman to the Pishachas, adore him.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: प्रकृतीनां परत्वेन पुरुषस्य च यः परः। चिन्त्यते यो योगविद्भिर्ऋषिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः। अक्षरं परमं ब्रह्म असच्च सदसच्च यः॥
en: He is above both Prakriti and Purusha. It is of Him that Rishis, conversant with Yoga and possessing a knowledge of all subjects think and reflect.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: प्रकृति पुरुषं चैव क्षोभयित्वा स्वतेजसा। ब्रह्माणमसृजत् तस्माद् देवदेवः प्रजापतिः॥
en: He is indestructible and Supreme Brahma. He is both existent and nonexistent. Agitating both Nature and Soul by his energy, He created therefrom the universal lord of creatures, viz., Brahman.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: को हि शक्तो गुणान् वक्तुं देवदेवस्य धीमतः। गर्भजन्मजरायुक्तो मर्यो मृत्युसमन्वितः॥
en: Who is there, who is competent to recount the virtues of that god of gods, who is gifted with supreme Intelligence? Man is subject to conception, birth, decrepitude, and death.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: को हि शक्तो भवं ज्ञातुं मद्विधः परमेश्वरम्। ऋते नारायणात् पुत्र शङ्खचक्रगदाधरात्॥
en: Being such, what man like me understand Bhava? Only Narayana, O son, that holder of the conch, the discus, and the mace, can comprehend Mahadeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एष विद्वान् गुणश्रेष्ठो विष्णुः परमदुर्जयः। दिव्यचक्षुर्महातजा वीक्षते योगचक्षुषा॥
en: can an He gifted with knowledge. He is the foremost of all beings in qualities. He is Vishnu, because he pervades the universe. He is irresistible. Gifted with spiritual vision, He is possessed of supreme Energy. He sees all things with the eye of Yoga.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: रुद्रभक्त्या तु कृष्णेन जगद् व्याप्तं महात्मना। तं प्रसाद्य तदा देवं बदाँ किल भारत॥
en: On account of his devotion to the illustrious Rudra whom he pleased, O Bharata, in the hermitage of Badari, by penances, that the great Krishna has succeeded in overwhelming the entire universe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अर्थात् प्रियतरत्वं च सर्वलोकेषु वै तदा। प्राप्तवानेव राजेन्द्र सुवर्णाक्षान्महेश्वरात्॥
en: O king of kings, it is through Maheshvara of celestial vision that Vasudeva has got the quality of universal agreeableness agreeableness which is much greater than riches.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: पूर्णं वर्षसहस्रं तु तप्तवानेष माधवः। प्रसाद्य वरदं देवं चराचरगुरुं शिवम्॥
en: For a full thousand years this Madhava practised the austerest penances and at last succeeded in pleasing the illustrious and boongiving Shiva, that lord of the mobile and the immobile universe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: युगे युगे तु कृष्णेन तोषितो वै महेश्वरः। भक्त्या परमया चैव प्रीतश्चैव महात्मनः॥
en: In every new cycle has Krishna pleased Mahadeva. In every cycle has Mahadeva been pleased with the great devotion of the great Krishna.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ऐश्वर्यं यादृशं तस्य जगधोनेर्महात्मनः। तदयं दृष्टवान् साक्षात् पुत्रार्थे हरिरच्युतः॥
en: Hari, who himself is above all decay, saw the power of the great Mahadeva that original cause of the universe, on the occasion of his penances in the retreat of Vadari undergone for getting a son.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यस्मात् परतरं चैव नान्यं पश्यामि भारत। व्याख्यातुं देवदेवस्य शक्तो नामान्यशेषतः॥
en: I do not, O Bharata, see any one who is superior to Mahadeva. Only Krishna is competent to explain the names of that god of gods fully and without creating the desire of hearing more.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एष शक्तो महाबाहुर्वक्तुं भगवतो गुणान्। विभूतिं चैव कात्स्न्र्थेन सत्यां माहेश्वरी नृप॥
en: This mightyarmed one of Yadu's race is alone competent to tell the qualities of the illustrious Shiva. Verily, O king, only he is able to describe fully the power of the Supreme god.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तदा भीष्मो वासुदेवं महायशाः। भवमाहात्म्यसंयुक्तमिदमाह पितामहः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said these words, the illustrious Bhishma, the grandfather of the Kurus, addressing Vasudeva, said the following words describing the greatness of Bhava, O king.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: भीष्म उवाच सुरासुरगुरो देव विष्णो त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि। शिवाय विष्णुरूपाय यन्मां पृच्छद् युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Bhishma said You are the Lord of all the gods and the Asuras. You are illustrious. You are Vishnu, because you pervade the entire universe. You should describe those subjects connected with Shiva of universal about which Yudhishthira has asked me.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नाम्नां सहस्रं देवस्य तण्डिना ब्रह्मयोनिना। निवेदितं ब्रह्मलोके ब्रह्मणो यत् पुराभवत्॥
en: In days of yore, the Rishi Tandin, originated from Brahman, recited in Brahman's region and before Brahman himself the thousand names of Mahadeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: द्वैपायनप्रभृतयस्तथा चेमे तपोधनाः। ऋषयः सुव्रता दान्ताः शृण्वन्तु गदतस्तव॥
en: Do you recite those names before this assemblage of Rishis having asceticism for their wealth, observant of high vows, possessed hear you. of self-control, and numbering the Islandborn Krishna among them, may

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ध्रुवाय नन्दिने होः गोप्ने विश्वसृजेऽग्नये। महाभाग्यं विभो—हि मुण्डिनेऽथ कपर्दिने॥
en: Do you discourse the high blessedness of Him who is immutable, who is always cheerful and happy, who is Hotri, who is the universal Protector, who is Creator of the universe, and who is called Mundin and Kaparddin.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वासुदेव उवाच न गतिः कर्मणां शक्या वेत्तुमीशस्य तत्त्वतः। हिरण्यगर्भप्रमुखा देवाः सेन्द्रा महर्षयः॥
en: Vasudeva said The very gods with Indra, and the Grandfather Brahman numbering among them, and the great Rishis also, cannot understand the course of Mahadeva's deeds truly and full.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: न विदुर्यस्य भवनमादित्याः सूक्ष्मदर्शिनः। स कथं नरमात्रेण शक्यो ज्ञातुं सतां गतिः॥
en: Even he is the end which all righteous people gain. The very Adityas, who are gifted with subtile sight, are unable to see his abode. How then can one who is merely a man succeed in comprehending Him?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तस्याहमसुरघ्नस्य कांश्चिद् भगवतो गुणान्। भवतां कीर्तयिष्यामि व्रतेशाय यथातथम्॥
en: I shall, therefore, truly recount to you some only of the qualities of that illustrious killer of Asuras, who is considered as the Lord of all sacrifices and vows.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु भगवान् गुणांस्तस्य महात्मनः। उपस्पृश्य शुचिर्भूत्वा कथयामास धीमतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said these words, the illustrious Vasudeva began his discourse on the qualities of the great Mahadeva gifted with the highest intelligence, after having purified himself by touching water.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वासुदेव उवाच शुश्रूषध्वं ब्राह्मणेन्द्रास्त्वं च तात युधिष्ठिर। त्वं चापगेय नामानि शृणुष्वेह कपर्दिने॥
en: Vasudeva said Hear, you foremost of Brahmanas, and you Yudhishthira also, O sire, and hear you too, O River's son, the names which are applied to Kaparddin.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यदवाप्तं च मे पूर्वं साम्बहेतोः सुदुष्करम्। यथावद् भगवान् दृष्टो मया पूर्वं समाधिना॥
en: Hear, you, how in days of yore. I gained a sight, so difficult to get, for the sake of Shamva. Verily, in those days was the illustrious god seen by me on account of Yogaabstraction.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शम्बरे निहते पूर्वं रौक्मिणेयेन धीमता। अतीते द्वादशे वर्षे जाम्बवत्यब्रवीद्धि माम्॥
en: After twelve years had passed from the time when Pradyumna, the son of Rukmini, who is gifted with great intelligence, killed the Asura Shamvara in days of yore, my wife Jambavati addressed me.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: प्रद्युम्नचारुदेष्णादीन् रुक्मिण्या वीक्ष्य पुत्रकान्। पुत्रार्थिनी मामुपेत्य वाक्यमाह युधिष्ठिर॥ शूरं बलवतां श्रेष्ठं कान्तरूपमकल्मषम्। आत्मतुल्यं मम सुतं प्रयच्छाच्युत माचिरम्॥
en: Indeed, seeing Pradyumna and Charudeshna and other sons born of Rukmini, Jamvavati, desirous of a son, said these words to me, O Yudhishthira, grant me, O you of undecaying glory, a heroic son, the foremost of powerful men, possessed of the most lovely features, sinless, and like your self. And, O, let there be no delay on your part in granting this prayer of mine!

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: न हि तेऽप्राप्यमस्तीह त्रिषु लोकेषु किंचन। लोकान् सृजेस्त्वमपरानिच्छन् यदुकुलोद्वह॥
en: There is noting in the three worlds which you cannot acquire! O perpetuator of Yadu's race, you can create other worlds if only you wish! Observing a vow for twelve years and purifying yourself, you had worshipped the Lord of all creatures (viz., Mahadeva), and then begotten upon Rukmini the sons that she has got from you, viz., Charudeshna and Sucharu and Charlshravas and Charuvesha and Yashodhana and Charuyashas and Pradyumna and Shambhu.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: त्वया द्वादशवर्षाणि व्रतीभूतेन शुष्यता। आराध्य पशुभर्तारं रुक्मिण्यां जनिताः सुताः॥ चारुदेष्णः सुचारश्च चारुवेशो यशोधरः। चारुश्रवाश्चारुयशाः प्रद्युम्नः शुम्भुरेव च॥ यथा ते जनिताः पुत्रा रुक्मिण्यां चारुविक्रमाः। तथा ममापि तनयं प्रयच्छ मधुसूदन।॥
en: O killer of Madhu, do you grant me a son like those of great prowess whom you have begotten upon Rukmini.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: इत्येवं चोदितो देव्या तामवोचं सुमध्यमाम्। अनुजानीहि मां राज्ञि करिष्ये वचनं तव॥
en: Thus addressed by the princess, I replied to her having slender waist Let me have your permission, O queen! I shall certainly obey your command.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सा च मामब्रवीद् गच्छ शिवाय विजयाय च। ब्रह्मा शिवः काश्यपश्च नद्यो देवा मनोनुगाः॥ क्षेत्रौषध्यो यज्ञवाहाश्छन्दांस्य॒षिगणाध्वराः। समुद्रा दक्षिणास्तोभा ऋक्षाणि पितरो ग्रहाः॥ देवपल्यो देवकन्या देवमातर एव च। मन्वन्तराणि गावश्च चन्द्रमाः सविता हरिः॥ सावित्री ब्रह्मविद्या च ऋतवो वत्सरास्तथा। क्षणा लवा मुहूर्ताश्च निमेषा युगपर्ययाः॥ रक्षन्तु सर्वत्र गतं त्वां यादव सुखाय च। अरिष्टं गच्छ पन्थानमप्रमत्तो भवानघ॥
en: She answered me, saying Go, and acquire success and prosperity! Let Brahmana and Shiva and Kashyapa, the Rivers, those gods who preside over the mind, the soil, all deciduous herbs, those Chahandas who are considered as bearers of the libations poured in Sacrifices, the Rishis, Earth, the Oceans, the sacrificial presents, those syllables which are ultered for completing the cadences of Samans, the Rikshas, the Pitris, the Planets, the wives of the gods, the celestial maidens, the celestial mothers, the great cycles, kine, Chaudramas, Savitri, Agni, Savitri, the knowledge of the Vedas, the seasons, the year, the Kshanas, the Lavas, the Muhurtas, the Nimeshas, and the Yugas in succession, protect you, O Yadava, and keep you in happiness, wherever you may live. Let no danger overtake you on your way, and let no carelessness be thine, O sinless one.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवं कृतस्वस्त्ययनस्तयाऽहं ततोऽभ्यनुज्ञाय नरेन्द्रपुत्रीम्। पितुः समीपं नरसत्तमस्य मातुश्च राज्ञश्च तथाऽऽहकस्य॥ गत्वा समावेद्य यदब्रवीन्मां विद्याधरेन्द्रस्य सुता भृशार्ता। तानभ्यनुज्ञाय तदातिदुःखाद् गदं तथैवातिबलं च रामम्। अथोचतुः प्रीतियुतौ तदानीं तप:समृद्धिर्भवतोऽस्त्वविघ्नम्॥
en: Thus blessed by her, I took her leave, bidding farewell to the daughter of the prince of monkeys. Repairing them to the presence of that foremost of men, viz., my father, of my mother, of the king, and of Ahuka, I informed them of what the daughter of the king of the Vidyadharas, in great misery, had said to me. Bidding them farewell with a sorrowful heart, I then went to Gada and to Rama of great power.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: प्राप्यानुज्ञां गुरुजनादहं तार्क्ष्यमचिन्तयम्। सोऽवहद्धिमवन्तं मां प्राप्य चैनं व्यसर्जयम्॥
en: These two gladly addressed me, saying Let your penances inultiply without any hinderance.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तत्राहमद्भुतान् भावानपश्यं गिरिसत्तमे। क्षेत्रं च तपसां श्रेष्ठं पश्याम्यद्भुतमुत्तमम्॥
en: Having got the perinission of all of them, I thought of Garuda. He forthwith came to me and took me to Himavat. Arrived at Himavat, I sent him away.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दिव्यं वैयाघ्रपद्यस्य उपमन्योर्महात्मनः। पूजितं देवगन्धर्वैाझ्या लक्ष्या समावृतम्॥
en: There, on that foremost of mountains, I saw many wonderful spectacles. I saw an excellent, wonderful, and agreeable hermitage for the practice of penances.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: धव-ककुभ-कदम्ब-नारिकेलैः कुरबक-केतक जम्बु-पाटलाभिः। वट-वरुणक-वत्सनाभ-बिल्वैः सरल-कपित्थ-प्रियाल-साल तालैः॥
en: That charming retreat was the property of the great Upamanyu who was a descendant of Vyaghrapada. That retreat is spoken highly of and respected by the gods and the Gandharvas and seemed to be covered with Vedic beauty.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: बदरी-कुन्द-पुन्नागैरशोकाम्रातिमुक्तकैः। मधूकैः कोविदारैश्च चम्पकैः पनसैस्तथा॥ वन्यैर्बहुविधैर्वक्षैः फलपुष्यप्रदैर्युतम्। पुष्पगुल्मलताकीर्णं कदलीषण्डशोभितम्॥ नानाशकुनिसम्भोज्यैः फलैर्वृक्षरलंकृतम्। यथास्थानविनिक्षिप्तैर्भूषितं भस्मराशिभिः॥
en: It was adorned with Dhavas and Kakubhas and Kaomvas and cocoas with Kuruvakas and Kitakas and amvus and Paalas, with banians and Varunakas and Vatsanabhas and Vilwas, with Saralas and Kapitthas and Piyalas and Shalas and Palmyras, with Vadaris and Ingudis and Punnagas and Ashokas and Amras and Kovidaras and Champakas and Panashas, and with various other trees having fruits and flowers. And that retreat was also decked with the straight steins of the Musa Supienta.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: रुरु-वानर-शार्दूल-सिंह-द्वीपि-समाकुलम्। कुरङ्ग-बर्हिणाकीर्णं मार्जार-भुजगावृतम्। पूगैश्च मृगजातीनां महिष‘निषेवितम्॥
en: Truly, that asylum was adorned with various other sorts of trees and with various kinds of fruits forming the food of various kinds of birds. Heaps of ashes were thrown in proper places all around, which enhanced the beauty of the scene.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सकृत्प्रभिन्नैश्च गजैर्विभूषितं प्रहष्टनानाविधपक्षिसेवितम्। महीरुहाणां च वनैर्विचित्रैः॥
en: It was full of Rurus and apes and tigers and lions and leopards, deer of various species and peacocks and cats and snakes.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नानापुष्परजोमिश्रो गजदानाधिवासितः। दिव्यस्रीगीतबहुलो मारुतोऽभिमुखो ववौ॥
en: Indeed, large numbers of other animals also were seen there, as also buffaloes and bears. Delicious breezes blew, continually carrying the sweet notes of celestial nymphs.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: धारानिनादैविहगप्रणादैः शुभैस्तथा बृंहितैः कुञ्जराणाम्। गीतैस्तथा किन्नराणामुदारैः शुभैः स्वनैः सामगानां च वीर॥ अचिन्त्यं मनसाऽप्यन्यैः सरोभिः समलंकृतम्। विशालैश्चाग्निशरणैर्भूषितं कुसुमावृतैः॥
en: The babblings of mountain rivers and springs, the sweet notes of winged choristers, the gruntings of elephants, the delicious notes of Kinnaras, and the auspicious voice of ascetics singing the Samans, O hero, and various other kinds of music, made that retreat highly charming. The very imagination cannot conceive another hermitage as charming as the one I saw. There were also large houses in that asylum, intended for the preservation of the sacred fire, and covered all over with flowering creepers.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: विभूषितं पुण्यपवित्रतोयया सदा च जुष्टं नृप जलकन्यया। महात्मभिर्वन्हिासमानकल्पैः॥
en: It was bedecked with the river Ganga of clear and sacred water. Indeed the daughter of Jahnu always remained there. It was decked also with many asce:ics who were the foremost of all pious persons, who had high souls, and who resembled fire itself in energy.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वाय्वाहारैरम्बुपैर्जप्यनित्यैः सम्प्रक्षालैर्योगिभिर्ध्याननित्यैः। धूमप्राशैरूष्मपैः क्षीरपैश्च संजुष्टं च ब्राह्मणेन्द्रैः समन्तात्॥
en: Some of those ascetics lived upon air and some upon water. Some were devoted to the silent recitation of sacred Mantras. And some were engaged in purifying their souls by practising the virtues of mercy and the rest. And some amongst them were Yogins devoted to the Yoga-meditation. Some amongst them lived upon smoke only, and some lived upon fire, and some upon milk. Thus was, that retreat adorned with many foremost of twice born persons.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: गोचारिणोऽथाश्मकुट्टा दन्तोलूखलिकास्तथा। मरीचिपाः फेनपाश्च तथैव मृगचारिणः॥
en: And some there were amongst them who had taken thic vow of eating and drinking like kine that is, by giving up the use of the hands at once. And some used only two pieces of stone for husking their grain, and some who used their teeth only for that purpose. And some lived by drinking only the rays of the imoon, and some by drinking only froth. And some were following the vow of living like deer.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अश्वत्थफलभक्षाश्च तथा छुदकशायिनः। चीरचर्माम्बरधरास्तथा वल्कलधारिणः॥
en: And some there were who lived upon the fruits of the Ficus religiosa, and some who used to lie upon water and some dressed themselves in rags and some in animal skins and some in barks of trees.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सुदुःखान् नियमांस्तांस्तान् वहतः सुतपोधनान्। पश्यन् मुनीन् बहुविधान् प्रवेष्टुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Indeed, I saw various ascetics of the foremost order observing these and other painful vows. I wished then to enter that asylum.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सुपूजितं देवगणैर्महात्मभिः शिवादिभिर्भारत पुण्यकर्मभिः। रराज तच्चाश्रममण्डलं सदा दिवीव राजन् शशिमण्डलं यथा॥
en: Verily, that asylum was honoured and adored by the gods and all great beings, by Shiva and others, O Bharata, and by all : creatures of pious deeds. Thus addressed, it stood in all its beauty on the breast of Himavata, like the lunar disc in the sky.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: क्रीडन्ति सर्नकुला मृगैर्व्याघ्राच मित्रवत्। प्रभावाद् दीप्ततपसां संनिकर्षान्महात्मनाम्॥
en: The mongoose sported there with the snake, and the tiger with the deer, like friends, forgetting their natural enmity, on account of the energy of those ascetics of blazing penances and for their being near to those great ones.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तत्राश्रमपदे श्रेष्ठे सर्वभूतमनोरमे। सेविते द्विजशार्दूलैर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः॥ नानानियमविख्यातैर्ऋषिभिः सुमहात्मभिः। प्रविशन्नेव चापश्यं जटाचीरधरं प्रभुम्॥ तेजसा तपसा चैव दीप्यमानं यथाऽनलम्। शिष्यैरनुगतं शान्तं युवानं ब्राह्मणर्षभम्॥
en: In that foremost of hermitages, which was charming to all creatures, inhabited by many foremost of Brahmanas fully conversant with the Vedas and their branches, and by many great Rishis well-known for the difficult vows they practised, I saw, as soon as I entered a powerful Rishi with matted locks on head and dressed in rags, who seemed to shine like fire with his penances and energy. Served by his disciples and possessed of tranquil soul, that foremost of Brahmanas was young to look at.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शिरसा वन्दमानं मामुपमन्युरभाषत॥ स्वागतं पुण्डरीकाक्ष सफलानि तपांसि नः। यः पूज्यः पूजयसि मां द्रष्टव्यो द्रष्टुमिच्छसि॥
en: His name was Upamanyu. He said to me who bowed to him vith my head down: Welcome are you, O you of eyes like lotus petals! Today, by this visit of yours, we see that our penances have fructified. You are worthy of our adoration, but you worship us still. You are worthy of being scen, but you wish to see me.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तमहं प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा मृगपक्षिष्वथाग्निषु। धर्मं च शिष्यवर्गं च समपृच्छमनामयम्॥
en: Joining my hands I made of him the usual enquiries regarding the well-being of the animals and birds who lived in his asylum, of the progress of his righteousness, and of his disciples.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ततो मां भगवानाह साम्ना परमवल्गुना। लप्स्यसे तनयं कृष्ण आत्मतुल्यमसंशयम्॥
en: The illustrious Upamanyu then addressed me in words which were highly sweet and delightfulYou shall, O Krishna, obtain, forsooth, a son like yourself.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तपः सुमहदास्थाय तोषयेशानमीश्वरम्। इह देवः सपत्नीकः समाक्रीडत्यधोक्षज॥
en: Practising severe penances, do you please Ishana, the Lord of all creatures. That divine Master called also Adhokshaja, sports here with his wife by his side.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: इहैनं दैवतश्रेष्ठं देवाः सर्षिगणाः पुरा। तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण सत्येन च दमेन च॥ तोषयित्वा शुभान कामान् प्राप्तवन्तो जनार्दन। तेजसां तपसां चैव निधिः स भगवानिह॥
en: O Janarddana, it was here that the gods with ali the Rishis, in days of yore, pleased that foremost of gods by their penances and celibacy and Truth and selfcontrol, and succeeded in realizing many high hopes. That illustrious god is verily the inexhaustible source of all energies and penances.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शुभाशुभान्वितान् भगवान् विसृजन संक्षिपन्नापि। आस्ते देव्या सदाचिन्त्यो यं प्रार्थयसि शत्रुहन्॥
en: Coming into existence and withdrawing once more to himself all things fraught with good and evil, that inconceivable God whom you seek, O destroyer of enemies, lives here with his consort.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: हिरण्यकशिपुर्योऽभूद् दानवो मेरुकम्पनः। तेन सर्वामरैश्वर्यं शर्वात् प्राप्तं समार्बुदम्॥
en: He who was born as the Danava named Hiranyakashipu, whose strength was so great that he could shake the very mountains of Meru, succeeded in getting from Mahadeva the power belonging to all the gods and enjoyed it for ten millions of years.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तस्यैव पुत्रप्रवरो मन्दारो नाम विश्रुतः। महादेववराच्छकं वर्षार्बुदमयोधयत्॥
en: He who was the foremost of all his sons, and who was known by the name of Mandara, succeeded, through the boon he had got from Mahadeva, in fighting Shakra for a million of years.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: विष्णोश्चक्रं च तद् घोरं वज्रमाखण्डलस्य च। शीर्णं पुराऽभवत् तात ग्रहस्याङ्गेषु केशव॥
en: The terrible discus of Vishnu and the thunderbolt of Indra were both unable to make the least impression, O Keshava, in days of yore, upon the body of that great source of universal misery.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यत् तद् भगवता पूर्वं दत्तं चक्रं तवानघ। जलान्तरचरं हत्वा दैत्यं च बलगार्वितम्॥
en: The discus which you carry, O sinless one, was given to you by Mahadeva, after he had killed a Daitya who, proud of his strength, used to live within the waters.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: उत्पादितं वृषाङ्केन दीप्तज्वलनसंनिभम्। दत्तं भगवता तुभ्यं दुर्धर्षं तेजसाद्भुतम्॥
en: That discus, effulgent as fire, was created by the great god having the bull for his emblem. Wonderful and irresistible in energy, it was given to you by that illustrious god.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: न शक्यं द्रष्टुमन्येन वर्जयित्वा पिनाकिनम्। सुदर्शनं भवत्येवं भवेनोक्तं तदा तु तत्॥
en: On account of its blazing energy it was incapable of being looked at by and person except the holder of Pinaka. It was, therefore, that Bhava named it Sudarshanam.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सुदर्शनं तदा तस्य लोके नाम प्रतिष्ठितम्। तज्जीर्णमभवत् तात ग्रहस्यालेषु केशव॥
en: From that time it passed by the name of Sudarshanam in all the worlds. Even that weapon, O Keshava, failed to make the least impression on the body of Hiranyakashipu's son Mandara, who appeared like an evil planet in the three worlds.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ग्रहस्यातिबलस्याङ्गे वरदत्तस्य धीमतः। न शस्राणि वहन्त्यङ्गे चक्रवज्रशतान्यपि॥
en: Hundreds of Chakras like you and thunderbolts like that of Shakra, could not inflict a scratch on the body of that evil planet gifted with great might, who had acquired a boon from Mahadeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अर्धमानाश्च विबुधा ग्रहेण सुबलीयसा। शिवदत्तवरान् जघ्नुरसुरेन्द्रान् सुरा भृशम्॥
en: Afflicted by the mighty Mandara, the gods, fought hard against him and his companions, all of whom had got boons from Mahadeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तुष्टो विद्युत्प्रभस्यापि त्रिलोकेश्वरतां ददौ। शतं वर्षसहस्राणां सर्वलोकेश्वरोऽभवत्॥
en: Pleased with another Danava named Vidyutprabha, Mahadeva granted to him the sovereignty of the three worlds. That Dana remained the king of the three worlds for a hundred thousand years.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: मनसैवानुचरो नित्यं भवितासीति चाब्रवीत्। तथा पुत्रसहस्राणामयुतं च ददौ प्रभुः॥ कुशद्वीपं च स ददौ राज्येन भगवानजः।
en: And Mahadeva said to him You will become one of my attendants. Indeed, the powerful Lord further conferred upon him the boon of a hundred millions of children. The Unborn Lord of all creatures further gave the Danava the region known as Kushadvipa for his kingdom.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तथा शतमुखो नाम धात्रा सृष्टो महासुरः॥ येन वर्षशतं साग्रमात्ममांसैर्हतोऽनलः।
en: Another great Asura, named Shatamukha, was created by Brahman. For a hundred years he poured on the sacrificial fire the flesh of his own body.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तं प्राह भगवांस्तुष्टः किं करोमीति शंकरः॥ तं वै शतमुखः प्राह योगो भवतु मेऽद्भुतः।
en: Pleased with such penances, Shankara said to him What can I do for you Shatamukha replied, saying you the most wonderful, let me have the power of creating new creatures and animals.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: बलं च दैवतश्रेष्ठ शाश्वतं सम्प्रयच्छ मे॥ तथेति भगवानाह तस्य तद् वचनं प्रभुः।
en: Give also to me, O foremost of all gods, everlasting power. Thus addressed by him, the powerful lord said to him So be it.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: स्वायम्भुवः क्रतुश्चापि पुत्रार्थमभवत् पुरा॥ आविश्य योगेनात्मानं त्रीणि वर्षशतान्यपि।
en: Concentrating his mind in Yoga, the Selfcreate Brahman, in days of yore, made a sacrifice for three hundred years, with the object of getting children.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: योगेश्वरं देवगीतं वेस्थ कृष्ण न संशयः। तस्य चौपददौ पुत्रान् सहस्रं क्रतुसम्मितान्॥
en: Mahadeva granted him a thousand sons having qualifications proportionate to the merits of the sacrifice. Forsooth, you know, O Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, him who is, who is sung by the gods.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: आराध्य स महादेवं प्राप्तवानतुलं यशः। याज्ञवल्क्य इति ख्यात ऋषिः परमधार्मिकः॥
en: The Rishi known by the name of Yajnavalkya is exceedingly virtuous. By worshipping Mahadeva he has gained great fame.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सोऽपि शङ्करमाराध्य प्राप्तवानतुलं यशः। वेदव्यासश्च योगात्मा पराशरसुतो मुनिः॥
en: The great ascetic who is Parashara's son, viz., Vyasa bent on Yoga, has become famous by worshipping Shankara.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तैः क्रुद्धैर्भगवान् रुद्रस्तपसा तोषितो ह्यभूत्। बालखिल्या मघवता ह्यवज्ञाताः पुरा किल॥
en: The Valakhilyas were on a former occasion dishonoured by Maghavat. Filled with anger at this, they pleased the illustrious Rudra.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सुपर्णं सोमहर्तारं तपसोत्पादयिष्यथा तांश्चापि दैवतश्रेष्ठः प्राह प्रीतो जगत्पतिः॥
en: That lord of the universe, that foremost one of all the gods, thus pleased by the Valakhilyas, said to them, You shall succeed by your penances in creating a bird which will rob Indra of the Ambrosia.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: महादेवस्य रोषाच्च आपो नष्टाः पुराभवन्॥ ताश्च सप्तकपालेन देवैरन्याः प्रवर्तिताः। तत: पानीयमभवत् प्रसन्ने व्यम्बके भुवि॥
en: All the waters disappeared through the anger of Mahadeva on a former occasion. The gods pleased him by celebrating a sacrifice called Saplakapala, and caused, through his lavour, other waters to fiow into the worlds. Verily, when the threeeyed god, became pleased, water once more appeared in the World.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अनेर्भार्याऽपि भर्तारं संत्यज्य ब्रह्मवादिनी। नाहं तस्य मुनेर्भूयो वशगा स्यां कथंचन॥
en: The wite of Atri, who was wellread in the Vedas, forsook her husband in anger and said I shall 110 longer live under that ascetic.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: इत्युक्त्वा सा महादेवमगच्छच्छरणं किला निराहारा भयादत्रेस्रीणि वर्षशतान्यपि॥
en: Having said these words, she sought the protection of Mahadeva. Through fear of her husband Atri, she passed three hundred years, abstaining from all food.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अशेत मुसलेष्वेव प्रसादार्थे भवस्य सा। तामब्रवीद्धसन् देवो भविता वै सुतस्तव॥
en: And all this time she slept on wooden clubs for picasing Bhava, The great god then appeared before her and then smilingly addressed her, saying You will have a son.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: विना भर्चा च रुद्रेण भविष्यति न संशयः। वंशे तथैव नाम्ना तु ख्याति यास्यति चेप्सिताम्॥ विकर्णश्च महादेवं तथा भक्तसुखावहम्। प्रसाद्य भगवान् सिद्धि प्राप्तवान् मधुसूदन॥
en: And you will have that son without the help of a husband, simply through the favour of Rudra. Forsooth, that son, born in the family of his father, shall become known for his merit, and assume a name after you. The illustrious Vikarna also, destroyer of Madhu, full of devotion 10 Mahadeva, pleased him with severe penances and got high and happy success.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शाकल्यः संशितात्मा वै नववर्षशतान्यपि। आराधयामास भवं मनोयज्ञेन केशव॥
en: Shakalya, too, of controlled soul worshipped Bhava in a mental sacrifice that he celebrated for nine hundred years, O Keshava.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तं चाह भगवांस्तुष्टो ग्रन्थकारो भविष्यसि। वत्साक्षया च ते कीर्तिपैलोक्ये वै भविष्यति॥
en: Pleased with him, the illustrious god said to him You will become a great author. O son, your fame shall be eternal in the three worlds.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: रुद्र उवाच अक्षयं च कुलं तेऽस्तु महर्षिभिरलंकृतम्। भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठः सूत्रकर्ता सुतस्तव॥
en: The illustrious Rudra said Your family also shall never come to an end and shall be adomed by many great Rishis born in it! Your son will become the foremost of Brahmanas and will make thc Sutras of your work.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सावर्णिश्चापि विख्यात ऋषिरासीत् कृते युगे। इह तेन तपस्तप्तं षष्टिवर्षशतान्यथ॥
en: There was a celebrated Rishi named Savarni in the golden age. Here in this hermitage, he practised sevcrc pchances for six thousand years.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तस्य तुष्टो महादेवो जगौ देवगुरुर्गुरुः । तमाह भगवान् रुद्रः साक्षात् तुष्टोऽस्मि तेऽनघ। ग्रन्थकृल्लोकविख्यातो भविताऽस्यजरामरः॥ गीतेन वादितव्येन नित्यं मामनुयास्यसि।
en: Pleased with him, Mahadeva, that preceptor I am pleased with you, O sinless one. Without being subject to decrepitude or death, you will become an author celebrated through all the worlds. No one shall cqual you in energy and penances. You will always serve me with your songs and instrumental music.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शक्रेण तु पुरा देवो वाराणस्यां जनार्दन। आराधितोऽभूद् भक्तेन दिग्वासा भस्मगुण्ठितः॥१०५
en: In days of yore, Shakra also, in Varanasi, filled with devotion, O Janarddana, worshipped Mahadeva who has space, alone for his dress and who is smeared with ashes as an agreeable unguent.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: आराध्य स महादेवं देवराजमवाप्तवान्। नारदेन तु भक्त्याऽसौ भव आराधित: पुरा॥
en: Having worshipped Mahadeva thus, he acquired the sovereignty of the celestials. Narada also, in days of yore, worshipped the great Bhava with devotion of heart.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: प्रबोधितो महातेजास्तं चापि शृणु विस्तरम्। तेजसा तपसा कीर्त्या त्वत्समो न भविष्यति॥ साक्षात् पशुपतिस्तात तच्चापि शृणु माधव।
en: Hear also in full for what object, O you of great power, I invoked with controlled senses and mind that illustrious god gified with Supreme energy. Hear also, O Madhava, how formerly I succeeded in secing that god of gods, that Lord of all creatures, O lord.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तत्सर्वं निखिलेनाद्य कथयिष्यामि तेऽनघ। मयाऽपि च यथा दृष्टो देवदेवः पुरा विभो॥
en: I shall, O sinless one, tell you fully all that I succeeded in obtaining from that god of gods, viz., Maheshvara.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: व्याघ्रपाद इति ख्यातो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः। यदर्थं च मया देवः प्रयतेन तथा विभो॥ प्रबोधितो महातेजास्तं चापि शृणु विस्तरम्। यदवाप्तं च मे पूर्वं देवदेवान्महेश्वरात्॥
en: Formerly in the golden age, O son, there was a Rishi of great fame, named Vyaghrapada. O lord, listion from me in prolics all that by which I pacified Mahadeva, the great spendorous god with apurpose. O sinles, whatever I got from Maheshvara, the god of the gods, during long long past; I will tell you all that in detail. He was celebrated for his knowledge and mastery over the Vedas and their auxiliaries.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तस्याहमभवं पुत्रो धौम्यश्चापि ममानुजः॥ कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य धौम्येन सह माधव। आगच्छमाश्रमं क्रीडन् मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्॥
en: I was born as the son of that Rishi and Dhaumya was born as my younger brother. On a certain occasion, O Madhava, accompanied by Dhaumya, I arrived at the hermitage of certain Rishi of purified souls.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तत्रापि च मया दृष्टा दुह्यमाना पयस्विनी। लक्षितं च मया क्षीरं स्वादुतो ह्यमृतोपमम्॥
en: There I saw a cow that was being milked. And I saw the milk and it appeared to me to resemble nectar itself in taste.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ततोऽहमब्रुवं बाल्याज्जननीमात्मनस्तथा। क्षीरोदनसमायुक्तं भोजनं हि प्रयच्छ मे॥ नेदं क्षीरोदनं मातर्यत् त्वं मे दत्तवत्यसि।
en: I then came home, and actuated by childishness, I addressed my mother and said Give me some food prepared with milk.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अभावाच्चैव दुग्धस्य दुःखिता जननी तदा। ततः पिष्टं समालोड्य तोयेन सह माधव॥ आवयोः क्षीरमित्येव पानार्थं समुपानयत्। अथ गव्यं पयस्तात कदाचित् प्राशितं मया॥ पित्राहं यज्ञकाले हि नीतो ज्ञातिकुलं महत्।
en: There was no milk in the house, and accordingly my mother, was much sorry at my asking for it. My mother took a piece of cake and boiled it in water, O Madhava. The water became whitened and my mother placed it before us, saying that it was milk and asked us to drink it. I had before that drunk milk on one occasion, for my father had, at the time of a sacrifice, taken me to the house of some of our great kinsmen.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तत्र साक्षरते देवी दिव्या गौः सुरनन्दिनी॥ तस्याहं तत् पयः पीत्वा रसेन ह्यमृतोपमम्। ज्ञात्वा क्षीरगुणांश्चैव उपलभ्य हि सम्भवम्॥ स च पिष्टरसस्तात न मे प्रीतिमुपावहत्।
en: A celestial cow, who delights the gods, was being milked on that occasion. Drinking her milk that resembled nectar in taste, I knew the virtues of milk. I, therefore, at once understood the substance that my mother offered me, for milk. Verily, the taste of that cake, O son, did not give me any pleasure whatever.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ततोऽहमब्रुवं बाल्याज्जननीमात्मनस्तथा। नेदं क्षीरोदनं मातर्यत् त्वं मे दत्तवत्यसि।
en: Moved by childishness I then addressed my mother, saying O mother, which you have given me is not any preparation of milk.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ततो मामब्रवीन्माता दुःखशोकसमन्विता॥ पुत्रस्नेहात् परिष्वज्य मूर्ध्नि चाघ्राय माधव।
en: Filled with grief and sorrow at this, and embracing me from affection and smelling my head, O Madhava, she said to me.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: कुतः क्षीरोदनं वत्स मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्॥ वने निवसतां नित्यं कन्दमूलफलाशिनाम्।
en: Whence, O child, can ascetics of purified souls get food prepared with milk? Such men always live in the forest and live upon bulbs and roots and fruits.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: कुतः क्षीरं वनस्थानां मुनीनां गिरिवासिनाम्। आस्थितानां नदीं दिव्यां वालखिल्यैर्निषेविताम्॥१२३
en: Whence shall we, who live by the banks of rivers which are the resort of the Valakhilyas, we, who have mountains and forests for our home whence, indeed, O child, shall we get milk?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: पावनानां वनाशानां वनाश्रमनिवासिनाम्॥ ग्राम्याहारनिवृत्तानामारण्यफलभोजिनाम्।
en: We, dear child, live on air and on water. We live in asylums in the midst of forests and woods. We habitually abstain from all sorts of food that are taken by person living in villages and towns. We are accustomed to only such food as are supplied by the forest products.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नास्ति पुत्र पयोऽरण्ये सुरभीगोत्रवर्जिते॥ नदीगह्वरशैलेषु तीर्थेषु विविधेषु च। तपसा जप्यनित्यानां शिवो नः परमा गतिः॥ अप्रसाद्य विरूपाक्षं वरदं स्थाणुमव्ययम्। कुतः क्षीरोदनं वत्स सुखानि वसनानि च॥ तं प्रपद्य सदा वत्स सर्वभावेन शङ्करम्।
en: There cannot be any milk, O child, in the forest where there are no offspring of Surabhi. Living on the banks of rivers, or in caves or on mountainbreasts, or in shrines and other places of the kind, we pass our time in the practice of penances and the recitation of sacred Mantras, Shiva being our highest refuge. Without pleasing the boongiving, Sthanu of undecaying glory him, who has three eyes whence, O child, can one get food prepared with milk and good dresses and other objects of enjoyment in the world? Do you devote yourself wholemindedly, O dear son, to Shankara.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तत्प्रसादाच्च कामेभ्यः फलं प्राप्स्यसि पुत्रक॥ जनन्यास्तद् वचः श्रुत्वा तदाप्रभृति शत्रुहन्। प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतो भूत्वा इदमम्बामचोदयम्॥ कोऽयमम्ब महादेवः स कथं च प्रसीदति।
en: Through his favour, O child, you are sure to obtain all such objects of wishes. Hearing those words of my mother, O destroyer of enemies, that day, I joined my hands in respect and bowing to her, said O mother, who is this Mahadeva? How can one please him?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: कुत्र वा वसते देवो द्रष्टव्यो वा कथंचन॥ तुष्यते वा कथं शो रूपं तस्य च कीदृशम्। कथं ज्ञेयः प्रसन्नो वा दर्शयेज्जननि मम॥
en: Where does that god live? How may he be seen? With what does he become pleased? What also is the form of Sharva? How may one succeed in knowing him? If pleased, will he, O mother, appear before me?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवमुक्ता तदा कृष्ण माता मे सुतवत्सला। मूर्धन्याघ्राय गोविन्द सबाष्पाकुललोचना॥
en: After I had said these words, O Krishna, to my mother, she, filled with parental affection, smelt my head, O Govinda, her eyes bathed in tears.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: प्रमार्जन्ती च गात्राणि मम वै मधुसूदन। दैन्यमालम्ब्य जननी इदमाह सुरोत्तम॥
en: Gently patting my body, o destroyer of Madhu, my mother, adopting a tone of great humility, addressed me in the following words, O best of the gods.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अम्बोवाच दुर्विज्ञेयो महादेवो दुराधारो दुरन्तकः। दुराबाधश्च दुर्ब्रह्यो दुर्दश्यो ह्यकृतात्मभिः॥
en: My mother said It is difficult for persons of impure souls to know Mahadeva. These men are incapable of bearing him in their hearts or understanding him at all. They cannot retain him in their minds. They cannot seize him nor can they see him.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यस्य रूपाण्यनेकानि प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः। स्थानानि च विचित्राणि प्रसादाश्चाप्यनेकशः॥
en: Wise men say that his forms are manifold. Many are the places in which he lives. Many are the forms of his Grace.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: को हि तत्त्वेन तद् वेद ईशस्य चरितं शुभम्। कृतवान् यानि रूपाणि देवदेवः पुरा किल।
en: Who is there who can understand in full all the excellent deeds, of Isha, or of all the forms that he has assumed in days of yore?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: क्रीडते च तथा शर्वः प्रसीदति यथा च वै॥ हृदिस्थः सर्वभूतानां विश्वरूपो महेश्वरः।
en: Who can describe how Sharva sports and how he becomes pleased? Maheshvara of universal form lives in the hearts of all Creatures.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: भक्तानामनुकम्पार्थं दर्शनं च यथाश्रुतम्॥ मुनीनां ब्रुवतां दिव्यमीशानचरितं शुभम्।
en: While ascetics discoursed on the auspicious and excellent deeds of Ishana, I have heard from then how, moved by mercy towards his worshippers, he grants them a sight of his body.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: कृतवान् यानि रूपाणि कथितानि दिवौकसैः॥ अनुग्रहार्थं विप्राणां शृणु वत्स समासतः। तानि ते कीर्तयिष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: For showing a favour to the Brahmanas, the dwellers of heaven have recited for their information the various forins which were assumed by Mahadeva in days of yore. You have asked me about these. I shall recite them to you, O) son.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अम्बोवाच ब्रह्मविष्णुसुरेन्द्राणां रुद्रादित्याश्विनामपि। विश्वेषामपि देवानां वपुर्धारयते भवः॥
en: My mother said Bhava assumes the forins of Brahman and Vishnu and the king of the gods: of the Rudras, the Adityas, and the Ashvins; and of those gods called Vishvedevas.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नराणां देवनारीणां तथा प्रेतपिशाचयोः। किरातशबराणां च जलजानामनेकश:॥
en: He assumes the forins also of men and women, of Pretas and Pishachas, of Kiratas and Shabaras, and of all aquatic animal. That illustrious god assumes the forms of also those Shabaras who live in the woods and forests.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: करोति भगवान् रूपमाटव्यशबराण्यपि। कूर्मो मत्स्यस्तथा शङ्खः प्रवालाकुरभूषणः॥
en: He assumes the forms of tortoises and fishes and conchs. He assumes the form of those corals which are used as ornaments by men.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यक्षराक्षससाणां दैत्यदानवयोरपि। वपुर्धारयते देवो भूयश्च विलवासिनाम्॥
en: He assumes the forms of also Yakshas and Rakshasas and Snakes, of Daityas and Danavas. The illustrious god assumes the forms of all creatures too which live in holes.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: व्याघ्रसिंहमृगाणां च तरक्ष्वृक्षपतत्रिणाम्। उलूकश्वशृगालानां रूपाणि कुरुतेऽपि च॥
en: He assumes the forms of tigers and lions and deer, of wolves and bears and birds, of owls and of jackals as well.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: हंसकाकमयूराणां कृकलासकसारसाम्। रूपाणि च बलाकानां गृध्रचक्राङ्गयोरपि॥
en: He assumes the forms of swans and crows and peacocks, of chameleons and lizards and storks. He assumes the forms of cranes and vultures and Chakravakas.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: करोति वा स रूपाणि धारयत्यपि पर्वतम्। गोरूपं च महादेवो हस्त्यश्वोष्ट्रखराकृतिः॥
en: He assumes the forms of Chasas and of mountains also. O son, Mahadeva assumes the forms of kine and elephants and horses and camels and asses.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: छागशार्दूलरूपश्च अनेकमृगरूपधृक्। अण्डजानां च दिव्यानां वपुर्धारयते भवः॥
en: He assumes the forms of also goats and pards and various other animals. Bhava assumes the forins of various kinds of birds of beautiful plumage.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दण्डी छत्री च कुण्डी च द्विजानां धारणस्तथा। पण्मुखो वै बहुमुखस्त्रिनेत्रो बहुशीर्षकः॥
en: It is Mahadeva who assumes the form of the Sanyasin bearing the Darda (emblem of mendicancy), and also of the king with the Chhatra and the Brahman with the calabash. He sometimes becomes six faced and sometimes becomes multifaced. He sometimes assumes forins having three eyes and forms having many heads.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अनेककटिपादश्च अनेकोदरवक्त्रधृक्। अनेकपाणिपार्श्वश्च अनेकगणसंवृतः॥
en: And he sometimes assumes forms having many millions of legs and forms having numberless stomachs and faces, and forms gified Hili numberless arms and numberless sides. Ile sometimes appears surrounded by numberless spirits and ghosts.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ऋपिगन्धर्वरूपश्च सिद्धचारणरूपधृक्। भस्मपाण्डुरगात्रश्च चन्द्रार्धकृतभूषणः॥
en: He assumes the forms of Rishis and (iandharvas, and of Siddhas and Charanas. He assumes a form wlich is rendered whilc with the ashes he smears on it and adorned with a hall-moon on the forchvad.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अनेकरावसंघुष्टश्चानेकस्तुतिसंस्कृतः। सर्वभूतान्तक: सर्वः सर्वलोकप्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: Adored with various hymns uttered with Various kinds of voice and adored with various Mantras fraught with encomiums, he, who is Sometimes called Sharva. is the Destroyer of all creatures in the universe, and it is upon hiin, again, that all creatures rest as common basis.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सर्वलोकान्तरात्मा च सर्वगः सर्ववाद्यपि। सर्वत्र भगवान् ज्ञेयो हृदिस्थः सर्वदेहिनाम्॥
en: Mahadeva is the soul of all crcatures. He pervades all things. He is the speaker of all subjects. He lives everywhcre and should be known as living in the hearts of all creatures in the universe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यो हि यं कामयंत् कामं यस्मिन्नर्थेऽळते पुनः। तत् सर्वं वेत्ति देवेशस्तं प्रपद्य यदीच्छसि॥
en: on their He knows the desire of every worshipper of his. He becomes acquainted with the object with which one pays hiin adorations. Do you, then, seek the protection of that king of the gods.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नन्दते कुप्यते चापि तथा हुंकारयत्यपि। चक्री शूली गदापाणिर्मुसली खङ्गपट्टिशी॥
en: He sometimes rejoices, and sometimes becomes irate, and sometimes litters the syllable Hun with a very loud noise. He sometimes arms himself with the discus, sometimes with the trident, sometimes with the mace, sometimes with the heavy mullets, sometimes with the scimitar, and sometimes with the battle-axe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: भूधरो नागमौजी च नागकुण्डलकुण्डली। नागयज्ञोपवीती च नागचर्मोत्तरच्छदः॥
en: He assumes the form of Shesha who keeps up the world on his head. He has snakes for his belt, and his cars are decked with car rings made of snakes. Snakes forin also the sacred thread he wears. An clephant skin is his upper garinent.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: हसते गायते चैव नृत्यते च मनोहरम्। वादयत्यपि वाद्यानि विचित्राणि गणैर्युतः॥
en: He sometimes laughs and sometimes sings and sometimes dances most beautifully. Surrounded by numberless spirits and ghosts, he sometimes plays on musical instruments. Various are the instruments upon which he plays, and sweet the sounds they yield.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वल्गते जृम्भते चैव रुदते रोदयत्यपि। उन्मत्तमत्तरूपं च भाषते चापि सुस्वरः॥
en: He sometimes wanders, sometimes yawns, sometimes cries, and sometimes causes others to cry. He sometimes assumes the guise of a mad man, and sometimes of a drunkard, and he sometimes utters sweet words.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अतीत हसते रौद्रस्रासयन् नयनैर्जनम्। जागर्ति चैव स्वपिति जृम्भते च यथासुखम्॥
en: Endued with dreadful fierceness, he sometimes laughs loudly, frightening all creatures with his eyes. He sometimes sleeps and sometimes remains awake, and sometimes yawns as he pleases.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: जपते जप्यते चैव तपते तप्यते पुनः। ददाति प्रतिगृह्णाति युञ्जते ध्यायतेऽपि च॥
en: He sometimes recites sacred Mantras and sometimes becomes the god of those Mantras which are recited. He sometimes practises penances and sometimes becomes the god for whose adoration those penances are practised. He sometimes make gifts and sometimes receives those gifts; sometimes disposes himself in Yoga and sometimes becomes the object of the Yoga of others.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वेदीमध्ये तथा यूपे गोष्ठमध्ये हुताशने। दृश्यते दृश्यते चापि बालो वृद्धो युवा तथा॥
en: He may be seen on the sacrificial platform or in the sacrificial stake; in the midst of the cowpen or in the fire. He may not again be seen there. He may be seen as a boy or as an old man.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: क्रीडते ऋषिकन्याभिर्ऋषिपत्नीभिरेव च। ऊर्ध्वकेशो महाशेफो नग्ना विकृतलोचनः॥
en: He sports with the daughters and the wives of the Rishis. His hair is long and erect. He is perfectly nude for he has the horizon for his dress. He has terrible eyes.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: गौरः श्यामस्तथा कृष्णः पाण्डुरो धूमलोहितः। विकृताक्षो विशालाक्षो दिग्वासाः सर्ववासकः॥१६२
en: He is fair, he is darkish, he is dark, he is pale, he is of the colour of smoke, and he is red. He has eyes large and terrible. He has empty space for his covering and he covers all things.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अरूपस्याद्यरूपस्य अतिरूपाद्यरूपिणः। अनाद्यन्तमजस्यान्तं वेत्स्यते कोऽस्य तत्त्वतः॥
en: Who is there that can truly understand the limits of Mahadeva who is formless, who is made up of illusion, who is of the form of all actions in the universe, who assumes the form of Hiranyagharbha, and who is without beginning and end, and birth.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: हृदि प्राणो जनो जीवो योगात्मा योगसंज्ञितः। ध्यानं तत्परमात्मा च भावग्राह्यो महेश्वरः॥
en: He lives in the heart (of every creature). He is the vital air, he is the mind, and he is the individual soul. He is the soul of Yoga, and he is called Yoga. He is the Yoga meditation into which Yogins enter. He is the Supreme Soul. Indeed, Maheshvara is capable of being apprehended not by the senses but through only the Soul seizing his existence.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वादको गायनश्चैव सहस्रशतलोचनः। एकवक्त्रो द्विवक्त्रश्च त्रिवक्त्रोऽनेकवक्त्रकः॥
en: Hearing those words of my mother, O destroyer of enemies, from that day my devotion was directed to Mahadeva, having nothing clse for its object.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तद्भक्तस्तद्गतो नित्यं तन्निष्ठस्तत्परायणः। भज पुत्र महादेवं ततः प्राप्स्यसि चेप्सितम्॥
en: He plays on various musical instruments. He is a vocalist. He has a hundred thousand eyes. He has one mouth, he has two mouths, he has three mouths, and he has many mouths.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: जनन्यास्तद् वचः श्रुत्वा तदाप्रभृति शत्रुहन्। मम भक्तिर्महादेवे नैष्ठिकी समपद्यत॥
en: Devoting yourself to him, fixing your heart upon him, depending upon him, and accepting him as your one refuge, do you, O son, worship Mahadeva and then all your wishes will bear fruits!

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ततोऽहं तप आस्थाय तोषयामास शङ्करम्। एकं वर्षसहस्रं तु वामाङ्गुष्ठाग्रविष्ठितः॥
en: I, then, began the practice of the austerest penances for pleasing Shankara. For one thousand years I stood on my left toe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एकं वर्षशतं चैव फलाहारस्ततोऽभवम्। द्वितीयं शीर्णपर्णाशी तृतीयं चाम्बुभोजनः॥
en: After that I passed one thousand years, living only upon fruits. The next one thousand years I passed, living upon the fallen leaves of trees. The next thousand years I passed, living upon water only.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शतानि सप्त चैवाहं वायुभक्षस्तदाभवम्। एक वर्षसहस्रं तु दिव्यमाराधितो मया॥
en: After that I passed seven hundred ycars, living on air only. In this way I worshipped Mahadeva for a full thousand divine years.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ततस्तुष्टो महादेवः सर्वलोकेश्वरः प्रभुः। एकभक्त इति ज्ञात्वा जिज्ञासां कुरुते तदा॥ शक्ररूपं स कृत्वा तु सर्वैर्देवगणैर्वृतः। सहस्राक्षस्तदा भूत्वा वज्रपाणिर्महायशाः॥
en: After this, the powerful Mahadeva the Lord of all the universe became propitiated with me. Desirous of determining whether I was solely devoted to him only, he appeared before me in the form of Shakra surrounded by all the gods. As the celebrated Shakra, he had a thousand eyes on his body and was armed with the thunderbolt.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सुधावदातं रक्ताक्षं स्तब्धकर्ण मदोत्कटम्। आवेष्टितकरं घोरं चतुर्दष्ट्रं महागजम्॥ समास्थितः स भगवान् दीप्यमानः स्वतेजसा। आजगाम किरीटी तु हारकेयूरभूषितः॥
en: And he rode on an elephant which was entirely white, with eyes red, ears folded, the temporal juice trickling down his cheeks, with trunk contracted, dreadful to look at and having four tusks. Indeed riding on such an elephant, the illustrious king of the gods seemed to shine with his energy. With a beautiful crown on his head and adorned with garlands round his neck and bracelets round his arms, he came where I was.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि। सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोभिश्च दिव्यगन्धर्वनादितैः॥
en: A white umbrella was held over his head. And he was served by many Apsaras, and many Gandharvas sang his praise.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ततो मामाह देवेन्द्रस्तुष्टस्तेऽहं द्विजोत्तम। वरं वृणीष्व मत्तस्त्वं यत् ते मनसि वर्तते॥
en: Addressing me he said, ( foremost of twice borns, I have been pleased with you. Beg of me whatever boon you wish.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शक्रस्य तु वचः श्रुत्वा नाहं प्रीतमनाऽभवम्। अब्रुवंश्च तदा हृष्टो देवराजमिदं वचः॥ नाहं त्वत्तो वरं काक्षे नान्यस्मादपि दैवतात्। महादेवादृते सौम्य सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Hearing these words of Shakra I was not gladdened. O Krishna, I answered the king of the gods in these words, I do not wish any boon from you, or from any other god. O amiable deity, I tell you truly that it is Mahadeva only from whom I may ask for boons.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सत्यं सत्यं हि नः शक्र वाक्यमेतत् सुनिश्चितम्। न यन्महेश्वरं मुक्त्वा कथाऽन्या मम रोचते॥
en: True it is, O Shakra, true are those words that I say to you. No other words are at all agreeable to me except those about Maheshvara.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: पशुपतिवचनाद् भवामि सद्यः कृमिरथवा तरुरप्यनेकशाखः। अपशुपतिवरप्रसादजा मे त्रिभुवनराज्यविभूतिरप्यनिष्टा॥
en: Commanded by that Lord of all creatures, I am ready to become a worm or a tree with many branches. If not acquired through the favour of Mahadeva's boons I would not accept the very sovereignty of the three worlds.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: जन्म श्वपाकमध्येऽपि मेऽस्तु हरचरणवन्दनरतस्य। मा वानीश्वरभक्तो भवानि भवनेऽपि शक्रस्य॥
en: I may be born among the very Shvapakas but I will still be devoted to the feet of Hara! Without, again, being devoted to that Lord of all creatures, I would not like to be born in the palace of Indra himself.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वाय्वम्बुभुजोऽपि सतो नरस्य दुःखक्षयः कुतस्तस्य। भवति हि सुरासुरगुरौ यस्य न विश्वेश्वरे भक्तिः॥
en: If a person has no devotion to that Lord of the universe that Master of the gods and the Asuras his misery will not terminate even if from want of food he has to live upon only air and water.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अलमन्याभिस्तेषां कथाभिरप्यन्यधर्मयुक्ताभिः। येषां न क्षणमपि रुचितो हरचरणस्मरणविच्छेदः।
en: Those persons who do not like to live even a moment without thinking of Mahadeva's feet, have no necessity of other subjects fraught with other kinds of morality and righteousness,

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: हरचरणनिरतमतिना भवितव्यमनार्जवं युगं प्राप्य। संसारभयं न भवति हरभक्तिरसायनं पीत्वा॥
en: When the unrighteous or sinful cycle comes, one should never pass a moment without devoting his heart upon Mahadeva. One, who has drunk the ambrosia of the devotion to Hara, becomes freed from the fear of the world.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दिवसं दिवसाधु वा मुहूर्तं वा क्षणं लवम्। न ह्यलब्धप्रसादस्य भक्तिर्भवति शङ्करे॥
en: One, who has not acquired the favour of Mahadeva, can never succeed to devote himself to Mahadeva for a single day or for half a day or for a moment or for a Kshana or for a Lava.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अपि कीट: पतङ्गो वा भवेयं शङ्कराज्ञया। न तु शक्र त्वया दत्तं त्रैलोक्यमपि कामये॥
en: Ordered by Mahadeva I shall cheerfully become a worm or an insect, but I do not desire for even the sovereignty of the three worlds if bestowed by you, O Shakra.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: श्वापि महेश्वरवचनाद् भवामि स हि नः परः कामः। त्रिदशगणराज्यमपि खलु नेच्छाभ्यमहेश्वराज्ञप्तम्।।
en: At the word, of Hara I would become even a dog. In fact, that is my highest wish. If not given by Maheshvara, I would not have the sovereignty of the very gods.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: इन्द्र उवाच न नाकपृष्ठं न च देवराज्यं न ब्रह्मलोकं न च निष्फलत्वम्। न सर्वकामानखिलान् वृणोमि हरस्य दासत्वमहं वृणोमि॥
en: Indra said I do no wish to have this celestial dominion. I do not desire to have the sovereignty of the gods. I do not wish to have the region of Brahman. Indeed, I do not wish to have that extinction of individual existence which is called Liberation and which is a complete oneness with Brahma. But I want to become the slave of Hara.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: उपमन्युरुवाच न प्रीयते पशुपतिर्भगवान् ममेशः। १ःखानि देहविहितानि समुद्वहामि।।१८९
en: As long as that Lord of all creatures, the illustrious Mahesha with crown on his head and body white like the lunar disc, does not become pleased with me, so long shall I cheerfully bear all those miseries consequent upon a hundred repetitions of decrepitude, death and birth, which embodied beings come by.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दिवसकरशशाङ्कराह्रिदीप्तं त्रिभुवनसारमसारमाद्यमेकम्। अजरममरमप्रसाद्य रुद्रं जगति पुमानिह को लभेत शान्तिम्॥
en: What persons in the universe can acquire tranquility without pleasing Rudra who is freed from decrepitude and death, who is effulgent like the Sun, the Moon, or the Fire, who is the root or original cause of everything real and unreal in the three worlds, and who exists as the one indivisible?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यदि नाम जन्म भूयो अवति मदीयैः पुनर्दोषैः। तस्मिंस्तस्मिञ्जन्मनि भवे भवेन्मेऽक्षया भक्तिः॥
en: If on account of any faults, I come by rebirths, I shall, in those new births, devote myself solely to Bhava.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शक्र उवाच कः पुनर्भवने हेतुरीशे कारणकारणे। येन शर्वादृतेऽन्यस्मात् प्रसादं नाभिकाक्षसि॥
en: Shakra said What are your grounds for the existence of a Supreme Being or for His being the cause of all causes?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: उपमन्युरुवाच सदसद् व्यक्तमव्यक्तं यमाहुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः। नित्यकमनेकं च वरं तस्माद् वृणीमहे॥
en: Upamanyu said I beg boons from Him whom Brahmavadins have described as existent and nonexistent, manifest and unmanifest, eternal or immutable, One and many.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अनादिमध्यपर्यन्तं ज्ञानैश्चर्यमचिन्तितम्। आत्मानं परमं यस्माद् वरं तस्माद् वृणीमहे॥
en: I beg boons from Him who is without beginning and middle and end, who is Knowledge and Power, who is inconceivable and who is the Supreme Soul.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ऐश्वर्यं सकलं यस्मादनुत्पादितमव्ययम्। अबीजाद् बीजसम्भूतं वरं तस्माद् वृणीमहे॥
en: I pray for boons from Him whence is all Power who has not been produced by and one, who is immutable, and who, though himself not sprung from any seed, is the seed of all things in the universe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तमसः परमं ज्योतिस्तपस्तवृत्तिनां परम्। यं ज्ञात्वा नानुशोचन्ति वरं तस्माद् वृणीमहे ॥
en: I pray for boons from Him who is above the quality of Darkness, who is blazing Effulgence, who is the essence of all penances, who is above all our faculties and which we may devote for the purpose of comprehending him, and by knowing whom every one becomes liberated from grief or sorrow.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: भूतभावनभावज्ञं सर्वभूताभिभावनम्। सर्वगं सर्वदं देवं पूजयामि पुरन्दर॥
en: I adore him, O Purandara, who is conversant with the creation of all elements and the thoughts of all living creatures, and who is the original cause of the existence or creation of all creatures, who is omnipresent, and who has the power to give everything.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: हेतुवादैर्विनिमुक्तं सांख्ययोगार्थदं परम्। यमुपासन्ति तत्त्वज्ञा वरं तस्माद् वृणीमहे॥ मघवन् मघवात्मानं यं वदन्ति सुरेश्वरम्। सर्वभूतगुरुं देवं वरं तस्माद् वृणीमहे॥
en: I pray for boons from Him who cannot be comprehended by argument, who is the object of the Sankhya and the Yoga systems of philosophy, and who is above all things, and whom all persons conversant with the topics of enquiry, adore, I pray for boons from Him, O Maghavat, who is the soul of Maghavat himself, who is said to be the God of the gods, and who is the Master of all creatures.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यतः पूर्वमसृजद् देवं ब्रह्माणं लोकभावनम्। अण्डमाकाशमापूर्य वरं तस्माद् वृणीमहे॥
en: I pray for boons from Him who it was that first created Brahman, that creator of all the worlds, having filied Ether (with His energy) and called into being the primeval egg.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अग्निरापोऽनिल: पृथ्वी खं बुद्धिश्च मनो महान्। स्रष्टा चैषां भवेद् योऽन्यो ब्रूहि कः परमेश्वरात्।।
en: Who else than that Supreme Lord could have created Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, Space, Mind, and the principle of Greatness.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: मनो मतिरहंकारस्तन्मात्राणीन्द्रियाणि च। ब्रूहि चैषां भवेच्छक कोऽन्योऽस्ति परमं शिवात्।।
en: Tell me, O Shakra, who clse than Shiva could create Mind, Understanding, Ego, the subtile elements and the senses? Who is there higher than Shiva?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: स्रष्टारं भुवनस्येह वदन्तीह पितामहम्। आराध्य स तु देवेशमश्नुते महतीं श्रियम्॥
en: The wise say that the Grandfather Brahman is the creator of this universe. Brahman, however, got his great power and prosperity by worshipping and gratifying Mahadeva, that God of gods.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: भगवत्युत्तमैश्वर्यं ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमम्। विद्यते वै महादेवाद् ब्रूहि कः परमेश्वरात्॥
