en: That great power, which is in that illustrious Being who created Brahman, Vishnu, and Rudra, was derived from Mahadeva. Tell me who is there who is superior to the Supreme Lord?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दैत्यदानवमुख्यानामाधिपत्यारिमर्दनात्। कोऽन्यः शक्नोति देवेशाद् दितेः सम्पादितुं सुतान्।।
en: Who else than that God of gods can bestow upon the sons of Diti lordship and power judging by the sovereignty and the power of oppressing given to the foremost of the Daityas and the Danavas? are

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दिक्कालसूर्यतेजांसि ग्रहवाग्विन्दुतारकाः। विद्धि त्वेते महादेवाद् ब्रूहि कः परमेश्वरात्॥
en: The cardinal points, Time, the Sun, all luminous bodies, planets, wind, water, and the stars and constellations all from Mahadevas. Tell us who is the higher than the Supreme Lord?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अथोत्पत्तिविनाशे वा यज्ञस्य त्रिपुरस्य वा। दैत्यदानवमुख्यानामाधिपत्यारिमर्दनः॥
en: Who else is there, than Mahadeva, in the creation of Sacrifice and the destruction of Tripura? Who else than Mahadeva has grinded the enemies, coming into contact with the Daityas and the Danavas?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: किं चात्र बहुभिः सूक्तैर्हेतुवादैः पुरंदर सहस्त्रनयनं दृष्ट्वा त्वामेव सुरसत्तम॥
en: What necessity, O Purandara, is there of giving vent to tall talks full of sophistry when I see you a thousand eyes, O best of the gods.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: पूजितं सिद्धगन्धर्वैर्देवैश्च ऋषिभिस्तथा। देवदेवप्रसादेन तत् सर्वं कुशिकोत्तम॥
en: You who are adored by Siddhas and Gandharvas and the deities and the Rishis? O best of the Kushikas, all this is due to the favour of that God of gods, viz., Mahadeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अव्यक्तमुक्तकेशाय सर्वगस्येदमात्मकम्। चेतनाचेतनाद्येषु शक्र विद्धि महेश्वरात्॥
en: Know, O Keshava, that this all, consisting of animate and inanimate creation with heaven and other unseen creation, which are in these worlds, and which has the allpervading Lord for its soul, has emanated from Maheshvara and has been created for enjoyment of the individual soul.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: भुवाद्येषु महान्तेषु लोकालोकान्तरेषु च। द्वीपस्थानेषु मेरोश्च विभवेष्वन्तरेषु च॥ भगवन् मघवन् देवं वदन्ते तत्त्वदर्शिनः।
en: In the worlds that are known by the names of Bhu, Bhuva, Svah, and Maha, in the midst of the mountains of Lokaloka, in the islands, in the mountains of Meru, in all things which produce happiness, and in the hearts of all creatures, O illustrious Maghavat, lives Mahadeva, as held by persons conversant with all the topics of enquiry.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यदि देवाः सुराः शक्र पश्यन्त्यन्यां भवाद् गतिम्।। किं न गच्छन्ति शरणं मर्दिताश्चासुरैः सुराः।
en: If, O Shakra, the gods and the Asuras could see any other powerful Being than Bhava, would not both of them, especially the former when opposed and oppressed by the latter, have sought the protection of that Being?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अभिघातेषु देवानां सयक्षोरगरक्षसाम्॥ परस्परविनाशेषु स्वस्थानैश्वर्यदो भवः।
en: In all battles of the gods, the Yakshas, the Uragas, and the Rakshasas, which end in mutual destruction, it is Bhava who gives to those who meet with destruction power, befitting their position and acts.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अन्धकस्याथ शुक्रस्य दुन्दुभेर्महिषस्य च॥ यक्षेन्द्रबलरक्षःसु निवातकवचेषु च। वरदानवघाताय ब्रूहि कोऽन्यो महेश्वरात्॥
en: Tell me, who else than Maheshvara is there for conferring boons upon, and once more taking them away from, Andhaka and Shukra and Dundubhi and Mahisha and many foremost of Yakshas and Bala and Rakshasas and the Nivatakavachas?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सुरासुरगुरोर्वक्त्रे कस्य रेत: पुरा हतम्। कस्य वाऽन्यस्य रेतस्तद् येन हैमो गिरिः कृतः।।२१६
en: Was not the seminal fluid of Mahadeva, that Master of both the gods and the Asuras, poured as a libation upon the fire? From that seed originated a mountain of gold. Who else is there whose seed can be said to be possessed of such power.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दिग्वासः कीर्त्यते कोऽन्यो लोके कश्चोर्ध्वरेतसः। कस्य चार्धे स्थिता कान्ता अनङ्ग केन निर्जितः।।२१७।
en: Who else in this world is described as having the horizon only for his dress? Who else can be said to be a celibate with vital seed drawn up? Who else is there who has half his body occupied by his dear wife. Who else is there who has been able to subjugate Cupid?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ब्रूहीन्द्र परमं स्थानं कस्य देवैः प्रशस्यते। श्मशाने कस्य क्रीडाथ नृत्ते वा कोऽभिभाष्यते।।२१८।
en: Tell me, O Indra, what other Being possesses that high region of supreme happiness which is highly spoken of by all the deities? Who else has the crematorium as his play ground? Who else is there who is so lauded for his dancing?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: कस्यैश्वर्यं समानं च भूतैः को वापि क्रीडते। कस्य तुल्यबला देव गणाश्चैश्वर्यदर्पिताः॥
en: Whose worship and power remains unchangeable? Who else is there who plays with spirits and ghosts. Tell me, O god, who else has companions who are possessed of strength like his own and who are, therefore, proud of that strength or power?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: घुष्यते ह्यचलं स्थानं कस्य त्रैलोक्यपूजितम्। वर्षते तपते कोऽन्यो ज्वलते तेजसा च कः॥
en: Who else is there whose place is described as unchangeable and adored with reverence by the three worlds? Who else is there who pours rain, gives heat, and blazes forth in Energy?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: कस्मादोषधिसम्पत्तिः को वा धारयते वसु। प्रकामं क्रीडते को वा त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे॥
en: From whom else do we get our precious herbs? Who else upholds all kinds of riches. Who else sports as much as he likes in the three worlds of mobile and immobile things?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ज्ञानसिद्धिक्रियायोगैः सेव्यमानश्च योगिभिः। ऋषिगन्धर्वसिद्धैश्च विहितं कारणं परम्॥
en: O Indra, know Maheshvara to be the original Cause. He is worshipped by Yogins, by Rishis, by the Gandharvas, and by the Siddhas, with the help of knowledge, of success, and of the rites laid down in the scriptures.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: कर्मयज्ञक्रियायोगैः सेव्यमानः सुरासुरैः। नित्यं कर्मफलैहीनं तमहं कारणं वदे॥
en: He is worshipped by both the gods and the Asuras with the help of sacrifices by acts and the ritual laid down in the scriptures. The fruits of action can never touch him for he is above them all. Being such, I call him the original cause of everything.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: स्थूलं सूक्ष्ममनौपम्यमग्राह्यं गुणगोचरम्। गुणहीनं गुणाध्यक्षं परं माहेश्वरं पदम्॥
en: He is both gross and subtile. He is peerless. He cannot be comprehended by the senses. He is endued with qualities and he is shorn of them. He is the lord of qualities, for they are under his control. Even such is Maheshvara's place.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: विश्वेशं कारणगुरुं लोकालोकान्तकारणम्। भूताभूतभविष्यच्च जनकं सर्वकारणम्॥
en: He is the cause of the continuance and the creation (to the universe). He is the cause of the universe and the cause also of its destruction. He is the Past, the Present and the Future. He is the parent of all things. He is the cause of every thing.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अक्षराक्षरमव्यक्तं विद्याविद्ये कृताकृते। धर्माधर्मी यतः शक्र तमहं कारणं ब्रुवे॥
en: He is mutable, he is the unmanifest, he is Knowledge; he is Ignorance; he is virtue; and he is sin. O Shakra, do I call Him the cause of everything.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: प्रत्यक्षमिह देवेन्द्र पश्य लिङ्गं भगाङ्कितम्। देवदेवेन रुद्रेण सृष्टिसंहारहेतुना॥
en: See, O Indra, in the image of Mahadeva the marks of both the sexes. That god of gods, viz., Rudra, that cause of both creation and destruction, shows in his form the marks of both the sexes as the one cause of the creation of the universe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: मात्रा पूर्वं ममाख्यातं कारणं लोकलक्षणम्। नास्ति चेशात् परं शक तं प्रपद्य यदीच्छसि॥
en: My mother formerly told me that he is the cause of the universe and the one cause of everything. There is no one who is higher than Isha, O Shakra. If it pleases you, do you throw yourself on his kindness and protection.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: प्रत्यक्षं ननु ते सुरेश विदितं संयोगलिङ्गोद्धम्। त्रैलोक्यं सविकारनिर्गुणगणं ब्रह्मादिरेतोद्भवम्। यद्ब्रह्मेन्द्रहुताशविष्णुसहिता देवाश्च दैत्येश्वरा। नान्यत् कामसहस्रकल्पितधियः शंसन्ति ईशात् परम्।।
en: You have evidence, o king of the gods, of the fact that the universe has originated from the union of the sexes. The universe, you kuow, is the sum of what has qualities and what has not them and has for its immcdiate cause the seeds of Brahman and others. Brahman and Indra and Hutasha and Vishnu and all the other gods, along with the Daityas and the Asuras, having the fruition of a thousand desires, always say that there is none who is higher than Ma.ladeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तं देवं सचराचरस्य जगतो व्याख्यातवेद्योत्तम। कामार्थीवरयामि संयतमना मोक्षाय सद्यः शिवम्।।
en: Moved by desire, I solicit, with controlled mind, that god known to all the mobile and immobile universe, him, who is, who has been described as the best and highest of all the celestials, and who is auspiciousness itself, for getting forth with that highest of all acquisitions, viz., Liberation.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: हेतुभिर्वा किमन्यैस्तैरीश: कारणकारणम्। न शुश्रुम यदन्यस्य लिङ्गमभ्यर्चितं सुरैः॥
en: What necessity is there, of other reasons? The great Mahadeva is the cause of all causes. We have never heard that the celestials have, at any time worshipped the emblem of any other god than Mahadeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: कस्यान्यस्य सुरैः सर्वैर्लिङ्गं मुक्त्वा महेश्वरम्। अर्च्यतेऽर्चितपूर्व वा ब्रूहि यद्यस्ति ते श्रुतिः॥
en: If Mahesvara be not accepted, tell me, if you have ever heard of it, who else is there whose einblem has been adored or is being adored by all the celestials?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यस्य ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च त्वं चापि सह दैवतैः। अर्चयध्वं सदा लिङ्गं तस्माच्छ्रेष्ठतमो हि सः॥ न पद्माङ्का न चक्राङ्का न वज्राङ्का यतः प्रजाः। लिङ्गाङ्का च भगाङ्का च तस्मान्माहेश्वरी प्रजा॥२३३
en: That god is, indeed, the most worshipful of all celestials whose emblem Brahma, Vishnu, you, O Indra, with all the other gods, always adore. Brahma has for his emblem the lotus. Vislinu has for his the discus. Indra has for his the thunderbolt. But the creatures of the world do not bear any of the signs which mark these celestials. On the other hand, all creatures bear the signs which mark Mahadeva and his consort. Hence all creatures inust be considered as belonging to Maheshvara.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: देव्याः कारणरूपभावजनिता: सर्वा भगाङ्का स्रियो। लिंगनापि हरस्य सर्वपुरुषाः प्रत्यक्षचिह्नीकृताः। योऽन्यत्कारणमीश्वरात् प्रवदते देव्या च यन्नाङ्कितं। त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे स तु पुमान् बाह्यो भवेद् दुर्मतिः।।
en: All female creatures, have originaled from Uma, and hence it is they have the mark of femininity which characterises Uma; while all masculine creatures, who have originated from Shiva bear the masculine mark that marks Shiva, out. That person who holds that there is, in the three worlds with their mobile and immobile creatures, any other cause than the Supreme Lord, and that which is not marked with the mark of either Mahadeva or his wife, should be considered as very wretched and should not be numbered with the creatures of the universe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: पुंलिङ्गं सर्वमीशानं स्रीलिङ्गं विद्धि चाप्युमाम्। द्वाभ्यां तनुभ्यां व्याप्तं हि चराचरमिदं जगत्॥
en: Every being having the mark of the masculine sex should be known to be of Ishana, while every being with the mark of the feminine sex should be known as belonging to Uma. This universt of mobile and immobile crcatures is pervaded by two forms (viz., male and female).

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तस्माद् वरमहं काइक्षे निधनं वाऽपि कौशिक। गच्छ वा तिष्ठ वा शक्र यथेष्टं बलसूदन॥
en: It is from Mahadeva that I wish to get boons. Not getting this, O Kaushika, I would rather prefer dissolution itself. Go or remain, O Shakra, as you like, O slayer of Vala.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: काममेष वरो मेऽस्तु शापो वाथ महेश्वरात्। न चान्यां देवता काइक्षे सर्वकामफलामपि॥
en: I wish to have boons or curses from Mahadeva. No, I shall not acknowledge any other god. Nor would I have my desires fulfilled from any other deity.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवमुक्त्वा तु देवेन्द्रं दुःखादाकुलितेन्द्रियः। न प्रसीदति मे देवः किमेतदिति चिन्तयन्॥
en: Having said these words to the king of the celestials, I became stricken with grief thinking that Mahadeva had not been propitiated despite my severe austerities.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अथापश्यं क्षणेनैव तमेवैरावतं पुन:। हंसकुन्देन्दुसदृशं मृणालरजतप्रभम्॥ वृषरूपधरं साक्षात् क्षीरोदमिव सागरम्। कृष्णपुच्छं महाकायं मधुपिङ्गललोचनम्॥
en: Within the twinkling of an eye, however, I saw the celestial clephant I had seen before me Changed into a bull as while as a swan, or the Jasminum puboscons, or a stalk of the lotus, or silver, or the ocean of milk. Of huge body, the hair of its tail was black and the colour of its cyes was twany like that of honey.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वज्रसारमयैः शृङ्गैर्निष्टप्तकनकप्रभैः। सुतीक्ष्णैर्मृदुरक्तात्रैरुत्किरन्तमिवावनिम्॥
en: Its horns were hard as adamant and had the Tue of gold. With their very sharp ends, whose hue was a mild red, the bull appeared to tcar the Earth.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: जाम्बूनदेन दाम्ना च सर्वतः समलंकृतम्। सुवक्त्रखुरनासं च सुकर्णं सुकटीतटम्॥
en: The animal was bedecked all over with ornaments made of the purest gold. Its face and hoofs and nose and ears were beautiful and its waist too wellformed.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सुपार्वं विपुलस्कन्धं सुरूपं चारुदर्शनम्। ककुदं तस्य चाभाति स्कन्धमापूर्य धिष्ठितम्॥
en: Its flanks were beautiful, and its neck was very thick. Its whole form was beautiful to look at. Its hump was charming and seemed to occupy the whole of its shoulder joint.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तुषारगिरिकूटाभं सिताभ्रशिखरोपमम्। तमास्थितश्च भगवान् देवदेवः सहोमया)।२४४।।
en: And it looked like the summit of a snowclad mountain or like a cliff of white clouds in the sky. Upon the back of that animal I saw seated the illustrious Mahadeva with his wife Uma.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अशोभत महादेवः पौर्णमास्यामिवोडुराट्। तस्य तेजोभवो वह्निः समेघः सन्तयित्नुमान्।।२४५ सहस्रमिव सूर्याणां सर्वमापूर्य धिष्ठितः। ईश्वरः सुमहातेजाः संवर्तक इवानलः॥ युगान्ते सर्वभूतानां दिधक्षुरिव चोद्यतः।
en: Mahadeva shone like the full-moon. The fire born of his energy shone ini effulgence like lightning that flashes amid clouds. It seemed as if a thousand suns rose there, filling every quarter with a dazzling splendour. That energy of the Supreme Lord looked like the Samvartaka fire which destroys all creatures at the end of the Yoga.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तेजसा तु सदा व्याप्तं दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ततः॥ पुनरुद्विग्नहृदयः किमेतदिति चिन्तयन्।
en: Filled to the fill with that energy, the horizon became such that I could not see anything on any side. Filled with anxiety I once more, thought that it could mean.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: मुहूर्तमिव तत् तेजो व्याप्य सर्वा दिशो दश॥ प्रशान्तं दिक्षु सर्वासु देवदेवस्य मायया। अथापश्यं स्थितं स्थाणुं भगवन्तं महेश्वरम्॥
en: That energy, however, did not pervade every side for a long time, for soon, through the illusion of that god of gods, the horizon became clear. I then saw the illustrious Sthanu or Maheshvara, seated on the back of his bull, of blessed and sweet appearance and loO king like a smokeless fire.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नीलकण्ठं महात्मानमसक्तं तेजसां निधिम्। अष्टादशभुजं स्थाणुं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्॥
en: And the great god was accompanied by Parvati of perfect features. Indeed, I saw the bluc-throated and great Sthanu unattached to everything, that receptacle of all sorts of energy or force, having eighteen arms, and bedecked with all sorts of ornainents.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शुक्लाम्बरधरं देवं शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनम्। शुक्लध्वजमनाधृष्यं शुक्लयज्ञोपवीतिनम्॥
en: Clad in white robes, he wore white garlands, and had white unguents sincared upon his person. His banner, irresistible in the universe, was white. The thread round his body was also white.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: गायद्भिर्नृत्यमानैश्च वादयद्भिश्च सर्वशः। वृतं पार्श्वचरैर्दिव्यैरात्मतुल्यपराक्रमैः॥
en: He was cncircled by companions all endued with prowess equal to his own, who were singing or dancing or playing on various inusical instruments.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: बालेन्दुमुकुटं पाण्डु शरच्चन्द्रमिवोदितम्। त्रिभिर्नेत्रैः कृतोद्योतं त्रिभिः सूर्यरिवोदितैः॥
en: A crescent moon, of pale colour, formed his crown, and put on his forehead it looked like the moon which rises in the autumnal sky. He seemed to dazzle with splendour on account of his three cyes which looked like three suns.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अशोभतास्य देवस्य माला गात्रे सितप्रभे। जातरूपमयैः पौग्रथिता रत्नभूषिता॥
en: The garland, of the purest white, that was on his body, shone like a wreath of lotuses, of the purest white, adorned with jewels and gems.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: मूर्तिमन्ति तथाऽस्त्राणि सर्वतेजोमयानि च। मया दृष्टानि गोविन्द भवस्यामिततेजसः॥
en: I also saw, O Govinda, the weapons in their embodied forms and fraught with every sort of energy, that belong to Bhava of peerless prowess.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: इन्द्रायुधसवर्णाभं धनुस्तस्य महात्मनः। पिनाकमिति विख्यातमभवत् पन्नगो महान्॥
en: The great god held a rainbow-coloured bow. That bow known as Pinaka as is in reality a powerful snake.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सप्तशीर्षो महाकायस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रो विघोल्बणः। ज्यावेष्टितमहाग्रीवः स्थितः पुरुषविग्रहः॥
en: Indeed, that snake of seven heads and huge body, of sharp fangs and virulent venom, of large neck and the masculine sex was twined round, with the cord that served as its bowstring. a a

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शरश्च सूर्यसंकाशः कालानलसमद्युतिः। एतदस्त्रं महाघोरं दिव्यं पाशुपतं महत्॥ अद्वितीयमनिर्देश्यं सर्वभूतभयावहम्। सस्फुलिङ्गं महाकायं विसृजन्तमिवानलम्॥
en: And there was an arrow which shone like that of the sun or of the fire that appears at the end of the cycle. Verily, that arrow was the excellent Pashupata, that mighty and dreadful weapon, which is without second, indescribable for its power, and capable of terrorising every creature. Of huge proportions, it seemed to constantly emit sparks of fire.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एकपादं महादंष्ट्रं सहस्रशिरसोदरम्। सहस्रभुजजिह्वाक्षमुद्गिरन्तमिवानलम्॥
en: Having one foot, large teeth, and a thousand heads and thousand stomachs, it had thousand arms, a thousand tongues, and a thousand eyes. Indeed, it seemed to continually emit fire.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ब्राह्यान्नारायणाच्चैन्द्रादाग्नेयादपि वारुणात्। यद् विशिष्टं महाबाहो सर्वशस्त्रविघातनम्॥
en: O you of great arms, that weapon is superior to the Brahma, the Narayana, the Aindra, the Ageneya, and the Varuna weapons. Indeed, it is capable of neutralising every other weapon in the universe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: येन तत् त्रिपुरं दग्ध्वा क्षणाद् भस्मीकृतं पुरा। शरेणैकेन गोविन्द महादेवेन लीलया॥
en: It was with that weapon that the great Mahadeva had, formerly burnt and consumed in a moment the triple city of the Asuras. With the greatest ease, O Govinda, Mahadeva, using that single arrow, performed that feat.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: निर्दहेत च यत् कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्। महेश्वरभुजोत्सृष्टं निमेषार्धान्न संशयः॥
en: That weapon, discharged by Mahadeva's arms, can, forsooth, consume in half the time taken up by a twinkling of the eye the entire universe with all its mobile and immobile creatures.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नावध्यो यस्य लोकेऽस्मिन् ब्रह्मविष्णुसुरेष्वपि। तदहं दृष्टवांस्तत्र आश्चर्यमिदमुत्तमम्॥
en: In the universe there is no one including, even Brahman and Vishnu and the celestials, who cannot be killed by that weapon. O sire, I saw that excellent, wonderful and peerless weapon in the hand of Mahadeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: गुह्यमस्त्रवरं नान्यत् तत्तुल्यमधिकं हि वा। यत् तच्छूलमिति ख्यातं सर्वलोकेषु शूलिनः॥
en: There is another mysterious and very strong weapon which is equal or, perhaps, superior to the Pashupata. I saw that also. It is known in all the worlds as the Shula of the Shula-armed Mahadeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दाहयेद् यां महीं कृत्स्नां शोषयेद् वा महोदधिम्। संहरेद् वा जगत् कृत्स्नं विसृष्टं शूलपाणिना।।२६६।
en: Hurled by the illustrious god, that weapon can rive the entire Earth or dry up the waters of the occan or annihilate the entire universe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यौवनाश्वो हतो येन मान्धाता सवल: पुरा। चक्रवर्ती महातेजास्त्रिलोकविजयी नृपः॥
en: Formerly Yuvanashva's son, king Mandhatri, that conqueror of the three worlds, having imperial sway and gifted with profuse energy, was, with all his armies, killed by means of that weapon.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: महाबलो महावीर्यः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः। करस्थेनैव गोविन्द लवणस्येह रक्षसः॥
en: Gifted with great might and great energy and resembling Shakra himself in prowess, that king, O Govinda, was killed by the Rakshasa Lavana with the help of this Shula which he had got from Shiva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तच्छूलमतितीक्ष्णाग्रं सुभीमं लोमहर्षणम्। त्रिशिखां भृकुटि कृत्वा तर्जमानमिव स्थितम्॥
en: That Shula is keen-pointed. Highly terrible, it is capable of causing everybody's hair stand erect. 1 beheld it in the hand of Mahadeva, as if roaring with anger, having contracted its forehead into three wrinkles.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: विधूमं सार्चिषं कृष्णं कालसूर्यमिवोदितम्। सर्पहस्तमनिर्देश्यं पाशहस्तमिवान्तकम्॥
en: It resembled, O Krishna, a smokeless fire or the sun that rises at the end of the cycle. The handle of that Shula was made of a great snake. It is really indescribable. It looked like the universal Destroyer armed with his noose.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दृष्टवानस्मि गोविन्द तदस्त्रं रुद्रसंनिधौ। परशुस्तीक्ष्णधारश्च दत्तो रामस्य यः पुरा॥ महादेवेन तुष्टेन क्षत्रियाणां क्षयंकरः। कार्तवीर्यो हतो येन चक्रवर्ती महामृधे॥
en: I saw this weapon, O Govinda, in the hand of Mahadeva. I saw also another weapon, viz., that shar-pedged battle-axe which, was given, formerly unto Rama by Mahadeva for enabling him to root out the Kshatriyas. It was with this weapon that Rama killed in dreadful battle the great Karttaviryya who was the king of the entire world.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: त्रिःसप्तकृत्वः पृथिवी येन निःक्षत्रिया कृता। जामदग्न्येन गोविन्द रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा॥
en: It was with that weapon that Jamadagni's son, O Govinda, was able to root out the Kshatriyas for twenty-one times.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दीप्तधारः सुरौद्रास्यः सर्पकण्ठाग्रधिष्ठितः। अभवच्छूलिनोऽभ्याशे दीप्तवह्निशतोपमः॥
en: Of blazing edge and highly terrible, that axe was hanging on the shoulder, adorned with a snake, of Mahadeva. Indeed, it appeared on Mahadeva's body like the flame of a burning fire.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: असंख्येयानि चास्त्राणि तस्य दिव्यानि धीमतः। प्राधान्यतो मयैतानि कीर्तितानि तवानघ॥
en: I saw with the highly intelligent Mahadeva numberless other celestial weapons. I have, however, named only a few principal ones, O sinless one.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सव्यदेशे लोकपितामहः। दिव्यं विमानमास्थाय हंसयुक्तं मनोजवम्॥
en: On the left side of the great god stood the Grandfather Brahman seated on an excellent car to which were yoked swans fleet-coursing like the mind.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वामपार्श्वगतश्चापि तथा नारायणः स्थितः। वैनतेयं समारुह्य शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः॥ तु देवस्य ब्रह्मा
en: On the same side was Narayana also, seated on Garuda and bearing the conch, the discus, and the mace.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: स्कन्दो मयूरमास्थाय स्थितो देव्याः समीपतः। शक्तिघण्टे समादाय द्वितीय इव पावकः॥
en: Near the goddess Uma was Skanda seated on his peacock, bearing his dreadful arrow and bells, and loO king like another Fire-God.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: पुरस्ताच्चैव देवस्य नन्दि पश्याम्यवस्थितम्। शूलं विष्टभ्य तिष्ठन्तं द्वितीयमिव शङ्करम्॥
en: Before Mahadeva I saw Nandi standing armed with his Shula and loO king like a second Shankara.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: स्वायम्भुवाद्या मनवो भृग्वाद्या ऋषयस्तथा। शक्राद्या देवताश्चैव सर्व एव समभ्ययुः॥
en: The Munis headed by the Self create Manu, and the Rishis having Bhrigu for their first, and the gods with Shakra at their head, all came there.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सर्वभूतगणाश्चैव मातरो विविधाः स्थिताः। तेऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं परिवार्य समन्ततः॥
en: All the clans of spirits and ghosts, and the celestial Mothers, stood surrounding Mahadeva and saluting him with respect.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अस्तुवन् विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्महादेवं सुरास्तदा। ब्रह्मा भवं तदाऽस्तौषीद् रथन्तरमुदीरयन्॥
en: The gods were engaged in singing the praises of Mahadeva in various hymns. The Grandfather Brahman, uttering a Rathantara, landed Mahadeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ज्येष्ठसाम्ना च देवेशं जगौ नारायणस्तदा॥ गृणन् ब्रह्म परं शक्रः शतरुद्रियमुत्तमम्।
en: Ultering the Jyeshtha Saman Narayana also sang the praises of Bhava, Shakra also did the same with the help of those foremost of Vedic Mantras, viz., the Shata-Rudriyam.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ब्रह्मा नारायणश्चैव देवराजश्च कौशिकः॥ अशोभन्त महात्मानस्त्रयस्त्रय इवाग्नयः।
en: Verily, Brahman and Narayana and Shakra, those three great gods shone there like three sacrificial fires.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तेषां मध्यगतो देवो रराज भगवाञ्छिवः॥ शरदभ्रविनिर्मुक्तः परिधिस्थ इवांशुमान्।
en: In their midst was the illustrious god like the sun in the midst of his corona, come from autumnal clouds.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अयुतानि च चन्द्रार्कानपश्यं दिवि केशव॥ ततोऽहमस्तुवं देवं विश्वस्य जगतः पतिम्।
en: I saw countless suns and moons also in the sky, O Keshava. I then lauded the illustrious Lord of everything, the Great Master of the universe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: उपमन्युरुवाच नमो देवाधिदेवाय महादेवाय ते नमः॥ शक्ररूपाय शक्राय शक्रवेषधराय च।
en: Upamanyu said I said, Salutations to you, O illustrious one, O you who are the refuge of all things, O you who are called Mahadeva! Salutations to you who assume the form of Shakra, who are Shakra and who disguise yourself in the form of Shakra.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमस्ते वज्रहस्ताय पिङ्गलायारुणाय च॥ पिनाकपाणये नित्यं शङ्खशूलधराय च।
en: Salutations to you who are armed with the thunder, to you who are tawny, and you who are red. Salutations to you who are always armed with the Pinaka, to you who always bear the conch and the Shula.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमस्ते कृष्णवासाय कृष्णकुञ्चितमूर्धजे॥ कृष्णाजिनोत्तरीयाय कृष्णाष्टमिरताय च।
en: Salutations to you who are clad in black, to you who are of dark and curly hair, to you who have dark deerskin for your upper garment, to you who preside over the eighth lunation of the dark fortnight.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शुक्लवर्णाय शुक्लाय शुक्लाम्बरधराय च॥ शुक्लभस्मावलिप्ताय शुक्लकर्मरताय च।
en: Salutations to you who are of white hue, to you who are called white, to you who are clad in white dress, to you who have limbs smeared with white ashes, to you who are ever engaged in white deeds.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमोऽस्तु रक्तवर्णाय रक्ताम्बरधराय च॥ रक्तध्वजपताकाय रक्तस्रगनुलेपिने।
en: Salutations to you who are red in colour, to you who are clad in red dress, to you who have a red banner with red flags, to you who wear red garlands and use red unguents.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमोऽस्तु पीतवर्णाय पीताम्बरधराय च॥ नमोऽस्तूच्छ्रितच्छत्राय किरीटवरधारिणे।
en: Salutations to you who are brown coloured, to you who are clad in brown dress, to you who have a brown banner with brown flags, to you who wear brown garlands and use brown unguents. Salutations to you who have the umbrella of royalty held over your head, to you who wear the foremost of crowns.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अर्धहारार्धकेयूर अर्धकुण्डलकर्णिने॥ नमः पवनवेगाय नमो देवाय वै नमः।
en: Salutations to you who are adorned with half a garland and half an armlet, to you who are decked with one ring for one ear, to you who are endued with the speed of the wind, to you who are highly effulgent.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सुरेन्द्राय मुनीन्द्राय महेन्द्राय नमोऽस्तु ते॥ नमः पद्मार्धमालाय उत्पलैर्मिश्रिताय च। अर्धचन्दनलिप्ताय अर्धस्रगनुलेपिने॥
en: Salutations to you who are the foremost of gods, to you who are the foremost of Munis, to you who are the foremost of celestials! Salutations to you who wear half a wreath of lotuses, to you who have many lotuses on your body. Salutations to you have half your body smeared with sandal paste, to you who have half your body decked with garlands of flowers and sıncared with fragınent unguents.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नम आदित्यवक्त्राय आदित्यनयनाय च। नम आदित्यवर्णाय आदित्यप्रतिमाय च॥
en: I bow to you who are bright-hued like the Sun, to you who are like the Sun, to you whose face is like the Sun, to you who have eyes each of which is like the Sun.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमः सोमाय सौम्याय सौम्यवक्त्रधराय च। सौम्यरूपाय मुख्याय सौम्यदंष्ट्राविभूषिणे॥
en: I bow to you who are Soma, to you who are as mild as Soma, to you who bear the lunar disc, to you who are of lunar aspect, to you who are the foremost of all creatures, to you who are adorned with most beautiful teeth.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमः श्यामाय गौराय अर्धपीतार्धपाण्डवे। नारीनरशरीराय स्त्रीपुंसाय नमोऽस्तु ते॥
en: I bow to you who are of a dark colour, to you who are of a fair complexion, to you who have a form half of which is yellow and half white, to you who have a body half of which is male and half female, to you who are both male and female.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमो वृषभवाहाय गजेन्द्रगमनाय च। दुर्गमाय नमस्तुभ्यमगम्यगमनाय च॥ नमोऽस्तु गणगीताय गणवृन्दरताय च। गणानुयातमार्गाय गणनित्यव्रताय च॥
en: I bow to you who have bull for your vehicle, to you who proceed riding on the foremost of elephants, to you who are obtained with difficulty, to you who are capable of going to places unapproachable by others. I bow to you whose praises are sung by the Ganas, to you who are devoted to the various Ganas, to you who follow the track that is trod by the Ganas, to you who are always devoted to the Ganas as to a vow.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमः श्वेताभ्रवर्णाय संध्यारागप्रभाय च। अनुद्दिष्टाभिधानाय स्वरूपाय नमोऽस्तु ते॥ नमो रक्ताग्रवासाय रक्तसूत्रधराय च। रक्तमालाविचित्राय रक्ताम्बरधराय च॥
en: I bow to you who are of the complexion of white clouds, to you who have the splendour of the evening clouds, to you who are incapable of being described by names, lo you who are of your own form. I bow to you having a garland of red colour, to you who are clad in robes of red.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: मणिभूषितमूर्धाय नमश्चन्द्रार्धभूषिणे। विचित्रमणिमूर्धाय कुसुमाष्टधराय च॥
en: I bow to you whose crown is set with gems, to you who are adorned with a crescent, to you who wear many beautiful gems in your diadem, to you who have eight flowers on your head.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमोऽग्निमुखनेत्राय सहस्रशशिलोचने। अग्निरूपाय कान्ताय नमोऽस्तु गहनाय च॥
en: I bow to you who have a fiery mouth and fiery eyes, to you who have eyes effulgent like a thousand moons, to you who are of the form of fire, to you who are beautiful and agreeable, to you who are inconceivable and mysterious.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: खचराय नमस्तुभ्यं गोचराभिरताय च। भूचराय भुवनाय अनन्ताय शिवाय च॥
en: I bow to you who range in the sky, to you who delight in living in pasture grounds, to you who walk on the Earth, to you who are the Earth, to you who are infinite, to you who are highly auspicious.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमो दिग्वाससे नित्यमधिवाससुवाससे। नमो जगन्निवासाय प्रतिपत्तिसुखाय च॥
en: I bow to you who are nude, to you who make a happy home of every place where you may happen to be for the time being. I bow to you who have the universe for your home, to you who have both Knowledge and Felicity for your Soul.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नित्यमुद्वद्धमुकुटे महाकेयूरधारिणे। सर्पकण्ठोपहाराय विचित्राभरणाय च॥
en: I bow to you who always wear a diadem, to you who wear a large armlet, to you who have a snake for the garland round your neck, to you who wear many beautiful ornaments on your body.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमस्त्रिनेत्रनेत्राय सहस्रशतलोचने। स्त्रीपुंसाय नपुंसाय नमः सांख्याय योगिने॥
en: I bow to you who have the Sun, the Moon, and Agni for your three eyes, to you who have a thousand cyes, to you who are both male and female, to you who are divested of sex, to you who are a Sankhya, to you who are a Yogin.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शंयोरभिस्रवन्ताय अथर्वाय नमो नमः। नमः सर्वार्तिनाशाय नमः शोकहराय च॥
en: I bow to you who are the grace of those gods who are adored in sacrifices, to you who are the Atharvans, to you who remove all sorts of disease and pain, to you who remove every sorrow.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमो मेघनिनादाय बहुमायाधराय च। बीजक्षेत्राभिपालाय स्रष्ट्राराय नमो नमः॥
en: I bow to you who roar as deep as the clouds, to you who display diverse kinds of illusions, to you who, lord over the soil and over the seed that is sown in it, to you who are the Creator of everything.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमः सुरासुरेशाय विश्वेशाय नमो नमः। नमः पवनवेगाय नमः पवनरूपिणे॥
en: I bow to you who are the Lord of all the deities, to you who are the Master of the universe, to you who are fleet like the wind, to you who are of the forin of the wind.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमः काञ्चनमालाय गिरिमालाय वै नमः। नमः सुरारिमालाय चण्डवेगाय वै नमः॥
en: I bow to you who wear a garland of gold, to you who play on hills and mountains, to you who are adored by all who are enemics of the gods, to you who are endued with fierce speed and energy.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ब्रह्मशिरोपहर्ताय महिषघ्नाय वै नमः। नमः स्त्रीरूपधाराय यज्ञविध्वंसनाय च॥
en: I bow to you who cut off one of the heads of the Grandfather Brahma, to you who have killed the Asura named Mahisha, to you who have three forms, to you who have every form.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमस्त्रिपुरहर्ताय यज्ञविध्वंसनाय च। नमः कामाङ्गनाशाय कालदण्डधराय च॥
en: I bow to you who are the destroyer of the triple city of the Asuras, to you who are the destroyer of (Daksha's) sacrifice, to you who are the destroyer of the person of Kama (the god of love) to you who hold the rod of destruction.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमः स्कन्दविशाखाय ब्रह्मदण्डाय वै नमः। नमो भवाय शर्वाय विश्वरूपाय वै नमः॥
en: I bow to you who are Skanda, to you who are Visakha, to you who are the rod of the are Brahmana, to you who are Bhava, to you who are Sarvam, to you who are of universal form.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ईशानाय भवघ्नाय नमोऽस्त्वनघकघातिने। नमो विश्वाय मायाय चिन्त्याचिन्त्याय वैनमः॥३१६
en: I bow to you who are Ishana, to you who are the destroyer of Bhaga, to you who are the slayer of Andhaka, to you who are the universe, to you who are possessed of illusion, 10 you who both conceivable and inconceivable.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: त्वं नो गतिश्च श्रेष्ठश्च त्वमेव हृदयं तथा। त्वं ब्रह्मा सर्वदेवानां रुद्राणां नीललोहितः॥
en: You are the one end of all creatures, you are the foremost, you are the heart of everything. You are the Brahman of all the gods, you are the Red and Blue of the Rudras.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: आत्मा च सर्वभूतानां सांख्ये पुरुष उच्यते। ऋषभस्त्वं पवित्राणां योगिनां निष्कलः शिवः।।३१८।
en: You are the Soul of all creatures, you are He called Purusha in the Sankhya philosophy, you are the Rishava among all sacred things, you are the auspicious of the Yogins which, according to them, is indivisible.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: गृहस्थस्त्वमाश्रमिणामीश्वराणां महेश्वरः। कुबेरः सर्वयक्षाणां क्रतूनां विष्णुरुच्यते॥
en: Amongst those who follow the different modes of life, you are the Householder, you are the great Lord amongst the patriarchs. You are Kubera among all the Yakshas, and you are Vishnu amongst all the sacrifices.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: पर्वतानां भवान् मेरुर्नक्षत्राणां च चन्द्रमाः। वसिष्ठस्त्वमृषीणां च ग्रहाणां सूर्य उच्यते॥
en: You are Meru amongst mountains, you are the Moon among all luminaries of the sky, you are Vashishtha amongst Rishis, yon are the Sun among the planets.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अरण्यानां पशूनां च सिंहस्त्वं परमेश्वरः। ग्राम्याणां गोवृषश्चासि भवाँल्लोकप्रपूजितः॥
en: You are the lion among all the beasts, and the bull adored of all among all domestic animals. are are

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: आदित्यानां भवान् विष्णुर्वसूनां चैव पावकः। पक्षिणां वैनतेयस्त्वमनन्तो भुजगेषु च॥
en: Among the Adityas, you are Vishnu (Upendra), among the Vasus, you are Pavaka, among birds you are Garuda, and among snakes you are Ananta.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सामवेदश्च वेदानां यजुषां शतरुद्रियम्। सनत्कुमारो योगानां सांख्यानां कपिलो ह्यसि।।३२३।
en: Among the Vedas you arc thc Samans, among the Yajushes you the Shatarudriyam, among Yogins you Sanatkumara, and among Sankhyas you are Kapila.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शक्रोऽसि मरुतां देव पितॄणां हव्यवाडसि। ब्रह्मलोकश्च लोकानां गतीनां मोक्ष उच्यसे॥
en: Among the Maruts you are Shakra, among the Pitris you are Devarat, among all the regions you are the region of Brahman, and you are emancipation amongst all the ends of creatures.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: क्षीरोदः सागराणां च शैलानां हिमवान् गिरिः। वर्णानां ब्राह्मणशासि विप्राणां दीक्षितो द्विजः॥३२५।
en: Of all oceans you are the Ocean of Milk, among all mountains you are Himavat, among all the castes you are the Brahmanas, and among all learned Brahmanas you are he who has undergone the initiation.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: आदिस्त्वमसि लोकानां संहर्ता काल एव च। यच्चान्यदपि लोके वै सर्वं तेजोधिकं स्मृतम्।।३२६
en: You are the Sun among all things in the worlds, you are the destroyer called Kala. You are whatever else gifted with superior energy or eminence existing in the universe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तत् सर्वं भगवानेव इति मे निश्चिता मतिः। नमस्ते भगवन् देव नमस्ते भक्तवत्सल॥
en: You are endued with supreme power. This is my certain conclusion. I bow to you, O powerful and illustrious one, O you who are kind to all your worshippers.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: योगेश्वर नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्ते विश्वसम्भव। प्रसीद मम भक्तस्य दीनस्य कृपणस्य च॥
en: I bow to you, O lord of Yogins. I bow to you, O original Cause of the universe. Be you pleased with me that am your worshipper, that am very miserable and helpless.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अनैश्वर्येण युक्तस्य गतिर्भव सनातन। यच्चापराधं कृतवानज्ञात्वा परमेश्वर॥ मद्भक्त इति देवेश तत्सर्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि।
en: O Eternal Lord, do you become the refuge of this adorer of yours who is very weak and miserable! O Supreme Lord, you should pardon me for all the sins i have committed, taking mercy on me for my being your devoted worshipper.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: मोहितश्चास्मि देवेश त्वया रूपविपर्ययात्॥ नाय॑ ते न मया दत्तं पाद्यं चापि महेश्वर।
en: I ain stupefied by you, O Lord of all the gods, on account of the disguise in which you appeared before me. O Maheshvara, I did not give you the Arghya or water to wash your feet.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवं स्तुत्वाऽहमीशानं पाद्यमय॑ च भक्तितः॥ कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा सर्वं तस्मै न्यवेदयम्।
en: Having sung thus the praises of Ishana, I offered him, with great devotion, water to wash his feet and the articles of the Arghya, and then, with joined hands I resigned myself to him, ready to carry out his command.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ततः शीताम्बुसंयुक्ता दिव्यगन्धसमन्विता॥ पुष्पवृष्टिः शुभा तात पपात मम मूर्धनि।
en: Then, O sire, an auspicious shower of flowers dropped upon my head, carrying celestial fragrance and bedewed with cold water.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दुन्दुभिश्च तदा दिव्यस्ताडितो देवकिङ्करैः। ववौ च मारुतः पुष्पः शुचिगन्धः सुखावहः॥
en: The divine musicians began to play on their kettle drums. A delicious breeze fragrant and sweet, began to blow and fill me with pleasure.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तत: प्रीतो महादेवः सपत्नीको वृषध्वजः। अब्रवीत् त्रिदशांस्तत्र हर्षयन्निव मां तदा॥ पश्यध्वं त्रिदशाः सर्वे उपमन्योर्महात्मनः। मयि भक्तिं परां नित्यमेकभावादवस्थिताम्॥
en: Then Mahadeva accompanied by his wife, and having the bull for his emblem, having been pleased with me, addressed the deities assembled there in these words, filling me with great joy Behold, your gods, the devotion of the great Upamanyu. Indeed, steady and great is that devotion, and entirely fixed, for it remains unaltered.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवमुक्तास्तदा कृष्ण सुरास्ते शूलपाणिना। ऊचुः प्राञ्जल: सर्वे नमस्कृत्वा वृषध्वजम्॥ भगवन् देवदेवेश लोकनाथ जगत्पते। लभतां सर्वकामेभ्यः फलं त्वत्तो द्विजोत्तमः॥
en: Thus addressed by the great God armed with the Shula, the gods, O Krishna, having bowed down to him and joined their hands in respect, said these words O illustrious one, O God of the gods, O Lord of the universe, O Lord of all, let this best of twice born persons obtain from you the fruition of all his desires!

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवमुक्तस्ततः शर्वः सुरैर्ब्रह्मादिभिस्तथा। आह मां भगवानीशः प्रहसन्निव शंकरः॥
en: Thus addressed by all the gods with the Grandfather Brahman among them, Sharva, otherwise called Isha and Shankara, said these words, as if smiling, to ine.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शंङ्कर उवाच वत्सोपमन्यो तुष्टोऽस्मि पश्य मां मुनिपुङ्गव। दृढभक्तोऽसि विप्रर्षे मया जिज्ञासितो ह्यसि॥
en: The illustrious Shankara said O dear Upamanyu, I am pleased with you. See me, O foremost of ascetics! O learned Rishi, you are firmly devoted to me and you have been well tested by me.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अनया चैव भक्त्या ते अत्यर्थे प्रीतिमानहम्। तस्मात्सर्वान्ददाम्यद्य कामांस्तव यथेप्सितान्॥
en: I have been very highly pleased with you on account of this your devotion to Shiva. I Shall, therefore, give you today the fruition of your desires.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवमुक्तस्य चैवाथ महादेवेन धीमता। हर्षादश्रूण्यवर्तन्त रोमहर्षस्त्वजायत॥
en: Thus' addressed by the highly wise Mahadeva, tears of joy came into my eyes and my hair stood crect.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अब्रुवं च तदा देवं हर्षगद्गदया गिरा। जानुभ्यामवनीं गत्वा प्रणम्य च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Kneeling down to him and bowing to him repeatedly, I then with a voice that was Suppressed with joy, said to him.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अद्य जातो ह्यहं देव सफलं जन्म चाद्य मे। सुरासुरगुरुर्देवो यत् तिष्ठति ममाग्रतः॥
en: O illustrious god, it appears to me that I was hitherto dead and that it is only today that I have taken my birth, and that my birth has today bomc fruit, since I am standing now in the presence of Him who is the Master of both the gods and the Asuras!

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यं न पश्यन्ति चैवाद्धा देवा ह्यमितविक्रमम्। तमहं दृष्टवान् देवं कोऽन्यो धन्यतरो मया॥
en: Who clse is more praiseworthy than I, since I am seeing with these eyes of mine Him of immeasurable prowess whom the very gods are unable to see without first paying hearty worship?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवं ध्यायन्ति विद्वांसः परं तत्त्वं सनातनम्। तद् विशेषमिति ख्यातं यदजं ज्ञानमक्षरम्॥ स एष भगवान् देवः सर्वसत्त्वादिरव्ययः। सर्वतत्त्वविधानज्ञः प्रधानपुरुषः परः॥
en: The learned and the wise consider that as the highest of all topics, which is Eternal, which is distinguished from all else, which is unborn, which is Knowledge, which is indestructible, at one with you o powerful and illustrious one, you who are the beginning of all the topics, you who are indestructible and challengeless, you who know all the ordinances, you who are the foremost of Purushas, you who are the highest of the high.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: योऽसृजद् दक्षिणादङ्गाद् ब्रह्माणं लोकसम्भवम्। वामपार्थात् तथा विष्णुं लोकरक्षार्थमीश्वरः॥
en: You who had created from your right side the Grandfather Brahman, the Creator of all things, you are he who had created from your leftside Vishnu for protecting the Creation.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: युगान्ते चैव सम्प्राप्ते रुद्रमीशोऽसृजत् प्रभुः। रुद्रः संहरन् कृत्स्नं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥ कालो भूत्वा महातेजाः संवर्तक इवानलः। युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि ग्रसन्निव व्यवस्थितः॥
en: You are that powerful Lord who did create Rudra when the end of the cycle came and when the Creation was once more to be destroyed! That Rudra who originated from you destroyed the Creation with all its mobile and immobile beings, assuming the form of highly powerful Kala, of the cloud Samvartaka, and of the all destroying fire. Indeed, when the time for the dissolution of the universe sets in, that Rudra stands, ready to swallow up the universe.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एष देवो महादेवो जगत् सृष्ट्वा चराचरम्। कल्पान्ते चैव सर्वेषां स्मृतिमाक्षिप्य तिष्ठति॥
en: You are that Mahadeva who is the original Creator of the universe with all its mobile and immobile creatures. You are he who, at the end of the aeon stands, withdrawing all things into yourself.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सर्वगः सर्वभूतात्मा सर्वभूतभवोद्भवः। आस्ते सर्वगतो नित्यमदृश्यः सर्वदैवतैः॥
en: You are he who pervades all things, you are the Soul of all things, you are the Creator of all principles. Incapable of being beheld by even any of the gods, you are he who exists, pervading all principles.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यदि देयो वरो मह्यं यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे प्रभो। भक्तिर्भवतु मे नित्यं त्वयि देव सुरेश्वर॥
en: If, O Lord, you have been pleased with me and if you would grant me boons, let this be the boon, O Lord of all the gods, that my devotion to you may remain unchanged.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अतीतानागतं चैव वर्तमानं च यद् विभो। जानीयामिति मे बुद्धिः प्रसादात् सुरसत्तम॥
en: O best of the gods, let me through your grace, have knowledge of the Present, the Past, and the Future.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: क्षीरोदनं च भुञ्जीयामक्षयं सह बान्धवैः। आश्रमे च सदास्माकं सांनिध्यं परमस्तु ते॥
en: I shall also, with all my kinsmen and friends, always eat food mixed with milk. And let your illustrious self be for ever present at our gifted hermitage.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवमुक्तः स मां प्राह भगवाँल्लोकपूजितः। महेश्वरो महातेजाश्चराचरगुरुः शिवः॥
en: Thus addressed by me, the illustrious Maheshvara gifted with supreme energy, that Master of all mobile and immobile creations, viz., Shiva, adored of all the universe, then said to me these words.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: भगवानुवाच अजरचामरश्चैव भव त्वं दुःखवर्जितः। यशस्वी तेजसा युक्तो दिव्यज्ञानसमन्वितः॥
en: The Illustrious God said Be free from every misery and pain and be above decrepitude and death. Be gifted with fame, be endued with great energy, and spiritual knowledge.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ऋषीणामभिगम्यश्च मत्प्रसादाद् भविष्यसि। शीलवान् गुणसम्पन्नः सर्वज्ञः प्रियदर्शनः॥
en: You shall through my grace, be always sought by the Rishis. Be your behaviour good and righteous. May you possess all attributes and universal knowledge. Be you of agreeable appearance.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अक्षयं यौवनं तेऽस्तु तेजश्चैवानलोपमम्। क्षीरोदः सागरश्चैव यत्र यत्रेच्छसि प्रियम्॥ तत्र ते भविता कामं सांनिध्यं पयसो निधेः। क्षीरोदनं च भुड्क्ष्व त्वममृतेन समन्वितम्॥
en: May you possess everlasting youth, and let your energy be like that of fire. Whenever, again, you may wish for the presence, which is so agreeable to you, of the ocean of milk, there shall that ocean appear before you. Do you, with your friends, always obtain food prepared with milk, with the celestial nectar being mixed। with it.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: बन्धुभिः सहितः कल्पं ततो मामुपयास्यसि। अक्षया बान्धवाश्चैव कुलं गोत्रं च ते सदा॥
en: After the expiration of an acon you will enjoy my company. Unending shall be your family and race and Kinsmen.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ मयि भक्तिश्च शाश्वती। सांनिध्यं चाश्रमे नित्यं करिष्यामि द्विजोत्तम॥
en: O foremost of twiceborn ones, your devotion to me shall be eternal. And, O best of Brahmanas. I shall always be present at your hermitage.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तिष्ठ वत्स यथाकामं नोत्कण्ठां च करिष्यसि। स्मृतस्त्वया पुनर्विप्र करिष्यामि च दर्शनम्॥
en: Live, O son, wherever you like shorn of anxiety. Thought of by you, I shall, O learned Brahmana, appear before you again.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः। ईशानः स वरान् दत्त्वा तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Having said these words, and granted me these boons, the illustrious Ishana, effulgent like millions of Suns, disappeared there and then.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवं दृष्टो मया कृष्ण देवदेवः समाधिना। तदवाप्तं च मे सर्वं यदुक्तं तेन धीमता॥
en: It was even, O Krishna, that I saw, with the help of austere penances, that God of gods. I also got all that was said by the great God endued with supreme intelligence.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: प्रत्यक्षं चैव ते कृष्ण पश्य सिद्धान् व्यवस्थितान्। ऋषीन् विद्याधरान् यक्षान् गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा॥
en: See, O Krishna, before your eyes, these Siddhas living here and these Rishis and Vidyadharas and Yakshas and Gandharvas and Apsaras.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: पश्य वृक्षलतागुल्मान् सर्वपुष्पफलप्रदान्। सर्वर्तुकुसुमैर्युक्तान् सुखपत्रान् सुगन्धितः॥
en: See these trees and creepers and plants yielding all sorts of flowers and fruits. See them bearing the flowers of every season, with beautiful leaves, and spreading a sweet smell all around.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सर्वमेतन्महाबाहो दिव्यभावसमन्वितम्। प्रसादाद् देवदेवस्य ईश्वरस्य महात्मनः॥
en: O you of mighty arms, all these are gifted with a celestial nature through the favour of that god of gods, that supreme Lord, that great Deity.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वासुदेव उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य प्रत्यक्षमिव दर्शनम्। विस्मयं परमं गत्वा अध्रुवं तं महामुनिम्॥ धन्यस्त्वमसि विप्रेन्द्र कस्त्वदन्योऽसि पुण्यकृत्। यस्य देवाधिदेवस्ते सांनिध्यं कुरुतेऽऽश्रमे॥
en: Vasudeva continued Hearing these words of his and seeing, as it were, with my own eyes all that he had described to me, I became filled with wonder. I then addressed the great ascetic Upamanyu and said to him, Highly praiseworthy as you are, O foremost of learned Brahmanas, for what righteous man is there except you whose retreat enjoys the distinction of being honoured with the presence of that God of gods.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अपि तावन्ममाप्येवं दद्यात् स भगवाञ्छिवः। दर्शनं मुनिशार्दूल प्रसादं चापि शंकरः॥
en: Will the powerful Shiva, will the great Shankara, O chief of ascetics, grant me also a sight of his body and show me favour?

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: उपमन्यु उवाच द्रक्ष्यसे पुण्डरीकाक्ष महादेवं न संशयः। अचिरेणैव कालेन यथा दृष्टो मयानघ॥
en: Upamanyu said Forsooth, O you having eyes like lotus petals, you will very soon see Mahadeva as, O sinless one, I succeeded in seeing him.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: चक्षुषा चैव दिव्येन पश्याम्यमितविक्रमम्। षष्ठे मासि महादेवं द्रक्ष्यसे पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: O you of immeasurable prowess, I see with my spiritual eyes that you will in the sixth month from, this, succeed in getting a sight of Mahadeva, O best of all persons.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: षोडशाष्टौ वरांश्चापि प्राप्स्यसि त्वं महेश्वरात्। सपत्नीकाद् यदुश्रेष्ठ सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: You, O foremost of the Yadus, will obtain from Maheshvara and his wife twentyfour boons. I tell you what is true.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अतीतानागतं चैव वर्तमानं च नित्यशः। विदितं मे महाबाहो प्रसादात् तस्य धीमतः॥
en: Through the favour of that Deity gifted with supreme wisdom, I know the Past, the Future, and the Present.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एतान् सहस्रशश्चान्यान् समनुध्यातवान् हरः। कस्मात् प्रसादं भगवान् न कुर्यात् तव माधव।।३७५। त्वादृशेन हिं देवानां श्लाघनीयः समागमः। ब्रह्मण्येनानृशंसेन श्रद्दधानेन चाप्युत॥ जप्यं तु ते प्रदास्यामि येन द्रक्ष्यसि शंकरम्।
en: The great Hara has favoured these thousands of Rishis and others. Why will not the powerful Deity show favour to you, O Madhava! I always like the meeting of the gods as does one like you, who is devoted to the Brahmanas, who is full of mercy and who is full of faith. I shall give you certain Mantras. Recite them continuously. By this you are sure to see Shankara!

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: विष्णु उवाच अब्रुवं तमहं ब्रह्मंस्त्वत्प्रसादान्महामुने॥ द्रक्ष्ये क्षितिजसंघानां मर्दनं त्रिदशेश्वरम्।
en: The blessed Vishnu said I then said to him O twiceborn one, through your favour, O great ascetic, I shall see the lord of the deities, that grinder of Diti's numberless sons.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवं कथयतस्तस्य महादेवाश्रितां कथाम्॥ दिनान्यष्टौ ततो जग्मुर्मुहूर्तमिव भारत।
en: Eight days, O Bharata, passed there like an hour, all of us being thus occupied with talk on Mahadeva.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दिनेऽष्टमे तु विप्रेण दीक्षितोऽहं यथाविधि॥ दण्डी मुण्डी कुशी चीरी घृताक्तो मेखली कृतः।
en: On the eighth day, I underwent the initiation according to due rites, at the hands of that Brahmana. I received the staff from his hands. I went through the prescribed shave. I took up a quantity of Kusha blades in my hand. I wore rags for my raiment's. I rubbed my person with clarified butter. I put a cord of Munja grass round my loins.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: मासमेकं फलाहारो द्वितीयं सलिलाशनः॥ तृतीयं च चतुर्थं च पञ्चमं चानिलाशनः।
en: For one month, I lived on fruits. The second month I lived upon water. The third, the fourth, and the fifth months I passed, living upon air only.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एकपादेन तिष्ठंश्च ऊर्ध्वबाहुरतन्द्रितः॥ तेजः सूर्यसहस्रस्य अपश्यं दिवि भारत।
en: I stood all the while, upon one foot, and with my arms also raised upwards, and giving up sleep for all the time. I then saw, O Bharata, in the sky a light that seemed to be as dazzling as that of a thousand Suns.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तस्य मध्यगतं चापि तेजसः पाण्डुनन्दन॥ इन्द्रायुधपिनद्धाङ्गं विद्युन्मालागवाक्षकम्।
en: Towards the centre of that effulgence, O son of Pandu, I saw a cloud loO king like a mass of blue hills, adorned with rows of cranes, decorated with many a grand rainbow, with flashes of lightning and the fire loO king like eyes set on it.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नीलशैलचयप्रख्यं वलाकाभूषिताम्बरम्॥ तत्र स्थितश्च भगवान् देव्या सह महाद्युतिः। तपसा तेजसा कान्त्या दीप्तया सह भार्यया।॥
en: Within that cloud was the powerful Mahadeva, himself of dazzling splendour, accompanied by his consort Uma. Indeed, the great God appeared to shine with his penances, energy, beauty, effulgence, and his beloved consort by his side.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: रराज भगवांस्तत्र देव्या सह महेश्वरः। सोमेन सहितः सूर्यो यथा मेघस्थितस्तथा॥
en: The powerful Maheshvara, with his wife by his side, shone in the midst of that cloud. The appearance seemed to be like that of the Sun in the midst of clouds with the Moon by his side.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: संहृष्टरोमा कौन्तेय विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः। अपश्यं देवसंघानां गतिमार्तिहरं हरम्॥
en: The hair on my body, O son of Kunti, stood erect, and my eyes expanded with wonder upon seeing Hara, the refuge of all the gods and the remover of all their griefs.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: किरीटिनं गदिनं शूलपाणिं व्याघ्राजिनं जटिलं दण्डपाणिम्। पिनाकिन वज्रिणं तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्र शुभाङ्गदं व्यालयज्ञोपवीतम्॥
en: Mahadeva was adorned with a diadem on his head. He was armed with his Shula. He was clad in a tigerskin, had matted locks on his head, and bore the staff in one of his hands. He was armed, besides, with his Pinaka and the thunderbolt. His teeth were sharp pointed. He was adorned with an excellent bracelet for the upper arm. His sacred thread was formed by a snake.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: दिव्यां मालामुरसानेकवर्णां समुद्वहन्तं गुल्फदेशावलम्बाम्। चन्द्रं यथा परिविष्टं ससंध्यं वर्षात्यये तद्वदपश्यमेनम्॥
en: He wore an excellent garland of various colours on his bosom, that hung down to his toes. Indeed, I saw him like the highly bright moon of an autumnal evening.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: प्रमथानां गणैश्चैव समन्तात् परिवारितम्। शरदीव सुदुष्प्रेक्ष्यं परिविष्टं दिवाकरम्॥
en: Surrounded by various clans of spirits and ghosts, he appeared like the autumnal Sun difficult of being looked at for its dazzling brightness.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एकादशशतान्येवं रुद्राणां वृषवाहनम्। अस्तुवं नियतात्मानं कर्मभिः शुभकर्मिणम्॥
en: A thousand and hundred Rudras stood around that God of controlled soul and white deeds, seated upon his bull. All of them were employed in singing his praises.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: आदित्या वसवः साध्या विश्वेदेवास्तथाश्विनौ। विश्वाभिःस्तुतिभिर्देवं विश्वदेवं समस्तुवम्॥
en: The Adityas, the Vasus, the Sadhyas, the Vishvedevas, and the twin Ashvins praised that Lord of the universe, by singing the hymns.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शतक्रतुश्च भगवान् विष्णुश्चादितिनन्दनौ। ब्रह्मा रथन्तरं साम ईरयन्ति भवान्तिके॥
en: The powerful Indra and his brother Upendra, the two sons of Aditi, and the Grandfather Brahman, all sang in the presence of Bhava the Rathantara Saman.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: योगीश्वराः सुबहवो योगदं पितरं गुरुम्। ब्रह्मर्षयश्च ससुतास्तथा देवर्षयश्च वै॥ पृथिवी चान्तरिक्षं च नक्षत्राणि ग्रहास्तथा। मासार्धमासा ऋतवो रात्रिः संवत्सराः क्षणाः।।३९४ मुहूर्ताश्च निमेषाश्च तथैव युगपर्ययाः। दिव्या राजन् नमस्यन्ति विद्याः सत्त्वविदस्तथा।।३९५
en: Numberless masters of Yoga, all the twiceborn Rishis with their children, all the celestial Rishis, the goddess Earth, the Sky, the Constellations, the Planets, the Months, the Fortnights, the Seasons, Night, the Years, the Kshanas, the Muhurtas, the Nimeshas, the Yugas one after another, all the celestial Sciences and branches of knowledge, all beings conversant with Truth, were seen bowing down that Supreme Preceptor, that great Father, that giver of Yoga.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सनत्कुमारो देवाश्च इतिहासास्तथैव च। मरीचिरङ्गिरा अत्रिः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः॥ मनवः सप्त सोमश्च अथर्वा सबृहस्पतिः। भृगुर्दक्षः कश्यपश्च वसिष्ठः काश्य एव च॥ छन्दांसि दीक्षा यज्ञाश्च दक्षिणाः पावको हविः। यज्ञोपगानि द्रव्याणि मूर्तिमन्ति युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Sanatkumara, the Vedas, the Histories, Marichi, Angiras, Atri, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, the seven Manus, Soma, the Atharvans, and Brihaspati, Bhrigu, Daksha, Kashyapa, Vasishtha, Kashya, the Chchandas, Diksha, the Sacrifices, Dakshina, the Sacrificial Fires, the Haris poured in sacrifices, and all the articles of the sacrifices, . were seen by me, O Yudhishthira, standing there in their embodied forms.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: प्रजानां पालकाः सर्वे सरितः पन्नगा नगाः। देवानां मातरः सर्वा देवपल्यः सकन्यकाः॥ सहस्राणि मुनीनां च अयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। नमस्यन्ति प्रभुं शान्तं पर्वताः सागरा दिशः॥ गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव गीतवादित्रकोविदाः। दिव्यतालेषु गायन्तः स्तुवन्ति भवमद्भुतम्॥ विद्याधरा दानवाश्च गुह्यका राक्षसास्तथा। सर्वाणि चैव भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च। नमस्यन्ति महाराज वाङ्मनःकर्मभिर्विभुम्॥
en: All the presiding deities of the worlds, all the Rivers, all the snakes, the mountains, the celestial Mothers, all the wives and daughters of the celestials, thousands upon thousands and millions of ascetics, were seen to bow down to that powerful Lord who is the soul of tranquility. The Mountains, the Oceans, and the Points of the compass also did the same, the Gandharvas and the Apsaras highly proficient in music, in celestial songs, sang and hymned the praises of Bhava who is full of wonder, The Vidyadharas, the Danavas, the Guhyakas, the Rakshasas, and all created beings mobile and immobile were worshipping, in thought, word, and deed that powerful Lord.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: पुरस्ताद् धिष्ठितः शर्वो ममासीत् त्रिदशेश्वरः। पुरस्ताद् धिष्ठितं दृष्ट्वा ममेशानं च भारत॥ सप्रजापतिशक्रान्तं जगन्मामभ्युदैक्षत।
en: That Lord of all the gods, viz., Sarva, appeared before me, seated in all his glory. Seeing that Ishana had showed himself to me by being seated in glory before my eyes, the whole universe, with the Grandfather and Shakra, looked at me.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: ईक्षितुं च महादेवं न मे शक्तिरभूत् तदा॥ ततो मामब्रवीद् देवः पश्य कृष्ण वदस्व च।
en: I, however, had not the power to look at Mahadeva. The great god then addressed me, saying see, OKrishna, and speak to me!

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: त्वया ह्याराधितश्चाहं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ त्वत्समो नास्ति मे कश्चित् त्रिषु लाकेषु वै प्रियः।
en: You have worshipped me hundreds and thousands of times. There is no one in the three worlds who is dearer to me than you!

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: शिरसा वन्दिते देवे देवी प्रीता झुमा तदा। ततोऽहमब्रुवं स्थाणुं स्तुतं ब्रह्मादिभिः सुरैः॥
en: After I had bowed to him, his wife, viz., the goddess Uma, became pleased with me. I then addressed in these words the great God whose praises are hymned by all the gods headed by the Grandfather Brahman.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: नमोऽस्तु ते शाश्वत सर्वयोने ब्रह्माधिपं त्वामृषयो वदन्ति। तपश्च सत्त्वं च रजस्तमश्च त्वामेव सत्यं च वदन्ति सन्तः॥
en: I saluted Mahadeva, saying I bow to you, o you, who are the origin of all things. The Rishis declare that you are the master of the Vedas. The pious hold that you are Penance, you are Sattwa, you are Rajas, you are Tamas, and you are Truth.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: त्वं वै ब्रह्मा च रुद्रश्च वरुणोऽग्निर्मनुर्भवः। धाता त्वष्टा विधाता च त्वं प्रभुः सर्वतोमुखः॥४०८।
en: You are Brahman, you are Rudra, you are Veruna, you are Agni, you are Manu, you are Bhava, you are Dhatri, you are Tashtri, you are Vidhatri, you are the powerful Lord of all things, you are everywhere.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: त्वत्तो जातानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च। त्वया सृष्टमिदं कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्॥
en: All beings, mobile and immobile, have originated from you. You have created this world with all its mobile and immobile creations.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यानीन्द्रियाणीह मनश्च कृत्स्रं ये वायवः सप्त तथैव चाग्नयः। ये देवसंस्थास्तवदेवताश्च तस्मात् परं त्वामृषयो वदन्ति॥
en: The Rishis say that you are superior to the senses, the mind, the vital air, the seven fires, everything else which rests upon the allpervading Soul and all the celestials who are worshipped.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वेदाश्च यज्ञाः सोमश्च दक्षिणा पावको हविः। यज्ञोपगं च यत् किंचिद् भगवांस्तदसंशयम्॥
en: You, O illustrious one, are the Vedas, the Sacrifices, Soma. Dakshina, Pavaka, Havi and all other ingredients of sacrifice.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: इष्टं दत्तमधीतं च व्रतानि नियमाश्च ये। ह्वीः कीर्तिः श्रीर्युतिस्तुष्टिः सिद्धिश्चैव तदर्पणी।।४१२
en: The merit of sacrifices, gifts, the study of the Vedas, vows, practices of restraint, Modesty, Fame, Prosperity, Glory, Contentment, and Success, are all for acquiring you.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: काम: क्रोधो भयं लोभो मदः स्तम्भोऽथ मत्सरः। आधयो व्याधयश्चैव भगवंस्तनवस्तव॥
en: Desire, Anger, Fear, Cupidity, Pride, Stupefaction, and Malice, Pains and Diseases, are, O illustrious one, all your offspring.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: कृतिर्विकारः प्रणयः प्रधानं बीजमव्ययम्। मनसः परमा योनिः प्रभावश्चापि शाश्वतः॥
en: You are the acts of creatures, you are the joy and sorrow of those acts, you are the absence of joy and sorrow, you are that Nescience which is the eternal seeds of Desire, you are the great origin of Mind, you are Power, and you are Eternity.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: अव्यक्तः पावनोऽचिन्त्यः सहस्रांशुर्हिरण्मयः। आदिर्गणानां सर्वेषां भवान् वै जीविताश्चयः॥
en: You are the Unmanifest, you are Pavana, you are inconceivable, you are the thousand rayed Sun, you are the shining intelligence, you are the first of all the subjects, and you are the support of life.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: महानात्मा मतिर्ब्रह्मा विश्वः शम्भु स्वयम्भुवः। बुद्धिः प्रज्ञोपलब्धिश्च संविख्यातिधृतिःस्मृतिः।।४१६ पर्यायवाचकैः शब्दैर्महानात्मा विभाव्यते। त्वां बुद्ध्वा ब्राह्मणो वेदात् प्रमोहं विनियच्छति॥४१७
en: By the words Greatness, Soul Understanding, Brahman, Universe, Shambhu, and Selfcreate, as well as other words seen (in the Vedas), your nature is comprehended as being at one with Greatness and Soul. Knowing you as all this, the learned Brahmana conquers that Ignorance which is the root of the world.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: हृदयं सर्वभूतानां क्षेत्रज्ञस्त्वमृषिस्तुतः। सर्वत:पाणिपादस्त्वं सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखः॥
en: You are the heart of all creatures, and you are worshipped by the Rishis as Soul. Your arms and feet extend to every place, and your eyes, head, and face are everywhere. You hear everywhere in the universe, and you exist permeating everything.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: सर्वतःश्रुतिमाल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठसि। फलं त्वमसि तिग्मांशोर्निमेषादिषु कर्मसु॥
en: You are the fruit of all acts which are performed in the Nimeshas and other divisions of time which originate from the Sun.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: त्वं वै प्रभार्चिः पुरुषः सर्वस्य हृदि संश्रितः। अणिमा महिमा प्राप्तिरीशानो ज्योतिरव्ययः॥
en: You are the original lustre. You are Male Being living in the hearts of all things. You are the successful fruits of Yoga.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: त्वयि बुद्धिर्मतिर्लोकाः प्रपन्नाः संश्रिताश्च ये। ध्यानिनो नित्ययोगाश्च सत्यसत्त्वा जितेन्द्रियाः॥
en: Understanding and Intelligence and all the worlds depend upon you. Those who are given to meditation, who are always busy with Yoga, who are devoted to or firm in Truth and who have conquered their passions, seek you and depend on you.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: यस्त्वां ध्रुवं वेदयते गुहाशयं प्रभुं पुराणं पुरुषं च विग्रहम्। हिरण्मयं बुद्धिमतां परां गतिं स बुद्धिमान् बुद्धिमतीत्य तिष्ठति॥
en: They who know you the unchangeable, or one who lives in all hearts, or one who is endowed with supreme power, or one who is the ancient Male Being, or one who is pure Knowledge, or one that is the effulgent understanding, or one that is the highest refuge of all persons gifted with intelligence, are, indeed, highly intelligent men. Indeed such persons reign supreme over intelligence. as one seven

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: विदित्वा सप्त सूक्ष्माणि षडङ्गं त्वां च मूर्तितः। प्रधानविधियोगस्थस्त्वामेव विशते बुधः॥
en: By understanding the subtile principles, by comprehending your six attributes, and by mastering the true Yoga, the man of knowledge succeeds in entering into your great self.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: एवमुक्ते मया पार्थ भवे चार्तिविनाशने। चराचरं जगत् सर्वं सिंहनादं तदाकरोत्॥
en: After I had said these words, O Partha, to Bhava, that remover of grief and pain, the universe, both mobile and immobile, roared like a lion.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: तं विप्रसंघाश्च सुरासुराश्च नागाः पिशाचाः पितरो वयांसि। रक्षोगणा भूतगणाश्च सर्वे महर्षयश्चैव तदा प्रणेमुः॥
en: The numberless Brahmans present there, the gods and the Asuras, the Nagas, the Pishachas, the Pitris, the birds, various Rakshasas various classes of ghosts and spirits, and all the great Rishis, then bowed down to that great Deity.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: मम मूर्ध्नि च दिव्यानां कुसुमानां सुगन्धिनाम्। राशयो निपतन्ति स्प वायुश्च सुसुखो ववौ॥
en: There then, dropped upon my head showers of highly fragrant celestial flowers and sweet winds blew on the spot.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: निरीक्ष्य भगवान् देवी ह्युमां मां च जगद्धितः। शतक्रतुं चाभिवीक्ष्य स्वयं मामाह शङ्करः॥
en: The powerful Shankara then, given to the behoof of the universe, looked at the goddess Uma, and the king of the celestials and myself also, and thus spoke to me.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: विदुः कृष्ण परां भक्तिमस्मासु तव शत्रुहान्। क्रियतामात्मनः श्रेयः प्रीतिर्हि त्वयि मे परा॥
en: We know, O Krishna, that you, O slayer of foes, are greatly devoted to us! Do what is for your good. My love and affection for you is very great.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वृणीष्वाष्टौ वरान् कृष्ण दातास्मि तव सत्तम। ब्रूहि यादवशार्दूल यानिच्छसि सुदुर्लभान्॥
en: Do you ask for eight boons. I shall grant them, O Krishna, O best of all persons. Tell me what they are, O chief of the Yadavas. Say what you wish. You will have them, however difficult of attainment they may be.

description: All the names of Shambhu. The duties of husband and wife
sn: वृणीष्वाष्टौ वरान् कृष्ण दातास्मि तव सत्तम। ब्रूहि यादवशार्दूल यानिच्छसि सुदुर्लभान्॥
en: Do you ask for eight boons. I shall grant them, O Krishna, O best of all persons. Tell me what they are, O chief of the Yadavas. Say what you wish. You will have them, however difficult of attainment they may be.

sn: कृष्ण उवाच मूर्जा निपत्य नियतस्तेजःसंनिचये ततः। परमं हर्षमागत्य भगवन्तमथाब्रुवम्॥
en: Krishna said Bending low my head with a controlled soul to that mass of energy and effulgence, I said to the great god, with a joyous heart, these words

sn: धर्मे दृढत्वं युधि शत्रुघातं यशस्तथाग्र्यं परमं बलं च। योगप्रियत्वं तव संनिकर्ष वृणे सुतानां च शतं शतानि॥
en: I ask for these boons from you, namely firmness in virtue, the destruction of enemies in battle, the highest glory, the greatest power, devotion to Yoga, your nearness, and hundreds upon hundreds of children.

sn: एवमस्त्विति तद्वाक्यं मयोक्तः प्राह शङ्करः। ततो मां जगतो माता धारिणी सर्वपावनी॥ उवाचोमा प्रणिहिता शर्वाणी तपसां निधिः। दत्तो भगवता पुत्रः साम्बो नाम तवानघ।॥
en: Whereto Shankara said, so be it, repeating the words I had said. After this, the mother of the universe, the upholdress of all things, she who purifies all things, viz., the wife of Sarva that huge receptacle of penances, said with controlled soul, these words to me: The powerful Mahadeva has granted you, O sinless one, a son who shall be named Shamba.

sn: मत्तोऽप्यष्टौ वरानिष्टान् गृहाण त्वं ददामि ते। प्रणम्य शिरसा सा च मयोक्ता पाण्डुनन्दन।॥
en: Do you take from me also eight boons which you choose. I shall, indeed, grant them to you. Bowing her with my head bended, I said to her, O son of Pandu!

sn: द्विजेष्वकोपं पितृतः प्रसाद शतं सुतानां परमं च भोगम्। कुले प्रीतिं मातृतश्च प्रसाद शमप्राप्तिं प्रवृणे चापि दाक्ष्यम्॥
en: I pray from you uniform affection for the Brahmanas, the favour of my father, a hundred sons, the highest enjoyments, love for my family, the favour of my mother, the attainment of tranquility and peace, and cleverness in every deed.

sn: उमा उवाच एवं भविष्यत्यमरप्रभाव नाहं मृषा जातु वदे कदाचित्। भार्यासहस्राणि च षोडशैव तासु प्रियत्वं च तथाक्षयं च॥
en: Uma Said You will have them, O you, who are endued with prowess equal to that of a celestial. I never say what is untrue. You will have sixteen thousand wives. Your love for them and theirs also for you shall be limitless.

sn: प्रीतिं चाग्र्यां बान्धवानां सकाशाद् ददामि तेऽहं वपुषः काम्यतां च। भोक्ष्यन्ते वै सप्ततिं वै शतानि गृहे तुभ्यमतिथीनां च नित्यम्॥
en: From all your kinsmen also, you will get the highest affection. You will have a most beautiful person. Seven thousand guests will daily feed at your palace.

sn: एवं दत्त्वा वरान् देवो मम देवी च भारत। अन्तर्हितः क्षणे तस्मिन् सगणो भीमपूर्वज॥
en: Vasudeva continued Having thus granted me boons both the god and the goddess, O Bharata, disappeared there and then with their associates, O elder brother of Bhima.

sn: एतदत्यद्भुतं पूर्वं ब्राह्मणायातितेजसे। उपमन्यवे मया कृत्स्नं व्याख्यातं पार्थिवोत्तम। नमस्कृत्वा तु स प्राह देवदेवाय सुव्रत॥
en: All those wonderful deeds I described fully, O best of kings, to that highly energetic Brahmana Upamanyu. Bowing down to the great God, Upamanyu said these words to me.

sn: उपमन्युरुवाच नास्ति शर्वसमो देवो नास्ति शर्वसमा गतिः। नास्ति शर्वसमो दाने नास्ति शर्वसमो रणे॥
en: Upamanyu said There is no god like Sarva. There is no end or refuge like Sarva. There is none who can grant so inany or so high boons. There is none who is his equal in battle.

sn: उपमन्युरुवाच ऋषिरासीत् कृते तात तण्डिरित्येव विश्रुतः। दशवर्षसहस्राणि तेन देव: समाधिना॥ आराधितोऽभूद् भक्तेन तस्योदकं निशामय। स दृष्टवान् महादेवमस्तौषीच्च स्तवैर्विभुम्॥
