en: I shall obey you implicitly in every thing and you will sport with me according to your pleasure! All objects of desire that are human or that belong to heaven shall be enjoyed by us.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: नातः परं हि नारीणां विद्यते च कदाचन॥ यथा पुरुषसंसर्गः परमेतद्धि नः फलम्।
en: There is no other pleasure more agreeable to women. Indeed, union with a person of the opposite sex is the most desirable object of joy that we can get.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: आत्मच्छन्देन वर्तन्ते नार्यो मन्मथचोदिताः॥ न च दह्यन्ति गच्छन्त्यः सुतप्तैरपि पांसुभिः।
en: When moved by the god of love women become very whimsical. Then they do not feel any pain even they walk over a desert of burning sand.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: अष्टावक्र उवाच परदारनहं भद्रे न गच्छेयं कथंचन॥ दूषितं धर्मशास्त्रज्ञैः परदाराभिमर्शनम्।
en: Ashtavakra said O blessed lady, I never approach another's wife. One's union with another man's wife is condemned by persons conversant with the scriptures on morality.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: भद्रे निवेष्टुकामं मां विद्धि सत्येन वै शपे॥ विषयेष्वनभिज्ञोऽहं धर्मार्थं किल संततिः।
en: I am an utter stranger to enjoyments of every kind. O blessed lady, know that I have become desirous of marriage for getting children. I swear by truth itself.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: एवं लोकान् गमिष्यामि पुत्रैरिति न संशयः॥ भद्रे धर्मे विजानीहि ज्ञात्वा चोपरमस्व ह।
en: Through the help of offspring righteously got, I shall proceed to those regions of happiness which cannot be attained without such help. O good lady, know what is consistent with morality, and knowing desist from your efforts.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: स्व्युवाच नानिलोऽग्निर्न वरुणो न चान्ये त्रिदशा द्विज॥ प्रियाः स्त्रीणां यथा कामोरतिशीला हि योषितः।
en: The lady said The very gods of wind and fire and water, or the other celestials, O twice born one are not so agreeable to women as the god of love. Indeed women are greatly fond of sexual union.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: सहस्रे किल नारीणां प्राप्येतैका कदाचन॥ तथा शतसहस्रेषु यदि काचित् पतिव्रता।
en: Among a thousand women, or perhaps, among hundreds of thousands, sometimes only one may be found who is devoted to her husband.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: नैता जानन्ति पितरं न कुलं न च मातरम्॥ न भ्रातॄन् न च भर्तारं न च पुत्रान् न देवरान्।
en: Under the influence of desire, they care not for fainily or father or mother or brother or husband or sons or husband's brother.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: लीलायन्त्यः कुलं घ्नन्ति कूलानीव सरिद्वराः। दोषान् सर्वांश्च मत्वाऽऽशु प्रजापतिरभाषत॥
en: Seeking what they consider happiness, they destroy the family even as many rivers wash away the banks that contain them. The Creator himself had said this marking the faults of women.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: भीष्म उवाच ततः स ऋषिरेकाग्रस्तां स्त्रियं प्रत्यभाषत। आस्यतां रुचितश्छन्दः किं च कार्यं ब्रवीहि मे॥
en: Bhishma said The Rishi, bent upon finding out the faults of women, addressed that lady saying Cease to speak to me thus! Yearning originates from liking. Tell ine what I am to do.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: सा स्त्री प्रोवाच भगवन् द्रक्ष्यसे देशकालतः। वस तावन्महाभाग कृतकृत्यो भविष्यसि॥
en: That lady then said in return illustrious one you will all see according to time and place. Do you only live here (for sometime), O highly blessed one, and I shall consider myself sufficiently rewarded!

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: ब्रह्मर्पिस्तामथोवाच स तथेति युधिष्ठिर। वत्स्येऽहं यावदुत्साहो भवत्या नात्र संशयः॥ अथर्षिरभिसम्प्रेक्ष्य स्त्रियं तां जरयार्दिताम्। चिन्तां परमिकां भेजे संतप्त इव चाभवत्॥
en: Thus addressed by her, the twice born Rishi, O Yudhishthira, expressed his resolution to satisfy her request, saying I shall live with you in this place as long as I can venture to do so. The Rishi then seeing that lady possessed by decrepitude, began to think seriously on the matter. He appeared to be even pained by his thoughts.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: यद् यदकं हि सोऽपश्यत् तस्या विप्रर्षभस्तदा। नारमत् तत्र तत्रास्य दृष्टी रूपविरागिता॥
en: The eyes of that foremost of Brahmanas could not get any delight from those parts of that lady's person whereupon they were fixed. On the other hand, his looks appeared to be dispelled by the ugliness of those particular limbs.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: देवतेयं गृहस्यास्य शापात् किं नु विरूपिता। अस्याश्च कारणं वेत्तुं न युक्तं सहसा मया॥
en: This lady is forsooth, the mistress of this palace. Has she been made ugly through some curse! It is not proper that I should quickly determine the cause of this.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: इति चिन्ताविविक्तस्य तमर्थे ज्ञातुमिच्छतः। व्यगच्छत् तदहःशेषं मनसा व्याकुलेन तु॥
en: Thinking thus in his heart and curious to know the reason the Rishi passed the rest of that day in anxiety.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: अथ सा स्त्री तथोवाच भगवन् पश्य वै रवेः। रूपं संध्याभ्रसंरक्तं किमुपस्थाष्यतां तव॥
en: The lady then addressed him, saying O illustrious one, look at the Sun reddened by the evening clouds! What service shall I do to you.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Asthavakra and Disha
sn: स उवाच ततस्तां स्त्री स्नानोदकमिहानय। उपासिष्ये ततः सन्ध्यां वाग्यतो नियतेन्द्रिय॥
en: The Rishi addressed her saying 'Fetch water for my ablution! Having bathed, I shall recite my evening prayers, controlling my tongue and the senses.'

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: भीष्म उवाच अथ सा स्त्री तमुवाच बाढमेवं भवत्विति। तैलं दिव्यमुपादाय स्नानशाटीमुपानयत्॥
en: Bhishma said Thus ordered the lady said Be it so! She then brought oil and a piece of cloth for his wear during the ablutions.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: अनुज्ञाता च मुनिना सा स्त्री तेन महात्मना। अथास्य तैलेनाङ्गानि सर्वाण्येवाभ्यमृक्षत॥
en: With the ascetic's permission she rubbed every part of his body with the fragrant oil she had brought for him.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: शनैश्चोत्सादितस्तत्र स्नानशालामुपागमत्। भद्रासन ततश्चित्रमृषिरन्वगमन्नवम्॥
en: The Rishi was rubbed, and when the process of rubbing was over, he went to the room set apart set apart for the performance of ablutions. There he sat upon a new and Excellent seat.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: अथोपविष्टश्च यदा तस्मिन् भद्रासने तदा। स्नापयामास शनकैस्तमृषि सुखहस्तवत्॥
en: After the Rishi had taken his seat upon it, the old lady began to wash his body with her own soft hands whose touch was highly agrecable.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: दिव्यं च विधिवच्चक्रे सोपचारं मुनेस्तदा। स तेन सुसुखोष्णेन तस्या हस्तसुखेन च॥ व्यतीतां रजनी कृत्स्ना नाजानात् स महाव्रतः। तत उत्थाय स मुनिस्तदा परमविस्मितः॥
en: One after another in due course the lady helped the Rishi in his ablutions. Between the lukewarm water with which he was washed, and the soft hands which were engaged in washing him, the Rishi of rigid vows could not understand that the whole night had passed away in the work. Rising from the bath, the Rishi became highly surprised.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: पूर्वस्यां दिशि सूर्ये च सोऽपश्यदुदितं दिवि। तस्य बुद्धिरयं किं नु मोहस्तत्त्वमिदं भवेत्॥
en: He saw the Sun risen above the horizon on the East. He was surprised at this and asked himself Was it really so or was it a mistake of the understanding.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: अथोपास्य सहस्रांशुं किं करोमीत्युवाच ताम्। सा चामृतरसप्रख्यं ऋषेरन्नमुपाहरत्॥
en: The Rishi then duly adored the god of a thousand rays. This done, he asked the lady as to what he should do. The old lady prepared some food for the Rishi sweet to the taste like ambrosia itself.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: तस्य स्वादुतयानस्य न प्रभूतं चकार सः। व्यगमच्चाप्यहःशेषं ततः संध्यागमत् पुनः॥
en: On account of the sweetness of that food the Rishi could not take much. In taking that little however, the day passed away and evening set in.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: अथ सा स्त्री भगवन्तं सुप्यतामित्यचोदयत्। तत्र वै शयने दिव्ये तस्य तस्याश्च कल्पिते॥
en: The old lady then asked the Rishi to go to bed and sleep. An excellent bed was given ts) the Rishi and another was taken by herself.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: पृथक् चैव तथा सुप्तौ सा स्त्री स च मुनिस्तदा। तथार्धरात्रे सा स्त्री तु शयनं तदुपागमत्॥
en: The Rishi and the old lady occupied different beds at first but when it was midnight, the lady left her own bed for that of the Rishi.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: अष्टवक्र उवाच न भद्रे परदारेषु मनो मे सम्प्रसज्जति। उत्तिष्ठ भद्रे भद्रं ते स्वयं वै विरमस्व च॥
en: Ashtavakra said O blessed lady, I am not inclined for sexual union with one who is the wife of another. Leave my bed, O good lady. Blessed be you do, you desist from this of your own accord.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: भीष्म उवाच सा तदा तेन विप्रेण तथा तेन निवर्तिता। स्वतन्त्रास्मीत्युवाचर्षिः न धर्मच्छलमस्ति ते॥
en: Bhishma said Thus dissuaded by the Brahmana with the help of his selfcontrol, the lady answered him saying I am my own mistress! In accepting me you will commit no sin.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: अष्टवक्र उवाच नास्ति स्वतन्त्रता स्त्रीणामस्वतन्त्रा हि योषितः। प्रजापतिमतं ह्येतन्न स्त्री स्वातन्त्र्यमर्हति॥
en: Ashtavakra said Women can never be their own mistresses. This is the opinion of the Creator himself, viz., that a woman should never be indepent.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: स्त्र्युरुवाच बाधते मैथुनं विप्र मम भक्तिं च पश्य वै। अधर्मे प्राप्स्यसे विप्र यन्मां त्वं नाभिनन्दसि॥
en: The lady said O learned Brahmana, I am pained by desire. Mark my devotion to you. You commit sin by refusing to accept me lovingly.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: अष्टवक्र उवाच हरन्ति दोषजातानि नरं जातं यथेच्छकम्। प्रभवामि सदा धृत्या भद्रे स्वशयनं व्रज॥
en: Ashtavakra said Various shortcomings drag away the man who acts as he likes. As for myself I am able to govern my inclinations by selfcontrol. O good lady, return to your own bed.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: स्व्युरुवाच शिरसा प्रणमे विप्र प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि। भूमौ निपतमानायाः शरणं भव मेऽनघ॥
en: The lady said I bow to you. You should show me your favour. O sinless one, I prostrate myself before you, do you become my refuge.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: यदि वा दोषजातं त्वं परदारेषु पश्यसि। आत्मानं स्पर्शयाम्यद्य पाणिं गृह्णीष्व मे द्विज॥
en: If you see sin in knowing one who is not your wife, I yield myself to you. Do you, O twice born one, accept my hand in marriage.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: न दोषो भविता चैव सत्येनैतद् ब्रवीम्यहम्। स्वतन्त्रां मां विजानीहि योऽधर्मः सोऽस्तु वै मयि। त्वय्यावेशितचित्ता च स्वतन्त्रास्मि भजस्व माम्॥
en: You will incur no sin. I tell you truly. Know that I am my own mistress. It there be any sin in this, let it visit me only. My heart is devoted to you. I am my own mistress. Do you accept me.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: अष्टवक्र उवाच स्वतन्त्रा त्वं कथं भद्रे बूहि कारणमत्र वै। नास्ति त्रिलोके स्त्री काचिद् या वै स्वातन्त्र्यमर्हति॥
en: Ashtavakra said How is it, O good lady that you are your own mistress? Tell me the reason of this. There is not a single woman in the three worlds who can be considered as the mistress of her own self.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: पिता रक्षति कौमारे भर्ता रक्षति यौवने। पुत्राश्च स्थविरे काले नास्ति स्त्रीणां स्वतन्त्रता॥
en: The father protects her while she is a maiden. The husband protects her while she is young. Sons protect her when she is aged. Woman can never be independent as long as they live.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: स्व्युरुवाच कौमारं ब्रह्मचर्ये मे कन्यैवास्मि न संशयः। पत्नी कुरुष्व मां विप्र श्रद्धां विजहि मा मम॥
en: The lady said I have, since my maidenhood adopted the vow of celibacy. Do not doubt it. I am still a maid. Do you make me your wife. O Brahmana, do not kill this devotion of mine to you.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: अष्टवक्र उवाच यथा मम तथा तुभ्यं यथा तुभ्यं तथा मम। जिज्ञासेयमषेस्तस्य विघ्नः सत्यं न किं भवेत्॥
en: Ashtavakra said As you are inclined to me so am I inclined to you. There is this question, however, that should be settled. It is true that by giving way to iny inclinations I shall not be considered as acting contrary to what the Rishi (Vadanya) wishes.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: आश्चर्ये परमं हीदं किं नु श्रेयो हि मे भवेत्। दिव्याभरणवस्त्रा हि कन्येयं मामुपस्थिता॥
en: This is very wonderful. Will this lead to what is good? Here is a maiden adorned with good ornaments and robes!

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: किं त्वस्याः परमं रूपं जीर्णमासीत् कथं पुनः। कन्यारूपमिहाद्यैवं किमिवात्रोत्तरं भवेत्॥
en: She is highly beautiful. Why did decrepitude hide her beauty so long? At present she looks like a beautiful maiden. I do not know what forin she may assume hereafter.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: यथा परं शक्तिधृतेर्न व्युत्थास्ये कथंचन। न रोचते हि व्युत्थानं सत्येनासादयाम्यहम्॥
en: I shall never Swerve from that control which I have over desire and the other passions or from contentment with what I have already gol. Such swerving is not good. I shall keep myself united with truth.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच न बिभेति कथं सा स्त्री शापाच्च परमद्युतेः। कथं निवृत्तो भगवांस्तद् भवान् प्रब्रवीतु मे॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me why had that lady no fear of Ashtavakra's curse although Ashtavakra was gified with great energy? How also did Ashtavakra succeed in returning from that palace?

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: भीष्म उवाच अष्टावक्रोऽन्वपृच्छत् तां रूपं विकुरुषे कथम्। न चानृतं ते वक्तव्यं ब्रूहि ब्राह्मणकाम्यया।॥
en: Bhishma said Ashtavakra asked her, saying How do you change your form so? You should not say anything false. I wish to know this. Do you speak truly before a Brahmana.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: स्व्युरुवाच द्यावापृथिव्योर्यत्रैषा काम्या ब्राह्मणसत्तम। शृणुष्वावहितः सर्वे यदिदं सत्यविक्रम॥
en: The lady said O best of Brahmanas, wherever you may live, in the celestial region or on Earth. This desire of union between the sexes is to be observed. O you of infallible prowess, hear with rapt attention, what it all is.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: जिज्ञासेयं प्रयुक्ता मे स्थिरीकर्तुं तवानघ। अव्युत्थानेन ते लोका जिताः सत्यपराक्रम॥
en: This trial was converted by me, O sinless one, for examining you aright, O you of infallible prowess, you have conquered all the worlds by the strength of mind.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: उत्तरां मां दिशं विद्धि दृष्टं स्त्रीचापलं च ते। स्थविराणामपि स्त्रीणां बाधते मैथुनज्वरः॥
en: Know me as the embodiment of the Northern point of the compass. You have seen the lightness of the female character. Even old women are tortured by the desires of sexual union.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: तुष्टः पितामहस्तेऽद्य तथा देवाः सवासवाः। स त्वं येन च कार्येण सम्प्राप्तो भगवानिह॥
en: The grandfather himself and all the gods with Indra have been pleased with you. I know the object for which your illustrious self has come here.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: प्रेषितस्तेन विप्रेण कन्यापित्रा द्विजर्षभ। तवोपदेशं कर्तुं वै तच्च सर्वे कृतं मया॥
en: O foremost of twice born persons, you have been sent here by the Rishi Vadanya the father of your bride in order that I may instruct you. According to the wishes of that Rishi I have already instructed you.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: क्षेमैर्गमिष्यसि गृहं श्रमश्च न भविष्यति। कन्यां प्राप्स्यसि तां विप्र पुत्रिणी च भविष्यति॥
en: You will return home safely. Your journey back will not be toilsome. You will get for wife the girl you have chosen. She will bear you a son.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: काम्यया पृष्टवांस्त्वं मां ततो व्याहृतमुत्तमम्। अनतिक्रमणीया सा कृत्स्नैर्लोकैस्त्रिभिः सदा॥
en: Through desire I had solicited you. You gave me the very best answer. People of the three worlds cannot get over the desire for sexual union.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: गच्छस्व सुकृतं कृत्सा किं चान्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि। यावद् ब्रवीमि विप्रर्षे अष्टावक्र यथातथम्॥
en: Return to your quarters, having achieved such merit. What else is there which yo!' wish to hear (from me)? I shall truly describe it to you, O Ashtavakra.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: ऋषिणा प्रसादिता चास्मि तव हेतोर्द्विजर्षभ। तस्य सम्माननार्थे मे त्वयि वाक्यं प्रभाषितम्॥
en: I was gratified by the Rishi Vadanya in the first instance for your sake, Otwice born ascetic! For the sake of honouring him, I have said all this to you.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: भीष्म उवाच श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्याः स विप्रः प्राञ्जलिः स्थितः। अनुज्ञातस्तया चापि स्वगृहं पुनराव्रजत्॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words of hers, the twiceborn Ashtavakra joined his hands respectfully. He then begged the lady for her permission to return. Getting the permission he sought, he returned to his own hermitage.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: गृहमागत्य विश्रान्तः स्वजनं परिपृच्छय च। अभ्यगच्छच्च तं विप्रं न्यायत: कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Resting himself for sometime at home and getting the permission of his kinsmen and friends, he then, in a proper way, went, O delighter of the Kurus, to the Brahmana Vadanya.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: पृष्टश्च तेन विप्रेण दृष्टं त्वेतन्निदर्शनम्। प्राह विप्रं तदा विप्रः सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना॥
en: Welcomed with the usual enquiries by Vadanya the Rishi Ashtavakra, with a wellpleased heart described all that he had seen.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: भवता समनुज्ञातः प्रास्थितो गन्धमादनम्। तस्य चोत्तरतो देशे दृष्टं मे दैवतं महत्॥
en: He said ordered by you I proceeded to the mountains of Gandhamadana. In the quarter lying to the north of those mountains I saw a very superior goddess,

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: तया चाहमनुज्ञातो भवांश्चापि प्रकीर्तितः। श्रावितश्चापि तद्वाक्यं गृहं चाभ्यागतः प्रभो॥
en: I was received by her with courtesy. She named you before me, and also instructed me in various matters. Having listened to her I have returned,Olord.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: तमुवाच तदा विप्रः सुतां प्रतिगृहाण मे। नक्षत्रविधियोगेन पात्रं हि परमं भवान्॥
en: The learned Vadanya said to him take my daughter's hand according to due rites and under the proper constellations. You are the fittest bridegroom I can select for the girl.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: भीष्म उवाच अष्टावक्रस्तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रतिगृह्य च तां प्रभो। कन्यां परमधर्मात्मा प्रीतिमांश्चाभवत् तदा॥
en: Bhishma said Ashtavakra said So be it! and espoused the girl. Indeed, having married the girl, the highly pious Rishi became filled with joy.

description: The declaration about joint duties on the occasion of a person's marriage. The discourse between Ashtavakra and Disha
sn: कन्यां तां प्रतिगृह्मैव भार्यां परमशोभनाम्। उवास मुदितस्तत्र स्वाश्रमे विगतज्वरः॥
en: Having taken as his wife that beautiful lady, the Rishi continued to live in his own hermitage freed from every sort of mental trouble.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किमाहुर्भरतश्रेष्ठ पात्रं विप्राः सनातनाः। ब्राह्मणं लिङ्गिनं चैव ब्राह्मणं वाप्यलिङ्गिनम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Whom have the eternal Brahmanas selected a proper object of gifts? Is a Brahmana who bears the marks of the order of life he follows to be considered as such, or is one divested of such marks to be so regarded.

sn: भीष्म उवाच स्ववृत्तिमभिपन्नाथ लिङ्गिने चेतराय च। देयमाहुर्महाराज उभावेतौ तपस्विनौ॥
en: Bhishma said O king it has been said that gifts should be made a Brahmana who follows the duties of his own order, whether he bears the marks of Brahmacharya or not, for both are faultless, viz., he who bears such marks and he who is divested of them.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच श्रद्धया परया पूतो यः प्रयच्छेद् द्विजातये। हव्यं कव्यं तथा दानं को दोषः स्यात् पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said What sin does an impure person commit if he makes gifts of sacrificial butter or food or with great devotion to persons of the twice born order?

sn: भीष्म उवाच श्रद्धापूतो नरस्तात दुर्दान्तोऽपि न संशयः। पूतो भवति सर्वत्र किमुत त्वं महाद्युते॥
en: Bhishma said He who has no selfcontrol becomes, forsooth, cleansed by devotion. Such a man, becomes purified in respect of every act.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच न ब्राह्मणं परीक्षेत दैवेषु सततं नरः। कव्यप्रदाने तु बुधाः परीक्ष्यं ब्राह्मणं विदुः॥
en: Yudhishthira said It has been said that a Brahmana who is sought for the performance of a religious rite should never be examined. The learned however, hold that while performing rites for the Pitris the Brahmana who is sought to be engaged, should be examined.

sn: भीष्म उवाच न ब्राह्मणं साध्यते हव्यं दैवात् प्रसिद्ध्यति। देवप्रसादादिज्यन्ते यजमानैर्न संशयः॥
en: Bhishma said As regards the religious rite for the deities these do not yield fruits on account of the Brahmana who is engaged in doing them but through the grace of the deities themselves. Forsooth, those persons who perform sacrifices acquire the merit of those acts, through the favour of the deities.

sn: ब्राह्मणान् भरतश्रेष्ठ सततं ब्रह्मवादिनः। मार्कण्डेयः पुरा प्राह इति लोकेषु बुद्धिमान्॥
en: The Brahmanas, O chief of the Bharatas, are always Utters of Brahma. The intelligent Rishi Markandeya gave vent to these words in days of yore.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अपूर्वोऽप्यथवा विद्वान् सम्बन्धी वा यथा भवेत्। तपस्वी यज्ञशीलो वा कथं पात्र भवेत् तु सः॥
en: Yudhishthira said Why, O grandfather, are these five viz., he who is a stranger, he who is gifted with learning, he who is connected by marriage, he that is endued with penances, and he who is devoted to the performance of sacrifices, considered as proper persons?

sn: भीष्म उवाच कुलीनः कर्मकृद् वैद्यस्तथैवाप्यानृशंस्यवान्। ह्रीमानृजुः सत्यवादी पात्रं पूर्वं च ये त्रयः॥
en: Bhishma said The first three viz., strangers, relatives and ascetics, when endued with these attributes, viz., purity of birth devotion to religious acts, learning mercy modesty, sincerity and truthfulness, are considered as proper persons. The other two, viz., men of learning and those given to sacrifices when gifted with five of these attributes, viz., purity of birth, mercy, modesty, sincerity, and truthfulness, are also considered as proper persons.

sn: तत्रेमं शृणु मे पार्थ चतुर्णां तेजसां मतम्। पृथिव्याः काश्यपस्याग्नेर्मार्कण्डेयस्य चैव हि॥
en: Listen now to me, O son of Pritha, as I recite to you the opinions of these four persons of great energy, viz., the goddess, Earth, the Rishi Kashyapa, the god of fire, and the ascetic Markandeya.

sn: पृथ्वी उवाच यथा महार्णवे क्षिप्तः क्षिप्रं लेष्टुर्विनश्यति। तथा दुश्चरितं सर्वे त्रिवृत्यां च निमज्जति॥
en: The Earth said As a clod of earth when thrown into the great ocean quickly dissolves away so every sort of sin disappears by the three high qualifications of officiation at sacrifices teaching, and receiving of gifts.

sn: कश्यप उवाच सर्वे च वेदाः सह षड्भिरङ्गैः सांख्यं पुराणं च कुले च जन्मा नैतानि सर्वाणि गतिर्भवन्ति शीलव्यपेतस्य नृप द्विजस्य॥
en: Kashyapa said The Vedas with their six auxiliaries the Sankhya philosophy, the Puranas, and high birth, these cannot rescue a twice born person if he falls away from good conduct.

sn: अग्निरुवाच अधीयानः पण्डितं मन्यमानो यो विद्यया हन्ति यशः परेषाम्। प्रभ्रश्यतेऽसौ चरते न सत्यं लोकास्तस्य ह्यन्तवन्तो भवन्ति॥
en: Agni said The Brahmana who engaged in study and considering himself learned, seeks with the help of his learning to destroy the reputation of others falls away from virtue and comes to be regarded as divorced from truth. Such persons of refractory spirit never acquire regions of happiness hereafter.

sn: मार्कण्डेय उवाच अश्वमेधसहस्रं च सत्यं च तुलया धृतम्। नाभिजानामि यद्यस्य सत्यस्यार्धमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Markandeya said If a thousand Horse sacrifices and Truth were weighed in the balance, I do not know whether the former would equal even half of the latter in weight.

sn: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्त्वा ते जग्मुराशु चत्वारोऽमिततेजसः। पृथिवी काश्यपोऽग्निश्च प्रकृष्टायुश्च भार्गवः॥
en: Bhishma said Having spoken these words, those four persons, each of whom is gifted with immeasurable energy, viz., the goddess Earth, Kashyapa, Agni, and Bhrigu's son armed with weapons quickly went away.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यदि ते ब्राह्मणा लोके वतिनो भुञ्जते हविः। दत्तं ब्राह्मणकामाय कथं तत् सुकृतं भवेत्॥१६
en: Yudhishinira said If Brahmanas observing the vow of celibacy in this world eat, begging the same the offerings one makes during funeral rites, I ask can the shraddha be considered wellperformed if the performer actually makes over those offerings to such Brahmanas.

sn: भीष्म उवाच आदिष्टिनो ये राजेन्द्र ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः। भुञ्जते ब्रह्मकामाय व्रतलुप्ता भवन्ति ते॥
en: Bhishma said If, having practised the vow of Brahmacharya for the prescribed period (of twelve years) and acquired proficiency in the Vedas and their branches a Brahmana himself asks for the offerings made in Shraddhas and eats the same, he is considered to fall away from his vow. The Shraddha, however is not considered as sullied in any way.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अनेकान्तं बहुद्वारं धर्ममाहुर्मनीषिणः। किंनिमित्तं भवेदत्र तन्मे बूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said The wise hold that duty or virtue has many ends and numerous doors. Tell me, O grandfather what however are the decisions in this matter.

sn: भीष्म उवाच अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोध आनृशंस्यं दमस्तथा। आर्जवं चैव राजेन्द्र निश्चितं धर्मलक्षणम्॥
en: Bhishma said Abstention from injury to others, truthfulness, the absence of anger, mercy, selfcontrol and sincerity or candour, o king, are the marks of virtue.

sn: ये तु धर्मे प्रशंसन्तश्चरन्ति पृथिवीमिमाम्। अनाचरन्तस्तद् धर्मे संकरेऽभिरताः प्रभो॥
en: There are persons who wander over the Earth, lauding virtue but without practising what they preach and engaged all the while in sin, O king.

sn: तेभ्यो हिरण्यं रत्नं वा गामश्वं वा ददाति यः। दश वर्षाणि विष्ठां स भुङ्क्ते निरयमास्थितः॥ मेदानां पुल्कसानां च तथैवान्तेवसायिनाम्। कृतं कर्माकृतं वापि रागमोहेन जल्पताम्॥
en: He who gives such persons gold or gems or king or horses has to sink in hell and there live for ten years, on the faces of such person as live upon the flesh of dead kine and buffaloes, of men called Pukkasas, of others who live in the outskirts of cities and villages, and of men who give out under the influence of anger and folly, the acts and omissions of others.

sn: वैश्वदेवं च ये मूढा विप्राय ब्रह्मचारिणे। ददते नेह राजेन्द्र ते लोकान् भुञ्जतेऽशुभान्॥
en: Those foolish men who do not give a Brahmana observant of the VOW of SBrahmacharya the offerings made in Shraddhas (unto one's deceased ancestors), have to proceed, O king, into regions of great misery.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किं परं ब्रह्मचर्ये च किं परं धर्मलक्षणम्। किं च श्रेष्ठतमं शौचं तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grand father what is superior to Brahmacharya? What is the highest mark of virtue? what is the highest kind of purity?

sn: भीष्म उवाच ब्रह्मचर्यात् परं तात मधुमांसस्य वर्जनम्। मर्यादायां स्थितो धर्मः शमश्चैवास्य लक्षणम्॥
en: Bhishma said I tell you, O son, that abstention from honey and meat is even superior to Brahmacharya. Virtue lies within boundaries. The best mark of virtue is Renunciation.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कस्मिन् काले चरेद् धर्मे कस्मिन् कालेऽर्थमाचरेत्। कस्मिन् काले सुखी च स्यात् तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह।।
en: Yudhishthira said In what time should one practise virtue? In what time should wealth be sought? In what time should pleasure be enjoyed? O grandfather, do tell me this.

sn: भीष्म उवाच कल्यमर्थं निषेवेत ततो धर्ममनन्तरम्। पश्चात् कामं निषेवेत न च गच्छेत् प्रसङ्गिताम्॥
en: Bhishma said One should acquire riches the first part of his life. Then should one acquire virtue, and then enjoy pleasure. One should not, however, be addicted to any of these.

sn: ब्राह्मणांश्चैव मन्येत गुरूंश्चाप्यभिपूजयेत्। सर्वभूतानुलोमश्च मृदुशील: प्रियंवदः॥
en: One should respect the Brahmanas, worship his preceptor and seniors, show mercy to all creatures, be of mild disposition and sweet speech.

sn: अधिकारे यदनृतं यच्च राजसु पैशुनम्। गुरोचालीककरणं तुल्यं तद् ब्रह्महत्यया॥
en: To utter untruth in a court of justice to behave deceitfully towards the king, to act falsely towards preceptors and elders, are considered as equivalent to Brahmanicide.

sn: प्रहरेन्न नरेन्द्रेषु न हन्याद् गां तथैव च। भ्रूणहत्यासमं चैव उभयं यो निषेवते॥
en: One should never do an act of violence to the king's body. Nor should one ever strike a cow. Both these offences are equal to the sin of foeticide.

sn: नाग्निं परित्यजेज्जातु न च वेदान् परित्यजेत्। न च ब्राह्मणमाक्रोशेत् समं तद् ब्रह्महत्यया॥
en: One should never quit his (homa) fire. One should also renounce the study of the Vedas. One should never attack a Brahmana by words or decds. All these offences are equal to Brahmanicide.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कीदृशाः साधवो विप्राः केभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम्। कीदृशानां च भोक्तव्यं तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said What kind of Brahinanas should be considered as good? Who are those Brahmanas by making presents to whom one may win great merit? What kind of Brahmanas are they whom one should feed? Tell me all this, O grandfather.

sn: भीष्म उवाच अक्रोधना धर्मपरा: सत्यनित्या दमे रताः। तादृशा: साधवो विप्रास्तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: Bhishma said Those Brahmanas who are freed from anger, who are devoted to acts of virtue, who are firm in Truth, and who practise self-control, are considered as good. By making gifts to them one acquires great merit.

sn: अमानिनः सर्वसहा दृढार्थी विजितेन्द्रियाः। सर्वभूतहिता मैत्रास्तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: One acquires great merit by making presents to such Brahmanas as are free from pride capable of bearing everything, firm in the pursuit of their objects, gifted with mastery over their senses, devoted, to the behoof of all creatures, and disposed to be friendly towards all.

sn: अलुब्धाः शुचयो वैद्या ह्रीमन्तः सत्यवादिनः। स्वकर्मनिरता ये च तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: One acquires great merit by making gifts to such Brahmanas as are free from avarice, as are pure of heart and conduct, gifted with learning and modesty, truthful in speech and observant of their own duties as sanctioned in the scriptures.

sn: साङ्गाश्च चतुरो वेदानधीते यो द्विजर्षभः। षड्भ्यः प्रवृत्तः कर्मभ्यस्तं पात्रमृषयो विदुः॥
en: The Rishis have declared that Brahmana to be a deserving object of gifts who studies the four Vedas with all their auxiliaries and is devoted to the six well known duties. One acquires great merit by making gifts to Brahmanas endued with such qualifications.

sn: ये त्वेवगुणजातीयास्तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम्। सहस्रगुणमाप्नोति गुणार्हाय प्रदायकः॥
en: The man who makes gifts to a worthy Brahmana multiplies his merit a thousand fold. A single pious Brahmana gifted with wisdom and Vedic lore, observant of the duties laid down in the scriptures, and marked out by purity of conduct is capablu to rescue a whole family.

sn: प्रज्ञाश्रुताभ्यां वृत्तेन शीलेन च समन्वितः। तारयेत कुलं सर्वमेकोऽपीह द्विजर्षभः॥ गामश्वं वित्तमन्नं व तद्विधे प्रतिपादयेत्। द्रव्याणि चान्यानि तथा प्रेत्यभावे न शोचति॥
en: One should make gifts of kine and horses and riches and food and other kinds of articles to Brahmana who is gifted with such qualifications. By making such gifts to such persons one acquires great happiness in the next world.

sn: तारयेत कुलं सर्वमेकोऽयीह द्विजोत्तमः। किमङ्ग पुनरेवैते तस्मात् पात्रं समाचरेत्॥
en: As I have already told you, even one such Brahman can save the entire family to which the giver belongs. What need I say, therefore, O dear son of the merit of making gifts to many Brahmanas of such qualifications? In making gifts, thercfore, one should always select the object to whom the gift is to be made.

sn: निशम्य च गुणोपेतं ब्राह्मणं साधुसम्मतम्। दूरादानाय्य सत्कृत्य सर्वतश्चापि पूजयेत्॥
en: Hearing of a Brahmana gifted with proper qualifications and respected by all good people, one should invite him even if he lives at a distance and welcoming him when he arrives one should adore him by all means in his power. making gifts, thercfore, one should always select the object to whom the gift is to be made.

sn: निशम्य च गुणोपेतं ब्राह्मणं साधुसम्मतम्। दूरादानाय्य सत्कृत्य सर्वतश्चापि पूजयेत्॥
en: Hearing of a Brahmana gifted with proper qualifications and respected by all good people, one should invite him even if he lives at a distance and welcoming him when he arrives one should adore him by all means in his power.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच श्राद्धकाले च दैवे च पित्र्येऽपि च पितामह। इच्छामीह त्वयाऽऽख्यातं विहितं यत् सुरर्षिभिः॥
en: Yudhishthira said I wish you, O grandfather to tell me what the ordinances about the rites for the deities and the departed manes on occasions of Shraddhas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: भीष्म उवाच दैवं पौर्वाह्निकं कुर्यादपराह्वे तु पैतृकम्। मङ्गलाचारसम्पन्नः कृतशौचः प्रयत्नवान्॥
en: Bhishma said Having purified oneself and then performed the well known auspicious rites, one should carefully perform all acts relating to the Pitris in the afternoon.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: मनुष्याणां तु मध्याह्ने प्रदद्यादुपपत्तिभिः। कालहीनं तु यद् दानं तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः॥
en: What is given to men should be given in the midday with love and regard. That gifts which is made untimely is taken by Rakshasas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: लचितं चावलीढं च कलिपूर्वं च यत् कृतम्। रजस्वलाभिदृष्टं च तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः॥
en: Gifts of articles that have been leapt over by any one, or been licked or sucked, or are not given peacefully, or have been seen by women who are impure for being in their season do not produce any merit. Such gifts are considered as the portions of Rakshasas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अवघुष्टं च यद् भुक्तमव्रतेन च भारत। परामृष्टं शुना चैव तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः॥
en: Gifts of articles that have been announced before many people or from which a part has been eaten by a Shudra or, that have been seen or licked by a dog, form portions of Rakshasas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: केशकीटावपतितं क्षुतं श्वभिरवेक्षितम्। रुदितं चावधूतं च तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः॥
en: Food which is mixed with hair or in which there are worms, or which has been spoiled with spittle or saliva or which has been looked at by a dog or into which teardrops have fallen or which has been trodden upon, should be known as forming the part of Rakshasas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: निरोङ्कारेण यद् भुक्तं सशस्त्रेण च भारत। दुरात्मना च यद् भुक्तं तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः॥
en: Food that has been eaten by a person incompetent to utter the syllable Om, or that has been eaten by a person bearing arms, O Bharata, or that has been caten by a wicked person, should be known as due to Rakshasas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: परोच्छिष्टं च यद् भुक्तं परिभुक्तं च यद् भवेत्। दैवे पित्र्ये च सततं तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः॥
en: The food that is caten by a person from which a part has already been extent by another, or which is eaten without a part thereof having been offered to gods and guests and children, is appropriated by Rakshasas. Such impure food, if offered to the deities and Pitris is never accepted by them but is appropriated by Rakshasas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: मन्त्रहीनं क्रियाहीनं यच्छ्राद्धं परिविष्यते। त्रिभिर्वर्णर्नरश्रेष्ठ तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः॥
en: The food that is offered by the three twice born classes in Shraddhas in which Mantras are either not uttered or uttered incorrectly and in which the ordinances laid down in the scriptures are not duly performed, if given to guests and other people, is appropriated by Rakshasas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: आज्याहुतिं विना चैव यत्किञ्चित् परिविष्यते। दुराचारैश्च यद् भुक्तं तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः॥
en: The food that is given to guests without having been previously dedicated to the deities or the Pitris with the help of libations on the sacred fire, or which has been sullied on account of a part thereof having been eaten by a person who is wicked or of irreligious conduct, should be known as being due to Rakshasas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: ये भागा रक्षसां प्राप्तास्त उक्ता भरतर्षभ। अत ऊर्ध्वं विसर्गस्य परीक्षां ब्राह्मणे शृणु॥
en: I have described to you the dues of the Rakshasas. Listen now to me as I put down the rules for determining the Brahmana who is worthy of gifts.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: यावन्तः पतिता विप्रा जडोन्मत्तास्तथैव च। दैवे वाप्यथ पित्र्ये वा राजन् नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: All Brahmanas that have been outcasted, as also Brahmanas who are idiots and insane, do not deserve to be invited to Shraddhas in which offerings are made to either the deities or the departed manes.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: श्वित्री क्लीबश्च कुष्ठी च तथा यक्ष्महतश्च यः। अपस्मारी च यश्चान्धो राजन् नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: That Brahmanas who is afflicted with leucoderina, or he who is shorn of generative power, or he who has got leprosy, or he who has got phthisis, or he who suffers from epilepsy, or he who is blind, should not O king, be invited.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: चिकित्सका देवलका वृथा नियमधारिणः। सोमविक्रयिणश्चैव राजन् नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: Those Brahinana who practise as physicians, those who get regular pay for adoring the images of gods established by the rich or live upon the service of the gods, those who observe vows from pride or other false motives and those who sell Soma wine, do not deserve to be invited.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: गायना नर्तकाश्चैव प्लवका वादकास्तथा। कथका योधकाश्चैव राजन् नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: Those Brahmanas who are by profession, vocalists, or dancers or players or instrumental musicians, or reciters of sacred books, or warriors and athletes, should not, O king be invited.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: होतारो वृषलानां च वृषलाध्यापकास्तथा। तथा वृषलशिष्याश्च राजन् नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: Those Brahmanas who pour libations on the sacred fire for Shudras or who are preceptors of Shudras, or who are servant of Shudra masters, should not be invited.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अनुयोक्ता च यो विप्रो अनुयुक्तश्च भारत। नाहतस्तावपि श्राद्धं ब्रह्मविक्रयिणौ हि तौ॥
en: That Brahmana who is paid for his services as a preceptor or who attends as a pupil upon the lectures of some preceptor for an allowance paid to him, does not deserve to be invited, for both of thein are considered as sellers of Vedic learning.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अग्रणीर्यः कृतः पूर्वं वर्णावरपरिग्रहः। ब्राह्मणः सर्वविद्योऽपि राजन् नार्हति केतनम्॥
en: That Brahmana who has been once induced to accept the gift of food in a Shraddha at the very beginning, as also he who has married a Shudra wife, even if gifted with every sort of knowledge, should not be invited.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अनग्नयश्च ये विप्रा मृतनिर्यातकाश्च ये। स्तेनाश्च पतिताश्चैव राजन् नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: Those Brahmanas who have no domestic fire, and they who attend upon corpses, they who are thieves, and they who have otherwise degraded themselves, do not o king, deserve to be invited.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अपरिज्ञातपूर्वाश्च गणपूर्वाश्च भारत। पुत्रिकापूर्वपुत्राश्च श्राद्धे नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: Those Brahmanas whose antecedents are not known or are vile, and they who are Putrika-putras, should not, O king, be invited on occasions of Shraddhas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: ऋणकर्ता च यो राजन् यश्च वाधुषिको नरः। प्राणिविक्रयवृत्तिश्च राजन् नार्हन्ति केतनम्॥
en: That Brahmana who gives loans of money, or he who lives upon the interest of the loans given by him, or he who lives by the sale of living creatures, should not, O king, be invited.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: स्त्रीपूर्वाः काण्डपृष्ठाश्च यावन्तो भरतर्षभ। अजपा ब्राह्मणाश्चैव श्राद्धे नाहन्ति केतनम्॥
en: Persons who are henpecked or they who live by becoming the paramours of unchaste women, or they who do not perform their morning and evening prayers, should not, O king, be invited to Shraddhas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: श्राद्धे दैवे च निर्दिष्टो ब्राह्मणो भरतर्षभ। दातुः प्रतिग्रहीतुश्च शृणुष्वानुग्रहं पुनः॥
en: Listen now to me as I say who the Brahmava is who has been ordained for acts done in honour of the gods and the departed manes. Indeed, I shall tell you what those merits are on account of which one may become a giver or a recipient of gifts in Shraddhas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: चीर्णव्रता गुणैर्युक्ता भवेयुर्येऽपि कर्षकाः। सावित्रीज्ञाः क्रियावन्तस्ते राजन् केतनक्षमाः॥
en: Those Brahmanas who perform the rites and ceremonies laid down in the scriptures, or they who are possessed of merit, or they who know well the Gayatri, or they who perform the ordinary duties of Brahmanas, even if they happen to take lo agriculture for a living, are capable, O king, of being invited to Shraddhas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: क्षात्रधर्मिणमण्याजौ केतयेत् कुलजं द्विजम्। न त्वेव वणिजं तात श्राद्धे च परिकल्पयेत्॥
en: If a Brahmana happens to be well born, he should be invited to Shraddhas notwithstanding his taking up arms for fighting the battles of others. That Brahmana however O son, who happens lo drive a trade for a living should be discarded.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अग्निहोत्री च यो विप्रो ग्रामवासी च यो भवेत्। अस्तेनश्चातिथिज्ञश्च स राजन् केतनक्षमः॥
en: That Brahmana who pours libations every day on the sacred fire, or who lives in a fixed habitation, who is not a thief and who performs the duties of hospitality to guests arrived at his house, should O king, be invited to Shraddhas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: सावित्री जपते यस्तु त्रिकालं भरतर्षभ। भिक्षावृत्तिः क्रियावांश्च स राजन् केतनक्षमः॥
en: That Brahmana, O chief of Bharata's race, who recites the Savitri morning, noon and night or who lives upon charity begging as much as is necessary, who is observant of the rites and ceremonies laid down in the scriptures for persons of his order, should, O king, be invited to Shraddhas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: उदितास्तमितो यश्च तथैवास्तमितोदितः। अहिंस्रश्चाल्पदोषश्च स राजन् केतनक्षमः॥
en: That Brahmana who having acquired riches in the morning becomes poor in the afternoon, or who poor in the morning becomes rich in the evening, or who is shorn of inalice or is stained by a minor faulty should, O king, be invited to Shraddhas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अकल्कको ह्यतर्कश्च ब्राह्मणो भरतर्षभ। संसर्गे भैक्ष्यवृत्तिश्च स राजन् केतनक्षमः॥
en: That Brahmana who is shorn of pride or sin, who is not given to dry disputation, or who lives upon alms got in his rounds of mendicancy from house to house; should, O king, be invited to sacrifices.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अव्रती कितवः स्तेन: प्राणिविक्रयिको वणिक्। पश्चाच्च पीतवान् सोमं स राजन् केतनक्षमः॥
en: One who does not observe vows or who is given to untruth, who is a theif, or who lives by the sale of living creatures or by trade in general, should be invited to Shraddhas, ) king, if he happen to subsequently drink Soma in a sacrifice.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अर्जयित्वा धनं पूर्वं दारुणैरपि कर्मभिः। भवेत् सर्वातिथिः पश्चात् स राजन् केतनक्षः॥
en: That man who having acquired riches by foul or cruel means subsequently spends it in worshipping the gods and performing the duties of hospitality, becomes worthy, O king, of being invited to Shraddhas.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: ब्रह्मविक्रयनिर्दिष्टं स्त्रिया यच्चार्जितं धनम्। अदेयं पितृविप्रेभ्यो यच्च क्लैब्यादुपार्जितम्॥
en: The riches that one has acquired by the sale of Vedic learning, or which has been acquired by a woman, or which has been gamed by meanness, should never be given to Brahmanas or spent in making offerings to the departed manes.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: क्रियमाणेऽपवर्गे च यो द्विजो भरतर्षभ। न व्याहरति यद्युक्तं तस्याधर्मो गवानृतम्॥
en: That Brahmana, O chief of Bharata's race, who upon the completion of a Shraddha that is performed with his help, refuses to utter the words yukta, commits the sin of swearing falsely in a suit for land.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: श्राद्धस्य ब्राह्मणः कालः प्राप्तं दधि घृतं तथा। सोमक्षयश्च मांसं च यदारण्यं युधिष्ठिर॥
en: The time for celebrating the Shraddha, O Yudhishthira, is that when one gets a good Brahmana and curds and clarified butter and the sacred day of the new moon and the meat of wild animals such as deer and others.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: श्राद्धापवर्गे विप्रस्य स्वधा वै मुदिता भवेत्। क्षत्रियस्यापि यो ब्रूयात् प्रीयन्तां पितरस्त्विति॥
en: Upon the termination of a Shraddha performed by a Brahmana the word Svadha should be uttered. If performed by a Kshatriya the words that should be uttered are Let your departed manes be pleased.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अपवर्गे त वैश्यस्य श्राद्धकर्मणि भारत। अक्षय्यमभिधातव्यं स्वस्ति शूद्रस्य भारत॥ पुण्याहवाचनं दैवं ब्राह्मणस्य विधीयते। एतदेव निरोङ्कारं क्षत्रियस्य विधीयते॥ वैश्यस्य दैवे वक्तव्यं प्रीयन्तां देवता इति। कर्मणामानुपूर्वेण विधिपूर्वं कृतं शृणु॥
en: Upon the completion of Shraddha performed by a Vaishya, O Bharata, the word that should be uttered are; Let everything become endless! Likewise upon the completion of a Shraddha performed by a Shudra, the word that should be uttered is Svasti As regards a Brahmana, the Punyaham declaration should be accompanied with the utterance of the syllable Om. In the case of a Kshatriya, such declaration should be without the utterance of the syllable Om. In the acts performed by a Vaishya the words, instead of the syllable Om. should be Let the gods be pleased. Listen now to me as I tell you the rites that should be performed, one after another, as given in the ordinances.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: जातकर्मादिकाः सर्वास्त्रिषु वर्णेषु भारत। ब्रह्माक्षत्रे हि मन्त्रोक्ता वैश्यस्य च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: All the rites consequent upon birth, O Bharata, are necessary in the case of all the three castes. All these rites, O Yudhishthira, in the case of both Brahmanas and Kshatriyas as also in that of Vaishyas, are to be performed with the help of Mantras.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: विप्रस्य रशना मौजी मौर्वी राजन्यगामिनी। बाल्वजी ह्येव वैश्यस्य धर्म एष युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: The girdle of Brahmana should be made of Munja grass. That of a Kshatriya should be a bowstring. The Vaishya's girdle should be made of the Valvaji grass. This has been laid down in the scriptures.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: दातुः प्रतिग्रहीतुश्च धर्माधर्माविमौ शृणु। ब्राह्मणस्यानृतेऽधर्मः प्रोक्तः पातकसंज्ञितः। चतुर्गुणः क्षत्रियस्य वैश्यस्याष्टगुणः स्मृतः॥
en: Listen now to me as I explain to you what forms the merits and demerits of both givers and recipients of gifts. A Brahmana violates his duty by uttering an untruth. Such an act on his part is sinful. A Kshatriya perpetrates four fold and a Vaishya eightfold the sin that a Brahmana incurs by uttering an untruth.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: नान्यत्र ब्राह्मणोऽश्नीयात् पूर्वं विप्रेण केतितः। यवीयान् पशुहिंसायां तुल्यधर्मो भवेत् स हि॥
en: A Brahmana should not eat elsewhere, having been previously invited by a Brahmana. By eating at the house of the person by whom he has been invited afterwards, he becomes inferior and even incurs the sin of the slaughter of an animal on occasions other than those of sacrifices.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: तथा राजन्यवैश्याभ्यां यद्यश्नीयात्तु केतितः। यवीयान् पशुहिंसायां भागार्धं समवाप्नुयात्॥
en: So also, if he eats elsewhere after having been invited by a Kshatriya or a Vaishya, he falls away from his position and incurs half the sin of the slaughter of an animal on occasion other than those of sacrifices.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: दैवं वाप्यथवा पिव्यं योऽश्नीयाद् ब्राह्मणादिषु। अस्नातो ब्राह्मणो राजस्तस्याधर्मो गवानृतम्॥
en: That Brahmana, O king, who eats on occasions of such acts as are performed in honour of the gods or the departed manes by Brahmanas and Kshatriyas and Vaishyas, without having performed his ablutions, commits the sin of uttering an untruth for a COW.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: आशौचो ब्राह्मणो राजन् योऽश्नीयाद् ब्राह्मणादिषु। ज्ञानपूर्वमथो लोभात् तस्याधर्मो गवानृतम्॥
en: That Brahmana, O king, who eats on occasions of similar acts performed by persons belonging to three higher castes, at a time when he is impure on account of either a birth or a death among his cognates, and knowing that he is impure or through temptation, commits the same sin.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अर्थेनान्येन यो लिप्सेत् कर्मार्थं चैव भारत। आमन्त्रयति राजेन्द्र तस्याधर्मोऽनृतं स्मृतम्॥
en: He who lives upon riches acquired under false pretences like that of sojourns to sacred places or who begs the giver for riches pretending that he would spend it in religious acts, commits, O king, the sin of uttering an untruth,

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अवेदव्रतचारित्रास्त्रिभिर्वर्णयुधिष्ठिर। मन्त्रवत्परिविष्यन्ते तस्याधर्मो गवानृतम्॥
en: That person, belonging to any of the three higher castes, O Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira, who at Shraddhas and on other occasions distributes food with the help of Mantras, to such Brahmanas as do not study the Vedas or who do not observe vows or who have not purified their conduct, forsooth, commits sin.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पित्र्यं वाप्यथवा दैवं दीयते यत् पितामह। एतदिच्छाम्यहं ज्ञातुं दत्तं केषु महाफलम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said I wish O grandfather, to know who those persons are by giving to whom the things dedicated to the gods and the departed manes, one may acquire sufficient rewards.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: भीष्म उवाच येषां दाराः प्रतीक्षन्ते सुवृष्टिमिव कर्षकाः। उच्छेषपरिशेषं हि तान् भोजय युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said Do you, O Yudhishthira, feed those Brahmanas whose wives respectfully wait for the residue of the dishes of their husbands like tillers of the soil waiting respectfully for timely showers of rain.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: चारित्रनिरता राजन् ये कृशाः कृशवृत्तयः। अर्थिनश्चोपगच्छन्ति तेषु दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: By making gifts to those Brahmanas who are always of pure conduct, О king, who are liberated by abstaining from all luxuries and even full meals who are given to the observance of such vows as lead to the emaciation of the body, and who approach givers with the object of getting gifts, one acquires great merit.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: तद्भक्तास्तद्गृहा राजस्तद्वलास्तदपाश्रयाः। अर्थिनश्च भवन्त्यर्थे तेषु दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: By making gifts to Brahmanas who considers conduct in the light of food, who considers conduct in the light of wives and children, who considers conduct in the light of strength, who considers conduct in the light of their refuge for crossing this world and acquiring happiness in the next, and who beg for riches only when wealth is absolutely needed, one acquires great merit.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: तस्करेभ्यः परेभ्यो वा ये भयार्ता युधिष्ठिर। अर्थिनो भोक्तुमिच्छन्ति तेषु दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: By making gifts to those persons, O Yudhishthira, who having lost everything through thieves or oppressors, approach the giver one gains great merit.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अकल्ककस्य विप्रस्य रौक्ष्यात् करकृतात्मनः। वटवो यस्य भिक्षन्ति तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as beg food from the hands of even a poor person of their caste who has just got something from others, one acquires great merit.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: हृतस्वा हृतदाराश्च ये विप्रा देशसम्लवे। अर्थार्थमभिगच्छन्ति तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as have lost everything in times of universal distress and as have been deprived of their wives on such occasions, and as come to givers with solicitations for alms one acquires great merit.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: व्रतिनो नियमस्थाश्च ये विप्राः श्रुतसम्मताः। तत्समाप्त्यर्थमिच्छन्ति तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as observe vows and as place themselves voluntarily under painful rules and regulations, according to the Vedic injunctions, and as come to solicit riches for spending it upon the rites necessary to complete their vows and other observances one acquires great merit.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अत्युत्क्रान्ताश्च धर्मेषु पाषण्डसमयेषु च। कृशप्राणाः कृशधनास्तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as live at a great distance from the practices followed by the sinful and the wicked, as are shorn of strength for want of adequate support, and as are very poor in earthly possessions, one acquires great merit.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: कृतसर्वस्वहरणा निर्दोषाः प्रभविष्णुभिः। स्पृहयन्ति च भुक्त्वान्नं तेषु दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as have been deprived of all their possessions by powerful men but as are perfectly innocent and as desire to fill their stomachs with any and every sort of food, one acquires great merit.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: तपस्विनस्तपोनिष्ठास्तेषां भैक्षचराश्च ये। अर्थिनः किञ्चिदिच्छन्ति तेषु दत्तं महाफलम्॥
en: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as beg on behalf of others performing penances and devoted to them, and as are satisfied with even small gifts one acquires great merit.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: महाफलविधिने श्रुतस्ते भरतर्षभ। निरयं येन गच्छन्ति स्वर्गे चैव हि तच्छृणु॥
en: You have now, O foremost of Bharata's race, heard what the scriptural declarations are about the acquisition of great merit by the making of gifts. Hear from me now, of those acts that lead to hell or heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: गुर्वर्थमभयार्थे वा वर्जयित्वा युधिष्ठिर। येऽनृतं कथयन्ति स्म ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They, O Yudhishthira, that speak an untruth on occasions other than those when such untruth is necessary for serving the purpose of the preceptor or for giving the assurance of safety to a person in fear of his life, sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: परदाराभिहर्तारः परदाराभिमर्शिनः। परदारप्रयोक्तारस्ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who ravish other people's wives or have sexual intercourse with them, or assist at such sinful acts, sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: ये परस्वापहर्तारः परस्वानां च नाशकाः। सूचकाश्च परेषां ये ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who rob others of their riches or destroy the riches and properties of other people, or trumpet the shortcomings of other people, sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: प्रपाणां च सभानां च संक्रमाणां च भारत। अगाराणां च भेत्तारो नरा निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who spoil tanks used by cattle for satisfying thirst, who injure buildings used for public meetings, who break down bridges and causeways, and who pull down dwelling houses, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अनाथां प्रमदां बालां वृद्धां भीता तपस्विनीम्। वञ्चन्ति नरा ये च ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who lead astray and cheat helpless women, or girls or aged dames, or such women as have been frightened, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: वृत्तिच्छेदं गृहच्छेदं दारच्छेदं च भारत। मित्रच्छेदं तथाऽऽशायास्ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who destroy the means of other people's subsistence, they who root out the habitations of other people, they who rob others of their wives, they who sow dissensions among friends, and they who destroy the hopes of other people, sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: सूचकाः सेतुभेत्तारः परवृत्त्युपजीवकाः। अकृतज्ञाश्च मित्राणां ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who trumpet forth the faults of others, they who break down bridges or causeways, they who live by following other people's calling and they who are ungrateful to friends for services received, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: पाषण्डा दूषकाश्चैव समयानां च दूषकाः। ये प्रत्यवसिताश्चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who have no faith in the Vedas and show no respect for them, they who break the vows made by themselves or make others to break them, and they who fall away from their status through sin, sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: विषमव्यवहाराश्च विषमाश्चैव वृद्धिषु। लाभेषु विषमाश्चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who follow improper conduct they who take exorbitant rates of interest, and they who make unduly large profits on sales, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: दूतसंव्यवहाराश्च निष्परीक्षाश्च मानवाः। प्राणिहिंसाप्रवृत्ताश्च ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who are given to gambling, they who unhesitatingly perform wicked acts, and they who are given to killing living creatures, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: कृताशं कृतनिर्देशं कृतभक्तं कृतश्रमम्। भेदैर्ये व्यपकर्षन्ति ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who make the masters dismiss the servants that are hoping for rewards or are in the enjoyment of wages or salaries or waiting for returns in respect of valuable services already done, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: पर्यश्नन्ति च ये दारानग्निभृत्यातिथींस्तथा। उत्सन्नपितृदेवेज्यास्ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who themselves eat without offering portions thereof to their wives or their sacred fires or their servants or their guests, and they who do not perform the rites laid down in the scriptures for honouring the departed manes and deities, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: वेदविक्रयिणश्चैव वेदानां चैव दूषकाः। वेदानां लेखकाश्चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who sell the Vedas, they who find fault with the Vedas, and they who reduce the Vedas into writing, have all to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: चातुराश्रम्यबाह्याश्च क्षुतिबाह्याश्च ये नराः। विकर्मभिश्च जीवन्ति ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who are out of the limit of the four wellknown modes of life, they who follow to practices interdicted by the Shrutis and the Scriptures, and they who perform wicked or sinful deeds or who do not belong to their order of birth have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: केशविक्रयिका राजन् विषविक्रयिकाश्च ये। क्षीरविक्रयिकाश्चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who live by selling hair, they who live by selling poisons, and they who live by selling milk have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: ब्राह्मणानां गवां चैव कन्यानां च युधिष्ठिर। येऽन्तरं यान्ति कार्येषु ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who put impediments in the path of Brahmanas and kine and maidens, Yudhishthira, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: शस्त्रविक्रयिकाश्चैव कर्तारश्च युधिष्ठिर। शल्यानां धनुषां चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who sell weapons, they who forge weapons, they who make arrows, and they who make bows, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: शिलाभिः शङ्कभिर्वापि शुभैर्वा भरतर्षभ। ये मार्गमनुरुन्धन्ति ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who obstruct paths and roads with stones and thorns and holes have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: उपाध्यायांश्च भृत्यांश्च भक्तांश्च भरतर्षभ। ये त्यजन्त्यविकारांस्त्रीस्ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who renounce preceptors and servants and loyal followers without any offence, o foremost of Bharata's race, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अप्राप्तदमकाश्चैव नासानां वेधकाश्च ये। बन्धकाश्च पशूनां ये ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who set bullocks to work when the animals have not come of age, they who bore the noses of bullocks and other animals for controlling them the better while engaged in work, and they who keep animals always tethered, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अगोप्तारश्च राजानो बलिषड्भागतस्कराः। समर्थाश्चाप्यदातारस्ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: Those kings who do not protect their subjects while forcibly collect from them a sixth share of the produce of their fields, and they who though able and possessed of resources abstain from making gifts have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: क्षान्तान् दान्तांस्तथा प्राज्ञान् दीर्घकालं सहोषितान्। त्यजन्ति कृतकृत्या ये ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who renounce persons gifted with forgiveness, selfcontrol and wisdom, or those with whom they have associated for many years when these are no longer of service to them have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: बालानामथ वृद्धानां दासानां चैव ये नराः। अदत्त्वा भक्षयन्त्यग्रे ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: Those men who themselves eat without giving parts of the food to children, aged men and servants, have to sink in hell.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: एते पूर्वं विनिर्दिष्टाः प्रोक्ता निरयगामिनः। भागिनः स्वर्गलोकस्य वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ॥
en: All these men numbered above have to go to hell. Listen now to me, O foremost of Bharata's race, as I tell you who those men are who ascend to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: सर्वेष्वेव तु कार्येषु दैवपूर्वेषु भारत। हन्ति पुत्रान् पशून् कृत्स्नान् ब्राह्मणातिक्रमः कृतः।।८४
en: The man who transgresses against a Brahmana by obstructing the adoration of gods, suffer from the loss of all his children and animals.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: दानेन तपसा चैव सत्येन च युधिष्ठि। ये धर्ममनुवर्तन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men, O Yudhishthira, who perform the duties laid down in the scriptures for them, practising the virtues of charity self control and truthfulness, go to the celestial region.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: शुश्रूषाभिस्तपोभिश्च विद्यामादाय भारत। ये प्रतिग्रहनि:स्नेहास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who having acquired knowledge by making obedient services to their preceptors and performing austere penances, are unwilling to accept gifts, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: भयात्पापात्तथा बाधाद् दारियाद् व्याधिधर्षणात्। यत्कृते प्रतिमुच्यन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who save people from fear and sin and who remove the obstacles lying in the way of what they wish to accomplish and poverty and the sufferings of disease, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: क्षमावन्तश्च धीराश्च धर्मकार्येषु चोत्थिताः। मङ्गलाचारसम्पन्नाः पुरुषाः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who are gifted with a forgiving disposition, who are endued with patience, who are ready to perform all righteous rites, and who are of pure conduct, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: निवृत्ता मधुमांसेभ्यः परदारेभ्य एव च। निवृत्ताश्चैव मद्येभ्यस्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who abstain from honey and meat, who abstain from sexual intercourse with the wives of other people, and who abstain from wines and spirituous liquors succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: आश्रमाणां च कर्तारः कुलानां चैव भारत। देशानां नगराणां च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who help in the establishment of asylums for ascetics, who be come founders of families, O Bharata, who open up new countries for purposes of dwelling and implant towns and cities, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: वस्त्राभरणदातारो भक्तपानान्नदास्तथा। कुटुम्बानां च दातारः पुरुषाः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who distribute cloths and ornaments, as also food and drink, and who help in marrying others succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: सर्वहिंसानिवृत्ताश्च नराः सर्वसहाश्च ये। सर्वस्याश्रयभूताश्च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who have abstained from all sorts of injury or harm to all creatures, who can endure everything, and who have made themselves the refuge of all creatures succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: मातरं पितरं चैव शुश्रूषन्ति जितेन्द्रियाः। भ्रातृणां चैव सस्नेहास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who wait humbly upon their parents, who have controlled their senses, and who are affectionate towards their brothers, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: आढ्याश्च बलवन्तश्च यौवनस्थाश्च भारत। ये वै जितेन्द्रिया धीरास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who master their senses though they are rich in worldly possessions, endued with robust constitution and gifted with youthful vigour, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: अपराधिषु सस्नेहा मृदवो मृदुवत्सलाः। आराधनसुखाश्चापि पुरुषाः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who are kind even towards the offenders who are of mild disposition, who have an affection for all who are of mild behaviour, and who contribute to the happiness of others by rendering them every kind of service in humility, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: सहस्रपरिवेष्टारस्तथैव च सहस्रदाः। त्रातारश्च सहस्राणां ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who protect thousands of people, who make gifts to thousands of people, and who rescue thousands of people from distress, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: सुवर्णस्य च दातारो गवां च भरतर्षभ। यानानां वाहनानां च नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who make gifts of gold and of kine, O foremost of Bharata's race, as also of conveyances and animals, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: ते वैवाहिकानां द्रव्याणां प्रेष्याणां च युधिष्ठिर। दातारो वाससां चैव ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who give away such articles as are necessary in marriages, as also servants and maids, and cloths and robes succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: विहारावसथोद्यानकूपारामसभाप्रपाः। वप्राणां चैव कर्तारस्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who make public pleasure houses, gardens, well, resting houses, and buildings for public meetings, and tanks for enabling cattle and men to satisfy their thirst and fields for cultivation, O Bharata succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: निवेशनानां क्षेत्राणां वसतीनां च भारत। दातारः प्रार्थितानां च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः।।१००।
en: Those men who give houses and fields and populated villages to persons that want them, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: रसानां चाथ बीजानां धान्यानां च युधिष्ठिर। स्वयमुत्पाद्य दातारः पुरुषाः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those who having themselves manufactured drinks of sweet taste and seeds and paddy or rice, give them to others, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: यस्मिंस्तस्मिन् कुले जाता बहुपुत्राः शतायुषः। सानुक्रोशा जितक्रोधाः पुरुषाः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who having been born in families high or low beget hundreds of children and live long lives, practising mercy and keeping anger under complete control, succeed in ascending to heaven.

description: The rites for the deities and departed manes on the occasion of the Shraddhas
sn: एतदुक्तममुत्रार्थं दैवं पित्र्यं च भारत। दानधर्मं च दानस्य यत् पूर्वमृषिभिः कृतम्॥
en: I have thus explained to you, O Bharata, what the rites are in honour of the deities and the departed manes which are performed by people for the sake of the other world, what the ordinances are about making gifts, and what the views are of the Rishis of former times about both the articles of gift and the manner of giving them. inen

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच इदं मे तत्त्वतो राजन् वक्तुमर्हसि भारत। अहिंसयित्वापि कथं ब्रह्महत्या विधीयते॥
en: Yudhishthira said O descendant of Bharata's race, you should answer this question of mine truly and in detail. What are those circumstances under which a person may become guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing a Brahmana.

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: भीष्म उवाच व्यासमामन्त्र्य राजेन्द्र पुरा यत् पृष्टवानहम्। तत्तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि तदिहैकमनाः शृणु॥
en: Bhishma said Formerly, O king, I had one day requested Vyasa to explain to me this very subject. I shall now describe to you what Vyasa told me on that occasion. Do you listen to it with rapt attention.

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: चतुर्थस्त्वं वसिष्ठस्य तत्त्वमाख्याहि मे मुने। अहिंसयित्वा केनेह ब्रह्महत्या विधीयते॥
en: Going to Vyasa, I addressed him saying You, O great ascetic, are the fourth in descent from Vaishishtha! Do you explain to me this. What are those circumstances under which one becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing a Brahmana?

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: इति पृष्टो मया राजन् पराशरशरीरजः। अब्रवीन्निपुणो धर्मे नि:संशयमनुत्तमम्॥
en: Thus addressed by me, the own begotten son of Parashara, o king an adept in the science of morality gave me the following answer at once excellent and fraught with certainly.
