description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: ब्राह्मणं स्वयमाहूय भिक्षार्थे कृशवृत्तिनम्। बयानास्तीति यः पश्चात्तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should know that man as guilty of Brahmanicide who having of his own accord invited a Brahmana of pious conduct to his house for giving him alms then refuses too give anything on the pretence of there being nothing in the house.

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: मध्यस्थस्येह विप्रस्य योऽनूचानस्य भारत। वृत्तिं हरति दुर्बुद्धिस्तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should, O Bharata, know that man as guilty of Brahmanicide who destroys the means of living of a Brahmana well-read in the Vedas, and all their branches and who is shorn of attachments to worldly creatures and goods.

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: गोकुलस्य तृषार्तस्य जलार्थे वसुधाधिप। उत्पादयति यो विघ्नं तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should o king, know that man to be guilty of Brahmanicide who puts impediments in the way of thirsty kine while engaged in satisfying that thirst.

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: यः प्रवृत्तां श्रुति सम्यक् शास्त्रं वा मुनिभिः कृतम्। दूषयत्यनभिज्ञाय तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should take that man as guilty of Brahmanicide who, without studying them, finds fault with the Shrutis that have come down: from preceptor to pupil for ages and ages together, or with those scriptures that have been composed by the Rishis.

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: आत्मजां रूपसम्पन्नां महतीं सदृशे वरे। न प्रयच्छति यः कन्यां तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should know that man as guilty of Brahmanicide who does not confer upon a suitable bridegroom his daughter endued with beauty and other excellent qualities.

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: अधर्मनिरतो मूढो मिथ्या यो वै द्विजातिषु। दद्यान्मर्मातिगं शोकं तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should know that foolish and sinful wightought to be guilty of Brahmanicide who pains the Brahmanas to the very core of their hearts.

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: चक्षुषा विप्रहीणस्य पंगुलस्य जडस्य वा। हरेत यो वै सर्वस्वं तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should know that man to be guilty of Brahmanicide who robs the blind, the lame, and idiots.

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: आश्रमे वा वने वापि ग्रामे वा यदि वा पुरे। अग्निं समुत्सृजेन्मोहात्तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should know that man to be guilty of Brahmanicide who sets fire to the hermitage of ascetics or to forests or to a village or a town.

description: The circumstances under which a person becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing him
sn: आश्रमे वा वने वापि ग्रामे वा यदि वा पुरे। अग्निं समुत्सृजेन्मोहात्तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should know that man to be guilty of Brahmanicide who sets fire to the hermitage of ascetics or to forests or to a village or a town.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच तीर्थाना दर्शनं श्रेयः स्नानं च भरतर्षभ। श्रवणं च महाप्राज्ञ श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said It has been said that sojourns to sacred waters is full of merit; that ablutions in such waters is meritorious; and that listening to the excellence of such waters is also meritorious. I wish to hear you expatiate on this subject, O grandfather.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि पुण्यानि भरतर्षभ। वक्तुमर्हसि मे तानि श्रोतास्मि नियतं प्रभो॥
en: You should, O chief of Bharata's race, mention to me the sacred waters existing on this Earth. I wish you of great power to hear you describe to me this subject.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: भीष्म उवाच इममङ्गिरसा प्रोक्तं तीर्थवंशं महाद्युते। श्रोतुमर्हसि भद्रं ते प्राप्स्यसे धर्ममुत्तमम्॥
en: Bhishma said O you of great splendour, Angiras thus enumerated the sacred waters on the Earth. Blessed be you, you should listen to it, for you will then acquire great merit.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: तपोवनगतं विप्रमभिगम्य महामुनिम्। पप्रच्छाङ्गिरसं धीरं गौतमः संशितव्रतः॥ अस्ति मे भगवन् कश्चित्तीर्थेभ्यो धर्मसंशयः। तत् सर्वे श्रोतुमिच्छामि तन्मे शंस महामुने॥
en: Once on a time approaching the great and learned Rishi Angiras gifted with tranquillity of soul, while he was living in a forest, Gautama of rigid vows questioned him, saying O illustrious one, I have some doubts regarding the merits of sacred waters and shrines. I wish to hear you describe that subject. Do you therefore, O ascetic describe it to me.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: उपस्पृश्य फलं किं स्योत्तेषु तीर्थेषु वै मुने। प्रेत्यभावे महाप्राज्ञ तद् यथास्ति तथा वद॥
en: What merits are acquired by a person regarding the next world, by bathing in the sacred waters on the Earth, O you of great wisdom? Do you explain to me this truly and according to the ordinance.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: अंगीरस उवाच सप्ताहं चन्द्रभागां वै वितस्तामूर्मिमालिनीम्। विगाह्य वै निराहारो निर्मलो मुनिवद् भवेत्॥
en: Angiras said A person by bathing for seven days successively in the Chandrabhaga or the Vitasta whose waters are always seen to dance in waves, fasting all the while, is sure to become purged of all his sins and endued with the merit of an ascetic.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: काश्मीरमण्डले नद्यो याः पतन्ति महानदम्। ता नदीः सिन्धुमासाद्य शीलवान् स्वर्गमाप्नुयात्॥
en: There ere many rivers in the country called Kashmira. All these fall into the great river called Sindhu (Indus). By bathing in these rivers one is sure to become gifted with good character and to ascend to heaven after leaving this world.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: पुष्करं च प्रभासं च नैमिषं सागरोदकम्। देविकामिन्द्रमार्गं च स्वर्णबिन्दुं विगाह्य च॥ विबोध्यते विमानस्थः सोऽप्सरोभिरभिष्टुतः।
en: By bathing in Pushkara, Prabhasa and Naimisha, and the ocean and Devika, and Indramarga and Svarnabindu, one is sure to ascend where, seated on a celestial car, one is sure be filled with joy on being worshipped by the Apsaras

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: हिरण्यबिन्दुं विक्षोभ्य प्रयतश्चाभिवाद्य च॥ कुशेशयं च देव तं धूयते तस्य किल्बिषम्।
en: By bathing in the waters of Hiranyabindu with a concentrated mind and respecting that sacred river, and bathing next at Kusheshaya and Devanta, one becomes purged of all one's sins.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: इन्द्रतोयां समासाद्य गन्धमादनसंनिधौ॥ करतोयां कुरङ्गे च त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति विगाह्य प्रयतः शुचिः॥
en: Going to Indratoya near the Mountains of Gandhamadana and next to Karatoyas in the country called Kuranga, one should fast for three days and then bathe in those sacred waters with a concentrated heart and pure body. By doing this, one is sure to acquire the merit of a Horse-sacrifice.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: गङ्गाद्वारे कुशावर्ते बिल्वके नीलपर्वते। तथा कनखले स्नात्वा धूतपाप्मा दिवं व्रजेत्॥
en: Bathing in Gangadvara and Kushavarta and Vilvaka in the Blue mountains, as also in Kanakhala, one is sure to become purged of all one's sins and then ascend to heaven.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: अपां ह्रद उपस्पृश्य वाजिमेधफलं लभेत्। ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधः सत्यसंधस्त्वहिंसकः॥
en: If one becomes a Brahmacharin and control his anger, devotes oneself to truth and practises mercy towards all creatures, and then bathes in the Lake of Waters, one is sure to acquire the merit of a Horse-sacrifice.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: यत्र भागीरथी गङ्गा पतते दिशमुत्तराम्। महेश्वरस्य त्रिस्थाने यो नरस्त्वभिषिच्यते॥ एकमासं निराहारः स पश्यति हि देवताः।
en: That part where Bhagirathi-Ganga flows northwards is known as the union of heaven, Earth, and the nether regions. Fasting for one month and bathing in that sacred Tirtha which is acceptable to Maheshvara, one can see the deities.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: सप्तगङ्गे त्रिगङ्गे च इन्द्रमार्गे च तर्पयन्॥ सुधां वै लभते भोक्तुं यो नरो जायते पुनः।
en: One who gives oblations of water to his departed manes at Saptaganga and Triganga and Indramarga, obtains ambrosia for food if one has still to go through rebirth.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: महाश्रम उपस्पृश्य योऽग्निहोत्रपरः शुचिः॥ एकमासं निराहारः सिद्धिं मासेन स व्रजेत्।
en: The man who in a pure state of body and mind performs his daily Agnihotra and fasts for one month and then bathes in Mahashrama, is sure to acquire success in one month.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: महाह्रद उपस्पृश्य भृगुतुङ्गे त्वलोलुपः॥ त्रिरात्रोपोषितो भूत्वा मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया।
en: By bathing after a fast of three days and purifying the mind of all evil propensities, in the large lake situate in Bhrigutunga, one becomes purged of even the sin of Brahmanicide.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: कन्याकूप उपस्पृश्य बलाकायां कृतोदकः॥ देवेषु लभते कीर्ति यशसा च विराजते॥
en: By bathing in Kanyakupa and performing one's ablutions in Valaka, one wins great fame among even the celestials and shines in glory.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: देविकायामुपस्पृश्य तथा सुन्दरिकाह्रदे। अश्विन्यां रूपवर्चस्कं प्रेत्य वै लभते नरः॥
en: Bathing in Devika and the lake known by the name of Sundarika as also in the Tirtha called Aslivini, one acquires, in next life, great personal beauty.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: महागङ्गामुपस्पृश्य कृत्तिकाङ्गारके तथा। पक्षमेकं निराहारः स्वर्गमाप्नोति निर्मलः॥
en: By fasting for a fortnight and bathing in Mahaganga and Krittikangaraka, one becomes purged of all his sins and ascends to heaven.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: वैमानिक उपस्पृश्य किङ्किणीकाश्रमे तथा। निवासेऽप्सरसां दिव्ये कामचारी महीयते॥
en: Bathing in Vaimanika and Kinkinika, one acquires the power of going everywhere at will and becomes an object of great respect in the celestial region of the Apsaras.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: कालिकाश्रममासाद्य विपाशायां कृतोदकः। ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधस्त्रिरात्रं मुच्यते भवात्॥
en: If a person, controlling his anger, and observing the vow of Brahmacharya for three days, bathes in the river Vipasa at the hermitage called Kalika, he is sure to get over rebirth.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: आश्रमे कृत्तिकानां तु स्नात्वा यस्तर्पयेत् पितॄन्। तोषयित्वा महादेवं निर्मला: स्वर्गमाप्नुयात्॥
en: Bathing in the asylum that is sacred to the Krittikas and offering oblations of water to the departed manes, and then pleasing Mahadeva, one becomes pure in body and mind and ascends to heaven.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: महापुर उपस्पृश्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितः शुचिः। त्रसानां स्थावराणां च द्विपदानां भयं त्यजेत्॥
en: If one, fasting for three days with a purified body and mind, bathes in Mahapura, one becomes freed from the fear of all mobile and immobile animals as also of all two feeted animals.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: देवदारुवने स्नात्वा धूतपाप्मा कृतोदकः। देवलोकमवाप्नोति सप्तरात्रोषितः शुचिः॥
en: By bathing in the Devadaru forest and offering oblations of water to the departed manes and living there for seven nights with a pure body and mind, one acquires the region of the celestials on departing from this world.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: शरस्तम्बे कुशस्तम्बे द्रोणशर्मपदे तथा। अपां प्रपतनासेवी सेव्यते सोऽप्सरोगणैः॥
en: Bathing in the waterfalls at Sharastamva and Kushustamva and Dronasharmapada, one is sure to acquire the region of the Apsaras where one is dutifully served by those superhuman beings.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: चित्रकूटे जनस्थाने तथा मन्दाकिनीजले। विगाह्य वै निराहारो राजलक्ष्म्या निषेव्यते॥
en: If one, fasting bathes at Chitrakuta and Janasthana and the waters of Mandakini, one is sure to be gifted with real prosperity.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: श्यामायास्त्वाश्रमं गत्वा उषित्वा चाभिषिच्य च। एकपक्षं निराहारस्त्वन्तर्धानफलं लभेत्॥
en: By going to the retreat of Shyama and living there for a fortnight and bathing in the sacred water that lies there, one acquires the power of disappearing at will.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: कौशिकी तु समासाद्य वायुभक्षस्त्वलोलुपः। एकविंशतिरात्रेण स्वर्गमारोहते नरः॥
en: Going to the tirtha Kaushiki and living there with a pure heart and abstaining from all food and drink for three days, one acquires the power of living in the happy region of the Gandharvas.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: मतङ्गवाप्यां यः स्नायादेकरात्रेण सिद्ध्यति। विगाहति ह्यनालम्बमन्धकं वै सनातनम्॥ नैमिषे स्वर्गतीर्थे च उपस्पृश्य जितेन्द्रियः। फलं पुरुषमेधस्य लभेन्मासं कृतोदकः॥
en: He who bathes in the lake Matanga is sure to acquire success in one night. He who bathes in Analamva or the eternal, Andhaka, or in Naimisha, or the tirtha called Svarga, and offers oblations of water to the departed manes, controlling his senses all the while, acquires the merit of a human sacrifice.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: गङ्गाह्रद उपस्पृश्य तथा चैवोत्पलावने। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति तत्र मासं कृतोदकः॥
en: Bathing in Gangahrada and the tirtha Utplavana and daily offering oblations of water there for a full month to the departed manes, one acquires the merit of a Horse-sacrifice.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: गङ्गायमुनयोस्तीर्थे तथा कालञ्जरे गिरौ। दशाश्वमेधानाप्नोति तत्र मासं कृतोदकः॥
en: Bathing in the confluence of the Ganga and the Yamuna as also at the tirtha in the Kalanjara mountains and offering every day oblations of water to the departed manes for a full month, one acquires the merit of ten Horsesacrifices.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: षष्टिह्रद उपस्पृश्य चान्नदानाद् विशिष्यते। दशतीर्थसहस्राणि तिस्रः कोट्यस्तथा पराः॥ समागच्छन्ति माध्यां तु प्रयागे भरतर्षभ। माघमासं प्रयागे तु नियतः संशितव्रतः॥
en: Bathing in the Shashthi lake one acquires merit much greater than what appertains to the gift of food. Ten thousand tirthas and thirty millions of other tirthas come to Prayaga, O chief of Bharata's race, in the month of Magha. He who bathes in Prayaga, with a controlled mind and observing rigid vows all the while the month of Magha, becomes purged of all his sins, O chief of Bharata's race, and attains to heaven.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: स्नात्वा तु भरतश्रेष्ठ निर्मलः स्वर्गमाप्नुयात्। मरुद्गण उपस्पृश्य पितॄणामाश्रमे शुचिः॥ वैवस्वतस्य तीर्थे च तीर्थभूतो भवेन्नरः।
en: Bathing in the tirtha that is sacred to the Maruts, as also in that which is situate in the retreat of the departed manes, in and also in that which is known by the name of Vaivasvata, one becomes purged of all one's sins and as pure and sanctified as tirtha.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: तथा ब्रह्मसरो गत्वा भागीरथ्यां कृतोदकः॥ एकमासं निराहारः सोमलोकमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Going to Brahmasaras as to the Bhagirathi and bathing there and offering oblations to the departed manes every day for a full month, abstaining from food all the while, one is sure to go to the region of Soma.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: उत्पातके नरः स्नात्वा अष्टावक्रे कृतोदकः। द्वादशाहं निराहारो नरमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: Bathing in Utpataka and then in Ashtavakra and offering oblations of water to the departed manes every day for twlve days successively, abstaining all the while from food, one acquires the merits of a Naramedha sacrifice.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: अश्मपृष्ठे गयायां च निरविन्दे च पर्वते। तृतीयां क्रौञ्चपद्यां च ब्रह्महत्यां विशुध्यते॥
en: Bathing in Ashmaprishtha and Niravinda mountains and Kraunchapadi all three in Gayaone becomes purged of the sin of Brahmanicide. A bath in the first place purifies one of a single Brahmanicidele; bath in the second cleanness one of two similar offences; and a bath in the third cleanses one of three such offences.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: कलविङ्क उपस्पृश्य विद्याच्च बहुशो जलम्। अग्नेः पुरे नरः स्नात्वा अग्निकन्यापुरे वसेत्॥
en: Bathing in Kalavinga, one gets a large quantity of water. A man, by bathing in the city of Agni, acquires such merit as entitles him to live at his next birth in the city of Agni's daughter. manes

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: करवीरपुरे स्नात्वा विशालायां कृतोदकः। देवह्रद उपस्पृश्य ब्रह्मभूतो विराजते॥
en: Bathing in Vishala in Karavirapura and offering oblations of water to his departed and performing his ablutions in Devahrada too, one becomes at one with Brahma and shines in glory as such.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: पुनरावर्तनन्दां च महानन्दां च सेव्य वै। नन्दने सेव्यते दान्तस्त्वप्सरोभिरहिंसकः॥
en: Bathing in Punaravarta Nanda, as also Mahananda, a man of controlled senses and universal mercy goes to the celestial garden of Nandana and served there by the various tribes of Apsaras.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: उर्वशी कृत्तिकायोगे गत्वा चैव समाहितः। लौहित्ये विधिवत् स्नात्वा पुण्डरीकफलं लभेत्॥
en: Bathing with concentrated soul in the tirtha of Urvashi which is situated in the river Lohitya, on the day of full moon of the month of Kartika, one acquires the merits of Pundarika sacrifice.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: रामह्रद उपस्पृश्य विपाशायां कृतोदकः। द्वादशाहं निराहारः कल्मषाद् विप्रमुच्यते॥
en: Bathing in Ramahrada and offering oblations of water to the departed manes in the river Vipasha (Beas), and fasting for twelve days, one becomes purged of all sins.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: महाह्रद उपस्पृश्य शुद्धेन मनसा नरः। एकमासं निराहारो जमदग्निगतिं लभेत्॥
en: Bathing in the tirtha called Mahahrada with a purified heart and after fasting for one month, one is sure to acquire the status of the sage Jamadagni.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: विन्ध्ये संताप्य चात्मानं सत्यसंधसत्वहिंसकः। विनयात्तप आस्थाय मासेनैकेन सिध्यति॥
en: By exposing oneself to heat in the tirtha called Vindhya, a person given to truth and endued with compassion for all creatures should then practise austere penances, actuated by humility. By so doing, he is sure to acquire ascetic success in course of single month.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: नर्मदायामुपस्पृश्य तथा शूर्पारकोदके। एकपक्षं निराहारो राजपुत्रो विधीयते॥
en: Bathing in the Narmada as also the tirtha named Surparaka, fasting for a full fortnight, one is sure to become in one's next birth a prince of royal blood.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: जम्बूमार्गे त्रिभिर्मासैः संयतः सुसमाहितः। अहोरात्रेण चैकेन सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति॥
en: If one proceeds with controlled senses and a concentrated soul to the tirtha known as Jamvumarga, one is sure to acquire success in the course of a single day and night.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: कोकामुखे विगाह्याथा गत्वा चाञ्जलिकाश्रमम्। शाकभक्षश्चीरवासाः कुमारीविन्दते दश॥
en: By going to Chandalikashrama and bathing in the tirtha called Kokamukha, having lived for sometime on potherbs alone and worm rags for raiments one is sure to get ten beautiful maidens as his wives.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: वैवस्वतस्य सदनं न स गच्छेत् कदाचन। यस्य कन्याहूदे वासो देवलोकं स गच्छति॥
en: One who lives by the side of the tirtha known by the name of Kanvahrada has never to visit the regions of Yama. Such a person is sure to ascend to the regions of happiness belonging to the celestials.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: प्रभासे त्वेकरात्रेण अमावास्यां समाहितः। विध्यते तु महाबाहो यो नरो जायतेऽमरः॥
en: One who bathes with controlled senses on the day of the new moon in the tirtha known by the name of Prabhasa, is sure, you of mighty arins, of acquiring success and immortality simultaneously.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: उज्जानक उपस्पृश्य आष्टिषेणस्य चाश्रमे। पिङ्गायाश्चाश्रमे स्नात्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: Bathing in the tirtha known by the name of Ujjanaka which is situate in the retreat of Arshtisena's son, and next in the tirtha which is situate in the retreat of Pinga, one is sure to be purged of all his sins.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: कुल्यायां समुपस्पृश्य जप्त्वा चैवाघमर्षणम्। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः॥
en: Fasting for three days and bathing in the tirtha known as kulya and reciting the sacred Mantras of Aghamarshana, one acquires the merit of a Horse-sacrifice.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: पिण्डारक उपस्पृश्य एकरात्रोषितो नरः। अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति प्रभातां शर्वरी शुचिः॥
en: Fasting for one night and bathing in Pindaraka, one becomes purified on the next day and acquires the merit of an agnishtoma sacrifice.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: तथा ब्रह्मसरो गत्वा धर्मारण्योपशोभितम्। पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति उपस्पृश्य नरः शुचिः॥
en: One who goes to Brahmasara which is adorned by the woods called Dharmaranya one becomes purged of all one's sins in and acquires the merit of the Pundarika sacrifice.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: मैनाके पर्वते स्नात्वा तथा संध्यामुपास्य च। कामं जित्वा च वै मासं सर्वयज्ञफलं लभेत्॥
en: Bathing in the waters of the Mainaka mountain and reciting morning and evening prayers there and living at the spot for a month controlling desires, one acquires the merit of all the sacrifices.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: कालोदकं नन्दिकुण्डं तथा चोत्तरमानसम्। अभ्येत्य योजनशताद् भ्रूणहा विप्रमुच्यते॥
en: Starting for Kalodaka and Nandikunda and Uttaramanasa, and reaching a spot that is hundred Yojanas remote from any of them, one becomes purged of the sin of foeticide.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: नन्दीश्वरस्य मूर्ति तु दृष्ट्वा मुच्येत किल्बिषैः। स्वर्गमार्गे नरः स्नात्वा ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति॥
en: One who succeeds in seeing the image of Nandishvara, becomes purged of all sins. Bathing in the tirtha called svargamarga one is sure to proceed to the regions of Brahman.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: विख्यातो हिमवान् पुण्यः शङ्करश्वशुरो गिरिः। आकर: सर्वरत्नानां सिद्धचारणसेवितः॥
en: The celebrated Himayat is sacred. That king of mountains is the father-in-law of Shankara, He is a mine of all jewels and gems and is the resort of the Siddhas and Charanas.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: शरीरमुत्सृजेत् तत्र विधिपूर्वमनाशके। अध्रुवं जीवितं ज्ञात्वा यो वै वेदान्तगो द्विजः॥ अभ्यर्च्य देवतास्तत्र नमस्कृत्य मुनींस्तथा। ततः सिद्धो दिवं गच्छेद् ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम्॥
en: That twice born person who is as master of the vedas and who, considering this life to be exceedingly unstable, renounces his body on those mountains, abstaining from all food and drink according to the rites laid down in the scriptures, after having worshipped the gods and bent his head in worship of the ascetics is sure to acquire success and proceed to the eternal regions of Brahman.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: कामं क्रोधं च लोभं च यो जित्वा तीर्थमावसेत्। न तेन किञ्चिन्न प्राप्तं तीर्थाभिगमनाद् भवेत्॥
en: There is nothing which one cannot get who lives in a tirtha, restraining lust and controlling anger on account of such residence.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: यान्यगम्यानि तीर्थाणि दुर्गाणि विषमाणि चा मनसा तानि गम्यानि सर्वतीर्थसमीक्षया॥
en: For the purpose of going to all the tirthas in the world, one should mentally think of those amongst them which are almost inaccessible or sojourns to which are attended with great difficulties.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: इदं मेध्यमिदं पुण्यमिदं स्वय॑मनुत्तमम्। इदं रहस्यं वेदानामाप्लाव्यं पावनं तथा॥
en: Sojourns to tirthas yields the merits of Sacrifices. They are competent to purify everybody of sin. Fraught-with great good, they are capable of leading in heaven. The subject is truly a great mystery. The very gods should bathe in tirthas. To them also they are sin-purifying.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: इदं दद्याद् द्विजातीनां साधोरात्महितस्य च। सुहृदां च जपेत् कर्णे शिष्यस्यानुगतस्य च॥
en: This discourse on tirthas should be delivered to Brahmanas, and to such honest or pious persons as are bent upon gaining what is for their own behoof. It should also be recited in the hearing of one's well-wishers and friends and of one's obedient and devoted disciples.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: दत्तवान् गौतमस्यैतदङ्गिरा वै पहातपाः। अङ्गिरा: समनुज्ञातः काश्यपेन च धीमता॥
en: Angiras endued with great ascetic merit, had delivered this discourse to Gautama. Angiras himself had got it from the highly intelligent Kashyapa.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: महर्षीणामिदं जप्यं पावनानां तथोत्तमम्। जपंश्चाभ्युत्थितः शश्वन्निर्मलः स्वर्गमाप्नुयात्॥
en: The great Rishis consider this discourse as deserving of constant repetition. It is the foremost of all purifying things. If one recites it regularly every day, he is sure to become purged of every sin and after this life 10 proceed to heaven.

description: The merits of ablution in sacred water
sn: इदं यश्चापि शृणुयाद् रहस्यं त्वङ्गिोमतम्। उत्तमे च कुले जन्म लभेज्जातीश्च संस्मरेत्॥
en: One who listens to this discourse recited in his hearing this discourse, viz., of Angiras, which is regarded as a mystery is sure to attain in one's next life to birth in a good family and, what is more, one would have the memory of the pristine existence.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच बृहस्पतिसमं बुद्ध्या क्षमया ब्रह्मणः समम्। पराक्रमे शक्रसममादित्यसमतेजसम्॥ गाङ्गेयमर्जुनेनाजौ निहतं भूरितेजसम्। भ्रातृभिः सहितोऽन्यैश्च पर्यपृच्छद् युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Equal to Brihaspati in intelligence and Brahman himself in forgiveness, resembling Shakra in prowess and the Sun in energy, Bhishma the son of Ganga, of infinite might, had been defeated in battle by Arjuna. Accompanied by his brothers and many other people king, Yudhishthira asked him these questions.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: शयानं वीरशयने कालाकाटिणमच्युतम्। आजग्मुर्भरतश्रेष्ठं द्रष्टुकामा महर्षयः॥
en: The old hero was lying on a bed coveted by heroes, in expectation of that sacred moment when he could take leave of his body. Many great Rishis had come there for seeing that foremost one of Bharata's race.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: अत्रिर्वसिष्ठोऽथ भृगुः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः। अङ्गिरागौतमोऽगस्त्यः सुमतिः सुयतात्मवान्॥ विश्वामित्र: स्थूलशिरा: संवर्तः प्रमतिर्दमः। बृहस्पत्युशनोव्यासाच्यवनः काश्यपो ध्रुवः॥ दुर्वासा जमदग्निश्च मार्कण्डेयोऽथ गालवः। भरद्वाजोऽथ रैभ्यश्च यवक्रोतस्त्रितस्तथा॥
en: Amongst them were Atri, Vasishtha, Bhrigu, Pulastya, Pulaha, and Kratu. There were also Angiras, Gotama, Agastya, Sumati of well restrained soul, Vishvamitra, Sthulashiras, Samvarta, Pramati and Dama. There were also Brihaspati, Ushanas, Vyasa, Chyavana, Kashyapa, Dhruva, Durvasas, Jamadagni, Markandeya Galava, Bharadvaja, Raibhya Yavakrita and Trita.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: स्थूलाक्षः शवलाक्षश्च कण्वो मेधातिथिः कृशः। नारदः पर्वतश्चैव सुधन्वाथैकतो द्विजः॥
en: There Sthulaksha, Shavalaksha, Kanwa, Medhatithi, Krishi, Narada, Parvata, Sudhanwan, Ekata and Dwita.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: नितम्भूर्भुवनो धौम्यः शतानन्दोऽकृतव्रणः। जामदग्न्यस्तथा रामः कचश्चेत्येवमादयः॥
en: There also Nitambhu Bhuvana, Dhaumya, Shatananda, Akritavrana, Rama the son of Jamadagni and Kacha.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: समागता महात्मानो भीष्मं द्रष्टुं महर्षयः। तेषां महात्मनां पूजामागतानां युधिष्ठिरः॥ भ्रातृभिः सहितश्चकै यथावदनुपूर्वशः। ते पूजिताः सुखासीनाः कथाश्चक्रुर्महर्षयः॥
en: All these great Rishis came there for seeing Bhishma lying on his bed of arrows. Yudhishthira with his brothers duly adored those great Rishis who had come there, one after another in proper order. Receiving that were were adoration, those foremost of Rishis sat themselves down and began to converse with one another.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: भीष्माश्रिताः सुमधुराः सर्वेन्द्रियमनोहराः। भीष्मस्तेषां कथाः श्रुत्वा ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम्॥
en: Their conversation related to Bhishma and was highly sweet and agreeable. Hearing that talk of theirs about himself, Bhishma became filled with joy and considered himself to be already in heaven.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: मेने दिविष्ठमात्मानं तुष्ट्या परमया युतः। ततस्ते भीष्ममामन्त्र्य पाण्डवांश्च महर्षयः॥
en: Having obtained the leave of Bhishma and of the Pandava princes those Rishis then disappeared before the very sight of all the beholders.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: अन्तर्धानं गताः सर्वे सर्वेषामेव पश्यताम्। तानृषीन् सुमहाभागानन्तर्धानगतानपि॥
en: The Pandavas bowed again and again and offered their adorations to those highly blessed Rishis even after they had made themselves invisible.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: पाण्डवास्तुष्टुवुः सर्वे प्रणेमुश्च मुहुर्मुहुः। प्रसन्नमनसः सर्वे गाङ्गेयं कुरुसत्तमम्॥
en: They then cheerfully waited upon the son of Ganga even as Brahmanas versed in Mantras wait with respect upon the rising Sun.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: उपतस्थुर्यथोद्यन्तमादित्यं मन्त्रकोविदाः। प्रभावात् तपसस्तेषामृषीणां वीक्ष्य पाण्डवाः॥
en: The Pandavas saw that the points of the compass shining on account of the energy of their penances, and became filled with wonder at the spectacle.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: प्रकाशन्तो दिशः सर्वा विस्मयं परमं ययुः। महाभाग्यं परं तेषामृषीणामनुचिन्त्य ते। पाण्डवाः सह भीष्मेण कथाश्चक्रुस्तदाश्रयाः॥
en: Thinking of the high blessedness and power of those Rishis, the Pandava princes began to discourse on the subject with their grandfather Bhishma.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच कथान्ते शिरसा पादौ स्पृष्ट्वा भीष्मस्य पाण्डवः। धर्म्य धर्मसुतः प्रश्नं पर्यपृच्छद् युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said After that conversation was over, the pious Yudhishthira, the son of Pandu, touched Bhishma's feet with his head and then resumed his questions about morality and virtue.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच के देशाः के जनपदा आश्रमाः के च पर्वताः। प्रकृष्टाः पुण्यतः काच ज्ञेया नद्यः पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Which countries, which provinces, which hermitages, which mountains, and which rivers, O grandfather, are the foremost in sancity.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। शिलोच्छवृत्तेः संवादं सिद्धस्य च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old conversation between a Brahmana in the observance of the Shila and the Unccha vows, O Yudhishthira, and a Rishi crowned with ascetic merits.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: इमां कश्चित् परिक्रम्य पृथिवीं शैलभूषणाम्। असकृद् द्विपदां श्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठस्य गृहमेधिनः॥ शिलवृत्तेहं प्राप्तः स तेन विधिनार्चितः। उवास रजनीं तत्र सुमुखः सुखभागृषिः॥
en: Once on a time, a foremost person, having travelled over this entire Earth adorned with mountains, arrived at last in the house of a foremost person living like a householder in accordance with the shila vow. The latter welcomed his guest with due rites. Received with such hospitality, the happy Rishi passed the night happily in the house of his host.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: शिलवृत्तिस्तु यत् कृत्यं प्रातस्तत् कृतवाञ्छुचिः। कृतकृत्यमुपातिष्ठत् सिद्धं तमतिथिं तदा।॥
en: The next morning the Brahmana in the observance of the Shila vow, having finished all his morning acts and rites and purified himself duly, gladly approached his guest crowned with ascetic success.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: तौ समेत्य महात्मानौ सुखासीनौ कथाः शुभाः। चक्रतुर्वेदसम्बद्धास्तच्छेषकृतलक्षणाः॥
en: Meeting with each other and seated at their ease, the two began to take on agreeable subjects of the Vedas and the Upanishads.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: शिलवृत्तिः कथान्तेतु सिद्धमामन्त्र्य यत्नतः। प्रश्नं पप्रच्छ मेधावी यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: Towards the conclusion of the discourse, the Brahmana in the observance of the Shila vow respectfully addressed the Rishi crowned with success. Gifted with intelligence, he put this very question which you, O Yudhishthira have put to me.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: शिलवृत्तिरुवाच के देशाः के जनपदाः केऽऽश्रमाः के च पर्वताः। प्रकृष्टाः पुण्यतः काश्च ज्ञेया नद्यस्तुदुच्यत्ताम्॥
en: The Poor Brahmana said What are those countries, what are those provinces, what those hermitages, what those mountains, and what those rivers that should be considered as the foremost in sanctity? Do you describe this to me.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: ऋषिरुवाच ते देशास्ते जनपदास्तेऽऽश्रमास्ते च पर्वताः। येषां भागीरथी गङ्गा मध्येनैति सरिद्वरा॥
en: The Rishi said Those countries, those provinces, those retreats, and those mountains, should be considered as the foremost in sanctity through which or by the side of which that foremost of all rivers viz., Bhagirathi, flows.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण यज्ञैस्त्यागेन वा पुनः। गतिं तां न लभेज्जन्तुर्गङ्गां संसेव्य यां लभेत्॥
en: The end which a creature can attain by penances by Brahmacharyya by sacrifices or by practising Renunciation, one is sure to attain by only living by the side of the Bhagirathi and bathing in its sacred waters.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: स्पृष्टानि येषां गाङ्गेयैस्तोयैर्गात्राणि देहिनाम्। न्यस्तानि न पुरस्तेषां त्याग स्वर्गाद् विधीयते॥
en: Those creatures whose bodies have been sprinkled with the sacred waters of Bhagirathi or whose bones have been laid in that sacred stream, have not to fall away from heaven at any time.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: सर्वाणि येषां गाङ्गेयैस्तोयैः कार्याणि देहिनाम्। गां त्यक्त्वा मानवा विप्र दिवि तिष्ठन्ति ते जनाः।।
en: Those men, O learned Brahmana, who use the waters of Bhagirathi in all their acts surely go to heaven after death.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: पूर्वं वयसि कर्माणि कृत्वा पापानि ये नराः। पश्चाद् गङ्गां निषेवन्ते तेऽपि यान्त्युत्तमां गतिम्॥
en: Even those men who, having committed various sinful deeds in the first part of their lives, live in after years by the side of Ganga, succeed in attaining to a very superior end.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: स्नातानां शुचिभिस्तोयैर्गाङ्गेयैः प्रयतात्मनाम्। व्युष्टिर्भवति या पुंसां न सा क्रतुशतैरपि॥
en: Hundreds of sacrifices cannot yield that merit which men of controlled souls are capable of acquiring by bathing in the sacred waters of Ganga.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: यावदस्थि मनुष्यस्य गङ्गातोयेषु तिष्ठति। तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: A person is respected and adored in the celestial region for as long a period as his bones lie in the channel of Ganga.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: अपहत्य तमस्तीवं यथा भात्युदये रविः। तथापहत्य पाप्मानं भाति गङ्गाजलोक्षितः॥
en: Even as the Sun, when he rises at the dawn of day, shines, having removed the darkness of night, likewise the person who has bathed in the waters of Ganga is seen to shine, purged of all his sins.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: विसोमा इव शर्वर्यो विपुष्पास्तरवो यथा। तद्वद् देशा दिशश्चैव हीना गङ्गाजलैः शिवैः॥ वर्णाश्रमा यथा सर्वे धर्मज्ञानविवर्जिताः। क्रतवश्च यथासोमास्तथा गङ्गां विना जगत्॥
en: The countries and the points of the compass which are destitute of the sacred waters of Ganga are like nights without the moon or trees without flowers. Indeed a world without Ganga is like the different castes and modes of life when they are shorn of virtue or like sacrifices without Soma.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: यथा हीनं नभोऽर्केण भूःशैलैः खं च वायुना। तथा देशा दिशश्चैव गङ्गाहीना च संशयः॥
en: Forsooth countries and points of the compass which are without Ganga are like the sky without the sun or the Earth without mountains, or the etherial region without air.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: त्रिषु लोकेषु ये केचित् प्राणिनः सर्व एव ते। तर्प्यमाणाः परां तृप्तिं यान्ति गङ्गाजलैः शुभैः॥
en: All the creatures in the three worlds, if served with the sacred waters of Ganga, derive a pleasure the like of which they cannot derive from any other source.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: यस्तु सूर्येण निष्टतं गाङ्गेयं पिबते जलम्। गवां निरिनिर्मुक्ताद् यावकात् तद् विशिष्यते॥
en: He who drinks Ganga water which has been heated by the Sun's rays, derives merit much greater than that which belongs to the vow of living upon the wheat or grains or other corn picked up from cowdung.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: इन्द्रव्रतसहस्रं तु यश्चरेत् कायशोधनम्। पिबेद् यश्चापि गङ्गाम्भः समौ स्यातां न वा समौ॥३९
en: It cannot be said whether, he who performs a thousand Chandrayana rites for purifying his body and he who drinks the water of Ganga, are equal.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: तिष्ठेद् युगसहस्रं तु पदेनैकेन यः पुमान्। मासमेकं तु गङ्गाया समौ स्यातां न वा समौ॥
en: It cannot be said whether one who stands for a thousand years on one foot and one who lives for only a month by the side of Ganga are equal.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: लंबतेऽवाशिरा यस्तु युगानामयुतं पुमान्। तिष्ठेद् यथेष्टं यश्चापि गङ्गायां स विशिष्यते॥
en: One who lives permanently by the side of Ganga is superior in merit to one who lives for ten thousand cycles with head hanging downwards.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: अग्नौ प्रास्तं प्रधूयेत यथा तूलं द्विजोत्तम। तथा गङ्गावगाढस्य सर्वपापं प्रधूयते॥
en: As cotton, when it comes into contact with fire, is burnt off without a residue, so the sins of the person that has bathed in Ganga become perfectly consumed.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: भूतानामिह सर्वेषां दुःखोपहतचेतसाम्। गतिमन्वेषमाणानां न गङ्गासदृशी गतिः॥
en: There is no end superior to Ganga for those creatures who, with hearts afflicted by sorrow, seek to attain to ends which may remove that sorrow of theirs.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: भवन्ति निर्विषाः सर्प यथा तार्क्ष्यस्य दर्शनात्। गङ्गाया दर्शनात् तद्वत् सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: As snakes become shorn of their poison as soon as they see Garuda, so one becomes purged of all his sins as soon as he sees the sacred river Ganga.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: अप्रतिष्ठाश्च ये केचिदधर्मशरणाश्च ये। तेषां प्रतिष्ठा गङ्गेह शरणं शर्म वर्म च॥
en: They who do not enjoy fame for virtue and they who are addicted to deeds of sinfulness, have Ganga for their fame, their protection, their means of safety their refuge or cover.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: प्रकृष्टैरशुभैर्ग्रस्ताननेकैः पुरुषाधमान्। पततो नरके गङ्गा संश्रितान् प्रेत्य तारयेत्॥
en: Many wretched men who commit various sins of a heinous nature, when they are about to sink into hell, are rescued by Ganga in the next world.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: ते संविभक्ता मुनिभिर्नूनं देवैः सवासवैः। येऽभिगच्छन्ति सततं गङ्गां मतिमतां वर॥
en: They, O foremost of intelligent men, who plunge every day in the sacred waters of Ganga, become the equals of great Munis and the very deities headed by Indra.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: विनयाचारहीनाश्च अशिवाश्च नराधमाः। ते भवन्ति शिवा विप्र ये वै गङ्गामुपाश्रिताः॥
en: Those wretched men who are destitute of humility or modesty of behaviour and who are greatly sinful, become righteous and good, O Brahmana, by living by the side of Ganga.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: यथा सुराणाममृतं पितॄणां च यथा स्वधा। सुधा यथा च नागानां तथा गङ्गाजलं नृणाम्॥
en: As ambrosia is to the deities, as Svadha is to the Pitris, as Svadha is to the Nagas, so is Gangawater to human beings.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: उपासते यथा बाला मातरं क्षुधयार्दिताः। श्रेयस्कामास्तथा गङ्गामुपासन्तीह देहिनः॥
en: As children stricken with hunger, solicit their mothers for food, similarly do people desirous of their highest good seek Ganga.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: स्वायम्भुवं यथा स्थानं सर्वेषां श्रेष्ठमुच्यते। सातानां सरितां श्रेष्ठा गङ्गा तद्वदिहोच्यते॥
en: As the region of the selfcreate Brahman is said to be the foremost of all places, so is Ganga said to be foremost of all rivers for those who desire to bathe.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: यथोपजीविनां धेनुर्देवादीनां धरा स्मृता। तथोपजीविनां गङ्गा सर्वप्राणभृतामिह॥
en: As the Earth and the cow are said to be the chief sustenance of the celestials, so is Ganga the chief sustenance of all living creatures.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: देवाः सोमार्कसंस्थानि यथा सत्रादिभिर्मखैः। अमृतान्युपजीवन्ति तथा गङ्गाजलं नराः॥
en: As the celestials support themselves upon the ambrosia that is in the Sun and the Moon and that is offered in various sacrifices, so do human beings support themselves upon Gangawater.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: जाह्नवीपुलिनोत्थाभिः सिकताभिः समुक्षितम्। आत्मानं मन्यते लोको दिविष्ठमिव शोभितम्॥
en: One besmeared with the sand taken from the shores of Ganga considers oneself as an inhabitant of heaven, adorned with celestial unguents.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: जाह्नवीतीरसम्भूतां मृदं मूर्धा बिभर्ति यः। बिभर्ति रूपं सोऽर्कस्य तमोनाशाय निर्मलम्॥
en: He who bears on his head the mud taken from the banks of Ganga looks effulgent like the sun himself bent on removing the surrounding darkness.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: गङ्गोर्मिभिरथो दिग्धः पुरुषं पवनो यदा। स्पृशते सोऽस्य पाप्मानं सद्य एवापकर्षति॥
en: When the wind which is moistened with the particles of Gangawater touches one's body, it cleanses him immediately of every sin.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: व्यसनैरभितप्तस्य नरस्य विनशिष्यतः। गङ्गादर्शनजा प्रीतिर्व्यसनान्यपकर्षति॥
en: A person afflicted by calamities and about to sink under their pressures finds all his calamities removed by the joy which originates in his heart on seeing that sacred river.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: हंसारावैः कोकरवै रवैरन्यैश्च पक्षिणाम्। पस्पर्ध गङ्गा गन्धर्वान् पुलिनैश्च शिलोच्चयान्॥
en: By the sweet notes of the swans and Kokas and other aquatic fowl that play on her breast, Ganga, challenges the very Gandharvas and by her high banks the very mountains on the Earth.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: हंसादिभिः सुबहुभिर्विविधैः पक्षिभिर्वृताम्। गङ्गां गोकुलसम्बाधां दृष्ट्वा स्वर्गोऽपि विस्मृतः॥
en: Seeing her surface teeming with swans and various other aquatic fowl, and having banks adorned with pasture lands with kine grazing on them, the celestial region herself loses her pride.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: न सा प्रीतिर्दिविष्ठस्य सर्वकामानुपाश्नतः। सम्भवेद् या परा प्रीतिर्गङ्गायाः पुलिने नृणाम्॥
en: The high happiness which one enjoys by living on the banks of Ganga, can never be his who is living even in the celestial region.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: वाङ्मनःकर्मजैर्ग्रस्तः पापैरपि पुमानिह। वीक्ष्य गङ्गां भवेत् पूतो अत्र मे नास्ति संशयः॥
en: I have no doubt in this that the person who is afflicted with sins perpetrated in words and thought and act, becomes cleansed on seeing Ganga.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: सप्तावरान् सप्त परान् पितूंस्तेभ्यश्च ये परे। पुमांस्तारयते गङ्गां वीक्ष्य स्पृष्ट्वावगाह्य च॥
en: By seeing that sacred river, touching it, and bathing in its waters, one rescues his ancestors to the seventh degree, and his descendants to the seventh degeree, as also other ancestors and descendants.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: श्रुताभिलषिता पीता स्पृष्टा दृष्टावगाहिता। गङ्गा तारयते नृणामुभौ वंशो विशेषतः॥
en: By hearing of Ganga, by wishing to go to that river, by drinking its waters, by touching those waters, and by bathing in them , a person rescues both his paternal and maternal families.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: दर्शनात् स्पर्शनात् पानात् तथा गङ्गेति कीर्तनात्। पुनात्यपुण्याम् पुरुषाच्छतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: By seeing touching and drinking the waters of Ganga, or by praising them, hundreds and thousands of sinful men become purged of all their sins.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: य इच्छेत् सफलं जन्म जीवितं श्रुतमेव च। स पितृस्तर्पयेद् गङ्गामभिगम्य सुरांस्तथा॥
en: They who wish to make their birth, life, and learning successful, should go to Ganga and please the departed manes and the celestials by offering them oblations of water.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: न सुतैर्न च वित्तेन कर्मणा न च तत्फलम्। प्राप्नुयात् पुरुषोऽत्यन्तं गङ्गां प्राप्य यदाप्नुयात्॥
en: The merit that one acquires by bathing in Ganga is such that the like of it is incapable of being acquired through the acquisition of sons or riches or the performance of meritorious acts.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: जात्यन्धैरिह तुल्यास्ते मृतैः पङ्गुभिरेव च। समर्था ये न पश्यन्ति गङ्गां पुण्यजलां शिवाम्॥
en: Those who, although physically able do not seek to see the sacred Ganga, are, forsooth, comparable persons suffering from congenital blindness or those who are dead or those who are benumbed through palsy or lameness.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: भूतभव्यभविष्यज्ञैर्महर्षिभिरुपास्थिताम्। देवैः सेन्ट्रैश्च को गङ्गां नोपसेवेत मानवः॥
en: What is there who would not respect this sacred river that is adored by great Rishis knowing the Present the Past and the Future, as also by the very gods headed by Indra? to

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: वानप्रस्थैर्गृहस्थैश्च यतिभिर्ब्रह्मचारिभिः। विद्यावद्भिः श्रितां गङ्गां पुमान् को नाम नाश्रयेत्॥६९
en: What man is there who wouldnot seek the protection of Ganga whose protection is sought by hermits and householders, by Yatis and Brahmacharins alike?

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: उत्क्रामद्धिश्च यः प्राणः प्रयतः शिष्टसम्मतः। चिन्तयेन्मनसा गङ्गां स गतिं परमां लभेत्॥
en: The virtuous man with controlled mind, thinks of Ganga at the time when his vital airs are about to leave his body, succeeds in acquiring the highest end.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: न भयेश्यो भयं तस्य न पापेभ्यो न राजतः। आ देहपतनाद् गङ्गामुपास्ते यः पुमानिह॥
en: That man who lives by the side of Ganga up to the time of his death, worshipping her reverentially, becomes freed from all fear of sin and of kings.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: महापुण्यां च गगनात् पतन्तीं वै महेश्वरः। दधार शिरसा गङ्गां तामेव दिवि सेवते॥
en: When that highly sacred river dropped from the sky, Maheshvara held it on his head. It is that very river which is worshipped in heaven.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: अलंकृतास्त्रयो लोकाः पथिभिर्विमलैस्त्रिभिः। यस्तु तस्या जलं सेवेत् कृतकृत्यः पुमान् भवेत्॥७३
en: The three regions are beautiful by the three courses of this sacred river. The man who uses the waters of that river, becomes certainly successful.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: दिवि ज्योतिर्यथाऽऽदित्यः पितॄणां चैव चन्द्रमाः। देवेशश्च तथा नृणां गङ्गा च सरितां तथा॥
en: As the solar ray is to the gods in the celestial region, as the moon is to the departed manes, as the king is to human beings, so is Ganga to all rivers.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: मात्रा पित्रा सुतैारैर्विमुक्तस्य धनेन वा। न भवेद्धि तथा दुःखं यथा गङ्गावियोगजम्॥
en: One who becomes bereaved of mother or father or sons or wives or riches does not feel that grief which one feels when he becomes bereaved of Ganga.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: नारण्यैर्नेष्टविषयैर्न सुतैर्न धनागमैः। तथा प्रसादो भवति गङ्गां वीक्ष्य यथा भवेत्॥
en: One does not get that joy through acts that lead to the region of Brahman, or through such sacrifices and rites that lead to heaven, or through children or riches, which one get from seeing Ganga.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: पूर्णमिन्दुं यथा दृष्ट्वा नृणां दृष्टिः प्रसीदति। तथा त्रिपथगां दृष्ट्वा नृणां दृष्टिः प्रसीदति॥
en: The pleasure that men derive from seeing Ganga is tantamount to what they derive from seeing the full moon.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: तद्भावस्तद्गतमनास्तन्निष्टस्तत्परायणः! गङ्गां योऽनुगतो भक्त्या स तस्याः प्रियतां व्रजेत्॥७८
en: That man becomes dear to Ganga who worship her with deep devotion, with mind wholly fixed upon her, with a respect that refuses to take in any other object within its sphere, with a feeling that there is nothing else in the universe worthy of similar adoration, and with a steadiness that knows no decrease.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: भूस्थैः स्वःस्थैर्दिविष्ठैश्च भूतैरुच्चावचैरपि। गङ्गा विगाह्या सततमेतत् कार्यतमं सताम्॥
en: Creatures who live on Earth, in the sky or in the celestial region indeed, even beings who are very superior, should always bathe in Ganga. Indeed, this is the foremost of all duties of the righteous.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: विश्वलोकेषु पुण्यत्वाद् गङ्गायाः प्रथितं यशः। यत्पुत्रान्सगरस्येतो भस्माख्याननयद् दिवम्॥
en: The fame of Ganga for sanctity has spread over the entire universe, since she carried all the sons of Sagara, who had been reduced to ashes, from here to the celestial region,

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: १ताभिरत्यर्थसमुत्थिताभिः। गङ्गोर्मिभिर्भानुमतीभिरिद्धाः सहस्ररश्मिप्रतिमा भवन्ति॥
en: Men who are washed by the bright, beautiful, high, and rapidly moving waves, raised by the wind, of Ganga, become purged of all their sins and resemble in splendour the Sun with his thousand rays.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: पथस्विनी घृतिनीमत्युदारां समृद्धिनी वेगिनीं दुर्विगाह्याम्। गङ्गां गत्वा यैः शरीरं विसृष्टं गता धीरास्ते विबुधैः समत्वम्॥
en: Those men of tranquil souls who have renounced their bodies in the waters of Ganga whose sanctity is as great as that of the butter and other liquids poured in sacrifices and which are capable of giving merits equal to those of the greatest of sacrifices, have certainly attained to a station equal to that of the very gods.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: अन्धान् जडान् द्रव्यहीनांश्च गङ्गा यशस्विनी बृहती विश्वरूपा। देवैः सेन्ट्रैर्मुनिभिर्मानवैश्च निषेविता सर्वकामैथुनक्ति ॥
en: Indeed, Ganga, having faine and vast extent and at one with the entire universe and respected by the deities headed by Indra, the Munis, and human beings, is competent to grant the fruition of all their wishes io them who are blind, to them who are idiots, and to them who are destitute of all things.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: ऊर्जावती महापुण्यां मधुमती त्रिवम॑गाम्। त्रिलोकगोत्रीं ये गङ्गां संश्रितास्ते दिवं गताः॥
en: They who seek refuge with Ganga, that protectress of all the universe, that flows in three currents, that is filled with water at once highly sacred and sweet as honey and productive of every sort of good, have succeeded in acquiring the beatitude of Heaven.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: स्तस्मै प्रयच्छन्ति सुखानि देवाः। तद्भाविता: स्पर्शनदर्शनेन इष्टां गतिं तस्य सुरा दिशन्ति॥
en: That mortal who live by the side of Ganga and sees her every day, becomes purified by her sight and touch. To him the gods give every sort of happiness here and a high end hereafter.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: दक्षां पृश्निं बृहती विप्रकृष्टां शिवामृद्धां भागिनी सुप्रसन्नाम्। विभावरी सर्वभूतप्रतिष्ठा गङ्गां गता ये त्रिदिवं गतास्ते॥
en: Ganga is regarded as competent to rescue every creature from sin and lead him to the happiness of Heaven. She is held to be at one with Prishni the mother of Vishnu. She is identical with the Word or Speech. She is very remote and can not be easily attained. She is the embodiment of auspiciousness, and prosperity. She is capable granting the six wellknown attributes beginning with lordship or power. She is always bent upon showing her grace. She is the displayer of all things in the universe, and she is the great resort of all creatures. Those who seek her protection in this life have surely acquired heaven.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: ख्यातिर्यस्याः खं दिवंगां च नित्यं पुरा दिशो विदिशश्चावतस्थे। तस्या जलं सेव्य सरिद्वराया माः सर्वे कृतकृत्या भवन्ति॥
en: The fame of Ganga has spread all over the sky, and Heaven, and Earth, and all the points, cardinal and subsidiary, of the compass. By using the waters of that foremost of rivers, mortal creatures always become crowned with high success.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: इयं गङ्गेति नियतं प्रतिष्ठा गुहस्य रुक्मस्य च गर्भयोषा। प्रातस्त्रिवर्गा घृतवहा विपाप्मा गङ्गावतीर्णा वियतो विश्वतोया॥
en: That person who, himself seeing Ganga, points her out to others, finds that Ganga rescues him from rebirth and confers Liberation on him. Ganga held Guha, the commander-in-chief of the celestial army in her womb. She bears the most precious of all metals, viz., gold, also in that womb of hers. They who bathe in her waters every day in the morning, succeed in obtaining the three-fold objects, viz., Virtue and Wordly Profit and Pleasure. Those waters are, again, equal in point of sanctity to the butter that is poured with Mantras on the sacrificial fire. Capable of purging one from every sin, she has descended from the celestial region and her current is held in high regard by every one.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: सुतावनीध्रस्य हरस्य भार्या दिवो भुवश्चापि कृतानुरूपा। भव्या पृथिव्यां भागिनी चापि राजन् गङ्गा लोकानां पुण्यदा वै त्रयाणाम्॥
en: Ganga is the daughter of Himavat, the wife of Hara, and the ornament of both Heaven and Earth. She is the bestower of everything auspicious, and is competent to give the six well known attributes beginning with lordship or power. Indeed, O king, Ganga is the one object of great sanctity in the three worlds and confers merit upon all.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: महोर्मिभिः शोभिता ब्राह्मणैश्च। दिवश्च्युता शिरसाऽऽप्ता शिवेन गङ्गावनीध्रात त्रिदिवस्य माता॥
en: Truly, O king, Ganga is Virtue in liquefied i form. She is energy in a liquid forin over the Earth. She is gifted with the splendour or power that belongs to the butter that is poured with Mantras on the sacrificial fire. She is always adorned with large waves as also with Brahmanas who may at all times be seen making their ablutions in her waters. Falling from Heaven, she was held by Shiva on his head. The very mother of the heavens, she has originated from the highest mountain for running over the plains and conferring the most valuable benefits on all creatures of the Earth.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: योनिर्वरिष्ठा विरजा वितन्वी शय्याचिरा वारिवहा यशोदा। विश्वावती चाकृतिरिष्टसिद्धा गङ्गोक्षितानां भुवनस्य पन्थाः॥
en: She is the highest cause of all things; she is perfectly pure. She is as subtile as Brahma. She is the best bed for the dying. She takes creatures speedily to the celestial region. She carries a large volume of water. She confers great fame on all. She is the protectress of the universe. She is at one with every forin. She is very much coveted by persons crowned with success. Indeed, Ganga is the path to that celestial region of those who have bathed in her water.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: क्षान्त्या मह्या गोपने धारणेच दीप्त्या कृशानोस्तपनस्य चैव। तुल्या गङ्गा सम्मता ब्राह्मणानां गुहस्य ब्रह्मण्यतया च नित्यम्॥
en: The Brahmanas consider Ganga as being equal to the Earth in forgiveness, and in the protection and upholding of those who live by her, further, as equalling Fire and the Sun in energy and splendour; and, lastly, as always equalling Guha himself in the matter of showing favours to the trueborn class.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: ऋषिष्टुतां विष्णुपदी पुराणां सुपुण्यतोयां मनसापि लोके। स्ते ब्रह्मणः सदनं सम्प्रयाताः॥
en: Those men who, in the life, even in their minds seek that sacred river which is lauded by the Rishis, which has come out of the feet of Vishnu, which is very ancient, and which is highly sacred succeed in going to the regions of Brahman.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: लोकानवेक्ष्य जननीव पुत्रान् सर्वात्मना सर्वगुणोपपन्नान्। गङ्गा सदैवात्मवशरूपास्या॥
en: Fully convinced that children and other belongings, as also regions possessed of every kind of happiness, are transitory or frail, men of subdued souls, who are desirous of acquiring that everlasting station which is at one with Brahina, always pay their adorations to Ganga with that respect and love which are due from a son to a mother.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: मिरावतीं धारिणी भूधराणाम्। शिष्टाश्रयाममृतां ब्रह्मकान्तां गङ्गां श्रयेदात्मवान् सिद्धिकामः॥
en: The man of purified soul who is desirous of acquiring success should seek the protection of Ganga who is like a cow that gives ambrosia instead of ordinary milk, who is prosperity's self, who is endued with omniscience, who exists for all creatures, who is the source of all sorts of food, who is the mother of all mountains, who is the refuge of all pious persons, who is immeasurable in power and energy and who charms the heart of Brahman himself.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: प्रसाद्य देवान् सविभून् समस्तान् भगीरथस्तपसोग्रेण गङ्गाम्। गामानयत् तामभिगम्य शश्वत् पुंसां भयं नेह चामुत्र विद्यात्॥
en: Having, with austere penances, pleased all the gods with the Supreme Lord (Vishnu), Bhagiratha brought Ganga down on the Earth. Going to her, men always succeed in freeing themselves from every sort of fear both here and hereafter.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: उदाहतः सर्वथा ते गुणानां मयैकदेशः प्रसमीक्ष्य बुद्ध्या। शक्तिर्न मे काचिदिहास्ति वक्तुं गुणान् सर्वान् परिमातुं तथैव॥
en: Observing with the help of intelligence, I have mentioned to you only a small portion of the merits of Ganga. My power, however, is inadequate to speak of all the merits of the sacred river, or indeed, to measure her power and sanctity.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: मेरो: समुद्रस्य च सर्वयत्नैः संख्योपलानामुदकस्य वापि। शक्यं वक्तुं नेह गङ्गाजलानां गुणाख्यानं परिमातुं तथैव॥
en: One may, displaying his best powers, count the stones of the mountain Meru or measure the waters of the ocean. But one cannot count all the merits of the waters of Ganga.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: तस्मादेतान् परया श्रद्धयोक्तान् गुणान् सर्वान् जाह्नवीयान् सदैव। भवेद् वाचा मनसा कर्मणा च भक्त्या युक्तः श्रद्धया श्रद्दधानः॥
en: Hence, having listened to these particular merits of Ganga which I have uttered with great devotion, one should in thought, word and deed, respect them with faith and devotion.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: लोकानिमांस्त्रीन् यशसा वितत्य सिद्धिं प्राप्य महतीं तां दुरापाम्। गङ्गाकृतानचिरेणैव लोकान् यथेष्टमिष्टान् विहरिष्यसि त्वम्॥
en: On account of your having listened to those merits which I have recounted, you are sure to fill all the three regions with fame and acquire a measure of success that is very large and that is difficult of being won by any other person. Indeed, you will soon after that, sport in joy in many a region of great happiness created by Ganga herself for those that respect her.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: तव मम च गुणैर्महानुभावा जुषतु मतिं सततं स्वधर्मयुक्तः। अभिमतजनवत्सला हि गङ्गा जगति युनक्ति सुखैश्च भक्तिमन्तम्॥
en: Ganga always extends her favour to those who are devoted to her in huinbleness of heart. She unites those who are so devoted to her with every kind of happiness. I pray that the highly blessed Ganga may always inspire your heart and mine with the attributes of virtue.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: भीष्म उवाच शिलरतये त्रिपथानुयोगरूपान्। बहुविधमनुशास्य तथ्यरूपान् गगनतलं द्युतिमान् विवेश सिद्धः॥
en: Bhishma said The learned ascetic gifted with high soul and great slendour and crowned with success having in this manner described to that poor Brahmana observing the Shila vow, on the subject of the infinite merits of Ganga, then ascended the sky.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: शिलवृत्तिस्तु सिद्धस्य वाक्यैः सम्बोधितस्तदा। गङ्गामुपास्य विधिवत् सिद्धिं प्राप सुदुर्लभाम्॥
en: The poor Brahmana observing the Shila vow, awakened by the words of that ascetic crowned with success, duly sought refuge with Ganga and acquired great success.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: तथा त्वमपि कौन्तेय भक्त्या परमया युतः। गङ्गामभ्येहि सततं प्राप्स्यसे सिद्धिमुत्तमाम्॥
en: Do you also, O son of Kunti, seek Ganga with great devotion for you will then, as the reward thereof, acquire great and excellent Success.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वेतिहासं भीष्मोक्तं गङ्गायाः स्तवसंयुतम्। युधिष्ठिरः परां प्रीतिमगच्छद् भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing this discourse from Bhishma of the praise of Ganga, Yudhishthira with his brothers became filled with great joy.

description: Countries, provinces, mountains and rivers most sanctified
sn: इतिहासमिमं पुण्यं शृणुयाद् यः पठेत वा। गङ्गायाः स्तवसंयुक्तं स मुच्येत् सर्वकिल्बिषैः।।१०६।
en: That person who recites or hears recited this sacred topic of the praise of Ganga, becomes purged of every sin.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच प्रज्ञाश्रुताभ्यां वृत्तेन शीलेन च यथा भवान्। गुणैश्च विविधैः सर्वैर्वयसा च समन्वितः॥
en: Yudhishthira said You, O grandfather, are endued with wisdom and knowledge of the scriptures, with conduct and behaviour, with various kinds of excellent attributes and also with years.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: भवान् विशिष्टो बुद्ध्या च प्रज्ञया तपसा तथा। तस्माद् भवन्तं पृच्छामि धर्मे धर्मभृतां वर। नान्यस्तवदन्यो लोकेषु प्रष्टव्योऽस्ति नराधिप॥
en: You are superior to others in intelligence, wisdom and penances. I shall, therefore, O you the foremost of all righteous men, wish to ask you questions about virtue.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: क्षत्रियो यदि वा वैश्यः शूद्रो वा राजसत्तम। ब्राह्मण्यं प्राप्नुयाद् येन तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥ तपसा वा सुमहता कर्मणा वा श्रुतेन वा। ब्राह्मण्यमथ चेदिच्छेत् तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: There is not another man, O king, in all the worlds, who is worthier of being accosted on such topics. O best of kings, how may one, if he happens to be a Kshatriya or a Vaishya or a Shudra, succeed in acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana? You should tell nic the means. Is it by the most austere penances or by religious acts or by knowledge of the scriptures, that a person belonging to any of the three inferior castes succeeds in acquiring the dignity of Brahmana? Do tell me this, O grandfather.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मण्यं तात दुष्प्राप्यं वर्णैः क्षत्रादिभिस्त्रिभिः। परं हि सर्वभूतानां स्थानमेतद् युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said The dignity of a Brahmana, O Yudhishthira, cannot be acquired by a person belonging to any of the three other castes. That dignity is the highest with respect to all creatures.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: बह्वीस्तु संसरन् योनीर्जायमानः पुनः पुनः। पर्याये तात कस्मिंश्चिद् ब्राह्मणो नाम जायते॥
en: Passing through numberless orders of existence by undergoing repeated births, one at last in some birth, becomes born as a Brahmana.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। मतङ्गस्य व संवादं गर्दभ्याश्च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Regarding it is cited an old history, O Yudhishthira, of a conversation between Matanga and a she-ass.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: द्विजातेः कस्यचित् तात तुल्यवर्णः सुतस्त्वभूत्। मतङ्गो नाम नाम्ना वै सर्वैः समुदितो गुणैः॥
en: Once on a time a Brahmana obtained a son who, though procerated by a person belonging 10 a different caste, had, however, the rites of infancy and youth performed according to the ordinances laid down for Brahmanas. The Child passed by the name of Matanga and was endued with every accomplishment.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: स यज्ञकारः कौन्तेय पित्रोत्सृष्टः परंतप। प्रायाद् गर्दभयुक्तेन रथेनाप्याशुगामिना॥
en: His father wishing to celebrate a sacrifice, ordered him, O destroyer of enemies, to collect the articles required for the act. Having received the command of his father, he started for the purpose, riding on a quick coursing car, drawn by an ass.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: स बालं गर्दभं राजन् वहन्तं मातुरन्तिके। निरविध्यत् प्रतोदेन नासिकायां पुन: पुनः॥
en: It so happened that the ass yoked to that car was very young. Instead, therefore of being reined, the animal bore away the car near its dam. viz., the she-ass that had brought it forth. Malanga, dissatisfied with this, began to strike the animal with his goad on its nose.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: तत्र तीव्र व्रणं दृष्ट्वा गर्दभी पुत्रगृद्धिनी। उवाच मा शुचः पुत्र चाण्डालस्त्वधितिष्ठति॥
en: Seeing those marks of violence on her child's nose, the she-ass, full of affection for him, said, Do not grieve, O child, for this treatinent! A Chandala is driving you.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: ब्राह्मणे दारुणं नास्ति मैत्रो ब्राह्मण उच्यते। आचार्यः सर्वभूतानां शास्ता किं प्रहरिष्यति॥
en: There is no harshness in a Brahmana. The Brahmana is said to be the friend of all creatures. He is the teacher also of all creatures and their ruler. Can he punish any creature so cruelly.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: अयं तु पापप्रकृतिर्बाले न कुरुते दयाम्। स्वयोनि मानयत्येष भवो भावं नियच्छति॥
en: This fellow, however, is of sinful deeds. He has no mercy to show to even such a young creature. He is simply proving the order of his birth by behaving thus. The nature which he has derived from his father forbids the growth of the sentiments of pity and kindness which are natural to the Brahmana.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: एतच्छ्रुत्वा मतङ्गस्तु दारुणं रासभीवचः। अवतीर्य रथात् तूर्ण रासभी प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Hearing these harsh words of the she-ass Matanga speedily came down from the car and addressing the she-ass said, Tell me, O blessed dame, by what fault is my mother stained?

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: ब्रूहि रासभि कल्याणि माता मे येन दूषिता। कथं मां वेत्सि चण्डालं क्षिप्रं रासभि शंस मे॥
en: How do you know that I am a Chandala? Do you answer me forthwith,

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: कथं मां वेत्सि चण्डालं ब्राह्मण्यं येन नश्यते। तत्त्वेनैतन्महाप्रज्ञे ब्रूहि सर्वमशेषतः॥
en: How, indeed do you know that I am a Chandala? How have I lost the dignity of a Brahman? O you of great wisdom tell me all this fully, from beginning to end.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: गर्दभ्युवाच ब्राह्मण्यां वृषलेन त्वं मत्तायां नापितेन ह। जातस्त्वमसि चाण्डालो ब्राह्मण्यं तेन तेऽनशत्॥
en: The She-ass said You were begotten upon a Brahmana woman worked up with desire, by a Shudra following the calling of a barber. You are therefore, a Chandala by birth. You have not the dignity of a Brahmana.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तो मतङ्गस्तु प्रतिप्रायाद् गृहं प्रति। तमागतपभिप्रेक्ष्य पिता वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्॥ मया त्वं यज्ञसंसिद्धौ नियुक्तो गुरुकर्मणि। कस्मात् प्रतिनिवृत्तोऽसि कच्चिन्न कुशलं तव॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by the she ass Matanga returned home. Seeing him return. his father said I had engaged you in the difficult task of gathering the requisites of my intended sacrifice! Why have you returned without having accomplished your charge? Is it that you are not all right?

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: मतङ्ग उवाच अन्त्ययोनिरयोनिर्वा कथं स कुशली भवेत्। कुशलं तु कुतस्तस्य यस्येयं जननी पितः॥
en: Matanga said How can he who belongs to no definite order of birth, or to low caste be regarded as all right and happy? How O father, can that person be happy whose mother is impure.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: ब्राह्मण्यां वृषलाज्जातं पितर्वेदयतीव माम्। अमानुषी गर्दभीयं तस्मात् तप्स्ये तपो महत्॥
en: O father, this sheass, who seems to be more than a human being, tells me that I have been begotten upon a Brahman woman by a Shudra. I shall for this reason, practise the severest penances.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: एवमुक्त्वा स पितरं प्रतस्थे कृतनिश्चयः। ततो गत्वा महारण्यमतपत् सुमहत् तपः॥
en: Having said these words to his father, and firmly resolved upon what he had said, he went to the great forest and began to practise the austerest of penances.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: ततः स तापयामास विबुधास्तपसान्वितः। मतङ्गः सुखसम्प्रेप्सुः स्थानं सुचरितादपि॥
en: Beginning those penances for the purpose of happily acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana Matanga began to scorch the very gods by the severity of his asceticism,

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: तं तथा तपसा युक्तमुवाच हरिवाहनः। मतङ्ग तप्स्यसे किं त्वं भोगानुत्सृज्य मानुषान्॥
en: The king of the celestials, viz., Indra, appeared to him thus practising penances and said Why, O Matanga, do you pass your time in such grief, abstaining from all sorts of human enjoyments.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: वरं ददामि ते हन्त वृणीष्व त्वं यदिच्छसि। यच्चाप्यवाप्यं हृदि ते सर्वं तद् ब्रूहि माचिरम्॥
en: I shall give you boons. Do you name the boons. Do not delay, but tell me what is in your mind. Even if it be unattainable, I Shall yet bestow it on you.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: मतङ्ग उवाच ब्राह्मण्यं कामयानोऽहमिदमारब्धवांस्तपः। गच्छेयं तदवाप्येह वर एष वृतो मया॥
en: Matanga said Desirous of acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana I have begun to practise these penances. After having obtained it, I shall go home. Even this is the boon I pray for.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: भीष्म उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं तमुवाच पुरंदरः। मतङ्ग दुर्लभमिदं विप्रत्वं प्रार्थ्यते त्वया॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words of his, Purandara said to him The dignity of a Brahmana, O Matanga, which you wish to acquire, cannot be won by you.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: ब्राह्मण्यं प्रार्थयानस्त्वमप्राप्यमकृतात्मभिः। विनशिष्यसि दुर्बुद्धे तदुपारम माचिरम्॥
en: It is true, you wish to acquire it, but then it cannot be won by persons of impure souls. O you of foolish understanding, you are sure to meet with destruction if you persist in this pursuit. Desist, therefore, from this vain attempt forthwith.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: श्रेष्ठतां सर्वभूतेषु तपोऽर्थे नातिवर्तते। तदग्र्यं प्रार्थयानस्त्वमचिराद् विनशिष्यसि॥
en: This object of your desire viz., the dignity of Brahmana, which is the foremost of everything, cannot be even acquired by penances. Therefore by coveting that foremost dignity, you will surely meet with destruction.

description: How can a man of any other caste acquire the dignity of a Brahmana
sn: देवतासुरमर्येषु यत् पवित्रं परं स्मृतम्। चण्डालयोनौ जातेन न तत् प्राप्यं कथंचन॥
en: One born as a Chandala can never acquire that dignity which is considered as the most sacred among the celestials and Asuras and human beings. once

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तो मतङ्गस्तु संशितात्मा यतव्रतः। अतिष्ठदेकपादेन वर्षाणां शतमच्युतः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by Indra, Matanga of restrained vows and wellcontrolled soul, stood for a century of years on one foot, O you of unfading glory.

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: तमुवाच ततः शक्रः पुनरेव महायशाः। ब्राह्मण्यं दुर्लभं तात प्रार्थयानो न लप्स्यसे॥
en: Highly illustrious Shakra more appeared before him and addressing him said The dignity of a Brahmana, O child, is unattainable. Although you covet it. It is impossible for you to obtain it.

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: मतङ्ग परमं स्थानं प्रार्थयन् विनशिष्यसि। मा कृथाः साहसं पुत्र नैष धर्मपथस्तव॥
en: O Matanga, by coveting that very great dignity you are sure to meet with destruction. Do not, O son, betray such rashness. This is not a righteous path for you to follow.

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: न हि शक्यं त्वया प्राप्तुं ब्राह्मण्यमिह दुर्मते। अप्राप्यं प्रार्थयानो हि नचिराद् विनशिष्यसि॥
en: O you of foolish understanding, it is impossible for you to obtain it in this world, Verily, by coveting that which is unattainable you are sure to meet with destruction forthwith.

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: मतङ्ग परमं स्थानं वार्यमाणोऽसकृन्मया। चिकीर्षस्येव तपसा सर्वथा न भविष्यसि॥
en: I am repeatedly forbidding you. By trying, however, to attain that high dignity by the help of your penances, despite my repeated admonitions, you are sure to meet with destruction.

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: तिर्यग्योनिगतः सर्वो मानुष्यं यदि गच्छति। स जायते पुल्कसो वा चण्डालो वाप्यसंशयः॥
en: From a brute life one gains the status of humanity. If born as a human being, he is sure to be born as a Pukkasha or a Chandala.

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: पुल्कसः पापयोनिर्वा यः कश्चिदिह लक्ष्यते। स तस्यामेव सुचिरं मतङ्ग परिवर्तते॥
en: Verily, one having taken birth in that sinful caste, viz., Pulkasa, one, O Matanga, has to wander in it for a very long time.

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: ततो दशशते काले लभते शूद्रतामपि। शूद्रयोनावपि ततो बहुशः परिवर्तते॥
en: Passing a period of one thousand years in that order one is next born as a Shudra. In the Shudra order, again, one has to wander for a long time.

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: ततस्त्रिंशद्गुणे काले लभते वैश्यतामपि। वैश्यतायां चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते॥
en: After thirty thousand years one is born as a Vaishya. There in that order, one has to pass a very long time.

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: ततः षष्टिगुणे काले राजन्यो नाम जायते। ततः षष्टिगुणे काले लभते ब्रह्मबन्धुताम्॥ ब्रह्मबन्धुश्चिरं कालं ततस्तु परिवर्तते।
en: After a time that is sixty times longer than what has been stated as the period of Shudra birth, one becomes a Kshatriya. In the Kshatriya order one has to pass a very long time. After a time that is measured by multiplying the period last referred to by sixty, one is born as a fallen Brahmana. In this order one has to wander for a long period.

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: ततस्तु द्विशते काले लभते काण्ड पृष्ठताम्॥ काण्डपृष्ठिश्चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते।
en: After a time measured by multiplying the period last named by two hundred, one is born in the race of such a Brahmana as lives by the profession of arms. There in that order one has to wander for a long period.

description: -continued The story of Indra and Matanga
sn: ततस्तु त्रिंशते काले लभते जपतामपि॥ तं च प्राप्य चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते। ततश्चतुःशते काले श्रोत्रियो नाम जायते। श्रोत्रियत्वे चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते॥
en: After a time measured by multiplying the period last name by three hundred, one is born in the race of a Brahmana that is given to the recitation of the Gayatri and other sacred Mantras. There, in that order, one has to wander for a long period. After a time measured by multiplying the period last named by four hundred, one is born in the race of such a Bralımana who knows the entire Vedas and the scriptures. There, in that order, one has to wander for a very long period.
