description: The creation of woman and the object thereof. The story of Vipula and Devasharman
sn: एताः कृत्याश्च कार्याश्च कृताश्च भरतर्षभ। न चैकस्मिन् रमन्त्येताः पुरुषे पाण्डुनन्दन॥
en: Women are like those (Atharvan) Mantrams which destroy life. Even after they have consented to live with one, they are prepared to leave him joining others. They are never satisfied with one person of the opposite sex, O son of Pandu.

description: The creation of woman and the object thereof. The story of Vipula and Devasharman
sn: नासां स्नेहो नरैः कार्यस्तथैवेर्ध्या जनेश्वर। खेदमास्थाय भुञ्जीत धर्ममास्थाय चैव ह॥
en: Men should not love them, Nor should they cherish any jealousy on account of them, O king! Only for the sake of virtue, men should enjoy their society, not with enthusiasm and attachment but with unwillingness and absence of attachment.

description: The creation of woman and the object thereof. The story of Vipula and Devasharman
sn: निहन्यादन्यथाकुर्वन् नरः कौरवनन्दन। सर्वथा राजशार्दूल मुक्तिः सर्वत्र पूज्यते॥
en: By acting otherwise a man is sure to meet with destruction, O delighter of the Kurus. O foremost of kings, reason is respected at all times and under all circumstances.

description: The creation of woman and the object thereof. The story of Vipula and Devasharman
sn: तेनैकने तु रक्षा वै विपुलेन कृता स्त्रियाः। नान्यः शक्तस्त्रिलोकेऽस्मिन् रक्षितुं नृप योषितम्।।२७
en: Only one man viz., Vipula, had succeeded in protecting woman. There is none else, o king, in the three worlds who can protect women.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यन्मूलं सर्वधर्माणां स्वजनस्य गृहस्य च। पितृदेवातिथीनां च तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me of that, O grandfather, which is the root of all duties, which is the root of kinsmen of home, of the departed manes and of guests.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: अयं हि सर्वधर्माणां धर्मश्चिन्त्यतमो मतः। कीदृशस्य प्रदेया स्यात् कन्येति वसुधाधिप।॥
en: I think this should be considered as the foremost of all duties. Tell me, however, O king, to what sort of a person should one give his daughter.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: शीलवृत्ते समाज्ञाय विद्यां योनिं च कर्म च। सद्भिरेवं प्रदातव्या कन्या गुणयुते वरे॥
en: Having enquired into the conduct and nature of the person, his learning and acquirements, his birth, and his acts, good people should then confer their daughter upon accomplished bridegrooms.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: ब्राह्मणानां सतामेष ब्राह्मो धर्मो युधिष्ठिर। आवाह्यमावहेदेवं यो दद्यादनुकूलतः॥
en: All righteous Brahmanas, O Yudhishthira, act thus. This is known as the Brahma marriage, O Yudhishthira.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: शिष्टानां क्षत्रियाणां च धर्म एष सनातनः। आत्माभिप्रेतमुत्सृज्य कन्याभिप्रेत एव यः॥
en: Selecting a befitting bridegroom, the father of the girl should make him marry his daughter, having by various presents, induced the bridegroom to that act. This form of marriage, forms the eternal practice of all good Kshatriyas.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: अभिप्रेता च या यस्य तस्मै देया युधिष्ठिर। गान्धर्वमिति तं धर्मं प्राहुर्वेदविदो जनाः॥
en: When the father of the girl, without consulting his wishes, confers his own daughter upon a person whom the daughter likes and who reciprocates the girl's sentiments, the form of marriage, O Yudhishthira, is called Gandharva by those versed in the Vedas.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: धनेन बहुधा क्रीत्वा सम्प्रलोभ्य च बान्धवान्। असुराणां नृपैतं वै धर्ममाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: The wise have declared, O king, to be the practice of the Asuras, viz., marrying a girl after buying her at a high cost and after gratifying the cupidity of her kinsmen.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: हत्वा छित्त्वा च शीर्षाणि रुदतां रुदतीं गृहात्। प्रसह्य हरणं तात राक्षसो विधिरुच्यते॥
en: Killing and chopping off the heads of weeping kinsmen, the bridegroom sometimes forcibly takes away the girl he marries. Such marriage, O son, passes by the name of Rakshasa.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: पञ्चानां तु त्रयो धा द्वावधम्यौ युधिष्ठिर। पैशाचश्चासुरचैव न कर्तव्यो कथंचन॥
en: Of these five, (viz., the Brahma, the Kshatra, the Gandharva, the Asura, and the Rakshasa), three are righteous, O Yudhishthira, and two are unrighteous, The Paishacha and the Asura forms should, never be followed.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: ब्राह्मः क्षात्रेऽथ गान्धर्व एते धा नरर्षभ। पृथग् वा यदि वा मिश्राः कर्तव्या नात्र संशयः॥
en: The Brahma, Kshatra, and Gandharva forms are righteous, O prince of men! Pure or mixed, these forms should forsooth be followed.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: तिस्रो भार्या ब्राह्मणस्य द्वे भार्ये क्षत्रियस्य तु। वैश्यः स्वजात्यां विन्देत तास्वपत्यं समं भवेत्॥
en: The Brahmana can take three wives. The Kshatriya can take two wives. The Vaishya should take a wife from only his own caste. The children born of these wives should all be considered as equal.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: ब्राह्मणी तु भवेज्ज्येष्ठा क्षत्रिया क्षत्रियस्य तु। रत्यर्थमपि शूद्रा स्यान्नेत्याहरपरे जनाः॥
en: Of the three wives of a Brahmana. She taken from his own caste should be considered as the foremost. Likewise, of the two wives permitted to the Kshatriya, she taken from his own caste should be considered as superior. Some say that persons belonging to the three higher castes may take, only for purposes of enjoyment, wives from the lowest or the Shudra caste. Others, however, forbid the practice.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: अपत्यजन्म शूद्रायां न प्रशंसन्ति साधवः। शूद्रायां जनयन् विप्रः प्रायश्चित्ती विधीयते॥
en: The righteous condemn the practice of begetting children upon Shudra women. A Brahmana, by begetting children upon a Shudra women, becomes subject to the liability of performing an expiation.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: त्रिंशद्वर्षो दशवर्षां भार्यां विन्देत नग्निकाम्। एकविंशतिवर्षों वा सप्तवर्षामवाप्नुयात्॥
en: A person of thirty years of age should marry a girl of ten years of age wearing a single piece of cloth. Or, a person of one and twenty years of age should marry a girl of seven years of age.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: यस्यास्तु न भवेद् भ्राता पिता वा भरतर्षभ। नोपयच्छेत तां जातु पुत्रिकाधर्मिणी हि सा॥
en: That girl who has no brother nor father should not be married, O chief of Bharata's race, For she may be intended for giving birth to the heir of her father.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: त्रीणि वर्षाण्युदीक्षेत कन्या ऋतुमती सती। चतुर्थे त्वथ सम्प्राप्ते स्वयं भर्तारमर्जयेत्॥
en: After puberty, it in, the girl (if not married) should wait for three years. On the fourth year, she should look for a husband herself.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: प्रजा न हीयते तस्या रतिश्च भरतर्षभ। अतोऽन्यथा वर्तमाना भवेद् वाच्या प्रजापतेः॥
en: The children of such a girl do not lose their respectability, nor does union with such a girl become disgraceful. If, instead of selecting a husband for herself, she acts otherwise, she gets the reproach of Prajapati herself.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: असपिण्डा च या मातुरसगोत्रा च या पितुः। इत्येतामनुगच्छेत तं धर्मं मनुरब्रवीत्॥
en: One should marry that girl who is not a Sapinda of his mother or of the same family with his father. This is the usage which Manu has declared.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच शुल्कमन्येन दत्तं स्याद् ददानीत्याह चापरः। बलादन्यः प्रभाषेत धनमन्यः प्रदर्शयेत्॥ पाणिग्रहीता चान्य: स्यात् कस्य भार्या पितामह। तत्त्वं जिज्ञासमानानां चक्षुर्भवतु नो भवान्।॥
en: Yudhishthira said Desirous of marriage some one actually gives a dower to the girl's kinsmen; some one, the girl's kinsmen consenting, promises to give a present; some one says, I shall carry away the girl by force; some one simply shows his riches; some one, again, actually takes the hand of the girl with rites of marriage. I ask you, O grandfather, whose wife does the girl actually become? You are the eye to those who wish to know the truth.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: भीष्म उवाच यत् किंचित् कर्म मानुष्यं संस्थानाय प्रदृश्यते। मन्त्रवन्मन्त्रितं तस्य मृषावादस्तु पातकः॥
en: Bhishma said The deeds of men approved by the wise, are seen to yield good. False speech, however, is always sinful.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: भार्यापत्यत्विगाचार्याः शिष्योपाध्याय एव च। मृषोक्ते दण्डमर्हन्ति नेत्याहुरपरे जनाः॥
en: The girl herself who becomes wife, the sons born of her, the Ritvijas and preceptors and disciples and Upadhyayas present at the marriage all become liable to expiation if the girl gives her hand to a person other than he whom she had promised to marry. Some are of opinion that no expiation is necessary for such conduct.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: न ह्यकामेन संवासं मनुरेवं प्रशंसति। अयशस्यमधर्म्यं च यन्मृषा धर्मकोपनम्॥
en: Manu does not speak highly of the practice of a girl living with a person whom she does not like. Living as wife with a person whom she does not like, produces disgrace and sin. No one commits sin in any of the following cases.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: नैकान्तो दोष एकस्मिंस्तदा केनोपपद्यते। धर्मतो यां प्रयच्छन्ति यां च क्रीणन्ति भारत॥
en: In forcibly carrying away for marriage a girl that is bestowed upon the abductor by the girl's relatives with due rites, as also a girl for whom dower has been paid and accepted, there is no great sin.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: बन्धुभिः समनुज्ञाते मन्त्रहोमो प्रयोजयेत्। तथा सिद्ध्यन्ति ते मन्त्रा नादत्तायाः कथंचन॥
en: Upon the girl's kinsmen having given their consent, Mantras and Homa should be restored to. Such Mantras truly accomplish their purpose. Mantras and Homa recited and performed in the case of a girl who has not been given away by her kinsmen, do not accomplish their purpose.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: यस्त्वत्र मन्त्रसमयो भार्यापत्योर्मिथः कृतः। तमेवाहुर्गरीयांसं यश्चासौ ज्ञातिभिः कृतः॥
en: The engagement made by the relatives of a girl is, no doubt, binding and sacred. But the engagement that is made by the bride and bridegroom, with the help of Mantras, is very much, more so.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: देवदत्तां पतिर्भार्यां वेत्ति धर्मस्य शासनात्। स दैवीं मानुषीं वाचमनृतां पर्युदस्यति॥
en: According to the injunctions of the scriptures, the husband should regard his wife as an acquisition due to his own pristine deeds or to what has been ordained by God. One, therefore, commits no sin by accepting for wife a girl who had been promised to another by her kinsmen or for whom dower had been accepted by them from another.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कन्यायां प्राप्तशुल्कायां ज्यायांश्चेदाव्रजेद् वरः। धर्मकामार्थसम्पन्नो वाच्यमत्रानृतं न वा॥
en: Yudhishthira said When after the receipt of dower for a girl, the girl's father more eligible sees a bridegroom,-one, who is endued with the threefold objects, does the girl's father commit sin by rejecting the person from whom dower had been received in favour of him who is more eligible?

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: तस्मिन्नुभयतो दोषे कुर्वच्छ्रेयः समाचरेत्। अयं नः सर्वधर्माणां धर्मश्चिन्त्यतमो मतः॥
en: In such a case either alternative appears to be sinful, for to discard the person to whom the girl has been promised can never be honorable, while to reject the person who is more eligible can never be good. I ask, how should the father act so that he might be said to do that which is beneficial? To us, of all duties this seems to deserve utmost deliberation.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: तत्त्वं जिज्ञासमानानां चक्षुर्भवतु नो भवान्। तदेतत् सर्वमाचक्ष्व न हि तृप्यामि कथ्यताम्॥
en: We are desirous of determining the truth. You, indeed, are our eyes. Do you explain this to us. I am never satiated vith listening to you.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: भीष्म उवाच नैव निष्ठाकरं शुल्कं ज्ञात्वाऽऽसीत् तेन नाहृतम्। न हि शुल्कपराः सन्तः कन्यां ददति कर्हिचित्॥
en: Bhishma said The gift of the dower does not make the girl wife. This is wellknown to the person paying it. He pays it simply as the price of the girl . Then again the good never bestow their daughters, induced by the dowers that others may offer.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: अन्यैर्गुणैरुपेतं तु शुल्कं याचन्ति बान्धवाः। अलंकृत्वा वहस्वेति यो दद्यादनुकूलतः॥ यच्च तां च ददत्येवं न शुल्कं विक्रयो न सः। प्रतिगृह्य भवेद् देयमेष धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: When the person desirous of marrying happens to be gifted with such qualities as do not go down with the girl's kinsmen, it is then that kinsmen demand dower from him. The person, however, who won over by another's accomplishments, says,—Do you marry my girl, adorning her with proper ornaments of gold and gems,—and that person who satisfies this request, cannot be said to demand dower or give it, for such a transaction is not a sale. The bestowal of a daughter upon acceptance of what may properly be considered as gifts is the eternal practice.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: दास्यामि भवते कन्यामिति पूर्वं न भाषितम्। ये चाहर्ये च नाहर्ये ये चावश्यं वदन्त्युत॥
en: In matters of marriage, some fathers say-I shall bestow my daughter upon such and such a person; some say-~-I shall not bestow my daughter upon such a one:—Some, again, say forcibly—I must bestow my daughter upon such an individual.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: तस्मादा ग्रहणात् पाणेर्याचयन्ति परस्परम्। कन्यावरः पुरा दत्तो मरुद्भिरिति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: These declarations are not tantamount to actual marriage. People are seen to solicit one another for the hands of maidens. Till the hand is actually taken with due rites, marriage does not happen. We have heard that even this was the boon granted to men formerly by the Maruts about maidens.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: नानिष्टाय प्रदातव्या कन्या इत्यृषिचोदितम्। तन्मूलं काममूलस्य प्रजनस्येति मे मतिः॥
en: The Rishis have laid the command upon all men that maidens should never be bestowed upon persons unless the father are eligible. The daughter is the root of desire and of descendants of the collateral line. This is what I think.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: समीक्ष्य च बहून् दोषान् संवासाद् विद्धि पाणयोः। यथा निष्ठाकरं शुल्कं न जात्वासीत् तथा शृणु॥
en: The practice of sale and purchase of the daughter, has been known to human beings for a long time. On account of such familiarity with the practice, you may be able, upon careful examination, to find innumerable faults in it. The gift or acceptance of dower alone could not be considered as creating the relation of husband and wife. Listen to what I say on this head.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: अहं विचित्रवीर्यस्य द्वे कन्ये समुदावहम्। जित्वा च मागधान्सर्वान् काशीनाथं च कोसलान्।।३८
en: was Formerly, having defeated all the Magadhas, the Kashis, and the Koshalas, I bought away by force two maidens for Vichitravirya.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: गृहीतपाणिरेकाऽऽसीत् प्राप्तशुल्का पराभवत्। कन्या गृहीता तत्रैव विसा इति मे पिता।॥
en: One of those two maidens was married with due rites. The other maiden was not formally married on the ground that she was one for whom dower had been paid in the shape of chivalry My uncle of Kuru's race, viz., king Balhika, said that the maiden so brought away and not married with due rules should be liberated. That maiden, therefore, recommended to Vichitravirya for being married by him according to due rites.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: अब्रवीदितरां कन्यामावहेति स कौरवः। अप्यन्याननुपप्रच्छ शङ्कमानः पितुर्वचः॥
en: Doubting my father's words I went to others for asking their opinion. I thought that my father was exceedingly punctilious in matters of morality.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: अतीव ह्यस्य धर्मेच्छा पितुर्मेऽभ्यधिकाभवत्। ततोऽहमब्रुवं राजन्नाचारेप्सुरिदं वचः। आचारं तत्त्वतो वेत्तुमिच्छामि च पुनः पुनः॥
en: I then went to my father himself, O king, and addressed him these words from desire of Knowing something about the practices of pious people in respect of marriage: I wish, O sire, to know what in truth the practices are of righteous people! I repeatedly expressed my wish. Such was my eagerness and curiosity, that I expressed my desire several times.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: ततो मयैवमुक्ते तु वाक्ये धर्मभृतां वरः। पिता मम महाराज बाह्रीको वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ यदि वः शुल्कतो निष्ठा न पाणिग्रहणात् तथा। लाभान्तरमुपासीत प्राप्तशुल्क इति स्मृतिः॥
en: After I had uttered those words that foremost of pious men, viz., my father Balhika, answered me, saying-If in your opinion the relation of husband and wife belongs to the gift and acceptance of dower and not to the actual taking of the maiden's hand with due rites, the father of the maiden would show himself to be the follower of a creed other than that which comes from the ordinary scriptures. This is what the accepted scriptures say.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: न हि धर्मविदः प्राहुः प्रमाणं वाक्यतः स्मृतम्। येषां वै शुल्कतो निष्ठा न पाणिग्रहणात् तथा॥
en: Persons conversant with morality and duty do not hold that their words are at all authoritative who say that the relation of husband and wife arises from the gift and acceptance of dower, and not from the actual taking of the hand with due rites.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: प्रसिद्ध भाषितं दाने नैषां प्रत्यायकं पुनः। ये मन्यन्ते क्रयं शुल्कं न ते धर्मविदो नराः॥
en: The saying is well known that the relation of husband and wife is created by actual bestowal of the daughter by the father. The relation of wife is not formed through sale and purchase. They who consider such status to be due to sale and the gift of dower are persons who are certainly unacquainted with the scriptures.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: न चैतेभ्यः प्रदातव्या न वोढव्या तथाविधा। न ह्येव भार्या क्रेतव्या न विक्रय्या कथंचन॥
en: No one should bestow his daughter upon such persons. In fact, they are not men with whom one may marry his daughter. A wife should never be purchased. Nor should a father sell his daughter.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: ये च क्रीणन्ति दासी च विक्रीणन्ति तथैव च। भवेत् तेषां तथा निष्ठा लुब्धानां पापचेतसाम्॥
en: Only those sinful persons who possessed besides, by cupidity, and who sell and purchase female slaves for making them servants, consider the relation of wife as capable of originating from the gift and acceptance of dower.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: अस्मिन्नर्थे सत्यवन्तं पर्यपृच्छन्त वै जनाः। कन्यायाः प्राप्तशुल्कायाः शुल्कदः प्रशमं गतः॥४८ पाणिग्रहीता वान्यः स्यादत्र नो धर्मसंशयः। तन्नश्छिन्धि महाप्राज्ञ त्वं हि वै प्राज्ञसम्मतः॥
en: On this subject some people on one occasion had asked prince Satyavat the are following question-If the giver of a dower to the kinsmen of a maiden happens to die before marriage, can another person take the hand of that maiden in marriage? We have doubts on this matter. Do you remove these doubts of ours for you are gifted with great wisdom and are honoured by the wise.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: तत्त्वं जिज्ञासमानानां चक्षुर्भवतु नो भवान्। तानेवं ब्रुवतः सर्वान् सत्यवान् वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ यत्रेष्टं तत्र देया स्यान्नात्र कार्या विचारणा।
en: ghaflat citantsura ya taifat HyrT:114 811 Be you the eyes to ourselves who are desirous of learning the truth.—Prince Satyavat answered, saying,-The kinsmen of the maiden should bestow her upon him whom they consider proper. There need be no scruples in this. The righteous act thus without caring for the giver of the dower even if he be alive! while, about the giver who is dead, there is not the slightest doubt.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: देवरं प्रविशेत् कन्या तप्येद् वापि तपः पुनः। तमेवानुगता भूत्वा पाणिग्रहस्य काम्यया।॥
en: Some say that the virgin wife or widow, whose, marriage has not been consummated with her husband by actual sexual intercourse on account of his absence or death-may be allowed to unite herself with her husband's younger brother or such other relation. The husband dying before such consummation, the virginwidow may either surrender herself to her husband's younger brother or practise penances.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: लिखन्त्येव तु केषांचिदपरेषां शनैरपि। इति ये संवदन्त्यत्र त एतं निश्चयं विदुः॥
en: In the opinion of some, the younger brother of the husband or such other relation may thus use the virgin wife or widow, though others hold that such practice, though it is frequent, originates from desire instead of being a scriptural ordinance. They who say so are clearly of opinion that the father of a maiden has the right to bestow her upon any eligible person, disregarding the dower previously given by another and accepted by himself. one

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: पाणिग्रहस्य तत्पाणिग्रहणात् पूर्वमन्तरं यत्र वर्तते। सर्वमङ्गलमन्त्रं वै मृषावादस्तु पातकः॥
en: If after the hand of a maiden has been promised all the initial rites before marriage be performed, the maiden may still be given to a person other than the one to whom she had been promised. Only the giver commits the sin of falsehood; so far, however, as the relation of wife is concerned, no injury can occur thereto.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: पाणिग्रहणमन्त्राणां निष्ठा स्यात् सप्तमे पदे। भार्या स्याद् यस्य चाद्भिः प्रदीयते।
en: The Mantras of marriage accomplish their object of bringing about the indissoluble union of marriage at the seventh step. The maiden becomes the wife of him to whom the gift is actually made with water.

description: The rites of marriage and all the particulars thereof
sn: इति देय वदन्त्यत्र त एनं निश्चयं विदुः॥ अनुकूलामनुवंशां भ्रात्रा दत्तामुपाग्निकाम्। परिक्रम्य यथान्यायं भार्यां विन्देद् द्विजोत्तमः॥
en: The gift of maidens should be made in the following way. The wise know it forsooth. A superior Brahmana should marry a maiden who is not unwilling, who belongs to a family equal to his own in purity or dignity, and who is given away by her brother. Such a girl should be married in the presence of fire, with due rites, causing her, amongst other things, to go round the bridegroom for the usual number of times.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कन्यायाः प्राप्तशुल्कायाः पतिश्चेन्नास्ति कश्चन। तत्र का प्रतिपत्तिः स्यात् तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said If a person, after having given dower for a maiden, goes away, how should the maiden's father or other kinsmen who can bestow her, act? Do tell me this, O grandfather?

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: भीष्म उवाच याऽपुत्रकस्य ऋद्धस्य प्रतिपाल्या तदा भवेत्। अथ चेन्नाहरेच्छुल्कं क्रीता शुल्कप्रदस्य सा॥
en: Bhishma said Such a maiden, if she be the daughter of a sonless and rich father, should be maintained by the father. Indeed, if the father does not return the dower to the kinsmen of the giver, the maiden should be considered as belonging to the giver of the dower.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: तस्यार्थेऽपत्यमीहेत येन न्यायेन शक्नुयात्। न तस्मान्मन्त्रवत्कार्यं कश्चित् कुर्वीत किंचन॥
en: She may even raise children for the giver by any of those means that are laid down in the scriptures. No person, however, can marry her according to due rites.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: स्वयंवृतेन साऽऽज्ञप्ता पित्रा वै प्रत्यपद्यता तत् तस्यान्ये प्रशंसन्ति धर्मज्ञा नेतरे जनाः॥
en: Commanded by her father, the princess Savitri had in days of old chosen a husband and united herself with him. This act of hers is praised by some; but others, conversant with the scriptures, condemn it'.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: एतत् तु नापरे चक्रुरपरे जातु साधवः। साधूनां पुनराचारो गरीयान् धर्मलक्षणः॥
en: Others who are righteous have not acted thus. Others maintain that the conduct of the righteous should ever be considered as the foremost evidence of duty or morality.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: अस्मिन्नेव प्रकरणे सुक्रतुर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्। नप्ता विदेहराजस्य जनकस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Upon this subject, Sukratu, the grand son of the great Janaka, the king of the Videhas, has declared the following opinion.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: असदाचरिते मार्गे कथं स्यादनुकीर्तनम्। अत्र प्रश्नः संशयो वा सतामेवमुपालभेत्॥
en: There is the wellknown injunction of the scriptures that women can enjoy freedom at any period of their life. If this were not the path of the virtuous, how could this scriptural saying exist? As regards the pious, therefore, how can there be any question or doubt about it? How can people condemn that saying by choosing to conduct themselves otherwise?

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: असदेव हि धर्मस्य प्रदानं धर्म आसुरः। नानुशुश्रुम जात्वेतामिमां पूर्वेषु कर्मसु॥
en: The impious violation of eternal practice is considered as the practice of the Asuras. We never hear of such practice in the conduct of the ancients.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: भार्यापत्योर्हि सम्बन्धः स्त्रीपुंसोः स्वल्प एव तु। रतिः साधारणो धर्म इति चाह स पार्थिवः॥
en: The relationship of husband and wife is very subtile. It is different from the natural relationship of male and female which consists only in the desire for sexual intercourse. This also was said by ihe king of Janaka's race.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अथ केन प्रमाणेन पुंसामादीयते धनम्। पुत्रवद्धि पितुस्तस्य कन्या भवितुमर्हति॥
en: Yudhishthira said Under what authority is the property of men inherited (by others when they happen to have daughters)? As for her father the daughter should be considered the same as the son.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: भीष्म उवाच यथैवात्मा तथा पुत्रः पुत्रेण दुहिता समा। तस्यामात्मनि तिष्ठन्त्यां कथमन्यो धनं हरेत्॥
en: Bhishma said The son is even as one's own self, and the daughter is like the son. How, therefore, can another take the riches when one lives in his ownself in the form of his daughter?

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: मातुश्च यौतकं यत् स्यात् कुमारीभाग एव सः। दौहित्र एव तद् रिक्थमपुत्रस्य पितुर्हरेत्॥
en: Whatever is the own property of the mother, is due to the maiden daughter. If the maternal grandfather happens to die without leaving sons, the daughter's son should inherit it.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: ददाति हि स पिण्डान् वै पितुर्मातामहस्य च। पुत्रदौहित्रयोरेव विशेषो नास्ति धर्मतः॥
en: The daughter's son offers funeral cakes to his own father and the father of his mother. Hence, for the ends of justice, there is no difference between the son and their daughte son.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: अन्यत्र जामया साधु प्रजानां पुत्र ईहते। दुहितान्यत्र जातेन पुत्रेणापि विशिष्यते॥
en: When a person has got only a daughter and she has been invested by him with the position of a son, if he then happens to have a son, such son shares the inheritance with the daughter. When, again, a person has got a daughter and she has been invested by him with the position of a son, if he then happens to take a son by adoption or purchase, then the daughter is considered superior to such son.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: दौहित्रकेण धर्मेण नात्र पश्यामि कारणम्। विक्रीतासु हि ये पुत्रा भवन्ति पितुरेव ते॥
en: In the following case I do not see any reason why the daughter's son should be considered as the proper heir. The case is that of the daughter who has been sold by her father. The sons born of a daughter who has been sold by her sire for actual price, belong exclusively to their father. Such sons can never belong, even as daughter's sons, to their maternal grandfather on account of his having sold their mother for price and lost all his rights in or to her by that deed.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: असूयवस्त्वधर्मिष्ठाः परस्वादायिनः शठाः। आसुरादधिसम्भूता धर्माद् विषमवृत्तयः॥
en: Such sons, again, become full of malice, impious in conduct, the misappropriators of other people's riches, and full of deceit and cunning. Having originated from that sinful form of marriage called Asura, the offspring becomes wicked in conduct.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: अत्र गाथा यमोद्भीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः। धर्मज्ञा धर्मशास्त्रेषु निबद्धा धर्मसेतुषु॥
en: Persons acquainted with ancient history, conversant with duties, devoted to the scriptures and firm in maintaining the restrictions therein laid down, recite in this connection some verses sung in days of yore by Yama.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: यो मनुष्यः स्वकं पुत्रं विक्रीय धनमिच्छति। कन्यां वा जीवितार्थाय यः शुल्केन प्रयच्छति॥ सप्तावरे महाघोरे निरये कालसाह्वये। स्वेदं मूत्रं पुरीषं च तस्मिन् मूढः समश्नुते॥
en: That man who acquires riches by selling his own son, or who bestows his daughter after accepting a dower for his own livelihood, has to sink in seven dreadful hells one after another, known by the name of Kalas. There that wretch has to feed upon sweat and urine and stools during that period.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: आर्षे गोमिथुनं शुल्कं केचिदाहुम॒षैव तत्। अल्पो वा बहु वा राजन् विक्रयस्तावदेव सः॥
en: In that form of marriage which is called Arsha, the person who marries has to give a bull and a cow and the father of the maiden accepts the gift. Some characterise this gift as a dower (or price), while some are of opinion that it should not be considered in that light. The true opinion, however, is that a gift for such a purpose, be it of small value or large, should, O king, be considered as dower or price, and the bestowal of the daughter under such circumstances should be considered as a sale.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: यद्यप्याचरित: कैश्चिन्नैष धर्मः सनातनः। अन्येषामपि दृश्यन्ते लोकतः सम्प्रवृत्तयः॥
en: Despite the fact of its having been practised by a few persons it can never be taken as the eternal practice. Other forms of marriage are seen, practiced by men, such as marrying girls after carrying them away by force from amidst their kinsmen.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: वश्यां कुमारी बलतो ये तां समुपभुजते। एते पापस्य कर्तारस्तमस्यन्थे च शेरते॥
en: Those persons who have sexual intercourse with a maiden, by force are considered as perpetrators of sin. They have to sink in darkest hell.

description: How a maiden after she is left off by a man after promise, should be treated. The inheritance of a person's property, who has daughters
sn: अन्योऽप्यथ न विक्रेयो मनुष्यः किं पुनः प्रजाः। अधर्ममूलैर्हि धनैस्तैर्न धर्मोऽथ कश्चन॥
en: Even a human being who is not a relation of blood should not be sold. What need then be said of one's own child? With the riches that is acquired by doing sinful deeds, no meritorious deed can be performed.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: भीष्म उवाच प्राचेतसस्य वचनं कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः। यस्याः किंचित्राददते ज्ञातयो न स विक्रयः॥
en: Bhishma said They who know the ancient history recite the following verse of Daksha the son of Prachetas, viz.,-That maiden, for whom nothing is taken by her kinsmen in the form of dower, cannot be said to be sold.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: अर्हणं तत्कुमारीणामानृशंस्यतमं च तत्। सर्वं च प्रतिदेयं स्यात् कन्यायै तदशेषतः॥
en: Honour good treatment, and everything else which is agreeable, should all be given to the maiden whose hand is taken in marriage.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: पितृभिर्धातृभिश्चापि श्वशुरैरथ देवरैः। पूज्या भूषयितव्याश्च बहुकल्याणमीप्सुभिः॥
en: Her father and brothers and fatherinlaw and husband's brothers should show her every respect and adorn her with ornaments, if they be desirous of reaping benefits, for such conduct their part always produces considerable happiness and advantage.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: यदि वै स्त्री न रोचेत पुमांसं न प्रमोदयेत्। अप्रमोदात् पुनः पुंसः प्रजनो न प्रवर्धते॥
en: If the wife does not like her husband or fails to please him, from such dislike and absence of joy, the husband can never have children for increasing his family.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: पूज्या लालयितव्याश्च स्त्रियो नित्यं जनाधिप। स्त्रियो यत्र च पूज्यन्ते रमन्ते तत्र देवताः॥
en: on Women, O king should always be adored and treated with love. There where women are treated with honour, the very gods are said to be propitiated.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: अपूजिताश्च यत्रैताः सर्वास्तत्राफला: क्रियाः। तदा चैतत् कुलं नास्ति यदा शोचन्ति जामयः॥
en: There where women are not adored, all acts become fruitless. If the women of a family, on account of the treatment they receive, indulge in grief and tears, that family soon becomes extinct.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: जामीशप्तानि गेहानि निकृत्तानीव कृत्यया। नैव भान्ति न वर्धन्ते श्रिया हीनानि पार्थिवा॥
en: Those houses which are cursed by women meet with destruction and ruin as if scorched by some Atharvan rite. Such houses lose their splendour. Their growth and prosperity cease, O king.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: स्त्रियः पुंसां परिददे मनुर्जिगमिषुर्दिवम्। अबलाः स्वल्पकौपीनाः सुहृदः सत्यजिष्णवः॥
en: Manu, on the eve of his departure from this world, made over women to the care and protection of men, saying that they are weak, that they fall an easy prey to the seduction of men, disposed to accept the love which is offered them, and devoted to truth.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: ईर्षवो मानकामाश्च चण्डाश्च सुहृदोऽबुधाः। स्त्रियस्तु मानमर्हन्ति ता मानयत मानवाः॥
en: There are others among them who are full of malice, covetous of honours, fierce in nature, unlovable, and impervious to reason. Women, however, deserve to be respected. Do ye men show them honour.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: स्त्रीप्रत्ययो हि वै धर्मो रतिभोगाश्च केवला:। परिचर्या नमस्कारास्तदायत्ता भवन्तु वः॥
en: The virtue of men depends upon women. All pleasures and enjoyments also entirely depend upon them. Do you serve them and adore them. Do ye bend your wills before them.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: उत्पादनमपत्यस्य जातस्य परिपालनम्। प्रीत्यर्थं लोकयात्रायाः पश्यत स्त्रीनिबन्धनम्॥
en: The begetting of children, the nursing of children already born, and the accomplishment of all deeds necessary for the needs of society, see, all these have women for their cause.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: सम्मान्यमानाचैता हि सर्वकार्याण्यवाप्स्यथा विदेहराजदुहिता धात्र श्लोकमगायत॥
en: By respecting women, you are sure to acquire the fruition of all objects. Regarding it a princess of the house of Janaka the king of

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: नास्ति यज्ञक्रिया काचित्र श्राद्धं नोपवासकम्। धर्मः स्वभर्तृशुश्रूषा तया स्वर्ग जयन्त्युत॥
en: Women have no sacrifices ordained for them. There are no Shraddhas which they are called upon to perform. They are not required to observe any fasts. To serve their husbands wish respect and willing obedience from their only duty. Through the satisfaction of that duty they succeed in conquering Heaven.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: पिता रक्षति कौमारे भर्ता रक्षति यौवने। पुत्राश्च स्थाविरे भावे न स्त्री स्वातन्त्र्यमर्हति॥
en: In childhood, the father protects her. The husband protects her in youth. When she becomes old, her sons protect her. At no period of her life is woman free.

description: The duties of men towards women
sn: श्रिय एताः स्त्रियो नाम सत्कार्या भूतिमिच्छता। पालिता निगृहीता च श्रीः स्त्री भवति भारत॥
en: Women are deities of prosperity. The person that desires affluence and prosperity should honour them. By cherishing women, O Bharata, one cherishes the goddess of prosperity herself, and by afflicting her, one is said to pain the goddess of prosperity.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सर्वशास्त्रविधानज्ञ राजधर्मविदुत्तमा अतीव संशयच्छेत्ता भवान् वै प्रथितः क्षितौ॥
en: Yudhishthira said You know fully well the ordinances of all the scriptures. You are the foremost of those who are acquainted with the duties of kings. You are celebrated over the whole world as a great remover of doubts.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: कश्चित्तु संशयो मेऽस्ति तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह। जातेऽस्मिन् संशये राजन् नान्यं पृच्छेम कंचन॥
en: I have a doubt, do you explain it to me, O grandfather. As regards this doubt that has originated in my mind, I shall not ask any other person for its solution.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: यथा नरेण कर्तव्यं धर्ममार्गनुवर्तिना। एतत् सर्वं महाबाहो भवान् व्याख्यातुमर्हति॥
en: You should, O you of mighty arms, expound as to how a man should act who is desirous of treading along the path of duty and virtue.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: चतस्रो विहिता भार्या ब्राह्मणस्य पितामह। ब्राह्मणी क्षत्रिया वैश्या शूद्रा च रतिमिच्छतः॥
en: It has been laid down, O grandfather that a Brahmana can take four wives, viz., one who belongs to his own caste, one who is a Kshatriya, one who is a Vaishya, and one who is a Shudra, if the Brahmana wishes to satisfy the desire of sexual intercourse.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: तत्र जातेषु पुत्रेषु सर्वासां कुरुसत्तम। आनुपूर्येण कस्तेषां पित्र्यं दायादमर्हति॥
en: Tell me, O best of the Kurus, which amongst those sons should inherit the father's riches one after another.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: केन वा किं ततो हार्यं पितृवित्तात् पितामह। एतदिच्छामि कथितं विभागस्तेषु यः स्मृतः॥
en: Who amongst them, O grandfather shall take what share of the paternal wealth? I wish to hear this, viz., how the distribution has been ordained amongst them of the paternal property.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यस्त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः। एतेषु विहितो धर्मो ब्राह्मणस्य युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said The Brahman, the Kshatriya, and the Vaishya are considered the three twiceborn castes, To marry in these three castes has been ordained to be the duty of the Brahmana, O Yudhishthira.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: वैषम्यादथवा लोभात् कामाद् वापि परतंप। ब्राह्मणस्य भवेच्छूद्रा न तु दृष्टान्ततः स्मृता॥
en: Through erroneous judgement or cupidity or lust, O destroyer of enemies, a Brahmana takes a Shudra wife. He is not competent to take, according to the scriptures, such wife.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: शूद्रां शयनमारोप्य ब्राह्मणो यात्यधोगतिम्। प्रायश्चित्तीयते चापि विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: A Brahmana, by knowing a Shudra woman comes by a low end in the next world. He should, having done such an act, perform expiation according to the rites laid down in the scriptures.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: तत्र जातेष्वपत्येषु द्विगुणं स्याद् युधिष्ठिर। आपद्यमानमृक्थं तु सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि भारत॥
en: That expiation must be twice heavier or severer if on account of such an act, O Yudhishthira, the, Brahmana gets children. I shall now tell you, O Bharata, how the (paternal), wealth is to be distributed.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: लक्षण्यं गोवृषो यानं यत् प्रधानतमं भवेत्। ब्राह्मण्यास्तद्धरेत् पुत्र एकांशं वै पितुर्धनात्॥
en: The son born of the Brahmani wife shall, in the first place, appropriate from his father's wealth a bull of good marks, and the best car or vehicle.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: शेषं तु दशधा कार्य ब्राह्मणस्वं युधिष्ठिर। तत्र तेनैव हर्तव्याश्चत्वारोऽशाः पितुर्धनात्॥
en: What remains of the Brahmana's property, O Yudhishthira, after this, should be divided into ten equal parts, The son by the Brahmani wife shall take four of such parts of the paternal property.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: क्षत्रियायास्तु यः पुत्रो ब्राह्मणः सोऽप्यसंशयः। स तु मातुर्विशेषेण त्रीनंशान् हर्तुमर्हति॥
en: The son that is born of the Kshatriya wife is, forsooth, possessed of the status of a Brahmana. On account, however, of the distinction attaching to his mother, he shall take three of the ten shares into which the property has been divided.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: वर्णे तृतीये जातस्तु वैश्यायां ब्राह्मणादपि। द्विरंशस्तेन हर्तव्यो ब्राह्मणस्वाद् युधिष्ठिर॥
en: The son who has been born of the wife belonging to the third caste, viz., the woman of the Vaishya caste, by the Brahmana father, shall take, O Yudhishthira, two of the three remaining shares of the father's property.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: शूद्रायां ब्राह्मणाज्जातो नित्यादेयधनः स्मृतः। अल्पं चापि प्रदातव्यं शूद्रापुत्राय भारत॥
en: It has been said that the son who has been begotten by the Brahmana father upon the Shudra wife should not take any portion of the father's property, for he is not to be considered an heir. A little, however, of the paternal property should be given to the son of the Shudra wife, hence the one remaining share should be given to him out of compassion.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: दशधा प्रविभक्तस्य धनस्यैष भवेत् क्रमः। सवर्णासु तु जातानां समान् भागान् प्रकल्पयेत्॥
en: Even this should be the order of the ten shares into which the Brahmana's wealth is to be distributed. All the sons that are born of the same mother or of mothers of the same caste, shall share equally the portion that is theirs.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: अब्राह्मणं तु मन्यन्ते शूद्रापुत्रमनैपुणात्। त्रिषु वर्णेषु जातो हि ब्राह्मणाद् ब्राह्मणो भवेत्॥
en: The son born of the Shudra wife should not be considered as invested with the dignity of a Brahmana on account of his being unskilled (in the scriptures and the duties ordained for the Brahmana). Only those children who are born of wives belonging to the three higher castes should be considered as invested with the dignity of Brahmanas.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: स्मृताश्च वर्णाश्चत्वारः पञ्चमो नाधिगम्यते। हरेच्च दशमं भागं शूद्रापुत्रः पितुर्धनात्॥
en: It has said that there are only four castes and there is no fifth. The son by the Shudra wife shall take the tenth part of his father's wealth.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: सपुत्रः स्यादपुत्रो तत्तु दत्तं हरेत् पित्रा नादत्तं हर्तुमर्हति। अवश्यं हि धनं देयं शूद्रापुत्राय भारत॥
en: That share, however, he is to take only when his father has given it to him. He shall not take it if his father does not give it to him. Some portion of the father's riches should, forsooth, be given O Bharata, to the son of the Shudra wife.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: आनृशंस्यं परो धर्म इति तस्मै प्रदीयते। यत्र तत्र समुत्पन्नं गुणायैवोपपद्यते॥
en: Compassion is one of the greatest virtues. It is through compassion that something is given to the son of the Shudra wife. Whatever be the object about which compassion arises, as a cardinal virtue it is always productive of merit.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: यद्यप्येष यदि वा भवेत्। नाधिकं दशमाद् दद्याच्छूद्रापुत्राय भारत॥
en: Whether the father happens to have children (by his wives belonging to the other castes) or to have no children, to the son by the Shudra wife, O Bharata, nothing more than a tenth part of the father's wealth should be given.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: त्रैवार्षिकाद् यदा भक्तादधिकं स्याद् द्विजस्य तु। यजेत तेन द्रव्येण न वृथा साधयेद् धनम्॥
en: If a Brahmana happens to have more riches than what is necessary for maintaining himself and his family for three years, he should with that riches celebrate sacrifices. A Brahmana should never acquire riches for nothing.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: त्रिसहस्रपरो दायः स्त्रियै देयो धनस्य वै। भळ तच्च धनं दत्तं यथार्हे भोक्तुमर्हति॥
en: The highest sum that the husband should give the wife is three thousand coins. This wealth that the husband gives to the wife, the latter may spend or dispose of as she likes.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: स्त्रीणां तु पतिदायाद्यमुपभोगफलं स्मृतम्। नापहारं स्त्रियः कुर्युः पतिवित्तात् कथंचन॥
en: Upon the death of the childless husband, the wife shall enjoy all his riches. The wife should never take any portion of her husband's riches.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: स्त्रियास्तु यद् भवेद् वित्तं पित्रा दत्तं युधिष्ठिर। ब्राह्मण्यास्तेद्धरेत् कन्या यथा पुत्रस्तथा हि सा॥
en: Whatever riches, O Yudhishthira, the Bralımani wife may acquire by gift from her father, should be taken by her daughter, for the daughter is like the son.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: सा हि पुत्रसमा राजन् विहिता कुरुनन्दन। एवमेव समुद्दिष्टो धर्मो वै भरतर्षभ। एवं धर्ममनुस्मृत्य न वृथा साधयेद् धनम्॥
en: The daughter, O king, has been ordained in the scriptures to be equal to the son, O delighter of the Kurus. Thus has the law of inheritance been ordained, o foremost of Bharata's family. Remembering these ordinances about the distribution and disposal of wealth, one should never acquire riches uselessly.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच शूद्रायां ब्राह्मणाज्जातो यद्यदेयधनः स्मृतः। केन प्रतिविशेषेण दश्मोऽप्यस्य दीयते॥
en: Yudhishthira said If the son born of a Shudra woman by a Brahmana father has been made in the scriptures to be disentitled to any property, by what exception of the rule then is a tenth part of the paternal property to be given to him?

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: ब्राह्मण्यां ब्राह्मणाज्जातो ब्राह्मण: स्यान्न संशयः। क्षत्रियायां तथैव स्याद् वैश्यायामपि चैव हि॥
en: A son born of a Brahmani wife by a Brahmana is unquestionably a Brahmana. One born of a Kshatriya wife or of a Vaishya wife, by a Brahmana husband, is likewise a Brahmana.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: कस्मात् तु विषमं भागं भजेरन् नृपसत्तम। यदा सर्वे त्रयो वर्णास्त्वयोक्ता ब्राह्मणा इति॥
en: Why then, O best of kings, are such sons to share the paternal property unequally? All of them, you have said, are Brahmanas, having been born of mothers that belong to the three higher castes equally entitled to the name of the twiceborn.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: भीष्म उवाच दारा इत्युच्यते लोके नाम्नैकेन परतंपा प्रोक्तेन चैव नाम्नायं विशेषः सुमहान् भवेत्॥
en: Bhishma said O destroyer of enemies, all wives in this world are called by the name of Dara. Although that name is applied to all, yet there is this great difference to be observed.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: तिस्रः कृत्वा पुरो भार्याः पश्चाद् विन्देत ब्राह्मणीम्। सा ज्येष्ठा सा च पूज्या स्यात् सा च भार्या गरीयसी।
en: If having married three wives belonging to the three other castes, a Brahmana takes a Brahmani wife the very last of all, yet shall she be considered as the first in rank among all the wives, and as being worthy of the greatest respect. Indeed, among all the cowives, she shall be the foremost.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: स्नानं प्रसाधनं भर्तुर्दन्तधावनमञ्जनम्। हव्यं कव्यं च यच्चान्यद् धर्मयुक्तं गृहे भवेत्॥
en: In her apartments should be kept all necessary articles for the husband's baths, personal decorations washing of teeth, and application of collyrium to the eyes. In her apartments should be kept the Havya and the Kavya and all else that the husband may need for the performance of his religious acts.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: न तस्यां जातु तिष्ठन्त्यामन्या तत् कर्तुमर्हति। ब्राह्मणी त्वेव कुर्याद् वा ब्राह्मणस्य युधिष्ठिर॥
en: If the Brahmani wife is in the house, no other wife is entitled to attend to these needs of the husband. Only the Brahmani wife, O Yudhishthira, should help the husband in these acts.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: अन्नं पानं च माल्यं च वासांस्याभरणानि च। ब्राह्मण्यैतानि देयानि भर्तुः सा हि गरीयसी॥
en: The husband's food and drink and garlands and dresses and ornaments-all these should be given by the Brahmani wife to the husband, for she is the foremost in rank among all the wives of the husband.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: मनुनाभिहितं शास्त्रं यच्चापि कुरुनन्दन। तत्राप्येष महाराज दृष्टो धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: These are the ordinances of the scriptures as laid down by Manu, O delighter of the Kurus! This, O king is seen to be the course of eternal practice.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: अथ चेदन्यथा कुर्याद् यदि कामाद् युधिष्ठिर। यथा ब्राह्मणचाण्डालः पूर्वदृष्टस्तथैव सः॥
en: If a Brahmana,OYudhishthira, actuated by lust, acts in a different way, he shall come to be considered as a Chandala among Brahmanas.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: ब्राह्मण्याः सदृशः पुत्रः क्षत्रियायाश्च यो भवेत्। राजन् विशेषो यस्त्वत्र वर्णयोरुभयोरपि॥
en: The son born of the Kshatriya wife has been said to be equal in dignity to the son born of the Brahmani wife. For all that, a distinction attaches to the son of the Brahmana wife on account of the superiority of the Brahmana wife to the Kshatriya wife in respect of the order of caste.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: न तु जात्या समा लोके ब्राह्मण्याः क्षत्रिया भवेत्। ब्राह्मण्याः प्रथमः पुत्रो भूयान् स्याद् राजसत्तम॥
en: The Kshatriya wife cannot be considered as equal to the Brahmana wife in point of Birth. Hence, O best of kings, the son born of the Brahinani wife must be considered as the first in rank and superior to the son born of the Kshatriya wife.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: भूयो भूयोऽपि संहार्यः पितृवित्ताद् युधिष्ठिर। यथा न सदृशी जातु ब्राह्मण्याः क्षत्रिया भवेत्॥
en: Because, again, the Kshatriya wife, is not equal in point of birth to the Brahmani wife, hence the son of the Brahmani wife takes, one after another, all the best things, O Yudhishthira, among his father's property.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: क्षत्रियायास्तथा वैश्या न जातु सदृशी भवेत्। श्रीश्च राज्यं च कोशश्च क्षत्रियाणां युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: Likewise, the Vaishya wife cannot be considered as the equal of the Kshatriya wife in point of birth. Prosperity, kingdom and treasury, ( Yudhishthira, belong to the Kshatriyas.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: विहितं दृश्यते राजन् सागरान्तां च मेदिनीम्। क्षत्रियो हि स्वधर्मेण श्रियं प्राप्नोति भूयसीम्। राजा दण्डधरो राजन् रक्षा नान्यत्र क्षत्रियात्॥
en: All these have been ordained for the Kshatriya. The whole Earth, O king, encircled by seas, is seen to belong to him. By following the duties of his own caste, the Kshatriya acquires immense riches.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: ब्राह्मणा हि महाभागा देवानामपि देवताः। तेषु राजन् प्रवर्तेत पूजया विधिपूर्वकम्॥
en: The sceptre of royalty is held by him. Without the Kshatriya, O king, there can be no protection. The Brahmanas are highly blessed, for they are the gods of the very deities.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: प्रणीतमृषिभिर्ज्ञात्वा धर्मं शाश्वतमव्ययम्। लुप्यमानं स्वधर्मेण क्षत्रियो ह्येष रक्षिति॥
en: Following the ordinances laid down by the Rishis, the Kshatriyas should adore the Brahmanas according to due rites. This is the eternal usage.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: दस्युभिर्रियमाणं च धनं दारांश्च सर्वशः। सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां त्राता भवति पार्थिवः॥
en: Coveted by thieves and others, the properties of all men are protected by Kshatriyas following the duties of their order. Indeed, riches and wives and every other possession owned by people would have been forcibly taken away but for this protection that the Kshatriyas give.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: भूयान् स्यात् क्षत्रियापुत्रो वैश्यापुत्रान्न संशयः। भूयस्तेनापि हर्तव्यं पितृवित्ताद् युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: The Kshatriya, as the king, becomes the protector or rescuer of all the castes. Hence, the son of the Kshatriya wife shall, forsooth, be held to be superior to him that is born of the Vaishya wife. The son of Kshatriya wife for this, takes a larger share of the paternal property than the son of the Vaishya mother.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उक्तं ते विधिवद् राजन् ब्राह्मणस्य पितामह। इतरेषां तु वर्णानां कथं वै नियमो भवेत्॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have duly said what the rules are that apply to Brahmanas. What, However, are the rules that apply to the others?

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: भीष्म उवाच क्षत्रियस्यापि भर्ये द्वे विहिते कुरुनन्दन। तृतीया च भवेच्छूद्रा न तु दृष्टान्ततः स्मृता।॥
en: Bhishma said The Kshatriya, O delighter of the Kurus can take two wives. The Kshatriya may take a third wife from the Shudra caste. Such practice prevails, it is true, but it is not sanctioned by the scriptures.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: एष एव क्रमो हि स्यात् क्षत्रियाणां युधिष्ठिर। अष्टधा तु भवेत् कार्य क्षत्रियस्वं जनाधिप।॥
en: This should be the order, O Yudhishthira, of the wives of a Kshatriya. The property of a Kshatriya should, O king, be divided into eight shares.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: क्षत्रियाया हरेत् पुत्रश्चतुरोंऽशान् पितुर्धनात्। युद्धावहारिकं यच्च पितुः स्यात्स हरेत् तु तत्॥
en: The son of the Kshatriya wife shall take four of such shares of the paternal property. The son of the Vaishya wife shall take three of such shares.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: वैश्यापुत्रस्तु भागांस्त्रीशूद्रापुत्रस्तथाष्टमम्। सोऽपि दत्तं हरेत् पित्रा नादत्तं हर्तुमर्हति॥
en: The remaining one or the eighth share shall be taken by the son of the Shudra wife. The son of the Shudra wife, however, shall take only when the father gives but not otherwise.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: एकैव हि भवेद् भार्या वैश्यस्य कुरुनन्दन। द्वितीया तु भवेच्छूद्रा न तु दृष्टान्ततः स्मृता॥
en: The Vaishya can take only one wife. He can take a second wife from the Shudra caste. Such is the practice, no doubt, but it is not sanctioned by the scriptures.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: वैश्यस्य वर्तमानस्य वैश्यायां भरतर्वभ। शूद्रायां चापि कौन्तेय तयोर्विनियमः स्मृतः॥
en: If a Vaishya has two wives one of whom is a Vaishya and the other a Shudra, there is a difference between them in respect of position.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: पञ्चधा तु भवेत् कार्य वैश्यस्वं भरतर्षभ। तयोरपत्ये वक्ष्यामि विभागं च जनाधिप॥
en: The riches of a Vaishya, O chief of Bharata's race, should be divided into five portions. I shall now speak of the sons of a Vaishya by a wife of his own caste and by one belonging to the inferior caste, as also of the manner in which, o king, his property is to be distributed among chose children.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: वैश्यापुत्रेण हर्तव्याश्चत्वारोंऽशाः पितुर्धनात्। पञ्चमस्तु स्मृतो भागः शूद्रापुत्राय भारत॥
en: The son born of the Vaishya wife shall take four of such shares of his paternal property. The fifth share, O Bharata, has been said to belong to the son born of the Shudra wife.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: सोऽपि दत्तं हरेत् पित्रा नादत्तं हर्तुमर्हति। त्रिभिर्वर्णैः सदा जातः शूद्रोऽदेयधनो भवेत्॥
en: Such son, however, shall take when the father gives. He should not take anything unless the father gives it to him. The son who is begotten on a Shudra wife by persons of the three higher higher castes should always be considered as disentitled to any share of the father's wealth.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: शूद्रस्य स्यात् सवर्णैव भार्या नान्या कथंचन। समभागाश्च पुत्राः स्युर्यदि पुत्रशतं भवेत्॥
en: The Shudra should take only one wife from his own caste. He can, under no circumstances, take any other wife. Even if he happens to have a hundred sons by this wife, all of them share equally the property that he may leave behind.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: जातानां समवर्णायाः पुत्राणामविशेषतः। सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां समभागो धनात् स्मृतः॥
en: As for all the castes, the children born of the wife taken from the husband's own caste shall, it has been laid down, share equally the father's wealth.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: ज्येष्ठस्य भागो ज्येष्ठः स्यादेकांशो यः प्रधानतः। एष दायविधिः पार्थ पूर्वमुक्तः स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: The eldest son's share shall be greater than that of every other son, for he shall take one share than each of his brothers, comprising the best things of this father. This is the law of inheritance, O son of Pritha, as declared by the selfcreate himself. more

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: समवर्णासु जातानां विशेषोऽस्त्यपरो नृप। विवाहवैशिष्ट्यकृतः पूर्वपूर्वो विशिष्यते॥
en: Amongst children all born of the wife taken from the husband's own caste there is another difference, O king! In marrying, the elder ones should always prccede the younger ones.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: हरेज्ज्येष्ठः प्रधानांशमेकं तुल्यासु तेष्वपि। मध्यमो मध्यमं चैव कनीयांस्तु कनीयसम्॥
en: The wives being all equal in respect of their order of birth, and the children also being all equal in respect of the position of their mothers, the son that is firstborn shall take one share more than each of his other brothers. The son who is next in point of age shall take a share that is next in value, while the son who is youngest shall take the share which belongs to the youngest.

description: The rules of marriage and the law of inheritance
sn: एवं जातिषु सर्वासु सवर्ण: श्रेष्ठतां गतः। महर्षिरपि चैतद् वै मारीचः काश्यपोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus among wives of all castes, they who belong to the samne caste with the husband are considered as the first. This is what was declared by the great Rishi Kashyapa the son of Marichi.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अर्थाल्लोभाद् वा कामाद् वा वर्णानां चाप्यनिश्चयात्। अज्ञानाद् वापि वर्णानां जायते वर्णसंकरः॥
en: Yudhishthira said The intermixture of castes is brought about through inducements offered by richies, or through mere lust, or through ignorance of the true order of birth.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: तेषामेतेन विधिना जातानां वर्णसंकरे। को धर्मः कानि कर्माणि तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: What, O grandfather, are the duties of persons who are born in the mixed classes and what are the acts laid down for them? Do you describe them to me.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: भीष्म उवाच चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य कर्माणि चातुर्वण्र्यं च केवलम्। असृजत् स हि यज्ञार्थे पूर्वमेव प्रजापतिः॥
en: Bhishma said In the beginning, the Lord of all creatures created the four castes and laid down their respective duties, for the sake of sacrifice.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: भार्याश्चतस्रो विप्रस्य द्वयोरात्मा प्रजायते। आनुपूर्व्याद् द्वयो_नौ मातृजात्यौ प्रसूयतः॥
en: The Brahmana may take four wives, one from each of the four castes. In two of them, he takes birth himself. Those sons, however, who are begotten by him on the two other inferior, (viz., Vaishya and Shudra), are inferior, their position being settled not by that of their father but by that of their mothers.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: परं शवाद् ब्राह्मणस्यैव पुत्रः शूद्रापुत्रं पारशवं तमाहुः। शुश्रूषकः स्वस्य कुलस्य स स्यात् स्वचारित्रं नित्यमथो न जह्यात्॥
en: The son begotten by a Brahmana upon a Shudra wife is called Parashva, meaning one bom of a dead body for the Shudra woman's body is as inauspicious as a dead body. He should serve the persons of his (father's) race. Indeed, it is not proper for him to renounce the duty of service that has been laid down for him.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: सर्वानुपायानथ सम्प्रधार्य समुद्धरेत् स्वस्य कुलस्य तन्त्रम्। ज्येष्ठो यवीयानपि यो द्विजस्य शुश्रूषया दानपरायणः स्यात्॥
en: With all means in his power, he should maintain his family. Even if he happens to be elder in age, he should still dutifully serve the other children of his father, who in age may be younger to him, and give them whatever he may succeed in acquiring.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: तिस्रः क्षत्रियसम्बन्धाद् द्वयोरात्मास्य जायते। हीनवर्णास्तृतीयायां शूद्रा उग्रा इति स्मृतिः॥
en: A Kshatriya may take three wives. In two of them, he takes birth himself. His third wife being of the Shudra caste, is considered as very inferior. The son that he begets upon her is called an Ugra.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: द्वो चापि भार्ये द्वयोरात्मास्य जायते। शूद्रा शूद्रस्य यचाप्येका शूद्रमेव प्रजायते॥
en: The Vaishya may take two wives. In both of them, he takes birth himself. The Shudra can take only one wife, from his own caste. The son begotten by him upon her becomes a Shudra.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: अतोऽविशिष्टस्त्वधमो गुरुदारप्रधर्षकः। बाह्यं वर्णं जनयति चातुर्वर्ण्यविगर्हितम्॥
en: A son who takes birth under circumstances other than those mentioned above, is considered as a very inferior one. If a person of a lower caste begets a son upon a woman of a superior caste, such son is regarded as outside the pale of the four pure castes. Indeed, such son becomes an object of derision with the four principal castes.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: विप्रायां क्षत्रियो बाह्यं सूतं स्तोमक्रियापरम्। वैश्यो वैदेहकं चापि मौद्गल्यमपवर्जितम्॥
en: If a Kshatriya begets a son upon Brahmani woman, such son, without being included in any of the four pure castes, comes to be considered as a Suta, The duties of a Suta consist in reciting eulogies and encomiums of kings and other great men. The son begotten by a Vaishya upon a woman of the Brahmana, order, is known as a Vaidehaka. Their duties consist in taking charge of bars and bolts for protecting the privacy of women of respectable families. Such sons have no purifying rites laid down for them.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: शूद्रश्चाण्डालमत्युग्रं वध्यघ्नं बाह्यवासिनम्। ब्राह्मण्यां सम्प्रजायन्त इत्येते कुलपांसनाः। एते मतिमतां श्रेष्ठ वर्णसंकरजाः प्रभो॥
en: If a Shudra knows a woman belonging to the foremost of the four castes, the son that is begotten is called a Chandala. Endued with a dreadful disposition, he must live in the outskirts of cities and towns and his duty is that are a or। of the public executioner. Such sons are always considered as wretches of their race. These, O foremost of intelligent persons, the offspring of intermixed castes.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: बन्दी तु जायते वैश्यान्मागधो वाक्यजीवनः। शूद्रान्निषादो मत्स्यनः क्षत्रियायां व्यतिक्रमात्॥
en: The son begotten by a Vaishya upon a Kshatriya woman becomes Bandi Magadha. His duties are eloquent recitations of praise. The son begotten through transgression, by a Shudra upon a Kshatriya woman, becomes a Nishada and his duties consist in the catching of fish.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: शूद्रादायोगवश्चापि वैश्यायां ग्राभ्यधर्मिणः। ब्राह्मणैरप्रतिग्राह्यस्तक्षा स्वधनजीवनः॥
en: If a Shudra happens to know a Vaishya woman, the son begotten upon her comes to be called Ayogava. The duties of such a person are those of a carpenter. The Brahmana should never accept gifts from such a person. They are not entitled to possess any kind of riches.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: एतेऽपि सदृशान् वर्णान् जनयन्ति स्वयोनिषु। मातृजात्याः प्रसूयन्ते ह्यवरा हीनयोनिषु॥
en: Persons belonging to the mixed castes beget upon wives taken from their own castes children invested with their position. When they procreate children in women taken from other inferior castes, such children become inferior to their fathers, for they become invested with the position of their mothers.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: यथा चतुर्पु वर्णेषु द्वयोरात्मास्य जायते। आनन्तर्यात् प्रजायन्ते तथा बाह्यः प्रधानतः॥
en: Thus as regards the four pure castes, persons beget children invested with their own position upon wives taken from their own castes as also upon them that are taken from the castes immediately below their own. When, however, offspring is begotten upon other wives, they are regarded as invested with a position that is, principally, outside the pale of the four pure castes.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: ते चापि सदृशं वर्णं जनयन्ति स्वयोनिषु। परस्परस्य दारेषु जनयन्ति विगर्हितान्॥ तु
en: When such children beget sons in women, taken from their own classes, those sons take the position of their fathers. It is only when they take wives from castes other than their own, that the children they beget, become invested with inferior position.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: यथा शूद्रोऽपि ब्राह्मण्यां जन्तुं बाह्यं प्रसूयते। एवं बाह्यतराद् बाह्यश्चातुर्वर्णात् प्रजायते॥
en: As an example of this it may be said that a Shudra begets upon a woman belonging to the inost superior cast a son that is outside the pale of the four castes, by uniting with women belonging to the four principal castes, begets offspring that is further degraded in point of position.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: प्रतिलोमं वर्धन्ते बाह्याद् बाह्यतरात् पुनः। हीनाद्धीनाः प्रसूयन्ते वर्णाः पञ्चदशैव तु॥
en: From those outside the pale of the four castes and those again that are further outside that limit, children multiply on account of the union of persons with women of classes superior to their own. Thus, from persons of inferior position classes spring up, altogether fifteen in number, that are equally low or still lower in dignity.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: अगम्यागमनाच्चैव जायते वर्णसंकरः। बाह्यानामनुजायन्ते सैरन्ध्रयां मागधेषु च। प्रसाधनोपचारज्ञमदासं दासजीवनम्॥
en: It is only from sexual union with women of persons who should not have such union with them that mixed castes originate. Among the classes that are thus outside the limit of the four principal or pure castes, children are begotten upon woman belonging to the class called Sairindhri by men of the class called Magadha.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: अतश्चायोगवं सूते वागुराबन्धजीवनम्। मैरेयकं च वैदेहः सम्प्रसूतेऽथ माधुकम्॥
en: The occupation of such children is the adorement of the bodies of kings and others. They are well acquainted with the preparation of unguents, the making of garlands, and the manufacture of articles used for the decoration of the body. Though free by the position that belongs to them by birth, they should live like servants. From the union of Magadhas of a certain class with women of the caste called Sairindhri, another caste originates, called Ayogava. Their business consists in the making of nets. Vaidehas, by knowing Sairindhri women, beget children called Maireyakas whose business is the manufacture of wines and spirits.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: निषादो मद्गुरं सूते दासं नावोपजीविनम्। मृतपं चापि चाण्डालः श्वपाकमिति विश्रुतम्॥
en: From the Nishadas originate a caste called Madgura and another known by the name of Dasas whose business is plying boats. From the Chandalas originates a race called Shvapaka whose business lies in keeping guard over the dead.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: चतुरो मागधी सूते क्रूरान् मायोपजीविनः। मांसं स्वादुकरं क्षौद्रं सौगन्धमिति विश्रुतम्॥
en: The women of the Magadhi caste, by union with these four castes of wicked nature, produce four others who live by deceitful means. These are Mangsa, Svadukara, Kshaudra, and Saugandha.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: वैदेहकाच्च पापिष्ठा क्रूरं मायोपजीविनम्। निषादान्मद्रनाभं च खरयानप्रयायिनम्॥
en: From the Vaideha originates cruel and sinful caste that lives by practising deception. From the Nishadas again originates the Madranabha caste whose members are seen to ride on cars drawn by asses.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: चाण्डालात् पुल्कसं चापि खराश्वगजभोजिनम्। मृतचैलप्रतिच्छन्नं भिन्नभाजनभोजिनम्॥
en: From the Chandalas originates the caste called Pukkasa whose members are seen to eat the flesh of asses, horses and elephants. These are clad in clothes, procured by stripping human corpses. They are again seen to eat off broken earthenware.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: आयोगवीषु जायन्ते हीनवर्णास्तु ते त्रयः। क्षुद्रो वैदेहकाद-ध्रो बहिर्गामप्रतिश्रयः॥
en: These three castes of very low origin, are born of women of the Ayogava caste (by fathers taken from different castes). The caste called Kshudra originates from the Vaidehaka. The caste called Andhra which lives in the outskirts of towns and cities, also originates (from the Vaidehakas).

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: कारावरो निषाद्यां तु चर्मकारः प्रसूयते। चाण्डालात् पाण्डुसौपाकस्त्वक्सारव्यवहारवान्॥
en: Then, again, the Charmakara, knowing woman of the Nishada caste, begets the class called Karavara. From the Chandala, again, originates the caste known by the name of Pandusaupaka whose business is to make baskets and other things with cleft bamboos.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: आहिण्डको निषादेन वैदेह्यां सम्प्रसूयते। चण्डालेन तु सौपाकश्चण्डालसमवृत्तिमान्॥
en: From the union of the Nishada with a woman of the Vaidehi caste, originates one who is called by the name of Ahindaka. The Chandala begets upon a Saupaka women a son who does not differ from the Chandala in position or occupation.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: निषादी चापि चाण्डालात् पुत्रमन्तेवसायिनम्। श्मशानगोचरं सूते बाबैरपि बहिष्कृतम्॥
en: A Nishadi woman, by union with a Chandala, produces a son who lives in the outskirts of villages and towns. Indeed, the members of such a caste live in crematoria and are considered by the very lowest orders as incapable of being classed among them.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: इत्येते संकरे जाताः पितृमातृव्यतिक्रमात्। प्रच्छन्ना वा प्रकाशा वा वेदितव्याः स्वकर्मभिः।२९।
en: Thus do these mixed castes originate from improper and sinful union of fathers and mothers belonging to different castes. Whether they live hidden or openly, they should be known by their occupations.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: चतुर्णामेव वर्णानां धर्मो नान्यस्य विद्यते। वर्णानां धर्महीनेषु संख्या नास्तीह कस्यचित्॥
en: The duties have been laid down in the scriptures of only the four principal castes. About others, the scriptures are entirely silent. Among all the castes, the members of those castes that have no duties assigned to them by the scriptures, need entertain no fears as to what they do.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: यदृच्छयोपसम्पन्नेर्यज्ञसाधुबहिष्कृतैः। बाह्या बाह्येश्च जायन्ते यथावृत्ति यथाश्रयम्॥
en: Persons unaccustomed to the performance of sacrifices or for whom sacrifices have not been laid down, and who are deprived of the company and the instructions of the pious, whether classed among the four principal castes or out of their limit, by uniting themselves with women of other castes, led not by considerations of virtue but by uncontrolled lust, cause numerous mixed castes to originate whose occupations and houses depend on the circumstances connected with the irregular unions from which they spring.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: चतुष्पथश्मशानानि शैलाश्चान्यान् वनस्पतीन्। कार्णायसमलंकारं परिगृह्य च नित्यशः॥
en: Having recourse to such places where four roads meet, or crematoria, or hills and mountains, or forests and trees, they build their houses. The ornaments they wear are made of iron.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: वसेयुरेते विज्ञाता वर्तयन्तः स्वकर्मभिः। युञ्जन्तो वाप्यलंकारांस्तथोपकरणानि च॥
en: Living in such places, openly, following their own occupations for acquiring livelihood. They may be seen to live thus, adorning their persons with ornaments and engaged in the work of manufacturing various domestic and other utensils.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: गोब्राह्मणाय साहाय्यं कुर्वाणा वै न संशयः। आनृशंस्यमनुक्रोशः सत्यवाक्यं तथा क्षमा॥
en: Forsooth, by assisting kine and Brahmanas, and practising the virtues of abstention from cruelty, compassion, truthfulness of speech, and forgiveness, and, if it is necessary, protecting others by sacrificing their own lives, persons of the mixed castes, may acquire success. I have no doubt, o king that these virtucs become the causes of their success.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: स्वशरीरैरपि त्राणं बाह्यानां सिद्धिकारणम्। भवन्ति मनुज्व्याघ्र तत्र मे नास्ति संशयः॥ यथोपदेशं परिकीर्तितासु नरः प्रजायेत विचार्य बुद्धिमान्। निहीनयोनिर्हि सुतोऽवसादयेत् तितीप्रमाणं हि यथोपलो जले॥
en: He who is gifted with intelligence, should, taking everything into consideration, beget children according to the scriptural injunctions, upon women that have been declared as proper or fit for him. A son begotten upon a woman belonging to a degraded caste, instead of rescuing the father, brings him to grief even as a heavy burden brings to grief a swimmer desirous of crossing a pool of water.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: अविद्वांसमलं लोके विद्वांसमपि वा पुनः। नयन्ति ह्यपथं नार्यः कामक्रोधवशानुगम्॥
en: Whether a man is learned or otherwise, lust and anger are natural tendencies of humanity in this world. Women, therefore, may always be seen to drag men into the wrong path.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: स्वभावश्चैव नारीणां नराणामिह दूषणम्। अत्यर्थं न प्रसज्जन्ते प्रमदासु विपश्चितः ॥
en: The disposition of women is such that man's contact with her produces misery. Hence, wise men do not allow themselves to be excessively attached to women.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच वर्णापेतमविज्ञाय नरं कलुषयोनिजम्। आर्यरूपमिवानार्यं कथं विद्यामहे वयम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said There are men who belong to the mixed castes, and who are of very impure birth. Putting respectable appearance, they are, in sooth, disrespectable. On account of those external signs we may not be able to know the truth about their birth. Are there any signs, O grandfather, by which the truth may be known about the origin of such men?

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: भीष्म उवाच योनिसंकलुषे जातं नानाभावसमन्वितम्। कर्मभिः सज्जनाचीर्णैर्विज्ञेया योनिशुद्धता॥
en: Bhishma said A person who is born of an irregular union shows various features of disposition. One's purity of birth, again, is to be determined from one's acts which must resemble the acts of those who are admittedly good and pious.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: अनार्यत्वमनाचारः क्रूरत्वं निष्क्रियात्मता। पुरुषं व्यञ्जयन्तीह लोके कलुषयोनिजम्॥
en: A disrespectable conduct, acts opposed to those laid down in the scriptures, crookedness and cruelty, and abstention from sacrifices and other scriptural acts that lead to merit, show one's impurity of birth.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: पित्र्यं वा भजते शीलं मातृजं वा तथोभयम्। न कथंचन संकीर्णः प्रकृतिं स्वां नियच्छति॥
en: A son inherits the disposition of either the father or the mother. Sometimes he inherits the dispositions of both. A person of impure birth can never succeed in concealing his true nature.

description: The duties of persons born in mixed castes
sn: यथैव सदृशो रूपे मातापित्रोहि जायते। व्याघ्रश्चित्रैस्तथा योनि पुरुषः स्वां नियच्छति॥
