en: Those kine, O Shakra, whose dispositions are well known, which have been won as honoraria for knowledge, or which have been bought in exchange for other animals (such as goats, sheep, etc.), or which have been got by prowess of arms, obtained marriagedower, or which have been acquired by being rescued from situations of danger, or which, their poor owners, being unable to maintain them, have been made over by careful keep, in one's house with the wish of remaining , there, are, for such reasons, considered as proper objects of gift.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: बलान्विताः शीलवयोपपन्नाः सर्वाः प्रशंसन्ते सुगन्धवत्यः। यथा हि गङ्गा सरितां वरिष्ठा तथार्जुनीनां कपिला वरिष्ठा॥
en: Or as Those kine which are strong of body, which have good dispositions and which emit a sweet fragrance, are highly spoken of in the matter of gifts. As Ganga is the foremost of all rivers, so is Kapila the foremost of all kine.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: तिस्रो रात्रीस्त्वद्भिपोष्य भूमौ तृप्ता गावस्तर्पितेभ्यः प्रदेयाः। स्त्र्यहं दत्त्वा गोरसैर्वर्तितव्यम्॥
en: Abstaining from all food and subsisting only upon water for three nights, and sleeping for the same for the same time upon the naked earth, one should make gifts of kine to Brahmanas after having pleased them with other presents. Such kine, freed from every vice, should, at the same time, be accompained by healthy calves. Having made the gift, the giver should live for the next three days successively on food consisting only of the products of the cow.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: दत्त्वा धेनुं सुव्रतां साधुदोहां कल्याणवत्सामपलायिनीं च। स्तावन्ति वर्षाणि भवन्त्यमुत्र॥
en: By giving away a goodnatured cow, that quietly allows herself to be milked, that always brings forth living and healthy calves, and that does not fly away from the owner's house, the giver enjoys happiness in the next world for as many years as there are hairs on her body.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: तथानड्वाहं ब्राह्मणाय प्रदाय धुर्यं युवानं बलिनं विनीतम्। हलस्य वोढारमनन्तवीर्य प्राप्नोति लोकान् दशधेनुदस्य॥
en: Likewise, by giving to a Brahmana a bull that is capable of carrying heavy loads, that is young and strong and quiet, that quietly bears the yoke of the plough, and that is possessed of such energy as is sufficient to undergo even great labour, one acquires such regions as are his who gives away ten kine.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: कान्तारे ब्राह्मणान् गाश्च यः परित्राति कौशिक। क्षणेन विप्रमुच्येत तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु।॥
en: rescues That person who kine and Brahmanas in the forest, O Kaushika, is himself rescued from every sort of danger. Hear what his merit is.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: अश्वमेधक्रतोस्तुल्यं फलं भवति शाश्वतम्। मृत्युकाले सहस्राक्ष यां वृत्तिमनुकाझते॥
en: The merit such a man wins is equal to the eternal merit of a Horsesacrifice. Such a person acquires whatever end he desires at the hour of death.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: लोकान् बहुविधान् दिव्यान् यच्चास्य हृदि वर्तते। तत् सर्वं समवाप्नोति कर्मणैतेन मानवः॥
en: For such an act a man acquires many a region of happiness, in fact, whatever happiness he seeks in his heart.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: गोभिश्च समनुज्ञात: सर्वत्र च महीयते। यस्त्वेतेनैव कल्पेन गां वनेष्वनुगच्छति॥ तृणगोमयपर्णाशी निःस्पृहो नियतः शुचिः। अकामं तेन वस्तव्यं मुदितेन शतक्रतो॥ मम लोके सुरैः सार्धे लोके यत्रापि चेच्छति॥
en: Indeed, such a man permitted by kine, lives honoured in every region of happiness. That man who follows kine every day in the forest with this intention, himself living the while on grass and cowdung and leaves of trees, his heart freed from desire of fruit, his senses controlled from every improper object, and his mind purified that man, O you of a hundred sacrifices, lives happily freed from the control of desire in my region or in any other region of happiness that he wishes, in the company of the celestials.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: इन्द्र उवाच जानन् यो गामपहरेद् विक्रीयाच्चार्थकारणात्। एतद् विज्ञातुमिच्छामि क्व नु तस्य गतिर्भवेत्॥
en: Indra said I desire to know. O Grandfather, what the end is of his who consciously steals a cow or who sells one from motives of cupidity.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: पितामह उवाच भक्षार्थं विक्रयार्थं वा येऽपहारं हि कुर्वते। दानार्थं ब्राह्मणार्थाय तत्रेदं श्रूयतां फलम्॥
en: The Grandfather said Hear of the consequences that befall those persons who steal a cow for killing her for food or selling her for money, or making a gift of her to a Brahmana.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: विक्रयार्थं हि यो हिंस्याद् भक्षयेद् वा निरङ्कुशः। घातयानं हि पुरुषं येऽनुमन्येयुरर्थिनः॥ घातकः खादको वापि तथा यश्चानुमन्यते। यावन्ति तस्या रोमाणि तावद् वर्षाणि मज्जति॥
en: He who, without being governed by the restrains of the Scriptures, sells a cow, or kills one, or eats the flesh of a cow, or they who, for the sake of money, allow a person to kill kine, all these, viz., he that kills, he that eats, and he that allows the destriction, rot in hell for as many years as there are hairs on the body of the cow so killed.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: ये दोषा यादृशाश्चैव द्विजयज्ञोपघातके। विक्रये चापहारे च ते दोषा वै स्मृताः प्रभो॥
en: O you of great power, those sins and those kinds of faults that have been said to attach to one which obstructs a Brahmana's sacrifice, are said to attach to the sale and the theft of kine.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: अपहत्य तु यो गां वै ब्राह्मणाय प्रयच्छति। यावद् दानफलं तस्यास्तावन्निरयमृच्छति॥
en: That man who having stolen a cow makes a gift of her to a Brahmana, enjoys happiness in Heaven as the reward of the gift but suffers misery in Hell for the sin of theft for the same period.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: सुवर्णं दक्षिणामाहुर्गोप्रदाने महाद्युते! सुवर्णं परमित्युक्तं दक्षिणार्थमसंशयम्॥
en: Gold has been said to form the present, O you of great splendour, in gifts of kine. Indeed, gold has been said to be the best present in all sacrifices.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: गोप्रदानात् तारयते सप्त पूर्वांस्तथा परान्। सुवर्णं दक्षिणां कृत्वा तावद्विगुणमुच्यते॥
en: By making a gift of kine one is said to rescue his ancestors to seventh degree as also his descendants to the seventh degree. By giving away kine with the presents of gold, one rescues his ancestors and descendants of double the number.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: सुवर्णं परमं दानं सुवर्णं दक्षिणा परा। सुवर्णं पावनं शक्र पावनानां परं स्मृतम्॥
en: The gift of gold is the best of gifts. Gold is, again, the best present. Gold is a great purifier. O Shakra, and is, indeed, the best of all purifying objects.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: कुलानां पावनं प्राहुर्जातरूपं शतक्रतो। एषा मे दक्षिणा प्रोक्ता समासेन महाद्युते॥
en: O you of a hundred sacrifices, gold has been said to be the purifier of the entire family of him who gives it away. I have thus, O you of great splendour, told you in brief of Dakshina.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: भीष्म उवाच एतत् पितामहेनोक्तमिन्द्राय भरतर्षभा इन्द्रो दशरथायाह रामायाह पिता तथा॥
en: Bhishma said This was said by the Grandfather to Indra, O chief of Bharata's race. Indra delivered it to Dasharatha, and Dasharatha in his turn to his son Rama.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: राघवोऽपि प्रियभ्रात्रे लक्ष्मणाय यशस्विने। ऋषिभ्यो लक्ष्मणेनोक्तमरण्ये वसता प्रभो॥
en: Rama of Raghu's race gave it to his dear and illustrious brother Lakshmana. While living in the forest, Lakshmana imparted it to the Rishis.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: पारम्पर्यागतं चेदमृषयः संशितव्रताः। दुर्धरं धारयामासू राजानश्चैव धार्मिकाः॥
en: It has then described from generation to generation, for the Rishis of rigid vows held it amongst themselves as also the pious kings of the Earth.

description: The end of persons who make gifts of kine
sn: उपाध्यायेन गदितं मम चेदं युधिष्ठिर। य इदं ब्राह्मणो नित्यं वदेद् ब्राह्मणसंसदि॥ यज्ञेषु गोप्रदानेषु द्वयोरपि समागमे। तस्य लोका: किलाक्षय्या दैवतैः सह नित्यदा॥
en: My preceptor, O Yudhishthira, communicated it to me. That Brahmana who recites it every day in the conclaves of Brahmanas, in sacrifices, of at gifts of kine, or when two persons meet together, acquires hereafter many regions of unending happiness where he always lives with the celestials as his companions. The holy Brahman, the supreme Lord, had said so.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच विस्रम्भितोऽहं भवता धर्मान् प्रवदता विभो। प्रवक्ष्यामि तु संदेहं तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said I have been greatly assured, O you of power, by you thus discoursing to me of duties. I shall, however, express the doubts I have. Explain them to me, O grandfather.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: व्रतानां किं फलं प्रोक्तं कीदृशं वा महाद्युते। नियमानां फलं किं च स्वधीतस्य च किं फलम्॥
en: What are the fruits, described in the scriptures, of the vows that men observe. Of what nature are the fruits, you of great splendour, of observances of other kind? What, again, are the fruits of one's Vedic studies.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: दत्तस्येह फलं किं च वेदानां धारणे च किम्। अध्यापने फलं किं च सर्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: What are the fruits of gifts, and what those of keeping the Vedas in memory? What are the fruits of teaching the Vedas? I wish to know all this.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: अप्रतिग्राहके किं च फलं लोके पितामह। तस्य किं च फलं दृष्टं श्रुतं यस्तु प्रयच्छति॥
en: What, O grandfather, are the merits of the nonacceptance of gifts in this world. What fruits does one enjoy who makes gifts of knowledge?

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: स्वकर्मनिरतानां च शूराणां चापि किं फलम्। शौचे च किं फलं प्रोक्तं ब्रह्मचर्ये च किं फलम्॥
en: What merits do persons enjoy who perform the duties of their order, as also do heroes who do not retreat from the battlefield. What are the fruits of the observance of purity and of the practice of Brahmacharya?

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: पितृशुश्रूषणे किं च मातृशुश्रूषणे तथा। आचार्यगुरुशुश्रूषास्वनुक्रोशानुकम्पने॥
en: What are the merits of serving the parents. What also are the merits of serving preceptors and teachers, and what the merits of mercy and kindness?

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: एतत् सर्वमशेषेण पितामह यथातथम्। वेत्तुमिच्छामि धर्मज्ञ परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: I wish to know all this, O grandfather, in sooth and in particular, O you, who are conversant with all the scriptures Great is my curiosity.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: भीष्म उवाच यो व्रतं वै यथोद्दिष्टं तथा सम्प्रतिपद्यते। अखण्डं सम्यगारभ्य तस्य लोकाः सनातनाः॥
en: Bhishma said He enjoys eternal regions of happiness, who, having properly commenced a Vrata (vow) completes its observance according to the scriptures.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: नियमानां फलं राजन् प्रत्यक्षमिह दृश्यते। नियमानां क्रतूनां च त्वयावाप्तमिदं फलम्॥
en: The fruits of restraints, O king, are visible even in this world. These rewards that you have acquired are those of Niyamas and sacrifices.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: स्वधीतस्यापि च फलं दृश्यतेऽमुत्र चेह च। इहलोकेऽथवा नित्यं ब्रह्मलोके च मोदते॥
en: The fruits of the Vedic studies are seen both in this world and the next. The person who is given to the study of the Vedas is seen to sport happily both in this world and in the region of Brahma.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: दमस्य तु फलं राजञ्छृणु त्वं विस्तरेण मे। दान्ताः सर्वत्र सुखिनो दान्ताः सर्वत्र निर्वृताः॥
en: Listen now to me, O king, as I tell you in detail what that fruits, are of self-control. The self-controlled are happy everywhere. The selfcontrolled always enjoy that happiness which results from the absence or subjugation of desire.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: यत्रेच्छागामिनो दान्ताः सर्वशत्रुनिषूदनाः। प्रार्थयन्ति च यद् दान्ता लभन्ते तन्न संशयः॥
en: The self-controlled can go everywhere at will. The self-controlled can destroy every enemy. Forsooth, the self-controlled succeed in getting everything they seek.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: युज्यन्ते सर्वकामैर्हि दान्ताः सर्वत्र पाण्डव। स्वर्गे यथा प्रमोदन्ते तपसा विक्रमेण च॥
en: The self-controlled. O son of Pandu, obtain the fruition of every desire. The self-controlled and the forgiving share the happiness that men enjoy in Heaven through penances and prowess, (in arms), through gift, and through various sacrifices.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: दानैर्यज्ञैश्च विविधैस्तथा दान्ताः क्षमान्विताः। दानाद् दमो विशिष्टो हि ददत् किञ्चिद् द्विजातये।।१४
en: Selfcontrol is more meritorious than gift. A giver, after making a gift to the Brahmanas, may yield to the influence of anger. A selfcontrolled man, however, never gives way to anger. Hence self-control is superior to gift.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: दाता कुप्यति नो दान्तस्तस्माद् दानात् परं दमः। यस्तु दद्यादकुप्यन् हि तस्य लोकाः सनातनाः॥ क्रोधो हन्ति हि यद् दानं तस्माद् दानात् परं दमः। अदृश्यानि महाराज स्थानान्ययुतशो दिवि॥ ऋषीणां सर्वलोकेषु याहीतो यान्ति देवताः।
en: That man who makes gifts without yielding to anger, succeeds in acquiring eternal regions of happiness. Anger destroys the merit of a gift. Hence self-control is superior to gift. There are ten thousand invisible places, O monarch, in Heaven. Existing in all the regions of Heaven, these places belong to the Rishis. Persons, leaving this world, attain to them and become changed into deities.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: दमेन यानि नृपते गच्छन्ति परमर्षयः॥ कामयाना महत्स्थानं तस्माद् दानात् परं दमः।
en: O king, the great Rishis repair there, helped only by their self-control, and as the end of their efforts to attain to a region of superior happiness, Hence, self-control is superior to gift.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: अध्यापकः परिक्लेशादक्षयं फलमश्नुते॥ विधिवत् पावकं हुत्वा ब्रह्मलोके नराधिप।
en: The person who becomes a preceptor, and who duly adores the fire taking leave of all his miseries in this world, enjoy endless happiness O King in the region of Brahma.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: अधीत्यापि हि यो वेदान् न्यायविद्ध्यः प्रयच्छति।।१९ गुरुकर्मप्रशंसी तु सोऽपि स्वर्गे महीयते।
en: That man who having himself read the Vedas, imparts a knowledge thereof to righteous disciples, and who praises the acts of his own preceptor, acquires great honors in Heaven.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: क्षत्रियोऽध्ययने युक्तो यजने दानकर्मणि। युद्धे यश्च परित्राता सोऽपि स्वर्गे महीयते॥
en: That Kshatriya who is given to the studies of the Vedas, to the celebration of sacrifices, to the making of gifts, and who rescues the lives of others in battle, similarly acquires great honors in Heaveri.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: वैश्यः स्वकर्मनिरतः प्रदानाल्लभते महत्। शूद्रः स्वकर्मनिरतः स्वर्गे शुश्रूषयार्च्छति॥
en: The Vaishya who, observes the duties of his caste, makes gifts, reaps as the fruit of those gifts, a crowning reward. The Shudra who duly observes the duties of his order, acquires Heaven as the reward of such services.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: शूरा बहुविधाः प्रोक्तास्तेषामर्थांस्तु मे शृणु। शूरान्वयानां निर्दिष्टं फलं शूरस्य चैव हि॥
en: Various kinds of heroes have been spoken of. Listen to me as I explain to you what the rewards are that they attain to. The rewards are fixed of a hero belonging to a heroic race.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: यज्ञशूरा दमे शूराः सत्यशूरास्तथापरे। युद्धशूरास्तथैवोक्ता दानशूराश्च मानवाः॥
en: There are heroes of sacrifice, heroes of selfcontrol, heroes of truth, and others equally entitled to the name of hero. There are heroes of battle, and heroes of gift or liberality among men.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: सांख्यशूराश्च बहवो योगशूरास्तथापरे। अरण्ये गृहवासे च त्यागे शूरास्तथापरे॥
en: There are many persons who may be called the heroes of the Shankhya faith, there are many others that are called heroes of Yoga. There are others who are considered as heroes in the forest-life, of domesticity, and of renunciation.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: बुद्धिशूरास्तथा चान्ये क्षमाशूरास्तथापरे। आर्जवे च तथा शूराः शमे वर्तन्ति मानवाः।
en: Likewise, there are others who are called heroes of the intellect, and also heroes of forgiveness. There are other men who live in tranquillity and who are considered as heroes of virtue.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: तैस्तैश्च नियमैः शूरा बहवः सन्ति चापरे। वेदाध्ययनशूराश्च शूराश्चाध्यापने रताः॥
en: There are various other kinds of heroes who practise various other kinds of vows and observances. There are heroes given to the study of the Vedas, and heroes devoted to the teaching of the same.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: गुरुशुश्रूषया शूराः पितृशुश्रूषयापरे। मातृशुर्षया शूरा भैक्ष्यशूरास्तथापरे॥
en: There are, again, men who come to be regarded as heroes for the devotion with which they wait upon and serve their preceptors, as indeed, heroes in respect of the respect they show for their fathers. There are heroes in obedience to mothers, and heroes in the life of mendicancy they lead.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: अरण्ये गृहवासे च शूराश्चातिथिपूजने। सर्वे यान्ति पराँल्लोकान् सर्वकर्मफलनिर्जितान्॥
en: There are heroes in the matter of hospitality to guests, whether living as hermits or as house-holders. All these heroes attain to very superior regions of happiness which are, of course, acquired by them as the rewards of their own deeds.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: धारणं सर्ववेदानां सर्वतीर्थावगाहनम्। सत्यं च ब्रुवतो नित्यं समं वा स्यान्न वा समम्॥
en: Keeping all the Vedas in memory, or ablutions performed in all the sacred waters, may or may not be equal to telling the Truth every day in one's life.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: अश्वमेधसहस्रं च सत्यं च तुलया धृतम्। अश्वमेधसहस्राद्धि सत्यमेव विशिष्यते॥
en: A thousand Horse-sacrifices and Truth were once weighed in the balance. It was seen that Truth weighed heavier than a thousand. Horsesacrifices.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: सत्येन सूर्यस्तपति सत्येनाग्निः प्रदीप्यते। सत्येन मरुतो वान्ति सर्वं सत्ये प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: It is by Truth that the Sun is giving heat it is by Truth that fire bums up it is by Truth that the winds blow; indeed, everything rests upon Truth;

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: सत्येन देवाः प्रीयन्ते पितरो ब्राह्मणास्तथा। सत्यमाहुः परो धर्मस्तस्मात् सत्यं न लड्वयेत्॥
en: It is Truth that pleases the deities, the departed Manes, and the Brahmanas, Truth has been said to be the highest duty. Therefore, no one should ever transgress Truth.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: मुनयः सत्यनिरता मुनयः सत्यविक्रमा:। मुनयः सत्यशपथास्तस्मात् सत्यं विशिष्यते॥ सत्यवन्तः स्वर्गलोके मोदन्ते भरतर्षभ।
en: The Munis are all given to Truth. Their prowess depends upon Truth. They also swear by Truth. Hence Truth is pre-eminent. All truthful men, O chief of Bharata's race, succeed by their truthfulness in acquiring Heaven and sporting there in happiness.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: दमः सत्यफलावाप्ति रुक्ता सर्वात्मना मया॥ असंशयं विनीतात्मा स वै स्वर्गे महीयते।
en: Selfcontrol is the attainment of the reward tha: attaches to Truth. I have described it with my whole heart. The man of humble heart who is endued with self-control, forsooth, acquires great honors in Heaven.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: ब्रह्मचर्यस्य च गुणं शृणु त्वं वसुधाधिप।॥ आजन्ममरणाद् यस्तु ब्रह्मचारी भवेदिह। न तस्य किंचिदप्राप्यमिति विद्धि नराधिप।॥ बयः कोट्यस्त्वृषीणां तु ब्रह्मलोके वसन्त्युत।
en: Listen now to me, o king as I explain to you the merits of Brahmacharya. That man who practises the vow of Brahmacharya from his birth to the time of his Death, know, O king, has nothing unattainable! Many millions of Rishis are living in the region of Brahma.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: सत्ये रतानां सततं दान्तानामूर्ध्वरेतसाम्॥ ब्रह्मचर्यं दहेद् राजन् सर्वपापान्युपासितम्। ब्राह्मणेन विशेषेण ब्राह्मणो ह्याग्निरुच्यते॥ प्रत्यक्षं हि तथा ह्येतद् ब्राह्मणेषु तपस्विषु।
en: All of them, while here, were given to Truth, and self-control, and had their vital seed drawn up. The vow of Brahmacharya, O king, duly observed by a Brahmana, is sure to dissipate all his sins. The Brahmana is said to be a burning fire. In those Brahmanas that are given to penances, the deity of fire becomes visible.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: बिभेति हि यथा शक्रो ब्रह्मचारिप्रधर्षितः॥ तद् ब्रह्मचर्यस्य फलमृषीणामिह दृश्यते।
en: If a Brahmacharin gives way to anger on account of any slight, the chief of the deities himself trambles in fear. This is the visible fruit of the vow of Brahamacharya that is observed by the Rishis.

description: The merits of Vedic studies, vows, teaching the Vedas, gifts of knowledge, of the satisfaction of one's duties, of serving the parents
sn: मातापित्रोः पूजने यो धर्मस्तमपि मे शृणु॥ शुश्रूषते य: पितरं न चासूयेत् कदाचन। मातरं भ्रातरं वापि गुरुमाचार्यमेव च।॥ तस्य राजन् फलं विद्धि स्वर्लोके स्थानमर्चितम्। न च पश्येत नरकं गुरुशुश्रूषयाऽऽत्मवान्॥
en: Listen to me, O Yudhishthira, what the merit is of the worship of the father and the mother. He who dutifully serves his father without ever provO king him in anything, or similarly serves his mother or (elder) brother or other senior or preceptor, it should be known, O king, acquires a residence in Heaven. The man of purified soul, on account of such service done to his seniors, has never to even see Hell.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच विधिं गवां परं श्रोतुमिच्छामि नृप तत्त्वतः। येन ताशाश्वताल्लोकानर्थिनां प्राप्नुयादिह॥
en: Yudhishthira said I wish, O king, to hear you discourse in detail upon those high ordinances which regulate gifts of kine, for it is by making gifts (of kine) according to those ordinances that one cquires innumerable regions of eternal happiness.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: भीष्म उवाच न गोदानात् परं किंचिद् विद्यते वसुधाधिप। गौर्हि न्यायागता दत्ता सद्यस्तारयते कुलम्॥
en: Bhishma said There is no gift, O king, that is higher in point of merit than the gift of kine. A cow, lawfully acquired, if given away, immediately rescues the entire family of the giver.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: सतामर्थे सम्यगुत्पादितो यः स वै क्लृप्तः सम्यगाभ्यः प्रजाभ्यः। तस्मात् पूर्वं ह्यादिकालप्रवृत्तं गोदानार्थं शृणु राजन् विधि मे॥
en: That ritual which sprang for the benefit of the pious, was subsequently declared for the sake of all creatures. That ritual has come down from primeval time. It existed even before it was declared. Indeed, O king, listen to me as I recite to you that ritual which affects the gifts of kine.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: पुरा गोषूपनीतासु गोषु संदिग्धदर्शिना। मान्धात्रा प्रकृतं प्रश्नं बृहस्पतिरभाषत।॥
en: Formerly, when a number of kine was brought, (before him), king Mandhatri, filled with doubt about the ritual he should observe, properly questioned Brihaspati for an explanation of that doubt.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: बृहस्पति उवाच द्विजातिमतिसत्कृत्य श्वः कालमभिवेद्य च। गोदानार्थे प्रयुञ्जीत रोहिणी नियतव्रतः॥
en: Brihaspati said Duly observing restrains all the while, the giver of kine should, on the previous day, properly honour the Brahmanas and appoint the time of gift. As for the kine to be given away, they should be of the class called Rohini.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: आह्वानं च प्रयुञ्जीत समझे बहुलेति च। प्रविश्य च गवां मध्यमिमां श्रुतिमुदाहरेत्॥
en: The kine also should be addressed with the wordsSamange and BahuleEntering the fold where the kine are kept, the following Shrutis should be uttered:

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: गौर्मे माता वृषभः पिता मे दिवं शर्म जगती मे प्रतिष्ठा। प्रपद्यैवं शर्वरीमुष्य गोषु पुनर्वाणीमुत्सृजेद् गोप्रदाने॥
en: The cow is my mother. The bull is my father. (Give me) Heaven and Earthly prosperity. The cow is my refuge. Entering the fold and acting thus, the giver should pass the night there. He should again utter the formula when actually giving away the kine.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: स तामेकां निशां गोभिः समसख्यः समव्रतः। ऐकात्म्यगमनात् सद्यः कलुषाद् विप्रमुच्यते॥८॥
en: The giver, thus living with the kine in the fold without doing anything to control their freedom, and lying down on the naked earth, becomes readily cleansed of all his sins on account of his bringing himself down to a condition of perfect similitude with the kine.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: उत्सृष्टवृषवत्सा हि प्रदेया सूयदर्शने। त्रिदिवं प्रतिपत्तव्यमर्थवादाशिषस्तव॥
en: When the Sun rises in the morning, you should give away the cow, accompanied by her calf and a bull. As the reward of such a deed, you will surely attain to the celestial region. You will also enjoy the blessings shown by the Mantras.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: उर्जस्विन्य ऊर्जमेधाश्च यज्ञे गर्भोऽमृतस्य जगतोऽस्य प्रतिष्ठा। क्षिते रोहः प्रवृहुः शश्वदेव प्रजापत्याः सर्वमित्यर्थवादाः॥
en: The Mantras contain these references of kine: Kine are gifted with strength and energetic exertion. Kine are also wise. They are the root of that immortality which sacrifice yields. They are the root of all energy. They are the steps by which earthly prosperity is gained. They are the eternal course of the universe. The multiply one's race.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: स्तथा सौम्याः स्वर्गयानाय सन्तु। आत्मानं मे मातृवच्चाश्रयन्तु तथानुक्ताः सन्तु सर्वाशिषो मे॥
en: Let the kine dissipate my sins. They have in them the nature of both the Sun and the Moon. Let them help me in the attainment of the celestial region. Let them come to me, as a mother takes to her children. May I enjoy all other blessings which have not been named in the Mantras I have uttered.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: शोषोत्सर्गे कर्मभिर्देहमोक्षे सरस्वत्यः श्रेयसे सम्प्रवृत्ताः। यूयं नित्यं सर्वपुण्योपवाह्यां दिशध्वं मे गतिमिष्टां प्रसन्नाः॥
en: For alleviating or curing phthisis and other wasting diseases, and for achieving freedom from the body, if a person takes the help of the five products of the cow, kine confer blessings upon the person like the river Sarasvati you kine, you are always co nveyers of all sorts of merit. Pleased with me, do you assign a desirable end for me.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: या वै यूयं सोऽहमद्यैव भावो युष्मान् दत्त्वा चाहमात्मप्रदाता। मनश्च्युता मन एवोपपन्नाः संधुक्षध्वं सौम्यरूपोग्ररूपाः॥
en: I have to day become what you are. By giving you away, I really give myself away, You do not belong to him who gives you away. You have now become mine. Possessed of the nature of both the Sun and the Moon, do you cause both the giver and the receiver the shine with all kinds of prosperity.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: एवं तस्याग्रे पूर्वमर्थं वदेत गवां दाता विधिवत् पूर्वदृष्टः। प्रतिब्रूयाच्छेषमधु द्विजाति: प्रतिगृह्णन् वै गोप्रदाने विधिज्ञः॥
en: The giver should duly utter the words found in the first part of the above Verse. The twice born recipient, conversant with the ritual regulating the gift of kine, should, when receiving the kine in gift, utter the words found in the latter half of the above Verse.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: गोप्रदानीति वक्तव्यमर्थ्यवस्त्रवसुप्रदः। उर्ध्वास्या भवितव्या च वैष्णवीति च चोदयेत्॥
en: The man who, instead of a cow, gives away the usual value thereof or cloths or gold, is considered as the giver of a cow. The giver, when giving away the usual value of a cow, should utter the words. This cow with face lipuurned is being given away. Do you accept her. The man who gives away cloths should utter the words, Bhavitavya (this should be regarded as representing a cow). The man who gives away gold should utter the word Vaishnavi i.e., the gold of the form and nature of a cow.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: नाम संकीर्तयेत् तस्या यथासंख्योत्तरं स वै। फलं षट्त्रिंशदष्टौ च सहस्राणि च विंशतिः॥
en: These are the words that should be uttered according to the kind of gift mentioned above. The reward that was reaped by making gifts of kine is residence in the celestial region for six and thirty thousand years, eight thousand years, and twenty thousand years respectively.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: एवमेतान् गुणान् विद्याद् गवादीनां यथाक्रमम्। गोप्रदाता समाप्नोति समस्तानष्टमे क्रमे॥
en: These are the merits, respectively, of gifts of things as substitutes of kine. While, about him who gives an actual cow all the merits that attach to gifts of kine become his at only the eighth step of the recipient.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: गोदः शीली निर्भयश्चार्थदाता न स्याद् दुःखी वसुदाता च कामम्। उषस्योढा भारते यश्च विद्वान् विख्यातास्ते वैष्णवाश्चन्द्रलोकाः॥
en: He who gives an actual cow becomes gifted with righteous conduct in this world. He who gives the valve of a cow becomes freed from every sort of fear. He who gives a cow never suffers from sorrow. All the three, as also they who regularly perform their ablutions and other acts at early dawn, and he who is well conversant with the Mahabharata, it is well known attain to the regions of Vishnu and Soma.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: गा वै दत्त्वा गोव्रती स्यात् त्रिरात्रं निशां चैकां संवसेतेह ताभिः। कामाष्टम्यां वर्तितव्यं त्रिरात्रं रसैर्वा गोः शकृता प्रस्रवैर्वा॥
en: Having given away a cow, the giver should for three nights, adopt the vaccine vow, and pass one night with kine. Beginning again from that lunation, numbering the eighth, named Kamya, he should pass three nights, living exclusively on milk and the urine and dung of the cow.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: देवव्रती स्याद् वृषभप्रदाने वेदावाप्तिर्गोयुगस्य प्रदाने। तथा गवां विधिमासाद्य यज्वा लोकानग्र्यान् विन्दते नाविधिज्ञः॥
en: By giving away a bull, one acquires the merit of Brahmacharya. By giving away two kine, one acquires the mastery of the Vedas. That man who celebrates a sacrifice and makes gifts of kine according to the ritual laid down, attains to many great regions. These, however, are not attainable by the person who does not know that ritual.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: कामान् सर्वान् पार्थिवानेकसंस्थान यो वै दद्यात् कामदुघांच धेनुम्। स्तासामुक्ष्णां ज्यायसां सम्प्रदानम्॥
en: That man who gives away even a single cow. which gives profuse milk, acquires the merit of giving away all desirable objects on Earth collected together. What more should be said of the gift of many such kine as give Havya and Kavya on account of their fuil udders? The merit which belongs to the gift of superior oxen is greater than that of the gift of kine.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: नाश्रद्दधानाय न वक्रबुद्धये। गुह्यो ह्ययं सर्वलोकस्य धर्मो नेमं धर्मं यत्र तत्र प्रजल्पेत्॥
en: One should not, by giving a knowledge of this ritual, benefit a person who is not his disciple or who does not observe vows or who is bereft of faith or who is possessed of crooked understanding. Indeed this religion is a mystery, which many people do not know. One who knows it should not speak of it everywhere.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: सन्ति लोकेऽश्रद्दधाना मनुष्या: सन्ति क्षुद्रा राक्षसमानुषेषु। एषामेतद् दीयमानं ह्यनिष्टं ये नास्तिक्यं चाश्रयन्तेऽल्पपुण्याः॥
en: There are, in the world, many men who have no faith. There are among men many persons who are mean and who resemble Rakshasas. This religion, if given to them, would lead to evil. It would produce equal evil it given to such sinful men as are atheists.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: बार्हस्पत्यं वाक्यमेतन्निशम्य ये राजानो गोप्रदानानि दत्त्वा। स्तान् मे राजन् कीर्त्यमानान् निबोध॥
en: Listen to me, O king as I recite to you the names of those pious kings who have attained son to regions of great happiness as the reward of those gifts of kine which they made according to the instructions of Brihaspati.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: उशीनरो विष्वगश्वो नृगश्च भगीरथो विश्रुतो यौवनाश्वः। मान्धाता वै मुचुकुन्दश्च राजा भूरिद्युम्नो नैषधः सोमकश्च॥
en: Ushinara, Vishvagashva, Nriga, Bhagiratha, the celebrated Mandhatri the of Yuvanashva, king Muchukunda, Bhuridyumna, Naishadha, Somaka. Pururavas, emperor Bharata to whose race belongs all the Bharatas, the heroic Rama the son of Dasharatha, and many other celebrated kings of great deeds, and also king Dilipa of widelyknown deeds, all, on account of their gifts of kine according to the ritual, attained to Heaven. King Mandhatri, was always observant of sacrifices, gifts, penances royal duties, and gifts of kine.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: पुरूरवो भरतश्चक्रवर्ती यस्यान्ववाये भरताः सर्व एव। तथा वीरो दाशरथिश्च रामो ये चाप्यन्ये विश्रुताः कीर्तिमन्तः॥ तथा राजा पृथुकर्मा दिलीपो दिवं प्राप्तो गोप्रदानैर्विधिज्ञः। र्मान्धाताभूद् गोप्रदानैश्च युक्तः॥ तस्मात् पार्थ त्वमपीमां मयोक्तां बार्हस्पती भारती धारयस्व। द्विजाग्र्येभ्यः सम्प्रयच्छस्व प्रीतो गाः पुण्या वै प्राप्य राज्यं कुरूणाम्॥
en: Therefore, O son of Pritha, do you also keep in mind, those instructions of Brihaspati which I have recited to you Having obtained the kingdom of the Kurus, do you, with a cheerful heart, make gifts of good kine to foremost of Brahmanas.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच कृतवान् धर्मराजो भीष्मेणोक्तो विधिवद् गोप्रदाने। तथा सर्वे स मान्धातुर्देवदेवोपदिष्टं सम्यग्धर्मं धारयामास राजा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed by Bhishma on the subject of properly making gifts of kine, king Yudhishthira did all that Bhishma desired. Indeed, king Yudhishthira bore in mind the whole of that religion which the preceptor of the gods imparted to the Royal Mandhatri.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: इति नृप सततं गवां प्रदाने यवशकलान् सह गोमयैः पिबानः। क्षितितलशयनः शिखी यतात्मा वृष इव राजवृषस्तदा बभूव॥
en: Yudhishthira from that time began to always make gifts of kine and to maintain himself with grains of barley and cowdung as both his food and drink, The king also began to sleep from that day on the naked earth, and possessed of controlled soul and resembling a bull in conduct, he become the foremost of monarchs.

description: Ordinances about the gifts of kine
sn: नरपतिरभवत् सदैवताभ्यः प्रयतमनास्त्वभिसंस्तुवंश्च ता:स्म। न च धुरि नृप गामयुक्त भूय स्तुरगवरैरगमच्च यत्र तत्र॥
en: The Kuru king from that day became very attentive of kine and always adored them, singing their praises. From that day, the king gave up the practice of yO king kine to his cars. Wherever he had occasion to go, he proceeded on cars drawn by horses of good breed.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भूयः शान्तनवं नृपम्। गोदानविस्तरं धर्मान् पप्रच्छ विनयान्वितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said King Yudhishthira gifted with humility, once again asked the royal son of Shantanu on the subject of gifts of kine in full.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: राजोवाच गोप्रदानगुणान् सम्यक् पुनर्मे ब्रूहि भारत। न हि तृप्याम्यहं वीर शृण्वानोऽमृतमीदृशम्॥
en: The king said Do you, O Bharata, once more describe to me in full merits of giving away kine. Indeed, O hero, I have not been satiated with hearing your nectarlike words.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तो धर्मराजेन तदा शान्तनवो नृपः। सम्यगाह गुणांस्तस्मै गोप्रदानस्य केवलान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus accosted by king Yudhishthira the just, Shantanu's son began to describe to him once again, in full, the merits of the gift of kine.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: भीष्म उवाच वत्सलां गुणसम्पन्नां तरुणीं वस्त्रसंयुताम्। दत्त्वेदृशीं गां विप्राय सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: Bhishma said By giving to a Brahmana a cow having a calf, gifted with docility and other virtues, young in years and covered round with a piece of cloth, one is purged of all his sins.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: असुर्या नाम ते लोका गां दत्त्वा तान् न गच्छति। पीतोदकां जग्धतृणां नष्टक्षीरां निरिन्द्रियाम्॥
en: There are many regions which have no sun. One who makes the gift of a cow has not to go there.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: जरारोगोपसम्पन्नां जीर्णां वापीमिवाजलाम्। दत्त्वा तमः प्रविशति द्विजं क्लेशेन योजयेत्॥
en: That man, however, who gives to a Brahmana a cow that cannot drink or eat, that has her milk dried up, that has weakened senses and that is diseased and overcome with decrepitude, and that may, therefore, be compared to a tank whose water has been dried upindeed, the man who gives such cow to a Brahmana and thereby inflicts only pain and disappointment upon him, has certainly to enter into dark Hell.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: रुष्टा दुष्टा व्याधिता दुर्बला वा नो दातव्या याश्च मूल्यैरदत्तैः। क्लेशैर्विप्रं योऽफलैः संयुनक्ति तस्यावीर्याश्चाफलाश्चैव लोकाः॥
en: That cow which is wrathful and vicious, or diseased, or weak, or which has been brought without the price agreed upon having been paid, or which would only afflict the twiceborn recipient with distress and disappointment, should never be given. The regions such a man may acquire would not give him any happiness or energy.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: बलान्विताः शीलवयोपपन्नाः सर्वे प्रशंसन्ति सुगन्धवत्यः। यथा हि गङ्गा सरितां वरिष्ठा तथार्जुनीनां कपिला वरिष्ठा॥
en: Only such kine as are strong, gifted with good behaviour, young in years, and possessed of odour, are highly spoken of by all. Indeed, as Ganga is the foremost of all rivers, so is a Kapila cow the foremost of all kine.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कस्मात् समाने बहुलाप्रदाने सद्धिः प्रशस्तं कपिलाप्रदानाम्। विशेषमिच्छामि महाप्रभावं श्रोतुं समर्थोऽस्मि भवान् प्रवक्तुम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Why, O grandfather, do the righteous highly speak of the gift of a Kapila cow when all good kine that are given away should be considered as equal? O you of great power, I wish to hear what the superiority is of a Kapila cow. You are indeed, competent to discourse to me on this subject.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: भीष्म उवाच वृद्धानां ब्रुवतां तात श्रुतं मे यत् पुरातनम्। वक्ष्यामि तदशेषेण रोहिण्यो निर्मिता यथा।॥
en: Bhishma said I have, O son, heard old men recite this history about the circumstances under which the Kapila cow was created. I shall recite that old history to you.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: प्रजाः सृजेति चादिष्टः पूर्वं दक्षः स्वयम्भुवा। असृजद् वृत्तिमेवाग्रे प्रजानां हितकाम्यया॥
en: Formerly the Selfcreate Brahman commanded the Rishi Daksha, saying, Do you create living creatures, For doing good to creatures, Daksha, first of all created food.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: यथा ह्यमृतमाश्रित्य वर्तयन्ति दिवौकसः। तथा वृत्तिं समाश्रित्य वर्तयन्ति प्रजा विभो॥
en: As the deities live upon nectar, so all living creatures, O powerful one, live upon the food assigned by Daksha.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: अचरेभ्यश्च भूतेभ्यश्चराः श्रेष्ठाः सदा नराः। ब्राह्मणाश्च ततः श्रेष्ठास्तेषु यज्ञाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥
en: Among all objects mobile and immobile, the mobile are superior. Among mobile creatures, Brahmanas are superior. The sacrifices are all set upon them.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: यज्ञैरवाप्यते सोमः स च गोषु प्रतिष्ठितः। ततो देवाः प्रमोदन्ते पूर्वं वृत्तिस्ततः प्रजाः॥
en: It is by sacrifice that Soma is got. Sacrifice has been fixed upon kine. The gods become pleased through sacrifices. The means of livelihood were created first, creatures came next.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: प्रजातान्येव भूतानि प्राक्रोशन् वृत्तिकाझया। वृत्तिदं चान्वपद्यन्त तृषिताः पितृमातृवत्॥
en: As soon as creatures were born, they began to cry aloud for food. All of them then approached their creator who was to give them food, like children approaching their parents.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: इतीदं मनसा गत्वा प्रजासर्गार्थमात्मनः। प्रजापतिस्तु भगवानमृतं प्रापिबत् तदा॥
en: Approved of the desire of all his creatures, the holy lord of all creatures, viz., Daksha, for the sake of his creatures, himself drank a quantity of nectar.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: स गतस्तस्य तृप्ति तु गन्धं सुरभिमुद्भिरन्। ददर्शोद्वारसंवृत्तां सुरभिं मुखजां सुताम्॥
en: He became pleased with the nectar, he drank and thereupon an eructation came out, spreading an excellent odour all around. That cruciation, Daksha saw gave birth to a cow which he named Surabhi. This Surabhi was thus a daughter of his, that had come out of his inouth.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: सासृजत् सौरभेयीस्तु सुरभिर्लोकमातृकाः। सुवर्णवर्णाः कपिलाः प्रजानां वृत्तिधेनवः॥
en: That cow called Surabhi gave birth to a number of daughters who became the mothers of the world. They were goldhued, and were all Kapilas. They were the means of livelihood for all crcatures.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: तासाममृतवर्णानां क्षरन्तीनां समन्ततः। बभूवामृतजः फेनः स्रवन्तीनामिवोर्मिजः॥
en: As those kine, whose complexion resembled that of nectar, began to pour milk, the forth of that inilk arose and began to spread on all sides as when the waves of a running river dashing against one another, sufficient froth is produced that spreads on all sides.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: स वत्समुखविभ्रष्टो भवस्य भुवि तिष्ठतः। शिरस्यवाप तत् क्रुद्धः स तदैक्षत च प्रभुः॥
en: Some of that froth fell, from the mouths of the calves that were sucking, upon the head of Mahadeva who was then sitting on the Earth. The powerful Mahadeva thereupon, stricken with anger, looked at those kine.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: ललाटप्रभवेणाक्ष्वा रोहिणीं प्रदहन्निव। तत्तेजस्तु ततो रौद्रं कपिलास्ता विशाम्पते॥ नानावर्णत्वमनयन्मेघानिव दिवाकरः। यास्तु तस्मादपक्रम्य सोममेषाभिसंश्रिताः॥ यथौत्पन्नाः स्ववर्णास्थास्ता ह्येता नान्यवर्णगाः। अथ क्रुद्धं महादेवं प्रजापतिरभाषत॥ अमृतेनावसिक्तस्तवं नोच्छिष्टं विद्यते गवाम्। यथा ह्यमृतमादाय सोमो विस्यन्दते पुनः॥
en: With that third eye of his which adorns his forehead, he seemed to burn those kine as he espied them. Like the Sun living masses of clouds with various colours, the energy that, came out from the third eye of Mahadeva produced, O king, various complexions in those kine. Those amongst them, however, which succeeded in escaping from the looks of Mahadeva by entering the region of Soma, remained of the same colour with which they were born, for no change was produced in their colour. Seeing that Mahadeva had become highly wroth, Daksha, the lord of all creatures, addressed him, saying, You have, O great deity, been drenched with nectar. The milk or the froth that escapes from the mouths of calves sucking their dams is never considered as impure. The Moon, after drinking the nectar, pours it once more. It is not, therefore, regarded as impure.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: तथा क्षीरं क्षरन्त्येता रोहिण्योऽमृतसम्भवम्। न दुष्यत्यनिलो नाग्निर्न सुवर्णं न चोदधिः॥
en: Likewise, the milk that these kine give, being born of nectar, should not be considered as impure. The wind can never become impure. Fire can never become impure. Gold can never become impure. The Ocean can never become impure.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: नामृते नामृतं पीतं वत्सपीता न वत्सला। इमाल्लोकान् भरिष्यन्ति हविषा प्रस्रवेण च॥
en: The Nectar, even when drunk by the gods, can never become impure. Likewise, the milk of a cow, even when her udders are sucked by her calf, can never become impure. These kine will support all these worlds with the milk they will give and the clarified butter that will be inade from it.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: आसामैश्चर्यमिच्छन्ति सर्वेऽमृतमयं शुभम्। वृषभं च ददौ तस्मै सह गोभिः प्रजापतिः॥
en: All creatures wish to enjoy the sacred wealth, at one with nectar, that kine possess. Having said these words, the lord of creatures, Daksha, made a present to Mahadeva of a bull with certain kine.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: प्रसादयामास मनस्तेन रुद्रस्य भारत। प्रीतश्चापि महादेवश्चकार वृषभं तदा॥ ध्वजं च वाहनं चैव तस्मात् स वृषभध्वजः।
en: Daksha pleased Rudra, O Bharata, with that present. Mahadeva, thus pleased, made that bull his career, And it was after the form of that bull that Mahadeva adopted the emblem on the standard floating on his battlecar. Therefore it is that Rudra came to be known as the bullbannered deity.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: ततो देवैर्महादेवस्तदा पशुपतिः कृतः। ईश्वरः स गवां मध्ये वृषभाङ्कः प्रकीर्तितः॥
en: It was on that occasion also that the celestials, in a body, made Mahadeva the lord of animals. Indeed, the great Rudra became the Master of kine and is named as the bullemblemed deity.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: एवमव्यग्रवर्णानां कपिलानां महौजसाम्। प्रदाने प्रथमः कल्पः सर्वासामेव कीर्तितः॥
en: Hence, O king, the gift of kine is considered as primarily desirable of Kapila kine which are endued with great energy and possessed of unchanged colour.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: लोकज्येष्ठा लोकवृत्तिप्रवृत्ता रुद्रोपेता: सोमविष्यन्दभूताः। सौम्याः पुण्याः कामदाः प्राणदाश्च गा वै दत्त्वा सर्वकामप्रदः स्यात्॥
en: Thus are kine the foremost of all creatures in the world. It is from them that the food of all the worlds has emanated. They have Rudra for their lord. They yield (nectar) in the form of milk. They are auspicious and sacred, and grantors of every wish and givers of life. A person by making a gift of a cow is considered as making a gift of every article that is to be enjoyed by men.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: इदं गवां प्रभवविधानमुत्तमं पठन् सदाशुचिरपि मङ्गलप्रियः। विमुच्यते कलिकलुषेण मानव: श्रियं सुतान् धनपशुमाप्नुयात् सदा॥
en: That who, wishing to acquire prosperity, reads with a pure heart and body these Verses on the origin of kine, becomes purged of all his sins and acquires prosperity and children and wealth and animals.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: हव्यं कव्यं तर्पणं शान्तिकर्म यानं वासो वृद्धबालस्य तुष्टिः। एतान् सर्वान् गोप्रदाने गुणान् वै दाता राजन्नाप्नुयाद् वै सदैव॥
en: man He who makes a gift of a cow. O king, always succeeds in winning the merits of gifts of Havya and Kavya, of the offer of oblations of water to the departed Manes, of religious acts whose performance brings peace and happiness, of the gift of vehicles and cloths, and of cherishing of children and the old.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच पितामहस्याथ निशम्य वाक्यं राजा सह भ्रातृभिराजमीढः। सुवर्णवर्णानडुहस्तथा गाः पार्थो ददौ ब्राह्मणसत्तमेभ्यः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words of his grandfather, Pritha's son, viz., the royal Yudhishthira of Ajamidha's race, uniting with his brothers, began to make gifts of both bulls and kine of different colours to foremost of Brahmanas.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: तथैव तेभ्योऽपि ददौ द्विजेभ्यो गवां सहस्राणि शतानि चैव। यज्ञान् समुद्दिश्य च दक्षिणार्थे लोकान् विजेतुं परमां च कीर्तिम्॥
en: Indeed, for getting regions of felicity in the next, and acquiring great fame, king Yudhishthira celebrated many sacrifices and, as sacrificial presents, gave away hundreds of thousands of kine to such Brahmanas.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: भीष्म उवाच एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम्। इक्ष्वाकुवंशजो राजा सौदासो वदतां वरः॥ सर्वलोकचरं सिद्धं ब्रह्मकोशं सनातनम्। पुरोहितमभिप्रष्टुमभिवाद्योपचक्रमे॥
en: Bhishma said Formerly, king Saudasa born of Ikshvaku's race, that foremost of eloquent men, on one occasion approached his family priest, viz., Vashishtha, that foremost of Rishis, crowned with ascetic success, capable of passing through every region, the receptacle of Brahma, and gifted with eternal life, and put to him the following question.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: सौदास उवाच त्रैलोक्ये भगवन् किंस्वित् पवित्रं कथ्यतेऽनघा यत् कीर्तयन् सदा मर्त्यः प्राप्नुयात् पुण्यमुत्तमम्॥
en: Saudasa said O holy one, O sinless one, what is that in the three worlds which is sacred and by reciting which at all times a man may win high merit?

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: भीष्म उवाच तस्मै प्रोवाच वचनं प्रणताय हितं तदा। गवामुपनिषद्विद्वान् नमस्कृत्य गवां शुचिः॥
en: Bhishma said Having first bowed to kine and purified himself, the learned Vashishtha described to king Saudasa who stood before him with head bent in reverence, the mystery about kine, a subject that is fraught with results highly beneficial to all persons.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: वसिष्ठ उवाच गाव: सुरभिगन्धिन्यस्तथा गुग्गुलुगन्धयः। गाव: प्रतिष्ठा भूतानां गावः स्वस्त्ययनं महत्॥
en: Vashishtha said Kine, are always fragrant. The perfume of the Amyris agallochum comes out of their bodies. Kine are the great refuge of all creatures. Kine form the greet source of blessings to all.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गावो भूतं च भव्यं च गावः पुष्टिः सनातनी। गावोलक्ष्म्यास्तथा मूलं गोषु दत्तं न नश्यति॥
en: Kine are the Past and the Future. Kine are the root of eternal growth. Kine are the root of Prosperity. Anything given to kine is never lost.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: अन्नं हि परमं गावो देवानां परमं हविः। स्वाहाकारवषट्कारौ गोषु नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितौ॥
en: Kine from the highest food. They are the best Havi for the celestials. The Mantras called Svaha and Vashat are forever established in kine.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गावो यज्ञस्य हि फलं गोषु यज्ञाः प्रतिष्ठिताः। गावो भविष्यं भूतं च गोषु यज्ञाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥
en: Kine form the fruit of sacrifices. Sacrifices are established in kine. Kine are the Future and the Past, and the Sacrifices rest on them.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: सायं प्रातश्च सततं होमकाले महायुते। गावो ददति वै होम्यमृषिभ्यः पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Morning and evening kine give to the Rishis, O foremost of men, Havi for use in Homa, O you of great effulgence.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: यानि कानि च दुर्गाणि दुष्कृतानि कृतानि च। तरन्ति चैव पाप्मानं धेनुं ये ददति प्रभो॥
en: They who make gifts of kine succeed in getting over all sins which they may have committed and all kinds of dangers into which they may fall, O you of great power.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: एकां च दशगुर्दद्याद् दश दद्याच्च गोशती। शतं सहस्रगुर्दद्यात् सर्वे तुल्यफला हि ते॥
en: The man possessing ten kine and making a gift of one cow, one possessing a hundred kine and making a gift of ten kine, and one possessing a thousand kine and making a gift of a hundred kine, all acquire the same measure of merit.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: अनाहिताग्नि: शतगुरयज्वा च सहस्रगुः। समृद्धो यश्च कीनाशो नार्घमर्हन्ति ते त्रयः॥
en: That man who, having hundred kine, does not establish a domestic fire for daily worship that man who though possessed of a thousand kine does not celebrate sacrifices, and that man who though having riches acts as a miser, are all three considered as not worthy of any respect.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: कपिलां ये प्रयच्छन्ति सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम्। सुव्रतां वस्त्रसंवीतामुभौ लोकौ जयन्ति ते॥
en: Those men who make gifts of Kapila kine with their calves and with vessels of white brass for milking themkine, which are not vicious and which, while given away, are one wrapped round with clothsconquer both this and the next world.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: युवानमिन्द्रियोपेतं शतेन शतयूथपम्। गवेन्द्रं ब्राह्मणेन्द्राय भूरिशृङ्गमलङ्कतम्॥ वृषभं ये प्रयच्छन्ति श्रोत्रियाय परतन्प। ऐश्वर्यं तेऽधिगच्छन्ति जायमानाः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Such persons as make gifts of a young bull, that has all its senses, strong, and that may be considered as the foremost among hundreds of herds, that has large horns adorned with ornaments, to a Brahmana endued with Vedic lore, succeed, O scorcher of foes, in acquiring great prosperity riches each time they are born in the world.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: नाकीर्तयित्वा गाः सुप्यात् तासां संस्मृत्य चोत्पतेत्। सायं प्रातर्नमस्येच्च गास्ततः पुष्टिमाप्नुयात्॥
en: One should never go to bed without reciting the names of kine. Nor should one rise from bed in the morning without similarly reciting the names of kine, Morning and evening one should bend one's head respectfully to kine. As the result of such deeds, one is sure to acquire great prosperity.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गवां मूत्रपुरीषस्य नोद्विजेत कथंचन। न चासां मांसमश्नीयाद् गवां पुष्टिं तथाप्नुयात्॥
en: One should never feel any repugnance for the urine and the dung of the cow. One should never eat the meat of kine. As the result of this, one is sure to acquire great prosperity.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गाश्च संकीर्तयेन्नित्यं नावमन्येत तास्तथा। अनिष्टं स्वप्नमालक्ष्य गां नरः सम्प्रकीर्तयेत्॥
en: One should always recite the names of kine. One should never show any disregard for kine in any way. If evil dreams are seen men should recite the names of kine.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गोमयेन सदा स्नायात् करीषे चापि संविशेत्। श्लेष्ममूत्रपुरीषाणि प्रतिघातं च वर्जयेत्॥
en: One should always bathe, using cowdung. One should sit on dried cowdung. One should never pass urine and excreta and other secretions on cowdung. One should never obstruct kine in any way.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: सार्दै चर्मणि भुञ्जीत निरीक्षेद् वारुणी दिशम्। वाग्यत: सर्पिषा भूमौ गवां पुष्टि सदाश्नुते॥
en: One should eat, sitting on a cowhide purified by dipping it in water, and then look towards the west. Sitting with controlled speech, one should eat clarified butter using the bare earth as his dish. One reaps, on account of such deeds, that prosperity of which kine are the root.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: घृतेन जुहुयादग्निं घृतेन स्वस्ति वाचयेत्। घृतं दद्याद् घृतं प्राशेद् गवां पुष्टिं सदाश्नुते॥
en: One should pour libations on the fire, using clarificd butter for purpose. One should make Brahmanas utter blessings upon one by presents of clarified butter. One should make gifts of clarified butter. One should also eat clarified butter. As the reward of such deeds one is sure to acquire that prosperity which kine grant.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गोमत्या विद्यया धेनुं तिलानामभिमन्त्र्य यः। सर्वरत्नमयीं दद्यान्न स शोचेत् कृताकृते॥
en: That man who inspires a cow's form made of sesame seeds by uttering the Vedic Mantras named Gomati, and then adorns that form with every sort of gems and makes a gift of it, has never to suffer any grief on account of all his deeds of omission and commission.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गावो मामुपतिष्ठन्तु हेमशृङ्ग्यः पयोमुचः। सुरभ्यः सौरभेय्यश्च सरितः सागरं यथा॥
en: Let kine which give profuse milk and which have horns adorned with goldkine viz., that are Surabhis or the daughters of Surabhisapproach me even as rivers approach the ocean.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गा वै पश्याम्यहं नित्यं गाव: पश्यन्तु मां सदा। गावोऽस्माकं वयं तासां यतो गावस्ततो वयम्॥
en: I always look at kine. Let kine always look at me. Kine are ours. We are theirs. We are there where kine are.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: एवं रात्रौ दिवा चापि समेषु विषमेषु च। महाभयेषु च नरः कीर्तयन् मुच्यते भयात्॥
en: Thus, at night or day, in weal or woe-at times of even great fearshould a man exclaim. By uttering such words, he is sure to become freed from every fear. By uttering such words, he is sure to become freed from every fear.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: वसिष्ठ उवाच शतं वर्षसहस्राणां तपस्तप्तं सुदुष्करम्। गोभिः पूर्वं विसृष्टाभिर्गच्छेम श्रेष्ठतामिति॥
en: Vasishtha said The kine which had been created in former age practised the hardest penances for a hundred thousand years with the objects of acquiring a position of great preeminence.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: लोकेऽस्मिन् दक्षिणानां च सर्वासां वयमुत्तमाः। भवेम न च लिप्येम दोषेणेति परंतप॥
en: Indeed, O scorcher of enemies, they said to themselves. We shall, in this world, become the best of all kinds of presents in sacrifices, and we shall not be liable to be sullied with any fault.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: अस्मत्पुरीषस्नानेन जनः पूयेत सर्वदा। शकृता च पवित्रार्थं कुर्वीरन् देवमानुषाः॥ तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च। प्रदातारश्च लोकान् नो गच्छेयुरिति मानद॥
en: By bathing in water mixed with our dung, people shall become purified. The celestials and men shall use our dung for the purpose of purifying all creatures mobile and immobile. They also who will give us away shall acquire those regions of happiness which will be ours.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: ताभ्यो वरं ददौ ब्रह्मा तपसोऽन्ते स्वयं प्रभुः। एवं भवत्विति प्रभुर्लोकांस्तारयतेति च॥
en: Appearing to them at the termination of their austerities, the powerful Brahman gave them the boons they sought, sayingyour desire will be fulfilled. Do you rescue all the worlds.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: उत्तस्थुः सिद्धकामास्ता भूतभव्यस्य मातरः। प्रातर्नमस्यास्ता गावस्ततः पुष्टिमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Crowned with fruition of their desires, they all rose upthose mothers of both the Past and the Future. Every morning, people should bow respectfully to kine. As the result of this, they are sure to acquire prosperity.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: तपसोऽन्ते महाराज गावो लोकपरायणाः। तस्माद् गावो महाभागाः पवित्रं परमुच्यते॥
en: At the termination of their penances, O king, kine became the refuge of the world. It is therefore that kine are said to be highly blessed, sacred, and the foremost of all things. It is therefore that kine are said to stay at the very head of all creatures.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: तथैव सर्वभूतानां समतिष्ठन्त मूर्धनि। समानवत्सां कपिलां धेनुं दत्त्वा पयस्विनीम्। सुव्रतां वस्त्रसंवीतां ब्रह्मलोके महीयते॥
en: By giving away a Kapila cow with a calf resembling herself, giving profuse milk, free from every vicious habit, and covered with a piece of cloth, the giver acquires great honours in the region of Brahma.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: लोहितां तुल्यवत्सां तु धेनुं दत्त्वा पयस्विनीम्। सुव्रतां वस्त्रसंवीतां सूर्यलोके महीयते॥
en: By giving away a red cow with a calf that resembes herself, giving milk, free from every vice, and covered with a piece of cloth, one acquires great honours in the region of the Sun.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: समानवत्सां शबलां धेनुं दत्त्वा पयस्विनीम्। सुव्रतां वस्त्रसंवीतां सोमलोके महीयते॥
en: By giving away a cow of variegated hue, with a calf similar to herself, giving milk, free from every vice, and covered with a piece of cloth, one acquires great honours in the region of Soma.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: समानवत्सां श्वेतां तु धेनुं दत्त्वा पयस्विनीम्। सुव्रता वस्त्रसंवीतामिन्द्रलोके महीयते॥
en: By giving away a white cow, with a calf similar to herself, giving milk, free from every vice, and covered with a piece of cloth, one acquires great honours in the region of Indra.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: समानवत्सां कृष्णां तु धेनुं दत्त्वा पयस्विनीम्। सुव्रतां वस्त्रसंवीतामग्निलोके महीयते॥
en: By giving away a cow of dark hue, with a calf similar to herself, giving milk, free from every vice, and covered with a piece of cloth, one acquires great honours in the region of FireGod.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: समानवत्सां धूम्रां तु धेनुं दत्त्वा पयस्विनीम्। सुव्रतां वस्त्रसंवीतां याम्यलोके महीयते॥
en: By giving away a smokecolored cow, with a calf similar to herself, giving milk, free from every vice, and covered with a piece of cloth, onc acquires great honours in the region of Yama.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: अपां फेनसवर्णां तु सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम्। प्रदाय वस्त्रसंवीतां वारुणं लोकमाप्नुते॥
en: By giving away a frothycoloured cow, with a calf and vessel of white brass for milking her, and covered with a piece of cloth, one acquires the region of Varuna.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: वातरेणुसवर्णां तु सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम्। प्रदाय वस्त्रसंवीतां वायुलोके महीयते॥
en: By giving away a dustcoloured cow, with a calf and a vessel of white brass for malking her, and covered with a piece of cloth, one : acquires great honours in the region of the WindGod.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: हिरण्यवर्णां पिंगाक्षीं सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम्। प्रदाय वस्त्रसंवीतां कौबेरं लोकमश्नुते॥
en: By giving away a goldhued cow, having eyes of a tawny colour, with a calf and a vessel of white brass for making her, and covered with a piece of cloth, one enjoys the happiness of the region of Kubera.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: पलालधूम्रवर्णां तु सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम्। प्रदाय वस्त्रसंवीतां पितृलोके महीयते॥
en: By giving away a cow of the hue of the smoke of straw, with calf and a vessel of white brass for milking her, and covered with a piece of cloth, one acquires great honours in the region of the departed Manes.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: सवत्सां पीवरी दत्त्वा दृतिकण्ठामलंकृताम्। वैश्वदेवमसम्बाध स्थानं श्रेष्ठं प्रपद्यते॥
en: By giving away a fat cow with the flesh of its throat hanging down and accompanied by her calf, one acquires easily the high region of the Vishvedevas.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: समानवत्सां गौरी तु धेनुं दत्त्वा पयस्विनीम्। सुव्रतां वस्त्रसंवीतां वसूनां लोकमाप्नुयात्॥
en: By giving away a Gouri cow, with a calf similar to her, giving milk, free from every vice, and covered with a piece of cloth, one acquire the region of the Vasus,

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: पाण्डुकम्बलवर्णाभां सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम्। प्रदाय वस्त्रसंवीतां साध्यानां लोकमाप्नुते॥
en: By giving away a cow of the hue of a white blanket, with a calf and a vessel of white brass, and covered with a piece of cloth, one acquires the region of the Saddhyas.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: वैराटपृष्टमुक्षाणं सर्वरत्नैरलंकृतम्। प्रददन्मरुतां लोकान् स राजन् प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: By giving away a bull with a huge hump and adorned with every jewel, the giver, O king, acquires the region of the Maruts.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: वयोपपन्नं लीलाङ्गं सर्वरत्नसमन्वितम्। गन्धर्वाप्सरसां लोकान् दत्त्वा प्राप्नोति मानवः॥
en: By giving away a bluecoloured bull, that is fullgrown in years and adorned with every ornament, the giver acquires the regions of the celestial musicians and nymphs.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: दृतिकण्ठमनड्वाहं सर्वरत्नैरलंकृतम्। दत्त्वा प्रजापतेर्लोकान् विशोकः प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: By giving away a cow with the flesh of her throat hanging down, and adorned with every ornament, the giver, shorn of grief, acquires the region of Prajapati himself.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गोप्रदानरतो याति भित्त्वा जलदसंचयान्। विमानेनार्कचर्णेन दिवि राजन् विराजते।॥
en: That man, O king, who habitually makes gifts of kine, proceeds passing through the clouds, on a sunny car to the celestial region and shines there in splendour.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: तं चारुवेषाः सुश्रोण्यः सहस्रं सुरयोषितः। रमयन्ति नरश्रेष्ठं गोप्रदानरतं नरम्॥
en: That man who habitually makes gifts of kine is considered as the foremost of his kind. When thus proceeding to celestial region, he is received by a thousand celestiai damsels of beautiful hips and adorned with handsome dresses and ornaments. Those girls serve him there and minister to his delight.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: वीणानां वल्लकीनां च नू पुराणां च सिञ्जितैः। हासैश्च हरिणाक्षीणां सुप्तः स प्रतिबोध्यते॥
en: He sleeps there in peace and is awakened by the musical laughter of those gazelleeyed maidens, the sweet notes of their Vinas, the soft strains of their lutes, and the sweet tinkle of their Nupuras.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: स्तावन्ति वर्षाणि महीयते सा स्वर्गच्युतश्चापि ततो नृलोके प्रसूयते वै विपुले गृहे सः॥
en: The man who makes gifts of kine lives in the celestial region and is honoured there for as many years as there are hairs on the bodies of the kine he gives away. Falling off from the celestial region (upon the termination of his merit), such a man is born as a man and, in fact, in a superior family among men.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: वसिष्ठ उवाच घृतक्षीरप्रदा गावो घृतयोन्यो घृतोद्भवाः। घृतनद्यो घृतावर्तास्ता मे सन्तु सदा गृहे।॥
en: Vasishtha said Kine give clarified butter and milk. They are the sources of clarified butter and they have originated from clarified butter. They are rivers of clarified butter, and eddies of clarified butter. Let kine ever be in my house.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: घृतं मे हृदये नित्यं घृतं नाभ्यां प्रतिष्ठितम्। घृतं सर्वेषु गात्रेषु घृतं मे मनसि स्थितम्॥
en: Clarified butter is always in my heart. Clarified butter is even established in my navel. Clarified butter is in every limb of mine. Clarified butter lives in my mind.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गावो ममाग्रतो नित्यं गावः पृष्ठत एव च। गावो मे सर्वतश्चैव गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम्॥
en: Kine are always at my front. Kine are always at my rear. Kine are on every side of my body. I live in the midst of kine.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: इत्याचम्य जपेत् सायं प्रातश्च पुरुषः सदा। यदह्ना कुरुते पापं तस्मात् स परिमुच्यते॥
en: Having purified oneself by touching water, one should, morning and evening, recite these Mantras every day. By this, one is sure to be purged of all the sins one may commit in course of the day.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: प्रासादा यत्र सौवर्णा वसोर्धारा च यत्र सा। गन्धर्वाप्सरसो यत्र तत्र यान्ति सहस्रदाः॥
en: They who make gifts of a thousand kine, leaving this world proceed to the regions of the Gandharvas and the celestial nymphs where there are many palatial buildings made of gold and where the celestial Ganga, called the current of Vasu, runs.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: नवनीतपङ्काः क्षीरोदा दधिशैवलसंकुलाः। वहन्ति यत्र वै नद्यस्तत्र यान्ति सहस्रदाः॥
en: Givers of a thousand kine go there where run many rivers, having milk for their water, cheese for their mire, and curds for their floating moss.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गवां शतसहस्रं तु यः प्रयच्छेद् यथाविधि। परां वृद्धिमवाप्याथ स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: That man who gives hundreds of thousands of kine away according to the ritual laid down in the scriptures, acquires great prosperity (here) and great honours in the celestial region.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: दश चोभयतः पुत्रो मातापित्रोः पितामहान्। दधाति सुकृतान् लोकान् पुनाति च कुलं नरः॥
en: Such a man causes both his paternal and maternal ancestors to the tenth degree acquire regions of great happiness, and sanctifies his whole race.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: धेन्वाः प्रमाणेन समप्रमाणां धेनुं तिलानामपि च प्रदाया पानीयदाता च यमस्य लोके न यातनां काञ्चिदुपैति तत्र॥
en: are Kine are sacred. They are the foremost of all things in the world. They are indeed the refuge of the universe. They are the mothers of the very celestials. They indeed incomparable. They should be dedicated in sacrifices.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: पवित्रमग्र्यं जगतः प्रतिष्ठा दिवौकसां मातरोऽथाप्रमेयाः। अन्वालभेद् दक्षिणतो व्रजेच्च दद्याच्च पात्रे प्रसमीक्ष्य कालम्॥
en: When going on journeys, one should leave the kine to his left. Determining the proper time, they should be given away to worthy persons.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: धेनुं सवत्सां कपिलां भूरिशृङ्गी कांस्योपदोहां वसनोत्तरीयाम्। प्रदाय तां गाहति दुर्विगाह्यां याम्यां सभां वीतभयो मनुष्यः॥
en: By giving away a Kapila cow, having large horns, accompanied by a calf and a vessel of white brass for milking her, and covered with a piece of cloth, one freed from fear, enters the palace of Yama that is so difficult to enter.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: सुरूपा बहृरूपाश्च विश्वरूपाश्च मातरः। गावो मामुपतिष्ठन्तामिति नित्यं प्रकीर्तयेत्॥
en: One should always recite this sacred Mantra, viz. Kine are of beautiful form. Kine are of various forins. They are of universal form. They are the mothers of the universe. O, let kine approach me.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: नातः पुण्यतरं दानं नातः पुण्यतरं फलम्। नातो विशिष्ठं लोकेषु भूतं भवितुमर्हति॥
en: There is no gift more sacred than that of kine. There is no gift that yields more blessed merit. There has been nothing equal to the cow, nor will there be anything that will cqual her.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: त्वचा लोम्नाथ,गैर्वा वालैः क्षीरेण मेदसा। यज्ञं वहति सम्भूय किमस्त्यभ्यधिकं ततः॥
en: With her skin, her hair, her hons' the hair of her tail, her milk, and her fatwith all these togetherthe cow maintains sacrifice. What thing is there that is more useful than the cow?

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: यया सर्वमिदं व्याप्तं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम्। तां धेनुं शिरसा वन्दे भूतभव्यस्य मातरम्॥
en: Bending my head to her with respect, I worship the cow who is the mother of both the Past and Future, and by whom the entire universe of mobile and immobile creatures is sustained.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: गुणवचनसमुच्चयैकदेशो नृवर मयैष गवां प्रकीर्तितस्ते। न च परमिह दानमस्ति गोभ्यो भवति न चापि परायणं तथान्यत्॥
en: O best of men, I have thus recited to you only a portion of the great merits of kine. There is no gift in this world that is superior to that of kine. There is also no refuge in this world that is higher than kine.

description: The mysteries of the gifts of kine
sn: भीष्म उवाच वरमिदमिति भूमिदो विचिन्त्य प्रवरमृषेर्वचनं ततो महात्मा। व्यसृजत नियतात्मवान् द्विजेभ्यः सुबहु च गोधानमाप्तवांश्च लोकान्॥
en: Bhishma said Considering these words of the Rishi Vasishtha as highly important, that great giver of land, king Saudasa, then made gifts of a very large number of kine to the Brahmanas, controlling his senses all the while, and as the result of those gifts, the king succeeded in acquiring many regions of happiness in the next world.

sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पवित्राणां पवित्रं यच्छिष्टं लोके च यद् भवेत्। पावनं परमं चैव तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, what is that which is the most sacred of all sacred things in the world, other than that which has been already mentioned, and which is the greatest of all purifying objects.

sn: भीष्म उवाच गावो महार्थाः पुण्याश्च तारयन्ति च मानवान्। धारयन्ति प्रजाश्चमा हविषा पयसा तथा॥
en: Bhishma said Kine are the foremost of all objects. They are highly sacred and they save men. With their milk and with the Havi manufactured therefrom, kine sustain all creatures in the universe.

sn: न हि पुण्यतमं किंचिद् गोभ्यो भरतसत्तम। एताः पुण्याः पवित्राश्च त्रिषु लोकेषु सत्तमाः॥
en: O best of the Bharatas, there is nothing that is more sacred than kine. The highest of all things in the three worlds, kine are themselves sacred and capable of purifying others.

sn: देवानामुपरिष्टाच्च गावः प्रतिवसन्ति वै। दत्त्वा चैतास्तारयन्ते यान्ति स्वर्ग मनीषिणः॥
en: Kine live in a region that is even greater than the region of the celestials. When given away, they save their givers. Wise men succeed in acquiring the celestial region by making gifts of kine.

sn: मान्धाता यौवनावश्च ययातिनहुषस्तथा। गा वै ददन्तः सततं सहस्रशतसम्मिताः॥
en: Yuvanashvas son Mandhatri, Yayati, and Nahusha, used always to give away kine in thousands.

sn: गताः परमकं स्थानं देवैरपि सुदुर्लभम्। अपि चात्र पुरागीतां कथयिष्यामि तेऽनघ॥
en: As thc reward of those gifts, they have acquired such regions as are unattainable by the very celestials. There is, about it, O sinless one, a discourse delivered of yore. I shall recite it to you.

sn: ऋषीणामुत्तमं धीमान् कृष्णद्वैपायनं शुकः। अभिवाद्याह्निककृतः शुचिः प्रयतमानसः॥ पितरं परिपप्रच्छ दृष्टलोकपरावरम्। को यज्ञः सर्वयज्ञानां वरिष्ठोऽभ्युपलक्ष्यते॥
en: Once on a time, having finished his morning rites, the intelligent Shuka approached with a controlled mind his father, that foremost of Rishis, viz., the Island-born Krishna, who knows the distinction between the superior and the inferior, and saluting him, said, What is that sacrifice which appears to you as the foremost of all sacrifices?

sn: किं च कृत्वा परं स्थानं प्राप्नुवन्ति मनीषिणः। केन देवाः पवित्रेण स्वर्गमश्नन्ति वा विभो॥
en: What is that act by doing which wise men succeed in acquiring the highest region? What is that sacred deed by which the celestials enjoy divine happiness?

sn: किं च यज्ञस्य यज्ञत्वं क्व च यज्ञः प्रतिष्ठितः। देवानामुत्तमं किं च किं च सत्रमितः परम्॥ पवित्राणां पवित्रं च यत् तद् ब्रूहि पितर्मम।
en: What forms the character of sacrifice as sacrifice? What is that upon which sacrifice rests? What is that which is considered as the best by the deities? What is that sacrifice which is above the sacrifices of this world? Do you also tell me, O father what is that which is the most sacred of all things.

sn: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं व्यासः परमधर्मवित्। पुत्रायाकथयत् सर्वं तत्त्वेन भरतर्षभ॥
en: Having heard these words of his son, O chief of Bharata's race, Vyasa, the foremost of all persons knowing duties, said as follows to him.

sn: व्यास उवाच गावः प्रतिष्ठा भूतानां तथा गावः परायणम्। गाव: पुण्याः पवित्राश्च गोधनं पावनं तथा॥
en: Vyasa said Kine form the support of all creatures. Kine are the refuge of all creatures. Kine are the embodiment of virtue. Kine are sacred, and kine purifiers of all.

sn: पूर्वमासन्नशृङ्गा वै गाव इत्यनुशुश्रुमा शृङ्गार्थे समुपासन्त ताः किल प्रभुमव्ययम्॥
en: Formerly kine were hornless as we have heard. For getting horns they adored the eternal and powerful Brahman.

sn: ततो ब्रह्मा तु गाः प्रायमुपविष्टाः समीक्ष्य ह। ईप्सितं प्रददौ ताभ्यो गोभ्यः प्रत्येकशः प्रभुः॥
en: Seeing the kine paying their adorations to him and sitting without food, the powerful Brahman granted to each of them what each desired.

sn: तासां शृङ्गाण्यजायन्त यस्या यादृङ्मनोगतम्। नानावर्णाः शृङ्गरान्त्यस्ता व्यरोचन्त पुत्रक॥
en: Thereafter their horns grew and each got what each wished. Of various colours, and gifted with horns, they began to shine beautifully, O son!

sn: ब्रह्मणा वरदत्तास्ता हव्यकव्यप्रदाः शुभाः। पुण्याः पवित्राः सुभगा दिव्यसंस्थानलक्षणाः॥
en: Favoured by Brahman himself with boons, kine are auspicious and givers of Havya and Kavya. They are the embodiments of virtue. They are sacred and highly blessed. They have excellent form and qualities.

sn: गावस्तेजो महद् दिव्यं गवां दानं प्रशस्यते। ये चैताः सम्प्रयच्छन्ति साधवो वीतमत्सराः॥ ते वै सुकृतिनः प्रोक्ताः सर्वदानप्रदाश्च ते। गवां लोकं तथा पुण्यमाप्नुवन्ति च तेऽनघ॥
en: Kine form high and excellent energy. The gift of kine is highly spoken of. Those good men who, shorn or pride, make gifts of kine, are considered as doers of righteous deeds and as givers of all articles. Such men, O sinless one, acquire the highly sacred region of kine.

sn: यत्र वृक्षा मधुफला दिव्यपुष्पफलोपगाः। पुष्पाणि च सुगन्धीनि दिव्यानि द्विजसत्तम॥
