description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: प्रनृत्ताप्सरसं दिव्यं देवर्षिगणसेवितम्। दृष्टिकान्तमनिर्देश्यं दिव्यमद्भुतदर्शनम्॥
en: It was the resort of the celestial Rishis, the Apsaras danced there in joy. The place was exceedingly beautiful to look at. It was exceedingly beautiful, resembling Heaven itself. Its view was wonderful, and indeed, its beauty and sweetness was beyond description.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स गिरिस्तपसा तस्य गिरिशस्य व्यरोचत। स्वाध्यायपरमैर्विप्रैर्ब्रह्मघोषो निनादितः॥ षट्पदैरुगीतैश्च माधवाप्रतिमो गिरिः।
en: With the penances of that great god who sleeps on mountain breasts, that king of mountains shone with great beauty. It resounded with the chant of Vedas uttered by learned Brahmanas given to Vedic recitation. Echoing with the hum of bees, O Madhava, the mountain became peerless in beauty.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तन्मोहोत्सवसंकाशं भीमरूपधरं ततः॥ दृष्ट्वा मुनिगणस्यासीत् परा प्रीतिर्जनार्दन।
en: Seeing the great god, who has a fierce form and who looks like a great festival, the ascetics became filled, O Janardana, with great joy.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: मुनयश्च महाभागाः सिद्धाश्चैवोर्ध्वरेतसः॥ मरुतो वसवः साध्या विश्वेदेवाः सवासवाः। यक्षा नागाः पिशाचाश्च लोकपाला हुताशनाः॥ वाताः सर्वे महाभूतास्तत्रैवासन् समागताः।
en: All the highly blessed ascetics, the Siddhas who have drawn in their vital seed, the Maruts, the Vasus, the Saddhyas, the Vishvedevas, Vasava himself, the Yakshas, the Nagas, the Pishachas, the Regents of the world, the several sacred Fires, the Winds, and all the great creatures lived on that mountain with minds concentrated in yoga.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ऋतवः सर्वपुष्पैश्च व्यकिरन्त महाद्भुतैः॥ ओषध्यो ज्वलमानाश्च द्योतयन्ति स्म तद् वनम्।
en: All the Seasons were present there and filled those regions with all sorts of wonderful flowers. Various kinds of burning herbs illuminated the woods and forests on that mountain.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: विहङ्गाश्च मुदा युक्ताः प्रानृत्यन् व्यनदंश्च ह॥ गिरिपृष्ठेषु रम्येषु व्याहरन्तो जनप्रियाः।
en: Various species of birds, filled with joy, danced about and sang merrily on the charming breast of that mountain. Those birds were exceedingly loveable on account of the notes they uttered.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तत्र देवो गिरितटे दिव्यधातुविभूषिते॥ पर्यङ्क इव विभ्राजन्नुपविष्टो महामनाः।
en: The great Mahadeva sat, beautifully on one of the peaks that was adorned with excellent minerals, as if it served the purposes of a fine bedstead.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: व्याघ्रचर्माम्बरधरः सिंहचर्मोत्तरच्छदः॥ व्यालयज्ञोपवीती च लोहिताङ्गदभूषणः।
en: Round his loins was a tigerskin, and a lionskin was his upper garment. His sacred thread consisted of a snake. His arms were decked with a pair of red armlets.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: हरिश्मश्रुर्जटी भीमो भयकर्ता सुरद्विषाम्॥ अभयः सर्वभूतानां भक्तानां वृषभध्वजः।
en: His beard was green. He had matted locks on his head. O dreadful features he fills with fear the hearts of all the enemies of the gods. He removes the fear of all creatures. He is adored by his worshippers as the deity having the bull for his emblem.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दृष्ट्वा महर्षयः सर्वे शिरोभिरवानिं गताः॥ विमुक्ताः सर्वपापेभ्यः क्षान्ता विगतकल्मषाः।
en: The great Rishis, seeing Mahadeva, bowed to him by touching the ground with their heads. Gifted with forgiving souls, they all became freed from every sin and thoroughly purified.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तस्य भूतपतेः स्थानं भीमरूपधरं बभौ॥ अप्रधृष्यतरं चैव महोरगसमाकुलम्।
en: The retreat of that lord of all creatures, filled with many terrible forms, shone with a peculiar beauty. Abounding with many large snakes, it was unapproachable and unbearable. ।

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: क्षणेनैवाभवत् सर्वमद्भुतं मधुसूदन॥ तत् सदो वृषभाङ्कस्य भीमरूपधरं बभौ।
en: Within the twinkling of the eye, O destroyer of Madhu, everything there became highly wonderful. Indeed, the house of the great deity having the bull for his emblem began to blaze with a terrible beauty.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तमभ्ययाच्छैलसुता भूतस्त्रीगणसंवृता॥ हरतुल्याम्बरधरा समानव्रतधारिणी।
en: To Mahadeva seated there, came his wife the daughter of Himavat, surrounded by the wives of the ghostly beings who are the companions of the great god. Her dress was like that of her husband and the vows she observed, were like those of his.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: बिभ्रती कलशं रौकमं सर्वतीर्थजलोद्भवम्॥ गिरिस्रवाभिः सर्वाभिः पृष्ठतोऽनुगता शुभा।
en: She held a jar on her loins that was filled with the waters of every Tirtha, and was accompanied by the presiding goddess of all the mountain rivers. Those auspicious ladies followed her.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पृष्पवृष्ट्याभिवर्षन्ती गन्धैर्बहुविधैस्तथा। सेवन्ती हिमवत् पार्वं हरपाश्वमुपागमत्॥
en: The goddess came, raining flowers on all sides and various kinds of sweet perfumes. She who loved to live on the breast of Himavat, advanced in this guise towards her great husband.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ततः स्मयन्ती पाणिभ्यां नर्मार्थं चारुहासिनी। हरने शुभे देवी सहसा सा समावृणोत्॥
en: With smiling lips and desirous of playing a jest, the beautiful Uma covered from behind, with her two beautiful hands, the eyes of Mahadeva.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: संवृताभ्यां तु नेत्राभ्यां तमोभूतमचेतनम्। निर्दोमं निर्वषट्कारं जगद् वै सहसाऽभवत्॥
en: As soon as Mahadeva's eyes were thus covered, all the regions became dark, and life seemed to be extinct everywhere in the universe. The Homa rites ceased. The universe became suddenly deprived of the sacred Vashat Also.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: जनश्च विमनाः सर्वोऽभवत् त्राससमन्वितः। निमीलते भूतपतौ नष्टसूर्य इवाभवत्॥
en: All living creatures became dispirited and filled with fear. Indeed, when the eyes of the lord of all creatures were thus closed, the universe appeared sunless.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ततो वितिमिरो लोकः क्षणेन समपद्यत। ज्वाला च महती दीप्ता ललाटात्तस्य निःसृता॥
en: Soon, however, that besetting darkness disappeared. A powerful and burning flame of fire came out from Mahadeva's forehead.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तृतीयं चास्य सम्भूतं नेत्रमादित्यसंनिभम्। युगान्तसदृशं दीप्तं येनासौ मथितो गिरिः॥
en: A third eye, resembling another sun, appeared (on it). That eye began to shine like the Yoga. Fire and began to consume that mountain.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ततो गिरिसुता दृष्ट्वा दीप्ताग्निसदृशेक्षणम्। हरं प्रणम्य शिरसा ददर्शायतलोचना॥
en: Seeing what took place, the large eyed daughter of Himavat bowed her head to Mahadeva gifted with that third eye which resembled a blazing fire. She stood there with looks fixed on her husband.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दह्यमाने वने तस्मिन् ससालसरलद्रुमे। सचन्दनवरे रम्ये दिव्यौषधिविदीपिते॥ मृगयूथैर्दुतैर्भीतैर्हरपार्श्वमुपागतैः। शरणं चाप्यविन्दद्भिस्तत् सदः संकुलं बभौ॥
en: When the mountain forests burned on all sides with their sales and other trees of straight stems, and their delightful sandals and various excellent medicinal herbs, herds of deer and other animals filled with fear, came quickly to the place where Hara sat and sought his protection. With those creatures almost filling it, the hermitage of the great deity shone with a sort of peculiar beauty.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ततो नभस्पृशज्वालो विद्युल्लोलाग्निरुल्बणः। द्वादशादित्यसदृशो युगान्ताग्निरिवापरः॥
en: Meanwhile that fire, swelling wildly, soared up to the very sky and endued with the splendour and unsteadiness of lightning and loO king like a dozen suns in power and effulgence, covered every side like the all destroying YugaFire.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: क्षणेन तेन निर्दग्धो हिमवानभवन्नगः। सधातुशिखराभोगो दीप्तदग्धलतौषधिः॥
en: In a moment the Himavat mountains were consumed, with their minerals and summits and blazing herbs.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तं दृष्ट्वा मथितं शैलं शैलराजसुता ततः। भगवन्तं प्रपन्ना वै साञ्जलिप्रग्रहा स्थिता॥
en: Seeing Himavat crushed and consumed, the daughter of that king of mountains sought the protection of the great deity and stood before him with her hands joined in respect.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमा शर्वस्तदा दृष्ट्वा स्त्रीभावगतमार्दवाम्। पितुदैन्यमनिच्छन्तीं प्रीत्यापश्यत् तदा गिरिम्॥
en: Seeing Uma overcome by womanly mildness and finding that she was reluctant to see her father Himavat reduced to that pitiable condition, then Sharva cast kind looks upon the mountain.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: क्षणेन हिमवान् सर्वः प्रकृतिस्थः सुदर्शनः। प्रहृष्टविहगश्चैव सुपुष्पितवनदुमः॥
en: In a moment the whole of Himavat regained his former condition and became as beautiful to look at as ever. Indeed the mountain displayed a cheerful aspect. All its trees became bedecked with flowers.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: प्रकृतिस्थं गिरिं दृष्ट्वा प्रीता देवं महेश्वरम्। उवाच सर्वलोकानां पतिं शिवमनिन्दिता॥
en: Seeing Himavat restored to his natural condition, the goddess Uma, divested of every fault, addressed her husband, that master of all creatures viz., the divine Maheshvara, in these words.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच भगवन् सर्वभूतेश शूलपाणे महाव्रत। संशयो मे महान् जातस्तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि।॥
en: Uma said O Holy One, O Lord of all creatures, O God holding trident, O you of high vows, a great doubt has filled my mind! You should remove that doubt of mine.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: किमर्थं ते ललाटे वै तृतीयं नेत्रमुत्थितम्। किमर्थं च गिरिर्दग्धः सपक्षिगणकाननः॥
en: Why has this third eye appeared in your forehead? Why also the mountain consumed with the forests and all that belonged was to it?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: किमर्थं च पुनर्देव प्रकृतिस्थस्त्वया कृतः। तथैव दुमसंच्छन्नः कृतोऽयं ते पिता मम॥
en: Why also, O illustrious god, have you restored the mountain to its former condition? Indeed, having burnt it once, why have you again filled it with trees?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: महेश्वर उवाच नेत्रे मे संवृते देवि त्वया बाल्यादनिन्दिते। नष्टलोकस्तदा लोकः क्षणेन समपद्यत॥
en: Maheshvara said O goddess without any fault, for your having covered my eyes through an act of indiscretion, the universe became in a moment devoid of light.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: नष्टादित्ये तथा लोके तमोभूते नगात्मजे। तृतीयं लोचनं दीप्तं सृष्टं मे रक्षता प्रजाः॥
en: When the universe became sunless and, therefore, all became dark, O daughter of the prince of mountains, I created a third eye for protecting all creatures.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तस्य चाक्ष्णो महत् तेजो येनायं मथितो गिरिः। त्वत्प्रियार्थं च मे देवि प्रकृतिस्थः पुनः कृतः॥
en: The great energy of that eye crushed and consumed this mountain. For pleasing you, however, O goddess, I once more restored Himavat to his pristine condition for making good the injury.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच भगवन् केन ते वक्त्रं चन्द्रवत् प्रियदर्शनम्। पूर्वं तथैव श्रीकान्तमुत्तरं पश्चिमं तथा॥
en: Uma said O Holy One, why are those faces of yours which are on the east, the north and the west, so beautiful and so agreeable to look at like the very moon.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दक्षिणं च मुखं रौद्रं केनोर्चे कपिला जटाः। केन कण्ठश्च ते नीलो बर्हिवर्हनिभः कृतः॥
en: And why is that face of yours which is on the truth so dreadful? Why are your matted locks tawny in colour and so erect? Why is your throat blue like the peacock's plumes?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: हस्ते देव पिनाकं ते सततं केन तिष्ठति। जटिलो ब्रह्मचारी च किमर्थमसि नित्यदा॥
en: Why, O illustrious god, is the Pinaka always in your hand? Why are you always a Brahmacharin with matted locks?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतन्मे संशयं सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि वै प्रभो। सधर्मचारिणी चाहं भक्ता चेति वृषध्वज॥
en: O lord, you should explain all these to me. I am your wife who seeks to follow the same duties with you. Further, I am your devoted worshipper, o deity having highly the bull for your emblem.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तः स भगवान् शैलपुत्र्या पिनाकधृत्। तस्या धृत्या च बुद्ध्या च प्रीतिमानभवत् प्रभुः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by the daughter of the king of mountains, the illustrious holder of Pinaka, the powerful Mahadeva became highly pleased with her.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ततस्तामब्रवीद् देवः सुभगे श्रूयतामिति। हेतुभिर्ममैतानि रूपाणि रुचिरानने॥
en: The great god then addressed her, saying. O blessed lady, hear as I explain with the reasons thereof, why my forms are so.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीभगवानुवाच तिलोत्तमा नाम पुरा ब्रह्मणा योषिदुत्तमा। तिलं तिलं समुद्धृत्य रन्तानां निर्मितां शुभा॥
en: The Blessed and Holy One said Formerly a blessed and foremost of women, was created by Brahman, called Tilottama, by collecting beauty from every beautiful object in the universe.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: साजभ्यगच्छत मां देवि रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि। प्रदक्षिणं लोभयन्ती मां शुभे रुचिरानना॥
en: One day, that lady of beautiful face, peerless in the universe for beauty of form, came to me, O goddess, for circumambulating me but, in sooth, moved by the desire of tempting me.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यतो यतः सा सुदती मामुपाधावदन्तिके। ततस्ततो मुखं चारु मम देवि विनिर्गतम्॥
en: In whatever direction that lady of beautiful teeth turned, a new face to mine instantly appeared. All these faces of mine became handsome to look at.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तां दिदृक्षुरहं योगाच्चतुर्मूर्तित्वमागतः। चतुर्मुखश्च संवृत्तो दर्शयन् योगमुत्तमम्॥
en: Thus, on account of the desire of seeing her, I became fourfaced, through Yogapower. Thus I showed my high Yogapower in becoming fourfaced.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पूर्वेण वदनेनाहमिन्द्रत्वमनुशास्मि ह। उत्तरेण त्वया सार्धं रमाम्यहमनिन्दिते॥
en: With that face of mine which is turned towards the east, I exercise the sovereignty of the universe. With that face of mine which is turned towards the north, I sport with you, O you of faultless features.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पश्चिमं मे मुखं सौम्यं सर्वप्राणिसुखावहम्। दक्षिणं भीमसंकाशं रौद्रं संहरति प्रजाः॥
en: That face of mine which is turned towards the west is handsome and auspicious. With it I ordain the happiness of all creatures. That face cf mine which is turned towards the south is dreadful. With it I destroy all creatures.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: जटिलो ब्रह्मचारी च लोकानां हितकाम्यया। देवकार्यार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं पिनाकं मे करे स्थितम्॥
en: I live as a Brahmacharin with matted locks on iny head, for doing good in all creatures. The bow Pinaka is always in my hand for accomplishing the work of the celestials.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: इन्द्रेण च पुरा वज्रं क्षिप्तं श्रीकांक्षिणा मम) दग्ध्वा कण्ठं तु तद् यातं येन श्रीकण्ठता मम॥
en: Formerly, Indra, desirous of acquiring my prosperity, had hurled his thunderbolt at me. With that weapon my throat was scorched. Therefore I have become bluethroated.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच वाहनेष्वत्र सर्वेषु श्रीमत्स्वन्येषु सत्तम। कथं च वृषभो देव वाहनत्वमुपागतः॥
en: Uma said When, O foremost of all creatures, there are so many excellent beautiful cars, why have you selected a bull for your vehicle?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: महेश्वर उवाच सुरभीमसृजद् ब्रह्मा देवधेनुं पयोमुचम्। सा सृष्टा बहुधा जाता क्षरमाणा पयोऽमृतम्॥
en: Maheshvara said Formerly, the Grandfather Brahman created the celestial cow Surabhi giving profuse milk After her creation there sprang from her a large number of king all of which gave sufficient quantities of milk sweet as nectar.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तस्या वत्समुखोत्सृष्टः फेनो मद्गात्रमागतः। ततो दग्धा मया गावो नानावर्णत्वमागताः॥
en: Once on a time a quantity of froth fell from the mouth of one of her calves on my body. I was enraged at this and my anger scorched all the kine which there upon became diversified in colour.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ततोऽहं लोकगुरुणा शमं नीतोऽर्थवेदना। वृषं चैनं ध्वजार्थं मे ददौ वाहनमेव च॥
en: I was then pacified by the Lord of all the worlds, viz., Brahman, conversant this bull both as a car for bearing me and as device on my banner.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच निवासा बहुरूपास्ते दिवि सर्वगुणान्विताः। तांश्च संत्यज्य भगवश्मशाने रमसे कथम्॥
en: Uma said You have many houses, in the celestial region, of various forms and possessed of every comfort and luxury. Why, O Holy One, do you live in the crematorium, abandoning all those delightful palaces.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: केशास्थिकलिले भीमे कपालघटसंकुले। गृध्रगोमायुबहुले चिताग्निशतसंकुले॥
en: The crematorium is full of the hair and bones (of the dead), abounds with vultures and jackals, and is covered with hundreds of funeral pyres.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अशुचौ मांसकलिले वसाशोणितकर्दमे। विकीर्णान्त्रास्थिनिचये शिवानादविनादिते॥
en: Full of carrion and muddy with fat and blood, with entrails and bones scattered all over it, and always echoing with the howls of jackals, it is certainly an impure place.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: महेश्वर उवाच मेध्यान्वेषी महीं कृत्स्नां विचराम्यनिशं सदा। न च मेध्यतरं किंचिच्छ्मशानादिह लक्ष्यते॥
en: Maheshvara said I always travel over the whole Earth in search after a sacred spot. I do not, however, see any spot that is more sacred than the crematorium.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तेन मे सर्ववासानां श्मशाने रमते मनः। न्यग्रोधशाखासंछन्ने निभुग्नस्रग्विभूषिते॥
en: Therefore, of all houses, the crematorium appears to me to be the best, shaded as it generally is by branches of the banian and adorned with torn garlands of flowers.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तत्र चैव रमन्तीमे भूतसंघाः शुचिस्मिते। न च भूतगणैर्देवि विनाहं वस्तुमुत्सहे॥
en: O you of sweet smiles, the multitudes of goblins that are my companions love to live in such spots. I do not like, O goddess, to live anywhere, without those goblins by my side.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष वाप्सो हि मे मेध्यः स्वर्गीयश्च.मतः शुभे। पुण्यः परमकश्चैव मध्यकामैरुपास्यते॥
en: Therefore, the crematorium is a sacred house to me. Indeed, O auspicious lady, it appears to me to be very Heaven. Highly sacred and endued with great merit, the crematorium is much praised by persons desirous of having holy abodes.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच भगवन् सर्वभूतेश सर्वधर्मविदां वर। पिनाकपाणे वरद संशयो मे महानयम्॥
en: Uma said O Holy One, O lord of all creatures, O foremost of all observers of duties and religious rites, I have a great doubt, O holder of Pinaka, O giver of boons.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अयं मुनिगणः सर्वस्तपस्तेप इति प्रभो। तपोवेषकरो लोके भ्रमते विविधाकृतिः॥
en: These ascetics, O powerful lords, have practised various kinds of austerities. In the world are seen ascetics wandering everywhere under various forms and clad in various kinds of dress.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अस्य चैवर्षिसंघस्य मम च प्रियकाम्यया। एतं ममेह संदेहं वक्तुमर्हस्यरिंदम॥
en: For benefiting this large number of Rishis, as also myself, do you kindly remove, O chaister of all enemies, this doubt of mine.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: धर्मः किंलक्षणः प्रोक्तः कथं वा चरितुं नरैः। शक्यो धर्ममविन्दद्धिर्धर्मज्ञ वद मे प्रभो॥
en: What are the characteristics of Religion or Duty? How, indeed, do men unacquainted with the details of Religion or Duty succeed in observing them. O powerful lord, O you who are conversant with Religion, do you tell me this.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: नारद उवाच ततो मुनिगणः सर्वस्तां देवी प्रत्यपूजयत्। वाग्भिर्ऋग्भूषितार्थाभिः स्तवैश्चार्थविशारदः॥
en: Narada said When the daughter of Himavat, put this question, the assemblage of Rishis there present, adored the goddess with words adorned with Richs and with hymns fraught with deep meaning.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: महेश्वर उवाच अहिंसा सत्यवचनं सर्वभूतानुकम्पनम्। शमो दानं यथाशक्ति गार्हस्थ्यो धर्म उत्तमः॥
en: Maheshvara said Abstention from injury, truthfulness of speech, mercy towards all beings, tranquillity of soul, and the making of gifts to the best of one's power, form the foremost duties of the householder.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: परदारेष्वसंसर्गो न्यासस्त्रीपरिरक्षणम्। अदत्तादानविरमो मधुमांसस्य वर्जनम्॥ एष पञ्चविधो धर्मो बहुशाखः सुखोदयः। देहिभिर्धर्मपरमैश्चर्तव्यो धर्मसम्भवः॥
en: Abstention from sexual union with the wife of other men, protection of the riches and the woman committed to his care, reluctance to appropriate what is not given to one, and avoidance of honey and meat, these are the five chief duties. Indeed, Religion or Duty had many branches all of which yield happy results. These are the duties which those embodied creatures who consider duty as superior, should observe and practise. These are the sources of merit.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच भगवन् संशयः पृष्टस्तन्मे शंसितुमर्हसि। चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य यो धर्मः स्वे स्वे वर्णे गुणावहः॥
en: Uma said O Holy One, I wish to ask you another question about with I entertain great doubts. You should answer it and remove my doubts. What are the meritorious duties of the four castes.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ब्राह्मणे कीदृशो धर्मः क्षत्रिये कीदृशोऽभवत्। वैश्ये किंलक्षणो धर्मः शूद्रे किंलक्षणो भवेत्॥
en: What are the duties of the Brahmana? What of the Kshatriya? What are the duties of the Vaishya? And what are the duties of the Shudra.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: महेश्वर उवाच न्यायस्तस्ते महाभागे सर्वशः समुदीरितः। भूमिदेवा महाभागाः सदा लोके द्विजातयः॥
en: Maheshvara said O highly blessed lady, the question you have put, is a very proper one. Those persons who belong to the twice bom order, are considered as highly blessed, and are, indeed, gods on earth.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उपवास: सदा धर्मो ब्राह्मणस्य च संशयः। स हि धर्मार्थसम्पन्नो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
en: Forsooth, the observance of fasts, is always the duty of the Brahmana. When the Brahmana succeeds in properly observing all his duties, he becomes at one with Brahma.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तस्य धर्मक्रिया देवि ब्रह्मचर्या च न्यायतः। व्रतोपनयनं चैव द्विजो येनापपद्यते॥
en: The proper observance of the duties of Brahmacharya, O goddess, are his ritual. The observar ce of vows and the investiture with the sacred thread form his other duties. It is by these that he becomes truly twice born.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: गुरुदैवतपूजार्थं स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनात्मकः। देहिभिर्धर्मपरमैश्चर्तव्यो धर्मसम्भवः॥
en: He becomes a Brahinana for adoring his preceptors and other elders as also the celestials. Indeed, that religion which has for its soul the study of the Vedas, is the source of all virtue. Even that is the religion which those embodied creatures who are given to virtue and duty, should observe and practise.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच भगवन् संशयो मेऽमस्ति तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि। चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य धर्मं वै नैपुण्येन प्रकीर्तय॥
en: Uma said O Holy One, my doubts have not been removed. You should explain in detail what the duties are of the four respective castes of men.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच रहस्यश्रवणं धर्मो वेदव्रतनिषेवणम्। अग्निकार्य तथा धर्मो गुरुकार्यप्रसाधनम्॥ भैक्षचर्या परो धर्मो नित्ययज्ञोपवीतिता। नित्यं स्वाध्यायिता धर्मो ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमस्तथा॥
en: Maheshvara said Listening to the mysteries of religion and duty, observance of the vows laid down in the Vedas, attention to the sacred fire, and accomplishment of the business of the preceptor, leading a mendicant life, always bearing the sacred thread, constant recitation of the Vedas, and rigid observance of the duties of a celebrate life, constitute the duties of the Brahmana.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: गुरुणा चाभ्यनुज्ञातः समावर्तेत वै द्विजः। विन्देतानन्तरं भार्यामनुरूपां यथाविधि॥
en: After the student life is over, the Brahmana, at the behest of his preceptor, should leave his preceptor's abode for returning to his fathers' house. Upon his return he should duly marry a proper wife.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शूद्रान्नवर्जनं धर्मस्तथा सत्पथसेवनम्। धर्मो नित्योपवासित्वं ब्रह्मचर्ये तथैव च॥
en: Another duty of the Brahmana consists of avoiding the food prepared by the Shudra. Walking along the path of virtue, always obscrving fasts and the practices of Brahmacharya form his other duties.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अहिताग्निरधीयानो जुह्वानः संयतेन्द्रियः। विघसाशी यताहारो गृहस्थ: सत्यवाक् शुचिः॥
en: The householder should keep up his domestic fire for daily adoration. He should study the Vedas. He should pour libations in honour of the departed Manes and the celestials. He should keep his senses under proper restraint. He should eat what remains after serving gods and guests and all his dependants. He should be abstemious in food, truthful in words, and pure both in body and mind.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अतिथिव्रतता धर्मो धर्मस्त्रेताग्निधारणम्। इष्टीश्च पशुबन्धांश्च विधिपूर्वं समाचरेत्॥
en: Attending to guests is another duty of the householder, as also the keeping up of the three sacrificial fires. The householder should also attend to the ordinary sacrifices called Ishti and should also dedicate animals to the deities according to the ordinances.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यज्ञश्च परमो धर्मस्तथाहिंसा च देहिषु। अपूर्वभेजनं धर्मो विघसाशित्वमेव च॥
en: Indeed, the celebration of sacrifices is his greatest duty as also a complete abstention from injury to all creatures. Never to eat before serving the celestials and guests and dependants is another duty of the householder. The food that remains after serving gods and guests and the dependants is called Vighasa. The householder should eat Vighasa.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: भुक्ते परिजने पश्चाद् भोजनं धर्म उच्यते। ब्राह्मणस्य गृहस्थस्य श्रोत्रियस्य विशेषतः॥
en: Indeed, to eat after the members of his family including servants and other dependants, is considered as one of the especial duties of the twiceborn householder, who should, besides, be conversant with the Vedas.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दम्पत्योः समशीलत्वं धर्मः स्याद् गृहमेधिनः। गृह्याणां चैव देवानां नित्यपुष्पबलिक्रिया॥
en: The conduct of husband and wife, in the case of the householder, should be equal. He should every day make offerings of flowers and other articles to those celestials who preside over domesticity.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: नित्योपलेपनं धर्मस्तथा नित्योपवासिता। सुसम्पृष्टोपलिप्ते च साज्यधूमो भवेद् गृहे॥
en: The householder should see that his house is every day properly rubbed with (cowdung and water). He should also observe fasts every day. Wellcleaned and wellrubbed, his house should also be every day fumigated with the smoke of clarified butter poured on his sacred fire in honour of the celestials and the departed Manes.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष द्विजजने धर्मो गार्हस्थ्यो लोकधारणः। द्विजानां च सतां नित्यं सदैवैष प्रवर्तते॥
en: Even these are the duties of a twice born householder. Those duties really upholds the world. Those duties always and eternally emanate from those pious persons among the Brahmanas who live like householders.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यस्तु क्षत्रगतो देवि मया धर्म उदीरितः। तमहं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे शृणु समाहिता॥
en: Do you listen to me with rapt attention, O goddess, for I shall now tell you what the dutics are of the Kshatriya and about which you have asked me.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: क्षत्रियस्य स्मृतो धर्मः प्रजापालनमादितः। निर्दिष्टफलभोक्ता हि राजा धर्मेण युज्यते॥
en: From the beginning it has been said that the duty of the Kshatriya is to protect all creatures. The king gets a fixed share of the merits acquired by his subjects. By that means the king becomes gifted with righteousness.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: प्रजाः पालयते यो हि धर्मेण मनुजाधिपः। तस्य धर्मार्जिता लोकाः प्रजापालनसंचिताः॥
en: The king who rules and protects his subjects piously, acquires, by virtue of the protection he offers to others, many regions of happiness in the next world.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तस्य राज्ञः परो धर्मो दमः स्वाध्याय एव च। अग्निहोत्रपरिस्पन्दो दानाध्ययनमेव च॥ यज्ञोपवीतधरणं यज्ञो धर्मक्रियास्तथा।
en: The other duties of a Kshatriya consist of self-control and Vedic study, the pouring of libations on the sacred fire, the making of gifts, study, the bearing of the sacred thread, sacrifices, the performance of religious rites, the support of servants and dependants, and perseverance in acts that have been undertaken.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: भृत्यानां भरणं धर्मः कृते कर्मण्यमोघता॥ सम्यग्दण्डे स्थितिधर्मो धर्मो वेदक्रतुक्रियाः। व्यवहारस्थितिधर्मः सत्यवाक्यरतिस्तथा।॥ आर्तहस्तप्रदो राजा प्रेत्य चेह महीयते।
en: Another duty of his is to give punishments proportionate to the offences committed. It is also his duty to celebrate sacrifices and other religious rites according to the ordinances laid down in the Vedas. Properly judging the disputes of litigants before him, and truthfulness of speech, and interference for helping the distressed, are the other duties by doing which the king acquires great glory both in this world and in the next. He should also sacrifice his life on the field of battle, having shown great prowess on behalf of kine and Brahmanas.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: गोब्राह्मणार्थे विक्रान्तः संग्रामे निधनं गतः॥ अश्वमेधजितॉल्लोकानाप्नोति त्रिदिवालये॥
en: Such a king acquires in the celestial region। such regions of happiness as are capable of being acquired by the performance of Horsesacrifices.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वैश्यस्य सततं धर्मः पाशुपाल्यं कृषिस्तथा। अग्निहोत्रपरिस्पन्दो दानाध्ययनमेव च॥
en: The duties of the Vaishya always are the keep of cattle and agriculture, the pouring of libations on the sacred fire, the making of gifts, and study.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वाणिज्यं सत्पथस्थानमातिथ्यं प्रशमो दमः। विप्राणां स्वागतं त्यागो वैश्यधर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Trade, walking in the path of virtue, hospitality, peacefulness, self-control, welcoming of Brahmanas, and renouncing things are the other eternal duties of the Vaishya.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तिलान् गन्धान रसांच्चैव विक्रीणीयान्न चैव हि। वणिक्पथमुपासीनो वैश्यः सत्यपथमाश्रितः॥
en: The Vaishya, engaged in trade and walking in the path of virtue, should never sell sesame and perfumery and juices or liquid substances. He should perform the duties of hospitality towards all.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सर्वातिथ्यं त्रिवर्गस्य यथाशक्ति यथार्हतः। शूद्रधर्मः परो नित्यं शुश्रूषा च द्विजातिषु॥
en: He is at liberty to pursue virtue and profit and pleasure according to his means and asmuch as is judicious for him. The service of the three twice born classes forins the high duty of the Shudra.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स शूद्रः संशिततपाः सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः। शुश्रूषुरतिथिं प्राप्तं तपः संचिनुते महत्॥
en: That Shudra who is truthful in speech and who has controlled his senses, is considered as having acquired meritorious penances. Indeed, the Shudra, who having got a guest, performs the duties of hospitality towards him, is considered as acquiring the merit of great penances.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: नित्यं स हि शुभाचारो देवताद्विजपूजकः। शूद्रो धर्मफलैरिष्टैः सम्प्रयुज्येत बुद्धिमान्॥
en: That intelligent Shudra whose wonduct is virtuous and who adores the deities and Brahmanas, gets desirable rewards of virtue.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य शोभने। एकैकस्येह सुभगे किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: O beautiful lady, I have thus recited to you what are the duties of the four castes. Indeed,O blessed lady, I have told you what are their respective duties. What else do you wish to hear?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच उक्तस्त्वया पृथग्धर्मश्चातुर्वर्ण्यहितः शुभः। सर्वव्यापी तु यो धर्मो भगवंस्तद् ब्रवीहि मे॥
en: Uma said You have recited to me what are the respective duties of the four castes, auspicious and beneficial for them. Do you now tell me, O Holy One, what are the common duties of the all castes.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच ब्राह्मणा लोकसारेण सृष्टा धात्रा गुणार्थिना। लोकांस्तारयितुं कृत्स्नान् मत्र्येषु क्षितिदेवताः॥
en: Maheshvara said The foremost of all beings in the universe, viz., the Creator Brahmana, always seeking righteous accomplishinents, created the Brahinanas for rescuing all the worlds. Among all created beings they are gods on Earth.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तेषामपि प्रवक्ष्यामि धर्मकर्मफलोदयम्। ब्राह्मणेषु हि यो धर्मः स धर्मः परमो मतः॥
en: I shall at the beginning tell you what are the religious acts which they should do and what are the rewards which they acquire through them. The religion of the Brahmanas is the foremost of all religions.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: इमे ते लोकधर्मार्थं त्रयः सृष्टाः स्वयम्भुवा। पृथिव्यां सर्जने नित्यं सृष्टांस्तानपि मे शृणु॥
en: For the sake of the virtue, three religions were created by the self-create. Whenever the world is created, those Religions are created by the Grand-father. Do you listen.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वेदोक्तः परमो धर्मः स्मृतिशास्त्रगतोऽपरः। शिष्टाचीर्णोऽपरः प्रोक्तस्त्रयो धर्माः सनातनाः॥
en: These are the three eternal Religions. The Religion prescribed in the Vedas is the greatest; that of the Smritis is the next in the order of importance; the Third in importance is that which is based upon the practices of the virtuous.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: चैविद्यो ब्राह्मणो विद्वान् न चाध्ययनजीवकः। त्रिकर्मा त्रिपरिक्रान्तो मैत्र एष स्मृतो द्विजः॥
en: The Brahmana, endued with learning, should have the three Vedas. He should never make the study of the Vedas. He should devoie himself to the three well known deeds (of making gifts, studying the Vedas, and performing sacrifices). He should be above the three (viz., lust, anger and cupidity). He should be the friend of all creatures. A person who possesses these qualities is called a Brahmana.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: षडिमानि तु कर्माणि प्रोवाच भुवनेश्वरः। वृत्त्यर्थ ब्राह्मणानां वै शृणु धर्मान् सनातनान्॥
en: The lord of the universe declared these six deeds for the observance of Brahmanas. Listen to those eternal duties.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यजनं याजनं चैव तथा दानप्रतिग्रहौ। अध्यापनं चाध्ययनं षट्कर्मा धर्मभाग द्विजः॥
en: The celebration of sacrifices, officiating at the sacrifices of others, the making of gifts, the acceptance of gifts, teaching and study, are the six deeds by doing which a Brahmana acquires religious merit.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: नित्यः स्वाध्यायिता धर्मो धर्मो यज्ञः सनातनः। दानं प्रशस्यते चास्य यथाशक्ति यथाविधि॥
en: Indeed, the daily study of the Vedas is a duty. Sacrifice is (another) eternal duty. The making of gifts according to his power and the ordinance, is, in his case, much praised.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शमस्तूपरमो धर्मः प्रवृत्तः सत्सु नित्यशः। गृहस्थानां विशुद्धानां धर्मस्य निचयो महान्॥
en: Tranquillity of mind is a great duty that is in vogue among the righteous. Householders of pure mind are capable of acquiring very great merit.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पञ्चयज्ञविशुद्धात्मा सत्यवागनसूयकः। दाता ब्राह्मणसत्कर्ता सुसंसृष्टनिवेशनः॥ अमानी च सदाजिह्मः स्निग्धवाणीप्रदस्तथा। अतिथ्यभ्यागतरतिः शेषान्नकृतभोजनः॥
en: Indeed, he who purifies his soul by the performance of the five sacrifices, who is truthful in speech, who is shorn of malice, who makes gifts, who treats with hospitality and honour all regenerate guests, who lives in wellcleaned houses, who is shorn of pride, who is always sincere in his dealings, who uses sweet and assuring words towards others, who takes a pleasure in serving guests and others arrived at his house, and who eats the food that remains after the requirements have been satisfied of all the members of his family and dependants, acquires great merit.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पाद्यमर्थ्य यथान्यायमासनं शयनं तथा। दीपं प्रतिश्रयं चैव यो ददाति स धार्मिकः॥
en: That man who offers water to his guests for washing their feet and hands, who presents and Arghya for honouring him, who duly gives seats, and beds, and lamps for lightning the darkness, and shelter to those who come to his house, is considered, as highly righteous.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: प्रातरुत्थाय चाचम्य भोजनेनोपमन्त्र्य च। सत्कृत्यानुव्रजेद् यस्तु तस्य धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: That householder who rises at dawn and washes his mouth and face and gives food to his guests, and having honoured them duly dismisses them from his house and follows them for a little distance, wins eternal merit.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सर्वातिथ्यं त्रिवर्गस्य यथाशक्ति निशानिशम्। शूद्रधर्मः समाख्यातस्त्रिवर्गपरिचारणम्॥
en: Hospitality towards all, and the pursuit of the threefold objects are the duties of the householder. The duties of the Shudra consist in the pursuit of the three fold objects.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणो धर्मो गृहस्थेषु विधीयते। तमहं वर्तयिष्यामि सर्वभूतहितं शुभम्॥
en: The Religion laid down for the householder has action for its chief characteristic. Auspicious, and beneficial to all creatures, I shall explain it to you.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दातव्यमसकृच्छक्त्या यष्टव्यमसकृत् तथा। पुष्टिकर्मविधानं च कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: The householder should always make gifts according to his power. He should also perform sacrifices frequently. Indeed, he who wishes to secure his own good, should always achieve meritorious acts.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: धर्मेणार्थः समाहार्यो धर्मलब्धं त्रिधा धनम्। कर्तव्यं धर्मपरमं मानवेन प्रयत्नतः॥
en: The householder should acquire riches by fair means, The riches thus acquired should be carefully divided into three parts, keeping the requirements of virtue in view.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एकेनांशेन धर्मार्थो कर्तव्यौ भूतिमिच्छता। एकनांशेन कामार्थ एकमंशं विवर्धयेत्॥
en: With one of those portions he should accomplish all acts of virtue. With another he should seek to satisfy his carvings for pleasure. The third portion he should lay out for increasing.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: निवृत्तिलक्षणस्त्वन्यो धर्मो मोक्षाय तिष्ठति। तस्य वृत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु मे देवि तत्त्वतः॥
en: The Religion of Renunciation is different. It exists for liberation. I shall tell you the conduct that constitutes it. Listen to me in full, O goddess.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सर्वभूतदया धर्मो च चैकग्रामवासिता। आशापाशविमोक्षश्च शस्यते मोक्षकांक्षिणाम्॥
en: One of the duties inculcated by that Religion is Mercy towards all creatures. The man who follows it should not live in one place for more than a day. For acquiring Liberation, the followers of this Religion free themselves from the fetters of hope (or desire).

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न कुट्यां नोदके सङ्गो न वाससि न चासने। न त्रिदण्डे न शयने नाग्नौ न शरणालये॥
en: They have no attachment to habitation, to the Kamandalu they bear for the keep of water, to the clothes that cover their loins, or the scat whereupon they rest, or the triple stick they bear in their hands, or the bed they sleep on, or the fire they want, or the chamber in which it lies.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अध्यात्मगतिचित्तो यस्तन्मनास्तत्परायणः। युक्तो योगं प्रति सदा प्रतिसंख्यानमेव च॥
en: A follower of this Religion fixes his heart upon the working of his soul. His mind is devoted to Supreme Brahma. He is filled with the idea of attaining to Brahman. He is always devoted to Yoga and the Sankhya philosophy.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वृक्षमूलपरो नित्यं शून्यागारनिवेशनः। नदीपुलिनशायी च नदीतीररतिश्च यः॥
en: He seeks for no other shelter than the foot of a tree, He lives in vacant houses of men. He sleeps on the banks of rivers. He takes a pleasure in living by such banks.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: विमुक्तः सर्वसङ्गेषु स्नेहबन्धेषु च द्विजः। आत्मन्येवात्मनो भावं समासज्जेत वै द्विजः॥
en: He is freed from every attachment, and from every bond of affection. He merges the existence of his own soul into the Supreme Soul.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स्थाणुभूतो निराहारो मोक्षदृष्टेन कर्मणा। परिव्रजेति यो युक्तस्तस्य धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Standing like a stake of wood, and abstaining from all food, he does only such deeds as point to Liberation. Or, he may wander about, devoted to Yoga. These are the eternal duties of a follower of the Religion of Renunciation

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न चैकत्र समासक्तो न चैकग्रामगोचरः। मुक्तो ह्यटति निर्मुक्तो न चैकपुलिनेशयः॥
en: He lives aloof from men. He is freed from all attachments. He never lives in the same place for more than a day. Freed from all fetters, he roves over the world. Freed from all ties, he never sleeps on even the same riverbank for more than a day.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष मोक्षविदां धर्मो वेदोक्तः सत्पथः सताम्। यो मार्गमनुयातीमं पदं तस्य च विद्यते॥
en: This is the Religion of persons conversant with Liberation, as declared in the Vedas. This is the righteous path that is trodden by this virtuous, He who follows in this path, leaves no vestige behind.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: चतुर्विधा भिक्षवस्ते कुटीचकबहूदकौ। हंसः परमहंसश्च यो यः पश्चात् स उत्तमः॥
en: Bhikshus (mendicants) are of four kinds. They are Kutichakas, Bahudakas, Hansas, and Paramahansas. The second is superior to the first, the third to the second, and the fourth to the third.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अतः परतरं नास्ति नावरं न तिरोग्रतः। अदुःखमसुखं सौम्यमजरामरमव्ययम्॥
en: There is nothing superior to the Paramahansa; nor is there anything inferior to it or equal to it or superior to it. It is a condition shorn sorrow and happiness; auspicious and freed from decrepitude and death, and without any change.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच गार्हस्थ्यो मोक्षधर्मश्च सज्जनाचरितस्त्वया। भाषितो जीवलोकस्य मार्गः श्रेयस्करो महान्॥
en: Uma said You have described the Religion of the householders, that of Liberation, and that which is based upon the observances of the pious. These paths are noble and highly beneficial to the world of living creatures.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ऋषिधर्मं तु धर्मज्ञ श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यतः परम्। स्पृहा भवति मे नित्यं तपोवननिवासिषु॥
en: you who are conversant with every religion, I wish to hear what the high Religion is of the Rishis. I always have a liking for those who live in hermitage.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: आज्यधूमोद्भवो गन्धो रुणद्धीव तपोवनम्। तं दृष्ट्वा मे मनः प्रीतं महेश्वर सदा भवेत्॥
en: The perfume that comes out of the smoke of the libations of clarified butter poured on the sacred fire, seems to pervade all the hermitages and make them delightful. Seeing this, O great god, my heart becomes always filled with joy.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतन्मे संशयं देव मुनिधर्मकृतं विभो। सर्वधर्मार्थतत्त्वज्ञ देवदेव वदस्व मे। निखिलेन मया पृष्टं महादेव यथातथम्॥
en: O powerful god, I have doubts about the Religion of the Ascetics. You are conversant with the details of all religions. Do you enlighten me, O god of gods, in detail about this subject truly about which I have asked you, O great god.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीभगवानुवाच हन्त तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि मुनिधर्ममनुत्तमम्। यं कृत्वा मुनयो यान्ति सिद्धिं स्वतपसा शुभे॥
en: The Blessed and Holy One said Yes, I shall recite to you the high and excellent Religion of the Ascetic. By following the dictates of that Religion, O auspicious lady, the Ascetics acquire success through the severe penances they practise.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: फेनपानामृषीणां यो धर्मो धर्मविदां सताम्। तन्मे शृणु महाभागे धर्मज्ञे धर्ममादितः॥
en: O highly blessed one, do you hear, from the beginning, what are the duties of those pious Rishis who know every duty and who are known by the name of Phenapas.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उञ्छन्ति सततं ये ते ब्राह्मयं फेनोत्करं शुभम्। अमृतं ब्रह्मणा पीतमध्वरे प्रसृतं दिवि॥
en: The Grandfather Brahman drank some nectar. That water had flowed in the celestial। region from a great sacrifice.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष तेषां विशुद्धानां फेनपानां तपोधने। धर्मचर्याकृतो मार्गो बालखिल्यगणैः शृणु॥
en: The froth of that water is highly sacred and it partook of His own nature. Those Rishis who live upon the measure of froth that thus came out are called. Phenapas (Frotheaters). This is the conduct of those pure Rishis, O lady having penances for wealth! Listen now to me as I explain to you who the Valakhilyas arc.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: बालखिल्यास्तप: सिद्धा मुनयः सूर्यमण्डले। उच्छे तिष्ठन्ति धर्मज्ञाः शाकुनी वृत्तिमास्थिताः॥
en: The Valakhilyas are ascetics who have acquired success by their penances. They live in the solar disc. Living like birds, those Rishis, conversant with every duty of righteousness, live according to the Uncha mode.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: मृगनिर्मोकवसनाश्चीरवल्कलवाससः। निर्द्वन्द्वाः सत्पथं प्राप्ता बालखिल्यास्तपोधनाः॥ अङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्रा ये भूत्वा स्वे स्वे व्यवस्थिताः। तपश्चरणमीहन्ते तेषां धर्मफलं महत्॥
en: Their dress consists of deerskins or barks of trees. Freed from pairs of opposites, the Valakhilyas, having penances for wealth, walk in this track of virtue. They are as big as a digit of the thumb. Divided into classes, each class lives in the practice of its duties. They wish only to practise penances. The merits they acquire by their righteous conduct are very great.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ते सुरैः समतां यान्ति सुरकार्यार्थसिद्धये। द्योतयन्ति दिश: सर्वास्तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषाः॥
en: They are considered as having acquired an equality with the gods and exist for the fulfilment of the purposes of the gods. Having dissipated all their sins by severe penances, they shine in effulgence, lighting up all the points of the compass.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ये त्वन्ये शुद्धमनसो दयाधर्मपरायणाः। सन्तश्चक्रचराः पुण्या: सोमलोकचराश्च ये॥
en: Others, called Chakracharas, are gifted with cleansed souls and devoted to the practice of mercy, Righteous in their conduct and possessed of great purity, they live in the region of Soma.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पितृलोकसमीपस्थास्त उच्छन्ति यथाविधि। सम्प्रक्षालाश्मकुट्टाश्च दन्तोलूखलिकाश्च ते॥
en: Thus living near enough to the region of the departed manes, they duly live by drinking the rays of Soma. There are others called Samprakshalas and Ashmakuttas and Dantolukhalas.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सोमपानां च देवानामूष्मषाणां तथैव च। उञ्छन्ति ये समीपस्थाः सदारा नियतेन्द्रियाः॥
en: These live near the Somadrinking celestials and others that drink flames of fire. With their wedded wives and with passions under complete restraint, they too live upon the rays of Soma.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तेषामग्निपरिस्यन्दः पितॄणां चार्चनं तथा। यज्ञानां चैव पञ्चानां यजनं धर्म उच्यते॥
en: They pour libations of clarified butter on the sacred fire, and worship the departed Manes under proper forms. They also celebrate the wellknown sacrifices. This is said to form their religion.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष चक्रचरैर्देवि देवलोकचरैर्द्विजैः। ऋषिधर्मः सदा चीर्णो योऽन्यस्तमपि मे शृणु॥
en: This religion of the Rishis, O goddess, is always observed by those who are houseless and who are free to go through every region including that of the celestials. There are, again, other classes about whom, I shall speak now. Do you listen.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सर्वेष्वेवर्षिधर्मेषु ज्ञेयोऽऽत्मा संयतेन्द्रियैः। कामक्रोधौ ततः पश्चाज्जेतव्याविति मे मतिः॥
en: It is necessary that they who observe the different religions of the Rishis, should control their passions and know the Soul. Indeed, in my opinion, lust and anger should be completely controlled.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अग्निहोत्रपरिस्पन्दो धर्मरात्रिसमासनम्। सोमयज्ञाभ्यनुज्ञानं पञ्चमी यज्ञदक्षिणा॥ नित्यं यज्ञक्रिया धर्मः पितृदेवार्चने रतिः। सर्वातिथ्यं च कर्तव्यमन्नेनोञ्छार्जितेन वै॥
en: With corn (wealth) acquired by the Uncha mode, they should perform the following duties, viz., the pouring of libations on the sacred fire, occupying a fixed seat employing oneself during the time in the sacrifice called Dharmaratri, performance of the SomaSacrifice, acquisition of especial knowledge, the giving of sacrificial presents, which forms the fifth, the daily performance of sacrifices, devotion to the worship of the ancestors and the deities, hospitality towards all.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: निवृत्तिरुपभोगेषु गोरासानां शमे रतिः। स्थण्डिले शयने योगः शाकपर्णनिषेवणम्॥ फलमूलाशन वायुरापः शैवलभक्षणम्। ऋषीणां नियमा ह्येते यैर्जयन्त्यजितां गतिम्॥
en: Abstention from all luxurious dishes prepared from cow's milk, taking a pleasure in tranquility of heart, lying on naked rocks or the earth, devotion to Yoga, eating potherbs and leaves of trees, and living upon fruits and roots, and wind and water and moss, are some of practices of the Rishis by which they acquire the end that belongs to persons unsubjugated.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: विधूमे सन्नमुसले व्यङ्गारे भुक्तवज्जने। अतीतपात्रसंचारे काले विगतभिक्षुके॥ अतिथिं कांक्षमाणो वै शेषान्नकृतभोजनः। सत्यधर्मरतः शान्तो मुनिधर्मेण युज्यते॥
en: When the smoke has ceased to curl upwards from a house, when the husking machine has ceased to play, when the hearthfire has been put out, when all the inmates have taken their food, when dishes are no longer carried from room to room when mendicants have ceased to walk the streets, it is then that the man who is devoted to the Religion of Truth and tranquillity of soul, wishing to have a guest, should eat what remnant of food may still remain in the house. By acting thus, one becomes a practiser of the Religion of the Munis.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न स्तम्भी न च मानी स्यान्नाप्रसन्नो न विस्मितः। मित्रामित्रसमो मैत्रो यः स धर्मविदुत्तमः॥
en: One should not be arrogant; nor proud; nor cheerless and discontented; nor wonder at anything. Indeed, one should treat his friends and enemies alike. Indeed, one who is the foremost of all persons conversant with duties should treat all creatures like friends.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच देशेषु रमणीयेषु नदीनां निझरेषु च। स्रवन्तीनां निकुञ्जेषु पर्वतेषु वनेषु च॥ देशेषु च पवित्रेषु फलवस्तु समाहिताः। मूलवत्सु च मध्येषु वसन्ति नियतव्रताः॥
en: Uma said Hermits live in charming regions, among the springs and fountains of rivers, in bowers by the sides of rivers and rills, on hills and mountains, in woods and forests, and in sacred places full of fruits and roots. With rapt attention and observing vows and rules, they live in even such places.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तेषामपि विधिं पुण्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि शङ्कर। वानप्रस्थेषु देवेश स्वशरीरोपजीविषु॥
en: I wish, O Shankara, to hear the sacred ordinances which they follow. These hermits, O god of all gods, are persons who depend, for the protection of their bodies, upon themselves alone.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच वानप्रस्थेषु यो धर्मस्तं मे शृणु समाहिता। श्रुत्वा चैकमना देवि धर्मबुद्धिपरा भव॥
en: Maheshvara said Do you hear with rapt attention what are the duties of Hermits. Having listened to them with one mind. O goddess, do you fix your heart upon virtue.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: संसिद्धैर्नियमैः सद्भिर्वनवासमुपागतैः। वानप्रस्थैरिदं कर्म कर्तव्यं शृणु यादृशम्॥
en: Listen then to what the acts are that should be practised by righteous hermits crowned with success, observant of rigid vows and rules, and living in woods and forests.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: त्रिकालमभिषेकं च पितृदेवार्चनं तथा। अग्निहोत्रपरिस्यन्द इष्टिहोमविधिस्तथा।॥ नीवारग्रहणं चैव फलमूलनिषेवणम्। इङ्गुदैरण्डतैलानां स्नेहार्थं च निषेवणम्॥
en: Performing ablutions thrice a day, adoring the departed Manes and the celestial, pouring libations on the sacred fire, performing of those sacrifices and rites called Ishti-Homa, picking up the grains of Nivara-paddy, eating fruits and roots, and using oil that is pressed out from Inguda and castor seeds, form their duties.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: योगचर्याकृतैः सिद्धैः कामक्रोधबिवर्जितैः। वीरशय्यामुपासद्भिीरस्थानोपसेविभिः॥
en: Having performed the practises of Yoga and become crowned with (ascetic) success and freed from lust and anger, they should seat themselves in the attitude called Virasana. Indeed, they should live in those places which are inaccessible to cowards.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: युक्तैर्योगवहैः सद्भिीष्मे पञ्चतपैस्तथा। मण्डूकयोगनियतैर्यथान्यायं निषेविभिः॥ वीरासनरतैर्नित्यं स्थण्डिले शयनं तथा। शीततोयाग्नियोगश्च चर्तव्यो धर्मबुद्धिभिः॥
en: Observant of the excellent ordinances about Yoga, sitting in summer in the midst of four fires on four sides with the sun overhead, duly practising what is called Manduka-Yoga, and always seated in the attitude called Virasana, and lying on naked rocks or the earth, these men, with hearts fixed upon virtue, must expose themselves to cold and water and fire.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अब्भक्षैर्वायुभक्षैश्च शैवलोत्तरभोजनैः। अश्मकुट्टैस्तथा दान्तैः सम्प्रक्षालैस्तथापरैः॥
en: They live upon water or air or moss. They use two pieces of stone only for husking their corn. Some of them use their teeth only for such a purpose. They do not keep utensils of any sort.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: चीरवल्कलसंवीतैर्मृगचर्मनिवासिभिः। कार्या यात्रा यथाकालं यथाधर्मे यथाविधि।॥
en: Some of them clothe themselves with rage and barks of trees or deer skins. Thus do they pass their lives for the time allotted to them, according to the ordinances.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वननित्यैर्वनचरैर्वनस्थैर्वनगोचरैः। वनं गुरुमिवासाद्य वस्तव्यं वनजीविभिः॥
en: Remaining in woods and forests, they wander within woods and forests, live within them, and are always to be found within them. Indeed, these hermits entering into woods and forests live within them as disciples, obtaining a preceptor, live with him.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तेषां होमक्रिया धर्मः पञ्चयज्ञनिषेवणम्। भागं च पञ्चयज्ञस्य वेदोक्तस्यानुपालनम्॥ अष्टमीयज्ञपरता चातुर्मास्यनिषेवणम्। पौर्णमासादयो यज्ञा नित्ययज्ञस्तथैव च।॥ विमुक्ता दारसंयोगैर्विमुक्ताः सर्वसंकरैः। विमुक्ताः सर्वपापैश्च चरन्ति मुनयो वन॥
en: The performance of the rites of Homa and the observance of the five sacrifices are their duties. A due observance of the rules about distribution of the fivefold sacrifices as ordained in the Vedas, devotion to sacrifices, forming the eighth, observance observance of the Chaturmasya, performance of the Paurnamasya and other sacrifices, and performance of the daily sacrifices, are the duties of these celibate men, freed from every attachment, and cleansed from cvery sin. Indeed, they should live thus in the forest.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उम्भाण्डपरमा नित्यं वेताग्निशरणाः सदा। सन्तः सत्पथनित्या ये ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्॥
en: The sacrificial ladle and the water vessel are their chief properties. They are always devoted to the three fires. Virtuous in their conduct and adhering to the path of virtue, they acquire the highest end.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ब्रह्मलोकं महापुण्यं सोमलोकं च शाश्वतम्। गच्छन्ति मुनयः सिद्धाः सत्यधर्मव्यपाश्रयाः॥
en: These Munis, crowned with success and ever given to the Religion of Truth, acquire the highly sacred region of Brahman, or the eternal region of Soma.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष धर्मो मया देवि वानप्रस्थाश्रितः शुभः। विस्तरेणाय सम्पन्नो यथास्थूलमुदाहृतः॥
en: O auspicious goddess, I have thus recited to you, in brief, the outlines of the religion that is followed by hermits and that has many practices in detail.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच भगवन् सर्वभूतेश सर्वभूतनमस्कृत। यो प्रर्मो मुनिसंघस्य सिद्धिवादेषु तं वद॥
en: Uma said O Holy One, O lord of all creatures, O you adored of all beings, I wish to hear what is the religion of those conclaves of ascetics who are followers of the scriptures describing ascetic success. Do you recite it to me.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सिद्धिवादेषु संसिद्धास्तथा वननिवासिनः। स्वैरिणो दारसंयुक्तास्तेषां धर्मः कथं स्मृतः॥
en: Living in woods and forest and well accomplished in the scriptures of success, some amongst them live and act as they like, without being controlled by particular practices; others have wives. How, indeed, have their practices been ordained.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: महादेव उवाच स्वैरिणस्तपसा देवि सर्वे दारविहारिणः। तेषां मौण्ड्यं कषायश्च वासे रात्रिश्च कारणम्॥
en: Mahadeva said O goddess, the shaving of the head and the wearing of the brown robes are the characteristics of those recluses who rove about freely; while the characteristics of those who sport with wives consist in passing their nights at home.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: त्रिकालमभिषेकश्च होत्रं त्वृषिकृतं महत्। समाधिसत्पथस्थानं यथोद्दिष्टनिषेवणम्॥
en: Performing ablutions three times a day is the duty of both the classes, while the Homa, with water and wild fruits, belongs to the married recluses as performed by the Rishis in general. Absorption in YogaMeditation, and performance of those duties which form righteousness and which have been laid down as such, are some of the other duties prescribed for them.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ये च ते पूर्वकथिता धर्मास्ते वनवासिनाम्। यदि सेवन्ति धर्मोस्तानाप्नुवन्ति तप:फलम्॥
en: All those duties also of which I have spoken to you before as belonging to recluses living in forests, are the duties of these also. Indeed, if those duties are observed, they who observe them acquire the rewards of severe penances.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ये च दम्पतिधर्माणः स्वदारनियतेन्द्रियाः। चरन्ति विधि दृष्टं तदनुकालाभिगामिनः॥
en: Those forest recluses who lead married lives should indulge in the gratification of their senses with these married wives of theirs. By indulging in sexual union with their wives at only those times when their seasons come, they perform the duties which have been laid down for thein.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तेषामृषिकृतो धर्मो धर्मिणामुपपद्यते। न कामकारात्कामोऽन्यः संसेव्यो धर्मदर्शिभिः॥
en: The religion which these virtuous men are to follow is the Religion that has been laid down and followed by the Rishis. With their eyes set upon the acquisition of virtue, they should never pursue any other object of desire from a sense of uncontrolled caprice.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सर्वभूतेषु यः सम्यग् ददात्यभयदक्षिणाम्। हिंसादोषविमुक्तात्मा स वै धर्मेण युज्यते॥
en: That man who gives promises of safety to all creatures, freed as his soul becomes from the stain of malice or harmfulness, becomes gifted with virtue.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सर्वभूतानुकम्पी यः सर्वभूतार्जवव्रतः। सर्वभूतात्मभूतश्च स वै धर्मेण युज्यते॥
en: Indeed, that person who shows mercy to all creatures, who adopts as a vow of sincere conduct towards all creatures, and who forms himself the soul of all creatures, becomes gifted with virtue.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सर्ववेदेषु वा स्नानं सर्वभूतेषु चार्जवम्। उभे एते समे स्यातामार्जवं वा विशिष्यते॥
en: A bath in all the shrines, and sincere conduct towards all crcatures, are regarded as equal in point of merit; or, perhaps, the latter is a little distinguished above the other in point of merit.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: आर्जवं धर्ममित्याहुरधर्मो जिह्म उच्यते। आर्जवेनेह संयुक्तो नरो धर्मेण युज्यते॥
en: Sincerity, it has been said, is Virtue; while insincerity or crookedness is sin. That man who acts sincerely becomes indeed with Virtue.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: आर्जवे तु रतो नित्यं वसत्यमरसंनिधौ। तस्मादार्जवयुक्तः स्याद् य इच्छेद् धर्ममात्मनः॥
en: The man who is always devoted to sincerity of conduct, succeeds in acquiring a residence among the celestials. Hence, he who wishes to achieve the merit of virtue, should be sincere.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: क्षान्तो दान्तो जितक्रोधो धर्मभूतो विहिंसकः। धर्मे रतमना नित्यं नरो धर्मेण युज्यते॥
en: Gifted with a forgiving nature and selfcontrol, and with anger under complete subjection, one should transform himself into an embodiment of Virtue and become freed from malice. Such a man, who becomes devoted, besides, to the discharge of all the duties of religion, becomes indued with the merit of virtue.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: व्यपेततन्द्रिर्धर्मात्मा शक्त्या सत्पथमाश्रितः। चारित्रपरमो बुद्धो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते।॥
en: Freed from drowsiness and procrastination, the righteous person, who follows the path of Virtue to the best of his power, and becomes possessed of pure conduct, and who is venerable in years, comes to be considered as equal to Brahma itself.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच आश्रमाभिरता देव तापसा ये तपोधनाः। दीप्तिमन्तः कया चैव चर्ययाथ भवन्ति ते॥
en: Uma said By what course of duties, O god, do those ascetics who are attached to their respective retreats and have penances for wealth, succeed in becoming indued with great splendour?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च निर्धना ये महाधनाः। कर्मणा केन भगवन् प्राप्नुवन्ति महाफलम्॥
en: By what acts, again, do kings and princes who are immensely rich, and others who are poor, succeed in getting high rewards?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: नित्यं स्थानमुपागम्य दिव्यचन्दनभूषिताः। केन वा कर्मणा देव भवन्ति वनगोचराः॥
en: By what acts, O god, do dwellers of the forest succeed in acquiring that place which is eternal and in adoring their persons with celestial sandal paste.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतन्मे संशयं देव तपश्चर्याऽऽश्रितं शुभम्। शंस सर्वमशेषेण त्र्यक्ष त्रिपुरनाशन॥
en: O illustrious god of three eyes, O destroyer of the triple city, do you remove this doubt of mine about the auspicious subject of the observance of penances by telling everything in full.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच उपवासव्रतैर्दान्ता ह्यहिंसाः सत्यवादिनः। संसिद्धाः प्रेत्य गन्धर्वैः सह मोदन्त्यनामयाः॥
en: The Illustrious Deity said Those who observe the vows of fasts and control their senses, who abstain from injury of any kind to any creature, and who practise truthfulness of speech, acquire success and ascending to the celestial region sport in happiness with the Gandharvas as as their companions, freed from every kind of evil.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: मण्डूकयोगशयनो यथान्यायं यथाविधि। दीक्षां चरति धर्मात्मा स नागैः सह मोदते॥
en: That pious man who lies down in the attitude of Manduka Yoga, and who properly and according to the ordinance performs meritorious deeds after having been duly initiated, sports in happiness in the next world in the company of the Nagas.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शष्पं मृगमुखोच्छिष्टं यो मृगैः सह भक्षति। दीक्षितो वै मुदा युक्तः स सगच्छत्यमरावतीम्॥
en: That man who lives in the company of deer and lives upon such grass and vegetables as drop from their mouths and who was undergone the initiation and attends to the duties attached to it, succeeds in going to the capital of Indra.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शैवालं शीर्णपर्णं वा तद्वती यो निषेवते। शीतयोगवहो नित्यं स गच्छेत् परमां गतिम्॥
en: That man who lives upon the moss he gathers and the fallen leaves of trees that he picks up, and puts up with all the severities of cold, acquires a very high place.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वायुभक्षोऽम्बुभक्षो वा फलमूलाशनोऽपि वा। यक्षेष्वैश्वर्यमाधाय मोदतेऽप्सरसां गणैः॥
en: That man who lives upon either air or water or fruits and roots, acquires in the next life the affluence that belongs to the Yakshas and sports in happiness in the company of the various tribes of Apsaras.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अग्नियोगवहो ग्रीष्मे विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा। चीवा॑ द्वादशवर्षाणि राजा भवति पार्थिवः॥
en: Having practised practised for twelve years, according to the rites laid down in the ordinances, the vow relating to the endurance of the five fires in the summer season, one becomes in his next life a king.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: आहारनियमं कृत्वा मुनिदशवार्षिकम्। मरूं संसाध्य यत्नेन राजा भवति पार्थितः॥
en: That man who, having observed vows about food, practises penances for twelve years, carefully abstaining from all interdicted food, and forbidden hours as well, during the period, becomes in his next life a king.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स्थण्डिले शुद्धमाकाशं परिगृह्य समन्ततः। प्रविश्य च मुदा युक्तो दीक्षां द्वादशवार्षिकीम्॥
en: That man who sits and lies on the bare ground with the canopy of heaven over his head, observes the course of duties of initiation, and then renounces his body by abstaining from all food, acquires great happiness in the celestial region.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: देहं चानशने त्यक्त्वा स स्वर्गे सुखमेधते। स्थण्डिलस्य फलान्याहुर्यानानि शयनानि च॥ गृहाणि च महार्हाणि चन्द्रशुभ्राणि भामिनि। आत्मानमुपजीवन् यो नियतो नियताशनः॥ देहं वानशने त्यक्त्वा स स्वर्गे समुपाश्नुते। आत्मानमुपजीवन् यो दीक्षां द्वादशवार्षिकीम्॥ त्यक्त्वा महार्णवे देहं वारुणं लोकमश्नुते। आत्मानमुपजीवन् यो दीक्षां द्वादशवार्षिकीम्॥ अश्मना चरणौ भित्त्वा गृह्यकेषु स मोदते। साधयित्वाऽऽत्मनाऽऽत्मानं निर्द्वन्द्वो निष्परिग्रहः॥ ची। द्वादशवर्षाणि दीक्षामेतां मनोगताम्। स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति देवैश्च सह मोदते॥
en: The rewards of one who sits and lies down upon the naked ground are said to be excellent cars and beds, and rich palaces effulgent like the moon, O lady. That man who having lived upon abstemious diet and observed various excellent vows, lives depending upon his own self and then renounces his body by abstaining from all food, succeeds in ascending to Heaven and enjoying all its happiness. That man who having lived in entire dependence upon his own self, observes for twelve years the duties of initiation, and at last renounces his body on the great ocean, succeeds in attaining to the regions of Varuna after death. That man who living in entire dependence upon his own self observe the duties of initiation for twelve years, and pierces his own feet with a sharp stone, acquires the happiness of the region that belongs to the Guhyakas.
