He who cultivates self with the help of self, who frees himself from the influence of all pairs of opposites, who is freed from every sort of attachment, and who mentally observes for twelve years such a course of conduct after initiation, attains to Heaven and enjoys every happiness with the celestials as his companions.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: आत्मानमुपजीवन् यो दीक्षां द्वादशवार्षिकीम्। हुत्वाग्नौ देहमुत्सृज्य वह्निलोके महीयते॥
en: He who lives in entire dependence upon his own self and observes for twelve years the duties of initiation and finally renounces his body on the fire as an oblation to the celestials, acquires the region of Brahman and is held in high esteem there.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यस्तु देवि यथान्यायं दीक्षितो नियतो द्विजः। आत्मन्यात्मानमाधाय निर्ममो धर्मलालसः॥ चीवा॑ द्वादशवर्षाणि दीक्षामेतां मनोगताम्। अरणीसहितं स्कन्धे बद्ध्वा गच्छत्यनावृतः॥ वीराध्वानगतो नित्यं वीरासनरतस्तथा। वीरस्थायी च सततं स वीरगतिमाप्नुयात्॥
en: That twiceborn man, goddess, who having properly performed initiation keeps his senses under control, and placing his Self on Self frees himself from the sense of mineness, desirous of achieving virtue, and sets out, without a covering for his body, after the due observance of the duties of initiation for twelve years and after having placed his sacred fire on a tree, and walks along the path of heroes and lies down in the attitude of heroes, and always acts like heroes, certainly acquires the end that is reserved for heroes.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स शक्रलोकगो नित्यं सर्वकामपुरस्कृतः। दिव्यपुष्पसमाकीर्णो दिव्यचन्दनभूषितः॥
en: Such a man goes to the eternal region of Shakra where he becomes crowned with the fruition of all his desires and where he sports in joy, his body decked with garlands of celestial flowers and celestial perfumes.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सुखं वसति धर्मात्मा दिवि देवगणैः सह। वीरलोकगतो नित्यं वीरयोगसहः सदा॥ सत्त्वस्थः सर्वमुत्सृज्य दीक्षितो नियतः शुचिः। वीराध्वानं प्रपद्येद् यस्तस्य लोकाः सनातनाः॥
en: Indeed, that pious person lives happily in Heaven, with the celestials as his companions. The hero, following the practices of heroes and devoted to that Yoga which belongs to heroes, living in the practice of Goodness, having renounced everything performed the initiation, controlled his senses, and observing purity of both body and mind, is sure to acquire that path which is reserved for heroes. Eternal regions of happiness are his.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कामगेन विमानेन स वै चरति च्छन्दतः। शक्रलोकगतः श्रीमान् मोदते च निरामयः॥
en: Riding on a car that moves at the will of the rider, he passes through all happy regions as he likes. Indeed living in the regions of Shakra, that blessed person always sports in joy, freed from every calamity.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कामगेन विमानेन स वै चरति च्छन्दतः। शक्रलोकगतः श्रीमान् मोदते च निरामयः॥
en: Riding on a car that moves at the will of the rider, he passes through all happy regions as he likes. Indeed living in the regions of Shakra, that blessed person always sports in joy, freed from every calamity.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच भगवन् भगनेत्रन पूष्णो दन्तिनिपातन। दक्षक्रतुहर त्र्यक्ष संशयो मे महानयम्॥
en: Uma said O Holy one, O you who had torn off the cyes of Bhaga and the teeth of Pushan, O destroyer of the sacrifice of Daksha, O threecyed deity, I have a great doubt.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: चातुर्वण्र्यं भगवता पूर्वं सृष्टं स्वयम्भुवा। केन कर्मविपाकेन वैश्यो गच्छति शूद्रताम्॥
en: Forinerly, the illustrious self-create created the four castes. Through the evil result of what deeds does a Vaishya became a Shudra?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वैश्यो वा क्षत्रियः केन द्विजो वा क्षत्रियो भवेत्। प्रतिलोमः कथं देव शक्यो धर्मो निवर्तितुम्॥
en: Through, what acts does a Kshatriya become a Vaishya and a Brahmana becomes a Kshatriya? By what means may such degradation of castes bc warded off?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: केन वा कर्मणा विप्रः शूद्रयोनौ प्रजायते। क्षत्रियः शूद्रतामेति केन वा कर्मणा विभो॥
en: Through what deeds' does a Brahmana take birth in his next life, in the Shudra caste? Through what acts, O powerful deity, does a Kshatriya also come down to the status of a Shudra?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतन्मे संशयं देव तवद भूतपतेऽनघ। त्रयो वर्णाः प्रकृत्येह कथं ब्राह्मण्यमाप्नुयुः॥
en: O sinless one, O lord of all created beings, do you, O illustrious one, remove this doubt of mine. How, again can the three castes naturally succeed in acquiring the status Brahmanahood?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच ब्राह्मण्यं देवि दुष्प्रापं निसर्गाद् ब्राह्मणः शुभे। क्षत्रियो वैश्यशूद्रौ वा निसर्गादिति मे मतिः॥
en: The Illustrious One said The status of a Brahmana, O goddess is highly difficult to attain. O auspicious lady, one becomes a Brahmana through creation or birth. Similarly the Kshatriya, the Vaishya, and the Shudra, all becomes so through original creation. This is my opinion.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कर्मणा दुष्कृतेनेह स्थानाद् भ्रश्यति वै द्विजः। ज्येष्ठं वर्णमनुप्राप्य तस्माद् रक्षेद् वै द्विजः॥
en: He, however, that is born a Brahmana goes down from his status through his own evil deeds. Hence, the Brahmana, after having acquired the status of the first order, should always protect it.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स्थितो ब्राह्मणधर्मेण ब्राह्मण्यमुपजीवति। क्षत्रियो वाथ वैश्यो वा ब्रह्मभूयं स गच्छति॥
en: If one who is a Kshatriya or Vaishya performs those duties which are assigned to the Brahmana, after the manner of a Brahmana, he becomes a Brahman.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यस्तु विप्रत्वमुत्सृज्य क्षात्रं धर्मं निषेवते। ब्राह्मण्यात् स परिभ्रष्टः क्षत्रयोनौ प्रजायते॥
en: That Brahmana who renounces the duties of his order for following those of the Kshatriya, is considered as one who has fallen away from the status of a Brahmana and who has become a Kshatriya.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वैश्यकर्म च यो विप्रो लोभमोहव्यपाश्रयः। ब्राह्मण्यं दुर्लभं प्राप्य करोत्यमल्पमतिः सदा॥ स द्विजो वैश्यतामेति वैश्यो वा शूद्रतामियात्। स्वधर्मात् प्रच्युतो विप्रस्ततः शूद्रत्वमाप्नुते॥
en: That little-witted Brahmana, who, moved by cupidity and folly, follows the practices assigned to Vaishyas, forgetful of his position as a Brahmana that is highly difficult to attain, comes to be considered as one who has become a Vaishya. Likewise, one who is a Vaishya by birth may, by following the practices of a Shudra, become a Shudra. Indeed, a Brahmana falling away from the duties of his own order. may go down to the status of even a Shudra.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तत्रासौ निरयं प्राप्तो वर्णभ्रष्टो बहिष्कृतः। ब्रह्मलोकात् परिभ्रष्टः शूद्रः समुपजायते॥
en: Such a Brahmana, degraded from the order of his birth and outcasted, without attaining to the region of Brahman, sinks into Hell, and in his next birth becomes born as a Shudra.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: क्षत्रियो वा महाभागे वैश्यो वा धर्मचारिणि। स्वानि कर्माण्यपाहाय शूद्रकर्म निषेवते॥ स्वस्थानात् स परिभ्रष्टो वर्णसंकरतां गतः। ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रत्वं याति तादृशः॥
en: A highly blessed Kshatriya or a Vaishya, who renounces the duties of his order, and follows the practices of a Shudra, falls away from his own order and becomes a person of mixed caste. It is in this way that a Brahmana, or a Kshatriya, or a Vaishya, comes by the position of a Shudra.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यस्तु बुद्धः स्वधर्मेण ज्ञानविज्ञानवाशुचिः। धर्मज्ञो धर्मनिरतः स धर्मफलमश्नुते॥
en: That man who has acquired clearness of vision through practice of the duties of his own casic, who is gifted with knowledge and science, who is pure (in body and inind), who knows every duty and is devoted to the practice of all his duties, is sure to enjoy the rewards of virtue.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: इदं चैवापरं देवि ब्रह्मणा समुदाहृतम्। अध्यात्मं नैष्टिकं सद्भिर्धर्मकामैनिषेव्यते॥
en: I shall now recite to you, O goddess, a saying uttered by Brahman on this subject. The virtuous and those who are desirous of acquiring mcrit always pursue with firmness the culture of the soul.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उग्रानं गर्हितं देवि गणान्नं श्राद्धसूतकम्। दुष्टानं नैव भोक्तव्यं शूद्रान्नं नैव कर्हिचित्॥
en: The food that comes from cruel and fierce persons is censurable. So also is the food that has been cooked for serving a large number of persons. The same is said of the food that is cooked for the first Shraddha of a dead person. So also is the food that is sullied for the usual faults and the food that is supplied by a Shudra. These should never be taken by a Brahmana at any time.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शूद्रान्नं गर्हितं देवि सदा देवैर्महात्मभिः। पितामहमुखोत्सृष्टं प्रमाणमिति मे मतिः॥
en: The food of a Shudra, O goddess, is always disapproved of by the great deities. This, I think, is the authority enunciated by the Grandfather with his own mouth.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शूद्रान्नेनावशेषेण जठरे या म्रियेद् द्विजः। आहिताग्निस्तथा यज्वा स शूद्रगतिभाग् भवेत्॥
en: If a Brahmana, who has set up the sacred fire and who performs sacrifices, were to die with any portion of a Shudra's food remaining undigested in his stomach, he is sure to be born a Shudra.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तेन शूद्रानशेषेण ब्रह्मस्थानादपाकृतः। ब्राह्मणः शूद्रतामेति नास्ति तत्र विचारणा॥
en: On account of those remains of a Shudra's food in his stomach, he falls away from the position of a Brahmana. Such a Brahmana becomes surely a Shudra.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यस्यान्नेनावशेषेण जठरे यो म्रियेद् द्विजः। तां तां योनि व्रजेद् विप्रो यस्यान्नमुपजीवति॥
en: The Brahmana in his next life comes by the position of that order upon whose food he lives through life or with the undigested portion of whose food in his stomach he dies.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ब्राह्मणत्वं शुभं प्राप्य दुर्लभं योऽवमन्यते। अभोज्यान्नानि चाश्नाति स द्विजत्वात् पतेत वै॥
en: That man who having acquired the sacred position of a Brahmana which is so difficult to acquire, disregards it and eats forbidden food, falls away from his high status.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सुरापो ब्रह्महा क्षुद्रश्चोरो भग्नवतोऽशुचिः। स्वाध्यायवर्जित: पापो लुब्धो नैकृतिकः शठः॥ अव्रती वृषलीभर्ता कुण्डाशी सोमविक्रयी। निहीनसेवी विप्रो हि पतति ब्रह्मयोनितः॥
en: That Brahmana who drinks alcohol, who becomes guilty of Brahmanicide or mean in his conduct, or a thief, or who breaks his vows, or becomes impure, or unmindful of his Vedic studies, or sinful, or characterised by cupidity, or guilty of cunning, or a cheat, or who does not observe vows, or who marries a Shudra woman, or who derives his livelihood by pandering to the lusts of other people, or who sells the Soma plant, or who serves a person of a low caste, falls away from his status of Brahman-hood.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: गुरुतल्पी गुरुद्रोही गुरुकुत्सारतिश्च यः। ब्रह्मविच्चापि पतति ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मयोनितः॥
en: That Brahmana who violates the bed of his preceptor, or who takes a pleasure in speaking ill of him, falls away from the status of Brahmanahood even if he knows Brahma.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एभिस्तु कर्मभिर्देवि शुभैराचरितैस्तथा। शूद्रो ब्राह्मणतां याति वैश्यः क्षत्रियतां व्रजेत्॥
en: By these good deeds again, O goddess, when performed, a Shudra becomes Brahmana, and Vaishya becomes Kshatriya.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शूद्रकर्माणि सर्वाणि यथान्यायं यथाविधि। शुश्रूषां परिचर्यां च ज्येष्ठे वर्णे प्रयत्नतः॥
en: The Shudra should perform all the duties sanctioned for him, properly and according to the ordinance. He should always serve, with obedience and humility, persons of the three others castes and serve them with care.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कुर्यादविमनाः शूद्रः सततं सत्पथे स्थितः। देवद्विजातिसत्कर्ता सर्वातिथ्यकृतव्रतः॥
en: Always following the path of virtue, the Shudra should cheerfully do all this. He should honour the celestials and twiceborn persons. He should observe the vow of hospitality to all persons.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ऋतुकालाभिगामी च नियतो नियताशनः चोक्षश्चोक्षजनान्वेषी शेषान्नकृतभोजनः॥
en: With senses kept under control and becoming abstemious in food, he should never approach his wife except in her season. He should ever search after persons who are holy and pure. As regards food, he should eat that which remains after the needs of all persons have been fulfilled.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वृथामांसं न भुञ्जीत शूद्रो वैश्यत्वमृच्छति। ऋतवागनहंवादी निर्द्वन्द्वः शमकोविदः॥
en: If, indeed, the Shudra wishes to be a Vaishya (in his next life), he should also abstain from meat of animals not killed in sacrifices. If a Vaishya wishes to be a Brahmana (in his next life), he should perform these duties. He should be truthful in speech, and shorn of pride or arrogance. He should be above all pairs of opposites. He should observe the duties of peace and tranquility.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यजते नित्ययज्ञैश्च स्वाध्यायपरमः शुचिः। दान्तो ब्राह्मणसत्कर्ता सर्ववर्णबुभूषकः॥ गृहस्थव्रतमातिष्ठन् द्विकालकृतभोजनः। शेषाशी विजिताहारो निष्कामो निरहंवदः॥ अग्निहोत्रमुपासंश्च जुह्वानश्च यथाविधि। सर्वातिथ्यमुपातिष्ठशेषान्नकृतभोजनः॥ त्रेताग्निमन्त्रविहितो वैश्यो भवति वै द्विजः। स वैश्यः क्षत्रियकुले शुचौ महति जायते॥
en: He should worship the celestials in sacrifices, attend with devotion to the study and recitation of the Vedas, and become pure in body and mind. He should keep his senses under control, honour the Brahmanas, and seek the behoof of all the orders. Living like a householder and eating only twice a day at the appointed hours, he should satisfy his hunger with only such food as reinains after all the members of his family with dependants and guests have been fed. He should be abstemious in food, and act without being actuated by the desire of reward. He should be free from egotism. He should worship the deities in the Agnihotra and pour libations according to the ordinance. Performing the duties of hospitality towards all persons, he should, as already said, cat the food that remains after serving all others for whom it has been cooked. He should, according to the ordinances laid down, adore the three fires. Such a Vaishya of pure conduct is born in his next life in a high Kshatriya family.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स वैश्यः क्षत्रियो जातो जन्मप्रभृति संस्कृतः। उपनीतो व्रतपरो द्विजो भवति सत्कृतः॥
en: If a Vaishya, after having taken birth as a Kshatriya, performs the usual purificatory rites, becomes invested with the sacred thread, and betakes himself of the observance of vows, he becomes, in his next life, an honoured Brahmana.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ददाति यजते यज्ञैः समृद्धैराप्तदक्षिणैः। अधीत्य स्वर्गमन्विच्छंस्त्रेताग्निशरणः सदा॥
en: Indeed, after his birth as a Kshatriya, he should make presents, worship the deities in great sacrifices with profuse presents, study the Vedas, and desirous of attaining to Heaven, should adore the three fires.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: आर्तहस्तप्रदो नित्यं प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्। सत्यः सत्यानि कुरुते नित्यं यः सुखदर्शनः॥
en: He should interfere for removing the sorrows of the distressed, and should always rightcously cherish and protect his subjects. He should be truthful, and do all true works, and seek happiness in conduct like this.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: धर्मदण्डो न निर्दण्डो धर्मकार्यानुशासकः। यन्त्रितः कार्यकरणैः षड्भागकृतलक्षणः॥
en: He should administer proper punishments, without laying aside the rod of punishment for good. He should induce men to do righteous deeds. Guided by considerations of policy, he should take a sixth of the produce of the fields.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ग्राम्यधर्मे न सेवेते स्वच्छन्देनार्थकोविदः। ऋतुकाले तु धर्मात्मा पत्नीमुपशयेत् सदा॥
en: He should never indulge in sexual pleasure, but live cheerfully and independently, wellconversant with the science of Wealth or Profit. Of righteous soul, he should seek his married with only in her season.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सदोपवासी नियतः स्वाध्यायनिरतः शुचिः। बर्हिष्कान्तरिते नित्यं शयानोऽग्निगृहे सदा॥
en: He should always observe fasts, keep his soul under restraint, devote himself to the study of the Vedas, and be pure in body and mind, He should sleep on blades of Kusha grass spread out in his fired chamber.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सर्वातिथ्यं त्रिवर्गस्य कुर्वाण: सुमनाः सदा। शूद्राणां चान्नकामानां नित्यं सिद्धमिति ब्रुवन्॥
en: He should pursue the three-fold objects of life, and be always cheerful. He should always say "it is ready” to Shudras desirous of food.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अर्थाद् वा यदि वा कामान्न किंचिदुपलक्षयेत्। पितृदेवातिथिकृते साधनं कुरुते च यः॥
en: He should never wish for anything from motives of gain or pleasure. He should adore the ancestors and gods and guests.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स्ववेश्ननि यथान्यायमुपास्ते भक्ष्यमेव च। त्रिकालमग्निहोत्रं च जुह्वानो वै यथाविधि॥
en: In his own house he should live the life of a mendicant. He should duly worship the deities in his Agnihotra, morning, noon, and evening every day, by pouring libations according to the ordinance.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: गोब्राह्मणहितार्थाय रणे चाभिमुखो हतः। त्रेताग्निमन्त्रपूतात्मा समाविश्य द्विजो भवेत्॥
en: With his face turned towards the enemy, he should renounce his life-breaths in battle fought for the behoof of kine and Brahmanas. Or he may enter the three fires sanctified with Mantras and renounce his body. By doing all this he is born in his next life as a Brahmana.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्पन्नः संस्कृतो वेदपारगः। विप्रो भवति धर्मात्मा क्षत्रियः स्वेन कर्मणा॥
en: Gifted with knowledge and science, purified from all dross, and fully conversant with the Vedas, a pious Kshatriya, by his own deeds, becomes, a Brahmana.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतैः कर्मफलैर्देवि न्यूनजातिकुलोद्धवः। शूद्रोऽप्यागमसम्पन्नो द्विजो भवति संस्कृतः॥
en: It is with the help of these deeds, goddess, that a person who has originated from a dreaded caste, viz., a Shudra, may become a Brahmana purged off of all sins and possessed of Vedic learning.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ब्राह्मणो वाप्यसवृत्तः सर्वसंकरभोजनः। ब्राह्मण्यं स समुत्सृज्य शूद्रो भवति तादृशः॥
en: One who is a Brahmana, when he becomes wicked in conduct and observes no distinction about food, falls away from the status of Brahmanahood and becomes a Shudra.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कर्मभिः शुचिभिर्देवि शुद्धात्मा विजितेन्द्रियः। शूद्रोऽपि द्विजवत् सेव्य इति ब्रह्माब्रवीत् स्वयम्॥४८
en: Even a Shudra, O goddess, who has purified his soul by pure deeds and who has controlled all his senses, deserves to be waited upon and served with respect as a Brahmana. This has been said by the SelfCreate Brahman himself.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स्वभावः कर्म च शुभं यत्र शूद्रेऽपि तिष्ठति। विशिष्टः स द्विजाते विज्ञेय इति मे मतिः॥
en: When a pious nature and pious deeds are seen in even a Shudra, he should, according to my opinion, be held supcrior to a person of the three twiceborn classes.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न योनि पि संस्कारो न श्रुतं न च संततिः। कारणानि द्विजत्वस्य वृत्तमेव तु कारणम्॥
en: Neither birth, nor the purificatory rites, nor learning, nor offspring, can be considered as grounds for conferring upon one the dignity of a twiceborn person Indeed, conduct is the only ground.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सर्वोऽयं ब्राह्मणौ लोके वृत्तेन तु विधीयते। वृत्ते स्थितस्तु शूद्रोऽपि ब्राह्मणत्वं नियच्छति॥
en: All Brahmanas in this world are Brahmanas on account of conduct. A Shudra, if he is of good conduct, is considered as equal to a B-ahmana.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ब्राह्मः स्वभावः सुश्रोणि समः सर्वत्र मे मतिः। निर्गुणं निर्मलं ब्रह्म यत्र तिष्ठति स द्विजः॥
en: The position of Brahma, O auspicious lady, is equal wherever it exists. This is my opinion. He, indeed, is a Brahmana in whom the dignity of Brahman exists, that condition which is bereft of qualities and which has no stain attached to it.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एते योनिफला देवि स्थानभागनिदर्शकाः। स्वयं च वरदेनोक्ता ब्रह्मणा सृजता प्रजाः॥
en: The boongiving Brahman, while he created all creatures, himself said that the division of human beings into the four orders as dependant on birth is only for purposes of classification.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ब्राह्मणोऽपि महत् क्षेत्रं लोके चरति पादवत्। यत् तत्र बीजं वपति सा कृषिः प्रेत्य भाविनि॥
en: The Brahmana is a great field in this world, a field having feet, for it moves from place to place. He who plants seeds in that field, O beautiful lady, reaps the corps in the next world.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: विघसाशिना सदा भाव्यं सत्पथालम्बिना तथा। ब्राह्मं हि मार्गमाक्रम्य वर्तितव्यं बुभूषता॥
en: That Brahmana who wishes to secure his own good, should always live upon the remains of the food that may remain in his house after satisfying the need of all others. He should always follow the path of virtue. Indeed, he should tread along the path of Brahma.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: संहिताध्यायिना भाव्यं गृहे वै गृहमेधिना। नित्यं स्वाध्यायिना भाव्यं च चाध्ययनजीविना॥
en: He should live, engaged in the study of the Samhitas, and remaining at home he should perform all the duties of a householder. He should always be given to the study of the Vedas, but be should never derive the means of livelihood from such study.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एवंभूतो हि यो विप्रः सत्पथं सत्पथे स्थितः। आहिताग्निरधीयानो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
en: That Brahmana who always acts thus, following the path of virtue, adoring his sacred fire, and engaged in the study of the Vedas, comes to be considered as Brahma.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ब्राह्मण्यं देवि सम्प्राप्य रक्षितव्यं यतात्मना। योनिप्रतिग्रहादानैः कर्मभिश्च शुचिस्मिते॥
en: Having acquired the position of a Brahinana, it should always be protected with care, O you of sweet smiles, by avoiding the stain of contact with persons born in inferior castes, by abstaining from the acceptance of gifts, and by other acts laid down in the scriptures.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतत् ते गुह्यमाख्यातं यथा शूद्रो भवेद् द्विजः। ब्राह्मणो वा च्युतो धर्माद् यथा शूद्रत्वमाप्नुते॥
en: I have thus told you a mystery, viz., the manner in which a Shudra may become a Brahmana, or that by which a Brahmana falls away from his own pure position and becomes a Shudra, stain of contact with persons born in inferior castes, by abstaining from the acceptance of gifts, and by other acts laid down in the scriptures.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतत् ते गुह्यमाख्यातं यथा शूद्रो भवेद् द्विजः। ब्राह्मणो वा च्युतो धर्माद् यथा शूद्रत्वमाप्नुते॥
en: I have thus told you a mystery, viz., the manner in which a Shudra may become a Brahmana, or that by which a Brahmana falls away from his own pure position and becomes a Shudra,

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच भगवन् सर्वभूतेश देवासुरनमस्कृत। धर्माधर्मी नृणां देव ब्रूहि मेऽसंशयं विभो॥
en: Uma said O Holy One, O lord of all beings, O you adored of deities and Asuras equally, tell me what are the duties and derelictions of men. Indeed, O powerful one, remove my doubts.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा त्रिविधं हि नरः सदा। बध्यते बन्धनैः पाशैर्मुच्यतेऽप्यथवा पुनः॥
en: It is by these three, viz., thought, word, and deed, that men become fettered with bonds. It is by the same three that they become freed from these fetters.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: केन शीलेन वृत्तेन कर्मणा कीदृशेन वा। समाचारैर्गुणैः कैर्वा स्वर्गे यान्तीह मानवाः॥
en: By following what conduct, Ogod, indeed, by what kind of acts, by what behaviour and qualities and words, do men succeed in ascending to Heaven?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच देवि धर्मार्थतत्त्वज्ञे धर्मनित्ये दमे रते। सर्वप्राणिहितः प्रश्नः श्रूयतां बुद्धिवर्धनः॥
en: The God of Gods said O goddess, you are well conversant with the true meaning of duties. You are ever devoted to Virtue and Self-control. The question you have asked me is fraught with the benefit of all creatures. It increases the intelligence of all persons. Do you, therefore, listen to the answer.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सत्यधर्मरताः सन्तः सर्वलिङ्गविवर्जिताः। धर्मलब्धार्थभोक्तारस्ते नरा: स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those persons who are devoted to the Religion of Truth, who are righteous and destitute of the indications of the several modes of life, and who enjoy the wealth acquired by fair means, succeeds in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: नाधर्मेण न धर्मेण बध्यन्ते छिन्नसंशयाः। प्रलयोत्पत्तितत्त्वज्ञाः सर्वज्ञाः सर्वदर्शिनः॥ वीतरागा विमुच्यन्ते पुरुषाः कर्मबन्धनैः।
en: Those men who are freed froin all doubts, who are gifted with omniscience, and who have eyes for seeing all things, are never fettered by either virtue or sin. Those men who are shorn of all attachments, can never be fettered by the chains of action.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा ये न हिंसन्ति किंचन॥ येन सज्जन्ति कस्मिंश्चित् ते न बद्ध्यन्ति कर्मभिः।
en: They who never injure others in thoughts, word, or deed, and who never attach themselves to anything, can never be fettered by deeds.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: प्राणातिपाताद् विरताः शीलवन्तो दयान्विताः॥ तुल्यद्वेष्यप्रिया दान्ता मुच्यन्ते कर्मबन्धनैः।
en: They who abstain from kiiling any creature, who are gifted with righteous conduct, who have mercy, who treat friends and foes equally, and who are self-controlled, can never be fettered by acts.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सर्वभूतदयावन्तो विश्वास्याः सर्वजन्तुषु॥ त्यक्तहिंसासमाचारास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः।
en: Those men who are gifted with mercy towards all beings, who succeed in creating the confidence of all living creatures, and who men have shaken off malice in their conduct, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: परस्वे निर्ममा नित्यं परदारविवर्जकाः॥ धर्मलब्धान्नभोक्तारस्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः।
en: Those men who have no no desire to appropriate others' properties, who never associate with the spouses of others, and who enjoy only such wealth as has been acquired by fair means, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: भातृवत् स्वसृवच्चैव नित्यं दुहितृवच्च ये॥ परदारेषु वर्तन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः।
en: Those men who treat the wives of other people as their own mothers and sisters and daughters, succeed in attaining to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स्तैन्यान्निवृत्ताः सततं संतुष्टाः स्वधनेन च॥ स्वभाग्यान्युपजीवन्ति ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः।
en: Those who abstain from misappropriating others' things, who are perfectly contented with what they themselves possess, and who live depending upon their own destiny, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स्वदारनिरता ये च ऋतुकालाभिगामिनः॥ अग्राम्यसुखभोगाश्च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः।
en: Those men who never know other peoples' wives, who are masters of their senses, and who are given to righteous conduct, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: परदारेषु ये नित्यं चरित्रावृतलोचनाः॥ जितेन्द्रियाः शीलपरास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः।
en: This is the path, created by the gods, that the pious should follow. This is the path, freed from passion and aversion, sanctioned for the pious to follow.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष देवकृतो मार्गः सेवितव्यः सदा नरैः॥ अकघायकृतश्चैव मार्ग: सेव्यः सदा वुधैः।
en: Those men who are devoted to their own wives and who seek them in only their seasons, and who do not indulge in sexual pleasure, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दानधर्मतपोयुक्तः शीलशौचदयात्मकः॥ वृत्त्यर्थं धर्महेतोर्वा सेवितव्यः सदा नरैः। स्वर्गवासमभीप्सद्भिर्न सेव्यस्त्वत उत्तरः॥
en: For the sake of multiplying their merit or for acquiring their means of livelihood, the wise should follow charity, penances and purity of both body and mind. Those who wish to ascend to Heaven, should follow in this tract and not any other.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच वाचा तु बद्ध्यते येन मुच्यतेऽप्यथवा पुनः। तानि कर्माणि मे देव वद भूतपतेऽनघ॥
en: Uma said Tell me, O illustrious-god, O sinless lord of all creatures, what are those words by which one becomes fettered and what are those words by speaking which one may be freed from fetters.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच आत्महेतोः परार्थं वा नर्महास्याश्रयात् तथा। ये मृषा न वदन्तीह ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Maheshvara said Those men who never tell falschood for either themselves or for others, or in jest or for exciting laughter, succeed in ascending Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वृत्त्यर्थं धर्महेतोर्वा कामकारात् तथैव च। अनृतं ये न भाषन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: They who never tell lies for acquiring their livelihood or for acquiring merit or through mere caprice, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्लक्ष्णां वाणी निराबाधां मधुरां पापवर्जिताम्। स्वागतेनाभिभाषन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: They who utter words which are smooth and sweet and faultless, and who with sincerity welcome all whom they meet with, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: परुषं ये न भाषन्ते कटुकं निष्ठुरं तथा। अपैशुन्यरताः सन्तस्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: They who never utter words which are harsh, bitter and cruel, and who are free from deceitfulness and evil of every kind, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पिशुनां न प्रभाषन्ते मित्रभेदकरी गिरम्। ऋतं मैत्रं तु भाषन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who never utter deceitful words which create disunion between friends and who always speak what is true and what promotes good feelings, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ये वर्जयन्ति पुरुषं परद्रोहं च मानवाः। सर्वभूतसमा दान्तास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who avoid harsh words and abstains from quarrels with others, who are equal in their conduct to all creatures, and who have governed their souls, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शठप्रलापाद् विरता विरुद्धपरिवर्जकाः। सौम्यप्रलापिनो नित्यं ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: They who abstain from evil speech or sinful conversation, who avoid disagreeable speeches, and who utter only auspicious and agreeable words, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न कोपाद् व्याहरन्ते ये वाचं हृदयदारणीम्। सान्त्वं वदन्ति क्रुद्धाऽपि ते नरा: स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: They who never utter, under anger, such words as cut others to the quick, and who, even when under the influence of anger, speak words what are peaceful and agreeable, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष वाणीकृतो देवि धर्मः सेव्यः सदा नरैः। शुभः सत्यगुणो नित्यं वर्जनीयो मृषा बुधैः॥
en: This religion, O goddess of speech, should always be followed by men. It is auspicious and characterised by Truth. The wise should always avoid untruth.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच मनसा बद्ध्यते येन कर्मणा पुरुषः सदा। तन्मे ब्रूहि महाभाग देवदेव पिनाकधृत्॥
en: Uma said Tell me, O god of gods, O holder of Pinaka, O you who are highly blessed, what those thoughts are by which a person may be fettered.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच मानसेनेह धर्मेण संयुक्ताः पुरुषाः सदा। स्वर्गं गच्छन्ति कल्याणि तन्मे कीर्तयतः शृणु॥
en: Maheshvara said Gifted with merit that originates from mental acts, O goddess, one ascends to Heaven. Listen to me, O auspicious one, as I recite to you what those acts are.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दुष्प्रणीतेन मनसा दुष्प्रणीततरा कृतिः। मनो बद्ध्यति येनेह शृणु वाक्यं शुभानने।॥
en: Listen to me, Oyou of sweet face, how also a mind of illregulated features, becomes fettered by illregulated or evil thoughts.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अरण्ये विजने न्यस्तं परस्वं दृश्यते यदा। मनसापि न हिंसन्ति ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who do not seek, even mentally, to take other peoples things even when they lie in a lone forest, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ग्रामे गृहे वा ये द्रव्यं पारक्यं विजने स्थितम्। नाभिनन्दन्ति वै नित्यं ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those who not others' belongings, even when they see it lying in a house or a village that has been deserted, ascend to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तथैव परदारान् ये कामवृत्तान् रहोगतान्। मनसापि न हिंसन्ति ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who do not seek, even mentally, to associate with the married wives of others, even when they see them in deserted places and under the influence of desire, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शत्रु मित्रं च ये नित्यं तुल्येन मनसा नराः। भजन्ति मैत्रा: संगम्य ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who, meeting with friends or enemies behave in the same friendly way towards all, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रुतवन्तो दयावन्तः शुचयः सत्यसंगराः। स्वैरथैः परिसंतुष्टास्ते नरा: स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who are possessed of learning and mercy, who are pure in body and mind, men care who are firm in truth, and who are contented with what belongs to them, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अवैरा ये त्वनायासा मैत्रीचित्तरताः सदा। सर्वभूतदयावन्तस्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who do not bear illwell to any creature, who do not stand in need of labour for their livelihood, who bear friendly hearts towards all beings, and who entertain mercy towards all, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रद्धावन्तो दयावन्तश्चोक्षाश्चोक्षजनप्रियाः। धर्माधर्मविदो नित्यं ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who have faith, who have mercy, who are holy, who scek the company of holy men, and who know the distinctions between right and wrong, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शुभानामशुभानां च कर्मणां फलसंचये। विपाकज्ञाश्च ये देवि ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men, O goddess, who know the consequences of good and bad deeds, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न्यायोपेता गुणोपेता देवद्विजपराः सदा। समुत्थानमनुप्राप्तास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who are just in all their dealings, who have desirable accomplishinents, who are devoted to the deities and the Brahmanas, and who are persevering in doing all good acts, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शुभैः कर्मफलैर्देवि मयैते परिकीर्तिताः। स्वर्गमार्गपरा भूयः किं त्वं श्रोतुमिहेच्छसि॥
en: All these me, O goddess, succeed in ascending to Heaven through the meritorious results of their deeds. What else do you wish to hear?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच महान् मे संशयः कश्चन्मान् प्रति महेश्वर। तस्मात् त्वं नैपुणेनाद्य मम व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Uma said I have a great doubt, O Maheshvara, on a subject about human beings. You should explain it to me carefully.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: केनायुर्लभते दीर्घ कर्मणा पुरुषः प्रभो। तपसा वापि देवेश केनायुर्लभते महत्॥
en: By what deeds does a man succeed, O powerful deity, in acquiring a long life? By what penances also does one acquire a long life?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: क्षीणायुः केन भवति कर्मणा भुवि मानवः। विपाकं कर्मणां देव वक्तुमर्हस्यनिन्दित॥
en: By what acts does one become shortlived on Earth? O you who are perfectly stainless, you should tell me what are the consequences of acts.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अपरे च महाभाग्या मन्दभाग्यास्तथापरे। अकुलीनास्तथा चान्ये कुलीनाश्च तथापरे॥
en: Some have great good fortune and some suffer from misfortune. Some are possessed of noble, and some are of ignoble, birth.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दुर्दर्शाः केचिदाभान्ति नरा: काष्ठमया इव। प्रियदर्शास्तथा चान्ये दर्शनादेव मानवाः॥
en: Some have such repulsive features as if they are made of wood, while others look very handsome at even the first sight.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दुष्प्रज्ञाः केचिदाभान्ति केचिदाभान्ति पण्डिताः। महाप्राज्ञास्तथैवान्ये ज्ञानविज्ञानभाविनः॥
en: Some appear to have no wisdom, while others are possessed of it. Some, again, are seen gifted with high intelligence and wisdom, enlightened by knowledge and science.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अल्पाबाधास्तथा केचिन्महाबाधास्तथापरे। दृश्यन्ते पुरुषा देव तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Some have to suffer little pain, while others there are that are loaded with heavy calamities. Such diverse sights are seen of men. O illustrious one, you should tell me the reason of all this!

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच हन्त तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि देवि कर्मफलोदयम्। मर्त्यलोके नरः सर्वो येन स्वफलमश्नुते॥
en: The God of Gods said Indeed, O goddess, I shall describe to you the fruits of acts. It is by them that all human beings in this world enjoy or suffer the consequences of their acts.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: प्राणातिपाते यो रौद्रो दण्डहस्तोद्यतः सदा। नित्यमुद्यतशस्त्रश्च हन्ति भूतगणान् नरः॥ निर्दयः सर्वभूतानां नित्यमुद्वेगकारकः। अपि कीटपिपीलानामशरण्यः सुनिघृणः॥ एवंभूतो नरो देवि निरयं प्रतिपद्यते। विपरीतस्तु धर्मात्मा रूपवानभिजायते॥
en: That man who assumes a dreadful aspect for the purpose of taking the lives of other creatures, who arms himself with strong sticks for injuring other creatures, who is seen with uplifted weapons, who kills living creatures, who is shorn of mercy, who always causes tribulation to living beings, who refuses to grant protection to even worms and ants, who is cruel, one who is such, O goddess, sinks in Hell. One who has an opposite disposition and who is righteous in deeds, becomes born as a handsome man.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पापेन कर्मणा देवि वध्यो हिंसारतिर्नरः। अप्रियः सर्वभूतानां हीनायुरुपजायते॥
en: The man who is cruel, goes to Hell, while he who is merciful, ascends to Hcaven. The man who goes to Hell, has to suffer great misery.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: निरयं याति हिंसात्मा याति स्वर्गमहिंसकः। यातनां निरये रौद्रां स कृच्छ्रां लभते नरः॥
en: One who, having sunk in Hell, rises therefrom, takes birth as a shortlived man.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यः कश्चिन्निरयात् तस्मात् समुत्तरति कर्हिचित्। मानुष्यं लभते चापि हीनायुस्तत्र जायते॥ पापेन कर्मणा देवि बद्धो हिंसारतिर्नरः। अप्रियः सर्वभूतानां हीनायुरुपजायते॥ यस्तु शुक्लाभिजातीयः प्राणिघातविवर्जकः। निक्षिप्तशस्त्रो निर्दण्डो न हिंसति कदाचन॥ न घातयति ना हन्ति नंन्त नैवानुमोदते। सर्वभूतेषु सस्नेहो यथाऽऽत्मनि तथापरे॥ ईदृशः पुरुषोत्कर्षो देवि देवत्वमश्नुते। उपपन्नान् सुखान् भोगानुपाश्नाति मुदा युतः॥
en: That man who is given to slaughter and injury, O goddess, becomes, through his sinful deeds, liable to destruction. Such a person becomes disagreeable to all creatures and shortlived. That man who belongs to what is called the White class, who abstains from the destruction of living crcatures, who has thrown away all weapons, and never inflicts any punishment on any body, who never injures any creature, who never causes anybody to kill creatures for him, who never kills or strikes even when struck or attempted to be killed, who never sanctions or approves an act of destruction, who is gifted with mercy towards all creatures who treats others as his own self, such a superior man, O goddess, succeeds in acquiring to the dignity of a celestial. Filled with joy, such a man enjoys various kinds of luxurious articles.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अथ चेन्मानुषे लोके कदाचिदुपपद्यते। तत्र दीर्घायुरुत्पन्न: स नरः सुखमेधते॥
en: If such a person is ever born in the world of men, he becomes longlived and enjoys great happiness.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष दीर्घायुषां मार्गः सुवृत्तानां सुकर्मिणाम्। प्राणिहिंसाविमोक्षेण ब्रह्मणा समुदीरितः॥
en: This is the way of those who are uf righteous conduct and righteous deeds, and who are blessed with longevity, the way that was marked out by the SelfCreate Brahman himself and which is marked by abstention from the destruction of living creatures.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच किंशील: किंसमाचारः : पुरुषः कैश्च कर्मभिः। स्वर्गं समभिपद्येत सम्प्रदानेन केन वा॥
en: Uma said By what nature, what conduct, what deeds, and what gifts, does a man succeed in attaining to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच दाता ब्राह्मणसत्कर्ता दीनार्तकृपणादिषु। भक्ष्यभोज्यानपानानां वाससां च प्रदायकः॥ प्रतिश्रयान् सभाः कूपान् प्रपाः पुष्करिणीस्तथा। नैत्यकानि च सर्वाणि किमिच्छकमतीव च।॥ आसनं शयनं यानं गृहं रत्नं धनं तथा। सस्यजातानि सर्वाणि गाः क्षेत्राण्यथ योषितः॥ सुप्रतीतमना नित्यं यः प्रयच्छति मानवः। एवंभूतो नरो देवि देवलोकेऽभिजायते॥
en: Maheshvara said He who has a liberal disposition, who honours Brahmanas and treats them with hospitality, who makes gifts of food and drink and clothes and other articles of enjoyment to the destitute; the blind and the distressed, who makes gifts of houses erects hall, digs wells, constructs shelters whence pure and cool water is distributed, excavates tanks makes arrangements for the free distributions of gifts every day, gives to all comers what each prays for, who makes gifts of seats and beds and vehicles, wealth, jewels and gems, houses, all kinds of corn, kine, fields and women, he who always makes these gifts with a cheerful heart, becomes a denizen, O goddess, of the celestial region.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तत्रोष्यं सुचिरं कालं भुक्त्वा भोगाननुत्तमान्। सहाप्सरोभिर्मुदितो रमते नन्दनादिषु॥
en: He lives there for a long time, enjoying various kinds of superior articles. Passing his time happily in the company of the Apsaras, he sports in the garden of Nandana and other delightful regions.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तस्मात् स्वर्गाच्च्युतो लोकान् मानुषेषु प्रजायते। महाभोगकुले देवि धनधान्यसमन्वितः॥
en: After the exhaustion of his merits he falls down from the celestial region and takes birth in the order of humanity, in a rich family, O goddess, which has a large command of every article of enjoyment.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तत्र कामगुणैः सर्वैः समुपेतो मुदा युतः। महाभोगो महाकोशो धनी भवति मानवः॥
en: In that life he gets all articles for gratifying his wishes and appetites. Indeed, blessed with the possession of such articles, he gets riches and a wellfilled treasury.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एते देवि महाभागाः प्राणिनो दानशीलिनः। ब्रह्मणा वै पुरा प्रोक्ताः सर्वस्य प्रियदर्शनाः॥
en: The SelfCreate Brahman himself declared it formerly that it is even such persons, O goddess, who become highly blessed and possessed of liberal dispositions and handsome features.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अपरे मानवा देवि प्रदानकृपणा द्विजैः। याचिता न प्रयच्छन्ति विद्यमानेऽष्यबुद्धयः॥
en: There are others, O goddess, who are incapable of making gifts, Gifted with small understandings. They cannot make gifts even when solicited by Brahmanas and possessed of immense riches.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दीनान्धकृपणान् दृष्ट्वा भिक्षुकानतिथीनपि। याच्यमाना निवर्तन्ते जिह्वालोभसमन्विताः॥
en: Seeing the destitute, the blind, the distressed, and mendicants, and even guests arrived at their houses, those persons always filled with the desire of pleasing the organ of taste, turn away, even when expressly solicited by them.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ये न धनानि न वासांसि न भोगान् न च काञ्चनम्। न गावो नानविकृति प्रयच्छन्ति कदाचन॥ अप्रवृत्ताश्च लुब्धा नास्तिका दानवर्जिताः। एवंभूता नरा देवि निरयं यान्त्यबुद्धयः॥
en: They never make gifts of wealth or dresses, or viands, or gold, or kine, or any kind of food. Those men who are disinclined to relieve the distress of others, who are full of cupidity, who have no faith in the scriptures, and who do not make gifts. Verily, these of little understanding, O goddess, have to sink in Hell.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ते वै मनुष्यतां यान्ति यदा कालस्य पर्ययात्। धनरिक्ते कुले जन्म लभन्ते स्वल्पबुद्धयः॥
en: In course of time, when their sufferings in Hell, terminate they take birth in the order of humanity, in poor families.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: क्षुत्पिपासापरीताश्च सर्वलोकबहिष्कृताः। निराशाः सर्वभोगेम्यो जीवन्त्यधर्मजीविकाम्॥
en: Always suffering from hunger and thirst, excluded from all decent society, hopeless of ever enjoying all goodly things, they lead wretched lives.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अल्पभोगकुले जाता अल्पभोगरता नराः। अनेन कर्मणा देवि भवन्त्यधनिनो नराः॥
en: Born in families which are destitute of all articles of enjoyment, these men never succeed in enjoying the goodly things of Earth. Indeed, O goddess, it is through deeds that persons become wretched and poor.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अपरे स्तम्भिनो नित्यं मानिनः पापतो रताः। आसनार्हस्य ये पीठं न प्रयच्छन्त्यचेतसः॥
en: There are others who are arrogant and proud for the possession of riches. Those senseless wretches never offer seats to worthy persons.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: मार्गार्हस्य च ये मार्गं न यच्छन्त्यल्पबुद्धयः। पाद्यार्हस्य च ये पाद्यं न ददत्यल्पबुद्धयः॥
en: Gifted with little understanding, they do not give way to them who deserve such an honour. Nor do they give water for washing the feet to persons to whom it should be given.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अार्हान् न च सत्कारैरर्चयन्ति यथाविधि। अर्ध्यमाचमनीयं वा न यच्छन्त्यल्पबुद्धयः॥
en: Indeed, they do not honour, according to the ordinance, with gifts of the Arghya, such persons as deserve to be honoured therewith. They do not offer water for washing the mouth to such as deserve to have that honour.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: गुरुं चाभिगतं प्रेम्णा गुरुवन्न बुभूषते। अभिमानप्रवृत्तेन लोभेन समवस्थिताः॥ सम्मान्यांश्चावमन्यन्ते वृद्धान् परिभवन्ति च। एवंविधा नरा देवि. सर्वे निरयगामिनः॥
en: They do not treat their very preceptors, when the latter arrive at their houses, in the manner in which preceptors should be treated. Living in cupidity and pride, they refuse to treat their elders and aged men with love and affection, even insulting those who deserve to be honoured and asserting their superiority over them without showing reverence and humility. Such men, O goddess, sink in Hell.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ते वै यदि नरास्तस्मान्निरयादुत्तरन्ति वै। वर्षपूगैस्ततो जन्म लभन्ते कुत्सिते कुले॥
en: When their sufferings terminate after many years, they rise from Hell and take birth as men, in low and wretched families.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्वपाकपुल्कसादीनां कुत्सितानामचेतसाम्। कुलेषु तेषु जायन्ते गुरुवृद्धापचायिनः॥
en: Indeed, they who humiliate their preceptors and seniors, have to take birth in such castes as those of Svapakas and Pukkasas who are greatly vile and bereft of intelligence.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न स्तम्भी न च मानी यो देवताद्विजपूजकः। लोकपूज्यो नमस्कर्ता प्रश्रितो मधुरं वचः॥ सर्ववर्णप्रियकरः सर्वभूतहितः सदा। अद्वेषी सुमुखः श्लक्ष्णः स्निग्धवाणीप्रदः सदा॥ स्वागतेनैव सर्वेषां भूतानामविहिंसकः। यथार्हसत्क्रियापूर्वमर्चयन्नवतिष्ठति॥ मार्गार्हाय ददन्मार्गं गुरुं गुरुवदर्चयन्। अतिथिप्रग्रहरतस्तथाभ्यागतपूजकः॥ एवंभूतो नरो देवि स्वर्गतिं प्रतिपद्यते। ततो मानुषतां प्राप्य विशिष्टकुलजो भवेत्॥
en: He who is not arrogant or filled with pride, who is a worshipper of the deities and Brahmanas, who enjoys the esteem of the world, wiro bows to every one who deserves his reverence, who utters smooth and sweet words, who benefits persons of all castes, who is always devoted to the behoof of all beings, who does not feel hatred for anybody, who is sweet tongued, who is an utterer of sweet and cooling words, who gives way to one who deserves to have way, who worships his preceptors in the manner in which preceptors deserve to be adored, who welcomes all crcatures with proper courtesy, who does not bear ill will towards any creature, who lives, adoring elders and guests with such honors as they deserve, who is ever bent upon having as many guests as possible, and who adores all who honour his house with their presence, succeeds, O goddess, in ascending to Heaven. Upon the exhaustion of his merit, he is born as a man in a high and respectable family.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तत्रासौ विपुलैर्भोगैः सर्वरत्नसमायुतः। यथार्हदाता चाहेषु धर्मचर्यापरो भवेत्॥
en: In that life he gets all articles of enjoyment in profusion and jewels and gems and every kind of riches in abundance. He gives to worthy persons what they deserve. He performs every duty and every act of virtuc.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सम्मतः सर्वभूतानां सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः। स्वकर्मफलमाप्नोति स्वयमेव नरः सदा॥
en: Honoured of all creatures and receiving their respect, he obtains the fruits of his own deeds.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उदात्तकुलजातीय उदात्ताभिजनः सदा। एष धर्मो मया प्रोक्तो विधात्रा स्वयमीरितः॥
en: Even such a person acquires a high birth in this world. This that I have recited to you, was said by the Ordainer (Brahman) himself formerly.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यस्तु रौद्रसमाचारः सर्वसत्त्वभयंकरः। हस्ताभ्यां यदि वा पद्भ्यां रज्ज्वा दण्डेन वा पुनः।। लोष्टैः स्तम्भैरायुधैर्वा जन्तून् बाधति शोभने। हिंसार्थं निकृतिप्रज्ञः प्रोद्वेजयति चैव ह॥ उपक्रामति जन्तूंश्च उद्वेगजननः सदा। एवंशीलसमाचारो निरयं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: That man who is fierce in conduct, who creates terror in all creatures, who injures other beings with hands or feet or cords or sticks, or brickbats or clods of hard clay, or other means of wounding and paining, O beautiful lady, who practises various kinds of deceit for killing living creatures or vexing them, who chases animals and causes them to tremble in fear, indeed, that man, who acts thus, is certain to sink in Hell.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स वै मनुष्यतां गच्छेद् यदि कालस्य पर्ययात्। बह्वाबाधपरिक्लिष्टे जायते सोऽधमे कुले॥
en: If in course of time he is born as man in a low and wretched family which meets with obstacles of every kind on every side.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: लोकद्वेष्योऽधमः पुंसां स्वयं कर्मफलैः कृतैः। एष देवि मनुष्येषु बोद्धव्यो ज्ञातिबन्धुषु॥
en: He is hated by all. A wretch among men, he becomes so for his own deeds.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अपरः सर्वभूतानि दयावाननुपश्यति। मैत्रदृष्टिः पितृसमो निर्वैरो नियतेन्द्रियः॥ नोवैजयति भूतानि न विघातयते तथा। हस्तपादैः सुनियतैर्विश्वास्यः सर्वजन्तुषु॥
en: Another, who is possessed of mercy, casts his (beings) eye on all creatures. Gifted with a friendly vision, treating all creatures as if he were their father, shorn of every hostile feeling, with all his passions under complete restraint, he never vexes any creature and never fills them with fear by means of his hands or feet which are always under his control. He inspires the confidence of all beings.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न रज्ज्वा न च दण्डेन न लोष्टैर्नायुधेन च। उद्वेजयति भूतानि श्लक्ष्णकर्मा दयापरः॥
en: He never afflicts any creature with either cords or clubs or brickbats or clods of hard earth or weapons of any sort. His deeds are never fierce or cruel, and he is full of mercy.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एवंशीलसमाचारः स्वर्गे समुपजायते। तत्रासौ भवने दिव्ये मुदा वसति देववत्॥
en: One who is given to such practices and conduct, certainly ascends to Heaven. There he lives like a god in a celestial palace full of comfort.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स चेत् कर्मक्षयान्मो मनुष्येषूपजायते। अल्पाबाधो निरान्तकः स जातः सुखमेधते॥
en: If, upon the exhaustion of his merit, he has to take birth as a man, he becomes born as a man who has not to fight with difficulties of any kind or to meet with any fear. Indeed, he enjoys great happiness.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सुखभागी निरायासो निरुद्वेगः सदा नरः। एष देवि सतां मार्गो बाधा यत्र न विद्यते॥
en: Happy and not compelled to work for his livelihood, he lives freed from every kind of anxiety. Even this, O goddess, is the path of the virtuous. In it there are no obstacles or afflictions.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच इमे मनुष्या दृश्यन्ते उहापोहविशारदाः। ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्पन्नाः प्रज्ञावन्तोऽर्थकोविदाः॥
en: Uma said In the world some men are inasters of inferences and the premises leading to them. Indeed, they are masters of science and knowledge, have large progeny, and are gifted with learning and wisdom.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दुष्प्रज्ञाश्चापरे देव ज्ञानविज्ञानवर्जिताः। केन कर्मविशेषेण प्रज्ञावान् पुरुषो भवेत्॥
en: Others, O god, are shorn of wisdom, science, and knowledge, and are marked out by folly. By what particular acts does a person become endued with wisdom?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अल्पप्रज्ञो विरूपाक्ष कथं भवति मानवः। एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि सर्वधर्मविदां वर॥
en: By what acis, again, docs one become of little wisdom and distorted vision? Do you remove this doubt of mine. O you who are the foremost of all beings knowing duties.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: जात्यन्धाश्चापरे देव रोगार्ताश्चापरे तथा। नराः क्लीबाश्च दृश्यन्ते कारणं ब्रूहि तत्र वै॥
en: Others there are, O god, who are blind from the moment of their birth. Others there are who are diseased and impotent. Do you, O god, tell me the reason of this.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच ब्राह्मणान् वेदविदुषः सिद्धान् धर्मविदस्तथा। परिपृच्छन्त्यहरहः कुशलाः कुशलं तथा॥ वर्जयन्तोऽशुभं कर्म सेवमानाः शुभं तथा। लभन्ते स्वर्गतिं नित्यमिहलोके तथा सुखम्॥
en: Maheshvara said Those men who always enquire about what is for their behoof and what is to their detriment, of Brahinanas learned in the Vedas, crowned with success, and knowing all duties, who avoid all kinds of evil deeds, who achieve only such deeds as are good, succeed in ascending to Heaven after leaving this world, and enjoy great happiness as long as they live there.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स चेन्मानुषतां याति मेधावी तत्र जायते। श्रुतं प्रज्ञानुगं यस्य कल्याणमुपजायते॥
en: Indeed, upon the exhaustion of their merit, when they take their birth in the order of humanity, they become born as men endued with great intelligence. They enjoy every kind of happiness and auspiciousness on account of that intelligence with which they are born.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: परदारेषु ये चापि चक्षुर्दुष्टं प्रयञ्जते। तेन दुष्टस्वभावेन जात्यन्धास्ते भवन्ति ह॥
en: Those men of foolish understandings who cast wicked eyes upon the married wives of other men, become cursed with congenital blindness on account of that sinfulness of theirs.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: मनसा तु प्रदुष्टेन नग्नां पश्यन्ति ये स्त्रियम्। रोगार्तास्ते भवन्तीह नरा दुष्कृतकर्मिणः॥
en: Those men who, moved by desire in their hearts, cast their eyes on naked women, those men of wicked acts take birth in this world to pass their whole lives in one continuous disease.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ये तु मूढा दुराचारा वियोनौ मैथुने रताः। पुरुषेणु सुदुष्प्रज्ञा क्लीबत्वमुपयान्ति ते॥
en: Those men of foolish and wicked acts who indulge in sexual union with women of castes different from their own, those men of little wisdom, have to take birth in their next lives as persons shorn of the virility.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पशुंश्च ये घातयन्ति ये चैव गुरुतल्पगाः। प्रकीर्णमैथुना ये च क्लीबा जायन्ति ते नराः॥
en: Those men who cause animals to be killed and those who violate the beds of their preceptors, and those who indulge in promiscuous intercourse have to take birth in their next lives as persons shorn of manhood.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच सावधं किन्नु वै कर्म निरवयं तथैव च। श्रेयः कुर्वन्नवाप्नोति मानवो देवसत्तम॥
en: Uma said What deeds, O foremost of the celestials, are faulty, and what deeds are faultless? What, indeed, are those deeds by doing which a man succeeds in acquiring what is for your highest good?

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच श्रेयांसं मार्गमन्विच्छन् सदा यः पृच्छति द्विजान्। धर्मान्वेषी गुणाकाङ्गी स स्वर्गे समुपाश्नुते॥
en: Maheshvara said That man who is desirous of determing what is righteousness, and who wishes to acquire prominent virtues and qualities, and who always puts questions to the Brahmanas with a view to find out the path leading to his highest good, succeeds in ascending to Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यदि मानुषतां देवि कदाचित् स निगच्छति। मेधावी धारणायुक्तः प्रायस्तत्राभिजायते॥
en: If, he is born as a man, he becomes gifted with intelligence and memory and great wisdom.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष देवि सतां धर्मो मन्तव्यो भूतिकारकः। नृणां हितार्थाय मया तव वै समुदाहृतः॥
en: This, O goddess, is the line of conduct that the pious are to follow and that is fraught with great good. I have told you of it for the behoof of human beings.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच अपरे स्वल्पविज्ञाना धर्मविद्वेषिणो नराः। ब्राह्मणान् वेदविदुषो नेच्छन्ति परिसर्पितम्॥
en: Uma said There are men who hate virtue and who are gifted with little understandings. Thcy never wish to approach Brahmanas knowing the Vedas.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: व्रतवन्तो नराः केचिच्छ्रद्धाधर्मपरायणाः। अव्रता भ्रष्टनियमास्तथान्ये राक्षसोपमाः॥
en: There are others who observe vows and who are given to the duty of performing Shraddhas. Others, again, are destitute of all vows. They do not care for observances and are like Rakshasas in conduct.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यज्वानश्च तथैवान्ये निर्होमाच तथाऽपरे। केन कर्मविपाकेन भवन्तीह वदस्व मे॥
en: Some there are who are given to the performance of sacrifices and some who do not care for Homa. For what deeds to men become possessed of these different natures.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच आगमा लोकधर्माणां मर्यादाः सर्वनिर्मिताः। प्रामाण्येनानुवर्तन्ते दृश्यन्ते च दृढव्रताः॥
en: Maheshvara said Through the Vedas, the limits have been laid out of all the acts of human beings. Those men who acts thus according to the authority of the Vedas, are seen to become devoted to the observance of vows.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अधर्मं धर्ममित्याहुर्ये च मोहवशं गताः। अव्रता नष्टमर्यादापते प्रोक्ता ब्रह्मराक्षसाः॥ ते घेत्कालकृतोद्योगात् सम्भवन्तीह मानुषाः। निर्दोमा निर्वषट्कारास्ते भवन्ति नराधमाः॥
en: Those men, however who being influenced by folly accept unrighteousness for its reverse become destitute of vows, transgress all restraints, and come to be considered as Brahmarakshasas. Indeed, it is these men who do not care for Homa, who never utter the Vashat and other sacred Mantras, and who come to be considered as the lowest and vilest of men.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष देवि मया सर्वः संशयच्छेदनाय ते। कुशलाकुशलो नृणां व्याख्यातो धर्मसागरः॥
en: Thus, O goddess, have I explained to you the entire ocean of duties of human beings for the sake of removing your doubts, not omitting the sins of which they become guilty.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: नारद उवाच एवमुक्त्वा महादेवः श्रोतुकामः स्वयं प्रभुः। अनुकूलां प्रियां भार्यां पार्श्वस्थां समभाषत॥
en: Narada said Having said these words, the powerful Mahadeva himself become desirous of hearing, and with that view he questioned his dear wife who was seated by his side and was bent upon doing his will.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: महादेव उवाच परावरज्ञे धर्मज्ञे तपोवननिवासिनि। साध्वि सुभु सुकेशान्ते हिमवत्पर्वतात्मजे॥
en: Mahadeva said You, O goddess, know what is Supreme and what is not so. You know all duties, O you who love to live in the retreats of ascetics. You are gifted with every virtue, possessed of beautiful eyebrows, and hair ending in the fairest earls, O daughter of Himavat, the king of mountains.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दक्षे शमदमोपेते निर्ममे धर्मचारिणि। पृच्छामि त्वा वरारोहे पृष्टा वद ममेप्सितम्॥
en: You are skilled in every work. You are gifted with self-control and look impartially towards all creatures. Divested of the senses of mineness, you are devoted to the practice of all the duties. O you of beautiful features, I wish to ask you (about something). I wish that, asked by me, you will describe to me that subject.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सावित्री ब्रह्मणः साध्वी कौशिकस्य शची सती। मार्कण्डेयस्य धूमोर्णा ऋद्धिर्वैश्रवणस्य च॥
en: Savitri is the chaste wife of Brahman. The caste Shachi is the wife of Indra. Dhumorna is the wife of Markandeya, and Riddhi of (king) Vaishravana.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वरुणस्य तथा गौरी सूर्यस्य च सुवर्चला। रोहिणी शशिनः साध्वी स्वाहाचैव विभावसोः॥५
en: Varuna has Gouri for his consort, and the Sun God has Suvarchala. Rohini is the chaste wife of Shashin, and Svaha of Vibhavasu.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अदितिः कश्यपस्याथ सर्वास्ता: पतिदेवताः। पृष्टाश्चोपासिताश्चैव तास्त्वया देवि नित्यशः॥
en: Kashyapa has Aditi. All these consider their husbands as their gods. You have, O goddess, conversed and associated with all of them every day.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तेन त्वा परिपृच्छामि धर्मज्ञे धर्मवादिनि। स्त्रीधर्मं श्रोतुमिच्छामि त्वयोदाहृतमादितः॥
en: It is, therefore, O you knowing every duty, that I wish to question you about the duties of women, you whose words are always consistent with righteousness. I wish to hear you describe that subject from the beginning.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सधर्मचारिणी मे त्वं समशीला समव्रता। समानसारवीर्या च तपस्तीव्र कृतं च ते॥
en: You practice all the duties of virtue with me. Your conduct is exactly like mine, and the vows you observe are the same that are observed by me. Your power and energy are equal to mine, and you have practised the austerest penances.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: त्वया ह्युक्तो विशेषेण गुणवान् स भविष्यति। लोके चैव त्वया देवि प्रमाणत्वमुपैष्यति॥
en: The subject, when described by you will become highly meritorious. Indeed, that subject will then become authoritative in the world.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स्त्रियश्चैव विशेषेण स्त्रीजनस्य गतिः परा। गौर्या गच्छति सुश्रोणि लोकेष्वेषा गतिः सदा॥
en: Women, in especial, are the highest refuge of women. O you of beautiful hips, among human beings the course of conduct laid down by you will be followed from generation to generation.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: मम चार्धे शरीऽस्य तव चार्धेन निर्मितम्। सुरकार्यकरी च त्वं लोकसंतानकारिणी॥
en: Half of my body is made up of half your body. You are always engaged in doing the work of the celestials, and it is you are the cause of have peopling the Earth.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तवे सर्व: सुविदितः स्त्रीधर्मः शाश्वत: शुभे। तस्मादशेषतो ब्रूहि स्वधर्म विस्तरेण मे॥
en: O auspicious lady, you know all the eternal duties of women. Do you, therefore, tell me in full what the duties are of your sex.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच भगवन् सर्वभूतेश भूतभव्यभवोत्तम। त्वत्प्रभावादियं देव वाक् चैव प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: Uma said O holy one, O lord of all created things o source of all that is past, present, and future, it is through your favour that the words I am uttering are originating in my inind.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: इमास्तु नद्यो देवेश सर्वतीर्थोदकैर्युताः। उपस्पर्शनहेतोस्त्वामुपयान्ति समीपतः॥
en: All these Rivers (that are of my sex), O god of gods, having the waters of all the Tirthas, are approaching your presence for enabling you to perform your ablutions in them.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एताभिः सह सम्मन्त्र्य प्रवक्ष्याम्यनुपूर्वशः। प्रभवन् योऽनहंवादी स वै पुरुष उच्यते॥
en: After consulting them I shall describe the subject in duc order. That person who, though capable, is still free from egotism, is rightly called a Purusha.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स्त्री च भूतेश सततं स्त्रियमेवानुधावति। मया सम्मानिताश्चैव भविष्यन्ति सरिद्वराः॥
en: As for women, O lord of all beings, she follows persons of her sex. By consulting these foremost of Rivers, they will be honoured by me.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एषा सरस्वती पुण्या नदीनामुत्तमा नदी। प्रथमा सर्वसरितां नदी सागरगामिनी॥
en: The sacred Sarasvati is the foremost river of all rivers. She goes towards the ocean and is truly the first of all rivers.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: विपाशा च वितस्ता च चन्द्रभागा इरावती। शतदूर्देविका सिन्धुः कौशिकी गौतमी तथा॥ तथा देवनदी चेयं सर्वतीर्थाभिसम्भृता। गगनाद् गां गता देवी गङ्गा सर्वसरिद्वरा॥ इत्युक्त्वा देवदेवस्य पत्नी धर्मभृतां वरा। स्मितपूर्वमथाभाष्य सर्वास्ताः सरितस्तथा॥
en: Vipasha, also, is here, here, and Vitasta, Chandrabhaga, Iravati, Shatadru, the river Devika, Kaushiki, and Gomati, and this celestial River who has in her all the sacred Tirthas, viz., the goddess Ganga, who having originated from the celestial region has descended on the Earth and is considered as the foremost of all rivers! Having said this, the wife of that god of gods, that foremost of all pious persons, smilingly addressed all those Rivers of her sex.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अपृच्छद् देवमहिषी स्त्रीधर्म: धर्मवत्सला। स्त्रीधर्मकुशलास्ता वै गङ्गाद्याः सरितां वराः॥
en: Indeed, the wife of the great god, devoted to the performance of all duties, questioned those individuals of her sex about the duties of women. Indeed, those foremost of rivers, having Ganga for their first all know the duties of women.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच अयं भगवता प्रोक्तः प्रश्वः स्त्रीधर्मसंश्रितः। तं तु सम्मन्त्र्य युष्माभिर्वक्तुमिच्छामि शंकरम्॥
en: Uma said The illustrious god has asked a question about the duties of women. I wish to answer Shankara after having consulted with you.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न चैकसाध्यं पश्यामि विज्ञानं भुवि कस्यचित्। दिवि वा सागरगमास्तेन वो मानयाम्यहम्॥
en: I do not find any branch of knowledge on Earth or Heaven that is capable of being mastered by any individual without your hcip. You rivers that run towards the ocean, it is, therefore, that I seek your opinions.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एवं सर्वाः सरिच्छेष्ठाः पृष्टाः पुण्यतमाः शिवाः। ततो देवनदी गङ्गा नियुक्ता प्रतिपूज्य च॥
en: It was in this way that those foremost of Rivers, all of whom were auspicious and highly sacred, were accosted by Shiva's wife. Then the celestial River Ganga, who adored the daughter of the king of mountains in return, was selected for answering the question,

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
