sn: बह्वीभिर्बुद्विभिः स्फीता स्त्रीधर्मज्ञा शुचिस्मिता। शैलराजसुतां देवीं पुण्या पापभयापहा॥ बुद्ध्या विनयसम्पन्ना सर्वधर्मविशारदा।
en: Indeed, she of sweet smiles is held as swelling with various kinds of understanding and well conversant with the duties of women. The sacred goddess capable of removing all fear of sin, gifted with humility in consequence of her intelligence, well acquainted with all duties, and endued with an exceedingly comprehensive intelligence sweetly smiling, uttered these words :

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सस्मितं बहुबुद्ध्याढ्या गङ्गा वचनमब्रवीत्॥ गंगा वाच धन्यास्म्यनुगृहीतास्मि देवि धर्मपरायणे। या त्वं सर्वजगन्मान्या नदीं मानयसेऽनघे॥
en: O goddess, you are always given to the due performance of all duties. You have favored me highly by thus questioning me. O sinless one, you are honoured by the entire universe. yet you ask me that am but a River.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: प्रभवन् पृच्छते यो हि सम्मानयति वा पुनः। नूनं जनमदुष्टात्मा पण्डिताख्यां स गच्छति॥
en: That person who, though himself competent yet asks another, or who pays a graceful tribute to another certainly deserves, I think, to be considered as righteoussouled. Indeed, such a person deserves to be called learned and wise.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्पन्नानूहापोह विशारदान्। प्रवक्तृन् पृच्छते योऽन्यान् स वै नापदमृच्छति॥
en: That person never falls into disgrace who asks such speakers as are gifted with knowledge and science and as are well conversant with premises and inferences.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अन्यथा बहुबुद्ध्याढ्यो वाक्यं वदति संसदि। अन्यथैव ह्यहंवादी दुर्बलं वदते वचः॥
en: A proud man, even when gifted with intelligence, by speaking in the midst of an assembly otherwise, finds himself uttering only words of weak meaning.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दिव्यज्ञाने दिवि श्रेष्ठे दिव्यपुण्यैः सहोत्थिते। त्वमेवार्हसि नो देवि स्त्रीधर्माननुभाषितुम्॥
en: You are gifted with spiritual insight. You are the foremost of all the celestials. You have taken your rise accompanied by various kinds of excellent merit. You, O goddess are fully competent to describe the duties of women.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ततः साऽऽराधिता देवी गड़ा बहुभिर्गुणैः। प्राह सर्वमशेषेण स्त्रीधर्मे सुरसुन्दरी॥
en: In this way, the goddess Uma was adored by Ganga and honoured with the ascription of many high merits. The beautiful goddess, thus praised, then began to discourse upon all the duties of women in full.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: उमोवाच स्त्रीधर्मो मां प्रति यथा प्रतिभाति यथाविधि। तमहं कीर्तयिष्यामि तथैव प्रश्रिता भव॥
en: Uma said I shall, according to the ordinance, describe the subject of women's duties as far as they are known to me. Do you all listen with rapt attention.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स्त्रीधर्मः पूर्व एवायं विवाहे बन्धुभिः कृतः। सहधर्मचरी भर्तुर्भवत्यग्निसमीपतः॥
en: The duties of women begin when created by kinsmen in the rites of wedding. Indeed, woman becomes, in the presence of the nuptial fire, the companion of her husband in the performance of all righteous acts.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सुस्वभावा सुवचना सुवृत्ता सुखदर्शना। अनन्यचित्ता सुमुखी भर्तुः सा धर्मचारिणी॥ सा भवेद् धर्मपरमा सा भवेद् धर्मभागिनी। देववत् सततं साध्वी या भर्तारं प्रपश्यति॥ शुश्रूषां परिचारं च देववद् या करोति च। नाम्यभावा ह्याविमनाः सुव्रता सुखदर्शना॥ पुत्रवक्त्रमिवाभीक्ष्णं भुर्तुर्वदनमीक्षते। या साध्वी नियताहारा सा भवेद् धर्मचारिणी॥ श्रुत्वा दम्पतिधर्मं वै सहधर्मं कृतं शुभम्। या भवेद् धर्मपरमा नारी भर्तृसपव्रता॥ देववत् सततं साध्वी भर्तारमनुपश्यति। दम्पत्योरेष वै धर्मः सहधर्मकृतः शुभः॥ शुश्रूषां परिचारं च देवतुल्यं प्रकुर्वती। वश्या भावेन सुमनाः सुव्रता सुखदर्शना। अनन्यचित्ता सुमुखी भर्तुः सा धर्मचारिणी॥
en: Gifted with a good disposition, endued with sweet speech, sweet conduct, and sweet features, and always loO king at the face of her husband and deriving as much joy from it as she does from loO king at the face of her child, that chaste woman who regulates her deeds by observing the prescribed restraints, comes to be considered as truly righteous in her conduct. Listening to the duties of inarried life, and perforining all those sacred duties, that woman who considers virtue as the foremost of all objects of pursuit, who observes the same vows as those which are observed by her husband, who, adorned with chastity, looks upon her husband as a god, who waits upon and serves him as if he is a god, who surrenders her own will completely to that of her husband's, who is chcerful, who observes excellent vows, who is gifted with good features, and whose heart is completely devoted to her husband insomuch that she never thinks even of any other man, is considered as truly righteous in conduct. That wife who, even when addressed harshly and looked upon with angry eyes by her husband, appears cheerful to him, is said to be truly devoted to her husband. She who does not cast her eyes upon the Moon or the Sun or a tree that has a masculine name, who is worshipped by her husband and who is gifted with beautiful features, is considered as truly righteous. That woman who, treats her husband with the affection which one shows towards her child, even when he happens to be poor or diseased or weak or worn out with the toil of travelling, is considered as truly righteous in her conduct.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: परुषाण्यपि चोक्ता या दृष्टा दुष्टेन चक्षुषा। सुप्रसन्नमुखी भर्तुर्या नारी सा पतिव्रता॥ च चन्द्रसूर्यो न तरुं पुनाम्ना या निरीक्षते। भर्तृवर्जं वरारोहा सा भवेद् धर्मचारिणी॥ दरिद्रं व्याधितं दीनमध्वना परिकर्शितम्। पति पुत्रमिवोपास्ते सा नारी धर्मभागिनी॥ या नारी प्रयता दक्षा या नारी पुत्रिणी भवेत्। पतिप्रिया पतिप्राणा सा नारी धर्मभागिनी॥
en: That woman who is gifted with self-control, who has given birth to children, who serves her husband with devotion, and whose whole heart is devoted to him, is considered as truly righteous in her conduct. That woman who waits upon and serves her husband with a cheerful heart, who is always cheerful of heart, and who is gifted with humility, is considered as truly righteous in her conduct. That woman who always supports his kinsmen and relatives by giving them food, and whose desire for gratifying her wishes or for articles of enjoyment, or for riches or for happiness, falls short of her devotion to her husband, is considered as truly righteous in her conduct.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शुश्रूषां परिचर्यो च करोत्यविमनाः सदा। सुप्रतीता विनीता च सा नारी धर्मभागिनी॥ न कामेषु न भोगेषु नैश्वर्ये न सुखे तथा। स्पृहा यस्या यथा पत्यौ सा नारी धर्मभागिनी॥ कल्योत्थानरतिनित्यं गृहशुश्रूषणे रता। सुसम्पृष्टक्षया चैव गोशकृत्कृतलेपना॥ अग्निकार्यपरा नित्यं सदा पुष्पबलिप्रदा। देवतातिथिभृत्यानां निर्वाप्य पतिना सह॥ शेषानमुपभुञ्जाना यथान्यायं यथाविधि। तुष्टपुष्टजना नित्यं नारी धर्मेण युज्यते॥
en: That woman who always takes a pleasure in rising early in the morning, who is devoted to the satisfaction of all household duties, who always keeps her house clean, who rubs her house daily with cowdung, who always attends to the domestic fire, who never neglects to make offerings of flowers and other articles to the celestials, who with her husband satisfies the deities and guests and all servants and dependants of the family with that share of food which is theirs by the ordinance, and who always takes, according to the ordinance, for herself, what food remains in the house after the needs of gods and guests and servants, have been satisfied, and who pleases all people who come in contact with her family and feeds them to their fill, succeeds in acquiring great merit.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शुश्रूश्वशुरयोः पादौ जोषयन्ती गुणान्विता। मातापितृपरा नित्यं या नारी सा तपोधना॥
en: That woman who is gifted with accomplishments, who salutes the feet of her father-in-law and mother-in-law, and who is always devoted to his father and mother, is considered as possessed of ascetic merit.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ब्राह्मणान् दुर्बलानाथान् दीनान्धकृपणांस्तथा। बिभर्त्यन्नेन या नारी सा पतिव्रतभागिनी॥
en: That woman who supports with food Brahmanas who are weak and helpless, who are distressed or blind or destitute, comes to be considered as entitled to share the merits of her husband.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: व्रतं चरति या नित्यं दुश्चरं लघुसत्त्वया। पतिचित्ता पतिहिता सा पतिव्रतभागिनी॥
en: That woman who always observes, with a light heart, vows which are difficult of observance, whose heart is devoted to her husband, and who always seeks the behoof of her husband, is considered as entitled to share the merits of her husband.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पुण्यमेतत् तपश्चैतत् स्वर्गश्चैष सनातनः। या नारी भर्तृपरमा भवेद् भर्तृव्रता सती॥
en: Devotion to her husband is woman's merit; it is her penance; it is her eternal Heaven. Merit, penances and Heaven become hers who considers her husband as her all in all, and who gifted with chastity, seeks to devote herself to her husband in all things.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पतिर्हि देवो नारीणां पतिर्बन्धुः पतिर्गतिः। पत्या समा गतिर्नास्ति दैवतं वा यथा पतिः॥
en: The husband is the god which women have. The husband is their friend. The husband is their great refuge. Women have no refuge that can compare with their husband, and no god that can compare with him.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पतिप्रसादः स्वर्गो वा तुल्यो नार्या न वा भवेत्। अहं स्वर्ग न हीच्छेयं त्वय्यप्रीते महेश्वरे।॥
en: A woman considers husband's grace and Heaven as equal; or, if unequal the inequality is very trivial. O Maheshvara 1 do not wish Heaven itself if you are not satisfied with me.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यद्यकार्यमधर्मं वा यदि वा प्राणनाशनम्। पतिर्ब्रयाद् दरिद्रो वा व्याधितो वा कथंचन॥ आपन्नो रिपुसंस्थो वा ब्रह्मशापार्दितोऽपि वा। आपद्धर्माननुप्रेक्ष्य तत्कार्यमविशङ्कया॥
en: If the husband that is poor, or diseased or distressed, or fallen among enemies, or afflicted by a Brahmana's curse, were to command the wife to accomplish anything that is improper or unrighteous or that may bring on the destruction of life itself, the wife should, without any hesitation, accomplish it, guided by the code whose propriety is sanctioned by the Law of Distress.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष देव मया प्रोक्तः स्त्रीधर्मो वचनात् तव। या त्वेवंभाविनी नारी सा पतिव्रतभागिनी॥
en: I have thus, O god, explained at your command, what the duties of women are. Indeed, that woman who acts thus, becomes entitled to a share of the merits acquired by her husband.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: नारद उवाच इत्युक्तः स तु देवेशः प्रतिपूज्य गिरेः सुताम्। लोकान् विसर्जयामास सर्वैरनुचरैर्वृतान्॥
en: Narada said Thus addressed, the great god highly spoke of the daughter of the king of mountains and then dismissed all persons who had assembled there, together with all his own attendants.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ततो ययुर्भूतगणाः सरितश्च यथागतम्। गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव प्रणम्य शिरसा भवम्॥
en: The various tribes of ghostly beings, as also all the embodied Rivers, and the Gandharvas and Apsaras, all bowed their heads to Mahadeva and departed for returning to the places whence they had come. The various tribes of ghostly beings, as also all the embodied Rivers, and the Gandharvas and Apsaras, all bowed their heads to Mahadeva and departed for returning to the places whence they had come.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ऋषि ऊचु: पिनाकिन् भगनेत्रन्ध सर्वलोकनमस्कृता माहात्म्यं वासुदेवस्य श्रोतुमिच्छामि शङ्कर॥
en: The Rishis said (O holder of Pinaka, O tearer of the eyes of Bhaga, O you adored of the entire universe, we wish to hear the glory of Vasudeva.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ईश्वर उवाच पितामहादपि वरः शाश्वतः पुरुषो हरिः। कृष्णो जाम्बूनदाभासो व्यभ्रे सूर्य इवोदितः॥
en: Maheshvara said Hari is superior to the Grandfather himself. He is the Eternal Purusha. Otherwise called Krishna, He is cndued with the splendour of gold and gifted with solar effulgence.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दशबाहुमहातेजा देवतारिनिषूदनः। श्रीवत्साङ्को हृषीकेशः सर्वदैवतपूजितः॥
en: Having ten arins, He is gifted with great energy, and is the Destroyer of the enemies of the celestials. He has a whirl on His breast, and curly locks of hair on His head. He is adored of all the celestials.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ब्रह्मा तस्योदरभवस्तस्याहं च शिरोभवः। शिरोरुहेभ्यो ज्योतींषि रोमभ्यश्च सुरासुराः॥
en: Brahman has sprung from his abdomen. I have originated from his head. All the luminaries in the sky have originated from his hair. From the bristles on his body have originated all the gods and demons.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ऋषयो देहसम्भूतास्तस्य लोकाश्च शाश्वताः। पितामहगृहं साक्षात् सर्वदेवगृहं च सः॥
en: From his body have originated the Rishis as also all the eternal worlds. He is the abode of the Grandfather and of all the gods.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सोऽस्याः पृथिव्याः कृत्स्नायाः स्रष्टा त्रिभुवनेश्वरः। संहर्ता चैव भूतानां स्थावरस्थ चरस्य च॥
en: He is the Creator of this Earth, and He is the Lord of the three worlds. He is also the Destroyer of all creatures mobile and immobile.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स हि देववरः साक्षाद् देवनाथः परंतपः। सर्वज्ञः सर्वसंश्लिष्टः सर्वगः सर्वतोमुखः॥
en: He is, indeed, the Foremost of all the celestials. He is their Master. He is the Chastiser of all enemies. He is gifted with Omniscience. He exists in everything. He is capable of going everywhere. He permeates everything.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: परमात्मा हृषीकेश: सर्वव्यापी महेश्वरः। न तस्मात् परमं भूतं त्रिषु लोकेषु किंचन॥
en: He is the Supreme Soul, He is the Worker of all the senses. He covers the universe. He is the Supreme Lord. There is nothing in the three worlds which is superior to Him.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सनातनो वै मधुहा गोविन्द इति विश्रुतः। स सर्वान् पार्थिवान् संख्ये घातयिष्यति मानदः॥ सुरकार्यार्थमुत्पन्नो मानुषं वपुरास्थितः। न हि देवगणा: सक्तास्त्रिविक्रमविनाकृताः॥ भुवने देवकार्याणि कर्तु नायकवर्जिताः। नायकः सर्वभूतानां सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः॥
en: He is Eternal. He is the destroyer of Madhu, and is otherwise called Govinda. The Giver of honors, He will cause all the kings of Earth to be killed in battle, for securing the purposes of the celestials, taking birth in a human form. The celestials, abandoned by Him, are unable to do their work on Earth Without Hiin as their Icader they cannot do anything. He is the leader of all creatures and is worshipped by all the gods.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतस्य देवनाथस्य देवकार्यपरस्य च। ब्रह्मभूतस्य सततं ब्रह्मर्षिशरणस्य च॥ ब्रह्मा वसति गर्भस्थः शरीरे सुखसंस्थितः। शर्वः सुखं संश्रितश्च शरीरे सुखसंस्थितः॥
en: Within the abdomen of this Master of the gods Who always docs celestial work, of this one who is at one with Brahman, and Who is always the refuge of the twicehorn Rishis, lives Brahman. Indeed, the latter lives happily in Hari's body which is his abode. I myself, that am called Sharva, also live happily in that happy abode of mine.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सर्वाः सुखं संश्रिताश्च शरीरे तस्य देवताः। स देवः पुण्डरीकाक्षः श्रीगर्भः श्रीसहोषितः॥
en: All the celestials, too, live happily in His body. Gitted with great effulgence, He has cyes which resemble lotus petals The goddess (if prosperity lives within Him and He lives always in his company.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शाङ्गचक्रायुधः खड्गी सर्वनागरिपुध्वजः! उत्तमेन स शीलेन दमेन च शमेन च॥ पराक्रमण वीर्येण वपुषा दर्शनेन च। आरोहण प्रमाणेन धैर्येणार्जवसम्पदा॥ आनृशंस्येन रूपेण बलेन च समन्वितः। अस्त्रैः समुदितः सर्वैदिव्यैरद्भुतदर्शनैः॥
en: The bow called Sharanga and the discus (called Sudarshana) are his weapons, as well as i sword. He has the emblem of the enemy of all the snakes his standard. He is distinguished by excellent conduct, by purity, by self-control, by prowess, by energy, by the most beautiful form, by tallness and well proportioned limbs, by patience, by sincerity, by riches, by mercy, by the beauty of form, and by power. He shines, having all celestial weapons of wonderful form and make.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: योगमायः सहस्राक्षो निरपायो महामनाः। वीरो मित्रजनश्लाघी ज्ञातिबन्धुजनप्रियः॥
en: He has Yoga for his illusion. He has a thousand eyes. He is free from every stain or fault. He is highminded. He is gifted with on heroism. He is an object of pride with all his friends. He is dear to all his kinsmen and relatives and they are dear to him.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: क्षमावांश्चानहंवादी ब्रह्मण्यो ब्रह्मनायकः। भयहर्ता भयार्तानां मित्राणां नन्दिवर्धनः॥
en: He is gifted with forgiveness. He is free from prive or egotism. He is devoted to the Brahmanas and is their leader. He removes the fears of all persons stricken with fear. He increases the joys of all his friends.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शरण्यः सर्वभूतानां दीनानां पालने रतः। श्रुतवानर्थसम्पन्नः सर्वभूतनमस्कृतः॥
en: He is the refuge of all crcatures. He is ever engaged in protecting and cherishing the distressed. Having mastery over all the scriptures and every kind of affluence, He is adored by all beings.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: समाश्रितानां वरदः शत्रूणामपि धर्मवित्। नीतिज्ञो नीतिसम्पन्नो ब्रह्मवादी जितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Knowing all duties, He is a great benefactor of even even enemies when they scek His protection. Conversant with policy and endued with policy. He is an utterer of Brahma and has all His senses under perfect restraint.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: भवार्थमिह देवानां बुद्ध्या परमया युतः। प्राजापत्ये शुभे मार्गे मानवे धर्मसंस्कृते॥ समुत्यस्यति गोविन्दो मनोवंशे महात्मनः। अङ्गो नाम मनोः पुत्रो अन्तर्धामा ततः परः॥
en: For doing good to the celestials, Govinda will take birth in the family of ..ie great Manu. Indeed, gifted with great intelligence. He will take birth in the auspicious and righteous family of that Prajapati. Manu will have a soni mained Anga. After Anga will come Antardhaman.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अन्तर्धाम्नो हविर्धामा प्रजापतिरनिन्दितः। प्राचीनबहिर्भविता हविर्धाम्नः सुतो महान्॥
en: From Antardhaman will Havirdhaman, that lord of all creatures, free from every stain. Havirdhaman will beget an illustrious son named Prachinavarhi. come

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तस्य प्रचेत:प्रमुखा भविष्यन्ति दशात्मजाः। प्राचेतसस्तथा दक्षो भवितेह प्रजापतिः॥
en: He will have ten sons having Prachetas for their first. Prachetas will have a son named Daksha who will be regarded as a Prajapati. Daksha will begeta daughter named Dakshayani.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दाक्षायण्यास्तथाऽऽदित्यो मनुरादित्यतस्तथा। मनोश्च वंशज इला सुद्युम्नश्च भविष्यति॥
en: From Dakshayani will spring Aditya. and from Aditya will spring Manu. Manu will beget a daughter named Ila and a son named Sudyumna.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: बुधात् पुरूरवाश्चापि तस्मादायुर्भविष्यति। नहुषो भविता तस्माद् ययातिस्तस्य चात्मजः॥
en: Ila will have Budha for her Husband, and from Budha will spring Pururavas. From Pururavas will spring Ayu. From Ayu will spring Nahusha, and Nahusha will beget a son named Yayati.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यदुस्तस्मान्महासत्त्वः क्रोष्टा तस्माद् भविष्यति। क्रोष्टुश्चैव महान् पुत्रो वृजिनीवान् भविष्यति॥
en: From Yayati will spring a powerful son named Yadu. Yadu will beget Kroshtri. Kroshtri will beget a powerful son named Vrijinivat.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वृजिनीवतश्च भविता उषड्गुरपराजितः। उषगोर्भविता पुत्रः शूरचित्ररथस्तथा॥
en: Vrijinivat will beget beget the invincible Ushadgu. Ushadgu will beget a son named Chitraratha.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तस्य त्ववरजः पुत्रः शूरो नाम भविष्यति। तेषां विख्यातवीर्याणां चरित्रगुणशालिनाम्॥ यज्वनां सुविशुद्धानां वंशे ब्राह्मणसम्मते। स शूरः क्षत्रियश्रेष्ठो महावीर्यो महायशाः। स्ववंशविस्तरकर जनयिष्यति मानदः॥
en: Chitraratha will have a younger son of the name of Shura. Indeed, in the family of these powerful men of energy known all over the world, gifted with excellent conduct and pure in son various accomplishments, given to the performance of sacrifices and pure behaviour, in the pure family honoured by the Brahmanas, Shura will take his birth. He will be a foremost Kshatriya, gifted with great energy, and possessed of great fame.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वसुदेव इति ख्यातं पुत्रमानकदुन्दुभिम्। तस्य पुत्रश्चतुर्बाहुर्वासुदेवो भविष्यति॥
en: Shura, that giver of honors, will beget a son, the perpetuator of his family, of the name of Vasudeva, otherwise called Anakadundhubhi.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दाता ब्राह्मणसत्कर्ता ब्रह्मभूतो द्विजप्रियः। राज्ञो मागधसंरुद्धान् मोक्षयिष्यति यादवः॥
en: Vasudeva will have a of name Vasudeva. He will have four hands. He will be greatly liberal, and will honour the Brahmanas greatly. Identical with Brahman, he will love and like the Brahmanas, and the Brahmanas will love and like him.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: जरासंधं तु राजानं निर्जित्य गिरिगह्वरे। सर्वपार्थिवरत्नाढ्यो भविष्यति स वीर्यवान्॥
en: That scion of Yadu's race will liberate many kings confined in the prison of the king of the Magadhas (Jarasandha) after defeating him in his capital buried among mountains.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पृथिव्यामप्रतिहतो वीर्येण च भविष्यति। विक्रमेण च सम्पन्न: सर्वपार्थिवपार्थिवः॥
en: Gifted with great energy, he will be rich with the jewels and gems of all rulers of the Earth. Indeed, in energy he will be peerless on Earth.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शूरसेनेषु भूत्वा स द्वारकायां वसन् प्रभुः। पालयिष्यति गां देवीं विजित्य नयवित् सदा॥ तं भवन्तः समासाद्य वाङ्माल्यैरहणैर्वरैः। अर्चयन्तु यथान्यायं ब्रह्माणमिव शाश्वतम्॥ यो हि मां द्रष्टुमिच्छेत ब्रह्माणं च पितामहम्। द्रष्टव्यस्तेन भगवान् वासुदेवः प्रतापवान्॥ दृष्टे तस्मिन्नहं दृष्टो न मेऽत्रास्ति विचारणा। पितामहो वा देवेश इति वित्त तपोधनाः॥
en: Possessed of great prowess, he will be the king of all kings of the Earth. Foremost among all thc Surasenas, the powerful one, living at Dwaraka, will rule and protect the entire Earth after defeating all her kings conversant as he will be with the science of policy. Assembling together do you all worship Him, as you adore the Eternal Brahman, with speech, flowers, and excellent incense and perfumes. He who wishes to see me or the Grandfather Brahman should first see the illustrious Vasudeva of great power. If he is seen I am seen, as also the Grandfather Brahman, that foremost of all the celestials.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स यस्य पुण्डरीकाक्षः प्रीतियुक्तो भविष्यति। तस्य देवगणः प्रीतो ब्रह्मपूर्वो भविष्यति॥ यश्च तं मानवे लोके संश्रयिष्यति केशवम्। तस्य कीर्तिर्जयश्चैव स्वर्गश्चैव भविष्यति॥ धर्माणांदेशिकः साक्षात् स भविष्यति धर्मभा।
en: I do not find any difference in this. Know this, O Rishis having asceticism for wealth. That person with whom the lotus-eyed Vasudeva becomes pleased, is liked by all the deities with Brahman amongst them. That man who will seek the protection of Keshava will succeed in acquiring great achievements and victory and Heaven. He will be an instructor in religion and duties, and will acquire great religious merit.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: धर्मवद्भिः स देवेशो नमस्कार्यः सदोद्यतैः॥ धर्म एव परो हि स्यात् तस्मिन्नभ्यर्चिते विभौ।
en: All persons knowing religion and duties should, with great readiness, bow down to that Lords of all the gods. By adoring that powerful one, one will acquire great merit.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स हि देवो महातेजाः प्रजाहितचिकीर्षया॥ धर्मार्थं पुरुषव्याघ्र ऋषिकोटी: ससर्ज ह।
en: Gifted with great energy, that god with the desire of benefiting all creatures, created millions of Rishis for the sake of virtue.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ता: सुष्टास्तेन विभुना पर्वते गन्धमादने॥ सनत्कुमारप्रमुखास्तिष्ठन्ति तपसान्विताः।
en: Those millions of Rishis, thus created by that great Ordainer are now living on the mountains of Gandhamadana, headed by Sanatkumara and engaged in the performance of penances.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तस्मात् च वाग्मी धर्मज्ञो नमस्यो द्विजपुङ्गवाः॥ दिवि श्रेष्ठो हि भगवान् हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः।
en: Hence, you foremost of twice born ones, that foremost of all eloquent persons, viz., the righteous Vasudeva, should be worshipped by all. The illustrious Hari, the powerfu! Narayana, is, indeed, the foremost of all beings in Heaven.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वन्दितो हि स वन्देत मानितो पानयीत च। अर्हितश्चाई येन्नित्यं पूजितः प्रतिपूजयेत्॥
en: Adored, he adores, and honoured, he honors; to them who make offerings to him, he makes offerings in return. Worshipped, he worships in return.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दृष्टः पश्येदहरहः संश्रितः प्रतिसंश्रयेत्। अर्चितश्चार्च येन्नित्यं स देवो द्विजसत्तमाः॥
en: If seen always, he sees the seers always. If one seeks His refuge and protection, He seeks the seeker as His refuge in return. O foremost of all righteous ones, if adored and worshipped, He adores and worships in return.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतत् तस्यानवद्यस्य विष्णोर्वे परमं व्रतम्। आदिदेवस्य महतः सज्जनाचरितं सदा॥
en: This is the practice of the faultless Vishnu. This is the vow that is practised by all righteous people, of that first of all deities, that powerful Lord of all creatures.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: भुवनेऽभ्यर्चितो नित्यं देवैरपि सनातनः। अभयेनानुरूपेण युज्यन्ते तमनुव्रताः॥
en: He is always adored in the world. That Eternal Being is adored by even the celestials. Those persons who are devoted to Him with the steadiness of a vow become freed from calamity and fear proportionate to his devotion.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा स नमस्यो द्विजैः सदा। यत्नवद्भिरुपस्थाय द्रष्टव्यो देवकीसुतः॥
en: The regenerate ones should always adore Him in thought, word, and deed. The son of Devaki should be seen by them with respect and in order to see Him with respect they should undertake the performance of penances.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष वोऽभिहितो मार्गो मया वै मुनिसत्तमाः। तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वशो देवं दृष्टाः स्युः सुरसत्तमाः॥
en: O foremost of ascetics, this is the path that I show to you. By seeing Him, you will have scon all the foremost of celestials.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: महावराहं तं देवं सर्वलोकपितामहम्। अहं चैव नमस्यामि नित्यमेव जगत्पतिम्॥
en: I, too, vow my head in respect to that Lord of the universe, that Grandfather of all the worlds, that powerful and huge boar.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तत्र च त्रितयं दृष्टं भविष्यति न संशयः। समस्ता हि वयं देवास्तस्य देहे वसामहे॥
en: By seeing Him one sees ihe Trinity. Ourselves, viz., all the celestials, live in Him.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तस्य चैवाग्रजो भ्राता सितादिनिचयप्रभः। हली बल इति ख्यातो भविष्यति धराधरः॥
en: He will have an elder brother who will be known over all the world by the name of Bala. having a plough for his weapon in form hie will look like a white hill. In fact, he will be gifted with strength capable of uplifting the entire Earth.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: त्रिशिरास्तस्य दिव्यश्च शातकुम्भमयो द्रुमः । ध्वजस्तृणेन्द्रो देवस्य भविष्यति रथाश्रितः ॥
en: Upon the car of that divine person a tall palmyra, three-headed and made of gold, will be his standard.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: शिरो नागैर्महाभोगैः परिकीर्णं महात्मभिः। भविष्यति महाबाहोः सर्वलोकेश्वरस्य च॥ चिन्तितानि समेष्यन्ति शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि चैव ह ।
en: The head of that mighty-armed hero, that Lord of all the worlds. will be covered with many huge snakes. All weapons of attack and defence will also come to hiin as soon as he will think of them.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अनन्तश्च स एवोक्तो भगवान् हरिरव्ययः॥ समादिष्टश्च विबुधैर्दर्शय त्वमिति प्रभो। सुपर्णो यस्य वीर्येण कश्यपस्यात्मजो बली। अन्तं नैवाशकद् द्रष्टुं देवस्य परमात्मनः॥
en: He is called Ananta (Infinite). That Illustrious One is at one with the immutabic Hari. Once on a time, the celestials thus spoke to the mighty Garuda, the son of Kashyapa:-Do you, O powerful one, sce if this one has any end. Though giſted with great cnergy and power, Garuda, however, could not find out the end of this Illustrious One who is at one with the Supreme Soul.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स च शेषो विचरते परया वै मुदा युतः। अन्तर्वसति भोगेन परिरभ्य वसुन्धराम्॥
en: pporting the entire Earth on His head, He lives in the nether regions. He roves through the universe as Shesha, filled with great joy.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: य एव विष्णु: सोऽनन्तो भगवान् वसुधाधरः । यो राम: स हृषीकेशो योऽच्युतः स धराधरः॥
en: He is Vishnu, He is the illustrious Ananta. He is the supporter of the Earth. He who is Rama is Hrishikesha. He who is Achyuta is Ananta the bearer of the Earth.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ दिव्यौ दिव्यपराक्रमौ। द्रष्टव्यौ माननीयौ च चक्रलाङ्गलधारिणौ॥
en: Both of those foremost of all creatures are celestial and gifted with divine prows. One of them is armed with the discus and the other with the plough. They deserve every honour and should be seen.

description: Religion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एप बोऽनुग्रहः प्रोक्तो मया पुण्यस्तपोधनाः। यद् भवन्तो यदुश्रेष्ठं पूजयेयुः प्रयत्नतः॥
en: I have, through my kindness for you, have thus described to you the nature of Vasudeva. This you ascetics having penances for wealth. is Virtue. I have described all this to you so that you may, with respect and care, adore Krishna, that Foremost One of Yadu's race.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: नारद उवाच अथ व्योम्नि महाञ्छब्दः सविद्युत्स्तनयित्नुमान्। मेघैश्च गगनं नीलं संरुद्धमभवद् घनैः॥
en: Narada said At the conclusion of Mahadeva's speech, loud roars were heard in the sky. Thunders bellowed, with flashes of lightning. The sky was covered with blue and thick clouds.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: प्रावृषीव च पर्जन्यो ववृषो निर्मलं पयः। तमश्चैवाभवद् घोरं दिशश्च न चकाशिरे॥
en: The god of the clouds then poured pure water like to what he does in the season of rains. A thick darkness appeared. The cardinal points could no longer be made out.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ततो देवगिरौ तस्मिन् रम्ये पुण्ये सनातने। न शर्वं भूतसंधं वा ददृशुर्मुनयस्तदा॥
en: Then on that charming, sacred and eternal breast of that celestial, celestial, mountain, the assembled Rishis no longer saw the ghostly beings who associate with Mahadeva.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: व्यभ्रं च गगनं सद्यः क्षणेन समपद्यता तीर्थयात्रां ततो विप्रा जग्मुश्चान्ये यथागतम्॥
en: Soon, however, the sky cleared. Some of the Rishis started for the sacred waters, Others returned whence they came.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तदद्भुतमचिन्त्यं च दृष्ट्वा ते विस्मिताऽभवन्। शङ्करस्योमया साधू संवादं त्वत्कथाश्रयम्॥
en: Seeing that wonderful and inconceivable spectacle, they become filled with surprise. They had heard the discourse, too, between Shankara and Uma with the same feelings.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: स भवान् पुरुषव्याघ्र ब्रह्मभूतः सनातनः। यदर्थमनुशिष्टाः स्मो गिरिपृष्ठे महात्मना॥
en: Tliat Foremost of all Beings, of whom the great Shankara spoke to us on that mountain, are You. You are at one with Eternal Brahma.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: द्वितीयं त्वद्धतमिदं त्वत्तेजः कृतमद्य वै। दृष्ट्वा च विस्मिताः कृष्ण सा च नः स्मृतिरागता।॥
en: Sometime before, Mahadeva burnt Himavat with his energy. You have shown us a similar wonderful spectacle. Indeed, we remember that by what we have seen today.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतत् ते देवदेवस्य माहात्म्यं कथितं प्रभो। कपर्दिनो गिरीशस्य महाबाहो जनार्दन॥
en: O Mighty-armed Janardana, I have thus, O Powerful One, recited to You the glory of that God of gods, viz., Him that is called Kapardin or Girisha.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः स तदा कृष्णस्तपोवननिवासिभिः। मानयामास तान् सर्वानृषीन् देवकिनन्दनः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by those hermits' Krishna, the delighter of Devaki, paid due honors to all those Rishis.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अथर्षयः सम्प्रहृष्टाः पुनस्ते कृष्णमब्रुवन्। पुनः पुनः दर्शयास्मान् सदैव मधुसूदन॥
en: Filled with joy, those Rishis once more addressed Krishna, saying, O Destroyer of Madhu, do you repeatedly show yourself to us at all times.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न हि नः सा रतिः स्वर्गे या च त्वदर्शने विभो। तदृतं च महाबाहो यदाह भगवान् भवः॥
en: 0 Powerful One, Heaven itself cannot rejoice us so much as a sight of Yourself. Everything that was said by the illustrious Bhava is true.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं रहस्यमरिकर्शन। त्वमेव ार्थतत्त्वज्ञः पृष्टोऽस्मान् पृच्छसे यदा॥ तदस्माभिरिदं गुह्यं त्वत्प्रियार्थमुदाहृतम्। न च तेऽविदितं किंचित्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते॥
en: O Crusher of enemies, we have told you all about that mystery. You are yourself acquainted with the truth of every subject. Since, however, asked by us; You were kind enough to ask us in return, we have, therefore, recited everything to You for only pleasing You. There is nothing in the three worlds that You do not know.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: जन्म चैव प्रसूतिश्च यच्चान्यत् कारणं विभो। वयं तु बहुचापल्यादशक्ता गुह्यधारणे॥
en: You are fully acquainted with the birth and origin of all things, indeed, with everything that works as a cause. On account of the lightness of our character, we cannot keep close any mystery.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ततः स्थिते त्वयि विभो लघुत्वात् प्रलपामहे। न हि किंचित् तदाश्चर्यं यन्न वेत्ति भवानिह॥
en: Indeed, in Your presence, O Powerful One, we indulge in incoherencies from the lightness of our hearts. There is no wonderful thing which You do not know.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दिवि वा भुवि वा देव सर्वे हि विदितं तव। साधयाम वयं कृष्ण बुद्धिं पृष्टिमवाप्नुहि॥
en: You know whatever is on Earth, and whatever is in the celestial region. We take our leave of You, O Krishna, for returning to our respective quarters. May You increase in intelligence and prosperity.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पुत्रस्ते सदृशस्तात विशिष्टो वा भविष्यति। महाप्रभावसंयुक्तो दीप्तिकीर्तिकरः प्रभुः॥
en: O Sire, You will soon get a son after you or even more distinguished than Yourself. He will be gifted with great energy and splendour. He will achieve great feats, and become possessed of power as great as Yours.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: भीष्म उवाच ततः प्रणम्य देवेशं यादवं पुरुषोत्तमम्। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य प्रजग्मुस्ते महर्षयः॥
en: Bhishma said After this, the great Rishis bowed to that God of gods, that scion of Yadu's race, that Foremost of all Beings. They then went round Him and taking His leave, departed.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सोऽयं नारायणः श्रीमान् दीप्त्या परमया युतः। व्रतं यथावत् तच्चीवा॑ द्वारकां पुनरागमत्॥
en: As regards Narayana, who is gifted with prosperity and blazing effulgence, He returned to Dwaraka after having duly observed that vow of His.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: पूर्णे च दशमे मासि पुत्रोऽस्य परमाद्भतुतः। रुक्मिण्यां सम्मतो यज्ञे शूरो वंशधरः प्रभो॥
en: His wife Rukmini conceived, and on the expiration of the tenth month a son was born of her, gifted with heroism and honoured by all for his highly wonderful accomplishments.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कामः सर्वभूतानां सर्वभावगतो नृप। असुराणां सुराणां च चरत्यन्तर्गतः सदा॥
en: He is at one with that Kama (Desire) which exists in every creature and which pervades every condition. Indeed, he moves within the hearts of both gods and demons.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सोऽयं पुरुषशार्दूलो मेघवर्णश्रुतुर्भुजः। संश्रितः पाण्डवान् प्रेम्णा भवन्तश्चैनमाश्रिताः॥
en: This Krishna is that foremost of all persons. He gifted with the complexion of the clouds is that four-handed Vasudeva. Through affection He has taken up the cause of the Pandavas, and you also, you sons of Pandu, have attached yourselves to Him.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कीर्तिर्लक्ष्मीकृतिश्चैव स्वर्गमार्गस्तथैव च। यत्रैष संस्थितस्तत्र देवो विष्णुस्त्रिविक्रमः॥
en: Achievements, Prosperity, Intelligence, and the Path that leads to the celestial region, are all there where this One, viz., the Illustrious Vishnu of three steps, is.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सेन्द्रा देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशदेष नात्र विचारणा। आदिदेवो महादेवः सर्वभूतप्रतिश्रयः॥
en: He is the thirty-three gods headed by Indra. There is no doubt in this. He is the one Ancient God. He is the Foremost of all gods. He is the refuge of all creatures.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अनादिनिधनोऽव्यक्तो महात्मा मधुसूदनः। अयं जातो महातेजाः सुराणामर्थसिद्धये।॥
en: He is without beginning and without destruction. He is unmanifest. He is the great Destroyer of Madhu. Gifted with mighty energy, He has taken birth (among men) for doing the purposes of the gods.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: सुदुस्तरार्थतत्त्वस्य वक्ता कर्ता च माधवः। तव पार्थ जयः कृत्स्त्रस्तव कीर्तिस्तथातुला॥ तवेय पृथिवी देवी कृत्स्त्रा नारायणाश्रयात्।
en: This Madhava is the expounder of the most difficult truths about Profit or Wealth, and He is also their achiever. O son of Pritha, the victory you have got over your enemies, your peerless achievements, the dominion you have acquired over the whole Earth, are all owing to having Narayana espoused your cause.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अयं नाथस्तवाचिन्त्यो यस्य नारायणो गतिः॥ स भवांस्त्वमुपाध्व! रणाग्नौ हुतवान् नृपान्। कृष्णस्तुवेण महत्ता युगान्ताग्निसमेत वै॥
en: The fact of your having got the inconceivable Narayana for your protector and refuge, enabled you to become an Adhvaryu (chief sacrificer) for pouring multitudes of kings as libations on the burning fire of battle. This Krishna was your great sacrificial ladle resembling the all-destroying fire which appears at the end of the cycle.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दुर्योधनश्च शोच्योऽसौ सपुत्रभ्रातृबान्धवः। कृतवान् योऽबुधिः क्रोधाद्धरिगाण्डीविविग्रहम्॥
en: Duryodhana, with his sons, brothers and kinsmen, was much to be pitied inasmuch as, moved by anger, he made war with Hari and the wielder of Gandiva.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दैतेया दानवेन्द्राश्च महाकाया महाबलाः। चक्राग्नौ क्षयमापन्ना दावाग्नौ शलभा इव।॥
en: Many sons of Diti, many foremost of Danavas, of huge bodies and vast strength, have died in the fire of Krishna's discus like insects in a forest fire.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: प्रतियाटुं न शक्यो हि मानुषैरेष संयुगे। विहीनैः पुरुषव्याघ्र सत्त्वशक्तिबलादिभिः॥
en: How incapable then must human beings be of fighting against that Krishna, human beings who, O foremost of men, are shorn of strength and power.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: जयो योगी युगान्ताभः सव्यसाची रणाग्रगः! तेजसा हतवान् सर्वे सुयोधनबलं नृप॥
en: As regards Jaya, he is a powerful Yogin resembling the all-destroying cyclefire in energy. Capable of drawing the bow equally with both hands, he is always in the van of fight. With his energy, O king, he has killed all the soldiers of Suyodhana.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यत् तु गोवृषभांकेन मुनिभ्यः समुदाहृतम्। पुराणं हिमवत्पृष्ठे तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥
en: Listen to me as I tell you what Mahadeva having the bovine bull for the emblem on his standard had recited to the ascetics on the breast of Himavat. His utterances form a Purana.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: यावत् तस्य भवेत् पुष्टिस्तेजो दीप्तिः पराक्रमः। प्रभावः सन्नतिर्जन्म कृष्णे तन्त्रिगुणं विभो॥
en: The advancement or greatness, energy, strength, prowess, power, humility, and family that are in Arjuna can form only a third part of the attributes of Krishna.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कः शक्रोत्यन्यथाकर्तुं तद् यदि स्यात् तथा शृणु। यत्र कृष्णो हि भगवांस्तत्र पुष्टिरनुत्तमा॥
en: Who is there who can transcend Krishna in these attributes? Whether that is possible or not, listen. Peerless Excellence prevails where the illustrious Krishna is.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वयं त्विहाल्पमतयः परतन्त्रा सुविक्लवाः। ज्ञानपूर्वं प्रपन्नाः स्मो मृत्योः पन्थानमव्ययम्॥
en: As for ourselves we are persons of little understanding. Dependent upon the will of others, we are highly unfortunate. Knowingly we betook ourselves to the eternal path of death.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: भवांश्चाप्याजवपरः पूर्वं कृत्वा प्रतिश्रयम्। राजवृत्तं न लभते प्रतिज्ञापालने रतः॥
en: You, however, are devoted to sincerity of conduct. Having formerly promised not to take your kingdom, you did not take it, desirous of keeping your promise.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: अप्येवात्मवधं लोके राजंस्त्वं बहु मन्यसे। न हि प्रतिज्ञा या दत्ता तां प्रहातुमरिंदम॥
en: 0 king, you make too much of the destruction of your kinsmen and friends in battle. You should remember, however, O chastiser of enemies, that it is not fair to break a promise.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कालेनायं जनः सर्वो निहतो रणमूर्धनि। वयं च कालेन हताः कालो हि परमेश्वरः॥
en: All those who have fallen on the field of battlc have really been killed by Time. Indeed, all of us have been killed by Time. Time is indeed, all powerful.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न हि कालेन कालज्ञः स्पृष्टः शोचितुमर्हसि। कालो लोहितरक्ताक्षः कृष्णो दण्डी सनातनः॥
en: You are fully acquainted with the power of Time. Afflicted by time you should not grieve. Know that Krishna Himself otherwise called Hari, is that Time with bloodred eyes and with club in hand.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तस्मात् कुन्तीसुत ज्ञातीन् नेह शोचितुमर्हसि। व्यपेतमन्युर्नित्यं त्वं भव कौरवनन्दन॥
en: For these reasons, O son of Kunti, you should not grieve for your (slain) kinsfolk. Be always free, O delighter of the Kurus, from grief.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: माधवस्यास्य माहात्म्यं श्रुतं यत् कथितं मया। तदेव तावत् पर्याप्तं सज्जनस्य निदर्शनम्॥
en: You have heard me sing the glory and greatness of Madhava. That is sufficient for making a good man understand Him.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: व्यासस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा नारदस्य च धीमतः। स्वयं चैव महाराज कृष्णस्याहतामस्य वै॥
en: Having heard the words of Vyasa, as also of the highly intelligent Narada, I have described to you the adorableness of Krishna. I have myself added, from my own knowledge, something to that account.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: प्रभावश्चर्षिपूगस्य कथितः सुमहान् मया। महेश्वरस्य संवादं शैलपुत्र्याश्च भारत॥
en: Indeed, I have described also on the Surpassing Power of Krishna as recited by Mahadeva, to that assembly of Rishis. I have also described to you the discourse too between Maheshvara and the daughter of Himavat, O Bharata.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: धारयिष्यति यश्चैनं महापुरुषसम्भवम्। शृणुयात् कथयेद् वा यः स श्रेयो लभते परम्॥
en: He who will remember that discourse when coming out from a foremost person, he who will listen to it, and he who will recite it, is sure to acquire what is highly beneficial.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: भवितारश्च तस्याथ सर्वे कामा यथेप्सिताः। प्रेत्य स्वर्गं च लभते नरो नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: That man will find all his wishes fulfilled, Departing from this world he will ascend to the celestial region. There is no doubt in this.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: न्याय्यं श्रेयोऽभिकामेन प्रतिपत्तुं जनार्दनः। एष एवाक्षयो विप्रैः स्तुतो राजन् जनार्दनः॥
en: That man who wishes to obtain what is beneficial for himself, should devote himself to Janardana.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: महेश्वरमुखोत्सृष्टा ये च धर्मगुणाः स्मृताः। ते त्वया मनसा धार्याः कुरुराज दिवानिशम्॥
en: O king of the Kurus, you should also remember those incidents of duty and virtue which were declared by Maheshvara.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एवं ते वर्तमानस्य सम्यग्दण्डधरस्य च। प्रजापालनदक्षस्य स्वर्गलोको भविष्यति॥
en: If you act according to those precepts, if you carry the rod of punishment rightly, if you protect your subjects properly, you may be sure of attaining to the celestial.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: धर्मेणापि सदा राजन् प्रजा रक्षितुमर्हसि। यस्तस्य विपुलो दण्डः सम्यग्धर्मः स कीर्त्यते॥
en: You should, O king, protect your subjects always according to the dictates of virtue. The strong rod of punishment which the kings bear has been said to be the embodiment of his virtue or merit.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: य एष कथितो राजन् मया सज्जनसंनिधौ। शङ्करस्योमया सार्धं संवादो धर्मसंहितः॥
en: Hearing this discourse, fraught with righteousness, between Shankara and Uma, that I have recited before this pious assemblage, one should adore with respect that god having the bull for the device on his banner.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: श्रुत्वा वा श्रोतुकामो वाप्यर्चयेद् वृषभध्वजम्। विशुद्धेनेह भावेन य इच्छेद् भूतिमात्मनः॥
en: One who becomes even becomes even desirous of listening to that discourse, should adore Mahadeva with respect. Indeed, the person who wishes to obtain what is beneficial for him, should worship Mahadeva with a pure hcart.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एष तस्यानवद्यस्य नारदस्य महात्मनः। संदेशो देवपूजार्थं तं तथा कुरु पाण्डव॥
en: This is the behest of the sinless and highsouled Narada. He has commanded such adoration of the great god. O son of Pandu, do you obey that command of Narada.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: एतदत्यद्रुतं वृत्तं पुण्ये हि भवति प्रभो। वासुदेवस्य कौन्तेय स्थाणोश्चैव स्वभावजम्॥
en: O powerful king, these are the wonderful incidents which took place on the sacred breast of Himavat about Vasudeva and Sthani, son of Kunti. Those events emanated from the very nature of those great deities.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दशवर्षसहस्त्राणि बदर्यामेष शाश्वतः। तपश्चचार विपुलं सह गाण्डीवधन्त्रना॥
en: Accompanied by the holder of Gandiva, Vasudeva practised eternal penances in the hermitage of Badari for ten thousand years.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: त्रियुगौ पुण्डरीकाक्षौ वासुदेवधनञ्जयौ। विदितौ नारदादेतौ मम व्यासाञ्ज पार्थिव॥
en: Indeed, Vasudeva and Dhananjaya, having like lotus petals, practised severe austerities for three entire cycles. I have learnt this from Narada and Vyasa, O king.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: बाल एव महाबाहुश्चकार कदनं महत्। कंसस्य पुण्डरीकाक्षो ज्ञातित्राणार्थकारणात्॥
en: The lotus-eyed and mighty-armed Vasudeva, while yet a child performed the great feat of killing Kansa for the relief of his kinsmen. eyes like

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: कर्मणामस्य कौन्तेय नान्तं संख्यातुमुत्सहे। शाश्वतस्य पुराणस्य पुरुषस्य युधिष्ठिर॥
en: I dare not, O son of Kunti, enumerate the feats of this Ancient and Eternal Being, O Yudhishthira.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ध्रुवं श्रेयः परं तात भविष्यति तवोत्तमम्। यस्य ते पुरुषव्याघ्रः सखा चायं जनार्दनः॥
en: O son, Forsooth, high and great benefits will be reaped by you who have that foremost of all persons, viz., Vasudeva, for your friend.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दुर्योधनं तु शोचामि प्रेत्य लोकेऽपि दुर्मतिम्। यत्कृते पृथिवी सर्वा विनष्टा सहयद्विपा॥
en: I gricve for the wicked Duryodhana about even the next world to which he has gone. It was for him that the entire Earth has been depopulated with her horses and elephants.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: दुर्योधनापराधेन कर्णस्य शकुनेस्तथा। दुःशासनचतुर्थानां कुरवो निधनं गताः॥
en: Indeed, through the fault of Duryodhana, of Karna, of Shakuni, and of Dushasana as the fourthi, that the Kurus have died.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं सम्भाषमाणे तु गाङ्गेये पुरुषर्षभे। तूष्णीं बभूव कौरव्यो मध्ये तेषां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said While that foremost of men, viz., the son of Ganga, spoke to him thus, the Kuru king (Yudhishthira) remained entirely silent in the midst of those great persons.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: तच्छ्रुत्वा विस्मयं जग्मुर्धृतराष्ट्रादयो नृपाः। सम्पूज्य मनसा कृष्णं सर्वे प्राञ्जलयोऽभवन्॥
en: All the kings with Dhritarashtra amongst thein become stricken with wonder upon hearing the words of the Kuru grandfather. In their minds they adored Krishna and then turned towards him with hands clasped in respect.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: ऋषयश्चापि ते सर्वे नारदप्रमुखास्तदा। प्रतिगृह्याभ्यनन्दन्त तद्वाक्यं प्रतिपूज्य च॥
en: The Rishis also headed by Narada, accepted and highly spoke of the words of Bhishma and approved of them joyfully.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: इत्येतदखिलं सर्वैः पाण्डवो भ्रातृभिः सह। श्रुतवान् सुमहाश्चर्यं पुण्यं भीष्मानुशासनम्॥
en: These were the wonderful subjects recited by Bhishma which Yudhishthira with all his brothers heard with joy.

description: Rcligion and profit, which bring on happiness in the next world. The history of Rudra and Uma
sn: युधिष्ठिरस्तु गाङ्गेयं विश्रान्तं भूरिदक्षिणम्। पुनरेव महाबुद्धिः पर्यपृच्छन्महीपतिः॥
en: Sometime after, when king Yudhishthira saw that Bhishma who had given away profuse riches as presents to the Brahmanas in the sacrifices celebrated by him, had rested and become refreshed, the intelligent king once inore asked him as follows.

description: An account of the one God
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा धर्मानशेषेण पावनानि च सर्वशः। युधिष्ठिरः शान्तनवं पुनरेवाभ्यभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard all the duties in full and all those sacred deeds and objects which purify human beings of their sins, Yudhishthira once inore addressed the son of Shantanu in the following words.

description: An account of the one God
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किमेकं दैवतं लोके किं वाप्येकं परायणम्। स्तुवन्तः कं कमर्चन्तः प्राप्नुयुर्मानवाः शुभम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Who may be said to be the One God in the world? Who may be said to be the One Object which is our only refuge? Who is He by adoring whom or singing whose praises human beings would get what is beneficial?

description: An account of the one God
sn: को धर्मः सर्वधर्माणां भवतः परमो मतः। किं जपन् मुच्यते जन्तुर्जन्मसंसारबन्धनात्॥
en: What religion is that which, according to your judgment, is the foremost of all religions? What are those Mantras by reciting which a living creature becomes freed from the fetters of birth and life?

description: An account of the one God
sn: भीष्म उवाच जगत्प्रभुं देवदेवमनन्तं पुरुषोत्तमम्। स्तुवन् नामसहस्त्रेण पुरुषः सततोत्थितः॥
en: Bhishma said One should always, diligently and throwing away all idleness, sing the praises of that Lord of the universe, that God of gods, (viz., Vasudeva), who is Infinite and the foremost of all Beings, by uttering His thousand names.

description: An account of the one God
sn: तमेव चार्चयन् नित्यं भक्त्या पुरुषमव्ययम्। ध्यायन् स्तुवन् नमस्यंश्च यजमानस्तमेव च॥ अनादिनिधनं विष्णुं सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्। लोकाध्यक्षं स्तुवन् नित्यं सर्वदुःखातिगो भवेत्॥
en: By always adoring with respect and devotion that immutable Being, by meditating on Him, by singing His praises, and bowing the head to Him, and by celebrating sacrifices to Him, indeed, by always praising Vishnu, who is without beginning and without end or destruction, who is the Supreme Lord of all the worlds, and who is the Master and Controller of the universe, one can succeed in getting over all sorrow.

description: An account of the one God
sn: ब्रह्मण्यं सर्वधर्मज्ञं लोकानां कीर्तिवर्धनम्। लोकनाथं महद्भूतं सर्वभूतभवोद्भवम्॥
en: Indeed, He is devoted to the Brahmanas, knowing all duties and practices, the enhancer of the fame and achievements of all persons, the Lord of all the worlds, highly wonderful, and the prime cause of the origin of all creatures.

description: An account of the one God
sn: एष मे सर्वधर्माणां धर्मोऽधिकतमो मतः। यद्भक्त्या पुण्डरीकाक्षं स्तवैरर्चेन्नरः सदा॥
en: This, in my judgment, is the foremost religion of all religions, viz., one should always adore and sing the praises of the lotus-eyed Vasudeva with devotion.

description: An account of the one God
sn: परमं यो महत्तेजः परमं यो महत्तपः। परमं यो महदब्रह्म परमं यः परायणम्॥
en: He is the highest Energy. He is the highest Penance. He is the highest Brahma. He is the highest Refuge.

description: An account of the one God
sn: पवित्राणां पवित्र यो मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम्। दैवतं देवतानां च भूतानां योऽव्ययः पिता॥
en: He is the most Holy of all holies, the most sacred of all sacred objects. He is the God of all the gods, and He is the immutabie Father of all creatures.

description: An account of the one God
sn: यतः सर्वाणि भूतानि भवन्त्यादियुगागमे। यस्मिंश्च प्रलयं यान्ति पुनरेव युगक्षये॥११॥
en: On the advent of the primitive cycle, all creatures originate from Him. On the expiration, again of the cycle, all things disappear in Him.

description: An account of the one God
sn: तस्य लोकप्रधानस्य जगन्नाथस्य भूपते। विष्णोर्नामसहस्रं मे शृणु पापभयापहम्॥
en: Hear, O king, the thousand names, highly efficacious in dissipating sins, of that Foremost One in all the worlds, that Master of the universe, viz., Vishnu.

description: An account of the one God
sn: यानि नामानि गौणानि विख्यातानि महात्मनः। ऋषिभिः परिगीतानि तानि वक्ष्यामि भूतये॥
en: All those names, derived from His attributes, secret and wellknown, of the great Vasudeva, which were sung by the Rishis, I shall recite to you for the good of all.

description: An account of the one God
sn: ॐ विश्वं विष्णुर्वषट्कारो भूतभव्यभवत्प्रभुः। भूतकद् भूतभृद् भावो भूतात्मा भूतभावनः॥
en: They are, Om! He who enters all things besides Himself. He who covers all things, He to whom sacrificial libations are poured, the Lord of the Past, the Present, and the Future, the Creator (or Destroyer) of all existent things, the preserver of all existent things, the Existent, the Soul of all things, the Originator of all things. (1-9)

description: An account of the one God
sn: पूतात्मा परमात्मा च मुक्तानां परमा गतिः। अव्ययः पुरुषः साक्षी क्षेत्रज्ञोऽक्षर एव च॥
en: Of purified Soul, the Supreme Soul the Highest Refuge of all liberated persons, the Immutable, He who lies enclosed in a case, the Witness. He who knows the material case in which He lives, the Indestructible. (10-17)

description: An account of the one God
sn: योगो योगनिवदां नेता प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरः। नारसिंहवपुः श्रीमान् केशवः पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: He upon whom the mind rests during Yogameditation, the Guide or leader of all persons conversant with Yoga, the Lord of both Pradhana or Prakriti and Purusha. He who assumed a human form with a leonine head, He of beautiful features and equipments, He of beautiful hair, the foremost of Purushas. (1824)

description: An account of the one God
sn: सर्वः सर्वः शिवः स्थाणुर्भूतादिनिधिरव्ययः। सम्भवो भावनो भर्ता प्रभवः प्रभुरीश्वरः॥
en: The embodiment of all things, the Destroyer of all things. He who transcends the three qualities of Goodness, Darkness, and Ignorance, the Motionless, the Beginning of all things, the source into which all things go at the universal Dissolution, the Immutable, He who takes birth at his own will. He who causes the acts of all living creatures to fructify, the Upholder of all things, the Source from which the primal elements have originated, the Powerful One. He in whom exists the unbounded Lordship over all things; (25-36)

description: An account of the one God
sn: स्वयम्भूः शम्भुरादित्यः पुष्कराक्षो महास्वनः। अनादिनिधनो धाता विधाता धातुरुत्तमः॥
en: The SelfCreate, He who gives happiness to His worshippers, the presiding Genius in the midst of the Solar disc, the LotusEyed. the LoudVoiced, He who is without beginning and without end, He who upholds the universe, he who ordains all deeds and their fruits, He who is superior to the Grandfather Brahman; (3745)

description: An account of the one God
sn: अप्रमेयो हृषीकेशः पद्मनाभोऽमरप्रभुः। अनादिनिधनो धाता विधाता धातुरुत्तमः ॥
en: The Immeasurable, the Lord of the senses. He from whose navel the primeval lotus originated, the Lord of all the celestials, the Divine Architect, the Mantra. He who weakens or emaciates all things. He who is vast, the Ancient One, He who is enduring. (46-54)

description: An account of the one God
sn: अग्राह्यः शाश्वत: कृष्णो लोहिताक्षः प्रतर्दनः। प्रभूतस्त्रिककुब्धाम पवित्रं मङ्गलं परम्॥
en: He who is incapable of being apprehended (by either the senses or the mind), the Eternal One, Krishna, the RedEyed. He who kills all creatures at the time of the universal dissolution. He who is vast for knowledge and power and other attributes of thic kind. He who resides in three parts of every creature. That which cleanses, is auspicious and high. (55-63)

description: An account of the one God
sn: ईशानः प्राणदः प्राणो ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठः प्रजापतिः। हिरण्यगर्भो भूगर्भो माधवो मधुसूदनः॥
en: He who urges all creatures in their acts. He who makes the vital airs work. He who causes all living creatures to live, the Eldest, the Foremost of all those who are considered as the Lords of all creatures. He who has gold in his abdomen, He who has the Earth for his abdomen, the Lord of Shree or Lakshini, the Destroyer of Madhu. (64-73)

description: An account of the one God
sn: ईश्वरो विक्रमी धन्वी मेधावी विक्रमः क्रमः। अनुत्तमो दुराधर्षः कृतज्ञः कृतिरात्मवान्॥
en: The Omnipotent, He who is endued with great prowess. He who is armed with the bow. He who is possessed of a mind capable of understanding all treatises. He who roves through the universe, riding on Garuda. He who is well suited to the offerings made to him and who has the power to enjoy them properly, the peerless. He who is incapable of being discomfited. He who knows all acts that are done. He who is at one with all deeds. He who rests on His own true self. (74-84)

description: An account of the one God
sn: सुरेशः शरणं शर्म विश्वरेता: प्रजाभवः। अहः संवत्सरो व्यालः प्रत्ययः सर्वदर्शनः॥
en: The Lord of all the celestials. He who is the Refuge of all, the embodiment of the highest happiness. He whose seed is the universe. He who is the source of all things, the Day, the Year, the Snake, the embodiment of Conviction. He who sees all things; (85-94)

description: An account of the one God
sn: अजः सर्वेश्वरः सिद्धः सिद्धिः सर्वादि: अच्युतः । वृषाकपि: अमेयात्मा सर्व-योग-विनिःसृतः ॥
en: The Unborn, the Lord of all creatures, He who has acquired success. He who is Success itself. He who is the beginning of all things. He who is above deterioration. He who is virtue in the form of the bull and the great boar that raised the submerged Earth. He who is of immeasurable soul. He who stands aloof from all kinds of union ; (95-103)

description: An account of the one God
sn: वसुर्वसुमनाः सत्यः समात्मा सम्पितः समः। अमोघः पुण्डरीकाक्षो वृषाकर्मा वृषकृतिः॥
en: He who is Pavaka among the deities called Vasus, He that is of liberal soul, being shorn of anger, hatred, pride and other evil passions. Truth. He is whose soul is equable on account of His perfect impartiality. He who has been measured by His adorers. He who is always equal, being above all change or modification. He who never refuses to grant the wishes of His adorers. He whose eyes are like lotus petals. He whose deeds are always marked by Virtue; (104-113)

description: An account of the one God
sn: रुद्रो बहुशिरा बभुर्विश्वयोनिः शुचिश्रवाः। अमृतः शाश्वतस्थाणुर्वरारोहो महातपाः॥
en: He who destroys all creatures, the Manyheaded, He who upholds the universe. He who is the source of the universe. He who is of pure or spotless reputation, the Immortal One, He who is Eternal and Fixed, He who has beautiful limbs. He who has such knowledge having penance for its mark that He is able to agitate Nature for evolving the universe out of her; (114-122)

description: An account of the one God
sn: सर्वगः सर्वविद्भानुर्विष्वक्सेनो जनार्दनः। वेदो वेदविदव्यङ्गो वेदाङ्गो वेदवित् कविः॥
en: He who goes everywhere, the Omniscient One. He who shines forth in unmodified effulgence, He whose troops are everywhere. He who is coveted by all, He who is the Veda, He who is conversant with the Veda, Ho who is conversant with all the branches of the Veda. He who represents the branches of the Veda. He who settles the interpretations of the Vedas. He who has no superior in wisdom; (123-132)

description: An account of the one God
sn: लोकाध्यक्षः सुराध्यक्षो धर्माध्यक्षः कृता-कृतः । चतुरात्मा चतुर्व्यूह: चतुर्दंष्ट्र: चतुर्भुजः ॥
en: He who is the Master of all the worlds. He who is the Lord of the celestials. He who is the Supervisor of both Virtue and Sin. He who is both Effect and Cause. He who is foursouled. He who is known by four forms (as above). He who has four horns. He who has four arms; (133-140)

description: An account of the one God
sn: भ्राजिष्णुर्भोजनं भोक्ता सहिष्णुर्जगदादिजः। अनघो विजयो नेता विश्वयोनिः पुनर्वसुः॥
en: He who shines forth in effulgence. He who is the giver of food and cherishes the good. He who does not put up with those that are wicked. (or He who puts up with the occasional transgressions of his devotees). He who existed before the universe came into life; He who is stainless. He who is ever victorious. He who defeats the very celestials. He who is the material cause of the universe. He who repeatedly Lives in material causes; (141-150)

description: An account of the one God
sn: उपेन्द्रो वामनः प्रांशुरमोघः शुचिरूर्जितः। अतींद्रः संग्रहः सर्गो धृतात्मा नियमो यमः ॥
en: He who is the younger brother of Indra. He who took birth as a dwarf, He who is tall. He whose acts are never futile. He who cleanses. He who is gifted with preeminent energy and strength. He who transcends Indra in all attributes. He who accepts all His worshippers. He who is the Creation itself on account of His being the Causes thereof. He who upholds His self in the same form without being ever subject to birth, growth, or death. He who sustains all creatures in creatures in their respective functions in the universe. He who controls the hearts of all creatures; (151-162)

description: An account of the one God
sn: वेद्यो वैद्यः सदायोगी वीरहा माधवो मधुः। अति-इंद्रियो महामायो महोत्साहो महाबलः ॥
en: He who is worthy of being known by those who wish to acquire what is for their highest good. He who is the celestial physician in the form of Dhanvantari. He who is always engaged in Yoga. He who kills great Asuras for establishing virtue. He who is the Lord of that Lakshmi who originated from the ocean when it was churned by the celestials and the Asuras. He who is honey. He who is above the senses. He who is gifted with great powers of illusion. He who displays great energy. He who transcends all in energy. (163-172)

description: An account of the one God
sn: महाबुद्धिर्महावीर्यो महाशक्तिर्महाद्युतिः। अनिर्देश्यवपुः श्रीमानमेयात्मा महाद्रिधृत्॥
en: He who transcends all in intelligence. He who transcends all in power. He who transcends all in ability. He who discovers the universe by the effulgence coming out from His body. He whose body is incapable of being seen by the eye. He who is gifted with every beauty. He whose soul is incapable of being comprehended by either the celestials or the mortals. He who held on His back. in the form of the vast tortoise, the huge mountain. Mandara, which was made the churning rod by the celestials and the Asuras when they began to churn the great ocean for getting therefrom all the valuables hid in his bosom. (173-180)

description: An account of the one God
sn: महेष्वासो महीभर्ता श्रीनिवासः सतां गतिः। अनिरुद्धः सुरानन्दो गोविन्दो गोविदां-पतिः ॥
en: He who can shoot His arrows to a great distance, piercing through obstructions of every sort. He who raised the submerged Earth, having assumed the forn of the powerfull Boar. He on whose bosom lives the goddess of Prosperity. He who is the Refuge of the pious. He who is incapable of being won without thorough devotion. He who is the delight of the celestials. He who rescued the submerged Earth. He who is the Master of all cloquent persons. (181-188);

description: An account of the one God
sn: मरीचिर्दमनो हंसः सुपर्णो भुजगोत्तमः। हिरण्यनाभः सुतपाः पद्मनाभः प्रजापतिः॥
en: He who is full of blazing effulgence. He who removed the afflictions of His adorers. He who assumed the form of a Swan for communicating the Vedas to the Grandfather Brahman. He who has Garuda, the prince of birds for his vehicle. He who is the foremost of snakes on account of His identity with Shesha or Ananta who upholds on his head the vast Earth. He whose navel is as beautiful as gold; He who practised the severest austerities in the form of Narayana at Badari on the breast of Himavat. He whose navel resembles a lotus. He who is the Lord of all creatures. (189-197)

description: An account of the one God
sn: अमृत्युः सर्वदृक् सिंहः संधाता सन्धिमास्थिरः। अजो दुर्मर्षणः शास्ता विश्रुतात्मा सुरारिहा॥
en: He who transcends death. He who always casts a kind eye on His worshippers, He who destroys all things, He who is the Ordainer of all ordainers. He who Himself enjoys and suffers the fruits of all deeds. He who assumed the form of Rama the son of Dasharatha and going into a exile at the command of his father made a treaty with Sugriva the king of the Vanaras for helping Him in the recovery of his kingdom from the grasp of his elder brother Bali in return for the help which Sugriva promised Him for recovering from Ravana His wife Sita who had been carried away by that Rakshasa to his island home in Lanka. He who is always of the same form. He who is always moving. He who is incapable of being endured by Danavas and Asuras. He who punishes the wicked. He whose soul has true knowledge for its mark. He who destroys the enemies of the celestials (198-208)

description: An account of the one God
sn: गुरुर्गुरुतमो धाम सत्यः सत्यपराक्रमः। निमिषो अनिमिषः स्रग्वी वाचस्पति: उदारधीः ॥
en: He who is the instructor in all sciences and the father of all. He who is the instructor of even the Grandfather Brahman. He who is the abode or resting place of all creatures. He who is the benefactor of the good and is free from falsehood. He whose prowess is incapable of being thwarted. He who never casts his eye on such acts as are not sanctioned or approved by the scriptures. He who casts his eye on such acts as are sanctioned or approved by the scriptures. He who wears the unfading garland of victory called by the name of Vaijayanti. He who is the Lord of speech and that is possessed of great liberality insomuch that He rescued the lowest of the low and the vilest of the vile by granting them His favour (209-217);

description: An account of the one God
sn: अग्रणीामणीः श्रीमान् न्यायो नेता समीरणः। सहस्रमूर्धा विश्वात्मा सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्॥
en: He who leads persons desirous of Liberation to the foremost of all conditions. viz., Emancipation itself (or, He who assumes the form of a powerful Fish and Passing through the vast expanse of waters that cover the Earth when the universal dissolution sets in and dragging the boat tied to His horns, leads Manu and others to safety. He who is the leader of all creatures (or, He who sports in the vast expanse of waters which cover all things at the universal dissolution). He whose words are Veda and who rescued the Vedas when they were submerged in the waters at the universal dissolution; He who is the accomplisher of all functions in the universe. He who assumes the form of the wind for making all living creatures act or exert. (or, He whose movement are always beautiful, or, who wishes His creatures to glorify Him). He who has a thousand heads. He who is the Soul of the universe and as such pervades all things. He who has a thousand eyes and a thousand legs (218-227);

description: An account of the one God
sn: आवर्तनो निवृत्तात्मा संवृतः सं-प्रमर्दनः । अहः संवर्तको वह्निरनिलो धरणीधरः॥
en: He who causes the wheel of the universe revolve at His will. He whose soul is freed from desire and who is above those conditions which invest the individual soul. He who is concealed from the view of all persons who are attached to the world (or, He who has covered the eyes of all persons with the bandage of Nescience). He who grinds those who turn away from Him. He who sets the days agoing, on account of His being at one with the Sun. He who is the destroyer of alldestroying Time itself. He who conveys the libations poured on the sacred fire to those for whom they are intended. (or, He who bears the universe placing it on only a minutepart of his body). He who has no beginning, (or, He who has no fixed habitation). He that upholds the Earth (in space in the form of Shesha, or rescues her in the form of the powerful boar, or supports her as a subtile pervader) (228-235)

description: An account of the one God
sn: सुप्रसादः प्रसन्नात्मा विश्वधृग् विश्वभुग विभुः। सत्कर्ता सकृतः साधु: जह्नु: नारायणो नरः ॥
en: He who is exceedingly inclined to grace, insomuch that He grants happiness to even enemies like Shishupala; He who has beco? freed from the qualities of goodness. darkness and ignorance so that He is pure or stainless Sattva by itself. (or, He who has obtained the fruition of all His desires). He who supports the universe. He who feeds (or enjoys) the universe. He who is displayed in infinite power. He who honours the celestials. the departed manes, and His own worshippers. He who is honoured or adored by those that are themselves honoured or adored by others. (or, He whose acts are all beautiful and enduring). He who accomplishes the purposes of others. He who withdraws all things unto Himself at the universal dissolution. (or, He who destroys the foes of the celestials of His worshippers). He who has the waters for his home. (or, He who is the sole Refuge of all creatures). or He that destroys the ignorance of all creatures. (236-246)

description: An account of the one God
sn: असंख्येयोऽप्रमेयात्मा विशिष्टः शिष्टकृच्छुचिः। सिद्धार्थः सिद्ध संकल्पः सिद्धिदः सिद्धिसाधनः ॥
en: He who is distinguished above all. He who cherishes the virtuous. He who cleanses all the worlds. He who crowns with fruition the desires of all creatures. He whose wishes are always crowned with fruition. He who gives success to all. He who bestows success upon those who solicit Him for it. (247-255)

description: An account of the one God
sn: वृषाही वृषभो विष्णुर्वृषपवौ वृषोदरः। वर्धनो वर्धमानश्च विविक्तः श्रुतिसागरः॥
en: He who presides over all sacred days. (or, He who overwhelms Indra himself with His own excellent attributes), He who showers all objects of desire upon His worshippers. He or who walks over all the universe. He who offers the excellent flight of steps formed by Virtue. He who has Virtue in His abdomen. (or, He who protects Indra even as a mother protects the child in her womb). He who aggrandises (His worshippers). He who spreads Himself out for becoming the vast universe.
