sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच के पूज्याः के नमस्कार्याः कथं वर्तेते केषु च। किमाचारः कीदृशेषु पितामह न रिष्यते॥
en: Yudhishthira said Who are worthy of being adored? Who are they to whom we should bow? How, Indeed, should we behave towards whom? What course of conduct, O grandfather, towards what classes of persons is considered faultless?

sn: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मणानां परिभवः सादयेदपि देवताः। ब्राह्मणांस्तु नमस्कृत्य युधिष्ठिर न रिष्यते॥
en: Bhishma said The humiliation of Brahmanas would humiliate the very celestials. By bowing to Brahmanas, one does not, O Yudhishthira, commit any fault.

sn: ते पूज्यास्ते नमस्कार्या वर्तेथास्तेषु पुत्रवत्। ते हि लोकानिमान् सर्वान् धारयन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: They, indeed, deserve to be adored. They deserve to have our vows. You should bchave towards them as if they are your sons. Indeed, it is those wise men who upholds all the worlds.

sn: ब्राह्मणा: सर्वलोकानां महान्तो धर्मसेतवः। धनत्यागाभिरामाश्च वाक्संयमरताश्च ये॥
en: The Brahmanas are the great causeways of Virtue about all the worlds. Their happiness consists in renouncing all kinds of riches. They are devoted to the vow of controlling speech.

sn: रमणीयाश्च भूतानां निधानं च धृतव्रताः। प्रणेतारश्च लोकाना शास्त्राणां च यशस्विनः॥
en: They are agreeable to all creatures, and observe various excellent vows. They are the refuge of all creatures in the universe. They are the authors of all the regulations which govern the worlds. They are endued with great fame.

sn: तपो येषा धनं नित्यं वाक् चैव विपुलं बलम्। प्रभवश्चैव धर्माणां धर्माज्ञाः सूक्ष्मदर्शिन॥
en: Penances are always their great riches. Their power consists in speech. Their energy emanates from the duties they observe. Knowing all duties, they are gifted with minute vision, so that they are cognizant of the subtlest consideration.

sn: धर्मकामाः स्थिता धर्मे सुकृतैर्धर्मसेतवः। यान् समाश्रित्य जीवन्ति प्रजाः सर्वाश्चतुर्विधाः॥
en: They are of righteous desires. They live in the observance of welldone duties. They are the causeways of Virtue. The four kinds of living creatures exist, depending upon them as their refuge.

sn: पन्थानः सर्वनेतारो यशवाहाः सनातनाः। पितृपैतामहीं गुर्वीमुद्वहन्ति धुरं सदा॥
en: They are the path or road along which all should go. They are the guides of all. They are the eternal upholders of all the sacrifices. They always upholds the heavy loads of fathers and grandfathers.

sn: धुरि ये नावसीदन्ति विषये सद्गवा इव। पित्रुदेवातिथिमुखा हव्यकव्याग्रभोजिनः॥
en: They never droop under heavy loads even when passing along difficult roads, like strong cattle. They are attentive to the requirements of manes and deities and guests. They are entitles to eat the first portions of Havya and Kavya.

sn: भोजनादेव लोकांस्त्रींस्त्रायन्ते महतो भयात्। दीप: सर्वस्य लोकस्य चक्षुश्चक्षुष्मतामपि॥
en: By the very food they eat, they rescue the three worlds from great feat. They are, as it were, the Island for all worlds. They are the cyes of all persons gifted with sight.

sn: सर्वशिक्षा श्रुतिधना निपुणा मोक्षदर्शिनः। गतिज्ञाः सर्वभूतानामध्यात्मगतिचिन्तिकाः॥
en: The wealth they possess consists of all the branches of knowledge known by the name of Shiksha, and all the Shrutis. Gifted with great skill, they are conversant with the most subtile relations of things. They know the ends of all things, and their thoughts are always engaged upon the science of the soul.

sn: आदिमध्यावसानानां ज्ञातारश्छिन्नसंशयाः। परमावरविशेषज्ञा गन्तारः परमां गतिम्॥
en: They are gifted with the knowledge of the beginning, the middle, and the end of all things, and they are persons in whom doubts no longer exist on account of the certitude of their knowledge. They are fully aware of the distinctions between what is superior and what is inferior. They it is who acquire the highest end.

sn: विमुक्ता धूतपाप्मानो निर्द्वन्द्वा निष्परिग्रहाः। मानार्हा मानिता नित्यं ज्ञानविद्भिर्महात्मभिः॥
en: Shorn of altachments, purged of all sins, getting over all pairs of opposites, they are unattached to all worldly things. Deserving of every honour, they are always esteemed by persons gifted with knowledge and high souls.

sn: चन्दने मलपङ्के च भोजनेऽभोजने समाः। समं येषां दुकूलं च तथा क्षौमाजिनानि च॥
en: They cast impartial looks on sandal paste and filth or dirt, on what is food and what is not food. They see with an equal eye their brown dresses of coarse cloth and fabrics of silk and animal skins.

sn: तिष्ठेयुरप्यभुञ्जाना बहूनि दिवसान्यपि। शोषयेयुश्च गात्राणि स्वाध्यायैः संयतेन्द्रियाः॥
en: They would live for days together without partaking of any food, and dry up their limbs by such abstention. They devote themselves earnestly to the study of the Vedas, controlling their senses.

sn: अदैवं दैवतं कुर्युर्दैवतं चाप्यदैवतम्। लोकानन्यान् सृजेयुस्ते लोकपालांश्च कोपिताः॥
en: They would make gods of those who are not gods, and not gods of those who are gods. Enraged, they can create other worlds and other Regents of the worlds than those who exist.

sn: अपेयः सागरो येषामपि शापान्महात्मनाम्। येषां कोपाग्निरद्यापि दण्डके नोपशाम्यति॥
en: Through the curse of those great ones, the ocean become so saline as to be undrinkable. The fire of their anger yet burns in the forest of Dandaka, unquenched by time.

sn: देवानामपि ये देवाः कारणं कारणस्य च। प्रमाणस्य प्रमाणं च कस्तानभिभवेद् बुधः॥
en: They are the gods of the gods, and the cause of all causes. They are the authority of all authorities. What man of intelligence and wisdom is there who would seek to humiliate them.

sn: येषां वृद्धश्च बालश्च सर्वः सम्मानमहीति। तपोविद्याविशेषात्तु मानयन्ति परस्परम्॥
en: Amongst them the young and the old all deserve honours. They honour one another on account of distinctions in respect of penances and knowledge.

sn: अविद्वान् ब्राह्मणो देवः पात्रं वै पावनं महत्। विद्वान् भूयस्तरो देवः पूर्णसागरसंनिभः॥
en: Even the Brahmana who is destitute of knowledge is a god and is a great instrument for purifying others. He amongst them, then, who is possessed of knowledge is a much higher god and like the ocean when full (to the brim).

sn: अवद्विांश्चैव विद्वांश्च ब्राह्मणो दैवतं महत्। प्रणीतश्चाप्रणीतश्च यथाग्निर्दैवतं महत्॥
en: Learned or unlearned, the Brahmana is always a great deity. Purified or not, Fire is ever a great god.

sn: श्मशाने ह्यपि तेजस्वी पावको नैव दुष्यति। हविर्यज्ञे च विधिवद् गृह एवातिशोभते॥
en: A blazing fire, even when it burns on a crematorium, is not considered as sullied on account of the character of the spot whereon it burns. Clarified butter looks beautiful whether kept on the sacrificial after or in a chamber.

sn: एवं यद्यप्यनिष्टेषु वर्तते सर्वकर्मसु। सर्वथा ब्राह्मणो मान्यो दैवतं विद्धि तत्परम्॥
en: So if the Brahmana be always engaged in evil deeds, he is still to be considered as deserving of honours. Indeed, know that the Brahmana is always a great god.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कां तु ब्राह्मणपूजायां व्युष्टिं दृष्ट्वा जनाधिप। कं वा कर्मोदयं मत्वा तानसि महामते।।।।
en: Yudhishthira said 'Tell us, o king, what is that reward of the worship of Brahmanas, seeing which you adore them, O you of superior intelligence! Indeed, what is that success, emanating from their adoration, guided by which you worship them?

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। पवनस्य च संवादमर्जुनस्य च भारत॥ क्षत्रधर्मे पुरस्कृत्य
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the conversation between Pavana and Arjuna, O Bharata.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: सहस्रभुजभृच्छ्रीमान् कार्तवीर्योऽभवत् प्रभुः। अस्य लोकस्य सर्वस्य माहिष्मत्यां महाबलः॥
en: Gifted with a thousand arms and great beauty the powerful Kartavirya, formerly became the lord of all the world. He had his capital in the city of Mahishmati.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: स त रत्नाकरवतीं सद्वीपां सागराम्बराम्। शशास पृथिवीं सर्वां हैहयः सत्यविक्रमः॥
en: Of unbaffled prowess, that king of the Haihaya race of Kshatriyas governed the whole Earth begirt by seas, together with all her islands and all her precious mines of gold and gems.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: स्ववित्तं तेन दत्तं तु दत्तात्रेयाय कारणे। विनयं श्रुतमेव च॥
en: Respecting the duties of the Kshatriya order, as also humility and Vedic learning, the king made large gifts of wealth to the Rishi Dattatreya.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: आराधयामास च तं कृतवीर्यात्मजो मुनिम्। न्यमन्त्रयत संतुष्टो द्विजश्चैनं वरैस्त्रिभिः॥
en: Indeed, the of Kritavirya thus worshipped that great ascetic who, becoming pleased with him, asked him to solicit three boons.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: स वरैश्छन्दितस्तेन नृपो वचनमब्रवीत्। सहस्रबाहुर्भूयां वै चमुमध्ये गृहेऽन्यथा॥
en: Thus requested by the Rishi for boons, the king addressed him, saying, Let me have a thousand arms when I am in the midst of my elders. While, however, I remain at home let me have, as usual, only two arms.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: मम बाहुसहस्रं तु पश्यतां सैनिका रणे। विक्रमेण महीं कृत्स्ना जयेयं संशितव्रत॥
en: Indeed, let combatants, when fighting, see me possessed of a thousand arms. Observant also of high vows, let me succeed in subjugating the entire Earth by my prowess. son

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: तां च धर्मेण सम्प्राप्य पालयेयमतन्द्रितः। चतुर्थं तु वरं याचे त्वामहं द्विजसत्तम॥
en: Having acquired the Earth righteously, let me govern her with vigilance. There is a fourth boon which, O foremost of twiceborn person, I solicit thee to grant.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: तं ममानुग्रहकृते दातुमर्हस्यनिन्दित। अनुशासन्तु मां सन्तो मिथ्योद्वृत्तं त्वदाश्रयम्॥
en: O faultless one, being disposed to favour me, you should grant it to me! Dependent as I am on you, whenever I may happen to go wrong, let pious men come forth to instruct and set me right.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: इत्युक्तः स द्विजः प्राह तथास्त्विति नराधिपम्। एवं समभवंस्तस्य वरास्ते दीप्ततेजसः॥
en: Thus addressed, that Brahman, replied to the king, saying, So let it be! thus were those boons acquired by that king of burning effulgence.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: ततः स रथमास्थाय ज्वलनार्कसमद्युतिम्। अब्रवीद् वीर्य सम्मोहात् को वास्ति सदृशो मम।। धैर्यवैिर्यशः शौर्यैर्विक्रमेणौजसापि वा। तद्वाक्यान्ते चान्तरिक्षो वागुवाचाशरीरिणी॥ न त्वं मूढ विजानीषे ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियाद् वरम्। सहितो ब्राह्मणेनेह क्षत्रियः शास्ति वै प्रजाः॥
en: Riding then on his car which was effulgent like fire or the Sun, the king, blinded by his great prowess, said, Who, indeed, is there who can be considered as my equal in patience and energy, in fame and heroism, in prowess and strength? After he had uttered these words, an invisible voice in the sky, said, O ignorant wretch, do you not know that the Brahmana is superior to the Kshatriya? The Kshatriya, helped by the Brahman, rules all creatures.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: अर्जुन उवाच कुर्यो भूतानि तुष्टोऽहं क्रुद्धो नाशं तथानये। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा न मत्तोऽस्ति वरो द्विजः॥
en: When pleased I am able to create many creatures. When angry, I am able to destroy all. In thought, word, and deed, I am the foremost. The Brahmana is certainly not above me.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: पूर्वो ब्रह्मोत्तरो वादो द्वितीयः क्षत्रियोत्तरः। त्वयोक्तौ हेतुयुक्तौ तौ विशेषस्तत्र दृश्यते॥
en: The first proposition here is that the Brahmana is superior to Kshatriyas. The counterproposition is that the Kshatriya is superior. You have said, that the two are united together. A distinction, however, is observable in this.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: ब्राह्मणाः संश्रिताः क्षत्रं न क्षत्रं ब्राह्मणाश्रितम्। श्रिता ब्रह्मोपधा विपाः खादन्ति क्षत्रियान् भुवि॥
en: It is seen that Brahmanas take refuge with Kshatriyas. The Kshatriyas never seek the refuge of Brahmanas. Indeed, throughout the Earth, the Brahmans, accepting such refuge under the pretence of teaching the Vedas, get their maintenance from the Kshatriyas.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: क्षत्रियेष्वाश्रितो धर्मः प्रजानां परिपालनम्। क्षत्राद् वृत्तिर्ब्राह्मणानां तैः कथं ब्राह्मणो वरः॥
en: The duty of protecting all creatures lies with the Kshatriyas. It is from the Kshatriyas that the Brahmanas derive their livelihood. How then can the Brahmana be superior to the Kshatriyas?

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: सर्वभूतप्रधानांस्तान् भैक्षवृत्तीनहं सदा। आत्मसम्भावितान् विप्रान् स्थापयाम्यात्मनो वशे।।१९
en: Well, I shall, from today, bring under my subjection, your Brahmanas who are superior to all creatures but who have mendicancy for their occupation and who are so selfconceited.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: कथितं त्वनयासत्यं गायत्री कन्यया दिवि। विजेष्याम्यवशान् सर्वान् ब्राह्मणांश्चर्मवाससः॥
en: What the virgin Gayatri has said from the sky is not true. Robed in skins, the Brahmans move about in independence. I shall bring those independent men under my subjcction.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: न च मां च्यावयेद् राष्ट्रात् त्रिषु लोकेषु कश्चन। देवो वा मानुषो वापि तस्माज्ज्येष्ठो द्विजादहम्॥
en: Deity or man, there is none in the three worlds who can throw me off from the sovereignty I enjoy. Hence, I am certainly superior to the Brahmanas.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: अद्य ब्रह्मोत्तरं लोकं करिष्ये क्षत्रियोत्तरम्। न हि मे संयुगे कश्चित् सोढुमुत्सहते बलम्॥
en: This world that is now considered as having Brahmanas for its foremost dwellers. shall soon be made such as to have Kshatriyas for its foremost dwellers. There is none who is capable of withstanding my power in battle.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: अर्जुनस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वित्रस्ताभून्निशाचरी। अथैनमन्तरिक्षस्थस्ततो वायुरभाषत॥
en: Hearing these words of Arjuna, the skyranging goddess became moved.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: त्यजैनं कलुषं भावं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नमस्कुरु। एतेषां कुर्वतः पापं राष्ट्रक्षोभो भविष्यति॥
en: Then the god of wind, addressing the king from the sky, said, Renounce this sinful attitude. Bow to the Brahmanas. By injuring them you will bring about troubles on your kingdom.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: अथवा त्वां महीपाल शमयिष्यन्ति वै द्विजाः। निरसिष्यन्ति ते राष्ट्राद्धतोत्साहा महाबलाः॥
en: The Brahmanas will either kill you, king, though you are, or, endued with great might as they are, they will drive you away from your kingdom, despoiling you of your energy.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: तं राजा कस्त्वमित्याह ततस्तं प्राह मारुतः। वायुर्वै देवदूतोऽस्मि हितं त्वां प्रब्रवीम्यहम्॥
en: Hearing this speech, the king addressed the speaker, saying, Who, indeed, are you? The god of wind answered. I am the god of wind and the messenger of the celestials. I say to you what is for your benefit.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: अर्जुन उवाच अहो त्वयायं विप्रेषु भक्तिरागः प्रदर्शितः। यादृशं पृथिवीभूतं तादृशं ब्रूहि मे द्विजम्॥
en: Arjuna said Oh, I see that you have today shown your devotion and attachment to the Brahmanas. Tell me now what kind of carthly crcature is the Brahmana.

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: बायोर्वा सदृशं किंचिदि ब्रूहि त्वं ब्राह्मणोत्तमम्। अपां वै सदृशं वह्नः सूर्यस्य नभसोऽपि वा॥
en: Tell does a superior Brahmana resemble the Wind in any respect? Or, is he like Water, or Fire, or the Sun, or the Firmament? inc,

description: The fruit of the adoration of Brahmanas
sn: बायोर्वा सदृशं किंचिदि ब्रूहि त्वं ब्राह्मणोत्तमम्। अपां वै सदृशं वह्नः सूर्यस्य नभसोऽपि वा॥
en: Tell does a superior Brahmana resemble the Wind in any respect? Or, is he like Water, or Fire, or the Sun, or the Firmament? inc,

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच शृणु मूढ गुणान् कांश्चिद् ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम्। ये त्वया कीर्तिता राजंस्तेभ्योऽथ ब्राह्मणो वरः।।।।
en: The God of wind said Hear, O deluded man, what the attributes are of Brahmanas who have all high souls. The Brahmana is superior to all those which, O king, you have named.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: त्यक्त्वा महीत्वं भूमिस्तु स्पर्धयाङ्गनृपस्य ह। नाश जगाम तां विप्रो व्यस्तम्भयत कश्यपः॥
en: Formerly, the Earth, indulging in a spirit of rivalry with the king of the Angas, forsook her character as Earth. The regenerate Kashyapa caused destruction to befall her by actually paralysing her.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अजेया ब्राह्मणा राजन् दिवि चेह च नित्यदा। अपिबत् तेजसा ह्यापः स्वयमेवाङ्गिराः पुरा॥
en: The Brahmanas are always unconquerable, O king, in Heaven as also on Earth. Formerly, the great Rishi Angirasa, through his energy, drank off all the water.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: स ताः पिबन् क्षीरमिव नातृप्यत महामनाः। अपूरयन्महौघेन महीं सर्वां च पार्थिव॥
en: Having drunk off all the waters as if they were milk, the great Rishi did not feel yet his thirst to be satisfied. He, therefore, once more caused the Earth to be filled with water by raising a mighty wave.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तस्मिन्नहं च क्रुद्ध वै जगत् त्यक्त्वा ततो गतः। व्यतिष्ठमग्निहोत्रे च चिरमङ्गिरसो भयात्॥
en: On another occasion, when Angirasa became enraged with me, I fled away, leaving the world, and lived for a long time concealed in the Agnihotra of the Brahmanas, through fear of that Rishi.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अथ शप्तश्च भगवान् गौतमेन पुरन्दरः। अहल्यां कामयानो वै धर्मार्थं च न हिंसितः॥
en: The illustrious Purandara, an account of his having coveted the body of Ahalya, was cursed by Gautama, yet for the sake of Virtue and wealth, the Rishi did not destroy outright the king of the celestials.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तथा समुद्रो नृपते पूर्णो मृष्टस्य वारिणः। ब्राह्मणैरभिशप्तश्च बभूव लवणोदकः॥
en: The Ocean, O king, that was full in former days of crystal water, cursed by the Brahmanas, become saline in taste.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: सुवर्णवर्णो निर्धूमः सङ्गतोर्ध्वशिखः कविः। क्रुद्धेनाङ्गिरसा शप्तो गुणैरेतैर्विवर्जितः॥
en: Even Agni who is goldhued, and who blazes with cffulgence when destitute of smoke, and whose flames uniting together, burn upwards, when cursed by the angry Angiras, became divested of all these qualities.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: महतश्चूर्णितान् पश्य ये हासन्त महोदधिम्। सुवर्णधारिणा नित्यमवशप्ता द्विजातिना॥
en: See, the sixty thousand sons of Sagara, who came here to worship the Ocean, have all been pulverised by the Brahmana Kapila of golden hue.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: समो न त्वं द्विजातिभ्यः श्रेयो विद्धि नराधिप। गर्भस्थान् ब्राह्मणान् सम्यङ् नमस्यति किल प्रभुः।।१०
en: You are not equal to the Brahmanas. Do you, O king, seek your own good. The Kshatriya of even great power bows to Brahmana children who are still in their mothers' wombs.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: दण्डकानां महद् राज्यं ब्राह्मणेन विनाशितम्। तालजंघं महाक्षत्रमौर्वेणैकेन नाशितम्॥
en: The large kingdom of the Dandakas was destroyed by a Brahmana. The powerful Kshatriya Talajangha was destroyed by a single Brahmana, viz., Aurva.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: त्वया च विपुलं राज्यं बलं धर्मे श्रुतं तथा। दत्तात्रेयप्रसादेन प्राप्तं परमदुर्लभम्॥
en: You, too, have acquired a large kingdom, great might, religious merit, and learning, which are all difficult of acquirement, through the grace of Dattatreya.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अग्निं त्वं यजसे नित्यं कस्माद् ब्राह्मणमर्जुन। स हि सर्वस्य लोकस्य हव्यवाट् किं न वेत्सि तम्।।
en: Why do yu, O Arjuna, adore Agni everyday who is a Brahmana? He is the bearer of sacrificial libations from every part of the universe. Are you ignorant of this fact.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अथवा ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठमनुभूतानुपालकम्। कर्तारं जीवलोकस्य कस्माज्जानन् विमुह्यसे॥
en: Why, indeed, do you allow yourself to be stupefied by folly when you are not ignorant of the fact that a superior Brahmana is the protector of all creatures in the world and is, indeed, the creator of the living world?

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तथा प्रजापतिर्ब्रह्मा अव्यक्तः प्रभुरव्ययः। येनेदं निखिलं विश्वं जनितं स्थावरं चरम्॥
en: The Lord of all creatures, Brahman, unmanifest, gifted with power, and of unfading glory, who created this vast universe with its mobile and immobile creatures, (is Brahmana).

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अण्डजातं तु ब्रह्माणं केचिदिच्छन्त्यपण्डिताः। अण्डाद् भिन्नाद् बभुः शैला दिशोऽम्भ:पृथिवी दिवम्
en: Some ignorant persons there are, who say that Brahman was born of an Egg. From the original Egg, when it opened, mountains and the cardinal points and the waters and the Earth and the Heavens all came into existence.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: द्रष्टव्यं नैतदेवं हि कथं जायेदजो हि सः। स्मृतमाकाशमण्डं तु तस्माज्जातः पितामहः॥
en: No one had seen this birth of the creation. How then can Brahman be said to to have taken his birth from thc original Egg, when especially he is said to be Unborn? It is said that vast increate Space is the original Egg. It was from this in create Space that the Grandfather was born. If you

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तिष्ठेत् कथमिति ब्रूहि न किंचिद्धि तदा भवेत्। अहङ्कार इति प्रोक्तः सर्वतेजोगतः प्रभुः॥
en: ask, Whereon would the Grandfather, after his birth from increate Space, rest for there was then nothing else? The answer may be given thus. There is an existent Being of the name of Consciousness. That mighty Being is gifted with great energy.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: नास्त्यण्डमस्ति तु ब्रह्मा स राजा लोकभावनः। इत्युक्तः स तदा तूष्णीमभूद् वायुस्ततोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: There is no Egg. Brahman, however, is existent. He is the Creator of the universe and is its King! Thus addressed by the god of wind, king Arjuna remained silent.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच इमां भूमिं द्विजातिभ्यो दित्सुवै दक्षिणां पुरा। अङ्गो नाम नृपो राजंस्ततश्चिन्तां मही ययौ॥
en: The god of wind said Once on a time, O king, a king named Anga wished to give away the entire Earth as sacrificial present to the Brahmanas. At this, the Earth became stricken with anxiety.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: धारिणी सर्वभूतानामयं प्राप्य वरो नृपः। कथमिच्छति मां दातुं द्विजेभ्यो ब्रह्मणः सुताम्॥
en: I am the daughter of Brahman. I hold all creatures. Having obtained me, alas, why does this foremost of kings wish to give me away to the Brahmanas?

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: साहं त्यक्त्वा गमिष्यामि भूमित्वं ब्रह्मणः पदम्। अयं सराष्ट्रो नृपतिर्मा भूदिति ततोऽगमत्॥
en: Renouncing my character as the soil, I shall now go to my father. Let this king with all his kingdom meet with destruction! Forming this conclusion, she departed for the region of Brahman.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ततस्तां कश्यपो दृष्ट्वा व्रजन्तीं पृथिवीं तदा। प्रविवेश महीं सद्यो मुक्त्वाऽऽत्मानं समाहितः॥
en: Seeing the goddess Earth about to go, the Rishi Kashyapa himself immediately entered the visibie body of the goddess, renouncing his own body, by the help of Yoga.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ऋद्धा सा सर्वतो यज्ञे तृणौषधिसमन्विता। धर्मोत्तरा नष्टभया भूमिरासीत् ततो नृप॥
en: Thus penetrated by the spirit of Kashyapa, the earth grow in prosperity and became full of all kinds of vegetable produce. Indeed, O king, for the time the Kashyapa pervaded the earth, Virtue became foremost everywhere and all fears ceased.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि दिव्यानि विपुलव्रतः। त्रिंशत: कश्यपो राजन् भूमिरासीदतन्द्रितः॥
en: Thus, O king, the earth remained penetrated by the spirit of Kashyapa for thirty thousand divine years, fully alive to all those functions which it used to discharge while it was penetrated by the spirit of Brahmana's daughter.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अथागम्य महाराज नमस्कृत्य च कश्यपम्। पृथिवी काश्यपी यज्ञे सुता तस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Upon the expiration of this period, the goddess returned from the region of Brahman and arrived here bowed to Kashyapa and from that time became the daughter of that Rishi.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: एष राजन्नीदृशो वै ब्राह्मणः कश्यपोऽभवत्। अन्यं प्रब्रहि वा त्वं च कश्यपात् क्षत्रियं वरम्॥
en: Kashyapa is a Brahmana. This was the feet, O king, that a Brahmana did, teil mc the name of the Kshatriya who is superior to Kashyapa.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तूष्णीं बभूव नृपतिः पवनस्त्वब्रवीत् पुनः। शृणु राजन्नुतथ्यस्य जातस्याङ्गिरसे कुले।९।।
en: Hearing these words, king Arjuna remained silent. The god of wind once more said to him, Hear now, O king, the story of Utathya who was born in the family of Angirasa.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: भद्रा सोमस्य दुहिता रूपेण परमा मता। तस्यास्तुल्यं पति सोम उतथ्यं समपश्यत॥
en: The daughter of Soma, named Bhadra, came to be considered as peerless in beauty. Her father Soma regarded Utathya to be the fittest of husbands for her.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: सा च तीर्व तपस्तेपे महाभागा यशस्विनी। उतथ्यार्थे तु चार्वङ्गी परं नियममास्थिता॥
en: The famous and highly blessed maiden of faultless limbs, observing various vows practised the severest austerities from the desire of getting Utathya for her husband.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तत आहूय सोतथ्यं ददावत्रिर्यशस्विनीम्। भार्यार्थे स च जग्राह विधिवद् भूरिदक्षिणः॥
en: After some time, Soma's father Atri, inviting Utathya to his house, bestowed upon him the famous maiden. Utathya, who used to give away sacrificial presents in profusion, duly received the girl for his wife.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तां त्वकामयत श्रीमान् वरुणः पूर्वमेव ह। स चागम्य वनप्रस्थं यमुनायां जहार ताम्॥
en: It so took place, however, that the beautiful Varuna had, from a long time before, coveted the girl. Coming to the forest where Utathya lived, Varuna stole away the girl when she had plunged into the Yamuna for a bath.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: जलेश्वरस्तु हृत्वा तामनयत् स्वं पुरं प्रति। परमाद्भुतसंकाशं षट्सहस्रशतह्रदम्॥
en: Abducting her thus, the Lord of the waters took her to his own house. That mansion was wonderful. It was adorned with six hundred thousand lakes.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: न हि रम्यतरं किंचित् तस्मादन्यत् पुरोत्तमम्। प्रसादैरप्सरोभिश्च दिव्यैः कामैश्च शोभितम्॥
en: There is no palace that can be considered more beautiful than that of Varuna. It was adorned with many places and by the presence of various tribes of Apsaras and of various excellent articles of enjoyment.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तत्र देवस्तया सार्धे रेमे राजन् जलेश्वरः। अथाख्यातमुतथ्याय ततः पल्यवमर्दनम्॥ तच्छ्रुत्वा नारदात् सर्वमुतथ्यो नारदं तदा। प्रोवाच गच्छ ब्रूहि त्वं वरुणं परुषं वचः॥ मद्वाक्यान्मुञ्च मे भार्यो कस्मात् तां हृतवानसि।
en: There, within that palace, the Lord of waters, O king, sported with the damsel. A little while after, Utathya came to know of the ravishment of his wife. Indeed, having heard all the facts from Narada, Utathya addressed the celestial Rishi, saying, Go, O Narada, to Varuna and speak with due severity to him. Ask him as to why he has abducted my wife, and, indeed, tell him in my name that he should give her up.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: लोकपालोऽसि लोकानां न लोकस्य विलोपकः।।१८ सोमेन दत्ता भार्या मे त्वया चापहृताद्य वै।
en: You may tell him further, You are a protector of the worlds, O Varuna, and not a destroyer. Why then have you abducted my wife bestowed upon me by Sona?

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: इत्युक्तो वचनात् तस्य नारदेन जलेश्वरः॥ मुञ्च भार्यामुतथ्यस्य कस्मात् त्वं हृतवानसि।
en: Thus requested by Utathya, the celestial Rishi Narada went to where Varuna was and addressing him, said, Do you liberate the wife of Utathya. Indeed, why have you abducted her!

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य सोऽथ तं वरुणोऽब्रवीत्॥ ममैषा सुप्रिया भार्यां नैनामुत्स्रष्टुमुत्सहे।
en: Hearing these words of Narada, Varuna replied to him, saying, This timed girl is very dear to me. I dare not let her go.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: इत्युक्तो वरुणेनाथ नारदः प्राप्य तं मुनिम्। उतथ्यमब्रवीद् वाक्यं नातिहष्टमना इव॥ गले गृहीत्वा क्षिप्तोऽस्मि वरुणेन महामुने। न प्रयच्छति ते भार्यो यत् ते कार्यं कुरुष्व तत्॥
en: Receiving this reply, Narada went to Utathya and cheerlessly told him, O great ascetic, Varuna has driven me from his house, catching me by the throat. He is reluctant to restore to you your wife. Do you act as you please.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धः प्राज्वलदाङ्गिराः। अपिबत् तेजसा वारि विष्टभ्य सुमहातपाः॥
en: Hearing these words of Narada, Angirasa became enraged. Having penances for wealth, he solidified the waters and drank them off, by his energy.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: पीयमाने तु सर्वस्मिंस्तोयेऽपि सलिलेश्वरः। सुहृद्धिर्भिक्षमाणोऽपि नैवामुञ्चत तां तदा।॥
en: When all the waters were thus drunk off, the Lord of that clement became very dispirited with all his friends and kinsfolk. For all that, he did not still give up Utathya's wife.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तत: क्रुद्धोऽब्रवीद् भूमिमुतथ्यो ब्राह्मणोत्तमः। दर्शयस्व स्थलं भद्रे षट् सहस्रशतह्रदम्॥
en: Then Utathya, that foremost of twiceborn persons, filled with anger, commanded Earth, saying, O amiable one, do you show land where there are at present the six hundred thousand lakes.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ततस्तदीरिणं जातं समुद्रस्यावसर्पतः। तस्माद् देशान्नदीं चैव प्रोवाचासौ द्विजोत्तमः॥ अदृश्या गच्छ भीरु तवं सरस्वति मरून प्रति। अपुण्य एष भवतु देशस्त्यक्तस्त्वया शुभे॥
en: At these words of The Rishi, the Ocean receded from the spot marked out, and land appeared which was highly sterile. To the rivers which flowed through that region, Utathya said. O Sarasvati, do you become invisible here. Indeed, O timid lady, leaving this region, go you to the desert. O auspicious goddess, let this region, destitute of you, cease to become sacred.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तस्मिन् संशोषिते देशे भद्रामादाय वारिपः। अददाच्छरणं गत्वा भार्यामाङ्गिरसाय वै॥
en: When that rcgion became dry, he repaired to Angirasaa, taking with him Utathya's wife, and made her over to him.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: प्रतिगृह्य तु तां भार्यामुतथ्यः सुमनाऽभवत्। मुमोच च जगद् दुःखाद् वरुणं चैव हैहय॥
en: Getting back his wife, Utathya became cheerful. Then, O chief of the Haihaya family, that great Brahmana rescued both the universe and the Lord of waters from the situation of distress into which he had reduced them.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ततः स लब्ध्वा तां भार्यां वरुणं प्राह धर्मवित्। उतथ्यः सुमहातेजा यत् तच्छृणु नराधिप॥ मयैषा तपसा प्राप्ता क्रोशतस्ते जलाधिप। इत्युक्त्वा तामुपादाय स्वमेव भवनं ययौ॥
en: Knowing every duty, the highly energetic Rishi Utathya, after getting back his wife, O king, said to Varuna, I have recovered my wife, O lord of waters, with the help of my penances and after inflicting such distress on you as made you cry aloud in pain. Having said this, he went home, with that wife of his.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: एष राजन्नीदृशो वै उतथ्यो ब्राह्मणर्षभः। ब्रवीम्यहं ब्रूहि वा त्वमुतथ्यात् क्षत्रियं वरम्॥
en: Even such, O_king, was Utathya, that foremost of Brahmanas. Shall I go on? Or, will you yet persist in your opinion? What, is there a Kshatriya that is superior to Utathya?

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः स नृपस्तूष्णीमभूद् वायुस्ततोऽब्रवीत्। शृणु राजन्नगस्त्यस्य माहात्म्यं ब्राह्मणस्य ह॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed, king Arjuna remained silent. The god of wind once more spoke to him. Listen now, O king, to the greatness of the Brahmana Agastya.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: असुरैर्निर्जिता देवा निरुत्साहश्च ते कृताः। यज्ञाश्चैषां हताः सर्वे पितॄणां च स्वधास्तथा॥
en: Once on a time, the gods were defeated by the Asuras upon which they became very dispirited. The sacrifices of the deities were all robbed, and the Svadha of the manes was also misappropriated.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: कर्मेज्या मानवानां च दानवैहैहयर्षभ। भ्रष्टैश्वर्यास्ततो देवाश्चेरुः पृथ्वीमिति श्रुतिः॥
en: Indeed, O chief of the Haihayas, all the religious acts and observances of human beings also were stopped by the Danavas. Shorn of their prosperity, the celestials wandered over the Earth as we have heard.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ततः कदाचित् ते राजन् दीप्तमादित्यवर्चसम्। ददृशुस्तेजसा युक्तमगस्त्यं विपुलव्रतम्॥
en: One day, in course of their wanderings, they met Agastya of high vows, that Brahimana, O king, who was gifted with great energy and solar splendour.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अभिवाद्य तु तं देवाः पृष्ट्वा कुशलमेव च। इदमूचूर्महात्मानं वाक्यं काले जनाधिप॥ दानवैर्युधि भग्न: स्म तथैश्वर्याच्च भ्रंशिताः। तदस्मान्नो भयात् तीव्रात् त्राहि त्वं मुनिपुङ्गव॥
en: Saluting him duly, the celestials made the usual polite enquiries. They then, O king, said these words to that highsouled one, We have been defeated by the Danavas in battle, and have, therefore, been deprived of affluence and prosperity. Do you, therefore, O foremost of ascetics, rescue us from this situation of great fear.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: इत्युक्तः स तदा देवैरगस्त्यः कुपितोऽभवत्। प्रजज्वाल च तेजस्वी कालाग्निरिव संक्षये॥
en: Thus informed of the condition to which the celestials had been reduced, Agastya became highly enraged. Highly energetic, he at once blazed forth like the allconsuming fire at the time of the universal dissolution.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तेन दीप्तांशुजालेन निर्दग्धा दानवास्तदा। अन्तरिक्षान्महाराज निपेतुस्ते सहस्रशः॥
en: With the burning rays which then came out from the Rishi, the Danavas began to be buint. Indeed, O king, thousands of them began to drop down from the sky.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: दह्यमानास्तु ते दैत्यास्तस्यागस्त्यस्य तेजसा। उभौ लोकौ परित्यज्य गताः काष्ठां तु दक्षिणाम्॥
en: Burning with the energy of Agastya, the Danavas, abandoning both Heaven and Earth, fled towards the south.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: बलिस्तु यजते यज्ञमश्वमेधं महीं गतः। येऽन्येऽधस्था महीस्थाश्च ते न दग्धा महासुराः॥
en: At that time the Danava king Bali was celebrating a HorseSacrifice in the nether regions. Those great Asuras who were with himn in those regions or who were living in the bowels of the Earth, were not burnt.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ततो लोकाः पुनः प्राप्ताः सुरैः शान्तभयैर्नृप। अथैनमब्रुवन् देवा भूमिष्ठानसुरान् जहि॥
en: The celestials, upon the destruction of their enemies, then regained their own regions, their fears entirely removed, Encouraged by what he did for them, they then begged the Rishi to destroy those Asuras who had taken refuge within the bowels of the Earth or in the nether regions.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: इत्युक्तः प्राह देवान् स न शक्तोऽस्मि महीगतान्। दग्धुं तपो हि क्षीयेन्मे न शक्यामीति पार्थिव॥
en: Thus requested by the gods, Agastya replied to them, saying, Yes, I can consume those Asuras who are living underneath the Earth; but if I achieve such a feat, my penances will suffer decay. Hence, I shall not exert my power.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: एवं दग्धा भगवता दानवाः स्वेन तेजसा। अगस्त्येन तदा राजंस्तपसा भावितात्मना॥
en: Thus, O king, were the Danavas consumed by the illustrious Rishi with his own energy. This did Agastya of purified soul, O monarch, accomplish that deed with the help of his penances.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ईदृशश्चाप्यगस्त्यो हि कथितस्ते मयाऽनघ। ब्रवीम्यहं ब्रूहि वा त्वमगस्त्यात् क्षत्रियं वरम्॥
en: O sinless one, so was Agastya as described by me. Shall I continue? Or, will you say anything in reply? Is there any Kshatriya who is greater than Agastya?

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः स तदा तूष्णीमभूद् वायुस्ततोऽब्रवीत्। शृणु राजन् वसिष्ठस्य मुख्यं कर्म यशस्विनः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed, king Arjuna remained silent. The god of wind once more said, Hear, O king, one of the great feats of the illustrious Vasishtha.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: आदित्याः सत्रमासन्त सरो वै मानसं प्रति। वसिष्ठं मनसा गत्वा ज्ञात्वा तत् तस्य गौरवम्॥
en: Once on a time the celestials were engaged in celebrating a sacrifice on the shores of the lake Vaikhanasa. Knowing his power, the sacrificing gods thought of Vasishtha and made him their priest in imagination.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: यजमानांस्तु तान् दृष्ट्वा सर्वान् दीक्षानुकर्शितान्। हन्तुमैच्छन्त शैलाभाः खलिनो नाम दानवाः॥
en: Meanwhile, seeing the gods reducer and emaciated on account of the initiation they were undergoing, a race of Danavas, of the name of Khalins, of statures as gigantic as mountains, wished to kill them.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अदूरात् तु ततस्तेषां ब्रह्मदत्तवरं सरः। हताहता वै तत्रैते जीवन्त्याप्लुत्य दानवाः॥
en: Those amongst the Danavas that were either disabled or killed in the fight were plunged into the waters of the Manasa lake and on account of the boon of the Grandfather they immediately came back to vigour and life.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: प्रगृह्य महाघोरान् पर्वतान् परिघान् दुमान्। विक्षोभयन्तः सलिलमुत्थितं शतयोजनम्॥
en: Taking up huge and terrible mountain summits and maces and trees, they agitated the waters of the lake, making them swell up to the height of a hundred Yojanas.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अभ्यद्रवन्त देवांस्ते सहस्राणि दशैव हि। ततस्तैरर्दिता देवाः शरणं वासवं ययुः॥
en: They then ran against the celestials numbering ten thousand. Afflicted by the Danavas, the gods then sought the refuge of their king Vasava.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: स च तैर्व्यथितः शक्रो वसिष्ठं शरणं ययौ। ततोऽभयं ददौ तैभ्यो वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः॥
en: Shakra, however, was soon afflicted by them. In his distress he sought the protection of Vasishtha. At this, the holy Rishi Vasishtha assured the celestials, removing their fears.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तदा तान् दुःखितान् ज्ञात्वा आनृशंस्य परो मुनिः। अयत्नेनादहत् सर्वान् खलिनः स्वेन तेजसा॥ ते
en: Understanding that the gods had become greatly dispirited, the ascetic did this through mercy. He displayed his energy and burnt, without any exertion, those Danavas called Khalins.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: कैलासं प्रस्थितां चैव नदी गङ्गां महातपाः। आनयत् तत्सरो दिव्यं तया भिन्नं च तत्सरः॥
en: Having penances for wealth, the Rishi brought the River Ganga who had gone to Kailasa, to that spot, Indeed, Ganga appeared, piercing through the waters of the lake.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: सरोभिन्नं तया नद्या सरयूः सा ततोऽभवत्। हताश्च खलिनो यत्र स देशः खलिनोऽभवत्॥
en: The lake was penetrated by that river. And as that celestial river piercing through the waters of the lake, appeared, it flowed on, under the name of Sarayu. The palace whereon those Danavas fell came to be called after them.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: एवं सेन्द्रा वसिष्ठेन रक्षितास्त्रिदिवौकसः। ब्रह्मदत्तवराश्चैव हता दैत्या महात्मना।॥
en: Thus were the dwellers of Heaven, headed by Indra, rescued from great distress by Vasishtha. It was thus that those Danavas, who had received boons from Brahman, were killed by that great Rishi.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: एतत् कर्म वसिष्ठस्य कथितं हि मयाऽनघ। ब्रवीम्यहं ब्रूहि वा त्वं वसिष्ठात् क्षत्रियं वरम्॥
en: O sinless one, I have described to you the fcat which Vasishtha accomplished. Shall I go on? Or, will you say anything? Was there a Kshatriya who could be said to excel the Brahmana Vasishtha?

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: इत्युक्तस्त्वर्जुनस्तूष्णीमभूद् वायुस्तमब्रवीत्। शृणु मे हैहयश्रेष्ठ कर्मात्रेः सुमहात्मनः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed, Arjuna remained silent. The god of wind once more addressed him, saying, Hear me, O foremost one of the Haihayas, as I describe to you the achicvement of the great Atri.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: घोरे तमस्ययुध्यन्त सहिता देवदानवाः। अविध्यत शरैस्तत्र स्वर्भानुः सोमभास्करौ॥
en: Once on a time as the gods and Danavas were fighting each other in the dark, Rahu pierced both the Sun and Moon with his arrows.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अथ ते तमसा ग्रस्ता निहन्यन्ते स्म दानवैः। देवा नृपतिशार्दूल सहैव बलिभिस्तदा॥
en: The gods, overwhelmed by darkness, began to fall before the powerful Danavas, O foremost of kings.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: असुरैर्वध्यमानास्ते क्षीणप्राणा दिवौकसः। अपश्यन्त तपस्यन्तमत्रिं विप्रं तपोधनम्॥ अथैनमब्रुवन् देवाः शान्तक्रोधं जितेन्द्रियम्। असुरैरिषुभिर्विद्धौ चन्द्रादित्याविमावुभौ॥
en: Repeatedly struck by the Asuras, the celestials began to lose their strength. They then saw the learned Brahmana Atri, having penances for wealth, engaged in in the observance of austerities. Addressing that Rishi who had all his senses and in whom anger had been extinguished, they said, Sce, O Rishi, these two, viz., the Moon and the Sun who have both been pierced by the Asuras with their arrows.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: वयं वध्यामहे चापि शत्रुभिस्तमसावृते। नाधिगच्छाम शान्तिं च भयात् त्रायस्व नः प्रभो॥
en: On account of this, darkness has overtaken us, and we are being struck down by the enemy. We do not see the end of our troubles. Do you, O lord of great power, rescue us from this great fear.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ऋषि उवाच कथं रक्षामि भवतस्तेऽब्रुवंश्चन्द्रमा भव। तिमिरन्धश्च सवितस दस्युहन्ता च नो भव॥
en: The Rishi said How, indeed, shall I protect you? They answered, saying, Do you become the Moon. Do you also become the Sun, and do you begini to kill these robbers.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: एवमुक्तस्तदात्रिर्व तमोनुदभवच्छशी। अपश्यत् सौम्यभावाच्च सोमवत् प्रियदर्शनः॥
en: Thus begged by them, Atri assumed the form of the darknessdestroying Moon. Indeed, on account of his agreeable disposition, he began to look as beautiful and delightful as the Moon himself.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: दृष्ट्वा नातिप्रभं सोमं तथा सूर्यं च पार्थिव। प्रकाशमकरोदत्रिस्तपसा स्वेन संयुगे॥
en: Seeing that the real Moon and the real Sun had become darkened by the arrows of the enemy, Atri, assuming the forms of those luminaries, began to shine forth over the field of battle, helped by the power of his penances.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: जगद् वितिमिरं चापि प्रदीप्तमकरोत् तदा॥
en: Indeed, Atri made the universe shine in light, removing all its darkness. By displaying his power, he also subjugated, the vast multitudes of those enemies of the celestials.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: व्यजयच्छत्रुसंघांश्च देवानां स्वेन तेजसा। अत्रिणा दह्यमानांस्तान् दृष्ट्वा देवा महासुरान्॥
en: Seeing those great Asuras burnt by Atri, the gods also, protected by Atri's energy, began to despatch them quickly.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: पराक्रमैस्तेऽपि तदा व्यनन्नत्रिसुरक्षिताः। उद्भासितश्च सविता देवास्त्राता हतासुराः॥
en: Displaying his prowess and collecting all his energy, it was thus that Atri illumined the god of day, rescued the celestials, and killed the Asuras.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अत्रिणा त्वथ सामर्थ्य कृतमुत्तमतेजसा। द्विजेनाग्निद्वितीयेन जपता चर्मवाससा॥
en: This was the feat that twice born one, helped by his sacred fire, that silent reciter of Mantras, that one clad in deerskins, performed! See, O royal sage, the act achieved by that Rishi who lived upon fruits only.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: फलभक्षेण राजर्षे पश्य कर्मात्रिणा कृतम्। तस्यापि विस्तरेणोक्तं कर्मात्रेः सुमहात्मनः। ब्रवीम्यहं ब्रूहि वा त्वमत्रितः क्षत्रियं वरम्॥
en: I have thus described to you, in full, the feat of the great Atri. Shail I go on? Or, will you say anything? Is there a Kshatriya who is superior to this twiceborn Rishi?

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: इत्युक्तस्त्वर्जुनस्तूष्णीमभूद् वायुस्ततोऽब्रवीत्। शृणु राजन् महत्कर्म च्यवनस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Thus addressed, Arjuna remained silent. The god of wind once more spoke to him. Hear, O king, the feat achieved by the great Chyavana.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अश्विनोः प्रतिसंश्रुत्य च्यवनः पाकशासनम्। प्रोवाच सहितो देवैः सोमपावश्विनौ कुरु॥
en: Having made his promise to the twin Ashvins, Chyavana addressed the chastiser of Paka, saying, Do you make the Ashvins drinkers of Soma with all the other celestials.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: इन्द्र उवाच अस्माभिर्निन्दितावेतौ भवेतां सोमपौ कथम्। देवैर्न सम्मितावेतौ तस्मान्मैवं वदस्व नः॥
en: Indra said The Ashvins have been outcasted by us. How, then, can these be admitted into the sacrificial circle for drinking Soma with the others? They are not classed with the celestials. Do not, therefore, tell us so.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अश्विभ्यां सह नेच्छामः सोमं पातुं महाव्रत। यदन्यद् वक्ष्यसे विप्र तत् करिष्यामि ते वचः॥
en: O you of great vows, we do not wish to drink Soma in the company of the Ashvins! Whatever other commands you may be pleased to utter, O learned Brahmana, we are ready to do.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: च्यवन उवाच पिबेतामश्विनौ सोमं भवद्भिः सहिताविमौ। उभावेतावपि सुरौ सूर्यपुत्रौ सुरेश्वर॥
en: Chyavana said The twin Ashvins shall drink Soma with all of you. Both of them are gods, O king of the celestials, for they are the sons of the Sun.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: क्रियतां मद्वचो देवा यथा वै समुदाहृतम्। एतद् वः कुर्वतां श्रेयो भवेन्नैतदकुर्वताम्॥
en: Let the gods do what I have said. By acting according to those words, the gods will reap great advantage. By acting otherwise evil will overtake them.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: इन्द्र उवाच अश्विभ्यां सह सोमं वै न पास्यामि द्विजोत्तमा पिबन्त्वन्ये यथाकामं नाहं पातुमिहोत्सहे॥
en: Indra said I shall not, O foremost of twiceborn persons, drink Soma with the Ashvins. Let others drink with them as they please. As for mysclf, I dare not do it.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: च्यवन उवाच न चेत् करिष्यसि वचो मयोक्तं बलसूदन। मया प्रमथितः सद्यः सोमं पास्यसि वै मखे॥
en: Chyavana said If, O destroyer of Vala, you will not obey my words, you shall, this very day, drink Soma with them in sacrifice, compelled by me.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: वायु उवाच ततः कर्म समारब्धं हिताय सहसाश्विनोः। च्यवनेन ततो मन्त्रैरभिभूताः सुराऽभवन्॥
en: The god of wind said Then Chyavana, taking the Ashvins with him, began a great religious rite for their bencfit. The gods all became stupefied by Chyavana with the help of his Mantras.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तत् तु कर्म समारब्धं दृष्ट्वेन्द्रः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। उद्यम्य विपुलं शैलं च्यवनं समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Seeing that feat undertaken by Chyavana, Indra became enraged. Taking up a huge mountain he ran against that Rishi.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तथा वज्रेण भगवानमर्षाकुललोचनः। तमापतन्तं दृष्ट्वैव च्यवनस्तपसान्वितः॥
en: The king of the deities was also armed with the Thunderbolt. Then the illustrious Chyavana, gifted with penances, cast angry looks upon Indra as he advanced.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अद्भिः सिक्त्वास्तम्भयत् तं सवज्रं सहपर्वतम्। अथेन्द्रस्य महाघोरं सोऽसृजच्छत्रुमेव हि॥
en: Throwing a little water at him, he paralysed the king of the deities with his Thunderbolt and mountain. As the result of the religious rite he had begun, he created a terrible Asura hostile to Indra.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: मदं नामाहुतिमयं व्यादितास्यं महामुनिः। तस्य दन्तसहस्रं तु बभूव शतयोजनम्॥
en: Made of the libations he had poured on the sacred fire, that Asura was called Mada, of mouth gaping wide. Such was the Asura that the great ascetic created with the help of Mantras. There were a thousand teeth in his mouth, extending for a hundred Yojanas.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: द्वियोजनशतास्तस्य दंष्ट्राः परमदारुणाः। हनुस्तस्याभवद् भूमावास्यं चास्यास्पृशद् दिवम्।।२८
en: Of terrible appearance, his fangs were two hundred Yojanas in length. One of his cheeks rested on the Earth and the other touched the sky.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: जिह्वामूले स्थितास्तस्य सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः। तिमेरास्यमनुप्राप्ता यथा मत्स्या महार्णवे॥
en: Indeed, all the gods with Vasava seemed to stand at the root of that great Asura's tongue, as fishes when they enter into the wide open mouth of a leviathan.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ते सम्मन्त्र्य ततो देवा मदस्यास्यसमीपगाः। अब्रुवन् सहिताः शक्रं प्रणमास्मै द्विजातये॥
en: While standing within the mouth of Mada, the gods consulted speedily and then addressing Indra, said, Do you soon bend your head in respect to this twiceborn personage.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अश्विभ्यां सह सोमं च पिबाम विगतज्वराः। ततः स प्रणतः शक्रश्चकार च्यवनस्य तत्॥
en: We shall without any hesitation drink Soma with the Ashvins in our company. Then bowing down his head to Chyavana, Shakra obeyed his command.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: च्यवन् कृतवानेतावश्विनौ सोमपायिनौ। ततः प्रत्याहरत् कर्म मदं च व्यभजन्मुनिः॥
en: Thus did Chyavana make the Ashvins drinkers of Soma with the other gods. Calling back Mada, the Rishi then assigned him his work.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अक्षेषु मृगयायां च पाने स्त्रीषु च वीर्यवान्॥ एतैर्दोषैर्नरा राजन् क्षयं यान्ति न संशयः।
en: Soma was ordered to live in dice, in hunting, in drinking, and in women. Hence, O king, those men who betake themselves to these, forsooth, incet with destruction.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तस्मादेतान् नरो नित्यं दूरतः परिवर्जयेत्॥ एतत् ते च्यवनस्यापि कर्म राजन् प्रकीर्तितम्। ब्रवीम्यहं ब्रूहि वा त्वं क्षत्रियं ब्राह्मणाद् वरम्॥
en: Hence, one should always renounce these faults to a great distance. Thus, O king, I have described to you thc fcat achieved by Chyavana. Shall I go on? Or, will you say anything in reply? Is there a Kshatriya who is higher than the Brahmana Chyavana?

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: भीष्म उवाच तूष्णीमासीदर्जुनस्तु पवनस्त्वब्रवीत् पुनः। शृणु मे ब्राह्मणेष्वेव मुख्यं कर्म जनाधिप॥ मदस्यास्यमनुप्राप्ता यदा सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः। तदैव च्यवनेनेह हृता तेषां वसुन्धरा॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words of the god of wind, Arjuna remained silent. At this, the god of wind once more addressed him saying, When the dwellers of Heaven, headed by Indra, found themselves within the mouth of the Asura Mada, at that time, Chyavana took away from them the Earth.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: उभौ लोकौ हतौ मत्वा ते देवा दुःखिताऽभवन्। शोकाश्चि महात्मानं ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः॥
en: Deprived previously of Heaven and now of the Earth also, the gods became very dispirited. Indeed, those great ones, afflicted with grief, then threw themselves unreservedly upon the Grandfather's protection.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: देवा ऊचुः ते मदास्यव्यतिषक्तानामस्माकं लोकपूजित। च्यवनेन हता भूमिः कपैश्चैव दिवं प्रभो॥
en: The Gods said O you who are adored by all creatures of the universe, the Earth has been taken away from us by Chyavana, while we have been deprived of Heaven by the Kapas, O powerful one.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ब्रह्मोवाच गच्छध्वं शरणं विप्रावाशु सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः। प्रसाद्य तानुभौ लोकाववाप्स्यथ यथा पुरा॥
en: Brahman said You dwellers of Heaven, do you, with Indra, repair speedily and scck the protection of the Brahmanas. By pleasing them you will succeed in regaining both the regions as before.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ययुः शरणं विप्रानू चुस्ते कान् जयामहे। इत्युक्तास्ते द्विजान् प्राहुर्जयतेह कपानिति॥
en: Thus instructed by the Grandfather, the deities went to the Brahmanas and begged for their protection. The Brahmanas replied, enquiring, Whom shall we subjugate? Thus asked, the celestials said to them, Do you subjugate the Kapas.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: भूगतान् हि विजेतारो वयमित्यब्रुवन् द्विजाः। ततः कर्म समारब्धं ब्राह्मणैः कपनाशनम्॥ तच्छ्रुत्वा प्रेषितो दूतो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनी कपैः।
en: The Brahmanas then said, Bringing them down on the Earth first, we shall quickly subjugate them. After this, the Brahmanas began a rite having for its object the destruction of the Kapas. As soon as this was heard of by the Kapas, they immediately sent a messenger of theirs, named Dhani, to those Brahmanas.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: स च तान् ब्राह्मणानाह धनी कपवचो यथा॥ भवद्भिः सदृशाः सर्वे कपाः किमिह वर्तते।
en: Dhani, coming to them as they sat on the Earth, thus communicated to them the message of the Kapas, The Kapas are like you all. Hence, what will be the results of these rites which it appears you are determined upon?

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: सर्वे वेदविदः प्राज्ञाः सर्वे च क्रतुयाजिनः॥ सर्वे सत्यव्रताश्चैव सर्वे तुल्या महर्षिभिः।
en: Of all them are well conversant with the Vedas and gifted with wisdom. All of them care for sacrifices. All of them have Truth for their vow, and for these reasons all of them are considered as equal to great Rishis.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: श्रीश्चैव रमते तुषे धारयन्ति श्रियं च ते॥ वृथादारान् न गच्छन्ति वृथामांसं न भुञ्जते।
en: The goddess of Prosperity sports among them, and they, in their turn, support her with respect. They They never know their wives uselessly, and they never eat the flesh of such animals as have not been killed in sacrifices.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: दीप्तमग्निं जुह्वते च गुरूणां वचने स्थिताः॥ सर्वे च नियतात्मानो बालानां संविभागिनः।
en: They pour libations in the sacrificial fire (every day) and obey the commands of their preceptors and elders. All of them are of souls under perfect restraint, and never take any food without dividing it duly among their children.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: उपेत्य शनकैर्यान्ति न सेवन्ति रजस्वलाम्। स्वर्गतिं चैव गच्छन्ति तथैव शुभकर्मिणः॥
en: They always proceed on cars and other vehicles together. They never know their wives when the latter are in mcnses. They all act in such a way as to acquire regions of happiness hercafter. Indeed, they are always righteous in their deeds.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अभुक्तवस्तु नाश्नन्ति गर्भिणीवृद्धकादिषु। पूर्वाह्नेषु न दीव्यन्ति दिवा चैव न शेरते॥
en: They never cat anything themselves, when enciente women or old men have not caten. They never indulge in play or sports of any kind in the forenoon. They never sleep during the day.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: एतैश्चान्यैश्च बहुभिर्गुणैर्युक्तान् कथं कपान्। विजेष्यथ निवर्तध्वं निवृत्तानां सुखं हि वः॥
en: When the Kapas have these and many other virtues and qualities, why, indeed, would you seek to subjugate them? You should abstain from the attempt. Indeed, by such abstention you would achieve what is for your good.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ब्राह्मणा: ऊचु: कपान्वयं विजेष्यामो ये देवास्ते वयं स्मृताः। तस्माद् वध्याः कपाऽस्माकं धनिन् याहि यथाऽऽगतम्।।
en: The Brahmanas said Oh, we shail subjugate the Kapas. In this matter, we are quite of a piece with the celestials. Hence, the Kapas deserve to be killed by us. As regards Dhanin, he should return whence he came.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: धनी गत्वा कपानाह न वो विप्राः प्रियंकराः। गृहीत्वास्त्राण्यतो विप्रान् कृपाः सर्वे समाद्रवन्॥
en: After this, Dhanin, returning to the Kapas, said to them, The Brahmans are not disposed to do you any good. Hearing this, all the Kapas took up their weapons and went towards the Brahmanas.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: समुदग्रध्वजान् दृष्ट्वा कपान् सर्वे द्विजातयः। व्यसृजन ज्वलितानग्नीन् कपानां प्राणनाशनान्॥
en: Seeing the Kapas advancing against them with the standard of their cars upraised, the Brahmanas immediately created certain fires for the destruction of the vital airs of the Kapas.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: ब्रह्मसृष्टा हव्यभुजः कपान् हत्वा सनातनाः। नभसीव यथाऽभ्राणि व्यराजन्त नराधिप॥
en: Having brought about the destruction of the Kapas, those eternal fires, created with the help of the Vedic Mantras, began to shine in the firmament like so many clouds.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: हत्वा वै दानवान् देवाः सर्वे सम्भूय संयुगे। तेनाभ्यजानन् हि तदा ब्राह्मणैर्निहतान् कपान्॥
en: The gods having assembled together in battle, killed many of the Danavas. They did not know at that time that it was the Brahmanas who had encompassed their destruction.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अथागम्य महातेजा नारदोऽकथयद् विभो। यथा हता महाभागैस्तेजसा ब्राह्मणैः कपाः॥
en: Then coming there, O king, the highly energetic Narada informed the deities how their enemies, the Kapas, had been really killed by the Brahmanas of mighty cnergy.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रीता: सर्वे दिवौकसः। प्रशशंसुर्द्विजांश्चापि ब्राह्मणांश्च यशस्विनः॥
en: Hearing these words of Narada, the dwellers of Heaven became highly pleased. They also lauded those regenerate and illustrious allies of theirs.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: तेषां तेजस्तथा वीर्यं देवानां ववृधे ततः। अवाप्नुवंश्चामरत्वं त्रिषु लोकेषु पूजितम्॥
en: The energy and prowess of the celestials then began to increase, and adored in all the worlds, they acquired also the boon of immortality.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: इत्युक्तवचनं वायुमर्जुनः प्रत्युवाच ह। प्रतिपूज्य महाबाहो तत् तच्छृणु युधिष्ठिर॥
en: After the god of wind had said these words, king Arjuna adored him duly and addressing him answered in these words. Hear, O mightyarmed king, what Arjuna said.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अर्जुन उवाच जीवाम्यहं ब्राह्मणार्थं सर्वथा सततं प्रभो। ब्रह्मण्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च प्रणमामि च नित्यशः॥
en: Arjuna said O powerful god, always and by all means do I live for the Brahmanas. Devoted to them, I adore them always.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: दत्तात्रेयप्रसादाच्च मया प्राप्तमिदं बलम्। लोके च परमा कीर्तिर्धर्मश्चाचरितो महान्॥
en: Through the favour of Dattatreya I have acquired this might of mine. Through his favour I have been able to perform great feats in the world and acquire high inerit.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: अहो ब्राह्मणकर्माणि मया मारुत तत्त्वतः। त्वया प्रोक्तानि कात्स्न्येन श्रुतानि प्रयतेन च॥
en: Oh, I have with attention, heard the achievements, O god of wind, of the Brahmanas with all their interesting details as described by you truly.

description: Superiority of the Brahmanas over the Element
sn: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच ब्राह्मणान् क्षात्रधर्मेण पालयस्वेन्द्रियाणि च। भृगुभ्यस्ते भयं घोरं तत् तु कालाद् भविष्यति॥
en: The god of wind said Do you protect and maintain the Brahmanas, by performing those Kshatriya duties which are yours by birth. Do you protect them even as you protect your own senses. There is danger to you from the family of Bhrigu. All that, however, will happen on a distant day.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ब्राह्मणानर्चसे राजन् सततं संशितव्रतान्। कं तु कर्मोदयं दृष्ट्वा तानर्चसि जनाधिप॥
en: Yudhishthira said You always worship, O king, Brahmanas of praiseworthy vows. What, however, is that fruit sceing which you adore them, O king?

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: कां वा ब्राह्मणपूजायां व्युष्टिं दृष्ट्वा महाव्रत। तानसि महाबाहो सर्वमेतद् वदस्व मे॥
en: O you of high vows, secing what prosperity of the worship of the Brahmanas, do you worship them? Tell me all this, you of mighty arms.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: भीष्म उवाच एप ते केशवः सर्वमाख्यास्यति महामतिः। व्युष्टिं ब्राह्मणपूजायां दृष्टव्युष्टिर्महाव्रतः॥
en: Bhishma said Here is Keshava gifted with great intelligence. He will tell you everything. Of high vows and gifted with prosperity, he will tell you what the prosperity is of the worship of Brahmanas.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: बलं श्रोत्रे वाङ्मनश्चक्षुषी च ज्ञानं तथा सविशुद्धं ममाद्य। देहन्यासो नातिचिरान्मतो मे न चाति तूर्णं सविताद्य याति॥
en: My strength, cars, speech, mind, eyes, and that clear understanding of mine, are all clouded today. I think the time is not distant when I shall have to renounce my body. The Sun seems to me to go very slowly.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: उक्ता धर्मा ये पुराणे महान्तो राजन् विप्राणां क्षत्रियाणां विशां च। तथा शूद्राणां धर्ममुपासते च शेषं कृष्णादुपशिक्षस्व पार्थ॥
en: Those high duties, O king, which are mentioned in the Puranas as observed by Brahmanas and Kshatriyas and Vaishyas and Shudras, have all been described by me. Do you, O son of Pritha, learn from Krishna what little remains to be learnt about them.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: अहं ह्येनं वेद्मि तत्त्वेन कृष्ण योऽयं हि यच्चास्य बलं पुराणम्। अमेयात्मा केशवः कौरवेन्द्र सोऽयं धर्मे वक्ष्यति संशयेषु॥
en: I know Krishna truly. I know who he is and what his ancient might is. O chief of the Kauravas, Keshava is of immeasurable soul. Whenever doubts arise, it is he who upholds virtue then.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: कृष्णः पृथ्वीमसृजत् खं दिवं च कृष्णस्य देहान्मेदिनी सम्बभूव। वराहोऽयं भीमबलः पुराण: स पर्वतान् व्यसृजद् वै दिशश्च।॥
en: It is Krishna who created the Earth, Sky, and Heaven. Indeed, the Earth has originated from Krishna's body. Of dreadful prowess and existing from the beginning of time, it is Krishna who became the powerful Boar and raised the submerged Earth. It is He who created all the cardinal points, together with all the mountains.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: अस्य चाधोऽथान्तरिक्षं दिवं च दिशश्चतस्रो विदिशश्चतस्रः। सृष्टिस्तथैवेयमनुप्रसूता स निर्ममे विश्वमिदं पुराणम्॥
en: Below Him are the sky, Heaven, the four cardinal points, and ihe four subsidiary points. It is from Him that the entirc crcation has emanated. It is He who has created this ancient universe.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: अस्य नाभ्यां पुष्करं सम्प्रसूतं यत्रोत्पन्न: स्वयमेवामितौजा:। तेनाच्छिन्नं तत् तमः पार्थ घोरं यत् यत् तिष्ठत्यर्णवं तर्जयानम्॥
en: In His navel appeared a Lotus. Within that Lotus originated Brahman, himself of immeasurable energy. It was Brahman, O son of Pritha, who broke open that darkness which existed surpassing the very occan (in depth and extent).

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स्त्रेताकाले ज्ञानमनुप्रपन्नः। बलं त्वासीद् द्वापरे पार्थ कृष्णः कलौ त्वधर्म: क्षितिमेवाजगाम॥
en: In the Krita age, O Partha, Krishna existed in the form of Virtuc. In the Treta age, he existed in the form of Knowledge. In the Dvapara age, he existed in the form of power. In the Kali age, he came to the Earth in the form of sin.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स एव पूर्वं निजघान दैत्यान् स पूर्वदेवश्च बभूव सम्राट्। स भूतानां भावनो भूतभव्य: स विश्वस्यास्य जगतश्चाभिगोप्ता॥
en: It is He who formerly killed the Dailyas. It is he who is the Ancient God. It is He who ruled the Asuras in the form of their Emperor (Balin). It is He who is the Creator of all beings. It is He who is also the fulure of all created Beings. It is He who is also the protector of this universe having the seed of destruction.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: यदा धर्मो ग्लाति वंशे सुराणां तदा कृष्णो जायते मानुषेषु। धर्मे स्थित्वा स तु वै भावितात्मा परांश्च लोकानपरांश्च पाति॥
en: When the cause of Virtue suffers, this Krishna takes birth in the family of either the gods or among men. Staying on Virtuc, this Krishna of purified soul (on such occasions) protects both the higher and the lower worlds.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: त्याज्यं त्यक्त्वा चासुराणां वधाय कार्याकार्य कारणं चैव पार्थ। कृतं करिष्यत् क्रियते च देवो राहुं सोमं विद्धि च शक्रमेनम्॥
en: Sparing those who deserve to be spared, Krishna sets himself to the destruction of the Asuras, O Partha. It is he who is all acts proper and improper and it is he who is the cause. It is Krishna who is the act done, the act to be done, and the act that is being done. Know that the illustrious one is Rahu and Soma and Shakra.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स विश्वकर्मा स हि विश्वरूप: स विश्वभुग विश्वसृग् विश्वजिच्च। स्तं कर्मभिर्विदितं वै स्तुवन्ति॥
en: It is he who is Vishvakarman. It is he who is of universal forin. He is the destroyer and he is the Creator of the universe. He is the holder of the Shula (lance); He is of human form; and he is of terrible forin. All crcatures sing his praises, for he is known by his decds.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: मुपतिष्ठन्ते विबुधानां शतानि। तं राक्षसाच परिसंवदन्ति राजस्पोषः स विजिगीषुरेकः॥
en: Hundreds of Gandharvas and Apsaras and celestials always accompany him. The very Rakshasas sing his praises. He is the Enhancer of Wealth; He is the one Victorian Being in the universe.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: तमध्वरे शंसितारः स्तुवन्ति रथन्तरे सामगाश्च स्तुवन्ति। तं ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्ममन्त्रैः स्तुवन्ति तस्मै हविरध्वर्यवः कल्पयन्ति॥
en: In Sacrifices, cloqucnt men sing His praises. The singers of Samans praise him by reciting the Rathantaras. The Brahmanas praise him with Vedic Mantras. It is to him that the sacrificial priests pour their libations.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स पौराणी ब्रह्मगुहां प्रविष्टो महीसनं भारताने ददर्श। स चैव गामुधाराय्यकर्मा विक्षोभ्य दैत्यानुरगान् दानवांश्च॥
en: The celestials headed by Indra sang his praises when he lifted up thc Gobardhana mountains for protecting the cowherds of Vrindavan against the incessant showers that Indra poured in anger. He is, O Bharata, the one Blessing to all creatures. He, O Bharata, having entered the old Brahmacave, saw from that place the original cover of the world in the beginning of time.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: तं घोषार्थे गीर्भिरिन्द्राः स्तुवन्ति स चापीशो भारतैकः पशूनाम्। तस्य भक्षान् विविधान् वेदयन्ति तमेवाजौ वाहनं वेदयन्ति॥
en: Agitating all the Danavas and the Asuras, this Krishna of foremost deeds rescued the Earth. It is to Him that people dedicate various kinds of food, It is to Him that the warriors dedicate all kings of their cars at the time of war.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: तस्यान्तरिक्षं पृथिवी दिवं च सर्वे वशे तिष्ठति शाश्वतस्य। स कुम्भे रेतः ससृजे सुराणां यत्रोत्पन्नमृषिमाहुर्वसिष्ठम्॥
en: He is eternal, and it is under that illustrious one that the Sky, Earth, Heaven, all things exist and stay. He it was who caused the vital seed of the gods Mitra and Varuna to fall within a jar, whence originated thc Rishi known by the name of Vasishtha.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स मातरिश्वा विभुरश्ववाजी सरश्मिवान् सविता चादिदेवः। तेनासुरा विजिताः सर्व एव तद्विक्रान्तैर्विजितानीह त्रीणि॥
en: It is Krishna who is the god of wind; it is he who is the powerful Ashvins; it is he who is that first of gods, viz., the Sun living a thousand rays. It is he by whom the Asuras have been subjugated. It is he who covered the three worlds with three footsteps.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स देवानां मानुषाणां पितॄणां तमेवाहुर्यज्ञविदां वितानम्। स एव कालं विभजन्नुदेति तस्योत्तरं दक्षिणं चायने द्व।।
en: He is the soul of the celestials and human beings, and Pitris. It is he who is the Sacrifice performed by those persons who are conversant with the rituals of sacrifices. It is he who rises every day in the sky (in the form of the Sun) and divides Time into day and night, and courses for half the year northwards and for half the years southwards.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: तस्यैवोज़ तिर्यगधश्चरन्ति गभस्तयो मेदिनी भासयन्तः। तं ब्राह्मणा वेदविदो जुषन्ति तस्यादित्यो भामुपयुज्य भाति॥ स मासि मास्यध्वरकृद् विधत्ते तमध्वरे वेदविदः पठन्ति। स एवोक्तश्चक्रममिदं त्रिनाभि सप्ताश्वयुक्तं वहते वै त्रिधाम॥
en: Innumerable rays of light come out from his upwards and downwards and transversely and illumine the Earth. Brahmanas conversant with the Vedas worship him. Taking a portion of his rays the Sun shines in the sky. Month after month, the sacrificer ordains him as a sacrifice. Twiccborn persons conversant with the Vedas hymn his praises in sacrifices of all kinds. He it is who is the wheel of the year, having three naves and seven horses to drag it. It is thus that the supports the seasons.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: महातेजाः सर्वगः सर्वसिंहः कृष्णो लोकान् धारयते यथैकः। हंसं तमोध्नं च तमेव वीर कृष्णं सदा पार्थं कर्तारमेहि॥
en: Gifted with great energy, pervading all things, the foremost of all creatures, it is Krishna who alone upholds all the worlds. He is the Sun, the remover of all darkness. He is the Creator of all. Do you, O hero, approach that Krishna.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स एकदा कक्षगतो महात्मा तुष्टो विभुः खाण्डवे धूमकेतुः। स राक्षसानुरगांश्चावजित्य सर्वत्रगः सर्वमग्नौ जुहोति॥
en: Once on a time, the great and powerful Krishna lives, for a while, in the form of Agni in the forest of Khandava among some straw or dry grass. Soon was he pleased. Capable of going everywhere at will, it was Krishna who, having subjugated the Rakshasas and Uragas, poured thein as libations upon the burning fire.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स एव पार्थाय श्वेतमश्वं प्रायच्छत् स एवाश्वानथ सर्वांश्चकार। स्त्रिवृच्छिराश्चतुरश्वस्त्रिनाभिः॥
en: It is Krishna who gave to Arjuna a number of white horses. It is he who is the creator of all horses. This world represents his car. He it is who yokes that car for setting it in motion. That car has three whcels. It has three kinds of motion. It has four horses yoked it. It has three naves.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स विहायो व्यदधात् पञ्चनाभिः स निर्ममे गां दिवमन्तरिक्षम्। सोऽरण्यानि व्यसृजत् पर्वतांश्च हृषीकेशोऽमितदीप्ताग्नितेजाः॥ अलंघयद् वै सरितो जिघांसन् शक्रं वज्रं प्रहरन्तं निरास स महेन्द्रः स्तूयते वै महाध्वरे विगैरेको ऋक्सहस्रः पुराणैः॥
en: It is this Krishna who is the refuge of the five original elements with the sky among them. It is he who created the Earth and Heaven and the intervening space. Indeed, it is the Krishna of immeasurable and burning energy who has created the forests and the mountains. It is this Krishna who, desirous of punishing Shakra who was about to hurl his thunder at him, crossed the rivers and at once paralysed him. He is the one great Indra who is worshipped by the Brahmanas in great sacrifices with the help of a thousand old Richs.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: दुर्वासा वै तेन नान्येन शक्यो गृहे राजन् वासयितुं महौजाः। तमेवाहुर्ऋषिमेकं पुराणं स विश्वकृद् विदधात्यात्मभावान्॥
en: It was this Krishna, O king, who alone was able to keep the highly energetic Rishi Durvasas as a guest for some time in his house. He is said to be the one ancient Rishi. He is the Creator of the universe. Indeed, he creates everything from his own nature.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: वेदांश्च यो वेदयतेऽधिदेवो विधींश्च यश्चाश्रयते पुराणान्। कामे वेदे लौकिके यत्फलं च विष्वक्सेनः सर्वमेतत् प्रतीहि॥
en: Superior to all the celestials, it is he who teaches all the deities. He scrupulously observes all ancient ordinances. Know, O king, that this Krishna, who is called Vishvaksena, is the fruit of all deeds which relate to pleasure, of all deeds which are founded on the Vedas, and of all deeds which appertain to the world.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: ज्योतींषि शुक्लानि हि सर्वलोके त्रयो लोका लोकपालास्त्रयश्च। त्रयोऽग्नयो व्याहृतयश्च तिस्रः सर्वे देवा देवकीपुत्र एव॥
en: He is the white rays of light which are seen in all the worlds. He is the threc worlds. He is the thrce Regents of all the worlds. He is the threc sacrificial fires He is the three Vyahritis; indeed, this son of Devaki is all the gods together.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स वत्सरः स ऋतुः सोऽर्धमासः सोऽहोरात्रः स कला वै स काष्ठाः। मात्र मुहूर्ताश्च लवाः क्षणाश्च विष्वक्सेनः सर्वमेतत् प्रतीहि॥
en: He is the Ycar; He is the Season; He is the Fortnights; He is the Day and the Night; He is those divisions of time which are called Kalas, and Kashthas, and Matras, and Muhurtas, and Lavas, and Kshanas, Know that this Vishvaksena is all these.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: चन्द्रादित्यौ ग्रहनक्षत्रताराः सर्वाणि दर्शान्यथ पौर्णमासम्। नक्षत्रयोगा ऋतवश्च पार्थ विष्वक्सेनात् सर्वमेतत् प्रसूतम्॥
en: The Moon and the Sun, the Planets, the Constellations, and the Stars, all the Parva days, including the day of the full moon, the conjunctions of the constellations, and the seasons, have, O son of Pritha, emanated from this Krishna who is Vishvaksena.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: रुद्रादित्या वसवोऽथाश्चिनौ च साध्याश्च विश्वे मरुतां गणाश्च। प्रजापतिर्देवमातादितिश्च सर्वे कृष्णादृषयश्चैव सप्त॥
en: The Rudras, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Ashvins, the Saddhyas, the Vishvedevas, the Maruts, Prajapati himself, the mother of the celestials, viz., Aditi and the seven Rishis, have all originated from Krishna.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: मग्निर्भूत्वा दहते विश्वरूपः। आपो भूत्वा मज्जयते च सर्वे ब्रह्मा भूत्वा सृजते विश्वसंघान्॥
en: Changing himself into the Wind, he scatters the universe. Of universal form, he becomes fire which consumes all things. Changing himself into Water, he drenches and submerges all, and assuming the form of Brahmans, he creates all the various animate and inanimate creatures.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: वेद्यं च यद् वेदयते च वेद्यं विधिश्च यश्च श्रयते विधेयम्। धर्मे च वेदे च बले च सर्वं चराचरं केशवं त्वं प्रतीहि॥
en: He is himself the Veda, yet he learns all the Vedas. He is himself all the ordinances, yet he observes all the ordinances which have been laid down in matters connccted with Righteousness and the Vedas and that force or might which rules the world. Indeed, know, O Yudhishthira, that this Keshava is all the mobile and immobile universe.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: ज्योतिर्भूतः परमोऽसौ पुरस्तात् प्रकाशते यत्प्रभया विश्वरूपः। अप: सृष्ट्वा सर्वभूतात्मयोनिः पुराकरोत् सर्वमेवाथ विश्वम्॥
en: He is of the form of the most resplendent light. Of universal form, this Krishna is shorn in that blazing cffulgence. The original cause of the soul of all existent crcatures, he at first created the waters. Afterwards he created this universe.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: ऋतूनुत्पातान् विविधान्यद्भुतानि मेघान् विद्युत्सर्वमैरावतं च। सर्वे कृष्णात् स्थावरं जङ्गमं च विश्वात्मानं विष्णुमेनं प्रतीहि।३८।।
en: Know that this Krishna is Vishnu. Know him to be the soul of the entire universe. Know him to be all the scasons; he is these various wonderful visitations of Nature which we sec; he is the clouds that pour rain and the lightning which fleshes in the sky. He is the clephant Airavata. In fact, he is the immobile and mobile universe.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: विश्वावासं निर्गुणं वासुदेवं संकर्षणं जीवभूतं वदन्ति। माज्ञापयत्यात्मयोनिर्महात्मा॥
en: The clay of the universe and above all attributes, this Krishna is Vasudeva When he becomes individual soul he is called Sankarshana. Next, he changes himself into Pradyumna and them into Aniruddha. Thus, the great Krishna, who has sprung from himself, divides himself in fourfold form.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स पञ्चधा पञ्चजनोपपन्न संचोदयन् विश्वमिदं सिसृक्षुः। ततश्चकारावनिमारुतौ च खं ज्योतिरम्भश्च तथैव पार्थ॥
en: For crcating this universe which consists of the five primal elements, he begins this work, and causcs it to go on in the fivefold form of animate existence containing celestial and Asuras and human beings and beasts and birds. He it is who then creates the Earth and the Wind, the Sky, Light, and also Water, O son of Pritha.

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
sn: स स्थावरं जङ्गमं चैवमेतच्चतुर्विधं लोकमिमं च कृत्वा। ततो भूमि व्यदधात् पञ्चवीजां द्यौः पृथिव्यां धास्यति भूरि वारि॥
en: Having created this universe of immobile and mobile objects divided into four orders of being (viz., viviparous, oviparous, vegetable, and fifthborn), he then created the Earth with her five fold seed. He then created the Sky for pouring copious rain on the Earth,

description: The prosperity following the worship of the Brahmanas
