sn: महानात्मा तथाव्यक्तमहंकारस्तथैव च। इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च महाभूतानि पञ्च च॥ विशेषाः पञ्चभूतानामिति सर्गः सनातनः। चतुर्विंशतिरेका च तत्त्वसंख्या प्रकीर्तिता॥
en: The great soul, the uninanifest, egoisin, the eleven organs (of knowledge and action), the five great elements, the characteristics of the five elements, these form the eternal creation. The number of clements has been said to be twenty-four and one (more).

description: An account of Brahman the highest object of Knowledge
sn: तत्त्वानामथ यो वेद सर्वेषां प्रभवाप्ययौ। स धीरः सर्वभूतेषु न मोहमधिगच्छति॥
en: That wise person who understands the production and destruction of all these elements, that man among all creatures, never meets with delusion.

description: An account of Brahman the highest object of Knowledge
sn: तत्त्वानि यो वेदयते यथातथं गुणांश्च सर्वानखिलांश्च देवताः। विधूतपाप्मा प्रतिमुच्य बन्धनं स सर्वलोकानमलान् समश्नुते॥
en: Hc who understands the elements accurately, all the qualities, all the celestials, succeeds in purifying himself of all sin. Freed from all fetters, such a man succeeds in enjoying all regions of spotless purity.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: ब्राह्मण उवाच तदव्यक्तमनुद्रिक्तं सर्वव्यापि ध्रुवं स्थिरम्। नवद्वारं पुरं विद्यात् त्रिगुणं पञ्चधातुकम्॥
en: Brahman said That which is unmanifest, which is indistinct, all-pervading, everlasting, immutablc, should be known to become the city of nine portals, possessed of three qualities, and consisting of five ingredients.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: एकादशपरिक्षेपं मनोव्याकरणात्मकम्। बुद्धिस्वामिकमित्येतत् परमेकादशं भवेत्॥
en: Encompassed by cleven including Mind which distinguishes (objects) and having Understanding for the ruler, this is an aggregate of cleven.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: त्रीणि स्रोतांसि यान्यस्मिन्नाप्यायन्ते पुनः पुनः। प्रनाड्यस्तिस्र एवैताः प्रवर्तन्ते गुणात्मिका:॥
en: The three ducts that are in it, support it always. These are ihe three Nadis. They run continually, and have the three qualities for their essence.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: तमो रजस्तथा सत्त्वं गुणानेतान् प्रचक्षते। अन्योन्यमिथुनाः सर्वे तथान्योन्यानुजीविनः॥
en: Ignorance, Darkness, and Goodness, these are called the (three) qualities. These are connected with one another. They exist depending on one another.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: अन्योन्यापाश्चयाश्चापि तथान्योन्यानुवर्तिनः। अन्योन्यव्यतिषक्ताश्च त्रिगुणाः पञ्चधातवः॥
en: They take refuge in one another, and follow one another. They are also joined with one another. The five (principal) elements are marked by (these) three qualities.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: तमसो मिथुनं सत्त्वं सत्त्वस्य मिथुनं रजः। रजसञ्चापि सत्त्वं स्यात् सत्त्वस्य मिथुनं तमः॥
en: Goodness is also the match of Ignorance. Of goodness the match of Darkness. Goodness is also the match of Darkness, and of Goodness the match is Ignorance.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: नियम्यते तमो यत्र रजस्तत्र प्रवर्तते। नियम्यते रजो यत्र सत्त्वं तत्र प्रवर्तते॥
en: There where Ignorance is restrained, Darkness is seen to flow. There where Darkness is restrained, Goodness is scen to flow.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: नैशात्मक तमो विद्यात् त्रिगुणं मोडसंज्ञितम्। अधर्मलक्षणं चैव नियतं पापकर्मसु। तामसं रूपमेतत् तु दृश्यते चापि सङ्गत्तम्॥
en: Darkness should be known to have the night for its essence. It has three marks, and is (otherwise) called Delusion. It has sin also for its mark, and it is always present in all sinful deeds. This is the nature of Ignorance and it appears also as confined with others.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: प्रकृत्यात्मकमेवाहू रजः पर्यायकारकम्। प्रवृत्तं सर्वभूतेषु दृश्यमुत्पत्तिलक्षणम्॥
en: Darkness is said to have activity for its essence. It is the cause of successive deeds. When it predominates, its mark, among all beings, is production,

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: प्रकाशं सर्वभूतेषु लाघवं श्रद्दधानता। सात्त्विक रूपमेवं तु लाघवं साधुसम्मितम्॥
en: Splendour, lightness, and faith-these are the form, that is light, of Goodness among all creatures, as considered by all good men.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: एतेषां गुणतत्त्वानि वक्ष्यन्ते तत्त्वहेतुभिः। समासव्यासयुक्तानि तत्त्वतस्तानि बोधत॥
en: The true nature of their marks will now be declared by me, with reasons. These shall be stated in aggregation and separation. Do you understand them.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: सम्मोहोऽज्ञानमत्यागः कर्मणामविनिर्णयः। स्वप्नः स्तम्भो भयं लोभः स्वतः सुकृतदूषणम्॥ अस्मृतिश्चाविपाकश्च नास्तिक्यं भिन्नवृत्तिता। निर्विशेषत्वमन्धत्वं जघन्यगुणवृत्तिता॥ अकृते कृतमानित्वमज्ञाने ज्ञानमानिता। अमैत्री विकृताभावो ह्यश्रद्धा मूढभावना॥ अनार्जवमसंज्ञत्वं कर्म पापचेतना। गुरुत्वं सन्नभावत्वमवशित्वमवाग्गतिः॥ सर्व एते गुणा वृत्तास्तामसाः सम्प्रकीर्तिताः। ये चान्ये विहिता भावा लोकेऽस्मिन् भावसंज्ञिताः।। तत्र तत्र नियम्यन्ते सर्वे ते तामसा गुणाः। परिवादकथा नित्यं देवब्राह्मणवैदिकी॥ अत्यागश्चाभिमानश्च मोहो मन्युस्तथाक्षमा। मत्सरश्चैव भूतेषु तामसं वृत्तमिप्यते॥
en: Complete delusion, Ignorance, illiberality, indecision about action, sleep, haughtiness, fcar, cupidity, grief, censure of good deeds, loss of meinory, unripeness of judgeinent, absence of faith, violation of all rules of conduct, want of discrimination, blindness, vileness of conduct, boastful assertion of performance when there has been performance, presumption of knowledge in ignorance, unfriendliness (or hostility), evilness of disposition, absence of faith, stupid reasoning, crookedness, incapacity for association, sinfull action, senselessness, stolidity, assitude, absence of self-control, degradation, all these qualities are known as no belonging to Ignorance. Whatever other states of mid, connected with delusion, exist in the world, all belong to Ignorance, Frequent illspeaking of other people, censuring the celestials and the Brahmanas, illiberality, vanity, delusion, anger, unforgiveness, hostility towards all creatures, are considered as the characteristics of Ignorance.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: वृथारम्भा हि ये केचिद् वृथा दानानि यानि च। वृथा भक्षणमित्येतत् तामसं वृत्तमिष्यते॥
en: Whatever undertakings exist which are unmeritorious, what gifts there are which are unmeritorious, vain cating, these also belong to Ignorance.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: अतिवादोऽतितिक्षा च मात्सर्यमभिमानिता। अश्रद्दधानता चैव तामसं वृत्तमिष्यते॥
en: Indulgence in calumny, unforgiveness, animosity, vanity, and absence of faith are also said to be characteristic of Ignorance.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: एवंविधाश्च ये केचिल्लोकेऽस्मिन् पापकर्मिणः। मनुष्या भिन्नमर्यादास्ते सर्वे तामसाः स्मृताः॥
en: Whatever men there are in this world, who are characterised by these and other faults of a similar kind, and who break through the restraints are all considered as belonging is the quality of Ignorance.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: तेषां योनीः प्रवक्ष्यामि नियताः पापकर्मिणाम्। अवानिरयभावा ये तिर्यनिरयगामिनः॥
en: I shall now declare the wombs wherс these men, who are always of sinful deeds, have to take their birth. Ordained to go to hell, they sink in the order of being. Indeed, they sink into the hell of the brute creation.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: स्थावराणि च भूतानि पशवो वाहनानि च। क्रव्यादा दन्दशूकाश्च कृमिकीटविहंगमाः॥ अण्डजा जन्तवश्चैव सर्वे चापि चतुष्पदाः। उन्मत्ता बधिरा मूका ये चान्ये पापरोगिणः॥
en: They become immobile entities, or animals, or beasts of burden; or carnivorous creatures, or snakes, or worms, insects, and birds; or creatures of the oviparous order, or quadrupeds of various species, or lunatics, or deal or bomb human beings, or men who are afflicted by dreadful maladies and considered as unclcan.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: मग्नास्तमसि दुर्वृत्ताः स्वकर्म कृतलक्षणाः। अवाक्स्रोतस इत्येते मग्नास्तमसि तामसाः॥
en: These men of evil conduct, always show the marks of their deeds, sink in Ignorance. Their course is always downwards. Belonging to the quality of Ignorance, they sink in Ignorance.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: तेषामुत्कर्षमुद्रेकं वक्ष्याम्यहमत: परम्। यथा ते सुकृताँल्लोकाँल्लभन्ते पुण्यकर्मिणः॥
en: I shall, after this, declare what the means are of their improvement and ascent; indeed, by what means they succeed in acquiring the regions which exist for men of pious deeds.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: अन्यथा प्रतिपन्नास्तु विवृद्धा ये च कर्मणः। स्वकर्मनिरतानां च ब्राह्मणानां शुभैषिणाम्॥ संस्कारेणोर्ध्वमायान्ति यतमाना: सलोकताम्। स्वर्गे गच्छन्ति देवानामित्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः॥
en: Those men who take birth in orders other than human beings, by growing up in view of the religions ceremonies of Brahmanas devoted to the duties of their own caste and desirous of doing good to all creatures, succeed through the help of such purificatory rites, in ascending upwards. Indeed, struggling, they at last attain the sam? regions with thcsc pious Brahmanas. Indeed, they go to the celestial region. This is the Vedic Shruti.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: अन्यथा प्रतिपन्नास्ते विबुद्धाः स्वेष कर्मसु। पुनरावृत्तिधर्माणस्ते भवन्तीह मानुषा:॥
en: Born in orders other then humanity and growing old in their respective deeds, cven thus they become human beings that are, of course, ordained to return.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: पापयोनिं समापन्नाश्चण्डाला मूकचूचुकाः। वर्णान् पर्यायशश्चापि प्राप्नुवन्त्युत्तरोत्तरम्॥ शूद्रयोनिमतिक्रम्य ये चान्ये तामसा गुणाः। स्रोतोमध्ये समागम्य वर्तन्ते तामसे गुणे॥
en: Coming to sinful births and becoming Chandalas or human beings that are deaf or to who lisp indistinctly, they attain to higher and higher castes, one after another in proper turn, getting above the Shudra order, and other (consequences of) qualities which belong to Ignorance and who abide in it in course of migrations this world.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: अभिष्वङ्गस्तु कामेषु महामोह इति स्मृतः। ऋषयो मुनयो देवा मुह्यन्त्यत्र सुखेप्सवः॥
en: Attachment to objects of desire is considered as great delusion. Here Rishis and Munis and celestials become deluded, desirous of pleasure.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: तमो मोहो महामोहस्तामिस्रः क्रोधसंज्ञितः। मरणं त्वन्धतामिस्रस्तामिस्रः क्रोध उच्यते॥
en: Ignorance, delusion, the great delusion, the great obscurity called anger, and death, that blinding obscurity. As regards anger, that is the great obscurity.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: वर्णतो गुणतश्चैव योनितश्चैव तत्त्वतः। सर्वमेतत्तमो विप्राः कीर्तितं वो यथाविधि॥
en: With respect then to its colour, its characteristics, and its source, I have, you learned Brahmanas, declared to you, accurately and in due order, everything, about Ignorance.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: कोन्वेतद् बुध्यते साधु कोन्वेतत् साधु पश्यति। अतत्त्वे तत्त्वदर्शी यस्तमसस्तत्त्वलक्षणम्॥
en: Who is there what truly gets over it? Who is there who truly sees it? That indeed, is the characteristic of Ignorance, viz., the seeing of reality in what is not real.

description: The three qualities and the means of improvement
sn: तमोगुणा बहुविधाः प्रकीर्तिता यथावदुक्तं च तमः परावरम्। नरो हि यो वेद गुणानिमान् सदा स तामसैः सर्वगुणैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: The qualities of Ignorance have been declared to you in various ways. Duly has Ignorance, in its higher and lower forms, been described to you. That man who always bears in mind the qualities mentioned here will surely succeed in becoming freed from all marks which belong to Ignorance.

sn: ब्राह्मण उवाच रजोऽहं वः प्रवक्ष्यामि याथातथ्येन सत्तमाः। निबोधत महाभागा गुणवृत्तं च राजसम्॥
en: You best of beings, I shall now declare to you accurately what (the quality of) Darkness is. You highly blessed ones, do you understand what those qualities are that belong to Darkness.

sn: सन्तापो रूपमायास: सुखदुःखे हिमातपौ। ऐश्वर्ये विग्रहः संधिर्हेतुवादोऽरतिः क्षमा॥ बलं शौर्यं मदो रोषो व्यायामकलहावपि। ईयेप्सा पिशुनं युद्धं ममत्वं परिपालनम्॥ वधबन्धपरिक्लेशाः क्रयो विक्रय एव च। निकृन्त छिन्धि भिन्धीति परवर्मावकर्तनम्॥ उग्रं दारुणमाक्रोशः परच्छिद्रानुशासनम्। लोकचिन्तानुचिन्ता च मत्सरः परिपालनम्॥ मृषा वादो मृषा दानं विकल्पः परिभाषणम्। निन्दा स्तुतिः प्रशंसा च प्रतापः परिधर्षणम्॥ परिचर्यानुशुश्रूषा सेवा तृष्णा व्यापाश्रयः। व्यूहो नयः प्रमादश्च परिवादः परिग्रहः॥ संस्कारा ये च लोकेषु प्रवर्तन्ते पृथक्पृथक्। नृषु नारीषु भूतेषु द्रव्येषु शरणेषु च।॥ संतापोऽप्रत्ययश्चैव व्रतानि नियमाश्च ये। आशीर्युक्तानि कर्माणि पौर्तानि विविधानि च॥ स्वाहाकारो नमस्कारः स्वधाकारो वषक्रिया। याजनाध्य.पने चोभे यजनाध्ययने अपि॥ दानं प्रतिग्रहश्चैव प्रायश्चित्तानि मङ्गलम्। इदं मे स्यादिदं मे स्यात्स्नेहो गुणसमुद्भवः॥ अभिद्रोहस्तथा माया निकृतिर्मान एव च। स्तैन्यं हिंसा जुगुप्सा च परितापः प्रजागरः॥ दम्भो दर्पोऽथ रागश्च भक्तिः प्रीतिः प्रमोदनम्। द्यूतं च जनवादश्च सम्बन्धाः स्त्रीकृताश्च ये॥ ये च च केचन। नृत्यवादित्रगीतानां प्रसङ्गा सर्व एते गुणा विप्रा राजसाः सम्प्रकीर्तिताः॥
en: Injuring (others), beauty, toil, pleasure and pain, cold and heat, lordship (or power), war, peace, argument, dissatisfaction, endurance, power, valour, pride, anger, exertion, quarrel (or collision), jealousy, desire, malice, battle, the sense of mineness, protection (of others), destruction fetters and affliction, buying and selling, lopping off, cutting, piercing, and cutting off the coat of mail that another has worn, fierceness, cruelty, vilifying, pointing out the faults of others, thoughts entirely devoted to worldly affairs, anxiety, animosity, vilification of others, false speech, false or vain gifts, hesitancy and doubt, boastfulness of speech dispraise and praise, laudation, prowess, defiance, attendance, obedience, servicc or ministrations, harbouring of thirst or desire, cleverness or dexterity of conduct, policy, carelessness, contumely, possessions, and various decorations which prevail in the world among men, women, animals, inanimate things, bouses, gricf, incredulousness, Vows and regulations, actions with expectation (of good results) various acts of public charity, the rites of Svaha salutations, rites of Svadha and Vashat, officiating at the sacrifices of others, imparting of instruction, performance of sacrifices, study, making of gifts, acceptance of giſts, riles of expiation, auspicious acts, the wish to have this and that, affection caused by the merits of the object for which or whom it is felt, treachery deception, disrespect and respect, theft, killing, desire of concealment, vexation, wakefulness, ostentation, pride, attachment, devotion, contentment, exultation, gambling, indulgence in scandal, all relations arising out of women, attachment to dancing, instrumental music, and songs, all these qualities, you learned Brahmanas, have been said to belong to Rajas or Darkness.

sn: भूतभव्यभविष्याणां भावानां भुवि भावनाः। त्रिवर्गनिरता नित्यं धर्मोऽर्थः काम इत्यपि॥ कामवृत्ताः प्रमोदन्ते सर्वकामसमृद्धिभिः। अर्वाक्स्रोतस इत्येते मनुष्या रजसा वृताः॥
en: These men on Earth who meditate on the past, present, and the future, who are devoted to the threefold objects of life, viz., Religion, Profit, and Pleasure, who, acting from the impulse of desire, exult on acquiring riches in respect of every desire, are said to be covered by Darkness. These men have downward courses.

sn: अस्मिँल्लोके प्रमोदन्ते जायमानाः पुनः पुनः। प्रेत्य भाविकमीहन्ते ऐहलौकिकमेव च। ददति प्रतिगृह्णन्ति तर्पयन्त्यथ जुह्वति॥
en: Repeatedly reborn in this world, they addict theinselves to pleasure. They covet what belongs to this world as also all those fruits of the world to come. They make gifts, accept gifts, offer oblations to the departed manes, and pour libations on the sacrificial fire.

sn: रजोगुणा वो बहुधानुकीर्तिता यथावदुक्तं गुणवृत्तमेव च। नरोऽपि यो वेद गुणानिमान् सदा स राजसैः सर्वगुणर्विमुच्यते॥
en: The qualities of Darkness have (thus) been declared to you in their manifold aspects. The course of conduct also to which it leads has been properly described to you. The man who always understands these qualities, succeeds in always liberating himself from all of them which belong to Darkness.

sn: ब्राह्मण उवाच अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि तृतीयं गुणमुत्तमम्। सर्वभूतहितं लोके सतां धर्ममनिन्दितम्॥
en: Brahman said I shall, after this, describe to you that excellent quality which is the third. It is beneficial to all creatures in the world, and unblamable, and forms the conduct of the good.

sn: आनन्दः प्रीतिरुद्रेक: प्रकाश्यं सुखमेव च। अकार्पण्यमसंरम्भः सन्तोष: श्रद्दधानता॥ क्षमा धृतिरहिंसा च समता सत्यमार्जवम्। अक्रोधश्चानसूया च शौचं दाक्ष्यं पराक्रमः॥
en: Joy, satisfaction, nobility, enlightenment, and happiness, absence of stinginess, absence of fear, contentment, disposition for faith, forgiveness, courage, abstention from injuring any creature, equability, truth, straightforwardness, absence of anger, absence of malice, purity, cleverness, prowess, belong to the quality of Goodness.

sn: मुधा ज्ञानं मुधा वृत्तं मुधा सेवा मुधा श्रमः। एवं यो युक्तधर्मः स्यात् सोऽमुत्रात्यन्तमश्नुते॥
en: He who is devoted to the duty of Yoga, considering knowledge to the vain conduct to be vain, service to be vain, and mode of life to be vain, attains to what is highest in the next world.

sn: निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो निराशी: सर्वतः समः। अकामभूत इत्येव सतां धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Freedom from cgoism, freedom from expectations, loO king on all impartially, and freedom from desire, these form the cternal religion of the good.

sn: विश्राभो हीस्तितिक्षा च त्याग शौचमतन्द्रिता। आनृशंस्यमसम्मोहो दया भूतेष्वपैशुनम्॥ हर्षस्तुष्टिविस्मयश्च विनयः साधुवृत्तिता। शान्तिकी शुद्धिश्च शुभा बुद्धिर्विमोचनम्॥ उपेक्षा ब्रह्मचर्ये च परित्यागश्च सर्वशः। निर्ममत्वमनाशीष्ट्वमपरिक्षतधर्मता॥ मुधा दानं मुधा यज्ञो मुधाऽधीतं मुधा व्रतम्। मुधा प्रतिग्रहश्चैव मुधा धर्मो मुधा तपः॥
en: Confidence, modesty, forgiveness, renunciation, purity, absence of laziness, absence of cruelty, absence of delusion, mercy to all creatures, absence of the disposition to calumniate, exultation, satisfaction, rapture, humility, good conduct, purity in all acts having for their object the attainment of tranquility, righteous understanding, liberation, indifference, celibacy, complete renunciation, freedom from the idea of mineness, freedom from expectations, unbroken observance of virtuc, belic that gifts are vain, sacrifices are vain, study is vain, vows are vain, acceptance of gifts is vain, observance of duties is vain, and penances are vain.

sn: एवंवृत्तास्तु ये केचिल्लोकेऽस्मिन् सत्त्वसंश्रयाः। ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मयोनिस्थास्ते धीराः साधुदर्शिनः॥
en: Those Brahmanas in this world, whose conduct is marked by these virtues, who follow virtue, who abide in the Vedas, are said to be wise and possessed of correctness of vision.

sn: हित्वा सर्वाणि पापानि निःशोका ह्यथ मानवाः। दिवं प्राप्य तु ते धीराः कुर्वते वै ततस्तनूः॥
en: Freed from sins and grief, those wise men attain to the celestial region and create various bodies (for themselves).

sn: ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च लघुत्वं मनसश्च ते। विकुर्वते महात्मानो देवास्त्रिदिवगा इव॥
en: The power of governing everything, selfcontrol, minuteness, these great ones make by operations of their own mind, like the gods themselves living in the celestial region.

sn: अर्ध्वस्रोतस इत्येते देवा वैकारिकाः स्मृताः। विकुर्वन्तः प्रकृत्या वै दिवं प्राप्तास्ततस्ततः॥
en: Such men are said to have their courses directed upwards. They are veritable gods capable of modifying all things. Attaining to the celestial region, they modify all things by their very nature.

sn: यद् यदिच्छन्ति तत् सर्व भजन्ते विभजन्ति च। इत्येतत् सात्त्विकं वृत्तं कथितं वो द्विजर्षभाः। एतद् विज्ञाय लभते विधिवद् यद् यदिच्छति॥
en: They get whatever objects they desire and cnjoy them. Thus have I, you foremost of twice-born ones, described to you what that conduct is which belongs to the quality of goodness. Understanding these duly, one acquires whatever objects one desires.

sn: प्रकीर्तिताः सत्त्वगुणा विशेषतो यथावदुक्त गुणवृत्तमेव च। नरस्तु यो वेद गुणानिमान् सदा गुणान् स भुङ्क्ते न गुणैः स युज्यते।
en: The qualities which belong to goodness have been declared particularly. The conduct which those qualities form, has also been properly described. That man who always understands these qualities, succeeds in enjoying the qualities without being attached to them.

sn: नरस्तु यो वेद गुणानिमान् सदा गुणान् स भुङ्क्ते न गुणैः स युज्यते।
en: The qualities which belong to goodness have been declared particularly. The conduct which those qualities form, has also been properly described. That man who always understands these qualities, succeeds in enjoying the qualities without being attached to them.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: नैव शक्या गुणा वक्तुं पृथक्त्वेनैव सर्वशः। अविच्छिन्नानि दृश्यन्ते रजः सत्त्वं तमस्तथा॥
en: The qualities are incapable of being described as completely separate from one another. Darkness and Goodness and Ignorance are seen existing in a state of union.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: अन्योन्यमथ रज्यन्ते ह्यन्योन्यं चार्थजीविनः। अन्योन्यमाश्रयाः सर्वे तथान्योन्यानुवर्तिनः॥
en: They are attached to one another. They depend on one another. The have one another for their support. They likewise follow one another.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: यावत्सत्त्वं रजस्तावद् वर्तते नात्र संशयः। यावत्तमश्च सत्त्वं च रजस्तावदिहोच्यते॥
en: As long as goodness exists, so long does Darkness cxist. There is no doubt in this. As long as Ignorance and Goodness exist, so long does Darkness exist.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: संहत्य कुर्वते यात्रां सहिताः संघचारिणः। संघातवृत्तयो ह्येते वर्तन्ते हेत्वहेतुभिः॥
en: They travel together, in union, and moving collectively. They move in a body; when they act with cause or without cause.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: उद्रेकव्यतिरिक्तानां तेषामन्योन्यवर्तिनाम्। वक्ष्यते तद् यथा न्यूनं व्यतिरिक्तं च सर्वशः॥
en: Of all these which work with one another however much they may differ in their an development, the manner in which their increase and diminution take place will now be described.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: व्यतिरिक्तं तमो यत्र तिर्यग् भावगतं भवेत्। अल्पं तत्र रजो ज्ञेयं सत्त्वमल्पतरं तथा॥
en: There where Ignorance exists in increased measure, in the lower creatures (for example), Darkness exists in a smaller measure and Goodness in a still lesser degree.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: उद्रिक्त च रजो यत्र मध्यस्रोतोगतं भवेत्। अल्पं तत्र तमो ज्ञेयं सत्त्वमल्पतरं तथा॥
en: These where Darkness predominates, in creatures of middle course, Ignorance exists in a smaller measure and Goodness in a still smaller quantity.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: उद्रिक्तं च यदा सत्त्वमूर्ध्वस्रोतोगतं भवेत्। अल्पं तत्र तमो ज्ञेयं रजश्चाल्पतरं तथा॥
en: There where Goodness predominates in creatures of upward course, Ignorance should be known to exist in a small measure, and Darkness in a still lesser quantity.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: सत्त्वं वैकारिकी योनिरिन्द्रियाणां प्रकाशिका। न हि सत्त्वात् परो धर्मः कश्चिदन्यो विधीयते॥
en: Goodness is the spring which causes the modification of the senses. It is, again, the great enlightener. No duty has been laid down that is higher than Goodness.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: ऊर्ध्व गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः। जघन्यगुणसंयुक्ता यान्त्यधस्तामसा जनाः॥
en: They who abide in Goodness proceed upwards. They who abide in Darkness remain in the middle. They who abide in Ignorance being characterised by qualities that are low, sink downwards.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: तमः शूद्रे रजः क्षत्रे ब्राह्मणे सत्त्वमुत्तमम्। इत्येवं त्रिषु वर्णेषु विवर्तन्ते गुणास्त्रयः॥
en: Ignorance is in the Shudra; Darkness in the Kshatriya; and Goodness, which is the highest, in the Brahmana. The three qualities exist thus in the three castes.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: दूरादपि हि दृश्यन्ते सहिताः संघचारिणः। तमः सत्त्वं रजश्चैव पृथक्त्वे नानुशुश्रुम॥ उच्यते॥
en: From a distance, the three qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance, are seen to exist in a state of union and more collectively. They are never seen in a state of separation.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: दृष्ट्वा त्वादित्यमुद्यन्तं कुचराणां भयं भवेत्। अध्वगाः परितप्येयुरुष्णतो दुःखभागिनः॥
en: Seeing the Sun rising, men of evil deeds become filled with fear. Travellers on their way become afflicted with heat, and suffer distress.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: आदित्यः सत्त्वमुद्रिक्तं कुचरास्तु तथा तमः। परितापोऽध्वगानां च रजसो गुण
en: The Sun is Goodness developed; men of evil deeds represent Ignorance; the heat which travellers on their way feel, is said to be a quality of Darkness.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: प्रकाश्यं सत्त्वमादित्यः संतापो रजसो गुणः। उपप्लवस्तु विज्ञेयस्तामसस्तस्य पर्वसु॥
en: Thic Sun representing light is Goodness; the heat is the quality of Darkness; the shading (or eclipse) of the Sun on Parvan days, should be known to represent Ignorance.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: एवं ज्योतिष्षु सर्वेषु निवर्तन्ते गुणास्त्रयः। पर्यायेण च वर्तन्ते तत्र तत्र तथा तथा॥
en: Thus, the three qualities exist in all luminous bodies. They act by turns in various places in various ways.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: स्थावरेषु तु भावेषु तिर्यग्भावगतं तमः। राजसास्तु विवर्तन्ते स्नेहभावस्तु सात्त्विकः॥
en: Among immobile objects, the quality of Ignorance predominates. The qualities belonging to Darkness are those properties of their is which suffer constant changes. Their oleaginous qualities belong to Goodness.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: अहस्त्रिधा तु विज्ञेयं त्रिधा रात्रिविधीयते। मासार्धमासवर्षाणि ऋतवः संधयस्तथा॥
en: The Day should be understood as threefold. The Night has been ordained to be threefold. So also are fortnights, months, years, seasons, and conjunctions.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: त्रिधा दानानि दीयन्ते त्रिधा यज्ञः प्रवर्तते। त्रिधा लोकास्त्रिधा देवास्त्रिधा विद्यास्त्रिधा गतिः।।१९
en: The gifts are threefold. Threefold is sacrifice. Threefold are the worlds; threefold the celestials; threefold is knowledge; and threefold the path or end.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च धर्मोऽर्थः काम एव च। प्राणापानावुदाश्चाप्येत एव त्रयो गुणाः॥
en: The Past, the Present, and the future, Religion, Profit and Pleasure, Prana, Apana, and Udana, these also are permeated by the three qualities.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: पर्यायेण प्रवर्तन्ते तत्र तत्र तथा तथा। यत्किंचिदिह लोकेऽस्मिन् सर्वमेते त्रयो गुणाः॥
en: Whatever object exists in this world, everything in it, is fraught with the three qualities. The three qualities act by turns in all things and in all circumstances.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: त्रयो गुणाः प्रवर्तन्ते ह्यव्यक्ता नित्यमेव तु। सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव गुणसर्ग: सनातनः॥
en: Indeed, the three qualities always act in an unmanifest form. The creation of those three, viz., Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance is eternal.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: तमो व्यक्तं शिवं धाम रजो योनिः सनातनः। प्रकृतिर्विकारः प्रायः प्रधानं प्रभवाप्ययौ॥ अनुद्रिक्तमनूनं वाप्यकम्पमचलं ध्रुवम्। सदसच्चैव तत् सर्वमव्यक्तं त्रिगुणं स्मृतम्। ज्ञेयानि नामधेयानि नरैरध्यात्मचिन्तकैः॥
en: The unmanifest, consisting of the three qualities, is said to be darkness, unperceived, holy constant, unborn, womb, eternal, Nature, change or modification, destruction, Pradhana, production, and absorption, undeveloped, not small (i.e., vast), unshaking, immovable, fixed, existent, and non-existent. All these names should be known by those who meditate on matters about the soul.

description: The united state of the three qualities described
sn: अव्यक्तनामानि गुणांश्च तत्त्वतो यो वेद सर्वाणि गतीश्च केवलाः। विमुक्तदेहः प्रविभागतत्त्ववित् स मुच्यते सर्वगुणैर्निरामयः॥
en: That person who accurately knows all the names of the unmanifest, and the qualities, as also the pure actions, well conversant with the truth-about all distinctions and freed from the body, becomes emancipated from all the qualities and enjoys absolute happiness. That person who accurately knows all the names of the unmanifest, and the qualities, as also the pure actions, well conversant with the truth-about all distinctions and freed from the body, becomes emancipated from all the qualities and enjoys absolute happiness.

description: An account of the Great Soul p. 44
sn: अव्यक्तात् पूर्वमुत्पन्नो महानात्मा महामतिः। आदिर्गुणानां सर्वेषां प्रथमः सर्ग उच्यते॥
en: From the unmanifest first originated the Great Soul, gifted with great intelligence, the source of all the qualities. That is said to be the first creation.

description: An account of the Great Soul p. 44
sn: महानात्मा मतिर्विष्णुर्जिष्णुः शम्भुश्च वीर्यवान्। बुद्धिः प्रज्ञोपलब्धिश्च तथा ख्यातिधृतिः स्मृतिः॥ पर्यायवाचकैः शब्दैर्महानात्मा विभाव्यते। तं जानन् ब्राह्मणो विद्वान् प्रमोहं नाधिगच्छति॥
en: The Great Soul has these synonymous words, the Great Soul, Intelligence, Vishnu, Jishnu, Shambhu of great valour, the Understanding, the means of acquiring knowledge, the means of perception, as also fame, courage, and memory. Knowing this, a learned Brahmana has never to meet with delusion.

description: An account of the Great Soul p. 44
sn: सर्वत:पाणिपादश्च सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखः। सर्वत:श्रुतिमाँल्लोके सर्वं व्याप्य स तिष्ठति॥
en: It has hands and feet on every side. It has ears on every side. It pervades every thing in the universe.

description: An account of the Great Soul p. 44
sn: महाप्रभावः पुरुषः सर्वस्य हृदि निश्चितः। अणिमा लघिमा प्राप्तिरीशानो ज्योतिरव्ययः॥
en: Of great power, that Being is stationed in the heart of all. Minuteness. Lightness, and Affluence, are his. His is the hard of all, and at one with effulgence, and knows not decay.

description: An account of the Great Soul p. 44
sn: तत्र बुद्धिविदो लोकाः सद्भावनिरताश्च ये। ध्यानिनो नित्ययोगाश्च सत्वसंधा जितेन्द्रियाः॥ ज्ञानवन्तश्च ये केचिदलुब्धा जितमन्यवः। प्रसन्नमनसो धीरा निर्ममा निरहंकृताः॥
en: In Him are all those who comprehend the nature of the understanding, all those who are devoted to goodness of disposition, all those who practise meditation, who are always devoted to Yoga, who are firm in truth. who have governed their senses, who are gifted with knowledge, who are freed from cupidity, who have conquered anger, who are of cheerful hcarts, who are gifted with wisdom, who are liberated from ideas of mine and thine, and who are devoid of cgoism.

description: An account of the Great Soul p. 44
sn: विमुक्ताः सर्व एवैते महत्त्वमुपयान्त्युत। आत्मनो महतो वेद यः पुण्यां गतिमुत्तमाम्॥
en: All these, shorn of all attachments attain to the status of Greatness. That, person who understands that holy and high goal, viz., the Great Soul becomes freed from delusion.

description: An account of the Great Soul p. 44
sn: अहंकारात् प्रसूतानि पहाभूतानि पञ्च वै। पृथिवी वायुराकाशमायो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्॥
en: From Egoison were, indeed, born the five great elements. They are earth, air, ether, water and light numbering the fifth.

description: An account of the Great Soul p. 44
sn: तेषु भूतानि युज्यन्ते महाभूतेषु पञ्चसु। ते शब्दस्पर्शरूपेषु रसगन्धक्रियासु च॥
en: In these five great elements, in the matter of the operations of sound, touch, colour, taste, and smell, all creatures become deluded.

description: An account of the Great Soul p. 44
sn: महाभूतविनाशान्ते प्रलये प्रत्युपस्थिते। सर्वप्राणभृतां धीरा महदुत्पद्यते भयम्॥ स धीरः सर्वलोकेषु न मोहमधिगच्छति।
en: When at the close of the destruction of the grcat elements, the dissolution of the universe comes, O wisemen, a great fear possesses all living creatures. However, the man with self realisation and bold enough remains undeviated to that circumstances.

description: An account of the Great Soul p. 44
sn: विष्णुरेवादिसर्गेषु स्वयम्भूर्भवति प्रभुः॥ एवं हि यो वेद गुहाशय प्रभु परं पुराणं पुरुष विश्वरूपम्। हिरण्मयं बुद्धिमतां परां गतिं स बुद्धिमान् बुद्धिमतीत्य तिष्ठति॥
en: The self-create Vishnu becomes the Lord in the primary creations. He who thus knows the Lord lying in the cave, the Supreme, Ancient Being, of universal form, the golded one, the highest goal of all persons gifted with understanding, that intelligent man lives, transcending the understanding.

description: An account of the Great Soul p. 44
sn: हिरण्मयं बुद्धिमतां परां गतिं स बुद्धिमान् बुद्धिमतीत्य तिष्ठति॥
en: The self-create Vishnu becomes the Lord in the primary creations. He who thus knows the Lord lying in the cave, the Supreme, Ancient Being, of universal form, the golded one, the highest goal of all persons gifted with understanding, that intelligent man lives, transcending the understanding.

sn: ब्रह्मोवाच य उत्पन्नो महान् पूर्वमहंकारः स उच्यते। अहमित्येव सम्भूतो द्वितीयः सर्ग उच्यते॥
en: Brahman said That Mahat or principle of greatness who was first produced is called Egoism. When, it originated as I, it came to be called as the second creation.

sn: अहंकारश्च भूतादिकारिक इति स्मृतः। तेजश्चेतना धातुः प्रजासर्गः प्रजापतिः॥
en: That Egoism is said to be the source of all creatures, for these have originated from its modifications. It is pure effulgence and is the supporter of consciousness. It is Prajapati.

sn: देवानां प्रभवो देवो मनसश्च त्रिलोककृत्। अहमित्येव तत्सर्वमभिमन्ता स उच्यते॥
en: It is a deity, the creator of deities, and of mind. It is the which creates the three worlds. It is said to be that which feels-I am all this.

sn: अध्यात्मज्ञानतृप्तानां मुनीनां भावितानाम्। स्वाध्यायक्रतुसिद्धानामेष लोकः सनातनः॥
en: That is the eternal world existing for those sages who are contented with knowledge about the soul, who have meditated on the soul, and who have acquired success by Vedic study and sacrifices.

sn: अहंकारेणाहरतो गुणानिमान् भूतादिरेवं सृजते स भूतकृत्। वैकारिकः सर्वमिदं विचेष्टते स्वतेजसा रञ्जयते जगत् तथा॥
en: By consciousness of soul one enjoys the qualities. That source of all creatures, that creator of all creatures, creates thus. It is that which causes all changes. It is that which causes all beings to move. By its own light ii lights up the universe likewise.

sn: ब्रह्मोवाच अहंकारात् प्रसूतानि महाभूतानि पञ्च वै। पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्॥
en: Brahman said From Egoism were, indeed, born the five great elements. They are earth, air, ether, water and light numbering the fifth.

sn: तेषु भूतानि मुह्यन्ति महाभूतेषु पञ्चसु। शब्दस्पर्शनरूपेषु रसगन्धक्रियासु च॥
en: In these five great clements, in the matter of the operations of sound, touch, colour, tasie, and smell, all creatures become deluded.

sn: महाभूतविनाशान्ते प्रलये प्रत्युपस्थिते। सर्वप्राणभृतां धीरा महदभ्युद्यते भयम्॥
en: When at the close of the destruction of the great elements, the dissolution of the universe comes, O wisemen, a great fear possesses all living creatures.

sn: यद् यस्माज्जायते भूतं तत्र तत् प्रविलीयते। लीयन्ते प्रतिलोमानि जायन्ते चोत्तरोत्तरम्॥
en: Every existent object is dissolved into that from which it is produced. The dissolution takes place in an order that is the reverse of that in which creation occurs. Indeed, as regards birth, they are born from one another.

sn: ततः प्रलीने सर्वस्मिन् भूते स्थावरजङ्गमे। स्मृतिमन्तस्तदा धीरा न लीयन्ते कदाचन॥
en: Then, when all existent objects, mobile and immobile, become become dissolved, wise men possessed of a powerful memory never dissolve.

sn: शब्दः स्पर्शस्तथा रूपं रसो गन्धश्च पञ्चमः। क्रियाः करणनित्याः स्युरनित्या मोहसंज्ञिताः॥
en: Sound, touch, colour, taste, and smell numbering the fifth, are effects. They are, however, inconstant, and called by the name of delusion.

sn: लोभप्रजनसम्भूता निर्विशेषा ह्यकिंचनाः। मांसशोणितसंघाता अन्योन्यस्पोपजीविनः॥ बहिरात्मान इत्येते दीनाः कृपणजीवनः। प्राणापानावुदानश्च समानो व्यान एव च॥ अन्तरात्मनि चाप्येते नियताः पञ्च वायवः। वाड्मनोबुद्धिभिः सार्द्धमिदमष्टात्मकं जगत्॥
en: Generated by the production of cupidity, not different from one another, without reality, connected with flesh and blood, and depending upon one another, existing outside the soul, these are all helpless and powerless. Prana and Apana, and Udana and Samana and Vyana, these five vital airs are always closely attached to the soul. Together with speech, mind, and understanding, they form the universe of eight ingredients.

sn: त्वध्राणश्रोत्रचढूंषि रसना वाक् च संयताः। विशुद्धं च मनो यस्य बुद्धिश्चाव्यभिचारिणी॥ अष्टौ यस्याग्नयो ह्येते न दहन्ते मनः सदा। स तद् ब्रह्म शुभं याति तस्माद् भूयो न विद्यते॥
en: He whose skin, nose, ear, eyes, tongue, and speech are controlled, whose mind is pure, and whose understanding deviates not (from the right path), and whose mind is never burnt by those eight fires, succeeds in acquiring that auspicious Brahma than which nothing superior exists.

sn: एकादश च यान्याहुरिन्द्रियाणि विशेषतः। अहंकारात् प्रसूतानि तानि वक्ष्याम्यहं द्विजाः॥
en: I shall now, O twice-born ones, mention particularly, those which have been called the eleven organs and which have originated from Egoism.

sn: श्रोत्रं त्वक्चक्षुषी जिह्वा नासिका चैव पञ्चमी। पादौ पायुरुपस्थश्च हस्तौ वाग् दशमी भवेत्॥
en: They are the ear, the skin, the two eyes, the longue, the nose for the fifth, the two feet, the lower duct, the organ of generation, the two hands, and speech forming the tenth.

sn: इन्द्रियग्राम इत्येष मन एकादशं भवेत्। एतं ग्रामं जयेत् पूर्वं ततो ब्रह्म प्रकाशते॥
en: These form the group of organs, with mind numbering as the eleventh. One should first subdue this group. Then will Brahma shine forth (in him).

sn: बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि पञ्चाहुः पञ्चकर्मेन्द्रियाणि च। श्रोत्रादीन्यपि पञ्चाहुद्धियुक्तानि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Five amongst these are called organs of knowledge, and five, organs of action. The five beginning with the ear are connected with knowledge.

sn: अविशेषाणि चान्यानि कर्मयुक्तानि यानि तु। उभयत्र मनो ज्ञेयं बुद्धिस्तु द्वादशी भवेत्॥
en: The rest, however, which are connected with action, are without distinction. The mind should be considered as belonging to both. The understanding is the twelfth in the top.

sn: इत्युक्तानीन्द्रियाण्येतान्येकादश यथाक्रमम्। मन्यन्ते कृतमित्येवं विदित्वा तानि पण्डिताः॥
en: Thus have been enumerated the eleven organs in due order. Learned man, having understood these, think they have done everything.

sn: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वं विविधमिन्द्रियम्। आकाशं प्रथमं भूतं श्रोत्रमध्यात्ममुच्यते॥
en: I shall, after this, enumerate all the various orgains. Space (or Ether) is the first. As connected with the soul, it is called the ear.

sn: अधिभूतं तथा शब्दो दिशस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। द्वितीयं मारुतो भूतं त्वगध्यात्म च विश्रुता॥
en: As connected with objects, it is sound. The presiding deity (of this) is the quarters. The Wind is the second. As connected with the soul, it is known as the skin.

sn: स्पष्टव्यमधिभूतं च विद्युत् तत्राधिदैवतम्। तृतीयं ज्योतिरित्याहुश्चक्षुरध्यात्ममुच्यते॥
en: As connected with objects, it is known as objects of touch; and the presiding deity there is touch. The third is said to be Light. As connected with the soul, it is known as the eye.

sn: अधिभूतं ततो रूपं सूर्यस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। चतुर्थमापो विज्ञेयं जिह्वा चाध्यात्ममुच्यते॥
en: As connected with objects, it is colour; and the sun is its deity. The fourth should be known as Water. As connected with the soul, it is said to be the tongue.

sn: अधिभूतं रसश्चात्र सोमस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। पृथिवी पञ्चमं भूतं घ्राणश्चाध्यात्ममुच्यते॥
en: As connected with objects, it is taste and the presiding deity there is Soma. The fifth is Earth. As connected with the soul, it is said to be the nose.

sn: अधिभूतं तथा गन्धो वायुस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। एषु पञ्चसु भूतेषु त्रिषु यश्च विधिः स्मृतः॥
en: As comected with objects it is scent; and the presiding deity there is the wind. Thus has the manner been described of how the five entities are divided into sets of three.

sn: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वं विविधमिन्द्रियम्। पादावध्यात्ममित्याहुर्ब्राह्मणास्तत्त्वदर्शिनः॥
en: After this I shall describe everything about the various (other) organs. Brahmanas knowing the truth say that the two feet are mentioned as connected with the soul.

sn: अधिभूतं तु गन्तव्यं विष्णुस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। अवाग्गतिरपानश्च पायुरध्यात्ममुच्यते॥
en: As connected with objects, it is motion; and Vishnu is there the presiding deity. The Apana air, whose motion is downward, as connected with the soul, is called the lower duct.

sn: अधिभूतं विसर्गश्च मित्रस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। प्रजनः सर्वभूतानामुपस्थोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते॥
en: As connected with objects, it is the excreta that is ejected; and the presiding deity there is Mitra. As connected with the soul, the organ of generation is mentioned, the producer of all beings.

sn: अधिभूतं तथा शुक्र दैवतं च प्रजापतिः। हस्तावध्यात्ममित्याहुरध्यात्मविदुषो जनाः॥
en: As connected with objects, it is the vital sec; and the presiding deity is Prajapati. The two hands are mentioned as connected with the soul by persons knowing the relations of the soul.

sn: अधिभूतं च कर्माणि शक्रस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। वैश्वदेवी तत: पूर्वा वागध्यात्ममिहोच्यते॥
en: As connected with objects, it is actions; and the presiding deity there is Indra. Next, connected with the soul is speech which relates to all the celestials.

sn: वक्तव्यमधिभूतं च बह्विस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। अध्यात्मं मन इत्याहुः पञ्चभूतात्मचारकम्॥
en: As connected with objects, it is what is spoken. The presiding deity there is Agni. As connected with the soul, the mind is mentioned, which moves within the soul of the five elements.

sn: अधिभूतं च संकल्पश्चन्द्रमाश्चाधिदैवतम्। अहंकारस्तथाध्यात्म सर्वसंसारकारकम्॥
en: As connected with objects, it is the mental operation; and the presiding deity is the moon. As connected with the soul is Egoism, which is the cause of the entire course of worldly life.

sn: अभिमानोऽधिभूतं च रुद्रस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। अध्यात्मं बुद्धिरित्याहुः घडिन्द्रियविचारिणी॥
en: As connected with objects, it is consciousness of self; and the presiding deity there is Rudra. As connected with the soul is the understanding, which moves the six senses.

sn: अधिभूतं तु मन्तव्यं ब्रह्मा तत्राधिदैवतम्। त्रीणि स्थानानि भूतानां चतुर्थं नोपपद्यते॥
en: As connected with objects, it is that which is to be understood, and the presiding deity there is Brahman. Three are the seats of all existent objects. A fourth is not possible.

sn: स्थलमास्तथाऽऽकाशं जन्म चापि चतुर्विधम्। अण्डजोद्भिज्जसंस्वेदजरायुजमथापि च॥
en: These are land, water, and ether. The birth is fourfold. Some are born of eggs; some are born of germs which; spring upwards, passing through the earth; some are born of fifth; and some are born of fleshy balls in wombs.

sn: चतुर्धा जन्म इत्येतद् भूतग्रामस्य लक्ष्यते। अपराण्यथ भूतानि खेचराणि तथैव च॥
en: Thus the birth of all living creatures is of four kinds. Now, there are other inferior beings and likewise those which range the sky.

sn: अण्डजानि विजानीयात् सर्वाश्चैव सरीसृपान्। स्वदेजाः कृमयः प्रोक्ता जन्तवश्च यथाक्रमम्॥
en: These should be known to be born of eggs as also those which crawl on their breasts. Insects are said to be born of fifth, as also other creatures of a like description.

sn: जन्म द्वितीयमित्येजज्जघन्यतरमुच्यते। भित्त्वा तु पृथिवीं यानि जायन्ते कालपर्ययात्॥ उद्भिज्जानि च तान्याहुर्भूतानि द्विजसत्तमाः। द्विपादबहुपादानि तिर्यग्गतिमतीनि च॥ जरायुजानि भूतानि विकृतान्यपि सत्तमाः। द्विविधा खलु विज्ञेया ब्रह्मयोनिः सनातनी॥ तपः कर्म च यत्पुण्यमित्येष विदुषां नयः। विविधं कर्म विज्ञेयमिज्या दानं च तन्मखे॥ जातस्याध्ययनं पुण्यमिति वृद्धानुशासनम्। एतद् यो वेत्ति विधिवद् युक्तः स स्याद् द्विजर्षभाः।।
en: This is said to be the second mode of birth and is inferior. Those living creatures which take birth after the lapse of sometime, bursting through the earth, are said to be germ-born beings, O foremost of twice-bom persons! Creatures of two fect or of many fect, and those which move crookedly, are the beings born of wombs. Among them are some which are deformed, you best of men! The eternal womb of Brahma should be known to be of two kinds, viz., penance and meritorious acts. Such is the doctrine of the learned. Action should be understood to be of various kinds, such as sacrifice, gifts made at sacrifices, and the meritorious duty of study for every one that is born; such is the teaching of the ancients. He who duly understands this, comes to be considered as possessed of Yoga, you chief of twice-born persons.

sn: विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्य इति चैव निवोधता यथावदध्यात्मविधिरेष वः कीर्तितो मया॥
en: Know also that such a man becomes freed too from all his sins. I have thus described to you duly the doctrine of spiritual science.

sn: ज्ञानमस्य हि धर्मज्ञाः प्राप्तं ज्ञानवतामिह। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थाश्च महाभूतानि पञ्च च। सर्वाण्येतानि संधाय मनसा सम्प्रधारयेत्॥
en: You Rishis knowing all duties, a knowledge of this is gained by those who are considered as persons, viz., the senses, the objects of the senses, and the five great elements, one should keep them in the mind.

sn: क्षीणे मनसि सर्वस्मिन् च जन्मसुखमिष्यते। ज्ञानसम्पन्नसत्त्वानां तत् सुखं विदुषां मतम्॥
en: When everything is immersed in the mind, one no longer regards highly the pleasures of life. Learned men, whose understandings are furnished with knowledge, consider that as true happiness.

sn: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सूक्ष्मभावकरीं शिवाम्। निवृत्तिं सर्वभूतेषु मृदुना दारुणेन च॥
en: I shall, after this, tell you of renunciation about all entities by means gentle and hard, which produces attachment to subtle topics and which is fraught with auspiciousness.

sn: गुणागुणमनासङ्गमेकचर्यमनन्तरम्। एतद् ब्रह्ममयं वृत्तमाहुरेकपदं सुखम्॥
en: That conduct which consists in treating the qualities as not qualities, which is shorn of attachment, which is living alone, which does not recognise distinctions, and which is full of Brahma, is the root of all happiness.

sn: विद्वान् कूर्म इवाङ्गानि कामान् संहत्य सर्वशः। विरजाः सर्वतो मुक्तो यो नरः स सुखी सदा॥
en: The learned man who takes all desires himself from all sides like thc tortoise withdrawing all its limbs, who is devoid of passion, and who is freed from everything, becoming always happy.

sn: कामानात्मनि संयम्य क्षीणतृष्णः समाहितः। सर्वभूतसुहृन्मित्रो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
en: Controlling all desires within the soul, killing his thirst, concentrated in mediation, and becoming the friend of good heart towards all creatures, he succeeds in becoming fit for assimilation with Brahma.

sn: इन्द्रियाणां निरोधेन सर्वेषां विषयैषिणाम्। मुनेर्जनपदत्यागादध्यात्माग्निः समिध्यते॥
en: Through suppression of all the senses which always hanker after their objects, and abandonment of inhabited places, the spiritual fire blazes forth in the man of contemplation.

sn: यथाग्निरिन्धनैरिद्धो महाज्योतिः प्रकाशते। तथेन्द्रियनिरोधेन महानात्मा प्रकाशते॥
en: As a fire, fed with fuel, becomes bright on account of the burning flames it puts forth, so, on account of the repression of the senses, the great soul puts forth its effulgence.

sn: यदा पश्यति भूतानि प्रसन्नात्माऽऽत्मनो हृदि। स्वयंज्योतिस्तदा सूक्ष्मात् सूक्ष्मं प्रन्पोत्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: When one with a tranquil soul sees all entities in his own heart, then, lighted by his own effulgence, one attains to that which is subtler than the subtle and which is peerless in excellence.

sn: अग्नी रूपं पयः स्रोतो वायुः स्पर्शनपेव च। मही पङ्कधरं घोरमाकाशश्रवणं तथा॥ रोगशोकसमाविष्टं पञ्चस्रोतःसमावृतम्। पञ्चभूतसमायुक्तं नवद्वारं द्विदैवतम्॥ रजस्वलमथादृश्यं त्रिगुणं च त्रिधातुकम्। संसर्गाभिरतं मूढं शरीरमिति धारणा॥
en: It is settled that the body has fire for colour, water for blood and other liquids, wind for sense of touch, earth for the hideous holder of mind (viz., flesh and bones, etc.), space (or ether) for sound; that it is pervaded by disease and sorrow; that it is overwhelmed by five currents; that it is made up of the five elements; that it has nine doors and two deities; that it is full of passion; that it is unfit to be seen; that it made up of three qualities; that it has three elements, (viz., wind, bile, and phlegm); that it is delighted with attachments of every kind; that it is full of delusion.

sn: दुश्चरं सर्वलोकेऽस्मिन् सत्त्वं प्रति समाश्रितम्! एतदेव हि लोकेऽस्मिन् कालचक्र प्रवर्तते॥ एतन्महार्णवं घोरमगाधं मोहसंज्ञितम्। विक्षिपेत् संक्षिपेच्चैव बोधयेत् सामरं जगत्॥
en: It is difficult of being moved in this mortal world, and it rests on the understanding as its stay. That body is, in called delusion. It is this body which stretches forth, contracts, and awakens the universe with the immortals.

sn: कामं क्रोध भयं लोभमभिद्रोहमथानृतम्। इन्द्रियाणां निरोधेन सतस्त्यजति दुस्त्यजान्॥
en: By controlling the senses, one renounces lust, anger, fear, cupidity, enmity, and falsehood, which are cternal and, therefore, highly difficult to renounce.

sn: यस्यैते निर्जिता लोके त्रिगुणाः पञ्चधातवः। व्योमि तस्य परं स्थानमानन्त्यमथ लभ्यते॥
en: He who has controlled these in this world, viz., the three qualities and the five elements of the body, has the Highest for his seat in the celestial region. By him is Infinity attained.

sn: पञ्चेन्द्रियमहाकूलां मनोवेगमहोदकाम्। नदीं मोहह्रदां तीर्खा कामक्रोधावुभौ जयेत्॥
en: Crossing the river which has the five senses for its steep banks, the mental inclinations for its powerful waters, and delusion for its lake, one should control both lust and anger,

sn: स सर्वदोषनिर्मुक्तस्ततः पश्यति तत्परम्। मनो मनसि संधाय पश्यन्नात्मानमात्मनि॥
en: Such a man, freed from all faults, then sces the Highest, concentrating the mind within the mind and sceing self in self.

sn: सर्ववित् सर्वभूतेषु विन्दत्यात्मानमात्मनि। एकधा बहुधा चैव विकुर्वाणस्ततस्ततः॥
en: Understanding all things, he sees his self, with self, in all creatures, sometimes as one and sometimes as various, changing form from time to time.

sn: ध्रुवं पश्यति रूपाणि दीपाद् दीपशतं यथा। स वै विष्णुश्च वरुणोऽग्निः प्रजापतिः॥
en: Forsooth, he can perceive numerous bodies like a hundred lights from one light. Indeed, he is Vishnu and Mitra, and Varuna and Agni, and Prajapati.

sn: स हि धाता विधाता च स प्रभुः सर्वतोमुखः। हृदयं सर्वभूतानां महानात्मा प्रकाशते॥
en: He is the Creator and the ordainer; he is the powerful Lord, with faces turned in all directions. In him, the heart of all creatures, the great soul, becomes resplendent.

sn: तं विप्रसंघाश्च सुरासुराश्च यक्षाः पिशाचाः पितरो वयांसि। रक्षोगणा भूतगणाश्च सर्वे महर्षयश्चैव सदा स्तुवन्ति॥
en: All the learned Brahmanas, celestials, Asuras, Yakshas, Pishachas, the departed manes, birds, Rakshasas, goblins, and all the great Rishis, laud Him.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: मनुष्याणां तु राजन्यः क्षत्रियो मध्यमो गुणः। कुञ्जरो वाहनानां च सिंहचारण्यवासिनाम्॥ अविः पशूनां सर्वेषामहिस्तु बिलवासिनाम्। गवां गोवृषभश्चैव स्त्रीणां पुरुष एव च॥
en: Brahman said Among men, the royal Kshatriya is gifted with the middle quality. Among vehicles, the elephant (is so); and among dwellers of the forest the lion; among all (sacrificial) animals, the sheep; among all those that live in holes, is the snake; among cattle, the bull; among females, the male.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: न्यग्रोधे जम्बुवृक्षश्च पिप्पल: शाल्मलिस्तथा। शिंशपा मेषशृश्च तथा कीचकवेणवः॥
en: There is no doubt in this that in this world, the Nyagrodha, the Jambu, the Pippala, the Shalmali, the Shinshapa, the Meshashringa, and the Kichaka, are the foremost ones among trees.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: एते दुमाणां राजानो लोकेऽस्मिन् नात्र संशयः। हिमवान् पारियात्रश्च सह्यो विन्ध्यस्त्रिकूटवान्॥ श्वेतो नीलश्च भासश्च कोष्ठवांश्चैव पर्वतः। गुरुस्कन्धो महेन्द्रश्च माल्यवान् पर्वतस्तथा॥ एते पर्वतराजानो गणानां मरुतस्तथा।
en: Himavat, Pariyatra, Pariyatra, Sahya, Vindhya, Trikutavat, Shveta, Nila, Bhasa, Kushthavat, Guruskandha, Mahendra, and Malayavat, these are the foremost of mountains. Likewise the Maruts are the foremost of the Ganas.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: सूर्यो ग्रहाणामधिपो नक्षत्राणां च चन्द्रमाः॥ यमः पितॄणामधिपः सरितामथ सागरः।
en: The Sun is the lord of all the planets, and the Moon of all the constellations. Yama is the lord of the departed manes; Ocean is the lord of all rivers.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: अम्भसां वरुणो राजा मरुतामिन्द्र उच्यते॥ अर्कोऽधिपतिरुष्णानां ज्योतिषामिन्दुरुच्यते।
en: Varuna is the king of the waters. Indra is said to be the king of the Maruts. Arka is the king of all hot bodies, and Indra of all luminous bodies.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: अग्निभूतपतिर्नित्यं ब्राह्मणानां बृहस्पतिः॥ ओषधीनां पतिः सोमो विष्णुर्बलवतां वरः।
en: Agni is the eternal lord of the elements, and Brihaspati of the Brahmanas. Soma is the lord herbs, and Vishnu is the foremost of all that are gifted with might.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: त्वष्टाधिराजो रूपाणां पशूनामीश्वरः शिवः॥ दीक्षितानां तथा यज्ञो दैवानां मघवा तथा।
en: Tvashtri is the king of Rudras, and Shiva of all creatures. Sacrifice is the foremost of all initiatory rites and Maghavat of the celestials.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: दिशामुदीची विप्राणां सोमो राजा प्रतापवान्॥ कुबेरः सर्वरत्नानां देवतानां पुरंदरः।
en: The North is the lord of all the points of the compass; the energetic Soma is the lord of all learned Brahmanas. Kubera is the lord of all precious gems, and Purandara of all the celestials.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: एष भूताधिपः सर्गः प्रजानां च प्रजापतिः॥ सर्वेषामेव भूतानामहं ब्रह्ममयो महान्।
en: Such is the highest creation among all entities. Prajapati is the lord of all creatures. Of all entities whatever, I, who am full of Brahma, am the foremost.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: भूतं परतरं मत्तो विष्णोर्वाऽपि न विद्यते॥ राजाधिराजः सर्वेषां विष्णुर्ब्रह्ममयो महान्। ईश्वरत्वं विजानीध्वं कर्तारमकृतं हरिम्॥
en: There is no entity that is higher than myself or Vishnu. The great Vishnu, who is full of Brahma, is the king of kings over all. Know him to be the king, the creator, the uncreated Hari.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: नरकिन्नरयक्षाणां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम्। देवदानवनागानां सर्वेषामीश्वरो हि सः॥
en: He is the ruler of men and Kinnaras and Yakshas and Gandharvas, and snakes and Rakshasas, and celestials and Danavas and Nagas.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: भगदेवानुयातानां सर्वासा वामलोचना। माहेश्वरी महादेवी प्रोच्यते पार्वती हि सा॥
en: Among those that are followed by persons full of desire is the great goddess Mahesvari having beautiful eyes.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: उमां देवीं विजानीध्वं नारीणामुत्तमां शुभाम्। रतीनां वसुमत्यस्तु स्त्रीणामप्सरसस्तथा॥
en: She is otherwisc called by the name of Parvati. Know that the goddess Uma is the foremost and the most auspicious of women. Ainong women who are a source of pleasure, the foremost are the Apsaras who are endued with great splendour.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: राजानो ब्राह्मणा धर्मसेतवः। तस्माद् राजा द्विजातीनां प्रयतेत स्म रक्षणे॥
en: Kings are desirous of acquiring piety, and Brahmanas are causeways of Piety. Therefore, the king should always strive to protect the twice-born ones.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: धर्मकामाश्च राज्ञां हि विषये येषामवसीदन्ति साधवः। हीनास्ते स्वगुणैः सर्वैः प्रेत्य चोन्मार्गगामिनः॥
en: Those kings in whose kingdoms good men languish are considered as bereft of the virtues of their order. Hereafter they have to go into wrong paths.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: राज्ञां हि विषये येषां साधवः परिरक्षिताः। तेऽस्मिँल्लोके प्रमोदन्ते सुखं प्रेत्य च भुञ्जते॥
en: Those kings in whose territories good men are protected, rejoice in this world and enjoy happiness in the next.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: प्राप्नुवन्ति महात्मान इति वित्त द्विजर्षभाः। अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि नियतं धर्मलक्षणम्॥
en: Indeed, those great ones attain to the highest seat. Understand this, you foremost of twice-born ones! I shall after this describe the eternal characteristics of duties.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: अहिंसा परमो धर्मो हिंसा चाधर्मलक्षणा। प्रकाशलक्षणा देवा मनुष्याः कर्मलक्षणाः॥
en: Abstention from injury is the highest duty, Injury is a mark of sin. Splendour is the mark of the deities. Men have acts for their characteristics.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: शब्दलक्षणमाकाशं वायुस्तु स्पर्शलक्षणः। ज्योतिषां लक्षणं रूपमापश्च रसलक्षणाः॥
en: Ether (or space) has sound for its characteristic. Wind has touch for its characteristic. The characteristic of luminous bodies is colour, and water has taste for its characteristic.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: धारिणी सर्वभूतानां पृथिवी गन्धलक्षणा। स्वरव्यञ्जनसंस्कारा भारती शब्दलक्षणा॥
en: Earth, which holds all entities, has smell for its characteristic. Speech has words for its characteristic, refined into vowels and consonants.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: मनसो लक्षणं चिन्ता चिन्तोक्ता बुद्धिलक्षणा। मनसा चिन्तितानर्थान् बुद्ध्या चेह व्यवस्यति॥
en: Mind has thought for its characteristic. Thought has again, been said to be the characteristic of the understanding. The thing thought of by the mind are determined with accuracy by the understanding.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: बुद्धिर्हि व्यवसायेन लक्ष्यते नात्र संशयः। लक्षणं मनसो ध्यानमव्यक्तं साधुलक्षणम्॥
en: There is no doubt in this, viz., that the understanding, by perseverance, perceives all things. The characteristic of mind is meditation. The characteristic of the good man is that he does not allow his acts to be noticed.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणो योगो ज्ञानं संन्यासलक्षणम्। तस्माज्ज्ञानं पुरस्कृत्य संन्यसेदिह बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Devotion has acts for its characteristic. Knowledge is the characteristic of renunciation. Therefore, kecping knowledge before his view, the man of understanding should practise renunciation.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: संन्यासी ज्ञानसंयुक्तः प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम्। अतीतो द्वन्द्वमभ्येति तमोमृत्युजरातिगः॥
en: The man who follows renunciation and who is endued with knowledge, who is above all pairs of opposites, as also darkness, death, and decrepitude, attains to the highest goal.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: धर्मलक्षणसंयुक्तमुक्तं वो विधिवन्मया। गुणानां ग्रहणं सम्यग् वक्ष्याम्यहमतः परम्॥
en: I have thus described to you duly what the characteristics are of duty. I shall, after this tell you of the comprehension of qualities.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: पार्थिवो यस्तु गन्धो वै घ्राणेन हि स गृह्यते। घ्राणस्थश्च तथा वायुर्गन्धज्ञाने विधीयते॥
en: Smell, which belongs to earth, is seized by the nose. The wind, which dwells in the nose is likewise appointed as an agent) in the perception of smell.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: अपां धातू रसो नित्यं जिह्वया स तु गृह्यते। जिह्वास्थश्च तथा सोमो रसज्ञाने विधीयते॥
en: Taste is the essence of water. That is perceived by the tongue. Soma, who lives in the tongue, is appointed likewise in the perception of taste.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: ज्योतिषश्च गुणो रूपं चक्षुषा तच्च गृह्यते। चक्षुःस्थश्च सदाऽऽदित्यो रूपज्ञाने विधीयते।।३शा
en: The quality of a lighted body is colour. That is apprehended by the eye. Aditya who always lives in the eye has been appointed in the perception of colour.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: वायव्यस्तु सदा स्पर्शस्त्वचा प्रज्ञायते च सः। त्वक्स्थश्चैव सदा वायुः स्पर्शने स विधीयते॥
en: Touch always belongs to the wind (as its quality). That is perceived by the skin. The wind that always lives in the skin has been appointed in apprehending touch.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: आकाशस्य गुणो ह्येष श्रोत्रेण च स गृह्यते। श्रोत्रस्थाश्च दिशः सर्वाः शब्दज्ञाने प्रकीर्तिताः॥
en: The quality of a ether is sound. That is seized by the car. All the quarters, which live in the ear, have been appointed in apprehending sound.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: मनसश्च गुणश्चिन्ता प्रज्ञया स तु गृह्यते। हृदिस्थश्चेतनो धातुर्मनोज्ञाने विधीयते॥
en: The quality of the mind is thought. That is seized by the understanding. The upholder of consciousness, living in the heart, has been appointed in apprehending the mind.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: बुद्धिरध्यवसायेन ज्ञानेन च महांस्तथा। निश्चित्य ग्रहणाद् व्यक्तमव्यक्तं नात्र संशयः॥
en: The understanding is appended in the form of determination or certitude, and principle of Greatness in the form of knowledge. The unperceived (Nature) has been, it is evident, appointed for the seizure of all things after certitude. There is no doubt in this.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: अलिग्रहणो नित्यः क्षेत्रज्ञे निर्गुणात्मकः। तस्मादलिङ्गः क्षेत्रज्ञः केवलं ज्ञानलक्षणः॥
en: The Kshetrajna which is eternal and is shorn of qualities about its essence, is incapable of being seized by symbols. Hence, the characteristic of the Kshetrajna, which is without symbols, is purely knowledge.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: अव्यक्तं क्षेत्रमुद्दिष्टं गुणानां प्रभवाप्ययम्। सदा पश्याम्यहं लीनो विजानामि शृणोमि च॥
en: The unmanifest lives in the symbol called. Kshetra, and is that in which the qualities are produced and absorbed. I always see, know, and hear it (though) it is hidden.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: पुरुषस्तद् विजानीते तस्मात् क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते। गुणवृत्तं तथा वृत्तं क्षेत्रज्ञः परिपश्यति॥
en: Purusha knows it; therefore is he called Kshetrajna. The Kshetrajna perceives also the action of the qualities and absence of their actions.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: आदिमध्यावसानान्तं सृज्यमानमचेतनम्। न गुणा विदुरात्मानं सृज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः॥
en: The qualities, which are created repeatedly, do not know themselves, being unintelligent, as entities to be created and gifted with a beginning, middle, and end.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: न सत्यं विन्दते कश्चित् क्षेत्रज्ञस्त्वेव विन्दति। गुणानां गुणभूतानां यत् परं परमं महत्॥
en: No one else, but the Kshetrajna, comes by that which is the highest and great and which is above the qualities and those entities which are born of the qualities.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: तस्माद् गुणांश्च सत्त्वं च परित्यज्येह धर्मवित्। क्षीणदोषो गुणातीतः क्षेत्रमं प्रविशत्यथ॥
en: Hence, who understands duties, renouncing qualities and the understanding, and having his destroyed, and transcending the qualities, enters the Kshetrajna.

description: The foremost objects in Nature are enumerated
sn: निर्द्वन्द्वो निमस्कारो नि:स्वाहाकार एव च। अचलश्चानिकेतश्च क्षेत्रज्ञः स परो विभुः॥
en: One who is free from all pairs of opposites, who never bends his head to any one, who is divested of Svaha, who is immovable, and hom ess, is the Kshetrajna. He is the Supreme Lord. one sons

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: यदादिमध्यपर्यन्तं ग्रहणोपायमेव च। नामलक्षणसंयुक्तं सर्वं वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Brahmana said I shall now tell you truly about all that which has a beginning, middle, and end, and which has name and characteristics, together, the means of apprehension.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: अहः पूर्वं ततो रात्रिर्मासाः शुक्लादयः स्मृताः। श्रवणादीनि ऋक्षाणि ऋतवः शिशिरादयः॥
en: It has been said that the Day came first. Then came Night. The Months are said to have the lighted fortnights first. The constellations have Shravana for their first; the Seasons have that of dews (viz., Winter) for their first.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: भूमिरादिस्तु गन्धानां रसानामाप एव च। रूपाणां ज्योतिरादित्यः स्पर्शानां वायुरुच्यते॥
en: Earth is the source of all smells; and Water of all tastes. The Solar light is the source of all colours; the wind of all sensations of touch.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: शब्दस्यादिस्तथाऽऽकाशमेष भूतकृतो गुणः। अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि भूतानामादिमुत्तमम्॥
en: Likewise of sound the source is space (or Ether). These are the qualities of elements. I shall, after this, describe that which is the first and the highest of all entities.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: आदित्यो ज्योतिषामादिरग्निर्भूतादिरुच्यते। सावित्री सर्वविद्यानां देवतानां प्रजापतिः॥
en: The sun is the first of all luminous bodies. Fire is said to be the first of all the elements, Savitri is the first of all branches of learning. Prajapati is the first of all the celestials.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: ओङ्कारः सर्ववेदानां वचसां प्राण एव च। यदस्मिन् नियतं लोके सर्वं सावित्रिरुच्यते॥
en: The syllable Om is the first of all the Vedas, and the vital air Prana is the first of all winds. Savitri is the first of all religious observances.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: गायत्री च्छन्दसामादिः प्रजानां सर्ग उच्यते। गावश्चतुष्पदामादिर्मनुष्याणां द्विजातयः॥
en: The Gayatri is the first of all metres, goat is the first of all (sacrificial) animals, Kin are the first of all quadrupeds. The twice-born ones are the first of all human beings.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: श्येनः पतत्रिणामादिर्यज्ञानां हुतमुत्तमम्। सरीसृपाणां सर्वेषां ज्येष्ठः सर्पो द्विजोत्तमाः॥
en: The hawk is the first of all birds. Of sacrifices the first is the pouring of clarified butter on the fire. Of all reptiles the first, O foremost of twice-born ones, is the snake.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: कृतमादिर्युगानां च सर्वेषां नात्र संशयः। हिरण्यं सर्वरत्नामोषधीनां यवास्तथा॥
en: The Krita is the first of all the cycles; there is no doubt in this. Gold is the first of all precious things.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: सर्वेषां भक्ष्यभोज्यानामन्नं परममुच्यते। द्रवाणां चैव सर्वेषां पेयानामाप उत्तमाः॥
en: Barely is the first of all plants. Food is the first of all things to be eaten or swallowed. Water is the first of all liquid substances to be drunk.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: स्थावराणां तु भूतानां सर्वेषामविशेषतः। ब्रह्मक्षेत्रं सदा पुण्यं प्लक्षः प्रथमतः स्मृतः॥
en: Of all immobile objects without distinction, Plaksha is said to be the first, that ever holy field of Brahman.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: अहं प्रजापतीनां च सर्वेषां नात्र संशयः। मम विष्णुरचिन्त्यात्मा स्वयम्भूरिति स स्मृतः॥
en: Of all the Prajapatis I am the first. There is no doubt in this, Of inconceivable soul, the self consistent Vishnu is said to be my superior.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: पर्वतानां महामेरुः सर्वेषामग्रजः स्मृतः। दिशां च प्रदिशां चोर्ध्वं दिक्पूर्वा प्रथमा तथा॥
en: Of all the mountains the great Meru is said to be the first-born. Of all the cardinal and subsidiary points of the horizon, the eastern is said to be the foremost and first-born.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: तथा त्रिपथगा गङ्गा नदीनामग्रजा स्मृता। तथा सरोदपानानां सर्वेषां सागरोऽग्रजः॥
en: Ganga having three courses is said to be first-born of all rivers. Likewise, of all wells and reservoirs of waters, the ocean is said to be the first born.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: देवदानवभूतानां पिशाचोरगरक्षसाम्। नरकिन्नरयक्षाणां सर्वेषामीश्वरः प्रभुः॥
en: Ishvara is the Supreme Lord of all the celestials and Danavas and ghosts and Pishachas and snakes and Rakshasas, and human beings and Kinnaras and Yakshas.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: आदिर्विश्वस्य जगतो विष्णुर्ब्रह्ममयो महान्। भूतं परतरं यस्मात् त्रैलोक्ये नेह विद्यते॥
en: The great Vishnu, who is full of Brahma, than whom there is no higher being in the three worlds is the first of all the universe.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: आश्रमाणां च सर्वेषां गार्हस्थ्यं नात्र संशयः। लोकानामादिरव्यक्तं सर्वस्यान्तस्तदेव च॥
en: Of all the modes of life, that of the householder is the first. Of this there is not doubt. The Unmanifest is the source of all the worlds as well as is the end of every thing.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: अहान्यस्तमयान्तानि उदयान्ता च शर्वरी। सुखस्यान्तं सदा दुःखं दुःखस्यान्तं सदा सुखम्॥१८
en: Days end with the sun's setting and Nights with the sun's rising. The end of pleasure is always sorrow, and the end of sorrow is always pleasure.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: सर्वं क्षयान्ता निचयाः पतनान्ताः समुच्छ्रयाः। संयोगाश्च वियोगान्ता मरणान्तं च जीवितम्॥
en: All collections have expenditure for their end, ana all ascents have falls for their end. All associations have dissociations for their end, and life has death for its end.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: सर्वं कृतं विनाशान्तं जातस्य मरणं ध्रुवम्। अशाश्वतं हि लोकेऽस्मिन् सदा स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥
en: All action ends in destruction, and all that is born is certain to meet with death. Every mobile and immobile thing in this world is fickle.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: इष्टं दत्तं तपोऽधीतं व्रतानि नियमाश्च ये। सर्वमेतद् विनाशान्तं ज्ञानस्यान्तो न विद्यते॥
en: Sacrifice, gift, penances, study, vow, observances, all these have destruction to their end. Of knowledge, there is no end.

description: The creation of Day, Night, Stars, etc.
sn: तस्माज्ज्ञानेन शुद्धेन प्रशान्तात्मा जितेन्द्रियः। निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो मुच्यते सर्वपाप्मभिः॥
en: Hence, one who has a tranquil soul, who has subjugated his senses, who is freed from the sense of mineness, who is devoid of egoism, is freed from all sins by pure knowledge.

sn: बुद्धिसारं मनःस्तम्भमिन्द्रियग्रामबन्धनम्। महाभूतपरिस्कन्धं निवेशपरिवेशनम्॥
en: Brahman said The wheel of life moves on. It has the understanding for its strength; the mind for the pole; the group of senses for its fetters, the (five) great elements for its have, and home for its circumference.

sn: जराशोकसमाविष्टं व्याधिव्यसनसम्भवम्। देशकालविचारीदं श्रमव्यायामनिःस्वनम्॥
en: It is possessed by decrepitude and sorrow and it has diseases and calamities for its progeny. That wheel relates in time and place. It has toil and exercise for its noise.

sn: अहोरात्रपरिक्षेपं शीतोष्णपरिमण्डलम्। सुखदुःखान्तसंश्लेषं क्षुत्पिपासावकीलकम्॥
en: Day and Night are the rotations of that wheel. It is encircled by heat and cold. Pleasure and pain are its joints, are hunger and thirst are the nails fixed into it.

sn: छायातपविलेखं च निमेषोन्मेषविह्वलम्। घोरमोहजलाकीर्णं वर्तमानमचेतनम्॥
en: Sun-shine and shade are the ruts. It is capable of being moved during even such a short space of time as is taken up by the opening and the closing of the eyelid. It is covered with the dreadful waters of delusion. It is ever revolving and void of consciousness.

sn: मासार्धमासगणितं विषमं लोकसंचरम्। तमोनियमपङ्कं च रजोवेगप्रवर्तकम्॥
en: It is measured by months and half-months. It is not uniform (being ever changing), and moves through all the worlds. Penance and vows are its mud, Passions' force is its mover.

sn: महाहंकारदीप्तं च गुणसंजातवर्तनम्। अरतिग्रहणानीकं शोकसंहारवर्तनम्॥
en: It is lighted up by the great egoism, and is sustained by the qualities. Vexations are the fastenings that bind it around. It revolves in the midst of grief and destruction.

sn: क्रियाकारणसंयुक्तं रागविस्तारमायतम्। लोभेप्सापरिविक्षोभं विचित्राज्ञानसम्भवम्॥
en: It has actions and the instruments of action. It is large and is extended by attachments. It is rendered unsteady by cupidity and desire. It is produced by varicgated Ignorance.

sn: भयमोहपरीवारं भूतसम्मोहकारकम्। आनन्दप्रीतिचारं च कामक्रोधपरिग्रहम्॥
en: It is full of fear and delusion, and is the cause of the delusion of all beings. It moves towards joy and pleasure, and has desire and anger for its possession.

sn: महदादिविशेषान्तमसक्तं प्रभवाव्ययम्। मनोजवं मनःकान्तं कालचक्र प्रवर्तते॥
en: It is made up of principles beginning with greatness and ending with the gross elements. It is marked by production and destruction going on ceaselessly. Its speed is like that of the mind, and it has the mind for its limit.

sn: एतद् द्वन्द्वसमायुक्तं कालचक्रमचेतनम्। विसृजेत् संक्षिपेच्चापि बोधयेत् सामरं जगत्॥
en: This wheel of life which is connected with pairs of opposites and devoid of consciousness, the universe with the very immortals should cast away, abridge, and chcek.

sn: कालचक्रप्रवत्तिं च निवृत्तिं चैव तत्त्वतः। यस्तु वेद नरो नित्यं न स भूतेषु मुह्यति॥
en: That man who ever understands correctly the motion and stoppage of this whcel of life, is never seen to be deluded, among all creatures.

sn: विमुक्तः सर्वसंस्कारैः सर्वद्वन्द्वविवर्जितः। विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम्॥
en: Freed from all impressions, divested of all Pairs of opposites, freed froin all sins, he। attains to the highest goal.

sn: गृहस्थो ब्रह्मचारी च वानप्रस्थोऽथ भिक्षुकः। चत्वार आश्रमाः प्रोक्ताः सर्वे गार्हस्थ्यमूलकाः॥
en: The householder, the Brahmacharin the hermit and the mendicant, these are modes of life have all been said to the householder's mode for their root.

sn: यः कश्चिदिह लोकेऽस्मिन्नागमः परिकीर्तितः। तस्यान्तगमनं श्रेयः कीर्तिरेषा सनातनी॥
en: The observance of every system of rules is prescribed in this world. Such observance has always been highly spoken of.

sn: संस्कारैः संस्कृतः पूर्वं यथावच्चरितव्रतः। जातौ गुणविशिष्टायां समावर्तेत तत्त्ववित्॥
en: He who has been first purified by ceremonies, who has duly observed vows, who belongs by birth to a family of high qualifications, and who understands the Vedas, should return (from his preceptor's house).

sn: स्वदारनिरतो नित्यं शिष्टाचारो जितेन्द्रियः। पञ्चभिश्च महायज्ञैः श्रद्दधानो यजेदिह॥
en: Always devoted to his married wife, acting like a good man, with his senses under control, and full of faith, one should in this world perform the five sacrifice.

sn: देवतातिथिशिष्टाशी निरतो वेदकर्मसु। इज्याप्रदानयुक्तश्च यथाशक्ति यथासुखम्॥ न पाणिपादचपलो न नेत्रचपलो मुनिः। न च वागङ्गचपल इति शिष्टस्य गोचरः॥
en: He who cats the residue after fecding celestials and guests, who is given to the observance of Vedic rites, who duly celebrates, according to his means, sacrifices and gifts, who is unduly active with his hands and feet, who is unduly active with his eye, who is devoted to penances, who is not unduly active with his words and limits, comes under the category of Shishta or the good.

sn: नित्यं यज्ञोपवीती स्याच्छुक्लवासाः शुचिव्रतः। नियतो यमदानाभ्यां सदा शिष्टैश्च संविशेत्॥
en: One should always bear the sacred thread, wear white (clean) cloths, observe pure vows, and should always mix with good men, making gifts and practising self-control.

sn: जितशिश्नोदरो मैत्रः शिष्टाचारसमन्वितः। वैणवीं धारयेद् यष्टिं सोदकं च कमण्डलुम्॥
en: One should govern his lust and stomach, practise universal compassion, and be characterised by good conduct. One should bear a bamboo-stick, and a water-pot filled with water.

sn: अधीत्याध्यापनं कुर्यात् तथा यजनयाजने। दानं प्रतिग्रहं वापि षड्गुणां वृत्तिमाचरेत्॥
en: Having studied, one should teach likewise should celebrate sacrifices himself and officiate at the sacrifices of others. One should also make gifts made to oneself. Indeed, one's conduct should be marked by these six deeds.

sn: त्रीणि कर्माणि जानीत ब्राह्मणानां तु जीविका। याजनाध्यापने चोभे शुद्धाच्चापि प्रतिग्रहः॥
en: Know that three of these acts should form the livelihood of the Brahmanas, viz., teaching (pupils), officiating at the sacrifices of others, and the acceptance of gifts from a person who is pure.

sn: अथ शेषाणि चान्यानि त्रीणि कर्माणि यानि तु। दानमध्ययनं यज्ञो धर्मयुक्तानि तानि तु॥
en: As to the other duties which remain, numberir:g three viz., making of gifts, study, and sacrifice, these are accompanied by merit.

sn: तेष्वप्रमादं कुर्वीत त्रिषु कर्मसु धर्मवित्। दान्तो मैत्रः क्षमायुक्तः सर्वभूतसमो मुनिः॥
en: Observant of penances, self-controlled, practising universal mercy and forgiveness, and loO king upon all creatures impartially, the man who is conversant with duties should never be careless about those three acts.

sn: सर्वमेतद् यथाशक्ति विप्रो निर्वर्तयशुचिः। एवं युक्तो जयेत् स्वर्ग गृहस्थः संशितव्रतः॥
en: The learned Brahmana of pure hear, who leads the domestic mode of life and practise rigid vows, thus devoted and thus performing all duties to the best of his power, succeeds in conquering the celestial region.

description: The conduct of the Twice Born
sn: एवमेतेन मार्गेण पूर्वोक्तेन यथाविधि। अधीतवान् यथाशक्ति तथैव ब्रह्मचर्यवान्॥ स्वधर्मनिरतो विद्वान् सर्वेन्द्रिययतो मुनिः। गुरोः प्रियहिते युक्तः सत्यधर्मपरः शुचिः॥ गुरुणा समनुज्ञातो भुञ्जीतान्नमकुत्सयन्। हविष्यभैक्ष्यभुक् चापि स्थानासनविहारवान्॥
en: Properly studying thus to the best of his power, in the way described above, and likewise living as a Brahmacharin, one who performs the duties of his own order, endued with learning, observant of penances, and with all the senses under control, devoted to what is agreeable and beneficial to the preceptor, steady in practising the duty of truth, and always pure, should, with the permission of the preceptor, eat his food without decrying it. He should eat Havishya made from what is got in alms, and should stand, sit, and take exercise (as directed).

description: The conduct of the Twice Born
sn: द्विकालमग्निं जुह्वानः शुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः। धारयीत सदा दण्डं बैल्वं पालाशमेव वा॥
en: He should pour libations on the fire twice a day, having purified himself and with concentrated mind. He should always carry a staff made of Bilva or Palasha.

description: The conduct of the Twice Born
sn: क्षौमं कार्पासिकं चापि मृगाजिनमथापि वा। सर्वं काषायरक्तं वा वासो वापि द्विजस्य ह॥
en: The raiment's of the twice-born man should be linen, or of cotton, or dear-skin, or a cloth that is entirely brown-red.

description: The conduct of the Twice Born
sn: मेखला च भवेन्मौजी जटी नित्योदकस्तथा। यज्ञोपवीती स्वाध्यायी अलुब्धो नियतव्रतः॥
en: There should also be a girdle made of Munja-grass. He should bear maited locks on head, and should perform his ablutions daily. He should bear the sacred thread, study the scriptures, divest himself of cupidity, and be steady in the observance of vows.

description: The conduct of the Twice Born
sn: पूताभिश्च तथैवाद्भिः सदा दैवततर्पणम्। भावेन नियतः कुर्वन् ब्रह्मचारी प्रशस्यते॥
en: He should also satisfy the celestials with oblations of pure water, his mind being controlled the while, Such a Brahmacharin is worthy of being lauded.

description: The conduct of the Twice Born
sn: एवं युक्तो जयेल्लोकान् वानप्रस्थो जितेन्द्रियः। न संसरति जातीषु परमं स्थानमाश्रितः॥
