sn: इत्युक्तो भीमसेनेन प्रत्युवाच युधिष्ठिरः। नकुलं प्रति धर्मात्मा सर्वबुद्धिमतां वरः॥
en: Thus addressed by Bhimasena, Yudhishthira said, with respect to Nakula, these words:—'He was of righteous soul and the foremost of all persons gifted with intelligence.

description: The departure of Pandava princes from the world
sn: रूपेण मत्समो नास्ति कश्चिदित्यस्य दर्शनम्। अधिकश्चाहमेवैक इत्यस्य मनसि स्थितम्॥
en: He, however thought that there was nobody who equalled him in personal beauty. Indeed, he considered himself as superior to all in that matter.

description: The departure of Pandava princes from the world
sn: नकुलः पतितस्तस्मादागच्छ त्वं वृकोदर। यस्य यद् विहितं वीर सोऽवश्यं तदुपाश्नुते॥
en: It is for this that Nakula has fallen down. Know this, O Vrikodara! That O hero, which has been ordained for a person, must have to be borne by him.'

description: The departure of Pandava princes from the world
sn: तांस्तु प्रपतितान् दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवः श्वेतवाहनः। पपात शोकसन्तप्तस्ततो नु परवीरहा॥
en: Seeing Nakula and the others fall down Pandu's son Arjuna of white horses, that destroyer of hostile heroes, fell down in great grief of heart.

description: The departure of Pandava princes from the world
sn: तस्मिंस्तु पुरुषव्याघ्र पतिते शक्रतेजसि। प्रियमाणे दुराधर्षे भीमो राजानमब्रवीत्॥ अनृतं न स्मराम्यस्य स्वैरेष्वपि महात्मनः। अथ कस्य विकारोऽयं येनायं पतितो भुवि॥
en: When that foremost of men, who was gifted with the energy of Shakra, had fallen down, indeed, when that invincible hero was on the point of death, Bhima said to the king, 'I do not recollect any untruth uttered by this great one. Indeed, not even in just did he say anything false. What then is that for whose evil consequence this one has dropped down on the Earth?'

description: The departure of Pandava princes from the world
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच एकाह्रा निर्दहेयं वै शत्रूनित्यर्जुनोऽब्रवीत्। न च तत् कृतवानेष शूरमानी ततोऽपतत्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Arjuna had said that he would consume all our enemies in a single day. Proud of his heroism, he did not, however, do what he had said. Hence has he fallen down.

description: The departure of Pandava princes from the world
sn: अवमेने धनुर्गाहानेष सर्वांश्च फाल्गुनः। तथा चैतन्न तु तथा कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: This Phalguna disregarded all wielder of bows. One desirous of prosperity should never entertain such thoughts.

description: The departure of Pandava princes from the world
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा प्रस्थितो राजा भीमोऽथ निपपात ह पतितश्चाब्रवीद् भीमो धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्॥ भो भो राजन्नवेक्षस्व पतितोऽहं प्रियस्तव। किं निमित्तं च पतनं ब्रूहि मे यदि वेत्थ ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said so, the king went on. Then Bhima fell down, Having fallen down, Bhima addressed king Yudhishthira the just, saying. 'O king, see! I who am your darling have fallen down! Why have I dropped down? Tell me if you know it.'

description: The departure of Pandava princes from the world
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अतिभुक्तं च भवता प्राणेन च विकत्थसे। अनवेक्ष्यं परं पार्थ तेनासि पतित: क्षितौ॥
en: Yudhishthira said You were a great eater, and you used to boast of your strength. You never did attend. O Partha, to the wants of others while eating. It is for that, O Bhima that you have fallen down.

description: The departure of Pandava princes from the world
sn: इत्युक्त्वा तं महावाहुर्जगामानवलोकयन्। श्वाप्येकोऽनुययौ यस्ते बहुशः कीर्तितो मया।॥
en: Having said these words, the mighty-armed Yudhishthira went on, withoui loO king back. He had only one companion, viz., the dog of which I have repeatedly spoken to you which followed hiin now.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सन्नादयशक्रो दिवं भूमिं च सर्वशः। रथेनोपययौ पार्थमारोहेत्यब्रवीच्च तम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Causing the Heaven and the Earth to be filled by a loud sound, then Shakra came to the son of Pritha on a car and asked him to ascend it.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: स्वभ्रातृन् पतितान् दृष्ट्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। अब्रवीच्छोकसंतप्तः सहस्राक्षमिदं वचः॥ भ्रातरः पतिता मेऽत्र गच्छेयुस्ते मया सह। न विना भ्रातृभिः स्वर्गमिच्छे गन्तुं सुरेश्वर॥
en: Seeing the brothers fallen on the Earth, king Yudhishthira the just said to that deily of a thousand eyes these words, 'My brothers have all dropped down here! They must go with me. Without them by me I do not wish to go to the celestial region, O lord of all the celestials.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: सुकुमारी सुखार्हा च राजपुत्री पुरंदर। सास्माभिः सह गच्छेत तद् भवाननुमन्यताम्॥
en: The delicate princess (Draupadi) deserving of every comfort, O Purandara, should go with us! You should permit this.'

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: शक्र उवाच भ्रातॄन् द्रक्ष्यसि स्वर्गे त्वमग्रतस्त्रिदिवं गतान्। कृष्णया सहितान् सर्वान् मा शुचो भरतर्षभ॥
en: Shakra said You shall behold your brothers in the celestial region. They have reached it before you. Indeed, you shall see all of them there, with Krishna. Do not give way to grief, O chief of the Bharatas!

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: निक्षिप्य मानुषं देहं गतास्ते भरतर्षभ। अनेन त्वं शरीरेण स्वर्ग गन्ता न संशयः॥
en: Having renounced their human bodies they have gone there, O chief of Bharata's race! As for you, it is ordained that you shall go there in this very body of yours.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अयं श्वा भूतभव्येश भक्तो मां नित्यमेव ह। स गच्छेत मया सार्धमानृशंस्या हि मे मतिः॥
en: Yudhishthira said This dog, O lord of the Past and the Present, is highly devoted to me. He should go with me. My heart is full of mercy for him.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: शक्र उवाच अमर्त्यत्वं मत्समत्वं च राजन् श्रियं कृत्स्नां महतीं चैव सिद्धिम्। संप्राप्तोऽद्य स्वर्गसुखानि च त्वं त्यज श्वानं नात्र नृशंसमस्ति॥
en: Shakra said You have acquired today Immortality and a status equal to mine, O king, prosperity extending in all directions and high success, and all the felicities of heaven. Do you cast off this dog. In this there will be no cruelty.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अनार्यमार्येण सहस्रनेत्र शक्यं कर्तुं दुष्करमेतदार्य। मा मे श्रिया सङ्गमनं तयास्तु यस्याः कृते भक्तजनं त्यजेयम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O you of a thousand eyes, O you, who ere of righteous conduct, it is extremely difficult for one that is of righteous conduct to perpetrate an act which is unrighteous. I do not with that union with prosperity for which I shall have to cast off one that is devoted to me.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: शक्र उवाच स्वर्गे लोके श्ववतां नास्ति धिष्ण्य मिष्टापूर्ते क्रोधवशा हरन्ति। ततो विचार्य क्रियतां धर्मराज त्यज श्वानं नात्र नृशंसमस्ति॥
en: Indra said There is no place in the celestial region for persons with dogs. Besides the Krodhavashas take away all the merits of such persons. Thinking of this, acts, O king Yudhishthira the just! Do you abandon this dog. There is no cruelty in this.'

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच भक्तत्यागं प्राहुरत्यन्तपापं तुल्यं लोके ब्रह्मवध्याकृतेन। तस्मान्नाहं जातु कथंचनाद्य त्यक्ष्याम्येनं स्वसुखार्थी महेन्द्र॥
en: Yudhishthira said It has been said that the abandonment of one that is devoted in sinful beyond measure. It is equal to the sin of Brahmanicide. Hence, o great Indra, I shall not cast off this dog today from desire of my happiness.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: भीतं भक्तं नान्यदस्तीति चात प्राप्तं क्षीणं रक्षणे प्राणलिप्सुम्। प्राणत्यागादप्यहं नैव मोक्तुं यतेयं वै नित्यमेतद् व्रतं मे॥
en: This is my vow, viz., that I never give up a person that is terrified, not one that is devoted to me, nor one that seeks my help, saying, that he is destitute, nor one that is afflicted, nor one that has come to me, nor one that is weak in protecting oneself, nor one that begs for life. I shall never give up such a one till my own life goes away.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: इन्द्र उवाच शुना दृष्टं क्रोधवशा हरन्ति यद्दत्तमिष्टं विवृतमथो हुतं च। तस्माच्छुनस्त्यागमिमं कुरुष्व शुनस्त्यागाद् प्राप्स्यसे देवलोकम्॥
en: Indra said Whatever gifts, or sacrifices spread out, or libations poured on the sacred fire, are seen by a dog, are taken away by the Krodhavashas. Do you, therefore, renounce this dog. By renouncing this dog you will acquire the region of the celestial.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: त्यक्त्वा भ्रातृन् दयितां चापि कृष्णां प्राप्तो लोकः कर्मणा स्वेन वीर। श्वानं चैनं न त्यजसे कथं त्यागं कृत्स्नं चास्थितो मुझसेऽद्य॥
en: Having abandoned you brothers brothers and Krishna, you have, o hero, acquired a region of happiness by your own deeds. Why are you so stupefied? You have renounced everything. Why then do you not renounce this dog?

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: नु युधिष्ठिर उवाच न विद्यते संधिरथापि विग्रहो मृतैर्मत्यैरिति लोकेषु निष्ठा। स्ततस्त्यागस्तेषु कृतो न जीवताम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said This is well known in all the worlds that there is neither friendship nor enmity with the dead. When my brothers and Krishna died, I was unable to revive them. Hence it was that I renounced them, I did not, however, renounce them as long as they were alive.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: भीतिप्रदानं शरणागतस्य स्त्रिया वधो ब्राह्मणस्वापहारः। मित्रद्रोहस्तानि चत्वारि शक्र भक्तत्यागश्चैव समो मतो मे॥
en: To frighten one that has sought protection, the killing of a woman, the theft of what belongs to a Brahmana, and injuring a friend, each of these four, O Shakra, is I think equal to the abandonment of one that is devoted.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच तद् धर्मराजस्य वचो निशम्य धर्मस्वरूपो भगवानुवाचा युधिष्ठिरं प्रीतियुक्तो नरेन्द्र श्लक्ष्णैर्वाक्यैः संस्तवसम्प्रयुक्तैः॥
en: Hearing these words of king Yudhishthira the just, (the dog became transformed into) the deity of Virtue, who well pleased, said words to him in a sweet voice fraught with praise,

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: धर्म उवाच अभिजातोऽसि राजेन्द्र पितुर्वृत्तेन मेधया। अनुक्रोशेन चानेन सर्वभूतेषु भारत॥
en: Dharma said You are well born, O king of kings. and endued with the intelligence and the good conduct of Pandu! You have mercy for all creatures, O Bharata, of which this is a bright example!

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: पुरा द्वैतवने चासि मया पुत्र परीक्षितः। पानीयार्थे पराक्रान्ता यत्र ने भ्रातरो हताः॥
en: Formerly, O son, you were once examined by me in the forest of Dvaita, where your brothers of great prowess met with (an appearance of) death,

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: भीमार्जुनौ परित्यज्य यत्र त्वं भ्रातरावुभौ। मात्रोः साम्यमभीप्सन् वै नकुलं जीवमिच्छसि।॥
en: Disregarding both your brothers Bhima and Arjuna, you did wish for the revival of Nakula from your desire of doing good to your (step) mother.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: अयं श्वा भक्त इत्येवं त्यक्तो देवरथस्त्वया। तस्मात् स्वर्गे न ते तुल्यः कश्चिदस्ति नराधिपः॥
en: On the present occasion, thinking the dog to be devoted to you, you have renounced the very car of the celestials instead of renouncing him. Hence, O king, there is not one in Heaven that is equal to you.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: अतस्तवाक्षया लोका: स्वशरीरेण भारत। प्राप्तोऽसि भरतश्रेष्ठ दिव्यां गतिमनुत्तमाम्॥
en: Hence, O Bharata, regions of inexhaustible happiness are yours? You have acquired them, O chief of the Bharatas, and yours is a celestial and high end.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो धर्मश्च शक्रश्च मरुतश्चाश्विनावपि। देवा देवर्षयश्चैव रथमारोप्य पाण्डवम्॥ प्रययुः स्वैर्विमानैस्ते सिद्धाः कामविहारिणः। सर्वे विरजसः पुण्या: पुण्यवाग्बुद्धिकर्मिणः॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Then Dharma and Shakra, and the Maruts, and the Ashvins and other deities and the celestial Rishis, causing Yudhishthira to ascend on a car, went to the celestial region. Those beings crowned with success and capable of going everywhere at will,orode their respective cars.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: स तं रथं समास्थाय राजा कुरुकुलोद्वहः। अर्ध्वमाचक्रमे शीघ्रं तेजसाऽऽवृत्य रोदसी।॥
en: King Yudhishthira, that perpetuator of Kuru's race, riding on that car, ascended quickly, causing the entire sky to blaze with his effulgence.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: ततो देवनिकायस्थो नारदः सर्वलोकवित्। उवाचोच्चैस्तदा वाक्यं बृहद्वादी बृहत्तपाः॥ येऽपि राजर्षयः सर्वे ते चापि समुपस्थिताः। कीर्तिं प्रच्छाद्य तेषां वै कुरुराजोऽधितिष्ठति॥
en: Then Narada, that foremost of all speakers, gifted with penances, and conversant with all the worlds, from amidst that concourse of celestials, said these words:-'All those royal sages who are here have their achievements transcended by hose of Yudhishthira.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: लोकानावृत्य यशसा तेजसा वृत्तसम्पदा। स्वशरीरेण सम्प्राप्तं नान्यं शुश्रुम पाण्डवात्॥
en: Covering all the worlds by his fame and splendour and by his wealth of conduct, he has attained to the celestial region in his own (human) body! None else than the son of Pandu has been heard to achieve this.'

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: तेजांसि यानि दृष्टानि भूमिष्ठेन त्वया विभो। वेश्मानि भुवि देवानां पश्यामूनि सहस्रशः॥
en: O lord, look at these several abodes of the gods living on the earth, you see in the form of stars and constellations in the sky.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राजा वचनमब्रवीत्। देवानामन्त्र्य धर्मात्मा स्वपक्षांश्चैव पार्थिवान्॥ शुभं वा यदि वा पापं भ्रातृणां स्थानमद्य मे। तदेव प्राप्तुमिच्छामि लोकानन्यान्न कामये॥
en: Hearing these words of Narada, the righteous-souled king, saluting the celestials and all the royal sages there present, said, ‘Happy or miserable, whatever the region be that is now any brothers, I wish to proceed to. I do not wish to go anywhere else.'

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: राज्ञस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा देवराजः : पुरंदरः। आनृशस्यसमायुक्तं प्रत्युवाच युधिष्ठिरम्॥ स्थानेऽस्मिन् वस राजेन्द्र कर्मभिर्निर्जिते शुभैः। किं त्वं मानुष्यकं स्नेहमद्यापि परिकर्षसि॥
en: Hearing this speech of the king the chief of the celestials, Purandara, said these words pregnant with noble meaning, 'Do you live in this place, O king of kings, which you have acquired by your meritorious decds! Why do you still cherish human affections?

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: सिद्धि प्राप्तोऽसि परमां यथा नान्यः पुमान् क्वचित्। नैव ते भ्रातरः स्थानं सम्प्राप्ताः कुरुनन्दन॥
en: You have acquired great success, the like of which no other man has ever been able to attain. Your brothers, Odelighter of the Kurus, have succeeded in acquiring happy regions.

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: अद्यापि मानुषो भावः स्पृशते त्वां नराधिय। स्वर्गोऽयं पश्य देवर्षीन् सिद्धांश्च त्रिदिवालयान्॥
en: Human affections still touch you. This is Heaven. See these celestial Rishis and Siddhas who have attained to the region of the gods.'

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: युधिष्ठिरस्तु देवेन्द्रमेवंवादिनमीश्वरम्। पुनरेवाब्रवीद् धीमानिदं वचनमर्थवत्॥ तैर्विना नोत्सहे वस्तुमिह दैत्यनिबर्हण। गन्तुमिच्छामि तत्राहं यत्र ते भ्रातरो गताः॥
en: Endued with great intelligence, Yudhishthira answered the king of the deities once more, saying, 'O conqueror of Daityas, I venture not to live anywhere, separated from them! I wish to go there where my brothers have gone!

description: Shakra comes to the king and informs that he will see all his relatives and Kinsmen
sn: यत्र सा बृहती श्यामा बुद्धिसत्त्वगुणान्विता। द्रौपदी योषितां श्रेष्ठा यत्र चैव गता मम॥
en: I wish to go there where that foremost of women, Draupadi, of ample proportions and darkish complexion and gifted with great intelligence and righteousness of conduct, has gone!'

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted Narayana and Nara the best of male beings, as also Sarasvati the God of Learning, let us cry success.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: जनमेजय उवाच स्वर्गं त्रिविष्टपं प्राप्य मम पूर्वपितामहाः। पाण्डवा धार्तराष्ट्राश्च कानि स्थानानि भेजिरे।।।।
en: Janamejaya said-Having attained to Heaven, what regions were respectively attained by my grandsires of old, viz., the Pandavas, and the sons of Dhritarashtra?

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं सर्वविच्चासि मे मतः। महर्षिणाभ्यनुज्ञातो व्यासेनाद्भुतकर्मणा॥
en: I wish to hear this. I think that you know everything, having been taught by the great Rishi Vyasa of wonderful feats.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच स्वर्ग त्रिविष्टपं प्राप्य तव पूर्वपितामहाः। युधिष्ठिरप्रभृतयो यदकुर्वत तच्छृणु॥
en: Vaishampayana said Listen now to what your grandsires, Yudhishthira and others, did after having attained to Heaven, that place of the deities.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: स्वर्ग त्रिविष्टपं प्राप्य धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। दुर्योधनं श्रिया जुष्टं ददर्शासीनमासने॥
en: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira the just, saw Duryodhana gifted with prosperity and seated on an excellent seat.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: भ्राजमानमिवादित्यं वीरलक्ष्म्याभिसंवृतम्। देवैम॒जिष्णुभिः साध्यैः सहितं पुण्यकर्मभिः॥
en: He was effulgent like the sun and wore all the signs of heroic glory. And he was in the company of of many celestials of blazing effulgence and of Saddhyas of righteous deeds.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: ततो युधिष्ठिरो दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनममर्षितः। सहसा संनिवृत्तोऽभूच्छ्रियं दृष्ट्वा सुयोधने॥
en: Yudhishthira, seeing Duryodhana and his prosperity became suddenly overpowered with anger and turned back from the sight.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: ब्रुवन्नुच्चैर्वचस्तान् वै नाहं दुर्योधनेन वै। सहित: कामये लोकाँल्लुब्धेनादीर्घदर्शिना॥
en: He loudly addressed his companions, saying, I do not wish to share regions of bliss with Duryodhana who was stained by cupidity and possessed of little foresight.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: यत्कृते पृथिवी सर्वा सुहृदो बान्धवास्तथा। हतास्माभिः प्रसह्याजौ क्लिष्टैः पूर्वं महावने॥
en: It was for him that friends, kinsmen, over the whole Earth destroyed by is were whom he had greatly afflicted in the deep forest.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: द्रौपदी च सभामध्ये पाञ्चाली धर्मचारिणी। पर्याकृष्टानवद्याङ्गी पत्नी नो गुरुसंनिधौ॥
en: It was for him that the virtuous princess of Panchala, Draupadi of faultless features, our wife, was dragged into the midst of the countries before all our elders.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: अस्ति देवा न मे कामः सुयोधनमुदीक्षितुम्। तत्राहं गन्तुमिच्छामि यत्र ते भ्रातरो मम॥
en: You gods, I have no wish to even see Suyodhana. I wish to go there where my brothers are.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: नैवमित्यब्रवीत् तं तु नारदः प्रहसन्निव। स्वर्गे निवासे राजेन्द्र विरुद्धं चापि नश्यति॥
en: Narada, smiling told him, It should not be so. O king of kings In heaven, all enmities cease.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: यूयं सर्वे युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो मैवं वोचः कथंचन। दुर्योधनं प्रति नृपं शृणु चेदं वचो मम॥
en: O mighty-armed Yudhishthira, do not say so about king Duryodhana. Hear my words.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: एष दुर्योधनो राजा पूज्यते त्रिदशैः सह। सद्धिश्च राजप्रवरैर्य इमे स्वर्गवासिनः॥
en: Here is king Duryodhana. He is adored with the celestials by these righteous men and those foremost of kings, who are now jeweilers of Heaven.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: वीरलोकगतिः प्राप्ता युद्धे हुत्वाऽऽत्मनस्तनुम्। सुरसमा येन युद्धे समासिताः॥
en: By causing his body to be poured as a libation on the fire of battle, he has obtained the end which consists in attainment of the region for heroes. You and your brothers, who were veritable gods on Earth, were always persecuted by this one.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: स एष क्षत्रधर्मेण स्थानमेतदवाप्तवान्। भये महति योऽभीतो बभूव पृथिवीपतिः॥
en: Yet through his observance of Kshatriya practices he has acquired this region. This king was not terrified in a dreadful situation.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: न तन्मनसि कर्तव्यं पुत्र यद् द्यूतकारितम्। द्रौपद्याश्च परिक्लेशं न चिन्तयितुमर्हसि॥
en: O son, you should not bear in mind the woes inflicted on you on account of the match al dice. You should not remember the sufferings of Draupadi.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: ये चान्येऽपि परिक्लेशा युष्माकं ज्ञातिकारिताः। संग्रामेष्वथ वान्यत्र न तान् संस्मर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: You should not remember the other miseries which you suffered for the deeds of your kinsinen-the miseries, viz., that were due to battle or to other situations.

description: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana blazing with effulgence and seated on an excellent seat Dialogue between Yudhishthira and Narada
sn: समागच्छ यथान्यायं राज्ञा दुर्योधनेन वै। स्वर्गोऽयं नेह वैराणि भवन्ति मनुजाधिप॥ नारदेनैवमुक्तस्तु कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। भ्रातन् पप्रच्छ मेधावी वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥ यदि दुर्योधनस्यैते वीरलोकाः सनातनाः। अधर्मज्ञस्य पापस्य पृथिवीसुहृदां दुहः॥ यत्कृते पृथिवी नष्टा सहया सनरद्विपा। वयं च मन्युना दग्धा वैरं प्रतिचिकीर्षवः॥ ये ते वीरा महात्मानो भ्रातरो मे महाव्रताः। सत्यप्रतिज्ञा लोकस्य शूरा वै सत्यवादिनः॥ तेषामिदानीं के लोका दुष्टमिच्छामि तानहम्। कर्णं चैव महात्मानं कौन्तेयं सत्यसंगरम्॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं सात्यकिं च धृष्टद्युम्नस्य चात्मजान्। ये च शस्त्रैर्वधं प्राप्ताः क्षत्रधर्मेण पार्थिवाः॥ क्व नु ते पार्थिवान् ब्रह्मन्नैतान् पश्यामि नारद। विराटद्रुपदौ चैव धृष्टकेतुमुखांश्च तान्॥ शिखण्डिनं च पाञ्चाल्यं द्रौपदेयांश्च सर्वशः। अभिमन्युं च दुर्धर्षे द्रष्टुमिच्छामि नारद॥
en: Do you meet Duryodhana now politely. This is Heaven, O king! There can be no enmities here! Through thus addressed by Narada, the Kuru king Yudhishthira, gifted with great intelligence, enquired about his brothers and said, If these eternal regions reserved for heroes be Duryodhana's that unrighteous and sinful wretch, that man who was the destroyer of friends and of the whole world, that man for whose sake the entire Earth was devastated with all her horses and elephants and human beings, that man for whose sake we were burnt with anger in thinking of how best we inight remedy our wrongs, I wish him to see what regions have been attained by those great heroes, my brothers of high vows, steady achievers of promises, truthful in speech, and distinguished for courage. The great Karna, the son of Kunti, in capable of being baffled in battle, Dhrishtadyumna, Satyaki, the of Dhrishtadyumna and those other Kshatriyas who met with death in the observance of Kshatriya duties where are those kings, O sons Brahmana? I do not see, O Narada, Virata and Drupada and the other great Kshatriyas headed by Dhrishtaketu, as also Shikhandin, the Panchala prince, the sons of Draupadi, and Abhimanyu, irresistible in battle. Brahmana? I do not see, O Narada, Virata and Drupada and the other great Kshatriyas headed by Dhrishtaketu, as also Shikhandin, the Panchala prince, the sons of Draupadi, and Abhimanyu, irresistible in battle.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: युधिष्ठिर उवाच नेह पश्यामि विबुधा राधेयममितौजसम्। भ्रातरौ च महात्मानौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ॥ जुहुवुर्ये शरीराणि रणवह्नौ महारथाः। राजानो राजपुत्राश्च ये मदर्थे हता रणे॥
en: Yudhishthira said “You deities, I do not see here Radha's son of incomparable prowess, as also my largehearted brothers, and and Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas, those great car-warriors who poured their bodies (as libations on the fire of battle, those kings and princess who met with death for my sake in battle.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: क्व ते महारथाः सर्वे शार्दूलसमविक्रमाः। तैरप्ययं जितो लोकः कच्चित् पुरुषसत्तमैः॥
en: Where are those great car-warriors who possessed of the prowess of tigers? Have those foremost of men gained this region?

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: यदि लोकानिमान् प्राप्तास्ते च सर्वे महारथाः। स्थितं वित्त हि मां देवा: सहितं तैर्महात्मभिः॥
en: If thosc great car-warriors have obtained these regions, than only do you know, O good, that I shall live here with those greet ones.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: कच्चिन्न तैरवाप्तोऽयं नृपैर्लोकोऽक्षयः शुभः। न तैरहं विना रंस्ये भ्रातृभिर्जातिभिस्तथा॥
en: If this auspicious and eternal region has not becn gained by those kings, then, know, O gods, that without those brothers and kinsmen of mine, I shall not live here.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: मातुर्हि वचनं श्रुत्वा तदा सलिलकर्मणि। कर्णस्य क्रियतां तोयमिति तप्यामि तेन वै॥
en: At the time of celebrating the water rites (after the battle), I heard my mother say, Do you offer oblations of water to Karna! I am burning with grief.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: इदं च परितप्यामि पुनः पुनरहं सुराः। यन्मातुः सदृशौ पादौ तस्याहममितात्मनः॥ दृष्ट्वैव तौ नानुगतः कर्णं परबलार्दनम्। न ह्यस्मान् कर्णसहितान् जयेच्छक्रोऽपि संयुगे॥
en: I grieve also continually at this, O gods that when I marked the resemblance between the feet of my mother and those of Karna of high soul, I did not immediately place myself under the orders of that destroyer of hostile ranks! Ourselves joined with Karna, Shakra himself would have been unable to defeat in battle.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: तमहं यत्र तत्रस्थं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि सूर्यजम्। अविज्ञातो मया योऽसौ घातितः सव्यसाचिना॥
en: Wherever may that child of the sum be, I wish to see him. Alas, not knowing his relationship with us, I caused him to be killed by Arjuna.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: भीमं च भीमविक्रान्तं प्राणेभ्योऽपि प्रियं मम। अर्जुनं चेन्द्रसंकाशं यमौ चैव यमोपमौ॥ द्रष्टुमिच्छामि तां चाहं पाञ्चालीं धर्मचारिणीम्। न चेह स्थातुमिच्छामि सत्यमेवं ब्रवीमि वः॥
en: Bhima also of dreadful prowess and dearer to me than my life. Arjuna too, resembling Indra himself, the twins also who resembled the Destroyer the Destroyer himself in prowess, I wish to see ! I wish to see the princess of Panchala, of good conduct, I wish not to stay here. I tell you the truth.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: किं मे भ्रातृविहीनस्य स्वर्गेण सुरसत्तमाः। यत्र ते मम स स्वर्गो नायं स्वर्गो मतो मम॥
en: O foremost of the deities, what is Heaven to me if I am separated from my brothers? That is Heaven where those brothers of mine are. This in my opinion, is not Heaven.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: देवा ऊचुः यदि वै तत्र ते श्रद्धा गम्यतां पुत्र मा चिरम्। प्रिये हि तव वर्तामो देवराजस्य शासनात्॥
en: The Deities said If you wish to be there, go them, O son, forthwith, At the command of the king of the celestials, we are ready to do what you like.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: वैशम्पायन इत्युक्त्वा तं ततो देवा देवदूतमुपादिशन्। युधिष्ठिरस्य सुहृदो दर्शयेति परंतप॥ ततः कुन्तीसुतो राजा देवदूतश्च जग्मतुः। सहितौ राजशार्दूल यत्र ते पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: Having said so, the celestials then ordered the celestial messenger, o destroyer of enemies, saying, 'Do you show to Yudhishthira his friends and kinsmen, Then the royal son of Kunti and the celestial messenger went together, O fore-most of kings to that place where those chiefs of men were.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: अग्रतो देवदूतश्च ययौ राजा च पृष्ठतः। पन्थानमशुभं दुर्गं सेवितं पापकर्मभिः॥
en: The celestial messenger went first, followed by the king. The path was difficult and trodden by men of sinful deeds.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: तमसा संवृतं घोरं केशशैवलशाद्वलम्। युक्तं पापकृतां गन्धैर्मीसशोणितकर्दमम्॥ दंशोत्पातकभल्लूकमक्षिकामशकावृतम्। इतश्चेतश्च कुणपैः समन्तात् परिवारितम्॥
en: It was covered with thick darkness, and covered with hair and moss forming its grassy vesture. Polluted with the blood, it was filled with gad-flies and stinging bees and gnats and was endangered by the inroads of grisly bars. Rotting corpses lay here and there.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: अस्थिकेशसमाकीर्णं कृमिकीटसमाकुलम्। ज्वलनेन प्रदीप्तेन समन्तात् परिवेष्टितम्॥
en: Overspread with bones and hair, it was noisesome with worms and insects. It was bounded all along with a burning fire.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: अयोमुखैश्च काकाद्यैर्गुधैश्च समभिद्रुतम्। सूचीमुखैस्तथा प्रेतैर्विथ्यशैलोपमैर्वृतम्॥
en: It was infested by crows and other birds and vultures, tall having beaks of iron, as also by evil spirits with long mouths pointed like needles. And it was filled with inaccessible fastness like the Vindhya mountains,

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: मेदोरुधिरयुक्तैश्च च्छिन्नबाहूरुपाणिभिः। निकृत्तोदरपादैश्च तत्र तत्र प्रवेरितैः॥
en: Human corpses were scattered over it, smeared with fat and blood, with arms and thighs out off, or with entrails torn out and legs severed.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: स तत्कुणपदुर्गन्धमशिवं लोमहर्षणम्। जगाम राजा धर्मात्मा मध्ये बहु विचिन्तयन्॥
en: Along that path so disagreeable with the stench of corpses and awful with other incidents, the righteous-souled king went filled with various thoughts.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: ददर्शोष्णोदकैः पूर्णा नदीं चापि सुदुर्गमाम्। असिपत्रवनं चैव निशितं क्षुरसंवृतम्॥
en: He saw a river full of boiling water and therefore difficult to cross as also a forest of trees whose leaves were sharp swords and razors.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: करम्भवालुकास्तप्ता आयसीश्च शिलाः पृथक्। लोहकुम्भीश्च तैलस्य क्वाथ्यमानाः समन्ततः॥
en: There were plains full of fine white sand highly heated, and rocks and stones made of iron. There were many jars of iron all around, with boiling oil in them.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: कूटशाल्मलिकं चापि दुःस्पर्श तीक्ष्णकण्टकम्। ददर्श चापि कौन्तेयो यातनाः पापकर्मिणाम्॥
en: Many a Kuta-shalmalika was there with sharp thorns, and therefore, greatly painful to the touch. The son of Kunti saw also the tortures inflicted upon sinful men.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: स तं दुर्गन्धमालक्ष्य देवदूतमुवाच ह। कियदध्वानमस्माभिर्गन्तव्यमिममीदृशम्॥
en: Seeing that inauspicious region full of every sort of fouiness, Yudhishthira asked the celestial messenger, saying, How far shall we go along a path like this?

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: क्व च ते भ्रातरो मह्यं तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि। देशोऽयं कश्च देवानामेतदिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: You should tell me where those brothers, of mine are. I wish also to know what region is this of the celestials.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: स संनिववृते श्रुत्वा धर्मराजस्य भाषितम्। देवदूतोऽब्रवीच्चैनमेतावद् गमनं तव॥
en: Hearing these words of king Yudhishthira, the just, the celestial messenger stopped in his course and replied, saying, Thus far is your way.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: निवर्तितव्यो हि मया तथासम्युक्तो दिवौकसैः। यदि श्रान्तोऽसि राजेन्द्र त्वमथागन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: The dwellers of the celestial region ordered me that having come thus far, I am to stop! If you are tired, O king of kings, you may return with me. was sorrow

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: युधिष्ठिरस्तु निर्विण्णस्तेन गन्धेन मूर्च्छितः। निवर्तने धृतमनाः पर्यावर्तत भारत॥
en: Yudhishthira, however sorely disconsolate and stupefied by the foul stench. Resolved to return, O Bharata, he retraced his steps.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: स संनिवृत्तो धर्मात्मा दुःखशोकसमाहतः। शुश्राव तत्र वदतां दीना वाचः समन्ततः॥
en: Stricken with and grief, the righteous-souled king turned back. Directly then he heard piteous cries all around.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: भो भो धर्मज राजर्षे पुण्याभिजन पाण्डव। अनुग्रहार्थमस्माकं तिष्ठ तावन्मुहूर्तकम्॥
en: O son Dharma, O royal sage, O you of holy birth, o son of Pandu, do you say a moment of favouring us.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: आयाति त्वयि दुर्धर्षे वाति पुण्यः समीरणः। तव गन्धानुगस्तात येनास्मान् सुखमागमत्॥
en: At your approach, O invincible one, a delightful breeze has begun to blow, bearing the sweet smell of your body. We have been greatly relieved at this.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: ते वयं पार्थ दीर्घस्य कालस्य पुरुषर्षभ। सुखमासादयिष्यामस्त्वां दृष्ट्वा राजसत्तम॥
en: O foremost of king seeing you, O first of men, we have been highly pleased O son of Pritha, let that happiness last longer through your stay here for a few moments more.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: संतिष्ठस्व महाबाहो मुहूर्तमपि भारत। त्वयि तिष्ठति कौरव्य यातनास्मान् न बाधते॥
en: Do you remain here, O Bharata, for even a short time! As long as you are here O you of Kuru's race, tortures cease to afflict us.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: एवं बहुविधा वाचः कृपणा वेदनावताम्। तस्मिन् देशे स शुश्राव समन्ताद् वदतां नृप॥
en: This king, heard there these and many similar words, uttered piteously by persons in distress, reaching his ears from all sides.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: तेषां तु वचनं श्रुत्वा दयावान् दीनभाषिणाम्। अहो कृच्छ्रमिति प्राह तस्थौ स च युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Hearing those words of beings in distress, Yudhishthira of compassionate heart exclaimed aloud, Alas, how pain-full! and the king stood still.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: स ता गिरः पुरस्ताद् वै श्रुतपूर्वा पुनः पुनः। ग्लानानां दुःखितानां च नाभ्यजानत पाण्डवः॥
en: The words of those woe-begone and afflicted persons seemed to the son of Pandu to be uttered in voices that he had heard before although he could not, then recognise thein.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: अबुध्यमानस्ता वाचो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। उवाच के भवन्तो वै किमर्थमिह तिष्ठथ॥
en: Unable to recognise the voice, Dharma's son, Yudhishthira, enquired, saying, who are you? Why also do you stay here?

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: इत्युक्तास्ते ततः सर्वे समन्तादवभाषिरे। कर्णोऽहं भीमसेनोऽहमर्जुनोऽहमिति प्रभो॥
en: Thus addressed, they answered him from all sides, saying, I am Karna! I am Bhimasena! I am Arjuna!

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: नकुलः सहदेवोऽहं धृष्टद्युम्नोऽहमित्युत। द्रौपदी द्रौपदेयाश्च इत्येवं ते विचुक्रुशुः॥
en: I am Nakula, I am Sahadeva! I am Dhrishtadyumna! I am Draupadi! We are the sons of Draupadi! thus O king did those voice speak.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: ता वाचः स तदा श्रुत्वा तद्देशसदृशीर्नृप। ततो विममृशे राजा किं त्विदं दैवकारितम्॥
en: Hearing those cries, O king, uttered in voice of pain suitable to that place, the royal Yudhishthira asked himself, What perverse destiny is this?

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: किं तु तत् कलुषं कर्म कृतमेभिर्महात्मभिः। कर्णेन द्रौपदेयैर्वा पाञ्चाल्या वा सुमध्यया॥ य इमे पापगन्धेऽस्मिन् देशे सन्ति सुदारुणे। नाहं जानामि सर्वेषां दुष्कृतं पुण्यकर्मणाम्॥
en: What are those sinful deeds which were committed by those grcat beings, viz., Karna and the sons of Draupadi and the slenderwaisted princess of Panchala, so that they have been compelled to live in this region of fetid smell and great distress. I am not aware of any sin that can be attributed to these persons of auspicious deeds.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: किं कृत्वा धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रो राजा सुयोधनः। तथा श्रिया युतः पापैः सह सर्वैः पदानुगैः॥
en: What is that deed by doing which Dhritarashtra's son king Suyodhana with all his sinful followers, has acquired such prosperity?

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: महेन्द्र इव लक्ष्मीवानास्ते परमपूजितः। कस्येदानी विकारोऽयं य इमे नरकं गताः॥
en: Gifted with prosperity like that of the great Indra himself, he is reverently worshipped. What is that deed for which these (high-souled ones) have fallen into Hell?

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: सर्वधर्मविदः शूराः सत्यागमपरायणाः। क्षत्रधर्मरताः सन्तो यज्वानो भूरिदक्षिणाः॥
en: All of them knew duty, were heroes, were devoted to truth and the Vedas; were observant of Kshatriya practices, were righteous in their decds; were performers of sacrifices; and givers of large presents to Brahmanas.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: किं नु सुप्तोऽस्मि जागर्मि चेतयामि न चेतये। अहोचित्तविकारोऽयं स्याद् वा मे चित्तविभ्रमः॥
en: Am I asleep or awake? Am I conscious or unconscious? Or, is all this an aberration of the intellect?

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: एवं बहुविधं राजा विममर्श युधिष्ठिरः। दुःखशोकसमाविष्टश्चिन्ताव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Overwhelmed by sorrow and grief, and with his senses ruffled by anxiety, king Yudhishthira indulged in such thoughts for a long time.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: क्रोधमाहारयच्चैव तीव्र धर्मसुतो नृपः। देवांश्च गर्हयामास धर्मं चैव युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The royal son of Dharma was them filled with righteous indigatio. Indeed, Yudhishthira then censured the celestials as also Dharma himself.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: स तीव्रगन्धसंतप्तो देवदूतमुवाच ह। गम्यतां तत्र येषां त्वं दूतस्तेषामुपान्तिकम्॥
en: Afflicted by the very foul smell, he addressed the celestial messenger, saying, Return to the presence of those whose messenger you are.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: न ह्यहं तत्र यास्यामि स्थितोऽस्मीति निवेद्यताम्। मत्संश्रयादिमे दूताः सुखिनो भ्रातरो हि मे॥
en: Tell them that I shall not return to where they are, but shall stay even here, since, on account of my companionship, these afflicted brothers of mine have become comforted.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: इत्युक्तः स तदा दूतः पाण्डुपुत्रेण धीमता। जगाम तत्र यत्रास्ते देवराजः शतक्रतुः॥
en: Thus addressed by the intelligent son of Pandu, the celestial messenger returned to the place where the king of the celestials was, viz., he of a hundred sacrifices.

description: -Yudhishthira's solicitude for his brothers and kinsmen and the Princess of Panchala
sn: निवेदयामास च तद् धर्मराजचिकीर्षितम्। यथोक्तं धर्मपुत्रेण सर्वमेव जनाधिप॥
en: He represented to hiin the of Yudhishthira. Indeed, O king, he informed Indra of all that Dharma's son had said. acts

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच स्थिते मुहूर्त पार्थे तु धर्मराजे युधिष्ठिरे। आजग्मुस्तत्र कौरव्य देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः॥
en: King Yudhishthira the just, the son of Pritha, and not waited there for more than a imoment when, O you of Kuru's race all the celestials headed by Indra caine there.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: स च विग्रहवान् धर्मो राजानं प्रसमीक्षितुम्। तत्राजगाम यत्रासौ कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The God of Righteousness, in his embodied forin, also came to that place where the Kuru king was for seeing that monarch.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: तेषु भासुरदेहेषु पुण्याभिजनकर्मसु। समागतेषु देवेषु व्यगमत् तत् तमो नृप॥
en: Upon the coming of those celestials of resplendent bodies and sanctified and noble deeds, the darkness that had covered that region immediately disappeared.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: नादृश्यन्त च तास्तत्र यातनाः पापकर्मिणाम्। नदी वैतरणी चैव कूटशाल्मलिना सह॥ लोहकुम्भ्यः शिलाश्चैव नादृश्यन्त भयानकाः। विकृतानि शरीराणि यानि तत्र समन्ततः॥ ददर्श राजा कौरव्यस्तान्यदृश्यानि चाभवन्।
en: The tortures undergone by beings of sinful deeds were no longer seen. The river Vaitarani, the thorny Shalmali the iron jars, and the boulders of rock, so terrible to look at also vanished from sight. The various repulsive corpses also , which the Kuru king has seen, disappeared at the same time.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: ततो वायुः सुखस्पर्शः पुण्यगन्धवहः शुचिः॥ ववौ देवसमीपस्थः शीतलोऽतीव भारत।
en: Then a breeze delicious and fraught with pleasant smell, perfectly pure, and delightfully cool, O Bharata, began to blow on that spot on account of the presence of the celestials.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: मरुतः सह शक्रेण वसवश्वाश्विनौ सह॥ साध्या रुद्रास्तथाऽऽदित्या ये चान्येऽपि दिवौकसः। सर्वे तत्र समाजग्मुः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः॥ यत्र राजा महातेजा धर्मपुत्रः स्थितोऽभवत्।
en: The Maruts, with Indra, the Vasus with the twin Ashvins, the Saddhyas, the Rudras, the Adityas and the other dwellers of Heaven as also the Siddhas, and the Great Rishis, all came there where Dharma's royal son of great energy was.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: ततः शक्रः सुरपतिः श्रिया परमया युतः॥ युधिष्ठिरमुवाचेदं सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वचः। युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो लोकाश्चाप्यक्षयास्तव॥ एह्येहि पुरुषव्याघ्र कृतमेतावता विभो।
en: Then Shakra, the lord of the celestials, gifted with blazing prosperity, addressed Yudhishthira and consoling him, come, said, O Yudhishthira of mighty arms, come, come O king! These illusions have ended, O powerful one.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: सिद्धिः प्राप्ता महाबाहो लोकाश्चाप्यक्षयास्तव॥ न च मन्युस्त्वया कार्यः शृणु चेदं वचो मम।
en: You have acquired success O mighty-armed one, and have attained to eternal happy regions. You should not give way to anger. Listen to these words of mine.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: अवश्यं नरकस्तात द्रष्टव्यः सर्वराजभिः॥ शुभानामशुभानां च द्वौ राशी पुरुषर्षभ।
en: Hell, O son, should, forsooth, be seen by every king. There is enough of good and bad, O king.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: यः पूर्वं सुकृतं भुङ्क्त पश्चानिरयमेव सः॥ पूर्वं नरकभाग् यस्तु पश्चात् स्वर्गमुपैति सः।
en: He who enjoys first the fruits of his good deeds must afterwards suffer Hell. He on the other hand, who first endures Hell, must afterwards enjoy the celestial region.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: भूयिष्ठं पापकर्मा यः स पूर्वं स्वर्गमश्नुते॥ तेन त्वमेवं गमितो मया श्रेयोऽर्थिना नृप।
en: He whose sinful deeds are many enjoys the celestial region first. It is for this, o king, that desirous of doing you good, I caused you to be sent for having a view of Hell.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: व्याजेन हि त्वया द्रोण उपचीर्णः सुतं प्रति॥ व्याजेनैव ततो राजन् दर्शितो नरकस्तव।
en: You had by a pretence, deceived Drona about his son. You have, therefore been shown Hell by an act of decention.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: यथैव त्वं तथा भीमस्तथा पार्थो यमौ तथा॥ द्रौपदी च तथा कृष्णा व्याजेन नरकं गताः।
en: Like yourself, Bhima and Arjuna and Draupadi, have all been shown the place of sinners by an act of deception.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: आगच्छ नरशार्दूल मुक्तास्ते चैव कल्मषात्॥ स्वपक्ष्याश्चैव ये तुभ्यं पार्थिवा निहता रणे। सर्वे स्वर्गमनुप्राप्तास्तान् पश्य भरतर्षभ॥
en: Come, o king, all of them have been purged of their sins. All those kings who had sided you and who have been killed in battle, have all acquired the celestial region. Come and see them, O foremost one of Bharata's race.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: कर्णश्चैव महेष्वासः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। स गतः परमां सिद्धिं यदर्थं परितप्यसे॥
en: Karna the powerful bowman, that foremost of all wielders of weapons, for whom you are grieving, has also acquired high success.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: तं पश्य पुरुषव्याघ्रमादित्यतनयं विभो। स्वस्थानस्थं महाबाहो जहि शोकं नरर्षभ॥
en: See, O powerful one, that foremost of men, viz., the son of the Sum. He is in that place which is his own, O mighty-armed one. Kill this grief of yours, O king.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: भ्रातूंश्चान्यांस्तथा पश्य स्वपक्ष्यांश्चैव पार्थिवान्। स्वं स्वं स्थानमनुप्राप्तान् व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः॥
en: Look at your brother and others, those kings, that is who had taken your side. They have all attained to their respective places. Let the fever of your heart be removed.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: कृच्छ्रे पूर्वं चानुभूय इतःप्रभृति कौरव। विहरस्व मया सार्धं गतशोको निरामयः॥
en: Having suffered a little misery first, from this time, O son of Kuru's race, do you sport with me in happiness, horn of grief and all ailments.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: कर्मणां तात पुण्यानां जितानां तपसा स्वयम्। दानानां च महाबाहो फलं प्राप्नुहि पार्थिव॥
en: O mighty-armed one, do you now enjoy. O king the rewards of all your virtuous deeds, of those regions which you have acquired yourself by your penances, and of all your gifts.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: अद्य त्वां देवगन्धर्वा दिव्याश्चाप्सरसो दिवि। उपसेवन्तु कल्याण्यं विरजोऽम्बरभूषणाः॥
en: Let celestials and Gandharvas, and celestial Apsara, dressed in pure robes and beautiful ornaments, wait upon and serve you for your happiness.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: राजसूयजिताँल्लोकानश्वमेधाभिवर्धितान्। प्राप्नुहि त्वं महाबाहो तपसश्च महाफलम्॥
en: Do you, O mighty-armed one, enjoy now those happy regions which you have acquired through the Rajasuya-Sacrifice performed by you have been increased by the sacrificial scimitar employed by you. May you enjoy the great fruit of your penance.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: उपर्युपरि राज्ञां हि तव लोका युधिष्ठिर। हरिश्चन्द्रसमाः पार्थ येषु त्वं विहरिष्यसि॥
en: Your region, O Yudhishthira, are above, far above, those of kings. They are equal to those of Harishchandra, O son of Pritha. Come and sport there in bliss!

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: मान्धाता यत्र राजर्षिर्यत्र राजा भगीरथः। दौष्यन्तियत्र भरतस्तत्र त्वं विहरिष्यसि॥
en: Sharing the blissful region acquired by the royal sage Mandhatri, king Bhagiratha, Dushyanta's son Bharata, you will sport there in bliss.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: एषा देवनदी पुण्या पार्थ त्रैलोक्यपावनी। आकाशगङ्गा राजेन्द्र तत्राप्लुत्य गमिष्यसि॥
en: Here is the celestial river, sacred and sanctifying the there worlds. It is called celestial Ganga, Plunging into it, you will go to your own regions.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: अत्र स्नातस्य भावस्ते मानुषो विगमिष्यति। गतशोका निरायासो मुक्तवैरो भविष्यसि॥
en: Having bathed in this river, you will be divested of your human nature. Indeed, your grief dispelled, your ailments conquered, you will be freed from all enmities.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: एवं ब्रुवति देवेन्द्रे कौरवेन्द्रे युधिष्ठिरम्। धर्मो विग्रहवान् साक्षादुवाच सुतमात्मनः॥ भो भो राजन् महाप्राज्ञ प्रीतोऽस्मि तव पुत्रका मद्भक्त्या सत्यवाक्यैश्च क्षमया च दमेन च॥
en: While, O Kuru king, the chief of the celestials was saying so to Yudhishthira, the god of Righteousness, in his embodied form, then addressed his own son and said, O king, I am highly pleased, O you of great wisdom, with you, O son, by your devotion to me by your truthfulness of speech, and forgiveness, and self-control.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: एषा तृतीया जिज्ञासा तव राजन् कृता मया। न शक्यसे चालयितुं स्वभावात् पार्थ हेतुतः॥
en: This indeed, is the third test, O king, to which I put you. You are incapable, O son of Pritha, of being swerved from your nature or reason.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: पूर्वं परीक्षितो हि त्वं प्रश्चाद् द्वैतवने मया। अरणीसहितस्यार्थे तच्च निस्तीर्णवानसि॥
en: Before this, I had examined you in the Dvaita forest by my questions, when your brothers with Draupadi had fallen down.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: सोदर्येषु विनष्टेषु द्रौपद्या तत्र भारत। श्वरूपधारिणा तत्र पुनस्त्वं मे परीक्षितः॥
en: Assuming the shape of a dog, I examined you once more, O son when your brothers with Draupadi had fallen down.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: इदं तृतीयं भ्रातृणामर्थे यत् स्थातुमिच्छसि। विशुद्धोऽसि महाभाग सुखी विगतकल्मषः॥
en: This has been your third test; you have expressed your wish to stay at Hell for the sake of your brothers. You have become cleaned, O highly blessed one. Purified of sin, you happy.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: न च ते भ्रातरः पार्थ नरकारे विशाम्पते। मायैषा देवराजेन महेन्द्रेण प्रयोजिता॥
en: O son of Pritha, your brothers, O king, were not such as to deserve Hell. All this has been an illusion created by the king of the celestials.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: अवश्यं नरकास्तात द्रष्टव्याः सर्वराजभिः। ततस्त्वया प्राप्तमिदं मुहूर्तं दुःखमुत्तमम्॥
en: Forsooth, all kings, O son, must once see Hell. Hence have you for a little while been subjected to this great sorrow.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: न सव्यसाची भीमो वा यमौ वा पुरुषर्षभौ। कर्णो वा सत्यवाक् शूरो नरकार्दाश्चिरं नृप॥
en: O king, neither Arjuna, nor Bhima, nor any of those foremost of men, viz., the twins for Karna, ever truthful in speech and endued with great courage, could be deserving of Hell for a long time.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: न कृष्णा राजपुत्री च नरकारे कथंचन। एह्येहि भरतश्रेष्ठ पश्य गङ्गां त्रिलोकगाम्॥
en: The Princes Krishna too, O Yudhishthira, could not be deserving of that place of sinners, Come, come, O foremost of the Bharatas see Ganga, who spreads her current over the three worlds.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: एवमुक्तः स राजर्षिस्तव पूर्वपितामहः। जगाम सह धर्मेण सर्वेश्च त्रिदिवालयैः॥
en: Thus addressed the royal sage, viz., your grandsire, proceeded with Dharma and all the other celestials.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: गङ्गा देवनदी पुण्यां पावनीमृषिसंस्तुताम्। अवगाह्य ततो राजा तनुं तत्याज मानुषीम्॥
en: Having bathed in the celestial river Ganga, acred and purifying and ever worshipped by the Rishis, he renounced his human body.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: ततो दिव्यवपुर्भूत्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। निर्वैरो गतसंतापो जले तस्मिन् समाप्लुतः॥
en: Assuming then a celestial form, king Yudhishthira the jut, on account of that bath, became divested of all his enmities and grief.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: ततो ययौ वृतो देवैः कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। धर्येण सहितो धीमान् स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः॥
en: Surrounded by the celestials the Kuru king Yudhishthira then went away from that place. He was accompanied by Dharma, and the great Rishis uttered his praises.

description: The advent of the deities, and their adulation of the conduct of Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira plunges in the celestial Ganga and assumes a celestial body, Yudhishthira proceeds, in company with the deities, to share with his brothers and kinsmen the region which they have acquired for themselves
sn: यत्र ते पुरुषव्याघ्राः शूरा विगतमन्यवः। पाण्डवा धार्तराष्ट्राश्च स्वानि स्थानानि भेजिरे॥
en: Indeed, he reached that place where those foremost of men, those heroes, viz., the Pandavas and the Dhartarashtras, freed from (human) wrath, were enjoying each his respective position.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा देवैः सर्षिमरुद्गणैः। स्तूयमानो ययौ तत्र यत्र ते कुरुपुङ्गवाः॥
en: King Yudhishthira, thus honoured by the celestials the Maruts and the Rishis, went to that place where those foremost ones of Kuru's race were.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: ददर्श तत्र गोविन्दं ब्राह्मण वपुषान्वितम्। तेनैव दृष्टपूर्वेण सादृश्येनैव सूचितम्॥
en: He saw Govinda gifted with his Brahmaform. It took after that form of his which had been seen before and which, therefore, helped the recognition

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: दीप्यमानं स्ववपुषा दिव्यैरस्त्रैरुपस्थितम्। चक्रप्रभृतिभिर्घारैर्दिव्यैः पुरुषविग्रहैः॥
en: Shining in that forin of his, he was adorned with celestial weapon, such as the dreadful and discus and others in their respective embodied form.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: उपास्यमानं वीरेण फाल्गुनेन सुवर्चसा। तथास्वरूपं कौन्तेयो ददर्श मधुसूदनम्॥
en: He was being worshipped by the heroic Phalguna, who also was gifted with a blazing effulgence. the son of Kunti saw the destroyer of Madhu in also his own form.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ समुद्वीक्ष्य युधिष्ठिरम्। यथावत् प्रतिपेदाते पूजया देवपूजितौ॥
en: Those two foremost of Beings worshipped by al the celestials, seeing Yudhishthira, received him with proper honours.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: अपरस्मिन्नथोद्देशे कर्णं शस्त्रभृतां वरम्। द्वादशादित्यसहितं ददर्श कुरुनन्दनः॥
en: In an ther place, the delighter of the Kuru saw Karna, that foremost one among all holders of weapons, resembling a dozen Suns in splendour.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: अथापरस्मिन्नुद्देशे मरुद्गणवृतं विभुम्। भीमसेनमथापश्यत् तेनैव वपुषान्वितम्॥
en: In another part he saw Bhimasena of great power, sitting in the midst of Maruts; and gifted with a blazing form.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: वायोर्मूर्तिमतः पार्श्वे दिव्यमूर्तिसमन्वितम्। श्रिया परमया युक्तं सिद्धि परमिकां गतम्॥
en: He was sitting by the side of the god of wind in his embodied form. Indeed he was then in a celestial form gifted with great beauty, and had acquired with highest success.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: अश्विनोस्तु तथा स्थाने दीप्यमानौ स्वतेजसा। नकुलं सहदेवं च ददर्श कुरुनन्दनः॥
en: In the place belonging to the Ashvins the delighter of the Kuru saw Nakula and Sahadeva, each blazing with own effulgence.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: तथा ददर्श पाञ्चाली कमलोत्पलमालिनीम्। वपुषा स्वर्गमाक्रम्य तिष्ठन्तीमर्कवर्चसम्॥
en: He also saw the princess of Panchala, decked in garlands of lotuses, Having acquired the celestial region, she was sitting there, gifted with a form effulgent like the Sun.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: अखिलं सहसा राजा प्रष्टुमैच्छद् युधिष्ठिरः। ततोऽस्य भगवानिन्द्रः कथयामास देवराट्॥ श्रीरेषा द्रौपदीरूपा त्वदर्थे मानुषं गता। अयोनिजा लोककान्ता पुण्यगन्धा युधिष्ठिर॥
en: King Yudhishthira suddenly wished to question her. Then the illustrious Indra, the king of the celestials, spoke to him, I his one is goddess of prosperity herself. It was for your sake that she took birth, as the daughter of Drupada, among human beings coming not from any mother's womb, O Yudhishthira, gifted with agreeable perfume and capable of delighting he entire world.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: रत्यर्थं भवतां ह्येषा निर्मिता शूलपाणिना। द्रुपदस्य कुले जाता भवद्भिश्चोपजीविता॥
en: For your satisfaction was created by the wielder of the trident. She was born in the race of Drupada and was enjoyed by you all.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: एते पञ्च महाभागा गन्धर्वाः पावकप्रभाः। द्रौपद्यास्तनया राजन् युष्माकममितौजसः॥
en: These five highly blessed Gandharvas gifted with the effulgence of fire, and endued with great energy, were O king, the sons of Draupadi and yourself.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: पश्य गन्धर्वराजानं धृतराष्ट्र मनीषिणम्। एनं च त्वं विजानीहि भ्रातरं पूर्वजं पितुः॥
en: Look at Dhritarashtra, the king of the Gandharva, endued with great wisdom. Know that this one was the eldest brother of your father.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: अयं ते पूर्वजो भ्राता कौन्तेयः पावकद्युतिः। सूतपुत्राग्रजः श्रेष्ठो राधेय इति विश्रुतः॥
en: This one is your eldest brother, the son of Kunti, gifted with the effulgence of fire. The on of Surya, your eldest brother the foremost of inen even this one was known as the son of Radha.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: आदित्यसहितो याति पश्यैनं पुरुषर्षभम्। साध्यानामथ देवानां विश्वेषां मरुतामपि॥ गणेषु पश्य राजेन्द्र वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथान्। सात्यकिप्रमुखान् वीरान् भोजांश्चैव महाबलान्॥
en: He moves in the company of the Sun-God. Behold this foremost of Beings! Among the tribes of the Saddhyas, the celestials, the Vishvedevas, and the Maruts, see, O king of kings, the mighty car-warriors of the Vrishnis and the Andhakas viz., those heroes having Satyaki for their first, and those powerful ones among the Bhojas.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: सोमेन सहितं पश्य सौभद्रमपराजितम्। अभिमन्युं महेष्वासं निशाकरसमद्युतिम्॥
en: Look at the son of Subhadra, invincible in battle, now staying with Soma, He is the powerful bowman Abhimanyu, now gifted with the gentle effulgence of he Moon.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: एष पाण्डुर्महेष्वासः कुन्त्या मात्र्या च संगतः। विमानेन सदाभ्येति पिता तव ममान्तिकम्॥
en: Here is the powerful bowman Pandu, now united with Kunti and Madri. Your father frequently comes to me on his excellent car.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: वसुभिः सहितं पश्य भीष्मं शान्तनवं नृपम्। द्रोणं बृहस्पतेः पावें गुरुमेनं निशामय॥
en: Look at the royal Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, now in the midst of the Vasus, know that this one by the side of Brihaspati is your preceptor Drona.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: एते चान्ये महीपाला योधास्तव च पाण्डव। गन्धर्वसहिता यान्ति यक्षपुण्यजनैस्तथा॥
en: These and other kings, O son of Pandu, who had fought on your behalf now walk with the Gandharvas or Yakshas or other sacred, beings.

description: Yudhishthira sees Govinda in his effulgent Brahma form as also all his brothers and relations, the Princess of Panchala and her sons, his own father and mothers grandsire and preceptor, uncle and grandsons the Vrishni and Andhaka heroes
sn: गुह्यकानां गतिं चापि केचित् प्राप्ता नराधिपाः। त्यक्त्वा देहं जित: स्वर्गः पुण्यवाग्बुद्धिकर्मभिः।।२३।
en: Some have attained to the dignity of Guhyakas, O king. Having renounced their bodies, they have conquered the celestial region by the merit they had acquired through word, thought, and deed.

description: Janamejaya's query regarding the period "The heroes of Kurukshetra would remain in the celestial region,' Vaishampayana's reply, Termination of Janamejaya's SnakeSacrifice, His return from Takshashila to his capital after having dismissed the sacrificial priests with profuse gifts, The merits of the Mahabharata, The Savitri of the Mahabharata
sn: जनमेजय उवाच भीष्मद्रोणौ महात्मानौ धृतराष्ट्रश्च पार्थिवः। विराटद्रुपदौ चोभौ शङ्खश्चैवोत्तरस्तथा।॥ धृष्टकेतुर्जयत्सेनो राजा चैव स सत्यजित्। दुर्योधनसुताश्चैव शकुनिश्चैव सौबलः॥ कर्णपुत्राश्च विक्रान्ता राजा चैव जयद्रथः। घटोत्कचादयश्चैव ये चान्ये नानुकीर्तिताः॥ ये चान्ये कीर्तिता वीरा राजानो दीप्तमूर्तयः। स्वर्गे कालं कियन्तं ते तस्थुस्तदपि शंस मे॥
en: Janamejaya said Bhishma and Drona, those two great persons, king Dhritarashtra, and Virata and Drupada, and Shankha and Uttara, Dhrishtaketu and Jayatsena, and Shakuni the son of Subala, Karna's sons of great prowess king Jayadratha, Ghatotkacha and others whom you have not mentioned, the other heroic kings of shining forms, tell me for what period they remained in the celestial region.

description: Janamejaya's query regarding the period "The heroes of Kurukshetra would remain in the celestial region,' Vaishampayana's reply, Termination of Janamejaya's SnakeSacrifice, His return from Takshashila to his capital after having dismissed the sacrificial priests with profuse gifts, The merits of the Mahabharata, The Savitri of the Mahabharata
sn: आहोस्विच्छाश्वतं स्थानं तेषां तत्र द्विजोत्तम। अन्ते वा कर्मणां कां ते गतिं प्राप्ता नरर्षभाः॥
en: O best of twice-born, did they live in Heaven for ever? What was the end acquired by those best of men when their acts terminated.

description: Janamejaya's query regarding the period "The heroes of Kurukshetra would remain in the celestial region,' Vaishampayana's reply, Termination of Janamejaya's SnakeSacrifice, His return from Takshashila to his capital after having dismissed the sacrificial priests with profuse gifts, The merits of the Mahabharata, The Savitri of the Mahabharata
sn: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं प्रोच्यमानं द्विजोत्तम। तपसा हि प्रदीप्तेन सर्वं त्वमनुपश्यति॥
en: I wish to hear this, O foremost of twiceborn persons, and, therefore, have I asked you. By virtue of your blazing penances you see all things.
